text: My gals and I were feelin just a little dehydrated. Maybe due to the shots last night. But who can really say. Anyways... now we are feeling like a million bucks. The staff was super friendly and we were having a good ole time. I would recommend to anyone to anyone feeling a little under the weather or who tiene una resaca.

Please for the love of god never ever rent from here. I know it's tempting but PLEASE DONT DO IT. If I could give it -10000 stars I would. They are relatively attentive prior to signing a lease, but once you have you're screwed. If you have issues the only method of contact is email. If you ask questions they will ignore you, they "go out of town" the 1st-5th so you can't ask questions without being late on rent. They allowed us to go without a heater for a week in the middle of winter. Our manager Emily is the absolute worst part about this company. She's rude, demeaning, lies to you every step of the way, and refuses to communicate with you if you're unhappy. Don't even think about trying to move out early. You have to pay rent till it's taken over, advertising fees, utility bills and $1000 lease break fee. Plus you have to forfeit your massive deposit ($1200) then pay an additional $500+ when you move out because you don't have a deposit anymore. And when I questioned Emily about these things, she conveniently "went out of town". 

Plus the positive reviews were given in exchange for a discount. So don't trust those.

Very small but dynamic!  My daughter ordered the Reuben which is her favorite sandwich, and declared this one the BEST one she's had in the country!  True rye bread, corned beef, and the perfect amount of thousand island dressing.  My BLT came with 3/4 lb. of wonderful bacon!  I pulled most of it out to eat the sandwich, but it was gone by the end of the meal with all of us picking pieces out.  My other daughter got the tuna salad sandwich and loved it.  My husband got the turkey bacon sandwich and was the first one finished!  Very fast service.  Super friendly!  Will visit again when we come back!

Only until a few months ago, the building that houses Shichi Sushi Bar was the longtime home of Marvin's Cameras. The owners of nearby Seven Restaurant saw an opportunity with the Main Street store front and decided Belleville was in need of a sushi bar.

It's no accident, then, that they decided to name their sushi bar Shichi, which is Japanese for seven. Shichi opened the same weekend as the 2012 Art on the Square show in downtown Belleville.

Belleville has one other sushi restaurant, but Shichi has the ambiance you would more closely associate with a sushi bar.

In both visits, I was impressed with the freshness of the food and the seasonings. Many restaurants in the Belleville area are afraid to experiment with seasonings. Sushi, like Seven, isn't, and that's a good thing.

I was pleased with the service during both my visits. My first visit was during Art on the Square, and I was impressed with how Shichi handled the sizable crowd.

Save your time/money and go to either Tinos, Sam's To Go, or South Coast Deli. This place is over priced and they don't give you nearly as much meat than any of the other places I listed. $11.50 for a standard sandwich? no thank you!

My husband & I were celebrating our Anniversary for this dinner. I made reservations on Open Table and
The hostess knew we were celebrating yet nothing special was done so that was a bit disappointing. Other places we've gone over the years have done something at the end or
During dinner. As for the food, I had the caprese salad which was very good. For dinner I had the lobster tail and shrimp stuffed with crab. The waiter recommended the Mac & cheese so I got it. It was very average. I was also disappointed in the portions given for the seafood considering the large price tag. My husband got steak and also thought it was just ok. We also booked for
The rooftop and were told they had to shut it down that night.

What is the fuss about this place? Goldy's is just a basic breakfast place. It's very small so you always have to want to get a seat. The food is acceptable but the staff are removed and disinterested in the customers on a human level. I don't know if they are disgruntled actors from LA but they don't have much of an interest people or their jobs. There is nothing great to say about the food. Its the same standard as you get at Denny's. There are much better places in Boise to eat breakfast. Certainly better service elsewhere. This is NOT the place to go in Boise,

Heard great things about this quaint family run neighborhood restaurant in Metairie, much to our surprise, our dining experience far exceeded our expectations. First of all, my wife & i are world travelers & eat out very often. We know quality food, wine & service. We also know there are only a handful of quality restaurants in Metairie that really care about good food & service... This is one of them. Offering a modern take on Creole classic cooking. Good menu selection , chefs specials & quality wine list. 
Reasonable prices, cozy ambience, lots of parking. 
Get the fish du jour, paired w/ haicoverts, jasmine rice & crab burre blanc or the farm raised stewed rabbit piquaint over dirty rice.
Dinner served tuesday thru saturday, 5-10 daily, closed sun & mon
Overall we had a great experience. Our waitress was very attentive and the food was good

Beautiful space, with excellent Indian/fusion cuisine. Excellent service, cocktails, and food.  

Not generally a fan of Indian food, but this was remarkable!

Mediocre in terms of food and service.  My boyfriend and I stopped in here Saturday afternoon on a whim because there was a Groupon and we were hungry.  The $3 Guinness was a pleasant surprise.  I ordered a veggie burger and my boyfriend had some sort of chicken wrap.  He enjoyed his, but my veggie burger was pretty bland.  I opened up the bun and dumped a bunch of salt and pepper on it.  The server wasn't rude or anything, but she wasn't friendly or nice.  When my boyfriend asked for a water, she said okay but proceeded to clear two tables, wipe them down, go stand at the bar and check her phone, talk to the bartender, and then finally bring over a water.  There were at least 8 empty tables and not a lot of people coming in, so no need to do all that before grabbing a quick water.
I don't know.  It was just mediocre.  Not terrible, not good.

Excellent place to sit, relax and enjoy a hookah. No loud club style music and no disturbances. Proper made hookah, the way it should be and reasonably priced as well. 
$16 for alfakher and $19 for startbuzz or paan flavor. Would definitely go again!

Great food, good service....We had Kristin as our waitress, upbeat and helpful.  Loved the roasted oysters, one of them was really tiny...so when I pointed it out to the manager, Ronald,  not only did he give us another full order, he did not make me feel bad about it.....First class, and the food is just as good....We went on a Saturday nite, be sure to make reservations...
The beer is amazing but the food is terrible. Go for drink and to play their games, eat at one of the other great restaurants in Phoenixville.

The hype and reviews are warranted. Everything was delicious and some things exceeded my expectations. I'm a sucker for great service, and it is impeccable here.

The cocktails are tasty and I'll definitely be wanting to try more on future visits.

Our server, Dillion, was just a treat. Never felt rushed and he was super helpful and informative.
He suggested cheese curds, grilled shrimp, or blue crab gratin for appetizers. We went for the cheese curds and blue crab gratin. Now, I can admit that I'm not the biggest fan of cheese stuffed anything, let alone fried cheese. Don't hate it, don't go out of my way to get things like that. Girlfriend wanted to try them though. These cheese curds. It seems like such a simplistic thing, but they were so good. Not greasy like your typical fried food and just perfect in the seasoning with a great little aioli for dipping. I've seen and heard about the blue crab gratin and that delivered. I scraped every last bite I could get in the dish it was served in.

For entrees, my girlfriend got the mahi and I got the beef cheeks. Both incredible. Seasoning and flavors were spot on. The beef cheeks came apart with just the scrape of a fork. So tender. Like pot roast. It came on a bed of seeded rice with some peas and greens. The rice and peas reminded me of that fake fried rice you get at Chinese buffets, but in the best way possible. Everything just worked together. I was so full towards the end of my dish, but I could not stop eating.

At first, we weren't going to do dessert as we were both stuffed. But, Dillion tempted us with the menus and he reeled us in. So we ordered one to share. We wanted something simple so we went for "The Cookie." They're baked fresh to order so we got a few minutes to let our stomachs settle. It was the simple sweet we needed to top off our meal.

For places that receive rave reviews all around, I try to keep my expectations tame. Well, they knocked it out of the park. Not a single complaint about any aspect of the meal.
I'm so happy to finally have tried O+O and I will definitely be back.

We had a great night sitting at the bar and enjoying amazing vegan food. I seriously love going to places where I can order anything on the menu! They were a bit busy when we were there, but the food was quick and delicious and the drinks were pretty dang good too. Definitely going back!

Jade and the rest of the Moxie Blue staff made my experience excellent. With new precautions put into place due to COVID-19 I felt at ease being back in the salon. I was spaced out, each seat or bowl was sanitized before and after, and everyone work masks. Jade absolutely met all my hair expectations when it came to highliting and cut. I couldn't imagine going anywhere else and getting the same quality.

I had terrible customer service when ordering delivery through doordash. I payed for a vermicelli bowl with egg rolls but only received egg rolls. When I called the staff, they said it wasn't their problem it was doordash's.
So many great food options. Can get a little hot inside when it's crowded. like most philly brunch spots this one is BYOB.

came here the other night for a birthday dinner and had a pleasant time! the inside is so cute and open windows made a very nice ambience for the summer time.

we started with the poke, arugula salad and crab tacos. crab tacos were very good! crab was fresh and seasoned well. the arugula salad could have used more fruit and dressing, too much arugula and bland. the poke was good but a little too much mayo/dairy product on it for my taste.

i had the steak medallions which were seasoned so well and cooked a perfect medium. the potato croquettes were also very good; nice and crispy.

 i tried a bite of the veal meatloaf which was surprisingly really good! the pancetta gives it a nice fatty taste that i enjoyed.

the crab cakes which i had the highest hopes for let us down. i wish they were broiled, not fried. the crab was dried out on the inside and didn't taste that fresh.

I love that this place is BYOB and with great service! I'll definitely be back to try more of their dishes!
Impressed with the service. I bought a uniform last minute and they were able to complete it within 30 minutes.

Extremely disappointed this time. I have been buying sandwiches here for years and I have never had a problem until recently. My order has come with bread that either stale or has been exposed to air all day. I buy my sandwiches in the evenings but I still expect fresh bread.  Since this has happened more than once, there is some kind of quality control problem at this shop.

Music 
     Loud not great loud 
     If it's louder is sounds better right - nope
Cleanliness
     Not very 
     Dirty floors and tables 
Food 
     Average bar food nothing special

Favorite fast food. Food always freshly hot. High quality ingredients. Sometimes the wait is a bit, but it's worth it because the food is fresh. I like that I can get a burger, chicken tenders, cheesesteak hoagie, a shawarma, a gyro, falafel and hummus all in same place. And the fries are so damn good.

I made an appointment online and received an email confirmation. I arrived 6 min prior to my scheduled appointment and the store/ shop was closed. 
I called and left a voice mail and replied to my emailed confirmation. 
Approx half an hour later I received an email from someone at the store that the store/ shop was closed today probably because of Memorial Day weekend but why does their website allows appointments and confirms these appointments! 
No note on the door that they were closed all day. 

Very bad to have a customer waste one hot of driving time, gas and making arrangements to get there on time to be disappointed.
Very neat store, something there for everyone. They do not allow pictures to be taken inside.

Been a customer from the start.  Couple of young ladies, Cindy and Laurie who took the leap into small business and have done it extremely well.  Added a great young stylist, Paige and continue to grow their business.  Lots of returning customers, always a good recommendation for a service business.  Favourite for a lot of people working in the legislature area of downtown. 
Great service, great cuts at good value, friendly atmosphere with good conversation.  What more can you ask?
If I can give it zero I would. Don't tell someone to hold on then take 3 others food orders. Left went to Taco Bell.
Delicious! Very unique atmosphere. There is bowling and a pool here. I think it's a bit over priced but still a fun place to eat and hangout.

My boyfriend and I were looking for an oyster/seafood place and decided to eat here based on the many stellar reviews. The dinner started out with a negative tone. The very first thing our server told us was to get him when we're ready to order.. He also never asked what kind of drinks we wanted and just gave us water and didn't even tell us what the specials were. We noticed the other waiter around us did all of this for every single one of his tables.

As for the food it came out unusually quick in under 10 minutes, which I can't complain because the chargrilled oysters were probably the BEST I ever had! Yes you heard me right. In the few years I've been eating chargrilled oysters nothing tops this place's. I even found a small pearl in one. The bread that came with the oysters had a unique tasting butter on it and was the icing on the cake.
As for the seafood platter, the shrimp, fries, fish, tarter sauce, and even the coleslaw were all spectacular. & this is coming from someone who doesn't like fried anything! 

Despite the less than service we received, Felix is a MUST TRY in NOLA for oysters and seafood!! The atmosphere was chill, the rooms were spacious and bright, and it wasn't crazy loud either because the rooms were divided. 

Out of all the food places in downtown NOLA to choose from, this is a place I would potentially come to eat at again. The food was unforgettable.

This is by far is an amazing pepperoni slice! Huge, fast, flavorful! Chicken bacon ranch was outstanding and even the bbq pork sounds nasty but is a great intoxicating blend of flavors to wow your tongue!

They make everything fresh and I wanna take a moment to highlight the seeet potato pie. IT. IS. DIVINE. Definitely the best sweet potato pie I've ever had the privilege of devouring. During Mardi Gras they stuff king cakes with their sweet potato pie filling (it won at King Fest one year)!!
Charming, small, quaint, yet delicious food. Excellent lamb chops and pate. Have had other things on the menu, but these two are the ones that keep me returning.
I've stayed here several times because I absolutely love this hotel. It's charming, sweet and in an ideal location. The rooms are clean and quiet and the staff tops anything you'll find in Philly.

Good, good GOD, a carnivore's haven. Cochon Butcher had been on my radar for a very long time. 

Cochon (and the take out Butcher) is a restaurant that industry folks, talk about outside of New Orleans as one of the most exciting places to open in the city in the past five years. Tasty, well executed food, moderately priced, accessible atmosphere. Back in the day I Iived in New Orleans for a spell but the restaurant opened just as I was leaving. It's been destination number one ever since

Decided to get my money's worth this go around-- Cochon de Lait Po Boy with swiss, mushroom gravy, and crispy fried onions, Buckboard bacon Melt special with braised Kale on pressed bread, beef brisket sliders, pancetta mac and cheese, house made boudin with spicy mustard. 

I can say they were all great, a few were incredible. The brisket had an wonderfully robust flavor matched by just the right amount of sweetness. The Cochon De Lait Po-Boy was, for me, a highlight. The pork was melt in your mouth, the gravy was light and acted more like a jus than a sauce on top. Melted cheese, crispy friend onions, you can't really go wrong.The meat didn't taste slow roasted over direct heat, but nonetheless, it was heavenly.

Pancetta mac and cheese was pretty straight forward but, hey, it was rich and creamy and very well made. The bacon melt didn't floor me, but more because i didn't know what I was getting myself into. Buckboard bacon is made from the butt or loin and is much leaner, more the consistency of ham. I was expecting fatty pork belly underneath all that kale and swiss and was a little disappointed, but come to think of it, if that sandwich had been my standalone lunch it still would have been one of the best sandwiches I've had in a while. 

I'm on of hundreds singing this places praises, but for good reason. Go!

We have always had great food and service at this location. We found our server Gary to be very personable and attentive! Caesar salad is so cold and delicious. Love the rolls with cinnamon butter too!

Great meal at a reasonable price. This was probably the most tender veal I have ever had and that is saying a lot. My husband and I eat out frequently and love trying new places. This is definitely worth going to. The food was great and they were attentive without making you feel rushed. BYOB.

This Scotty's is hit or miss, and I blame it all on the managers: they need to train their staff (host, servers, and cooks) better. For instance, I have ordered the Lucy and it came out like a burnt piece of charcoal. Other times it came out juicy and medium. Some of the servers and bartenders act like they hate their jobs. The VIP program is a mess too -- the bartenders shouldn't have to track down a manager (who always seems to be hiding) to make an adjustment. The food is a tad expensive too, but it's very convenient to my boyfriend's condo, so I don't mind. 
That being said, today was the way Scotty's should be (and is on 96th). My server, India, was prompt and very friendly. My Lucy burger was prepared perfectly, and India gave me what I needed without hovering. She is a veteran server, and I could tell. (Unfortunately the have had done turnover with staff, which you can tell.) 
I will continue to eat there, but the management needs to step up!

Omg I Don't Know Where To Start But I walked Pass this Place Twice Because it was empty so I was skeptical to eat here but a nice good looking guy was smiling at us and and told us to dine in and we did and the handsome guy who recommend this place was our server lol Devin He was  Beyond Helpful And the Food Was awesome And All his recommendations were good we will definitely we back Mr Ed you have a wonderful staff keep it up :)
Love this super cool donut shop. They have a cool fire place and a variety of donut flavors. Plenty of parking and good service.

Ordered jerk chicken and oxtail. 
All of the food tasted old and had a styrofoam taste from the food being reheated in the takeout containers. 
The oxtail didn't even look or taste like oxtail. 
The chicken tasted like it was at least a week old. 
As bad as all that was, the mac n cheese was horrible and not eatable. Very disappointed. I am not sure how they can stay in business. 
I will stick with Wildfire Or Reggae Grill in Camden.

I've been going here for 16 years and this place is just as amazing now as it was when I first tried it.  This is not your Americanized Chinese restaurant but instead is a nice modern Chinese restaurant that has a lot of great options for non-chinese people like myself. Definitely try the pepper steak and the seafood basket!!

Having grown up on the east coast I am very familiar with and a discerning NY style pizza eater.  One of the toughest things to find in the Midwest is good NY style pizza.  It's got to have a good cheese to sauce balance, fold nicely so you can eat it, and dough that is not too thick with a nice chew.  This place checked all the boxes for me.  It took me a few years living in the Chicago burbs before I found a reliably good pizza place.  I take one trip to Indianapolis and found this gem!  We had a plain cheese pie and a half mushroom and half veggie pie.  Both were delicious.  I might have liked a slightly more zesty sauce, but that is a minor quibble.  If you like NY style pizza, this place is definitely on point!

Not as impressed as some of the reviews led us to hope. My wife and I decided to give this place a try last night as a to go order. Maybe that's where we screwed up.
Since we ordered to go, we were only at the location for a few minutes for pickup. First impression is it is a pretty cool little place with a nice atmosphere. It may have helped that last night was a beautiful cool evening and they had the place opened up. But it definitely seems like it could be a good place to go have a drink and a bite with some friends.
As far as the pizza... we ordered a margherita pizza and a sausage & peppers pizza. Total was over $33 plus tip. Basically that's for 2 slightly larger than personal size pizzas. Ok if the pizza is phenomenal but a little on the high side if not. Maybe it could be phenomenal if you eat on site fresh and hot out of the oven. That's where I say maybe we screwed up by getting it to go. By the time we got home, the paper thin part of the crust was almost soggy and falling apart. Toppings & sauce were good and combinations were tasty. The chewy & charred sourdough crust is definitely unique and I could definitely see potential if fresh out of the oven. Just wasn't great to go.
I'd say we'll definitely give this place another try in the future but next time we'll eat on site and add a few drinks.

Kayla & Randy are so genuine and it makes learning the wisdom that they have to share so much easier.  Our dog Bane (Bullmastiff puppy) has responded so well to the tips and "tricks" we were taught to help manage him.  Learning how to best communicate in a canine manner has been enlightening and it's amazing to see Bane react positively.
Having Bark Busters available to us for fine-tuning of Bane has been sp helpful and comforting.
I highly recommend Kayla & Randy and Bark Busters and wouldn't use anyone else!!

Okay.... New favorite sandwich-- fatty melt. Ugh, it's so good! It's so juicy and the rye bread combo is great. The thickness of the bread holds the sandwich together. I could eat another one right now. If you're on the fence and want something other than a traditional burger try the fatty melt!!

Oh man, Bodega is great. The entrees are delicious and I love their drinks. I usually get the Pollo Asado. If you've never had it, you should give guarapo a try. Freshly squeezed sugar cane is an interesting treat. It's not terribly sweet, but it has good flavor.

My friend, Tracy, and I had a wonderful time at the Button Bash. We enjoyed playing several vintage pinball game machines, air hockey, and even some pool. It was wonderful to feel like teenagers again. We loved it and plan to bring our teens to one of their monthly all-age events soon.

Everyone at Press Start was terrific. Art, however, was totally a stand out among the other gems. He was just amazing! We had several points of contact with him and it was like meeting up with an old friend. 

The pizzas from Pizzava were delicious. They had a wonderful variety of slices to choose from. 

The Peanut Butter and Jelly Old Fashion from the bar was tasty and unique. We also enjoyed a couple of samples from the Verdi Distillery. My favorites were the garlic one paired with the Bloody Mary mix. 

We enjoyed just hanging out for awhile on those couches, as well. We were chatting with another Yelper whom I thought looked familiar, but we couldn't figure out how we knew each other. After a few minutes of chatting, I figured it out. We had both cosplayed the 13th Doctor Who at the recent Reno Pop Culture Con and stopped to get a picture together. Small world. Yes, we are now Yelp friends. 

I especially love the Yelp events like these when we give back to the community and am proud to be a part of this generous Yelp community. This was a wonderful way to end 2019.

So, we were told there was a two hour wait, stepped outside, made an Open Table reservation and where then immediately seated. Had fun waltzing back in to the same woman, looking her in the eye and saying. "We have a reservation". 

The highlights were happy hour 75 cent oysters and half price wine along with great service from Maddie and Kenny. The pate was great and generous. 

Lowlights. Crab and tuna appetizers were great, but tiny portions for $15. Did not order any entrees because I'm not a tourist and won't pay $28 for a soft shell crab sandwich or boiled shrimp. Spent nearly $100 and left hungry.

Slurp, sip, savor. I try to maintain a low-carb lifestyle and this restaurant easily accommodates my choices by allowing the Ramen to be optional. All the flavor is there without the carbs. Of course it's also worth an excellent splurge meal too. The restaurant reminds me of a cute little Ramen place in Vancouver that we just loved. Totally cute and insta worthy. Order on a touchpad and in a blink, you'll be slurping away!

If you are looking for faux bibimbap, this place is it. Tried all the different types of bowls. They are healthy options which I see appeals to the masses. 

The top bap steammed vegetables could have been steamed a bit longer. They were barely warm. All the sides in the classis bowls were cold making the rice and the protein cold fast.

The protein serving size is small. The chicken wings were fried on point. It could have used some salt.

I would only try this place again if next time I did take out and had access to a microwave to actually have warm food. Charging extra to have a warm stone bowl to warm the food is not cool.

Looking forward to a nice NYE dinner... limited menu did not offer any of the items popular at Roys...NO BUTTERFISH? Menu made more limo listed buy 86ing most of the dessert and entrees.  At $200 this gets very aggravating... add a hour wait and the new year is getting off to a sour start.  Big let down Roy

As much as I like new restaurants that push the envelope of tastes with new combinations, I have to admit that simple food done well still makes for an enjoyable meal.  Such is the case at Dawson's which was packed even on a Thursday lunch.  To avoid a wait, I was able to sit at the bar where the bartender did a great job.  Not only did he manage the folks seated around the counter (it quickly filled), but he took care of all the folks in the room including a large party of 12 that wanted individual checks!  That's is efficiency and impressive.

He let me know all the daily specials and soon had my order in.  I went with a lunch special of the Chicken Salad Sandwich that came with a small side of fresh fruit.  I also ordered a cup of French Onion Soup.  Being so packed, I expected some delay in getting my order, but was a little disappointed that the soup didn't come out first.  Instead, it was served at the same time as my sandwich.  The folks who ordered salads as their sides got them ahead of time, so I was hoping the soup would come so I could occupy some of my wait time.  

The soup did taste wonderful and the cheese was soft and stretchy, the kind where you can separate it with just the spoon, but almost always need your fingers to break those few strands that cling to the cup.  Nice flavor with just the right amount of saltiness.

The side of fruit was disappointing.  Some of the fruit was chilled, some looked a little 'soft'.  Some rind was still on the cantelope, but not much.  This could have been much better.

The sandwich came on my choice of wheat bread which was thick and had a chewy crust that was okay, but not great.  There was a large dollop of chicken salad, probably about a cup, in the center of the sandwich like it had been placed by an ice cream scoop.  Would have taken much time to spread it evenly?  I remedied the distribution, but it just made the restaurant seem like it was taking shortcuts.  The flavor of the salad was okay, but I did like that there was lots of chicken and they had sliced grapes which I always appreciate in my salad.  Overall, just an okay sandwich.

So, I would give a 5 for the service, a 4 for the soup, and a 3 for the sandwich & fruit.  They obviously have a good value for the quality of food since the place was packed, so if you want something affordable, then definitely stop by.

Review #1974
STOP READING THIS REVIEW AND GO TO THIS RESTAURANT! without a question thus us the best authentic Mexican place I've been to! The prices are even better than the taste

Amaaaaaazing. 

If you go, the breakfast foods are the way to do it! I favorite is the broken yolk sandwich with bacon. It is absolutely too delicious. Last time I got the Omelette You Cant Refuse: bacon, potatoes, cheese, sour cream. So good. If your meal comes with a choice of bread on the side, get the cinnamon toast, delicious.

For lunch, I've only had nibbles of my husbands food (I always get the breakfast since it is served all day), but the chicken salad was good, as was a salad he got.

Coffee is good, hot chocolate is great.

Putting this review in a little late but I walked in Simons and wanted to purchase a pre-owned Rolex. I asked a worker to view the Rolex and he proceeded to tell me that due to prior issues he could not show me the watch and that his manager would have to show me the watch. While the manager showed me the watch two workers went and stood by the door. However, there were other customers in the store looking at jewelry with no problems. I did not feel welcomed and completely discriminated against. I have purchased several Rolex watches from other authorized Rolex dealers with exceptional service but I will never be purchasing from Simons. They have horrible customer service. I felt like I was treated like a criminal.
They are the best auto body place. Honest good people!!! Their work is excellent!!! I've worked in the insurance business for 25years.

Thank you Westin Philadelphia for a really nice stay on Saturday night. My husband and I were in town for 24 hours to meet up with friends, so at the last minute I bid on Priceline for a hotel. We snagged the Westin for $115 for the night. 

The Westin is in a great location with lots of shopping, dining, drinking, and touristy attractions literally steps away. We decided to skip using the hotel valet and parked in a garage around the corner. There are tons of garages to choose from, and unfortunately, we chose poorly. $26 for 24 hours...OK that is fine. But then, it's $20 for an hour! So because we opted for late checkout, parking ran us $46. Our fault for not reading the sign the day before, but beware.

Even though we arrived slightly before noon on Saturday, we were able to check in immediately and head to our room. The room is really spacious and the bed is...heavenly. Or something like that. It's heavenly if you like nice, soft beds. Me, not so much. But it was fine and I slept like a baby. Although I'm not sure if that was because of the bed or the 13.5 hours of drinking we did. Because of said drinking, we called for late checkout on Sunday and were able to check out at 1 pm with no problem. The only thing about our stay that was a negative was the shower and the water temperature. It literally would take 10 minutes to get our shower hot or anywhere near the temperature I turned the handle too. Not sure if that is a hotel problem or just a room 633 problem. 

Overall we had a really nice stay in a lovely hotel. I would not hestitate to stay at the Westin Philadelphia on a future visit due to price, location, and the room.

I've been here about 10 billion times. Dave Bailey is a genius. Rooster is fun, quirky, not too pricey, and perfect for dining al fresco. You've gotta get the Memo (mimosa with pomegranate) and you can't go wrong with the Swedish pancake or any of the crepes. A favorite among the St. Louis young, semi-broke and fabulous set.

Since moving to NOLA in January, Mr. B's has consistently been recommended to me time after time. Recently a work colleague was making her departure to her next city; so, I figured Mr. B's would be the perfect spot for her going away dinner. I have to say I was not disappointed in the least! We had the bacon wrapped shrimp and grits, gumbo, cocktails, and an assortment of desserts. It was all delectable. I have to say, I have already wanted to go back for the shrimp and grits alone!
Amazing atmosphere. We went for lunch and afternoon drinks. The perfect sunny afternoon place.

Welcome to Reno, Pine State Biscuits! I am sooo happy you're here. And it's cute that they're settled on Center and Pine. 

Went in their first week open and was amazed. For only being open a day or two and in somewhat a small space, they were on it. I kept it simple my first visit: the reggie deluxe (a pine state classic), biscuits and gravy, s'mores pop tart and sweet tea.

Oh my, it was all delightful and so satisfying. One hundred percent a place you want to stop in on a weekend morning. The biscuits were big and fluffy. The sweet tea was sweet and tall. The piece of fried chicken on the reggie was HUGE! I didn't know how to attack that sandwich, but if you can eat it without a knife and fork, I applaud you. The gravy was rich and flows down whatever dish you're having. Biscuits and gravy were good too, but the star was definitely their classic reggie. As for the pop tart, it stole my heart. Wish I had eaten it warm because it went a little stale sitting their, but it was still uber good. The chocolate in the middle was sweet, the pastry was crisp and the marshmallows fluffy! 

I truly can't wait to come back to Pine State Biscuits!

This place just gets better each time I visit. The enchilada sauce is amazing! The nachos were just right amount of crispy, and the steak taco  shell was grilled slightly and such a nice surprise. The pollo Cancun was perfect! Donaldo our server was full personality and very attentive. To top it off, they were playing the Stanley cup game 7 and dis not mind we stayed until the end.

The "Family Size" Pizza is fantastic!  We have always been completely satisfied with the service and food. If you are looking for quality pizza at a decent price for a group (or delicious leftovers), this is definitely the place to go.

They forgot to make our order. When I arrived, the worker at the counter had no idea about my order until he found the ticket under some receipts. I guess the guy who took my order just wrote it down and forgot immediately? Since they hadn't even started our food, I got food somewhere else because it was going to take so long to make our dishes. What a waste of my time.

Update: My wife ordered from them, and the food was delicious. Hopefully them messing up our first order was a rare mistake, and they have better service in the future. I hope this place succeeds!

Bought my first car here in the summer--the salesman (Tom Kelley) we got was very professional, helpful, cheerful, and accommodating...I had actually been shopping around for a car for a while before I just decided to check out Team Toyota as I was passing it on the highway.  So glad I did though!
Was able to work with us a lot to get the price we could pay for the car...He was also very patient, and even invited us to the back room for food and cold drinks!  Guess he was trying really hard to make us feel at home and comfortable with him (nice sales tactic, huh?)..Also the facilities are nice, and seemed more "open" and spacious than some other ones we went to.  
A week after getting my car, a hubcap had fallen off of the car for whatever reason, and he actually was able to replace it for us at no cost even though it wasn't covered under the warranty.  Great service :)

I had an experience similar to Stephanie C's review of 7/22/20. I'm new to Tucson and I purchased a Groupon for an exam and cleaning that included a discount for any other needed services. I went in for an exam and got a few x-rays and received a periodontal exam by a hygienist. I saw the dentist for a few minutes after that. I did not receive a regular cleaning. They recommended a periodontal cleaning and also laser treatments, for a total of over $1000 with the Groupon discount, which I scheduled at that time. Shortly thereafter I went for a second opinion from a periodontist, who said my gums were fine for my age and there was no periodontal disease, and that I just needed the routine preventive dental cleaning. He further said that an unnecessary periodontal cleaning and laser treatment could actually be damaging to my gums. I'm not going back.

My husband, our daughter, and I went in to have linner and we got seated pretty quickly. Our table wasn't even cleaned off, I used a wipe to clean it off because there was no one around to ask them to clean it off. Then we sat there for 10 minutes waiting for someone to take our drink order and about 6 servers walked past us and didn't even come to our table. No one even took a drink order. Then a couple came in AFTER us and they were waited on BEFORE US!!  We stood up and left. There was also another woman in there with her baby and her other child. God only knows how long they were waiting to be waited on, they still had their menus on the table and they were there before we even got seated. This establishment is going down hill FAST. And it's not just this location, but the Voorhees, NJ one as well!!
Great food and friendly staff. The atmosphere is upscale lounge with EDM music with DJs and private VIP areas.

The system was down today and couldn't take money. That's okay. They gave me my coffee and did so with a smile. The lady ahead of me was a complete douche. She was all cranky about it. That's okay douche lady. I tipped them $10 and will continue to go to this Star Bucks. Minus one virtual star for not having a drive through in Safeway for my lazy moments. Plus one virtual star for the employees being fabulous! I love you to the moon and back coffee. I mean Starbucks.
First time here. great fresh food. had mufulatta sandwich and chili. omg! will be back to try everything. great staff on top.

I found my new favorite breakfast restaurant. The menu is extensive. The Leprechaun Benedict was as tasty as it was unique.  We sampled the Liege Waffles and will order them the next time. The service was faultless.  They even provided "lawn chairs" for those on the waiting list.  Thank you,  Baja Cafe for an enjoyable eating experience.

Came for the food as we normally like these types of Cajun venues.  But this is by far the worst one.  The food was meh.  Order peeled shrimp sauce was flavor less.  Sweet potatoes fries weren't good they looked stored bought frozen fat fries.  Michelada had no taste.

My husband got a nail in the tire and found out that our spare tire on our new-used car didn't fit! Bad luck :( So after a frustrating night and the road side assistance, the next morning I had the car towed to Les Schwab (even though it's a huge chain, I've never heard of it since we're new in town) and they fixed the tire for free.  Phew! Because 4 new tires would have been over $900.  I will definitely go back to them if I need something small done that we don't need to go to the dealer
Really great massage at an excellent price! Sunny is highly recommended, I have been looking for an experienced and thorough massage and ai definitely found it!
Great price, fast service, and delicious smoothie. Place is small and decors are ok, but doesn't matter if the smoothie are superb.
Sunday brunch was mediocre at best.  Nothing fancy.  All breakfast meats were pork.  Bottomless mimosas were good.

The Red Velvet Elvis would be my last meal before death.

It's the best treat ever. 

Love the flying cupcake!  

My only wish--Bring one to the Westside! 
(My office is close to the Illinois Street location-- but I still wish it was closer...)

Still amazing! It's been years since I went to this Maggiano's but the service and the food are still right on.  I had a reservation on mother's day and we were seated promptly at 12 PM.  We chose to do the family style dining and our fave dishes were the calamari, stuffed mushrooms, mom's lasagna and the lemon cookies.  Great place for a special event or just when you want to eat well and get good service.

great spot to hit up for lunch in the elmwood area - and thank god for that. there's nothing worth a damn in that area, as far as healthy eats go. albeit it's a little pricey for a wrap that's predominantly greens, i thoroughly enjoyed my wrap. i got the turkey & avocado wrap and added chevre to it. i liked how the turkey was literally shredded. one downside was that there was way too much dressing on it. i'd likely go without dressing and sub something else, like walnuts. 

everything was fresh and tasty. i did grab one of the cucumber lemonades and regretted it after i saw that it was $3. not worth it in my book, but it was pretty decent. from my understanding, you can order any of the salads as a wrap, which should be the case because all of the wraps are basically a salad wrapped up. duh.

YUM! I love this place! It's so good and fast! The portions are more than enough for one person. The baked cheese grits are my favorite side. If you can't eat it all which I usually can't I take it home and reheat it and it taste so good!

I wanted to go here and discover the complaints were overblown. And yes, I know the reality of Mexican restaurants on Cinco de Mayo so I was prepared to give the benefit of the doubt.

I can't. 

They should have opened well before today. The staff is far too inexperienced for this. I had friends who arrived at 1:30 pm and did not get a table for hours. There were tables, mind you. They were just being seized by whoever got to them first and no one was attempting stop it. I know because my group did it too.

The place was packed and there didn't seem to be any monitoring of who was coming or going - or, on that note, how many people were here. The only way to get service was to flag down a server like a total asshole. I had one margarita and was underwhelmed. Shouldn't that be one thing that's good in a place like this?

I think they had a live band which would have maybe been cool but I could barely hear the person next to me, let alone some musicians across the patio.

Building is nice. Get some experienced staff and a good GM in here!

Eclectic store full of high quality items. If you're downtown and bored from the park and want to see something new and different, come on by to check it out. This store occupied a antique like building with multiple floors of exploration. 

I love their dresses, including ones at urban outfitter when they bring out their new year specials. I also like their accessories section, gotten a little bag that I'm still using for years now from here. 

They make great gifts, even if it's in the clearance section. Check out their online store!

I found this nail salon about a year ago and honestly will not go anywhere else!!! Everyone there is so amazing and customer service is number one on their list you must go there. They do get busy at times and there may be a wait but well worth it!!!!!!

I tried OC Tan yesterday for the first time and am NOT disappointed! I love how natural the color is after the first shower. I'm only seeing a few splotches around my underarms but I think that is due to dry skin - I think if I triple my exfoliation efforts it won't be an issue next time. Danielle did a great job explaining all of the details/options and answering some of the aftercare questions I have had. I will absolutely be going back and cannot wait to tell my friends and family about the great experience. :)
My fave pub to go watch a game and grab some food... the pizza is delicious with the right amount of sauce and meats... the crust is also great!  The service is always fast and friendly...

Had the best move in experience with Kayla from the Leasing office. She was pleasant and kind and was very attentive to my constant needs!! (Sorry Kayla! Lol) and also thank you Emma & Justin for some additional help.

We have used this company twice now for windshield replacement. Both times we have gotten the U.V. film protector and the tinted visor strip. We could not be happier with this company, the windshield has looked great both times and that U.V. protector film is the best! They keep in contact with you about when they will be coming by and call about 30 minutes before they arrive. They have worked on both my car and my husbands Raptor, and did a great job on both.
This last time when the tech came out I was at home with my two small kids, he was so friendly to my kids, made the process seamless, and was done quickly. Insurance gave a slightly hard time about not using their contracted provider but let me tell you it is worth the "hassle" of having the insurance company come out to take a few photos of the car in order to use this great company. 
We will be using Clear View Glass and Tint for all of our car window needs indefinitely.

Love the Rialto. It is the perfect sized venue. You can be way in the back and still get a great view. Because of the moderate size of the venue, the Rialto is definitely not the place for huge mainstream acts (think Justin Timberlake or Katy Perry). This is perfectly fine with me, as most of the music I prefer would gravitate towards venues like Rialto. In fact, the Rialto has housed some of my absolutely favorite bands.

Drinks are pricey but not too much so. Plus, the great location ensures one can drink well before and after the show. 

Love the Rialto murals on the side of the venue announcing upcoming shows. Who does that anymore? I hope the Rialto always keeps those.

Came here with a group on a Friday - yay for BYOB! The bread was probably the best part, and it wasn't even warm. I ordered the wild boar pappardelle, which was very meh. The pasta was a bit overcooked and actually clumped together. My friend who ordered the mushroom pappardelle didn't even bother to finish it. The calamari was decent. Heard the salmon and lamb were also decent. 

The ambiance is cute, but it gets super loud. It was often difficult to hear the person sitting right next to you. Service was fine.
Great selection and great prices.  We drive from Brandon so my daughter can get trendy clothes for a very reasonable price.  Their sales are great too!

Location, location, location!  They have the spot.  We sat outside and enjoyed people watching.  Started with crispy calamari and complimentary pita bread... moved on to generous sized side salads and finally the best part kebabs.  I had portabella and hubby had chicken... both deliciously grilled.


We will be back - good service too - never felt rushed as we enjoyed the meal

These are by far the best wings I've ever had. My boss orders them for use when we have meetings and I always load up my plate. We usually get spicy, buffalo, lemon pepper with ranch. Hands down better than most places I've been.

Great shop! Mac was awesome sauce!  Best beard cut I've ever had.  Industrial Massager... need I say more.  Hot lather around the neck with a straight razor. When I'm back in town, I know exactly where to go.  A plus is the fountain square area is a great place to explore.

I stop and get the charbroiled oysters when I am passing through New Orleans and have time. The chicken and sausage gumbo is really good, too! The service is always great. It's always clean and has a fun vibe.  This is a must stop for New Orleans seafood!

While walking around the Dunedin craft fair, knew that Mexican would make hubby happy. Yelpers helped lead us to the fun atmosphere of Casa Tina. The decor alone is worth 5 stars. Because of the crowd at the fair every place was packed. Told there would be 30 min wait but must've been our lucky day cuz after 5 min, I went to check if we had time to walk around and host decided to seat us right then. Awesome! 

Queso fundido translates to fun cheese. Wasn't sure if we wanted cup or bowl but glad we went with cup. Gelatinous glob of ooey gooey melted cheese mixed with salsa and onion served with tortillas!  Yummy for my tummy. Healthy?  Um, let's not go there! 

Love that all offerings come with veggie choice!  Smart!  Listen up other restaurant owners!  Due to the festival, it was a special smaller menu but no problemo. The tostada vagabunda with veggies was good. Got it w/o beans and didn't eat the rice. Two crunchy corn tortillas with veggies, cheese with guac and sour cream on the side. 

Hubby opted for tamales and said they were good. 

Saw lots of mixed reviews. Service was great and food good so not sure why some bad reviews. Maybe a case of go and make up your own mind.

I recommend avoiding this place at all cost. I was referred for an endoscopy and a colonoscopy. Before they will do anything they require full payment of whatever your co-pay and deductible will be. I appreciated this because I would rather have all of this taken care of and not have to worry about all these bills and insurance forms coming later and having to figure it out. After paying approximately $400 in addition to my insurance,  the procedure was completed. A few months later I received a bill for an additional sum of nearly $800. Assuming that this was some sort of issue with the insurance company and the bill and knowing that I had already paid my complete portion I did not pay any attention to the statements. I began getting phone calls from a collection agency and protested. I was then told that there was a separate bill for a separate organization within the doctors office. I found this to be very misleading and deceptive but paid the bill less the 200 and some odd dollar "collection cost."  They have since reported negative information to the credit bureaus and damaged my credit.  I have always had flawless credit and this is the very first time in my life that negative information has been reported.  This place is a money mill and that is all they are interested in. I recommend going to a hospital or some other not-for-profit for these procedures that this place offers.  
Still bad. They called to supposedly "resolve the issue."  They did nothing but mess up my credit...

Lovely nails is exactly what this place is! I've had 24 years of pedicures but not like this! They offer 6 different kinds of pedicures with different price ranges and length of massages. They truly care about the spa experience. From the hot towel wraps (done three times on me). Hot stones massage. When you get a 10 min massage they actually turn a timer on so you know it's 10 mins. The products they use are decadent. The atmosphere is relaxing. It is super clean in here. The staff is friendly and attentive. Prices are the same as other nail salons. I did go to a nail salon near by, but that place felt like a factory. Lovely nail is a spa and worth every dollar and min you spend here. I got the Mandarin & Mango spa pedicure with 10 min massage. They end the pedicure with a neck massage! I mean come on how fabulous is this place!!  They even give a neck massage for a nail treatment as well. My new go to place. Wonderful experience!

I went to Jillian's a couple of times during my recent weekend trip to Indy.  The first night we ended up here for a couple of drinks in the first floor bar and after the Colts game on Sunday, we came back for some post-football bowling.  I am generally in favor of places that offer both drinking and some sort of entertainment, and Jillian's did not disappoint.  Great to have a place like this downtown for the out-of-town crowd.  Thumbs up!

I came to this facility with family and was very appalled just by walking in, the place was so small and dirty. They're massage chairs were dirty and did not work. The owner was cleaning peoples feet with the same gloves she cleaned the trash cans with. They did not properly give a pedicure, they rushed the whole process and did not let anyones feet soak. They let the supplies they used on costumers touch the trash can and then continued to use them with the costumers. This place was an all around horrible experience just from being there with someone else, I would not suggest going to this horrendous place.

Mr Boyd was extremely professional and i would not hesitate to call him again for service. He made the effort to add us onto his full Saturday schedule and we really appreciated. He was very knowledgeable about my dad's clock and what was needed. Thank you Mr Boyd!

We stopped into numerous "honky tonk" bars along Broadway and this was my favorite.  It might be because I was totally in love with the band performing on the top floor.  They were great!

Three total floors, with a heated rooftop bar as well.  Despite the very chilly temperatures we could comfortably stand right by the open garage doors.  There was plenty of room on the second and third floors to enjoy the great live music - no fighting through a jam-packed crowd, finally!!!

Staff was great and the beer selection was better than I expected.

Definitely the highlight of my bar-hopping!

Ordered $50 worth of hoagies and sides for a family lunch. The service was slower than glacial speeds and the sandwich makers looked like questionable characters. They were rude and unsavory. When I got home the the meatball sandwich I had ordered wasn't even hot enough to melt the cheese. The chicken parm sandwich tasted of a foul aftertaste like the defrosted chicken had gone bad. The spongiest hoagie bread to accompany the lack luster filling of every sandwich left us all disappointed. Will never return to this establishment and be warned do not waste your money here. If I could give less then one star.... I would !!!
one of the best nail salons i've been to by far! everyone there is super sweet and friendly and welcoming. the man that did my nails did amazing and i definitely recommend you come here!!
The service could be better also eliminating the ability to smoke anywhere would be great. Food was okay and $21 for a fish bowl drink that was loaded with "shots" a joke not strong at all.

This is one of my favorite places to go with girlfriends. We have so much fun drinking sangria, this is super duper delicious here and sharing tapas. Last night I went with one of my besties and we had the best time sitting outside and sharing conversation and food. First came our Croquettas de Queso, there were four on the plate, so I only got two, but I could have eaten all of them. They were filled with goat cheese which is fabulous. Then we got the Albondigas, which were these meatballs in a tomatoe sauce with garbanzo beans, also fabulous. Then came out my favorite, the Eggplant Granada, which is layers of thinly sliced grilled eggplant with this mushroom stuffing in between the layers and has these kind of crispy carmelized onions on top. Yummmmmm. Of course we got our usual cheese board, which is always great for me. It had four different cheeses, a blue, a goat, a soft cheese that was like butter, and of course manchego. It came with some fig spread, nuts and fresh baguette. Ate that up super fast! There are so many different tapas to choose from it will take many visits to try them all. I have yet to try the paella because I always want to get a variety of tapas. Maybe some day. I will be back.

I am not a vegan, but I could eat here any day! It's a bit of a hole in the wall on the outside, but the inside is very quirky and inviting! Parking is not the best, but I would not let it stop you from coming here. They do have some non-vegan options, which I actually have not tried yet. I recommend the vegan Reuben sandwich, which tastes identical to a Reuben, and the vegan queso. They give very good size portions as well. The vegan Mac and cheese could actually be split between two people.

Um, hello spicy fried chicken.
I have to start off by saying, I typically do not like fried chicken. It's usually greasy and I don't like that it's so fatty. 
This place is working some magic. I LOVE their chicken!
Not once have I had a chicken tender from Crazy D's that I didn't enjoy. 
I love that they have so many levels of spicy-ness. Beware of the spiciest option, Crazy. That spice sneaks up on you!
I enjoy the medium. It has a good kick, but doesn't make me sweat through my meal. The cole slaw is also great for easing the spice.
The chicken is always lean and juicy, which keeps us coming back!
The reason I'm giving 4 stars, instead of 5, is the inconsistent wait times. We usually order to go. We're told it'll 45 minutes, but when we arrive to pick up 45 minutes later we still have to wait 30 more minutes. It has happened about 3 times. We love this place though. The food is great!

I've heard so many good things about this place and was excited to try it but was disappointed.  We ordered burgers, cheesesteaks and wings.  All were just ok.  Cheesesteaks  could have been better if they didn't add ketchup and the wings were dry, could have used a sauce.

Hands down the best milkshakes in the city. Johnny Rockets and Shake Shack take a back seat to the milkshakes at Bassetts. There is always a line at Bassetts, especially on the weekends, so consider yourself warned. The prices are high but you get what you pay for here. The portions are huge and their fan base is constantly rising. If you find yourself in the Reading Terminal and looking for dessert, Bassetts is a great choice.

I went to Salon Leezae this weekend to prep for a wedding. The bride also had an appointment, so I followed her lead. Salon Leezae is in a pretty rural area of New Jersey, as was the wedding. I came in from the DC area, and was thinking, "Geez, there's a lot of corn around, I don't know if they can style hair out here." Typical city-slicker thinking. 

I could not have been happier with the service and styling I received. These ladies are pros. When I first called to make an appointment I talked to the owner, Debra, and SHE was the one to double check the timing of the appointment vis-a-vis the wedding, ask about my make-up needs, tell me about the stylist, make sure I knew where I was going, etc. You know how usually you have to butt in and say "sorry...one more question..."? Debra answered all my questions before I knew I had them, called me back to confirm that the make-up artist was available, etc. Super friendly and helpful. You can tell that Debra is very interested in keeping her customers totally happy. 

My stylist was Kathy. She did a phenomenal job on my hair. I was wearing a retro-styled dress and thought I wanted retro, pin-up style hair. I suggested victory rolls. Kathy hadn't heard the term before, but pulled out my phones and she immediately knew what I was talking about and was willing to give it a go. And, by gum, she was tremendously patient with my requests for tiny changes here and there. She was great. My hair was a hit, and strangers kept coming up to me after the wedding to say they loved my hair. The style stayed all day with a mere 10 bobby-pins and some strong spray. Wizardry. 

Melinda did my makeup, and also was willing to search the internet for ideas when I described my look. She showed me the work in a mirror after every little step to make sure I was happy, and also made little changes when I asked. 

Even down to getting me a cup of coffee, I felt like the staff here was bending over backwards to make sure I had a special visit and felt pampered. Big city skills and service with country friendliness and prices. I can't say enough nice things about the ladies there.

Great experience. The atmosphere was friendly and open. Music matched the decor. And the food was wondeful. Had the Senor Mu shu tacos and they were very tastey. I could especially taste the ginger.  

At the end of lunch,  you get this small dessert donut. Holy crap was that good. Their chips are different but very good. We week be back.

I made it out to the Urban Winery this past week for the Creative Release Party hosted by Native. This was such a fun event put on by the magazine, and it was at the perfect venue!

Parking is a bit sparse on a nice day, but you can find plenty of street parking across the street or a block away. The space is absolutely beautiful, and great for large parties. There's an outdoor patio, making it great to bring your four-legged friends, it is topped off with a mini golf area, and corn hole. Inside there's a large bar space with comfortable couches and plenty of table spaces. When looking through their menu it seemed like they had a wide variety of cocktail, wine, and frozen drink selections. They even had the option of a "unicorn size" drink, that was a double frozen wine (frose, bellini--yummmm) served in the cutest unicorn shaped mug, and topped off with a rainbow lollipop.

The Urban Winery is truly magical and the next place to add on your list of things to do in Nashville.

We have been to Hawthornes quite a few times and it has been hit or miss but we kept going back because we really wanted to like it.  Tonight was the last straw.  We ordered wings tonight. When they came out they we all one piece (wing and drum bone still attached to each other) and still had the claw like thing on the end too. After deciding they were too creepy looking to even try to figure out how to eat them, I asked if they would cut them for me. What I got was a mangled  plate of chicken that clearly showed the chef's irritation at my request.  There were even bloody Bones on the plate. I asked the waitress to take them away because they were now creepy and disgusting. Not once was I asked if I wanted something else and they charged us for the food!  The quality of the food, the prices they charge and now, bad service are really disappointing. We really wanted to like you.
Great place for Adidas items at a lower price. My family enjoys checking out the store almost every other month. We always seem to find something to buy during each visit.

Recently I graced this branch with my presence to drop off a few packages the UPS truck failed to pick up at my place of business. Upon entering the neat and tidy store I witnessed a full counter as typical of the holiday season and everyone panicked to get their respective gifts to their destination on time. I was initially greeted by a young man (later found out was Austin) the moment I stepped through the door and made me feel welcome, a lot of shops fail to do that sort of thing. I saw Austin was busy with a customer who just seemed to not get it, he was trying to patiently explain things and saw I was waiting for help, he hollered for Tyler who came bounding in from the back with a bright smile on his face and a pleasant attitude. He quickly scanned my packages and instructed me to have a great night. Overall was a great experience and will certainly return for all my shipping needs.

Let's skip right to the end of the meal. Shall we?

Green tea should not be steeped in boiling water. 

Yeah, this's one of those reviews. Take it for what you will. Small detail to some, perhaps indicative of something larger to others. 
Ignorance? Indifference? Ineptitude? What?

Not serving green tea at the correct temperature speaks volumes.
(If you can't prepare it properly, don't have it on your menu.)

Does not inspire confidence.

This place was one of my most amusing locations since I've been to New Orleans. ... thw people were nice and funny. ... singing and carrying on. ... very entertaining. .... let me taste whatever I wanted which made it easier to make a purchase...... will come back!

Well it depends on what time of the day you are here. If it's a hot followed by rainy afternoon, this is the nicest spot! It has a hipster, chilled out atmosphere with not very loud music. You will love studying here. 

Coffee is pretty decent I like the iced coffee with a little cream in it!
Is under Cooked fog ,but they say that's what is .I ask Cooke more well not even 5min bring it back to me ,sill under Cooked. Ok
Great sub, fun line, real food. I would definitely recommend this place for anyone of all walks of life - whether you wear the Carhardtt for purpose, homage, or style-points.

Food 4.5/5 

Ambiance: 3.5/5

Service 4/5 

Ambiance is very mediocre. Kinda tacky, feels mildly dirty and old. Service was good not great, and they had some annoying rules about splitting checks, and making special requests. I understand running a restaurant is tough, but the place made us feel a bit awkward trying to order with our large group. 

Overall, fish was very good, soup was pretty mediocre, and the ambiance was mediocre. Wouldn't come back, but not a bad place to eat :)

Great view. Room was very clean and nice. The bathroom was very big clean and modern. The room was also big. The pool was wonderful and the fitness center was amazing. I highly recommend staying in this hotel.

This place is neat my company rented out this place for an event.  We actually got a reservation next to the place they have for big events. All in all very good service. It was more snacky than foodie we were hoping for more food.  The drinks definitely kept coming so that made it better. The servers were very nice and very helpful with recommendations as well. 

Thank you for a fun experience and great customer service!
Great food! Good portions and low cost. I ordered the single cheeseburger and my boyfriend ordered the spicy chicken sandwich. We recommend both! And, the shoestring fries are well-seasoned!
Green curry and veggie spring rolls are amazing, ordered to go on Uber eats and it came quickly and correctly! Will definitely order from here again!

Visiting from the South Bay, Tried this place out last night. Wait was 1.5 hours so my husband and I put our names down and they texted us when our table was almost ready. We were able to go to bar near by and wait which was nice. 

We got seated and our waitress that came over appeared tired and "over it". Maybe it was Because she was also serving a big all girl party next to us? 

Our food came out way before our drinks. My husband and I shared the rib-eye, $58 to share. We must've had too many drinks because we didn't realize it was only 12 oz to share. Cooked medium rare but it was tough and chewy. There were more roasted vegetables nicely spread over the plate than meat. $58 for roasted vegetables and some meat to share. That plate was definitely not worth the price or the wait. They should probably take that off their menu. 

We also ordered the Brussel sprouts which were good.

Overall, it was A restaurant experience I didn't want the day of my birthday. Should've stayed at the Loquita bar and watch the bartenders work. That's a show.

Great spot. Very authentic. If you like REAL pizza, this is the best place in the area. The crust is thin and charred around the edges- as it should be. We got the zucchini fritter appetizer and then instead of 2 pies, we got one large pizza and one calzone. For three people the bill was around $40 (before a 20% gratuity).

Finally, the weather is starting to warm up.  That means that it's time to head out to the park for some good old fashioned picnic time in the park.  For our group, coffee and pastries hits the spot.  With a carafe of coffee packed in the picnic basket, we headed over to Laurel Street Bakery for some treats.

What I found was a really cute neighborhood bakery with little cafe tables.  I was very pleased with the variety of little breads, muffins and other pastries mostly under $2.00 a piece.  I especially enjoyed the pumpkin bread.  I would love to come back again and try some of the coffee.  

This place is good for running in and grabbing some treats to go.  The atmosphere is really cute inside too.  It would be nice for a quick casual stop if you'd like to eat in and sitting and reading or chatting a little.  However, the tables aren't huge so this would not be a good location if you have a lot of work to spread out.

The District Tap is amazing for literally any group size or event. I have been here just meeting a friend for drinks and with a larger group. The staff is amazing and our favorite bartender Frank, she is amazing and always comes up with delicious shots for us! Ask for her!

The food was absolutely delicious. My sister said the oysters were wonderful . The crab cake was very well prepared, moist and tender. Itwas very flavorful. 

The ceviche was perfectly citrusy and the shrimp was well prepared and not rubbery. The waiter, I believe his name was Doug or Don, he was super lovely and attentive. We absolutely loved him. His suggestions were spot on. 

The ambiance is more like a casual sporty hang out spot. There is outside and inside dining.

Bill's is my favorite place to go to for fast and inexpensive breakfast and lunch! They offer so many great breakfast and lunch sandwiches and soups. My favorite breakfast sandwich they have would be the eggs and bacon with cheese on a club sandwich roll.

Stepped up creole food. My wife and I were wary about eating all of the traditional fried food during our New Orleans visit while trying to stay healthy with mostly salads. The chef here was very creative and we felt we experienced the New Orleans styles at a higher level. We would definitely come here again.

Amazing staff! Jocelyn was amazing receptionist and take care of all my needs. From the management, the doctor to the technicians Stephanie and Nickki took amazing care of my dog and treated him like family! Thanks for looking out for him and for all the information. Keep
Up the great work

Interesting location and menu. I like the way they decorated the space. 
 
When we first walked in we asked for a table for 2.  We were met with one of my least favorite restaurant games. The "Do you have a reservation?" when the restaurant is empty game. No we did not and we got sat over by the bar which was fine.  Our server was extremely enthusiastic and really hyped the food. This is obviously much better than a sour puss!

My dinner date ordered the Baby Beets and the Bouillabaisse.  She was pleased with the beet salad and thought the Bouillabaisse was just fine but nothing remarkable.  She felt the broth could have had a bit more spice or heat.  She commented her dish was not hot.  

I ordered the Burnt Ends (Yakiniku BBQ Sauce. Sesame Soba Noodles. Braised Leeks and Baby Bok Choy.) The burnt ends and the soba noodles were cooked correctly.  Yakiniku is a term that just means Japanese BBQ so I'm not sure what that BBQ sauce on the menu is supposed to be but the dish was dressed in what tasted like a combination of soy sauce and a little sesame oil mixed with the renderings from the smoked meat.  The predominant flavor on the whole dish was salt.  It ate overly salty and I only made it halfway through.  My dish was also not served hot.

When we left they had a nice little crowd of 5-6 tables in the front part but no one would have ever needed that reservation we were asked if we had.

Vegetarians: don't bother. The staff doesn't know what has meat and what doesn't. The answer is 99% of the items do, including veggie dishes (like green beans..) Ended up eating biscuits, mashed potatoes, corn and "fried" apples (apple pie filling...)

Waiter initially brought out dumplings. Mentioned that he wasn't sure if there was meat in them...(thick white gravy on them) when he was bringing the check he said there was chicken broth, which we figured and hadn't eaten them. 

Extremely fast service and a carnivore's dream!

by far one of my favorite restaurants. I got the veggie burger, and the housemade bread is to die for. Ive never had anything like it. Its warm and delicious. 
I also tried the vegan raw carrot cake which blew my mind.. Please try this place you'll leave so happy  you did

Good news and bad news. I used to hate this place but they have come a long way. Menu is constantly improving. Cheesesteak is excellent and the fries are solid too. My beef is with the cheeseburger sliders. They used to be great with an excellent sauce. Now they are dry and gross (as you can see in the picture) Cheese is minimal and the bun to meat ratio is off.. like way off.

Kevin did a beautiful job on my nails and my pedicure. I would return there in a heartbeat. Kevin was extremely professional and very very friendly. The price was reasonable for what I got. I opted for the deluxe pedicure because of the paraffin wax that was applied to my feet to soften them. It was absolutely heavenly.
Impressive McDonald's, the food is good and of course gorgeous Christmas Decorations.

This is a great restaurant and priced appropriately unlike several other restaurants on main street. It's good food and the staff is friendly. I love the outdoor balcony. I definitely recommend sitting up there on a warm evening!

My sister and best friend booked this wine tour as part of my bachelorette trip to Santa Barbara a few weeks ago and we couldn't have been happier. SUCH A GREAT DAY!!!!! Scott was incredibly accommodating and picked us up from a different location than what we had originally asked for, saving us a walk back to our hotel. We ended up being the only 3 on tour that day and Scott made sure that we were well taken care of and having fun the whole time. His car was spacious, comfortable, and clean, fully stocked with water bottles to keep us hydrated throughout the tour. It was a luxury experience from the start, but not at all pretentious. Scott was very personable, friendly, and knowledgable. He provided additional info throughout the day and has the credentials to back it up. We all had a blast hanging out with him during the tour, but he was also good about knowing when it was appropriate to give the three of us time to ourselves. The wineries we visited were all excellent. The wines were top notch and the scenery was unparalleled. Lunch was delicious and Scott made sure we got to enjoy it in a beautiful spot at one of our stops. We felt like the pace of the tour was perfect. We were occupied the whole time, but also very relaxed. Scott truly catered to us and our needs/personalities. I think I can speak for the other two and say that it was a very special experience. I've been on tours in Napa and the Loire Valley, but this was my favorite without a doubt. I absolutely plan to return one day with my husband or friends. Thanks again, Sustainable Vine and Scott!!!
Great indoor/outdoor atmosphere and service. Food was delicious,  but it could be a little but bigger portions.

Just had the most epic veggie burrito. I came in late and he just threw me something together with what he had left. I knew it was going to be great, but it was REALLY great. Fantastic tortilla. Can't wait for my next visit

Their staff is friendly and the portions are well sized for the price. I got the chicken arugula pizza which was exceptional and I even had some to take home for lunch the next day. We also chicken fettuccini pasta which was served well. For how fancy this restaurant is the food is priced well. Don't worry about dressing up too nice, I wore a collared shirt and felt like I fit in. I would go back for a special occasion!
Over priced, small portions, greasy, bland, and not Chinese. Their vegan food is disgusting. The mixed sauce noodles was just grease! This was the worst thing I've eaten in years.

I purchased a bridesmaid dress through David's Bridal this summer, and found the service to be OK, but not great.  I was able to get an appointment to with the bride to purchase my dress fairly easily, and I liked that they had the dress in all sizes available to try on, which negates the process of measuring and ordering the dress based on measurements.  The dress was an excellent price, and the order came in within a month.  The women working there seemed confused when filling out alterations forms and using the tills, but the store had just opened when we went in.  They also called the bride to come pick up my dress when it came in, when I had explicitly asked them to contact me.  

When the time for my fitting arrived I came down with a bad case of the flu and wasn't able to attend with the other girls in the bridal party.  I called the next week to book an appointment and found that I could only get an appointment in four weeks' time.  When I arrived for my alterations, they told me I could pick up my dress in a couple of weeks, which was only three days before the wedding. The first time I tried it on was the morning of the wedding, thank goodness it was hemmed properly.   

My biggest issue with the store is that the sample dresses you try on are stretched out and not reflective of the size of the dress you will receive.  I ordered one in my usual size, and could pull the sample size down over my bra, so I purchased a bra with some extra padding to hold up my actual dress.  The dress I received from my order was so tight we struggled to get it zipped up at the alterations fitting.  I did find the right bra to go with the dress so it fit well for the wedding, but unsurprisingly it was starting to fall down by the end of the night after wearing it all day.  Overall I was happy with my bridesmaid dress, but I won't be shopping for my own wedding dress or bridesmaid dresses here.

The bbq was so good the best I had in a while. I had the burnt ends, ribs and boudin with the beans and sweet spoon bread. This was my first time having burnt ends and now I'm addicted. I didn't like any of the bbq sauces but the meat didn't need them because of how seasoned it already was. I'll definitely be back!

terrible place to buy anything! we ordered an elliptical machine, and after two scheduled deliveries....they haven't delivered! they just haven't gotten around from taking the floor model to the truck to our house. today....we waited for the delivery truck and they just didn't show up. no call, no email. nothing. when you call their delivery service....you get routed to the Phillipines and they don't care at all, and they don't have any information. Finally the operator in the Phillipines called the warehouse again to confirm the store just didn't give the delivery truck the item (we paid for this 8 days ago...said it would be delivered a couple days ago and was not). the store ASSURED us on the first missed delivery they would handle it and rent a truck on their own if they had to. that didn't happen and then they missed the SECOND delivery. We know the store has this item. the item is a floor model and is already assembled. 

I have tried calling the store several times. they barely pick up the phone. Then when they do, you get put on hold for the manager. as I type I have been on hold for 25 minutes.
