I haven't added the total time I have spent on hold while the people at Sears figure out where the 600 pound, 5 foot long elliptical is (that was on the showroom floor last time I saw it).....but let's just say it's a lot longer than it should have been. what a waste of my time and energy! I wanted a workout when I bought the elliptical...but this was not what I had in mind. 

my takeaways: 
- no accountability at Sears
- you can't talk to anyone who actually be handling your item
- the people on the phone in the Phillipines work from the same script, they "assure" you it will be delivered.
- even if you spend a lot of money, you are not a valued customer. 
- get ready to wait on hold for a very long time, and be ready to call the same number many times before anyone picks up the phone

Took my cats here for a schedule saturday appointment.  The front desk staff consistently ignore folks in the waiting room to address phone calls and they instructed the staff to do this right in front of us ("the people in the waiting room understand why they are waiting, the ones on the phone do not so always give priority to phone?"  what terrible customer service strategy.  There were two people behind the desk?  Why not divide it up?  We waited until 3 for a 2pm appointment???  Once in the room the vet was nice but seemed extremely young and inexperienced.  Again, we waited for 20 minutes for the doctor to come into the room etc.  There was only one other person in the waiting room when we were there?  Are they eating lunch back there?  The up-sell effort was absolutely ridiculous.  Highly recommending full blood work and fecal screen etc. for an additional hundreds of dollars and giving the feeling if you don't do it you're a bad pet parent.  The cats were in for a check up and vaccines nothing more.  We eventually paid $200ish for the service but at one point she showed us a proposed invoice for $700 and change to do the full work up???  What??  Never never again.  Awful.  They need a complete customer service overhaul.  If I'm waiting for a world renowned heart surgeon maybe I'd wait over an hour to be seen.  A clearwater chain vet???  Just figure it out.

I had a salmon dish that had raw onions! I guess I should have looked closer, but the dish which was a special was disgusting . Stick to the pizza here...
Won't be back any time soon...

Extremely helpful, honest and courteous business. Zach went above and beyond customer service. Not only did he report the computer codes generated by the check engine light and point me in the right direction, but he also opened up my transmission to check on a few concerns I had regarding the flex plate (flywheel) at no cost. While I'm glad I didn't have to have my transmission repaired, I wouldn't hesitate to bring it back to this business to have it repaired. These are good people!

Just another hipster place. Typing this while here. Service sucks, took 15 min to get water, then another 15 to place order than another 15 for my drink. With 5 others and all our foods came out about 10 minutes apart, and on top of it the orders were wrong.  As for the taste of the food nothing special. I feel like I am trapped in here and just want to get out.

We arrived and were put on about a 15 minute wait, we looked over the extensive menu while we were waiting. Once called we were seated by a friendly hostess with a bright genuine smile. Once seated we were immediately greeted by our server, Grant, who did an awesome job! The rolls were fantastic with what I believed to be cinnamon butter and regular whipped butter. The salad bar had ample amount of toppings and everything was fresh. I ordered the ribs and grilled shrimp with creole seasoning with the loaded baked potato. My father ordered the Sizzlin' Sirloin cooked to medium. The food was cooked to perfection from the ribs to the sirloin steak with mushrooms and queso. The ribs were so tender and moist, the sirloin was cooked to a perfect medium. The loaded baked potatoes had butter, sour cream and bacon; I just wish it had cheese and chives. Grant came back to check on us several times throughout the meal and made sure we had everything we needed. He also made small talk with us and we enjoyed visiting with him. I also noticed the manager walking around checking in with guests and helping the servers clear off tables for the guests waiting to be seated. Awesome job and I will recommend this place to everyone back in Dallas/Fort Worth, TX!

Moved to the area couple months ago and this is the nearest Publix.  Sad to say that I will be driving past this store to go to the bigger and nicer one by Fletcher for now on.  

It's not that this Publix does anything really bad, but the little nice things that I've come to expect are completely overlooked by management.

For instance, Publix is famous for their scales by their store entrance.  However, the scale to weigh yourself at this location is on the south side entrance.  The store only opens cashier lanes by the north side entrance.  If you happen to park your car by the south entrance so you can weigh yourself, due to shopping at other stores, or because of parking you have a LONG walk with your groceries.  

The medicine, first aid is separated from the rest of the personal hygiene product aisle.  Again, medicine, first aid, etc is by the north side entrance and the personal hygiene products are on the other side of the store in an aisle.  What?!  Talk about a long walk back and forth to get that Advil you needed!

They put the slowest cashier on the 10-Items or Less lane during the week, after work!  I mean seriously, I stopped in for a rotisserie chicken and potato salad at 6:10pm after work, the dang cashier was a senior woman who was s-l-o-w and chatted up every single customer about personal stuff.  It only took me 3 minutes to grab my two items, but 17 minutes to pay!  Speedy lane should have a speedy cashier. Period.

On the plus side, a shout out to the produce employee.  He always finds what you're looking for and/or walk you over to the area.  He is always upbeat and happy.

UPDATE: The owner of the company finally got back in touch with us about repairs, and has resolved the situation by managing the repair and painting of the damaged wall. 

BEWARE! If I could give less then 1 star I would. How disappointed we are in SB Tree Care. They have serviced our trees several times and most recently they had an accident that resulted MAJOR damage to an exterior wall. When the accident occurred no one called to tell us the damage had occurred, imagine our surprise when we came home. Furthermore calls, emails and text messages have gone unanswered from the owner and we have been left holding the bag. Th

I just had a brain storm.......I was watching Diners, Drive-in's & Dives on TV and thought, "WHAT A GREAT IDEA!"  There are so many of us on here that love this place we should try to get him on the show!  Let's go the website on suggest that Guy and the show put him on.  What do you think!!!!
It's really easy and fast to pick up the order. So glad I can enjoy their awesome beer! Thanks!!
Have dined at Little Italy and ordered food thru UberEats several times. Always great food. Their pizza is awesome. The pasta is always tasty. Highly recommend a visit.

After waiting 30 minutes for two benedict plates it was clear that the food was ready long before it was delivered to our table because it was nearly room temperature. They weren't terribly busy on Sunday brunch-- several open tables even with COVID restrictions. I ran out of coffee and water. I'm not sure where the server was. We had to get up to find a server to notify them that the food is cold. I expected much more.

This is a pretty good pizza place, but only if you are in to the coal fired pizza.

The restaurant itself is very small, and you can normally expect to wait a while if its around dinner time. The menu isn't bad, and there is a great selection of items. One of the things that I do find annoying is that they do not have refills on drinks and everything comes out bottled. When I got to a sit down restaurant, I expect free refills, especially considering that soda and tea is so cheap to sell in bulk.

The food is fairly good. I highly recommend the wings, they bake them in the coal fired oven, which gives them a nice smoky flavor. The wings are not greasy like your normal wings, and they bake them with onions and seasoning right on top.

The pizza is good, although I am not a huge fan of the burnt tasting crust that can occur. They have a good selection of tops though, and if you like thinner crispier crusts, you will like the crust.

The price isn't bad, and you will normally have left overs. If you want pizza, and you are in the mood for something a little better than delivery, this is a great place to stop in.

Close...but no cigar. Went here for the first time today and ordered the chile relleno and chicken burrito with chips and salsa. The burrito was okay..but rather bland and there was too much batter and not enough chiles in the relleno. I'm finding the "Mexican food" here to be sorely lacking. The chips and salsa were pretty good though. I'm going to try this place again and order something different next time. Stay tuned.

My daughter and I were visiting from out of town and did not know where to go for a pedicure. So glad we found Hue.  We stopped at two other nail salons and did not go in just from looking in the door.  Hue was immaculately clean,  the techs were friendly, efficient and knew what they were doing.  The equipment is obviously new, no broken chairs.  The atmosphere was pleasant. And Grace and the tech who took care of my daughter did not speak to each other, but concentrated on their work. They did not rush us.  When we are back in that area we will visit again.
"Amazing!" That is the word my husband and teen boys used to describe this place. The hot bbq sauce was perfect, and the food was delicious. The plate portions were huge. Glad we found this place!

Poor College Me wrote a review years ago for LICK. Today Me doesn't blink when going to make a LICK purchase. Worth every penny. Their innovative approach to ice cream and attention to high quality ingredients has me coming back for more every time. 

Can't wait to see what's next for this wonderful business - - said the lady who just purchased a pint of gorgonzola walnut...

The building itself is very nice and well kept up. However, the service is terrible. The workers were too busy having side conversations to serve us. My food is freezing, and the workers have a terrible attitude in general. If i could give 0 stars I would.
Needed to find a new barber, was walking by and was intrigued by the classic bikes. Got a great cut and beard trim/shape up. Would definitely recommend.

If I could give this place zero stars I would. Absolutely terrible selection, terrible products, terrible customer service. Might I add extremely over priced and again poor quality merchandise. They charged me $60 for a vape tank that costs normally is $20 in store. To make matters worse, the tank wasn't functioning properly and kept leaking. I took the tank back and the guy at the counter that day was very helpful so I will give them that. He offered to switch out the tank for a different one. The one we switched it for was only $30 so we were taking a loss but at that point we just wanted a working tank so we settled. The clerk helped us set up the tank, put in our atomizer etc. We went home and tried the new tank and to no surprise it was not working, AGAIN. We went back a few days later to let them know and the guy behind the counter this time was not friendly, frankly rude. Long story short he said the atomizer wasn't working properly, mind you another worker there set it up so that was on them and their mistake. We asked them to replace the atomizer they mis-installed and he refused. Fast forward a few days later of using this tank maybe 2 times, it's leaking AGAIN. In all my tanks I have ever purchased, I have never had this many issues. Needles to say, we will NOT be coming back here. Horrible experience!! Honestly don't waste your money here, go to a REAL vape shop like one on south street.

BEWARE:  WORST HAIR EXPERIENCE OF MY LIFE!  I spent thousands my year at this studio to help me grow my hair and walked out with shorter & thinner hair at the end of that year! She cuts the blunt cut that SHE thought was best.  Not what I wanted. Jen is extremely arrogant.  Apparently her answers are always best.  NOT WHAT THE CUSTOMER WANTED!  When I called after the visit to discuss how upset I was, it took many phone calls and I could not reach her.  She then leaves me a message on a Saturday morning, but never answered when I called her cell or business phone.  By Monday I had HAD IT!  I left a very unhappy message with her assistant.  I thought st the least I would get an apology and some kind of a refund.  No!  Instead, Jen leaves me a nasty email that she has refunded my money and that she would never see me again?  Do you really think I wanted to go back anyways?  No contrition, no apology.  Jen knows best not the customer.  I'm leaving before & after photos of my hair before she cut it...I am an actor and now I don't look like my photos.  As an update on 3-8-18, Jen's email had ZERO contrition, ownership or apology????  I find that when you trust someone and they don't pay attention or listen, then you end up with the exact opposite of what you paid  for or consulted them for, THAT REQUIRES an apology or it is construed as ice-cold, unkind, heartless aka "nasty."    I CONSULTED HER MANY TIMES THROUGHOUT THE YEAR ABOUT THE ADHESIVE AND SUITABILITY FOR MY HAIR.  I often asked her if it was damaging it?  She said NO, and that they were growing my hair!  I COULD NOT ALWAYS GET IN FOR AN APPT WHEN THEY WERE COMING OUT AND THEY WOULD HURT.  THe BOTTOM LINE IS THIS:  the adhesive for her extensions was way too strong for my hair type and Jennifer should have known it and said so long before it caused so much damage.  And not since I was 13 have I had someone chop off hair they were not supposed to without checking in before they did so.  No clarification?  Do you really think I would ever come back again?  It's going to take a solid year to get it back.  And Jennifer dodged my calls after the incident for DAYS.  I RETURNED HER CELL CALL AND TO HER STUDIO & LEFT MESSAGES.  Why? She didn't really care.  She knew she had made a mistake.  She didn't want to face it or be accountable or apologize.  I told her receptionist how upset and hurt I was finally.  Abusive?  Not at all.  Very unhappy.  Very very hurt & disappointed and I had every right to be.  Cuss words?  I don't typically use ANY bad language in business. But in this case I know I said EXACTLY ONE that I quickly recanted.  Anyone else who paid thousands to have their hair THINNER & SHORTER than when they started a year prior would likely have used less restraint than I did.  SHE ABUSED her authority by not checking in with me, properly advising me throughout, or taking any responsibility.  Instead she just dismissed the situation and me, and I find that repugnant and QUITE UNKIND!   I've never had ANYONE cause more harm on my hair than good.  Apathy is not a characteristic you want in anyone you pay to help you especially in someone who does your hair.

I went there on a Saturday night and it's super quiet! 
It's a nice little place, I really like their Tom yum soup, it's different, the broth's more clear unlike some other places where they add tons of Tom yum paste. They also gave me some raw chili pepper to add in the soup! IT was HOT! If you like spicy food I would recommend to add that in your food(I basically use it for everything).
The seafood salad was almost good, it just missed some more lime juice, cucumbers and celeries.

Nicest guy ever! Emergency flat at 7:55 am yesterday. Not only did he drive me to my office, but fixed it immediately and I was back in my car at 10 am. Super nice, reasonable and efficient. Restored my faith in humanity!

Don't really understand the hype with this place. The food is is A-OK. It was worth a try  and if your a tourist wanting some pork sandwich go for it & have a try. Is it worth the hype? I dont know. Is it good, its okay but I'll rather just get a cheese steak. Pork sandwich is just isn't my type of thing. But if your a fan of it, go for it.

This is a great lunch spot. My boyfriends mom took us to lunch there since it seems like a New Orleans classic place. It's very nice and relaxed on the inside and the prices were a little high. But I got the lunch special which was 1/4 of a po boy and a cup of soup which I chose the gumbo-I would've just loved a bowl of that. everything was great and I'm only giving 4 stars because the server was a little emotionless, but none the less did a good job. The worst was the po boy just didn't have enough shrimp which is really the only thing that can go wrong with a po boy.
The martinis are so good and so is the food! Erin F. was an amazing waitress and made sure everything was perfect! She was so wonderful and had such a great spirit! She made the experience memorable!

Used their services twice within the past year, 1st time was rear deck speaker removal and installation after a accident with glass remaining in the car. charged a little bit more but cleaned out the remaining glass that they could find installed the speakers with no trouble or complaints. price was comparable to best buy but with faster service. 2nd time i had a remote starter put in the car, was able to have it installed the next day and have it within a few hours. in this case they were cheaper than bestbuy and i was also able to avoid the wait time that best buy was offering almost weeks later. So far no issues with either product service was great and i would recommend them to friends who need work done.
Haven't come into this place since I waited in line 15 mins to get skipped over so that the server could help the people behind me.  (I walked out, I'm diabetic and was on my lunch hour.)
Very pleased to have a lovely place to dine and the pints of local draft beer are the best prices in town. Highly recommend

I lived in Fairmount for a year, and my quality of life was way higher because of Klein's. Perfect neighborhood grocery store...all the brands you want and none of the brands you don't want. There may not be an extremely large selection, but I've literally never wanted for anything they didn't have.

All of the produce is super fresh, as is the protein. I've found that the produce I've bought at Klein's is better than most other stores in the city. Deli counter is also a plus. They carry Dietz & Watson (even though I prefer Boarshead) and have a variety of prepared dishes. Even the sushi is fresh and tasty! I've found their prices comparable to any major grocery store. Produce is a bit cheaper, processed foods are a bit higher.

I miss Klein's!
Great beers by I ate the macaroni and cheese and it was burnt and not cheesy at all.  I love the selection of beers here but my food was just sub par.

Utterly unique. Basically Burrito size Asian Spring Rolls and other interesting and unique versions of staples. Great slightly funky vibe. Casual. I have brought a few people here and they all kind of just dug the whole of it very much - which I agree with.

Utterly unique.

This food was so good and the wait from ordering to being ready was fast. They give you a lot of meat and the staff was super friendly. It's a little food truck but there's a decent amount of parking so you shouldn't have a hard time finding it. The only reason I didn't give it 5 stars is because I also ordered the lemonade and I'm not sure how they made it but I couldn't even get half way through it. But the food gets 5 stars if you're in the area it's definitely worth checking out for real authentic tacos.

I love cute little bookstores. Don't get me wrong - I do love B&N but sometimes it can be a little too crowded and overwhelming. 

I like that I can quickly pick up a book for myself and my son without having to spend hours looking for the perfect book. I also love that they staff there are knowledgeable about what is in stock and can give great recommendation. 

Oh and upon reading other reviews, I'll definitely have to check out their story time!

The food was OK, not good, not great. The service was either indifferent when present, or missing in action entirely. I was one of two customers in the place, so the service levels were not a result of being busy.

BUT, what really rankled me was the size of the portions. My entrée had the volume of a side, and my sides were the size of something you'd grab off a canapé tray at a cocktail party. A meal for one person with two beers cost $41.00, and I was still hungry when I left this restaurant.

You know that ain't right.

Heard how great the Banana Cream Pie was so decided to have appetizers and a salad and then splurge on the pie. The BBQ shrimp, roasted kale salad, and gumbo were heavenly! The pie was everything we heard it was and more!
I get my lashes filled with Tammy every other week and I never leave disappointed. She by far makes them look better than I've ever seen them.

After researching online and nearly using an online service, a friend suggested I try diversified labs in St. Louis. I thought, great! It's local! I quickly gave them a call and they were able to not only meet my deadline for 56 photographic "floating" prints on metal, but they were also able to customize the backing of each different size photograph so that they would appear to be floating the same distance away from the wall as all of the other sizes. The online service only offered certain backings for certain sizes. And they were not be willing to mix and match to customize my order so that our wall collage would appear seamless.

Diversified labs not only customized our order but also saved me nearly $400 on the order  that met our needs for our custom photographic wall mural vs. going to the competitor. 

I'm sold!

If you're a photographer, professional or hobbyist, check this place out.

Their customer service and follow up calls were impeccable and very welcomed.
The order came out perfect and the prints are gorgeous and very vibrant 
I would go back to diversified labs in a heartbeat for any photographic print or specialty print needs!

Came today for the grand opening  and I have to say I was very impressed. The man taking orders was super nice and understanding of the fact that I can't eat certain things. We were waiting in a line about 59 people, but everything went fast and we got our bowls quickly. They were definitely prepared and things were organized. Everything was great and I will definitely be back.

Alright fam,
I am going to try to let my bias for what I think a coffee shop should be not ruin this review. I like a coffee shop with tables that I can lay stuff out on to work or sit across from someone to have a conversation. Coal Yard has tons of space. This makes it perfect for events (they have jazz night and blues night and more) However its not great for a casual meet up. The back room ,which is the most private, is cold in the winter. The main room feels like the barista can hear your conversation. The front room is right by the door and noisy. 
The pour over was just ok. They have local variety but I could have had it in a regular coffee pot and it would have been a similar taste. The price was very reasonable. The menu is not simple enough yet the espresso drink variety was not terribly  impressive. The barista had trouble explaining their special drinks to us. 
If you like the local art scene or music nights then check this place out. If you are looking for the best cup of coffee in Indianapolis there are about 5 places I would rank above Coal Yard.

If your a guy that knows how to take care of your woman you'll cheat and join her here for the beers and mani's with the massage. Trina and Tracy did an awesome job and my old lady couldn't be happier and I'd have to agree. It's a great way to spend time with my woman.

I hate to open this with "this hotel is low frills" because really it is not.  The room itself, for $150 (with tax) included: free parking, updated furnishing, clean shower, walk in closet, fridge, microwave, complimentary bottle water, recycling bin, makeup station, flat screen TV, and a dresser.  Most beach side motels, usually have the cheesy furnishings and have an overall stank to them.  Here, I was presently surprised, especially since other hotels in Santa Barbara were going for twice this amount.  

The 10 room motel is located walking distance to the beach, and right off of highway 1.  You could, in theory, walk to the "down town" area, but we drove, and it look less than 5 minutes.  We were only using SB as a pass through on our Cali road trip so we didn't do much.  The office staff was polite and offered advice on where to eat, albeit we chose to use Yelp and Trip Advisor in the end.  The front desk, french lady and a new guy named John (or Jeff?) were very welcoming and helpful in our planning.  There's a pool, too, and the wifi worked well enough for both my sister and I to stream movies on our ipads at the same time.

I would absolutely recommend The Blue Sands Motel for your stay in Santa Barbara.  It gives you everything you need for your stay. They accept dogs, too, for $10

Speaking of dogs, on occasion, you could get a wiff of a dog in the room. Not urine, but just a vague dog smell.  This wasn't overwhelming and I only smelled it when the wind blew into the room at the right angle.  But again, overall, the room was extremely clean.

Great service! Great guys! Most shops do not know how to handle a beard but, theses guys do! I use to go to shops where when I got home I had to trim my beard and correct it. Now I don't.  I have been going here regularly for a few months now. You're Always going to come out happy and looking good!

It's a little better than it used to be they've cleaned it up.. EVER SO SLIGHTLY.  I worked there for a very brief period BC I couldn't get along with a few that have worked there for a long time. Seems after being in retail all my adult life my "habits" weren't what they were looking for.  I had to put clothes away that ppl.  tried on then left on a "Go Back Rack" but because supposedly I "Sorted" the pants all according to color I was told ...  "I don't know where you think you're working but we aren't Salvation Army and this isn't working bc you're trying to turn us into one - You don't color code the clothes when they go back"  It's funny because it just so happened the customer who tried all 6 or 8 pairs of the pants tried on...  Yes,  ALL THE SAME COLOR" But Silly me I didn't mix them up when I returned them to their proper location.  Also,  Someone had discarded alot of Kleenex tissues...  Just threw them on the floor right in front of the entrance door.  When I asked if I could get a broom someplace I was then told,  "We have a guy that does that.  That's not your job so don't do it..  If you do it you'll get in trouble."  I respected the fact that there was a maintenance/handy guy who went around at night and swept the place but absolutely should have been an exception. They were blowing all over the store as the wind blew in, while the doors we're continually opening and closing and it was ridiculous I should wait until closing time to clean them up...  I had quite a few customers and on various occasions,  who complained to me that the girls that worked there were more interested in texting on their phones than in helping them when they needed customer service ... I came to find that being employed there it's a "Clique" type environment.  I never once ever even met the owner, my "Boss" he just never took the time to introduce himself once. It wasn't important to him to meet who he employed bc he left the Hire Fire Stuff to Claudia, who is that stores manager. 
Now my Mom and I, from the 80's into the mid 90's used to own a very well known and if you'd ask ... A fairly upscale, Consignment shop in Ocala Fl. I helped run the "Boutique " as ppl. referred to it as Assistant Manager until her death.  She was killed in an accident involving a drunk driver. Our store, even though it was a second hand one ... was an extremely popular and also profitable business. I went to school for merchandising, advertising and display and was able to exercise those talents there everyday.  I thoroughly enjoyed what I did bc I loved the interaction with people everyday so when I got this job I had high hopes it would give me that same joy. I was so happy to be doing this type of work again especially since it was supposed to benefit our United States Veterans. The whole entire time I worked there I never saw one discount given to a Vet. That's not to say they didn't ... I just never had one customer get any sale price unless they brought a coupon in from the TBT with them No Coupon No Sale Price ... Not for anyone!!! 
In the end,  let's just say, this was a job ... I sure didn't cry over losing. I'm just sorry I tried to stick it out and didn't quit first ... I still shop there from time to time but am sincere when I say bc of the way they treated me while I was employed and subsequently fired from this place...  I truly hate giving them a dime.    EVERYTHING IS DONATED TO THAT STORE I JUST REALLY WONDER WHAT KIND OF CHARITY WORK OR HELP THEY DONATE BACK INTO THE COMMUNITY. 

A COMMUNITY THAT I'M QUITE SURE HAS MADE THIS GENTLEMAN EXTREMELY WEALTHY IN ALL THE YEARS HE'S OWNED IT SINCE THE PREVIOUS OWNERS. 

AND IT'S ALL FROM DONATIONS IN THE NAME OF VETERANS OF THESE OUR UNITED STATES !!!!

I had been waiting to try this new place out ever since my family in new orleans told me about it and I have to say, it did not disappoint! I love seafood so this was a good place for dinner with the whole family!

-Chargrilled Oysters: delicious!
-Oysters on the half shell: fresh and good!
-Chicken & Waffles: good, with the exception of the sauce. It was a little too much hot sauce and not enough syrup. But the sauce does not define the dish; the waffle was crisp and delicious, while the chicken tasted great.
-Seafood scampi: delicious!
-Ooey Gooey: amazing!

The service was great, our waiter made sure that we were well taken care of.  I loved the atmosphere of the restaurant; it's pretty versatile.  It'd be a great place for date night. But it can also be a fun place to come watch games or hang out with coworkers for happy hour: $.75 oysters & $2 beers!

There are a few kinks to work out, but that's true of any new restaurant. 

I'm in the area quite often so I will definitely be coming back! 'Specially for the oysters!

I love Caje! I used to come here all the time as a college student at UCSB. My favorite drink is the Agave Blended Coffee. It's really just a perfect drink. I also really enjoy their house coffee sweetened with the agave syrup they have. I don't know why other coffee houses don't have this stuff around! The atmosphere is really laid back, as it should be in IV, and the hours are fantastic for students.

I liked the sports environment, but I got a terrible hair cut. The manager cuts real well, but the other noobs suck. My side burns were uneven, I got no fade, and my hair looks sloppy even after a wash. I wish I didn't look like such an idiot. It's slightly my fault for just assuming everything was alright, and then walking out paying $20.

I'm in Reno working from home & visiting, and invited 5 friends out to get nails done on a Tuesday evening for a girls night. We called to make the reservation two days prior for the 6 of us with the service we wanted, showed up and they were not ready for us. I was going to get a gel manicure and the co-owner Helen upsold me to the dip and said it lasted much longer. Prices are not listed anywhere and I should have asked the price. She didn't rub my hands, or clean/shape my nails, only cut my cuticles to the point of bleeding on 4 fingers! When she was done with the painting, she didn't clean up all the paint that was on my skin and left places on my nails not painted, they looked terrible. I felt rushed and not happy at all. She charged me $45! Unreal. I went back four days later on my lunch break because the chipping on three of my fingers was so bad I was hoping that for the amount that I paid she would redo two of them. I showed up Helen wasn't there, there were five technicians and one customer at 12 o'clock on a Monday. They told me to call her or text her and come back. One of the technicians called her and said she didn't answer it and to come back later. I am on my lunch break and leaving town later that night, why couldn't she fix it for me? The other co-owner Kim was right there, didn't ask how she could help, apologize or speak to me in English. Horrible service! I came back later that evening, and Helen shaved off the top layers of all the nails and re dipped them. Again she rushed, explained that my nails "were too short which caused the chipping" (NEVER heard that in my life!) and the residue on my skin was everywhere! Many of my cuticles were cut and bleeding...again. I don't want an infection and shouldn't leave with cuts on almost ever finger from a professional. Won't be back!

Very tasty food, stylish ambiance, and sexy black and red decor.

Personally, I found the food a bit heavy and oily, but it was an excellent dinner experience.

I'm not sure what the hype is about this place. My husband couldn't wait to go, so we decided to stop in for dinner on Saturday night. It was around 7:00. 

When we walked into the actual restaurant, it was PACKED (which we saw as a good sign.) But, it was also extremely noisy, so, since the weather was glorious, we decided on a table outside. 

We waited a good 15 minutes before anyone came out to take a drink order or give us menus. This was annoying, but understandable because it was very busy. About 10 minutes later another couple sat down and we noticed 2 or 3 rounds of drinks were comped. We weren't once thanked for the wait or apologized too (even though we never complained) 
So we ordered. About 20 minutes later,  my Granny Smith Apple Salad  appetizer came out, and it was pretty good, but smaller than I expected. My husband got an avacado salad that was on special which was also small. It was described to have shaved asparagas and mozzarella cheese, neither of which we could find.  Again, they were both just okay. Midway through our salads, we got our dinner rolls. The bus boy seemed very overwhealmed.  
After another 20 minutes, we finally got our entrees (it's now about 8:00) I got the lobster ravioli. The ravioli itself was delicious, but the sauce it came in was very watery and didnt have much of a taste. 
My husband got the "Seafood pot pie" which was more like a chowder with a biscuit on top. He said it was "okay" but not that good. 

The waitress finally came back with our bill when we finished (about 8:40) and finally thanked us for our patience (yeah, tip time, right?) She was nice, but just slow. 

This place was just okay at best. I'd prefer "Cafe Valentino" or "The Ugly American" in that neighborhood.

I would like to try their brunch, but for dinner, there are much better options in this neighborhood.

The best Poke place in town. Made the way it's supposed to be!  It's cute to go somewhere and pick what you want in your bowl, but you don't get the true flavors and combinations like you do here. 

The portions are huge and the staff are great. I always try to call ahead and order my food whether eating in Or taking out. 

Good food takes a little time to make it great food!!!

Great restaurant!
Really great food.  Had grilled grouper,  husband had steak. $3 Margarita at happy hour was large.

I loved it. This is some real authentic Mexican tacos. Chicken enchiladas the best around so far. 
I had a variety of beef and pork. The flavors were perfect. 
Don't be surprised if you drive by and miss it. It's a very unassuming venue.

Best Mexican food I've had in Clearwater! Came in on a Tuesday after work and they weren't too busy. Got fast service. Margaritas are on special during happy hour along with beer. I got cheese dip($4) and it was good. The mixed fajitas ($13) were amazing though! So juicy and tender. Everything tasted fresh and the portions were big. Will definitely be back.
Don't come to see Marilyn ~ she's gone and so is the sailor kissing the nurse. It's all modern art. Not what I care to see.

Great menu with something for everyone. Had just gotten off our cruise ship and hadn't had a chance to eat breakfast so stopped in for an early lunch on a Monday. Recommend making a reservation or arriving early as it is a popular place. The Okra fries were great as well as the chargrilled oysters. The house made ketchup was really good. The Ulele burger with portabellos and fire roasted peppers was perfectly prepared and seasoned. The lobster roll was light, fresh and delicious and paired with French fries. Save room for the candied maple bacon ice cream coated in cinnamon and corn flakes because you have to try this desert!
Great place and the sweet and sour soup is amazing i definitely would recomand this place if you live uptown and you are looking for Chinese restaurant.

My wife and I had a very enjoyable tour of Solvang with Cameron back in October.    He was a great conversationalist and made our group of 8 feel special throughout the tour.   It happened to be a very hot day and Cameron went out of his way to find shade at each of the stops.  By the end of the tour we were all interacting with each other as if we had met each other before.
My wife and I have been to Solvang at least 50 times over the years and we were pleasantly surprised to learn new things about the town's history and see sights that we had never seen before.  
We enjoyed the variety of food and drink tastings.   There was plenty of it too.  We were both full by the end of the tour.  
Special thanks to Tara in the main office for her outstanding customer service.
It is a little gem in the tampa bay area. They have everything from community pool (currently closed) to a small waterfall, volleyball courts, picnic areas and great hiking trails. Highly recommend

The drinks at this place are carefully made with care. The end result is a tasteful bliss of enjoyment with every sip. Today I got the Sangre y Arena (Scotch, Jamaican Rum, Spicy Citrus Shrub, Italian Vermouth, Cherry, Smoke). The aftertaste has hint of spiciness and smokiness but really subtle. I really love this drink.

I love this place!  Well, I think I do.  See, I was born here :)  and yeah, although I do not recall the exact memories of it, I survived.  And so, yeah, the Doctor who delivered me is probably long gone by now, I'll always cherish my birthplace!

Who would have even thought I'd be writing a review for a visit 46 years ago?  Not me :)  But I'm sure its the nicest place on earth and it delivered me safely into the world!

This place SUCKS. My cheese quesadilla included a large black hair grilled into it. Took an hour to get food and 4 times to get the bill right. The toilets were covered in urine and the staff was terrible. Don't give this place you money.

The Buffalo Slices are a must. Actually, pretty much any specialty slice here is good. I believe it's $3.75 for students if you purchase two slices and a drink. No seating, so don't go there with hopes of sitting in. Otherwise, pretty good.

I have heard about this place for years, the food is simple and straight forward. Had 2 pork tacos and was not  really excited about the meat, it was not tender or tasty just and ordinary simple taco. Save the drive - But at least we tried it. Cheap Eats LA

This was a wonderful company to work with.
When I called and told Ralph what I wanted done he said he was in my area and would be right over.
He was at the house within half an hour, gave me a wonderfully affordable bid and did the work while he was here.
Our palm trees look GREAT and Ralph and his partner are fast, friendly and very efficient.
They also do an amazing clean up job when they are done.
I would highly recommend them to anyone at any time.
Another great Hilton Family hotel. What else can I say!!

Wow what a wonderful surprise. It's not the fanciest restaurant however the food is absolutely the best I've had locally. I have been searching and searching 4 good authentic Thai food and I finally found it. Don't let the outside fool ya.... very nice people very reasonably priced and I cannot wait to go back

Popular local place for breakfast, friendly and fast service. Pork chop special $7 with eggs + potatoes, very good, all standard breakfast and lunch items on the menu. Will be sure to stop back by when we are in the area. Perfect way to get the day off to a start...love it!
Excellent food and service. Salads with shrimp and orange cilantro dressing were delicious. Creme Brule was excellent too.

I love supporting local but the service here is not good. With a 5:30 saturday reservation, we were seated immediately but didn't get drinks for close to 45 minutes. Empty glasses and dishes sat at our table while servers and bussers walked by. A meal close to $300 should have better service.

We went here last weekend prior to a show. Our waitress was a blast and the food was great. Glad we made a reservation prior cause it was busy !!  We had burgers and they were awesome we will definitely be back !

Amazing food, great prices, good service, friendly staff. I drive from DC to Philly for this. Not usually a fan of Sate Padang but theirs is delicious as well as the lamb sate. Anything with their ayam goreng (fried chicken) is good! We also had ayam bakar kecap (sweet grilled chicken) which brought me back to my childhood in Indonesia when we used to buy them from one particular street tent that no longer exists. Wish I can bring the whole restaurant back to DC. Everything there, so far, are flavor bombs.

Best Thai ever! This restaurant is great for dine in or take out and has endless options. My favorite is the red curry, but everything I have tried has been delicious. Everything is fresh, flavorful, and priced accordingly. I enjoy my food each time and have never had a complaint!

I've moved to Pinellas county from Houston TX and Houston has 100's of great boiled seafood restaurants. I felt i needed to give you this bit of information and disclosure before my actual review.

I couldn't wait to try this place since it opened, so last night I did. I ordered the hot, Mr and Mrs seasoned crawfish. To be honest, it was a good flavor and the crawfish was cooked right (not over cooked and I can tell they were purged). Therefore I had to give them, at least, 3 stars. 

BUT it was NOT $13/lb good! I have never paid $13/lb of crawfish, or shrimp, or anything before! How are they justifying this ridiculous cost for their food...I dont know .

I will never return...I can't return without going broke.

Disappointed with the update on the wings. The old wings were easier and much more enjoyable to eat. They now have the full wing with the elbow .   The wing sauce is amazing tho!

There is a large beer list and the wine list is pretty good. This place isn't very  gluten-free friendly tho.

Great place to spend a few non-casino hours in Reno.  Well done displays and a generally god collection of cars.  Their strength is with cars between very early late 1800's to the early 1960's.  They have a few late model custom cars, but not many.  Overall, I would go again.
Room 917 had a cockroach...imagine my horror to wake up to a massive insect crawling around the ceiling directly above my bed. Disgusting.
1st visit to the Dancing Pig.  Excellent pork ribs.  The beans and corn bread are winners too.  Looking forward to going back very soon.

Wow. Terrible experience. I wish I could give it a zero. It seemed like the staff did not care or want to be there.

-I overheard the (very young male) doctor complaining to his associates in the other room about another patient. 

-The doctor barely looked at my x-rays and mouth.

-The doctor ran out of the room before I could ask any questions.

- I was given very bad & incorrect information about my teeth/gums.

- The front desk couldn't figure out how to email my x-rays to another doctor's office.

- They claimed that other doctors can read paper printed x-rays (The other dentists laughed when I told them this.)

Save yourself some time and go somewhere where the staff cares.

I went to Rittenhouse dentist in Bala the next day and received 5 star treatment.

Went here for the Restaurant Week preset $30 meals. It was a very busy Saturday night, supposedly a waitress walked out. The "manager?" Or owner was very apologetic and took our orders. all the food I got was very good! This is ideal southern comfort place. I was surprised with the decor very modern look for a southern place. There was live soul music from a black man with a keyboard and a soul filled voice. All the sides are great mash potatoes were very creamy, Mac cheese was super cheesy, and collard greens were cooked perfectly and seasoned well. My meatloaf was perfect. Peach cobbler could of been served with ice cream or whipped cream but was still not bad by it self. Only compliant was the wait on the food.

Exceeded my expectations! Some of the best Thai I've had, and have lived in Atlanta, Chicago, etc. The signature pumpkin curry was excellent, as was the pad thai. I complimented the owner/chef on the crab leg dish she was wok-ing, and a few minutes later she walks over with a small sample to go container for me to try...wow was it delicious! You can really tell that the owner and her polite and friendly daughters love their food and their customers. "I hope you like it!" as I walked out the door, and yes I sure did...you have a new regular customer!

I was conflicted regarding the review so would give the spot, but I settled on 3 stars. Here's why: 1. The portion size is great! They have so much food that me, my husband and toddler were able to share (4 stars for that)! 2. The hush puppies were delicious! They were soft in the middle and crunchy on the outside! They were flavorful and not dried out... just how I like them. Now the fish, shrimp and fries while fried to perfection, lacked seasoning! What's fried fish and shrimp without proper seasoning? What makes fries great is when they are perfectly salted. So contrary to the reviews that led me there, the food was lackluster.

We had originally requested to sit inside but the host asked if we would sit outside due to limited seating. Normally I wouldn't care but it started to very lightly rain and the host went out of his way to not notice us. Our server wasn't very engaging and only visited our table a few times even though it wasn't busy. That was just unfortunate service I suppose, but they made up for it with their food. We started with the pretzel bites which were cooked perfectly and buttery with a nice cheese dip on the side. The shrimp tacos were my favorite, the grilled flavor with the spicy mayo were perfect together. I didn't care for the rice side, it was dry, bland and refried beans were just dumped on top. I would definitely recommend the sweet potato fries as a wonderful side.
My favorite tacos in St Louis. Great sauces. Out-of-the-way location but definitely worth a stop if you're anywhere near by and have a hankering for some delicious tacos.

We go to NOLA every year for my wife's birthday and our wedding anniversary. We have been for brunch and dinner.  We love the ever changing seasonal menu. The ambience is always nice and upscale with great food and worth every penny. 

If there for dinner do the tasting menu. It is always exceptional. This last trip we ate there on 11/6 for Sunday brunch. They had a deconstructed tamale with chorizo that was very tasty for a starter. I had the Soup De Jour to start which was a very nice butternut squash soup that had lump crab meat and the perfect amount of heat. The Goat Cheese Stone Ground Grits were amazing. My main dish was the Cochon De Lait Eggs Benedict, as I love eggs benedict, and it was the best I've ever had. The pork they used was tender and paired well with the sauce. For dessert my wife had the Commander's Classic Fudge Sheba and it was smooth and rich. I had a pumpkin custard dish that had a maple ice cream to die for. The bread pudding is also amazing. Since it was our anniversary they wrote happy anniversary on the plates and for my wife's birthday they gave a nice paper chef hat to wear and lit a birthday candle. 

Only thinks I wish they had for brunch still was the $0.25 martini. They should bring it back. We go here every year for a reason. They never disappoint so you should pay the price and eat here.

I have never left a strip club with most of my cash!  My wife and I came to have a good time and only one dancer bothered to speak to us. The place was dead empty most of the night. Meanwhile the dancers just sat out on the patio smoking and socializing with each other. We went out to talk to them but they acted as if we were interrupting them. The dancers are lazy and most of the time didn't even bother to take off their tops while dancing on the main stage. And to make things worse, the GM "Danny Boy" sent our waitress on a pass run, whatever the hell that is, so we couldn't close our tab and leave until she got back. If you're looking to have fun go somewhere else.

It's a tradition for my family and I to come here whenever we visit Reno! The food is amazing and the service is great, everyone is so nice and even when we show up years later it seems as though nothing has changed. 

We usually stick to the regular ham and eggs but decided to try some different items today and of course weren't disappointed. My parents shared the huevos rancheros which was great, the sauce on the eggs was really flavorful and delicious. My brother had the piglet omelette and was very satisfied. I had the corned beef hash and loved the extra veggies mixed in which gave it such nice freshness. The hash browns of course are perfectly crispy and the full stack we shared was fluffy and tender. 

You really can't go wrong with anything here, we've been through most of the menu at this point and have never been disappointed. Maybe it'll become a tradition for you too!

After writing the review my family checked out and forgot my daughters favorite stuffed animal.  I received an email (before we realized the oversight) from the head of housekeeping letting me know what they found.  They mailed it back to me and also wrote a personal note about how nice the kids were.  I mean really!  Is this place for real?   The staff across the board is the finest I have ever come across anywhere.  Hotel Monaco has raised the bar on service.  It will be hard to travel and stay anywhere else.
No more donuts I guess they dropped them awhile ago. Talk about disappointment! On the other hand the Chicken Sandwich was great just like in the past young lady at counter was very pleasant.

I had a car loan through Defilippo Brothers and their loan department, Premium Auto. I wish I could give them a lower rating. My issues include:
1. They have a promise form for things they will provide you that are missing from the car. You will not get them no matter how many times you follow up.
2. They could never keep my due date correct. They would debit my account on the wrong days, shut the car off even though the payment wasn't due, and harass you by an automated phone system to make a payment that isn't due.
3. My car has been paid off for a month. I get daily calls from their automated system telling me my account is past due. I've called multiple times. Most of the time you get transferred and then the phone disconnects. The one time I got someone, he told me he has a loan through them and HE gets the same calls, and I should just ignore them. Their system will dial you multiple times.
4. I've been waiting for my car title for a month. When I call about it, I get transferred, and then the phone disconnects. You never get a return call. They are really nice to you when they want to get you into a car, but it becomes a nightmare once they have your money. I would not recommend these people under any circumstances.
A must place to eat when in Clearwater! The smoked gouda was phenomenal!  Service outstanding!  A mixture of European foods... huge portions.  The owners definitely take pride in their establishment!

Ceiling leaked onto our table (ewwww) wait staff acted as if we were in their way because we wanted to sit in the bar area. The staff wanted to chat- we felt I the way and rushed. Then we found out they'd changed the menu. They did earn us, but we would never have spent so much on so little. Things are way overpriced now. We won't go back until they change things back. WAY too expensive.

This was an experience. 

I went alone, no reservations, they sat me down front near the stage. I had the seafood alfredo and it was delicious. Get plenty of bread to sop up the sauce. What a treat. Nice glass of wine. 

The band is terrific - every one a master and talent oooooozing out of their collective vibe. The trumpet player is a character - very friendly. He looks about 55, from England, and when he got talking and said he'd been in New Orleans for decades, I wondered aloud if he'd moved when he was a child? Nope. When he was in his twenties. Must be the water, the music, the food...something. And then he played. Amazing.

The topper had to be the owner, a nice, little older lady, dancing her ASS off late until the night. She sat a nice Turkish doctor with me, so I learned about the art of urology in the Middle East during band breaks. 

I really don't think you can top that kind of evening.
Excellent Italian beef and hotdogs. Salad and soup delicious as well. Hubby from Chi Town and he gives it a thumbs up.
Very very good food good drinks waitress was really good nice and clean hostess was good went here before we went down town for The party every May 5th.

Layla's is probably my favorite bar on Broadway. It's non-pretentious, and doesn't get *too* full, though it can get a good amount of people on the dance floor.

They don't do draft beers, only bottles. They have a decent selection though, which is nice.

There are tables along the walls, and some bar seating.

I saw the Eskimo Brothers here, and they were one of the best live acts I saw that week in Nashville.

I was only here for a few days and went to Layla's twice for drinks and live music. Couldn't help but come back a third time to pick up a t-shirt. It was the last one in my size, so the bartender just plucked it off the wall. It had a staple hole in it, cost $20, and smelled like beer, but it's probably the most authentic souvenir I brought back with me.

OK. Ok. Panchita's is the spot I crave any time I leave the city. Panchita's is the absolute best you can get if you're looking for casual, delicious Mexican food. Absolutely sublime. Best veggie burrito I've ever had, it is borderline addictive. This is a 10 out of 5 review. An absolute gem. Salsa made in house, delicious. Very very great spot.
Coolt ställe, trevliga servitriser. Kul att de körde på 80-tals menyn, det var riktigt billigt!

I live one block away from this place, and I will not be going back again.

Jason, the "manager," was very rude and condescending.

I picked up Harry Potter 1 for my kids, and halfway through the DVD froze. When I went back to ask for a different copy, he said they didn't have any other copies and waved his hand toward the other movies and said I could pick another one.

When I said that this was a movie my kids were watching, and I'd just like my money back so I could get it someplace else, he snickered and said that they don't do refunds, and I could get another movie.

I'm not even sure what the snicker was about. He's the 20/30something who manages a Blockbuster. Manages a shift of one person, as I'd picked up the movie 1 hour before from another gentleman whose nametag also said Manager.

I know that I'm not huge customer for Blockbuster, as I was only in there for a 99 cent movie. However, that shouldn't really matter.

By the way, there was only one other customer in the store at the time, and she was still picking out movies when this started, so it wasn't like I was stopping him from doing anything else.

I had chicken and waffles for the first time ever here and it was a game changer.  We even sat in the weird bar room right at the entrance to the kitchen, and it was still a good experience thanks to that dish.

I give Baan Thai an A for Awesome.  The Thai fried rice with Crab is a knock-out, and they do my favorite Thai dish, Pad See Ew, very well with more veggies than most places.  The staff was so incredibly friendly, and though the fire alarms started going off during our meal (thanks to the apartments upstairs), I liked the ambiance of Baan Thai.  After the fire alarm ordeal, they sent over complimentary fried bananas (so frickin good).

The price points are right up my alley, and with it being a BYOB you really can't beat it for a nice night out on a budget. I plan on going back ASAP to try out the rest of their menu.

Friendliest store in the universe.  All the great organic fresh veggies and a great dry goods and dairy section at much less than Turnip Truck or Whole Foods.  Could use a fresh coat of paint but its heart is in the right place.  A hidden treasure right here in Madison.

We came in for a celebration around 7:45 p.m. it said they close at 9. We were greeted with "we are closing soon so can you get to go?" Excuse me?! When I told them they are open till 9, the girl said they are going to close earlier..I am guessing bc she didn't want to work. We had 5 people in our group and came downtown to eat out, NOT get to go. Have a groupon to this place, won't be coming back. Won't be surprised to see this place close down soon, as my negative review isn't in the minority.

I was in the area, it was past prime dinner time and I was pretty hungry. I had a taste for pizza and this seemed like it was what I needed, but my local-loving ways urged me to slow down. Ultimately, my stomach won out and that was a good thing. Two Boots may not be locally-born but the pizza they serve up is good enough to make you forget all about that.

The decor, vibe and name of the pizzas all lean toward pulp/kitsch. No worries. When I'm in the mood, pulp/kitsch is just fine with me... when I'm in the mood and that usually involves shakes and onion rings. I'd never been served such in pizza form... but I was willing to go all in to try. The menu names and toppings are wildly imaginative. Have fun with the order. Spend some time studying the menu beforehand or walk around the display case with purpose. People who come here know what they're doing and they don't need a clueless n00b gumming up the works. I was impressed the the efficiency of customer and worker alike in ordering, preparing, serving, and getting out of dodge. Keeping it moving is one of my favorite things. Two Boots has mastered the process.

Since I tend to practice what I preach, I knew what to do. I stepped up and ordered a... pepperoni (shut up) and a Dude (see?). I was a bit verklempt that Two Boots offered a Great Escape slice. Way to give propers to the comic store which ruled this corner for years, sirs. Props/points/snaps for all of that. I would have ordered it but all I don't dig too much on basil since reading it's a bit of a carcinogen (as are fennel and tarragon). So, I kept it moving with the meat parade. I wanted to order a beer but I was getting my food to go and Nashville is not New Orleans. I settled on a Boylans Ginger Ale.

The pizza was as good as promised. Wide slices with just enough sauce and a thin, NYC-like crust, the toppings were the real star of the show. Pepperoni is my staple for pizza. If you can do pepperoni right, odds are you know what you're doing. Two Boots knows what it's doing. The Dude was as delicious about a slice bearing such a name should be. Tasso ham, andouille sausage, ground beef, and two cheeses make this a slice fitting for manly men, hungover men, men who bowl, men who slack, and (most importantly) men who love White Russians (of all kinds). Adding to the party in my mouth and belly was that Boylans soda. Good googly moogly, Boylans makes a tasty soda pop. 

I'll be back, Two Boots.

We just discovered this new Keke's. We are regulars at the one on Fletcher. This one is great too. Moe, the manager, checks in with every table to make sure folks are well taken care of. Food is great, coffee is great, service is great.

This restaurant is very convenient if you are staying at Atlantis. There is no salad bar/soup special right now due to covid. They were understaffed and trying their best to keep up with a relatively full restaurant. We did get seated in just about 10 minutes while the buffet restaurant had a much longer wait. (Saturday dinner)
The club sandwich and philly both were enjoyable! I liked that you could have soup as a side with the sandwiches.  French onion was the soup of the day and clam chowder is consistently offered. 
The caesar salad was very large but lacked flavor- not much pepper or parmesan.

Anytime I want a solid, satisfying meal HopCat is one of the first things to come to mind. Being so close to Broad Ripple and Butler is a huge incentive. Half price burgers Monday-Thursday is completely worth it. The beer selection pretty much covers the entire state of Indiana as well as other popular breweries. Their Facebook page posts about beer pairing dinners that are currently on my bucket list. They also have their daily specials on the website.

My business partner and I accidently stumbled upon Red Mesa during lunch time, i've got to say, great menu options and the food was delicious. I had the Tuna Tacos, which were amazing down to the rice and beans. The seasonings they use are unique and flavorful. can't wait to try some of the more traditional options. Wait staff was friendly and I will be returning on my next trip to St. Pete!

Italian (Roman) BYOB in the heart of South Street.

Service was great. Atmosphere was slightly upscale but still casual / homey. Food was delicious - had the artichoke hearts appetizer (apparently flown in from Rome?), bone-in veal entree, and fettuccine carbonara.

Can't beat the location. Great place to eat and drink before going out in South St.

Katie did a remarkable job and I can't recommend her highly enough. She is a consummate professional and helped make our event a big success. She is calm, patient and obviously very experienced. This made working with her an absolute pleasure. Everything was extremely well organized and went off without a hitch. Go, Katie!
Bad food, rotten greens, and the guy who runs it is a douche.

It would have probably been a decent experience shopping for furniture had the salesman not literally followed us around the ENTIRE store today! SOOOO UNCOMFORTABLE.

Update: I do not want to be bothered by this store. Several messages in less than one week is as uncomfortable as the stalking salesman.

A friend and I decided to have a stay cation and so we booked at the Varscona. The final bill was only about $190 including all taxes. This also included a free wine tasting and a free breakfast.

The rooms were comfortable, although not overly spacious, we were pleased. The air conditioning worked fabulously and we revelled in the linen. It was like constantly having the cool side of the pillow! crisp white linen, downy feeling beds... what more could we ask for? Oh yeah, great service from the lobby to the bellhop!

I don't want to tell on everyone, but the service was so good, the maid gave my friend a couple sample bottles of their moisturizer because she liked it so much!

The wine tasting was very nice, with cheeses, crackers and grapes as an accompaniment.
Their service is so damn fast I'm always so impressed. Their tacos are delicious I recommend the shrimp tacos YUM

Avoid this place if possible. #1 they are expensive because everything is a la carte (pedicure $20 + gel polish another $20 + take off gel polish $5) and #2 the customer service is non-existent. When I tell you that the guy doing my pedicure did not introduce himself or utter two words to me the entire time he was doing my nails it is not an exaggeration. He used taps and hand gestures the entire time. I indicated I wanted my nails filed rather than cut down and he immediately proceeds to cut my nails. Definitely not the level of service I expect for the money.

Andrew R. wrote "...the only thing that's a problem about Acme is the service desk. Strangely enough, the only legitimate service seems to occur ANYWHERE ELSE in the store - the deli, the bakery, the cashier's lanes. They offer a variety of services at the customer service area, but invariably there is a solitary surly employee back there..."

So, it wasn't just us!  Yes, I know EXACTLY who you're talking about, and she's the main reason that hubby & I haven't set foot in the Pennsville Acme for...maybe three years, now?  Maybe longer.  I have to wonder how many other perfectly good customers she's run off, and management is either unaware or just doesn't care, them being "the only game in town," and all.  For our bigger shopping trips, we make our way to the Woodstown Acme, where even the grumpiest employee seems downright pleasant, by comparison.  

We really need to renew our Costco membership!

Other than that, the Pennsville Acme is "meh-okay", but I wouldn't go as far as a three-star "A-OK".  Their scones are harder and not nearly as tasty as the ones baked at Woodstown, but their fresh breads are excellent.  This store is actually where we got hooked on the freshly-baked Italian bread loves, which they bake every bit as well in Woodstown, thank goodness.  The shelves were usually stocked well enough and the selection was adequate, although our tastes are, fortunately, not very exotic, so we don't demand a lot of variety from a grocery store.  Last time we were in, though, we had to bag our own groceries, but that was apparently an "Acme thing" that's possibly changed.  In the Woodstown store, there's about a 50/50 chance, now, that there'll be someone there for that, so hopefully it's a corporate-wide improvement.  (This is a full-priced store, not a discount chain, folks!  Treat your customers accordingly.)  The parking lot feels cramped.  We haven't taken measurements, but it doesn't seem as though there's as much room as there should be between rows.

If, for some reason, this were the only store we could shop in, we wouldn't be too happy about it, but we'd find everything we needed and then some.  We'd just studiously avoid the Service Desk!

I will never use another florist in Philadelphia. 

I live out-of-town now, so I am unable to pick out flowers in person when I send them back home now.  Thank you, Yelp, for sending me to Pure this year!!  For the same price I spent on an internet florist last year, I got something totally unique, completely incredible, and worthy of my mom!  

My mother received her birthday flowers today, and I was blown away via iPhone photo. I can only imagine just how gorgeous they are in person!  I had asked the designer on the phone to send something bright, oranges and yellows, that exudes happiness and makes you want to do a little dance when you see them.  To be perfectly honest, that is EXACTLY what I did when I received the photo of them.  I'm an only child, so my mom is pretty stoked on anything I do, but hearing the overwhelming happiness in her voice on the phone when she talked about the flowers was next level.  They are absolutely perfect.  I wish I could go hug whomever made them.  THANK YOU!

Seriously, using another floral designer would be a huge mistake/future regret, dear Philadelphia person searching for a florist reading this review.
So glad to have found a place to fix my Oreck after running over a cat toy shut my upright down. After their honest, fair price, and great service my Oreck is like new!
Good food and nice atmosphere.. Will be back again soon. Bartender are top notch. Only suggestion would be to dim the light for dinner.

Food was ok. Although the french onion soup seemed as though it were from a can.
Beer was not as cold as I would have preferred, but tasty. 
We'd try this place again.

We really love going to See's. We like to either get a small box or just a handful of candies. 

Our favorites are the different truffles. Our absolute favorite is definitely the Apple Pie Truffles. I love these even more than the darkest chocolate truffle they have available. It's that incredible!

We also love the Chocolate Chip Dark Chocolate Truffle (not positive on the name, but it is something like that). This one has the best dark chocolate flavor of all in my opinion. This is after several taste tests....lol I know my dark chocolate and this is THE one.

After we get those two, we often mix it up a bit. Some of the others we really like are: Pumpkin Pie Truffle, Pecan Pie Truffle, and Dark Chocolate Blueberry Truffle.

They have always been really nice when we go and they usually offer you a free sample.

All of their candies are now gluten free, too!

I had two cataracts removed by Dr. Berger in August and September. I went to Brandon Ambulatory Center for the procedures. Bay Area Eye Insititute is very professional, organized, and efficient. Dr. Berger is attentive and experienced. I would recommend morning appointments if possible as the afternoon wait times can get long though I know Dr. Berger is trying to address this. 
  I put off getting my cataracts removed. I am so glad I went through with the surgeries. I had him correct for near vision and I can now see 20/20 which is perfect for most of my activities. I was surprised that I experienced no discomfort of any type during or after the surgeries.

It was cool to do a mini tour of the behind the scenes action of local media. I got to see and feel the numerous Emmys that WFYI has collected over the years. Got to check out the set of Inside Indiana Business which seems larger on TV. The Small Studio Sessions space was neat to see as well. Sessions go down every first Tuesday of the month. During my tour I learned of the different programs they offer on the air via radio and tv. I also learned of the podcasts including, Curious Mix, and about WFYI Nerds. I recommend checking out both.

We stayed in this Hotel over the past weekend. Got Home today and realized that I had a charge for $100 on my credit card. I called Hotel and the Manager claimed it was for a smoking fee. We don't smoke. However the room had a slight musty smell so she burnt a flavored candle. The Hotel says they have certified professionals that are certified to declare an area has been smoked in. Now a few minutes later I am told by same Manager that your not allowed to burn candles in the room. It's a no win situation at this point. It's amazing so much hotel competition right now they would do this for an extra $100. That is fine keep the $100. As far as travel I will certainly not advise any one to stay at Tru by Hilton.

Impeccable customer service. I recently stopped by to have a charm attached to a bracelet and have the silver polished. The customer service rep, Lise, was super helpful and friendly; she made me feel really welcome despite my visit being "free" (Int'l mall employees can get their jewelry cleaned for no charge; a nice perk for sure!) My husband always has good experiences when he buys me jewelry here and my mother and sister in law are huge Tiffany's fans. Yes, it is expensive but the jewelry is good-quality and definitely unique.

Had dinner there last night. 
Ordered the pork tenderloin sandwich. 
I couldn't stomach as it was fried in olive oil instead of the traditional deep fried. My bad for not noticing this on the menu  

Management went out of their way and took it back without question. 
I then had the sliders, very good but my appetite disappeared
Five stars for customer service and five stars for management. 
We will defiantly return soon. 
My wife had fish fry which was fantastic.

We have been here many, many times. Just about every time, the food is wonderful. Occasionally, it is a bit hotter than usual, but always good and can mix with rice to cool down the spice.

They offer gluten free and vegetarian, which is required for is.

Love it!!

I wanted to give it a try today because I wanted something different from my normal routine and....IT WAS THE WORST FOOD I EVER HAD! (and that's saying Alot!) the helpings are so small it's rediculous the Chinese pizza is so hard it nearly broke my daughters tooth biting into it. the lomein was ice cold and there were barely any veggies in it and the "sushi" was just plain grose. No flavour tasted like old product. I don't know how this place stays open. I have to post a reminder not to go here again because I dnt even wanna try this place ever again. Maybe it's different if you eat in but delivery food from my experience is terrible. They forgot our drinks too.wich put the cherry on top. The only part of this place that was any good was the packaging lol they packed the bags neatly and used really nice plastic ware.
Had some cake at a baby shower from this place. Horrible.

You don't have to ride horses to love cowboy boots. :-) I am a huge fan  as they are the most comfortable footwear one can own, not to mention a great acessory. Space Cowboy is the place to go if you are looking for a well priced pair of quality boots. They have a great inventory of Lucchese and Liberty styles along with some other brands.They know their stuff and will work with you to find the right boot and fit. I walked in with the intention to buy 1 pair but walked out with 2. Need I say more?

I've only been here once before and once is definitely NOT enough...I'm due to make a stop there in the very near future. I ordered the Scrapple, Egg and Cheese on a long roll. One of the BEST Breakfast Sandwiches I've ever had in my life. They pack the Sandwich full of all 3 Ingredients and it is a very hefty portion size, so it's safe to say you could split one with someone and you both would be very full and satisfied. Up for me on my next stop here is the famous Roast Pork Sandwich!

Based on previous reviews, I had high hopes for this local eatery. The decor was trendy, service was fast and the wait staff was pleasant and appropriately attentive. Although, the food left more to be desired. Menu wording led me to believe I was in for something out of the ordinary. It was fresh and prepared well, although there were no enhanced or curated flavors, and presentation mirrored that of the average diner. I ordered bacon, eggs, breakfast potatoes, and shrimp and grits from their recently released "summer menu" (a verbal selling point). Exciting right? I was too but it was just bacon, eggs, breakfast potatoes and a waffle. Little effort was given to staple brunch drinks. Their mimosa was not prepared with equal parts making it overly acidic, and their bloody mary lacked flavor. Oddly enough, the $66 bill matched the total restaurant experience I thought I was getting.

While the apartments look great and the staff "seem" to be helpful if you have a maintenance issue they are slow to respond...if they do at all.  I have had an air conditioning issue since move in.  I was told it would be addressed quickly.  Their own maintenance staff has determined that the air conditioning unit needs replaced in writing.  That was 3 weeks ago and I've been told that they know nothing about a new unit and will fix it if possible, 24 hours after I was left the formal Sterling Management repair notice.  I cannot get a call back from the complex maintenance manager and no one in the office knows anything or is saying.  It's going on a month and the height of summer is coming and Lake Castleton CAN'T be bothered to address the issue or even provide an update.  Stay away if you want responsive support and customer service!

I contacted ACS to reroute some underground sprinkler irrigation pipe that had separated at a 4-way due to some overgrown oak roots. Based on previous reviews and communication with Laura / Bernie, I had high hopes the issue would be resolved quickly.

The techs showed up late on a Fri (way past my appt) and convinced me rerouting would not be necessary, since they could just use flex tubing as a repair method. I went along with this as a quick and cheap solution, since I desperately needed to water my dying grass. I should have raised a red flag when they asked if I had any extra 1 inch couplers.

During the initial test, the repair didn't hold which they blamed on the new glue they had tried that didn't require primer. After cutting a longer section of tubing and reattaching with primer & glue, it held. However, half of the repair was sticking out of the ground. I wasn't happy, but just let it go since I perhaps would be able to cover it up with mulch. 

A few weeks later (~3 watering cycles), I noticed no pressure on that sprinkler zone and water coming out of the ground in the exact same spot. After calling ACS back out, the techs claimed that an adjacent pipe was now leaking, not the original one they had worked on and would not warranty the repair. This would end up costing me double and still leave me with just a temporary solution. Either they did not identify / repair the original problem or while digging they caused another leak. I felt they should have honored their warranty or quoted me properly upfront which would have led me to stick with the original plan of rerouting. I spoke to Bernie who was very professional, but did not see things my way and simply offered a discount on the reroute or future repairs.

I ended up replacing the two 90 deg elbows (on the right) as well as the spaghetti repair with a proper 4-way allowing everything to be buried neatly. I had to get a little dirty, but everything has been working fine since.
Went there for the first time and it was REALLY GOOD! Yummy is all I can say and it was hard to pick what to eat because they had so many choices and they ALL looked TASTY!
Delicious food, fabulous drinks and an awesome atmosphere! Our server Dave made our dinning experience even better.  Cant wait to go back!
Not your average diner.  High end diner with yummy food.  Always crowded which is a big bummer.  Treat yourself!
I've been here a couple times, food and service have always been good. Their menu always has something interesting and new. I love the outdoor seating by the water.

Catfish was good, with a nice crunchy batter.  Pork baked beans were excellent.  Mac and cheese was good but tasted a bit different than usual, maybe had some blue cheese in it.  Banana pudding was amazing but the portion was pretty small - only half the container size.  If the banana pudding portion was like the rest of the sides I would give it 5 stars.

6:30pm on a Saturday night was perfect timing for a few friends to get a comfy corner to sit and chat. I can only imagine how busy this place gets come 8pm.  When you walk in the decor makes you feel like you've gone back in time. The bartender is friendly, very professional and can whip up a delicious cocktail. We ordered a few French 75's and Pecan punch before going over to Centro next door for dinner. The drinks were delicious and reasonably priced. Looking forward to spending more time at 1864.
