Remember to tip your bartender!

I will be honest, this was the last on my list of desserts to try in Nashville, but since every other place was closed...I didn't have much of a choice. 

The girl working there was not very friendly. Cupcakes are supposed to make people happy. 

I ordered half a dozen so I could take some home to the kids. The reviews are correct, the things are stacked high with icing. And the reviews are also correct when they say the cake part is dry. And I thought kind of plain. 

I guess now we know why they add so much icing. I mean isn't that what everybody does, when the cake isn't all that great, mask it up by drowning it in icing. At least it was good icing. Don't get me wrong, I love icing, and I have been known to plop it on.. but at least my cake is moist and tasty, and I am not a professional.

For the price and the quality, I would not bother with this place again. But I will say, the cupcakes are beautiful. So at least there is that.

There is a wait time, but it isn't without reason, as the food here is incredible. The staff here is friendly, and the wait time once you order is not long at all. The restaurant is a no brainer if your hotel is within proximity.
Best gym in Reno. Is customized training everyday unlimited and only $25 for new members to join. So worth it

I am forever grateful to local libraries and the services they offer.  Rooms for holding meetings, making copies, browsing the net, books for reference, community outreach, and friendly staff can all be found here.  I went initially to see about programs for preschoolers and ended up having a pleasant conversation with a staff member and leaving with a bunch of books and a DVD.  This particular library is tucked away in a strip mall, and thus is on the smaller side.  I like it because it is close to home and has a decent kids section.  I've seen more fancy and well stocked libraries, even within the immediate area, but this place is clean, large, and has dedicated staff.

Came here for dinner and drinks with a friend while I was in Tampa. Great beers, great atmosphere, okay food. I ordered a filet, oysters, crab mac and cheese, mashed potatoes and green beans... I can't say I was overly impressed by anything unfortunately. However, definitely a great happy hour spot for drinks when the weather is nice! I'd return and probably just not sit down for a meal.

I LIKE STRATTON"S:
It is clean, simple, and roomy.
The food is fresh and classic American (great for anti-foodies)
I ordered and egg and cheese wrap with green peppers
My son had REAL blueberry pancakes
My husband had a HUGE breakfast
--and it all came to only $24

THE GELATO:
absolutely amazing! The best I had (I got chocolate brownie) 
they dont skimp on quality here.
just eat it! (the small size is like 5oz so there is no excuse not to get some!

note: Kudos on great mgmt staff for keeping the glass doors clean all day :) yes--I notice things like that!

We wondered in off of the street into Jaspers and they weren't actually officially open. They let us know that they'd be opening on the 26th and we went on our way. As we were walking down the street someone came out as called us in, and told us not to worry they'd seat us anyway and we could have a quick drink. Jamie our bartender was amazing. She knew what she was talking about when it came to the drinks and to the food. They were all awesome and I would recommend to anyone. 5 stars out of 5. Stars

Love this place! Great menu of creative sandwiches, though you can build your own if you prefer classics. Just about everything is made in house (though I don't think their bread is unfortunately). Their tea of the day was quite tasty and the staff was very good about keeping it filled. The owner (I think) welcomed us and gave us some samples; he came back later to check on us. We felt very welcomed, had great service, and loved our sandwiches. The prices seemed quite reasonable to us (about $7 or $8 a sandwich). We've already recommended it to our neighbors and we will be back!
I had a steak burger. It was just ok. Sweet potatoe fries were good and service was very nice.

three words:  chocolate chip pancakes.

2 stars because crazy wait + no reservation option = me not coming here more often.
Best Ihop In the world. Meet new people, get great service . It's an fun experience, and the servers are top tier, shows actual personality. Very nice .

I can not recommend Toyota of Santa Barbara enough! I've purchased 2 new trucks in the last year and a half for our pool service company. Both transactions were extremely fair, fast and the customer service I received was far superior to any other dealership I've dealt with. Hector Tellez is a huge asset to this dealership. He helped us through every step of the transaction and I never once felt taken advantage of or overcharged. To anybody in the market for a new car, GO TO TOYOTA SANTA BARBARA FIRST!

Customer service took a nose dive
I came to place an order, no one else was in line.
A gal was arranging plastic bags next to the register. She called another name presumably to assist. Over the next few minutes kept arranging bags, she hollered a name to the back.. a few minutes later another customer came in.. nothing. The phone rang and she promptly placed their order.. 10 minutes waiting and the phone person can be helped but not the person in front of you. This is god awful service, cant even call it service since you provided none. No matter how good their food was in the past customer service is all important. I walked out pissed. Well it saved me a certain stomach ache as that is always a certainty after eating there.. Lost a consistent past customer..

Love this place, haven't been here in awhile since we moved but the Pizza slice lunch deal was still going and the Pizza and Beer both tasted great on hot Tucson afternoon. Construction has put a big hit on their customer base so stop in and check them out. Support local shops through hard times of city construction.  Great pizza and great customer service.

The bands are good. The drinks are waaaayyy too expensive and the food is below average bar food.
Staff is nice if you ever get to see a member of it at your table. They are usually understaffed so you have wait for your over priced drink and the lame food.
The Kimmel Center is looking better and better all the time.
Customer service amazing Lindsey was an awesome server!  Great meals and atmosphere will definitely return!

Years ago Pizza Hut was my favorite. Its been years since I've had it. My kiddo wanted pizza so we thought we'd try the buffet. 
I tried all three crusts. The pan pizza was greasy and tough (that could have been due to the amount of time the pizza had been sitting out). We requested a pizza on the regular crust. I was surprised at how tough the crust was fresh out of the oven. It was like cardboard. 
The selection was minimal and odd. One pizza had pepperoni and pineapple on half, pepperoni and jalapeno on the other half. It hadn't been touched. All of the options except for the one we requested had pepperoni on it. I did lots of picking off of pepperoni.
The cinnamon sticks were yummy. We wished the dessert pizza was on normal crust.
For the price,  its a good deal if you aren't picky about your toppings.

after doing a dolphin cruise me and my sister decided to have something to eat but we didn't want to go to a traditional restaurant we googled seafood and decided to stop here and we were not disappointed I had the coconut shrimp my sister had the regular shrimp, we also had the appetizer calamari and they were all amazing and not to mention that the price was decent we also had drinks she had the painkiller and I had top shelf Long island we had a nice buzz we also ordered a shot that you must have when you go there it's called the white tea but it would not have been possible if not for our wonderful host Chris he did an amazing job at taking care of us making sure that everything we needed was available and also doing it with an amazing smile on his face and a great personality you guys are very lucky to have him there we will be returning not only for the view but because of the hospitality and the amazing food
 from Chicago till our next trip see you soon

I've been to many gyms and this LA Fitness location is one of the cleanest locations I've seen. The locker rooms, cardio are and weights area are kept clean. 

The equipment is fairly new and it's all working. There are many new treadmills, bikes and stair steppers. The weights are usually in order and look legit. 

If you sign up for a longer term, it's the best way to get a good deal. Less than $30/month is a good deal of you are not getting personal training.

I love when I can get in and out quickly. My appointment was at 1:00. I was taken in promptly and was out before 1:30. The staff was friendly and competent.  Had both a 3D mamma and bone density scan done. 

Also, the facility is clean and tidy.

Why people hate on this place is beyond me. Yes you wait awhile, but David and his girls do quality work. Don't walk in at 7:00pm like an asshole looking for a full set and a pedicure when they close at 7:30. Don't be that person. 

Best part of this place is their willingness to do cool designs. I've been to so many places in the northeast that get so pissy when you ask them to do designs. If I'm paying all this money for someone to do my nails I want them to look banging, not basic. You pay for what you get. I literally come all the way over to Epitome because no other nail salon has yet to come close in satisfaction level.

Okay experience. Place is on Bourbon St. It's pretty dirty but typical for the area as they see so many customers, drunk ppl and messy seafood options. 

My partner ordered fish and chips. He was not satisfied. I had the shrimp po boy. It wasn't bad but not the best. The prices aren't justified. I've heard great things about the oysters and saw customers devouring by the bucket. 

Our waiter was very attentive and kind. The line to get in the restaurant moved fairly quickly. Overall 3/5.
Lindsay is the best bartender. Delicious drinks and delicious food, they have a great weekend happy hour!

We were in town for a few nights and found this place online and knew immediately that we had to go! It was worth it! Tim our waiter was fantastic, and very knowledgeable. The whole staff was so friendly. We thought it would mainly be just about the dessert but the food was amazing as well! We highly recommend the grilled cheese. Great experience overall, would fly back just for this!

This hotel has great amenities.  It's not on the strip so it has to have fun stuff to keep people entertained!  :)

The pool is outside, but remains open throughout the year.  It's fun to hang out in the pool and heated spas during winter.  

Biscotti's Cafe has a nice selection of desserts:  crepes, gelato, etc.  Love being able to take a short jaunt from the room to grab a sweet fix.  

They also have a great barbecue place.  I was really impressed with it.  

There is one part of the hotel, I think it's the Montego Wing, that is not directly connected to the rest of the hotel.  These rooms are cheaper, and it's a short walk to the hotel itself, but I really like the casualness of not having to throw a jacket on to go somewhere within a hotel.

Very good custard!  Flavorful, cold and refreshing!  Prices are reasonable which is a sight for sore eyes (and wallets).  I got a few wonderful flavors in a large and I was not disappointed.  My wife who isn't a big sweets person really enjoyed hers as well!  Hope to come back again soon!

Small establishment which can get crowed during busy hours.  Came for dinner on a Sunday night; ordered fried wontons and Gang Ped Phed Yang.  The wontons were not spectacular but not a disappointment, the curry on the otherhand was amazing!  The roasted duck was done perfectly while the spice and flavors of the curry were well balanced and robust.  The service from the waitress/hostess/busser/cashier was good, although she was busy she was attentive and very pleasant.  Looking forward to returning!

This place is THOROUGH! I have been to so many carwashes in the area and Autosheen is definitely the winner. Every inch of my car was sparkling, and they even used a compressed air gun to get in all of the crevices. 
Give yourself plenty of time b/c it takes them about 10+ minutes to wipe down and vacuum each car in line, worth the wait!

1st time. Easy menu to follow. Friendly cook and cashier. Cafe style line. 6 tables of 4 chairs each. Clean.
Sunday's are a great deal with 25% off orders of more than $20.
Absolutely returning.
Have been here multiple times and every time it gets better. This will be the best steak you ever have... I recommend to anyone and everyone

Love this place and I'm super excited it's dog friendly on the patio. 
I had the cheesesteak and it was amazing. Rumor is sometimes they sell out! We also had the Irish spring rolls. They were really good too. 
Kellyn was my server- what a delight she was. Attentive and friendly.

We go here every time we visit Santa Barbara! 
I recently became vegan as well and they were totally accommodating. 
Plus, bottomless mimosas for only $1 a refill! I definitely can't complain about that!

I used to work by the Tucson mall and sometimes the way my schedule was my dog would have to be locked up by herself for a minimum of nine hours.
I was using the Pet Hotel for "doggy day camp" several times a week so she wouldn't have to be locked up all day.

The staff at the Pet Hotel is friendly, knowledgeable, always excited to see my dog, and very accommodating.

I know that our high strung, high-energy, slightly neurotic dog can be a handful at times. They never made it seem like she was a burden, too hard to handle, or made her seem like the real pain that I know she can be at times.

I cannot say enough amazing things about the staff at the Pet Hotel! Thank you for everything you do.

We were  passing this place & was craving something sweet so we stopped had no idea what to expect. We purchased two delicious cannoli's. The owner was very nice. We will definitely go back for Italian food.
Best brunch in the world. Super busy, but very well organized. Everything on the menu is terrific.

If you're looking for Authentic Mexican food, don't bother coming here. The food was average at best. If you want real authentic Mexican & not the larger bill that you receive here...go to Los Gallos! Bigger portions, better food, better service & a much smaller bill!

We had reservations for 6:30. Arrived early and sat at the bar for drinks/appetizer. Bartenders are great.  We went to check in before 6. Told "we'd be seated closer to 6:30."   At 6:20, restaurant was only 1/4 full but they refused to seat us.  Said they had reservations ahead of us that had to be seated first.  Ridiculous- as there were no other customers waiting.  We went back to the bar and ate there.  Food was good but after spending over $300 for two of us and dealing with their awful seating process, not sure worth going back even though the bartenders were great.

This is a place that you can bring all of your friends to...   AND have them all be satisfied!  (I am assuming that you don't have any friends with crazy macrobiotic/organic/what the heck DO you eat?-type needs. Kidding...  Mostly)

The reason I can make such a statement is because their crepes, stuffed with WHATEVER YOU ARE IN THE MOOD FOR, are highly customizable. IPhones of the food world, if you will.  Have a friend who wants Lamb with Veggies and Pesto? Berry cheesecake? Check. Gyros... With Ranch? Check. Bananas, honey, walnuts, Boston Cream, Oreos, and Nutella? ... Check x5 ;) YES

Essentially, their very wide variety of fillings, spreads, and sauces means this:  Freedom to experience surefire deliciousness that will fill the hungry college belly on a starving college budget.  You can even call ahead to order, so that your crepe(s) are ready for you by the time you get there.  If you are a Temple U student, chances are that it will not take you that long because it is on campus (HUGE plus).

Amidst the sea of food trucks, stands, and establishments that grace the TU campus, this is my favorite...  And apparently I'm not alone (they were voted 'Best Food Truck' for several years in a row.)  As I watch my crepe being quickly whipped up, while he cuts open a fresh avocado to nestle inside it...  I smile because I am about to again experience why that is.
The best guacamole and mango dolce du leche ever. Everything is great there especially the drinks. You almost forget you're in the mall.

I have been to there for breakfast twice now, and I can't wait to go back.  Hands down the BEST pancakes I've have had!  Food is excellent, staff/owners are welcoming, and love the sea turtle atmosphere.
Delicious donuts! A lot more flavors compared to my other choices. Super nice and great people. Tip: I called my order in so no waiting. You can order online too. I will be coming back often. :)

Okay maybe I should give them 4 stars because they are mobile and I only know where they are one day a week. and that would be at Jesse Owens Park on the east side of town.  My girlfriend and I both had the Nutella and banana Crepe and it was fantastic.  This is why they got 5 stars and not the 4.  I may have to make a date to get one of these every Friday at the park.  Yup, it's as good as it gets!

We had booked a room at the Hotel Milo down the street and the room they put us in was absolutely horrible, I went to the front desk and they didn't even try to make it right, so we called the Best Western which was substantially less money and they had a room. We are so glad that we made the change. The Best Western was clean and the room was 5 times the size. I would recommend this Hotel to anyone who wants to be close to the Beach and Pier. I really don't like paying for 2 rooms but it was the best decision. The staff at the Best Western actually cared if we were happy with our room. Kudos to the Best Western and a big BOO HOO to the Milo.

The Corner Bakery has really gone downhill lately--my experience over the past year shows that the food often comes out cool, and they tend to take forever to clean tables. Receiving this burnt toast today prompted me to update my review. 

It's been almost a year into the COVID-19 pandemic, and I completely understand that many restaurants face a more challenging time to serve customers and stay afloat. But it has been almost a year, and this location is still unable to get ahold of itself to provide the quality service that used to make it a breakfast gem here on City Avenue.

I have been here occasionally for breakfast throughout the pandemic, and it always seems that either my pancakes come out cool (the butter barely melts on them), the bacon may be hard and looks like it was made yesterday, there are salty patches in my scrambled eggs, or toast is burnt.

I can only muster up two stars for this fallen angel--one for good value, and another for good selection of food. At this rate, it will soon no longer even be a good value--due to bad food preparation.

Hopefully Corner Bakery will keep watch on our reviews, and is able to return this location to the enjoyable spot that it used to be--before it's too late.

I like this place because it's one of the few ramen spots in Edmonton. I've been here many times and tried several kinds of ramen. My favorite is the spicy ramen except I prefer to have no toppings in it. I like plain and simple ramen with pork and an egg. 

The ramen wasn't oily or heavy, just really flavorful and spicy. I also ordered the rolls, which aren't bad at all. 

Couple of reasons why it gets a lower rating: the ramen made with peanut sauce is not good at all. It tasted like peanut butter and the broth was super thick! I also wish you could order an extra order of noodles to add into the broth when you're done the first round of noodles. I like my ramen! :)

Fried ribs as a light lunch before work today was the perfect choice. The ribs are smoked then fried with a crispy coating, juicy and full of flavor and come with a mild dipping sauce. The choices here are unusual in a good way. Next Saturday is the patio opening with a pig roast. I am going to try and make it. Excellent edition to the south city neighborhood.

Some of the reviews on here are just a little bit ... mean.
This is your average diner. The food is good. They have a decent selection. I ordered onion rings, they were a tad oily but tasty otherwise. My mom ordered a tuna melt that she said was really good. Our waitress was Brianna and she was the absolute sweetest young girl. Very attentive and so nice - definitely keep this girl! The other great thing about this place was how CLEAN it was! It's a little dated, sure but the tables were spotless, we were even amazed all the glass light fixtures were so clean - an odd thing to notice but it just goes to show they take pride in their establishment. I didn't eat at the salad bar but it is an option. Overall it's just a regular diner! I'd eat there again.

After experiencing all of the poke restaurants in St. Louis to date, I would have to say that this one is my least favorite. The customer service was satisfactory, the station appeared clean, and the dishes ordered didn't take long to prepare. However, I wasn't too impressed with the poke. Another downside is that Hiro Poke Co. did not have free fountain water. The customer will either have to buy one of their water bottles or go to a different station to get free water.

I tried the following:
1. Tori Paitan Ramen: The broth was flavorful, and I enjoyed the saltiness level. The noodles were the same ones used at most ramen restaurants in St. Louis. The chicken was tender. The portion was fair. I would likely get this dish again. Although, if you ask me how this ramen compares with others around St. Louis, I'd give preference elsewhere.
2. Aloha STL Bowl (with white rice): Plenty of color and looked like a promising choice. There was a decent amount of ahi tuna and salmon in the bowl. The ingredients tasted relatively fresh. However, I realized instantly after taking the first bite that the rice wasn't cooked with enough water. Very disappointing, considering that the rice portion is about half of the bowl. The rice was barely edible, and much of it was discarded because I just couldn't suffer through the crunchy, hard texture anymore. Additionally, I would've liked more sauce drizzled over the poke bowl. Dry rice and not enough sauce is not a good combination.

Stopped in here for lunch and was pleasantly surprised.  I ordered shrimp tacos and all the ingredients were fresh and tasty.  I also ordered a tamale on the side and though it wasn't like any other tamale I'd had, it was quite good!  Oh, and that Raspberry Margarita?  THAT was awesome!  Which made the rest of the meal probably seem better than it really was.  Will definitely stop in here again!

I called and I pretty much had no idea what I was doing. Ella had me email some pictures to her and then she was off to the races. She communicated with me over email due to I was at work. Stayed within my budget and I love the ring she put together. I went in and she was off enjoying a day off so Sean worked with me. Was beyond courteous to me and my 2 year old daughter. Put on a movie so she could chill out why we did our thing. He explained the ins and outs of the ring cut clarity grade etc. All in all I am very happy with this experience and I would recommend them for any jewelry needs. Thanks
Food is wonderful.  Staff is extremely helpful.  You must try the poppyseed chicken!

Cute boutique shop. There's a handful of boutique shops in the French Quarter, but this one stood out to me because the scarves were pretty affordable. I purchased a soft, grey/black elephant scarf for $21 after 25% discount. Service was quick and they use Square so I was able to pay by credit card and the receipt was emailed to me right away. Overall, I was pleased with Lost and Found and glad I was able to buy something to remind me of my trip to NOLA without being overly touristy.

I had the Tuna Poke Grain Bowl and it was absolutely delicious.  The broccoli cheese soup was cold and I refused to eat it.  The green teas were average.  I'll go back for the poke again though!  It was great!!

Couldn't have asked for better. My pod arrived on time, the driver placed it exactly where I wanted it (i mean exactly!). Easy to load (no ramp needed!!) as its only 4 inches above the ground. Perfect solution to our kitchen remodel. 
Use promocode AE0616 to save on delivery and monthly storage fees.

We didn't have a reservations! You probably should because the hostess wasn't to happy with us! Not a very friendly person! But we waited at the bar and things got better! Everyone was very helpful and kind! We got a table and our waitress was so very sweet and wonderful! I am so sad I didn't get her name! The food was amazing! We had the pulled pork sandwich, tuna, hush puppies and the pretzel! Yum!!

Went to the Thistle Cafe today for a holiday lunch with my team of 30 people. Trish the event manager was so helpful coordinating this lunch. We were able to order ahead of time so the food was ready right when we got there but could also order items a la carte as needed. I had the pimento cheese sandwich and it was the best pimento cheese I have ever had. The service was great and everyone was so friendly. They cater and deliver as well and I will definitely use them in the future. Cannot recommend this place high enough!

I went for lunch yesterday & it was great, I'd made a reservation on opentable.com.  I had the arugula salad with pistachio's, the meatballs over polenta, and the calabrese pizza.  This was split between 2 people and was just right!  Our server, Todd, was very kind as well!  Would definitely go back!

I'm from California and came here off of the recommendation of one of my s/o's friends. Upon walking inside, I was super impressed at the interior. It's a pretty big space that's also really cute and clean. Someone told me to try the king cake while I was in Louisiana, so I was excited to see that they had both king cake and the king cake cupcakes. I was in the mood for a cupcake, so I ordered a king cake cupcake. 

Let me add that I've never had king cake before, so I am not sure how it's supposed to taste and what the consistency is supposed to be. The cupcake was just pretty dry to me and was on the blander side. The frosting was pretty good. My favorite part about it was the sparkles! It was cool that there was some frosting infused on the inside of the cupcake. I did dip some of the cupcake in the caramel (?) sauce that's drizzled on the plate. For $5, I was simply underwhelmed. It was cool to try, though.

Just developing a taste for steak so my review is based solely on my non-red meat treats here! The tuna steak is by far the best I have ever had, always seared to perfection. The wine list is stellar and vast so listen for recommendations.

Urgent... Not at all.  I was the first one here at 9 am.. Doctor strolled in at 9:40.. The front desk girls were nice, but not well trained.. Everyone was very confused as to the process and what needs to be done. They are definitely not URGENT

5 stars for the setting, ambiance, and the way this place is changing the feel of Downtown Wilmington. Overall I am only giving 4 stars because in my two visits I wasn't overly impressed with either meal (I guess not the actual location's fault). Maybe my expectations for the food quality were higher than they should have been from things I had heard. I'll be back to try a 3rd shop at DECO and see if I find a homerun.

There's a better and cheaper new smoothie place nearby here... It's at about 4240 N 1st Ave, on the East side of the road right next to the big new gym, and is called "Smoothe Factory".

I used to love Jamba, but then they emailed me a birthday coupon to get a 16 oz smoothie for $2... I go in there with the email on my phone and they say it needs to be printed out. WHY?

Pulling up the email on your phone is actually MORE secure and proves that you were actually probably emailed it, whereas anyone can print anything.

Because of their stupidity, I'm officially done with Jamba Juice. Plus, this new Smoothie Factory is super good! My first smoothie tasted a little better than the Jamba smoothie's I've had! And I'm not saying that because I'm bitter.. I think it seriously tastes a little better. Plus, $4.70 at Smoothie factory gets you a 20 oz... For almost the same price you only get a 16 oz at Jamba.

180$ tab for two. 50$ steak was overcooked, under-under seasoned, grey exterior, barely even had grill marks, and was sitting in a pool of liquid. If I had to guess i would think it was usda choice or lower. I've picked up better cuts from publix. For 50$ I expect prime steak. 

Wife's grouper was barely acceptable. Zucchini fries app was great and salad was great. Great service but can't pay that kind of $$$ for service and apps. 

It's too bad but we wont be back.

Great place for Vietnamese noodles.  Great location right off of Sierra Pkwy and Virginia, in South Reno.
This place is always packed!  And I think they may need some help as there is always a wait when food is called in and stated that it will be ready at a certain time.
The Bun Vermicelli is good.  The Spring rolls may be on the "thin side"
I've yet to order the boba.  Next on my list!
Decor is ok, place is clean for a busy place.  Server is friendly (I only see one person working the customers each time I visit)

This is the best sushi option around this area. The food is fresh, always prepared nicely and in a timely manner, and the service has been good every time I've been there. Ordering online and picking up was even more convenient. 

Being the best in the area doesn't mean it's the best sushi ever, though, so I've definitely had better. This place makes up for it in ambiance and paying attention to detail if you're dining in (such as bringing over fruit while processing your check). 

It's plenty spacious, too, so you can bring in a nice sized family without feeling crowded or rushed because they can continue to seat others at a distance away from your group. And they have non-sushi options such as hibachi and teriyaki choices, so most people seem to be able to find something from here, even if sushi isn't their cup of tea.

In more civilized days when individual HONOR had meaning and men were willing to put their lives on the line for it, other than just in warfare, this area of City Park was very frequently used for duels.  Originally there were two dueling oaks but unfortunately one was destroyed by a hurricane in 1949 so we have the last remaining and singular dueling oak standing.  There is a commemorative plaque explaining the historical significance of this oak and the area around it (at least until Maoist Mitch and the rest of of his Cultural Marxist Red Guard continue their destruction of history spree and remove it and cut down the tree).

We sorely need to re-legalize dueling in City Park and I would be happy to meet all the honorless Cultural Marxists in duels under the dueling tree at such time.  They would lose in a simple battle of wits as they lack logic and facts to justify their destruction of history.

I'm fairly certain that Barcelona's was the first tapas restaurant in STL and it's still tasty after all these years. Barcelona's is located in Clayton, which is still fairly easy to get to even with the highway 40 closure. Barcelona's has very cheap lunch and dinner menus which are really convenient as tapas can add up quickly and become expensive fast. The mojitos at Barcelona's are also really tasty and refreshing. As far as food goes, I really like the Brecel Rioja and the Atun com Pimienta. This place still gets busy fast and the tables in the dining room are really close together, so I like to come early to avoid the crowd.

Krispy Kreme is always coming up with something new.  Mini donuts.  Valentine donuts.  Summer donuts decorated like strawberries and pineapples.  Chocolate glazed chocolate donuts.  There's almost always something new and different every time I stop in (maybe 6 times a year).

The downer is that when I do stop in, it's in the evening Sunday after work and they are often out of certain donuts.  One time they were out of a donut in the case, but I spied some on a rack behind the counter and had to ask if I could have one of those (they obliged).  

The lobby is not always super clean - it's not gross, just doesn't look like it's been swept, or tables wiped down recently.

Delicious donuts - better when they are fresh though, but that is probably the case with all donuts really - window to the assembly line where the kids can watch the production of donuts, bathroom for patron use, and decent prices (if you are getting 7 donuts, it's a better value to get the dozen).

It appears to be locally owned, is near my home, and has pork roll. I like it.

I got breakfast sandwich and enjoyed it. My lavender latte was good. 

The space is small. If you're looking to have a meeting over coffee, this might not fit the bill. But for a to-go order made just for you, it's a good option in the area.

I find this unacceptable! The amount that was charged on my credit card ended up being 33% more than they quoted and I authorized - and the final bill emailed to me.  Turns out their charge is "estimated" as evidenced by the small asterisk next to the final price amount.  They explained that the items I ordered weighed more when they picked them hence the extra charge.  This is the first and last time I will use them.  If I budget for a certain amount in groceries I just can't get these kinds of surprises - this feels very abusive!  Other than that, they were timely and friendly.  However, I was very surprised to see that they packaged fresh vegetables (exposed) in the same box and right next to the raw meats.  Don't know if they realize the exposure.

An absolutely lovely family run restaurant with great food and great service.This was our second visit and we were just as impressed the second time as the first.My family and I own and run a business in Tucson and know how hard it can be to get established.Do yourself and Tucson a favor and take advantage of this gem of a restaurant,Barry Callahan.

My wife purchased Karastan carpeting for two bedrooms.  They did not suggest installing a top-grade pad.  Price was OK.  

The installers were unprofessional -- they were two hours late because they were given the wrong address.  How do you give the wrong address from the invoice?  Strike one.

They showed up in a panel truck with bald tires, filthy van interior, dents all over the van.  They claimed they installed carpeting in Hollywood Florida the weekend before.  Given the van's condition, no way did they drive this vehicle.  Strike two.  

The best part -- they were told one of the carpet installations was to be over a tile floor.  They did not bring the correct tack strips!  They did not have the right equipment to install the carpet against an adjacent tile floor.  Strike three.

They did not vacuum the carpet one it was installed.  The installers said their vacuum was not working.  We then called Steve at JB who told us "this is not in the contract."  After 30 minutes on the phone, he finally agreed to have the installers vacuum when they came back to install the carpet against an adjacent tile floor.  Hit by pitch (I'm out of strikes!).

Bottom line:  Find a store staffed by professionals who truly want satisfied customers and won't waste the customer's time with so-called false directions, wrong tack strips, incomplete installation, and a manager who offers only excuses rather than do the right thing to fix the problem.

Such a quaint little ice cream shop in Broad Ripple! There is very limited parking, but the staff is friendly and the ice cream is delicious and extremely well priced. They even had cute table top discussion prompts to keep you entertained while you ate. I will definitely be back!

Drunken noodle 
Pad Thai 
Chicken skew

These were all good when we went for dinner. Place was small and intimate. Seems like a lot of regulars come to this establishment. 

Street metered parking.

I try not to go here because every time I try to order something they get my order wrong. Today I order lunch for me and a couple of friends. When I got back to work with my order I realized that they had forgotten my sandwich and they got my Mac and cheese order wrong. Been trying to call them but of course they aren't answering the phone. Now I'm stuck with no lunch and I can't even go back because I'm on the clock.

Monthly Burger and Shake Specials.

Fries with a dozen sauces to choose from - awesome!

Can be a little pricey, but I enjoyed my food while I was there. I would definitely like to return and update my review later. It was awhile ago since I went. 

I enjoy the variety of burgers to choose from. Kids menu available.

Alcohol available.

Service and food were excellent, Debra our waitress was a rare treat - we'll make sure to request her next time we dine here.

A few things to mention:
The saloon was incredibly loud given there was a 10 top with multiple children. A poor management decision on a Saturday night. We could barely hear each other over the shrieking. Trying to have a quiet drink while waiting for our table was impossible and really gave us a poor impression of the restaurant's management. 

The bartender was wonderful and recommended great new options in local beers, given we are new to the area we truly appreciated his skill and attention. 

Piping in music on top of that just added to the cacaphony. *ouch*

The hostess need additional training to seat families and loud parties together to create quiet zones for couples in other areas. Seating (especially older) couples near (in this case, alongside) the kitchen is an amateur mistake in the restaurant business. My husband is a military veteran with service-related hearing loss, he had a horrible time hearing me speak.  Again, poor management there - lack of training of staff. Next time, we'll make a reservation ahead of time and specify a quiet table.

Nametags would have made things a lot easier. When we needed to find Debra, we couldn't identify her except by description - this puts diners in an awkward situation. Its all about the experience. 

That said, the waitstaff works great as a team - waitstaff management is obviously doing a great job there!

Highly recommend!!   Carlton, Julius & Edgor were prompt, professional, strong and efficient. They completed our move in the least amount of time while still being careful and respectful of our belongings and space.

When I scheduled this move, the scheduler, Amy, was very knowledgable and answered all of my questions. The quote was very competitve and they do not bill for travel time to and from your home.

Nothing but a great experience.

I've lived in Nashville for two weeks and I've been here three times, if that says anything.

Von Elrod's has this incredibly relaxing and casual vibe. A great spot to hang out with a group, grab a beer on a date, or even wobble over after one too many.

They have spacious cafeteria-style seating options on the inside, along with patio and outdoor seating if you need some air.

The prices are incredibly affordable, especially if you buy in bulk (grabbing a full liter beer). 

Meal options are decent, about what you'd expect at a bar like this. Overall, would definitely recommend.
It's Dunkin' Donuts. It's fine. The staff here was very nice though so I figured I'd give them a shout

What a horrible customer service experience.  The wait staff was NOT friendly and continually ignored customers at the bar that was not even half full.  They clearly think that they are a high end downtown club not the dive bar that they are.  

The facility was run down and while the drinks were cheap, it was not worth the aggravation of dealing with the bartenders.

Excellent in every way. This is the type of place that people fall in love with. I see people come in everyday, others come in every Saturday or Sunday with the family. Definitely kid friendly. The staff is very helpful and they always keep everyone entertained and happy. It does get busy on the weekends so I always come a little earlier. I would recommend this place for lunch or breakfast to anyone.
The smell and service were so bad that we weren't given a menu after about 7 minutes and decided not to wait for one....

Service is impeccable, our waiter max was knowledgable and friendly. Never has a empty glass or wait for him to come around. Food was divine. Being a vegetarian it's hard to find a place that has good vegetarian options and their vegetarian dishes did not disappoint. I ordered the eggplant dish and it was a huge plate and each bite was delicious. Ordered the churros for dessert and they were heaven.

Our little airport here in New Orleans is easy to navigate, comfy and you can zip right through security without many problems.  YOu don't have trams to take to other terminals, and you don't need a map and a compass to find your way around.  (Honestly, I have needed a map to navigate an airport once.  The fact that the airport actually had a map to give out was a little troubling).  The flights are usually on time (weather permitting) and the parking costs are not too high.  There are always cabs ready and waiting or shuttles to take you to your hotel.  A great airport to go in and out through.

Considering this is the 4th Ace Hotel I have stayed in, this review is not coming from an unbiased "fan". 

What I like about this Ace Hotel in NOLA, spectacular ambiance, great location, abundance of amenities and posh design details.  

Looking from outside in, this is one of the swankiest of the four I have stayed at. Other three being LA, Portland and Palm Springs.  The overall experience as along as you are outside of your room is A+. 

Here are a few things that failed expectations.  The room, despite the size and high ceilings, was poorly furnished and designed. The tiny table and two uncomfortable chairs made this working station unbearable. The privacy curtain that divided the wc from the sleeping area seems nonsensical as it was full of gaps; which really was not useful if privacy was desired.  The fully stocked bar, fridge and top of the fridge was a bit overkill as the hotel prices are supremely gouging. Lastly, the services was mediocre if not C-.  

Would I stay here again?  Not if I cannot check out the room first as the online representation is a bit overzealous.  If there is no adequate working station or comfortable seating, it would be a pass for me.
I have been a member for over two years. The machines are always in top condition and the attendants are helpful and friendly. Great pool and Sauna and the best showers of any gym in town.

I had a really hard time finding a place that did Gel-Builder fills (an alternative to acrylic). I finally found Mi Nails and I'm so happy! 

Tim always does my gel-builder fill with gel polish on top and he's always amazing. He takes his time and makes sure you love the shape and length of your nails every time! They have a large selection of both gel and regular nail polish (including names brands such as OPI and Essie!).

One thing to note is that they have stopped taking tips via credit card so remember to bring some cash with you! You can always pay with your credit card, but the additional tip option is being phased out.

I'll be back in two weeks as always!!

It's Starbucks so you know the coffees going to be good. But the main issue with this one is the drive thru takes anywhere from a couple of mins to upwards of 30 plus. I've been going here for years now and it just seems that they can't find a happy medium with moving the drive thru along.

Stumbled upon this artisan chocolatier on a Monday night as they were about to close. Instantly fell in love with the 75% Kokoa Kamili dark chocolate bar. I've found my perfect healthy (dairy and gluten free) and decadent dessert. My only regret is not purchasing more of this divine chocolate. Also recommend the Handlebar espresso dark chocolate bars for coffee lovers!

I really enjoy this simple vegetarian friendly place.  They could use more flavoring in their dishes, but I am a fan of a light veggie-ful dish.  I had a soup and noodle dish for under 10 bucks.  I'll be back for sure.

I'm guessing that the reason this restaurant got 4 stars from most reviewers is that it's really the only place around like it.  Food was average - no way it's a 4 or 5. 

The bread was boring.  I like ultra-spicy, but the hummus served with it had quite a kick, which means your average patron wouldn't be able to eat it. The salad dressing tasted bottled.  I know they're a seafood place, but coming from Orlando I'm used to knowing that good seafood grills also have a top notch beef dish for the landlubbers, especially in the $20-30 price point. My steak was overcooked and loaded with a too-salty sauce.  Yo top it off, the service was tepid at best.

The three stars comes from the desserts, which were quite tasty.

Horrible service. My Volkswagen club met here on a Wednesday night. There was one waitress serving the bar  and the whole restaurant. Our table had about 12. No joke it took 1 hour and 45 mins to get our food. Food was cold. Contacted the owners and no luck. Are club hasn't been there since.

Walking to get the car after dinner and decided to stop in and try it out. Absolutely more than I expected. I tried the java chip frappe.  I'm usually not a frappe fan given I like black coffee, but wow! It was a little taste of heaven :) will def stop in again and I def recommend it!

We are heading to the Pet Parade tomorrow, and I felt like the worst dog owner in the world because I realized my dog was out of date on his vaccines! I would never expose him to the public unvaccinated, so I was calling everywhere trying to get an appointment. WGAC told me to bring him on up and had a tech vaccinate him. I found the front desk helpful, and the staff to be very kind. 

I did have quite a long wait, which could have been better, but other than that great service and caring people.

I will not be returning. I was wash, cut and blown dry in under 1/2 hour after waiting 1/2 hour for my appointment. Explained the problems with my very straight, heavy hair and what I was looking to do. the stylist cut a few layers in back, trimmed my bangs, and charged a hefty price, $60.00 later my hair does not even look styled. could have done as well in Hair Cuttery for half the price. My idea of a good style is when you get some compliments. None here!!!!!

The Brooklyn pie is one of the best tasting pies you'll get anywhere. Ive had it twice now and its just perfect. Pizza with pesto and a few other things is delicious. I really enjoy it and its only $15 for 12 slices.

Went on a day after heavy rain so the mud puddles were a nightmare.  Great to have such a huge dog park right in the middle of the FQ.  It's pretty securely fenced in so the dogs can have a blast running around with each other.  But still keep a watchful eye out though in case your little one slips through somehow.

Lots of very chill, cool dog people that seem like responsible dog owners.  Very clean park considering the number of visitors here each day.  Love the chairs they have all over the place.  Parking in the area could be a challenge though.

My fiancé and I were so pleasantly surprised at their beer menu for being a new brewery they had an extensive menu! My sour beer was awesome and the IPA's and German beers were great!! Can't wait to come back next time.

After leaving the Captain America movie (Must See!), decided to have a nice meal around 7pm Saturday, July 23rd with my lovely wife. Although we didn't have reservations, they were able to sit us on the patio. It was actually pleasant with a slight breeze. Anyway, the food is always good. We live in Brentwood, I prefer Wild Iris, my wife prefers the Yellow Porch. Started with Crawfish Cakes and Tomatoes Basil soup. Both were good. I'm from New Orleans and fancy myself a very good home cook. I've made Crawfish Cakes with Crawfish Cream Sauce many times (Emeril recipe) and while YP missed the mark because the breading to crawfish ratio was off (too much breading), it was good. We had the Salmon and BBQ Shrimp for entrees -- both were excellent. As always, the service was very friendly and attentive. We didn't have wine, but the list has some nice selections.

When I tell you the Effen hot Philly cheesesteak from this spot gave me LIFE! If you love really spicy food then this is the PERFECT sub for you! For those of you who dont care for steak, try the Chicken cutlet cheesesteak!! Soooooooo Good. Everything was so flavorful ! There certainly aren't stingy with the meat portions either. You will have to adjust your mouth with every bite! The sweet potato waffle fries were also delish! They also serve beer and wine which makes me love this spot even more! I would say they are a little on the pricey side but it is SOOOOOO WORTH IT. The service is great! There are two levels and even a little sidewalk seating area. Everything is very clean and polished. The decor has some cool vintage art which is interesting  to look at. I will definitely be coming back here the next time I visit Philly! The location is a perfect spot to get lunch while you're out shopping!

Norristown location looks pretty unassuming and is located in a tiny strip mall with not much else going on. I actually thought I was in the wrong place for a moment. 
Mostly for takeout, the storefront has two tables and a small cooler next to the counter. The staff was friendly and greeted us immediately. 
We ordered a juice to split, the walnut meat taco salad, the 'tuna' salad, and a piece of chocolate pie for dessert. This is really my first experience with raw veganism and it was a good one! 
Both of the salads were extremely flavorful and huge portions. The pie was delicious but super heavy, I don't think either of us really had room for it, even splitting the item. Juice was refreshing and a good blend. 
As far as price, the items were all priced reasonably individually, but be forewarned it can add up quickly. Our total was close to $45 for lunch (oops).

Super service, good food and wide beer selection. Had the Crown Jewel salad and really liked it. Not a big salad eater but this one has enough meat on it for any carnivore. 

About 25 taps and many, many bottle selections. You won't go without finding something you like.  

Id like to see this place on a game day Saturday.  I'm betting I'd have competition for the bar stool I've had for the last couple nights. It's relatively quiet in Tucson right now. They have a nice outdoor area in the front too. 

Lots of good choices right on this strip but I'd recommend cruising in to the Frog & Firkin if you're in the area.

The only thing I wanted to add to all the great reviews was that this park is gated and has hours and does not open until 8am. So if you want wildlife you may miss some of the best time around sunrise. Wish they would open earlier. Also Park May close before sunset. So best time for wildlife watching is in seasons where the park hours are closest to sunrise and sunset. The hours may also change with the seasons so check in advance.

My son needed a book for a UCSB English class, at the last minute of course. Paperback Alley had a copy, at a greatly reduced price. Small bookstore, locally owned. They know their stock, and the proprietor is very helpful.

So nostalgic and the views of all the beautiful homes on St. Charles was worth the frequency of stops the trolley makes. The cost is very affordable at $3 per person for a daily pass. This is not a smooth ride and the seats are wooden but we didn't care.  We were able to see other things we wanted to do while riding the trolley. It stops super close to Bourbon Street. Everyone was friendly and there was always a seat available.

I was skeptical about getting my car windows tinted in the PA area because I usually go to someone from my hometown (MD) to do the job. So shopping around I read nothing but 5 star reviews for Osmi Car so I went with them and boy am I glad I did. 

My sister and I both were getting our vehicles tinted the same day so they offered a multi-car discount, which is 5% off the original price (I was amazed because the price in my hometown is about $70 more and they don't offer any multi-car discount) 

I made my appointment the day before and was told to come at 9:30am when they opened. I did have to pay a deposit which went towards the final price. I arrived at 9:30am and Jose greeted my sister and I and asked what percentage we were looking for we told him and then he informed us we had a few cars ahead of us and that our cars would be ready by the end of the day and that they would call us when they were done.

They called us around 2:30pm which was faster then we had anticipated! When we picked up our cars we paid the remainder balance and just a tip if you pay with cash they won't  add the tax to the price. 

I am so happy with my tint job and will recommend Osmi Car to anyone they really were so friendly and did a wonderful job!

I have lived here for a year now and will be renewing my lease. The staff has always been courteous and it is obvious that they try hard to create a community feel . My mom visited over the weekend and was very impressed by the property. She commented several times about how well the grounds were maintained and the overall cleanliness of the common areas, hallways, pool, etc. It helped remind me that I may have come to take these things for granted. The train is quite annoying, but the location is great for access to all the downtown restaurants and shopping.
Love this neighborhood spot. The kale salad is a winning local fav and the burger is top notch. They have a perfect ambiance and the cocktails are spot on.

We went here for their soft opening. We ordered crispy noodles with seafood and rice vermicelli with pork. Both were excellent. The crispy noodles had fresh seafood and a great variety of vegetables. The pork with the vermicelli was very nicely flavored, and the pork wasn't fatty at all, which is a huge plus. Overall, the two dishes were excellent.

The service was very attentive, and the food came out pretty quick.

We'll be back. Recommended.

At first glance, it appeared to be closed, but most of the parking is in bake. Same quality as the location in the FQ, plus they accept debit cards. Tasty beignets and plenty of chicory-laced coffee. Make sure to wear a black shirt to catch all that powdered sugar goodness.

Went on Sustainable Vines tour recently with my mom. We had the best time on this tour with our guide Scott. This is my second tour in Santa Barbara/Santa Ynez valley and would definitely recommend Sustainable Vines over any other. Being pregnant I wasn't able to participate but had a lovely time regardless. The scenic drive alone through the valley was worth it. Scott was a lot of fun and took us to the most beautiful spots. It was a gorgeous trip and I heard the wine was amazing too! Will certainly go back post-baby to try myself!

I don't know why people are so hard on this place. I went there for dinner last night around 8:30 pm. It was a Saturday night and we felt like diner "comfort" food. We were seated right away, the servers were attentive, and the food was very good. Yes, I said servers, plural. We had multiple servers with drink refills, and bringing out our soup and salads. OK, they ran out of matzoh ball soup but the chicken noodle soup was just as good a substitution. Our platters were diner portions (enough for 3 meals), which much of it was taken home. Our original server was friendly and did a good job of trying to upsell us on dessert (sorry, we declined, too full). No issues with paying our bill and the place was clean. They weren't busy so that may be a factor. However, we have no complaints and would return for another dinner in the future.

I thoroughly enjoy stopping in here for a quick  beverage after working out or when I'm hustling around on the avenue!

They offer a mix of teas, boba, and espresso. I've always gotten a latte of some kind when I'm in there, but since their focus is primarily bubble tea, I'm sure it's great.

Get an iced lavender latte - it's delicious.

PROS:
-big drink menu
-friendly staff
-usually have a special of some kind running
-lots of plugs if you're sitting down to do some work
-lots of seating and a little upstairs area

CONS: 
-there's usually only 1 (sometimes 2) staff member working, so sometimes the wait is long
-not a lot of food options at present

A cute spot that's definitely worth a stop!
Such a fun spot! Nice atmosphere and the taro tea was delicious and flavorful. I wish they had more milk options but it's nice that they have almond milk.

We weren't impressed. The pretzel was delicious and so wasn't the Frozen Rum Runner,  but everything pretty much went downhill after that.

My partner got the seafood pie and he said it was very good, but dang it was so little. He said the mashed potatoes were about the worst he ever tasted (he didn't eat them at all). I got their 'famous' grouper sandwich. There was such a little piece of grouper in it I couldn't even taste it and the onion roll was terrible. 

I wouldn't go here again.
Great upscale food and nice quiet atmosphere. Had a great romantic meal there. Sometimes there are DJs too. Check it out. It's a great addition to downtown Wilmimgton.

This little coffee shop is next to  Cuban bread bakery and operates out of a food truck. There's outdoor/patio seating attached to the truck. Their coffee is delicious! It's expertly roasted, mellow, yet strong- very unlike chain coffee stores. They make a variety of different coffees but my favorite is the cafe con leche. The barista makes it out of regular whole milk, heaping of sugar, and a strong espresso.  Spaddys is definitely one of my favorite coffee shops in Tampa- I brung out of town visitor here regularly.

My mom is 88 years old. She decided to change dentists at the suggestion of her friend. With her age I am the one driving her around to medical appointments.

She got the discounted first cleaning and X-rays and all was well. Very nice staff. They did a 2nd appointment for a deep cleaning that she told me was going to be $89, they also suggested that a tooth needed work. We we got there it turned out that the $89 was for a discount card and actual work was over $1,000 but without the discount card it was over $2,000. No problem just $89 today and sign up for a credit card and make installment payments. The credit card jumps to 26% after the intro period. I quickly googled the procedure on my phone and the $1,000 price seemed 2 or 3 times what it should have been.  My mom has very limited income at the extra $100 a month impacts her quality of life. 

We decided to get a 2nd opinion with her old dentist. Their price for the procedure was much lower and it turned out she did not need this extra cleaning or the work on her tooth. 

After reading other reviews with similar stories about this particular office I felt the need to post this review. As they say buyer beware.

When I first came to Florida many years ago I remember Cracker Barrels being a interstate highway thing, and we'd drive over an hour just to eat in one.  It was a treat!  When they started building them amongst "the people" and they started building this one, I was high fiving myself.

I'm a huge fan of the meat loaf and the dumplings. My wife has a pancake addiction. This Cracker Barrel is as good an experience as the ones along the highways. Service is always friendly and quick even when busy, and I love the blatant merchandising as you enter and exit.   Their peanut butter brittle is divine. I'm a fan!

Represents menu Cooks, driver and friendly food including Pizza.  They remembered and talented Cook and delivery professional .  Represented, professional long time

Proud

Wow has been near 20 years since I was actually a regular here. And was my favorite pizza and housemade root beer!  No house made root beer now. But salted caramel brownie sundae and jerk chicken pizza coming. Viki n Darby having salad variety. So my pizza was real good. Brownie not edible. Yuk. But the coffee ice cream was good. Salads looked ok but not anything wonderful.

We reserved a car a month ago to pick up at Thrifty at Philadelphia airport. We arrived yesterday (July 24) to find a long line snaking outside of the building.  Despite the long line, there were only two workers. After waiting 1 1/2 hours, the sleepy, slow attendant asked me for my flight itinerary.  But it didn't have my name on the email confirmation, so I had to log onto the website to get the itinerary with my name on it. Then she asked me for my credit card, but then said she couldn't accept it because "your first name is not spelled out; it only has your initials".  I am from the UK, and none of our credit cards spell out our first names.  She called her manager, who, with a menacing look on his face, told me "our system doesn't accept cards where the names don't match the reservation.".  When I asked him what was I supposed to do, he shouted at me that I should go somewhere else and told me I was holding up the line. No apology, no offer of assistance. In 45 years of renting cars in 4 different continents, I've never heard of such a requirement, and I've never been treated as badly. there Was no explanation on the reservation confirmation that spelled out this requirement. Another man with a pregnant wife was also denied a car even though they had a PREPAID RESERVATION. I will never darken the doors of Thrifty again!
Very clean, professional, relaxing salon! I've gotten both massage and hair services here and have been absolutely satisfied! I love that they take the time to make each service personal.

Talk about top notch!  Friendliness and food quality. I moved out of Philly where I used to order from them often. So happy to see they were opening a new shop right around the corner from me. They have been open for maybe a month or two and I have already ordered from them at least 4 times. Prices are the best around and their pizza and pork sandwich a second to none!

Stopped by this location on a five dollar Friday and was treated very rudely.  The 2 female staff were irritated because they thought they were not making enough tips.  They angrily discussed the issue in front of me.  They should be paid enough that they don't feel like they live on tips since they are not servers.  How are they different than McDonald's employees who hand you your meal or scoop up the fries.  People feel like tipping when clerks are friendly, helpful, and pleasant.  I often stop at a SK on West End where the atmosphere is quite different and will gladly leave a small tip.

My friends and I rented 3 hybrids and 1 road bike for the week.. The bikes were first rate ( I really enjoyed the electronic shifters on the trek)  and the staff we very professional and courteous, gave us extra bike lights and set us up with a set of panniers and a bike rack for the car.. All good!

Honestly i do like this shop
But im a little pissed that i was pushed to buy a vape without being told they were no longer selling extra parts to replace things on it.
I had it for 3 days when the glass broke and now im being told they discontinued making glass replacement for the model 
I just think you shouldn't sell the product at that point it just doesn't seem fair to me.
It wasn't cheap.

Still my favorite craft beer restaurant, even since the introduction of the many new places in Edmonton. 
The beer selection is phenomenal, with the monthly taps takeovers and constantly rotating 72 beers on tap. I love the food, and have tried almost every menu item, never disappoints!! Very original menu, and great service!!

I think this place is starting to get a reputation around town for their craft beer selection because it's the only place my friends want to go to anymore.  I've been here a bunch throughout the years.  It's a good spot to throw a party, I've done so twice so far.  Bunch of different rooms to rent depending on the size of your party, couple different food options.  This is also a cool spot to watch games.  Big enough to fit a lot of people but spread out so they're not all on top of you.  Take-out beer too, that's come in handy before!

A fantastic place to go for food, for drinks, for company.  Our server tonight, Andrew, has an encyclopedic knowledge of wines and scotches.  Lovely decor, easy to find, free parking, comfortable -- it's a place that will become a favourite on your first visit!

this place is nasty and ran by an Asian female who is racist and very obnoxious and condescending.
Cheap products and dirty.
Food poisoning yesterday from eating there the night before. Not much else I can say about that except the obvious - not recommended.

This was our first time at Altitude and probably our third time at a trampoline park. I would've given them 5 stars had they had designated employees attending to each obstacle course. With there being so many children of all ages there, I felt a little monitoring/guidance would've helped. We attended a kids birthday party there and we really enjoyed the party room. We were allowed outside food and drinks, as well as decorations. There were also tables, benches, and other seats for everyone else  through out the establishment. Pricing was also very decent compared to other trampoline parks. They may need more than 3 waiver computers to help elevate some waiting time. Also, they have massage chairs in the front. Last, you can also trade your socks from other trampoline parks for their socks for free. There's food and drinks there as well.

This is the only place I got for tattoos and piercings! Awesome work, super great people and all for a cause. What more could you ask?? I'm a walking advertisement and tell everyone who asks: GO TO SPARK PROJECT COLLECTIVE.

Came here the weekend of Halloween... our friends went to another bar and my BF and I ended up at Pat O'Briens! Went right up to the bar to just chill and have some drinks. Our bartender Chaz asked us "have you ever been here?" I said no.... and he whipped out some Hurricanes for us! Delicious! His energy was amazing and definitely entertained our crowd so well! Who puts a "bar towel" on their face? Mine as well lick it and get sick hahaha!!! He is amazing! What a great guy and he kept us so entertained throughout the night. Thanks for the NOLA hospitality!!!!! You've also made the nights of the fellow new friends we made just sitting at the bar! Happy Halloween!

We had reservation at 7:30pm on 9/20/16 to celebrate a special birthday. My two gfs showed up before 7:30pm and were seated. The male host working that night told them that they had TWO hours to finish dinner and to be done by 9:30pm. I arrived shortly after finally finding street parking. The host or waitress did not bring the time restraint issue back up again. They did come over often to check if we were done with our dishes so they can clear them. It was restaurant week by the way and they were only serving restaurant week menu. We also noticed that they did NOT put a time restraint on other customers. We were the only minorities there. I have never been treated that way before ever! Thinking back, we should have gotten up and leave. We tipped out of respect for the waitress but the service was mediocre. The food was not bad. WE WILL NEVER GO BACK TO BE TREATED THAT WAY AGAIN.

So glad they opened a store in the Central West End which is just block away from my apartment! Went and grab a box in July fourth and the start sprinkled chocolate donut was so tasty! Was surprised that it was just the right amount of sweetness! The glazed donuts and twists will be my go-toes!

I like this place. The food is good and so is the service. The salads are big. Along with a pizza, we get fries as well. I just wish they were made in house. I also like that they don't use plastic bags or styrofoam for take out. Definitely try it out.

I read thru the reviews and most are raving about the nachos appetizer I WONT because at the $13 price it's not worth that price for what we were delivered (photos posted) One layer of chips definitely not stacked or even close to what you will get at other places. The owner needs to check out Jimmy Buffets Margaritaville "Volcano Nachos" and there you go - you'll know why I say these were sent back!
With the bad experience getting the appetizer it was a pleasant surprise to see how fabulous the Calzone turned out (photo posted). What could have been a poor review was leveled by an awesome main course dish.
For the cost there are better places to eat on our recommended hot list. I mean if you want a pizza place go to a pizza place, if you want burgers got to a burger place, you want Italian, you go to.... (you get the point) This is a nice atmosphere and they are really sticking to the covid protocols which is great but there wasn't much that makes me want to come back anytime soon.
I will agree with the average overall rating on at this place a 3 out of 5 is fair for our experience. I truly wish it could have been a better experience but they need to step up their quality, quantity and price values for the customer.

Excellent service and the ceviche was excellent. Garlic crab fries are worth getting every time. The grouper egg rolls were ok. Seasoning overpowered any grouper taste. Definitely check them out when in the tourist area.

LOVE the shortribs!!!!  I gave five stars because the food was so good, but I might switch it to four stars because I felt that my meal was overpriced.  My friend and I had iced tea (no alcohol), a salad, and an entree.  No dessert or coffee, and the bill came to 90.00!!!  I mean it was really good, but damn!! I was surprised when the check came.
Best restaurant in Reno, it happens to be Thai. The Penang with roti, and rad na are stand out dishes.
I had an amazing experience here! The service and food is phenomenal and will definitely be returning.

These guys were awesome! My roommates and I were having issues with our water heater and they got back to us RIGHT away and had someone over to look at it the next morning to fix the issue. With a house full of girls we had no idea what we were doing and they gave us fast and fair service. AND they cleaned up after themselves!!! I will continue to use them if i ever have any other issues and recommend them to all my friends!

If you love ice cream, custard, or anything cold Sub Zero is the place for you! You can chose have you want your ice cream because they make it right in front of you! It is so convenient to go to one place rather than drive around because someone wants frozen yogurt and someone else wants creamy ice cream! Sub Zero is the one stop shop. The possible flavor combinations is endless I was so shocked when I walked in and could not decide on what I wanted.  

I chose premium with peanut butter, fudge, and butterfingers. It was to die for! It was so amusing to watch them blend the ice cream right before my eyes. I was even more impressed when it tasted so delicious! I will definitely be coming back soon!

Quick update to my review. My wife and I stopped in late afternoon to watch the UCF game and ended up spending the entire evening. First highlight GREAT service. The bartenders are so cool. Secondly GREAT food!  Wings, and a Cesar salad were perfect. Lastly there are so many very nice people from all walks of life here. A real neighborhood tavern with a very relaxed vibe.   

Just a quick note to say we are back at our favorite upscale neighborhood bar, great cocktails, beer, service and food!

Great atmosphere! The music  makes you feels if you are miles away on an island! really liked how they have a virtual menu to view all the foods! My husband and I were enjoyed our food. The best were the drinks! After 9 pm they half off drinks and appetizers!  I recommend the Cuban mojito!

Food was good except the burger. It was ordered for my kids to split, but I could hardly cut it in half, so they just shared my food. They were good enough to take the burger off the bill. I guess the problem is that one would think a burger would be the go-to thing to order eating outdoors at a pub. Still going to return here, but more for the beer than the food.
I love this place.  They are very nice and the always seem happy to see you. Hu is my technician.  I recommend her. Very nice. Go here !!!

Update 4/28/2018: It's with deep regret that I have to downgrade my review of the Owyhee Tavern to 2 stars.  
My office recently treated a group of six of us to lunch, and I was very excited that we were going to the Owyhee.  Unfortunately, our experience was definitely subpar, and it was all about the service (or lack thereof).  I had the special (halibut on a crispy rice cake with avocado, cilantro, mayo with sauteed fresh bush beans) which was phenomenal.  My delicious meal is the only reason I didn't decrease my review to 1 star.  
Our waitress, although friendly and knowledgeable about the menu, and the other waitstaff really need to be educated on the difference between a person who drops off food (like at Taco Time) vs superb waitstaff whose job is to help enhance the dining experience.  First, we ordered the Bruschetta Caprese appetizer to share.  The young man who delivered the app dropped it off in the middle of the table and immediately walked off.  Six of us sat there, staring at the food, unable to eat it since we were not given small plates to serve ourselves.  After sitting for apx. 15 minutes, one person at our table had to get up and chase down our waitress to request the plates.  While still waiting for our food (which was a long time coming), one lady asked for a refill on her iced tea.  When the glass was brought, it was immediately obvious that the tea was not properly brewed (it was a pale yellow color and not a rich brown like my iced tea) and no additional ice was added.  She had to ask for a new glass of tea.  One person at our table received and ate her side order of soup about 20 minutes before our lunch entrees were brought out.  Our food order actually took 60 minutes to be delivered to our table.  Considering there were 8 tables that I could see that had patrons, that seemed like an excessive amount of time.  Finally, we ate our lunch with all the dirty dishes from the appetizer and the soup bowl sitting on our table the entire time -- this is totally unacceptable in my opinion.
I enjoy the food at the Owyhee so very much, and I'd love to go back again, but I'll need to see some reviews that the service has improved dramatically before that happens.  

************************

First visit to the Owyhee Tavern was pretty good.  I must admit their menu prices are a bit rich for my wallet but I have been wanting to visit.  They have some great offerings on their Happy Hour menu -$5 wines, beers, and bites. We ordered the brussel sprouts appetizer to share. They were very good but a little too much oil on the plate for my liking. I had the $5 Pinot Noir and it was a very nice wine. My friends ordered the clams and carpaccio which looked delicious although I thought the servings to be rather light and they had to depend on bread to fill up.  I had the chicken tacos from the HH menu. The first taco was very good until I bit into a part that was very salty.  I almost didn't eat the second taco but I'm glad I took the chance. The second taco was perfect and the chicken was moist and seasoned right. The black beans were a nice touch in the taco filing.  I must say our service was exceptional - from our friendly, attentive waitress to the staff who delivered the food. I will go back but it will probably be during Happy Hour.

Small local joint, with a small patio that they put warmers on and offered blankets and pillows when that was where we were seated. "Casual upscale" atmosphere, with some far reaching buzz words throughout the menu. Great concept. 

The service was ok. We went for an early dinner on a Friday with the family, we each had an entree plus we ordered a side of veggies for the munchkin because none of the "kids" options had veggies. The beer menu was large in options but not a solid mix, especially for those that enjoy a darker beer. They had one option for us that was a very light porter. It was decent but a better selection would be a draw for us. 

For the slightly over $60 (before tip) we spent (quail, chicken and a kid's burger plus the green beans, one beer and waters) we could have easily gone to one of a dozen other options and enjoyed the food more. None of us "loved" the food, although the kiddo did like the green beans :). Nothing was horrible, it was just...okay. The best thing, we all agreed, was the potato "puree" (it was mashed potatoes lol) with the chicken. The stuffing in the quail was very salty (and I love salt and usually add it to everything: I could barely eat it) but the bird was cooked nicely. The flavor was just boring. The chicken was slightly better, but again...just okay. Everything felt heavy and just overdone, despite it looking nice on the plates. 

We have had much better meals at places like Fork or Red Feather or Bittercreek Ale House compared to this one. Even though this one is very close to our house, we will trek a bit further for a more well rounded option.

What isn't there to love about the Tucson "Eat" Yourself? Other than big crowds, but who can blame them! This year's event was bigger and better than ever, seriously, it crawls up into the TCC area. More food, more non-food stands, and even a Yelp stand! 

Great live music by the 7 Pipers. Mingling of food and people everywhere.

This is the culmination of everything Tucson, and beyond. Every kind of food vendor, mostly local I presume, are here, and you can get the freshest foods and taste a little of the world. Jerk chicken, danish treats, Africa meals, frybread, on and on and on! You will learn about and mingle with many cultures here. There is non-stop music playing. Entertainment abounds left and right.

This is an extraordinary event. If you want a slower pace, come during the day and gobble up food. You can nibble a little of everything cheap (grab a shish-ke-bob at one booth for 2 bucks, and rice at another booth, and a pastry at another, and try all kinds of strange drinks). I can't remember if alcohol is served here or not. This event is just FUN. It's worth visiting. Plan on at least a few hours of visiting every day!

I haven't visited yet.  I've read about them and that they are similar to the bagels of New York which is very exciting for me. I've asked a question on Instagram and they immediately responded so I already like their service looking forward to visiting

This was the best massage i"ve ever had. Suzanna is truly a pro. She accurately focused on my problem areas and I walked out with no pain, or stiffness. A great experience.  I will be a regular customer!

Abbey Plumbing was assigned to work on our house by our home warranty company, American Home Shield (AMS).  When Abbey Plumbing set the appointment, I made sure I was not working in the office so I could be home to let them in.
