When the time frame they had given me was just about past, they called and asked if they could come another day. I rescheduled them to try to be more flexible for them. The second appointment was made on time. When he came in, he started working on the things that he had been contracted for. When it came to the faucet handle adjustments, the employee did not know how to remove them. While he worked in another bathroom, I inspected the faucet handles and discovered that they could be removed by removing a small screw on each handle. I informed the plumber and he stated that he could not adjust them because he did not have a tool small enough to do the job. He had come unprepared. 

After installing a toilet kit and clearing a backed up pipe, he collected the $75 surcharge that we were responsible for and left. A day or two later, the toilet kit that he replaced was getting caught on the flushing handle. I called Abby Plumbing and asked them to come out and to adjust it properly, as the toilet now ran worse than when he had worked on it. He said that this was the first time he had worked with the kit and instructed me to call the toilet kit manufacturer and ask them about the warranty and to have them replace it. I was shocked. I told him the kit was not the problem, but that the way he installed it was the problem. He needed to adjust it properly. He informed me that I would have to call American Home Shield again and set up another repair call. That could result in us having to pay another $75 surcharge. 

Do not use Abbey Plumbing. They do not do quality work, they come unprepared when they do come and they don't follow through when they do shoddy work.

Been coming here for a few years to purchase essential oils, floral essences, and occasionally incense or a bath product. It's convenient and they have a good selection, better than Whole Foods and Essene for sure. For the most part, I know what I want and can help myself, but the staff always asks if I have any questions. There are only two ladies that I ever see at this location. One of them, I presume, is the manager, and she's a bit of sour puss. I just hate seeing her. Everything she says is tinged with passive aggressiveness, whether it's how to pronounce "bergamot" or denying that the quality of citrus essential oils fades with time. She comes off as really bitter, and it kind of dampens the experience of shopping with them. So, this review is mainly about customer service. The products themselves, however, are very good.

DO NOT judge this book by its cover. This cafe is an almost-hidden GEM. The basic drip coffee affords clean, distinct flavors; a near-perfect brew.

AND THE FOOD! We were pleased with the twists on the basic croissant but the show-stealer was the pickled greens and soft boiled egg on thick toast. L-E-G-I-T.

5th star for the friendly, bend-over-backward service.

Terrible food. They have a great location and I see that as being the only reason they can stay in business. We waited 20 minutes at a table before we went up to the bar to get service. No one came to tell us why we weren't getting service and it was during the middle of the day so it was pretty empty. Food came out quicker than the drinks and the drink we tried wasn't good. But they wouldn't swap it out so we paid $7 for a crappy drink. Food is served on paper plates and is poor quality There's so many other places around this area that are much better. Don't waste your time.

ABSOLUTELY DO NOT GO HERE. Rooms are atrociously dirty, I did not trust leaving my car in the parking lot, and there was no one even there to check us in or answer the phone after 8 hours of driving. We honestly left and did not stay. I feel as if I can put up with a lot and excuse some dirt, but this was beyond anything I was willing to experience.

5 stars for Mockingbird Salon - new(ish) home of my stylist Michelle.
I have only been once so far but immediately felt comfortable and at home when I walked in.  The salon is cute and homey and it definitely doesn't hurt that there are yummy goodies for the taking along with a nice cup of coffee.  

My hair has changed over the years but Michelle has recommended products and tips to help me adjust and she was also the one who cut my hair when I was finally ready to lose the length. I definitely trusted her to do this way more than any other stylist I have had in the past.  My color always looks great and I just generally feel good after leaving her chair - and isn't that the whole point of getting your hair done? 

If you haven't checked out this new salon or are searching for a new stylist, give them a call.  You won't be disappointed!
I have never been disappointed at Zinc.  Never rushed, recommendations are always spot-on, and the wait staff is occasionally high.  Dark 'n' small.  Cheerz it.

While the donuts and sliders were ok, the service was absolutely terrible. I stepped up to pick up my order when they called my name, however, a lady stepped in and swooped up the order right before I got there. They proceeded to tell me to wait - my order is coming. They never verified the orders to confirm.

I proceeded to wait another 5 minutes and eventually the lady came back after touching the sliders and realizing that it wasn't her order (I was sitting right behind her).

Seeing all of this, I walked up and told them that it was my order - like I said. And they tried to give me the sliders at this point and were defensive, saying the names were confusing. And i told them no, I don't want these because I saw this woman touching them. They tried to argue and then eventually remade them (but who knows if they actually did). No apology at any point for the mix up. 

While mistakes happen, had they taken two seconds to confirm the order or to apologize for having me wait 1 hour for 4 sliders (not busy), it would have made a world of a difference.

Food is alright. Good portions. But, can't say the same about deserts. They offered strawberry shortcake for desert today. By far the worst shortcake ever. It felt as if they put whip cream & 2 strawberries on English muffin. Slow service!!
quality meat, a little skimpy on the tzatziki spread ( which is also too thick) and the fries are either stale or you need to wait for them to cook a fresh batch. good portions.

What I loved: The service is great. The place is clean and comfortable. Steak was tender and plentiful. 
What I disliked: No seasoning/not enough on the meat, I didn't realize they had pepper shakers...that would have solved that problem for me. The bread, I mistakenly ordered the unseeded roll. This is a delicious sub/hoagie but I felt like something was missing while eating it. I got m I'm mine with peppers, onions. Provolone, and mustard.

We enjoyed our family outing. The aquarium was updated nicely from the last time I were there. If you are into social distancing, this is not the time to visit yet. Masks are mandatory once you enter. The boys enjoyed their hot dog and lemonade and just running around freely since there were no one except us at their newly renovated eating area. Can't wait to come back soon.

I don't usually write a review on yelp but I felt I had to so I can save other people from this mechanic!.....He might be a smart mechanic but he is rude and greedy. He charges for his labor more than the mechanics at the dealerships!....Believe me he's not worth your money!...I went to the Mercedes Benz dealership for a simple problem and they gave me an estimate of about $400 total to fix the problem with a new part and labor. I thought its expensive so I made the biggest mistake by coming to this guy. He charged me $400 for his labor only and bought me a used part and charged more for it than the dealer!!!!.....He takes your car as a hostage and don't tell you about his labor until you see the receipt.
If you have a problem with your German car, go and fix it at the dealership at least they will give you a warranty or go somewhere else.....Safe yourself and your money!.......Stay away from this guy!!!.............................Stay away!

The S&T exchange is one of my favorite guilty pleasures.  I stop in often to grab new spices and teas to play with.  I always love switching up my traditional recipes with any number of new combinations.  If I'm ever uncertain of what to use in a dish the friendly staff is always eager to share their thoughts on the best combinations to try!  Today was no different...I went in for one thing and came out with quit a few newly inspired choices along with my old favorites.

Thanks for responding. There have been at least 4-5 occasions where I had a less than favorable experience while trying to place a phone order. I don't have all of the dates, but the most recent was last Sunday AM. Needed to have a delivery to bring to a special event and was assured it would be no problem. I was skeptical based on the rush job I received on the phone. The order was late and was the wrong order. Trying to straighten this out and make the event on time was very difficult. Thanks again for your concern.

We were a party of 3 at around 11am on a Saturday. Two of us ordered the skillet to start and came out with an overwhelming taste of Canola oil. 

We tried to get people's attention but weren't able to. My older father finally got restless and walked up to let him know. But when he went up to the waiter to tell him about the issue, he dismissed him instead of immediately asking him what was wrong. Then, we had to wait for the waiter for awhile to come over to tell him that the food was bad.

My dad elected not to reorder, and then I decided to order an ham, bacon, avocado omelette which was just average. 

Overall I think this place needs a bit to work out the kinks.

Great restaurant and theme.   We had a great server that was working her second shift of the day. We were there on vacation and during the beginning of opening back from the pandemic.  Food was great and delicious and she was very helpful as things on the menu were out due to the inability to get ingredients for them from supplier.   She had a great attitude and made it great

We were walking down the Riverwalk and decided to finally try ulele! It did not disappoint us whatsoever! I got the steak and hubby got the fried catfish. Both were absolutely delicious along with the calamari

Sadly disappointed. Terribly unprofessional. Neither of our technicians spoke ANY kind of English AT ALL. One of the techs scalded my mom with the hot towels. Our feet were not rinsed with clean water; they used the soaking water to rinse our legs and feet! Fail. My mom and I were there to relax and instead had to endure the front desk/owner perhaps, singing Vietnamese karaoke the entire time into her gold-plated, speaker, all in one microphone. Yes, that happened. WTF? Never again.

I don't know if Horizon Plumbing and Heating is local or nationwide. Most of us around here are very familiar with their commercials and bright orange trucks. But just a word to the wise if you ever use them. I called them yesterday because my garbage disposer had stopped working and using that tool thing wasn't helping. I already had bought and had the new disposer. From their website, I had a $37.50 off any plumbing job coupon and they advertised a 10% senior discount. Okay, when I called to set up a time for them to come out, I was told there is a $50 dispatch fee just to come out but that it would be applied to the job total. 

A very nice man showed up on time today and looked at my old disposer. He found the reset button (I searched and couldn't find it) and the disposer came back to life though it sounded really sick. I decided that since I already had a new one and the plumber was already in the house, to get the new one installed. 

This is where it gets interesting. The plumber and I were sitting at the kitchen table so he could tell me the price for installing the new disposer. With all of the discounts, coupons, and dispatch fee taken off the total it came to $399.00. I laughed and told him he was insane. He asked what I was thinking to spend and I told him  $100. He told me if I didn't want to go ahead with the installation, it would be $126.99 for what he had already done. I told him that I wasn't going to pay that. He then called his supervisor and, lo and behold, the price was now $105.00 to install the disposer. 

I hate doing business with companies that do this and just want to let you know how they work.

I thought it time to update my review after several years away. I found that the food looked the same but my dish, the chicken teriyaki, though tasty, was quite peppery. It was so different that I asked if it was under new ownership. It is, from maybe 4 years ago my waitress explained. 

Another noticeable change from my last visit was the clutter of brick-a-brack on the ledge near the tables.  Although it went with the Japanese theme, it detracted, I think from the austere but elegant Japanese style interior created by local designer/builder Joseph Jasinski, back in the early 1980's for a previous iteration as a Bavarian restaurant. I know it sounds strange,  but the Bavarian restauranteurs were not really aware of the Japanese influences on their builder.
Charbroiled and raw oysters are great, especially charbroiled. You won't get any other charbroiled taste as good as this one here.

Okay, yum.  

The lunch hour at Bonefish wasn't exactly hoppin' but the food was.  There were maybe 5 groups in the house.  Still ... attentive service, great food, no complaints here.

I had the lunch special fish tacos (cajun-style tilapia, with mango salsa) and they were light, flavorful and good.  Even the corn tortillas (which are never very remarkable) were extra good.

You might have to ask them to bring out the bread; it comes with a lovely pesto olive oil.

Caffe Milano opened for lunch recently after being closed over the summer. I have eaten there dozens of times over the years-back to when Carlo owned it. The food was always good and reasonably priced. My recent visit was very disappointing. The menu is almost completely in Italian. The dishes are grouped together by type but other than insalada and pasta I had no idea what they were. I loved their paninis but I didn't see them anymore. So I asked if the had their old pasta salad. No-they now have a mediterranean pasta with tuna. I asked if I could have it without the tuna. Nope-its already mixed together. Really! Why not just wait until its ordered? My friend ordered red sauce spagetti. My salad was well presented and a good portion. But the pasta was chewy and if there was dressing on it I couldn't tell. It was also incredibly salty. I put a lot of balsamic vinegar and oil on it. My friend's pasta was also chewy and the sauce bland. The presentation was simply sauce on pasta. A moderate size. We both had a drink. My tab was almost $13 and his a bit over $13. Before, you could get a salad and drink for under 10 bucks. I'll give it one more chance but I was very disappointed.

Silo is one of the best restaurants in Nashville. The quality and service are always consistent, and the food is exceptional. I came here with a large group, and one of the biggest perks of group dining is getting to try what everyone else orders. Everything was on point. 

The pot de creme dessert is a MUST. As is the mac and cheese, and cornbread, the cheeseburger, and cauliflower salad, chicken confit, and pork chop... Basically if you come here you should really just order everything. 

Silo has been great for nicer occasions, group dining, or sitting at the bar to share an appetizer and a glass of wine (not sharing that part). Looking forward to trying their brunch!

Really sweet place. The food is great, the counter help is very friendly, a great place to sit outside and relax on St. Charles. Or if you're in a hurry, it's good for getting a sandwich on the run.

I'm not  a huge fan of pasta salad but the pasta salad they were serving one day was to die for. All their homemade dressings and marinades are worth trying. I highly recommend the california avocado club.

Some really good people at our hotel recommended Port of Call so we tried it out. Our hotel was in the heart of Bourbon street and it was a nice 15 minute walk to the bar. Busy place but worth the wait! Very local feel with an eclectic decor. The burger and tater were legit amazing! One of the best meals I had on our trip! The monsoon is too good, be prepared to be buzzed after one :). Really liked this place and got a really nice New Orleans feel.

I am a new patient at The Asthma Center. Everyone I have come in contact with here has been very professional, knowledgeable and friendly. There is plenty of staff so you are very well attended to when you are there, and so far, all are very thorough and efficient. I had testing to determine the cause of my repeating sinus infections. I was nervous for some of it and the staff was empathetic, patient, supportive and encouraging; cognizant of the fact that I did not feel well at all. The Dr. I saw, Marc Goldstein, MD, is extremely thorough, asking lots of questions and listening to the answers to help diagnose and prescribe. I do not feel that he over-prescribed to push services either. I am pleased with the overall relationship and will continue to use this practice for my ongoing needs.

Went to pick up my takeout yesterday and while leaving the restaurant I accidentally dropped my phone. After 15 min I went back and asked the staff if they had found my phone. They didn't see at, asked for the manager who took over 15 min to come out from the back (red flags went up, he had he phone) they pretended they hadn't seen it. Half hour later I called them to see if was found, the hostess was beyond shady as she said it wasn't there. 

By then I had called to report it stolen. They couldn't use the phone at that points 

2 hours later I get a phone call saying that my phone was there and I could come back to pick it up. 

They had the phone the entire time and lied about it . 

Will never go back to this restaurant this isn't the first time I've had bad service!
I'm never disappointed whenever I visit any Miller's Ale House. The food is always enjoy my food and my cocktails. Will return soon

Zea is a chain, but it is a local chain.

They started as a rotisserie and microbrewery and have expanded to several locations, including this one.

Their food is consistently good. Highlights include the duck empanadas, loaded hummus(not the official name), rotisserie meat of the day, ribs, ribeye and grilled fish.

I went to this location for fathers day and was given a free six pack of their beer. Their Pontchartrain Porter is wonderful. Dark with undertones of chocolate, it soothes your soul.

Anyway, you can't go wrong with Zea.

I specifically asked to have as much of an arch as she could do and I left with the most straight across/very thin brow I have ever gotten from any threading studio. I hate how the lady did my brows, they make me look angry.... which I guess now I am.

Heard about this place from a friend so i had to try it on a late night munchie run.  Got the chicken plate. Food was hot n fresh.. they give large portions but it could use a little more flavor/spices.  Think I'll go back and try the Philly cheese steak..  I'll keep you posted on my next review.

I called to place an order for delivery during a very busy time and was put on hold. A different person finished taking my order but apparently didn't realize it was for delivery. I waited for 50 minutes and when nobody showed up I called Reginelli's. The woman apologized and sent my order right away at no charge to me.

This was my 1st visit & LAST! 
* Wait was said to be 1.5hrs - we waited 2hrs & 10mins. 
* The hostesses were rude
* The lobby seats were built for 2yr olds to sit comfortably on.
* Then It was so annoyingly loud, when the waiter started talking, we didn't hear a word he said besides, "turn the cheap wooden stick to green if you want meat.
* the chair I sat in had a loose backing & the floor was extra slippery.
* There was ZERO room between my table & the party of 17(!) table sitting less than a scootch (inch or so) behind me.
* the waiters were reaching over my head to serve the guest behind me.
* The Buffett was boring with low variety 

 * the only good experience was with the servers cutting the meat at our table - they were very nice & fun to deal with. 

To sum this long review up, SAVE YOUR TIME & MONEY - Go to Hometown Buffet INSTEAD - at least you'll have a buffet with a wider variety (dessert included). 

Please take my advise, Tuscanos is HORRIBLE

Love this place and the doctors. My poor pup was clipped by a car and we were referred here for her broken bone. Emergency services are, of course, a bit pricey, but this facility is excellent and the staff is awesome. They are caring and compassionate and have been so helpful.

Just an amazing experience, we are EBikers and this is a great end of the trip stop, beautiful trail nearby. 2.50 Yuenglings, food was so good. We had pulled chicken, pulled pork, jalapeno cheddar sausage, sweet potatoe fries, fried green tomatoes and chilli.  Then we finished with the pecan pie.

Oh yes, a doggy bag went home. Alex our server was so helpful and accomadating we rolled out very happy. 

Definatly doing this again!

When you first approach the door to enter this establishment, you are greeted with a rather speak easy sort of vibe....like a elegant, sexy, secret little gathering spot from the 1920's and of course this is fitting considering it's located in an antique building located just off the corner of Idaho and Capital Streets inside the historic Adelmann Building built in 1902. It has dreamy and romantic lighting inside and this building in which they occupy has a historic aesthetic with it's deep wood, built in bar, filled with glass jars with homemade syrups and such. The Adelmann was constructed and owned by a German miner and Civil War veteran, Richard Adelmann. and designed by Cambell and Waylen, so Press and Pony is housed by a unique shell, most likely full of tales gone by and it's a pretty cool place to frequent if I might say so myself.  The cocktails here are inventive and very well made. The staff is fun with their witty, confident, suspender wearing, curly mustache donning charm. They show off and that is part of the wonder of it all, and I believe that they have taken it up a notch in regards to creating imaginative and selective cocktails since they have extensive knowledge of all things boozy and the grace needed to pull off some pretty awesome acrobatics with their thimble hands. The one suggestion that I have, is to create just a tiny bit more sense of urgency in regards to getting to the customers in a reasonable amount of time so that they CAN in fact enjoy your delicious offerings. It's a busy place and often there is only one bartender and I can imagine with all of the thought and steps that it takes to create their product, and in order to keep the vibe intriguing and engaging, speed is compromised on occasion, but other than that, it's a glorious place to meet a friend and catch up on life and have a little sip of something special.

Simply exceptional place! This building stands out in downtown area because of its beautiful look. It is an older building that is over 100 years old and reminds me of my time in Germany. The inside is decorated in a very German way which makes the experience that much better since it gives a realistic look of what a German restaurant should look like. I had the diablo pasta which probably wasn't the most German thing on the menu. They also have a great selection of beers to select from for those looking to have a good time. If you come to Indianapolis I recommend you visiting this place if you visit this city because it's unique and just really good food!

The St. Louis Zoo is probably one of the reasons why St. Louis is considered a good place for families. Growing up in this city, I went to the zoo over and over again, and even got to go on a overnight trip there in high school (we slept indoors). Driving down Highway 40 and seeing that tall stone ZOO sculpture at the entrance always reminds me of my childhood. 

Now, I haven't been to many zoos, but I think this one is pretty good. It's located in Forest Park, which is a quite impressive park in the city with lots of activities and sightseeing opportunities. Zoo entrance is FREE, which is always a bonus, but parking is $10. There is a zoo railroad train that takes you to different areas of the zoo, and it's not free, but is fun - especially for kids. Also not free is the Children's Zoo, which costs $4 per person over the age of 2. 

Lots of the same things I remember from my childhood are still around (the monkey house, the reptile house, the prairie dogs) and there are plenty of newer exhibits (like the penguin house - GREAT on a hot summer day because it is cooooooold in there!). Be sure to bring cash for refreshments, which can be found all over the zoo and are not cheap ($3 for a bottle of Dasani water?! I guess they gotta make money somehow). Just be prepared to dodge 8 million kids' strollers and slow walkers, and bring sunblock if it's a nice day. Definitely a fun place to visit with kids.

I'm a normal eyebrow customer here but I haven't been in about a month or 2 until last weekend . EVERYTIME I get my eyebrows done I always explain how I want my eyebrows because they're thick with a nice arch . The lady act like she understand when I was explaining but did the complete opposite. She was rough turning my head and instead on trimming my eyebrows she was trying to pluck it . This was a newer lady . I recommend MAE .

What a great dining experience. The atmosphere is very pleasant. My wife and I sat in the loft which was very spacious. The music was quite varied and something for everyone. The food was especially good. I had the chicken and waffle which was a perfect portion. At first I was annoyed that I didn't get two waffles but by the time I got to it after two drumsticks and a thigh, one waffle was quite adequate. My wife had a brisket and rib plater that was off the chain. The collards are to die for as well with a nice mix of sweet and sour. 
For a family of three the cost for the value received was outstanding. I highly recommend it but not if you want a quiet intimate dinner. Not that kind of place.

Really disappointed - we were told we would be on a 45 min wait and after approaching the hostess 75 min through she told us we would be the next 2 top to be seated.  15 min later she sat a couple that was waiting right next to us that came 30 min after we did.  This is the second poor experience we've had here.  I don't normally write poor reviews but the hostess was so dismissive and rude on Mother's Day of all days and made no efforts to accommodate after having us wait for 90 min total.

We just stopped in here for a few minutes to hide from the rain and grab a coffee before a drive back up to Phoenix. It was fun to explore the lobby, the tap room, etc. The tap room looks like it would be a fun bar to hang out in next time we are in Tucson. In fact there are several bars in this hotel so if there is an event here, I am guessing it shouldn't take long to get a drink. The lobby is fun and funky. I love the giant Ouija board table in the lobby! Can't wait to check it out for longer next time I am in town.

I absolutely love the Cat Shoppe. It is a great place just to go and see the cats that are in the store. There are always new ones because they get adopted. The people that work there are friendly. Before I lived here I would come to visit every couple of months and I would always want to go to the Cat Shoppe just to pet the cats. How could anyone not like this place? Plus they have cat food, toys, and gifts.

So, we're in uptown New Orleans on Saturday night and at 5:30 I realize that I've made no dinner plans - not a look at options, and certainly not a reservation. With three teenage girls in tow, I had to think fast - I decided we needed to go someplace with very healthy options, because just about everything we had eaten all day was fried. 

We looked at several uptown choices - I really wanted something very casual because the daughters were wearing shorts and tshirts - but I couldn't find it in such a tight timeframe. 

After looking at several menus, we chose Atchafalaya. White tablecloth - so MUCH fancier than I planned - but the menu sounded amazing. I am so happy I chose it - Atchafalaya delivered on the promise!

First off, we did put on nicer blouses with shorts, but we were still not nearly as elegant as we needed to be. But no matter - the staff made us feel so welcome and so special. Oh it was a lovely greeting and welcome. 

We ordered a pan-cooked salmon, the miso risotto, the truffle-oil fried chicken with mashed potatoes and the night's special- halibut with fingerling potatoes and toasted hazelnut brown butter. 

The salmon was served with a fresh jus made from pea shoots and ginger, with crisp-tender and raw vegetables. It was sublime - perfectly cooked to a soft moistness, with the flavors marrying to yield a burst of fresh, green flavor. 

The miso risotto met with rave reviews from my meat-eating daughter. She wanted something light, but filling and like the salmon, the miso delivered in the promise. 

The fried chicken with mashed potatoes was also met with rave reviews - our waitress brought every other dish before this one, and she told us she had sent it back to the kitchen for a bit more cooking before serving.  We very much appreciated her care and her focus on ensuring a stellar dining experience. 

Finally the halibut was amazing. The brown butter hazelnut sauce had a vaguely orangey taste, which made the flavors a complex mix that satisfied. Fresh green peas accompanied the roasted fingerling potatoes and perfectly cooked piece of fish. 

We all agreed that this was one of the best dinners of our lives - not a stretch for a 13, 15 and 17 year old - but for their 49 year old mom, it was saying something special. We will be back!!

Played here with my dad while on vacation. While the course isn't exactly Augusta, it's fun to play and the grass is well maintained. The people in the clubhouse were super nice and helped us rent clubs and gave us dinner recommendations. Highly recommend

My favorite frozen yogurt place!  Super clean and so, so good!!!!!  Don't forget to ask for the discount card so that they can punch a little hole in it each time you come back.  By the 9th time, you get a huge chunk of change taken off of your order.

The most beautiful arrangements in town. Local, Original and creative. Not to mention the amazing staff. 
If you get flowers from me, they will absolutely be from Flowers By Patti.

My fiancé and I won a wine tasting for four and were excited to try out a new place. We were disappointed when we realized we had missed the expiration date of the coupon and called to see if it would still be honored. When we called to ask a very disgruntled employee answered the phone to say, " I only get paid $15 an hour to work 80 hours a week and can't make that type of decision." We then called back to ask the owner who said they still will not honor our coupon. Definitely not worth the drive out to South Reno for us with such poor customer service!

I like this place, even if the entry door is one of those crappy Old City doors that's made for Twiggy. Christ, what would be wrong with having a decent door?

I like the coffee. It's strong. The decaf is behind the cash register, and I've gotten it a couple of times, but I wonder about the turnover. 

People seem nice. Just a crowded vibe.

I was so excited to check Sprouts out and thought 45 min would be an ok amount of time for a first visit but nope! Lol. I could've spent hours in there! Amazing market and great prices, kinda like if Whole Foods, Trader Joe's and Mom's had a baby, it'd be Sprouts. The majority of the staff are awesome too. SO glad this market is so close to my work! Oh, and don't go anywhere else for avocados because they have THE best ones (huge and perfect!!) for the best prices, hands down! 

Love this place!

Excellent service by Jordan. Very knowledgeable about his products and was not pushy in making a sale. He was extremely helpful and more than accommodating when dealing with a few of the delivery logistics. Today I also had the pleasure of meeting the store manager Lamont who was swift in dealing with a slight hiccup. Will most certainly make all of my furniture purchases from here in the future!

Pricy, but very tasty. One star off for the service--I think our waiter could have been a little more available. Overall, food came out relatively quickly, ambiance is great, and the rose sangria was sooo good. This would be a fun date night--setting is very romantic! It gets busy though, so I'd make a reservation.

Whoever the door guy/bouncer was at this bar on the night of Nov. 7 is a homophobic *not allowed to use profanity but use your imagination.* My brother was visiting out of town and the bouncer told him, "We don't let fags in this bar." Really? They won't let them in, but I guess they let them work there...

Spend your money elsewhere. Let this place shut down since they are willing to hire people who turn away good people and customers based on personal, horrifying beliefs.

I will continue to post this on all their review pages. I'm still reeling days later.

"To create an oasis amidst a sea of homes."

This is the beautiful legacy that Beulah and Jesse Cox left us on their property in Carmel. Suburbia is formed when cornfields and vacant land is developed into more neighborhoods. This was not the Cox's wish, and for that, I am thankful.

While Coxhall boast a children's garden (think: mini village as a playground), it primarily serves as a beautiful backdrop for weddings and photography. Many a high school senior or engaged couple take their photos here. The Roman-style amphitheater with tiered lawn seating makes for a unique wedding venue. I can't help but think of the IMA movie nights and how this space could be further activated beyond formal affairs.

The Coxhall Mansion hosts local voters for primary and general elections, but can also be rented out. 

If you're looking for a more kid-friendly space, I recommend heading down the road to West Park. But for some peace and tranquility, stop by and enjoy Beulah and Jesse's parting gift to our community.

Our friend got married here last night, and I have to say the venue was excellent. The guests loved being able to walk around and look at the exhibits during cocktail hour. The space was perfect for a wedding of 100 or so. 

James, who pretty much runs the place, is fantastic. Very detail oriented, super helpful, definitely knows his way around events. He made sure all the details were covered.

They had a 5 piece band playing which I was a little unsure of from looking at the space - but it turned out they sounded great.

If you are looking for somewhere to have a small wedding or private event - this is a great choice.

My only word of advice, although Hops n Props in next door, I would suggest NOT getting your catering from here. Their food is great, and their catering staff is works magic with what they have available to them. But they are a bar and restaurant, not a caterer. So food comes out when they scheduled it - not a minute early, and when food runs out, it has to be caught early so they can cook more. 

So, I might suggest looking at their other catering options.

We were looking for a new, quiet, date night place after our favorite closed. The Bridge Tap house is a Fantastic dark, perfect date night location.  Huge beer and wine selection, decent spirits selection that can hold its own.  Becky was great- made us feel at home and welcome.  Cheese crisps were divine!  This is our new spot!!

Finally got in to try Surfset at The Surf Studio...  I was too chicken to try it before, thinking it'd be hard and I'd look silly doing it... but now I just feel silly for not having tried it sooner!

I love the space in the front, very welcoming atmosphere and decor. I appreciate the area to sit down. I like the merch for sale, very cute clothes (I might pop in sometime just to shop, especially 'cause they're just next door to the world's best chiropractor). I think it's super handy that there are three changing stalls, and the cubbies to store belongings (honestly, they'd lose points if they didn't have those - how would they not have cubbies!?) and a washroom are appreciated. 

I'm not as keen on the space in the back, where the classes are held... there are some nice touches, but they are not enough to keep it from still feeling like a backroom that was built for storage - I probably should not be so picky about these things, it was mostly forgotten once the class started and I was focused on what I was doing... but I'm one of THOSE people. 

I only tried an abbreviated version of the 'blend' style class. I got a little sweaty, but not enough to justify using one of the sweat towels they have on hand (a nice touch), though I can easily see using them during a regular  length class. I'd say that it was a very balanced class that had a lot to offer. I felt like it was a good workout that worked on a lot of areas: cardio, balance, strength. Nothing was too difficult if you didn't want it to be, lots of modifications provided. Also, most importantly, it was a lot of fun! I definitely got surf stoke and have to go back!

I plan to get my kids to try out one of their kid friendly classes and I'm quite interested in giving it a go outside in the summer... but I'm most excited about checking out the yoga class. As someone who has done yoga for several years, I feel that the board will offer a really interesting and challenging twist to my practice, and one that I cannot incorporate on my own at home, so that's added value and incentive for me to buy a pass.

I spoke with Natasha, owner and instructor, after the class about my hubby's injured ankle and whether or not this sort of thing would be suitable for him and she explained about how she'd provide him with modifications and how the exercises can be quite restorative. She had actually got into Surfset herself because of injuries sustained while engaging in high impact sports. She seems to have a lot of experience, knows what she's talking about and is very helpful. 

As I said, I've only been once, but it was satisfying and addictive and I feel that I'm one step closer to my fantasy of hanging ten with Keanu Reeves.

I brought my cat here in 2018 for spay surgery.  I realized a little bit later that she was going into heat.  I called the facility multiple times about the issues I was having (granted this was when they were located in Feasterville-Trevose so there may be different doctors now).  I was told to pay to get her urine tested; that it had to be a UTI.  I told them over and over again that she was rolling around, backing up her behind, moaning, attacking people, it was pretty bad.  I was told they would consult the surgeon and call me back, I never got a phone call. The phone tag went on for a bit. She went into heat again.  Same situation but this time I was told that I would have to pay for exploratory surgery and if the surgeon found that it was an error on their part, then I would be paid back. I trusted them initially to successfully complete a surgery they have clearly done hundreds of times before. Why would I trust them to own up to a mistake they created?  Sounds like a conflict of interest to me. 1 year later and I was finally able to take care of the problem: ovary left behind and found by a 3rd party.  

Just be careful with these clinics. I was warned before and now I fully understand.  I get they try to help the community with low cost services (and that's great) but sometimes it's better to bite the bullet and eat the cost with someone you trust and know.

...An Awful-Awful review of the Nugget Diner...

Reno is known as "The Biggest Little City In The World."  So my favorite joke about Reno is "we flew to Reno and it was frickin' closed..." because it's so tiny.  So how appropriate to go to the "Biggest Little Casino in the World" - The Nugget (http://www.yelp.com/biz_photos/LbhraX3qY94g3Xn2Havbpg?select=0SoYEjC9IpsY6oBYyTDrPw).  And it is TRUE, it's like a 20'x80' opening in the side of a building that has a bunch of slots and a bar.  We were in search for Reno's best burger:  The Awful Awful (http://www.yelp.com/biz_photos/LbhraX3qY94g3Xn2Havbpg?select=jtI4ijN6snDw1PhU-fIpSw) found in the hole-in-the-casino Nugget Diner.

I have to say, this Diner was pretty much the pits of all Diners (http://www.yelp.com/biz_photos/LbhraX3qY94g3Xn2Havbpg?select=zmVAR3Rrw_52HZpKETnrGg), and the "character actors" all had their superbly acted roles:  The two waitresses that were stern-looking at first, but began to lighten up when talked to, whose discussions ranged from personal problems to which customer left the better tips.  The down-and-out locals that talked about how much money they made the day before bicycling visitors around downtown.  The other characters talking about how this is the best food in all of Reno; and the cook that never turned around from the griddle.  Spending all day in this place could really give you insight into Renonians:  Down-and-out, the life-of-hard-Knox, tough-skinned people who have nothing but kindness to give out.  The Diner had an "A" rating, but the grease and dirt surfacing the entire area made me really wonder... "How?"  We sat at the bar and was immediately told that we couldn't order from there, but had to walk about 10 feet to the right and order right under the "Please place order here" sign.  No credit cards accepted, cash only!

- We ordered "The Original Awful-Awful" (http://www.yelp.com/biz_photos/LbhraX3qY94g3Xn2Havbpg?select=Bo6Nl2-Ai0xHXmRuwMRE7A) at $6.50.  Made from a half-pound of ground chuck and grilled to order.  The Onion bun looked like nothing really special; and served with fresh lettuce, a raw red onion slice, tomato, cheese slice, and their "special" creamy sauce (http://www.yelp.com/biz_photos/LbhraX3qY94g3Xn2Havbpg?select=7I8J_hPJG7oHWzQ3EIeorQ).  An extra patty can be added for an extra $2.95, or bacon for $1.75 more.  I must say that the burger was "Awfully Awfully" tasty!  A 4-star experience that made the trip worthwhile... kinda...

- The burger was served on a huge basket of fries.  The fries were semi-crisp browned and soggy-soft in the middle... Just the way I like it.

- Coleslaw was also ordered, but nothing too special and a slight hint of horseradish. 

The Little Nugget got its Awful-Awful notoriety by winning Camille Ford's Food Wars with The Bigger Nugget that serves its version of the Awful-Awful.  It was funny because they kept showing the Food War's episode over and over and over...  I guess a place like this needs all the recognition it can muster.  To me this place will be known for a 4-star burger in a 2-star tiny little dirty diver in the World's tiniest city.  *flips the sign to CLOSED, and turns and walks away*

Jason I sure hope your deposit is on a credit card....if so call the credit card company.  I have dealt with Alan in the past....until this summer I would have given him a 5 star rating.  But like you my order is "lost" and no customer service.  My order was placed in April and I can't wait any longer.
Oh my goodness! I wasn't prepared for all this deliciousness! We both had the tuna poke bowl and we both got one to go!! Best thing I've eaten in while!

Be careful here. Not sure if the management changed or just the customer service but the last few times I've taken my dog here for boarding my bill has been $100s of dollars more than what I anticipated. They do what they want while the dog is there and you're stuck with the bill when you pick them up. No heads up, courtesy phone call, or explanation as to the charges. Until they've already swiped your credit card and then you see the bill.
Great place, just went here and every bay was clean and working. Great, easy, and good priced car wash. I have a big truck as well and it's nice to come to a place that fits lifted trucks with ease.
Cool hip place. I tried the coconut boba milk tea, being a coconut fanatic in all form and shape, I loved it!

I went in today to try and get a new TV and Xbox bundle since they where having a sale on them. The employees were friendly and professional when I was in the store. We hashed out a deal and I told them that I could take delivery on Monday. After figuring some things out I wanted to come and pick up the items the next day. So I called at 6:30pm and was told I need to speak with the person who set me up. I was put on hold for about 15 min and told I would get a call back. They closed at 8:00 pm, so at 7:00pm I called back, with the same thing happening. I waited and called back at 7:30 pm, was put on hold for 10 minutes before I hung up. I was about to get into an agreement for 2 years with this company, and I could not get a call back? So I have decided to go ahead and cancel the order. I was on the fence about the agreement and I made that known, and the lack of customer service after I had agreed, sealed the deal. I will give them 2 stars cause they did help me when I was in the store.
UPDATE: I called at 10:30 am (half our after they opened) and asked to cancel my order. I was told that John (the manager) had gone to the bank and he would call me back within the hour since he was the only one who could cancel an agreement. I called back about 2 hours later and asked to speak to John, I was told he would call me back. I said that I will not be calling again or waiting for a call to cancel my order. They said ok they would cancel my order, with no questions asked. So with about 5 calls over the last 12+ hours and not a single call back. I would stay far away from this location.

Worst steak hibachi I've ever had. The steak was tough and borderline not edible. I poured yum yum sauce (which was nasty and watery) and eel sauce to try to muster down the steak and that didn't even help. I would give this 0 stars if I could . Writing this review is making me relive the horror of yesterday!!

First time visiting this adorable place and it won't be the last. The staff is great and the food was amazing. I had the grilled eggplant sandwich and loved it. Leslie was one of our servers and I just loved her. It is small so there may be a wait for a table but it is totally worth it!
The bowser breakfast sandwich is on point. Plus, the Big Al and his son are incredibly nice people. You should probably take the time and check out this awesome place!!

I am a fan.  The $10 Beer & Lunch! Monday-Friday
Choose any sandwich, wrap, or salad from our new menu and enjoy our beer of the day for only $10.  Offer good during the week, 11 am - 4pm.  IS AWESOME!!!!

My only drawback is that the set up does not allow for fast service if you only want a cup o'joe.  It's a long wait for coffee because people pile up and both registers are not working.  If there were 4 staff people there 2 to ring and 2 to serve it would go quicker.  But that's the only down side.  If you have any issues with anything just tell someone and they will fix it.  GREAT FRIENDLY PLACE!  If the change the wait time to get a coffee i'll give it 5 stars.  

Thanks to Gale i didn't know about the free coffee refills - does it matter if it's in a to go cup?

David there is an employee that is odd. but other wise they all do their best in a badly designed situation.  they really need 4 staffers on at once.

Been going to Bottega for a couple years now. My favorite spot in Tucson tbh. The calamari romana is my favorite dish - haven't had anything quite like it. Also, get the lemon chello mule! Sooooo good. The staff is amazing and the service is impeccable. 5 star restraint for sure.

To make this short - I've never had a better cannoli! The filling is to die for and the shell is the perfect crunch. I will go to Termini's anytime I'm in Philadelphia. If you can't decide what to get at Reading Terminal - make this a must! I don't think you'll regret it.

As soon as I walked into the Restuarant, I love how calming and relaxing the place look. The food was delicious. No words. We did not leave anything behind. Our plates were all clean! The service was really good too. If you want to try authentic Burmese/Kachin food, this is the place to go.

I found not one but two flies in my dinner alone.  They were very obviously cooked in the sauce.  We had a large order of pineapple chicken fried rice, a large order of spicy chicken fried rice, a sesame chicken dinner combo and two crab Rangoon.  Nobody else will eat their food because of what I found and the restaurant is refusing a full refund of my $29 and some change.  The man I spoke with told me that my other dishes were fine.  Well we wouldn't know that because we won't be eating them because we found 2 flies in mine   after ordering from Ho Wun faithfully for the last 10 years, literally going at least once a month, we will probably not ever return after this experience!  Good luck y'all!  Hope there's none in your food but if I have two in mine there's sure to be something else wrong.  Also, more disappointing than the flies in the food, the man I spoke with told me the system does not allow full refunds which is crap because I've worked with a point of sales system before.  He clearly lied to a customer.  He also unfortunately did not confirm any of my information after I asked to have someone else call me back.  He simply told me he did not know if they could call me back.  Bad food is one thing, bad customer service will chase off every good customer you've got.
I used to love this place, would stop by whenever I was in town.  But yesterday I found a BUG in my ice cream, and the guy working there couldn't have cared less!  NEVER AGAIN!

We are so pleased with Dustin  McClelland, who has been our service advisor in the past several visits. We love his wonderful sincere and friendly personality. He is so knowledgeable and dependable. He is a great asset to your store in Reno and Mercedes Benz in general. Our thanks big time! Grace and Sashah Branscombe.

Amazing acoustics upstairs, the toweringly high ceilings of the former bank that houses the restaurant make the place quiet enough to hear the other people at your table even when the place is busy. The columns and fabric on the walls also help dampen the sound.

Renaud's has recently opened in Loretto Plaza, next door to Harry's Plaza Cafe. It is a French style bakery and bistro with a warm neighborhood feel.
In the morning it smells of a busy warm oven. I got an almond croissant straight off the baking sheet that was sweet, crisp and flaky. The plain croissant was also crisp and flaky, not at all like the large fluffy things we are starting to grow accustomed to at the chain and warehouse shops. 
The chocolate macaroon was to die for. French macaroons are not the coconut haystacky things (although I like those too), think of them more like a light meringue shell encasing a dense creamy filling. The inside of the chocolate macaroon was like a flourless chocolate torte. Delicious.
I bought an assortment of pastries to take home and the counter woman wrapped them up in a pretty brown box and tied it with raffia. 

There is bistro food served here, too. Baguette with jam or cut meats, some simple sandwiches, egg dishes and salads.  One of these sit-down meals will cost around $8-$11 for the dish.  The menu's on the website.

All the customers there when I visted early one morning seemed very happy to be there. A few were already repeat customers, and the new ones were excited to give things a try.

The coffee was ok.  I had a Carmel macchiato.  Not the best I've had but good enough to drink! It was a little on the sweet side.  

The location was great, but parking was a little tricky.  Plan on parking and walking a bit.  

I love how quiet and open it is.  The coffee wasn't as good as yeast Nashville.

As a native Chicagoan I have to say the pizza is on point. It's like a cross between Chicago deep dish and a New York slice - my friend and I were pleasantly surprised! We tried pizza from a few places nearby and were not impressed.

The restaurant itself is cozy yet spacious, and it feels like you're in someone's well maintained home. The owner is very friendly and inviting. He is also quite knowledgeable of Nashville so it was a bonus chatting with him as an out-of-towner. 

I highly recommend swinging by after some shopping in the nearby area or after a couple of cocktails from the Saloon across the street.

Oh my god this is my new church I have seen the light as far as hamburgers gold the one I have the Vatican City was outstanding the grilled cheese sandwich and a hamburger put together it was amazingly good five guys the only down would be very noisy and we felt kind of rushed but other than that I will definitely be back
Best place around to get a Poke Bowl. Staff is nice, the place is super clean. You will not be disappointed with the flavors and options available, all super fresh by the way!!!

Favorite place for dance music! They have remodeled the main dance floor and it's a amazing space to dance even when crowded. They have two dance floors and a awesome outside patio with a fire place/pit and Disco ball. I've  had friends who've had bottle service and I defiantly recommend EOS lounge. WO

The slowest service you'll ever get, waited in line for so long that it overlapped our rental time. It was ridiculous. We had to walk over to an employee for someone to finally recognize that we were standing there

I kind of stumbled on the old Carrows place as I am always looking to try anything new. The inside is very nice and open, service was quick, we kept our order simple and my wife ordered the Mushroom and cheese and I ordered the BBQ burger and cheese and I asked that they hold the jalapenos. Food arrived on these overthought rectangle plates and then our fries were in these little galvanized buckets and as requested a side of ranch in a little cup arrived with about a table spoon full of ranch, this just screams portion control "Really". Our burgers were cook well and taste was good, but as I was eating my tongue found one single jalapeno in the middle buried under the cheese, talk about the cook staff going out of their way to completely disregard what the customer wanted, SAD. So, with that said we will not be back because of the small portions of fries and sides, I just do not see the value for the cost. And I defiantly don't like having the staff messing with my meal. Not cool.

What a delightful place! Certainly reminiscent of the quintessential Paris bistro. The pate, cassoulet & short rib were divine. Topping it off with a slice of almond cake & a French press was the perfect ending. Our waitress was wonderful - attentive allowing just the right dining pace. Can't wait to return.

Don't go here unless you absolutely have to. All of the previous reviews are 100% accurate. Extremely slow, understaffed, no sense of urgency. 3 people behind the teller desk, only 1 working...its worth the extra 20 minute drive across town to the charlotte location

Stopped in here with the family, everyone seemed to enjoy there food.  My meatball sandwich tasted like the meatballs and sauce had been cooking all night - not good.

Easy in and out off of Valencia.  Also this is a newer building so it is nice on the inside and out.  On the plus side for those nice days there is plenty of outside seating.

My Mom, a friend, and I have used Affordable Custom for years, and have always been very happy.  Kevin is very knowledgeable about his products and very skilled at his craft.  I would highly recommend him to anyone.  Never a long wait.  He also has a cool painting gallery with artwork for sale!

Had a blast.  Didn't start out too hot with my axe throwing skills, but Coach Anthony made sure I and my group had a blast. He had a lot of helpful tips and made sure we had fun. Definitely coming back.

Amazing food and amazing pork rinds and the bar tender is great!!! 

Burgers are very tasty and filling but get the double bc you will regret if you don't.

Love their happy hour

It was fun to see the different dessert animals and learn about their habitats as well as see the scenery. We did not have children with us but it was very child friendly, and still interesting for adults of any age. Easy stroller and wheel chair friendly paths and animal viewing areas. The quick grill have good food with generous portions. Wild bird demonstration was a good attraction with hawks swooping within inches above your head with the supervision of trainers.

Jose Garces' newest restaurant is a smash! 

This newly renovated space (formerly Chifa) is incredible. Looks like you stepped back in time into the beautiful era of Cuba's history.

The food hits all the right notes! The smoked pineapple on top of the guacamole is not to be missed. We also had a beef empanada and the frisee salad. 

I had the pork shoulder, Some bits were a bit too crispy but the black beans and rice....oh my! were spectacular and I'm not even a fan of black beans! The corn pudding that came with it was less successful. Like an OK side of creamed corn.

My dinner companion had the roasted chicken with potatoes. The seasoning was just right. Tasty and delicious right down to the bone!

And we split a flan for desert. Remember to order a mojito. They were spectacular!

Well played, Mr. Garces. Well played.

As soon as I stepped foot into Corner Pub, I knew I was at home. In front of me was a sign toting 3 dollar New Belgium Drafts and 4 dollar bottles. For a kid from South Florida (the land of expensive adult beverages) who just so happens to love good beer... it was like like being introduced to your first love all over again and being told you'd never have to actually pay for dates. I had come from the Vandy/UF game, and Corner Pub had all the good games on, albeit finding a spot at the bar took some guile.  The bartenders were fast, polite, and knew exactly what I wanted when I felt like being indecisive. I can't really comment on the food, as I just wanted liquid lunch, but you might just find me there again sometime soon.

It kills me to write this review, because the Metairie location has always provided great food and great service. This location seems to be severely lacking in the latter. 

The food is good. My eggplant poboy was great. Husband's 1/2 catfish dinner was okay. My daughter liked the cheese pizza and it was only $4.99, so that's a win.

The service? Leaves a lot to be desired.

We decided to dine in. The wait to order wasn't too bad. They gave us a number and we waited to be called. It took about 20 minutes, which I expected given that my daughter ordered a pizza. Unfortunately, the first thing they brought out was an eggplant stick appetizer, which we didn't order. I gladly would have eaten it anyway, but they apologized and took it away. Next to arrive was the catfish plate. Another 5 mins later, we received the pizza and the eggplant poboy. There was supposed to be an order of onion rings with that, but I decided to be polite and wait, since obviously the food wasn't coming out at all at the same time anyway. By the time I was finished the poboy, I tracked down the server and she said she would bring some out. They finally arrived and were pretty good. 

Throughout the meal, we got to watch as multiple other orders (both dine-in and takeout) were incorrect and sent back. There seem to be some major issues with keeping track of what is ordered & what is sent out. 

It also took about 10 mins just to get a to-go box for the leftover pizza.

I would think that with a very successful store under their belt in Metairie, it wouldn't have taken this long to work out basic issues like getting an order correct & good customer service.
Carlos did a great job on my owl. The colors are amazing! The tattoo is just beautiful! Will definitely come back for more work.
Great service, good and interesting food and drinks. And fun decor. Definitely coming back.

Very good experience with Family Air, who I hired to come and clean/maintain my HVAC, which hadn't received any maintenance for a few years. The tech was easy to work with and friendly, and was very thorough, pointing out his findings (which were thankfully that everything was running well) and making suggestions to ensure reliable operation. Good stuff, I recommend giving them a call!

This place is OK.  The staff was a little weird this past Sunday like they didn't want us in there bothering them while they were trying to clean up, so we kept it simple and ordered a Bustelo Cool to-go.  Probably won't ever go back because of the cold shoulder, but we shall see.
Will come again! The biscuit was fire ' and they give good portions of chicken and Mac n cheese !

First time we have dined in a restaurant since the pandemic. I am so happy we chose this new little gem I found by googling Lebanese restaurants. Food was authentic and delicious if you like Mediterranean cuisine. Tried a couple appetizers and the chicken shawarma. We can't wait to go back and have a nice dinner! The owner could not have been kinder.

First lI want to let you say I do not go here for the sports at all as i care less for them other then NASCAR and the Olympics so I not normally go to a place like this but I got a deal  on wings there that was to god to pass up so we went and glad we did as they got the best Garlic wings in Tampa using real garlic not garlic butter so the garlic favor is nice and  strong  which is why I love it so much.
This is the very best Indian restaurant in the city. Not only is the food delicious, the staff are super friendly and accommodating. Great value. Tandoori chicken is fabulous.

I used to go here for good pizza with u limited toppings for around 10 dollars which to me was well worth the price for the size. Now they have changed the price that a basic cheese pizza is 6 dollars and each additional topping is a dollar. That is ridiculous. I can understand if it was about saving costs but making each topping including cheese a dollar extra just doesn't make the pizza taste as good especially since from the start they were cheap with the amount given on the toppings anyways. Honestly I drove here instead of blaze to save mayb 15 minutes however I think for what I am getting I will wind up going elsewhere. Not to mention they don't even have a loyalty program to make the place even worth it. Highly disappointed. So much so I actually took the time to write a review.

I gotta say I'm dissapointed...Ming ming's was a favorite of mine. After driving 20 minutes out to the place, I order my sushi to go, and the place is empty, save for two people who already have their food. I take my food, drive it back 20 minutes, and go to eat it... the rolls were practically empty! There was absolutely no reason to skimp that much on the fillings (barely any fish and hardly any veg), and it wasn't as if they were busy and trying to make it as fast as they could. Very dissapointed in their new standard

I am in love... with Pascos !  I would give this place 10 stars if I could.

A friend and I were in the area heading to another restaurant and this one caught our eye. It was cute, the menu looked good and they advertised custom adult beverages. We were sold ! 

This became  one of those meals that I compare all others too.  You know "That was a really fantastic meal, but not as good as the one I had at Pasco's" . 

The food is absolutely fresh, delicious and affordable.  They have a phenomenal drink menu but you can tell the certified mixologist your desires and out comes a drink better than you thought possible. 

I can say with confidence that I will be back again the next time I'm in Tucson.  Add in the classy yet casual ambiance and friendly and attentive staff, and you have a real gem.

Wow! Recommend this place! Came in on Sunday night for a dinner, the place was pretty full. The service is quick and the food is out of this world! My wife had duck and it was really good. I had teriyaki steak and it was really good. And of course the fried ice cream! One order is plenty for 2 people, trust me! Really enjoyed the dinner! Thank you Ooka!

I venture to Oceano Bistro for Clayton restaurant week. I really loved  the comfortable booths. They are also great for social distancing. I found the food to just be okay, but the atmosphere was welcoming and enjoyable.

Heard about this place on indystar. Wanted to try it. I'm a big fried chicken lover. Me and the wife loved it. Wanted more. Chicken marinated in a mouth watering sauce, don't know what but good! The fries are pretty basic, but you go for the chicken not the fries! Recommend!

Love love love The Christmas Tree Stand! Ordered a tree for delivery and set up and here's what I loved:

Price for delivery and set up was very reasonable and the price even includes a stand! Well worth saving the time and energy of going to the store. And perfect for those who don't have help but still want to get a nice tree.

They deliver as early as 24 hours after ordering. I ordered a tree on Thurs afternoon and could have had it on Saturday.

The delivery and setup process was super quick. Took less than 5 minutes. By the time I filled up a jug to water the tree, the delivery man was done.

Last but not least, the tree is gorgeous! They deliver fresh cut trees and the tree had a beautiful shape.
Our favorite go-to for local takeout. My favorite dish is the Pad Thai and my husband loves the sesame chicken meal. Highly recommended for anyone in the area.

I want to give this more stars because the food is really good. The t-rav crust is hands down the best. However the service is so poor! This is twice now that they've screwed up part of our order. Admittedly, we had a big part of 7 and most of us ordered the t-rav crust which apparently takes an extra 20 minutes to cook. But my god. No advance notice that this was the case and we waited about an hour for our food. Then, when it got out here, they'd forgotten to make one of our pizzas! The server blamed it on the kitchen staff but she had to have entered it wrong into the computer. And she didn't even offer to comp it! I hate to do it, Sliced Pint, but we are breaking up. 

Edited to add that she messed up some of our checks and also took forever to run cards. Sigh.
Really cool establishment I guess one would say it's similar to a hooters... great service , food and drinks were good also

I went here every year for my prom dresses, dresses for fancy weddings, everything.  I was convinced that they were miracle workers.  Until that dreadful day!  
Me and my family were going to a fancy wedding and my mom went there to get a gown. When she went to pick up the pistachio colored beauty, she noticed a huge stain on it.  Quite like a coffee stain.  Here, the seamstress spilled coffee on it and would charge my mom an outrageous amount of money to clean it. ...yes, to clean a spill they made!  How horrible!  I'll never step foot in there again.

So glad to have this place on the Avenue!

Particularly great for gifts and stationery. Cards, kitchen doo-dads, scented candles that actually smell good, tea towels, cocktail bitters, that sort of thing.

Every time you go for an overnight visit somewhere, you should buy your host(ess) gift here.

I LOVED this place! The food was delicious, the fries amazing, and the service was great! They have SO many different kinds of beers too! Definitely going back and recommending it to ALL of my friends!

They either forgot or lost our paper work for some flower arrangements. I called the morning of to pick up the flowers and they were completely confused. Luckily, they has enough flowers to quickly put something together.  Still paid full price. Was not impressed by the arrangements.

Realistically, Yelp ratings tend to vary by community, and 4 1/2 stars in a smaller city may not bring the same level of quality as it does in a larger one. That was true here. When I arrived at the restaurant, there was one other diner (and a pair of diners arrived as I was leaving), but all in all it's a pleasant setting.

The menu is largely comprised of Indian "standards" that you'd find in most Indian restaurants, with a few unique dishes. When I told him I wanted lamb, the waiter steered me toward the lamb saag (with spinach). Unfortunately, the dish really lacked flavor. It almost felt like it had been boiled and the Indian spices watered down with milk--and the lamb was rather fatty as well. Coupled with the rice, which didn't have that fluffy texture of a good, properly cooked basmati, I wasn't terribly happy. I was just going to suck it up and deal, but the waiter, to his credit, insisted that they get me something else. I was a little concerned about the chicken tikka masala, because so many times it just tastes like chicken in tomato sauce, but he told me it was a house specialty. Thankfully, the new dish was a substantial improvement over the last one--still not at the level of a place like Badmaash in LA--and I appreciate the server's willingness to get me something different, even when I didn't specifically request it.

If the review hinged solely upon the lamb and the rice, they'd have been in trouble, but as it is, this seems like the definition of a-ok. Would I return? Possibly, though I'd probably consider my options first.

As a business traveler, it's hard to find places that do decent takeout near hotels, but this place was great. Now, I can't vouch for their full meals, but coming from the DC area if I can find a great snack to tide me over for $10 (their sampler platter) that was enough for 2 people, it's a winner. The hummus was so-so, but the tzatziki was nicely sharp with garlic, and the grape leaves were lemony. There were a ton of olives accompanying the platter, too - absolutely won me over with that! I'll definitely do takeout from there again the next time I'm in town.
Worst breakfat ever! Service sucks. Tables wobbly restaurant dirty. Save your money and your digestive system.

I'm surprised to see this place only has three stars! My husband and I loved it. Beer was great! Food was fabulous. Our server couldn't have been more kind and attentive. My husband got a shrimp alfredo and loved it. I tried it and also really enjoyed the flavor. I got the embargo sandwich and thought it was perfect. The sweet potato fries I got on the side were perfectly fried and got fresh out of the fryer. Overall, fabulous.

Had the crawfish, shrimp and crab legs. The crawfish were pretty gross, didn't have a good colour, there was barely any meat and even the waitress said they weren't good but I've never had them before and we wanted to try them. The lobster was 1 big leg and was something like $54. I'm sure the weight was after cooking after they soaked it in butter. The shrimp we're pretty delicious but everything came in a bag and it was a small table with no room. We paid $150 with tip and I really believe we didn't get value for our money.  I could've spent $50 at the grocery store and made the food taste better.

So I travel a lot for work and stay at Marriott hotels about 95% of the time. Every once in a while you find a Marriott that is more suited for partiers than business folk like me.

I was "upgraded" to a 2nd floor balcony room that over looked St. Charles ave. This meant that out of the 4 nights I staid 3 of them were with people who were drinking and screaming on their balcony for most of the night. It also meant I had a prime location for the noisy street car that runs to midnight. An people blasting there radio so loud I can hear the lyrics in my room. Basically I had a very unpleasant time at this place. 

So if your an underage drinker looking for a place to make everyone else miserable this is the place for you. On a business tip - strongly consider another location. 

The room its was clean but paint was cracked and peeling off of the ceiling.

I just spent 41 dollars treating my husband to a delivered meal. His sandwich " the medium" was a veritable feast for 13.99. I ordered the " half sub" not because I was not hungry but because 40+ for 2 subs and 2 drinks is insane. My sub, although absolutely delicious was " Tiny". I am sad and still hungry. The " half sub" was smaller than one half of my hubby's medium sub. Huh???

What a cute, locally owned, shop!  Went on a Sunday around 11:30am before heading to brunch.  Wash, mini scalp massage, blowout and left feeling beautiful!!  Very clean shop.  Jules did my hair and Brenna did my friends hair, both listened and styled as we asked.  Show pics of what you want.  Great for a group.  First drink included in the cost, we had mimosas, but you can get wine, water, coffee, tea or champagne too.  They do lashes and make-up too.  They have no contract monthly memberships.  They sell product and cute hair accessories too.  Treat yourself!!  Enjoy!!

I love this hotel it's new modern we got an upper room side view the bedroom and bathroom was all glass looking out over the city it was stunning it is very modern and up-to-date they have a great steakhouse and bar in the hotel if we come in Asheville we will definitely be staying there again

My dog had a minor acute need and they were able to get her in last-minute on a busy Saturday, which likely prevented her symptoms from progressing to something more serious. The staff took excellent care of her and the doctor clearly explained her treatment plan and answered all of my questions. I think sometimes people who leave poor reviews perhaps have unrealistic expectations about the scope of practice and services that can or cannot be offered by health care providers, whether they take care of people or animals. It's important to recognize that veterinary and health care workers often go out of their way to make sure their patients needs are met, frequently at the expense of their own personal time. For this reason and a whole host of others, I wanted to say thank you to the doctors and staff at Woodland for taking such good care of my sweet little Grace.

I've been coming to Marianne for over a year and I swear she only continues to get better. She's still my favorite massotherapists, although I've gone to multiple therapists across the US in the past couple months. Another favorite part about the massage is sometimes we don't even speak the entire time and I swear it's a deeper, more therapeutic massage. I cannot overstate how skilled Marianne is and it would be extremely hard for me to go to anyone else!
The margarita was very small, I didn't even taste the tequila. Food was ok, service horrible. The waiter dropped a glass of water near my foot and acted like nothing! will not be back!

Great bbq! This place is really good. Only edged they offered more selections of sauce flavors. Getting in out of this establishment is a hassle. You will find yourself finding a hard time entering and leaving, but the food is worth it!

I set up as a vendor once this spring.  It was well attended early, with very hungry dealer-buyers.  Then later, just as the recreational shoppers were starting to circle, it started raining. For the limited amount of hours I was set up, I thought sales were OK, though the bargaining was unusually agressive.  When I had closed up, I wandered around to see who remained -- there was a good variety of used, vintage and antique merch. Some quite expensive, some in the $1-$20 range.

They're open Wed, Sat & Sun.  Vendors -- on Sunday, you need to call in advance to reserve a spot.

I generally don't give poor reviews, and I'm not squeamish when it comes to the realities of our bodily functions.  That being said, the ONLY reason for the one star is the bathrooms. Imagine what four port-o-potties servicing a few hundred vendors and a few thousand customers look like. There had been some sort of intestinal explosion in one rendering unusable. The one I used as a last resort was leaking out the bottom, otherwise it would have been overflowing. No sinks or anti-bacterial lotion.  I'm sure the men duck into the woods because it takes 2-3 minutes to hike up the hill... my first thought was what health inspector is being bribed to allow this to go on?  And second, with thousands and thousands of dollars in rental fees coming in, why won't management spend a bit to have a sufficient number of frequently maintained port-o-potties. Or even a more permanent rest room structure?

I'd love to go back, it seemed like good buying and selling -- but I'll wait until the bathrooms are upgraded.

Went here this past weekend for our friend's birthday.  Our friend's sister told them it was his birthday, and they were really sweet and brought out a piece of cheese with a candle in it.  I did notice that it was mostly an older crowd here, but everyone seemed friendly and polite.  I really liked how there is so much history here and how neat it is.  The beer selection was very good too!  The entrance is confusing though-it is not the door in the corner on the front that you might think it would be, but instead on the side.  I hope to go back again soon.
Well this place didn't meet my expectations. Seeing that I am a Southern girl. Born and raised I'm the South. This did not represent the South by far.

Coming into this office was nothing but delightful! Michelle who works the front desk is so helpful and friendly and Elizabeth (the dermatologist) helped me with all my needs for my skin, she's educated in eastern & western medicine so that was a huge plus for me! 10/10 recommend!! So lucky I found them :)

I'd go as far as to say the hummus at Dizengoff is better than most I had in Israel; it's creamy, smooth perfection with just the right amount of oil. The fresh warm pita is also amazing, but I like to enjoy my hummus on its own with a spoon - yes, it's that good. 

Dizengoff is an absolute must-try in Philadelphia. They always offer the classic tehina hummus, but other flavors/toppings change daily. On Sundays you can order shakshuka, but in all honesty I wasn't that impressed - it was a little too chunky for my liking and overly spicy. It wasn't bad by any means, but I would personally recommend sticking to hummus when coming here.

Don't be deterred by the crowd/line, the service is really fast. Seating is very limited (both inside and outside), but tables free up quickly.

So I'm a sushi snob..a big time sushi snob.  I've been eating sushi since I was in 1st grade...i've tried everything from the most mouth watering melts in your mouth sushi to the nastiest puke in your mouth sushi (the latter is normally from a buffet so I tend to stay away from them). I came across sushi pier on yelp and couldn't believe the super duper 5 star reviews...I said what the heck...let's drive by the place and see if it's legit.  Besides, im pretty tapped out from the typical casino food that i normally get when visiting reno.  I drove by twice attempting to look through the window somehow hoping that I would be able to determine the freshness of the sushi...I mean it is Reno right?  There isn't an ocean here!!!  

Well sushi pier socked me in the face and flicked me the bird.  

The service was ridiculously awesome.  The servers were amazing and on it!  I did not have an empty plate sitting in front of me longer than a couple of mins.
