Dress code.  Don't just pop in in your walking shorts.  The place has history and standards, but it isn't snobby.  Nobody cares if you don't know which fork to use.  (It's the one on the outside, but it doesn't really matter.). But it's nicer for everyone if your grungy toenails and the shark-bite on your calf are invisible.

The service is what you dream about: the staff gives the impression they never read Karl Marx and would have thought him tasteless if they did.  The staff treat the paying customer like he's paying their rent, not a nuisance who's responsible for all their heartache, which is both accurate and refreshing.   At a lunch-rush recently, I had to wait five minutes for a re-fill on my drink, which was really almost unheard of: they have their eye on you for good and not for evil.  The guy who runs the crumb-knife over your table between courses gives you the impression that it's his privilege to do it.  They are friendly, but they don't forget who is paying.

Tip them heavily.  You will not see this again: it is the old way.

The food is exceptional.  Now and then it doesn't live up to the high reputation Commander's has set for itself; but this is very rare in my experience.   I once recently found myself thinking of it as an overrated place, but the cherry-glazed quail completely changed my mind.

At lunchtime, some of the decent house cocktails are under a dollar.  But you should splurge and order your drinks off the menu.  They're reasonably priced (it's a drinking town) but the mixologists are professionals.  They know their business.

In general, Commanders is not a place to economize but to spread out a little.

Delicious! 
Great customer service! 
Easy online/phone ordering and pick up. Service was quick. I ordered Thai and garlic wings. Garlic are super wet and Mayo based. Not my style but flavorful. Will def bring company with me next time. Salad was fresh and had the right amount of dressing!

I used to live in Philadelphia; however, on Sunday, September 11th was the first time I truly visited and took advantage of this casino, when I was returning to the city as a visitor.

We had an amazing experience.  I now live in Los Angeles, just a short 4 hour drive to Las Vegas.  We head out to Las Vegas about 3-4 times per year and enjoy gaming at most properties on and off the strip.

Sugarhouse is definitely comparable to some of it's Vegas counterparts.  It has a huge selection of slots and table games (I mainly come for the slots).  It's decor is beautiful and the casino overall is very classy.  It has plenty of food options and the service that was provided to us at the players club booth was excellent and friendly.

The complaints I see in other people's reviews, I personally do not hold much merit.  They are complaints like "I am not winning".  People --- the point of a casino is entertainment.   You cannot always come out ahead.  It is like playing the lottery.   You do it for entertainment, but just a few people will win.  Other complaints I see are about beverage service.  Beverage service is always something that can be improved, and yes, they could get better at that.  However, honestly, it is the seem in almost every casino I have ever visited.

Overall, I rank Sugarhouse highly, and would definitely return again.

Amazing healthy tastes, great price, and very clean. Definitely give this place a try if you're into healthy and tasty wraps, sandwiches, flatbreads, paninis and a variety of great tasting smoothies!! :-)

Love it love it love it thanks tropical smoothie!!!!!!!! !!!!!!!!!!!!!!
I ordered my girlfriend flowers for Valentines Day and they turned out absolutely gorgeous!  The team at Alpha get an A+++.  Thank You sooo much!  She loved them!

With it's long holes, most of which are relatively straight, this is a great course to come get in some wood work. Mix in some rolling alleys, a few water hazards (hence the name five ponds), and a couple tough dog legs, and you'll find this is a pretty challenging spot to do your weekend yard work. Probably got the club record with my 41 above par the other Saturday I came here (1:10 tee time with cart for $65), but I still had a great outing. 

As far as difficulty goes, I found the front nine to be the worst of it, because that's where most of the water hazards came into play (though I did have my only two splash downs of the day when I was on 17); utilizing the on location driving range with it's $5 baskets is a good way to work out that first hole rust, and should help keep your score down a little. Long greens will give you room to work on your putting, and there are also a few short holes where you can flaunt your skill wirh the irons. 

I suggest making your tee time because it can get pretty bumping here, and I doubt they'll hold your spot long. Sneaking beers on looked possible as long as you stay somewhat covert about it, but they also sell sixers at $12 each (during peak season they are $18). 

Five ponds is a great scenic course with a good atmosphere of professionalism; enough class to stand out from the more lax city courses, but also relaxed enough that you won't feel like too much of a tool when you shank your first tee shot.

The best thing about this place is that it is super sketchy looking on the outside, so when you finish your deliciously tasty and authentic Thai-Laos meal, you feel like you've discovered the biggest hidden gem ever.

Syphay is located in a run-down looking white (well, more greyish white because of all the dirt) building beside a strip mall on Calgary Trail.  Inside is much more inviting with Thai decor and tapestry.  Service has always been pleasant and prompt.

My faves (though I've yet to have anything bad there!) include:
* Pad Paa Phit - their only fish dish, Basa fish stir-fried with a chili-coconut milk sauce and veggies.  It's sweet and a teeny bit spicy.  Pairs really well with coconut rice.
* Pad Thai - the real, authentic stuff with Tamarind sauce like you get in Thailand.  Not the fake sweet and sour stuff that is so prevalent in North America.
* Pineapple Curry Goong - pineapple lends a nice sweet and tartness that complements coconut milk, kaffir lime leaves and shrimp very well!  Again, go with the coconut rice. 
* Tohm Kha (Light Coconut Soup) with Chicken - you really can't go wrong with anything coconut milk, but this is a nice mix between creamy, a teeny bit spicy, and fragrant (from the lemongrass).
* Salad rolls (Vietnamese style) with peanut sauce are solid as well.
* Thai Iced Tea - like all Thai iced teas, they come in a disgustingly creamy shade of orange but taste like a delicious vanilla tea

If the location skeeves you out (I promise, the interior is more inviting than the exterior!), they do take-out too, and have always been fantastic and prompt in that regard.  My favourite Thai/Laos place in the city!

One of my go to grocery stores.  They have hot food bar that opens at 11:30am, salad bar, soups, juice bar and smoothies.  They sell organic produce, vitamins, and full complement of non-GMO groceries.  

It costs more to eat cleaner.  We got our organic guacamole ingredients here for the super bowl and had the best guacamole ever!   Avacado, cilantro, lime, mango, tomato and Celtic salt!  Wow!  

We would rather go often and buy fresh organic and eat it then.  Too often we were going to the big stores and letting the deals spoil in our fridge.  There are certain fruits and veggies you should get organic!   Dovt ingest all those pesticides, etc! Eat clean!

Made us pull out of our work to determine the milage so i had to drive all the way back and i lost money. I cannot express enough how they will not schedule a good time. They expect it immediately like as if i dont work??

Couldn't agree more with Steven B. From Vegas! We were surprised to note Roy's was open on Christmas evening & took a chance without a reservation.  High marks from Yelp convinced us to give them a try and we were extremely pleased with our decision. They seated us right away and it soon became apparent they were being a little bit overwhelmed by such a large response of patrons without reservations on this Christmas night - likely the result of so few other restaurants being open or else already booked. Nonetheless, they stepped up to the challenge and served excellent dishes from a special Christmas menu. 

The organic salads were good portions of fresh ingredients with ample, but not excessive, dressing - a pet peeve of mine.  The Tomato Bisque was extremely flavorful with just the right consistency.  The Seafood Pasta entree contained an ample portion of fresh Bay Scallops, white fish, and shrimp and an Alfredo sauce that was exquisite - not too thick, not too watery, and, again, a plentiful amount. The Chocolate Mousse for dessert followed the same pattern: perfect texture, delicious flavor, and more than ample amount.

Even though the service was a bit slow (due obviously to the high volume of diners), the server was pleasant, apologetic, and very attentive throughout the evening. And while we waited, we enjoyed the 'stoutly' mixed cocktails from the bar.

Bottom line: An overall fabulous experience: delicious food, pleasant & attentive service, ample portions, and reasonable prices.

I love this place. I haven't been since pre-pandemic but this is the spot. I have been put on to so many new graphic novels...ugh it's incredible. The staff are knowledgeable and very easy to talk to...and their recommendations are just *chefs kiss* They sure do hire great people. I have been to a couple of events here pre-pandemic and overall, it's just a great addition to the neighborhood and city. I'm just a huge fan of this place and I'm hoping to make a trip back shortly.

This is one of my favorite studio that I've gone to for hot yoga in Philadelphia. Most classes are 75 minutes and it's an amazing workout. The studio has a local feel which makes it more homey and community-like... love the atmosphere. I've taken classes with almost all the instructors here and enjoy each one for different reasons. If you're looking for an extra challenging class though, take Ashely's class - she is amazing and very motivating.

I've been coming here for just about a year on a weekly basis (usually for Wine Wednesday, Martini Thursday, or Sunday Brunch) and I've literally never had a complaint in that time. I continue to come back because the food is consistently great and the staff are the friendliest people. 
Happy Hour between 4-6pm on weekdays is a great deal, appetizer specials are a la carte and look small but are actually pretty filling if you get 2-3 of them for a decent price. If I go for a Wine Wednesday and get 2 appetizers and 3 drinks off the Happy Hour menu, my bill is never more than $25-ish. 
Bartenders like experimenting with new drink combinations (most of the time they'll include some whiskey component, which I'm totally fine with) and bartender's choice drinks are always tasty. When I started going here, I was very nervous being a young woman alone at a bar in a place I wasn't familiar with but I've been coming here for nearly a year to read a book for an hour or two with some drinks and appetizers and no one's ever bothered me or given me trouble. 
Great place to go if you want to de-stress but don't necessarily want to have a huge friend group with you.

Very happy to finally have a pub in this area, this is what the former Ale Yard should have been.  A nice break from all the restaurants/lounges in the area (Moxie's, The Keg and Original Joe's).

It's a nice and homey type atmosphere, reminds me of Sherlock's.  They have live music Thurs-Sat. This night they had a live Irish singer on guitars.  Even with the live music it's not overly too loud and you can still socialize and talk to others.  Service was friendly from the door greeter to the waitress, who was prompt to take orders and always checking.  She did forget to put in the order for the nachos, but no big deal as it only took 5 minutes to get them.  The only thing I didn't understand is why there is no prices for the beers on tap on the menu (it states to ask for pricing), so FYI pints are $7.50-$9.  They do have a nice selection of beers on tap, as well as bottle beers.  Lots of TVs to catch some Oilers or other sporting events too.

I had the big bacon burger.  No complaints, the beef patty do seem home made and nice size.  The full size chicken top nachos (can also get half order) were nicely topped and enough for 2 people to share.  They have other things on the menu I would love to try next time, like their meat pies.  Overall, the menu is typical pub fare and you can check the full menu online.

They do take Scene cards here, but was disappointed to learn it's only one card per table, and you have to tell them you have a card BEFORE they finalize the bill.  There were 4 of us and we split our bills. Not sure I understand this policy, as we each spent on average $45 each it would be nice to each collect points.

As I mentioned, it's very nice to finally get a real pub in the area.  It just gives a different vibe than a restaurant lounge.  Having a place with live music is also a bonus.  Judging from the crowd on a Friday night, others seem to agree too.  I will definitely be going back.

Love this place. My wife and I come in as often as we can.  Hate they closed the Cool Springs location as it was more accessible. Never want the portion to end, so delicious and hot!!! # 805 Thai Hot and steamed dumplings will cute what ails ya.

oh man this was absolutely glorious.  

we came here after a long day of traveling and finally sat down for dinner around 10 ... the big burger and mountain of fries definitely hit. the. spot. i was holding my stomach when we were walking out and the food baby never felt so good.

the only thing is that.. we ordered medium rare for our burgers and we got.. medium/well done.. also, the fries were a little too greasy.. but that truffle oil is bombastic!  there is def room for improvement.  the plus side is that.. when you just want a juicy and monstrous burger w/o going to an actual restaurant n paying extra for tip? this is your spot. i'll def b back when im in a burger mood again.

I ordered a Rib Sandwich & Brisket sandwich thru Uber Eats. I was very tired after working 10 days @ the hospital and just wanted to go home..For the very first time ever, The Ribs were tough and dry and the Jumbo sandwich looked like a $5 meal from Burger King, not to mention the fact that it was very salty. I called to speak to the manager who told me to bring the food back to them. Okay???? what am I to do get the Ribs out of the dumpster??? 
Sorry Jack's can't support you or advise anyone to come there till you get your act together. I don't have $31.00 to throw away.
Had a plain pizza and a caesar salad. Both were very good. Pizza has a sweeter tomato sauce and the caesar dressing was great. Best pizza we've found in the immediate area.

Like many of the reviewers here and on other Philly food sites, I had a $10.00 gift certificate for this place - the successor to Joey's Stone Baked Pizza. The conveyer-belt oven that Joey's installed to make crisp thin crusts is still here. I never went to Joey's because they never sold slices and - since La Fuente took over I didn't go for the same reason. (I did learn that they sell slices - plain only - at lunch Mon-Friday only now).

So here I am by myself for dinner and I decide to use the certificate and do take out (the place has zero atmosphere - pop music playing and a TV with the sound off. And it's nearly always empty. 

Though their pasta dishes sounded good - and were much cheaper than even the small pizzas! - I said I gotta try the pizza. I settled on a small (they are "12 inches) with sausage, broccoli rabe and onions - with a touch of fresh basil. Ten minutes after ordering it was ready to go. I'm only a few blocks away so it was still hot when I got home but kept part of it in the oven - which didn't affect the crispness.

The pie was tasty I might say and certainly crisp. Think of the texture of matzo (the crisp kind, not egg matzo) and you get the idea. It was a bit tastier than plain matzo but the crust when tasted without topping lacked any discernable flavor. It all came from the topping. It didn't take a lot of effort to finish off the pie with no leftovers. I felt just about as full as after two of those gigantic slices at Lorenzo's at 3rd and South. Of course I had some toppings but there couldn't have been more than 3 oz of crumbled sausage on the La Fuente pie.

The pie including tax was $13.50 (that's for 1 hungry person or two very light eaters). Compare that with $5.50 for 2 slices at Lorenzo's. (Oh yeah, Lorenzo's adds 25 cents for the box). Was it worth it. Probably not. With the certificate it was $5.00 less. Would I return? Maybe with another certificate. But I think they've priced themselves a bit too high. And they could use a bit more atmosphere too I guess.
Pretty good but not a top end Sushi house. One time I did get grey Tuna. Wait staff is nice.

When I first visited Nashville for a tour of Belmont University years ago, the locals I knew here took me to SATCO first. I don't know if it was because it was new or what, but I loved it.

Just recently, I took a friend there for lunch. I hadn't been in awhile, but was expecting the same experience. I'll agree with Sarah - the cheese sauce is great, but the tacos I had didn't do it for me. It has moved down on my list of places to go when in that area. It is still good food, there's just better around.

Let me start off with.....
My best friend from high school is the concierge at the Ritz Carlton in New Orleans for 9 years now and she took me to Surrey's. And I loved it. Mind you, it was a Sat at 11am, the wait was about 20 min, but so well worth it. the waite staff were funny and very entertaining as they blurted out the party's name.
I ordered the Migas  with egg whites and it was soooooo yummy! my friend ordered the eggs benedict with crawfish and added a side of mushroom gravy, which tasted soo good with my potatoes. It's a must if you are ever in New Orleans!!

WOW!!! A friend and I saw on facebook that this location was having its grand opening, so we just had to come. We were greeted immediately. Andrew came up and helped us both, walked us through the menu and explained all their cold press juices to us and gave us the juice tour! While I ended up getting their Blue Tart smoothie which tasted AMAZING. I will be back to buy their cold press juices! My friend got the Açaí berry bowl and that also tasted amazing.

Small place with a family as cooks and waiters. All heart, some looses edges when they're busy, but that's to be expected.  The food is family-style Korean.  A nice change of pace from the other  Korean restaurants in town.

Updated- music has been a good volume the last several times I've nommed on a burger and Kumara fries

BurgerFuel. Woah. Normally I enjoy a sinfully delicious burger and leave with taste buds happy but a greasy gut. Not at Burgerfuel! They have thought of absolutely everything! The gourmet burgers are 100% grass fed, chicken is free range with 0 hormones or fillers. The buns are wholemeal with no added sugar. Even the soft serve is organic! But don't for a second think they have compromised taste for being healthy. My burger was thick and juicy, so juicy that have give you a burger holder so you don't drip flavor down the side of your hand while you're savoring every bite. I can't yet speak to the veggie burger, but the people eating them Now letss move on to the Kumara fries and Aioli sauce, a perfect combination of sweet and garlicy. We enjoyed our fast and fresh meal while a dj was spinning beats in the background and silly Japanese game shows played on the TV. We sat close to the DJ and it was a little too loud for us, so if sound easily overwhelms you, head towards the perimeter.

I have been wanting to try La Cocinita for a long time now and they were outside of Eiffel tonight and I was excited to finally have the opportunity! Little did I know that I would stand there for quite a while with no one ahead of me in line without so much as an acknowledgement as the woman at the window played with her cell phone. When I was ready to walk away, she asked in a rude tone if I needed help and as I said yes and was ready to order, she started talking with her co-worker and playing with her cell phone again. I was really hungry and might expect this kind of treatment at City Hall, but not somewhere I am choosing to spend my money. The treatment was so rude, I walked away and will never try them again. The good news is that there are so many other great food trucks in New Orleans! For tacos/burritos, I would definitely recommend Taceaux Loceaux or Los Poblanos on Broad St. in the evenings instead. Both have delicious food and treat you with respect.

This was my daughter's first dentist appointment. She is almost 2 years old. She was very curious about the beautiful setup in the new office with the jungle animal seating. (There is a center island with animals and orange seats that go all the way around. The walls have really lovely animals painted all over the office) The dental assistant and the dentist were both very sweet and professional. My daughter was scared but they both did their very best to make her comfortable and assure her that everything was ok. I was nervous about her first appointment because I didn't know what to expect but the staff really made me feel confident about her next check up with them. I highly recommend taking your kids here! Just a note but even adults can go here too!

Just picked up the white clam sauce with spaghetti and a meat pizza.  The spaghetti was dry as a bone, no sauce and the clams were fishy smelling and tasting.  Couldn't get past the first bite.  Threw it out.  ($16 bucks for the spaghetti). The meat pizza was great.  We will definitely get pizza there again.  We won't waste our money on the pasta dishes.

I have been seeing my family doctor at Rabbit Hill Medical for many years, and I'm thankful that I found a clinic that is close to home with care that is a great match for me. I've always found it easy to get an appointment with my doctor, but when she has been unavailable, I've seen other doctors at the clinic (at least four) and been comfortable with them all. Since all my charts and files are kept at the clinic, whichever doctor I see has my history there, and my regular GP can access them next time I see her. The thing I love the most about this clinic is that it is also a walk in, and my doctor reserves a couple of walk in spots a day for her regular patients. When I have had need of walk in services, I've been able to call the clinic when it opens and often get a quick visit with my doctor. I hate going to the doctor, so if I like a clinic, it's worth sharing!

Frickin cool space and an A+ coconut milk latte.  Great options for pour over and creative drinks of the day.  This place is dedicated to the art of coffee, that's for damn sure.  Dig that mucho.

You may feel out of place if you aren't working on a laptop...

Have been there 4 times and tried different things.  Haven't been disappointed yet.  Ella's put a good twist to comfort food.  Was there the first time only to try their "chocolate-covered-bacon".  Yep, you heard it right -- dark chocolate covered bacon!!!  Before you scream and gag, think for a moment, you like chocolate covered pretzel, right?  It is just 100x BETTER!!!  Love their version of Bloody Mary too.  Just the right kick to go with some healthier version for southern food.  Hence, why only 4-star?  The live band on weekends are way too loud for that small place.

Terrible service, food mediocre at best, took hour and half for appetizers. They will not be around long, too many other good restaurants in the area. Will never go back!!!  Don't waste your time or money.

Got a pair of my shoes resoled & the rubber replacement sole started to detach from the shoe after a few weeks. It also costed more than what I'm used to paying at the cobbler I used to go to before I relocated.

I have a daughter in college and have tried about every cookie delivery service there is.  My daughter says Blondie's are "THE best.  Definitely."  She loved the cookies, I loved the online service (shipped quick!) The shipping cost was definitely high but for a gift box of cookies this was a good value overall.  I have just ordered a gift box for my son and plan to stop at the store when I visit the area.

I'm catching up on my reviews. So here goes. My husband an I had brunch here about 2 months ago we came on a weekday. It's true what people say about it being like a restaurant inside a quaint store. It's a unique way to eat being surrounded by items to purchase and people watching. I was a little annoyed by a guy who was checking out merchandise literally 5 inches behind where I was seated. Space please! We ordered a bagel and house cured salmon, pancakes which were awesome, and a breakfast burrito of sorts. It was overall a good brunch.

Been in a few times now and always have a good experience. Fantastic calzones and salads, great beer selection, and friendly staff. The breakfast calzone in January with the maple cinnamon butter was awesome! On our last visit one of the owners even shook our hands and thanked us for visiting as we were leaving. 

If you want to save a little $$ there, the portion sizes are large enough that you can split one calzone and a salad between two people.
I eat here every so often. Usually my go to spot for lunch if guests are in town as there is a sandwich for everyone.  My favorite: buffalo, on brioche with Gorgonzola.

I have been going here for a couple of years now and absolutely love Dr. Rosinski. Unlike other reviewers, I'm very fortunate in that I have not had issues with my insurance coverage, and the dental hygienists that I have seen have all been great. One of the things that I love most about this place is that it is very close to my office, and they are really quick with cleanings and exams. I am usually in and out in about 20 minutes. I have never had to wait around.
Good diner food.  Good price and good people.  Lots of people come at least pre-Covid and it's a family restaurant.  So it's not Gordon Ramsey.  You pay a fair price for a filling tasty meal

Natural processed cold brewed Peruvian was fabulous.  We were there with our daughter (she drank milk and fresh lemonade) and relaxed, wrote, and drew to the smell of fresh roasted coffee.  Perfect way to spend an afternoon.

Came in here while on vacation for my birthday. Her artwork is amazing! I was so very excited walking through her gallery. Pamela is a warm, outgoing, and easy to speak with artist. Her passion for what she creates definitely shows. Will be back the next time that I am in town.

This was honestly the most unbelievable experience of my life. I got connected with Capital City through El Ada, a company that helps low-income people replace their ACs and furnaces. My swamp cooler was rusted out, and the motor was burning. I was desperate because I have severe medical issues that make it really hard for me to thermoregulate. I get overheated easily, can pass out in the heat, get migraines, and...well I'll spare you the gory details. Suffice it so say I was put at the top of the heap to get a replacement swamp cooler. 

Capital City came out and the guys were really nice. They threw my old unit off the roof and said it was days before the pan would have collapsed and flooded my house. They installed the new swamp cooler and there was an unbelievable grinding and clanking, that shook the whole trailer. They kept trying to fix it, but I was certain that would blow out the motor. I called CC nearly in tears. Michael's wife was so understanding. She told me to call the foreman, Max on his cell. When I told him what was going on, he bustled right over. He told them to quit trying to mess with it and said it had a bent shaft. It took a week for that part to come in. My poor cat almost died because it got too hot one day that I left him alone. Thank God the emergency vet is right down the street from me! They had left me a portable window AC and so I started locking my animals into my bedroom with it running. 

The new shaft finally came in and it ran for a few minutes. Then the motor burned out, as expected. They went and got the new motor, and the thing was working ok. But it stayed around 85 degrees in my house, even when it was only 10-15 degrees hotter outside. It wasn't blowing enough to feel 10 ft away. I knew something wasn't right. I spoke to Floyd and he told me he ordered one that was twice as big. That was incredible! So I was getting upgraded for all the problems. The new unit came in and was installed. The motor kept shutting off as soon as we turned it to high cool. Finally they called in an electrician, Robert. He wired in a new circuit to run the unit. We thought we had fixed the problem. But the motor wouldn't run the unit! 

Almost a week goes by and they install a new motor. It's not working. I'm about having a nervous breakdown and crying to the neighbor. I just can't be without AC! Robert was told to come out to see if the switch was wired wrong (it was!). Easy fix. I was told the service tech supervisor, Michael was coming out. I was so glad it was being elevated to someone who could make sure everything was right this time! When he got here, I thought he was one of the most charismatic people I've met. In fact, I called him "Mr. Personality". I told him that Robert had just figured out the switch was wired backwards and gotten it running.  Unfortunately, that wasn't the case. The motor burned out again and Robert couldn't get it working. What's more, putting in the new circuit made the thermostat unusable. Without the ability to control the temperature, I could still get really sick. 

I imagine about now you are wondering why I gave this 5 stars? Michael took one look at my face, and realized I was about to cry, went into my bedroom with Robert, under the pretext of looking at the breaker panel, and proceeded to have a whispered conversation about me. Before I could get indignant about being talked about, Michael comes back and says that he is a God-fearing man and believes that all this is happening because God wants me to have central air. He actually offered to install a unit at an amazing deal. It was so amazing that my jaw was in my lap and I stared like an idiot. I told him no way because I was afraid he would get fired. Well that wasn't going to be a problem because it turned out that Mr. Personality owned the company! Robert even agreed to donate his time to getting the high voltage installed in it. I'm not sure, but I think some of the guys (I think I know them all by now!) may have pitched in too. 

God still lives in the hearts of some. I'm so humbled. Thank you.

As senior Philadelphian, I started going to the Reading Terminal when I was a kid, and that was 70+ years ago.  Nothing much has changed except the signs have gotten more modern and the food better and multicultural. You visitors to the Convention Center, forget the fancy resaurants.  Walk accross the street and roll up your sleeves.  A lot cheaper too!

I don't think this park is that special. The trees are pretty spectacular, but that is it. It is a very long paved path around the park. I think I would have to visit it again. I was pretty exhausted; my sister tired me and my brother-in-law out! We walked everywhere!!! I hope I get to enjoy the park as much as the other reviewers.

I've been coming to foxy nails for any nail service since I've been in high school! They are always able to squeeze me in for any last minute appointment! The salon is clean, the staff is personable, friendly, and I always leave feeling satisfied and happy with my service. 

Thank you Don for always taking care of me! You're amazing and make my engagement ring even more beautiful with your great work!

We had dinner here on Saturday evening. The food was excellent as was the service. The flavors were spectacular. I had a dish with beef and vegetables along with the roti appetizer. Both were lovely. The Thai Tea was also amazing. We finished the meal with Mango Sticky Rice! I am so glad to have this establishment as a part of the Collingswood Restaurant scene.
I have had many meals at Donatello's....always outstanding! Last night, Beth and staff did an amazing job with service and food which made for a memorable evening.

This might be my favorite restaurant in Santa Barbara. We go here for special occasions all the time and it's my go-to for birthdays and anniversary's or graduation celebrations. My younger brother and dad both like the different pizzas and pastas. My mom loves the risotto. I have tried and enjoy the two different filets and pastas but my favorite is the salmon dish.

The staff are always courteous and knowledgeable. They know a lot about their wines and pairings, but my go-to drink is the blood orange greyhound. It's strong and delicious!! I could not rave about this place enough. Get their special cheesecake for dessert and you won't regret it. This place is truly a local's favorite.
Mixed. Dr armaghani was amazing. I can't praise him enough. This review is not about him. It's about how much this place tries to gauge you:
Great gym with friendly coaches!  We have been other places in town and my daughter is happiest here.  Would definitely recommend to any family in the area.

Tim Anderson knows our E350 Van intimately.  Not only is it a bitch to work on, it has the infamous 6.0.  T & A has kept this vehicle from being very expensive lawn art!  From overhauling the engine the way it should of been built by Ford to an ATS transmission and multiple bigger & smaller jobs on it...they have kept it going down the road!!  
Yesterday we had to have it towed into T & A's shop with a bad coolant leak...not only did they find the problem quickly but found the part, fixed it and got us back on the road that afternoon!!
Thank you so much James!!!  T & A's whole team are awesome guys!!  I cant really put into words how much these great people mean to us but they're just really like family!! 
Thank you all so much for always doing such great work!!  Thank you Tim, Paul, James & Virginia & all the rest of the T & A team!  We'd NEVER go anywhere else!!! 
These guys know diesels...we highly recommend them!!

I like this Walgreen's because its not like the giant, new stores you see on every street corner these days, but more of the old school neighborhood store type motif. The employees are nice, the selection is good enough, and the location is convenient to my house. 

My only problem is with the Walgreen's/Blue Cross issue... we used to get all of our prescriptions here, but had to switch to Rite-Aid when Blue Cross dropped Walgreen's as a provider. I REALLY hope they reconsider and fix this problem because I hate Rite Aid! 

BOTTOM LINE: Quaint little neighborhood pharmacy. Doesn't take Blue Cross :(
Very good hospitality and service. Only went for drinks, but the food smelled really good. Loved all the choices of craft beer.

I live right around the place from this taco joint and I haaad to check it out! Someone recommended it to me and I'm glad they did. 
They have all the Mexican you could want and for an amazingly affordable price- especially for the girl on a serious budget. 
I got the pork and pineapple taco (my fav kind of taco). I loved it! 
Next time I am definitely trying the beef tongue! Or the chicken, avocado and cactus! 
Aaand they have Mexican soda! 
Great experience! All day long I have not been able to stop thinking about those tacos! 
Definitely going back soon!

Four of us went to Cielito last night and the experience was memorable. It is the most impressive venue in Santa Barbara and the service was spot on. We shared 13 small plates and everything was great. The bar features some very interesting cocktails and we tried quite a few.  We will be coming back soon and often.

A great dining experience at Sapore tonight with my family!!!  I was a bit nervous about bringing my 7 and 9 year old with us to dine...but, was pleasantly surprised by the warm welcome we received from the owner (Paul) upon arrival and throughout our meal.

We were seated in a lovely secluded area near the bar area and were promptly attended to.  The kids both ordered spaghetti and meatballs (and fresh veggies).  The adults both ordered the Sea Bass Sicilian-style.  The food was delicious and so were the cocktails/wine!

With my gluten and dairy allergies, I am always nervous about Italian cuisine.  Not here, they prepared everything perfectly!

Looking forward to going back to Sapore soon!!

we needed a place to stay in Reno that would allow us to bring our 4 dogs.  thats right, 4 dogs.  they have a pet policy (a document to sign) but asked no questions as to the number of dogs, size or weight of the dogs.  they provided a wonderful pet area, grass section, poop bags, etc.  the room was clean and we were never bothered by hotel staff.  i even brought on of my dogs to the lobby to pick up the free breakfast for my husband and me...  i would totally recommend this place to dog owners.

We take our five yr. old bichon to Bayshore Animal CLINIC, not Hospital which is located nearby and easy to confuse.  I don't know anything about that one.  We started going to Dr. Stu after having problems at a couple of other vet offices.   He was so wonderful we didn't think anyone could live up to his expertise and bedside manner. I think half of South Tampa deeply mourned his early passing.  Fortunately, we found Dr. Newkirk who carries on Dr. Stu's tradition in a wonderful, caring way.   The office has actually gotten better with the addition of its own after hours care and a cool website where you can access information about your pet's visits, vaccination needs, and upcoming appointments.  Can't say enough about the good care we get for both the canine and humans.

I love this place.  I've been twice and had the biolift facial which I highly recommend.  I also purchased a cleanser, eye gel, and toner.  My skin has NEVER glowed so much or been so soft.  I cannot wait for my next visit.

The waitstaff need to seriously get it together. When I walked in the restaurant, no one greeted me. I stood there for a good five minutes getting completely ignored, and there was hardly any customers. I had to ask whether I needed to seat myself before anyone even acknowledged my presence. The hostess/waitress acted like she was super annoyed. The food wasn't even anything to rave about. Definitely will not be back here.

This place is awesome. I got my nails done by Andy and he did an awesome job, and never not even once was I hurt by him. My nails look amazing and are such a great shape (not uneven or crooked). Andy was also very sweet and funny. I will definitely go back soon, and I recommend you to go here as well:)
I have never been disappointed by the service, food, or atmosphere at Saloon. Every time I leave I am more than satisfied, and I always bring something home to enjoy later!

I recently bought a used bike on Craigslist. I haven't owned a bike since I was 12 years old, so I needed a bike lock and a helmet and all that stuff. The woman I bought the bike from suggested going to Trophy. I stopped in there about 15 minutes before they closed and they were super helpful. They told me which lock to get (Kryptonite, my bike friends agree), showed me how to use a cable to lock my wheels and even fixed the kickstand on the bike for free (it was too long).

They only had really expensive helmets when I was there, and I wanted a cheaper one, so they suggested Eastern Mountain Sports, where I did find one that fit my needs.

I expected them to be snobby bike people, but they were really helpful. I plan to come here again if I need to get my bike fixed or tuned.

This was my first time here and it will not be my last. I went for lunch. I had the Summer Rolls with shrimp and the Pad Thai. Both were good. The summer rolls were a chilled refreshing bite for this hot day. The Pad Thai was nicely seasoned and good. Be prepared for a decent amount of heat/spice with this dish. However, it's not overpowering. I love Thai cuisine and will make this a regularly rotating lunch destination for me. The staff is very pleasant and more than willing to answer questions. The kitchen will customize any dish to your liking.  I'm anxious to try other dishes.

Coming from a household that frequented Sam's Italian Market in Willow Grove, I've had hoagies and tomato pie in my hands since I could open my little Italian fist.  All I can say is, "See ya, Sam's Italian!"  Staff is awesome.  The Italian hoagie is way tastier than Primo's, and less than the cost of Subway.  The tomato pie is to die for.  I recently cut up and brought a tomato, spinach, and bruschetta to a family party (die-hard Sam's Italian folks for generations), and they all couldn't stop talking about how much better Corropolese was.  It was all gone in the blink of an eye.  The cookies are all very authentic and what you'd come to expect from an Italian bakery.  Couldn't be happier that Corroplolese came to town!

I absolutely adore Pet Play House! My doggie is so happy to go "play with his friends" and he always comes home happy and tired. PPG is a god send, I'm so grateful. The pups are always safe and well taken care of. 
We also boarded our pit mix, and he was very well taken care of-came home happy and healthy. PPH is highly recommended

So, my husband is first generation American with two *VERY* German parents, and a very German family, in general. We spent a few weeks last October traveling around Europe, including several days in Munich. We frequented many a beer hall (including the infamous Hofbräuhaus, which is essentially what Bavarian Bierhaus is going for), so we were excited (read: hopeful) to try this place!

Large open room atmosphere, great German decorations - loved the hops hanging from the chandeliers, as I remember seeing that in many restaurants in Munich - totally took me back! Bench seating, but they don't seat you with strangers, which honestly was part of the fun of the beer halls in Germany, but I get that we as Americans aren't generally used to that, lol. 

Service was nice, and menu was exciting - we saw several dishes we recognized from both my German mother in law's kitchen, and from our time in Germany. We ordered a pretzel and some bier cheese - the cheese is worth it! Really tasty. We also ordered two .5 L dunkel's, which were lovely and definitely tasted as they did in Munich.

I had intended to order the jägerschnitzel, as it's one of my favorite German dishes, but chickened out at the last minute, because I was terrified they wouldn't do it justice - especially the spätzle, haha. I was right to avoid it, but more on that later...I opted for the brats in a blanket, and my husband ordered the wurst plate, with a weisswurst and Oktoberfest brat, sauerkraut, and spätzle.

Food comes out, and my brats in a blanket are...hard. Overcooked for sure. The smoked brats had decent flavor, but just way overcooked. Fries were good, though! I dipped them in leftover bier cheese, totally recommend. My husband's reports on the wurst plate - weisswurst had basically zero flavor, very bland, but the Oktoberfest brat was good. Sauerkraut was sauerkraut, yay! 

Now, about the spätzle...it's from a package. Hands down. Like, the kind you can buy in the international section of your local Kroger. If you've ever had real spätzle, it's almost like a German dumpling and a noodle had a baby - they should be slightly dense, buttery, salty, and delicious. These tasted like...rubbery eggs. Really, really disappointing. I get that they're feeding the masses here but I make it at home from my mother in law's recipe and it's so simple to prepare, and 100x more delicious than the freeze dried stuff they're serving here. 

So...in conclusion. Come here for beers and a pretzel. Entree food was mediocre, at best. Service was great and prices were high, but eh, that's Opry Mills for ya. I might come back for that apple strudel, though...!

What a great experience I had recently at RPM!  This shop does an amazing job keeping you updated on the progress of your vehicle and when it came time to pick it up I expressed that I wasn't sure how I would get the car since my spouse was out of town and they even came and picked me and my toddler up from our home.  I am so happy to have a knowledgeable and quality shop to work on our Saab that's close by!

Five stars for the wings, one star for the service -- so we'll split the difference and call it three stars. 

We've tried most of the wing flavors but our favorite is bone-in Hermaican style. They've recently upped their prices but we still feel you get quite a bit of food for the price. We've also tried the deep dish pizza. While it was decent, it definitely isn't the best in the area. 

Service has been slowly going downhill for probably the last six months or so. We've had a different server every time we've visited the last five or six times. Poor time management and little to no people skills. We're rarely checked on even once during our meal, even if it's not busy. 

We'll be back because we love the first wings, but we'll probably get them to go.

A perfect Monday. 

In the mid 30s, sunny,  bright, marvelous crisp air.  

Lunch at The Wylder...*
The French picnic,  smoked turkey, brie, apple,  arugula,  fig jam,  house mustard.  Absolutely delicious.  

Paired with the Damn Skippy, the bartender's recommendation when I asked for an old fashioned. Peanut butter whiskey,  Rittenhouse rye, bitters.  Adjusted to be spicier and less sweet,  after a polite back and forth prior to ordering.  

Bliss.  Because living well is the best revenge. And you might get hit by a bus tomorrow.

PS: the True Grit: buffalo trace,  chili flakes, lemon, honey. Yup,  that'll do. 


*The Wylder is rapidly becoming my favorite restaurant downtown.   An excellent blend of a kitchen that knows what it's doing, a very well thought out menu, a great bar,  and a room with good energy.

An okay hotel not the best but i believe there are better ones around.
I used to come here every time i went with my family. I'm from San Francisco.  Probably my last time I came here was when I was perhaps like 12. I'm now 17. 
I want to try other ones but this one is alright. 
Might come back to this hotel if possible. 
I'm content with it and the little train too...haha

Checked on Yelp to make sure this place was open today (Sunday, around 2:30 PM). Drove up, and came to find the place boarded and locked up. Checked the front window for business hours because maybe they didn't get a chance to update their changed business hours online. Nope, says Monday-Sunday 10 AM- 7 PM. Yeah, if they can't handle the most basic part of running a business like communicating store hours to new & existing customers, they're not getting my business.

Just got back from Nepal, and discovered a Nepalese restaurant right here in St. Louis. Many of the same menu items we saw in the Himalayas. Images on the walls that were very familiar to us were good to see, and again, the menu items were right on. The only regret is that there was no beer available, and i was ready for an Asia brew with my meal. Maybe they were not yet licensed for alcohol. But I recommend supporting this family-owned spot with authentic food you can get nowhere else in town, as far as I know. Thanks, Yeti.

My husband and I were really excited about this location opening up close to us. We have been very disappointed with the lack of customer service, long wait in the drive thru and clarity of business hours. As good as their food may be, it's not worth it.

Dan was incredibly detailed and thorough. He patiently answered all of our first time home buyer questions. We scheduled the inspection that day before. With the short notice, US Inspect was available when other companies were not. Overall would recommend and would work with Dan again.

I've been here a couple times and every time I am happy with the food and service. The beer selection is outstanding, and it's a great place for the whole family.
The atmosphere is fun, load and enjoyable.
A great place to get a decent meal and enjoy a few beers.
I mean c'mon!!! Terrific bar service, lobster bisque and lobster grilled cheese is excellent! Football on the TVs , fun atmosphere. I'll definitely be back!

Super friendly and knowledgeable wait staff.  Stopped to buy a six pack take-out, bartender immediately acknowledge me despite being very busy.  Small brewing operation on site...nice addition to the airport.

Overall a great time. I started with a blue cheese salad that was very flavorful with fresh greens. The Chicken Parmesan was the main course and it was one of the best I've ever had. Lots of meat and not overrun with batter. Many people like there Parmesan really thin with lots of batter but than whats the point of the chicken? The sauce on the mash potatoes was tangy and unique over the top of more delicious veggies. I paired the dish with a Hefe  by Magma that was fresh and light, perfect for summer and served in a old wine bottle that had cleverly been cut into a pint glass (other micro brews available). The desert however wasn't what I wanted. Flaming tiramisu, the tiramisu itself was good but the sauce had a distinctive rubbing alcohol taste even after the flame burned itself out. I will return to Ricks Press Room and try one of their delicious burgers that walked past me a few times during my meal.

I have been wanting to try this place for a few months and I finally got the opportunity to tonight and I am so pleased with the outcome! I got jerk chicken with jollof rice, mac and cheese, and a side of plantains. Everything was so amazing! I ordered the food as soon as I walked into the restaurant and it was ready just over 5 minutes later. The staff was incredibly friendly and I can't wait to go back and try more dishes!

I had the regular gumbo and also the seafood gumbo and both are pretty good. I would be willing to get them again but I think I prefer a darker roux. I did have a cool hurricane dream is yellow and blue little smoke coming out of the top. The rice was fresh as well with the gumbos. Absolutely terrible picture outside, as I got both cups to go. They were very busy the past few nights and should probably say something about their food.

O. M. G. New favorite lunch spot. Think chipotle setup for Mediterranean food and then stop thinking. That's it, all there is to it! They have everything you need, freshly prepared, energetic service, and a great atmosphere to boot! 

I made my own bowl with basmati rice, chicken shawarma, onions, and tahini sauce with some falafel balls - I was so happy I could have just screamed. 

My husband got a pita and loved it and then the Naf Naf chips were the icing on the cake, yummmm. 

I really don't know what more I can say! Try it and then go back the next day!!

I am honestly not sure who these people are giving this place four stars.  So the manager comes over to us and says how this is the friendliest restaurant on the beach.  My father-in-law asks our waitress, who has a heavy accent, if she speaks Spanish or German.  Her response I speak English, if you need something translated I can get the manager!!!  Wow what a horrible answer and horrible service.  

Then the manager states that they are an authentic Greek restaurant.  I thought to myself, authentic Greek fabulous, let me get a Gyro.  I asked him about his gyro meat, the guy states that they don't have the gyro meat on a spiral. It is pre-made frozen gyro meat.  Seriously!  How can you say you are authentic Greek without a real Gyro.  

We should have left at that point.  Their food was greasy and lacked a lot of flavor.  The manager is a bit shady as well.  I would skip this place and go somewhere else.

Dinner ok was fair. Not great. Previous visit was pretty good. 

Wings. The skin was soggy. The crust was not crispy. The dry rub was not consistent. Some areas with none and some areas spicy. The carrots were not crisp. The cucumber yogurt was ok. The ranch is better. This was one of my top 3 wings place but I only had 3 and threw out the rest. 

BLT salad. Overall the salad was tasty but the bacon was soggy, not crispy at all. 

Berkeley thin crust. I like the toppings but the olive flavor was very strong and not very pleasant. Removed them. 

I will take a break from here because the recipes seemed to have changed and it's no longer my favorite.
I'm visiting from out of town and needed some juice. This place was great! Super friendly and helpful. Excellent juice selection! Will definitely be back when I visit:)

This location has ONE very slow employee with a lazy attitude "assisting" a line of about 30 customers. Comcast is garbage customer service and I can't wait for google fiber to arrive and put all of these piece of shit ISP's out of business. Enjoy the monopoly while you can, and fuck your self Comcast.

I really want this place to do well in the historic downtown but it just never seems to change or improve. Draft never works when I'm there and the AC just does not keep up. Bathrooms smell horrible and the feces smeared on the wall of the men's bathroom stall was the last straw for me. Bartenders are friendly and the food is excellent, but it needs more basic effort in improving/cleaning the place.
It's nice to have a sushi place so close to home. The selection is pretty good for a place that's way out here in the middle of nowhere.
Oysters were AMAZING!!! They gave us a fresh warm loaf of bread. Also the barbeque shrimp were really good.

I came here for dinner and enjoyed the Devour Indy menu. I was a little disappointed that I couldn't mix and match the taco choices because there were several tacos that I wanted to try. I decided to go ahead and get the Pork tacos. I couldn't decided between the corn and the potatoes for the side so I got both of them. I enjoyed the tacos and both sides. I also enjoyed the guacamole. For dessert I got the Riz Au Lait. I had not clue what it was but I wanted to try something new. I was not a fan. It has the consistency of rice pudding. Other than my dessert I enjoyed the whole meal.

This was another place we tried via Groupon.  It was OK, like other reviewers have said there's nothing really special that makes me want to go here over other burger places.  The ordering method is also inefficient, you have to wait in a line to order at the counter which really backs up when more than 3 people are in line.  Then your food is brought out to you...however if you wanted another drink you'd have to get back in line.  It's like the place can't decide if it wants to be more like fast food (though good quality) or a sit down restaurant.  Glad we tried with a Groupon, will probably not be back.

We were late getting into Nashville and wanted somewhere to eat dinner and have a good time. Wild horse was definitely that place! The food was great and the dancing was even better. In between dancing they have wonderful performers that make dinner nice as well. It's the best of both worlds. Very clean and nice. We will definitely be returning on our next trip!

Don't buy a car here. Go to another VW dealership if you want a VW. I had THE WORSE experience I have ever had. So I spoke to Jeff, who had nothing to say but sorry you had a bad experience. I WILL NEVER BUY HERE AGAIN NOR RECOMMEND ANYONE TO.  You trust a business, get screwed, and it's sorry about your luck it was your fault. There is NO accountability here, stay away.

As I mentioned before we visit this restaurant very often but I'm getting worried about this place we like to drop by. About 6 weeks ago I found a hair in my food and today when I got the utensils the fork was not cleaned and was greasy and had some food and the knife also had dried out food. The pork chops that we always order was very dry and hard not as we are used to, nice and juicy. Another problem with this place is the air conditioning which just doesn't seems to get fixed or at least it is not working as it should. This is not only very hard for the customer to sit there and eat in a hot and humid restaurant but also I'm sure for the employees who must suffer in the heat there. If the temperatures outside hit the mid twenties it is getting uncomftable there. For people with heart problems or if your body doesn't function to well in a hot room, this is not the place to visit at hot days. So I hope they fix the airconditionig to make it comfortable for everybody. Oh and maybe they could paint the railing outside at the back, that would look much better than too. All said and done, the service of the staff is always 5 stars for us for sure.

Best Thai ice tea hands down. Most places make it overly sweet and it ruins it. Also, if you type Spudnuts into your iPhone it'll take you to another Spudnuts (I made this mistake and ended up at the one off Hollister which is just awful so make sure you type Spudnuts and Bagels). The lady at the counter is so sweet at this one and the donuts look so fresh. This place is a gem.
First time here and I will definitely be back! Best massage ever! Katerina was perfect!  The hot towels and stretching was a nice added touch.

First off, had this been written a couple of years ago, it would have been easily five stars. 

The previous executive chef had a large, varied menu with a ton of absolutely delicious dishes, including a carrot basil bisque which I tried the first time I went there, expecting to hate it, and ended up ordering it every time I went after that - which was usually a few times a month. 

But things change, and change fast in the restaurant business. Shortly after the old chef left (which was about two years ago IIRC), I had gone back craving the restaurant I had grown to love only to find that everything (on the menu at least) that I loved had been taken away. It was like waking up next to your long-time S.O. one morning and discovering that she had been replaced by Janet Reno. 

I tried to stay optimistic after learning that my beloved bisque would no longer grace my palate and seeing that the former novelesque menu had been reduced to a single page (it may have grown more since then). However when the roast chicken that I had ordered arrived far too dry and with none of the flair I had come to expect from Bella Brava's dishes, I knew that it was time to file for divorce from my favorite restaurant. 

I've heard some good things since then and really hope they've improved themselves but I haven't been able to bring myself to make it back there again yet.

I love Chianti's clareview....all their pastas are amazing, they have all kind of combinations and they can always modify or add your favourite ingredients to your meal.....also Mondays And Tuesday they also have pasta specials....service its great

the appetizers yum yum i have tried them all and love them!

My sister and I checked into this hotel today and  checked out five minutes after entering our room. We were aggressively approached by a gangster smoking weed in the parking lot, and frantically locked ourselves in the room. He waited with his shirt off outside of our room taunting us. Luckily there is a back exit in the room that leads back to the lobby that we used safely. I've never felt as threatened as I did checking into this hotel today. As a young woman I was horrified by the lack of security. An establishment like this should not be responsible for anyone seeking a place to stay for the night. Keep yourself safe and stay away. P.S. We did take a look around our hotel room while we were there; unmade bed, black hair in the shower, broken window blinds, crusty stains on the desk chair. Felt like we were on a movie set.

While this a Mexican restaurant, it's not a typical Mex place at all. They have three bar areas, with inside and outside seating. The frozen margaritas are large (18oz) and have a pretty fair amount of alcohol in them. We started with chips, salsa and queso dip. The chips were light and fresh and still warm. While the chips and salsa are bottomless, the queso is not and comes in a large bowl. Four of us shared it and that was plenty for the table. Everyone got something different and we were all very happy with what we got. I got the burrito grande with chicken. It also had black beans, lettuce, red peppers and cheese. It was well seasoned and very filling. It came with two sides. I got corn bread and their special corn on the cob. The CB was sweet and just a little crisp. It was very good and I found myself wishing it were a larger portion. The corn on the cob was covered with a cheese sauce that had just a little kick to it. It was excellent and I see why it is one of their best sellers. Don't come here thinking this is some cheap, lots of food Mexican place. Yes, you will get lots of GOOD quality food, but it is not cheap. However, the old saying "You get what you pay for" is definitely in play at Hablo Taco. We will be back to enjoy the WHOLE ENCHILADA.

The Grouper was a wonderful.  As was the Scalibut.  Both the entrees were fantastic.  The BBQ shrimp and grits, were a little overrefined.  Sometimes you can over polish a rustic dish and lose some of what makes it unique.  

The service was outstanding.  Our server knew the menu inside and out and even knew we needed reading glasses when we had forgotten ours, before we even asked.  The service was VERY good.

Cute clean restaurant. I got take out and the owner was super nice and friendly when we came to pick it up. He offered some recommendations for next time!

The food was so fresh. I got sesame chicken, it was real chicken! Chunks of chicken that were so fresh I was very happy! Could use a little more breading on the chicken. They gave you broccoli as well that was fresh not frozen. Overall the food quality was great and surprisingly felt very healthy. Can't wait to try something else!

Second review, 

After my last review of this particular Steak N Shake, I decided to try again months later. Still, nothing has changed and in fact, it has become a lot worse. This establishment didn't have pop available at all, which really isn't that big of a deal, the cream for the coffee was expired noticeably due to the cream separating in the coffee which is exactly what cream will do if it has gone bad. 

There were so many dirty tables with dishes still at them that therr were no clean coffee cups at all here so we had to use styrofoam cups which are not at all environmentally friendly. There was only two servers in total for a rather busy morning. 

Reports came out that Steak N Shake has closed several restaurants until further notice. I believe that this location should be one of them. There needs to be better training and staffing to properly run this establishment. Upkeep is very important as no one should see an abundance of dirty tables when they walk in. Wait time to seating was close to five minutes as we had a crowd of people behind us. 

Steak N Shake needs a total revamp of its diner. The "to be seated" area is in too close proximity of the door as well as checkout making it a nightmare for traffic. The two areas need to be separate from each other so that people are not waiting right by the entrance/exit. 

The only good thing I can say about this is the food. The food was good. It doesn't take a rocket scientist to make eggs, bacon, hash browns, toast, burgers and etc. However, just because the food is good does not excuse everything mentioned above and I hope that Steak N Shake will take this review into serious consideration.

I used amenity housekeeping for the first time and they did a really good job. Yira and team of 2 were very nice and asked questions as needed, but worked quietly and they were very thorough. I recommend giving them a try.

I haven't gotten any services here, but I came for a consultation and it was a friendly, and also somewhat strange, encounter. Dr.Anu seems like a very honest person! 

I made an appointment, confirmed via text, and drove to the office. During the pandemic, you're required to call when you arrive and they'll let you into their space. I called, they said they had tried to reach me to see if I wanted an online appointment instead and if I'd rather do that. Was very confused because I was literally asking them to open the door for me, standing AT THEIR OFFICE. They let me in, but it felt like they didn't want me there. 

When I got there I waited like 3 minutes (I think I was the only customer) for the doc to see me. My consultation was on laser hair removal but dr.anu quickly let me know I was not a good candidate (apparently you have to be super hairy with thick dark hair). It was literally a 5 minute interaction and then I left. On one hand I nearly felt it a waste to have come to the office, but on the other, I appreciated that she was honest and didn't try to sell me on anything. 

I'd say based on the consultation alone, I didn't really find this place comforting or friendly at all. However, it might have just been because of the pandemic? They offer a lot of spa services and definitely were the most responsive out of the multiple med spas I called. Their prices seem fair and they also had the best reviews, so I'd still recommend giving this place a try.

Will never stay here again...can hear everything in your rooms - neighbors, maids yelling down the hall etc.  room service quick but food not good.. Room service coffee tasted like chocolate. Maid walked in on us even though we had do not disturb sign on the door. We come to new Orleans about twice a year.  Stayed here because of CIA trade show and company booking. Co chose this hotel because it is cheap.  We are moving to Windsor court today for the next three nights.  A hotel can make or break your stay here.  This one was definitely a downer. packing to leave now thank God
Fantastic friendly service. Had the curry chicken lunch special. Large portions; very tasty.  Very affordable. Would definitely recommend this place.

DO NOT GO HERE!  I paid for a tire rotation, only to realize the next day that the tires had not been rotated.  I know because there was paint on the front passenger side tire when I fought it in, and that tire was in the same location the next day.  When I tried to resolve it, I was treated terribly. They had the nerve to deny that there was a problem.   I cannot stress enough how badly this place works
Stopped here for breakfast after a night out in Philly (pre covid). This place was so cute and the staff was attentive. The yogurt parfait was delicious and I really enjoyed the orange pancakes.

Don't go there within I would say an hour of closing. Quickly dismissed my child as even the nurses.expressed they just wanted to go.home. they were nice to my 3 year old but medically did a very rushed poor job despite her pain and temp over 104.5 for 5 days.

We were in a bind as we had just moved to Reno and did not have our friends close by  to dog sit. We had a 2 week vacation planned and had never left our dogs in any type of a dog care business. 

The team at Bow Wow camp did a fantastic job and deserve a 6 star rating. I cannot say enough in regards to the care our dogs received. Plus, an added bonus for us, Toby was nervous/scared around other dogs due to being attacked as a pup. They worked with him and he is now more comfortable around other dogs which was a major breakthrough for us! 

We were extremely nervous leaving our dogs but found an excellent place and highly recommend Bow Wow Camp!

Tim and Deb Stansell

The best Joann I've ever seen. They are HUGE and have an incredible inventory! Love the knitting, jewelry, and baking sections especially, since those are my hobbies. Checkout lines can move slowly, but that's really the only drawback.

Truly, truly, truly outrageous. The cake donuts are rich and almost as buttery as a great croissant, the raised donuts have a delightful subtle crisp on the very outside, and rich, fluffy soft and delicious flavor throughout. 

Only criticism is the raspberry filling is way basic and lacks flavor (Krispy Kreme's raspberry filling is way better, with some actual tangy, sweet berry flavor, as a point of reference), but the donut surrounding it more than made up for it. 

Highly recommended.

I highly recommend using Generation 3 Electric. Chad came over this morning to help me fix some outlets I messed up installing my backsplash, and to fix my fan/dimmer switch I also managed to botch. He was very thorough, explained to me what I did wrong, and most importantly the visit cost a fraction of what I thought. He even gave me tips on how to do things better in the future. I highly recommend this company. They are honest and do a thorough job. I will personally be giving their number to all of my friends who need any electrical work done. As a side note, I have dealt with all different kinds of people since I purchased my house a year and a half ago. I am a single female in my mid twenties and most of the contractor type people I have dealt with I wouldn't use again. Chad was polite, treated me with respect, and was dressed well. This shows how their company goes above and beyond. 

Use this company, you won't regret it.

Cute place. Nothing special. 

The only interesting donut I saw was a maple syrup and bacon one, which in hindsight, I absolutely should have had.
Friendly service and good value at this neighborhood taco stand, salsa bar is fresh, everything I've tried is good. Same owners as Ruiz Dogs
Shay was super awesome and everyone was really great. The course was fun and the spinners are amazing!!!

I am new to the area and went online to find a vet near me with good reviews. I called to schedule an appointment and they were able to accommodate me right away. When I arrived, the staff was friendly, welcoming and the place was clean. They took an interest in my little guy and his special needs. The vet tech made copies of all of his records and asked me questions to be clear on what his needs were before speaking with the Vet. When the Dr. Montor came in, she was friendly and had been told all of what my pet needed already. They were genuine and helpful, and I didn't feel like I was being 'upsold' on any products or services. They offered things that were directly relevant to the questions and concerns that I had. I would recommend 4th St Pet Hospital. Melanie

I've visited this location several times and I've even written good reviews on how good the service was, however today not so much. I called to order a carry out and was placed on hold for about 2 minutes then the line was disconnected. I thought "it happens no big deal, they must be really busy ". So I called back after a few minutes and the line was busy, so I called a few more times until I got through. I placed my order and went to the restaurant fir pick up. While there I realized that they weren't busy at all, but what I did notice is that they intentionally take the phone off of the hook to make the line busy so they don't get calls. Which to me is a poor process and a way to lose business. I also saw one of the employees scratching his back with his bare hands then he proceeded to ask me if I had been helped. He didn't wash nor sanitize his hands he just walked into the kitchen area. Thankfully they already were bringing my order out otherwise I would have canceled my entire order. This visit has made me reconsider ordering from here in the future.

Just moved to Indy and chose to have this as our inaugural feast here as it was walking distance to our place. We were greeted warmly with complementary champs on the cute outdoor patio. Both our sommelier and waitress were very knowledgeable about the wine and food menus. Although the menu is small, it has the right combo of veggie and meat dishes to please any crowd. We loved the mushroom sticky buns and squash noodles. They do a great job of mixing unique flavor combos. Their menu changes every 2 weeks, which is awesome! We will definitely be regulars!!

Loved it!!! The rides were scary and fun! We're def going there again next year! FYI: the vip tickets are expensive but we'll worth it bc we didn't have to wait in any lines! The whole thing was great!

I come here mainly for their grab n go summer rolls and whatever else I feel like snatching away from the deli counter. I love it so. The rolls are stuffed to the max with fresh goodness and inexpensive.  
I'll also eat here late-night if I'm in the mood or if Pho 75 is closed.  They make a great Pho, and their takeaway style works great so I can have everything separated and ready to assemble when i get home without the noodles going mushy or beef getting hard.

Bluebird Car Wash has all the extra bells and whistles needed to get your car as clean as possible! The complimentary microfiber towels, dash wipes, strong vacuums, compressed air and a really cool auto mat wash and dryer is what makes this place 5 stars! I've never been to an express car wash that offers as much as Bluebird does! 
The auto mat washer works by pressing the green button and then placing your car mat in so that the rotating gears roll it through the washer. It took me a minute to figure it out on my own the first time but now this mat washing machine is one of the main reasons why I come here to wash my car! 
The compressed air gets all the dust and dirt out from those small cracks, I use it in tandem with the vacuum! It's really easy to be efficient in cleaning with all the supplies they offer here! 

Also, the staff is always so nice and helpful at all stages of the Bluebird car wash experience!

We stopped by this weekend.  We called to place an order but nobody answered so we decided to walk in.  It would have been nice if we could have called it in, but once we got there we noticed only one person was working the counter and cooking so that's why they probably didn't have time to take phone calls.

Love the decor!  Seating in the front and it looks like there is a patio in the back.  Location is nice.  We paid meter parking and it wasn't hard to find a parking spot.  It was ready in a reasonable time (30 minutes).  

The food was ok.  Mac and cheese was good.  The beef ribs weren't as flavorful as expected.  The stuffing was to crumbly.  It was in little pieces so it was hard to eat with the fork.  The fried chicken was delicious.  And the salmon cakes were pretty good.  Most of the food had a little too much salt for our liking.

I think I would try it again.  It wasn't out of this world type of good, and they didn't have everything on the menu (pork ribs, greens, etc).  But I would come back to try a few other things on the menu.

Joo Joo has one thing going for it that other Chinese and Korean restaurants don't--the late hours. My friend called me up late one evening with an Asian food craving and this was the only place open.

I ordered the yook gae jang (spicy beef soup with vegetables). The flavor was fine but the meat that they used was chewy and just really difficult to eat through. I don't think it was very good quality meat. I ended up giving most of it and just going for the vegetables instead.

They do serve a ton of banchan (the Korean side dishes) so that's a plus for them.

During your meal, if it's on the weekend and at night, you'll likely be serenaded by people doing karaoke. The karaoke prices are pretty fair so I wouldn't mind coming back at a later date to try the karaoke.

We had a terrible experience with this company. We got a mailer and booked a cleaning for our sofa and loveseat, and 5 rooms and a hall. I was quoted a price over the phone, $193.95. Jack arrived over an hour late (he did call, however) and introduced his wife who was helping him. My house is clean and our carpet is fairly new and in good shape. He proceeded to give me a half an hour sales pitch to upgrade to a cleaning that was DOUBLE the price. At this point, I was annoyed, but politely told him no, I was quoted this price and I just want the standard cleaning. He said "oh, he always does that" when referring to the previous quote I got. Then he proceeded to inform me that he will go ahead and honor that price but it's just the basic cleaning, and I'm probably not going to be happy with it. For $200? I'm not going to be happy with it?  Well....he was right. What I got was a basic run over my carpet with a wet vac....all the rooms and my couches in about 35 minutes. I had ONE spot that I asked him to try to clean on my carpet, of which he told me he would try, but it wasn't going to work. And it didn't. I ended up buying spot shot and it came out easily. He and his wife made comments while working in our home saying had we bought the better package, they probably could have gotten this better. How unprofessional. When he left, he informed me that he was headed back to Alabama and they had a long drive ahead of them. I'm not sure it makes economic sense to send a driver to Franklin, TN from Alabama for a $200 cleaning, so maybe that was why he was pushing me to upgrade so much. Poor job, unprofessional. I will never, ever use this company again.

I rarely write reviews, neither good nor bad, but you need to warned about Amie. See Stan M.'s review below . . . because he hit the nail on the head about her lack of customer service skills. Her business motto must be "The customer is always WRONG!" because that's how you'll be treated. The rest of these reviews must have been written by her friends because based on my experience Stan is right, Amie, the owner, is RUDE and HAS ZERO customer service skills.  If you want to be abused and verbally berated this is your place, otherwise stay far, far away from Amie Van Zant and Van Zant Auctions.

Why 2 stars? Same "Tampa Area Dunkin' Donuts" experience I've literally had at all Dunkin' Donuts including this one.

#1 I love the coffee here
#2 I love the donuts here

There, I did it.  Two stars.  As painfully as it may be this location along with just about every Dunkin' Donuts in Tampa is poorly managed, employees don't care about working, and service is slow as heck.  I don't know why Dunkin' Donuts settles for sub-par service, but it's just ridiculous that people keep coming back for coffee and donuts here.  Tables are dirty, literally no line except for drive through, yet no one cares about working here.  To the point that they are annoyed to even come to the cash register.  Come on managers!  Come on Dunkin' Donuts!  You're more than just Coffee and Donuts!  Step up to the plate and hire some people that have some semblance of management experience and employees that care about working and making the world a better place.  Is that too much to ask?  Or is it the same old "Time to make the donuts" attitude that you guys have?  In any case, I'll probably keep coming back because your ice coffee is an addiction I have, but seriously put at least a half smile on your face when your customers come in, you might gain a few more.
