Warren Smith

The mimosa deal here is unbeatable, 12 dollars for unlimited MONSTER mimosas until 3pm! They are very generous pours and portions. 
We stumbled in for breakfast around 11 and ended up leaving completely tipsy thanks to Meagan, our bartender. 
We ordered the pulled pork nachos, the crab and spinach omelette, and the eggs Bennie. The nachos come on pork rinds- I didn't realize.. I hate them!! But it's my fault I didn't read the menu properly. It was way too fatty for me but my boyfriend loved it. So just personal tastes.

This place has no atmosphere whatsoever, but the sushi is very high-quality. Kind of like if you went to fast food sushi, but it's not fast food. It feels like you're sitting in a storage room, but the quality of the fish was really good. I would go back.

Oh boy, where to begin with this one? How about: I just threw up Wiseguy in the toilet. It's not really Wiseguy's fault. Well kind of. Who knows?! I guess you'll just have to read on to find out.

This week, Tom and I are joined by our friend Austin: mac n' cheese connoisseur and pizza aficionado.

Don't really know much about Wiseguy and couldn't find anything online. It's a NY style pizzeria. They have two sections; the front does pizza by the slice and the back is more of a sit down pizzeria with bar and sports. I really appreciate that you can have both experiences. Nice atmosphere. Very hipstery, parts of it look like a pirate ship and other parts look like a wine cellar or some kind of medieval hallway.

Tom and I each ordered a drink, a pepperoni slice, and a specialty slice. I got Hawaiian, he got veggie. Austin ordered a single slice of their signature Wise Guy which is essentially a meat-lover's. Two big slices and a drink came out to $7-something which is a very reasonable price.

As we waited for our slices to heat up, we watched Metallica proceeded to play the national anthem at a hockey game.

Metallica on Ice: 1 shred out of 5

At some point we noticed our slices had not yet arrived which was a little strange. I jokingly said "he probably forgot about our slices and the whole pizzeria will catch on fire." As I say this, Tom sees the guy who put our slices in the oven walk nonchalantly into the room. Then he spots us, a look of alarm overtakes his face, and he runs back in the other direction. A few minutes later the guy walks back in and says, "Hey so your slices... they're a little crispy. I'm going to make another set but I forgot what you guys had." We say it's no problem and tell him we had 2 peps, 1 veggie, 1 hawaiian, and a Wise Guy. A few minutes later he is back again with 2 veggies, 1 hawaiian, and a Wise Guy. We tell him that's not what we ordered and he's just devastated. The guy is so nice that we can't really be mad at him. We finally get the correct order and dig in.

-Pepperoni-
Austin says the dough tastes like marshmallows. Tom and I look at him confused. Don't believe Austin, the dough tastes like regular pizza dough. The pepperoni and meat-lovers in particular are very crunchy. I like crunchy but I know most folks would say this is too crunchy. You couldn't fold it without it cracking and falling apart. Sauce is good. It's very Italian but there's very little of it. That cheese though. The cheese is just awful. It didn't seem to bother the others as much but to me it was just goop. It's like when you have leftover pizza and heat it in the microwave for not enough time so it's kind of melted but not enough and it's really oily. The peps are 'flat on it' style, not crunchy style. I'm more of crunchy kind of guy but peps will be peps.

-Veggie-
This is my favorite of the bunch and probably Austin's favorite as well. Tom doesn't like it much. The flavors are everything you expect from a veggie, strong taste of mushrooms, peppers, olives, and onions. That cheese though. AUGH.

-Hawaiian-
Some jalapenos for an extra kick, but really the jalapenos don't have any kick. Pineapple doesn't really have taste either. Canadian is very nicely cooked and tastes great. I would have preferred just the Canadian bacon.

-Wise Guy-
This had some good meaty flavors. Mushroom and sausage go well together. Good steady flavor but no thrills. After the first bite, you kind of know what you're eating and you're just eating more of it. And that cheese. Oh that cheese. Cheese Louise amirite?

-Verdict-
So when we left Tom and Austin were adamant that this place was really bad. I was more on the mediocre portion of the spectrum. Their argument was that it's downtown, there are at least a couple places that are better and just a few blocks away. My argument was that it was cheap and it wasn't that bad. I was ready to give this place 3 slices.

Then the vomit.

It was hot, I had a headache, and pizza is not the best food to eat in these conditions. That being said, the pizza really didn't help. It was greasy and oily. I might have been more motivated to keep it in, had the pizza tasted better. I guess that doesn't make sense because if it tasted really good, then throwing up would kind of let me taste it a second time? So maybe if it tastes really good, then throwing up is actually a compliment?

Nah, it was bad. This actually brings up an important point about food that we didn't consider in the other reviews. You should feel good after eating it. This is the place you go to when Guido's and Pie Hole are closed for the day.

1 slice out of 5

[EDIT: Originally 2/5]

My boyfriend and I brought our two dogs in after they got their shots for a treat. We were the only customers in the store. We had planned to get them treats from the display case, but the two ladies working were too deep into their own conversation to even ask if we needed help despite us standing there waiting for a long time. Super disappointing service. We definitely won't be returning to this location. We left and took them to Three Dog Bakery in Broad Ripple and received excellent and kind service, as always.

I've now had my third haircut here and my hair looks good freshly cut and continues to look great for at least 4-5 weeks. I'm not the kind of guy looking for a cocktail bar, a stogie, or a beautiful young something to look at who is not an experienced barber. Yes, those options are available in NashVegas, but for cripe sakes - I just want a REALLY good cut, neck shave, and be out door in 30 minutes for less than $30 (that includes the $5 tip)! If your a practical dude who likes to look good without all the sideshow crap, Red's is your kind of place. I highly recommend James and Rob. Oh, and Jim will you ensure you get a refreshing bottle of water or a cup of good coffee.

We have had an excellent experience at Extra Space Storage. The staff is very professional, knowledgeable, and friendly. The property is extremely clean. The pricing is completely reasonable as well. I can't imagine ever wanting to store anywhere else based on my experience here. I feel like we got lucky in finding Extra Space Storage! If you need to store items, this is the place to go. They also don't require a contract - it is month to month. So, short term or long term, check them out!!

I was pleasantly surprised at how delicious and filling the food was. I am a proud omnivore and I was initially a bit apprehensive about having all vegetarian meals.  The atmosphere is quite cozy and romantic but casual so it would be a great date spot.  The waiter recommended 2-3 dishes per person which turned out to be a perfect portion.  It was like having vegetarian American Tapas.  Food was delicious, the wait staff was awesome, the food came out super quick and the cocktail was refreshing and delightful.  I will definitely be coming back.

Genuinely shocked at the reviews at this place. It was crazy overpriced for the lack of flavors and portion size being so weak. Actually that's the best way to describe this place; weakkkkk. My soup was literally like half a ladles worth of soup, and honestly lubys does a better job with the cucumber salad. Most assuredly not worth returning.
Great place for beer and food. I HIGHLY recommend the Blueberry Cider. If you hungry, go for the pork schnitzel and potatoes. The cider and schnitzel pairing is AMAZING!

I am proud to have my name attached to a scathing review of a sub par over-sensationalized "restaurant". After waiting 2+ hours in line we were served dry and cold food. The meats tasted like they picked them out of the dumpster out back and put them on a fancy plate. The only reason they have fancy plates is probably to distract you from not only the food, but the lingering smell of sulfur coming from the kitchen.

Yum Yum yum. The Metropolitan Bakery is in a great location. My friend introduced me to this place. I walked over on a weekday to have lunch with her. Whenever I eat out, I like to order something that I wouldn't be able to just make at home. The MB menu has many unique tasty options that fill that requirement! 

I love being able to pick up food from here to eat outside at in their outdoor seating. Rittenhouse Square is super close so I expect that next time I go when it is warm I'll perhaps eat there.

I also appreciate the cups and the water they have available for customers.

Only reason I am giving this location a One-Star is because they signed me up for an additional membership without my permission and then signed the electronic confirmation form for me as well. Luckily my Credit Card hasn't been charged but this is super shady and unacceptable. Luckily Snap Fitness corporate doesn't take complaints about their franchises, nevertheless, it's unacceptable for a company to assume I am still in need of their service and then proceed to sign documentation with my personal information attached without my consent. Very unprofessional and I would not recommend anyone using this location as their go to gym, regardless of the location.

When going to a restaurant next door, we happened upon this place and they weren't open yet.  After eating next door, we stopped in to order their Banh Mi sandwiches.  I ordered one tofu and one eggplant and mushroom to go.  They were very hot when we got them which is a change from the norm but very delicious and I think the only way to serve the eggplant one would have to be warm, I can't imagine it cold. Very good flavor and we will return, there were other items on the menu that I'm ready to try.

Is it a restaurant? Is it a nightclub? Is it a hotel? This place is so confused with its identity...it's not even funny. When you walk in the first thing you get is the stench of dirty carpet, yeasty beer, and an overall uncleanliness. The only reason I didn't turn around and walk away was because we had a fantasy football draft. We called ahead of time and were advised by management that we would have a private room and a 20% discount on our tabs. We get there, no private room because it is under construction and at the end of the night we were told that the discount was only for food....disappointing when those expectations were not set during the phone call. Our food and drinks were good and of course we had a good time because we were with friends. I won't be back though under any circumstances.

Is David Berg a Chiropractor or Insurance Salesman? I'm not entirely sure. I was a little leery about going to a chiropractor that also sells insurance. That being said, it become clear that my suspicion was all too real. He spent a total of 20 seconds adjusting my back after putting some heat on it for 10 minutes. He literally had me twist back and forth twice, touch my toes and that was it. I have been to several different chiropractors in my life across multiple states and never have I had so little time spent actually making adjustments. And to add to this review, I spoke to another poor individual that went here trying to get help and had the same 20 seconds spent on him. How can you be an excellent Chiropractor if the other half of your professional life is selling over-priced insurance premiums? Well thats exactly it; you get half the treatment. I have now spoken to several "patients" of this chiropractor and they have all expressed a very similar story of how he put heat on their back, spent 20 seconds on two "cracks" of the back and sent them on their way with a promise to return 3 times a week. Mr. Berg does not utilize a single adjustment tool or adjustment table and has a one size fits all approach to different individuals with different issues. After two adjustments, if you can call them that, my suspicions were further emboldened by a "thank you" card I received in the mail from North Valley Chiro. It never fails with these guys that try to make as much money as possible in their young professional lives by selling insurance, trying to be a chiropractor and being a real estate agent on the side. Inside the Thank You card there was a business card for his Allstate insurance office, a business card for his wife's real estate business and a card for his chiropractic office; one big sales pitch/advertisement in the guise of a thank you card. Bottom line, the man sells insurance for a company that has exorbitant premiums higher across the board with all things being equal with other companies, provides sub-standard chiropractic work and follows up all customers (not clients) with sales pitches and advertisements. Mr. Berg is a successful entrepreneur and businessman looking for numbers, and for that reason you should stay away from his chiropractic work and insurance premiums. I would stay clear of the insurance company he works for, the chiropractic services he provides and go to specialists that have devoted their lives to one discipline, which is hopefully not business.
the broth in their soup is tasty, but their matzoh balls are crazy dense. like can be used as a weapon dense. that said i guess it's a good value because you fill up after eating 1/4 of one...

I was there for dinner on Thursday night for 1st time with my daughter and son in law who were here from our of town. It was their suggestion and I couldn't have enjoyed it more. Food was fresh and amazing, drinks were refreshing and the service was by far one of the best experiences ever. Our waitress Anna was amazing, knowledgeable, friendly and awesome. She really made our night. Please tell her about this review. Can't say enough about the great experience we had there. Will be back for sure. BTW I am an extremely picky eater and I loved everything the 3 of us ordered and we ordered apps to desserts. Loved it!!!!!!

You get a lot of bang for your buck here and the food is good . You're not gonna walking to see king crab legs everywhere but for $9 what are you expecting. It was quick and easy and fresh and I will definitely be back . I'm glad I found this place . 

They had a place like this similar where I just came from in Seattle so when I found this over here it felt like I was right back home . There's plenty of parking outside so you don't have to worry about that either .

Maybe it was an off night (not just me by looks of things) but I was unimpressed. Reading the other reviews and always up for a good Indian meal I thought it might be worth a try. It might be my preferences but I doubt I will return. The flavors lacked complexity in dishes that traditionally have more layered flavors.

I modeled as a teen in the 1966 era at a store called LEVY'S, that  later became GUS MAYER in Memphis, TN. IT was a great time because I met so many GREAT people and got to wear such exciting clothes. When I can get back to Nashville I will track down the GUS MAYER at the Green Springs Mall!"

Flavor wise Barcelona Tapas is probably one of the best Spanish restaurant I visited. The paella is well worth the wait, rice soaked in the flavor to perfection. In terms of tapas, I would say the only let down was ceviche, it's just not that special. But I highly recommend the calamari, it's so tender and juicy I was almost speechless. Lamb chop with fries was also great, the lamb was no doubt cooked to true tenderness. Just beware the so called one serving size paella is actually pretty decently sized, I would recommend only ordering one entree for party of 2 and enjoy more tapas.

The ambience and food was good.  But a little pricey for what you get.  We ordered the dumpling sample ($22 for 8 pieces) , the chicken and ginger dumplings ($16 for five)  and the crab and lobster dumplings ($16 or $18 for 4) to start.  They were pretty good but for the price I thought we would get more.  Next my husband had the miso black cod and I had the sweet walnut shrimp and we shared lobster fried rice.  The lobster fried rice was not worth the $24.  The lobster was dry and it didn't have any seasoning.  For dessert we tried the bento box.  Our total was $275.  Again, a bit pricey for what you actually get.

Food is average and unfortunately that's not acceptable for me at this price point. You're better off going to Maggiano's. Also, there was this girl with long hair who was hanging out by the food prep area in the kitchen. She didn't have her hair tied back and was whipping her hair around so dangerously close to the prepared dishes. It was really gross. I think she works there but was on break.

My mediocre rating is probably more due to my expectations than the venue. I was here on business many years ago. At that time is was very rustic looking with old wooden beams and a "barn dance" kind of atmosphere. Now that my wife and I are visiting the area I couldn't wait to take her back to see what I loved on that visit. Sadly, it isn't here anymore. My wife summed it up best when she said her impression of the decor was "cafeteria". We had a beer ($7) and left. We didn't order any food, so we can't comment on that. The band playing was not great, and wasn't playing any country tunes. Seems like Wildhorse isn't the place to go anymore for country music or a country feel.

In theory, this place should be amazing. I want to like it SO much but it's just impossible. I've been a handful of times (maybe 5 or 6) and I'm glad that the lines have finalyl gone down. Waiting 30 minutes for mediocre stirfry is not fun. Here are my opinions about this place.

1) It's inconsistent. Sometimes there is a lot of sauce with the stir-fry, sometimes theres not enough at all. Sometimes the sauce is thick, sometimes its watery. Sometimes it's spciy other times it's not. It's never what I actually want or expect.

2) I like to make my own stir fry.. It's $8 to start and you get a sauce, a starch and 3 veggies then they add on from there. But seriously, $8 for bbq sauce rice and 3 veggies?! For $8 I could make this for a family of 8! 

3) Stop pushing the smoothies on me. Dear lord, if I want one I'll order one. Put more effort into the stirfry and less with the smoothies, please. Maybe fire some smoothie people and lower the cost of a veggie only stir fry, how about that?

4) The salads are ridiculously expensive. I could never justify spending more than $7 on a salad from a 'fast food' place nevermind $11. That lettuce better have healing powers if I'm going pay that much to eat it..

Mike C. in sales gets five stars for being great!

The service department gets three stars for being mediocre.  I was really impressed at first, since they did (almost) everything right and were very quick.  However, at the end my car didn't get washed.  Isn't that why you go to a dealership to get your car serviced?  Because they go extra mile for you right?  They didn't because of weather. 

I didn't buy it because it was completely CLEAR outside, and it hadn't rained all day, nor was it going to.  It really shouldn't matter even if I decide to drive it in mud afterwards.  I certainly expect a level of service associated with how much I pay for an oil change and tire rotation.  One of the service ladies told me just to bring it back for a wash when the weather was nice.  Yes - because that is really convenient  to drive 30 minutes out of my way to Greenwood.

My coworkers have been telling about this place for ages. A hidden pizza gem in STL! Although it did take a while to get our pizza, it was soo worth it! We got the deep dish, what they're known for, with Canadian bacon, green peppers ans onions. There is a middle cheese layer just hot cheesy goodness with the perfect balance of everything! If you try this place go ahead and call in your order then head over so there is no wait time. This is the place where I've declared calories and fat don't exist, treat yo self!

Went here with my boyfriend to see dead pool. Service was horrible and inattentive! The server was friendly when he came to get our drink order. However, 20 minutes later, they bring my boyfriend a drink which he sips and finds out is completely the wrong drink. I noticed it meant to go to the man next to us so a food runner takes the drink and puts it at the bottom of the stairs on a table. When the man next to us asks where his drink was (I was listening), the server takes the same drink my boyfriend sipped on, the drink that was at the bottom of the stairs, and gives it to the guy! The guy said he saw the whole thing and the server brings back a new drink. Then I ordered nachos, my boyfriend orders a burger, but after they gave us the wrong food again, they bring us two nachos and his burger, which my boyfriend said whatever to and ate it anyways. I also asked for guac twice, which never comes, but was charged twice for it when the bill came. They did take the guac off. In addition, the food was cold! I pushed the button to order another drink and the server never comes, so I have to leave the movie and walk to the bar to get my own. When it's time for the bill, ingive the card to my server and have to wait until the movies over, and everyone's left, to get it back. Let's just say horrible movie, horrible service.

You can't get anymore in a retail store than this stores customer service. It is run very well and strong. You can tell the leader Mr. Stone, who I had the pleasure of meeting knows what he is doing. I cant wait for my house to look as good as their showroom
Great location. Had the sushi here. It was good but not the best in Saint Louis. The staff is nice and love the outdoor seating area.

Easy parking, very nice owners, we enjoyed the food we ordered  the sad part was the number of customers that came in unmasked. Owner of course didn't say anything because she wants her business to succeed, but apparently these customers don't.  Even if you don't believe in masks it's the way business needs to stay open. I hope these selfish people don't cause the owner grief.  If you want wonderful food go if you want to do it safely maybe order to go.

What a great eclectic place to stay!  Definitely not your run of the mill hotel!  Love the retro feel of the place as well as the art! The staff is very friendly and helpful and there to offer suggestions on fun places to visit or nearby restaurants.  The free oatmeal and coffee bar is a nice touch as well as the variety of pop tarts!  We will definitely be back!

Awesome breakfast place! Fresh brew coffee is amazing. I had the big breakfast. The hash browns were really deep fried potato chunks, not what I would call hash browns. But everything was very delicious.

There's not of lot of places in Vail AZ to eat unless you want to drive into town. It's a fixed food truck with an extended closed in patio. The food is cheap, good and she will tweak it to your liking. My daughter really likes their cheese enchiladas, breakfast burritos, and nachos. My favorite is the carne asada chimichanga enchilada style. They have daily specials and are not open on Sundays. They also close intermittently during the holidays.
Excellent food, service and atmosphere. Prices are low.My wife even loved the food even though she thought she wouldn't like Indian food.

I really love this place.  I am from San Diego, so i know all about Mexican food.  Mexican food is my favorite food and it is really hard to find good Mexican food in the South.  My bf showed me this place and I have been there a few times and it is pretty damn good.  I love the cheese dip, especially the second time I ordered it, it was spicy spicy yum yum.  The fajitas are amazing.  The chips and salsa are really good.  I love the bean burrito with sour cream, so good, cheap and a huge burrito.  The vegetarian is good.  The chicken rolled tacos are of the chain, with guacamole of course.  Quesadillas are great.  The only complaint I would have is that I don't like the red sauce.  It is very bland, it need a spicy kick to it even just a little.  It tastes like tomato sauce to me.  I love enchiladas and chile rellenos but the red sauce is not good, so I don't order those things here.  But luckily the menu is so big, I will find other delicious things.  They also have a great dessert menu.  Fried ice cream is bomb!  Good service, good atmosphere, great value, and great food.  I would recommend to anyone!
Amazing food and excellent service!!!! Currywurst is fantastic!!! The owner is so nice and everything is homemade!!! A St.Pete MUST!!

Olio E Limone came highly recommended by our bed and breakfast as a special place to celebrate my husband's birthday.
We had to ask four times for balsamic to use with the straight olive oil served with the bread. Finally got it;  my husband's appetizer was the special, scallops, whichnwere not cooked through and served in an overpoweringly spicy sauce. The veal scallopine was not prepared in the lemon and caper sauce as advertised and there were no artichokes.  Broccolini was good.  Spaghetti with dungeness crab and shrimp that I ordered was stingy on the shrimp - 1 small piece - and crab was scattered about in the dish and served in a sauce  so hot (cayenne?) it complete overpowered the delicate seafood.  Waitstaff didn't return once to ask how our meal was but we did get our water glasses refilled once.  We both returned our dishes at least half full and left without seeing the dessert menu. 
With all the wonderful restaurants to choose from in Santa Barbara, we will be foregoing any future visits to this restaurant.

Absolutely horrible experience. We were told the wait was 20-25 min. We sat there and after an hour still did not have a table. I went to the hostess who responded with "we are waiting for a five top". We went there with our three little kids and when we ask what the wait time is, it is imperative we know the actual wait time. Our kids were miserable after waiting an hour and still no food. We decided to cut our losses and we left.  Would not recommend to anyone with kids!
Was told there would be hot water during check in, never happened. Tv barely works. Room barely clean. Worst decision of the year so far.

I've been to this Newtown location three times and the Blue Bell location two times. It's really nice to have another breakfast place to go to in Bucks County but I was disappointed because I could not help comparing the dishes I had to the ones I had enjoyed in Blue Bell.  Blue Bell's portions for the same dish was a lot bigger, presentation a lot more impressive, and food tasted better, e.g. not as overcooked. Potatoes and shrimp was overcooked and really dry at Newtown. That being said I'm still glad Newtown got its own Turning Point. The service I have to say was excellent and the host and servers were all friendly and warm!

The ribs are smoked with a dry rub 
I think there was to much rub for my taste 
BBQ beans were very good
Service was ok but we did wait to get our food

CRIMINALS/ CRIMINAL RING /DINING SCAM

I decided to update my review of Lerua's, rather than simply checking in, after my most recent visit. When I'm in Tucson, this has become my go to for Mexican food.

While in town last week, my mother took me to dinner to celebrate my birthday. She asked me to pick my favorite restaurant and we ended up at the home of the best green corn tamales in southern Arizona.

Lerua's has much more going for it than just their tamales. Every time I sit down in the cozy dining room, I find something different and amazing on their Specials Menu. Big props for the variety and excellent choices!

This time was no different. The "Holy Mole Enchiladas" caught my eye. And I wasn't the only one. I overheard the guy behind me react to the Mole as well. As we were paying our bills I asked if he also enjoyed it and he confirmed that he did.

My mother enjoyed her usual green corn tamale as well. But this time she ordered and extra one to take home. And I forgot to mention how wonderful the dining room smelled when we walked in! From top to bottom, beginning to end, Lerua's can't be beat! Gracias!
Let me tell you, if your looking for good creole cooking you want find it here. All you will find is great creole food.

Mi esposo y yo fuimos a mirar la calidad de los muebles para nuestra nueva casa..Nos encanto,el
Peronal es muy amable y Angela nos alludo bastante en lo que estabamos buscando con buena calidad y el precio exacto,travajaron con nuestro presupuesto,compramos una recamara y un comedor,los muchachos que nos hocieron la entrega a domicilio fueron muy amables y tuvieron mucho cuidado en acomodar los muebles de la forma en que nosotros queriamos...estamos muy contentos con esta muebleria,quisieramos que vendieran sofas tambien --definitivamente volveremos a comprar con ellos!!!! Hout y anais
Cute new tea place! They also have classes on Saturdays on how to mix teas. The owners are nice and helpful. Tried the root beer one and it was pretty good!

Perhaps I have been sick lately or my tastes have changed, but it seems like my opinion has been against the majority recently.

Anyway, we came here for dinner.  Reservations are recommended.  This place is pretty small and gets packed.  The area is really hard to find parking for.  We circled around for quite a bite looking for a spot.

So the food..for appetizers, unfortunately they were out of the chicken livers for the night so we got the escargot instead.  While the sauce was really savory and rich, it was super salty.  

For entrees, we ordered the duck, the pork chop and the special, suckling pig.  The duck was cooked great (probably the best dish of the night).  The pork chop was okay, I didn't expect it to be completely battered and fried.  Too heavy.  The suckling pig was not that great either.  The meat was tender but the dish overall didn't excite me.  The lentils were dull and the poached egg didn't add much to the dish.  

For dessert, we had the shortbread with bacon ice cream.  Very sweet but helped pick up the night.

Sadly for a pork fan, I liked the duck..

I miss this restaurant! !!. Expensive but in my opinion but well worth it. A definite steven Starr favorite of mine. I no longer work in the area but when I do travel in the unversity city area I  look this place up. I enjoyed the food, drinks and it is so fun to create your own lighting/mood experience! !!!.  This place use to get very crowded during after work hours which made it a bit uncomfortable for me. No room to move around. I would definitely suggest experiencing pod at least once during evening hours!

We have been ordering here for years. We usually do takeout dinner and order the yum beef salad, which is tangy/spicy/sweet and delicious, pineapple chicken curry, and banana coins with coconut ice cream. So so good! Today I went in for their lunch special. I got a half order of amazing chicken, a JB tempura roll, soup and eggroll for $13. Yummy in my tummy! The servers are so nice! And presentation and ambiance is beautiful!
So glad I finally found a bubble tea place near my house! Even though it's 30 mins from me, I am sooo happy! The ambiance here is great and I love the bubble tea, always tasty and on point!
Amazing brown sugar boba milk! Super cute inside and they have fresh pressed juice as well! Yumm!

Last fall I wanted to go for a big change from my natural dirty-blonde hair to auburn, and I had yet (in my four years here) to find a place in SB I really liked. I had looked into 19 Blue and one other place, called about appointments/availability, and honestly was leaning toward the other place, but I wanted to do it ASAP and 19 Blue had the soonest slot available. 

I am SO glad it worked out that way, because Kim is the BEST stylist I've ever allowed to mess with my hair! She is sweet and genuine (which makes long appointments so much nicer versus the more common fake or rude stylists I've dealt with). She listens to what I want and gives thoughtful advice when I ask for it. She never rushes through an appointment; she is careful, meticulous and always does a great job making sure the lengths match on each side, the layers aren't uneven or too bulky or too thin, etc. 

Last night I went in to do another BIG change -- this time, donating ten inches and going BLONDE! I wasn't nervous at all, and my hair turned out even better than I had hoped!

The only reason I can't give five stars is that I've had some issues with the receptionist(s) when I call to make or adjust appointments. My name isn't super common, so I understand when people don't understand me over the phone, but I've spelled it out and still been written down as "Cataba" instead of Tabitha. To their credit, though, my last couple appointment setup calls have been much more successful and pleasant.

Seriously, if you're looking for a great place to make your "hair home" -- this is it. I've also had a cut and color done by Shanna, and she is excellent as well. I personally prefer Kim because she knows my hair now that I've been with her awhile, but I'm sure Shanna and everyone else at the salon is top notch!

At the time of this review, Ludlow's had 2 stars...

My thought is that, since it's new, a bunch of self-important Yelpers (the kind that consider themselves "bloggers") came through on a "soft opening" and left feeling only as important as they actually were.

My prediction is that, as more real people pass through, it will rise.

The service was lovely. Everyone was passionate about the food and my waitress had recommendations, which I love. I hate when you go somewhere and ask for a recommendation and they say "a lot of people like..." or "I like everything". That's the worst.

The food was really good too. I'm a little spoiled on Cajun being back and forth to New Orleans so much, but I still really enjoyed it.

Between the service, the decor, the fact that they serve Cajun food, the fact that I'm compensating for some negative (and, in my opinion, misguided) reviews, and just the vibe in general, I'm dishing out all the stars here.

I'll be back for this Bloody Mary also... when it isn't lunchtime on a weekday.
Awful! Rude workers and when you turn in clothes they give you barely any money! They judge you either with what you got, what your wearing etc.

My Girlfriend and I went here on a Wednesday to celebrate our 2 year anniversary and it was AWESOME!  I've been wanting to try it for years and it lived up to its reputation.   They have a full bar but still allow byo with no corking fee Tuesday through Thursday... they offered us complimentary champagne and an amazing mushroom soup amuse bouchée... we ordered a few apps and two entrees, everything was delicious and fairly priced.  Interesting yet simple menu with perfect execution.  They comped our shared desert as well, and wrote happy anniversary on the plate in chocolate sauce.... Great food, Great service, I'll definitely be back and I will definitely recommend to friends!

As a Korean American from Chicago, I know good Korean fried chicken when I taste it. Andy's Chicken satisfies my craving in every way. I ordered the Honey Garlic and my friend ordered the Spicy Chili. The honey garlic was sweet and savory; the garlic was strong but not too overpowering. The spicy chili prominently shows off heavy notes of gochujang, the perfect balance of sweet and spicy. The chicken itself was so crunchy and tender. The workers have the fried chicken on a wire rack, but double fry the chicken at the store so that each chicken piece is hot and fresh. I've had good Korean fried chicken, but Andy's is the best I've had. There's no room to sit, and the wait is 20-30 min long, but if you like fried chicken (who doesn't?) stop by Andy's!

We got an order to be delivered. It was sashimi, some specialty sushi rolls, seaweed salad and edamame. The sushi was all mediocre, not very flavorful and the spicy rolls had absolutely no heat. The edamame had no salt on it, and the seaweed salad was also bland. It wasn't terrible, but I won't be ordering here again.

This place is awesome! I visited their salon today on a whim after moving to the area recently. I finally found "my" nail salon. I got a pedicure and a gel manicure. The salon is clean and welcoming. Ann took care of me and was so nice! Ill definitely be back.

Come here frequently for festivals or just to walk down to the river walk. They hold various festivals here throughout the year. The only downside is there is not much shade so it can be hot. It is on the river overlooking the university of tampa. Nice views of downtown Tampa

Best cuban sandwiches, delicious platanos. I always come here when I visit Seffner. Always clean and fast (it's usually empty when I come). The only downside I can say is it's always cold inside so bring a layer.

Yummy!! We got takeout Margherita pizza and Caesar salad! The pizza was hot and delicious and the salad was crisp! The dressing for the Caesar Salad was really tasty too. We drove up and had car service. The waiter took our card, and came back with the food! My only complaint was that the lettuce was pretty wet, but atleast we know it was clean!! The wet salad meant the croutons were kind of soggy.. if it weren't for the salad I would say 4 stars !!

I'm not sure if they claim to have "the best burger in town" but they should.  If you want a no-frills basic cheeseburger with lettuce, tomato, pickle cooked to perfection, then look no further.  The price is great as well.  Our office orders from here at least once a week. They got rid of my favorite (navy bean and ham) soup, but it is still a great deal and the food is good. The fries are the thick steak ones, which is a bonus!

So every time I've ever visited Louisiana the first thing I do when I step off the plane is to get a poboy. I love trying them at different Restaurants.Now that I live here I've thoroughly enjoyed getting a poboy about once a week. My husband has lived here for a year so he knows places to go for poboys, although after trying parkway bakery's  I'm beginning to question his judgment. That's another review though. Anyways we were out driving around and hungry so he took me here. I ordered the shrimp remoulade poboy and it was absolutely delicious. It's actually the best one I've tried so far plus I liked that it wasn't fried, after all the ones I've been eating I needed a break from fried shrimp.
The service here was great. We were here during lunch and they were packed but our waitress was awesome. She was super friendly and explained different food items to me and she didn't miss a beat when it came to refilling our drinks. I will definitely be going back!!
Love this place! Paul Anthony gave me great service. I'll definitely be back! There was a wide variety of options and definitely worth the money. This will be my dinner and lunch!

The food here seems to be really good. I had the shrimp salad and it was very fresh and the shrimp were perfectly cooked. Other people I was with said the food was good as well. We were a large group that called ahead so they reserved us an area. Only problem was that we were in this pocket that got very little breeze as we were behind a wall outside. About half of the area was in the sun and we had to ask to see if they had any table umbrellas. I would think these would already be in place seeing how we're dealing with mid 90's and high humidity. There weren't any fans either. 
I would go back, but not if I'm going to be stuck in that ultra hot area. The waitstaff was very attentive, though.
Love this spot! Our handicap brother lives nearby and always ask for Joe's pizza when we visit! Service and the Pizza have been really great every single time.

Dr. Nourani is the most compassionate and empathetic Doctor I've ever come across. I spent years trying to get a proper diagnosis of my stomach troubles and after being rushed out of multiple offices with a diagnosis of "stress less" "lifestyle changes" It was a godsend to meet with Dr. Nourani and have him sit with me and thouroughly go through the ins and outs of my day making recommendations and changes that he saw fit.  I had never been talked to for so long and gotten such an in depth explanation of everything. I highly recommend Dr. Nourani!!!! He is an incredible individual!

Dr. Ballard is very considerate and very good at what he does. I've been seeing him for over 10 years and he treats me as a friend as well as a patient. The staff has changed several times during the years, but they are usually very nice and helpful.

Robert and his team were so helpful with our move! They were very skilled in properly handling our items and treating them with care from start to finish! The group of guys worked very quickly and organized a huge move within 2 days notice, 3 drop off and pick up locations and were flawless! Highly recommend Platinum movers for any move! Defiantly recommend Robert and his guys!

Food is always good at the red Robin, but the service is not good you have to wait an hour to an hour and a half just to eat because they've closed down most of the place the bar is not even open and people are waiting in their cars to be able to eat, what a sad situation for a good burger place in Meridian Idaho

Omg worse service ever! Party of 5 this past Saturday at 6pm. Half the restaurant was empty but still told would be 30-45 min wait unless we wanted to sit outside. We chose outside. Got our drink order quick and ordered appetizers then it went down hill. She took our dinner orders as we were eating the apps plus I ordered one more Corona and we got wings for take out for the neighbors(nobody else ordered another drink). We waited over 30 min, no food and no beer. Finally the to go wings came out and we told the food runner about us not having our dinners or my one beer. He ran inside and someone brought a beer out about 15 min later but I told him to take it back as I ordered it 45 min ago and didn't want it anymore which he did. Had to find manager as still no food and our waitress never came back out to see us or tell us what was going on. He eventually brought all the food out except one plate...When he returned he told us the last dinner we were waiting for (a wrap) was dropped off the tray and they were remaking it right now....Again still no waitress (but you could see her walking around inside). He finally brought out the wrap and told us he was comping the drinks and wrap that was late. He also took the to go order to make fresh wings (yeah right) since at that point were sitting out for an hour. Waitress came out and I again told her to take the 2nd Corona off the bill as I never got it to which she said no, the manager comped one round I had to pay for that. I explained again I never got it and she got flustered and said she would be right back. She came back with the bill and to go order and of course 2nd Corona was on it still. Unfortunately I hate to say it that came off her tip along with the fact that that was the last time we saw her. The waitress taking care of table next to us (who we saw every 10-15 min mind you) took the card, ran it and brought it back out to sign. 

 I lost a lot of faith in Buffalo wild wings, worse 3 hrs at a restaurant ever. Nice of the manager to comp us the drinks and the wrap "they dropped" but seriously, what happened to the waitress? She never stopped to see how the food was, or if we needed refills or to again say sorry kitchen is behind. Just plain awful

Oh and the kicker, as we were getting up to leave, the food runner came out with a Corona and asked us who ordered a beer ....
How can you say anything bad about this mall? It has everything.  Best place to visit on a rainy day.

My family LOVES Sylvia's! My boys have a blast at open play, story & craft time, as well as special events. We enjoy the monthly Parents Night Out opportunities, too! The best birthday party spot as well! Highly recommend this indoor play place!
What a fun place to visit!! The bowling alley and pools make it a unique dining experience! As a visitor to Nashville I'm happy I had a chance to explore this fun restaurant!!
Great place family owned if you have anyone with family roots in Germany this is a good place to enjoy a lunch or dinner in newly renovated with big extended bar area and new room!

Came in for two cups of coffee.  The cashier didn't hear my boyfriend the first time with his order.  She had a disgusted look on her face (even with the mask on, we could tell) and shook her head and said "uh... what?"  Instead of asking if he could please repeat himself.  That  alone made it awkward and uncomfortable.  When we got our coffee's about 10 minutes later, neither of ours were hot, more like lukewarm.  I'm willing to give a second shot, I understand she may have had a bad day.  Otherwise the inside looked pretty clean and is a cool spot to sit down for a coffee break.

Came back into town for the 500 and came to dinner here. Amazing food and service. Unique menu and the quality of food and selection of ingredients were outstanding. I would highly recommend stopping in for dinner.

Waited in line for 30 min, room was not clean. Said they would text when room was ready. At 4 waited in line 30 more min, room still not ready. Hundreds of people in lobby without rooms. Need to learn how to process people quickly and have rooms ready at check in time.

This morning we dined at Another Broken Egg and we were really excited. We love the food, people & atmosphere from our last experience. Well, today was the complete opposite. Our sever was Collin, and we received terrible service. The two tables on either side of us received wonderful service, in a very speedy manner. My table, however, did not. We waited 30 minutes for appetizers alone. Collin said the kitchen "lost" the ticket so he stole someone else's order, which arrived to us hard & barely warm. Within the 30 minutes, we had to hint Collin down to place our food order. Once our food did arrive, Collin checked in on us about 3 minutes later and that was it. We had to hunt him down for straws also. The table next to us was seated right after our appetizer arrived. They were received promptly & their food arrived about 2 minutes after ours, considering we had ordered about 20 minutes prior. Collin continuously checked in on the table and even delivered their check without them having to ask. I had taken my wallet out as a clear sign I was ready for my check, however Collin went about other things, not bringing our check. I finally had to ask for a check that took 6 minutes to get to me. When I reached for the checked, he sat it down, as if my hand was not open. Needless to say, he received a written tip rather than a monetary one. I do not recommend this restaurant for people with a darker skin tone.

Awesome!! Had such a a great time fishing with these two! They really worked the entire time helping us catch fish. Both Captain Tom and Cody were knowledgeable and just great!!Tenni, who you book with on the phone, is so helpful and sweet!  She is quick to reply to emails and return calls! We had a really great experience and would highly recommend. Plan on going back next year! Actually this trip was a surprise for my husband and he wants to go back every year and we just might! We may go a different time of year to catch different fish. Check the website for the seasons!  Tip: If you stay at the Holiday inn at Indian rocks you will be right by the dock. They will also cook up your catch at the restaurant there, Jimmy Guanas, for $10/pp.
Service was excellent but food was mediocre. The restaurant was clean and family friendly.
Loved our waitress and the food was delish! My daughter and I will be back! Great breakfast with everything I love. Grits, cheesy eggs, raisin toast! Always come back!

Love this place - I have only been twice but the coffee is great and I'm fussy with coffee. The baristas know how to serve an espresso with god crema - most places I go to don't even know what crema is, so thank you for training your staff well and being able to deliver on that front. 
I haven't had a meal - just coffee and a scone or a cookie and both were well baked. I will come back for a meal as the menu looks great and everyone who's eating looks happy and is making those faces you make when your food tastes great.

Arrived 8:16AM on a Saturday morning after another diagnostic company told us to use Lab Corp as it took out insurance. Walked in, signed in, stood for a bit as there were more people waiting than chairs available. They take you back once to review paperwork then a second time for actual blood work. 
Everything moved very quickly though, my father was done and out in 45 minutes getting a draw for CBC and metabolic panel blood work.
Staff was polite enough but not conversational.

This place is one of the best bbq places in Virginia City. Its a good place to bring the family or just to get a quick bite to eat. The BBQ sandwiches are terrific, the sauces were good. 

This place has limited seating, so it could be a long wait and no where to sit on a busy day. This place shuts down kind of early, which is somewhat of a draw back.

I was not really in the market for a new car. I did figure it was Memorial Day weekends so I went ahead and contacted a few dealerships to see what specials were in line for the Holiday. I am in the process of having my first child with my wife so I wanted something a little more family friendly but that still would be able to pack a punch when I did not have the family with me.

I opted to look into the IS 350 F Sport. I dealt directly with Mark Sherman for the entire deal. I contacted the dealer and he helped me from end to end. He worked out the numbers over the phone for what could be provided for my car (trade), my needed down payment, and overall terms. It was a simple and painless process. Everything was presented to me. Everything looked fantastic and we were so anxious that we went down the very next day after speaking with Mark over the phone.

When we met with Mark he was full of energy and ready to take care of my wife and I to be able to get into our new Lexus. He made sure we were comfortable and he was courteous and charming.

We were offered water right when we walked in. The amenities of the dealership were plentiful and the entire place was gorgeous. Our new IS350 F Sport was detailed to perfection. All facets of the car were completely explained and reviewed by Mark with my Wife and I. We were able to take it on a test drive before pulling the trigger on the lease. 

In Finance we dealt with Michael Weinzimmer. He was straight and to the point with all of the paperwork being submitted. He went over every line item in perfect detail to make sure my wife and I were comfortable with every piece of the deal. It was the quickest and easiest financing experience I have had buying a car. 

I could not have asked for a better experience and look forward to being part of the DCH family for years to come. Mark Sherman will be my salesman of choice.

Sorry but food was disappointing. My granddaughter ordered the cheese burger that the menu specifically states chopped bacon but it had undercooked bacon strips. Our grandson in law ordered his fries loaded. When they brought it to the table they were plain so he told them and they took the plate back to the kitchen an just threw some grated cheese and over cooked bacon on them. Didn't even try to heat them up so the cheese wasn't even melted. I ordered my mashed potatoes with white gravy and got brown. Wife had the tuna melt and it was very good.

Loved the extensive menu. Food was yummy. Very pleased with customer service. The wrong sauce was put on one of our sandwiches and when we mentioned it, the manager came out and made our dessert complimentary. I did expect the place to be bigger from the pictures but we had no problem getting a table.

Saw the reviews for Mario's on Yelp, and I wasn't disappointed. Food and service was great and décor was inviting. Our party had the fettuchini alfredo with chicken and two of the rigatoni specials, and we were happy with our selections. I'd definitely return because the menu is huge and there are a lot of entrees I want to try!

Absolutely amazing everything is really really fresh everything original and one mama mama the atmosphere is very welcoming you can create your own sandwiches . Or just stop by for fresh cut meats and all kinds of cheeses to take home

I must preface this review with...Mix is EXPENSIVE! The only reason I even went through with my order was because someone else, someone RICH was paying for the cupcakes. Had it been my responsibility, there is no way I would have paid close to $100 for two dozen cupcakes. I would have borrowed my mom's stand mixer and would have gotten down to business. With that being said, my cupcakes wouldn't have been half as good and nowhere near as cute as the cupcakes we got from Mix. 

I was the host for a good friend's baby shower. This was a very special baby shower for a very special lady who was expecting her very first baby, so it had to be perfect. Mix made the cutest ladybug themed cupcakes and when the person paying for the order said, "Those better be some damn good cupcakes", I was nervous. Sure they LOOKED cute, but would they taste good? Well, Mix knocked it out of the park. I am pleased to say, Mama, Baby, and Daddy were VERY pleased with the flavor and look of the cupcakes. 

I understand Mix needs to charge what they do to stay in business, it's just a shame I will never be able to afford more than a couple cupcakes on my own.

So fast! I came in looking to sit and wait and do some work, but they didn't even make me get out of the car! 

Oil change places are a commodity and this one stood out for customer service and such quick and accurate work!

After tasting a friend's Peanut Butter Burger 6 years ago I have never ordered anything else.  Peanut Butter and bacon are a delicious, inexplicable combination.  Hints a little at the peanut sauce in Thai food when mixed with the meat.  Even if you aren't an onion eater, I recommend leaving the red onion on for just a bite, as it adds another dimension to the ecstasy. 
Tell them no mayo. 

Even my good Baptist mother compromises her religious beliefs when she visits New Orleans to go into this "bar" and have one.  

My husband prefers the Bullfighter.  I recently sampled a pal's Texas BBQ burger, which was pretty tasty, too. 

Order your potato's butter on the side, lest the bottom of your hamburger bun be soaked in it.  They certainly aren't stingy with it. 

The gumbo is excellent. So is the mac n' cheese. 

Only 4 stars because getting an  extra well-done burger is hit or miss.  Absolutely no pink is a requirement, and sending a patty back with PB on top doesn't make for good regrilling.

I live in Southern California and visit Boise at least once a year because my parents live here. On my last visit (2017) on my annual visit to Freak Alley, I noticed this place. Great array of sandwiches and sides and beer and wine too! After my first visit, I had day dreams about the Hummazing Vegan sandwich--even tried to replicate it. Well, I went back with my brother yesterday and he's a devoted carnivore without much of a taste for veggies. He LOVED the HV. He said it seemed "meaty" thanks to the hummus spread. Looking forward to my next
visit.

We initially were going to refinance our home but after seeing the market we decided to sell and purchase a new home. Though the process was a bit longer because we sold our home in the middle, the LoanFlight crew was there throughout the process and was available to answer questions and provide us support! We would definitely recommend them!

Went down for Dead and Company with John Mayer playing with the addition of the Lexus Lounge. 

What is Lexus Lounge ? 
Lexus Lounge is something fairly new which is a basically an add on to your ticket for an event with an extra $40 to 150$ depending on the show and  you are given a VIP access to the concert area which includes unlimited food buffet, drinks and pop corn :). If you are here for the games then you have VIP access right next to the locker but keep in mind to read the rules only home team folks are allowed near by.;)

 Buffet - 5 different food stations await you. 
Italian - From grilled cheese to pasta to pizzas and more.
Entree - Toasted bread, seafood soup, ox tail, roast ham , hot dogs and more
Salad - Cheeses, fruits, greens and deli meat.
Desert - cool cup cakes from loaded to light ones.
Snack Bar - pop corn, nuts ,trail mix and more.
Drinks - U N L I M I T E D  Free

Lexus lounge is an experience which is a must and due to the affordable prices it more than pays for it self, you have your private restrooms and not have to wait for long lines for drinks either. You have great big bars and the main bar has 3 6 ft tvs showing you the entire event if allowed by the performers or if the Preds are playing you will not even have to go in to watch. It is basically the Dallas Cowboys Big tron in a smaller version. Going in and out to the concert area is a breeze as the lounge is right there.

Seating - the lounge does offer some great seats if interested in different areas which are quite close it self and awesome view more like a behind the scenes view of the concert. The suite has awesome LEATHER seats exactly the ones like in the car and would be annoying sitting in something normal now :P

We met Dan the sales executive who was very hospitable and made sure everyone was comfy enough and if there is anything else he could do to make our time better, he did more than his fare share.

This place was very nice. Great murals painted on the walls and good location. 

I had the Grilled Spinalis Steak served with asparagus and Roasted Potatoes. It was wonderful. The steak was so tender and cooked to perfection. No complaints at all on how well the steak was cooked. 

BUT..... I left the restaurant hungry. My food portion was very small. I wish now I had ordered an appetizer and a salad to go with my meal. .....Lesson learned!  

Food was great. Small portion. Service was just "Ok".

Wonderful! We've lived in Reno for 2 years and I've been searching for a casual Italian place.  We found it.  I had the meat lasagna and my husband had the meatball sandwich.  Both were EXCELLENT - hot and really good.  And, another VERY pleasant surprise, they sell sliced meats by the pound.  Again, I've been searching for an Italian Deli - and I'm anxious to try the salami and cheese.  I'm disappointed there is no Havarti cheese and not the Buon Gusto salami, but I'm betting their choices will be better than Raley's or Scolari's.

Anyone that gives this gym less than 3 starts should take a trip to the Glendale LA and then count your blessings for being a member of this one instead. 

Equipment seemed to be updated and their treadmills have individual TVs so you can choose what you want to watch. 

The only downside to this place that I saw was that their pool is only 3 lanes. But, since it was about 30% as full as my normal LA, I had a lane to myself and an open one next to me for all of my swim. 

It's a bit hard to navigate to this place off the highway, and the exterior and age/location of the building might make you skeptical, but it's been completely updated inside and is a great place to workout.

I felt the need to write this review in light of the position I was in just a short while ago. First a little background for why we were looking for a new gate. We live in an extremely remote area in the foothills of the Dragoon Mountains east of Benson. To say that it is difficult finding excellent service is putting it mildly; it is definitely "hit or miss." My husband and I are handy having previously built our own house and refurbished several others, so we tend to try and do as much of our own work as we can just to avoid hiring "uncertain" labor as much as possible. 

Unfortunately this house came with a gate that was installed in such a manner that every time a heavy monsoon storm came through, the gate would open uphill into the driveway where mounds of gravel and dirt always piled up. It was simply a poor design. The final straw was when opening it caused a couple cross bars to break. It was obvious from several welds on the gate that it had happened before.

One of my frustrations was trying to find a gate fabricator that someone could highly recommend - not just say that they had their gate built there. There are people here in the community that have gates, but no one was heaping praise on anyone. I am particular and tried to do some research but couldn't find any reviews. I finally just had to go with a gate company that I really liked a design found on their site. The company happened to be Alltech Gate Systems out of Tucson, AZ. 

I contacted Alltech with my needs, sent them some photos, and stated my issues with the site location. I got back two quotes following my request to reuse my old gate and one for the new design. Dennis O'Neill, my sales rep, worked with me and came out to measure to ensure that the gate would fit perfectly and work with the requirements we discussed. 

It turns out ordering a gate in winter is an excellent time to get one. I had my gate in just about a week's time! It normally takes closer to a month to get a gate, but winter is a slower time for manufacturing gates. I was lucky. :) They just installed it yesterday - 8 days after Dennis O'Neill came out to measure. Wow!

And here is where I have to say that I am blown away! First, I got a call on Friday saying that my gate was complete and asking if I would be around on Monday. They set up a time to come in the morning. Monday morning, I received another call saying that they were on their way. The company's communication is excellent and so unlike many service appointments these days.

Two gentlemen, Dustin and Charlie - very polite, friendly and professional - immediately went to work to install the gate. They installed it perfectly. Everything is level and beautifully painted. The existing stanchions were sanded and painted to match. They even serviced the gate arm where previous homeowners had opened it up which caused issues with my control board. It all looks brand new and very classy. 

And what a gorgeous gate! It has truly exceeded my expectations. I am so, so happy that I found them. So, I am here to say that I HIGHLY recommend Alltech Gate Systems. If I need anything done again, I will not hesitate to use them.

Appetizers: 
The wings were perfectly crispy. Many of the places around here overcook them and they come out dry. These were crispy and the bbq sauce was really good. 
The Meatball trio was so good. The red sauce was sweet and had great flavor with the meatball. 
Pizza:
We ordered the classic Pacific Rim Pizza. We are from Buffalo, NY so we like the pizza to be a little more doughy than NY style. This was perfect! The bacon was so crispy and had great taste and the ham was amazing. 
We also ordered a Pesto Base pizza with chicken and onion NY style. It was so good. The pesto was perfect.

Order your steak one level less cooked. Usually come out a little over done for what you ask for. 

The apps are great usually. 
Really crowded probably not worth the wait here. 
If you can get a seat in the bar. Give it a try
Eh. College students drowning in homework on one side, layers of paper flyers about the local band playing on open mic night, and not-so-special lattes.

Weekend brunch includes unlimited sangria, mimosas, and bloody marys!

I love weekend brunch, because that implies that the brunch deal is good for Saturday or Sunday. Why are there so many places in the Tampa Bay area that only believes in Sunday brunch? Where are my Saturday brunchers at? Well, it would be a stretch to say they're all here, because it was only moderately full, but they should be here, because the brunch/lunch selection is spot on.

In addition to the brunch menu, they let you order off the lunch menu. This is great for me, because my husband is not a brunch person. Give him a normal menu and he will be happy all day. He went against the grain in this instance and ended up ordering the chicken and waffles off the brunch menu (probably just to prove me wrong in this review). I asked about the size of the Greek yogurt parfait, because I was hungry and wanted to know if it would be enough. The waitress told me not to worry that it wasn't that big. I'll take it as a compliment that it looks like I have the appetite of a bird and opted for the Mushroom and Swiss Omelet for something more substantial. 

I enjoyed the omelet (though I maintain it is difficult to mess up an omelet). I thought the breakfast potatoes were fine, but didn't have strong feelings about them. My husband enjoyed his chicken and waffles. Oddly enough, it came with a giant scoop of butter. If you really like your butter, then this is good for you, otherwise it is easy enough to move it to the side. It also comes with a peppering of bacon bits. A lot of things on this menu has bacon. The bloody mary even had a piece of bacon in it. I don't eat pork, so it limited my options (I know that I could always ask for things without pork, but I feel like I'm paying for the pork in the price and if there aren't any substitutions available, like turkey bacon for bacon, I usually won't choose that option. Tangent over). A vast majority of the population lives by the motto the more bacon the better, so I'm sure the abundance of bacon is actually a boon in the eyes of many people.

I have to confess that even if the food was mediocre, I would still come here for the drink deal. Most places only have unlimited mimosas or make you choose mimosas or bloody marys. Here, you get both plus sangria! I thought the bloody mary was very good. I was impartial to the sangria, but the others at our table enjoyed it. Our waitress was attentive enough that I never had an empty drink. That's the hallmark of a good brunch.

I enjoy the look and feel of this place. It is definitely a family restaurant, but I saw a good smattering of couples too. You definitely won't feel out of place partaking in their unlimited drinks brunch.

My son ordered the breakfast Nashville Hot Chicken & Waffle is excellent.  Perfectly spiced chicken & the waffle is cooked golden brown.   I wasn't very hungry and ordered the biscuits side & bacon.   Biscuits were a little small but tasted good & bacon was crispy and not burned.     Overall a very good breakfast.   Would come back.

I don't know where to begin the bad service , rude staff, or the mandatory 15% gratuity charge even for to go orders. 

Upon walking into this establishment my coworker and I were greeted with (Get in line) and handed two menus. We were unable to order large pizzas and had to wait an hour for our to go orders (It wasn't even that busy). One pizza was cold and undercooked while the other was warm. The staff acted like they didn't want to be bothered with us, and god forbid you ask for a little bit of Parmesan as it was treated as a precious commodity. 

It takes a lot to motivate me to write a bad review on a place but I just had to with this one. I will not be returning there as I was severely disappointed. If you're looking for a decent pizza I would pass this one up.

Moxie's there are several of them in Reno. I believe this is the original. The menu is freaking delicious. Top choice the brie cheese fig jam burger. It is mouthwatering tasty. The service is good a little slow, they definitely could use a few more people in this location. The atmosphere. The bar is on one side and it is huge. It is a smoking area and is pungent. The eating side is comfortable and a lot of bench seating. The bathrooms are clean and easily located. I hardly eat desert, but make exceptions and Moxie's is definitely a place to do so. It changes and listed on a chalkboard. The drinks are good and what I like most love ice and when I ask they give me an extra cup of it. I would give it five stars except the service. It's a great little local place I hope it stays. The menu is hard to choose because it's so good. We like the Sharlands location due to the fact my husband grew up in this area since he was two. Went to Mcqueen  and really loves that area. A lot of his friends live up there we spend a lot of time in northwest Reno.
Great Indian Food in New Orleans! Very good flavor and interesting mix of options. It is located within a great food hall with a nice bar and other food options as well. Definitely worth trying!

Love this place! Great atmosphere, food, and service. Coffees are HUGE and they offer free refills.  Food presentation was pretty as well as delicious.  Prices are reasonable. We are wishing there was one of these back home.

This is a cute family owned ramen restaurant. Very small and intimate. I was a little confused with how you signed up for the waiting list as there is just a tablet by the door with a bunch of names and I was not sure if I did it myself. After 5 minutes of waiting the waitress told everyone by the door to sign in on the iPad. The wait was about 10  minutes since there was a lot of groups.

As far as the food though this place is delicious. It felt like I was in an authentic Japanese ramen place in Japan. It was small and steamy. It was full of great aromas and good smiles everywhere. 

You can say that if I am looking for ramen this place is a good lace to go. 

Now if you don't like small places or are a huge person, I would not recommend, as I felt like I was on top of the people next to me. I am 6'1 and is doable but just consider my knees were touching the table underneath. 

Food and service is great. I recommend.

I needed 65 donuts immediately for my associates, the original person I needed to make the donuts told me the night before at 11pm they could no longer provide. 

I called RNR at 8:24am with the request and they said yes! I was so happy! 

I picked up and they were ready to go, he even threw in a free peanut butter cookie and raspberry tea which were both amazing. The donut literally melts in your mouth, I will totally go back.. much sooner rather than later!!

There have been some great coupon deals lately that have entitled me and others to enjoy your restaurant on a more regular basis and I have certainly learned to learn what constitutes quality meat as opposed to those "inexpensive" steakhouse chains.  The incredibly fresh salad bar is a great start, but things like the filet, the pork tenderloin, the leg of lamb, lamb chops, and a friendly eager to please staff has me hooked as a customer.

Best word I can use for you is mmmmm.

We decided to stop in after an afternoon of shopping at the Westfield Brandon Mall. It was a good decision. We wanted to try their new blonde espresso. I think it's a great idea to have two different types of espresso. Most people who complain about the burnt bean taste should really like this smoother version. There is definitely no bitterness. It's actually quite smooth. I had the blonde latte. I thought it was very milky & creamy. I love milk, so I was happy with it. I noticed that you don't need to add as much sugar to the drink. My mother liked her shot of blonde espresso, but she felt that she needed more than one shot. It was gone in one gulp. 

The location is very busy. I give them a pass when it comes to cleanliness. I do think that they may need more staff because the floors and tables needed attention. The garbage bins were overflowing as well. If anything, they just need an extra person to maintain that part of the business. Other than that, the service was great. We were quite happy overall.

Steve Goldflam is absolutely amazing. He will meet you wherever you are and help you out. He truly cares about everyone that walks through his door and will not only help get your taxes done, but will also do everything he can to help you get all your finances in order. He has some of the best advice around and is very kind. If I could rate six stars I would.

I enjoyed our visit for lunch.  I think the staff is really great here.  We were greeted by the hostess and he was quite personable. We were seated in Juan's section and he took great care of our party of six. We had a 40th birthday at the table on a Saturday afternoon at lunch time and he obliged by bringing a dessert and singing Happy Birthday all by himself. We really appreciated the sentiment. 

Some of the table partook in the bourbon flights. $40 for  six tastings. Overall I think it went over well. They do of course have a draft wall where you can show your ID, receive a bracelet and sample all the beers at your leisure. I've done this before at other restaurants and typically find it is very pricey so I opted in for my usual standard Bud light. 

The food was ok.  I think the wings were the best part of the mail. To me, the Philly egg rolls were powdery on the outside and the beer cheese soup also tasted a bit like flour. With that being said nothing was bad. 

All in all We enjoyed the atmosphere and service was great. I would absolutely return.

Very good, contemporary Italian with a couple problems. Ordered a couple pizza and pasta dishes to share. The lobster pasta dish was amazing. This being said, service was insanely slow. Docking half a star bc I saw not one, but two roaches during dinner. Yes, our table was near the door and I realize I'm in the south, but definitely a distraction from an otherwise great meal.

This market is really a classic.  It is not glitzy and sparkly with exotic and wild selections, but is bright, clean and packed with every Italian item you may be looking for.  The meat area has a beautiful selection of top-grade goods and the produce section is full of the freshest vegetables and fruits.  The rest of the store is loaded with pastas, pastries, wines breads and all the goodies that make this cuisine so loved.

The prices are very good, and the service is helpful, quick and genuine.  We love this gem!

I am constantly on a search for good Thai food. We ordered chicken pad Thai and medium spice red curry. The chicken pad Thai was one of the best I had ever had. The red curry was also good and creamy, maybe a little heavy on the bell pepper flavor but I would still order it again. 

The service was very good. Friendly host and our waiter was very timely and we received our food in a timely manner. Overall very good experience and we will definitely be back.

It fulfilled the hype that we saw here on Yelp. A beautiful restaurant, amazing staff, Ivan was NY style professional. Where do they find such amazing staff ?
   Better suited for a crowd, most portions are large and we wanted to try a few items and were pained to leave half on the plate. We were traveling and doggie bags were not an option. 
    Everything we had was Good to Awesome. Highlights were the Seabass, Stuff Baked Potato and the Lobster Tacos. Somewhat less successful but good was the Grilled Shrimp "Oreganata Style" with Jonah crab. The dish was quite dry perhaps from excess time under a heat lamp. 
    AND Yes, the Bannans Foster cake was great but again enough for 3! We will be back soon to try the dry-aged, Tomahawk rib eye.

I have been in Tucson staying at my mom's house since February of this year. So far during my stay we have eaten here a total of 7 times. I have had 3 or 4 different type of steak dishes, the salmon, & the chicken fajitas and I have loved every meal I have tried. I like the PICO, the refried beans, the rice, the corn tortillas, the charro beans, the green sauce that comes with the chips, and I even like the chips. I like the PINK lemonade with some freshly muddled strawberries in it as well. 

I always order my meals at all Mexican Restaurants with corn tortillas because I don't eat any gluten, in addition I always order my meals everywhere without dairy because i am allergic to dairy.

I will miss going out to eat here once I am back home in IL, because the food here is really good. 

There is a place by my house in South Elgin,IL  that is very good but for different types of food, I always get the Tilapia Ceviche at Coronado Mexican Kitchen & the Combo Platter which has 8 or 8 items in it.

Boyfriend talked me into eating @ the doghouse saying how much he loves the dogs. I cannot thank him enough. Definitely not a fancy place but Holy hot dog good. Hot dogs are so long they are cut in half. I love the fact that I get to see my food cooked. My lunch was ready in a snap. boyfriends Chile cheese dog didn't disappoint him. I loved the sauerkraut, relish, and mustard dog. Fries are super good. You better bring cash because that's all they take.

For the second wedding this fall, I've been wowed by the floral talents of Ms. Nga and her team. From the charming Chuppah from this past October to the wonderful ceremony and reception decor AND stunning flowers of this November, I couldn't be more thankful. The service was great and personal, the execution was flawless. My clients were pleased. I'll be back!

Our AC unit was getting some heavy condensation on it, as if something inside was freezing, and we had a guy from Peterman come out to try to figure out what was going on. He probably spent 2 maybe 2.5 hours trying to diagnose the issue. At one point he was on the phone for like an hour with who I can only assume was a person more knowledgeable than him. He finally just told me he didn't know what was wrong with it and that he didn't want to tell me to pay for a replacement of a part that wasn't necessary. Fair enough.

He mentioned that some exhaust pipe that we had was improperly installed because it needed a joint so it could be removed in order to be flushed out periodically. I asked him how much that would cost, and he said $47. I didn't want to cut PVC and try to do it myself, so I told him sure go ahead. He spent 15-20 minutes cutting the PVC pipe and adding a joint to it. He also flushed it out for me. The diagnosis (which didn't yield any results) cost $60. So we were at $107.

Then he told me he had some stuff called A/C Re-New which was similiar to additive you would put in your fuel to flush out your car engine. He assured me it wasn't "snake oil" even going as far as showing me YouTube videos of how it works. He said there was a 50/50 chance that it would make my system run normally. I thought well it's just a 4 oz bottle of some liquid he has to put in my system; it can't cost that much money. I asked him to give me a quote on it.

$324.

$324 for them to pour a 4 oz bottle of something in my system.

"But sir it will save you thousands of dollars on future repairs."

Finally he talks me into it, saving me a few dollars by signing me up for their "Peterman Protection Club" ($16/month).

I should have done more research before telling him to do it, but I didn't want to just have him stand there while I try to figure out if him pouring this stuff in my system was worth $324, so I was like whatever I mean 50/50 let's roll the dice on it, and maybe it will stop my system from freezing up.
