He left my garage, and I thought he was just going out to his vehicle to grab something because he came back in like 2 minutes. He tossed me the empty bottle of A/C Re-New and said, "alright you're good to go; can you toss that in the trash for me?"

It didn't solve our problem. Our system froze up again the next day. So then I thought let me check out this A/C Re-New stuff.

First of all, the bottle costs $70. Anyone can buy it online. It's not something that's exclusive to HVAC professionals. The special tool that you need to put it in your system is $110. So $180 total. There is a YouTube video that shows you how to put it into your system yourself, and it takes less than 5 minutes, which their employee demonstrated by taking 2 minutes.

So I thought to myself, "man these people have these tools; they only had to pay for them once, and if they're paying $70 for a can of this stuff (probably paying less because they buy them in bulk), they're making $254 off their customers every time they dump a can of this stuff into their system." That seems a little outrageous to me because he installed a $2 piece of PVC in my system for $47 and that took him 20 minutes. So 20 minutes of labor costs $45.

But for the A/C Re-New, 2 minutes of labor costs $254?

I called them the next day and explained all of this to them. I even had the owner of the company, Chad Peterman, call me and tell me how they have overhead costs, and they need to pay employees, and he stands by all of their pricing. He told me that they price their services to make 10%-15% profit. That might be the case on some of their services, but when they charge $324 to dump a $70 4 oz can of liquid into your unit, they are making much, much more than 15% profit. You don't need to have a PhD in mathematics to see that.

We had a guy from a different company come out to see if they could figure out why our system was freezing up. Within 10 minutes he discovered the problem. Our return air filter just needed to be replaced. Apparently when your filter is old and clogged, it reduces airflow going into your unit, and because there isn't enough air moving over the coils, they get too cold and freeze up. He sold me the filter for $40 and was even kind enough to waive the diagnostic fee because he felt bad that we already got robbed by Peterman.

The bottom line is this. Peterman Heating, Cooling, and Plumbing might have some nice people working for them, but the people they send to do work at your house might end up wasting 3 hours trying to find a solution when a different company will come and do it in 10 minutes. And that kind of sucks, but sometimes people are new at their job, so it's excusable. What's not excusable is them taking a $70 can of some liquid and charging people $324 to spend 2 minutes putting it in their system.

Chad Peterman is a charlatan who will unapologetically swindle you out of a significant amount of money.

My wife and I celebrated out anniversary with a couples massage at Puritie Spa and it was a great experience.  We requested a deep tissue massage and they really delivered, and the environment was clean and relaxing.  We'll definitely be back!

I recently went to P.F. Changs with my family for dinner after a long day of moving. We tried to go to another restaurant in the area but the wait was over an hour and a half. Luckily P.F. Changs had a table for my family. They promptly sat us down and are enforcing social distancing and masks guidance. They provided paper menus and were very quick with service. Our server Julian was very kind and answered all of our questions patiently as we were a large group. We got several drinks and plates for the table. The food was tasty and guaranteed to meet everyone tastes. We even got Great Wall of cake for dessert and it tasted amazing as always.

I was always very fond of this restaurant and would regularly go here with my friends. However, last week I came to the restaurant and was double charged. To elaborate, they charged me TWICE for my order. Needless to say, I will not be returning to this restaurant.

Mai Lee was a fun, fresh, and delicious experience. I left here feeling full, but not too full. The interior is warm, inviting, and full of friendly servers waiting to help you. The menu is extensive and our server made recommendations and tips about each one that we asked. The only thing lacking (and I agree with other reviewers) is that the flavors are not robust. They do leave a bit to be desired. Maybe this is the restaurant's choice, and then they leave it up to you to pour sauces and other flavorings after you get your meal...I'm not sure. However, that would in no way stop me from returning, as I fully enjoyed my spring rolls and noodle bowl!

On some rare occasions I wish I could rate negative stars. This is one of those occasions.

Without getting into the details, I'll just say the person at the box office was beyond rude and unwelcoming. I left frustrated, angry, and with two unredeemed tickets. Money down the drain and nobody willing to provide an iota of customer service. 

Guys, skip Roadhouse and go to the Century Tucson Marketplace. They have the recliner chair experience at half the price. Also staff won't be walking around noisily obstructing your view during the movie. You don't need all the drunk people ruining your date night anyway. The food is overpriced for the Chuck E Cheese-like quality . Only the popcorn is good here. 

I'm done with Roadhouse and will never come back. I hope you'll avoid this overrated theater too.
We love this place.  Food is ok, but otherwise very enjoyable.

My family are BIG fans of Russell's on Macklind! My brother in law works in the kitchen and so he tells me all about the awesome things available.  I find that the bakery menu changes more often than the dinner menu, which isn't that big of a deal, as I like to come in and get tea and cake. A slice of cake isn't cheap, but it's enough for two (maybe three if the third person is tiny!) people to split. :)
The staff are always lovely and friendly.
I cannot say enough good things about Russell's! The breakfast flatbread, the cakes, the savory grits, their sangria and their float trips are THE BEST THINGS EVER. I love taking guests here, we had my mother's birthday dinner here.... It's all just really lovely! Wish it was a bit more affordable but if it pays to keep their staff that great, then it's worth the splurge.

I've been to Pat's and Geno's and Jim's, and while Jim's is still my favorite, Tony Luke's comes in a strong second.  On the recommendation of my Uber driver, I went for a Pizza steak with mushrooms.   The line was a little bit long but eventually I made it to the front and was able to place my order.  The food came out relatively quickl;y and was about as straightforward as you can get.

The pizza steak was as advertised, and the combination of the tomato sauce meat and cheese on that crusty bread, left you with a sandwich who's messiness was only paralleled by it's deliciousness.  The meat was so tender that it pretty much melts in your mouth.  The fries I also had were crisp and well seasoned.

The only downside of my visit was a super hot summer day and I would have liked some relief fromt eh heat in the form of some AC.  If I came back it would be for a to go order.

Came in on the final leg of our vacation right before heading to the airport. We were hungry and tired. Our server took excellent care of us. Kept our waters full and asked if wanted new cocktails when they were done. She was always one step ahead of what we needed  i.e.  Drinks, plates to share apps with ect. Also I have a serious allergy to nuts and the server made sure to check that things were nut free when we placed our orders. We also sat outside neat the pretty lake and listened to some live music which is nice. 

We got the spinach dip, the firecracker shrimp and the empanadas. The firecracker shrimp was my pick and my favorite. Crunchy without being over cooked and the Siracha sauce it came with was spicy and flavorful without being too extreme. The spinach dip was delicious but I would of liked it a bit thicker. But over all good. The empanadas were hot, flaky and good. But my least favorite. Only Bc I am not a huge empanadas fan. 

We got dessert too. I got a key lime pie. Which is delicious. I scraped off the meringue like top part Bc I don't like that. The pineapple creme brûlée in a pineapple was just wonderful with the hint of pineapple. My other friend got a dessert with nuts in it that I couldn't try since allergic but she liked it.

Mercers is a good crowd and a good time. The staff is very friendly and there are good beer specials on tap. 

The main drawback that I am seeing is that the DJ has no skill in transitions and completely changes genres suddenly. The dancing could be a lot better if they could be a lot more consistent and read the crowd. Breaking up the dance floor rhythm is a carnal sin.
I love our new gutters, the service was excellent, the price was excellent, I would recommend this company 100 percent.

Absolutely the best small breakfast/lunch spot in the area. Staff is amazing and make you feel like family. Mel is constantly there with a smile. Best pancakes I've had in Philadelphia period. Amazing bacon egg and cheese and anything breakfast. I can't say enough great things about this place! Go try it!!!!

Food is great! Service and atmosphere are both below average...and they're actually at odds with each other. The music is loud and high tempo, almost subliminally rushing you through your meal, but the service is too slow for it to work. If you're a die-hard ramen fan, it's worth a try. But the experience really makes you earn it.

Two thumbs up to the breakfast crew in the restaurant.  I think every employee had a cheery attitude and a peppy "Good Morning" for us.  Thanks to Kaleigh at the front desk for making sure everything was perfect in our room.  Great experience.

Everything was delicious and on point. We were very happy with our experience. Personally, I do not eat meat or fish, but the people I was with did, and everything they ordered was scrumptious.

I doubt there is a bad meal on their menu, and there is a little something for everyone. 

What I liked most about them is how accommodating they were with out orders. Like I said, I don't eat meat or fish, and they were able to hook it up.

Miso soup was exactly as it should be, the corn was very tasty, and I was surprised with the tofu. Very good! I also got the green goddess roll, minus mushrooms (not a fan of mushrooms unless they are magic;))

The only thing that was underwhelming were the deserts. Not a big fan, so I had to give them 4 stars. If I was judging based on their ambiance, customer service, and dinner food, it would have been a 5 for me.

It was kind of expensive, so it's not somewhere I would eat out at all the time, but I believe you pay for what you get, and to me, it was totally worth the price. Go check em' out and I feel confident you won't be disappointed.

I purchased the Taste of St Pete food tour on Groupon.  I was excited to see that my home city now has a few food tours.  

I chose the Beach Dr food tour which had four stops.  We met our tour guide Craig, near the Vinoy to start the tour to make our way further down Beach Dr.  

Craig has a great personality, is super friendly and has an awesome singing voice.  He starts the tour with a few songs and performs more during the tour.  I am not a huge fan of listening to these types of solos but he was good and it was entertaining enough.  People who enjoy that type of thing would love it.

I don't want to spoil the spots, but as you can see from my pictures, you get a lot of food on the tour.  You get a drink at the first stop and can purchase drinks at the 2 other restaurants.  

The tour was approximately 2 hours, I am used to longer food tours with more history.  It went quickly, would be nice if the tour was slightly longer.

There is little atmosphere and as a result - prices are low.  You can get a very good massage here from Katherine.  (Dawn - my favorite - moved away.)  Linens are clean and tables are comfortable and adequate.

There is alot of turn over in the therapists, and I suspect they do not make much money.  

It is NOT a spa/luxe experience - for for a chair massage - or a quick 30 or 60 minute table massage its a solid quick fix.  Often you can just walk in - but I like to call and make an appointment.

I wish I could give this 3 1/2 stars. The happy hour specials are great - try the shrimp, flatbread, and sliders. But the place is just so big and corporate and kind of anonymous. They have valet parking, but the valets were about to leave so just told me to leave my car in their lane - and tip them for it. I did. What can I say? It was raining and a holiday and I felt sorry for them. 

Anyway, service was ok, but not great. We were a big party and they needed more than one server who did not check on us that often. We ended up clearing the table ourselves at one point, just to make some room. And one of our party had to go in search of the server when she wanted another drink. The place was not that full... maybe they were understaffed?

I'd go there again if friends suggested it, but not on my own steam.

Amanda shaped my eyebrows and she did a great job! The whole process was quick and nearly painless. It's a really cute boutique and you feel relaxed (soothing music is on) as soon as you walk in the door. I plan to come back and I recommend you make a visit if you need anything done.

This place was great! Makes me wish we had one of these back on the east coast. 

I was able to try a little bit of everything: the Mediterranean bowl, the Hawaiian bbq bowl, and even the clam chowder. Along with being of great quality, there was a short wait time and the prices were so great. Truly a bang for your buck. For the same money that you spend at chipotle you can get an awesome bread bowl with really great quality ingredients. I will definitely come back if I'm ever in the area!

Also, try the mint lemonade and the basil pink lemonade. So cheap for a large ($3) and SO worth it.

This is a nice place to go get a cup of coffee. They also have a larger menu for lunch or dinner if your hungry. Or if you want to get a beer they have options for that too. Tables and seating are available. They have a kids play area and tv's. Its a nice place to go for meetings if you have to bring your kids.

Used to do a decent job but they've stopped using brushes on the pre wash. Now they just spray a little. Not sure if it's laziness or management driven, but it's ineffective and now I always have to do touch up after. Not worth the 10, 15, or 18 bucks anymore. Time to find a new wash, I guess.
A very mom and pop feeling shop filled with a little bit of everything your nerdy heart could appreciate plus more! Prices are fair, lots to pick from! Check it out!

I'm not going to go out and say this is the best bbq in the metro area. I still think ms.hysters and podners are far better, but this place is pretty damn good. That smokey kentucky style is something that puts this place pretty high on my list of Louisiana bbq joints.

Too bad we don't have much of an original style of bbq here, or at least a popular one.
Great food, service was good, and I couldn't buy into to the hype and I thought this place was lacking in value. I thought it wasn't worth the wait and pricing was kinda high for breakfast/ brunch.

My favorite barber shop in Tucson.
I travel here often and when I do I always try to get here because they do a bang-up job of giving me a clean-cut. I'm looking good and think and the barber!

P'sghetti's is absolutely amazing. I have grown up eating a variety of things on their menu. I can say you can not go wrong with anything on the menu. Anything from sandwiches to pasta to the amazing cheesy garlic bread is to die for!!! Perfect for catering or just a casual meal. I would recommend to absolutely anyone
Locked my keys in my car on a hot summer day way out in Oro Valley. They came within 20 minutes to help!!! He was very professional and worked very quickly. I definitely recommend.

Popeyes has got quite the scam going. You can place an order online using the app or computer. Arrive at the restaurant and wait in the drive thru line for an hour or so because they're that slow.
Then arrive at the window. They then will generally tell you that they didn't receive your order and to prove to them that you have a receipt so that they can "maybe fill your order". 
They won't issue a refund and you have to contact corporate and your credit card company to dispute the charge for not receiving a thing. This place is the absolute worst fast food restaurant (dive) that I've ever has the displeasure of visiting. Do yourself a big favor and don't ever go here for anything.

Why I Love Where I live manages to showcase the spirit of the Old Pueblo in their shop at the MSA annex. Go there for Tucson made and Arizona made products from T-shirt's to hats, books, stickers, buttons, gifts and more. This store is here to celebrate Tucson though unique product made locally. If you have been , check it out!
Our family had dinner there tonight. It was my mother in law's birthday. Everybody had excellent meals and service was very good.

It is an okay Starbucks. It has definitely become and chain store. I wished it was like back before it got so big that they would give you your coffee in an actual mug. Their were Starbucks store in the east coast that would do that. The ounces here don't. I don't mind their coffee it's still pretty good and the atmosphere is good. There is just a romantic memory that I had with that Starbucks in the east coast. It was raining out, you could smell the wet rain as it dripped from my clothes. I order some coffee and sit down. I start reading the news paper and as I was reading here came this lady politely interrupting me to serving me some coffee. "Here your coffee sir" the lady says with a smile on her face. I can just image all this happening in black and white hehe jk. Any how enough of letting my imagination take over. I just miss the days when Starbucks wasn't so commercialized. But I would come back here to grab a cup from time to time.

I went because of the good reviews, but I will not be returning. I was sitting at the drying station waiting for my toes to dry and the technician comes, takes off my foam flip flops and puts on my street shoes, smudging the polish. She fixes the smudged polish but at first poorly, I had to ask her to re-fix it. 

Overall, I felt like I was rushed. I've never been to a salon where they come and ask you to pay and change out of your shoes while your polish is drying. I've never seen technicians touch the nails too to test if they are dry. That's how smudging happens. I'm disappointed I paid $28 plus tip for this experience.

oh.em.gee. i'm salivating thinking about my excellent pizza experiences here. 

I've ordered twice and not been let down. 

disclaimer: you need to be into thin crust. If you want a breadier-stands-on-its-own pizza, this is not for you. Its also not a super crispy thin crust, but I find it delicious and balanced. 

Their toppings are amazing....I've had the magherita-eque one with tomato sauce, mozz, and fresh basil and it was mindblowing (emphasis on the tomato, which i'm all about). at the other end of the spectrum we had a great buffalo chicken pizza--actually tasted like buffalo with some kick too it and wasn't overly greasy. 

all in all, lazaros is becoming one of my favorite pizza places in the city.

Delicious noodle soup.  The soups are super hearty, and I love how they add pickled vegetables.  I also like how they offer both shaved and pulled noodles; I'm still on the fence on which one I like better.  The first time I was here, I got the lamb noodle soup, but the amount of meat in the dish was kind of pathetic, and mostly bones.  The next time I got the beef noodle soup, where the meat was more generous.

The first time I was here, it was packed and we had to wait 1/2 hour for a table; the 2nd time, it was pretty empty... just bad luck the first time?

My boyfriend doesn't like it as much because he can't see the noodle-making theatrics, and there isn't a dumpling appetizer.  The appetizers here are, uh, authentic... (aka meat parts that are only for the adventurous or initiated.)

Went here for the first time finally after saying I wanted to go for years and seeinf the greqt reviews. I was very happy. The food was amazing. Got Salman and these potato things. Both were great. I am.picky amout fish, b7t it was cooked just right. Sometimes more expensive resturants have very small portions, but I thought the salmon was a nice - sized piece


My only complaint was that the server forgot my friend's side. We reminded him and he was very apologetic, but by the time it came out, we were pretty much done our main dish. 

I wish we had made reservations more in advance so we could have had a window, but there are pretty good views from anywhere.

Oh, I got a appletini  and damn it was strong! I didn't mind as much it was a bit expensive because they definitely don't skimp.

Excellent food, nice ambiance,  friendly staff, great location. 
All of our meals were amazing,  this will now be a regular spot for us, and they do togo! Very impressed with everything about this restaurant.  I've been to their sister store called Moxies,  and their food is great also. 
I will tell everyone about this place,  in fact one of my clients today said she was going to head there to eat tomorrow!  
I could eat there every day. Moderately pricey but it's worth it.  
Go treat yourself,  you won't be sorry you did.
Cappelli AL Pomodoro with blackend chicken was amazing,  mac n cheese was so tastey. I'm hungry now!

Well don't let the one star reviews scare you away. I was so anxious about going because of that. Making an appointment is like pulling teeth, trying to get ahold of someone is always a phone tag. Although, they were able to get me in within the week even as a new patient. Other places take a month or two. There may be a reason for that but it was convenient for me. Appointment was okay, I felt like the lady was trying to get me to answer questions how she WANTED me to answer them. I saw thru that so just a heads up. 

You wait in the waiting room for at LEAST 10 minutes minimum after your appointment time. Kind of annoying. The front desk lady comes and goes so you just have to catch her, and even when you do you'll be sitting for a while. Bring a book. 

If you are going to be a patient needing medication, the room is down the hall, not the main entrance. It is kind of confusing. 

Payment was fine. I wouldn't recommend it 100%, but girl if you need a place to go asap that takes insurance, just go. (Bring change for the meter parking in front/side of the building)

This was so much fun.  Our tour guide provided so much history about New Orleans cuisine and culture.  We had no idea there has been so many influences from so many different cultures that have created the one of a kind culture you find in New Orleans.  The food was excellent and a wonderful way to try the foods.  The tour guide was a retired chef so he knows the good places to go.

My husband and I brought our first puppy home in September 2013. We found Leo's Pet Care through the great reviews on the Indy A-List and also by following Dr. M's Twitter account. The first time I called, I was expecting a wait to get an appointment for my pup, but they were able to fit him in the very next day. I've been so impressed by the staff's professionalism and compassion ever since. They are always on the lookout for what's going to benefit my dog's health and well-being - I feel like I can trust the staff's judgment and recommendations on what will be best for him rather than feeling pressured to go in a certain direction. I highly recommend Leo's Pet Care if you're looking for a vet that will treat your pet as their own!

This review is for the music only.  We did not eat there.  We paid a $15 cover p/p for am mediocre band (at best).  Stayed for one watered down cocktail and left.  Charmaine Neville was the entertainer.  Disappointing at best.
Friendly staff and great cheese pizza and garlic knots. The cinnamon toast crunch is a great way to end your meal too. We will definitely be back soon.

What an amazing experience. I dunno where to begin. The food or the staff. Everything was phenomenal. From the minute my husband and I arrived, we were made to feel welcomed. Our waitress gave a great over view of the menu, as it was our first time here. We went with the short rib option that gave us a nice sampling of smaller dishes prior to the main event! We loved it all. Will definitely be back in the future!

Service was fast and friendly. I enjoyed the chips and salsa. Salsa was really good. Decor was bright and unique with plenty of decorations to admire. The food was good and plentiful but not exciting. They have a very large menu that looks more like a Chinese place. It is nice to have something in Whiteland other than a burger joint. I would go there again. They have take-out and their phone number is 317-535-1508. I could not find a website for them. They are located in the strip mall next to Burger King and Subway.

I love coming here to sit at the bar and people watch!  Jersey cougars at their FINEST...

And to top it off, a great wine list, awesome bartenders, and a delicious menu.  I love enjoying a tasty bottle of wine here and some of their appetizers.  The filet Kona tips and mushrooms are amazing, as well as the spicy tempura rock shrimp!  My steaks have always been perfectly prepared, and the sides, especially the garlic spinach and sherry mushrooms are fantastic.

I haven't sat out on the new deck yet, but I have walked around out there to check it out, it's gonna be a great place for patio dining this spring :)

This place is awesome! We ate there when they first opened. We did AYCE for 22.95 person. No complaints! Very friendly staff. Our server was amazing and the GM made you feel like a million bucks. Highly recommend. You will not be disappointed.

Weinrich's is my absolutely favorite area bakery, hands down.  I'm a baker, so when I don't feel like making something myself, it's Weinrich's that I turn to for fantastic baked goods.  Their birthday cakes are amazing, especially the chocolate buttercream icing.  They created a beautiful half sheet cake for my son's first birthday that was just amazing, and their prices are reasonable.  I've been a customer there for the past twenty years!

Today I picked up my first Mercedes - a 2018 GLC 300.  After a great experience at this dealership to order the car (see my previous reviews), I was expecting no less for delivery.

I have never had a car buying experience that was any smoother or quicker.  We literally could have been in and out within 15-20 minutes if we were in a hurry.  Most of the "paperwork" is on an iPad, and you leave with all your copies on a USB drive.  There was no high pressure sales pitch for extended warranties or the like.

All the folks at Lokey are great.  Jazz, our sales professional, and Nicole, the sales manger, feel like old friends already.  We had an exceptional experience, and got a great deal on an amazing car -- what more could we ask for?

If you are looking for a Mercedes--make Lokey your first (and probably last) stop.

Unsure why this aldi location has such low ratings, this is my favorite aldi! The store is always neat when I come in here and the parking lot is easy to get in and out of. Now if people have never been to Aldi, they need to know it's not like regular stores! Make sure you bring your reusable bags and your quarter. I will be back!

Professional, courteous, respectful, competent, that's this company, all with a focus on customer service.

My iphone broke on Thursday, I went to them Friday around lunch, problem diagnosed quickly and fixed just as quick, all at more than a fair price, and my replacement battery gave me my phone, lifeline, back. I was ready to buy a new phone- didn't need to.

I had a second phone i thought had a hardware problem, their effective diagnosis said it was a earphone problem not a hardware problem, so good to go, no charge.

If you have an iphone or tablet problem, make them your first stop.

Probably the most disgusting meal I have eaten since I have lived here. I don't expect much from chains, but when it is inedible and you pay 100.00 for 3 meals and an appetizer you expect a little bit more. Don't ever order the fettuccine unless you want to suck on a Parmesan rind. Don't order the salmon unless you want it so dry you need a vinegar shot to swallow it. Disgusting.

I came here with one of my girl friends visiting from out of town on a Saturday night. As soon as we sat at the bar we were greeted with waters and a menu. The staff is exceptionally prompt with servicing their guests and I will be returning. It was easy to find parking and I loved the live band that was playing in and out through the night. Overall I had a nice experience. The staff was also exceptionally good looking which didn't hurt either.

I thought I'd reviewed this location before...the food is pretty much the same quality that you'd find at any location, however I will never order anything to go from this specific location again. Third strike in a row, you're out. I don't understand how it can be so difficult to get an order, with no special requests or substitutions, right. If I don't check the bag, there is ALWAYS something missing, or something incorrect. I expect this from McDonald's, not Panera.

This little jewel is a treasure. Very friendly and courteous service. The bacon sandwich is to die for and a bacon lovers dream. Definitely enough to save a little for later. Also had the turkey club. Yes, it was Devine as well. I have found a new stop for a foodie like me.

Finally tried this place, as I've heard good things about it! The waitress I had, Jenny, was Phenomenal! As I was new, she actually sat down for a few min and reviewed the menu with me, and it was pretty busy! She also pointed out that everything was made from scratch, which is awesome! I loved the flavored coffee option, it was vanilla cream which was very good! I couldn't decide what I wanted so I tried the waffle and protein platter with a side of sausage gravy. The sausage was good, bacon was nice and crispy and perfect. It was still hot too! The eggs were pillowy and light. The waffle was very good, you could smell the vanilla in it! The reason I rated 4 instead of 5 was because of the price. Most times I can go get breakfast and not spend over $20, today I spent almost $30 with tip! Breakfast is usually the cheapest meal of the day. The coffee itself was over $2.50. I would recommend this place to others but would also caution about the price. I do look forward to trying some other options too!

My second time here and it was much better! $2 mimosas and Steak and eggs. The steak was a bit too bland for my taste but the service was exceptional. Kate was our server and she was great. We come back and ask for her for sure.
Neighborhood restaurant, I have tried several items on the menu- and have never been disappointed. Charbroiled oysters are the bomb, barbecue ribs are succulent and service is impeccable!!.

I honestly have no complaints. I got the 3 chicken tenders meal, it comes with a medium drink, Texas toast, fries, and dipping sauce of your choice which there are at least 10 to choose from. First off we got our food maybe 4 minutes after we ordered so super quick. The chicken tenders were very moist and juicy. The fries to me personally were a little salty but that's more so preferential. The Texas toast was awesome, better than Zaxbys. And there were plenty of drink options! Sweet and unsweet tea, peach tea, lemonade, and soft drink products. Also they have a drive through! Slim Chickens is definitely worth the visit. I'll have to try other things on the menu and do and update but chicken fingers are a good first option.

Very rude staff and they did a TERRIBLE job. Also when I asked them to fix something they just said that's how it's supposed to be and refused to do anything about it. I like the white on my French tips to be just a bit thinner and she refused to make it thinner so now I have thick ass French tips.

Situated in Downtown Belleville, right next door to a sushi place you would not expect much from them. They have an artsy vibe as soon as you walk inside. If not a live person playing, good music and pictures adorning the walls (even the bathrooms). 

They had a decent beer selection though they were out of what I wanted. I decided in the end to go with a martini. Good choice. The boyfriend and I had a hummus plate, delicious. The chicken curry sandwich was total yummm. I cannot remember what he had but he really enjoyed it as well.

I think we will be returning here. Great place for drinks and a simple lunch but good lunch.

Perfect date night spot! Love the ambiance and low lit dining area. I can't come here and not get the biscuits they are the best biscuits I've had in the city and the butter that comes with them is amazing too. The fried chicken dinner is so juicy and seasoned well I just wish there was a different side than the cornbread because I already got my biscuits lol. I've been here many times and will continue to return!

I do not understand all the negative comments here about Kentwood water. They have delivered water to me since 2008. They were a local company and were sold off, but I have not noticed any changes. If anything their online billing got better. They never miss a delivery. I auto bill pay, so maybe you guys with customer service issues pay differently??? I have nothing but good things to say about Kentwood. The water tastes great so I keep it coming. Yes, it's probably cheaper to buy bottled water, but have you seen the world's oceans are filled with empty bottles. Come on you guys.

So I know it's called "sushi" shop, but I've never had their sushi. This place is a fast food restaurant, so I wouldn't expect the sushi to be any good. 

What I do come here for is the Chicken Mango bowl with brown rice. It's under $12 and I feel the portion is great, and they are not skimpy on the chicken. It's delicious and healthy-ish for having to eat out.

I have tried the popcorn shrimp, but it is incredibly bland.

So basically - 3 stars for the chicken mango bowl.

The worse habit in sb lol. I have no idea why but they can't ever get the order right. I door dash a burger and get no cheese??? Maybe some quality check should be implemented. Go to the habit on milpas it's way better

I always love me a good Kimpton and the lobby of this one is particularly inviting. There is a solid happy hour at the bar or in the lobby for guests of the hotel.  How could you go wrong with popcorn doused in truffle oil?  The calamari and the hummus appetizer are both excellent but I was disappointed that they did away with the happy hour sliders.A bit cumbersome that the ladies room is on the second floor.
This restaurant is a great place to enjoy a glass of wine with a delicious appetizer or a wonderful meal made with their fresh pasta. The tripe is excellent and squash blossoms are my favorite.

This Moes is deplorable.  At 11:45 (before the lunch rush) the food in the steam food table looked old... dried on the edges, crusted on the top.  The guacamole was brown for example. I pray it wasn't from last night. 

The staff was surly except the male cashier.  The order taker asked if I wanted hard or soft tacos and then acted put upon when I responded.  Evidently, ahe had to go get taco shells. As we were paying I watched a female cook knock the grill spatula on the floor AND PUT IT BACK.  I thought for sure she will put that in the dish room.

As we sat down, I noticed the carpet runners were covered with debris as if they hadn't been vacuumed in days.  It looked like what you expect a place to look like after the lunch rush about 2 pm. There were lemons under the drink machine on the floor.  The taco ahells were stale. 

I didn't venture into the bathroom and I don't want think about the kitchen.  

Had there been anyone that there who looked like they cared, I would have spoken to someone about it.  When a place is that dirty, no one cares. Zero standards.  

We threw our food away and went to the Chicken Salad Chick.

Awesome place!!! Great food and service. Can't wait to go again. The wings and burger we ordered were so delicious and the bartender Anthony was super knowledgeable and helpful with picking the right Irish beer.
Great customer service, awesome taiyaki and boba tea. Too bad it's far from my house. But whenever I am around that area I stop by.

Well constructed thin-crust pizza and salads here!  I also love the garlic knots.  The take-out service is speedy and efficient, which we took advantage of multiple times.  A hip and relaxed vibe inside, which compliments this neighborhood.
Amazing Colombian and bakery items.  Affordable pricing, amazing food, quick service and drinks.

I'm not changing my rating because I didn't visit Handlbar this time, but I window shopped and noticed they have expanded. I have to retract my initial comment about their merchandise because they now have a shirt rack among other things for sale. I am confident their coffee is still good though.

used to be better when they had specialty burgers.  Now there are two burger options and the rest is a mix of tex-mex southern, they were great at burgers and should have stuck with that.  Small inside, dinner feels rushed.

Great chicharrón torta like the streets in mexico. All natural juices ( vampiro) the best JUST TRY IT !!!
4.5 starts

This place should be shut down.
At minimal Wendy's headquarters needs to investigate or health inspections are needed.

How hard is it to fry a frozen chicken sandwich? How hard is it to ask that employees clean the grease my fries are cooked in? How hard is it to get a lemonade, not a different drink altogether?

I wish I had taken a photo of the crap I was given that I wouldn't feed a starving dog.

And if we weren't already back to our place, I would have went back for a full refund of my 24+ dollars.

I live out of state and I always enjoy Wendy's food. But this place gives the franchise a terrible reputation. Yuck! And shame!

Well, I really wanted to like this place, because my husband loves a craft beer.  I'd give it a 4-5 star for the beer, and if that's all you are going for, stop right here.  We went for beer and appetizers. The food was not so great.  The salad was meh, but the nachos were bad. Really bad.  it was as if the kitchen just threw everything on the plate, not pleasant and indistinguishable.  We were hungry, so we nibbled, and like I said we went for the beer, so I didn't complain about the food.  I'd go for beer, but not food.  And we were traveling, so I won't be back anyway.  Too bad, because there are way plenty of great places to eat in Nashville.

My drink was FANTASTIC! The namaste... can't wait to go back and have it again and my beet salad was also delish. Everyone else in my group also enjoyed their meals and drinks. Love the farm to kitchen theme.

My wife and i had been meaning to try this place out.  We were a little skeptical since the Summit Mall seems to be a revolving door of attempted and failed non-chain eateries.  

Its about as small as you would expect based on the outside.  They keep it a fairly dimly lit, but this isn't an issue.  It's nice for a quiet dinner.  Tables are fairly close together.  A lady with a a walker had slight problem navigating the tight space between tables...i actually moved a chair for her to make it to her destination.  Wheelchairs would be more problematic.  

We were offered garlic bread to start which we accepted.  I expected to be charged for it, but was surprised that it comes free.  We were even offered more.  It's great garlic bread...i could eat it all day.

I ordered the Flat Iron steak with frites and my wife ordered the Linguini and Clams.  The food came out not too fast or too slow.  

Presentation on my dish was interesting, it initially looked like a big pile of frites.  a little steak peeking out from under it...with drizzles of balsamic around the outside.  Under the frites was the steak with gorgonzola and the sautéed mushoom/spinach side.  

Steak was cooked perfectly, i ordered medium.  Everything was perfectly seasoned and the balsamic was not too sweet and meshed well with the steak and frites.  This is actually my meal of the year so far.  It was just an excellent, excellent dish and cooked perfectly  My compliments to the chef.  

My wife's linguini and clams was a little different from what we typically experience.  The sauce was fairly thick and clung to the noodles very well.  This is not the sort of light wine/garlic broth you might expect or be used too.  Definitely not something to sop up with bread...the pasta takes it all up with ease.  TONS of clams in this dish along with some onion and roasted fennel root i believe.  Very tasty and i'd order it in a heartbeat (my wife couldn't finish everything so i gladly helped her out).  

I ca't say enough about the quality of the food.  You can tell its all prepared fresh and with great skill.  I"m found the prices quite reasonable.  21 for my steak and 19 for the linguini and clams.  Portions were large, you want to arrive hungry.  

We'll be back for sure, they apparently have a couple of nights with deals for either 2 for 1 or a date night combo.  Looking forward to trying something else next time.  Next time you head to the movies, go a little early and check this place out....its great.

Chef - Keep up the great work.  You are doing this town a great favor by offering such a great eating establishment.  Well done.

walked in yesterday on a whim, was really craving something cold and sweet after eating at Blackbird pizzeria. i was hoping for the best when i walked in, and was greeted by a nearly-empty store, except for two women and their screaming toddlers. alright, that's not the fault of the store, although still a nuisance. as soon as i walked in, the only worker in the store came out from the back, but she had her headphones in. i got my yogurt, there was an alright selection. i got my toppings, where there was a nice selection as well. i got to the counter to pay and the girl still had her headphones in. i sat down, toddlers still screaming, and watched three separate people come in to get things and the cashier had her headphones in the entire time. 
my note to the owner: PLEASE find staff members who brighten up the cafe. she wasn't rude in any ways, but she was very obviously disinterested, distracted, and did not care about her job. 
and, to top it off, the yogurt was kinda runny... has the potential to be a great place, if only you found staff that gave a shit
Love Nail Splash! Affordable and great quality. Gigi does an amazing job on my nails, so talented!!
Beautiful place,  I had the tuna sandwich which was overall very plain for such a nice looking place.
I love Suki Sushi. The food is always fresh, the service always kind, and it's consistent. By far the best sushi joint around. Highly recommend if you're looking for some fresh, tasty sushi!

What a fantastic find. 
I had a used ceiling light I wanted to turn into a hanging light. D delivered! 
She added everything I needed and then said she had time left and painted the chain and all the fixtures to match my light. It is part of my kitchen renovation and really meant a lot to me. 
It looks fantastic! Thank you, D 

Colleen

Loved my first experience at Infinity Nails Spa today. My bestfriend and I get our nails done every 2 weeks and we've been looking for a place to call "home". Angela was my nail tech, she was quick but very attentive to my nails. We'll definitely be back!

Yats is awesome. As a vegetarian, sometimes I find myself having to eat salads or pasta at places that serve otherwise good food and not getting to try any, but Yats always has a vegetarian option. When i went, it was a delicious black bean and corn stew type dish served over rice and with garlic bread on the side. I've been making my own version of this dish for a while and it has never tasted this good.

Really 3.5 stars because I can't say I'm a fan, but it's a little more than A-OK, especially for Reno. I come here every few weeks or so for staples like oyster sauce (my favorite brand from Thailand). I've also gotten into Chinese cooking (braised pork belly), and they have Pearl River Bridge light and dark soy sauce, rock sugar, and shao xing cooking wine. Lately, they have offered a few bags of very fresh veggies, like baby bok choy and Chinese broccoli. I can't say much about their frozen section, but I do think they offer a good variety of Asian sauces and canned goods, like bamboo shoots, coconut milk, and Mae Ploy red curry paste.

As another reviewer suggested, do check the expiration dates! Overall, it's a decent place to get Asian ingredients.

Decent restaurant but overpriced for sure. Best thing about Sqwires is their beautiful Lafayette Square location and the Banana Foster French Toast available during Sunday brunch only. They have a wide variety of wines, outside seating which is very nice during summer months and plenty of parking available on the shared lot. The lot is open to residents and several other businesses in close proximity so on gorgeous days it can fill up fast. Fret not, there's street parking and other small lots close enough to park and walk a bit. If you're in the area stop in, the building alone is worth seeing. The service and food aren't necessarily wow factors. 

~Christy

I went here a few times for haircuts, and they were really great.  However, the last time I went, I went to have my hair colored.  My roots had grown out and I asked the stylist to match my natural color so I could try to end the vicious coloring cycle!  I ended up with carrot orange hair.  At the salon I deluded myself into thinking it was ok, but as time wore on and my roots grew in again, it was incredibly obvious it was nowhere close.  I take some blame for not going back and giving them the opportunity to fix it, but I didn't want to take the chance of another botch, so I went to a color specialist who had to bleach out the orange before layering my natural strawberry blonde back in.  Sad face.

So, the moral of the story is that they are a very friendly and competent salon with regard to haircuts, but I'd recommend finding another place for color.

My only first thoughts are wow. We had tried this place awhile ago and loved it and I have no idea why it took so long to come back because the second time was even more amazing than I remembered. It is tucked away in south city, but absolutely worth the find. They do not take reservations so have to luck out at the right time or will have a bit of a wait but definitely worth it for the best burger I've had in STL so far. The en fuego is my favorite. Breaded jalapeños and chipotle ranch are two of my favorite things and make for an amazing burger. You can get your fries topped with cheese sauce and idk which is better the cheese sauce or the amazing homemade spicy ketchup. Their menu is full of different amazing crafted burgers so there's something for everyone. If you're in the mood for amazing burgers and fries this is the place. I definitely won't be waiting so long to go back this time I was in a happy food coma the rest of the day after visiting stacked this past weekend! :)
This is my fave restaurant in the cherry hill area! Other restaurants don't compare. Love the vibe, scenery, consistent outstanding food and service! Their Sunday brunch is the best around.

Joe is not only great with haircuts providing an experience like none other I have ever had.
I used to visit Joe for trims once a month but pass his shop in between the parking lot and building I was working in. 
He is always positive and I truly miss having the companionship as well as the best haircut of my life.  If you are new in town, stop by and say hello.
Unfortunately I live pretty far and changed jobs to be closer to home or I would still be visiting him daily.
Thank you for everything Joe!

I cannot say enough good things about this place.  Chris Fowle is a wonderful guy who'll always make sure you're taken care of.  His staff, Donny, Adam, and Wallie are well trained and I trust them completely with all of my vehicles.  I will never use another mechanic.

The charbroiled oysters aren't good; they're an American delicacy. I've had the pleasure of visiting this place--from thousands of miles away--several times over the past few years. The food has never disappointed.

Very good breakfast food, excellent staff and service. I hosted a morning sales force meeting here recently for about two dozen and they were very accommodating for us. Everyone loved the food, service and atmosphere. The broken yolk sandwich with the bacon and avocado is the way to go. I'd go here again anytime.

Don't know what to really say it a grocery store. We ran in to just buy a few things for the BBQ it's was the closest store. We were able to run in and out quick. The checkout lady was super friendly. So if I was in the area again I would go here again.

Wow!  I'd heard good things, but i  was still surprised . Everything fresh.  The pakora was tender, as opposed  to the crunchy overcooked stuff you get elsewhere.   The samosas were the best I've had in years.  I had the dall special which the most flavorful dall I've ever had.  My sons loved their bhindi masala   and smoked chicken curry.  huge nan.  the garlic naan is packed with garlic.  Really nice people.  i'm glad my wife didn't  come with us, because now i have an excuse to go again soon with her.

Nice place in great location. 
Great vibe and crafted drink menu. 
Drinks were good but we left hungry. Why you ask?  Because the Chorizo Dip that we ordered never arrived despite several inquiries over s 45 minute period. We finally left and went to eat elsewhere.  Other patrons seemed to have same issue. Too bad that poor kitchen service ruined our first trip to this joint.

I cannot say enough good things about the service and care that they give their customers at Fairmount dry cleaners.I popped in to Fairmount dry cleaners looking to get a bridesmaids dress hemmed. It was a long dress, with three layers of fabric and I knew it would be costly. Andre took one look and without prompting said "i know you asked for a hem but if I take this in in the back and not the hem line I could save you most of the cost". Hero. they really care about their customers, they could have easily charged me the $100 I was expecting and sent me on my way. Instead he anticipated my needs took it in a different way and instead only charged me the oh so reasonable $30! Thank you for caring guys! One happy bridesmaid.

I ate here for lunch and I must say it was one of the best overall dining experience I have had in years.   The food was fantastic... the service was outstanding... the atmosphere was very nice.     I will head back here again when I return to NOLA.

They seemed nice and offered complimentary drinks and all. But, Nails chipped within a week and the eyelash glue gave me an infection. My eyelids are still itching 4 weeks later. Not to mention all eyelashes fell off within 4 days. Not going back

I also had a Groupon to see Jennifer and was thoroughly impressed.  I've been to several nice salons in Santa Barbara and she surpassed everyone else I've seen.  She was thorough, listened well to my input and wants, and also had great ideas of how to improve my hairstyle.  She was also very pleasant to talk with -- it wasn't awkward small talk for an hour.  

The salon itself was very clean, bright, and open.  I liked it a lot and would definitely return.

I live 2 minutes from Miss Vicki's. Love stopping in for a quick drink and a quick sunset. Food is good and reasonably priced. I feel very comfortable going alone, but I always seem to strike up conversation with someone. People are friendly and polite (so far). 
Miss Vicki's is a children friendly place, which makes me happy because I have grandchildren and will feel comfortable bringing them there.

My husband and I stayed at the Hilton for my birthday 7/28/18 and decided to have dinner downstairs at the Luke. It was AMAZING! The food was our best experience while visiting NOLA. We had two different waitresses and they were super nice! We even were offered a free glass of champagne!

Came here on my birthday because people told me it was free on your birthday (which is true). I unfortunately chose to do korean bbq but i think i should have done hot pot. I'm kinda bougie when it comes to korean bbq but the quality of the meats at this place are far beyond what i'm used to. everything was chewy and not seasoned well. I was a fan of the seafood pancake because it was crispy but there was 0 seafood in it. Not sure if I'll come back but the service was great!

Very relaxing, the cats are well cared for, and great treats for humans and kitties. The staff are very friendly. I really like how they have catifed the space. I also like how you can choose between 30 mins or an hour.

It doesn't exist anymore!!!

My wife and I were very disappointed with the whole mystery theater experience. 

The hors d'oeuvres were just OK, and the meals were only a little better. Service was generally friendly but slow. Something I ate made me ill that night, which is never great.

There seemed to be a contentious relationship between the bartenders and waitstaff, which was rather odd. I watched bartenders blatantly ignore waitstaff when approached for drinks, even though the bar wasn't crowded, and some had to leave empty-handed.

The actors were moderately entertaining, the audience participation was nice, but I strongly advise against submitting your information on the "who done it" ballot. I did this in good faith, but now I'm getting heavily spammed from various sources. Lesson learned.

This DQ is tucked behind a Cox gas station on Oracle Rd. and Rudasill Rd. First of all the counter folks are all so nice.  They always have big smiles to share with their customers that are craving for something gooey and sweet.  Every once in awhile one needs a fix of sweetness to the nth degree.  DQ is waiting for you.  I get the smallest blizzard you can order and just savor over it's goodness.  I don't do this too often because the guilt ravishes me.  So if you are looking for that something special just stop in here and enjoy.  I believe they even have a drive thru.

El Gato Negro is hands down the BEST Mexican Food in the world. I've been to Mexico several times, have lived in Latin America and I have NEVER eaten Mexican food as delicious as El Gato Negro. We used to live in Baton Rouge, LA but would make trips into Nola about twice a month just to eat GN all weekend. If we came Friday night for dinner, chances are we were also there Saturday for lunch...I wasn't kidding when I said, "all weekend!" It's that good. Anyway, we recently moved to San Francisco and have never been more disappointed with  Mexican food. For whatever reason, Northern Cali just doesn't know how to prepare Mexican food. I dream about El Gato Negro and still follow their Facebook page hoping that one day they will open a location in California. We always start out with the queso fundido. It's probably my favorite appetizer on earth. The table side guacamole is pretty amazing too. For my entree, I always get the chicken quesadillas and ask for them to be made on corn tortillas - PHENOMENAL. My hubby orders the fish quesadillas also on corn. Ok, the margaritas...prepare to drink faster than you normally would because they're so succulent. The fresh squeezed house orange margarita is divine. I don't upgrade to "top shelf," but if you're like my hubby and want to kick it up a notch, ask for top shelf tequila. I am counting down the days until I get to eat my favorite quesadillas for the first time in over a year. In a couple of days, we are flying all the way from San Francisco to New Orleans just so that I can get my "fix." Do yourself a favor, and indulge in El Gato Negro. It will undoubtedly be the best Mexican food you've ever eaten in your life. Thursday cannot get here soon enough!

Stayed for a week. Staff is friendly. Rooms are decent size. They have self service laundry on each floor which is convenient. Accommodating for dog with several pet friendly areas. Nice location off highway but inconvenient exit ramp to actually get to hotel. Overall it was nice.

Everything I want & need (and don't need but want) is under one roof. Everyone in the store is friendly, professional & efficient. I know where everything is, but if they move something, someone is nearby to direct me. It's well lit, with wide aisles. When I checkout, if the lines get long, cashiers magically appear. 

This is the Beall's I usually go to. If they don't have a size or color I need, I can usually find someone to look it up on the computer. Then I can drive to the store that has it in stock, or someone will help me order it with free delivery. 

I have a Beall's credit card, and belong to their reward program. When I shop a lot, I get $5-$10 reward certificates. I also like the Beall's bucks that I earn by spending $25 or more. I LOVE Beall's!

Stopped in here Saturday morning for a snack. They make their own lemon and orange sodas, and I can verify that the lemon one is quite delicious. Me and the man split the MEAT personal pizza (9") as a snack, made with lots of local ingredients. No regrets. I'd stop back here for sure!

The hotel recommended Studio 2000 and Brandy was able to fit me in and repair my nail. The repair looked great and I was soo thankful! I will definitely be back my next time in Indy to get one of the award winning pedicures and a spa treatment. Great location, friendly staff, and reasonable prices :). Thank you guys!

The  biggest draw is the delicious bread made on the premises. After a falling out  between the cafe owner and the baker there is no longer homemade bread available. 

Good home style cooking in a nice location. Unfortunately without the homemade bread there isn't a compelling reason to go out of the way.

Versalles is a cuban restaurant with somewhat of a unique atmosphere.  Many years ago this used to be La Teresita, a branch of the popular restaurant chain.   It later became Black Beans,  and now Versalles. 

Let me say the food is good.  The beans (black and red) are cooked cuban style, so for the Puerto Rican cuisine connoisseurs out there be advised the taste is different. The churrasco steak was well made, and the roasted pork was outstanding. The fried plantains were soft and sweet, and the flan dessert was delicious.  Foodwise I'd give it 4 stars. 

I'm knocking off one star because of the atmosphere.  I didn't particularly care for it.  There was nothing wrong, it was just a little strange. The chairs and tables are very elegant, and they have a stage where they apparently have some sort of live entertainment, although I've missed it the times I've been there. However, someone decided that purple light bulbs was a good idea, giving the place a strange look. There is also a pool table and several flat screen tvs (it does say bar and grill on the sign outside) in what looks like an attempt to create a sports bar atmosphere.  However, the attempt falls flat as it clashes with the rest of the more traditional decor. 

If that kind of thing doesnt bother you, you will be rewarded with a delicious meal. If you like cuban food you should give Versalles a try.   And if you like a more lively atmosphere with your meal, you may end up giving this place 1 or 2 more stars.

Had okra fries, catfish, Rice, collared greens, homemade bread and fancy butters. I love farm to table restaurants and this was great for my first time.  Comparable to a number of high end places in Orlando but a low key atmosphere. Definitely worth a drive for this city girl even if it was pitch black outside

I ordered their shrimp tempura and softshelled crab rolls. MmMmMm.  Almost a week without eating rice definitely had its toll on me as an Asian person.  It was so good.  I actually missed rice.  So Asian!!  Even I can't believe it. Wow.  

Each order only came with 4 pieces, but it actually was really compacted with rice.  I regret getting two orders because I was greedy.  One would have been fine for me. Service was not bad at all.  The prices are a bit expensive, but its not too bad.

Rice. Yum. Specialty Rolls. MmMmMm

Stopped here for lunch. Will stop here again. Pleasant atmosphere. Good customer service. Lite music playing. Clean. Now then food : OMG!!

I'm eating healthy right now and this menu was awesome. I opted for the Roll Sod healthy roll. It was fantastic. Sticky vermicelli roll stuffed with lettuce , cucumber and shrimp. Beautiful presentation and served with a light peanut dipping sauce. I added some dry Chilli for a little heat and wow, what an amazing bite. (Be careful - that shit is hot )

I then ordered the Tom Yum Goong. Tasty and a little hint of spice. Fresh vegetables and very savory tomato broth. Just perfect. 

  This place is a gem hidden in a strip mall. Go find it.
Worst McDonald's ever. 3 cars and waited in line for almost 30min. Avoid if possible.

It's a good thing I read the reviews after my Mom's visit or I might not have gone!  Maybe they've changed management   I've been there twice in the past week each time Mon was taken right back. I was impressed with the friendly staff. Mom is 90 with severe arthritis and sciatica so sitting in a dentist chair is painful. Mom was dreading the visit because she's has some bone loss and Christine was going to have to scale deep under gums. So Mom was incredibly pleased with how gentle she was. 
Dr Kasey was very thorough in explaining what's going to be involved in the denture process. Mom isn't hating the idea anymore!

If you're going to get something spicy realize they mean REAL spice. Even though it took a while for my northern taste buds to recover this place was amazing. Our waitress emma recommended some greats beers for my fiancé. The Jack Daniel's lollipops were very good and had a lot of meat on them. The Bloody Mary was VERY spicy! We had a great experience though and the restaurant itself was very cute.

I saw a good-value car on the CarValue website, called, was assured the car was available and made an appointment to see it.  When I got there, after driving over an hour, I was told the care was having work done to it and not available. Seems to me a bit of bait-and-switch.  Either was, a waste of time.
I stay at Peppermill monthly and love it.  I have never had a bad time there, never win anything but enjoy my stays.

Authentic Indian/Pakistani eats are hard to come by near Center City, and the honest-to-goodness Indo-Pak craving can, unfortunately, be quelled solely by a trip to University City's hole-in-the-wall halal spots. One of these joints is the original Kabobeesh, whose Pakistani fare's tastiness is, admittedly, outmatched by the hassle it takes to get there from distant neighborhoods. 

When I found out that another Kabobeesh outpost on 4th and South was opening up, I was thus ecstatic. The food here matches the quality of the University City original, in cleaner, more modern digs. I prefer the juicy, expertly marinated lamb kabobs here to the more common, slightly drier chicken, but in reality you can't go wrong with any of Kabobeesh's meats. The vegetable dishes may even outshine the charcoal-grilled kabobs. Both the toothsome, fresh okra and deeply spiced, tender eggplant sides delivered serious flavor while keeping things light, in contrast to the more heavy-cream laden, gringo-fied Indian food you get elsewhere. The rice, though a bit clumpy, was also well-seasoned and cooked. Naans, as expected, have a great rim of char while maintaining adequate fluffiness and chew.

The prices are a bit high here (~$12 for a platter), but the portions are ample. For me, the price is well-worth it for a taste of home near Center City. If you wish to expand your Indo-Pak food horizons beyond tired lunch buffets, do check out Kabobeesh for a glimpse into what many South Asians crave regularly.

I've been going to Pink and White for almost a year now. It's basically like the typical nail salon - average size, about 6 or 7 stations, 6 pedicure chairs, and a waxing area. The staff are very nice and friendly. I get gel nails done and Jenny and Elaine are the best for that. I've had a few other girls do the gel, and they don't seem to last as long as they should. I've had my eyebrows done a few times, and they do a pretty good job. It's a pretty popular place, which is generally a good sign. Even so, the most I've ever waited is 15 minutes. Generally I'm taken within 5 minutes. As with most nail salons, I wouldn't bother making an appointment. If someone gets there before you, they will still take that person. I've found this to be true in most nail salons I've gone to. I would recommend Pink and White. My only complaint is that they play lame movies and boring TV shows, haha.

I have been here more times than I can count and I cannot say enough good things about it.  Every time we go there the food is great.  They use all fresh ingredients and you can taste that in their dishes.  I am not big on green peppers and I have never had a problem ordering something without it (no language barrier problem).  We have tried several other Thai places that are supposed to be the best in St. Louis and they don't even come close to the Thai House.  The owners are friendly and often come out and talk to the customers and make you feel welcomed.   I highly recommend this place to anyone.

Am I being harsh in my rating? I dunno.

Came here on a Sat for brunch. There was a line but I think I waited less than 2mins. The options are your typical breakfast options, the thing here is that it's just fresher I guess.

I went with scrambled eggs, blueberry pancake, hot chocolate and scrapple. What is scrapple? beats me! I just wanted to try something new I guess. Twas okay...a tad bit salty but it complimented the sweet syrup of my pancake.
I ate pretty quickly, done in line 20mins.

The staff were friendly and polite. I don't think I got something here that I found SOOO out of the norm. Would I return SURE. 
I like the feel of it and I'm one to support a lil'buisness like this one.

Next time I think I'll branch out and try other things on the menu.

As I sit and enjoy my Shrimp Cocktail in a Creole sauce- I'm in AWE. 
This is certainly something worth going here for!! The shrimp are sautéed perfectly! And the staff were super friendly- will be back!!!!

You know how calling AT&T with  question/problem is so super awful and will in fact take one entire day?
I'd been putting off an upgrade for months before remembering a person can still walk into a store for help.
And help I got from Melvin who was so nice and patient and informative. The other employees were so smiley, too. And the customers. It was pretty weird.
Anyway left before long with a new phone and total conviction I will never call AT&T again. Except for my landlines. And my internet.
Damn.

This is our go to place for good basic seafood. Nothing fancy or nouvelle here - just fresh fish prepared in your choice of ways: fried, broiled, grilled, blackened, or sauteed. Baby particularly likes the stuffed with crab imperial option. The available fish change from day-to-day depending on what's fresh (they have a seafood market next door if you want to prepare your own). One annoying thing is that there's no printout of the day's fish choices (nor have I ever had a server tell me them or the specials), they're only listed with the specials on a blackboard by the bar out of sight from the dining rooms. So I snap a photo of the blackboard with my cell phone instead of running back and forth. Also, be warned, soda refills are NOT free. Last time, our server kept offering Baby refills as though they were complimentary but we were billed for all of them.
So great taste and healthy, what's more, the waiter is so nice and generous! Nice choice, I will definitely come back with my bf.^_^

For example, this August we registered for small groups, and now in late October, we have yet to be placed with a group. We are new to the Indy area and we were hoping to find a solid church family, but we will have to try elsewhere.

This was recommended by a hotel nearby,  should have walked away when seeing only 2 cars in the lot at dinner time.  Was not greated at the door, guy waved me down a hallway. Place was not very welcoming,  dark and hard to see. Have had sushi in over 59 countries,  have never sat at the sushi bar and not been greated by the chef. Was there about 1 hour, he never acknowledged me even sitting there. Ordered Spicey conch and octopus salad, i think they forgot the conch because i didn't see any.  Had Chirashi, fish was good, rice was cold and sour, way too much rice wine vinegar in it. Would not recommend this place.

Love the burritos and cucumber margaritas. Food comes out fast and furious so if your on a time crunch for lunch it shouldn't be a problem. The only reason I didn't do 5 star is the greetings aren't always pleasant. When we walked in hostess was seating another table and a server walked by and said " hostess will be right back"   No hi or hello or welcome.  Other than that everything was great!

I'd give 3.5 if I could.  The food was interesting and I guess mostly good but I wasn't in love.  The salsa to start was awful: instead of salsa we got "chipotle mayo and tomato sauce" Really?  Just give me a bowl of salsa next time.  (To be fair, the tomato sauce looked orange and watery like cheap Ragu brand spaghetti sauce but it tasted OK)

My main course was called "verde" and was chicken stuffed with spinach, cheese and chorizo with a verde sauce.  It was tasty but pretty dried out.  Husband had vera cruz style grouper which tasted good but he wasn't impressed with the quality of the fish itself.

The restaurant is cute but the dining room is TINY and we were seated at an awkward table that was on top of another couple and in the way of the wait staff walking to and from the kitchen.

I'll give it another try but I really wasn't wowed.  I don't think this place is worth going out of your way to visit.
Very good food and much healthier than it's vegan neighbor....I frequent this place but the one and only knock with them are the portions, very very small.....I always leave this palce hungry.....

We stopped in here during a recent visit home and it was as delicious as I remembered. The food was ready fast and exactly as ordered. The employees were overly friendly and courteous. I will definitely be back when we visit Tucson again!

First of all, I wanna tell you that I am Deaf and American Sign Language is my primary Language. I went to Mellow Mushroom in Washington, DC and Arkansas. I was super excited when I found out that they opened one in St. Louis. My parents went to one of their restaurants in Arkansas. 

Yesterday, my parents, my grandma (it was her first time), and I walked into the restaurant and we were greeted by hostesses. The hostesses told us that we will need to wait approximately 20 minutes; they noticed that I signed to my parents. We killed our time and visited their merchandise; they sell t-shirts, drinking glasses, and shot glasses. My grandma wanted to buy one drinking glass for me, but she didn't know if she should pay for it before we receive the bills. She asked one of hostesses (40s, short brown hair) and that hostess rudely and repeatedly shouted, "YOU CAN PAY IT AFTER LUNCH!" My parents and my grandma are hearing and they heard her. I am Deaf and it doesn't mean that my parents and my grandma are also Deaf. I honestly was upset about that because it was my grandma's "first time" and you have no idea how I was excited introducing her the best potato pizza in the whole wide world. I would recommend the manager or the trainer to provide the sensitivity training for workers to interact with elderly people and people with disabilities. 

I am the big fan of their trippy painting walls and sculptures!

Luckily, we did not have to wait approximately 20 minutes. We were assigned to the table and we ordered the bowl of Caesar salad and two large pizzas (Red Skin Potato Pie and Mighty Meaty). Our waitress (25s, blonde) was awesome! We got the "cold" potato pizza and my mom expressed her concerns to the waitress. The manager visited our table and gave us another potato pizza to go! I am giving them 5 stars!

I am definitely looking forward to visit more Mellow Mushroom restaurants!

I love Posh Salon! Josie made my hair look fabulous. My consultation was great. She actually listened to what I wanted and gave me feedback about which hairstyles would suit my face shape. This is extremely important. She will not let you walk out with an unflattering cut. I've been to stylists that have not helped me in this way and I was unhappy with my cut. I don't get to the Salon as often as I should, Josie's cut grew out beautifully. If you want a quality cut and or color from a true hair guru that listens to what you want, go see Josie at Posh! I cannot recommend a better salon experience. :)

Great sandwiches and I love pickles! This is a much easier location to get to that the downtown location but you do lose the ambiance that is associates with the Nashville spot. Hot pastrami sandwich is my bread and butter and no one is better. I would give it 5 stars but I have to comment on the service. Slower than most places, and not as friendly. I know it's a Nee York deli but we are in Nashville so customer service is king!

Had an excellent lunch from here (Takeaway) I ordered the grilled fish tacos and think I received the Baja (?) tacos instead (fish was breaded) but the tacos were still excellent, fish was very fresh and cooked perfectly. My husband had the Padaro burger and it was also excellent, juicy and just the right amount of sauce and toppings. Highly recommend lunch from here if in the area.
Friendly people and I love the breadsticks.  The cheesey dip is one of the best around.

Booked my appointment with Dr. Butler.  First saw Sandra Brice, PA.  I was not too impressed with her personality and conversation skills.  She was blunt, direct, and cold.  When she finished, a nurse came in with 2 scripts for MRI's, cervical and lumbar spine.  Nothing for thoracic.  I asked, and was told that between the two images, they could see the thoracic spine.  As I was being ushered out, I asked, "do I get to see Dr. Butler, you know the one I made my appointment with?"  It seemed to me that meeting with Dr. Butler was all but forgotten. 

Upon meeting him, I almost wished I didn't.  As I was telling him my symptoms and areas of pain, he was telling me where I should be feeling pain...because it's in the textbooks and he only works with science.

Doctor....I'm a fan of science and validity too...but when dealing with patients, I suggest you listen first.  Don't they teach you to listen in med school?  

Regardless, I went to get my "MRI" today and was told they will not image the thoracic area of the spine.  So, guess what?  I need a third script!  (Didn't I ask about that?). And whose time, money and resources have been wasted yet again?  Not the doctors - for sure.  I've been on the phone, driving to offices wasting my work day, time, gas, and money...and I still don't have a diagnosis, an image, pain relief, or a good feeling about my medical care.  

I love Susan Griffith at this practice (my kids see her), but after meeting once (years ago/different issue) with Dr. Boylan and now this yahoo....I just don't have a warm fuzzy feeling about this practice.  

Too much God complex, not enough patient centered care.  Well...I guess you get what you pay for!

The view is fantastic and the best thing going for HB. We ordered the smothered grouper for $24, and it was just ok. It didn't taste like real grouper and had a pinkish color. The manager insisted it was red grouper flown in from somewhere. The white sauce on the fish did not have much flavor.  The Honolulu roll was flavorful, but pricey for the size. Should have been in $10-12 price point. Think will stock drinks and the ambience.
My absolute favorite crawfish and crabs spot. I buy fresh fish, shrimp, and gumbo crabs from them as well. Not up for debate. That is all.

I cannot say enough about how wonderful Roya is. She took my wedding dress from "the dress" to "MY dress." And let me tell you, it couldn't have been easy! There was A LOT of dress to alter. I'm still in awe of her work, and I still can't believe how great her price was! She even altered my rehearsal dinner dress for free, and she gave me a crystal and pearl comb to wear in my hair. If you're looking for someone to make your dress dreams come true, then look no further!

The caring and attentive staff at VSEC not only saved my cat's life the day we brought her into the ER and during her time in the ICU that followed - but Dr. Hamilton diagnosed her very rare blood disorder and got her on the meds she needed. I am so grateful to have another holiday season with my girl and it's amazing to see her feeling and looking better than she has in years . If I could give more than 5 stars, I would.

The things I HATE about this place:

1) RUDE service
2) LOUSY food. Nothing Hawaiian about it. 
3) Unhelpful employees
4) Filthy bathroom
5) Incorrect/incomplete orders
6) Employees more interested in phones than service

In short: SAVE YOUR MONEY!

Culinaria is what I want it to be. Nothing more, and nothing less. 

Said place makes sense for downtown, when sometimes downtown makes little sense. Culinaria carries the products that one dwelling downtown would want to buy. See, those of us living in lofts and staying in hotels prefer not to buy our items in bulk. I have no stand alone freezer or walk in pantry in which to store my 'family-sized' products. Nor do I want these things.

The selections of essentials are plentiful. Beer, wine, poptarts, meats, cheeses and frozen stuff. I am aware that my essentials may vary slightly from yours, but I think you too would be happy with what you find. 

The live music on Saturdays is nice, kind of weird, but none-the-less enjoyable. Sometimes the clientele lurking around the exterior entrances can be dodgy, so I would refrain from making too many friends outside. All in all, I am completely contented with Culinaria being my neighborhood grocery sto.

Yum! What an amazing place, all you have to do is walk by and the smells coming from the bakery are amazing. They have any pastry or bakery item you could imagine focusing on the Greek pastries. Their baklava is out of this world, also had a cannoli and a huge chocolate cupcake. It's attached to Hellas the restaurant so you can have your meal there and order dessert from the bakery or you can go to the bakery  as a separate shop. If you are in Tarpon Springs by the sponge docks, definitely check out Hellas bakery.
Just ordered delivery. Estimate was for 45 minutes, it was here in 18. Good food. Very inexpensive. Cheeseburger was solid and BLT was very good. Highly recommended!
