When I first moved to Philadelphia in 2004 I went to Queen Village b/c they were highly recommended by those in the community. Unfortunately though by 2009 I feel the place has gone down in service. My last experience (about 2 years ago) ended with me waiting over 40 minutes for my appointment and then being rushed through my dog's appointment. My dog suffers from anxiety and it takes her time to warm up to people, but instead of the vet listening to me she rushed into the room and didn't even take the time to get to know my dog-just started the check up. I understand that vets are very busy and that there are other clients waiting, but for me when I'm in the room with you my dog and I are what matters most. Prior to this I had my cat's check up and again was rushed through the entire process. So once I found a new vet (check my reviews!) I haven't returned. Sad to have to leave, but just wasn't the right fit.
Definitely a must eat when in Nashville. My wife ordered the strawberry chicken salad. 5/5. I ordered the catfish n' chips. Best fries I've ever had and the catfish was amazing. Great service.
I love Old Town Coffee! The vibe is so nice and the bagels are yummy! My friends and I always come here during finals week and it's a great study spot as well.

My friend has been telling me how much she loves this place for quite some time. So I decided to go there and give it a try. 

It was nice. Not a place I would recommend to go if you plan on getting the full dining experience or a date. It's just a small, chilled spot that you may want to go to just to get good food and drinks. Its very loud from the music playing, the food was great, [alcohol] drinks very good, non-alcohol drinks are $5 [not worth the mini glass] and the hookas are very popular. I think we were the only table with out one. Overall, it was fun!

Great food, great service on a great Saturday night. The only bummer was having an obnoxious  couple at the bar bumping into us and arguing throughout the night, a bit cramped for romance. Would certainly try again.

If I could give this company 0 stars I would. I have been using them for almost 1-1/2 years and my lawn has gone from bad to worse. I had new sod put in about a year ago as well as new landscaping an bushes. Most of it is dying or dead with tons of weeds in the lawn. I call and text and nobody responds. Do not trust this business, I get notifications that they are coming but I haven't seen them in weeks. They may even be out of business but since I cannot reach them, how would I know. Stay clear.

I have tried Gateway twice now and both times the service has been fast and friendly. As far as the dogs go my favorite thus far is the Hot Papa, the Grilled Chipolte onions relish give it a great sweet and spicy tang.
The Blue apple brat is fantastic if you like blue cheese, I was surprised to like the sweetness of the cooked apples. The only miss thus far is their namesake Gateway Beer 'n pretzel dog, the pretzel bun was delicious and chewy, but it went downhill from there with soggy microwave looking bacon and watery cheese sauce. If you go get the california/freese fries..you wont be disappointed, but may need a breath mint!

****Lunch Only Review****

I wanted to go somewhere special for my Adoption Day but I had work later that day so my mom and I decided to go here...I was longing for the days of Yamatos in Trazana,CA...
We walked in and were seated right away...the service was great...the good was yummy...even though I would rather have had miso soup instead of the onion...the cook came...and was fun...i enjoyed my meal...

Hands down, the best Japanese fare I've ever had.  I live on the west coast where sushi and seafood are as fresh and abundant as you can find, but still, nothing compares to Morimoto.

My mother and I treated ourselves to a meal of a lifetime (cliche, I know, but true) by ordering the omakase.  Every single dish was incredible!  Fantastic flavours, fresh product, outstanding presentation, and the excellent service didn't hurt either.  I went back again with some friends and tried a large variety of dishes including the miso black cod, steamed scallops, surf and turf, and various sashimi/sushi pieces.  Wasn't on the same level as the omakase meal but delicious all the same.

Highly highly recommended.

Different Cheesesteak #905.  I have been waiting to try Al's.  Big operation.  10 am and at least 10 other people waiting for sandwiches.  Big operation.  Salads and deli stuff looked amazing.  The cheesesteak was $8 and it is a corner deli.  Very Good corner store cheesesteak.  Very good balance, mix and amount of cheese, fried onions and mushrooms.

THE CARROT AT THE END OF A BITTER STICK
I always dread visiting this part of town because the circumstances are never good: standing in line to sort property taxes, disputing tickets in traffic court, visiting a sick friend at Tulane Medical, etc. But ever since it moved here, high-quality, reliable Pho Tau Bay is my reward. 

A CASE STUDY IN HOW TO RUN A RESTAURANT
With so many new arcane-genre over-priced and poorly executed eateries, Pho Tau Bay is among a handful of openings that gets it right:
1. Counter Serve: efficient and no waiter tip.
2. Refillable cold drinks.
3. Lots of flexible stool and bench seating.
4. Condiment bar including sriracha and hoison.
5. Constant busing so even crowded tables are clean.
6. And it's a snazzy build-out!

We had heard a lot of good things about this place, so we figured we'd check it out.  However, we were pretty disappointed.  The sushi tasted extremely salty and cheap.  It's overpriced for the quality.  We won't be going back.

This is a nice little location right next to the movie theater in the shopping plaza. There is both indoor and outdoor seating. I came here with my friend for Taco Tuesday. Tacos are normally $3.75 each but they're only $2 on Tuesdays.

The tacos are pretty big compared to most places that I've been to for Taco Tuesday. I got the chipotle pork, fried avocado, and shrimp taco. I would definitely recommend the shrimp taco over the rest. Not too big of a fan of the other ones.

More amazing service considering how travel has changed. My wife and I got to spend time with the amazing Captain and crew during a layover in Nashville and they were incredible without ever trying. My favorite Airline and the only one I have stocks with.
I can't wait until they start going to Europe. 
As always I am not related or friends with any Southwest employee's. Keep up the great work Southwest.......

Yes, it's a tapas bar.  Yes, it's located in the heart of the Hill.  Yes, I see the irony of a Spanish restaurant being located smack dab in the middle of St. Louis' Little Italy.

Doesn't matter.  Modesto is one of the longest standing tapas restaurants in the St. Louis area and it's title is well deserved.  It is a fantastic little spot.

I was home a few weeks ago to celebrate my birthday, so as a special treat, my mom and I had a "girls day" together, which included having dinner at Modesto.  We made a reservation for Saturday night and arrived a bit early (around 6), when it was still very uncrowded.  The inside of the restaurant is very cool.  It's filled with dark wood, large floor to ceiling windows, a nice bar, and a good view of the kitchen so you can actually glance over if you choose to see the tapas being prepared.

The menu was very extensive and since we were being decadent (and eyes were bigger than stomachs), we ended up getting six tapas to split between the two of us.  I should also note that since gluten free appears to be the trendiest food intolerance to have lately, the menu conveniently highlights those items and/ or your server can explain ways to make others gluten free.

So here's what we got: bacon wrapped figs stuffed with chevre cheese, goat cheese flan (so unusual), steamed mussels, lamb skewers, the braised beef short rib (a special that night) and the crispy pork belly.  Plus, they brought out a complimentary board of fresh baked bread with olive tapenade and whipped butter.  Yum!

Everything was very good.  The crispy pork belly was a little chewy, but other than that it was fantastic.  The figs were juicy and the bacon crispy (a very good combo of salty and sweet), the goat cheese flan actually had the light, airy consistency expected of flan as well as great flavor, the steamed mussels were bathed in the best broth I've ever tasted (I sopped up extra broth with the bread), the braised beef was well seasoned and very tender and the lamb skewers were perfectly cooked.

We managed to eat everything, but it was a bit of a struggle at the end and we had no room for the famed desserts like the black and white bread pudding or flan.  Ah, well, maybe next time.  

Service was excellent throughout and I would definitely go back in the future to try some more of their dishes and save room for dessert that time too!  Bravo Modesto, bravo!

Compared to other gay bars in Tucson, Brodies is a total dive. I've been there twice and had two bad experiences. Drinks are priced right, but the owner gets angry-drunk and harasses the patrons. This, and the restrooms are nasty.
Needed an upgraded plug for our window AC and they also did a check of the house for any other issues and made recommendations, some we did and some we will wait. I would hire them again.

I am not impressed with the tap list here. The last couple times I have gone, most of the beers were out so there was a limited selection. Usually empty except trivia night. They do have there own parking lot so no need for street parking.
The bartender was really nice but the nachos were so soggy and gross I could hardly eat them. The chicken was rubbery and something about it just tasted spoiled. Definitely not going back.

If you're craving something fast, cheap, and AMAZING then this is the place to go!  Parking is a little hectic depending on the time.  This is a no frills, simple kind of place.  You walk up to the counter to order and you can sample anything you want to try.

The staff was very friendly, and your food beats you to your table.  The guy working the counter let us eat before paying because they do not accept cards and we didn't have cash on us.  After we were done we ran across the street to grab cash from the ATM.

I would have rated it 5 stars, but even with great food, great prices, and great service... It's 2014 and not accepting cards is in unacceptable in my opinion.  If they raised the prices a little to absorb the cost of taking cards I'm sure nobody would complain.  I never carry cash and paying an ATM fee and having to take a separate trip really kills the experience.

Good chocolates at a reasonable price - definitely cheaper than Godiva. My mom won't shut up about the raspberry cookie covered in chocolate, or the raspberry chocolate bar. She said "they do raspberry really well." 

Guess I'll have to bring her here so she can stock up on the goodies she liked from Mother's Day!

Shrimp and Grits: lumpy undercooked grits and okay sauce, totally underwhelming dish
Lean mean platter: I did not get the turkey bacon I ordered.  Breakfast potatoes: cooked in rancid oil- horrible 
I got charged for bacon I didn't get, I had pointed out to the server, no apologies from her.  Also got charged "service fee" for using a credit card without notice.  
I will NEVER go back there.

My go-to buffet in the Wilmington area. Just remember, it's a buffet so don't expect the best quality for all the dishes. You have to pick and choose to find the good stuff. I recommend the hibachi in the back right corner of the dining area for the best quality
They deliver to the warehouse district!  Enough said. No more pizza for me.

This place is beautiful! My group of 4 sat at a table on the front porch and enjoyed a bottle of wine and delicious bread pudding! There were musicians playing inside one of the front rooms and it was so relaxing to listen while we socialized.....overall the Hotel is just gorgeous!

However......the service here is horrendous! After 15 minutes of waiting at our table we decided to go to the bar and place our own order. The waitress NEVER even acknowledged us! We purchased a bottle of wine and shared it at our table, getting our own glasses and pouring it ourselves. Sometime during the night we were able to flag down the waitress and order bread pudding (of which was magnificant! It was the best I'd ever had!). But, she never came back! After our stay of about an hour and a half we decided to leave cash on the table to cover the cost of the bread pudding.

When we left only then did the waitress notice our existence. She ran after us as we rounded the corner to our vehicle. She yelled, "Hey, don't leave without paying me! You ordered bread pudding and didn't pay for it!" My husband turned and calmly explained that we left her cash on the table for our order, and that we were just tired of waiting for her. So then she scurried away without even apologizing. He also reminded her very nicely that we left NO TIP.

I think whomever manages this Hotel needs to be made aware of the horrible service. The establishment is beautiful and paying patrons should be given respect at the very least.

We had a high quality meal at this restaurant.  The scallops were the best we have ever eaten anywhere.   The rest of the meal was amazing as well as the service.   Everything was so fresh and the drinks were excellent as well.  I will recommend this restaurant to friends who will be visiting in the future.   If you only have time for one meal out in NOLA, I would HIGHLY recommend GW FINS!!

I was born in Tucson and I love this city. One of the must-do's when I visit is eat at The Lucky Wishbone. Their fried chicken livers are what I base all other chicken livers by. I dream about them & my Mom does too. There's just something special about the salty-hint of sweet, crunchy outside and soft yet firm livery inside that can make one swoon ( or gag if you hate liver). I love the box the food comes in. When you get that white container with the red lettering & illustration of a boy & girl forever pulling on each side of a giant wishbone, the box heavy with promise, you lift the lid and there it all is, glorious fried nirvana! My Dad loved the steak fingers, my brother loved the chicken and my boyfriend (who was a skeptic until we vacationed in Tucson) loved the shrimp. Let's face it, it's an institution. The fries are good, the shrimp sauce is good, the place hardly changes through the years and that's refreshing, when so many classics feel the need to constantly evolve.There are several stores, all in Tucson. They basically are all good. I'm surprised and sorry to read the negative reviews as I've never had a bad meal here. When you need something good and fried this is thee place to go! Even if you have to fly to get there.

Very good sushi, but not a fan of the ramen. My family visited twice, and both times tried different ones and they still lacked flavor to us. Not many good options on their kids menu. Customer service is really good.

Service and presentation are always on point, but somehow every time I leave here I do not feel satisfied with the meal. The sizzle is better than the steak. We nitpick as to why this or that does not taste good, then we end up coming back because of the inviting atmosphere. I think we just hit the end of the line. If the taste does not quite fit, then it's time to quit!

This is one of our favorite family restaurants! We have 2 teenage girls and eat here all the time. 

You do not have to like sushi to have a good meal here. Their veggie steamed gyoza dumplings are amazing. I always start out with clear mushroom soup as it is healthy and only costs $2. I really don't think anyone in the times we have visited has disliked their food. 

The servers are awesome and very accomodating. They bring us ice buckets for white wine, never complain when we need to change an order, and work as a team. 

BYOB to boot! Can't beat it.
Super bland food, tasted good after drenching it in hot sauce otherwise it tasted like air, they're way over priced for the quality food they serve, I wouldn't go back here
Came for lunch after seeing this place on yelp and was blown away. The tacos were incredible and Tyler was quick and courteous. Will definitely be coming back

the happy hour deals here are the best! my favorite thing at copa is definitely the $5 lime margs if you go between 4-7pm. their cheap food options are mediocre choices, but the best thing on their menu is SPANISH FRIES WITH REAL CHEDDAR so delicious 10/10 would recommend!!! the reason i gave 3/5 stars because their service tends to be really slow which sucks (even though everyone is really friendly) and a lot of their other food options are expensive and mediocre...would still recommend spanish fries tho:)

Hot and Noisy!
When I cannot sleep at night at this time 2am at this hotel, I have time to write this review! What else I can do? 
No air conditioning in summer, the fan is noisy I have to turn off! I had slept about 1 hour until the room upstairs they cannot sleep and they keep walking around like crazy now!!!!!
Headache! 
Tell me what can I do now after a long drive on road trip and now you cannot sleep because of this environment!
Two stars for the swimming pool and the room and the staff but he closed the office at 10pm! Can't complain!
I really mad now and really want to sleep! I have another long drive tomorrow!

Very disappointing dining experience. The two star rating is only because we were a walk-in party of fourteen the day after Christmas, We were seated in a very cold and drafty room the chairs were very flimsy plastic and two were broken. The food and service were mediocre at best. We had to ask for a beer list and were only given one for a party of 14. The menu unimaginative, just the usual pub fare.

Quite possibly one of the worst restaurant experiences ever. If it weren't for the bartender's pronounced disdain there would have been no interaction at all. Five video game machines, uninteresting bar food and filthy bathrooms. Do yourself a favor and go to the crappy McDonald's on Canal Street.

Got s chain restaurant the atmosphere is always popping. The food has a Caribbean flare to it.  Definitely a place to go with friends and enjoy a good time. The service is excellent and the prices for the amount of food they serve is very reasonable.

Seemed promising in the beginning - but my reservation price quoted was different than what I was told upon check in, then they wanted to charge for wifi, then after arriving early and told I could check in a couple hours early I was told I could not...Then when I tried to voice my opinion I was told I could always stay elsewhere, so I did..last time I give ol Motel 6 a shot.

If you sign a lease with these people you might as well be signing your soul over to the devil.  DO NOT RENT FROM THIS COMPANY!! 

What you've been reading is 100% true and then some- no security, no communication and no f*cks are ever given by PMC.

Theresa did amazing work on my wedding dress. I purchased an old sample at a wedding boutique and it was at least two sizes too big. The entire dress was beaded so the smallest alteration was going to be an ordeal. Teresa was able to expertly hem and take in the dress, making it couture. She added lingerie straps and even washed an area that had been soiled. With all of my family out of state, it was a wonderful experience to prepare my dress with such a warm and nurturing lady as Teresa.  

Teresa only accepts cash. So bring it with you or you visit the ATM in La Fortuna, the grocery store on the corner. Also be sure to bring your receipt with you and have Teresa annotate it with each payment. I had failed to bring my receipt and my final payment was not marked on Teresa's copy. This was a regretful and uncomfortable experience after such a positive interaction at Special Occasions. Just bring your receipt and make sure it's always up to date and you'll have a very pleasant experience working with Teresa.

Solid family friendly trails that leads to a natural tar pit beach. 

We wanted to stretch our legs before the long drive back down to San Diego. The Carpinteria Bluffs are right off the 101 and there's a reasonably sized dirt parking lot. The path along the bluffs is well traveled with several opportunities to cross train tracks and get right to the edge. 

From the dirt parking lot we went RIGHT (North) and we eventually were forced to cross train tracks.  That's where the small path is located that takes you down to the beach. Much of the path  that goes down to the beach is made from tar and looks like molten lava. If you're lucky it's low tide as you'll be able to climb around the tide-pools and see marine life. There's also sea glass here too, but alas also sticky tar. 

When we first walked along the rocks we noticed the distinct smell and saw all the sticky tar  of the rocks and pools of rainbow oil floating in the water ( see picture). I totally thought this was the remnants from a major oil spill but I later found out it's actually a natural tar pit ( Like the one in La Brea). Apparently there's a beach farther north called Tar Pt Beach but it's past the seal sanctuary.

- It's a good family friendly diversion from a long drive..
- There's also a seal rookery in this same area. Check the yelp page for exact directions.

Finally, a Mexican food joint in New Orleans that I can get excited about. So many positive things to mention about La Carreta on Magazine St. 

First up, absolutely delicious margaritas prepared with fresh ingredients. We tried the mango, cucumber, traditional and strawberry mint margaritas - all were delicious! My favorites were the mango and the strawberry mint. The latter was original and amazing. 

Second, the decor is cute AF. The VW bus bar is adorable. Love the chill, laid back and relaxed vibe that has enough special details (skeleton wearing a poncho and riding a bicycle? YAS) to keep your eyes entertained. 

Third, the food is very good. I had the tamales, which also came with a chili relleno. All were prepared from fresh ingredients and were so darn tasty. As a table we also shared chips & queso, which I highly recommend. 

Finally, the service is excellent. Louis (I hope I'm spelling your name right, sir, because you are a treasure!) was on top of everything that night. Anticipating our needs, checking in with us regularly and generally being a delight. Couldn't have asked for a better service experience.

I can't wait to go back!

Do not do the grocery delivery or pick up. It took  4 times to get it right. I placed my order before I arrived in Florida on Monday and it is now Wednesday and I am still trying to get my groceries even after speaking to a customer service representative    this system is flawed  and instead of cancelling my order how about a phone call first. They just assumed it was fraudulent. 4 x. Even after I spoke to them. Its ridiculous. I'm visiting my son at college and wanted to make things easy and not spend my time in a store ,but with him.  The staff are very NICE BUT the system is lacking profoundly. Never again. !!! AND now waiting for our groceries after having to pick them up since we couldn't get them delivered. Took 20 minutes. This is unsatisfactory and not what I would expect from Walmart. Dissatisfied and disappointed. But your employees did their best under the circumstances.

All flavors are low fat or fat free!  The yogurt is priced reasonably (a 1/3 filled cup came out to about $1.50) and so yummy.  Try the cherry amaretto with slivered almonds, maraschino cherries, and chocolate chips!  I can't wait to come back and try more.  The non-dairy pink lemonade sorbet was the perfect tartness, if you want to go that route.  

The store is very clean and in addition to tables, there are big white leather couches.  There is also seating outside.  Yes, it's a parking lot, but the seating is under an awning, so at least you stay cool...and have a lovely view of Michigan Road.

I love that they have a water dispenser with cups for free water.

Excellent, excellent customer service!

My boyfriend and I have been talking about rings and I went to look at settings, since I already have my grandmother's diamond.  I went with my best friend, for some moral support.  I'm heavily tattooed, which puts some people off, yet I was greeted right away, with a smile and offer of assistance.  

Bonnie was SO helpful and awesome!  She really made the process quick and painless. AND she help me narrow my choices to that ONE ring.  She answered any questions I had and told me if I needed anything else, to get in contact with her.  

Bonnie gave me a "hint, hint" card with all of the ring information on it, so when the time is right, the boyfriend will have an idea of what I love.  I will definitely be recommending Ramsey's to others looking for diamond jewelry!

Holy crap. This was such a fun experience! I booked online for myself and three friends for an afternoon escape show on a Wednesday. This was my first Room Escape, but not my boyfriend's. He said this was hands down the best one he had ever been to. Our zombie's name was Sawyer. He was such a trip! I think the girl who lead room was Sara. Even though the pressure was synthesized, my fear for my life was very real! We solved the puzzle with just twenty-five seconds left and escaped with our lives and a good memory.
I love taking the airbus !! Makes flying into & out of LAX a breeze. I use it several times a year and always think it's a great deal.

Firstly, I love that this place has its own parking lot. I had never been and was nervous the entire drive downtown anticipating the parking situation, so that was a pleasant surprise!

The building is huge and I love the way they designed the place. Lots and lots of brick and wood elements but with pops of red from the modern chairs. I headed upstairs to meet my people and saw the entire back wall was filled with arcade games, which we later find out are 100% free! Skee ball, Galaga, Super Mario, and more - all at no cost while you enjoy their beer menu. I had a Zellige, their Moroccan coffee stout, and it was de-lish. We didn't get food but I did glance through that menu and it was tempting as well. 

Service was quick and friendly, bathrooms were modern and clean, and I overall really enjoyed the space and the beer. Would definitely come back!

Kenneth Stover saved me from an injustice DUI. He really went above and beyond to search threw cop cams, police report, and detailed every video, sound, and report he saw. This man deserves over 5 stars. He has extensive knowledge that no public defender can give you and his credentials behind the degree is extensive. He's a man with integrity and is Trustworthy and at no point did I feel like he wasn't keeping me in the loop with many things like: potential rulings while going through my file initially, Median, and at the end; where my case truly stood in perspective to himself and prosecutor. I can't give this man and his team over 5 stars, but if I could, I would. This man gave justice where it was deserved and did not lose. He's a fire not to be messed with

Our car was leaking oil after another place damaged the washer on the oil tank while doing a simple oil change. Terry's took care of us in a very timely manner despite fact that they were very busy. All their people are well trained and top notch. They really know their business and take the time needed to do a complete and excellent job for every car they service. They are the best.

This place has a large beer selection from all over the world and a pretty good $3 Bloody Mary on their weekend brunch menu. I didn't eat since I had had a large cheesesteak a couple hours before but my friends had the parfait and the sweet potato duck hash, both of which they found delicious.  We sat outside and although it took a little while to get our drinks right in the beginning, after that our server was attentive and pleasant. I enjoyed my visit!

Great variety in entries, salad, and deserts, but there are some days, the menu doesn't appealing. I like their made to order omelet section during breakfast, and pho sections during lunch time. If you get in before 10:30, you can enjoy both!!
The service is definitely depends on server. They have some awesome servers who never leave your glass empty, and put away dirty plates away in a perfect timing. If you get the one who doesn't care about customers,  you won't get your drink until a half an hour after you sit at the table, and no refills until you ask four or five times.

Great pork poboy. The wife had the muffaleta which was also good. Yes you can get both at johnnys or the famous grocery but they close early so you won't miss out, go to maspero's. Our server KATIE was great. Spunky and full of life, unlike most others in the area sadly. But overall, great dinner spot to go to in The French quarter that is NOTHING LIKE the trashy bourbon st crowd. Lord help that street. On another note, the bartender was able to make me a Tokyo Iced tea, which I always have a hard time finding someone that can make that. If you don't know, you better find out.

I love coming here for takeout.  The staff is super friendly.  I would highly recommend the buffalo chicken bowl.  You can put of substitute spaghetti squash for the base in the bowls.  

The wine and beer list is unique and reasonable.   Very good service at the bar for takeout.  The staff is very knowledgeable about the menu.
Good ambience and excellent service. The food, however, was terribly disappointing. It was just overwrought. Everything -- every ELEMENT of everything -- was an assault on the palate.

Had a great time tasting for my moms birthday. The location was COVID-safe and my mom had a great time on her birthday! Eliza was fantastic--friendly and knowledgeable! The sparkling wines are really something special :)

The only reason it gets 2 stars are for the two employees who worked hard, were apologetic for the slow service and they fixed my order (even though they didn't work in the kitchen). Their names are Maria and Olivia. The place cute but the service in the kitchen is inefficient and food is delivered slow. I waited 15 minutes for a cold egg and cheese biscuit and a coffee. Maybe it's because the store is trying too hard to get in orders (kiasks, double lane drive thru), that they can't deliver quality service and in a fast food time.

Tried this new place and was quite surprised.  Menu's - $9.99 with choices, buffet right from kitchen $18.99 or their single order menu. We chose the $9.99 and had plenty to eat.

One soup, two appetizer and either - one entree OR choose three sushi rolls with two sashimi rolls. Everything was seasoned well and fresh. Will return!

Very friendly and helpful. Very affordable and reasonable price. Locally owned, Tim does an exceptional job dealing with me. He's very knowledgeable and very experienced. I was with the big pest company, but they keep jacking up the payment. I'm glad I switched. Support locally owned businesses. Highly recommended pest control company.

A fun little hipster store, where you can find great unique items and handmade arts and crafts. The prices are higher, but again it's mostly homemade or repurposed art. I love going in and wandering around, there's always something new to see!

Osake is great for both lunch and dinner. They have very affordable lunch specials and all day roll specials. I love that it's within walking distance from my work, too. The sushi has always been good. Granted, it's not the highest grade of fish, but it's still good for what it is. Their vegetable udon and tempura udon are both delicious. Very rarely do I find a broth that I don't need to add extra seasoning to. The waitresses are always so sweet and attentive. The restaurant itself is tightly packed but has a sense of coziness. We had a party of 10+ one night and they were very accommodating. 

Parking may be the only issue. If you're lucky enough, there's a lot in the back that has limited spaces and is only available for customers in that building or the one next to it. There's plenty of meter parking on the street, but lunch time and later in the evening they tend to fill up.

I cannot day enough kind things about this place. Friendly and caring staff. I took my cat in and met Dr Kelly. She is knowledgeable, professional, fun and caring. She explains everything thoroughly. When I needed to update her on the progression of meds, she was quick to call back. She spent time considering what meds to use and explained the pros and cons to me. I never felt rushed or silly or bothersome. I know my "boy" will be well cared for under their wise eyes.

I had a good experience here, the food was good I had a filet and the drinks were good as well. I will say what they have in food, they lack in service. Our waitress just totally disappeared for long stretches of time and it was not crowded at all. I'd go again for the location.

So glad we finally have a place to get fresh produce, meat, seafood and cheese at a reasonable price and that's close to me.  Plus I love all the bulk items you can get here.  There are a few aisles of natural items like toothpaste, deodorant etc. that I really appreciate.  This location just opened so it's a bit crowded but the people working there are very friendly and very accommodating.  Go check it out!!

I ordered the baby back half rack, upgraded to garlic bread to corn bread with green beans and corn on the cob for my sides. The ribs were good, but the cornbread and corn tastes like gas. My friend I came with had the same problem with her corn and garlic bread. You'd think for a place that smokes their own meat tasting gas wouldn't be an issue. I don't think I'll be going back for more any time soon, I don't need gas in my diet - at least not "that" kind of gas!
How long do it take to cook chicken.  it took them 45 minutes for six (6) wings.  Why so long????  I don't understand trying to support, but I might have to Hattie Bee

College Hunks is our go to for moving  and clearing junk we no longer need. I love that they repurpose items in good usable condition. From the office staff to the actual movers, they are all very professional, careful, friendly and helpful.
They make the whole process very easy. Great communication to let the customer know what to expect, and when they will arrive.
They show up when they are scheduled and do an amazing job to preserve the integrity of donated items.
Highly recommend College Hunks!
The food was good and served within a short timeframe. No major issues with the service.  The restaurant was not crowded but there was a wait.  Will visit again.

CoAuto is great! A friend referred me when my car needed some work and they were wonderful! My car was in and out very quickly, given the amount of work and the semi-vagueness of the problem. Albert was in touch with me every step of the way and I was given the opportunity to approve everything before the work was done. I ended up spending more than I thought but it was because I had not done the proper maintenance on this "second car" and needed to catch up. I will be taking the car back for regular maintenance from here on!! Thank you Albert and Vinnie!!!!!

I wish i had read the reviews first before becoming a member. During sign up everything was amazing and everyone was so nice and helpful but that quickly changed as soon as we signed the papers. We became members in May and it is now August and we still haven't received ANY documents from them. When i emailed them they completely ignored me for weeks. I literally sent them a dozen email but NO ONE cared to respond. I finally sent them a message on Facebook and was able to get help. They are so unprofessional it makes me wonder how they're still in business. Please do your research first and don't fall for their FAKE im so nice and helpful and here to always help you act!!!!!!!!!!! Wish I could give them negative stars coz thats what they deserve  also they are so dated that they dont even have an online payment system and to make your monthly payments you get a COUPON BOOK that actually looks like a raffle ticket  you dont even get an actual invoice or statement!!!!
Wow amazing tasting sushi. And you can't beat the price of the lunch special .(2 specialty rolls and soup or salad for 14.50$

DO NOT GO HERE IF YOU HAVE A BIRD!!! 
WORST emergency vet experience, EVER! 

First and foremost: 
Emergency vets are expensive. That is a given. I know that. This is not my first time taking my parrot to an emergency vet. This was my first time ever going to this one (bird or otherwise). When I say this is the worst experience, I truly mean it. 

I brought my parrot in on a holiday weekend at about 4 am. I already knew the diagnosis. It was obvious; we needed assistance to make her comfortable. Before even handing her over to the receptionist/AHT, we asked if the doctor on shift (Dr. Latif) had any experience with birds. She said yes. It wasn't long before we were brought into a room with armchairs to negotiate his fees. 

He said flat out, he had no experience with birds. UHHHH... alright.. so what can you do for us? Well, for the estimated price of $1400-$1600, I could have my bird stay with them overnight and have a number of unnecessary tests done.  OH, and POSSIBLY have a specialist brought in the next day to see her. POSSIBLY. After pointing out the extraneous fees and tests, he dropped the price range to $600-800. 

I was incredibly offended that he would even try to take advantage of me and my bird like he had. There was NO WAY I was leaving my bird in the hands of a dishonest man... who had no experience with birds. What? Didn't make enough money over the holiday weekend, that he tried to maximize the amount of money he could make off of my bird?

I left having to pay the $126 exam fee, incredibly frustrated since:

A) I was told the doctor had experience with birds, when he didn't.

B) The very snotty receptionist/AHT said to me, in response to me having mentioned this fact, "Oh, no she [the other AHT/receptionist] wouldn't have said that."

REALLY? What do I have to gain from lying about her saying that? NOTHING. That is just unprofessional and misleading. Educate your staff on what you do/do not have experience with... and keep the rude ones away from the front desk where money is collected.

C) There was no gain from the visit. Nothing was done to make my bird comfortable. I did not leave with more knowledge than I came with. I could have probably taught him a thing or two about birds. 

If you have a bird, go to Delton Veterinary Hospital and see Dr. Person. He will do EVERYTHING in his power to squeeze you in for an emergency appointment. That is a doctor that TRULY cares about the welfare of his patients. You can tell he genuinely loves animals.

(***ADDED: I looked on the FB page of Delton and someone had asked about them seeing Hedgehogs. Instead of them being dishonest and saying they saw them, they referred them elsewhere. That's what I call a good veterinary practice. Take note.)

I can't say anything about taking other species here, but knowing that Dr. Latif had no problem trying to take money for what he had no experience with, I would not recommend it. 

Go to Guardian on 99th for an emergency veterinarian. From my experiences with them (avian and canine), they won't charge you NEARLY as much for the same services.

AMAZING! Matt, the owner of We're On The Move, was the best! He managed to move everything out of my 2nd floor apartment, even the washer dryer, in record time. I would, and have, recommended him to all my friends and family. He's professional, efficient and friendly.

Love this pizza!  This is not your over sauced, cardboard crust, pepperoni junk.  We ordered take out for lunch one day and I was elected to go get it. I walked in as they had just finished packing the order (sandwiches and pastas) but didn't see the pizza I ordered. I quickly found out why. They put the pizza together once I walked in and put it in their wood fired oven and boom just like that it was cooked, it didn't even take 2 minutes. Everyone loved their food and my pizza was amazing. I have yet to go there for dine in but since it is a BYOB that puts it high on the list of places to go. It's nice to have a pizza place around that isn't just the same old boring tasteless pizzas.

Stopped by and was assisted by "Bob."
He provided me with an honest and professional opinion that lead me to selecting the right bike for my son.  Wry happy with the service. I would recommend this place to anyone seeking a Trekk bike.

Upon arriving, we sat at the bar booths. Was greeted very shortly after arriving by Marley. She was very sweet and attentive throughout our stay. 

I got the Filet Mignon (with sautéed mushrooms, but asked for them on the side instead of on top) with a side of garlic mashed potatoes and a sweet potato. 

The Filet Mignon was cooked well and tasted great, sweet potato was a sweet potato, but the garlic mashed potatoes barely had any flavor, so I added my own with the salt and pepper grinders they had on the table. (Though, I didn't mind. Rather it be under-seasoned than over!) 

I couldn't finish my entire meal, so Marley got us some to-go boxes and drew a cute little anime girl on top. Instantly grabbed that one as MY to-go box. 

Tipped a little bit more than 20% and left stuffed. Would dine here again. 

(Just to note down, we ate here on Tuesday night around 8:30pm!)

Best BBQ I've had in years!  The pork steak was fork tender.  The taste was phenomenal and the portions were generous.  The candied bacon was a treat.  Homemade fresh french fries were delicious.  Local gourmet sodas from Excel were a nice touch. 
    The staff were attentive without being intrusive.  They care about their customers!
Food is authentic Russian food! Every time we go there we order family style so you get to try a bunch of food and everything is amazing! Thank you Sveta, amazing!!!

I had the pork belly po boy suggested by the really nice young man behind the register and it did not disappoint. Really nice neighborhood mom and pop store and will be going back to try other menu items. Got the red beans and rice for a side and it was excellent. Also got some fried chicken and chicken thibedeaux  to eat later.

I had the Raspberry Banana malt with the heart stopping BLT, and the other meal was a chef salad..  So good both.. Neither of us could finish our dinners. Love this Old Fashioned Soda Fountain the original building and furnishings.. Great place.

The refurbishment and menu change have broken a fine thing.  The previous formula was great.  The 30-50% price hike and retirement of the no-tipping policy have taken it out of the realm of regular lunch spots.   And they seem to have dropped the great daily specials like the buck-a-shuck oysters that used to be on Tuesdays... In a big shopping center that is filling in, I'm not sure what the Pub's competitive angle is any more.  It used to be a tasty bargain.

Since their re-opening, I have dined here on multiple occasions with various group sizes. The other night a large group went out for a celebratory dinner, and while the food was good, it just isn't the same. I've held off on writing another review, but the new location, while visually beautiful, just doesn't "mesh." I know other people complained about the smaller location, but I actually enjoyed the tight-knit feeling you felt when you dined, and even waited for your table there. Now, in addition to a painful parking lot, the interior's tall ceilings, loud music, and ill-fitted seating makes the dining experience hard to enjoy, especially when you can't hear the person sitting right next to you (please work on the acoustics!)

As for the food, while most of the menu has stayed the sam ( as well as prices aside from several increases) I can note that some key items that I used to adore are just missing that extra loving touch. The hummus, which Arpeggio should package up and sell for retail, has not been the same since the old location. I don't know if someone else is in charge of making it or what, but each time I have gotten it, it is neither as garlicky or lemony as it used to be. A disappointment for sure. Good thing is their baba and dolmades are still amazing, and tabbouleh is always an ace- especially in the summer with fresh tomatoes.  

As for service, while many of the servers remain from the old location, some new faces in the bus boy/girl realm are a little bit over zealous in their approach towards clearing tables (it is polite to say excuse me instead of reaching in front of someone mid-fork as they eat,) and we have found ourselves waiting far too long for the check to be brought and picked back up as well. 

Arpeggio is a restaurant I used to call one of my favorites, one I used to crave, and I surely hope that these kinks will be worked out as they continue to get their feet resettled.

Love the cozy, coffee-bar-like ambiance and the drinks are inventive. The bartenders are fun, know their stuff and love to share information. When asked, the bartenders will happily make a special drink based on any particular liquor or type of drink you may like.

Will never bring my VW there again! My car was hit while it was parked, so I wanted to bring it to a VW certified body shop. Aside from every person there being extremely rude, when I got my car back , I noticed cover up paint in the cup holder. I thought it was complementary, but noticed the next day the paint was used to cover scratches that weren't on my car before (and I took pictures of my car before I brought it in for insurance purposes!). A few days later, I brought the car back to their establishment, told them what my issues were, and instead of the receptionist trying to reassure me that the scratches will be removed from my vehicle and apologizing for the inconvenience, I got nothing but attitude, and a snarky comment about not letting the technicians cover up imperfections for free ever again. Of course the comment didn't sit well with me, and I proceeded to let her know that my car was in near-perfect condition (minus the bumper where it was hit), showed her the photos of my car prior to them receiving it, and told her that I didn't appreciate the unnecessary attitude! 

I will NEVER bring my car to this place ever again. Next time, I'll be taking it to Pit Stop Auto Body. Their customer service is better and the results are what you'd expect from a PROFESSIONAL auto repair facility, despite them not being VW certified.
We go to La Fuente's about 3-4 times a month. Love the food and the service.

Decided to sit in and eat rather than take it home. It was packed so I def should have called ahead, I waited online to just put in an order for 20 mins (but that's my fault, I should have known). The bagels came out pretty quickly, I ordered a Taylor ham, egg, and cheese with a hash brown on a toasted sesame bagel, it was a little bland but after some salt it was perfect. Taylor ham is a staple in New Jersey so if you're reading this and not from the area... do yourself a favor and order it!

I recently purchased and installed brand new Crown boiler and CyrcleGuard keep burned out. so I replaced 4 times in 3 months. I called Crown boiler and spoke with technical support team. they keep saying wire issued. I called 2 electrification and boiler install intention. they said it is totally fine. So I asked Crown Boiler technical support team to send someone to take a look at it. it might be defected. and technical support team said WE DO NOT DO ANY SERVICE OR INSTALL. WTF then what are you doing over there? what is technical support team for?? 

DO NOT BUY ANY CROWN BOILER PRODUCTS!!! THEY DO NOT DO ANY THING AFTER YOU PURCHASED. DO NOT WASTE YOUR TIME AND MONEY.

The reason why the low rating is because we arrived 5 minutes before "lunch seating" ended and the hostess was on the phone the entire time talking to a flower delivery person (granted it was Valentines Day) but when someone else bothered to show up they said "We only seat people until 2:30.", the clock on the hostess stand had just turned to 2:31. Not cool and I will not go back!

after checking out all the reviews from this place, i had to come check this place out for lunch..

fresh out of the airport, we hopped on our rental car and trooped our way to wrights to have a satisfying welcome to Tampa. 

once me and my boyfriend walked in the place was packed, i guess it was because it was lunch time and everyone and their mother decided to lunch in Wrights.

i had their version of the Cuban and i must say that i wasn't disappointed. I'm not a mustard fan but my bf said i should try it out anyways since this sandwich is known as the best for their type of sauce. 

for dessert i had the cream cheese brownies, and those were finger licking good. 

overall i indeed had a very tasteful welcome into Tampa.

Checked out another Insomnia spot; late evening in the city. I got lucky and found a parking spot! More like put my hazards on, run in and out type thing. Had to walk between outside dining restaurants lol (hence; less parking).

It's like most of the insomnia places inside, quick and painless. They had 3 cookies on display. I thought all the drama (with parking); I went through at this point was in vain, but they had all the cookies available (*corny joke time* almost had a cookie attack). Cookies were good. Always wish I ate a cookie when it's warm (I think that's the point of this experience). Welp, rewarming them at home will have to do. I'm interested in trying the "CookieLab"!!!!

Honestly, I would only come here if I'm already in the area.

Living in Mosaic has been very good overall, Cory and his crew are all good people!!  I'm currently building a home and will need to go month to month for about 1 or 2 months. So to my surprise, my month to month fee is $6132 give or take a few dollars!!! I'm going to go speak with the person that comes up with those numbers and post a follow up.... but as of now, that's the number!

If this is the only review you will see on Yelp, then this review deserves to be 5+ Star, if there were such a thing. When it comes to local fare, when it comes to home cooking, when it comes to "Brotherly Love" incarnate, Miller's is the place.

The food is delicious, and the price is reasonable. Don't sleep in, 'cause Miller's closes early.

I had the worst experience ever at this location. The screwed up my order so I called in to speak to the manager and they gave me a comp meal, I was satisfied. So I returned the following week and ordered a small fry, a chocolate frosty, spicy nuggets, and a hamburger. All of which were from the dollar menu and Wendy's most common things to purchase. However, when I got to the window I was asked to pull up and they would bring it out to me. They also had the car behind me pull up so they asked me to park next to the sign. After about 15 -20 minutes I seen the Wendy's worker take my order to the other car so I pulled back around to ask for a refund. The cashier acted baffled so then the district manager came to the window. His name was Siraa pronounced (Siraj). He was EXTREMELY nasty when I repeated to him that I wanted a refund he pulled out his own wallet and gave  $3 and some change (incorrect change). I then asked his name and he quoted "I'm Siraa, the District Manager. " he had the nastiest attitude I have ever encountered, I will not recommend this Wendy's to anyone.

This place will piss you off!!
Food-nasty
Service-below standard, SLOW
Prices-high
I had high hopes for a nice,residential neighborhood eatery but was disappointed as soon as I entered the door.  The atmosphere was so noisy, it gave me a headache. People forget when to use their indoor voices... I had a reservation but it didn't matter, no one asked. 
The raspberry wings had no taste of raspberry.
The teriyaki glazed salmon was cooked too hard (although the glaze was good).
The broccoli was overcooked.
The ONLY thing I enjoyed at this place was the strawberry lemonade and the nice family of mother and two daughters that sat next to me. 
I won't be back and would not recommend this place!

Friendly & efficient staff that get you in and out and on your way. Always let me pick out my stamps without seeming annoyed that I make them pull out every stamp option. There's plenty of street parking and a small parking lot that I've never seen completely full.

Only complaint is that you can no longer pick up packages here(or haven't been able up in a while actually) you have to go to the Post Office on Mermac if you ever get one of those lovely slips that you have a package that the mail carrier wouldn't leave.

One of the best post office in the city!

Cute little India store with nice people. Fair amount to pick from . Call on certain days they may have rotis or samosas that are fresh that day . Prices are decent and fair. It's a small store so they might not have everything you are looking for but they have most.

Hidden treasure of Reno!  A local small business with great food, service, location and prices!  

I had lunch here today with my best friend.  While she's had their food several times in the past, including having it at her place of employment as well as the catered food at a couple of small events she attended, it was both our first time actually sitting inside to order and eat.

It's located on the corner of 1st and Lake, downtown - across the River from the Sienna hotel.  Their outside back patio seating faces the river and Sienna.  From the main dining area windows, you can see the Ace's Baseball Stadium catercorner, and the original "Biggest Little City" Reno Arch sign is also located just outside.  We found a no-charge parking spot right in front of the place.  I think we just got very fortunate on that parking spot, however.  I'm not sure how convenient the parking is.

Bonus on location would be how its next to the Ball Park and River Walk.  After dinner... you can stroll the river a little if you want.  Ah... a little late night rib-mance.

The interior is fairly plain, with a kinda-sorta sports motif.  There is an attached bar, a neon light here and there, and a couple of flat screens for ESPN fans.  About 10 tables in the main dining area each sit 4 to 6 people.

So, Men Wielding Fire is a casual BBQ joint, and while they are known to serve up killer wonderful ribs and those types of foods, my friend and I didn't go that road.  (Note: They do have a wide variety of choices for meals, appetizers and so forth... so if you're not exactly in the mood for BBQ or rib-foods, you can still visit here and leave happy.)

The specials for the day were Brisket and a corn soup.  My friend had the soup.  Unfortunately, I can't remember exactly what the soup was called... but, anyway... it came piping hot and served in a very large bowl (it was a meal, to be certain.)  I didn't try any, but my friend said it was deliciously smilearific.  Her soup special was $9.00 and apparently very much worth it.  How did I miss knowing what she ordered and ate?  Hey!  I was busy digging into the academy award winning Mr. Burger Goes to Tummyland.

I had the 'standard' burger, which was maybe one of the best burgers I've ever had... honest!  This tasty, perfectly cooked-to-order burger was plenty large with all the trimmings, and the big bun (you have a variety to choose from) I had was perfecto.  I can't eat a burger any way other than well done.  Usually, this means its dry and the taste is mostly gone.  NOT TODAY!  It was cooked well done, just like I likey, but was juicy, full of burger-taste (almost like back yard bbq burger) and it had a slightly crispyness to the outside.  For me?  Perfect!

As for sauce, they don't put any on the burger, which I appreciated.  I like to put on my own combo of mustard, katsup, and mayo.  The burger was $8.00 and totally worth it.

Oh, and while I have never liked seasoned-fries, I was shocked that I actually loved the basket they served me.  The fries were almost-steak-cut, very fresh, and they weren't overly seasoned.  The hint of seasonings was just right, and didn't discourage me from eating them all.  Too much of that season salt, and I can't eat em.  So, that was a first for me.

A little bonus I loved was when the waiter asked, "Would you like Mayo or Ranch to go with those fries?"  I've never been offered that before, and... I just happen to love either of those instead of katsup.  

Speaking of the service, our waiter (Joshua) was friendly, prompt, attentive, and seemed to know his stuff.  He was awesome!  I left him over 20% on tip, but wanted to leave him even more than that.  Yeah, for real!  I think the big deal here was the waiter seemed GENUINELY friendly and upbeat.  Know what I mean? And, thanks to the fella who 'bussed' our table, too... as he really was awesome as well.  Good or great service is pretty rare these days, so we really noticed and appreciated that.  Both jobs are pretty challanging.

Considering the super tasty food, portion size, the cost of our two meals combined ($17) being reasonable, and A+ service... Men Wielding Fire is highly recommended!  I already know my friend thought the place was great before we even went inside, but I admit that I can be particularly critical of eating out... and I have a feeling I will be visiting this place often!

FOOD:  A+
SERVICE:  A+
COST:  A+
ATMOSPHERE:  B
LOCATION:  A+
Dr Case is awesome! I feel I receive the highest quality of care here! Vision Works Seminole is no longer my closest location but I'm happy to make the drive.

Found this on the way to Clearwater aquarium. All I have to say is I will never have another boxed pergoi ever.  The food was really good.  The decor should be updated though.  Looks like a mix of old western and eyptian.

Honestly I got my first pedicure here and it really set the bar high, ever since I've tried multiple nail salons and none of them compared! Love getting my pedicures here!! Also the fills for acrylics is just $20 and they are super good and never feel rush!! Definitely recommend this place for an amazing pedicure!
The octopus app and the Spicy honey sauce pizza were incredible. Good atmosphere as well..they didn't cram tables in so you can actually have a conversation.

Very good food.  It doesn't look like much from the outside, but it's food is great!  The eggplant sticks are awesome as was the redfish cookery.  Def a place to come to when you're in the great city of Nola!

We had the Southwest Oysters and they were awesome. Wife had the seafood nachos which was huge and fantastic. I had the best bowl of gumbo ever. Unfortunately we ate here on our last day so we couldn't go back.

This place is a hidden gem! If you're looking for authentic Caribbean food this is the place, on this we had the jerk chicken platter with Mac and cheese and green beans. The chicken was the perfect blend of sweet and spicy. This was some of the best food I've had and beats the normal pizza and sandwich take outs in the area. I'll be back again soon.
Really good! If your looking for that "up north" taste, this is the place!! They are also VERY generous with the toppings! Glad i found this place!!
The Benko Gym one of the best gyms that an AFB has to offer.  The equipment is great and the classes are wonderful too!  I really like going here for any fitness needs.

We were renting bikes for a couple days in Tucson and RC had the best rates for hybrids when we called around. They also hooked us up with helmets, locks, water bottle cages, and bike pouches. What can I say? We're high maintenance. The bikes worked out really well and were in like-new condition. 

The guys working there were also friendly, awesome, and even entertained us by letting us run around the shop like it was a candy store. Coming from NYC we rarely see so much open space in a store and parking lots to try out bikes in. And tandem bikes! And unicycles! And penny farthings! We were happy.

New rooms!

Circus Circus was nice enough to give me a couple of nights comped and my wife and I thought it was finally the year to visit WING FEST!

I had heard of renovations and construction that had been underway for a little while so we were interested to see the modern take on on of the classic well known casino/hotels.

I have to say that these rooms were very nice.

Modern, clean, good bed, great shower and just all around a comfortable experience.

As per usual, the few interactions with guest services were great. This seems to be the norm for the casinos and hotels on the Row.

Of course since this was Circus Circus, there were quite a few kids around but that was to me expected. It is nice that the family areas are nicely separated from the rest of the casino and +21 areas.

Excellent value and location, I'll definitely keep Circus Circus in mind for my next Reno road trip!

The menus on this yelp page  are a bit out of date.  The price for hot pot is $22.99, korean bbq $26.99 & $29.99 for hot pot and bbq.  For someone that cannot eat a lot, this is a bit expensive, but the food was good quality.  The "black agaric" mushrooms were actually woodear mushrooms served in huge pieces; I'd recommend that Q Pot slice those mushrooms into thinner strips that are easier to eat.  The variety of ingredients was impressive.  I had the thai (Thom Yum) soup base for my hotpot. The rest of my party had the BBQ; they enjoyed it!  We liked all the dipping sauces, side dishes and desserts.  Everything was fresh and well presented.  The service was very good.  

As a suggestion, it might be nice to offer a cheaper alternative for people that aren't big eaters. Basically, I think only offering the expensive  "all you can eat" pricing would prevent people with smaller appetites from coming back because we can't eat enough to justify paying that "all you can eat"  price.

I got a brisket sandwich from this place. The toppings I got we're sweet pepper and cheese. The sandwich was quite large and the brisket was really good however it sorta tasted bland after a couple of bites. Don't get me wrong the brisket was cooked quite nicely but in my opinion it lack flavor wished they offer sauces on the sandwiches though. But don't let my review stop you from coming here though.

First of all, I want to say that the food was very good. My recommendation would be to skip any addition of the $4 "Oscar Style" to your entree. It consisted of 4 small pieces of crabmeat, each the approximate size of half of a garlic clove. Save your $. My problem on this visit was with the service. We entered the restaurant and walked up to the hostess stand. Before I could say a word to the young man standing there, a young female employee came from the restaurant, obviously leaving for the day. The host ignored us while he flirted with the young woman.  Once she left, he greeted us and we were seated. Our server was polite, but she forgot to bring my husband's soft drink. She also forgot the side of mayonnaise that he had asked for when he ordered his meal.  After dropping off our food, she disappeared for a long period of time even though the restaurant was not at all busy.  My husband had nearly completed his meal by the time she came back to see if we needed anything. At the prices this restaurant charges, I expect better service. Even though the food tasted good, I will probably not return.

Pretty sure this is the second time I've tried this place.  I couldn't remember if I had been there previously or not but when I walked in this time I knew the answer was yes.  Why I didn't write a review after the last visit remains a mystery.

I was super-excited for burnt ends.  Unfortunately, I was there on the wrong day for burnt ends.  Instead, I ordered their special of the day: a pulled rib meat sandwich with two sides.  Those were pit baked beans and house-made apple sauce.  The gentleman at the counter added a couple of pieces of their house-made salami to our baskets as well so I was able to try another meat.  Also, my dining guest offered up some brisket so just that fast I was able to try almost a third of their meats.  In no particular order, here are my impressions:

Rib sandwich - great amount of smokiness and lightly sauced so the flavor of the meat really shined through.  The bun was nothing special and neither added nor detracted from my enjoyment of the rib meat.  I need to make it in there again (minus the dress shirt) to try their ribs.  My guess is they will be even more impressive.

Salami - interesting consistency, almost like a bologna but a coarser grind.  I found the flavor reminiscent of pastrami and a bit unusual but enjoyable.  Even a couple of days later I still haven't decided what I thought of it.

Pit beans - very sweet, thick sauce and smoky flavor.  A good interpretation of a classic bbq joint side dish.

Next time, I will plan better and get there on a day when they have burnt ends.  I'm guessing they are pretty amazing.

This place is badass.  I never knew I liked pita and hummus that much.  That's probably because I was eating crappy pita and hummus my whole life.  The pita and hummus are both made fresh and it's like night and day.  Closest thing I could compare it to is if you get grocery store sushi your whole life and then you go to Japan and get some Sushi from that ancient little Yoda dude Jiro.

We tried two hummuses...hummii? and they were both amazenuts.  The pitas were redonkified.  Come here to get lunch.   It's fantastiballs.
The most flavorful Vegan  food I've tasted! Made with much love, respect and spices. The portions are perfect and so are the prices.  Can't wait to see Ras at the Dunedin Downtown Market.

I was in St. Louis in June of 2013 shooting a pilot for Spike TV when I had some free time to visit the arch. You have to visit at least once. My recommendation is to go at twilight/sunset. The view is amazing! 

You ride to the top of the arch in a kind of egg-like capsule. The ride up takes about 5 minutes and fits five people. I was here with a friend on a Wednesday in June and luckily it was not very crowded. We had a capsule all to ourselves. 

When you arrive at the top of the arch you can look out the observatory windows. Warning for those of you that are claustrophobic, this might not be your favorite monument! The observatory can be feel very packed very quickly as the walk way is narrow and only a few people can look out the windows at a time without rubbing elbows. 

The museum at the bottom is so so but there is a large gift shop and bathrooms. We found parking for free in a lot adjacent to the park. 

The park below is quite pretty and it is really an impressive feat of engineering. The ride to the top was $10.00. 

Definitely worth a visit if you are in the St. Louis area.

Nice addition to the dining scene. Service was great and the menu has many choices. They have a lot of specials throughout the week. 
Crab Rangoon and gyoza were good starts. The salmon and tuna nigiri were outstanding. Spicy tuna crunch and kamikaze topped off our meal. Everything was fresh and tasty.

***update:

The only thing keeping me from giving lower stars was the food. We have been to ichicoro several times now and have always had a pleasant experience. Recently staff quality has gone way down. Today our appetizer was "misplaced" and then when my husband ordered the spicy kimuchi he instead received the spicy Aruba soba. When we politely informed the waiter that there was a mix up he boldly told us "you're wrong. What do you want me to do about it." He refused to fix the order. Sorry ichicoro, we love your food, but your staff has lost you two neighborhood regulars.


FYI Ichicoro according to our check: "server 1001/Mo"****

previous review:
I have visited Ichicoro twice now--once for dinner and once for lunch. 

The restaurant definitely has a very "cool" atmosphere and reminds me a lot of something you would find in New York or Chicago. 

The smaller size of the place generally leads to longer waits and a louder environment during prime dining hours. It also makes it difficult to dine in with a large group (anything larger than 4 people seems to be difficult for them). If you are planning to venture in during peak hours, I highly recommend grabbing a drink at the bar and trying some of their "snacks."

We did just this at dinner and were thoroughly pleased.
Drink: Key Lime Cider mixed with Kirin Slushy--heaven
Eat: pork steam bun & karaage
Skip: edamame & tsukemono

Lunch: ramen salad. A cold ramen dish perfect for the Florida heat. Loaded with flavor and fresh veggies. Only served at lunch time.

I just got back from getting my car repaired for the first time at Fowler's Automotive, and I've got to say, Jeff has definitely made a positive impression on me! I called earlier in the week to set up an appointment on Friday and everything went well with that. Then, I arrived early in the morning to the shop and I was in the door rather quickly. During the entire time, I was kept in the loop regarding my car throughout. I truly do feel like I was treated like a valued customer and what Fowler's Automotive does differently is that they don't try to upsell you on things you necessarily don't need at the time to try to get more money out of you at that time. Thank you very much for the service and I will definitely return for future auto repairs!
This is a great place. If you have an appointment and are not feeling well, they will forego late cancellation fees. Be safe!

Surprisingly empty on a Friday night! When we walked in at 7, the place was about half full, but by 8 pm, there was just one other table, and by 8:30, we were the only ones left. 

This is an upscale place within easy walking distance of the Hotel Du Pont (even for non-New Yorkers). The staff and server were very friendly - even made little jokes with our group such as giving one of our party a super small spoon after he specifically requested a large spoon for the shared desserts (of course she had a large spoon hidden away, but we all had a good laugh). 

I had the New England Clam Chowder. This soup is home made and the portions are very good - it was not gritty (very important) and the flavor was decent, but not super amazing.  

The scallop entree had some highs and lows. It was PERFECTLY seared and the taste was amazing. However, I found it a bit grainy/sandy. MAYBE this was just the sear, but I doubt it.  That being said, it was still very yummy. The Lobster polenta, arugula, and smoked bacon sauce was good, but not super memorable. 

One awesome thing was that they have a Friday night special - half price on all bottles of wine.  You have to make sure you mention the special, but we got $80 off our wine (which everyone said was good)! Me... I had the Pomegranate Orange Martini and the Gin & Grapefruit (I think... it was recommended by the server, and all I recall* is that it was very good). 

Lastly, there was a great selection of desserts. The bread pudding won (great recommendation again from our awesome server) but the creme brule came in a very close second (smooth, rich, doesn't overwhelm you after a few bites...yum). The chocolate mousse was OK, and maybe there was a cheesecake?

I should also note that the plating was very pretty and very professional. Definitely a "nice" restaurant where you can take your clients, family, the Queen (maybe the Queen)...

One minor issue at the end was that we were all done with desserts, but for a long time, no one came by to ask if we needed anything else, or if we needed the check. I had to go up and ask another server and ask for the check.

Overall, I highly recommend this place. The food is worth the price tag, which gets you a full belly and a nice relaxing night out.

---------------------------------------
* No... I didn't forget what I ordered because I was drunk (I think... hope... scanning FB for incriminating pictures... *whew*), this was a business dinner after all, I just forgot because I couldn't decide which drink to order and thus don't have a good memory of what the server recommended.

This was our first time after finding it on Yelp. You won't leave hungry, that's for sure.  Country Fried steak was large,tl tender and without gristle.  Try the American fried potatoes too. Leave room for donuts on your way out because you won't be able to resist.  This will be our new goto place when we are up here.

This little hole in the wall serves the best Cuban sandwich I have ever had. By far the best, not even close.
Bring cash, no cards taken.
Friendly staff, full sandwich feeds two easily.

This was our second visit to 1818 Chophouse, and both times we have had excellent food. Today we went for brunch. There are very few non-chain brunch places worth going to in the area, and we are so happy they offer one. I ordered the Crab Cake eggs Benedict. It was very good. The hollandaise sauce had a siracha flavor which gave it a tasty twist on the original.  Instead of on the traditional English muffin, it was on a baguette. This gave it a great flavor, although I wish the baguettes were bigger to hold it all together as the egg fell off.  Overall though, extremely tasty! Others in our party got omelets which came with toast and a side of breakfast potatoes. Everyone loved what they got as we will definitely be back as prices were very reasonable. As we were leaving, the server brought delicious looking cinnamon rolls to the table next to us. We may have to try those next time! We had a great experience and we can't wait to come back for brunch or maybe even their happy hour soon!

I had the most AMAZING customer service experience here tonight! Well, to be honest, I ALWAYS have an amazing experience here at this particular Lush! The employees are always so nice, very knowledgeable, willing to help and somehow always seem to recommend the best products for me. Tonight was particularly amazing because I was in need of MAJOR retail therapy and wanted something to cheer me up. I stopped by a few stores and got 'meh' customer service, which didn't necessarily make me feel great about my purchases there.. and then it hit me.. I need Lush! As soon as I walked in, everyone greeted me (but they were not overwhelming as sometimes that can be) and made me feel like I was a special guest entering their own home. Three lovely ladies assisted me and helped me find everything.. and exactly.. what I needed! Leah, Aan-Sofie and Lauren were nothing short of amazing! I know I've used the word "amazing" a thousand times already, but that truly is how I felt after my experience. I love Lush, particularly this one, and I got the retail "therapy" I was searching for. They made me feel so wonderful and I left with a bag full of goodies and a giant smile on my face! So, thanks girls! You truly are so kind and helpful and I'm glad to see customer service like this still exists! It's clear that you're passionate about what you do, and being in retail myself, I appreciate that more than you know! CHEERS!! :)
Only medium size by Starbucks standards. Cool Portland Brew coffeehouse nearby on Murphy Road at West End is preferred alternative.

I needed 5 locks re keyed and 1 deadbolt replaced, Sean responded to my request thru Yelp within minutes, answered all of my questions and was able to schedule the job within the hour. He arrived on time, he was very professional, fast and he even fixed the sagging gate issue! His fee was lower than expected too. I highly recommend SW Locksmith, 
thank you Sean!

Got two bagel breakfast sandwiches. Both bagels weren't toasted, the cheese was cold, the eggs undercooked and had shells in them. Staff was unprofessional and we ended up throwing out our food before we even ate half. The worst Einstein Bros Bagel location I have been to.

I first went to Revive in November to receive Botox in my masseter muscles to create more symmetry in my face and slim my jawline. I was originally recommended by a friend to go to Revive so I knew I could trust them once I saw my friend's results . The first time I went to Revive in November I had the best experience and loved my Botox so much I couldn't wait to go back and get more. I went back just a few weeks ago in April and was happy with the service of course but had the worst outcome. After 3 weeks of the Botox settling in I noticed my smile was off. Apparently, the Botox was injected incorrectly or traveled around my face and now my smile muscles were relaxed from the Botox instead of my masseter muscle which is what I had asked for originally. After much research of why this happened to my face, the only conclusion I found was the Botox was clearly placed in the wrong spot. I had reached out to the office to inform them of what's going on and was absolutely dissatisfied in the response I got. I paid a good amount of money for my Botox and was told to " massage it out with a tool" . Why would I pay that amount of money to be able to "massage the Botox out" ? Botox lasts up to 4 months before it starts wearing off , so now I have to go 4 months with a crooked smile . I'm embarrassed and super disappointed in the feedback I received from Revive and probably will never return.
Went for restaurant week. Everything was really good and I would like to go back to try more. The ricotta appetizer and budino dessert stole the show by far.
I have to say my cheeseburger was amazing... The homemade fries were delicious and the atmosphere was good with hip music.... my friend had the tater tot's and loved them

I use this place fairly frequently. Fast, efficient, and usually not much of a wait. $5 per page for notary- can also get signatures as a witness, auto tags, boat tags, title transfers, fax/copy things, etc. Their website has a longer list of their services and also they are very helpful if you call. Everyone who works there is always friendly but also gets down to business, so I'm always in-and-out quickly. The parking lot can be a little tight but I always manage to find parking. Two thumbs up.

Came straight here before closing on a thursday night after landing at the airport. My wife from cali and me from nyc...my wife who frequents nashville alot due to business insisted on hattie b.

The food more than speaks for itself..(backed by all the other reviews already describing the chicken and sides better than i can right now). 

What really made the food taste better was the staff here. They  are genuinely friendly.  I felt this the first time i came thru here during my tiring trek, moving from west to east coast last year.. and pleasantly surprised to recieve  the same positive vibes. 

Good start to my nashville visit!
I have been in two rooms already. Both have had dirty bedding and the floor looks unswept. The second room had furniture with a broken handle and a burn on the couch too.

I love the Anthony's cold fire pizza in Exton. It is my happy place. The atmosphere is very nice and the food is very tasteful. The staff are very friendly. I've been coming here  for years. One bartender in particular Lauren Michelle does an awesome job with the customers and she makes coming here a joy. I totally recommend coming here with family and friends.

This place is a pleasantly affordable restaurant to eat, brunch, drink and or watch the game with friends here in Nashville. The service was good and the brunch cocktails were extremely tasty!
