Loved the small bakery at the front of this location. Bathrooms are unisex with open hand washing stations. Although cocktails were tasty, it was a very heavy juice low alcohol volume. Would like to come back for happy hour as I have only been there for brunch. Huevos rancheros were delicious!

I absolutely would recommend this place. I went last night at 9:13 on a an impulse to get my tragus pierced and they did it. The owners were amazing made me feel super comfortable and really calmed my nerves. The person that pierced me was amazing. She was super sweet and super understanding with me passing out in the chair & squirming like a 2 year old on a road trip. I would definitely go here again & again & again. They also give you a soap that I love and let you come in for a free 2 week check up to see how the piercing is healing.

Good service and the packing is good.  Prices are ok and the food quality is on par from food truck standard.  Just remember that you are here to enjoy the surrounding area, decent food at location is a bonus.

Our family has been coming to the Family Vacation Center for years and up until last summer, I would have given FVC 4-5 stars.  Not any more.
 Some of our favorite activities got cancelled: Improv Night and Top Chef Night for the adults; the Overnight Beach Campout and the Surfing Lesson for the kids; and Horseback Riding for the whole family. 
 For the one Horseback Riding day, FVC had contracted with a new stable that had only THREE horses available (our family signed up and got bumped).
 The Teenagers' Overnight Beach Campout was cancelled for the entire summer but FVC was not telling families in advance. (Our family and our friend's family left voice messages and sent emails with questions about the campout and FVC did not to respond.) In place of the campout, FVC substituted a little kid's movie, "Finding Dory." The high school boys did NOT consider that a fair trade.
 There were problems with the adult Bike Rides, Tennis Lessons, and Day Hike (our FVC group got kicked out because FVC did not have permission to hike there).
 There were problems with the Art Classes and the Craft Studio (insufficient art supplies for kids and adults).
 There were problems with the new activities. The new mystery game night for adults turned out to be a complete mystery for the FVC counselors. They had no idea how to play, constantly changed the rules during the game, and argued with each other and the parents.
 My teenage son enjoyed seeing his FVC friends (we had been going the same week and meeting up with the same families every summer). But he and his friends felt the scheduled activities were lacking last summer.
 Not sure where all these glowing reviews are coming from because most of the parents we talked with were also disappointed in the FVC experience.
 That said, we did speak with a few parents who were happy at FVC. Those parents had very young children, appreciated the good counselors, and were happy to spend most of their time drinking (beer and wine tasting day trips plus beer and wine at nighttime events.)
 For those of us who expected something more, FVC was a disappointment.

Extremely friendly and helpful staff. Sometimes a little too friendly. I am always asked if I need any help multiple times while I am shopping. I love their 20% off coupons that magically appear in my mailbox. It's always an effective strategy to get me in the store to buy something cool, new and fun for my home. Even if I don't need it. I mean seriously, do I need a food processor, mini processor and a mini chopper? Oh yes, I do.
The Husband cannot wait to go back! The Meatballs, Sauce, and Fresh pasta are wonderful! Everyone should try this new East side Gem.

Mays Counter has the best fried chicken I've had in Tucson, bar-none. It's a great spot for that down-south comfort food that you can't resist, despite knowing that you'll need to work that much harder at the gym to burn it off...

They have a nice little setup going on with warm lighting and a number of booths along the walls. Their menu is very concentrated and not too expansive. They also have a nice cocktail menu with some pretty good drinks inspired from parts south of the Mason-Dixon line. The blackberry pueblo tea, served in a mason jar, is my personal favorite.

I've been here a few times and have had the privilege of experiencing most of their menu. I don't generally go for appetizers but I tried their fried pickles (because I LOVE fried pickles) and while being crispy/perfectly cooked, they were horrendously over-salted.  I couldnt eat more than one without chugging half a glass of water after. I think they added salt to the batter, which isnt a good call with already salty dill pickles. 

Their catfish is also something I tend to steer clear of. It was far meatier than any catfish I've ever had (almost like Cod) and the breading slid right off of it, making it almost impossible to eat. Im also not sure it was entirely cornmeal based which I think is a bad decision. 

The chicken, however, is what it's all about. I usually go for the winner-winner (which includes 3 pieces and 2 sides),  but sometimes I want some tasty waffles as well and pick up the Ironside. The chicken is perfectly seasoned and the light batter makes the skin just brilliantly crisp up. The meat itself is juicy and packed with flavor everytime. For sides, I usually go for the Mac and Cheese and Collard Greens...both of which aren't bad, but aren't particularly noteworthy either. The waffles are also light and fluffy, though not the most flavorful I've had. 

I've never had any problem with service. 

Overall, May's is a 3-star restaurant with regard to most of their food. Dishes other than chicken are kind of a dice roll and can often come out salted too heavily or too lightly or really just average. Their chicken, however, is insanely delicious and addictive. Since that's their go-to, it's earned them a star back. If you like fried chicken, DEFINITELY go check them out. You won't be disappointed. Otherwise, expect just average southern-inspired food at a fair price.
Is it closed Down? Lack of information. Why do the idiot yelp staff put in Nor Recommended?

Sterling is a nice spot to grab a quick breakfast downtown on a weekday. One time I stopped by there while on a time crunch so I asked how long the big breakfast (eggs, bacon, pancakes) would take to make and the man answered "5 minutes, want to time me?". Well I did time him and he was right on. They offer friendly service with a tough of humor in the mornings . The prices are great, you can get a big breakfast for under $7. I enjoy the hot cakes and french toast.
I know they serve lunch as well, but I still haven't tried it. They close at 2pm.

So great!  Easily booked an appointment, stress free from the moment I got there.  I had a horrible cut from a chain place and needed a "rescue."  Those of you ladies who have short hair know how important it is for a stylist to actually KNOW how to cut & blend well, and these gals delivered in spades.
I'm so stoked!!!  Thank you!!! :) :)
First time visitor today. Mushroom Frittata was so good! The best breakfast I've had in a long time. The price was a little high but food was worth it and it supports a local business.

When Pizza Domenica first opened, I would have given it five stars. It has nice decor, tasty options, and friendly staff. But they're slipping. They've removed popular items like the roasted cauliflower appetizer and pulled pork pizza(!) and pushed happy hour to end at 5 instead of 6 which is not going to work for most people who work normal hours. And the most neglectful part is that the spicy oil they put on the table has gone RANCID. 

There are still good parts of Pizza Domenica, but all of my favorite parts are gone and I see no motivation to return.
New favorite Sparks Sushi. If you like Heroba, I am very confident you'll enjoy this place. Haven't had a roll I wasn't impressed with.

Fantastic Chicken! the quality of ingredients is excellent.  I high recommend trying this place.  If you love spicy food as much as I do, start with the Level 4 and go from there.  I have yet to try the Level 6 but 5 was intense.  Great service as well.  I recommend ordering ahead online.

This was my 2nd escape the room event. This one did not have a person monitoring in it and instead we were given clues by a TV screen. Takes an hour for the game, and 15 minutes or so to explain the rules at the beginning. 

Great for group experiences and a lot of fun. Definitely like a real life Sherlock Holmes. My whole group of 9 had fun, and everyone was able to feel like they participated. Highly recommended!

All I can say is amazing!!! We had a happy hour group of 10 people all coming in a different times  ordering food and drinks at different times but the service we received from Sydney was amazing, she did not miss a beat! You must ask for her next time you're in.
A true Creole landmark. Be sure to try the shrimp creole.

Worst experience, I want my money back. The ruben was small the meat was way too fatty, cold, the bread sucked and was old, and my girlfriends meal was very poor also. I was hoping for much more. 

The menu was also very odd.

Finally got to try this place. Walked up to the counter and got it to go. I got the pastrami burger. The burger was amazing! You can tell that it's grass fed and made fresh in house. The pastrami was awesome on top of it. The burger was huge! Can't wait to come back!

The burger was good but I wouldn't call it Jack Daniels plus for the price I think I would have done better going to Fridays. The Mac and cheese was bland and our waitress made sure to steer us clear for rom other bland tasting food. The rolls were good but not worth $8 and after waiting an hour for a table for 6 on a Saturday for lunch  I was over the whole experience.

Too Soul Tea is a great place for tea and snacks. Their selection of loose leaf tea is extensive. They sell great baked goods, including vegan options. The ambiance is great inside and outside (heated patio).

I called here to get an inquiry for a tuneup on a Mini Cooper. Before I got two words out, the person who answers, hangs up in my face. I will not go there and I will not refer anyone to this place. That was bad customer service.

Customer service was awful got seated before folks and other people that got seated after us got their food before us we waited 30 mins and still no food manager wasn't worth shit either smh would never recommend this Bob Evans to anyone. Also server was rude and not friendly or helpful

A fabulous addition to Philadelphia!
The interior is not at all what I expected. With a name like Tweed, I anticipated lots of beige and burlap. What I got was dark wood, modern chandeliers, and all-out sleekness. 

Food was mostly fantastic.
Appetizers:
Smoked Salmon Deviled Eggs ($10): Not really a deviled egg, as no yolks are in the filling. Rather, eggs are filled with an apple slat and delicious smoked salmon and topped with salmon roe. Delicious.
Cheesesteak Fritters ($10): Cheesesteak fried with a homemade ketchup for dipping. Who could say anything bad about fried cheesesteak!?

Entrees:
NY Strip ($29): Cooked perfectly, but my cut wasn't the best. Seemed to have been cut against the grain, making it necessary to use my steak knife as a saw...  But tasty! Oh, and they serve it with a house-made steak sauce (like a tangier A-1) and hollandaise (probably the richest, most delicious hollandaise ever created). 
Magret Duck ($26): Sort of typical duck preparation. Seared w/ a demiglace. Still perfectly prepared and yummy!
Side of macaroni and cheese ($8):  OH MY GOD. The absolute best mac and cheese I have ever had! I can't even say more because I might go into a pleasure coma from the memory. ORDER THIS. NOW. 

Dessert: 
Vanilla Cheesecake ($7): Definitely room for improvement with this one. Okay, but bland. The crust could use some sort of cinnamon or something to kick it up a notch. Skip it.

Service was prompt and friendly. The bussers and managers are chatty and stopped by a few times to make sure that we were enjoying everything.

Will definitely be adding this restaurant to our rotation.

Beware!  They cancel cruises at the last minute.  We were looking forward to this cruise but two days before, I get a message saying our cruise has been canceled, without any explanation or apologies.

Our first time here and we were not impressed. My husband arrived before I did and said things were "in disarray". Clutter was on shelves behind the bar and the sushi area was used for storage as well.
My husband was able to take a video of sushi chef eating while preparing the sushi. It was not professional looking.
As far as how was the food, I think the atmosphere ruined my meal. Just wanted to go and get back to work.
I was disappointed!

I usually like staying at the Hyatt properties. Unfortunately, this one kinda let us down.  The selection at breakfast is just okay. The fridge in our room broke so our food were all spoiled when we got back from work.
This place stole my money. I didn't receive my entire order and they to believed their employee over me he said he gave me my entire order which wasnt true

Always a pleasure just swinging by and picking up some Chick-fil-A. I just love the Polynesian sauce on everything...lol Today I enjoyed something different, and that was the chicken salad sandwich. It was pretty good and I think I would have it again,but my favorite are the grilled chicken nuggets.

Can't ever go wrong with those.

Today I ate at the "Ristorante Verona," and the overall experience was quite stellar. I enjoyed my experience as a first time visitor and I would like to go again sometime. My favorite part about this restaurant was the all natural sugar cane cola that was offered. It was quite nice to taste something other than the generic "Coke," or "Pepsi." The decor made me feel quite "at home," the people were incredibly generous and refilled drinks often and asked how we were doing frequently. I ordered the "Pasta e Fagioli" and it was average, but I also tasted my friends "Caesar Salad," and it tasted delicious, with homemade dressing. My main course was "Gnocchi Bolognese," and it was homemade Gnocchi which was superb. The meat sauce was good, could have been better, but no complaints. This is an all around solid place to eat at. Good service, great people, solid food, and nice atmosphere. I will definitely go back, and recommend to people in search of good Italian food.
Classic place to visit in New Orleans! If you go to NOLA without Gumbo Shop, you're doing it wrong! Excellent seating, a bit noisy during peak hours, and decent prices!

The Curvy Girl!

This place rocks! As a guy who loves a very beautiful "curvy girl", I encourage her to shop there! 

Amy has fond very nice, stylish clothing that ranges from casual to professional. 
She has found the perfect items that give her the confidence, professionalism and style she exudes on a daily basis.

As a guy, I appreciate a number of things that Curvy Girl provides. 
1. Great quality clothes and accessories at very reasonable prices.
2. Professional, knowledgeable help, a can do and happy attitude.
3. Guy chairs. There is nothing better for us guys when that lady in our life is shopping for clothes then a good guy chair. The Curvy Girl has a great guy chair along with free Wi-Fi!
4. I know when Amy goes to Curvy Girl that she will be treated with respect and good humor. That means a lot to me.

Finally. Supporting locally owned and operated businesses is a passion for me.
The ladies of the Curvy Girl are bright, knowledgeable and fun. They work HARD to make this very small business that operates on very narrow margins succeed. 

THIS BUSINESS DESERVES YOUR SUPPORT!

Lee and his crew are always busy but they take the time to point out what you need and what can wait.  And if it's a safety issue they let you know immediately.  After a close look at what Lee was worried about I gave him the go-ahead and I thought that the price was very fair.  Now I'm very pleased with the work, price and attention to detail and I feel much better about my car's issues.  I will certainly be back for the excellent service!  Very happy...
Really good options for ice cream, shakes, and other things. Was surprised that the things we got were so good. Delicious.
Good food and always crowded. Great place to get quality seafood away from the shore.

We spent a lot of time here, and loved every minute of it!

Just imagine...you get tourists, all ages and from all walks of life, coming into this bar and getting on stage.  It wasn't just about singing.  People were having dance offs, the MC's almost had little skits going on (their way of getting the crowd into it, and it was effective).  

There are 3 bars so there really isn't much of a wait.  until 8pm is a 3 for 1 beer special which is awesome.  The bathrooms could be cleaner but hey, it is what it is.  And we loved the courtyard.  You can still see the fun on the TV monitors but sit down in a quieter location just outside of it all.

The crowds were always a decent size and for some reason I became addicted to this place.  The two MC's we seen...a middle aged black man and a younger black man...had very different styles but get the job done!  

Some people could really sing.  Others...not so much lol

Great for bridal parties! They are so accommodating to large groups. We went in on a Friday morning and they were all ready for a group of about 10. One thing I loved about this place is the employees were so nice and spoke great English! This salon is very clean and so well priced. I would definitely go back if I get back up to that part of Tampa.

I rarely am in this area but this is the second time I've had a poor experience with this Duncan. The window attendant wasn't wearing her mask properly, she crumpled up my receipt and handed it to me with my card and coffee so everything was cold and wet together. And to top it off my macchiato is like 80% milk

I really like this place, great beer menu, they had something from everywhere.  With 76 beers on tap, how can you go wrong.  My wife and I met Steve and Chris before I flew back up north the Providence (the cold tundra...lol) and really had a good time talking with the two of them.  I would definitely come back here to have a beer or two and watch some sports, nice place and close to home in Tampa.
Love this cozy spot!!! We always sit at the table in the "bar room" and blast music on the jukebox. Can't go wrong with their gumbo, and any pasta. We love the bartender Chris!!!

Had the catfish bites appetizer and could have had ten more! Delish! Had seafood pasta and it was great! Wife had red bean soup and I stole a bunch of it. She also had the gumbo and she liked it ! Service was excellent! Akinthia was a great server.

I am so impressed with Dr Elliott at LifeSmiles.  I had a consultation with Dr. Elliott after I saw another local cosmetic dentist. I was able to get an appointment very quickly which was very nice because I had oral surgery scheduled for only 3 weeks away & I needed my appliance to be ready prior to surgery.  
When I arrived at he office I was happily greeted by the front desk. The 1st thing I noticed about the office is that it doesn't smell like a dentist office. Once I was checked in I was brought back to a consultation office and met with Dr. Elliott & Cassey (his dental assistant). Dr. Elliott and I discussed what I needed and my health history, etc.  After that we headed over to one of the exam bays and he did a full evaluation. We came up with a plan 
Over the next few weeks I spent a lot of time at Lifesmiles. I was having to come about 3 times a week. Dr. Elliott was meticulous about making sure that my new smile was going to be perfect.  He spent a lot of time with me. His office regularly went above and beyond the call of duty for me.  Cassey regularly hand delivered my appliances to the lab on her way home from work. My surgery was on July 5th. My smile has been restored and I can't even come up with the words to express my happiness. Dr. Elliott even called me the day after surgery to see how I was feeling.  It was such a nice gesture. 
Dr. Elliott is truly a great dentist.  If you want a gentle & caring dentist you should meet with him.  You will not be disappointed.

I have eaten at Parc on many occasions and have enjoyed it immensely until tonight.  Our table was unsatisfactory, the maitre d's were rude, the service was disorganized, and the food was mediocre, especially given the price tag. Simply disappointing.

When your fellow diners are policemen, taxi drivers, women in hijabs, a priest, millennial finance guys, petite Asian women, Philly locals and a strange looking guy with a small disheveled therapy dog in tow, you know you have come to the right place.  Located in a strip mall down the street from the hotel we had landed in, this Yelp recommendation did not fail to satisfy and makes us wish that this Maryland Peruvian chain 'Fast' food restaurant was as ubiquitous as the predictable Boston Market brand that can be found next door. Don't be put off by the looming presence of the dialysis treatment facility next door. I suspect a lot of their clients come running to this friendly and yummy restaurant immediately after treatment.  The extensive menu featuring Peruvian favorites with a smattering of Mediterranean type offerings (think Lamb Gyros) is a revelation and took a while to sort through.  But you shouldn't miss the house specialty- the charbroiled chicken.  My only regret was not getting the half chicken, as my smaller dark meat quarter chicken was licked clean and left me wanting for more. Moist, infused with umami lemon saltiness, this chicken ranks up there as one of the better roast chickens that have passed through these lips.  Judging by the strewn bone carcasses left by my fellow eclectic diners, they would agree. Sides of beans and Yuca were solid. Great side sauces and tempting desserts (bread pudding hit the spot).  This strip mall restaurant (lots of seating, no tableside service but they will bring your dine in order to the table) is a hidden gem.  The service was friendly and surprisingly homey and honest with that Philadelphia brotherly love toughness oozing through. A winner in my books.
Worth the trip, great T-Shirts too!

The coziness and character of Prufrock will bring me back again and again. I want a chair I can relax in while I sip my beverage and dive deep into a book or conversation, and Prufrock delivers! The staff were very friendly. They have quite a bit of seating and even a small area for kids to play in. I tried a milk steamer that was luke warm and neither good nor bad, but I'd like to try their other drinks before I give a clear verdict on beverages. I was excited they carry Circle Kombucha! 

Welcome to the neighborhood, please stick around!

Food was great and people were super friendly. Strongly recommended! We felt like we were traveling in Germany again.The athmosphere was 100% authentic. Beer, bread, the shnitzels, everey dish we tried was superb! The deserts were amazing as well. Loved it! If this restaurant was closer to home we would be there every week!

My wife and I are new to the Boise area. We're staying at the Hyatt Place across the street while we're in town building our new house. We decided to check out Lock, Stock & Barrell after we noticed the "famous Prime Rib" sign on the outside. After the quick walk across the street we were promptly seated in a two top booth after initially being offered, and turned down a  table.  

I was intrigued by the looks of the place from the outside in that the restaurant didn't jump out as anything special.  That said, I can't tell you how many places in my life that I've been to that didn't look like much from the outside but wound up being some of my favorite places! 

My wife and I ordered the Pork Rib Eye.  The waitress quickly came back to the table advising that they only had one left.  Being the gentleman... I gave my wife that and I decided to order their "famous prime rib." After a cocktail or two and a glass of wine we asked our waitress to submit our order.  Our server showed up not 10 minutes later with a double chop, bone in pork chop with loaded baked potato for my wife and my 11 oz., medium prime rib with horseradish mashed potatoes for me.  

Not to sound too snooty but my wife and I are members of a VIP club at Lawry's the Prime Rib in Beverly Hills, CA. (We can't afford to live there but it's within traveling distance from our house).  The experience and food at Lawry's are amazing but I have to admit, the prime rib at Lock, Stock and Barrell was every bit as good if not better than Lawry's.  The salad was nothing fancy yet delicious. The prime rib was not too marbled but at the same time off the hook flavorful.  The prime rib was served in a sea of au jus that perfectly complimented the meal.

Also, the wine list was complimentary to the menu in that it had some great wines but were not over priced for the experience. 

Overall, we had a great time and will be back!  We love the funky decor and appreciate that not all great things come in a shiny chain restaurant environment. 

I can't wait to come back and try the steaks!  Overall I'd say two thumbs up!

I would not recommend this company. We had caps on our windowsills installed and a strip of siding put in. The work was unprofessional and we had damage occur to our home from their employee.  The reason I gave them two stars was that they did come out to fix the job, but the second employee was not informed about fixing the damaged siding, which I was told he would be. Rather than chasing them down once again and being accused of "wanting a whole new back of the house" again (we only wanted them to fix the strip of siding that was damaged), we decided to just walk away. I do believe they tried to contact me, but left no message. It was just one headache after another with them and quite frankly I wouldn't trust them to fix the damage at this point. The other reviews on Yelp seem to be fairly inline with our experience and I feel like their work speaks for itself.

They had me sleeping on soiled bed sheets. Blood stained sheets. It took 3 weeks to get a response from the GM who basically told me it was my blood... So I left a huge blood stain on a bed when I had no cuts or blood coming out of me.... Right... This has to be a health code violation right?

Cute place... with delicious drinks! The Rosette comes with an actual rose on top!! Soooooo pretty! The drink itself is light and very refreshing... not sweet at all! So if you're in the mood for something non-caffeinated, this is a perfect drink!
2nd visit and just as enjoyable this thru.  Fu atmosphere for all.  Outstanding entertainment for the $.  Parking in garage is expensive$35 for 3 hours.

Living in West Philly, this is a local spot for local beer and pub food. I wish I could give this place more stars because it's literally 2 blocks away, but everything is average here. Food is your standard pub food, local beers at a local price, and regular ol service and decor. Nothing amazing, nothing bad.

This place used to have the BEST menudo that was Available daily. I stopped in Tuesday to get a large container for hubby and I,the girl at the front was nice and helpful but the menudo was NASTY. Way wayyyyy too much lard. When the soup would be sitting after each bite you could see the layer on top,it ended up making both of us vomit. I'm pretty bummed as we eat their menudo regularly and usually get some for my Nana too when we stop in from vsil. Unfortunately we will NOT be back. I had to dump the rest and the amount of lard left in my sink was nasty. Such a waste of $15.

Never had a bad experience here yet. Right on the corner of Street and Hulmeville Road, their parking lot can be a little tricky/dangerous.

Solid beer selections and you can make your own 6-pack as well.
MJ is the man to see for all your truck needs. Got me the exact truck I wanted at the price I wanted!!!!

No insurance company is comparable to USAA.   If you doubt it, ask any auto insurance company if they can match USAA rates, coverage & service.  Also since it is a mutual company, if you are a member and buy any form of insurance, you are partial owner and get a rebate/dividend at the end of the year.

I have been a member and had USAA auto insurance for over 40 years, having joined when I was in the military.  You must be active-duty military, retired/a vet or immediate relative of a member to join (my grown kids are members through me)  The company is based in San Antonio but has a major office in Tampa.  You can handle nearly all business by phone, mail & email, including claims for auto, home-owners, life insurance, investments, mortgages, auto loans, banking, real estate buy/sell assistance, referrals and commission rebates, etc. They are very technologically advanced, allowing for check deposit by online scanning, reimbursement for any ATM service fees, all statements/status, including images of your checks available online or paper version.   They offer an extensive array of mutual funds, including retirement mixes, and will handle any stock purchases/sales or other brokerage transactions for low or no commission.   I have been able to consolidate most of my financial/insurance/investment activity under one umbrella, with free investment advice & healthy yields, even in a down market.  And they are great on handling claims, and I have had both auto and home damage that they have covered efficiently, fairly & quickly.

So if you are eligible directly or by family connection....check it out....note for the first time, USAA is advertising its services.  They offer an impressive variety of financial/insurance products.  I have told them that if they venture into the grocery business, I will be hanging around their produce section, since it will undoubtedly be better than even Publix or Whole Earth.

And note, I have given only one 5 star rating for eating places and this 5 star for services.
Food is always delicious. It'll be await for your order so good to call ahead but it's worth the wait. Feels like the food is made w love

I just don't get the rave reviews.  I had the bbq chicken bowl and it was slim at best.  Little chicken.  A few fries.   And the slaw was on top of the French fries.  By the time I got to them they were soggy.  And the sauce on the chicken wasn't a bbq sauce.  Not sure what it was.  $35 for lunch for two with a tip?  Holy crap.  Not at all worth it.

Great dive bar with good food @ good prices
Locals places, small, dark, tab too smoky but it is a bar
Food served till 5 PM, excellent poorboys
easy walk from the converntion center, when you need to get away from the business side of things walk in the Corporation Bar & Grill  ... on my list favs in NO

At least the salad wasn't iceburg but it was still good.

Three words: Flur De Tini. Yes please!! So yum!

Gumbo, you rocked my world. You gave my spicy tummy a run for it's money. 

Bartender was cool. I love NOLA because football is on even in the nicer resturants like this one was.

No way would I recommend this podiatrist. In my opinion, he seemed mostly distracted and unable to make sense of anything or explain what he was trying to do. Never did anything that seemed organized or professional. The staff was good, but the office has a very strange layout. Matches his aptitude.

Have been a long time customer at this resteraunt. In the past few years ownership has changed hands. I usually spend $80 to $120 dollars there a month. I ordered by phone last night and when I went to pick up the order I told the man who took care of me what salad dressing I wanted with my salad and he said they no longer give salads with dinners. I proceeded to tell him that I would not be coming back as the salads always came with dinners. Mr. Owner, you won. You didn't have to provide me with the salads. Guess what, you really lost as I won't be returning and will tell my friends and family of your new policy. By the way I have seen the portions get smaller and prices rise. Some things do change. Support your local restaurants during the pandemic which we did and now we get paid back,!

Went here on Saturday with one of my colleagues who also happened to need a renewal on contacts. I made an appointment for both of us at with one at 10:00AM and the other at 10:30.

If you've ever been to a LensCrafters then you pretty much know what to expect from this store. However, there are a few things that set Vision Works above any other combined eye doctor/glasses dispensary. 

1.) I have astigmatism in both eyes which causes me to pay around $1200 a YEAR for contacts.  The very young, very fiscally aware eye doctor I had (Dr. Vu, I think.) noticed the astigmatism in my right here could actually stand not to have torque lenses anymore. This cuts my contact bill by nearly half :) That alone would make me come back time and time again. 

2.) The front of house staff that takes care of insurance, glasses fitting, answering phones etc. etc. were the *most helpful* individuals I have experienced in the eye care industry.  Seriously.  The woman who took care of me tallied up the cost of my glasses a half dozen times so I could get the best deal. AND she fixed my personal pair of glasses that were all kinds of jacked up.  That's going above and beyond in my opinion. 

3.) The store is very bright and cheery with tons of glasses to choose from.  They run some killer deals too so make sure you hit them up. 

I will be back!

This was my first Tennessee bar experience and it set the "bar" real high! In such a random, business looking location, this bar will shock you with vibrant color and adolescent excitement the second you walk in the door!  

When my friends and I walked in there was awesome music playing, live Bingo being called out, and many individual crowds bursting out with laughter. The song that comes to mind in explaining the awesome environment of this bar would be "I Love This Bar" by Toby Keith. You could tell all who enter love this bar!

We got up to the counter and were greeted immediately despite the somewhat larger sized crowd. The menu was full of unique, funny, exciting drink names but of course the first to catch my attention was the Californication! Anything with California in the name plus pineapple and tequila is my kind of drink, and it lived up the the expectation. In fact, all the drinks ordered that night did! Super fruity, exotic, and boozy are the best way to describe them.

With our drinks we headed to the back patio to play the life sized Jenga, Connect Four, ping pong, and darts games. There was a nice crowd outside but so much space that everyone felt comfortable doing their thing. The games were such a fun surprise and missing no pieces which was a plus! With live bingo, life size outdoor games, and sports on the TVs there was really something for everyone at this bar. Only complaint I'd heard amongst another group was that they got rid of the Beer Pong table.. Definitely would have been cool to play that!

*Tourists and locals alike looking for a good time with many options of entertainment, funky drinks, and not a crazy crowded atmosphere check this place out!

Tamira is great. There are not many options for Indian food in the Santa Barbara area, but from what I have experienced, Tamira reigns supreme. And the owner is wonderful! I highly recommend the lamb korma.
Charming place. Had the mango salmon and curried goat which were outstanding. Tasted fresh! I even saw a couple celebrities at the restaurant. Very cool. Small family fun place.

Called to have my dryer fixed.  A Rep was sent out the next day to inspect my dryer and diagnose issue which was no heat, needed a new heating element.  The Rep said someone should call us in a day or two to confirm and schedule the repair once they have the part.  It took 17 days to fix my dryer, only after I called them to ask if they were going to come out and finish the job.  The price was higher than quoted by nearly $90.  Shady all the way around.

First time in the area, we were headed to Denny's next door, saw all the cars at Jerry Bobs and went there instead. So glad we did. Best breakfast we had our whole trip. Fresh ingredients, nice selection, wonderful iced tea and coffee. Our waitress was amazing, place was very clean. We got the last table on a early Saturday morning. By the time we finished there was a huge line and I can see why. If you're in the area, this place is a must!!!!
Well done Kermit's! I love sidecar.... So I knew Kermit's wouldn't disappoint... Best pizza I've had in the city :-)

Does not accept Aetna if you on medicaid. They do not tell you that until you show up and embarrass you in front of all the other patients. Desk lady was rude and mean. Even if you have insurance you should go somewhere else. Terrible experience.

A month ago i requested extra beef at a cost of two dollars a sandwich. When i got home each sandwich had four slices of beef. . Next time there i mentioned it and was told if it happened again to let them know , ( ques i was out four dollars). A  month later 9/13 ( i got two beef sandwiches for take out, ( $8.50 a piece) Sandwich was lousy , chewy, no meat. Instead of forcing the other sandwich down i brought it back, assuming owner would say no problem, that happens with beef sometimes. Instead  the owner and two other employees took the sandwich apart and examined it.  The owner was  clearly upset . ( at me ) I asked if there was a problem, he told me i was the only person in twenty years to complain about and return a sandwich.  Yeah , right, sure i was I bet if he were to go out to eat and got a bad $8.50 sandwich, he would be the first to complain and refuse to pay for it . He should read some of the other reviews on this site. He has no issue taking your money, he just does not want to hear a complaint. Every time i get take out i go out of my way to tip the waitress nicely for the takeout order .  Of course everyone of them looked at me like i was some type of a low life .  I WAS GAINING NOTHING,I feel i am a nice, generous, customer, and thats what i get.  I got my replacement  sandwich , took it home an fed it to the neighbors dog.   STAY AWAY,  All smiles, until you mention a problem with the food .   Fatty, over priced, horrible sandwich, worth maybe $4,00 dollars at best . STAY AWAY !!!!!! . When he goes out of business he will be scratching his head wondering what went wrong.

Part of this is nostalgic but my boyfriend that lived in the neighborhood at the time took me here and I absolutely loved it....it was spicy enough to make my have to drink enough water for a week, fresh and the staff was friendly. So many good choices but I stuffed myself on the PUD KRAPOW -spicy basil chicken and perfect rice. How could you go wrong?

I have been dying to try this place since I heard it was going in. I had the bahn mi sandwich and it was absolutely delicious. The pork was tender and perfectly spiced. The veggies were fresh and crisp. The bread was also amazing. It held up beautifully to the moisture from the pork but had a wonderful crisp texture. They have La Croix and a bunch of other artisan waters. It was a great dining experience and I will definitely be going back! Can't wait to try their salads!

I enjoyed the massage a lot. Friendly staff and clean, cozy environment. I purchased a groupon for a couples massage with champagne and strawberries, however, did not receive the champagne or strawberries. When I asked, I was told I needed to ask for them before the massage when I was asked if I wanted a drink. A little disappointed that I didn't get a drink/fruit, but the quality of the massage made up for it. I'll probably go back, and now I know to ASK for the drink.

As a new fan of Plato's, I'll say this place probably isn't the first one I'd go to if I wanted to shop/sell. Even though the store is full of clothing, there just isn't anything that interests me.

One thing I will say is that they have a great promotion going on, but you would only know if you happened to go into the fitting room and see the flyer. Right now, all their dresses are buy one, get one free until the end of March! (I scored a VS, Free People, and 2 other dresses for $20!)

The people that work there seem to be nice enough, not overly polite but tolerable. I give them a 3 for service and selection; they earn an extra star for being the only location with the bogo deal!

Definitely a unique experience, the dishes we had here are very different then traditional dining.  Get the Gnocchi, do it!  Wasn't a very big fan of the desserts though or the beef tartar.  Cool spot overall, the flavors you will get in each dish is definitely an adventure.  I would recommend sitting at the bar to watch the food come out, for me there was a big disconnect between the print on the menu and what the dish was actually like.  Best practice look at the food come out and order stuff that looks good! Kind of an expensive meal of you include wine, would probably go back for the experience, probably won't be a casual spot though because the portion to price ratio (I know they are tapas) is not very conducive to someone trying to get the most food for their buck.

Our waiter was fantastic! The fried ravioli and caprese were out of this world!! So fresh!! Highly recommend the Venetian Breeze drink. So fruity and so yummy!! The veal Parmesan was great. And for dessert, highly recommend the brownie and the tiramisu!! You won't be disappointed here!!

The burrito was sour by the time I brought it home. I didn't even add sour cream or cheese.. maybe the gauc? And There was hardly any chicken in mine. Maybe it was last bits of chicken at the time. It costs more than Chipotle as well.

I love going to this place for lunch. I recommend the Commish and add chicken cutlet. The pesto gets absorbed into the bread and it makes the bite that much better. The burgers are good too. The loaded funnel cake fries tho...best unhealthy decision you could make for yourself. So fire.

Really nice little Thai place in Montecito.  We had the vegetable spring rolls and pad thai with tofu.  Both were great.  Flavorful and very fresh.  Excellent service as well.  We'll definitely be back!

Delicious flavor combinations! Order your flavor first, and then you can choose as many toppings as you'd like once it's done. Fresh, real, ingredients. Loved the owners, they let my two very curious boys watch up close how the ice cream was made. They were very kind and made sure we loved our ice cream. We will be back!

Great staff but extremely limited beer menu and the pretzels they brought me looked like they were heated in a microwave. Yuk! $8 for shriveled up bread. C'mon whoever owns this place. You know you have a captive audience in the airport but won't you feel better if you also deliver good product and experience? Have some pride.

Wow! This place  is the real deal for anything sweet! Unique flavors of cupcakes that make your mouth cheer! Family owned and loved....their custom cakes are insane YUMMY! Thank you CAKE AFFECTION for bringing St.Pete/ Seminole your TOUCH!
Karim and his taxi service are terrific. He is professional, personable, and always on time in a well maintained taxi. I highly recommend Green City Taxi.
worth every penny. Incredible vegan pastries at mostly affordable prices. If vegan this is a must breakfast/coffee stop!

Jim Click Kia, about the wonderful sale they were having at the Community 
Center on Kia's. I had wanted one for a very long time, as they were held 
in such high esteem by the ratings.So I called them and went over to see what
they had. I found one and took advantage of the sale. 

I bought it and since I live near Royal Kia decided to use their service as I had used their free pit stop  service for my Chrysler town and country for years.I had the best service adviser Chrystal Orantez. Also I was impressed with the pit stop director and gentleman named  John Pittman who greeted people and with the hospitality set up,so he was multitask,pit stop expert and also making wonderful popcorn.  It was the consumers dream. Thus I decided to buy the extended warranty for almost $2000,since it was several hundred less that Jim Click.All went well until time for my 15000 mile checkup. 2018.I was told that Kia USA had ordered a remodel of the facility, and thus everything was torn up making it like a war zone,and the lounge was gone, and so we waited and finally it was done. No oh no,now it was time to tear up some more making it hard to get in to the newly remodeled section and still gone were the stalls for the service advisers. None the less when I finally found where to turn in for first major check up,the 15,000 mile check up  and to my surprise when we discussed the new gasket for the door, covered indeed,but saying that I was to pay for the installation.. I said no way. I was supposed to be given the given credit for what had been charged.
Checking my bill I am seeing not so. That amount had been added in as a misc. cost  Altho on my copy it shows a credit. First con at this place.It gets worse.I paid $327.83. and thereafter when there for the gasket installation was told I needed a wheel alignment , which I learned I did not need. That would have been extra and the reason I was not told on the big visit , was they  were to busy. 

To make this story interesting they had no record of my $2000 extended warranty that I purchased from them  and declared that  I had not bought it there. So I came home and got it  returning the next day and they said they had copied it had taken care of it and I was would hear from them soon. To this day I have not, and my husband a retired master mechanic said they thought I was just another dumb  blond, and that women are stupid,  but he wanted them  to know they had met their match. They have yet to call and my friends have urged me to post this as they feel it will bring results. Lets  hope so.Numerous calls have yielded no  results from any one. 

 I want the old Kia dealership personal back. they were so wonderful.

But this will not happen so I have to take care of this. 

And if they do th is kind of thing to me they will do it to you too, I would imagine.

Went here today, just now. This is the worst "detailing" I've ever seen done by adults. I paid for the "interior super clean".. Super clean, my a$$! They barely did anything to it. So now, not only am I out $50+ (after tax), I also have to clean it myself. On top of that, the gal who wiped it down before it went in for the full detail was talking about how my car was " a piece of shi* " and" why bother even detailing it.. " etc. 1. My Toyota 4-runner is in great shape and is in pretty good condition. 2. It's not even that old. Pictures included are after the " detailing". Worst experience at a detail shop ever. Also worst place to go to get your car cleaned out. Don't waste your money or your time.
My favorite place in STL! Bartenders are super friendly. The patio is so unique- perfect for photos :)

Came in on a grey Saturday after the lunch hour and it was pretty empty. Despite the lackluster crowd, the bartender was still pretty dismissive and abrupt with us, a group of four at a high top off the bar. 

You'd think this bar did everything right. Exposed kegs, wide variety of drafts, electronic menus with a live running bar of social media mentions, including twitter, foursquare, and untapped. But nothing really hit home. The electronic menus were hard to read. The bar felt too slick and packaged. Everything had a false note to it. In this part of the city, it's really not necessary to settle for such lackluster ambiance.

Never had a chimichanga, it's pretty good here yummy. Definitely recommend frozen margaritas over margaritas on the rocks. (There's more alcohol in them). Service was pretty fast for a Saturday night with a line out the door.

The time I'll go there. After ordering soup and the Chefs Special, which the server and hostess raved about, my soup was promptly delivered.  Although the obviously felt a knife and fork were proper utensils I asked, and waited for a spoon.  After finishing the soup I sat for more than 20 minutes as the staff disappeared. When the server did come by she said she didn't know what was taking so long.  After another 6-7 minutes I got up yo try and find the waitress to cash out for the soup and leave. IF THE KITCHEN ISN'T PREPARED TO COOK DON'T  OPEN THE DOORS!

I loved Hollands when it was part of the meat market on Sugar Creek. Now I think they both have suffered. I don't like the new restaurant. It doesn't feel welcoming. The lighting is glaring and the tables aren't set up well. The pick-up side is too big. Just a waste of space. The aroma of smoky barbecue is gone. The meat market hasn't changed much but it was so nice to be able to eat there. It was cozy and fun. A unique experience that we looked forward to. Now I still go to the meat market but it's not a fun visit. We probably won't go back to the new restaurant. Makes me sad.

This pizza is something special. The ambiance of the restaurant is very nice and feels fancy without being snooty. We ordered cheesy breadsticks to start and they were amazing, but very filling. Next we ordered the vodka pizza with basil and it was amazing. The crust was so thick and so soft and the vodka flavor was unique and fun. Will definitely be coming back here!

I am so happy I found this place! I've been going here for a few years now, and Kailey has been doing my hair recently. I have never been happier with the results of my haircut/dye. She is extremely talented and I'm so happy I've found someone I trust to do a great job with my hair. This place has a great atmosphere and everyone is friendly and welcoming. The prices are great, especially for the high quality results you will get. I highly recommend this place!

This Verizon store is the bomb. 

All of the employees are super, super nice. I'm going to be honest - sometimes, the people at the phone store at the HARDEST PEOPLE TO DEAL WITH IN THE WORLD. Jamal made my experience awesome. 

This store is really big and nice. They have a lot of accessories in addition to just phones. Their phone case selection is the best of any Verizon store I've been to. They have a lot of different speakers and cool phone gadgets.

Plus, this Verizon is close to Uptown. Win.

My boyfriend and I stayed here while we visited Busch Gardens. I must say the hotel is very convenient. It is located literally across the street from the park. Complimentary breakfast which was very filling. Waffles, bagels, cereal, boiled eggs, toast and other things that are tasty. The beds are very comfortable I slept in till 12PM !! Located next to different food spots, and also if you're looking for liquor only go to deweys because that is the only liquor store that has Hennessy ! Lol will stay here again!
Came to New Orleans for vacation and saw this little place in the corner of a shopping mall, food was very good! Flavored to perfection! Service was very fast and friendly! Definitely recommend it!
Stopped in for a drink, and some in our group had giant onion rings, which they said were good.  Nice selection of beers!

Dude, I did not expect to have as much as I did here! It's pretty expensive, but as long as you bring a group it's totally worth it. I would definitely suggest making some sort of reservations on the weekends, the last Saturday we wen we had to wait over an hour. It's awesome because you have a waiter while you're golfing. It's dope.

I am in love with this place. Finally a poke spot in Indianapolis. The fish is fresh. There is an assortment of toppings (crab salad and seaweed salad at no extra cost)! Yum! Keep up the good work with your quality ingredients and quick customer service.
This is one the best take out or sit in restaurants . The food is fresh and the people that serve you are so nice . I would go there every Day if I could !

4 stars for what it is, a nice clean motel.  It's in a nice quiet neighborhood.  The rooms are clean and there's a fridge provided.  They provide little amenities like tooth brushes and shaving kits.  They nice touches like free water and a bowl of candy in the room.  Wifi is free.

The pool was small and the jacuzzi is in a different area.  I opted to get a massage from an on call masseuse.  They have a nice private room and for $70 for an hour, it's not bad for a hotel.

The staff is friendly and helpful.  If we stay here again, we may try the adjacent restaurant.  The menu looked decent and they had a little bar.

I don't know what other people paid, but this place is cheap.  I think we paid $129 a night for a weekend stay.  You'd be hard pressed to find anything cheaper in Santa Barbara.  Also it is what it is.  If you crave luxury, spend $600 and stay at the Bacara or the Four Seasons.  If you need something in the middle, drop $300 on the Fess Doubletree or the Hyatt.  I've stayed at all of these hotels.  But if you're traveling with small kids and just need a place to crash, this place is just fine.

I called around to a few auto mobile detailers and got a quick response from Anthony.  He came over later that day and provided a quote and came out later that week on a Saturday to do the job. I walked over alot of things other companies routinely missed. I had to leave after 4 hrs and told him just to leave the keys. When I got home it looked like it did when I bought the thing if not better! Would definitely recommend him to any of my friends.  Keep up the good work!

Food was amazing. Always looking for good new places for lunch around the area and this was defiantly a hit. few guys in my office joined me for lunch and we decided to give Dooleys a try. Everyone was impressed with the food and the service. Very friendly people, and the burgers were delicious. I would recommend trying this place. Also they have their own parking lot, which is nice in this area.

My friends and went here for brunch. I had the Yogurt Panna Cotta with a side of the Castle Valley Mill Grits. The grits was delicious, but seeing the melted butter on it made it less appealing. Despite that, the flavor was amazing. The yogurt was my favorite. It was absolutely delicious and I would definitely get it again. The saltiness of the grits and the sweetness of the yogurt worked so well together and I highly recommend it. I can't wait to go back and try other things.

I'm down with this place. 

My first experience today for a late lunch was really pretty perfect. Our waitress Lindsay was funny and honest with her recommendations. I went with the vegilladas. I wasn't expecting much looking at the menu, but hot damn, those flavors packed a punch. The blend of tangy lime, earthy feta and cilantro was unbelievable. I've never had anything that original Mexican fusion-wise. I found myself savoring every delicate bite. I also had a side of sweet potato fries, which were coated in sugar and cinnamon, maybe a touch of salt. The taste and texture was just right, and I'll get them again for sure.

I enjoyed Taco Mamacita's atmosphere, though it's clear they're aiming to be a chain. So long as they have plenty of tasty veggie items on the menu, I'll keep coming back.
I think this Nico's is actually better than some of the other locations. Nothing to write home about but it's decent enough that I go back.

I've been seeing Dr. Monte Neugebauer of Reno Dental Associates for about nine years now.  He was referred to me by a coworker after I had a bad experience at another dentist in town.  Dr. Monte is wonderful, and unfortunately, retiring (sort of).  He only works Mondays and Tuesdays now, but he is still there for the time being.  All of his patients can still see him if you go on Mondays or Tuesdays, or they've moved us over to Dr. Tamra Neugebauer for visits during the other days of the week.  Dr. Monte has done a few fillings for me and a root canal over the years.  I can't say it's never been painless (let's face it, a shot in your gum is going to hurt regardless), but he does try to take the sting out of it.  He's very fast with his work but you don't feel that he's ever rushing either so you feel confident that everything is getting done right.  His assistants are great too, very friendly and helpful.

The hygienist are okay, good or great.  I've had quite a few over the years, and some I absolutely love, while others I could do without.  I think it comes down to personal preference really and what you expect from a cleaning or x-rays.  They take many different kinds of insurance too - I think I've changed insurance four times in nine years, and they've taken all of them so far.  Overall, they are great place to go for being a dentist.

Must wear your mask for the entire tour!! 
We did the classic cave tour, which we thought was very interesting! Online, we made the assumption that children were allowed in the cave however, I started questioning myself when the family in front of us were split up because their young child wasn't allowed. 
Talking to the guide, he said young children are allowed, as long as they wear a mask the entire time. 
No babywearing. You can hold your child but can't have them in a carrier.

Wow! I thought no way was I getting a "best ever" steak at a bar, I was wrong. The steak was awesome. When I set at the bar and saw the A1&57 setting out I was again thinking if it needs sauce its not going to be any good. But a 20oz for 12.95 and others saying how good it is I had to try it. 

You have a choice between a side salad, potato salad or fries. I went med_rare with fries. Jest before my dinner came out I grabbed the ketchup (I refuse to use A1-57). When my plate came out (again WoW!) it was a great looking steak with seasoned fries. The steak and fries were both so good I didn't even use the the keychup. 
I add my approval of this place.

Thank you, to Adam and Sara for a great night!

I dislike writing this review because the best part about Glendale 12 is that no one knows about it.  While everyone else goes to the Arts Cinema or Castleton theater, I will gladly enjoy the theater to myself.  The most important part of a movie theater experience has nothing to do with the theater but the people who attend the theater. This one has no annoying movie goers.  Other than this it is just like all the other movie theaters.  I have always had friendly service and the prices are great for the early screenings.  I am a big fan of the Saturday afternoon movie and I am waiting for it to get warm so I can walk there.
Hate chains but this one is one of the best.  Food typically good and the service here is always excellent

Erin creates a culture that is translated through her staff.  Every staff member that I've come in contact with is amazing.  You can tell the owner cares about her staff and they are well taken care of.  So much so, I would enjoy working here and hope to soon.

WONDERFUL COMPANY. HONEST, AMAZING CUSTOMER SERVICE, PROFESSIONAL. 
     Thanks very much specifically to Alex, Glen, Chris, G., and Robby! 
     Our family has used Brothers EZ Moving twice, now. 
This review will be detailed because they deserve it, and in my mind as I write this, I am comparing our fantastic experience with Brothers EZ, to a horrendous experience we had with a different moving company.
      We have only ever been treated respectfully by every member of Brothers EZ Moving. I so appreciate their customer service - each of them is easy to talk to, while still professional, understanding, and helpful. Everyone operates with integrity - what they say they offer and do are exactly what you get. They do not cut corners, (they take apart bunk beds, regular beds, dining room tables - all the things - and thoroughly wrap every piece of furniture you have in moving blankets, tape, and shrink wrap), they do not take advantage of you (the movers do not abuse the time-estimate the scheduler/operations manager gives you at quoting), and they behave professionally.
    I scheduled through Alex after being quoted an incredibly reasonable price - we live 2 1/2 hours from their office, on the third floor, and our destination is another 2 hours away, into a two-story. Just to be safe, Alex quoted our move for a certain number of very-feasible hours, but Chris, G., and Robby beat that time, which meant WE PAID LESS MONEY than we were quoted (?!).
     After Alex took all my information and gave me the quote, he told me he would speak with their operations manager, Glen, who would call me soon after, to confirm everything. 
      That's exactly what happened. 
      Also, this is a tiny detail, but if you're a mom, you'll get it: both Alex and Glen kindly asked about my daughter they could hear her blabbering during our phone conversations; I got to gush about my baby, and hear about their families. That's simple, easy, plainGOODcustomerservicerightthere. 
      My move was scheduled for the very next day (crisis, and Brothers EZ Moving was there,) and Glen said I could expect a call in the morning from the foreman handling my move, to let me know they were on their way. 
        Guess what? 
       That's exactly what happened. 
       Chris called me before 7:30am to let me know they were on their way to me. He texted me when they were 40 minutes out. When I didn't respond (my phone was in another room and I didn't hear it ding - organizing boxes, keeping Baby happy, etc...) he called me, to make sure he actually spoke with me. Our things were handled with care and packed into the Brothers EZ truck pretty much as fast as humanly possible, and Chris, G., and Robby drove another 2 hours to our new home, and unpacked everything. I mention the times because they were so conscientious! They worked hard, did their jobs, and didn't mess around. When they were done, I got a text from Chris (my husband was on the receiving end of the move) and an emailed invoice immediately after. 
     At the risk of sounding like a one-woman choir, singing the praises of Brothers EZ Moving, well...I don't really care. They made me feel that they were capable and that they cared about how well they accomplished their work. I truly appreciate every interaction I've had with Brothers EZ Moving and confidently say their business practices and the employees who enact them are worthy of respect.
Thank you so much, guys - and sorry again about all the stairs.
Discovered this place this week and already eaten there 3 times. I recommend this place to anyone that enjoys mexican
Enjoy live music and great breakfast any day of the week.  One of my go to spots for Saturday morning relaxation.

We got there two hours before closing so didn't think they would still be busy. We didn't make a reservation so had to wait 75 minutes (for a party of five) before we were seated. Once we got a table, the server was inattentive to our group since she was still swamped with other tables. 

Food was a hit or miss for me. My favorite item the whole night was the crabmeat stuffed shrimp appetizer. Entrees that I tried were ok (paneed rabbit and grilled duck breast). We were super hungry so was happy to get complimentary cornbread and fried oysters. It was disappointing since the cornbread was dry and the fried oyster was cold and soft (probably sitting around too long). The shrimp and alligator sausage cheesecake came highly recommended but it's over hyped as well.

We were happy we ordered the bbq oysters with blue cheese dressing, alligator sausage and seafood gumbo, and we got carried away eating that yummy bread. It was our first meal in NOLA, and we were looking for something quick and near the hotel before heading out to explore the French Quarter.  It has generic "tourist" vibe, but we had good food and service.

They didn't have any seating available downstairs, so we sat upstairs at the little indoor bar area.  The seating was a bit awkward, but the food was fabulous!  We shared a couple appetizers and they were all great!  I'd love to come back to try one of their burgers!

I recently adopted my dog Jack from the animal shelter and he is a bit anxious and nervous. I took him into the Petsmart grooming at El Con about a month or so ago to get his nails trimmed and the woman did a great job. She was very loving and although he cried while she trimmed his nails, he came out of the appointment wagging his tail. 
Today I took him back into the same Petsmart to get his nails trimmed again and had a very different experience than the last. The woman working the front desk in the grooming center was rude and seemed very uninterested. She put the leash on my dog and proceeded to drag him through the door. She did not even greet him or try to make him comfortable. I picked him up and handed him to her so she would stop dragging him. I then went outside for a few minutes and when I came back she came out and told me my dog is "too strong and stressed" for her to trim his nails. Mind you he weighs 8 pounds and is a terrier/dachshund mix. I went to get him and she handed me my dog and did not say another word. Very disappointed in her rude behavior and lack of compassion towards my dog. Will NOT be returning.

I'm not the kind of dude who throws around the term awe-inspiring. But this century-old courtyard space inspires truckloads of awe. Maybe it was the four margaritas I consumed...but I was definitely in awe.  A night at El Paseo is the quintessential Santa Barbara experience. Sure, the food is good. But it's the experience you'll love.

I eat here at least 2 times a week for breakfast. The food is always good and the service is awesome! My little girl who is 3 can't wait to finish eating so she can get her free lollipop at the register)) Highly recommended!

Cute shop but seems kind of young for my taste. It's a good place for festival clothes or a sweet gift. When I went, it was mostly spring/summertime clothes, unsure if this is their year round vibe or if it was for the upcoming season. 
Customer service is good but nothing out of the ordinary & their instagram & fb pages seem to be updated regularly.
Best Mexican food in Fl! This review brought to you by a Californian that knows and misses his Mexican food.

This IHOP location is pretty easy to spot - bright blue roof surrounded by car dealerships. It used to be a pretty decent spot (decent considering it's an IHOP) but under new management I dont think it's been up to par with its other breakfast spots located a block or two away.

The atmosphere: It is relatively bright and cheery spot. The servers are all njce and courteous. You can definitely have a good time sitting, sipping on your coffee and munching on your preferred dish.

The quality: IHOP isn't the best of the best in terms of food quality. Most of the dishes I had were pancakes and different variations of them. The pancakes  were sometimes over done, under done, soggy, spongey...Sometimes the pancakes were good but maybe it was the topping that tasted off.

Ultimately, this place is hit or miss.

I came across this place during my wanderings in and around the Glenora area today and decided to stop in and browse even though im not big into new age or paganism. I like the layout of the store most of all as there is lots of room to browse without worrying about bumping into other shoppers. One of the biggest turn offs for me when it comes to stores that carry breakable merchandise is when they have their shelves packed in tightly together making it hard to move around.

They have a wide variety of merchandise including wall scrolls,figurines,books.music,stones,and jewelry. I was interested in the music they were playing over the store speaker and probably would have purchased it had I not been turned off by the customer service. The girl at the front was staring right at me as I came in the door and even though I smiled at her did not acknowledge my presence. I was totally ignored for my roughly fifteen minutes of browsing until I shifted my recyclable shopping bag from my right hand to my left and then she literally shot out from behind the counter and asked if I needed any help finding anything. I genuinely think the rustle of the bag made her think I was shoplifting and I left shortly after.

A cool store for sure and the largest I have seen in the city if you are interested in this type of merchandise but the suspicious sales girl turned me off of any further interest I might have developed in visiting this store again.

We had such a great experience the last time we ordered from here, we decided to try in again. We again, just ordered the pizza. Well, I happy to say, the pizza's we got were great. They were delivered with in the time window, were nice and hot, and everything was intact/in place on the pizza's. There were a few areas that were stuck to the boxes, but that can happen and it was easy to loosen them, and certainly didn't affect the crust or toppings. I hope this location can keep up the good work.

I've had the lunch buffet twice and it's the best of an otherwise unimpressive lineup of Indian restaurants in Tucson. High points first time were lamb rogan josh, aloo gobi, and gulab jaman. Second was chicken keema aloo and saag paneer. Naan was the best I've had, brought out steaming and buttery from the tandoor. Good flavors and spice levels. Indian buffets here are small compared to those in other cities, but nothing major was missing, the people were nice, and the building and location are pluses. Not to mention that the lunch buffet is offered seven days a week.

Authentic! (which yelp friends will tell you is my prime concern with ethnic restaurants).
Very good food.
Very good service.
Nice atmosphere.
Well stocked bar.
Can seat a large party.
Lots of parking.
Lots of options on the menu.
Very accommodating for people with food restrictions.

A great place for a date, a family meal, or a large group of friends.

Definitely a must visit when in Indy.

Not impressed with the place settings, table cloth, silverware and plastic table cloth.  We ordered a really expensive bottle of wine, over 100 dollars and were expecting wine glasses to compliment the wine.  It wasn't served at the proper temperature, and it wasn't served in the proper glasses.  The menu was limited, the appetizer was good, but not great.  When we are told it was Cajun shrimp, I would have expected spice.  The shrimp was cooked to perfection though.  The steak was wonderful.  That was truly the only saving grace of the night. Very flavorful. The potatoes had been sitting in the warmer for a long time as they were too hot to eat.  The ambiance and the room decor was uninvited g for a special occasion anniversary. We had heard great things and left very disappointing except that the wine no matter what glass it was served in was great.

Mirror & Mantel is my ideal hair salon - it's high quality without a hint of being over-the-top or pretentious. I feel 100% comfortable walking in, there's no air of high-strungness, but the quality remains. I go to Hannah and couldn't recommend her more - she's great at listening to what I want, and when I can't fully articulate what I'm looking for, she is very intuitive at sensing what I want. She's down-to-earth and easy to be around, making the entire experience pleasant. I walk out of here feeling amazing, every time. Thee prices are incredibly reasonable for what you're getting: $75 for a quality women's cut and blowout, with free trims (which admittedly I haven't taken advantage of) in between cuts. Definitely recommend!

I wish so badly that I would have found this place first. I don't want to waste time explaining (the literal) pain I went through when I originally got lashes done at another local salon but rather talk about my great experience at Extend Lash. 
When I nervously called to make my appointment and explain what I needed, they actually took the time to listen and had real suggestions and made me feel like they would take care of me, and they absolutely did. 
You wouldn't think such intimidatingly beautiful women would be so kind and sweet and make you feel like you are their number one priority, but they absolutely did. This is a great place that will officially be my new lash home! 

Needless to say, I was a little traumatized by my past lash experience but after my first appointment here, I'm officially ready to start enjoying the process.
The food was pretty good but not awesome. The service wasn't top notch either. My favorite part was probably the Thai spring rolls. My pad Thai was ok and my wife's yellow curry was about the same.

Best cheesesteaks in my humble opinion but I have experienced the staff being rude so that's why I am not giving 5 stars. Haven't been to this location in a while because of it but if you are a tourist please don't bother with Geno's or Pat's, just head to Jim's.

very good food delicious crepes however They must continue to warm up their crab legs

what surprised me is that they do charge for toddler which she barely ate anything please be careful on your bill

This is a great burger spot! They have a gluten free bun option which is perfect for me. We got the double stack burger as apart of Nashville Scene Burger Week, which is a classic burger with two patties, so we're looking forward to trying their other more unique burgers next time! We had David as our server and he was great! He was attentive and very friendly!
Such an amazing place to eat! So authentic, with the food, the music, the drinks....we were just wow'ed. We will definitely be back to try other things on the menu!
Delicious sushi for a great price!! Service was great & the servers were very nice. The sushi rolls were the perfect size. I recommend the butterfly roll!

We've heard great reviews from our friends who dine here frequently so we went for the tasting menu. Overall disappointing. The fois gras was stringy which didn't have a pleasant texture nor taste. The pickling of some of the vegetables was so extreme which overwhelmed the dish and taste buds. There was a lack in balance of flavors.The cheese in the final course may not have been stored properly because it tasted rank (almost fishy) and I never met a cheese I didn't like. I really hope this was an off night for them.

This is one of the only companies that does oil heating and furnaces in Reno that I have been able to find. It has been about 2 years since we have moved in and I realized we need to get it maintenance, as they recommended it to keep it clean and keep the life of our 50's unit in good working order. 

We were able to book it at an 8am slot and Gio was here by 8:05. He was cleaning our unit working in our basement for about 2 hours solid. It had been two years, so I guess there was a lot of soot and build up- I now know it needs cleaned every year! 

When Gio was done, he went over the electronic paper work with me and I signed, but asked about the filters as I had remembered the lady on the phone list 10-15 things that was included in the cleaning. He acted like he didn't know and asked me to pick it up from the store. I stated that I was told it was included, and he didn't even look for them. I was disappointed, but he opened up the back side and took them out. He said he would have to come back for that. I asked him about a CO test and all that and he acted like he didn't know what I was talking about and was like "oh yes of course." But when I asked him how it was preformed he just rambled off some stuff... 

Anyways we left it that he would call me by the end of the day to let me know when he could bring the new filters and I didn't hear. The next day I called the office and they didn't know about it, but quickly jumped in to get it scheduled. 3 hours later Gio called me and was VERY rude- stating that since I hadn't cleaned my furnace in 3 years, there is no way I was in a rush, it works just fine without the filters, etc. etc. I told him that I would be putting my experience on Yelp and if need be would cancel the check I gave him if the job wasn't able to get complete. He stated it was complete and I hung up. 

Following that he called back and said he would come the following day between 10-12 to install- I said thank you and hung up. The office clerk, Natalie then called 3 other times explaining how sorry she was, called another guy out to my house this evening, and even stated they would bring us two extra filters for the trouble. She was SO KIND and SO NICE, I could tell she was upset by the situation too and wanted to correct it. 

Finally, Dustin came out not even an hour later with 4 filters! Installed 2 of them, left 2 for 3 months from now, and double checked all of Gio's work. He even did a CO test to make sure we were all good to go and ran the unit for correct usage/ thermostat check. I was so pleased with this service and so happy that it was corrected in a quick and easy way. 

I will use them again and will just make sure I don't get Gio again-- he was young and just didn't have good communication skills. Great price and timely service.  Thank you Natalie and Dustin for making this a pleasant experience after all!

I love this place! The atmosphere is open and welcoming and the service is amazing. They always have tons of staff and do a great job of allowing multiple samples of their delicious ice cream while still moving the line along. So many fun flavors to try! A bit pricey but worth it to any adventurous ice cream lover! I recommend the wild berry  lavender!

My family and I have almost become regulars here. First, the sushi is fantastic. There is a great variety of fish, a fantastics selection of rolls, and the salad options are great. Secondly, the staff is amazing. Everyone is extremely nice and they are very fast for how much they do. They seem to do great in deliveries/takeaway with how many boxes I have seen being prepped and how many people I have seen pick-up food. Everyone is wearing masks and they do not have people wait inside for a table. They do have some seating outside for people that are waiting for their togo orders or for a table. The place is not very large, but social distancing is practiced there. Highly recommend this sushi restaurant!
Oversized sandwiches, great service and fair prices! High quality ingredients, homemade desserts. An outstanding small gem.

Really good steak restaurant.  Quality of food & service is excellent. My reason for 4 stars instead of 5 is the cost of menu items, it is a little higher than I care to pay for food. However, that does not take away the fact that the steaks & burgers are really good.
The fish I have had at Firebirds is not as good as the steak & burgers.

Absolutely love this spot! Food and service is on point. I'm a picky eater, so when I order something it usually comes with a custom request which they always say "no problem" to.

Easy call ahead pickup and delivery except on Sunday. 

My go-to is the bacon egg and cheese and their cheesesteak is delicious!

Patient, accommodating, and best of all creative.

So I went into BVW to shop for an engagement ring. Valerie walked me through everything, the ring, the diamond. She instructed me in the characteristics of diamonds and how to chose one, never pushing me towards something I didn't want. She even showed me how to find the serial number on the stone so I can know for sure that it never gets swapped out by somebody in the future during a cleaning or whatever.
