I wound up picking out one of Britten's custom designs. After having the stone installed, I learned he added some flare to the mounts... little hearts. 

My fiance was very happy.

Bed Bath & Beyond has become one of our favorite stops at WEM, just because they have all kinds of things for the home and you can pretty much find anything you need here, and then some. My personal favorite is the non-stick ceramic cooking set they sell; healthier and easier to clean and use than regular non-stick pans. Seriously, it's kind of ridiculous how much I love my new pan, I will probably write a separate review for the thing alone.

They always have the latest trendy kitchen gadgets so if you like fun and handy little tools for the home, especially the kitchen, this place is for you! It's also a great place for gifts. There's always a section of marked down items in each section of the store, so take a look -- there's always something for everyone here!

Very impressive for a hotel restaurant! Our waiter, Francis, made our dinner special and was very kind to our kids and family. He is a blessing to this resort! Short ribs were AMAZING! Spicy seafood pasta and lobster tortellini were great too. The special bread was just the icing on the cake. I could seriously eat here again before we leave.
The chicken was moist and the dip was really good but the cheese grits had way too much vinegar (or too much of something that tastes like vinegar) and the horseradish mashed potatoes were too dry.

I love coming to Luxury Nails and getting my pedicures done by Don!! I drive from Santa Barbara just to see him! He is the BEST!! The staff is so friendly and very nice. I never feel pressured to get "extras" like other places. My sisters, Mom, and aunts come here too! Leann is very sweet as well along with the other ladies. They always do a great job on my toes. I highly recommend this place. They all do a great job!!

Been here a total of three times its one of my places I always eat every time I'm in Reno. The food here is good, prices are reasonable and service has always been good here. My favorite here is the brisket it has this good BBQ flavor to it is so good.The ribs are also good here there not to fall off the bone ribs but there pretty tasty. Sides I really like the beer braised chili  beans they have jalapeños and onions and cheddar cheese, also like the black beans and rice. Will be back here to try more stuff out on my next trip to Reno

Give your taste buds a treat.  Excellent tasty cuisine.   We chose the dining room at 4PM and ordered from the multi-choice menu.  Don't miss the 'starters '.....crispy calamari is outstanding.  As is the house made Mai Tai.  We tried several menu items...all very good.  The group seating with an onsite chef had begun before we finished.  That will be fun next time with a group of friends.
Highly recommend.

Many others have praised the good dog signature burger and I want to add my voice to theirs.  The roquefort cheese, caramelized onions, and quality meat arrived on a lovely bun.  Silly that in many places bad bread kills you.  I've been twice and its been meatily amazing both times.  The first time I was there was with a vegetarian--always tricky at a bar.  He had the homemade veggie burger with lentils and beets and really enjoyed it.  It was a good size sandwich, and not a premade/formed burger.  The fries and aioli were better the first time I went and a little soggy the second time so just a timing issues.  A nice place to check out for lunch!

Review only for the restaurant. Finally made reservations to come here for brunch for my sisters 40th birthday. Made reservations easily through open table with a comment that I'd like a window seat if possible. Arrived a half hour earlier than our time and we were pleasantly greeted and seated right away in a seat by the window overlooking the street. The inside of this place is awesome! Very unique and plenty of seating. 

We ordered mimosas, eggs Benedict, crab cake, lobster and crab bisque soup, turkey panini and some type of Mexican breakfast (forget the name of it). The mimosas were strong but I probably wouldn't order again for $8.50 each. The bisque soup was the best we've ever had and we've had it everywhere. Perfectly creamy with HUGE pieces of crab and lobster. Mom liked the crab cake that had no fillers and came with veggies and potatoes for $17. I had the eggs Benedict which were delicious but not the best I've had. Came with a cup of fruit and potatoes. The Mexican breakfast was delicious but the chorizo was too spicy for my sister so she sent it back in exchange for the turkey panini which was good. It was a lot of meat so it was slightly dry but the raspberry mayo that came with fixed that. Our waiter was awesome! So fast and so sweet and really made a difference in our experience. I wish I had remembered his name because he was top notch! The total for lunch plus tip for the 3 of us was $100. We had an excellent time and would most definitely come here again. Setting was perfect, service was excellent, prices for brunch menu were reasonable and the food was great. Can't wait to come back!

I agree with other reviewers about wait time. It's ridiculous, I've had to wait 20mins for my drink to be ready on separate occasions. The last time I was there, there was only one employee making drinks. I don't understand why other baristas didn't jump in and help. There was no sense of urgency on their part.

Service was pretty slow. Only a few tables occupied, but our waiter was laggy.

Food: basic burger and fries. $10.00. Below average taste, soggy buns, fries were awful. 

Served with salsa and chips, chips were stale. 

I would not recommend this place, there are better options in town.

Always good service and a good breakfast spot!  Several omelettes to choice from and fresh cup of coffee! Only thing I would not recommend....$3.75 for large class of milk. Milk is way overpriced and I wasnt expecting that!!  Everything else is reasonably priced though! Tasty biscuits n gravy with friendly service! 
For lunch I recommend open faced roast beef!

The Barrel is a cool concept but their product is horrible.  It tasted like cheap boxed wine that sat in my car too long on a hot July day.  I hope that as a wine bar they can expand beyond a selection of six basic cheap wines... Otherwise, they won't last.  The ambiance and staff are great... It's only the product that is suffering.

I have been to this Pieology occasion twice, now, and I have to say that I am very impressed.

The first time I went, the staff was incredibly kind and helpful and didn't mind helping me make my pizza at all.  The pizza itself is really good considering that this is a fast food, customize your pizza and make it as you go type of place.

This second time, I was beyond floored with the amazing customer service.  When I reached today, there was a decent line of people ordering the pizza.  As I waited in line, the workers did a very good job keeping it moving.  When I got to the front, I had to wait as the people ahead of me were making their order and one of the workers thanked the  customer for reminding her to add one of the toppings on there.  That shining character and the smile she had on her face showed how genuine she was (and I told one of who I hope was a supervisor that this young woman should get the MVP).  The rest of the line went very smoothly and the young woman who rung me up was really nice and offered to hold my pizza warm in the oven as I ran next door to Burger-Fi to grab some fries (it was a carb kinda night).

Anyways, I think this place is fantastic, and I will definitely be going back to Pieology for some really tasty pizza and spectacular customer service.
Pleasantly surprised. Taco trio were packed with meat. Steak quesadilla was also loaded with moist tender meat.

Wanted the Delmar Loop shirt. Didn't see it during the Ice Carnival, and I felt a bit sad. So while walking around today, I found this store. They make custom shirts, and St. Louis butter cakes. 

This is a very small store. But they sell the cool Delmar Loop t-shirt, with the stores names on the back, like in the picture. While I was in there, some customers were selecting custom shirts. 

There are 2 areas to try on the shirts, one is a curtain that is red and white, and the other is the bathroom. I chose the curtain. 

The store makes any custom T you want, and they have a few to sell, and as examples. They have male, female, kids and dog shirts. Space is well utilized, with a computer in the middle of the store for designing your own tshirt. Often I find stores like this don't have any try on areas. The store is red, white and black, and my shopping bag has red and black tissue, with a red bow. 

While there, I grabbed a Delmar Loop map, cause I'll be back to St. Louis. This isn't my last time.
Great local spot. Homemade soup and yummy fresh salads. The breakfast food is delicious and the service always cheerful and welcoming. One of the best hole-in-the-wall joints in Boise for sure.

I'm not sure if it's due to over-drilling or what, but my nails are ruined. Three have peeled off below the nail line. My nails used to be strong and healthy and now they're thin and falling off. This is after a gel manicure, which I've had many times at other salons.
One of my top 3 bakeries in the city. You have to try their donuts. They are the best in the city, in my opinion. Simple and delicious!

Visited their location at the Mercado today and was not disappointed. Their seasonal fig latte is delicious. They have oat milk as an alternative to regular milk but no other options--just a heads up! Currently they are only open for to go orders; you order inside and can choose to wait outside and stroll around and window shop at the different stores in the area or you can stand inside and wait. The plants are beautiful and their coffee is fantastic! Highly recommend.

The decor is beautiful and relaxing... but not quite complete. The newness of it all gives off the smell of freshly cut wood, which blends well with the fragrant foods to give a unique ambiance.

On to the food. It was here for lunch. The portion size was perfect, leaving me full but not feeling overstuffed. More significantly, the kebab and rice were fantastic. 

Great service. Great atmosphere. Great food. Recommended without reservation.

One of the only places in Tucson where you can get Goya products. I'm from the East coast and have missed the food from there. At leasts this carries the ingredients I need to bring some of the East coast over here, like ADOBO!!!!

This facility is MUCH older than what it appears. It is not terrible but sure needs updating. The kitchen is so very small not even large enough for one person. There was only one nightstand. The fan in the bathroom did not work. The light fixtures were from the 70s. The hotel is very difficult to get in out and out of and the traffic is terrible. Not at all what I pictured. I have stayed in MUCH better extended stay facilities and at about the same price and they were much better. Did not feel very safe around the area. I would NOT recommend!!!
I love this place!  The wine, the food, the venue, the staff is all top notch. Always my go to. Love their outdoor seating during the warmer months as well. If you haven't gone yet; do it

Absolutely incredible food.  Food here is so delicious, fairly priced, and on top of that it is non gmo and preservative free.  The owner is extremely kind and sincere--he will give you good suggestions of what to try.  I had pupusas, tamales, and the famous corn fritter balls.  All three exceeded any expectations I could have had.  The salsas are all so tasty and everything is just so authentic.  Do yourself a favor, go eat here immediately or you will regret it.  I had to pinch myself the food is so good.

No free wi-fi unless you purchase something at least that's what I was told from employee when asked named Francesca. Rude employee Francesca with puffy hair and other co-woker working Sunday Evening March 18 are true gossipers! They were gossiping all kinds of stuff about different people and they have the hunger for it,WOW! I also agree with Andrea R's review. This coffee shop doesn't radiate that welcoming environment, at least from my experience I also didn't felt that here.IMO. I won't be back for sure.

This was seriously outstanding. We enjoyed this meal so much - from the server who was so kind, welcoming and engaging - to the food and ambiance. We really loved this meal and it was one of the best we've had in a long time. It was our 18th anniversary and they really went out of their way to make it special for us (we stayed at the adjoining hotel as well, Hotel Californian, which I also give 5 stars!).  The outdoor patio was heated just right and it had such a relaxed summer ambiance with a view of the pier from State Street. The food was outstanding from beginning to end. We had the chickpea fries which I can't stop thinking about. Then the crispy kale salad which was so perfectly done the kale melts in your mouth. I got the branzino (fish) and my husband got the Wagu beef burger. Both were prepared perfectly and delicious. Their dessert and coffee were a perfect way to end the meal. We would definitely recommend this restaurant and can't wait to go back! Check out the Hotel Californian and the other hotels restaurant called Goat Tree. It was excellent too.

Matt and Mike were fantastic!!  I just bought my first home and noticed the air from the vents was cool but not cold which left the upstairs extra hot.  I didn't have a list of contacts to choose from so I looked to Yelp.  I emailed Matt late last night and received a quick response early this morning.  He was able to meet at my house when I got off work later that same day!  He and Mike checked the coolant and added the necessary amount then checked all the temperatures to make sure it was cooling properly.  We went to check out the unit in the basement and I mentioned that the home inspector noticed there was no filter in the unit and put in his report that it should be cleaned.  Matt offered right then to clean it, but said he would check it first just to see if it actually needed cleaning.  The unit was a bear to get into, but they worked so diligently!  Turns out the coils were filthy!!!!  Like huge fistfuls of pet hair filthy!!  They cleaned the coils better than I would have done!  They explained everything every step of the way and never made my nosy questions feel like a bother.  They even double checked the coolant levels after cleaning the coils just to double check the amount.  These guys seem to treat each system as if it were their own.  On top of all of that the price was extremely reasonable!!  So reasonable that I plan on having them fix a few duct issues that they noticed that are affecting the airflow to two of the upstairs bedrooms.  I'm definitely adding Matt Starr to my list of contacts!

Consistently bad service. Scheduled a valet appointment online and received two emails and a text confirming appointment. No one showed up. When I called, they said they weren't aware of the appointment and didn't have any openings for a week. No apology, no accommodation. And I'll probably still get a "rate our service" request from them. The worst.
This is a horrible port of subs. Customer service is horrible and they always served old hard bread! Avoid at all costs and go somewhere else

First and last time here, I felt like my chicken sandwich tasted like the breast came out of a box of banquet chicken, and my fries were cold, my man said he paid 22 dollars for lobster sauce barely any meat noodles barely cooked if u like al dente might wanna try their stuffed lobster, I'm in the industry and understand shit happens but dude this food was not good. Maybe come during a rush not so ur food is fresh NOT when they first open. Also waited a half hour for our food, yal just opened why so longggg but Good happy hour prices for drinks though!

Great selection of food options including saxbys, cosi, Wendy's and jersey mikes. Clean bathrooms. The ticket cashiers could be more friendly. I had missed my train and the cashier wasn't very helpful or friendly.

Service was slow. Took my group about 35min after we sat down to get waters and almost an hour just to get beers. Food was Eh. My buddy and I both tried beer flight samplers. We each tried 4 different beers. When they came they were no longer cold and all the beer tasted close to the same. The 4 of us wished we went somewhere else but we stayed cause it was late and didn't want the hassle of a wait at another place. After we left we agreed going somewhere else even if we had to wait would have been worth it.

Fun place for decent fast food. My only dislike so far is the blandburger. The Italian beef sandwich and the burnt polish top my list of faves here (great fries, too). Don't forget the chocolate cake slice. Yum!
Great drinks.  Great atmosphere. Best bartender to be a part of this establishment is Julie.  Friendly place!

My favorite pizza place in Reno! It's real NYC/NJ style pizza - it's the same kind of setup like they do back east and I love it. I can appreciate the giant cracker-like (CA style) pizza common around here but often I need a real pizza or I get homesick! I've always had great service and they offer lots of options- the salad is very good too. I've tried so many pizza places claiming they have NYC/NJ style pizza but this is the only one who does the sauce/cheese ratio and crust right! Enjoy!

Very unprofessional and lazy staff. Our car and another car of 2 each pulled in 45 minutes before close (yes, COVID hours updated on Google and on Yelp). One of the staff waved his hands and motioned "No" across his neck while another guy came over to the windows shutting the window covers. Other car sent someone in and the staff told him that they were closed. As both cars drove away we saw them clapping inside. Incredibly unprofessional. 

Hire people that aren't lazy and actually do their job. We weren't rolling in 10 minutes before close but 45.  Lost business and won't be coming back to this location again.

I loved the movie so this was a must see for me. I was disappointed that they moved the rocky statue to the bottom. The intersection traffic is god awful and saw about 3 near accidents within a minute of one another. Was crowded with tourists, but with the same reasons you're visiting. Again as a fan I am glad I saw and climbed them, but other than that it is nothing special

Fun way to spend an hour with family or friends. 
We did need help and they gave us some clues, but made it out within the very last minute.
Workers are very personable, and friendly. 
We will go back again.

Worst place to go... 
First time there and my hair was hacked 
By the time I walked I had 5 inches cut off my hair.  One side longer then the other.  So much product put in my hair that my hair looked greasy and dirty.  
Then when trying to have this corrected I have to wait a week.  Really...???

If you a bad hair cut... Go there. 
If you want something styled.. Go anywhere else.

Love this place. The food is awesome, as you'd expect. Cool atmosphere. Love ordering pitchers of margaritas and a bunch of dishes to share. The dessert sampler is awesome. The only negative thing is that it's always crowded, there's almost always a wait, and it's loud. But that's not their fault, everyone likes it and it's a busy neighborhood. Great spot to start a night out.

Thank you Sala Family Dentistry!  I've been working through some dental issues this past year and the entire staff at Sala Family Dentistry has been right by my side.  Thank you for your support, professional talent, and caring staff.  The broad choice of talented doctors provides patients the opportunity to find the doctor who works best for them.  For me...it's Dr. Josh and Dr. Jason.  Thank you both for your support and talent.

Gary Vroegh (owner) and his team at Stuttgart Autohaus are some of the nicest and most honest mechanics in the business. Not only as a shop are they direct and have their customer's best interests in mind, but Gary personally went above and beyond to make sure I wasn't getting taken advantage of by the Fletcher Jones VW dealership service department in Chicago, IL.


To preface this review -- I no longer live in Tucson, AZ otherwise I would have taken my 2001 VW Jetta directly to Stuttgart Autohaus and saved myself a lot of hassle. 

My story...

My Jetta was serviced at Stuttgart Autohaus in October 2013 in preparation for making a cross country drive to Chicago, IL which is where I now live. The car made the drive fine, but upon arrival in the city the check engine light came on. 

Initially I took it to a Bosch Certified auto body shop in the city, and was told that my computer system simply needed software updates, which unfortunately could only be done at the dealership. I then took the car to Fletcher Jones VW in Chicago to have a diagnosis done ($160...yikes) and they failed to fully diagnose the problem. They suggested several things that might be the cause of the issue, and sent me an estimate for $3300 worth of repairs they claimed I needed done.

Gary, having recently seen my car, knew that almost everything on the estimate was unnecessary. Of the items on the estimate, the only repair that warranted being done was replacing a cracked vacuum booster pipe, which Gary believes would solve the check engine light & cylinder misfire problem. 

Gary went above and beyond by:
1. Reading through my entire estimate from VW. 
2. Calling my mother, who still lives in Tucson, to explain the issues directly to her.
3. Looking up the VW direct list price for the part I needed (vacuum pipe) which only costs $116, and advising me that I shouldn't pay more the $300 total with labor.
4. Being so outraged that he called my VW service rep directly to discuss the estimate.
5. Contacting the Bosch auto body shop I had originally gone to, explaining what I needed done, giving them the part number, and telling them they could contact him any time if they needed help with the repair process. 
6. Having my back 100%.

Thank you Gary for your kindness, honesty, and all of your help.

If the lady (mom) is on the grill then everything is fine but everyone else seems to get the order wrong. I only order when she is cooking. She is this place's salvation. If she isn't cooking, I'm not ordering.

I want to love this place . Everything tells me to love it . But the burgers are just ok. The chicken they use for their chicken sandwiches is strange . The chili they use for the chili fries has always tasted burnt or something . Patty melts and shakes have not disappointed yet . Kinda pricey for fast food you can't count on to taste the same everytime . Quality control please

We stopped for a quick bite and we're pleasantly surprised.  The staff was very friendly.  The spicy tuna was excellent and the happy hour prices couldn't be beat. The rolls only come with four pieces, but for $3 I wasn't complaining.  For two people we had a Yuengling,  hot sake, edemame,  chicken gyoza, and spicy tuna roll for $13.91 (happy hour prices). If I lived or worked closer, I'd be here daily. If you don't see something on the moving belt, just ask because the hot dishes are made fresh so they don't get cold.  This is definitely a different kind of sushi restaurant,  but worth trying!
Always a must stop place when we are in SB and on the pier. whether, its to eat or just get a few drinks, the patio is the place to be. The view is awesome and the food and drinks are always amazing!

This place is THE BOMB! The staff was absolutely amazing and the inside was so cute! They had so many items on their menu to choose from! The donuts were absolutely amazing and the pricing in my opinion is very reasonable. This place is definitely better than the old mini donut factory that used to be around! I highly recommend this place to others! Can't wait to go back!

Not as great as people are saying. Food is as good as Dusit Thai but service is lousy. Phone skills and courtesy need some improvement.  When we went to pick up the food they had made it wrong and said we could wait 10 minutes to have it remade. There was no offer to take money off the total like restaurants that care about their customers would do.

The first time I ate here all I got was the mac and cheese and it was so good I gave them a 4.  I just went back and got the chicken sliders on pretzel rolls (amazing) and the Media Dia (mediocre at best).  

Wayfare is way fair.  Ha.  This place isn't all that great but definitely not bad.  Their sandwhiches come with homemade potato chips which arent very good.  Service could be better.  I only had 2 sandwiches; the chicken sliders were a 4.5 out of 5 and the media dia was a low 3 and the chips were a 1.  

Decent beer/drink selection; cocktail wasnt that great (some special martini thing)

Glad I went but I am just going to cross this place off my list as a place to go again.

I am not sure what all the fuss is about. Maybe it's just me, but I was completely unimpressed with my sandwich and roast beef covered fries tonight. The Roast beef was a little dry, and lacked enough flavor for me. I covered the sandwich in horseradish and peppers, but was still bored. I will give credit for the bun though, it soaked up all the juice.
We ordered the zucchini fritti and the St. Louis style pizza. It was delicious! Has a great atmosphere and the service was good.

I cannot say enough how glad I am that I went with SS for my move. The guys were on-time, professional, worked hard, and significantly reduced my stress from moving. They worked with me to understand my moving plan/preferences and provided excellent ideas based on their past work. I will definitely hire them when I move again. 

FYI - they accept credit cards but add a 3% fee to cover the credit card company fee. No such fee for cash/personal check.

This is my new favorite spot in town! Perfect timing for a great change in SB! I have been there a few times now and love it more and more each time. My new favorite is the Hawaiian BBQ combo plate that has katsu, pork, short rib, rice, cabbage and Mac salad. The sauce is great on top of all it!

They have a great drink menu to complement. From nigori sake, draft sake, Belgium draft beers, unique house cocktails and a decent wine list with ambiance to match. 

This is a place I will Definitely visit again with friends and family.

Two stars because we had poor service. Our waiter was slow and made so many mistakes on our order. The sauce was not on the side as requested. He did not clear our dirty plates off the table . He forgot to put in our take-out order, we had to wait an additional 15 minutes to "rush" the take-out that he forgot. The manager was supposedly informed of this "forgetting the order" and never came around to apologize. 
The service was so slow, we were the first ones in the restaurant and left after it was nearly empty. 
Not going back.

Transcraft has and will continue to work on all my vehicles. Very professional, will not sell you something you don't need. But they will insist on doing the job correctly. It is a very busy shop, so be patient.

Firstly I want to say the meals my son and I had were good. Contrary to se reviews the noodles are freshly made the veal Marsala was very good and my son was pleased with the spaghetti and red meat sauce. The atmosphere was pleasant but commercial ( as would be expected a block from city hall). Now the wine list was minimal and did not show respect for good Italian wines. The list of entrees is small and, from my perspective, the chef showed limited imagination on what an Italian restaurant should present. My recommendation; good choice for lunch, and okay for dinner if you like a menu of familiar and traditional Italian meals.
BBQ was very good. Awesome Collard Greens - very fresh. The biscuits they bring as a starter melt in your mouth. Server was polite with fast service.

Had a most pleasant experience at Ulele. The restaurant is conveniently located in bayfront downtown. Luis chucked locally harvested fresh oysters. The food was delicious and the service was second to none. The place was spotless, the staff was most friendly and food was delicious. Best ice cream too.
I plan to return when I'm back in the Tampa area

We finally made it over to Anna's Mexican Grill after reading a decent review in the RG-J a while back and, I'm pleased to announce, we were very very pleasantly surprised.  

I have to say, we looooove good mexican food and we're really not that picky--with that said, if we're going to make the effort to leave the house to go out and spend our hard-earned money dining out, we do not want to be disappointed.

The place was clean and comfortable and pleasant enough.  Easy to get to, practically right off the freeway, off West 4th Street or off McCarran--plenty of parking.

The menu offers lots of options that all sounded so good I had a hard time deciding (and can't wait to go back and try).  Other reviewers have mentioned the gordita in lieu of chips and salsa--not only is it a refreshing and very tasty change from the norm, but I think it keeps you from stuffing yourself with addictive chips before you get your meal AND combined with that sliver of moist absolutely scrumptious slice of cake at the end, gives you a feeling of having had a "complete" meal with all the courses.

Some of the things we noticed:
the food was fresh (the chili relleno was excellent--the pepper was still firm, not mushy)
the service was good, and food was delivered quickly
the salsas (red and green) are excellent--spicy with excellent flavor (how good the salsa is always our gauge to a good mexican restaurant) 
I like that the food comes with mexican queso and creme fraiche-type toppings (not your typical sour cream and jack cheese)
you can tell that the refried beans and rice were fresh and homemade--which turned out to be very complementary and very tasty companions to the meal

Looking forward to going back!

My friend recommended this place but I was hesitant to try because I have never had hummus in my life so I had no idea what to order. But OMG I'm so glad I came here. The food is bomb. I got the tomato and egg duet and the portion was decent, I couldn't finish it. The staff were really friendly and patiently recommended things for me. The space is small but you can get to-go! If I live in Philly, I'll be here every week!

They don't call this place the Shitty Kitty for nothing!  Let me just start off by saying I am from the dirty south, and they know how to do it. Then I come to Santa Barbara where, um, it feels very ethnically homogeneous and you can forget about getting on a dance floor because it is nothing but the tsh-tsh-tsh repetitive house music and my ego tells me I am not allowed to dance to Kylie Minogue remixes in public.  But Wildcat was poppin!  If you want to get down on a dance floor in Santa Barbara, this is it.  They do the poppy jams but then they got jams that will make you bring it from the windooooooow to the wall!!!  This is where you come when you don't an ish and go out to dance rather than pretend you're on some catwalk.  The dance floor is packed and sticky, it is loud and crowded, there is an outdoor area out back which is nice to cool down.  It's all kinds of funky in here and that's what it's all about!

Oh Em Geeeeeee

This was soooooo fun!
My girlfriends and I did the Sprocket Rocket at 9pm this past Saturday and had an amazing time. It was 12 of us and another group of 4 on one bike. 

Remember to bring cans; not glass. They have a cooler they will keep your booze cool in. 

Definitely worth it!

International markets are hidden in plain site throughout our community, quietly serving local residents from various parts of the world including the India, the Mediterranean, Korea, China and other parts of Asia. A year ago I was gifted a goodie bag of Filipino treats and staples, like chicharrones, Tuba (coconut vinegar infused with chilis), Bagoong (toasted shrimp paste), and more by my wonderful Filipino friend. I was told they all came from Melvicky, a Filipino grocer and specialty store. SO when her birthday came around this year and she'd organized a Filipino food feast called a "Boodle Fight" it was my turn to reciprocate and bring her a taste of home! So naturally I headed to Melvicky! 

Here you'll find fresh produce including a SAS Squash (see photo), exotic spices, shelves are lined with snacks, treats and staples from all over the Philipines, and and even Filipino baked goods brought over from a bakery in CA.

Not knowing what to get, I did the intelligent thing and asked. The owner wasn't TOO forthcoming with advice, but eventually she pointed me in all the right directions. For $20, I left with a huge haul of packaged snacks for the party, each of which put a smile on my friends face.

I'll definitely return to Melvicky. They have some really interesting produce for sale, and all of it looked great. I also discovered a new favorite sweet snack called "Pillows" which are like cereal stuffed with Taro!

I'm a little worried about this place. Actually, the worry is new because before two nights ago, I would've given 5 stars. Sorry, guys!

Last year some time, I ate here and the restaurant was pretty gross, but the food was good. We came back a few months ago and it was great! They must've redone the place and the food was still great. There are always huge portions and the biriyani was amazing!

A couple of nights ago, we ordered take out as we often do from here and the chicken in the biriyani, korma, and suka was gross. Chewy and not cooked properly. Also, my portion of plain rice (with the korma) was tiny. The biriyani portion was big, as always. 

There are ready made lassi's right in the refrigerator by the register, which is great, and you get a discount when paying in cash. 

I REALLY hope the nasty chicken was one off, because I love this place!!

There has not been a time we've gone here that our steaks weren't filled with gristle and tough as a piece of wood. Even the server apologized. I don't know why this place hasn't yet closed and been replaced. It's been this way for more than a few years now.

I've come here twice and gotten the caprese sandwich on an everything bagel both times. It's amazing! The mozzarella is sliced thick and the tomatoes always taste fresh (although I'm not sure I would get this sandwich any other time besides summer). What makes it is the goopy balsamic drizzle they add. It's sweet and tangy and the perfect counterbalance to the fresh flavors going on in each bite.

I wish I could rate a 3.5 here, but I digress. I love the Union Jack, don't get me wrong, but it isn't without it's flaws. They basically have the best draft list in the area most of the time and the food is decent with the wings being the best around. It's a neighborhood bar, so the crowd is as such, not to upscale, but not terrible. I've been going there twice a week for a year or so and I still dig it.

However, the beer list does come and go. Some weeks there will be a good six beers on there that I love. Other weeks though, I'm lucky if there is one or two. The real problem is that they sometimes get caught up in similar styles, so it's all IPAs or all stouts. I like them both, but I don't want to drink either all day. The only other problem is that it is cash only and the ATM is crap. I agree with some other reviewers; I would rather pay a little more and be able to use a credit card than depend on that ATM.

Other than that, it's a great place.

I recently had a great interaction with the staff at 21st; they were knowledgeable and provided good customer service. 
On a rainy Saturday in late November, I stopped at this 21st amendment location for a birthday gift of tequila (Teremana). Upon walking in, I was warmly greeted; that's something to be noted on such a cold day! I couldn't help but notice the beautifully decorated tree, standing tall and shining brightly. It made me smile because it was put together so well *(see photo). 

I was guided to the tequila, and given a brief breakdown of their selection. At the checkout, the cashier complimented my choice (Blanco), and then mentioned the distinct differences between 3 of the most popular types of tequila: blanco, reposado, and añejo.  Nice!
Awesome, quick service. Had several repairs. They were completed quickly and expertly AND reasonably!

This is THE BEST car wash in the area, hands down. They go out of their way and pay attention to detail when they could just "give you what you paid for." They open up your hood, to blow out all the accumulated dirt and leaves...same with the trunk. The gentleman asked me to hold off putting things in the trunk, so He could vacuum it out first. I have them shampoo my seats and carpet once a year..they still look brand new. The Works wash takes about 20-25 minutes for a reason...they vacuum and wash n dry everything.

They don't need this review. Everyone must know how delicious their treats are. But in case someone needs guidance: get the white chocolate peanut butter cookie sandwich bites. Every bit as good as the name is long. And a cappuccino. They have the best espresso/coffee in town.

First time eating here as we usually go to Vietnam Cafe in Telford for Vietnamese food. We had the Pho (beef), shrimp with broken rice and summer rolls. It was all great and so was the waitstaff. It was a smokey inside from the cooking, but its still a better dining experience the the place in Telford.

Our new go-to Vietnamese restaurant!
First time eating Hot Chicken.  Got a real education.  Be careful on that spice!  Mild was too weak, Nashville Hot was too strong.  Will go medium next time.  Don't miss the pimento cheese spread

Loved the appetizers! ( fried squid, chashu pork, rayaki fries, cubed streak , scallop ) The Ramen was ok, we have had better ramen. But the place is very nice from the inside as well, friendly staff. Will definitely come back, but maybe we will just order tons of appetizers and skip the Ramen.
The stylists at DarinJonStudio are so talented and professional it's refreshing to watch them in action. The salon itself is really clean and friendly.  Darin Jon has a fabulous team.
Been going to this salon for almost a year to see Natasha and haven't had a bad experience yet! Everyone is super friendly and talented I recommend all my friends and family!

An owner that has passion for what he does and is proud of his business. It shows in the way he runs things. It's sad that people leave reviews that have nothing to do with recommending a place for its value, or understanding our humanity. Any little thing that didn't go your way, and you run to Yelp to bash someone? WTH? I've found this place to be helpful and honest with its dealings.

If you are looking for a car dealership that is going to give you attitude, not call back, and essentially tell you that your business is not worth their time- you found it. By far the rudest group of people I have ever spoken too. How dare you tell someone that has purchased 3 cars from you that they are being harsh? Unfortunately you have to be in order to get some sort of response. On top of that- they bash the dealership next door (which is also under the Piazza name) saying that they only sold 1 car when Hyundai sold 12. There are plenty of other dealerships in the area that I am sure would be more than happy to discuss what options are available.
Chicken tikka masala is horrible here !! they add sugar to it and it doesn't taste authentic but the somasas are really good i always come back for samosa

I love this place. Every time I walk into the store I'm greeted kindly and usually have a pretty good conversation with whoever is working. They usually have my size, but if they don't they will go the distance and make sure they get it in and get it to me. Being on the other side of town, I really appreciate the website too.
I arrived at quest went to the kiosk. It said seven minutes. Waiting over a fucking hour.
We LOVE KCK! Our daughter has been there since birth. Everyone knows her and she is so happy to go everyday! It is a great place to leave our daughter everyday. I can not recommend them enough!

A hidden gem! The food is so good! The street fries are amazing! And it's SO MUCH FOOOD!
The flavors are all there, nothing lacked. Cool view too.

Masks are a must. If you don't have one, they will give you one. There was a line to get in and it was raining, they had pop up covering for the part of the line that wasn't under the overhang of the building. It was still a little nerve wracking since it was thundering and lightning. Several hand sanitizer stations. And Ikea naturally has one way paths throughout the store. The cafeteria was closed and blocked off with curtains. Server items in the snack area of the exit were not available... gummy candies, ice cream and drinks. Of course their infamous cinnamon rolls were available at checkout!

I did score a $49.99 office chair (finally!) And the rainbow Pride shopping bags... So it was a great trip!

I absolutely love this place! Denise is the best server in town! I love coming here for breakfast. They get to know you and treat you like family. Lady Di is almost always here too and is pretty awesome herself. If you like spending your money locally instead of at a chain, definitely come here!!  

Oh and now, the place is no smoking establishment so I can enjoy my breakfast without the smoke! And it's been painted and is homier than ever!
I was in the mood for fresh sushi to go and stumbled on The Spot.  Family owned, and is AMAZING!!! I'll definitely be back.

PRMG has streamlined the mortgage process as much as possible. And while it doesn't necessarily make the process easy, it did help a lot. All staff at PRMG are friendly and available practically any time you need them.

Live music, outstanding food, right in the heart of music city.  Cast iron wings and brick oven pizzas, nice selection of local beer and mason jar cocktails.  I can't wait to come again the next time we are in Nashville.
Good value for sushi and korean food. Great for valrico.
Very unique setting and very new Orleans. The bar really rotates. Sazerac traditional drink was made well.

Pretty good service for a small store. Much better than trekking to the UPS store in Old City. The employees there are highly responsive and cost efficient. They aren't there to gouge you. Considering they are one of the few places that handle shipping in that neck of Philly, it is one of the better ones.
I've had a lot of donuts but these were the best!!!! I was recommended the caramel cinnamon and it was out of this world good!!!! The store was impeccably clean and the server was so friendly.
Date night ran about $90, but everything was great so maybe it was worth it. Salmon was spot on, wife had flat iron pork that was very tender. Cocktails were quite strong.

To transfer data from a broken computer cost $60 for a 'diagnostic" - I was given no estimate on fixing the computer but only told the data could be removed. So, if it was not able to be removed you're out the $60. Then, if the data can be removed it is $90 more ($150 total) to put the data on your thumb drive ($30 if they provide, $7 at Best Buy next door) for between 10GB and 100GB.  Ours was 24GB and $150 total to put on our thumb drive. They don't just say this up front, you start with the diagnostic fee and it goes up from there. Maybe this is a competitive price but I'd shop around and personally won't be back and would have been a lot happier if they had been upfront with the costs at the beginning.  

One star, service was completed. Second star because they were accommodating when we mistakenly brought in the wrong computer for repair at first, didn't charge a second diagnostic fee, of course that computer didn't need diagnosing since I knew the screen was broken and data could easily and freely be transferred by attaching it to a monitor but they charged $60 anyway. I was called and told the diagnostic was done before I reached home after leaving the store, at most 20 minutes.

Their oyster pasta has such a well-seasoned sauce, my friend was stealing my sauce during the whole meal. Also our fine nice waitress Cindy showed us truly adorable hospitality. I wish I was hungrier last night.

If your coming to the Tampa Bay Area, you MUST get a Cuban Sandwich! Some of best Cubans you will find are in weird places like in a roadside shack or a dusty gas station. However, that's no place to enjoy your lunch. If your looking for a comfortable place to enjoy a Cuban, come to the Floridian. It's not the prettiest place in the world, but it's authentic and only minutes from the beach on Treasure Island. Even a Pirate would agree these Cubans are more than Arrrrgggg-right, they are delicious!!! 

Probably the most authentic Tampa Bay lunch you can get on Treasure Island! The only reason I cannot give it 4 stars is that they could load up the sandwiches with a little more meat! Nevertheless, one Cuban will fill up your plunder bag, um I mean stomach!!! You gotta try this place!

This is a pretty typical Starbucks shop located on the strip along with other stores and a shopping mall. The interior is pleasant and well-designed with high ceilings and sports the regular Starbucks motif. The staff were pleasant and attentive during my visit, the store was clean, and it was a good environment. I hung out there and worked on my laptop for a while and the wifi signal was decent and didn't drop out. All, in all, this store upholds what you expect to find and experience in any Starbucks store.

Oh, and the white chocolate mocha was delicious. They always are.....
The staff, food, atmosphere was great. Good quality of food, great taste, and genuine friendliness from all the associates. I also appreciated the "thank you" out loud for my donation.

To the owner/son of owner. Food is always pretty good. Shrimp scampi however is always cold. 
To the server Amanda if you want good tips you have to be kind and smile. A dry personality is not going to get you good tips, you can see a smile and feel the smile behind the mask. If you hate your job that much, do the customers a favor and quit. 
To the owner your server came after us in the parking lot....for what were you going to kick out A$$. 
That is my tip for you!! Cheers

We went here on a whim, because we needed to go to Target nearby and we were in the mood for Italian. On a Monday night (this was New Years Day), they were surprisingly busy. We were told the wait would be 10 minutes. Not too long of a wait; I figured I could distract my toddler for 10 minutes until we got seated and the bread basket was put in front of him.

The wait seemed a lot longer than 10 minutes. I wish I took note of the actual wait length.

I was also surprised to see that about 1/3 of the tables were empty despite the wait time.

We were seated and we ordered an appetizer and my son's meal right away. After we got our appetizer (buratta mozzarella with tomatoes, basil and onions) and our salads, we ordered our dinners (both pasta/seafood dishes). We dug into the bread basket and immediately asked for more, because my son likes to eat carbs by the fistful, and frankly I'll do just about anything to keep him happy towards the end of his day while we're trying to dine out.

Welp, things were ok until then. It took quite a long time to get our second bread basket. My son started flipping out so I took him out of the restaurant so we didn't disturb other patrons. (I realize this has nothing to do with the actual restaurant but it's still relevant.)

Right before I took my screaming son out, I told my boyfriend to ask the waitress to pack up our food to go so we could get out of there ASAP. Well, maybe a half an hour later we got our food and our check so we could leave. They kindly threw in extra salads.

We got home and I was so excited to dig into the real dinner (after putting the monster to bed). Dinner was good, but by no means was it great. I got the seafood alfredo, and my boyfriend got shrimp/scallop a la vodka. Neither of our dishes had enough sauce; both sauces seemed runny and just pooled at the bottom of our takeout containers.

Between the meh pasta dishes, the fact that my son's kid's ravioli had 5 ravioli in it (for $7, I believe...), and the incredibly slow service, we will not be going back.

The call center help desk was very helpful. The repair technician was knowledgeable and responsive to our questions. Phone Their billing process and methodology was upfront and very reasonable.

My one concern was with scheduling the follow up visit. Technician said they would call to schedule the following day, however no one called. We called and the appointment was set without our input for a day later than stated by the technician. The phone rep updated the appointment but it was still concerning that no one called.

The tech came by and he quickly did what he said he would. Everything is working. He did leave his card and told us he would come by again if the issue came up again. 

I was very satisfied with our experience and the tech. Pricing was reasonable and I will be recommending this business to anyone who needs an appliance repaired.
Love this place! When I saw they were coming to St Louis I was so excited since I had been to the Lake of the ozarks location and loved it. Awesome beers, great pizza....and the pizookie....

Patrick is fantastic! I've had him several times as a server and he's always attentive and wonderful, but above all other things he's kind. He's truly an asset to the Olly's team. The food is great. I can't recommend another 24 hour place more.

I've been here several times with friends and family, it never disappoints! We have tried most of the dinner entrees and they are all spectacular. We usually start off with either the baked Brie or the eggplant lasagna, and my favorite entrees will have to be the salmon and the swordfish. The restaurant itself is very intimate and I love how you can see the cooks making your food. Most recently, we tried their brunch and it was perfect! Definitely try the Moroccan eggs! Best of all, it's byob so bring your bottle of wine for dinner, or your champagne for brunch!

You can't beat this place. The best barbecue spot around. Bring your wallet it won't be cheap, because you can't come here and order just one thing. The food is all well grilled and you get a vast selection of sauces to put on your meats. The baked beans are the best. I love to get the two meat combo so I can taste more than one thing in the same sitting. Go here in a group and if you put some time in with a woman you can bring her, so you can pig out together. Go here
GREAT neighborhood restaurant! Hummus was creamy & garlicy! I had the fava bean plate, rice, green beans & the falafel. All great along with the friendly staff.

Good selection compared to the mall locations, but the staff are useless. I was there helping my boyfriend pick out dress clothes and wound up helping two teenage boys as well because they couldn't get assistance from anyone. Especially for men's jackets and suit trousers, it's helpful to have people working who know what they're talking about, or at least care somewhat about the product. You can't expect a guy to drop $150+ on clothes if they don't know how to make them fit and look good.

Mushroom soup, with your side of buttery herbed crostini, will you marry me?? Seriously, this stuff brings me so much joy I nearly float out the door. (Doesn't that doesn't sound like love to you?) Additionally, the iced tea (it's just tea, right?! Um NO!) It is really clean and bright and homey tasting! Trust me, it's the tea of grandma's kitchen! The only downfall, and it's kinda a big one, the service. I'm not sure I've had a warm or friendly server or wait staff yet. And I'm pretty much a frequent flyer! Even take out can be a drag- I just feel like Ugh, why are you so cranky? Ok, no more negative Nancy cuz I want to add the decorating in the back room is really cute and cozy!

This cafeteria style cafe has some delicious food!  This review is based on food, service, cleanliness, atmosphere, and value.

I've been here a few times now.  Their Medianoche is loaded down and very delicious!  During lunch, the line is out the door, so get there early, grab a tray, and proceed through the line.  There is a wonderful assortment of prepared items, or ordering off the menu is another option. 

The parking lot gets crammed at lunch.  It's mostly gravel, loaded with potholes, and the only real downer I've encountered so far (which isn't a big deal).  The line can get long, but they move customers through very efficiently.  They have a good team of employees working fast, taking orders, and making food.  The service has always been fast and friendly in my experience.

There's lots of seating, but during the lunch rush it can fill up.  The noise level is on the high side, just because it's so busy, but not so loud you can't have a conversation.  The place is kept fairly clean, considering the age and condition of the building.  They do good about keeping tables cleared, despite the high pace.  The atmosphere is about as casual as it gets.  It's comfortable, and has a nice flow to it. 

For the quality, flavor, and portion of food, I can't complain about the value.  The menu is priced for repeat business, in my opinion. 

Overall, it's great food, quick & friendly service, and it doesn't break the bank.  I'm a big fan!

You know how some people live and die by burgers and fries? Well, I'm not one of those people but this place has been on my radar and I finally had the opportunity to hit them up last weekend. I don't just give out 5 star reviews all willy nilly, I have to be blown away and Engine No9 did exactly that! This was the best burger I have ever eaten. It was monster in size but had a bun that could handle it. The requested cook temp was perfect and makes me wonder why more places are unwilling to serve rare burgers? 

We had three burgers in total, the Alice in Pain, The Fat Duck and a traditional dressed out cheeseburger for the meat purist. All were excellent and paired so well with those Fat Tires on draft. None of us could finish and we all took home half and finished it for dinner. The fries were no joke either, fresh and hand cut. Perfectly seasoned and served hot.

Service was great as well, we never wanted for anything. There was a tall ginger that was either the owner or a manager who had his eyes on the entire restaurant. If he's only a manager, give that guy a raise, he's on point. 

Small and locally owned makes the deal that much sweeter. I will be a frequent guest

Sister-in-law broke her iPhone while in the US. The repair was reasonably priced and the service was quick and professional. I highly recommend this store if you need any repairs. Be sure to bring your Axxess card!

After running all over looking for a BBQ place with parking without having to walk 3 miles we finally found the place. We Wanted BB King, but no parking even close, and everyone else was kinda meh or not some serious BBQ. We also wanted some Mac and cheese. This place delivered, wow oh wow. You order from a window inside and than take the number to your table, fairly simple. Ribs were amazing! Juicy, soft, not very fatty either, I'd say 80-98% meat,the whole time as I ate through the ribs. Then we had the Mac and cheese. God bless this restaurant, if you don't like creamy, cheesy, bacon topped Mac and cheese you'll hate their cheese. If you like all that, you'd be very pleased. I leave you with with this, if you're looking for; excellent BBQ, with close parking, good people, and slamming Mac and cheese this is your place.
This is a hidden gem, the food is amazing!!! Don't be fooled by the shack, Mike and his gang can whip up some fantastic seafood.

Love this sushi place. It is a find as it's located in a nondescript shopping center that hosts a DMV. But the small restaurant hosts some very good sushi at reasonable prices. They also have wonderfully decadent desserts.

Well yes just ok...its the same thing when it comes to these restaurants, they all look the same and the food tastes the same. Sure its good for a date or something but Im not saying Hey lets go to moxies tonight when people ask where we should go. Not my first choice but not my last.
Love this place for some simple, fairly quick food! The service is normally great, although I've had a couple of "off" experiences.

Waited in long line at drive thru only to get up there and find out the card machine was down.  How about a sign. How about letting u know before you order. Terrible customer service.  Last time I visit this McDonald's
Just had the best breakfast buffet!  Even had the most amazing cheese grits...that's right grits in the north!! Going back to try lunch or dinner very soon!

By far the best car wash in town. I've been coming here for a year-and-a-half and for the first time someone asked me how to move my wheelchair ramp so they could clean the back of my Kia Sportage. They have to hand wash my car and it came out spotless inside and out.
Twice now I've ordered from Uber eats. Twice you've gotten the order wrong. I love your food but you need someone checking your orders more accurately
Great waffles. We tried the Bob's Deluxe and the Waffle Me Up Strawberry. Our kids loved it too.

I have visited the brewery on several occasions and have always had a good experience. The food is really good and it's always fun to drink local beer. We look forward to going here when we visit downtown.

I had the best experience today at Dr Obeime's office. I called to make an appointment, and I was able to get in within a couple of days as a new patient after I expressed my concerns with the scheduler. Upon arrival I was greeted warmly . I had to fill out paperwork, and as soon as I was finished I was promptly taken back for my appointment. Dr. Obeime was great! He was so kind and knowledgeable. He addressed all of my questions and concerns. He was even able to do a small procedure the same day. I didn't have to come back for a second visit. I left the appointment feeling great! I would highly recommend Dr Obeime and his staff. My overall experience today was great.

Holy crap, we had an awesome time here. We did the $35 customized lunch and got a lot of special attention. The chef (Yun) was from Puerto Rico but had spent time in NC and we talked some about that. The sushi started out terrific and just got more creative and tasty from there. The flavor combinations were not only creative, but sensibly ordered so that they complemented eachother, culminating in what felt like a gourmet meal from appetizer to dessert. The slightly odd feeling of sitting at a campus dining hall take away counter at Penn State quickly diminished as we realized we were getting the best seats and the best deal in the house. We might as well have been out for a nice dinner.

This is a must stop place for a great BBQ at an even better price.  Words cannot describe the flavor you experience with every bite.  My favorite is the brisket with a side of sweet potato fries and potato salad.  As an avid  BBQ taster of the stl and neighboring Illinois area this place has no competition.  If ur in town for a few hours or days, check this place out!! Just look for the line of people outside entrance doors.  

*for military, they give a more than generous discount!

I've been here a buncha times on my way to/from the train station. Great place. Good casual vibe. Service is always quick which is important when catching a train! Love the burger and fish and chips. I'll be back!

I wanted to love Penca. The design is thoughtful, modern and inviting. Service could not be warmer (if occasionally confused). The chips and salsa are first-rate and there are some inventive drinks. If only we had stopped with just chips and drinks. The appetizers and entrees are, at best, ordinary. Better queso fundido can be found almost anywhere in Tucson. The meat in the tacos was flavorless - I could hardly tell the carne asada from the carnitas. On a Wednesday night the restaurant ran out of sausage for the queso fundido, and turkey and swordfish for the tacos. I would happily visit again for drinks but the food was disappointing.

After years of hauling my kids to Skate Country across the street, I finally had a reason to stop in here.  I was there for only 1 reason: to buy Mexican-style pots, so I didn't look at their plant selection (it seemed pretty huge, just glancing around).  After looking at 5 other places (2 other nurseries, 2 big boxes, 1 Mexican theme place), this was the place for me.  I ended up getting 6 medium/small Mexican-style pots and 6 plastic water trays for about $90.

Staff was nice and helpful -- I interacted with 3 of them during my search and purchase.

We were in Clearwater for vacation and the concept of a coal oven pizza intrigued me. We were not disappointed. The pizza was great and the homemade gelato is making somebody's grandma proud!  I would highly recommend dinner and dessert. It seems like a spot for locals and I would easily become a regular if we lived here. The service was great as well!
The WORSE nails Iv ever had in my life. I'm extremely disgusted and disappointed. This woman should be fired

DON'T buy Cadillac! My Escalade only has 60k miles & I consistently have it serviced, but somehow it stopped working. Apparently the engine might have to be replaced. For a luxury vehicle & over $100k price tag, one would expect it to last longer. That aside, my husband took it to get repaired at Reno Buick GMC Cadillac about a month ago, & it's still not ready. They did not lend us a car since we didn't purchase our car there. Even then we were patient & understanding about their policy. However, it's been a total nightmare to get updates on the status of our car. People either aren't working or not returning our questions. Nobody seems to know what's going on or not taking responsibility. As I was getting ready to go pick up my car today my husband got a call that it's not ready. Super frustrating since yesterday they assured us it would be ready today. I will NEVER buy a Cadillac again. Honestly I can't wait to get it back so I can sell it. Awful service! Unprofessional employees & clearly poor training on behalf of Cadillac & GMC. Stay away & share with others. I wouldn't even give them one star! Ugh! Wish us luck!

I went on the dolphin sightseeing cruise with beach excursion with my mom, sister and 2 nephews on Sunday afternoon, and we had so much fun!! Everyone from the woman selling tickets to the captain was friendly and efficient. The boat was clean. My nephews, aged 8 and 11 both loved it. I would definitely recommend this!

This is by far the worst McDonald's around. They got a bunch of idiots working there that really don't care about anything. Service is a joke they tend to run out of drinks so how even first thing in the morning. Someone much of been wearing to much oils cause that's all I smelled on my food. The place is a joke n so are the employees owners n mangers. It really should be knocked down for a parking lot.

The staff was very polite they were attentive, the young lady who made my southwest chicken salad was very clean she changed her gloves everytime she did something, i asked for greener leaves and she did it with no problem My Salad was so good, she said if i wanted my bread toasted ,that the gentleman would do it for me and he did, my mulitigrain  bread was delcious. Fives Stars to you guys for Top Notch Service. Thank You. And that was my first time ever in Au Bon pain. Smiley Face :).

Terrible customer service! Manager has no experience handling good customer care. Inappropriate conduct and disrespectful staff members. 
SO GLAD SPROUTS FARMERS MARKET RECENTLY OPENED A STORE HERE IN SB. Great atmosphere, outstanding customer service! *****HIGH QUALITY AND VARIETY OF FOOD! Extensive section of NUTRITIONAL SUPPLEMENTS (found so much more than any other market)
EVERYTHING is a lot less expensive!

This is a shockingly good setup for a music venue. I was a little skeptical, but purchased general admission tickets for The Cult/Bush/Stone Temple Pilots. The stairs leading to the Superdome are PERFECT for those of us who just want to hang back and enjoy the music.
Drink options are plentiful, both outside at several booths and inside the Opening Act bar. Sound quality is great. I wouldn't hesitate to attend another concert here.

Dope new Taiwanese bakery + coffeeshop here in St. Louis (best city)! I honestly like this place better than most places I've been to in LA and SF. The crispy orange bun was sooo yummy! The barista came over and gave us free samples of their oolong tea w/ honey boba which hit the spot. I'll definitely be back to try out their breads (like black walnut sourdough and chocolate cherry) and fruit teas (they have an avocado milk tea whaaaat)

Came in as a walk-in to get my first ever tattoo with Chris Boyle.  The receptionist was very kind as was Chris!  Chris talked through the process with me, made sure I was well informed, even sketched out a design for me after talking through it with me that was much better than what I brought in.  He took the time to make sure I was happy and didn't try to rush the process at all which was very nice.  He also has done some amazing work on others and did a great job on my tattoo as well.  Chris made me feel welcome with his friendly attitude, and I will definitely be coming back to him for my next tattoo!  10/10 would recommend to a friend.

I really do like this Starbucks, and it's conveniently located close to home, but.. it is very busy and that can lead to mishaps with coffee orders and some spillage with unfastened lids.  Check your order and ensure that the lid is fastened when you pickup!

This is a very comfy cinema grill; the seats are ergonomically sound, (I could fall asleep in those seats). I like the way the theatre is organized, you can see well from anywhere. Yet, it must be said that the other patrons greatly contribute to the movie going experience and sadly most people just don't care how you feel. However, the staff is nice and don't rush you to select your seats :)
Oh, and the food is good and they have a nice beer & wine selection too! 

to movie goers...
[what you won't do is get out your cell phone during the movie, for an extended period of time, with the led light bright af. It's rude, you're rude, get out].

Great variety on the menu for family friendly "sports bar" dining. Service was great and fast. Everyone 's food was good too. No complaints if you're looking for a casual, quick, tasty dinner with a good selection for the whole family.

Certainly the best Mexican food in West Philly, and pretty decent given the options elsewhere in the city, too. Having lived in California for ten years, I can honestly say this is a decent place to get a burrito, even given those high standards. Have eaten both in house and got delivery through GrubHub-- they delivered during an epic downpour, of which my rumbling stomach is ever grateful. Thanks, Don Barriga!

I came here Saturday for the first time after seeing this place recommended continuously on Facebook. My appointment was with Emily and she was very nice and professional right from the start. I'm used to just getting my brows waxed at whatever nail salon i go to so this was definitely a treat. She was extremely knowledgable and took her time to shape my brows perfectly. She asked questions about my usual routine and made suggestions as well. I honestly think this was the least painful wax i've ever had as well. At the end she showed me what she did and told me not to touch my brows between now and going back there or somewhere else to help my "lazy brow" grow in better like my "good brow" lol. I will definitely be making my next appointment at The Brow Bar and won't be trusting anyone else anytime soon.

My favorite muffin is one of my favorite little places in all of Reno. So much so that I usually will pick up an order to go on my way to work on the weekends.  I know how busy it can be which is why I always call 30 minutes ahead to place my order so Im not late for work. I would absolutely give this establishment 5 stars, however, this is a process that needs to be smoothed out. The last few times I have done this, instead of being able to go in and pick up my order quickly, I've had to wait in the ginormous line. This ultimately causes me to be late and my breakfast is not hot anymore. It makes me sad to know they have no solution to this and that I can no longer have this as a part of my routine.
Mexican food is one of my favorites and friends introduced us to this place and I had the best burrito I have ever had. Loved it!

We had a great half day fishing trip. The crew knows how to make sure everyone has a good time, and is amazingly attentive to people who need help seemingly all at the same time. I hadn't fished but maybe twice in my life, and that was many, many years ago. I also wasn't super enthusiastic about fishing, but my daughter really wanted to try it out. I ended up enjoying the trip so much, it will be on our list of activities every visit to the area now. We have minimal recent fishing experience, and caught six fish we could keep. They clean the fish for you, and if you are staying in a hotel without a kitchen, they will tell you which local restaurants can cook it for you. It was perfect to end our visit to Pass A Grille eating fish we had caught that morning.
These pralines are delicious! Many flavors to choose from and they always give you a sample if you are unsure which kind you want to purchase.

I have been here a few amount of times an they always have exactly what I want!

They have so many movies its insane! They have new and used ones for a pretty good price.  Some of their newer times price wise are similar to what you way pay somewhere else but on the flip side you can see if you can find a used one at half the cost.  

I have frequently buy used and have never gotten a bad one.

The chicken with broccoli was on par with just about every place in NYC I have been to. The chicken fried rice was a little bland - could use some a kick to it at the very least - but still tasty. The fried dumplings and crab rangoons were also excellent.

This is truly as good as it gets in Nashville. Not a gourmet restaurant by any means, rather this is the perfect Chinese takeout restaurant. I don't know why there is such a dearth of Chinese restaurants in this town but China Panda definitely hits the spot. I will definitely be back.

My review is a little different because we don't go there as a bar, we go there for the restaurant!  We have eaten there twice, the first time, we all ordered pizzas (one price for one topping or all toppings) and toasted ravioli for my son.  The pizzas were hot and the toppings were plentiful.  The toasted ravioli (cheese) was maybe the best I've ever had.  Service tends to be a bit slow in terms of drink refills.  Last week I was there for the quarter auction (entirely too many people packed in the big room), but didn't end up going in -- we ate dinner on the patio (fabulous chicken ceaser salad), but because we patronized the restaurant, we weren't able to get a seat for the auction.  I will say that the oversized, industrial fans were nice on the patio, but there was absolutely no a/c or air circulation in the auction room.  

We will defintely go back!

Been here twice in the last two days. Food and service is always excellent. Waiters and waitresses are always attentive, without being overbearing. Live music this morning was a nice addition. Will definitely be back, probably in a few hours.

I've had three great experiences at the Gerst Haus.  The food is great, get the sampler, there are way too many good options to just settle for one.  Lunch was pretty quiet and the place was a bit empty but Saturday night was busy with a great oompah band playing up front.  Good times overall and I'll be heading there this weekend with a  friend from out of town.
Very disappointed that you would close the business and not let people with existing appointments know!!

Great service, food was really good. Interesting fusion of Cajun/Mexican in their huevos rancheros breakfast. 
Coffee was very good as well. Highly recommend!

I tried the beer sampler, frankly I'm not a beer person and this didn't change it . . . I liked the uniqueness of the beer flavors, like espresso. Their portions were huge! I swear the appetizer nachos were for at least 3 people and their blue cheese burger was great!

Wow! Forget the Shake Shake hype. This is the real deal. Even the turkey burgers taste decadent. The fries are wicked good, particularly with the old bay mayo. And shakes are thick and Delilah. Check out toasted marshmallow; it actually has that charred BBQ taste

This is such a cool and fun spot for some unique yet snarky gifts. I don't want to compare it to anyone because I think they probably get more love. They both have items the other don't so you should definitely take a look. I bought a couple of gifts for myself on this round but saw a few things I'd get friends. Perfect gift spot plus place to bring out of town guests for their gift shopping.

So I've had Prince's, Bolton's and now Hattie B's. Before Hattie B's, I did not like hot chicken. I honestly thought it tasted like fried chicken with Ramen packet seasoning mixed in. But wow Hattie B's changed my perspective of that within the first few bites. I got the small dark plate plus a tender. I wasn't sure what spicy level I would like, considering I thought the hot levels at Prince's and Bolton's were spicy to the point of no enjoyment/taste- but to keep consistency I went with the hot option at Hattie B's. For the extra tender piece, though, I got a medium spicy level to mix it up.

Had to get a beer with my fried chicken as well, and a light Nashville pilsner went down real smoothly with this deliciousness. I licked my mac and cheese side clean, but had a bite of cole slaw to spare. I would've liked to try the fries and the hot chicken sandwich, but one only has so much room in their stomach. But since there's always room for dessert (scientifically proved), I had some peach cobbler and ice cream to be a real Nashville local. I did not regret a thing. 

The service was great and quick- counter service then table service if you need it. Food is brought to your number, and all the fixins are there for your convenience. The ambiance is casual and homey, it was an awesome meal to the end. Starting to salivate...

This place is definitely a good look if you're on South Street, hungry, and not really looking to pay outrageous prices for food. They have a take-out side and an eat-in side to the restaurant. I've done both, and either way, you can't really go wrong here. Looking for a gyro or other pita-wrapped specialty to go? They'll fix you up real nice. Want to sit down and try some lesser known Greek cuisine? They'll do you right there as well.

I recommend everything on the menu, really. Not sure if anyone else has mentioned it, but their mussels appetizer is surprisingly good. Not sure what made me order mussels in a Greek place or why they're so delectable, but yeah. Get them. Also, not sure if this is a BYO or not, but if you ask them they'll give you a beer.

Stopped by last week to try out mattresses and spent nearly an hour with Shawn, who really knew his stuff and never tried to "hard sell" us into buying something. So refreshing! After looking at one other mattress store, we came back and purchased from Mattress Land. They went out of their way to make sure we were happy with our purchase, and we were especially impressed with their customer service! Thanks Shawn!

Once inside I was like, "This place is so cool, I don't feel like I'm even in Tampa!" It had a very Instagram friendly, hipster, reclaimed industrial space aesthetic. There was a book store and Warby Parker pop-up in front, a coffee bar, a tea bar, and a restaurant. There was also an Anthropologie-esque retail area with candles, fun trinkets, pretty coffee table books and more. We had brunch in the restaurant which was very buzzy and had a great atmosphere. A lot of the reviews say it's "classy" but attire at brunch runs the gamut- were dressed in yoga pants and there were other people dressed casually as well as women in dresses. As for the food, everyone in my group enjoyed their brunch entrees and cocktails.  I wish the service had been a little more efficient, it took awhile to get the check and drink refills. Definitely make a reservation!!

I have now lived here over a year. You can see that my rating has gone down. The neighborhood is still gorgeous.  It is kept up for the most part.  However the dog park has a few ongoing issues.  There are divots/holes that can easily injure your ankle. They filled in one but not the others.  The gate door has been broken for MONTHS and can barely be opened and closed. Regatta needs to create a TAG system for their resident dogs.  They need to provide a colored tag that residents must put on their dogs collar so that we other residents know if it is an approved dog or not.  I know for a fact that people come from other neighborhoods and the trail to use our dog park. They say they don't allow pit bulls yet I see residents with pit bulls every day. 

The outdoor light on the side of my building has been broken since April and it can be PITCH black at night without it. It is September.

The staff is for the most part awful.  I'm convinced this location must be a training facility.  You will never speak to an office associate more than once.  There is constant turnover. They don't know anything and can help with nothing. I have lived here over a year and still don't know how to buzz my guests in because no one in the office has ever been able to show me how. 

The bugs and spiders are such an issue. I feel like I live in a jungle. I do not understand where they all get in.

The trash situation is WRETCHED! You get used to bringing the trash down to the ONE location of dumpsters, but good luck finding a recylcing bin that isn't over flowing! They need to pay for an additional pick up each week.  You have to wear sneakers because the overflowing recylcing bins lead to tons of broken glass. 

We still do not experience any noise from the neighbors which is wonderful.

The environment is great with great friendly staff. The boba was little too sweet and mushy for me. It made the Milk Tea really sweet. Overall, not bad just need a little quality control to make it great.

Matthew McConaughey's Voice: Alright alright alright, let's talk about the best Chinese food in New Orleans. This isn't the middle of the mall food court stuff, this is the real deal Holyfield of Chinese cuisine. Authentic as can be, they make a delicious soup dumpling, amazing noodle dishes, and a special Chinese crepe. So this is where it's at & this is what we recommend and usually get: Crabmeat/Crawfish Soup Dumplings, XiaoLongBao, Spicy Chilled Noodles, & Spicy Wontons... don't forget your veggies, can't go wrong with any of them!!

@phidingthefam

I was at Nodding Head on Saturday for a friend's bday celebration. We got there at dinner and had a group of 12. The place is pretty large so they had room for us immediately. Service was good.
