The waiter made great beer recommendations. The beer list was not extensive but I did really enjoy one of their beers which was some sort of wheat beer. People seem to either love or hate the beer here. I like most light or wheat beers so I was satisfied.

I love the feel of this bar- the wood benches, dart board, bobble heads and scale. Well I don't really get the scale because weighing myself kind of kills the mood for scarfing down bar food and beer but it was fun to watch the boys play on the scale while being drunk.

The food is the best part of this place. I had the monks vegan burger and it was the best vegan or vegetarian burger I have ever had. I also hear the monks mussels are great and can't wait to go back again and try them.

They treat you like family at Villa Vito! Hands down, the best authentic Italian food in the area! From the bread with dipping oil, all the way to the desserts, there is no other Italian dining to match! They also provide excellent service!

My husband and I stayed here for our baby moon in January. Our room was small but very clean and nice. We didn't have any noise issue during our stay, maybe it's because we booked early and required for a quieter room? (our room was at the end of the building, far away from the street and elevator) 

There is really nothing we can complain about here. It's in great location, the room is clean and functioning well, front desk staffs are very friendly and helpful, and the off season price was great. We had great time there during our stay.

Btw, they allow guests to check-in luggage early or check-out luggage late. (bags will be stored in a gated space) We didn't stay in other hotels in French Quarter so I'm not sure if this is common for hotels there to provide this extra service. But it's really a nice touch, we spent one more afternoon around without dragging our bags everywhere!

Katherine is the BEST!!!
I got laser hair removal on my legs, she takes her time to get every single hair she can see and I am on my 4th session and just need touch ups now.
I have tried other places and did not get results like this!!!
Thank you for making it so painless for me and HAIR FREE.
Wings are good, fish and chips are good. Rueben is bad. Burgers are good. Cuban is very good except the ham is different, kinda sweet. Nice deal on on Thursdays $1.50 domestic bottles.

I want to put zeros stars. This is the absolute worst CVS I have ever been to. I've been trying to get my prescription for almost a week now. On day 1 they said it would be ready in an hour, ever since they have been giving me the run around. Now they are challenging the prescription order and will not release it to me. I hate this place so much. Now I have to go out of my way to another pharmacy. For 6 days, I have called 2-3 times. Everytime I am ok hold for 45 minutes no one will answer. They never do. Then I drive here just for them to give me the run around again. They should shut this place down. So disorganized it's ridiculous!

Great place to grab a beer and chicken wings after work! This location offers happy hour from 2-6 pm and 9pm-close on pretty much all beer and well drinks Monday-Friday. They also have 4 or 5 appetizer choices on that menu. Drinks are reasonably priced, I got a 2 beers for $3.50. 

The chili con queso is on their happy hour menu and it's pretty good. As for their wings, I always go for boneless spicy garlic with a side of ranch. Their cheese curds are really good as well, try dipping them in the southwestern ranch. Tuesday is their special on bone-in wings and Thursday is their special on boneless. Not sure why this place has so many bad reviews.
Bad customer service. One of the manicurists took the gel color samples out of my hand without explanation. No attempt at service recovery for a regular customer.

This place is getting more ghetto by the minute. Went in today shoes were all over the floors. Baby clothes not in right racks and also on floors. They never have enough lines open to get your stuff rung up. And the staff seems miserable. It's a shame because it was my go to place years ago
First time at the restaurant and it was very good. Complimentary dessert was unexpected and very nice! Delicious too!we would like to go back to shop the market.

Not fucking bad!  Not fucking bad at all!

POSITIVE:
+Clean.  Always a good thing when a hole in the wall isn't really a hole in the wall.
+Price is right and I'm a cheap motherfucker
+English speaking staff comes in handy for rookies
+Tacos are on point.  Not perfection, but good enough.
+++++Lunchtime means Mexican soap operas.  I cant understand what they're saying, but they've got hot broads with awesome cleavage.  

NEGATIVE
-That's some dry ass chicken. 
-Seriously?  A can of soda?  Time to get a fountain in the house.  make sure it has horchata, tamarindo, and jamaica while you're at it.

Bottom Line: This is probably the best one can expect in Nashville.  Maybe I should bump em up to five stars, but I just dont wanna put em on the same level as the awesomeness closer to the border.  Am definitely planning on becoming a regular though,.

***2/15/2016***
It's been a bookmark for a while and didn't disappoint.

In looking for a non-valentine's day valentine's day spot, I called before going to make sure they DON'T take reservations. Living in the former space of the ORIGINAL St. Louis Bread Company/Panera location, we found Winfield's to be a VERY comfortable place to gather.

****UPDATE 8/12/2016****
I didn't finish my review in Feb and I guess I should have. Maybe it would have helped them a little to keep the doors open.

Our party really enjoyed the Lobster Wontons, the Smokehouse Gumbo and the Brisket French Dip. The ambiance was comfortable and laid-back, and active but not crowded. I'm sorry to see that it will not be an option in the future, but wish Mark Winfield the best
Will is an absolute breath of fresh air! Always so kind and friendly when taking your order through the drive thru. Thank you for staying positive with everything going on!

What a classic joint filled with casual Nola chic characters just outside the elegant dining room of Antoine's restaurant. I had a pre-meal cocktail and small plate just soaking up the atmosphere. In a classic bar like this I settled for a 1920-1930's Sidecar expertly made and some local Louisiana Andouille sausage with a spiced creole mustard. I watched all the going's on around me as tables roared with laughter as everyone was having a grand time. A perfect pit stop on my way for more culinary madness ahead.

We have gone to this Chili's many times and usually have good service and a good meal until last night. Honestly the worst meal ever.... our ribs were overcooked and really dry, the vegetables were overcooked, and the chips were totally overcooked. The service was horrible. The excuse we received from our service was; "it's only my second day". Well then, don't serve!!! the Manager took the ribs off our meal, we left, and went home to eat. ABSOLUTELY HORRIBLE!!!!

We just bought our new dishwasher here. It is fantastic and I loved the selection they had. The store is organized, clean, pretty much everything you look for in a giant hardware store.

They'll definitely help you in the appliance section, but the salesperson the other day was a little overbearing. He just stared at us as we were looking at the dishwasher we wanted We didn't really have any questions, so it was a little awkward. Didn't stop us from buying it though so definitely A-OK.

Experience did not meet expectations. First time customer to Audi Wynnewood after relocation from Paul Miller Audi in Parsippany NJ and was not impressed.

Representative I spoke to over the phone when booking service appointment with was not friendly or helpful. Appointment was made over a week in advance, when loaner car was requested I was told no.

Day of service, I was told I was a walk in even though appointment was scheduled over a week in advance.  I  requested a loaner upon arrival at 8:00am and was made to wait 2 hours before they would consider a loaner option. There was no sit wait for the 2 hours.

Boa was helpful, he arranged for Audi to drop off my car and pick up the loaner at the end of the day.

My response when they texted me regarding an appointment for a free quote that I did not re-schedule or cancel:

Free quote??????? You guys originally came out to check out the unit and charged us $80 to just LOOK at it and say, yup, it's broken. Then scheduled a SALES rep to come out for a free replace or repair quote. Someone did come out and quoted me for a new unit for over $6k for a new system. But did NOT come prepared with a repair quote. After calling multiple times to try to get a repair quote so we can outweigh our options, I reached out to another company. This company quickly and diligently found a repair solution within hours of me contacting them with a quote of the repair costs and didn't charge me a dime. He overnighted the part for me, and said he would come out to replace it the second it came in. 

I called you guys again, and I finally got a response and quoted me at $1k and told me it would take approximately 2-3 weeks!!! That is a long time without an A/C! I called and informed the agent that came out that, that we found another provider. 

The other company came out and replaced the part that was broken for $500 dollars and did it in one day!!!!!

I'm not sure what all the hype is over this All That Jazz. It was ok to me but not as great as I was expecting.  It seemed to have a lot more sauce than shrimp and ham.  It could be that I was just spoiled by the huge, lower priced, overstuffed shrimp po-boy that I got in Slidell on the way into town that blew this sandwich away.  
As I type this the next morning, I'm eating my daughters leftover half of her fried chicken po-boy and I find it better than the All That Jazz.

Wow, Wow, Wow.  We were very impressed with Chris' work ethic. He is HIGHLY DETAILED and PERSONABLE. There's no way a 1st time home buyer can notice these findings while doing a walk-through with your agent. He even took extra time to explain to my husband all the deficiencies in the home. Outside of the home inspection, we requested additional services. (Radon and Termite - 1st-time buyers: PLEASE GET A RADON TEST; SO WORTH IT) And the service also includes a "Request List" feature to provide your agent with a repair/replacement/monetary reimbursement report to provide the seller. This made the process seamless and kept the home buying progress moving!! Would DEFINITELY hire again and refer CBC Home Inspections to family and friends.

Treated my daughter and myself to facials and massages. Excellent service and results. For the first time ever a masseuse who really listened and applied the correct pressure!! Loved the atmosphere and staff. Will definitely return.

Had a great lunch here- this place serves healthy food that is unique and very tastey.  I had a burrito with chicken and beans that didn't taste like any other burrito I had ever had - the sauces and quality are very good- the house made cookie i had was really fresh and delicious - I am anxious to go back again soon

This gym is unique because of its location and design and the entrance is behind the main street.

I met several nice employees and two were from my hometown of San Diego. I took two yoga classes and they were fantastic. Patrick was one yogi and Kathryn was the other. I was amazed at the way Patrick could teach with one leg and both were unique and had an awesome practice.

I did some cardio on an exercise bike and it worked well. They played two soccer games on screens above the bikes. One was the LA Galaxy and the other was a European match.

This location does not offer free towels and I didn't know that, so I had to use paper towels. It reminded me of LA Fitness where I had to do the same thing. It's a hassle and not a good long term solution, but it worked.

The sauna was extremely hot and definitely hotter than the 190 degree one I'm used to in Lakewood, California. There was no thermometer, but I estimate it was 220 degrees. I could only stand it for 20 minutes and I typically go for 25-30 minutes.

Overall this is a good gym, but it could use towels and the independent cardio machines could use their own TV screens. Otherwise the yoga classes are great and I liked it. I also didn't notice any "gym bullies" with necks like tree trunks who can barely walk through the door, which makes it a little easier to relate to the members.

Stay Away!!!!

Poor service, lack of selection,  horrible ambience, pushy,rude, unapologetic owner, bland drinks, no complimentary chips and dips.  Horrible food.."they actually used tater tots in a dish"
Very unsavory Mexican, unfortunately  between this place and fast chain Mexican...I would have to say "Yo queiro Taco Bell"

The crab was excellent! 5 stars! My wife got the snow crab and said it's some of the best crab she's ever had. I'm a shrimp guy so I tried the 1lb headless shrimp in buttery garlic. 3 stars. I don't like peeling the shrimp but I can get past that. I didn't taste the butter, it felt like it was in garlic oil more like. The seafood bread appetizer was QUITE scrumptious, and the corn in the buttery garlic shrimp I got was to die for. They provide bibs and gloves which is fantastic, because I get to eat the corn while holding it like an apple. This isn't something I ever knew I wanted to do, but it was. Overall, 4 stars cause most everything was amazing but I didn't like peeling my shrimp or the "garlic oil." Good size though. Shrimp is always yummy.

This place gave my favorite boots a longer and better life! I had probably fallen in them ten times due to poor traction and the heel was starting to crack. Peabody replaced the sole of the heel with better traction, and added a traction layer to the toe - seamlessly. The new sole looks like it has always been there and I can walk so much better in them! To top it all off, I was surprised to discover they polished the scuffs from all my falls and they look brand new! I also got them back the next day and the pricing is super reasonable considering their level of craftsmanship!
Way over priced they do not return emails or fb messages even when trying to make an appointment

We interviewed and received estimates from at least a dozen HVAC companies in Tucson. Hands down Temperature Control, Inc. had the most knowledgeable representative and offered the best prices. The installation team was extremely professional and skilled. The entire experience went beyond our expectations. We were and still are very pleased. Many kudos to the Temperature Control, Inc. team. We can easily recommend them to anyone. We are looking forward to a long happy relationship. :-)

If you're looking for good delivery food, look elsewhere.  They showed up half an hour late.  The food barely passed as warm and to top it off, they forgot half of my order.  It seems eating there is a good experience, but delivery is definitely not an option.

So I went to Rocket Fizz on Haddon with little success on what I was looking for so I traveled to this location. First, the the store was much bigger. Much more items. It was so cool being in there. It literally reminded me of my childhood. The two young people were pleasant. I appreciate that and the customer. And they had what I was looking for!which excited me even more.

Ok, I literally just got done stuffing myself so I cant even show you a picture of what the food looked like before but holy cow! IT WAS DELICIOUS!

I ordered the Steak & Fries. My steak was cooked a little over medium (I ordered medium) but the seasoning and flavor was perfect. The chimi sauce was delicious and the fries were tossed in it! I thought I wouldn't enjoy it because the fries would get soggy.. but no.. I was wrong. it was amazing!

I also ordered the Yuca fries. UMM BOMB!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

I 100% recommend this place and I cant wait till they come to my work place again! Will visit every time!

Great salon! Clean and bright and the girl who did my nails (gel manicure) was very nice and took her time, paying attention to detail and making sure they were exactly what I wanted. I'll definitely be coming here regularly from now on!

I've walked place this place so many times on the way to get brunch at Sabrina's but I never remembered to check it out at a different time (I don't explore all the great options on Callowhill as much as I should). Thanks to my classpass, though, I jumped at the opportunity to take a class here. I hear the drop in rates are decent and if I wanted to take more classes at this studio than my class pass allows, which I might!, I wouldn't be upset with the prices. This studio is SUPER clean. I know most studios that you go to are pretty clean, however, I found this place to be immaculate. It's got wood floors all throughout and walking around barefoot I didn't pick up any floor dust or anything. 

I went to the 90 min hot vinyasa flow with Cecile (spelling?- sorry if it's wrong). I think 90 min was too much for me, I usually go for 60 min classes and consider 75 min classes to be pushing myself. I loved the pace of the class though; it was slower, even though we were doing sun salutations and we were able to hold stretches for longer. It was really beneficial and I felt rejuvenated after leaving. Another great thing is that there are no windows and the heat is real! It's not some open air space (which is nice sometimes) that uses space heaters and claims to be a hot yoga studio. This is legit 95 degrees and you will sweat! Make sure to bring water to class and a towel for your mat and yourself. The instructor was great, she came around and helped every person at least once through the various poses. The only thing I didn't like is that we did a lot of hip stretches that required us to be on one of our knees and my knee started getting really irritated after our second set of hip openers. I would have preferred pigeon pose or something else. Lastly, I didn't think I wouldn't like the no mirrors deal at this place, but I actually really liked it. I felt like I had a greater awareness of where my body was and I wasn't concerned with what other people were doing or what I looked like to other people. I'll definitely be back here!

Fabulous place! Congrats to the owners for creating such success since 1963.  Overall this place seems like homemade and local except for the chips.  It's good to sell chips yet highly recommend to change to a local or regional brand. Seeing Lays brand just doesn't fit at the same level of quality as the other items.  The only other recommendation is less dressing in the pasta salad as it seems like thick soup. Very friendly staff. Nice music as a good volume.

Julie was an incredible addition to our wedding day. You can tell she knows what she is doing and uses only the highest quality hair & make up products. She was able to get my hair and make up exactly how I wanted it. Julie was so sweet and easy to talk with which was very calming before the ceremony! She has great style and I would highly recommend her for any event you may have.
Will definitely come back soon. And often. The home made mozzarella in the caprese salad is perfection.

Great shop plus the owners go above and beyond to support their community. Not only do I love their sweets-  I parked there for St Charles October Fest- Protesters showed up- one of the owners husbands went way out of his way to help me get out of the parking space- was kind and very calming-
I would recommend everyone who visit StCharles Main Street stop by and get a sweet!

I have to write about all of the Continentals... best ever!  Rad Na Thai Salad (which is really more of a pasta dish) makes me want to shoop.  Oh and the Miso glazed Chilean Sea Bass melts on your tongue!  It comes with sweet potato mashed potatoes.  I don't care for sweet potatoes, but these are amazing.  I thought about working there just so I could learn how to make it!  

Prices are good, except for the drink prices.  The drinks cost more than the food and have a weak pour.  

Cool atmosphere.  The top floor bar is really cool.  Lots of beautiful people looking smooth.  Well except one time, I ran into a girl from high school and got stuck talking to her and her breath was kickin.  But anyway, check it out!

A friend and I went here for lunch about 3 weeks ago. I had been to the location on 4th St. and it was very tasty, so I had high hopes for this one. My friend had never had Cuban food, so I was on the spot to deliver. We ordered from the buffet style setup, and our food was stone cold! We had them heat it up, but it wasn't the same. Not sure why there was such a difference between the two locations, perhaps we chose the wrong time?
Not professional, poor quality, poor customer service, all red flags . Don't do it save your money, it's not worth it
Amazingggggg! We had the duck clay pot, chicken red curry, and seafood pho (I hate squid so they omitted that for me).

Had an amazing day at this outback today! This is the original location where the magic started! Our waitress was phenomenal. Sooooo attentive. She noticed that I did not receive condiments With my tacos and corrected this immediately. She was quick to refill water and check on satisfaction.

The food was great! Steak was cooked perfect and sides were amazing. Drinks were delightful. I ordered a new cocktail and it was well made. The Caesar side salad was tasty. 

Parking was easy and reservations were not needed for lunch. I will definitely return here...the service was exquisite!

How cute is this shop? Board games cover the wall. Love that! From what I read online the room can be rented out for parties. Sign me up! Such a fun party idea. I thought Square Scoop was a locally owned ice cream shop so I was super confused when the glass cases had Sundae's stickers all over it. Turns out Square Scoop does not make ice cream in house but they sell Sundae's ice cream. Sundae's is locally owned and operated! 

Obviously I wanted to try all the flavors because they looked so.good but went with their two most unique options which I learned were the top sellers - lemoreo and graham central station. Um. I am going to be dreaming about the lemoreo ice cream. Yes, you read that correctly and yes it is lemon meets oreo and it is life changing. I may just have a new favorite flavor of ice cream. It doesn't pack a tart punch but just a nice, refreshing lemon. The graham central station was also a real treat! These are 2 giant scoops for less than $5. I will be making many a trips to Square Scoop this summer. If I bike down from So Bro, that is called balance, right?
I came here for a quick bite to eat and ordered the veggie pizza and it was good, definitely a good place to try if you are in the area and would a different type of pizza.
sushi is very good,  white tuna with roasted garlic was a nice surprise.

So comparing this to the Chattanooga market, this market was seriously lacking. They advertised live music that was an hour late in starting. The inside is just one large food court and the outside booths were very lacking. There was no atmosphere of liveliness and all in all my family and I were just disappointed.

Thanks Matt and Steve for the great service. I was in the market for a new vape shop since I just moved back from California and they were such a great help. I'll definitely be a returning customer. The Pebbles ejuice tastes amazing and I recommend it to anyone!
Rover done over was awesome! Thank you for being so great with Lilly for her first grooming session!
you can never go wrong here.  Old school amazing pizza.  You've tried the rest now try the best!  Believe me I grew up in NYC with the best pizza and this pizza is right there!

Great little place!
The service was impeccable! The food was served quicker than able to eat the bread. The appetizers were delicious. 
The dolma(grape leaf wraps) were very fresh, It was filled with a rice mixture flavored with cloves. It was very good mixture of flavors. 
Loved the lentils. Soup, It was blended and the soup was really soupy and flavored to perfection. 
The hummus was smooth to the paladar specially with the soft and warm pittas. 
My vegetarian sampler platter was a perfect size. 

The stuffed artichoke heart is a must, It had flavors similar to the dolmas, the rice and cloves....

The stuffed eggplant was flavorful however a bit too oily. 

Now the hot apple tea!!! You have to try It!!! So good and sweet... I was super impressed about the refills on that. 
 The  coffee is very good and the dessert of the day was great! Not too sweet but flavorful enough to understand that is a dessert. 
It was a good meal and not too pricy. 
Will be back here!

I had a great experience at Solarium today. I went in and looked at the pricing sheet, asked some questions to decide on the best package for my needs, and signed up for one month.

There were absolutely no high-pressure sales tactics; just friendly, efficient, and I was tanning within 5 minutes of walking in.

I've tanned at chain stores in the past and it was constant pressure every time I went. They always wanted to sell me something or get me to upgrade.

Solarium understands that customers are people and the level of respect I was given makes me feel much more comfortable going there regularly. I think this tactic is more effective in the long run and probably yields more customer loyalty.

Best of all, there were no contracts or automatic deductions from my bank account. Solarium seems to understand that if they do a good job, customers will renew each month. Chain stores know their customers are unhappy, so roping them in with long-term contracts is the only way to keep them.

Thank you for a first class experience!

Terrible service today at ACE. I've been a loyal customer for years and will not be returning. Online orders here are a joke-don't waste your time. I asked multiple employees to look for my online order which was ready per their email to me. No one seemed to care and the one guy who went to the back to look for it never came back. I stood there for at least 15 minutes and got back in line with the same employee who then looked at me like he'd never seen me before. Everyone's tone and demeanor was RUDE. Not the helpful place today.
Used to LOVE this place - what happened!!? Beer is meh, food used to be delicious-  now it's Bleh. So disappointing.

Do not eat here. Terrible food, lack of service and the owner lied and said she was the manager until I asked to speak with the owner. That is when she admitted it was her and her husband that owned the restaurant. 

I tried to give her feedback about her food and she was condescending.  My four taquitos were burned in the fryer to the point that the meat disintegrated and looked like steel wool (no meat remaining).  In a very condescending tone, she asked if it was burnt black. The attached picture is the guacamole salad and cost 4.99. 

With all of the competition surrounding this restaurant, you would think that the owners would pay attention to the food quality and welcome feedback. It is hard to believe that when I already expressed that I was dissatisfied with the food, I received such hostility. Do yourself a favor and drive a little further to Margarita House to the south or Los Compadres to the north.

The food was delicious!! We went late at night there was music and people drinking but it was not packed! We ordered some beers and they didn't have anything else. We had three entrees and asked for them spicy and they didn't mess around. The food was so spicy it was delicious! The service was great. The waitress was very nice. I loved it! Highly recommend

The Doctors and Medical Assistants at Edenson Dental are knowledgable, personable, and thorough. My daughter and I found ourselves there due to a scheduling conflict with our family's previous dentist. Together, we've had cleanings, a filling, and an extraction with this group. We were pleasantly surprised at the amount of attention given to each procedure as well as the personal care we both receive during visits.  The service at Edenson Dental is exceptional!

Two stars because our waitress was really delightful, otherwise a 1 star review. Our family went to Captain Bill's  based on other Yelp reviews. Although I agree with other reviewers- the prices are reasonable - we were really disappointed in our food. I'm hoping it was just a bad night in the kitchen, but we won't be going back.

Fairly decent meat but slow service and side dish buffet had limited choices. There is no pao de queso bread or sauces that you find at most rodizios. The strawberry cream was not that great. Be prepared....when asking for picanya....be sure to say rump steak. It does have a nice atmosphere.

If you must have rodizio.....then ok go....otherwise make another selection.
Kristine blesi is the best for microblading and permanent makeup  she is also a makeup artist

Let me preface this by saying my tastes tend more towards European style food than American junk food, but if I'm going to watch a football game, I'm not above ordering a takeout sandwich or pizza if I can find a good tomato pie. TK swears by their plain cheese pizza. It has a nice, flat crust, plenty of cheese and tangy sauce.  They don't know how to do anything small, be warned.  If you get a "whole" hoagie or cheesesteak, it will feed your entire family.  

Personally, I am a fan of their chicken parm sandwhich, which have real, breaded chicken and marinara sauce. Yum!  As for their steak sandwiches, gastronomical size aside, they aren't the best in the city.  I found the meat a little dry.  I don't do cheese so it may have been helped by a substantial slathering of provolone.

Overall the pizza gets four stars and the steak sandwiches get three.

I have been coming to Tabora for years, and the food is always fresh and delicious! Their cold brew coffee is a great summer treat if you need a little pick me up! From smiley face cookies for the kids to savory stuffed rolls for lunch, we love this place! The owners are always friendly too. They host many festivals and events for the whole family.
Jennifer was awesome. The shop itself is very nice, clean and inviting. They really concentrate on what you do and do not like. Pricey but worth every penny

Awesome hotel! From the moment we walked in, the front desk clerk Jarrod greeted us with a smile and was very friendly and accommodating. We'd had a long, delayed flight and he made sure to get us a room even though it was still a few hours till check in time. The staff at this hotel goes above and beyond to make you feel welcome. The room was spacious and clean. The bed, pillows and comforter were the most comfortable I have ever slept on! Perfect for sleeping in! Walls are thin so if you are a light sleeper ask for a room away from the elevators.

Great Thai food, inventive, and original.  Spice to your level of desire.
Took my daughter, granddaughter and vegetarian son-in-law there last night, and they all enjoyed it thoroughly.
Not a fan of the worker's who seem to be eating the profits. Which is not appetizing. There are other places in this same shopping center I would advise you going.

Beware of any blended fruit drinks that are made with non-organic fruits, or fruits grown with pesticides.  It takes a lot to make a drink and you end up consuming a ton of this additive.  With the assumed selling healthy drinks (because they are fruit) I doubt this place will even utter the pitfalls of using "pretty fruit" rather than cutting into their profit margin by using the more expensive organic fruits.  It beats a soda I suppose.
Amazing Mediterranean food,  soups,  burgers and breakfast sandwiches.  We get takeout food from here all the time... You will not be disappointed!  Oh,  and they have gas, too!

Love BurgerFi. My only gripe about this place is the location. There is never any parking, making it hard to go there too often. The food is always top notch and we love their shakes and concretes. Will definitely go back again, when there is parking available :)

Diggin vibe ! Nice little nook for live music .. Bring  on One Borrowed Time ..
Was pleased they had a decent wine selection  by the bottle !! Raveswood Select Zin  Purr ...
A Good time :)

Updating as I spoke to the manager and she was very understanding of the situation and refunded the items I ended up not needing. She was very open to making the situation better for me, and I appreciate it.

Their dresses are really amazing, especially the Disney line which isn't available anywhere else. I wouldn't trade my dress for the world and at the end of the day that's what really matters to me. Thank you

We were once again visiting in Edmonton and based on previous visits wanted to go here for some good Chinese food. What a disappointment! It was as if the menu and the cook was totally different. Being as there were 3 of us we first looked at the family combo meals but the choice ( yes one choice if 3) wasn't anything that sounded appealing so we each picked a dish to share and each had an egg roll. Nothing was good. The egg rolls were over cooked and dry, filled only with bean sprouts. The chicken chowmein had noodles where some were burnt and some weren't cooked at all. The almond chicken, which in the menu is described as crispy, had way too much batter around cold chicken and was a soggy mess. We also had Pekingese ribs but they tasted like scraps of stringy leftover pork deep fried with no flavor. At one point I asked the waitress if they had changed the menu because the food was so different from our visit just 6 months before. She said No but we were all very disappointed and confused as to the reason for our horrible food. We won't be back because you know it's bad when the memory the next day gives you the shudders

Disappointed our last 2 visits.
We walked in and was told to grab a couple of menus and seat ourselves.
The apple chicken salad was chicken salad with sliced apples sticking up. They didn't have the pancakes so ordered the waffle which had no flavor. and the service was poopy. Like poopy so maybe they thought we weren't going to tip well.

This was the first time I visited Bahama Buck's I walked into the Trinity location and was really surprised by the nice interior and layout of the store. If you're a fan of italian ice then coming here is a must. The open area kitchen allows customer's to view Bahama's extensive italian ice flavors and potential pairings.

During my visit, I couldn't see thr tv menu well from the line and skipped a traditional italian ice and purchased a small paradise fruit cup. It's a choice of two different fruits (I chose banana/strawberry) one type of ice cream at the buttom of the cup (starwberry ice cream) one topping (I got chocolate dizzel) and an extra topping like sprinkles or sugar for a total cost of $5.34 w/ tax.

The crew at Bahama Buck's took a few minutes to make my order. They only had 3 people (high school age) employees working during my Tuesday at 4pm visit. The strawberries in my fruit cup tasted frozen but the crew hand cut  bananas that hang from a chain attached the ceiling above their open prep area. While waiting for my order (5 minutes or so)  I observed most customers ordered something to go and more kids came in than adults.

 I liked what I ordered the appearance of the cup was cool with the decorative umbrella. The ice cream wasn't anything special though which is a huge deal for me as I thoroughly enjoy ice cream. I'm more of a fan of Rita's italian ice  because of the smooth creamy custard they pair with thier ice's. However, Rita's doesnt come close to the amount of italian ice flavors customers can chose from at Bahama's. If you're a fan of italian ice's then you'll love Bahama Buck's.

The best donuts I have ever had! Everyone was super friendly in there and great environment. I will gladly drive to philly just for these donuts! The blueberry mascarpone was delicious and the lavender donut heated was incredible! Worth the wait to get them fresh out of the oven

I bought a groupon to a detail that I just had to buy for half off. 15 bucks!
Was it worth it...not even 5 bucks. Horrible job! My grandma could do a better job. 
I could do better with my eyes closed. 
Dirty stains everywhere! Doesn't a detail mean clean the carpet? At LEAST scrub the stains?! Nope...fogetaboutit! 
Thank goodness it was for half off or I would have went off!

I love this place! Christine gives me great pedicures and she's so personable! I brought my five year old to get a pedicure with me but instead she got a pedicure and her nails polished. I got here at 8:30 am (which is when they open on Saturdays)  and both of us were finished by 9:30 but I stayed a little longer to make sure that my toes were perfectly dry! This is only my second time coming but I recommend them to everyone. They've gotten busy every time I've come so make sure to come early. The wait doesn't seem long though because they have enough people working! Give them a try if you can!!!

Had to wait 2 hours for a table for 18. 5 empty tables the last hour and through most of our meal. We asked hostess 3  times if we could sit at the 5 empty tables. She would not seat us. She kept us waiting for long tables. As it turned out our party sat at one long and 2 round tables anyway after waiting the extra hour while round tables sat empty. While being seated the hostess had rude snarky remark I suggested she was a tad unprofessional. Our waitress was awesome. Band was great... food was good but both hostesses were unprofessional and rude.
Best pho in St. Louis. Their broth is delicious. My personal favorite is pho sate. It's spicy pho with a blend of Thai peanut satay.

Really cannot ask for a better haircut for the amount they charge for. Walked in today because the other barbershops were closed for Memorial Day. Matt was extremely professional, friendly, and skillful in giving me a fresh fade. Couldn't have asked for a better service. 

Matt is extremely talented. Would give 6 stars if possible. To all UCSB students, this place is just 5 dollars more expensive than Campus Cuts, but worth every penny.

I happened across EnVie with three friends this past holiday weekend, and we absolutely loved it. The coffee was good, and the carrot cake (at 10:00am!!) was amazing. They also had alcohol choices to add into the drinks which was great, and the food choices looked yummy as well. The prices were definitely comparable to other coffee places, and we all thought the bar itself looked really cool. Overall, loved it!
Love this place! The atmosphere is very laid back, and the lavender vanilla latte was delicious! Perfect place to study or relax with a book.

My friend told me about this place and we decided to go. I love sushi and I can tell you everything we ordered was delicious. We had the mussel appetizer and that was very flavorful as well. Would definitely recommend.

I cannot recommend the wonderful services of Maison de Cheveux enough. In addition to making you look amazing, they'll also serve you wine and entertain you with stories while you get beautified in a super cool, artsy/funky space. The owner, Nicolle, is a GEM. I'm so grateful I stumbled on this awesome salon while in NOLA and I will be back!!!
This is the slowest Dairy Queen I have ever been to and they don't wear masks. Not friendly. Will not return.

We really enjoy Lucky 13. From the outside it may look like a dive or tattoo parlor, but the inside is really cool. Neat Schmidt's of phila. Memorabilia & other old school stuff lines the shelves. Head banger music posters line the walls. Excellent Juke box. Always a good selection of craft beers on tap. The most surprising thing about this bar is the menu. The food is awesome, as good as any gastro-pub anywhere. The food selections are diverse
 Enough to satisfy almost any taste. They have everything from Meatloaf to really good vegan dishes. Check out the Ace Of Spades sandwich, quite possibly the best vegan sandwich in Philly. The staff is also great, Clarke who owns the place and also bartends at times is always a pleasure. My wife and I always make a point to stop in on Saturdays in the late afternoon to see Katharine who bartends Sat afternoons. She too is always a pleasure to visit. A really fun neighborhood pub.

Decent food. I placed a to go order and I was missing an item. Called the location back since I live nearby to pick it up. Guy argued with me and said I was lying about 1.99 rice. I was done after that. Poor  customer service!

Everything in this place is excellent, except for the boss. 
Every time I stop by, I witness him bullying and yelling at his staff. I feel bad for the girls that work there, because they do their job perfectly and don't deserve to be yelled at. But the most obscene fact is that he yells at customers, too! 
The boss needs to change the attitude or he will scare all the customers away.
Love this place. Always spotless and toppings are so fresh.  Excellent selection of yogurt flavors.

Delicious and classy steakhouse. The lobster buttered popcorn appetizer was fantastic, and the Brussels sprouts were a delicious side to our rib eye and NY strip steaks. It's definitely a great choice when you want to splurge! We were celebrating a birthday, and they offered us a free dessert of our choice (for there or to go, if we were too full, which we were) for celebrating with them!
Amazing! Had the mushroom stuffed salmon and was so good I'm glad we made the drive all the way out for this restaurant. Everything tastes so fresh and the service was amazing

My first time coming here was last week and I was a little worried from the looks of it but I decided to give it a try.  My Challenger came out super clean and shiny 2 hours later! and I LOVED IT!! it looked better than when I first bought the car. They did an amazing job! will be going back soon!

Never again!  We were going to the Elton John concert so we called and made reservations for two at 6:30.  The person that answered the phone said "You shouldn't need reservations, but we will go ahead and put you down for 6:30."  Good thing we did because they obviously have no idea what goes on in their neighborhood.  The place was packed and way under staffed.  We arrived at 6:30, finally about 5 minutes later someone came over to the waiting area where there were about 15 people waiting to be seated.  We told them we made a reservation and thankfully we were seated right away.  The waitress told us that normally on Sunday evening they were dead so this was a surprise to them that there were so many people.  We put our order in right away.  We ordered 6 sliders and 2 orders of fries.  She came back with our drinks (wrong) and then told us the kitchen was really backed up and it would be a while.  She pointed to a table that had gotten there before us and they still did not have their food.  I went to the restroom (a total mess!!! Broken soap holders, crap all over the floor, broken hand towel dispensers) and when I walked by this particular table they said that they had gotten there at 6 and at 7:30 they finally got their food.  So we asked the waitress again to check on our food.  We said we would wait until 7:35 because the concert started at 8 and we had to walk over to the Chaifetz arena.  She came back to the table and said it would still be a while.  We pointed at another table that had been seated after us and they had already gotten their food and we asked how they got their food so quickly?  She said, "Oh they ordered appetizers so they got theirs first."  Well, guess what?  The sliders are on the appetizer menu. Why didn't we get ours quicker?  Another table that was seated after us also got their appetizer.  An order of what looked like nachos, turned their plates upside down on the table and left.  By this time it is 7:35 and we decided we needed to go so we got up, went over to the bar and the waitress comes up to us and says "Oh you are leaving?  Your food is coming up now." So we went back over to our table sat down and she went over to another table and started talking to them.  We are like OK if our food is coming up now why aren't you going to get it??  We gave her a couple of minutes and then got up, put our coats on, went to the bar to pay for our drinks and the bartender told us to just leave.  That we didn't have to worry about paying.  What a waste of time!!!   We wound up going to the arena and eating a pretzel with cheese for dinner. We will NEVER visit this place again.
Great place. Great vibes. Happy and welcoming employees. Drinks were good. Will come back.

Love this place so much. Always on point with my order, incredibly fast, and delicious. Not to mention the seasoned olive oil and bread at the beginning. Also it's not freezing in the building even though it's attached to the mall-that's very important to me. They have a bar and all of the staff is extremely eager to help. Again, LOVE this place.

I have been attending Tucson Strength for just about 4 years. I began with the Strong and Healthy Woman program. I found out I really enjoy kettlebells and general weight lifting. 

The staff are what make this place special. The focus is on making sure you know the proper way to do an exercise so you don't get injured. And, they re-fresh you on technique on a regular basis.

I love my gym and the folks there. Great place

If I could give zero stars I would. Had a meal here a few months ago. Meal was mediocre and my drink was terrible. Decided to give it another chance. Big mistake! Buffet brunch was not good. There were shells in the scrambled eggs! Not just a few shell pieces but a large and crunchy amount of shell. They were also undercooked. We told the waitress and she let them know to pull the eggs. Even after that, they still charged us full price. I'm praying I don't end up sick from the food. Stay away from here!

My friend ordered the Bento. Then menu says it comes with Tempura. When her food came there wasn't any tempura. They said they have discontinued tempura. I ordered the Korean BBQ. I did NOT get Korean Kalbi Ribs as usual. It was some weird kind of beef with teriyaki sauce. If I would have know I would have ordered something different. They need to change menu and be more upfront with customers. I did not eat one bite of my meat. When they asked if everything was OK, I told them no. Yet no kind of compensation or anything. We got charged for items we did not get.

This is by far the BEST Greek restaurant I have ever been to. The food is authentic & the service outstanding! I visit at least monthly & try something new each time. I brought my in-laws, visiting from England twice in the last 2 wks because they also loved the experience! Thank you to the outstanding servers who give great recommendations, exceptionally accommodating & very efficient in serving our every needs! A very fun, entertaining, relaxing & delicious place to visit!

It can get crowed and loud sometimes because it is a small cafe, but my fave dish to get there is lad nah. I prefer chicken as my meat, but any other meat is fine. Their sea food combo is popular as well.
Great service from both nail techs! I'm throughly pleased with how my nails look every time I visit Tara's Nail Salon

I can't say enough good things about Dr. Bash and his staff! 
My family found his office while looking for dentists that wouldn't turn you away if you didn't have insurance. 
  I had 2 broken molars that I would have sworn they should have been pulled. After a consultation with Dr. Bash, we discussed my options, what I wanted to do, what we could afford, etc and he set to work. 
3 years later, we have saved both molars, stopped the pain they we causing, we are working on lesser problems and getting my bite adjusted which is cutting back on my grinding as well. 
While he does require payment up front, he will submit your work to your insurance so you'll be reimbursed.  
His staff is excellent, the office uses an email and text reminder service for appointments, and they are in an easy to find location in a nice area. 
 While there are other dentist offices closer to me, Dr. Bash is worth the 11 mile drive.

This is a great place. Complements to the chef on his gluten free dishes. The mushroom ravioli was out of this world. Also the Brussels sprouts with pancetta were very good. Guava sorbet is excellent. And this is the unbelievable one; gluten free orange ricotta donut holes that were fantastic. 
On top of that the bartender really knew his stuff from drinks to all dishes. 
Very wonderful experience. A dream come true for a foodie like me.

A friend recently brought me here for dinner.  It's a beautifully designed restaurant with a lovely view upstairs.  I was very impressed.  I had the plank salmon.  Fresh wild caught, perfectly cooked salmon with fresh  vegetables.  Great service and friendly staff.  If you have room for dessert, please order the homemade Key Lime pie.  Chef Chanel makes it herself and it's the best I've ever had.  Thick graham cracker crust and the perfect blending of sweet and tart.  Can't wait to return.

Unfortunately I do not remember my stylists name. But she was new to the salon. 
I feel bad in saying all this because my stylist was very sweet and kind. But unfortunately her work isn't ideal. I had to keep explaining what I had wanted and asking her to cut off more and more and more. She was not able to end with the desired results (even after 5 hours in the chair). I don't know if she was just afraid to cut my hair or what the issue was. We also added some some blonde pieces to my hair that were placed very badly and didn't turn out anything like I had asked and showed pictures of. Even though I had asked her to straiten my hair she curled it and when I got home and straitened it I noticed my hair was all different lengths in different places and not even what's so ever and very bulky. I'm sure the great reviews are on here for a reason. I just wanted to inform any newbies so if you decide to go in to ask for the stylist who have been there for awhile and not anybody new so you don't have this problem.

Such friendly people & great rates!

Had my wife's car diagnosed before at another repair center for bad alignment & vibration issues & was quoted $875 because of bad ball joints & lower control arms needing replaced. It would take 2 days to repair. We budgeted for 2 years to get the money to do the job. 

Belle tire comes to town, right down the road from us. Out of curiosity we took the car there to be diagnosed. They diag the suspension for free & give us the same outcome. Two bad ball joints, have to buy the lower control arms. $480 for the job, includes alignment & free alignments for the next year. We had enough budgeted that we got the job done & got 4 new tires & and a great oil change on top! After worrying & budgeting for 2 years, we found Belle tire was were we needed to be the whole time.

Paul & Brad were amazing & super helpful. Great job guys.

We're buying a condo in the French Quarter. Realtor suggested Axelrad and we took her recommendation.  Gabrielle (Gabby) came to do our inspection and in my opinion did a very thorough job. Plenty of pictures from the attic and roof, produced a helpful report. Informed us that the shingles on the roof were not, in fact, slate, but defective synthetic slate.  We knew the roof was in need of replacement, but finding out that the material that had been used before was defective (and not reusable, as slate should be) helped us be clear-eyed about what the roof replacement was going to cost.

My family and I tried this place out for the first time this last weekend. Walked in and was told we would be seated right away just needed to wipe off a table. Waited another 10-15 min while other tables were available for one to get wiped off. Many employees walked by us without even asking if we had been helped. Finally got seated and our waitress was very nice. In all my family ordered tri tip, ribs, and pulled pork. My pulled pork was barely warm when it came out. Fry sauce was good but not impressed it was 50 cents each not even one included if you ordered fries. Oh and if you use a card you also get charged a fee. Not to impressed with that either. All in all food was alright, waitress was good, just nothing amazing.

Firstly they serve food without wearing gloves so they touch the phone, the cash register, money and then touch the pizza. I thought that was gross. Also ordered Parmesan fries which tasted like they were made a week ago, barely any cheese on it. Garlic knots were also tasteless. Also they put all your pizza slices into one box, slices on top of one another so they get stuck and half the toppings are on the bottom of the slice above. I definitely won't be returning.

Slimy ba*****s, monopolizing the masses. Who the f*** charges 30$ for late fees! AND charges you a deposit of about 2 months in advance because you were late! On top of that every storm that passes by the power goes off! Some times for hours! Last winter it took them 7-8 days to freaking bring the lights back! Mean while I took showers in the gym 20 miles awy every day and dug a hole in the snow to store my food! But who cares because they got us by the b***s! Worst side of capitalism. I HATE YOU bas****s!!! Can't wait to move away and use solar. Here is my middle finger (on both hands)

We were traveling for work and found this spot on Yelp, and oh boy aren't we glad we stopped by! The service was spectacular, I believe our server was a lady named Kristine, and she was outgoing, attentive, knowledgeable and offered great recommendations. We ordered the house salad to start with an amazing vinaigrette dressing. It was so good I was actually tempted to order a second. We then ordered the Pineapple Honey Habanero Wings which were delicious, they didn't come with a dipping sauce - but honestly the wings were so good alone that you didn't need any dressing. I thought they would be spicier then they were, but living in Phoenix for a decade, our spice tolerance is pretty high. You have to try their organic Italian sodas. They aren't overly sweet and the flavours are spot on. The pizza was excellent - prepared in their really cool oven. AND THEN, there was the local cheesecake. I don't recall where they get it from, but... oh my goodness it was heavenly. I normally think cheesecakes are too sweet, this was not. It had nuts, caramel, and the filling was fluffy almost like a mousse. If we had been in town for longer, we would have certainly returned for a second dinner.
Great real Chinese food restaurant. If you know what to order.Garlic crispy chicken is awesome!
OMG! Awesome & well worth the wait. I had the Chicken St Charles it was amazing I had a bite of the pancakes & they were fabulous! Good Bloody Mary & Ronald our server was fantastic
My favorite place in Brentwood , TN .... can't go wrong with anything from the menu !

After 6 days of being housebound and miserable, my sick spouse decided he needed some comforting in the form of western-style chinese food. Harvest Chinese is the latest iteration of the chinese resto in an old strip mall at the corner of 75 St and 90 Ave in the Ottewell neighbourhood. This spot has hosted 3 differently named chinese restos in probably as many years, which worried me, but it's slim pickings for non-western food in this part of E-town, so Harvest Chinese it was. Of course no horrible Yelp reviews helps too! 

My guy was happy with the food, but I thought it was pretty average. Not quite as advertised (mixed veg used instead of greens, white mushrooms used instead of chinese mushrooms) and a bit pricey for what you get in terms of meat quantity. Taste was overall passible, slightly better than your average western-chinese, and the veg was fresh and the sauces not too heavy or gloopy with corn starch or MSG.

Not the best, but good for caucasians looking for the comfort of the chinese food of their youth. All that was missing was horoscope placemats and tropical drink umbrellas. And maybe a koi pond.

Don't think about ordering online for pickup. They are always an hour behind on the orders. I don't think I've ever come to get my order and they actually had it ready (I leave 15 minutes late to pick it up on purpose). You're better off waiting in a line that's out the door than coming here. Also the staff are horrible. I don't know her name my the cashier yelled at us for asking where our food that was supposed to be picked up at 6:00 (now 7:00) is.

Would not recommend. Everyone hyped up this place so we went. We were unimpressed. I had the shrimp scampi which was horrible. I was really surprised because everyone said that it was the best. Soo disappointed.

Love the place, read about it in the RFT, so had to give it a try. If you like thin crust pizza this the best you'll find. Crisp and holds up to the toppings. We love the meat eater. I also tried the spaghetti and meat balls. Loved the meatballs and the sauce was great. Wife had the lasagna she said it was wonderful. Overall well worth the trip from O'Fallon Mo.

I'm not a fan of seafood, but this wasn't seafood. It was heaven. Caplinger's special and fried potatoes. Also got a sample of the tuna salad and I almost ordered a pound. Super fresh and super delicious. Gotta be patient though cause a lot of people know this place rocks.

Love love love this place!!!  Everything I have eaten here has been so fresh and delicious!!  Ate here for the 1st time Sunday brunch- it was amazing!!  Not one to want to photograph my food, but did!  Was so yummy!  Then went back for dinner a month later...I had greek chicken salad.  Let's just say I dream of that salad!  The best I've had and I've had many!  The meatloaf & chopped steak are delish!  The Mediterranean plate is phenomenal & a MUST!!!  
This would be a 5 star review IF they would bring back the Goat Cheese balls encrusted with pistachios in honey....so sad those are gone!  :(  please bring them back!

Wait time was about right with approximation and  service was quick to take order and somewhat quick to deliver. Food was mediocre, some things weren't so fresh. I think menu can be freshened up with more flavor. It's all about the atmosphere, family friendly and eating seafood on the beach.

Easily the best byob in the city. No reservations but awesome service! fun fact: they DO take reservations on valentines day but you're packed in like sardines. enjoy this awesome place on a nice day and sit outside

I did not like my pasta, but im sure have other great tasty food. I got to see Josh Holloway ( sawyer) from LOST!!! That made my day!! It was a nice evening w great company and beautiful view of the beach.

Why do things keep changing everyday?  Portion sizes keep getting smaller, some items disappear and then reappear. For example, salmon disappeared for a few days and sometimes avocado is available and sometimes they're not. Consistency is key! You really need to have this down before you open rather than change things on a whim so customers know what to expect. What kind of poke place has teriyaki chicken as a protein?  Speed is still a problem, for a restaurant that has all the ingredients already made, it shouldnt take that long to put it together.

Great delicious food and great service! For my first time eating Korean BBQ it was a great experience. The staff were friendly; they informed me what each meat and side dish was. I'll definitely be coming back again!

This place is so awesome. I have no idea why so many people are giving it negative reviews. When you consider the price of this place during the week ($29.99) it's probably the best deal you can find in Reno.. Even motel 6 is slightly more to stay at. 

The rooms are big and the bathrooms are nice. Everything seemed pretty clean. The only things that I didn't like were the slow elevators, slow flushing toilets, and lack of good ventilation in the rooms (windows don't open).


This place has so many positives.. HUGE POOL that has bad ass parties in the summer. Free spa.. Room service from Mels! A seriously bad ass buffet upstairs too! Get a players card, it's free and you can get into the buffet for way cheaper than normal. It seems that weekend rates are higher, but honestly I would stay here even if it were $80 a night.. Good overall place. Everyone who thinks differently should go to Circus Circus and enjoy the annoying little kids running everywhere!

I thought the man at the front desk was exceptionally rude. I made an appointment and still waited for 25 mins. The pedicure was fine- but the polish was clumpy (I should have just picked another color). I wanted a gel manicure but was pressured into getting dipped nails. She applied three coats and my nails look chunky and weird. I was really disappointed with the experience there. I will not return.

Huge menu so tough to make a decision. Settled on Maria's Greek Skillet and Meat Skillet (subbed gravy for hollandaise). Both were huge portions and delicious. They were super busy, but the service was really good. Plus... had to have a half price mimosa! (All day every day)

The most difficult and lengthy menu! When the staff has to check "the board" to see what you're talking about you might want to condense it a bit. Pricing was a little high for fast food, and the wait was ridiculous
I went in there the other day and was no pleased. The store is crowded Because they have SO much furniture. Expect to pay 2-4K on a couch here.

This nail spa is ghetto!!! Nail tech rolled her eyes at me because I was taking too long deciding a color. The price list said $30 for SNS but was charged for taking off previous SNS and because I have long nails. TELL PEOPLE HOW MUCH THEY GOTTA PAY BEFORE YOU START MAKING STUFF UP.

I wanted to buy a Neuton mower, and thought I would get better service if I bought it at a brick-and-mortar store.  So wrong.  The staff was rude and slow.  When I had a problem, they told me to bring it in.  I asked  could I please make an appointment, as it was a long drive, and was told , bring it in anytime.  SO I get there, and am told to leave it and someone will  call to let me know what is wrong in a week.  7 days later, I call them and they say I need a new battery.  AND they will need to order it, so it will be at least another week before it comes in.  I said, 'You don't sell replacement batteries for a BATTERY OPERATED MOWER THAT YOU SELL?' They said no.  I then said I would just return it and order direct from the company.  When I called the company and complained about their authorized dealer, the company told me that Affton had never recorded my purchase with Neuton, so I had missed service updates. Pathetic.

Have been to this location a few times with my wife and the service has been good. Stopped in today for lunch and was disappointed with the service. Seemed to be well staffed and low volume based on an 11:30 arrival. My wife ordered a salad and opted for the blackened chicken, standard chicken was served, I ordered a Cali burger and salad, waitress noticed the burger was wrong when bringing the food to the table and said the right would be out soon, second burger was brought out and it was wrong as well. Received the burger which was asked to be well done, served medium and the bottom bun was so wet that is was no longer in bread form, had to ask for water multiple times and again, not very many people in the restaurant.
Make sure you walk in here hungover with 2 of your friends and some Andre. Order the Satsuma juice, it pairs up with a $6 Brut nicely.
They only care about the money not the pet  not the customer. they will not take products not used .they find reasons to avoid this ,poor service . Use pet smart

I read a couple negative reviews and it prompted me to offer my review. We celebrated our great grandson's 6th Birthday. What a fun day. Food service was good the food is not five star but I didn't expect it to be. But I would certainly return. The staff were friendly and equipment was well maintained.

The worst service we have ever had. The server and manager argued with us about the servers mistakes. It was completely unprofessional. We have been there multiple times and never had an issue. Our food is always wonderful. If I could give service 0 stars I would. Our group could not believe the awful service and attentiveness.

My wife and I recently purchased a pre-owned car at Ed Martin Acura. The whole sales process was a little frustrating for us as there was zero flexibility on their part in the negotiation, but we really liked the car so we went forward with it. That was a little frustrating, but it got worse.

Dan from the finance department within their office was quoting us on an auto loan and tried to pull one over on us. He offered us an interest rate over 1% higher than we had been quoted elsewhere that same day and said that was as low as he could go. When I told him that was ridiculous he was somehow immediately able to drop the rate down at or below that of the competition. Clearly he was lying to us in the beginning and that was alone was enough for me to consider financing elsewhere.

Then after that, they sent my title information to the wrong state. When I called them to tell them to change it to the correct state, they said the sales man who helped me just two weeks ago was no longer with them... After several phone calls, messages, conversations with multiple employees, driving with expired plates, and 2 MONTHS of me bugging them, I was finally able to get them to send me the title. And this was only possible because the title clerk at Ed Martin Acura was out of town on vacation and the title clerk from Ed Martin Lincoln was able to help me instead. If I hadn't called everyday for over a month, I wouldn't have been lucky enough to call during his vacation week and get a hold of someone else from a different dealership!

I also discovered upon receiving the paper work that they messed up the amount of tax they charged me upon buying the vehicle. Therefore I had to spend another $400 in tax at the BMV. That was a pleasant surprise...

Overall, just a bad experience at a sub par dealership with some very unhelpful (and arguably unethical) people that caused me a lot of stress, headache, and lost time. Go somewhere else.

Traveling through Boise, we were given a tip about this place by a friend so we had to try it.

My partner and I had their unique vegan burger which was really good on their home-baked roll. Many folks were enjoying the bison and beef side burgers. Salads can be ordered up also.

Of all the fry choices we chose Russett  shoestring fries. I bet half the folks there were eating the purple fries. The other choices were Yukons, Sweet, Okinawa, Gold, and Yam. So many choices you really need to return many times to try them all.

You can get a totally guten-free meal if you wish. Lots of choices in craft beers.

We got our food pretty quickly in spite of the small restaurant being packed with happy  Friday night locals. This place is immensely popular and a true gathering spot. It's very near Boise State Stadium.

Sadly I want to love this place AND we live nearby. I've been here at least a few times and it sure has potential: great location, cute house, good products from other businesses to eat ( Renaud's), it is the only coffee shop around.....
So here's the problem: EXTREME slow service every time I have been there, sauce on pizza too many herbs, dressing on Caesar salad: bad, and the kicker: bad weak coffee all very expensive!  (Only coffee shop around).  Order espresso drinks only!  
Even the owners ( who seem nice and earnest) are in slow motion with customer service. 
Good luck cafe luna hopefully you will improve.

Very good beer selection, but....the food is very mediocre. Actually, for the price, the food is bad. Nice service though. 
The jambalaya was extremely salty. My wife's pasta looked like it was cooked last Wednesday. 
Overall - think TGI Friday's wth 150 beers and double-priced food.
Had the chicken basil dish.  The bok choice was awesome.  My wife had the squid vermicelli and that was even better.  Everything was grilled and delicious.  Highly recommend...

On a day when everything was going wrong, Cool Springs Lock & Key got it right! I had run out for a quick lunch and ended up locking my keys in my car before I got the chance to head back to work.  I felt panicked, but quickly remembered my mother-in-law recommending Cool Springs Lock & Key to someone else recently. I decided to give them a try and the service I received was exceptional! They were at my car within 10 minutes, and had my car opened within 2! That's no exaggeration! The method that they use causes much less damage to the car than the usual "coat-hanger-hook-and-hope". The man who assisted me was very pleasant as well. He was even able to take my credit card as payment right there. Very convenient service overall!  While I hope I don't have to, I wouldn't hesitate to turn to them again!

I wish I could give him six stars. This man is awesome. The lady that wrote he is rude must be delusional. 

I went to Stanley through a friend and he was amazing. He made sure I got exactly what I was looking for. He worked with me to make sure he delivered the best product possible at an unbelievable price. He beat all of the other jewelers by a substantial amount. 

My wife was extremely happy with the pieces he delivered and we have found our lifetime jeweler. 

I have referred a few friends to him and they have said the same thing. This is the guy you want to go with if your looking for quality, honesty and a great price.
Good prices and good selection at this outlet.  The quality and stylish clothes are worth shopping here for.

Fun, food, full of energy! I went crazy could not make up my mind where to eat!  Philly Steaks, Pork Sanwhiches, peking Ducks, cajun cuisine, best juices and smoothies!! Have mercy! I would come back each day for lunch for a month!! Try just about anything at Beck's Cajun Cafe. Amazing Creole and Canjun comfort food! The pork sandwich with provolone at Dinic's. Juices at Four Seasons juice bar! Hard to find a spot to sit but i am good walking and eating..helps getvready for next tasting!

Employees that go out of their way to make sure your experience is perfect is what makes a great restaurant. Amanda is always exceeding expectations and makes dining / drinking here an easy choice. She is quick witted but even quicker behind the bar when it comes to whipping up a Moscow Mule or one of the best Bloodys in town. Not only does Amanda go out of her way for us but she does so with anyone that I've seen her interact with. Writing this review makes me want to get a drink served by Amanda right meow. She also has every shade of lipstick and never repeats a choker. Thanks Amanda! Thanks Gaspars!

Grabbed the Irishman and Rocky Strong cheesecake to go and both were DELICIOUS!!! There's real Jameson in the Irishman frosting . The Rocky Strong was chocolate heaven. Glad to have this new establishment in our Safety Harbor neighborhood.

Gargantuan burgers served by a chubby waitress with a muffin top and an exposed butt crack.

Food is great but the visuals are not so great.

Went yesterday. Jerk chicken was BBQ chicken. Rice and peas were mashed clunky. Cabbage had ZERO seasoning. They don't have a menu. You have to read the faded chalkboard.   Lady in line behind me ordered a beef patty. Brought it back while I was still waiting and asked if they could microwave it because it was cold

This bagel are delicious I get a 2 onion bagels once a week from this Bagel Cafe. They staff is very efficient friendly and kindhearted towards the customers. Keep up the excellent work! God Bless You! Ms. Metrius

Been in multiple occasions, and we love Osteria! Plenty of space to move between tables unlike most of the restaurants in center city. Their Vegetable appetizer is great to begin with, grilled octopus is chewy yet soft. Tried three kinds of pizza, and all were good. Pasta with (squid? octopus?) black ink was flavorful but a little too salty for my taste. Other entrees were yummy too. Just watch out if you are driving. On my first visit in 2009, my friend parked her car right across the restaurant at 6pm, and when we came back at 7, one of the windows was gone(and so was her gps).

I had a bad experience with them about 10 days ago and wrote a 2-star review. 

They responded, telling me to come in and they would fix it and give me a gift card. 

I came yesterday and arrived 10 mins before they close (6:50) but the place was locked up with only one employee finishing another customer. A sign in the front said they take their last appointment at 6pm.

So today I got there at 5:50, right after work and NO ONE is there at all and the place is locked up. I tried to call but no answering machine. 

Bummer. I guess I have to deal with these horrible nails myself. I'm def not ever coming back. Such a rip-off and bad customer service.

Hurricane's is your hometown bar, plain and simple. Good beer, great staff, and good food. In my opinion it does not get much better than Hurricanes, I would gladly pick an evening here over some of the other choices. The inside has limited seating, however most evenings you can still find a table. Outside there is a small patio, which is a great way to spend an evening with friends. 

The food is good, my favorite place for wings, they are great. Be sure to check for the specials as they change out every day!
It's awesome when these guys set up shop on a nice weekend and you can eat their delicious & fresh oysters while sipping a crisp white.
Excellent barbershop. The Owner and his staff are fantastic. I highly recommend you checking them out!

This review is based on my experience so far which has been pretty great. When we went to go visit the apartments the staff at the front Desk were all really friendly and professional and when we decided to apply they were quick with responding with our welcome letter. Today we are moving in around 3 PM and I will update my review based on how the move and goes but I expect it to go smoothly. 

-----update 
The move in went smoothly and the apartment was clean and had great features as we saw in the apartment we viewed before moving in. I love the vintage 90s style of the cabinets,
Lighting, and kitchen :) very Tampa

Only go here if you are looking for a pair of timberland boots, or a $99 purple suit with white alligator shoes.  All the good stores are gone.  Can it even be considered a mall...Macys couldnt even make it there.
The pizza was delicious! Right off Louis Armstrong Park and it has a Ms. Pac-Man machine...full bar, fun decor. Definitely go there. The slices are huge!
Hands down the best food we had in New Orleans!! Everything was super fresh, and so extremely well seasoned and spiced that every bite was enjoyable! Can't wait to come back with my family!

I knew one of the drinks I must try while in NOLA was a Sazerac, so what better place to go than the Sazerac Bar. Located inside the beautiful Waldorf Astoria hotel, the bar is dark and elegant. Bartenders are sharply dressed, but impersonal and inattentive. 

I sat at the bar because I wanted to take in the full experience and enjoy watching the mixologist at work. It took forever to even get a menu. Each bartender had their "space" to mix, so the person taking your order could be mixing your drink on the opposite end of the bar which is what happened to me.

We also noticed other people around us getting bar snacks, but none for us. After watching several gin fizzes being made, I was tempted to order one, but since no one ever bothered to ask if we needed anything else, I just left. Two drinks, $27.

It looked like the table service was slightly better, but with overpriced drinks and subpar service, I don't plan on returning. There are too many other bars in NOLA to try out.

This is the blue ribbon loser for any McDonald's I've ever been too. No sense in ranting, I'm too stoned for that. Lets go with point form instead:

- Chronic understaffing, as if anyone would want to work there
- Long wait times even when not busy
- Quality of food is poor even for fast food
- Don't use the bathroom there unless you need a place to shoot heroin 
- Overall cleanliness varies, but is usually mediocre 
- I have observed numerous employees not following proper handwashing as mandated by law. 
- Believe it or not, the homeless addicts that frequent this location are some of the better behaved customers

Do yourself a favour and just go somewhere else if you have the munchies. If you absolutely have to have MacDonald's, roll an extra joint and smoke it on the way to the one over by United Cycle.

Dr. Rubin is very well-versed at chiropractic and he makes it part of his mission to also help educate people on how to be safe with a very important part of the human anatomy....the spine.  He teaches how to avoid injury or re-injury, and he is a proponent for healthy eating.
 I sustained a back injury while working in June of 2012  and Dr Rubin treated me. He regularly adjusted my back, gave me a back brace to wear on a daily basis,  gave me a tens unit, which is an electronic device that stimulates the muscles and facilitates healing.  He is adept at treating patients with a drug-free program and it is fantastic.  Part of the treatment was given on a horizontal massage machine, that also helps to release tension and aids in realigning the spine.  His bedside manner is very professional and leaves one at ease.  I am now enjoying life with a lot less pain after this treatment.    I highly recommend Dr Rubin.

I should also mention that Dr Rubin's Doctorate degree is a D.C. degree, which means that he is a Doctor of Chiropractic.  I must reiterate that he is far more knowledgable in regards to human health, than many general practitioners I have visited.

Came here for Dim Sum on a Friday morning. 

The good: Pan-fried turnip cake, egg tarts, steamed bbq pork buns and pork spareribs were good.

The bad: Lo Mei Fan wasn't very good and luck warm at best. Also luke warm were the rice wrapper rolls (we had an order of the bbq, beef, and chinese donut). The chinese donut inside the rice wrapper roll was also way too hard. 

Another unfortunate thing is that we arrived when they opened (10:30am) and by the time we were wrapping up (around an hour later), that's when more variety of dishes were finally coming out. So don't get there too early or you miss out on other classic dim sum dishes.
Best pizza in all of south jersey!!!  Pasta is amazing aswell! So happy they are up the street :)

Baker Brothers did a repipe on our two story home. Nearly the entire first floor ceiling and many living room walls were opened to access pipes to all the bathrooms and the kitchen. 
We planned to move to a hotel for the month with our two Siamese cats. Mike told us it wouldn't be necessary but we wanted to be comfortable. Silly us! After two nights we moved back home. The guys were so clean and organized that we hardly knew they were there. They managed to keep our bath and kitchen working all the time. 
Drywall and paint finished and you would never know they were there. 
I called Mike much later because of a strong odor in a guest bath. He told me to put Clorox down the drain!
I felt so dumb. LOL 
Love Baker Brothers!
