They had limited fabric samples and nothing bright and tropical as I had envisioned for the chair pads.  They helped me select something more to my liking online, and that's what we ordered.  Unfortunately, when they came in, they were less 'melon and pink' and more orange.  When I realized I could not live with that (after about 6 months) I asked for help to recover.  They gave me instructions on how to find fabric elsewhere that suited my purposes better and how to measure the amount needed.  I purchased the fabric and brought the chairs in for recovering.  We went on COVID lockdown, so I just picked them up (3 months later).  They look amazing!  And they did not even charge me for the recovering...saying they just want to make it right.  Also they said they have improved their selections of finishes and fabrics greatly since last year.  Love dealing with a store like this!

Recently had a disappointing visit to this Tampa restaurant. Started with the tackiest waitress I have ever encountered, and she continued till the end. My paella was only ok. I expected so much more from the Columbia. We have totally enjoyed the Sand Key restaurant in the past. For some reason, we only got 4 partial glasses of sangria from the "pitcher" we ordered. We never did see a pitcher. Mussels in appetizer were way too small. 1905 Salad was great as usual. Waitress forgot our request of a birthday candle in my sweethearts dessert. She took it upon herself to decide who paid what. When we told her that I was paying for sangria and appetizer trio, she commented that it was only a few dollars. I would not be surprised if our tips were not the smallest she gets. I am rarely tempted to leave no tip at all and I fought myself to leave more than she deserved, when normally I would have doubled the amount.
I absolutely love this location. The people here are sweet! It's very clean inside and the waiters do good of picking up all dirty places. I can't complain about a single thing.

Amazing face lift for the Grand Theater! We just saw Tom Segura there this past Saturday night, had great seats and really enjoyed the new layout!

I'd be fibbing if I said I wouldn't miss the table seating tho, I will, as I thought that was a great option for small groups. I only caught a glimpse of a cocktail server before she disappeared, and the only other downside to long rows of theater seating means getting up and walking in front of 15 people to get a drink, or having someone's booty at your eye level when they get up to get drinks!

Overall, good on the GSR for refreshing the whole building, inside and out! Counting the days until the revamped pool opens, and we always have a great time at the GSR, dining, gaming and relaxing!
I've had many Bobbie's over the years and I have never had this little turkey on the sandwich ... mostly stuffing.   The picture doesn't lie

Six days later my lashes are still fabulous! This is super important because other times I've gotten extensions (not here) they look wonky after a few days. 

I was greeted right away and instructed to wash my lashes using a product they had in the bathroom. My technician (wish I remembered her name!) was super sweet and easy to talk to. This is important since you're spending a lot of time with your eyes closed and chatting is all you can do. She was great because when I wanted to talk out of boredom she was happy to chat, but I also got to relax and she worked silently while I 'meditated' aka sort of dozed off. I kept joking that I was worried my lashes would look like a drag queen and she made sure that didn't happen! I love watching drag race but don't want to look like that!

The reason I docked a star is that my eyes were pretty red afterwards and that hasn't happened before. I wonder if the pads they put on my lower lashes were too close to my eye and caused irritation. It's all good now and I feel fabulous!
Very nice natural plants and birds/Lizards/bugs.  Easy trail and the dogs loved it.  Took awesome pics.
Service is very good, they are on top of it. Good prices for the all you can eat. Only bad thing is ive asked for the air to get turnd on with no luck. It gets stuffy in here.

Great spicy ramen. Just don't get the chicken ramen... that's what I got the first time and it took me a while to come back. it's almost like an ramen take on southern chicken noodle soup. No thanks. Other dishes are great!

I'm sorry to say that the quality of the General Tso's chicken has plummeted. In my first review I remembered being highly satisfied with the large chunks of what appeared to be all white-meat chicken that was lightly breaded and tender to bite into. The General Tso's from our past three orders have been a major disappointment. The chicken is over-breaded and not all white meat. In fact, some bites were so tough, they couldn't be cut with a  knife or chewed. 
  I truly hope something changes and they can go back to their winning recipe. If not, we will be on the lookout for a new place for Chinese takeout. 
  I must note that with the exception of the General Tso's chicken, the other items in our regular order have been enjoyable. They include old standbys like egg rolls, dumplings, chicken or pork lo-mein, Singapore noodles and possibly some others that I have failed to review.

The pizza here is definitely a 2 thumbs up kind of pizza. The bartender Dani was amazing, she was friendly and very knowledgeable about the restaurant and the menu.  We were in Philly for a Convention and the location is close. Can't wait to go back next time when we are  in the area.

SO GOOD. Wow!! I had the salted chocolate doughnut and it was an amazing experience. It's a bit pricey ($4-$5ish for one pastry) but it's worth the splurge for sure. The ultimate cheat day experience!! Or ultimate any day experience because it really is that good.

I have been taking my Schnorkie (Schnauzer Yorkie) here since his initial set of shots 3 years ago. During our first visit we met with the office manager who took us on a tour of the facility, we got to see the emergency room, treatment areas, xray lab and so on. It was very cool to see, and something I have not been able to experience at other vet offices. Any staff I have dealt with from the receptionist, to nurses to the actual vet are always friendly and helpful. I will admit, I have called in or shown up with some dumb questions and they always have answers. Ellerslie Pet Hospital makes you and your pet feel welcome and special - as evident in the personalized, handmade welcome card we received after our first visit. I will never go elsewhere and highly recommend this clinic.

If you're in Santa Barbara and looking for Indian food this is a spot to check out. Had the Tandoori Chicken and the Rogan Josh. The Rogan Josh is a lamb specialty curry cooked in traditional Kashmiri Sauce. The garlic Naan was also good.

A small gallery that features contemporary, edgy, often experimental work from local artists and beyond. This is also a social hot spot as various networking and party events are held here (and on the roof and patio). Admission is free, but donations are welcome. Latitude 53 is located right behind Metro Billiards and is totally worth a visit if you are into art, design, and local culture.
Looking for the best sandwich in Ardmore? Look no further. Try the "Outlaw"... yum.

They were out of seemingly all ingredients so we ordered what the kind woman recommended. Waited almost an hour and left empty handed after spending $30. Would recommend going to literally any other restaurant before stopping here.

Late night find that turned out to be extremely pleasant and delicious! The service was great, attentive and very honest with recommendations! The gumbo delicious and the sausage and rice dish was even better! Drinks were good too! Would highly recommend to anyone in NOLA!

We waited fifteen minutes for our table to be set. Then we got seated and every single thing took forever. Drinks: 20 mins. They also wouldn't let us sit to see the sunset. Only in the back area, because we weren't ordering a full dinner. Pretty disappointed overall. Not a 5 star experience.
The food is very tasty I've had pizza from all over, Blaze has the best pizza in New Orleans. The staff was friendly and the store was clean and I felt very comfortable

The ambiance of this place was great however the food was somewhat of a let down. The restaurant was very nice but when they brought me my food it was almost like a lunch Alea type of deal. I had the chicken gyro platter? The chicken was super dry and pretty rough with not much flavor to it- the pita itself kind of chewy. The portion sizes were decent but you really get what you pay for. When you put the whole sandwich together it wasn't bad but i don't think this restaurant would've my first choice. 

However, their white sauce and fries were amazing and super addicting!
Ordered two extra most bestest pizzas..Place going back to skimping on ingredients..if you order these type of pizzas, make sure to open box and check..pizzas low quality lately..

Fantastic authentic Vietnamese cuisine. My best friend growing up was from Saigon and I spent 3 weeks in Hanoi. I have had a lot of Vietnamese dishes and this place will not disappoint. Four of us ate and left happy!! Highly recommended.

I love, love, love this salon!  The staff treat you like you've been friends forever, they're friendly, accommodating, and genuinely super nice people. I've had a lot of facials at a lot of spas and salons, but the one I had from Jane was absolutely exceptional.  She knows her stuff and took the time to give thorough, knowledgeable explanations to my questions. She went above and beyond to make sure I was comfortable and that the experience actually exceeded my expectations.  The owner, Kim, is very hands on, and her efforts to run a top notch salon are obvious through all the little touches that she's incorporated throughout the different rooms. I love the "wall words" that evoke a sense of great energy and a create an ambiance that's warm and welcoming.  She's done a phenomenal job in building a professional business with a "down home" feel - truly a five star salon!

Straight out awesome! Very fun place to hang out at. I'm glad I was able to swing by during my stay up in SB this weekend. Very very enjoyable beers!  Everyone has to try the hoppy poppy and mosaic. Can't go wrong with anything there. Big shot out to Miguel!   Provided great service! And made sure our cups never stayed empty!  Oh yeah ask him to show off his art piece on the back of his calf. To the staff at fig mtn   thanks for a great time and can't wait to come back!

i could not find ANYONE to help me or single person to check me out and i was walking around for 20 minutes with no assistance and that is not okay. i couldn't even tell who was an employee because they were just standing around talking. and the store is like a maze. i might as well not make a purchase since i can't find anyone to check me out.

Been a while since I've left a review but this one star is warranted.

The level of service here was abysmal. I came in by myself and asked for a table for 1 - the good news is I was promptly seated at a table. The server was friendly enough but she was just buried with too many tables.

5 minutes to take my drink order (mind you, its a Diet Coke), another 2-3 to bring it by, and then another 5 minutes to come by and take my order.

I order the nachos with steak instead of cheese; she tells me they can do it (it only lists chicken as an option) but fails to tell me it's a $5 upcharge (vs $3 for the chicken).

20 minutes later my nachos come out (20 minutes for nachos...?) and the chips are burnt (oven), the steak is medium (cooked separately it appears, it was colder than the cheese on the nachos), and I finally get a refill on my soda.

Anyhow...I eat, the food is alright, but I was hungry and not about to wait on another order of nachos, especially since a table of 10 sat down just as my order was being brought out.

10 minutes after my food is done the server grabs my plate and I ask for a check and a piece of cheesecake to go...15 minutes later a guy brings my check by and says he's going to check on my cheesecake. I stick my card in the book and 6-7 minutes later my cheesecake appears, but no silverware to-go. Finally, the original server brings back my paid receipt and apologized. I nodded and told her it wasn't her fault, which I don't believe it was, but it's unbelievable how slow the service is, not to mention the lack of attention.

1 star for friendliness, they certainly weren't rude, but the -4 for sub-par food, slow service and not informing me about the difference in up-charge cost.

I'd avoid unless you're doing to-go or cheesecake only; there's a lot of great food in Reno and this isn't it!

I've been going to Affinity Eye Care for several years and I've always had a good experience.  As I've gotten older, and my eye health has become more complicated, they have stepped up to the challenge.  Dr. Mulgrew is patient and caring, and he really tries to give me the best sight possible for my own needs.  He knows every person is different, and handles each patient as such.  I'm grateful that I found them after many years of floating around to different practices.

Probably should get 3.5 starts, but no halves on Yelp . . . 

I've been here 3 times.  The first was for lunch about a year ago, and had one of their lunch specials (I think I had yellow curry).  I remember thinking that while the food was good, the portion size seemed small.  In retrospect, the portion size is what lunch should probably be for most folks, but not what I've become accustomed to with so many places now serving lunches that are 1,200 calories or more.

The second time was carry out, with spring rolls and pad thai.  Spring rolls were mediocre, but the pad thai was solid.

The most recent was last night, where I had some green bean special that was supposed to include prawns.  While there were two shrimp artfully placed on top of the green beans, basil, etc, that was it.  Not quite what I expected.  The other surprise was the ground beef that rounded out the dish.  While I actually enjoyed what I ordered, definitely not what I expected after reading the menu.  (Unfortunately, I didn't think to re-read the menu to see if I read it wrong, or if this truly was a surprise.)  My friend had the green curry, which was good.

So, overall, no wow factor, but I'll still go to this place occasionally.

I got my hair done by Mercades 2x now my fiancé gets his hair cut by Cody and I absolutely love this salon we have 100% found our home here everyone at caliber takes your hair health and integrity very seriously and always wants you to leave 100% happy with beautiful healthy hair
Not impressed. Their crawfish and shrimp with pasta was like a glob of bad mac and cheese. Not worth the time or money. Presentation and quality were high school cafeteria level.

The reviews I read on here share common threads with my visits.  Employees are NOT friendly.  Im pretty sure I recognize some as school bullies.  Pizza by the slice is thin, cheesy and cheap making it a good value.  Ordering their extra large pepperoni was a whopping $30 with a side of anchovies and tasted nothing like the single slice.  I had this order to go calling ahead of time because I did not enjoy my previous dining experiences.  Screaming kids in a room with tall vaulted ceilings make for poor acoustics.  The aluminum seats are too large for the metal tables.  The room was cold and the furniture was freezing.  I won't be back....not a good value....and employees are there to collect a check or doing community service.

This diner has character, this diner has very good food, this diners service staff are friendly and help when needed. Went for dinner and had breakfast, and everything ordered was delivered as expected and was hot and good. Home fries had a bit of crispness and scrapple was also crispy on the outside and creamy on the inside.
Croissant sandwich loaded with ham and cheese was enjoyed. 
 We will be back. Nice job!

Went for lunch during a local event. I really liked the fact that the flights had six glasses so you can try a number of their beers.  I'll rate the beers later, but first the food. My wife and I both had the Bella which was a portobella mushroom sandwich with sun-dried tomato jam and arugula on sourdough bread. It also came with fries. Very tasty sandwich. I loved the jam and the french fries were nice and crispy.  The service was really great. Nice bartenders.

The beers (my wife also had a flight so we shared:
Beach Day - Belgium Blonde - Very enjoyable and great on a hot day 
Funny Farm - Farmhouse - Least favorite, very little flavor
Land Down Under - Hoppy Saison - Nice example of a saison, but not sure why they called it a hoppy.
Huntingdon Drive - IPA - Good IPA but nothing special
Wrong Way - New England IPA - Very good IPA
Rye Bread - Rye IPA - My favorite of the bunch. It's one of the first rye beers I've had that really tasted like rye. 
Liquid Courage - Belgium Strong - Good
Tropic Thunder Coconut Chili Porter - Ok, didn't get much of the coconut, but the heat from the habaneros was nice. 
The Juice is Loose - Cask Imperial IPA - Really good. Very citrusy and tasty
Oatis - Oatmeal Stout - Good

Overall a very good place and would love to go back.

Came here twice so far, and I would definitely recommend to any sushi lover, OMAKASE! Definitely a must try for anybody willing to take on a challenge of eating different types of seafood. The selections are very fresh and prepared beautifully on a dish to where he chef can explain the different rolls he had prepared. The restaurant is always packed which let's you know they are doing something right! There are a lot of items I've yet to try, but definitely am pleased with what I've tried already. Staff is always attentive, as well as finding the chef coming to make sure everything is ok. Shogun has been around for years and is pretty much a staple in Metairie. Go try them out if you haven't yet!

Love the Sangria! They made it right in front of you. Service was also great, everyone there was corteus and friendly. Definitely seeing a touch of Spain in every corner of this place. Get the devil croquette too!

The Mann is one of my favorite outdoor venues in Philadelphia.  I attend a few concerts here each season.  I prefer this venue to the Dell East because it has partial covering in case of poor weather.  My last concert was Frankie Beverly & Maze & Patti Labelle.  The sound and lighting for the stage is great, no matter what seat you may have in the house.  I always try to sit half-way (near The sound board) - The costs for those seats range from $65-$90 - well worth it!!  When the Jumbo Screen is on - you can view that - but you can see the talent pretty good too.  If you can't swing those prices - check out the lawn seats - the acoustics are so good that you will still have a great time.

My tips are:  eat before you arrive - the food is expensive - you may want to get a snack while there - but keep it to that..LOL

If you arrive early enough - you can find on-street parking - now you may have to walk a block or two, but it will save you some money so you can buy a drink or two.
Cute! Nothing crazy or anything to rave about but something cute and different. Avocado pop was nice and creamy.
My food was not awesome at all.  Prices way to high for the quality served.  Not interested in going back.

Two stars because I was seen without an appointment, however the slots were open due to cancellations and now that I am home and can see my cut more closely I do not think I will return.  First of all, I asked for a layered bob and showed a picture.  And the girl cutting my hair (Julie?) at first gave me blunt bangs - something I specifically did not want.  I had to ask her to soften the edges and lightly layer around the face.  At the end of the day the cut is not even, where I have long strands that she missed, and it does not have the shape of the haircut that I asked for.  Once I trim up the long strands it is livable - but I don't think I will return to this salon.
Visited for the 1st time with my wife and had a great meal. Chicken was excellent, service was fast and priced reasonably.

After my second time I've gone here for business meal I'm convinced this is where I'm taking clients that like Thai food in the Tampa airport area.  The appetizers we ordered were all delicious although a bit pricey and everybody loved their food. I had the basil duck and it was absolutely delicious. Of course I'm a sucker for duck. I will be back.

Love this salon! I'm here once a week for a manicure. The nail techs are fabulous and I always love my nails. I find it pretty cheap too, $12 for a manicure! They give you a hot towel around your neck, massage your hands and then give you a neck/back massage while your nails are drying. 
Just a heads up though, you cannot use a card if u spend less that $20 and u cannot tip on the card. 
I highly recommend this salon.

Good breakfast choices, some of which are available later than normal break fast time.  I haven't tried much of the lunch fare other than the chili which I thought was very good.

Staff is friendly and accurate.

Great little Mexican place. Two wonderful salsas unlike any other red and green sauces I've ever tasted, both quite spicy, but delicious. The chicken on tostadas was very fresh, moist, and properly pulled, not just cut. Only draw back is street parking or the big lot next door, where you have to pay. Great spot. Great eats!

I will always visit Guadalajara Grill on a regular basis for their fresh table side salsa an the Pork Green Chile Verde Burrito. The Chile Verde is made with poblano chilies and tomatillos with large chunks of pork that can be cut with a fork, then some beans and cheese and oh my goodness. This dish is so good that when I first tried it I went on a quest to learn how to make it myself. 
I do love the booths in this establishment, and the large square bar with all the flat screen TV's surrounding it. Happy hour gives some great drink and appetizer specials that are very delicious. I love the Mini Chimichanga with shredded beef, you can get half chicken or even veggie filled bits of crispiness. Not to mention the Queso Fundito with chorizo and mushrooms(melted cheese served with tortillas). Go try it, you wont be dissapointed.

I'm a OCD clean freak, when I go places I pay attention about every little detail, people, employees, if the kitchen is clean, etc etc. 
This place is clean and modern and their food tastes very good. Will be coming here again.

Candy, candy everywhere...so let's all have a candy...Want to feel like you are five years old again? Visit Carol's Quality Sweets. Too bad this store isn't run by elfs; it would make it even more special than it is now :) Whatever your sweet tooth desires, Carol' Sweets got it. Everything from sour worms to giant lollipops is here. You can buy pre packed candy, and bulk candy. You can buy gum, belgian chocolates and altoids. There are literally hundreds of sinfully sweet treats here. If there is a child in your life whose birthday is coming up, make sure to come here and stock up. You will forever be a hero in this child's eyes. I've tried that, it works!
Carol's Sweets are a one stop shop for all your sweet needs.

Jose is a true professional!
I have a class A Florida mechanical/HVAC , Heat- ventilation- air-conditioning license. (Highest license available) 
This man knew his business inside and out, was prompt, clean and priced competitively. I highly recommend this man and this company.

Took my wife and daughter for a Mother's day lunch. Food and variety were great even for a vegan. Had a veggie wrap and asparagus leek potato soup.  

Service was good and price was reasonable for Doylestown. Pay at the counter and the food is brought to your table.  Will definitely return for another lunch.

Found this restaurant on Yelp looking for a Sushi restaurant for my sister in law's birthday.  Not only was the sushi fresh and amazing but the Thai Food and Hibachi were delicious as well!  So many great options to choose from.  Will be back to try more!
Ethan our waiter was very informative and helpful and provided top notch customer service.
5 star for this fantastic restaurant find!!  
Support local businesses.

First time here, and I must say. Very impressed with everything they had to offer.
The setting and decor was perfect. I admire how the lights are placed to present the food not harsh on the eye.
We were seated and greeted by Isaac our server. Top 5 server I've ever had. The man was on POINT! He knew everything about the menu and was very personable and not pushy or overbearing. He made excellent recommendations and again was on point!! Well spoken, confident and professional.
We both got soup to start, she lobster bisque and I had the gumbo. She enjoyed the bisque and the gumbo was perfect w the right amount of spice
we split the corn crab fritters.. again nice portions do tasty
I had the seafood platter. A little bit of everything. Scallops that melted in your mouth. Crab cakes to die for, vegetables we cooked correctly... again great dish 
She had the filet which was also cooked and prepared to perfection. 
While we were winding down we had obsoletely zero room for any kind of dessert. Which was a shame because he carrot cake looked AMAZING.
After mentioning this to Isaac. He put a piece in out bag to go on him. (Class act and good server) 
Anyway I do have to say we will be back because the seared tuna steak is in my future for sure! And if anyone does take this review into consideration 
You must ask for Isaac as your server, again tops!!!

Oh one last thing that I've seen in some reviews here. That people are putting dollar amounts in a review. People IF YOU HAVE to look or ask. Well you know the rest. It's Rittenhouse square people!!! Center city Philly!!! You pay for the best! Which is DEVONs 

Enjoy Philly!!!!

I have to start by saying overall the food is just not good.

However for a drink when it's nice outside  their outdoor seating is great. Definitely the best in dogtown.

Drinks are good. I have ordered a few items while having a drink or when I have gone for lunch and just generally disappointed.

Nachos tasted like they used velveeta. The flatbread seemed like they took a store bought flat piece of bread and threw some premade cheese and marinara, just not good.

If they improved the food this would be an amazing place.

The employees were really nice. The food rotates daily and they have multiple options. I appreciated the employee giving a sample of what was on the menu and I was overwhelmed with all the tasty options. It was my first time trying and I was impressed from start to finish. The serving size is plentiful. I had alot of left overs! I cant remember what I had exactly but none of the options will disappoint, I guarantee it. Also, be sure to order extra bread!

Came in on Saturday morning. Seated quickly. Nice variety on menu but went basic. Prompt friendly service. Lots of families and friends meeting up. If you looking for quiet not the place. It didnt bother me. Food was fresh and delicious. Coffee is great and served in big cup. Would dedinitely return. As the menu says, "Nothing fancy.." but definitely satisfying.

Our server, Stephen was busy with a group of regulars from the legion.  I had to raise my hand and call out Garso to get his attention to come hither.  I had the Tony Roma burger and fries.  Nothing to right home about. My friend had the  BBQ quarter chicken that she inhaled. 
Normally I would have ordered the ribs, but the price was insane.  Its ribs its not gold.

First visit but not my last... I had a hard time deciding what to try.  Sweet Potato Black Bean Burger sounded good as did the Greek falafel, loaded nacho tots, roasted winter veg flat bread and buffalo cauliflower bites.  So I ordered the buffalo cauliflower bites and a small loaded nacho tots.  Ummm portions were bigger than I expected so this was enough for two meals.  Delicious!  The buffalo cauliflower bites are so good!  Yum!  The tots are crisp on the outside and soft on the inside.  The jackfruit carnitas tastes like the real deal.  Butternut squash cheese sauce is really good and jalapeños keep it interesting.  I think less sauce plus some sriracha or salsa would've been a good tweak.  I will be back to try more great food.

The food was absolutely delicious! From food to drink to dessert - I loved it all. I will say some of the food was spicier than expected but still so good. The place was really cool but also had a laid back vibe. I would definitely go back in a heart beat.

I love learning about spirits, so when i found out it was apart of the Cajun Encounters tour, I was elated. We were there for about twenty minutes, but it was enough to draw me in. Conveniently located ten minutes from the French Quarter, Right underneath the 10 Highway, between Lafitte and Iberville. Candy led the tasting and I learned so much-about the spirits, Seven Three and the city of New Orleans. I cannot wait to get back to the city, as it'll be one of the first places i go.

I do not recommend going because they did not execute a gel manicure on natural nails neatly. I could have painted my nails better, but I wanted gel and didn't have the tools. There is a reason they are not busy, unfortunately their work is not good for people who KNOW GOOD NAIL SHOPS.

The menu is really limited in a way I was not prepared for. There were only a few options for chicken, fish, and beef dishes (no more than 5 or 6 for each protein). There were so many options I expected to see but didn't. (For example, if you wanted Cashew Chicken or Orange Chicken? You are out of luck.) There was a sizable Dim Sum menu, so if you are into that (I'm not) you will probably be happy.

My father ordered the beef and broccoli which he enjoyed. I was dismayed by my lack of choices (nothing seemed appealing) so I wound up just having a fried rice entree that I could have gotten anywhere. My rice was fine, but then I ate some chicken that had a strange raw taste to it. I think it was cooked through, but there was a strange flavor. Put me off the rest of it. 

Egg rolls were over-breaded and over cooked; light on the filling. Egg rolls should be light and crispy outside and chock full inside. 

This would normally be a 2-star review, but the service was prompt, friendly, and attentive so I gave it 3 stars.

Really nice upscale grocery with great bakery.   I don't live in the Lafayette area but enjoy browsing the store and seeing the various selection of items when I get the chance.  Being a person whose former working positions have been in customer service, I notice Fields employees have always been very friendly and busy with their jobs.  In produce, bags of miniature sweet potatoes were even available!  Everything always fresh and colorful.  Really nice for the residents living nearby to shop and a great place for people working in the area to have a place to get prepared hot food with a place to sit down to eat.   Good job, everyone !
Horrible service!  Diner type food that is just basic and NOT special!  Stay away from this place!

Greatest movie experience. Prices are great for the kind of service you receive. Actually cheaper than AMC or Regal. They have different drink specials every night. Order the coconut chicken tenders best thing on the menu. Chairs so comfortable.

Accommodated my need for appointment time easily and provided a clean car loaner so I didn't miss work. Timely completion of the work
No pressure for other work
Best pizza in Tampa Bay Area! I came here on the way to the Beach. It's truly a hidden gem!

The worst Domino's I've ever been to. I stopped ordering from this Domino's in Voorhees a few months ago.  They almost always do a really bad job.  It's like a South Asian pizza joint...poor customer service,  pizzas are put together very hurriedly without any attention to detail. It's all about quantity over quality. I've received a wrong order. Also,  during one of my visits, while I waited for my order,  one of their drivers put my order (with my name label on the box) in his bag and took it away to deliver to someone else  and I had to wait another 20- 25 mins for the order to be prepared again after another guy realized my order had disappeared. Ridiculous. Very poorly managed by very unprofessional inexperienced young people.

Very good Mexican restaurant with reasonably-priced dishes. Our server was very friendly and courteous. It's a cozy setting with only six or so tables on the main drag of Phoenixville. Parking lot is just around the corner, but not next to the restaurant per se--probably about a two-block walk. It's cash only, so bring your dough.

Things I like:
- Unapologeticly  New Orleans -- no dumbing down of flavors. 
- Adaptable for vegetarians
- A full cast of Abita beers available on tap and in bottle. They carry seasonals. 
-Good specials during Phillies games
-They've had Straub on tap in the past. This is a sign of very good judgment. 
-Breezy outdoor space with pretty, festive lighting.
-They threw a fun Mardi Gras party!

My pick: Truffled mushroom flatbread, one huricane, followed by two ice cold Jockamo drafts

My correction: A Sazerac is not a Manhattan with Sambuca.

Wow. Went in for a slice - they had 2 fresh whole pizzas and another tray with a couple of slices. I ordered a slice and of course was given a piece that was as hard as Melba toast crackers. Like it had been sitting out for hours. 5 minutes later someone goes and throws the other piece out - yeah , you think?! 6.25 for the worst piece of pizza I've ever had in my life. Don't go to this place.

Ugh. Just...don't do it. Don't. Don't let the FAKE chocolately aromas or adorable chalkboard signs lure you in. This place is a waste of your moneys. A real tourist trap. Grr.

We came on a quiet Sunday night for dessert, and after being ignored by the hostess for a good 5-10min we were seated at a wobbly table. The music was way too loud. We ordered hot chocolate and the peanut butter chocolate fudge sundae. I explicitly asked that the hot chocolate be brought out first so we could drink it before eating the ice cream. The server actually said to me "Um I don't know how we can time that, but okay.." ...really? Likeee, get your shit together.

So, as I probably could have predicted, the ice cream came out first. They merely said "oops". No offers to fix this. Fools. The ice cream was yummy but should've been half the price, honestly. Oh, he also spilled hot chocolate on our table when he finally gave it to us. Indifferently.

I was mad and disenchanted. My boyfriend got to listen to me on my soapbox, explaining to him the importance of customer service excellence. Suffice to say, I ain't comin' back.

Pros
Good coffee
Beignet, cranberry scone and breakfast sandwich all tasted amazing 
Beautiful decor 

Cons
Coffee Luke warm

When I informed the bearded twat of a waiter that I didn't receive the beignet I ordered, he just replied it was not on the order slip & walked away. He didn't even go check out what happened so I had to enquire myself.

I took my mom to have a refill since her usual salon was closed for cleaning. We waited about 30 min, no biggie COVID and all. But be aware they are rude. Or at the very least the guy that did my moms set was. My mom took a picture which was 2 nails pink, 2 nails glitter pink, 1 metallic. I guess it was very hard. Ask for short nails, nope, he will do what he wants. My mom decided to agree with what the tech wanted to do rather than getting into an argument. At the end the nails were rough, uneven, the paint job was horrible even after re painting them. Be aware they will not do simple requests as having different colors for diff. Nails. Or what length you prefer. Also the way he was handling my moms hands was rude. We will never return to this place.

Very yummy. And you get more than what you pay for. The portions are great here. Got the veggie plate (vegetarian friendly y'all!) and it more than filled me up. I saved the rest for dinner! I love the Farmer's Market location. Quick, easy, and priced well. I will definitely return for another delicious meal!
If you live in S. Tampa- go here! Don't waste your time at the boutiques in the mall. Anita is very talented and quick. There has never been a wait when I've gone.

Snow, our rescue Cockapoo had bladder stones recently. We took her to the ER and got a diagnosis after she was crying all night. The estimate we received was close to 4K total. 

I called Dr. Nuradim and he gave us a great rate on the surgery. He even came in on his day off to do it so she wouldn't be in pain any longer than necessary. The surgery went great and she came home in wonderful shape. Her pain management was completely appropriate and on target. There was no sluggishness or stomach upset from her medications.  

We took her back in a week to have her stitches out and even after surgery she immediately ran to Dr. Nuradim and started giving him kisses. (And she's stingy with kisses.) 

I couldn't recommend Lindsay and Dr. Nuradim any higher. They are wonderful resources for the rescue community and truly love their patients. I'll be forever grateful to them for saving our Snow.

Had a terrible time here, the salsa was chopped tomatoes with nothing else in it.  No peppers, no onions,no cilantro, very bland.  

  I ordered the fish tacos and after waiting over 45 minutes the waitress came over and told me that she had "forgotten to put in my order".    Great.  She apologized and offered me anything I wanted off the menu, but I really didn't care for anything.  

  The fish tacos were bland, with no flavor at all.  They were terrible, I really don't remember ever having such terrible food in my life.  This place had the worst mexican food I have ever tasted.  They tout that they are authentic mexican food, but that is NOT accurate.   I have been to many mexican food places with 'authentic' mexican food, and this place was not one of them.  

Ick.

Frogro is the most convenient grocery store for me to get to so I consistently come here to pick groceries up but if I had any other options I would go elsewhere. Everything is expensive and the quality does not make it worth it.

The aisles are diagonal for no apparent reasons and the aisles are disorganized. They also run out of things at more crowded times.

After a long day of moving, who wants to cook!!? I love local pizza places and would prefer them over any chain. Fresco was located the closest. They would've gotten 5 stars had they delivered :-( 
Between all of us, we ordered two large pizzas, one being a supreme. Also ordered a Philly calzone. Food was ready within the specified time frame and it was still hot when we brought it home. Everything tasted fresh and home made. Can't wait to eat there again!!

I haven't been here in about 4 years but according to their website not much has changed. 

Last time I was here was when they opened their newest ride at the time,Wahoo Run. A HUGE purple enclosed water tube ride where 6-8 people would fit in a single raft. I was 16 at the time and this ride would make me scream.

Coolers are permitted and there's plenty of places to grab a seat within the park. Best time to go would be mid-week, because Saturdays can get busy. Driving here can also be rough because Bush Gardens is directly across the street and traffic can be a little insane on the weekends.

I always found that we would set up a picnic table near the Everglides ride. Plenty of shade and room to spread out, also an entrance to the lazy-river was nearby. 

The only downside to the park is that yes, it's located in the lightning capital of the nation so expect the summer thunderstorms to sneak up on you. Arrive early and BRING SUNSCREEN. They sell sunscreen but I recall it being overpriced, and bring your own food too! The park does close down if thunder/lightning is in the area...but I have been there and the park usually reopens if the weather passes within a half hour. Good time to take a lunch break if this occurs.

Amazing atmosphere. As soon as you walk in you're blown away by the design of the place and greeted by a warm welcome. 

Food was amazing and price is very reasonable. 
They even have a kids menu which is great. 

My girlfriend and i had the egg fried rice, Mongolian beef, and the black bean mussels. Oh and it also came with appetizers which included two won tons, shrimp, amd 2 egg rolls... We killed it!!! Lots of flavor. Just enough food for the two of us. Although I think we went past our limits and over ate because it was so good. 

Definitely coming back!

I found myself in this gem and boy am I glad.  Their appetizers are amazing and the crab cake was melt on your mouth good.  Just speed in for cocktails and apps after shopping and will definitely return for a meal!

Sorry but this place needs a Good cleaning from top to bottom.  Everything is sticky chairs, tables, what ever you touch.  Saying that it turns you off as to the condition of the kitchen n food quality.  Sorry folks but soap n water are cheap so no need for this condition on any place that serves food.

The best ramen I've had so far in St. Louis Area! The noodle was great but the soup was even better. I really enjoyed the food and their service. A little bit pricy but totally worth it.
Overall, an amazing place for having ramen with friends.

We had a wonderful time here! I'm not sure what all the negative reviews are about. We had 5 in our group. We arrived 45min prior to the salt cave and enjoyed champagne in the tea room followed by a 45min private salt cave session. We then had 60min massages. Everyone in the group enjoyed the cave session and massage. The spa atmosphere was very relaxing. Yes, the bathroom is in main shop but it's close and doesn't really make a difference. Staff were courteous and professional and pricing is reasonable. This isn't a full day spa (with robes/showers) but it didn't matter to our group. We really enjoyed ourselves!

Just opened on Oracle, North of El Conquistador in the old Cuban restaurant space. Looks to be family run. They have a special Szechuan menu in addition to the usual American Chinese favorites. Food is good. Service a bit spotty, but this is only the first 

If you order off the Szechuan menu, you can request authentic preparation. On my 2nd visit, I ordered Ma Po Tofu 麻婆豆腐 with "mala" (spicy numbitaste. 

I came in on a Sunday and ordered 宫保鸡丁. I forgot to tell them I wanted the authentic style, so I was served Kung Pao Chicken.  It was stIll good. 

The Singapore Noodles are a favorite! Rice Noodles with shrimp, char-su pork, egg and vegetables with a rich curry spice

Tried the Chinese style Sweet and Sour Pork 糖醋里脊. Much tastier, not too sweet. 

Recommend the Beef Noodle Soup with house made noodles. Broth takes 15 hours to cook.

I usually love Round 1, and drove to Reno since our local locations in CA have been closed for over a year.  The cranes here are much, much harder then the bay area locations with zero floor help to assist or reset the games.  They also refused to accept any of my redemption cards won at any other Round 1 location even though I had spent over $300 at this location over the last three days.  For these reasons I am not sure I would recommend this location as I have seen what an exceptional store looks like, and this location fall far short of that.

To be fair, we were here during the middle of the week, so maybe their staffing hours are based around the weekends...

The food was alright. Nothing to go home & rave about. I had the breakfast biscuit with poached eggs. The biscuit was dry & the sauce on top was blah. The fried biscuit thing with the powered flower was eh. My boyfriend had the banana pancake thing and he seemed to enjoy it. I wouldn't eat here again though....

When we purchased our tour to check out the cemetary back in February of 2010, I was a little scared, but once we walked through it, it was pretty neat. There's a very interesting fact the tour guide mentioned was that people only got to be buried for 100 days or so and the body would have to be removed because New Orleans and below sea level which means they don't have enough space to bury people. Also there was a rumor that the pyramid there was reserved for Nicolas Cage. This is a very historical and interesting cemetary full of stories and great tales and architecture. Marie Laveau's grave is a definite touristy spot. I actually had my hand on it and made a wish and sure enough, my wish came true. I must return to give my thanks.

This is an update: I got a chip in my gel polish today. I know it's kinda petty, but tomorrow is my first day at my new office and I want to at least give the physical impression that I'm professional. 

I walked in and was seated right away. The woman who helped me remembered me from yesterday.  She fixed the chip in under 3 minutes and didn't even charge me. Now that's excellent customer service.

Always our favorite sushi place! Simple, clean, and great service! They are happy to customize our rolls if we ask and prepare any specialty items! We have been here several times and have never had a bad meal! Our favorites are the sashimi roll with extra tuna and the crazy Mexican! Delicious every time!

Their panoramic modem is complete crap. I live in a 2 bedroom apartment which isn't anything huge and I can't even get decent coverage. My bedroom is literally next to the living room and connection speeds are subpar to what they quote which is 100Mbps download.. I'm renting this modem from them for $10 a month which was supposedly best for overall coverage and it can't cover a room next to it well. I then tried to plug in my modem to my room to get better coverage but one problem... they only authorize one coax cable per household as what the customer service lady told me. During the call she told me that they have to send a tech out to change the coax cable connection to my room and would charge me $135 dollars in total, just to switch my coax connection to my room... I pay upwards of $70 a month and they can't even include free tech support which is atrocious.

I have Waste Pro Florida as my trash pickup. They have been randomly missing days for months. They did not pickup last Thursday. I called Friday and they assured me that they would pick it up Monday. They skipped Monday as well. I called again this morning and again they said they would pick it up today. Nope. I called at 4:30 and they said they were on their way. At 6:30 a guy in a pickup came and only took the garbage from my cans. I got a voice mail message saying that there were 30 bags of leaves and your contract only allows for 5 and for a charge of $50 they would get the rest. I have been doing yard work since last weekend and if they had picked up the bags last Thursday, there would not have been that many as I continued to add to the pile. I can't believe they have the gall to want to charge me for their lack of performance. Does this look like 30 bag?

50 minutes for a table. The first thing we're told as we sit is that their is an hour and a half maximum time policy for eating. Overpriced Mexican eggrolls that you could see freezer burn on. The only plus is the atmosphere, but everything else is mediocre

My kids have been with Dr Bean for 5 years. He is very professional, attentive to their needs, and always returns my calls. 

It is so nice to been at a practice where we see the same Dr and he remembers the names of the children.

Okay so pretty much everything about the experience was awful. Our food took and hour and a half and came out cold and this was the brunch restaurant we choose for a bachelorette weekend. Our server was amazing but the girl who refilled our mimosas had an attitude from actual hell. Also they ran out of champagne and rose for bottomless mimosas. There is no excuse for that, y'all are located in the French quarter of New Orleans & there is absolutely no way this is your first time serving bottomless mimosas on a busy weekend. Also like so unimpressed with the management staff, we deserved a much bigger apology. I have had fast food places recover better and more genuinely than this company. My least favorite food place we have visited on vacation due to AWFUL customer service. Do not pretend to be a high end restaurant and not recover the right way. Bringing bananas foster was like trying to put a bandaid on someone bleeding out. Like desert does not fix us sitting for that long waiting for food and paying for "bottomless" mimosas but being cut off. I definitely DO NOT RECOMMEND. Oops I said it and I will say it again on Yelp. Step your game up cause we all collectively (six of us) have never had a poorer dining experience. Hopefully the 400 + bucks you made off of us for cold food was worth it.  #sorryforthetruth also literally find a different brunch place unless you love paying 20 bucks (or more) for cold food.... biggest regret of my life was agreeing to go to this place. I just can't express enough how UNIMPRESSED I was. Also based on reviews we are not the only ones being served cold food.... like how are you guys still open. Food was about a 2
1/10 and I was STARVING (after sitting that long who would be) my server tried to take my cold food and I had to advice her that I was so hungry that I would rather eat it cold than wait another hour and half

Very good! I had the pulled pork. The portions aren't huge, so don't expect leftovers. The real winner was the huevos ranchos my mother in law ordered. I ate most of it, and she got real mad. Double bonus! My wife ordered the grits and it was also tasty. The bread pudding was just ok. 

Don't order a diet coke, they will serve you one of those tiny tiny cokes, that should read on the bottle "Please dont order soda anymore.".

Wasn't impressed. Got the nachos with brisket. Very bland and basically a head of lettuce and huge chunks of tomatoes. 
The chips tasted stale and very generic. Homemade chips would have made a world of a difference. 
Got one of each of the tacos. One again nothing special and once again way to much lettuce. Obviously using it as filler. 
Service, fail again. Ordered a side of guac and the person brought out the food and it wasn't there. I asked for it and she told me she could not give me any cause it wasn't on the ticket and then left. So now  waiting for my server. Couldn't the person who brought the food just go get it for me and then to our server?  Won't be returning. Wanted to try the doughnuts they had one with fruity pebbles on it, but the whole experience was ruined from everything else.

I've been to Hugo's many times, and I've always enjoyed their food. Since my childhood they've expanded this location to about twice the size of it's original iteration. It's a lot brighter than it once was inside, which for some is a bonus, but I preferred the sort of dimly lit "Cobby's" feel of the place. Here's what I like about them, in list form:

1. My favorite JoJo's in town. Salty, with bits of crispy/flaky coating. Unique flavor.
2. I always order the Italian on the french roll, it's always good. 
3. Ketchup with horseradish mixed in.
4. Unique fry-sauce
5. Decent fried Chicken

It may not be the cheapest deli in town, but I go there infrequently enough for it to not be a hindrance. Worth a quick trip for the JoJo's alone, in my opinion.

I love a build your own salad anytime! Choice offers plenty of options-no question about that. You can call orders in over the phone for easy pickup, you can dine in and take part in the chopping and mixing and matching of ingredients. It's fun! And quick and easy. Although, I do wish quality was little fresher. The choices are fairly basic when compared to salad bars in the  Bay Area. But when In a crunch, choice greens is a solid choice.

Terrene definition? mundane...
by Mr. Tasty 

Our first experience at Terrene was quite a disappointment. Even though the staff was friendly and accommodating enough, the interior had the feeling of a 60's Famous Barr in-store eatery. The outdoor patio was pleasant but was missing the calming sounds of a water feature.
We started with the small plate frites-hand cut fries. I believe the oil they were fried in was old as the fries were oil soaked through. The accompanying white cheddar ale sauce was a welcomed tasty dip for the frites.
Moving on to the big plates we ordered the hanger steak, the lamb pot roast and tofu tacos. We asked the waitress about the hanger steak as we unaware of this cut of beef. She told us this steak was located on the diaphragm of a steer. She said it was a flavorful and tender cut. My wife ordered it cooked medium well. The steak arrived but was tough and chewy-not at all flavorful and tender like the waitress had described. Upon returning home and a quick Google search we learned that a hanger steak can tough and chewy if not ordered rare to medium rare. Had we been informed of this my wife would have ordered medium rare. Needless to say, the hanger steak was a disappointment. If you order the hanger steak please heed our warning as the staff will not. The vegetables that came with her dish also came complete with stems.
I ordered the lamb pot roast. The lamb was perfect, tender, juicy and flavorful. However, they serve the meal in a bowl and the Yukon gold mashed potatoes quickly disappeared into a red wine lamb jus watery concoction. My baby turnips and carrots also came complete with stems.
My son's big plate was the tofu tacos.He thought the tacos were fine but enjoys Chipotle's version better and at half the cost.
The $5 bloody Mary's are fantastic. Spicy, strong and delicious! Methodically made.  Definitely worth a stop in for a brunch drink!

Great experience! Did a walk in appointment and only had to wait about 10 minutes! All workers were very friendly. Went in thinking I was having an allergic reaction, and they quickly realized it was something more. They diagnosed me, got me some medicine, and recommended further action. Very glad I came in. I had a great experience and would highly recommend.

Great service and very friendly. An employee named Jacob was really helpful in helping me diagnose what was wrong with my car. I really can't thank him enough, he probably saved me several thousand dollars compared to if I had let the problem go unsolved. Highly recommend this store for your auto parts needs.

Really tasty tacos, probably unlike anything you've had before.  The shell is so crispy that it doesn't seem like it's actually possible.  My favorite thing on the menu is the nachos, because the chips actually stay crispy until the last bite instead of getting soggy.

The atmosphere is completely laid back, which I really like.  You definitely see all kinds in this place, especially late at night.  Mema's is a lot of fun!

The gowns are stunning however this locations customer service was disappointing :( 
The sales reps convinced me to order a dress a size larger than the sample I tried on that fit me perfectly. The dress came and was exactly a size too large and the manager who assured me the size up was what I needed offered no help and sent me to transformations for adjustments. Transformations quote for alterations was over $550! They are wonderful people over at transformations and recommended I reach out to LaNeige for help. They were able to have the smaller size shipped to me (which fits absolutely perfect ) and all is well. I am so impressed with the gown and I feel like you should absolutely come here and explore their incredible selection. Just be cautious when you order! 
Cheers

Saw good reviews so wanted to try it out as I make it my mission to eat at a new pho spot at every city I travel to since I travel for work 90 percent of the year.  Whereas the pho served to me had a good flavor, it was served warm.  The bowl was cool to the touch and no steam coming from the broth.  That is not how you serve pho.

My husband and I booked massages as an early Valentine's present for ourselves.  He got the Swedish stone massage and I got the deep tissue stone massage.  His was more of a full body massage than mine, which focused more on my shoulders/back area.  I think this was because the therapist said I had "a lot to work through" back there.  Mine hurt at points but it wasn't anything I couldn't handle and the relief afterwards was wonderful.  The warm stones were very soothing and I really like the sound table.  

My husband enjoyed his massage but said he would likely go for a massage without the stones next time.  He said his massage was more of a relaxing type instead of a stress reliever.  

I really liked that they have online booking and accept gift cards from spa websites.  I was able to find a deal and we ended up getting a discount that covered the tip.  Can't beat that!  I definitely recommend trying them out, I think I want to try the Thai yoga massage next time.

On the spur of the moment, we decided to check out MMB on a Thursday evening and were glad we did. We're Woodbury residents, and we try to support local restaurants whenever possible. Things got off to a bit of a slow start as we sat without any acknowledgment by the wait staff for a few minutes, but things soon improved.

We were served bread and dried herbs for us to add oil from a small jug on the table -- not a bad start, but not a great one either. We shared the fried calamari appetizer, which was nicely deep fried and quite tender (not an easy task). It came with a tomato/sauteed pepper topping that complemented it very nicely. We also shared the pear, gorgonzola and walnut salad, which is a wonderful combination that MMB executed very nicely. It was large and the dressing was homemade. At this point I was full, but we still had entrees to come!

My husband had had the crab cakes, which he ordered on the strength of the recommendation of our server. (He had asked for her suggestions, and she had opinions to offer -- a very good thing!) Two decent-sized crabcakes (I would guess they were cooked on a flat top grill in butter) were served with a fresh tomato topping and on top of another sauce drizzled artfully on the plate. I had a couple of tastes and can say that it was a very good entree. It would have been excellent with just a bit more of the delicious drizzled sauce and with a small side of some sort served with them -- maybe a few sweet potato fries or some greens. It was a pricey entree that deserved a bit more punch. Overall, though it was quite nice.

I ordered the pappardelle entree which came in a nice portion and was quite delicious. I thoroughly enjoyed the meaty homemade tomato sauce, which included finely diced fresh vegetables. None of the flavors were overpowering, but they all worked together with the wide strips of pasta to make a memorable dish. I would have had enough left over to make two more modest meals, but my husband was obviously looking for a bit more to finish out his meal, so there went one of those meals. :-)  However, I am looking forward to having the last portion for lunch today!  

The decor felt upscale with a large touch of the family that the owner wants to invoke through the name of the restaurant (It's named after her late mother, Marlene.) and the use of many artfully arranged black and white family photos. All-in-all the staff and management of MMB is doing a good job, especially considering the  restaurant has been open only a scant month. I really want this place to survive and thrive. Woodbury seriously needs this kind of business, although I think calling it "a savior" is excessive. I would also like to see it make a success of itself for me;  I would like to eat here a few times a year for some time to come. Well done and welcome to the neighborhood, Marlene Mangia Bene.

Went here today with my boyfriend for lunch. We were literally the only people in the restaurant. Fortunately,  our waitress didn't hover and gave us our space. We got gyoza, chicken teriyaki bento box and salmon teriyaki bento box. As a white person from Connecticut, I thought the food was really good and can't wait to go back. My boyfriend, a Japanese man, didn't think the food was as good. He said he enjoyed everything but he said that there were plenty of other places to try.

This place used to be a Radison owned property and includED Sleep Number beds, they have since taken the SN beds out but for the most part, everything is still the same. The first time we stayed, our room over looked the pool and was quite quaint. This time, our room (3067) over looked the Cracker Barrel and two stories above the restaurant which hosted a very loud country band the room is not sound proof to say it lightly.

Pros: location, directly across the street from the Gaylord Resort and convention center.
Free parking
Almost $100 less per night (during the Christmas season, which is when I priced both places)
Several dining options onsite or within walking distance 
Shuttle bus

Cons: shuttle bus to the Gaylord only runs until 7:30 pm even on the weekends. 
The shuttle bus to downtown is $20 per person.
The noise level
Price is still steep, in my opinion.
Small children in the hot tub...I know that isn't the hotel's problem, I just hope that someone will read that part and refrain from allowing their children in the hot tub. 
Parking is hard to find after 8pm...on the weekends.
Excellent food and excellent service. This is one K highly recommended!  Pricing is right and a great value!  When you go say hi to Bella. The future in service!!  Enjoy

This place is delicious!!! You can really tell that everything is fresh. I had the lunch special with generals chicken, chow mein and fried rice and it was excellent! I would have liked the egg roll to be a little more crispy but other than that, I would highly recommend this place to anyone! Oh I also tried Boba tea for the first time and damn. I have been missing out!

This place is AMAZING!  
The Food. The People. The Staff ROCK soooooo Much!  My family and I come here regularly and we Love them here. 

It is DEFINITELY our GO TO place for breakfast and lunch!  
Reasonable prices and Large portions. 

Owners are super down to earth and we Seriously Love them Here. 

When we come here, it is like being HOME!  
you leave FULL and FEEL SOOOOOO LOVED!
Amazing food! Great vibes! Wonderful staff! Perk: as it was our first time here we got a half order of the loaded chips for free and they are to die for!!

Korea house has amazing food! This place is a hole in the wall with a wait out the door and down the sidewalk, but you understand why and will do it again once you take a single bite out of this food! Their Bulgogi is perfect for the not-so-adventurous and is just delicious!! Cheap for what you get. Always consistent, always yum, moves quickly.

Not the cleanest looking bathroom. They were understaffed and the guy was trying, but the bathroom was dusty and the shower looked half cleaned. They brought us extra towels that were not even dry yet.  They tried, but i've had better expeirences at other Marriotts.

After some cravings for Mexican food and the lazyness of not going all the way to Philadelphia, I've decided to try this restaurant that it is in the Walmart plaza close to home... bad decision.

The menu is very poor and the food doesn't have flavour at all. It is just like putting latin  ingredients together and just see what happens. The service is very friendly and respectful, but no way we can call it a "Mexican Restaurant".  There is nothing authentic in it.

The only good... the chips and salsa.

Plop!!!

Went there with my wife to try something new. The are where it is located is really nice! We felt as though we were in Europe because of the colors of the apartments, walkable streets and calmness of the area. 

The restaurant itself was pretty empty so we decided to sit outside to see the sunset. 

Service was excellent and food was on par!

My wife and I both agreed that we will return here for sure!

Your standards Rita's fare. I usually get the mango ice and others get gelato. The servers are usually very friendly and happy to provide samples to those who aren't sure what they might want. However, the seating outside leaves a lot to be desired -- only about 4 benches here. Not the best location for a summery outdoor treat.

I feel compelled to update my previous review based on the experience I had this past weekend which will definitely be my last.

A friend was in town and, on account of trying to find a mutual location, we thought we'd try Conshohocken Cafe again.  Our first experience was marred by awful canned potatoes, but the breakfast sandwiches we had weren't half bad.

This time I again went with a BEC sandwich, my wife got an order of french toast, and we split a bowl of fruit.  My BEC was just average this time and everything else was an abomination.  My wife's french toast had so much nutmeg, you couldn't eat more than two bites.  And I'm talking raw nutmeg, like it hadn't even been integrated in the cooking process, but rather sprinkled on top, ad nauseam (literally), after the fact.

Our bowl of fruit was simply bullshit.  Offensive.  A bowl (the large size compared to a cup of fruit which is the small size) was $5.50 I believe.  What we received was 2/3 of a cup of bruised, old fruit bits.  I wanted to ask the server if she had mistakenly brought the bowl to our table instead of throwing it in the trash.

Unfortunately, we had to pay for the slop they served not wanting to take time away from visiting an old friend to explain to the owner how shitty their food is.

I was excited to learn that the Tampa area had an H&M store. I've been a fan of the brand since visiting the Stockholm stores and make it a priority to stop by when I'm in the area. This Tampa location was conveniently located at a mall entrance but I found the store very cramped. I enjoyed the variety of items but was constantly bumped into by other customers and my purse knocked multiple items to the ground (that I tried to put back properly!). 

The employees were great and made this H&M stand apart from other locations around the world. Everyone I interacted with smiled and were glad to help, joking with me and being personable as they located an item or rang me up. 

If the store can expand or move their children's items to another part of the mall to provide a bit more room, it would be the perfect place to shop!

There's actually a Maloney's in Westwood, CA...and that place is shady! so i thought "oh no...if this is the same place"...well, it WAS the same place, BUT it was better. a LOT bigger too....it's actually a pretty spacious place so you're not elbowing around...they're pretty attentive...didn't have to sit at the table that long to get service...they have a couple of pool tables, so that's fun...music can be a BIT too loud @ times...very close to UofA...and the Marriott that we were staying @...taxis all around...and the crowd is cool...they're not all dicks or bitches or anything...actually pretty polite for being in a bar...and not all smelly or anything like other bars...had the most business compared to other bars...but then, it is summer...definately would go back

Ok, so I have been coming here since the first place opened (After it was Jack Willies fish camp). Always ordered Kettle 1 martinis, they were perfect and a decent pour. Today, after coming here for at least 10 years, we received martinis with the pour in the second photo. It was pathetic. Granted these are larger martini glasses, but this pour would not have filled even the smallest martini glass. Both the barmaid and the manager told us it was a proper pour and that they were getting in trouble for over pouring and someone even "was fired for overpouring". So, if trained bartenders are getting in trouble and even getting fired for "over-pouring", maybe they aren't over pouring and maybe the standard for the "correct pour" is wrong? This was one of most anemic martini I have ever had, and I won't be coming here for a martini anymore based on this pour. I should also mention that the barmaid did buy our drinks, just be fair.

Pretty good manicure and pedicure. They are fast as well.  I would recommend this place.  Spa pedicure and manicure run at $40 without tip which is cheap than most places in SB. Salon is across from McKinley park.

Went for Sunday brunch and Had the fried chicken and biscuits. I'm super picky about my biscuits and gravy and theirs was INCREDIBLE. You can tell it's made from scratch and oh my goodness so good. Tasted like my grandma was back there whipping it up in the kitchen. Portion was perfect with the biscuits we got before our meal. Service was good. Overall great experience and would definitely recommend.

My family and I have been with this practice for about 14 years. Generally good care from Drs Kim and Caracappa. But we are taking our family elsewhere since the staff is unfriendly, uncaring, have an attitude when you call and consistently unhelpful. I am healthy but recently I had a bout of bronchitis and tried to get an appointment but was told to wait until the next week. That was it for us since this a continuing pattern  of being given this bad responses from the front office staff. Also, Often we have to leave messages when calling and not being called back- despite real medical needs at times. I do not recommend this practice anymore.

Love these people... so welcoming and helpful to anyone that walks in the door.  Scene supporter in Nashville Skate scene forever and they do it right!  
Check em out and skate the park too -- it's so fun and air conditioned and top notch!

Really really disappointed. The stars are for the cool patios. The service was so subpar last night! I asked for separate tabs when we arrived....3 couples, some eating, some drinking, didn't think a 1/3 split was sensible. The waitress sent runners out with every bit of food and drink, never checking in if everything was ok. She stood over us less than assumptive to bring fresh cocktails to everyone at once. As the drinks that are dwindling if they would also like a refill. The food was just not good. Expensive and unimpressive. The sole was bland. The linguine and clams was in a cream sauce, the nachos looked weak. The salad was a bunch of warm witty mescaline greens on a plate with a bit of balsamic. After dinner, every single one of us was still hungry and had to ask for a menu for more food. We asked for some appetizers, and the waitress couldn't figure out whose tab to put the edamame and hummus on. I said "put them on mine", and she couldn't figure that much out!!!! Ugh! So someone else jumped in and said "we will just split in thirds". So one couple spent $100 for nachos and a few rounds of drinks. I say a few because the small rocks glasses the vodka tonic was served in practically had no room for booze! $6.50 for totally unimpressive cocktails. I knew this from the last experience so we stuck to beer and wine. 

For the price and the atmosphere, you really need to work on service, food, drink size and meal value, and the list goes on. Btw, food was like warm. But the molten lava cake looked great. 

Stick to happy hour apps and wine and beer. Everything else is poor.

I recently took my car in for service and became a fan. Even though I didn't purchase the car from this location they treated me as regular and made sure I was taken care of appropriately. I'm glad to be apart of the Acura family!

My husband and I stayed here for several days in April 2011. This is a redecorated classic early 1960s-ish motel a couple blocks north of the north end of State Street. Each room is decorated differently with colorful decals on the walls, colorful pillows and colorful plastic chairs. The overall effect is 1960s + Etsy hipster + Ikea. There is also a very nice sundeck above the parking lot, which I used and enjoyed. The staff is very friendly and free breakfast (coffee, tea, juice and DELICIOUS baked goods) is available in the tiny office every morning.  Nice sense of style, very affordable (I think we paid about $90 a night), within walking distance of State Street and away from how loud it can sometimes get (although you can still hear a lot of traffic noise, so bring earplugs). One thing we really appreciated was the book in the room with a list of recommendations for local bars, restaurants, etc. We checked out many of them and found every one worth visiting! 

Overall, I loved the vibe of this hotel. But the one area it was short on was comfort. Maybe it's because I'm over 45, but I really would have liked at least one comfy (non-plastic) chair, and a little table where we could have sat and eaten our breakfast would have made all the difference (had to eat on the bed). There weren't enough places to sit or surfaces to put things down in the room. It was just a *little* too spartan in that regard--but, that may be more a matter of my age than the hotel.

As a customer, nothing disturbs me more than poor service, especially when the bill is $120+ for 3 people.

My parents are down here visiting and we were looking for a nice place for dinner since we only see each other once or twice a year. Im young, but when I have a reservation and the host looks down his nose at me as if i dont belong that sets the tone for the rest of the night. The server I had tonight was short, interpreted both me and my parents while we were ordering, and took 45 minutes to get our appetizers. After our entree, it took 20 minutes to get our desserts.

The food was remarkable however. If the service was up to the foods level, this would be a 5 star easily

I went during the grand opening and a few  times after that, they have excellent customer service, unfortunately that's the best thing about this location, the restaurant is very clean and the workers are attentive to those dining in, the food is over priced and leaves you wanting more flavor, the fries are always good and their milkshakes are basic, nothing to write home about

Ambience is incredible. Food is just ok for the prices (and insanely salty). Some dishes better than others. I left thinking .. Why didn't I just go to Vernick? It's cost the same .. But was no where near as good. I think this place is a little inflated. Service was weird.

Second chances. I just finished breakfast here this morning and the wait staff, in particular Don, were simply outstanding.  The poached eggs were cooked with firm whites and creamy yolks spilling into a hollandaise sauce that turned my biscuit into a dream.  I had eaten here about five weeks-ago and the service-was so appalling and the food such a jumble we were completely turned off.  But they have worked through their wobbles and I encourage everyone to come back or come soon.

I'm shocked that I'm about to write this review because I'm the last person who would say: "Let's do some tacky, booze-filled tourist trap while we're in beautiful Nashville!" In fact, I didn't entertain the idea and secretly resented the idea before going on the trip for a bachelorette party, but here's the not-so-secret secret: I had a blast!

We had John B. and Jess C. as our guides/chaperones for this insanity, and they did everything in their power to make sure we had the absolute best hour and a half of our lives while biking intoxicated through the streets of Nashville. It was everything it sounds like and then some. Your cup was never empty, the music never stopped, your feet didn't stop pedaling, and the fun never ceased. We sang out hearts out to every song John played (and we requested) and had all of these incredibly entertaining moments captured by Jess.

While it may be hot and you may be biking for a good hour (you get a half hour break to continue drinking at the bar of your choice), the sweat your pouring and the pain your feeling is nothing compared to the booze-induced euphoria you're feeling with some of your best friends.

Very clean, which is the most important factor for me with nail salons.

Space is calm and well-kept. Great massage chairs and a wall of colors to choose from. 

Extensive menu of options and some nice (and pricier) all natural options. 

There's a delicious sushi place in the same shopping strip, which I've definitely enjoyed after.

Disclaimer: I am a carnivore.  My girlfriend and I were visiting Nashville when we came across this place.  She was immediately sold, while I had reservations.  I seriously could not believe anyone could make a vegetable sandwich as good as real fried chicken.  Boy was I wrong.  I ordered the "chicken" sandwich and it was freaking delicious.  To be honest, it might have been better than the real thing.  I'm not converting to veganism anytime soon, but I am seriously impressed and would come back again and again and again.

I'm visiting from out of town so I've only eaten here once (and it was takeout). I thought the pizza was a bit overrated. The topping are okay but the crust is nothing special and was soggy in the middle.

Customer service is bad at this location. When I walked in all three employees were talking to eachother and completely ignored me.

The lingerie here is meant for teenagers and young adults.

I can see why this restaurant is in the top 50 of new restaurants in America. The food was spot on and our server Laura was great. She knew about the various dishes on the menu and could also pronounce each dish correctly. The decor and atmosphere is also pristine.

I hope to come back before the season changes to enjoy their open air space.

First time here and we will definitely be coming back. The prices for the quality of the food are great. I had the veggie omelette. It's rare for me to find the perfect kind of omelette that I like, and theirs is perfect! Our waitress was very attentive, even with the full restaurant. I only gave four stars because I did not care too much for our seats right next to the bathroom. It's a nice restaurant and all I could see is the bathroom (which is a pet-peeve of mine) other than that, I highly recommend this place! If you haven't tried it yet, be sure to soon!
I had no great expectations when my wife and I came to Bich Nga, but found that this is one of the best Vietnamese restaurants in the Tampa Bay area!  Highly recommended.

They will win no awards for decor although everything was clean and well presented.  Service was a definite plus - cheerful, attentive and informative without being intrusive.  The menu is rather small, but the selections are quite imaginative.  The interesting salad choices are large enough to share and consistently excellent.  Entrees are reasonably priced, attractively plated and more than adequately portioned.  Best carbonara I've had outside of Rome.  My wife had the chicken with lemon and capers, and declared it terrific.  Don't pass up the garlic bread if your cholesterol count can handle it - crisp crust, silky soft texture, going with butter and loaded with garlic.

Average Italian restaurant.  Nothing wrong but nothing really special, different, unique or better than many other Italian restaurants.  Okay to go to once but would not really be excited about going back.

The po'boy I got was delicious! The cashier recommended it and I was not disappointed. Definitely a napkin destroyer!  the only issue I had was the fried okra- the breading was just a little too thick. I would return in a heartbeat!
