Wondering when this restaurant in going to open? The "Coming Soon!" sign has been up for a loooonnnnggg time.
Our delivery was left on the porch. There was no call nor voicemail nor email providing any update about the delivery or that it was left on the porch.

Yolanda and Yuko are great! The VIP membership is the BEST DEAL IN TOWN! The location is very simple, but they offer quality services in a comfortable atmosphere. I have recommended to my family and friends.

My wife and I were under the weather after a big night out in NOLA. Dr. Berenson came to our hotel room for IV therapy. He was fantastic! He was on time & talked us through the whole process. We both felt completely at ease with him. Besides making us both feel better, he was just the nicest guy you could meet. We will be recommending him to all our friends who visit & work in NOLA. If you're not feeling well from a hangover to the flew this is your guy! 
Thanks Doc & best of luck!
Beth & Mandy

Been toBroad Axe Tavern many times. This time the service was really slow particularly since the place was less than half full. Food was not up to the usual either. Had a group of seven that has been there numerous time with us. They felt the same way. Fortunately football was on to kill the time.

The only thing I order from Burger King lately are their breakfast croissant meals (usually with a coupon). This morning, after a visit to Home Depot, I gave this BK location a try. There were three or four cars ahead of me in the drive-thru but we moved along very quickly. I placed my order, and soon enough I was at the window. My food was piping hot, everything tasted great, and the woman helping me at the window was efficient and professional. No issues here.

I literally have dreams about the Build Your Own Taco I make with them prickly pear marg. My hubby and I did carry out and it was ready so fast! They put the majority of the ingredients on the tacos already but put the veggies and sauce on the side so they don't get soggy. Can't wait for all of this COVID 19 stuff to be over with so we can come for taco Tuesday!
This is the cleanest wing stop in town, amazing customer service. Manager came to my table and asked it everything was good? And it truly was an excellent experience. This is my go to wingstop.
Amazing. If you have not been here go NOW. I'm not even a fan of Sicilian pizza but this spot knows how to do it. The fermented dough makes all of a difference.
Got a French manicure today and it is gorgeous. Great price also ($15). My sister got a gel refill and was equally as happy. Friendly staff and fast service.
The most interesting patio in all of st louie. Good live music and super chill. The only downer is that its cash only and often a cover at the door. You have to go here on a nice day. Enjoy!

I came here during a bachelorette party early July, and although we were only here for a short time, it was time well spent.

I came here with 2 of my friends while we were waiting for the other remaining 8 girls to get ready and get their butts to broadway. While waiting for them though, we had ordered a blue mist mint hookah with a drink each. All 4 items came out to be about $25 each including tip which was a bit pricey, but it is what it is. The hookah was long lasting and had the perfect amount of smoke & no AC blocking my way (a major plus!!). 

The best hookah bar in Nashville in my opinion. Definitely recommend!

I love love love NOLA.... You name it, it's here. The food, people, atmosphere,  entertainment, and most important; a place to rest your head after the long long day of pleasure... I would recommend this place. Always good food,  folks,  an fun..
Great REI location. Excellent dressing rooms, clean and organized store, and lots of options for outdoor adventurers and travelers.

A little tired and maybe needing a little tighter management.  I'm a big Hilton guy, so I've been in them all.  Prefer ES, since you get more room and often times a decent breakfast.  Skip the breakfast here.... or get there earlier.  First, the room showed a bit of wear and the public areas were a bit worn.  Bed was comfy though.  
I made it to the FREE breakfast only to find egg pellets (aka scrambled eggs) that were super dry, cold sausage, cold potatoes.  9a and the buffet closed at 930.  The better solution would have been to direct us later folk to the omelette bar for made-to-order eggs and accompaniments.
I did get a steal through a company rate, but it doesn't excuse the conditions for the other folks paying full price.

This place had some delicious food. We had salad and lamb and both dishes were fantastic. The desert we ordered (chocolate cake) was presented well and it tasted even better. Their margaritas were good too, even though I am not a tequila or cocktail fan (I usually go with wine).
Overall, the food was pricey, but it was well worth it.

I came to Elements for a 90 minute Chakra Balancing Massage which was nice, but the massage was only about 60 minutes. I was in and out (paperwork, undressing, dressing) in 75 minutes flat. I told the receptionist and she offered to take $20 off, and was accommodating when I told her I was only willing to pay for a 60 minute massage, which was $40 less. It's a shame - I'm a generous tipper and the lack of time cut my tip in half.

Can I give less than zero?
Placed wrong item in my car. Deliberately.
Had to drive all way back to get the right one. An hour later still trying to get anyone to help me. Ended up returning item as I had no way of getting it to my destination. No one offered a store credit or possibly exchange for something else. No they kept pushing me to buy something with missing parts so I could buy the said missing parts too. Waited in the car 15 minutes as I had kids with me and can't just leave them while I waited on him to process return. Nothing. Schlep kids out of car into the cold and look for guy. Finally came to me with my return printed on labels. I go online to order similar item for $$delivery. 
Now I find they processed the return but not an immediate refund as their policy says would happen. So now I'm fighting to get my refund and can't...because I have no item to return as it shows...it was already returned. I know that but they didn't issue my credit or refund! 
I don't know how any business can hire a staff of complete idiots. Maybe they need to think more about customer service than using Uber to deliver food to them.

I absolutely love this place!  Everything I've had so far was delicious and the staff is always friendly.  I drive by every day on my way to work and I'm tempted to stop for breakfast often.  It's usually crowded, but there's comfy waiting on the party bus.

Wow! Had a couples massage with my beloved bride (her idea; brilliant woman, surprised she married me). The facility is beautiful, the staff is professional while also relaxed and inviting. The HydroLuxe water massage bed is an incredible precursor to the actual massage. Christie was my therapist, Lyndsey was my wife's, and they were both amazing. I highly recommend their services (in fact, I referred a friend this evening after our massage)!

5-Stars for the price we paid: ~$87 with fees. Free parking. Helpful & quick bellhop service. Well designed, spacious room. Comfortable beds & pillows. Clean bathroom, lightly scented soaps, and decent water pressure in the shower. Refrigerator was a good size. Desk & bedside lamps had an outlet & USB attached. Large television. Air conditioning was quiet & effective. Also, late night food was available in the casino. 
Cons: blackout curtains weren't entirely blackout and few television channels provided.
Great place, lots of variety. Worth a trip from out of town. Could have spent more time and more money. Will certainly go back
In the past I always hated going to get my haircut, after visiting Razzledazzle I can wait for my hair to grow back, thank you Robin Marie for a great time

Great lunch place! I had the half bahmi and the fantastic pumpkin soup, which lives up to the hype.  Beautiful indoor outdoor atmosphere, thanks to the atrium seating, and the attentive, congenial service will keep me coming back for more.

I love Wildflower! The pork is fabulous and last time I had the halibut special which was done really well. We sat outside this time and with the heater the temp was just right. Love their lavender honey drink thingy. Sweet, but different and yummy. 

The ambiance is quite loud at times since this restaurant seems to be the place people come with large groups. 

Service was attentive, almost over the top. If you want a good mean, come to Wildflower!

This was our first visit.  We will definitely return.   The food was truly scrumptious.  F.G.T.B.L.T.  OMG yasss!   Both entrees were fabulous and the side salad was so tasty and fresh!  Finished up w the strawberry shortcake...  Service was friendly and helpful!  Vibe was super cool.   Prices were very reasonable.   We will be back..SOON!
Had an arrangement that I bought online but the store was about to close.  Steven delivered it that night~!  Great customer service for my aunt and uncles anniversary gift.  THANK YOU GUYS!

Super disappointing experience all the way around. The ambience is more like a diner than a steakhouse. The drinks came out pretty quick as well as the chilled seafood platter. I've ordered the similar starter at almost every steakhouse I've ever been to and this one was easily the weakest in terms of presentation and quality especially for the price. The shrimp and oysters were ok but it's pretty hard to mess those up. 

It took a LONG time for our steaks to come out and when they did they were barely warm along with the side dishes. My sons ribeye was absolutely raw when it was supposed to be medium rare. 

When the server came by (and I had to ask him to stop and he was passing our table) I told him about the issues. He offered to "re-heat" the steak to which I declined. Mine was already borderline overcooked and slightly dry. Clearly our food has been sitting out for a long time after it was prepared and I wasn't going to wait another 30 for them to cook it all again. 

The manager came by and apologized and offer a free dessert. Really? I spend $500 on dinner for four that was completely underwhelming and all I'm going to get is some free ice cream? 

Another thing. Once I complained to the waiter, and I did very nicely, he was invisible the rest of the night! Like he knew his tip was going to suck so he cut us loose. BTW, I still tipped them just under 20%!

So, based an my experience I would DEFINITELY NOT recommend eating here! Diner like atmosphere, poorly prepared food and average service with a pretty high price tag.

Had a great date night here. They still have some work to do with the decorating, but it's coming along nicely. 

We were greeted with an amuse bouche that was tofu, edamame and a spicy sauce. It was a nice gesture, but it seemed more like a cheap way to say you offer that perk. It was cold tofu that was cut in small squares, a peeled soy bean and some sriracha sauce over the top. 

The meal escalated quickly from there. Next we had the tuna tartare as it had a perfectly poached (super creamy/runny yolk) egg over the top. We were looking for ways to mop up the leftover yolk when it was all said and done. 

The fish was great too. We had the usual nigiri: hamachi, maguro, sake. All were fresh and delicious. Then we had 2 of their special rolls, but can't remember the name and we were happy with them. 

Save room for dessert because you won't simply find the traditional green tea ice cream on the menu. You'll see their version or an apple turnover and fried bananas among the choices. Both were quite tasty!

The also had a decent sake menu. Not a ton of variety, but the had a few junmai's, a nigori, one daiginjo and maybe a nama too. They have a nicely priced smaller that will let you have a couple to enjoy

I visited with my family and the food was delicious. We loved the ambiance and the cozy atmosphere. Definitely a place where you can go and have a good time with your family. The only part that my family complained about was the small portions of fries and onion rings. However for the most part it was worth the drive from downtown Indianapolis to Carmel.

Fabulous place to take friends for drinks. The French 75 is a lovely cocktail gin lovers will like. They offer local beer but serve it frosted pint glasses (a no-no). The menu is scaled back from the downstairs St. Elmo's menu, but you can get the shrimp cocktail which is a must.

I had never been to a "blow dry" bar before.  Knowing that I wanted my hair to look amazing for my bridal shower, I decided to make an appt so I got that "just came out of the hair salon" look. Unfortunately, this was a very disappointing experience.  I was expecting a real blow out. One where they use a blow dryer to smooth out your hair in sections, giving it that perfectly smooth curl.  What I received was an attempt to dry my hair before hitting it with the curling iron. I even had to ask the girl halfway through the "blow out" if this is how it was going to look (because it was that bad and I started getting frightened).  Even when curled it was so bad my girl had to ask the owner/manger to step in to fix it.  
If you book an appt, please ask for someone experienced. I really think the main issue I had was I was left with a young, inexperienced girl who didn't know how to blow dry or curl hair properly. I can not vouch for anyone else's talent, so you will have to take a risk when booking.  I will also note that the owner/manager did do everything she could to make me feel better as I was fighting away tears and was very pleasant about the situation.  
All in all, i would not go back and trust to get my hair done here for any other special event.

What happened?

Was looking forward to a good pizza from Gallery on Thanksgiving Eve upon returning to Atco where I grew up.  What a disappointment! Shared a large mushroom/onion pizza.  The sauce was flavorless and sparse.  The mushrooms were canned (tasted like that at least).  Also, the crust was dry and tough.  

I'm hoping this pizza was a fluke because Gallery has always made a quality pizza.

I have been to this location for lunch on numerous occasions.  Do not attempt eating lunch here during the week unless you have at least a 2 hours lunch break.  Awful service!  I even emailed corporate to complain about a couple of bad experiences and they were not responsive.
Love it!  Family owed and ran.  Food is great and the servers are very attentive.  Surprised them with a large group for lunch and they didn't miss a beat.
The setting to get a full capacity and personal service is perfect! The staff are great! A great diner style breakfast after a night on Bourbon Street!

This was the first indoor golf facility I've ever seen.  I've since been to a number of them, but this one is still the best I'v seen.  Very friendly staff, fantastic environment and a very good time.  I took my two kids and 3 nieces and nephews and they all had a great time and want to come back again.  

The simulators were great, ran fast and had really good graphics.  They have a nice selection of clubs that all of us could use while we were there.  Fully recommend it.

This place is basically designed to put on your Snapchat and Instagram Story. Great place to take a girl on your first Hinge date after she notices you've put on 10 pounds since your last picture.
There's a library inside so you can look at all the books and pretend like you've read anything since  the Magic Tree House series. 
Drinks are bomb, but you'll have to take out a loan to pay it off. The bartenders are dressed like Andy Bernard on Easter Sunday. 
I had the flatbread it was honestly gas. Pretty cheap too. 
The only thing that wasn't great was the coffee. The 7 Eleven down the street was more fresh than this cup. 
Very nice staff. I'll be back to f up some crab cakes

Great place to eat in a casino, it's very friendly and open! My server, Austin, was very cheerful and prompt with our drinks! He also made sure we had refills and enough napkins, as well as fixing a wrong order. Great experience overall!

My boyfriend and I were visiting Philly for the weekend and went for dinner after reading the other great reviews. I have to start by saying that both the food and service were out of this world. We did the "leave it to us" option where the chef decides what to send out. Aside from the food being unbelievably delicious and unique, there was SO much food included in this option. Between the small plates, appetizers, pasta, entrees, and desserts, there were probably 12 dishes between the two of us and each one was better than the last. The gnocchi with pesto and corn was one of the most delicious things I've ever eaten. I was practically yelling to the entire restaurant about how fabulous it was. The Parker House rolls were also unforgettable. Every dish was flavorful and stood out in its own way. You can read the menu but the descriptions don't do it justice. Also, the staff was so attentive and friendly, they truly elevated the whole experience. I can't say enough good things, we left so full and satisfied and just HAPPY about the whole evening.
Great place, food, atmosphere and staff. Our server Katie was extremely helpful and pleasant, thank you. Will definitely be coming back.

We're LQ Elite members and stayed here on 9-20-17, using accumulated points for a free stay. Yay! There was some confusion at check in because there was no pet policy form to complete, but other than that little hiccup, the stay was fine.

Unfortunately I went there meeting a couple of friends and got there for my reservation and they said they would not be able to seat me until all of my friends were there. I told him I came early to get a cup of coffee on my own and they said because my reservation was for four they could not see me. Really? You just lost my business.

I cannot express enough how thankful I am for Circle City Pet Care.  Since day one of dropping off my dog I have been absolutely amazed with everything from the ease scheduling drop off and pick ups to the professionalism they show to the pet owners and the pets.  I know %100 my dog LOVES to visit Chris and Jose, and I never have to worry about her one bit.  Knowing that she's under the care of Chris and Jose really puts my mind at ease when I'm out of town. 
 
They simply are the best, my dog loves them and so do I.  I HIGHLY recommend Circle City Pet Care, you will not be disappointed!!

I was SO nervous leaving my 4-year-old bulldog for the FIRST time ever for a 4-day trip. I truly couldn't enjoy myself, but then I get pictures via text of my bulldog giving her lots of licks and getting her belly rubbed! After that, it was like I had finally had that first glass of wine-So Relaxed. I truly felt like I'd left LeeLoo with a close friend. Thank You, Erin, for giving me that PEACE OF MIND;)

This is a nice theater. I have always received good service while there and it has always been clean. 

It is overpriced like most theaters and they started doing reserved seating in their recliner theaters. It's more expensive per ticket and the movie you may want to see is only playing in that theater. It's terribly inconvenient when you don't want to pay more and everyone chose seats leaving only single seats available and you have a party of two.

It is also super busy, so don't show up 20 minutes before a weekend movie and expect to get tickets or good seats unless it's an older movie. I've resorted to paying more on fandango so I can make sure I have tickets.

Great place for healthy AND tasty food & drinks! Convenient for dining in or grabbing takeout after a workout. I got the lean n clean bowl with steak and it was a pretty large portion. The Rose Ave wellness drink was a sweet way to round out my meal :)

Got a gyro platter from the Flourtown farmer's market location. Holy crap was it amazing. There was a ton of food and it was all delicious.  I can't wait to eat at the restaurant. The greek salad is so fresh and delicious, I wish I had bought a whole container of it.  My girlfriend does NOT like potato salad, but she couldn't get enough of it from Caspian Grille. It's hard for me right now to not go back and get more food from them, even though I am completely full.

Lived in Wilmington pretty much all of my life, always loved cheesesteaks. Lived in Philadelphia for a while and got spoiled, it happens as a good cheesesteak is one of my favorite meals. Listen, this place is on point, meat is good. Onion and cheese is right. I don't get ketchup or other stuff, I want to taste the sandwich and this place comes through. If you're looking for a number, I'd say 7.9. Easily. This is in comparison to originals. I will say with the proper roll, which was a little soft. Needs a good outer crunch, but doughy inside, Olympic would easily conquer some of the "right over the bridge" places. I'm going 9.5. Yes, they're that good. I'f I were to open a shop, I'd hope it had their flavor. Great job guys! Got 5 stars from me.

Warning Warning Warning do not bother to eat here if you have a later reservation. I had read this in other reviews and thought it was not possible but we had an 8:15 reservation and there was literally nothing left to be served on the menu including all the pizza options what? How is that ok? What exactly were we going to eat once we were seated?If this is how you need to operate then don't take the reservation. I kept my end of the deal and showed up on time to be told no food left? I just don't get that as a business model. So disappointing. Also was told the reason is the pizza dough takes three days to make. Which I can appreciate but three days ago this restaurant knew I had an 8:15 reservation and their menu is 75% pizza so again what exactly were we going to eat?
Cute breakfast place in Montecito. Loved the Kahlua Banana French Toast!

I usually come here for the Italian beef but the pizza is a must as well. Back to the beef though. Big, juicy, tender. I love this sandwich so, so much. The employee's have always been incredibly helpful and friendly. The owner is a somewhat...hrm, intense Chicagoan but I kinda like him! Sometimes the best owners are...intense.

If I could give zero stars I would. I ordered a salad and after 15 minutes it finally appeared in the window but it took an additional five minutes for one of the four front line workers to retrieve it and then it took at least another 30 seconds for her to ask "Sonoma salad". Of course it didn't have the grilled chicken I had paid extra for. They had one cash register, four front line workers and two back line workers. It was horrible service for an airport where Everyone is in a hurry.

Been eating here for two decades.  You got to love the debris poor boy, at an even ten dollars, is made from the pan drippings.  It could cave in the heart of a young pony.  Wash this down with the local root beer and put it over the cliff with the bread pudding.  The breakfast is also amaze balls: the best baked ham on the planet with eggs and fluffy grits.
Great service. Very attentive staff helped me find a great pair of shoes. Better than expected. Great price on 2015 Nike Air Max.

Had great service and good prices ! Authentic Sonoran Mexican food.
Great Margaritas!

The food was delicious
The service impeccable
And the empathy for evacuees from hurricane Irma was heartfelt and so warm
New Orleans was so welcoming to us

so we came to New Orleans on a girls trip from Long Island. we had brunch at the vampire cafe. we had a great time. Ambiance was very authentic. Food was amazing, bottomless mimosa. But the best part was our server Richard   He was incredible. Super personable and attentive. He gave us great advice on where to go and what to see.  he made a great impression and makes us want to come back. Thank you Richard we already miss you!!!

It beats the chain Chinese places... The waiter took forever to take our order and to bring it out... There were tables where customers had eaten at and they didn't clean it up yet.. The food was ok good, but not OMG good... We may go back, but probably not.. We will be at Yummy House.. Mmmm
Best homemade ice cream uptown, I just hate that they only take cash.  The Cookie Monster is my personal favorite!

Service was great. Beer was good. The only complaint is that I ordered the NY steak sandwich rare-med rare. It came out dry and Plain. Hopefully in the near future it turns out better. The calamari was great.

We came for the brews and a movie and thoroughly enjoyed Great Grizzly's beautiful patio! The staff was so friendly and attentive, and the beer options are plentiful. I didn't try the fall apple cider cocktail but it honestly looked delicious. As another reviewer mentioned, this is definitely a great spot to watch any sporting event. The food was good, I wish the pretzel came with beer cheese instead of the mustard, but I'm excited to come back and try their other offerings!

This is a great place to get unique and delicious cheeses.  I really like their sandwiches, especially grilled.  The sandwiches are pre-made (that day) and they only have a set number of them, so just be aware that they do run out.

Not my favorite Ethiopian restaurant in the area (I'm partial to Kaffa Crossing), but very different atmosphere than most. Super cheap pitchers, lots of loud music, and great service, even on a packed Friday night. My date really enjoyed the Ethiopian cheese steak - I thought the veggie platter was pretty good, but not spectacular. I hear it's a good place to dance, but I've never stayed long enough to check it out.

Very chill brewery. Large, spacious establishment. The beers were very good. My friends and I shared two flights. $9.00 for each! Super friendly staff. Bathrooms were poppin' too with a legit baby station. ;)

What a wonderful find!  The signs were a little misleading and it was initially hard to find - seems like the neighbors don't like all the butterfly admirers which flock to this area during mating season.  There are lots of butterflies fluttering about, and it really is a unique experience.  The sky got a little dark as they flew overhead and blocked the skylight, and it was  magical to see them hanging and creating clusters on the eucalyptus trees.  It was my first time going to a butterfly preserve, and so glad we were able to see them on their migratory journey. Peak times to see the Monarch butterfly range from December through February; though they begin arriving as early as October and are usually gone by the end of March.

Ask for "RED" he is awesome and treated  my spouse and I very well. We went in thinking it would be the same ol same dealership but he made us seee that people can make a difference in companies. Thank you Red for all you help we are loving our new car!

I'd give 10 stars if I could! My old man cat had dental surgery recently and he stopped eating, drinking, lost a significant amount of weight and barely had the strength to stand up. Cats can't go very long without eating and few vets are open on a Saturday night. I brought him here and I'm glad I did.

The techs were very sweet to Frank, even though he was pretty vocal about how bad he felt. Dr Toll-Schacter was just amazing! As I've spent an insane amount of money on vet bills recently, I'm pretty maxed financially. Rather than insisting on a hospital stay and a battery of tests that I just can't afford right now, we worked together to come up with a plan that wouldn't require me to take out a loan. A solid, logical, cover the important stuff plan.

The test results suggested an infection, so she prescribed appropriate medications and sent me home with everything I needed to take care of my cat. As he's dehydrated and I'm an experienced rescuer who is comfortable with giving injections, the vet tech showed me how to administer fluids at home. That's just amazing! Way above and beyond what I expected.

Frank is already starting to feel better and is starting to eat the food he was prescribed, without the need for syringe feeding. He yelled at me when he wanted me to get out of his chair so he could lay down. This is progress! This is my old man!

They could have manipulated me into paying thousands. This situation was potentially serious enough that I would have done it. Instead, they worked with my engineer logic, diagnosed my cat and apparently it's an accurate diagnosis because he's getting back to his grouchy old man self.

I've always loved Bertucci's Pizza. We went to the restaurant in Sicklerville. Drinks, rolls and our order were taken quickly. Something happened in the back after that because it took a really long time to get our order. So long that the waitress came and apologized multiple times. We weren't in a hurry, but kind of annoyed nonetheless, but just tossed it up to "stuff happens." Our food came. It was quite good. The bill came. The manager came, apologized profusely and then proceeded to comp the whole meal.

We'll be back.

Just moved back to Clearwater. Needed to find a really good hair stylist. Marlo Stone was very accommodating and provided a fantastic experience plus had a phenomenal haircut at the end plus the shampoo was practically a spa service!! Highly recommended!!
Great service and decent bar, food is mediocre at best.

I got the chile relleno burrito and it was delicious. we ate outside and the tables were spread apart, so it felt safe. people wore masks for the most of it and the area was clean. I felt comfortable eating there during this time.

I'm so happy to write this review because I was nearly hit by a car while walking across the street to pick up order -- ha! 

The last meal I had in Philly before the pandemic was a great one at Serpico, so I was over the moon to discover Pete's Place. My boyfriend and I ordered the bibimbap with marinated ground pork, chicken ramen, and soft tofu stew for his birthday meal. 

The bibimbap had fresh flavors, but was not particularly memorable. The braised pork belly in the tofu stew was great, but the soup was not especially flavorful. 

But the chicken ramen? Outstanding. I would buy a bucket of that broth if it were sold in grocery stores!

So four stars and much gratitude from me. Even some parts of some dishes were lackluster, my partner and I really appreciated this meal overall and would definitely visiting before Serpico comes back and Pete's Place possibly disappears forever!

I called in an order since I was staying at a nearby hotel. The food was ready promptly, all at appropriate temperatures and all quite delicious. As is the american custom, there was far more food than one human could ever hope to consume in one sitting, so I recommend ordering less than you think you might need. I had the burger with the pepper bacon, crisp fries and some of the boneless wings. All better than average, none super phenomenal.

We went fot the seafood market and not the restaurant although the food that was being served looked fantastic!  They only had a relatively small case but a fairly generous selection of frozen fish and shellfish.   The prices were exceptionally reasonable and the quality was excellent.  The gentleman who waited on us was knowledgeable,  friendly, and shared useful information about the origin and quality of the seafood.  It was well worth the drive from the Valley and is now my #1 place to go for seafood.

If you are looking for a great espresso, with an atmosphere that invites relaxing, reading a book, or a quiet conversation with friends look no further.  The desserts are lovely but I love the pear and prosciutto panini.  My friends had a grilled peanut butter and jelly and the pistachio toast and they both thought they were excellent.

Hello history!  This recently renovated establishment beautifully mixed history and technology to create an informative and fun experience.  The interactive exhibits mixed with vintage decor provided the perfect experience for the guests to experience the product history and current offerings.  Samples were also provided throughout the self-guided tour.
The people working here were also surprisingly and abundantly friendly and helpful!
Of course, being a free activity, the hope is that you're so enamored that you freely spend in the gift shop - which most people seemed to willingly do.  
It should be noted that the distillery offers not only Sazarec, but also a variety of rums, spirits and bitters for tasting and for purchase.  There's a little something for everyone.
I went for Karaoke with Friends. Room was spacious but the Karaoke system is very confusing and hard to use. Food was below average...

I've been in Warminster for two years and this is by far the best pizza in the area. However, they could use a good lesson in customer experience. Also, this is the first review I've ever written on any establishment. Again, great pizza, not so great customer experience for me.

The grooming is fantastic and love her work, however, the customer service is what ultimately guided my decision to quit using this business. Customers cannot be expected to adjust their schedules at the drop of a hat! I did try and cooperate with the owner, though in the end it didn't matter because it wasn't exactly on her terms, i.e., I could not provide her an answer to her scheduling request on the spot.

The issue escalated in such a manner that my husband and I agreed that we could no longer do business with someone who handles their client interactions in such a surly, reckless manner.

This staff was great. They did emergency surgery on my puppy and he came out well. Also, they helped find funding to help pay large vet bill. The doctor spent sufficient time with us and him. The staff at the front desk was polite and the vet technicians were also kind and understanding of out stress.

My husband, and I ate there last night, we got there a little early to beat the rush.  There were two other tables in the main dining room when the hostess sat us.  The owner took our drink order, and then the waiter came by promptly to take our food order. I ordered the cheesesteak with fries, and my husband ordered the ruben with fries as well.  We waited almost an hour for two sandwiches, and the other two tables before us waited longer than us since they were there before us, and received their food right about when we did. I was hoping for a little more of a face lift of the place, they put some paint on the walls, still the same dated entrance, carpet, tables, and chairs.  I was really hoping for this place to be great, but was pretty disappointed.

I liked the food so well that I decided to place another order. Well, I spoke to fast. I  ordered the wings again and those onion rings I heard so much about. The man asked if I wanted the bone in or out, I said bone in. After the delivery man left, I opened the bag only to find Boneless wings and very greasy over cooked onion rings, I called to let the know they sent me the wrong wings. The same man that took my order told me that the kitchen was now closed. After spending close to 15.00 I am not pleased.

Just came from this place to get some macarons for my daughter. Don't get me wrong, the macarons were absolutely delicious but the lady working there was just horrible. I don't know but I'm all about good customer service and if you don't greet me when I walk in, that's strike one.  She was basically rushing me when I was picking out my order. I technically wasn't even finished and she said something that was basically TELLING me I was done.  Even though she was rude, I would go there again because those macarons were delicious!

If you like chicken salad, this is the place to go... I have been there a few times and have tried a different chicken salad each time ad thy have all been delicious. If you want to taste test what you want before you order, the servers will give you a sample. They have a few different things for those who don't eat chicken salad and their soups and side dishes are awesome too! You order at the counter and the give you a number and bring your order o the table. I don't know if they do it during their busier hours but I have generally visited a little bit after lunch rush and their staff always comes to the table to ask if we need anything. The personal attention is an added bonus to a place that is already a new favorite.

Absolutely the best sushi in town!  They also have a place in Malvern, called Mino's.  And it's so good, they've now opened this place in Chester Springs.  Being 15 minutes closer to home, this will be our new spot.  BYOB, awesome service, and the best sushi around.

We'll be back next month, and the month after that....

Lit AF. The BEST Indian food in town. No other place compares. Plus they play FIRE  Indian trap music for your enjoyment. AMAZINGGGG 
Had the chicken tikka and my girl had lamb curry. We are happy.

This location just recently opened- so I'm sure they'll only get better. 
The beef tacos are excellent, though they haven't mastered the chicken tacos- they are severed with chunks of chicken rather than shredded chicken which is what the other Jimboy's Tacos in town serve. I'm hoping they change it to the shredded because that's my all time favorite! 
All in all not bad! Service was fine and tacos were good.

Our favorite restaurant In Philadelphia with wonderful selections of pizza and seasonal specialties. Chef Marcie Turney creates wonderful delicious masterpieces from the todie-for stuffed meatballs to artisanal pizzas.  Fantastic.  And we just had Lemon Olive Oil Gelato which absolutely blew us away with the texture and flavor.  No wonder why it's one of the hardest places to get reservations in the city. Plan early and get your reservations now.  And New Years is a special treat. Get your reservations early.  Worth every dollar spent. 

Back again to try the Sanguinello and Basil Lemonade. Heaven Perfectly blended. The Cacia e Pepe Arancini are wonderful stuffed risotto balls with mozzarella, corn and a Smokey black garlic come with shaved Parmesan and just a slight bit of lemon zest to make it fabulous. Peach Crostone was a treat of heavenly bliss. Fresh sweet peaches blend perfectly with mint and a zing of jalapeño over whipped ricotta with a touch of honey. A wonderful summer treat. The popular favorite the Caciocavallo Stuffed Meatballs don't disappoint. I couldn't even get both in the picture they went so fast. Pizza with wonderful combinations are usually the highlight of a light dinner. We tried the Fiore  di Zucca with local squash blossoms touch of mint, buffalo mozzarella, just a heavenly bit of roasted zucchini, pine nuts garlic and prosciutto di Parma. Amazing combination served on a wonderful thin crust cooked in a wood fire stove. And top off you evening with the perfect dessert Bundino. The perfect blend of salt sweet caramel soft fluffy goodness that you just can't stop eating. 

If you are lucky you can watch your pizza being made in the open kitchen. 

Congrats to Chef Mike for keeping this legacy growing and creating wonderful food and perfect experience. 

Okay back again and now a new favorite. Grilled chicken. Beautifully grilled in and exquisitely subtle sauce with polenta, squash and a little zing of mint. Your palate floated from flavor to flavor. Love it.

Full disclosure:  I'm a native Houstonian. Houston has a Mexican restaurant on every corner. I've eaten a huge variety of Tex-Mex so keep that in mind as you read this review. 

We decided to go to Tito's Mexican Restaurant one day simply based upon location. We needed a quick lunch but didn't want fast food.  We came here based solely upon a word-of-mouth recommendation. 

The restaurant was fairly busy post-COVID.  We were able to get a table for five fairly quickly.  They brought us our chips/salsa almost immediately. Then, there was a long lull before someone took our drink order. By the time we ordered drinks, we were ready to order food so we did it all together. 

The one question most people will ask about a Mexican restaurant is, "How good are their fajitas?"  Since I had not been here before, that is what I decided to order. As I mentioned earlier, I have eaten a lot of Mexican food and their fajitas were not that good. First of all, they were cut into very thin strips of meat. Almost like shoestring fajitas vs slices of meat. Since they were cut so thinly, they were also overdone. In my opinion, fajitas should be sliced thicker and cooked medium. These were definitely overdone. They did come with grilled onions (that's normal). However, it seemed like the meat and onions were cooked together on a frying grill. The best fajitas are cooked on an open flame and the onions are grilled separately. Anyway, that's enough about the fajitas but I'd give them 2-stars. 

My family members ordered other various  menu item. I snuck a bite of my son's quesadilla as well as my wife's chicken enchilada with verde sauce. The enchiladas that she ordered were pretty good and plentiful. If you aren't starving or if you are trying to cut back, you could split the enchiladas.  I do recommend them. 4-stars on the chicken enchiladas. 

Bottom line - Tex-Mex restaurant with decent food but sub-par fajitas. Good service and a quick in/out for lunch. Due to the lack of really good Mexican restaurants in Franklin, I'll give them 3-stars overall. Bon appétit, y'all.

yeah, this could easily be one of my new fav restaurants in the city.  great food, great staff, great tap list, great digs... a wonderful night.  ate on the new patio, which was PERFECT for a night like tonight.  weather was nice and the shade from the pergola vines was great.  loved it.   started with pickles (peanut butter was super), anchovy and fresh mozzarella (tomatoes were the hit of the dish), and pate plate (i don't like liver but MAN this was good).  had pomme frites-- yeah, those were good; the mustard was very good with fries.  tried the tongue; i psyched myself out of it but it was very good and the celery whip was great.  had lamb burger for husband and the fish special for me.  loved the fish and roasted veggies.  the roasted kale was my favorite.  we tried dessert--ordered the lemon curd and the tres leches.  lemon curd was great; my friend loved the mint cookie but it was too savory for me--not bad, just not my palate for dessert.  best part of tres leches was the berry whip--pretty and delicious!  however, i will say, we were treated to a dessert special -- lemon curd french toast.  i WAS not enticed by this dessert by description but OMIGOSH; easily my favorite thing EVER.  warm, gooey, sugary, creamy; had custard type layers to keep everything extra tasty... i think i licked the plate clean.  the berries were sweet, the cream cheese ice cream rich and smooth, the custard warm, the bread not too heavy nor syrupy.... oooohhhhh.  SO good.  needless to say, the four of us walked out STUFFED and happy.  between room four/recess and black market, i believe i have found my date night destinations.  creative and innovative, great tap list, casual and fun and sophisticated environment, great staff to help along the way.  stick to the specials and the recs from your server at black market---they really do try to steer their guests in the tastiest way!!!!  only downside?  no coffee.  whaaaattt???!!!  that was a little weird.  but in exchange for a great meal?  absolutely not a problem for me!!!!  thanks, mica!!!!!

Last 3 times I have been to thIs location I have been extremely disappointed. I have been extremely polite and even stuck up for an employee that was dealing with a rude customer. They put under the minimum on each serving the give out extremely small portions. Today was my third chance for them and they struck out I'll be driving extra miles to go to better locations. I don't recommend anything about this location. 12/15/2019

Profites de chaque instant, tu sais pas quand est-ce que ca va se finir 
(Enjoy every moment, you don't know when it's gonna end)

Scenic drive to the Loveless Cafe... just a simple day yet so beautiful. It is the little things in life that matter. The Peach Whisky for breakfast at The Loveless Cafe with fried chicken was delicious. I loved coming to the Loveless Cafe for good southern food and the ambience.

"Give me sunsets in different cities and road trips on dirt tracks not sighted on maps.
Whiskey for breakfast & cheap thrills for dinner.
Give me happiness in a smile and nothing of certainty but the way we make eachother feel.
There so much life in living while you're alive & id give absolutely anything to have it all with you." Nikki rowe
I stopped here on the way home from hiking. The bar is cozy and the beef stroganoff is PERFECT.

First time to the salon, I called around 9 and they scheduled me for 10. The salon was great with very friendly staff. I had the pleasure of having  Marie do my hair. I could tell she has been doing this a while. She asked me a few questions about what I was looking for and I received exactly that. She was very personable and made me feel comfortable in her confidence. I will be going back to see her for color!
OMG the best street tacos I've ever had!!! They are super nice and very friendly ppl!!! Definitely recommend a very clean spot it's a must try

After a horrible visit to J&J Nails down the street, this place was absolutely amazing! Customer was point on as was Sue who did my nails. Thank gosh I finally found a great place to go and it's very clean!
Food is over priced. View is nice. Go to Wolfies in Geist. At least the food is cheaper there

The Taco Bell giveth and the Taco Bell taketh away.  I'm fairly certain this is a real bible passage.  For everything TB does right, they tend to screw up and even things out.  My trip this afternoon was no exception.

Tried two of the new grillers with a small baja blast (love that stuff).  The beefy crunch one was hot and delicious and every bit as good as the beefy crunch burrito that came before it.  They really need to bring it back.  The spicy chicken griller was pretty bad though.  It was cold, which didn't help, but so drowned in volcano sauce that it still scorched my mouth.  I honestly couldn't taste any chicken, it all felt like sour cream and volcano sauce. Paid the upcharge to add cheese but couldn't taste it.

All in all, this location looked clean inside and is in a good area, but the service and food is typical of today's fast food industry. Major hit and miss.

went on a Saturday morning. proprietor was awesome. great recommendations around town. that kind of causal but fantastic customer service I'm after. I loved the chicken liver but she hated it, be warned. but I'd try it again in a heartbeat. this place kicks ass.

Besito is a nicely appointed, somewhat upscale setting.  They offer valet parking but the lot directly across the restaurant wasn't full so I opted to park myself.  

Our party of two was sat immediately, it wasn't  busy at all.  We were quickly greeted by Josh who recommended his favorite margaritas and main dishes.  Upon placing our drink orders we knew we had to get the tableside guacamole.  We were given the choice of mild, med or hot.  We went for a nice medium and it did not disappoint. Chips and salsa are complimentary but the salsa was extremely bland for my taste.  

Our main dishes consisted of tomitillo enchiladas and a mixed grill of chorizo, chicken and steak.  I absolutely loved my main dish.  I also had plenty to take home for leftovers.  

Josh of course offered dessert but with complimentary churos for all, who needs anything more?? My leftovers were boxed up and our bill was delivered with a set of worry dolls. I think that is a super interesting parting gift. All in all a very enjoyable meal, I could really see myself returning.

I love eating at famous daves.  This is really good bbq.  I first discovered famous daves at the reno rib cook off about 5 years ago.  I have been a huge fan every since.  The restaurant is always clean and the people are so friendly.  Today i am trying the burnt ends and Wilbur's revenge sauce.  Absolutely delicious, i cant wait to have the Wilburs revenge on my wings.  Brianna was my server and she was excellent.  She really knew the menu and made it a great experience.

Folks...this place is LEGIT! From the ambiance to the service to the food itself, it was all such a delight from start to finish. We ordered A 'Creuben' Reuben Sandwich Croissant(one of the best spins on a Reuben I've *ever* shoved into my mouth) & 'Highbrow Appalachian' Croissant Breakfast Cube w/ Country Smoked Sausage, Egg, Apple Butter, Cheddar Cheese. Followed up w/ White Chocolate Peppermint Polar Espresso & Gingerbread Cheesecake! Yes, it's pricy but you're paying for these quality ingredients mixed with care, high rent in a higher-priced area and more: guess what though? IT'S WORTH IT!!
Quintessential Nola drink, cold, refreshing, and pleasant to drink in their courtyard!

Car wasn't ready when we arrived and it was dirty. It didn't even appear to have been vacuumed out. After making changes to our rental we were supposed to receive a refund but instead the refund was processed as an additional charged. Ended up being charged about 280 more than we should have been. We did eventually get a refund but it took several phone calls and wasted time.

This is half a review as I was here for a event but I will comment on my experience so far. It's a place I'm definitely coming back but only when they have their specials. It's a tad bit on the pricey side but for the experience it's definitely fun! 

I mean... Almost $20 bucks for a bottle of sake which you can buy at the store for 8-12 bucks is a bit ridiculous. 

So! The event I went to was a preview for newer items to be released in May. So far there are items I didn't like and items I loved. If you want the details for that please find my blog which the link is in my profile. 

I love how flashy yet simple and clean the conveyor belt is. There's booth and bar seatings so wherever you want to sit at you won't miss any action. 

The servers are really friendly and everyone is smiling! They have some killer deals like happy hour and also blue Monday's! 

My absolutely favorite to die for dish is the Albacore Tuna with Ponzu and Truffle. Seriously, whoever thought of this needs a trophy. It's something I am obsessed with. 

The sushi that I've tried wasn't really impressive, but it's certainly not bad. I do like that there's unique dishes like takoyaki and okonomiyaki that aren't normally served at restaurants. 

It's a fun place to try, especially if you've never tried a conveyor belt sushi before.

I sincerely cannot believe there are negative reviews! As far as customer service goes, I don't think I've seen anything like it. Once, we had a slight problem with a pickup order, and they DELIVERED almost immediately to fix it. This place deserves some serious praise. Not only is the food delicious, it's almost impossible to order the WRONG thing from their extensive menu; EVERYTHING is delicious. I think the portions are fair for the price, and it's always preferred (in my opinion), to support the smaller businesses in the area, rather than the chains around the block. Favorites include - thai panang curry, spring rolls (obviously), chicken and beef satay, spicy basil, and spicy bamboo shoot. If you're a lover of very spicy foods, like myself.. make sure to specify that you'd like it VERY hot, because the ONLY problem I have is when my curry comes a little too mild. ;) That being said, this is one of the only places I've encountered that truly deserves five stars. Do yourself a favor, and give this place a try. Seriously.

I recently purchased my daughter's bridal shower cake from The Caketeria. Not only was the cake aesthetically beautiful, it was delicious! It was a chocolate cake with mixed berries and cream filling! My guests raved about it, and there was not one crumb to take home!

Definately take the South Tahoe Express if you have California License Plates.  I was singled out and pulled over on the stretch of Highway 50 where it becomes four lanes at the top of Lake Tahoe and given a ticket for 50 in a 45 MPH.  There were cars in front, behind and beside me but he said on the citation that there were no cars near me.  I have California plates.  Don't drive, take the train in South Lake Tahoe, on the Nevada side for sure!

Maybe it's because I have high expectations when an establishment has good ratings on Yelp but I was seriously disappointed in this place.  My daughter and I went for a simple French mani and the nail tech did what I would call a half professional job.  I would never return not recommend this place.  I was on vacation from Maryland hoping to have a different memorable experience - instead left with a bad one.

Great service at a great price!  Needed tint on my two front windows redone and called Shane. After visiting for a quick quote I found out I couldn't beat his prices. He did the work in a few hours and it looks fantastic. Happy I found his shop!

I don't want to like Bici, I want to love it!  We live three blocks aways.  The place is charming.  The outdoor seating is wonderful.  But the food always disappoints.  Granted, it's never awful or nasty.  But it's never inspired either.  It's consistently meh.  If the kitchen improved, we'd be there all the time...

Came in for my fill and pedi today. As always loved the service Paris nail bar provided! Alan did my acrylic,   Another woman technician did my polish. She did amazing! They have a new rose gold mattalic color. It's sooo pretty I love it. Perfect for my bday nails! Kevin did my pedicure, this was the best pedi I have had in a while. He took his time and was really detailed with the cleaning trimming and massage. I came a little late and didn't realized they closed earlier on Sundays. Alan and the team were amazing about this. They didn't make me feel rushed and they took their time.  They are the friendliest nail team! Thank you all so much. I highly recommend Paris Nail Bar! The only place I trust in Tucson.

Love Jeff.   Always bring my computer troubles to him.  I just bought a refurbished laptop from him and it greaaaat!  Thanks Jeff.  Hope you won't see me for awhile!  Oh, and he is fixing up another computer for a colleague.

VERY disappointing. I got a 30% off coupon emailed to me, only problem is that it went to my Spam box. I called to see if they would honor it, under the circumstances and apparently the manager said no. This would have cost them nothing monetarily, and in my opinion, was a very poor business decision. I have been to other dispensaries who are much friendlier and flexible. Other establishments have honored coupons if mentioned with-in a week. It expired on January 31, Today is February 4, 4 days, really? Some of the staff members, like the associate I was on the phone with, are very nice. I pretty much blame management. I can get what I need elsewhere in a much nicer, user friendly, empathetic environment where management makes you feel welcome. 
What a shame, thought you were in the business to help people, just greedy like  most large corporate entities. Other dispensaries really do have empathy.   I'd prefer to spend my hard earned money at a place that has empathy, which is not Ilera. 
Ilera, you just lost another customer because of your cavalier attitude. No wonder you only have a 2 1/2 star Yelp rating.  I will never shop here again.

United sucks and your flight is late.  Seriously, it's the only reason you're here. The food - and wait staff - is cold, greasy and super salty.  Welcome to Philly.  Good news is the beer - like the wait staff and those awful fries - is cold, and there's a good selection of beers.  Good luck catching your flight back home; hope the rest of your day/night is better for you.

We stopped in today and had burgers. I ordered the bacon avocado burger with garlic fries, my wife had the classic burger with american cheese. I asked for my burger to be cooked medium. When our food arrived it was obvious the thin burger patties had been previously frozen. They were chewy and overcooked. I had to look for the avocado on the burger. The fries were dry, flavorless, and whatever garlic was put on them was indistinguishable. On top of all that, the servers were robotic and appeared that they would rather be somewhere else. Maybe the rest of the food is great, but you know the old adage about first impressions....our first and last visit.

As an employee of a local medical office I am appalled at the quality of care that this establishment offers. I have attempted to phone in a prescription multiple times for a patient that the pharmacists have "not received". So when I attempted to call and speak directly to a pharmacist I was on hold for over 15 minutes. 
This prescription was vital to the patient and was most likely deleted off of the pharmacy's prescription voice-mail.
After much frustration I ended up advising the patient to take her business elsewhere and that she didn't deserve to be treated by incompetent and irresponsible pharmacy staff.
I would never recommend this pharmacy to any of my friends, coworkers or patients.

This place actually deserves more than 3 stars! Probably because they recently hired a new manager, the service is absolutely pleasant and amazing. My waitress was extremely friendly, helpful, and considerate. The food itself is pretty good as well. All of the seafood are very fresh, especially the shrimp! The lobster tail was very juicy and tender. The salmon was a little bit overcooked, but I was so full at that point I didn't really care. Give this place a try! It's really not bad at all.

This is a really great spot to get some work done, especially since they've remodeled and expanded the space.

I got the chai latte this morning, which was a bit more sweet than spicy, but that's alright. They were doing some promotional photos of their menu at the same time and let me have the cucumber chickpea salad on the house. I'm not much for cucumber, but that was a mighty fine salad, and a much higher quality dish than what I've had at some other coffee shops in town. The spicy sauce is an awesome touch. I've already recommended it to a few friends, and would definitely order it again for myself.

Not worth the 25 I spent on two sandwiches. The menu is misleading, I expected a great well put together roast beef sandwich and got a super dry sandwich not with all the seasoning and the this. and the that the menu showed . Just boring roast beef on a boring white loaf and a little cup or brown gravy . Not worth it
Depends on the day and the person you get. Mia is very very good and I always like her work. The spa is very clean and comfortable.

I love this place and wish I still lived in Brandon so I could come here on a regular basis. After moving to Tampa I realized how great Mimi's is, when you get a pedicure they clean the tub while the towel is on your legs! In Tampa I really miss finding a place that actually cleans! Mimi's -I miss you! Move to Tampa!!!

As long as I can remember i have always had access to a Baskin Robins and have never had a bad experiance.  

Over the past 20-years i have visited the Fairview and Locust Grove B&R quite a few times and have always felt welcomed.  I enjoy their options, although wonky at times, always creamy and delicious.  

This year i was able to introduce my daughter to her first Daiquiri Ice scoop, mine ws 40+ years ago.  There's something conforting about tasting your childhood memories and sharring them with your own kids.  Love yah B&R!

We had such a nice time that we came back for a second visit in our 4 day anniversary trip. We have enjoyed the small plate selections and several of the specialty drinks they offer. The staff is very helpful, friendly, and knowledgable. We sat on the patio the first time and now we are enjoying a window seat looking at Jefferson Square.

So before we get to the point, I say thank you to a dear friend of mine for the recommendation in her words "amazing"! Here goes, mind you I am still in a state of bliss from today! 5 Stars absolutely with a Gold Star "Golden Buzzer" that needs to be put in place by yelp! I would push it multiple times! 

I have had the G1 Pizza my last two visits!  The combination of the G1 starts with homemade red sauce, fresh mozzarella, prosciutto, black truffles, basil, on a crispy tender crust, and obviously passion late love from the chef preparing it!  The other half had the  Tuscan Burger the first time and the tomatoes on it were to die for, last time he had a sandwich that he scarfed down and don't remember which one and today he had the BBQ Burger with the homemade chips! I asked the server whom has been there each time we have if the chef could do something with the Tuscan tomatoes on a pizza! She asked and he said sure. WoooHoooo, but what to combine with them! I asked the chef to create anything he wanted that would be phenomenal with the tomatoes! 

So now you want to know what I got and how it was; It was the most epic ultimate foodgasm my mouth ever had! I was so thankful I wanted the crew to taste it so I gave them a slice to taste and apparently they had the same reaction! So, I'm sitting here writing this and I want more......lol! Not going to happen when it's going on 12:30! I have attached a picture of this masterpiece! It by far is the most impressive flavor explosion with the ability to taste each layer of goodness! 

I have to give a huge shout out to the great staff, your service is impeccable and your desire to want to accommodate a customers request is so long forgotten by most restaurants! Even a visit from the chef himself! I thank you very much for creating my pizza that was just to be centered around the Tuscan tomatoes! Chef; you are amazing! Looking forward to many more enjoyable meals here!
Alexandra is very personable. I would love to have her as my waitress each time I visit.

Food is delicious  you need to try uptown barbecue shrimp and the spicy boil shrimp and their bread omg  is fresh. Please help small business grow this place is to die for. Im from California. And I wish I had more time to try more dishes from the menu.

Liliana's was a serendipitous find one Saturday night. As out-of-towners, my husband and I craved St. Louis Italian food, but the hill wasn't on our way to my parents in O'Fallon from a stop in South County. We stumbled into Liliana's for takeout and weren't disappointed. Their food is delicious and portions generous. The little time we were there, everyone was helpful and friendly. Offering classic St. Louis Italian salads and pastas, Liliana's seems like a great new neighborhood staple.

If you're looking for some sweet coffee shop merch, this is the place to go. Old World Coffee is one of the few iconic coffee shops of midtown Reno. I think this place really shines with their signature espresso drinks. The coffee is delicious, unique, and classy. If you're looking to hangout for a while, there are better places, if you're just going for the  coffee experience this is a good optionbut the music soundtrack is dope and the quality of coffee makes everything worthwhile. Make this your place for a quick stop in for a to go cappuccino, matcha, or seasonal latte.

The staff is very attending and they have so many choices; not just a ramen place. And lots of different wines to choose from surprisingly. My Korean spicy ramen was too spicy for me. But even then, I finished it and it was delicious! We got some tempura veggies as appetizers. Yum! Can't wait to come back

Quaint, cozy, beautiful views at this very pleasant "surprise" restaurant tucked into the elbow of a sweeping turn on old rt 611.
The menu is not long, nor is it inexpensive, however, the delightful meal was worth it. I ordered the strip steak with Tiki shrimp. The steak was on the small side but cooked to pefection. Two flash fried shrimp coated in a potato crust were outstanding. Lots of excellent veggies too. My dining partner had the shrimp and scallop bake with spinach and artichoke. She pronounced it as perfect.
We checked with our server, and despite the intro here on Yelp, they do take credit cards and do takeout.
Service was good, and they had some unusual beers on tap too!
Enjoy!

Mike showed up and felt with a drain issue and made sure it was clean and functioning. I felt like he went the extra mile, he cleaned up after himself and was very courteous. Have used Drain Medics a few times and have never had an issue.
Great, but average for now.  sales associates are still new and in training so don't expect a speedy service. Still fun and has dope games though

There was no one in this restaurant when we walked in, and I can see why. Half of the menu items weren't available and our server didn't seem to know the answers to any of our questions about the food and it seemed like he forgot about us most of the time even though we were the only customers. I had the boiled shrimp and it was okay.

Came to grab some food and the owner wasn't there just the cook and was told he didn't have access to the register so I would have to come back in a hour. Came back and ordered the garlic crab dinner and fried crab dinner and chicken wings and fries. First the garlic crab was soooo over steamed and mushy I couldn't eat them under the crabs was just plain pasta that was literally spoiled (smelled and tasted sour) the garlic butter potatoes were good but over cooked.  The chicken was just frozen pre- breaded wings and frozen fries no seasoning were added so it was bland. I didn't try the fried crab it was bought for someone else. The owner was friendly. My food just wasn't good so I probably won't return
Brent is amazing!!! He is very comforting, and quite the artist at his trade. All the staff were very nice and accommodating. I look forward to my next visit.
Always a great work out! The energy is awesome and the effects can be felt for days after!

Lavender Nail Bar is my new favorite local nail salon and Kathy is my new favorite nail tech.

Highlights include: 
*Complimentary beverage
*Relaxing waterfall and music
*Organic products
*Hygienic disposable wrap for pedicure foot soaks and fresh buffer for each customer
*Beautifully modern décor
*Excellent and attentive service

Prices are slightly higher than other area salons, but you get what you pay for - Lavender is worth the extra few dollars.

I ordered the big filet which comes with mashed potatoes, one side (picked the creamed spinach) and added grilled shrimp. The filet was cooked perfectly to my preference of medium rare, and the shrimp and creamed spinach were fantastic. The potatoes were not so good - very heavy on cloves or some other spice, and didn't really even taste of potatoes. The spices should enhance the flavor, instead of overwhelming. Never understand why restaurants don't include some bread with the meal. To go order was ready promptly. Wish the lobby area had some signage as to where to pick up carry-out. I was stuck waiting behind patrons who were dining in for several minutes. I like to get in and out quickly due to Covid19. I will order again soon, but no mashers next time.

Our go to pizza place in south tampa for saturday night pizza and movie with the kids.  Have  only ordered pizza here so cannot comment on other food items.  The crust is excellent!  Orders have always been correct and pizza hot.

Took delivery of my Tesla here and have had some service done as well. Everyone is super nice and helpful. The car buying experience is like no other. Very fast and uncomplicated. 

The center is clean and modern with free WiFi. Waiting to have the tires rotated isn't a bother.

Good food ..good service and friendly staff.. the one keystone had waiting one ..so we went here and I m glad we did ... Blue booster was really really good .. just the way I like it ... Nice place for brunch with family and friends .. and they have a lots o
Had the eggs Benedict.  Really nice Hollandaise sauce.  Great menu.  Great service.  Worth the wait and lives up to the hype.

What a lovely Italian restaurant! I've been very impressed with the Italian scene in Philly recently, particularly around South Philly. I came here for a graduation party of four and they were able to accommodate an extra +1.

Food: Perfect portions and came SUPER fast. I wasn't very hungry so I ordered a prosciutto antipasti, which was plated very nicely and tasted delicious (good cuts and I really liked the vinaigrette, though a little heavy). My family ALL ordered the lobster spaghetti and they liked it. Everything was presented beautifully and I like how it wasn't a mountain of pasta per plate, as I find a lot of Italian places can overdo it on the portion sizes. 

Free bread: Five stars. Ugh it was so good. Fluffy and doughy, and I appreciated how they poured out olive oil with a flourish into a small condiment dish right after sliding the bread onto our table--because that is the only way bread should be consumed at an Italian place (plus salt and pepper).

The staff is really sweet. I haven't had my nails done in awhile but they gave me a pretty sweet set. I'm obsessed with the butterflies. Would love to come back soon. The base coat I picked out is DND gel in the color  596 Oak Buff. I will be buying it soon I'm obsessed with it.
Amazing food.  This is not your average lunch truck.  Try the Chicken Gyro.  5 stars all day long.

Me and my wife tried this place for the first time, we order the super nachos and now it's what we come here for! Both the beef and chicken will hit the spot and the portion size is enough for two! Good stuff
Had a terrific server Alfred!!  Very informative, didn't rush us, very pleasant!!  Swordfish was superb!Appetizers all delicious!

This is one of my favorite breweries on the planet!  Their IPAs are like nothing I've ever had before.  Hop Hands and Alien Church are the best.  The food is top notch and comes out fast.  We brought our daughter here and high chairs were available.  Our server immediately brought a cup of water with a lid on it without even being asked.  Beers are offered in different sizes which makes trying many easy.  Though, they do have a strange rule that, to do flights, you must only do one beer at a time.  There is a parking lot out front and plenty of room inside.  We will be back again and again.

Do not rent here. The apartments are very overpriced, $1,645 being the cheapest and smallest apt you can rent. None of the apts have central a/c or the ability to control the room temperature (heat is base board and is either on or off, no temperature settings.) I was without heat for 4 days in March of this year when temperatures dipped into the teens, so I did not pay rent for 4 days, and management still insists I owe it to them (the PA state law says I don't.) They were supposed to do a massive heating system overhaul in March 2020 but instead bought another property. 

Every and any bit of work they do is done as cheaply as possible. Our front doors stick because they painted right over the old paint without scraping or sanding. Contractors typically show up in unmarked white vans, and I once called the police because there was a young boy in the hallways ripping out old, dirty carpet from the stairwells without any protective clothing or filtered mask. The massive pot hole in the back parking lot was filled only with sand. The management decided to contract with Comcast, so you have no choice but to use Comcast for internet. My bill went from $40 to $60 to $100 in 2 years, and you have no leverage because they know it's the only service you can get.

Walls are thin, you can hear everything in the hallways and your neighbors going to the bathroom and flushing the toilet. My bedroom window doesn't close all the way because it wasn't installed properly, the fan in the bathroom vents into the ceiling (black mold growing around it,) and they even turned down the water pressure after the start or Covid to keep the water bill down! They don't hire a lifeguard for the pool, and we don't know who does the chlorine checks, so few people swim it out of health concerns.

Management is greedy, rude, and there have been at least 4 different assistant property managers since I moved in. You can rent a nicer place for less money in Media. The only redeeming quality is Shaun the maintenance guy, but once he's gone, you'll be out of luck. Go elsewhere for nearly $1,700/mo.

A lovely experience with lovely people. Thank you Tom from @tomarestaurant for a unique lovely culinary dining experience. From the #grilledoctopus #squashblossom #shrimpgnocchi and #searedscallops to the beautiful #santabarbara view everything was just perfect. The service was excellent as well. I will be back for more with friends.

If you're looking for the perfect pizza in a relaxed yet trendy atmosphere then you can't go wrong with Pizzeria Vetri. There is something about their dough that just cannot be matched by any other pizza place. I'd recommend getting pizza, calzone and the fried dough dessert just to experience how amazing and versatile their dough is. This place is consistently amazing, has a great bar and fun atmosphere. Can't go wrong!

Picked up an order to go here yesterday. Customer service was not the best, but one of the owners contacted me and apologized, and said he had addressed the issues with his employees as well. That carried a lot of weight with me, and I will probably try them again next time I'm in the area.

Stopped in on Friday on my way home to look for a pre owned XT5 for my wife,got out of the car and looked around then went inside and stood for awhile.The front desk was empty and a few employees looked at me but never spoke so i walked around the showroom for a bit then left without anyone ever bothering to interact with me.
This is the best place for quick serviceand great food. Madison is the most fantastic server.

I used to live in south Nashville and visited Martin's for my barbecue fix and once I moved to 12 South, I tried out Edley's. I did have high expectations due to the fact that there is so much hype around this place and indeed the food is great, it is really tasty and the bar has a good diverse selection of alcoholic beverages. The crowd I didn't dig so much, this place always seems to be packed full of people and whenever I go, I am elbowing and nudging people and circus-ing around chairs and stealing condiments off of other tables.
Hands down, our favorite restaurant in Jefferson County!!  Not to mention the best food and service, but you earn rewards towards FREE food!!  This will continue to be a must have in our house.
We were going to give this place another try, but it seems to be shut down.
Had an amazing brunch, service was great, the waiter told us that one of our choices was not the best and not to get it! Must love the honesty :) after changing our minds, all 6 of us LOVED our meal!

Before I begin I just want to note that is is a review for their grooming and for Sarah the groomer. I did not leave my dog there over night and cannot comment on that. First thing this place did that made me love them, they actually answer their phones!!!! I called all around town looking for pet groomers but no one answered their phones or even called me back. But what really made this place great, was the fact that the people who work here truly love dogs. Everyone was so happy and friendly towards my little dude. I also have to say that he is as soft as he was when he was a puppy and his new trim makes him look 3 years younger. Price was only a little more expensive than places I've been before but nothing unreasonable and worth every penny for the patience they take to make your dog feel comfortable and look amazing! Thank you guys!!!! Rio and I will definitely be back!

I love Costco! If you ever need to buy a TV buy it from Costco. They offer a 5 year warranty on the low! Costco has allot of great products and they Kirkland brand is legit! They have some amazing wines and their Kirkland brand vodka is as good as Grey goose. With a great return policy and great service.  Who wouldn't love shopping here. They also offer allot of organic grass fed meats at a great price as well as lots of healthy food choices for kids snacks.

LARGE/FULL SIZE TRUCKS BEWARE!
I had been a 20+ years  customer of this car wash through many changes. Including changes of personnel and  business ownership.
Last week , December 20, 2020 I was attempting to leave the  car wash and ran into the
newly placed metal  portable work station.
I could not see it from the drivers seat of my Toyota Tundra. It is about 3-4' high.  It resulted in scratches  on my passenger door and front quarter panel.
I acknowledge that I had attempted to turn around a vehicle in front of me
without any guidance from the car wash personnel.
Next visit I reported to  Joe, the Manager on duty, that the incident happened and I thought they should  warn drivers of large trucks with a red pole or something. Joe said it had never happened before and they don't see any reason to change anything. And since they gave me no instructions he felt no responsibility for this incident .
Evidently posting a warning to other drivers would be an admission that it should have been posted before my incident,
I don't agree with that kind of thinking so I am going to take my business to Jules Car Wash down the street.  I have used them for waxing all my family vehicles many years. Mister Car Wash never could get hand waxing right.

Keep coming back here mostly because of the staff.  Of course the food never disappoints but we have our usual.  I am a fan of the Cold Brew Coffee and Power Breakfast Quinoa bowl.  This location in particular is the best.  We are regulars and sad that we'll be leaving in a few months.

Visited two times did not like my panini the first time, tried it this morning again, ordered a different dish. Horrible.. I mean paid $10 and still can't justify swallowing. The pastries look delightful, however their food is hard to stomach. In addition they have no way to bring a stroller up. Skip this.

I love Zazen! I get my nails done here all the time and they always do a fantastic job. The service s great; they're very kind and offer refreshments, they never do a bad job with my nails and the environment is very peaceful. It smells great and they use non-harmful organic products. I definitely reccomend them!

Went here to see about purchasing my 1 year old some clothes their selections were very very small and the children's department is so small you might miss it in passing l, but couldn't help me self went over to women shoes and boy oh boy nice shoes with good prices I was surprised will definitely be back.

The new E Passyunk spot is allowing them to grow.  The wine list is as simple as there name, very approachable.  The food is gourmet without being over the top.  The service is top grade.  And the place is inviting, cozy and cute.

The staff is awesome, and really chill.  This is the sort of place you want to be a regular at.

Great place if you are looking for a place for vintage clothes and random costumes and outfits. It has the most random stuff there, different styles of shoes, dresses, accessories, etc. 

This is basically a great place for you to exchange any unique outfits or clothes you have or some good basic vintage accessories.
