The only problem is that yes it is kind of cluttered and there are a lot of random clothes everywhere, but lately I noticed they have organized their clothes better and the place expanded a bit. 

Also a bit of a downside, for a thrift store and for vintage items, the clothes are  tad bit overpriced. A bit too much for not so great quality on most of these items.

This restaurant is insane. I cannot say enough about this place!!! I have never written a review like this in my life. I just finished my third visit to this restaurant and I have been blown away each time. Impeccable service, always extremely attentive. The second your chips or salsa are low they refill it immediately. The employees who aren't even your waiter/waitress constantly check on you to make sure everything is amazing. Everyone is always in the best mood ever! I always leave with a smile! This is not to mention the food. I have never had better Mexican food EVER. The salsa is wonderful every meal I've gotten!! This is how every restaurant should be!! I will be back time and time again! Thank you! I will forever be a regular here!
Good beers but rude customers. Sad. Too many little kids. Get there before the families show up.

We went the day before Christmas eve, it was very crowded but well worth it! The displays were beautiful and once the lights came on the place was magical. Great place to take the family especially for those shutterbugs or garden enthusiasts. Only difficulty was dealing with the cold! We were prepared but at night with the wind coming at us it was just unbearable but a definitely plan on coming back in the Spring!

I was expecting some real NO fare.  Didn't get it.  Everyone at the table decidely thought this is just soul food, nothing cajun or creole or special about it.  

That was last year.  This year we won't be stopping at Mother's.

Been going here for years.  Consistsnt food quality, but portion size seems to slowly be decreasing, but more importantly, service quality has seriously diminished.  Tried the online ordering...not so good.  Website functions well, but they're not doing a good job with it at the location.  Still had to stand in line behind all the walk-ins, even though they advertise "no more standing in line when you order online".  By the time I got to the counter it was ten minutes after the time my order was supposed to be ready....and it wasn't ready.  Finally got my order another ten minutes later, so it was late by a total of twenty minutes!!  Not much of a time saver there.  After I got back to work with my lunch I discovered they had shorted the toast that's supposed to come with the Pop Shrimp meal.  They also had ignored my request for a couple lemon slices for the shrimp and fish.  I figured that was a reasonable request of a place selling seafood AND iced tea, but apparently not.  Also, no napkins or utensils included...????  Pretty poor showing overall, don't you think?  Going back to Mr Crispys instead next time.  Severely disappointed in what used to be one of my favorite places.

Love osaki only sushi place I'll ever feel comfortable eating raw sushi from. I usually stick with the cooked rolls because I'm always so iffy eating anything raw! But everything I've had from Osaki is always delicious. love having it an arms throw away from my house :)
We were there in October the service was okay, needed to keep asking out server for drinks, etc and the food was blah.

Every time the topic of hair comes up in passing at my office my co-worker gushes about this place. So Friday when I decided I was entirely overdue for a trim and had some time this weekend to get one I gave them a call hoping they had something available since my usual salon is always booked at least a month out. They had availability for the very next day. Then when I had to call them that morning 3 hours before my appointment because my pup had suddenly gotten very ill & I had to take her to the vet they were kind and even able to reschedule me for a later appointment that day. The place was very comfortable, fun, & relaxing. The staff was friendly and chatty. Instantly felt at ease like old friends. My appointment was with Mikinzi. She listened to my style, lack of skill, what I was looking for, what products I use, and my routine. She gave the best shampoo & really took a lot of time with me to give me simple, easy to follow styling lessons. The experience was beyond incredible and I really cannot say enough in praise. It's the first time I've gotten a trim & shape that didn't leave me feeling like I lost almost everything I was working to grow since I am trying to grow it longer. It's also the first time I've ever left a salon feeling like my hair was really styled the way I like it & the way that suits me. When I went to check out the cost was half what I pay at my usual salon & they didn't push a bunch of upsells and products. My hair feels amazing, I feel like a goddess, and a cute guy hit on me everywhere I went the entire rest of the day!  I've already made my next appointment. Mikinzie & the Pink Mullet now have a new customer for life.
This review is for the lady that was so nice when I asked about their vegan options! She even double checked to make sure my smoothie was vegan. Thanks for being so accommodating!!

First time here and I really enjoyed my breakfast.  First the place has a modern country feel to it. The staff was quick and attentive to our needs. My boyfried ordered the eggs and chicken fried steak and I had eggs and pancakes.  The portions are perfect. 
The chicken fried steak was well seasoned, gravy was tasty. Fluffy pancakes and eggs done perfectly.  The only thing we didn't care for are the potatoes. They didn't have any flavor. Definitely will be coming back.

Honestly, I was divided between giving them a two or a three rating, but I liked the flavors in their bowls so I settled on a three. 
I had fries with buffalo wings, blue cheese crumbles/sauce, bacon bits and jalapenos. My issue was the boneless chicken wings/nuggets. They were very, very obviously of the frozen variety and by the time I got a few bites into my dish the thick overly bready breading had soaked up way too much sauce, resulting in a very unappetizing sogginess. The fries suffered the same fate as the wings, as they were so loaded with sauces none were even close to crispy. 
Overall, I'm not really a fan. There is definitely room for improvement!

Let's say 4.5, only because I am not a huge fan of "Southern Food."  But, having said this, this place is nice.  What makes it nice is the outstanding service.  It seems like they really do care about their customers and making sure that they have a nice experience.  It is definitely worth the visit.
Adios El Charro! The cheese crisp is divine and the fajitas were fantastic. The bar is great for watching sports too. This was our first visit. We will be back.

Got the scrambled eggs with brie, spinach, toast and fruit. The eggs were so delicious. Who would have thought to put eggs and brie together? Genius. Staff was friendly and the ambiance was cozy. Definitely recommend coming here for breakfast! :) Oh and very affordable.
The literal best sausage and biscuits I've ever had. The place is super clean and very cute! Prices are totally fair and the staff is very nice! We loved it.

VERY unprofessional in returning calls and emails.  Failed inspection and refused to communicate with tenant on rescheduling inspection.  My family and I (including a disabled child) were left homeless due to their negligence.  This was a blessing in disguise, (despite being left without housing) because it showed me what type of landlord (slum) I would have dealt with if repairs needed to be made in the future.  So in a way, thank you for showing your TRUE colors in advance.

Outstanding steakhouse experience.   Everything was perfect... from the waitstaff, to the decor, to the table side prepared Cesar salad, to the prep of the steaks & ultimately the taste of a well prepared and inspired meal.   The wine list definitely has something for everyone and all different budgets.   Sure, you will spend a few bucks here but it is well worth the meal & experience.
My favorite Burrito in town! Tri-Tip + Chix

This is an average sports bar with below average BBQ.  

It is phenomenally loud in here.  The hard wood floors and the tin ceiling greatly add to my the cacophony.  It is reinforced by the symphony of he Tvs.  

Other than the deer widows and divorcees there is not much going on in here.

Bottom line there are better places to drink and fat better places to eat

It's Taco Bell, you know what you're getting. 

I only visit here in the afternoon for lunch. The afternoon staff is always super polite, the place is clean and the bathroom is clean and smells nice. 

What more can you ask for from a Taco Bell?

I like the food and have been there a number of times, but honestly the food is just ok.  So far, everything I've tried has been decent, but nothing has wowed me.  The service is good and I like the feel of the restaurant, it would just never be my choice with all of the great places there are in South Jersey that are better.
Tastes just like home ( Norristown PA )
Absolutely incredible food! Wow. Will be coming back! They made it fresh and fast! Definitely will be coming back to enjoy this place with my friends!

Totally my type of store, I love games! The service was amazing... the guy seemed to have knowledge of every game in the store, giving game-play instructions on any games that you were interested in. He even offered to play the game with us if we didn't get it. I love that. Coming into this store made my day.
Had the margarita pizza- was very good. Octopus and lentil soup were both waaaaaaaay too salty. Octopus was dripping with oil.
Refinished my wood floors and it looks AMAZING! I highly recommend! Very efficient and professional. Got the job done  in perfect timing for a family get together.
Absolutely delicious food. The menu is a bit unusual, but they allow you to order things your way. The food is flavorful and well prepared.

I love DiNic's. I just love em. I took my one brother here months ago because he is a big Man v Food fan, he still talks up how good that sandwich is EVERYTIME i talk to him. 

The pork, broccoli rabbe, and aged provolone are a perfect combination. Everytime I go, it never disappoints. I keep half exepecting to get angry one day and feel ripped off- but it never happens. The products here are always good. 

One tourist sat next to me eating a DiNic's sandwich and proceeded to take it apart and re-arrange it. I wanted to yell at them, "Stop abusing that sandwich! There is not a thing wrong with that sandwich- there is something wrong with you!" 

I have tried this same sandwich (roast pork, broccoli rabbe, provolone) at John's Roast Pork, DiBruno Brother's, Shank's and Tony Luke's. I can say honestly after trying each place a few times DiNic's is always the best.

One piece of advice, the hot peppers are pretty hot and they can overwhelm some of the other flavors in the sandwich.

Best.Bacon.Ever.

There, I said it.  I dare you to find me a better bite of bacon. I double hog dare you.

I know the city is abundant with brunch places, but I am always compelled to drive West, not East when it comes to my favorite meal. 

The staff is basically your best friend.  I don't know if there is some kind of hardcore niceness training they put their folks through, but I have never been to a restaurant that had a staff that I wanted to friend request after visiting.  Ok, that sounds stalker-ish, but I mean, it would be a friends with benefits situation...and the benefit is bacon.  

I first learned about The Silverspoon \when I needed to find a good brunch spot convenient for my family to celebrate my bday.  Yelp showed me the way and I booked a table for 9 with no issues.  We all enjoyed our meal and there wasn't a sad face in the bunch.  I had the crab omelet, which was tasty.  They have a monte cristo sandwich that will make your toes curl.  We brought our own birthday cake too.

I have been back a few times since and every time has been a pleasure.  In warmer months, they open it up on the veranda, which is technically facing a parking lot, but it is a nice parking lot.  This is the Main Line after all.

Oh bonus, they are BYOB!!

After my husband finished planning every detail to our trip to the Philadelphia area, this resturant was located conveniently between the two tourist destinations we visited. Going down the street it's located on, you wouldn't think you would find a nice restaurant but Smoking Betty's is hidden nicely down this rough street. 
Upon entering during brunch time, we were immediately greeted and seated. There is indoor seating, out door seating, an upstairs and downstairs. 
Our waiter immediately came over and was so nice. I ordered the BBQ sliders and my daughter ordered one of the smaller burgers. The breakfast food that came out for other tables looked delicious! I also saw that they served mimosas and inquired. I ordered the houses special Fuzzy Mimosa! It was delicious and the best Mimosa I have had!!! My BBQ sliders were ok, but being from the south I've has better BBQ and pulled meat sandwiches. My daughters burger didn't taste that great to me either. 
Besides the food being just ok, the Mimosa and atmosphere was excellent. This is a really nice restaurant located in the downtown Philly area.
Save yourself. Don't order the boiled crawfish, even when desperate. Odd flavor, tons of broken claws. And the potatoes have ZERO seasoning.

Heard all the good things about Rebecca, so scheduled my first appointment. Used their system, appointment was accepted, and confirmed. Showed up 20 minutes early as I know there are always forms to fill out on first visit.
Then I waited, and waited, and about 15 minutes after my appointment was supposed to begin, was told Rebecca had to go somewhere earlier but was supposed to be back and they cannot get hold of her by phone. This is about as rude as it gets folks! Things come up, but you call your customer and cancel, not let them make a 30 min drive to find you are not going to bother to show. Not sure where all the glowing reviews are coming from. Friends and family?

While Jiro dreams of sushi, Ginza is where sushi dreams come true as authentic sushi chefs make fabulously fresh incredibly artful and delicious plates of those dreams. New to the area and addicted to the stuff, I tried other places before finding this hidden gem which beats Ra by a kilometer and a half. Itadakomasu, y'all.

This place is phenomenal! Excellent service fantastic food! My husband and I decided to give this place a try after the recommendation from one of our drivers! We were not disappointed at all! The seafood platter is amazing very generous portions! Will definitely be coming back on our next NOLA trip!!

I brought my family of 5 because we read the reviews. We were prepared to be disappointed because we've been fooled by reviews before. Let me tell you, THE REVIEWS ARE ABSOLUTELY RIGHT!!!!! The food was remarkable. We ate the most flavorful NOT FISHY catfish that was tender and seasoned to perfection. The juicy cherry smoked baby back ribs with just the right amount of sauce, not overly saturated. We also ordered the brisket and roast beef which were not very tasty and worthy of a repeat visit. I was searching for a steakhouse and overjoyed to find this jewel .

I had a very displeasing experience here, ive been here before and things have never been this bad! They said they open up at 11am i was there at 11:15 there were already 3 people outside the door were locked the person walked past the door in a very unwelcoming way continued to turn on all the light and then let us in. . . . After ordering and asking questions about the menu i was told to pick off the menu OR LEAVE! I waited 45min and im happy i didnt tip. I WILL NOT REVISIT THIS ESTABLISHMENT! 
by the way good luck if if you dont speak spanish very rude and unprofessional!
Went for brunch. Had the Cuban breakfast and Mixto Carillo. Food was great. Definitely a good place to check out if you want to mix things up from traditional American breakfast.

Booked the school bus for my buddy's bachelor party and was not disappointed one bit!  Quality service, that provides worry free transportation with a party atmosphere!! All the guys couldn't stop talking about how much the bus was and are looking forward to doing it for their own bachelor parties.  Awesome job to the owner Darin and our bus driver Danny!  You guys made our trip to SB one hell of a memorable day!
Great Chinese takeout. If you compare it to other Chinese places in Indy, it is the best. You can even get Pad Thai there and the food is fast.

To whoever the PHD/MD/PPAP who made the educated decision for everyone's safety to allow 1 or 2 customers at a time in the garden section, it is rather really redundant to do this in a ventilated area, and generate a line a mile long of customers inside the store. You sir/ma'am deserve the dundee award. If COVID-19 overtakes the country, it will be because of this amazing example of poor judgment.
I was in New Orleans for a conference staying in CBD. Wanted coffee and come upon this place on yelp. They make really good coffee  and the artwork with foam is nifty! Recommend the place to everyone

One of the best wood floors I have ever skated on! 

For the adult skating session come Sunday, it's a great night time activity to do with a group of friends or alone. If you're an adult looking to skate another day besides Sunday it would be a Thursday, but it's family night so expect lots kids as well some adult regulars.

SUNDAY:
Adult Night - 21 + Only
8:00pm - 11:30pm
$7.00 with Skates
$10.00 without Skates

THURSDAY:
Open Skate
6:00pm - 9:00pm
Admission $5.00
Skate rentals $3.00

(For more session times check out their website)

I had to change my review. Saigon Harbor use to be amazing. I don't know what happened. The pho bowls are smaller and the prices are higher. The broth isn't as good as it use to be. The appetizers have changed significantly in taste. All prices were raised and food quality lowered. What a huge disappointment. Also the service is extremely slow. You can wait for pho there up to 40 minutes. It just doesn't make sense. I think they got a new chef or management.

We came here last Saturday night while shopping at the mall around 6:30pm. We were told the wait was 5 minutes but it was more like 20 which wasn't a big deal. But I was surprised when we were sat that half the back dining room was empty with so many people waiting for tables. They also didn't allow our stroller in the dining area which was fine but they made us leave it right inside of the entrance which left it unattended while they sat tables which made us uncomfortable. It took 15 minutes to get one beer and a cocktail, and the bread didn't come out until 5 minutes before our food was served. Our waitress was nice and our Hawaiian and Thai chicken pizzas were good. Our daughter's kids meal was a big portion we had plenty for lunch the next day. Our experience wasn't great this time around but it's a good dining option in the mall we would probably come back in the future.

I would make it a point to stop here for brunch a few times a month, but I stopped. The service is poor and the servers do not treat EVERYONE the same! I ordered breakfast potatoes with my brunch meal that tastes like they were cooked next or with meat. I do not eat red meat or pork. When I told my server that the potatoes tasted like meat and weren't  good. She said "Oh yeah they cook potatoes on the same grill with the meat!" Then she walked away and did not come back for at least 20min, She never offered to correct the order or asked how we liked everything. Additionally she didn't refill coffee or our mimosas at all. That was my last visit. I know go to brunch at Michele's in Dover Downs cost way more but food and service is better!
Delicious asparagus fries. I had the tri tip salad with a blue cheese vinaigrette and a cup of the tomato bisque soup. Great experience.

I`ve used Dave`s Limousine service for few years. They are excellent. Always on time, always there, as helpful as can be. Example: my mother does not speak ANY English and does not use a cell phone (I know...), but every single time I asked them to somehow connect us, they would go out of their way and make extra phone calls and wait, etc..
I have no idea where all these negative comments are coming from. It is a shared ride and a very reasonable price.

I used to love this place years ago when it first opened. However, on my last visit I ordered a salad that included chicken. The quality of the chicken was not as good as before. It seemed like lunchmeat quality or just not real, fresh chicken. Tijuana Flats is by far a better choice.

I was staying at a local hotel.  Saw the Pizza Hut and stopped in to order a meat lovers.  The pizza was ready quickly and was still hot when I got back to my hotel room.  The pizza was really good.  I wish I had ordered in advance as it would have cost a lot less, but hey, I had a good pizza.

I'm back in town & will call in my next order and pick it up.
Stopped by here randomly after reading some great reviews. The Philly cheesesteak was delicious and very friendly service. Definitely coming back next time I'm in town.

One of my favorite places to take visitors to the area. They have a wide variety of items on the menus to fit omnivore, vegetarian, and vegan diets. Every thing is very flavorfull and the atmosphere is fun and inviting. The only complaint is that most of the metal chairs are horribly uncomfortable. I will most often request to sit at a high top or at the bar.  Favorite things are the roti, curry pho, lettuce wraps.

After being there 5 minutes with no acknowledgement I asked if there was a server in our corner. There were at least 5 servers there. After being there 10 minutes we finally got a server. After our order was taken I askwd to talk to the manager.  I told her we were definitely not happy and why.  We had been there for over half an hour once we got our food.  My order went back twice before they got it right.  Plus a table that came 10 minutes after us got served first.  Though the manager felt bad and comped our meal, we will never go back to that one again.

Always on the road looking for clean, friendly, delicious and healthy. Found it here. Probably wouldn't have stopped had it not been for the Yelp reviews. It's a small, unassuming sandwich shop in a small plaza that's easy to overlook. Sandwiches are great and they have wonderful fresh, homemade sides. The carrot and raisin salad was perfect. Love these kinda places where the people care and it shows in everything. Congrats, I was so pleasantly surprised that I wrote my very first Yelp review after using it for years.
yummy food but they can give you just a little bit more of it and I think their prices are just a little bit too high on some of their items. But other than that I think it is yummy.

I have been a fan of The Couch Tomato for several years.  They often change the menu and there are some really unique and healthy salads.  We usually order the calzones instead of the pizza and we're never disappointed with the taste of the food.  They seem to use really fresh ingredients.  They also make really great homemade soups.   I am only giving three stars because it seems that over the years, the prices have gone WAY up and the amount of food you get has gone down.  Tonight, we ordered "small salads" and for $5.99 it was literally the smallest salad I've ever seen!  I'm not sure where they even get those tiny containers.  Again, the food is great.  The delivery is convenient and the prices are outrageous.

From the outside, you wouldn't think that Nail Garden is worth entering. Once you step inside, you completely rethink this. The service is great and they immediately ask your desire to be there. The employees are polite and give great pedicures! I am a huge fan and wouldn't go anywhere else. I've had terrible experiences at even the newest and cleanest nail salons! I would recommend this to anyone any day!

Absolutely best views and best restaurant in all of Florida. We sat down to drink and got to basically watch a whole dolphin show! SO COOL! The only downfall to this place is it's only cash (they do have an ATM) and the wait staff was incredibly rude. We felt like a burden to them most of the time. Still worth going to visit though!

I consider myself a Mexican food aficionado. I lived in Arizona for 10 years and I probably eat more Mexican food in a year than most people will in a lifetime. Having just moved to the neighborhood our real estate agent suggested we check out café Ynez. I loved the ambience of the place when I walked in. The staff were extremely friendly and the menu is great. They have something for you adventurous folks and something for the people that won't deviate from the standard quesadilla. Given all that I have to say the food was FANTASTIC. Simply amazing. Guacamole was perfect and the homemade chips are to die for. I had the pork tacos and the sauces that come with it are out of this world. Fresh, delicious ingredients prepared perfectly and well priced. This place is a gem. It's hard to find with only a tiny sign but well worth searching. I can't wait to go back.
The chocolate covered coffee beans are PERFECTION! Not too much bean for the chocolate, the ratio is perfect! So addicting! Great prices and the staff is really nice!

Food is about 3.5. Atmosphere is 5 stars. 

I love the tacos. They can be quite heavy but they are fun and tasty. My issue with the food are the chips and guacamole. For a taco joint it's hard to get over bad chips and guacamole. The chips are really heavily fried and the guac is blended. I never turn down a chip or guac and I couldn't finish this. 

Love the fun atmosphere and pretty good margs so it kind of evens out.

We came here for a birthday dinner. The appetizer was good: fried portabellos with a horseradish sauce and we loved the sauce. The complimentary mushroom soup was outstanding. My husband had the night's special veal chop which was large and delicious, but underdone for his preference. The waitress had neglected to ask for how he wanted his cooked and he did not specify. I had the wahoo special with mango. I found the fish to be slightly overcooked and dry as a result. The sauce was less tasty than I would have expected. We have eaten here previously and loved the food, so this time did not meet our expectations.

I'm torn. I was obsessed with this place when it first opened. Their portion sizes have gone down dramatically whether it be the French fries as the side or the toppings on a burger. However, the quality is top notch. Their burgers are creative and delicious. The beer options are plentiful and always changing. The bar has large TVs if you're wanting to watch the game or nice tables if you're wanting a night out with the family.

Perfect lunch! Jojo was quick and awesome! I love how the managers come and check on the customers! Specifically Mrs. Maria. I noticed she went by each table and made sure everyone in the restaurant was satisfied!

We loved this restaurant. Classic upscale New Orleans restaurant. Our waiter as she called herself Alicia couldn't have been better. Between food suggestions to area suggestions she was one of the tops. No rush at this place. Sit enjoy and indulge. I would go back. We also had the best table in the back on the main floor. Loved it.

This was my First Time being back in New Orleans in a while . We stayed at the Marriot on Canal once we left Frenchmen street this was basically the only place still open. When we got to the front door the smell was hideous like Dead Rats or Something immediately I wanted to turn around but It was 8 of us and I was out numbered . So we stood at the door about 3 minutes before being seated at like 2 Am . Waitress was friendly the food came out fast I ordered A omelet with bacon snd mushrooms with my side being hash browns . The omelet was just Ok but the hash browns were greasy cold and burnt up Looking others at the table also got cold Food which was promptly brought to their attention and asked if they could bring out Freshly Heated Food. Everyones ticket is put together for a Grand Total plus her Tip for having a table over 5. We asked For change which they did not have so with it being 8 of us that made it worst . We asked for a Manager she claimed one was not available but offered the Number to contact . Overall I will never Return to Daisy Dukes Near the Marriot at 555 Canal Street .

I came across this place with a friend while in Philly for business. I had Googled Best Happy Hours in the city and this one was highly rated, so we decided to give it a shot. I was bowled over! Great little "graffiti-style" alley bar attached leads to Sampan, which had three beautiful rooms (including a Speakeasy downstairs), each with their own unique personality and decor. We sat in the sidebar and ordered away. Everything on the happy hour menu was $4 OR LESS, so we gorged ourselves. We had the Korean Beef Satay ($3), the Shrimp Dumpling, Pork Potsticker, Beef Dumpling, Vegetable Spring Roll, Pork Bahn Mi, Chicken Bao Bun and the Kim Chee Fried Rice (all $4 each!). A few items were on the smaller side, which was completely understandable considering the prices, however some were pretty substantial! We probably finished a little more than half of our items, but everything we ordered was fantastic and the price made it just that much better! The happy hour drinks featured a few beers and a house red/white, as well as a featured cocktail/punch of the day. The bartenders were super friendly and engaging, and offered us samples of the punch (the sample being more like 2/3 of a full glass). All-in-all, highly recommended and will be back when I'm in Philly again.

It's a cute cafe in Old City. Nothing truly out of the ordinary, but I'll meet someone for tea here to talk. 

The bagels and food are dandy - I had no idea I could get a decent lunch here by getting a bowl of soup (comes with bagel)! The tea is fine, the iced tea is a nice treat. The coffee is fine, not spectacular.

A note of caution - if you plan on bringing a laptop for the internets, you need to get a code from the desk every hour ... and it sometimes doesn't work. Doesn't bother me much, because you can't expect a cafe in Old City to let the laptop-ers camp out when it's a high traffic place. So just put your laptop away and enjoy a good conversation.

I had the brakes done on my porshe here. The price was $209 lower than the mechanic I usually go to quoted! I think when repair shops hear performance cars names they automatically raise their prices. I'm glad mike made me feel comfortable by giving me the prices of the parts.and work up front! He was very helpful. I will be back!
AWFUL. Ordered fish and chips but it should have been called "breading and chips." The burger sucked and birds come up immediately after people leave and eat off their plates. Gross.

We got mixed plate for two - amazing and we have two meals of leftovers! Consists of chorizo, chicken, skirt steak, filet, and pork. All very juicy tender and flavorful! Good service and fun atmosphere! Happy hour is 50% off entire bill Mon through Friday from 4:30-6:30.

This hotel is probably as out dated as the late Fess Parker himself. Everything is worn out and needs refurbishing from the carpet to the beds. The location is the only thing earning this review two stars. Anyone that gives this hotel a decent review must be so excited to be near the beach that it numbs their senses to the quality and cleanliness of the actual hotel rooms and grounds.
I love this place very animal you would think of is there and it's free admission it is amazing if you are in Saint Louis I WOULD recommend you going,the only thing is there is a lot of walking

I love this place. Only have eaten the wings here and they're always great. Only problem is I got super case of stomach sickness the next day. Feel better the same night but man did I pay for it. Could have been eating 25 myself did the trick. Still will be back for more wings maybe just in moderation and not overindulge. Would have given four stars if I felt better today.

Super cute inside and friendly service.   Several coffee options to choose from. I had an americano that was decently priced and a really good temperature. 

There were a few snack options but in the 5 mins between when I ordered and when I got my coffee, my chocolate croissant was forgotten.   When they remembered , they pulled it out of a fridge, opened the plastic that sealed it and warmed it.  I know these things aren't made in house but would have loved to seen them on display rather than piled out of a fridge and thrown in microwave essentially....it would have elevated the classy experience I was otherwise provided.

Roof was leaking and it was muggy and hot. TONS of employees standing around and very few customers. This is the 2nd time in about 6 months I've been here (and only the second time in a year I've been here) and both times I've asked to see a firearm with the intention of purchasing it. Last time, I asked 3 people to assist me and each said they were assigned a different area. After waiting an absurd amount of time I left. As I walked out, the employee 15' from me said sorry we couldn't help you. It should be noted that employee even tried calling others on the phone to get them to do their job to no avail. 

Today, I asked to see a $700 gun. The guy behind the counter said he couldn't show it to me because he was a "range safety officer" and had to watch the range. This same guy has his back to the range as he said this. He also was talking and not paying attention immediately preceding my request. He then told me that only one of the other guys behind one of the other counters could show me the gun. He then stared blankly at me and I asked him if it was my responsibility to fetch someone so I could give them a bunch of money, and he got the hint. He then asked another employee to help at which time that employee cut him off saying he was already helping someone. I then walked out with my pocket still full of money and numerous employees standing around at this dilapidated range. 

If I'm being honest, there have been other times long ago where I had very shitty service at this place and I don't think I'm coming back. I don't feel like describing the incident, but it was enough to get me to email their corporate office. They need better management and smarter employees who understand that businesses need to make money to succeed. This is why people just buy the guns online for cheaper.

This place makes the BEST Old Fashions I have ever tasted!!!!  Their food is spot-on.  The Beer Cheese Dip is a must!!  Great staff and the owner really cares.  My favorite new place in Ybor, GET THE WORD OUT!!!!
FANTTASTIC! From service to presentation to delectable food, to fabulous wines, Cooper's Hawk has it all!!!! Will definitely be back and will definitely enjoy being part of their wine club!

Papas Fritas, vegetable board, scallops and octopus. 
All was top notch including the red sangria and sundae for desert. 

Jamonera is a absolute gem in Philadelphia  and if you do joy love it . . . you are impossible to please.

I live much closer to the Oro Valley Store.  So it has surely become my favorite store.  I have not been here for a while.  Went in yesterday just moseying around looking for an outdoor chatchka for the outside.  There is so much stuff to decorate the outside of your house as well as inside.  Couldn't make up my mind though.  Got several ideas.  Anyhow, love checking out their gourmet food area which I believe has tripled in size since my last visit.  TJMaxx and Marshalls are all under the same umbrella.  More of favorite stores as well.  I found my much loved jam from Kozlowski's Farms in Roseville, Calif.  Fig and Muscat Wine. Amazingly delicious.  In the clearance section there were two jars and I quickly picked them up before anyone could get to them.  What a deal $2.50 each.  Yum.  The selection of chips is amazing.   A bit expensive but if you are into healthy style eating it's quite an array of so many gourmet selections.  Tons of bathroom, kitchen, children's room, art, plaques, picture frames, dog items.  It's a potpourri of goodies.  Love love Home goods.

Wonderful servers!  Great brunch while wilding out for BFF's surprise bday fiesta! Thank you, staff, for having us, up from LA & Orange County, where things get more complicados! I enjoyed a local IPA, go Goleta! "Hoppy Papi," played Jimi on my iPhone too loud, devoured half a salmon omelette, & had a memoria !que valía la pena!

Along with good food, there are several pluses we have from our visit:

1) The guy who handled check-ins was great. He was energetic. He explained the procedures. He greeted people as they came in. He also spoke to us as we left.
2) Our waitress (Coco) is good at her job. Personable. Attentive. Explained how family style worked.
3) The shift manager was attentive to the needs of the handicapped person with us, from great seating for a person with a wheelchair  to making an extra effort to work out a special need our handicapped person had in relation to needing help (husband) in the bathroom.  SO GREATLY APPRECIATED.  Too often we encounter places that claim to be wheel-chair accessible, but that seems to only apply to getting in the door.

While it's good to have good food, it is also good to have excellent customer service.

I am a frequent customer at nature food patch or what I like to call NFP.  This is by da my fav grocery store in the area.  I am a big fan of their salad bar and the hot food bar! Everything is so fresh with no artificial ingredients! I have befriended many of the awesome staff! Everyone is so friendly and knowledgable!
Ordered a side of grits and got a sample of grits, really! Exactly two spoons of it. Come on Biscuit Love! That side of grits was pretty sad

My families FAVORITE place for dessert!!!! Seriously, there is no other yogurt this good. I've been to them all. In the spirit of full disclosure, one of my kids actuall likes Pink Berry better, we are still trying to figure out where he came from...
Amazing!!!!  Service was great as was the food. Have nothing bad to say. Burgers were cooked to perfection and exactly as ordered.

Oh yes!!! This place is amazing. Fresh crab, shrimp & fish for your broth. You flavor your broth from the sauce section in the back. Unlimited meats and broth that you will be stuffed full. I can't wait to go back. The price point is perfect for such a big meal. Service was good. No problems. The lady even cooked the beef at the table to free up our hands. That's service. Drinks always full. Even tho the restaurant was full.

I am not a big beer drinker so I don't come here very often. I'm told, however, that they have a great selection if you are into that sort of thing! I ordered the brunch burger which was grilled to perfection and topped with a fried egg, bacon, cheese, and maple mayonnaise. Holy delicious! Everyone else in my party also enjoyed their meals, although I can't remember them because I was so infatuated with my burger...

After Titus (my '96 Saturn SL2) was destroyed in an accident on 395, I took a couple months to decide on a new car. My old car had gotten me through high school, college, and the first couple years of my professional career, so I really wanted to make sure I was buying a car that was gas efficient, reasonably priced, and (most importantly) cute. After all my online research, I decided that I wanted a Mazda 3. 

Although I was buying the car on my own I had my dad take me out to the dealership for a test drive. The place was dead a day after a snow storm, so there weren't many people working. A guy named Ciso took us on a really fun test drive. Ciso was extremely knowledgeable about all the features and packages available for the Mazda 3. He also respected that although I am a "young lady" it was my purchase and my dad was there for moral support. Ha! I really enjoyed working with Ciso. 

Down side to Dolan is that the color and trim level that I wanted was not available. Dolan did say they could find the car in the color I wanted, but I wouldn't get any special financing or rebates that were being offered. So I turned to the internet and found the exact car I wanted--color and all--at a dealership in Sacramento. Through text/email I let Ciso know which car I wanted. He had to correspond with his managers to see what they could do. The price Dolan said they could get for that exact car would be about $1,000 more than MSRP. The price if I bought from the Sacramento dealer was $4,000 less than the Dolan inventory (which didn't have the right color). Dolan was also unwilling to drop the price of any of their models to match the Sacramento rate. Needless to say I made the short trip to Sacramento and purchased the exact car I wanted and saved a few thousand dollars on it as well. 

Overall, I really enjoyed the test drive and shopping experience with Dolan. There was no pressure to buy that day and Ciso was so knowledgeable about the product. However, once we got to the buying point there was a lot of pressure and not a lot of willingness to negotiate on Dolan's part.

The food was ok. I had the Benedict (Santa Fe). It was a good spicy but bland at the same time? My partner had the Bloody Mary and it had bacon, also not spicy and sort of bland. This place was busy even at 0800 in the morning. We were a party of two so we were seated very quickly. I know I've been saying the food is sort of bland but the service staff is very friendly and attentive. And the food is actually pretty good for a moms and pops place. Other breakfast places are also over priced but the food is the same and service isn't good. I recommend this place but it is pricey. This place is small and not kid friendly. You can hear other people's conversations also. So there's that.

Ok, it's confession time. I am usually a visitor of HotBox in the wee hours of the morning after an evening of drinks and dancing. Let me tell you, HotBox always sounds like a good idea after drinks and dancing. I typically go with the usual pepperoni pizza. What can I say? I like my pepperoni. And the breadsticks! Don't forget about the breadsticks. And the cheese for dipping? Heavenly.

HotBox may or may not have the same effect on me in the middle of the day, but I have faith that the pizza would taste just as good. It's very much a "college" type setting with the plastic HotBox cups that comes with your meal, but hey - it keeps ya young! 

The one located on Georgia Street is conveniently placed next to Howl at the Moon. Coincidence? I think not.

Very good, authentic mexican food. Though it has $$ here on yelp, i find the prices to be closer to $. The tacos are the best I've ever had, and so far every dish we've tried has been very delicious.  The wait staff is extremely friendly. Friday nights with the mariachi  (?) band is a real treat.
Go here for the atmosphere and to people watch. It's usually a lively crowd on the weekends. The drinks are decent but the food is just ok.
Food was very very good. Fast and friendly service. The menu was a little hard to understand but I was pleased with my order and will definitely return.
I love my hair. After 5 hrs my hair went from black to ash blonde. I'm very much satisfied with the results. After almost 2 month my hair still looks great. I use purple shampoo to upkeep the color.

This literally is my favorite restaurant. From sitting at the bar to the full dining, I have ALWAYS had an amazing time.

The red sangria is the best I've ever had.

The interior design influenced how I decorated my house. It just feels warm, sophisticated, and somewhere you'd want to get food/wine drunk on a hot date.

The food is above average than most of American Chinese take away. Price is also reasonable. Staff are nice. They were waiting for me at the door when I arrived. Payment process was fast with social distancing. I will definitely return.

By far the best Mexican restaurant I've been too in my entire life!

Great service, excellent food, the staff was very nice. There's quite a wait in line while ordering but that was totally expected. They have a very large menu to choose from anywhere for breakfast burritos, to tortas, to tacos.

Best place for Mexican cuisine in all of Santa Barbara, CA.

Still open 24 hours, free garage parking when you spend 10$ and a shitty staff that will eye down your top and instead of being helpful will hit on you. On the bright side the fro was recently bought by shop rite so the prices have decreased and that's awesome!
This place was incredible....the service was amazing and the food was some of the best I've eaten in the Quarter.  I had the whole fish and Brussels.  Truly awesome!!
Great mall!!!!  Lots of different stores to meet all different style preferences. Very spacious. Not crowded at all. Would definitely recommend adding this into your trip when visiting Philly.

This is the place that legend speak about or at least America tend to deem as one of the two BEST FRIED CHICKEN SPOTS. 

IMO IT ISN'T EVEN CLOSE

This place does not compromise and let you pick or hem and haw about what you're getting. You're getting chicken, there is going to be a bit of spice, and you're getting 3 pieces. 

As all the more professional reviews kind of mention you're glad you got the 3 pieces. They are moderately sized pieces, so not huge piece of fried chicken. The are more then expertly fried, and I will say this: You don't feel like you're eating fried chicken with the way its been fried. It barely has that greasy oily feel. I WAS STUNNED. I could have had 6 pieces to myself but my wife and I shared a plate, in order to also order the Blackened Fried Catfish w/ fried Okra. 

Again another piece of fish that I have no idea where the oil goes, because its not in the fish, its not in the batter and yet here is this gold brown crusted and spiced fried Catfish. I know if i take a piece of paper or w/e you'll see the oil, but you don't taste it and it doesn't weigh you down.
Now if you get the fried Okra expect your plate, like mine, to be filled with Okra and the fish just sits on top. 

The server also recommended the bread pudding but they were out for the night and we'd have to come back just to experience it and we DID. 

The next morning we come back just for the bread pudding. And gotta say best BREAD PUDDING we had as well. This bread pudding is more moist, and is just simply done. Just the bread pudding, little bit of confectionery sugar and one single sliced up strawberry. The wetness of the bread pudding really let it melt on the palate. Again amazing service and even returning for lunch just to get 1 bread pudding the people couldn't be more accommodating.

We decided to spend a snowy Saturday in town, discovering new places. We decided to go to Midtown as there's always something new and everything is conveniently located within walking distance. 

First stop was Monaciello for brunch. We had no problem finding a parking spot at the small lot behind the restaurant. We were greeted by a friendly waiter and directed to chose the table of our preference. Monaciello is very small but they made the best out of the space. The floor to ceiling windows make it airy and open and does not feel constricted. I love the 50's style decor. They found the perfect balance, making it feel still contemporary not like you just went back in time. 

The service was quick and friendly. I had the veggie crepes. The filling was delicious: sautéed onions, mushrooms, spinach, corn, artichoke and olives. My boyfriend had the crab Benedict. He liked them. The eggs seemed to be perfectly poached and the sauce was velvety. Not too rich, not to thin. 

I'm not going to lie. I was there for the mimosas. When I heard that they have over 20 flavors that got my attention. I had the basil blackberry and my boyfriend the strawberry mango. They were fruity but a little light on the champagne. We ordered a glass of champagne to balance them out. 

We took a look tan the lunch and dinner menu and it sounds mouth watering. 

Ambience, food, drinks and service were good and this place is definitely a keeper. Mimosas here we come!
Told the waiter I respect her for working in a industry where the customers are rude especially when they are drunk, she blankly stared at me then ignored me. Well then, I'll take that back.

Delicious! Very friendly staff! Always happy to serve! 
Fresh French cuisine. Great go to on Tierra Verde that is consistent.

Delicious Vietnamese food- simple but ample menu- even as a vegan I am spoilt for choice with apps and entrees. My favourite is the Pho- very reasonable price and massive portion so much I get a to go box and have another meal at home! 
Prompt service even though the place is obviously popular so usually busy. Ginger tea here is really good too!

We were given a gift card and decided to use it 

Full disclosure I had an extremely poor experience at this location probably 15 or more years ago and have not set foot in a chilis since 

Wednesday night seated promptly wait staff friendly 

A group walks in with three kids seated a few tables away the child screeches continuously no parent disciplined the child and the wait staff and management did nothing to try to insure other patrons had a pleasant experience.  I know it's a chain restaurant and family oriented but there is a point where if parents are inept management needs to step in 

We ordered steak with shrimp and asparagus with mashed potatoes  they accommodated plain mashed with no issues    The asparagus were overly seasoned and needed to have the salt and pepper wiped off... barely edible the entire meal too salty steak tasty but over seasoned

Shrimp tacos very tasty the rice overdone and dry I substituted fries for beans they were hot tasty but way over salted 

Cheesecake for dessert very good accommodated strawberry goo Ilona the side 

The calorie counts on the meals are scary best not to look at them if you want to enjoy your meal I don't understand how some of the menu items are so high in caloric content 

Margarita very tasty and plentiful 

Well in all honesty they stepped up their game from years ago but still have a long way to go....

On my way to the bathroom I passed the kitchen and saw a wait staff eating on a food prep area.  That did not make me feel good but overall I thought the place was clean and well kept 

The checkout kiosk on the table is slightly confusing and did not print our receipt 

Beware mAny people in shorts and flip flops with their ugly Fred flintstone feet making the dining experience less than savory

My wife and I ate outside on a Friday night. They've got  a good selection of esoteric beers, the one I chose was $6.00 a glass. We both ordered the eggplant parm which was served with fresh mozzarella on a ciabatta roll. It was excellent. The french fries that came with it were also superior. My wife and I split a peach cobbler dessert which was also excellent.
Service was very attentive and friendly. We had tickets for the sketch comedy show upstairs which ended our evening on a high note.

What is the Porter Road Butcher Shop? A resturant? A deli? 

On Monday's the owners go visit all their area farmers. They know their farmers well. They even go to some Amish Farms. Anyways, They buy whole cows, pigs, goats - load em up and bring em on over to the hood on Gallitin. Then they chop, make, bake, cut it all up where its all used and sell it. They make even roast beef and Italian sausage. So as the week goes on everything sells and by Sunday most of the cases are empty because we'll they sold all the meets. They gas up the truck and head out Monday again to do the same thing. 

If you need a certain meat, or amount call em, tell em and they'll get it. They might be the nicest people ever. And they have cheese there too, which is great, but I'll save that story for another day. 

Hooray for Local Businesses!
Terrible service ever do not recommend people there are so rude. Very dirty place with hair everywhere on the floor and the person their working had the audacity I ask me what brung me in today

Best pizza place in town! I ate there at the pre-opening and I am already in love. I know where my families go-to pizza and pasta will be every time - always Mofo's! 

Did I mention the staff is super friendly!
Had an excellent donair here.  The sweet sauce was wonderful and lots of meat.  I was so hungry I did not get a pic but I will be back.

I had a wonderful "go green" omelet today with slices of avacado on top. It was delicious. I was in town for a swim me up at the high school and Yelp had pretty good ratings on it. I agree with their ratings and I gave them a 5 star because a great service from a waitress named Mel. She was fantastic. She even gave me a ice tea to go. I love yelp!!.
Sean H

Ok this is my second review.  If I could just rate their food I would say 4 stars, even though it is cold all the time.

Their service on the other hand should get a 0 star.  The waiters and waitresses are so bad you would think it is one of those theme places that they give you real mean  servers just to be funny.  

I have been there 3 times.  first time service was bad, second, worse, third horrible.

The girl got mad because we asked to split a check.  who does not do that?  And we did not even care about itemizing it.  Just divide by 4 is that too hard?  she had an attitude which can best be described as bad.  It was like we were doing her dirty by even ordering.  She never checked on us and shot us dirty looks because we ordered.  

I am sick of the wait staff and even though they have good food will never be back.

Death Penalty to Rooster.

Parc saved our Valentine's Day after the disaster at Branzino's just around the corner. 

They managed to squeeze us in for dinner without a reservation, and we were seated immediately when we arrived at 9:20, even though it was still quite busy! The server was incredibly accommodating and never rushed us, even though we could tell she had worked a busy and long night. The food was great, with HUGE portions. Bread came out first and was soft, warm, and delicious. They had a raisin nut bread that was to die for. Next we had escargot, which came in a rich sauce, full of garlic and mushroom flavors, and served with toasted crostini. Delicious. I had the lamb shank provencale, with goat cheese polenta, and my partner had the roasted duck, with spinach (I think), and both were cooked perfectly! The duck was slightly pink, and the skin was crispy, leaving it moist and divine. The lamb shank was fall off the bone tender, and the polenta was creamy and light. We had their special dessert for Valentine's Day, which was a hazelnut mousse wrapped up like a present with raspberry coulis tucked inside. So yummy, light, and perfectly sweet. Thank you, Parc, for saving our Valentine's Day!

I heard from a lot of people that this place was awesome.  Anything with seafood is awesome, the dip is fantastic, and the fish tacos are very authentic.  If I had to leave something bad to say "I" thought the churros were a lil overcooked- it's happens easier than you think.  It's usually steady Yelpers that advised me on the quality of this place through the reviews.  Otherwise it would simply "approach" a 3-star with a binomial distribution under "the bell curve".  Be BOLD, I've been chewed out by owners because I left them a 1-star review. 90% of those places were closed in 6 months.  I'm not there to bash them- it's constructive criticism.  El Pavo real was also kind of warm.  And then I looked at A/C vents. They might want to consider one of those ductless systems that hang on the wall.  It's EASY to be the critic.  But the waitress from SoCal was knocking it out the park.  Hope you get her.

The website states the top priority is the customer.  Their top priority is $$$.  Not an honest dealership lease on a Camry $459 a month???   Do not even consider this dealership.  Customer service is non existent. Rip off artists from the start.

On a recent lunch hour I decided to stop by NOPSI and I have to say  impressed doesn't begin to describe my visit. 
It all began when I walked by and to my wondering eyes should appear you guessed it a streetcar named Desire of course I had to stop, I am a sucker for a streetcar,  mix that with the reference to Tennessee Williams and you couldn't stop me. 
The Conductor was a lovely and extremely helpful young man named  who led me in an impromptu tour of what can only be described as a magnificent establishment.  From the grand ballroom to the cozy nooks perfect for a couple to sip a cocktail and whisper sweet nothings.  
NOPSI is an experience in itself complete with a restaurant, several bars, beautiful rooms and a staff that will insure your visit will be unforgettable. 
Slip away for lunch and cocktails with your sweetie and just phone in because we all need to play hookie once in a while.
For a planned evening in town the central location is great perfect for hopping into the Quarter or slipping away to Collette's make NOPSI your home base. NOPSI hasn't forgotten your furry friends bring them along or give the hotel a call when you need to schedule Rovers birthday party. 

Remember stop by and say hello to Kelvin

Cochon is not what it could be. I've had better alligator in Texas. Way better fired boudain balls at damn near any gas station in Acadiana.  If they opened a satellite location in St Martinsville they would go broke in a week.  $10 for 3 boudain balls?  Really?  Since anthony bourdain came here this place is brimming with Yankees looking for true cajun or creole cooking.  You may find that here. But get ready to pay a kings ransom for the same fried stuff they serve any Chevron on I-10. Is it too late to catch a cab to the blue crab?

The Best in service , food and music.
We had a very delightful waiter.
Seated quickly 
White linen table cloths 
One of the finest in a restaurant.

One of the worst experiences I've had. Upon entering this facility, it took more than 10 minutes for someone to greet me. When asked for a basic pedicure, the receptionist stated that "to let him see because there's appointments", obviously I was confused because on their website it states that walk-ins were welcomed. When asked if I should make an appointment, the receptionist stated " I could if I wanted but he was unsure if anyone would take me". I was a little confused by his statement. He then went to the back after someone encouraged him to check to see if someone was available, the nail tech that was sitting in the back, turned the corner, peeked at me and shook her head no. He than returned and stated that if I wanted a pedicure, I would have to wait 30/40 minutes. One of the worst experiences of my life. I will never support this place again and I encourage everyone else to try other shops in the area that's inclusive.

This is the best Indian and Pakistani food I've had in Indiana. The food is extremely fresh and the flavors are spot on. Atmosphere is not the best ever but I come here for the phenomenal food. I recommend the Goat Karahi, and tandoori chicken for sure. But everything on their menu has not disappointed me. Highly recommended.
No one here, not one employee or manager wears a mask until they are speaking directly to you.  I felt very uncomfortable with my health safety and left.  Not to mention it's the law in Pasco County.

Does anyone look at yelp reviews for dental offices? I don't know, but I still need to get this off my chest. The dentist, the employee is the kids' coloring room and the receptionist that checked us in were really nice and professional. The rest of the place was just horrible. This review is for the roosevelt blvd location only. We arrived 5 minutes before our appointment as new patients. They send you into the waiting room that's behind closed doors. They're extremely busy and overcrowded. They call you up to the desk through a loud speaker. It was 20 minutes before we were called back to the front desk. After making copies of our insurance cards we were sent back to the waiting area. It was almost another 30 minutes (or more) before we were called back to see the dentist. The dentist was awesome. The assistant was an idiot. Maybe she was having a bad day because the place is overcrowded. Amongst all the craziness she quickly told me they'll send me a postcard for a check up in 6 months. I went to the check out area, because I always make sure we're all good with our insurance. The assistant says, "Mom? THEY.WILL.SEND.YOU.A.POST.CARD.IN.SIX.MONTHS." What an ignorant idiot. I am going to try another location even if it's further away.

My husband surprised me with this tour for my birthday last weekend. I have always wanted to go to Santa Barbara's wine country and his idea of taking a tour was perfect. Lisa, our guide and certified sommelier, was great! She had great information and history throughout our trip. The drive was beautiful and she made it even better by pointing out sights & sharing stories. In the beginning she asked us if we knew what kind of wines we enjoyed and from there she took us to our first winery. She made sure to observe what we enjoyed and disliked and tailored the rest of our trip to our tastes. She led us to what are now our fave wines (by the way,  my husband and I have different tastes). 

We were picked up from our hotel and We went to 4 wineries. She also had us pick from a lunch menu before the trip and we enjoyed our delicious sandwiches at a picnic table at one of the wineries. She provided plenty of water and made sure to take a picture of us at every winery. Which, was great, because we kept forgetting to take pictures ourselves. 

During the tastings, she would step out and just let us enjoy ourselves. You can tell she has a good relationship with the wineries and we were able to take a behind the scenes tour through one of them. 

The ride was very very comfortable. I highly recommend this tour! They also have a wine, cheese and chocolate tour in Ventura, which we will definitely be going to someday.
Priority car care and tire was fantastic at fixing my car. Jeff and his crew are knowledgeable and helpful. I will be taking my car for all future repairs and maintenance. Thank you Jeff and crew!

My favorite! I've heard a lot of great things about cafe patachou but I'm glad this morning I finally got to experience it first hand. I went around 9:00 & it was about a 15 minute wait. The atmosphere was very enjoyable. It's a cozy, inviting and  a bit of a hipster vibe. They offered coffee while you wait to be seated, but didn't realize it cost $3.00 for a cup of joe once you received your bill. The menu was a bit confusing to read, there's a lot to take in! I ordered "the omlet you can't refuse" an it didn't disappoint! The fruit and cinnamon bread I enjoyed along with it was very filling! One thing I would say is you do get a lot for your money but it's a rather expensive breakfast shop. Cafe patachou overall was a very good place to unwind & enjoy a filling breakfast this morning. I will be going back shortly!
During this Covid mandated isolation, this Diamond Credit Union found it appropriate to dock my account for: "Debit Card Non-Use Monthly Fee".

Horrible expensive treats! I got a mocha and it was good. Got my dad a triple fudge brownie ice cream that was advertised and it was the tiniest dinky thing ever. I regret not getting out money back. The brownie was small and dry and there was barely any ice cream. Ridiculous.

Best naan I've ever had! I came here with co-workers and we tried a ton of different entrees. Besides the naan, the tikka masala, vindaloo and eggplant vegetarian dish were my favorites. The service was great (possibly because we were only one of 3 tables) and the staff is very nice.

Great food but pricey.
The service was lacking in attention and had our food before we got silverware or napkins.
Since it was right there where you saw the movie it was a good location.

I have been waiting for actual good Mexican food in Carmel for a while. I didn't even realize this place was here. Its a little bit hidden on Carmel Drive. But I will be a repeat customer, the food was super good. I am actually going there tonight to get more yummy dinner. I loved the flan and the horchata.

My wife and I have eaten  at Bella Italia several times. We have made many trips to Italy and I can tell you the food at Bella Italia is fairly authentic. The service is good,the food is very good and the ambiance is like a restaurant in Italy. The prices are reasonable. They have a chefs special for two. You get an appetizer, a trio of an entre, and desert. It is quite good. Highly recommend Bella Italia.

I can't say I'm impressed. It's ok but we had a Jr suite in their new tower and it just ok. The beds are comfy, but the room was extremely warm even though we had it set to cool and down as low as it would go. Mind you it's the end of February.  Our room was on the train yard side and even though we are 20 floors up. You can hear them all day and night. 

We went to Rosie's for dinner two night in a row. The food is ok. Definitely dinner quality. It's cheap though which is nice. 

A huge plus for me.. there is a Starbucks in the lobby.

Their WiFi is a huge down fall. It is not secured with a password. And is beyond slow.

Solid spot for Bikram. I've only ever practiced at one other studio and it was in Chicago...so I was a bit nervous to try new teachers. However, it didn't disappoint. 

Today was my first day back to hot yoga after a year's hiatus...and man, I'm rusty. I've been running a little too much and it was starting to bother my hips and knees; so my answer is always hot yoga. If you're a runner or athlete, Bikram will help not only your body, but also your mind. I highly recommend it. 

The instructor, James, was very thorough and his corrections were helpful. I would suggest trying his class whether you've done Bikram in the past or not.

Great place to stop in for a quick casual lunch or take it to go. Discovered it a few years ago with my teenage son- he loves it. Lots of workmen types come for lunch cause it's good for subs- gyros etc.  My husband had the cheesesteak and it smelled delicious and he enjoyed it.
I had the Greek salad with chicken on top. It was large and very fresh- tomatoes here are always red and tasty not barely pink and flavorless!
The grilled chicken they use for chicken gyros and topping the Greek salad is seasoned well and my favorite.
     The place is small and bright- great pita too.  Counter help is friendly and good parking. Eat in or take out but try it.

This place is awesome! The hashbrown casserole is da bomb. My food came really fast and the entire staff was sooooo nice. The place wasn't packed but I came on a Friday around 1-2. I got the pulled pork, h/b casserole, greens and bread.. yum! 
I will definitely be back

I was staying in Riverview with a friend. After a series of plumbing leaks, leaks that she was repairing one at a time she finally experienced a huge pipe burst. After calling and emailing multiple plumbers, Cass got back to me almost as soon as I pressed enter. They were out at the house in 14 hours and were able to give a full evaluation of the problem. They also provided an estimate. With estimate in hand, I shoped around. Cass was right in line with the cost. Within  a week the entire house was replumbed. An entire house recieved an entirely new system, the old system shut down and the water heater, outside spikets, etc. all properly hooked up and working perfect.

Cass was professional, worked without budget and did things quickly. 

There were a few things that I didn't expect. When I reached out to Cass for clarity, they came back out, fixed a few things that were not part of the contract and did it with free of charge. They put quality and customer service ahead of dollars.

If I ever need, or know of anyone that needs, plumbing services, Cass will be my first and last call.

I didn't want to write a review about this place as its one of my secret hide-aways (which I want to keep secret) but the cat's already well out of the bag. This is my favorite bar in this section of the Warehouse District as they always have cold beer at a fair price with attentive bartenders.  The food is generally good and they have one of the best shepherd's pies in the city.  Most of the crowd in this area seems to stay focused on Lucy's so you can either deal with waiting and standing over there or you can almost always find a seat in Vic's and get quick service.
Recently took my niece and nephew to get books. They love going there to pick out books.   This time we also got cookies from the cafe.

I am only giving this a 1-star because the system doesn't allow zeroes. On the strength of the Yelp reviews my family had its only meal in New Orleans here that last time we visited. Omigosh. While the fried eggplant fingers were passable, anyone could have made these. Meanwhile my shrimp ettouffe still scares me to think about it. The shrimp were spongy and tasteless and the ettouffe lacked character. While the corn side dish was tremendous, I couldn't get over the shrimps' lack of texture and taste. Meanwhile our waiter seemed oblivious to the fact none of us were eating our meals and boisterously spoke about how we were clearing our plates with gusto. Never again.

Good experience turned bad...

I originally booked the Nugget on Hotels.com and received a decent rate. I booked individual nights because a family member is in the hospital and I wasn't sure when they would be released. My third night, while checking in, I mentioned that I was a veteran. The ladies behind the desk told me that I could receive a veterans discount and that I'd pay a grand total of  $58.45 each night. As you can imagine, that did not happen and is the reason I am writing this review. Instead, I was charged $122 for one night on a weekday! It was a total bait and switch and very unappreciated. Long story, short, if you have a relative in an area hospital (Renown in my case), stay at Circus Circus for $40/night (you need a letter from the social worker to get the rate.)
Love the place, even make them at home.  I drink the cafe' au lait just like it comes.  A must visit if in the Quarter.

The server standing on the patio ignored us when we arrived- only when my friend started to head inside to ask for service did he suddenly ask "how many?" They took my ID when we sat down- I assume so we don't dine and ditch- so insulting. The food was sub-par and the service worse. They automatically add 15% gratuity no matter the size of the party. Not coming back.
Always fast, good food and make it right. Can't complain - not the most amazing pizza in the town but always good for stay at home night :)

Clearly the best lobster roll ever! The fries are amazing. Everything fresh, very clean and friendly with excellent service. The place is a "sleeper" from the boardwalk! Don't walk by. We ate two lobster rolls and hand cut fries. Awesome!

The bathroom sink needs reglazing, the walls are thin so we listened to those in the rooms around us all night, there are no kitchen supplies in the kitchenette you need to ask the front desk for that, and what really grossed me out are their blankets. We are very happy with our Tish floors! They offered the best price of the 3 places we went to, they were knowledgeable and friendly (David).  It took longer than we were told, which is the only reason I'm not giving it 5 stars!  Jacob and Robert were all nice to work with and did a good job laying the carpet.
Great burger joint. Fries and dogs are great too. Milkshakes are good but overpriced imo. Always a goto spot when I'm not sure where to go.

We went there last Monday for lunch. Best salsa I ever had. The salsa had roasted peppers In it. Went there yesterday just for that. The dumb ass waiter didn't have a clue about the salsa. He offered to bring a bottle of hot sauce. HIGHLY DISAPPOINTED.
I went there on opening night and ate  some spicy tacos that were excellent, Plenty of TV's and a nice location(lots of parking) and the staff was very personable.
Best carne asada tacos in town with marinated beef, chopped white onion and cilantro, fresh tomatillo sauce, and fresh squeezed lime. Can't go wrong.

Best nieghborhood bar.  Awesome food, reasonably priced beverages, a bunch of flat panels, and an awesome staff.

The onion rings were soggy, again take out order, but I don't think they were every crispy by the looks of them. They also didn't have much flavor. Great Terriyaki chicken and pork fried rice! Crab ragoon are crispy bits of wow. I enjoy their lunch specials from every week

Beth designed our website last year. It's better than you can imagine, and has been recognized by many legal publications as being top notch. The site is unbelievably stylish, unique, and functional. It's always nice to support a family business, even better when they can accommodate large groups! 
Vito's is definitely a hole-in-wall family restaurant. I have driven down 135 more times than I can count and had never even noticed their sign, but that's also part of the family feel, no advertising needed, it's all word of mouth. 
As far as the food, their Garlic Bread is all I really need to say. It has that addictive garlic seasoning covering warm and flaky all you can eat loaves.  I chose the minestrone soup, which was good, but nothing special like the other reviews made their soup seem. For my meal I went with the Tortellini which is Spinach pasta stuffed with ricotta & romano cheese with tomato & alfredo sauce. It was good, not great. I'm normally more partial to marinara so the mix with alfredo pulled down the flavor for me. They do have an very strong dessert menu- traditional like spumoni and cannolis, along with more varieties like chocolate gelato cake with hazelnut powder. 
In my opinion, it's really hard to do Italian wrong. I'm looking forward to try their pizzas to see if they wow me more. Otherwise when I'm in the area I don't mind stopping by, but it's not a place that I will make special arrangements to go.
We were told about this Bistro a while back and decided to try it. The service was excellent! the place was packed for lunch. The food was great. We will be back!

For starters, I've eaten here a long time ago with friends and I didn't care too much for the food and all. It had been quite a while since I had eaten at Fitz's. I've attempted to eat here three times in the last six months and I would be ignored by the staff once they tell me to go to the bar. Yes, it gets very busy in there, and I get it. There are always families and couples waiting a long time to get seated. On my most recent visit, I was told to go up to the sports bar area where I sat at the counter. Service was slow, and the guy was sort of friendly, though I can tell that I was interfering with his sidework/cleanups and some of his other duties just by his facial expressions. There was a girl washing dirty ice cream glasses not far from me; that wasn't a pretty sight to see when I was about to eat! Another turn-off was there was so many dirty tables upstairs and most of them remained that way throughout my visit. 

I ordered the Delmar Chili Mac and the original Fitz's Root Beer Float. The mac was okay, but I was not given crackers or parmesan cheese like other places that serve that kind of thing give you. The Root Beer Float was fine, but it was so messy that if I were the server and/or bartender that made it, I would have embarrassed to serve it. I tried to sympathize with them, so I took the float. The ice cream was covering the whole thing at the top of the glass; usually when I drink root beer floats I like to taste both the root beer and the ice cream at the same time. That's just me, I guess. 

The bathrooms were gross, too. I only gave my server/bartender a $1 tip, and I hope he learns from my poor experience. I know, it could have been worse. Oh yeah, another thing: the bottling factory portion wasn't in operation during my visit, and it looked so dirty and unsanitary in there.
