Type of Order: Online

TLDR: Be VERY careful with how you word things, and pay VERY close attention to how they word things. A simple miscommunication has tangled up $89 dollars and caused a significant amount of stress trying to figure out what happened. Their product was great from my original order, but the actual service  was disappointing and frustrating. If I'm going to buy cigars in the future, it won't likely be through Thompson.

-

I made a purchase around 49 days ago online after viewing a promotional in one of their catalogs. Initially I had a very great experience. The Rocky Patel cigars I ordered arrived in great condition and were excellent product. Soon after ordering, I received a phone call, inquiring as to how my order went and my experience. During that phone call questions were asked of me about my smoking habits and preferred brands. All things I expect to be asked for ad targeting or coupons, things of that nature. 

Fast forward 49 or so days to today. I find a $89.18 charge on my card despite having not ordered or requested any new cigars. After waiting what seemed like an hour (In reality, it was about 20 minutes) I was able to get a hold of a representative whom I explained to that despite their insistence that I had signed up to be a club member, that I had not nor would have ever signed up for such a service. I mistakenly referred to the club as a "Monthly recurring charge" at which point the man went out of his way to clarify that it wasn't a monthly charge and was calculated based on my smoking habits and preferred brand. After talking with that representative for about five minutes, I was transferred to the "Club Care" support line. 

When speaking with that representative I explained the situation and that I was quite unhappy that the original caller (From that initial phone call around 49 days ago) had miscommunicated or somehow misunderstood and that I had not, nor would have signed up for a recurring (Whether it was 30 days or 49 days) program. 

I was informed that the shipment had shipped already and that I could no longer cancel the order, but could return it once it was received. Once they receive the returned package they would refund the charge to my debit card. I was sure to cancel whatever club membership they had signed me up for. As I was cancelling, the representative went so far as to ask me those questions again about how often I smoked and if I had a preferred brand - and was very intentional about mentioning that purchase wasn't necessary and neither were regular shipments to be a part of the "Club". The audacity! I'd never requested a shipment to begin with, and if no purchase was necessary then why was I signed up for an automated purchase of Oliva's? 

Be VERY careful with how you word things, and pay VERY close attention to how they word things. A simple miscommunication has tangled up $89 dollars and caused a significant amount of stress trying to figure out what happened. Their product was great from my original order, but the actual service was disappointing and frustrating. If I'm going to buy cigars online in the future, it won't likely be through Thompson.

Despite the utterly frigid weather, we had a most delightful three hour tour through the 9th Street Italian Market & Magic Gardens with our guide Arielle. What a fun and informative way to spend our morning! The market was fantastic, and we had a chance to taste many of the local purveyors. The bread and tomato pie from Sarcones were spectacular, and the cheese from Di Bruno was a mind blowing assortment. The corn tortillas from Tortilleria San Ramon were among the best we've eaten, and the subs from Georges were solid, as welll. The Magic Gardens were an unexpected treat - a beautiful labyrinth of mosaic art worth seeing. As a local, Arielle gave us a unique perspective of her beloved city as well as insider stories on the history, rivalries, and way of life in this area. Definitely recommend it!

GoldLeaf is a welcoming, excellent addition to our South Broad Ripple/Fairgrounds/etc. neighborhood. Although they opened in the middle of COVID, they appear to be doing well, thanks to their friendly owners & staff, creative and quality menu options that incorporate local products, and investment in the neighborhood. Plus, any place that offers Underbergs is A+ in my estimation. The baked goods and pastry options always look and taste great too, according to my pastry buff partner.  I like grabbing an Old Major truffle beef stick on my visits, for a lower carb snack, and hope to check out the chicken salad over arugula lunch option in the near future.    Once COVID dies down, we're interested in exploring GoldLeaf's beer/alcohol options once they feel comfortable re-opening their bar-top and expanding their hours.  GoldLeaf also partners with other 46th Street businesses, such as collaborating with Black Circle Brewing over a "Stay Gold" lager offering.

I also really enjoy GoldLeaf because my partner is a Phish-obsessive and jam band uber-fan, and the congenial owners tend to incorporate musical references into the naming of GoldLeaf's specials/options. He loves the hidden references and I get a chuckle out of observing the habits and conversations of the not-so-secret society of Phish fans whenever we visit GoldLeaf (i.e. the explanation behind the "Nutty Wook" dirty chai latte ).  The owners and staff are just amazingly nice, that you may personally get "please be my friend" feelings whenever you visit.  I highly recommend visiting GoldLeaf so you can enjoy its special and welcoming qualities.

I REALLY like this place and I already want to go back. At $10-13$ per bowl, it's a bit pricier than the typical ramen bar, but it has a casual, no-frills atmosphere. The space is VERY small. There are only a handful of two-person tables and the majority of seating is along the bar, which has a fantastic view of the open kitchen. When seated, you can  feel the floorboards move as people walk by. My friend and I sat at the high-top table in the back, which had stools with spinning seats. There was an awkward adjustment period of learning how to cross and uncross my legs without comically turning around on my seat, but that was more due to my clumsiness than anything else. 

Like the restaurant itself, the menu is on the small side too, but it still manages to have a handful of options that can be made veg friendly. I was very, very happy to have so many options. Few ramen bars have one, let alone THREE vegetarian/vegan main course offerings. Cheu scored big points with me there. The coconut curry I ordered was delicious. I thought a very generous helping of hot sauce helped bring out the already-stellar flavors, but that may just be personal preference. The noodles were really a standout. The texture was unique and excellent- bouncy and springy with juuuuust the right amount of chewiness. I only wish the bowl came in a super size! 

Next time I come back, I'm trying the other veg options. And I'm sitting at the bar.

I am such a big fan of the Little Baby's brand and ice cream that we are having a Little Baby's ice cream cart at my wedding and can't wait to have all of our guests try all the cool flavors! I am posting this review as I recently went in for a private tasting and I feel like a true aficionado as I tried probably 30 different flavors, so Yelp, lemme give you the rundown.

First of all the customer service here is always friendly and fun no matter how long the line is. A personal shout out to Meg who I believe is a manager and she is awesome. Secondly this place is not for the picky minded eater-- though there are tasty flavors like Plain (sweet cream) to appease you too, so fear not! Thirdly-- flavors you would never ever expect to like are actually amazing, like Pizza. Yes, Pizza ice cream is f*cking delicious. Imagine an herby delicious vanilla. 

LBIC also has their stuff together in terms of allergens, they can tell you the ingredients in everything, and they have vegan flavors to appease non animals eaters too. Also the vegan flavors are actually as good as the non vegan flavors. The cookies and cones are also vegan and the cookies are incredible. I believe they come from Crust Vegan Bakery, who also supply baked goods for Hip City Veg. Anywhom the best flavors ranked by me are Brown Butter Brawler-- sweet dear god yum, Lavender Pepper, Sour Honey Cherry, Blueberry Ginger, Chocolate Salt Malt, Dirty Chai and Mint Chocolate Cookie. You can't really go wrong here though as long as you are open minded!

I really wish I could give this place a better review. I'm constantly NEAR here but only just finally got a chance to go in tonight for dinner.

First things first, my server - there was a pair, both young women, one named Emma - were very nice. Attentive, sweet, friendly, couldn't have been more grateful.

My meal was less successful.

I started with their pretzel, which is $9 and comes with a cheese dip. It was burned on the top. Like literally the top crust of it was burned black. Beyond that it was really not very special in terms of a pretzel, something I would expect to pay $4-5.

The real disappointment though was the lasagna, at $23. It's a hefty portion, with bolognese, sauteed spinach and a piece of foccacia. The first weird thing is the spinach is not incorporated INTO the lasagna. It's just tossed on top. But beyond that, the preparation of the dish left it incredibly uneven.

The top noodle was burned HARD. Like, it was an inedible noodle, charred black around the edges. Yet somehow there were portions toward the bottom edges that were actually cold?

I can't say that flavor wise it wasn't tasty, and again, it was gigantic, but because of the way it was cooked it felt like it was numerous temperatures in different sections. For $23 I would have liked something prepared with more care.

I probably wouldn't come back here just because of how disappointing the food was, which is a shame because it's a really cute place and again, my servers were super duper lovely and kind.

We are in the area on a short trip and ordered delivery. 

Positives: delivery was fast! And the food was hot and has fresh ingredients. 

Negatives: no flavor... the pad Thai was bland and there was no option to make it spicy on the Postmates app we used. I would have liked the option or at least a couple crushed red pepper packets. 
The crab Rangoon has HONEY MUSTARD FILLING!!?? My husband and I both did not like them and couldn't finish them. It is not traditional and when you're craving the traditional taste it is quite disappointing. This should be disclosed.
Loved their chicken sausage gumbo and their bread pudding. They were prompt with the time projected on the app fir my take out order.  Great staff!

I have to love Mollys At The Market!  Laid-back vibe, good bartenders and excellent drinks.  The Frozen Irish, as previously noted, is quite delicious and was finished with a tasteful swirl of ground coffee atop.  Let the douchey men and vacuous women drink slushy hurricanes on Bourbon: the adults will drink this.

I also believe I had an LA 31 Biere Pale here: just beautiful.  The old standby (Abita Amber) also on tap here.

While smoking was permitted inside, the wide-open windows and doors created a fine draft to flush all the devil fog outside.

I do love The Abbey and Aunt Tikis on this street--but sometimes, I want a bit more of a grown-up, less grungy place to hang out at; this place hits the spot adroitly.

Honestly this is my second review for Luciano's but I have to give it to them. Their seafood fettuccine is so bomb, their bread and clams are fantastic too...pretty much everything is great...good portion sizes and fresh ingredients!! My husband and I ate here one last time before we moved to California and I am so desperate to come visit Boise just to have the seafood pasta again!! We've tried to duplicate the dish but we couldn't :((( and it's my favorite ever!! I've even tried to find something like it on all the menus on San Diego Yelp...no luck. Guess we'll be frequenting the area once again for that last meal ;) love this place.

Called to get my car service about 8-12 time over a period  of  6 months and never got a  single call back. if i'm even able to talk to someone they are very rude. So  6 moths later i say ill try  one  last  time over the  phone so  i call and ask to talk  to the  service centers GM and of course i get a voice  mail.  told  him  this is bullshit  and that if he doesnt  return my call ill be showing  up within 2 hours.  Guess who had gotten a phone call back within minutes of hanging up that phone. :)

We went there to watch the CAN/US hockey semi-final game (as Canadian fans). The food was FANTASTIC. Mmmmm chicken and baked beans. The bartender provided excellent service. We will definitely go back when in the Tampa area.

The journey to Caladesi and Honeymoon Island was fun! Miles of beach and picnic areas provide a great get-away for a large group of people or for a few. There is a ferry that runs back and forth that is the only commute between the two islands. I did Caladesi island for a picnic, then headed over to Honeymoon Island for the beach, was a good, fulfilling day! There are cafes and bathroom facilities in both locations which  make spending an entire day enjoyable.

Facilities are accessible, but may still be more difficult for wheelchair users to navigate. Please plan accordingly!
The food and drinks are delicious. I also got the hummus which is mouthwatering. Everything is fresh. The service is amazing! Highly recommend!
Food was mediocre and drinks were overpriced. Service was just ok, nothing to rant about. Always wanted to try this place. Glad I got it outta my system. Won't return considering my lunch was $50!

Absolutely delicious! Best food we had on our trip to New Orleans (and we had a lot of good food). Great atmosphere & very attentive service. Incredible value - had the lunch prixe fixe special - 3 courses for only $20. Was very impressed also to learn that John Besh, owner & chef, broke back into New Orleans 4 days after Katrina to gather food and feed those who were stranded.

I have to say this place has come a long way over the years. They now have a ninja course, rock climbing, laser tag, and obviously bowling. As well as an arcade. The foods pretty good as well and they have a bar for the parents !!!

GREAT place, great atmosphere, good food options. Back patio, organic drinks and foods, vegan options and gluten free foods. 1 star down because I would have loved even more gluten free/DAIRY FREE options, less grease and a cheerier waitress, but generally really great experience!

I wish this could be a negative star. 30 minutes of some chick talking on the bar no songs playing. How is that supposed to bring in customers. $5 for bs on a microphone over the music. Save your money.

Some of the best filled donuts I've ever had. The lines can be long depending on the time of day, so if you see a short line that doesn't wrap far around the corner - GO GET IT! Doughnuts are only $0.95, which is a steal for the quality. The size isn't large, nor is it small - it's perfectly sized. The dough is actually of substance, not just full of air pockets like the ones you get at the store. Everything also tastes so ft esh!

I ordered the salted caramel donut -the icing was salty and sweet, the whipped cream filling in the middle was perfectly airy and not overly sweet. I also tasted the peanut butter filled one and it was delicious with a nice peanut flavor in the mousse/cream on the inside. 

For 95 cents, it's well worth a wait in line. I can't wait to go back and try more flavors. They had a mocha one that looked very promising.

A very disappointing lunch!  It was actually a buffet on a Sunday.  Customers were asked to wear a mask when going into the buffet area where the food could be found - but only if you wanted to!  There was a person working the line to show you what was available and serve you, so you could not really get next to the food.  The food itself was just fair - some had been sitting in the warming trays too long and were dried out.  The desserts were pre- cut and set out in the open.  They began to run out of dessert toward the end.  The waitress was pleasant and helpful enough but every table was taken and she had her hands full.  We had wanted to sit outside but the weather was too windy and chilly.  I would not return again because of Covid considerations and quality and price!  There are lots of other places to try.

Captain Todd and Mark!  These guys kept us calm and informed as a infamous Florida storm popped up! Both islands they took us to offered relaxing views! Highly recommend this company!  We would have stayed the full 6 hours had the storm not popped up!
Great espresso drinks! Comfy atmosphere. Lots of outlets. Would be good for a study spot.

This review is specifically in regards to Super Burrito's wet "Super Burritos." For a few bucks extra your burrito is covered in some sort of cheesy beany wet sauce -- highly recommended. Carnitas is delicious. Always quick and friendly service. There is a drive through window as well. Treat yourself to a delicious "Super Burrito."

DO NOT GO THERE, INITIAL PRICING IS DECEIVING:
I had the driver side tire damaged & I decided to change 2 tires and asked to keep the extra good tire in my trunk, found what I thought at the time was the best pricing compared to other shops. 
I called last Wednesday to get my tires replaced, they said if I wanted it early on Thursday I better leave it overnight, so I did.
They called Thursday morning & said: I will need front breaks but I answered that my car just  passed inspection less than 2 weeks ago & I won't replace my breaks! so they said I needed an alignment then when I said "Just change the tires that's all I need", they reluctantly agreed.
When I went to pick up the car, they claimed that they had my new tires in the back & the old ones upfront! (newer tires should always be in front!) and I expected the third old tire to be in the trunk per my request.
Driving home, tires felt strange like something was stuck to them, so later in the evening I got in the car again & it said check driver's side tire pressure, it was at 20 !! and there was a huge headed screw in the tire! the 2 old Pirelli tires were on the left front & back & the 2 new Kelly tires were both on the right!!.. and.. the third tire was not in my trunk!!
Friday morning we called and we were shocked: they claimed the passenger side tire had a nail in it so they kept it!!! 2 nails???????
Did I mention that I informed them that Thursday was our Christmas eve & Friday was our Christmas? That was I think a 2nail Christmas present, 
DO NOT GET FOOLED by their initial prices They WILL COST YOU A LOT

My wife surprised me with a date nightThis is our favorite steakhouse locally. The atmosphere is very laid back and the food is amazing!! We always get the filets and our side as the fettuccine alfredo. The steak was cooked and seasoned to perfection and the fettuccine was thick and creamy as always. We both highly recommend this place to everyone we know. We haven't been disappointed when we go and I'm sure you won't be too.

This place refuses to serve tap water or any potential tap water bearing vessel. Its ridiculous. I have never before been refused an empty plastic cup from a bar. They refuse to serve me a glass of tap water... fine. But I refuse to aim while I dispose of said fancy water. Maybe they can use the three dollars they pried from my pocket to help hire some poor (and probably thirsty) guy to clean my pee off the floor.
Food was amazing. Shrimp and Grits where off the chain! And yes, we had to get the unlimited fabulous Bloody Mary's to finish off the weekend.

Such a cute and delicious market. Everything is so authentic and fresh. Had the Aztec iced coffee and an açaí bowl there... amazing! Definitely going back more often. Not sure how I lived here so long and haven't been here more!

They got everything done in a timely manner.  My main issues were that the owner Dick tried to quote me $800 for two tires for a Nissan Murano.... I had bought tires in the past and had done research. I asked if he meant for all four tires and he said no, just the two.  Ridiculous.  I then questioned it again and asked for a lower price and the owner said "oh you know I think my computer priced them a little high. They are ~$470."  He then tried to upsell me an emissions test cause my plates are out of state. And when I told him why I didn't need one and was planning on getting one at a later date he questioned that too and said "that doesn't sound right but ok.." so I explained again that I know they expire and I'm waiting for the South Carolina DMV to transfer my title.  I did appreciate that they gave me notes on things that need to be checked soon and what was causing this loud noise while driving.  I ended up having to take my car back and when I went to pick it up the battery was dead. He had mentioned it was weak but I had 0 issues and was going to get it replaced soon. The battery was so dead you couldn't even get the dashboard lights on, and they couldn't even get a read on the charge. I just find it funny that they didn't tell me it was dead when I went to get it.  They waited till I tried to drive off.  If a battery is THAT dead you'd think they would notice.... Definitely will not be returning.

Cod was the best part of the meal. 5/5
Fukumitsuya Sake flight 5/5
Sake Monjito 5/5
Soba and Kani salad 4/5 
Wagyu, sushi/ sashimi 3/5. Decent, but not worth the price.

We discovered this wonderful place through the Kids Bowl Free summer program. My daughter and I have really enjoyed coming here on weekdays to play her free games. Rudy and the rest of the staff are amazing and super friendly. We've been going there the past few weeks and Rudy now greets my daughter by name now. It's such a welcoming place and love the ambience with the 60s music playing in the background. Plus their hamburger combo is delicious! It has such a family feel to it!
You've got to stop here if you're visiting NOLA.  The Beignets and cafe au lait were both great. Quick service and there was a brass band playing holiday music!

This is such a clutch hole-in-the-wall find in Point Breeze. Their buffalo chicken pizza is fire (this means exceptional in millennial speech). Their quesadillas are some of the best I've ever had (Drake reference), but the tacos I got once were just so so. They also have loaded cheese fries that, trust me, you want to get, and onion rings that hold their own. That's really all I've gotten there so far but I trust that the rest of their menu is just as good. Solid neighborhood spot for some grub!

I get sausage from Billy and his crew at the Media Farmers Market - and I just pulled a link of pork/broccoli rabe/sharp provolone outta the freezer, defrosted it and grilled it up.

Served it in 1 inch chucks over orzo pasta.

BLISS.

These are some of the best artisanal (Wilmington Made) links ever.
Please make more chicken and turkey with greens (spinach, rabe, kale whatever you got!)

Seasoned to perfection.

Love!

The gel manicure and pedicure here are one of the best in town!   The owner and staff are so sweet and take their time to do an amazing manicure and pedicure.  The bad review must have come from an off day because I have been their numerous times now and have had only great service and the best mani/pedis.   They are new so they have the latest nail products, it is a clean salon and instruments and they are right on State St. with parking in the back.   You will love it here!
Standard greasy spoon place. Nothing on the menu really stands out to set it apart from others. Price is nice and cheap and they fill up coffee right when you need it. Solid greasy spoon place.
I decided to stop here after an event & have dinner since I am sans kids today. I'm having crabcakes!!!!! There are two pianists playing right now & I am LOVING it!!!

Sidecar has a great environment, and amazing drinks prices very fairly. The bartenders were friendly and knowledgeable. The entire place smelled like fresh citrus and herbs. Probably my new favorite bar in Tucson!!

The location is a bit inconvenient since it's connected to a gas station on an extremely busy street. The food was done after about 15-20 minutes. Everything was cooked well, not too hard, not too soft. The fish could have used a little more seasoning, there honestly wasn't much flavor. The shrimp was spicy and had a little more breading than I would have liked. I do like the mild dipping sauce on the side with the fries. Overall I did like the meal and, I would dine here again.

Worst service ever.  Waitress brought water and silverware and never even spoke to us.

Finally left without being waited on.

Great sushi, wouldn't go out of my way for it, but it's really good. I liked it. 

If I am ever in the area, if I want sushi, I would go again. But that's a lot of "ifs." You got your generic rolls, it's better than some, but not worth the 5-stars.

Got a massage here while stopping in Reno on my way to Burning Man; very good massage. I liked that she took time to listen to my issues and craft her massage to account for them. She's versatile and can bring a lot of techniques to bear. At some point, she offered cupping, which I find unusual in a massage therapist, and I took her up on it. All in all, a very good massage.

Good location with decent parking. Ambiance was cozy and friendly.

Bathroom: Clean and functional.

This place!! Wow!! I will start at the beginning. I came in during the middle of a week day, so it wasn't busy and no wait. The decor is cute and has a retro vibe, but not a total 50's dinner. They sat us and we ordered. I was prepared because I had head the prices were expensive. They were. My daughters un-birthday shake was 19 dollars. However, it came with a cookie and a cup cake. Honestly, it was so well prepared. I will admit I am an ice cream snob. I love Blue Bell and nothing else really compares. Well, their ice cream was amazing. I got the all American. It was a regular sundae but with HOT fudge. So delicious. I would definitely recommend going and trying it out.

Not he worse chicken dish that I have had, bit far from close to the best. I ordered the #2 combo (Hot).  The fries were crinkle cut and lacked salt. The chicken looked well seasoned and it was, bit I didn't care for the flavor of the seasoning or the dried meat itself. The sauce tasted more like 1000 island than anything, and while I do enjoy 1000 island, it didn't go with the food.  If I had to pick my favorite park, it was the pickels in the sliders. The people were friendly and others there looked as if they were enjoying their food. Maybe I am in the minority, please try it for yourself and judge for yourself.

I've been to other locations, most specifically the one in Rehoboth, and have always been a fan. I was excited to see them opening one off Concord Pike in Wilmington, and was lucky enough to pop by on opening day. That can sometimes be a dicey proposition, and they were bumping the entire time I was there. The staff was friendly but busy, and I snagged a stool at the bar. Julia took care of me, and couldn't have done a better job - friendly, funny, quick and great with the recommendations. She's a twenty outta ten. I had each of the three brews done exclusively for GT, the Shell Raisers, and all three were good. Nice beer selection, and the wings were good. I had a split serving with 6 Cajun and 6 Buffalo Parmesan, everything was delicious. Looking forward to getting back to the Turtle as soon as possible - awesome spot to watch a game, grab a bite, or take the family. I'll be back for sure. Thanks for a great time!

Upscale and quaint home decor and gift shop located in the Summit Mall next to Sephora.  This is not a chain store and it is likely locally owned.  The merchandise is pretty classy, most of which is a modern take on a traditional product.  A few items have a touch of humor in an upmarket fashion.

Reasonably priced, good quality, interesting finds for sure.  If you collect colored glassware or are looking for seasonal decor this is a fun place to explore.  They used to have more big ticket items and it appears this year they have switched to smaller items almost entirely.  They have good sales on Black Friday and the day after Christmas from what I've seen. 

My only constructive input would be that a couple times I have felt like the one person working could have been a little more friendly, but they have never been rude in the handful of times I've shopped here.

One of the best Mexican restaurants, authentic food, prices are a steal, portion sizes are large, lots of variety, and drinks are also authentic, the service is great, and wait is just a few minutes with appetizers until the food arrives, workers are kind and quick.

I've been a fan of the King Buffet for years.  If not for the food, for the fact that it's just fun to eat, there.  They've got an awesome selection of dishes to choose from, a complete salad bar, and even a children's food bar for those who aren't quite into their parents' ideas of good eating and apt to go batshit the entire time Mom and Dad are trying to enjoy their meal.

The food's alright.  But, being a buffet, you know it's not going to be as one might expect a restaurant serving fresher entrees would be.  It's no worry, though, as the staff is seen regularly ferrying hotpans full of goodies to replace the depleted and, as there's always a decent amount of people around, what's under those heatlamps doesn't stay there long.  Usually.  There's always that one item, that day, that's not as popular as its brethren and you're left kind of wondering.  But I've never had a complaint to offer toward their quality.  It's just a fact that buffets of any sort anywhere share, that they're simply not going to be serving food as fresh as a traditional eatery.  Some people are more sensitive to that than others.  I could eat an egg sandwich left on my kitchen counter at home for nine weeks and barely suffer a burp while somebody else might go into convulsions after eating a lukewarm fry that's been out of the oil for slightly better than fifteen minutes.  As it is an all-you-can-eat buffet, feel free to sample what you feel may be of dubious quality before lumping an effing ton if it onto your plate, find something you like, take it to your table, enjoy, and get on with your life.  Don't be a pussy - take a chance.  And have a good time.

One thing I should point out: you'll notice that the wait staff are always standing around the place at intervals like guards in a prison mess hall.  Don't let this freak you out.  Because of them, I have never been shanked yet while dining at the King Buffet, nor have I ever had to give up my pudding to the guy at the next table else he jumps me in the men's room, later, and makes me toss his salad for refusing.

Oh.  Lastly.  Sometimes, they serve this dish with little octopi in it.  If you've got a kid with you, it's always worth a laugh to dump some of that onto his or her plate.  It's worth the crying and resultant therapy you - or your sister and brother-in-law - will be paying for, trust me.

I didn't eat here, I came on a Friday night to see a cover band (Vote for Pedro, which btw was a great show!)  

My internal thesaurus is failing me in describing this bar.  The only word I can think of is really, really, *random*.  

Harley Davidson on the walls, disco lights on the ceiling.
Women dressed like hookers (I'm talking full on glitter dress - more like a long shirt -  and 5" stilettos) dancing next to a 60 year old man wearing his Bluetooth headset
21st birthday party sitting next to a 50th birthday celebration
Musical playlist (before the band started): Enrique, Sammy Hagar, Salt n Peppa, Pink - in that order

I love that it's non smoking because they serve food during the day.  $5 cover, average priced drinks.  Plenty of tables and a small dance floor.  My guy friends liked the waitresses and their lack of uniforms.  The cougars were quite aggressive, I had to run interference a few times with the more intoxicated ones.  I think the guys kinda like that too though! ;)

I'll probably be back, if nothing else just for the people watching!!!

I have a self imposed rule to steer clear of restaurants in hotels because I theorize that they usually aren't great and wouldn't be able to survive on their own merit were it not for the hotel traffic.

This place is an exception and comes with a big name in the culinary world, John Besh. It doesn't feel like a hotel restaurant as it is separated and in an old and warm feeling space adjacent to the hotel lobby. The food is seafood and cajun influenced. I had some sort of shrimp etouffee on grits that was simple and wonderful. I coupled my meal with a great glass of wine and sadly stayed away from dessert to save myself a few calories.

The only negative thing that I would note is that it is loaded with tourist type folks. Not always bad but it can make for bigger and louder groups that at times intrude on converstation.

In all, it was really great. I will be back here soon.

Their bread is amazing! They were very accommodating to me creating my own vegetarian sandwich and the cheese was fresh-sliced.  They have a good assortment of toppings and dressings, and some great sides to go along with that. Loved the friendly service and tasty sandwich!

Wings were underwhelming. Well-cooked. Crispy on the outside and nice and tender on the inside. Not even close to spicy enough though, and I ordered buffalo as the sauce. Blue cheese and ranch both were quite watery as well

Decent prices for beer $11 bud light pitcher on a Thursday night.

Large venue and good spot to watch sports. Some limited outdoor seating

We went there with another couple on a late Saturday night. We had the whole cellar to ourselves for a while. It was great. It's all about the atmosphere baby. I feel like there should be a secret passage in one of the walls and there would be a high stakes poker game in the back.
Very good food but kind of expensive for take out and small portions. We also didn't eat in but the eat in area didn't look too nice but probably the same as any Chinese/Thai restaurant.
Little on the pricey side but always do and a good job. Hard-working and responsive. No issue would recommend.

Bottom Line: Bierstube is one of my favorite bars in Philadelphia.  I have been to this bar several times since May and have never been disappointed.

Beer Selection:  Everyone agrees that this is solid.  AND IT IS!  They always have a great selection that has many different taste-options ( nothing personally pisses me off more than a draft list that has too many of the same kinds of beer....especially if it's all stouts or IPAs).  If you don't see something new and fancy, they always have trusty ol' Franziskaner to fall back on.  I tried a Dirty Deutsch, which is a Bierstube bartender creation, of half-Hefeweizen and half-Framboise.  It was absolutely delicious and upon first sip I proclaimed "Oh god, I could happily get drunk on these forever."  Can't find something on draft?  It's cool, bro!  They've got an awesome bottle list too.

Food Selection:  I ALWAYS start with the Winzig Pretzels, they're delicious pretzel with three awesome sauces...my personal favorite being the Asian soy/gingery one.  So far, that's the extent of the Asian fusion that I've seen in any of the food.  I've had the grilled cheese and schnitzel sandwiches in the past and found them both awesome and filling.  I like that the schnitzel sandwiches come with 2 pieces of schnitzel each and really tasty french fries.  I will say that the prices seem a bit steep, but the portions are fair.

I've never witnessed any dry-humping by the bartenders, only friendly personalities.  One time I was there and my boy and I were the only people in the bar and we had a really great conversation with the bartender.  Went last Friday and it was super busy, but all of the bartenders stopped at least once to ask how our food was and checked up on beer refills with perfect timing.

Have had the Cuban as well as the Cuban bowl and I can say that both were excellent, especially the bowl definitely a unique spin on a classic dish. The Cuban wasn't the best in Tampa ( my vote still goes to West Tampa Sandwich Shop) but it was up there. The Jalapeno hush puppies were great as well and the sauce they gave you for dipping was mouthwatering. Be warned that they only have a handful of parking spots so if you're coming during the lunch rush you may have some trouble getting in.

Ridiculous! Won't be back! Sat 15 minutes waiting for someone to take our order. Actually moved to the bar thinking that was the problem. Wrong! Crappy bartenders, one older guy and young girl! TERRIBLE, TERRIBLE TERRIBLE!!!! Shame on the management for even keeping people like this working!!!!

I recently ordered and received a table pad for my large RH dining table and am SO happy with how it turned out. I wasn't really sure what color would look the best but gave it my best guess and I think it looks amazing. The pad is high quality and was well packaged for shipping. Sherri was a great help whenever I had ordering and measuring questions. Overall I definitely recommend!

DO NOT HIRE THIS COMPANY unles if you want to end up paying and arm and a leg to hire another company the day of your move or moving the stuff on your own which is what you probably didn't want to do if you are hiring a moving company. Talked to them 2 weeks prior to our move date scheduled an appointment they got all our info from my fiance except payment (thank the lord we didn't pay them before services rendered). The day before our move my fiance tried to call many times to confirm our appointment for 9 am but no answer. We were both up and waiting for them by 8 am by 10 am i had called many times but never got an answer. We had to call around looking for another moving company but they were all booked or wanted $700 bucks for a small last minute move, so by noon we had friends on their way and rented a Uhaul. I have tried to call to speak to a manager for 3 days and not one soul has answered their phones. I will be reporting them to groupon and the BBB. They are scam artist and should have never been given and rights to own or run a business. They do not even deserve 1 star on this review.

My fiance and I decided to just take a drive and ended in Doylestown.  After walking around for a bit, we found at the Taproom sitting on their patio.  The street was quiet and it wasn't too hot in the shade.  Most of the tables were full which was a good sign.  

For being a taproom the beer list was pretty small.  My fiance ordered a beer and I got a glass of wine.  We ordered the hummas as an appetizer and I ordered the guacamole burger, sans bun and he ordered the club sandwich.  Not sure if it was the kitchen's fault like the server had us believe but our courses came out pretty close together.  We should have known something was up when it took 20 minutes to get hummas.  

The food was good but the service could use some tweaking- maybe its because they pull their tips, who knows.

A sports bar with a good variety of seafood. My favorite is definitely the buffalo chicken salad, but be warned, even the h1 (basic sauce) can be hot sometimes so if you don't like heat stay away.
Only negative is the location is small and during big sporting events you probably won't get a table unless you get there early. Otherwise decent beer selection and pricing and most of the time the service at this location is decent.

The pizza and diet soda were good as the tables are large as well as clean plus there is 
oregano for some people who want extra -- not me. The restaurant offers extra part skim mozzarella on slices which is great and are very kind men who speak Spanish as well as English. Also, the bathroom is clean and great for all sexes. 

Plastic utensils are out for use. In addition, I ate a cheese steak there that was very juicy and satisfying as well as a wonderful caesar chicken salad -- I don't like hot spicy on the salad so I ignored a pepper or something. It is affordable. THEY TAKE CASH AND CREDIT CARDS. It is close to hotels in Philly as well as shopping. Seriously, they deliver to hotels if it is near and you ask. This solves a holiday problem so tip well if they do.

Believe it or not, some major cities or towns in CT won't let customers buy a slice so hail Joe's for understanding that sometimes less is more or you can choose more after eating a slice.

Joe's was suggested by someone who lived in Philly to me because of not wanting a formal dinner or a whole pie and that is delightful.

For only being open a few weeks, everything was amazing.  So much food and drink, we left stuffed.  Our waiter (Noah) was so attentive.  We would come back many more times if we didn't live so far away.

Linda helped my little brother pick out his engagement ring and she did an excellent job. She did everything you'd hope a saleswoman would do when helping a guy buy a ring. She walked him through everything patiently and together they found the perfect ring. Thank you Linda for taking care of my little brother.

Just had my car serviced here Wednesday 1/15/2020. I had a pleasant conversation with Sara on the phone while scheduling. Harold greeted me, reviewed service options and got me in and out quickly. I'm so happy I switched from a downtown dealership to here! So much more professional and trustworthy. Like another gentleman that had to make the same move told me "this is the place to be". Thank you Darrell Waltrip team for making such a difference! I was ready to switch brands.

Check in was easy and smooth, very friendly service. 
We got a suite with 2 queen bed and a pull out sofa plus a kitchenette. The room was huge. So much space. It was 6 of us. The room was clean, organized. We LOVED it. We can't hear any noise inside the room. Hotel has complimentary breakfast including waffles, juice, coffee, cereal, oatmeal, fruit, bagels, pastries , eggs, bacon, French toast, yogurt all food was delicious. They have an indoor pool, it was warm, perfect to swim in the morning. They provide towels in there also. We will definitely be coming back and recommending this place. Check in starts at 3pm. Check out is at 12. Pool is open from 8am- 10pm. Breakfast starts at 6am-10am. About a five minute drive to circus circus and its surroundings.

This place is a joke! Went in informed the first salesman I saw that I was interested in the 2019 Rav4 (car drove and smelled like  btw do with that information as you will). But what was most disheartening was after the gentleman ran around the entire dealership asking for where the RAV4 keys were all the salesman said that somebody was getting gas and that he would be back soon. Because I originally had an appointment but I did not remember who it was with. After sitting in the waiting room for 45 minutes I finally get frustrated and ask everyone where the hell the keys are. It was at that time after all other dealerships closed that a salesman pulled the keys out of his desk drawer. The fact that the salesman don't care for their fellow coworkers should show you the sleaziness of this establishment. "We where holding the car for you". End of the day you never knew if I was actually gonna buy the car so hiding the keys from your fellow coworkers is preventing sales and maybe commission in your coworkers pockets really bad business practice especially from a fellow salesman. I wish I had the salesman's name but he was also incredibly rude blaming the whole waiting ordeal on me not remembering who my appointment was with. 

Save your time and save your money and go elsewhere I'm ashamed that my insurance company recommended this place and will be contacting them to remove this dealership from their suggested sources. I hate to sound like a karen and I usually love to leave the best reviews but I simply wouldn't send somebody I even hated to buy a car here. And if they were really holding the car for me the least they could of done was washed it. As it had dust on it from how long it was sitting on the car lot!

Interesting stuff, but very small and very narrow. There's one way in/out. If you want to read the bulk of the articles, you'll have to stand in the hallway to that singular entrance/exit people in and out. It's just wide enough for one person, really. Off the hallway, there are two small rooms. That's the museum. Plus a small gift shop in the front. 

Pictured is the informational packet I got. Let me amend what I said earlier: It *seemed* like interesting stuff. Not much information was available. And, I'm pretty sure I paid for a guided tour online (via a tourism site)... But this definitely was not guided. 

Cool in theory. Not so much in practice. I thought that this would be a highlight of my stay in New Orleans, but it was not. Don't bother spending $7 here. You can find places that are at least equal in quality for free.

So glad to see a huge change here!   New ownership, new menu in the making.....and everything smells better there.   I tried the curry chicken: the chicken was tender and good.....but the curry barely discernible.   I was quite happy to see veggies included, if a bit over cooked.   It's such a good difference tho from previous.   I know the menu is being tweaked, and hope the recipes too - will try it again.

It was worth the wait.  My upstairs bathroom and bedroom's electricity in Santa Barbara was not working.  The team showed up timely.  They wore masks, and were respectful of the property.  After listening to the symptoms, they quickly found the problem and thought they were able to fix it quickly, .  It resolved the problem for a bit, but it did not hold, and we were back in the dark. 
 We called, and Oliver made it a priority to schedule us in and made a more comprehensive/replacement fix.  I appreciate their conservative approach, trying to save us costs, rather than telling us, we needed a complete overhaul.  He and his team were professional, courteous, friendly, punctual, and responsive to texts, email, and phone calls.   Easy on line payment as well.  I will call on them again!

We wanted breakfast and it was already noon, so we were lucky to run into this place.
They close at 2pm, so you know they are serious about breakfast. 
Super Friendly Staff.

Goody Goody is def one of my fav places to get a good breakfast. In fact it might be my fav place. 

Clearly everyone goes on and on about the chicken and waffles which is good...not the best..but good. HOWEVER there are seriously some really delicious other items of the menu. Shall I introduce you to the catfish fillet and grits. It is the best! They cook the catfish perfectly and you get eggs and two sides. Seriously enough food for even the hungriest of patrons. 

The atmosphere is fun and has a family feel. All of the servers are super friendly and attentive. Highly recommended!

Expensive hipster polluted hangout. 

Positive: pumps money into Fishtown economy, cliental mostly ride bikes so doesn't really affect neighborhood parking

Negative: Pretentious "Cash Only" policy, subpar food, expensive drinks served to you like you should be grateful to be given a can to drink out of

We became a Honda family back in 1997, when we bought the very first CRV delivered to Pasco County. Everyone loved it and wanted to know where we got it. Back then we never imagined that our new "baby" would still be running TODAY, with over 320k miles on her! When the dealership relocated (across the street), we found ourselves needing a second car, and WOW - Honda came through once again! Our 2005 Civic was a SWEET little ride that ran over 350K miles before it retired. Fast-forward to the Spring of 2019 - it was time for a new car. With such a stellar track record - we knew it HAD to be a Honda! "Tony F." did an awesome job showing us all the reasons why the new 2019 Civic fit our needs & wants. Months later, we are LOVING it, but the story doesn't end there. Last week we stopped by to say hello to Tony, our favorite salesman. (BTW - such a genuinely nice guy!) Just as we were about to pull away, I spotted a cute little "Fit" on the lot and decided to check it out. Once again, Tony helped us figure things out - and we are once again a "two Honda" family! It's so wonderful to have TWO beautiful, reliable, affordable Honda's in our driveway - Thank you Ocean Honda! You've done it again!

I used to be a loyal customer of Teavana but within the last year I stopped purchasing from them because I believe they're deceptive and immoral. I would read reviews before purchasing their tea, they were usually 5 stars or a little bit above 4 stars. I wrote a review for every tea I drank from them and if I wrote anything under 5 stars they'd never post it. Then I realized all of these 5 star teas I'd purchased that I didn't like were most likely not 5 stars according to the community. On top of that, when I received 1 order from Teavana, I was given a slip of paper with another customer's information on it! I called their customer service number immediately to let them know what happened and the lady on the phone sounded very unconcerned. But ANYWAY...
I was shopping on Black Friday and I walked by this store, not remembering the name or even seeing the store before (although I would imagine this store has been there for quite some time). I basically saw "TEA" and got really excited so I walked in. Almost immediately, Michelle (I hope I got her name right. I was just SO excited), asked me if I needed help. I told her I was a new customer and not really sure what I was doing. She was very patient, answered all of my questions, very friendly, recommended the best products for me, was very understanding of my allergies, and made sure to point out all of the good deals and sales going on that day. I settled on a package/bundle with a tea infuser, spoon, tin of tea (I chose the Jumpy Monkey), and chocolate agave. She was also very knowledgeable about agave, which I had never heard of before. When I checked out, I signed up for their rewards program and the checkout process was very smooth and everyone behind the counter was also very helpful.
I went home and washed the infuser and spoon and immediately tried the chocolate agave. It is DELICIOUS! So I made a cup of tea with the agave and it was very rich and tasty. I live with 4 other people, but there were 3 other guests over at the time and I immediately showed all of them the tea and the products and told them I got these from DAVIDsTEA and recommended everything I had just purchased. Then I went online to order some more tea and they had more great deals going on. I got 4 ounces of another tea, a tin, and 3 sample teas all to be shipped to my house for a grand total of $10. SO CHEAP! SO much cheaper than Teavana and everything is better quality, better value, and better customer service. Also, I must say, their website is beautiful!
I would highly recommend this location of DAVIDsTEA and would recommend their teas and products in general. 1 million stars! I am SO happy!

Excellent service!!! Sat down at the Mex after catching a movie mid day on state street. The smell attracted us, and the friendly staff welcomed us. Sat at the bar ordered drinks. Good margaritas! Fresh homemade chips! Asked our server/bartender for recommendations, ended up with enchiladas and fish tacos. Food was good, I'll be back especially for more fish tacos!!!

Best carnitas street tacos in Nashville. They're so flavorful, a bit crispy, and oh so delicious! $1.25 per taco is such a steal. They're true street tacos with just cilantro and onion, and are true perfection.
Food is good, cocktails are great, and the hot sauce is amazing! Our waiter was kind enough to give me a few plastic to-go cups of the sauce and I've put it on everything since.

Really terrible pizza! I think they must have started making their own, becuaae other reviews don't match up. Far worse than frozen pizza. First time in my life I ever left pizza! Waitress not particularly friendly or concerned we left 90% of our food.

Terrible horrendous awful experience. The driver they hired lied about the pick up situation and they refused to stick to there plan to pick up my car, and they wouldn't help despite their driver lying. I will never use this company nor should you and I would not recommend it to anyone. Rude drivers, liars, and overall terrible. I would give -5 stars if I could.

We have attended a couple events here. It's a pretty typical sports pub. Pool tables, lots of seating (mostly high tables) and it is a pretty big venue. The parking lot can be tight as it shares it with a lot of other businesses. There isn't a lot of choices for local or micro-brews but I guess what they offer pleases most of their customers.

Tons of TV's line the upper ceiling so no matter where you sit you will be able to watch whatever game or sporting event is going on.

Food is okay. Pretty typical sports pub fare. I've only eaten there twice I think. Nothing too special about the menu or the quality.  It's good pub food, not great or unique. They do have a big menu though so there is lots to choose from. They may not be able to accommodate all diets though. I think they have some vegan/vegetarian dishes. They offered a gluten-friendly pizza crust but they cannot guarantee no cross-contamination will occur. The fryer is shared also so anything is a no go for anyone that is Celiac.

Our visit was 8/15/14
Like a previous person (on a facebook review) , we've had issues with roaches too... I believe it started back in 2011, where it was also caught by the inspectors... The online thing says ..."critical items" ..."noncritical items" but according to kitchen cops on the news, it was roaches/roach traps and other things where they shouldn't be.
We stopped going there for a while then went back, after a couple trips my mom and dad were having lunch and one crawled out of their chips bowl. My dad killed it, and they called the waiter over who accused them of bringing it in their purse... then asked what they wanted to eat. They left instead. But called up Pima county health and reported it (since the most current rating was excellent) and they informed us that the restaurant was on a program with a pest company to get it all taken care of, but may take some time.
There was another case with my parents, but I don't know the whole thing so I won't even attempt.
A couple nights ago, my wife picked up an order to go, and at home, in the chips bag we find the body of a roach.. no legs, so I assume it's been dead for a while. Needless to say, my wife and I got sick on that meal (probably the thought more than anything else.) My wife called the store, and was told we could stop in for a $10 gift card.
The next day, my wife was working, so I grabbed my mom and ran up there... no manager.. but the owner will be in the next day. So today my mom ran up there as I was busy, and gave a run down of all the roach issues we've had with their facility and managed to get my $35 back for our dinner the other night (thanks), but was told they didn't have a roach problem. ...now lets back track to yesterday when my mom mentioned to the counter person they should "close down a few days, give the place a good scrubbing and really get it under control" The guy told us that they had done that, and the problem is the building... since it's old. ha! What can I say, we're done with giving chances, our stomach can't take it anymore.... Shame too- cause we actually really liked the crisps, Mr. Mikes specifically. :-(

Who doesn't love Cracker Barrel?! We usually go for Sunday breakfast, but stopped in for a quick dinner this week. Instead of the normal comfort foods you can expect from here, both my husband and I opted for salads. They were HUGE and delish. I still recommend their meatloaf, chicken fried steak and oh ma lord, the biscuits; but they do have healthier eats that are just as good! The service is always good, but be prepared to wait on the weekend's for breakfast, which is served all day.

Excellent!, highly recommend!!!!  Our first time visiting Bartaco but I will definitely visit again!  Excellent atmosphere, high energy and friendly staff from the onset. The drinks are amazing, with the freshest ingredients.  Yao Ming aka "Chris" is a great bartender, very friendly, personable and attentive!

Just had a terrific experience with Precision Inc.  I was visiting Tucson from San Diego and late in the day before I was supposed to be driving back to SD, the engine light in my old Honda CRV came on.  I wasn't comfortable driving back across the desert with this, so I called Precision Inc first thing in the morning.  They seemed to be very busy but they fit me in & I was able to get the car fixed very quickly and for a reasonable amount and got back to San Diego safe and sound.  Thank you guys so very much.  I highly recommend Precision Inc.

Placed a mobile order for pickup via the drive through  using the Burger King App on my phone. Left house to go pick up the order and arrived at shopping center 10 minutes after order placed, tapped the "I'm Here" button, then got in line in the drive through. Car in front of me places order, I pull up and tell them I'm here to pick up my mobile order, in this case #81, and the drive through person mumbles something about it not being ready etc, no worries, there were still 2 cars ahead waiting for their food. I pull up to the drive through window to get my food and again state I'm here to pick up order etc etc. The drive through person said they haven't started it yet and that I'll need to come inside and wait. What is the point of the mobile order app? I could have just placed the order when I pulled up to the speaker and I would have had the food hot and ready instead of nothing. The mobile order process is clearly being mis-managed at this store.

Definitely a hipster bar. 
But anyway, they have good food, & if you're into local breweries (which of course they have local beer-hipster bar, remember), they have a good selection of beers.
Fabulous customer service with the new owners. Delicious food and bubble tea! I love the vegetarian options too!

I visited the Castleton location on opening weekend. Walked in and noticed a young salesman sitting on one of the couches.  He looked right at me; however, he didn't get up.  A man walked in after me, and you guessed it! The salesman got right up to assist him.  I didn't read too much into it until it happened again.  This time, it was an older salesman who completely ignored me in favor of a gentleman coming in the door.  I walked through the entire store just to see what would happen. Literally 25 salespeople standing around, and not ONE  of them even bothered to look in my direction, let alone speak! Don't get me wrong, I don't want to be badgered by salespeople but, damn, they should at least greet you when you enter their establishment.
This place is the best. Not only do they have beer, but the owners are some of the nicest most genuine people I have ever had the pleasure of encountering.
A hidden treasure. They are in the back of a grocery store. $2.50 tacos free chips and a taco bar with all of your fixins. The AL Pastor taco is to die for.
" this place is awesome " my hole family said after we ate there

I godda say, my wife and I just got back from a culinary tour of New Orleans last week and went to your new location today (since we had not eaten nearly enough Cajun food). Your Oyster Po'boy rivals (and in my opinion beats) any Po'boy we had in NOLA!

I'm excited they have opened another branch and much closer to my work! You might wait a little bit, but it's because they are cooking your chicken fresh!

The fries are almost as good as hot-diggity shhh, but hot dignity still has the best dipping sauces!

A great addition to south street!

Sorry for the poor review but couldn't appreciate your pizza since it was ice cold because of the incompetence of the delivery person.
Was late, asked me which house was mine on 300 Canal Street.  Really?!?  So I tell him I'm at a hotel.  He asks me for my floor and says he'll be here in a minute.
Sixteen minutes later I text and he says he's turning into Canal.  A few minute later he tells me he's at the lobby, I guess he's not even bringing the darn thing to my floor.
So I tell him I'm on my way so I could ask him why the delay and such.
To my surprise, the pizza was just left on a desk by front service, lonely and unattended.
Too bad because I feel I just lost the $$ on a warm dinner and the response from yelp/grubhob was similar to the driver's attention to my pizza.
So your pizza pretty much sucked because the carelessness of your delivery service.

Came in for a quick lunch on a Thursday around noonish.  We were seated right away, but the food took FOREVER to reach us. Then, I find a nice hair lodged deeply into my slaw!  My meal was comped, and replaced, but I had to have it to go since we waited so long to get our food originally and we were on a timeframe. I just couldn't even eat the replacement meal after finding that hair. The staff was nice and completely apologetic for the hair in the food, but I just don't think we will be going back. The prices are high also.

Excellent service, prompt, affordable and knowledgeable. My lock on the security screen door was stuck and he was able to fix it without having to take my door off of the hinges. The last locksmith from a different company charged double with subpar services. This one was very personable and polite despite the late hour. I would definitely use his services again in the future.

Damn good BBQ in the back roads of St Louis! 

This place is worth the trip from the city to get authentic St Louis BBQ!!
I love it! Food is delicious! You feel like you are eating home food in Peru! Great job

We had a great experience with this shop. Every person I dealt with there was helpful friendly knowledgeable - from sales to installation!  Everything was completed quickly. I highly recommend this place.
Best dinner in town hands down!! If your a true Hoosier u have to try one of these. It is cash only so don't forget to stop by the ATM  on your way. The bang for your buck can't be matched
Don't bother unless you have two months to wait and can make endless number of calls to follow up.  Might as well do what I should have done and recycle what doesn't work and purchase new.

Being a Boise outsider, and having recently lived in Seattle where I feel people tend to be cold, one thing I love about this town is how nice everyone is. Especially in the service industry. This place however, was not that. I could not believe how incredibly mean they were to their customers. Not patient with the drunk ones, yelling often, and not to mention the amount of bratty body language that was shown. I liked the pizza a lot, and was not drunk, so there's that. But as an observer of the business and people, the girl and boy working on Wednesday the 10th during the evening either need to quit their jobs, or realize they work in the customer service industry and adjust their attitudes accordingly. You are serving people. If you don't like serving, and you don't like people, then do everyone a favor and quit.
Catnip cigars that are LOVED by ALL cats! Ours get a new one annually, and every one I've gifted was a huge success.

If you're looking for somewhere to take a date or a client or just to take your family for a special occasion, Sperry's is the place to go. The staff was incredibly welcoming and friendy, yet still maintained a high level of professionalism. 

We started with the lobster mac & cheese (with truffle oil) and at first glance I was shocked at how small it was (for $12). As soon as I put the first bite in my mouth, everything immediately was ok in the world. It was absolutely delicious. Next, I had the ceasar side salad, which was also super scrumptious (and I'm a caesar salad snob). Then, my salmon florentine ($24) was brought out and it was also amazing. Everything was spot on. Even the gin & tonics... 

I was way too full for dessert, but next time I'm getting that bananas foster! Way to go Sperry's, you're awesome. Definitely recommending this place to my hotel guests as my favorite steakhouse from now on.

I'll openly admit that as I'm writing this I'm a bit annoyed. 
Last Sunday the boyfriend and I were too lazy to get out so we decided to try Taste of Italy since they delivered and had something to offer other than pizza. I went with the Italian club sandwich (minus hot peppers) with fries and he got the mild buffalo wings and fries. We were quoted a 20-30 min delivery time but it actually took almost an hour. 
My sandwich was really good! It was on yummy homemade bread and had a good amount of ham and turkey, lots of melted provolone, fresh tomatoes, and romain lettuce. (NOT shredded lettuce! Yay!) The bacon could be crispier. The fries were good but almost too salty to eat. My boyfriend liked his wings and also agreed that the fries were too salty. 
Here's where my annoyance sets in.... So tonight I stop by because even though It's only been 4 days, I'm already craving another Italian club sub! After I place my order I show the waitress my Yelp check in offer and she has to go "ask her boss because she doesn't know about that." She comes back and proceeds to tell me they don't "do that" and the only discount they have is for senior citizens. I told her that her boss needs to contact Yelp so people won't be led to believe that they offer a discount if in fact they don't. I SHOULD have asked to speak to the manager to clarify the issue but after the day I had I simply wasn't in the mood to argue or debate over something that I shouldn't have to argue or debate over. The manager SHOULD have came out and explained their policy to me him(her)self. 
Anyway, while I was seated at a table waiting for my order I noticed a little card on the table encouraging people to check in and review them on Yelp. (See pic) Seriously, any other day I would have addressed this with the manager but sometimes you just know yourself well enough to know that it's probably best to let it go for now. 
After reading other reviews I now see that this happened to someone else a month ago. Management responded and blamed it on a new waitress and has allegedly fixed the issue. Apparently not. 
I'll likely give this place another try but if they still don't honor the Yelp discount I will definitely be addressing it with the manager. It's not the 10% off that's a big deal, it's the principle.
Fresh, Fresh, Fresh!  Very good sushi. Lunch all you can eat for $12.99. Not just sushi either! The list goes on. Great service, staff was very friendly and helpful. We will definitely be back again.

Frenchy's came highly recommended, so tonight we finally checked it out. Despite the current circumstances, it certainly lived up to the hype! First things first, it had a great location, right off Honeymoon Island, and plenty of parking. The place was busy (duh, it's Saturday night), and we were told it was a half hour wait -- but we were seated in less than that, always a plus. 

Next, the service was fast and the staff were friendly. The menu was entirely online (I suppose if you asked they probably had some hard copies), so have your smart phones ready. 

Our appetizer came out quickly. We decided on the Frenchy's Crab Fries- crispy fries topped with a garlic aioli and crab. While these were tasty and I would do these again to share, buyer beware, the aioli is *heavy* on the garlic! 

According to their menu, they're known for their grouper sandwiches, so I ordered one: the Cajun grouper sandwich, a grilled grouper fillet with Cajun seasoning, Parmesan, Romano, and the standard sandwich fixings. Overall, I was happy with it. The Cajun seasoning was a nice change from the standard battered fish you'll find on grouper sandwiches around here. I expected far more cheese on my sandwich than I got. I'm not entirely sure I'd order it again when there are so many options to try on the menu, but I would eat here again overall!

Great place to really experience good New Orleans food. friendly staff, good specials, and a nice location in the French Quarter. I got the Taste of New Orleans and it was worth it. The gumbo was good and everything has the appropriate level of heat to it. It is family friendly. Prefect night out.

I love my nails!!!!! Out of all the places in chesterfield and Creve coeur (and I mean all of them) this is the best manicure I've ever had!!! I get dip and the nail techs at other places always drill my actual nails after getting some of the powder off and my nails are terribly thin and actually hurt when there isn't dip on them. Right away they said that's not the right way to do it. They drilled the very top layer of powder off without even coming close to my real nails and then soaked them and then just used a cotton pad to get the rest off!!! No filing or drilling my real nail!!! My nails look amazing, the dip is all the way to my cuticle (I've had them done before where when I walk out of the salon they look a week grown out already). Kevin is awesome!!! They got me in right away AND gave me a coupon for $5 off my next visit  so happy right now!!!!!

We drove all the way from Sevierville, TN to eat at this Burgerfi after our location closed in Sevierville. This Burgerfi is awesome; great atmosphere, amazing employed, and excellent food!!!!! Don't pass up this burger place, you'll not order a burger from anywhere else after eating Burgerfi.

Must must must get the dirty kettle chips. They are amazing! We visited twice within 5 days just so we could get them again. Our server Miranda was awesome. She recommended so many places to go and things to do while we were visiting. She was super friendly and attentive to our needy group.

oh how i love thee...

the palm is your classy high end steak house.  it's not pretentious nor stuffy nor does it pretend to be.  when you come here, expect one thing... high quality steak cooked right.  if you want to be pampered, the palm is not the best place... i mean, it's a steak house!  

i highly highly recommend the fried calamari.  it's a heaping plate of fresh squid nicely battered and fried to perfection.  and to help clean your palate, there are thin slices of jalepeno and lemon zest, battered, deep fried and mixed in with the calamari.  genius!!

the steak... yummm~ ny strip, rare.  with each bite you can taste the nurturing this steak went through.  slice after slice, our rare steak did not end up swimming in a pool of blood (which you would see in lesser rated steak houses).

after our well executed dinner, i felt ready to retrieve to the smoking room for brandy and cigars.  that's the kind of mood the restaurant sets.   if you appreciate a nice cut of steak, the palm is there for you.
Excellent service. The guys doing the work were professional, polite, skilled. The President, Mike, kept his word on cost, time to complete,etc. Hard to find in today's world.

Parking is the worst. Construction isn't helping out at all either. So, go early and plan on looking for parking. And FYI, you can use the TECO cars for free if you park in Ybor and hop it at one of the stops. There is free parking in Ybor but you have to be off strip a little bit. It is an easy walk if you are capable. Today, I was suffering huge back pain so I was not able to walk hardly at all so parking off strip wasn't an option for me. 

So, make your way in. Check in at the counter. And make your way through the place. It is new, modern, clean and put together smartly. Staff were all very friendly. 

There is a small cafe and restaurant and also a gift shop. We enjoyed our time here and are contemplating a companion membership. Definitely great for history buffs. 

They do offer some special events which some cost $ and others are free to the public. Great view from the cafe inside.

So, yeah, I had a good foodie weekend...Sylvain, Huevos and Cowbell all in one weekend! And Cowbell is awesome! Once again kudos to Susan W for a perfect physical description of Cowbell (though note that chair kept wanting to slide away from the bar where we ate)! 

I am totally loving this trend of new spots opening up with simple, very tasty menus and fresh ingredients for mostly less than $ 20 entrees. Not fancy but casual places serving better, in my humble opinion, dishes and more enjoyable dining experiences than some of New Orleans more established and well known restaurants. 

I started off with a bowl of the clam chowder (with apple wood smoked bacon and red bliss potatoes). Probably the best clam chowder I've ever eaten in New Orleans. It was creamy and buttery (think Dakota's crab and brie soup) and sweet tasting with chunky bits of bacon and potatoes - fabulous. I joked that I wanted to send it back but needed until the last spoonful to realize I didn't like. No one bought that! 

And being in a burger mood, again, I had the best burger I had in a long time (and I've had lots recently!). I had their natural beef burger with cheddar cheese, more of that apple wood bacon and a fried egg with their agogo sauce (mayo, roasted peppers, sriracha and honey) with some really delicious fries (and their house made ketchup)! My now favorite burger in the city! And I loved that it was served in one of those red and white card board box trays! 

While we sat at the bar, you'll most likely share a larger table with fellow diners. No reservations, so be prepared for a bit of wait if you get there when they are busy. And for a limited time BYOB (no corkage)! 

Highly recommended!

In a quaint little house-looking building is this gem of a sandwich shop. The pressed po'boys were excellent. Ranked in order of deliciousness (out of what we ordered) - Cuban, Muffaletta, hot roast beef w gravy, and the last one was a BBQ roast beef. The Cuban was amazing. I wanted more. The bread was perfectly toasted and the meat and cheese inside wonderfully smothered. The Muffaletta was pretty good although much too salty for my taste. The hot roast beef w gravy was messy to eat but pretty tasty. It falls apart completely and the taste was good but not memorable. The shop is great to stop by for a quick bite and the parking is easier to find than French quarters. The BBQ roast beef was actually pretty bad. Nobody in out group could eat more than w bite of it but the other sandwiches were good enough to make up for that one.

This place was amazing! 
Dan was excellent.  I got my phone screen fixed at foxpaw originally and not even a week later the screen cracked again.  My friend googled places that were a little cheaper and we came across this place.  When we got there Dan was the only one there and possibly in the weeds but was still very friendly and very helpful.    He said the phone wouldn't be done until close, which didn't concern me.  Around 5:00 he called and said it would be done around 5:45 and wanted to show me what was really going on .   When we got there, he showed me some irregularities with the phone. I had already mentioned to them that my ear speaker didn't work since I got my screen replaced    Apparently foxpaw replaced the speaker and it wasn't the right screws and not the right speaker that comes with the phone.    So my question is why did they feel the need to replace it?   Even though Dan was a lone soldier he was perfect.  The way he explained everything was fantastic and very helpful.   I recommend this place 100%! Please give it a try!

AWESOME! 

Just got a turkey sub from there, but the bread and meat were super good, happy I didn't end up with a soggy meatless sub. 

No wait to get my stuff to go &Alex was super nice !

I was out of town for work searching vegan restaurants near my hotel when I came across Blackbird pizzeria. I was even more excited when I found out they delivered to my hotel, which was wonderful since I was not feeling like heading out being that I was sick.

When the delivery guy got to my room and found out that I was sick he asked if I had vitamins to take to help me get better. I thought this was very sweet. 

I ordered the Fungi pizza and added elephant garlic. It was AMAZINGLY good! Since I was heading back to LA that night and my girlfriend is from Philly she asked me to bring her the vegan cheesesteak. So after traveling across country in an airplane refrigerator she was extremely happy while eating it. Just think if she had it freshly made. I also brought her some of the whoopie pies from Vegan Treats that they offer at Blackbird. Everyone loved them.

I will definitely be returning to Blackbird Pizzeria when I return to Philly.

Do not go here, my friend and I went to tonight and asked about the music they played we where told WB"s played house music, which was techni and that the other side was a mix of hip hop, latin, 80's and 90's....while we where there it was techno on both sides. Which neither one of us like. Went and spoke to manager about refunding us the$20 cover charge because we only stayed 10 minutes, he said no we refund no one's cover charge. Do not appreciate being lied to about the music and the manager being rude. DO NOT GO IF YOU DON'T LIKE TECHNO!!!!

As a local to the neighborhood, I had every reason to hate the NFL Draft on the Parkway from the start. However, despite a little inconvenience here and there, I absolutely loved it. 

It was a great experience all around. The NFL and the city communicated the closures from the start, unlike some major events (ahem, Papal visit). By the time the event came around, I was fully prepared and was able to just able to enjoy myself. 

I loved that everyone could come and go as they pleased. I was not limited to overpriced food or drink, and was able to visit the local establishments outside of the draft grounds. 

I had a blast with the scavenger hunt. While it would have been cool to actually do some more of these activities, it was really easy to use the QR code to scan for a badge. You Yelpers know how it is with badges after all. I ended up with the collector's edition pin and a $20 gift card to Papa John's for my efforts. 

I wish they had promoted the music stage better, but I thankfully found out that one of my top 10 favorite all time bands was playing a gig. It was awesome spending 45 minutes front and center listening to Good Old War jam. 

On Saturday I was even able to spend some time in the draft theater. Of course, rounds 5, 6 and 7 aren't the best rounds to see, but it was still exciting being part of the action. The NFL did a great job creating this indoor/outdoor theater. It was gorgeous, I really felt like I was inside and felt totally stable in the structure at the same time. 

Even with spending all three days there, I felt like there were things I missed. There were things to do for all walks in life- sports fan and non-sports fans alike. 

Overall, I loved how peaceful and happy everyone was. Despite having NFL fans from every team under the sun, everyone got along as far as I could see. I'm proud to have been a Philadelphian representing the City of Brotherly Love and Sisterly Affection in the national spotlight and on my home turf.

My husband and I were down in Greenwood and wanted to try a new nail salon for our pedicures.
