We try new places all the time (from North, East and South side of town)  to find one that we truly enjoy, who doesn't rush us in and out, who are friendly and do quality work! Because I'm REALLY particular about my nails! After looking at the reviews on Yelp, I decided to go ahead and get a full set of nails as well as our pedicures. 

We were greeted at the door and were seated in our chairs right away. We were very happy with our experience and I'm so glad I opted for my full set of nails! Taylor did a wonderful job and I haven't been this happy with a fresh full set of nails in a long, long time!

We ordered takeout from Macaroni grill and were under impressed with the quality of the entree (mushroom ravioli) and were very sad to find that they had charged us for a soup and not given it to us.  My husband (being the nice person he is) actually offered to go back and pick it up after an exhausting day with kids at theme park.  I would not have been so nice, especially with 4 hungry kids to feed at 8:30 pm. In the end, they offered to refund the amount of the soup to our card. But aside from an apology, there wasn't any other attempt at keeping us as customers.  Not happy with this place.

Good fries.  Not bad for a bite to eat while walking.  I expected something more like pommes frittes though...they used your basic foodservice mayo straight from the pump.

Overall good walking food though.  They were accomadating in putting onions on it so I could get something like the "Special" remember from Amsterdam.

I'll go back!

We used Lloyd's twice this week: once for an emergency and another for maintenance. Both Rob & John were professional, timely, friendly and knowledgeable with our A/C concerns. Appointments were easy to make and times were convenient.

I came into Zenari's for a coffee and to knock another small business off my list of places in downtown Edmonton I want to experience. It was after lunch so I decided to go with a lemon tart and cappuccino. I don't usually order strong coffee drinks so I wasn't sure how I was going to like it but much to my surprise it was quite good. I didn't find it overly strong and I swear I could almost taste a hint of dark chocolate. Now onto my tart and oh what a tart it was! I honestly don't remember the last time I had a more moist and flavorful baked good.

I think my one and only concern with this place would be cost versus portion size. My cappuccino came in an average sized coffee cup that wasn't even filled to the top for about $3.50 and my tart though AMAZING rang up at around $4.00. With that being said however I do believe it's important to treat oneself from time to time and I was so impressed with my post lunch experience here I will definitely be back in for a meal and to check out their wine bar as well.

You have many choices when eating downtown but I strongly encourage you to give these friendly folks a try at least once.

This restaurant was a nice find in Lafayette Square. We came here on a Sunday night and were pleasantly greeted by a very friendly staff. The waitress/hostess was really attentive and checked in on us a few times, giving us her recommendations on what to order and engaging with us.

The food itself was good, being from Texas I try hard not to compare the Mexican food here to the TX Mexican food... that being said, I think I have had tastier Mexican food in STL. I enjoyed my shrimp fajitas though, just thought I didn't get quite that much food with the meal. 

I'd come back here for their margaritas, they had a good looking cadillac margarita that my friend had and I'd be down for that any day! :)

The best breakfast sandwich in the city. Something about their bacon egg and cheese with a hash brown in the bagel covered in chipotle mayo just makes for a perfect weekend morning. The staff are friendly and always recommending great items. Lunch is also great. The daily specials keep me coming back, especially the spicy meatball parm hoagie. Great selection of drinks and candy too.

My wife was miserable with the small stream of cold air that was struggling to push its way out into her car. Given that we live in an oven in the summer...we decided to get it fixed. So, Jiffy lube looked at the AC for free and told her that the compressor needed to be replaced by a full service mechanic. After looking around, we saw other Yelp reviews and decided to give it a go.

The communication from this family run business was great! They offered an appointment and shuttle service even though we live 20ish minutes away. The woman driving the van called to let her know she was leaving and when she arrived to drive her to pick up the car. Everyone was super friendly too! The work was completed promptly at the quoted price. We got a tune up too and they replaced a head light for free.They also (unexpectedly) cleaned the car!

This was probably one of the best car service experiences we've ever had! Definitely recommend!
Rolo's Bakery is a small but very clean and delicious place to stop and buy delicious Colombian treats(pandebonos are AMAZING ) people is very kind and polite.

Horrible experience. Used the business membership, needed a lawyer to execute a "letter" on my behalf on a time sensitive issue. WHICH I STATED MANY TIMES. Just to get the letter done and it's review to send it took over 30 days on a real estate specific performance issue.  Legal Shield used a bogus legal firm called DSK to handle my issue. Everytime someone from DSK would call it was someone different who had NO CLUE about what the complaint was about, I was rudely insulted by a lawyer last name Haygood. I reported the rude behavior an the Legal Shield complaint department is a bigger joke. I had to deal with that rude lawyer several times after that. Their 25% off regular legal fees is not the biggest discount, as the lawyers already have the Legal Shield fees set at a higher rate.... conclusion you really don't see any savings at all. After this legal matter I mixed in is done, they better hope the outcome is good or I will copy and paste this review across every review platform I can find!

I moved out of Philly 5 years ago, and the one thing I still often crave is George's Roast Pork. I was in the city on Friday and stopped by to pick up a container to take home for Saturday (it is Lent so I couldn't eat it though I was dying for it at that moment). The smell of George's shop is intoxicating! It's small and the place was packed for lunch, as well as had a line outside for the walk up window. I used to live in the neighborhood and ate there weekly.

The service was quick and efficient. I love the old school, South Philly attitude of the man behind the grill! I have to laugh at some of the reviews of tourists mentioning the service as unhelpful or rude. They obviously don't realize that is not the case at all, this is just how us Philadelphians are. We are not warm & fuzzy people by nature. The guy made me miss Philly even more!!! I highly recommend that you eat a sandwich there and get some meat to take home because you'll be left with wanting more later. 

I love this place and always visit when I'm back I the city. Everyone in Philly knows this is the place to go for roast pork. Period.

While I'm not a fan of skydiving, we all got to do it once in our lifetime right?

My friends and I bought a groupon for skydiving and had to make reservations. Even though we had to reschedule another date due to weather (it was raining like crazy on the day of, and I really don't need millions of tiny bullets piercing through me when I free fall). So after 2 months, my friends and I finally returned and it felt like ultimatum.

We were told to arrive at 9am because of the paper work and "training" session we need to take that can be around 2 hours long. We walked up to the second floor and started filling out the paper work, while filling it out there was a video playing in the background about the experiences of past jumpers. Once the paperwork was done (took less than 30 minutes) we were told to head on downstairs to get our weights recorded so they can find the right person for you to tandem with (basically they need to know the weight to balance it out when you're in mid air). After that, outside we go and waited for our jumping "partner."

My guy was named Chris, really cute accent. He got me strapped into my suit and told me we will be the second group that's going to jump. Truth be told, I'm nervous as heck, I didn't really want to jump but my friends bought the groupon without my knowledge - what a surprise! Chris tries to ease my nervousness and made small talk with me (which I really do appreciate).

The take off, I admit, was scary. It was a small plane and when we were about 12,000 feet in the air, Chris said we were ready to jump. I went first out of all the people on the plane. Insanely scared and freaked out (good thing I didn't show much emotions) we jumped. Holy...it was actually quite an amazing feeling. We soared through the air and landed safely. Chris was really professional and catered to me, I like the scenic route and he even showed me a rainbow that reflected off of the clouds from our parachute.

Would I do this again? Probably not but I wouldn't technically say no. It was indeed the craziest thing I've done and I don't regret it at all.
Just saw an old woman pass out and no one came to help her...

Noticed this place while picking up dinner and had to check it out! The store is beautiful and very clean with a huge selection of candies, nuts, fresh pastries, and coffee. We ended up purchasing several varieties of baklava and some Turkish Delights, but look forward to going back to try more options. The treats were DELICIOUS! We also sampled the Turkish coffee and were able to customize a blend. The staff is very friendly and helpful. We can't wait to go back!

Didn't have high expectations for vegan fare here but was pleasantly surprised. They can do vegan breakfast bowls with hash browns and black beans with veggies. I had avocado toast with roasted garlic spread, avo, and tomatoes. It was delicious and the sourdough bread was really good. Also had a side of fresh fruit and bottomless French Truck coffee (with soy or almond milk). Their menu is marked with vegan options which is always appreciated. 

Omnivore boyfriend had hash browns (which I tried and they were so crispy - really liked them) and a bacon sandwich which he said he really enjoyed.

Will definitely be back!

Came here for lunch. After I was seated, I informed the waitress I wanted the $1 margarita special. She asked me which one I wanted. I asked her which ones they had, we flipped open the menu and there were two different types. I told her I wanted the strawberry. She brought it to me. Later, when she brought me my bill, it showed my margarita was $7.99. I informed her it was supposed to be $1, and she proceeded to tell me it was in fact not part of the special and it wasn't a $1 margarita! Didn't offer to do anything to make up for it! Not only that, half of my 6 oz sirloin was fat, food wasn't great quality like it used to be! Disappointed!

This place is huge and could be great but it never is. We've given this place 5-6 chances and they e sucked every time. All their food is skimpy, we got a Reuben and had two thin slices of meat on it, the salad was super small, and the sliders are so small with almost no meat. ALL their beer is warm hence why it foams so much when they pour it. Service is always terrible even though they aren't even busy. The workers make you wait awhile and also skip you and help other people and also don't give menus unless you ask and gossip and aren't even knowledgeable about the products at this place. Has a great location and bowling and pool tables and darts but is bad when it comes to consuming anything here.

Useless. Even if you live in an igloo and need a dogsled team to deliver your meds - find a different company. ZERO customer service. We spent HOURS trying to get the meds, delivery and costs straightened out. The only reason we even considered them was the phony 'authoritative' letter they sent about having to pick a drug company or losing our benefits. They should be investigated and shut down. Once they had our business - it took us ONE  refill to realize they are simply not capable of managing delivery on time. Multiple phone calls to Covered California, our doctors, our pharmacy to get rid of them.

The entire experience was the epitome of average. The 20-minute wait on a Thursday night was frustrating considering how many open tables there were. The bread, salad and meal were all pretty meh and forgettable. And the atmosphere was bland. The only thing that saved the trip was a good waitress and pretty quick service once we were sat. But it doesn't stand out as a place I'll be dying to come back to anytime soon.

***Note I have not used their services...but....they were extremely helpful in answering question about another company. To elaborate...we delivered a baby girl never thinking about banking before. The hospital packed everything up for us utilizing CBR another private company. So the sample was sent off while at the hospital as most of us at that time we have a lot going on. We did as well so did spend any extra thought on what company to use. Get the call a few days late from CBR for enrollment start filling our agreements and doing a little research and find out there are a lot of complaints on CBR. Seems more customer support related billing or sending people to collection where individuals claim they cancelled or paid or whatever. So I called Cryo-Cell to find my options.

Can I move the sample to your facility? Is it safe? etc.,

The gentleman on the phone was honest, caring, understood the product and his competitors. We chatted yes I chatted with the guy which I never DO because good customer service is non existent. He gave advice for best approach for my family which I truly appreciate! So thank you Cryo-Cell for listening and assisting me and my family!

Probably some of the best ramen currently available in Philadelphia, although with Philly's burgeoning ramen scene, there hasn't been many ramen places that are quite perfect yet. 

The noodles are springy, the broth is good, the soft boiled marinated eggs are flavorful and cooked perfectly, and the pork is delicious. Perhaps my only gripe is that the pork is sliced too thin and really they're pretty stingy with it.

The pork belly buns are a bit underwhelming.

The ambience is nice, and overall I would go back.
The mask police are alive and well here, beware. Too bad it's come to discriminating patrons. They won't continue to get our business.

My wife and I dined here on a mini-vacation to the city. They had a good wine and craft beer/cider collection as well as decent cocktails. The food menu was an adequate size of options, perfect for a date night.

I had a fresh house-made pasta dish which was perfectly cooked, and had a bread and ricotta appetizer which was DELICIOUS. One of the noticeable parts was that for a modern/highly rated restaurant the portions were reasonable. Having an appetizer, entree, and dessert left me full, but comfortable. The portions were not too big or small (small tends to be the norm at many "hip" places to dine at).

Overall, I'd recommend this cozy little restaurant to anyone seeking a unique, fresh dining option in the city.

I checked out this place today for lunch as a co-worker suggested the Pho and I was feeling very Pho like... the place is your typical looking hole in the wall kinda place which in my opinion are the best places on earth. That and food trucks. And street vendors, but sadly non around in Tampa, att least not where I wander. And I like when ethnic restaurants are well occupied by the same ethnic people as well as everyone else. I figure it's a good sign of the real stuff.
The Pho at Saigon was the closest to my favorite Pho in NOVA. I miss my NOVA Pho. So I am happy to have found one that'll do quite nicely. Next time, I'm jumping on those shrimp spring roles I kept eyeing near the register and some of the interesting stuff in the cooler even though I have no idea what any of it was... I'm game.

This place was meh. After having the ribs at Pappy's my expectations for St Louis bbq were high. We had the 2 meat combo of brisket and turkey. Both were ok, not stellar. I actually thought the brisket was dry. We had the sweet potato salad and baked beans as sides and I didn't like the sweet potato salad but my husband said the beans were ok. The place was dirty in the sense that the tables weren't being cleaned which made it hard to find a table to sit at. I wouldn't come back.

We received an alert from our Nest thermostat that our furnace was turning on and off while heating. Due to the fact that we have an infant, we wanted to get it checked out by a professional. We called Davis and someone came out to fix it wIthin three hours of our call. Dennis was  polite, thorough, and explained everything in detail. He also added a picture of our make/model/serial number of our unit so it would be in our account for reference later. I will definitely be using them again if needed!

We've played the old course and the newer course a bunch of times.  I've never had an issue with parking, but I've had some issues with large groups playing.  It should just be common courtesy to have a group of six or more split into two groups.  People can still talk and chat, but everyone get's done faster.  Almost everytime we are here, this isn't enforced, but we just play around them.  

My biggest issue is brick walled courses.  I don't really like these courses as the brick is too unpredictable.  This course is challenging and incredibly unforgiving.  One small mistake as you put up a hill brings your ball all the way to the start.  They do the best they can with their course, but I think I do prefer their older course over the newer one.

Usually, I love you guys.  But not today.  I feel as though we pay top dollar for food here.  WIth that being the case, I EXPECT to get exactly what I ordered, no more, no less.  Well, today's order was totally botched.  I ordered guac in my burrito bowl.  No guac.  I ordered double protein.....barely a regular portion.  I ordered BEANS.  NO beans.  I ordered brown rice.  I got white.  C'mon, guys!!  This is NOT rocket science here, and it's the second time I didn't get what I ordered.  If you can't get it together, there are plenty of places around here that do get the orders right....  Please shape up!

This place has some serious potential!! I think with just opening they have a few kinks to work out, but the overall atmosphere and idea is great.  The desserts are beautiful and decadent, but what are they? I wish they had signs by each cake or dessert saying what it is, so hard to ask for help just to see what something is.  I had some coffee and a truffle and LOVED both, but I may have tried something else if I knew what things were or what was available.  Also there was just a lot of commotion going on and I wasn't sure if I seat myself, wait to be seated, order at the table?? Too many people standing around and not enough really contributing to the work.  

With all this being said.. you still need to go and experience the luxurious cake bake shop! Closest thing to an English tea room in the Broad Ripple area!

This place was a wannabe hole. Their rules should be placed in the restrooms. They literally will not allow debit or credit payments. It's a sure place never to go again bar.  I'd rather go to hell than go back to this place.

I love this Publix so much! Everyone is so kind-- they wash all of the buggies after each use. The employees talk to me while checking out and ask what my plans are which leads to us chatting. Everyone is so helpful and cheery which is so needed in these times! Thank you Publix on old hickory blvd for being the real MVG!
Bodovino is the perfect place to sit, relax and enjoy a nice wine.
Love Bacara! Fabulous setting, most gorgeous views, amenities are amazing and the spa service is top notch. Highly recommend for your next trip!

Stopped in here for an afternoon pick-me-up a few weekends ago with some friends and was pleasantly surprised with just how different a place this is between day time and night time. You could say it's like... black and white.

The first thing you'll notice about this place when you walk in is that it's beautiful. It's a narrow area, so the bar itself takes about about half of the area, meaning there's not too many places to sit, or even to stand. But it's decorated impeccably creating a very warm and inviting atmosphere, and you can always go out back for a little extra room. The day we were there they had a band playing near the entrance, and while the music was honestly amazing, it was so loud that my friends were yelling and still having trouble being heard. And the few times I've been here at night we've had the same issue even without there being a band to add to the problem. The only problem with the awesome decor is that it's all hard surfaces and noise just never dies.

As for the drinks, I've got nowhere to complain. I've had a Moscow Mule there, which was pretty good; an Old Fashioned, which was great; and this most recent time I ordered a Nolet's Nectar, which was absolutely amazing. You get your drinks pretty quickly when you order them, and the bar tenders are all very classy looking people that seem to know what they're doing. And this is definitely a place to stop by on your birthday.

Prices are a bit steep but it's what you'd expect from a bar that's trying to look a little classier than the multitudes of others within a two block radius.

Definitely give this place a try though. And if you like gin (and especially if you like the bitter kick of a negroni), give the Nolet's Nectar a try. Not as bitter, but absolutely amazing.

My grandfather is a badass Cuban man. He is like 200 years old. He has survived more heart attacks than I've had serious relationships. He came to the USA after the Castro regime took everything from his family. He vacations by working on his ranch in South Carolina. He speaks with a thick accent, a charismatic voice carved from years of toil and adventure.

He is the real life version of that dos equis stooge, "the most interesting man in the world."

It was in Florida that he taught me of Cuban food, the food of my people(Cuban Jews). Throughout my childhood, dinner with grandpa was usually dinner at a Cuban place. He would not take his family to any sucker joint that did not satisfy his discerning palate. It is with this background that I gain the authority to say Alma de Cuba honors legitimate Cuban cuisine and mixes it up with Steven Starr panache...and it is pretty darn delicious.

I like this place. It has become kind of a go-to spot for me when it comes to entertaining business-y guests. The ambiance is elegant and unique without being stuffy. The service has never been poor.

The ceviche here is my favorite in Philadelphia. The Peruvian bass, Rainbow, and shrimp ceviches are all great. You can't go wrong here. Do you want to try a good ceviche? Then just close your eyes and point in the general direction of that part of the menu. Eat that one.

The empanadas and tuna tartare tacos are excellent appetizers.

If you are trying to decide between the honey mustard glazed salmon and the shrimp stew, go with the stew.

The chocolate cigar is a very good dessert. It is a decadent almond cake wrapped in chocolate mousse that works in perfect harmony with dulce de leche ice cream. That being said, keep your expectations humble if you order this. The 5 stars of this review was earned by the ceviche and not the sweet selections.

Furthermore, Alma de Cuba's happy hour offers some really excellent apps and drinks. I like it a lot.

On the action-movie-parallel-satisfaction-scale, this movie is the OPPOSITE of Batman Forever.

Heard about Dr. Roach's practice from a co-worker and was more than thrilled when they were able to get me in the following week. I scheduled an early morning appointment and was able to find street parking (2 hour parking for free). I was promptly greeted by a woman named Hannah who explained intake paperwork I needed to complete. Hannah called over her headset and let me know that my room was ready early for me and I could go there to complete my forms. The room was immaculately clean, had a private television and was very warm. Hannah gave me a new patient gift (so sweet!) and explained the practice has a comfort menu which I can use at any appointment (chap stick requests, neck pillow, etc). 

I then met with Jackie, a dental hygienist, who is seriously wonderful. She listened to my personal needs and dental history with care and was able to walk me through the appointment. I so appreciate that staff utilizes a form to ask you about your communication style, what you are most concerned with when it comes to your teeth - it helped to make my care individualized! Jackie and I had a great conversation and I can't wait to see her on my next visit - she is a ROCKSTAR (which is evident from all the other reviews singing her praises!) 

I then met with a dental assistant and dentist, Dr. Zhang. Both were wonderful and were able to perform oral cancer screenings, x-rays and fluoride treatment.

Front office staff came back during my appointment and brought an itemized sheet with services I received during my appointment - what my insurance would cover, what I would pay out of pocket, as well as out of pocket expenses for a cavity I need to have filled at my next appointment. I truly appreciate their transparency. 

I had a great experience and have already told several of my co-workers about the practice. Keep up the great work!

We were trying to find a place in the area for dinner, my son had always wanted to try Red Robin so we did.  It was busy but there was no wait for a table.  We loved all the artwork on the walls. Service was friendly but not fast. We all got the bottomless floats, and each had a burger with steak fries.  The floats were good but we didn't need more than one.  Two of the three burgers were good, the third was a crispy black puck.  The steak fries were just ok.  We let them know about the burnt burger, they offered to make a new one, we asked for it to go as we had to be somewhere to pick up another kid.  We were told they could have it out for us in a few minutes.  Well, after 10 minutes of waiting we were just about to leave.  It finally came out.  We got in the car and headed out.  I opened my burger and saw that it was just as burnt as the last one.  Yes, I asked for it with no pink as did my son, his burger was perfectly cooked not burnt like both of mine.  The only good thing with my order was the fries, they were super fresh and very good.  No plans of coming back again.

Visiting st. Pete beach for the week, and we visited Shell's on our first night. We'll be going back, probably more than once our whole trip! The service was awesome; very sweet wait staff and the food was amazing. I got the lobster pasta the first night, and crab legs the second. I was in a good coma after! Ate every last bite. Would recommend to anyone looking for a place with great food and great prices, especially for seafood in such a tourist filled destination, as these places can get pretty pricey! Overall, excellent place.
Most authentic Philly-style grub I have found in the Tampa Bay Area. Worth the trip from anywhere within an hour radius. DO IT.

Went with a large group for new years eve this year.  Had a great experience.  The tuna tartare was awesome, i started with a wedge salad with bacon and red peppers that was very good.  A friend had the stuffed chicken wings, which i would highly recommend.  They were awesome, and really unique.  I had the sea bass for my main meal, which was a special that night, served with gnocci.  I was also very tempted by the drum and the duck, on the normal menu.  Someone at my table had each of those though, and they were also both VERY good.  I would definitely get the drum if I were to go back (assuming the bass was not on the menu) or the duck.  

I was way too stuffed for dessert, but I'm sure it would have been good as well!

Would definitely go back.

We have ordered from Jay Asian for  years and is our go-to Chinese/Thai takeout place.  We always order the Wonton Soup - lovely, soft pork dumplings in a flavored broth.  Beef and broccoli, General Tso's chicken, pork lo mein are typically on our list.  We also have the sushi - buy one, get one free is a sweet deal.  We have also tried the currys and other items.  Just wish they had shrimp toast!  My girlfriend joined us once and every time she comes over she says wants to order from here.

We have never had an issue with delivery. Often, if there is a question on the order, we get a call from them.  We order online thru their link vs. GrubHub, etc.  My only complaint is that I place notes that I do not want any cutlery, soy sauce, etc. but it still comes with the order.  I try not to waste resources - oh well!

i shop here once a week and on my recent visit i've purchased rotten produce from this place. i bought 2 containers of cut up cantaloupes and one of them had a recent date on it but the melons tasted like alcohol and that only happens if they were cut up 2 weeks prior since usually i keep melons for 2 weeks in the fridge. my cherry tomatoes didn't have a packing date but were rotten after a day of buying them and i've kept cherry tomatoes for 3 weeks before they rot in the past. Also the mushrooms i got had fungus growing on them by the second day of purchasing which is unacceptable since i haven't eaten any of the produce i bought. the other things they sell do not disappoint and the staff is friendly, but they need to pack fresher produce.
The Meridian red Robin is worth the drive from Nampa. The service and the meal were great.
Love this place!  It has become Boise's new music scene and hosts a wide variety of things to do.  Their food is hosted by BBQ 4 Life and it's hard to resist the french fries.

3.28.19 First time eating here, and we loved it! 

We all decided to meet after work for their Happy Hour. As we were about to enter the restaurant, I noticed a posting on their door saying "Prime Rib Night Every Thursday". It was a three-course dinner all for just $19.95. It just so happened that evening we chose to dine in was also a Thursday! 

We started off by ordering the Artisan Cheese Board, American Kobe Beef Meatballs, and the Italian Polenta Cakes. The Artisan Cheese Board was served with Cambozola Cheese, Fontina, White Cheddar, along with honey, pear, and assorted crackers. The American Kobe Beef Meatballs was served in a bowl of Mission Figs Demi Sauce mixed with a Humboldt fog Fondue, micro mint and crostini. Lastly, their Polenta Cakes were crusted with crispy parmesan, served in a Pomodoro Sauce with dollops of Mascarpone Cream, sprinkled with Italian Parsley. Having a cheese board is always a fun way to dine, and everything was absolutely delicious. When it came time for dinner, I was dead set on ordering their Prime Rib Special. As advertised, it was a three-course dinner, starting off with either a soup or salad, the prime rib, and lastly, vanilla bean ice cream. I opted for their soup, which was a hearty and tasty Chicken Posole Soup. Their prime rib was tender, juicy and served with steamed vegetables and a baked potato. I just kept thinking to myself that all of this was just $20! The ice cream was simple and a sweet way to end our dinner service. 

Service was notably on point throughout from beginning to end. Our waters were always filled and finished plates were promptly cleared. 

For being our first time dining at Napa Sonoma Grocery Company, we were all very much impressed. The atmosphere was casual and welcoming with such exceptional service. Their food was tasty and we left no survivors. Being so close to home, you can count on us visiting more often!

Absolutely awesome.  So glad this location opened for those of us who don't always feel like making it a city night.  The Loop location is great too, but who doesn't love a new venue?  Anyway great burgers, awesome as usual beer list, nice patio (with propane heaters!), well presented main courses and a good vibe & atmosphere.  Will definitely be back, possibly making this my new go-to pub.  They have most things right here!

This little coffee "shack" is decent! My husband and I tried this place out today and we both really enjoyed our experience! First off, we were greeted by a smiling face, as we pulled up to the drive-thru window! I had several questions on their menu and the lady, working the drive-thru, kindly answered each and every one of them. It took me a while to decide, as their menu was rather large. Not only did they have their regular menu, but they also had a specialty menu, filled with tons of interesting and delicious flavor combinations. I, finally, decided on the blended French Kiss, which is a blended coffee with french vanilla and raspberry flavoring. She made it perfectly! It was blended to my liking and the flavor shots were the perfect addition to their already flavorful coffee. It made me just want to try more of their specialty menu! My husband got the blended S.O.S, which is 6 shots of espresso with irish creme. The espresso was the perfect wake-me-up and it was tasty coffee, as well. However, after trying it, myself, I felt like the espresso overpowered the light Irish creme flavor. It was still quite good! My husband (being a coffee addict!) really enjoyed it. The barista even gave him an extra cup of his S.O.S, since the hot espresso melted the "blended" portion of his drink. We both got 20 ounce drinks and our total was just over $11.00; we both, however, thought it was worth it. My favorite part of my experience here, by far, was the absolutely exceptional customer service. She checked with us to make sure we liked our drinks and was satisfied with our experience! I give them two thumbs up!

Worst customer service I have ever encountered.  The person behind the counter wasn't interested in selling or promoting his wares. No interaction at all. 

A signs says 30,000 plus records which is a sizeable sum. I'm sure you'll find what you are looking for. Mostly used records layed around with a few new ones in a bin. 

Other than the size of his wares, nothing fantastic.

I've been looking for a good Ethiopian restaurant since leaving California to live in champaign urbana. I came here on a weekend trip to Indianapolis with my fiancé. I liked Major and thought the food was good. We got the veggie combo and it was a great choice. Our favorites were the Quosta and Shiro. The waitress was very kind to bring us extra of those for free! Major props! Their less sweet honey wine tasted progressively better throughout the meal and was a nice touch. I recommend this restaurant and think others will like it too!
Our waitress was so awesome today. She was lively and her personality was infectious. I think her name was Lacy. We will definitely come back in the future!

I have officially been coming here for years!  I am here now, and will address some of the negative reviews I've read:

1. One reviewer gave Trolley Car a bad review because they asked for "no mayo" and got mayo.  Honestly, I hate mayo and would probably do the same if I had that experience.  My orders have always been accurate.

2. A couple of reviewers complained about the service, and in the past I would have agreed.  I recall one waitress who was just down right b**chy.  Trolley Car seems very responsive though, because I have not seen her in a while and the server that I have today could not be more sweet and attentive is she tried.  I had her the last time I came as well.

3. For better or for worse, the menu has changed entirely since 2011, so be sure to read more recent reviews if you are looking for opinions on the food.

Today I ordered the nova platter, and it was impressive!  I actually said "wow" when it came out--toasted bagel, arugula salad with capers, tomato, cucumbers, nova (lox) and cream cheese.  The presentation was lovely and I devoured it.  The guy at the table next to me said "wow" when his order came also.  Not sure what he ordered, but two "wows" in one morning is pretty great.

I think a good restaurant should be willing to listen, make changes, improve, and update the menu.  Trolley Car is a winner for me.
LP's is a friendly, laid back hang, perfect for a cold beer and live music! A lot of regulars here and the menu is quite good! The locals love it and the bands are a lot of fun.
Don Juan exceeds my expectations. With Kids and adults, he takes his time and offers his expert opinion on style/cut. Highly recommended by me.

I  have to start my review by saying I have worked with and been friends with the head chef/part owner Violeta for many years and after she left the last place we worked together I have been dying to eat her cooking again. I finally was able to get to Tapas on a weeknight so it was pretty chill. The decor is very classy and fun. I ordered the ceviche because shes always made the most amazing ceviche and once again she didnt disappoint. It was fresh and light and didnt have that fishy smell some other place have who freeze their fish. My son got the 1/4 chicken and fries and devoured it. I was brought a complimentary dessert with puff pastry and sweetened condensed milk jam. It  reminded me of peruvian Alfajores but lighter and fresher! I loved it!! I cant wait to try the new dishes on her menu that I havent seen before...
I have been seeing Dr. David Allen for about 19 years and I have never known such a caring & compassionate Doctor. He has helped me so much throughout the years. I highly recommend him.

Great experience - you walk in and instantly feel like you're dining for experience rather than simply great food. I have been lucky enough to have the tasting menu twice. The lamb dishes are both great. Of the two fish dishes I prefer the halibut to the bass but both were interesting. The fatteh is different and delicious from the Middle East flavors you can get at many fast casual dining options on the city (as opposed to dishes like hummus and such). The apple dessert is very tasty and the coffee ice cream dish is also indulgent. Yum! Cannot wait to try their brunch options.

This place has really gone downhill... food was cold, no silverware. And neighbors in the next booth experiencing the same thing.  Food portions were small, clearly minimizing, side bread was limited, only served 2 pieces for two people, had to ask for more, two pieces again, no more bread basket. We will not be going back.

My husband and I generally enjoy sitting at the bar when it comes to eating sushi, but the only downside with sitting a the bar and ordering a lot of orders and that your space can be over filled with plates. My husband and I are like Dyson vacuums. We eat soooo fast, they we end up with a lot of spare empty plates quickly. Here, no problem. It was a slow day, but service was attentive about taking away our finished plates, refilling our water, and the sushi was delish! 

I'm a huge fan of baked mussels, and I could probably eat 5+ orders and then another 5+ orders after a couple rolls. Yummy food here, guys!

The fish and chips is as good as they say.  We also liked the cioppino, which came with a tasty broth and loaded with shellfish.  Good margaritas.  Service was prompt and professional.  We sat inside so the ambiance wasn't the greatest - it was a crowded, high traffic area.  However, the outside seats overlooking the harbor looked nice.  Prices were reasonable.

Definitely one of the top sushi places in the Tampa Bay Area. Made a reservation with my boyfriend through their website and had no troubles being seated-be mindful that parking is scarce in the evening & valet is an option. The ambience inside is casual, yet intimate-with dim lighting. Our server was the sweetest and very attentive, and had no trouble answering our questions with the menu. My boyfriend lives for anything spicy so he immediately ordered the "Jaletuna" Bites appetizer and to be quite honest that appetizer is the reason we will be returning. The Jaletuna bites are slices of fresh jalapeño peppers topped off with spicy tuna and cream cheese, tempura fried and drizzled with spicy mayo and eel sauce- literally drooled as I typed that. It's delicious. Definitely wouldn't recommend if you can't handle some spice in your life. My boyfriend and I happen to run on spice ‍ Further on, if you put spicy and salmon together on a menu I'm going to order it- their crunchy spicy salmon rolls were so fresh and scrumptious (I didn't wanna share) I just know they will be a staple in my future orders. For our dinner my boyfriend ordered the asparamaki dinner, which is essentially asparagus rolled in steak-any positive comment would be an understatement so just know I highly recommend. I ordered the katsu dinner which was breaded chicken along with a citrus- barbecue sauce- it was perfect. Needless to say Soho Sushi is #1 on my list of go-to sushi restaurants. I cannot wait to try more of their delicious sushi options come my next visit!

As an attorney, I strongly recommend against accepting any services from Palm Harbor. Regardless of the quality of the service, accepting any medical treatment here places you in a difficult financial position. 
The "Consent to Treat" form is actually a trick to get you to pay for any number of services.
food is decent and a good price. Service is terrible every single time I have come there. If you want good food but no drink refills or cheap wine you ordered, this is the place.

First let me start with the obvious, they have a parking lot right out front.  It doesn't get any better than that.  I had a hoagie with roasted peppers, sharp provolone, prosciutto, and capacola.  It was tremendous, roll was perfect!   The service is so friendly from the minute you walk in the door.  It has such an Italian feel to the place I felt like I was walking into my grandmothers house.  They have breakfast all day long, a coffee station and a bunch of baked goods I will definitely be coming back to try.  I came during the lunch rush and still had quick service but it wasn't even a concern because they have free wireless internet there!!  If you like a friendly place with excellent food, this is the place to be.  It will be my new lunch spot.  I will also have them host our Christmas party because they also cater.

Love this place. Cool atmosphere and even cooler food. The drink stations for tea and coffee are awesome. Like walking into an old movie scene. I loved the books and little shop. The dining are was bright and open, definitely worth seeing. only negative was the prices of the mimosas. $15 for two sips is excessive... Other than that I would say definitely do not miss this if you are exploring Tampa!

If I could put zero, I would. I pray this isn't the complex you choose, go anywhere but here. I hope you don't have to suffer. The amenities? Great, when the office isn't closing it as a punishment like they're a babysitter? ANYTHING ELSE? Shit. The staff is a joke, including Dorian who will follow up with you once and when you respond he goes completely ghost. I haven't had internet since moving in and my neighbors suck but they only care about their money, not their tenants. The building is rapidly aging poorly, the apartments are tiny, there's no storage at all for one person let alone anyone else, they steal your money, and don't get me started on the amount of animal crap and pee or human throw up and spit EVERYWHERE in the hallways. The place is a total illusion, what you see is not what you get. Please save yourself the trouble, you'll hate it. We all got sucked in by the amenities as they're great, don't get me wrong. But in the end, they are not worth it and I can find an apartment with the exact same amenities cheaper and nicer  for the same price, if not less. Trust me, I've been looking since I moved in. Good luck to you though if this is where you choose, start looking at new apartments quickly so they don't fill out by the next leasing season!

Although I found Jake Banks personable, he really let me down in terms of his dental practice.
On three separate occasions, he insisted that I needed a crown on a tooth and that a filling wouldn't suffice or wouldn't be possible to do. Being that crowns are costly, I decided to get a second opinion from my previous dentist of twenty years whom I loved and trusted. I'd stopped going to my previous dentist only because I'd relocated and his office was a considerable distance from where I now lived. 

 My previous dentist assured me that a crown wasn't needed and he proceeded to do fillings on the teeth, both of which have held up just fine.
On the third occasion, Jake had told me that there was a cavity under an existing crown that wouldn't be possible to fill without removing the existing crown and then having a new crown made to put in its place. My previous dentist was out of town so I couldn't consult with him. Since Jake had been adamant that the filling couldn't be done without removal of the crown, I believed him.

A friend who lives part of the year in Ensenada, recommended I come down to Mexico for a visit and go to his trusted dentist, of many years, to have the filling done and a new crown made. I don't have dental insurance and pay out of pocket for dental work, Dental work is a fraction of the cost in Mexico compared to what it is in the states so I made all the necessary arrangements to be worked on by my friend's dentist. 
It was a long journey, between flying to San Diego and then taking a bus to Ensenada. When I arrived, my friend's dentist took an x-ray of my tooth and informed me that he wouldn't have to remove my existing crown to fill the cavity. He said he'd only have to shave off a very tiny portion at the base of the existing crown to be able to fill the cavity and that's just what he did for a mere $80.00. He stood to make a lot of money by doing a crown but was an honest man and didn't want me to have work done that wasn't necessary. That tooth has been fine ever since.

In May of 2015, a different tooth developed a severe infection seemingly out of the blue.
I have my teeth cleaned every four months and practice good daily oral hygiene and have never had a mouth infection in the past. The infection came on very suddenly and became severe within just a day and a half. 

I knew I had to be seen by a dentist and get some antibiotics ASAP as my whole mouth was throbbing and felt like it was on fire and my face had begun to swell all the way up to my ear. I haven't taken antibiotics in 20 years, as I prefer treating myself with herbal remedies and I rarely get sick but, in this case, I knew antibiotics were needed. It was Jake's day off when I called his office but I was told I could be seen by his partner, Dr. McConnell. McConnell turned out to have the worst 'bed-side manner' of any doctor or dentist I've ever met. He was huffy, insensitive, and mis-diagnosed the problem. I left the office in tears, without a prescription for antibiotics, and had to go to my MD's office to get a prescription. I had a very high fever and my MD seeing how inflamed my mouth was wrote a prescription for me. She told me I should really be going to a dentist and I explained I had gone to the dentist but I never wanted to return to that office as it had been such an awful experience with Dr. McConnell.

The antibiotics cured the infection and I got a referral from a local friend to go to their dentist a week later. I'd had a complete set of x-rays done a couple of months earlier. When this dentist looked at the x-ray of the tooth that had been infected, he saw that the tooth was being afflicted by a rare condition called 'resorption'. He tested the tooth and determined that it was now dead. He told me it was urgent for me to be seen by an endodontist to determine if it would be possible to save the tooth by means of a root canal. It turned out it wasn't and I had to have the tooth extracted. It was a canine tooth in the smile zone, too. Bummer.

I'd been assured by the front desk at Jake Bank's office that Jake had looked at my x-rays when they were taken and that he would've notified me if there had been any cause for concern.
During the week that I had the infection, I called Jake Bank's office, to ask that he look at the x-rays, again, and let me know if he saw anything wrong with that tooth. I never heard back from him so I assumed everything was okay. My friend's dentist spotted the resorption problem, at once.
Had Jake taken the time to really look at the x-rays when they'd first been taken, months earlier, it's possible my tooth could've been saved.
I'm very disappointed with Jake Banks and McConnell's office. By contrast, I love my new dentist. He's extremely knowledgeable, skilled, and friendly. I have a great rapport with him and he even charges less for his services. Unless you want to pay for crowns you don't need and possibly have serious problems overlooked, I'd recommend going elsewhere.
I love this place! Such a beautiful mansion. Stylish interior, clean and tidy. Rooms are a bit small though, but I would definetly come again

I stayed at my nieces apartment during out Family Reunion. Can I just say how impressed I was with everything on this site. We had traveled 6! hours and dreamed of a dip in the pool. So we did! The grounds were significantly clean. We stayed for 3 days. Enjoyed the very safe and updated playground.  On Saturday, we were pleasantly surprised to hear about Brunch inside the clubhouse lobby. What apartment complex serves HOME MADE BLUEBERRY MUFFINS?! Impressed? just a little. The nice young lady in the office, Kayla, expressed that this was a weekly deal. Brunch and fresh coffee every single weekend. There was a gathering beginning with residents needing to pay their rent, and not once did the smile leave the young  ladies face. She had many people trying to speak with her and I was impressed but she handled everyone with in the time it took for my family and I to grab our little brunch items and leave. My husband used the onsite gym facility with my future nephew in law, cant get him to stop asking about getting a sauna for our home. 

over all... great staff, amazing grounds, delicious muffins.

I must say, I've never had a $100 trip to the movies before this. Next time we'll go eat dinner before the movie elsewhere because the menu is a bit too overpriced for what's served. I don't need a $14 mini pizza and a $10 drink with my overpriced movie ticket. It's also convenient for the theatre that the food court is closed during the evening showings, so if you're hungry, you're "a captive audience". Kid at the counter didn't know anything about validating our parking, so we paid full price on that too. Total movie experience for two adults = $100.00. Not something I plan to do again.

Pretty busy when we came on a Saturday night which is to be expected, had to wait for a table to become open before ordering. They forgot a meal out of our 5 but fixed it quickly. Overall, Would go back.

Petite Chou has never disappointed.  The food has always been wonderful, service is great, and they are pet friendly!  Salads are delicious, chicken salad is legit, and of course the cinnamon and sugar toast!  Oh, and I love their fruit cups -- always fresh.

Yup I did it, the 3rd Wal-Mart I have visited in my life. Don't go getting judge on me, I have nothing against Wal-Mart & they have some great products & prices.
My problem originates with the fact there is never a slow time to go, so time consuming.
Second is parking! What a nightmare, just park far away & try not to get killed entering store. Then talk to the rain God's to hold off till you make it safely back to your vehicle.
Next is the cart pile ups in lanes, especially frozen & refrigerated...can I take a number.
Last but certainly not least, extremely long check out lines. Even if they have self checkouts, your frozen food won't make it home. A nightmare, I wish I could find just 1 well run store & I would make the drive, at least I'm moving.
What's a girl to do? When your patience level is low & your love of your ankles is high, only make that trip when you must!

My husband and I made reservations to come here for our anniversary. We were very excited after hearing all the good things about the restaurant. It did not disappoint! Our server Joe was great he made us feel very welcomed and helped me pick a wonderful glass of wine! My prime rib was cooked perfectly and my husbands filet mignon melted in your mouth! I cannot stop thinking about the mushroom risotto!! It was amazing! We really enjoyed ourselves and can't wait to return!

my boyfriend scheduled his covid booster shot over a week ago for today (12/26) at this location. this morning, he confirmed his appointment, and within 12 minutes of his confirmation, this location canceled his appointment with no explanation. he tried to call to ask why it was canceled, and he was placed on hold indefinitely. he then tried to reschedule 2 more times and it allowed him to reschedule for the same date and same time. both times, CVS canceled it, and every time he tried to call, he was placed on hold for 15+ minutes. when we finally got through to someone on the 3rd call, she would not answer our questions and eventually stopped responding to us. after about 5 minutes of silence and him repeatedly asking if she was still there, he hung up. he asked for her name, but she would not respond to him at all. if they ran out of boosters at this location, or were simply understaffed, we have both worked in customer service before and would understand. but to be blown off repeatedly the day of the appointment is unprofessional. I received my booster at a different CVS location (Meridian and 16th Street), and had no problems scheduling, and was seen promptly. this leads me to believe that it is not a CVS issue, but an issue with this specific location. i would recommend any other CVS location in Indianapolis, this one isn't worth the headache.
Drove 45 mins the check this place out and their hours changed and they were closed. I suggest calling first before assuming they are open.

The food was good, Service could be better. Don't think I'll be back. Nothing wow'd me

We went here with a group of people, some of whom were from out of town. Sunday morning for brunch, when we arrived we were the first ones there ordered our drinks it took about 30 min to get those then our meal came out an hour later. 

I asked for a second drink and the waitress never brought it out. She then said she was so busy with the other tables and it had been a crazy morning (there were about 5 or 6 other tables there)

Dr. Lin is a great general doctor who has the best manner with patients. I will send my whole family to Dr. Lin. My experience with her practice was very good. The travel clinic also very quick and easy. Got all shots for trip.

UPDATE - This place is still great.  I've been back, and it's great.  Mirko makes a terrific lunch spot.  Here's why:

- EASY PARKING:  Found a parallel parking spot right out front, and saw two more that were open.  Dropped four quarters in the meter and walked 50 feet to Mirko.  Done.

- EFFICIENT HOST:  The host greeted us immediately and seated us.  No wait (which can be a real key if you don't have a ton of time at lunch).

- GREAT SERVER:  Our young server was professional and enthusiastic.  When I asked her which of two dishes the liked, she had a great answer that indicated that she eats there and loves the food.  (You'd be surprised how many servers will say, "uhhh, well, I've not had that yet...")

- FRESH FOOD:  Everything is fresh.

- TABLE BREAD AND BEAN DIP:  Gotta try the white-bean and olive oil dipping sauce for the table bread.  I've not had anything like it.  Love it.

My Lasagna Verde was strong.  It's verde because of the spinach, by the way.  The sauce was just right, with good crushed tomato in it rather than just pureed stuff.  There was a layer of meat sauce in it that balanced well with the cheese and pasta.  My lovely wife's pasta was home made and tasty.

Didn't get to try the desserts.  Guess we'll have to go back.

Tuan and Kit were extremely helpful right from the start.  I received a call back within minutes and they were out to work on my issues within a day.  I cannot say enough how helpful, honest and informed they are.  I have passed there information to all of my friends in the area.  If you need a plumber call Drains R Us!

We have enjoyed both an excellent dinner and delicious lunch. Both times, we took advantage of the Calamari Appetizer.   It was excellent!  We look forward to enjoying a meal here next time we are in town.

I'm from out of town and was coming in from the airport.   I ordered pickup since they were closing soon.   They took my order even though it's about 30 minutes to closing.  

As usual, I asked for the most famous 3 items and selected the shrimp and grits.  Very well done.  Probably top 10 of the ones I've eaten.   I'd say it's a winner.   As far as the other stuff, bread didn't last well to the hotel and the sweet tea was so small for the price you pay.   I'd ask to retune their pick up orders to give more value if possible and to change the recommendation to items that travel better.

I'll have to come back in the future to eat at the restaurant.   I'm sure the experience would be even better.

I went there a few months ago last time. i found this amazing restaurant in a magazine 'NASHVILLE' I had a huge breakfast then. i don't eat American style one much but did enjoy there. Simple crispy bacon and sunny-side-up and toast. I tried to order lunch too  but I failed then because it was too early. So I came back here again for lunch today.

Lunch comes with 2 sides and toasts or corn cakes. Additional side is $1.5

Roast herb chicken with skillet beans and mashed red potato and corn cakes. $7
Huge and Tasty! Chicken is super tender and tastes a little bit like jerk chicken. The bones fall apart. Skillet beans are a tiny bit spicy and AMAAAAAAZING. I've never tasted like this. MUST ORDER. Mashes red potato is very good too. The skins make it tastier. Corn cakes are simply good.

Salisbury steak with coleslaw, mac&cheese, greens, and mix beans. $8+$1.5+$1.5
Salisbury steak is really moist and very flavorful. Coleslaw is a little bit heavy mayonnaise but fresh and delicious. Mac&cheese is rich but good. Greens are a little bit sour. Mix beans ... hmmm. I prefer skillet beans!

The chef Big Al is funny  friendly and the waitress is really nice. I like the really welcome atmosphere. 

I can't wait for the next visit there!!!!!

Now they sell tickets at group on. Check it out;)
Amazing food and GREAT service. It's the "local" place to go and you have to try the seafood nachos. They're phenomenal!

I ate here three time I was in town for work, so it gets my approval. Good beer selection and great apps. I got three different burgers and all three were delicious and the sweet potato tots were great too.

I love coming to this place with my wife and kids! It is one of the coolest locations architecturally. We have always gotten excellent service here. We have had small gatherings/parties here and the owner always accommodates all of our requests. The tortilla/chip lady in the back corner is always really nice to my kids as they pull up a chair and watch her. The kids' menu is so reasonably priced that I think they barely break even on it. The portion size on the kids menu is huge! The entrees are very good too. If you are looking for cheap traditional Mexican food, this is not the place. They offer a nice variety of good Mexican entrees.

A gem for Tucson! My best friends and I came here for one last hoorah in Tucson and I will forever remember the warm fuzzy feelings of happiness that this place (and the wine) left me with. The happy hour rocks with $5 appetizers* and $20 bottles of wine. The fries, which you order for the "gourmet sauces" are your average crinkles fries and the sauces are just okay. The spinach dip was pretty standard too, but the caprese salad was awesomely fresh as the basil, tomato, mozzarella, and dressing all complimented each other wonderfully. We also ordered bottles of Moscato, Reisling, and Chardonnay, though I tend to only like Moscato. 

I love this place for its lounge-esque feel and attentive service. This is a great go-to place if you're looking for a casual but elegant night out and want to spend time chatting, eating, and drinking the night away until close. I will definitely be visiting the Scottsdale location!

Thanks for a wonderful experience!

* = Okay, so there's cheaper out there, but the portions were decent and you're there for the wine anyway. Drink up!

Went to my first UYE here. I'll never forget it. The staff was very friendly and attentive. The food was really good. I had the cheesy tots. House made potato tots covered with a house made cheese sauce. I want to be buried in that sauce. Then I had the special, scallops. I almost fell over when I was told $12 for 2 scallops. But they were huge. Then, I almost fell over because the were so tender. 

The noise from the other patrons was deafening and there was heavy metal music playing but you really couldn't hear it because of the noise from the people talking. There was a lot of sound bouncing off the walls. We had the same problem at our church. They make dampening panels for that. But before that gets fixed I think some money should be put into new fixtures for the ladies room. It was kinda clean but the toilet was stopped up. One of the YELPers I was with, told the owner and it got fixed right away. Yes, I'm crazy that way, I went back to check. But even without stopped toilet the L. room gets an F, because the sinks would be called retro if they were refinished. But they weren't. One more thing, the faucets don't have to be automatic but working would be nice. I don't like L. rooms in dives to be icky either. However, UPH is NO dive.

This was my third visit to S+S in about three months.  I had good experiences the first two times and this time with Aunt Annie in town, we decided to see how they hold up to the consistency test.  We went for lunch and arrived a little before noon.  I would say they may not have been completely discovered yet.  The place was not busy on a weekday.  It did fill up somewhat before we finished our meal.  We were seated promptly and had a polite, professional and knowledgeable server.

Salt + Smoke has been consistently good over the three visits.  This time we tested; ribs, brisket, pulled pork and pulled chicken.  All were very good to excellent.  The ribs were perfectly done with a good rub, perfect salt and very nice smoke.  They stack up well against any that I have had in St Louis and would compete well in Memphis.  These are the style I prefer, smoked not grilled.  

The brisket was again very good.  I ordered fatty and it was not excessively so, but was moist, tender with a flavorful bark, good peppery rub and plenty of smoke.  The rub can be plenty salty, it should be eaten with the meat as you go.  

Repeating myself, I am not a knee-jerk pulled pork fan because so little of it is done well.  On this day, it was done well.  I think it is the first time I have had it here.  It was shredded and was moist and flavorful.  I can't say I have had better in St Louis, but I do know I have had a lot that is much worse.  This did not suffer from being the usual big hunks of dry roasted pork.  The pulled chicken was exactly as last time.  It was smoky, moist and very flavorful.  Ms T has made this her thing to order here, I think.

Sides at S+S are generally better than average.  Mac 'n' cheese is white cheddar on shells and certainly not something out of a Kraft box.  The potato salad is dressed with a mayo based dressing.  It matches my taste except for the large hunks of potato.  The pit beans were again very good.  These are savory beans, not sweet, with a lot of smoked meat shreds.  On this day they did not need salt.  I really like these.  It is nice to get something that was not just dumped out of a can with some brown sugar added.  These are clearly made in house and I believe, cooked from dry navy beans.  I would pass on the slaw with red onion and apples.  It is bland and just not what I want.  Forget the apples, omit the onion and work on a tangy dressing with some heat.  Ms T again liked the green bean and tomato salad.  She thought the dressing was different than last time.  I thought it looked over-dressed a bit.

I am raising to five stars.  I said last time, that I might.  The added star is for consistency across four smoked meats, which is quite an achievement.  It is nice to have the meats all moist and salted just right.  Having some very good sides also helps.  The popovers are a nice change from a slice of light bread or sugary corn cake.  It all adds up to the best place (that I have tried) for barbecue in St Louis right now.  I hope they can maintain the consistency.

My nails were in really bad shape this morning and my regular nail salon was crazy busy. I decided to check this place out since I didn't have time to wait. I just got a gel manicure, no extras. It was fine and looks good, but no fantastic. The disappointing part was the lack of massage. She just put some lotion on my hands and called it good. $20 for the gel mani, so the price is pretty good. You can pay AND TIP with a credit card. I'm not about to make this my regular place, but I got the basics covered.

Standard fro-yo joint. It's a nice treat but quickly adds up as you add on the toppings. Not much seating and decor is pretty bad. Still, nice to have a place like this to go to. Seems like a lot have gone out of business.

So happy to find a pho place close to home. Tried it tonight and it really exceeded my expectations. The place was very spacious and clean and they gave complementary spring rolls for being newly opened. We got the summer rolls which were pretty average but the star for me was my seafood pho. Super flavorful and HUGE. Left with two quarts even after filling myself up. My bf had chicken and scallions and they gave him so much chicken compared to most places and he's one to lick the plate clean but he couldn't even finish it. Our waitress was super friendly and attentive, filling our waters and asking if we needed anything. Only thing we didn't like was their Jake fruit smoothy since it lacked flavor. Not sure if all jack fruit is tasteless but this smoothy did not taste like anything. Also for the amount of food we got the price was really decent and surprised me since I thought it'd be more expensive. All in all I'll be back.

One of my favorite parks.  There are groomed walking trails.  There's are quite a few pavilions but my favorite overlooks the water.  So peaceful.
You can walk the causeway to the beach or drive.  The beach is small but you can always find a spot.  Decent snorkeling if you're looking for juveniles, there's a lot of sea grass.  Keep your eyes open for a dolphin or a manatee sighting.

Ordered A vegetarian banh mi through Uber eats.  Came quickly, however halfway through the sandwich I bit down on something hard.  There was a 2" metal screw in my sandwich.  Tried to contact them but their phone number is apparently out of service.

BE VERY CAREFUL ABOUT ORDERING FROM HERE.

This McDonald's is one of the worst I've been to, and I love me my McDonald's. I saw several health code violations, from grabbing raw hash browns with bare hands right after taking cash, to letting coffee lids sit directly on the counter. Plus employees returning from smoke breaks and directly going to handling food without hands being washed. Ew.

This place! They have a wide array of cookies and pastries daily, from eclairs to cupcakes, and their filled cookies--think raspberry shortbread and chocolate truffle--are awesome. They also sell cards and cutesy home decor.

I have had their cake (a chocolate with strawberries number) and while it's pretty yum, it is still a bakery cake...which means it's not going to taste like mom used to make. Sigh.

What I love about Cake and Flower is that you can give them a call and order flowers, and they will ask your budget and create a custom bouquet accordingly (including a vase!). All of the arrangements that I have bought like this are always bright and pretty. Plus, they are located about a block away from St. Mary's, so you can swing by and pick up some treats on your way to Visiting Hours.

I read some of the reviews decided to give it a try anyways. I had a reservation for my daughters 23 beat. I must say we arrived got seated right away. Within 5minutes our server was attending to us. We ordered our drinks came out quick. Since it was our first time we took a look at the menu ordered our food came out within reasonable time. Food was delicious. Let's talk about view very nice. I will be back for your breakfast and dinner again.

This is a great place for a family or friendly get together.  The meals as very affordable and the atmosphere is fun and upbeat!  The croutons are amazing and the salad bar is fresh and delicious.  The sides are good, you basically serve yourself, and the grill isn't too crowded (we went on a Thursday night).  Overall it's a great experience and the waiters and bartenders are so nice!  You can come with friends and leave with new ones for sure.

I will not be returning here. My wife waited an hour or more after the appointment to be seen (nearly EVERY visit is like this. The minimum has been about 30+ minutes).

I've spent copious amounts of money for half-assed service and lazy diagnostic work. They can't give good recommendations for anything, and they medicate constantly. I still don't know for sure whether my dog has a prostate, thyroid, or bladder problem after 5-10 visits, and each doctor tells me something different from the doctor before. Prescribed a specific food to treat a urinary problem (80 bucks per bag for over a year), only to be told by another doctor that he *might* be allergic to that food because he has high yeast production and licks his paws a lot. She proceeds to recommend a different food completely from the medicated food that he was prescribed by a different doc at the same clinic.

Three different drops were prescribed to treat a corneal ulcer. Two were prescribed initially with an antibiotic pill for ANOTHER ear infection (I clean his ears 2-3 times per week, sometimes once at least). Then they say he needs a third after the initial two were administered flawlessly for at least 3-5 days as prescribed (with no success). 

Third visit for the same problem. Ulcer is worse after giving drops to the schedule and order they've recommended and yet ANOTHER antibiotic (this one's pink). Ulcer is still not healed. He's on his second E collar as well...

Now I have to go to a specialist (250 just for the diagnosis, no idea how much for the treatment yet, and I've already spent well over 500 with McCormick). He's been on thyroid medication (for over a year), but they're not *100% sure* he has a thyroid problem (might be a prostate issue now?).

Thousands of dollars spent at this place ZERO actual answers. I'm going somewhere else, I recommend you do too.

My girlfriend and I ate here for the first time not to bad if you font mind basically eating the toppings,  as they slid completely off the "hand tossed" crust it seemed more like thin crust. We plan to try the deep dish pizza and see how that goes!

For a Taco Bell, this store is a five.  Prompt service, hot fresh food, and most importantly, late night hours for bad decision snacking.  Also plenty of napkins and they handle sauce requests when you pay so you move very swiftly through the drive-thru.  This place is a well oiled machine!  What more could you ask for?

I am almost afraid to rave too much about this place, because I don't want them to change a thing. Too often, a place gets popular and before you know it they are "upgrading the decor" etc. and it's no longer the funky, unique place that serves the BEST FOOD IN TOWN. Seriously, we discovered DG a year ago and we have been in SB for 30 years! Incredible beers from Europe, insanely good soup, (best ever) and fresh vegetables to accent the authentic German potato salad or Potato pancakes, the place just has it together. Yes there is dust on the funky decor because the stuff is so old it would probably fall apart if anyone tried to dust it off! I AM a clean freak but all is forgiven in the dust department. The kitchen is clean. The dust adds to the funky charm of the place and I hope they don't change a thing!!

This place never disappoints! Today I was served by Billy jones and Ryan "creme man" Schmadke. They were kind and patient while I decided what to order. I ended up going with the classic ice cream sandwich and boy am I glad I did!! 10/10

Dr. Kessler has been my Dentist for many years. He and his professional staff provide the best in dental care. The office staff are also courteous and provide great service. I would highly recommended this practice.

Came in to this salon because I was given a gift card that I needed to use. I sat down with Chantell and she was so friendly, she talked a lot and made the appointment fast. 

I ended up getting a hair cut and style, and I walked out feeling like a million bucks. I was loving the cut and style and it made me feel beautiful. 

I loved this salon so much, this is now my go to salon for all my future hair needs. I would highly recommend this salon if you want a great cut and nice style.

We arrived at this restaurant with high hopes given the great reviews and full parking lot. The wait staff was friendly and helpful and kept my drink full. The first sign of trouble was the menu. There were too many choices. In my experience when a restaurant has a menu that is this large and with this many choices they are often unable to do anything on the menu particularly well. A jack of all trades and a master of none so to speak. 
We started with the truffle five onion soup, and were Immediately greeted with a warning from the waitress that the soup is "not what we expect" and "often customers complain that they are being fed gravy instead of soup, but once they give it a chance it's really good." We gave it a chance, and it was mediocre. My wife complained that she didn't taste any truffles, and I felt that it was a clear case of "trying too hard" too many flavors were added and the result was muddled. 
For the main course I ordered the Greek lamb tacos, and my wife ordered the vegetable stir-fry bowl. The tacos were quite tasty, however it appeared that they did not drain the meat as the flour Tortillas were soggy. Furthermore they were overstuffed making them difficult to eat without contents going everywhere. My wife's description of the stirfry bowl was " it taste funny, and it is drenched in sauce, and the vegetables are over cooked and soggy". 
In terms of overall service: while deciding what to get on the menu my wife asked to have one of the sauces in a pasta dish substituted for another. She was told "we would normally do that, but we have a large party in the back and I don't think they will want to go through the trouble". This resulted in the fateful order of the stirfry bowl.
When asked at the end if everything was good my wife who did not eat the entire portion, explained that she thought it tasted funny and was soggy. The waitress explained that she wasn't surprised given "we use frozen vegetables for that". The waitress was apologetic appropriately and offered to ask for them to take it off of the ticket. When she returned she had succeeded because "they decided to be lenient, given our patience with the large group situation and the long wait to get our food" however she explained that my wife's soup had to be Up charged as it was billed out as a meal and since she wasn't paying for the other part of the meal "we have to charge you the full price for the soup."(Did I mention we waited almost an hour  for our order to be filled in spite  of a larger party that was seated after us in the next booth being served and almost done before our food came out) 

Overall disappointing. Two stars.

It's been a while since I visited, but I went one day for afternoon tea with my mom. We usually go to a tea place in Upper Darby, but this one is near one of the places I work out and also is more capable to handle walk-ins--though we did make a reservation, just in case. Of the (presently) 3 tea houses I've been to in the area, this one wins for taste. The atmosphere is very cute, don't get me wrong, but it is in a shopping center (albeit, a very upscale one), so you don't necessarily feel transported like my regular place in UD. All that said, I don't remember the specifics of the food, but it included plenty of tea sandwiches--bigger than bite size but not huge--some giant scones with a choice of flavors (they even have a flavor of the month), and mini pastries, along with lots and lots of tea. The service was very attentive and sweet, and there's even a little gift shop with some really unique British-themed stuff. What sets this apart from other tea places is that you can actually order real food, like chicken pot pie and other delicious-sounding stuff. The scones really were outstanding, and we left feeling very full. I'll definitely be back.
Adrienne was the best game master!!!!! very helpful and hysterical. one of the best escape rooms i've done!

Typical puccinos. Great flavors. This location is a little bigger than the others which is a plus. It has more tables too. Today we went in for the simple Granita with an extra shot of expresso for the extra kick. It was flavorful. The wifi works fine but the restroom needs a little more TLC. Dining room is pretty clean. It can get noisy at times. Overall great location.

I went to Jesse's because I had heard from a friend how delicious many of their selections are. I had the brisket sandwich, potato and coleslaw salads.
Everything was very good. The sandwich was of a good size. Bun was also a perfect match. I did not wait long as I got there about 11:45 but it was busy from 12 on. I plan on going back trying the ribs and chicken.

Chicken pastilla was so light, crisp, sweet and savory. The combination of flavor and texture was amazing. Falafel was pretty good. Staff was nice. Sat outside during a live music in the square night. We will definitely go back!

Someone scraped / tore off part of my bumper and didn't leave a note-- what a surprise. Geico led me to Gerber, where they took my car and had it fitted with a brand new bumper by the next day. Pretty amazing. Everything you need is in one place-- the insurance adjuster, the repair shop, and the rental car. Everyone was super nice, and they detailed my car, which means it not only looked better when I picked it up, but it smelled nicer too. Customer for life. Thank you!

For the price I'd head elsewhere. Burgers were good but the service was slow.  Close to an hour to be served both times we visted without any crowds. Unlimited fries are usless if the waitress never comes around to refill them or the drinks. I'd rather head to 5 guys and get a better burger and better service.
