My wife has been wanting to come here for lunch for ages. Given she is gluten and dairy free, there are limited options. I myself was looking forward to the bahn mi that I saw in the photos. 

The staff was friendly and answered all of our questions. She ordered a wrap and iced tea, I a smoothie and sandwich. I realized that they no longer serve bahn mi, instead, their sandwiches are served on ciabatta with sauteed peppers & onions, and sauce. The char siu pork was great in my Red Pork sammy, but I was a bit disappointed with the bread and toppings. Again, just a function of expectations.The smoothie was  outstanding, and my wife loved her food (crispy pork wrap). There are plenty of other items I can eat on the menu next visit, but I was bummed that they no longer serve what I heard so many good things about.  Oh well, you can't have it all...or can you?

One minor nit: the credit card machine asked me if I wanted to leave a 15, 20, or 25% tip. I was a bit thrown off here. Remember, you give them your order at the counter, you collect your own silverware and napkins, you pour your own drinks, you box up your own leftovers, you even bus your own table when you're done. What does the staff do? They take your order, make your food, and bring it to the table. Is that really worth the same tip (or slightly less) that you would give to a server who waits on you from start to finish? If their staff is making $5.13 under the assumption they will get tips, I'd like to know that so I can take care of them. Anyway, was not something I was ready to think about.
They consistently get our order completely wrong.  Wrong sizes. Wrong items.  Cold tots.  And the bellhop was not surprised at all.  I will not go back.

Gavin has a borderline freakish understanding of style, his inventory in the store, and how to match it with what you're looking for. Super welcoming, totally not pretentious. It's the place to go for not-chick-stuff awesome vintage. GO HERE, DUDES!

Brand new location. I was in the area on business and found this location via the Starbucks app, as it showed they offered Nitro Cold Brew. There is plenty of parking in this new strip mall, and the staff is really friendly.
On both visits I was greeted upon arrival and thanked on my way out. WiFi speed is very good and there is seating both inside and out.

Checked in Thursday late. After reserving our room 9 months ago, upon checking in we were informed they do not have the room we reserved and had the option for an up-charged suite, we had to take it. Woke up and had coffee wanting to watch tv on couch. We saw a crap stain (picture) on the cushion...friggen gross!! They couldn't even clean it right. My wife and I had complained my personal concierge Ivy couldn't do anything. WTF?  We will go elsewhere next time! Motel 6 is much better. Stay away!!!

On Oct 01 I bought two slices of pizza. The guy who served me took the slices to the kitchen and kept them there for few minutes. I thought he was going to heat the pizza before boxing them.  The pizza was not heat up which he was supposed to do. It was a joke, If he was not going to heat pizza why did he take them to the kitchen and kept me waiting ? Everyone can tell between a hot pizza or a cold one. I was offended and will never return to this place for pizza.

For cheap, fast Chinese food this is the place. The chicken teriyaki is great - 6 pieces for like $4. The shrimp egg rolls are good and have a nice ginger taste. Had the pork lo mien and beef & broccoli and both were good. I'd recommend avoiding the dumplings as the dough is too thick and the filling is just okay.

Remember it's cash only.

My ports are my family and I wouldn't trust them with anyone but Dr. Tim. For 24 years he has card for my ports, he has removed a small ball from my dogs stomach, he has given them there sits, sister and neutered them and even came to my home to care for some goats that were injured. I moved to Oregon, and Dr Tim is still my vet. It's with the drive to know my babies are in good hands
Short and sweet, great pizza and never had an issue or displeased with anything else that we ordered.  Staff is always real friendly

Wow. Just had breakfast for the first time there and it was amazing. Highly recommend the juice flight so you taste a variety.  Best chorizo hash I have ever had. Husband loved the salmon benny.  Great atmosphere and fabulous staff.

Any place that makes their ketchup has already won my heart even before I take the first bite. And Highlevel does make their own. Who knew that Heinz wasn't the only ketchup flavor in the universe?

We had breakfast there. The place was bustling, the wait staff helpful, food came out quickly and was very well prepared. Their cinnamon buns and their breakfast special (eggs, bacon, potatoes and a very nice multi grain bed) were both very good. 

Their coffee was excellent....

I made a quick visit to the Antique Emporium. It was my second visit to the store. It is not a really big space - certainly not as big as The Carmel Antique Mall but they have a nice mix of merchandise. I was tempted by a pair of salt and pepper shakers but ultimately did not make a purchase. If you are searching for something in particular I suggest you pay a visit to the Antique Emporium and visit the Carmel Antique Mall as well since it is nearby. Both times I was there, one employee was sitting at the desk  available for assistance. The parking lot has ample parking. I am not sure of the future of the strip mall since I believe the nearby strip mall with SoHo cafe is closing Dec 30 permanently and slated to be demolished.
Excellent bistro. After just returning from Paris, I found Bistrot La Manette on a whim and it was a superior dining experience.
Love Dominick's in Plumsteadville and glad to see a closer location with the same great taste!

Experienced the Splendid Pig pop-up on a trip to NOLA with some family. The appropriate word is wonderful. Fairly prompt service, a creative menu, and deliciousness in the foods quality. Definitely would recommend to anyone either passing through the area or locals who want to experience the best of New Orleans cuisine.

BEWARE!  I don't enjoy writing a negative review but I honestly cannot think of one positive thing to say about my experience at this place.  I called to see if it would be OK to bring my dog in for a nail trim and was told to come on.  After they took my dog back, I was informed they were short handed.  I wish they would have said something whenever I phoned so I could have made the choice to schedule at another time or go somewhere else all together.  Instead I sat there while a groomer came out and argued with the lady working the front desk about her payroll being "messed up".  There is a time and place to bring these issues up but never should it be OK to do so in front of customers.  It showed a total lack of professionalism.  At the time, the focus should have been on doing her job instead of making customers and their pets wait. The staff was so unprofessional.  My dogs have been going to groomers since they were very young and never have I or my dogs witnessed the nightmare of a place like this. I could hear one of my dogs "screaming" & whimpering from behind the closed door. I got very upset & asked they bring him out immediately. They said they could have someone else finish and that's when the lady who was handling my dog came out and accused the lady behind the desk of trying to take money from her by letting a different groomer take over. I demanded my dogs be brought out whether they were finished or not. This is when I noticed they had put hideous looking pink bows on 1 of my dogs - BOTH OF MY DOGS ARE BOYS!  They never asked me if they could do this & they had to be CUT out of my dogs hair! I am amazed they are still in business - I would NEVER EVER recommend such a place to anyone!

I do not know if this is a new owner or it is the same owner because I was confused because the sign and everything was Los Jarrones, but the name on the menu was Colombian, and it was Colombian Food not Honduran food.
This place was nice, and had the fancy big huge jars, the theme of Los Jarrones.
We ordered a Colombian Tamale, and a combo platter with steak, sausage, colombian arepas, and rice.
The first thing that completely turned me off is the first bite of the tamale was a slimy muscle part of the pork, and when I say slimy, yes slimy, the second bite, oh guess what same thing. When I broke it apart, it was a hunk of pork with the biggest bone ever. Maybe that is the way those tamales are made, but i did not like it at all, and I like almost everything.
The steak was cold and flavorless, and it just was the same for everything else.
The best part was the passion fruit shake. The service was fine, and it should be bc there was no one there but they had just opened.
The place looked clean and nice, but the food no way, yuck. sorry.
Awesome pizza, great beer selection and the ambiance is very chill. Only thing is the pretzel bites seem d like bread dough and not real pretzel bread, still good though.
By far the best sushi and best unlimited menu in the city! Less expensive than sushi garden with more selection!

wonderful!!! you must get any of their pizzas, my personal favorite has a runny yolk in the middle that gives it a carbonara-like taste. the fries were not as crispy as i would've liked, but they went great with the soup. it's very packed when it comes to rush hours, so i recommend going during a more ambiguous time, or trying to make a reservation if possible! i also heard the wings here awesome, baked, not fried!
Great italian ice, no complaints with service, and I've been coming here for at least a decade.
Top rate manager and team I would rent here again! Professionally managed  and clean, the grounds are maintained and the buildings are well cared for.

Salt & Pepper is a French bistro which specializes in crepes, as well as several tempting main entrees and pasta selections. We started with a lovely and refreshing bottle of Vouvray which complemented our meal. Spouse selected Pasta de la Mer for dinner which consisted of al dente linguini topped with mussels, shrimp, and scallops in an herb/butter/white-wine sauce. I chose the Nordic crepe, an excellent galette filled with a layer of gently poached salmon and topped with a bechamel-dill dressing. Both entrees were scrumptious, of generous portion, and were preceded by a house salad with balsamic vinaigraitte and delicious bread. The staff is very friendly and accommodating; the chef came out to greet each of the tables. At S&P, one feels very well taken care of. We were too full to consider dessert, although the choices looked wonderful.

I've been having issues with an ankle injury for the past month.  I went for my first appointment here today and they gave me a clear physical therapy plan and timeline for recovery.  This is the first time in the past month that I felt like I really knew and understood what was going on with my injury.

I went to this store yesterday am and had a wonderful experience with the manager Angela! She was so sweet and took her time no matter how many questions I asked . I left with a perfect watch for my boyfriend! Thanks time after time!!!!

To summarize our month long stay while we were waiting on our house to close:

* Rude staff with bad attitudes 
* PAPER THIN WALLS
* Staff had to ration toilet paper, then ran our for a few days and was told, "well just go buy some" with an attitude 
* They require you to trade in your towels for clean ones but never have any clean ones to trade them in for
* Laundry not working quite a few days, and took your quarters numerous times, then told the front desk and they got an attitude for you asking and also bringing the problem to their attention, we just did one of those prepaid visa''s and seems to work better that way
* Staff does not seem to clean hallways or stairways, the same pare of extremely soiled "under ware" has been laying in the stair way for a week. The hand rails and doors are covered in dirt, really not good going into flu season either
* Cleaning staff does not vacuum or clean the floors in the rooms, we bought a swifter sweeper and the dirt we saw after doing the cleaning for the staff was just disgusting 
* Smoking is not allowed in the building but they allow all the smokers to literally stand outside the end door where everyone comes in and out, and you walk through smoke and cigarette butts 
* Witnessed a staff member sneak stuff out in a trash can, like she was  taking out the trash, and put all a bunch of bags that were in the trash can in her trunk? 
* Saw a couple drug deals 
* Random people just hanging around the building, in the parking lot, and just sitting in their cars all day, makes a person uneasy 
*They do not have trash picked up enough and it literally overflows all into the parking lot, then when the trash truck comes he only takes the can and leaves all the bags all over
* One night the fire alarms all went off and their protocol on the door is to call the front desk, well we tried 40 times and no answer? So we called 911 and they said they were sending a team over already, so we packed up our essentials and dog and headed out (at 10PM at night) and my husband went to the front to see what was going on because NO One was evacuating? And the front desk said someone on the 4th floor burned something on their stove?  Well for one they should have a reverse calling system to the rooms to let people know the urgency or no urgency of the matter. Well the alarms then stayed on at least an hour.


This place did serve the purpose, and you always have to beware of your surroundings and never let your guard down. If they had the right management and staff they could really clean this place up.
It  has wonderful Chinese food. We get the Shrip bowl.. has a variety of food. Shaloo is so friendly.. we know her very good.

To start off I walk in and was greeted by someone who seemed to lack any personality at all. I wait for my pizza to be made and she then gives my pizza to someone else. I finally get home my pizza and it's under cooked. I had to cook it some more just so I could eat it. I don't know if they were having an of night, but from my experience that location doesn't seem to be well run.

This was my first time visiting Books and Brew in Carmel. Parking is interesting. You can park on the street or by the Palladium. Walking in it was very quaint and quiet. It reminded me of the castleton location but a little smaller. I'm a vegetarian, and they had a ton of grilled cheese options. I got the Return of the King sandwich. It was really cheesy and good. It came with chips and a pickle. I have been to the Castleton location for trivia, tonight this location was holding Bingo. It filled up, but stayed chill. I really enjoyed the atmosphere. I got the Ciderboys Strawberry Magic and oh my goodness, it tasted just like strawberry juice. So so good. I can't wait to come back.

I've had Franzone's in the past and really wanted to have it again. We decided to order pizza for delivery. Their estimate was pretty long (45 minutes), but we knew to order ahead of time before we were starving (thanks Yelp delivery. The food came below estimate and the driver was pleasant. This is the best pizza I've ever had. Yes the sauce is sweeter than normal pizza, but it's not unbearably sweet. It's perfect to me. The dough they make from scratch and it's nice and thin. I normally can only stand to eat two slices of pizza, but this pizza is so good and thin I can eat four or five. I'm glad we ordered two pizzas because they did not last two days. My boyfriend ordered some wings which came with bleu cheese, but there was no celery which was a little odd. He thought their wings were just ok. I think it's best to stick with their pizza!

We are tourist. And it was not easy but also not hard to find the place. Because it's in a business like building.  This place is great! Very nice staff. If you get lucky, they will give you free samples.
Definitely have to try when you are in the area for healthy food.
Love the Vermicelli bowls.  Banh mi's are some of the best I've had.  The service is quick and friendly.  My favorite Vietnamese place in South Jersey.

We arrived at the hotel at around 1:30. The front entrance was closed so we had to walk our kids through the casino to find the check in desk. I feel some sings outside the hotel directing people to the appropriate door would have been helpful. My husband had to pull the car around to the other side of the building to unload our luggage then go park the car. The only entrance from where we parked to the lobby door had about a 35 step stair case. When we left the gates to the valet area were closes and we had to haul our luggage down those steps.  We were able to check in early and our room was ready. I had asked on my reservation to have a mini fridge in the room and that was not provided. We had requested a non-smoking room which we received but the hallway smelled like smoke. The room itself was okay, I've had better at the Peppermill and Atlantis. The shower curtain smelled like pee...obviously a result of mildew, so that was kind of gross. I wiped all the surfaces with Clorox wipes, including the bathroom. The wipe had a lot of dirt on it. It would have been nice to have some sort of pamphlet in the room informing us of the amenities of the hotel and prices of activities. All the golf activities were really overpriced. I could go play 18 at a local course with a cart for the prices they charged. 
If you are interested in the "mall" they advertise don't get excited. It's like 3 super fancy stores, a candy store, a coin collectors store (really??), and a small toy store that seemed to never be opened. The arcade was sub par. Not a lot for younger kids, and half the games seemed to be broken. If your interested in the laser tag and the tumble town get your all day passes early to make use of the $10 they want to charge you (again useful info. that could have been provided in the room). They do have bowling leagues in their facility. This caused are family of 4 to have to bowl next to another family of four. Normally we get two lanes but they did not allow it. There is two seats per lane so most of the time us adults were standing. 

We ate at Round Table for lunch the 1st day. It was okay and the prices were similar to regular Round Tables. We had our breakfasts at the Café. The prices were reasonable for the sides we ordered. But my kids did not like the hash browns. We ate at elements lunch buffet. We were charged 10.99 for the kids, which is way to much. Kids should only be like $6, they hardly eat anything. We got there a little after 11 and a lot of breakfast items were still out. This is somewhat of a rip off with us because we are non egg eating vegetarians. Our choices were very limited and not at all worth the $50 we were charged for the whole family. To make it even worse they were no signs on anything with the description or ingredients. I had to flag down several employees to ask questions. They put lard in there beans which would have been nice to eat, and they use chicken stock in the rice pilaf. So we basically paid $14 a person for salad and pizza. I could have got that at RT for 7. Just FYI, you have to walk your kids through a smoky casino to get to restaurant row. 
This was our 1st and last visit to this Hotel. We should have stayed at the Atlantis. At least they have an indoor pool for the kids, and windows that crack open.

One of the best gelato places I have ever been to. The strawberry banana flavor was amazing. Honestly, who needs froyo when you have amazing gelato. It is kind pricy if you think about though. It's like 6 dollars for two scoops. Def worth it though.
Stop for a $1 jello shot, stay for Max!!!!! Best spot on Bourbon Street. Made us feel at home all the way from CT

nice store. good products. friendly employees. problem is our only experience was buying paint can for a price we were told by the employee only to find after he made the paint that it was much more than what he told us it would be. it was a small mistake but they wouldn't fix it. they should own up to their mistakes.  the store is fine otherwise.

Delicious food with different types of beer incorporated into the food and suggests the beer that would pair with it. Lovely environment. Great staff. Outdoor seating with TVs and heaters when it's cold. Live music every Friday and Saturday night. This is the best place to be for any beer enthusiast or just a fun place to wind down.
Delicious, authentic Mexican food.  Tacos el pastor, horchata, barbacoa, pico de gallo...oh my.  So happy to find a piece of Mexico in St. Louis.

Superb food, warm and clean atmosphere along with incredibly charming hosts (Ron on our first visit and Gus last Friday) make this place a MUST for Tucsonans!

On our most recent visit, all four of us had seafood and were yummified by it all. My bouillabaisse amazing, salmon done to perfection, scallops were succulent and the trout was great. We sipped a decent white wine while chatting and the food was quick (not TOO quick though). 

They threw in a free dessert (delicious creme brulee) for my in-laws 43rd wedding anniversary which even got my father-in-law to taste it! 

Thanks so much for a wonderful evening! Felt like a bigger city sitting inside Agustin!
Chuck's is a great local steakhouse.  We enjoy going there often.  The staff is great!  Brad and Brian keep the place running smoothly!  It is great that they remember you when you come in!

Exceeds expectations! My grown sons and husband have purchased many suits here and always been pleased. 

My son said "I've never had ANYTHING fit me so perfectly."  Owner Brian Lipstein provides great advice and personalized service - plus makes the experience painless for the men who hate to shop (like my husband, who was thrilled with latest custom tux purchase). 

Biggest surprise - fast turnaround on custom shirts, too. Plus great selection of ties in house. 

We will be back! Soon....

I followed Nicole to Twisted and was thrilled when I went there for the first time.  The atmosphere is very laid back and friendly.  I got the exact cut I was looking for and when I asked for suggestions about products I could buy, the staff was very helpful and was genuinely interested in selling me something that would work, not just the most expensive thing on the shelf.  I'll definitely be going back!

Ordered a black bean chalupa box.... Ans there's hardly no filling! There's like 3 pieces of lettuce ... like 2 tomato cubes. Total trash. I also ordered onions on it and there are none... and the beans don't even fill it all the way. To make it worse... the shell was soggy. Pure trash. For a new location they're already a dump.

Maybe my expectations were too high with chef Joe Baldino being just named a semifinalist for a James Beard Award - Best Chef Mid-Atlantic. As others have stated the place is small, fine. But it's LOUD and that's coming from someone from an Irish family of loud talkers!

Based on other reviews, I tried the Tagliatelli al Limone which was overwhelmed by the lemon. It approached Lemon Pledge territory. My friend had the gnocchi which I tried and were amazing. This gave me food envy. 

While offering desert the server knocked our bottle of red wine down my sleeve spilling 1/3 of it. Fine, it will come out of my black sweater, but it was a goooood bottle of wine! I expected the server to say let me bring coffee or a desert as an apology, but we got nada.

Unfortunately, a disappointing experience.

I have always loved Minado since the first time I went to the Minado in Natick.  This Minado is no exception to that rule.  They always have the most interesting and creative sushi rolls.  Our cooked-only sushi friend came with us last night, and she was able to find plenty of things to try and enjoy.  She even tried sashimi (albeit, mushroom sashimi) for the first time last night.

I also enjoy it as a chance to find new things to try that I otherwise would not want to pay for.  

The tempura maki rolls were an exquisite treat, that I have never seen before.

And the Crepes!  Oh. my. goodness.  they don't advertise them, and you have to go ask the hibachi person to make them, but it is *worth it*.

I was so excited about the raw and sushi bar that I didn't even get a chance to try their hot offerings.  Now I have an excuse to go back :)

This is definitely worth the drive and the price.  We will be back, and we'll bring friends.

Really cool spot to go in west conshy. Great selection of beers on tap that appear to be rotating. Service was quick and the bartender explained what to expect from certain beers. Thursday during happy hour they have free wings to enjoy. I'll come back.

Among the many neighborhood pizza choices Lazo's food is right about average. Their pizza is ok, they make a solid cheesesteak, and their munchies aren't bad. Having ordered takeout and delivery several times they don't have any dishes that stood out as being out of this world. They do offer friendly service, are open late, and generally deliver faster than they say they will. Not a bad spot by any means, and you can do a lot worse when looking for a late night dinner.
It was mostly empty when I arrived. Regardless, I had to sit at the bar to get service. The food was subpar, but the live music was excellent and the crowd was friendly.

Just stumbled upon this gem. In downtown St Louis with one of us wanting a hearty breakfast and one wanting a club sandwich. Fast superb service and high quality fresh ingredients. Food was delicious. Can't wait to come back and try more food!

Joe is very professional and accommodating to my schedule. He is very informative and helpful and eager to help and answer any questions I had. He is also easy to reach which is convenient. His services don't disrupt my work which is great because I don't have a lot of time on my hands. He is quick, clean and affordable. I would recommend his services!

This was a pleasant surprise for lunch!   A well lit,  open sports bar type atmosphere. 

Many tv's, but not in your face and not distracting in any way. 

The music selection is an outstanding mix of 80' and 90's R&B, and top 40. The volume is perfect,  loud enough to enjoy the classic sounds of days gone by,  but,  not so loud as to intrude on your conversation. 

Our server,  Devon,  was excellent,  personable,  extremely knowledgeable about the menu and did a fantastic job guiding us to ideal meal selections. He never missed a beat, checking in on us at the perfect intervals. Truly a professional who enjoys what he does,  and it really shows!

I had the chicken fingers dipped in Chipotle BBQ with a side of homemade bleu cheese. They were tender and juicy and the BBQ sauce was smooth! 

My wife had a California Buffalo burger,  perfectly cooked! 

This one place I would highly recommend if you're in the area!

Cask Social Kitchen Restaurant & Bar is located just north of Platt and south of Kennedy in the building formerly Sunova Beach and Mangroves off Howard in Soho South Tampa.  Cask Social Kitchen offers southern comfort cuisine and the finest in handcrafted cocktails.  There is limited street parking available and a valet only lot even though the valet only drives your car 2 feet to a spot lol. Cask Social Kitchen's decor is rustic with barrels of whiskey, dim overhead rustic wire lighting, exposed brick walls, rustic metal chairs, rustic metal tables, an upstairs loft for large private parties, a bar with an indoor and outdoor areas, and an outdoor patio. Cask Social has live music every weekend night Friday Saturday and Sunday.  Cask Social features a large craft beer list from local breweries including Tampa Bay Brewing Company, Cigar City, 3 Daughters, Angry Chair, Barley Mow, Motorworks, Bold CIty, and out of state breweries SweetWater, and Goose Island.  SoHo Thursday 9PM-Midnight Cask features Live Music, $4 drafts, $5 premium wells, house wines, and $6 Mason Jar Punches. Unfortunately, Cask Social recently changed Thursdays to be just for the ladies $3 Martinis, $4 Titos drinks, and $5 Bubbles. Cask still has their daily daily happy hour 4PM-7PM with half off Select drinks and appetizers and a late night happy hour Friday and Saturday 10PM-12AM with the same deals. We had Cask's Titos Lemonade Mason Jar Punch w Blueberries and their black bubbles mason jar punch with blackberries.  They ran out of most of the fruit garnishing for all their mason jar cocktails and just had blackberries at the time. While Cask Social advertises all these exquisite drinks garnished with amazing looking fruit on Facebook and Instagram, you aren't getting the same thing when you get here. And at $12 per drink, you really should, so we were a little disappointed.  Cask Social's "handcrafted cocktails" run from $12 to $20 and are considered above average pricing for the area, so I really don't come here that much unless it's for happy hour. My friends had the Farmer's Daughter, Ol' Dirty Bastard, and Bees Knees and they all liked their drink, but not so much the price tag. They also make top notch Margaritas! I heard their food has been hit or miss and nothing really remarkable so I haven't tried it yet. Our bartender tells us Cask Social's most popular dishes are their Chicken 'N Waffles and Cask Low Country Carbonara.  We look forward to catching them at their next happy hour!

I had met the owner of V Vegaz while I was looking for a new stylist and was scared to shell out money since I have been going to $14.99/per cut places for a year now. I know this salon specalizes in curly hair but I have short hair and Martina did an amazing job giving me a "feminine fade" and cut my hair perfectly. I would reccomend this salon to anyone looking for a great, fun, & funky place to get a hair cut. I plan to visit the colorist Jen on a future visit so she can work her magic on me!
The special touch I liked was she rinsed my hair after she cut it to remove all the tiny hairs that usually make me itchy. Plus they have great style the place looked wonderful!
I dont usually like to hold a conversation with who ever's cutting my hair but today was nice to have another cool chick to talk to! Thanks see ya in a few weeks : )
I come here to people watch. It's like a reality show. The old Indian lady is super racist and I'm glad she's not there anymore.

We thought it was a big restaurant, but it was kinda small.  The servers seemed like doesn't have experience and two or three of them brought our foods and still have lots of missing stuff like forks, spoons, chop sticks and napkins.  The food sizes pretty small servings and we were surprised with the prices !  Online they were cheaper or pretty decent prices but in actual restaurant it was expensive!  Not going there again.

We love this happy hour. Huge glasses of good wine for $5 and good menu choices. 

Tonight we had dinner for the first time. We shared the fennel dusted and pan seared scallops. They were outstanding. 

Service is always fantastic and servers and other staff are vey friendly.

This is a salon that feels like an assembly line.  They try to upsell you on everything, for instance, by trying to book your next appointment four months out and sell you all kinds of expensive hair products.  The haircut I got there was not great and didn't work with what my hair naturally wants to do.  And it is pretty expensive.  Not impressed.
Grilled chicken and walnut pesto sandwich was awesome!

Very good Peruvian food! 
I spent a few months living there a couple years back & have tried a lot of Peruvian places since. This place was spot on.
Pisco sours were perfect, & they also gave us concha (toasted corn kernels) while we waited, which I haven't found since Peru.
We ordered the ceviche mixto & anticuchos for appetizers ~ super yum ~ & split the lomo saltado for the entree; a lot less greasy than some other lomo dishes I've had. 
.

Yikes! It would have been more comfortable to sleep on the non-carpeted floors! 
The staff was friendly, but the 70.00 price tag was unbelievably high. We were thinking about sleeping in the car (we got in around 3:00 am and left around 9:00) but decided on the cheapest hotel. We should have chosen the car! Would have slept better. 
I wasn't expecting much, but I thought the bed would be made of something softer than concrete. 
(Also- they have wifi, but it is NOT FREE)

We got to stay just a night and our experience was amazing! For a King sized bedroom at $109.99 it was well worth it. You walk into this beautiful lobby with a mural and a water fountain. The front desk personnel were really nice and greeted you with a smile once u walked up. Once ur done getting ur room they usually have a valet but we got here kinda late so we self parked but I was still very impressed. It was a security garage parking where u need ur room key to open it and once you park u can ride the elevator straight to ur floor. The room was beautiful! The bed was soo soft it felt like you were sleeping on a cloud. The pillows were exactly the same. My goodness I think the bed was what made the whole room that much better. Two things why this didn't get the 5th star... 1) the view we had was of a building under construction. 2) the restroom didn't have a vent or fan so when somebody forgot to courtesy flush everyone knew it lol but other than that, best hotel I've ever been in!!!
Terrible customer service. I was there for 20 minutes. Walking around and no one even came over to me. When I ask for someone to help me. The guy looked aggravated. Then I just left.

Sooooo good! Grew up in So Cal and have lived here since Feb 2020...so close to 6 months and the one thing that was missing was GOOD West Coast style Mexican food. Ya...we don't understand the whole white queso cheese thing where we are from! So back to this place....DELICIOUS! We found our new go to when we are craving legit Mexican from CA! We had carne asada burritos, the meat was grilled perfect, fresh and tender! The guacamole was homemade and perfect and the pico was great! Loved it! We also tried a hard shell shredded beef taco (simple but tasty, meat was again done perfectly with great flavor), a fish taco and a shrimp taco. They were all delicious (we really liked the shrimp) and the tortillas taste fresh and homemade! We loved it so much we got 2 breakfast burritos to go for tomorrow....I'm sure they will be just as good! We will be back for sure...probably every other week if not more!!

This is a GREAT breakfast spot and very hardy. The pancake was recommended and I see why, I took half to go. The omelette was okay, next time I might substitute the cheese for a lighter version. Omelets don't come w the biscuit and I didn't know that until I received the bill.

We infrequently get take out from here. Prices are good and we've never had a bad meal. OTOH, we stopped off recently for pickup (not our usual pattern) and one of your reviewer's comments about the men's room is pretty accurate. The word I'd use would be "off-putting." Unair-conditioned, poorly ventilated with a urinal that didn't flush. Says nothing about the food, per se, but makes you wonder.

I used to think they were the best in town. Recently, though, they did a small job and when I got it home saw a bit on the underbelly of the car that had not been painted and still had bondo on the scratch. Took it back and they insisted that it had been re-scratched. I paid another $150 to have the scratch painted. I am not convinced  and wonder if it worth $150 for them to have a disappointed and now ex customer.

This is a go to place for me since I live and work in the area and i love Mexican food. 
This place is always #1 however last night was an exception. The bartender looked like she rolled out of bed, the bar was empty and was a mess. She wasn't very welcoming, at all!!! A few months back i went alone after work and she asked me if i could give her a good review on Google since they were having a contest. I did. I ordered a naked margarita and it came in a wine glass that wasn't even filled to the top. At the end of the night, she was loudly placing the chairs on top of the bar. It was myself, my friend and her husband and another couple on the other side of the bar and she was throwing chairs up on tables and the bar. I asked her what time was closing, she said NOW and continued to throw the chairs up. I left somewhat aggravated. I didn't get her name, but she was a young blonde with a tattoo behind her ear.

This place is a mainstay on the Philly music & vinyl scene for good reason. The city's various record shops all tend to have areas they're strong or lacking in, but Long in the Tooth manages to avoid having many weak spots. 

Sure, it's great on certain forms of indie, punk, etc, but like some of the places that specialize in used golden-era classic rock/soul albums, LitT has a substantial section with bargain-priced used stuff adjacent to the "new" rock one. The jazz section is strong, and while I would love an even wider hip-hop selection, theirs is definitely better than that of any used-focused shops in town and probably a touch better than the other places I've been to that focus on newer editions. If it's light on anything, it's electronic stuff - as far as I can tell, you can maybe hope to find some mixed in with the rap and rock sections, but that's stuff like DJ albums that have rap features or bands that have dipped their feet into electronic styles, like Primal Scream. 

One recent niche itch I've had that Long in the Tooth has been the only store that scratches is Brazilian tropicalia music from the late '60s/early '70s. I haven't seen a single record from this genre elsewhere in the city, but LitT reliably has at least a handful of re-issue stuff from Os Mutantes, Caetano Veloso, & Gilberto Gil. 

I see on here that there's a bit of a mixed take on the store's vibe/that of its longtime owner, but I don't know what those people are talking about - I used to go in to buy CDs and music books back in the mid-2Ks and now use it for vinyl, and it's pretty much exactly what I would expect or want when I walk into a record shop.

Related to my review panning Dale Mabry HLE, this HLE also deserves a review.

We came into Tampa on Amtrak, and Dale Mabry had us call a different number to arrange for pickup.  They didn't say it was another Hertz location.  These guys did the pickup, and drove me to their location.  I had no idea it wasn't Dale Mabry, but upon completing the paperwork, the rates weren't right.  Apparently this location normally charges more, plus there's a hotel concession fee of some sort.

Two minor annoyances with this HLE:  they didn't catch that they were charging me something higher than the rate guaranteed on my paperwork, and they issued me a car with only 5/8ths a tank without telling me.

Other than that, they were stellar, because they had an annoyed customer on their hands, through no particular fault of their own.  After spending some time trying to "fix" it, they assured me that they would correct the problem, and that I should just take the car and go.  In my experience, this is a recipe for disaster, but they were good to their word, and the rate I ended up with was actually a bit cheaper than the quote.  They were friendly and professional about it, tried to figure out an immediate solution, actually followed through on what they promised when that didn't pan out, and got me on my way quickly, realizing that I had a family sitting at the Amtrak waiting for me.
So many fun games to play while you drink the strawberry and blackberry beer! There's a coffee shop next door too. Cans for sale you can bring on your pedal tavern ride.

Stayed in St. Louis for a weekend and this is were we ate several times. I love the Pho with meatballs and steak...P3 I think. We have been trying to find a great Pho place in Columbia, Missouri with no luck so we were very happy to find this place. We also visited this restaurant on the way back from Six Flags with the kids. Kids loved it and especially enjoyed the eggrolls. I had the ox tail Pho and didn't like it as much as the meatball Pho. The place was really busy the times we went, I wish there was more space. Also I didn't get a chance to try to avocado shake... but it looked yummy.
Outstanding brunch. Had the shrimp poor boy, was fantastic.  Service was very friendly.

from the ratings the service dept must be great -- but my wife and I went in with the intention of purchasing a Q5 -- had researched the vehicle and looked at the inventory on line --- the salesman did approach us and tell us his name but he then quickly disappeared to a group of salesmen laughing and having a good time -- i went to the group and asked if they had the Q5 we had seen on line and his reply was -- " it's on the lot somewhere "  --- the salesmen stood there talking and laughing and offered no help -- no service  ----  believe I will be going to the Lexus dealer  ---
Top notch Mexican food and they deliver :O I haven't tried anything else but the tacos, guacamole, burritos are all authentic and I should know because I was just in Mexico :)

Me and my family were loving this place and have gone 10 or more times since they've opened.  Shared an order of nachos with my son last Sunday night and was sick from food poisoning the entire night and next day.  My husband had something different (chicken vs. ground beef) and was fine. Sad to say we won't be going back...

This mall was super large with adjacent other stores. Inside the mall are common brands as well as higher designer brands as well. I enjoyed how this mall had even hired actors to get people into their stores. For example, Sephora had this "Pirate/Mermaid" theme going and they actually hired a dude with a six pack in a sort of sexy pirate costume to attract shoppers. It was hilarious. Serious consumer strategies going on here. Also, I think I might have seen Jay Sean and his wife while I was walking to the bathroom?
I love My Pedi Spa! Always welcomed & missed if I go over my normal return time. These ladies are awesome!  Always leave happy !! BEST in town!

Finn McCool's Ale House. The "new" Finn's has been open for over a year now, but I long for the old Finn's. The renovated Finn's is a nice, somewhat high end pub meets lounge. It's decent, the food is decent, the DJ can be hit or miss. It's not a bad time. But I do long for the pre-renovated, hole in the wall bar that Finn McCool's Ale House once was.
Perfection!!! Ask for Dan! Best waiter in the world! Eat the lamb

Update 2017:

Ran out of contacts and Macha was great again. They worked with me for three solid weeks when it became apparent that I had a minor eye infection; working to find check up times that would fit my work schedule, advising me on some some eye care health bits that no eye doctor had ever taken the time to cover before and making sure thing were covered by my insurance.

I appreciate that they were firm on waiting to take my measurements for new contacts and glasses until they were absolutely sure I was healed (not every doctor does this even if they should be). And the selection of glasses is really great. The staff were kind and informative.

They've completed their renovations and have hired a pretty talented muralist to give the their relatively low profile building some great pop which makes it's easy to spot coming down Shelby!

As a person who loves Thai & the fact that this spot is 5 mins from my house I'm not sure why I don't go more!!! The pad Thai with shrimp is my absolute favorite! Even when you get take out the food is always piping hot & just as yummy as if you stayed In the restaurant to eat. I also like the shrimp shu mi! The sauce is nice & spicy (I always ask for extra) and add it to my pad Thai. Great spot to eat in or take out! Great service and nice little shop tucked away in Wilmington!

Great Mediterranean food and take-out. The only negative mark against Norma's is that I personally don't care for their hard, dense pita bread. I prefer the lighter fluffier kind. My family enjoys the appetizer sampler platter.

Portions are tiny but the price reflects that. Very affordable and have never been disappointed with the sushi (only when they forget side items for to-go orders ). The past couple of months though (July/Aug '21), I have not been able to get through to the restaurant. I'll try 3-4 times receiving a strange automated message each time, then usually just decide to eat elsewhere.. This has happened pretty much every week recently. Not sure what's going on over there but we've pretty much stopped going as a result.

I was craving orange chicken, teriyaki chicken and delicious noodles so we decided to go to Panda. This location is super convenient so we popped on in. First thing we noticed was almost all food options were out. Second was that the servers were really rude.. they didn't let us browse what they did have. They kept asking hurriedly, "side's, what sides do you want?" Then my husband would ask a question if they had a certain type of chicken, they would answer with one word and spit out again, "and for ur entree?" Once we sat down to eat, I noticed that the rice was hard in some places like some of it was uncooked and it was pretty tasteless. Overall, I don't think this Panda is very good. We felt pretty rushed.

We received excellent service and enjoyed the outdoor seating. Baby's Strut Burger was spot on.. and I'm usually not a fan of fruit (mango chutney in this case) on meat. However, the salad, fries, and Mac n' cheese were mediocre, and the fried chicken had more crispy coating on it than chicken; Plus, the flavor of the chicken overall was bland. I tend to like more zest, spice, and nuance to my food. If you're looking for blander versions of a few Southern favorites, then I'd encourage you to try it out. Otherwise, I think there is better Southern/American food elsewhere in Indy. I appreciate this business's practices (locally sourced food), and I suspect the drink menu is worth trying out with friends on the patio again.

A bit hard to find, tucked into the middle of a strip center mall. You enter & see bank staff, but no teller station! On your right there are several private kiosk type cubby, where you do virtual banking.
At first it is super strange & uncomfortable, I believe I felt that way because it was new to me. I also had some major cash I was depositing & didn't initially feel comfortable putting it into a machine.
There was a bank representative on the screen once I started the transaction, I could see & hear them in real time, just as they could me. All went well & the transaction was complete.
I left scratching my head & muttering something similar to what my mom would say about technology. Dang it, no I didn't just say that, I am too progressive! I am always complaining about banks , how slow they are, tellers don't know how to count & they are always MIA.
After careful consideration, I have concluded this is a genius idea & cuts the slackers unfortunately out of jobs. I got timely & accurate service from a live person, no lines & quick painless process. Only down side you have to park & go in, no drive thru. I hate banks so much I hate going inside them, but with this feature I can be in & out in a flash & have no problems with the service.
What's a girl to do? Ya gotta keep an open mind & change with the times, I personally think it is an ingenious move on the banking industry.

A solid good choice in Indy. Haven't tried it for dinner yet, but would very much recommend it for your next business lunch. The food is delicious and definitely a bit of a change-up from the usual lunch spots around town. Service has always been very good and the changing menu keeps things interesting.

Since I spend a significant amount of my waking life interacting with soap (and I hope you do too!), I have decided to spend the extra money to ensure I am using healthy and beautiful products. For the past two years this has been easy for me because of Soap. 

I have tried too many products to list but what I can assure you Yelpers is that they have a bar or two for everyone. If you are in the gift giving mood ask them to wrap it up. They do a beautiful job.

I cannot get over this park. Indy's got a lack of green space, yet this somehow survived, prime real estate overlooking the city. A little hill to climb, and BAM! There's the city, shining in its glory. Bring friends, bring your pets, bring your kids.

I love walking the dog over to the park, and I frequently share this buried treasure with newcomers to the city, or old friends who need some inspiration. The variety of trees is beautiful, especially during the fall.

Best time to visit is during fireworks. I suspect that it's a great place for sledding, but we have a little bit of time until we know for sure.

This location is garbage!!! I ordered a chicken sandwich and fries were ice cold and tasted like they've been sitting out for days. The chicken sandwich was dry and burnt. The amount of mayonnaise they put on this sandwich was a joke, see the photo for evidence. I get that it's McDonald's and to not have too high of standards but come on, this is just beyond ridiculous. You have to literally try to ruin it this bad!

The customer service I received from Laura, a Senior Bridal Stylist at Gigi's was just amazing. This boutique beautiful and has gorgeous wedding gowns! Laura sincerely took the time to understand my vision and select dresses  to try on that followed what we had discussed. La Encantada is very lucky to have gained such this store in it's recent move!

Ordered delivery through grub hub and received the wrong order. When we called the restaurant to remedy the issue, they told us to call grub hub. When we called grub hub, they told us it's the restaurant's issue. Horrible customer service and still without our food.
Disinterested service. Slow food preparation. Food was good but not great. Looks like besh set this place up and has never come back.

Thank you Travelzoo for helping me avoid a financial disaster! Sometimes you have to be careful if you follow so called buzz about well known dining and exclusive restaurants or clubs. I'm so thankful for Yelp, I read the reviews so I was prepared for what I would possibly experience, meh! I wasn't disappointed because the reviews weren't that favorable and I split the cost of the Travel Zoo deal and the automatic 20% gratuity.  Can't see me doing this again as I was not impressed!


The best thing about this place is the view and our very attentive server Imani (sp). Although we were under a thunderstorm watch and the clouds were ominous the view was still beautiful. We were served a variety of warm rolls and whipped butter. For my appetizer I had the King Crab Tempura it was good, not special. My entrée I had the Smoked Duck Breast which I asked to be cooked medium well, it still came out medium but whatever I went with it. Finally I had espresso gelato it was tasty but not as good a the Icery in Lansdowne!

One of the previous Yelp reviews said "Best Italian in a strip mall".  I suspect it was meant as a compliment and that is the way you should take it.  I've eaten here a couple of times (including the past week) and left impressed with the service, atmosphere, food and overall value.  

Sandro's is a cute little restaurant that sits maybe 50.  You won't be thinking you are in Italy but you will forget that TJ Maxx is 30 yards away.  Service is excellent; quick and unobtrusive.  They have a broad menu and food quality is above average.  

They take reservations but reserve half the seats for walk-ins.  

The overall experience is not quite up to Vincents or Impastato's, but it is very good, about half the price and much easier to get into.  

Dinner for two, drinks and tip was about $55.  I plan to go back.

I felt good about eating here in that the menu is mostly healthy stuff... colorful, so you know you're eating fresh. Long line, as it's located in the French Market where there are lots of tourists. Slow but friendly service.

second time we've been here - and every memory held true!  Indeed delicious, solicitous, and fun.  Lively music.  intimate seating or larger tables.  It didn' t feel crowded but was full.
i can think of a few suggestions or things to warn folks about - it's noisy.  tables in the front didn't seem to be as loud, but the back area bounces sound.  and the staff, who were really wonderful, were a bit over whelming.  i know they needed to turn the table, and i didn't exactly feel rushed, but it was intrusive at times.
the good things sooooo out weigh any room for improvement!  the foi gras soup is unlike anything you've ever tasted - a bit sweet, then rich and creamy, then a hint of heat.  omg - even the croutons pop in your mouth with flavor!  meatloaf and potatoes were not like mom's but intensely flavorful with creamy small potatoes.  roasted pork and broccoli rabe - not your philly sandwich and the provolone bread pudding was amazing!  spicy, and dreamy.  the octopus - super spicy...good for my partner but not me.  salmon was simply amazing - curry and crispy skin.   did you know the bread course is actually truffled popovers!?  Yup!  deserts - well, honestly, we were so full.  the curried rice pudding was awesome.  cheese plate pretty good too.  fig newton was soso.  key lime pie yummy.  it's one area were i'd love to see less, and more.  maybe a few intensely flavored chocolates?  interesting fortune cookies?  
you've got to go.  really - it's wonderful!

This is my favorite sushi place in town. It's the perfect venue to relax outside, have a few sapporas (which are $2) and enjoy an amazing array of sushi. I think they have the best lunch specials in Indy for sushi. 2 roles with a soup or salad for $7 or 3 roles with soup or salad for 9. My friends and I go here a lot because the service is always great, the ladies are super helpful, the place is cute and the sushi is fresh. The roles are a little more on the smaller side, but I honestly prefer it that way, I feel like the quality is better. I'll be a lifelong customer. Props!

The chicken was really good. Cooked too order, crispy, tender, etc.  For me what makes the difference is knowing it comes from a good farm. I can get fried chicken a lot of places (not necessarily as good as this), but I'm tired of eating food that I actively try to ignore where it came from.
With that out of the way. The chicken was really good. The pickles and the bread, good. The Nashville hot, good. You should be noticing a trend here. It's all really good. And what's better than being a vegetarian? Creating a demand for humane products so that the price comes down enough for people who will never be vegetarians to end up buying the good stuff instead of factory stuff.
Great tour with a super friendly staff! Tho place has such an interesting history and the tasting was a lot of fun! I definitely recommend a trip here!!

Ming's has the best pancakes and French toast anywhere in the area.

The Asian side of the menu is equally devastatingly good.

Great prices and the service is something you have to enjoy.
Breakfast stopped at 10:30. It was 10:31 when I sat down. Even though I knew what I wanted, no more breakfast. BAD customer service.

Bad place. Just stay away from them, unless you enjoy hidden fees, non itemized community utility bills and the refusal to provide it when requested, paying for unassigned parking each month (you'd think since you LIVE THERE it would be included in the rent but it isn't) trash and broken glass everywhere, vandalized playground equipment, an office that NEVER calls you back when you have an issue,and a money grubbing corporate management team that will try to steal money from you in every way possible when you want to move out.
If you're ever in Tucson you have to check this place out!! The prickly pear is delish and Adam was friendly and knowledgable. A must check out destination if you're in town!!:)

Volare Helicopters is not only a highly professional and safe environment, but also an incredibly fun and enjoyable experience. My fiance has always had the dream of learning to fly a helicopter and Tyler and Tasha made it a reality. With a thorough safety instruction and clear expectations, my fiance was piloting with minimal assistance almost immediately (with the instructor keeping a close hand on the redundant controls of course). I was even invited to ride along in the back to watch!
Not only was the equipment very well maintained, but our instructor Tyler was an extremely patient and kind teacher; his calm demeanor and clear instructions did away with any anxiety either of us felt. I could not imagine a more comfortable and healthy learning environment.
They also offer tours around the same area we trained which are beautiful and expansive. During the training we were even able to fly over my parents house who snapped a photo of her piloting!
If you want to learn to pilot a helicopter and are in the Tucson/Pheonix area, there is no better instructor than Tyler Sturges. Even if you have never been in a helicopter (which we had not), Tyler will make you comfortable, safe, and enjoy the process. This is an experience neither of us will ever forget.

I can honestly say I agree with the post that was made on 6/25/12. I was spoken to rudely by Jasmine when I advised that I was unable to complete the patient packet before my Appt. I am a self paying patient and refuse to be insulted by this office staff, so I took my business else where. Happy I made the decision to switch!

I was not happy with my experience today. The lady who did my eyebrows did my do a good job. She made one of my eyebrows way thinner than my other. I'm really disappointed. I've been to this eyebrow place before and the service was just okay before. Today i was really disappointed. The prices are really high too. Overall not happy with the pace. I won't go back to this place for my eyebrows.

I opened a new checking account and was assured checks would be coming soon. After three weeks and no checks, I went into the Carpinteria branch, " I don't know what happened, I will reorder".
Three more weeks pass, I go in again, this time I was told I would get complementary next day shipping.
Seven days pass. I go in again....

Also, I deposited a large check. Seven day hold, of course. I write a check dated for nine days later (weekends don't count, of course). The check bounces because my check had not cleared! And I was charged $34 fee,
This is the worst bank! Staff is not that knowledgeable.

We went around 3 pm and stayed until 7:30. We only left because we had a reservation at 8:15 on the other side of town.
We had such a blast here.
Both bands were awesome.
No cover--bands play for tips.
Alcohol is reasonably priced (that Tennessee tax is a beast) and the bartender was on top of everything.
The crowd was fun and the music was great.

Overpriced, overrated, bad service, nothing special. This place claims to be a dine-in, relaxing, and reclining seat paradise, but the truth is... it's just your old school typical theater, with poor sound, blown out speakers, and fuzzy picture. 

We ordered tickets online and were promised reclining seats, we got a very small theater with padded regular theater seats, not bad, but don't promise one thing and deliver something completely different. 

We decided to get an adult beverage before the movie and the drinks were outrageously expensive and poor quality. I understand theaters jack up their food/drinks/alcohol, but this was far more than I've seen at any other theater, and just bad bad bad. 

Almost every theater nowadays offers oversized, comfy, reclining seats, alcoholic beverages, and better than your typical theater food, this place just doesn't deliver. A major overhaul is needed if they want to continue charging what they are and claiming their luxury seats...

We stayed at Blue Sands Inn for 2 nights, 3 days and were very satisfied with our stay here. This is a very beautiful, quaint hotel right across the street from the beach. Location is amazing, close to Stearns Wharf, State St., and all the calm action in the area. I ordered our rooms with Chase points and I found the rooms to be very affordable; several hotels were $50-60+ more per night in the same area. Our room was clean and comfortable, bathrooms were immaculate, and all of the amenities were great. My only issue was that they needed us to move rooms after the first night because they had a reservation coming in... I'm not quite sure why they couldn't work things out without having us move rooms. It was a little inconvenient, but we're very easy to please, and they moved all of our packed bags to the new room while we were on the beach. The pool has really nice chairs to lay out on, beach towels upon request, and they even delivered an iron and board when we asked. I would definitely stay at Blue Sands Inn again.

I usually go to the same nail salon but it was my nail technician's day off so I looked up some reviews and decided to give this place a try, upon arriving, the whole staff was very friendly and the atmosphere was great. However, the lady who did my nails rushed through my pedicure and cut my foot pretty bad. She also applied the coats very thick so that even hours after getting them done they got messed up. Also, the day after, the nail polish on my toe nail on the other foot was chipped. I Typically go to the same place and it turns out great so unfortunately I will not be returning here.

Perfect seafood place. You walk in and immediately know you have the right spot by the smell. So much seafood to be ordered by the pound. They dress you in gloves and bibs and let you have at it. My husband went daintier with a lobster roll that was quickly inhaled, so he got to watch me enjoy seafood the way its meant to - with your hands and no shame. I did crab legs with their fever mix with mild spice and would do it all over again (maybe a bit more heat. Mild didn't even have a tingle). Only thing that kept it from being five-stars was the wait for the food. My pound of legs came out at least 10 minutes before our appetizer - and that came out with the lobster roll and my son's shrimp roll. The staff was so friendly you didn't care too much, though.

"Jimmy"  called me a white piece of shit and told me to get the fuck out of the gas station when I asked for contact info for the owner.  This is him on the phone with the cops for calling him uneducated. I waited for the cops but they never came.
Rachid on the DD end was on his cell phone and would not give me piece info either.

This place is always put of gas. But they make you go inside to find out

Great food and service. Had wings, Ahi Tuna and an awesome corn dip and wine. Everything was delicious and the restaurant was comfortable. The NBA finals was on and you had a great view of the HUGE tv or one of many other screens from any angle. Would definitely return.

After having been to China and falling in love with their food and style of service, this is the most authentic Chinese dining experience in Edmonton we could find after returning from living abroad!! 

The food is delicious, and although a bit pricey compared to other Chinese food restaurants, it is rich and full of flavour!!! Such a treat, and I highly recommend. Also, their  spicy, is SPICY. Be prepared!

Working with Sierra Landscape Design has truly been a pleasure. Jose and his team are extremely responsive, reliable, and our quotes were very reasonable.

We've worked with Sierra Landscape Designs on several projects around our home. The first was the installation of a concrete patio and spa to our backyard. The second was a complete overhaul of the back and side yard with new sod installation, updating our irrigation system and all new landscaping. Jose even took the time out of his busy schedule to take me to the nursery so that I could view and touch what flowers and scrubs he thought would work well throughout the yard.  He was very knowledgeable in creating a non-toxic beautiful backyard that would be safe for our young toddler. I'm incredibly grateful for his patience with us as this was a new home for my husband and myself and we were often unsure of what we wanted at times.  We are very happy with the results and the financial savings we are already seeing on our water bill.  We look forward to the next project with Jose.

Stopped in today for lunch and ordered the turkey club. Interesting they chose to include an egg instead of avocado... the sandwich I thought was OK a little on the dry side but the bun, turkey and bacon were all good.. I was missing that so cal avocado we all love though. 

The space was nice the staff was pleasant and the cost was all in line with typical SB spots. 

All in I would go back to try other items on the menu but I was not impressed with the turkey club.

Seek out this throwback on a street that has been scoured of the richness that is New Orleans.  Not only is the food consistently good, sticking with the standards, but is locally sourced, freshly prepared and served with personality and pride.

Yelp has been nagging me to review the Sheraton for ages so I guess I ought!

To be honest, not hugely impressed. The best thing about it was the view from the window, the sunrise over the Mississippi was just phenomenal.

The hotel itself was a classic example of a generic, chain hotel that is more interested in earning a profit than actual customer satisfaction. The customer service was poor (unusual in the States), the desk staff seeming unwilling to help and made at bit of a cock up with my reservation details, and then over charging me at the end. The breakfast was not included in the room rate and was ridiculously expensive - why would you eat here when there are so many better and cheaper options in New Orleans??

The only reason I stayed here was because I was attending a conference on site. The conference facilities were OK but the chairs were fairly uncomfortable, I suppose this can be useful when trying to stay awake through lectures when slightly hungover (what did they expect, putting on a conference in the party town of New Orleans??!!)

The room was pretty standard and did it's job, but again it was fairly generic. There is a bar in the foyer for guests which was a nice enough place to meet for drinks. There was also a Starbucks on the premises, again this involved long queues and appalling service.

The swimming pool is fairly small for the size of the hotel and there was frequently not enough sunbeds for the number of guests requiring them. The gym was small but unfortunately it was ridiculously expensive for guests to use - that's me going for a run then!

I really believe that a hotel should be able to offer things such as water, wifi and gym facilities for free to guests that are already paying a substantial sum to stay there. But in this day and age, its all about profit, profit, profit :-(
Good food and great service. The owner is an absolute gem. He overheard me talking about ice cream and gave my party free matcha ice cream on the house. What a darling.
Great and friendly customer service. Food is made quickly and taste great. Facilty is clean and well maintained.

Idk all I can say is meh. Me and my mother ate here on a cold Friday night. The whole place was freezing! They only had 1 server on a Friday night so the whole thing took forever. My mother isn't very adventurous but I said as long as she's in Florida she has to try some seafood. I got her to try the lobster ravioli for us to share and it was meh. Not much flavor. And it also made me very sick later. Our server was way way too pushy with everyone there. The whole experience kind of sucked in general. Won't be back. At least the fries were good!

There may be hipper, trendier places in NoLa. And in those places you might eat some strange esoteric molecularly cooked deconstructed Southern fare, but...... If you want old world Southern food that is absurdly good look no further than Brennan's. Having eaten at places such as Cochon and Atchafalaya one would think you've had some of the best food in NoLa. Whoever that "one" is would indeed be wrong. There is something about adhering to classic tradition. If something works, don't try and fix it. That's what Brennan's is about. Some might see it as a dated tourist trap, I would say they are damned wrong. Service here transcends Souther hospitality, this is more akin to service in Michelin starred restaurants. From the moment you walk into the dining space you are treated with the utmost respect and courtesy. The dining room captain introduces him/herself and the other members of the waitstaff follow suit. They all work tremendously hard to make sure your visit here is special and memorable. Drinks and food are perfectly paced, and the food- what good old classic French inflected creole food!!!!! The turtle soup is not to be missed for sure, as are any of their eggs Benedict dishes (I think they have 4 different ones). The baked apple is absurdly simple and absurdly good!!!!!! We only ate brunch, but their other menus look equally impressive and we will return to eat dinner on our next  trip to NoLa. Don't be deterred by its location or its lack of trendiness. This is a special place, with special food. It's not to be missed.

I was in the market for a truck and Parks Ford of Wesley Chapel had a Tuxedo Black 2011 F-250 Lariat with all the options I wanted for a fair price. My family and I stopped by to look at the truck and take a test drive. Our Salesman, Jeff Gemma politely went out with us on a test drive so I could get a feel for the truck. After the ride, we spoke to Gene, one of the sales managers and we left without feeling like we were pressured or hounded like at other dealerships. They didn't even ask for my phone number, it was so relaxed. 
A week later, I came down to the dealership again and we proceeded to talk numbers. After agreeing on a price that benefited both parties, I went back to work out the financing with Paul, who worked for at least an hour finding the best interest rate because he knew he could get me down at least a percent from what my bank offered me. My only qualm with this portion of the transaction was that I was convinced to add unnecessary GAP coverage, which was later easily cancelled. Some people might have appreciated the extra protection GAP provides, but I did not need it. 
After taking delivery of the truck, I noticed that the 3rd tail light was leaking water into the cab during heavy rains. With a Florida summer fast approaching, I brought the truck back to Parks and the replacement light was ordered free of charge. The truck was bought used and did not have a warranty, but Gene saw to it that my concern was made right. Will Smith was a fantastic help in verifying the light was faulty, and even gave me a roll of electrical tape to seal the light off until the part came in 4 days later. 

TL:DR- I had a great car-buying experience at Parks Ford of Wesley Chapel. If you need a new car, ask for Jeff Gemma. If you need your current car serviced, ask for Will Smith. Im absolutely sure the rest of the Parks team is as respectful and competent, but my experience with these individuals was nothing but positive. Thanks, Parks Ford!
I love that we finally have a big restaurant/bar like this in Hendersonville! I do think that they could improve on their bar food items such as the wings but overall it's a great place!

Neat little place, came here on the last morning of our St. Louis trip.  Loved to potatoes that came with breakfast, omelet was good even though it was a little pricey.  My wife got one of the skillets and she was very pleased... a lot of food.  Coffee was hot and fresh.  I like how they have writing all over the walls and floors, ceilings, rafters and anywhere else you may look!

One of the worst experiences at a medical facility. Their support staff is the worst. They do not return important calls about lab results, trying to get an appt. is no easy task, rude staff that make a lot of mistakes and blame patients for it, Dr believes every word they say, it got ridiculous, too many family members working for the same practice. I spent more time sick while at this practice than not. After I left this practice, I went out of the area for care and went into remission soon after. I do not recommend this practice.
The service and food was fantastic! Some of the best Italian food I've ever had. We will be back!!
The food was great. This small Poboy place exceeded expectations. The pesto club, roast beef poboy, gumbo, and meatball sub were all fantastic. We will definitely be back.

Coffee is questionable. The people behind the counter are really nice though- and they remember you and are good folks to converse with. The hangover hoagie is, surprisingly quite good and deserving of the status it has achieved. Like a gourmet version of a sandwich you get from a cart in center city.

I dislike the stand in line and order your food with a tray cafeteria style. But I'll be back for more of the pulled pork! It was cooked perfectly. Very tasty. The ribs were spot on as well. That white BBQ sauce was gross. The sides were nothing special but I didn't care because the meat and sauces were so good. They have a sauce bar. A sauce for everyone.
Excellent madras shrimp curry!!! Loved the service. Beautiful ambience. Will definitely visit again!!
This is an amazing lunch spot. Recommend their "the Bentley". It's quite large and of great quality for the price. Their breakfast and coffee is also amazing.

It smells like a sewer in there.   I'm not exaggerating.  How about bringing back pets and smoking inside.   Another idea might be cleaning.  There are cob webs and nasty dirt everywhere.  I have low standards but even I think it's  filthy.  I heard a couple of homeless guys complaining that they thought it was dirty and they sleep on the ground.

My daughter and I stopped here for a late lunch. She had the Taro Milk Tea and I the Passionfruit Green Tea. Both seriously yummy.  We shared an appetizer of Gyoza (potstickers) which were hot and tasty! Then an entree Tonkatsu which is ramen soup with pork and some other stuff I can't remember ;).  It was both adventurous and delicious!  Served nice and hot (and pretty too). Our waitress was friendly, helpful with questions and prompt as well. Excellent experience and will be back!

This nail bar deserves all of the stars in the sky! Conveniently located, great prices, precision, friendly, clean, fast and it's a female owned business. Jen is a bo$$ lady who is extremely talented and an expert in her craft. All hail the queen of NOLA nails!
I am usually a picky haircut human...but Sarah Kate made me feel so freaking beautiful today! I love love love my new hair! I felt safe and comfortable the entire time, too! A win-win!

Um, how do I even begin? This place is AMAZING.

Firstly - being a CA native, I was in dire need of fresh produce. TJ's? Nope. Superfresh and Whole Foods? Meh. Luckily, someone mentioned Reading Terminal Market as a cool spot to get all my grocery shopping done while grabbing some ready-made eats.

The place can be a little overwhelming/crowded, but just take your time and explore the diff stands. Now that I'm getting more "domesticated," I def love walking around and checking out the various meat/seafood/produce/bread stands. Seafood is the best quality/price I've seen in the area, and produce is ridics cheap.

Will def need to try DiNic's, the Reuben stand and many other spots but this is my go-to shopping spot moving forward.

Quick tip: Student discounts at nearly all of the stands on Sun and Wed!

We got takeout here a couple times and were pretty happy. I got a vindaloo curry, and my wife got her usual chicken korma. Mine was appropriately spicy, hers was appropriately creamy--both tasted pretty good and portions were fair. Nans were fluffy and fresh. 

Of particular note: they have a GREAT chicken tikka kids meal. Nice grilled chicken with a side of rice at a good price. My kid was really happy with the flavor and portion size, and I liked the price. Will definitely return.

So lately for me, this Pizza Hut has improved. I mean, Pizza Hut is Pizza Hut, it is a chain and you know what you are getting...you either like it or you don't. This leaves the cleanliness and service to review:

So this location is very clean and the past two times I have gone, I have gotten a guy named Billy who looks like he is new, but super friendly. I will keep coming back for friendly service with a smile!

LA Cafe is a hidden gem on Main Street in Whitestown.  It is just up the road from Anson.   The reason for 5 stars: Very friendly and attentive staff, family friendly but also can be more upscale.   The lunch menu is very reasonably priced as is their Sunday brunch buffet.   Dinner is a little pricier but the offerings are also more upscale from the standard lunch menu.   Steaks, seafood etc.  If you really crave a burger though just ask and they will gladly prepare if for dinner.   They offer outside seating on the patio and often will host various events like wine tastings and wine and canvass type events.   If you are looking for a local bar, they have that too.   The brownie sundae is a family favorite for and enough to share.    
They offer catering for events and will host private parties as well.   We love that it is a small business and the owner is very hard working and friendly.

the best little mexican place in town.
have only been for lunch a few times - but it's very good.  
pazole every day! 
prices are very fair.
i've tried four items now and everything has been delicious and well prepared.
the owner - Angie, is very nice and attentive and there is clearly a commitment to quality and service.
can't wait to go for dinner when i can have a margarita or maybe something with some fruit - they've got yummy looking pineapples and bananas at front counter that i assume are used to make some tropical tasting drinks!
amazing salsas too!

This theater is so gross! It smells like a basement and I'm pretty sure the seats were wet. Do not go here, it's a complete waste of money, I had a hard time enjoying the movie due to my physical experience. It's been years since I've been here, don't know if my standards have increased or the establishment has declined- either way, won't be coming back. If there was an option for no stars, I would have gone with that one.
Tacos are very small and not much meat on them! Salsa bar was all empty... Service is mediocre at best... they got our order all wrong and over charged us... kinda spends for what they are!

Stopped in for lunch. Sushi was sub-par, not fresh. And on my way to the bathroom I got a glimpse of the kitchen and the floor was filthy. At 12:30pm? That made me nervous. The guy making the sushi seems hate his job, he looks miserable behind the counter. I'd give it one star but I feel bad for the waiters. He was at least friendly.
Wawa is somehow less magical when you're not drunk at 2am looking for a sandwich. It's just... a convenience store. This one's open 24 hours, so that's nice.
