Very pricey compared to all the other gas stations is Carp. The customer service is lousy and the selection of mini mart goods is poor. They don't give you cash back and tell you to go to the  ATM. Unfortunately they don't compare to the other 76 gas stations out there. Too bad.

This place is a really neat concept. It wasn't as busy as some of the other spots nearby, but we did go in the early evening and it was still about a third full. I think it'd be best to come here late in the evening when it's busier. Still, we saved on cover which they start charging later in the evening.  The pianists are pretty talented and they sang everything anyone threw at them. We didn't try the food here, but the drinks were reasonably priced.

Unreal good.  Probably best meal I have had in Nashville so far.  Had Crispy Brussel sprouts, Spicy Tuna Guacamole, and Blustered Baby Heirloom Tomatoes.  Has good patio area, good atmosphere, and must have good drinks by the laughter at tables near me ;-)

I posted a picture. The chicken sandwich was pink in the middle, not white. It looked like ham, its not ham. I've eaten here several times and each time the food is undercooked. I wonder if they use timers and the elves working in the kitchen have limitations in their educational abilities. Anyway, I'm concerned with what is goin on in the kitchen. I think Anthony Bourdain would have strangled someone  here. This is not exactly what Marriott should associate themselves with, and I'm thinking this is borderline illegal and not appropriate to sell to people with weak immune systems. I'm very concerned.
I just had a great pedicure. The girl that did it was awesome!!! I got a nice foot massage with oil and hot stones. Although the salon is not the nicest decorated wise their service is top notch.

I'm a teacher, so clearly I went to Union Trust during Restaurant Week.  It rocked my world and then some.  Great service, killer wine, and AMAZING decor.  Big ups to Fabian for dealing with my drunk friends and I :)  

I did also eat, so I can tell ya that WOW hericot vert and cod never tasted so good!  My girlfriends ordered filet mignon, and they all almost died in their seats.  I'd definitely like to go for a little hh or special occasion meal again!!

It wasn't busy at all.  The bartenders walked by us I don't know how many times without even recognizing us.  Finally placed our drink orders and it took forever for them to come back and take our food order.  Food had definitely changed since they were bought out. And not for the better.  We use to eat regularly at Scotty's until the change over.  Sent reviews to Scotty's as their menu request and each time received lip service pretty stating everything is the same.  I've spoken with many people that feel the same it's gone corporate about the bottom line.  Will definitely not spend another dollar with Scotty's!

We had our large group of 6 kids and 4 adults dine at Fitz's on a busy Saturday afternoon. First, let me say how PHENOMENAL our waiter was. He was patient, attentive, and really didn't seem to mind the crazy ankle biters running around and throwing things. He helped us with the drink and food selections, and kept the refills of their handmade sodas coming! We ordered an order of Toasted Ravioli for the table. They were your typical St Louis staple; breaded and fried stuffed ravioli served with a side of marinara. Delicious. I told our waiter that our two kids would be sharing their Chicken Fingers with Smiley fries. He brought it out already equally split into two kid-friendly bowls. Amazing! For my entree, I ordered the Fish and Chips. The fish (haddock) was HUGE and perfectly fried to crispy perfection. It was served with Chips and Coleslaw, both of which were wonderful counterparts to the fish. Between our group, we ordered 8 different entrees, and everyone's plates were empty. To top that off, our waiter brought the kids two HUGE Root Beer Float Ice Cream Sunday's for the kids birthdays, completely complimentary! This place is super kid friendly and had some pretty good food. I know I haven't said much about their handmade soda's, but that's not really my thing. I will say everyone at the table enjoyed the bottomless mugs of Root Beer, Cream Soda, Black Cherry handmade sodas.
Good food.  Curbside pickup was perfect.  20 minutes and food was ready and brought out.

I am THRILLED this place opened up in Kensington! I came here for dinner and was not disappointed. I didn't have high hopes for the cocktails but was pleasantly surprised at the variety and quality. We ordered three appetizers and an entree between the two of us which was more than enough food. The fried pickles and Mac& cheese were our favorites out of the appetizers. We didn't love the entree options surprisingly (not a lot of vegetarian options), but the appetizers more than make up for it. The place wasn't too crowded, nor was it empty on a Saturday night. Service was fantastic. I will definitely be visiting again...also, caught a glimpse of the happy hour menu and it looks like they have great deals!
No matter where you go, no matter how much you pay, you can't get a better burger in Tucson. And, you'll get a big order of fries on the side. Plus, served by a pro.

The female "owner" of this establishment is rude, inconsiderate, selfish and down right uncaring. Maybe if you weren't such a stressed out ugly soul, your parking lot would be full and business would be booming. 
I witnessed the owner rudely bark at customers with 2 young kids walking to another establishment because they parked in her empty parking lot! She barked "I pay $1000.00 a month for parking." Did you even consider that maybe they were going to stop at your place afterwards? Again the lot was EMPTY! 
My family stops to patronize several dessert shops at one time, everyone does, I guess you didn't consider that!! I will not visit your icecream shop ever again, I will also be sure to express what I witnessed to all that want icecream on the beach! It literally left a bad taste in my mouth, so much so that I threw out the icecream I ordered. 
It's patrons like myself that pay for your mortgage, car and everything else you feel like spending money on and living comfortably with. I hope this negative post resonates loud and clear with other customers, your attitude is disgraceful and I hope you feel it where it hurts!

I used to order from here all the time when I lived in Clayton, and I never had anything less than a stellar experience. Fish is fresh, rolls are well-made, and prices are more than reasonable, especially if you get the all you can eat special. Best sushi in the St. Louis area (St. Charles and Downtown locations were also just as good in my experience).

5 stars as can find nothing wrong with my many experiences here. Staff are pleasant and accommodating, very focused on your comfort with any and all tests. Nice waiting area and calm scenery playing on the tv for those who may be anxious. Mammograms are quick and very focused and making it a comfortable procedure. Bonus, if you are signed up for My Chart, you will receive your results within 24 hours!

In a semi sketchy neighborhood: check 
Bar looks fairly hole in the wall: check
The seating is nearly impossible to get on a weekend evening: check
You shouldn't order anything but beer: check

Seriously folks, don't be like the people I saw here and order a Chardonnay with your dinner...because it'll come from a mini bottle on a never dusted shelf of their never touched drink area. It's like the stuff you might get on an airplane. However, who in their right mind comes to black thorn for Chardonnay anyway??? It's all about the beer here.

I know this place seems sketch...they do not even have a menu online. Oh noes, what will I do? Well if you have a hankering for Chicago style deep  dish pizza and you want to know what they offer you seriously need to call them or look at the yelp pics of the menu. If they give you sas, well I'd say that's expected of a grungy place, but that's not necessarily true. I really didn't get a good feel for their attitude here. 

When I was there it took forever to get a drink because of how "busy" it was, but like I said it was mostly expected. It's tiny and a bit rundown feeling like a dive bar. Not my favorite feeling but that's part of why they don't get 5 stars from me.

If it's busy you probably won't find seating immediately. The best solution is to scope things out and play some arcade games until something opens up! 

The pizza here is seriously an awesome combo while you are drinking. I love deep dish, and while black thorn isn't my all time favorite, it's pretty good for st Louis. 

Keep in mind deep dish takes forever to cook and when you are in line for your pizza to be made it could take an hour, which means you might already be feeling the buzz of your alcohol kick in.

We were super excited to try this place after seeing videos on Facebook. 

And it was good - but not great. 

We shared the Ranch this Country flight with 13 sides of ranch. Our favorite flavors were the pesto ranch, ruffalo and the castaway ginger. 
Our table ordered several other menu items including the Twisted Ranch burger, Big Kid Mac and Cheese, Dill Pickle Chips, and BBQ Brisket Sandwich. All were very good with the exception of the mac and cheese - maybe the texture. 

Our favorite part of the whole experience though was our waiter, Mason. He was very helpful in helping us choose menu items and drinks. And when we had an issue with the mac and cheese, he was more than willing to exchange it for another item. But most importantly his attitude was great!

This is a very cute cupcake place. It is located in Hyde Park Village. It has a lot of different flavors. The most unique thing about this place is that it has Cupcake ATM outside. That's a cool thing, you have to try it once you are there. I was not sure if ATM works after the store closed but yes, it does! My boyfriend and I tried to buy a cupcake at 11 pm. They had only one type of cupcake left. But even tho, it was cool that you can go there after hours and still get the cupcake. The cupcakes look beautiful but the taste is okay. There is nothing special about them. You can buy the same cupcakes from any grocery store the difference is that it will look less fancy. It a nice place to try but it is a one-time thing. If you did not take a photo with ATM, then do it
I love the food here! Not like I've been every place they have them in the city, but definitely be the best Pho and Bahn Mi I've had in Philly.
Laura is the best. Have been following her for years and she is so good with my small temperamental dog. He always looks and smells good when he comes home.

Jacques-Imo's is legendary. This divey, walk-in restaurant could care less about ambiance, fancy drinks, or even comfy seating. The tablecloths are those plastic ones you see at kid parties. Ours had gingerbread men and snowflakes. Seriously. The tables are crammed haphazardly, and the waiters do a dance around the maze to reach you. You walk though the kitchen to get to the dining room. This place has character for sure.

They also have a spot on my most delicious meal in New Orleans thus far. This is saying something, as the bar is so high in this city!

The complimentary Garlic Cornbread bites set the tone off right. Don't be shy to ask for more - we devoured 7 between both of us...

The Boudin Balls aren't mentioned much in the reviews, but it was my favorite dish of the night. Fried pork rice balls stuffed with jalapeño & gooey pepper jack cheese. Words can't even explain how satisfying this was. Just order it!!

Austin Leslie's Fried Chicken was so (so!) juicy with a thicker, crispy breading. We chose four sides total. The Corn Macque Chow and Mashed Sweet Potato had so much butter, so much fat, and so much yummy. The Red Beans & Rice were hearty and delicious. The Country Greens had good seasoning and fatty flavor.

We also had the Crawfish Etouffee and the Duck & Andouille Gumbo. These flavor profiles pretty much epitomize Cajun food. Jacques-Imo's did not disappoint. They make it with a dark roux and you could just taste the labor of love in the complexity of flavor. The amount of crawfish was very generous.

Unfortunately we made the mistake of thinking the Shrimp and Alligator Sausage Cheesecake was a sweet dessert. We cancelled our order, but our waiter couldn't resist and brought us complimentary Creme Brulee instead. As you guessed, the top was torched perfectly and the filling was done right.

Speaking of our waiter, his personality and service was superb. This ain't no white glove place, instead he made us feel like family.

If I had to recommend one spot in this city it would be here. Go and thank me later :)

Take Note:
-They only take reservations for 5+. Get here early for walk-ins. We arrived just before 6 pm on a Saturday and our estimated 45 minute wait turned into a quick 10.

I visited this establishment twice with coworkers and both times I was unimpressed.  The food lacks flavor and comes out way to fast to be freshly cooked.  On the second visit my coworker ordered the lunch steak fajitas and the food came out on a skillet that was NOT sizzling.  I am very disappointed because I had been anxiously waiting their opening for months.  I hope they are able to work out the kinks sooner than later.
coffee is good. I ordered an oat milk latte, but was charged $1 for alternative milk options. I also ordered food, which i waited 30minutes to get. Service is slow.

Soooo good. Yesterday was my first time eating here and I loved it! All of my friends' food was good, because who doesn't taste their friends' food on Galentine's Day!? Waiting staff was amazing! Christina was AWESOME!! Best waitress I've ever had!! Request her! Love this place. Def going again soon.

Surprisingly, the Whole Foods in Metarie is significantly larger and nicer than the one in Orleans Parish (at least, the one I visited; they have one uptown as well). It's got enough going on that you really could use it as your main food source, if you were either wealthy or careful in how you shop.

I'm not a huge supplement person, but I had a specific and scientifically plausible need to supplement some vitamins, and I was quite happy with what I found there, as well as the food. The downside is that unlike the two NOLA locations, this is not on the streetcar, so you must drive yourself.

Hassan was friendly and chill from the start. I knew which car on their lot I wanted to look at because I saw it on their website. They had well lit thorough photos. I made an appointment for after work. Nobody is expected to know everything about every trim level of every model, but Hassan seemed to be pretty knowledgeable. When he didn't know something he wrote it down and said he'd find out for me. I had done a fair amount of research, so I knew the answers to most of the questions I was asking. Hassan was honest and helpful the whole time, through the entire buying process.

 When I showed up for my appointment Hassan was waiting for me. I didn't realize it at the time but there was also another couple in the  showroom who was also interested in the car.  They had to wait to drive the car because I had an appointment. After I test drove it Hassan handed the keys off to another salesman who test drove the car with this couple. Before they got back I put a deposit down on the car  to hold it.  I later learned that the couple that test drove it after me offered to buy the car.  But, because I had put a deposit down on the car they were not able to purchase the car.  Keep in mind this is a very well priced car with very low mileage  for a certified pre-owned 2016.  The next time I could see the car and go through with the deal was a few days later, this was a stressful time for me because I did not personally know Hassan before this and did not know if he would sell the car and refund my deposit if the other couple were perhaps to offer more money. If the employees at Scott Kia were not honest they would have sold the car the first chance they got, but this situation showed me that they are trustworthy! Hassan held the car, had it detailed, and a dark spot on the driver's door wet sanded off. The cabin air filter was not changed, so they changed that too. 

I paid in full, the transaction was an absolute dream. I cannot stress this enough. I was ready for a high pressure sales pitch. I calculated what I thought the final check I'd have to write should total, I was off by only a couple hundred. I was not even offered extras like seat protectant spray until after the deal.  And when I was offered the extras it was correctly assumed that I would not want them. Kristin explained everything very clearly for us and even left the room to take care of other parts of the transaction when she knew we wanted to read all of the fine print. Ridiculously generous! It's like they know there's a better way of doing business and they make the changes to improve!

After signing only a handful of papers, Hassan was willing to take as much time as we needed to connect our phones to the car and get all the technology set up. With the sale being wrapped up he asked if he could have a photo of me next to my new car for his website. This is important because it shows Hassan takes pride in his work. I also got a thank you letter in the mail about 2 weeks later.

In contrast, Murray Kia of Conshohocken made me wait a inexcusably long length of time to enter my license into their computer system when I went to test drive one of the cars on their lot. I don't think the salesman knew how to do it. He was older. Then, within 3 minutes of exiting the showroom, walking toward a vehicle, the Murray Kia salesman told me he has prostate cancer. I don't appreciate this unsolicited personal information. It had no bearing on what was going on. Also, everyone should know it's policy at Murray Kia for the salespeople to make you wait for a manager come to talk to you before you leave. I don't like everything about that situation and I don't appreciate the social discomfort it forced me into. Scott Kia didn't waste my time like this. I'd been to Murray Kia before and been thrown around by their sales department, it's their standard operating procedure. Scott Kia was different, they were respectful, matched my calm demeanor, ect.

Every step of the way the employees at Scott Kia are working hard to break the stereotype of aggressive used car salesmen. My wife was also impressed with the entire experience. Right now we have three Kias and in the future we can't see ourselves buying from anyone buy Hassan at Scott Kia.

The service was exceptional. Johny is awesome, hes quick and seems really know what's hes doing. My dad backed up his car into the garage door, the cable was broken, the door was unbalanced and did not open right. I and my boyfriend tried to fix it for 3 hours but still didn't get it to work right. My whole house is only half year old and my house's builder's guy looked at garage door's damage and said it would cost at least couple to five hundred dollars (the warranty doesn't cover it, I was so sad). So I found Elite Garage Door and couple others on Yelp with good reviews. I was gonna have 3 companies estimate and see who gives the best deal. Johny from Elite Garage Company was able to come right on the day I called them. He was on time, polite and very nice. After 1 minute looking at it, he said it was gonna take about 30' labor, nothing needed to replaced, so $45. I was so happy that it could be that fast easy fix and that cheap. I agreed to get it done right then. After less than 30min, he was done. He also fixed the metal bar on the side that whoever built the garage door didn't install it right. In general, I had a very good experience with this company/ Johny. I am normally too lazy to write reviews or very short ones but this time I have to, they deserve it. I will totally recommend them or call them again if I need my garage door repaired or installed. Now I gotta call to cancel other estimation appointments

Extremely bland and ordinary, and slow. Crust was preformed frozen, with gummy mozzarella and the Parmesan was the stale and tasteless packaged variety in shakers. Tomato sauce was nearly without tomato flavor. Really only deserves 1/4 star but yelp doesn't give that option. Sad pizza in a city famous for its food.

I'm so lucky to live within walking distance to this awesome chocolate store. It's an old fashioned delight with home made hand dipped chocolates and many local favorites, and they made footballs when the Eagles went to the Superbowl! They also make the best peanut brittle and their French Burnt Peanuts are so fresh! The staff is very knowledgeable and friendly, so make it down to Lore's Chocolates, you will not regret it!
Hummus is great!  Food great !  Wish the bread came warm but I've always enjoyed anything we've had there. Thank you.

If you have a bit of an old soul, you will love this place. The bar is a bit on the small side, but the food is good and there is a cool rat pack vibe to it. Not many good places in LOL but this place you should definitely try.

Shitty customer service. 

This place is a joke. Deserves no stars. Took my car there at 1pm, gave them my phone number and waited for a call. 6 hours passed and no call. I called them 5 times with no answer. So i went there. They were closed (open light was still on). So i used my spare key and took my car because i had work in the morning. So i called them the next day at about 4pm and told them exactly what happened and that i was very dissappointed. I offered to pay half price and they refused. They even called the police. They are thugs useless peices of shit.

Something happened to the batter, I think the girl told me, so they couldn't make anymore fancy donuts. So the only donut I had was the one that came with my chicken, I never found out the flavor...it was pretty good. I got the buttermilk chicken...ummm I didn't like it that much. But, I'm willing to give this place another try so that I can taste their fancy donuts and get a different seasoning on my chicken.
Amazing  flavor !!  Delicious sauce and perfect crust !!  The staff was super friendly and my boys were happy as can be!

We always have a lot of fun at Jeffs this is a nice laid back neighborhood atmosphere.  This is a fantastic place to watch sports and I love sitting on the patio and watching football.  Really good specials during game days and a lot of really nice people who hang out there.  Its really an interesting mix of people both younger and older but everyone gets along really well with each other.  You aren't a stranger very long at Jeff's.  Food is good too!  Prices are reasonable.

If you haven't been here for taco Tuesday's your life is missing something. That being said make sure you arrive early because after 5 it's a serious pain in the butt to find an open table without wait. Try all the tacos on Tuesday that's simple enough!

If it's not Tuesday you must have the nachos or the brisket sandwich. Best brisket Sammy I've had in this city to date.

Went there with my wife on Sunday for dinner. Ordered 3 dishes of sushi. They looked good but tasted not fresh. Just better than what you can find in the grocery store. Didn't try Hibachi, have no idea whether it is good or not. If you have high expectation about great sushi, try somewhere else. I still haven't found a place that better than Sushi Land, in Bryn Mawr. I would recommend go there instead for authentic and fresh sushi.
Salmon johnny Cakes were outstanding. I'll be returning. Great atmosphere. They have a diversity of everything.

Love Cup Bop you can pick you level of "hot". The sauces are amazing and very friendly staff. Always greeted with a cheerful hello when we visit. They have a punch card system, so our next visit will be free. Combo Bowl

Can't believe we haven't been here before. It was excellent. Our waiter was spot on with his recommendations!! We both thoroughly enjoyed our beef stew and creole eggplant.  Service and atmosphere are great!! Must stop in Nola for us next time.

So. I went to this place last week. I'm gonna keep it short.  The food was GREAT. Not kidding. The service was the worst I've ever had. In any place. Ever. I used to wait tables.   I can give the benefit of doubt when deserved. 

Sat for 15 minutes without being greeted, we joined friends but come on...our food order was in before we had water on the table, which I had to ask for 3 times. 3. 

We had 4 different servers. Four.

I spoke to the manager, no idea his name but he couldn't have cared less. 

I've been to The Row four times. That will be the last. It's been the same for different reasons each and every time. 

Ironically, the bartender was great. 

Sucks cause food is good, sorry kitchen staff--servers and management will might end up costing you your job :(

I decided to meet my spouse for lunch. We decided on Makers pizza. The pizza was good but I determine good pizza by the sauce so I got some on the side, it was very good. But I noticed on the menu, handmade fresh. It was delicious‍

We had lunch here on Cinco De Mayo. Right after we placed our order, the manager came to our table to inform us that their credit card machines were down, but they had an atm and would refund us any atm charges. The server and food were both pretty good, but nothing to write home about. The salsa was good, and they give you bean dip with the chips and salsa. I'm not sure that we will be dining here again. This was our second time here, and I'm just not overly impressed.

Their burgers are like nowhere else.  I love these cheeseburgers.  The monsoon is really good too.  Nice and strong, they definitely don't skimp you on the alcohol.  Like the other reviews have said, you'll need a few days to recover from the grease, but it's definitely a unique experience all around.  Just be prepared to wait so don't go starving!

Adding an update: just went this weekend and whoah - some of the waitstaff is incredibly rude.  The drink girl who comes and takes your order approached the table, "Do you want any drinks?" without even a high and interrupted our conversation.  We proceeded to call her the drink wench for the rest of the evening.  The waiter was still very polite, but it took 30 minutes for us to receive our bill after we were done eating.  The waitress taking names and seating people was also very unfriendly and rushed.  I'm not really sure what's happened since the last time I've been there, but thank goodness the burgers are consistently satisfying because it made up for the inconsistent service.

I am usually a little leery of mid-range chain steakhouses, but who can afford Morton's more than 2-3 times per lifetime?  The filet mignon was good and the trout was very good, as were the baked potatoes.  The chocolate stampede desert was also very good, surprising since I figured it would be one of those substitute-quantity-for-quality servings, but it was actually tasty, and enough for three of us to share.

Service was very good - quick, friendly and helpful.

I was glad to see a Subway at the Summit Mall but disappointed on Saturday when I found out this particular location doesn't honor the current promotion of "$5.00 Footlongs", although I'm almost sure I read in the Reno Gazette last week that they did.
The wheat bread was stale and the sandwich came wrapped in only the outside paper with the "Subway" logo on it, without the usual inner paper that is used to place the sandwich on during assembly. Maybe that's why my bread dried out on the 10 minute drive home.
Won't go here again...probably the worst Subway sandwich I have ever eaten and at $35.00 for 4 sandwiches I felt ripped off.

I have been coming here for awhile now the food is amazing, you can never go wrong when picking from the menu. Staff is courteous and friendly. The bartenders and waitresses are well trained they know the menu and alcohol. Owner of the business introduced himself very professional employment and great bar. You will catch me here often.

We went ordered vegetarian platter to share and one  ordered the one order falafel which had six falafel  balls.
The vegetarian platter had hummus, ban ganoush and tabbouleh. We liked the platter and falafel was good but not great.

Mazarro's Italian market is a favorite, especially Friday when they have their fish sandwich. Then they opened Annata on Beach Drive for wine, cheese and meats. That became a favorite. Now they have Alto Mere Fish Bar, next door to Annata, and it is spectacular. First, Sara was an amazing help with the menu. We started with 6 Oysters. What made them great were the sauces. Cocktail with extra horseradish, mignonette, and their own spicy sauce. The fish spread is a defining spread in Florida, and theirs met the test. We asked for their spicy sauce from the oysters and it took it up a notch. They had red and green rice crisps for the Christmas season. The manager gave us some of the sauce to take home!
Next was the fried green tomato caprese. Another hit and I used the hot sauce again. 
Sara raved about the Pernod Mussels and she was on target. We had the leftover sauce packed to take home. We'll warm it up with a loaf of Italian bread! We love fennel and it had a great balanced flavor. 
We finished with an entree of Bucatini and Lobster. Another hit and if they hadn't served it with bread, we would have taken that sauce home too!
The only complaint is they don't take reservations. 

Back for another great  meal. We happened to get there during happy hours(4-6) and had a dozen oysters for $2 each. These were perfectly shucked so you could just let them slide into you mouth. They had a terrific  brine to them which I love. We then had the calamari which was perfectly fried in a light tasty batter. It was like eating popcorn shrimp. The side tomato sauce was a perfect match. 
My wife had  the salmon special with gnocchi and I had the shrimp scampi. It was  in a lighter sauce than I get elsewhere, but spicy and delicious. 
Just a wonderful experience and our server, Brittney, was terrific. We also took some  more  hot sauce home!

Placed an order through DoorDash and it was delivered in a timely fashion. Salmon Bagel was fine, Niçoise salad was okay but missing the olives, green beans and hard boiled egg - a sad looking scrambled egg was thrown on top. They really dropped the ball with the poutine - no chorizo, no pico, no egg, no tots. It was listed with entrees but this was a side portion of fries with sauce. Gave us an incorrect side also - ended up paying $5 for 7 slices of potato - not the bacon we ordered. $60 for a sandwich, a salad and side of fries is pretty steep. I don't think I'll be back.
This is our 2nd visit to the office and they are amazing!!! Both my kids suffer from anxiety and the work was simple and stress free! Need a pediatric dentist come see them today!

Visually amazing , great location, amazing food... could have used at least one drawer or dresser? Otherwise we had a wonderful stay... I have to call out Chris ( long hair) one of the bartenders at the hotel bar- strong cocktail skills, attentive, witty banter - he very much made a fancy hotel feel approachable and like home. Its people like him that make me want to come back again; and not , yet again, search for the next newest of the new hip hotels. We had a wonderful time. ( Also of note: the chicken on the Cobb salad I ate by the pool was randomly the best chicken I've had in a very long time and I feel I need people to know)... I mean Chris was great ... but that chicken though

I was here for a meeting. We had our choices for food fare a couple of days prior to the meeting. I had chosen seafood, no dairy. My infant son has a dairy intolerance. They graciously took the challenge and presented me with some delicious dinner and dessert! I can say they really do inspire to accommodate the guest. I appreciate it, and my infant son appreciate it 

The salad was crisp and fresh, made with local ingredients! So good! The dressing was light and refreshing.

The scallops were cooked to perfection. I tasted a hint of coconut milk which made the dish taste creamy without dairy. The corn salad was a perfect match with the scallops. 

The dessert of lemon sorbet (one of my favorites) was so delicious. Tart and sweet, made my mouth water just looking at it. And refreshing and light to end the meal.

Our intention was to go to the Acme oyster House until we saw the line waiting to get in due to the food.com attention this restaurant has received,  Lo and behold right across the street was Felix's Oyster Bar where we were seated with only a 5 min wait.  

We specifically went in to eat raw oysters and yes... The had the best.  We had amazing fresh, cold, huge oysters and we got to make our own fresh cocktail sauce which was fun.

Now let me tell you about the other oyster dish we tried--- Oysters de Jour!!!!!            Oh My Hell ... These are fried oyster (light breading) with buffalo sauces and sprinkled with blue cheese.  These are best cooked oysters I have ever eaten.  I plan to eat here every time I go New Orleans.

Why 4 stars? Because I will definitely keep Tazikis on my short list.

   ---   ---   ---

While usually the wife and I don't mind driving a bit for a good meal, lately we've been exploring spots that we've never been to in our own hood. She works near the Tazikis in St. Pete and raves about it, so we put them on the short list to visit for dinner. I definitely see us coming here more often in the future!

I ordered a beef gyro with a salad and pasta salad. I wasn't super thrilled with the sides - they were average at best - but the gyro was really great. The pita bread that it was wrapped in was thick and buttery, which exactly what you hope for anytime you're enjoying pita bread. My only complaint is that I wish they had included some more of that pita bread on the side with salad, but instead we were given more of a pita crisp.

We ordered online ahead of time, which was super convenient. The food only took as long as our commute from home to the restaurant (about 10 minutes) so it was ready for us as soon as we arrived. Just another reason why I think we will definitely put this on regular rotation when we're trying to figure out where to eat!

Excelent front desk customer service, however, this hotel is in need for a renovation. Bathroom wall paper peeling off and dirty, tv controls not working, holes in bed sheets, lamps are standing but not strait, everything old, used, outdated. Does not feel clean, and it gives bad reputation to the Sheraton brand. Rooms are spacious, and air conditioning worked fine. Will certainly book somewhere else next time.
Needs to work on customer service. Super slow and at one point it takes 3 associates to figure out a guys return on curtains....

Hubby and I stopped in for lunch while waiting for our bus. It was busy so we had to check it out. So glad we did! We were seated right away. They were participating in Coolinary Month, and it was Taco Tuesday. But, we went with an order of chorizo and queso and a crab cake sandwich to share. Service was great. Food was quick, fresh and tasty! I'd definitely come back and try some other menu items. We left satisfied and full. Give this place a try if you're in the area.

This is what supporting locals is all about !  All the planning and hard work makes Reno proud !

The events were varied and there was a special all over town that would fit anyone's tastes.   With the the crazy week I had I did not get to enjoy as many as I wanted.....
But tried 3 new restaurants and will return to them.   
Of course the highlight again this year was the chef showdown.   Excellent!!!! 
Every chef was able to showcase their talents.   The secret ingredient made a lot of faces cringe and the creativity flow!   
Thanks for all the worm to put this one.

Soooooo sad they have changed the happy hour menu! Now it's just shrimp and oysters. Now don't get me wrong I love shrimp and oysters, but I miss the tacos the sliders all the other yummy stuff! Love your cozy little bar !

This place is amazing! Great food and service! 

P.S. my brother did get sick there once but the cause was inconclusive, but a coincidence... not sure.

I follow this restaurant of FB and IG and the pictures always look amazing. I saw the fried fish picture and had to have it.  I was a little disappointed.  The fish was very greasy, as if they didn't let it drain properly before putting it on my plate. My husband had the cajun pizza with shrimp and andouille. There was no Cajun flavor, at all.  Tasted like garlic alfredo sauce.  The cheesesteak eggrolls were good.  I will go one more time to give another item a chance but I was disappointed.

Booked reservations after seeing an ad for Ice Package and I called and was told that the reservation included Ice exhibit, ice skating, slides, etc and that is why the second night (Thursday night) was so much more expensive than Wednesday (+$300 difference). Arrive to check in and after waiting in line for almost 45 minutes, I am informed that the package only includes tickets to the Ice exhibit and everything else is extra.  The rate was so much higher because the Music City Bowl is Friday. So basically we've been price gouged for a game we care nothing about seeing. NO ONE did anything when I explained what I was promised and since it was a non-refundable package, even leaving and going home would not get us our money back. So we decided to stay and try to make the best of it.  The hotel is grossly understaffed and not equipped to handle the game, the Christmas exhibits still open AND the recently opened water park. Valet parking full, three hours to get pillows, so ordered pizza from room service and they called back to say they couldn't serve just cheese pizza and suggested we order from restaurant in hotel so we called and they said you have to be there in person to order. Husband walks what seems like half a mile to restaurant only to find it locked up at 9:30 even though closing time was quoted as 10:00.  Ended up paying $38 for a 10" pepperoni pizza that was over cooked.  Next day we went to ICE exhibit which was good but not worth what we paid and found the ONE employee that was helpful and actually smiled.  Returned to room at 2:00 and housekeeping still hadn't been there so we called and requested service that finally happened at 4:00. Went to find dinner and ended up paying for an Uber after waiting on shuttle for 45 minutes. At dinner, the server actually laughed and said Gaylord is known among locals as not honoring what is promised and over charging guests and that numerous customers have complained to him saying the same thing.  It's just sad. I absolutely feel like I was scammed. We paid over $1,000 for two nights at a hotel and an ice sculpture display. Can not wait to check out and go home. It is beautiful, but we will NOT be back.

Huge rolls for a small price! I'm normally not into sushi but my boyfriend loves it so I decided to give this place a try and I am so glad I did. every bite was amazing. I got the caterpillar rolls-so good!

I stopped in one evening after a night out at the Comedy Club in town with three other girlfriends.  It was in the wee hours of the morning somewhere around 4 a.m..  We ordered 2 Seafood Combination Platters & 2 Breakfast Combination Platters.  They were all more than generous with the Portion Sizes & Taste was Great.  Everone had Doggy Bags to carry home.  The atmosphere was festive with the Dessert Cases taking Front & Center.  We salivated just glancing at the picture perfect Thank goodness we were too full to try  anything else at that time(made a return date promise for dessert only next week).  The bill was much less than we anticipated given the huge portion sizes & the quality of the Seafood Dishes, as well as the breakfast foods.  The waitress was very attentive & helpful when we informed her that it was our first time there,making suggestions that  really helped with our confusion.  Substitutions were not a problem for any of the Dishes.  Gotta say there should be more places like this one.  I recommend this eatery for anyone that wants Value & Quality   We "will Be Back"

This place has good food but it is WAY too expensive. The specialty cone is $7 and salads start at $6. The upside to the "make your own" is that you can have unlimited toppings but the size doesn't merit the price. They say it is the size of 2 regular slices of pizza but they must have measured a small pizza because it was not filling, but I wasn't going to spend another $7 for a second cone. 

They have ice cream cones for $5 a cone which still feels really expensive for the novelty of ice cream in a pizza cone. 

If the price was a couple dollars cheaper...this place would get 5 stars. It was good, just not nearly enough food for the price.

This place needs help bad, they have a huge ant problem and act like it's normal, Santa Barbara does not have an ant problem; this place does. If you want your belongings to be covered in ants, then this is the place for you. 
The front desk personnel are probably the worst I've come across at any hotel. Paris Hilton needs to check them and they're really weird bartender (I mean weird).
The food here gave me the BGs, do not eat here even if you're not staying here, you'll get an earful from a weird bartender and served old looking food. 
The room and property were not well maintained, most of the porch lights for the rooms are out, the couches are old and stained, we had broken glass outside our room, the parking works about half the time, this list could go on but I'm not going to do their job for them, they need corporate Hilton to come in.
This review is getting too long, if your not convinced not to stay here, that's on you!!

This place only opened a couple weeks ago.  And I almost missed it.  Luckily, I saw a sandwich board announcing its' presence.  It's hidden away on the beautiful upper patio of Antioch University and is open to the public.

They serve farmer's market fresh salads, as interesting and good as any I've had in Santa Barbara.  And the sandwiches my friend and I had were out of this world - amazing! The Brisket Banh Mi was incredible and the Pickled Beet sandwich was also filling and flavorful.

See if you can find the place. It's definitely worth it.  There's nowhere else like it in Santa Barbara.

Well I have to say I was nervous boarding my 8 yr old girl after not being boarded for 3 years.  My dad heard about this place from his neighbor . I must say the minute I spoke with Donna on the phone I felt at ease, then I met Susan and the two of the them made me so comfortable to leave my girl with them and had not worry in the world. They honestley make you feel like family..... These two women are so likable and have a love for the animals like no other thay are so great I can not say enough about how great they are!!! After you leave  you will just wanna stop by and say hi ( I know Elsa and I do) after I left Elsa  and I knew Elsa would be taken care of the way I would love her at home. The personal touch of  your dog sitting in the office with them after countless hours of loving all the animals as they were their own and being able to text or call and always get a response is priceless, along with pics being sent!  Elsa was so happy to be there she gave Susan a big sloppy kiss bye and can't wait to go back! Thank you both we will def be back and I have already spread the word of how great Elsa was taken care of  and what a great time she had, she has slept all afternoon.... You would be crazy to take your dog anywhere else....  Susan and Donna you may need to expand good news spreads  quickly thank you again you both are amazing and even more amazing at what you have started just out of your love your love for dogs! Thank you from the Merry family including Elsa

Good local eatery.  Breakfast options all day long and good selection of All American favorites.   The service is good and friendly.  Food is quick and fresh.  Good pricing and smoke free environment.

I love this place! I get my nails done, pedicures and now I've added eyelash extensions! They are so pretty and I get tons of compliments. I see Tiffany but all of the staff are very friendly.  They are tucked away in a plaza mall and very conveniently located for me. I'm always able to get appts when I need them and I'd highly recommend to anyone!

Arrived extremely excited this morning with the taste of beer nipping at my tongue, only to be met with a feeling of disappointment akin to that of catholic mother on coming out day. The boys an I were just trying to celebrate yet another beautiful Wahoo Thursdays but what we thought would be a fun outing quickly turned into a drastic descent into depression. As the cashiers lips opened, out poured a combination of words that struck fear deep into my heart, "the tap is out." I let out a shriek that echoed throughout the UCENs endless rafters. After several minutes of mourning I mustered up the courage to respond. I dragged the phrase "one Lagunitas" out of my quivering lips as I drearily tossed my card onto the counter. As I sipped my tepid beverage, I could not distinguish my tears from the Ale of defeat sat poised in my palm. Hope for a better experience next week.
UNNACEPTABLE

-with love, the wahoo thursday's boys

Renters and homeowners, Avoid this management company (Connie) at all costs. Staff and Connie are all unresponsive and unprofessional. Houses are managed so poorly. Read other reviews...
One townhome managed by Connie was in decent area but far below the market rental price (20-30% less). When we scheduled a tour at her convenient time, we found the home was trashed and not maintained at all. And said they'll not fix anything before we move in.

Some notable highlights:
- No showing and no response back on weekends or outside of their short office hours
- Connie is overall very rude and unprofessional. Just call her to ask any simple questions. I couldn't imagine how she'll treat me if I actually became a resident.
- Water didn't work in one restroom and she asks me what I think is wrong with it.
- Carpets are extremely old and stained and she doesn't know when it was last replaced. They'll not replace carpets.

Me and the hubby made a trip to NOLA and made reservations here.
First thing, the service is AMAZING. All the waiters greeted us as we walked in. We were seated in a nice table and our service throughout the whole dinner was top notch. At one point, one waiter even came and replaced my full glass of water with another glass of water so I could have "fresh ice." They were truly amazing and made us feel so welcome, like we were VIP. 
The food was okay. I had the creole gumbo as an appetizer, but honestly, it tasted like gravy. Not what I expected. My husband had the turtle soup and said he loved it, though. My pork chop was great, and the desserts were good too. I had the Alabama Apple Crisp, but it wasn't actually a crisp at all. It actually looked like bread pudding when it came out. It had great flavor, but not what I expected. My husband had the bread pudding soufflé and was very pleased.
The service here is phenomenal. The food was okay (to me.) But I gave it four stars for how efficient and wonderful the service was. Definitely give it a try!
I love how helpful the ladies are at this Sephora and the nice generous samples they make.  I always find myself getting addicted to the samples and going back and buying the stuff!

Great store with demonstrations and hands on activities with their amazing cars! You can use the big display to create your Tesla design. You can choose the leather, paint color, and so much more. The employees devote their time to helping you choose your car without feeling pressured or hurried. Tesla car shops are much better than regular car dealerships because it is always like an informational car show. The vehicles are unique and have funny creative settings. This shop was great and I also feel that the company as a whole is  revolutionary.

This was our first time at this restaurant. It was Friday night so it was pretty busy. The environment was beautiful. We were there for my boyfriends birthday. Service was kind of slow. Took forever to get our drinks. Good thing we had drinks before we showed up. Finally got our dinner order in. While waiting we were enjoying conversation but then we were waiting and waiting. Over an hour later we got our steaks. My food was cold. Our reservation was for 8 and I got my steak around 10. We were excited to watch the dueling pianos but that was just ok too. Nobody offered a birthday drink knowing it was a special occasion. Maybe they don't do that there. Anyways we are still undecided if we will go back. The amount of money we spent was not worth what we got.

Really fresh, really good food. If you enjoy sushi, you'll enjoy this place. Prices are kind of high I think. $10 for a veggie bowl or veggie burrito but it is tasty. Twice I asked for a Bubble Tea and twice the machine was not running so that was a bummer. 
I'd recommend and I would return.
Daryl was very helpful, energetic, and knowledgeable. The 35 scampi was delicious. And the 32 oz margarita was excellent

It's a very lovely place, the service was impeccable from the hostess, our server and the manager.  I love duck and was excited to order it! It arrived with a underdone gummy skin, completely inedible, so my server graciously took it back to have the skin cooked longer.  It came book looking much better however, they cook the meat on a wood burning grill which made the taste completely overwhelmed the flavor.  The manager came over and apologized and asked if I would like something else.  I ordered the rack of lamb, and had 4 tiny ribs, and also completely charred by the grill and took a bite and all I tasted was char. I took 2 bites and left it on the table.  Everything is ala carte, and the side broccoli was also charred from the grill.  Paid 200.00 with tip and left hungry.  My suggestion to the proprietor, you have beautiful cuts of meat, you should give people an option if they want it cooked with our without wood.  I would have loved to taste the flavor of the meats.
Food was delicious and the wait to get in went quickly. Service wasn't the best,but if I lived closer I'd definitely be back often for the delicious dumplings.
My favourite food in Nashville. Missed it everyday.
Best food ever!  The chef is fabulous. Menu is creative, fresh seasonal, artistic!  The chef prepares  the food perfectly!  Always our favorite!
The older workers here are miserable. Especially the bald dude. My god. The young workers are extremely helpful and happy to be there.

My husband and I went in for a bike fit and Adam was knowledgeable, kind, and very patient with us. He gave us great tips on improving our pedal stroke and efficiency. You can tell he's very passionate about riding. Truly one of the best experiences where we didn't feel like we were judged by our lack of biking experience. Thank you for all your help!

This was our lunch stop during the Captain Jack's winery tour.  It was fairly disappointing even though we kept our choices simple.  I had a cup of clam chowder and a serving of the oysters Rockefeller.  The clam chowder was off in its flavors.  It was a touch more watery than I would have liked.  I also did not come away with a nice rich, buttery flavor; this offering was much less nuanced, pedestrian in nature.  Clam was seldom seen throughout.  The oysters were definitely a miss.  These were not the famous ones from Antoine's.  The variation here was a very thick layer of melted cheese spiked with spinach or was that chives?  I couldn't tell, because the only thing I could taste was cheese.  It even dominated the natural taste of the ocean in the oysters entirely which really misses the point of the dish.  It is called Rockefeller because it is a very rich dish.  This was clunky.  Worse, one could simply scrape off the layer of coagulated cheese and just eat the oyster.  There was no melding of flavors, no subtleness to it at all.   A better name for this dish would have been oysters Velveeta.  Pass.

This is exactly what a neighborhood barbershop should be. No frills, bells, or whistles, but you get three gentlemen that know their craft well. What you ask for is what you get, and I've never come out disappointed with a cut. Yeah some of the hours and cash only might be a bit of a curveball but that's ok, it's part of the personality of this place. It's first come first serve which is great for those of us that can't plan our day around a  hair appointment and just need to get in and out when we can spare some time. Glad to have this place in Hendersonville.
There's far better choices for authentic Mexican cuisine in this city at a far better value.  Hit up Jose's on the corner of 10th and buttonwood or wander south of the market.

Visited the restaurant shortly after first opened and didn't have good experience - had to wait an hour and half for table for 2, then 30 mins for drinks and just to order, then the food was just meh.  Thought would give another shot tonight ordering thru Bitesquad but same bad experience - they took over an hour to prep my food and when finally delivered the order was missing items and cold. Never again Grand Hacienda - don't think your going to last very long in St Pete with this level of service and there are much better places to get Mexican food!

Ever have poached avocado?  Well you sure should, real fast.  It's absolutely delicious.  

I went here for brunch and was very impressed.  They have a very nice brunch menu which is available on the weekends.  The waitress was very sweet and passionate about the place, which always helps.  I am a vegetarian, so cheese/eggs are usually part of my brunch routine.  Trust me, you won't miss them here!

During the week they only serve dinner, but the menu for dinner looked really good and I'm very excited to go back.  They make it very apparent that this is a vegan only spot, which could turn off some people.  However, I think PLENTY of non-vegans will really enjoy this place.  I'm so lucky that this place opened so close to me!

Don't forget to try their fresh squeeze juices that the waitress informed us are made fresh right up the street.  

The prices are a little bit higher than people may be used to, so they write that tips are not expected at all.  I went on their website and they make the prices as they are so they may pay employees a good living wage.   Don't get me wrong its not "expensive" they probably ad about $2-3 dollars to each option.  I must say I'm not at all comfortable with not tipping, so either way I'm going to tip.  

It's so enjoyable to leave brunch feeling LIGHT and recharged, instead of feeling like you need to take a 3 hour nap. I will be back often

Happened upon this bar by chance when visiting Indy friends. It's simple and to the point: the best of "dive" bars. The owner was really nice, and we had a great time drinking with a couple of locals. If you go, ask for their specialty shot recipe the Red Rooster. You won't be disappointed!

Did you know you get unlimited refills of the breakfast potatoes at First Watch?!?  Neither did I until today and I've been coming here for a while!  That's one of the many small touches today that caused me to come back & change my 4 star review to a 5...and it was all because of my server, E.B. (Yep, that's her name.)

I still recommend the "Lean Machine" breakfast - it's my favorite: single turkey patty, tomato slices, english muffin, and 2 cholesterol-free, fat free eggs (I "cheat" and get 2 poached real eggs and add a side of avocado).  Stack everything for the perfect breakfast or lunch!

E.B. left a pitcher of lemoned water and carafe of earthy coffee with us (standard First Watch etiquitte), and then convinced us that, in addition to our Lean Machine & Bacado Omelette (Bacon, Avocado, & Montery Jack cheese) entrees we should split the Floridian French Toast we were both eyeing (French toast dusted with cinnamon sugar and wheat germ, and then topped with kiwi, bananas, and strawberries with warm fruit compote on the side).  

You should basically trust any suggestions this girl has.  I'll be back (now regularly ordering 2 entrees) and will hopefully never have another server.
Great samples today! Love that they are offering more gluten free options, now if they could only find some with less sugar :)

ITS COLD!!! Brrr....I think winter, and stocking up at Friedmans is my first stop.
If you are into camping and other wilding, you will find a good, but not great selection of essentials here. Not the snazzy down filled sleeping bags from free range geese that you'll be paying a premium for at REI.  Think more "zombie survival joint" than 'hipster camping joint' and you've got the vibe of this place right.

You should absolutely go to this place instead of going to Old Navy for their clothes which fall apart in the wash. They have really, really good sales items and many racks of tops and bottoms for kids and women in addition to the guys. 

There is a STUPID amount of army surplus....so, good naming of the place Mr. Friedman! Get your full body camo on the cheap here.

And knives. Did i mention the crazy knife collection? This place has them all. Like every one of them. The sad side of this is that their horrific counter display is like 8 feet in the air and lots fo the knives are behind the counter. But if you are into hunting, which I guess you are if you're at the giant hunting store, you will surely find the knife of your dreams/nightmares is in here somewhere. 

The staff has rightous gruffness with hipsters and not what you might call friendly or speedy, but they get the job done and know where all these weird little things hide around their store.

I'm scaring you off from coming now, right? Sorry...did I mention the bad ass collection of super cheap thick sweatshirts, running pants and fleece?
Also, there is mace, hand warmers, scarfs, a zillion hats and gloves for winter and they regularly let a variety of food trucks pull up in front to sell BBQ and such. 

Bottom Line: Come here first for your industructable thermals, winter and camping wear but be prepared to not be coddled while shopping.  And good luck leaving without managing to convince yourself you really do need a giant knife.

Also, I'm super amused Marcia M reviewed this place at all. I think its high praise that my dog-loving, vegan buddy gave it 3 stars. Lets just say, this is not where I would imagine her hanging!

After speaking with Tammy, she sent out Drew to work on my plumbing problem. Drew was great, he analyzed the problem and gave me an estimate within 5 minutes after meeting him. Drew had a great personality and he seemed as someone I would enjoy having a beer with. Other than having to stop work to go buy a part, he was very efficient and quick. Great customer service from both Tammy and Drew. Very good customer service overall and would definitely use them in the future.

Ralph

While my girlfriend and I don't actually wear boots, we figured that while in the area we might as well try some on - and with the buy 1 get 2 free deal it was kind of hard to end up not buying any. 

However, we had a fun time seeing and trying on a whole bunch of new boots. I didn't realize how difficult it was to take these things off. The staff working there were very nice and helpful, and overall we felt this would be the place to go if we ever did end up needing a pair of nice boots.

I am not really a steak fan (I know, blasphemy!) so I tried their pizza and a salad. I can say, hands down, this place is a winner! Their pizza, which is Greek Style, has a delicious crispy crust, a zesty sauce... and THE CHEESE!!! It was just spot on! The texture and flavor was perfect. Their menu has some creative selections (like different types of grilled cheese sandwiches) that will be sure to entice the epicurean as well as the common foodie. I'm happy to see something different- and delicious- come to Broomall.

We LOVE this place, soo many options and we have yet to have anything we have not enjoyed! Meatloaf, Carribean jerk chicken or wings, creole pasta, pineapple rum chicken, along with such a variety of seafood. 2for 1 drink options ALL the time, margaritas, island punch, sangria, well drinks, (and being from Kentucky one well drink option Four Roses ) This is a MUST STOP every time we are in the area! Soo glad your open!!

Wanted to like it here as we were craving good Mexican food. But the tamales were mush, rice dry and flavorless, and refried beans salty and coated like glue. Positives were nice staff and warm environment but definitely a tourist joint.

I've been going here for many years even when they had a much smaller location on Alt 19. The rolls are so fresh and tasty,  it's tough not to eat several while waiting for your meal, especially the onion rolls. I've had corned beef and cabbage, pastrami, brisket, latkes, knishes, and always enjoy every one. Plenty of meat and usually have a doggy bag. Besides they give a slice of free cheesecake or Apple strudel with every meal. There is a wait list most of the time, so avoid peak times, but the food is worth the wait.

This is the highest rated Walmart in Reno which blows my mind. Nothing personal when it comes to the staff but this Walmart is scary and not very clean. I've been a few times because it's the closet one to my house & every time I've gone a fight has broke out inside or there were cops in the parking lot for one reason or another.

Definitely a must eat in NOLA. The chargrilled oysters are TO DIE FOR! The best in NOLA in my opinion. Go early to beat the line outside. I also had the oyster Rockefeller soup which I cannot recommend. Taste was just okay, but what really turned me off is that it smelled like those powdered chicken soup mixes from Campbell's. I also had the hush puppies. Those were good, but not the best. I like hush puppies with a grainier meal and onions, and these were 'delicate' for lack of a better description. Still good though. But definitely 10 stars + for the chargrilled oysters, can't say enough about them!! Will be back for those!!

I've been here twice before, and both times have been highly successful.
 I've had the duck breast as a meal, from the app menu I believe, and it was scrumptious! 
 This last visit my girlfriend ordered a boba drink that was amazing, that was my first experience with the drink. I love the chewy tapioca balls!
 I ordered the lemongrass chicken bowl, super good although not super filling. Hubby had another chicken dish which sadly didn't have that much flavor, can't remember what it was called though 

Plus the ambiance of the place is cool AND they offer TVs so if you o on a Sunday for lunch you may be able to catch your NFL team playing

Joey B's a go-to spot. Consistently great service with an array of wonderful choices from appetizers to pasta to burgers, sandwiches to italian entrees and pizza. The salads are phenomenal and all of the portions are gigantic! There is something for everyone eyone. Great lunch specials and early bird dinners during the week. Whether it's lunch with coworkers or dining out the family, you will NOT be disappointed.

Meh. Not impressed. I had the pesto chicken with cauliflower mash and spicy roaster broccoli. The pesto chicken was delicious and piping hot. The cauliflower mash tasted like nothing. It was literally just mashed cauliflower that they heated up. No seasoning or flavor. The broccoli tasted like it was cooked in a smoker's mouth. Seriously. It tasted like roasted cigarettes. Healthy food doesn't have to be bland or taste bad. I get the whole low-sodium thing, but there are plenty of ways to season food without salt so that it isn't bland. Your only drink choices here are water, hot tea, bottled water, some kind of bottled juice, and bottled beer. My meal was pricey too. $13 total. If you want healthy food, skip this place and go eat at whole foods.

I love total wine! 

I went with my co-workers for a wine tasting, and it was a blast! They gave you a good size portion of wine to taste, and a wide variety. It was both educational for the rookies, and fun for the pros! I will definitely be bringing friends back here to try it out! 

The staff is always professional and pleasant. Sometimes I order my wine online for pick up, so I spend less (this store is kind of like target for wine lovers, it has things you never knew you needed!) And it's always ready and bagged to go.
Waited half an hour for our food before giving up. To say we were ignored is an understatement - the waitress actually left someone else's dirty dishes on our table while we sat there.

This is a dental office that I enjoy visiting.  Service is always prompt (no long wait times) and friendly (welcoming atmosphere).  Sara and Ruthie upfront are amazing and treat you like another one of the girls in the office family.  Dr. Mike is very thorough and gentle as he executes procedures, and Shi is right there to assist with special care.  Whether it be the procedure it self, or finances, everything is handled with professionalism and smiles.  I will go again and again when necessary.

Sonny's BBQ was one of my first stabs at eating southern food in another location.  So, no matter which Sonny's I try, I always have some type of memory recall of enjoying my first Florida southern pulled pork sandwich and the like.  

Naples does not have a Sonny's BBQ, so we go out of our way to pull off the highway at the Sun City Center/Ruskin exit to quickly run through the drive-thru if we're traveling north or south on 75.  The location is convenient for those who are looking for something to eat quick like us.  Not sure how convenient is for those who live in the area, but it surely works for us.

There's not much to write about a chain bbq place, but I think my three stars have to do with a certain familiarization with that sweet bbq taste and the trustworthiness of what they serve.  It's amazing how many bbq places do not serve corn nuggets or have their pulled pork look and taste as if it had been sitting in bath water for a while.  Although I'm not uberly wowed by Sonny's, but at least I know exactly what I'll get, and that's consistency.  With that said,  I just so happened to order a new item on my way to Tampa just cuz.  It was a Sweet Carolina sandwich.  It had a sweet pulled pork with a sweet sauce and coleslaw on a bun.  It was a nice way to veer off the pulled pork on texas toast, especially when you're in the car and don't want to mess with having to put stuff on your sandwich.

Our drive-thru experience has been spot on from all the times I can remember.  It never takes a lot of time, and they've gotten our order right.  With the amount of times I've opened up a bag a few miles down the road to realize that they've missed something at other drive-thrus, have been way too many. So, my somewhat lowered expectations have been met? (Now I'm singing "Lowered Expectations" from MadTV).  They're also pretty friendly there too.

I can't remember what my dine-in restaurant experience was there, but I can guarantee that it's good as it gets through the drive-thru.  When the magic door opens and you're greeted with the wafting smell of bbq while being handed a monstrous sweet tea, you'll thank me.

I love Brothers Barbecue. Everyone there is always so friendly and helpful.  My daughter loves their pulled pork sandwich but does not care for the bread.  So last time we were in Joe told her she could order it without the bun.  She got so excited.  My favorite dish is the pulled pork potato is hands down the most amazing. But honestly you cannot go wrong with any of the choices.  If you are looking for amazing bbq with an amazing feel. Stop in, grab some ribs or anything, a glass of tea and relax. And even better when it is nice out they have outdoor seating.
Really enjoyed the green chile chicken enchiladas! Would have been a 5 star if I could have gotten a margarita. But still, the food was great and the service incredibly fast.

You HAVE to try this spot! Homemade pasta, delicious cocktails - it's a great date spot or a good group spot, too. The ambiance is fun and laidback but the food is simply amazing. I recommend the pizzas as well as the burrata appetizer. You cannot go wrong with this choice.

So the yelp discount and the proximity to the debaliviere metro station along with a craving for pasta brought me and my girlfriend to this restaurant to give it a try. The place was kind of empty at five o clock, especially for such a large restaurant. We were sat quickly, bread was served, and the order was taken. This place had a lot of pizza options and some pasta. Even though the pasta wasn't the center piece of the menu, it was delicious. Everyone we dealt with was incredibly nice as well. Our server, though a little inexperienced was fantastic and really nice. We felt very welcome and will be back. Be warned though, the portions are huge. One of out pasta portions would have been enough for both of us plus left overs. All in all a good experience just steps from the metro station.

Went for a carriage ride on a Tuesday night date night about 9pm.  The weather was fabulous and we had a great time.  It was very quiet down by the arch and we had a nice relaxing 30 minute ride. It cost us $50.  The price is steep but our driver was friendly and we are glad we did it.  Nice view of the Arch.

A super pretty place.  The staff is super and the location is great if you want to be close to the outdoors.  The only downside is that they have a lot of long-term residents with children.  I don't know why but that kind of creeps me out.

We stayed here to celebrate my sister's birthday. It was my second time staying here. Our room was a lot nicer than the first time we stayed here. Our room was so pretty. When we were gambling, we were never approached if we wanted a drink which was kind of sucky. Also, there was a miscommunication between my sister and I and we actually booked three rooms instead of two. We canceled over the phone and was not given a refund which kind of sucked but I understand since it is hotel policy. However, when we checked in, they told us to have canceled the room at the resort because they could be a little more lenient which made us feel worst since we lost out on our money that we could have used to gamble. All in all, the second time coming was okay. I do feel like it is an older crowd. I think the first time was just so amazing that we were kind of let down the second time.
Maggie was recently our waitress and she was A-MAZ-ING!! She was funny and kept us entertained. Margaritas were great and the nachos were delicious!!! We'll be back!

Terrible, terrible, terrible. This is a downtown location and only one person is working the desk at a time. I had to stand in line for over 30 minutes just to mail one thing. You should be ashamed US Post Office, for your shit quality service and place.

Absolutely the WORST service I ever had.  Literally almost didn't tip, (we still did) because technically you earn your tip right? It wasn't even busy and it took 20 minute to even get a server to our table. Ordered a Bloody Mary that we watched sit and melt in the service bar while our server was standing next to it texting away. Once the food came the server never even did a check back and didn't see her until it was time for the check. As far as the food goes my boyfriend had the burger with bbq pulled pork on it which wasn't bad but The mozzarella sticks we ordered had almost no cheese in them. The Mac n cheese burger was awful. The burger patty wasn't even seasoned, and the Mac n cheese was super dry. I've been in the food industry almost my whole life and bartended/served the last 12 years and there's no excuse for the service received. Oh but wait, she made sure she came right back the second it was time to pay though. It's a shame because I've been following the craftsman Instagram page for a while now and have been dying to go because everything looks amazing in the pictures. Oh well.
This is my favorite place for a foot massage! I'm a regular and they treat me like family. I highly recommend it!

The worst experience I ever had going to a museum. The workers there are so rude to paying customers. There is only one register for the entire museum - just ONE. This means that getting tickets, gift shop payments, everything is done through this one register. Needless to say, there is an extremely slow and long line just to get in because they make it priority to attend to the people wanting to purchase gifts. 

The man who was letting people in slowly (I mean slow like 2 people every 5 minutes) was such a impolite jerk. When my group of 4 got to the front of the line after about 40 wasted minutes, I noticed about 8-10 people leave the museum at different times, so why did they still not let us in?! When we asked he just started yelling at us and saying do you not see we have one register, we need to process purchases. We just left at this point! 

Here's a simple lesson, for any business, customer service should be #1. If you are turning people away because they have leftover restaurant food in containers (hello we are in New Orleans, best food ever), because you can't handle lines of people, and can't manage your business maybe you shouldn't have one, just a thought. Or get another register maybe? For example, at the Mardi Gras museum they noticed we had luggage from the airport and they offered to keep it next to their desk so we can walk around. This simple act meant so much to us and I would recommend that over this any day no matter the content.

I had the Morning Prep Omelette and my Aunt had the All Hail The Omelette (the potatoes were out of this world), my little guy had the Plain Jane pancakes (the pancakes are light, fluffy but with a nice crispy on the edge.  They had super fresh and flavorful berries and the syrup was delicious) and pork sausage.  The only complaint that I have is that the sausage was a little dry but otherwise the food was OUTSTANDING!!!  I am so happy that we tried this place out today, on a whim, and I look forward to taking all of my out of town guests here for breakfast.  Can't wait for our next visit!

Don't get me wrong, the food here is great. Everything is extremely well prepared and flavorful. The waitstaff was accommodating to our mix of palates (2 children and a vegetarian) and offered to adjust the spice level or bring the sauces on the side to ensure no one was overwhelmed with something too spicy.

The only reason it doesn't get 5 stars is that everything was salty beyond what would be considered reasonable, IMO. Sure, this amplified the flavor, but everyone also felt the need to drink a quart of water on the way home to balance out their sodium levels.

The heat levels were about what you'd expect. A "4 dot" dish (which translates to "Hot") is pretty spicy but not nose running, drooling, lips on fire hot. You'll actually be able to taste your food.

I suggested coming here because of the gluten free dinner menu (confirmed with the waitress as well).  Lunch menu has some gluten-containing items FYI.  We shared the short rib nachos and I ordered the taquiza with chipotle shrimp (build your own tacos).  I liked the nachos, but I don't know if it's something I can't wait to eat again. With my entree, it came with I think 5 corn tortillas, but I had only enough food to make 4 substantial tacos. The flavors we're good, but I didn't like that the shrimp had tails still on.  Prying them off the skewers took some finesse to avoid knocking any glasses down.  

I will say the service was insanely fast (and very good in general).  Our reservation was at 6pm on a Saturday and we were mostly through our entire dinner (for 4) but 6:30pm.  I felt like we should have ordered more apps to extend the dinner because it went by so fast!  The entree sizes were on the small side, with most of them being 3 taco, so if you're hungry, plan on getting a couple apps.

Great little spot
Meat perfectly cooked
Tasty toppings 
Eager to try the shawarma and falafel next time.
This location is great for business printing services! Thank you Mary Lee!

This afternoon a friend and I came here for Happy Hour (4-6 Mon-Fri).  Unfortunately it is a bit chilly and windy in Reno today, so we were unable to sit outside, which overlooks the Truckee River.  However, we sat inside, where the motif is very modern and classy.  The Happy Hour menu is top notch for a restaurant that is a bit pricier than many restaurants in town.  

There is a $3.00 and $5.00 menu.  I had a mojito from the $5.00 menu and my friend had a dirty martini for $3.00.  We split the pear bruchetta for $5.00.  There are appetizers on both the $3.00 and $5.00 menu.  The presentation was very well done, and the taste was superb.  It was the perfect size for two people.  Additionally, our waitress was very friendly stopping at our table serveral times to see if we needed anything.
Best donuts in the area. Great service they are always friendly. I would highly recommend them.
The best tortilla soup in all Arizona ! Great friendly service. One of the waitresses gave my daughter a tour of the kitchen. Love this place

It felt like a public clinic. The fish are nice, but then I was ushered into a room to await the doctor. ... I waited for an hour and fifteen minutes before the doctor came in.  I thought maybe they forgot my room existed! When your not feeling well the last thing you want to do is sit in an uncomfortable room with a loud tv on. Finally the doctor came and apologized for being confused about something.  Great my doctor is confused!  I'll find a different doctor next time.

I've only been for breakfast,but I think that's all they serve(?)
Food was great,eggs cooked perfectly.
Owners,servers were super nice & helpful.
Will definitely return.

We were in need of a Pizza, Pauls is no longer an option, I think he may have sold it, our last Pizza from there was less than ok. Amore pizza was good, we intended to eat there, but really not a place to eat inside. We changed our mind when we got there and ordered it  to go. It was a thin crust pizza, B,P and Onion. I'd love to Oder a pizza from any place in the Clearwater area where they put amp condiments on your Pizza, without having to pay extra.  Overall the Pizza was good, we would order again from them.

Got there for our appointment.  We were told that she was running a couple minutes behind but she would have her assistant do my husband pedicure and she would do mine as soon as she was done with the nails she was working on.  Heard her talking to someone in the back explaining what she needed to do.  Out comes her 13-14 year old daughter who proceeded to give my husband what was supposed to be a pedicure.  She in no way tried to hurry with the other customer.  I finally got out of the salon two hours later. While doing my toes we had a long conversation about how they don't charge extra for gel polish. I don't think I would have been mad, but when I was checking out she said she was giving us $25.00 discount and then charged me  $50.00. I was a little taken back and asked how much the pedicure was and she said  a gel pedicure was $50.00 Won't be going there again.
