I can't say enough good things about this place.  We eat here once every week or two.  Their sandwiches are huge and priced fair for the quality of the meats you get.  We've had the cheese steak, meatball, roast beef and, of course, the roast pork.  I'm not a broccoli rabe fan so I usually order my pork and beef sandwiches loaded with the extra sharp provolone cheese and roasted red peppers...so yummy!  BONUS:  The complimentary dried long hots at the counter in the dining area are AMAZING!  Definitely try them on your sandwich to spice things up!  
This is place is a wonderful little order and take out joint with a South Philly flair.  It is NOT a 5 star restaurant, and that is ok.  The gals behind the counter are not going to kiss your butt and play sweet.  They are going to take your order and bring you your food, that is it.  If you need to be coddled and sucked up to, this place is not for you.  But I will say that if you go in there enough to become a regular, you will find that the girls here are really nice, down to earth ladies who will crack a joke or make small talk when you come in.  
Oh, and if you have a gluten allergy, this is also not the place for you.  Even if you try and insist they make your sandwich without the (delicious) roll, they will have the decency to let you know that starch (which contains gluten and is in pretty much EVERY gravy) is an ingredient in their gravy.  So bread or no bread, it's still a gluten hazard.  If you have a food allergy, use common sense or go up the road...don't Yelp bash them.
Bought a coupon from Groupon and Luis showed up on time and did a fine job cleaning the vents. He left a holiday coupon for a deep cleaning for a later date. Would recommend this company.
Great med food.  I would pass on the gyro, kinda dry.  Everything else is fair game.  Dolmas, hummus, salad, baklava = yum.

Tribe is my favorite bar in Nashville. The combination of the food, location, crowd, and price can't be beat. Lots of good reviews here already, but I'll add that they have two pool tables and you can usually get a game within 10 to 20 minutes.

This was an awesome breakfast spot with great coffee. Definitely should make a stop here for breakfast. Their berries and French toast was so good and fluffy and we also got their puffed pancakes were amazing and you'll probably only need the small because they were so filling! They are seriously melt in your mouth good and don't get me started on the potatoes. Stop here it's a must.

The waiter was so rude it just ruined our entire experience. As three girls from NYC, we have a pretty high tolerance for rude but having just stepped off the plane, hungry and tired, we were hoping to be welcomed with a little southern hospitality. 

My one friend forgot her ID. After I and my friend showed our IDs, my friend, desperate for a beer, asked if she could show him a photo of her passport. He said no and I told him she was 25. He still refused (which is fine, I respect that), but what really pissed me off was he patronizingly said "yep, it's the law in the United States. You have to be 21 to drink." Thanks, asshole. I had no clue. 

He nickel and dimed us for everything. We ordered water and he came back with BOTTLED -- what?! My friend ordered a burger and he charged her for fries (who serves a burger with chips) and asked her what kind of cheese she wanted -- charged for that too. 

My friend and I split BBQ wings and a veggie burger. Both mediocre. 

Total tourist trap, rude rude waiter and mediocre food. Bye.

My husband had delicious BBQ oysters. I don't usually like oysters but thought they were great. The entrees were both very good and the side of potato salad was tasty. The only disappointment was the signature bread pudding. I love bread pudding, but this was average at best. The dark chocolate poured over the top was bitter and does nothing to add flavor.
I got a full set a week ago. The whole nail including tips cane right off while I was working.. will never go there again...

Had an amazing stay over Memorial Day weekend recently. The service was top of the line and I enjoyed the classic decor and ambiance. The Carousel Bar is a must do but be ready to wait your turn for a seat. The Criollo restaurant has some awesome food but make sure you make a reservation. Even for breakfast. Spa Aria will rejuvenate your life after a long few days walking around the French Quarter. Finally, the Aqua Bella Bar and rooftop pool was a lot of fun. Thank you for all the memories and can't wait to come back to my new favorite city!

The food is average- I ordered roast pork with vegetables/ portion size average. I have only one important comment- the waitresses are abrupt and not overly friendly. They ask you your order businesslike and don't look at you or smile . They want to get you in and out. Quickly. As a result you don't wait long for your food but the minute your fork is down they are clearing it away .
Wonderful food!! Large salad bar great deals in meals. Lots of selections to choose from. 2 locations in saint Louis. Clean atmosphere friendly staff and pretty fast and well priced

I mean honestly, I don't know if something has changed in the past few months, but we've had a great experience here. All maintenance issues have been solved in a timely manner, the staff has been really kind about everything, even pets, and we just got the place sprayed for spiders for extra safety, and they got it done super fast. No bug issue currently as a far as I know. Also, the location is phenomenal. I feel bad that this place has a negative reputation because things are pretty good so far for myself and my 4 roommates. We haven't had any of the same issues mentioned in negative reviews. Maybe creaking ceilings from people walking upstairs and the showerheads could be updated a little (because the water pressure is super strong and it blows our shower curtains around a bit if it's turned up all the way), but that's really the worst thing. Otherwise, we've had a pleasant experience.

Amazing vegetarian food variety that never disappoints! My favorite is the phenomenally delicious Kale salad and  the Zora Neale Hurston buffalo chicken sandwich. Oh my and the desserts are Awesome! The decor is vibrant, inspirational and beautiful. Seating is family style, with a few singletons. It reminds me of grand meals at grandma's house- one massively large table (adults only) and a few kid tables sprinkled throughout. I love this place and I guarantee you will to. It serves as a testament of what StL could be.

stopped by this week and for garlic chicken, low mein, and pot stickers.  
it was all very good.  we'll be back.

Love how many healthy options they offer and how many of their items are gluten free. The sweet potato fries are really good, legit best thing they have. The açaí bowls are kind of tiny but no places around have them on their menu so y'all might want two.
Plenty of other Mexican restaurants that are cleaner with better food.  This place has gone down hill fast.

I had to cancel my appointment due to an emergency. They charge $65 to reschedule if you don't cancel 2 days in advance. They think they're some sort of hair gods and that people will pay any price just to grace their presence again after committing the deadly sin of cancellation. Maybe in an alternate universe, but in this one they're just a bunch of greedy clowns with overinflated egos. Pass.
After my previous post, I received a very nice call from the company and I think this matter may be resolved. I very much appreciate that they addressed my concerns. Thanks much to Renee.
Amazing food, amazing staff! Would recommend trying this place out, you won't regret.

This is as good as it gets when it comes to neighborhood restaurants.  Been going to Lola's for years and absolutely love it.  I love it for a date spot.  It is tiny and very cool with the kitchen tucked away in the only room of the restaurant.  Front of the house and back of the house all mixed into one happy family.  That being said, I went there last night with a party of 7 and they handled it just fun and the food is incredible and very erasable.  We went to canseco's, grocery across the street and bought 3 bottles of wine.  corkage fee of $5 i think. and had 1 large fideua with a bunch of apps AND everyone got an entree and bill was $30 each.  fantastic night!  

If i was ordering for you: Start with antipasto(great mix of meat and cheese) then move on tp the almond soup (sounds crazy but trust me) then you have to order the calderetta.  The calderetta might be my favorite dish in the city!  Everything I've gotten there is great, so you are not going to miss but these are my favorite
Amazing Korean food beat food in greenwood varieties are so generous. I'm thankful my sister for bringing me here to experience this wonderful place

This is an update review of Day Spa by Zsuzsanna because dear Mae has passed away so I now go to Gloria for my facials.  She is wonderful.  The spa has been refurbished with a store downstairs and a modern upstairs just for privacy and services.  It's a luxurious experience to be in Gloria's care.  Staff Cindy and Deborah are welcoming and lovely. 

Ladies, do it for yourself, you'll feel and look like a princess. Treat your favorite guy or gal and they will love you for it.

My first time in St. Louis and walking down the street it was super easy to find this deliciously delightful place. I followed my NOSE the aroma filled the street the way good BBQ should. The staff were all courteous and attentive to customer needs and experiences.

If you are in the are make this a priority stop!

Flavorful Korean barbecue bowls on the Delmar loop. (Side street).  You have a choice between bulgogi beef, pork, tofu, or chicken. You can also combine. Everything's under nine dollars. They also have fresh kimchi and several appetizers. It's very small with a fast food format. One thing that was kind of odd is that they serve hot water, but they have no teabags. OK. That was strange. Otherwise delicious fast food.

Every time I'm in the area, I go to Makiman. Compared to other sushi places in the area, I find them to be one of the best. My favorite is Pete's roll. 

Although the service is not great, especially because the place is usually empty. But if you're just coming in to eat then it's not a deal breaker. 

They also have a lot of different rolls to choose from and the  decor is really nice and modern. 

If you have room for dessert then get the fried ice cream.

Overall, the experience at Revery was positive and I will probably visit again even though  I am never in greenwood. The entrees that the wife and I had, scallops and short ribs, both tasted great. I'd recommend the short rib vs. scallop just bc the portion size of the scallop was disappointing. You get 3 scallops, without much garnish. The salads were good. Apps were above average. Service was alright, each server looked young/inexperienced, but I'm pretty low maintenance  as a customer so for me service was fine. One curious thing is the beer selection. 4 taps, with 3 respectable local brews and PBR. Why waste a tap on PBR? It's not good. Is it cool? Just seems like a waste to me. I like the menu at Revery and would like to try some different items, maybe order another appetizer next time to make up for the smallish portions.

I've gone to Lucky's about five times over this last year and I have not only never been disappointed, but my expectations have been exceeded. I have tried the bacon cheddar burger, the Gorgonzilla burger, the bacon egg and cheese burger, tots, fries and the veggie burger. Every single thing I have tried has been absolutely delicious, and I am always satisfied. I always come back to the gorgonzilla burger.  With bacon, onions, mushrooms and Gorgonzola cheese, it's extremely difficult to go wrong.  

The service is always great- you feel like you belong there.  The bartenders are happy to recommend beers and drinks that would be good for you based on your taste. 

If you're looking for a great burger and delicious beers or cocktails, you can't go wrong here.

I do not recommend this hotel to anyone. Be careful they will change your dates and refuse to give a refund or give you a room. They tell you they don't have rooms with that rate any more for the night. Just *bs. If they did this to me imagine what they will do to you. Words of warning. Avoid at all cost. This is a new hotel. It used to be a Sheraton. I wonder what they are running from?  Poor service!
Delicious, quick, beyond excellent customer service. Fun and friendly atmosphere. All ingredients are fresh and amazing. Recommend this this restaurant to anyone.

Bobby's a great cool burger spot for the burger lover and two people can eat a personal burger and share a cup of fries for just $20 bucks. That's a bargain for great tasting burgers, made fresh to order with 100% Angus beef. 

Bobby's Burger Palace is similar to Smash Burger in that you walk in, order, get a number and sit down and wait for your food. 
The only difference here is that you don't get your own table. You sit at a bar top, shaped like an s-curve with other people if it's crowded. 

I had the Dallas ($7.95) - served spiced crusted, with Monterey Jack cheese, pickles and barbecue sauce. The burger was perfect, came well done like I asked and was juicy and very flavorful. 

My wife had the Bobby Blue ($8.50) - served with blue cheese, bacon, lettuce and tomato. I'm not a fan of blue cheese, but the burger was good and the blue cheese didn't overwhelm. 

We also got a side of Sweet Potato Fries ($3.50) served with a honey mustard horseradish sauce. The sauce was very good. The fries were lightly seasoned with salt, crisp but still soft. 

All in all a great burger stop. You can tell they put their heart into the food. It's really fresh and full of flavor. The only thing that I could be put off by is the inability to sit alone if I like, but it wasn't very crowded so not a real issue and it does foster a little socialization which we lack these days. I'll be back because it's 5 minutes from the house and right on the complex with the mall. 

Oh and a great selling point for me is the complimentary pickle that comes with each burger. Not a big deal until you bite into it and realize it's a garlic pickle. I friggin love garlic pickles!!! AHHHHAAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA YES!!!!

Situated right outside of suburban square, this is our go to breakfast spot and we LOVE it. This review is for our most recent visit. There was something going on in Ardmore the other day and it was way more crowded than usual. We had to wait to get a table, but were seated within 15 minutes. They have all these crazy different french toast and pancake flavors. I got the french toast sampler, where you get to try 3 different types of french toast. I tried the smores, strawberry stuffed, and the pumpkin french toast. The smores was great and not too much for breakfast. The pumpkin which I have gotten before was also very good. I was not a fan of the strawberry stuffed french toast because it was a bit too heavy on the cream cheese for me. May have just been my personal preference. My boyfriend got the reese's pancakes, which I thought would be gross but I tried it and it was amazing. Despite being crowded, we still got the same great service as usual. Waitresses are always very friendly and the service is quick. Definitely go here for breakfast if you live in the area, best place I have found.

I used to live in Kirkwood and this was one of my favorite spots to squeeze- and I do mean squeeze- into. It doesn't have a lot of space, but it's worth elbowing other eaters out of the way. The fish sandwiches are crispy and the rootbeer in the chilled mugs is classic. Greasy spoon, here I come!
We love going for Korean BBQ when we are in LA, so we were excited to see a place open locally! Korea BBQ & Sushi did not disappoint! Very kind staff and, most importantly, incredible food!

I visited Habanero Bistro with my fiancé around lunch time today. He loves their tacos and I hadn't eaten there yet, therefore we decided on the Bistro. I ordered the traditional Mexican pork tamale and a fried cod fish taco, my fiancé ordered two Carne Asada tacos and we shared a pork and cheese pupusa. Wanting something different to drink, we opted for the Sangria sodas in glass bottles. 
 Let's start with the tacos, because they were the best thing we ate. The fish taco had a mango salsa and his Carne Asada tacos had a very yummy sauce on them! The pupusa was fluffy and cheesey with a yummy salsa and cabbage slaw. The tamale, at least the one I got, was terrible! It was old and hard, with one corner so hard it was inedible. I love tamales and this left soo much to be desired, however I am sure they would have been amazing....fresh...
 The soda was delicious and a salsa bar offered mild green salsa which was very yummy, a medium, tangy salsa which tastes almost sweet and spicy, and then their hottest salsa which was smoky and tasty! Pickled carrots, onions and Jalapenos finished off the salsa bar and honestly also left a little to desire. Most salsa bars offer radishes and limes too, this one does not.
 Over all I would say a relative 3 stars because of the Tamale, but everything else was very good.

We ate here Saturday 1/10. Place was packed because of some big party going on.  The wait was I hour for our party of 4. Once seated it took another 2 hours to get our meal. Normally I would be pissed but...
The server and the manager went so far out of their way take care of us.  The place is very cool, the food looked amazing and given different circumstances, it would have made our top 5 list. Check out the beer cellar in the loft!!

These people are THIEVES! While vacationing in New Orleans I bought a piece of art for $150. They claimed they were able to ship it to my home in Tennessee and that I should have it within 2 weeks. It's been 6 weeks and I have not received my picture nor have they returned my phone calls or e-mails. This seems to be a trend since it happened to one other person that posted a review as well.

This was my first experience at David's Bridal and i can't say i was overly impressed. We went on a Saturday so first and foremost it was crazy busy which made for a less than memorable experience. But that wasn't even the most disappointing part. I dont know if they over book, or under staff, but our consultant was just as much about helping us as she was about helping another party which was incredibly irritating. When you make an appointment months before, you kind of expect to have someone helping you the entire time, not having to chase them down every 10 minutes. I get you're busy on a weekend, but either don't over book, or just don't help walk-ins. Plain and simple. Not only was our consultant playing the disappearing act constantly, she really could not have been less helpful. She brought dresses out, and helped get them on but that was literally it. She offered no advice, no opinions, wasn't engaging at all. Just basically wanted to get us in and out it felt like. This was our first time dress shopping for my friend, so we were really looking forward to this being an amazing experience. It wasn't. The manager came over a couple times and she was awesome, she was super engaging and helpful. If we had known about her, and could have booked an appointment with a specific consultant, it would have been her hands down. She did bring out a couple questionable dresses that weren't at all what we were looking for, which didn't make a lot of sense to us, but maybe she was just trying to show us all the different options. Either way, the experience over all was vastly disappointing. If you're a bride on a budget this is the place to go, they do have a decent selection of dresses, mostly for quite cheap, but the customer service just isn't good at all. After a 1.5 hour appointment we left no better off than we came in really.
As for the store itself, its pretty small and cramped. At least in the changing area. You're almost shoulder to shoulder with the other brides, which makes it a little difficult to try things on and really get the experience. I really had higher hopes for David's Bridal and we probably won't be back unfortunately.

We dined last night with our extended family of 20 and had a great time. (This was our second time) The server and food runners were all friendly and efficient. (5 stars)The server told us his favorites and we agreed. Because we were a big group, we were able to try a lot of menu options. 
I personally tried the crab Rangoon (small, but good), the dancing crab roll (good), the sexy lady roll (ok), the shrimp and steak hibachi (mediocre), sashimi (tuna- ok, salmon and whitefish-good) and the green tea ice cream (very good). 
This restaurant is basically an AYCE sit-down restaurant. Items come out when ready, so some at our table were waiting a lot longer than others for their food. The quality is fair. I think I'd rather go to a sushi restaurant that's specialty is sushi or a hibachi style restaurant that specializes in hibachi, as I do feel those are better. However, for the price,  you will definitely leave full. I would go back if the family wants to because it is easy to please a group here.

My friend and I came on a Thursday night...the place was empty, but sadly, the bar(not very big) was full so we got a table. The service was fine. The menu was very limited so I got a carrot salad...it was ok but literally just different carrots- not exactly exciting. We both agreed that we won't be running back. Not sure why this place keeps winning awards!?
Had a great smoked cobia salad with a raspberry vinaigrette, delicious will go back again.

Food isn't great but when it's all you got it is great. They take vouchers family can purchase or the hospital can sometimes give you, which helps. The grill is my favorite, but if I wasn't in the hospital I wouldn't come searching for it. It's okay and they sell things that are packaged too in case you don't want any of the fresh food. They close at 7:30pm sharp. I've been going to Wawa or the food trucks outside lately. Sometimes I even just live off of goldfish, and we have a bunch of vouchers. Maybe I'll use some later.
Now this is what crepes are suppose to taste like!!! Always fresh!!  Love the owners, always so nice and friendly.  Love talking with them.  A most try!!!!

Great experience!! Gerald is awesome! We were greeted immediately and promptly put on the wait list. They brought us drinks and the wait time was not bad. Our waitress was quick and friendly and the food was perfect! We will be back.

So I went in on a Saturday which is one of their busier days. To order a cake. The assistant John (I think) took a lot of time taking down notes and even sketching an image of what I wanted. Confirmed with Michelle Kitchen via email with these images that this is what I wanted.

  Received the cake and I'm very disappointed. But first on a good note the cake was great. I ordered chocolate cake with vanilla buttercream and it was amazing.
So 1) the Momma Bear on the front of the cake was suppose to be a cut out from the tree and placed on top. Not a silhouette on the tree. 
2) the Momma hand writing looks childish
3) the leaves are green and the picture I gave her and requested are orange and fall themed. 

I paid $102 for this 8inch custom cake for my mom and although the art work is amazing. They DONT LISTEN. And its disappointing when the baker doesn't send u a final sketch for me to confirm 1 last final time before she makes the whole custom cake. 
    I won't go back because first time ordering a custom cake and very bad impression and service left on me as a customer.

so I always stay here when I come to Reno. Never had a problem.   this time I left a pair of jeans and a cool ass dickies shirt in the closet. emailed,  called. nothing. 
finally talked to someone 5 days after I checked out. and go figure, the house keeper for that day has no idea what I'm talking about. 
not sure if I want to stay there anymore.

Great place, super friendly staff. Would recommend. The apps are amazing! I've gone there many times over the years since I was a kid. 
Love it.

Too hot. Lack of service and attention. Had to seat and get everything myself. Food mediocre(got pho and the spring roles). Pho was okay but nothing outstanding and the portion not very large. The shrimp was also very low quality with little to no taste to them. Spring rolls needed a lot of sauce for me to be able to eat all of it. Shrimp was minimal. I expected full shorts but only got thin, extremely thin, slices in the rolls. Also bought the sandwiches to go and once again disappointed. It was smaller and less filled then sandwiches from other locations that I've brought from for the same price. Place also does not appear very clean. One this i did enjoy was the coffee. If there's anythings I recommend getting from there, it's the coffee. However I have to say it did not meet my expectation and i can't say I understand what the hype is about.

Autograph Brasserie was absolutely amazing!! I went there for my birthday lunch and it was everything that I expected and more! The interior and aesthetic of the restaurant was stunning. The food was amazing as well. I ordered the open crab face melt and it was so good!! It was probably one of the best crab dishes I've ever had. I had the creme brûlée and signature sundae as dessert and they were both very good, especially the signature sundae. The creme brûlée was a bit too flambé-d for my preference and the top layer of crust was starting to separate itself from the pudding. However, the sundae was the best sundae I've ever had! It was in a cute jar and a good portion for two. I highly recommend Autograph Brasserie! I would definitely come here again!

Went to dinner there based on yelp reviews. 
The food was ok, I had pot roast.  Very
Good my husband had sirloin steak that was just average.  The deviled eggs were very good.  Service was really good.  
However we sat in bar to listen to music and room is too small for live music.  Couldn't hear yourself think.  Also very warm, had to get out my fan.  So it was just ok.

EverybodyFights is absolutely epic. I have been trialing a bunch of gyms in the area including Title and CKO. Neither of them come close. EverybodyFights sets the standard for gym equipment, facilities, and classes. I absolutely love it!

The whole place is painted black and has a luxurious feel to it. The weights are very high quality. They don't have tons of machines but they have all the right ones including bench presses, squat racks, stair masters, other compound exercise focused machines.

The classes are an excellent workout. My first class was on Valentine's Day. I had it with a trainer Adrienne. She kicked my ass. It was so awesome. There were a lot of people in the class but she and another trainer did a good job keeping us all in the zone and working hard. We were split into groups of five and alternated between ten different workout stations. For the championship round, we paired off with a partner and they played romantic music. It was kind of funny because my partner was married and I have a girlfriend that I love. I appreciated the effort for all of the single guys in the gym. All fifty of us worked really hard and had a great workout doing things I had never done before.

The locker room is also pretty nice. They are building a sauna. The lockers have locks on them that you can make your own combination for. They provide razors, towels, shampoo, body wash, conditioner, and of course showers. Gloves and wraps are on sale for not too much money. I wish they sold some snacks though!

Only complaints are that their microphone system sometimes fails them and the sauna said it would be complete by the 15th on a sign. I was there a few days after that and it still isn't done. Besides that, this gym is really all I could ask for in a center city boxing gym. I will definitely be back, and maybe sign up for a membership once they offer a great promotion

Update: the mic problem is fixed. Still waiting on the sauna

Update two: the sauna is working! This is now the best gym out there

Have visited here several times since our first visit, and just love this place.  We went for dinner last year, made friends with the waitress, and have even been down to Philly to see her !  Its like dating a woman with your family !!  : )  She's great, and so is the food when we go.

Seriously impressed with this breakfast spot, it immediately became my favorite spot in Reno. The Steak Beni.. Get it on the veggie fritters and thank me later. Oh and the sweet potato home fries are a MUST. So good! They also get hooked up by a local roaster for an exclusive blend, best cup of coffee around.
Got a tray of chicken parm for Christmas. Large serving, reasonably priced and it was a huge hit. We will definitely be using them for future parties.
Chad was awesome!! Knew exactly how to translate my wave idea. Great attitude and demeanor. Highly recommend!! Clean and up-beat shop

Such a cool place to grab some dinner! 
Recently went there for a Yelp meet up and was pleasantly surprised at how nice and delicious all the food was! AND it was during a parade so we got a nice view while finishing desert and our drinks. 

Our server (Nick, I believe) was very nice and helpful while we were decided what to get. We weren't quite sure what appetizer to get when he arrived at the table and was very patient with us. 
We decided on the nachos, you must always get the nachos!! A HUGE bowl full of chips, jalapeños, salsa, and queso dip was placed in front of us and believe me when I say my boyfriend would have licked the bowl clean had we not been in public. He couldn't get over how delicious the queso was! 
I ordered the Tasmanian Shrimp bowl and even that was huge! (Everything was a large meal, honestly). It was 10/10 delicious on my scale. I was surprised there were only four shrimp at first but then once I got done to the last one, it was a battle to find room to finish. Not sure of the spices but it had a nice kick to it! 
We finished our drinks and watched the parade a bit before deciding to get the open face ice cream Sammy. 
A homemade chocolate chip cookie (huge) topped with vanilla ice cream and chocolate drizzle. Perfect sharing size! 
Our server told us that on Tuesdays they have a taco night and on weekends they have brunch. 

I cannot wait to come back and try the other items on the menu. Although, it will be hard to try something new when I know how amazing those meals are.

I just want to say, we could not even step into your restaurant because you, for some reason, keep skipping us and not even trying setting us up with the table when we know we got there way before some people that you have already found the table for your other customers. So when we got there, girl with the tablet told us it would be 30 to 40 minutes until the table is available. We walked around and came back. When we came back, man who had a cell phone said 10 to 15 minutes. Then we waited at near the door. Still waited while people who were there after us got to sit. 

We asked if our table is ready, he said another 10 to 15 minutes. We just left. And after another 1 hour and 30 minutes later, we received the text stating our table is ready. 

Total waiting time: 2 hours and 30 minutes.

I dont care how your food is good. You literally didn't let us sit for some reason. Glad you have customers. But no thanks.
Excellent breakfast...excellent lunch.... excellent dinner. These folks know how to run an eatery unlike that shithole Jimmy J's down the street from them. Excellent waitstaff, too.

Conveniently located near Hilton Garden Inn Hotel and its within walking distance of the restaurant. It has an old school diner feel that serves up Americana home-style dishes. Bob Evans is a chain restaurant similar to most other brand chain restaurants across the region. 

Our waitress was courteous and friendly, the service was attentive and prices were reasonable. Decor is a bit dated, maybe if lighting were dimmed it would disguise the flaws. Nevertheless, the dining experience matched the quality of the food.

I have been to C'est Cheese a total of four times, and every time the service was outstanding.  I don't recall who helped me the first time I went in, but there was nothing bad that stuck out in my mind.  The other times I've had the privilege to be helped by one of the owners.  

My most recent visit to C'est Cheese was a week ago, on a Friday afternoon.  There were four people working, and I had one of the owners help me out.  I like that she remembered me, and she was patient to allow me to sample many cheeses.  She was also a big help in picking a good variety of cheeses as well as a salami.

The cheeses at C'est Cheese are the right temperature and flavor.

Regardless of how busy the store is, someone will greet you with a smile.  I also like how C'est Cheese doesn't portray itself a some pretentious business.  

If I get married some day, I'll have C'est Cheese cater my wedding, and then I'll write another review.  =)

Bob's bicycle tour was fantastic! 

I have never been to New Orleans and I am so pleased that I chose the Big Easy Bike Tour. 

Bob is extremely knowledgeable of the history of the architecture, cemetery, museums, places to for music, food, etc. It was very educational while covering more ground than a standard walking tour. 

I highly recommend this tour! 

Thanks Bob! It was great. 

Sherry Rock

Tried this within the last month. The food was delicious. We ordered a burger and the mango turkey salad. The salad meat portion was huge; enough to feed 4 in my opinion! The burger was juicy and delicious; however, we ordered it medium rare and there was not even a hint of pink in the burger. We usually order burgers medium rare at places because we prefer them medium, and restaurants are almost always overcooked. The burger was still thick and juicy and tasted like it was cooked to medium, but there should have been some pink. Right? We would go back.
The inside was very loud and was a little small. The tables in the regular dining section were on top of each other. You couldn't get out of you chair without bumping in to the table behind or next to you; we are not overweight people.
Nice spot, nice staff.
We had a fabulous time!! Loved the ambiance, and the hosts were wonderful! The rooms was very clean, and included all of the amenities we needed. We will definitely be staying here again!

Spur of the moment breakfast decision that we regretted. Should have known when we saw the ad for Cinco de Mayo Mexican lasagna on our way in. I'm pretty sure I ate undercooked pork sausage. My husband called his omelette the worst of his life. We will not go back.

Scotty's has some hits and misses, but the things that are good are REALLY good, like the dill chips and seven tidal dip and burgers. The menu is massive, which is sometimes good and sometimes bad. I usually prefer a very small menu, but for a sports bar type place, it's good to have something for everyone. The service is typically good and we enjoy sitting outside on the patio during nice weather. The specials are typically pretty good, especially the cheap pitchers and half price apps later at night. 

The only problems I ever really have with Scotty's is 1) the loud as hell music that is constantly blaring and 2) some dishes are rather bland. Turn down the damn music and turn up the seasoning.

They also have Sunlight Cream Ale on tap which makes me happy.

Dalessandro's steaks are the best in the northwest!  Always fresh, hot and delicious!  I have tried to figure out what makes them taste so much better than the other guy's. It doesn't matter. Dalessandro's Steaks are the best!!

I absolutely adore Sachiko Sushi. 

One night about a year and a half ago or so I had a craving for sushi but didn't want to go too far into town for a place to eat. I found Sachiko on yelp and decided to give them a try. 

The service is amazing and I really enjoy the atmosphere. Anytime I have a craving for sushi or want to go somewhere to meet with friends or family I recommend this restaurant. 

I'm so happy that the cucumber salad is like the one I grew up on at RA. The sushi has always been so tasty and so many options as well! 
I will continue to visit this place and have so far enjoyed all of my visits whether it's by myself or with people.

Good food cooked as you asked for it and good service--but I probably won't be back.  The noise is so bad you can't carry on a conversation without screaming.  Every few minutes they start up again with ringing bells, clapping hands, and yelling.  Between these assaults on your ears, everyone is talking loudly.  If you decide to try it, wear ear plugs and sit as far as possible from the bar.
So disappointed.  Mac and cheese was smaller than a lunchable.  Burger was over cooked.  Use to be a great place. Never ever eating there again. Too many better places to spend our money on dinner

I love the feel of the place and how cute it was. I also love their menu options. I tried the tortuga bowl plus bee pollen. My total was $12. I do think that for the such a small portion that they should bring their prices down a little bit. The bee pollen add on alone was almost $2. The bowl itself was tasty tho :)
Fantastic food, and a fantastic atmosphere despite the very cozy space. Yes, certain menu items might be a little on the pricey side, but it's absolutely worth it!

Awesome, homemade Italian. Came in last minute and was able to get a table quickly with no reservation. This place is BYOB so definitely bring wine to add to your meal. Our special appetizer of sautéed kale, white beans with garlic and white wine was scrumptious and I wanted to lick the plate clean. My branzino with crab meat was perfect. Loved this combo of seafood on seafood. I was so happy with my meal. Mmmmmm. A great choice in South Philly for Italian. 

Note: they don't take Amex.

Disclaimer. The food is mainly from Andhra in South India. So be prepared to sample some spicy food.
It is a fairly new establishment(6 months). The owner was very affable and the food is very genuine. A good way to initiate yourself into Southern food.

I love love love this place! My only complaint is that they charge for shellac removal when you are having a reapplication. Most places I've gone for shellac or gel don't charge to remove as long as it was applied there in the first place and you're having another application. It makes the process pretty pricey to keep up with. The coffee and the staff keep me coming back though.
Went for jazz brunch. We only heard about 5 mins of live music though, so that was a bit disappointing. Food was expensive but excellent quality.

I'm so happy to have a Ramen restaurant in Tampa after leaving Japan in April 2015! Not just a Ramen restaurant, but a good one at that! Had their fried chicken (karaage), pickles (tsukemono) and their specialty ramen (champon). Everything came out great, although maybe a little expensive but I can excuse that as this would not be an every day type of meal. My only criticism was maybe the noodles could have been cooked just a little longer, but for me it was a minor thing. I'll definitely be coming back!

Just left this Kroger and revived very poor customer service as family was trying to do the scan as you go service and a lady was very rude to my family and I instead of trying to help us she was horribly rude. Then turned around and was nice to the next customer she helped I am in the hospitality industry and was appalled with the service received.
Sup consistently has amazing sandwiches, salads, and, of course, soup.  I've been going for years and am pleased everytime I show up that the quality is still there.  Highly recommend!
We were very pleased with the rolls. However, the fried rice was very bland and the salmon was disappointing. We didn't realize that they fried the salmon. Salmon is a fish that shouldn't be fried.

This was my first time at the Tap Room ... never quite noticed it before.  Anyway, it's a small area at the front of the store, small but adequate lunch menu.  I didn't want to have a beer or wine, so I went out into the store and picked up a lemonade and they just rang it up with my lunch order which I chose to sit at the bar to eat.  There are some counters and tables if you prefer.

Chose to have a Rueben ... OMG it was one of the best I ever had.  Came with way too many fries.  Almost finished the sandwich.  

I understand they have a Happy Hour .. great place to stop and have a snack before doing the rest of your shopping.

Would definitely go again.

Wow - what a fantastic find! The service was incredible - the waiter and manager were welcoming and kind. Probably the best service I've experience in Philly.  
My favorite dish was the aka nom nom ramen. The portion was hearty and the pork was delicious!
i love catches! I enjoy their crab legs and i love their bisque! the shrimp they bring out is so fresh And delicious! its my favorite place to eat in PR!
Really, really helpful staff. Very clean, great food and prices. Dogs, brats, italian beef... all very good. We'll be back!

Must have been an off night because although the host staff were nice...they seemed impersonal. Our waiter admitted he started working there exactly 3 hours so he could not give us a recommendation on drinks (which I can appreciate) but then we waited 30 minutes for our meal. At some point, sarcasm sinks in and you want to ask, "Did you have to go fishing for our meal?" 

Had the Mr. Miyagi (big girl drink) which was more juice than alcohol. But like I said, must've been an off night because I hear differently from others. Overall, a drink I would not mind getting again if I had more people to share it with.

Like the atmosphere...nice place to have a meal and talk then take a nice walk down the road to Mandarin for more drinking...your preference.

We had some sashimi...which was pretty chunky in size. I am used to Sashimi being thinly sliced...easy to consume. It tasted pretty decent. Had the Wonder woman, which I liked a lot. Definitely recommend that one for anyone who likes cucumber and tuna (raw).

Love our local hidden gem!!!! We always find the staff here very friendly and are always offering up recommendations on what to order. Truth be told we always request Phil's table, he always takes good care of us. 
There is something for everyone to enjoy here!!!! Food and atmosphere is absolutely amazing.
Kevin the manager always comes by all the tables to engage with the customers. 
If you ever find yourself in Nolensville, definitely a place you have to try!!!!

Overpriced and underpoured drinks.  $15 for a martini at the bar?  This is not a hotel bar and it is not a high end night club - it is Roy's.  Even Eddie V's does not charge that much.  Bad enough they overcharge, bartender pours short.
Food was ok, a little salty as others have mentioned.

Gorgeous location, albeit a lot of gnats and mosquitoes later in the evening, but typical for any summer outing. The grounds are full of gardens everywhere you turn, and I love how open the space is. The entrance is tucked away from the main road right before a tunnel, so it feels as if you found a secret garden when you go up the gentle slope onto the main campus. I found the huge trees next to the antiqued masonry with teal shutters so full of charm. As I was here for Yelp's Muse-a-palooza, the scenery perfectly complimented outdoor concerts and food vendors on a semi-muggy summer evening. 

The mix of indoor and outdoor venue space is a must-see for anyone planning large-scale events for curious guests. I spotted an herb garden, a "secret" flower garden, and even a smoke house out back. It feels a bit like going into a historical park.I definitely recommend it for celebrations or parties.

Omg! Where should I begin ?? 

This was my first time there and my first time back spinning in who knows how long. The place is super cute and conveniently located. First time riders may buy a class and get one free so that's awesome within itself. If you are trying to figure out what day and what class to go to, um it's a no brainer...... SOUL SUNDAYS WITH CANDICE!!!
    Candice is my girl. She is one of a kind and the music she plays is awesome. It's a little of everything and she has you really feeling it. I usually don't even sweat when I work out but I was sweating everywhere. It's an awesome feel with and awesome workout and an awesome instructor.... Did I mention it's AWESOME!? Now go check them out and get ridin.
Don't worry about what I tell you, just put your phone down, grab your keys, get in your car and get down here. It's that good!
So many delicious items to choose from: curry to sushi rolls to even their salads. I have more to try and will come back again
Very clean and nice people! Very professional and mange the atmosphere well. My artist was not distracted by the on lookers.

I have been treated by physicians at Reno Family Physicians for many years.  My current physician is Erica Simpson.  She is an outstanding physician that takes the time to understand not only my physical health but my over all mental as well as community health considerations.  She cares about the whole person and makes me very comfortable that she is in charge of advising me what to do to stay as healthy as an old man can stay.  I highly recommend Reno Family Physicians.  Yes I have dealt with several of their physicians over my many years with them and I have received excellent care by each physician that ever saw me.  My wife and one of my grand adult grand children also see physician at this medical facility.

I have only been here 3 or 4 times, but as I eat here now, I have never experienced such high quality customer service. Along with great tasting subs and fries, the employees are the best ever. I literally downloaded yelp just to give this place their well deserved rate. I just ordered medium fries and the cashier upgraded it for no extra charge. And don't even get me started on their cookies.

For a $31 car wash and and $8 tip, I am so disappointed. I've been here before and the interior of my car has been cleaned. This time, it was not. The interior of my car is still dusty. The cup holders, area around my shifter, area around the emergency break, etc. were not even touched! It has been a few months since my last visit and I must say, this is LAZY work done by the team. I never complain and I'm not picky at all, but the inside wasn't even wiped down. Surely a $40 car wash would yield a much better interior wipe down than this. Not to mention, look at my rims?! WTF is that! Wow. Disappointed, want a refund, and will never return.

We stopped for lunch on 5/2914. Wow! I had "All That Jazz". I wish I were hungrier, because they only sell it on a french loaf. It was a TON of food. A little salty, but very good.

The lady had the Shrimp Po' boy on a round bun. DAMN! It was perfect. I would go back to NOLA just for another one of those. Certainly a place to revisit. 

Be sure to check out the old plywood boards hanging from the walls. They covered the windows during Katrina, and the love for Verti Marte scribbled on those boards attests to how great the sandwiches are.

Love this place and the service is always great. We had our 24th wedding anniversary dinner here and they gave us a complementary molten cake dessert. This place is always top notch. Highly recommend going here if you never been. If you leave hhungry it's your own fault.
Best Indian restaurant what i ever visit... Food is delicious and reasonably priced. Great staff, always helpful and super friendly. 5\5.

I've been hitting up World Market lately for some of the stuff that Trader Joes doesn't carry.  They have some pretty good spices, and dry goods.  I wouldn't trust them too much for perishable items. 

Plus they have the monster bottle of Cholula.  The regular sized bottles are gone in a week at my house.

Nam Son is a classic Vietnamese restaurant in a Vietnamese strip mall. 

Nam Son Bakery is next door and is the take-out joint for the main restaurant. 

They offer some awesome Banh Mis, smoothies, and bubble tea. Also have a pretty large selection of items to grab-and-go. Perfect place when you want some Vietnamese food and are in a rush.

They refused to let us come inside, because we have a small service dog with us. But it was hot and muggy outside. We have gone there a million times before with our service dog and it has never been a problem. This time they wouldn't even let us in the door.

Order a coffee, and California bacon Benedict with hash browns and was nasty. Coffee wasn't coffee it was water down, and had no flavor.
Hash browns were so dried, burnt and in the center under cooked. The eggs Benedict tasted strange, bacon was burned. Service was poor.

Super great find! This is the best Asian food I've found in north Indy so far. Little bit pricier than I usually go for, but def worth it. 

Ordered take out. Crab Rangoon was the best I've ever had! Full of crab meat, cream cheese, and scallions. Spring rolls were solid too! I got an order of Pad Thai Noodles and Orange Chicken. The Pad Thai was just as good as I've anywhere and the Orange Chicken was also the best I've ever had!
Can't turn or adjust the air conditioner. Restaurant does not have any food. Vending machines don't have drinks. Just unhappy with everything at this hotel.
Popped in Friday on the way home from Fountain Sq. Nice and clean, friendly staff, it was too late for food, so can't speak to that, but I'll be back sooner than later.

Met a friend here for lunch and we sat inside. My first time here, and my friend told me she usually sits either in the bar or outside in nice weather because of the noise level in the main dining area.  We were able to talk and hear each other, but the dining room was only about 1/2 full.  Something to remember for next time I go.  Other than that, the one thing I have tried so far was amazing, chicken barbecue salad!  I loved it!  I can't wait to go back again, the only problem is that I will want to get the barbecue salad again so I won't try anything new.  I'll take my husband and I can try whatever he orders.  Even though I have only tried this one time, I give 5 stars to places that I can't wait to go back to again, and this definitely qualifies!

I had an oxtail platter with Mac n cheese and cabbage and a slice of chocolate cake today. The oxtails Mac n cheese and cabbage were delicious, the cabbage could be cooked more since I like mine tender and this wasn't. The chocolate cake gets 0 stars, it tasted like it had been in a smelly freezer and I couldn't eat more than 2 tiny tastes. I'll skip deserts from here from now on.

The service and breakfast at Sunshine Breakfast was delicious. The first time I went to the restaurant I had the French toast, bacon and potatoes and when I went back the second time I had a skillet and French toast. The potatoes had a light, flavorful and seasoned crisp on the outside and the French toast was delicately sweet. I will definitely be going back!

Ermanos had the best craft beer, ciders and wine in all of Tucson period!  The staff and owners are always nice, warm and inviting every single time I come here.  Their food is to does for, and it is consistently good every single time I order.  They also have many gluten-free options and have gluten-free bread and buns, so I can have burgers and sandwiches, which is totally awesome!! My favorite has been their grilled cheese on gluten-free bread, add chicken.  They also make their own ketchup, kimchi in house, amongst many other food options.  I love Ermanos and it is my go to bar and restaurant in Tucson Arizona, especially for their craft ciders, I love love love the options that I have to drink when I come.  Oh also, they have a large screen at the main bar, where you can watch your favorite game on GameDay!!  Thank you Ermanos for being here in Tucson, I really appreciate it!!!

This place gets two stars because of our good server Makayla. She was very nice. However The food was was not good. First off I came here for crab legs and they were out. But they had the crab soup so I got that. It was the consistency of pudding. So thick the soup spoon stood up in it. It was not even warm. She was nice and offered another soup but I declined. I also got the steak and shrimp. The steak was cooked to the right temperature but had no salt or any seasoning on it. The mushrooms had so much dirt on them they definitely don't wash them and somehow looked and tasted like canned mushrooms. There's even fruit flies in the dining room. This place is stuck in the 80s and so is the menu. It's unfortunate.
Way to pricey for overcooked steaks and snotty service. Charley Gittos is better on all counts.

Oh my, heaven on earth.  They say "man cannot live by bread alone."  Forget bread.  Give me cake, and make sure it was Baked on 8th.  This store is like a step back in time.  True craftsmanship in baking and decorating, and customer service like time forgot.  If you live in, or are visiting Nashville be sure to get Baked on 8

They have great products, They have more food products than before. They have a lot of organic products now. They have a lot of vegan items and gluten-free options. They also have a lot of paper products now that's a good book for.

We went to 4 korean restaurants. This one was the best. Best food. Best chairs. Best atmosphere. The others were very good but Sa Ri One Grill was tops. Music not too loud. Plenty of space. Highly recommended.

We stopped here today.  The selection, not large but enough. We ended up with Sea Scallops and Red Shrimp. The seafood is good quality and staff was nice and answered all my questions with no hesitation. We enjoyed our seafood tonight to kick off Shark week!

My favorite vegan date night spot! Super friendly service and cool little patio. I've had a lot of plant-based pizza over the years but Homegrown really has perfected it! The decor is sexy and funky and the cocktails menu is quite impressive! Can't wait to try their vegan breakfast this weekend
This is a great hotel great location especially the hydrotherapy massage chairs and breakfast. We will mark this one as a repeater. It's a very clean hotel and frienly staff.

After hearing so much about the Lil' Pop Shop, I finally made my way there. Like many, I love most things sweet. So, needless to say, I was giddy with excitement.

From the moment I walked in, I knew I was in an organic trendy type of place. It's a simple place, with complex flavors. What they do with ice pops, I have never seen done before. I loved the selection of flavors, and was a little intimidated at the same time.

I knew I could not have just one. At $3 a pop, I also know I could not have 10. But since I was with my wife, I knew we could go two a piece and do some sharing, which is exactly what we did.

We got the Lemon Blueberry Buttermilk, Creamy Mint With Chocolate Chunk, Mango with Lemon Verbena and Curry (non dairy), and Vanilla Bean Orange Blossom. They were all good, and quite interesting. But some, IMO, are better than others. As much as I was intrigued and liked  the Lemon Blueberry Buttermilk, it was not my favorite combination of flavors. The sour of the lemon did not go so perfect. I felt the same about the curry in the Mango with Lemon Verbena and Curry. But I absolutely loved the Creamy Mint With Chocolate Chunk and Vanilla Bean Orange Blossom. They were just perfect to me.

All in all, it was a good experience, but their daringness with some flavor mixtures is not for everyone.

Man I wish I would have seen Michelle B's review of this place. The customer service here absolutely stinks. They bait and switched me a mid sized rental when I had requested (and confirmed) a full size. When I complained that it was not what I asked for I was sharply told "That's all we've got". Obviously the rep was a member of the Customers Un Needed Today school of thought. Reported the nasty attitude to Hertz and my insurance company. STAY AWAY!

Well. I love their burgers. Small but mighty. Fries were awesome too. They also have a little market where you can buy real fresh farm eggs from hens. They taste like they're supposed too.  Those chickens must be happy because it's the best eggs I've had. The place is lovely, kinda crowded, all kinds of people. I took pictures and posted here.  Their competition would be Hi Pointe and vice versa.  I will be back. There is a bit of a wait, but who cares. Just read something in your phone. I'm excited to buy more things from their market again.

Are you kidding?!  This is the best restaurant I've gone to in a decade!  First the customer service is OUT OF THIS WORLD! I am on an unusual and restrictive diet and my fantastic Zahav experience began a month ago when I contacted the restaurant to see if I would be able to eat there.  I exchanged multiple emails with Christy the GM who not only told me all of the ingredients of every dish, but offered to modify my top choices so that I could order them. She even emailed me the day of my reservation to confirm I could eat one of the ingredients in one of the dishes-- this is after she researched my diet to check every ingredient!  When I arrived everything was preset, they even bought a special kind of yogurt so I could have the grilled cauliflower that I told her I hoped to order. After the meal I was surprised by a specially made dessert that I could eat!!!  (I'll post a photo). 
Order: The 6 small salad plates!!! Fried Cauliflower!!!As per the others at my table: Holumi cheese,  Hummus, custard dessert! 
My hats off to Christy! Our waiter Brenden who matched Chrissy's extraordinary customer service! And the chefs!!!  We just dropped our son off at college and trust me I will always come to Zahav when in Philadelphia!  Can't wait!
I love Michaels Italian Hoagies and routinely drive 1/2 an hour just to get one. Also, love their cheesesteaks and burgers. Give Michaels a try if you haven't already. You won't be disappointed.

Positive experience here at Jared's. My fiancé bought me the most amazing ring and the staff was so helpful! I had to go back and have it resized because he purchased it a little too big! Liz was such a great help!

Needed new wipers and while paying 80 bucks for wipers is ridiculous this place was amazing!
Clean, neat and wonderful employees.
The person who helped me was able to get me take. Care of in under 10 minutes and I didn't even ask for the wipers to be put on - he automatically walked with me to my car and did it!
Definitely will be my Advance Auto Parts of choice!

We came here for lunch and were trying to get our ramen fix.  Upon arriving it looks like we seat ourselves to any available tables. This is one of the first places where they have tablets at each table taking orders. There appears to be some confusion with the way their system because they brought orders to our table that were for a different table. This happened two or three times during our meal. My wife and I both got the Charshu Ramen.  Service was speedy and the food came out quickly.  The broth was tasty creamy and flavorful. The bamboo shoots, egg, and spinach were also good. The noodles had good bite and were decent. However I don't think they are made from scratch. My biggest disappointment was that the charsiu wasn't actually charsiu (braised pork belly) but beef brisket. The brisket was actually still prepared well and was tasty but when you are expecting to be having that delicious melt in your mouth braised pork belly, it's just not the same. Upon looking at the menu I realized they offer beef brisket so looks like they got our order wrong.  Since I was already halfway in and the ramen was still generally tasty I just dealt with it and finished my meal. All in all this place is a great addition to the variety in the south Jersey area and the ramen is actually good enough to satisfy your ramen craving. They just need to work on the kinks in their service.

I'm not the type to leave a review, but I had to come on here and share my thoughts. This place has too high of a rating online and I think people need to see some negative reviews to keep them from going here. Honestly one of the worst buffets I've ever been to not to mention the pricing is outrageous for what you get. The food was cold and old. One of the staff members was just going around and stirring the food around to make it not look so old. Staff was not very friendly either. After spending over $17 on my food there, mind you I only ate a small piece of cake because the other food I tried wasn't edible, I ended up going to McDonalds and getting some spicy nuggets. Which were embarrassingly enough better than the food I had just paid $17 for. Keep your money, go spend the money you have on good food, instead of going to this overpriced dingy buffet.

We were walking through the midtown Reno neighborhood on our way to lunch with fam. We were exploring and window shopping along the way. This shop caught our eyes.  Through the window I can see taxidermy animals, succulents, and plants in a modern designed shopfront. It peaked my interest. The shop, Natural Selection, labels itself as "purveyors of all things odd and beautiful". What a gem of a shop. 

After lunch, I meandered on back to this shop. Right when I walked in, all the taxidermy small critters such as a flying bat and weasel were intriguing. Don't fret folks, the owners obtained these items at estate sales and surrenders. They are not commissioned. Plus they stock plants and flora; houseplants, succulents... all things to build a terrarium or buy one already made. The inventory is sure unique and rotates. You can buy $3 turkey feathers, $4+ geodes.

The shop is small business owned by a daughter and mother duo. Luv that. Follow the shop on Instagram, Facebook, or their own website. Also to reference for folks not familiar with Reno but are familiar with Sactown, the shop is in a neighborhood that reminds me of midtown Sacramento. The neighborhood has a similar look, vibe, and collection of small businesses in an older neighborhood of homes. 

#naturalselectionreno

I just joined this gym. So far the staff has been very friendly and have enjoyed just being back in a gym. I will say the music in the main room upstairs is way too loud. I think that vibe is better for CrossFit or a place full of guys getting aggression out. When I take a yoga class(which isn't just for stretching) it's a place to also relax, the music is so loud and distracting you can't hear the instructor or really focus. I would think they would have the music at a much lower volume or at least schedule a more appropriate music schedule when classes are going on! I am a huge class taker so this may be a problem for me down the road. I also like to hear my OWN music when I'm on the treadmill or elliptical. I don't think it needs to try so hard to be a "Nashville" gym with the music blasting. So we will see.

What a cute house!

This cupcake shop is family owned and operated. Their cupcakes are made fresh daily from scratch. I read a lot of great things on Yelp about The Cupcake Collection and decided to grab some cupcakes for everyone. 

When you enter, you will notice that half of the house has been turned into the baking station and the other half is where they sell the cupcakes. I decided to sample a few of their flavors (ie. Strawberry, Sweet Lemonade, Sweet Potato, Red Velvet, Wedding Cake, and Carrot Cake). 

The Sweet Potato and Strawberry were my favorites. Though the icing for the Strawberry was a bit too sweet for me, I loved the fresh pieces of strawberry in the icing and cake. The icing on the Sweet Potato cupcake was smooth, creamy, and not too sweet. The cake was moist and flavorful. It was like biting into a slice of sweet potato pie. 

The Sweet Lemonade cupcake definitely had a zing to it. It was tart and very sweet. The Red Velvet icing was nice. The cream cheese frosting was not too sweet and smooth. The cake was flavorful and moist. The icing on the Wedding Cake was a bit too sweet for me but it was still smooth. The vanilla butter cake was delicious. The carrot cake was also well made with plenty of carrots, pineapple, raisins, dates, and coconut. The walnuts on top were lovely. 

At $1.50 per cupcake, the price is definitely right. 

Mignon Francois and her beautiful family are extremely hard working and I wish them and their business all the best.

i will be short and to the point:

I just had one of the best sandwiches I have ever had from here, the Sicilian. their delicious bread with eggplant, lettuce, tomato, mozzarella, basil mayo. it was all so perfect. it was like a little peice of heaven. it was $6.50 but this is not just some deli sandwich. this is the good stuff right here. worth every penny.

and no minimum for cards!
Absolutely loved the fajitas. They were a huge success and fan favorite among us. Very kind service and we will definitely be back

My husband and I got to check this place out after the opening last month. The staff were super friendly and helpful throughout the evening! They made it an enjoyable experience to come here. I was impressed and pleasantly surprised by the number and variety of taps available--everything from local to national brands along with the beer selections ranging from session ales to Belgian and barrel aged beers. It's pretty impressive and perfect for a group hangout!

By far the most luxurious pedicure I have had. I made the trek to Iris after hearing my friend Anat's awesome experiences there. The salon is immaculate, full of natural light, and most notably, void of those terrible fumes. There must be some great ventilation going on in this place because you don't even get a whiff of that acrid nail salon smell. The ladies at Iris really take their time and deliver amazing results. I was thrilled to get massage and hot stone treatment with my services; many salons I have visited will charge extra and badger you about upgrading your pedicure but Iris just includes everything. That said, this salon is a little pricey. In my opinion, it is worth the splurge because my beautiful mani pedi lasted several weeks (I got gel). The technicians were all very polite and friendly (no smack-talking or giggling) and frankly, I'm willing to pay a little more to enjoy an immaculate space and top-tier service.

Not good!
Overpriced with poor service and terribly bland. 
Only reason for two stars is that I didn't get sick.
Figure out who you are. Japanese, Thai, Chinese, Korean, Vietnamese.....figure it the heck out and and do it well!
I'll bet all the good reviews here are from people that have never lived in a big coastal city with real Asian food. It seems that a lot of transplants to Nashville have bland midwestern palettes and it shows by how many mediocre restaurants are opening to rave reviews.
Go to Sapporo in Rivergate for some delicious, affordable Japanese food in a home style Japanese atmosphere.

This is like a Subway for shawarmas, in my opinion.  Fast, delicious and extremely flavorful!  In fact, I'd say that I haven't actually had meat spiced up in such a manner before.  Every bite took me the middle east.

So here's what I ordered.  A beef shawarma with all the fixins, plus the hot sauce.  And for a side, I got the hummus.  Here is the deal though, the hummus comes with a quartered pita, so the shawarma plus the quartered pita was a freaking carb-o-nightmare.  I think that two people could easily split the shawarma and hummus and leave full enough.  But at any cost, I highly recommend the hummus because it was face-melting.  Get it to go and have it as a snack later.  Just be sure to order it.  At any cost.

As for the shawarma, if was really good.  It contained a combination of flavors my lily-white ass had never before tasted.  The sweetness of the pickles, the fire of the middle eastern hot sauce and the bold seasoning on the beef.  It was truly shawarmsational.  The sad part?  The place was freaking empty!  At noon!  I cannot believe they're selling food this good to virtually no one.

The staff was extremely friendly and the bathroom was clean.  So marry that with the great food experience, and you've got a solid 4 star review.  If I lived in the area, I would be a regular.

Side note, they're open until 2 AM!
This place wasn't horrible but I'm not sure if I would go back. It's definitely too expensive for the taste of the food I think. But all the staff was very nice.
Very good food! Love the chili's and options for spice.  It's a little pricey but the food is excellent and the service was good

I usually go to Wendy's everyday in the summer and almost every day on weekends in the winter, however lately the customer service has been very poor more than usual. The food is always late and it premade rlly like it's called fast food for a reason, anyway the workers r lazy and will do anything to leave early even if that means closing before they are suppose to. They also blame customers for messes that aren't even their fault, they can be funny but lately they have been lazy and rude. Sadly I will be returning this weekend and the next because it's in the neighborhood and I'm broke.

Love their food but they NEVER include the peppercorn sauce that goes with the Seared Beef Tenderloin even when asked!  This isn't once, it's every time and since this is all I order from here and have it delivered, it's extremely frustrating.

I came back to Lola tonight for the Yelp Eats event with Aimee, Browning, Joselyn, John, Travis, and Steven! Phew -- did I miss anyone? 

Anyway, I love the interior of Lola. It's such a cool lofty building with high ceilings and a chic atmosphere. 

First up? A drink! I had the Bogen: this had coconut rum, iced tea, and pineapple juice. This was tasty, but it was VERY weak. I had two and barely felt anything. Lamesauce. But it was a tasty drink nonetheless! 

I started with the polenta fries, which came with a spicy ketchup and garlic aioli. The polenta fries were very unique and delicious! I loved the spicy ketchup. The garlic aioli? Not so much -- it was pretty bland, actually. 

Next up? The spanakopita stuffed portabella. THIS. WAS. HEAVENLY. Oh my gosh...if I wasn't so full and struggling to save room for bread pudding, I would have demolished this. It was amazing. The phyllo dough was perfectly flaky, and the feta cheese, portabella mushroom, and toast were so freaking delicious. Holy moly.

Finally...BREAD PUDDING! It's sick how obsessed I am with this dessert. But it was on the Yelp Eats menu and I HAD to try it. 

The verdict? I wasn't a fan. At all. It sucks, because I really really REALLY wanted to like it. It was just not good. At all. Even the drizzle of blueberry sauce couldn't help this dry hunk of bread. And that's exactly what it was. Don't get me wrong -- I've definitely had worse bread pudding elsewhere, but this was such a disappointment, it was unbelievable. 

Another small annoyance -- the volume of the music! The band that was playing that night was great; they were a jazz band. But the volume was WAY too loud. It's no fun being surrounded by awesome people and having to shout across the table to hear each other! Boo.

I'll probably come back to Lola eventually, but I'm in no hurry to return.

This is a shout-out for Jen who works at Arby's in Boise on Findlay, by Fred Meyer.. She provided amazing customer service tonight. We had ordered through door dash and the previous few times we have ordered this way Door Dash has forgotten the bag containing condiments. This time I called the Arby's and asked them to please remind the door dash person to take the condiments. Bad timing he had already leftJen went out of her way to call him and ask him to come back for the condiments!! She is friendly, has the best phone voice. Please consider the great asset she is to your company.

Thank you!

Ordered a new keyed lock set including deadbolt and was ambitious to change it out myself.  Tried to learn how to re key the lock set but ran into difficulties.  Called Around the Clock Locksmith LLC and Joe Verdi answered my call and immediately headed to my home to repair the door within 30 minutes.
I was amazed and impressed that he responded so quickly.  The locks were installed promptly and correctly.  Joe did a great job and the price was reasonable for the time that he put into the job.  I highly recommend Joe for anyone having locksmith issues.

I'd always flown out of Newark growing up, but living closer to Philly now, I far prefer this airport! It's not as crowded, easy to get to, and there's good, affordable parking nearby. The airfares aren't always as good as flying out of Newark or JFK, but all the other factors make it a much better alternative in my opinion.

There are some good food options throughout, including Chick Fil-A, and they seem to be adding more. I've also yet to find an itinerary that isn't available from PHL.

I love ramen and this is probably one of the best places to get it in town. Just be sure to go on the weekends, because it isn't available during the week. It's a small venue and it can get packed depending on the day and time. There are only 3 options for ramen but hey, stick with what you know right?

We stopped in today for a late lunch and were the only ones in the restaurant which was great because we have a usually wild one year old and hyper 5 year old and didn't want to disturb anyone's meals. Our waitress was super friendly and attentive, I wish I remembered her name. She brought out our drinks and chatted with us a bit. Our teppanyaki chef was awesome as well. He was super friendly and outgoing and involved my 5 year old a lot. It was really cool to have the place to ourselves and our kids loved the fried rice. Everything was cooked perfectly. Even my usually picky one year old loved his vegetables. The only thing that was missing from our experience was the miso soup and salad that I thought usually accompanies our meal. I'm not sure if it was because we came in during lunch and it wasn't included or what, but I was looking forward to having that today.

Dr Gropper is my dentist and he is super awesome! He is very attentive and listens to all concerns. He set me up with a treatment plan and assured me that I did not need the 5+ root canals that the last dentist I saw told me I would need. The entire staff at Roach's Family Dentistry are great. The treatment consultant, Lauren, is so nice! She is all smiles and treats you like she's known you forever. Hands down 5 stars for this entire group!

I eat at Pinocchio's when I am in the Sparks area visiting my family. The meat eating members of my family love the food. I like that they have more vegetarian options than most places and their fries are delicious. I could live off of the fries alone. Their veggie burger is Boca, or Grillers Prime, or some other meaty tasting veggie burger. I personally don't like the taste of meat... I am a vegetarian after all. If you are a vegetarian I would suggest going with a pasta dish or a veggie sandwich.

This is okay.  Maybe it was just our visit.  There was a bit of a wait, but that is to be expected on a Saturday night in New Orleans.

Walking to our table was like walking through an obstacle course.  The seating is narrow here so they walk you down the dance floor which means you are dodging people doing their cajun two-step.  There was a live band playing as well when we went which was a positive (for me at least) and it really made me miss my hometown and the atmosphere there.  

I got red beans and rice with sausage.  The sausage had a good flavor, but was burned on the ends.  Not sure who thought it was a good idea to serve that.  I was really hungry after walking all day so I just cut that end off.  It was also a bit more watery than I would expect, but it at least had a good flavor which is more than I can say for what I've tried in Texas.

My companions got gumbo.  It looked a bit watery to me.  Now, for all you tourists it should be somewhat watery since it is really just soup, but there should be big chunks of veggies and meat in there as well.  The veggies were cut small and the shrimp were tiny in my opinion and my friend said they were overcooked - so mush basically.  He did say the roux was good though and for some that is all that matters.

Twenty years ago Mulates was the place to eat in New Orleans even for my friends raised "down the bayou", but I think they would be a bit disappointed now.  Or maybe they just don't order the gumbo.  Positives were the live band and the dancing - that will give you more of an idea of what happens in "cajun-land" on weekends or at festivals.  So come for the culture if anything.

My preferred sushi place in Edmonton. This is my weekly date night favorite.  The quality of the food is great, the price is affordable, and the service is the friendliest I've had at a sushi restaurant for n Edmonton. I will absolutely recommend Sushi Sugoi to my friends.

I have high standards for donuts, and Long's donuts never fail me. They are so good, my fiance and I are planning to have them at our wedding this summer as the dessert. 

The only tip I would have is to make sure you check your bag/box before you leave and make sure that you have everything you asked for! It's very sad to get home and find that one is missing.

The worst company and even worse employees!! Will is the employee is spoke with. Entirely unprofessional. Hired them to fix a stove range and knob. Lied to me about replacing a piece and just used a wrench to put the old one back on. He told my tenant to lie to me about the oven being fixed, so he could get paid. I refused to pay him until the job he was hired for was completed. He went back to the property two more times and while there, he glued the old knob back onto the stove. He then realizes the NEW thermostat HE installed was defective and causing the oven not to work. He told me "oh well. There is nothing I can do now that the knob is glued on." He was unable to replace the defective part he put on. He refused to fix the stove and said it was my problem now. He then yelled at me and continuously texted me about how it's my problem. See the attached photo for our text conversation. 

I now have to buy a new stove. DO NOT HIRE THIS COMPANY.

We had a great evening in the bar at the Blind Owl.  The bartender was attentive and had great suggestions regarding the beers on their extensive drink menu.  We ate at the bar and enjoyed the chicken caesar salad, grilled cheese sandwich and steak with fries.  All of the food was good.  The basketball game we wanted to watch was put on a television per our request.  We will return!

My family loves this place.  We have gone here for 2 parties and we have hosted one  party.  All the parties had 4-6 year olds.  Every child had a blast.  The parents were impressed by the set-up and the team, who were very nice and friendly.

As guests to 2 parties, they did a great job making sure the kids are safe and having fun.  As a host to one 6 year old's party, they did a great job making sure my husband and I had fun not having to deal with anything!  

We decided to make the party a cosmic party so it would be different.  It was a great decision.  It wasn't too dark, there were fun colorful lights, and the kids had glow sticks.  The entire party is cosmic until you get to the eating room.
