I called back after picking up the pizza and explained my concerns, and the person I spoke with refused to acknowledge my concerns about the pizza and didn't care to try to make it right. He said "well everyone likes that pizza, so". Consequently, I ordered dominos afterwards. 

Avoid this place if you want good pizza and reasonable service.

I loved First Watch when I lived in St. Louis. I usually went to the Kirkwood location and never had a bad meal. On a trip back this weekend, the hubs and I went to the Clayton location and were just underwhelmed with the whole experience. The wait wasn't bad (25 min), but we watched the busser clear off our table, then we were seated when there were still giant crumbs left on the table. Everything seemed to be a little dirty and sticky, like a greasy diner. The memories of First Watch I had were that everything was clean and fresh, but I didn't have that experience here. The hubs and I left satisfied with our food, but not blown away by anything, and not having a strong desire to return next time we're in town.

I stayed here on a business trip for 9 days in November and it was a fantastic place to stay. Located in the Warehouse District, it was a 10 minute walk to the French Quarter, located near some good restaurants, including Emeril's and Cochon, a 10 minute walk to the WWII museum, and close to a lot of art galleries. It's not necessarily in the center of all of the hubbub, but I actually liked being able to get away from the craziness of the French Quarter and Bourbon Street at the end of the night. 

They have very cozy suites with brick walled bathrooms with big open windows overlooking the city so you can have a great view while showering or getting ready to go out at night. 

Now to the best parts - 

FREE HOT BREAKFAST IN THE MORNINGS. Their staff is very friendly and energetic and they have a large variety of hot food choices. It's a great way to get your day off to a good start.

FREE MANAGER'S SPECIAL FROM 5-7 PM EVERY DAY. I know alcohol's not on the expensive side in New Orleans as compared to LA, but how awesome is free drinks with chips and salsa every day to get your evening kicking?! The free drinks, of course, are house bottles, but you can order anything you want - vodka tonics, bloody marys, beers, wines, hurricanes, you name it! The drinks aren't very strong, but you can keep coming back for more during the time period. It's all located in the downstairs courtyard, where you can destress from your convention or your workday with some football on the TVs or just some conversation.

By the way, the only reason that I gave a review of 3 stars is because my hotel room had ants. I hate ants.

We met some close friends for Sunday brunch and it was a first-time for everyone at Jackson's. The ambience was comfortable, clean and with a great view. The food was decent, however the cocktails were not good. The blood Mary was watered down and not sure it even had any vodka in it at all. With an "All you can eat" buffet, $21 per person plus tax/gratuity is very fair considering the amount of labor/food that goes into presenting a buffet with many options/choices. Recommend for sure if you cannot find another view on the water.
Went for a vision test.  52$ and no wait.  Professional and better than pearle vision in my opinion.  The optometrist was solid.

Shake Shack is overrated and having eaten here multiple times I have never understood the hype. I appreciate that their meat doesn't contain hormones and is generally more sustainable sourced than other chain burger joints and as a sugar lover I always appreciate a quick shake stop. My particular gripe with this Shake Shack is that the possible mix-ins for a concrete (their name for ice cream blended with other sweet things) are never listed anywhere. This means that you have to ask at the counter and hold up the whole line.

It was my first time trying Poke and I can say that this place is pretty good, I wasn't disappointed. The workers are really friendly and I like how you can add other toppings for no price (most of them). However, they didn't have salmon and considering it's only been a few days since opening, I felt that they aren't as prepared. Overall, the poke bowl was good, I would come back again.

A decent fast food option, but nothing to write home about. Rice to protein is way off--sometimes feels like I'm just paying for rice but the other ingredients, although sparse, are SO delicious it's almost worth it. The spicy aioli and shrimp tempura and pineapple create your own is unbeatable. Kind of like a fish taco

I ordered the St. Pete roll to go on my way home from work. There was no one sitting inside, so I am not 100% sure if the dining room is open, however to-go orders are happening!
St. Pete roll - fried shrimp, avocado, cream cheese, & topped with spicy tuna and crunchy flakes. A little ginger and wasabi on the side finishes it up.
While a pretty solid sushi roll - everything tasted pretty fresh and no funny looking pieces - nothing really wow'd me, exactly. The ingredients all blended well enough to be edible, but I didn't take a bite and just go 'wow'.
An okay stop for some sushi & I'll be back to try another roll.

I had heard of Code Coffee several times, but never tried it until recently.

I will say that the moment we walked in, we felt more at home than we do in most coffee shops. No hipster feel with overpriced coffee. Instead you feel like a proud American walking in and there are no judge-y looks while wearing cowboy boots.

Slightly disappointed that they don't offer an espresso shots or drinks, but also understand that their target (First Responders) opt for a quick cup of Joe most of the time. Their tea is decent as well! 

Lots of room for events and decent seating. Only complaint is the height of the long bench in comparison to the tables. Definitely not good to sit for a while there unless you are at the community style tables or in the chairs instead of the bench. 

Other than that, we really love the space and will be back to support.
Wow, the cutest atmosphere and the most delicious black and white cookie I've ever had! The girl behind the counter was so kind and helpful!
So much variety and a must see when you are in Philly. Be careful if you are short on time around lunch because it's very busy then, but they have the lunch crowd down to a fine science

Favorite Mexican restaurant is Santa Barbara. They have such a nice outdoor patio (with heaters) and life music on the weekends! The service is top notch as well.

Let's talk about the chips and salsa. I think my table went through 6 buckets, they are amazing. The bean/corn salsa is my favorite salsa in the world. You really can't order wrong here, get the guac - it's super good. I love the combination plates,they had GREAT tacos and enchiladas. I love their chicken salad, sounds boring but it has amazing jalapeño dressing. Their burritos are great too. Honestly, you can't go wrong! 

Get their mango margarita. Just do it.

Overall one of the best restaurants in Santa Barbara and it's right on State Street. I would recommend to anyone visiting the area and of course locals who have never tried!

amazing as always  customer service the best yet system is down pat been a long time still great and i must say your greeted as you come thru the door ready to help the next guest so you get throught the line fast DID I MENTION EVERY ORDER COMES WITH CHIPS AND A DRINK !!!

What a wonderful time.  The three hours flew by and we were stuffed at the end.  Nancy was the best!  She ensured we saw the sights, learned some history all while eating delicious food and tasting some excellent wine.  We never felt rushed.  It was incredible.   A must do and will do again.  Great for couples and for families. Kids would absolutely enjoy.

I spent $170 on a custom upgraded bobble head for my most important client. This lady has everything so it was really hard finding something she would love that she didn't already have. This was a great idea. I went through the proofing process and it was great. I sent back many changes and every time they did a great job. When I received the bobble head it looked "exactly" like my client. EXCEPT there was a large blotch of dried clay on the base and it ruined the whole thing. How could the designer NOT have caught that. Such a bummer. I can't give it to my client so now it's worthless. I tried sending a few emails the other day and now have tried several different emails with no avail. Was almost blown away, but now super disappointed. If I hear from them I will update.
This place is amazing! I'm surprised they weren't very busy on a Friday night. I had the chicken bacon ranch and it totally hit the spot.
Some of the best tacos and margaritas in town. Highly recommend the salsa and queso as well. Spicy margarita was one of the best I've ever had.

Very, very, very delicious. We had some stir fried lemongrass beef, pho with chicken and shrimps spring rolls. Lemongrass  beef super tender and tasty, chicken in pho was so tender, unbelievable and the spring rolls weekend also very good. We finished with some ice cream and loved it.  Great service, very friendly and helpful.
I I ordered Domino's Pizza on alarm Mingo and they no good I order ologies pizza and I delete the meat and chicken chicken pizza I don't like it does no good play new order

i always thought the Red Lobster ads on TV made the food look much better than it really was....maybe that's still true in some of their restaurants. But this new one off I-19 South in the Spectrum Center is a keeper. 
The food arrived in a timely manner and was  hot and good.  The servers were attentive and courteous. Nice and clean decor and lots of great seafood choices. You get a big basket of buttered biscuits and boy, are they good! I'd  recommend the giant coconut shrimp. Yum!
Save some bucks by having lunch and not dinner. 
All in all a very nice dining experience. We shall return.

Used to be really good but something has changed.  Service was extremely slow.  Pizza was cold.  The dipping sauce for the grilled chicken was cold.  20 for a small pizza and salad is way too much.  They used to have a lunch special that was reasonable.  Table next to us was dirty with a rag on it the whole time we were there which was an hour and 30 minutes.

I love The Butcher Block.  When we want beef, their's is the best in town!  They also make several sides that are delish.  Everything is fresh and they will cut-to-order.  They carry Angus beef, and I love the flavor.  They make a great pimento cheese, too!

With the day off for the Fourth of July decided to stop by for some breakfast. One word of recommendation you can't read the menus so look online in advance to determine what you want. Also drinks will have themed names so you'll need to convert your favorite latte to the menu. The service was great very friendly workers which is welcome first thing in the morning. The variety is great particularly the variety of fresh roasted coffee. If you like coffee they will have plenty of choices. I was able to get Indonesian coffee today which is one of my favorites. You can also get beans to take home as well. The other choices my kids liked was the hot chocolate which my daughter said was the best. My coffee was good not too hot. I got the breakfast bagel which was tasty as well. The bagel tasted fresh and the egg wasn't rubbery. The sausage wasn't too greasy easy and had a nice flavor. I saw a large container of biscotti so I had to get one too. They are quite good. Both chocolate with white chocolate drizzeled on them. Tasted great not all dried out with a nice touch of anisette. The inside is great nice and unique has a fireplace and several nice tables and free WiFi so you could come in and get some work done too. Will be back to try more of the coffee drinks.
Exceptional food quality!!   I had a chicken tamale and a shrimp taco on a quick stop en route to airport.   So so good.  Small eating space but it looked like the locals get carry out.

This place is indeed popular, but the space is HUGE, so there's plenty of room for groups. Oyster happy hour was dawning on us soon, so we just had a few items to share between the four of us:

fried alligator with chili garlic mayonnaise: Too much mayonnaise - could have been more crispy
louisiana blue crab rice with chili flake & cilantro: everyone's faves
macaroni & cheese casserole: can't really go wrong with baked mac n' cheese
smoked pork ribs with watermelon pickle: bbq sauce was SO overwhelming on the ribs
chicken & andouille gumbo: not bad, not great. I wouldn't order it again.

Overall I think the place is overrated - but I also heard that I missed out on the Grits.

After my Yelp explaining my dissatisfaction with the Kia service department,  I received a response from the General Manager of this dealership,  Andrew Dunton.  He invited me to call him to talk about my service visits.

During this call, I further detailed my experience with the dealership service department and how I felt about the way things unfolded and how I wished that they would have. We agreed that it didn't go quite how either of us would have wanted.

Mr. Dunton was pleasant and listened with what seemed like sincere concern.

Based on his reaching out to me and his professional manner,  I am willing to give Courtesy Kia of Brandon another chance to form a better relationship together.  I will in fact go back and hope for a great experience.
Food's great and authentic, but the waitress had an attitude, like we were an inconvenience to her just for being there. That would be my one deterrent from going again.

I really enjoy burger night here at the Woodside on Wednesday nights - I haven't tried the other entrees because I feel that the prices are too high.  If you order a beverage, for 5$ you get a burger served on a huge kaiser roll that you choose your cheese & toppings from a paper, they come with fries or chips.

They have some excellent happy hour beers for reasonable prices too.  Happy hour wine and appetizers are available as well.

When we were sitting at the bar in front of the taps, there was an odor of old yeast. Possibly from leaking tabs. My husband has 30 years of bartending experience so he's very familiar with bars. He said maybe the taps are leaking etc. due to  that smell we moved to the side of the bar just a few feet away & it was more pleasant. 

Quesadilla appetizer was 4$, & burgers @ 5$ make for an economical night out.

The service at the bar is friendly. Jon was our bartender, friendly and conversational.

The restaurant is beautifully decorated for Christmas. There is a cozy faux fireplace near the bar too.

I used to go to the Woodside many moons ago when they had a salad bar with hot bacon dressing and a statue off good ole "Spuds Mackenzie". Many happy memories within the walls of the old Woodside Inn. The Buckmans are the owners and they completely renovated the Woodside. It's absolutely beautiful but the price points are significantly higher than the former Woodside Inn. I like the Buckmans and I'm pleased that they're successful.

I enjoyed Tito's a lot, but I find the pricing a bit too high. I think Magazine is just getting too expensive for me in general.

I do love me some Peruvian food though, so high chances I'll be back.

The ceviche, causa, and pisco sour were very good. I had the duck and it was enjoyable but I found the cilantro rice it was served with too salty. All the main dishes that my dining companions ordered looked good but from what I tasted, it looks like the apps are way superior to the mains. 

I may need to stick to visiting Tito's for drinks and appetizers so I get the things I enjoy the most and don't break the bank.

My first visit to the Roxborough location to try their gyro.  There is on street parking on Ridge Avenue.  The restaurant is bright and cheery with the color scheme.  

I decided on the beef/lamb gyro woth tzatziki sauce and the greek yogurt with strawberries, bananas, honey, and granola for my daughter.  The menu allows you to either put it in pita or plate it. They offer chicken, pork, beef/lamb, and falafel.  Then select sauce. You can add fries to the entree. I passed on the extra calories.   There are a number of sides as well as salads.  Plus two different desserts.

On my next visit I will eat in so I can enjoy the food after it is prepared.  Also, I want to try sides  and dessert.

The Missouri Botanical Gardens runs their reservations through Catering StL, and we have experienced nothing but frustration dealing with them to reserve the Japanese garden for our wedding ceremony.

Apparently all of the MOBOT reservations run through one woman, Anna, and each time we have needed to communicate with her, we have waited at least a week for a return call. We then have left a frustrated message either for her or with a supervisor, and then we get a call back the next day. 

It's unclear whether she is incompetent or if Catering StL is drastically understaffed, but for the simple procedure of renting a space just for a ceremony, we have gone through hell. 

We are so glad that we did not go through them for our reception. It's too bad they have a lock on some of the nicest venues in St Louis. We do not believe they deserve it.

Grossman's has one of a kind pieces.  Many of the pieces I was interested in I could pick the stain and or fabric for.  The prices are great as well and within the range of national stores where the furniture is not customizable.  They also are a mom and pop store in Philadelphia and are conscious about picking brands that are manufactured in the US. That was a big plus for me.  Michelle O., was the sales person that worked with me, she was a recent grad of one of the local design colleges and she spent alot of time helping me with fabrics and colors to get what I wanted just right.  I would definitely go back there again and recommend to others if you want special one-of-a-kind pieces that fit your design perfectly and don't break your budget.

Four Green Fields is another one of my favorite bars in Tampa. I love the authenticity of the thatched roof and the decor inside.

The staff is always friendly and there is normally live music playing. Four Green Fields is also the official Liverpool Football Club Bar for our watch parties on Sunday mornings! 

Parking is never a problem here. FGF owns a huge parking lot that accommodates at minimum 75 cars. It is also a great bar to go to when the temperature is much cooler, because there is outside seating out front and the patio out back. 

Food is consistently good here and you can't go wrong with anything you choose. Tonight I had the Irish Potato Leek Soup, which was a little bland for me. But, I am a salt-aholic so everything is bland to me. My dining companion and good friend, Steve E. enjoyed his without all the extra seasoning. 

I also ordered the Cottage Potato Skins, which is FGF's take on the typical potato skins. They were fried perfectly and crisp. They tasted even better when slathered with sour cream.

Four Green Fields is a great laid back bar with a nice chill vibe. No douchebaggery here! Definitely stop in and have an adult beverage, some Irish Pub goodness, and be douchebag free!

I've been here a couple times. Service is good, burgers are excellent. I got the black and Bleu burger which was great and the bleu cheese was not too overpowering. When I went on a Tuesday evening we got right in for a party of 7. Went on a Saturday night during Wiregrass mall's Symphony in Lights and had to wait 45 mins for a table. They have bottomless soft drinks and bottomless sides (that means all you can eat French fries!). It's a nice large restaurant with  different rooms with tables. There are several televisions in the bar area and the dining area as well. Parking is available any where you can find it at Wiregrass mall, but there is small lot directly next to the restaurant but when the mall is busy at the holidays it's a challenge to find parking.

My friends, hubby, and I visited on a Saturday night around 4:30 pm for a tasting.  They're located in an industrial area. The front area is the tasting room and the back warehouse is where they distill and bottle.  Wow, we were able to sample 9 different spirits (vodka, gin, rum, whiskey, bourbon), a bbq sauce, a bloody mary mix, a cherry, and a pickle. I enjoyed most of the tastings and especially loved the cask bourbon and coffee liqueur.  Nick gave us a quick tour and provided us with descriptions of every spirit while another person (didn't catch her name) provided the samples.  We had a great time and all ended up buying a few bottles including that delicious Moonshine BBQ sauce.
Great menu! Lots of vegan awesomeness. Friendly, well-informed staff. Welcome addition to the neighborhood.  Thankfully they don't take credit cards - otherwise I'd spend a fortune here!

ADT is the worst security system. All they do is kick back and collect their money. My alarm had gone off numerous times with no calls from ADT. They were great when they first started out but have become sloppy and lazy while people trust them because they've been around so long and claim they have a great reputation. 
I'm on a 3 year contract for a set rate and every 6 months they try to raise my rates. I moved one time in the past during a 3 year contract and I was forced to renew my contract for 3 more years because it's either cancel with penalties or renew it for 3 years. I recently moved out of my rental and bought a new house and continue to pay ADT for the 6 remaining months to avoid paying for the penalties which is more money than the monthly payments. I haven't lived at the rental for 5 months and they haven't even noticed or addressed it. They disgust me. Never will I use ADT's services again.  Do not get ADT. You will regret it.

On, Saturday night Dec. 5th, 2021 I had dinner at Buca Di Beppo. Luckily, the weather was very nice outside. Going into the front entrance of the restaurant there are a lot of stairs, and I didn't see a low walk ramp so that someone who can't do stairs needs the ramp. I noticed the restaurant is smaller compared to the one downtown if that's still open, and the restaurant is in a great location in the Castleton area. For, my dinner I had the baked ziti which was a big plate, I order a small that was big enough for 2-3 people.  It was missing some flavor, and more cheese I didn't eat all just half then took the rest home. Overall, it wasn't a bad restaurant just be prepared that the foods are huge sizes whether it's a small, or large dish.

Simply bomb coffee! I just recently moved from Seattle after living there for 4 years. I had my best cup of latte outside of Seattle here. 

The milk is good. The coffee is good. And texture of the foam is just fantastic. They also have distinctive notes for their actual coffee too.

Their coffee on the shelf also excellent. Freshly roasted. Washing method mostly with water. I got the Zephyr summer blend since I like Ethiopia light roast. But they also have other selections from South America and other parts of the world too.

Anyways highly recommend!

The spicy Panang fish on a cold and rainy day was great.

$8.95 gets you soup, salad, eggroll, wontons, rice and perfectly cooked fish in a rich curry sauce.

DELICIOUS

I'm so ready for a ramen joint in Philly that gives Terakawa a run for its money, but alas, that day has not yet come.

I came during off-peak hours on a weekday, so the place was fairly empty. I got the Miso ramen, along with a mini curry Tonkatsu rice bowl. The rice bowl was pretty decent and bigger than I'd expected. When I eat ramen, I seldom leave noodles in my bowl, but unfortunately, this was the case here (or maybe it was because of my cold, which prompted the search for a steaming bowl of ramen in the first place). 

Nothing in the ramen really stood out. I could barely taste the miso flavor in the broth, and the broth also did not have much substance or umami. The fish cake was a bit slimy. The pork was hard and a little overcooked (although I did appreciate the char). The noodles... well, they kind of reminded me of the ones I get in ramen packets. 

I'm probably not returning any time soon, but it was worth a try!

Finally went to this place. We booked it about 3 weeks ahead of time. Even then we had table for only at 5 30 pm. The food was great. We ordered hummus with laffa for starter. One of the best hummus with lot of flavor in it. For small plates we ordered fried cauliflower and house smoked sable. Both of them were fine. But best part was the entrees. I had salmon and my wife had chicken shislik. 

Ambience was noisy outside but they had room inside which seemed to be quiet. Next time we will request to sit inside. I took one star away because of service. The server to our table seemed to be very busy even at 530 pm. And felt like we were rushed a little bit. But great place to enjoy the flavor of middle eastern food ! Will go back some time.
Great food, outstanding service and very unique amazing drinks.  Our server Madison was great. We live two blocks from there and i already cant wait to get back there.
The food was very good the inside vibe was good as well. My bartender was nice and was on top of our refills and what we needed. I met some cool local people there.

As a first time visitor to the always popular 3 Sisters, I must admit to great disappointment. Our server was charming and efficient, but the food was average and the ambience sub-par. We practically had to scream to hear each other over all the noise, and the chairs were hard and uncomfortable. I ordered the DDD featured corn cakes with lemon curd and berries; thank goodness for the berries, because the cakes themselves had no noticeable flavor. The French Toast got a positive review from one member of our party, but the egg sunnyside over was deemed almost inedible. The whole experience was a bummer because one of our guests was from out of town, and I told her this was supposed to be one of Indy's best.
Worst service ever. Once they take your money, they Don't do anything to rectify your problems I called Mike who is the manager he never answers his phone
One word- AMAZING. We ended up eating here twice while in town because we loved it so much!

This restaurant is a nice place to dine in.
The live music pretty nice and typical for this region. At some point the server should be trained better but it is what it is: still a nice place to go to. They got plenty of beers and good food. I tried the wraps and they were in so fatty as promise at some point. So go and check it out for yourself.

Gregory and his team (Hi Diego!!) did a great job on our extensive backyard redo. Very responsive to our concerns, and flexible with changes. We love our new outdoor living space. Would highly recommend!

I had the pleasure of seeing two Cardinals games this weekend, Friday night from a corporate luxury suite and Saturday afternoon with standing-room tickets.  The ballpark doesn't quite measure up to the top tier of the new generation of stadiums.  It doesn't have that intimate feeling of gems such as PNC Park, where even the top-level seats feel very close to the field and open concourses allow viewing of the game from any point.  Strong points at New Busch are the view towards the outfield, with the courthouse and Arch (but also the gaping hole of Former Busch Stadium), and the out-of-town scoreboard which shows not only scores but game situations for five selected games.

The suites are fairly standard; of course since they are brand-new, they are a bit "nicer" and slightly roomier than others in which I have been.  Food-service employees and hard-core Cubs haters may be pleased to hear this:  in my estimation, the suite food (including the dessert cart) is significantly better at Busch than at Wrigley.  

The standing-room areas are surprisingly generous, as long as everybody obeys the "yellow line" rule.  Once you get one jerk who wants to move forward a few feet, it ruins the view of the field for everybody else.  The ushers were hit-or-miss about enforcing the policy.  We tried a few spots, starting in the right-field tower, and eventually settled into an area on the third level down the first-base line, parallel with shallow right field.  We could see the game very well from there and had concessions and restrooms just a few dozen feet away.  On a 95-degree day, we much appreciated the shade and the open architecture at that spot which allowed a breeze to flow through the area.  

The food concessions are decent; not the greatest variety I have seen, but what I got was solid.  The kosher dog was very good, with a nice snap and tang, although the bun was dry, and free grilled onions.  A 24-ounce beer for $8.75 is a good value for a ballpark.  They really need to take credit cards at the stands, however.  

One more note: the ease of transportation to the stadium is astonishing.  On Friday we drove (coming from Chicago) and it only took ten minutes between getting off the highway and parking the car.  I was shocked to see easy parking for $12-15 within a block of the stadium.  We went a bit farther away--about three blocks--and parked for five dollars.  FIVE dollars!  On Saturday we ate lunch in the Soulard neighborhood and took a free shuttle from 1860 Saloon (other bars have them too) and then back again after the game.  Not only was the shuttle free, but beer was provided by the driver in exchange for a nominal tip.  Awesome!

I'll definitely be back here for games on upcoming trips to STL, so I'm interested in seeing the seats in other spots in the stadium.

Went this past Friday and it was amazing! We did the tasting menu which I highly recommend for your first time because you get to try a lot of different items on the menu. The service was as equally amazing! I pick the swordfish for my entree and it was cooked to perfection! Absolutely no complaints about this restaurant, go now!
Food was delish. fast and friendly service. Kid friendly we had a nice meal since no one could hear our loud kids.

Much more upmarket restaurant than everything else in the honky tonk area. It's definitely not good value and I didn't see any live music there and not sure if they even offer it. The interior has nice decor and the guacamole was great. The tater tots even though they were goose fat ones tasted like any other ones I've had. If you are on the strip and want something a bit fancier with no music check these guys out.

DO NOT RENT FROM THEM. I've had so many problems with my apartment from the start of moving in. I moved in August 2016 . Had to pay $629 for a deposit and an additional $629 because I wanted an upgraded apartment , that had "new appliances" and "new carpet" which I didn't mind because i thought it was a nice apartment complex. WRONG. I had numerous problems after only living there for 2 months . My refrigerator handle broke off , my living room and dining room windows didn't open , (and it was super hot this summer), my microwave broke, the dishwasher started leaking and holding water which made my apartment smell like mildew , my toilet was constantly running , and the other toilet in the master bathroom leaked water onto the floor every time it was flushed, the garbage disposal broke leaving our house smelling like mildew & a dump site, lastly we had a pipe burst in our apartment leaving the hallway to the master bedroom soaking wet. Everything except for the pipe busting took FOREVER to get fixed (more than 3 months) it took them 9 days to come fix the pipe that burst. By the time they came after me complaining for 8 days they finally came to fix the problem. By that time the water had made it to the master bedroom . Because all of the leaking from dishwasher , toilet and pipe burst , we had water stains on our "new carpet". When it was time to move out, We scheduled a walk through because of our busy schedules so we could be there and no one ever came . I went back two days in a row after that because I was concerned and    they gave me a run around saying I was going to be called and never was . Return a week later just to see if I was in the clear to see if and how much of my deposit I got back. Turned out I owed them. They charged me for small things around the apartment, like replacing drip pans which was ok but then they charged me $1213 for new carpet because there was damage ....... damage from all their "new appliances" and the toilet leaking , damage from the pipe busting. This place is awful . Save yourself and DO NOT RENT HERE !!!!!

I got the Bacon Chic and I must say that it was pretty huge.  I believe they use 8" rolls and it's full of ingredients, so the amount of food that you receive is great.  The sandwich could have been seasoned a little better, and the chips should have been seasoned LESS (very salty).  Also the bacon was fairly flavorless and a bit stringy.  Overall I'd give them 3 stars.

Ruby Tuesday "is what it is..." You kinda know the food you're getting so what really differentiates is the service...or lack thereof. I met a friend for a quick bite in the bar. There were different groups of people, of two people or less, including me. While there, I observed three of us have issues. One poor girl's food was wrong, she didn't have time for them to fix it, so she was offered a free dessert. She LEFT without the free dessert because it took them too long to bring a slice of cake. She gave up after 10 minutes. The area wasn't crowded, but the lackadaisical attitude to orders was ridiculous.

First time here.  Was looking for an Italian restaurant near Blue Bell, and found Il Boscaiolo on Yelp.  It definitely deserves all the favorable reviews.  We had an absolutely wonderful dinner.  Great service and amazing food.  Highly recommend the Gnocchi in vodka sauce and the Calamari Veneziana.  We also had the Lobster Ravioli, Spaghetti Carbonaro, Veal Parmigiana and the Vitello Franscese.  Everything was delicious. They are in the process of expanding to include alfresco dining.  Really looking forward to returning soon.

Fiorella, the owner, is fabulous. I've gone to her for 20 years or more. She cuts my totally straight hair into a shape I love. The others who work here are also good, but she's great, and lovely person.

This place used to be Discount Tires. American Tire Depot checked in about 2 years ago. Anyway, I live close by and have been getting my tires and wheel service from these guys (even when it was Discount Tire) for about 10 years. I've never had a complaint.  Great service, very knowledgeable staff and fair prices. I've always made sure of competitor prices before I commit to purchase.  They run Legoland specials every once and while. A set of Goodyear tires for our minivan cost me $460. and we received four free admission tickets to Legoland (figure those are about $65 each).  The kids love Legoland and I'm a fan of American Tire Depot.
Perfect for a clutch meal! They were pretty fast, and the workers are very pleasant and respectful.

This place used to be pretty awesome thrift store. Prices were reasonable. I'm not sure what happened to the one lady who was manager but she was awesome. I used to spend 1000$-2000$ a month here but now nothing of value everything has been increased in price for far beyond what actual selling value is. Such a shame. Wish the people were nicer inside too just a horrible place to shop now. Nobody wants to pay 200$ for Dior jackets and polo when they are on eBay for 50. Don't forget who you are as a thrift store that helps the laurel house. Everything you get is donations to have things priced 5$ under retail is beyond a shame. Do your self a favor and do not shop here.

Oh so good!  The Mexican slaw was fantastic, and loved the vegetarian tamales.  Wish they had a reusable dish option or at least recycling on premises!  But great walkable location from nearby neighborhoods, and the staff were super-friendly.  Will definitely be back.

Nic: Who's going first, you or I?

Ran: You. 

Nic: Fine. Why do we go here? 

Ran: Because I like the beer, like that Sins of Our Father Imperial Stout they have on tap. They rotate the beers so there are always several really nice craft beers. 

Nic: That's great. But I don't drink. And the food is really, really just kind of meh...

Ran: Well, you know they're trying because they have lots of things on the menu that are hard to find elsewhere. 

Nic: Yeah. Like Scotch egg! That was great! And it only took 45 minutes to make it to the table......

Ran: You got me there, the service is really slow. I think what they are trying to do is wait until you're really thirsty  in between beers. That way you'll enjoy it more. Or it could be that their service just sucks. I had that meatloaf sandwich, the smoked meatloaf sandwich, and the smoke flavor was so heavy my breath set off the smoke alarm when I came home. Anyway, it was hard to eat. But my fries were perfect. 

Nic:  Lucky you, my fries were overcooked and dry. How is that possible? Anyway, you like the beer, and that's why we're going. For the beer, not the food.

Ran: That's right. We go for the great beers on tap, and not the food. Except for the hummus. That was pretty good.  

Nic: Maybe I'll try the frog legs next. Or start drinking. 

Ran: Next time, I'm going to order a hamburger. Their service is so slow, it will be aged beef by the time it gets to the table.

Nic: What next time?

Wonderful stay! Upon check-in, had a very pleasant experience --it was seamless, fast and easy. When I walked into my room, it smelled freshly cleaned and the modern decor was so nice! The bed was also VERY comfy, probably the most comfortable bed I've slept in while traveling. My room faced the Truckee River, which was awesome. I must also note the lovely lobby, art gallery, restaurant, and bocce ball court that is attached to the hotel. The only thing I wish my room had, was a microwave. I booked my stay through Priceline and got a great deal, so maybe that's why the microwave wasn't included? Ha, I'm not sure, but it doesn't negate the rest of the awesome I experienced at Renaissance Reno.

We went there with a group of 6 and sat outdoors, it was very relaxing.  Great music playing softly, the drinks were great and so was the food.  We live in Chicago where we have some of the best Mexican food, this is the only reason they did not get 5 stars.  Overall we enjoyed our visit.

This place is horrible I've waited now about 4 hours and still have not been seen I watched a gentlemen walk out with blood dripping down his face bc they didn't see him for three hours this bullshit I will never ever come back here

I wish I could put zero stars because of how AWFUL the service was. My boyfriend and I ordered take out (well first, delivery- then got a call after the order was placed that they aren't delivering today, okay whatever, we'll pick it up no problem) after getting there 25 minutes after the order was placed ( just like the young girl on the phone said) she proceeds to help every other car before even taking the signed copy receipt back! Another 25 minutes later and no one has come back to talk to us or tell us why our food is taking so long. Wish I wouldn't have paid for it and just left!

I feel bad giving this place three stars - I've had Dr. Rowbotham for both general and gynecological exams, and she's been friendly, attentive, knowledgeable, and about everything else you could wish for in a doctor. I've had the same nurse every visit, and she's always been the biggest sweetheart and amazing with taking vitals/blood/etc. The offices are immaculate and in a beautiful location.

However, if I were rating this place on the merits of the resident dermatologist, I would have to give it one star. I've had a lot of very unfortunate changes in my skin over the past year, and given the other great experiences I've had here, I assumed visiting the dermatologist would be the same case. But I don't think I've ever had such an unpleasant, unnecessarily humiliating doctor's appointment in my entire life. Dr. Bachurina is condescending, unhelpful, and told me absolutely nothing I didn't know ("You have acne" - no shit, Sherlock. That's why I'm here). She talked to me like I was an idiot child, examined my body without telling me what she was doing, and was just ... I don't know ... mean. I like a doctor to be honest with me when it comes to my health problems, but she flat out told me I needed to pluck my body hair (which I feel is greatly out of line - I'm there to figure out why I have it in the first place. Making me feel ugly for it is another thing). When I told her I run regularly, she just smirked at me as if she could barely believe it. She also answered none of my questions (except in a roundabout way), misspelled my name wrong on my prescription, sent it to the wrong pharmacy, and gave me no helpful followup when my blood work came back and the results didn't pinpoint what was up with my skin.

All in all, while I can't recommend most of the services enough, avoid the dermatologist here like the plague.

Great little dive bar on the outskirts of St. Pete right on the inlet. Mostly outdoor seating - no fans so on a hot day it can be brutal. Two food items we tried to order were out of stock. We got the fried shrimp basket with spicy fries and they were good. They have a full bar so you can get pretty much whatever you want. 

As far as Covid precautions go - there is some social distancing with tables, masks are asked to be worn when going in and once seated you can take them off. The servers had masks on but we noted that often times the mask was being worn below the nose.

I had my engagement ring made there and it was the most pleasant experience I could have hoped for.  Anna and Page made the most perfect ring I could have imagined.  We have now just picked up our wedding bands and they are equally incredible.  I am so thrilled we chose the Bario-Neal team to make our bands.  I wear my engagement ring every day and it always looks stunning!

Thank you!!!!

NO. JUST. NO.
One of my dearest friends wanted to have her birthday gathering here!
It was sad that growing up Applebee's used to be the JAM and now all the millennials are choosing hipster food options that will likely make this place go out of business. The truth is that this place will probably go out of business because you can spend a lot less somewhere else and it be fresh flavorful food.  Their food is like pull it from the freezer and slap it in the microwave, then let it sit under the heat lamp for 20 minutes and then bring it out.  It's so expensive. No thank you.
I also tried to be super patient with our waitress because we were a large party but it took foreverrrrr to get the alcoholic beverage (that tasted like water, probably bc it was a happy hour special drink - don't get the lemonade special drink, no way). And I walked up to the hostess and asked for some silverware.  I got all apps I think you could pick 3 for $10? The pretzels were decent, but everything else was nasty. I don't recommend and I won't be back.  Ahhhh it is so sad!!

I had high hopes for this place after seeing the other reviews- but left very frustrated and disappointed due to the lack of instruction. The setup is visually impressive and seems easy enough- you sign a computerized waiver, sit around watching the group in front of you go, and then go in to watch a safety video. Then the "instructor" comes in and repeats exactly what was said in the video, and you get suited up. Unfortunately it seems the only thing my instructor actually taught was how to put on the helmet and suit. Upon going into the wind tunnel, the instructor, Alex, seemingly spent the whole time trying to lift me off the floor as the airflow didn't appear to be powerful enough to lift me, even in the body position demonstrated in the video. For iFly advertising they support guests up to 300 pounds, myself weighing in at 225 or so seemed to be too heavy for their facility. It was even worse for my friend that I was visiting with. Despite the fact that the training video explained to use that the instructor would give feedback via hand signals, the instructor never came into my field of view during the entire time in the wind tunnel (despite me actively looking out for his hands the whole time). As continually doing face plants on the metal grate on the floor was no fun, I tapped out after the first "flight". From watching the instructor's mannerisms, he seemed more interested in putting on a good show for spectators rather than instructing students. I spoke with several other employees and asked for a manager at the front desk, but nobody seemed particularly interested in helping, so I left. 

While others seemed to have a good time, I recommend skipping this place if you weigh over 200 pounds. And try to get a better instructor than the one I got stuck with. Unfortunately for me and my friend, iFly was a complete waste of money. 

Been on the fence between 2 and 3 stars for this place. Going with 3 since the lighter people in my party thoroughly enjoyed, but again, stay away if you're heavier.

I was visiting a family member in Tucson and really wanted to grab a beer, something different and delicious. A friend of mine told me this place would not disappoint and it didn't. Haven't a clue if it was timing or just pure luck... but they had bottles of 120 minute IPA from Dogfish Head. Mmmmm, heaven in a bottle! they don't call it the holy grail of beers for nothing! I think most of the good beers are from the bottle store, they called it? 

The pizza smelled inviting too but I had already eaten just before so I had to take a pass. The only con I'd say is the parking lot, it's pretty small. I'd go back though!

Was visiting UCSB for the day only to discover that breweries had popped up all over the place. Of course, I had to explore. This was our second stop and I definitely see the appeal. It has a good sized parking lot, I had zero trouble finding a spot. They have an outdoor patio right out front with benches and tables with umbrellas. We were there on a Friday evening and were able to order our drinks and find a table right away. There were a few groups doing gift exchanges and meet ups (you could tell because they had matching t-shirts haha) but I enjoyed the laid back vibe everyone seemed to portray. I noticed people of all ages here. I thought being so close to the university it'd be nothing but college kids but that wasn't the case at all. 
The bartenders did seem a little unapproachable. Like they didn't really want to help anyone and kept walking past you waiting for the other bartender to help you instead. That was my only negative. The beer menu is creative and makes you want to try all the beers. I tried 2 different beers (i can't remember the names of them) and enjoyed them both. It's a nice spot to meet up a friend and have a drink. They don't serve food but they're cool with you bringing food on your own or getting food delivered. If I still lived here, I'd be here often, for sure.

First let me start of by warning, parking is terrible and the valet is a scam. You have to valet, so if you don't want to pay the $7, park before you enter parking lot. It is all used for valet. Which you still wait 30 mins for your car. The restaurant atmosphere was the best New Port Richey has to offer. It is five stars and can compete competitively with surrounding beach restaurants like in Clearwater. The food was good, I think they still have the quirks to work out. Wait staff was attentive, yet odd. The beach view and band was on point. Beautiful sunsets from the deck. We will be back! 
Side note- if coming from water be aware of the sandbar, 15 yards out. Hitting it wouldn't make a pleasant day out lol
Service is a bit slow. But staff were very polite. Can't beat chilling on the patio. Nice off the path place for a drink.

The best.... simply put, Diane's is the best. Debate your auntie with the bad hip and bad perm, because it's seriously the greatest deli and it isn't up for debate.

Now when I say that this the best deli that I've EVER been to, I absolutely mean that.  For those of you who say Wawa has good sandwiches, go fuck yourselves. You must love Spam sandwiches and Arby's, because you absolutely do not know what a real authentic sandwich is. The only reason I stumbled upon this place is because I won a free lunch at work and Diane's was one of the options. I decided to do a little recon and try it before I wasted a free lunch on it......and boyyyyyy am I happy I did.

I decided on my first trip to try my 2 favorite meals. A hot roast beef sandwich and a buffalo chicken wrap.  I was told at work that if you eat from here you'll have a meal for at least 2 days because they give you such big portions, but I took that with a grain of salt because people like to exaggerate.... they weren't lying though. Look at the picture of the roast beef, LOOK AT ALL THAT MEAT! (insert that's what she said joke here)

They do not gyp you at all when it comes to their portions like I stated earlier. I swear they had to butcher half a cow for that sandwich alone. They give you so much meat that the bread is essentially there like a garnish, but I must say a delicious one. They use Jewish rye for their sandwiches and it's a perfect touch. Mix that with the Russian dressing and coleslaw (which I hate) and you have perfection. Even with bullshit ass coleslaw on it. Also the buffalo chicken wrap was fucking delicious as well.. not beating Belmont Grill (which I mentioned in episode 1 of the Just Grubbin Podcast) but it's tied with the Perky Cafe at number 2 on my big board of BUFF-A-LOWWWWW wraps.

Diane's is so good that I ended up going back 5 times in 8 days.. yes you read that right 5 times...a work week. Each time I bought a different meal, like the hot roast beef Reuben, hot Romanian pastrami, hot corn beef patty melt, the roast beef hoagie, and the Heart Burner (hot Italian sausage, melted provolone, fried onions, hot peppers, and Russian dressing) and each time Diane's delivered like Tom Brady in clutch time, I haven't had a bad meal yet. HERE IS THE BEST PART THOUGH! I've gotten like 7 different sandwiches and I've probably spent 50-60 bucks . Cheap ANDDDD delicious?

Can't beat that. I do have to go try their breakfast out one day because it HAS to be good.
I definitely give Diane's sidewalk deli the Tom Brady rating. GOAT, THE BEST,  THERE WILL NEVER BE ANOTHER LIKE IT! (again, not up for debate, that's what your Aunt Patrice is there for).
Very clean office! Wonderful customer service, very educated staff that explains everything on detail, flexible schedules, payment plans! Recommend this office highly

Better than average Chinese buffet, but I have had some things from the line that were simply inedible. The variety is rarely exceeded, but the quality can be bettered most places where you can order by the plate. The thing I lost appreciate about this place is the unlimited sushi on the buffet line. Not the freshest or best, but if you have the yen, it fills the square, no matter how big your square is.
There every Saturday for breakfast.  Great family feel. Debbie #1 Waitress in Philly.
Excellent in every aspect!!!! Highly recommend!! My daughter's and I love the lunch specials! Great food, great service! Give them a try and you too will be hooked!!

Dr Beus is seriously amazing! I have always had a massive fear of having work done on my teeth. Unfortunately, I needed to have a root canal, so I took a deep breath and called Sierra Endodontics to see if they could help me. Sierra Endodontics not only got me in promptly after I expressed the amount of pain the tooth was causing me, but Dr Beus was able to fit me in to her schedule last minute that same day to do the root canal to relieve me of the pain it was causing me. After I made it very obvious that I was terrified (I was trying to be brave but that wasn't working), Dr Beus and her assistant were so kind and understanding and patient with me. They both walked me through everything that was going to happen throughout the whole root canal process, and made sure to answer any questions that I had (which was mostly me asking if stuff was going to hurt ‍). For the most part, the root canal was painless, and I would highly recommend seeing Dr Beus if you have a fear of pain and need a root canal like I did. Thank you Sierra Endodontics for taking care of me :)!

What a terrible shopping experience! Asked a worker where to find soap making products and was briskly pointed in a general direction. There are signs on the walls but they are all below the level of the shelves so they can't be seen from anywhere except the isle along the wall. Nearly impossible to find anything. The prices are very high compared to online and even other brick and mortar shops. I honestly can't see how they stay in business except that they carry a lot of products. I recommend doing your craft shopping elsewhere!

I atmosphere was great; we hit it up around 1pm and so was the food. The app we had was stuffed pig, which are potato skins with bacon, andouille sausage, cheese, and cilantro cream. They were good, but I'm not a cilantro fan .
I had the hop house horseshoe w/ brisket. The brisket was amazing--my sister-in-law had the brisket platter and loved it. She had the coleslaw and mashed potatoes with beer/bacon gravy and said they were the best potatoes she's had! The only issue with my plate is the portion was huge. I've always wanted to try a horseshoe because I've heard good things, but half the portion would have been perfect. Other than that, the rolls were amazing and the price was great. 34$ and I left a 20$ tip--the waiter had a lot a tables but kept us in the loop about our food.

Decent food at decent prices. You can't really go wrong with Chevy's.

Make sure you try the Ooey Gooey Chewy as dessert if you go out with a group. It's so AMAZING.
Lee is the best!  The best kept secret in Reno.  Prices are reasonable and she does the best pedicure, manicure and waxing.

Walked in and was taken back right away only got a pedicure. Very nice place and clean. The staff spoke good English I understood all of them. Very nice and friendly made me feel very comfortable. Prices are very good for the service they took their time and gave a great message, great service. Love the back massager seats.

Despite eating tons of poboys on my trip i never got tired of them. My last meal of the trip (half before my flight and half, to the envious looks of the other passengers) was a a shrimp po-boy from Johnnys. Though I think Domilese's edges them out a little you can't complain with the stuff they're whipping up a johnnys.
Owner Kenny is a super nice guy ! Explained process and repairs necessary following a Hurricane . Very satisfied with quality of work .

Came here a couple times, the first for coffee and brekky. This is a true Italian restaurant judging by the observation that almost all the staff speak Italian! 

Coffee was excellent. Seating has several options, downstairs is more of a cafe with tables, booths & bar seating whilst upstairs is a more formal restaurant. 

For dinner I went with small tasting plates and they were ok. Wine selection was excellent but the highlight was the attentive service of Ben behind the bar. He took me on a virtual wine tour of Italy allowing me to taste 3 wines at a time before choosing each glass. Would have been much cheaper to just buy a bottle but the variety was fun.

Stopped in to the aquarium restaurant to have a drink at the bar and enjoy a cool, aquamarine vibe whilst enjoying a cleverly named martini with some friends.
The bartender was great, she made drink suggestions and truly seemed to take pride in her mixology.
The atmosphere was breathtaking. They have the most amazing aquarium with such a huge number of marine life. I circled the restaurant 3-4 times just taking videos, and enjoying the wonders of the deep blue sea. 
The tab was pricey, but I payed happily, almost feeling guilty, as if I should have paid an extra $40 just for the aquarium tour, lol. I highly recommend checking this place out, the experience is worth it.

The five night stay at Place d'Armes made our first trip to New Orleans a wonderful experience.  The hotel is located in the French Quarter...a half block from Jackson Square and 2 blocks from Bourbon Street.  The staff made me feel at home...very helpful and nice...especially Miss Brenda with the continental breakfast every morning.  I highly recommend first timers to New Orleans to stay here...immerse yourself in the culture.  We will definitely stay here again.

Tonight was our first trip to Kona Grill but definitely not our last.  The blue bubble display when you walk in is very unique as was the decor, very cosmopolitan.  Our waitress was more than attentive.  We never had to ask for refills and the food was presented in a timely manner.  We had Edamame for starters and the Macadamia Chicken and the Broccoli Chicken for our entrees.  They were both delicious and we will definitely return.

Reservations definitely needed. We had some great haddock and tilefish. Despite being very busy our entrees were perfectly cooked. I didn't give them five stars because their presentation was sloppy.  The food looked like it was hastily put on the plate. A good value for the money based on food quality.

I called Mike in a panic, my son goes to the local University and I am out of the area and needed to find him a bed. Mike took my call, advise me on which bed he recommended. Mike had my sons bed to him the next day at 9 AM! Thank you for making everything so easy,

Beer me! Little Harpeth was a fun Saturday stopover. I saw Cousins was going to be there so it was the perfect time to check out both. The brewery is tucked next to the river on the east bank. Use Waze to get there, you'll need it. The space is huge and they have an interesting way of using it. There is a front taproom and a back seating area. Then they have an outdoor area. This place is great for groups! They even have corn hole to keep you busy.

Out of all of the local beers, Little Harpeth's brews sit solidly on the top half of the list. The lighter ones for sure. I tried a funky cheese beer and it was yeasty, too yeasty. You'll either love it or hate it. That's for sure. They other secret is that they have a gluten free beer for all you non-gluten people.

Definite 5 starts for service and getting out here when he said he'd be here!! Ted showed up, found the issue and fixed it! Fast, fair, and an overall great guy to have on your call list when the heat goes out. Will definitely be using him from here on out!

We order lunch and dinner through GoWaiter a little more often than I'd like to admit.  I particularly enjoy it on home alone nights.  There is a pretty hefty variety that includes local and chain restaurants...BBQ & sports bars through nicer establishments.  

Delivery is consistently timely.  The one time there was a delay, the dispatch (??) guy called me to explain and gave me a discount code for a free delivery.  The delivery cost is $3.99, which given that most pizza places charge for delivery, is not a bad deal.

I felt like we were at Ed Debevic's in Chicago as the hostess and waitress could've cared less that we were there. The waitress tried to tell us about the special burger and literally said "I can't remember what all is on it".  She seemed irritated we didn't want to order the second we sat down. 

We contemplated leaving but had already ordered a beer so decided to try the food. The burgers were "average". I ordered a burger cooked medium and it had no pink, my daughter ordered a burger cooked medium well and it was pink in the middle.

We won't be heading back anytime soon.

Last night's drive-through line was crazy-over an hour wait to get to the window to get your food. Employee repeatedly apologized for the long wait. Employee stated that they are extremely understaffed-with the person at the register also preparing the food and had recently just joined their team. Lobby area was closed as well. To top it all off, similar to months before, they only accepted cash so be prepared when getting food here.
My dog loves coming to the Willingboro Veterinary Clinic and I do too. The vets are so nice and good with my dog. I highly recommend this practice to any pet parent.

Went here for a late bite to eat last night, and it was a toss up between Kabob Express and Naanolicious.  Boy did we choose poorly.

First of all the woman taking the orders had no idea what was available on their very limited menu, nor did she have any idea what came with each dish.

We decided on a couple of donairs, with a bottle of water and a bottle of beer, it came to $25.00, I was hopeful for a big donair at that price.  

We sat down, and waiting for our food.  I watched the cook use the phone, shake hands with numerous customers, and generally just hang out before starting our order.  Unfortunately, washing his hands was not on his agenda.

We ended up taking the donairs to go, as there was no chance we were going to eat them after watching him touch half the restaurant before cooking our meal.

The donairs were also tiny.

I can not express how gross this place was.

This is definitely  the best Indian Food we have had in Philadelphia so far!

We ordered  take out and they had it ready to go within 20 Minutes. The Rice and Cheese dumplings were tasty, but I would try something else from the menu next time as far as appetizers go. 

We ordered Chicken Korma and the Chicken Tikka Masala which both were absolutely amazing...we found them to be tastier than Ekta. If you like spicy I would ask them to kick it up a notch. 

Overall, Tiffin was a great experience and we will definitely be going back soon!

Listen, there is no such thing as the perfect falafel and shawarma; I learned that almost 20 years ago. They are basic dishes that don't require much to make them average or good, sort of like fried chicken.

I tend to find good falafels and shawarma at grocery stores and restaurants like the old Salaam Market in Ballwin MO and the old Serrano's in North Philadelphia. 

Falafel: 1.5/5 Ok my thing with this place is the price to portion ratio. it sucked ...6 falafel about  the size of a quarter!?  I looked @ that ish and was like Ashton Kutcher come out ...this has got to be a special edition of Punk'd.  The falafel was average. The only good thing about it was the amount of cumin used. The lettuce was very suspect, like even a homeless rabbit wouldn't fool with it. Tahini sauce was average but im not big on the kind made with parsley.

Beef shawarma 2/5 again the price to portion ratio was a huge issue. It's the same size and tasted almost like Al Tarboush Deli in U-City but higher $ and minus the potted oily can meat taste of Al Tarboush. 

After this experience, I'm think I'm going to stick  to what I know  best for these food items.

This restaurant is awesome on so many levels! We have been about 5 times now and are never disappointed. The menu is fresh, seasonal, and uber creative. The hamburger with an egg on it is not to be missed! They hand make all of their desserts (which sell out early)- the doughsants are kind of underwhelming, but everything else is totally on point. I recommend the scones!

And let's talk tea. Prep and Pastry does an absolutely amazing high tea during the week. You need a reservation, but for an absolute steal $, the chef makes your table a one of a kind 3-course tea. And we aren't talking little cucumber white bread sandwiches. These are crafted, unique ingredient sammies, sweets, salads....all beautifully presented with your choice of 3 teas. So fun. So worth it. Hands down the best tea service in Tucson. 

We love this place and can't wait to be back!
Awesome meal. A must stop if looking for lunch near John's Pass - Madeira Beach. Large portions. All of us brought food home.
Teri is great. Her shop has the most affordable prices around. And she is more then fair. And a great Stylest. I highly recommend this shop.

This place is amazing!  My girlfriend normally hates breakfast and going to breakfast, but after the first time we went here SHE asked me to go back the next day!!! We have tried a few things on the menu and everything has been delicious! Good menu selection with great prices and you get a good amount of food too!! The cook (maybe owner as well?) is such a nice guy! 10/10 recommend this place, wish I could give it more than 5/5 stars!

This the type of place that you go on middle school trips. Completely full of information but presented in a cheesy and over the top way. I agree, this place is for the tourists. I went here on a trip in high school, the place is a lot smaller than I thought it would be. I went to the presentation at the Center. It was what I expected, lots of info and cheesy graphics and jokes.

If you are really into the founding of our capital, I would recommend it. If not, you probably learned all you need and want to know in middle/high school.

Pandemic update:
Rouses is my usual go to big grocery. I popped in midday yesterday to do my parents' shopping and pick up a few things for me too.

There as a staff person outside wiping down baskets. All employees were masked and the checkout stations have plexiglass.

Most of the shoppers were wearing masks. And the store was well-stocked, I got almost everything on Mom's list. They even had paper towels! (OK, one brand and they were the small rolls.) 

Since this is a large store, I felt like I could keep my space away from people more easily and people maintained distance at the checkout.
Great food!!! Owner and staff are great! Very popular place but I understand why. The new building is very nice.

SERIOUSLY! SERIOUSLY! I didn't there were European style permanent markets like Europe in America. it was like an American Boqueria! part Farmers Market and part Food Court this place is amazing.
I wondered to myself why doesn't NYC have one of these.

I went in early to get Dinic's Roast Pork and then returned for flowers, eggs and sausage! As wandered the aisles of produce, meats and candies. Also cheese steaks, gyros, Chinese food and even a bar. I found my happy place. It is places like this that make me happy!

Piping hot , freshly made pizza and house made garlic bread was prepared and served with love. Couldn't have asked for better option on a cold early winter afternoon . The pizza Maker was very kind and greeted us with smile whenever he got us the food. We ordered tri sauce pizza and house made garlic bread. 

Please try if you are in Newtown / Yardley area.

I think the food quality has gone way down these days. I've been there a dozen times and the last 3 were not that great at all. For the entrees, anyway. And the pre fixe prices mean nothing when 80% of the menu has an add on charge to each dish. 

And French? I think not.
Wonderful service and food! We were there for brunch and also had the Levee High Caramel Apple Pie! Yum
Nathan killed the game at the oyster bar today super cool very informative and looks like he can shuck an oyster like a pro
I happened in here hoping for some breakfast and got an amazingly tasty sambusa with egg and also a wonderful chai. The store owners were very kind. I will be back often!

This is not my usual Starbucks, but I visited them via the drive-through after an urgent care visit (don't worry! I didn't have covid!)
I ordered ahead, and when I went through the drive-through I explained that while I didn't have covid, I was sick, and they were more than happy to hand my drink to me!
I will definitely stop by again when I'm in the area!

Affordable quick service and their food is the bomb. I can't wait to go back and try some more bowls. Everything is fresh and portioned well. I had a spicy bowl that I can't remember the name of and we also tried to bulgogi bowl. I will be back and hope they open up indoor dining with the cold weather on the way. Thanks for being great!

Yes, the fried chicken is that good which is the reason why it's been on my "Must Do" list for years and years. I've heard and read there is always a long line to get in and this is all true... 

... but they are open till 1am on wknds so we arrived around midnight for our second dinner, Lol... no wait! I don't have patience to wait so if you are like me, come back at an off time or just go almost next door to Turtle Bay like we did three nights in a row! (see my review!)

Hubby and I split the 2 breast dinner which comes with rabbit and sausage jambalaya and slaw. I also ordered a cup of seafood gumbo for us to share. Wow, that gumbo had a shrimp, oyster, crawfish tail and crab claw in it which sure did look delish although a little too watery for our taste. Everything was good but not really over the top, wow! ... although that was some mighty fine fried chicken. 

Now the bartender / server was cool but also a little arrogant all at the same time.  Do not touch me nor my phone at any time. I Yelp. I check in. I take pictures. I put my phone up. I do not sit there ignoring my dinner companions like many do on a regular basis. Maybe, just maybe, this guy sees it way too many times and he's as fed up with it as I am. He was trying to joke about it and make conversation, etc. It wasn't funny. Let me repeat, Do Not Touch My Phone! Oh and when we asked for a Coors Light, we were brought an Abita Light. It was good with us, but not what we ordered. Whatever. 

Coop's Place is a really dive bar and restaurant. It's not all that special... but it does seem like it's one of the 'places to go' which now I've been. Would I go back? ... if I was in the mood for fried chicken and didn't have to wait, sure why not... otherwise, you'll probably find me walking right past Coop's Place back down to Turtle Bay.
The Love Burger is to die for. Don't be swayed away from the "high prices" the food is good quality. Quick and friendly service. The place is a must to try if you're in the area!

Went there today for their Art and Music festival. Went to the store for some ice cream for my son and I. The 16 year old girl with an IQ less than her age actually served me melted ice cream. As she handed me the ice cream she said "it's kinda soupy." And she actually acted surprised when I asked for a different (unmelted) ice cream flavor. To make the entire interaction even more awesome Ms. soon-to-be voted most likely to not succeed actually poured (not scooped, because it was, ya know, melted) the ice cream back in the bucket for the next would-be schmuck.

Just a few of the amazing pieces I have bought from Shark Reef both in person and the auction site both were a great deal and let me tell you these guys are great when it comes to customer service.  They remember every piece, problem and even further interest in the hobby I've had .  They have saved my corals countless times and helped me with tank issues I've cause from my own neglect like red slime that almost ruin my corals.  ( it also helped they didn't make me feel horrible about it ) . They help calculate common issues like light settings,water changes amount, filter media. They will not oversell you on any products you don't need, the results are immediate my take cleared up the next day with zero loss of coral and fish.  It's over an hour drive from where I live but it's worth I appreciate everything these guys have done for my tank. The price are amazing the corals are beautiful and most importantly they will help you along the way.
Just had Jets pizza and always good and fresh.  Consistency of pizza pie is great.  Has the chef salad and big amount excellent dressing.  Nice checkout person when I picked it up!

You would expect the Garrett Hill Alehouse to have a full selection of beers, and they do.  But we've also been so pleased with a very fine menu.  Tonight I had salmon Oscar with lobster, asparagus, and hollandaise.  Last time I had scallops, which were also delicious.  The hamburgers and sweet potato fries are a favorite.  And the (bacon, soy) Asian Brussel sprouts are too.  We're delighted they are in our neighborhood.

This company is a joke. They don't tell you there are no returns or exchanges. I had to read it on the receipt after I had already left the office. I called before the prescription was processed to try and stop the order to remove anti glare and it was a shit show. If you call to complain or want something changed they make it seem like you're being difficult and causing a problem. Their employees lie. I was told with a previous order I had issues with by a manager that if they didn't process the order they could refund me but that was retracted. I said I wanted a refund they out right refused. I asked if they could at least take the anti glare and refund me. They refused said they could give store credit. That's how hard up on money they're. They will take but not give. They don't value customers or have any knowledge in customer service. It's all peachy until you're not happy or want a change in the order. Little things like that you wouldn't think would be a big deal. Think again!!!

I have to confess, I am in love with Lucky's Last Chance. Not only was I impressed with the ambience and the atmosphere, but the food and service were great too! If you do not know what to order, go for Bananas Foster French Toast, it is just amazing. Service was wonderful and every one working here was extremely nice and hospitable. Lucky's Last Chance, wish I could come here more often.
AWESOME EATS and friendly atmosphere!!  Chris and his team provided great service.  If u like BBQ YOU MUST EAT HERE!!

The beer is better than the food for most part. We live close to this location and there's not too many other close alternatives, so we go somewhat frequently. 

My last meal was pretty good, ordered a salad with salmon. The fish was over cooked for sure, but the salads vinaigrette helped overcome it. Probably the best thing I've eaten there in a long time.

I did have an odd thing occur though, the sever asked if we were regulars and if I want to join the King of The Hill club. I knew of it, but didn't frequent the place enough to pay for membership. 

When I ordered another beer, he brings it back in the KOTH  members mug and I quote "So I can have a taste of what's it like to be a member ". As these mugs hold more than the pints, I was like all good, thanks man, appreciate it! 

The the bill comes and he up charged me for the beer size a few dollars. I found this lame as he acted he was serving the mug size as a courtesy, not that I was paying the difference. He should have asked, not assumed I want to pay for a bigger beer.
Great breakfast... Home cooked, family owned. Food is absolutely delicious!!! Beautiful view is bonus!

I stop into this FedEx about once a week to either ship something for work or make copies/prints. The staff is really great, they remember me when I come in and they are so friendly! Even if there is a lot of people in line they work quickly to get people in and out. Definitely stop into this fedex if you need anything shipped or need prints made!

Panera Bread has always been an exquisite establishment best known for their soups and sandwiches. Their bread bowls are the most favorable item on their menu. Honestly, who doesn't want a flavorful broccoli cheddar soup encased in doughy delight? It just screams O-M-G! 

This Panera Bread is located right next to Raymond James Stadium, which allows for an influx of customers. It is relatively new or at least I believe it is new. It wasn't to busy when I came in but I would imagine they receive a lot of customers being as they're located right next to the stadium. The restaurant was rather clean like most Panera Bread restaurants. Their seating arrangements were no different from any other Panera Bread. To be honest, this restaurant is the same quality as all Panera Bread restaurants. It is for that reason I give this Panera Bread restaurant my stamp of approval and rate it 4 stars.

After waiting more than a hour, our food was cold I'm not exaggerating.  From 5:15to 6:55 we weren't offered any refills for our empty glasses. The manager only offered to cook our food  again but couldn't understand that it would be unreasonable for us to wait that long to eat. I also had children that had school the next day. I think the server was polite but that was unacceptable.

A lovely wine tasting venue with a nice interior and pleasant benches on the outisde. We had a glass of smooth cabernet followed by a sweet merlot. A meat and cheese platter delivered a delicious pairing. 

Would most recommend with a small or large group.

Go here. Food was perfect. Not salty like some people have said (Don't believe those reviews now). Adequate alcohol options. Parents liked it a lot and they're pickier than me. 

Got the wings, dumplings, miso ramen, crab broth and yakisoba. All good. 

Definitely going back to try the other items on the menu.
Love this place...good service great vibe.decent prices. The food is very good,simple menu.nice place to meet for lunch!
Great food and excellent service.  Will definitely return.  We ordered the dinner for four, which could easily feed six people.

So me and my best friend went here for the nfl kickoff game. We are both experienced servers and bartenders, so we understand if you're busy but also can be very critical when it comes to certain things. We walked in no one greeted us at all servers walked by looked at us and kept walking. A nice guest told us we could seat ourselves, so we did. We sat for about 20 minutes, we finally asked a server who walked by if we could get some menus and apologized for abruptly stopping her. She said oh let me see who's section you're in you might be in mine. The host came back in a few minutes with menus and we continue to sit for about ten minutes. A different server noticed we had been sitting and stopped by and asked if we had been helped, we replied no we had not and we would be happy if we could just get a drink and asked her about the specials. She told us about them and was very nice and cordial. We told her we wanted the beer and wing special, the original server who we asked for menus came and said "what flavor you want for the wings?!" In a very rude manor we had a couple more questions since we had never been there but didn't want to bother her. We gave her a simple order, and she said "oh sorry you waited forever for a drink or whatever" like extremely rude like we were burden. I pointed out we were the only table that was only girls and that she was quick to be all over the all male tables to my friend. I promise we will tip much better than most of these douchebags if you just treat us right. We got the beer and wings and they were all alright. This experience would have been MUCH better if the server whoever it would have turned everything around. All we needed was a simple honest apology and some friendly conversation. I have never wrote any review this long or detailed but the reviews are great on this place and this is why we chose it. Never again.

Franchise rib joint. Tried to order last night but they close at 10:00 but called at 9:00 and said it was too late to order because they closed in an hour. Which was ok. Make sure if you order here you get sauce on side cause you might end up with Lard tips hidden under your sauce . Their beans and bread are great though, hence the 3 stars
