The food is AMAZING!  Enrique is very personable and fun. We enjoy visiting here as often as possible and indulging in excellent Food that he has no problem tailoring a little bit to our liking. Would recommend this place for anyone looking for good food, laid back atmosphere, and an enjoyable evening.
Awesome place.We found this after spending tooooo much time at circus Circus with kids. We closed the place and all the food and staff were great. This is now are place to go when we are in town.

We come here every time we visit Indy from Chicago during the on seasons. My SO and I started coming here for date nights about 6 years ago and we haven't stopped dropping in since. Ten bucks per head for two movies, can't beat it. Something new that I've noticed is the little playground under screen one; what a great idea. This is a cool place to bring the kids, or just have a date with your someone special.

Excellent food and service. Miso soup was the best I have had in a long time. The fish seems expertly prepared and is of great quality. The ordering process for the all you can eat was a little bit confusing at first, but it is a great deal. We will be back!

Ordered 2 couches on veterans day of 2018. There have been nothing but issues since the beginning. Salesman was great. All downhill after that. It is now April 2019. We still are having issues. Deliveries took 3 times longer than was told. Items never arrived. We called the store who told us to call corporate who told us to call the store. We went back and re selected different items to try and make things easier. Now we are still waiting for them to refund us for the items that never arrived. Never even think about stepping foot in this place. Ashley's is right across the way.

This place is amazing and I want to go back and try more things. The pisco sour is amazing!!!! I love the complementary plantains and dip. I will update this review once I get to try more of the menu.

The drive thru service was horrible the little teenage girls that were working the window on top of rushing me to order totally screwed up my order and I made a second order when I got to the window somehow both of the orders were combined and I paid for both aside from me waiting a hour to get my food there was no sweet heat sauce left and the girl rudely asked us there anything else as she was repeatedly saying while I was trying to order my food

This review is going to focus on two excellent departments of Whole Foods. 
First, the seafood section; as a seafood lover, I am very particular about the seafood I buy. Whole Foods offers an excellent variety of seafood. For me seafood must be fresh, never frozen. Most of the time Whole Foods labels it's seafood as fresh when it is. When in doubt ask the attendant. 
A word to the wise, I'm told Whole Foods get seafood deliveries daily except Thursday. Seafood prices are very moderate compared to others... especially if you shop the sales. 
Second, the cheese section offers a wide variety of cheeses from various regions of the world. Some cheeses are hard to find. I am a fan of Talegio from Italy. Many cheese shops don't carry it. Whole Foods always has it. 
Most of the cheeses offered are fairly priced. Here again show the sales.

I was super excited to visit Philly Style Bagels, but much was left to be desired after my visit. I went in on a weekday around noon, and they were sold out of a lot of bagels, which is understandable after a busy morning. No everything bagels so I went with a garlic bagel and an onion bagel. What disappointed me was that when I toasted them even lightly, the garlic and onion burned but the rest of the bagel didn't. The garlic did seem a bit dark to begin with so maybe it was overcooked from the beginning, but it really ruined the taste of the bagel. I thought maybe it was just the garlic bagel, but the onion bagel turned out the same--charred tasting. The bagels were smaller than I thought they would be. Compared to South Street Philly Style bagels, these bagels didn't come close. I will be back to give them a second chance, in hopes that I just got a bad batch that day.

This was such a nice surprise!  The barbecue was EXCELLENT, the staff were friendly and many, many choices of beer. My husband is from Texas and is very picky about barbecue...... He said it was as good as any he's ever had in Texas!! We will definitely go here again!!

Absolutely love the tart frozen yogurt here! The froyo is the same as the one in center city, but this location has an additional gelato place, which has pretty delicious flavors. It's convenient that it's right near Drexel and Penn, but there is barely any seating, and I can see that to be a bit of a problem in the future. Otherwise, great froyo and gelato!

Ordered online for curbside pickup. The whole process was very easy. We've been here multiple times and have tried most of their menu...everything is delicious!! We especially love their GIANT Tripleta sandwich. This is definitely one of the best restaurants of this kind that I've been to, not just in St. Louis but overall.
This is ridiculous, wanted to put in a order to  food and they deny me say we are to busy pushing out orders wtf !!! I been long time customer sad
Ruth helped me so much and so quickly,  she was knowledgeable,  sweet, and very good at her job. I will never go anywhere else.

Had an amazing time here! Kev and I stopped by on a whim on memorial day and we were not disappointed. 

The staff is all very nice. You can get a student discount if you have your ID (make sure to bring it) I believe it knocks it down to $17. 

So, we started outside. We got some coffee and sat in the garden before exploring. It's really pretty out there and the coffee was pretty decent. (also this is where the infamous clock is located) 

I definitely recommend the audio tour as well as the guided tour. They are both very informative, the guided tour being a little more in detail. They don't go over every painting but hit the top ones! The tour guides are very knowledgeable. A lot of people were asking them questions and they were able to respond with no hesitation! The audio tour has, i think for the most part, information on every painting in there. I learned a lot about Mr. Dalí and he is awesome. 

The museum has 3 stories. The bottom floor has the cafe as well as a little movie theater room, the gift shop and a kids section with the arts and crafts. The theater plays the same video on loop all day so, you can just hop in there when ever you please. It's kinda like an overall summary of Dalí and his work. I only watched some of it but it seemed good. I don't think its a must if you are on a time crunch. 

I have no idea what the second floor holds. lol for some reason we didn't ask about it. lol 

3rd floor, has all the galleries! It also has a virtual reality portion which was SO cool. I definitely recommend trying it out. They only take a few people at a time so, make sure you wait in the line to get the pass! (located by the open space by the stairs). They only give you about 3 mins in the painting so, make sure you use it wisely. Kev and I saw different things!! I guess depending on where you enter the painting is what you will see! I was told you can do it multiple times but we didn't feel like it! You sit in a cool chair that swivels 360 degrees and they clean the glasses before each person puts them on. (very nice) 

It was a great experience and the gift shop has a lot to offer! ENJOYYY!!

We came here for a birthday dinner with 11 people and our time was AMAZING! We can't stop raving about it! The service was great for our large group. We all decided to do the chef tasting menu and LOVED it! It made the meal and night so much easier! They just kept bringing out one amazing dish after another. Our favorite things were the fish tacos and the slow braised beef!! So so good. And the margaritas were great. The presentation of the food was great, loved the atmosphere of the restaurant.
Cool place to have dinner. It's very clean and everything is renovated. Foods are fresh  and the habachi section is awesome. Definitely will come back again.

Servers and staff are the best in the business - they do as a team and it's incredible. 
Food is really good - my faves are the steak Maui and the Carrot cake!

DO NOT DO BUSINESS WITH THESE SCU*BAGS.

Just a warning for anyone thinking about doing business with this crappy dealer (especially the pre-owned department).  

I bought a  '07 Aston Martin from them in October, 2013  Car only had 19,850 miles on the odometer and looked good.  Brand new, the car was about $190,000, but I got it for $68,500.  Sounds good, right?  Well - just like everything else in life.  When it sounds too good to be true . . . .

Just like EVERY other dealership, all they care about is moving cars, but will not stand behind them once they leave the show-room.  

I had the car inspected a few days after delivery and my mechanic found that it was leaking oil from a forward seal (among a bunch of other problems).  I brought it right back to Cherry Hill and the kept it for for 35 days undergoing 'repairs.'  

Almost immediately after I got it back, I noticed water would seep into the trunk whenever it rained, so I requested they repair it.  You know they actually had the nerve to argue that I waited too long to let them know (pretending they forgot that they had the car in their possession for 35 our of the 45 days I'd owned it).  I had the car repaired locally and - since I'm a lawyer - threatened to sue them so we compromised and they agreed to pay half of the costs (dividing $1,600).  

I then had the car inspected again, wouldn't you know it, turned out they never actually repaired the oil leak.  So, back to the dealership the car went, where it's been for another 28 days (and counting).

Naturally, the car easily qualifies as a lemon under the NJ statute, so I suggested I simply return the keys, retrieve my possessions from the trunk and allow them to buy it back for what I paid.  All of this was tentatively agreed to by the General Manager but, of course (since all car dealers are born trash), the 'owner' suddenly had a change of heart and reneged on the agreement.  And, naturally, the car still hasn't been repaired.

Now I have to go through the trouble of filing a claim with the NJ Attorney General's Office and the brain-dead idiots running this side-show are going to try and defend a case they have no chance of winning. Just wasting my time.

So, like I said - if you want to buy a car from them, be prepared to be lied to and di*ked around as soon as something goes wrong.

This was a nice facility, the coaches and members were very welcoming. Zack was very attentive to everyone in the class and made sure everyone was on the same page as well as performing movements in a safe and correct manner. A great place for CrossFit! I was really satisfied with this gym. Thank you CrossFit Regulus!

One of the bigger bars on bourbon, this is the home of the hurricane.  Almost as strong as the grenade, don't let the sweetness fool you.   It is loaded with rum. Makes a good drink on a hot afternoon.  The bar restauraunt has lots of tables and the food is OK.  I recommend it for a place to sit and have drinks more so than a place for good food.

As a newbie to the "Sonoran Hot Dog" experience, this place was recommended to me. I was told that these Sonoran style hot dogs were better than taco truck hot dogs because they didn't feel like a greasy belly bomb. Again, as a new comer to the Sonoran hot dog experience, I admit that I have no frame of reference here.

All I can say is those hot dogs are DELICIOUS. That delicious, soft, slightly sweet potato bun really enhances the experience! Also my belly did not feel like crap later. I feel like this needs to be said when dealing with fast food restaurants.

My boyfriend said the carne asada taco was very good, too. Mostly I was jealous of that extensive taco-topping bar: lots of salsas, fresh vegetables, and roasted green onions!

Loving this new airport! So sparkly and clean! Nice light it gets with big windows and white spaces that have working outlets for charging and comfy seats. Escalators in middle are very open to the entire airport and great visual. TSA was a little odd with bizarre lines but quick. 
New restaurants are a bonus and a welcome for those awaiting their flights. Meal choices were there for our gate with touchscreen ordering options for those wishing to order and run to catch a flight. Perhaps the most delightful sight was the Cafe Du Monde. Not sure passengers want to white powder all over them for a flight but it's a staple for the area so if you missed in the quarter, here's your chance.

We ate at Jack Daniels several times while we were attending a conference. The first night, my cheeseburger was 5 stars! It was delicious! Their bbq sauce is amazing and the service was friendly. We also enjoyed their Lynchburg lemonade. We went back another night and I had to send my burger back because it was cold, and my sisters brisket was dry and cold. The service was still top notch and they replaced the burger. My second burger was A + again and their fries were delicious. It's a great place to go when you are staying at the resort and I still recommend them, even though my second meal needed to be remade. The first night we were there, they had live music which made the experience fun and memorable.

Bellagio Nail Bar did a fantastic job with my nails. I haven't done them in a long time so I was a bit skeptical about where to get them done... but this was definitely the right choice! They were detailed, professional, and friendly! We will definitely be back again!
Yummy as usual!  We have visited locations in five cities and consistency in food preparation is laudable!!  Love it!

Okay WOW! This place is absolute garbage! Now I don't say this often but your gonna want to hear this. 

I placed an order on Uber eats and it has now been 2.5 hours! I tried calling and they hung up on me. I spoke to the owner and when he asked me what the problem was he put the speaker up to a fan to "drown me out" then he laughed and said "oh sorry what did you say?" 
So I stayed an adult about it and repeated myself then he did it again- laughed- then hung up!! 

Absolutely terrible service and TERRIBLE owner. 

WOW.

One of the best WFM I've been to. Great selection & really a lot nicer since the expansion. You can find all your natural foods here; but the prices sure are high!

The new bulk foods section is much improved. You can get bulk, oils vinegar, honey. in addition to all sorts of grains, nuts, beans, etc. Nice to find unsulphured dry shitakes.

My favorites here are the turkey tenderloins, the many beef choices, Ray's Wheat Meat(The dreaded gluten!), turkey salami,Organic Chocolate Animal Cookies and the Jewish Rye. Produce is nice some local in the summer; but again overpriced.

I have no idea how this place got good ratings.  The pizza crust was like cardboard & the cheese was a mess. Waste of money. Never again

UPDATED: however, it was excellent 2nd day pizza! If I order again, I'll wait to the next day to eat it

Lets just start by saying my wife and I love burgers. We once nearly worked through an entire year of a burger-a-week burger book, so we're always excited to try fun burgers.

We visited Bru Burger for a friend's birthday last night. What a treat! We arrived around 6:30 on a Friday and asked for a table for 9. We were quoted 90 minutes, so we sat outside and waited for our text announcing that our table was ready. Less than an hour later, we were at our table inside placing orders!

For starters, they have a rather good draft and bottled beer list, including an interesting O'Fallon's Wheach (peach wheat) beer that I enjoyed enough to order a six pack from Kahns today.

To start with, my wife had excitedly mentioned that they have buttermilk fried chicken chunks on the appetizer list. So naturally, we got them. Clearly hand breaded and fried, these succulent little chunks, dipped in the chipotle bbq sauce were amazing. It took quite a bit of self restraint to not eat them all and save room for dinner.

For my entree, I chose the Provencal burger, medium rare, with creamy herbed goat cheese, sauteed mushrooms, red onion jam, and basil aioli, and for good measure, I added a fried egg. This burger rocked. I took one bite and told my wife that I only intended to eat half my burger... but I had already changed my plan. The flavors all came together, even the egg. The goat cheese was thick and creamy, and dripped off the burger. The mushrooms and red onion jam were so full of flavor. I think the basil aioli may have gotten lost though in the rest of the flavors that were more dominant. I typically like my egg a little runny, which it wasnt this time, but that was actually better given the messiness of the rest of the toppings. 

For the table, we shared a couple orders of fries, with homemade ketchup, black pepper mayo, and chipotle bbq sauce. The fries were good, really good, but to be honest, I'd have happily given up the fries for another burger. It was just that good!

I do plan to return, hopefully sooner than later.

Was looking for a sushi place that was open late and came across this place. It's in a hotel area but still was really good. They serve sushi and other Asian cuisine here as well as traditional American fares like New York Steak. Besides the food my server was really cool and super cute. She also had her music playing in the restaurant which was all the music I listened to in high school. I ordered a virgin Strawberry Daquiri with chicken Udon soup, yellowtail nigiri, and a sushi roll. It was really delicious. The way they had their chicken was a little different, but still good nonetheless. There weren't any veggies in it which made me a tiny bit sad. The sushi roll was really good though. It had fried shrimp inside and was topped with salmon. The nigiri was also really yummy too. Would definitely recommend coming here. They're open until midnight.
Prices are fair, food is amazing, the bread is to die for. I like BYOB and the service was great!

los betos is always a favorite when we're out on 4th ave or downtown pretty late. it's my husband's go-to drunk food. 

this is fast food mexican, so you can't really expect too much from them. at times, i feel that there is a language barrier when ordering food, or asking for extra sauces, but, usually my order comes out right. just be sure to check everything before you drive away!!

i love that they're open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. it makes it very convenient when you're out late and just have a hunkering for a burro.

Blech.

Not even the buzz off several pints of cider and a shot of whiskey could save a cheesesteak from this place.

Awful bread, barely any meat, and although we were both charged for extra whiz, there was hardly a generous slather. A extremely gruff owner/ counter person made this experience very lackluster. Please do not yell at your employees in front of customers. You're an owner of a pizza joint, not a drill sergeant.

I do give this place 2 stars due to the fact that it's open late and right around the corner from my local. So when the boozey munchies hit after one too many, you're at least somewhat covered, but I doubt I'll return for their steaks.

This place is by far the best Mexican restaurant I have ever been to the food was amazing I ordered the fajita with chicken,steak and shrimp it was sizzling hot and just perfect and the food came really fast and are waiter was super nice and I will defiantly be going back soon for more!
Buffet style meal. Overpriced. Then you find out the desserts cost extra which you don't find out until you go to get one.

I hope this is the one off of Rob Drive I've never had a pizza place that I had to argue with them usually the customer is always right but whoever owns this place does not do a good job and training of people my orders you're never right there so I probably put together and I don't go there anymore I go to the two guys Pizza place on the other side of the street     Have to take it back I think there must be a new owner Domino's is good again

Lobster roll is to die for! Just a little kick to the seasonings which enhances the entire experience- sat outside in the rain and stayed dry! Don't pass this little place by! Food/view/great service- all well worth it!!

Pretty good if a little on the $$$ side.  I prefer the ramen at Kizuki (similar $ point) and they don't have those long lines!  If you are looking for a nice bowl of ramen and live in the area this place was pretty good!

Great place if you are looking for gorgeous lingerie.

They sell lingerie by actual designers, not just random underthings spread around.  I think that this is the closest thing that New Orleans has to an "Agent Provocateur".  They sell bras, panties, corsets, garter belts, stockings, teddies and more.

The items here aren't cheap, but they are definitely worth the extra splurge.  When you want something a little nicer than what Victoria's Secret has to offer or you want a pretty matching underwear set, this is the place to go.

Two thumbs up! I was in town for a work conference and needed my car detailed for a route ride with my bosses. I reached out to Elite Auto Salon through their website and received a reply in minutes to set an appointment. Because of our busy schedule, I couldn't leave the hotel. Not a problem for this company. Dallas picked up my car and took it back to the shop, detailed it and then returned it to the hotel for me. While they offer mobile detailing, I had some body work I wanted a quote on. Simply fantastic! I would recommend this place to anyone. Great job Dallas and Elite Auto Salon crew!! Very impressed! And thanks to Yelp Elite, Cece C. for your great review!!

This place is yet another one of those places that I drove past all the freaking time but never stopped in at until recently.  

I decided to bring some donuts to work and got a baker's dozen for about 8 bucks.  These donuts were solid, but not overly special.  My favorite was the devil's chocolate cake donut.

Aside from Lamar's (or is it Ray's now...) this is the only donut place that I know of in the vicinity, so check it out if you're jonesing for a donut.  Even though I can't wait until we have Dunk'n Baskin Robbins combos here, I'd still choose this place over Dunk'n for a donut.

I wanted to love this place but it was more annoying. We got there 1 hr before closing on a Friday night and they said they were closing because they ran out of food. What dafaq? We decided to try it out again the next day for lunch, and the first three items I tried were also out. Again, WTF?! It's lunch rush and you're already out of food? Why bother having a menu when you can just have a board that lists the 5 items that you do have? 

I finally ordered an item that they did have and I felt like I won the lotto! Finally I might have food. On the plus side, the sweet potato fries were great. The ocean sushi was subpar, and they wanted to charge me $0.50 for the third time I asked for peanut sauce. Maybe if you have a decent portion, I wouldn't be asking for more. Same goes for water. Stop filling my glass half full and get annoyed when I keep asking for a refill. Maybe you should get the hint.

My first time experience with an escape room !  The rooms, atmosphere, props and instructions were incredible! Like a movie set. All the advise to have less people than the max is true. We were crowded and some of the rooms were so small we couldn't stand up straight. 
My biggest suggestion is to light the rooms better! Couldn't believe how dark the rooms were. How are you supposed to find clues and unblock combination locks without light?!
There was a weird electronic light-up clue at the end that did not fit with the theme and was just odd. 
I also felt they rush to set it all up and forget to put keys back, etc. It would be nice if everything was calm and ready on time. Was it worth $35 a person? Yes. It is that entertaining and fun!
this is my favorite Indian food in the area - there are other decent places but I'm always impressed when I order something new at saffron which isn't always the case elsewhere.

This is the only one at a convenient location to me. Coffee, ambience and seating is good. However you have fight for the comfortable seats which seem to be taken most of the time by members of African ethnicity who are relatively pleasant. But there's enough of them there to make a Tarzan movie. My biggest complaint is the staff. They are rather cold and impersonal and some of them look like they kissed the wrong end of a baby. If you're willing to ignore that it's not the worst coffee shop to go to

Solid semi-upscale option.  Multiple locations in Philly area and location in center city is a pretty convenient locale to other activities off Broad-  Check it out as a pre-cursor to your overpriced tickets that gain you admittance to watch talented people break into song completely out of context whilst performing arbitrary tasks (musical theater (can we go see the flyers? Union? Steve Winwood? St. Joe's field freshman field hockey?)). My orzo side dish was really unique- picture Chef Boyardee at a 5 star restaurant.  I never knew that Spaghetti os could taste so good.

Hands down the greatest fried chicken ever! Service is always fast and always friendly. It runs as a well oiled machine. They have all of the southern favorites, the okra is always piping hot! I love the old fashioned candy at the check out, I always pick up a pack of Neccos! This is a great place to visit regularly or to bring out of town guests to.
Food is delicious, above average portions, & low prices, makes this restaurant a winner! And friendly service to boot!
The food was decent but the service was horrible. The margaritas were good again decent. I was pretty underwhelmed.

So me and my girlfriend decided to try out the new sushi place on Plumb Lane since it's close by. I have previously tried out their Sparks location and liked it a lot, but it was too far away for us to visit very often. We finally made it to the new location, and we were very happy with our experience.  The fish is very fresh, the waitresses and sushi chefs are very friendly. The owner was present and was also very friendly. He engaged us in conversation and seemed genuinely interested in talking to us. The décor is nice and the place feels spacious. We will definitely make this one of our regular places to visit.

went when it was not busy at all so i can't speak about the service during a rush, but the taste, presentation, and value of the food and drinks here is off the charts. you can pay the same amount at another restaurant, but what you get will not be this high quality. i definitely recommend the tequila twilight for sweet cocktail lovers, or dark and stormy for people who aren't as big a fan of sweetness but still want something that genuinely tastes good. the dessert presentation was so nice too. basically, if you're on jasper ave, this place is worth it.

Captain Markham of Salty Dog is a talented and knowledgeable seaman with vast experience throughout Louisiana despite his youthful appearance.  He was able to get us on great redfish on an otherwise off day where most boats came up empty.   We enjoyed his stories, knowledge about the local flora and fauna and just a great day of fishing all around.  We will be back!

I love it when I can ask the server what their favorite dish is and they will honestly tell me their thoughts.  And she was right, the baked mac 'n cheese and ribs WERE amazing.  My husband got the sea food jambalya and also loved it, and, FYI, the man hates sea food.
Yum Yum Yum.
FYI.... Check out the discounts online for a free entree with purchase of one, also some tours offer a similar deal upon booking with them.

Smaller, half gravel, half area trying to have grass, no division between sizes, lots of human seating, wash station with hose and buckets but no one has left toys like other parks.  
These are just observations. I have a Great Dane that loves to play with smaller dogs as well as big dogs so this was a bonus for him. He doesn't really understand the concept of fetch so it doesn't matter if toys were left or not.

I am thankful everyday that my office building is only a few minutes down the road and that I was able to: 1. discover Tony Roni's and 2. eat it for lunch.  Their pizza is always fresh and delicious, and I especially love their french fries.  I highly recommend T-Ron's to everyone!!

Amazing food, service ... five star experience!
Belgian waffles look and taste awesome, vegan skillet lights out and huevos rancheros were the best I've had. Wonderful!!!!

I've been to Shanghai grill on a couple of occasions. The food here is pretty solid if your looking for Shanghai dishes. The soup dumplings are done quite well and are worth a try. The space is quite spacious and the service was good. I'm not a huge fan of shanghai food but here the dishes were done pretty well. We ordered Shanghai noodles, rice cakes, salt and pepper fish and soup dumplings. Probably the best of the bunch was the soup dumplings. I felt like the other dishes you could have had at another Chinese restaurant and had a similar experience.
Yes yes yes! Staff is so kind. Food was fabulous. I had gumbo and my husband had shrimp creole and we were both pleased. The live music was great as well. We would definitely return!

I went to Characters on October 12th with my companion.  We hadn't been here in almost 3 years....  What a nice return :-) !  First and foremost, the menu has changed considerably (NO MORE Mac & Cheese--I am sorry, but in my opinion, it wasn't great or even good for that matter.....my motto is that a carb has be worth it, on ALL levels to order it...this dish was NOT, ever....).  So, that is one nice thing that greeted me when I looked at the menu.

The second was that they now serve a small cup of fries with aioli instead of the bread...a welcome change, especially since they give you JUST enough to not fill up on them and they are a nice size too.  As well, they also served some home made potato chips :-) 

For my appetizer, I ordered the Baby Octopus which was very good and not rubbery from over cooking :-)  My companion was a bit jealous since he had the Mixed Greens, which were good, however, he loves seafood.  So yes, I had to share....

I ordered the Sea Bass which was really good and served with a nicely sauteed gnocchi....these were crunchy on the outside and soft on the inside--YUM!  (UNLIKE the ones I had at Cibo a while back....sauteed in Sage and Butter and they were just oily ....)

For dessert, my companion had the Passion Cotta and I had the Chocolate & Cake.  They were both nicely presented and very delicious end to an enjoyable dinner...all the way around :-)

I love this Salon! I have been there twice so far this year and left very happy each time. The pricing is standard. I am picky when it comes to coloring of my hair... especially when dealing with blonde you need someone who listens to you and knows what they're doing. If you're going for color, ask for Alisa. So sweet and great at her job!! Overall would definitely recommend this place to friends and family.
Love this place! Amazing food, fantastic beer selection, great big (dog friendly) patio! I plan to be a regular!

Lots to love at the Loveless Cafe. As the Mrs. noted, the bowl filled with pats of butter is a great harbinger of good things to come. As in, good things to spread that butter on. As in delicious biscuits. Also accompanying those biscuits is their signature strawberry, blackberry, and peach preserves. And when we finished those off, our waitress Robin brought us more, which we boxed up and took home with us.

Mrs. ordered the pork chops, which came with three, two of which went home for a future dinner. Her caramelized sweet potatoes were quite good, and the creamed corn may be the best side they make. It's certainly one of their most popular. I had the grilled catfish, none of which survived to go home in the doggy bag. Wonderful seasoning. Mac and cheese was fine, the southern grits outstanding. 

Adult beverages are available. Their featured drinks center around local moonshine which comes in a little take home souvenir mug. I opted for for the sweet peach tea moonshine and loved it. There are also many dessert choices. Mrs. had the Blueberry and Peach cobbler, of course warmed and served a la mode. I had the honey chess pie. Both most satisfying. Robin took good care of us. We had a minimal wait time, maybe 10 minutes, but there is a gift shop and general store to occupy your time which beats just sitting on a bench. 

The only knock against the Loveless may be that it's just so far from the city, you really have to go out of your way to eat there. But it was undoubtedly worth the trip.

Super cute decor (upstairs is best). Italian fair is offered in addition to steaks. We were craving a food meat and they did nit disappoint. I got the filet and my husband got the pork chops. I liked their house dressing (best Italian salad on the Hill)

this is a great little store with rockabilly, retro, & pinup style clothing. their prices beat the other shops in the area and the people that work there are very nice and helpful. I've bought two Jackie O dresses from them and I absolutely love them. since my first visit, it has become one of my favorite places to stop by and check out their dresses.

Generally under impressed, although the service is attentive. French toast came out dry without butter and upon request the kitchen sent out only enough to cover one half slice. Big breakfast faux pas! Maybe their milk shakes are better?

I can't believe I hadn't reviewed Monsoon. We've been coming here for years. Oh well here goes.
If you live in west county and don't want to travel to U City for Vietnamese food you should come here. The Pho is terrific as are almost every other dish they offer. Lunch is just as good as dinner.
The wait staff is friendly, knowledgable and willing to adjust the level of heat according to your taste.
If you've never eaten Vietnamese before but like Asian food give Monsoon a try. You'll be glad you did.

I've only tried pizza and some bread, but that has earned the five stars. The crust is wonderfully doughy with a crisp exterior. Their sauce is brimming with flavor, sweetness, garlic-y goodness, and savory depth. Bring a napkin -- you might wear some sauce -- but it's a worthwhile accessory. 

We've also ordered their long bread (order at least a day or two in advance). This thing is a behemoth -- easily several pounds and probably close to 3 feet in length (don't quote me on anything, I'm full of fisherman's tales). If I remember correctly, it costs $5. Don't change your prices, Sarcone's, but this is the best value in Philly.

Intimate atmosphere with a very personal experience. Isabelle will take the time to talk about various pictures on the wall, which are some of her travels. The food is absolutely amazing. We did call an hour ahead for reservations. We have definitely found our new date night restaurant.

First off, the store was uncomfortably cold. I heard multiple customers complaining about this. We were having a pleasant experience other wise until the food arrived. I ordered the Guacamole Steakburger off the main menu, not the $4 meal. The burger I ordered was described on the menu as being a double, dressed with guacamole, pepper jack cheese, chipotle mayo, lettuce, red onion, and tomato. What arrived at my table was a single with guacamole and pepper jack cheese. I addressed this with The server and rather than say that she was sorry and she misunderstood my order, she proceeded to disagree with me. She told me that was what I ordered and acted baffled when I said it was not. I explained that it was supposed to have the things listed on the menu and she told me that I, the customer, had to specify that. I have worked in customer service for 25 years. I have done it in food service, retail, service, and call center environments. It has never been appropriate to place blame on the customer when there is a problem with the customer's order or product or service. The appropriate response is to apologize, address the issue, and make sure that the customer has no further problems. After this she offered to have my food remade, but I was eating with my 9 year old son, and did not want to have to wait for the food to be remade. After eating, I went to the counter to pay. The manager was working the register and I thought that this would be my chance to address the issue. The manager asked how I was doing today, gave me my total and rang me out. I was stunned. I have never had a manager at ANY establishment fail to specifically ask me how my experience at their business was. I rang out and left. This Steak n Shake is less than a mile from my home. I will not patronize it again, and I will actively encourage others to do the same. This is the third time in three visits that I have received poor service or an order that was produced incorrectly.

Needed a Chinese food fix in STL and this totally satisfied it. Hand pulled noodles in Sichuan sauce and chili oil wontons were our favorites. There is a bit of wait because of its proximity to the universities and it's on the popular Del Mar Blvd. We look forward to coming again and trying out more dishes.

While in town 2 weeks ago I had a desire for a 2nd round of grilled oysters. So I went to Acme cause I've seen a lot of friends post about this place on social media. The oysters were so good and came out sizzling. The gumbo was all seafood, no meat. The atmosphere is loud but in a way that lets you know that people are having a good time.
My husband and I like to come here on Saturday or Sunday mornings. Love the comfy seating, delicious coffee, friendly service, and tasty everything bagels.

Came in on a Friday at 10am. The place was empty so I was seen right away. I greeted him n asked for a haircut. My hairstyle is very easy, short pony with shaved sides. Not hard to do. Sat down on a chair, he started doing his thing, but when he  was finished, my facial hair hasn't been touched. My beard is everywhere, my sideburns are still hairy. 
I asked him "can you shape this up? Trim and make it look better?" He looked at me and shook his head and said no beard. 
Now everywhere I been, for a mans cut it usually includes facial hair, am I right? 
What's the point of this paying when I have to go home and retouch this myself??
My all time favorite Po-Boy place in New Orleans.  Great sandwiches.  Go early as there is almost always a line.

Classic French dining ,staff was excellent.  Will be back very soon .  

Each course from soup exceeded the next.

A great night on the town, thank you !

Paraiso Tropical Latin Market

I checked this place out, it's a popular Latin market that sells imported and traditional goods from Central America like corn flour, beans, jars, music, movies and magazines. What I like about this market was that there's this small food bar beside the front cash register that sells authentic Latin cuisines like tamales, pupusa, tacos and many more. Here's what I got and tried.

Carnitas Taco. An order came with 4 tacos with 2 corn tortillas to each of them. It had a good amount of meat and toppings to them, but I found the pork to be so dry and was very hard to chew and swallow.

Mexican and Colombian Tamales. There was 3 different tamales on the menu, but they only had the Mexican and Colombian tamales at the time. The Colombian tamales was wrapped in plantain leaves and stuffed with corn masa, carrots, potatoes, chicken drumstick (bone in) and pork. I wasn't expecting any bones, so that threw me off, I would have preferred chicken without bones. The Mexican tamales was perfectly seasoned and had the right amount of chicken and corn masa, which was wrapped in corn husk.

Pupusa. This was a thick corn tortilla that was stuffed with seasoned pork meat and cheese and it had a nice crisp exterior on either side.

Flautus (Taquitos). An order came with 5, each stuffed with chicken in a corn tortilla and deep fried. There wasn't much of the filling, but more so of the corn tortilla.

Empanadas Argentinas de Queso y Guava and Pastel Brasileiro. The Empanadas Argentinas looked puffy, but it only had a thin layer of cheese and a small dollop of guava jam with sugar on the exterior. The Pastel Brasileiro was stuffed with ground beef, olives, eggs with a secret blend of seasoning.

Overall, food was good, but my favourite was the pupusas, Mexican tamales and the pastel brasileiro.

blake f. and I lunched here one sunny Thursday this spring....we sat in the window so all of Collingswood could walk past us and gawk...and it was pretty fun!  It was one of the first sunny days of spring, so I was sporting my sunglasses the whole time, so I didn't have to squint at my food.

Let me just say MAC N CHEEEEEESE.   More pleeeeeeze!!!  Seriously, the portion was HALF of what I wanted...but probably twice as much as I needed....thank goodness we split it, giving each of us just enough to satisfy our cheesy cravings, but not too much as to make us regret it later.

blake had the lentil soup, looked tasty...and I had the fish tacos....teeeny tiny flour discs (mini tortillas?) with delicious sashimi tuna and avacado relish...they were SO tasty!  I think there was a little chili sauce of some sort drizzled over the top too...it was tasty.

Of course, being a day off, lunch is not complete without dessert, and it was a unanimous decision to share the bread pudding.  Orange and carmel....omg amazing and delicious.....

Can't wait to come back!

Friends reserved a table at 5:30 pm on an Oiler game night vs SJS.  Told the waitress all the seats would be taken and a guy would be an hour late.  I show up at 6:30 pm and I immediately see a huge lineup outside.  I let the bouncer know there's a reservation for me and im expected.  He tells me that they're at full capacity.  I ask him why would it be full if they accounted the original seat?  He looks mad and says they can't allow anyone in that isn't already in there.  Fine, I'll head home no biggie.  So I call my friends to let them know I can't come in.  While i'm waiting by the door a girl walks out of the bar and tells the bouncer that her girlfriends are coming but will be late.  The bouncer says that's ok and to give him a code word so he knows who it is when they get here.  What the hell?????

Needless to say I'm pissed at this point.  But I'm not going to force my way into this joke of an establishment so I bite my tongue and vow to never come back and let my friends know.  Trash place, garbage service.

Once a year visit to StL and somehow, I make my way to Mama's. I've been to several other Hill restaurants, but Mama's always brings me back. Lasagna is great and huge. The service is terrific. I can't wait for next year
This place is amazing!! Annie & Lynn are the best! Super sweet and the best service ever! Way better than any nail salon in the phoenixville area

This place is a solid 3. Great vibe, dark with candles, and mood music. Only problem is this is a cocktail bar and their cocktails are just not good. Between all of my friends we tried six drinks and none were good, all just very weird. One or two ingredients off from being good. However, food was so good but small and pricey . They share the restaurant with YellowBellys. Great service!

The waitress was a little pushy and not very accommodating - a short blonde woman.

I had the roasted vegetable soup for an appetizer - very spicy! They should have a warning for it. For an entree, I had the vegetarian thali. The korma was delicious and the lentils had a little heat, but were tasty as well. The chana masala was awful - if you want good chana, go up the street to IndeBlue. The naan wasn't as chewy/doughy as IB either, but it was good. The mango lassi and rice were good as well. The thali came with a miniature undressed salad - please don't serve me bare leaves and thick red onion slices and call it a salad!

The dessert, the mango mousse cake was excellent! The carrot cake was not cake - very misleading/false advertisement!! It was pureed carrot in a wet pile; there was nothing cake about it. I did not like its flavor either.

This place just opened.  It apparently is pretty large and is BYO in shop.  I ordered delivery. 

I got the Old Italian Pizza.  Typically, I order from City Pizza but I think I have found my new go-to pizza place in South Philly.  The Old Italian is a well seasoned square pizza with awesome breadstick like crust.  The sauce is a plum tomato based sauce and a perfect balance of sweetness and fresh tomato taste.  The pizza has a pretty decent amount of seasoning which could bug some people but personally i thought it was awesome.  

The employee who answered the phone was very friendly and the delivery took about 40 minutes.

The difference between a plain old hair cut and amazing looks and style is having a passion as a hairstylist,and passion flows here! From a simple trim to a unique look,special event hair,perms,color,highlights and waxing,from children to men to ladies of all ages,this is your hair headquarters!

Tucked away in the same corner that houses Hilal Bilal Steak and Take [those were the days], Tooba Fashions is your typical little Muslim store that sells incense, body oils, scarves, thobes, and the like. They got an A+ from me today as I have searched high and low for a tarboush [Google if you need to know], and they had one red one left! The shop of course has the overpowering scent of oils and perfume, aided by the heat and lack of a/c. But the owner's nice so I will be back again.

Stopped in here while I was walking monon to get water, what a cool place! Fresh tomatoes, cucumbers and reggae music playing. I walk monon every chance I get and pass this spot every time and now will spot by more. I felt like I walked into a farmers market that should be near a beach, Love the cool music playing, really liked!!

To add to the chorus: the menu states happy hour from 3-6 but nowhere does it say HH is only M-F. So, I had to argue with the poor server, who called over the manager, who comped my drink but seemed dismissive when I suggested that they should update their menu to reflect HH days?  I appreciate the comped drink, but really, I just wanted to pay the price as stated on the menu.

Frites are okay--not Pomme frites!
Bar has character and great bottle selection.  My advice if you love beer grab a couple drinks and grab a bite elsewhere (burgers are eh?!?) and wings are okay.  A few blocks away you can grab better wings at Good Dog!
I really enjoyed my sushi burrito. I do find them to be a bit pricy, but it's worth it once you taste it. The staff is very friendly, and their spring rolls are heavenly. They also have good boba!

I missed out on the free cocktails, the breakfast, the pool and whatever else they offer due to my vacation schedule
The room- great size, clean, fridge, micro, coffee maker
No coffee cups tho?
Bed -comfortable, pillows -divine 
Shower floor felt a bit slimy, I stayed on a washcloth the whole time
fairly quiet overall, ac/heat both worked well
Didn't use the tvs
Nice touch with the makeup remover towellette- it came in handy lol
No complaints, solid hotel

got a response after two months, just to say that they don't certify the document. that is not what my complaint was about, my complaint was that the translation page did not include a notarized stamp on the same page so no one can verify if the translation is for the original document. I will probably get  response next year.

This is one of those places everybody tells you not to miss.  Then you get there and think "wtf  I could have missed this!"  

We split a hurricane which are supposed to be incredible.  It wasn't .   Horribly sweet,  the perfect drink for a non-drinker.  

We did enjoy the dueling pianos.

I did not think the wait staff was particularly friendly or attentive.

Having had enough, we took flight in the middle of a rainstorm to Finnegan's across the street!
Excellent cut at a great rate. Dani is so you get still very focused on customer service and quality.

Second time I ate here but its been a while because I felt the place was grossly overrated due to Guy F.  coming here for Triple D.  I hate to say it but it was the same.  The place was packed and the food was just OK.  No need to come back since there are too many other places to go that are so much better especially since there was an hour wait!!

Charged me for the room and tacked on an extra 20 for me to park my car in the hotels designated parking.

Forgot toothpaste, my fault, but was told they didn't have any. They had some in their store of course. 

No hot water in the shower in the morning. Woke us up at 730 am by knocking and leaving a check out form under our door! Check out wasn't even until 11.
They couldn't wait to get us out it seemed. Definitely wouldn't recommend, even if the only problem was them charging us parking
Great place to hang out, especially at night. Great views of not only the plaza but the arch as well. Wish there was a bit more to do/see around Xmas but oh well. Will def revisit soon.

We came here as we reviewed the menu on yelp and spotted "the big easy" - when we got here and looked for that item on Yelp it said "mahi-mahi" and the menu here said "catfish" so hubby was disappointed as he wanted that meal on the Yep menu.  We decided to stay and he had the seafood platter (snapper, shrimp) the shrimp had a unique sauce on them (buttery), served with rice and veggies.  I ordered the coconut chicken salad and it was awesome.  Great service and free margarita for checking in!  Yelp - please make sure you have the correct menu!

Like Lydia says in Beetlejuice-I myself am strange and unusual.

Which is probably why I like this store. We found this place on a random road trip. I came in at 7:30pm and when I walked in the staff looked alarmed. It is kinda weird that I managed to scare the staff in a scary store. What happened was they thought it was 8pm and they were getting ready to close up. 

They were so friendly and nice they opened the store/museum right up again. We got to walk around and look at strange oddities and pet a cat. (Warning: do not pet the cat on the belly even if it rolls over and begs you to). The owner demonstrated her homemade Tesla coil, and I got to look at crystals through a microscope! It was a great place to nerd out. 

As far as stuff to see, there was lots of old medicine bottles, old medical equipment and taxidermy. I am not a 100% sure what items were on exhibit and what was for sale, but I ended up with a book on abandoned asylums and a yoga skeleton because I am strange and unusual.

I feel incredibly fortunate to have found Jeremy and recommend him without reservation. He's a dedicated, talented, skilled Rolfer gifted w/ sensitivity. If my review results in a visit to Jeremy, I'll feel like I a made a positive difference in the world. He's that good.
Came here for a 5pm bite before a night class.  An hour later my stomach was LOSING IT.  Would not recommend eating here- the slices must not have been properly stored.

As a self proclaimed gear whore, I frequently find myself at Best Buy for one reason or another. They have a great selection of a lot of different electronic devices, appliances, gadgets and computers. For a very long time this was my favorite spot for picking up The latest music on cd. As the times have changed, so has the selection of music. I have had to rely on other sources for music cds as Best Buy has downsized their selection by staggering amounts. Not the end of the world, but makes me cry man tears when I think that cds are going the way of 8-tracks, cassettes and vinyl. 

Aside from music, I have purchased items for work and home to include a refrigerator, dish washer, stereos, iPod/iPhone/iPad & accessories, headphones, cameras, gps units and everything in between. Did I mention music? Rock, alternative, country, jazz, folk, rap and pop. All things considered I would say my experience has been above average. The level of customer service is generally on par with what you would expect out of a big box store. Associates were friendly and have adequate knowledge of the departments they cover.

As far as the overall experience goes, it is nice to be greeted, but I usually don't like to be overwhelmed by salespeople (Blue Shirts). They seem to do good job with checking in without being overbearing. Occasionally, when you really want something that is locked up, you can't find an associate to help and end up wandering the sea of blue until you find someone with the power to unlock or provide the product you require.  

I have never used the Geek Squad for a repair (Black Shirts). I have purchased extended warranty on a couple of fragile electronic devices (which is pure revenue and people generally don't utilize the service associated with them). Can't say much about the service as I have not had a unit fail when I purchased the insurance, only when I didn't! 

Waiting in line drives me insane. The lines are usually manageable, but sometime they get a bit out of had. I am usually the guy with one item to purchase, behind the family of 7, each with their separate transactions of 11-20 small items needing a price check and have funky forms of payment.  These are the same folks that inevitably beat me to the front of the line at Walmart as well. I hate to wait at this point, and I hate having to have my receipt checked two steps later without actual verification of anything!

Don't forget to throw out a furtive smirk or quirky look as you walk out the door to make the Yellow Shirt get nervous think that he/she missed catching you absconding goods from his domain. Several of these folks can be a little over zealous. Yellow Shirt Michael seems to be pretty cool and engaged with the customer base, so be nice to him. 

Now on to the return policy...Not always a fan.
14 days for phones etc.
15 days for "almost everything else"
Holiday purchases between Oct 30-Dec 31 can be returned until Jan 15th.
Receipt Required
May ask for ID (ID required & will be stored)
Missing Packaging-Uh oh! Subject to missing item deduction
Official policy is posted at best buy.com/returns
Don't forget your complimentary guilt trip for all returns. No matter what you return, you will always get a look like you are trying to pull something over on the cashier!

There are also some variables that can sway your review up a star or down a star depending on the day and if you end up with the B-Team for customer service. Overall a solid 3.57 stars for me bring this review to 4 stars.

Response to owner: I agree that's why I did 5 months ago. However I have only went to 1 person salons for over 15 years, not once did I have problems. Even when they were busy with other clients. Only 1 person wasn't their excuse. What about having to cancel my appointment due to a death in our family. I contacted you twice with no return anything. After waiting 2 weeks I went elsewhere. I owned a business (now closed since I moved here) and it was a 1 person business. I never treated 1 client better then another. I provided excellent customer service. If I made a mistake, I owned up to it, refunded monies and kept their business.

Friends and I have had some really great times here! Fun music plenty of dancing! There's volleyball a pool and of course the beach! People are all around having great fun ad mingling. Several locals and vacationers to get to know and celebrate life with.

The supermarket you go to when you're thinking "I really cannot afford Whole Foods right now".

Pretty standard fare for a supermarket; nothing exciting or good.  Kind of pricey for what it is, interiors feel dark and dingy, and the parking structure is a mess.  Yes, it's less expensive than Whole Foods, but not by much.  If you can do it, there are lots of other supermarkets in the area that have the same products at lower prices and don't feel as gross.

We actually ate at this place twice.  It was reasonably priced, good food.  Living in Texas, I've learned to be pretty picky about BBQ.  For me, this was a nice break from all that brisket.  The pork was moist and flavorful.  I also stuffed myself with two serving of mac-n-cheese.  This isn't fancy food.  Its just good BBQ.  A great base for a night of drinking and lets face it, what else are you doing on Broadway at night?

My daughter and I tried to get into the newer Yard House around 6:00 PM on a Friday night. The hostess informed us there would be a 45-50 minute wait so we walked over to Harvest Seasonal Grill. We had better luck and were seated immediately.

Harvest Seasonal Grill is a very nice space. It has a classy mountain lodge type of vibe. There were a lot of people at the bar for happy hour also. I checked in with Yelp and a free $4.00 flat bread appetizer popped up! Score.

Happy hour at Harvest Seasonal Grill is until 7:00 so we slipped in that window. I had a local beer, they have a decent selection from Flying Fish, Forbidden Boardwalk, Spellbound, etc. My daughter had a Sangria and both the beer and her Sangria were 1/2 off. 

We ordered the Fish Tacos - Blackened Mahi Mahi, Jicama Slaw, Tomatillo Salsa, Guacamole, Baked Tortillas, Cilantro Lime Sour Cream and BBQ Braised Short Rib-Mango Pineapple BBQ Sauce, Local Jalapeño Honey Cornbread, Jicama Poblano Slaw, Black Lava Sea Salt. Both of these items were very good. We really liked the cornbread that came with the short ribs. The tacos had good flavors and spice.

We really liked Harvest Seasonal Grill. It is a little pricey but the quality was there. Take advantage of their happy hour, they also have some food specials.

3.5 Yelp stars.

Really excellent quality meats. The counter guys are always super friendly and helpful. Have even gotten great cooking ideas from them too. Their house made marinated meats are delicious too. We have done their meat box package and that's super affordable and great to stock the freezer. Definitely would recommend over the supermarket

I like really basic maki rolls like salmon rolls and tuna rolls. Unfortunately, the rolls are always sloppily prepared (uneven cuts of fish and sushi pieces that are completely fallen apart) 

Additionally, the prices to add avocado in the roll are astronomical. While a salmon roll is $4.50, a salmon avocado rolls is double that. 

Service is also a hit or miss. I've waited over 40 minutes in the food court once for my order. It seems their space and staff don't meet the busy demand. 

I've also paid an extra $1 for a side of spicy Mayo for delivery multiple times and they never include it which is disappointing. 

The 2 things I commend about this restaurant is that they have generous portion sizes (the cuts of fish are decent) and the "Buy 2 get 1 roll free" deal on Wednesdays is worthwhile!

1) futuristic hand wash tunnel machine at entry- super sweet
2) awesome & expedient service ~ spot on
3) burgers- juicy & hot
4) extensive sauce selection- check
5) Brian (manager?) amazing customer service &!attention to detail
6) restaurant was super clean 
7) my company was pretty amazing too

Fresh, homemade, delicious food. Try the dutch crunch roll with any sandwich. We had the 3-pig bacon, pulled pork, ham with BBQ sauce. Pulled pork rivals Sugar Fire and Sando was amazing with homemade soup every day!
This restaurant is closed. The sign above the restaurant is removed and a sheet of plywood is covering it. There are no information in the window indicating the whereabouts of a new location.

Soooo...: having moved during the pandemic. There haven't been very many chances to eat out and find a new local Mexican Restaurant.
But today we had a wonderful lunch here and it may very well become my "go to" place.

Unfortunately the wait staff hadn't arrived and the manager was waiting tables... but he did well and the food was excellent.

The carnitas is wasn't ready to serve so I got a Pollo & Creme burrito (1st one ever) and it was so good!  This maybe my new favorite burrito.

My spouse got the pollo mole, which was seasoned well but a touch too sweet. A little hot sauce helped with that!

I can't wait to go back!

Definitely a more family style experience. Combos are such good deals, more than filling for two people. What I love the most though is how quick the food came out, I barely waited 5 minutes and food's already out piping hot. Had the jambong and sweet sour chicken combo, highly recommend. Will come back to try pig trotters!!!

I am a person who loves to try new food. I love Ethnic food and for some reason the two to three places I tried in Indiana, Chicago and Hawaii (so I know I'm limited in my review) I was NOT a HUGE fan of Indian Fan. However, one of my best Indian friends who married an American man hired the Amber Restaurant AT THE CASTLETON location to cater her wedding. We returned for lunch and she taught me how to eat "pickle" with naan and other Tiffins. Yummy!

I stop by during the week for their Country Breakfast special or Soup & Sandwich special. Both include beverage and a great value. 

My breakfast choice is usually creamed chipped beef over toast with home fries and beverage for $6.59 or for $6.69 a two egg ham and cheese omelette with home fries toast and beverage. Both are delicious. They have 9 different breakfast specials. 

There are 15 Soup & Sandwich specials all only $8.39 includes sandwich, soup, beverage and fries or coke slaw. 

Food is good and a great value. The service is always excellent with friendly servers.

Quite and extensive menu and inexpensive. Had the bbq burger... it was gigantic and quite tasty. Their portions are not small and don't expect to leave without buying a tasty baked good by the register!

Went here to try their brunch as their menu looked unique and good! My friend and I got the smoked salmon scramble and peach cobbler French toast. And they were kind of disappointing and did not taste as good as we were hoping. Overall, service wasn't super great either. The restaurant wasn't busy and our waitress barely came to us.

This place has great breakfast! I would definitely recommend sitting out on the patio. It's very cute and decorative, and just has a fun atmosphere. However, the tables are really packed, and it's always pretty crowded, so generally it's loud whether you eat inside or out. But it's definitely a great place to come with friends or family! I've had the chorizo scramble and the huevos rancheros. Both were really good! I've also heard good things about the French toast. 

Also, check out the gift shop while you're waiting to be seated! They have hilarious cards/gifts.

Please. Save your time and money do not go here! I have never been treated with such disrespect. If you are looking for a gay bar go somewhere else. There is a reason this place has such a low rating.
Yummy yummy yummy the shrimp was good, hot and fresh and the French fries are yummy!!! Honey BBQ chicken wings were equally tasty

Thought I'd take the time to say that we absolutely love this place.  Tom (the bartender) is simply GREAT in every way...the food is WAY WAY above average; beer selection is perfect for craft beer drinkers.  Prices are fair, ambiance is nice - clean, simple, dark and peaceful.  Good music.  A really fine place for lunch.

Love this Salon. First time here and Layla took super great care of me!! She took her time, leg massage was awesome (wish I can take her home), her polish skills on point (hand n feet). Please ask for her!

This is the best breakfast place on the beach, and also probably in the Clearwater area. Their Mexican Skillet is the best breakfast ever and I get it every time I go here. They have a wide selection and every thing is cooked fresh - no powdered eggs in sight. I only give it four stars because sometimes their waitstaff is hit or miss.

Very very very good! "The Snack Board" is $18 and has enough meat and cheese to be worth $40. Best part of our meal. Then I got a wedge salad which was so so good. The Brussel Sprouts were very good. The Firestone Pizza we liked. Highly suggest and it lives up to the hype for sure. We got here at 5:45pm on a Saturday and only waited 20 min, I call that a win. At 6:30 there was an hour+ wait. So worth it!

Feels like home in this place! It's gets no more home than your Auntie selling WARM cake! Loved every minute of Bullets. From the music to the HUGE poboy at the food truck to the $5 wine... Can't beat it! I WILL be back! Amen!

So sorry to hear Bill has passed away.  He always was a wonderful man who fought for Veteran's rights.  When I walked my dog out at the Bluffs he always offered her a Surf Dog. He was so kind and friendly to everyone.  RIP Bill.

I am such a ridiculous fan of this barnes and noble, it's my go-to place when I have a test coming up or when I need to study. They have a lot of tables to study, I will forewarn that they do not have that many outlets, but usually someone brings a multi-outlet and lets everyone use. They have the tables in the front by the starbucks, but they also have a large table in the back which tends to be quieter. It does seem that this location is a little more short-staffed than other locations, and it can be hard to find someone to help you, but they have a large assortment of books, and they are typically well organized.
Just magnificent. Profession and helpful taking the order. The arrangement was stunning. Wife was very, very pleased. The owner of the shop actually delivered it himself.
They always give good service. They may make a Mistake sometimes but they always make it right.  They're good people.

This is probably my favorite restaurant!! They Staff is outstanding! They let us sit where my dad could put his walker somewhere without anybody tripping. We usually eat here once a week. God Bless the staff and Owner for putting this restaurant here!! 10 out of 10!!

Went there last night in a group of 7. They charge $15 for parking which still is disappointing even with the $7 coupon on the back. Place was a madhouse- I cant believe the fire marshall didnt show up. Was told 3 hours for a table. Something opened up near the bar an hour later so we took it since we had driven over an hour to get there and were starved. Took 20 mins to get my draft beer which was $7.50 and not the right temperature! My buffalo chicken minis were OK but my husbands cheeseburger still had ice in it. Waitress claimed she walked around the table to see if everything was fine and he didnt mention the burger then. That was a lie-she asked a couple people in the group if they needed refills and nothing more and my husband was out smoking a cigarette.  He took literally two bites and quit so its not like he ate it then complained. She offered to order another burger but the whole group was so disapounted with their food and the wait time he declined. Another person in the group complained that her food was not very good and the waitress was not at all surprised. She said they get complaints all the time about the kitchen. Place was filthy and our sky high bill that arrived made everyone upset. Would have rather spent that money somewhere else where the food was actually good and edible. $15.63 for a double shot of jack daniels and coke which had no coke in it. The only reason this location is able to survive is because of the games. Will never go back.

The food was delicious, beer menu was sub par and the service was horrible. Went for dinner and ordered the Fenwick's Breakfast; scrambled eggs, seitan sausage, two hash cakes & a biscuit with butter on the side. I chose to go with a beer and I was looking for either a porter or a stout as I wanted a heavier option. The beer menu which our server provided was not accurate and out of date, so I asked for the darkest thing they had after finding out they had nothing which I wanted on the beer list. I ended up paying $5 for a Shiner Bock  -- way overpriced for that beer (though it is good.) 

I was there with three other friends and we all received our drinks within 15 minutes of being served, so no complaint there. After we received our drinks, we waited another 30 minutes before being asked what food we wanted. Fenwick's was not busy and had a number of open tables, so our server was not particularly busy (saw her milling about several times.) We had to ask another server to bring her over to our table to order, this the 30 minute wait as we wanted to see how it would play-out. We placed the orders and received our food in a timely manner. Our server was curt, not friendly and obviously didn't want to be there that night. 

There is a great bar in the middle of the restaurant and the lighting is interesting. As it is owned by Bongo Java it has an artsy/hipster vibe and much like Fido they offer smaller portions at higher prices. It's more focused as a breakfast/brunch destination than a dinner place.

In conclusion, the food was great, the atmosphere is nice but it's too pricey to have to ask to be served. Won't be going back, and I'll stick with Fido or another Bongo offering.
Lovely restaurant.  We sat outdoors on the patio. Beautiful ambiance. Friendly staff. We had shrimp pizza and chicken parmesan. Both very good.

Just wow. So we went the other night for dinner, as they were ranked in the top 50 in Philly of 2012. Date had rabbit for the main course, said it was fantastic. I had the Duck Confit, which was melt in your mouth amazing. I have a few food allergies, and one of them is dairy. Well, French food = butterific, so the waiter wasn't certain which appetizer would be best so he went to ask the chef. Upon returning, he informed us that the chef advised that it would be best if he could MAKE UP A DISH FOR ME. Ummm ok if you insist, LOL! It was a scallops dish and it was to die for. Seriously, what a great experience, all around. Customer service, food, drinks, knowledge of the food by the waiter.. all of it was fantastic. 5 stars!!!

Fantastic chiropractic clinic!  I've gone to see Dr. Andrew a few times now.  He makes great recommendations for easy exercises to do at home and I always leave the clinic feeling better than when I went in.... which I guess should be obvious lol

The staff at the front desk are very friendly and the clinic hours are great.  I've never had a problem getting an appointment when I need one.

The pork verde burrito was delicious! My friend got the chicken burrito, enchilada style. He literally did not say a word as he inhaled the thing! So I'm assuming it was also delicious. Haha.

Service is fast and friendly. There are outside tables under a roof. Casual vibe, a couple of TVs had football on. It's near several cool bars and is a great place for quick food, lunch or dinner. I will be back for more in the future! 

**I withhold the 5th star in order to properly rate truly miraculous food. So, although it is short of the ultimate food, I consider this place awesome.

This review is for the Brentwood, TN MainStay Suites: I live in the area and checked into the hotel after I thought my husband was coming down with COVID. The room was clean but it felt dingy. There was a cigarette burn on the toilet seat and a white disgusting stain on the couch. After sanitizing everything with Clorox wipes (a must if you stay here), I sat down to do some business but quickly found there was no internet. The front desk gave me some excuse and gave me a number to call for help. The guy with the internet company told me that he can normally give someone a boost; however, it had been so long since the hotel updated their system that he couldn't even see their equipment! I was out of luck. I had an urgent message that had to go out that night, so I checked out and stayed down the street at the Baymont. Compared to this place, it was like checking into the Ritz and well worth the $10 extra a night. On the upside, the front desk was friendly and no problem refunding my room. I hate to say this, but stay far far away from this place. Not sure how to say this without sounding like a snob, but the clientele is less than desirable and I feel certain many are here for weeks at a time.

Ordered Hunan chicken, veggie lo mein, orange chicken. Worst Chinese food ever eaten - no flavor, no spice, no taste whatsoever. Orange chicken came in two separate boxes - chicken and orange juice (no joking) 
We ended up throwing away :-( 

People who had given raving reviews have not eaten good Chinese food!

Marketed as a boutique hotel in Old City, I wasn't sure what to expect from Penn's View. I wanted to book a room downtown for a special occasion, and I settled on this hotel because it was reasonably priced and offered amenities like a gas fireplace in the room and a jacuzzi tub. 

From viewing photos on their website, I was terrified that our room would have flower wallpaper and a comforter straight out of the 1980s. Instead, our queen spa room was tastefully decorated and surprisingly spacious. And even though it was one of those snowy days in early March, it was too hot to use the fireplace. Thankfully, there was a "balcony" that allowed us to let in some chilly air to moderate the temperature. 

For the price, this was a good value. There was free street parking overnight (meters started at 8), breakfast included, and we also had a voucher for two drinks at the bar. Things that could have made this place better: a nicer TV (I think we had a 13-inch CRT with 10 channels); better mattress and bedding; and, better coffee. Without those extras, Penn's View is a solid 4 - very nice.

I have been getting my nails done for years now... I have been to places in Hawaii, Florida, kutztown, York, Lancaster, even places all over Philly and more and this has by far been my favorite place ever!!! I get gel refills on my acrylics and it was $30, which in my opinion is very reasonable. I had Elly has my nail tech and she was great. Very sweet and was so good to my nails!

I had spilled DayQuil all over the front passenger side of my car and it was a goopy, sticky mess.  I went to Boise West Car Wash and my car has never looked so good!!

Not only did they fully clean the front seat 'til every ounce of DayQuil was gone, but they fully cleaned my entire car! There was not a piece of grit or sand or grime to be found on the whole interior of my car.  

They did an amazing job & I have told everyone I know to get their cars washed at Boise West!!

Well this was my first time at this Deli, went on a Saturday afternoon at 2 p.m. and the line was twenty people deep which I hear is pretty typical for any day of the week. Finally ordering my sandwich and the choices of bread are many and the one I chose was dry and not the best.  I ordered a BLTA and there was hardly any avacado on the sandwich. I would expect more for the price.  There were so many people working behind the counter, which you think would be good, but they all seemed confused about what their job was.  They were preparing sandwiches for call in orders and taking care of the customers in front of them and I never knew who they were talking to.  The worst part of the experience was an older woman in the middle behind the counter who was extremely rude and unprofessional to the rest of the staff.  It was very uncomfortable standing there watching it.  When this particular woman asked me what I wanted on my sandwich she looked at me as if I was inconveniencing her.  She was awful yelling and barking at people.  The girl wrapping my sandwich up asked me if the order was to go or eat in and I replied eat in and then she wrapped my sandwich up to go and then had to unwrap it again.  I have never been there so I was expecting to pay and she replied "no you pay up front" and not in a nice tone.  Then said "oh yeah, have a nice day".  Maybe that girl could say to you when she hands you your sandwich, you can grab what you want to drink, chips, salad etc and then pay for everything up front, might be nice and helpful.  The saving grace was the girl who did ring me up in the middle of the gas station, she was kind, polite and helpful when I asked about the drinks and paying. To be fair the pesto pasta salad was fabulous, but the sandwich, not so fabulous.  I might give this place one more try, but first impressions..............................
To expensive for just a burger not worth it they over price it way to much and the food is not that good ether

Quick kind order placed
Made super fast, and accurate 
Quiet 
Pretty much clean 
Pretty typical. Which is good!
We got really lucky when we found this place. I was expecting an average Mexican food meal but it was way better than that. The food was amazing and the service was great. I'll be coming back.

This is a solid place to get some quality sushi. The crazy sushi roll is excellent and their sashimi is fresh for sure. But the best in all is the staff especially CK or KC if i remember his nickname well. This guy is funny, friendly and will for sure make you want to come back haha. Keep it up buddy and I'll see you in the next one.

We had a wonderful afternoon here today. Hot out but nice breeze under a table umbrella. The gouda mac and cheese bites were good. Our server was very attentive. Some folks were doing karaoke. We even saw a dolphin by the dock!

I've recently made my way back to Just Ride after taking a break from spinning. I had been to the studio once before when it first opened a few years ago.

Since I have been back the studio is under new ownership and I have really enjoyed the handful of classes that I have taken. I've enjoyed them so much that I have decided to buy a monthly package. The price for monthly unlimited classes is so reasonable and one of the best prices I have seen in the city. 

The classes are limited and most weekdays only provide 2 classes a day- 6 am & 6 pm. But these times work well for me and it is super convenient to pop over after work. I am hopeful that as the studio becomes more popular more weekend classes become available. 

The teachers that I have had so far have all been really great and bring a lot of energy to the classes. Their music choices are great and there are often theme rides based around a specific genre or artist. 

At the end of each ride, they do stretches and offer a lavender soaked cold towel which is a great way to cool down.

Just Ride seems to have a great community and do a lot of fun things off the bike as well. I am looking forward to continuing working out here and meeting people.
Food is terrible. Low quality meats, busy because cheap, not good.

VERY RUDE EMPLOYEE!!!!

I made a online order so that my husband and I could go and pickup through the drive through. When we went to the window they gave us the order and I was checking the order to make sure all was in the bag, when a gentleman came to the window and said can you please move forward and park further up since we have a timer for the drive thru. I said I'm trying to make sure that my order is complete. He said it's rude for you to stay by the window. (when there was no one behind us at the time since I had looked before looking in my bag and again after he said that). I said I'm sorry did you just say I was rude? He said yes it's rude to stay at the window. So I leaned towards the window since I was the passenger and asked for his name and he ignored me and closes the window on me as if I was no one.
