When in all reality I'm the reason why he has a job as a paying customer for his work establishment. I never reach out to corporate however tonight I was so upset I had to write an email to corporate and let them know about this establishment. I have been a loyal customer of Popeye's for several years and NEVER have I ever felt so upset of how I was treated! And guess what YES a an item was missing!

Excellent excellent excellent.  There were 6 of us, and we spent $110. The three kids ate as well as the three adults, including an array of appetizers and a stack of bubble teas all around on top of our delicious entrees.

The decor and the waitresses and the fish were also big hits all around. Our pickiest eater found depth and variety of choices.  It was wonderful.

As a frequent flyer in the Nashville Sushi scene, my most recent experience at O-Ku could not have gone better. The waiters/waitresses are always attentive without being annoying. The fish is extremely fresh. The portion sizes are great. My personal favorite sushi rolls are the Playboy, Tennessee Two-Step, and sunrise roll. Go eat here, you won't be disappointed.

I tried to introduce my husband to sushi here. It took me another year and a half to convince him to even TRY sushi again. They hid their mistakes with wasabi - and we both vomited a few hours after we left. Sooo awful. And unless I'm mistaken, part of a sushi chain. Gross.

I purchased the high end delta polished nickel syst for my master and guest bath - wow - this stuff is impossible to clean - I purchased the recommended cleaner and polish - nope water spots remained- my housekeeper and I worked hard fir 3 hours polishing (rubbing hard) with silver polish - that cleaned and shined but wow - do t want to do that every week !!  Any suggestions-anyone!!

This Safeway is decent, it is always well stocked. Finding someone to help you though is another story. Once you do find someone though they are definitely helpful. If you are ever in a pickle for lunch stop in and have a sandwich made, they are really quite delicious. Everything you could ever need is here except sometimes there is no cream of celery soup which is a weird thing to want but I use it for lobster bisque soup!

Honestly I just come here for the New York Cheesecake Pancakes, AMAZING!  I'm a fan of any place that serves breakfast all day, everyday.  Don't visit too often, but for the most part restaurant is usually well maintained and the service is hit and miss.

Recommended by a friend and it exceeded all of what I heard. One of the nicest most enjoyable casual dining experiences ever. Great ambience with the giant brick pizza oven . Terrific, knowledgeable, patient, and responsive service. Pizza delivered. Umbra was great. Te marguerita d.o. Was really good. The tomato bread soup was perfect. Will definitely return.
Been going here for years, glad things are opening up again. Service was great and the food was excellent as always.
Great pizza. Got an 18" meat lovers and 18" cheese. Not easy to satisfy two people, from NY and Chicago respectively, but you did. We'll be back.
Great little store with interesting items. You can't really haggle though bc the space is rented by vendors.

I admit I was not interested in noodles and was dragged in here one day when my girlfriend wanted to try it.  I know that this is a noodle house, but I was disappointed to find out that I couldn't order anything but the noodles.  Anyway, long story short I tried the duck noodles and they were really good. As it turns out the noodles come in a soup, and so I had a duck noodle soup for dinner.  It was tasty and I left full, but inevitably I was hungry again later.

Delicious food! Recommend coming at least a minimum of 45 min to an hour prior to closing. Anything less and buffet food will be older and closer to the bottom. That will happen at any buffet so just a tip. Their cheese rangoons are amazing and I also love their General Tsao Chicken. Their honey chicken is a favorite, as well as their curry and the green beans that they have. Can't go wrong for a good all you can eat buffet. They do have small sushi rolls like California rolls, but again, if you come closer to closing it may be a little more picked over. The staff is super friendly and even remembers my drink order every time I go. You can tell I've become a regular. Highly recommended!
This was the worst Turkish food I have ever eaten.  I sent my plate of lamb kebap to the trash.  Will never waste my meal or money there ever again.  HORRIBLE!!!!!!!!!  Would not recommend.

Great looking room with plenty of TVs.  Breaded wings are not wings, call them something else so people don't accidentally order them (me).  Burgers used flavor free meat, served over cooked.  Service was inadequate.   We literally had one server for our group of 38.

So The Aristocrat is one of my favorite places in Indianapolis. I have tons but if you the make my list, you're impressive. The food is always really good. They have awesome fish n chips and I've never gone wrong with any of their salads. They are really filling and can make you feel full for the entire day. I'd split a salad if you're going with a friend. If it's nice outside, eat outside. They have outdoor dining that usually isn't always full. In the wintertime, you can snuggle up inside their cozy bar and restaurant and look at all the old decide on the ceiling and walls. Such a nostalgic, well-looked after, restaurant and bar. I couldn't love it more.

The worst Chinese restaurant I have ever visited.
Food are nasty and service are awful.
We went yesterday Saturday noon try to eat dim sum, after seated for more than 40 minutes never see dim sum carts pass by. And we have to call the waiter to get the food then the dim sum came with really unpleasant presentation. I would say they serve the food just like something that we are about to throw to trash at home.
Never ever go to this restaurants.

Came in here today to get some range time with the new gun I just got, and it was a great experience. Vince helped me with everything and explained how the range worked in about 5 min. The prices were Aweosme too, $10 for a daily pass, and about 15 bucks for some regular range ammo. The whole experience was great. If your looking for a place that is very friendly and knows there stuff, this is the place. Thank you Vince!

I have recently moved and will still be coming here although it will be a 24-mile round-trip.
The Owners and staff are wonderful. Caring and thoughtful. They know all their customers by name.
When you walk in you feel welcome.
The expertise and experience of the staff are above par. I recommend this business often  to others.

If I could give this place a zero star I would. This place sucks. Don't live here. They don't care about anything the residents say. There furniture is so cheap. I broke a mirror and told the company and they told me it would be $300 to do a replacement. I then went and bought the exact mirror for $92 but the management couldn't even give me a measurement of it. There lazy!! It is extremely hard to sleep and study during the week because our upstairs neighbors were moving furniture around all hours of the night, banging on the doors, walking up the stairs super loud and that's on them but we tried to complain to the RAs and they couldn't care less. Then when we would throw parties at our place they would come to our door an get mad at us at 10 pm on a weekend?? even though they wouldn't yell at our neighbors at 9 pm on a school night because that was the RAs house.

So a very disappointing meal. I will say the house salad was The Best!! (Only reason for the third star) So in the mood for a great salad...go! The server was on top of drinks and super friendly. I had the NY Strip, rare, it came with NYO mac n cheese. The steak while cooked correctly was desperate for salt! There was zero seasoning...wait there was a pad of seasoned butter placed in top. It did little to help. My fiancé had the rotisserie chicken, decent flavor but dry so the au jus was appreciated.

We were very excited to have our baby shower sprinkle at Just Pop In. I called a month ahead to make a reservation without a problem and when we got there no one could find a reservation. They directed us to a nice area to sit in but did not offer to arrange tables for us, to the point where  another customer offered to help us arrange the tables for our party. No big deal, we moved on. 

Food was delicious, we will give them that. 

I asked how to order popcorn since we were dining in or if there was a menu for popcorn since I had seen one online and our server acted confused. I asked again after a while so she left, came back and said a manager would print one off and we could order from our table. We continued to open presents and an hour later no one ever came back to give us options for popcorn. That being said we never actually ate any popcorn. 

When we asked for silverware, the waitress nicely took my 3 year old niece's silverware and handed it to another person. We then ended up getting up to get silverware ourselves out of a basket by the entrance since there wasn't enough. 

Our tip amount, which reflected our experience, finally got the manager's attention when she came over and ever so nicely inform us we needed to tip more after our horrible experience.  All in all very tacky, especially from a manager, to address our baby shower as a group asking for more of a tip without checking in on us once throughout our experience as a large party. Very cringey. 

Potential for a nice spot to go to for an event, but what a mess of management, organization and an experience. Maybe a random flop but wouldn't risk it for a special event or occasion. 

One star for vibe, another for food quality.

Dont even get me started on how awesome it is that someone finally reinvented our old vets hwy favorite... but thank God they did. I live out of state now but this is a Must Visit  every time i am in town. Im sorry to see some bad reviews recently but this is not my experience. Always fantastic food and service. You dont find customers and staff all sharing the same memories and fun like this often. Im honest in reviews and would say if this was failing. Its not. Tonight i only bought takeout chili relenos. Still - service was fantastic and food was awesome. Loved chatting with staff from vets while i waited. I love love love 2 amigos!

Place looks pretty nice. Came here at night when it was 60+ degrees out, around 8:30 as their website claims to be open until 10 with last sales at 9:40. Guy picking the range told us the place was closed and to go home. So if you're not open til 10, please don't advertise as such. Place looked nice enough though to hit some balls, that's why I'll merit them 1 star anyway.

This was our first trip to this location. We were greeted as soon as we entered. Rashay was very professional, polite and covered everything thoroughly. The entire checkout process took about 10 minutes and was quick and simple thanks to Rashay . The clean van was conveniently parked out front and ready to go. 

The store has boxes and moving supplies for what appears to be any situation. Corner guards, bubble pack, tape, foam pouches, utility dollies, furniture covers, packing boxes and much, much more. Trailer hitches and bike racks are installed here as well.

The return was busier as several trucks arrived at the same. However, they didn't lollygag and we were in and out in 5 minutes or less.

I wouldn't hestitate for a second to use this location again. Excellent customer service and a clean vehicle.

The last 4-5 times I have gone to this target their shelves have been very poorly stocked and I haven't been able to get what's on my list. Just went in and only 1 of the 5 items on my list was available. Unreal! If I didn't know better, I'd assume they were clearing their shelves to go out of business.

Went to Panera after a long night of partying, and in their usual fashion, the served us well. The service was quick and the restaurant was clean. I order a hot tea and an everything bagel. Thanks for the great service Panera.

My adventure started by looking up Parks On Yelp. Since this place was only a few miles from my hotel, I thought I would give it a try since I had a couple of hours of spare time. In short, big fat waste of my time! Yelp directed me to the parking lot of the Hilton. The parking lot was jammed. Parking valets were double parking cars everywhere. As I tried to maneuver through the parking lot, I was cut off several times by people driving way too fast. In addition, through the main thoroughfare through this Suburban Office Park, several cars tailgated me when I was traveling at the speed limit. I never found a place to park, and this adventure ended up being nothing but aggravating. Do not waste your time. This app would not allow me to select 0 stars.
Paul Volpe was friendly and accessible. This was a first time purchase with and FHA loan. He answered emails very quickly, even late at night.
It's fun, it's interesting, there's cool and charming stuff there. It's not the cheapest but it's not overpriced either.

This place is the dope. I ate food that I normally don't like and I liked it. Best tacos I've tasted in town. The service is good (perhaps reluctantly...hipsters....but it's good). Lots of pretty women at the bar.

These folks have been soliciting in our gated community and have been asked repeatedly to leave.  I see other reviews saying that they received unsolicited house calls from these folks.  When I posted on Facebook asking them to stop soliciting our neighborhood, they deleted my post.  I do not appreciate having people come to my door and ask me to switch pest control companies.  Please have some respect.

Everything I've had here so far has been phenomenal. I've tried the jambalaya, the hot chicken sandwich, the shrimp salad the deviled eggs and the nachos. They also make really good cocktails as well.

Let me start off by saying that I can often be a difficult customer to deal with.  I am a little bit obsessive, so in the process of finding a Tuxedo for my wedding, I have agonized over dozens of sizes, cuts, fits etc to find the perfect look.  Well, I wish I would have saved myself the time and just gone to Brentwood Alteration and Tailoring in the first place.  I ended up buying a really nice tux that needed some fit tweaking, and when I took it in to BA&T, I was blown away with how well the staff understood exactly what I was looking for.

Most tailors with whom I have interacted are completely disconnected from what modern twenty-somethings are looking for in fit, but not Loan.  I didn't have to say very much, but it was like she could read my mind.  She gave me great advice.  When I did have questions or ideas, she was open and accommodating, and gave thoughtful answers about how we could accomplish certain goals, and what was realistically possible.  The prices are very reasonable, especially given the level of service they provide.

If you are picky about how your clothes fit, don't waste your time elsewhere.  Thanks Loan for the excellent work!!

Don't judge a book by its cover
The front of the hotel looks okay, the lobby is nice. The staff was friendly . In the morning they give you a breakfast on the go pack in the lobby.. Water
, coffee and fruit. Kinda cool... Now the room I stayed in was something totally different.. I have never stayed in anything similar to this, I'll let the picture speak for them selves ..( see pictures )
I talked to front end manager , explained the spots on carpet the smell and her reply is I will make a note so you don't get charged for the spots or the tear in the chairs or Couches.   I smiled and thanked her for her time.  call me a sucka but if I didn't get thru her with kind words she wasn't going to get the point..

Nice spa, grounds, location. Otherwise overpriced.  The room was decent sized but the wifi was horrible, the golf carts were noisy and the room was dirty. There was an old dental floss pick out on the bathroom countertop when we checked in. The furniture was more like a frat house than an upscale hotel (see pic of sofa) For $2k for 5 nights I feel like I got fleeced.

We had a filling and tasty meal of falafel, kebab, eggplant, tabouli, kibbe and baklava when we dropped by to enjoy the south Tampa version of a locally-known Clearwater favorite. This restaurant is much larger than it's original outpost. We were the only patrons at first but later, more folks came in to try the Jewish cuisine. 

The kebab comes in round patties that are nicely spiced and moist. They really are quite good, especially with the tahini sauce that comes with them. The kibbe, eggplant, tabouli and everything was satisfying but not over-the-top wonderful in presentation or flavor.

Unfortunately, the menu was a bit confusing since the mains come with two sides and next to them on the menu is a list of sides... that are not available with the mains. What? Apparently, you can only get fries or rice with the mains (this was the explanation of the waitress) and the other sides have to be ordered separately. Whatever. We ordered what we needed to order so we could try many dishes. The fries were forgettable and not really worth ordering at all.

Just went for dinner tonight, was awesome as usual. We have been several times in the last few months. EVERY visit has been delightful. Yes, it's always packed, obviously for a good reason-it's very good food at a reasonable price.

I see the steak complaints,really. Never had a bad steak. If your that fickle because it's a tad above or below then go to Berns and spend a months mortgage for the same thing disguised with a bunch of lip service.

We have been to the Bradenton location a few times. It was also pretty good. We have been to The Colony Texas location on a few occasions. Couldn't hold a candle to Riverview location. We have also been to the Denton Texas location same thing. You would think "Texas" Texas Roadhouse lol. The food was mediocre at best. The service was subpar. We recently had relatives visit from Seattle. They also commented on this location's food/service compared to the location they visit in Washington state as well, in agreement with our observations regarding the Riverview location as noticeably above other locations.

What we noticed that stands out about the Riverview location, the service team. There must be something in the water or a kickass manager. The happiest bunch of folks we've ever received food service from. Fast, very friendly, and professional. The workers all appear to enjoy being there. The food quality is always as expected, real good food for a very reasonable price. We always enjoy the service and try to tip as such.

We recommend this place and foresee many more visits in the future.

I came here for lunch with my Mom and sister last month. Hadn't been to a Fridays in a while but was excited to get my old faithful. Cajun shrimp and chicken pasta is still bomb. All of us thoroughly enjoyed our food and dessert. My sister and I both had margaritas that were essentially water so I knocked a star for that. 

Also, when it was time to pay, our waiter left and don't come back for a while. So it was uncomfortable trying to track her down. When she did come by, she took a while to bring the card back. She didn't have many tables so I don't know what the wait was, but it was irritating  and took wayyy to long

We decided to sit on the patio to have appetizers and wine at about 8:45 pm Friday, as it was too late to eat a full meal. 

Sitting outside turned out to be a poor choice, as the music across the street at Rumba Room (Same owners?) was so loud that we pretty much had to yell to hear each other. In addition, the music on the patio from Salt Rock Tavern was on as well.....the cacophony was nearly unbearable.

Appetizer food: 

Fries w/cheese and truffle oil - were not crisp, lukewarm. We would have enjoyed them had they been freshly made and hot - what a shame.

Filet Kabobs:  Meat quality and tenderness was not up to standard, according to my friend that had eaten there before. I thought it was tasty, but she was right about the meat....this was disappointment #3 (music, fries, kabobs )

Dinner Plate: (we split this entree) Shrimp and Grits:  Anson Mills grits (true South Carolina Grits!) were great. Sadly, these great grits were pretty much ruined by the overly spiced sauce on the shrimp (way too spicy, overpowering and I really LIKE spicy)  
AND the shrimp were disguised by a couple nice sized ones in the middle of the plate, that covered the other (41-50 count smaller) additional shrimp of lesser quality.

Overall:  This is not a restaurant that befits the quality of a Chivas establishment, period.

Came upon this restaurant unintentionally.  But, oh so glad we did.  The food was above expectations, the beer selection was good.  The service was great.  Our water glasses were never empty.  Don't miss if walking along the canal.
This newer place in Soho was delicious! We had the bowls and chips and they were fresh and tasted great. The service was very friendly and they even brought it out water for our dog. We will go back!
All the 5-star reviews are well deserved.  I would give up my Netflix if I lived in Tucson.  The selection is unbelievable.  This is truly the best video store I have ever found.

All I can say is...WOWW! This was my first time at Painting with a Twist. It was such a great experience. It was a fun, chill, lively experience. 

Of course, when you think painting, you think, structured, quiet, instructor correcting you. At Painting with a Twist, it is the exact opposite. The instructor was fun, allowed us to be creative and we just went with the flow. The music was on, we were painting and creative juices were flowing. For those individuals (like myself) who were worried if they could paint, the actual person/object that you'll be painting is stenciled onto the canvas for you! :)

The instructor, I believe her name was Desire, was so awesome and the people (fellow painters) made it a fun-filled evening. I HIGHLY recommended Painting with a Twist-Wilmington. You will not be disappointed.

We did the Ghosts & Vampires Tour and were mostly disappointed. Lots of walking with random stops to hear stories that may or may not be true but were definitely not "spine tingling" in anyway. Just not what we expected.

My all time favorite spot on Clearwater Beach! I love being on the beach all day & coming to Frenchy's for drinks, lunch, or dinner. My Husband has never been to Frenchy's so I knew it was a must!

We actually came here twice while on vacation. Our first visit was in the afternoon the second day we were in Clearwater, we sat on the patio and had some beers and lunch. The second visit was two nights later with our cousins who live in Florida for dinner and more drinks. 

The wait was over an hour for dinner, however they move very fast! They take your name and number and let you check online how many parties are ahead of you (I like that so you don't have to bother them to see how much longer). Our server, Bianca, was very friendly and welcoming. You could tell she was working very hard and was very busy that evening. 

Our table ordered Crab Fries for an appetizer, grouper sandwiches, chicken sandwich, &California fish tacos. Everyone loved their food choices, and my Husband was so happy he tried the Cajun Grouper sandwich. Proceed were reasonable we thought, and service was fast given how busy they were on a Saturday night. 

It was all really very good! I wish we had a Frenchy's here in Michigan.

I write few reviews but want to give credit where due. This past week my central ac went out so had another company come out to check it. The person they sent had no interest in finding out why my compressor wouldn't start after putting on an initial gauge that showed it wasn't powering but instead tried to sell me a new system. My gut told me something was wrong so called Lincoln air that day and they sent Brenden to check it the next day. What a difference- he was so professional and explained everything fully -found it was a capacitor that was bad and replaced it and compressor fired up. This is a relatively cheap fix compared to buying a new system. Good company with honest employees.

We have dinner here and the food is good but nothing spectacular. I had the crab stuffed ravioli and it was warm not hot. On the positive side the octopus appetizer was delicious.. The people in my party that ordered it loved it. Very hard working staff and not bad food just nothing out of the ordinary.

Fajitas had high-quality chicken breast and OK steak.  

Our main critique is that they should take some risks with sauces.  My spice-loving husband felt the salsas were not hot enough (he even requested the spicier version and found it "mild").

Overall, we would eat here again if it was convenient, but probably would not go out of our way.

Our last day in NOLA and I still needed a muffuletta. We were close by and decided this was as good a place as any.
The sandwich was pretty good. An awful lotta bread. But it tasted good.
I would start sneezing anytime they opened a pot with some sort of seafood boil....that spice was strong!
I'm not sure if I would go back if I were going to be in the city again, but I got my muffuletta.

Excellent care, and professional staff. Been going here for years, be it a small ear infection or full blown poison oak. Always have been given an honest assessment with a courteous demeanor. It really has felt nothing less than as if I were around family. Highly recommend!

I was craving pasta for Date Night and used Yelp to find a place close to where we were shopping. Luna Rossa did not disappoint! You start with pizza bread and regular rolls but the pizza bread was so delicious. Before our meals I had Chicken Escarole soup and my fiance had a Caesar salad which were both good. I had the homemade gnocchi in fresh garlic and oil and I was in garlic heaven. The portions were huge and I can't wait to eat my leftovers. My fiance had Linguine alle Vongole which is clams and linguine and he loved it. It was definitely authentic italian and I can't wait to come back to try the rest of the menu. The owners walk around and talk to everyone like your family and when we went to leave he asked us how it was and when we said we couldn't wait to come back he gave us a gift certificate for 10% off our next meal.
Best water in Tucson, hands down. Gotta try it while  in town. 8th wonder of the world.

Thanks so much to Kimmi who suggested I go here and Haley who chopped my hair back off!!! I came on a Saturday for a noon appointment, I only scheduled on Weds. so that was nice not to have to wait awhile to get in. I was greeted by a lovely receptionist who had me fill out some paperwork about my hair etc etc.

Once Haley was done with her customer she took my coat and hung it up, gave me a tour of the renovated building, which has a wonderful history and is super adorable!! She explained all cuts get a chair massage and mini facial.WHAT?! A massage?!!! Since my hubby lacks those back rubbin' skills I was pretty excited. Other than that, Haley looked at the photos I brought in (I had a power point slide-overdone? maybe. but whateves.). She and I discussed my hair and my recently ok haircuts and my lack of commitment on growing out my hair. So we decided to go sexy soft pixie. She spent some serious time and concentration on making my hair look a-mazing.

So thanks to Haley for the awesome 'do and to the staff who chatted with my about the Super Bowl while I got my four inches chopped off. I will definitely be back, that back rub felt g-e-w-d, gewd.
We used to love this hotel during the rib cook off, they used to shuttle people the 4 minute drive. Now they do not include an Uber in your stay, you are better off at the nugget for the price!

Quick review: best filet ever!

A hotel employee told us to try Darfon's last time we were in Nashville. We weren't expecting much, but were blown away by the food! 

The filet oscar with mashed potatoes was the best I have ever had. It beat Morton's and Ruth Chris! 

Pros: good environment, amazing food
Cons: absolutely none!
Superior in every way.  The best red beans and rice ever.  Blackened red fish is excellent.

Food is good but the service I received today was so awful I will never go back. 

I ordered the caniac combo, but when they repeated my order to me I somehow missed that they accidentally rang up the box combo. The guy at the first window told me it was a box combo and asked if I wanted to change my order. He is the redeeming person of my service today and I have no problem admitting there was a miscommunication that was my fault. I get to the second window, however, and they already seem annoyed before I get there. The woman rudely asks if I got a large soda and then gives me my order. 
Me and the other person in the car realized then that they gave us the box combo instead of the caniac and came back, and the woman on the speaker sounded annoyed again, even though they're the ones who got my order wrong after I tried to fix it. Yes, I get that they didn't process the change in time to switch the food, but why was she making that my fault? 

Anyways, the man at the first window asked what happened and said not to worry. I could keep this order and they would give me the caniac combo. Well, I get to the second window and the woman rudely says "Can you give me that order" and hands me my original order without saying anything else. My order was still wrong but I was so angry that we just left. Not worth speaking to these people

The worst part is the man at the first window dropped my receipt so I cannot write a review that will actually go to their management. 

I don't mind that they took the food back. I wouldn't have been able to finish it, but they'll just throw away the food or violate some health code and give it to another customer. We actually touched the food to check if they got the order right, so hopefully they don't give it to another customer. 

I paid ~$13 for bad service and a wrong order twice

A wonderful little dive Italian place. My wife and I have ordered pizza for pick-up a few nights ago, and today we stopped in for lunch. Both visits were excellent. For lunch, I had spaghetti Pomodoro. The spaghetti was cooked perfectly al-dente, and the Pomodoro gravy was amazing. My wife had lasagna, which was also excellent.

We ordered the Supreme pizza a few nights ago, which was a more traditional Mediterranean pizza, and a welcome addition to the neighborhood selection. The crust was a little over-saturated with garlic and sauce which caused the crust to be a bit soggy and required folding the slice to get it to the mouth. I'm not complaining, because I like it that way, but you should be aware of the style. The people next to us just ordered a little lighter pizza (looks like the Caprese), which doesn't seem to have the saturated crust, and sounds like it has a nice crisp.

All in all, a welcome addition to Seminole Heights. Please help keep them here.

Went for a couples massage today, little did we know it was just going to be a light hand rub down. Every time I get a massage they ask what type of pressure I prefer. To start this massage we were immediately told that if we wanted any type of additional or extra pressure there would be an up charge, which was very different for me. It wasn't customer friendly whatsoever! It just wasn't what we were expecting. Did not feel any more satisfied or relaxed afterwards. It also was not a full hour. Very disappointed and will never be going back.

Unprofessional owner refuses to accept my calls (can be heard in the background telling employee he doesn't want to talk with me). Destroyed a new pair of pants then refused to make good on it's value ($40) by offering $25 after mgr admitted it was burnt up in a fire. Very impolite!  I witnessed another customer whom was lied to...told her her clothes she was there to pick up were "missing" and she can call the owner. She wisely did not leave the clothes she arrived with...then I learned of my pants and only after questioning of 2 employees did they admit the fire incident. AVOID THESE PEOPLE.

Came here with a friend for our first tattoos and the guys were incredibly friendly and helpful. They made sure we felt comfortable and clearly have a lot of pride in their work. We didn't have an appointment and the whole process was easy and relatively painless. Bonus: great music!

I stopped here while in Downingtown for work and walked out happy (and full...). The pizza was excellent and the service was very good. I ordered the BBQ chicken pizza which was perfect. They actually use real chicken slices and not the cubed crap you get at some pizza places. The crust had just the right amount of crispisness and the sauce was well portioned for the slice size. 

I will definitely stop by again when in the area!

This place really is just fantastic! I highly recommend it. It's not my usual place, but i REAAALLY do like it.

The service is really nice, the guys know the shpeel but they're always easy to flag down, which I appreciate. 

The Oysters Lyonnaise are fantastic - and it comes with a big whole block of delicious smokey pork belly. They were really great. The sauce was delicious.The mussels were fantastic as well. Creamy, garlicky, winey sauce that I want to drench everything in. The shrimp with fennel was fantastic too. 

I got the Pecan Crusted Fish, which was black drum. Huge portion, yummy mashed potatoes, and asparagus. I asked for a side of Bearnaise because I can't resist. 

The sweetbreads were also prepped perfectly. Some places don't smash them, and the texture... grah. These were perfect.

They also serve traditional Italian bread, it's so great. They have a long list of FANTASTIC side dishes. Try any of them. 

All in all, a great meal.

Unfortunately, our follow up dining experience didn't compare to our first. Grilled chicken breast was very dry and overcooked, spring mix was wilted and did not appear or taste fresh.  Waitresses were very rushed and overworked, not friendly or welcoming.  In fact, our waitress (I wish I had gotten her name) was rather intimidating and argumentative at times. The hostesses, however, were nice and able to seat us within 15 minutes of our reservation.  Not sure if I will return.
Wonderful food!! Best wonton soup I've ever had. Service was fast and friendly. Portion sizes were great. Crunchy shrimp was the best!!!

Reasonably priced thai food.  Not completely authentic but it's tasty, fresh, and probably healthier.  Sushi is an added bonus too.  I think they are getting better since opening earlier in 2012.  Fast free delivery. BYOB!  Great lunch deals!!

Really the only drawback to Mafiaoza's is that it is just too popular.  Word spread quickly about this gem in 12 South and the people flocked.  On Tuesdays they have 2 for 1 beer and pizza slices, but you have to be willing to wait in the line outside (they don't let the lobby get crowded with people waiting which is nice if you're already seated) for up to an hour.  I recommend taking turns sending one person ahead while the rest of you relax at home for an extra half hour.

The pizza is so good, and has charming Italian mob movie themed names.  The Informant is my favorite.  It has a creamy sauce and is covered in tasty peppers.
Husband & wife team serving up good bbq cooking.   Chicken, Pork, Ribs with some delicious sides, especially the country green beans that are full of soul.

Wow, my multi-year desire to visit Ruth's Chris steakhouse was met with great disappointment, a tough steak, and some nasty B.O. coming from the next table - thanks girls(!).  

We went to dinner last Saturday.  Let's see, what went wrong - GF's lobster arrived 20 minutes after the other food did.  My steak was of an unrecognizable cut but seemed to be, from the extreme toughness, from somewhere in the boot region of a cow.  And I burned myself on the ridiculous 500F temperature plate.  And if you are dismissing that last point as my own fault - they advertise the plates at that temp after all - then the other downside is that the last part of the steak was at 2 levels of doneness that what I ordered!

The upside is that the sweet potato casserole was really tasty with a nice crumble.  And we were able to get an 8pm reservation at 7:35 while in the car (thanks Android apps).  

When I'm in the mood again to drop $40 on just a steak, I'm heading to Morton's.
Quiet place late on a Tuesday night. Seemed like a nice clean place and the waitresses and patrons were happy to help a lost traveler. If only it wasn't 50miles out of my way I'd go back for food lol

We stayed at the Atlantis Resort for a week. Toucan Charlie's Buffet was surprisingly very good. I'd highly recommend it. We did lunch one day and the steak and seafood dinner another day. They had a great variety of foods and they kept pumping out plates without compromising the taste which is rare in a buffet. The dessert was just ok for me. The servers were very good and attentive.

I have been looking for a salon around the area for a while now. I've read reviews but I've always been so uneasy when it comes to getting my hair tended to because it is so easy to mess up and I would have to live with it for a month at the very least. I called Christopher when I finally decided it was time to get my hair taken care of. It has been over a year since I've gone to the salon, I've let it grow out again for the most part but it started getting a little more dull and in desperate needs of professional care. The lady that answered the phone was very pleasant, I explained to her what I wanted done and she asked me if I have had a chance to look over their stylists' page online to see if I wanted anyone in particular. I have but I still wasn't sure so she assigned me to someone she thought would get the job done. She was very upfront about the price and gave me a quote depending on what service I might require which was great. I ended up seeing Vince Santangelo.

The day of my appointment, he was finishing up a gentleman's haircut so I maybe waited for 5 minutes or so. When it was my turn, he was asked me what I wanted, all the specifics about the color I wanted and brought over samples. He was also very helpful with making the decision as far as what color I should go with since I have very dark hair (natural). So my 2.5 hour appointment consisted of the color, wait time, some extra conditioning time since my hair ended up very dry, and the cut and blow dry. All in all, I think he did a wonderful job. The color isn't too bright or unnatural for someone with my complexion and he gave me the cut I wanted which is a softer face-framing layers, little trimming throughout and some side bangs. I honestly have no complaints and will most likely be back. He was concerned with what I wanted and tried his best to give me the color and cut I asked for.

As far as the salon itself, it's clean, the people are friendly and it seems like most of their clients have been going there for a long time. When I was in the back room waiting for my color to set, the two ladies shampooing seemed to have known everyone sitting in there except for myself. I feel that they like to give you personalized service which is why I think people come back to the salon. My experience was definitely so much nicer than anywhere else I've gone to and the price is really not that tremendous.

We had a great New Year's Eve at City Winery. This was our first time there, and we will definitely be back. Our server was Kimberly and she was attentive, and delightful! We didn't feel rushed or recieve sub par service because it was a busy holiday. Kimberly was phenomenal!!!

the absolute worst place in all of st pete. the food is average at best, nothing special. what makes this place horrendous is its staff. not once in my life have i ever felt the need to review a resteraunt on yelp, but angelos takes the cake here. the workers treat people as if they are five, and being yelled at for resting my head in one of the booths was NOT a highlight of my night. and dont even get me started on the fact when i got up for a refill of my sweet tea the lady just poured water in my cup and passed it back. like what ??????? moral to my story, if i had to choose between going to angelos or eating my own hand, at least i know id treat myself with some respect while i chewed on my fingers. wish i didnt have to give this place 1 stars. hope this helps!!
Walked in and walked out not friendly didn't really want to serve a party of 10 so we walked down the street to another place that was happy to serve us don't waist your time

This was the best local coffee shop we could find close to the FQ. I had already planned on this being in my rotation for good coffee but I was pretty impressed. The aesthetics are forward and the vibe is chill. I got a New Orleans Iced coffee every time because when in Rome - right? I didn't add the simple syrup but the chicory flavor was delicious. I should have grabbed a bag of beans to bring home now that I think of it.

I'm a native New Orleanian and the French Quarter can feel like a tourist trap but this is one of those hidden gems everyone should see. It's only $5 and worth every penny. It's overflowing with relics. I don't think the binder they provide is necessary. Most of the information is in the glass cases. The midwifery portion was unexpected and cringe-worthy but very cool! There were some unique posters lining the staircase that advertises being available in the gift shop. I was hoping to score one but none of them were available. Bummer! I am careful to be critical of staff but the one employee is not very welcoming and inmediately mentioned that it was $5 to walk through, handed me the binder and that was it. A simple hello goes a long way.

I love Latin food, but I don't want to go to deep DEEP north Philly and I'm not always up to spending what they spend at the Center City spots. So Parada Maimon is a good compromise. Most of the times I've been here I've gotten the pernil with rice and black beans. I've tried the half chicken, the gizzards, and the mofongo. The chicken was good enough that I brought some home to my family. It was a hit. The price can't really be beaten. For those wondering, you can sub out rice and beans for some fries... or maybe some other side they're offering. 

What issues did I have? You can either order at the counter or you can have a seat. The counter (cafeteria style) food is ready-made while most other things are made to order. My first impression was underwhelming... as the pernil I had was dry. I didn't know to ask for gravy since I ordered from the menu. That wasn't enough to keep me away because I came back and had the mofongo and I didn't like it much. I mentioned in a review for another place that I don't fault the establishment. I just didn't know what I was getting into because it more or less tastes the same everywhere I've tried it. There was a little confusion in the portions... they should just say large and small, but instead they say lunch and dinner if I remember correctly.

So for the best dine-in experience... order at the counter, if you're not fluent in Spanish then English is fine...mostly (I got a verbal judo flip with my basic Spanish), state what sauces/gravy you want on your food and then have a seat. Also, get one of their fresh juices (Chinola for me). If you really want to EAT get the dinner (large) portion, but if you're there for the deal get the lunch (small). 

So with a large plate of pernil with a good amount of gravy, some hot sauce and oil for the rice, and some thousand island or whatever for the little salad... I'm NICE! I think they have tres leches too, but I've been too full to try it.

PRO-TIP: And ask for maduros... I don't think they're included, but I don't think they're extra. It's just like 3 or 4 and anyway.

FUN FACT: The area is desolate so there's really no best way in or out on foot. You're catching alleys, bums, and long empty stretches on all sides. Seriously, don't let that stop you from checking this place out.

Very, very disappointed with our visit to Spare No Rib. 

Apparently this was an anomaly, looking at the other reviews...but maybe the owner needs to know how the restaurant runs when they aren't there.

When we arrived for dinner there were only 3 other parties in the place. One person was sitting at the bar. A total of less than 6 people. I am explaining this because every aspect of our service was slow. From being seated, to receiving our drinks, to our food and ending with receipt of the bill: SLOW. Not "European Service" slow, just the  "Not Paying Attention" kind.

Two college-aged men were running front of house. They frequently were on their phones. When 2 young women came in, they spent quite a bit of time chatting them up such that they almost never checked on us. Those 2 women were the only other party to come in the whole time we were in this place. Just terrible service.

When I asked the server about cocktails, he said he didn't drink - so he wouldn't know. Not, "I've heard this is good" or "People say this one's sweet". He was so odd about my questions that I should have taken this as a sign to NOT order a drink. I ordered the Caipirinha - at this point I was still banking on the rep of the place - it was so heavy, I couldn't finish it. I would have been TOASTED if I tried to finish it. And let me explain - I'm a drinker. I spent almost every evening in St. Louis at The Whisky Ring or The Fortuneteller - I drink! This was an irresponsible amount of booze and it was far too heavy for a drink with a meal. 

The only thing I liked were the ribs. The meat fell off the bone.  The sauce is on the sweet side.  Based on all the other issues we had, I will go elsewhere for ribs. 

Taco aficionados may wish to be wary. The tacos were dry, made with no care and very expensive for what they were. The meat on all the tacos was dry. Seriously. OK - I'm from the West Coast and spend plenty of time in LA, so I have high expectations - but St. Louis, these tacos are wayyyyy toooo expensive for the quality or lack thereof. 

Mac n Cheese - very loose, bland and had a graham cracker topping I found too sweet for the dish.

Corn Fritters were hard to judge because they were overdone. Hard on the outside and dry inside.  There seemed to be some nice flavor there, but it was lost.

Just a waste of money up and down.

They put together a last-minute arrangement for a family member that was beautiful and the flowers lasted quite a good amount of time. However, I had a meeting with them about a wedding reception and was told I would receive a quote in 1 month (after a major holiday). I had no problem with that. I waited 5 or 6 weeks (I can't remember which) instead of 4 weeks to give them a little breathing room and then called them to see if the quote was ready. I was told they were waiting on one final quote from a supplier and they would get back to me in a week. That was 2 months ago. I haven't made a second follow-up call, of course. I did find a different florist but I REALLY wanted it to work out with this shop and I'm really disappointed.

Disappointed in Drag Brunch!! Went yesterday for my sisters bachelorette party. We were sat in a booth and could barely see any of the show. The food was good, service was good, but it was like a tease sitting in the end of the booth and hearing the excitement but not being able to see anything. Restaurant should ask performers to spend more time in the upper booth area or make it clear that visibility of the show depends on where you are sitting.

The worst mani a d pedi I have ever received. Paid for a spa pedicure received a 20 pedicure at best. Was not worth 58.00. Toes still had cuticles that need trimming and heels were not done properly. Don't get the spa pedicure waste of money, the foot massage was barely a rub down definitely not what I'm use to. The manicure was even worst  . The owner tried to come fix the tech errors but I just asked to remove the polish. 23.00 for a manicure with no polish she did not rub my hands with moisturizer after I wash them. I definitely will not be back here ever again.
I wish I could give this place a negative rating. They are so rude inside and unprofessional. Did not help with my return whatsoever. Will never go back here ever again! I do not recommend!!
Slow coming out of kitchen Guessin I should not of given you guys a third try. Only 5 other small tables but it's been almost 20 minutes for eggs?

We've ordered delivery from The Landing a few times during this Pandemic. The food has been excellent each time. My husband prefers the bone-in wings. The kids nuggets are actually very good quality. The kiddos definitely enjoyed them. The flatbreads are also very good.

Notice the recent reviews are getting lower? Yeah. This place has been riding on the fact it's the only pho around and they can dupe the students because students are always new in the area.
I have eaten there. The pho is actually really good. Not the highest quality gourmet, but for the price, very tasty.
The manager is incredibly rude. 
The owner is incredibly nice, but you can't talk to him because the manager won't let you.
We'd love for Noodle City to be a part of the community, not just skim off the continual easy prey of students. There's a community fundraiser of a great food festival coming up. It's a great opportunity for them to win new customers. Despite their poor reviews, they said no to the community.
Too bad.

My mother, son and I went to the melting pot in KOP this evening. We were going to go to the Cheesecake Factory (literally in their parking lot) but we decided last minute to change our minds. I've always wanted to try the melting pot but just never got around to it. We didn't know what to expect, we had a toddler.. do they have a kids menu? Is it kid friendly? How do we order? What do we order? The whole situation had us overwhelmed, plus indoor dining was kinda freaking us out as well. We conquered our fears and made our way in. We were greeted by the host and sat promptly. She let us know our server would be over shortly. Once our server Stephen arrived, we didn't have menus because they were doing the virtual menu so he gave us a few minutes to check if out. Upon his return we probably looked extremely confused and still Had no idea what to order. He couldn't be more patient! He explained the entire menu to us in great detail. He did such a great job we STILL didn't know what to get because everything sounded so good. Finally we let him know we were just looking to do some cheese and something chocolate. He asked what cheese we wanted... que glazed over look (I accidentally clicked out of the menu). He immediately made suggestions and we just went along with it! He was spot on! He really made our experience! I pretty much never write yelp reviews but he did such an amazing job guiding us through the entire experience I couldn't let it go unrecognized. Thank you so much Steve! We will definitely be back because of you!! Sincerely two confused ladies and the little boy who kept unplugging the burner!! Keep up the great work!

I got the burger and it was the best!!! Environment and vibe was really nice! The food again was great except kinda of pricey, but that was expected.dessert was awesome... the vegan desserts took my non vegan friends by surprise. Our waiter gave us a free cheesecake since he liked us so much and it was left over... we were probably one of the last groups there. The location is good but make sure to find good parking since the lot is usually full.

i am usually a lil 'ish' when it coms to chain places,but i have to say carrabba's is pretty good. as for italian,dont know if thats where  id go for an authentic italian dish,but the food is good. best plate there is the sirloin marsala.with a side of alfredo.mmmmmmmm they're steaks are way substantial and way delicious...the marsala sauce it to die for,again in my opinion its not italian style marsala,but the best i've had..its more of a mushroom steak sauce..carrabba's is owned by outbavk which has very good steaks so thats why carrabba's steaks are also excellent,outback's steaks with the perks of the italian influence..service is good prices are fair,nice clean place def give it a try. wait can be long tho,so try it during the week

Connie is the only person here I would take my young children to. Josh gave my four year old a really bad haircut and my child was still the whole time. It was really so bad we had to get a refund and have him attempt to repair the damage. I will never go back on a Saturday, and I will *only* go to Connie now.

Their specialty is BBQ but that's about it. Mac and cheese fell flat- super oily, oddly sweet. Salad was literally a bag of mixed greens and a handful of craisins and walnuts that weren't candied like menu said. Not worth the money unless you're ordering meat only. Make the sides yourself. 

Location and decor is really nice. I also love that they have outdoor seating- there's not enough of it in Ardmore!

We went there for lunch. Ordered the roti lemur and that was really bad. THIS is not how roti lemur is made. We also got the thai green curry. The sauce was really thin but it tasted good. The worst part was that they do not give you rice with the curry and you have to pay extra to get the rice. That is something that put me off. Made me think that they are greedy. The servers were not courteous also and the service was also bad.

I swung in here after having my hangover breakfast at another establishment. I knew it was going to be one if those hangovers that required food throughout the day and I heard amazing things about the goodies here. 

Well, it lived up to the hype. 

I got a coffeecake muffin and a 1/4lb bag of chocolate peanut butter caramel balls. Yes you heard me correctly. Chocolate. Peanut Butter. Caramel. Balls. ;p 

Amazing!!! It got me through a rough day after :). And the staff was so super nice. I can't wait to go back and try more.
everything here is excellent, fresh and made daily - great fresh salsa's - rice and beans are top notch - fajita beef is killer - amazing enchilada sauce - and they have jarritos too!

This place sucks big donkey ****!!! No stars from me but I had to put at least 1 to leave my review. My 19 year old daughter's friend's mom brought her here on Monday 2/12/2018. I was out of town. I would have passed this place right on up. I wouldn't bring my dog here. It's Friday 2/16/2018 at 6pm. We were supposed to be discharged this morning...but nope. We are still here. My daughter has been disconnected from her IV since 10am but STILL has the needle and tube sticking out of her arm with a heplock on the end. We were informed by the doctor this morning that she no longer needs fluids and from now on will take her antibiotics orally. Well, take out the got damn tube!!! On 2/12/18, without having a diagnosis yet, her nurse wanted her to get the flu vaccine. We refused. My daughter had 103 fever and ended up having strep, mono with an enlarged liver and spleen, and an infection in her small intestine whiched caused her to vomit for 3 days straight. They ordered her to have an ultrasound of her lower abdomen for Tuesday morning 2/13/18 and said she could not have anything to eat or drink after midnight and they would perform the procedure the very next morning. My daughter was so thirsty and dehydrated but we couldn't give her fluids by mouth after midnight because of the ultrasound. Well, Tuesday 2/13/18 was friggin Mardi gras. Mardi Gras is more important to them than the health of a 19 year old because everyone was off for Mardi Gras, so the procedure had to wait until Wednesday. We deprived my daughter of fluids for nothing! Tuesday night we had to do the same thing....deprive her of fluids. Wednesday morning by 10 am...still no ultrasound. She was so thirsty and her lips were so dry from all the vomiting but we had to wait for the ultrasound. I had to get the ultrasound Department's phone number myself and call them and ask what was taking so long because my daughter is dehydrated and needs water. They told me they did not even have orders for her to have an ultrasound. I was pissed off!!! Since everyone in the ultrasound Department was off the day before they did not see that my daughter had orders for an ultrasound. When they came in Wednesday all they saw was their appointments for Wednesday they did not see that my daughter was supposed to have an ultrasound the day before when they were closed. The ultrasound tech told me if I had not called them they would have never known. PLEASE, if you care about your loved ones, do not bring them to this place!!!!! I also had a bad experience a few years back. My doc thought my appendix was infected (I could not walk my stomach hurt so bad) so he sent me to have an mri at SBPH and put on the orders that he wanted the MRI report STAT. Well, I had the procedure done and went back to my doc office to await the results as instructed. Well, 2 hours later I still had no results. I was now in a wheelchair from the pain and had my fiance push me over to the hospital MRI department to see what the hell was taking so long. Luckily, I ran into Wayne Landry, the hospital director. I told him what was going on. He put me in his personal office where I had tv and a refrigerator full of drinks and some snacks too. He came back in and informed me that the doctor who was responsible for reading the MRI and reporting the results to my doc went to lunch, came back and just disregarded that my doc wanted the report STAT. I was there for 6 hours! Good thing it was a rather large ovarian cyst that ruptured and not my appendix. Wayne Landry advised that I would not be charged for the MRI as I had to meet a deductible. Guess what? I was still charged for the MRI! What a shitty hospital.

DONT GO!! This place has to be the most unorganized mess I've been to in a long time. I've gone 3 times now, 2 times to this one by Tyrone and once to the Largo Mall location.  My daughter loves the chicken Caesar plus is so convenient to the theater but its pure torture each time. The service is slow, first time we went we were one of 4 in the restaurant and it took them 10 minutes to greet us another 25 min for someone to even come to our table and another hour for it to arrive.  The wings suck they were horrible I'm just not that impressed.  When we went to one in Largo I was really hopeful that we'd have a way better experience and nope exactly the same actually worse if that's possible!  That visit we waiting an hour and half for our food.  Every visit you look around and these servers look like they're in the weeds and it's barely full so I don't know where they're hiring but it's certainly not experienced staff.  I won't be back and by the looks of these reviews neither will anyone else.  Hopefully they close this place soon so something good takes its place

Review for groupon users: what the fine print on the groupon doesn't tell you is that sakura has a special menu that you must order off of if you want to get sushi with said groupon. All the rolls on that special menu start at $12, and the same with the nigiri: you could not order just small pieces. It had to be the special which started at $15.  For a $30 group on that meant we could only get 2 rolls and an appetizer. Honestly it seemed like a bait and switch, since their normal non-groupon sushi menu has plenty of rolls or nigiri in the $3-8 range. 

On top of that, the service was quite poor. We waited 20 mins to get our 2 rolls after ordering, and we started off as the only people in the sushi dining area, so they certainly were not busy.

Finally to add insult to injury the bill had one roll miss-priced ($1 more than the menu said) and we had to ask them to fix it at the register. 

The food was good, but we won't be back. Take this into consideration if purchasing groupons. Staff told us that they tried to add the information about the restricted menu but groupon wouldn't allow them to change it.

I went to this parade last night after the Krewe of Oshun parade. The marching bands were not that great but the floats were off the chain. I will admit I caught more beads from this parade than Oshun

I did get to see one of the parade goers dressed like Colonel Sanders. That something you don't see to often.

But yeah I had great fun at this parade.

I drove past this place a few times a week for a year, and one day we decided it was something to try. 

Good things first: the cake was amazing. We had a white cake and a chocolate cake, both with strawberries. The white cake was light, sweet, delicate and moist. The chocolate cake was rich and very sweet, but the sweetness complimented the strawberries. All the strawberries were very fresh and ripe. The waiter we had was very attentive, very nice, and was great with our 3 year old. 

But: the hostess was a bit short with us. We mentioned we had a little one with us and wanted to seat us in chairs near the door. We asked for a booth and that seemed to frustrate her. She stuck us behind the server station so we got to have butts in our face during most of our meal. There was a lot of, "Excuse me," and, "Sorry," being said between us and the staff. 

Everything we got was great except the pizza rolls. They were really doughy, maybe underdone. The sauce was pretty good, though. 

In all, this was a great place to eat.

Edit:
Went back, service was way better. All the food was amazing. We all especially loved the fried mushrooms and sauce. I got a turkey BLT club, and the turkey was perfect.

The cash-only thing is still kind of annoying.
So pleased with the grooming. I'm sorry to be moving out of state. My little dog London always gets a great groom!  Nice job ladies!

Joe and Jaimi are the owners of the new tap house located in South Reno. The environment is awesome to take a small group or even a date for a high end beer. The beer options are endless with so many selections of beer on tap that vary and change on a regular basis. Every so often Beer NV has a takeover night where Joe, Jaimi, and their team host a specific brewery company and a large variety of their beers. They typically have a large crowd so get there early for first dibs!

If you have not tried this place yet it is worth trying at least once because I am sure you will come back for a second and even third visit.

I love supporting new and local business' that have great products and service to go along with it! Definitely rate Beer NV A 5 star rating and can not recommend this place enough!

We went to hear a musician my husband wanted to support and were pleasantly surprised by the food.  I would give the homemade chips and loaded baked potato dip a 10 but the chips were over cooked.  The clam chowder was a 10!  Best I ever had!  The cup is so generous that my husband and I could split. I had 10 mild wings that were just spicy enough for me.  Unfortunately, although I repeated I wanted the wings "extra crispy well done" to the server THREE TIMES, I had to send them back.  I also thought the portion of blue cheese was very small for .75 cents, so that you had to order two.  They allowed my husband to order a dinner salad and a kid's meal hamburger and fries.  That would have driven the 4 stars to 5 stars, but the burger was very well done.  I drank a $4 draft Shocktop and he had a dark beer for $5.00.   I have already recommended the place to people.

Everything's pretty much already been said about the Royal Tavern... 60 reviews! and still 4.5 stars.. the odds are with you that you'll like this bar if you haven't been. 

I extra highly recommend the grilled chicken sandwich that has not only prosciutto, pears, and "elitist" arugula.. but blue cheese and LAVENDER honey mustard, too. You'd think all those flavors conflict, but somehow it works. 

French toast with dulce de leche? Sold!

I once had an omelet on special there that had cilantro sauce. Never even heard of that before, but now every time I go for brunch, I hope to see it on the board. (Though I haven't yet, so, Hint Hint.. if Royal Tavern people ever read these reviews)... 

Lastly.. I went once with 5 of my family members, including two 50something year olds, a vegetarian, and my fancy Paris-dwelling sister, and everyone found something on the menu that they truly enjoyed. 

So again.. it's all about the odds, and it seems they're stacked for the Royal Tavern.
You want to taste the wild waste? Here ya go! They have the best beef ribs in town. Sit under the stars and enjoy an amazing meal from the old west.

This is my 2nd time coming to Convivio and it was amazing both times!  Both times i was celebrating my birthday and it might be a new tradition for me!  Tonight I had gamberoni, asparagus, red potatoes, a Caesar salad, and extra dirty martini.  All of it was spectacular!  I so wish I would have had room for dessert because I remember the tiramisu being phenomenal!  Maybe my next trip should be drinks & dessert 

Either way you can't go wrong here.  We made reservations and I highly recommend doing so!  There were a lot  of people waiting.

I got super lucky. Melinda was super nice and took my doggy in last minute on a busy schedule. My doggy was really calm when I handed him over to Melinda and she was really sweet and gentle with him. Pricing is reasonable and the place looked immaculate. You are able to see the doggy grooming stations and cages from the entrance, which is what I loved and made me place my trust on them. Thank you so much Melinda, we will definitely be back to see you soon!

Absolutely amazing! First time here, and the service was excellent. Make sure to ask for Fallon she can help you find anything you're in the mood for, while answering any and all questions. Will be coming back for sure.

A peaceful and restful urban park with many large and beautiful live oaks draped with Spanish Moss. My main interest in the park comes from its being the former site of the 1884-1885 World's Industrial and Cotton Centennial Exposition, which can be read about in my book "1884-NEW ORLEANS-1885 The Great World's Fair" - ISBN 9780692065099 - containing over 250 rare photographic images from my personal collection. The park is also the home of Audubon Zoo, a section of which was once the location of the exposition's Horticultural Hall. You can easily spend a day in this beautiful park, visiting the zoo, strolling the park's many pathways, and having a relaxing lunch at the Audubon Clubhouse Cafe.

WOW! My life  will never be the same!! This place was amazing! I had the Honey-Chipotle BBQ and I cannot tell you how incredible it was! The entire time I was in heaven! We also had the pretzel rolls and onion rings. The pretzels were soft and really good! The onion rings were a little over cooked, but still good. The milkshake was pretty thin but good flavor. We also ordered a root beer float which was Awesome! 
   Overall, this place was incredible and I cannot wait to come back! I will be in a food coma for a couple days....
Love Ralph's for real authentic Italian food. Reasonably priced. Delicious food & great staff.

Well I haven't eaten here but a few times mostly for breakfast.
But the other night I went with my Niece from Italy and she had on a previous  night had the the special of what  I believe was the Black Cod. She and her guest raved about it.
So upon my return from a month abroad (I live in SB) she wanted to treat me. We made reservations the previous day for 830 pm .
Well when we arrived they said they were closed but after some reluctance put us at our table at 830 pm.
service was passable but I ordered the mussel with chorizo dish,she had the Caesar salad,with the seafood stew.
The salad was good I tried it, her seafood stew looked a bit tired and gray, but she said it was good.
My mussel plate on the other hand was like I had seen in a previous post here, Inedible . It was like so over powering with tomatoes and chorizo and salt, I could not finish it. it was like the cook thought they were doing me a favor and adding all they had from the bottom of the kettle.
I should have sent it back but my niece was so proud to take me there,I said nothing.
So this is why I write now.
From my view the plates need to be made with a much more subtle hand and sense. More will never be better in cooking ! The chorizo was too much and not really the best quality ,it was like cubed summer sausage ! one could not even taste the mussels!
But to be fair I will try it again someday.
Michael Schmitt 
Santa Barbara
This is the 3rd ikea I have been it & its just like the rest. Clean & easy to get around. The cashier was very nice. If I need anymore odds & ends I will go back.

a solid 4 stars. we arrived at 8:30 on a sat night and the place was packed, even at the bar. the two of us got squeezed in after waiting about 10 -15 min. i ordered the black spaghetti because i noticed a lot of others got it, and our server recommended it. while very tasty, you could tell the sauce was 99% butter. it was very rich, heavy, and greasy. i am glad i ate it before the sauce solidified and i could see the solid fat appear on the plate. we also got the lobster whipped potatoes as a side, which was delish! a very cute and romantic place right off the beach.
On each visit, staff is consistently rude, patronizing, and unhelpful.  Any of the other Ace Hardware stores in the area will give you more satisfying service.

Thai Esane is a decent choice if you're craving Thai food. I ordered the drunken noodles with chicken. I also made sure to ask for it to be extra spicy. The lady taking my order made sure to tell me, no refunds or remakes if it's too spicy to handle. I accepted the challenge and proceeded to get something that might burn my mouth out. The food was made quickly and I was ready to go. All in all, it was good and the spice level was more than eatable for me. I have to admit though, the slow spice nature of the heat built up by the time I finished my dish. The slow buildup eventually required me to grab something to fend off the gut heat that had accumulated. Another friend got the spring rolls and said she was thoroughly disappointed. In any case, I'd go back and try something else off the menu. Worth looking into if you've got that Thai itch.
Good breakfast, service, toiletries, location and price. No complaints.
best south indian food in the state!!! the thalis are a must try!!! Service is great and the food is almost oil free!
I love this place when I want to take a break from strolling Hyde park and get something eat. The tacos are good. The bowls are delicious. And I love the way they do chips and salsa.

The massage itself was terrible and was only 50 minutes when I went in for an hour long massage. When she said I was finished I was shocked.  She hadn't worked out any of my knots or helped my back feel better whatsoever. The only thing that I did appreciate was the lady at the front desk felt bad that I didn't have a good experience and told me I could come in next time at a discounted price.  Great customer service but I don't recommend Elizabeth if you have actual pain and knots that need to be worked out.

Enjoyed Wednesday night drinks and dinner at Crabby Bills. Staff are very organized; Great service! The bar/restaurant appear to be accustomed to the high volume tourist trade, but treat all with courtesy normally given to well-known locals. Unlike other area restaurants that look/feel like "tourist traps", Crabby Bills appears to put effort into creative, personalized decor, cleanliness, staff training and quality food/beverage. Busy and noisy, but very fun! Food is fresh and quality. Offerings for adults and kids. Broiled, blackened, fried, etc. seafood. Diverse, quality drink menu.

Terrible customer service, very irresponsible (misplacing items, breaking items, etc) and extremely slow.  The "truck" is actually a trailer.  At one point the movers said they could not fit our box spring (queen size btw -- nothing HUGE) into the new apartment...so my husband went down the stairs to take a look.  He asked if they tried to rotate the queen size box spring to fit it another way.... they did NOT even try that until it was suggested by the customer!  I wonder if the couch I had to put out for trash also could've been rotated a different way to fit into the apartment....

What an awful experience when we were specifically paying for a service to avoid the stress of moving .... I am sore from having to physically move a lot of items myself since these guys were too slow to get it done!

We could've moved everything ourselves in half the amount of time....... unacceptable.  AND they are giving us a hard time about receiving a credit.  I am still pretty upset about this experience.

One positive thing I want to end with:  The guys were all very very very verryyyyy nice people.. I feel terrible about writing a negative review, but due to the head guy not working with us, I cannot hold back.  I cannot imagine anyone else having to go through this terrible experience so I am hoping this will help them make the necessary changes to improve their business. 

Sorry to the guys that I really enjoyed as people... I hope this can be used as constructive criticism.

Great spot that has a ton of beer and excellent food to compliment it. There is a bar on both floors with a balcony overlooking the passing street cars. Tons of craft beers from around the nation are available and there is a grill in the back that has a few platters and burgers available. The burger was one of the best I've had. Not what I expected at all.

Amazing place!
Great menu selection from gluten free to vegan to meat eaters! Something for everyone! Great flavor and presentation on the entrees. The craft cocktails are so worth it. I highly recommend peach bourbon smash!!! ;) clean rustic feel environment. Five stars all the way! Def will be a regular spot for me.

Absolutely the BEST gluten free pasta imperial.  You must try it and also had an incredible gluten free bread.    Loved it!!!     Great way to celebrate Mother's Day with friends.    Thank you Joe and Joan Foglia

Stopped by for the high rate review.
BUT Xiao Long Bo isn't authentic.
:(

Oh its so good.  Probably my favorite Mexican place in St. Louis along with Nacho Mama's and Tower Taco.  Best vegetarian burritos ever--they have every vegetable in them you can imagine.  The guac is also a dream come true.  Love the neigborhood setting too--you can walk off your burrito while seeing some nice yards and homes.
The food was imagination and thought provoking. Freshly prepared and served by friendly and knowledgeable staff who really pay attention to every detail. A definite repeat. And soon. Thank you KYLE.

Have lived close by pretty much all my life and this was my first visit to the Brooklawn diner..... got the Michael salad with honey lime vinaigrette..... so fresh and yummy and the grilled chicken was perfectly cooked and flavored. My BFs bacon burger was excellent also.

I have never seen so many beers on tap before. No bottles of beer are here. I was overwhelmed with the selection and fortunately our waitress was very helpful. I love fruit beers and tried a citrus beer that was exclusive to CRAFT. I also had a glass of Liefmans in a wine glass with ice. It was a sweet, refreshing, great dessert beer.

Speaking of dessert, beer is an ingredient in many menu items, such as beer floats. I am going to come back here one day just to try that. However, today I went for the brunch. My chicken and waffles had two chunks of breaded, fried chicken, four wedges of waffles that had some pepper in them to make them more savoury than sweet, and a garnish of fruit on a kebab skewer. I adored the little individual glass jar of maple syrup and the side of CRAFT hot sauce had a citrus kick - and major after burn. Use sparingly if you are sensitive to spice. My chicken was slightly over done on the outside, but was redeemed by the moist, juicy meat inside.

Meanwhile, my dining companion said that his smoked salmon eggs benny was the best he had ever had. The salmon in particular was very flavourful. To my eyes, the English muffin upon which it was served looked more like brioche.

Brunch is served on weekends until 2 and the prices are very reasonable. Prices on the regular menu items seem a bit high, and the beer prices are high as well and happy hour specials do not apply to everything on the drink menu. Service was very friendly and the food came fast. However, we were there on an off hour and were practically the only people in the place.

Overall I also love the look of the place, except for the fact that the washrooms are down two small flights of stairs (not accessible) into a rather dark cellar.
Came here on Advacado festival Friday evening. Margaritas were $5 and had mucho fresh squeezed lime.

We walked into Endless Summer hoping for some great views of the harbor, and those views did not disappoint. However, the food and service is why this got two stars. The server was very friendly, but she only refilled ONE out of three of our drinks and they were each 4 dollars. The food was okay, but nothing to write home about. Wouldn't go back.

Simple and straight to the point ! If you're looking for exotic or fancy dishes, look elsewhere. But if you just want a good simple meal, this is the spot for you. It reminds me of a "mom and pop" type of place. 
I came here with my mom and aunt and we were seated right away even though it was fairly busy. I ordered an omelet and it was pretty good. The potatoes (or home fries) were fresh and not soggy (big plus).
Can't really say too much about this place since, like I said before, it's simple. If you want some good breakfast food, stop by ! They're pretty reliable.

It's worth going here just for the chill location. Short of looking at the ocean, I don't know what other view could be more relaxing around here. Dolphins, manatees, and birds will come and play. People who work here are usually chill. Music is pretty bad but not very disturbing. Gets too crowded at the weekend. Go late afternoons and avoid the mosquitos.

The giant frozen glasses of beer alone are worth the trip, but the food can be good as well.  Creole style foods here are really very good, but anything with marinara sauce is less so.  The service is fair, and it may take a few minutes to get a table, but it's worth the wait.  Remember to bring cash, they don't accept any plastic!

Horrible customer service experience!!!!!!!!!!! I would love to be able to come and get tatted on state by what so many recommend but after the crappy service and attitude given I'd never hit return or waist my money around bad vibes and energy. Good luck comming here. I'm a local and they are completely trash!

Great place in a great location. If you like biking the Monon trail, you can't beat the location--it is literally right next to the trail in Broad Ripple. We ate there twice during a long weekend in the Indy area. The first time was a late lunch and we returned two days later to sample breakfast. Both times they were not busy so we were served very quickly. Both times we were greeted at the door [coincidentally by the same person] and asked if this was our first time visiting.
