For twenty bucks you get what was probably an entire potato, three unpeeled rubber shrimp, a couple of slices of slimy corn on the cob, a few slices of andouille that was probably purchased at Costco, all flopped into a little cereal bowl.  When it was brought out I thought it was maybe a side of sauce or something to go with the actual plate.  I tried tasting all of it, but the three cups of salt wiped out any chance of that happening.  The skewered shrimp appetizer (for two according to the "waiter") was one stick with five or six tiny rubber shrimp that was so dry that it sucked all of the St. Louis August humidity out of the air around it.  Again, TONS of salt.  The nachos were stale and likely from the bottom shelf of a grocery store.  I believe there was supposed to be pulled pork on them, and we did see a couple strings of what appeared to be meat.  Somehow this place made ceviche flavorless.  Maybe it was the POUND OF SALT in it?  I've been to lots of restaurants and I have never done these two things:  left any shrimp, and left the restaurant hungry.  I did both of those in one sitting at this place.

There was no wait, and these guys give a good haircut.  It's a good deal at $15 and they shave the back of your neck with a straight razor.  The people who work here are funny guys and they get you in and out.  I'll definitely be coming back.

The bf and I just went for dinner last night for restaurant week. The atmosphere was cozy.  So cozy that we heard the entire conversation of the next table on their first date. The restaurant was loud and I could barely hear my boyfriend talking to me from across the table. 

For me, the food was quite a disappointment. I mean, it wasn't bad, it just lacked the Asian flavors that I expected. It's like there was just a hint of flavor, and I was waiting to be wow-ed. So, I grew up in Hawaii and am used to authentic Asian flavors. We got the shrimp and lobster dumpling, pork bao bun, pork belly, beef short rib, Kim chee fried rice, scallops, and the calamari salad.  The dumpling was bleh, but the soup was really good. The pork bao bun was pretty tasty except that the bun kept sticking to my teeth. The beef short rib was tender, but I didn't understand the need for the panko crust. The noodles it sat on was pretty good.  The Kim chee fried rice was a big disappointment because there was no Kim chee in it and that's the best part!! The scallops were ehh. The calamari salad was 75% salad and 25% calamari. It was a good mix of flavors and was the largest dish. 

I'm not sure if I would go there again, I could get better tasting Asian food from Chinatown and at a cheaper price. You are pretty much just paying for the loud atmosphere. The service was ok. The food came out fast, but our server did not come out to check on us even once.

I was so excited to try this place after searching for a local vegan option. New Orleans is known for its food. It's very hard to find healthy options. Seed did not disappoint. Located in a cozy little neighborhood, I was surprised at the number of options on the menu at this hip little spot. A good mix of standard sandwiches and salads as well as healthy takes on old Louisiana faves like gumbo and even a fried poboy. Even alcoholic drinks and fab desserts. I opted for the chickpea salad sandwich which came with a side of quinoa. It was fabulous. Had the Standard, which is a juice blend of beet, carrot and apple. Super friendly and attentive staff. Whether you are vegan or just trying something healthier - Highly recommend giving this place a try.
Very simple. Always amazing. You can't get a better breakfast. Use the Yelp app to cut the line. Highest recommendation

I much prefer the quiet peacefulness of Washington Square Park to our other famous Philly park. It's sprawling, with plenty of grass for a picnic, lots of trees for shade, and gorgeous scenery in every direction. 

You also can't beat being so close to Talula's Daily, in case you need a quick and easy lunch to go, or even just an afternoon pick-me-up in the form of a coffee or treat.

Stumbled on this place while I was going on an enjoyable Sunday afternoon drive through rural PA. I got the tuna melt and a coke, and it just hit the spot. The bread was toasted perfectly, and the cheese (which I believe was provolone) was nice and cheesy. Came with a side of potato chips (ruffles) and a couple of slices of pickle, which are always a great addition to any tuna melt.
Terrible! Unadvertised gay bar! Give people a heads up before charging a cover! Apparently it's called "The ShittyKitty" for a reason!
My bestie and I get massages everywhere we go ..... McVeigh massage is one of the best!!!  Can't beat the price for SB too!!  David and Melissa were both great ..... We'll be back!

Ok place. Only problem here(had the same problem at qdoba) is multiple times I have gotten burritos that are cold in the middle? How hard is it when you are paying 7 bucks for a small burrito to make sure the meat is freaking warm?

outside of that, its your normal chipotle, average/above average food , at high prices.

Have shopped here for a couple of years and was impressed with the quality and variety of products available.  Very impressed with customer service as well.  Had an issue with price matching and the store manager called me at home to resolve the issue.  Really impressed with this level of engagement.  Top notch at every level!

This place is top notch and it is practically downtown. Do you want to buy something in a box that has been on the shelf for who knows how long? Then you will want to go somewhere else. Everything is as fresh as it can be and the grains are ground while you wait. AWESOME. Plus every recipe is tailor made to match your home brewery. Extract? They have it. Partial mash? Yep,  same recipe and the right ingredients. All Grain? You bet ya. Oh, want to do an all grain batch in your kitchen? Check out the Tuxedo Park Brew Cube.....you may never use that turkey fryer outside again.

BTW, the prices are competitive with anything you can find on-line...so don't do that and instead go to Tuxedo Park Brewers Supply.

I recently moved here from Chicago and frequented a couple of brewings supply stores there. The shops in Chicago were great but the staff was talented wihtout being super helpful. If you can imagine going into the bike shop with a flat tire. Most bike mechanics can change that tire in a few seconds. However, ask the mechanic to show you how to do it so that you might repair it yourself sometime instead of walkind the bike home. Most mechanics will give you a funny look and expect you to somehow figure it out for yourself. This is the way homebrewing staff was in Chicago, they were very knowledgable but could not really identify with you as a beginner. 

Not so the staff at Tuxedo Park Brewers Supply. They seem genuinely interested in helping me become the best brewer I can be. Of course they are happy to sell me freshly made kits from any of thier 100 or so tried and true recipes. They even ask me questions that lead me to think about my brewing process and how I may improve it. 

I should mention that this shop is a little bit hard to find since it is an alley suite. Don't  despair, turn in at Brass Ring Lounge, go to the alley, turn left and go past the Teamsters Union Hall. I promise you that you will not miss the shop.

In a city without Chipotle, I was desperate for good, cheap Mexican style food.  Felipe's is good, but nothing special.  It's got a Chipotle type setup, although I don't think it is as flavorful.  Their salsa bar is kind of depressing as well.  It is pretty damn cheap, however.  

Also, this is only one of two locations in NOLA.  Cheers to their French Quarter location; when you're up late partying in the Quarter, they stay open until 3 AM!

This was the best place I've eaten in Florida so far. We didn't skip on anything. We got cocktails that are unique to the restaurant, an appetizer we couldn't find anywhere else, food choices that were most popularly ordered and beignets to top off the night. I thought I would feel heavy and bloated after but that couldn't be farther from the truth. It was amazing. 

Drinks: Hurricane, bloody Mary, voodoo magic 
Appetizer: alligator cheesecake 
Entrees: shrimp andouille sausage gumbo, blackened chicken noodle (our favorite) and pork chops red beans and rice. 
Dessert: beignets. 

Seriosuly, try this place if you want a taste of Louisiana

Haze has the best ice cream. We travel from Dunedin just for their ice cream ! They are always helpful & very friendly. Despite what another review stated , they do give samples even when they have a line out the door. It is well worth the 30 minute drive & wait in line !

Phenomenal shop. Pat fit me in on short notice and gave me great personalized service. I am covered in tattoos, and even though the piece I selected was a small piece, Pat gave it the respect of a full sleeve. The tattoo itself is perfect -- I couldn't have asked for any more. Finally, the atmosphere of the shop is very laid back and welcoming. Get some ink done at Glenside Tattoo soon.

This was my first experience with poke bowls. I am going with 4 stars because the ingredients were fresh and tasty, but I think the OG sauce we ordered may have been left out of the bag. I stirred and stirred, there was no sauce (or flavor) in the bowl. My husband had spicy and ahi tuna so he had a bit more flavorful ingredients, but no sauce there either. We also ordered the mochi ice cream. Yuck. Little disks of ice cream (maybe the size of 3 half dollars stacked up) covered in some sort of chewy fruit roll up/fondant stuff.  The flavors were blah (Belgian chocolate and mandarin orange), certainly not enough to overcome the thick, chewy texture of the coating. Definitely not worth $4.  I will be making some ginger dressing for the rest of my bowl tomorrow-I got bored eating plain rice and veggies. Hopefully this was just a case of something not making it to the delivery bag, and not too little flavor to taste!

The Grill is THE definitive diner in the French Quarter: simple, bar stool-style seating, simple menu, inexpensive prices, and awesome staff. 

They're not the most patient, but if you sit down and need more than 5 minutes to figure out what you want, you are too high-maintenance for The Grill.

We ate there twice on a recent trip - it's perfect for a quick, filling breakfast before having some adventures in NOLA.
Terrible food! The fired rice has nothing on it and smells like it has been sitting there forever!!! Weird after taste, the eggs taste very old too... nothing fresh there!!!

My 2 friends and I have been going out every month trying different BYOs.  Another friend recommended that we try this place after he went on a date here.  I'm very glad he did!  We opted for the pre-fixed meals ($33 each) with 4 courses.  

I had the grilled octopus as my app, which looked quite strange but was very good!  Both of their apps good also, but more visually appealing!  K's crab app was to die for!  I then had the spaghetti with a red sauce and pancetta......so good!  It was slightly spicy, and I'm a huge fan of spicy!  I ordered the trout as my third course.  It was ok.  I don't remember what they got.  All of the courses were the perfect size though.  My dessert was frangelico cream or something like that.  I'm not usually a dessert fan, but this was unbelievable!  It had toffee crumbles on top that completed it quite nicely.  

The owner came out and greeted us.  Oh, and we had outdoor seating (in the beautiful weather!).  I'm so glad we had this, because when I went inside to use the bathroom, I realized how cramped it was in there.  The service was awesome, and our server was quite cute, too!  That's always a plus!

Reservations are a definite for this place.  They're only open a certain amount of hours.

Hot Chicken is a Nashville specialty, and Big Shake's does it well.  I got a breast and it was moist and full of flavor. I got it "hot" and it was hot, but not overwhelmingly hot. Perfect!  Then, when you get done there is a flavor soaked piece of white bread that tops it all off.

My overall experience at Jimmy J's was pleasant. I noticed the owner making his way around the restaurant many times. Making sure everyone was okay. 

My food-bomb! Grits- AMAZING....BUT would I return? Idk. 

My date did not like what she ordered...literally took 1 bite. A small bite..and we were told we could not send it back or get it taken off the bill. 

Apparently, they have a one bite rule! It's crazy how can I know if I like something unless I try it?! 

We still appreciated the waiter for trying. 

Nice place, kind of small, & I hope you know what you want 100%!!! Or you will be paying! LOL!

Today I witness the store manager, Brian M., acting in the most unprofessional manner. It disgusted me, especially due to the fact that I work in the mental health profession. A young man came into the store with his service animal and Brian forced him to leave. He would not even let him simply purchase what was already in his hand. I admit the young man reacted in an disruptive manner, but I could only imagine how I would feel to be kicked out for refusing to part ways with a resource that assists my own personal health.
Brian went on to worsen my perspective of him and the store when he mocked the idea of service animals to Hilda. Hilda did not really say much, but today I witness an Albertson representative basically slap the idea of mental health in the face.
Sensitivity training is obviously needed !

Yuck! I hate writing bad reviews, but this is well deserved. We were starving and thought this would be a good idea. Everything sounded so good. The server came and asked if we were ready we knew we wanted the nachos so we ordered that first. She seemed really nice. Next time around the attitude kind of changed. I ordered the chicken burger and my bf ordered a burger. It took FOREVER for the nachos to come out which I believe sat in the back for awhile because they were cold. I think they would have tasted ok if they came out to the table in a proper timely manner. Then we waited forever again for our entrees to come out and a refill on my bfs coke. The entrees were also cold and disgusting. The chicken and the meat patty had an old flavor. Not even the bacon was good, like come on it's bacon! My bf asked for BBQ sauce that never arrived with his meal so he finally had to ask the manager that walked by about 5 times for it. The only thing that was semi-decent was the coke! Then it took forever to get the check (that we never really even got). We had to walk up to the register and ask the young man (who seemed like the only person who was actually working and gave a care) if we could pay. He was trying to help us out and couldn't find our check so he had to track down our server who wasn't around. He proceeded to ask his manager if she was still there and he said "yeah, she's somewhere". Which makes me think that this dude doesn't even realize the lack of something I like to call "service" was happening around there. The poor young man was finally able to find her and get our check. We paid and were on our way. We were very disappointed with this dining experience. The one star is for the coke and the nice fellow that took care of us.

Easily the best place I've been in the Tampa area, and with their seasonal/rotating menu, I can't wait to come back and try some of their other dishes. You can put your name on the wait list online before you get there so I recommend that so you can sit down as soon as you get there. Their timing estimate was spot on.

The service was a little slow but the food was incredible. I ordered the southwest flatbread. It looks really intimidating to start but I was able to finish most of it. The flavors were that good! The large variety of flavors blended all together wonderfully and created a perfect spicy bite every time. I could eat that every time I go here and be happy.

Then finished off with the snickerdoodle cookie. It's baked from scratch (a family recipe apparently) and served hot and fresh and DELICIOUS. Highly recommend finishing your meal with this desert.

Great food and people. Their veggie boom is great especially for individuals whom want to cross over into eating vegetarian or even for vegetarians.  The sandwich has great texture and flavor which I found it's hard to find in vegetarian sandwiches. I've had their eggplant sandwich which is very tasty as well especially for cold day.

Just went in today and made an appointment the day before to ensure I was able to get a good time and accordingly thru the covid stipulations. Went in and there was an over lap with another client, I said I could wait in the car, no rush but she insisted in getting me on. I sat down and said what I wanted and that I wanted a fade and an undercut on the side when I comb it over. She didn't know what an undercut was and I explained how I want it. Very little conversation but I don't mind, I did mind tho that she was yawning and she kept saying she's falling asleep. She blended the side, instead of doing the undercut like I asked, she gave me a crooked fade and a taper which stuck out way too much in the back, it was uneven. I told her I plan on have a comb over and she left the top like a mushroom, didn't even have a side cut or parted to comb it over in either side. The back was a mess. As soon as I got home I just shaved it all, rather than having to deal with growing it out or paying to get it fixed. I been going here for a few years now and I've had a few times where I left unsatisfied but this time, I've just had it. I've met some awesome workers and gotten good cuts that make me want to come back but after this last experience I'm done. I came in with a happy intention to support a local business when I heard they just opened back up but after today, I cant recommend going here

The food here was delish! It brought back memories of platters in NYC! The chicken over rice were really good and comforting. Serving size was large enough to last me two days! I came back for the chicken biryani another time- by far my favorite dish! It was rather spicy though so for those who don't like spicy food, it may not be a good fit. There's a small station where you can get the "white sauce"- which you'll need an abundance of if spicy food isn't for you. Nonetheless, the kick was worth it!

Exceptional Italian restaurant! Impeccable service from experienced wait staff. I can't say enough about their food- excellent varied menu. Appetizers: buratta cheese and tomato, mozzarella caprese, and beef carpaccio all excellent. 
Arugula salad delicious.  For entrees: gnocchi Adriatico, chicken parm, scallop risotto and Bronzino are delicious.  
Il Villaggio is one of the only restaurants I will order gnocchi. They are house made and filled with love! They are light, fluffy little pillows of deliciousness. 
If it's warm outside, ask to sit on the patio. We have a family member with wheat and dairy allergies and she is able to order from the menu with no problem
If I could give no stars I would. The rudest individual I have ever met. They move at a snails pace and are very short with you. Bossy and rude.

My go to place for boba, a sweet treat, and traditional Filipino food on the weekends!!! Family oriented business and staff that makes you feel welcome and want to keep coming back! Conveniently located for a quick to go order and great to meet with friends and family to sit and catch up! Love this place!

Brock did an absolutely phenomenal job on the home inspection for a house we hope to soon own. He went out of his way to verbally go over his findings and offer ideas for repairs. 
He is a pleasant, conscientious, and organized professional, that I highly recommend.

I'm really disappointed with my visit yesterday to serene salon Sunday ! I haven't been there  in quite sometime. I called in for an appointment and I showed up 45 minutes earlier. I was looking thru the colors. Lucy was going to take care of me. Whenever Julie isn't there Lucy is the 2nd one I choose. Although, I was skimming thru nail pic and out of no where she says I can't do designs. I said I do  not want or.Need a design. I'm just just looking for a different color. What is her problem of why she had to say that ...I'm just looking and deciding some different chrome colors. Needless to the say , my nails were done refill I mean. Then the polish from the color that I picked was supposed to be a mood change reaction blue to a light green sushi green. Hmmm when you see my nail you see all spots no changing mood. I believe Lucy should know her products a little bit more. She couldn't even locate the mermaid blue chrome color to go on top of the one nail. They were talking for 10 minutes s and looking. I will be back to speak to Julie about getting a color change fixed . I'm not paying for it! I'm already paid and the nails you can tell. Lucy should have redone them that day. It's unacceptable! Yeah , I still tipped her though. But, that color never changed to color it has on the nail next to cat eyes. Evidently they got rid of there mood changing colors. Never went back.. Just don't have time!

This place is crap. Im not talking about the fact that the building itself is odd, no major complaints there. Quick service on a Saturday nignt, no complaints there either. My complaint is sitting at the bar as a party of one, and getting shabby service. I was greeted by an older server, she seemed nice enough, but seemed somewhat disappointed in the fact that i was asking about the crawfish prices per pound as if i were now a major dent in her day. I ordered my crawfish, and got literally JUST crawfish. Fine, maybe it doesnt get corn and potatoes. Then, i hear her and everyone else offer corn and potatoes to other crawfish orders. I would've jumped on that. Food was mediocre, service was completely disappointing.

amazing environment with positive and happy instructors. i had never really done pilates and tried out their "power your tower" class and really noticed a difference in my posture and abs (which is a hard area to work on after you've had a baby). Andree bring her medical background to every class and you know you're in good hands. a MUST TRY!

1808 felt like an overpriced hotel restaurant from the second I walked into the door. 

I ordered the cauliflower soup, which was really creamy and thick and not that flavorful. I also ordered the asparagus salad, which was ok, but it had a really goopy sauce at the bottom and the shaved asparagus was really bitter. We also ordered the burrata and beets appetizer, which was good, but the cheese also just wasn't great. I expected more from a highly rated and expensive restaurant. 

The drinks were great, so I recommend coming here for those.
Great pizza place.  Manager was top notch.  Everything came out as ordered.  Will definitely return !

After hearing about this establishment from the locals, my boyfriend and I decided to try it out. The restaurant was packed for a Friday morning. We had to wait outside the door for a few minutes before the line inside moved enough for us to come in.

Ordering is cafeteria style. You pass the containers of food and line of workers assembling orders through sneeze guards before hitting the register, ordering your food, and paying. If you ordered a drink, you wait right next to the register for those drinks to be given to you. We decided on the Ferdi Special & a bowl of jambalaya for myself. All this costs a little over $20, which is a great deal. If you visit when it is busy (which it will almost most likely be), may the odds be in your favor when looking for a table. They are almost always taken immediately after a group leaves.

Workers walk around with orders looking at your receipt to match the right table. I would think there would be a more efficient way of handling this to save errors from happening. We were given an extra piece of bread pudding we never ordered. Not complaining though! It was delicious.

Food was given in great portions, just like in the rest of New Orleans. However, I was very underwhelmed at the quality. The debris po'boy was very plain from the few bites I had tried and I thought my jambalaya was a little too salty. However, with the amount of food we were served, I didn't mind. My boyfriend, who usually could eat a horse and still have room for dessert, could barely stomach half the sandwich. This was a very big plus. However, we decided not to take the leftovers with us for a later meal because of the sheer amount of sodium we had lingering in our dry mouths.

If you are a neat freak like me, I suggest you try your hardest not to look down by the containers of food and on the floor. I had a very hard time not grimacing at the amount of grime, grease, and dirt in the restaurant. Then again, it's the food that matters, right?

Honestly, I would not come again. The restaurant was in dire need of a deep cleaning, food was underwhelming, and service was lacking (not including a couple amazing waitresses that served us). Hopefully the next time I come back to NOLA, the establishment would have improved in these areas and I would be very interested in the hype.

Was a little worried when I walked in... nobody but me in the place. Surprise surprise!! Great selection of rolls. Classic fusion menu reasonably priced and very tasty. 4/5 only because fried rice came on a paper plate. Picky I know
An hour and a half wait.  Then they run out of flat bread pizza.  Owner laughs as waiter explains our issue.  Until they get their shit together stay away.   Don't waste your time.

Great food friendly service and tons of t.v's to watch all games. The only thing that turns me off is some servers are good while some are so so and you may receive slow service but that's not every experience.

Classic Qdoba, when you go here you know what you're going to get. They have. The updated coke machines that allow for you to get whatever drink pleases your taste buds. My only issue was that they didn't have BBQ sauce, this is essential to my burrito experience. Other than that, service was good to me.

Petals and Paints provided the flowers for my September 2016 wedding and they were absolutely gorgeous! Amy worked with me for weeks to ensure that I got exactly what I asked for, even creating mock-ups of the centerpieces so that I could see what I liked/disliked. Amy was not sure if the flower I wanted (anemones) would be in season for my wedding day, so she spent time searching for "plan b flowers" to use in place of the anemones--luckily, she was able to get them in:) Amy was an absolutely pleasure to work with and her work is simply amazing. I highly recommend using Petals and Paints for all of your floral needs.

The customer service here SUCKED I went to enjoy drinks and some food with a friend, at the sight of my empty drink a server who MIND YOU wasn't even ours comes and drops off the check, also,  OUR server never even came over to ask if I wanted another cocktail, trying to still hang out and have a good time, I asked if we could order something else because we were waiting on another friend to come, I was told no because there was a "waitlist" To top it all off the server who came to drop the check had the grossest attitude so, basically I'll never be back.
The best little restaurant ever! Very good food, friendly and nice staff, clean and beautiful design! Love it

This place is what I've been looking for in the midtown/music row/Edgehill area. 

Great vibes & great joe. It's a small spot, ideal for grab and go coffee. If on a walk near Edgehill in the morning, make sure your route swings by Osa.

If you need some grub, get there early! Their small sampling of pastries goes quick.

Frescoes !! For the first time. 

Outside of the cathedral is fun too...

Great food, nice divey atmosphere. 

The kitchen staff were very nice, but our bartender seemed un-engaged.

The good: great location, very convenient to touristy places and restaurants in Nashville. Loved that they were able to accommodate me for early check in (11am). Lobby was clean, stylish. Views from rooms were good. I was on the Commerce street side (happily) on the 7th floor which was quiet as far as street noise goes. Room was well designed and overall mostly clean. Bed very comfortable and big screen TV. Decent view (no upgrades).

The bad: there was a YMCA youth leadership conference there and my entire hallway was filled with high school aged kids. They were loud and rambunctious between 7am-8am and 6pm-9pm, laughing, giggling, slamming doors, running to each other's rooms. This was very annoying, especially as I was exhausted from being jet lagged. Also, you may have to wait 30 minutes for an elevator... I was leaving for the airport at the same time these kids were going to the morning part of their conference (8am) and EVERY elevator that came was full. I took the stairs at least twice during my stay. I had free WiFi with my AAA rate, but it never worked. I never bothered to bring my laptop down to the front desk, but it would've been nice to have it work (it tries to connect but no window pops up to pay/sign up so it can't connect). Finally, my room could've had a bit more attention to cleanliness detail - it was grimy under the sink faucets when you turned them on and my fitted sheet on my bed was slightly displaced when I checked in and I could see blood on the mattress pad... ew!
Mediocre burger place. Service is OK. Food is OK. They served me a burger on toasted sliced bread. Eh.

This was an amazing dining experience and will be recommending to all!!!!! Shoutout to our amazing waitress Kiwi!!!! Great environment, great staff, great food!! Here is your new favorite restaurant!!!

Hermoso lugar y excelente servicio. La comida excelente también. Definitivamente en mi siguiente viaje a NOLA iré a comer en este lugar. 
Las micheladas son lo mejor!

Slow but they just opened. I stood in line for about 25 minutes to place my order on opening day and despite being given a free burger, I was really unimpressed.  

The overall quality and  flavor (or lack thereof) of the meat was just pathetic. If this is what guilt-free, organic burgers taste like they can keep them. 

Also who was the Einstein who thought steaming meat would do anything other than dry it out and give it the consistency of refrigerated cat food. 

And while this has NOTHING to do with the craftsmanship of the food, those damnable neon lights around the old Whitney Bank are an eyesore and should be removed. They do nothing but irritate the community.

On a positive note, the money that went into the decor and food package is exquisite. However I question if the cost of these extras (branded clamshell wrappers and trash bins) were appropriate for a new business. If the food was better, such extras would be consider a part of the experience but they just serve as reminders of where never to eat again.
-------------------------------------
UPDATED: AUG 10, 2012 - I would like everyone to know I privately responded to the owner and I was in fact there on opening (hence my check-in). To save him and his business further embarrassment, I will not be engaging in public debate with a business owner over my experience.

We came here as it was closing and lucky for us the bar was wide open. The bartender was absolutely charming. She let us sample wines and gave us a rundown what was good. We grabbed the shrimp and asparagus to go and it was delicious. Honestly this particular Olive Garden seemed rather modern compared to the ones I've been to in the past 10 years. We'd go back.

Upon thinking about this review, my mouth began to water. I've been here three times and every time has been awesome! I've had the chicken tchoupitpulas and the trout. Both are served with veggies, potatoes, and muffins. The bread pudding soufflé is to die for! It isn't really a soufflé so I'm not sure why they've named it so, but it's delicious just the same. I would gladly drown in a vat  of the bourbon sauce served with this delicious treat. Service is always on point and the prices are more than fair. Don't miss out on this place when you're in Santa Barbara!

DO NOT PULL FORWARD!!!!! I will not ever make that mistake again. 

Every single time I order my food is wrong, and they forget about you once u pull forward out front to wait on your food. 

Usually 10+ minutes after already waiting in the drive thru line. And then once u get ur food it's wrong and u also have to ask for sauces so it takes them 2 more trips to fix it all. 

Unfortunately they are the only restaurant with a certain menu item I want from time to time so it's a necessary evil but I refuse to pull forward again bc they always take FOREVER and also screw it up so it's way too inconvenient, I'd rather be at the window so they can fix it right then and there, bc I know it'll be wrong unfortunately.

I bought 2 tickets to watch the Lion King at the Academy of Music for $120 per ticket for my wife and I. To my dismay, one of our seats was an obstructed view by a pillar and you had to constantly shift around to see the show. At the intermission, we switched seats so both of us could enjoy at least half of the show. If I had known in advance (while purchasing) if a seat view was obstructed, I would NOT have paid what I did or sat in those seats. I think this needs to be clearly listed when selling seats.

I haven't eaten here in 4 years probably, and it was always good. I went today and got the basic gyro and it was delicious! They don't short you on meat or anything. The taste they knocked it out of the park. Really awesome and it's worth traveling 10 miles for.
Been here a few time. Descent burgers, OK service nothing great. Lots of places to choose from in the area. Convenient location. Still looking for an awesome burger in the Indy area. Suggestions?

First of all, they don't sanitize anything, and I mean anything not even the tools. They also don't sanitize the pedicure bowls between clients. I had an appointment but still had to wait a while while they took other clients. The girl doing my pedicure was great! Friendly and did a good job. However another girl was giving me a manicure during the pedicure but kept walking away mid task to work on other people. I'm not sure my nails were actually all done. Didn't make for a great experience and I won't be coming back.
Always great food and great service! Devon in particular was our server on New Year's Day and helped me and my family have an awesome dining experience!
The best restaurant we found in the area yet. Consistently great food and great service no matter what time of day. Owners are locals that really know how to run a restaurant.

When using the coupons, it's a great deal.  I signed up to be picked up at the airport and just drive from the terminal.  It's worth the extra $13 because it will save you a lot of time.
You check in at the parking place.  It takes less than 3 minutes.  Then they drive you from the parking lot to the terminal.  Before you leave the lot, they take multiple pictures for their record to ensure your car is memorialized before you leave.  It's about 10 minutes to the terminal and they drop you off right there.
If you are travelling with anyone, I would recommend you call for the car when you get to baggage claim.  It takes about 15-20 minutes to get the car.  So if the luggage comes out, then you can get right in the car.  If not, you take the car to cell phone parking lot and wait for your travel companion to call to tell you that the luggage is there.  It saves a lot of time and you're off to home.
We'll be using this service again.  It's very convenient and the cost is great with the online coupon.

I have always had good service here. I don't know some reveiwers said it was bad.  They are always willing to give you samples.  I have had the Lobster bisque, their chili , and sandwiches, all of which are good.

Chef Gina had her mask on when she started cooking, however by end of preparing our order it was under her chin and she was talking and singing. I asked for a remake please an apologized saying im so sorry I don't  wanna be a pain but I'm uncomfortable with that. The waiter Colby told me im being ridiculous and that masks arent necessary and Chef was clearly ticked off I asked for reorder. Calling corproate to report Colby and Gina. 340pm, 11.11.20. We clearly offended them by asking to please wear mask with food prep! CANT BELIEVE THEY WOULD TREAT A MOM AND 2 KIDS THAT WAY nevermind undermining the seriousness of a pandemic!

I would rate this the 3.5 just like the average right now.  

I had a lamb dish and the lamb was cooked great and had a great garlic flavor.  It had alot of tomato also but it lack some in between flavors to really bring the dish together.  

We also had the spinach korma and it was tasty and healthier than other dishes elsewhere I have had with the same name.  There was no cream. 

I feel with slight modifications both of these dishes would really pop!
The Chicken Sandwiches here use to be hot,fresh and delicious. Lately they've been cold,rubbery & inedible....... I had one that sucked a month or so ago and gave them another try today. Garbage
We're in our mid 30s and this place would sell us beer bc we both didn't have ID. Fine whatever... store policy, Indiana policy... which is it? Can we get the chips and 5 hour energy then? No? GFY
Gluten free and happy! I ordered the filet mignon and it was perfect. Great customer service, good wine list and a lovely atmosphere. I can't wait to go back.

I recently moved here from San Francisco and was in search of a reputable vet here in Tucson for my English Lab puppy.  I emailed for an appointment and was called immediately the following morning by the receptionist.  She was very polite and addressed all my questions and  booked an appointment with the vet Dr. Justin Keaner. 

Upon entering the office had a very modern tranquil setting. Clean with a relaxing zen-type esthetic. Instantly felt comfortable and was greeted by the super friend staff/ client reps Rachel and Jessica. 

My puppy and I were brought into one of the exam rooms and met with the vet tech named Stephanie. The room was immaculately clean and she was very informative and helpful recording my puppy's data. 

Lastly, I the vet Dr. Justin Keaner met with us. He was very soft spoken and you could tell he loves animals. He evaluated my puppy and explained some of the virus/ diseases that I was unaware of in this locale. He showed me an option called a "puppy plan" whilst even thought my dog had her first series of shots they still saved me about $100. I didn't feel like I was being "up sold" because if they wanted to make more money would have a la carte the visit/ shots instead of offering the less expensive bundle. 

Great experience!  Highly recommend!!!

This was such a fun dining experience! Greg was enthusiastic and knowledgeable, and while the food was pricey, the colonial recipe factor made it exciting. I got the braised rabbit which was fantastic. The amount of vegetables I got was unbelievable! My boyfriend got the beef turnover, which was also phenomenal. I also tried their non alcoholic cider because it was freezing cold outside, and it absolutely hit the spot. It had a cinnamon stick in it too. So cute! My boyfriend also got the founding fathers beer sampler--he particularly liked Ben Franklin's beer. We finished off with Martha Washington's chocolate cake and loved it. Very rich and satisfying! The theming is incredible and we really enjoyed ourselves!

Better than average but no longer around.

Guess my review was too late to save it.

Online order form made delivery super easy. I made a special note to make everything extra spicy... could have been hotter but still hit the spot. Will definitely be my go to Take Out Chinese spot.... delivery time was a little long... but worth the wait.

Went to Woolworths before a show at TPAC. I called ahead of time to make sure I didn't need a reservation to sit at the bar and have a drink. When I arrived it was packed- that's a great sign! Then I sat down at the bar. It took almost 15 minutes for anyone to come and take my drink order much less just drop a water to me. I've worked as a bartender and I know they were busy- but it almost felt like they were avoiding me.
The bartender was extremely rude to the couple next to me- I get it- busy night, lots going on. But there's really no excuse. Perhaps Woolworth should add more bartenders? Not sure. The fried green tomatoes were great. However, it's not good enough for me to return any time soon.

They are so fantastic. I live in the area and any maintenance problem with my car that I've had they fixed it within a day. Whether it was a problem with my battery, my windshield wipers, or when my bumper came off they were nice, fixed it quickly and for a reasonable price!

Happy 30th Anniversary!  my first visit here and everyone was soo friendly and the yuca chicharron was super delicious! I'm so excited to have won the $500 contest and can't wait to go back to spend it all  #Feliz30th thanks to the recommendation in Linda Hoang's newsletter for  letting me know about this awesome Latin market!

Before new menu the main reason I liked Percy because it was so authentic.  Just like in Texas. Now place is trying to be different, not sure what they trying to do. Lots more options, which to me always a sign that it is unlikely they can do so many dishes well. I never had chicken there until new menu and found it pretty dry. Lockhart option appears like good deal, but what I find really disgusting  that you never know what you will get. One day it is even split between three meats, then it is pretty much what kitchen needs to get rid of.  Last time we got mostly chicken, with few pieces of brisket and definitely a lot less ribs than chicken. And chicken was so dry it was just horrible and no resemblance the way chicken is done in Texas.  It was probably old and needed to be reheated several times. So I am crossing Percy of my list of favorite places in Philly unless old menu returns. Erin, there is nonstop flight from Philly to San Antonio, takes 3 hour, go to Rudy's near New Braunfels and see how chicken should be done. You use the same smokers, no reason why yours should taste like shoe leather
If you like good bbq ribs, this is the place to go. Avoid the pulled pork, it's too salty and has an unusual after taste. Solid bbq choice when presented when the mid week BBQ urge!!
Friendly, fast service and great pricing. I'll be returning if I need them in the future!
We LOVE this place!  Everything we've gotten has been amazing...you really can't go wrong!

We've lived in AZ for 16 years and only recently found this gem. From Tucson it's just a short one hour drive from bottom to top with many beautiful spots to stop and explore along the way including overlooks and hiking trails. We even saw a group rock climbing and repelling at one stop. The true rewards at he top where the temp is almost 30 degrees lower then the start with beautiful views in all directions. The pictures tell the rest of the story...

So disappointing.  The place is hot.  Very uncomfortable.  The wait for food took forever- even when it wasn't super busy.  The food that we ordered wasn't right, and what we got did not taste good.  Scrambled eggs?  Maybe eggs thinned out a ton with milk and not real.  Such a terrible experience.  Wish I could give less than 1 star.

I was very dissappointed with the food here. Their menu read so well and I wanted to try EVERYTHING.  However, everything we had was sub par at best.  The tacos in a bag were bland and we didn't finish them (although we ate all the fritos).  The calamari should actually be called Shrimp Toast with a few calamari.......the fried chicken and meatloaf we both ok.  I want to mention that our server was spectacular and she alone made the experience worthy enough to go back, although I don't think I will only because I don't want to waste $$ on a mediocre meal.

The first time I visited (to buy the glasses) I had a wonderful experience, the staff members were eager to help and gave me opinions on various glasses, but when I went back to get them adjusted I was very disappointed. 
   I went back to get them better adjusted to my face and while at the counter the woman helping me did not even look up from her computer screen to help me. After telling her I needed my glasses adjusted she angerly looked up from her computer and said what is wrong with them and I told her, she fixed them, handed them back to me and continued to do activities on her computer monitor. Meanwhile, a girl who came in shortly after me was asked to put the glasses on her face to see how they fit and was inspected to make sure that the glasses fit her properly in all areas. I was very disappointed that I was not given the proper fitting and will not be buying a second pair from Warby Parker due to the terrible customer service I received.
Very cool spot!  Worth checking out.  It's just over the overpass on Virginia St  over highway 65.

Xandy came out on short notice to make a minor repair on our piano. He works carefully and thoughtfully. Originally he had refurbished the piano, tuned it after the move home and found it still in tune! When it needs tuning I'm thankful we will have a great technician to call!!

A HIDDEN GEM FOR SURE!! I met my friend here for coffee and I was blown away. the lattes are yummy. The food was good. Staff is really friendly! the atmosphere is laid back and whoever makes the playlist has amazing taste in music. a cool hidden hangout with some yummy treats.
Come for the Saturday jam, haven't been here at night for many years. New wait staff, we always go to the bar to get out drinks.

This place was the absolute worst. We arrived for our reservation, and was barley greeted by the front desk guy Benjamin, after checking in? He stated they were getting our table ready, 20 mins later I checked in and asked how much longer and he stated " for what"..... I then reminded him of my reservation and then he stated "oh yeah" turns out no one was actually getting a table ready. He then asked his coworker to seat us and her response was " why can't you do it"... we then were taken to w table with no silverware, no plates or cups, now mine you this is "fine dining", Benjamin told us our waiter would be with shortly... after sitting for 25 mins, our waiter never came. Meanwhile the manager is standing outside chit chatting. This place is a joke.

Was visiting Philly with my two small children and used the Yelp app to search nearby. This place had a Yelp coupon, so I thought we'd try it. We were very happy we did! They have a nice selection of food for a lot of different tastes. Everything was very fresh and tasty. The sushi was fresh and done really well, the sandwiches and wraps were awesome. We will return.

Employee recommended Chipotle dog for the extra spice. Crazy how it's vegetarian! It's a build heated kick w a chewy sausage like bite. I had it w slaw, grilled onions and jalapeños. Get it, your mouth will thank you.

Love the concept of Blaze. You pick your crust and sauce then top it with whatever you want. It's super tasty! I loved the vegan options with the red sauces and vegan cheese. The cheese isn't the greatest but not too shabby. Half of the veggies are awesome and fresh and the other half are just average and sometimes canned. Overall I enjoyed the experience, pizza, and variety offered by the build your own concept.

No stars at all. Waited 15-20 min before anyone even approached our table. Party of 6 came in we'll after we ordered and received food long before us. My daughter finally got her food and was half through eating when I was informed they were out of what I ordered. Re ordered and received my food 38 min later. At this point I'm timing. Burger was raw. Not rare but raw. Best suggestion I can give anyone going here is run away as fast as you can.

The food served here (at least for take-out) is just.... weird.  The hot and sour soup looks normal, but is neither hot nor sour.  The General Tso's chicken is coated chicken chunks in a kind of yellowish sweet and sour sauce, nothing like the sticky-dry brown spicy tangy coating normally associated with General Tso's.  The real shocker was the Pad Thai.  Although there were some crushed peanuts sprinkled on top, this dish looked completely wrong.  It was in a dark orangey-red sauce, and tasted exactly like spaghetti with cheap tomato sauce, without any of the light peanutty flavor or fish sauce it is supposed to have. Just weird.  The ingredients do not seem to be bad quality- they just seem to be completely wrong.  We used to like the place when it first opened many years ago, but it seems to get worse on every visit.  It's almost like they are testing their customers, to see what level of absurdity customers will tolerate in their dishes.  The search for good Chinese take-out in the Collegeville area continues.

Rooster buys from and supports local farms, which was very attractive. The quality of food was excellent, but for what we got, the prices seemed a bit steep. a small glass of orange juice was $4, and it was most definitely small. My husband ordered the chocolate chip pancakes, which were too much on the sweet side, even for chocolate chip. The french toast sticks were a hit with my son, and I was a fan of the scramble I ordered. Excellent service, especially considering the establishment was packed to the gills.

I brought my car in this morning for an oil change and new wiper blades and was warmly greeted by Jorge . He quoted an hour and a half to complete the services my mini needed . The showroom and waiting area was spotless and provided nice refreshment options. The manager came by and we have a nice conversation . The entire experience from start to finish was Perfect... they washed my car and waved goodbye when I departed ! I bought my car at this very dealership 7 years ago and would highly recommend it ... plus my car is " better than new " and runs like a charm.
The service was attentive. All of the appetizers, entrees, wine and desserts were perfect. It was a special dinner for my wife and me and my brother and sister-in-law and everything was perfect.

The margaritas were nice and strong and smooth. The blood orange margarita was decently flavored but the cucumber was a little light in the cucumber rosemary margarita. The salsa was okay and it was only a few extra dollars to add guac. I wanted a little more kick and flavor, so we wound up adding the hot sauce to them. The heat was a little less than mild. My girlfriend got the beyond tacos, and said they were good but wished they had a little more "meat". The chimicurri was okay but a I expected a little more. The steak was medium well to well (more of a medium fan) and could have been marinated a little longer. A little oily as well. The sides of green beans threw me off. I was expecting something a little more on theme when it said seasonable veggie. Overall though it was a pretty decent and cheaper price with the exception of the steak and definitely would go again. The space is nice and I love the bar space in the back. Vegan friendly.

I'm rating this place based on their pizza alone, not on their qualities as a restaurant.  I gotta tell ya, the BEST pizza I ever had in my life.  You can look at me and tell I've had more than my share of pizza, but this place is unbelievable.  Perfect proportions of cheese to sauce and crust.  If I lived near there, I'd be there everyday.  What did I have?  Small pizza with anchovy.  As I said, just wonderful.  Staff is pleasant, service efficient.  Keep on rockin'!  BTW, the person who told me to go told me to get the small pizza, the large ones, she said, tasted completely different.

I would consider myself a regular at Nathan's. To be honest in the beginning I had my doubts about the nails services here, but I always come back for more! My gel acrylics stay on for weeks. It is reasonably priced with the quality services he provides. He isn't much of a talker, but if you show some interest he will tell you some funny stories. I will keep on coming back.

I tried the long board fish tacos which were good but rather small in size.  Next time I'd probably opt for the 3rd taco for $3 more, but it can get pretty pricey for a workday lunch (especially if you include a beer).  Nice atmosphere though, service was prompt and friendly.  A lot kids with mom (I imagine with school ending for the year soon, there will be more kids), so the indoor area can get pretty noisy...

My friend and I made reservations for here when we were visiting Nashville for a long weekend. We had tickets for a show at the Ryman and knew we'd want dinner after. Located right off Broadway, it's super convenient and has live music, but it's not bar food like the rest of Broadway.

I ordered the hot chicken salad because I felt like I needed some green on my plate. Oh boy, the chicken was delicious and the salad was pretty awesome too. They could've gone a little easier on the dressing but overall it was delicious.

For cocktails, my friend went for the Blueberry Smash (blueberry vodka, smashed blueberries, lime, simple syrup, and soda) and I went for the Southern Peach (moonshine, peach liquor, sweet tea, and sours). I loved my drink. Just enough sweet and sour! The blueberry drink was tasty but I'm not really a blueberry fan. But my friend loved her drink.

Overall, I thought it was tasty meal and would definitely recommend stopping by here.

Very popping place on a Saturday night.  The rooftop was crowded with people hence we were unable to stay up there but for 3 minutes. I gave the goat cheese balls in panko bread crumbs a try since yelp had so much to say about it, I was pleasantly surprised on how good they were! The nachos were a bit spicy but enough for the four of us to munch on. Overall, I'd go back but probably on a less busy night. I live in Miami and don't want to be elbow to elbow with people like we are normally are back home.

I was pretty incredulous about going to BTG, but I couldn't be much happier about our experience.

We were lucky enough to get Allison who was personable and very patient with us. She walked through a few options and gave us a quote on a corded an cordless set.

We were there the last day of a sale, so we put down a deposit to secure the price. It kind of made me nervous to do it without having more time to think, but we ended up saving some cash for sure.

The measuring process was a little nerve-wracking. They give you a clear guide how to do it, but if you get the measurements wrong it's on you so you want to get it right. When I called in and gave our measurements to another woman (not Allison) I expected her to go over it with us to make sure we were cool but she was a bit disengaged. This unnerved me a bit but ultimately it worked out fine so I'm not tripping on it.

The blinds were ready super fast--three days!

Doug is THE MAN. He installed the blinds super quickly and at a very very reasonable price.

Overall I'm very happy with the experience.

From beginning to end the service was incomparable. Alicia was the best server I ever had. She got me a blanket because I was cold, and even wrapped it around me. Her knowledge of the menu and her positive attitude was amazing to say the least. Everything she recommended was so delicious and she even gave us to go churros. It's safe to say I'll be going back and requesting Alicia!!

I usually get a cone or a triple chocolate utopia.  Today I decided to try something new and get the hot fudge milk shake.  What they gave me was about medium thickened  glorified chocolate milk.  This was not a shake.  It was a total failure.  Big mistake.  Stick with blizzards, cones, etc.  Steer clear of the milkshakes.
Must have been a bad day.  Under staffed. Lots of lost motion. Waiting on people out of turn. Left after 20 minutes.

Cute atmosphere. Great location and customer service, and delicious tea. I ordered a ginger milk tea with less sugar and it was excellent. There are so many flavors to try and definitely I will go back!

We rolled in here one night for our dessert fix. Seeing as Emeril is also a Fall River native, I thought I should pop in. We posted up at the bar and quickly concluded that a return visit would be in order to grab dinner. We inhaled some Warm Ooey Gooey Cake (I was a huge skeptic of the marshmallows in this dish...& in general, but it worked...really well). Great Port selection - 20 Year Tawny was perfect

They are clearly killing it - service, atmosphere, food - all on point.

Just wanted to update everyone including the area manager for the Dale mabry location.i got My car repainted and it came out pretty good except for 1 Major thing. It's not the correct color. I asked for charcoal metallic gray and they painted it metallic gray.and Patrick the manager of that location. Stated to me it's the right color. I wish they would please just give me a refund.im going to be in contact with the better business bureau on this matter if i don't get a response.photos are included at the bottom.for proof.

Saturday 4/30 lunch. I met two friends here at their request for lunch. I arrived about 10 minutes before they did and when I walked in I immediately noticed a fishy smell and that it was extremely warm in the restaurant. I ordered a hot tea and water. The water was fairly warm and the tea was fairly cold. They were about the same temperature.  Odd. When my friends arrived and we ate at the buffet I sampled things I thought should be safe.  The hot n sour soup was cold and flavorless. The crab Rangoon was overly crisp and didn't have much filling.  The egg roll was eatable but not really enjoyable.  Later I went back and tried a couple of the chicken dishes. Each one had very thick breading and a very thick shiny sauce loaded with sugar and corn starch. The sauces had a shellac like consistency.  I wouldn't have gone near what they called sushi on the buffet for any reason. I hadn't been here since high school (mid 1990s). It looks exactly the same but not sure anyone has been in to clean since then. Never again.

Looking for a unique coffee place where the barista actually knows where the coffee came from and knows how to brew. There is always a good story behind the coffee and a tasty pastry to go with it. Don't have Starbucks expectations here, think outside the box.

JG Sewing & Leather repair is fantastic! José, the proprietor, is a skilled craftsman with leather and at repairing very beat-up shoes. He's done delicate spike-heel repair and restitched/reinforced heavy boots. I know he offers other services aside from shoe cobbling, and I look forward to using more of his skill-set. Highlights of using JG:

Reliable (never had or worried about items being lost)
Quick/reasonable turn-around time (on a rush job, he was done in one or two days and for non-rush, it was about a week)
Responsive and uses text messaging
Good pricing
Support a local/small business

Came here today for the first time and it was amazing! Pizza was fresh and hot. I was served by Kayla and DJ and they were both amazing and have great customer service skills.I will definitely be coming back!!!

The atmosphere is why you want to come to Salt Rock Grill.  The scenery is breathtaking. Make sure you get a seat by the window/water. The food is very good - not the best on the beach, but pretty good. While there are options if you do not like seafood, they are very limited items that are not seafood.  The specials change regularly, so you won't ever get bored with the menu. The prices are pretty high for the amount of food that you get, but when you come to a place like this, you are coming for the view.

As a fun street festival with food and music, this is great. As an "Italian" street festival, it falls short in most categories. That being said, I don't come to a central Indiana church fundraiser expecting an authentic Italian experience, so I am never disappointed. 

The location is great. I always just walk here, but they have plenty of info about their free parking on their website. This takes place in a neighborhood just outside of downtown with plenty of bars and restaurants to go to either beforehand or afterwards in the close vicinity. The setup works well, with food and drink on one side and the band in the park on the other. It gets crowded when it is a nice evening of weather for the event, but it's not so much that you can't move around comfortable. There is more room in the park area than there is in the food booth sections. The lines for food, drink, and tickets (you buy tickets and use those at the stands) can be very long, but they move quickly.

The nicest thing about this festival is that is one of the more affordable things you can do in the city, especially relative to some of the other larger festivals that take place around town. It is free to enter, the food is affordable at $4-$6 for most items, and the beer and wine is on par with what you are going to pay at a bar anyway.

The food is all Italian themed, but certainly isn't authentic if you are going to nit-pick about it. They have a couple items they list as "homemade", so I'm assuming everything else probably comes frozen from Sysco. It's all pretty good, and isn't anything to complain about for the price. They have wine that can be purchased by the cup or bottle, and have beer including Peroni, some light domestics, and a few local favorites. 

The bands are far from anything Italian, but it is fun popular cover music that everyone knows and enjoys. The bands play most of the evening with a few breaks in between sets and when they are switching bands. 

If you plan on staying for a while, you can bring chairs or blankets to setup in the park to watch the band and enjoy the evening. There is some limited seating in the food area, but I wouldn't come banking on that to be available. They do allow dogs, but it is a crowded event so they should be comfortable with that sort of environment. The food and drink booths only accept tickets, and the ticket people only accept cash. There is an ATM on site, but plan ahead if you don't want to pay fees to use it. Bathrooms are porta-pottys.

Their website is helpful, with most of the information anyone would be looking for. That can be found here: https://www.indyitalianfest.org/
Locally owned and locally invested. This bank is really the perfect community financial institution. Free checking account, no fees, really friendly and authentic. Exactly what I want in a bank.
Helpful people very polite and allowed me to use a few  tools for free when I was stuck stranded in traffic in front of this location.

I love love love Mad Nails! I love the ambiance first of all. If you like good vibes and good music, Mad Nails supplies it! The artist are exactly that!! I love trying wild and different designs and Morgan has always topped my expectations! I've tried multiple applications and have maintained healthy nails with each set. I do recommend scheduling your appointment before hand and also give yourself time to find parking. The wait may be long because of their popularity, but it's worth it. Just a heads up, make this a pampering session. Don't be in a rush! Sit back, relax, and watch your hands come to life.

Best seafood dishes!!! Friendly service. Love the piano player on weekends. Classy but casual.

I enjoy sabor divino. Dined here by myself, with a significant other, as a large group and every time service is fantastic.

Service is quite exceptional. Paced perfectly but not rushed with the privacy to hold a good conversation without being rudely interupted.

I prefer the fish dishes as they are seasoned perfectly and are so fresh. The accompaniments are always perfect and have so much flavour. Its definitly farm to table like quality. The steak is great too but I find with large groups the steak is kinda inconsistent. some pieces drastically overcooked and some rare. But when ordered  individually they are always perfect. 

I love how the desserts come in taster sizes too. I find the meals are large but I could never finish an entire dessert so the taster size is just right. I especially fancy the passionfruit cheesecake or the creme brulee. Both are outstanding.

If you want to try this place out without breaking the bank...lunch specials are awesome.  My fave is the Lobster risotto with black cod!!! Most specials are $21 and come with a choice of soup or salad. The specials change daily and are posted on their website. It sells out quick so best to get there before 1230.

This location is closed. Has been closed at least since may, 2014.   Go to the one in
Castleton
8651 Castlecreek Parkway East Drive
 Indianapolis, IN 46250 

(p) (317) 577-2211 | (f) (317) 577-0064

Great place in a great location. All outside (covered) seating, which is great for covid and all the sheep businesses that require vax cards in the area. The cafe au lait is fantastic and the beignets were great too but a lot of powdered sugar. They're cash only which is baffling to me since it's 2021.

We went here on a Saturday afternoon and honestly had low expectations. Turns out it's quite the spot! Outdoor seating was available and we walked up to the window where we met Stuart. He helped us figure out which beers to get but went far above and beyond and gave us some good information about the nearby neighborhood. He was enjoyable to talk to AND the beer was good. We'll definitely be coming back. Nothing but a 5.

BREAD PUDDING WAS AMAZING!!!!! Highly recommend it! 

Service was great, we were seated right away on a Saturday night and that was a plus! I ordered the cornmeal dusted tilapia and that was tasty!  Definitely coming back soon!

The crab cakes are more cake than crab which is disappointing. They are also served with honey mustard which is a bit strange. It overall made the dish way too sweet. The lobster chowder is tasty but it was served to me cold. By cold, I don't mean refrigerator cold but it was cooler than room temperature. That was disappointing. The shrimp were okay but I was kind of done mentally by the time I got to them.

I have been a client of Les Cheveux for about six years. I followed my longtime hairdresser Gloria when she moved there. I am very happy to say that my hairdresser Gloria is very happy working at Les Cheveux, and if she's happy I'm happy. It's a very friendly salon. I walk in a total wreck and leave the beautiful woman that I am..... Lol
The food is great and they have a huge selection of things to choose from. The service is also usually good and the bloody mary's are amazing!!!

This is by far one of the most beautiful resorts I've ever been too and that includes various parts of Caribbean. 

The hotel itself is gorgeous. Every single employee is extremely friendly and helpful. The suite was beautiful and clean, smelt like a high end spa, so relaxing. 

Pool and hot tubs are also clean and never felt cramped even though it was busy.

Beach was beautifully manicured and the activities they have are fun! 

Food was delicious. All the surrounding restaurants are equally as good. Have to try clear sky right beside the hotel, recommend the bean burger and calamari. 

Just an all around amazing experience!

We just celebrated Cinco de Mayo. El Sarape did an amazing job. The service was lightening fast and the food tasted fabulous. I have been to terrible cinco de mayo due to restaurants being overwhelmed. It was evident that they planned and executed very well.  Great job El Sarape!!!
I'm not a vegetarian, but I loved Blue Sage. The food is hearty and the variety is interesting, especially the soups. I had spicy sweet potato and it was excellent.

I definitely preferred the pizza from nabruzzi, but Enzo's is still a good take out option in the area. I recommend their meatball sub and garlic knots. The meatballs taste homemade and of good quality. We'll continue to get food from here, but I do wish they would still offer the pizzas they had when it was nabruzzi
Mess up with order due to lame neighbors, was totally resolved upon calling. Thank you for the great food and sorry for the confusion.

I would like to say that the host was really nice. Ok... With that said, the food is absolutely atrocious. For a place that specializes in crepes (its the center of their menu) you would think that they got making crepes down to a science.  They don't. The cook (i dare not say chef) must have graduted from the blintz factory out of IHOP because what they served WERE NOT crepes. They were cold, soggy, undercooked and the blintz batter they used in no way resembled crepes. My bacon was soft and seemed undercooked and the spinach was tossed in haphazardly. I will admit, Im angry... So very angry.....for me, my sister who was with me, and for the French.... I really wish I could say something redeeming about the crepes here... . I mean how difficult is it to make great tasting food!?! The concept of a crepe place is so SIMPLE... the menu a no brainer... PLEASE... Do some research online... I promise... Crepes are not that difficult... You have an incredible location, great staff. Fire the cook and hire someone who can make some good fricken crepes. Geez! With that said, I had an amazing Arnold Palmer and the atmosphere is great. I dont like bombing places. The good reviews must be from people who either work here, or know the staff personally. The crepe place in the Reno Mall is better.. Yes.. I said it... The Reno Mall. Go back to the drawing board with this menu... You truly have a wonderful opportunity to make great food...don't waste it.
The shrimp cocktail is fantastic - make sure you use the crackers and not drink water! Have always gone with a group of about 20 and service and food have been outstanding.

I really freaking love this place. It is seriously one of my favorite places to get mexican food, namely carne asada (top sirloin) in Tucson. They have home made tortillas which are wonderful. You can buy meals for 2, 4 or buy the meat by the pound. Their quesadillas are authentic, filled with meat and cheese...I get tired of the typical tons of cheese and little meat quesadillas found around town. They have an incredible salsa and veggie bar. Their guacamole salsa is incredibly tasty. They also have some great tortilla chips sitting out for your pleasure. Their charro beans are great. I don't like rice or refried beans much so I can't really speak to theirs.

They also have this crazy, modern soda machine. It's touch screen with a potential 150 combinations of water and soda. There are so many different flavors that there is definately something for everyone. 

They are moderately priced, a little bit more expensive than similar places in town. However, for the quality and freshness, they are well worth the price.

I'm telling you, these folks should change their name. They are soooo good- they shouldn't keep themselves a secret!  I called their phone number at 12pm on a Friday and explained my emergency. Lynn immediately found an opening in the schedule and sent out 2 terrific cleaners within a matter of 1.5 hours. I couldn't be more pleased or more appreciative. Thanks, Lynn and Best Kept Secret!  I'm going to tell everyone I know about you!

I've pasted Pura Vida dozens of times on my bike, and for some reason, I've always been interested in eating here.  I stopped in with Emily on Saturday night for dinner.

Right off the bat, I was surprised by how empty this place was.  At 7:30 on a Saturday night, there were only two other tables.  The decor here is awful; kitschy tropical themed pieces around the room outlined by Christmas lights.  To top it if, terrible trance music was playing the entire time we were there.  Seriously, who can take that much trance music??  Luckily, as if some kind of make up call, our servers were attentive and friendly.  The service is as good as the atmosphere is bad.

Our appetizer was a grilled zucchini and cheese dish.  It tasted good, nothing amazing, and was pathetically small for $7.  We both ordered enchilada dishes for entrees.  Orders can with rice, beans, a dollop of guacamole and three enchiladas.   I mixed and got three different kinds of meat.  The chorizo was pretty good, and the chicken was okay.  I wish I would have gone with the shredded beef for all three because it was the only thing I ate that came close to impressing my palate.  Emily was quite happy with her order of vegetarian chorizo however.     

I like that this spot is a BYO, but there's not much to say about eating here.  My experience was incredibly average.  It looks like they have some outdoor seating, but not any when we visited.

Bottom Line:  It's cheaper than most areas in the neighborhood, and also not as nice.  I could provide several better recommendations, even if you're in the mood for cheap BYOB Mexican.  They have Cuban sandwiches on the menu which may be the only thing that could entice me to return.

Went today for a nice lunch; the draft beer was so vinegary no matter which we chose. The bartender told the waitress yeah we have a problem with the lines, have had a few complaints already, yet they were still selling the beer. It was so rancid, yet the bartender and waitress did nothing about it for the next unsuspecting customers to come. I guess they figured they would get away with it and play the lazy card. Not impressed with either the bartender or waitress for not wanting to let the owner know about this. People pay for a nice lunch and get sick, thanks!

We had a nice Sunday brunch here recently. I ordered the waffle with candied pecans and husband ordered avocado toast. Coffee here is greeeaat! Everything was delicious and the atmosphere and servers were extremely nice. I would come back.

Food was really good service was a little slow and sporadic waitress did not check in with us very often had to go to the register to check out couldn't get our check taken care of but it is good food fair price so I will return
Food and drink was delicious. The waiter was the friendliest person I've ever met. Definitely going back

in my honest opinion, this is the best acme i have ever been too. maybe i'm biased because it's "my" acme..meaning it's the acme i've been going to for years... but i just love everything about it. the produce selection is better than any other stores in the area, the isles are always clear and everything is stocked no matter what day of the week or time of day. something i appreciate, besides them also selling wine, is the staff. now there are a few younger cashiers that i try and avoid at checkout because they seem to find their phones more important but overall the staff is excellent. very friendly people and also something i notice is that most of the staff members have been there for years and years. i have been coming to this acme at least once per week for years and years and most of the cashiers are the same.. that really says something about the work place. i would highly recommend going to this acme and if you do find yourself having a not so pleasant experience at any point, the customer service staff are so accommodating.

Nothing but positive things to say. Moved here from Florida and Doug gave me the run down on the local breaks, how it'll be different from what I may be used to, and recommended a great board. Hit the water immediately and it's been serving me well.

Had a great experience last night painting irises! Melissa was a fantastic instructor. She started by giving us an overview of how we were going to approach the painting, and provided very clear instructions throughout. When I got sort of stuck, she came over and kindly helped me figure out how to fix my mess! Super fun! Already looking forward to trying again.

This is a cute little place on the corner of the very happening 13th street in philly. I love the cosy ambience which is perfect for a casual evening out. I have always enjoyed their pizzas and they have good meat boards too, the hot coppa and diavlo are my favorites. The service is great and the waiting times are better than any of the other restaurants around.

For $600 dollars a night I could have stayed at many places I chose this place to enjoy the beach and that dream was ruined when i took my kids to play on the sand and discovered we were playing in crude oil.  

I am not one to exaggerate but i lost my slippers to this crude and my swimming shorts.  

It took me over 2 hours to clean up the crude off my skin.  The hotel had gasoline wipes that assisted with the clean up effort.  

The Hotel itself was very nice but for $600 night I could have picked so many other hotels I only chose this place for the beach experience.   Avoid going to the beach here if you go you will regret it.
Well this is interesting.   Sign on the door says open at 4.   Happy hour sign on the street 4:30 happy hour.   Walking in at 5:06 pm and told not open yet come back later.  No thanks.

Stayed for 2 nights on a post-Mardi Gras weekend for a little stay-cation. 

For a high priced FQ hotel, I had high expectations. The location is hard to beat and the set up was really charming and quaint as others have mentioned. But, the service was mediocre and I didn't feel that the staff was welcoming or friendly enough. The walls between our room and the next were very thin and I heard our neighbors talking very clearly at 5:30 am when they came back to the room; you could even hear their alarms go off later in the morning. The rooms (in the area where I stayed) all face the courtyard and pool, and it wasn't very quiet or peaceful. You could hear the voice of every person who was hanging out in the courtyard, etc. I expected the usual ambient FQ noise but not the activities of every other guest.  

The room itself was pretty standard and I didn't feel that it was much more luxurious than average for the price we paid. The bed was comfy and the headboard was pretty, but not many extra frills here. The toiletries only offer a shampoo/conditioner combo, and there are no robes. We did enjoy the coffee maker. 

Final logistical things: There is no elevator. The doors to the lobby are awkwardly narrow and stiff making it hard to get your luggage in and out of it. At times there was no staff member watching the gate to let you in "after hours."

i dont know about this place. i had the straw and hay pasta and my bf had the santa fe turkey sandwich. IMO, both of them were less than mediocre. we went on a whim and didnt read any yelp reviews so we might have ordered two of the worst things you can possibly order. who knows. but i can say that i am extremely surprised that people are giving such high ratings. 

santa fe turkey (grilled sandwich): i
 thought the turkey was supposed to be grilled but not so. then i thought the whole sandwich was supposed to be grilled but not so. then what in that sandwich was grilled?!?! no idea. 

straw & hay: the pasta was overcooked. it said spinach fettucini but it had regular pasta underneath my spinach ones. maybe to decrease cost?? they used actual shredded parmesan cheese. i liked their big garlic bread that came with it. that was the only good part.

will i go back?
maybe, i might go and try what everyone else likes, and if its good ill rewrite the review. as of now, it did not live up to my standards at all.
