Great car selection - love the "aisle" where I can select my own. All of the options were new models, the Chevy Malibu I selected had all the luxury features, it was great to be able to use the usb port to charge my iphone AND listen to my own music.

Pickup and return was easy and professional, will definitely be back

I was excited about trying this pizza spot after passing by it numerous times.   I was going to order the Margherita pizza which was $12 but I had I great one on Wednesday from Catelli Duo and it was freaking awesome so I didnt want to put a new spot on such of a high expectation. I opted for the pricer $15 Truffle pizza. I dont mind paying such a high price for pizza if it's worth it. But this pizza was B.L.A.N.D. I had to put salt, garlic and crush red peppers just to make it edible.   The crust was the best thing going for the pizza, maybe I should have started out with something simple. Honestly, I could have made a better pie at home. This pizza is worth $10 not $15.  This was a $15 lesson but at least I learned my lesson.
Fast, friendly service! Highly recommend taking your car here for smog or any repair!

We got a half chicken parm, half all meat pizza. The chicken parm pizza is life changing! I was a little skeptical at first but it was such a good combination of flavor. The all meat pizza was good, too. The sausage was really flavorful! The only thing is the crust was a little hard and chewy but tasted good. We also ordered the garlic knots which were great, too. Very fresh and lots of garlic! 

We picked up our pizza and they had the slices in the glass case and it seemed a little old? I'm not sure because I didn't have it by the slice but it just didn't look that great to me. 

Overall, really good pizza!

Gotta be honest... I haven't ever set foot in Helen Fitz's again after the awful experience I had when I went with a couple of my best friends on a weekend for dinner and drinks. The bar area was packed, which isn't necessarily a bad thing in and of itself. But the way the floor-plan is at Helen's, it winds up with a lot of people lined up all up and down the bar, with little room to move as people try to come and go. You wind up with lots of people pushing or bumping up against each other as others struggle to watch something on one of the TVs or wait for their drink.

We wound up with problems when one of their bouncers jabbed my buddy in the back with his flashlight. (To this day, we have no clue what prompted that, or if it was simply an accident.) But as any normal person would do, my friend spun around to confront whoever was shoving a steel object into his back -- and the bouncer got all aggressive in response, ultimately demanding we leave.

We attempted to complain to management, but were met with an apathetic "So what? Who cares?" attitude that told us this establishment assumes they'll make plenty of money on quantity of visitors - regardless of customer service.

I drive by this place all the time and their parking lot is pretty full. I know they have some decent bands playing there too, now and then. So *maybe* they're doing something right and I'm not giving them enough credit? But I keep getting the feeling that ultimately, they only do so well because of a relative lack of bars or hangouts in the Sunset Hills / South County area and the fact they've been around so long?

We like the food but the service and wait time are absolutely horrible.  Waited 20 minutes to get food at a mall food court... ridiculous!  The rest of the family had finished their food before we even picked ours up.  NOT WORTH IT!

Oishii is a good to have in the area offering some diversity from fast food chains.  I have had their chicken teriyaki and two of their noodle soups.  I love Vietnamese, Thai, among other Asian noodle soups and neither of these here were good.  They lack substance, but that could be the style and not the restaurant's fault.  The chicken teriyaki lunch special was subpar as well.  I still plan on eventually trying their sit down hibachi cook in front of you tables.

Sussman Kia got us into the car we wanted.  They scheduled a test drive within a day of our call, answered all of our questions, and didn't try to add on a lot of unnecessary options.  The price and financing were lowest we found.

Some Employees are sometimes friendly, other employees are always nice, or bare minimum... cordial at least. Atmosphere is occasionally welcoming.

Gym stuff: there are always machines available and I almost never have to wait. It's never overwhelmingly busy, even at peak times. It's always clean, not stinky like many gyms. The spa area is always open and clean also. The bathrooms are nice. It's great for the person who wants to get fit, or lift basic weights, but not a body builder type place. Good for regular peeps who just wanna stay fit.

I just moved to Hamilton and looking for a new gym.  I figured I'd check out a few places in the area.  I stopped into Powerhouse late one day and looked around with the sales manager (I think that was his title).. He cursed throughout the entire visit! I was shocked at the level of unprofessionalism. He told me that the gym had recently been renovated. I don't know if that's true or not because the place was DIRTY.  I understand chalk dust, people don't put things back etc, but I'm talking about cobwebs and dust bunnies lined up behind the dumbbells like it's never seen a mop or a vacuum, like...EVER. So the guy brings me back into his office to talk about options. I was unimpressed but trying to be polite still so I told him I was going to look around at other gyms. He got defensive and arrogant and started talking about how all the other gyms in the area keep calling him to come work for them.  Arrogance, unprofessionalism and dirty. I think I'll go elsewhere.

It's so wonderful to welcome Pamcakes to the neighborhood!
The cupcakes are yummy, reasonably priced , and 
served with a smile !

The Chuck Wagon continues to serve a very solid menu at a reasonable price for the last 35+ years.  We were delighted to order the taco family pack to go and follow the strict Covid standards.  To our children's delight, who live/work in St. Louis, we took them each a family pack.  They love not only the tacos but especially the enchilada tray and the burrito tray.
We will be using this safe socially distant functionality again in the future weeks as the pandemic winds down. Thanks Chuck wagon for a great experience.

While Fare is quite pricey, it is the ONLY restaurant in New Orleans that I can find that is soy, peanut, dairy, and gluten free. For someone whose allergies are as severe as mine, this restaurant is a huge relief. I highly recommend the Zucchini muffins and strawberry banana smoothies. Mmm.

Place was extremely clean and immediately as I walked in I could smell the delicious fresh bread. I enjoyed their Taro boba milk tea and wished I got a baked item because it smelled delicious! This place is sorta hidden, on my way there, I took an immediate right, so just be on the look out if you're going to this place. Overall I would return!

This office has many different eye specialists under one roof.  It's very convenient if you have any issues with your eyes.  I was there for the first time and was seen by Dr. Alonzo. First the technician did all the necessary tests beforehand and dilated my eyes.  Then Dr. Alonzo does the eye exam.  I found Dr. Alonzo to be very personable. 
My husband had cataract surgery with Dr. Henderson and everything went perfectly and he is happy.  
The staff are all lovely and the office is clean and modern. 
The only negative about this office is the wait time. You can easily be there for a good 2 hours from start to finish so prepare accordingly if you have an appointment. 
There is a huge parking lot.

This is the best yoga spot I've been to yet and my fiancee is a yoga teacher so we've seen a lot of studios...and sadly I no longer live in SB. But every time Im down there, Deb's sat am class is on our schedule. No better way to start the weekend. It will kick your ass and also happens to double as one of the best guided meditations I've seen. Deb covers it all! Very good looking crowd in there which doesn't hurt much. Nieve was our sub on Sat morning last time and she filled Deb's yoga slippers quite well. Two incredible teachers. And then roll right over to Backyard Bowls once you're done and you have yourself a decent little Saturday!
We love it and go regularly. The black bean burger and the tuna burger are delicious. The salmon sandwich is also fantastic. I do eat burgers occasionally, but rarely. Definitely get the onion rings.

I'd driven by this place as it was being constructed... but didn't get the opportunity to eat here until Monday night...  and now I've eaten here two days in a row!  SO YUMMY!!!

I ordered the chili thai basil mango noodle - something dish - - not sure the correct name.  It was FABULOUS!

The prices are reasonable.  The portions are just right.  

I'll definitely be back!

I have been eating at this establishment since its opening. At first, the food was excellent. But over the few years it has been open and the change of ownership, the quality and taste of the food has gone downhill. To top it off, I had a buy 5 and get the 6th free incentive card. They decided to stop this incentive and when they changed their policy denied me the 6th sandwich I had earned with them. Great way of taking care of the customer!

My first visit, with high expectations from prior dining at Little Fish. Well they did not disappoint! I'm amazed at how the chef uses different spices and textures to prepare fish. The flavors that hit my palate was like a party in my mouth on every bite and uniquely different than I've ever had. I had the Octopus app (best I ever had) and Barramundi for my main meal. The tender fava beans soaked up the flavors of the broth with spices and peppers and was absolutely fabulous! Great service, intimate atmosphere, I'm afraid unless they have plans to expand, it might get difficult to make a reservation as word gets out about this yum fish lover's restaurant! I will be back and soon!

After two failed deliveries through FTD and 1800Flowers, I called Westbank Florist. Lesson learned, I should have called them first. The female who took my order over the phone was very polite and made an excellent recommendation after I gave her a price point. The arrangement was delivered timely, just as promised, and they even accommodated knowing the receiver would be at work on the day of delivery.  I am beyond pleased and will be using Westbank Florist again!
Food is very good and the service is even better.  Nice to have a quality restaurant in the Vail area.

Absolutely the worst P.O. ever! I was waiting for 2 parcels from Amazon. They delivered the small package, which my daughter picked up at the door, but I guess the larger package was too much to handle. They then said that no one was at home to leave the 2nd much larger package. I was sitting right there. Now I have to go to post office to pick up a package that I already paid to be delivered!!!

Got the guacamole (corn, onion, lime, rabanito, cilantro, jalapeño, EVO) and spicy chips, as well as the Antojito Special - 1 taco, 1 chalupa, 1 tosta da barbacoa - everything was delicious! Tried the brisket and shrimp versions of the same special and they were both tops too. Would come again and recommend.

MAKE SURE YOU ARE CHARGED CORRECTLY. My situation was fixed but a pain in the ass to type in my entire credit card number, expiration date, zip code for a refund. And if I mistyped a number, then no refund   I ordered the short ribs and a pork burrito. And was charged for 2 steaks. The difference is pennies but will add up in the long run. 


Other than that, the food is absolutely amazing. The line is almost always at the door. The staff knows what sauces/toppings to pair with what type of meat. 

I was in heaven when I ate my burrito. It is made to order/chipotle/subway styled. 

The tortilla is so big.. the brown rice, beans, meat options, kale, lettuce, sour cream, pineapple habanero, corn salsa, sauces are fresh, constantly running out of items, and replenishing them. 

Everything was so good and the staff there are constantly hustling. The burrito was so big and filled that it ripped when being rolled.

I went to Mimada with a Groupon for a Brazilian.  I was a little taken aback to have a guy do the waxing, but Zachary is not heterosexual, and very talkative, and really put me more at ease than any woman I've had.  Plus, it was the LEAST painful wax I've ever had.
Can't say enough great things about the Oyster house. If I could give 100 stars I would! Anything in the menu is to die for.
Decent atmosphere and food in a typical bar setting. Food is average at best, and overpriced for the quality. Small dining section and crammed.
One of my favorite restaurants to open last year. Their food was great. The server was helpful in recommendations. It can get busy, so plan accordingly to avoid a long wait.

One of my favorite pizza places, which makes its location so much better since it is convenient. It's a bar and since it's on University, it is always crowded and finding a place to eat is damn near impossible. The variety of pizzas and the size of the slices they have make it almost worth it, but I usually get it to go anyway. Definitely stock up on campus coupons!

Well, I attempted to order online from grub hub despite the negative reviews. Go through the process of creating account only to discover this restaurant doesn't accept online orders. They close in 43 minutes. Maybe that's the reason. But I'm .85 miles from the location and my order would have been ready in 10 minutes. Oh well.

This review is for drive up & go. Unfortunately, this was the second time we ordered online only to arrive at outback & have food promised ready at 6:00 pm only to have them bring our food to our car at 6:30 pm, while 2 other vehicles drive up after us & they receive their orders before us & depart. Finally a gal tells us they had to fix our order as there was a problem. We finally receive our order & a manager approaches us to apologize & make it right. He explained they were short staffed due to Covid & very busy. He did give us a gift card for another time as well as a appetizer & free dessert card. He was very nice. However, once we get home we are still missing a side dish we ordered & paid for. I give up! They need to get much better organized.

I get my pedi and gel manicure done a couple day ago It was the bad services .The girl name Lisa did my pedicure so fast less than 20mn and when she did my gel manicure she didn't seal the tips . It started chip out and peal off the next day . It have never happened like this before . I get my gel done every two weeks. Everybody body work so good . I don't know what happen this time ?
Dean is my guy who did my gel last 3 weeks . And he has good massage .

Just came back from lunch at chickie and pete's and everything was excellent. My son and I took my mother for her birthday. We had the lobster white pizza which was out of this world. We had  the little lobster tails which were delicious. Fried calamari was excellent, son had a bbq burger which he said was very good and of course we had the crab fries. waitress was very nice and friendly. Love this place! Excellent customer service and food!

Vietnam House is a brand new, just opened, noodle place at the NW corner of 9th and Race. It's where the New Harmony Cafe used to be. The food is decent, but they've got tough competition, since they are literally located right next to Pho Xe Lua (the choo choo train place), which has pretty awesome pho. So honestly, I don't think they'll do great, aside from the fact that they're open on Wednesdays and Pho Xe Lua isn't. Their portions are fairly generous, though the meat just doesn't taste quite as good as choochoo train's tastes. They're brand new so I'll cut them some slack, but they have some misprints on the menu. The #15 spicy pho bowl says it comes with bread. It did not. And when asked about it, the servers and staff just claim that it was a mistake on the menu, so too bad. There wasn't an apology. It was just.. too bad.
They also have your expected vermicelli and rice dishes, and appetizers like spring rolls.
The total for 4 bowls and spring rolls was ~$26 (including a 10% off for grand opening). Cash only.

On any given day, aside from Wednesday, I'll probably just go next door.

Great food and great people! The food was absolutely delicious and beautiful. The staff was so nice and helpful. My sister and I both got the raspberry cheese blintz and it was the best crepes we've ever had. It had a delicious lemon mascarpone filling that paired perfectly with the raspberry sauce and berries on top! I want to go back already.

One of the most uncomfortable booths I have ever sat in, ever. One of the servers has a grating loud voice and doesn't give very good service. The other server was very attentive, quick, and polite. Despite the booths being uncomfortable, the restaurant was very clean. The singing Bass fish above the register are a nice touch. 

Most of the other customers seemed to be getting the 2-rolls or 3-rolls lunch specials which include soup and I think a small appetizer. 

The food was really good. The All-You-Can-Eat menu is $19.99 Mon-Thurs and $21.99 Fri-Sun. Included with the AYCE sushi is your choice of appetizers, soups, salads, and specialty, cooked, and raw rolls, nigiri, and sashimi. 

I started with Miso Soup which was flavorful and good. I ordered a specialty roll (Magic Castle=spicy something fish with cream cheese, fried, topped with spicy something else), 2 pieces of squid nigiri (ika), and a Philly Roll (smoked salmon and cream cheese) to start. I usually steer clear of fried rolls and anything with excess sauce but I'm glad I tried this one, as it was quite tasty. Ika was delicious and fresh and I ordered it with my next 2 orders too. The specialty rolls are full-sized whereas the regular rolls are just 3 pieces. Nigiri and sashimi are ordered as singles. My 2nd order was another Philly Roll (3 pieces), and Eel Roll (3 pieces), Eel Nigiri, and Squid Sashimi (no rice). Round 3 was just nigiri: ika, white tuna, smoked salmon, tuna. Yum yum yum. I definitely got my money's worth. 

I had thought "Oh, the rolls will only have a little bit of fish in them, and the fish slices will be ridiculously thin," but this wasn't the case at all. The fish slices weren't great hulking chunks but were the right size to be a bite. For the money, I think this has become my favorite sushi place in Indy. $23.97 was my grand total, I think. 

I arrived at 11:20am and was the first one in the restaurant. When I left the place was about half full and had carry-out orders going out every 10 minutes or so. 

There is children's pricing for the AYCE sushi, and there's also a kid's menu of 2 cooked items (chicken teriyaki or tempura, I think).

We came in on a busy Friday night. We waited about 5 minutes for a table. Everyone was super friendly. The service was awesome. The food was great! We were surprised with the quickness they brought the food to the table. We've been to another endless sushi restaurant as they always make you wait when you order.

While I am from the St Louis area, I come frequently to Carmel, IN as my parents live here.  I have been getting threaded since 1994.  I have gone thru a lot of hardship trying to find someone that threads properly.  When I say properly, I mean the person understands skincare, through and through.

I have struggled in St Louis trying to find someone that can thread well.  I have all kinds of scars on my neck and face now, due to individuals that do not thread with care.  

Kavi of Salon 96 is THE best threader I've been to in Indianapolis.  I came across her during my visit this January, 2010.  Her method of threading is meticulous, considerate and well-practiced.  I have not had one cut as a result of her techniques.  I am so very glad to have found her.  She also specializes in herbal facials, which I look forward to this week.

If you've never tried threading, it's a wonderful thing.  I've got several friends in St Louis that now get their facial hair threaded, as opposed to waxed.  Waxing on your face has some detriments to it.  Over time, it will cause your skin to sag.

I highly recommend Kavi of Salon 96.  She will not steer you wrong.  She has been a pleasure, and I look forward to seeing her on my future visits to Indiana!

Good food at a reasonable price. 

My husband and I split the Costa Rica bowl along with a side of biscuits and gravy. 

The biscuits are out of this world and the gravy is the best I've ever had. I'm always disappointed by gravies but this one delivers! 

The coffee isn't strong enough but my cup was always full. 

Good service and a clean restroom. Which has been hard to come by during this trip.

I love it here! I am shocked by all the negative comments because I have had nothing but a wonderful experience from move in till now over a year and half later. I have met the most exceptional group of people I consider my closest friends now. The staff is amazing and has responded and reacted immediately upon anything I need (including helping with my application upon move in because I was in a rush on her own free time after work). I highly recommend this place and tell anyone who asks to move here. Upon lease renewal I had a very tiny increase that I had no issue with because they are working hard and have installed a brand new gym, sports lounge, new carpets, painted, steam cleaned halls...you name it the improvements keep coming. Im sorry that those reviews may influence people, but I just wanted to say Im staying here as long as I can and am extremely thankful I found my new home!

Finding parking is the first challenge -- it only has parking spaces for about half the number of people it could seat. Nearby lots have ominous warnings about being towed.

I was there with my wife and another couple. Ordered a marguerita, which was OK. Ordered carne asada, which was OK. The menu didn't have a lot of variety -- basically tacos, burritos, enchaladas, chimichangas and fajitas.


In my opinion, not worth the hassle of parking to eat mediocre mexican food.

The service was good. Our server had no affect on our bad experience. We ordered a medium pizza and two kids meals at exactly 3:55 pm. After about 45 minutes of waiting and asking for a manager, I was told that there were only 2 people cooking. Ok. Whatever, but 3 other tables got their meals before us.  They were sat literally 30 minutes after we arrived. It's unbelievable. The kitchen manager was no help. We were offered nothing for our 65 minute wait for our food. I am speechless. I will never return here
Had the black spaghetti and it was very good. Ate at the bar and the bartender was very friendly and knowledgeable about their sizable wine list.

the best blt in stl
yelp wants me to say more, so blah blah blah

Good food-not over the top....but if you live in Fenton, it is a nice place to go.  Selection is good and they are always busy.  They are very generous with their portions of chips too.  There is a small area outside for sitting---it only has 3 tables I believe.  The staff here are very very friendly.  If you have a large group---I would call ahead and give them a heads up.

Wasabi is quickly becoming the only spot in the city I will trust for sushi. After a sub-par experience elsewhere, my roommate and I decided to hut up Wasabi a few days later since I was still craving some GOOD sushi. We went right after work and were pleasantly surprised with Happy Hour! YAY! Heavily discounted apps and select rolls? Sign me up! We got a bit overzealous and ended up with a boatload of sushi rolls (literally!) but it was delicious and we left fat and happy. The only slight disappointment was the Rasta Roll, which has jalapenos in it... odd flavor for a sushi roll, but not the end of the world. Service was great as usual!

Oh, and a tip, because we learned this the hard way over the summer... if it's hot out and you opt to eat outside, your sushi will fall apart! (not that we have to worry about heat for quite some time, sadly).
A wonderful Italian restaurant.  Love the chicken picata or sorentino with spinach...

I had two colonics at Natural Rejuvenation and Dr. Terri was such a pleasure. Her facility seemed to be pretty clean, before I began I gave the machine an extra wipe down, mainly because I'm a super germaphobe. She was very helpful throughout the process . The ambiance is OK. The office itself is pretty small so make sure you bring head phones otherwise you'll be able to hear the people next to you releasing as well. The only thing that I just can't allow myself to get over is how disgustingly dirty the trash can was. Understandably , because the office is so old, you aren't allowed to put any paper product in the toilet , including tissue. One would think that because this is a place that deals with feces everything in the room would be pristine . In my two trips I found both garbage cans ,in two separate rooms were filled to the max with trash and looked liked they had NEVER been cleaned. They were so filthy it made me question the overall cleanliness of the entire office. That and the fact that I'm not 100% sure that she wiped the machine down with any type of antibacterial solution before she took her next client in the room is why I can't bring myself to every return here,or give it more than two stars.
Service was pretty slow. The waitress seemed as if she was focused on something other than work. Food was good though!

My husband and I have just finished the trial box $60/box every other week.

To date we have  picked up our order at the warehouse as we had running around to do in the south end each weekend anyways, the staff are always friendly.  

We consume a good amount of fruits and vegetables in our household and found it easy to consume all the fruit in a week and vegetables in one to two.

I found the fruit is usually best eaten quickly but easily lasts a week, the vegetables are amazingly fresh, I have been able to eat salad well over a week after pick up its that fresh.

So we have been getting the weekly condo delivery and it is great, we have actually started getting the canning produce we eat some as is and I hot water bath the rest, exceptional.

As for the delivery, I made a buzzer code note on my account and they buzz at the same time each week and I come home to a big box of fresh produce.

The menu had a bunch of options for vegetarians and carnivores alike. It even had el salvadorian pepusas and tamales. I went with a grilled shrimp burrito and it was packed with lots of flavor. It was cheesy, gooeyness with warm rice and beans and a fruit salsa. I added extra salsa from the salsa bar for some heat. The medium salsa was very good with nodes of lime.  

I can't wait to come back and try the veggie pupusas! :)
Getting my pedi done as we speak. Tilley is amazing. Doing my Van Halen stripes. She is the best for design work. I love this place. Thank you for the awesome hospitality. #maleswithnails #nailedit

I love tacos; I mean who doesn't so when a new taco joint opened close by, I couldn't wait to try it.  I love Tried and True and I'd seen several posts recommending Humble Taco so I knew we had to try it out. 

The options are a bit overwhelming online so take-out didn't seem like a good first try option.  I was shocked to see how packed they were. I felt like I had walked into the hottest bar on a Friday night. I expect this place to do well and be an older hot spot (didn't feel quite as welcoming for me and my daughter). 

The food was decent, but a bit overpriced. My daughter wasn't quite as impressed.  The bar is located in Johnson County which is no longer in a mask mandate and they sure took advantage of that. There was not a mask wearer in sight. Unfortunately, this isn't the environment we are looking for while still very much living in a pandemic. (There is obviously a market for this for those interested). 

I hope this place does well because you hate to see shutdowns, but unfortunately we have no intentions of returning.

These guys were awesome. They were friendly, fast, and helped me out with a discount I didn't know about so I could get the best deal on winter tires! Plus, I could schedule an appointment, so I wasn't stuck waiting around like when I go to walmart.

I was in Philly for a wedding weekend and met up with one my college friends, a Philadelphia local. Of course, I requested he take me for a great cheese-steak. Now, every tourist knows of Geno's and Pat's, but my friend, and some other locals I spoke with shook their heads when I mentioned these travel/food network channel destinations and suggested Jim's. 

A short walk from Independence Hall and the myriad of historical sights seen there is the South Street/Society Hill area which has a bunch of funky looking shops, art galleries, bars, and restaurants. We got to Jim's at about 1:45 pm on a Saturday and it was pretty crowded. The line was not out the door, but was only about two people shy away from being so. However, the line moves quickly.  While waiting in line you see the meat being sliced and boy does it look fresh. There is constant beef and onions on the griddle to make the operation run smoothly, and it does. 

I ordered a cheese-steak with provolone, sweet peppers and onions. (Cheese whiz does not do it for me, although it is an option here, as is American cheese). We ate in the upstairs dining room which is totally no frills. The cheese-steak, in my possibly inexperienced cheesteak eating opinion, was fantastic. The meat is savory and flavorful and the provolone was truly outstanding and smokey, unlike the provolone you so often get at places like, say Subway. The sweet peppers were also fantastic as were the onions which were also very sweet. The meat retained juice getting the bun a little soppy but not too mushy. I did not want to finish this sandwich I was enjoying it so much. 

My only real complaint with it though is that it couldd have been a bit bigger. Now, I had been walking around for about four hours that morning and might have worked up a large appetite but the other diners I was with were also not totally satisfied and we probably could have split a couple of more sandwiches. For about ten bucks you want to be full. This is why I need to deduct one star. Please note though that for many people, this sandwich will be more than enough, but it just was not for me and my friends. 

Overall though, I really liked Jim's and am jealous of Philadelphians who get to have cheese-steaks like this on a regular basis.

Fantastic meal on Frenchmen.  Teeny tiny place upstairs with bout 10 tables.  Server was great and recommended all of the best entrees.  I ordered the chicken picatta and was very pleased.  Loved the artichokes it came with.  the vermicelli with marinara was delicious and very different...cayenne pepper in the sauce gives it that creole italian kick.  two members of my prty got the ribeye with ocean sauce...unreal.  rack of lamb is ENORMOUS! Mussels appetizer was so good and super garlicky.

great experience all around.

Awesome outdoor space!! There's a huge bar and a ton of tables inside.  Outside, there are a few nice big picnic tables, corn hole, and string lights to complete the vibe.  I tried the Two of Tarts sour beer and Breaking Away (ale with lemon and ginger) and honestly loved the taste of both.

I've only ordered pizza from here and it's not exactly "bad" per se, the food we got just tasted really processed.  The pizza sauce was sweet and thick like tomato paste.  The crust was dense and bland (we got the thicker crust not the ultra thin cracker type)

I guess this is a local chain but the national chains are better *shrug*

For chain style st louis pizza, IMOs is better.  For traditional pizza (not ultra thin crust, no provel) try Corner Bistro. - their pizzas are great.

None of this should reflect poorly on this particular store.  The staff was perfectly friendly, I just don't see any reason to get a pizza here when there are tons of other places who do it better.

This place was a o.k. but not my favorite bbq establishments that I visited in Nashville which was surprising given the long line. 

I had the pulled pork and brisket. They both were good but not great. The cornbread was also very underwhelming. 

Rank of establishments in Nashville area I visited:

1 being my favorite 

1-Catbird  $$$$
2-Hattie B's  $$
3- Peg Leg Porker $$
4- Fin and Pearl  $$
5-Martin's BBQ   $$
6- Mission BBQ  $$
7-Biscuit Love  $$

Okay, so where do I start!?  This place is exceptional!!  My wife and I decided to try it based on all the great reviews and could not believe the experience we had!  Coming from a family that owned a restaurant, I know what it takes when it comes to providing great customer service and I was very pleased with the way services was provided at this establishment.  The manager is so friendly and truly has a passion for his business and it shows.  We had the lamb mango and the goat marsala.  Both dishes were amazingly flavorful with the right amount of spice.  For beverages, the wife had the mango lassi which is a delicious soothing yogurt sweet drink with mango.  I chose the hot  Indian Masala Tea.  It has just the right amount of sweetness and spice that resemble a hot cup of Chai.  The food is plentiful, the atmosphere is unique, but the service is what sets this place apart from any other restaurant in the area!!  After our dinner the server came by to ask if we made room for desert.  Even though we declined, we were still brought a small desert sample of Kheer, which is a traditional basmati rice pudding, flavored with almonds & pistachios.  Again, this place did not let us down and I highly recommend it if you are in the area.  Take note, the menu can be overwhelming.  If this is new to you, I recommend coming during their lunch time when they serve a buffet with a nice selection for you to sample.

This used to be our family go to spot. There was something for everyone and you can show up with a large group and it's no big deal because they have tons of seating and long tables. The service is pretty good and so is the food and variety of the buffet. However.... we will never go again. Recently we went with 15 people in our party and 3 found tiny bugs IN THEIR FOOD. BUGS. The managers apologized and claimed they just cleaned the night before and this always happens when they clean. They also gave those people their meals free. But since everyone had already had at least one plate of food who knows if we had been shoveling more hidden bugs in our mouths the whole time. Disgusting. I understand that bugs happen in restaurants but apparently I am not the only reviewer that has experienced this here. They need to get serious about their pest control because they just lost a lot of loyal customers.

I think this will be the flagship store of what will soon become a burger franchise a la Five Guys. It has the inside vibe of a "classic 50's diner" minus the cheesiness and plus a stylish design. It is always over flowing with families and the company touts it's community involvement on it's walls. The servers are always fast and friendly

The menu is large and I have yet to try it all. The Tex Mex burger with onion straws, chipotle mayo, and avocado was awesome. The blue cheese and bacon burger was just OK. The blue cheese sauce was a little overwhelming/salty towards the end.

 I gave the sweet potato fries a chance, but I like the regular fries better. Overall the fries are a little too thin for my liking.

The chocolate milkshake was awesome. My only request, a cookies and cream milkshake please!

For the non burger lovers, they have turkey, chicken, and even ahi tuna burgers. They also have an extensive selection of salads that looked pretty enticing. 

I plan on coming here until I've tried everything!

We have been going to pascuccis for 20 years. For years I have said Pascuccis is the best place to go for great food and service. I was extremely disappointed with both. The staff was NOT friendly or welcoming. The first words from the hostess was how many. No greeting or smile. The only words from the waiter was Are you ready? The food came after a long wait. No apology. The risotto was not worth taking the leftovers home. The steak was overdone and not tasty. Bad service and terrible food. We my never go back. Not sure what's going on but maybe the owner will read this and fix her restaurant.

This was an excellent breakfast experience. Do you want real fluffy buttermilk pancakes where you can taste the zing of the buttermilk along with the sweetness of the maple syrup poured over it?  We also had the craftsman omelette, no additional hot sauce required. Full of flavor. Everything is fresh as if it came straight from your home kitchen. Liv and Charlie's is highly recommended!

I started going to Revel Kitchen about six months ago, and I was immediately obsessed. I've never seen another fast casual place that so perfectly struck a balance of fast, healthy, and tasty. Serious "love at first bite" stuff.

Their menu was simple: pick a base (salad, bowl, wrap, eggs, etc.), pick a protein (beef, falafel, salmon, etc.), and pick a style (Latin, Asian, Southern, etc.). I first tried a Latin rice and quinoa bowl with braised beef, and it was amazing. The quality of their meat (and all other ingredients, for that matter) was extraordinary for a fast casual place and immediately impressed me. Luckily, that hasn't changed. I was also blown away by the fact that you could order and have your food in well under five minutes. There were a few times I had my food less than a minute after ordering. I felt I had found my perfect post-gym healthy dinner option, and I was elated.

Sadly, Revel Kitchen abruptly wiped the slate clean with their menu about a month ago, and every aspect of their product has suffered as a result. The last two times I've gone, I've witnessed universal confusion over their new menu format (it's not really that complicated, but the old way was far superior), and I'm never sure if what I'm ordering will taste good until I try it. In the time it takes to explain the new menu to one person, I previously would have already had my bag and been back in my car.

Not only is the ordering process far less efficient, but the prep team has seemingly had no training on the new menu. Every visit since the menu change, it has taken at least ten minutes to get my food. That's kinda mediocre by any fast casual standards but especially bad knowing how great it was mere weeks ago. To avoid this, you can always order online, but it's far more tedious than it used to be. 

Sadly, when I got home with my food today, my order was largely wrong. I ordered two items, and both either had things I didn't order on them or were missing their tastiest elements (the sweet potatoes are amazing...too bad I didn't have any). That was the last perfect score on Revel's report card: they had always previously gotten my order right.

In the end, Revel Kitchen is still putting out very high quality food at a decent price. Though they cut all of the specialty ingredients for my previous favorite combo here, there are still other things on the menu that I love. Overall, this is one of those weird instances when a restaurant should have abided by the "if it ain't broke..." mentality, but instead they tinkered and broke themselves very, very badly. I really hope they get it figured out sooner rather than later.

Don't now why this hotel is rated 4 1/2 stars. We booked a suite for 4, the sofa bed in the room was broken, they haden't even bothered to check it let alone prepare it for the night. We finally had to move rooms. It's advertised as a 'green hotel'. Indeed, it's so green that the bathrooms in both suits didn't even have any kind of heating. It was Freezing!!! And in the second suite there was still toothpaste on the wall from the guests before us. Staff was friendly though. But I would not stay there again.

The furniture is great, and I found a few pieces in my budget. I would have given 5 stars, but the financing process that was supposed to take 15 minutes took over an hour and a half. It's my understanding it was because of the financing company. I'm extremely frustrated in that respect. Other than that, the customer service was great.
Can you guys be more careful when making a drink? Last time I had a fly in the cup of Oolong milk tea and i bit on it and this time it's a hair stuck between the lids. It's nasty.

What a great,  friendly,  local restaurant!  Very refreshing to get away from the hub bub of the French quarter and enjoy an authentic New Orleans meal.  Our waitress was very friendly and the owner came out just to chat with us and make sure we were satisfied. I was beyond impressed with the food and the service

If you are looking for a great old style steak house you will not find a better value than Harrah's steak house.  Great place to take a date and order something made table side. Wine list is good too.

Terrible beyond reason. Old seafood, bland, some items were overcooked while others were undercooked. 

My previous, detailed, one-star review was removed.

Our pool interior painter left Jim a phone message about 2 weeks ago, and my husband and I did an internet follow-up inquiry about a week ago. Finally, today, Jim called my husband only to tell him he needs about 2 weeks out to schedule pool tile cleaning. (Well maybe if you get back to customers in a timely fashion...). Additionally, we have heard from two other pool tile cleaning services that our pool being empty was a plus, but Jim said it wasn't...His phone quote was high as well, pool unseen. We gIve him a zero on follow-up, and a "next please" on his over-priced quote.
Jennifer performed some basic maintenance and cleaning on our HVAC system. She was really easy to communicate with, punctual, and reasonable. Thanks for making this such an easy process!

I'm a tough grader on fake Fifties things but the original Nifty's comes close to the real thing. I've known this place for 20 years. Great burgers and fries; quality ingredients just like they say. Their milkshake list seems a little shorter now but still impressive. Service is friendly and the price is right. The Turnersville Nifty's has the same great food and service but seems less like a real 1960 diner. Finally, a good word for Nifty Cola. It's unique, halfway between Coke and Pepsi in sweetness; perfection.

This place is so unorganized and the staff just plain ignorant. You wait forever for your food and then the order comes out wrong. I have a large family and spend a small fortune when we order from them and it is very disappointing that they can not put the right ingredients into the box. In need of new management pronto. Will not be going back.
Great food. Really friendly staff!  We had clams, seafood chowder and parmasean chicken. It was all fantastic!

I just moved to Reno and this is the worse pedicure I have ever experienced since moving her.  Owner(Maya) was by herself.  When I walked in, I asked if they had time for a walk-in. She said yes and to pick my color. I sat on the pedicure chair for less than 2 mins, soaked my foot for less than 1 min and she began working on my foot.  I simply pointed at the problem areas of callus build up on top of my toe and OMG...!!! I guess I asked the wrong question.  With a stern voice, het response was, "you need to relax and let me do my job" and continue to mumble and talk badly about my request.  I was merely POINTING (not touching just pointing at the callus near the top of my toe to explain what I would like done.  She kept mumbling and repeating herself that I need to wait and let her do her job and that I don't need to tell her what to do. WOW!!! So I kindly asked her to stop what she was doing and will pay for the 10 mins I was there. She continued to talk out loud and states, I wasted her time. I actually saved you time lady and paid $20 for the 10 mins I was there. I've had pedicures for 15+ yrs and never been spoken to or treated this way.  Salons usually ask what I would like done and listens to my request:  I hope this is not typical for nail salons in Reno.

Kids love this place.  Good selection of food and they can't get enough of the salad bar.  Burgers are really good, never had a bad steak.     Will try the ribs one of these times.  Kids eat free on Tuesdays after 5pm.
Great ambience and location. Coffee is really good. We got beignets and they are good. However, cafe du mond is the place for the best beignets!

Awesome experience!  My daughter ordered blackened salmon and I ordered a Wedge Salad and by special request added Tritip.   Both plates were beautiful and delicious!   The Mozzarella Sticks (Large order) were SUPER!   LAUREN M. was our server and she was FANTASTIC!   Lauren was well versed in the menu, super professional,  polite, and attentive.  Lauren came by several times to ensure we were taken care of!    Great night!   Thanks, Lauren

If you are in the market for gel polish nails please use Gail. She always does a fabulous job and is very professional. Jennifer does a nice eye brow wax although the price is a bit high. ($18)
There are coupons handed out on occasion in local shopper magazines which make this salon more attractive.

The first time I shopped here, about 3 1/2 years ago, I bought a bunch of produce and clearly confused the crap out of the cashier.  One item was a bulb of garlic and I was asked "What's this a mushroom?" Really!!!???!  And it went on and on.  I absolutely blew his mind.  They have definitely improved since then and have even added a natural foods aisle, okay it's like maybe 1/3 of an aisle but it's a start.  Natural foods tend to be super expensive though since they don't buy large quantities.  In a pinch it's nice to have access to those products close to my house. 

After shopping at a Wegmans last week (GLORIOUS!) It is so unfortunate to me that Thriftway is my grocery store. I do have to give them credit for trying.  They are definitely aware that their clientele has been changing a bit. I'm guessing sales of Morningstar Farm and organic produce have gone way up in the past few years.  I'll continue to shop here because if I realize I have forgotten an item for dinner this is where I'm going.  That being said I try to visit different grocery stores as often as possible. 

My absolute biggest grievance with Thriftway is that you can't take your cart to your car.  Ugh.  Big shopping trips require you to either 

a. bring a friend or loved one
b. leave your goodies behind while you lug what you can to your car 
c. struggle and possibly injure yourself trying to get all your stuff to the car in one shot
-or- 
d. support one of the many helpful pill loving lurkers by letting them aid you to your car for a tip.  

I usually choose to struggle, shop less, and bring my reusable bags that hold a ton of stuff.   Please, please, please let a Wegmans open in the city of brotherly love sometime soon!

One of the girl host was very unprofessional. She took us to an outside table, and out of the two tables that were available she sat us down at the one with no shade. Since we did not want to sit on a hot chair with the sun beaming on our faces while the other guest sit in the shade, we asked her nicely if we could be seated at the one with shade, granted they only needed to wipe that table down since it only had two cups from the previous guests. She ignored us and continued to walk away, keeping us confused and later she rudely said to us to just grab our menus and just pointed at the table we originally wanted to sit down. We thought she would at-least be kind enough to wipe down the table, well she did not. Maybe she was having a bad day but I don't think she should be seatings guests with that kind of attitude. :/

We were in our way to the SB zoo! 

First impression: this coffee shop has an adorable beach house shingle feel with thick white trim, and a colorful door. It's so cute! They did a good job making a small space feel inviting. 

Ordered: cold brew with vanilla, iced latter with brown sugar and almond milk 

Pros: friendly staff, beautiful hanging plants, cute decor, right off the freeway, adorable town, outdoor seating. 

Cons: this is more of a come and go shop, or sit outside place only because of the size. My brown sugar latte wasn't very sweet, but I have a big sweet tooth. Different milk was a 75 cent up charge which is a little steep to me.

I will go back! So cute!

I came here for the pictures ! This place reminded me of cool spots in the art district of Wynwood Miami with graffiti all over the walls.

It was ramen day. Joking... was in that mood for Ramen and this place was close by and looked very appetizing. Initially I almost gave up because it's outside sitting only. I grabbed a menu, walked outside and the weather was actually good. So I ordered.

Shrimp tempura ramen. Was really good. Tasty, well seasoned and not too thick of a broth. The shrimp  was bomb. I truly enjoyed the meal. The water came in one os those sealed cups were they put bubble tea. I thought it was pretty neat.

Fantastic experience last night!  The decor was very unique and the service was fantastic.  The signature drinks were delicious.  The food was spot on as well.  I had the scallops and they were prepared perfectly.  Great to see this addition to Lafayette square!

I have been going to Brow Ritual now for almost a year. I have no complaints. I always get compliments on my brows and eye lashes. It's better to make an appointment but you can walk in. This is by far my favorite place I just wish it was a one stop shop hair... And nails too... I am grateful to Ericca. I love her!!! She always has me on point!!

Specials are pricey but worth it.  Delicious food, great atmosphere and excellent wait staff.  Love that you can bring your own wine.  I had pork loin with asiago cheese and walnuts.  It came with asparagus and roasted potatoes.  All were cooked to perfection.  And don't skip the tartufo for dessert! Wish I lived closer...

What a beautiful, clean and well organized venue.  I have been to a great many stadiums and this is one of my favorites.  The ease of having the septa near by as well as plentiful parking is a joy.  I also liked the idea of all the arenas being organized near one another.  There were a lot of stores to buy your Phillies gear and a lots of stands to buy overpriced stadium grub.  They have a great children play area that is nicely done and clean.  I really enjoyed my visit to this venue.

Excellent cookies - very busy shop but it is always hot inside and in the summer I am concerned about the working conditions for the employees.  When asked I was told the air conditioner was "broken" - but for months now?  Heat stroke is a thing.

Cute/cozy restaurant and good food! We grabbed a relaxing dinner here recently with family and I was pleased overall. 

They have a good variety of entrees (salads, soups, traditional chicken entrees, pizzas, pastas, and mussels) all between $10-20. Service was good and they were quick to provide drink refills.  They did inadvertently give my bf a mashed potatoes side instead of Mac n cheese but did correct the mistake quickly. Mac n cheese was a good portion but sorta average Mac n cheese. 

I got the traditional mussels ($13) which was a decent size portion and two pieces of delicious toasted garlic bread to dip in the broth.  Great mussels! Very tasty and highly recommended. My boyfriend got the chicken pot pie which he liked as well. Others got grilled chicken salads which were hearty portions with a good amount of chicken. We also split a veggie quesadilla for appetizer which wasn't anything special. I think I'd skip an appetizer next round.

All in all, quality meal.

Wednesday Wonderful!
The space at Flyte is so welcoming; very neighborhood restaurant with a dash of big city glamour.  Comfortable and special in all the right ways. The Happy Hour in the Lounge is a great wind-down from your day or rev-up to your evening. We  enjoyed the Potato Fitter and Squash with Goat Cheese Appetizer; delicious!  Thank you Doc for making our first Flyte smooth and relaxing.

Growing up in New Orleans, there was a fenced-in facility on Veterans that had 8 or so trampolines really close to each other with a sprinkler spraying them creating a Tetanus-friendly, slippery, high-risk field-trip spot that was EPIC...at the time. Fast forward 20 years later and Sector 6 is the Extreme Frankenstein version of this spot (in truth, it couldn't be more different except for the fact that they both have trampolines).

I've been wanting to try out Sector 6 for a while now, and when we found out that the Boulder Lounge wasn't climb-friendly till later this week, we still had an urge to do some physical activity without having to deal with the brutal heat we're currently experiencing in the city. We set our Yelp directions to Elmwood, and headed out to Sector 6. 

HUUUUGE facility. We got there around 11:30 on a Saturday and there wasn't any line but a good bit of people already there for birthday parties and good times. We were sent to fill out the electronic waivers, and then paid our $13 dollars for 1 hr of play. I do agree with others that if you want to get your whole hour in, pay in advance. 

There are lockers for $2 and open, free cubbies that I shoved my purse in the back of guarded by my stinky shoes and socks though if you have some serious valuables I'd pay the $2. 

Various sections including the front area of just a ton of trampolines, the dodge ball trampoline section, two basketball rim trampoline area, and then various foam pits in the back with tramps, a trapeze swing, tight rope, and silks. Plenty of seating areas for parents watching their kiddos, and ladies that like to glare at 30-somethings busting a sweat on the trampoline....lady, you know I'm talking about you! 

It was 4 of us, all over the age of 28....definitely the oldest ones partaking in that day. I was sweating profusely within 10 minutes of trying to dunk on the basketball rims and tossing those soft gator balls at kids. The staff is lenient for the most part, but blowing whistles if you run/bounce across the front tramps or basically run anywhere. They could be just a tad more pleasant, but it makes me think of the lifeguards at the pool that are "so over it." I get it, it gets exhausting watching these kids that are literally running EVERYWHERE! There were a ton of tiny ones here, and they have a tendency to burst onto trampolines with others already jumping on them so be on the lookout for these minions. 

I don't know if I could do more than an hour here just because I was losing steam at about 45 minutes. Such a great, fun way to burn energy. Would love to check out Club 6, 15 and over, 9-11 on Friday or Saturday nights. 

Note to people that visit here. Fun as hell, but know your capabilities. Don't try the double bounce or flips unless your past gymnast competitions earned you some medals. Enjoy yourself but don't attempt the impossible or you'll probs hurt yourself, and the only fault it'll be is your own.

This is a great little spot to visit. They have 3 different trails ranging from flat (wheelchair accessible) to relatively intense. I love to bring my dog to play in spring branch creek. I hike limestone hill trail several times each week and find it a great workout that never gets too easy.

There is a great little museum (beautiful architecture) where you can learn about this little gem of a historic site and learn about the history of the area. If you enjoy geology or paleontology you will likely get a kick out of seeing the striations in the rock along the trails and visiting the museum to learn more about the dating and creatures that lived in this area. 

Limestone hill trail has a lot of washout on the trail so if hiking this one, plan for steep inclines, roots and rocks, and uneven surfaces. Nice rock formations and varying views of nature in the middle of suburbia.

Spring branch trail is perfect for those wanting leisurely stroll for all ages it has a pretty wooded center with a winding creek throughout different portions of the trail.

Wildflower Trail is a short trail with stairs and various ups and downs. Good little trail with pretty rock formations and nice wooded views.

Four stars for a great little gem. I stopped in last minute before a show and was able to grab 2 seats at the bar. 

The drinks were glorious, the bartenders were glorious, and I had a salad the size of a small infant.

It did seem to fill up fairly quickly, so I recommend a reservation and empty bellies.
Really enjoyed the prime rib dinner. Can't beat the value (just $14.99) and taste. I'll be back for sure

My husband and I happened upon Honeydeux to get out of the impending storm. We were very pleasantly surprised! I can't comment on the quality of the bubble tea and other desserts, but I can say that the wraps were fantastic! Everything was really fresh and made just the way we ordered it. The staff was super friendly, without being overbearing. The decor is also really nice.....I would have liked to see some more comfy chairs so the older gentleman sitting at the counter could have had his own chair to sit in, and not stare at us until we got up!

Great atmosphere! We came here on recommendation from the hotel concierge and I would go back next time I am in Nashville! I had a delicious homemade veggie burger, fired green tomatoes and my fired had the catfish. The portions were huge and the quality of the food was great, very satisfying home style food. There was also a fabulous band playing.

I first worked with David Bosney. He took the time to allow me to test drive several models and answered every question my two teenage girls and I had with humor and patience. I did keep the other appointments at other dealerships because I had to do my due diligence. 
Of course I returned to Parks Ford of Wesley Chapel. I made an appointment and unfortunately David was unavailable, but he made sure we were still welcomed and taken care of. He left us in the capable hands of Robert Vido. 
Robert was waiting for us at our appointment time. He too allowed us to test drive what we felt we needed to compare and was very patient with us. He even understood how attached we were to our trade in. Robert took my hard and firm budget seriously. He went to bat for me and got me where I needed to be. The entire staff was amazing, but Robert and David truly rise to the top. Thank you Gentlemen! Especially Robert Vido who helped us seal the deal. 
Thank you Parks Ford!!! We LOVE our new Explorer named "Koda".

Me and my sister used to come here and we liked it. The workers were nice and they always did a good job. Recently, we've had nothing but bad experiences. First off, the wait is ridiculous. Appointment or not, 2-3 hour wait is not okay. After about an hour and half me and my sister were done waiting. We wanted acrylics, but there were literally 3 workers just sitting there. These were the workers that could only do gel nails I guess. So my sister and I said it was fine if we did gel on our real nails since the wait was so long and we didn't have a definite time. Why don't the gel people get crossed trained in acrylics if all they do is just sit there? We finally get there and the lady tells me my cuticles are bad (which okay yeah they were), but this lady literally starts stabbing my cuticles. I left with crusted blood on my nail bed. And okay I was disappointed with the paint job too. I'm sorry but if you paint nails everyday, you could at least not try and leave nail polish on the surrounding skin. The guys on the other side that specialize in acrylics have been fine every time we go, there's just such a long wait for them. Eh, I used to like this place but I don't think I'd ever come here again.

I love this place! Came here to study and it was such a quant place to get my work done. Not the biggest fan of their Bloody Mary but my server was accommodating and got a beer instead. I will definitely be back because I am curious about their dinner menu!!

First off, I have to say that our waitress was really nice and very attentive. Maybe it was that it wasn't packed or I just had a good waitress, but there are no complaints there. None. 
As for the rest . . . this place depressed me to no end. The tables have sad vinyl tablecloths like the kind grandmas wipe down with a damp dish cloth and throw away once they tear. Drab-looking curtains that look like they were sewn in home ec. There is nothing "lounge" looking in this place. Everything looks old, used and tired. 
In concept, this is a great idea. I feel it would appeal to anyone from high school kids to retirees. It would be perfect for study groups or for a date where you actually want to hear someone. This place needs a lot of work and help, though. 
The desserts are expensive. Ours were almost $7 a piece and didn't taste amazing. For that price, we could've bought a cake at a bakery or just another refrigerated cake like what we had. 
I wish I would've read Brooke's review, because I ordered the ricotta cheesecake. If you're thinking of doing this . . . don't. You're not missing out. It just had no flavor, nothing special. 
We played Scrabble but quickly found out the tiles were messed up. We had two "J's" and missing some of the other letters. Plus I was really, really wanting to wash my hands or soak them in Purell . . . . or bleach. 
Our coffee was "meh". I could make some just as good at home. That's all I kept thinking, "I could make something better at home".

NEVER eat here. If you have an issue, The General Manager Kristin will charge your corporate card twice! Her management skills were so poor that I did not even believe she was an actual manager. ZERO customer service. After walking 10 blocks to and from this place to  pick up the office order only to have 2 orders missing. We called and was told there was nothing they could to do for us other than make the missing orders and we would have to walk back to get it. This is downtown Tampa, Florida 95 degrees outside, we walk back only to be scolded for not checking the order first before we left. Kristin did not offer any compensation for our troubles but in turn charged our corporate card TWICE!!! I guess she thought she could get away with that, but of course any established corporate office checks their statements for erroneous charges. We have been trying 2 days to get this resolved and gotten nowhere. BE CAUTIOUS IF YOU EAT HERE- IF YOU COMPLAIN; YOU WILL PAY FOR IT- DOUBLE!
I enjoyed their pho and vermicelli! Their pho portions are super large, and they have surprisingly really good boba too!

We went to Brasilia for our son's birthday. We were met by wonderful people who asked our familiarity with Brazilian food. We had a mixture and he was very kind with explaining the menu. The CAIPIRINHA is amazing. Plantains delightful. I am a sucker for both. Then they had specials this evening- lamb, red snapper, salmon stuffed with crab and an app of cheesy bread/ muffin. Omg. It was all delicious. My husband is allergic to fish and they made sure that there was not cross contamination. Chef George and his staff are amazing. Oh wait I forgot dessert- I will just let you got to see that treasure. Please go and enjoy.

I've been taking my Boxer to Banfield South Philly for almost a year now. I'm incredibly pleased with all of the staff I've encountered. Vets get down on the floor with him, instead of lifting my 80lb baby up on a table. No one ever pressures me to buy unnecessary services or tests for him. When I had to drop him off for acute care, the vet called me multiple times with updates and gave me pricing updates as treatment was needed. Transparent, caring, reliable and have the best interest of you and your pet in mind. Love them!
Not that good place to dine in are to drink    kind of a dirty place.it smells   not going back

Love this place.  What a variety!  And free soft serve ice cream?!?!? That I can swirl myself??!  What??!!?!?  Nom nom nom!!!  Best of the menu?  Caprese panini!!! Yum!   Oh don't worry, I'll be back.  And I'm bringing my family!

My experience with DAWG was not a good one. It was the first dog I ever adopted and they didn't do a home check or tell me anything about the dog except he was found as a stray. It was a nightmare, he scratched through two of my window screens and would have fallen to his death out of our upstairs apartment. I had no idea he was this terrified of his new situation but he truly called dawg his home. He ran away one morning and by the grace of god he didn't get killed and I found him miraculously!!! After that he tried biting everyone in my house except me and we ended up feeling so scared of him. I called them and they tried talking me into keeping him. I absolutely refused and took him back, he finally found a fitting home for him I just knew it wasn't meant to be me. One of the hardest things I have ever had to do, but I, not them was looking out for his best interests, go figure!

I'm giving Asian kitchen five stars for a great customer service during a delivery I had tonight. I've believe that I mistakenly ordered the wrong option and by the time it was delivered I realize it was the wrong order. I called them back to let them know the mistake, and they were able to get a hold of the driver went back to the restaurant and brought me back the right order without additional charge. In addition they allowed me to even keep the wrong order option from before even though I offered to give it back. I'm giving them a bravo for excellent customer service and the food was quite tasty as well! I definitely recommend these folks for great delivery service
This place is bomb. Best pho in Philly. Get the summer rolls.

Oh my Goddess. One of the best meals ever. Wood roasted sweet potato pâté, one of the most incredible flavors of my life, and a nice little spot of homemade mustard with it, actually, not enough of that; grilled seitan with black lentils and a horseradish cream- all my meat eating friends would die for this seitan, it's not trying to be meat, it's excelling as seitan; a "soup" of beech mushrooms, gigante beans and a little mound of saffron skordalia- the only thing to make this better would be if it had been cold and wet outside because it had a serious comfort factor going on; roasted ("crispy") cauliflower with kimchee "mayo"; decent Spanish wine AND chocolate pot de creme with coffee salt. F you vegan haters. there were so many complex flavors and textures going on. Those five dishes and 4 glasses of wine cost my friend and I $90. Half of that was the wine. Not bad for the level of experience. The server suggested we order more items at the beginning, but it was totally more than enough food. She was nice, friendly and attentive. I liked the simple decor and vibe of the place too. I wish I could eat here for every special occaision but, alas, I live thousands of miles away. I will pine for that smoked sweet potato!

Whenever I go to this location, no matter if busy or slow, the food takes FOREVER to come to the table. Usually I order just simple things that I can make at home, and I have decided I would rather stay home. I thought to try out to-go because we love the pumpkin pancakes, but have a disabled family member that doesn't like getting out of the house. After being told when the phone was answered that a server needed to take our order, we waited patiently for over 10 minutes. I called early enough to beat the breakfast crowd, but still got put on hold. When asking if I can place and order for pickup, the lady sounded aggravated as if we were a bother. I will just go to the store and buy all the ingredients to make us all breakfast instead of feeling like we're a pain in the butt.

I had my first Metro Diner Plainfield experience last week and I had a lot of fun! The portions are extremely large and "good value." The restaurant was clean and well set up. Loved the free coffee and water in the foyer for people in line to sit down, even though we did not have to wait! The food was greasy but delicious. I ordered a sandwich that was (I kid you not) the size of my head. I was starving and had a tough time finishing half of it! Thankfully it heated up well for dinner. :) Special mention for the hash browns here - browned and crispy on the outside, soft and fluffy on the inside. The service was quick and helpful... someone actually stopped and explained the menu to us, as I think she could tell we were first-timers. We will be back!

Recently went to Stacy Ninan for Juvederm filler and Botox. Could not be happier!  I have had aesthetic work and products prior. In comparison, her technique, gentle touch, and a keen eye for a natural but enhancing appearance were top notch. Highly recommend!
Awesome atmosphere! I've been may times and had ok food. Got the steak tacos today and they were terrible. I have a stomach ache. Go for the drinks

We are visiting from out of town and bought tickets to watch the sea lion show. We bought tickets at 1:45 for the 2pm show. We have never been down here and and mistakenly thought the entrance was at the marine life area downstairs. We thought it was a waiting area and at 1:59pm asked one of the workers there where the entrance to the sea lion show was and she told us it was actually upstairs. We got upstairs at 2 and the man working upstairs told us once the gates are closed they would not let us enter. We had no idea and the guy working there said the woman who sold us the tickets told us this was the policy and to be back before 2. I swear I didn't hear her tell us that but it could have been that there a lot of commotion as it was Remembrance Day and we have a toddler. I insisted we hadn't heard and we were visiting from out of town and couldn't wait till 4pm till the next show as our toddler needed to get back for her second nap. He snapped back that it wasn't their fault we didn't hear and proceeded to systematically ignore us like a complete A hole with no customer service training or basic manners. While waiting about 10 minutes for the manager to come and give us a refund she tried to let us into the show but said by that time the show was about half over and she graciously apologised for this sad excuse of an employee and gave us a refund. Never coming back here and, wow, what a welcome to Edmonton.

I loved golfing here, it is a cute  mini golf course.  My only compliant is the course seemed a bit "short" in that it didn't take very long to putt through the entire course, but the price was right.  This is a great place to take kids when the weather is nice.  Some of the obstacles seemed a bit dated but I would go back here again.

The food was decent. The music was great
 The service was deplorable. Order food when you arrive!

She was probably one of the best experiences we had in New Orleans, so informative about the culture, so passionate about the history and knows how to wow a crowd.  

We liked her so much we took about 3 of her tours.  Looking forward to each and every one as we went. 

The night time tour of the undead is by far the best.

Husband picked up take out tonight.  It was good.  Have to agree it really wasn't New York style pizza but it was good.  My husband is from New York and would love to find New York style pizza but this isn't it.  The reviewer that said the oregano was missing what right.  It would have really added something.  

Could have skipped the black hair in my pizza though.

This place is a hit or miss. I've had great pizza and absolute trash from here. Wings aren't good the sauce is WAY too watery doesn't taste like anything. Also be careful using your card. I was charged twice and the manager said they fixed the problem. Nope still charged twice and won't fix the mistake. Just be careful if you decide to eat here and use a card.

Their atmosphere is dark but inviting. They have one of the top happy hours in the city. From 4-7 some of their top menu items are half price. Some of these items include:  kim Chee fried rice topped with a perfectly fried egg and chicken bao bun is incredible!! At dinner the tasting menu is phenomenal !!don't miss this spot if you are in Philly!!!

Missing food in order. Extremely bad customer service. Two employees actually avoided me when seeing I needed assistance. Very rude when confronted about the mistake as well, and didn't want to fix it. Won't be coming back.
Great establishment! Very welcoming! Very neat and professional. Discounted my full set! Love the quality, hospitality, and work ethicwill definitely be coming. I highly recommend them.

Great little place. All the drinks I have tried (regular coffee, ice coffee, chai tea, matcha frap) are great. Staff is friendly. The monkey theme is cute, and they even have a banana shaped pillow on the couch!

Last year my boyfriend and I did the New Years Eve party at the Crowne Plaza and it was by far one of the best hotel parties that I have ever been to. The package included all you could drink, a hotel room and dinner as well as brunch the next morning.

Our room was beautiful and we slept very comfortably. Dinner was delicious, as they served a lobster tail stuffed with crab meat and a filet. We were stuffed before we ever started drinking! The alcohol was top shelf and there were three different ball rooms where three different bands played.

Overall, it was a wonderful experience.

My one complaint is that the food booth was a little disorganized, possibly because it looked like they got slammed with a lot of orders just as we got there (maybe my complaint is that there were too many people?). Ok, now that I got that out of the way, the concept for the garden is great and well executed, the food was delicious and so was the beer. There is also a good selection of non-alcoholic beverages for anyone who doesn't drink, or just isn't in the mood to.

I ordered the pork sandwich and my wife the veggie sandwich. We both had lemonades and I had a beer. The pork sandwich was flavorfull and not dry, topped with some awesome coleslaw. The veggie sandwich was also very good, thanks to some tasty pesto sauce. Even my wife who doesn't like veggies very much ate it. I'm not a fan of getting things like chips and fries as a side, but the chips that came with the sandwich were finger-licking good (something about the seasoning).

This is not the place for your Toyota to be serviced. 
My situation is very sad and confusing 
I made an appointment to have my car fixed and serviced 
My car had an issue with the RPM, it's always low, car shakes and sometimes turns off by itself 
I went to a few different mechanics, everyone said it's a weird issue and that I would have to take it to Toyota 
The drop off and welcoming of the car is very nice. The shuttle service is delightful and useful. 
Justin, who took care of me, is a very nice guy with a pure soul 
I agreed to pay $160 to inspect my issue and have it serviced 
When I got the car back, it looked like the issue was fixed and serviced well 
The day after, the issue in my car was back. 
I went again, dropped off the car, they tried to fix it again, they were unsuccessful. 
They said the car doesn't have a problem and this is a normal situation 
I asked why they didn't give me a refund if they didn't solve anything? 
My car still has this issue 
I'm so disappointed, angry
This is no way to treat someone who purchased a car with them 8 years ago 
My car and I will never be back 

P.S- this review is not about the sales. But this impacted it in a way that I won't ever buy from them again
Good food !!!! Always fresh ..... Lunch and show with the kitchen staff...... Great menu selection .

My first reaction when I saw the place was not so good. Old school motel vibe. It's def got some miles on it. The old pk lot attendant guy was rude. The bar out back was rockin and they played till late in the night. I was afraid I wouldn't get any sleep at all. The carpet in our room was stained and dirty. By the second day it started growing on me. Great beach right there. The tiki bar was very convenient. Pool was nice. What really made it for me was that somehow we got the best room in the whole place. Room 512 has the best view of the pool and the beach in the whole hotel. If u stay there ask for 512!

First off, this place is CASH ONLY! There's an ATM inside though just in case. I went here three times within a span of four days with different groups of folks because I was in town for a conference. This review is combining all three visits. Please note that at each time there was a line and each time I was delighted. You can't really go wrong and if you're 
just visiting Philly and you're nearby someone will undoubtedly suggest 
to go here.  

The ambience and service: This place is not your traditional Dim Sum place with the carts and various other dishes. If I were them I'd rename it Dumpling Garden. The service is all over the place. Someone will come and get your order but several people will check in on you throughout your dining experience. The thing is though if you place your order with one person it might not be communicated so make sure whoever you're talking to has a tablet cause they will note it on your bill! They are, however, very accommodating for large groups (which is nice when you're here for a big conference).  

The food: I didn't do any of the actual ordering because I went with friends who have eaten before. Below are the ones I remember.

- The crabmeat and pork dumplings (with the yellow tip) are delicious! Note, most people confuse this with shrimp. They also have delicious shrimp dumplings but it is not the soupy ones. 
- Spicy pork soup dumplings are also very delicious! For all the soup dumplings, beware of the hot steam/soup that comes after the first bite!
- Shanghai Shao Mai are interesting. It's "dumplings" filled with sticky rice. I personally was not a fan but some of my friends really liked it!
- Dry fried string beans: not as savory as Din Tai Fung's but still fresh and crispy and delicious

All in all, I would definitely recommend!

We got an entertainment book and thought we would start some place new. Our first clue should have been no cars in parking lot and only one person came in while we were there. 

The Gyro meat was thick, dry and not very tasty.  My son took two bites of a a turkey Blt and said his stomach hurt.  My husband had meatball sub and they were pre made meatballs and bread did not taste good.  The place looked old and run down.  I would not recommend it to anyone

Great pizza and place love the new updates!! They were actually doing something called "Car Pizza" which was to raise money for Puerto Rico after hurricane Maria. Gave me more of a reason to give a good review

We met friends at Mona Lisa while visiting NOLA from California. The owner is absolutely hilarious and lovable. The wine kept flowing while we conversated and devoured some good eats!

What is not to love? Great food, wine and a quirky styling of Mona Lisa plastered across the walls! Do yourself a favor when you visit NOLA stay off Bourbon street and go where the locals go!
