It's been awhile since we dined at Little Mexico. The ladies were very attentive and breakfast was really good. 

(On a side note, It was very dark inside and I feel the restroom needed some major TLC)
Has always been one of my favorite spots in the entire Nashville area! Great ownership, great location, and great food!

Great pizza, decent service. I got pretty excited about the swamp thing pizza but they were pretty stingy with the gator sausage. The carnivore was great though! Piled high with toppings! 

Not crowded. Pretty far from bourbon street.

The Muny is awesome! It's a huge outdoor amphitheater in forest park that puts on great shows! I've only seen one show here but the cast was super talented! 
What's the best part? There's FREE seats! It's not very often that you can see a show of such quality for FREE! They aren't even on a grass hill or anything--the whole back section of chairs is up for grabs :) 
I wish they had these kind of places everywhere so I could go more often!
This company is great. They have eco-friendly options, very competent technicians, and they create a work to own option for their employees who perform at high levels. They are also locally owned.

Bacchanal might be my favorite place to go to when I visit New Orleans.  At first, you walk into what appears to be a wine store.  You pick a bottle of wine, get some cheese out of the fridge, check out and tell them you want your cheese plated - and trust me, you WANT YOUR CHEESE PLATED.  Take your wine through the back door and enter the courtyard and prepare to be amazed.   The courtyard is beautiful with lots of seating, a small stage for live music, another bar and a window where you can order more food.    If you're visiting New Orleans, I highly recommend setting aside some time to check out Bacchanal !

I've been coming to this McDonalds for years.  I was so happy when they started accepting Apple Pay.  I had always used it here.  I came today and they don't accept it here any more.  They need to bring back APPLE PAY or I'll have to go to another FF restaurant.

The donuts are little works of art...looks like you made donuts with your kids. Very heavy on icing but good tasting donut if you scape a bit of that sugary drizzle. Coffee is low on the list here but worth trying their donuts which run about $2 or more a piece

This was my second time placing an online order for pick up.  My first being decent so I decided to add a tip on top of the convenience fee they charge.  I get there and pick up my order and walk back to my office only to find out when I got back that it was wrong.  I said no cheese/oil and all the veggies... it had no veggies on it with cheese and oil.  I print out my confirmation and walk all the way back. When I get there they laughed at how wrong the order was and remade it... all the while I'm waiting for someone to really apologize and offer me a refund for having to wait 20 minutes for a new sandwich.  Finally after my sandwich is complete (AND wrong again) it had carrots on it... that isn't even an option for toppings when you order online... and looking really pissed the guy offers me a free dessert... when I declined he said he would pay for it... It was already charged to my card!! I wasn't about to wait around for them to cancel my online order - when I didn't even have my wallet with me - and then give it to me.  What a mess.  I doubt I will go back.

The M room is a great spot for a beer, some food and a live band! Haven't frequented this place too often but everytime I have it left me with a story to tell... Meeting Ron Jeremy there for one, got him to give me one of his own branded rolling papers and autograph it for me ;) can't of course you'll have an experience like mine but I do suggest giving the place a shot along with getting a shot from this place!

Well this isnt the first time I've been to this place and probably not my last.  I do frequent here alot of family birthdays and what nots.  This place probably is more known for the Bubble teas and smoothies.  Both which are very good, but the consistency has gone down for the fact they seem to hire different people to make them.  The last few times I've had it, which was yesterday, it was very watered down.  I had the peach w/conjack jelly and green tea.  The smoothies were up to par though.

As for the food here.  Its the typical chinese food, but not americanized.  Yes they have the General Tsao Chicken and chicken w/broccoli, but they also have frog legs!!!!  Actually its the whole frog and not just the legs.  Its batter and fried with garlic!  Yes it taste like chicken too! LOL!  The menu is self explanitory its in english.  So if you cant read chinese, dont worry they wont give you the chinese only menu lol!

The service is pleasant.  Also depends on who you get as the waiter/waitress.  Never really had a problem with any of them, but there is 1 with an attitude. 

They are open late till 3 am and also have karaoke rooms to reserve.  I believe they have 4 rooms.  Request the first one on the right, its got the best machine and system. Also the songs are current too!

Happy Eatings!!

What an excellent day of fishing for any level of experience. Workers were friendly and helpful.  My son caught a ton of fish which was a dream for him. Extra bait not needed unless you are really trying to catch a rare fish. Don't miss out...choose Hubbard's!!!!

The Clever Rabbit is yet another character business opening on 124 Street.  There is now no chance that you would recognize where you were, if you stood on this street two years ago. Believe me...that's a good thing.

The restaurant fits right in with the posh, French Duchess and home-y, Italian Tiramisu with its own pair of adjectives: funky and Vegetarian.  There are a handfull of tables for people to eat in, and a selection of baked goods at their front counter.  I forgot to ask if they were vegan or not, but they looked amazing.  Operated by a young staff, a few of them do double-duty with the gourmet pet food bakery, Food Dish Wishes, next door.  As an aside, FDW is a treat to walk by, often being full of playful puppies and glaring cats. The owners also do animal-rescue work in third-world countries...ask about it if you get a chance.

TCR is new and clean with a great-looking menu and exceptionally friendly staff.  They don't pull any vegetarian punches with their dishes, if something is textured vegetable protein, they call it textured vegetable protein (or TVP in the case of the tacos).

The TVP Tacos happened to be what I ordered along with their split pea soup of the day.  The split-pea soup was fantastic: thick and rich and still piping hot, even after walking it back to my office.  Carrot flecks kept it from looking like baby food, and its consistancy leaned towards a "cream of..." instead of mashed peas.

The soft-shelled tacos had perfectly seasoned TVP...just enough heat to make them interesting, but not enough to turn off people that don't like hot spices.  The avocados were fresh (I can't count how often I've had brown avocados on takeout food), salad crispy, and shredded cheddar delicious.  They even asked if I wanted vegan sour cream instead of the regular stuff.  I will say that the presentation left something to be desired. I fully admit that tacos are difficult to present at the best of times, especially in a take out box.  But I hope they accept the challenge, and come up with a better way, as I could see people being turned off by paying that price for a couple tacos dropped in a box. Either way, I got past it, and I'm glad I did...they were delicious.

This restaurant has a lot of potential, and I'm very excited to see where it goes.

Tried the crab bolognese fettuccine and it wasn't bad. Nothing amazing. My friend's burger looked better and my girlfriend's fried chicken sandwich definitely was. I think I ate more of that than my own meal. The waiter was super friendly and helpful, suggesting cocktails for my girlfriend to try. She liked everyone he recommended. The sidewalk patio was nice and I'd recommend sitting outside when the weather permits.

I was quite tepid about ordering from a florist I was unfamiliar with...but chose Serendipity due to Yelp reviews.....
WOW! GORGEOUS! What a beautiful arrangement that was sent to our daughter-in-law on the birth of my granddaughter! I will never use another florist in Reno. Amazing bouquet! So beautiful and sensual! 
Thank you Barbara and everyone there who made everything PERFECT! Thank you Serendipity!
PS - just heard from my D-I-L - and she said this is "the most beautiful bouquet she has ever received" 
Thank you Serendipity!

Literally the BEST pizza! Very thin crust with an amazing amazing variety of yummy and unique topping combinations. We haven't had anything less than amazing - it is thin crust though so if you cgi hungry make sure to order several pies to fill you up :)

This was my first experience with any of the Mikado's because I have recently moved here from Texas. It was my birthday on the 19th so we went on the 20th with my BF, his mom and 3 kids to celebrate. We went early (6:30 on a Sat. night) to beat the crowd since we had children with us. First they had no cherry juice to make "Shirley Temples" for the kids. (I know, so what...) Then, when the food came out, guess who's meal was never even turned in.... You got it, mine. 

I had ordered the steak (med/rare) and scallops. When the waiter realized he didn't place my order with the others he ran to the back and came back out with a steak (well done) and shrimp... I asked him to please bring me my original order and that I would wait for it. It took another 20 minutes and when I got my food everyone else was done and kids were getting rowdy. 

We asked for the check when they brought my dinner and still had to go up to the bar to ask for it again because the waiter never came back with it. Then, not one thing was removed or even discounted on our check. $175 (No alcohol ) and easily the worst meal I've ever had in all of the Northeast. Will never return.
Perfect. Everything was perfect. Salmon and filet were spectacular. Finished things off with the chocolate coca cola cake. Great service by our waiter, Chase. Perfect evening

This used to be one of our favorite casual places when in town. However, the delivery experience lacked this time. Forgot pepper rings for the pizza the first time, and delivery guy was a bit mean second time (plus spaghetti was crushed and they forgot to put potato salad on the side for the Greek salad). We asked if they could sell us some ice from the restaurant or have the delivery guy pick a bag up. No go to either.

I realize its not the normal request, and by no means required. However, would have been impressive to go above and beyond.

Monday Night Football, great place to watch games. Many large, HD flat screens line the walls. Large U shaped bar, seats about 20+ people. Lots of booths and high top tables. Had the Rib/Chicken Tender combo at recommendation from sever. Ribs we're wet and SUPER tender, fell off the bone. Chicken was in a light batter, almost tempura like, very good. Other items on menu look great, homemade pizzas, burgers to name a few.  
Location was great, right in midtown and close to campus. 
My server Holly was great, though busy. Bartenders are busy with their customers and bar drinks, but overall a wonderful experience.

So I remember eating here a long long time ago... but came today since I was in the area. 

Parking is iffy. I was lucky to find a spot a block away but you have to be careful of the signs.

So there was a line around the place for cheesesteaks. I found out that that line is for cheesesteaks only. There is a different window/counter for fries and drinks. Thank god I didn't wait long on that one. I just have waited 20-25mins for the cheesesteak.

It's an average cheesesteak. I opted for the original cheesesteak with provolone melted cheese and onions. They also have wiz and American cheese to choose. It costed me 10 bucks. And oh yeah- its cash only. 

Next time I'll try Pats across the street since I hear there is a street rival between the two.

Placed an order for two Haltech Fusebox Relays on May 27, 2019. On June 3, 2019 I received two Ford fuel filters that were supposed to go to another customer. I notified TRUMotorsports and they sent me a shipping label to attach to the package so I could ship the filters to the customer who actually ordered them. My mail person comes mid day so I'm never home to hand her a package so I had to go out of my way to drop it off at the post office, no big deal. June 12, 2019 I received a second package that had 4 sets of Haltech 4 pin Tyco plugs. I immediately notified TRUMotorsports that they sent me the wrong package again and requested a refund so I could order direct from Haltech and stop wasting my time. June 14, 2019 I get a reply email with a return label and my question about a refund was ignored so I replied again asking for my refund. The only response I got was a question as to whether or not I received the shipping label and had sent the wrong products back to them yet. TRUMotorsports messed up the order, not me. I never received what I paid for. My money should not be held hostage while I go out of my way a second time to send back a product I did not order. Pay for your own mistakes, don't make your FORMER customer pay for them.

finally closed what a dump !
bad food and owner with a really bad attitude

After my 4th or 5th lunch visit I continue to be underwhelmed by this place.    Went to lunch there with co-workers this most recent trip which mirrored my previous visits, where I left wondering what all the fuss is about.  Today's visit was no different.  Coworker ordered a glass of wine which arrived in a very dirty glass that included small chunks of food stuck on it.  Gross and sent back.  After the table ordered we waited a solid and verified hour for food to arrive which was cold.  My Sriracha Patty Melt was also missing the Sriracha.       

Also, the AC vent right as you walk into the men's room upstairs is disgusting and at face level as you enter the restroom.  Covered in black dust.   Gross.    How about some attention to detail?
Delicious food!! Great selection (small and large plates, good prices!) Wonderful staffing and atmosphere (both indoor and outdoor seating) Will definitely be back!

Gave Chihuahuas another chance and they did a great job!  Had the tacos, we were a party of nine and they kept the chips and salsa filled they kept our drinks filled and the food was amazing!  Total change from the first time!

At first thought it could be a flewluke  and my wife and I tried it again and the food was amazing again!

We have enjoyed our dinning experiences!
Amazing atmosphere and food. The service is great. Flat bread is the best in the Bay Area. Highly recommended for small intimate groups are large parties. I will definitely go back
The beds are horrible..i get a room just to relax, but thats not happening here. They are loft bed that have terrible mattresses, so u feel like your sleeping on a board..never again

The food is okay but the fact that they charge $4 dollars for a taco at the size that they serve is absurd. Being Mexican it's almost insulting, that alone ruined this restaurant for me. May be my last time eating at this place.

If your taste buds can't tell the difference between freshly chopped garlic or the pre-chopped, out of a jar, rancid variety that is used here then by all means go.
Whatever you do, DO NOT ORDER the fried long hots! I don't understand how anyone can take something so simple and utterly fantastic and turn it into a petrified oil laden piece of rancid laced #%&@!
Fried in good olive oil with a pinch of salt to enhance the natural flavor, that's it!
Whoever invented the "coated French fry" should be drawn and quartered, here again, where simplicity is abandoned for what? Turning something that's naturally awesome into something that it shouldn't be.
If not for the wait staff, (my wife and I had a wonder girl who was attentive and very polite), I would have asked for the owner and suggested that he/she eat the bill.
Giving this place a single star was a gift, I can only imagine what that their "Italian" specialties are like, YUK!

They're the only cab company I use in New Orleans. They are the only cab company that has their phone number on my phone.They have a flat rate from the airport- $33. I don't give a crap if they don't speak English.   They take me where I need to go. Their prices are consistent. Several times, they would ask me which way I would like to go to my destination- in other words, they asked me what route was best for me! In college, I used to call them ahead to take me to the airport at 445 am. Not once was I ever stood up. Another time, I need to go back home, but didn't have enough cash on me. The driver still accepted. I sat in the front with him, and he just chatted about his daughter who was also in college. This was also well past midnight.

I've never used a credit card on a cab. Cash is king. You'll be scammed less (with any cab company). Just take money out, mm kay?

My son, husband and I go to Jack's almost every weekend. They have a delicious breakfast and lunch menu. I love their fresh brewed iced tea- the best anywhere! The food and service are consistently good. It does get very crowded on the weekends, so expect to wait. 

My favorite dishes are the build your own omelette, the chicken croissant sandwich, the pasta lunches, the burger, and the best of all, the chorizo burrito.

So me and my girlfriend have order from here through waiter several times and also enjoy eating at the restaurant and it's always great food. But today we placed and order around 12:16 and they never accepted the order and when I called around 1:00 a man answered and was a little rude and told me they were not delivering food at this time that they don't start until 5:30. Even though their delivery hours end at 2:30. But when I tried to get more information the man hung up on me.

10 large pretzels for $7
Small rivets box (nibblers) for $4

You can't beat the price, flavor and softness anywhere else. I visit the Philly Pretzel Factory every time I'm in PA. I've never had a bad batch, sometimes a bit too salty, but nothing that I can't rub off. Their spicy brown mustard and cheese dip are the way to go for dipping sauces. 

The next day, if you even have leftovers, you can reheat them in the microwave for 15-20 seconds to bring back the softness. 

I LOVE LOVE LOVE these soft pretzels.

Been searching for a great sushi place here in Reno and Hinoki so far has been our favorite by far!! My husband and I ordered the Hinoki, Samurai, Playboy, Casanova, and Yoyo rolls and we honestly loved all of them!! The service was incredibly prompt and we received the rolls much sooner than most sushi restaurants. We will most definitely be returning!
Nice selection of cigars and coffee is great! Excellent service and great atmosphere!

The bar/restaurant was beautiful. I love the atmosphere of this place. The staff was very friendly.. I ordered a BBQ Bacon hamburger. My waitress recommended this burger to me that this was her fav. When the burger came out, OMG, it was huge and piled high with Onion strings. It was delicious. For an extra dollar, I got a side of tator tots. I havent had tator tots since I was a little kid. My partner originally ordered a pulled pork sandwich, unfortunately, she came back and apologize that they were out of pulled pork. So he ended up getting a Classic Cheeseburger with French Fries. The meal was to die for.. Definately be going back.. 

Hey guys, be sure to check out the bathroom. It was quite a show. Love it..

Just left after having lunch, food was marginal but expensive. Wait staff poorly trained, service was slow. When I got my bill, it was someone else's, but was less than mine. Tried to get it corrected, took over 18 minutes and I'm still not sure if they cancelled one transaction and put a second in. I asked for the paper transaction showing the credit and the debit and was told, I would have to wait see it on my credit card statement. So at this point I'm not sure if I paid for two lunches or one. Will not be going back and recommend you think twice before considering this establishment.

China King is my go-to for Chinese take out. I have lived in Florissant for about 2 years. It was hard to find a decent Chinese take out near me. My husband and I tried three places at different times. We tried to give each place a second and third chance to impress us. It didn't work. When China King opened we thought we would give them a whirl. We have not been disappointed.The food is good, the staff has been nice and it place is clean. Hope that doesn't change.

After nearly 5 months living in Sundance I have watched the apartments deteriorate at a rapid rate  and now cannot wait to move out. The standard answer is "That's a corporate decision; we cannot do anything about that". So you get the standard answer for nearly everything! Trash dumpster are overflowing by weekend and if you thought you might want to invite friends or family over well you shouldn't....completely ghetto! The breezeway is always littered with yard debris and has never been cleaned; except by me. The grass gets cut and thrown all over your patio and that's what you come home to. No they cannot aim the discharge toward the yard...requires someone to actually think about that and well, we just can't ask them to do that. 
The cable is very expensive and with the change in dish you cannot get the channels offered at the time you signed your lease ; however canceling is not an option....you guessed it....its a corporate thing...... If you want to take a walk around the grounds keep a few things in mind. Sidewalks are few and do not connect like you would anticipate. So you can walk thru the grass and avoid the copious amounts of dog poop (looks to me like the dog stations for bags and disposal are always full of poop for extended periods of time and complimentary bags are always empty.) or you can walk in the parking lot and dodge speeding cars. They don't remove dead bushes but they trim them once a year......must be a corporate thing too. They cut down trees but never replace them and the grounds are typically littered with cigarette butts and trash. The pool, not bad for the most part if you don't mind trying to have a quiet day at the pool and the guy shows up with his cooler of beer and blares country music next to  you. The Hot tub....doesn't really exist....Has never been filled or in use  at any time....always "under repairs". The maintenance crew (Whom I refer to as Huey, Duey and Louie) well, keep your expectations low. They spend a lot of time on the golf carts but you never see them really doing anything. Finally, I moved my parents into an apartment on the  North side. Apartment a bath smaller than mine; they pay the same rent but he décor is beautiful, the grounds immaculate! They have a dog park and I have never seen dog poop on the grass. The waste stations are frequent and stocked. Counter tops are granite and the appliances are newer than the early 80's. The carpet is not builder grade and the breeze ways are cleaned every other week. The pool and hot tub are beautiful and this space includes an outdoor kitchen. And yes, I have not seen anyone wearing a house arrest ankle bracelet that my neighbors adorn.

I'm writing review before i got my food.  I love Texas Roadhouse, but this one stands out from the rest.  As a matter fact stands from any restaurant . Very unprofessional place. Workers argue with each other constantly. I was shocked one one worker yell at the other "do your job", after that the chaos broke out between them. I didn't come here to listen to this. The manger needs to get a handle on their workers.

Really solid brunch. We did a small 3 person happy-hour-brunch here and it was great. There's so much nice outside space. The wait staff was super great, and nice. 

We had waffles, chicken and waffles, the crabby dick, and a few cocktails. I can tell you that the crabby dick is great and so is the Passion fruit elderflower cocktail. 

When it's a nice day out definitely come here. I felt like it was a bit pricey but nothing to deter you from enjoying everything.

I'm a huge fan of BBQ restaurants, and Edley's is one of my top 10 favorites (in Nashville and beyond). The food is very good, service is always great, and they have a pretty good craft beer selection. 

My go to is the pulled pork, but everything I have tried has been good. On our last visit, my girlfriend had the brisket and I tried it. Excellent smoke flavor and very tender. I'll be getting that again! My daughter has tried their hot chicken and tells me it is very good too, although I personally have not had it. Every side I've tried has been great. I love the mac & cheese. Their fried pickles are amazing!!

If you like BBQ and a good variety of options, I highly recommend Edley's. I'll point out that they are in the trendy 12 South neighborhood and can be quite crowded. Heading in at off-hours is a good option if you don't want to stand in long lines. But to me it's worth the wait!

Pretty good.  Had the gold wings and tarter tots for afternoon snack.  Wings were very flavorable.  Tots are what you would expect

Staff was very friendly and helpful. 

Dining area pretty vacant.  Reminded me of a warehouse, hot, and flies.
They do have delivery.  Have used that before. That's what you should use so can enjoy good food in comfort without needing a shower to wash off sweat.

Ok, love the Parlour Bar and the aesthetic of this place BUT feel the rooms are over priced for what they are. Bare essentials only. Skimpy on amenities; two towels, one bath mat and no extra offerings like robes or slippers (or in our case a shower). The bathtub was lovely though. For the price, we expected a few more thoughtful touches.

Crystal did such an excellent job on my hair ! I was very unhappy with my previous experience at another salon in Santa Barbara, but she was able to get my hair looking even better than I had expected. Will definitely be returning in the future !

This past Saturday I saw someone set up at Barto Pools in Tex's usual spot.  Immediately I knew something was amiss.

I called Barto and received the devastating news.  Tex has moved.  To Alaska.
To confirm I tried to call Tex on his cell.  "The person you are trying to reach is not accepting calls at this time".

I could smell Tex's delicious smoke from my house when he was in town and esp loved his sauce not to mention his "take a beer, leave a beer" policy.

I'm sad.  Hold me.

My mom had hip surgery here in 2012.  It took several hours to get through emergency and to get admitted.  The doctor and x-ray technician misread the x-ray and sent her to be operated on the wrong leg!  We told the doctor he was wrong - she fell on the right side, all the pain was on the right side and there was nothing wrong on the left side, but he was the doctor and he knew what was right.  DO NOT let doctors intimidate you or ignore you.  It was because we had the nurses write on the left leg (do not operate) and that the operating surgeon saw this and cancelled the operation.  The same initial doctor came and said that there would be no operation without our consent, and he was dismissive and uncaring.  After arguing with him for 15 - 20 minutes he agreed to send my mother back for another x-ray and MRI.  My mother suffers from anxiety attacks, so having the possibility of an unnecessary surgery was incredibly stressful.  He came back the next day, said we were right and walked out.  An incredibly unprofessional and unhelpful person.  We were glad that he was not operating.
     The nurses and the physio-therapists on the other hand were amazing.  They listened, showed concern and were helpful in calming my mom and treating her like a human being.  Be willing to challenge doctors and advocate for a patient - we truly feel that it was the only thing that saved my mother from a horrible, unnecessary surgery.

Boucherie is probably my favorite restaurant in NOLA. It's very quaint and the food is excellent. The food isn't too salty, which is rare for a NOLA restaurant. I've had a good amount of things on the menu and think that the brisket is a must-try. I recently had the ribs with watermelon salad, and those were great, too. The small plates are relatively small and will probably serve 1-2 people. The large plates are decently-sized and a good size for an entree for a single person. Prices are reasonable and comparable. Service has always been excellent here, and I appreciate that they bring out an amuse bouche, even during lunch. It's a fun way to try something new and different. The krispy kreme bread pudding is worth a try but I actually think the bread pudding that I've had at Nordstrom Cafe is better. I do realize that I've discounted the validity of my review with that last statement. 

Parking isn't much of an issue as there is ample street parking in the surrounding area. My biggest complaint with Boucherie is that the ventilation is terrible, so you will come out reeking of fried food. Worth it, though!
Excellent choice for lunch or dinner. Everything looks so delicious and you know it is one of the best in town if the establishment is always busy.

Great atmosphere, great food.  Portions are much too big; we were stuffed and still brought home doggie bags.  The sardines appetizer was the best appetizer I've ever had ... of any kind.  I've always felt Greek desserts are not fantastic, so their so-so dessert menu isn't really the restaurant's fault; we really didn't have room for dessert anyway.  Overall, a little expensive but worth it!

I recently had a pair of Vince Camuto heels repaired by Bob and recommend him to everyone in the Saint Louis region! Not only is he well skilled and knowledgable in his craft, but he is passionate about his work and takes great pride in his service. Thanks Bob!
Rudest bunch of employees. Their shelves are always bare. Check out lines are always extremely long. Customer service is horrible.

I love this gem in old Metairie. It is an old Italian grocery shop right next to the train tracks. There is plenty of spaces to park outside. I have been here quite a few times. They have italian wines here that only they sell. They have specific cheeses like the festival cheese and the balsamic and onion cheese - OMG - get the balsamic and onion cheese now! The best! I love their muffalatta, it is an equal meat to olive salad ratio and is served HOT, which is how I prefer it. They also sell halfs and quarters and mini muffs. They have cannoli filling in the freezers and cannoli shells, they also make cannolis fresh there and recently added gelato as well. They sell all types of pastas too. They even have olive oils you can sample that they make in house. Great little Italian Grocery.

I came here a few years ago and they must have had different owners/managers, because service and interaction with the community is so much better now. They have wine tastings and pasta tastings and cheese tastings just about every other month. Today I went for their pasta tasting and I really like the man that owns it now, I always forget his name, but he is the reason I fell more in love with this place. The pasta was made in a giant 70lb cheese wheel. He threw in some extras like  meat and olive oils and voila, you have a great pasta dish. I came there once when they were selling pasta plates and got here right before they were pretty much closed and that same gentleman said it was not a problem and he sold me a couple pasta plates, I gave him a huge tip because I did not even realize it was after they were closed and I hate to inconvenience anyone.

This place could be a model for other places struggling with customer service. Every visit here is special.

If you don't feel like spending $50 for all you can eat meat, this is the much cheaper yet slightly ghettoer version.  This isn't a chain like fogo de chao so they certainly don't have the breadth of selection that you can get there, but you can still get your meat on for a very reasonable price.  You have to walk up and get your meat though during the week and during lunch, as there are no pantalooned gauchos walking around yielding their meat sticks.  For dinner on weekends, they do come around to cut the meat fresh in front of you.  But alas, no fancy pants, just a boring uniform.  There is also the buffet salad bar, but again, the selection is limited, but still full of brazilian favorites like feijoada, which is one of my favorite foods in this entire universe.  Go for lunch, it's a great deal.
Oh yeah! This place was poppin! Had the crawfish quartet....it was so delicious! Hands down a must do again the next time I'm in Nolan's!!!!

Rita's has an amazing array of sweets to make everyone happy! I love how the menu changes daily. The owners are extremely involved in the community and well respected. All the treat team members have incredible customer service, especially Logan and Landen. We love Rita's!

Went to Ginza for the first time Tuesday night...Started with the fried oyster appetizer...It was coated in a light and flaky panko crust...Delicious!!!  Definitely a shareable dish...I had a chicken Kastu dish and it was amazing...Hubby had a poke bowl and all the 
fish was fresh and delicious...The portions were very generous and everything was seasoned to perfection...There were 4 others in our dining group and every one raved about their choices...All 6 of us were extremely satisfied and will be returning soon!!!  So glad Ginza is a new dining choice in Pennsport...
Good food. I ordered the portobello and goat cheese flat bread and it was delicious. However a little bit small for the price. Still I would come back and taste more of their options.
Meal was fantastic ... such fresh and expertly prepared food, excellent staff and great waterway view!!!

I just moved here and this is my closest store. I shopped and included sale items. I explained that I don't have a card because I just moved here. I was told that they don't give out rewards cards anymore and I need to register online and charged me full price on everything. And, when I got home I noticed an expired date on my packaged salad. I really don't think they want my business anyways so I am out.

Decor: small, family-owned and comfortable. On the left are hookah things to buy; the right are refrigerated items you can just grab and go and in the center are some tables and chairs and of course, the counter you order at!

Service: I have always had great service- prompt and courteous with big smiles. Love! Always puts me in a good mood 

Food: Puts me in a better mood! They make it right in front of you so you can go ahead and watch. I've had their chicken schwarma, which is a decent size and pretty healthy (i think, lol) and I've had their home made baba ganoush (which is always gone within 2 days of bringing it home, lol)

Overall: quick and yummy! This place is easy to look over and dismiss, but I want people to come and eat here more, it's yummy!!

Cute wine bar in SB.  Great tasting wine from select vinyards.  Corks n' Crowns only tries to select wines that have limited cases made.  This makes for it's uniqueness.  I had a glass of the honeycut that was fabulous.

This place is as hipster as hipster gets but I love it! I was in town for the weekend and desperately needed a non-Starbucks cup of coffee. The shop was in this cute little neighborhood and also full of people! The service was friendly and there was a really neat outdoor area with a square stone table to sit and relax.
See pictures of the birds that visit my feeders (handmade by the Wild Bird Store)

I've been to Parasol's a few times over the years.  Only to the restaurant though, never to the bar.  

The restaurant part is very small with only five or six tables.  You have to order at the kitchen window and they bring your order out.  No table service.  

Each time I stick with the classic po-boys (shrimp and oyster), no soft-shell crab unfortunately.  You can't go wrong with the shrimp and oyster po-boys.  I had a bite of my Dad's roast beef po-boy but didn't really like that.  The beef just was not tasty, seemed that it had been in the fridge for a while.  And served with very pre-made gravy.

They don't have beer on the restaurant menu but don't know if you can bring in a beer from the bar.

Careful about going around St Patricks day b/c it gets really crowded.

All in all a NOLA institution.

This a great meeting and studying location, but not the best spot for coffee. They have a wide selection of drinks available including coffee, teas, flavored coffee drinks, and smoothies. They also serve food like desserts and pastries, meal bars, and bagel sandwiches. For their wide selection and the convenience of being able to find something for everyone, it's a good spot. However, the flavored coffees lack a lot of flavor. The peanut butter mocha just tastes like a coffee and isn't sweet at all. And same for the regular mocha, just tastes like no flavor is added. I've stopped in a few times and was consistently let down by the flavored coffees. For the regular drip coffee and lattes it's average. 
Another great thing about this place is the atmosphere. There are a lot of group tables that seem to be made for studying. There are couches and comfy chairs for reading and even outdoor seating. The location is right in the heart of midtown which is also very convenient. If you're looking for a casual hangout place or stop for food and drinks, it's a good choice. But for the coffee snobs or mocha lovers, not the best choice.

Can i just say... the best place to hang out! The bartenders were awesome. I think you group were known to have finished the bottle of wild turkey. Ugh, how can I forget the hand grenades? They were sooooo good!!! I can't wait to come back. Definitely recommend it.

Previously known as I.O Metro, Erdos at Home, is a home furnishings and accessories store that caters to the high-end modern rustic appeal. I became familiar with John Erdos while in Singapore. The namesake has been in the home furnishings business in Singapore for over 20 years. Before modern rustic was a thing in the states, people were having items shipped and some of his pieces landed in well-known architecture type magazines.

All of the furniture is very large scale and has aged woods and leather's. Nothing here seems fragile and it is apparent that the materials used are of great quality. It appears that when the store turned over that they also obtained a whole new staff. The young lady that was manning the door didn't seem very knowledgeable and didn't seem to exude the thrill I would expect from a new store opening with new offerings.

The only thing that concerns me is that in this day and age, especially in the St. Louis furnishings market you can't really afford to be just one thing and Erdos is overwhelmingly rustic. I cannot speak for anyone else's taste but for what I value aesthetically, I could only see myself grabbing a piece or two here and not trying to transform several spaces. This store will surely be 100% up someone's alley. For now I can give the pieces a four and the service of three.

Pork Tenderloin 

Locally owned and operated, a real community restaurant.

Yes it feels a bit old fashioned and it seems busiest around the time of day my grandma prefers to eat but dont let that deter you from this local gem.

They do a lot of things well foremost among these dishes are the Pork Tenderloin sandwhich (my favorite in Indiana) the fried biscuits with apple butter, and the velvet chicken soup (someone snuck curry powder in there.) 

There service staff feels a bit inexperienced but always more than make up for it with their wonderful attitudes

The prices are more than reasonable but beware, they aren't open on weekends.
This is some of the BEST breakfast I've had while visiting in Philly. The Jewish Apple Pancakes were absolutely AMAZING I would eat breakfast here everyday if I could!

Love this place. The staff is super friendly and the ambiance is perfect for working or hanging out. Their coffee is so good and I love to support local. The toasts are really good, and their chocolate chip cookie is one of the best-so good!!

Food Is great and reasonably priced. We had the tatonka wings, Buffalo chx pizza and popeye salad. All dishes were fresh and exceeded our expectations! As a suggestion to the owners, no one wants to get up during their meal and go wait in line for another drink and then wait in another line to obtain the drink. Please consider having some drink servers floating around. You place your order at a counter then sit and wait till your name is called. I went up twice thinking my order was ready but I guess "Vinny your order is ready" sounds too close to "Denny your order is ready" and then "Lenny your order is ready". Maybe consider a numbering system or a screen of some sort letting people know when their order is ready. It's already a pretty loud atmosphere and to put someone on a PA system calling out names only adds to the noise level. Overall though great job on the remodel and awesome menu and drink selection. We will be back for sure!!! It felt so nostalgic to be sitting in the old shop and go and still eating pizza and drinking beer.

Very hit or miss. Have been here twice, food is average to decent depending on what is ordered. Service leaves a lot to be desired. Drinks take a very long time to arrive (I waited roughly 30 minutes for a latte, another time at least 20 for a mimosa). On our latest trip, our waitress seemed very displeased to be there and actively avoided her tables which were all waiting around an hour for food on this day. Food arrived lukewarm despite being assured she was watching carefully for it. Dessert crepes are fun but a little too rich breakfast. Had a more positive experience on an earlier visit but seems server-dependent, as many other members of staff were standing around and also seemed less than pleased to be there.

Great little place with fantastic food. This little extension of Northside Social is a new favorite! It seats maybe 30 people but appeared to be doing a booming carry out business. Our server was most delightful with perfectly paced service and professionalism, which is greatly appreciated rather than being called sweetheart and asked @what are we having" at other venues recently. The garlic knots are heavenly and a huge portion. Wednesday is half price wine so always a bonus. The salads are interesting and shareable. The pizza ranks as one of the best I've had and I'm a pretty big pizza snob!

My meal was fantastic. The place was clean, socially distanced, and run efficiently. I got the beef taco and cheese enchiladas combination and have decided that it is my favorite in town. The enchiladas sauce was spicy yet not over bearing. It made my nose run, but my mouth wasn't burning. The taco was HUGE. It tasted amazing. In the trying times of this pandemic, this place has gone the extra effort to guarantee customer satisfaction.
Worst business ever. Bunch of shady stuff that goes on there. Plus one of the "regulars" which is good friends with the bartender smashed my car window out. Never going back there.

My friend and I called ahead to see what the protocol was for getting a cave session together, since the website says one person at a time. We were told we could get a room together, so we decided to go. Once we got there and paid, they informed us we would actually be in a room with 8 people, which is not what we thought we were paying for. We decided to give it a shot anyway, and when nobody in our session was wearing a mask (and no staff was encouraging them to either) we decided to leave and get our money back. Very disappointing experience.
Response to Mike: I understand and enjoy the rule that everyone must wear a mask upon entry to your store, but I was truly disappointed when I was trying to enjoy my experience in the Salt cave (with 5 other people, when my friend and I were TOLD BEFORE HAND that we would have a private room) and the other 5 people took their masks off and none of your employees said anything to them. As of right now, we are in the red tier, still not a great tier to be in. Being in a closed space with 5 other people with no masks on is going to put us closer to the purple tier, not the orange. All I ask is your employees enforce the mask rule a little, because from what I experienced today, no employees said anything to the people who took their masks off.

Fantastic hotel experience from check-in to check-out.  Experience started with a friendly receptionist and fresh cookies and ended with a great breakfast.  New hotel with great amenities.  Highly recommend.

Came here for a Sunday brunch.  Food was really good, but a little on the pricey side.

We ordered the eggs in a jar which was really good, but very creamy and a bit heavy.  The dish was served with jalapeño grits which were awesome!

We also ordered a sandwich "madnam" maybe?  Can't remember the exact spelling, but it was served with an egg on top and was also good.

Last entree was the shrimp and grits which was very good as well.

Kids ordered the hamburger and chicken strips.  Hamburger seemed to get the thumbs up, chicken strips were just ok.

Dessert- we had steamed chocolate which the chocolate by itself didn't do a whole lot for me, but the ice cream combined was fantastic!

Wife ordered the gateau basque which she said was also really good.

The flamenkuche which was our appetizer and had incredible tasting bacon.

Gave this place 4 stars due to our lunch bill adding up to $159.00 (before tip).  Which we did have a couple of bloody marry's, but still a bit much for a lunch.

This is authentic food. Amazing service and family owned . Inside if a craft beer store that is to die for. This place is aha gem and one of a kind. Don't let the aesthetics fool you. This food is clean fresh and made to order. We eat here at least once a week and grab a nice unique bottle of brew to go with it.

I like Publix, you can find items you can't find other places and, although prices are high compared to other grocery retailers, when they have a sale,. the sales are great. I use this pharmacy and scheduled my vaccine here. This review if for that experience which would get only 1 star. Imagine my horror when I went to the pharmacy and found no privacy. Chairs were set up, with vaccine signs, right there in the open. The shot would be given right out in the open. They could have at least invested in a screen or set up off to the side where no one goes or looks anyway. I drove around and found another provider that offered an acceptable spot to dispense the vaccine.  I did see another Publix that was the same way.  I didn't think of getting a photo, but I will the next time I'm in the store.

I was excited to try this place as we need a good beer/gastropub in the burbs.  I just came back from our first (and likely last) visit to this place.  When seated we were shoved in a corner.   Ten minutes later the waitress came back and asked us if we knew what we wanted to drink.  We asked to see a beer menu (being a 'pour house', not sure why they weren't with the menus) and she went to get them.  She gave them to us and stood there.  We let her know we needed a minute.  First order was Firestone Wookey Jack, a great beer, but she came back and said it was replaced by Sam Adams and their tap takeover.  Pretty weak, but ok.  Then ordered a Nectar IPA, which is not bad for a single beer with dinner.  She comes back and says this is kicked too.  I then order a Goose Island Nut Brown ale.  Not really what I want, but okay.  Before she gets back with the bottle, another person drops off a GI Honkers ale.  The waitress comes back with my bottle and asks if I got my beer.  Well since you didn't give it to me, one might surmise that I didn't, right?   I finally get my beer and a frosted glass, another indicator the people running this joint don't know anything about serving craft beer.  

Anyway, all this could be overlooked a bit with good food.  Nachos were tasty with decent cheese sauce, house chili and other standard fare.  Wife ordered a veggie burger (no mention of it served on a pita on the menu) and the waitress confirmed it was house made.  I got a club, which was supposed to have some cusabi sauce (whatever that is) and two slices of bread.  

Veggie burger appeared to be from a box (wife eats the good brands often and said it resembled a frozen kind) and my club was dry as anything with three slices of bread.  

The overall beer menu is pretty weak and while the food was decent, the service was just not good.  This probably brought the whole rating down a point.  Maybe it's a bad night, but often times you get one shot to make an impression in the restaurant business.  I'd rather drive the extra 15 minutes to the dog and bull or high street grill.
Both times Husband & I went and am delighted with friendly customer service. Establishment is neat and clean. Prices are very responsible.
Luckily they were serving hot doughnuts when we arrived. Their glazed doughnut is heavenly. It just melts into your mouth

Great taxi service. I called the day prior to my trip had made arrangements for them to pick me up at the St. Louis airport to take me to my hotel. Once I landed, there was a message on my phone that they were waiting for me. After picking up my bag, I walked out to the taxi area and they met me with a minivan and took me to my hotel . Great trip, The driver was very friendly and courteous. After my hotel stay, I called them the day before to arrange a pick up. They were prompt and picked me up at the time designated time. Again the driver was very friendly and courteous. I would definitely use this company again. Clean taxi and professional drivers. Thanks for making my trip that much easier.

I took my car to Budget Brakes for a second opinion after being quoted over 700.00 from Firestone.  Mike Miller the service manager looked at my car and gave me an estimate at half the price and accordingly so since my car is not that old and has under 70,000 miles.  This team is wonderful to work with- they are professional, fast, and most importantly honest about the repairs that need to be done.  I wish they provided more auto services.

We spent my birthday here this yr. for my birthday dinner.Little Debbie always gets the best local fried chicken in our area. I had the chicken fried
steak. This was an enjoyable dining experience. A good meal @ a fair price.Plenty of parking, clean restrooms & an attentive staff. I suggest it.

10:40- Sat at a dirty table as it was the least dirty table. (Only maybe 5 actually had people)

10:45 - flag down waitress. 

10:50 - told the table will be cleaned and they take our order (order didn't go in until 11:10 according to.checks)

11:05 - we clean our own table by placing everything on next table 

11:10 - I stand at the bar trying to order a drink as we haven't seen the waitress since. 

11:30 - the waitress finally comes back and I place a drink  order with her 

11:40- someone finally comes by to clean the table

11:45 - we get part of the order. (Missing fries and my drink still and multiple other items)

11:50ish - rest of food comes. It's cold and has clearly been sitting as cheese has hardened  ( still missing fries drink and someone's main course)

11:55 - main course comes.

12:10 - checks come and they've charged for missing items. Waitress says she'll take care of it. (We are now the only table left)

12:20 - we ask for manager as the waitress still hasn't returned. 

12:22 - trainer comes up and says she will take care of it. 

12:25 - manager comes and we explain and beg for the checks so we can just pay and leave

12:30 - waitress and trainer come back and they've camped my meal and halved everyone's and gave us a 75 gift card (got a gift card for sale btw)

12:30 - we explain that one of the meals that was halved was already paid for to another waitress. We are told that she likely took that as a tip and that  money is still owed. 

12:35 - the other waitress finally comes forward with the money and the check it was with (thus she knew it wasn't a tip) and angrily handed it over. We then just leave the $20 for an $8 bill and leave.

Visited Half Moon after having not visited for several years. The crab nachos are still worth going for however not much else was. They were short staffed in the kitchen and our food took 45 minutes from ordering to arrive and the appetizer came out last.  Generally this is a good place to go to grab a beer and after this experience if we go back it will just be for beer and not food.
Been coming here off and on for years. Quality produce sold by mostly family members. A long standing business.

I absolutely had an amazing experience during my first visit to the Carnivore Meat Company. The staff are incredibly helpful. I love all of their products. On this trip, I purchased two rib eyes, bacon, cajun beef jerky and a fruit tea. I admired how they cut the rib eyes and can't wait to put them on the Big Green Egg tonight.

Worst club in SB. My bf is a bigger guy.... Just because he doesnt weAr skinny jeans they told him his jeans were to baggy... Which they came the way they are for his size.... You mister bouncer are just a DOOR MAN! Get over your self...
Besides he was also accusing another customer who had bottle service of baggy jeans......We ended up going to omallys and Madisons for the night

So everyone calls this place "The Dennys of Italian" and I can see where they are coming from but I entirely disagree. The reason people call it this is because it's too much of a good thing, therefore something is wrong with it. 

1.) A lot of food
2.) The food tastes great (but I haven't had everything on the menu)
3.) Unlimited soup and salad FREE
4.) The people that work there aren't "nose-in-the-air"
5.) It's INEXPENSIVE!
6.) Nothing beats those little mints they give you before you leave

If you get a good waiter (and 8 times out of 10 I do), it's unbeatable and you'll always walk out happy. Don't listen to these foo foo people who would rather pay more, get less, and live by the standards of their peers.

Corino's customer service, food, prices are HORRIBLE. Macaroni grill is the only large chain in town that compares and the problem there: not enough food, no soup or salad, and that one measley piece of bread they give you (which tastes good but half the time it's cold and tough). I've been to a lot of italian food chains across the nation and it's honestly one of the better ones. By the way, the chicken parmigiana is to DIE FOR!

Well, I really hate when this happens. When something is so absolutely terrible that it just gets worse at every opportunity there is to turn a bad situation around. I ordered a large pizza for pick up and when we got home it was a scrawny 12in pizza. It had the right toppings but there is no way anyone would pay $30 for that sad little pizza in a very big box. I sent my husband down to pick up a new pizza. When he got there they were not ready...and they also made the new one a small and it was missing one of the topping they charged me nearly $4 to add in the first place. Basically, they do not know what they are doing and they completely ripped us off in addition to disrupting our evening. Additionally, I ordered it online so it is very clear what I ordered...twice. They did not offer to correct it or give our money back..which is what they should have done at this point in the disaster.

Two words:  DYNAMITE ROLL. 
Also, if I could bathe in the house salad dressing, I would.

Walked in at 4:30 in the afternoon on a Friday and had a Lease finalized on a great CX-5 at the price we were budgeting for by 7:00. The staff was EXCELLENT! Kenyon, Carlos, and Troy went out of their way to work out the numbers for us.

The old stigma of playing hardball so that you don't leave money on the table during negotiations is a waste of time at Paretti. (and trust me, I normally like to play the game) We told them what we were hoping to get with what we could afford and they found several tweaks to the deal to make it happen. I truely feel it was a Win-Win. They clued in on the fact I own a Mazda and made sure to add the $750 customer loyalty rebate that I was unaware of!

Definitely give Paretti a shot at earning your business. They were a pleasure to deal with and Mazda is producing some pretty amazing vehicles.

Biggest bunch of crooks I've ever encountered, they target people for illegal tows and charge a ridiculous amount of money to get car back. My car was still being hooked up, but the obviously not so intelligent driver wouldn't budge. On top of that, they dragged my AWD vehicle out from the spot and around the lot damaging my tire. All I can say, check the signs anywhere around for signs and stay away from anywhere these folks service. Crooks.

awwwfuuulllllllll!!  i would not let my dogg eat here!!
they don't post the prices on their menu board, and don't give you a bill at your table, so that you have to pay at the counter and they routinely have over-charged me.  the druggy looking girl from portland is snarky and  is very shady. i definitely would *not* use a credit card to pay here. the food is substandard and overpriced. i eat out a lot and i will save you  time, money and skank factor--it "looks" clean but majorly shady and skanky-avoid!!! avoid!! avoid!!!!!!!!*************

This is NO longer under Ramada:  We booked a room while under Ramada last year and when we called 3wks ago was informed there were new owners; it is now called Nashville Airport Inn & Suites.  We were supposed to arrive on June 5th and after them lying to us for 3wks were told they do not have our info & have NO room. They did not honor previous reservations and dissed our room so they could get more $$$ per night from someone else.  I would rather sleep in my car then deal with these rude liars ever again. Now from what I have read glad we are not staying in this nasty place.  I am not done w my complaints; I am going higher up. We got totally screwed.

The coffee was really good and the baristas were super friendly. So, why two stars off? Because they're selling mugs heavily marked up (the camper/adventure mugs) that you can buy a 4-pack of from Sam's Club for $8. That's pretty scummy.

Apple stores occupy a weird space in my world. 

On one hand, I really want to avoid going there because it is a real ripoff. Seriously, every time I go there, they recommend a plethora of unnecessary fixes/services that cost at least 30% more in comparison to hiring another professional. 

Then again, it's great to have a one stop shop where all of my tech needs are met. As an Apple man, that type of reliable service just doesn't exist elsewhere, so I often find myself coming here. 

The service here is fantastic. Everyone here is super friendly, knowledgeable, and helpful. On occasion, you might even find someone who is willing to go the extra mile in order to ensure that your technology is in perfect working condition. 

The only problem are the prices, which can be ludicrously high. 

Still, it is the only dedicated Apple store in town, which makes it a special place. I just wish it wasn't so expensive.

I think this is the cleanest dollar tree store I have ever visited. And here I am again sitting in the parking lot looking in through the glass doors and the lady is sweeping sweeping sweeping sweeping in front of the door on the inside. They also have a good supply of dollar items with the usual ever-changing variety.

I've gotten carryout from here many a times since I live just down the street. The pizza is pretty good (i tend to shy away from deep dish, so i'm very happy about talayna's many options) and the service is friendly. 

I can't say much more about this place, but living on pershing, i'm one happy girl to know this place is a pizza option instead of the papa john's across the street.

I've had a bad experience in almost every Primary care doctors office I have been to. I have always been treated like a number and not a patient with medical needs, making me feel uncomfortable to trust my doctor. My experience at this office was the opposite of all of my experiences, I was treated like a patient. Dr. Bralow was down to earth, professional, asked me all the questions and took his time with me for my first intake appointment.  He made sure all of my questions were answered, and the woman at the front desk was just as pleasant. I'm so happy to finally have a doctor who actually cares about their patients, and I feel confident in knowing all of my medical needs will be taken care of. I highly highly recommend this office!

My need of fining new places and to eat delicious food had brought me so many great experiences! 
This time I want to talk about Salz, I think this is the idea of home made food with the touch of a trendy place and great service.
Food was really good, we ordered two brats in a plate; the sausage comes with two sides and some extras!
If you feel like having some delicious sausages later at home, ask your server and they can sell you some of your favorite one! 
The concept of a big table where all the customers can sit and actually talk to others is great! 
The only downside is that they don't open on Mondays; during the last month, every time I suggested to my bf to visit Salz is has been a Monday! What is happening! Anyways I will be back very soon and bring some of my friends!
Such a relief after all this going on, a place to have beers  and burger  definitely stop by, you won't regret it!

We were passing through on a road trip, trying to find a good tasty spot to eat. Looked up the menu and it looked like a good choice. Well... when we first arrived the hostess looked less than happy to see us and begrudgingly sat us at the bar. With Covid-19 restrictions in affect we knew we were in for a different dining experience but little did we know we were in for something worse. The bar tender (early to mid 40's white woman) made me feel bad for asking for a drink menu. After I asked to see it she responded, "yeah we have one but it's in the other room and plus I'd have to clean it first.. fine I'll go and get it" making like she was doing me a favor to see the drink list. After sitting for another 15 minutes she came back for our drink order... we got our drinks (corona and a water) and she kept up with the same super rude attitude. We ordered food from her and began our wait. After 20 mins our food came out cold. My burger looked like it was sitting under a heat lamp for 10 mins. Not good. While we were finishing up our very sub par American dinner, we noticed a couple of patrons outside waiting to put in a drink order... after taking their order she said it would be a "just a sec, actually more like a hot minute" she turned her head and under her breathe said "if everyone would just go the f@$k home that would be great". Not only did I hear what she just said but the patrons outside heard what she said under her breath, we exchanged looks and comments ..." did she just really say that?!". We didn't ask for our bill we were so discussed, dropped some cash and left. Never again. We called in to complain to the manager and he basically said he was gunna comp us a appetizer but not address his disgruntle employee. I hope corporate sees this review and takes actual action. This is the beginning to the end of your business.

DELISH! From the unique deviled eggs, to soups, to salads, and more substantial selections, our group of 4 simply ate our faces off. Very posh, but not stuffy, trendy and comfy, I can't wait to go again!

My Zoey went for her yearly physical and shots, she warmed right up to Dr. Waller as she did the last time we were there.  Don't hesitate to take your kitty to VCA Feline Medical Center, it's a great place.

Salads and main course came out at the same time and the main meals were cold. That was promptly addressed by the friendly location manager and our very kind waitress. At the end of our meal we paid the bill through the portable kiosk at the table and received three "error" messages, however all three transactions showed as pending with our bank.   Since my husband works for the bank that handles their credit system he is well aware of what was happening. We asked for clarification and presented the information we had from our bank. The operating manager came out and made a huge scene about our card getting "declined".  To clarify our card would never be declined as funds are not an issue.  However , the operating partner thought it would be best to loudly state for all restaurant guests to hear that our card was declined and he is not holding our money.  Instead of trying to act as a professional as we attempted to provide him with the correct information (also information that he was not able to provide immediately because he was not aware of who handles their credit processing) he should be giving to his customers he continued his defense and go around and around and around.   Rude, unprofessional and disappointing is the best description of this situation.  Agitation was expressed on our part as well after being accused of not having funds to pay for our meal. I would only hope this location video records interactions with guests as this is a scenario that could be used in guest relations and management improvement.  
On a positive note, the location manager Greg( different from GM/operating partner) was very friendly as was our waitress. We were able to calmly and clearly explain the issue to them and they seemed to understand the issue and sympathize as well. Too bad the manager is not an operating partner as I believe this location could really use some improvements from the top.  
In addition, this was the first night out to eat with my family in days as I have been out of town tending to a very ill parent. 
I should have paid more attention to the current Facebook reviews on this location and taken my business elsewhere as I will be in the future.
Edit: A call was placed to corporate at the phone number and extension provided to us by the GM and that information was also inaccurate.

My lawn has never looked better. They are a little bit more expensive than other places but it's worth it if you care about your lawn! They are honest good people and I won't use anyone else! I found them because of a sign in the yard of multiple neighbors with beautiful yards! They are above and beyond some of the other companies I've used!!!

Lazy to cook, so we came here for dinner. It didn't disappoint us. We got the margherita pizza. The crust was perfect not too thin and crunchy. A little too much cheese, but that's just me. 
We also ordered cheesesteak. I think it could have a little more meat. It looked pretty sad. 
Will definitely come back and try other stuff.

I bouught 2 vehicles from Evo  looking to buy a 3rd , I had no issues that some of the people are talking about.
choose the vehicle I wanted test drive , was approve in less that 15 minutes I send some of my friends to Evo they had similar experience. over all experience excellent.

Should have listened to the Yelp reviews instead of insisting on trying Scratch biscuits myself. Dryyyyy biscuits and chicken. I got my sandwich with mayo and had to ask for more on the side to combat the dryness and make it edible. 

Also, the menu board displays that all sandwiches come with homemade chips and pickles. Since my boyfriend and I each ordered sandwiches and neither of us received chips and pickles, I asked the cashier who said they did not have any made. He offered to give us a side of hush puppies as an alternative, which I took him up on, because I should have been given the option when ordering or offered a discount on their pricey sandwich combo.

By the way, the hush puppies were extremely dry as well.

I started eating here when they first opened. I was really surprised how good it was. My favorites were the calamari salad and the bronze pebble. 

AND THEN God knows what happened but a few months ago the food started tasting like crap. The calamari salad is now okay and the bronze pebble now has no flavor. 

ON TOP OF THAT the delivery drivers have no sense of direction. My building has a huge sign on it and is only 12 minutes from the restaurant. Why does it take over an hour to find me? 

BUT THATS NOT IT, I got charged three times for one order, which I'm sure was the computers fault. But then the cashier could care less when I called about the problem and could not spell westshore. How dumb are you? After I talked to a manager who said she will talk to the general manager, they still didn't do anything about. After two days, I went into the restaurant and I finally got my money back. Why wasn't it a priority? You're holding my money! 

MY POINT IS that I will NEVER eat here again. It is the last time I'll eat somewhere besides koto or soho sushi. They need to get there shit together and I'm not going sit and shift in it until they figure it out.
I got the steak and crab cake. My steak was a bit over done but it was fine. Bf got the steak. Server was very attentive. Calamari were a bit salty.

Recently discovered this fine Italian wine bar and met the adorable husband and wife that run it, along with a few friendly regulars and I'm sold. They have great wine at various price points. With the hospitality and decor of a cute Italian couple I felt as if I were a guest in their home. The first to admit and stress that they are not a restaurant, the owner showed me a menu, and while there was amazing looking bites, dinners, and desserts on it, he stressed it was all about the wine. I'm dying to go back and see them, and hopefully all the friends we made the short time we were there. This is a secret must-try for locals who THINK they have done it all. This is just the beginning for this tiny, cannoli-sweet secret!
The staff are all very nice and caring! They are great!

I had my free oil change and tire rotation after buying my vw at this dealership.  But after being served I went around the corner to examined it.  Well I found the same oil filter and tire placement.  How do I know this?  Because I had placed my initials in the oil filter and wrote in the tires the initials FL (front left) FR and so on.   But wait there is more.
About one year later I go back for the 20000 free oil change.  But soon after my undercarriage fell off.  They forgot or broke the harness after opening the oil release bolt.
Unfortunately there is more.  About one year later I went back for an appointment I had made.  But they told me I didnt have an appointment that day but rather for the next week.  So I go the next week (after also receiving email reminders for 915am) and I am told they will not be able to take a look at my car until the next day.   Such good cars.  Wished with had other options in the southshore :( 
Like a previous reviewer said, this creates a grave dilemma when considering buying another VW thanks to Walker.
First time in Philly and stumbled upon this gem. We tried all flavors of the chicken and they were outstanding.  The greens, cole slaw and cornbread were stellar. JJ's for the win!!!

This is the best and only lash place I've been!! Megan was incredible and I have a fill with Cindy coming up!

EVERYONE had commented on how natural and beautiful they look. People with and without knowledge of lashes, even guys who had no idea they were extensions!!!

So I'm so happy I didn't have to go through any horror stories before finding this gem

If you didn't have a Philly Cheesesteak, did you even go to Philly?

I never had a Philly Cheesesteak and a lot of the big names were quite out of the way from where I was staying. I ended up finding this spot two blocks from my hotel and it was a no brainer what I needed to get.

I got the Cheesesteak (second thing on their menu) with provolone cheese on a classic bun. They set the bar pretty darn high for what constitutes as a great Philly cheesesteak. It's not overloaded with cheese so you don't feel fattening and sick from all of the dairy. The meat is not dry, but also not dripping with grease. It was pretty darn perfect for just steak and cheese on a bun. Very filling for just 10$ and the amount of steak you get. I will be using this place as a benchmark in comparing other cheesesteaks in the future.

This is a great place to have some delicious sushi, drinks and listen to music on Fridays. At first we thought it was a small restaurant but then they guide us to the next door and voilá, a huge bar and nice restaurant area that you can't realize is there from outside. I really recommend this place :) Excellent customer service, everyone is so attentive and friendly too. Come and enjoy!

**Such a FANTASTIC all you can eat crab, byob that is an unknown hole in the wall!** 

The price on the all you can eat crabs changes based on season, volume and demand. There are platters for people, like myself, who will only eat a small portion of crab. Platters vary but I chose the KING CRAB platter , which included 2 sides and soup/salad. The macaroni and cheese was just how mom would make it...mmmm! The hush puppies were so-so but were great dipped in with my creamy seafood soup. The coleslaw was a step above average but my king crab made up for it. The king crab was the largest I have ever eaten and along with the garlic sauce...WOW. Dave and Busters, Bobby Chez and Red Lobster can step aside because Blue Claw rules over the commercial chains.

The price for my platter was around $40 and I left with dinner for the next day. Be forewarned, greedy-grubbers: you cannot bring home leftovers with the all you can eat. The service is excellent and do not neglect your appetite-- they keep 'em comin'. Inside the restaurant has a knicknack style to it and is the type of place you where jeans and a t-shirt.

Also on the menu: pasta, clams, founder, catfish, shrimp, scallops and wings. Everything can be cooked a variety of ways; take-out is available.

Rob is absolutely wonderful! My husband and I (as well as our kitty) were driving from Maine to California and with only 3 1/2 hours left to our destination. We stopped at a nearby gas station for gas and food and unknowingly locked the keys in our car! (With our precious cat inside!) Being the crazy cat lady I am I panicked. My husband ran across the street to Jiffy Tube to ask for assistance. Thankfully, he was able to talk to Ian and in turn Ian was able to talk to his boss Rob an without any cost, he walked back over to our car and was able to pry the door and unlock the car free of charge and without any damage or scratches. We are SO thankful to Rob and his crew for his act of kindness. Thanks again Rob! Both my husband and I as well as our kitty are so grateful for your help!

This place is great! Tucked away on the marina, I hadn't discovered this gem until yesterday. Went with a bunch of friends around 2 on a Sunday. It was quite busy but ordering was quick. The food took a little while to get to our table but it was well worth it. I had the shrimp tacos but everything at our table looked fantastic. Looking forward to coming back!

Highly recommend!! Very clean and reasonability priced. My boyfriend and I recently moved here from Southern California to attend graduate school. We found this place last minute online while driving across the country in a Uhaul without ever seeing it in person.

The unit itself is clean, the air works wonderfully (you chose between warmer, normal, and coolest which has not been a problem at all), our unit includes stainless steel appliances, plenty of storage, hardwood floors, the shower pressure is great, and the views are wonderful. You pay for electric & cable/internet - everything else is covered by the Mansion House.

The apartment building has been updated, there is free laundry (and plenty of machines), plenty of amenities (rooftop pool, sauna, gym, library and an outdoor area), there is an efficient package delivery service run by the lobby attendants, the mail is conveniently located, you have to have a key fob to enter the building which makes it feel very safe, and the elevators have worked fine for us (we've only run into traffic a few times which is to be expected in a 29 story building). The only downside we've encountered is the additional $90 a month for parking which can only be paid with check or cashiers check. The garage is open to the public. 

The staff here are so professional and friendly. Leah and Eileen in the leasing office were so helpful and made the transition to Saint Louis a pleasant one. The lobby attendants are all very friendly and helpful as well. We asked maintenance to check our door (it stuck a bit when opening it) and they arrived promptly and fixed the problem without any hesitation. 

We are both very glad we chose the Mansion House Apartments as our first home away from home!

Great place. Near the casino. The beer is terrific. Standard but nice brewery tour. The food is quite a suprise, not what you would expect and prepared exceptionally well. Wonderful how much of the place is old and has been repurposed to serve their needs. A model of intelligent recycling. Solar powered. Great place freat food great beer
I use Just Grillin for ALL my outdoor grill needs... the folks are always attentive to customer needs and willing to educate. Highly recommend this locally owned familyestablishment!
One person and ten people in line = 15 minutes plus to get rung up on the cash register.  This is the quality service you can expect from this Panera.

I like to think the midwest gets all the nice things the coasts have a decade later. Case in point, Seoul Taco. Korean-Mex fusion has been a thing in LA since the 90s. Enter Seoul Taco to bring this trend to flyover country, first as a wildly popular taco truck and later as a brick and mortar location in the Delmar Loop.

Most people are familiar with the ingredients that make up a taco or burrito. Korean tacos essential gimmick is to change up the ingredients that go inside the tortilla. For example, their burritos are made with your choice of Korean-style BBQ protein (pork, beef, chicken, or tofu), kimchi fried rice, lettuce, cheese, carrots, and "seoul sauce," which is like a tangier and spicier thousand island. All in all it's a flavor combo that is delicious and filling.

Seoul Taco does fall short on two counts. The proteins can be really salty and their "Korean" blend of greens is literally just the earthbound farms organic greens from the plastic box. I'm a big fan of bibimbap and was disappointed to find that their greens blend top a bowl of bibimbap in lieu of seasoned veggies. It's weird to eat a rice bowl with a bunch of wilty salad greens on it and it's something I will probably never get used to. Consider this place a chipotle-tier experience with an neat fusion twist.

Yes, their service is horrendous. Inexcusably horrendous. However, they serve the best Cuban food in Tampa Bay. Order a beer, as soon as you arrive,  then sit back and chill out. The sampler is the best bang for your buck, but everything is good.

I walk into Yeoman's thinking to myself - average local bar where everyone knows eachother's name but if you are not in the local scene you'll stick out like a sore thumb. ENTIRELY WRONG!
