My favorite part of this bar is the bartenders. They had spunk and they knew there stuff re: beer. My friend and I tried most of the on draft beers.  I only happen to like fuity beers, so I indulged in a cider, blueberry and pumpkin beer. They made sure to remember all of our names and were very quick to serve us. They said make sure to come back and I actually probably will. 
I normally don't like these types of bars at all... but it was truly a good night.

Several people told me when I moved to St. Petersburg, that I needed to check out Ted Peters for smoked fish.

Driving by the other day, I pulled in to buy some smoked fish to take home. The small shack outfront is kind of love the script, and you may not be sure where to go in.

Once inside it's a nice simple counter, I sign listing several kinds of fish by the pound and a whole wall of built in smoking trays.

The guy who helped me, was very friendly, explained some of the options for fish and pulled out a nice sized smoked mullet.

It was weighed, wrapped in plastic and then in paper....and I was off.

He did explain that if I fished they would smoke those fish I caught and brought to them as well.

The fish was nice and smokey, flakey and moist.

Absolutely going back to try more smoked fish.
Joe is a thorough photographer and he gets great results.  He took my ideas for poses, but also came up with wonderful ones to suggest.  He is wonderful for headshots!

These young men arrived on time and ready to work.  They were extremely careful with all the furniture and televisions.  I was impressed that they knew how to disassemble an old roll top desk, and reassemble while repairing some old damage.  They were very patient, courteous, and respectful of us old folk when we got in the way!  They charged a more than fair price for their time and effort.  I HIGHLY recommend these movers.

Angel was truly awesome! She was extremely helpful and responsive throughout the whole closing process. Being that we were the first house that she was in charge of closing, she did not come off as an amateur. The whole mortgage processing staff in Tampa, that assisted my husband and I, were truly great. We definitely felt at ease during the exciting and stressful process of purchasing a home.
Big al is the absolute man. Steak sandwich was great. Awesome service as well. Great hole in the wall place for a low key lunch or breakfast

Kind of a dirty salon with no prices posted and they just throw numbers left and right out. I was watching everyone's face when they would throw out numbers of 55.00 or 75 and not one person questioned it or asked but just stood there with a puzzled face trying to figure out the math. They will nickel and dime you for everything even add a processing fee if you use a card. At least they take Venmo. So there's a win. I remember when the these types of salon were the more affordable options and many people chose these salons over a nicer salon like place with higher prices. Honestly I'm ready to ditch these types of places and head to a salon. I'll gladly pay the money when it's justified.

Th staff is extremely welcoming and friendly! When my friend and I walked in we were instantly in a seat and had our polishes picked out, someone to get started on our nails and a complimentary drink. No waiting and absolutely zero hostility, and to top it off the little place is just so homey. The nail stylists make jokes and conversation to make you feel comfortable! They also don't beg for tips or most importantly rush through. My nails were impeccable! all for a low price. Definitely go here :)

Good, too much sauce on the fish tacos, very salty. 
Sweet potato fries and blue cheese chips were amazing!
I may actually gain a few pounds from this place...but the cupcakes are so good ...I'm going to be ok with that!

This is a Mexican restaurant with a predominantly white staff and management. I have been to the West Philly location 4 times and have never seen anyone on their staff who identifies as BIPOC. To make matters worse, the manager was very rude to me. I went there to celebrate my friend's birthday, and I expressed to her that my friend wanted to sit in one of their outdoor structures. I told her that there were 3 adults, 1 six year old and a baby in our party. She informed me that we would not fit in the structure as it only seats 4 people, and she could offer us a picnic table. I reiterated that it was my friend's birthday, and that is where she really wanted to sit. She continued going back and fourth with me, and then rudely said "first of all pull up your mask." My friend told her that the baby would sit on her lap, which is what I was trying to explain to her and then she said oh okay you guys can sit there. At that point I was so over it because I couldn't believe she had talked to me like that. Meanwhile, she never said happy birthday to my friend or notified the waiter that it was her birthday. I decided to go tell her that the way she talked to me made me uncomfortable, and when I did she said that the reason she talked to me like that was because I raised my voice at her. I did not raise my voice at her, but I'm sure as a black woman my natural tone may have come off threatening to her. When I explained to her that I am a customer and deserved to be treated kindly she just stared at me. I also let her know that if it wasn't for my friend's birthday I would have left that restaurant and went somewhere else. She said okay and nothing else. 
It's so many things wrong with this restaurant for me. It's founded on cultural appropriation. A lot of the staples like tacos, rice and beans taste inauthentic and bland. The energy there is very off, which makes sense because the manager has a nasty attitude. I wouldn't waste my time or money with this place. It will only support white people who are appropriating, and leave you disappointed with the service. 
There is an amazing Mexican restaurant called Don Barriga less than a mile from this place. The food is authentic and delicious and the service is stellar.
Way too expensive in comparison to portion size. We ordered delivery and although we really enjoyed the taste, it was $30 for the two of us and we did not have anything left over for later.

I am so impressed. Not only is this team of people incredibly kind and great at customer service, but the quality of the food, coffee, and space is spectacular. My only regret is getting only one taco. I'll be back and I'll be telling friends to make this a go to spot.

Strange it will sound, as Yoda might say. I don't like much about this place yet I am giving it a passing grade with a smile. I know... All I needed was a clean quite place to get some work done and this place was a perfect at an economical rate. Yeah, it is old. The toilet looked well used (not a good thing), and the carpet had seen better days. The towels are sadly stiff. It is probably the worst TownePlace Marriott I've stayed in terms of overall look...However the staff is accommodating and I am OK with the overall experience. If you're looking for a place to crash or get some work done at a good rate, this is the right place.

I have been hearing about this place on the local radio. They advertise a $10 haircut. Their marketing is definitely directed at men. 

The place looks great. There are comfortable leather chairs all facing one of many high definition televisions showing sports. When I walked in, there was no one at the front desk but a young lady came over and asked me to complete my "registration" on a computer. Afterwards, another young lady came over and introduced herself. The haircut was done correctly and efficiently, the stylist was pleasant, but the best part is the shampoo. Once the haircut was done, my stylist asked me to go to the back to wash out the cut hair. She proceeded to shampoo and condition my hair while massaging my head. She did ask if I wanted extra time on the massage or a hot towel around my face. I declined as time did not allow me to stay for these additional services. But, I'll be back to try them out. 

I had a great experience at Lady Jane's and will be going back!

Disgusting all around. Bouncers scream at you for waiting in line for over an hour, and then violently grab you to shove you through the door. The service has always been awful here, but I draw the line at physical violence by EMPLOYEES. There is also a blatant disregard for COVID safety precautions. No masks and everyone packed in like sardines. Abhorrent behavior in management.

Vietnam Cafe exceeded all my expectations. Being part Vietnamese and having been to Vietnam a trillion of times, my tastebuds will not stand any kind of subpar pho. I was a little weary on my way here, but this place offers a nice vibe and great food. I was excited because I've never been to a Vietnamese restaurant with a bar, so that super hyped me up. Woot woot! (I promise I'm not an alcoholic lolol). Not only that, but I've never been to an Asian restaurant that made an effort with decor and had bomb food at the same time. 

The prices were a few dollars more than your average Pho joint, but still very affordable. The menu had an amazing selection of food. I can't wait to try other things. 

I got beef pho and my boyfriend got beef stew noodles. The food was just nom, not lacking flavor and the meat was fresh and tender. We also got a flaming volcano cocktail bowl to share which was amazing. 

I have nothing bad to say about this place. Will be back soon!

I met a friend for dinner and we weren't rushed through dinner. I had a caesar salad and gnocchi in a light pesto sauce with shrimp the meal was excellent. I would highly recommend Gino's to anyone looking for really excellent Italian food.

Glad I finally stopped into see what I thought would be excellent, and wasn't disappointed! Incredible wings and great conversation! Hard work at its finest and can't wait until I can make it down to Indy again!

I am a big Pappy's fan.  This is an excellent, true traditional slow smoked barbecue restaurant. Great rind on the meat and flavor, and the smell makes your mouth water.  Writing this review makes me think "Got to get me some Pappy's soon!!"

I think three stars sounds about right for this place. I have to say that the staff are friendly and the place is cute. The concept is fun and we've been back a couple of times so that says something. The menu is simple but I'm guessing they will have something you like. There are also gourmet pops here that you might like. 

Two stars off because of a slightly too limited menu an the prices are a bit high. My wife and I were close to $20 both times. $7 for a grilled cheese with chips just seems too much.

I love the pops and gelato from this place so while I was in St. Pete having brunch nearby I had to get in for a refreshing treat before heading back across the bridge. I always only have had the popsicles on the truck but these pops are delicious and perfect for a hot day. I had the Pineapple Mojito on this sorbet on this trip and it was delish. I am sad that the one weekend I finally made it to the shop is the last weekend the brick and morter building will be open. You can still find their products at Locale Market and the cafe at the  Dali museum though.

I have eaten here several times and the food is fabulous, unfortunately the service has declined severely. Two days ago my daughter took me to Shaya for a belated birthday lunch. We had reservations at 11:45 and the restaurant was not full. Our server took our drink order (just water and a pomegranate lemon soda).  She didn't return for nearly 10 minutes. She finally took our order and then returned with Shaya's delicious homemade pita. 45 minutes later she had delivered 4 loaves of pita bread, but not our main meal. After an hour, I canceled the order at which point she offered to comp my soda. Won't be returning.

Wanted to enjoy a nice evening with my boyfriend, with dinner and drinks there. Our server took our drink orders but never returned to our table to take our food order or refill our beverages in over 45 minutes and it wasn't even busy. She attended tables that showed up after us and they got refills and food. We asked for our check and it took her ten minutes to bring it. Was near FORTY DOLLARS for one hookah coal and two drinks. 
I stopped by and let the bartender know we wanted to stay and eat and drink more but she just asked who our server was and then never apologized or said have a good night. I was not rude or demanding, and was polite when I told her our situation, so I'm utterly confused why the service was so bad.
We will never go back.

My boyfriend and I were very disappointed with the food. The food was very bland, which is unfortunate because Thai food is some of the most flavorful food. I would not recommend Aqua to anyone. There are better Thai restaurants in Philly.

Absolutely love coming here. I always come for happy hour during the week. Their crunchy L.A. roll is my all time favorite. I've always had good service and no issues with our order. I am a frequent flyer! 
Also took my boyfriend here and he won't stop asking me when we can go back. LOVE IT!
Superb ice cream!  Staff is friendly and efficient!  Local hotspot!  Lines do get long but go quick!  Tried quite a few flavors and everyone is excellent.  A personal favorite for a tasty treat!!!

These folks are great! I recently bought a car from another dealer that turned out to be a total lemon. I took it in for a diagnostic and they were amazing at giving me a rundown of everything that was wrong. They were fast and friendly. Juliet is a champ!

LOVED their gluten free pizza!  I had the sausage, mushroom and green pepper pizza and it was wonderful.  The crust was so good, you would think it was a regular dough.  They have the most friendly staff.  Many do not realize they also have wonderful BAKED wings!
Great morning bike ride along the river then lunch and a brew. We were so happy to see that the Sandbar is back open!  Our server Cecily was terrific and the brisket sandwich was fantastic.

Stayed here for work. Was great. Tim the front desk clerk was exceptional. As well as the guy who drove the shuttle.
Rooms cleaned everyday, absolute 100% customer service

I got the Aka special for which they were doing a test-run. It was quite yummy. The price isn't too cheap but reasonable, especially in comparison to Ramen Bar in University City which is more expensive and not THAT much better. The menu is simple but adequate.

Ordered the outlaw ribeye, crispy Brussels and a salad. 

The good: the waitress was outstanding. Quick to keep my drinks filled, and friendly. The kitchen was on top of it, brought my meal out quickly. 

I orders my steak medium rare and I'm happy to say it was medium rare throughout. Almost all of it was moist and tender. The sauce was outstanding and the Brussels were quite tasty.

The salad was unremarkable. Tasty if average and unimaginative. 

The bad: parts of my stake were dry. The middle 30% or so was absolutely dry - nearly inedible. There was a little gristle on one side that I had to cut off. The salt was unevenly applied, parts were exceptionally seasoned. Parts (the middle third again) were unseasoned. 

All in all for 40$ with tip I expected a little bit more. If the whole steak had been as excellent as the outside was it would be something I'd be extremely satisfied with. 

To be fair the outside of the steak was so phenomenal that I would still buy another steak just like it. With the caveat to be careful not to dry the middle out. Maybe it was a weird piece of meat. All I know is I will be back.

Unfortunately the reviews for this hotel are very misleading. I used priceline to book this hotel, and they advertised it as being a 3 star hotel, and that simply is not the case.  The positive reviews seem to come mostly from people who have experienced and used the conference center, those who have stayed in a room seem to have all the same complaints: that it's dirty, dusty, old, uncared for and neglected. There are stains everywhere and it doesn't even seem like the rooms are cleaned on a daily basis. I'm not a picky person, so I can deal - but to think you're getting a deal at a 3 star hotel when really it's just not, is very disappointing. The staff is friendly though. Jesus help me.

First time. Very nice, service was exceptional. Ordered shrimp as an appetizer. Not chilled but still warm from the pot and you peel. Iced tea was fresh. Ordered the fried combo with scallops, white fish and mahi-mahi.  If you like crispy fried this isn't it but then there is plenty of seafood flavor not over ridden by grease and breading.  Other order was seafood pasta with creole sauce. Had crab, shrimp, scallops and craw fish. Outstanding. Finished off with a nice key lime pie and a mango pie. Not home made but excellent. Would go back with friends.

Really great bulgogi poutine!  You have to get the kimchi, if you like the contrast of flavors to the sweet bulgogi poutine.  It's really akin to throwing spicy sauerkraut to a greasy brat or Reuben.  

Overall the poutine fries were crispy and well put together.  I'll be trying a bowl next time.  My friends had suggested double meat for the future.

For a more calm less hipster-tastic outing I will suggest 1702.
This place is nice and CURRENTLY is ALMOST a hidden gem of tucson.
It gets PACKED! I love how they have an ever changing and  constantly evolving tap selection. Seriously you can check what is on tap before you head out for dinner and by the time you get there they will have had to change it as they have run out of something. Now I know beers, hell I have been known to brew my own, I have also worked sales, So I both understand and hate when you go somewhere order a strong/rare/fancy (expensive) beer and they serve it in a juice glass (8-10 oz, tiny, NOT A PINT). Look charge me the $9-10 for a pint  or offer a smaller glass for the similar average $6 a glass with the rest of the PINTS. The people who come here are beer dorks/snobs they will pay what it is worth, but dont assume a larger price per drink is going to shoo away your target clientele. I want my beer experience to last longer than 10 ounces will.
    They also sell some bottles retail and then will charge you a $1.50 opening fee. Now I understand that a large portion of the fee is probably due to liquor laws/ taxes, I got it, the government sucks. I respect not taking a loss selling bottles, but a better strategy would be to price the bottles for the "open it and drink it there" price and then offer a discount on "TO GO" products to reflect the tax savings. I cant be the only one who hates a mandatory up charge at the register, but we all love discounts when they come our way.
    Seating, where the hell can I find a seat? Seriously there needs to be more places to sit and relax unless you want me to get a glass pound it and GTFO. Parking in the area, F THAT, you have to find some on street parking. Which is annoying as it  is just off of 4th and downtown districts so parking is a sh!t show and can change from permit needed to private to loading zone in a matter of feet. Not to mention the fact that it is such a lovely neighborhood to wander around in late at night, by train tracks, and hobos, where no one will hear you scream... yeah.
   Which leads me to this point, maybe it is because it is new and the throngs are abusing this place before the shiny wears off, BUT as busy as it was on a tuesday night in the middle of July (when Tucson is historically dead) this place will be ridiculous when the college kids come back. I think if I want some fun beer I will drive by this place and see if it is nice or a zoo before looking for parking. If it is a zoo I will just drive to 1702.

Excellent people. I'm a Soldier making my way back to base my a/c stopped working took it in to jiffy lube and Jose/humble Hispanic guy diagnosed the problem as the rest of the staff helped. If I was staying in the area, I would honestly trust these guys to service my car but I'm heading down to Junction city. Very polite as well! They saved me a ton of money.

Fresh ingredients, great service, food had a unique taste and was a delight. There was a wait but we signed in online and we walked around shopping center first so wait wasn't bad for us. We really enjoyed our meal and will be back
Super delicious! Felt very safe with covid precautions. Sat outside in the covered patio and it was warm and comfortable on an otherwise chilly day!

Creekview placed a crown on my tooth in October/Nov. 2012. They made this crown in the office with a special machine. 

The crown fell off within a week, but they put it back on. All well and good.

 In mid-July 2014 part of the crown broke off.

They couldn't work me in immediately, so I went to another dentist, who said they (new dentist) guarantee crowns for five years and I should try again to see Creekview since surely the crown was still under warranty.When I called, Creekview said no, they only guarantee crowns for a year. They would have to look at the tooth to work up a quote. I went with the new dentist, and I have a temp crown while the new one is being built in a lab.

I'm very disappointed Creekview Dental does not guarantee their work. They do not stand behind their product. I was out of a lot of money, and I could not make myself pay who knows how much more for another crown that would not be guaranteed. 

These types of crowns made in-office do not seem to be very sturdy. My new crown is going to include metal; the old one was just some type of ceramic. The new dentist also said the old crown was not placed securely on the tooth.
Amazing food. Authentic Chicago. If Wrigley Field was next door it'd be perfect. The service was great as well

I'm a die-hard fan of KungFu Tea, but decided to stop by Mr Wish just to see what all the hype was about. BEST DECISION EVER. 

Their fruit tea with pulp selection is a such a nice breath of fresh air compared to the typical milk teas every other boba shop is stirring up. I tried the peach tea with pulp + boba and found it to be fresh, hydrating, and absolutely delicious. Knowing that their teas incorporate fresh fruit made me feel less guilty about indulging in another large cup of boba. Texture and taste of the pearls were also on point. Visiting Mr Wish was such a perfect way to end my weekend in Philly and I'm stoked to see that there's also a location in NYC.

P.S. To those looking for a nice casual study spot in the area, Mr Wish should definitely be on your list of places to check out. The place is brightly lit with outlets along the walls.

i like this place. i came here with some family and really enjoyed sunday brunch. they had a live jazz band that was absolutely rockin. the food was buffet style but they also had chefs preparing fresh omelets and anything else you wanted. the buffet food was good too. they kept it fresh and brought out new food throughout the entire brunch. service was decent.

Two things I like eating the most is Seafood and Mexican food.  Now when a place can make a bad ass fish burrito (they call it a fish taco for some unknown reason), i'm a true happy camper.  That's what they did here.  I had it blackened.  They use cod for this.  The rice was SPICY! no joke! but it was really good.  The black beans mixed with the salsa was spot on.  Well worth the $13.50.  The person who served it says they serve it a lot.  I don't doubt that for one second.  My wife had the grouper.  Grouper being one of my favorite fishes was delicious.  It was perfected breaded and was accompanied by an awesome lemon/wine sauce.  Get there before noon to beat the lunch crowd.

Ah, 666 - The Mark Of The Beast. A number so sinister that it has hellacious written all over it. When you reach this milestone on Yelp you clearly have to write about something that represents your idea of hell (or Johnny Brenda's if your Dave H. -1- but he's still the man). So it sounds like the perfect time to sum up exactly how I feel about Starbucks. And since I already spelled it out for you many moons over (http://www.yelp.com/list/i-hate-starbucks-philadelphia) you know exactly where this one is going.

My overall thoughts of Starbucks has nothing to do with service or product. I've had decent service in plenty, and in spots like the one that I'm dropping this review on (you'll go anywhere if certain people suggest it) I've had better than decent. And you can't go wrong with the diverse selections of beans that they bring in, assortment of Tazo teas, and delicious treats that they offer for the most part. Although a lot of the prices can be pretty damn horrendous (there's good reason why I affectionately call them Fourbucks). And they do provide a spacious decor that gives you plenty of room to get some work done if your in a bind (I like the upstairs that this one offers).

But in the land of lush and vibrant indie coffeehouses that is Philadelphia, Starbucks is pretty much the Soulless Empire. When you walk into a place like Chapterhouse that turns it's surroundings into an art gallery; a spot like Last Drop that's packed to the gills with good music, listings for local shows, and gratuitous people watching; or a spot like TBar that hooks up Scrabble and an amazing book exchange; the atmosphere brings you to life. But by comparison the atmosphere of Starbucks manages to suck the life right out of you. Every time I walk in and see the same typical looking art, the same cold plain decor, and total lack of vibrance, I can't help but feel like a corporate slave digging a hole towards a corporate grave no matter what I'm doing. If you ever hear the words "Grande soy latte two sugars" coming out of my mouth feel free to slay me.

But the main reason I hate Starbucks is because, just like rats in the city, they're freaking EVERYWHERE. If you walk down any major Philly street and see a Starbucks, and then it's more than likely that you'll come across another three blocks away, and then ANOTHER! It borders on the unnecessary, but rather than do something to lessen the amount (even when Starbucks announced the closing locations) it feels like their building more (http://www.yelp.com/biz/macys-philadelphia#hrid:6dm686CWJQrzhJAfGOcEwQ). Damn the Empire!

-1- Dave H. did review Johnny Brenda's as his 666. But it wasn't because he found it evil. It was because he didn't put the same significance into the number that I did. and after going to a good show he just felt that it was time to.
Thanks Herman for great dining experience.  Fried chicken with Mac and cheese and the wagyu steak perfect. Topped off with the peanut butter pie... am amazing!

I came here for dinner with a friend one weekday evening.  We were seated and had our drinks right away.  The weird part was when we asked our server what he would recommend, as neither of us had been there before.  
He kind of just started at us so I said "well what about the *insert dish here* or the "insert dish here*?"  For every dish we asked about, he made a face, said it wasn't very good, said it was bland or boring, etc etc.  
I appreciate honesty, but should you REALLY be telling customers that the food at the restaurant you work in sucks?

I ended up ordering the Kentucky sandwich, which was actually fairly good.  Great sangria too. 
We were both a little put off by our server's...candidness, should I say?

I can't fully understand why I put this place off for so long. As we came in the owners greeted us and explained the menu options. We ordered dippin' dots with cookie dough, funnel cake with powdered sugar, and double stuffed oreos with powdered sugar. Also we were given complementary mini donuts!! Everything is made fresh to order. They offer multiple toppings for whatever you choose, we're just plain people. Everything came out within minutes and was amazing!! The mini donuts are like nothing I've ever tried before, super light and fluffy almost like a donut and a funnel cake made a baby. They powdered some with powdered sugar and the others with cinnamon sugar. The funnel cake was perfect and golden, exactly what I was looking. Same with the double stuffed deep fried Oreos, golden perfection. Also the oreos come double stuffed with cookie dough or chocolate. I'm so happy I went today, the owners are great, the food was amazing and the ambiance is definitely retro!! Wish I could give more stars!

Really excited to see this restaurant join some of our other favorites in the 86th/Ditch corridor. We ordered the chicken makhanwala and palak paneer with regular naan. The portions were generous and we had plenty leftover to take home for lunch. We like spicy so we asked for it extra hot and it was just about right. The service was attentive. I really hope this place does well. I'm looking forward to trying some other dishes on subsequent visits.

Dinner and drinks on a rainy Monday at 6:0pm.  Started at the bar where I picked up 2 great cocktails.  A bit miffed by hostess telling me that even though I was drinking at the bar they couldn't hold my table for me in the completely empty restaurant.  Regardless, moved to the table for apps and dinner, all delish and delivered perfectly.  I would definitely recommend, but that "can't hold your table thing" left a (the only) bad taste of the night in my mouth.

Amazing company with great costumer service and all the toys to make being on the water fun.  Love their dedication to their members. They are so efficient at taking all the hassle out of getting out on the bay. Thanks Alex for being a first class man of your word.
Just tried the breakfast as the line at McDonalds was nuts. The breakfast fries were good an this sausage, egg an cheese biscuit was surprisingly good!!!!!

Where has the quality gone???
Here is $6 give me what you want because NO ONE LISTENS HERE!!

Every order has been wrong or slow for the past year!!

Absolutely awful store service!

Consistently clean and beautifully decorated for the holidays!   The signage is very well done.   Many restaurants to choose from.  The HVAC works well so that the myriad smells aren't overwhelming when walking by.   The employees are professional and appear to be happy to work there.  Always relaxing to look out the windows at the runways which seem very well planned and not over-crowded.

Hands down...This is the best place if you want BBQ and also have a vegetarian in your group! They have a great selection of beers on tap, fast service and a casual atmosphere. Right in the heart of downtown Palm Harbor, this place is  a gem!

I've tried numerous crab places and this one happens to be the most popular.  You order inside this small building which has seafood, crabs, and seasoning. Be aware that it's a little funky because of the seafood and its freezing inside.  The items to order either cooked or raw are written on brown paper and can be hard to decide on what to get with so many options.  Went for the snow crab tray and blue crabs with fixings. The food is made to order and took about 30 minutes to prepare.  I like the way the food is packed up for to go. The prices are a little high but for is good.

I went to a bar and grill and ordered coconut shrimp and mussels, I was shocked to see that they actually handmade the coconut shrimp, not the pre made stuff you would get at like a walmart, the pepper jam matched perfectly. 

The service was very good, our server saw we had spilled a little water on our table, we wiped it with a napkin and he walked to our table with his hand out ready to take the wet napkin to throw away! That's dedication that's true kindness, That's why I gave this review 5 stars!

The ambiance is awesome. It's half coffee bar, half bar with great vibes and lots of cool decor. We came mid week and happened to be happy hour, score! The food and drinks were amazing. We'll definitely be back next trip to Nashville!
THE. BEST. OYSTERS. Matt took good care of us today! Just ate 2 dozen by myself! Also took advantage of their drink specials. Their Sunday brunches are fire too!

Food was excellent...great location 

Service really fell down. The unfortunate thing was we watched every table around us get excellent service and attention. Being our first time here our server didn't explain anything or offer  recommendations. She did ask if we had questions then when we asked a question (catch of the day, explain an item, etc) she looked at us like it was crazy to ask then had to consult her book for the answer. We had to request water and dinner rolls (after we saw other tables receive them).  We also watched every table be offered a small key lime pie dessert but were not even asked if we wanted it. 

P.S. the beer selection was terrible for a "tap house."
Best BBQ shrimp I've ever had. I mean delicious, bread dunking, finger licking scrumptiousness. I want to take a bath in it. If you are in NOLA, go!!!!

Really enjoyed rasoi, definitely authentic and great service. Ordered the chicken korma, goat curry, and lamb xucati. Excellent garlic naan definitely a must try.  
The serving size could be larger but all good.

Clean place, seems t be relatively new.  Flew in for quick stay for the Grand Prix of st Pete.  Stayed a bit out of town for cheaper rate.  Saturday check in and stay was great.  Problem came about Sunday morning before the race.  Up for a shower about 6am....  no hot water.  What hotel runs out of hot water?  Called the front desk, said they were working on it.  Did what I could t shower in the cold.  We went down t front desk t see what the problem was.  The desk people took light of the situation, I asked for the manager.  6a, he wasn't there, we asked for his phone number...  they said they would make arrangements for him t be there after the race..  spent great day at race, stopped at hotel before dinner.  No manager, he said he would talk t us on Monday...  flight out at 6a Monday.....  we did get a business card with a number...  called once we got back t Indy.  Left message, asked for return call, nothing.  Called next day, finally found the manager in the office...  he said the issue was the hotel was crowded...  everyone showering at same time.  The parking lot was only half full, we sat at the breakfast bar for over an hour, bet there weren't 5 people total.  We are asking for a refund for that night of our stay.  No hot water is unacceptable and the manager avoiding us then lying about the situation is unforgivable.....  raddison corporate was supposed t have a resolution in 48 hours, it's been a week.  Only was the little guys can make things right is stick together.  Avoid staying at this hotel......

I came here today to see what all the hype was about. This place was incredibly cool. It is very educationally focused and a great little set up for children to get up close with the manatees and stringrays. 

Important information: they have free parking right next to the facility and also free parking in an overflow lot. They offer free shuttles from the overflow lot to the main facility, however there is also a beautiful, short and easy walking path from the overflow lot to the main site. I'd highly recommend walking it as it is flat, easy, yet beautiful and has a lovely view. There are also an overlook trail, allows you to walk about .7 miles off the main path to a tall overlook tower that allows you to climb to the top and get a grand birds eye view of everything. It's quite breathtaking and worth the extra time to experience it.

Once at the main facility, you can walk up a little ramp/set of stairs to go see the viewing bride of the manatees, which gather by the power plant during the winter to enjoy the warmer waters. There are also restrooms, photo opps, decoration, informative plaques everywhere and another little viewing bridge that you can walk down to take in all the scenery. 

There are a lot of little opportunities for children to learn about the manatees, nature in the area and gorgeous views for adults to take in the natural scenery. The trails are awesome, not too long but just long enough to make it worth your while. 

I'd highly recommend to anyone. Free parking, free educational facility, with all the workings.

It took 5 minutes before anyone appeared from the kitchen to take my order

While waiting 30 minutes for my pepperoni rolls, a man with a sunken dirty face, 6 missing teeth, scraggly clothes and stoned out of his mind, just waltzed to the back of the kitchen (where my food was) and disappeared for 10 minutes.
When he finally came out he was accompanied by the rest of the staff and they all looked to be high and were  talking as if they were all best friends

not going back if they let homeless drug addicts just walk in the kitchen

THAT is NO way to run a business! Completely disgusted!

What a find!  I'm so glad I watched Heat seekers before our NOLA trip and discovered this restaurant.  We made our meal off the appetizer section and were STUFFED.  Here's what we had:

Bad Bart's Black Jambalaya - Not at all hot by my standards but really wonderful flavor.  I love the black-eyed peas and the meat was very high quality and tasty.

Fried Mac N Cheese - OMG, so GOOD!  This was my favorite dish.  I LOVE the crispiness of the cheese.  It takes a traditional dish to a whole new level.  I'm definitely going to have to try to replicate it at home since I can't just pop down to NOLA anytime I want some Mac N Cheese

Two pies - We had the meat and seafood pies from the appetizer menu and they were really tasty.  The crust was flaky and tender and perfect.  The fillings were really flavorful.  

Framboise Float - I LOVE good beer and I also love when someone comes up with a clever way to use beer and that's definitely what this is.  The creamy sweetness of the cream cheese ice cream perfectly balanced with the sweet/tart fruitiness of the lambic.  I could see doing something similar with other lambics as well.  I think peach in particular would be GREAT in summer.  

Unfortunately, we were too stuffed to try their pizza or their sausage (other than what was in the jambalaya) and I really regret that.  This will definitely be on my must stop list for my next visit to NOLA.

We could not wait to move out.
After reading all the bad reviews I can totally agree with what some people had to say. Loved the place at first but the one thing that gets me is I can't believe we ended up paying $1,007 when they post this tiny apartment for $899. With utilities it was $960. Then we got a dog and my parents brought my two cats from home and nobody told me about the two pet limit. I didn't have them when I signed the lease but I told the office my animals would be coming later when I signed the lease papers but it still said no pet policy so I had no idea. Luckily Tony was the only reasonable person I could deal with. I ended up paying $400 for my animals and an extra 40 for rent. Bringing it to $1,007 after tax. 
I got to Tucson on Sunday, June 23rd, 2019. Signed the papers on the 24th as I had everything set up for when I got there. I went out of town for a week to see my husband in Missouri and when I got back I had a tow notice sticker on my car window. I was told the wrong parking spot and I told the office I was going out of town. Their response, "oh yeah that's why I only put the sticker halfway on the window so it wouldn't stick that bad" it took me like two weeks to get that shit off my window. Then a little bit after that I get a call from the office to come get my gift card. Had no idea what they were talking about but they ended up giving me a $500 amazon gift card for signing up at this time(idk)
Fast forward to later on me and my husband we're so cramped in this apartment we just wanted to see what the price would be to break the lease so we could look at renting houses. I was told it would be rent 899 times 2 and then add 500. I asked where the 500 came from and that gift card they gave me I would have to pay back it's like a bargain to stay on the lease... 
we had a few AC issues in the past and it took about 4 days to get someone to fix it and this was in Aug-Oct time. That was super annoying we almost stayed in a hotel it was 95° in the apartment.
-Fast forward to now and we are so excited to leave. We can't believe we pay this much for a tiny apartment plus due to Covid we can't even use the pool or gym if the office isn't open. We pay this much to not be able to night swim without a million kids or use the gym when I get off work at 7pm after working 12 hrs. The most recent headache was our 60 day notice. April 26th was the 60 days. We heard nothing from the office and we were looking at houses already. My husband calls and is like hello we're moving out soon what's going on, someone new in the office said oh since you're calling on May 7th you can't move out til July 7th instead of June 23rd. I said no lol no way I'm deploying soon this is annoying and we're moving out on time. So tony helps us out and gets it all worked out. I go to turn in the vacate paper and Monica looks so confused at me. She goes well you have to give this to us 60 days in advance I said yes I know but nobody called or told us anything so, she goes oh I have the copy we put on your door if you want to see it. I say sure. She searches for a few minutes and of course doesn't find anything because THEY NEVER GAVE ME ONE. So tired of this place. We get a tiny, run down looking place to pay $1,000 and it's not even an updated unit. Luckily we found a nice rental house and we're done with that place.
-update to now July 25th, 2020 
I'm deployed and we are FULLY moved out of this place but now they say we owe $363 for them cleaning the apartment when we went in to clean anyways but either way. My husband has called 5 times a day with no response to the actual amount we owe until just now. GLAD TO BE OUT OF THERE

Very odd interaction yesterday on the evening of May 26th. I was taking a picture of some beers (so my wife could pick the ones she wanted) and the clerk came out and confronted me about it. I told him what I was doing (he seemed to accept it) but also seemed somewhat aggravated by the whole thing. I don't know the going rate on "corporate secrets" from beer stores in Philadelphia but I'm sure it settles in the millions. 

Then, when I went up to pay for a six pack of Golden Monkey, I was rushed as if the clerk was in some kind of hurry. I'm the only one in the store by the way. Finally, he hands me the debit card reader, I input my card, and then HE SNATCHES the thing out of my hand into his booth, (with my card attached). More aggression than I expected from a trip to the corner store for beer. 

The clerk hands me my beer, card, receipt, mumbles something of a goodbye, and then goes back to (SPOILER ALERT!) watching TV. 

I leave a little pissed over the whole thing. 

Is it small stuff? Sure, I guess. But in the simple basic interaction of changing currency for goods, why even bother with the hassle of it when I can go somewhere else? I'm a local in Queens Village and there are a ton of other options in the neighborhood: New Wave Cafe, Lucky's Last Chance, For Pete's Sake. Most places, you can buy the beer, get a friendly smile, and walk home in five minutes. 

So that's what I'll be doing. Won't be going there again. And unless you like that kinda treatment, you probably shouldn't go there either.

All you can eat lobsters!
I come to Lake Tahoe for snow ski every year. I come to this place once or twice a year... 
This time is a little bit disappointed, they offer the lobsters without pincers. Some of them are not really fresh, the lobster meat just falls apart. 

Remember to get a player card, one player card is good for 2 adults. It will become $32.99 per person. The bill will be $71.xx with tax for 2 people.

If you are far away, it is not worth to drive all the way here.

Great atmosphere.  Food is quite good (the smoked corn soup is to die for) and often quite interesting - especially for Indy.  I had pasta with a wild boar meat sause - it was excellent.  Hubby had Osso Buco - also excellent.  The staff is knowledgeable and friendly.  We especially like eating in the bar.

UPDATE:  We just stopped by Meridian again now that the weather is nice.  We had a lovely dinner on the patio overlooking that green space at Westfield and Meridian.  It doesn't get much better.

This place hits it out of the park for me - inexpensive, high quality, healthy food, prepared really quickly, with a ton of vegetarian options. Bonus: it's really kid friendly. It's our go-to spot for a weekday dinner when we're really busy and don't have time or energy to cook. This particular location is my favorite, because there's always plenty of room and everyone who works there is really nice. 

Pros:
*Inexpensive
*Great tasting food
*Reasonably healthy options (depending on your choices)
*Fast
*Clean restaurant
*Friendly and thoughtful staff

Cons:
*I wish it was in my neighborhood so I didn't have to drive to get to it.
*But really, nothing else

Kid-friendly scale:
Off the hook. The people who work here seem to really enjoy having kids around and interacting with them. The food gets to your table really quickly - on our last visit, I barely had time to get the wrapper off my straw before the food showed up. The background noise level makes it okay for an occasional random louder-than-you-really-want outburst of preschooler energy, but is still low enough for conversation.

Vegetarian-friendly scale:
Also off the hook. My go-to used to be beans & three (black beans, with three sides) but I've switched to the black bean salad. Loads of protein, lots of variety, everything that 95% of restaurants in Nashville miss on their vegetarian options. If you're a vegetarian in Nashville and haven't been here, I don't know why.

Sooooooooooooo, ill admit the awful awful and fries is amazing and really fills you up, but the breakfast we had the next morning was horrible. The bacon was burnt and the French toast was basic, nothing fancy. Its tricky to find this place but once you do its kind sketchy looking. Its dowanstairs at the nugget by the bar. I would go here only for the burger
They have it ALL!  Could be cleaner though.  The employees seem apathetic, but I think that would be expected, LOL

This place deserves 0 stars there food  super oily taste less sopes are super small birria is not goat it's de res big fat pieces no meat never coming here again !!!! And it was 50 for that nasty food

I appreciate that Chick-fil-A like many restaurants has found ways to remain open, especially for the sake of the individuals that work there. That said I also think they should get a better handle on their new system. I ordered via the app and opted to pick up. Upon my arrival, I told 3 separate individuals about my mobile pick up order and was told to wait in their order line 3 times until a 4th individual asked me to pull out of their order line and park at the designated mobile pick up spot. 

Something told me to check my bag before leaving but after being stuck in the line I decided to just go home, big mistake. The large fry I ordered was literally only half full and the fries were cold as though they'd been sitting. They didn't give me any of the sauces I'd requested, or any sauce at all for that matter. And I realize that I potentially should have just braved the Trader Joes line. Think I'll hold off on going to Chick-Fil-A till they resume normal service.

After reading previous reviews I can only assume they were isolated incidents or otherwise grumpy people, because my first experience here was nothing short of awesome. There was a little mixup when I arrived for my appointment, as I had requested a specific waxer (my friend Amanda, who is amazing, and I highly recommend), but they got the mixup fixed right away and were able to accommodate my request.

The staff is nice and constantly making sure guests waiting are greeted and comfortable, offering beverages if needed. 

Amanda was amazing as anticipated. Ultra professional and thorough, and recommended the perfect after care products for me post Brazilian. Not to mention...my brows have never looked this good before and probably never will again! (Until next month anyway!) 

All in all, if your peach isn't naked...it should be. Looking forward to my next appointment!

Wonderful, established restaurant in the French Quarter, of Brennan Family fame.  Wonderful bar (GREAT martinis!), and delicious, dependable menu.  They are known for a number of dishes, namely their Gumbo, Barbecued Shrimp, and Shrimp and Grits.  I love their Shrimp and Grits, and get it every time I am there.  Their Duck Spring Rolls are about the best thing on the menu, and I just recently tried them.  Next time I visit, I will get two orders!  Their 1-1-1 appetizer consists of Pork Belly, Baked Oyster, and Fried Shrimp, and is a delicious way to sample several appetizers....all wonderful.  Service is snappy, but not pretentious.  RESERVATIONS STRONGLY RECOMMENDED!!

Worst warranty company ever. Over three weeks since my plumber recommended replacement of my hot water heater, still not even ordered from Sears Home Warranty. Customer service is non-existent. As soon as new hot water heater gets installed (if I don't lose my patience and buy a new one out of my own pocket first) I'll be dropping this warranty service to find a competent one. Stay away!!

My favorite restaurant in the entire world! I could literally eat everything that's on the menu, it's so freakin' good! We ordered:
The VooDoo rolls (a must to anyone that comes here)
Dozen of chargrilled oysters 
Swamp pasta w/ potato salad

Westbank location closes early on Sundays (cries), so it was a must to head towards Lakefront for this and of course, wasn't disappointed at all :) food, service, and atmosphere was excellent!

Authentic Mexican food!  The best we've had since moving to the East Coast from the southwest.  The free chips and salsa are fresh and delicious.  I had cabeza of beef tacos and chicharones with green salsa tacos.  Yum.

I have used the Dog Spot West since our dog was a puppy.  She has always loved going to daycare and I have NEVER received any poor feedback in the 7-8 months we brought her there.  

However, there is a new manager who came over from the East Nashville location who apparently runs a tight ship. We were told that our pup was "latching on" to other dogs and that he thought she played too rough. Ok, no problem - we get it.  Dogs are dogs and I'm sure she can play rough at times. We accepted the feedback and moved on. The following time we took her to daycare she was once again too playful for his liking and got asked to "take a break" from the Dog Spot. One of my close friends who owns a GSP had the exact same situation happen.  We were both loyal users of this facility!

If you have the perfect dog then take them here.  If your dog is playful, watch out because you might get kicked out!

I had high expectations for FFS and they exceeded them! I visited as part of my personal trainer's client night. We all got fitted for shoes by having 3D scans taken, having our gate evaluated and preferences discuss, even analyzing the shape of our feet and how the shoes we already had were wearing. Mind blown, truly. Our group went on a short "fun run," and by the time we came back, I had missed out on a run clinic I was really looking forward to. Lucky for me, Alex, who had already done the most amazing job finding me shoes, was more than happy to go through the clinic with me and he really gave me such wonderful information and not only taught me HOW to run better, but WHY that way was healthier for my joints and how it would improve my running experience. I was truly more impressed than I can articulate - excellent, excellent job.

This truck was conducting non-essential business outside Russel's Cafe on Macklind on Sunday March 29.  This is a violation of St. Louis City's Stay at Home orders.  Essential workers risk their health and the health of their families everyday during this pandemic and individuals such as the owner of Rudy's are disrespectful and contributing to Stay Home and Social Distancing orders needing to be extended.
The food is great...I highly recommend eating here...When I return to LA I'll be back.

this has been our go to chinese take out for years. we can usually order a feast for about $30! service is always nice and very quick. sometimes we order, then pop over to wawa and it is ready by the time we get back.

our usual picks:
general tsos shrimp - sooooo yummy
happy family - a nice variety of flavors and ingredients 
chicken and broccoli - a classic with lots of flavor and sauce 
hairy mexican sushi - our fave, tastes delish!
spicy tuna sushi - fresh and priced right
chinese pizza - delicious, crispy scallion pancake with awesome dipping sauce

i don't know why people are giving chows grief on here. i've been coming here pretty regularly for about 20 years and have had great service each time and good consistency with the food taste and value. we don't eat chinese take out any place else.

My girlfriend and I have been coming to India Sizzling for as long as we've been getting Indian food. The service is top notch, the staff is so friendly and of course, The food is incredible. I recommend it to anyone who enjoys Indian food!

Not sure where the good reviews are coming from. Had a horrible lunch: hair in one oyster and pieces of shell in almost all 12 we ordered, overpriced ($8 for a 8 oz beer), and slow, inattentive service. Went here to escape long lines at Acme and paid for it. Lesson: keep expectations low and proceed with caution when dining on Bourbon St.

A comfortable friendly place. The food is fast we'll priced and really tasty. Great for lunch on a Saturday.  It feels like they make everything on the spot.  I had the house pimento burger and that was the first time that I really enjoyed he texture of pimento cheese.  Easily the best burger I've had all year.  I bet they will be a contender for next years nashville scene's burger week.  This is worth the visit!
Skimpy on the meat most my sandwich was bread. Fur the price I would of expected more. Service was good friendly.

Stopped in for our first visit to Bar Hygge last night.  Very crowded inside and actually deceptively small when you look at it from the outside.  Scored some bar seats after about 20 minutes and had an excellent, very friendly bartender.  However, for a bar that claims to be Danish themed, there is absolutely nothing Danish about it.  No Danish food, beer or drinks anywhere to be seen.

I'm not a fan of the house brewed beers at Earth Bread and Brew, and that trend continues here.  Tom seems to like to brew non-standard, or at least not common styles, and the trend continues here.  They did have a Pale Ale (Fingerprint #1 - "a hop sensory pale ale experiment").  First, if I'm paying $6 or $7 it had better not be an experiment.  That's what a small test brewing system is for.  It was mediocre at best - thin, not a pleasant hop flavor, no aromas.  Luckily they do have some guest taps.

Ordered one of their "boards" - pickled shrimp, Spanish goat cheese and Brussels sprouts.  It's $18 for 3 items, and the serving size of the shrimp (about 5) and Brussels sprouts were decent, but for $6 we got 2 less than 1/8" thick slices of goat cheese.  Even if it was Humboldt Fog that was $0.50 worth of cheese at the most.  Overall the board food was really good.  The waffle wings were weird - VERY sweet - almost like something you'd get at a carnival (think corn dog with syrup and bones).  

Hopefully they do well and have a long run along Fairmount Ave, but it's probably not a place we'd go to again.

I'm going to give them 3 stars, because I understand the growing pains they are experiencing.  The food isn't bad and they try very hard with an inexperienced waiting staff. Management can turn this around.

These folks are great... !! I've lost track of the yards of mulch I've purchased from them, but they've always been friendly, curteous  and helpful. ( and I receive just what I've paid for..)I'm now going to start buying firewood from them, their prices are certainly competive. Two thumbs up from a satisfied customer !!

We used Upper Crust for catering this weekend and we will definitely be using them again. Their prices are good and the food tasted great. The delivery person was also super helpful with getting things setup and making sure we had everything we needed.

This place is always busy on the weekends. We don't go here a lot but I got a hankering for potato pancakes and corned beef hash so we went here last Sunday.

We went later, after the after church breakfast crowd, so we did not have to wait for a table. I think the key to not waiting is to go really early or really late.

I don't really like eggs so I went with the side of potato pancake and a side of corned beef hash. My hubs got the 2+2+2 breakfast and chose the potato pancake so I could have two (one to eat there and one to take home for the next day.) His eggs were done soft like he likes and like he requested, and his potatoes were well done, again like he likes and like he requested. Not many breakfast diners do his eggs and hash browns the way he likes them, even though he requests it like that every time so I have to give them props for that. They really listen. Also, the melon on the side was perfectly ripe.

The times we have come here I always look some of the omelette combos but I always end up getting potato pancakes. They do have a lot of varieties of dishes though so I think everyone would be able to find something good.

Great service and the food was delicious. I actually got the Blue Crab tray already cooked and chilled. The young man behind the cash register was very patient and friendly with me since this my first time going to the location.

The location is noticeable from the street but you have to park in the back. Follow for the signs being the building. There is no distinct parking lot but make sure you are not blocking any cars when you park. 

There is a nice small farmers market behind the building. 

The food was very good even when reheated in the oven.

I will definitely be back.
An epic local dive! Love the ambiance!  Had a hot sausage po boy with yam fries. Tasty!  Nothing fancy, but food is flavorful .

What a fucking joke. We went with our family booked for 10 No problems we can do that . Show up and are told only 6 in a booth and a 45-60 minute wait on top of the reservation. Whatever. Literally every other booth had 9-13 people and they never said anything to the other booths. The manager came over and was a complete asshole about it and never asked the other groups to leave. We were also there a week prior with 15 people with no issues

Beer. Comfort Food. Outdoors. Music. Cornhole. Welcome to the best backyard party. Bring the kids or bring your friends. This is a place to enjoy the Wilmington Riverfront at its best. Just know what you're getting into ... it's mostly outdoors so weather will play a role. Probably the best place in town to just relax and unwind.
It's been over an hour now and still have not received my food I live 1half mile away there's no excuse for this at 4.30 in the afternoon do I blame Grubhub or Three Brothers

Family owned and operated Alteration's Connection is the BEST Connection in town! I've been a repeat client since early 2000! Their work is top notch and affordable! If you need anything repaired you drop off and usually pick up the following Tuesday. I walked in yesterday needing a new zipper fixed for Street Vibes (today) the son comes out takes my top to the back and within 1 min says here you go Miss Pickett $10!  I wear this top every year and it makes me great tips! What great customer loyalty!!!!!!!! You guys rock!
This location in terrible! Severely understaffed.   Save yourself  time and frustration and use the airport location if you must use Hertz.

Great variety of food. 
Must visit for first time Philly fans!
Canolis are great!
Try Asian food too!

RACIST! RUDE! 

I decided to get a gel pedicure with two friends of mine for my birthday. We arrived and made an appointment for 3 pedicures. We were told we had to wait about an hour which was fine. We came back and the customer service was SEVERELY lacking. We were led to the back and only 2 bowls were filled with water. I sat around and waited until someone filled my bowl. It never happens. The attendant gives my two white friends towels and ignores me. I politely asked reminded the woman that I was receiving a gel pedicure, she goes and drops the nail colors on my lap. Ok? Its been 15 min and water is STILL NOT IN THE BOWL. Every other attendant sees that I'm in distress but I recieve no help. I ask the woman about the water again and she ignores me. After I am upset she blames my anger on me being "tired"... I end up NOT getting a pedicure. Not to mention spending $100 on a pedicure is not worth the bad attitudes and lackadaisical customer service. DO NOT ATTEND THIS SUB PAR SALON.

I am sorry to write a bad review for a local restaurant. In this area, we have way too many chain places.

Good: Nice atmosphere and great lounge. Our server was very friendly and knowledgeable of the menu. Also, the staff did an excellent job on keeping-up with the water and cocktails. The cocktails were a nice "pour," also. The all-black chairs, tables and linen gave the place a classy look. 

Not As Good: I was disappointed in the food. We ordered calamari as an appetizer; it looked and tasted like it came pre-breaded and just warmed at Catch 22. At our table we ordered salmon, ahi tuna and sea bass. We were underwhelmed with all our dishes. The tuna and sea bass appeared to be lovely pieces of fish, but came-out room temperature and quite bland tasting. The salmon was thin and was "chewy." The fish tasted like something you might end-up-with trying to cook at home yourself. The worst part was our bill was $70.

I wanted the food to be better and a felt bad not liking a local place. I just couldn't recommend anyone go.

DO NOT GO HERE. This place is terrible. I am a waitress and never complain about anything. Food came out and we had no silverware. How can you eat French toast with hands? Went to the bar to ask for some and they couldn't find any. Waited 15 mins for a fork and food was cold when I finally got one. Poor waitress was new and had 10 tables. Didn't get my money's worth for bottomless mimosas. THIS PLACE IS A JOKE.

Some of the best brisket I've ever had. The sides are very clearly made on site and are delectable. The cornbread is sweet. The sauces varying in flavor and style. Can't recommend this place any more. I've now had it twice, and were it closer to my house I'd have it way more often. 

Update: the brisket has really taken a dive as of late.

Dee Dee is amazing! My she and her products have been so important in helping with my teen's face. Dee Dee is great at not only the work she does but the way she educates- She really does care and takes the time to explain what's going on and how to care for your skin at home. The products are not cheap but I have to say, they actually work. I highly recommend!!!
Wonderful customer service and delicious ribs:)I think this is such a great place to chill .

I want to give Rione a good rating because the concept and quality are a much-needed addition in the area. However, when you order four slices (for $15) and only three are found in the box upon returning home, it makes it difficult to rate. I'm willing to give them a second chance, but will certainly check the box before leaving the store!

An Italian restaurant where I felt like we had to beg for bread.  I ordered spaghetti bolognese and got spaghetti with a couple of meatballs.  The meatballs were terrible however, the homemade spaghetti and sauce were decent.  If you go, don't go on a hot day- air conditioning was either not working or completely inefficient.  Could have been offset with a couple of cocktails but service was terrible and server never checked in on us after we ordered.

Our $240 bill was not worth it.  There are some really great restaurants in Doylestown...don't pick this one.

I ordered curbside pickup from Twisted tree and I was so impressed! After months of fast-food style carry out I was more than ready for something nicer and Twisted Tree was impressively able to keep high quality food from their restaurant at the same standard at my kitchen table.  Curbside pickup was extremely fast and easy.  We ordered a medium rare tenderloin steak, sides, salad, and scallop entree. We enjoyed our nicely packaged salads then warmed up both dishes (also expertly packaged for take-home) in the microwave for a minute each. They were perfect! Not over cooked, delicious, and tender. If I could give more than 5 stars I would!

After a pretty unpleasant experience with another Rittenhouse vet, I knew I needed to get my spoiled pup to the experts ASAP. World of Animals has been nothing but incredibly pleasant and overall GREAT at their jobs. Dr. MacMahon sees my dog, and she is the kind of vet that you dream of - she greets Leo by name, she says hi to him around the neighborhood, and she is thoughtful, kind, and thorough. Even though I can be a bit of a helicopter dog mom, she treats me with nothing but patience. Every time I see her, I'm more impressed and love the team even more. Huge thanks to the WOA team for taking sure good care of both of us!

This review is for the outstanding service department. Took my car in for a service, and, as usual they did a great job. As soon as I got out of the car someone came out from the service area to greet me, and we went inside where they had all the paperwork ready with estimates and everything. I couldn't find the coupon they had sent out for a big discount on the service, but they gave me the lower price anyway. That's how you keep customers happy!  

As usual the work was top notch. They took care of everything and ordered in the one part they didn't have in stock, for which I'll take the car in this weekend for them to finish off one last minor thing. Even before that the car runs great--much better than before--and they even washed it, inside and out, free of charge. Awesome service all around. 

Some other car dealers in the area could learn a thing or two from these folks--they know how to treat customers.

The cheese Valley Shepherd Creamery makes is great, the bread they use is good, and the flavor combos are on-point, however my 8.50 'Melter Skelter' was far less than the sum of its parts.  The bread was scorched at the edges-- Raclette doesn't go well with Kingsford.  Bituminous-ness aside the sandwich was way out of balance--unremittingly salty and sharp.  With 4X the watercress this could have been killer, but as is it's more Hanson than Mansen.   

The Cheese these guys make is awesome, especially the Morbier.  I've never had a better domestic version.  They sell real Buttermilk and good quality cultured butter.  I totally support VSC's mission and want to see them succeed.  Towards that end, here are a few pointers- 

Their signature product -fresh mozzarella- is unfortunately not tender enough to compete with Claudios.  Guys, I know Mozzarella is tough, but it shouldn't actually BE tough.  Figure it out.  ;)

Although VSC's stand has a SICK selection of obscure European olives and oil-preserved items, many of them seem to be a bit old.  The pepper shooters -when they're fresh- are among the best I've ever had, and are priced reasonably.  This is saying a lot in pepper shooter city U.S.A.  

One last thing-  the guy ringing people up and the guy doing the cheese Q&A with each and every Texarkansan tourist should be two different guys-- the system as it stands makes the wait irritatingly long for anyone who actually knows what they want.  I do most of my shopping at RTM but won't stop here to get olives, butter, buttermilk, cheese etc. unless there's no one in the cheese line.
Authentic Spanish! Best Spanish restaurant in Louisiana! I love all the Tapas. I ordered the crabmeat, garlic shrimp and mussels.  I paired it with the red Sangria.

Joey Rose is the best stylist I have ever had.  He's so welcoming and down to earth and extremely talented.  I have moved around alot in the last 5 years and it had been a long time since I had a hairdresser who I could trust completely.  I sincerely feel like Joey thinks about you, your personal style and comfort level before even touching the scissors.  I would recommend anyone who is ready for something new to see Joey.  It's so great to be able to trust someone completely who knows what they are doing!

Prices here are super affordable, so buying on trend items that might go out of style sooner or later don't hurt the wallet as much as some other places. This store is a bit crowded when it comes to how they've laid out racks for shopping, but they recently had a great sale with tons of stuff 50% off so it was well worth digging through all the options. 

The sales associates weren't super helpful here, nor super friendly, but I got a very comfortable skirt & some jean shorts that do wonders for my butt all for $15. I would've bought more if my boyfriend wasn't with me; he's not the biggest fan of shopping so I didn't want to drive him nuts by trying on everything. But there's a great selection here, so take time to check it all out.

Sizes do stop at a large here, so not very inclusive, but a lot of the items do have some give to them, so I was able to wear both smalls & mediums. I'm a size 6/8 for reference. 

Interesting return policy, so read it carefully and only buy if you're certain you'll wear it. Most items either can't be returned at all, or only be returned for store credit.
The food was yummy! Ate sev Puri, bhel Puri amongst other things

We found ourselves a place for breakfast. We went there on a Thursday at 8AM and it was almost full already. The food was delicious and the service was great. The restaurant had a family feel to it perfect for a breakfast/brunch place.

I love Macaroni Grill. I'd pick it over Olive Garden every single time. Yeah, it's a chain, and there are some drawbacks to that. But I am hopelessly hooked on their roasted vegetables that come as a side with the entrees. Plus, they are always kind enough to accommodate me by subbing my pasta side with more vegetables, since I don't do pasta.

Cosy place for a girls' night out.  Love the names of their dishes - very fun and creative!

Favorites:
*  Date with a Pig:  bacon wrapped dates 
*  I Like Pig Butts:  habanero-infused pulled pork sliders
*  Lamb Pops: lamb chops with teriyaki and honey

Mixed reviews:
*  I liked the whipped cauliflower but my friends felt it didn't have enough flavor to it (like cheese), especially in comparison to the savory dishes listed above

Drinks: Paper Plane and Blueberry Lemon Drop were delicious

We went for Mother's Day this year and this place is awesome!!! They had a belly dancer there and my kids loved her!!!! It was quite a surprise but very entertaining. The belly dancer was very nice to my 6 year old daughter and let her try her finger symbols and helped her balance a sword on her head!!!! Great time!!!

TIP: Normal days the belly dancer is there are Fridays and Saturday's!!!

They were great when I first started going there (when they initially opened) and have seriously gone down hill. The girls at the front desk were so rude. The one was even paying more attention to her boyfriend than the other customers and myself as we were trying to check in and ask questions. The waxer was popping her bubble gum in my face and looked like a total slob. She also screwed up my eyebrows so bad that I have some serious growing in to do. I'll never go back to this EWC.

Cute Blue Spot! Food was Good & FAST! Sauce was really good. Wings were hot and delicious. We tried the Sweet heat and spicy hot. The French fries were good as well. Glad we made the stop. We will be back again.

Love this place !  In fact, I will be there today to watch football games.  This is exactly what Nashville needs. A high-end amazing sports bar, with a really cool vibe.  The staff is awesome and the managers are really attentive and help out in any way possible.  I am so excited this place is in Nashville. Five star venue and five star service

I love Sushi Garden for their lunch buffet. Everything is clean, classy, and fresh. 

The environment is chic and a hot spot for business meetings, dates, families and solo outings. There is a large sushi bar lit up naturally from the many windows. 

There is parking in the back with entrances from country Club and Broadway. 

Although I have yet to order from the main menu I think Sushi Garden earned four stars for having a buffet that I keep coming back to. I have been to buffets with more options but the options that are offered here are well done. Bravo.
They didn't ring up our order and no one bothered to check on us, so we didn't get to eat. All we got was a half-a**ed apology. Pretty awful service.

Overpriced meh food, couldn't even finish the chicken breast, it had no flavor.  Clam chowder was ok. The calamari was good and my husband like the cioppino.

You're better off bringing your own meal to go and eating by the benches beside this restaurant where you have access to the same beach.

I was helped by a girl named "Candy" she was rude and incompetent. I think I was bothering her by asking her to help me get a donut so I could leave. She was totally overwhelmed by doing her job. It wasn't like there were a lot of people in the place. I was the only one. I will never go back.

My family's favorite restaurant!! Dine-in is amazing, but we have used curbside pick-up numerous times now since Covid, and let me tell you... they have it ON POINT!!! Order has been correct every time and ready in a timely manner. Get the Buffalo Mac or Buffalo Pizza, you won't be disappointed!!!!!!

I called reno renovators to get an estimate on a kitchen remodel. The sent a guy out to look at what I needed to have done as far as the remodel, he took measurements took pics and we discussed what I wanted done. 2 1/2 weeks I never received a quote on the job, no phone call nothing. If RENO RENOVATORS where not interested in the job they at least could have given me a call to let me know they where not interested! It cost me valuable time waiting for an estimate that was never coming and very disrespectful to me to just leave me hanging. I am assuming the job wasn't big enough for them and they didn't figure I at least deserved a call to let me know that. I would not recommend RENO RENAVATORS to anyone looking to do any kind of remodel of their home, don't waste your time it's obvious they didn't want to waste their time. One star is way to much for this company trust me!
The Christy is my favorite item on the menu!! Birthday dessert wouldn't be complete without Ted Drewes!

Food was wonderful. Service was outstanding. I ordered a petite filet mignon medium rare with béarnaise sauce and it was cooked perfectly. Dessert was to die for- we got the black bottom pecan pie and I could've eaten 5 more pieces it was so good. Men are required to wear their jackets the whole time just fyi 

Long story short- AMAZING food. order the filet and don't skip dessert!!

Overrated.  I thought oh gee "oldest barber shop in NJ " and had high expectations but i was not impressed.  My one and only experience here was nothing special and quite ordinary.  I was expecting them to be at least better than my moms haircuts but was frankly let down.

It's good for the price I guess.  

For comparison Michael allen fine barber(kings highway) is a better quality haircut (but it's also $25 bucks).  I'd say this is on par with Unique barbershop. 

Short version:  average at best

I've been eating here since I was young (almost twenty years now)   The food tastes delicious each and every time. Dining In is always nice and never over crowded.  Delivery always comes fast and is fresh and hot.  It my choice for Chinese in Mayfair.

The food is meh, have had way better Mexican food and the prices are way too high for that quality. The one I went to, the cashier seemed to hate her job or was in a particular bad mood. We ordered the queso and she never told us that they didn't have queso. Then I ordered sour cream on the side and the chef was never told so he seemed frazzled too when I asked him. The chicken was dry and didn't have much seasoning. Needless to say, that money is better spent elsewhere.

I've been on this quest lately to eat lite and have been mostly eating soups and salads for lunch.  I've been pretty consistent, but I need to develop an exercise regimen to reap the full benefits of my efforts.  The good news is that I'm biking two or three times a week in approximately twenty mile intervals.  The bad news, well not so bad or else I'd stop, is that the bike rides or more of a social gathering and less of an aerobic exercise.

So as not to jeopardize any good I may have accomplished in my quest to eat lite,  and to capitalize on continuing some friendships, I had lunch at Neyow's Creole Café with a couple of friends.  I had the a traditional chef salad with strips of ham, turkey breast, cheese, boiled eggs, creole tomatoes, and olives with bleu cheese dressing.  My friends each had red beans and rice.  One of my friends had a side order of fried pork chops and the other had a blackened catfish filet.  The chef salad was perfect as a midday meal, such that I wasn't overstuffed and able to return to productive desk duties afterwards.  Both of my friends enjoyed their lunches,  though I felt that the red beans were a bit to creamy, and one of my friends asked for a spoon.  My friend that had the blackened catfish filet, devoured it.  My other friend that had the fried pork chops, could only manage to eat just one because they were quite large, and he had to get a doggie box for the second pork chop.

The food was great and so was the service, but what didn't go unnoticed was the ambience.  We were seated in an anteroom along the the side of the building on Jefferson Davis Parkway.  The tables were situated far enough from each other so as not to to interfere in the conversations for each table.  The outer wall had clear plexiglass windows that allowed the benefit of natural light, but were closed because it was a chilly day outside.

Really love what they have done with the St Pete Pier and this place definitely adds to the coolness overall. Spacious and brightly lit digs, the restaurant has a nice area to stand outside and admire the view of the water and the main Pier structure. Parking was surprisingly easy to find, which was a bonus. But the food was the real standout as was the service - both were excellent! The menu has a nice variety of seafood dishes and non seafood such as burgers and taco entrees, so there's something for everyone. Everything was reasonably priced too. Nice selection of local beers and fancy pants drinks if that's your thing. Great place to have a nice relaxing dinner (almost) on the water! Will definitely be back again!
Great sea food.  At a reasonable price. My wife and I really enjoy the food and the atmosphere at this restuarant.

This place is great for breakfast. You can't go wrong with a latte and a blueberry loaf. Even their regular coffee is delicious. It  is often busy but the line moves quickly and the staff is very friendly.  Plenty of seating and the decor is cute and not crowded.
