Easy to park and close by other places so it's a great stop if you need to run other errands.
Amazing food, great service. I got the top thing on the vegetarian option was fantastic. The vegetarian appetizers for 2 was really good. The chef nann bread was amazing.

Rigazzi's is .... fine. 

Went  for happy hour and those fishbowl size beers. Good value, I guess. 

Had some apps and they were all traditional STL Italian - fried and cheesy. Nothing I get cravings for after and need to go back for.
I love the bagel market cafe. The bagels are always fresh and the donuts are good too! The turkey supreme bagel is my favorite. Everyone is very nice and service is great!

Went here for dinner with the wife and it was fantastic. 

To start its BYOB, so there's that. The service was also spot on throughout the meal. 

We got the trio of dips as an appetizer and they were great.  Great way to start the meal. 

For dinner we had the beef cheeks and lamb stew. Off the charts. The wife and I were both blown away by the taste and everything was cooked to perfection. 

For dessert we had the salted caramel tort with ginger ice cream which was the perfect way to end the meal. 

This was one of those meals where everything just comes together for a perfect dining experience. I highly recommend Kanella.

I write yelp reviews on two occasions. You either disgust me with your customer service or you blow me away. Here at yogurt beach, they get five stars! The employees are so friendly! They offer samples, greet you upon entry and are just genuinely friendly. My favorite is the good old vanilla custard with rainbow sprinkles. Always excellent!
Simply the best Mexican Restaurant in Reno.  Great Food, Great Drinks, Great Service, and VERY friendly!

Bruh. I went to Nashville with 6 close friends from high school and this is the first place we went to go eat at. Being adventurous and trying to challenge myself, I ordered the 2nd to the hottest flavor of chicken. I can usually take on spicy without a problem but...yo when I took a bite of this chicken my mouth was on fire and my stomach was hurting midway through as I was digesting this chicken. I ordered 2 pieces, and after finishing the first one, I packed the other one to go and just ate potato salad and cole slaw to cool my mouth down. However, it was a good experience!!! I'd say if you are out there in Nashville, you have to go try it. Oh, also we went on a Thursday night and it was STILL crowded. This place had a line outside the door and we also were strugglin out there to find parking lol. #GoodFood #AlmostDiedTho
I tried this buffet once the first time I came to reno it was terrible!!! No stars! But we tried it again and it was not half bad. They made some improvements I guess in the last few years.

Great Music & Bloody Mary's!!!!

Service was friendly & helped with all your needs.

Unfortunately the Live Music stopped around 2:00pm.

The next time, we get there a little earlier.

Went here tonight for the first time with a friend. We were in the area and decided to go to a restaurant on Restaurant Row. I had been craving BBQ for a while but wasnt too optimistic with finding any good BBQ in DE. Decided to give this place a chance. It was a great decision. There was a small wait when we arrived but that was expected as the parking lot was PACKED. We were told 10-15 minutes but it ended up being less. The host was polite and friendly and so was our waiter. We didnt get the free chips like everyone here says they got but I guess thats ok. The waiter also didnt explain the sauces to us but I have taste buds so I figured that out on my own. However, the food was DELICIOUS!! I had the brisket and my friend had cod and we both left full and happy. I also order a "to go" platter for hubby. The ribs and meat platter. Opted for the pulled pork and the baked beans and the corn on the cob. He LOVED it. Its not the best BBQ in the world but its really good food!

There are now 4 legit hotpot places in Tampa Bay.  3 of the places are like Yum Yum and have a conveyor belt.  

The sauce bar is limited, and not many salad items to choose from.
Customers really like it here because they have AUCE ice cream sandwiches and Klondike bars instead of scoop ice cream.  It is way more sanitary with pre-wrapped ice cream treats than the knuckle-dragged ice cream troughs.
The seafood was just alright (a little iffy and uncovered), but the lean sliced beef is the best.
If you are into lamb, that is the most traditional style meat with the mala broth and napa cabbage dipped in chili oil sauce.  I only order the spicy broth, because it has the most flavor.

To me, not worth driving from St Petersburg to come here again.  There is a similar hotpot much closer to my home.

This is a piece of history. Great food and very old school steak house. Huge wine selection. Be sure to do the tour after dinner and check out the dessert room. Then go across the street to the Epicurean and check out the rooftop bar.
Was a great place to rent a car prices were very reasonable and the cars were up to date and clean I love this place great job on saling me.

Very good pizza, as the name implies you can order by the slice and order virtually anything of the menu by the slice.  Traditional style pizzas to the exotic gourment types, but pizza isn't the only thing on the menu. I had a side ceasar that was less than spectacular but again I didn't go there for the salad. Wait staff was efficient and I think the prices are reasonable. I would still put New York Pizza and The Pizza Man in front of them.

My boy Lawrence and I have this thing we do where we always show each other whenever we discover a place that makes a really good burger. One day I took him to a bar near where I live, telling him the burgers were the bomb diggity. (I'm writing this review from the past, by the way. It's 1996 and it's still cool to say things like "the bomb diggity")

He said the burger was good, but he found a place that was dope as hell, and they made burgers that made this burger look wiggity wack by comparison. He brought me to Lucky's and I had the Mac and cheese burger. I looked him in the eye and said, "This burger sucks.... NOT!" and we put on our Charlotte Hornets Starter jackets and went home. I've since brought family and friends to share in the glory of their wonderful burgers and dogs whenever possible.

The Good Ol' Dog is the single best hotdog I've ever had in my life. At first, I thought a hotdog would never be worth more than like five bucks tops, but that was before I tried Lucky's. Spend the money, get the dog. Holy Jesus. Banger.
if you want good cooking come here also had a great time with my hubby svc was great service was excellent

First time at this restaurant, and probably won't be the last!  We tried the Thai side of the menu this time - hubby got the pad thai plus tom yum soup.  I got the drunken noodle with chicken.  
The food was good -- I'm not a huge thai fan b/c I do not like sweetened curries or main dishes, thus I usually stick with noodles.  These were very good -- wide noodles, perfectly coated with chicken/basil/onion/pepper stir fry -- about the same as I've had at another local Thai place (Noodi), and portion is decent.  Pad thai was also tasty.  The soup had a decent broth with a pleasantly spicy, sour taste that I would expect of tom yum, but was not a stand out.

Service was okay but felt a bit aloof and uncaring (no smile, no 'Hi how are you" or "welcome" or "thanks for coming")  -- maybe b/c there were only 2 waiters to serve the entire restaurant, which was fairlly busy on the Thurs night we visited. 

Prices are a couple bucks higher than our other neighborhood Indian and Thai, but I had a "Living Social" deal, and hope to get another one so I can try the Indian.

Atmosphere is dark, but not unpleasant.  Byob, always a plus.

Overall I'd return here -- with a groupon or living social!

Avoid this place like the plague, poor customer service I had purchased a tire in November and not even 1000 miles on the tire and got a flat. Called the tire store to inquire about the warranty they said it was not covered. Even though the tire was new. And he said that brand was known to have problems and had seen tires get after a week of installation. But their was no mention at the time of purchase.

This is my new go to when dealing with car issues. The staff was great and honest (dealing with auto places, honesty seems to be a trait people are lacking). They're quick and efficient and their pricing is affordable. They will also offer you options that won't destroy your wallet. Also , waiting room has netflix with comfortable seating! Just another plus!

Clearly I'm in the minority here, but Corvid's has just been an OK experience for me. Maybe I need to try brunch, since that's where all the 4 and 5 stars seem to be coming from? I've gone twice for lunch with co-workers and while the food has been good, it takes forever to come out, and it's never crowded. The staff has zero sense of urgency, which drives me insane. 

On our first visit I had the grilled cheese, which was fine but nothing to write home about. Most recently I had the chicken salad on a pretzel croissant, which was very good, but I felt like the flavor of the pretzel over powered the chicken salad. 

I think this would be the perfect neighborhood spot to come in with your laptop to get some work done, or on an afternoon where you were in no rush to be anywhere. But on an hour lunch break it just makes me anxious because I feel like I have to rush though my food to get back on time.

Here is the email I just received when I inquired about adopting one of the dogs on pet finder: 

"We are very sorry but it is necessary that we do adoptions in our local Main Line community.  Thank you sincerely for your interest."
 

I am very disappointed that dogs will continue to live in a cage without a family to love them because the owner has some kind of prejudice against non-mainliners.

came here 20 minutes before closing and there was a huge line! but it moved fast. very good ice cream though I wish I tried the dark chocolate which I would have liked better. besides that though very delicious ice cream and a cute place :) we enjoyed it. definitely a stop to make after dinner when in Nashville!

My friend and I got the Nutella and cookies and cream cannolis. Normally I'm partial to the original favor with mini chocolate chips in it, but we decided to try something different. The shells taste fresh and they have a variety of extra options for them such as dipped chocolate and pistachios, and the employees hand fill them in front of you. I'd give them a solid 8/10, as the filling was flavorful but not overpowering, and they were a good size. The filling was a little thinner than I'm used to, but overall not a bad place to stop for a quick treat.

As others have said this isn't the biggest Home Depot but def the best home improvement store in the area.

We have been shopping for a new front door and storm door and visited the Clifton Heights Home Depot and the Havertown Lowes and this Home Depot. This location is hands down the best out of the three.

The people that work here are very friendly and helpful and answered a ton of our questions and were upfront and realistic about price and didn't make me feel stupid asking questions.  Also the sales reps have taken time to talk to us and find out what we need and offer suggestions. Also they actually know what they are talking about here, at Lowes they just tell you what you want to hear. At the Clifton Heights Home Depot people that work there act like they are doing you a favor by answering your questions.

We will becoming here from now on.

I came here with my friends the other day. It was super tasty, and the place was huge. They have an extensive menu, and all of us were very satisfied with our meals. The portions were huge, and the prices were very affordable. I had the arroz con pollo and really enjoyed the rich flavors. I also went home with lots of tasty baked goods. The guava and cheese pastries were fresh and filled with guava goodness. The wine cake had a nice caramelized flavor and tasty wine-soaked figs. There was this large shortbread ball coated in dulce de leche and covered in coconut which was good flavor-wise but very dry. I would definitely recommend checking it out if you're in the area. The baked goods case is not to be missed!

Very bad service. Couldn't get my order right. Called in ahead and had to reorder at restaurant and wait 15 minutes. Also they couldn't even get the order right and forgot my sides. Very unhappy with this location.

Received a call from this company stating they can frame the article that was printed in the paper and we could review it.  When the product came to our business it was so poorly done that not even our company was spelled correctly.  Emailed the individual and told them I wanted to send it back.  They never sent me the label and the next thing you know they sent us to collection for $212.00 for the item that was worthless.  Refuse to pay for it especially because I have in writing to them that I did not want the item.  Stay away from this company!
I enjoy Irish 31's consistency in good service and cold beer. Their Irish 31 draft is my favorite and you can't beat the price! Devon, Jen and Molly are the best!!!

I went here with 3 coworkers that are from Pakistan.  I got to say this place is really good.  The food was great and exotic.  Previously I had tries a Pakistani place and the food was very similar to Indian.  This place was definitely not that.

We had curry goat, some spiced fry chicken, a chicken pea dish, beef kabob and some bread.

The curry goat, chicken and bread were the best.  I'll definitely have to go back and try some of their other dishes.

I do agree with some of the reviewers that the service is a bit slow, but it is on par with the slow service I keep getting around Philly.  The food was worth it though.

I find this place overpriced and snotty - which wouldn't bother me if the service or treatments were worth it.  Sadly, they are not.  Need your nails done?  Go across the street and pay $16 at Beautiful Nails.

I really like Tin Angel, they have a great variety on their menu and all the dishes I have tried were unique and well-prepared. I like the ambiance and the service has been good. If you do not like valet service you will have a hard time parking though.

Let's be honest - when you opt to eat at a diner, you know it won't be haute cuisine. And oftentimes, diner food doesn't even rise to the level of mediocrity. That said, Café Manhattan's fare is above average. We returned for a second visit to this 50's-inspired diner because the food was tasty the first time. 

The décor is pretty much what you would expect - lots (& lots) of Elvis pictures, album covers and tchotchkes, as well as Coca-Cola memorabilia and a jukebox. Soda fountain complete with stools and Formica-topped dinette tables & booth seating. 
The seasoned beef sandwich (French dip) is served on toasted garlic bread with a side of au jus. Plenty of meat and very, very good. The fish (cod) sandwich came on a Kaiser roll, and again, was good - not great, but good. For the non-carnivore in our party, the Liberty Melt was a hit. Melted white cheddar cheese, with sliced tomatoes, avocado and alfalfa sprouts between toasted whole wheat bread. Hit the spot! Very good.

The place was fairly busy, and while we were there, a number of people came in to pick up pizzas to-go, or to enjoy an ice cream cone. Our server was very friendly, and the service was prompt.

Cute little place with decent food. I would recommend.

Not very happy with the services they provide, I wasn't relaxed, no skelp massage, water in my eyes while she washed my hair and she left conditioner in my hair that I had to tell her about. When she brushed me out it was still tangled that was from the awful shampoo and conditioner job. Haircut was rushed and blowout was fine but it should be a relaxing experience that I did not receive. Location is close to my house however I won't be returning.

This review is strictly being written about the manager (Jason) at this location and his behavior when I found bed bugs in my room. He confirmed them himself when I took him to my room with two maintenance workers and they all saw one dead bug I had killed and one live bed bug crawling on the sheet. He refused to take my items to have them treated. When I called the Hilton Honors line, they connected me with another woman at the hotel who stated my items would be removed from the room and treated and would be ready for me to pick up after work. When I arrived after work, the manager (Jason) stated none of that was done because he was not told it needed to be. He told me all my items were left in my room (with the bed bugs) and I needed to go retrieve them myself so I can check into another hotel. Went to my room, none of my belongings were there. I went back down to the hotel lobby and advised them my stuff was not in the room. Took them 20 mins to find my stuff. They had removed all my belongings, did not treat them, and placed them in the SAME bag (shoes, tooth brush, hair brush, clothes) everything I owned was in one big bag, along with the items sitting on the bed with the bed bugs. I told the manager that I didn't feel comfortable with taking my items because I was afraid they might have bugs on them. He told me "I can give you quarters and you can wash your clothes if that's what you want". So he wanted me to use the public washer and dryer that other guests use to kill bed bugs... Doesn't seem sanitary to me. I moved hotels, the Hilton Garden Inn was expecting me and after hearing the story this manager put me through, offered to take care of my belongings for me at no charge. Honestly, I think the manager at this location is not fit for his job. Customer service was horrible. He had no remorse for what happened. He fought me on everything I asked him to help me with. I would never stay at this location again.

My wife and 2 daughters had dinner here. We were greeted quickly and everyone was friendly. The place is still very clean which it should be, its brand new location.

We look at the menu and both thought the prices were good and when the food came out the portions look fair. 
My wife and I both agreed the burgers were a bit on the to greasy side but the fries were good!! Both girls inhaled there grilled cheese so I asume they were good. We did like what we saw with others around us who order salads so we will be back to try the salad or the chicken sandwiches.  Not sure about the burgers again tho.

Some of the best schnitzel I've ever had. A very unassuming place, the owners are very friendly, and the beer was amazing. We ordered the Apple strudel for dessert, it was okay nothing great but we would definitely go back if only for the schnitzel.

I wish I could give this place a zero star review.
The person who had taken my order was rude.  The pizza was terrible and hour and a half for delivery.  Next time I will go hungry yuck pizza sucks terrible quality.

I went here for lunch with an adult and a toddler. Seating was quickly done. Nice lighting and background music. I had a seafood gumbo cup and a crab cake burger. The food was great. There's so much more items on the menu I'll like to try next time! I will recommend!

If I could give 0, I would. I saw the newest low in Customer service and in human treatment today. I spent over a thousand dollars on boots in this store in one day. Was told by their rep I have 10 days to return a pair. Brought my 525$ never worn boots on day 8 and got rejected. Came back the next day and got the rudest treatment from the owner's wife who threatened to call a police ... for wanting to return a pair of boots?! Still in shock... stay away from this place for your own sake. Nordstrom carries same brands for same price and hassle free returns.

Can I put 6 stars? If you have a sweet tooth, this is the spot! Everything from chocolate covered Oreos to pralines in every flavor! They also have ice cream in a multitude of flavors. Go in there, splurge, and get a sugar quenching from Heaven!

Great meal, terrible service.

This review is really difficult to write because the dichotomy between the meal and service was immense. After being seated early (6pm) among 3-5 occupied tables, my wife and I anticipated service would be a breeze, as the restaurant was nearly empty. We perused the drink menu for about 10 minutes before our server made his first greeting. We ordered drinks, hoping the delayed greeting wasn't a sign of things to come. My wife ordered a Collins and received an awkward joke in the form of an impression of her voice by the server. We ordered bone marrow for a first course (which we were excited about) and entrees. Shortly after, we received entrees from a runner with no mention of the first course. Puzzled, we informed the runner we never received our first course. The original server came to the table and explained that the error was "[due to his] charging us for a second beer instead of the bone marrow." After we made understandably confused expressions he, finally sensing disaster, made an a sudden and unapologetic bow and delegated his duties to the runner. What made this worse was the fact our server then stood around only 10 feet away with no other tables, socializing with 5 other severs who had apparently nothing to do. One staff member leaned backward onto a table, hands tucked behind his back and fiddling with a basket of silverware, only to make the loud comment to another female sever: "We going to make a lot of money tonight, girl!" To our astonishment, at the end of out meal, our sever (now MIA) neglected to take off the mistaken extra beer from our check. He later came out and attempted to convince us to pay for the mistakenly added beer, to no avail. 

In stark contrast to the service, my wife's pasta dish was light, but richly flavored. My meatloaf was fresh, unctuous and fulfilling. The food was excellent, service obviously lacking in training and guidance. The worst thing is once the sever makes multiple mistakes, he pawned our table off to a runner after trying to convince us to pay of beer we didn't order in place of an appetizer he forgot.

Food: 4
Service: 0

I had so much fun at this place! It was super cute. I was with a couple friends (we aren't from the area) and it just happened to catch my eye on the way back to the hotel. The live band was great but the regular speaker music could have been better because it was the same songs on repeat. the bartenders (Haley and Stephanie) were super sweet and accommodating. Can't wait for a visit back to Reno to go back! I also highly suggest Haley's little drink she made for my friends and I. I forget what it was but it was delicious!!

Tried this place on a whim. Good job on nails. Cute spot, but chairs not so comfortable. Being petty, but got a short lecture about not letting them know ahead of time about getting foil on two nails--3 minute addition if you're a perfectionist. Probably had time issues with other customers who wanted the full Shanaenae. Oh well. Just smiled and nodded.

I left a voicemail for Mark about our broken water heater and he returned my call promptly.  He understood our dilemma of not having hot water during the dead middle of winter and was quick to accommodating us, moving his schedule around to see us immediately.  We touched base at 6:00 PM and his crew came to our home by 7:40 AM the next day (less than 24 hours!).  I am grateful for his clear communication and accommodation.  The installation by his crew was seamless.  Both Brian and his associate efficiently maneuvered our old piece of junk out of our 2nd story condo and installed the new one.  I should mention that the guys also drove through snow/sleet early in the morning to see us.  All around excellent service.

This property is absolutely gorgeous, the interior decor was New Orleans themed and perfectly themed for a getaway! Upon check in, the staff was very hospitable! 

Every evening the hotel serves gumbo, it is AMAZING! Don't leave without trying it!

It is also perfectly located in the heart of New Orleans and is walking distance from many attractions and restaurants!
We have eaten here for years and always loved it. The last two times we've eaten there the food and drinks have been awful.

Had them come out this week and hydro jet out pipes (which also are old and had some build up.) they were able to come out within the week. Our tech did a great job and even snaked the shower because the slow drainage wasn't resolved with the hydro jet. 
Of note the person on the phone misquoted the price for the service and they honored the price I was initially quoted which saved me some $. I definitely respect that they honored the initial quote. Would use again even if they may be slightly more $ (at least according to other reviews I've read).

When my family and I decided that it was time to purchase a sectional for our basement, we arrived at the Bridgeton Weekends Only location hopeful and excited, and came out not only successful, but having dealt with the best service we have ever received, and with a beautiful new couch. Our floor salesman, Keith, could not have done a better job helping my family with kindness and professionalism. He is surely the best salesman that I have ever done business with. He deserves a raise!

great coffee.  my only negative is the atmosphere is too bright and loud.  may be preferred by others but a quiet corner is my preference.  

atmosphere aside they do coffee right.  5 stars for coffee choices and prep.

Since moving to Tucson from Scottsdale, I have had a hard time finding a good location for my massages. After a long work week I was definitely feeling the pain in my neck and back. I was super pleased to see I could not only book an appointment online, but also customize the experience if I wished. I made the appointment this morning for an 8:30pm appointment tonight. I absolutely love that I can get a massage so late and feel relaxed right before bedtime. The lady who checked me in was super kind and friendly (a rarity here in Tucson). Alfonso, my massage therapist, greeted me right on time and intently listened when I explained my areas of concern. His massage was absolutely PERFECT! I'm pleased to say I have finally found the Massage Envy in Tucson that is right for me. I highly recommend this location and Alfonso for massages and some relaxation time.

I've purchased 4 cars from nissan conicelli within the past 3 years.. Traded in 4 cars as well... I've checked on their site after each trade in and they marked my traded in vechiles 5 grand more than I received in trade in value... they made 20 grand off me in trade ins and ive purchases 4 cars plus paying the differences on those cars... ive been trying to buy a FIFTH car and they refuse to lower their price continuously saying ,"We know you buy alot of cars from us we just can't lose money" .... thanks for taking all of mine... im completely frustrated and will never return and take my business each year elsewhere...
Staff mighty pleasant.  Breakfast food choices for a vegan were abysmal.  If you are an omnivore, you'll be fine for a quick bite. Manage your expectations in any case.

Usually I'd assume people don't write a lot of good reviews about fast food restaurants, so I just want to say tonight BRAVO TACO BELL! So usually the Bell is ok, but nothing to write a review about and at least one thing is ick. Tonight however the crew at this location more than exceeded my expectations! My beefy Frito burrito was actually beefy and warm and Frito-y instead of just a sad lukewarm tortilla filled with mostly rice. My crunchy taco was actually crunchy and the bottom wasn't all mushy and collapsing. I was given the perfect amount of sauce packets instead of the usual one or 1000 and the girl at the window was quite pleasant and didn't look like she wanted to kill herself which was a nice change from the usual late night drive thru window workers. Thank you Taco Bell crew for feeding my hungry belly and making food that made it an enjoyable experience

Had the time of my life!!! Captain Nick was more than awesome!! First off I'm terrified of the ocean, by the end of day I was swimming in the ocean like a fish I even got on the tube and he promised he wouldn't kill me.. Well I rode it with my friend which a bigger girl than me ( not fat wise ) we took his ride better than anyone else on the boat even though The next day I had bruises all over me and across my nose because my friend landed on me!! ( proud moment because I don't tube either ) captain nick catered to our every need and we are a CRAZY BUNCH!!! As we floated in the water he would serve us fruit even put it in our mouths so it wasn't salty, he also grabbed our phones and took pictures!! Thank god because all we we're more worried about how many cocktails we could down!! Point of the story best day I've had ever!! And must have captain nick as your captain!! We are already planning our next trip with him!!! Beware lol wish I could give 10 stars!!!
Got the Cafe Au Lait and Beignets. Beignet was the bomb. Very fresh and fluffy inside. Pretty long line but I can see why. Highly recommend the Beignet

Ate here on my first night in NOLA and it was delicious !!!!! I had the mozzarella fireballs, and the goat cheese and beet salad. Both were delicious appetizers. I also had the salmon. The sauce on the salmon was kind of similar to tartar sauce and it was out of this world. The ambiance was great, really relaxing atmosphere. Service could be better. Our waitress was a little cold.

It's the curse of Reno sushi, striking again. 

I visited KitzMo roughly a year ago, and this weekend was looking to grab some AYCE and we figured we'd try it again. I'd remembered having a decent experience the past time, but at that moment I was still pretty new to Reno and hadn't formed many opinions. The restaurant had been pretty busy so our service was a bit slow, but we were willing to be forgiving of that.

Fast forward to lunch this weekend. The restaurant is practically empty. It seems like the manager doesn't enforce regular checks on the floor, because I had to wave to them a handful of times in order to get new rolls and refills.

Even that would have been forgivable, but the food was just so... blah. And, it took the chefs too long to get the rolls out, considering how few people were there. The tuna namely was actually unpleasant to eat. That's my fiance's favorite and she wouldn't even finish her rolls. I did like how they actually cut the tails off of the upside-down shrimp, but that's pretty much the only way they outpaced other sushi joints in Reno.

I likely won't be returning to KitzMo. Even if friends want to go, I'll likely fight them on it and suggest one of the other restaurants known to have higher standards for similar pricing. Underwhelming, followed by disappointing, experiences is enough for me to rule it out of the hierarchy of the Reno sushi scene.

Hmmmm, where to start with this place. A couple of friends and myself stopped by to grab some lunch after attending the Diva's Day Out event. We were able to get in for lunch and they weren't overly busy, which we were thankful for since we were starving! Not the best customer service, our waitress was mediocre and lacked personality. Upon taking our order, rather annoyed and bored by our presence, we never saw her again till the end of the meal. We each ordered a roll and one of my friends ordered their hot and sour soup in addition. When he received his soup, there were noodles and meat in the hot and sour soup, none of us have ever had it with noodles and meat, which was a bit of a surprise. Our rolls arrived with pretty basic presentation and were nothing exciting at all. My friend also received a roll he didn't order, but decided to eat it anyways since once again, we were hungry and the waitress was no where to be found. When we received our check, we were charged incorrectly. When we approached the waitress about the error, she was very confused and went to get her manager, upon the long wait while they figured this monstrosity out, she returned still with an incorrect check and offered us free dessert for the inconvenience. We were very frustrated by this point and just wanted to get out of there ASAP. We won't be returning here, there are plenty of other sushi joints that offer up way better customer service and above par food.

The bar that invented the Flaming Dr. Pepper shot!  I don't like Dr. Pepper so I've never done that shot but I usually have a really fantastic time in here.  This is a classic late night dive spot in the quarter where you can escape the nastier aspects of Bourbon Street.  They usually are playing great 80's music and there are wild crazy people dancing everywhere (but not necessarily doing a good job of it).  

The are a few negatives: 

1)  You always have to pay a cover to get in and although it is usually crowded sometimes it is crowded with people you don't like being around and you can't tell anything about the crowd until you get inside.

2)  The drinks are a bit expensive on the New Orleans scale but about on par with most of the rip off prices in the French Quarter and occasionally some random dishonest bar tender might try to pull a fast one on you and overcharge you but I've rarely had this problem and found most of the staff here to be good hardworking fun folks.

3)  They are usually only open Thursday-Saturday and sometimes closed on those days so if you open a tab (and you have to give them your ID also) on a Saturday and forget to close it then you can't get your credit card or ID back until maybe Thursday at the earliest (I don't know anything about this from personal experience right...).

When Bourbon Street is getting deserted that is about the time that this bar is beginning to get crowded so 2am and later is the time to get here.  They have lots of old school 80's video games and other fun things to occupy your time if you don't feel like dancing the night away.  There are always interesting people in here and the crowd typically includes several bachelorette parties along with people dressed up from weddings, balls, costume parties and the million other random things that go on in New Orleans.  You probably want to make sure you never arrive here sober as that would just be too much too fast for any person in that state of mind to be able to handle so do yourself a favor and booze it up really good before entering here or you will be overwhelmed by the sheer decadence unleashed in here.

This place is usually great for takeout. They have quick delivery and have a pretty extensive menu. I usually get one of their many salads. Sadly had to take off 2 stars for the salad I received today.. Do not order steak with any of your salads unless you want a bunch of cheesesteak meat dumped all over it. Literally had to drain the salad to remove all of the grease that was pooled at the bottom. This left a film of beef grease on all of the veggies. See picture of salad after removing 80% of the meat. Could not eat it.
Jenny did my manicure & pedicure & it was an AMAZING experience. This was my first experience. It definitely won't be my last. Thank you everyone.

We live in the Nations and were very excited to have Taqueria join the neighborhood. And we enjoy the food! 

I'd like to give them 4 or 5 stars, but I can't for 2 reasons; 
1. Their hours. They close everyday between 2:30-5:30pm. I do not understand why dinner hours start at 5:30. We've walked to Taqueria once for happy hour - closed. Went to M. L. Rose instead. Walked there a second time for a late lunch - closed. M. L. Rose got our business instead again. A third time we went for an early dinner at 5pm - closed. We walked to Cinco de Mayo instead. And we've walked there twice on a Monday and they were closed. So, they've been open 2 months and missed out on our business 5 times already. 
Reason number 2: they refuse to give me a glass for water because their glasses are for booze only. If you want water, they make you use a disposable plastic cup instead. Apparently this is because the glasses are also used for margaritas so if you want to use one, you have to show your i.d. to prove you're 21. I can't be green at Taqueria. Too bad. 

I'd give their food a solid 4 stars. I like the vegetarian options. The queso is great and the guacamole is really good. Cheese enchiladas and veggie tacos are good too. 

They'll still get my business, but M. L. Rose is getting a lot more of my business because they're not open during Typical business hours. 

They've got friendly staff and Tony, the owner, is always greeting you at the door.

My go to sub shop when I'm in my old hood. Customer service is always great even when they are crazy busy. The sub/hoagie I get is always the half #2 which got only being half is very filling. They offer hot food as well but I'm here for the subs lol! You won't be disappointed with this place. They do have parking in the back so don't be discouraged about location. This isn't a sit down spot. They have chips, drinks, snacks.

Good beer selection. Great food. Awesome atmosphere and vibe for a group. The beer selection is good but not as extensive as some other places to be called great. I didn't really have expectations for the restaurant going in and the food was definitely a pleasant surprise. Preparation and style of the food was pretty simple but well executed. Standard Tap deserves to be called a gastropub. Reservations are recommended as the place does get busy on weekends. 

The Food: The menu changes but my group tried most of the staples
1) Fried Squid (Calamari): probably the worst one of everything we tried and I would call it sub-par, but not bad. 
2) Mussels w/ Sausage: good mussels with a great tasting broth and some really good bread for dipping
3) Chicken Pie: a little overhyped on Yelp, I thought it was only okay and I probably wouldn't order again
4) Berkshire Pork Chop: simple, pretty moist for pork chop, but the other 2 entrees were better
5) Duck Breast: simple preparation, but the quality and taste of the duck meat were very good. If you like duck, definitely try it out!
6) Hanger Steak: a staple for a gastropub and it was well executed. Ordered it medium rare and it came out true medium rare and even all throughout, including the tips. The fries were excellent and even better when drenched in the steak juices. 

Overall, it was a great experience and I would highly recommend it. Just don't go in with high expectations, expecting the best meal of your life because that's not what this place is about.

Fabulous meal and perfect service , I am in the food service industry, very picky and demanding and they were dead on. Ribs to die for, salmon cooked perfect. The waitress was one of the best. The only constructive thing I could say is that the manager should have been doing table visits .

So I looked at a few reviews of Distrito before going, and the consensus seemed to be that the portions are too small.  The thing is, you're eating from the tapas menu.  My friend and I sort of gorged ourselves last night.  I'll add a disclaimer--my brother is a chef here, so we did receive some special treatment.  The Atun Ceviche was so delicate...yet it fairly bursts with flavor.  Lime sorbet and little cracker thingies made it a delicious start.  Next was zucchini quesadillas with radish.  I never thought I would eat radish, but it was damn zesty.  We had both pork and duck mole....I prefer the duck.  The pork reminded me of a puerto rican dish called pernil, and I generally only eat it around holidays.  The dish I found most clever was this crab and cactus concoction.  Courtesy of the kitchen, or lovely server brought out tuna tacos--mmm, mmm good.  As for the drinks, I had two Jamaica Cosmos: tangy vodka with hibiscus and lime, while my girlfriend nursed a strong watermelon magarita.  The ambiance alone is worth the visit--mexican wrestling masks adorn one of the walls from floor to ceiling, there is a movie projector AND a walking serenade.  Jose Garces is the man.  He was present the entire evening (how do I know this you ask? we were there for three hours).  I respect a chef who keeps track.  Watch out Stephen Starr!!!

Great food, staff could be a bit more attentive. The time i dine in I had to get up several times and asked for napkins, sauce. I understand they get busy but you have to keep everyone happy in the hospitality business.
Very tasty food all in all!

Humble store front with a cool modern lounge vibe on the inside. That earns them one star. Friendly service, so that bumps it up to two.  Where it goes terribly awry is the food. 

To sum it up: I feel crazy for having wasted my stomach and wallet space after dining here. 

The quality of fish was similar to supermarket sushi (i.e. lower quality and not fresh -- has been frozen before). The cuts of sashimi was as amateurish as it gets -- like a new person combined with a blunt knife randomly cutting up fish.  The rolls were inconsistent in terms of fillings.

For the prices they are charging - they can afford to improve their quality in both chef and fish.

Order take out for dinner tonight. This is our favorite dim sum place in Tucson. Really authentic. When they open the dining room, you will see a lot of people from Hong Kong come to dine here. One thing is the location, very far south. It takes very long to get here.

The last time I went there for real was with family when it was Christmas Time my brother had just come from Arkansas where my parents both now reside with him and his wife.  The reason we chose that was because the food is good and the drinks are poured correctly as it was the spot for the reunion For Notre Dame High School Class of '79 in 2009, where I was MC, and we had the great Frank Olivetti as DJ, a excellent Buffet and everyone went home responsibly, it's the old saying " home and tea! " Metro Grill you earned every tip you received!!
OUTSTANDING Greek food! Great customer service and delicious food! Too full to try the ice cream but they had some delicious looking choices. Will be back!!!!! AND they deliver to our area!

Just letting you know now when they ask you if you want your wings breaded or naked, they REALLY mean do you want Wing Dings or restaurant style wings. The zeppoli dough is heavier than a down pillow, and the "fresh" Wing Dings taste like they've been left in the back of a 2001 Ford Explorer for half the afternoon and then nuked for a minute thirty just for a little extra warmth. I tried to call and complain without being angry, but the manager, apparently named Danielle, who is also a doctor??? is literally childish in her approach to problem solving as a manager, and cannot provide any decent customer service without trying to "educate me" about the onset of food poisoning when i tell her the food felt disgusting not only in my mouth, but during its visit to each of the steps in my digestive tract prior to the stomach, which i felt just as abruptly as a PATCO stop. I didn't tell you I had food poisoning, Doc Danielle, I told you it tasted gross. You know what you're serving. This is like the 4th different name i've heard since i graduated in 2016, so I guess this is why. Best Wishes!

Took the 2hr trip down to look at a used suv after visiting a franchised dealer elsewhere and the experience was worlds apart. This was simply a no pressure experience. Shannon gave us the keys to test drive it. Then we sat down with Bill and went over the numbers. There are no games played. Its a small shop with great value and a personal touch. These guys are worth the time and their prices are second to none. So if you want a no pressure simple car buying experience I suggest you head to Royal Auto Group and check out the fantastic array of vehicles with amazing prices. I expect my wife to pick up her next car and get a great deal from Royal Auto Group.

I went to LaVie because it had excellent reviews and let me tell you, this did not disappoint. What a beautiful and wonderful experience I had. I was well taken care of and my nails are beautiful. Kim to the most beautiful flowers on my nails. Thank you so much  for brightening my day and you  now have a dedicated customer.

Sister Sue T, Uncle Mike and Ms T and I spent a morning at Soulard Market and timed it so we could utilize a Groupon at McGurk's.  McGurk's was hightly recommended by a co-worker of Ms T's. 

Around the table we ordered Fish and Chips, Bangers and Mash and a burger.  Ms T and uncle Mike really liked the fish and chips.  The fish was cod chunks with a light coating.  I stole a bite from Ms T and it was good.  Sister Sue ordered the Bangers and Mash.  The potatoes were plentiful, lumpy and good with hints of skin included.  The Bangers were interesting.  We asked and learned they were house made.  The soft loose texture was from potatoes ground into the mix.  These were good and in fact I grew to like them a lot (stealing again).  They are not the typical garlicky smoked sausage or Polish that you might expect.  The flavors were subtle and mild with a taste of rosemary.

I ordered the burger to continue my quest for good burgers.  I ordered medium (based on the recent experience at the Eagle's Nest) and it was medium rare.  I had sautéed mushrooms, caramelized onions, lettuce and tomato.  This was a good burger, flavorful, properly salted but not over spiced.  Again, I am looking for a bit more grill crust, but all in all, quite good.

McGurk's is a definite return.  Great place.

Mediocrity is alive and well at Sushi Teri! I consider myself accepting and understanding of many different people's differing tastes and opinions, which is why, while skipping over menu items at Asian restaurants with cream cheese in them, I politely don't pass judgment. In this case however, it was hard to ignore that a good 80% of the rolls have cream cheese in them, and not just as an embellishment. My friend, being forced to settle, for lack of a single solid, straightforward menu item, was dismayed to find more cream cheese than everything else on the roll put together! Top it off with a pitifully organized and incomplete menu, an unprofessional wait staff, and too-high prices that fluctuate with little warning and you've got one of the most lukewarm, mediocre restaurant experiences I've had in recent memory.

Excellent business lunch, great price, cool venue. At lunch it's all you can eat, but not at dinner. You tell the server what kind of meat/seafood/tofunoodles/rice you want and they bring you a metal bowl that you will fill at the salad bar with all the veggies, sauce, toppings you want.
Then you take it to the chef and they stir fry it with your sauces right in front of you. I got tender, delicious steak and tofu. A+
Service was friendly and fast. Wish there was one in our area.
If you want good mexican walk down the block to Cantina! The fish tacos I ordered were inedible and the décor is hideous!

live coming here for anytime!! one of my favorites thing to eat here is Phô and the crispy chicken in the appetizer side it's very good!! and now the I found out they have the Thai tea boba even better!!!

1 star for minus 1. Terrible food quality. I visit this location at 12:30am and got a cold chicken sandwich with cold saggy fries. What a shame, I assume this place have a manager on duty, clearly don't care about quality food. No pride on the staff work. 

This is the second time a got a non quality order from Wendy's and clearly will be my last. The first time I complaint to Wendy's online and never got a respond from them, I guess they also don't care.  I'm done with this franchise.

This place used to be okay but is now terrible.  I brought pants in to be hemmed and they came back two inches longer than requested.  They refused to fix plus were rude.  

The worst.

This TJ Maxx is okay. I feel like I hardly ever actually find things here. I am always hopeful when I decide to visit this location but rarely actually leave with anything. Their kitchen and home decor section has some good options. I once scored a huge butchers block for my kitchen counter here at a great deal and it was great quality. 

In regards to clothes how ever, it seems they miss the mark. Especially dresses. They hardly have any dresses! Like cocktail dresses, often times I check out store like this because I just truly hate going to the mall and hope maybe I can find something without having to order online. I wear a common shoe size and it proves to be a big issue here since I can hardly find anything in size in this department as well.  This TJ Maxx is just ok.

The catchy name, Humpty's Dumpling, easily grabbed my attention. And the stuffed goodness inside of each dumpling made it easier to grab my heart. 

Must have dumplings:
- Cheesesteak
- Buffalo Chicken 
- Broccoli 

Less of a fan of:
- Honey BBQ
- Noodles (slightly dry)

Improve on: 
- Height of tables are too high, it is not handicap accessible. This was difficult for my friend. Recommend having one standard height table for universal access.

The restaurants concept is simple, but brilliant. It's recreating sandwiches, but in fun sized form! All the deliciousness packed into one, without the mess. Yum.

Got the Frisco burger meal, never been to Hardee's twice in one day but this one just opened up & was on the way home. Lots of staff but NO customers. Girl that took my order never smiled, never said anything but "what can I get you" yawned once & seems not to want to be there, that's fine, I don't care, live your life unhappy. Fries were old & warm but the frisco burger was amazing! 4 stars for the frisco burger alone & it being a new store. Staff is replaceable! Plus they have the original tasting coke, good deal!
Visited Union Jack once and had fish and chips. Solid choice, decent beers, and I would def try them again.

I've had some issues with the beauty institute before with scheduling and appointments but I have found lately that it's great! I have gotten a dye job I didn't like before but only paid $60 so I can't complain. I got my hair lightened to blonde in two visits with both cuts and blow outs/styling for only $120 when a salon quoted me $400 for one visit! I always go here for hair and soon will try some skin services so I will update my review when I try them out. All I suggest for hair is to do your research through Instagram of what stylist you would like, I wouldn't recommend going random. Also, you will be there ALL DAY. it's ok for me because I'm off on the weekends and don't have young kids, but it may be an issue if you can't be free from 10am-5pm. Other than that I love it:)

Told my mom I was eating vegan donuts and though her initial reaction was negative, I was gleaming! My friend is trying to be vegan once a week to try new things and get into the mindset more often, and these treats were the perfect way to start the day. We got a sampling of 3 donuts (peanut chew, boston cream in the shape of a heart, cookie crumble) and also the pear muffin! 

As for the donuts, amazing. Donut texture with delicious frosting, especially the cookie one we got. It was covered in cookie dough and oreo crumbles and the chocolate frosting all made me feel like I was eating a high end, creamy, guilt-inducing dessert. The boston cream was the same frosting but with an interesting filling, which was almost exactly like a regular cream filling but slightly thinner. The peanut chew is for the PB lover, drizzled with maple or caramel and a really really sweet overall taste. 

The muffin was dense but so lightly sweet, it complemented the donuts we got perfectly. You could tell it was fresh by the pear legitimately in the muffin, and the crumble top was a perfect crunch at the top of every bite. Plus it was huge! And I topped it off with an almond milk hot coco which kept me warm and happy! 

Will be coming back to try the huge fritters.

I don't think I'll be going back here-unless I just want some beer and fries. They DO have a great selection of microbrews at reasonable prices and have their own brew made by Tempe's Fourpeaks. Their food is slightly above average, but you get smaller portions at higher prices. My burger was not exceptional...dry bread...and it's one of those places you pay for add-ons....I think I'd rather try something new than to return here.

JESSE IS THE MANNNNN!!!! I was terrified to even touch an axe when I walked in because I'm a delicate flower. But jesse taught me how to bend & snap lumberjack style and now i'm throwing axes like a freakin' ninja. I can't wait to go back!

Look, even their DIET root beer is GREAT, and you can down FOUR or more frosty mugs guilt-free for one bottomless price of $2.24.  I visited on Tuesday night when the sidewalks were as icy as the beverage glasses. I drove in with an SUV full of college kids, and, along with our soda microbrews, we sampled several foods. The seafood gumbo and steak salad were very good, and I can't complain about the sweet potato fries. You can pass on the pizza though, since the crust looked and tasted prefabricated. Overall, three stars for the food, and five stars for the root beer!

What a great little restaurant and bar. My wife and I ordered off of the "build your own burger" menu and our burgers were absolutely great.  Our bartender was Danny (sp?) and she was very personable, polite, and professional.  We really value restaurants that put in a lot of time into preparing food from scratch and this place seems to do that.  We can't wait to go back to try out other menu items that were appealing to us.
Food is amazing, chicken cutlet sandwich is better than most Italian places in south philly .only problem I have is the female "possibly the owner" is very rude and miserable
Love the Picasso Roll,  and every thing else I have tried.  Great friendly staff,  must try if in The Village.

We were really excited to come have a great dinner before the Taylor swift concert. The service was alright... we didn't see our waiter again after she came back to check how everything was cooked. As we got farther into our steaks, 2 out of the 3 were had pretty strong fat lines for being filet Mignon. We all ordered our steaks medium rare.. only 1 came out a perfect medium rare. My boyfriends New York stop was more medium well, and our friends other filets were closer to rare (each the ones with the fat lines throughout). Our Caesar salads had too much dressing and almost too salty to eat. The lyonnaise potatoes and creamed spinach were on point. Our waitress only told us that the sides came in family sizes and were big enough for the table to share... never mentioned anything about the individual sizes which isn't a huge deal, but would have been nice to know since we were two separate couples. The drinks were delicious and beautifully presented. My steak was amazing... just unfortunate that it was the only one to come out right. If we hadn't been on a time restriction to get to the concert, we would have sent them back to be remade which is why i decided to write this yelp review instead.

Arnold's is quite possibly the best meat and three around. Hailing from Alabama, I have had my share of meat and three restaurants - including Birmingham icons like Niki's West. Without a doubt, Arnold's passes all meat and three options in Alabama - and probably elsewhere in the south, that I've been to. Don't miss their Mac and cheese - simply perfection. And grab a slice of strawberry pie for dessert.
Really great service and yummy food made in front of you..old school pizza at fair prices and good quality. Thanks Manny!

A quick update on my previous review: we STILL have not received our prints. After attempting to leave feedback on their Facebook page, all negative comments were deleted from their page. Additionally, they managed to post more samples of their work. Basically, they have time to weed out criticism and post pictures, but not to return a phone call or email. 

Before they were deleted, most of the negative comments were about a lack of customer service and the fact that it was taking months for people to get what they had paid for.

This place has a pretty cool yet terrifying aesthetic. I love the veggie sharwma wrap and at a great price. There are very limited places to sit, but their service is quick and the servings are huge, so it's nice to pick up on the way to something else. Nice for vegetarians, vegans, and non-vegetarians alike.

I went on a field trip and they were very understanding with the staff and the type of school I attend. They museum was very intriguing and had many things from skulls to full skeletons. You can tell the people who put the museum together and keep it running love there jobs. All of the items included are beautifully placed and have the information regarding what you are looking at. 
I saw Einstein's brain and read the tales about snow white, the mad hatter and saw many different types of tools used in wars.

We brought then tail lights from a 1951 Jaguar - not very large at all.  They had them for 3 months and could not get the job done.  Like others ran into a lot of stalling and "good cop-bad cop" on the phone.  I finally went there to get them and I saw the shop - they have all the right stuff but it just looked like no one was working.  While they went in the back to get the lights I saw an opened box on the desk - someone sending something back demanding a no-charge rechrome - no telling when they'll see those pieces again.  Ours had copper on them and that was it - after 3 months - sheesh - just glad to have them back so we can get the job done right elsewhere....

Sold us a 2011 Chevy Traverse and said everything was great with it. They lost our second key and when we took it back the next day to tell them there was a power steering issue they said it was a spring winding in the steering column and it was fine. I knew that was incorrect. Come to find out when we took it to the Chevy dealership they said it was very dangerous to drive and parts had to be completely replaced but that it was all covered under warranty through Chevy. Thankfully Chevy actually did their jobs unlike Internet Auto Sales. Worthless people that are unwilling to do the right thing and completely ok with putting people's lives in danger. Our kids were in that car!  This is why I have never bought a car from a used car place and never will again.

So I'm a BBQ nut.  I consider it its own food group.  If you read my reviews you will see many BBQ places, and when I'm traveling (which is a lot) I try to eat BBQ in new cities.  DISCLAIMER, I believe that SC (specifically midlands whole hog/mustard sauce) is the best second to Texas Beef Brisket, and then NC BBQ.  Martin's put Tennessee in the top 5 places!

I went to Martin's at about 11:30 on a Saturday.  The line was picking up.  A little out the door, but not much (when I left it was down the street.)   Like many places in Nashville, you order at a counter and get a number.   Apparently, if you're eating at the bar, you can go straight there.  I wish I had known that, but I'll address this later.  

I had the sampler platter that had whole hog, brisket, and two sides.  WAY TOO MUCH FOOD FOR ONE PERSON, but I wanted to try both the brisket and the whole hog.  As for sides,​ I had green beans and mac n' cheese (staples at any good bbq place.).   Start with sides.  Mac n' Cheese was beyond legit.   Loved the bread crumbs on top.  Good. Solid. Mac n' Cheese.  Green beans were also great.  Cann​ed? Yes.  Still good? Definitely.   

The meats.  The whole hog was great.  I'd give it an 8.5 out of 10.  Glad they put the sauce on the side.  Didn't need any, but did try it.  Red sauce.  Not as sweet as Memphis or Kansas City.  The brisket was 8.2.  Not my first rodeo.  I should have said lean, as I prefer the lean, but my cut was deliciously fatty.  Fall apart.  Good brisket. 

For all of these reasons, I'm giving it five stars.  My only beef (not the brisket) was the service at the bar.   As I stated earlier, if I knew I could go straight to the bar I would have.  Since I was alone, I took my number and beer (I ordered from the counter and asked do I need to go to the bar) and sat at the bar.  The bartender was not happy I had already ordered.  I get it, you're not getting the tip, but give me the benefit of the doubt to make this right.  The woman behind the bar was downright rude.  When I finished my first beer (which I did fast so I could throw her some money), she ignored me until I finally caught her eye and asked for another drink.  I ordered a beer and a drink.  I would have like to know there was a $2.00 charge for getting a whiskey on the rocks.  When I asked about the fee, again she was rude as hell.  If the food hadn't been so good, I would have left a much lower score just for how she treated me.  I have tough skin, and this was just dumbfounding that someone in the service industry had an attitude like this.

If I could leave Zero stars, that's what they deserve. My journey at Elder Ford started with the purchase of a vehicle several years ago. It was a beautiful Ford Ranger. As I drove it off the lot, I sensed there was something going on with the vehicle. I drove it back the next day, and spoke to the person who I purchased it from. He shrugged me off, told me service wasn't open ( Saturday, it was) and sent me on my way. Several days later my car, catastrophically damaged, was a useless hunk of metal on the side of the road. Now I will say, as I was covered with warranty and I just purchased a vehicle, they fixed it for free.  But they had to install a new engine, that wasn't actually knew, it had more miles than the car I purchased. Then they were difficult with the rental car and were otherwise incommunicado and took absolutely forever to get me my vehicle back. All of this wouldn't even make me leave a bad review, because ish happens, and some people there were nice. But I did vow never to go to Elder Ford again. Fast-forward about three years, and my husbands Mercury Mariner breaks down on the side the road.  Our mechanic could not fix it, turns out it was a computer issue that had to be dealt with by the dealership. I have, unfortunately, found my way back to Elder Ford. They have had our car for weeks, and while it is a serious issue and I understand that things take time, they have terrible communication. They tell us they will call us back and they don't.  I have a six-month-old, it's a Saturday, we were supposed to have a car back on Wednesday. We're all going absolutely stir crazy. I blame Elder Ford. Stay away, stay far away.

I've rented from this location a few times in the past years.  It's the closest location to my house so it makes it convenient when a rental is needed.  My employer also has pre-negotiated rates with ERAC so it's always nice getting a deeply discounted corporate rate when renting a vehicle from here.  The staff each time I've been in has been very friendly and polite and work at top speed to get people in and out in record time.

My only gripe comes with the interior cleanliness of their cars.  Each time I've gotten late model cars that appear newer and clean on the outside, but each time the interiors of these newer cars (ones that have less than 8k miles on them) are totally disgusting.  They either reek of smoke, have stained interiors/seats, and are so grimy it makes you feel dirty just touching the steering wheel or any other interior surface of the car.  They have porters who wash the cars before each renter gets them, but it may actually be more worthwhile for them to get the interiors of their cars detailed from time to time.

Tres Leches!!! My best friend ordered it and I had a delicious bite of it. Everything home made. My pastries were good and French pressed iced latte was great. Can't wait to come back for tapas Friday nights and when they start having paella/ceviche. Their Latin Lunch menu looks good too.

Worst place to go for ice cream.  We waited in line for 30 minutes and still didnt get ice cream.  There were 2 people behind the counter but only 1 was actually making ice cream.   The second person was just standing there talking to the guy that was working instead of helping make ice cream.   Maybe he was the owner or the manager but that isnt an excuse.  He should have jumped in to help.  If you want to actually try some cream and not just stand in line.  Pick a different place.  There are plenty of better places to go.

Mediocre at best. 

I ordered the following dinner combinations: 

House Special Lo Mein 
+ Fried Egg Roll (x1)
+ Crab Puff (x2)
+ Fried Rice 
+ Hour and Sour Soup (x1)

The egg roll and crab puffs were in the same styrofoam container as the main dish and fried rice, so they were wet and soggy from the heat/steam. The fried rice was passable, the hot and sour soup was average, and the main dish was bland and swimming in oil. Additionally, of the 2 shrimps in my Lo Mein, 1 of them was not cleaned (it still had the vein in it).  

Beef Broccoli 
+ Fried Egg Roll (x1)
+ Crab Puff (x2)
+ Fried Rice 
+ Hour and Sour Soup (x1)

The fried egg roll, crab puffs, fried rice, and soup in this combination, of course, had the same issues/characteristics as those with the Lo Mein dish. As for the beef broccoli itself, it was also bland and there was a lot of gristle in the beef. 

Overall, Bamboo View wasn't a good dining investment. It may not have been the worst food I've ever had, but it definitely wouldn't crack my Top 10. In other words, considering all of the good "fast casual" Chinese restaurants in town, there wouldn't be any reason at all for me to recommend or suggest this place.
We ate here n our way to Vegas. My wife and I both got sick. My wife and I were sick for three days so we are thinking it was food poisoning. Will never eat here again.
Huge sandwich with three chicken tenders with special sauce. Nice and crunchy. Huge serving of seasoned fries come with the sandwich. Friendly staff too.
Had the Happy Hour Gumbo was very good ..My party had the Bar  B Que shrimp and grits it looked delicious also

If I could give this place less stars I would ...I was called by Fedex a few days ago (they day my package was supposed to be delivered) and they said they had the wrong building number and room number so the package could not be delivered that day. Now I was in clinic seeing patients so it was about an hour before I could call them back in between patients and let them know the proper information. The stupid guy at the FedEx in Tucson entered in the number wrong so my package was not delivered!! They had to send it all the way back to Tucson and then it's going to be sent back to California as promised in the next few days... to top it all off they wanted to charge me an extra $12 to have it resent and it wasn't even my fault in the first place!

I hope it just gets there soon. This is ridiculous.

First the bad, service here when busy is terrible and completely unorganized. Like a Fawlty Towers episode! If you plan to come here on weekends be prepared for a 30-40 min wait, especially when 3 or more...But everything we ate was delicious. Great traditional breakfast choices and desserts. Also have some specials on the board but didn't have the chance yet to try those yet.

I'm pretty picky with burgers and Sketch totally delivers.  The beef is what stands out to me.  Great flavor and freshness.  Not too salty but not flavorless. Also not oily.  The burgers sit extremely well in my belly.  No drama.  

Best of all is the incredibly friendly service.  It's great to get a smile and cheerful personality.  It makes a difference and shows that they care about what they are doing. Burger temps are accurate which is great.  If you can't get that right..,.

Anyway.  I work in the city so it takes a lot to bring me back down on my free time and sketch burger is often a reason to make the drive.   There are always people here which is another sign of good food.

Full Ride is the best of the best. The instructors are not only kind and amazing people but they truly put so much time and effort into planning amazing classes and continuing to challenge you. I always leave not only having completed an amazing work out but feeling inspired and motivated. Side note- there are typically dogs running around in the studio so if that doesn't get you there I don't know what will ;) If you are looking for a spin studio in Nashville, look no further than Full Ride!

Where do I begin???? My wife and I have been to several shake junts up and down the coast but this was THE WORST!!! We came in late on a Friday night... should be prime time right??? No. We were immediately accosted by some dude who hadn't even paid to get in, then we walked in to what I can only assume was the gates of hell. The bathrooms look like you would easily find a dead body, and the sound system was shit. We sat down with a stack of 100 ones and that's when the real fun began. These girls looked like they either just gave birth or are are about to.  Awesome if that's your thing, but for us it wasn't.  We spent more time wondering where the pole work was than actually checking out the entertainment. When we were ready to leave there was an altercation at the front door so we were afraid to leave. Needless to say we ran out after an hour!!!!

Its those happy accidents that make life worthwhile. I was driving home after getting my taxes done and decided to treat myself to a good lunch. I knew a Primos was nearby but had inadvertently passed it while looking for it. I searched for a place to turn around and then I smelled it...BBQ...smoked meats...deliciousness. There, next to a tire place was a tiny shack with a small sign " Big Daddy'z BBQ and Grill. All thoughts of a Primo Hoagie were trampled on by a pig.

Now, I cant review a BBQ place without mentioning my benchmark, Sweet Lucy's  but as good as SL is, its a bit of a hike for me. The prospect of good BBQ right in my backyard had me as excited as a toddler in a room full of porcelain knickknacks. The smell surrounding the place was wonderful, and I noticed the huge smoker outside of the building. A great sign if I ever saw one.

Inside, there was barely enough room to move around. This place is takeout only (although I did notice a few park benches outside). The friendly people inside welcomed me and bore with me as I looked over the menu. Its pretty standard BBQ fare, everything that you would want or expect. I went with Hog Heaven: 2 good sized links of smoked kielbasa served on a long roll with sauteed onions, spicy mustard and pulled pork. $9.95. The meal was finished in no time and I was on my way after getting a wonderful Olde Philadelphia Black Cherry to go with it.

The assessment: I wasn't impressed by the sides I chose. The Slaw was good but not great. The mac and cheese, while utilizing bacon, was pretty bland. It was just a simple Kraft style creamy cheese. So Ok, I got that out of the way, sides aren't great, but I didn't come here for the sides. Its easy to forgive lackluster sides when THE MEAT IS SO GOOD! Yep, Id put the meat/ sauce over Sweet Lucys, Daves Famous, Jimmys BBQ and Dinosaur BBQ in Syracuse.

The pulled pork was perfectly prepared and sauced. Some places go a little dry and offer the extra sauce but I prefer places like Big Daddy'z and Sweet Lucy's that put the right amount on for you. The Kielbasa was the best Id had anywhere. While technically a sandwich, I couldnt pick the thing up and just ate it like a pig in a trough. If you think that is a complaint, think again. Thats good eatin!

So Im only giving 4 stars because of the sides and the fact that I need to try their ribs and chicken. If they are as good as I think they will be, sub par sides or not, they will get the 5. I cant tell you how excited I am about such a great find nearby, mostly because my mouth is full with BBQ.

I came here 2 times, and both times the wait wasn't too bad (for happy hour, on a saturday night).. we came around 9:30 and got seated within 20 minutes. for $1 oysters, i was a little skeptical and thought the oysters would not be very good and I'd probably be biting into some sand grains or two. I was definitely wrong..the oysters are very fresh and soo good! Can't believe it's only $1 :) My friend and I also decided to try the oyster rockefeller, which were pretty good and herby but not as good as the fresh oysters in my opinion. What's also pretty good is the new england style clam chowder :) I'd definitely recommend this place for happy hour.
Great original fluffy pancakes at a very reasonable price! I went around 7pm which is when they were about to close but because I had driven a while to get there they made sure that I got my cakes!

Surprisingly good was a little worried because you have Greek in Florida. But the menu was a mixture with some good Greek options, the surf an turf was spot on, the stuffed grape leaves were perfect, was expecting warm( I didn't read the menu) none the less they are great. The staff was great the bartender was moving like no other the restaurant flowed smoothly an even with a wait the turn around was fast very polite people we met ... definitely will be back it's a good twist an mixture of food

This is a traditional hardware store with household items, tools, supplies...and a staff that is incredibly helpful and knowledgeable.  I go out of my way to shop there, even if I am near some big box store (yuck).  It's everything you want in a hardware store, or any store for that matter.  They are great problem solvers.  And I find their prices great. They've given me the names of great contractors.  I'll never understand why anyone would shop in a chain store, with awful service and changing staff that barely knows anything instead of in a place that is truly there to help.   I hope they are here for many many years to come.

Love the food favorite place to go on a beautiful day in the city. I love to go with my beautiful wife I always have the best time. The service is always good and I make sure to leave a great tip. The seat could be a little bit more comfortable though but besides that o really enjoy it.

I was worried about finding a place to get my hair done last minute for graduation but they were able to accommodate me! Mohammed did an amazing job and added some curls to the ends which I didn't think would hold throughout the humid day. It ended up lasting till the next day to my surprise since my hair never holds curls! Will definitely make another appointment with him for my next blow out.

I don't understand how someone can enjoy eating this type of food. Over greasy and over priced for the dishes.  We ordered several rice and noodle dishes and expect some quality for price. 

Please save your money and go elsewhere.  Penang is way better for same price.

Everything about this restaurant was perfection.  We were a group of 10 and every meal was outstanding.  I had the scallops, my husband a steak and both were wonderful.  The drink list is extensive with an array of high end, sometimes hard to find brands.  Service perfected, with just the right amount of attentiveness, allowing us to just enjoy our time and without rushing us.  Save room for desert, but share! Their butter cake is delicious but huge!  Atmosphere is lively, modern and classy and would also be a great place to have a drink as the bar area looked very nice.
Pretty good coconut soup, pad Thai, and red curry. The Papaya salad came out without any papaya. On second glance the menu did say "cabbage OR papaya"--so I guess they gave us the cabbage version?

The wait is finally over.  I honestly can say it was worth it!  All of the owners hard work shows though; it is simply amazing.

Here is the low down: 

There is NO other place like this in the Indianapolis area.  People will be traveling to Indianapolis to come to the Inferno Room. I was lucky to check out the Inferno Room opening night and already ran into other Tiki Connoisseurs. This new establishment compares to other well known Tiki Bars in Chicago and California.  

The tiki culture in Indianapolis is real and live now! I really want to say congrats to everyone who worked on it.  It is a true accomplishment not just for getting something like this off the ground but doing it the right away.  I am sure it will pay off.  I can't wait to see what is next!  The owners and workers put their heart and souls into this place.  You can tell that with the detail that went into everything; small details from the walls, handmade items, and environment were all were designed specifically with Tiki in mind in and out. 

We sat in the "Kahuna Lounge" which allowed us to take it all in and enjoy the atmosphere.  Of course, I had a Mai Tai.  As expected, it was fantastic.  It is nice to get these classic drinks in this setting.  From Black Market to Inferno Room, the menu is something they should be proud off and it is.  I can't wait to go back and work my way though the list.  The service was great and I expect to continue to get even better as these new employees gain experience. I can not express how excited I am to have this in the neighborhood. 

It's tiki time!

The worst Starbucks, not to mention the rudest one, in the city. I went there today to get my mobile order, which was suppose to be ready, and it wasn't. The staff was downright rude to the customers, plus I was rudely told to "put your mask on" when it slipped off my face for less than 5 seconds. I take COVID VERY seriously. I know people who are working on the front lines, not to mention who have caught this awful disease. I could've been politely told to fix my mask. Did I mention my order wasn't ready until 10 min AFTER I got the text that it was SUPPOSE to be ready? This Starbucks is awful. I will never go hear again.

Even if you're not much of a wine drinker, you'll definitely find something to suit your style.  For a wine bar, their liquor selection is par, and if you're not a total beer snob,  they also have an impressive bottled beer list.
Their wine list is über extensive, and even better, every member of the staff I've encountered has impressive knowledge of all of the wines available and is more than happy to assist you in choosing a glass to your liking, even providing multiple tastings. Although I wouldn't label this joint as a "value", their house wines are reasonably priced and during happy hour only four bucks!
I have thoroughly enjoyed everything on their French inspired menu. Everything is always fresh, with simple and clean flavors and simply yet elegantly presented.  Try the house salad, the beef satay, or if you're very hungry, the steak frites is superb!  Portions are relatively small for the price, but the quality makes it well worth the splurge.  I would advise against the cheese or charcuterie plates, neither are anything spectacular, both are limited in variety and ridiculously overpriced.
Vintage is laid back, candlelit, and perfect for relaxing with a few people, a date or solo. It's perfect for that "me" time you've been craving.  Their display of local art for sale, the chandelier made of wine bottles and the wall made of wine crates create an interesting ambience.
Go! You'll love it.
Wonderful salon with great hair stylist and prices. I'm always very pleased with my cut and color. Michele is very knowledgeable and professional. I recommend it to all my friends.
