Love this place! 

 I have been going here for over a year now and each time, I leave happy. 
They are so nice and friendly. They do a wonderful job and it is affordable. 

I would definitely recommend going here.

The "Shrine" has a restaurant on site and it's a great place for lunch.  Have visited on a couple of occasions recently for going away luncheons.  The buffet has about six soup selections daily.  Last Friday featured a BBQ soup/ reminded me of BBQ with pork and beans.  Salad bar featured fresh fruits including honeydew melon and pineapple.   Prices are reasonable and the servers are friendly.  Good location for a small get together

OMG... an airport restaurant/bar that doesn't just have quesadillas, nachos, wings, etc!  

We tried Mosaic's new location recently and we so impressed.  Service was good and the food was excellent...definitely  the best food I've had at lambert airport!  We had the caprese sandwich and the tenderloin sandwich, both were excellent.  The tenderloin sandwich comes with the truffle chips, which should not be missed...yum.  I actually felt like I was eating at a nice restaurant!

Seating is plentiful, there is a bar area with a tv and a larger dining area with booths on the side.  Hopefully that will alleviate the crowd that accumulates around mealtimes at the other A-gate alternatives.

We were informed that the breakfast is great...and I can attest for lunch...so if you're traveling, give this place a try!

I'm not one to spend much time writing reviews, but this place was amazing.  My server took the time to give me recommendations that were spot on! Starting with the tomato basil fondue and then on to the braised short rib, it was probably one of the best meals I've had in years. I could've stopped there, but he recommended the butter cake as a dessert and it was exquisite.  This place just became my favorite restaurant in Boise.

I have been with Fidelity for over 25 years; my husband moved his accounts to Fidelity about 14 years ago.  For the last 5 years we have been bumped from one rep to another without any regard for informing us up front.  Its almost impossible to reach the Santa Barbara office directly.  We have moved our accounts this week and would not recommend Fidelity to anyone we care about.  They are too big for their britches.

Easily the best diner style burger in the Boise area. It might not be the place for you if you like a big gob of meat that tastes like it was washed in the blood of the lame. I happen to like thin well-done patties that are browner than grasshopper spit. It gives the meat the familiar flavor of an old home burger in the distant diner of the mind. The bun is fine, the dressings fresh, the stick taters tasty, & I don't give a hoot to pollute my chute with any custard. I'm sure it's good, but I'm on a low fart diet. If you've got any funk in your spunk, you'll like this place, even if it is a chain.

Was sent here for good po boys.  The sandwiches do not come dressed.  Everything is on the side.  The "lettuce" looked like shredded cabbage (not sure what it was.)  The bread was cold and tough...not warm and flaky such as po boy bread should be.  Service was good but I would not recommend them for po boys.

Great tasty food. There on mother's day but it did not feel too kid friendly, but that was more the clientele than the restaurant. The only complaint was that we have two allergies and when asking very politely about ingredients we got a very flustered and then frustrated response. I chalk it up to the stress of mother's day. It was busy and our requests just slowed the waitress down. Quiche was fluffy and delicious. The seafood omelet was also excellent.
Every time I'm in town we can coming to Steve's the past few years. Produce and meats don't compare to Publix and price or Quality. Keep it local Palm Harbor

Walking by today on my way back from five guys and a person was standing out front of Chickalicious giving out samples.  On their dime? Sign me up. WOW is all i can say. I called them to make sure i had the name of the sauce they used so when I go get an order, I can get them the right way (soy garlic) My previous review mentions some slight disappointments but none of that matters after today. You don't go to a steakhouse and order fish so I suppose you don't go to a chicken house and order something other then chicken. My biggest regret was trying today's delight on my way back from five guys. I was actually tempted to scrap the already purchased lunch and get the Chickalicious goods and if it were not an off-pay week I definitely would have done so. Does someone want to trade me their Chickalicious for my burger? Anyway, stay out of my way and set me aside an order of chicken wings with soy garlic sauce as Arnold so eloquently put it "I'll be Back"

5 stars for everything! I so wish I could've taken a picture of it all. Customer service was awesome and the food was just as great. It was my first time and I got the Bourbon Basket with the EZ blend (recommended by one of the workers). I shared it with my boyfriend and we still couldn't finish it so I definitely felt that I got my money's worth. Will definitely be coming back when I'm in town again!

Lovely atmosphere and good food. I had the creamy strawberries and my boyfriend had the Romeo et Juliet (both sweet crepes) and they were delicious. I ordered a caramel macchiato which turned out to be a simple okay latte. The "macchiato" as they called it just tasted like milk and ice. I think it's probably the worse coffee I've ever had but regardless, the crepes were really good.

Was ok
Tuna wasn't very well prepared
People were nice but for sushi you're better off paying higher prices for better quality

The Country Music Hall of Fame  was great! Just enough on each person so that you can pick up those cool facts that actually stick with you, the audio option is worth it. Also close to the main strip of broadway, you can walk to it from the fun.

If you are a group of people visiting Nashville, my group used www.whattodonashville.com to plan our trip, they got us from place to place and even had one of their "Party Butlers" come with us. It was so awesome and really made Nashville a great memory.
Fun spot to splurge. I had the cookies n' cream "snow."  Tasty. Nothing spectacular, but fun.

My husband and I just ate at Nomzilla for the first time and loved it! There was a groupon available so we decided to try something new. The employees were very friendly and helpful in making our selections, and the food came out fast.

We both had the crunchy shrimp roll, he also had the spicy tuna but substituted the pineapple for avocado. Both were very tasty and fresh. I also tried a "build it yourself" option and made a rice bowl which was great.  

We also both thought the decor was cool and different then the typical sushi place.

This food was so good! I don't have one complaint about my food. The service was amazing and everyone was nice. They even gave us a discount on our bill without us asking because they said we waited too long for our food (which wasn't long at all). Highly recommend!

DO NOT PURCHASE FROM THEM
They called and scheduled my delivery, after over a month waiting, for today 9/15/2020 waiting till 2pm to call and check "your not scheduled till the 22nd"  I took off to be here for delivery,  are they going to reimburse me?  They charge for delivery and 10% cancellation fee,  when you get tired of their runaround.  Good luck trying to get someone on the phone At least 45 minute wait EVERY TIME I'VE CALLED.  Now waiting on back counter manager to call me and tell me COVID delayed! I understand a slight delay....but ASHLEY CALLED ME WITH DELIVERY DATE AND TIME!!!!

WHY call and schedule a delivery YOU HAVE NO INTENTIONS of delivering on that day?  

Reviewing everywhere I can and filed a complaint with the BBB.

BUYERS BEWARE!!
Had some snacks here along with some beer and wine. Friday night they had a live band. A mug of beer (local brewed island blonde), a glass of chianti two meat balls and an order of bread sticks $17

What kind of bowling alley has a DRESS CODE?  This one!

A friend of mine tried to meet us here the other night and was not allowed in because he was wearing a plain white shirt.  Come. On.  I get that this is not supposed to be your average bowling alley, but a DRESS CODE?!  

One star.  Shame on you.

Great atmosphere! There are awesome legit fire pits that will keep you warm during a cool Nola winter. This allows for ample outdoor seating in the time of this pandemic. Also they have food trucks most nights...when I was there a great place was cooking in the inside bar-had Karibu kitchen and for 10$ had a very filling Crunchwrap supreme ( it was not really a "crunch" wrap and more soft flour taco style). it was great!

Super cute store with awesome clothes!  Their accessories were majorly lacking though.  I got the cutest dress there but unfortunately they didn't really have anything to pair with it.  Kind of weird to see so many cute clothes and shoes with no jewelry options, but still loved this store so much!

We took the Ghost and Vampire Tour guided by Luke in early November. He did an amazing job and really made the experience for us.

This tour made about 8-9 stops and our guide wove in additional comments and pointed out buildings of interest as we passed. I think the other reviews cover most of the highlights.

He kept our group together, spoke clearly and made the stories interesting without taking too long to get to the point.

For basically the price of an adult evening movie ticket, I think it is one of the better values in NOLA and highly recommend it.

This Pho gets 5 stars!!! It's carried me through several winters and fought back every time I have had a cold. I normally get the Pho Tai, only because I have an aversion to tripe. The staff is lovely and the prices are cheap. Try it.
LOVE IT! this is one of those rare gems with character. Felt right at home. Lots of color lots of smiles great food great staff. Wish i knew about this place sooner!

3 words. Hot turkey sandwich!  Sooooooooooo good!  Service isn't all that friendly, but c'mon it's a diner.  I've deducted 2 stars because they don't take credit/debit cards.  Who carries cash these days?  C'mon now.  G

If you get anything besides a wrap/sandwich/burger then you may be dissapointed.  I got the cheese ravioli and meatballs my first time there.  I swear that the meatballs smelled like stinky armpits, no joke.  I didn't even attempt to eat them.  Everyone there seemed very nice.

WE CAME BACK... FROM NJ.... and BROUGHT OUR KIDS!!Actually on the last trip to New Orleans we had come back to Tito's 2 more times since the original Yelp review.  This is my new favorite restaurant.  Great food,  great atmosphere,  great staff.  Shout out to our server Brina!!

I ordered from this Jersey Mike's location through Uber Eats.
I had two sandwiched delivered. One to eat right away, the second to take along on my flight.
The first sandwich was the big kahuna with chicken. Being a fan for years of that sandwich with the roast beef, I had to finally try the chicken. Had it on the rosemary parmesan bread. It was absolutely delicious!!! Hurray, another new favorite sandwich!
Later, onboard the airplane in the cockpit, I ate the second sandwich (which had been stored in the airplane cooler for freshness). It was on the same bread style, the #9 Club Supreme, with roast beef, swiss cheese, bacon, fixed Mike's Way. Again, this sandwich was equally as good as the chicken big kahuna!
Jersey Mike's is my all-time go-to favorite sandwich shop. Period!

I can not thank enough the people and staff at Tires Choice, they saved my day!!! I walked in and was greeted with how can I help you and how can I make your visit here better!!! They are truly the best!!!

A.J and Jeff are great tour guides - super willing to share information about the local area, including the amazing ecology of the Pearl River and its inhabitants.  The trip was at just the right pace, with plenty of time to explore the swamp and even have a little lie-down in the sun. Really fun and way better than riding on a motor boat with a crowd!

Decided to stop in tonight while waiting on my car to be finished at the mechanic nearby. I normally like more authentic Mexican restaurants, but for Red Habanero I make an exception. Their food is always good and I'm a sucker for a good margarita. I chose the frozen pomegranate margarita tonight, good but mango is still my favorite. The chips are fresh and warm, salsa is good but could be a bit spicier in my opinion. I had the cilantro cream enchiladas with a side of rice and black beans....very good! Not a bad choice at all for decent Mexican on a weeknight.

This tiny venue is not only the backdrop for the hit show, Nashville, but also boasts performers such as Taylor Swift.

Reservations fill up weeks in advance and by a stroke of luck, we got tickets to an open mic night, just the day before. Because there were only two of us, they put us right against the stage. We got to watch 18 solo musicians stand up on the tiny platform and sing their heart out for a few minutes. A few got called up for a second round. 

We enjoyed fries and beers and loved the intimate feel of the venue. We truly got to know the crowd and singers. Such a magical night!
I had a great experience here. Antonio and the rest of the staff were very professional and knowledgable and I found a great pair of glasses. I will definitely return in the future.
Just what we needed!  Got into SB late and saw Dave's on yelp.  They had great topping choices.  Dave and his crew were awesome!
Amazing!!!  Make sure you say HI to Gene! Get chicken st. Charles! Owners should be proud of team

Just because of where I grew up, sometimes, I just crave German things. Not just the food, but the atmosphere and everything. And this place absolutely delivered on that. 

The store front alone was so beautiful it's worth mentioning, it was all wooden with flower beds and a small garden table out front. The inside had the same affect, with a little stereo playing polka music which made me personally incredibly happy. I had come that morning for pastries, and they had a very wide selection. Unfortunately most of the pastries weren't labeled or priced, but the lady behind the counter was very willing to describe what each pastry was and how much it cost. (I would take off a half star if I could for the prices not being displayed, but its certainly not worth reducing the rating to four-stars over)

I decided to get a croissant stuffed with blueberries and cream cheese, and it was absolutely delicious. The croissant was buttery and flaky and the filling was the perfect amount of sweetness. It was filling enough for someone like myself who usually eats a small breakfast, but it would be a delicious addition to a large breakfast too.

Visiting this bakery absolutely made my day just a little bit better.

Always terrible. Always. Sandwich was thrown together sloppily missing an ingredient, the fries were all cold and half full, missing sauces, and the drink was carbonated soda water. Every time we go to this location they forget something or mess it up. It's not that difficult. No wonder they only have 2 1/2 star rating. I'm done and won't ever be returning. Learn to do your job.

Zero sense of urgency. It seems like everyone working is on their own schedule. Super annoying to see 7 people working and only one person working the line- as it is now out the door. Won't be returning to this location. You'd think since it is in a very popular/busy area of Tampa that they would be doing better. I've been in line now for 20 minutes- and there was only 4 people in front of me to begin with.

Been going here for 10 years!!  The food is yummy but what keeps me coming back is the service.  They are family owned and always go above and beyond for their clients.  They even remember you when you call!  So many times I will call, they will address me by name, and then ask how my husband is doing (by name!!).  LOVE THEM!

Frustrating. I went there on a Friday night, placed my order in person, and was told "20 minutes". I came back 15 minutes later - and they repeatedly said my order was "in the back being prepared"... I stood at the counter (despite their suggestion I take a seat) for another 35 minutes - at which point they claimed somebody else claimed my order and they would "start cooking it now" - almost an hour after I ordered it. I politely requested a refund and left. They never really made the effort to figure out where my order was, brushing me off repeatedly, instead.

The very next day, my wife insists we try again Saturday night - I make her go because I'm too irritated to EVER go back - and we get General Tso's that's COLD and completely over cooked or re-cooked (a steak knife couldn't make it through the gristle)... Wife tried it and agreed... My guess is they're making General Tso's in afternoon batches and shoveling it into boxes as the orders come in. IMO - save your money, save your time... I expect more - They need to get their act together.

Came here for the all vegan sushi menu and was not disappointed! It's hard to find good vegetarian sushi but Tomo knows exactly how it's done. The menu is next-level imaginative and you won't be able to find rolls like these elsewhere. The Harvest Roll was AMAZING-- who knew sweet potato could taste so good in sushi! Their vegetarian miso ramen was equally flavorful. Our waiter was outstanding and I'm so glad we stumbled upon this hole in the wall restaurant. Ask for some extra spice on the side if you want some chili oil, garlic, and chili paste to go with your meal. Looking forward to trying out more of the vegan sushi menu and highly recommend all of my fellow vegetarians to do the same!
The Tacos weren't very good but their 'happy hour' specials will blow your mind. When I ordered 13 beers for 14 dollars I knew I had made a friend for life.

This place is Hott mess. I came in late February or early March (before Covid 19 quarantine) and I was okay with the service, nothing spectacular. I got about 15 minutes from the dispensary and they (Herbology) call me and they needed me to come back to the dispensary because they gave me someone else's medical marijuana ID and driver's license smh

Do not order mixed drinks here. Very bad! They used canned pineapple that had sat out room temp in an open can. I didn't know this before I tried it, but I kept saying how weird it tasted. I sat at the bar, right by the cash register and at least 4 different staff members heard me. Not one offered to do anything.
The pizza was only slightly better than the drink. I would never go here again, nor would I recommend anyone else too.

One of my favorite sushi spots in the city. The head sushi chef there is amazing and nothing shy of an artist. She's even made things for us we've requested that aren't on the menu. Great customer service. Our favorite rolls are the fried fish roll and the scorpion roll but I've never gotten a roll there I didn't like!
Their coffee is pretty decent -- pretty comparable to places around it but this lemon poppy muffin is not good lol...very dry and flavorless.
My Westie always gets the best care and service at this Petsmart location! Everyone treats Sophie special and I know she is in good hands!
Proceed with caution with the spice level. I went with hot and I probably should have gone with medium. Flavor was great, fast and polite service.

We happened upon this place by consulting Yelp and loved it. Wonderful breads, salads and sides. We had grilled eggplant sandwich, grilled cheese and turkey sandwich. Gazpacho was excellent too. Great service. I left my hat behind and they were as nice as can be when I called and came back to retrieve it. A winner!

Really torn, probably more like 3 1/2 stars.  It's a solid Chinese food place, but nothing extraordinary.  We had the dinner specials, and you get a TON of food for a ridiculously low price.  I probably will return here and try another dish (had Mongolian beef, which was solid, but again, didn't stand out).

I like the idea of what this place wants to become, but I don't think it has quite the right locale nor vibe to become it...yet...at least for me. Please don't get me wrong, the drink options and what we actually tried there were fantastic. However, when you pay $10-12 for a drink, there is a certain expectation to have vibe that compliments it. Places like Patterson House, Roth & Daughters, and Holland House pull it off bc they have the ambience to match not just the drink price, but the drinks themselves. Amari, while displaying a great menu of drink options somewhat misses the mark as the next hipster crafty cocktail joint. It's too a bit open, the wall art is a bit too casual, and the speakeasy hook didn't quite hook me. That said, it might work on the hipper Vandy/Belmont crowd. I'm just a non-trendy drink snob wannabe. All that said, the service was great and our server's knowledge of the menu and spirits was top notch. I may come back to try the food, just to give this place a second chance.

I've meant to write this review for quite some time, but being the procrastinator that I am, I waited and waited and waited, until now. Better late than never, I guess.

I first visited Apsara about a year ago. At that time, I was going through a rather difficult time with my hair. It was falling out...in huge chunks! It wasn't diffuse either, I was losing hair in about 4 focal areas, some the size of a quarter and others the size of a fist. I had alopecia areata. My personal remedy at the time was to simply forgo getting a haircut and allow my still intact hair to cover the areas that were missing. But eventually, it reached a point where I started to look ridiculous and needed a haircut in the worst way. However, I was, to say the least, quite apprehensive about my situation, and felt the need to venture beyond my neighborhood barbershop. I needed skilled hands and a skilled eye. So I went to yelp in search of a helping hand.

It took me nearly a week to decide on where to schedule my appointment. I read a ton of reviews running the full spectrum of salons and barbershops in Philadelphia before deciding on Mary and Apsara. 

This may sound like hyperbole, but in all honesty, it was the best decision that I could have possibly made. I was just so nervous at first and not only did Mary recognize that and listen to my concern, she was very skilled. She cut my hair in such a way that my hair looked great and my gigantic bald spots were not noticeable. Not only that but my hair still managed to look great growing in, which in my mind is the true mark of a great haircut.  All this in spite of several areas of scalp that were completely devoid of hair.

Since then my hair has finally filled back in, however, I still go to Mary and Apsara and cannot imagine going anywhere else.  Skilled hands, a skilled eye, and a kind ear.

Great Mexican. Ordered the short rib nachos, fish tacos and Margie. Service and atmosphere were great. The only reason I didn't give them a 5 is because I would prefer El Vez if I had the choice. I love frozen margaritas and Feliz didn't have that option. Also I wish the fish tacos were served on corn tortillas. And the actual chips in the nachos seemed like bagged chips instead of fried corn tortillas. Great option for authentic Mexican in the city!!

I don't buy my dog food here, but they always have a fun selection of frozen specialty treats that my dogs love.  The leashes are pricey, but they last forever (you will seriously just get tired of it before it rips or frays) .  Five stars!

So, we came here for a weekend trip to Sesame place.  Overall experience with the hotel and the amenities were good.  Front Check-in staff were super friendly.  Housekeeping was super nice and the restaurant staff were good.  My 3 star rating is strictly due to the guests that stayed right across the hall from us and how the hotel handled these noisy guests.  

I guess it must have been a wedding or something, but the guests were literally partying until 4AM, talking in the hall ways and opening and slamming doors.  I complained to the front desk in the morning and they acknowledged that multiple people complained and they informed me that security was contacted and dispatched multiple times and that they should have been evicted, but weren't.  Obviously, it wasn't the hotel's fault for this, but if multiple people complained, why not action appropriately?

At any rate, the overall experience with the hotel itself was not bad.  Pretty clean, rooms a bit dated, but overall, not a bad place to stay.

i had some emergency things i needed to get done and was unable to due to covid. 
they got me in right away, very friendly, very good covid screening, and safety, etc
Was able to fix my problem, no hidden fees, upselling or surprises.

overall very satisfied and will go back
hate going to the dentist lol

The owners were quite rude and not very accommodating .my family and some friends (10 in all ) meet there and I was asked by my sister who had been there several times to bring a cheese plate as she and others have done many times before  ..I made sure to ask that this was ok to do and even checked their website to make sure ..there was no menu no mention that no outside food was not allowed  ..they stopped me on the way in and said they don't allow outside food we serve food Now and offered to put in the fridge ..I didn't  make a fuss ..my sister was Insulted when they said if your here to get drunk your in the wrong place ...my sister had never been to the winery before ..we shrugged it off , did a tasting , bought acouple bottles of wine ,and ordered some pizza service was slow but they took time to watch we didn't bring any outside food .when the food came they basically threw it on the table ..and never came back with napkins plates ...the pizza was ok and the wine ..so back to the car to get Napkins and plates being watched again ..we ate,cleaned up ,brought back our glasses  and went to unionville winery 10 mins down the road and was treated very well  ...not one of us will ever go back and I suggest you find someplace else

The pizza is light and everything is fresh and locally sourced. The place is still rather new, so many people don't know where they are located. I would give it another couple months before it starts to really grow! The whole thing is such a cool concept, and there really isn't anything like it in the area. The food is great and the staff is amazing, definitely recommend!

What a find! This is in a 100 year-old building with original brick walls. It is small, but that doesn't keep it from serving great beer and delicious food. The beer is described as small-batch craft beer, The food is close to gourmet and is prepared right behind the bar using a variety of cooking utensils. I had the Veggie Meatballs with polenta, raw tomato sauce and gremolata. Fantastic! My buddy had the Short Rib Taco snack with hoisin, kimchi and scallions and the Tomato Panini with sweet pea guacamole and pickled egg. He loved both. Give this place a try.

I am so thankful that Butcher and The Barkeep has come into the area! It was much needed!
As far as the food goes, I can't get enough of. Their Shrimp and Grits is to die for! 
Im tend to be a Beer drinker (which they have a fantastic selection of) but their cocktails are some of the best I have had! 
The service and bar staff are knowledgable and friendly. 
I look forward to going back

Puckett's is a mix of so many wonderful things from live music to unique concept to the steady stream of customers enjoying themselves late into the evening. Chicago doesn't have musicians playing on every restaurant corner so it was nice to relax after work with a little country music while we ate and drank. The food was okay but I have a feeling it's the music and concept that keep people coming back in droves. The place was packed! 

Our 7pm reservation on a Wednesday turned out to be something we actually needed. People were standing 2 deep near the front wall as open tables were hard to come by. And this was after we were seated. The music was inviting without being too loud. Some songs reached a level making communication rather difficult but in general the noise level wasn't too bad. 

The beer list was primarily full of mass produced domestics of which I wasn't a fan - then again I'm a big city beer snob looking for great craft brew from small breweries around the country. Our spinach artichoke dip and fried pickle & jalapeno appetizers were a nice start. Both were better than some of the other restaurants we've visited in Nashville. But my ribeye steak was a little disappointing. It was tough, stringy, and I ended up leaving 50% of my steak uneaten due to the large amounts of fat. I understand ribeyes have fat - this is why I order them. But this was more like I ordered a fat steak with a little ribeye meat on the side. It was served with bacon wrapped green beans, mashed potatoes and a corn cake. The sides played their supporting role as nothing special was eaten in the group. 

The apple pie with ice cream for dessert was good as well. I'm an apple pie maker at home so they were up against stiff competition from my taste buds but it was a nice close to our dinner. The best thing about Puckett's was the atmosphere. It's a fun place to be and be seen. You can get better food in Nashville but you may not get a better place.

I love bell and this was by far the worst experience at a Taco Bell of my life. Me and my buddies get Taco Bell all the time together and they are usually pretty good, but this location was the worst service I've ever experienced.

They literally messed up every single item that we ordered, and that not including them just completely forgetting half the items we ordered.

Than, the guy at the drive thru window was extremely rude and mad at us that we came to get some Taco Bell. 

The jerk store called and there running out of that guy!!!

I thought the experience was nice. The restaurant was nice and roomy with high ceilings. Decoration and cleanliness was noticeable. It's the complete opposite of Noodle City in Goleta. Most Vietnamese restaurants are straight up dive-y, but this one was totally respectable w/o taking a hit on quality. My only nit picky things we're the slow service and the noodles we're falling apart...not as firm as most Pho places. Other than that, the place is good!
Dope ass bbq and great service! Not a beer drinker but looks like they have a lot of choices!

Hands down the best family owned authentic Italian food I've ever had. Ordered the grilled octopus which was perfectly cooked. Also had the seafood spaghetti. I highly suggest you order this dish if you like seafood. So flavorful and light. Pasta is cooked perfectly and is fresh. Do your self a favor and make this place your next stop. The owners are super kind. The service is good as well. Plenty of seating outside. Recommend a reservation if you want inside seating

Short:

Southern Buffet, good price, great tasting. Southern Hospitality. 

Long:

I've been here a few times, but usually for breakfast.  The breakfast is incredible.  A good selection of everything you would want.  From the sweet to the savory.  My favorite dish is the potatoes and cheese casserole.  The have the common breakfast items, eggs, bacon, sausage, and grits.  Pretty much everything you'd expect at a southern restaurant. 

Even though this is a buffet, the service here is wonderful.  The people are all friendly.  Staff here will make you feel you are at a genuine southern restaurant.   The table was kept clear and you never have to worry about asking for refills.

Overall, wonderful place to enjoy breakfast for friends and family.  I wish there was one closer to Tampa!

Nice little casino to get ur little gambling fix but it doesn't compare st all to Vegas Casinos. It's a mostly no smoking casino but there is a Smokers lounge which a little area outdoors that has several machines.

Limited but tasty breakfast menu served in a "bohemian" casual atmosphere. Counter service was excellent.  Kitchen turn was fast.  Food was fresh made from high quality ingredients.  Coffee was excellent.  Recommended!

I wanted sweet and sour chicken without the breading.  The lady at the counter told me they don't do that.  The chicken is already battered.  So I asked if they can use the chicken they make hunan chicken with and she said yes.  Instead, what I got was unseasoned steamed chicken.  It was awful

Enjoyed dinner at Tuscan Sun. Service was good. Meal didn't all come out at once which was s bit of a disappointment but the food was delicious nonetheless. 
Would go back. Nice evening!

Not a big fan of cheesecake factorys food forever. Living downtown Chicago where they have a location closed to where i lived ...but drinks aee great n portions are huge...i dont eat that much thats why they not a fit for me...first time at this location staying at the Hamptons inn very close...great bartender guy on his 50s amazing...kinda shady blonde bartender like trying to make me look bad in front her public the ppl behind me...he was a great service turkey burger not for me w them sweet onion gross ... very nice manager...so far i will be back at least for drinks ....

The best place we ate at in NOLA. The chargrilled oysters were to for for. Add to that the Fried soft shell crabs and we were In heaven. The pecan pie was perfect. Great food. Amazing service .
Food comes fast and it is always full. Hats off to the team to running an efficient ship. 

There is a waiting line, but it moves fast so don't be disheartened and go to another restaurant. We did that on day one and I wish we hadn't.

I used to love Emma's, but the last few months things have gone downhill.  The salon got a cute semi-makeover, the only improvement, and prices have increased to pay for the new tables and stools .  Three times in the last few months my "perfect match" gel and regular polishes have not matched (I like to have gel on my fingers and regular polish on my toes).  Every time I mention it to Andy, the owner, he tells me I can get gel on my toes so they match.  The problem is he wants to charge me an additional $10 for the gel polish and another $5 to remove it on my next visit if I don't get gel again.  My last visit was the last straw.  The polishes didn't match again so I talked to Andy.  I also told him about a friend whose gel polish had been chipping within the first week.  As the conversation progressed, Andy's attitude worsened.   I suggested that we were going to try a different salon if the same problems kept coming up and Andy said "I don't care if my customers go to another salon".  At that point I realized the discussion was futile so I turned and walked away from him.  I'll definitely be going to another salon from now on.

Holy cow, where do I even start?  The food was SO GOOD.  I mean, absolutely incredible.  I got so many compliments from all of my guests about the dinner that we served at our wedding.  And thats pretty nice when you consider the fact that we weren't making food our #1 priority!  

We tasted with several different caterers before deciding to go with Catering Connection, and we couldn't be happier with our decision.  Hands down, they had the best food for the money.  I literally felt like I was eating a 5-star meal.  And their presentation is immaculate.  They pay attention to details, which I love.  Perfectly sliced lemons in each water ... perfectly placed little pieces of bread with butter next to it.  They made sure that the food tasted just as good as it looked, which was important to us. 

One of my biggest fears in choosing a caterer is that they would put their best foot forward during the tasting, but on the wedding day, it would be a step-below.  The exact opposite is true with Catering Connection.  The wedding day food was actually better than the tasting, which I didn't even think was possible. 

They also made Sangria for our bar and it was a hit!  I can't recommend them enough.

The steak burgers are so good here and so is the frozen custard. The frozen custard here is way better than the competitors. The fries are small, skinny fries and they have a fry sauce that pairs well with it. The staff is always helpful and friendly and the prices aren't too bad. Try it, so much good stuff.

So since my first review everything has gone downhill in regards to this restaurant from the food, delivery, to the  customer service. Price for food is now seemingly double what it was pre Covid and they also now charge 6 dollars for delivery. I was able to order an order that they were going to charge me $60 for down the street for only $35, and the quality of the food was better. Sad state of affairs now I drive past it and see it empty where once it had a line of folks waiting.

Virginia took the time to make my color and cut look beautiful. She really took her time to help guide me through color choices. The salon has a great vibe! Very relaxing experience!  Thanks Virginia!  Cheers,  Maggie

While the quality of the food served here is very good, the prices are insanely high and are not at all justified.  The quality of the service is good but the overall feeling here is one of pretentiousness.  Their insistence on having reservations to eat there is also highly questionable since they have very few customers and it also indicates a level of self-importance on the part of the owners that is downright snobbish.  Do yourself a favor and avoid eating here at all costs.

BUFFALO CAULIFLOWER TACOS were amazing! 

We went here on a Saturday afternoon and happy we stumbled upon this place. There is a small bar immediately when walking in with about 10 tables in the back. It was intimate with a great vibe. 

Our waiter was awesome and recommended some amazing dishes. For two people we ordered 4 dishes and it was plenty for us. The second to last dish was the Buffalo cauliflower tacos and I would have easily ordered two more entrees of it that's how good it was. 

Location is great,  tucked away next to a small park,  walkable from SEPTA

Highly recommend!

Cara Frank is my 'go to' for Chinese herbal medicine. She has thirty years experience treating patients with acupuncture and herbs. Cara created the herbal medicine program at Won institute and is a current faculty member. She really knows her stuff!  Her company, China Herb is right on the premises so my herbs are fresh and of the highest quality. Her knowledge of herbs is top notch. Booking appointments is easy and can be done online, front desk staff is very friendly, and even though it's in the city, parking is not that bad! Want a trusted practitioner for Chinese herbs? Go see Cara!

Terrible company for delivery. Ordered Super Bowl accessories and it is sitting in their Bristol location since yesterday 2/2/18.  Need it by today and they changed the delivery date till 2/5/18. Both NFL.com and their delivery service stink.  I ordered the items on 1/22/18 and was promised it will be delivered by today.  Both companies failed their promises.
The food was really good. Large portion. Jambalaya was one of the best I've had in a while. Would definitely go back!

I was unhappy with an experince I had, and I left a review. Not even 24 hours after my review the owner Tracie replyed, she called me. She texted me and wanted me to come back. When I came back she did everything to rectify the problem. She gave me an amazing Moroccan oil treatment and everything free of charge and really hooked me up. She takes pride in her buisness and what she does like every buisness owner should. This will be the onky place I get my hair done in the Philadelphia area! I appreciate this place so much!

Went to the Piano Bar at Harrah's and was thrilled that my favorite pianist was there, but was disappointed because he spent most of the time playing a drum set. As always the pianists were their usual "charming" selves entertaining all but the atmosphere seemed toned down compared to my previous experiences with this venue. In my personal opinion you can find the most amazing musicians at the Piano Bar. Great job guys!
Excellent! Dinner for two near the fireplace. We had the NY Strip with potatoes and mixed veggies. Very good service as well. Not crowded as we arrived early on Sunday evening. We will return.

I called at 6;45.  It's now 9:45 and after waiting over an hour and a half at my house, not only my food not show up I never even got the decency of a phone call.  Was told wait time would be 45 minutes to hour which was very reasonable. 
We were at my house for an hour and half before we left completely famished.  Thankfully chickies and petes wasn't  too far.  But really, this Philly seafood company totally ghosted us.  Not even a phone call to tell us that something happened or that they just felt a weird need to not come through.  Don't order here with good expectations.

Interior is very clean and well designed. The staff was perfectly attentive and cordial. While my experience with Indian cuisine is limited, I enjoyed what I ordered. Will do definitely return, felt it was an extreme value.

Ummmmmm okay. 

What a time and calorie effective class! I am already seeing results after 2 classes. 

Also, I'm so out of shape. I have never ran or been encouraged appropriately. Everyone comes in because they are somewhat out of shape or desire a nicer body so don't be scared to come in. We are all reaching for the same goals. 

Tony is really great! Class is always packed. The girls up front (esp   Abigail) are sooooo nice and very helpful. 

I hate coming to class but I end up loving it at the end of class.

Came for a birthday dinner and service was great. Very attentive. We started with Parmesan garlic chicken wings for an appetizer.
Then we all Had different burgers. They were very good. The fries are different, kinda like curly steak fries.
Trying new chicken menu for first time. Dogs are awesome so expecting to be as good. Love the different styles they have.

Not going to lie. My husband has more than once, fantasized about friending the grill guy in the hopes that we can "invite" him to a BBQ at our house one day. And of course he'd invite him early. 
Here's why-
this place does meat right!! Very, absolutely, tender, delicious right.  And did I mention that I'm not really a "meat person"? Well unless it's "don't bother to pick up the ribs cause they'll fall apart anyways" ribs. Or crispy skinned, moist inside chicken. Or grilled, slightly spicy chicken wings.
Hmm...maybe I am a "meat person" after all? Or at least I am when I'm eating here? 
Don't come for gourmet, delicious sides. It's not one of those places (although, I do admit to asking for more "Lucky 
Wishbone-ish" toast to sop up the spicy pinto beans on occasion). 
This far west side local restaurant offers a full bar, no frills decor (decorate a dollar bill and stick it to the wall and eventually it'll get donated to a great cause) and friendly atmosphere. 
Any ideas on making my husband's fantasy come true can drop me a message. Much appreciated.

As I walked in, I noticed a vibrant (read LOUD) bar scene.  I watched with devouring (pun intended) eyes and salivating mouth as a huge plate of Ethiopian food was carried past me at the bar and up a set of stairs behind me.  My friend and I inquired and found out that we could eat either downstairs at the tables set up in a room just past the bar or upstairs.  We chose to venture upstairs.   

Upstairs there were 3 rooms: 1 with a pool table set up (we saw some Ethiopian? men playing bocci), 1 with a bar and about 7 tables and 1 in the back with 2 tall tables and bar stools.  This last room had a patio door that led out onto a porch with more tables.  We decided to sit in the room with the 7 tables (too much PDAs coming from the couple sitting in the last room - yuck! ). The bar was empty and the room very quiet.  The track lighting and lighting fixtures in all the rooms were different and interesting.  The walls all look freshly painted with delightful pastel/citrus colors; one wall had a mural on it.  There were also 2 huge LCD tvs playing sports (for you ladies that have to convince your guy to try Ethiopian).  

The service was slow; all part of the Ethiopian trend.   But our waiter (possible proprietor?) was very friendly.  We ordered a combination platter for 2.  When the platter came, I was amazed.  These platters just keep getting bigger and bigger!  There was a good amount more food than at Kaffa's.  We tasted the food mmmm!  The food was quite good, but a bit oversalted.  But the food really was not bad at all. The most amazing part of the food was the injera though.  This injera (maybe Kaffa's disappointment was just too much for me) was perfect in consistency!  It was thick and perfectly spongy!  Still not completely sour enough for my taste.  There seemed to be a spice that they threw into the injera that gave it a unique flavor that no one else's injera had, but it left a sandy feeling in your mouth afterwards (no doubt the ground up spice in question).  I did not mind the extra flavor, but was not sure it outweighed my personal distaste (why yes, I am punny today) for the texture.
Very small place in a strip mall that makes the best Italian food in Madeira beach and beyond. Best chicken parm I've ever had.

Nice little place on Spanish plaza. Straight forward menu but with enough choices that everyone can find something. Drink prices are actually not terrible considering you are in the middle of tourist central. Can't comment on quality of food because we aren't eating but what i can talk about is the service.  AL IS OUTSTANDING!!!!I can't stress it enough....ASK FOR AL!! And no,  i don't know him,  never even heard of him until we randomly walked in while waiting for our NYE fireworks cruise. He is personality plus,  efficient and just all around awesome. Since I'm a local,  i don't find myself in this area much but he's the kind of guy I wish worked, or even better bartended, somewhere locals go because I'd go just for the service. Just saying,  ASK FOR AL...tell him Rebecca sent ya...lol.

Horrible service and the "Service Manager" Camille is the worst, does not genuinely help a customer who spends hundreds on repairs nor shows any empathy, but yet spends more time highlighting an employee characteristics? I care more about getting the service I had booked than listening to a manager rant and rave about an employee. I have never dealt with such an unprofessional and uneducated "Manager" in my life. Once you drop your vehicle off you are not even greeted, instead you wait there until someone comes available. Capital Jeep is better and management is easier to deal with. I will spend my money and extra warranty cost at Capital Jeep.

Hands down, the coolest comic book store I've ever stepped foot in. We were spending the day in St. Pete and stopped in while it was storming. We probably could've spent even longer here if we weren't so hungry. Vast selection of comics and comic related memorabilia, along with tabletop games including a ton of demos with a demo room. My kids were in love. We will definitely go back!

I just stopped by here today and the minute I entered it felt like home. A family run business and I was welcomed so warmly. The portions are healthy and the falafels here are to die for! I got fresh falafel batch of the day. It was so delicious, you could tell they were home made; very flavorful. I also tried their berry lemonade (again home made). So delicious! Highly recommend this spot for delicious Mediterranean food.

Wow! Awesome food and so much of it!! You won't leave hungry from this place. Great atmosphere and stunning service. You will never have an empty coffee cup. Servers are always coming past. Food was different but creative and exceptional! Our server Matt was so nice!

This is a great space to get work done. I always find my best coffee shop productivity is at Ugly Mugs. 

The atmosphere is relaxing. The music is playing, but not too loudly, so that it is not disruptive, but pleasant. 

I like how they are open late. Mon-Fri 6 am-10 pm and Sat-Sun 7 am-10 pm.

There is usually local artwork hanging on the walls. They also have songwriters nights.

I'm new to Santa Barbara and have pain-in-the-ass Asian hair.  A co-worker recommended Riverblue, and I've gone three times since moving here.  My appointments are always right on time and I'm always treated like a princess.  Twan (the owner, I think that's how you spell his name) helped me find a new haircut, breaking me out of the rut I've been in for the past 14 years.  

Their new digs are open and airy and very clean.  I love their stylists; their depth of knowledge and experience makes me trust them completely (something very important in a hair stylist).  I can't wait to try their other services:  coloring, manis, pedis, and facials!
The worst service ever in the history of me going to drive Thur for food. The lady taking the order in also the manager no customer service at all thank you

This place was amazing and the home-cooked Chicken fried chicken all I have to say about this restaurant Everything is Delicious reminded me of my grandmother's homemade foods. The waitress was nice and friendly with our family. We're coming definitely will be back. See you soon . 

Thank you for the Great Service!

Came in to Barber on 24th with some very messy hair. I had been growing it out for a while in hopes of trying a new style as I transitioned between jobs. I easily made an appointment over the phone (they have great hours!) and went to see Melissa. She did a great job showing me the way my hair naturally grows and explaining some options of what I could do with it. I decided on a more classic look and Melissa expertly trimmed, faded, and styled to get it set up right for a new style and even recommended style tips and products to use at home. Best thing - wife highly approved and wants me to go back to Melissa for my next cut. Very highly recommended.

I've been here a few times because I live in the area but this is definitely the worst ice cream I've had in Indy. The prices are way overpriced for ice cream that isn't that great. All the flavor options are okay but the ice cream itself isn't that great (because ice cream shops like this buy their ice cream from other businesses meaning they don't make it). Also everyone who works here is relatively pretty young and I've not been treated very kindly, maybe management needs to crack down some. The service from these teens are lacking a lot. If your wanting something a little expensive from rude teens and with no good quality or quantity of ice cream, come here!

We had a party of 9 for a special birthday on 5/14.  Ruben was fantastic--very professional and on top of things during the reservation process.  They had prepared  a dedicated, upbeat area with end-on-end tables in the restaurant.  This is a new restaurant, and they are just getting their feet on the ground. Still, the block had suffered a power outage the day before, and our reservation for this special occasion was honored.  In fact, they made no mention of their inconveniences--we only learned about it later.  The service was prompt, friendly, and fun.  They made the evening feel special---they put the effort into it.  This typically only happens when the owner /operator of the restaurant is involved--which he was throughout the evening.  We took their advice on the wine, and it was fantastic.  We ordered most everything off the menu, starting with small plates as appetizers, and shared, family style.  We did the same thing with the mains.  The staff and owner were totally on board and enthusiastic about our sharing all of the dishes.  We loved the food--all of it.  The ramen was the small plate dish that we ordered twice--absolutely fantastic.  We LOVED all of the small plates---with at least 3 discerning "foodies" in our group.  We also ordered the pommes frites twice--and shared up and down the table--it was great.  The wasabi mashed potatoes were great; we were not crazy about the croquettes (potatoes).  The spare ribs, the bone morrow, the lamb belly--how good can it get?  We ordered: beef cheeks, divers scallops, seabass, 'reconstructed" chicken, and beef cheeks. In sum, we were impressed and enlightened.  We want this restaurant to succeed, because we love food and live in Santa Barbara.

The Sweet Sweet Bacon shake was awesome (at first).  The taste starts with Makers and then quickly fades as the salty caramel ice cream cuts the alcohol completely away, but it's so thick and so sweet that it gets overwhelming.  Half-size would be perfect.

The PB&J (Pesto Bison Jam) was OK, but pretty salty.  I'd rather add more jam to balance it out.  Also, the bun was a little cold (like not even lukewarm), fell apart a bit, and ultimately didn't add anything to the burger, which is interesting, because you can tell that all the combinations were well-thought out and tested.  These creations (and you don't often get to call a burger a creation, but this label is well-deserved here) are very intentional, very unique, and generally sound pretty good, so it's a disappointment that the bun doesn't match.

The American was pretty good.  The grass-fed beef was solid, the cheese with the mac and cheese was perfect, and the bacon added a small kick.  I didn't taste the house sauce or sriracha mayo to the point where I was surprised to read that they were on the burger, but it didn't matter.  Good combo of classic comfort foods.

I wish I had time to try out the sodas, the spiked root beer float, the other burgers, the fries and dipping sauces, etc, because the menu is so full of cool ideas.  I'd be surprised if any of the burger toppings was used in more than 2-3 other burgers.  That's how creative they are.

My first time here. Everyone is very friendly and the food is amazing! Our server was Tina and she was so helpful. We ordered the "crack" chicken and the chow fun small. I will come back next time I'm in town.

We loved our meal here. The Cesar salad was grilled which gave it so much more flavor. We also had the carpaccio appetizer which was also very tasty with great sauce on the side. I had a 10oz prime Filet mingnon, it was very tender and full of flavor. I opted to have it blackened and it gave it a nice spice as well.  Wife had a barrel cut ribeye, she loved it. Ohhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh the truffle oil, parmisain french fries were heaven.  Very romantic dinning here. Service was good as well. Then we got our bill, Ohh boy, but it was worth it..

Their gold coast chocolate is amazing. I never order anything else, because I like it so much... so I can't really comment on the other flavors. But I've never heard friends say they disliked what they ordered! The huge drumsticks are intriguing. Maybe someday I will give one a try. 

On a summer day, there is nothing better than an ice cream cone here. 

Be warned that the smallest size is REALLY small. Like a spoonful! You will probably want more.

Food is great here! What a wonderful surprise !!
Chicken shawarma plate is so tasty that I had to order it again for a take out. Meze was another plate that I recommend it highly.

I'm shocked no one has reviewed Adriana's yet!  It's one of the best pizza places around.  Their plain pizza has great sauce with basil and just enough cheese.  Their specialty pizzas are great, and they will even give you 1/2 of one specialty and 1/2 of another on the same pie.  Their salads are really what's amazing - you wouldn't expect it from a pizza place, but from their regular house salad to their Meditteranean, they're all great.  It's BYOB, so bring a nice bottle and head to Adriana's.

Came here after work on a Friday evening, around 4:30. There was only one other table when my boyfriend and I walked in. The waitress and owner didn't greet or seat us, so we sat ourselves at a table. We did feel a bit out of place for the first 5 minutes but that awkwardness dissipated once we got our bowls of pho ga. 

The chicken - juicy and tender, you could really taste how fresh it was. The noodles - soft and slightly chewy. The broth- simple but flavorful. Overall, the pho ga definitely lived up to the hype and is definitely worth driving deep into the hood for. Plus, traveling down Kensington Ave (under the el) made for an entertaining drive back home!

My order was 15 minutes late and they cut there phones off 30 minutes before closing every night. How can you call for an update on a delivery if you cut off your phones a half hour before closing. How do I know if my food will arrive and you already charge me... smh

Had a steak and chicken and shrimp burrito and I had a lot of steak and chicken and 2 pieces of shrimp. I guess my expectation is if the menu says 3 items that I would get the same amount of each item. Then I told the waitress thinking it was an error but no she says that's all that comes with it and started laughing and walked away. Now with that being said the food is great here I mean really good but was very disappointed with my burrito. Spoke with the mgr and he was very nice so if you want shrimp in your burrito don't order one here.
In town for work and this food is amazing!!!  Different type of Mexican food than I've had in Utah, but very good.  Nice service as well

I was so craving a chicken home wrecker so I decided to have one for lunch...my first sign should have been that they were not very busy at 2:00 pm. Any who so I placed my order with half a spoonful of toppings. Got home and bit into my burrito and what a disappointment it was!! 
My beans taste burnt and the rice was a little crunchy or maybe it was the scorched beans. This was by far the worse burrito ever...even down to the flour tortilla which tasted like raw dough. A total epic fail on that Moe's!!

Awesome place  atmosphere is great. Service great and staff are super friendly. The food they have is great for a beach bar like place. Many items are fresh or home made. Enough drink choices to please everyone. If you want fine dining and a $150 steak and wine dinner go somewhere else. That is not the objective of this place. Snobby pompous people should avoid coming. You ruin the atmosphere. This is a hidden gem. If you visit enjoy it and appreciate it.

We just moved to the area and were needing a preschool for our 2 year old, my friend that has a child here recommended we check out the Little Golden Goose. With three children, We have high expectations for schools. We were so impressed by the professionalism and care shown by the staff during our tour, we immediately enrolled our son. The owner truly cares about the well being and happiness of all of the children. We are thrilled with all of the social and academic bounds our son has made since being there! Our son is always so happy to go to school, which makes us feel like he loves it just as much as we do!
This is just good, authentic, savory, Caribbean food. No fuss, working man's food. Can't be beat.
I love You fit, it's such an easy gym to get in and out of with personable staff who remember when you come in. Highly recommend for those looking for a simple gym with cardio equipment and weights.

Tried Max's last night . It disappointed. After the excessive wait which really seems to be the result of their order system and limited staff I walked to my car and realized my bag had juice/ grease running out. Ok that was the first issue.  I ordered a traditional cheesstteak and it was not good. The other party ordered a chicken cheesesteak and it proved to be the source of all the liquid . He said the bread felt like it was hosed.  Back to my steak . The meat was chewy and tough. I actually think it's because they put too much meat on their grill at one time and it cooks too long . I frequent high volume steak joints and I know it can be done better. I am a Philadelphia native who loves a cheesesteak. And this was not the best we have to offer . I'll be sitting on a stool at D'Akessandro's soon or stopping by Tony Luke's or even Cosmi's for a better cheesesteak. My advice to Max's hire another person clean up the grill move the line quicker and deliver a better product.

I loved the entire experience. My pedicure was sublime and my nails still have me in awe. I will definitely return as a regular. I live in Thonotosassa so it is a bit of a drive for me but it is so worth it.

The barista seemed too bored with me to even open her eyes all the way. She sold me a growler covered in dust, when I got home I realized that the cold brew is practically yellow. $17 down the drain. Even Starbucks made a drinkable cold brew.

Fun beach bar. Love having Parrothead meetings here. Food provided was yummy. Black beans, rice, pulled pork with Cole slaw. Music was great. Service was courteous and attentive. Thanks Martha for taking care of us.

I wasn't sure what to expect when I first walked in. But this place was definitely cool and fun. The atmosphere was neat.

First floor was mellow, clean and unique. I loved the antique chairs/sofa, the green walls and funky pictures, clocks, old toys, etc. The price was perfect - especially since I am in college and broke. The cheapest beer was 2.50 - pabst which is perfect and I could live wit that. And 3 dollars for Lionshead (especially compared to philly drink prices). Doable.

Our waitress was slightly scary. She made me really nervous because she wore a sunglasses ... inside... and it was near 9pm. So, I couldn't tell if she was making eye contacts and ready to listen. It was just odd. 

We went upstairs and the atmosphere was so much fun. The walls are covered with sharpie marks, posters, band flyers, and etc. It was cool and very laid back. I had fun looking at all of the writings. There was a pool table and bumper cars seats. It was neat. I'd definitely go back!

I am a Nashville native for 46 years.  I have done the downtown scene for many years and with the rapid growth of the city, I can finally enjoy "the other side" of downtown without traffic and parking nightmares.  If you have not been to this restaurant yet, it is a MUST try!  They deserve the most likely to succeed superlative since their grand opening.  I have been a loyal customer who believes this place will grow immensely over the next few months!  There are so many choices for every fan base.  The food is delicious and the atmosphere is open and fun.  If you like sports (any kind), you will definitely love it.  Krista (sp?) brought back the attitude that was lacking.  You were amazing to all my friends 1st experience there. Thx for the hard work and improvement to my favorite watering hole.  Enjoy Nashville's best kept secret!

I have been taking my dogs here for several years. There have been a lot of changes over that time and it's gotten better & better. They treat my dogs and me like family. Having a place I trust will provide exceptional care and treatment (and LOVE) is such a godsend. Having tried other options on the Main Line and in the City, no other place has come close to what the Doctors and staff at Girard have consistently given us. Do yourself and your loved fur buddies a favor and get to know Girard.

This place is great. It is off the beaten path and worth it. There is plenty of seating, and all types - high tops, bar, community tables, regular dining tables, lounge seating. The staff is wonderful, polite, and accommodating. Once you find your spot, you do all your ordering through your phone - absolutely genius. You can open a tab and order drinks, flights, food, everything. The selection of beer and alcohol is decent. The food is classic pub-ish and good, but average. This place has a great vibe though. I would most certainly come back.

This theater is beautiful and never packed. We enjoyed a movie with only one other person in the theater with us. I enjoy their candy selection and Ted Drewes is a bonus. Fun place to see a cool indie film!

Excellent food, good beer, unimpressive service. Expensive, so you expect better.

Returned for lunch a few days later.... food and beer still excellent, service much better
Best NY style pizza around! The staff is also super nice and accommodating. All in all a great restaurant!
The best ice cream I've had in a very long time! So worth the indulgence. Fabulous service, too!!
Crystal always does a wonderful job and makes me feel welcome and comfortable. Love her new salon. Thank you Crystal!

Was there for dinner last night . We were seated right away and our server was pleasant and attentive. I had ribs and burnt ends, with Mac and cheese , and potato salad as my sides. The ribs were terrific, the dry rub was so flavorful! The burnt ends were tender and seasoned well. The Mac and cheese was creamy and the dusting of crushed ritz crackers on top was a genius idea! The Bloody Mary I ordered was perfect and I can not wait to go back to Salt and Smoke again!
Cowboy roll was raw. Called restaurant because we live right by them and told them the stake is raw and the manager said "what do you want me to" terrible customer service.
loved going out here @ night for drinks! the atmosphere was super vibrant & their Room 311 drink was sooo good!!!

There are few things that can get me to cross the state border into Jersey :P, but this place is going to be consistently one of them!

Came here on a weeknight with the bf on friends' recommendation. Ordered the fried oysters for appetizer, and for entrees got the chirashi, eel roll (w/ fish roe) and sea urchin w/ quail egg sushi. Chirashi is something I order often at Japanese restaurants because I love the simplicity of good quality raw fish more than contemporary rolls. The assortment here is impressive both in variety and in freshness. I can vouch that after having eaten at many Philly sushi restaurants, the chirashi here outdoes all the ones I've tried locally.

I make it a mission to always order sea urchin (uni) at any Japanese restaurant if it's offered. We requested the addition of quail eggs to ours. However the uni here is actually so excellent (not fishy at all; rather sweet and creamy) on its own that next time I don't think I'll be asking for the egg (although it does make for a prettier picture!).

The service is fantastic (we were seen opening our white wine bottle, and 2 servers within 5min of seating came up and asked if we needed an ice bucket) and the extra perk is that it's BYO! Try to show up to the restaurant on the early side. We arrived at 5:45pm (15min after opening), and the place was already half full!

Well played Jersey, well played.
The best pho viet soup that I eve try! The place is not to fancy but the food it's very good!

When you talk Steak and Seafood this place is the best! Franz with over 25 years in the business was our server. I went in with Shorts and a T shirt and he treated us like King and Queen! Christian and Peter the Assistant Manager was Super!

I have been working with Carlos P. at this store for over 2 years.  We order all of our appliances from them and I make several orders per year for our business.  They always have or can get what I need regardless of what it is and Carlos has been excellent at both service and professionalism when helping us.  I make one call, he finds it, quotes it and sends it over to me.  If you're in need of some appliances don't go to the big chain stores, go here.

I've loved their pizza (even though it is thin crust) ever since I started going to Angelo's in Black Jack. I watched the kids grow up and Pirrone's is every bit as good.  The supreme has everything I love on it and the salad is awash in Provel. Not being a St. Louis native, I've tried many different pizza places in many towns and Pirrone's is my favorite, hands down.
First time here. Got the #1. Mind blown. Shout out to my boy behind the counter who delicately placed this wonder of a sandwich together for me.
Excellent lunch of field greens and frittata- yummy coffee too.  Cozy, nice spot for a quiet lunch.  Seems like a place you could easily take your parents or a date.  Very nice service as well!

Delicious treats, laid back atmosphere, and the owner and staff couldn't be nicer!  The oatmeal raisin and decorated butter cookies are delicious and reasonably priced.  Great food plus friendly service make for a wonderful experience.  We will be back to try more soon!

While the food is what you might expect from a bar like WingHouse or Hooters, the service is phenomenal! I sat at the bar and casually enjoyed my pitcher with a friend and very relaxed, pleasant environment. The Heat game was on, other patrons dotted the landscape.  Excellent spot to grab a few brews or catch a game after a rough day. If you sit at the bar I would recommend Simone!

Gotta love this place. The dictionary definition of "hole in the wall" has a picture of Noodle City.  Many older Asian customers makes me think this is the real deal. 
After be sure to go next door to the Mercury Lounge which is just a "crack in the wall" and almost invisible but great place for that pint afterwards.

Used to love this place.  I'd eat in on Saturdays for breakfast and order deliveries at night sometimes.  (Always cheeseburgers and fries).  They used to be Great and I would have given them 5 stars, then all of a sudden something changed.  The burger was totally different, looked like frozen pre-packaged burgers and were even delivered in different packaging.  When I asked them if they had changed owners, I received some BS answer.  So, we tried again - same thing.  I will never order from here again.  they lost a loyal customer.

There was even a slight payment discrepancy, which was handled discretely and professionally. 
Highly recommended for our four legged children. Thanks for all your patience with Ophelia!

The three employees were so engrossed in their conversation that my drink took longer than it should have. Thankfully the drink was good but do I really have to wait more than 5 minutes for one drink when I'm the only one waiting? Pay attention!
Excellent night at Sangrita! Can't go wrong with the short rib tacos -- always tasty.

This place is fantastic! They have more ice cream flavors than most ice cream parlors, with a broad array of flavors, from chocolate, vanilla, and cookies and cream, to more unusual flavors like chocolate pecan, pine nut, and rice. They have a wide array of ices, with basic flavors and more unusual flavors. Then they have ice pops, chocolate dipped bananas, and fresh fruit salads. They give large portions and gladly give out numerous samples. 

Just as an example of the broad selection, last time we went, my son felt like strawberry. They had at least 6 strawberry options, including strawberry ice cream, strawberry cheesecake, vanilla with strawberry ribbon and strawberry ice pops. I wanted one of their sweet and spicy combinations. They had mango ices with some sort of hot sauce ices mixed in, cucumber Chile, and some amalgamation of several different fruit ices with Chiles, which is what I chose and it was delicious. 

My family and I have been here about 5 times and it is one of my favorites. 

The staff is also friendly and helpful.  Always treated nicely and with patience.

WOW!! WHERE do I start?? I will try to keep this short and simple as well as I can. 
I'm a little newer to the area, but have had cats all my life and am an avid fan. I have always done the best to keep them up to date on yearly exams and vaccines, even though they have never and will never go outside.
I'll admit, just like several people had stayed on here, that I was a little skeptical at first. I mean a lot of reviews and a 5 star rated place?? Can it possibly be? Well... I thought what harm could there be in trying since there were so many great reviews.
From the moment I called, the girls were so very pleasant and helpful. I told them that I was not exactly sure what my kitties might need, that I would really like to bring them in together if possible, and went over some questions in regards to my kitties themselves as well as pricing. They seemed more then happy to take the time and go over everything with me as well as all my crazy questions.  The girl on the phone (Lisa I believe) was even kind enough to contact my previous vet to have their records faxed over prior to their exam, because she could hear in my voice that I was a little concerned as far as speaking to my previous vet, due to some not so wonderful experiences with them.
Although the parking was a little rough (yet, what do you expect for Roxborough/Manayunk area... does anything ever have the parking we would truly like??) I was instantly impressed when I walked in the door. WOW!! I couldn't believe it! Was I really in a vet hospital?? No stinky smells, so clean and organized and just a bright and amazing atmosphere.
I was instantly greeted when I walked in the door and Lisa was so very pleasant with me while I was filling out my new paperwork. My kitties were a little upset, so she even came over to see and comfort them.... then it wasn't long at all until we were taken back to a very nice exam room.
Once in the exam room, Lisa made sure to have a small conversation with my kitties and reassure both them and myself that everything would be just fine. She let me know that they did indeed receive their records and we're aware of what vaccines were needed, and that the doctor has also reviewed their records. Another girl whose name I believe was Christine (may have been Kristen.. sorry) quickly came in and introduced herself and was just as pleasant. The girls seemed to radiate off of one another... you could really tell they had a great working relationship.
I met Dr Guth, of course, for our exam. She was very gentle, kind and informative. I never felt once (by any of the 3 there) that I was rushed or being talked into something that was unnecessary or going to cost me a lot of money. 
Lisa and Christine gave my kids, what Lisa nicely called a "mani/pedi." The girls were so gentle and sweet to my less then happy kitties... but all the while, the girls used calming voices, words and were just overall so amazing!! I couldn't believe it!! Other places I have been to in the past, my kitties have been not so pleasant, but they really seemed more at ease.
I was assisted in carrying my kiddos to the front and check-out took no time at all. Better yet... I was surprised that the cost were so very reasonable!! Thank goodness!!
Lisa was also nice enough to give me some information in case of emergency, just in case it was ever necessary, and made me feel well informed about each place.
So... in all... I truly did have an AMAZING experience! What a wonderful group of people, that really care about your kitties... don't just fake it to get by!!
You can be fully assured that with such an amazing, helpful, informative and caring staff.... I will most definitely be back!

If you are anywhere near the area.... please, check them out and give them a shot.... I highly doubt you or your feline friends will be disappointed!! Thank you so much Lisa, Christine and Dr Guth!

Totes adorbs bar that had to open with what they had. No food, no draught, no restroom signage...no problem... yes it's country themed! Live music, weekends get a DJ. It can get a little hairy on the weekends with line dancing and what not. Super clean with an atm front and center! More of the weekday type, it's a very chill place. The earlier the better! Hope they figure out that food and restroom signage, then they are legit!

Highly disappointing
 Went for lunch and ordered chicken Tikka roll. So the roti was all stale and soggy and w email were the only customer there at that time. They could have easily made a fresh roti and served hot. It was very spicy too

Mona is amazing, and I couldn't recommend this store more. I went to the store on Thursday searching for a strapless bra to wear on Saturday at a fitting for my Maid of Honor dress. I didn't have the dress with me and wasn't sure if the strapless bra I tried on would work with the dress because the dress has a low back. Mona offered to let me take the bra home on Thursday to try it on with my dress and then if the bra worked, to come back on Friday and pay for it, and if the bra didn't work, to simply bring it back on Friday. I offered to pay for the bra on Thursday before taking it home but Mona said not to worry about it. She is so accommodating! Of course when I tried on the bra with my dress on Thursday even, the bra worked perfectly with the dress because Mona is a miracle worker and knows her craft. I went back on Friday and paid for the bra! Anyone looking for a perfectly fitting bra should shop here ASAP.

Very highly recommended by several 'locals' so I thought I would give it a shot.

This is not a location I would ever drive through let alone stop in, the stark noisy cafeteria feel to the place inside (was this place a Denny's?) is not inviting (but very clean), pool table in the back, full bar to one side, lots of people seem to walk through the place that are not dining in so they can use the restrooms, friendly but very disconnected service, AND 5-styles of pizza on offer as well as your typical pasta dishes made me think this place had potential.

The verdict on the small house special Boston style char-grilled pizza that took 30-minutes to get? MEH. It was cold by the time I got it, or perhaps it was undercooked. 

Time for someone to take down that Best Pizza House sign they have and burn it.  They don't deserve it.

The brunch and dinner here are both amazing. This is my favorite brunch spot on the weekends; there is usually no wait, the atmosphere is cute, and the food is amazing. My personal favorite is the eggs florentine with ham and my boyfriend always gets the waffle with "the works."

We stayed for 3 nights. As a new hotel, there are a lot of minor issues that need to be ironed out. 

1. Television did not work. The maintenance guy was not able to fix it. Front desk told us that it's currently a hotel wide issue.
2. We asked for extra towels and slippers to be delivered up to our room, but when housekeeping came up, he just brought towels. When I asked where the slippers were, he told us they had run out.
3. We asked for newspaper delivery in the morning. It didn't come once.
4. We asked for an extra laundry bag. They never brought it.
5. We can hear neighbors having a conversation through the walls.

Having said that, the hotel room was clean. Wi-fi is free.

I love brick oven pizza so I had to try Spuntino's. I got the arugula salad and the fradiavolo pizza. The salad was so fresh and light, thankfully not drenched in dressing. The pizza was so flavorful I ate it all in about 5 minutes. I've been to plenty brick oven pizza places in the city but this place is by far the best. Even better than Vetri. If you are looking for amazing food and great service you need to go to Spuntino's!
The food is spectacular and the decor is so cool. You won't regret splurging a little for this establishment.

Food here was decent, and the draft selection was great.

My problem was that we specifically went here to kick back at the bar and catch the NCAA Final Four game before a later dinner reservation at Marigold Kitchen.  At half time - of a great game - they changed the channel (only one TV...for this type of place you'd expect at least two) over to the Phillies game.  I know everyone is crazy for the Phillies and excited about Cliff Lee coming back, but, seriously?
