Change from one of the greatest final fours in recent memory to catch the FIRST inning of the second game of a 160 game MLB season?

I could tell the popular opinion was against us on this one, so we checked out and caught the rest of the game at a tiny pizza shop down the road.

It's tough to find things you need to make authentic Filipino dishes! I was able to find some produce that i couldnt find at other grocery stores and they have all the dry goods/ canned goods you could ever think of!
Luckily this market is close to home and has a lot to offer & MORE. Definitely feels like an oriental market i would go to back in Chicago.
Parking can be tough but it's old town goleta- that shouldnt be news to you!
Keep in mind that there is a $10 min for credit!

Definitely try this place out! It's a little confusing where you order and understandably the workers get annoyed, but our first visit was started off with a blunt "order over there," so do take note! My husband and I shared a buffalo mac and cheese with a side of ranch. Holy moly do not pass that up!! It's any mac and cheese lovers dream. For a sandwich I ventured to have the roast beef with giardiniera. It was fantastic, although the maker had no idea what giardiniera was. This place also offers access to a dog store which sells bandanas made from old T-shirt's and pup friendly treats! I would gladly go back!
This place is amazing! Everything is super fresh, incredibly delicious and the people are very nice. Try something different. I bet you will like it.
Always want to come back! Best chicken pho in USA! I am from New York and the chicken pho over there were different. This is the best chicken pho I have ever had. :D

Rick's is my favorite go-to restaurant during the summer to grab appetizers and drinks. I always go and grab a spot on the deck. No matter how crowded it is - and it gets CROWDED weekend nights - there's always a spot waiting for you on the deck at one of the cocktail tables. You can also step inside to be seated by the hostess at a table inside or outside on the other side of the deck if you wish.

My favorites are the Smoked Salmon and Roasted Poblano Nachos, Blue Cheese Broiled Steak Salad, and when it's cold outside, Raspberry Chicken. I've been to their Sunday brunch once, it was pretty good too - I ordered the Seafood Frittata.

The main reason this is my favorite summer restaurant is the scenery. It's so gorgeous, and there's not too many places in this city where you can dine by the water. The crowd on the deck is usually having a good time, so it's also good for people watching. They have a nice variety of live music inside and outside that's perfect for the setting. 

The food is good and consistent, the prices are reasonable, and the service is nice & friendly also.

Clay was awesome and very knowledgeable! Feeding the tortoises was the coolest thing I've done with animals and it's so incredible how gentle and old these reptiles are! Def would recommend to anyone especially if you love turtles like we do! 
Make sure you tip your tour guide. What he does and is knowledgeable about is incredible.
SERVICE IS HORRIBLE. very very rude employees and very long wait time for food and beverages.
Dr. Guggemos went above and beyond with his eye exam of my daughter. I appreciate his professionalism and kindness with our visit.

In the past I think two months before I ended up in the hospital for a month or so I have bought a washer and dryer Samsung from Famous Tate. I left a review on their website which I can't find now so they must have taken it off because it was negative. The salesman I feel should have went over all of the details of this washing machine and dryer because it is so detailed and does so much but he did not all he told me was it washes clothes and 6 inches of water and I was excited and I said fine I don't mind that I prefer them. Well I guess they had seen it and my salesman I think his name was Bob who I bought four years ago and went back to the same to interest him again let me down he called to tell me that they saw the review and I told him I was buying the step stool so I can get my clothes out of the washing machine and he said okay pretty much. So as a customer service person you would have thought they would have offered being it's so brand new and I've only used it a very few times since I bought it that they would have exchanged it for something that be more suitable to me it's more for a big family not a single girl. No solution to my issue I'll deal with it
Love this place. Simple food, really fast service. I just hope they open one up in Carmel so I don't have to drive so far!

The deep dish is always the best way to go, always had great customer service. Especially when out pizza took longer than expected the manager came out to inform us and when the pizza was done they even plated a piece for each of us.

Get there soon! This place is really a gem. I was there today with my Dad and we had the Spanish and Indonesian breakfasts. The proportions were generous and the wait time short. Our server Steve was a delight, very helpful with all of our questions and extremely friendly.

But the food is absolutely the best part. Particularly the kale and tofu eggs in the Spanish breakfast. (I had no idea tofu could taste like that!) We were chatting with Steve about the spices used in it and went to Giant IMMEDIATELY afterwards to stock up. 

However this place is still relatively new in Ambler and about half of all restaurants fail in their first two years. Try it soon and help keep this unique and passionate eatery open!

If I could give zero stars I would.  They apparently hire unreliable technicians since the one coming was "sick" on a Friday, sure!  Anyways they rescheduled for Tuesday never showed up and never called.  To make it even more unprofessional they don't even answer their phone.  So if a vital appliance like a refrigerator is broken in your home go somewhere else.  These people should not even be in business!

I believe the recipe for THO was concocted at the Garfield Park pool. And I also believe this is the first time I have ever written "THO" - especially in a public setting. 

I'll be the first to admit it took me way too long to discover this wonderful Downtown green space. On this particular visit, my friend and I were craving a break from the 90+ degree weather. In walks the Garfield pool packed full of kiddos running wildly without parental supervision (typical summer pool scenario) and plenty o' half naked PDA. Unlike the Broad Ripple pool, Garfield has more of an amusement park feel to it with fountains bursting out the ground and a separate kiddie pool. The physical appearance of the pool was of no concern to my friend and I, all we needed was a corner to gayly prance around and doggie paddle "for exercise".  

As we entered the pool/fitness building the sign read "Pool is cold! 67 degrees" - and holy shit, they weren't uh kiddin'. Our body temperature is supposed to fall somewhere around 98.6 degrees, correct? And freezing is 32? Well, between these two crucial numbers falls the Garfield pool. Wow-wee. Enough of my pansying about the temperature. The changing faciities were very clean and new. Despite how busy the pool was on our Friday visit, there were still plenty of chairs available. The pool is only one of the many wonderful assets to be found at the Park. Can't wait to give them all the time they deserve.
Great food.highly recommend tofu.The only problem Is that their is a small stench.Otherwise this a great food choice!!!

My husband I were just in town vacationing and took a moment to sit and enjoy a beverage here.  Nikki and Wendy were so nice and very informative with suggestions.  

I had a lovely totally from scratch daiquiri (no bottled juice here which is really hard to find... perfection!) and their Jubilee Shrimp starter... lightly battered so all the great shrimp flavor and texture came through tossed in the house made "jubilee" sauce (think slightly spicy Thousand Island dressing)... so many places over batter their shrimp that you can hardly find much less get to enjoy the shrimp... not this place (thanks again Nikki for the suggestion).  I even shared a few with my husband...

maybe next time we'll actually stay for dinner... I hear their crawfish mac and cheese is fantastic... So ladies, save us a place at the bar...

Underwhelming. Not worth the price. Service OK but a bit pretentious. Everyone had a look that read "we want your $$". Busser was the most honest person for the night. Work in the food and beverage industry for 10 years you can sniff out the phonies. Foie Gras and scallops were decent. Really the first dish was the most impressive. Everything after that was a slippery slope downhill. Nothing that blew me away. Ordered a duck that was cold. Cold. Was more shocked than anything to even demand the dish be brought back. Dessert again good but nothing amazing. Manager did nothing to remedy the cold dish and meal that costed top $$. Won't be returning. Can name 300 restaurants in philly alone can receive better service and food for a $300 meal. Also not appreciative in this entire place they stuck myself and my GF in the corner by the coat room where we had no peace of mind to enjoy our meal. Must've been bumped 10 times. Plenty of other open tables. Again I know how the food and beverage industry works, and didn't appreciate that. A big step down from blackfish, Mr Roman.

This was our first visit but not our last. Made reservations for dinner (so glad I did) before a show at the Fox. Wasn't sure what to expect since it was attached to the Holiday Inn. 
We arrived a little early and the table wasn't ready yet so we wandered to the bar and ordered a drink. Nice selection of craft beers and cocktails. Highly recommend the Cosmo. Jimmy came and got us when the table was ready. He carried our drinks to the table (nice touch). The ambiance is nice but it is a little dark at the tables for my liking. We were told about the aging process of the beef and given a few suggestions. Next,  the server came and asked to refresh our drinks and gave us some suggestions for starters. We ordered the Crab Rangoon. Very good,  came with 2 dipping sauces. We ordered the filet and fried lobster tail for dinner. Entrees come with a salad, bread and side.  We went with the Caesar salad and I got the Brussels and my husband got the cheddar au gratins. The server also lead us in a good direction for a wine with dinner. The salad came family style. It was dressed nicely with fresh croutons and shaved parmesean. Real tasty. 
They bring the steak out on a cart with a warmer and au jus. They spoon the au jus on the plate with the steak. Some would say outdated and old fashioned. I say if it ain't broke don't fix it. The steak had great flavor and melted in your mouth like butter. The lobster tail was very different than any I've ever had.  Battered and fried. It was tender and had a great flavor.  Not greasy or chewy. The Brussels were OK but the potatoes were rich and cheesy. Yumm...  Unfortunately we were too full for dessert. We know better next time.
If you are looking for a nice old school steakhouse this is the place. Nice ambiance,  fantastic service, awesome food for a great price.
            5 stars all the way.

Great experience at Olio. Awesome service as we sat outside on a nice summer evening. The portions are good sized and the staff very helpful. Very interesting Mediterranean tastes. The staff was helpful with the menu as we had not eaten here before. We ate staff recommendations, all were good. Our favorite was the chicken salad. Great place to visit, a little on the pricy side though.

If you want everything in one place when it comes to food I suggest going to Reading Terminal. It's very touristy so if you're into that sort of thing plan out a couple of hours so you can look at everything they have. There is a greasy atmostphere to the place but it gives it character. They have everything from their famous pulled pork, donuts, chocolates, indian food, burgers, hoagies, drinks, and tons more. My cousin bought some candles. I had some Indian food which was really good.
Meric made a super yummy pizza! Very nice and friendly person. Definitely plan on going back after eating so many Papa John's haha.

The pesto pasta was greattttt. Love this place it's super trendy and cute. It seemed like a very authentic place, one of the owners was my waiter and he was very nice guy! I will definitely be coming back here. The decor and the environment are beautiful by the way, 10/10 would recommend.

Food, service & atmosphere were amazing. We shared an Appetizer which was grilled oysters. Delicious buttery sauce. Trout entree (& the baby book choy) was flavorful & cooked to perfection. Seafood salad was fresh & had plenty of seafood (shrimp & crab) & plenty of avocado. Dessert was ice cream trio (creamsicle / brown butter / chocolate basil) & creme brûlée (lemon thyme flavor was amazing). Jeana was our server who was friendly, funny & provided excellent service. 
The atmosphere was charming.  We sat outside & overlooked the pond filled with Lilly pads, flowers, ducks  & a few sculptures. 
I am already planning my next visit. 
After lunch we walked around the grounds. 
Overall an enjoyable day!

i cannot say enough nice things about this place. the guys are so helpful and enthusiastic - i've never seen anyone get so excited about great new potting soil! - and really seem to want to help me succeed in my first ever attempt at container gardening vegetables in my little patio space. i've stopped here for advice on planters, soil, which greens to grow, timing, transplanting, and they've always helped me find the most appropriate and budget-friendly solution. they even offered to let me dumpster dive for their old plastic containers! everyone does it, so they say. and i'm not too proud. i'm always looking forward to reaching the next stage of growth so i can return, chat about plants, learn a thing or two, and leave with precisely what i need - reasonably-priced supplies and a game plan.

MISERABLE EXPERIENCE at this office. Totally unprofessional, disrespectful of my time and concerns. My complaints center on the staff -- but why does the doctor allow this?

Repeatedly failed to follow through on key communications with my insurance company, and with me -- then tried to pretend otherwise. I spent months trying to get them to interface appropriately with my insurance; never followed through... then tried to gaslight me about it!  These words come to mind: incompetent, uncooperative, unprofessional, profoundly unpleasant.

Further, their NEGLIGENCE in not wearing masks -- during an upsurge of COVID cases in New Mexico -- put my health and that of every patient who enters their office at risk. In a MEDICAL setting!! 
Shameful and abusive. 

FIND CARE ELSEWHERE!

Food was very good. We had the blackened amberjack sandwich and the blackened snapper sandwich. We shared the u peel shrimp, crab cake and gator bites for appetizers. Service was great. I would definitely come back. Best fresh catch fish sandwich I have had in the area. Better than Caddy's and Doc Side Daves. Looking forward to our return next time we are in the area. Great view of the pier and boats passing by.
Had a delicious brunch there on a Sunday. The rosemary bread with lemon butter and the fruit side (beautifully arranged fruit with honey and yogurt) were the highlights.

I was visiting from Texas last weekend and wanted to eat something that I could only get from New Orleans. It was pretty early in the morning and this place was the only thing open so we decided to give it a shot. Man did it change my life. I got the Bayou Pasta. Personally I hate pasta, all types of it (even spaghetti) but this place made it so perfectly that I inhaled my plate! I even hate shrimp, but it was SO GOOD. The bread that came with it was really good too. I've been on Yelp for years and never thought any place was worth making a review, but this is my exception. GET THE BAYOU PASTA. Coming from someone who hates shrimp and pasta entirely, but in love with this dish? Get it, you won't regret a thing.

Where to begin. The worst mistake of my life was doing business with the place. My loan co signer died 5 years ago, and still to this day they harass me about her signature needing to be on forms or pester me for her death certificate even though it was provided to them 5 years ago. Funny with a motto mentioning treating you like family you'd think they'd know grandma passed away. Now they've set up their payment system to be out of commission for updates over the end of July and beginning of august. Why on earth would any financial institution schedule that for the period of time where payments come due? Easy, they stand to gain late payment fees from anyone who goes past due, and if you're in the unfortunate circumstance of being 90 days past due they just put you over the limit to come repo your car. Don't get me started on the terrible customer service and their dishonesty.

My favorite meal is offered here : yellow curry! I don't know many places that offer this so five stars for that fact alone!

Plus the interior is so cute and different. Both lunch and dinner are amazing here .

I wish I could rate it lower but, I can't . I called for supplies for my bi-pap machine and they said I needed a new Rx. I went to the Doctors over a week ago and stood there and watched them fax an order over to provider plus!
I called today,12/28 and they said they never received the fax ! Maybe their string broke between the 2 soup cans ! Really folks I have the delivery number showing you received it ! Maybe it's time you give it up. But, then again why would you? that insurance money is a sweet honey pot for you! Your so bad I had to drive 115 miles one way 3 times because you always send the wrong supplies ! Get your head out of your ass and start paying attention to your patients instead of their insurance carriers !!!!

Went here for my daughters birthday lunch . Great service, atmosphere. Food was awesome. Great selection of vegan food . Great taste , good quantities. Lots of unique, original recipes . Pretty on point. A little on the pricey side . Would probably be better for just me and my lovely wife next time . Great local beer selection. Very clean . Would like to see more coupons and deals to make it worth the drive from Clearwater. 5/5 on the food . 4/5 on price. 5/5 on service and friendliness. I would recommend it and go back.

Delicious breakfast, 3 days in a row! Definitely a great place for the first meal of the day.  Our first morning I had the seasonal beignets. Four delicious beignets, swimming in a bowl of sweet pumpkin whipped cream soup! Yum!
Day two I tried the seasonal French toast. A light, airy pumpkin mousse slathered between two full slices of French toast, topped with a generous dollop of whipped cream and 2 slices of crisp bacon.  Rich and delicious and I could only find room for half of it. My husband managed to eat his full order.
Our last day in NOLA I got the Bananas Foster Pain Perdue.  The French toast of the pain Perdue was made with French bread (instead of yesterday's white bread) dipped in egg batter and griddled. Swimming in a pool of buttery bananas Foster goodness and topped with at least a full banana and a generous sprinkle of raisins. Beautiful as well as delicious. This also came with 2 slices of the aforementioned bacon and again way more than this girl could eat.
I would definitely recommend the Ruby Slipper to get your morning started on the right foot!
In these COVID times, do t forget your vaccine passport as they will need to see it befor you are seated ( just like every other NO restaurant).

Considering all of the great/previous reviews, we went recently on a Friday night. Granted, weekends are always usually busy for most restaurants, & this place was no exception.  
First of all, if you value your personal space, this is not the restaurant for you whatsoever.  It was like sitting in a sardine can.  If you end up loving their food, it might be best that you take advantage of their take-out option.    
When we got there it was just starting to get really busy. Thankfully we were seated right away. The problem is that the place is so small &  cramped.  You are literally elbow to elbow with the other diners seated next to you.  
You really can't have any kind of conversation (intimate & otherwise), because everybody around you can hear you.  I am a fairly private person, so that scenario troubles me.   
We attempted to ask for a table that was off to the side, & they were very reluctant to seat us there.
A woman came over and asked us if we were waiting for other diners because we were seated at a 4 seat table.  We told her no, it was just us.   She then quickly removed the other place settings &  left.  She didn't take or drink order or say anything else to us.  
A waitress came over shortly thereafter and took our drink order.  
After that, it starts to get a bit odd.  A man, (from what I could surmise, he was either the main manager and/or owner), came over to us a few minutes after the waitress took our drink order, & asked to take our drink order.  We told him that we were already being waited on & had just placed our drink order.  He looked and acted put out, and declared that he was helping her out. He was unfriendly & was acting nervously.  Then he asked us if we were waiting for other people to show up at our table.  We again said no & he continued to act completely annoyed.  It was beyond bizarre, awkward, uncomfortable & borderline creepy for us.  At that point I was SO CLOSE to throwing in the towel and leaving.  I was wondering why he was treating us so gruffly and rudely.  
Why did I stay ?  I always ask myself that question after the whole experience is said and done.  I always try to give chances.  I figured &  really hoped the food would redeem the situation & I could look past it.   So, sadly, this was not the case.  I didn't listen to my gut again, and it came back to kick me in the rear yet again.  

The appetizer was brought out and it was not what we ordered.  We ended up with raw uncooked lettuce wrap version of the spring roll, but wanted the cooked/fried type of spring rolls.  

We ordered a few entrees that included a stir fry chicken and vegetable dish, & also a similar pork configuration.  
Both of them were passable in taste, but it wasn't anything outstanding. 
They were actually on the bland side.  The dishes were swimming in a watery soupy sauce.  I didn't care for that.  
I have seriously had better oriental type food.   For the ridiculously high price point this restaurant charges, one should really expect & receive more quality.   
At one point the manager man came back over to us & asked us how things were.  The strained look on his face was not gracious or sincere whatsoever. I told him everything was 'OK', but the appetizer came out wrong. He then said he would get us the right version as he was making excuses and trying to explain it away.  Sadly, it just ended up sounding disingenuous all the same.  The appetizer was eventually brought out, but it wasn't anything spectacular tasting as anything else before it.  None of the food blew us away.  Was I expecting it to?  Maybe, because I always hope for that experience.  I certainly expected the food to be better than what we ended up receiving - primarily based on the reviews here on Yelp!    I absolutely don't think this restaurant is deserving of 4 1/2 stars whatsoever. I reluctantly give it 2 stars and a big - OY!

I dined at this establishment a few years ago, & I had an average experience at that time. I gave them a second chance, & it proved to be one chance too many.  
Considering the previous shining reviews, I am really perplexed about them.  I am dismayed at my own hard luck & general poor experience.  Lately, it just seems to be more 'miss' than 'hit' anymore; at least for me anyway.  I wonder if I am going on 'off' nights?  I really don't know, but my broad assessment is that no establishment should really be able to afford an 'off' night.  That really will make or break a business in the end.  
Turning over the almighty dollar seems to be so much more of a priority at this restaurant than the quality of the food or the customer's general satisfaction; namely their comfort & peace.  

All in all, I really don't care if I ever go to this restaurant again. 
For the money, the atmosphere (lack of), the cramped sardine seating situation, plus the fact that it felt like a cattle drive - cram em in, move em along & get them out quickly. I think it was all just too much.  
It's off the list.  ;o(

Immediately loved this place after my first time. Got in quickly & thankfully as a walk in, they had tons of colors to choose from for my gel. Got a basic pedicure and it honestly was the best pedicure I've had in a long time!! Even better than when I've splurged at other salons in the past. She took her time, and was very precise & KIND. Happy I found my new regular spot, highly recommend!

Cut above the standard Indian fare. Ordered the chef's tasting menu. Exceptionally delicious and varied dishes -- not the same 'ol tikka whatever. Plus great beer or wine pairings (I had wine, my bros had beer). It was a real culinary experience. The waiter was awesome too: attentive without being obsequious. One of the most enjoyable Indian meals I've had anywhere.

My husband and I are new big fans of Daddy's. After attempting to get into Bonefish for the high priced fish, rushed service and 9 dollar glass of wine it is great to go to a family owned place and leave for under 35 dollars for dinner. The wait staff and hostesses are funny, friendly, accomodating and prompt. I also cant believe how well priced everything is. My husband always gets the prime rib and I usually get the fish. This weekend I got the haddock in a mushroom artichoke sauce with fresh green beans and a baked potato. For under 13 dollars...prime rib for under 15 dollars. With a salad and bread...drinks are two for one from 3 to 9. I could NOT put that food on my table for that price. My fish was delicious..fresh, well cooked and just right. The prime rib was very, very good. 
I cant imagine what people on here can complain about. Yes the crowd is older...(you can see the waitresses struggle giving 9 separate checks to a table of 9, there's your sign) yes it can get very crowded (they take reservations for dinner) and yes breakfast can be crowded with a wait but it is a great place. These people work so hard and are open 7 days a week, husband, wife and two sons. Every body talks about eating local and supporting your local family owned places so do it! To keep it in perspective my daughter and I ate lunch in Panera the other day....you pick two 8.99 x2, 2 sodas 3.50, one cookie 1.99. Total 24 bucks
Daddy's Grill Prime Rib Meal, Fresh Haddock Meal and 2 Beers. Total 33 dollars. WITH enough leftovers for my lunch the next day. 

Try it...it's great for me.

I have to say, I'm pretty impressed with my first Wash Cycle experience! I used to be a cyclist for this company years ago and I'm really glad to see that they're doing so well. The pickup was right on time as was the drop off. Everything came back neatly folded and every pair of socks was accounted for! Prices are a little more that I had been spending at my previous wash 'n fold, but after you take into account the time saved with the pickup and delivery, it really isn't too much at all. I really like that the cyclists have a good attitude are are easy to talk to unlike many other types of delivery services. Also, I'm a bit of a detergent snob and I know they use the good hype-allergenic stuff at no extra charge. I'll definitely be using this service again.

Literally my FAVORITE pizza in the city! 
The crust just tastes better and better each time I visit. I don't know how they do it. You can't go wrong with their Pint and a Slice deal; it's a steal! Let's be honest, through, I'm ordering a 18in each time just so I can continue to partake the next day with my left overs! Soon delicious!

They have new staff members.  Hooray!  The lady working tonight was friendly and awesome overall.  The reason for only 4 stars is the lack of stock on the shelves.  They did not have two items that I went in for.  

i love CVS as a store in general.  Small, good sales, coupon machine.  I will be coming back since they have good staff (finally!).

Owner is a dirtbag, place looked abandoned so we parked there to eat breakfast next door. When we went to leave the owner got right in my face and started yelling, YOU HAVE GET OUT OF HERE!! GOOO!!! I said ok, if you move your car over there we can back out, leaving right now. He looked like he was about to punch me right there. He refused to move his car and insisted we leave immediately. What a dirtbag.

Love this place and come here often. It has good quality pub food, at decent prices. It is a crucial piece of the Hyde Park neighborhood.

My only issue is with the owner sometimes being overly territorial about outside food. Even a single measly $1 taco from Parrilla, is enough to get him to rudely ask you to leave... 
If you are not bringing in outside food or drink though, he is usually fairly nice.

I've been to the Crossroads twice.  On both occasions, a country singer named Tim McDonald was playing.  From now on when I go honky tonkin', the Crossroads will be my first stop to see if Tim is playing.  He's a great performer and makes the entire experience fun for everyone.

The actual Crossroads bar is nice.  It has a very old west feel to it.  The bar is long and they have an okay selection of beer.  For the most part, there is little seating.  Most of the real estate is dedicated to standing room only.  My advice is to go early.  Do some day drinking.  The bands are good, there is no cover, and there is no crowd.

This is my favorite honky tonk in Nashville.
Very informative staff, tons of craft beer and wine, other snacks and goodies, great prices compared to some other beer stores that sell craft and regular beer like bud light Etc.

The new owner has returned Joe's to what it was when Joe Rangel was the owner. I enjoyed eating here in the 80's when Joe was in the restaurant and Butch was in the kitchen. I do NOT expect it to taste exactly like it did then; but, the new owner has captured the essence of what Joe's was then and updated it in what Joe's is now. The new dishes are solid, but the old one taste right. I think the chili con queso is almost exactly as Joe would have done it.  It's not the creamy  liquid that you get at Qdoba.....they are NOT the same thing.(if you want that then go to Qdoba). I am enjoying eating my way through the menu today and tasting the history of the restaurant. The present owners and management have done very well in bringing the restaurant back. When i visited here earlier I must confess I was disappointed. Not now.

Fred's Market buffet restaurant is a wonderful place to eat. The quality and selection of foods is great, their staff is outstanding, and the cost of a meal is unbelievable. For the wife and I, it is cheaper to eat at Fred's than it is to cook at home, with the added benefit of having choices and a broad range of homemade desserts at the end of every meal!

We went on a quest for authentic Persian food while visiting from out of town. Esther's was fabulous. The owner made us feel especially welcome and tended to all our needs. From the fresh herb plate and outstanding hummus to the tahdig with both ghormeh sabzi and gheymeh, we were all delighted. Then, the kabob and rice were excellent. Thank you for a splendid meal!

My girlfriend and I went to Amada on a Saturday night in October. Overall, it was an absolutely amazing experience.

The only downside to the restaurant is that if you do not have reservations it can be a real zoo. The place is packed and the seats at the bar and in the non-reservation area are not managed. 

From the time, however, we got a seat until the end of our meal we loved every moment of it.  The guy at the bar was super helpful and the food was just spectacular.  I will not call out specific items, however, we literally did not eat anything that we did not like.

We live in New York City and this beats almost every restaurant we have been to in NYC. If you have a chance to go to Amada I *definitely* recommend doing so.

FIVE STAR. It was an absolute pleasure working with Coolco. Dario, Ervin and the crew provided perfect service. They arrived promplty and were very thourough. Highly recomended. Not only the finest service, but also a price that was affordable.

Killer B's is the best! They've got a great happy hour and Will (the owner) is awesome. The mac n' cheese puffs are amazing and they've always got great beer on tap, and their sliders, loaded fries, and nachos are pretty good, too. The girls that work there are super friendly and are definitely good at recognizing faces. And they love dogs!

This used to be our go to spot and yesterday we went back.(keep in mind this is the first time since the pandemic started that we physically went to a sit down restaurant) we ordered 2 orders of chicken wings and 2 orders of tots. The crispy wings were anything but crispy. I stopped eating the wings when I hit a bleeder. The tots arrived well after the chicken wings.
I believe they need to soft open, just to get their act together. Won't be going back anytime soon.
The only star was for the beer. The meal deserves no stars.

We moved to Tucson from California and visited dozens of Mexican restaurants to finally find something we were happy with. I love the decor of Crossroads, the food is fantastic, I love the live music from the blind man. He is so talented and it's so refreshing to see. One of my favorite meals is the fajitas, or the buffet. Great place, great atmosphere

I'd love to give this 5 stars but it's too inconsistent in quality and service. We've had great salads here (particularly the arugula with quinoa) and pancakes rock. However, French Toast was dry because chef didn't soak the bread long enough. WORST omelettes we've ever eaten. Instead of light and fluffy in the classic French style, they were dry like fried eggs. Chef: you are supposed to mix cream (or milk) with eggs to make an omelette. Otherwise, it's like fried eggs...just FYI...
Would be nice if they had a fruit plate as a standard on the menu or something vegan or gluten free other than oatmeal (which isn't guaranteed GF). Dined with vegan friends who had no option other than fruit.
Service is hit or miss depending on how late your server was out partying and how much sleep they got...
Potential for greatness but just doesn't deliver...

We just had them install a screen enclosure at our house and it turned out great. They arrived on time and  finished on time. My wife was very surprised when she got home. I would definately recommend them to anyone looking for a new screen porch.

Some co-workers were visiting from Texas and wanted to try the best BBQ in Nashville.  I'm not a huge BBQ fan but heard great things about Peg Leg Porkers so we settled on giving this place a try.  Really great BBQ ribs, Mac n Cheese and Green Beans were tasty and you have to save room for a Fried Chocolate Pie!  (even if you split it with the table just to have a small bite)

Over price, inattentive service. My old fashioned was much tooooooo sweet and my old fashioned was $15 + $2 tip that he did not deserve. He didn't even stir my drink. Poor service for a bourgeois bar. Arrogant bartender with poor mixology knowledge.

Really coldest day of the year forecasted in advance and you have 1 soup ( a spicy one I cannot eat)  I dont mind paying for things but I HATE getting ripped off.
 I ordered one of the signature soups with salad and bread sticks and I was able to get 1 small bowl and then they ran out....$8 for 1 bowl of soup and 2 bites of salad.
Ok Olive garden for the lousy $8 you got from me today you will lose a 3++ times a month 4 person avg bill  of $30.
I hope it was worth it ?

Had lunch here on Friday and the food was wonderful.  I had the Pulled Chicken Sandwich and it was served with a corn relish, yummy.
The service was wonderful also.  
And yes I would go back
Pork sandwich was greasy , too much bread and not very flavorful. The brisket sandwich didn't have much meat and was dry with the amount of bread. $18 not spent well unfortunately.
The staff is super friendly. I'm not a coffee drinker, but I love their chai lattes, hot and cold. They also have a drive thru, which is convenient and uncommon for a small coffee shop.

I visited Nashville from 09 December, 2018 until 11 December, 2018. I stayed at the Holiday Inn Nashville - Vanderbilt. This hotel is less than half a mile away from Three Brothers Coffee!

Beautiful little shop, quiet and delicious hot chocolate! The employees were very nice and friendly!

A comfort food place. Nice size serving with a like selection. I had the meatloaf, mashers and fresh green beans. I server was on the ball and I tipped her accordingly. Would not hesitate to recommend.

First time ever eating Indian food.  I will be back!  Hopefully often! :)  I LOVED IT!  Lots of vegetarian options.  Can't wait to try the buffet!  Lots of left over food for lunch the next day. :)  Prices very reasonable.  My favorite thing was the friendly staff, and especially the owner who is very nice and cute! :)

I am a snickerdoodle fiend, and this place helps me get my fix.  I also love their caramel pretzel ice cream!  I'm only taking off a star because when I ordered online one time, the delivery took almost 70 minutes and my ice cream was basically a milkshake :(  
The staff here is great though.  Stop in to grab a warm, delicious cookie next time you pass by!

Very dirty restaurant.  I should have followed my intuition upon arriving.  Very dirty entry way and interior walls were dirty.  I had the most unimpressive chirashi ever.  Just rice on a plate with the fish on top and a few lettuce pieces.  Nothing else to accentuate it like you'd normally see.  Sub-par.  Avoid.

I've driven past this place a few dozen times as I come and go from Barre3, and I finally stopped in yesterday. I got a Pure Yellow Juice and it was so good. I can't wait to go back and try more. Marisol who was working, was SO sweet and friendly. I can tell she loves her business. She was friendly to the people who entered and you could tell she makes customers for life! I have already shared how good this place was with some co-workers! Can't wait to work my way through the juice list!!

One of my favorite pizza restaurants on the Mainline...and a great alternative to the local joints, most of which are middling. Growing up in the NYC area, one becomes selective about pizza, learning to be content with Neopolitan style pies...but Biga offers the coal/wood oven taste with a hand tossed texture. I recommend that Classic Cheese which reminds me of a pizzeria I used to visit in North Arlington NJ...
Nick and team are great. Very fair with fees. My in laws are very happy with them too.

In the area so stopped for lunch.  No indoor seating at all but there are a couple of table outside.  No bathroom either to wash up but at least the municipality offices were across the street.   Ordered the Crazy Frank.  I am curious the story behind this name.  Sandwich was really good.  Nice flavor and packed with meat.  Bread is a bit thick, too much for a sandwich. Good use of the condiments to spice up the flavor.  Overall a nice lunch .

I wish I could give this place zero stars. It's horrible, it really is horrible. The entire staff is completely unattentive, it takes forever for them to stop playing around with their employees and help someone. 

Today was my final straw. An employee sweatpants came walking up to me for my appointment- my 2 month old iPhone's speaker is not working- took my phone, and told me it would take 20 minutes to a half an hour. After an hour I was getting a little restless, and I had to go back to work. It took me 15 minutes just to get someones attention (they are really good at avoiding eye contact, I'll give that to them) then the girl disappeared for 20 minutes, came back and ignored me entirely. Finally, someone brought out my phone. And it still doesn't work. You have an hour and a half to fix a speaker and it still doesn't work? 

I took the phone to Cherry Hill and it was a whole new experience. The person I worked with actually listened to me, and when I told her the speaker didn't work she tested it out with me, and explained what the problems might be. It's like she understood that I might want some insight into my very expensive phone. The problem was solved in 10 minutes!

This is the second time I've taken my product to that store only for them to either do further damage or do nothing at all. The first time was with my Mac Book Pro, which had a slight glitch. When I got it back the problem was still there, and the screen was now flickering in and out for no reason. I took it into Cherry Hill and they told me that whoever had looked at my computer had clipped a wire and messed up the connection. They were shocked when I told them it was an Apple employee. Unbelievable. Absolutely unbelievable. 

Both my brothers worked for Apple. My mom worked for Apple. My mom refuses to go to the Sagemore store. We are an Apple family and this store is really a black mark on the company. Don't waste your time here. Cherry Hill is so much better and so close.

I started taking my two high energy pups here. They both love this park, it's a beautiful park, and lots of parking spots. They also have water spots.  everywhere at park, bring a bowl for doggies. Just a an advise keep eye out for dead birds and fish throughout your walk.

We had some guests and ordered about $150 worth of food from T'dori.  The food was average at best.  Some of the dishes were under seasoned and had zero flavor.  Some were over seasoned and were borderline inedible.  This place used to be better.  The only positive was that they have big portions, but I'd rather have good food than lots of bad food.  

They accidentally left a dish out of our order.  Our guests were hungry and we didn't have time to drive back.  We called that night and they wouldn't refund our money, only restaurant credit.  Apparently "Their boss has a policy of no refunds ever".  To me it seems pretty silly policy to lose a customer for their $14.99 mistake.  I had to reverse the charge with my credit card company.  

I won't be going back here.

They are opened for dine in 
Their maki rolls are top notch 
Probably the best sushi in lansdale

Drove 40 mins just for this place and they did not disappoint. We ordered 4 different platters with just about every side they offer. The Mac n cheese and the potato salad were my favorite but the greens and beans were also delicious. They have huge portions that definitely left us with leftovers. Do yourself a flavor and try out this black owned business! You won't be disappointed. (Wish I took pics but we ate too fast lol)

Most of the time if you have seen one Kroger, you have seen majority of them...however this location was different than most that I have visited and still frequent to this day. Mainly the size and layout with this location threw me off, as it was tiny for a Kroger and given that size difference, the layout and flow did not really work as well as the larger locations. 

In addition to the size, which is understandable as you can only do so much with the space you have...the condition of the store was less than stellar. It was definitely older, dated and worn. 

We swung by for a few items to hold us over for the night, mainly snacks and bottled water/drinks. Out of the six things we were after, we had to pivot to other items on three of them as they were out of stock. 

Parking is not an issue as they have their own dedicated lot, but also share the larger shopping center lot and deck with the other businesses. 

Service also left something to be desired. We did self check-out and the young lady who was watching the registers was nose deep in his phone and was actively having a conversation with someone. When we needed assistance I had to go get him and during his assistance, he continued having his phone conversation and did not speak to us at all. Very bold and odd for a Kroger. 

Overall, not my greatest experience at a Kroger and honestly, I would be upset if this was my neighborhood Kroger. I would definitely be driving a few more miles to avoid frequenting this location.

I love this place! The tortilla chips are the best I've ever had! Tacos were incredible, especially Al Pastor! The ingredients were very fresh and everyone working their was friendly! Can't wait to visit again!

I'm rating this place a 4 stars. Our food was AMAZING! However, we did not like the salsa, which is no big deal to us, and there hours of operation are strange. They close at 8 which if you are on vacation and spending most of your day on the water is just too early.

After a night of drinking margaritas and nomnomnoming down cheese steaks, what better way to end the evening than a cup of strawberry covered in toppings so much that you can't even see the frozen treat below.

Had a chance to hang out with and old friend and catch the Pokey LaFarge show here last night. Didn't get to see the art space, but the 4th floor music stage was perfect for a smallish show. To my happy surprise the acoustics were spot on. I would definitely be willing to return here for another show. The alcohol selection was limited to a few beers and your hard liquor mainstays. If you want my recommendation, go for the show and then head out boozin later.

Okay this place is just FUN FUN FUN.  Picture it: a NYC girl in Nashville wearing a purple cowboy hat and dancing to live music.  It's probably not a pretty sight, but this is one of those situations where I'm glad I don't have to actually see myself!  Wahoo!

The drinks were good and we made friends with some others hanging out at the bar.  People started buying me drinks and I tried one of everything that people said was good.  The bartender tried to give me drinks I hadn't tried before.  Now I know I have a good liver, but 8 shots later I was totally sober so I'm thinking these drinks aren't too strong.

This place is just a good place to have a good time.  As a married girl out with a girl friend, there was lots of respectful dancing and talk.  I was impressed - usually guys get too grabby.  No problems here...and I still have lots of pictures with me and a whole bunch of strangers I'll never see again.  Fun times!

Bad Boy Burgers on Vista is "still doin there thang"
The Finger steaks were smaller than I had anticipated but cooked right. The basket came with gems, fry sauce and cocktail sauce along with shredded lettuce, a few small diced tomato dropped with cheese- kind of like a salad, only not.
The Bad Boy burger with cheese is a quarter pound with Merican cheese and the standard burger salad. A bench staple, pay the boys a visit

Went with my family . We loved it . Food was great for the price . The portion sizes do not disappoint. Clean and friendly environment. Large party friendly . We went early around 8:45am on a Sunday. By the time we were finished around  10:45 there were large wait lines so I suggest going early . Also, parking is complimentary valet !

Here I go again with another disappointing meal!  Ya know, I'm getting really tired of supporting crappy local restaurants.  I understand times are difficult for the restaurant industry, but does that excuse mediocre food and slow service?!  My Bloody Mary was terrible. Heavy vodka pour, but the mix had zero taste!  Garnish of 3 small green olives was lame.  Mozzarella and tomato salad bland, my veal chop tasted meh with very little seasoning.  Side of potatoes and veggies was just ok.  But the wait times were atrocious!  Waitress actually said she slowed the service down for the kitchen to catch up?!?!  I'm sorry but what does that mean?!  You do not tell customers this!!  She also had a flippant attitude.  My FIL joked about placing his breakfast order because it took so long.  He got tasteless, dry pasta bolognese with very little sauce!  Best part was the bread basket and oil dip.  The place was packed though and the volume level was off the charts.  Guess all those people must LOVE mediocre Italian food and snail-like service.  GET IT TOGETHER, Osteria!
First time there today. First impressions... very closed off tight group kind of crowd. Did not feel welcome. Second impression... $7 for a pint of Guinness!? You have to be kidding?

Briar is the only all men's vintage store (that I know of) in the city.  It's a pretty rare thing to find a store that even has a small amount of vintage duds for men, let alone a whole shop filled with them!  I know that the owner Amanda of Sazz Vintage and the manager David have collaborated on the store - I don't know to what degree - but you certainly won't find any other people with the kind of knowledge that they have about men's vintage apparel in this town.

David pretty much lives Briar.  If you like his look, you are going to like the store.  He reminds me of an amalgamation of 19th C. dandy and 1940s stylish American man.  

He once commented on my All Black oxfords with stacked heels - told me that he "loved them".  That one is filed in my complement vault.

Despite the crazy weather, the rental process was smooth. Everything was explained thoroughly by the young lady taking care of my reservation.  I wish I remembered her name! The only surprise was the mile cap for local residents.. I booked through Travelocity and it shows unlimited mileage there,  no disclaimer. If that was disclosed I would of given 5 stars .

Average food that you'll wait forever for. Server checked in on us 2x in over an hour. Ribs were average. Mac and cheese is good. Wouldn't come back.

Update: member of our party got sick from the food.

Good coffee. I will sample more of what they have to offer since I feel places like this are important to the city and offer an alternative to fast food. But they kinda need to lose the militant vegan attitude. That was a turn off. I don't care if you a vegan cafe. All I want is good coffee that rocks. 

Please consider something other than your Brazil "creamer." I understand good food comes at a premium, but I found the whole Brazil thing pretentious.

Not sure why this place is at 3.5 stars. If you are a couple and 1 of you likes sushi and the other is a cooked meal type of person this is the place for you! My wife says the sushi is always fresh and delicious and plentiful. I enjoy the 12oz sirloin steak cooked to perfection and a generous portion of veggies and rice and a salad with ginger dressing. our waitress was perfect and the atmosphere is cozy. my steak dinner was $12.99. They offer many specials. Wonderful Place!

This is the old Yoyo's.  Same owner, Tony. Great guy and awesome cook. The best Italian restaurant in the Tierra Verde area. The garlic rolls are a must. The pizza, the calzone, chicken alfredo - delicious. Highly recommended.

So I just absolutely love Shane Co. My fiance bought my ring in February and every time we have gone in since to get it cleaned or looked at, Shane Co is extremely professional and nice.  I can get my ring cleaned as many times as I want, whenever, and without an appointment. It is really so nice to get things shined up before a fun weekend or an occasion. 

I am so happy that my love went to Shane Co - we will be picking out wedding bands there soon.

My friend and i ordered the caramel Machiatto. Mine was a tall and hers a grande. Both of ours had a pouring amount in caramel. They didn't do this last time. I taste alot less of caramel at downtown st.pete. Stay consistent! St. pete dt taste much better. Part street put like 3 table spoons caramel in there. Sugar kill.

Apparently I live in an area that is still considered a foreign country to places that deliver food. But thats ok because I am perfectly content to stop by Pizza Perfect whenever I have a pizza craving.

The quality of pizza is really really really good. We've tried most of the pizzas you can get there but favorites are meatball and the white pizza ( which comes with artichokes on it...yum). The crust is perfectly done and none of their pizzas feel like a grease-fest. I usually only need to blot it once or twice to make me feel like I'm eating a little bit healthier (Yes, I pretend it does). I haven't tried any of the sandwiches but their calzones are very good as well.

It may seem like its run by teenagers, but they are definitely among the most pleasant ones you'll find. If you live in the area this is the best pizza around. If you haven't tried it yet, you should!

For those Lexus owners or thinking to become ones.  Lexus of Edmonton client service is top notch.  I have been there for over four years now and the car service has been constantly good.  The car drop off is on time and the loaners are ready so there is no delay in the dealing and you can actually continue your day.  The service desk is prompt and cordial.   Before picking up the car, I receive a call letting me know that car is ready so I know car is ready for pick up .  I consider the service very professional and respectful.  The waiting area is very comfortable and they offer coffee, water, and so so pastries.  Newspapers are ready :  it is a great experience and you feel your car is in good hands.  I haven't had a major work on my car yet so I can't opone on the costs or service on those matters.

I wish I could give this place more than a 5! Seriously the best bubble tea in town. I've seen this man work everyday except Sundays! He works so hard and I can tell that he loves what he does. If you haven't visited this little cafe you need to! My whole family has been going for about 10 years! I love the environment, and he also expanded a few years ago! A lot more room and comfort. Try the egg rolls too!

Been here for lunch twice and it's great food and price! For $11.95, I got to choose from 5 broths, 5 items, and a big bowl of vegetables.  The broths are chicken, egg & tofu, tom yum, spicy chicken, and a mushroom one.  The 5 items are quite varied including fish filet, fish balls, shrimp, mussels, thinly sliced pork, chicken, or beef, tofu, udon, rice, or vermicelli noodles, rice, wontons, and more.  There aren't too many cooked items and no sliced lamb (although you can order it and pay extra) to choose for the lunch items, so likely more for dinner.

After I filled out my order on the paper, they brought out the bowl of vegetables.  I like the variety with lettuce, one big carrot, mushrooms, broccoli, and piece of corn on the cob.  The first time they also gave me a quarter of a tomato but not the second time.

While we waited for the rest of our food, we went to mix our concoction of sauces.  They do a pretty good to keep the sauces filled but the last time the bowl of cilantro was empty.  Soy sauce must be a popular choice as they have a large dispenser for it.    I like how there's a great selection including soy, oyster, sesame, XO, and chili sauces.

The tofu broth came out quickly and each person got their own pot which is great.  The temperature controls are just under the table top and easy to control and work well.  I turned it up to 3 on the control and my broth was boiling in little time.  The broth had a few pieces of tofu in it.

The meats, seafood, and noodles arrived soon after.  They gave me a bowl of noodles and I was impressed at the portion size.  I ordered fish, tofu, chicken, and shrimp.  I cooked a handful of noodles and mixed in the other food and vegetables.  With the sauce, it tasted delicious.

The first time I was here, it was full around 12:30.  The second time, the weather was warmer and the restaurant was never full.  Next time I want hot pot, will definitely go back!
They are simply the best. The entire staff is very kind (especially the owner). If you are in Philadelphia, definitely go here.

I have walked past here over the last few months and was excited to finally go here. From the outside it looks like a cool place and it definitely had a classic and hip vibe on the inside too! When we walked in we had to see a hostess who said we could sit at the bar just fine but had to get a table through them. All the tables had reserved signs but no one was sitting at them... so we had to go back to the front to get a table. Just a very weird set up to get a seat. 

We only got drinks and the menu was quite extensive. They only brew a few beers there but serve all the other beers from the other breweries. We got the sisters flight and their cider. The flight was $20 but wasn't listed on the menu, ugh! I usually like sour beers but these were all way too sour and were almost undrinkable. The cider also wasn't spectacular. Don't think we'll be going back here anytime soon.

Well, I finally got to see what all the fuss what about when The Halal Guys opened today on the Westbank.

As you know, I am a big fan of Middle Eastern food. Give me all the shawarma! The Westbank already has two really good locally owned Halal places: Sahara Cafe and Cleopatra. While I usually avoid chains (and I have avoided the two other Halal Guys locations that have opened in NOLA), I decided to give this place a shot.

Like I said, it was opening day, but there was barely a crowd so I was in and out in 10 minutes. The staff is great and has everything organized and they move quickly- major bonus points. I got the combo platter (chicken and gyro), extra white sauce and a side of hummus. The large platter will run you $10 and it's A LOT of food and well worth the money. The taste was good, but not great. The platter had a lot of flavor and the hummus tasted homemade, so I was happy about that. I enjoyed it and it definitely satisfied my craving, but it wasn't the best Middle Eastern food I've ever had. However, I could say that about a lot of other locally owned places I've tried.

It's a really good lunch place and they have a few wraps I'm eager to try. I would always choose to eat local, first and foremost, but this spot is good in a pinch.

My first time visiting New Orleans and this was on my to eat list. After reading all these great reviews about Cochon I had high expectations for this restaurant. Unfortunately it was just ok. The ambience was great, the servers were knowledgable and helpful but the food was a miss. We got the oysters with chili garlic butter was absolutely delicious (which is really why I'm giving this 3 stars)! The cocktails were also strong and pretty decent. That's where the good really ended for me. I got the cochon with cabbage and it was extremely salty. It was not really balanced out well. Had a few other side dishes and they were all blah. Portions were also small and I left feeling like...did I really even eat? Overall not memorable and lacking.

I loved this store! The customer service was excellent, I felt like a princess in there and the quality of the clothing was outstanding. I ended up spending way more than I should have, but I don't regret it at all! I think I will even shop from here online now that I'm back home.

Came here while attending a conference at the convention center. Amazing food and super cool vibe, service was fast and good and the had a great selection of drinks at the bar. I would definitely recommend anyone looking for some great meat to check this spot out.

Never again. My biggest complaint was "lunch with the characters".  The minute you walk in, someone actually yells to not approach the characters. They will come to every table. Really? Not one came to us. My husband quietly went to Zoe and asked if she/he would come say hi to our 21 month old granddaughter. She/he obliged. That was it. Elmo is in a corner with a professional photographer. They ask your table number so that you can of course purchase the photo. What a shock (sarcasm) when they didn't have it! No toilet paper or paper towels in restrooms. No one cared. The floor was slippery and wet from people that didn't dry themselves from the disgusting water rides. I called corporate, and was basically told too bad, so sad, we're not doing anything about it. All I'm asking is for some compensation for the non existent character lunch. I called the local news stations today to see if they can help, and put a dispute claim on my credit card for the lunch. Save your money. What a ripoff.

This place was SO good. It was a bit late when we arrived and not very crowded, but the service was wonderfully friendly and attentive. With a Yelp check in, we got a tasty meze platter for free and every one of the 5 items on it was perfect. That dish came with a side of fresh pita that was light and fluffy and direct from the oven. The turkish ravioli was mouthwatering and the scallops entree was delicious and big enough to share. We finished with Baklava and coffee, and would absolutely be back with frequency if we lived anywhere near Philadelphia.

By far the worst experience I have ever had at Panera. This was down right horrible. I came here with my girlfriend for a quick lunch and chose this over the pho restaurant in the same complex to try and mix it up...BIG MISTAKE. I order the lobster sandwich and side salad 1/2 1/2 combo and the sandwich came out horribly runny and watery. I did not notice it until I sat down outside and took a bite. It was the worst taste ever and made me very upset because they charged $16 for that combo! I take my order inside and go to show the employee behind the counter and before I say anything he goes "it's too watery isn't it?" And I say yes and ask to get another sandwich. He then has to get his manager who tries to tell me I can get another sandwich, however I will not get refunded the difference. I had to look him dead in the eyes and say "I don't care, I want my money back and will then pay for a proper sandwich that is not soaked in water" and he reluctantly asks if I still have my receipt, which I do and then refunds me the difference, $8! By then I had waited an additional 20minutes for my refund and new meal while my girlfriend had to wait for me. A quick, nice relaxing lunch turned into a stressful, disgusting hour long ordeal. By the time I sat down with a decent sandwich I didn't even feel like eating and just wanted to take my tray inside and throw it at the manager, food and all and go somewhere better. I will never go back to this location again, or any others most likely.

I can't tell you how much I love Yelp! Yelp never disappoints me. You won't be disappointed choosing this company.  Worth. Every. Dime.
We booked Big Rick's Moving two days in a row (one for packing things and one for loading our truck). They were on time both days! I highly recommend their packing services too (very quick and thorough). Very personable and friendly. Great job guys and thank you for taking care of my mom we had a great move out of state :-)

I'm not going to lie Rouse's is pretty expensive but I do like their produce. I'd rather go to some of the higher-end Rouse's where you can churn your own Almond butter.

Their Petit Fours are amazing! Also - during Mardi Gras there is a contest where you 'find the baby' and you can get a free slice of King Cake.

Honestly, has anyone ever tasted good food that reviewed this place? It is a Chinese buffet feel that makes sub standard sandwiches with prepackaged side dishes. I threw away  most of my food (soup, BBQ sandwich, pasta and potato salad) but drank the I unsweet tea. Try visiting a real deli (northeast) before trying to compare this place. Perhaps the breakfast is better, but I doubt it.

Dr Haraphongse has been a fabulous Dr! She is very thorough and always really cares and takes the time to fully listen to her patients. HOWEVER some of the ladies at the front desk have zero customer service skills and are quite rude and not at all caring about patient care and don't own when they make mistakes at all!! It is infuriating to deal with that level of ignorance. Dealing with them makes me want to change clinics which is unfortunate as she is a great Dr.

Such a fabulous lunch!!  It was a nice day in February.  We ate on the patio.  Crowded, but not noisy.  It was a pleasant chatter everywhere.  
I had the perfect burger.  So perfect.  My husband had seared Ahi Tuna salad & was in love.
Absolutely terrible service. They messed up my order and they gave me an attitude about it. Not to mention the pizza was like cardboard. I do not recommend this place not the food nor the service

It's not as huge or legendary as the Reading Terminal Market, but this farmers market still has a lot of great buys and is very worth checking out.
some of it stands include the following:

1) One of the best cheese shops ever.
2) The best sushi stand that you will find in any marketplace.
3) a fish stand that offers incredibly fresh fish at good buys.
4) the second best Amish section outside of Pennsylvania Dutch territory.
5) Their very own mini wine section which makes it one of the only place in PA where you can buy wine outside of a state store.

You will usually find anything your looking for. But there is also a Trader Joe's inside the same parking lot if you can't.

A warm strong welcome immediately when you enter this cool Pub.  I sat at the bar as I was alone. The bartender was waiting for me the minute he saw I was ready ....great wine and BEER -18 on tap. I ordered streamed clams and fish and chips. The clams were perfectly cooked and fresh they just needed a bit more adventure on spice. I would order them again.  The Fish and Chips were awesome as the bartender highly recommended.  Fries? Eh homemade.  I'm just tired of fries.
They decided to ignore customers twenty minutes before closing so they could socialize outside.

Been to Seamus McDaniel's year and years ago and remember the delicious and large hamburgers they create.  In searching for something to eat the other night, stumbled upon Seamus McDaniel's at 1208 Tamm Avenue in Dogtown area.  It was another winner . . .

Ordered the pasta con broccoli with both white cream sauce (and a touch of red sauce) with plenty of shell pasta, broccoli, and mushrooms.  The dish was FULL and so was I at the end of the meal.

You can add a good size house salad onto your dinner entrée for $1.99 . . . and wanted to try their sliced garlic bread too.  Both were winners.

Next time I will be getting the burger.  Seamus McDaniel's lived up to its reputation.  The main dining room was packed during the week and we had to sit in the side dining area just outside the kitchen which was also full.

Prices were very reasonable too and I'm ready to go back very soon.

I LOVE YOU. One day I waited in line twenty minutes and then you RAN OUT OF DOUGHNUTS!!!! WHAAAAA!?!?!? But it was all good because you gave me a card for a FREE half dozen. Thanks for doing right by your customers!

Brunch is my favourite meal of the day. I took my friend with me to brunch here on a Sunday, they were pretty crowded but the food was wonderful. Minus one star because the waitress made us sit upstairs even though my friend is a disabled vet who had to lumber painfully behind her one step at a time up the flight of stairs. Of course he is too manly to say anything, but I thought it in poor taste that instead of recommending somewhere else, she merely waited for us at the top of the stairs.

Overall, though, the quality of the food here is outstanding and I would come here again, but if I was going with my friend, I would insist on sitting downstairs.

This was a fun treat up at La Encantada! We had a great time celebrating, but were very lucky we got here for happy hour. Their prices are reasonable during HH but borderline expensive (their cheapest glass of wine was one red and one white, each $9, the rest more than $10) at other times. Fortunately, they have great specials on each night of the week, which is encouraging. The live music was great, as well.

Unfortunately our waitress was very busy, even though it was a Tuesday night and there were empty tables everywhere. There were 7 of us, here just for wine and a few appetizers but were never brought water and were left with empty plates and glasses quite frequently. Every time she came to the table, we were all more than ready to order more of everything, but after taking one order, she'd walk away and we'd have to call after her to get her to take the rest of our orders. A few of us split a cheese and meat tray and ordered the manchego and a cheddar with onion and chives. The board was brought out and the manchego was there (and delicious) but the cheddar on the board was orange, and definitely tasted like boring old cheddar. Of course it was another 10 minutes before I could ask if this was the onion/chive cheese, and then 5 minutes until she came back from the kitchen with the "we are out of the onion and chive" response. She kindly offered us to choose another cheese, which took all of 30 seconds but she was long gone and it was another 20 minutes for her to come back. Oye. And apparently they charge a 18% gratuity to parties of 6 or more, which was definitely more generous than I felt was deserved. 

I'd love to come back and sit outside.

Overall the food was good, however I did have a problem with my Mongolian Beef... for the almost $13 for the entree, without an egg roll or even fried rice, I would expect more then 4 tiny pieces of beef in my meal. It was practically all onion.... There had to be at least 3 whole onions in my meal. I will say... The beef that was actually in there tasted great.

I would go again, but wouldn't get the Mongolian Beef!!
Food is very good but a little noise due to small location. Service was very good and menu changes

I stopped in here for a quick manicure & pedicure before my engagement party. I wanted a clean, simple manicure with a neutral nail color and the service didn't disappoint. The price includes a hot stone leg  massage and the manicure included a shoulder massage. The staff was very friendly and helpful. I'll definitely stop back next time I'm in town.

The food was alright, but nothing special.  Our group had 8 guests, and we just did not receive the service we had hoped for.  I was never asked if I wanted a refill on my drink, and I had to ask two different people for one to-go.  They were very quick to take our drink and food orders, but after that, very little attention was paid to us.  The waiter also was not very pleasant.
What a gem. Love the Peruvian part of the menu! Not greasy/oily, just wonderful flavorful food. Great value on top shelf drinks too. I'll be back!

Absolutely delicious food, the yellow curry is a great meal especially for the colder winter months. The service and facility is top notch. I like the fact that at lunch there is counter service, it's really quick for those on a limited schedule. I think I've found my favorite new restaurant!

Went here on a short stop on our road trip. I wanted to try a little bit of everything so I had the combo plate with shrimp creole, jambalaya, blue crab Étouffée (replacement from red beans and rice) with some chicken gumbo on the side. Everything was really good. My favorite was the Étouffée. The sauce was amazing. The gumbo wasn't far behind. Shrimp creole was good too. Who am I kidding? It was all good!!

Customer service is horrendous. The employees are always rude and annoyed. The food is always old and disgusting. My order is wrong 9 times out of 10 and no one cares about getting it wrong or making up for it. They usually end up remaking my food while I still pay full price for it with nothing to make up for the fact that they just wasted my time. Huge waste of time and money. Last night there was a hair in my sandwich and all they did was give me my money back. No one apologized or offered to make up for it. Will never eat here again. I will drive all the way to Clearwater for the Steak and Shake on SR 580 to avoid this place.

As first time home buyers, we couldn't be more pleased with the service! Christine was incredibly nice, helpful, and a pleasure to work with. Our inspector, Dan, was informative, thorough, and super helpful in explaining details about our concerns. The report was easy to read and understand. I would absolutely recommend them to anyone and we will definitely be using their service again for any future homes!

My sisters home was in need of a professional cleaning as she has 4 pets. I contacted various cleaning services for a quote and availability last minute right before Xmas. I decided to go with the Dean Clean Team as they were available in short notice. They did an amazing job cleaning the 1 bedroom apartment and were very accommodating. Thank you for all your hard work, highly recommended.

Absolutely love this place! It's across the street from my work, so I frequent Suis. The menu is ever changing and always on point. The booze is reasonably priced with a delicious wine selection. I wish they were open right now because that's where I'd be!

I lived behind this place for close to 9 years. I've been there maybe once or twice in the past. I've mostly always considered this place to be a local bar. Never-the-less, I'm always in search of the best wings around, I go Publix because their wings are generally good at a good price. However, on this particular day, I wanted something different. So throughout my searches, Yelp recommends Bilmar station for wings, rated one of the best places in town. I'm thinking, this rating has to be within a 5 mile radius from my house, not the entire city of Tampa?! After deciding to try it out, I was completely blown away, their wings are without a doubt some of the best wings I've had in town! Their mild wings were crisp while maintaining tenderness. But the most impressive aspect was the sauce! They're a little pricey, but I'll reiterate the fact I'm used to Publix wings, and their wings like $9.99 for like 50 wings. But never-the-less I would recommend Bilmar station's wings.
Love it here! They fix my nails up every time another place messes them up. I've been to different techs and they all do amazing jobs. Reasonable prices.

The staff here is the highlight. Been here more than a dozen times and each time the staff is helpful and seems happy. 

They also do UPS and USPS shipping so you can compare costs which sometimes vary between companies drastically. Not a huge fan of shipping stuff but it is nice when the staff is pleasant.

My friend and I stopped in after an event at USF. It was late and pretty much anywhere serving food was closed, except for 3 coins and taco bus. So we opted to try something new. I was torn between a couple things on the menu, and the waitress suggested the French toast from my list. I went with it and while it was good, there was nothing that blew my mind. I also found myself wishing for real maple syrup as I always seem to do anywhere that only gives me "pancake syrup" as an option. Our waitress was fantastic, but the place is a total dive. I was reassured by the 3-4 cops that came in for their dinner break that night though.

I love coming here when I stay in Indy because we do not have CPK in my city. The pizza is so amazing! I always order the White Pizza because I love the roasted garlic and sauteed spinach and the different kinds of cheeses. It is seriously one of the best pizzas!  I should also add the staff is always very,very kind whenever I stop by and that makes me happy! Good food and great staff always makes a great restaurant!

Thank God for white castles they prepare your food from start to finish Pour your drinks right in front of you. It was White castle that brought hamburgers back it look as if it's going to have to be white castles to bring people back to eating out .

I really love there food and have been ordering from Paprika since they have been open. Recently, I ordered through Uber eats and went through a whole mess trying to get my food and never received it, it was telling me that it was delayed. I was told by the restaurant to contact Uber eats which I did. I was on the phone for hours trying to resolve the issue and after 2 and a half hours of going back and forth between Uber eats and the restaurant, I was exhausted. In the end Uber eats offered to pay for my food and the cancellation and told me that I would be able to still pick up my food for the inconveniences. Furthermore, I called as well as Uber eats to explain that I would be coming to still pick up the food even though it was cancelled. They told me that my food wasn't there and that they weren't responsible for anything on my part and that I wouldn't be getting another platter unless I paid for it, AGAIN. I was very disappointed and dissatisfied and they weren't too comforting nor apologetic in the matter. What a disappointment coming from a local business.

This place deserves a high rating. The tacos are not expensive and they are delicious. Especially you should try the triple play! You can choose any three types of tacos. I liked the spicy shrimp one and the ahi tuna! 

You can also play baseball. If you have not tried baseball yet, this is the place to go! 

The negative things are the following:
There are not many parking spots. Actually they do have 15+ but given that it's a popular place, the spots are always taken.

You might need to wait a bit to get your food!

It's a lot like Chipotle's except it has a bar and sports TV's and there are more options for add-ins and for basic choices (e.g., they have quesadillas).  I was very impressed by how they renovated the old house and added the crazy contemporary structure in the back.  Very tasteful.  I had a pork carnitas burrito and sorry to say, it was not.  Not very tasteful, I mean.  Same category of atrocious tortillas as at Chipotle's.  Those things could be manufactured in larger sizes and sold as trampolines.
THIS PLACE IS BOMBBBBBB. Me and my 2 friends named alex and alex were treated like QUEENS. Highly recommend

Went here because it was the only bar that didn't have a line out the door. It was a really great experience. A small quaint cozy bar with friendly bartenders that had fast service. If you're looking for a place to just have a few drinks and not be consumed by large crowds on a Saturday night, this is it!

Came here with a large group of people during a conference, and wasn't overly impressed.
The salsa that comes with the table was probably the highlight of the meal. I got the carnitas tacos and they tasted like the meat had been sitting in a crock pot for days. The tacos felt soggy and the flavor was pretty blah. The beans and rice, which is usually one of my favorite parts of a meal at a Mexican restaurant, were too bland and tasteless. If you want good Mexican food, keep looking.

I went to Indiana Spine Group after a recent cosmetic surgery I had due to some left over swelling in my lower back along with some pain in my spine. I was 5 weeks out after my surgery and my doctor had referred me here for a check up because the cosmetic surgery I had done had nothing to do the area that was swelling on my lower back. I was told to arrive 30 minutes before my actual appointment to fill out paperwork. I got to the office by 11:05 my appointment was for 11:30.
