I had already done all the necessary paperwork online they asked of me. I sat down with a nurse in the waiting area and filled out more paperwork and then was put in a room to wait for the doctor. Naturally I expected for them to give me a bit of the run around before actually seeing the doctor because I had never been there before. Because I didn't come with images (MRI or X-ray) the nurse raised an eyebrow at me for not coming with any of those images. Which tells me she wasn't paying a bit of attention when I told her I wasn't in there because of an injury I just needed advice on my lower back and if after the surgery I had this was normal. After waiting for about 30 minutes we're now at 12:00 pm and an x-ray tech steps in and says they need to do imaging. I politely told him no and that I'd prefer to talk to the doctor before doing imaging as once again my swelling wasn't a result of injury. He was annoyed with me that I refused but told me he would send the doctor in anyhow. I waited another 20 minutes for the doctor to come in. He was very nice and agreed with me that I didn't need imaging and apologized about the staff pushing it on me. After reading through everything he had me taken care of and on my way. The real reason I was dissatisfied with this place was truly because instead of treating me like a patient I was treated like a number. In order for the monotony to stop I had to say I wasn't going to go along with their little plan to charge me out the wazoo by taking images and reading them in the same day. I couldn't help but think they force this on everyone that doesn't have it in them to say no first and talk to a doctor before hand. It makes me wonder if that is how they are paying for the brand new fancy expansion taking place there. Although the doctor was kind and understanding, the staff was taught to be pushy and insistent. Beware of this place and know that as a patient it is ok to say no and ask to speak to someone before they do imaging.
rude staff, they lose and don't honor reservations. Avoid this place. Go somewhere that deserves your business.  Food ok, but it's not worth having to deal with the people who work there.

As awesome as everyone says it is.  Very affordable too.  The only thing I wasn't crazy about was their homemade ketchup - but I asked for a side of the special sauce they use on the burgers (it's mayo-based) and that went perfectly with the fries.

Even if you aren't into Twitter, follow their page to see what this week's specials are.  Also if you don't want to wait in line ahead of time, they will usually tweet a few times during the evening to let the stragglers know that there are still burgers and no line.

I have been going to the Listening room for quite some time, being a local and I love it.  One of the best sound rooms in town for hearing great live music and the food is good.   Generally great servers.

their prices are higher
but that's no reason to give a one star
its their rudeness and better than thou attitude

Second time being here and we love it, went for breakfast and love the ambiance and menu, the portion size is awesome and the food is great too. Had the butter croissant with eggs and Italian sausage. It was great! Will be back.

had my first pat's about 25 years ago and I still love it every time I eat it.  I took away a star because the last time I was there they changed their ice from delicious crushed to cubes.  not a fan of the change.

Saint Louis is home to a number of great Italian restaurants, and LoRusso's has earned a place among the best of these.  As a modestly sized restaurant on "The Hill" this location has an "old town" ambiance with pleasant but understated decor.  Irresistible aromas allure visitors even while still in the parking lot.  Once inside, there is a  sense of being only a step away from an Italian grandmother's well-stocked kitchen.

We were seated promptly as per our reservations, and our small table for two was comfortably nested against a wall, allowing a view of two rooms filled with guests who ran the gamut with regard to age, gender, etc.  it seemed most were having a good time, along with plenty of wine...the scent of "good vintage" perfumed the air.

Our waiter, Vince, was a lively and charismatic man who accurately sensed that my dinner guest was to be attended - while I remained low maintenance - and proceeded to make sure she enjoyed truly lovely service.  All of her questions about the menu and specific items were answered in detail.  In time, we ordered the eggplant lasagna (a meatless dish with cheese and marinara) and chicken spedini.  Both arrived after a reasonable wait, along with Italian bread that was among the best I've had in the area.

Our entrees did not disappoint, with both dishes proving to be absolutely delightful.  The Italian custard dessert with fresh berries also was a dream.  Fresh, flavorful, and with just a hint of the wine/spicing that is the hallmark of Italian fare in the Northeast, the Ohio valley, and the Great Lakes area.  This was Italian of the sort one finds in the "auld neighborhood" in Boston, Philadelphia, Pittsburgh, Cleveland, or Chicago.  Yes...this is how it should be.  Eat!  Eat!  Let us feast!

And so we did, and so we shall again.  Many thanks, LoRusso's!

While both locations of UCBC are good, their newest location is by far my favorite. Spacious, with seating both inside and out, with the quality beer (and food) we've come to expect from one of the best breweries in St. Louis.

I had the fried shrimp platter, and a cup of seafood gumbo. Some of the best fried shrimp I've ever eaten hands down! French fries cooked perfectly, and not overly seasoned. The gumbo was good, spicy isn't really that spicy, and a little more watery than I am use to. Don't mistake that for a negative by any means. It was delicious! I will definitely return. #5stars

This was the last stop on my pizza tour of Hernando County and I almost missed it altogether as I was keen to get the article out. I'm glad that I made the effort to go down and try it though as I have discovered a really good pizza for a really good price.

$3.99 lunch special for 2 slices and a soda. $3.99!!

The two owners were in the kitchen talking whilst I was waiting for the pizza blissfully unaware I was eavesdropping on their conversation. They were just like an old married couple, I could have sat there all day listening to them going back and forth.

Anyway, the pizza has a sesame seed crust, which adds something different and exciting to this variation. The pizza is a thinner New York style and it is GOOOOOOD. Lots of sauce, lots of nice gooey cheese. I really enjoyed this pizza and had I had more time I would have gone back and tried one with more toppings. For $3.99 you simply can't find a fault in it. I suggest that if you are passing that way you stop in for some entertainment and some really good tasting pizza.

This is my first time meeting Natural Beauty by Latricia but I can tell she has a wonderful spirit and she was a pleasure to be around. The shop is beautiful and there is parking. I felt comfortable and trusted her from the beginning of our consultation because she asked questions to build a rapport. Her work was flawless and her products were great. She does not force services on you but let's you know what you need. I will be back! Follow Latricia on instagram and view her on Styleseat.com
Breakfast was great and an awesome value with bottomless Mimosas.  We had a poignant visit watching the world cup with 50+ raucous Argentina fans.

The food and service was great but the low rating is due to the conditions of the restaurant. It is a shame that a business would not have a functioning air conditioner in the dining room. It was around 90 degrees inside when we walked in. After talking with the waitress who was sweating profusely, we were told that the a/c in the dining room is always broken. 
    You could actually tell by the conditions of the wet tile floor, which was slippery and the ceiling fan blades were dropping downward similar to what happened after Katrina from the excessive humidity inside.
How in gods name is this place famous for their pork sandwich? Soggy bread with heaps and heaps of meat? Eh no thanks.

The St. Louis Cathedral is a beautiful towering staple in Jackson Square. I can't think of Jackson Square without a picture of this beautiful Cathedral appearing in my head. On a gorgeous day you can walk through the garden or around marveling at the local street art and into the Cathedral which is free to visit and there's never a wait. The stained glass is breathtaking and is in wonderful condition. I've been coming to New Orleans for ten years and can't walk through the French Quarter without paying a visit once or twice.

I have always wanted to try their donuts everytime I go through Southport Road. I visited this place a couple of times and ordered a dozen of donuts for my family in each visit. The donuts are just OK, not special. I'd rather go downtown and get my donuts from Dunkin Donuts. Or drive up to Keystone Ave and satisfy my craving for donuts from the Donut Shop. Dissapointed. I miss Virginia Kay's.

Good food in good quantities. The atmosphere is calm without being pretentious. My burger was good and my wife enjoyed her fish. Our server was very nice, but did seem a little rushed. This place is popular locally and I can understand that given the value for the cost.

I was having trouble with my ankle. I let it go for several weeks. Dr mike assured me he could help. I was very impressed with what he did and was able to take care of it.  I will recommend him to anyone having issues. Thanks dr mike.

What a waste of space. Beautiful location and completely wasted. Closes over 30 minutes before the time stated, terrible food that's completely overpriced, and pitiful staff. I will watch this place fail and close within months. Hopefully a better restaurant will fill the soon unoccupied space.
Very intimate setting and the staff is very attentive.  Food was good but not outstanding.  I was expecting more considering what I paid for my meal.

Everytime I go to Peg's, I order the Island breakfast from their Hawaiian menu. It consists of 2 porkchop slices topped with teriyaki sauce, rice, macaroni salad, eggs and a pineapple slice. It is AMAZING! Although it is good, I can never finish it in one sitting, because there is so much food they give you, for such a good price!

I had 2 PRP Microneedling back to back procedures done here. The Nurse Practitioners are very knowledgeable and gentle with the procedure. I especially like how I felt 0 pain. Although, the cost is around $680 per procedure. I've been to one other place to get PRP at a $300 lower price and really appreciate how non-painful this location is with the procedure and worth the money. Pictures are taken of your face and this location is neat, staff are friendly as well.
 My first experience was pretty salesy with their products, I do like their koji pads, they are amazing, but I try to use products with less synthetic ingredients. I wish they included active duty military discount, but unfortunately they dont so fyi. I noticed my Enlarged pores shrinking, my face looking brighter and plump.

Wowza and wowza. It has been a long time since I have been to Shapiro's and most great places with time I feel tend to degrade. That is not the case here. It's more like a fine wine. Seems to only have gotten better with age. They have the most amazing light rye bread. I dislike Rye bread however I could eat Shapiro's rye all day. Just a quick suggestion if you are like me, you can order just half a sandwich. Even the Reuben. OH man I have had a love affair with Reuben sandwiches since culinary school and I have to say that the Reuben at Shapiro's is by far the superior Reuben in Indianapolis. They are open for dinner too. Did you know that? Why did I think they were only open for lunch. Also on Tuesdays they have half price sandwiches I believe so if you're turned off by the price maybe make a trip on a Tuesday. The food is definitely worth it. The potato salad was also very tasty and you might as well have some cake and eat it too. :)

Boyfriend I went on Sunday after finding a coupon in the Val Pak. It was amazing. We used the the $30 coupon to get couples soup, salad, hibachi(steak,shrimp,chicken) meals, one sushi roll and fried rice. So much food and for a great price, we had lots of leftovers. Waitress was super sweet and attentive as well.
 The location is bad because its tucked away and slightly hard to find but it's worth it once you do. Will be back asap.

I called this local store on a whim to get a photo framed for a gift. After arriving, Betty was so helpful! She took so much time to help and explain everything to me in full detail. She was so patient with me, as I didn't know much about the framing process. She even took the time to put the hardware on my frame so it could easily be hung. She was so incredible and kind to work with. I highly recommend going to see Betty for all your framing needs!

Warm, welcoming, laid back and friendly. 

I've used ethnobotanicals for years and it's so gratifying and cool to have a local business I can actually support and recommend! The staff has ALWAYS been exceptionally friendly and helpful. Their suggestions are great and their Kava shakes in particular are really, really good.

I love Mad Hatters. 

I am using the word LOVE here!

:^)

I will NEVER come back. 


I came for visit number two after my visit last week. I dealt with the same employees, and I had the rudest encounter I have EVER had at a public place.  I inquired about the cupcake options, and I was TOLD there was some un-frosted cupcakes in the back. I asked for one of these, with white buttercream frosting, instead of one of the prepackaged 4-packs in the front. Instead, I had the manager get up, stomp around the bakery, and raising her voice in the store. I only stated preferred a "fresh" one from the back, instead of the pack of four. I didn't say it, but my concern was that they had been sitting out too long, as there were only four plastic containers left. The manager tells me that a fresh cupcake would fall apart if I tried to eat it. So I guess that means all of their cupcakes are old. This is the VERY same manager who was very friendly the first time (told me their best sellers) and smiling, AND who happily got us frosted almond cupcakes when I came in when my mom. Today, she stops her consultation (only other customer in the store), and informs me and the employee behind the counter that they "weren't dealing with that today." She was EXTREMELY rude and disrespectful. I even let them know that I had written a glowing Yelp review about my last visit. She continued to show her ugly attitude. She told the employee to "DO WHAT I SAY" in the future. We seriously were just trying to save plastic. I think she was just being ridiculous at this point. We even purchased extra items to have it be a $10 charge on our credit card. We bought chocolate covered strawberries, and asked if we could just get our strawberries out in the same container as the cupcakes, in order to save plastic, rather than using up an EXTRA container. There were only two cupcakes in the container, and we had no reason to carry two containers. The manager got onto the worker and said "REMEMBER who you work for" and "you do what I say". The manager, when she heard me mention my initial positive yelp review, she claimed they were too busy to "stop" what they were doing to frost cupcakes. However, only other customer was in there, and they were there for a sit down consultation. And if that's the case, that's fine, but I need to be told that in a nice way. 

Food:
Delicious cake options. Their best sellers are king cake, but also fruit filled cakes. I had a vanilla almond cupcake with white buttercream frosting. The buttercream frosting didn't have the best texture, in my snobby opinion. It was a little airy for my liking. However, the flavor of the frosting was pretty good. I would rate the icing a 6 and the cake portion a 9. The cake was flavorful, and had a delightful, crumbly texture as I bit into it. However, it was also moist and didn't fall apart as I bit into it. Overall, it was an 8/10 in my opinion, having eaten cupcakes from all over the United States, in many cities, and in many countries! Pick up a cupcake to try it out, and purchase a cake for a special occasion.

Best burger in Nashville, hands down. I recommend the Seamus burger over the Gabby burger (Seamus has one less patty). Otherwise it's too big to get into your mouth. 

The grass-fed beef and other quality ingredients make this a no-brainer when that greasy cheeseburger craving hits.

If I were to only rate based on food, it would've been 4 star. But the service that my family and I just had were the worst we experienced. 
We arrive around 5:40pm with the restaurant mostly empty except for maybe 3 tables. The lady went up to us saying that there is a party of 20 coming supposedly at 5:30, but they're late. We had a party of 6 and another family of 4 coming in later, so total of 10. They ended up giving us the "reserved" seats since we were already there. That table would fit around 12 people, so we were comfortable. 
Also it was Christmas, so the cook wasn't in, so they told us that if you order something other than noodle soup, it will take a long time to prepare. We were okay with that.
After ordering, the same lady came up and told us the 20 people are here and wanted our family of 6 to sit in a 4 seater, plus share a table with another family behind us. We were baffled that they would want us to separate our family of 6 into two tables. We ended up suggesting to use the table of 8 behind us in which we did. And our other family of 4 came in and there was a table of 4 in the back that was empty, but instead the lady told them it's reserved for another party of 20? It was confusing and the other family that was with us wanted to leave when they came in.
The managing of seats and reservations were confusing and out of hand.
This is good Italian the bread is soooo good I have 4 stars cause this place is pricy but the food is sooo bomb
Please add some bourbon to your bar and you will get 5 stars.  The music was awesome, fish tacos 5 star all the way.  Staff was awesome, truly makes the difference between a good and bad experience.

I tried sitting outside to drink & wait for my to-go food instead of sitting inside at the bar & it was a whole different experience. Our waitress was sweet & attentive & just generally good at being a waitress. The food we ate at home later & it was wonderful as usual. I've never had any problems with the food or service at Gunners Run, just the ambience inside. So going on a nice night & sitting at a table out in the piazza makes it a whole different experience. Sitting outside it's kind of a peaceful & nice. You notice less that there are very few customers besides a few regulars at the bar & you don't get that vaguely depressed icky feeling. They really need to do something about the inside of the restaurant, so I have two different ratings for this place. Nice weather & outdoor table: 3 stars.  Weather forcing you to sit inside: 2 stars.

Get a seat out in the courtyard!  Sunday Jazz Brunch is a treat to remember! Atmosphere, southern hospitality and food is amazing!  Chris was our server and his stories are great!  He graced us with his tales of the restaurant!  Thank you for making our visit the best ever!
The food was ALRIGHT but one of the workers tried to STEAL my phone and I found it by the findmyiphone app in the back of their kitchen.

Have frequented this bagel shop several times. Always great service and awesome bagel breakfast or lunch sandwiches.  Prices are reasonable.  Very clean place, good service and good food--what more do you need?  

Plenty of tables to sit inside or out.  Parking can be a little tricky at crowded times. We like the side lot as long as their are spots. If not the meters on the street behind are fine too.

Great local coffee shop!

This has popped up since I left the city a few years ago and it's a great addition to Whyte!  I love finding non-chain shops and this is a great one to hang out and catch up with friends or get some work done.  Wi-Fi with a minimum purchase.  They do have computers on site as well that involve an additional fee.

Nice seating options from tables to comfy chairs and nice table spacing.  Great mix of cold and hot drinks and a nice selection of basic coffees... loved my hazelnut one at less than $2 a cup!

How can you go wrong with that?

Came in here a little over two weeks ago to get some information on planning a destination wedding, as I'm a AAA Plus member. Unfortunately the travel agent who handles weddings was not in the office that day, but another travel agent  sat with me to get some details (where, when, # of guests, etc.), to then provide to her colleague. The woman I sat with, I don't recall her name, but she was very nice and provided me with a book to take home outlining the hotels in the Caribbean with which AAA has associations/partnerships with. I ended my visit with being told I would be hearing from the wedding travel agent when she was back in the office the next day. It's now been over two weeks, and I've not heard anything from AAA. 

I'm annoyed at the poor customer service at this location, but it will not deter me from going to another AAA location for wedding info. Giving two stars for the one woman who tried helping me, and was very professional & nice. Also for their convenience of being in Center City, so I was able to run over on my lunch break.

I will probably be back to this location, because of their convenience, for any map/brochure/travel book needs, but will definitely never use their agent services at this location.

HUGE Staples, really slow cashiers, clean store. 

Definitely not a bad choice if you're in need of some office supplies!

this place had a good college coffee shop vibe with plenty of busy bees studying and people chatting. I like the Scottsdale location more, because they were more accommodating to personal request. Might have to do with the level of traffic each one gets. Still a good place for an espresso.

I've really only ever been to two real 'cupcake' places; Kickass Cupcakes in Cambridge MA, and here.  My major complaints with Kickass Cupcakes were that they were overpriced (2.50-3.50 for a relatively small cupcake) and they were far from kickass.  

Flying Monkey, on the other hand, does it oh so right.  Their signature cupcake is a chocolate cupcake, with chocolate buttercream frosting, and banana filling in the middle.   It tastes even better than it sounds.  And its $2.  They've got other cupcakes that are also pretty good for less. They also have a bunch other delectable sugary treats that would send a diabetic to the ER in seconds.

I go here out of convenience sometimes, but prefer to buy local products. Harvest is a transnational corporation. Often times understaffed. There will often be 2 dozen waiting and they will have a mere two tenders and several empty slots. Post Office ridiculous.

The last of the Starr stops, rounding out at 10. I have an appreciation for the details that go into each vision. The brass clothes hooks and curtains to cover the liquor are great. The drinks again are delicious and strong. The art work is tasteful. We ordered the dessert sampler, I thought the churros were the best bite.

Two words, Taco Tuesday! 
Zim Zari is so fun and the food is really yummy! We have the best time every time we dine here.
Love Elite service! Chris, Rudy, Nate, Lisa, and the rest if the team are spectacular. I've trusted them with my cars since 2005 and highly recommend them and trust them. It's an excellent team!

If you like ultra ultra ultra, and I mean ultra thin crust pizza than you'll like this. But I honestly felt like I was eating a tortilla chip pizza. I literally could eat probably two of these "large"pizzas, nor am I a big eater. I recommend you skipping this location and getting something a little more hearty. Very disappointed.
Very good and very friendly!! This is my go to place!! Although they are closed on mondays and they usually close at 5 or 6. But they do do all items to go :)
Love it. Nice service, delicious dessert and waitresses are always friendly.

Hands down one of the best food experiences at a restaurant in my life.

We had bookmarked this restaurant before our trip to NOLA, and after taking a street car to the end of the line, realized we were close to it.

When we walked in, we were told they were fully reserved for the evening (this was at about 6:30 on a Friday).  It's a small place and we saw a couple of open tables.  We asked the host if we could eat if we promised to be out in less than 30 minutes.  He agreed and sat us.

Since time was of the essence, we decided to just order one appetizer and one main course.  And the truth is we weren't even that hungry because we had just eaten at Willie Mae's a few hours prior.  

We started with the boudin balls.  They were awesome.  Tender on the inside with a nice fired outer skin, they were quite delectable!

The star for me was the brisket however.  It was done to perfection, and even though I wan't very hungry, I would have easily ordered a second plate.

We had a blueberry capote dor dessert that was alright, but no mind-blowing.

Overall the best place we ate in in New Orleans and one of the best meals ever.  And to top it off, one of the incoming reservations wanted to sit at the bar, so we got to stay and enjoy ourselves without being rushed.

I am writing this review over a month after having been there which accounts for the brevity of it.  While the memory of the details begin to fade, the memory of the flavor does not!
I don't like ice cream and I will eat Ted Drewes any day. A perfect place for tourists or locals. Parking can take time and the lines can be long but it moves quick and it's worth the wait!

Last night was my first visit to Radizio and overall the food was GREAT.  I couldn't say the same about the service.  We had a table of six and we waited for drinks, had to ask about the very small appetizers and the rotation of meat servers were slow.  I think the meat servers were told to give small portion cuts because we got a bite or to and then waited several minutes for the next server of meat.  In other type of restaurants like this I've never had wait this long for the meat servers.  I would blame the service on this being a new restaurant but we met the owner which is also the owner of another successful Nashville restaurant, so I don't think they have the server/customer ratio at a good level yet.  It's a pricey meal, so you expect good service to go along with the great food.

Had a wonderful lunch here in the courtyard complete with a fountain.  Excellent brunch menu and drinks.  We enjoyed a flatbread with prosciutto and mimosas. Staff was busy but pleasant and service was attentive.  Gorgeous space filled with beauty, in all things.. ambiance, decor and people, staff and guests!

Awful awful service sat at the bar the bartender said he will be right with me fifteen minutes later now asking if I wanted a drink waited another five minutes and then took my order. Too make things worse I ordered the boil expecting that it came with the sausage potatoes and corn well I was wrong all I received was just the crawfish.Anyways I finished my meal of just the crawfish and waited another ten minutes until he stopped expoing all the other servers food he then came back to give me the check. Worse service I've ever had there was also no attempt to tell me the specials as well. Will not be returning!

The station itself is very nice. Although it's named after Joe Biden, there is only one placard that even says his name. I wish Amtrak or Wilmington would put up a mini Joe Biden museum or at least sell copies of Joe Biden posters?????????????? I would probably volunteer my time to put it up myself if I could get a mini grant to acquire Joe Biden artifacts.
These guys are awesome! We are so lucky to have them in the neighborhood. I wish every business was run like this one!

The WORST leasing company EVER. For starters, when I moved in the wood under the sink had water damage and was rotting, the drywall in the bathroom had a hole from water damage, and the windows in the bedroom were covered in mold. Everyone at this company does not know how to communicate whatsoever. Emailed the property manager Tom Donnelley about issues at the complex and a week had passed and I did not get a response. I called the main office asking to get transferred to the main manager since I had not heard back from Tom. The guy on the phone did not want to forward my call to the main manager and instead insisted I called the property manager again and he would remind him to respond to my email. I called and left a voicemail for the property manager and still no response. I wish I could give them zero stars, there is really no excuse for blatantly ignoring tenants. Any rating for this company above one star must be fake, because there is no way we're talking about the same place. Avoid Wolfe & Associates at all costs.

Good food. Expensive, but typical for airport. Service poor. Food is ordered by an iPad, so the servers really don't have to communicate with you. Servers spend most of their time washing glasses and gabbing to each other about their personal crap. I wasn't greeted. I had to ask them to follow up on my slow food. Had to ask for a napkin. Had to ask for cutlery. Why am I paying a gratuity?

You can't go wrong with the food here.  My last visit, I was craving one of their muffalettas and the bread delivery specifically for the muffaletta had not come in so no go for me.  I enjoyed the fried green tomatoes and gumbo instead. 
They have a full bar and you will be entertained while you sit at the bar with lively conversations.  This is also a great place to sit down to dinner for a relaxing chill casual meal.

While going to a fertility Dr is never easy Dr Whitten and staff were amazing.  I was a patient for several years and while I never ended up with a baby I feel Dr Whitten did everything he could to help me.  I never felt like just another patient.  Staff learn and know who you are the minute you walk in the door without having to look at your chart. Everyone is also very understanding with all that you are going through during an extremely emotional time.  When bad news is delivered it's Dr Whitten who calls you, not a staff member even if it's on a weekend or holiday.  I loved this office so much I wish they could be my regular Dr's office.

The food is absolutely delicious. BEST QUESO EVER. The portions are excellent, even the lunch. We tend to have the same server (Miguel) and he is terrific. Very attentive and great with kids. The speed of service is perfect, we have never had a problem. Oh, the fried ice cream is really good too!

Service and food were great!  I had breakfast here during the week, so there wasn't a wait, but still very busy! The server had many tables, and was still offering exceptional service. I will definitely be back for the bacon, eggs, and hash browns!

One word: delightful! We had such a nice time! We came for my wife's birthday and had decided to go for the chef's menu with the wine pairing, no doubt! We arrived and were sat quickly, the service was great and the six course six wine experience started right away! Let me tell you, what an experience! My favorite were the first three dishes, the lamb, a wrap, and a succulent sea bass! This was my first real wine pairing experience and I enjoyed it very much! Those two hours savoring delicious dishes went by quickly! At the end, for the last course, they were so nice to place a candle on my wife's plate and gifted us a card with well wishes from all the staff, that was so unexpected and really nice! We loved our experience! This was a $400+ experience, but it was fantastic!

I'll start off by saying this is one of the best BYOB's in the city. I came here for a birthday dinner with my husband on a Thursday. We opted for the chefs tasting menu which is entirely selected by the chef. It was a birthday, so we had no problem splurging on the $65 price per person. The waiter who took our order was extremely knowledgable about the menu. He even came back after we placed our order to ask if we had preferences for the tasting menu. Overall, we were so pleasantly surprised by the amount of food for 2 people. Everything we ate was delicious. Some favorites were the pork belly appetizer, brussel sprouts Cesar salad, mushroom ravioli, bucatini, the duck entree and frutti di mare, plus we received two deserts which were incredible. We seriously can't wait to go back and keep recommending A Mano to everyone we know who hasn't tried it yet.

I've been here a handful of times now and have yet to have a less than fantastic time. The ambiance is upscale, upbeat, and inviting. The staff are courteous and generally happy to help you navigate the menu to find something you'll enjoy. That's a big plus for me since I'm not exactly a sushi connoisseur.  That said, this place is becoming my go-to restaurant for a great time.

And for those who don't enjoy sushi, there are plenty of other options to keep you happy. I keep asking my friends to go just so we can order the strawberry cheesecake roll on the dessert menu. I think I'd go back sometime just for that!

Family dinner heaven!   My kids LOVE the Palms because it is the only place they get to cook their own dinner, make their own garlic toast and serve up a salad with the fixings of their choice.

Ok, the interior is a little tired.   Ok the salad bar is far from gourmet.  BUT, the staff are as nice as the customers and you always meet super nice people at the grill.

While all the cook your own main courses are good... the lamb chops are definitely the best!

First time visiting this place and let me tell you it was worth the hour and ten minute drive... When we arrived the staff was friendly and they had curry crab and dumplings on the menu.. I ordered that and two chicken doubles... The curry crab is only on Thursdays so glad I came on this day!!! The food was so delicious and I'm so happy I found this place on Yelp.. it was worth the money.. You must try this place..

Went to see what the fuss was about.  Don't need to go back.  Average at best.  I expect it to fizzle out soon enough - feels like chain restaurant with cool
Decor and not what I was expecting.   Oh well.

Bed was AWEFUL.  They said the mattresses were only 1 year old, but mine had depressions in it.  Not just one depression, many all over the mattress, like rolling hills.  Needless to say, you probably won't get any sleep.  That's a ridiculous and cheap cost-cutting tactic for such an over-priced mediocre establishment.   They did offer to move me to another room, but if I'm packing up to move rooms, I might as well leave and spend my money where it will be appreciated.

Cute place, fast service loved the atmosphere,  my hubby had the typical eggs and toast..said they were great. Me on the other hand had the cinnamon crape.. Someone needs to teach the cook how to properly cook a crape...it was raw..they were very gracious about exchanging it for a toasted bagel, not a peep about a refund . That's what happens when they expect payment upfront  I noticed other comments about the crepes being under cooked . Perhaps  you need to take it off the menu , if you can't find someone to cook them properly..i don't think I'll be back..

What a chaotic mess. 
The kitchen apparently went home during mid service based on how our meal was "cooked". Half of it was raw, half of it was cooked but cold. All of it was unmemorable and I would be embarrassed if this was my restaurant. 

Ordered a bottle of wine, took over 45 minutes to get it. Why? The wine guy disappeared. No one could find him. 

We asked our server to get the manager, we were told they hadn't seen him all night. They basically comped half our meal and the wait staff was horribly embarrassed  - but couldn't seem to get anyone above their pay grade to care. 

If I managed this place, the "Chef" would be gone immediately. I heard him from the kitchen say something like, "I don't give a @#$# -- we're outta here". 

We were there on probably their last night open. Our server was telling us that this version is closing and a new "Chophouse" is opening next week. so, this may explain SOME of this mess. But, if that "Chef" is still around --- count me out.

Went for a bday dinner on a Saturday night and made reservations for downstairs jazz lounge. 
Pros:  Food was very good. Music was very good. 
Cons:  service was  bad. From host and delay in getting seated to wait staff. Very Slow. Staff was pretentious and superficial without high level of service to back it up. 
Food and music good. If you go for that and don't mind unfriendly slow staff it's good place to go.

JUST NO.

Haven't been here in YEARS. Decided to give it a try.

First off, FYI- you can call and make a reservation, but not on the actual day you need them. You have to do it ahead of time by at least a day.

They are dog friendly on the patio, which I appreciate.

They are open at full capacity inside now, but still have outdoor dining.

Being a group of 6, with no reservation, we were sat pretty quickly outside. 

Problem started with the bathrooms. The sewer smell was so incredibly horrible, we could barely breathe, and we had masks on! It wasn't the cleanest either. I was informed by a server that they are having issues with the city about it, but it put a bad "taste" in my mouth, quite literally, upon arrival. 

Walking back to my table, I started to see what a dump the place had become. It's filthy, I got grossed out  walking back to our table. The bread and salsa station is filthy and is actually falling backwards as both the legs up front are off the ground. Food and trash all over the ground, everywhere, and it was only 6pm on a Saturday. 

The front entrance of the restaurant is where the kitchen is, but there is a table at the front for their to-go orders right when you walk in the front door, and it was just complete chaos and looked horrible, dirty, and unorganized. 

Now the food. It was gross. If you came for the stiff drink, go for it, but pass on the food. Trust me.

Steak was over cooked, I even asked the waitress how their chef was on his temps so I could plan accordingly. I was assured that if anything they are a lower temp than normal, and I could always cook it up more if need be. The baked potatoes are old, precooked and then reheated so much so that the entire first half of the potato is hard, dark, and inedible. 

My friend ordered the burnt ends sandwich and was stoked because she had never heard of that before and loves the burnt ends. But they don't serve a burnt ends sandwich. We were informed by the manager that they don't have enough to do that for every sandwich and they just chop up meat from the prime rib and tri-tip to mix in with whatever burnt ends they have. Here's a thought, how about you just only serve the burnt ends, and when you are out, you are out. Elevate your menu like you care about what goes out to your patrons. OR explain that when someone orders so they are not disappointed. When she discussed this with the manager, there wasn't an apology, he just took the plate and they went and fried up the pieces in a pan and brought it back on the same bread it was served on. It was disgusting.

Not once did anyone ask how our food was for me to correct it quickly, and we had to be somewhere, so I just doused the steak in salt and ate it. $25 for a steak, I can do better at home. 

When we told the waitress about our experience and the frustration with the food, she apologized but nothing else. You'd think they would have comp'd something. Anything. Or had the manager come back over himself.

Sliders and fries were good. 

Clam chowder has always been good. 

But nothing else was. 

It's a shame, the history and nostalgia of this place is what made me want to bring our friends and family to experience. Hell, I even was one of the very first staff to open Harry's, under the new management of John Scott. 

We won't be returning, not unless it's for a stiff drink at the bar.

Just moved to Tampa and we found ourselves craving Greek food. We took a chance on Little Greek in Vaerico and we're happy we did :-) we tried the appetizer sampler, chicken souvklaki, it's yummy with he rice and salad! Since we were starving, we also took a recommendation and also ordered fries topped with feta  and added tzatziki sauce for dipping ...delicious too :-)  We finished our meal off with a new twist on a classic favorite, baklava cheesecake!, it was heavenly!! All of this great food along with wonderful service means we're definitely going back until we eat our way through the menu !!!
Wrap and salad were both so fresh and complete.  I will be back often for both. The smoothly was also good but the food was outstanding.

I loved their happy hour (pre covid) so I wanted to try their dinner selection.  The atmosphere is very relaxing and somewhat romantic. We started with  2 apps. Korean BBQ short rib skewers and mushrooms stuffed with spinach,crab and shrimp. The skewers were good but the shrimp was missing something.  Next was the beet salad. I discovered I dont like beets but every other part of the salad was awesome.  They even split it for us. Now the entrees are the stars of this place. I had the porkchop and hubs had the shrimp and grits. My porkchop was moist and seasoned well but the star of that dish was the sautéed cabbage with gold raisins. Yes you read that right the cabbage was amazing. The shrimp and grits were flavorful with a Cajun flavor. We opted for extra sides. The Brussel sprouts were good but the risotto I would pass on. I enjoyed my PB cup dessert and hubs liked his pecan pie dessert. All and all I would go back

Fresh and Delicious subs for a quick and filling meal. 
The chicken, mushrooms and onions are greased and grilled right in front of you and topped off with melted cheese. They offer 6"/8"/12" subs which are all great options for great prices. They have an expansive menu offering chicken teriyaki, chicken Parm and a few other pork and beef based subs. The chicken Parm sub was delicious, reminiscent of great cheesesteak hoagies in Philadelphia. Every order comes with an order of fries, fried to perfection. This is junk food, no two thoughts about it, but when the taste and price are right, everything else seems alright

awful awful awful. line out the door. alllll kinds of glitches in the system for every customer. one customer was being charged 300.00 for a fridge dolly.
nobody knew what they were doing except latrice. 
horrible horrible customer service 
i will never use this uhaul again.
never.

Chocolates are tasty, especially the caramel, yet are extremely overpriced. I actually feel bad that my boyfriend spent so much money on them when there's other tasty, less expensive options available. This issue is a major barrier to keep others from purchasing them, or from me purchasing them on a more constant basis.

Before I moved to the area I hated morning radio because it was all obnoxious talking. Preston and Steve changed that. I love their show, the bizarre files, tatTuesday, the interviews with celebrities. The thing that really sets them apart is their great sense of humor. Other morning shows in the area rely on bathroom humor and sexual jokes. Sometimes that's ok, but John DeBella on 102.9 almost exclusively relies on sexual based jokes. There comes a time that those jokes get old. Preston and Steve do a wonderful job at keeping it fresh and it's really fun to listen to on my way to work.

I recently won a gift certificate for Zachary's BBQ and I went to pick it up. The front desk person was extremely friendly and personable. I'm excited because I love BBQ and I work close to the restaurant and have heard good things about them, but have never been! This is my second ever time winning something on the radio, the other was sometime before 2011 and it was for Wendy's. I ended up getting the bacon 5 patty burger and it made me sick :-(

If your in a rush and want variety, this place will rally your taste buds. It's clean, usually pretty fresh as long as you choose peak dinning hours. There is even a meager sushi bar to choose from and it's all included in the reasonable buffet price. It's not a date night destination, but good for a fill-er up before grocery shopping. The sautéed green beans are awesome and the sesame chicken is quite tasty.

Walked in, went directly to the register to ask about exchanging a gift that was given to my 9-year-old, who was with me.  Have no reciept.  As stated, it was a GIFT.  Cashier said no problem, let me hold it for you while you look.  Go back 15 minutes later, of course different cashier, would not exchange.  MUST have reciept - why didn't the 1st cashier tell me this?

MAJOR pieve of mine - employee's should all know WHAT a policy is.  It is YOUR job - not MINE.  Will not return to shop.

Long live the library!

My mom asked me to cancel an appointment (45 day notice) and reschedule.  Well, after being on hold for 15 minutes the CSR finally answered, I cancelled the appointment and before I could request to reschedule, the CSR hung up.  She didn't ask why or if we needed to reschedule.  She didn't even thank me or wish me a good day.  My gosh, she didn't even say bye, she just hung up.  I decided to take my parents business elsewhere.  Besides, who wants to wait months to be seen?  Not my mom, which is why we cancelled the appointment, we found a dermatologist that was able to get my mom in within a few days.

I don't love this place. Everything has too much sugar in it. Got it a few times thinking it was a fluke but every time the general tso chicken was like candy. I think I got the eggplant a few times as well with the same result. Please please adjust your recipes, people like slightly more authentic Chinese food these days. Don't be afraid to use chili oil and peppercorns.

I purchased a washer and dryer online from them. They charged my card immediately. I then received an email stating the dryer was backordered.
I decided that I would just wait. Then they called and said they would not honor the price I paid and wanted more money. I declined and purchased elsewhere for less. 
They Still have not refunded my money.
Stay away from Godeckers!

DON'T EAT HERE. Spare yourself. It is ran by Arabs who can't make decent Italian foods. I ordered delivery to my hotel and the food came cold and soggy. I picked up my sandwich and the bread fell apart and everything was cold. The lettuce was soggy like it was cooked. They would not issue a refund or replace my food even after I offered to give all the food back uneaten. Even if they just brought me back something I could actually eat I would be happy. They told me it is not their problem that I don't like soggy bread or the flavor of cold cheese steak meat with soggy lettuce. They told me that is their food and not their problem if I don't like it. The manager would not get on the phone.  They also charge a $4 delivery fee. I lost $14 just for a cheese steak and fries and didn't get to have dinner after a long day of travel and jet lag and this place could care less. Extremely rude service and horrible food.
Probably the best pizza I've had in the Philly Metro area.  Non-greasy, fresh, high quality tasting ingredients.

Stumbled upon Bbi when shopping nearby, and now I wish I lived close enough to be a regular!  Huge selection of sandwiches, soups, etc.  I had the chicken curry soup and half a steak sandwich lunch combo.  That soup was amazing, rich and flavorful, big pieces of tender roast chicken, and not too strong on the curry.  I'm wishing I'd ordered some to take home.  The sandwich was on toasted buttery sourdough bread, with a couple nice pieces of roast beef, sauteed onions and some other things ... very good.  My husband enjoyed his reuben.  The owner was very friendly, said they could make anything to order to suit our tastes.  He even surprised us with free cookies at the end of the lunch!  Will definitely go again when in the neighborhood.
At first bite you can taste freshness in the ingredients. Their upside down style pizza is absolutely delicious. 5 stars all the way!

Okay, this is a cheese lovers oasis! I loved it! I had the Mac n cheesy.... To die for. My husband had the shrimp one and it was good. We shared a gumbo dipper. We quenched our thirst with rose' and beer.  Gotta try this place... You will not regret it.

The only con... I was turned off by the green slime I noticed as I was getting ice for my water. The ice machine needs to be cleaned.

Needs more parking. 
Convenient seating
Good atmosphere

We went to lunch.  No wait.  All the other restaurants in the area had a 20-25 minute wait.
Our waiter was pleasant.  The menu was so-so.  Prices were high for what you got.  
Location is great but they need to step up the menu.
The waiter never refilled our water.
We won't hurry back.

We've been to ERs in Las Vegas and the Bay and these do not take a back seat. We had lots of fun as a group finding and solving the different puzzles in both Pirate Ghost Ship and Psycho Dentist, and will definitely be back to try any new rooms. The staff was very welcoming and friendly.

First of all, let me say that I typically love Sheraton and Marriot properties. I travel for work a good bit and almost always stay at a Marriot property.  So when it came time to book a trip for a vacation, of course I looked at Marriot and found Sheraton Tampa Riverwalk Hotel.
First the pro's. The location is really great. Right on the river walk and very easy to walk to several great restaurants, bars, and parks.  Also, the valet service was very nice and efficient. We never waited more than 3-4 minutes picking up or dropping our rental car off. Although be sure to understand that there is no self parking option at this hotel, it's $32.25 ($30.00 valet fee & $2.25 tax) fee every night.
Now for the flip side.  There were so many issues with this hotel, that I was actually tempted to leave and try and find another hotel.  When we checked into the hotel we were given a room with a city view. Getting to the room, there were cracks in the ceiling, paint streaks on the wall, as well as chips of paint missing from the walls. The balcony looked like it hadn't been cleaned in years, and there were black streaks all over the walls. The mattress itself was lumpy and very uncomfortable, and they pillows were so flat that they were almost non-existent. The whole room looked like it could use a good upgrade. On the second day of no cleaning service, and my room key being deactivated, I went to the front desk. They reactivated my card (technical glitch they said), and then proceeded to tell me that due to Covid, they weren't doing daily room cleaning, but because we were staying for 5 days, they would request service for the next day, but would have fresh towels and toiletries brought to the room. I would have been ok with that, had they told me during check in what their Covid policy was.  4 hours later with still no toiletries or towels, I went to the front desk again to ask, and was told " I've already ask housekeeping, but I guess I can ask them again"  Almost like we were bothering them.  Finally did get fresh towels and toiletries that evening, but no replacement waters or coffee.  The next morning while at breakfast, which was buffet style only consisting of lukewarm breakfast items, my husband poured some milk out of a carton for cereal and clumps of milk came out.  When he told the waitstaff, they just kept going on and on about how the date of the milk was fine, even though they could see the lumpy milk. $40.00 for lukewarm breakfast buffet and clumpy milk was not a good experience.  Also, they have billed 2 pending charges on our credit card for no reason.  I'm still waiting on those pending charges to fall off. The next to the last day, my room card was again deactivated, and after going back to the front desk, they realized that my card was set to expire every day.  We actually decided to leave a day early from the vacation, and one of the reasons was that we didn't want to stay in hotel another night.
Will not stay here again.

I love this place! If you're into birds and wildlife then you'll love this place too. They have everything you could ask for when it comes to feeding and watching birds. Besides food, they have feeders, books, bird houses, bird baths, audio and video supplies, binoculars, even salt licks for the deer and snacks for the squirrels..but most important are the employees. They are most kind and knowledgable and really know their stuff. When you walk in, the sound of birds chirping (on CD) and water splashing in the bird baths is such a relaxing and stress relieving environment that you won't want to leave.

Recommended to me by a coworker. I was elated to try everything on the menu before I even got there. The food was mediocre - nothing to rave about. Don't get the crab cake appetizer, it only comes with a small sized patty for $8. The raw oysters were good, as was the calamari and the spanakopita. 

I would return, hopefully not on a Monday night because apparently those nights attract the entire city.

I came in after hitting my bumper pretty hard, and they fixed my tire issue in an hour and checked to see if I needed a body shop. They were fast, incredibly friendly, and because the fix was so minor (just a flap hitting the tire), they didn't charge me a dime. I'll definitely be back.

Wow! What a great menu and selection of juices. We needed the detox after a boozy brunch the day before, and this was the perfect place to do it. Clean food, healthy options, superb biscuits and perfect coffee. Fan favorites were the benny, pancake (simple but lovely), green eggs & ham, veg omelette and any juice in their fridge.

Lovely staff who offered to seat our group of 10 on two nearby tables. Lovely patrons who volunteered to move so our tables could be next to each other. What a great place to start the day and advocate the NOLA hospitality.

Just say NEAUX to GEAUX MAIDS!   
I requested an online quote based on their website that claims to service the Northshore (Hammond/Mandeville) and received a quote.  I booked on 8/13/20 for service on 8/20/20.   
Problem is I received an email less than 48 hours prior that my cleaning was being cancelled "because they don't service my area".   It's between Hammond and Mandeville AND on the Northshore, so I'm not sure why it took the staff so long to figure out they do not service between those two areas.   
But now I have guests coming and no one to clean my home and was not notified until 36 hours prior to appointment.  

I spoke to someone there this morning and she said "let me call some of the "girls" in Hammond and see if they want to go the 9 miles to reach my house...I told her forget it - she should have done that BEFORE cancelling my appointment.  
I am very highly disappointed in  the customer service.
They obviously need help if they are giving quotes for areas they don't even service!!!!!!!!!!!!
I did receive a call from the Director of Operations to try to "right" this wrong and I declined his offer of a half price cleaning after reading these reviews and the BS of scheduling issue.

P.S.  Looking forward to Brunson Sayes attacking me like he did most of the other reviewers.   Bring it on Mr. Sayes...it's NEVER your company's fault, you always rudely point the finger at your former customer.   Bad Bad way to do business.   Guess your college professor never told you the customer is always right.   First rule of business!
Best sushi ever!  Wonderful atmosphere! Beautifully  decorated restaurant and the food was very high quality and delicious. The employees were friendly and attentive. I will definitely be back.

Came through in our pick up and they turned us away because they said we had "too much" mud. What kind of a car wash turns away dirt? Then they apologized and gave us a coupon for two dollars off... But guess what it expired in 2019 and it's definitely 2020. Lol the whole experience was a joke and I will never visit the misters car wash again.

My friends and I were so excited to come here for their highly recommended Sunday jazz brunch and left extremely disappointed. 

First and foremost, you would assume at a jazz brunch you would hear a jazz band. Not the case. During our 2-hour visit, the jazz ensemble visited our dining area once for less than 10 minutes. And when they were elsewhere in the multi-room restaurant, there was no music to be enjoyed. 

Secondly, the service was embarrassingly bad and the food was sub par, especially with the $$$ prices. See dining experience details below...

Once seated, a server assistant timidly greeted us and quietly told us he was helping out our server. My friends didn't even hear him say that, though. After at least 10 minutes, our server finally came over. He didn't introduce us to the restaurant (we were first time diners), didn't inform us that a mimosa came complimentary with an entree (which we had to request once our entree hit the table), and was very unwelcoming in general. Also, I asked him to refill my water glass and after 5 minutes of waiting, I had to wave down another staff member to do so (actually, had to ask for water multiple times throughout the meal).

Next up, the meal. My friend ordered an appetizer that never made it to our table. And then in the first bite of her crab omelette entree, there was an egg shell. I ordered the soft shell crab flourentine--completely inedible. The crab was fried so heavily that it tasted like salty grease and the creamed spinach only tasted of cream. When I realized I couldn't stomach the meal, I had to nearly stand up and wave down our server assistant--not exaggerating! They took care of the meal and quickly replaced it with another entree. It wasn't much better, though. My friends and I decided our pricy food could politely be described as very underwhelming... 

Good news? The cheesecake dessert was delicious. And they took care of a portion of our meal, which was greatly appreciated. 

Overall, the food was mediocre and the service was unacceptable. There's plenty of options nearby, keep walking.

The bulgogi is average better than other Korean places in the STL region - needs more flavor, less grease and better charring on the beef.  There wasn't the usual miso paste and lettuce leafs but with about  20 side dishes, which is cool and you get a great selection, we did not ask.  The service is awkward with no flow, I understand the cultural differences, but it makes for a distracting experience.  This may be a good example of a restaurant to incorporate complete ordering by ipad.  The other issue was the lack of cleanliness - tables, floor, walls, glasses it all needs a deep scrub, new paint, new chairs and repair the booths - these issues alone keeps me from bringing / recommending to others.
Very nice gelato/bakery shop. They have great selections of gelato as well as macaroons. Great vibe atmosphere.

Food was completely inedible, "fresh tandoor naan" was reheated frozen bread that is available at any Indian grocery store in a package of 5 for $2. Restaurant is charging $2.50 PER FROZEN PIECE. When we called the owner he admitted he doesn't have a tandoor oven yet. Malai kofta had gone sour and tasted spoiled. Owner admitted they "fresh make it every week" and freeze it. EVERYTHING is frozen in and just reheated. Rice we got was from the bottom on the pot and crispy/ burnt. We even took the whole order back to show the owner and he was rude and unwilling to listen. Thankfully DoorDash was able to help otherwise we had wasted $65 on reheated food that we had to throw away. Stay away from this place, many better options in the are.

Ha!!! Need I remind you Nimesh that you txtd offering to make us a multi course dinner and chapati but we never took you up on it because we didn't want to deal w you or the terrible food. Short memory you have.

I took my wife here for our 25th wedding anniversary.
The veiw was spectacular.
The service was also spectacular.
We both ordered the center cut fillets & I opted for the 1/2 lobster also.
Supposed to be all ready shelled but I found a large piece if she'll in my lobster.
Had no interest in eating any more of that.
The waitress was shocked & apologized multiple times & also bought us desert.
The manager acted like it was no big deal that I wasn't interested in eating any more of my food after finding a shell I could have easily choked on.
Disappointed with the chef & the manager for not even trying to make it up to me!
Won't ever go back now!

My husband and I order Hotbox once every couple months and while this is not the usual location that we order from, we've ordered carry-out a couple times here. Pizza is always ready within 15-20 minutes and comes out hot. We love their Hot Chick pizza and breadsticks. I also love their ranch dressing for dipping. Employees are friendly and the store is clean.

After my visit here the other day I am a fan. I have been in in past years and found that the food was amazing with a huge menu of stuff to choose from, but the service had been abysmal. 

I'm not sure what has changed but the service seemed great. I had a traditional cheesecake with salted caramel topping and it was very tasty.

They have great brunch menu for the weekend and can accommodate even the trickiest of dietary concerns.

It was cool to learn that they are an independently owned Canadian company that has been in the same family ownership since it began. I love to support businesses like this so give them a try.
As usual, everything was amazing, including our drinks. And Kyle is the perfect server. We will be back again soon!

I used Creature Comforts while I was away for a week during Thanksgiving.  I must start with I am a very attentive (some would say obsessed) doggy mommy.

Andrea and her team did a wonderful job with my crew.  They met with me before my trip.  I was impressed with their professional behavior and natural instant bonding with my dogs.  One of my dogs is a special needs dog, deaf with limited vision -- I was VERY impressed with how the pet sitter made such a special effort for my little one. 

I received up-dates during my visit and a detailed note on my return.  A few days after my return, Andrea even called with a very friendly follow-up call.   

I would greatly recommend Creature Comforts for pet-sitting.
No better place. We came in loaded, ready to party, and they delivered. Too bad Jason missed out. Oh well. He will regret it for the rest of his life.

Long weekend May 31st 2010. I will remember this was the worst food I ever ate in my life. We were enjoying everything we were doing but this dinner where we were 14 adults and 2 kids was all screwed up by me who pushed my friends to skip italian and to do some Indian bread.
HORRIBLE in all ways... I now know you get what you pay for, $6.95 buffet means they are giving garbage with no taste.

BIG NOOOOO..!!

Best Place in town to eat Love Love this place great music ... Looking you say this is just one place that you can sit back relax have a great cocktails and food does get a little bit busy on the weekends and dinner but they do have valet

I took my dogs in for their checkup and vaccination and everything seemed very reasonable. So, I took my cat in because she seemed very lethargic. I walked out with an $85 vet bill.   I sat in the "room" for well over half an hour. They discovered that my cat was bleeding on her tail and ended up giving her antibiotics. That's ok, but  I was charged $25 for an assistant to shave about a one inch area off of her tail and rear end. It took a whole 3-5 minutes. 
Now I am heading back to my old vet.  Very frustrating.

This place was so much fun and the food was great! The chefs, kevin and charlie were awesome and funny. For a glutton like myself, you are not going to find a better value. If you are looking for a sushi joint just south of tampa, don't look any further that this place. Also, the unfiltered sake was great!

Miss managed hotel. First night:  Booked a 2 queen suite got a king, no rollaway so my son had to sleep on the floor.  2nd night: got the 2 queens but at 9:30 the music started. LOUD MUSIC!  When I called the front desk they said they were aware it's due to a party in the ballroom.  The walls are vibrating the music is so loud. Disappointing.

A true hidden gem in the city.  The food is always outstanding (grab any of their rice plates) and always at a reasonable price. There is a great selection for everyone with a different taste (pho, rice plates, Bahn mi,etc) so you really can't of wrong!

Get happy my vegan and vegetarian friends- this is the place for you! We over- order here because everything on the menu sounds delicious. Empanadas, street tacos, amazing hummus. Super cute decor, sit in or out. Staff is warm and knowledgeable. Parking can be tricky, so be patient or creative.
Rude counter help. Plenty of other places in the area to grab a quick meal on the run and not be served "attitude" on the side. Won't be back.

Decent value. Limited options. Decent flavour. Okay service.

Party of four arrived to check out the dinner buffet ~$13 per person. 

Rather limited buffet selection, and the options there were mostly decent.

Overall, this place is a pretty fair value for a dinner buffet if your focus is on quantity.

Very good cheesesteak and the pretzel was huge

Service excellent 

All 3 of us had very good lunches

If you're looking for a grandfather clock and you want a concentrated inventory of them, without having to weed through the possible selections at big box furniture stores, Nashville Clock is the place. They have recently moved just a little down the street to a much nicer looking building. 

They have all the major brands of grandfather clocks, including Howard Miller, and they have some more contemporary designs as well as the more traditional ornate clocks (of which they have plenty). I did see a couple of mission and modern inspired ones there though. Their prices are reasonable, especially as I did some trawling through E-Bay to see if I could beat them.

I believe they also do some clock repair, although I don't know the details of that, but they would be a valuable resource in town, as I don't know anywhere else in Davidson County who specializes in clocks.
Unsurpassed for atmosphere, selection and price.  There simply isn't another indoor market in the country that compares.

I needed an oil change and rotation. Lucky for me Eric saw that I needed an alignment too. I was able to get all things done and it was cheaper than most other places. Good looking out Eric now I know my car is in good shape!

I was a skeptic on chiropractic care, but I decided to give it a try.  I have been going to this place for a month and I am pleased with the service.  Dr. Halle is a nice man and knows his craft.  The pressure I felt in my lower back has been aided by his care.  The place is clean, and I have witnessed that after each session his assistants wipe down the tables and chairs.  He has four patient rooms so it's a short wait to be seen. His patient sign in log is digital and has ease of use.  He also has the capability of X-ray or imaging I believe, but call to find out.  I can't comment on price as my insurance covers all my care, but I heard patients in waiting area stating he is so fair in pricing and has gone out of his way to help when insurances fall short.

Everything about my visit exceeded my expectations. Fantastic massage for my pedicure and manicure, amazing customer service, and my nails and toenails look perfect! All COVID protocols were followed just as they should be as well.

We were greater by a very harried and snippy hostess. We inquired about an outside table. No smile or hello , just a whippy cranky remark that she would have to get a table cleaned. When I inquired the whereabouts of e ladies room, she just said " down the hall". We then decided to sit at the empty bar. We asked If the MASTERS --- in the final round could be put on. He acted put out and said he would ask the manager when he had time. Note to manager.   Every persons interactions count. Rude service even before I eat?! Have heard the food is good, but we left with a bad taste even before the meal.

Just had my first visit to get my dog groomed.  Friendly staff, helpful and very knowledgeable.  We walked in and right away they knew my dog had a thyroid problem and made a bunch of suggestions for food and supplements we could use.  Not a sales pitch, just information.  

The groomer was great.  She did exactly what I asked and even gave her some Halloween bows.  I will definitely be going back for grooming and other pet needs.  

You need to check them out.
Our favorite hideout in New Orleans. Terrific drinks and chill loungey vibes. A good reason to get that old smoking jacket out. Noah took great care of us.

Awesome store in reno! Great open lay out with plenty of room to eat. Had a side of grilled veggies and chorizo black bean soup for lunch... Very tasty and reasonably priced. They also have very high end items for the culinarian- my fav truffle oil and live crab!!! Best part of lunch was a green's gluten free beer- one of the best that I can only find ever so often in SF or Denver.  Shon behind the deli counter was also very nice and helpfully. Highly recommended.
Fresh, great tasting Vietnamese food. The Chao Tom (Shrimp on sugar cane) was particularly good.

I thought the menu was very diverse for a Sports Bar.  I had the grilled chicken and it was awesome! Others at the table tried different appetizers, sandwiches and entrees and we all walked away pleased. Service was very attentive and we didn't fell rushed to eat and leave quickly. This place was recommended by a friend and it didn't disappoint.
Excellent food, awesome service! Special refills that circulate throughout restaurant. Our favorite breakfast/brunch.

Terrible experience. Sold me used, broken equipment. Tried to demand that I pay a 20% restocking fee for the 1 hour I had the component before bringing it back the same day.

My personal opinions: The store is disorganized. The staff is unprofessional and they don't value service.

I went in to Tito's during the soft opening and was so pleased. The restaurant is so nice and unique (think Mexican that's a little more upscale) and the service was amazing. Their creamy avocado is to die for and their jalapeño margaritas are spicy but not TOO spicy. Highly recommend both but my steak fajitas were a little bland (they have great hot sauce though and house-made tortillas).

Had Sunday Brunch here - upon entering, we were told that we had to wait at the bar despite having reservations,  because the chef was backed up. There were about 50 empty tables, so that was bizarre. My bloody Mary was great though - don't do bottomless, as the glasses are half the size of the $6 pint and not worth the $15 price tag. The menu was much more scarce than the website, plus they gave my friend and I each a different one, which had to be corrected. Our food was okay (my friend got Shrimp and Grits and I got the Veggie flatbread) - glad we had a groupon. The singer played from about 1130-1, and it was a nice intimate setting for her performance.

I've been to the restaurant twice now, and both have been good experiences. The first time I was there, the server was almost too professional, but the second time the server was very personable and made the experience much more laid back. We happened to go on a very busy night because of a promotion they have right now, but we received our orders in a decent amount of time.  

I've tried two pizzas now that are outside the 'norm' of pizzas for me. They weren't 'to die for' pizzas, but the cool thing about California Pizza Kitchen is that if you don't find the best pizza ever on one visit, then there's several others to try.  

Definitely an awesome place to go if you're bored with pepperoni or the regular pizza toppings.  However, I still can't make myself like lettuce on any pizza. 

Oh, and definitely sit at the bar at least once if you're a fan of watching how things are made. It most certainly added to the whole experience.

My crab cakes were thick and dry. My beans and rice were terrible;( The rice was hard as if it was not completely cooked well. The beer and sitting area was relaxing. Staff was amazing! Even thou the food I selected that day was not great. I would try it again in the future.

New place on an outlot at Plaza Frontenac.  Was going to go to Sugo, or Via Vino, but both looked crowded.  Had a movie timeline, so time was a concern.  Bricktop is an upscale chain, with fairly high prices in general.  Entrees are 20-30 dollars. Since I had not read reviews other than my yelp app reviews, I was going stealth on this one.  Place was very crowded, with a short wait.  Ended up with a burger (good, but certainly not the best in St. Louis), and the swapped out the fries and for an additional buck gave me a decent wedge salad.  Food came out quickly and service was good.  Not sure I would hurry back, but it was good overall.  Pricey area and this place fits in.

Have been meaning to write this review for a while now.....

As others have mentioned, the service used to put a strain on your patience, but things have really improved!!

First went in here a few times last fall.  Food was great, service not so much.  Didn't get back until this spring.  Service has been very good - not stellar - but very good. 

The food?  AMAZING!!  Bacon of course is always great here.  Biggest problem is deciding which flavor you want from the long list on the board.  Mesquite is my favorite.  Black Forest is also very good and have had some short term special ones that were also excellent.

If you happen to catch the bacon meatballs (sometimes on special) definitely try them. Probably the best meatballs I have ever had.  Certainly the best that were not in tomato sauce.

We've sampled a good bit of the menu, but my favorite remains the Flying Saucer.  I always think about adding an extra egg (it only comes with one), but haven't and am still stuffed after finishing this masterpiece of breakfast foods.  The hash brown cake it comes on is coated with caramelized cheddar.  Oh, so good!!

Plenty of other good stuff too!

With the service, they can get a bit flustered when it is very busy (as is the case with every place I've been in the area), but if you avoid the 10 - 11:30 weekend breakfast rushes it has been very good.  Not like the old diners you can go with waitresses that have been at it for 30 years, but my coffee cup is never empty and the food hits the table too hot to eat immediately.  That works for me!  Also, all of the servers seem to be very knowledgeable about the menu and the bacon.

Don't be fooled by the picture on the size of the flying saucer.  It is pretty big!  Those are full length pieces of bacon on there.

People are so hateful full of stupid complaint 
Just eat the dam... thing and shut the hell up. 
It's hard to please all customers.

I had high hopes for this place. It was hard to get an appt and the service was less than stellar. Coming into nail salons for the first time, I seem to always wind up with the least requested tech (and for.good reason) for service. The tech kept looking over at person next to me not paying attention to what she was doing like she would rather be doing anything else but a pedicure. Imma need your undivided attention on me while your doing my feet. Hey! What's over there? Focus on what your doing over here.

1st visit here after driving by for years...not much to say in this review but I will say that the vegan banana bread was excellent. 

5 stars for that item specifically... The service was also very good. Service with a smile in fact. How sweet. 

The dark roast coffee was a bit of a let down though. I was expecting it to be a bit better than your standard dark roast wawa coffee or dark roast K-cup - It wasn't. 

Good enough but not great. 
I'll stop back in to give them another try. 

Try the banana bread.

After almost a year of going back and forth to another vet with no cure, my friend suggested to get a 2nd opinion with her vet, AB Animal Hospital. We FINALLY have a plan to treat my little girls skin condition. They are very caring, the office is clean, prices are reasonable and when one course of action did not work, they thought out of the box and tried another. Even though that means I have to give my kitty haircuts and regular baths:) She has been home less than 24 hours and I can tell she is feeling much better already.

Big thanks to Hector and the staff for treating me with dignity and respect.  They treated me as a customer versus a woman customer and did not try to take advantage of me or treat me like I did not have a brain. Having had a very bad experience at another dealership, I am very glad I waited and purchased from Hector.

Jack in the Box this morning was very efficient.  They did quite well with a very large order. There was one item missing but it was just hash rounds and my employee didn't want them anyway. This is was the reasoning for 4 stars. The order taker and person that greeted us at the Window were cheery and positive even on this gloomy morning. We will be back!

I have been dying to try C.C.'s so I finally made the trip for the last day of the special "chicken" dinner. It absolutely did not disappoint. I tried so many things and they were all delicious! I am glad I tried two different types of lemonade, the cherry wasn't my jam but the pink lemonade was fabulous! I also got the pita with hummus which was quite tasty. The "chicken" dinner came with a side "bacon chicken" salad which was very good and would probably have been pretty good on its own! I was so happy to have mashed potatoes with gravy, I can't even remember the last time I had gravy (one of the few things I miss as a vegetarian). The online ordering process was great and I didn't even have to get out of the car. I really wish I had an excuse to go to Alton more often because I can't wait to try more things on the menu!

This is my favorite, favorite place in Tampa. I'd give it more stars if I could! The staff and owner are great people, good service and phenomenal food. They make great little German potato pancakes from scratch with potatoes and onions, fried to a delicate golden brown and served with creamy sour cream and fresh, chunky applesauce that tastes homemade. The Reuben Dog is the stuff of legends, as are their goulash and wurst dinners. It's popular with the USF crowd and locals. It's jam packed a lot of the time because it's such a gem and worth the wait. Prices are low too, especially for the quality of the food and atmosphere. An absolute must if you're in Tampa.
Love this place. Been eating here since I was a kid. I've never had a bad burger or shake from this establishment.

My boyfriend just moved to The Grove, and I was looking up places to take my golden retriever, and Dogtowne caught my eye!
