I love supporting local business, so it wasn't a hard decision to go to Dogtowne! I have taken my boy to a lot of groomers and he has never looked this good! Dropped him off at 9:30an and picked him up at 3pm! Cash or check only.

We went in here on a day off.  The staff was very friendly and attentive.  We had taken some champagne with us to take our time.  Once we told them we were in no rush they gave us whatever we needed and waited for us to let them know when we were ready.  Dani was our waitress and it was her first day.  She could not have possibly been any better.   We would go back there again.  Oh and about the food - It was my first time there and I loved the food.  I had heard great things and I went there with a giftcard. We tried the Huevos Rancheros and the shrimp hash breakfast, both were amazing.
Great service and price. This is the second car I got tinted here and I'll bring a third. I'd recommend to someone looking.
Great food, fair prices.  The only problem is word is spreading and they are running out of seating.
Amazing smoothies with great service! Reopened the entire store after closing to make two last smoothies! It's a must try!

The Key Lime pie makes this place! My husband and I were in today to try a new local restaurant, expecting a little local flare, which was only partially delivered. Personality was a bit of a low, but the food was delicious. Moderately priced. Minimally decorated. I'll be back, mostly for the pie...

We hadn't been to Hellas for several years and decided it was time to repeat. We had  a 6:30 reservation and arrived on time. Restaurant was about one third full. We waited about 10 min at the desk. Ignored by the one person waiting tables. A second server finally arrived and showed us to a table where we waited, hopeful we would be noticed. The server walked past us several times going to the Bar but alas we were ignored. After being ignored for 25 minutes we left. The second server was busy putting out trash and and as I informed him we were leaving he just said "ok". 
I should have read and heeded the previous reviews. I would have given a zero star rating if it was an option

Ordered a plain cheese pizza and ate at the restaurant. The service was good, but the pizza is very mediocre. It tasted vinegary, and the crust was very bland. It's about as good as school cafeteria or Ikea pizza. There is basically zero atmosphere aesthetically. Perhaps their other dishes are more enjoyable, but if you are known for you pizza you should have GOOD pizza, and not market it based solely on it's shape.

My finance and I got engaged over Christmas and we already had a $50 Groupon for Moshulu so we decided to celebrate our engagement with a nice dinner out.  Plus I wanted him to check it out as a potential wedding venue.  I had been a few times for lunch and an event but he had never been.

We had a reservation during the week between Christmas and New Years.  It wasn't very crowded but we still had to wait for 15 minutes for our table plus other people who arrived after us were seated before us.  That didn't bother me to much, as I wanted to walk around a bit so he could see the space.  I suggested we get a glass of wine while were were waiting, since we were celebrating anyway.  The bar service seemed slow and he admitted to me afterward that he was annoyed we had to wait for a reservation. Apparently had I not suggested a cocktail he would not have bought one out of principle since he felt they purposely make us wait so that we would buy drinks.  As far as I can tell that was the only real negative of the evening.

Food:  Expecting it to be expensive, we were happy to have the Groupon. Even with the $50 certificate it was still about $150 pre-tip for  apps, dinner, dessert, another glass of wine each and a glass of port each.  I ordered the Moo Shu Chicken app which was delicious but more of a bbq bun than Moo Shu. He got the foie gras PBJ which he said was probably the best foie gras he'd ever had.  For dinner I ordered the Diver Scallops with autumn roasted veggies.  It was very good, all the flavors melded together very well.  The veggies were more crunchy for roasted than I expected. I don't mind crunchy veggies but some people might think of them as undercooked.   He ordered the Ribeye, medium rare, with a side of the duck fat potatoes.  Personally, I like my steaks more well done unless I'm sure it will be a good cut and served properly.  I tried a piece and it was melt in your mouth delicious. My finance had no complaints saying it was cooked perfectly for him and the best steak he'd had in a long time.  He said the potatoes were good but not quite what he expected, fairly large chunks of potato with skins and a far amount of aioli on them.  For desert we each ordered a glass of port, I had the Coconut Custard Tart which was good but not outstanding.  I wanted more of the blood orange caramel and the coconut flavor was a little weak.  On the other hand my finance had the S'more which was by far better and the smoked salt vanilla ice cream was divine!  It's worth ordering just for the ice cream.

Service:  Our server was very friendly and we had excellent service from her, which made the evening even nicer.  However the bar still seemed slow to fill our drink orders even over dinner.

Venue:  Despite the food and service, we decided against it as a potential venue for our wedding.  We felt it the space was too chopped up and would separate people too much.  It's a unique venue for the right event, just not for us.   Even though we'd already decided to have our reception elsewhere a neighbor shared with me her son's 2010 wedding experience at the Moshulu, advising us not to consider it.  Unfortunately they were very disappointed with their experience and the service prior to and on the day of the event.

Although we won't have our wedding there we still decided it we'd happily return the Moshulu to celebrate our future wedding anniversaries.

We weren't happy to stop by this place but since it was going to rain badly and was right off the hotel we decided to have dinner there. What can I say?the food is just one of the best I have ever had. Love every single plate. I'd suggest the fried bananas  and the enchiladas.
Lots of construction very well laid out.  I can see where they are going with the vision. Cannot wait to see the finished product.
Food is decent. Garlic baked clams never disappoint, but most things on the menu are overpriced. It is a very touristy spot, but it's location can't be beat.

The wait is always worth it when it comes to Sugar and I'm so glad I did post lockdown for my brows with Celeste! She always leaves mine look full and defined and gives me exactly what I want every time. If you have the time to do a brow tint with your wax, DO IT! So worth it when working from home and you have one less step to worry about to look presentable for Zoom ;)

Heard from a worker the shrimp taco was good and the cashier's face lit up when I asked if they had their seasonal brussel sprout taco. The shrimp were cooked perfectly and the brussel sprouts were a pleasant surprise. Everything was delicious, we'll definitely be back!

I normally go to the one on 22nd and old Spanish trail I go there weekly. I made the mistake of ordering from this one the lady on the phone would not let me order the advertised coupon of 12.99 for an 1 topping co pizza . For that reason I do not recomend.
When the WIFI password is goodfood you know you're at a great place; best veggie wrap I've ever had.  Can't wait to go again

Disregard earlier reviews! New chef Nicholas Cassidy is turning out exciting versions of old favorites. We were a group of foodies unsure about the small but well-rounded menu, and instead were astonished at what came out of the kitchen. Very innovative and highly recommended.

I never got the chance to enjoy this place. It would have been my first time going to enjoy a show last year (2019) for the Mos Def concert. At this point, the concert has been cancelled several times and The Ave Live has not returned the $160+ I spent on those concert tickets. After calling frequently for a year, posting on their Instagram and emailing them I am still out of money. So disappointing since I love live music. I was hoping to patronize their business for years to come. The Ave if you are reading this please return the money of the concert goers who were unable to go to the concert due to cancellation.

I had  the Fried Oyster "Loaf" and the Pepper Crusted Duck Breast with Seared Hudson Valley Foie Gras.  The oyster loaf was not very good.  I wish they served chargrilled oysters.  The duck was okay, but I expected much better.  The portion was very small and the duck was a little dry.  I wouldn't recommend either dishes.  

There were plenty of tables upstairs available, but the only option given to me was sitting at the bar.  I won't be giving Palace Cafe a second chance.  I'll stick to Drago's, Acme or Red Fish Grill.

I hosted a birthday party here and we had the best time! Deborah was a wonderful instructor - lively, energetic and professional. Beverly helped me coordinate the party and was extremely attentive and responsive. I would definitely recommend this for a fun, carefree night of dancing for a birthday party, bachelorette, or any celebration!

This place is great. Super clean, ample parking, and plenty of samples =;)

Although not as big as other Whole Foods, it's just the right size if you want to be quick, or of you wanted to meander through for awhile. 

Definitely check it out!
Are you a watch guy or gal, this is the best place to do business , fair , honest and reliable. Number ONE in my book !

Tim's willingness to work with me and help me prioritize the work my car needed was great. He was honest, and didn't try to tack on work that could wait. Willing to work with those of us on a budget! His mechanic, Kyle, did a great job on my car and was friendly and happy to answer my questions. I'll be back!

Where do I start?? I'm so disappointed. I ordered through Door Dash - cheese dip and fajitas. Easy, right? Apparently not. 

The cheese dip is fine, but not only are the fajitas gross - no taste... seriously, everything in the tin (chicken, steak, shrimp, onions, peppers, tomatoes) tastes exactly the same!! How do you even manage that?? But the worst part?? They didn't include the tortillas!! I mean... really?  I'm not asking for much, I'm not high maintenance, but tortillas with my fajitas is kinda expected. 

So, I called the restaurant... not bc I wanted them to bring me tortillas, but thought they might need a reminder of how fajitas work. The man didn't even let me talk - as soon as I said I had orders through DD - he said "you're their customer, complain to them." And hung up. 

So I did... I was clear that the tortillas were the only thing missing, but they refunded me for the  entire order. THAT was a pleasant surprise. 

I'll never order from there again...
Very cool atmosphere here.  Nice vibe and setting.  The were out of their IPA, so couldn't try that.  No sours.  I tried a few random beers which were good. Would come back.

I love the Ruby Slipper locations and I am so excited about their new venture on Metairie Road!

This is a great location and, being a Westbanker, it might actually be easier for me to get to this location and park, rather than weave all around uptown getting to the Magazine St. location. I'm pretty excited that this is here.

We were here for brunch this morning and I love what they've done with the place. Of course, the restaurant is decorated in their signature red accents and has the cozy feeling of their other locations. Monica was our waitress and she immediately took our drink order as soon as we sat down and she told us all about the specials.

Ruby Slipper's Chicken St. Charles is one of my favorites. It's two biscuits topped with fried chicken, poached eggs and their special benedict sauce. It's really one of the best things ever and it works well for breakfast or lunch. I got that with a side of grits and David got the catfish and grits.

As usual, my Chicken St. Charles was phenomenal. The chicken was juicy and fried golden brown and I love how the poached egg oozes onto the chicken and biscuit bringing the whole thing together. The grits were fabulous, as usual, and I just love how creamy they are. David loved his catfish and grits and we both agreed we would order all of this again. One thing that I really want to try is the French toast batons. Sliced up French toast that's all sweet and sugary? I'm in!

Monica was a fabulous waitress and she really did her best to make our experience memorable. This Ruby Slipper is going to be a great addition to the area and I expect it to be pretty packed every weekend. I can't wait to return.
Service was terrible and food quality was low-medium. The experience in general was very poor and we do not recommend.

I've eaten here a few times trying to let them have a chance since I've heard ok things, but they are very unfriendly don't care about how you enjoy your experience. They guilt tripped us into leaving since they were dead and were closing in an hour and a half so they wanted to just close early.... On a Saturday night!!! They then made us feel uncomfortable because we wanted to get food. They seem to get ruder ever time we go and there is a reason why they are so dead cause it's not good and are so rude. Never going again! Most definitely wouldn't suggest.

I was really, really excited about this place opening. Maybe I'm spoiled from my 5 years on San Antonio where tamales are amazing, cheap and plentiful. Not these! Dry, lacking flavor, and cost about $5 PER TAMALE. Im glad I tried it but I won't be back. So disappointed.

I've started coming to this deli/convenience store more often as I am a dog walker in the area and I often need a quick bite.  I recently starting grabbing a few quick snacks to go and then last night, I got a custom made sandwich to take home.  The line was a little long but the meat and cheese was fresh, generously portioned, and they even gave me more meat because they were out of one bread, which was nice of them.  The sandwiches are fresher and tastier compared to the average WaWa and I think I saw that they sell Boar's Head's meats, which is a sign of quality, compared to over processed meats, which I can attest to, having worked in a deli.  

The food was really good, the price was right and I enjoy the grocery offerings of quick snacks, beverages, even some yogurts and prepared dishes.  My only concern was that one of my yogurts wasn't that cold when bringing it home, probably on a hot day, the heat had something to do with it too.

I am glad to know of this local spot, they have a lot of good food choices at a fair price, I like the deli, the available seating and the convenient location.

Time to update!

Had the chance to visit during COVID-19 and I was very pleased with the safety regulations the entire team implemented. Everyone was wearing masks, all tables were socially distant, and they were cleaning in-between diners.

I went with a friend and had some small bites and champagne. They actually have a champagne bottle for $20 and it definitely paired nicely with their creme brulee.

I've had a few visits pre-covid and my updated review was long overdue.

What an amazing place!!! I came in to the shop in a pinch to get an inspection and an oil change and even though they were booked solid one of their guys stayed through his lunch to get it done. They were extremely professional and couldn't ask for better service.
Best service super speedy and super friendly highly recommend to anyone l. Had my car done within a day and a half. They have a customer for life.

The. Worst.  Never again...Rude staff and sub-par service.  There was still old polish on my nails that I wish I had noticed before paying and leaving.  Another reason why I stopped going to strip mall nail salons.

If i were to die and go to Falafel Heaven..... this place would be it.
The Falafel, Tabouli, Baba Ghanoush (sp?) and Salad cant be beat. The Falafel is made fresh and is so reasonable you cant turn it down!

Someone turned me onto this place and I was hooked. Although its a bit weird that the cart is titled "King" of Falafel, when the person running the show is a woman. Oh well...

Don't get the pizza. 

That's right: let me be a lone wolf here and say that, IMHO, the 'za here isn't as extraordinary as maybe its built up to be. Actually, I thought it was pretty unmemorable. When I asked our server which of the vegetarian options he suggested, he encouraged us to try the "Zucchine" (zucchini, cherry tomatoes, red onion, garlic, caciocavallo, pistachio pesto, and squash blossoms). It was pretty greasy, and relatively sparse regarding the toppings: not a single squash blossom, and very little red onion or garlic. It was mostly just a marghertia pizza. Which is fine... but not what I wanted.

That was the only blip on an otherwise spectacular dining experience at Barbuzzo, which I plan on coming to every time I'm in Philly now. Despite the seating (tables are small and packed in very, very close to one another), the atmosphere is sexy. Dark colors, warm yellow lighting by Edison bulb-type fixtures or candle light or wood fire oven, and just a very cool buzz/vibe happening. Dunno if it's physical location or the people coming here, but... I want to be Barbuzzo's level of cool.

For drinks, we got the pitcher of red wine sangria which was wonderful for two people to split!

For food, we (thoroughly) enjoyed:
+ Seared Snap Peas: if a garden could choose what the fruits of its labors would go on to do with their lives, I think it would want them to be this salad! What an amazing bite of food this was; earthy, yet light, and a bit of smokiness from the char. I could have just eaten this and been entirely satisfied.
+ Spring Pea Arancini: I'm not sure, but I think this changes regularly. When we came, it was five fried to golden perfection, mouth-watering balls topped with preserved lemon aioli, parmesan, and pea tendrils. I've never had such lush arancini before. Some of the best I've ever had; and, looking back, I wish I had gotten a second order of these and skipped the pizza. 
+ Salted Caramel Budino: you had to know this was coming! Hate to sound like a broken record, but... hands down THE BEST DESSERT I'VE EVER EATEN ANYWHERE. I am sorry I decided to share with someone. After one bite, both my dining partner and I realized we should have gotten our own (we felt this way about the arancini, too). We also debated pretty heavily about ordering budino to go, decided not to, and spent the next day talking incessantly about the regret of that decision. Creamy, salted caramel crystally, chocolate crunchy, vanilla velvety, and all around epic. 

Do yourself a favor: go to Barbuzzo. Make their budino the star of the show, and work your way backwards as to what you'd like leading up to it!

A St. Louis institution.  Despite how busy it can get, the team there has the logistics of moving you through quickly so you can sit and feast!  The staff is really friendly and willing to answer any questions you may have before ordering.  (Just ask those questions before getting close to the head of the line!).  For those "non-purists " like myself, the sauce selection is great, each with its own unique flavor.  I loved the "hoodoo" and vinegar.  The portions are generous and you will absolutely leave with a smile on your face.

Acoustics in this place is terrible....had to shout to be heard and restaurant was only half full. Food had good flavor but cold by the time we got it....was going to tell the waitress but I never saw her again until she bought the check....not even to refill drinks. Ate my meal with no drink. Tried to flag her down once but to no avail. Might try Grand location next time to see if it is any better.
Amazing and delicious.  Weekend brunch was crowded but well worth the wait.  We will definitely be back.

I've taken my son to this park, and he absolutely loves it.  It's almost hidden if you don't know where it is, although being hidden out in the open is probably a more apt term.

It's funny, in one sense, as one one end, there's a thoroughly modern, handicap friendly, almost antiseptic play-area on one end, while on the other is a very old school, rocky, dirty, gritty, worn-down, wooden monstrosity just waiting to skin knees, cut fingers and break bones.  Both are lots of fun.

I enjoy the center area, but I never realized it was a dragon until now.  Call me ignorant.

There's a little bit of everything at this little park, and it is a great place to take your young 'un if he needs to get rid of a little extra energy.

Once you walk in to Bob Evans Restaurant you and your family be greeted by the host or hostess to take you to your table then you'll be handed your ordering menus. Then the waiter or waitress will come over and take your drink order or food order sometimes both. The service from the staff always has been great here since this restaurant opened back up to the public. 

The noise from the customers/guest and employees is normal and some what quiet depends on how busy everyone is. I like coming here and same with the family always great service and the food is great!

Bad experience. I ordered a sign after already giving this company business and after a week and a half; I called the company and spoke to Tom for him only to forget what I ordered. Then he asked that I come pick it up even though I already told him that I'd pay for a professional install. Then I called him a few days later to get a concrete date and he tells me to take the business elsewhere. He wasted 2 weeks of my time to just jerk me around. 

Large or small, businesses is business and at least communicate. Don't string clients around. Tell me right away that you don't want the small business. I will never ever do business with such ungrateful people again. Tom, thanks for wasting my time. I told you that I'll give you a good review for good service. What do you expect me to do now? After wasting 2 weeks of time and energy? 

For everyone else, I would pay a few extra dollars for another sign company that would actually appreciate your business.

Atmosphere was great and service was excellent.  Jamie was our server and she was great.  We didn't have to look for her if we needed something as she was very attentive and accommodating to our table.  Food was good as well.

I had a routine cleaning with no problems.  However, the hygenist left in the middle of my cleaning to do a flouride tratment for another patient.  Then she kept telling me everything was fine and the dentist would be with me in a minute.  30 minutes later of sitting in the patient chair, i left.  Ever since Dr Jolly stopped as my dentist, its been downhill.

Awesome new brewery in Santa Barbara. The orange sour beer is delicious. Try to call and find out when happy hour is because they have some good specials.

Location is a little bit odd, It's in the back of the warehouse building that is also shared with a winery tasting room.

The food is also good. The grilled cheese sandwich was tasty (albeit kind of expensive), but the side of pasta salad was good. 

Will be back when I'm in the area next.

I come to Reno every year, and this year I decided to stay at the Boomtown Best Western Plus hotel. I shouldn't have stayed here. It's pretty dead and not as fun as actually being on the strip in Reno. It's definitely cheaper than staying the strip. Would I stay here agian? If it was a last resort I would, then go eat at the lobster buffet and just drive 10 minutes to Reno and go play over there.

Arrived at 8:15am on a Saturday for an oil change and wiper blade replacement. It's now now 8:50am and my car is done. Record breaking time at any oil change shop on a Saturday morning. I'm impressed! Customer service also on point, thanks Walter.
    The missing star, bathroom in the waiting area not in service. I didn't ask if there was another one in the store. 
    Anyway, fast and accurate service will keep me coming back to this Pep Boys!

Received a great haircut from Jess.

I needed a quick appt for a work thing, after calling around to a few salons Ulta was the only salon that I could find that was open on Sunday & could schedule me with less than 24 hour notice.

Jess was awesome, she did my hair exactly like I asked & didn't try to talk me out of anything (every stylist I go to try to talk me out of the cut that I want, and I've had the same haircut for 15+ years). I brought in pictures to show how I wanted my bangs & she cut them exactly the way the picture look.

I love the cute. It is easy to style. Looks super clean (especially for long hair). I've had the cut for almost 2 weeks & have received many compliments.

Pizzeria Tivoli is a small, family owned Princeton Heights neighborhood pizzeria with rustic homemade traditional style Italian pizzas that are made in a wood-burning oven.  The crusts are hand tossed and crispy.  They use mostly mozzarella cheese.  I had the shrimp pesto pizza ($13), which was very tasty.  I like the traditional style because it's not too heavy with ingredients.  You can really taste the freshness of each item.  

We also had the bruschetta ($6), which was fresh, but a little difficult to eat because the bread was so thick.  

Overall, I enjoyed my experience.  Pizzeria Tivoli sits on the quiet end of South Kingshighway on a treelined side street and they have a nice outdoor patio with lots of outdoor seating.

Update:  Thanks for the comment Janez, but honestly, I haven't been that impressed with your other appetizers and the bruschetta is not easy to eat since the thickness of the bread changes each time I come and  it is usually too thick to bite into and hold together once I am able to bite through it.  I like the topping on it, but I'll stick with the pizza.You may want to consider editing the appetizers a bit and having something that is light and not breaded.  Something that would compliment pizza rather than substitute.

Underwhelming. I had pretty high expectation coming in because of good things I heard, but every dish--i mean every one, turned out average or below. I should have been warned when my waitress spilt water on the table and the menu. The stirred egg with shrimp was so salty, yet the Galician soup was so bland. Won't come back again.
Awesome concept and taste, but the staff has consistently lead to disappointment... Not sure what the deal is but they give off a locals only, take your coffee& go vibe. What is that?

I like this place better than Sciarinos and Thunderbird, because prices are cheaper, and delivery is quick, and they are nice, the other places are somewhat rude. We order all the time, the pizza is good, I like the sauce, and wings are good too.

I'm in love with BJ's in Wesley Chapel/Lutz. In short, I've come here with my husband on 2 additional occasions, both at different times of the day than today and all visits were on different days of the week. I just have to ask -- how can a restaurant have the exact same chef back there 24/7?! Lol! The food is delicious and tasting fresh... consistently! For traditionalists, there are familiar dishes to order. However, for a large portion of the menu, the food is creative in concept and flavor -- so this is definitely a fun place for a true foody to enjoy exploring. BJ's has yet to disappoint.

Drink options: From soft drinks to the hot or iced-caffeinated beverages, the selection is pretty traditional. Alcoholic, wine and beer? This is called a brewery for a reason... bottom and top shelf is available --however, you cannot possibly make it here to ONLY drink... it's super hard to do! If you are a beer-drinker, though... I recommend the cherry-chipotle wings, bone-in, complimentary to any choice of beer--Scrumptious!

Ambience & Decor: Personable, but open. The decor gives off an authentic brewery/warehouse feel, yet the varying booth options allow for all party sizes to receive the pleasure of feeling private. You have the TV tuned in to all of the exciting games for sports-lovers. The music is at a reasonable volume, so it's great for socializing or holding small, informal meetings (they have free wifi).

Appropriate for all. You won't find a BJ's mascot ready to fill balloons with helium and pass them out for quick pics with the babes, but BJ's a great place to bring your kids during the daytime and in the evenings. No there's not a jungle gym, but the piZookie dessert is powerful enough to bring joy to children of all ages.

Despite working in the area for over the last four years I had never known this place to exist until they came into our office with fliers. I will say the first time we ordered we were trying for delivery and since we had separate orders (and wanted to pay with card) they said we would have to pay the delivery charge on each individual order who wanted to pay with card. We order from lots of places typically they just split up that charge or the first order pays it and we work it out so instead of paying one delivery charge they wanted to charge us four times for one delivery.... Yeah. So we opted for carry out on time one.

Upon arrival there are two doors so I opened the first one I came to which is a direct door into the kitchen (a sign up wouldn't be a bad idea). The lobby was clean and they had awesome looking pizza by the slice on counter sadly we ordered sandwiches this time around. The philly chicken was sliced so thin and bundled together that when I took a bite a large amount of grease came out the bottom of the sandwich. My co workers and I began a contest to see how much grease could fall out the bottom of the sandwich. Needless to say these weren't very impressive especially considering we have amicis, New York New York, best ny pizza, and the major brands just to name a few all within delivery range to us with better sandwiches that won't have the delivery charge fiasco per order or as much grease. 

The saving grace however is the pizza. Over the weekend we ordered pizza and wings and this was delicious. We ordered 8 for the store and all were hits, very large slices as well. I certainly recommend the pizza as it beats quite a few places in this area in quality. The wings were alright nothing great nothing terrible, and the subs philly chicken and steak were major misses in our opinions. Stick with pizza and you will be fine
A great place for lunch.  The Mexican dinner is hard to beat, not really what I would call traditional -- but tasty nonetheless.

I've been going here for 3 years. The price of meat and quality has gone down in the past year. They had good prices and good quality but I'm not sure what has happened in the past year. The staff are always helpful and friendly which is good. But meat fruit and veggies are not in the best of shape I can go to Bravo and find better quality that's not a good thing .

I went to Atomic to have a professional look at my belly ring because it was bothering me and was recommended by a friend to go here. I loved it. The place is spotlessly clean, and it has a great atmosphere. Danny was the person who helped me with my belly ring issue and was extremely pleased with the help I received. I no longer have any issues with my piercing, so thank you Danny!!!

What a great place for live music!  Some Big Chief and War Chief were playing music, and it was really quite good.  The smoke was a tad overwhelming, but what great music!  Wish I had more time in NOLA, would have spent more time listening to live music!  The local Purple Haze was a tasty brew , light, with a hint of raspberry.  Allegedly made for Mardi Gras.  Don't like the smoking in bars thing too much ( used to the NY scene), but the music was well worth it, and then some!  Galactic apparently plays there a lot too.

This truck is my heaven on wheels!! The guys are great ppl so nice and friendly! They give u that real island love Now getting down to the best part their food is out of this World Good!! I have not had a bad plate from them yet. So great every part of the meal is so good from the always fresh juicy chicken to the tender beef. It's all mouth watering sticky rice that goes great with the meats. Also the cold creamy mouth feel of the macaroni salad that is refreshing in between the bites of hot meat and rice. I can't help but get a plate of both when I can! They even have the crunchy, hot fresh from the fryer chicken Katsu with the sauces it's so moist! I can't help but to dig in as soon as the plate hit my hand it don't even make it back to my office door before half is GONE!! The smell is like the best when your waiting on ur plate!! I go broke if they came to my job everyday!! If I could afford it I would have them do my breakfast, lunch and dinner!!

Very fast oil change and 5 tire rotation but then I learned why.  After I left, the dash light warned me of a tire 10 lbs. low on air.  The spare rotated in was not checked even though the "mechanic" checked the form indicating he had inspected it.  Had to waste time going back.  They fixed but offered no compensation - not even a simple car wash.  Very poor customer service and now I have no confidence in their work since they lie.  Fast service, polite staff and clean waiting areas are worthless if you are incompetent with the main reason I am there!

A must see when in Nashville!!!!
We bought a Grayline bus tour package that included a back stage pass at the Opry House. It was fantastic!!! We spent 90 minutes or more with a guide seeing what it looks like behind the scenes.  We got to look inside the dressing rooms to the stars of country music. The hallways were lined with beautiful pictures of country singers and performers young and old. The Opry House has a tradition and rich history in country music that we were not aware of and we soaked it all in. The tour ended with a picture taken by their photographer that you can purchase as you leave. Would highly recommend.

Love this shop! We get all of our nice steaks here for grilling! The smokies are great! They did a wonderful job of a special order we brought in. We were using a sausage recipe out of an old cookbook and the replicated it perfectly!

Delicious food, unbeatable view, unique layout.  Makes a nice quiet Sunday afternoon all the more delightful.

I had the conch chowder which was easy on the wallet (as is always a factor for me) and had the perfect amount of spices and seasonings, as well as BACON!!!

Others with me ordered a sashimi style dish and buffalo shrimp, which they also enjoyed, but I didn't try.

As we had arrived there in the afternoon, and sat around long enough to talk, we welcomed in the dinner hour, where they brought over complimentary blueberry and cornbread muffins.  Delightful!  I ate every last one that I brought home with me.

As I've mentioned before, I no longer drink, and neither does my boyfriend, but he said the sangria can't be beat and the other couple with us enjoyed a pitcher while they were there.

I am a big fan of Bayshore Boulevard, which is like the Tampa Bay version of Chicago's Lake Shore Drive (I am a Chicago native!)- so I would definitely come back here for the view alone. Adding great food to that certainly takes the cake.  It is a little out of my way and higher priced, which would not make the Colonnade my first choice.  But my first time there is definitely not my last.

Great breakfast!  There was a short wait so we sat at the bar. Lots of great options and the coffee was yummy (my friends said). Vanilla Latte was sweet and delicious. A little loud but it was a good time. Thank you!!

Nice quick service, they are pro and fast moving! Atmosphere is cute and updated for a greasy spoon! This place has a great huevos and chorizo rancheros for the American palate. Price is low so expect to get with a 10-12$ bill per person!

We love this buffet!  We eat here at least once a stay.  There is always a wide variety of food and the servers are friendly and helpful.  This time I noticed that they even had a large variety of sugar-free desserts which I truly appreciated!

The food here is awesome! Every time I come here I have the queso  to start and one of each of their bao. Soooo good! This last time I had the huckleberry buttermilk tart which was amazing. Came with homemade whipped cream!

We came here after reading through our AirBnB's guest book and I understand why it was recommended 5+ times! House squeezed OJ was incredible - we brought our own champagne for byob mimosas. The BEST we had all weekend. We ordered the Shrimp & Grits and Biscuits & Gravy for the table and they were by far crowd favorites. I'd also suggest the breakfast burrito if you're on the go (we were not, it was still great!) and the BLT with Lox, which was a very 'meaty' BLT variation. The tortilla soup was not impressive but the soup of the day was a squash option and it was deeeelightful. Friendly staff and fun art for sale on the walls. Art is cash only - but they have an ATM machine. They also only have coke, diet coke, and maybe one other option so if you're hungover and want a soda water - no can do.  

Next time I will be getting the Shrimp/Grits, Biscuits, and hopefully a crawfish special (omlette was good, but I'm not into Brie so I would opt out). French toast also looked AMAZING but I prefer savory to sweet so we did not get this and probably won't next time.

We also waited about 45 minutes, but this is exactly what they quoted us. We went down to another coffee shop about 2 or 3 blocks away to get some cafe in the meantime. Worth the wait!

We stayed here for a few days this month. Service was great, and hotel was clean. Parking was ample. My only complaint is the room design, the air conditioner blows right into the side of the desk that can't be moved. I never really felt like the room cooled down.

Aaron L. From Seattle Washington doesn't know what he's talking about. He was probably rude and the staff didn't want to deal with him. This place is AMAZING. A local gem and the pot boys are the shhhhiiii Aaron L. From Seattle has probably never had a real poboy.

Incredible! My husband and I visited Jeff Ruby's tonight while on a weekend trip for our anniversary. Be sure to make a reservation. It's near impossible to get a table without one. Sam, our waiter, made our night nothing less than perfect. He was so attentive and really wanted to get to know us and make our night special. We decided to share the Cowboy Steak crowned with mushrooms and onions, a side of mashed potatoes, and the best macaroni and cheese I've ever tasted. From the atmosphere, the food, the service, and complimentary celebration dessert sampler for our anniversary - This restaurant completely surpassed our expectations.

I was really hoping they would do something nice with this location, since it was my beloved old favorite spot to go to by myself. This is the old Filo's, I spent many nights there having a few drinks,  listening and dancing to great music by the Worship crew, then walking home. 

We decided to check this place out one Friday night when a friend from out of town was visiting. It was the perfect atmosphere and food in the downstairs lounge area. The music the dj was playing was great and funky, yet not too loud, so that we could still hold a conversation. The food was spectacular, we had the Ceviche de Callos con Sandia (watermelon and scallop ceviche), I wasn't sure what to expect, it was not like the typical ceviche I have had before, but it was delicious. We also had the Queso Fundido, one with chorizo and the other with mushrooms. They were both devine!

They also have a reverse happy hour special in the lounge: Thursday - Saturday, 10pm-12am. We had some tasty margaritas (although not the best I have had, but good enough for the price), and we were feeling really nice by the time we left there, not too full, it was the perfect amount of food, and we still had some $ in our pocket!

I am definitely looking forward to going back to Xochitl.

Decided to try RR's for the first time when I was feeling a little under the weather this past week. I don't eat meat, so ordered their vegetarian shoyu ramen with a soft boiled egg to go. I also got an order of the vegetable gyoza.  I called in and am told my order would be ready in 20 mins.  Got there to pick up and it was ready timely, just as promised and well-packaged in a big paper bag.  Total price was 20 and some change.  
I got home and the food looked good, although what was noted as Napa cabbage on the menu appeared to be some sort of greens.  I also didn't see any carrots or bell peppers.  The broth was packaged separately, so I nuked it quickly before pouring it on my noodle dish.  I then proceed to slurp it down (I was glad to be at home eating it, I was kinda sloppy)!  My gyoza were pretty flavorful, but overall I was sort of underwhelmed by the ramen.  Nothing was overtly bad, I just felt like I was expecting more.  Everything seemed salty, which I expected but the noodles, veggies and broth really lacked any other distinct flavor than that.  For $20+, the portion size seemed a little small as well.  I was hoping to get two meals from this order (as I usually do at most Asian restaurants), but all that was left were a couple gyozas when I was finished.
I wouldn't rule out Ramen Ray's again, but I don't think I'll be in a rush to come back.
** As an aside, I've never had take-out ramen, so I can't compare it to anything else I've tried.

The place used to be a gem sadly poor management and now slop they serve for food.  So sad that a good little bar can go down hill so fast. Just order a pizza the other day it was disgusting cheese fell right off pie and dough was undercooked inside and bury on bottom.  Will never spend another time here.

Their turkey focaccia sandwich is probably my fave sandwich in the world, besides poboys and cheeseburgers. My company always orders catered lunch from here and I storm the kitchen to make sure I get the turkey sandwich and side of pecan cranberry salad. 
After seeing so many people that I follow on Instagram post their baked goods, it dawned on me that I'd never come here in person. 
Needing a change of scenery and a new place to work, I headed to Gracious on the St. Charles street car line for lunch and to knock out work on my laptop. There are over two dozen baked goods including donuts, muffins, cookies, cupcakes, various savory and sweet breads, croissants, scones, hand pies, quiches and so much more! I'm a creature of habit, so I ordered the turkey focaccia sandwich with chips, and to be a little adventurous I indulged in their dulce de leche brownie. 

Service was efficient and friendly!

There is ample indoor seating and a few tables outside. Inside is not wheelchair accessible since there are a couple steps to enter the front door. 
Besides baked goods and cafe food, they have a full coffee bar, (sans blended drinks) and display coolers selling wine, energy drinks, and assorted non alcoholic beverages. Gracious does offer catering, and you can purchase seasonal goods to go in store like king cakes, loaves of bread and assorted gift baskets. 

The free WiFi was perfect for me to use for a few hours, and it wasn't super noisy. There are only a couple plugs inside, so if you plan to do work here, make sure you snag a table by the wall.

This review is for the service department!

Just like I buy water damage warranties for my electronics, I also buy tire warranties for my vehicles! Nails and screws are two peas in a pod for me and my tires.

I thought I was on a 6 month streak as I haven't had any leaks in my tires. Then I woke up yesterday morning to find that one of my tires was Down to 10 PSI.

I drove across the city to SP Toyota and pulled into the service department. I was greeted by my first name by Jay (the service manager) asking what I did this time, Apparently I have a reputation there.

I proceeded to tell Jay about my tire leaking and that I needed it fixed. Well, because I was unorganized at the time, I didn't have an appointment. The service department fit me in right away to get my tire fixed. They also noticed I was a little late on my oil change and they said they would do it for me as well!

An Hour and a half later and two vanilla coffees in my tummy from their brand new coffee machine, I had my Scion tC back! Tire fixed (yes it was a nail) and my  Oil change completed. They even washed my car for me (for free)! Now that is service!

Thanks again SP Toyota! I'm sure I'll see you soon again. Hopefully with no more Nails in my tires!
I ordered delivery the other day, and it was great. The food came quickly, it was inexpensive, and very good. I especially like the General Tso's tofu and the cold sesame noodles.
I love this restaurant and it's environment!  The paella is amazing and it is small and quaint.

Our family has become hooked on escape rooms in the last year. We have visited every location that has opened in the Reno/Sparks area. I particularly appreciate the attention to aesthetic detail Key and Code invests in their rooms. Great production design. If you are from the area, the Tahoe themed room is particularly fun, while also offering some clever puzzles and devices I have not seen used elsewhere. It's a family operation, and you can tell they love what they do.

I've struggled with hormonal acne, blackheads and hyperpigmentation. I tried multiple different skin care products but nothing i did was improving my skin... then I met Lauren-she's the clinical esthetician here and I'm so very grateful for what she's done for my skin! After just 2 weeks of seeing her for a clarifying facial/microdermabrasion, she recommended some products that changed everything for me-for the better!!! Her kind and upbeat personality is contagious and really makes the experience, she makes you feel right at home and comfortable and you can tell how dedicated she is to quality skin care for every, unique individual!!! If you are not happy with your current skin care routine, i highly recommend you go see Lauren- she's worth every penny!!!

Vegans rejoice! It's so great to know that there is a place to know when you want something sweet and sorbet and water ice doesn't cut it. My boyfriend and I live in Deptford and make special trips to Little Baby's on occasion. I usually get an ice cream sandwich (made with vegan cookies) go big or go home! The cookies are amazing. I don't know if they sell cookies by themselves, but they should. The ice cream flavors are unique but are always tasty. If choosing a sandwich, I usually ask what they recommend as a pairing and they are pretty helpful. The ice cream is rich and decadent and doesn't lack any flavor. Ugh.... Now I want some!

I. Adore. This. Place. Every food item I've tried has been amazing. Their peanut butter cake is insanely good. I love the razzatazz French toast. I love the sausage and cream cheese quiche. I love the ambiance. I love it love it love it!!

The dilemma, food or service? Mr. Wizards' custard is the "St. Louis" taste. Perhaps a touch creamier than Ted Drewes, but that might just be being served warmer or closer to melted than the St. Louis landmark. The topping choices go on and on.  If you can not find a combo that suits your taste, you may just be too picky. I had a German Chocolate. It was a little light on the coconut, but had the right chocolate/caramel mix.

Then there is the service. Or rather, the two people behind the counter taking money, since the service pretty much sucked. I was there mid afternoon on a weekday. The service wasn't rude, just lacking. I do not need a show with my treat, but I would like to be treated a little better.

Getting in and out can be a pain. Try to make a left at the wrong time on Big Bend and you will sit a loooong time. The lot is small.

Great atmosphere!!!! Great food!!! Awesome service.... Kevin was out server he was extremely nice and Kevin was awesome as well if you are in town or a local get dolled up and come and visit Desi Vega's steakhouse!!!
This is the most authentic Mexican food in town by far. Try the fajitas. The chips with the warm salsa are also very good.
Good expresso drinks.  Friendly service. Great outdoor seating.  Try out the lox and bagels dish.  Super tasty. Music inside is a l little loud.

An upscale addition to the great Carp restaurants.  Their publicity says among other things, "just a short drive from Montecito," and that sums up their targeted clientele.  Thursday we went for lunch there and had a good experience.  I had an entree called "Top of the Hill" including shrimp, clams, and fish on pasta (green and yellow) and it was superb.  Our waitress had more than a little attitude--but hey, what do you expect at a place like this?  What looks like a real Vespa mounted over the bar, and other details that evoke Italian Riviera images.

Update: I filed a consumer complaint with the corporate office last week.  I received a call from the corporate office today saying that they would not refund my money and I would have to go back to the local office.  The representative had a very nasty, negative tone and asked me why I paid for a service that I was not happy with.  I told her that I was not informed that I could even refuse and I would have appreciated a discussion about the fees before going through the entire process. This was a complete method of entrapment.  I was hoping to speak with someone who acted like she cared or perhaps would ask for my account of the events.  Clearly, my expectations with H & R Block were too high.  Do NOT use this service.

I moved to Tampa recently and have definitely found my regular spa!! The entire staff was so attentive and kind. It was easy to make an appointment, I was responded to efficiently, and I was beyond pleased with the services I received. I gave the spa my ideas and they gave me beautiful nails. Will most certainly return again and again.

We came across Love City on our search for the best beers Philly has to offer. Happy to say this was by far our favorite spot. The warehouse vibe with wooden bench seating, and leather couches and chairs; paired with all the hanging plants made me feel right at home. They have a unisex bathroom which is fine by me aside from the first stall I went into not closing properly. Easily fixable though. 

We stopped in around 4:30 on a Sunday and although plenty of people were there, it wasn't crowded at the bar and we were easily able to find a seat to enjoy our drinks. They did have a waitress coming around, so I think you could have sat down and ordered more but it was super easy to grab a drink quickly at the bar. They have a nice long floating bar, which makes for tons of seating. The beer selection was good, not overly large. I had to check out their IPA, and I was very pleased with it. This was definitely one of my favorite spots we discovered while visiting Philly and by far my favorite brewery!

My wife and I stopped by this store on our way back home from an errand in West Chester to quickly pick some grocery items.  Well, the supermarket turned out to be not so "super."  It was small: very small compared to other Giant supermarkets (or any supermarket by today's standards).  It was also showing many signs of age, badly in need of a significant refresh.  Does it matter?  Not for many, but for some, it may encourage them from shopping elsewhere.  (My wife, for one, won't be returning to this store.)

I stayed at Vista Del Monte for a week with a relative who needed round the clock care while he waited for his room to be ready at their 'memory care' facility (which includes round-the-clock supervision and care.) 

These are the observations I made in that time : 
The staff is doing an excellent job caring for their residents and treats each person as a unique and valued individual. Every staff member we encountered knew my great uncle's name and greeted him warmly. 
The kitchen staff were fantastic and accommodating. Any time we had unique requests for condiments or extras (any time of day) they were always happy to oblige. There were two ladies in particular that remembered my name (even though I am a guest and not a resident) and made a point to address me by it, which I thought was very professional and kind. I believe their names were Jennifer and Melissa. On the occasions when we went to dine in the outdoor dining pavilion the wait staff was on par to any high end restaurant in town. I would know as this is what I did for a living for many years. I was shocked...especially considering they don't accept tips anyway...they were just that good because they cared. William stood out as being especially accommodating when our 'reservation' got messed up (my fault) one day. 

All of the medical staff who came to the room to give medications or do wellness checks were professional and kind. One woman (Juline) was particularly warm and cheerful. Everytime she left my uncle commented on how much he enjoyed her visits. 

The 'resident services' staff were always going above and beyond with any request I brought to them. One lady in particular (Angie I believe) stands out. When I needed to do laundry for my great-uncle, but it was after hours so their little shop was closed she went to her car and got her OWN laundry detergent that she happened to have with her and gave it to me to use! 

I could go on and I'm sure there are many staff that deserve specific mention that I've forgotten to include (I should have been keeping notes all week) but in general the entire staff was amazing and I don't have one single less than stellar incident to report.

I've visited twice since they've opened. I was excited to see that it finally opened. Their food truck is super popular with the locals. I've given their food truck 4 stars in the past. That's why it pains me to write this. The service and food at this location was more like 3 stars.

The first visit was a takeout order. I got the Mexican Street Taco platter which comes with a side of rice and refried beans. I'm not a fan of refried beans so I won't elaborate on that. I chose 3 different vegetarian fillings;  Nopal (cactus), Flor de Calabaza (squash blossom), and mushroom. I'd never had cactus before and it was unique. I liked that it tasted like a tart green pepper, but I feel like it should have included tomatoes or garlic to give it some more taste. The squash blossom taco was more like zucchini. I didn't see any blossoms. The mushroom and zucchini were really bland for Mexican tacos. I know that sounds weird but it's like they forgot to put seasoning on it. I added a slice of avocado to each one for an extra charge. I was happy for that because it gave it a bit more taste. These were tacos that you would need to have some kind of sauce to give it some flavor. Maybe it would have made it better had I used the green sauce. The service that day was very slow. I sat at the bar for quite a while. I didn't say anything the entire time. I don't complain. The bartender kept telling me it would be out soon without me even asking. I finally got the order and the manager gave me complimentary chips and salsa because of the wait. Again, I did not have to mention it. The salsa was okay, but I've had better.

The second visit was with my husband. We were seated promptly at a nice booth. The atmosphere is very lovely. That's one huge advantage. The murals and decor are absolutely beautiful. They did a wonderful job renovating that space that used to be Vallarta's. The service was very friendly. We started our meal with salsa, green sauce (hot & amazing if you haven't tried it before), and sauce that tasted like chipotle or mole. We also got guacamole. I must say it was different because it had these bacon wrapped vienna sausages sticking out of it. It was okay. I'd prefer to have the sausages separated from the dip in the future. This is when we waited and waited for our fajitas to come out. We finally got them, but only 1 came out. I guess there was a miscommunication even though I told her 2 fajita dishes. She thought we were sharing it. She apologized and placed an emergency order. It came out pretty quick so I feel like I may have taken someone else's order. Anyway, we weren't impressed with the steak. My husband's order had a lot of gristle. Mine didn't have that, but it was overly salted. It looked pretty, but I've seriously had better at other restaurants. Again, I didn't speak to a manager. I never do. My husband didn't either. I guess they could have corrected it but we didn't want to wait longer. This all happened on a Sunday evening. There were many people there. Take that for what it's worth. I do think that it will get better. It's a new expansion for them. I just hope it does soon.

I'll leave on a positive note. They have a full bar and it looks fully stocked. Again, the decor is beautiful and a lot of love went into painting and decoration both inside and outside. I will try it again.

This place was wayyyyyy over hyped. Coming from the northeast is was your typical diner. Staff wasn't very helpful and food was only ok. Ordered the build your own omelette, hash browns and came with a side of pancakes. Nothing amazing but standard diner food.

Booked another res and enjoyed it.

Additional notes:

They appear to have a problem with their OpenTable-to-reservation system.  They "lost" our reservation and the next table wasn't open for 45 minutes.  Mistakes happen, but there was no apology which was disappointing.  We came back after 45 minutes and had dinner.

The Restaurant week menu is pretty spot on.  Got the Bibimbap which was delicious.  Spicy "KFC" (Korean Fried Wings) are also excellent but when compared to the soy versions my wife got, weren't all that spicy (kick it up guys!).

Service was exceptional in the restaurant.  Fast.  Attentive.  Friendly.  

I'm still a little put off by the reservation thing, but I'll probably eventually come back again.

Bangkok Cruise is the place to go if you're looking for some Thai food in Reno. Don't forget to check in and get 10% off your total order! 

Came in on a Monday afternoon and no one was there. Was immediately helped and seated. Service was subpar, but the food was great. 

You can never go wrong with a Pad Thai. The Pad Thai I ordered was great and had a decent amount of shrimp and chicken. The Pad Thai off their lunch special is the same as their regular entree menu except it comes with some soup. Be warned though, their spice levels are no joke. I could feel it with a medium at level 2 and I wouldn't wanna guess what level 10 is. 

Overall, the food was great and will be back to try out some of their other foods!

I was looking for Chris Taylor's address and came upon these reviews. Chris is amazing.  My husband and I love him.  He is as delightful in personality as he is knowledgeable in technology.  We have used his services for several years now, and not once has he let us down. He is so patient with us both--elderly writers who take to technology very slowly. He has done everything from helping my husband with the footnotes of a scholarly book to teaching me how to save my passwords. Just today he installed my new computer.  I hated to see him leave!  Chris is also a man of great integrity.  
Diana B.

Miller Brothers Auto continues to impress us with their service.  We have been loyal customers for years.  The most recent interaction was when the 4WD system on my 4WD pickup (which I rarely use) was acting up.  I was receiving an error code (SERVICE 4WD) that can suggest some major issues.  An online review suggested it could also be a grounding issue, a switch issue, or a host of other "gremlins".  Kenny had a long discussion with me to make sure he fully understood all the parameters of the problem (how often the light came on, usage rate for various 4WD settings, etc.).  I dropped the pickup off with fingers crossed.  In just a few hours, I was notified that an analysis of the onboard computer, the switch system, and all the mechanical components revealed it was most likely just an intermittent problem created by the very low frequency of use.  They also had checked and topped off all my fluids.  What a relief!  As always, a thorough diagnosis, discussion of what can be done and what you might want done, and a very fair price.  It also feels great to support a family business in our community.  Thanks, yet again, Miller Brothers!

Biscuit Cafe is a Mexican restaurant in the Broad Ripple area. The first time I went, I was not a fan, but this second time it was not bad. They have a good selection of food and nice decor. The staff were super friendly and kind. It was good to talk to them in Spanish. My boyfriend and I split a chorizo torta. The plates are huge! The only disappointment was the lack of fresh hot salsa. The salsa they served us was super mild and not that flavorful which was disappointing for a Mexican restaurant. Yet, I understand why given the location and most of the customers are Non-Mexicans. I ordered an horchata drink, but it did not taste like most horchatas. It tasted more sugary with a mix of whipped cream, which does not go with the traditional drink but had an interesting taste to it.

AMAZING!!! I took my Bill Levkoff bridesmaid dress to Best Season's Tailoring as the bridal store ordered the dress two sizes larger than needed. After striking out with multiple other tailors in the area with respect to price (quoted anywhere from $80-$300!), my sister found Best Season's on Yelp and I dropped in the next Friday to get a quote.

I changed into the dress in the small back room (completely private) and stepped out for the fitting. She consulted me on the height of the shoes I'd be wearing (to understand if the hem needed adjustment) and if I wanted to wear a bra. Overall, it was decided she would take in two inches on each side of the bust and leave the hem untouched for a total of $65!! I was ecstatic and happy that I wouldn't be spending over $100 in alterations and immediately told my sister to stop in the following day for her fitting.

The dress is a 3 layer chiffon dress with side boning in the bust, the alterations were not easy-peasy so to speak and required her to remove the side boning without compromising the integrity of the dress. I returned this past Saturday to try on the dress post-alterations and it fit like a glove!! I am extremely happy (as is my sister) with my dress and Best Season's alterations. This awesome tailor will be my go-to for any easy and difficult alterations needs I have in the future!

One of my closest friends is getting married. Traditional Indian wedding. I found this store of the most beautiful Indian clothing. Mita and Kieran helped me and my husband find the perfect outfits for the sangheet celebration. They were very friendly and patient. I recommend this place and I will be back

Brought a boot in to have. One inch step stitched..cobbler not in so the receptionist suggested a dab of glue to hold it until I could get it properly stitched..she charged me $5.. No receipt..rip off!
Food was just okay for a restaurant that is not cheap! Hostess stand people were snobby but waiter did an excellent job!

I found Spotwalk after adopting an 8-week old puppy from a nearby shelter, and needed to set up a dog walker once I went back to work. Their customer service is excellent, very responsive and helpful. As for the walkers themselves, I couldn't have asked for better care for my pup! After each visit they send an email detailing where they walked, how he behaved, if he ate and went to the bathroom, and confirming that he was home safe. All of this gives me peace of mind while I'm at work all day. Aside from that, their website is very easy to use when scheduling visits. I'd highly recommend!

We only came here for drinks and chips and queso. It was the only place we called and found that had frozen margaritas! They were good they have them mixed with sangria which is what we got, and their happy hour deals are $3 and on Saturdays they have happy hour from 11 to 6 which is unheard of for most places which I really appreciated! The customer service was really good! I would recommend going here for drinks. I unfortunately can't say much about the food since we didn't eat here but I smelled and looked delicious when other people were getting

I had a terrible experience here because I was seated at a table by the bar in an area that should not have dining tables (cocktail tables would be okay). Loud revelers were crowding my space with their various body parts, threatening to spill their drinks on my head (one woman spilled her wine but fortunately not on my head), and one even shook her head enough to drop hair on my pizza (disgusting).

The server came to take our order and deliver our drinks and basically never came back. (She probably couldn't push through all those people crowding the table.) I finished my drink and wanted to get another but after 15 minutes she still hadn't returned. When she finally pushed people out of the way and emerged at our table, we asked for the bill. Ten minutes later and no sign of her. Instead, we continued to suffer from people pushing into us along with cackling and shrieking so loud we couldn't hear ourselves speak.

Two stars are for the food: calamari, veal and ricotta meatballs, and Margherita pizza. But it wasn't good enough to entice us to return.
I love this place and go every time I am in the area. The food always tastes so fresh. The food is always hot.  I have never been unhappy every time I've gone.

Be prepared to wait and then be surprised on why you waited.  This place is consistently in the runnings for best burger in the city.  It is a fine burger but not very impressive.  It is big and flame grilled which you can taste.  They cook just as you ask but overall it is just not that exciting.  

A bake potato for a side kinda sucks.  Just make me some french fries like the rest of the country please.  Bake potatoes are not a good standard side and there are no other options which is annoying.  

Staff is nice, atmosphere and location are great.  Burgers are good but not worth the wait or the hype.

*All this being said, sometime you gotta eat at certain places to say that you did.  The reason I went the other day was to take my gf because she had never been.  Now she can say she has been there.  (it is that kinda place in NOLA.  People look at your weird if you say you haven't gone.  But people are stupid (not me).

Oyster selection is awesome, truffle fries are always delicious, Tonight is the all you can eat Crab Legs. It's is a good meal. Let me not forget to mention the very nice and smooth Berry Mule.  Now that completes this meal.

I've only been to the Blind Onion four times but every time I loved it. The atmosphere of the restaurant is great. While you are waiting for your pizza, you and your friends can either choose a game to play or watch the game on TV. The pizza is delicious; I will admit that it is a little pricey, but worth it. They offer honey to dip the crust in, which is a good combo. The chicken alfredo pizza is the best!

Fifth and Fitz is a welcoming, friendly, and gorgeous salon. If anthro designed a hair salon, they would take their cues from F&F. Guaranteed you'll feel welcome the moment you walk in. 
And it doesn't hurt that Ari is a genius with my hair! She does a great job with my cut each time, and goes out of her way to make sure I'm 100% happy at the end. I feel comfortable trying something a little different than my norm, or even just saying "ehh maybe just trim the ends." I always leave with hair that I'm happy with.

Fantastic service! We rented Big Red for 6 hours and had a blast! Bluetooth music through the speakers of the boat, driving through Tampa bay with skyscrapers on each side!!! Private island where you can doc and swim! Such a great day and very conveniently placed near our hotel. 

The gentleman that helped us was super nice and helpful. We did not have any experience with boating and he gave us the run down so we felt prepared and safe!

Wonderful hidden gem! My mom and I are visiting my grandma and needed somewhere with wifi and coffee to get some work done since grandmas isn't much faster than dial up. Day after thanksgiving everywhere else was insanely crowded. This lovely shop not only had wifi, plenty of seating and a lovely ambience but the lattes were delicious, service was friendly and there were scrumptious pastries to go with! I was so happy we found this place and felt sorry for all the suckers waiting in line at Starbucks (not that I have anything against Starbucks). Worth checking this spot out for sure!

So far we've only been there for brunch a few times, but it was AMAZING! Can't wait to try dinner, I've only heard good things. Staff is friendly and nice atmosphere. Only disappointment is no more brunch on Saturdays.

This place is a healthy, creative, and yummy oasis in Reno.

I miss the Pneumatic Diner and many people referred me here to the Deluxe.

Awesome logo, great kombucha choices, and filling food.

I wasn't a fan of the particular musician they had that day so I ate outside. Good choice as it was a nice courtyard with a pleasant breeze!

The food was awesome and exciting. Not your standard casino menu: Asian leaning and locally sourced.

They share space with a few other neat food joints in a gorgeous historic brick building.

Loved it!
Delicious!  Didn't know a place like this existed in Fishers - and I am SO happy that it's here!  Love poke.  I got the ahi spicy tuna in the house mix.

After traveling to countless taco trucks outside all summer, it is refreshing to enter an air conditioned building to eat fish tacos from Mr. Baja Fish. The batter is crunchy, the portions are generous, and the selection of toppings from the salsa bar is nicely-sized. Let's not forget free chips. During one visit, I was excited to order the lengua since I have never tasted it in a taco. However, I was quickly disappointed because it lacked flavor. This resembled my childhood dish of steamed tongue before being dipped in a salty, thick sauce. I often wonder why restaurants won't try marinating and grilling tongue for added flavor, like Japanese gyutan. In the end, the taste of the lengua tacos were easily fixed by a trip to the vibrant salsa bar (see my photo).

I have been hearing good thing about Lupo for a while and finally decided to check it out. 

I shares a wall with the Loving Cup. The wall actually opens, so during the day, you can walk straight from Lupo into The loving cup for a cocktail. 

The original Lupo, which is Wolf In Italian, is in Carson City. The owner expanded to Reno and I am delighted that they did! 

Lupo is the perfect lunch pizza place! You can purchase pizza by the slice or a whole pie. I love the lunch specials. I orders the lunch special for a slice, a drink, and a small salad. It was a healthy serving of food. My husband and I ended up splitting the salad. Everything was made fresh and was absolutely DELICIOUS! 
I love the Detroit style pizza with an extra serving of marinara on top! So flavorful! 

The location has both indoor and outdoor seating. Parking in a small lot along side the building or in California street. 

I will definitely be back for another Detroit style slice!
The food is always great !! We try to eat there once a week . The workers are so nice . I love the homemade soups .
Got a take out order of my favorite Italian Touch salad, which always have fresh ingredients. My favorite hot sub I ordered is Eggplant Parmesan very tasty and toasted just right!!! Get yours today!

Good food , and nice  staff. I use  to eat here alot. Now that the pandemic  is here, I can't.  Hopeful  to be back  soon in the future  when this horrible pandemic  ends.  God bless you Annmarie.  Best wishes.

We started off with the margaritas. Everybody enjoyed them,the big hit was the blueberry ginger margarita. I got the house salad and it was great. One of my party got the short ribs and could not stop raving about how good it was. The chef came out to meet us. New place so not too busy. I will definitely be coming back!

My girlfriends and I went to Philadelphia on a vacation and one of them suggested Hawthornes; I was glad she did! We brought champagne for make-your-own-mimosas and ordered the potato/egg mashup thingy, the french toast special and the eggs/nachos special. It was all amazing. everything was sooooo good and fresh and tasty. I would go back to Philly for Hawthornes alone. Not to mention the atmosphere of the restaurant is great: high ceilings, big windows, a fireplace, etc. great place!
My cashier Jessi was amazing!!! She was so friendly and just as cool as I remember her!!!

Our server Nick was incredible!  We normally only get this type of service at upscale restaurants and it was so nice to have such wonderful service.  He was happy, friendly, quick, personable and made our dinner perfect.  The food was good but it was the service that made it for us.  Thanks Nick!
Tavern has a great food. A little bit pricey, but a nice atmosphere. Good spot for a group of friends to get together and eat, maybe have a celebration.

Solario is another needlessly way overpriced restaurant with a lousy menu at Opryland right next to another way overpriced restaurant with a lousy menu, Ravello.  They must be run by the same awful management.  Ravello used to be Volarie and it was a nice place with a decent menu/prices, no more though once it became Ravello.  We ate at Solario and had just as negative experience as Ravello, first the the shocking needlessly high prices, again nothing upscale about these restaurants or food, food is actually pretty bland and tasteless.  My wife did not want anything spicey so they said they could give her some shrimp that were not spicey, they were not spicey and not very good either and we were shocked when her meal came to $40 with just the bland lousy small amount of shirmp and a drink.  My meal was not good either, no better then what you get at Rosie's or same medium priced Mexican place for $16, except it cost $30 at Soario with no salad or side.  Opryland is nice to visit but their restaurants are way overpriced for very mediocre food and little selection, very disappointing.
Dannye does a super job of cutting hair so I came back for a repeat performance. Plus, you get a discount if you save your receipt which, unbelievably, I actually saved! It's my super day!

So jealous of the SB residents that have spacious TJs in their area. While in Brea/Cerritos I can barely squeeze myself through each aisle.

The positives is that everything was super organized but the layout was  bit different from the other locations. 

Only negative thing is asking a TJ employee where an item was and she was completely oblivious as to where it was. I ended up finding it near the cash register. Womp womp, so I had to crawl my way back into line. 
The parking lot is a bit crowded given its in a small shopping complex but again this TJ is nice and spacious!

I love it here!  So lucky to work so close, by far the best lunch spot!

This place is so good that I am on an every-4-business-days rotation.  I can't even limit it to once a week.

The chicken meatballs are by far the best.  They are even creative enough to create a salad option for the wedding planners like me out there - no idea how many calories are in the caesar salad, add chicken meatballs but I take my chances.

My only complaint is their lack of a punch card - come up w/ something to reward the frequent lunchtime shoppers like me!
Good gluten free options. Friendly and fast service. Hot cocoa and tea prices were a bit too high.
My favorite restaurant! Best garlic naan and vegetarian dishes in town. My favorites are the paneer butter masala, naram garam kofta, onion bhaaji (app.) and Kerala shrimp.
It it 2018 start taking credit cards already. Not everyone carries cash or can use debit all the time. I will not be back to any WinCo until my Amex is acceptable

We were in town on business and seriously overdue for an oil change.  It's bad when your car starts "yelling" at you to get the oil changed!  I was able to get in and out within an hour and the kids area kept the hooligans entertained the entire time.  Great service!

Used to go here years ago for great bbq and sides.  Times have definitely changed.  Went there last night with husband, our daughter and her fiance.  We were considering using their catering service for their barn wedding next fall.  Not so much now.  Ordered 4 different sandwiches and 5 different sides.  Meat was all ok, not spectacular and the plain, white bread buns were very inexpensive and falling into pieces in our hands.  Hot bbq sauce was very mild.
Sides:
mac and cheese:   bland and not very cheesy.  Macaroni noodles were way overcooked and    
                              mushy.  No need to chew.
green beans:  no flavor what so ever, not even salt.  canned green beans are better than these 
                      were.  Needed bacon or pork fat for seasoning and some herbs.  omg. the worst.
slaw:  decent, nice flavor
baked beans:  tasted like they were straight out of can of generic baked beans. bland, bland.
corn bread:  dry, dry, dry.  omg.  I had to take a sip of water to not choke.  It was dry, tasteless, and hard as a rock.  Jiffy corn mix is gourmet compared to this.  I love cornbread, even mediocre corn bread.  I left mine on my plate.

I seriously cannot understand all of the glorious reviews on this bbq place.  The four of us rated it 2,3,3,and 4 out of 10.  We had realistic expectations going in but were sorely disappointed.
I love to cook and would love to make some suggestions to the cook to adjust their seasonings and not keep the food on the warmers so long to avoid overcooking.  It is not hard.  I used to help     cater years ago.  I hope the manager sees this post and talks with their cooks.  I used to love this place.

Love this place staff is incredibly nice and the atmosphere is quiet and relaxing. The owner ms. Sweeta is so freakin awesome. My friend and I always goes there to get our eyebrows done. Definitely recommend going to this place. The precision and attention to detail is what keeps me coming back.

I would recommend that the owner hire and train new/more employees. 

My friend and I had walked in and were immediately seated but the host didn't ask how many people in our group, this was a small detail but we were waiting on one more person so the host didn't have enough silverware, waters, or menus, when he sat us. We had noticed that it was very quiet in the restaurant and only a few other tables were seated. 

We ordered 2 sushi rolls and 3 entrees. After about a 20 minute wait, 1 entree came, 10 mins later one sushi roll, 5 mins later the other 2 entrees and finally the last sushi roll. My friend had to eat his meal by himself basically so it wouldn't be cold by the time our food arrived, and it was very strange that our sushi rolls were almost the last thing to arrive at our table. It would have been much better if the sushi came out first while we were waiting for all our entrees to come. 

The waiter did not know the menu at all and relied on the owner or manager to come answer our questions. He also did not take the correct drink order from me because I specified wine and brand to be specific and the owner had to come back and ask me what I ordered...
