Overall it was a very strange dining experience and I was not impressed with the lack of enthusiasm and knowledge from the waiter.
This is some of the best and most consistently prepared hot chicken in Nashville.  Start a step higher than whatever your usual spice preference is,

Understand self check out if the store is busy.
But why encourage self check out it you have 5-6 associates just standing there " for assistance " while chatting with one another,  while customers ring up their own purchases and pack it up. Scanning is not also friendly since it keeps telling you to ask for assistance . So frustrating.

As the other reviews have said, Dr. Gardner is amazing! I'm new to the city and found him here on yelp and the other reviews were accurate - great dentist! This isn't your usual large dental practice where you see a different dentist, hygienist, etc for each appointment or procedure you have done. He does it all, and does it very well. Highly recommend!!!

This place is awesome Matthew Sewell really runs a tight ship.  I love it here; every time I go through there it's fast friendly and efficient...they have customer service nailed to the wall!



Thanks Matt!
Decent ice cream and custard. Waffle cones are good. Service is awful, my 10 yo said "why was he so rude?" And that was after paying for a $6 small ice cream. Ugh.

I find myself in a quandary. I very much want to praise, rave, and profess my undying love and devotion for this GC staple... Problem is, I can not.

 Over the past few years, for one reason or another, the consistency of the food and service staff has been less than stellar. Nine out of ten times the fried chicken is as good as it always has been for thirty years, but the other menu selections have suffered.
 
 On my most recent visit, (formerly a three time a week patron), I ordered the "Ribeye steak grilled to perfection with garlic butter and crisp onions"... Ok, the soup? ... Awesome. The salad? ... Umm, love the dressing. Steak? .. HORRIBLE.
The steak was so thin it could have been used for a tissue, it was grey in the "middle", (ordered medium rare), and the "crispy onions" didn't seem to be anything but the canned crap you put on green bean casserole. 

 Ravanelli's was a outstanding place to go for a steak for a very long time, but something has happened. The pasta dishes are suffering from inconsistency as well. What was THE place for a good pasta bowl, has become the place for mushy noodles and sauces that seem closer to store made than homemade. 

 This is not the Ravs I know and love. I know they can, (and hopefully will), do better. If they could just get some stability in the kitchen / FoH and drop the frozen junk all would be right in the world again.

I have never been disappointed with my meal or service at Burger Up. The lamb burger is by far the most interesting and delicious burger I have ever had, the truffle fries are incredible, and their Krispy Kreme bread pudding is what dreams are made of. 

There tends to be a long wait, you can avoid it if you go right at 11 when they open.

This is very worth it if you are on a budget and do not want to spend $25 - $80 per person on the paddlewheel steamboats. They run every half hour and each way is a grand price of $2! They depart from the Riverwalk Pier at the end of Canal street across the river to Algiers. It reminded me of the cheap Star Ferry in Hong Kong which plys from Wanchai to Tsim Sha Shui. Great way to get good shots of the New Orleans skyline and the Mississippi river. Bicycle and even car friendly! Prepare to take great photos of the river and the New Orleans skyline!
I ordered here a few times on door dash pick up a few times and in store as well, I've never had any order issues and everything was surprisingly delicious. I recommend the big chicken burrito

I've been here a couple of times and it has a nice feel. The outdoor seating is well done and it's a great place to be on a nice clear night. The other plus is that it also doubles as a hookah bar. Nonetheless I've had much better Middle Eastern food at much better prices so I've discounted the setting and gave it two stars. No matter if the place looks great, the wait staff is courteous and attentive, the fact is I'm still there to eat and if it's not great the rating is going to take a hit. 

On the flip side many friends love the place.

Wonderful for my little boys haircuts! He loves the toys and decor! The owner is wonderful with my son and so friendly. The haircuts always look so great, and its tough to get a 14 month old to sit still! We are here once a month like clockwork. Love it.

I messaged this company as they had great ratings. They responded to my message right away and gave a reasonable price and expected to do the job right away. They came as expected(despite the rain) and did a very nice job and cleaned up afterward. They suggested a few minor repairs but otherwise .... clean job and very easy.  I paid after job completed.
Super patient and friendly staff. I only got a shot of ginger but it was delicious and served with fresh sliced strawberry. I will be back for a smoothie soon.

They have a lot on hand, it's just expensive.  That's more the NFL's fault than the store though.  The one in Lucas is bigger, but this store has a nice location.  They usually don't have much on sale, so check Dick's first.  However if you want a non-star player's jersey (and I'd rather have an Angerer jersey than Manning since everyone has it) then this is where you want to go.  Speaking of go......Go Bears.

Overall, I enjoyed my dinner at Mockingbird! After hearing about it from several friends, I had to try it. The Punch in the bag was pretty good, the seasonal flavor was spiced apricot and I chose bourbon as my spirit. We had mac & cheese for the table as an appetizer and it was delicious. For my entree, I had Three's Company which was their take on meatloaf. It was pretty yummy overall, but for my next visit, I'd try something different. I've had better meatloaf but the atmosphere and their fun menu made it worth the wait.

My partner and I stopped in here for some after dinner drinks and we could not have picked a better spot. The vibe of this bar was so chill and the bar tenders were pure artists - this is not just any run of the mill bar - the create actual ART here. Even though we just got a couple drinks off the happy hour menu they were still very attentive and amazing! I would highly recommend this place to anyone looking to have some chill drinks

Simply Pho is located on the corner of Dale Mabry and Fletcher in a strip mall that houses a lot of other business so there is plenty of parking. If you're in this area, it's a great place to grab some Vietnamese food. I wouldn't say it is ideal for big groups though. We went with a group of 8 and had no issues being seated, but that's probably all they can accommodate since the rest of the seating is made up of small tables and  booths. 

Other than that, the food was really good. I ordered the beef short rib rice platter which came with 3 pieces of short rib. The short rib was marinated well and really tender and the rice and pickled vegetables that came with it accompanied it well. Soo much good flavor! Although I can not speak on their other dishes, I would definitely recommend this place for your Vietnamese cravings.

I have been here at least 20-30 times over the years, mostly with family. All of my experiences have been very average. It is in a fairly quiet spot and is usually not crowded where you have to wait or anything. The menu is not huge, but they have some variety. Service is decent and I often enjoy the brunch options on Sunday. However, I feel like the overall quality has declined somewhat over a period of time. I think the food was a little better back in like 2011-2014 vs. what they offer now. Also, the fries changed and are now dark, shriveled and kinda weird tasting. They used to be more of a regular style. How can a bar restaurant ruin fries? That being said, its the sort of place that you end up going to because its close to home and you know what you're going to get.

Delivery was fast and the food was awesome. Ordered the chicken quesadilla which was perfect and their chicken street tacos were delicious and their chicken burrito was great. Will definitely order again.

Lovin it. Fried green tomatoes were yummy.  Blackened red fish was good. The cornbread thing was crazy good. The spinach salad was very good. The greens were brown but tasty and the cole slaw was so so (Brophy Bros is the gold standard). Planning on coming back tomorrow for more.  And Jon Cleary next door at Maple Leaf   A fantastic NOLA atmosphere.  I 'd say 4 and a half stars really.  It is not the highest level of fine dining (service and atmosphere are 'ordinary') but great great food.

We have been to Lester's a few times and the food is average and the service far less than average.  We will not be going back. Most recently the server had an attitude and I regret not leaving after the first sarcastic comment. This restaurant is far overrated for an average sportsbar with subpar servers and bartenders.

I guess it's just about what you would expect from Pizza Hut.  There's a lot of negative reviews about the delivery service, but I got carry out and it was okay.  It's a small place so I had to be awkwardly close to the people in front of me, but it only lasted for a few minutes.  I think the gentleman waiting in front of me was wearing Old Spice...so that's nice.  The pizza was warm when I got it home.  Which is good considering my girlfriend had me running all over town for God knows what.  I took my first bite and it reminded me of my first time...my first time having stuffed crust.  Do you remember the Dennis Rodman commercial?  They really thought people were going to eat the crust first?!? It sounds like a good idea, but it's not.  Anyways...I ate the whole pizza (save a slice or two) in one sitting.  I completely gorged myself and I liked it.  Will probably go again if my girlfriend doesn't make me go on that diet she's been talking about.  I hate quinoa.

My girlfriend and I visited Chima during restaurant week, but chose to do the regular menu as it restricted some of their best meats.  Small disclaimer, I have been to Fogo De Chao and a very high standard has been set.

Overall, I was very satisfied by my experience here.  The wait staff were prompt in refilling our drinks and taking away dirty plates when needed.  We didn't order any alcoholic beverages, but their wine/cocktail list was pretty extensive, albeit expensive.

On to the nitty gritty...to start with the salad bar.  I went in with low expectations given the quality of Fogo's, but this salad bar is nothing to turn your nose up at.  The mix of cheeses, meats, with their assorted veggies and salads were excellent.  Their balsamic vinaigrette was very good.   An added bonus which I don't believe Fogo has is the sides that are brought to the table including the creamy mashed potatoes (my favorite), fried polenta fries and fried banana.  Their cheesie bread was outstanding.

Now to the meat! The highlight of the eating experience, so they say.  Each meat had its highs and lows.

Pros:
Filet - perfection
Ribeye
Bacon wrapped chicken breast
Salmon
Marinated pork loin

Cons:
Swordfish - overcooked
Lamb chop - lacked flavor
Pork ribs - did not like the marinade it was accompanied with

This is a great option if you are all "Fogo'd out".  The atmosphere is classy, but casual.  No need to get too fancy when eating all that food!  Highly recommend a trip hear to indulge.  

Quick note: Sign up for their newsletter and receive a $20 coupon! Great deall!

Holy Smokes!

I'm no cigar smoker, not really my thing, but Carlos is your man if you need some help finding the perfect gift for that cigar aficionado in your life.  

Given that I was clearly outside my comfort zone, I was very concerned that I'd be routed towards a standard gift box or two as the best option.  I truly wanted something unique and different.  

Enter Carlos, who was incredibly helpful on my quest.  He took the time to educate me on several options unique options to consider in the price range I was looking for.  I very much appreciated his efforts to help and in the end, was able to find a few pieces that I think my giftee will definitely enjoy.

I'd definitely return given my experience.

So thrilled that this gem is in South Tampa.  Right on Bay to Bay.  
My top favorite desserts:  
1.  Dark Chocolate Toffee.  (Free samples!  During the pandemic, just ask and they will provide samples.  They used to be out on the counter.)  
2.  Toffee Cheesecake.  The best ever!  
3.  Chocolate pie.  It's just like Mom used to make.  
Of course their coffee is awesome and goes well with all of these desserts.  It's super easy to pick up.  The employees are quick, provide excellent service, and are super-friendly.  There is good reason Oprah put Toffee to Go on her Christmas wish list a few years back.  My last phone order was for a full Toffee Cheesecake for a friend's birthday.  They placed it in a beautiful box to carry home.  They can write whatever you would like on the top of a full cheesecake.  Happy Birthday ... etc.  Just call ahead for that service.  Awesome place!

I have eaten at the TBBC many times, but this was the first time I've had their Shepherd's Pie. It was probably the BEST I've ever had!! The gravy is made with their Iron Rat Imperial Stout, and it is absolutely delicious!! I enjoyed the pie with a True Blonde Ale.

Food and price was ok for the amount of Diners I've been to for the same food choices. Had the SOS and short stack of pancakes with a side of sausage. Since me and my bf were a little more hungry (we just got done training legs) we were going to order more however our waiter never stopped by again other then giving our food to us for over 15 minutes. Which was irritating because it wasn't that busy (we would of understood that) and I never got a straw to drink my water :(

This review does not in anyway reflect the quality of the doctors at Tri County. Their level of expertise is the best in the area. 

I'm reviewing the staff. Specifically a receptionist that chose to THROW MY SON's INSURANCE CARD AT ME.  
I was having an issue having my son's Chip. (Who doesn't). I made arrangements with the billing department before I came in that the referral would be back dated and the insurance would be reinstated with in couple days. 
This receptionist was completely out of line. She read the notes out loud and it SAID THE REFERRAL WAS BEING BACK DATED. I was leaving a personal check in case it was longer to reinstate then anticipated. 
Not only are we ESTABLISHED PATIENTS, but this woman tore me down from front to back. She took it to a personal level. I was completely cool until she started throwing things at me. I looked directly at my husband and my child whom was playing in the distance. That was it- I've had enough.  I let that woman have my crazy. As well as another woman who wore a black short MOP on her head. 
They escorted us to the back because I am crazy and I don't have my filter on any longer. "Black mop head" was in my personal space. She was so close to myself telling me to calm down. WHT? Who tells an irate crazy woman to calm down. I simply advised her "walk away from me". Well "black mop head" didn't like that answer and chose to talk to me like a child. What she didn't know is that I was holding in my laughter. What an idiot. Cut that shit on your head and someone may take you serious. 

The doctor was amazing as always. We Love her dearly. See her in another office. Unless you have an emergency. Then go to PEARL VISION ON STREET ROAD AND YORK ROAD.  
The new doctor there is amazing. 


I have enclosed a picture of "crazy receptionist."  But you will absolutely know mob head when you see her. She'll be close enough to make out with you when she talks and spits on you.

Craving for chinese food and this was the closest we could find. They offer typical American-chinese fare. 

Food was good, we had ordered the salt and pepper shrimp, Hunan beef and house special tofu. The batter on the salt and pepper shrimp was not crispy when we opened it but still tastes pretty good. Hunan beef was listed as spicy, but it was really just a hint of heat. I love the fried tofu in the house special tofu, definitely will reorder this next time.

If there were no stars allowed, that is what the Geek Squad and Best Buys online "service" would receive.  I have waited over 10 hours on two different days for an installation in my home that still hasn't happened.  Their phone service is the worst, having spent even more time on several calls and was cut off/hung up on three times.  So when no one wants to deal with your issue, they hang up on you.  On the fourth call, I was informed that service was outsourced and they were not able to move to a different outsourced company since the one they turfed us to was unhelpful, unreliable and generally terrible.  Whatever your options are for home installation of anything, use another company other than Best Buy/Geek Squad/Install, Inc.

This place is crap. Bunch a little kids working talking rapping at the window dancing and all the stupid. Sh*t how the hell do you mess up a easy request on a soft taco then give me all hard. Trash! The manager needs to run a better work place instead of a unprofessional work place!
Great salads, sandwiches, and of course the crepes were amazing. Have been here several times and it doesn't disappoint.

To begin...there was a line forming before they even opened the restaurant!  Innovative rolls, great beer and wonderful service, even when it's packed. My son and daughter eat there often because it is consistantly great food, and full of localsl
I was not impresses by this place at all. The pizza was burnt in the bottom and had a rank flavor. The place looked really dirty inside.

Stopped in for the Jazz, a glass of wine, and a quick bite. Wasn't disappointed on any account; great music, seated in an alcove where the volume and privacy were just right. Ordered a glass of Lohr Chardonnay, house salad, and the chargrilled oysters. Everything was great. Oysters not quite as good as Acme, but a close second! Relaxing  atmosphere was awesome. Will be back for evening chill time!

Postscript - ordered the bread pudding for dessert and am in heaven. Will be back for this tidbit if for no other reason. Was told it was an old family recipe; tastes like it, hard to replicate!

Went here for the first time today and was pleasantly surprised.  It was as close to a New York Deli that I have seen in Reno.  We ordered the mile high Pastrami on rye and it was huge, the side dishes also.  Although you have to order at the counter and get your own beverage it was still wonderful and so happy to find a real Deli not just a sub shop.
Only problem we found was that the owner, I think it was the owner, was almost rude when we tried to speak to him.  He could care less about our opinion or compliment.  Being gracious wouldn't have hurt him but we will return again as the food beats the rudeness.  So many things on the menu to try and everything we saw coming by our table looked delicious and fresh.

Love this place, been back many times. Sometimes the food can be a little inconsistent. I always get plantains and they are  a little different each time, always good though. The staff/owners are very friendly and helpful. The food is fresh and flavorful all the time. I'd like to keep it a secret.

Best Thai I've had in a while! The yellow curry is divine, the sushi my wife had was also excellent. Our friends got the red curry, also a winner! We loved it and will be back often. Just don't order the chicken toast appetizer (only thing we thought was mediocre).

In my last review, I was impressed with the flavors and quality of the food, but lamented the fact that the menu was limited. Well, I returned a month later and I am still blown away by Juanita's food, plus the menu was totally revamped since the first time I visited. There are tons of new options now, including burritos.

I ordered the Savor de Mi Tierra, which came with pork and beef, a chalupa, guacamole, and rice. The pork was definitely the better of the two meats but everything on the plate was delicious. Additionally, I ordered dessert (Sango). Three words: deep-fried cheesecake. You should really try it. It's so tasty... And it's fried.

The owner even visited our table and asked how we were doing. He is still working on the take-out menu, but it should only be a few more weeks before the menu is complete.

I choose Panda as a healthy alternative for my family and enjoy the environment usually. This evening, the employees were running around the lobby locking the door on other employees. It reminded me of high school.  I did not find it funny. They were very lackadaisical about taking my order. The portions were very small compared to other Panda Express experiences. I personally spoke to the PIC (sup on duty) and told her I didn't appreciate this attitude in the store. She told me, "fine" and offered no apology.  This surprised me bc I would have at least expected a supervisor to offer an apology and keep everyone at task. When I told her I was going to report this on a review, she responded, "fine."  UNBELIEVABLE!  I have never experienced this kind of rude behavior and careless and inconsiderate attitude at a Panda Express EVER!  I know it may not matter to this company.  But I will not return to this location and will report this Careless Flippancy on any social platform I can. WOW!  Very disappointed with Panda. Obviously they need to teach customer service skills and behavior.
Delicious sandwiches and homemade bread! Will definitely be back! Wish there was more space to eat in house, but that won't stop me from going back.

Coffee is decent! The environment is very "sara barielles" and the noise level is rather high for a cafe. The staff is very nice, but the red headed dreadlocks girl doesn't wash her hands after taking smoke breaks. Seen this multiple times and never cared much until today. My order of food  had a smokers smell to it. Yes it was the plate. Just a bad experience. Last time I'm visiting. ALWAYS WATCH THE WORKERS PREPARE YOUR ORDER!

This place was awesome, a couple days ago I spotted it and could smell the food from outside, decided that I needed to try it and went there today. The Chef, and I'm assuming owner, was super friendly. Honestly said walking out with my to-go order that purely because the customer service was so good I would come back even if the food was just alright. With that being said the food was amazing!!  I ordered the sliders and they were out of this world. For me it was also perfect portioned I was full and still had a handful of fries left. Me and my friend had no problem waiting a little longer for our food since we knew it was all being prepared fresh right then and there, this is why I gave the place 4 and not 5 stars, if the food came out just a bit faster it would definitely been a 5 star review. Definitely recommend checking this place out!

Have visited during the lunch buffet and was not overly impressed.  Went to dinner recently and was pleasantly surprised.  The dinner was so much better.  Probably one of the best Indian meals I have had in Chester County!!!

This is the best of the Ruby's locations in Middle Tennessee. The salad bar is always fresh, and the signature black bread croutons are always cooked perfectly. I usually go with a Prime burger when I dine here; they use quality, prime grade beef and always nail my medium-rare. They get VERY busy for lunch during the week; frequently there are people standing outside when they unlock the doors, so if you need lunch on a weekday, go early or late.

I regularly get waxed every 4-6 weeks and my regular aesthetician told me her salon was discontinuing her services. In need, I decided to go for bust and try a new place. Haley P. is a gem! Super thorough, very pleasant and personable. I explained my concerns regarding my previous experiences and overall skin issues; she listened and explained her entire process prior to and during the service. I will 1000% be a repeat client.

Absolutely stunning location, beautiful live music, fabulous wines, yummy cheese and antipasto boards, and the most gracious host ever.  Kearstie Simmons, the tasting room manager, went out of her way to make this the most delightful and memorable part of my daughter-in-law's bachelorette party.  VIP treatment all the way.  Can't wait to come back again with my husband.
On point coffee and pastries. Great atmosphere and staff was friendly and helpful. Free refills on house coffee till 1 PM. What else can you say. Will be going back real soon.
I got the bacon chicken quesadilla and it was delicious, with a ton of chicken! They have tons of sauces and toppings. Can't wait to bring my family back here for lunch.

Incredibly rude bartenders, eye rolling and all.  They often don't make eye contact.  This place should look for people who are passionate about working downtown Nashville.  Karaoke is fun, but service leaves nothing to be desired.
This place is legit ice cream!!! Recommended to us by a guy in the ice cream business. Best ice cream I've ever had and the employees were very nice.

A group of 8 of us went to Merils last night. We ordered a set of appetizers for the table and everyone ordered their own individual meals. For the appetizers we ordered; Brussels sprouts, cornbread, flatbreads, cauliflower fish dip, and deviled eggs. I enjoyed everything except the cauliflower (but my friends loved it). I also ordered the saffron pappardelle with lamb ragú and the Mexican Street corn. Both dishes were excellent! So food wise Merils is on point. Plus their birthday surprise is really cute. The cons were the appetizers were really small. Besides the flatbread, everything was designed for like two people to share, so for a large group we had to order like 2-3 of everything. And the prices are affordable BUT when you have a large group ordering multiples of everything really  turns a $10 into $30 making it less affordable. So it would be nice if they could have larger options for larger parties with a slightly increased price. As for service....it was okay. Our waiter had a "meh" attitude. It was really busy there so I understand that he couldn't give us all of his energy.

The place is beautiful. They did a great job with the design. It has a full restaurant, cafe area, and a full bar where you can sit and have a drink. They also have a parking area across the street to help with the stress of parking in Fishtown. I usually go in for the pastries and coffee which is awesome.

Driver was 5 to 10 minutes late, which in this business is unacceptable. Then over charged me. 
Never will use it again.

We like all the Clear Sky locations (2 others) in Clearwater, but this one is our new favorite.

The Cleveland location is newly opened in downtown Clearwater.  Parking can be a bit of a hassle - but not as bad as you may think.  As long as nothing big is going on downtown, you should be fine.

The restaurant has two dining rooms that are very different. The front room has the bar and the more swanky seating.  The back "courtyard" is air conditioned but feels like you are eating at a sidewalk cafe somewhere in Europe.  The courtyard is our preference.

The menu is very interesting, and different than any other location.  We have tried a variety of menu items, including the meatballs (forget the name) and the "Not your roommate's ramen."  All of it was excellent, and nicely presented.

If you are looking for a fresh and unique menu in a new place-give Clear Sky on Cleveland a try.  We have already been back a couple times and will be back again soon.
These are the absolute best authentic street tacos around. Super friendly service! Eat in or carry out. Don't forget a STLMADE paleta (popsicle) from the freezer case after you finish your tacos.

What a Special group of people. The doctors are the most knowledgable, caring people. All of the staff is warm, friendly and most helpful. I have taken my dogs there for years and always know I am in the best care!

This place has never let me down in the past. I hadn't eaten here in a long while, but decided to stop for dinner. I ended up the same thing I have always gotten in the past, 2 fish, 1 chicken, add 3 shrimp along with sides. Who can't resist the crunchies they serve..???

Unfortunately, LJS is not the same quality that I remember from years ago. The fish was overcooked and pretty much dry, the chicken was a bit rubbery, I will say that the shrimp wasn't too bad. I had corn and green beans as my sides and they were pretty well seasoned but I could tell that the sizes had gotten smaller.

It was a little late in the evening when I went and I assume that maybe I had gotten the leftovers but, totally unacceptable in my book. Don't anticipate I'll be going back anytime soon.
Overrated restaurant. Food is not bad. Don't ever Order veg biryani. Serving and ambience was good. Tandoori platter has the matter.

I had huge dinner reservations for a group of about 14 people for 7:30 on a Friday night. We called a week in advance and they assured us the table will be ready by then. 

Everyone was there by 7:40. We waited. And waited.. AND WAITED until 8:10, 40 minutes late. I was there at 7:30 and ready to be seated. They kept using the same excuse to me that they were "pushing the tables together. It'll be just one minute!" over and over. The blonde hostess kept making faces at every patron that was coming in and asking for a kid menu OR asking for a booth. And her coworkers cackled with her; I thought this was really lame.

So after we were seated there was not enough bread and it took over 15 minutes to bring us our drinks/bread. Nothing was difficult, mostly water, diet cokes & a pitcher of sangria. The pitcher of sangria was completely filled to the top WITH ICE (!!!) and only 4 small glasses of sangria in between the ice cracks. For $22, I expect a little more sangria and a little less ice. So buyer beware and do not order it.

We didn't get our food until well past nine-thirty. I ordered the tomato soup and it was horrible. It tasted like tomato sauce and there way way too much fresh basil. Fresh basil is potent so the cook should have have put that much in it-- people from across the table could smell the basil soup! Everything was just okay.

I understand that this an okay Italian chain; I'd say one step up from Olive Garden. It seemed like they were trying to make us order drinks at the bar while we waited for our table to be 'pushed together.' It wasn't right that walk-ins were being seated before us when we had reservations.

My girlfriend paid the bill and did speak to the manager. No one was trying to get a free meal. 

They did add a tip on the bill and I don't think anyone added on top of that. I was most upset about that because it was an expensive tab and she did not devote enough time to our table to justify the tip. I'm not saying to be a slave but waiting 20 minutes for refills and over an hour for our dinner? It wasn't busy at all! The waitress was slow and kept walking away without the full order of first our drinks, then our food & later our cocktails! And she spent half the time talking with coworkers in plain view. Urgh.

I usually like Carrabba's but I will avoid this one like the plague.

DIRTY - DIRTY - DIRTY / I've also seen people shopping for lingerie here at 1am ... WITH THEIR YOUNG CHILDREN WITH THEM!!!  

The parking lot is disgusting....used condoms have been found on the lot...NICE....

Avoid if possible.

Always a good place to hit. Super busy and crowded but it's the last Saturday in August so yeah lol. Food was good, our bartender, a white guy in his 30s or 40s was nice , polite and attentive despite the busy atmosphere. He got our drinks and food out ASAP and when we wanted more, he was quick to deliver . $80 for 2 mojitos, 2 Coronas , shrimp fajitas, Spanish fries and buffalo shrimp. Priced fair and absolutely delicious. I started coming here about 10 years ago and have never been dissatisfied or disappointed. Thanks for an awesome Saturday night

Attention to detail is what I noticed most...  The rooms are really clean, the bed was very comfortable, it does not have a traditional feel at all...  The rooms are tastefully designed with a modern feel, Vizio flat screen on the wall, there's a nice sundeck on the second floor.  

Location is good, not great, but good.  We received great recommendations from the owner/host btw...

I would definitely go back.

This review is of the bon appétit restaurant on the water in Dunedin Florida.

 I must say that the atmosphere is one of the best that I've ever encountered as for the brunch menu and unfortunately the grouper sandwich was bland drab and did not have much taste.

the french onion soup was excellent.!

 For the amount of money that you pay for this food there are  a lot better restaurants out there (like cafe Alfresco) which I think is the same ownership.

if you're looking for atmosphere this is the place to go, However if you're looking for tasty yummy food this would not be the place

Great food..authentic.  This place had really good food and service.  I would definitely recommend it especially if you are hungry.  We had veal, gnocchi, chicken, lasagna, Caesar salad, and a few other things all were delicious.

I hired Leah to do my wedding make up and hair.  My maid of honor and I both really enjoyed working with Leah.  She is awesome!! Leah was always very receptive to our questions, comments, and feedback.  On the wedding day, she showed up early and was ready to go.  She was so well prepared, including straws for us to use after the make up was finished so that we wouldn't mess up the lip make up!! She ended up having to stay past the estimated finish time but didn't charge us extra nor make a fuss about it.  The wedding pictures came out beautiful thanks to Leah's master work and the prices were very reasonable compared to other artists in the Santa Barbara area (wedding venue) and Southern California area whom I came across.  Book Leah's services now!!

A group of four of us visited RGE RD recently and were very impressed with their menu and  service!  Top Drawer for sure!  We had the kitchen board selection of meats and breads and the borscht sausage for appetizer. I had the pasture raised beef entree. Super delicious!!  We will go back again.

Excellent crawfish pies! I stumbled across Vivian's booth at the St. Pete Farmer's Market. I was curious to try one of her crawfish pies because they came in a pot pie type size much larger than the traditional meat pie size. It was delicious so I bought a pack of 6 of them for the family.

No meat

3rd review is Geno's.  The highlight here is that I met Joey Vento before he passed away.  Just for that I gave this grease dump an extra star.  I found Geno's less greasy then the previous 2 that I busted but the biggest issue is that there's virtually no meat on the sandwich.  My sandwich was not wet and infested with canned cheese wiz so this was a plus.

I wouldn't really recommend Geno's either but if your looking for a sandwich that won't give you as bad a bout of heartburn as the others try Geno's 

Thanks, RIP Joey Vento

Accompanied by a cold and stale pita, the vegetarian platter was a disappointment.  The baba ghanoush was a worthy side, but the hummus was overwhelmingly sour, the stuffed grape leaves plain and tasteless, and the falafel very dry.  I had heard so much good praise for Bitar's, but left confused and still hungry.

Very disappointed to see that the quality of food and service has declined.  I questioned Villagio putting out this quality of food now and was told that they no longer are partnered with the theatre. Bring them back... Villagio served great food.  Even the kids food was fair at best. Next time, we'd eat first and get drinks and popcorn at the theatre.
They have been so helpful. I had a car problem on a Sunday and they were able to diagnose and fix it immediately. The price seemed reasonable and honest.

I just can't do it anymore.* Despite my love of juice, frozen ethnic meals, cookies, popcorn, and (finally) cheap wine, I can't do it anymore. The parking lot. The oversized cars (unless you live in the country and tow isht on the regular, you don't need a truck; you don't. And if you don't know how to park the s.o.b. in one spot, you certainly don't need one). The unruly children (a marketing campaign for Lord of the Flies, perhaps? Control your bad a$$ kids, people!!). The congestion. The lack of stock. The overall rudeness and lack of common courtesy (you're in a grocery store in a wealthy first-world city; your life can't be that bad. It can't be). Getting my heels banged with carts as patrons race for free samples.

I can't. Not anymore. I'm convinced whoever scouted this location hates people. This has to be a social experiment. Has to be.

*My undying love for TJ juice keeps this review at 3 stars. I know. I'm weak.

Omg... went out for a different restaurant but the wait was forever long so we went walking and came upon this little gem. So glad we did. Everything we tried was amazing. The waitress was beyond helpful and friendly. We will be going back if we are ever in town.

When I moved to West philly, everybody told me to try Mr. Lees breakfast... specifically the egg cheese susage bagel which is amazing. Just enough butter and cooked properly.

Mr Lee touts his spinach chicken cheesesteak as the best in philly and it does not fail to impress. Personally I enjoy the chicken cheesesteak with broccoli instead.

If you want good food at an extremely affordable price come to mr Lees! 

Also try the Hungryman breakfast special. 4 eggs, 2 orders of meat(SUAsage, bacon?) hashbrowns (whcih are DELICIOUS) toast

The food is tasty here but the young man with glasses who works the
counter is soo rude. I have no idea why this guy acts so angry but he should not have a job where he interacts with the public. While his English isn't perfect, he is able to communicate well enough. However, I have seen him deliberately mumble or speak unintelligibly to certain customers and not others. He is the main reason I will not return as there are many others to patronize in the area.
No what me and my company expected, can't believe how many times security turned up and told me I couldn't do something!

My experience with this car rental company was amazing! After dealing with Thrifty Car Service for almost 2 hours in which I had a BAD experience, National was the best! No deposits, no hassles, no hidden charges, very honest and super friendly! The front desk guy was so helpful. The car was pretty much brand new, a Hyundai Sonata, very clean and spacious. Will definitely be coming back to use this car rental service again.

I've been here multiple times now and it's always so delicious. I get the "Squirt burger combo with wings and fries" for $10.95. It's so delicious and filling. I've never had any problems with my food not being tasty or hot. 

The fries by themselves aren't the best thing, but if you're coming here for plain fries, you're missing out.

Also, curly makes everything fresh in house. Which is freakin awesome if you ask me.
Sometimes it takes a bit longer to get your food because of this, but I always find it worth it.
Just order ahead for that reason!

I was in New Orleans for Mardi Gras and stop in at Razzoo Bar & Patio. I had a great time here. It was a lot of fun and a great experience. The people were friendly as they were having a good time. The staff was friendly and did a great job. I was drinking Hurricane that were a great price @ $9.50 each. Next time I'm in New Orleans I will be stopping by again.

first time ordering from here i had thin crust sausage pizza it was really good, definitely will be going back for more.  The staff was amazing really helpful, place is very clean and inviting. not too many people dining in.

I recently received excellent customer service at the KOP location. I needed a custom blind in a short period of time and the male customer service representative was very knowledgeable and efficient. He ensured I double check the measurements before ordering and the blinds fit perfectly. I was happy with the service!
Very good fried chicken this time. Maybe they've improved or maybe I was just lucky today, but it was the best fried chicken I've had in Tucson.  The cole slaw and garlic bread was good too.

When my boyfriend and I were looking to adopt a second cat, we visited ACCT Philly.  They have cats at a few different pet stores, one being at the Petco in Willow Grove, near us.  The cat we adopted was from the Petco location.  He stole our hearts.  The staff working that location (M-F 6p to 8p and S-S 9a to 3p) and the staff at ACCT's main location, impressed us.  The work they do and the people working and volunteering for them, speak volumes of how good of a program they have there.  Our one cat is getting up there in age and when the time comes that we look to adopt again, we won't look anywhere else but ACCT Philly.

Started our anniversary eating here for lunch and they hit it out of the park. Tori was our server and she was fabulous. The decor and vibe was absolutely fantastic. And the food? Topped it all. Oyster BLT, oyster pie, and the shrimp and grits were all amazing and delicious. The flavors of all the dishes were fabulous. You just eat here when you get a chance. You will leave oh so happy...

Let me start by saying the ticket(s) I received were bullshit. I parked in front of MY apartment building but got a ticket for parking by a private driveway (REALLY?) and expired registration (I didnt know it was expired as I jus frickin moved and that kind of mail still goes to my moms house). 
Anyway, my car was towed, I read the reviews on these guys and I was ready to be just as rude and ignorant as I'd read they were especially since it was $775 (yea, u read it right) to get my damn car out. $175 for initial towing and 25.00 a day to store it ( I was on vay-cay lucky me). So, I was already pissed at that AND everybody in Philly (re: public transportation) decided to be attitudinal assholes today, I was NOT in the mood to deal with the towing guys rudeness. Surprisingly, the guy that handled mine was coolly indifferent (re: he didnt give a shit one way or the other) I did almost get away with only paying 205 for my car because he gave me the wrong paperwork, but not thinking, I corrected him and he gave me the right paperwork and I paid full price. It was an okay experience. Not too bad but not good (I mean hey, my car was impounded for $775 nothing would make that good). 

The neighborhood was not the best, but its a tow yard, I dont expect it to be great. The bus (after another bus and a train) took me pretty much right there in front of it, but it is easy to miss on the bus or if you're driving there.

Lissette has done an incredible job on my eyebrows.
I have had my brows microbladed before and was happy to see that she made them look even better! I was extremely happy with the results.
Healing time was a week. I did not scab at all. 
If you want to have natural beautiful brows! Get them done with Lissette

So I fried my hair off right before my 30th birthday and I was freaking out! Rae saved my hair and gave me a gorgeous blue using different blues! I was so grateful for her and her amazing skills! Pure art! She's also so sweet and kind and didn't make fun of me at all (I was definitely nervous for that!) and we had great conversation and some good laughs! I highly recommend her! She also made my hair so soft! You could never tell I had bleached it 3 times prior!

Man the section with the subwoofers is great. The employee there had all of them hooked up and ready to go switching from one to another in a split second for comparison. That's how it should be! He even went down $200 on a sub that I couldn't find cheaper anywhere else. I would've bought it but he went away to help other customers and it got very busy very fast but I will be back to spend some money. Thanks for the help guys at Sam Ash!

Good place to get your fix for some good beer, on draft and bottled.  You can buy beer to go in bottles as well and you get a discount for taking it with you.  

The actual space looks like your typical chain, so -.5 stars for that (I would prefer a more unique atmosphere) and another -.5 stars for the lack of food options, you can bring your own food or order from Moe's or Pizza Suprema II and they will deliver to you.  I would prefer some sort of bar bites, but I realize that would require more work on their end and obviously they aren't into that.

Literally the worst experience ever here! then I went to a Panera in Zephrahills and had one that i called into corporate!
Ordered a pick 2 and the sandwich 1/2 was smaller than the apple they gave me!
Not to mention the manager ARGUED that it was the right size! 
I wanted to slap him! 
Now I have free food coming from panera and he is getting yelled at lol

Finally decided to pull the trigger and bring my whole family to Florida for a vacation. First night here stopped in to Snapper's because of all the great reviews I had heard. Oh boy were they wrong. Got there and was greeted by the hostess, who was nothing but dismissive and rude to my family the whole night. After waiting about an hour with my family (when the wait was supposed to be 30 minutes) we were brought inside. Let me also mention that they had us waiting in their waiting area, the parking lot, which was no place for our young children and senior citizens that we had with us. Inside is where we found that they split up our party of 10 into two different tables. Although told we would all be sitting together we sat at our two tables that were very far from each other. Since we had all our kids with us, ranging from ages 10- 13, we assumed they would be able to order off the kids menu because the adult menu had expensive seafood that our children would not eat. When the waiter came over to the table he placed nothing but adult menus in front of them, since the kids menu age maximum was 11. We thought this was simply a mistake and walked over to the hostess to ask for kids menus for the children. The hostess told us that our children were too old because the age limit was 10 (which was different from the age we were previously told) so they would have to order off the adult menu. Not only did she say to us as if we were stupid but she said this to us as if she had to time for us, and as someone who had worked as a hostess for 12 years this is the absolute last impression you want to give to a customer. After already waiting an hour I was already quite annoyed with the service, so I expressed to the hostess that I was upset and asked to speak to her manager to see if there was something we could work out. The manager, Dara, was just as (if not more) rude and disrespectful to my family. She that ordering from the kids menu was not an option, even after I had explained I would pay the same amount as the adult menu. She continued to argue with me and spoke in a derogatory and condescending way. I finally decided to walk out after having this discussion for another 20 minutes. Thankfully we found a nice restaurant down the block (that had a kids menu who's age limit was 9 but let all the kids order from it with no problem) and ate there. 
I will never be going back to Snapper's. If I could rate it 0 stars I would. The staff was patronizing and down right mean. If you are heading down to St. Pete's I would suggest heading to any of the other lovely restaurants that this beautiful town has to offer.

OMG ... DISGUSTING!! Someone call the health department. We went four of us a month ago. You walk in to burnt ass smell... feet sticking to the floor...crumbs and food everywhere. So we ordered...8!!!! Different items "sorry were out???"
No BBQ.. no wings... no pretzels... we left.
So we gave it another try... BAD IDEA. Two of us got the trots!!! The Mac n Cheese came out smelling burnt... it was inedible. The pork chop was greasy in a canned cafeteria gravy. Salty inedible! This placed should be condemned!!! Dessert we tried the so call banana fosters pudding??? Trailer trash canned garbage! Over priced...dirty... finished with diarrhea!! Great for local drunks... buyer beware.
Delicious food!  Really good service!  Have avoided this spot because of a so-so YELP! rating...wish I'd come sooner.  Great meal!

It's really easy to overlook this quaint little Thai restaurant just off Jasper Ave if you're not actively seeking it out. I first discovered this gem during a work lunch, and came back for more with my fiance for dinner.

The service has been excellent both times I've been here so far; they answer any questions you have about anything on the menu, they're quick, and they make sure you're happy with everything.

The coconut rice is delicious, light and sweet (but not too sweet) as it should be, and the garlic squid is definitely a dish to try! It's a delicate blend of sweet and salty, but veering more to the sweeter side. The pad thai is pretty much your standard pad thai, nothing different about it, but it's still done pretty well. The cashew chicken is another dish to try (my mouth is watering just thinking about it)!

The only quibble I have is with my order of glass noodles with chicken. I expected glass noodles, i.e. a dish consisting mainly of noodles, like the pad thai, but what I got was more like a chicken stir fry with maybe a spoonful of glass noodles thrown in. Maybe they were low on noodles and I was the lucky customer to savour the last remnants of their noodle stash ...? Probably not. I was disappointed with the noodles, but hey, it's not going to deter me from returning here. I just won't order the same dish!

Overall, a wonderful and yummy little Thai restaurant with friendly service. The exotic decor throughout the place also makes for a cozy ambiance too!

I went in a week ago to look at a Jeep Grand Cherokee and worked with a salesman named Norm. He was very responsive and took his time going through all the features with me and then more time picking out the right one for me from their inventory. My girlfriend liked the Jeeps so much she ended up deciding to get a new Cherokee that day as well! We had the normal haggling that one would expect but it was short lived and we both got what we believe to be a good deal (I had done a lot of price research prior). 
My finance guy, Ryan, was proactive and fair (although we were not a fan of the woman my girlfriend had and ended up just having Ryan do both deals). 
Our only real criticism, which seems to be a common theme on here, is that the service department needs to be better organized. Rob, in parts was great, but as part of my girlfriend's deal she needed to have something installed to her car and when we called and made our appointment to come in on Saturday after telling them why we were coming in, never were we told that what we needed to have added couldn't be done on the weekend. This was an early morning annoyance; however, when we told Norm about this, without hesitation he promised to make it right. 
Overall, we love our Jeeps (they were well tested in this week's snow) and had a good experience (assuming service get their act together when we go back again next week for the install).

Great Thai in unexpected location (metairie strip mall). We had yellow curry and glass noodles and both were great.  Asked for spicy and was right on the money.  Also were sensitive to us being vegetarians which was a bonus.

To busy that you don't even have time to chew ? Get a juice that will fulfill your needs, keep you full and maintain that hourglass figure.
I got their CinCity which is a delicious juice, naturally sweet and healthy.
Honestly, anything that has spinach banana and milk is a win in my book. Add some honey, cinnamon and PEP, you are golden. I think this drink was the only reason why I didn't pass out on my 6 mile run post a long day of work. Thank you Animo!

Love the bachata music and diverse employees. Makes me feel at home while also enjoying delicious vegan food. The prices are pretty cheap compared to other vegan places nearby. 

P.S their creamy vegan dip is spicy but nutty. Must try!
Drinks are excellent. But where is the chicken?! I don't understand why we can't have a single chicken breast item on the menu?

The BEST kielbasa in Philly...I drive from Northeast Philly to come here every Easter ....I married a pol so it's part of our Easter dinner...man great stuff ..all fresh...get there early like 7:30 to get in line or you'll be in line for hours...Also great babka breads...it's worth the trip!

It is a Saladworks and there is not much to say as far as the food quality and menu items.  After all there is a standard menu and standard ingredients.  The ingredients are fresh and tasty.  I am a fan of the green goddess dressing.

The thing that I find problematic about the saladworks dishes are that they do go a bit heavy on the dressing.  You can always ask for less dressing or have it on the side.

The staff is fast and courteous and the eating are is large and clean.

The problem with this location is the strip mall itself.  It is a bit inconvenient sometimes as there are 2 entrances but only 1 exit.  The exit goes to the divided highway so you are stuck traveling in a particular direction and have to pull a U turn to get back.
excellent service & tasty meat!! :) Definitely an on-point KBBQ... far from the reaches of K-Town. Love that they have handy guides printed for any noobs. ;)

Wow, service to the next level. Ask for Olaf, we had a birthday at our table and he has a surprise post dinner for the celebrant. We actually had a vegan with us, they went out and purchased a vegan protein to make sure that the four us enjoyed the same Prime 47 Carmel experience. 

Thank you Olaf and team for a great dining and service experience, birthday celebration for my son was over the top. Go see Olaf and you'll know what I mean. 
Joe Fazzini

Searching for a natural smoothie, Yelp led me to this quaint place.  Very laid back & comfortable atmosphere.  The owner was extremely friendly & helped me select the right smoothie for my needs.  Absolutely delicious!  Other patrons were very friendly.  What a pleasant stop.  Can't wait to return & enjoy an entire lunch.
Been here 40 minutes and still waiting for food. Food finally came out and it was not worth the wait. At least the server let us know the fruit was canned before we ordered it.

We stopped by for some food and drinks on a Thursday night. I was pleasantly surprised by the ambiance through this bar. Downstairs they have some booths and a full bar, upstairs they have a bunch of booths (some more private than others) and tables. Food was delicious; everything is tappas style and made to share. We ordered fries, hummus, and a chopped steak plate. I'm happy to report that everything tasted high quality and delicious. Customer service were great too, but it got pretty busy around 10:30p and the bartender was the only one making drinks and taking orders. We didn't necessarily feel neglected, but we did have to flag him down a few times. This place brings in a colorful, young crowd and it gets pretty loud downstairs. I would definitely recommend Nectar to others; it's a nice small place to unwind and enjoy quality food.

I can't begin to imagine how many jewelry stores are in this city, but I always go to Gemoro as they've been around forever and service has always been great. I have two necklaces that my SO purchased from Gemoro, and I've purchased a chain for him as well. We've been in there together in just normal street clothes and never felt judged as some people claim. A sales associate even let us dream with the Seamasters. 

They are also quite accommodating as I purchased a chain more than two weeks before I was gifting it, so they wrote on the receipt that I could have extra time to exchange it. I appreciated that, because you just never know if it will need to be exchanged due to preference (it didn't).

Exceptional food. Sometimes you go to an Italian restaurant and all of the spices and sauces blend into the same taste. Not here! Every dish is uniquely seasoned, so fresh, and beautifully presented. Can't go wrong with handmade pasta (sweet corn agnolotti) or crudos. The summer Frozen Pompelo (gin, aperol, grapefruit, and lemon) is as satisfying and dangerous as a Slurpee.
tasty dirty chai latte for the folks out here who like foofy morning cup.

The service was good with a friendly hostess and really nice server. The atmosphere was trendy and probably good for dinner or drink meet ups. 

Beyond that, the food killed it for me. There was no heat in the salsa. It was like watered down tomato paste. The tomatillo sauce was a little better though. My chili relleno with beans and rice was bland bland bland. I think they were going for non-greasy, but the total effect just didn't do it for me. I really wanted some full Mexican flavors today, but this spot wasn't it.
Great food, but a little cramped. Also if the water is gonna be left on the table could use ice in it.
MY #1 PLACE. Parc, I love you. I've had many dates here and it's my favorite in Philadelphia. Every time I dine here I spend way too much money but never regret it.

It is with great sadness that I write my review.  I have been coming here for about three years.  I was fairly regular for a while and then took a break for about a year and then returned.

To begin, like my 5-star ratings, I take my 1-star ratings very seriously and unfortunately this is my second one of the day.

The last few months, service and quality has declined immensely.  On one occasion two months ago, I asked if the nail tech could do special nail art for Autism Awareness.  I gave her four choices and rather than tell me she could not, she chose one design and got to work.  She rushed through my fill, making the nails uneven with one set of nails longer than the other hand.  She started the designs and I didn't want to be rude so I let it go.  After staring at them overnight, I was so embarrassed that I went back the next day, paid an additional $10 to have them remove the design and repaint the nails.

My husband's pedicures declined as well.  On more than one occasion, he asked them to take care on an ingrown toenail. One was done so horribly that he had to wait an extra three months for it to heal properly.  He nearly had to go to the doctor to have it surgically fixed.

When we finally went back, primarily due to the fact we have limited options in the North Valleys, I flat out asked if they had time for my fill and husband's pedicure.  If she had said they were booked, we would have just gone to run errands and went back later.  We did not have appointments after all.  However, one of the techs stated "15 minutes."  Stupidly we waited, knowing it is their standard response EVERY TIME.  After 20 minutes, we got up to leave and by some miracle, a spot opened up. I informed them we were tired of waiting and we were done.  Between the substandard work and consistent over-promising and under-delivering, I'm glad to drive extra to find a salon that will give me what I pay for...and not constantly trying to upsell me on services when they are incapable of handling the services we paid for.

A bit of a back story: I am in my mid 20s and my skin is changing. I used to be able to put whatever on my skin and, miraculously, my skin would take it. This has always been especially nice since I get bored with beauty products and like to switch around, just for funsies. Well, not anymore. Recently I bought a new moisturizer and cleansing wipes and my skin just FREAKED OUT. I broke out like I hadn't in years! I felt like I was in middle school again. I had been thinking of getting a facial and after this lovely incident, I decided to go for it and booked an appointment at Mia Bella. 

The facial is wonderful. I won't bore you with the facial components since they are all pretty much the same across the board. They appear to customize the facials, though, according to what your skin needs. I, for example, needed extractions so I got extractions. Un-fun but necessary.

After my facial and thanks to Jewel's genius skin recommendations, my skin is finally clearing up again. Not only that, but I had been noticing my skin getting a different and rough texture on my forehead which is, thank god, gone now post-facial. Mia Bella: Strongly recommended. 

New clients get $25 off various services (including facials) with a Yelp check-in.

I've been raving about this place, non-stop! Best pedi I've had in, I think, ever. 
It was Sunday evening, and I was looking for a spot to get my toes done. Most places were already closed, or close to closing, when I stumbled upon this gem on Yelp. Open till 8pm on Sunday!

This cute little place is in a shopping center by Edmondson and Old Hickory, but when I walked in, I forgot all about that. The first thing I notice is their bar. The nice guy at the counter explained the menu, and also about the bar situation. How cool?! I opted for the pedicure that included a sugar scrub (several options), extra massage with hot stones, and a COCKTAIL! I ordered a mai tai from the drink menu, and sipped happily while having my feet pampered. 

I can't forget to mention that they play music videos, too.

Do yourself a favor and check this place out, I am looking forward to going back again soon.

I've been hearing about this place for a while and had to check it out.

The place is located in Carrollwood next to a YouFit, I arrived around 6:30pm and the parking lot was packed, probably due to the gym next door.  Once inside, the restaurant is laid out cafeteria style, which wasn't what I was expecting but the idea was neat.  To order you would stand in line, tell the servers what type of meat/meal you want, then select the sides that comes with the order.  All food is served on a tray with a liner on it.  When receiving the food since the tray was so big, made the portions look a lot smaller than they were.

I got the burnt-end dinner which came with three sides.  Never had this type of meal before and wanted to try something different.  The three sides I orders were the southwestern corn, cornbread salad, and jalapeno poppers.  The southwester corn was delicious with good amount of seasoning added to it, probably seasoned with a bit of cumin, salt, pepper, and butter.  The jalapeno poppers are roasted jalapeno stuffed with cream cheese and wrapped with bacon, this was tasty but they only serve you two.  I ordered the cornbread salad because I have never heard of it before so decided to try it out. Tasted like a typical salad with a bit of sweetness added to it due to the crumbled up cornbread.  The burnt-ends is definitely different and probably something you should at least try once!  Definitely a different taste, it had a fluffy texture and tasted kind of like dried out pork.

Overall the experience is nice and will come back again.  I enjoyed how easy it was to order and good selection of sides.

Please don't order from here. Worst and most expensive Thai food I've ever had and I've tried several Thai food restaurants. Ordered pad Thai, pad kee mao and crab rangoons. Best part was the rangoons which are hard to mess up. Noodles were super dry and bland. Chicken was dry as well and everything lacked sauce and seasoning. Again, please don't order from here. Id rather order a Big Mac than try this again.

The main location for this local confectioner. I entered mainly because of the unseemly chill that swept over the city, but was quite happy to gaze at their many chocolates, pastries, and ice creams before settling on what I think was their last package of dark chocolate caramel cookies. I think I picked right. Then again, I'm not sure if I could have picked wrong.

It isn't quite as impressive looking of a space as the French Quarter store they have, but it's a worthy indulgence in a city built on decadent pleasures.
Huge juicy burgers are the specialty here. Just as good as port of call without the wait. Highly recommended. I had the bacon cheeseburger with the mac and cheese side.

This was the worst experience ever! The food was atrocious, I ordered a Long Island ice tea and all it was, was mixer. The service was extremely slow. This was my first and LAST time coming here, NEVER again!

Had a pedicure done here twice - I like that they do a good job and are sensitive to the fact I have ticklish feet. 

I got a French gel manicure done - it was beautiful however it chipped within a few days - which shouldn't happen for at least a few weeks - they repaired the polish chip quickly and efficiently free of charge.

Came to Jefferson internal medicine for a long overdue physical. I'm so glad one of my coworker recommended this practice. The front desk ladies and the medical assistant were kind. Check in was smooth and quick. I wasn't waiting in the waiting area forever which unfortunately is the case in a lot of other practices. 

My doctor addressed all of my concerns even though they were minor. He was very personal and thorough with my physical exam. I had some rudimentary questions and he was very patient to answer them all. 

Love this practice!

This sweet tomato is an okay option for lunch. The salad bar has a nice variety and the vegetables are usually fresh and tasty. It's a good choice if you're craving a make-your-own salad.

So why only a 3? I've yet to find one of their pre-made salads that tastes good. Their soups and bread are mediocre, and unless you plan on eating your weight in lettuce, it's overpriced.

Oh wow!  Came for the beef, but the "try our new jerk chicken sandwich" caught my eye.  Boy am I glad I took the chance.  Fabulously seasoned, yet much juicy chicken breasts have made my day a little better.  Now I'm gonna have a tough decision when I come here...

My third time went there..
I'm 100% satisfaction their customers service...
Mrs. Whitey is wonderful customer service that help me out what I was looking for eyeglasses to buy it..
However the transition lense issues is no good because when I go out and drive the car the sun is bothering my eye..
So I had to use my polarized sunglasses..
I will keep coming back in the future whenever I need eyeglasses..

Ordered and food came cold. Didn't have the gelato, but didn't call me to let me know. The lettuce was brown and wilted. I asked for no bacon and to substitute fried onions, because I don't eat bacon and they didn't. I also asked for cheddar instead of monetary Jack. I'm assuming they don't see special instructions when you order from grub hub. I ended up taking everything off and just eating the burger. I'm extremely disappointed. The only good thing about the meal was the beerbattered fries. Extremely disappointed. Tried calling twice and got hung up on.

Love this tiny little place. Interior and exterior design makes it a nice and comfortable place to eat.

The food is great and very healthy. I don't feel bad after eating here. 

Free parking right outside in the back.

5 stars yes. Not fancy inside but the owners are fancy. When I first walked in I wasn't sure if I was in the right place that people left all these great reviews. Yelp is what brought us here btw. Roberto and his wife are excellent. Chips, queso, guacamole, delicious. My burrito... I had the 3 compadres. Huge. Tasted great. It was actually the best burrito I've ever had. They gave me a spicier sauce which had a nice zip but not too hot. Everything was perfect. I had no problem leaving a 20% tip. They deserved 25%. I'll be back. Thanks again Roberto.

Amazing experience - fantastic staff recommended cocktails and appetizers - both were incredible.  Squid Ink Pasta dish was delicious.  I never eat my entire meal and finished this....it was that good.  Dessert didn't disappoint.  Our server, Chris, was excellent.  And new Manager, Carmen, made sure our experience was top notch.  We will definitely be returning.

If you're considering staying here, READ THIS. WORST EXPERIENCE EVER. I stayed here for 5 days until I decided to road trip a bit. I drove to North Carolina by I didn't pack my stuff because I decided I didn't need to carry so much. I called at 9 am everyday telling them to charge my card because I was out of state. They charged me $100 for Saturday, $75 for Sunday and $55 for Monday. I was ok with that. I explicitly told them to charge it because I won't be there but I wanted my things to be secure in the room. I came back Monday night and told them I'll be leaving Tuesday morning. I went into my room and there were people in there having sex. It WAS EMBARRASSING for both myself and the couple. I ran out and talked the front desk asking where my stuff was. They had it in a dirty closet filled with bleach and nails on the ground. I looked at my stuff and MANY things were missing. The french chocolate my boyfriend gave me was missing. The flowers thrown away. My Georgia thermos cup gone. I didn't care about that if they acknowledged their mistake. I asked for a refund and didn't get anything. They REFUSED to apologize for anything. I wouldn't care about what they had done if they ONLY apologized but they kept arguing over and over and said they had to check the security cameras to see what happened.!! I was sooo frustrated. I had to wait in the cold until I was sick of begging them for my money back. I HAVE NEVER EXPERIENCED SUCH A LACK OF PROFESSIONALISM in my life. DO. NOT. STAY. HERE.
I saw my chocolates on the table of the front desk where an employee was eating them and when I confronted them about these chocolates FROM FRANCE, which would be hard to get unless you've gone to France or ordered online and the manager told me "you think you're the only one that can buy those chocolates?" 

I shut my mouth and left because I couldn't take their ignorance

Here is the picture where my stuff was thrown.

In a mad frenzy to get food before the arrival of the inlaws, Erika K and I ordered Pointer's. We ordered a pizza and wings. The wings seemed to be highly praised on yelp so I was fairly excited. They turned out to be a fatty, flubbery, separated sauced disaster. They had no crunch and were made from what seemed like frozen low quality chicken. The sauce was decent but separated and oily. I pity the fool who,thinks these are good.

The pizza was average. I enjoyed the crispy crust and sauce, but in the end it seemed like just the standard pie. Nothing really stood out or distinguished it as a Pointer's Pizza versus the rest of the other so so pizza shops in the universe.

In conclusion, Pointer's is just average pizza with below average wings. A cheap stop for quick but mediocre grub.

Not planning on returning. Odd menu and space. Was going to stay for more food, but decided against it because of the cold service and weird house made jerky. There are too many good places in the area and this place is one of the least impressive of the bunch in my short visit.

They have the best roast beef I have ever had. I have been going for years. I am a creature of habit and I always get the roast beef. They put plenty roast beef on the sandwich and the right amount of dressing like you want. You will always make the right choice if you order the roast beef.  I heard the seafood is great. I did get the soft shell crab once and it was awesome!  Also GREAT  service. You get your sandwich quickly if not fried.   Fried you have to wait a little longer.

Love this park! It is our first time and is so big I didn't get a chance to even see half of it!! I brought my kiddos here (2 and 1) and I'm so glad I did! There's like 4 or 5 playground/ activity areas! They loved it and did not get bored. They were so happy jumping from playground to playground. It looks like the playground areas are updated and newer which was nice! They also have a piano that kids can interact and jump on and it makes noise!! There were many people walking on the trail (which I would've loved to do but I left my kids stroller wahhhhhh). Love the shade all the trees provide, and it's also great scenery. There are many pavilions (that can be reserved) and lots of benches CLOSE to the playground so you can actually sit and keep a close eye on your kiddos! I also saw a dog park/area and looked great. I called before coming because I thought there would be an entrance fee from all the different activities I saw but it is F R E E!!!! You can def make this place an all day affair with some family and friends and your fur babies! The park is very clean and taken care of! I'm not from the Tampa area, I'm just here for a couple of days and we've tried a couple of different parks in the area but this one blows every other one out of the water! If you haven't been I recommend you stop by!

This was our favorite dinner place while here for 4 days.  REally good seafood.  Casual but nicer than some others around this area.  Scallops were awesome.  My mahi tacos were also excellent.  Very good service.

We've gotten take out twice, once the red curry and then the panang curry. The first was great the second was not our favorite. The portions are a good size for one person with some rice but definitely a little pricey.

When you first enter, the decor reminded me immediately of my Polish relatives. Very quirky and tacky in a sense. The menu is rotating and was very diverse, they seem to like to experiment with a variety of flavors. It was very reminiscent of Milktooth, the same kind of ambiance and food menu. I got the chicken and waffles and the chicken tasted like it had been cooked in an old oil. The flavor pallet was interesting, however I feel unimpressed. This is more of a place for people who like very unique combinations.

Very disappointed. I went there today to get a basic pedicure. I did not have an appointment. When I entered I asked if they took walk-ins and they said yes but it was not a warm greeting. They close at 6:00 on Saturdays, I arrived at 4:20. She said pick a color after I used the hand sanitizer and a guy took my temperature. As I was picking my color the guy just stood there watching me so I asked him if he needed anything from me and he said no then walked away. The technician was not friendly or engaging, she just stated and was rushing even though like I said they didn't close until 6:00. I will say the only part I enjoyed was the foot massage. When it was time to pay I was shocked that he said $34? I mean for a basic pedicure? I certainly won't ever go back!

I ordered a tomato pie and chicken nuggets and here's what I got (see pics)

Hoopty's sucks!

UPDATE: This was the 2ND TIME that I placed an order at Hoopty's and therefore doubly disappointed. When I had complained the 1ST TIME I received the promise from the manager that it wouldn't happen again. A week later the same subpar food was delivered- and LATE by almost an hour. There's no excuse for this and too many other options in this area for me to move on with. As for the employees that the manager claims are hurt by this review, perhaps he should reflect first how browbeaten the gal is who takes the orders. LOL

Deeply offensive wait staff.  While waiting to order today, one of the cashiers very nicely said that it will be another 10-15 mins before the kitchen will be ready for lunch.  I simply said "Oh!  I thought lynch started at 11:30."  The cashier looked at me said " Oh Jesus Christ" and started mumbling profanity!  so offensive, unnecessary and completely uncalled for.

This place is amazing. The owner is extremely nice and accommodating. The tenders are seasoned amazingly. I wish they were just a little bigger but I think with the current chicken shortage that's the reason. They're just delicious. The wings and churros are amazing too!!! Definitely try this place! I know I'll be back!

We love going to J. Alex but today was a big zero.   The food was excellent as usual but the service ruined our dining experience.  We arrived at 2pm for a late lunch.  Only about 6 tables were occupied, as we expected at that time.  There were an abundance of servers.  Our server, Andrew, was terrible.  He lacked any kind of personality, took off before we were even finished ordering and was never seen after other servers brought our appetizer and entrees.  We had to ask other passing servers for drink refills as he was nearby but we couldn't get his attention as he was sitting in a booth near the kitchen. Andrew brought out dessert to share but placed it on our table and left without removing our entree plates.  We picked them up and put them on the table next to us to get them off the table.  Thankfully, Sharon saw us trying to get his attention several times and came to check on us.  We mentioned our disappointment to the manager on our way out.  She defended Andrew, saying they work as a team and it wasn't his fault.  She spoke as if it was our fault and his team's fault that he was a subpar server.  I don't mind spending $100 for a lunch for two people but it was a surprise that the manager was so rude. We will return as J Alexander's is one of our favorite restaurants but will make sure Andrew is not our server.
Food is really good & service was fast, staff was friendly. I will definitely be going back to try more things on the menu.

Best Subway I ever been in and I visit a lot of them all over the USA. Very clean. Employees extremely courteous and helpful. Food was standard for a Subway but the nice employees warranted doing a review.

This was the very first place we ate when we arrived in July 2017 . I had reported for duty at Scott AFB. It was our first Saturday in a new house, we hadn't really stocked the fridge yet.  This little gem was close...that was all we knew.  Over the years  Main Street became "church"...nearly every Sunday we ate breakfast there (actually only meal we have ever had there...became weird goal to only ever have breakfast).  Anyway, over the past few years it was our comfort, something to look forward to.  

Then comes Covid-19. They closed, like everyone, for a while.  Then there were fits and starts, we missed it, in that time we changed our ways, lost a combined 100 lbs. 

We are getting ready to leave this wonderful little town and head back to the crowded, frantic, rat race of Maryland. There are no Main Street Cafes (that I am aware of), only chain "diners". Maybe we will make it a mission to find one.

So this morning we did carry-out (only option) for the first time. Every bite was coming home, every taste exactly like July 2017, even out of a styrofoam box. My favorite employee was still there, first bright smile that ever took care of us there.  We are all 3 years older, the smile is still heartwarming.

I type with a tear forming in my eye. We will miss Main Street Cafe. It doesn't have to be perfect, no business ever is. It was perfect for us and that is all that matters.
Love this place! Great bartenders, bouncers, door women! :)

I cannot say enough good things about Dr. Haley and his staff.  Had to come for extraction of two back molars last week with a bone graft.  Elizabeth, his assistant, is like his secret agent, taking every word, every concern that you may have to him and every single thing is addressed.
