I had a second dental policy that was going to expire at the end of June and they fit me in, working through their lunch hour to do it.  I just referred a co-worker today who had dental work done somewhere else (and not correctly) to Dr. Haley and hope that he does go - he will not be disappointed!  When it comes time to consider an implant, you better believe this is where I will come.  EXCELLENT in every way!

Where else could you find cookies this late that also delivers? The employees were super friendly and their strawberry cheesecake ice cream actually tasted like strawberry cheesecake. 10/10 will come again if I'm ever in town

This is the 2nd time I've been here to get my nails done and I love it. The last place I went to get my nails done at made me wait over 30 mins even though I had an appt and then my gel polish looked terrible because it didn't cure properly, so I decided to try here again. I work downtown so it's an easy walk up the street but I decided to come in on a Saturday since my nails looked so bad. It was super busy, there was a bridal party in the shop, and they got me in within 30 mins of me calling. I felt terrible because I was late due to the parking issue downtown on a weekend, but they were very friendly and accommodating. Nhi Le did my nails. She was so friendly, and did a fantastic job! Also, their pricing is better than any spot I've been to lately. I will definitely be going back!

We hopped in on a whim on a Saturday night right before closing. What a treat! We found that donuts are buy 1, get 1 free which is awesome. We also enjoyed great, kind service which is impressive since we walked in literally 5min to closing. We chose our good quickly but we were impressed by their patience. Darling place, amazing treat options. Loved very bite!
My favorite restaurant of all time.  All the food is excellent.  The service is excellent.  The vegan steak burrito and ultimate veggie salads are the best.

Generally a fan of this place but recently the burgers seem bland and smaller then they used to. Got a turkey burger which generally they have the best but mine was bland and mushy. The Nutella shake is fantastic though. Here's hoping last night was a blip and they go back to being great.

The most fresh donuts in the world! This bakery has amazing staff, never have to wait in a line for long, and the most tasty donuts. Just writing this review makes my mouth water! This is a MUST try place!

This review is for their in-office services during COVID. My husband had me deposit a check for his business at this branch. I arrived mid-morning, and there was one customer being helped ahead of me. The teller saw me and alerted another banker to come out and help me, and she brought me to her desk to help put through the deposit. The process itself took a few minutes. The check was crumpled, so her tablet wasn't picking it up, and she ended up having to get help. But she was very polite and friendly through it all.

The branch itself has hand sanitizer pretty much everywhere you turn, and there are spots marked clearly on the ground for where to stand while you are waiting. All of the tellers are wearing masks, and there are shields put up everywhere possible to limit airborne transmission. I felt as safe as I have anywhere indoors during this pandemic inside this particular bank (come think of it, today was the first time I've stepped into a bank in over a year -- I pretty much try to handle everything at a drive thru ATM or through my banks' apps).

My Fiance and I had a reservation on NYE to celebrate with friends in Philadelphia.  Check-in time was 3pm. We arrived at 2:45, and put our name on a 'queue' and were told they'd call us when the room was ready.  After checking on our room twice, and standing in the freezing cold lobby for an hour and a half, we finally decided to make our way into the hotel restaurant.  

After almost 3 hours into our 'stay' we mentioned to our waitress that we've been waiting for our room to be ready.  Soon after a manager named Kate come to our table to tell us our room was ready, and that we had been upgraded to the King Suite.  This was hardly the case when we went upstairs and walked into a room with two queen beds.  Maybe we should have pushed them together?  

We called the front desk to ask about this 'upgrade' and were put on hold.  Waited...waited...waited.  Hung up, called back, and asked for Kate - who said she would come up to take us to a different room.  The next room was a normal Queen room, with a nice view of the side of a church.  When we asked Kate about the 'Luxury' bathrooms that were listed on the reservation, we were told that's just language they use online to make them sound nicer, but "they do have marble counters!".  

Like most people on NYE, we had plans to meet friends for dinner.  These plans were quickly crumbled after we hadn't gotten to our eventual room until after 6pm.  

To make matters worse, we booked the room through Priceline.  Priceline had eventually told us that the bill the hotel gave us was a mistake and we weren't supposed to see that the room was in fact $85 less than what our card was charged.  When Priceline reached out to the hotel to enquire about the delayed check-in and room changes, the hotel told priceline that we were compensated by being given A KING SUITE!  

Not only was this completely untrue, but Priceline refused to refund us in any way because the hotel had lied and said they already compensated us.  

What a way to treat paying customers of the hotel, restaurant, and parking.  Word of advice:  When there's a reason for a sold out hotel, such as NYE, plan accordingly and have your rooms ready when guests arrive.  If they're not ready, at least make your guests feel appreciated rather than just another drop in the bucket.

Better than I expected, good service and pretty lively and kept clean inside. I got the miso grilled salmon rice bowl with veggies and it was really tasty. Nice amount of veggies with brown rice, so a great healthy and good tasting option.
Literally the best mashed potatoes I've ever had, and I lived in Idaho last year. The tender sub was amazing and the salad looks really fresh. I'm extremely impressed. Worth it for a pricy Uber eats!

I'm so disappointed in my purchases at this shop.... I purchased two corsets one of the corsets is coming apart and neither fit right, pantyhose won't stay up either. The sales lady was helpful, but made me feel somewhat uncomfortable... she didn't take me into a dressing room to try on lingerie. She insisted I try them on over my clothes in the middle of the store for bystanders and patrons to observe! I'm pretty easy going and didn't want to make a fuss plus it seemed like they both seem to fit, over my clothes. As for the pantyhose the sales lady said they would work w my body type but won't stay up, not even for two seconds, they keep rolling off. Had to get my bank involved to get some type of reimbursement for the nearly $250 spent in this dump!
Glad to see this location revitalized. The portions were large, and the service was good. Recommend their Tao's Chicken.

Great food here, and probably some of the most unique high-brow dishes you'll find in all of Indy. That said, the food can sometimes be gilding the lily. I've had some excellent food here, and some where it felt like they didn't know when to say enough was enough and added too many ingredients. I also feel like there are some dishes that sound amazing, then there are one or two ingredients that feel like they don't fit with the rest of the dish or completely change the flavor profile. So definitely read the menu discerningly as nothing can be sent back or anything changed other than how it's presented on the menu. I get it about not compromising your vision, but they take it a little extreme here. Definitely somewhere to try if you're the more adventerous type for food!

Loved the mini-golf, the go karts and the laser tag! The bumper boats were fun but I don't recommend going in when you see a bunch of children; you will come out wet! We still had a blast with it though. Solve it by bringing a poncho! The only downside was the arcade. Half of the games are out of order and many that aren't steal tokens and don't give you tickets

Absolutely loved my experience with The Dressing Room! I booked an appointment and appreciated the follow up messages I received to let me know they were highly invested in offering me the best experience. They asked for pictures of styles of dresses that I liked and this helped create the foundation for the search. I also advised of my short time frame and this allowed my consultant to focus on off the rack possibilities that I could leave with that day. I tried on just two dresses before finding the one! I tried on 3 more before deciding that I was done looking. I was so worried I would find anything but I never expected I'd find something I loved so much that my family assured me was perfect for me! I had 100% personal attention unlike other stores and that was immeasurable. This was an absolute dream wedding dress experience and I am so so grateful for The Dressing Room! Tiffany was amazing! I'll cherish this day forever!

Website and Google says they're open....

They're not......

If you can't take a few minutes to let guest know you're closed then I wonder how lazy they are elsewhere.

My wife and I have dealt with banks in the past, and its a daunting process for a first time home buyer.  Finding people we could talk to about our situation and do a little bit of underwriting and not just look at our FICO score is a rare situation.  Our loan officer did her best to hold our hand through the entire process, tell us what was coming next, keep us posted with updates and kindly ask for needed information.  I would highly recommend my experience.

Stopped in here because it was familiar and I had tried to find a local place that wasn't a chain but nothing popped and couldn't find a turkey burger on those menus.  So settled for the chain and all was fine.  Pretty good turkey burger, solid service and good beer.  My only complaint, and that was super minimal, Was the ranch dressing was like water.  Wanted it for my fries but it was so watery I just used catsup.  For me that is a last resort.  However overall was just fine and filled my hunger need well.

This is Philly's cupcake 2nd location, which has their Signature Pink & colorful store front. Gem stone chandeliers, so Whimsical.. They owned Philly chocolate, finally merged the 2 locations..loved this place..From truffles to cupcakes, store front had baker baking!!!  What a delight. They had 3-4 seasonal flavors, & the gentleman was quite personable & informative about his sweet creations.They had fig stuffed with goat cheese * chocolate, OMG..sounded heavenly -get it next visit. They had Illy -famous Italian coffee, which I will trying too.My brunch buddy & I each got cupcake to go, mine was coconut cupcake, regular size-dont think want it any bigger-the cupcake that is!! 
: )~
She got the strawberry lemonade-wowser!!
Return factor-YES!!!!! Love them.
A cozy little distillery with a very nice vibe. Everything is the simple price, $8 per cocktail. The cocktails are just amazing! The bartender is so friendly. I'll definitely be back.

Today's edition of day-drinking with retirees (my parents, who are a hoot) took us here. The food was decent...everyone loved their various sandwiches and the portions were large. My fish tacos were good but the flour tortillas werebaked I guess, because they were quite tough to chew through. Everyone liked their beers. Our server was also the bartender, who seemed annoyed to have to wait on us. It was a Sunday mid-day so it wasn't busy. Maybe they were short-staffed? She got more pleasant the closer it came to tip time. Funny how that happens.

A friend and I both got the croissant; he got iced tea while I got a hot tea. It's true what everyone says - best croissant I've had in the United States. It's got that pure buttery flavor, rich and moist on the inside, with a flaky brittle crust on the outside. Afterwards, I had no reason to eat anything more because it was made so well, it resulted in my feeling of fullness. 

BUT if I have one weakness, its macarons (also known as "macaroons"). These pastel colored lovelies are something I'd give my firstborn child away for, as long as it is done right. I have not had a decent macaron since Paris (2 years ago) and have been on a quest to find one that is just as delightful and pleasing to my palate as those sweethearts I left in France. 

I ordered 4 macarons. Of the 4, only 2 I felt were on par with France. The other 2 were "okay" but felt somewhat brittle and stale in quality. Like I had the macaron that'd been sitting in the window display for a little too long. Also, I'm not a fan of macarons that have more of a jelly like type filling, sometimes used in fruit flavored macarons. I'm a cream filling gal when it comes to my Parisian pastries. The two exceptional ones, one of which escapes me, but the other - damn. So good. It was coconut. And I HATE coconut. but I LOVED the macaron. It was perfect - the outer cookie was the right degree of soft inside and slightly hard on the outside. The cream was delicious - not overpoweringly sweet, but enough to make you feel tingles along your tongue and down your throat. A good macaron makes you feel like the world has stopped and nothing matters except you and this delicious goodie - and that's what that coconut macaron did. 

Thank you, Renaud. 

With that said, my regrets include: not having tried everything in the bakery cases (because they all glistened and glittered, asking patrons to have a taste), having paid 14 bucks for a breakfast of two croissants, two teas, and a handful of petite macarons, and lastly not having said, "Sup?" when Renaud was walking around the patisserie. So here's my chance. 

Hey, Renaud! Sup?
Neigborhood atmosphere. Good food. Good friendly servers. Nice menu selection. Pizza looked good. First visit - good first impression.

Reasonably priced lunch menu. Some dinner items, esp sushi and seafood a little pricier. Service was excellent, prompt and attentive. Food came out quickly and was fresh, very good. Atmosphere is fairly minimal with sparse design and layout, but has a good modern feel. Wasn't too loud. This kind of reminds me of Jasmine when they first came on the scene and were on top of their game. They've let that place slack off some and Le Shio seems to be aiming to be Jasmine at its own game for Asian fusion.

Today was my trash day however because of the holidays I thought they weren't coming till tomorrow I see the trash man pull up on my street so I run the trash out as he's pulling up yells out his window at me should have had it at the curb motherfuker and passes me by terrible company have service with them over 20 years

Booking my birthday at this new TG was the best gift.  Taylor and the rest of the staff were incredibly helpful and made the event a lot fun.  If you go, the top floor is a great location and gives you a great view of the mountain ranges.  Parking is really easy and the menu has something for everyone.  If you are planning a large event, this is a great place to host larger crowds.

Seriously disappointed. The food was good, though not run-down-the-street-screaming good, but the service was seriously hurting. We arrived at 6:30, to a mostly empty restaurant, and it took 2 1/2 hours to get through our meal. We spent a lot of time wondering where our server was, where our next course was, where is the water refill? If this were an average priced restaurant, I might give it four stars, but lets be fair - at the prices they are charging I expect a heck of a lot better. I've got favorite restaurants all over the planet, I don't need to drop a bundle at Brennan's just to say I've been there. Final word - meh. Go to Commander's Palace instead, or any of a dozen other truly world-class restaurants in New Orleans. Give Brennan's a miss.

Had a flat tire Saturday while riding in Tower Grove Park and was lucky enough to be SUPER close to A & M Cyclery. Walked my bike over and got a call about the problem Monday (badly-adjusted caliper brake pad), then stopped in for a long talk about adjusting handle-bars, seat height, and other bike deets. I'm a newie and employee (owner?) was very understanding and helpful. Live really close and will definitely use for all my bike needs in the future!

These guys are awesome if you have a group and need some speed.  Just move your tables together and watch them Rock the Wok!  They are definitely fast and this is a regular stiff for us when we are in a hurry.  I like the Pho and Thai noodles here.  Fairly nice crew although it seems to change every 6 months.  Not a chain, a little hard to park in the small lot.
It was ok. Not as good as I expected. The servers weren't too attentive and my meal was not too great.

Just did a mobile order.   Ordered and paid for chicken sandwich.   Not received!!!!!   Ordered chicken tenders.   See picture for yourself on size of said tenders!   More like nuggets that will not be enough to satisfy a kid!   Ordered 5oiece meal.   Includes two wings!!!   Second time they completely missed an item!!!!   Service been going down hill for a while now.   Has nothing to do with Covid!   And when u try to call the store: bust and can't get through!!!!   Is there a minus stars selection!!!!??????
This is the best burger joint in town, they are clean, kind, and the food is very good! A must eat restaurant!
Don't bother making an appointment.  Made mine days in advance for simple tire rotation...  Sat in waiting room for 1/2 hour before work began.

Yes!!! So I am excited for this pop-up Pink Taco Truck! Finally, some excellent tacos in the Sparks area! Reno Pink Taco Truck has popped up in Sparks on Visita and Wingfield Hills Road near the United Federal Credit Union or across the street from Starbucks!
The food is fresh and made to order! My daughter loves the freshly homemade pink tortillas. Those and the pink crema were such a fun touch to the meal. 

The meat is tasty, juicy, and bursting with flavors. 
We tried the chicken tacos, the quesabirria tacos, and the Mexican Asada pizza. Every one of the dishes had its own savory flavor. The tortillas are homemade daily!

I can't place the chicken flavor, but boy, was it delicious! I wanted to go back for more. This could be bad for me as I live on the opposite corner of where they have popped up! 

The quesabirria tacos are made with chopped-up birria stew meat served with onions, cilantro, and a consommé, all in a cheesy pink shell. They are were rich and flavorful. The image of these tacos with the tender, juicy meat and fried, crispy cheese sticking out the top, being dunked into a deep red consommé, warms my tummy up! They also serve this delicious meat as Birria Ramen. They do the beef birria stew meat topped with onion, cilantro, and a squeeze of fresh lime juice all over noodles! I can't wait to try this! 

My daughter enjoyed the Mexican Asada pizza and chicken tacos. She is tickled pink to see the pink taco shells and the pink crema! My daughter also requested more of the Mexican wedding cookies they gave us as a treat. These buttery cookies feature ingredients like butter, sugar, spices, and nuts. They are oh so delicious! We have requested an order for three dozen already. We hope our friends enjoy them as much as we did. 

The customer service was fantastic. We spoke about the history of the business and the owners behind the delicious creations. Thank you for the conversation and delicious food! Give them a try, and I'm sure you won't be disappointed. I hope the Reno Pink Taco Truck will continue to stay in the Sparks area as we lack restaurants in the area....plus, they are so yummy.i

*Edited to add we went back and tried the chicken burrito, Asada tacos and the Birria Ramen. We enjoyed everything and my daughter is already asking for more of the Birria Ramen soup! The chicken burrito was huge!!! It was filled with chicken, beans, rice, cheese, sour cream, and guacamole! It was really good.

Checked in at the Goodland and upon arrival we were greeted by Benjamin. Benjamin is the front desk agent who is extremely nice and attentive. We were offered complimentary beer while we were checking in :) always a plus. Not to mention from 5pm to 6 pm complimentary wine!!! Like common can you ask for more?? The grounds are beautiful so are the rooms!! 
I will definitely come here again!! I highly recommend:)

I am so disappointed I didn't know about this place earlier! The food here is a amazing. Literally had everyone at my table saying it was the best dish they had in boise! And the burger is just too good!! I wanted a second one!!!! Service is great and love their MO. Can't wait to come back like every week until my husband bans me (which will never happen).

Ate  breakfast twice while on vacation. I had egg white sandwich with cheese on toast.  Way overdid amount of egg on sandwich.  Almost sickening amount for a sandwich.  Otherwise was good.  Fruit cup was fresh.  Daughters chocolate chip pancakes excellent bring thin and light powdered with sugar.  Husband enjoyed waffle and chicken and said chicken was very juicy.  However waffles very heavy and thick with no flavor.  Syrup was not that standout either.  Neither my husband or I liked sausage patty or links.  They were oversized and patty seemed like it was previously frozen and has a strange texture.  Link lacked spice and too fatty.  Loved the restaurant itself.  Very clean and modern.  Seemed up scale with wood paneling and colorful paintings.  Staff was very friendly too.  Also loved the music selection.  They play all my favs.  So for music, decor and friendly staff I give it 4 stars.
I've eaten there a couple of times . Service was. Great , food didn't wow me   It would be nice to find a good steakhouse that can sauté some mushrooms

Sorry no stars here. Came in at a very busy time and they couldn't handle it. Food was good once we received it. I think they need a few more people to keep the tables clean. No waitresses. Too bad could be a good place. If they aren't busy it may be different.

Went to the Jazz Kitchen Saturday night to see the spectacular Spyro Gyra. Show was so amazing. The talent is always top notch but they need to work on the service.  Our table (one couple, two single women)  was a mixture of strangers and we all became friends. Only the couple knew each other and I guess the server assumed me and the other female knew each other...? We didn't. The server asked the couple if they needed a menu. They didn't. I did but wasn't asked. The other female was in the ladies room so the server left 2 menus for the couple "just in case they changed their minds"...confusing. Finally placed a food order which I wasn't sure would even come. I was prepared to cancel the order. Drinks came very late. Mine was just a glass of wine so not sure why it took so long. The other female ordered wine too so that was equally disconcerting. A bit later, the server came back around and asked the couple if they needed another drink order. She didn't ask neither me nor the other female. I had to raise my glass and point to get her attention as did the other female. So I'm really hoping the server was distracted or just having a bad day and that the lack of her attention was not due to the fact that both I and the other single female were  African American and the couple was not. I hate to think this but it really felt that way.
One of my favorite bars!!!!!A lot of fun great outdoor area. Very relaxed environment. Also has a great view of the ocean.
Food was awesome! Get there super early on a Saturday. We got there at 8am and by 815 there was a significant line. Worth the wait. Mimosas on point. Dont be afraid to try something new here.

I think both Kane (my fur baby) and I can agree that this place is the best doggy daycare ever. I have been sending my pup here for the last 3 months for doggy daycare and have also done boarding at this location, and I have no complaints. The staff is incredibly friendly and the place is super clean. They have daily rates and packages available; which is great for me since I send Kane about 2-3 times a week (great deal). They also have grooming services available if you aren't looking for a daycare or boarding option. They have webcams so you can check in on your pup; just not available from 12-2 when it's lunch and nap time. He has a great day everytime and comes home wiped out!

Visiting from out of town and found Janes on yelp, it was also recommended by a bartender at our hotel. It did not disappoint. I had the chicken piccata and janes sundae for dessert. My husband had the seafood penne and the daily special fruit cobbler. We both really enjoyed our meals and desserts- very good! Service was good too. I was tempted to get the coconut cake but decided on the sundae. We will have to come back soon.

Awful experience. They charged $114.00. After specific instructions, they shaved my golden retriever. This breed is NEVER recommended to be shaved. Disappointed and appalled on how this situation was handled by the groomer and front desk staff

Ohhh Randall's, the mecca of all things booze.

I'm a huge fan of this place. Typically I visit just to get things for my place (usually wine, sometimes beer and spirits) and it's so fun to wander the rows of alcohol and pick out new things to try. I have a giant wine rack mounted on one of the walls in my dining room, so I'm under a bit of pressure to keep that bad boy full. The employees are always so nice and willing to make recommendations, and I've ended up trying things I never would have had someone not told me it was awesome.

The second reason I go to Randall's is to pick up alcohol for an event I'm hosting. The prices are reasonable which makes a lot of difference, and I can count on them to have even the most unique thing necessary to make a specific cocktail.

The third reason? Party gifts. Gift packages, samplers, whatever you need, they have it. It's such a relief to be able to waltz in this place and leave with a really impressive gift that really didn't take that much effort. I really hope no one whose holiday party I attended last year reads this review. But it's true.

Randall's is your one-stop-shop for everything booze. Go in and try some new things!

What more could be said than "Amazing" about Central Bark and their staff. From the moment you walk in the door you will notice the attentiveness, love and personal care your pet will receive all while having the time of their lives playing with other pups. Right from the start you can tell how well structured and monitored your pets day will be.
      Simply at the mention of Central Bark our pups ears pop up and he is waiting at the door pitching a fit until he arrives. I simply don't think there is a price one can put on how well your dog is well cared for while there. There is not a visit that does not go by where 300+ pictures are placed on FB showing how much of a best your pup is having... Trust me from pet parents who have tried many others in the area your pup or pups will be missing out if they don't get to spend time at Central Bark!!!!

I'm surprised to see so many positive reviews for this remarkably bad hotel. My experience was of one mistake after another. Here's a sampling from a four-night stay: the room wasn't cleaned my last day; twice the staff forgot to send up something I requested; the in-room dining menu is only available on the TV but was "unavailable" on mine and this was never resolved; the front desk phone sometimes rings 10 times before someone answers; the breakfast menu to hang on the door overnight was only provided my first day; and the furnishings show major wear and tear. The staff is pleasant but undertrained and apparently unsupervised. By "boutique" the company appears to mean "bold wallpaper and hipster staffers milling around chatting." Any one of these issues is unusual for a hotel, especially at this price point. Together they add up to a simply bizarre experience. Don't be fooled by the attempt at fancy decor. Overall this is the least professionally run hotel I've ever stayed in.

I sent them my Chanel  Executive tote.  It had been at the Chanel boutique in Bal Harbour for over a year!  I picked it up from them and Lisa my friend at Saks NYC told me about them.  I emailed them and took my baby and a wallet that needed refurbishing to the UPS store.  They packed them up and off they went.  I waited with anticipation for their return.  The box came yesterday!  I literally cried!  The bag was carefully packed in a dust bag!  I pulled her out and she was brand new!  She had certification and authentication in a professional folder.  The wallet looked  new as well.  In a day where we need to refurbish things instead of blindly shopping they are gods!  I love them!!
great food, fast service everytime. a little pricey but it's due to the location! their 'fat' sandwiches are delicious.

Really happy I found this place. The inside is gorgeous (a foodie's dream for good pics). Our waitress was awesome too, very helpful and attentive. Tacos are flavor packed and my personal favorite is the Chicken Salad Sandwich. Quiet for a Saturday but loved it and wish I lived closer to this gem.

Wow.

Never had YogoKiss until tonight. Absolutely, positively delicious. My husband had the original flavor with pineapple, watermelon, and strawberry and gobbled it all down. I had the taro flavor with watermelon, strawberry, and kiwi. Oooooooh my god the taro flavor is AMAZING. It is sweet but very light. Fantastic. I was excited to see an Asian/pacific flavor and it was fantastic!

We moved here from the UK recently and had to furnish our new house from scratch.  We heard about Urban Styles from a friend who suggested we ask for Mike.
We were so pleased with the variety of styles available and also the quality and price.  The showroom is like an Aladdin's cave!! 
Since moving in this April, we have made several purchases and dealt with Mike every time.  He has done some great deals for us and everything has been delivered as promised. We have been thrilled with the quality of the pieces we have bought.  The delivery team are always prompt and exceptionally polite...
Urban Styles is always our "go to" store for furniture and home accessories.

Came in Sunday evening wanting to grab dinner to go. Walked in, what I thought was an empty restaurant but ended up seeing no one. Finally saw one server that had walked over to the table, but never checked to look at the door area as I stood up near a table that had menus on it. I wasn't impressed with the prices, they were higher than expected considering I live downtown and work next door and have never seen this place busy and now I know why. Customer service is lacking and prices are jacked. Probably to makeup rent since they don't ever seem to be busy.

Great "Lightening Bolts" (Fried Zucchini) but that's it.

My husband and child were in the area and wanted to try something new. Having a friend that works here who raves about the food we decided to try it out.

Our experience started the moment we walked in. The restaurant is one big open room. It has a very sterile ambiance. No real sense of design elements other than large televisions every 4 feet and speakers placed every 8 feet. No theme. Obviously geared towards sports enthusiasts and beer drinkers. This is a seat yourself place, no host or hostesses, so unless you're immediately greeted- you stand at the front looking lost until someone provides direction. 
Once seated we realized that there was some memorial also going on on the opposite end of the room which was only 40 feet away. It was awkward and borderline tacky. If you're going to have a memorial shut the restaurant down, make it a private event. We felt like we crashed the memorial based on the glares we received from the group. 
Come to find out it was the mother of an employee which explained why the other employees were drinking and distracted.
Our server was pleasant. She took our order correctly and food came out in a reasonable amount of time.  We ordered the fried zucchini which was good and the homemade pretzels. The pretzels were just ok. The cheese and mustard dipping sauces were gross. But our largest disappointment came with our entrees. My husband ordered the black and blue salad and per my servers suggestion, I ordered the fish and chips with a side salad. His salad was not fresh. The greens were wilted and lacked any crunch. He complained of a metallic taste. Overall it was a bland gross salad. The meat was ok but did not have any pizazz. It could have been better seasoned.
My fish and chips were the same. Too much flavorless batter and a strong fishy odor. I ate one of the three large pieces of fish. The fries were overcooked and gross. The only enjoyable part of my entree was the coleslaw, and I normally don't like coleslaw but because it lacked flavor I was able to eat that. My side salad came out with the wrong dressing but my greens were also wilted and actually included rotten tomatoes!  I sent it back. Our server took it off our bill and said she'd notify a manager but no one came over to speak with us. Obviously if they don't care to check the salad before it goes to a table then they probably don't care about keeping business. 
One thing that bothers me about any business is when I see employees hanging out or sitting at a table doing side work or closing duties. These duties should be done out of customer view. 
Overall, it was a disappointing experience. We will not be back. I can spend $50 elsewhere on more enjoyable food!

This could easily go up to 5 stars after repeat visits, as I was very satisfied. We got in easily by parking and standing in line for about 10 minutes right when they opened, so we got our food quickly. There was no way I was waiting in the drive-through line, no matter how good it was.

In any case, all of the employees were super polite and place looks great. I had The Waffler and The Kickin' Chicken sandwiches. Both were excellent - certainly superior to obvious places that would be used for comparison. The former was super dense and sloppy as anything, but tasted great! I also enjoyed the Green Bean Fries.

The Chocolate Swirl Funnel Cake had a good flavor but was too crispy, which the guy in charge openly acknowledged to me and said they were probably taking it off the menu for that very reason (hey, transparency!). I also thought the fries were forgettable - not bad by any stretch, but not really worth getting, either. And the soda selection is weak... Was that Mr. Pibb I saw there? Really?

That's all a little nitpicky, though, as the main event there, the chicken, completely lives up to expectations and I look forward to going back and trying a few more menu items. Plus, they'll eventually get breakfast!

We made a reservation for 8.  When we got to the restaurant, they did not put us in the dining area, but in the bar.  We had requested a table so that we could talk.  The
restaurant was so loud that we could not hear the person next to us.  The food pricey for what was served.  The server was unavailable and we had to ask several times for things like napkins and get the order correct.  We were all finished eating by the time one of our members of the party received their food.  We were ready to get out of the restaurant, and when the checks came, three of them had overcharges on them.

I know that this is a new restaurant in the area, but the have been in business long enough to get the above things straight.

There is no pizza more "authentic New York" than Joey's!  The quality and taste is always consistently real New York and the service there is fantastic!  Huge slices at a great price.  The people there are really nice and friendly and the pizza is in a class of its own - you really need to treat yourself!
The employees are rude and not friendly. But overall the coffee is amazing, but will not be back because of the unfriendly people.

Came here with two friends on a Thursday night.  We originally wanted to go to North Bowl but the wait was 2.5 hours there, but they were nice enough to call South Bowl for us to put us down for a time later that night since South Bowl had a shorter wait time.

Stopped by the bar for some drinks - I got the Backyard Tea (sailor jerry spiced rum, lemonade and iced tea served in a mason jar).  Would have been better if it had a bit more lemonade in it.  We also ordered the original and garlic and herb tater tots which we finished dangerously fast.

We had to wait about thirty minutes before we got a lane.  Once we were settled in our lane we had a great time.  When it's busy they only let you play two games if you're with a group of three or more.  Our waitress that came by to check on us was very nice but it took her a while to get us our waters.  Other than that we had a great time!
After drinking for 2 hours here, we were told by the bartender "You are being too loud..." Really??? Being too loud in a bar...

Delicious food! If you haven't had Afghan before, then come here and try it ASAP. We had the emperor platter (large kabob sampler with eggplant), chicken biriani, and muntoo. All of which are not to be missed!

We were in town and heard lots of good things about this place. We checked out the menu on yelp and really liked the variety. It had something everyone in the family would like.  We went at lunch and it was packed, it made us feel like it must be good if they were full on a Monday afternoon.  The staff were very polite and helpful. My husband ordered a burger, which he loved! My daughter had the kids Mac and cheese. Unfortunately she was not a fan. But my husband and I stole a few bites and it was delicious! It was buttery and perfectly cheesy. I think the flavors were too intense for her palette and she was expecting kraft. I would most certainly order it again just for me, but maybe another kids menu item for her. I ordered the Reuben and it was great. Good cut of chip beef and it was put together wonderfully. This was a two thumbs up and will be back to try more menu items.

As a Sailor for over 17 years I have received amazing massages all over the world, but this is by far the best one of them all.  Wearing the headphones and having the bed that vibrates with the key notes allows you to completely take your mind off of everything and fully relax.  I highly recommend getting any of the hot stone massages offered here.  The facials are wonderful as well!

Food was fair at best.  But the owner was about the most unfriendly person I have ever met.  He should not be in the restaurant or anything that has to do with people.  They got the order mixed up when the food actually did come it was cold.  It did taste OK but nothing t0 rave about.

One of the best experiences we've had in buying a car.  The people we dealt with treated us as welcome guests instead of buyers in need of high pressure.  From the initial response and info provided by Reid, to our dealings with Tim on finalizing a price, to the wrap up with Jason and Frank.  Reid provided the exact info I was looking for instead of run-around with evasive answers and meaningless back and forth.  In other words, they did things the way we were most comfortable with.  The car was meticulously detailed, full of gas, and ready at the time promised.  We got a high quality vehicle at a very fair price.  So often, you walk into a dealer expecting the worst, to have to argue and go through the motions, and be lied to.  These folks did just the opposite, and earned our repeat future business.

The great thing about visitors is that you go out and eat special meals. This was my first trip back to la Petite Grocery (well besides for drinks) in several years. We had a fabulous meal. 

My friend & I split the special soup & salad of the day. The soup was AMAZING. It was just perfect, leek & broccoli with a little bit of cream. The salad was well balanced with greens, blue cheese & pistachios.  We each had an appetizer as our main meal I had the spaghetti with blue crab. It was the perfect size and the crab was really luscious, but it was maybe a smidge over parmesaned which made it a bit salty...or maybe that's just me. This did not prevent me from gobbling it up. My friend had the octopus appetizer and said it was amazing. 

So we planned to be good and stop and then I heard the special dessert was a peach gallette with strawberry ice cream. And my friend ordered the creme brulee. The gallette was lovely and huge! which did not stop me from eating it all. And my friend raved about the brulee.

The restaurant was pretty full as it was Jazz Fest weekend but service stayed on point and it wasn't too loud despite the happy crowds. I do have to mention that the flowers in the restaurant, on tables, the bar, the hostess station, etc were stunning, just really beautiful.

All and all a great meal.
Super cool spot. The frozen coffee is awesome and the pastry option gives nearly everyone something they can eat here. The decor is great.

The entire staff was knowledgeable and accommodating. 
The pharmacy is incredibly busy and the customers not always polite. .....but everyone remained kind and focused.    From pet food to the pharmacy. ..CVS is my store!

The rating doesn't really matter to me.  D&B is fun.  But, a Millers Ale House just opened up at the mall, which honestly has better food. But I don't want Dave and Busters to go Bust because I really love video games.  FYI.  PINBALL

Oh my this isn't your typical taco joint.  Ok well it isn't my typical hole in the wall taco joint.  Nice patio, huge portions, eclectic decor.  I am going to try it on one of the special nights because I am such a deal whore.

I recently bought out the lease on my Toyota Tundra.
Lisa and Joe were amazing. They delivered on every thing they said they would. Lisa and Joe stepped me through the entire process and explained everything. Don in finance did a good job as well.
I have had every sandwich on the menu. This is the real deal. Best sandwiches in South Jersey.

One of my FAVORITE places to eat for Authentic Mexican food, I don't care what the other reviews say This place IS AWESOME !! GREAT FOOD ALWAYS!! I eat there a couple of times a week customer service is ALWAYS GREAT they remember you by name. Did I mention that they make their tortillas fresh on the big grill in the restaurant they are definitely DELICIOUSO!!!

I've visited La Margarita about 4 times and have never been disappointed. 

The meal starts with corn tortilla chips and three types of fresh salsa, which your server will gladly refill. At my last visit nothing on the draft beer list spoke to me so I ordered a pomegranate tequila cocktail that was good enough to drink but not great enough to order a second (though I'm not huge on sweet drinks anyway). 

My favorite dishes are the shrimp tequila and the chicken chipotle. They cook both to perfection and they come with very well-prepared sides of rice, potatoes, guacamole, and pickled veggies. Yum!

Great food, friendly service, reasonable prices for NOLA.  

This is my go-to place when I hit NOLA with an appetite.  This time I ordered the soft-shell crab and it was an ample meal.

Great food, great music and server Denna was awesome! Great recommendations for the stuffed bacon blue cheese dates, three muses pomme frites and as others recommended, the lamb sliders! Perfect little tapas to start off our night of love jazz music on Frenchmen street!

We had a Hot Water tank fail on us 6 1/2 years after install (by another company). I spoke with Sandi and she was incredibly amazing to deal with. She got back to me during one of the busiest weeks of a crazy heatwave. She identified that it was still under warranty even though the original company claimed it was not. She went above and beyond and saved me over $1,000 in unnecessary costs. I highly recommend this sort of professional customer service and will make sure they are my first recommendation and go to for anything Heating or cooling related. Wish I heard of you sooner!

If I was able to give minus stars I would. Went to dinner at the original down on Lakeside. HORRIBLE! Even spoke to the waiter, his response "Well can't make everything perfect every time". REALLY? The last time we had eaten at Luciano's it was still on Virginia St. AMAZING! I had raviolis, my husband had spaghetti. It was amazing. I'm not a person who is concerned with ambiance. WHO CARES? As long as the food and the service is great, I'm there repeatedly. But, when you sit and see dust bunnies hanging from Pothos plant limbs...well it's time to leave.  What does the kitchen, refrigerator, or prep station look like? If the Chef is incapable of making Gnocchis STOP COOKING! My cat can make better Gnocchis than the Chef at Luciano's. It seemed that the hostess had more time to sit at the bar, than worry if the clientele was served great food. Even after speaking with the waiter he never approached the hostess? WHY? Having a critic from Frommer's you would think that would have been the first thing a waiter did. Sorry folks your potential clients to steer clear of this place. With the prices as expensive as La Familia, well you have fallen short., very short.

Good restaurant with good and affordable food. The service was fast and the servers were friendly and accommodating. They have a good seafood bisque and you get a free dessert with some of their specials. They have a lot of selections in their menu. They also have a couple of party rooms that can accommodate small or bigger groups. I was really impressed. Great place to take family and friends.

Grifols Reno recently increased their payment amount for new donors only. This means that new donors get $20 more per week than returning donors. grifols is making more money off of return donors than new donors. This is totally unfair to returning donors!  They need to change this!  Why penalize returning donors, which is exactly what you're doing!!  you should treat everyone equally!!
Was great with a different then normal style! Best Rueben in stl! The loaded bbq cheese fries where super tastey! Brisket sandwich was off the chain

I went back to give this restaurant a second chance and was really impressed with improvements across the board.  The food was delicious and the service was much improved.  I plan on going back soon.  Updating rating from 3 to 4 stars.

I've been here several times. I keep hoping that I'll like it -- and I keep ordering different things in the hopes I'll find a great dish -- but I never do. Portions are smaller than at Thai Singha (which is kitty-corner to Pattaya) and more expensive. Food has generally been bland, and even when I practically beg them to make it extra spicy, there's barely any heat...unlike Thai Singha, which cranks their chili-meter up when I ask for "five-star spicy" there. Really not worth coming here, especially with Thai Singha a minute walk away.

The Aja Experience is a great salon. I just moved into the area and in need of a haircut. I choose to go here based on the fact they were open on a Sunday. I called to see if I could get a same day apt and the owner was so nice and asked for my name and number and said he would call me back once he talked to his stylist. He called me back within a short time and had an apt for me a bit later that day. My stylist was Heather, she was so sweet and listened to exactly what I wanted and I received a wonderful haircut! A huge pulse is their washing sinks. They have quite possibly the most comfortable washing sinks. I had Heather do a conditioning tx on my hair and she had me sit with it in my hair for 10 mins. I had no trouble laying with head in that sink. It has some sort of pillow in the bottom making the whole experience very nice and comfortable. I will be going back.

Baja is one of the go-to Mexican places for college students in the area. The food is delicious and cheap and the service is fast. It is set up "chipotle style" where you can choose what goes into your burrito/taco/etc. t
This time I tried the taco plate which came with two tacos, rice and beans. I chose the guac taco which was amazing and the chicken taco which was a bit dry. The restaurant itself is kinda small and there is limited indoor and outdoor seating so not the best for large groups.

This branch of Platos Closet has a fairly good selection but the assistance for staff is very hit or miss. Some employees have been very friendly, eager to help, and kind during the process. Others have been arrogant, condescending, short, and unhelpful. The sales at this branch are also hit or miss - not very well-organized and not living up to the expectations of the marketing. I come back here but if the rude employees keep it up there will be no customer base whatsoever.

My husband and I have been waiting for an authentic local Mexican food spot to hit our area for a while now. After hearing about Mi Mex Cocina, we decided to give it a try, and it did not disappoint. We ordered the chicken and steak fajitas and they were seasoned to perfection. Every bite was better than the next, and the fact that they provided both regular tortillas as well as cheese tortillas made it that much more delicious. The taquitos dorados de pollo were out of this world as well, so definitely give those a shot. We can't wait to order again and explore the rest of the menu.

There was a time when this place had excellent food and worth spending the money. But that time was long ago and now it has diminished in quality and quantity. So I ordered the Mongolian beef, fried rice and beef on a stick. Mongolian had way too much onions and scarcely any meat. Combination fried rice did not taste fresh and not piping hot. The beef on the stick, however, was worth of a high rating. I liked it. Drive up window is no way fast food service. There was a long wait. But, the convenience of waiting in your car and listening to music is better than waiting inside. Only Chinese restaurant that has a drive up window service that I know of around metro east. Business has been around a good while and I would go here off and on.  Service is decent.

May 17, 2014 Saturday - breakfast 9:30 AM
2 adults

Atmosphere - 5 stars
Food - 5 stars
Service - 5 stars 

Background - Just finished up at the vet and the wife had a hair appointment at 10.  So she suggested this place.  She had been here before, probably before another hair or pedi appointment.  (Yes Robert S. I used the term PEDI again!)
 
Atmosphere - A small place but how big does a coffee shop need to be?  Love the local art work in the place!  We had our dog, I know Reno is very dog friend but we ate outside it was a beautiful morning.

Food
  Drinks - Yeah this is the reason we are here.  I was going with the standard Mocha.  My wife tells me she is getting the Milky Way.  What is that the solar system or candy bar?!?! Oh damn I read the rest of the coffee board, I guess I was too hungry.  Candy bars!!  I ordered the Snickers which of course is a Milky Way with more/better stuff!

  Appetizer - None.

  My Main Course - I had the #2 bagel, sausage cheese egg bagel.  Then the choices begin.  What type of bagel? Spicy, duh.  Then cheese, pepper jack yeah!  It was so yummy, fresh, did I say yummy with that coffee. 

  Dessert - none today.

Service - The lady behind the counter took our order and she later made our bagel sandwiches.  While I think he was the owner, or a great manager, he made our drinks.  Shortly after starting our breakfast he came outside to make sure our coffee were perfect.  Which these coffees and bagel sandwiches were!

Future - Please.

Stay away on holidays!
My family was vacationing in the area over Thanksgiving and booked a reservation for the holiday and the whole outing was a disaster!
First, they had a set menu which knew and were ok with even if the prices seemed a bit high... we figured this was necessary to keep the schedule on track. We arrived a few minutes before out reservation and were told they were running 1 HOUR LATE!!! Ugh!!! We had two kids in tow and since it was a family holiday meal we skipped the ipads so they were bored out of their minds. We crowded into the small bar area for a drink - they were terrible. They either didn't use the top shelf alcohol we ordered or it was very old. They also don't give you anything to stir which should be given for mixed drinks... you want to skip the plastic to save the fish that's fine but hand over the paper or wooden stick because all the alcohol is on the bottom when you pour it first. When we finally got seated we were at the end of our ropes and so was our server it seemed. He'd been trapped since 11 am and was completely frazzled so we got the benefit of his exhaustion which didn't help with our moods. We had to ask for the relish trays which were the automatic starter for all tables (fixed menu remember) so why wouldn't you show up with that??? We've been here for an hour waiting and have had nothing but bad drinks! The dinner, when it finally arrived, was actually good and so was the dessert but the evening was so terrible that by this point that no amount of good food was going to turn the night around. Maybe this place is better on any other night but we'll never know because we're so put off by their terrible execution for the holiday we'll avoid this place on future trips and never recommend it anyone else headed there.
Lasagna is awesome.  Staff is always attentive.  Thin crusted pizza was a new experience, but a good one.

We were just here for a concert but wanted a good champagne brunch to finish off our mini vacation. Did our investigation on all the local brunches within walking distance from Harrahs. We were very pleased with the brunch at the Legacy!  Esteban, our server, was wonderfully attentive!  The food was fresh and offered many choices.  We were very pleased with the quality, price and service!

Atmosphere great, service not so good, vey slow, takes too long for drinks.  Ordered lobster did not taste good, sent it back and the new one still tasted awful.  Ordered peach mojito, server said one bar did it wrong when she brought me out second drink, but charged me for both, food not bad.  live band was horrible, girl had on tshirt and no shoes, guitar player had shorts and sandal on, need to geter better on live entertainmet.  Younger staff working there, usually Debbie owner on site, realy does not say much, does not stop by to check on service.  Will go there still definately nice view and atmoshphere, but you know not to go there if you are in hurry or have to catch a show

Stumbled into this place. It's simple and dead cheap. Really tasty too and they serve enough to eat twice. I strongly recommend you guys check it out. It's something you would go grab in lunch hour when you are working. 
P.S. Soups are 1$ and fried rice is 3$. That's how cheap it is ! :)

This was a very pleasant dining experience. I got the stacked tacos and they were very flavorful. The rice and beans were SUPER flavorful, the food came out in a timely manner & the chips and Salsa were also very delicious!

Impressive...that's the perfect word.   The neighborhood is adorable, quaint, and lovely. The restaurant looks like a modernized colonial style home and inside makes you feel like you are in a modern barn with slits between the slats providing just the right amount of natural light.  The wall of plants is something I've not seen and when we commented on it, they tore a few leaves off for us to try...that's never happened before.  The menu was interesting in that I could've closed my eyes and pointed at anything and been satisfied but I hate surprises so I picked the lamb ragu and it was ....wonderful.  That poor ragu had no idea what was about to happen.  The portion was a bit small and had I been with hubby instead of girlfriends, that may have been a concern.  For dessert we had the ricotta donuts....  mind blown.  I'm pretty sure they had bacon on them...  which brings me back to my initial comment.  Impressive.
Went here 2-3 times over the summer. Had two different ice coffee brews and both were delicious. I love the coffee ice cubes, extra coffee once they melt!

Wingers certainly up'd their game, their new eatery on Eagle Road near intersection Ustick & Eagle; I had the Wings Lunch upgraded with onion rings absolutely THE BOMB came with 5-6 wings and slaw, went washed my hands cruised by the bar discovered they had 52 draft beers on tap, by the way the place was clean as a whistle no ordors, staff friendly I don't give out 5 stars much but Wingers gets it this time!

I went Saturday after Pacers game. Never been to the downtown location but frequently to Broad Ripple because parking is easier. Definitely glad I went though. It was beyond packed but those bartenders and servers were very attentive. I was amazed because I just knew I was going to go elsewhere. Hot food and delicious. I highly recommend. We should of stayed at Kilroys for the night because once we got over to Tiki Bobs, the night went downhill. (Don't go to that place ever) :) Go Kilroys! :)

This place is a joke.  It is not a real clinic and the care is spotty at best. If I need information I can watch Dr OZ.  I don't need talk, I need medicine and treatment, not excuses and BS.   I don't know if this is due to obama care, or because the military is trying to save money or you have woman doctors who want to strap it on and prove they are in charge, but I find it hard to believe one doctor at the clinic writes a valid prescription and another doctor at the same clinic won't refill it. Unfortunately I can't go back to the same doctor because they are TDY or deployed, or PCS'd.  I don't think I have ever seen the same doctor more than twice.  I usually see a different doctor every time I go there.  I have seen seven different doctors in two years from more than the team I am supposedly assigned to. In fact I was assigned a new doctor once, who I saw one time - on her LAST day.    In fact I have NEVER seen the doctor I am currently assigned to; only members of his team. He will probably be retired or PCS before I ever get a chance see/meet him and will be assigned another new doctor  Because I get shuffled around, I have to listen to lame excuses from different doctors I have never seen before like, "I don't feel comfortable writing that prescription"  or "I don't feel comfortable renewing that prescription", etc. etc.  We are not talking about asking for high risk opioids or addictive pain killers, we are talking about testosterone gel or an antibiotic for an infection, or daily blood pressure medicine.  In fact one doctor rather than treating the infection gave me pain killers for the pain caused by the infection that they wouldn't treat.  She felt comfortable with that but not giving me penicillin or some other antibiotic.  Forget getting any type of energy or diet pills. The clinic can't handle most problems or medical issues so they send you to approved civilian doctors on the outside, but when that doctor writes a prescription, the pharmacy in Brandon won't fill that or any prescriptions not written by doctors at the Brandon clinic.  The clinic won't answer phones during business hours, particularly if you are within 30-40 minutes of closing.  They rely on a recording system.  The problem with that the recording system is not advanced and is not programed with artificial intelligence so it can't handle real world problems.  Example: pharmacy automatic refill system.   I have called in for refills and on one occasion they refilled the wrong prescription.  In another case there was no record that I ever called, so no refill.  When you can't talk to a live person you run into problems like this.  I get a prescription it has 3 refills until a date about a year out.  On my first refill I call into have the refill entered so I can pick it up in three days.  Even though the refill does not expire for over four months, I am told by the recording that it is too early to get a refill I have to wait four more days to request it and then I have to wait three more additional days to actually fill it.  One problem. I have to go out of town in three days and will be gone for several weeks.  So it is too early to renew my prescription yet I will run out of my blood pressure pills while I am out of town.  I can't explain that to a machine. I can't explain to a machine that I will be without my pills and the possible health consequences or the reason why I can't wait four days to start the refill. Blood draw?  Good luck.  Try both arms and stuck a total of five different times with twisting and wiggling the needle trying to find a vein before they finally went and got someone more experience to stick me again.  I have plenty of blood, I give or have blood taken every month, this is the only place I had this problem.  Do you get my point (pun) or do I need to go on?

I took my car here, after my Groupon had expired for a $200 premium detail. Instead I got $100 of credit towards another service per Groupon rules. I told them what I wanted, a premium detail. They had a special going for their premium detail. It was supposed to be $175. I thought, "Awesome, at least I only have to pay $75 today."

I left and they called back a few hours later to tell me it was done. I showed up and went to pay, only to find I owed $100. When I asked why, the guy had no comment. I didn't want to argue, so I swiped my card...for $100. Which means I paid $200 for a $175 detail. To make up for it, I just kept the $25 I had pulled out of the ATM to tip them out. I guess it worked out in the end, and the car looked really nice, but no matter how good the detail is, customer service and honoring your specials is key.

I will say, the car looked very nice, better than it had in years.

I've been to Gigi's twice now and I would visit every time I goto or drive through Nashville from now on! Amazing cupcakes and always changing their menu! We've tried the wedding cake, red velvet, peanut butter, and about 3 other kinds and they were all amazing! Amazing little shop with amazing people inside. I wish they delivered to Chicago! A must try while in Nashville!

This is the most disgusting place I have ever had the misfortune to book and the only bad room I have ever booked on Expedia.  Ps no refunds given under any circumstances. Wish I could give it minus 5 stars   Beware

Been here quite a few times, small but it is a BYOB and most of them are tiny - its more cozy...reminds me of places I've eaten in Italy.  Food and service are good, don't like when you substitute but there dishes are really good the way they are prepared.

Great chicken! I have not had better fried chicken in the fast food category in Florida. They are cash only not crazy about that but it's a trade off for there chicken. I really did not try any of the sides I only wanted the chicken. It is not greasy, it's not burnt, and they pull most of the bone in the breast meat. The place is small and at lunch it's impossible to sit and eat. Go a little later and it is empty.

If I could give less than 1-star I would. Went to service department to get recall work on my F-150 and they flashed my ECU to repair. Less than 200 miles later, my check engine light came on with multiple faults. Brought it back in and they charged me $130 to diagnose the problem and then quoted me $1100 to fix an evaporative control module line. Refused service and went to Hi Tech Automotive and they ran same tests and fixed the issue for $115.  Would never recommend Brandon Ford Service. If their service department is this unscrupulous, I can only imagine how their sales department staff are. STAY AWAY!

Terrible! Was looking for a place to play pool and drink! My boyfriend and I went here and no later than 5 seconds I  was told that I needed to get up out of my seat because the bar owner "Katie" was coming, needed to sit down and that she could sit wherever she pleased. Absolutely not. Very rude.

This place is just great. I can't speak much for the lunch items, as I've fallen so hard for their breakfast items that I can't bring myself to possibly order lunch. 

Their specials are always delicious and unique (red velvet pancakes? are you serious?!). The Mass Ave egg sandwich on an everything bagel and pommes anna on the side is my favorite dish (even though I know I will be cursed with seeds in my teeth if I forget my floss). Their hot chai latte? Yummiest!

I've never once had an issue with the service, even when very busy. I agree that taking a cell number when they're on a wait is a genius thing. You can shop around Mass ave while you wait!

If I could give this place zero stars I would we ordered our food and were the only customers in the restaurant and 30 minutes later they hadn't even started making our food please spend your 50 plus dollars somewhere else!

I do a lot of traveling in my job, which is stressful and takes a toll on my body.  I have massages on a regular basis, and I thank my lucky stars that I just recently found Leslie!  She has such a unique style, and she has done wonders on my aches and pains!

What a fun and fantastic experience! This Italian restaurant is in the middle of a residential neighborhood in South Philly, and is the perfect way to end a long day of tourism and sightseeing. Show up before your reservation (but make a reservation!) and you'll be able to have a few drinks upstairs in the lounge which is full of Rocky photos - as the restaurant as in the movie! Good drinks for reasonable prices.

Dinner downstairs was fantastic. For appetizers, my family had the burrata and the pear and prosciutto salad (a special) - both fantastic ways to start the meal. For the entree, I had the calamari fra diavolo. I will say that the calamari could've been more tender, but other than that, a fantastic meal. The beautiful singing done by the staff every 20 minutes made the meal truly memorable - this will be somewhere I visit again during my time in Philly.
Visiting for a wedding. Native cincinnatian we miss eating our favorite home town meal! The staff was super nice & they made incredible 3ways and cheese coneys.

This review is for the restaurant at the front of the Healing Center, which is known as "Fatouche". 

My wife brought me there when we first moved into the area. She swore it was excellent middle eastern food, and she was absolutely right. The food is fresh, fast, and very tasty. The prices are reasonable. The only (minor) drawback is that the service is just a tad sluggish and depending on the complexity of activity in the kitchen (which is half-open to the restaurant), you may have to listen to arguments between the kitchen staff while waiting for your food. 

Otherwise, everything about this place is great. The space is bright, tastefully decorated, and inviting. There is plenty of seating. It is clean and well-maintained by an attentive staff. 

I highly recommend Fatouche if you're in the area and feel like good Turkish or Middle Eastern food. The gyro ("yeah-row" here, NOT "jye-roh"), in particular, was especially good.
I love micro breweries. They just started serving food and it doesn't disappoint. I'm an ipa drinker and palm bender is my favorite. If you want to go somewhere for a good beer and a decent lunch.

Had another great visit here yesterday.

Was surprised to see a friend I hadn't seen in quite some time working at the bar so that was definitely nice.

Started with some warm olives served with rosemary and a side of goat cheese wrapped grapes rolled in nuts. Sounds weird but it's so good. We then tried two east coast oysters and two west coast oysters, shucked perfectly and served ice cold. 

We moved on to the fish and chips which was really good. Flaky and crispy and the chips are like little potato boats with parmesan. Wow ere they good.

I got the salted caramel dessert and he got a cheesecake. Unfortunately mine was too salty to eat and had to be returned but my dessert martini was darn good.

We decided to stay for a bourbon as well as it was such a nice relaxing atmosphere.

Kudos to Katie for excellent service as well!

Really nice hotel away from the noise of the French quarter. Easy to access from the interstate. There are a few restaurants in walking distance to the hotel but nothing that sticks out too much so you might have to take an Uber or walk a little more if you want more options. 

The hotel is of course right near the convention center and near the Riverwalk mall if you have a convention to attend and then want to go shop. 

The suites are large! Our room was clean at first glance but our bed spread had blood on it from a previous guest and I did have to ask twice for them to come up but eventually they did. 

They also text you at this location to see how your stay is going. Which was helpful after I went down the first time and got no answer. 

Highly recommend for a NOLA stay other than the small incident the service was great and the breakfast is the standard Hampton inn style breakfast.

My family and I was on a quick getaway trip and decided to eat here. Not only was the food excellent, it was within walking distance from my hotel! 
Loved it!!

I stopped in to try this new pizza restaurant and was warmly greeted by the servers. My first time there and they explained the different options that were available-  I opted to get the mini pizza with mushrooms and well done crust. The pizza was excellent the crust was nice crisp dark brown -the mozzarella cheese was good the sauce was excellent and I had put mushrooms on as well which were very tasty. I will definitely be returning thanks for a nice new pizza experience!!
Nice place . Good vietnamese options for the area. I usually get my pho fix there if i can't make it to tampa . Dim sum is decent as well

Natasha was absolutely fantastic and so helpful and informative on all the food and beer menu options. She made the eating experience a thousand times more enjoyable! The food was definitely worth the wait! So delicious! We will definitely be back, even all the way from Birmingham, AL. 10/10 would highly recommend.
We love these guys, they always treat our dogs like they were their own. We live in St Louis now but still would rather drive out to O Fallon just to have these guys take care of our kids.

When I heard they were building a Sobeys on Jasper, I was happy just because of how close and convenient it would be.  But now that it's been here for a while, I find myself walking right by it on my way to Save on Foods.  

Sobeys is great for convenience, and good for a couple rarities they have once and a while.  The prices are higher, and there's nothing that really justifies it, considering their competition, with lower prices, are only a few blocks away.

When they first opened, they sold things like Kangaroo tail and other completely foreign products that had no real reason to be there other than for the "wow thats' different" factor. I have'nt seen any Roo for a while.

They do have some decent sales in the meat department at times though. I find some pretty great deals on chicken sometimes, and I like the fact that they have bison and other game.  The game isn't always consistant, but I like that it's there.

They do have a cafe area, and a large section of the store is a dedicated kitchen, where they make salads, sandwiches and all kinds of dishes. For this reason, it's a pretty popular place for lunch. I work downtown, and I've went in quite a few times for their wrap sandwiches (a nice healthy alternative to mallfood or subway) and other things.  Everything I've had was really fresh, and though the lines were long, they move fast.

I know in their cafe area they also serve beers/drinks, but I've never sat down, simply for the fact that I'd feel kinda weird doing that in a grocery store.  They also have live jazz some nights, I think weekends, but can't tell you exactly on what nights.

On a random note, I saw Akon shopping in here one day :/

I think if your going to get your big order of groceries, go down the road to Save on or Safeway.. if you just need a few things, and your nearby, Sobey's is really handy.

The most amazing small business ever. They order food for you if they don't normally carry it. They deliver said food if you live in town and always attach a treat to the bag. Our pup has lots of anxiety and can't stand being bathed at home. Maddie's Castle accommodated us and our pup so we could get her into the (amazing!) bath station right as they opened. They have a great selection of bath products and cozy towels. At the end they gave our pup a free treat and a free puppy ice cream. We will only use Maddie's Castle for our pet needs and highly recommend you do too!

Uh oh... what happened? Actually it seems like maybe they changed owners, or at least they have a different cook now. The food does not seem the same anymore. 

Perhaps it is just my imagination, but the food is not tasting as good as it has in the past.

Had "the Rittenhouse". Hit the spot but I couldn't eat here more than once or twice a year. Super heavy and unhealthy, but I could see why tourists wanna try it or someone hung over might want. Drizzles sound cooler than they are. Ingredients don't seem to be super high quality.
I've eaten here many times and never have I been disappointed. Good and flavorful food worth a friendly staff

The best race I've ever run!! I did the full in November...and am going to sign up to do it again this year. Loved Manayunk, the free beer (though any smart runner knows never to imbibe during the run), and especially the orange peels! Some of the areas were a bit sparse, but that was okay, as I was able to have my family strategically placed in those areas which really boosted my mood. The only gripe I do have, is the race employees told us to be there by 5 am for this security checkpoint. Literally, I was advised to get there by 20 different people in order to avoid missing the start. The checkpoint consisted of me walking through a cattle shoot which people were jumping to and from. Irritating, because it was extremely chilly in the morning and I literally waited for 2 hours for the start. Really though, I can't express how amazing the experience...tons of spectators, a gorgeous day, and a great finish line experience. The only drawback was seeing people pass out left and right...yikes!

PS--There are two hills! Don't be fooled when people tell you it's a totally flat course. They weren't hard, by any means (I do not run solely flat training runs so NBD for me), but unexpected if you weren't prepared...I heard a lot of cursing and "WTF's" around me at this stage :)

I recently hired Chinnar to cater an event for me (an important pre-wedding celebration). Overall, both the food and service we received from Chinnar was EXCEPTIONAL. Anand (the manager) paid extreme attention to detail, was patient, thoughtful, and extremely organized. He picked amazing staff who were professional and courteous. The food was loved by both Indians and others alike, who raved about how well they were being taken care of. I was so pleased with their services after that I pushed to be considered a reference! 

I cannot wait to use Chinnar for future events, as well as dine at their beautifully decorated restaurant. Great service, AMAZING food, and overall just lovely people. I HIGHLY recommend.

This is a touristy and gimmicky bar that has rotating seating that circle the bar tenders.  After spending a couple hours here, bouncing back and forth to the other side with a tv, I realized that no one was happy here.  Carousels are supposed to be happy but no one was, not the bar patrons and certainly not the bar tenders.  The people next to me called management on one because he wasn't giving them enough water.  Now that's a sign of unhappiness.  Was it because of the lack of water...or the unordered side of attitude that came with it?  Well I have to guess the attitude because I received it later when I politely asked what kind of whiskey was poured in my drink.  Is it always angry here?

Go walk in and see the bar rotating and leave, total gimmick.
This place is decent. Food is good. The only thing I don't care for is how when I get the same meal its a different price for a different worker.

Must try!-
Black Cod: Cooked perfectly. Melts in your mouth. Went well with the accompaniments. 
Meatloaf: Bacon marmalade on top of the meatloaf. 'nuff said. Wait..I'll say more! Moist, well seasoned, perfection!

Great addition to the philly dining scene. I had an amazing meal at Sbraga about a month ago, and looking forward to the many more ahead.

Both my husband and I had an amazing experience at 3000BC.  The therapists and the staff were all polite, professional, and knowledgeable. The massage therapists listened to what our needs were and did a great job working on the troubled areas. We are glad that we gave this spa a try and look forward to returning.

Overall good experience. Be mindful of gift cards and terms of service. They don't allow you to use a gift card with any other promotions which is opposite of what most companies offer. For example, I booked a service that was $20 off for the weekend, because I used my gift card I could not take advantage of the savings for that service for the weekend. I almost feel as though I got cheated. Nonetheless the rest of the service was good. The spa is rather small. For some reason I didn't get the full spa ambiance by being here, no waterfalls, fun lights, etc. The waiting area is in open room with glass walls and the bright light shinning from outside. Reminded me more of a hotel lobby then a spa waiting room. The actual massage was good; however, when it was done I had no desire to stay around as there weren't any relaxing rooms to just sit in afterwards, or at least not any that were offered to me.

There is no place like Dr. Melman's office. Every time I am there I am treated as if I am the only customer and all attention is on me. I would never go anywhere else as long as I live close enough to be one of his patients.

Great little BBQ Spot. Dined here twice during a weeks stay at a nearby hotel.I had the chicken and rib platter both times....wth the Kansas City Sauce. Truly finger licking good, and the mgr and staff were very nice.

There is absolutely no seating nor parking. The coffee is sub-par and the staff and atmosphere is extremely lacking. I like that it is 24/7, but I can never find a place to park nor sit so there is no point in coming here to study. The staff is also loud at late hours, which is annoying when you're trying to get work done. I would rather brew coffee at home and go to the UA library for free.

The food is five stars, the fact that the food took about an hour to come to our table is unacceptable.  It's hard to enjoy yourself when you are looking forward to dining out all afternoon, making sure you have an appetite, only to sit starring at the clock waiting for the food to arrive.  When it finally did come it was delicious, wish we would have had a better experience.


Response to Allykiro V. : Yes, in fact we did wait about an hour before we were served our entre. I don't make up negative things, I promsie.  I would much rather give a good review than a bad one.  I in fact understand that your establishment isn't a fast food restaurant!
