-Location is also less than favorable, but giving them the leeway since they are connected to a large parking area in Sprouts shopping center. 
- Bank statement shows 7ounce Steakhouse. Which, I get it's from the previous establishment, but they should really fix that technical error so people don't get confused - especially if your new in town.

I would recommend this place to family and friends, but with the restrictions that I mentioned above. I did see that they had a separate room to "reserve private parties " which, I'm a big fan of.

a classic in philly. the line was pretty long, so don't come here if your'e dying of hunger and need a quick fix. still it's well worth the wait. i went cheese steak with whiz. my girlfriend had one with mushrooms and provolone. we both were fans, but to be honest, i wasn't amazingly  overwhelmed, hence 4 stars. worth the visit for the indoor market/delis period.

My wife and I have been working out at Platoon Fitness together for over 2 years. After, about a five-month pause due to COVID, we have started back up.  Due to staff turnover from COVID, we started with a new trainer, Brad Martin. 

He asked us what do you want to work on. I told him our ages, mid to later 50's and that we aren't competing for anything and asked, given that, what should we be working on. He said, strength, balance, flexibility, and stamina. 

Ok, so that's the plan. In just 90 days I can say I feel better and stronger than I've ever been. My posture is better and I'm excited to enter ski season feeling so strong. The proof is in my ability to do yard work and physical activity easily and without injuring myself, which was previously quite common. 

I had two shoulder problems over the last 2 years and they both are feeling great. Strong, flexible with a much-improved range of motion and no pain. 

I highly recommend and endorse Platoon Fitness and Brad Martin. 

Let it snow.

quiet time of the day when we entered [lunch...dinner] got drinks quickley ordered french onion soup...the cheese was chokey the broth uneventful,burger for the Mr....salmon B.L.T. for the Mrs....burger nothing special..no flavor..salmon cake ..chopped breaded ..tasted nothing like salmon ..i thought it would be a piece of fish  $ 12.95..upgraded to the sweet potato fries they were great...I was expecting better food...Maybe I just ordered the wrong thing...

The first time we dined at this restaurant was 7 years ago. The food is still amazing! The service is awesome! The garlic knots are other worldly. Also had the Italian wedding soup & a salad -- both were bomb! Megan was our server and she was very attentive.

That lunch buffet was DELICIOUS!  So much variety! Just the right amount of spice! I got there at 11:31am and everything was ready and piping hot!! I was seated, received my naan, had three plates of food (lol), got my mango lassi to go, paid my bill & was out the door by noon in time to hustle back to work hahaha. I will definitely be back!!!
Great local spot. Seriously good food at a reasonable price!

This place is a great spot for some really good cheap pizza by the slice. They have a big menu full of different pizza options and also pasta. Ordered the lasagna and was really impressed. Great spot for lunch or for a casual date. Friendly staff

We were driving back to NJ the day after after Easter with family in Harrisburg.. along the way we decided that we were "hammed' out and in the mood for seafood since it was so gorgeous out. Came along this place and picked up some stuff to go.  We got one of each type of crabcake, and a shrimp cake and a lobster cake.  Heated them up as soon as we got home- was not disappointed!  Hit the spot. The Smith Island was our fave, tons of fresh crab! The lobster cake was great too. Living on the Jersey shore it's hard to impress me with seafood, but this place certainly did.  I usually make my own tartar sauce but we took a chance & bought some here- glad we did! Tangy and delicious.
Yellow rice instead of "Chinese fried rice." Best part of the meal was the fortune cookie.

The swamp tour was one of my favorite parts of my trip to New Orleans! The swamp was beautiful and so relaxing, I felt like I stepped into another world.   We saw gators, hogs, birds and there was no bugs or mosquitos. Captain Tom was funny and informative. Don't forget to bring your camera and try to sit on either end of the boat for best picture taking seats!!

Great local farmer's market!! I have been going here for years for all of my fresh fruits and vegetables. Just recently they started offering a Market Crate full of vegetables and fruits delivered to my door.  How cool is that!! Just like when my parents were kids.  When we go to the store, the kids love to place Spin the Banana. And some how they always win!  Great atmosphere, great service!  A throwback to the days of the past.
Seems as though there was no TSA pre approved. although at 5am it went really fast. more food options then Honolulu International Airport. relatively clean. really Close to Grand Sierra Hotel .

Worst experience ever at Indianapolis International Airport.

Service/Atmosphere:
Champps was busy to the point of having a line of people waiting to be seated. After waiting for a little under 10 minutes we finally made it to the front. I asked the hostess for a menu..she rolled her eyes, sighed, then handed me the menu. Wasn't sure what I did to warrant the irritation. The wait time to get food for dining in was about 30 minutes, to-go was 10 minutes according to the hostess. We opted to get our food to go.
It took them almost 45 minutes. 

Food:
My daughter ordered the chicken finger appetizer. They were lightly breaded which was a plus but they didn't have the expected crunchy exterior.
I ordered a Cobb salad. The chicken was good but that was about it. The bacon was burnt and the tomatoes were mealy. The worst part was the avocado. For some odd reason they were slightly sweet and the texture was quite off putting. It seemed as though it was candied. I ate all of the chicken and picked through the lettuce that wasn't brown or flimsy.

Overall Experience:
I won't be going back. The service was horrible and the food was sub-par.
Food and service were good but they continue to pour to obnoxious drunks and let smokers walk through the restaurant. Very unpleasant visit to one of our fav spots. Disappointed
I don't usually post things, but this is the best torta I've ever had - cubana. They got Axxess deal too!

The food is always so fresh and healthy! I especially love the wraps and salads - great portion sizes at reasonable prices. Definitely try Lilly's if you are in the mood for something nice and clean! Only downside is that it can get quite busy for lunch. Try calling ahead for pick up if you're in a hurry.

Crown Point is a bit of a drive from almost anywhere on the Westbank, but well worth the trip.  I just love the Crabmeat Remick as the appetizer.  I usually get a cup of seafood gumbo, which is very good.  I always try seafood gumbo where ever it is served because my grand father was the Executive Chef for the Fountain Blue Hotel in New Orleans and Chef at the St. Charles Hotel back in the day.  His gumbo set the standard both chicken and seafood, des Familles gumbo is very close with real whole shrimp and lump crab meat.

For the main entree I really enjoy their lightly fried seafood platter with a dirty rice that includes sweet corn in the mix.  My wife doesn't like it because of the corn.  I do because it is a different take an an old food item.  I also have had very good Catfish Almandine, Catfish Foster (very rich) and the Redfish Marcel (a bit pricey).  It is hard to choose when we go, which is usually on Friday nights, about 5:30pm to beat the crowds.

The staff is very efficient, friendly and knowledgeable. I always get my Dixie beer at des Familles.  Dixie beer is hard to get around here.  I do not know why.  However, when they were out the server steered me to another beer with similar qualities off the top of her head.  I was impressed with the selection.  I know it is not wine, but beer goes with seafood my friends.

The ambiance is very nice.  I like the view of Bayou des Familles.   Though in the summer it can be overgrown.  Last time we were there we had a great view of an alligator resting on the shore.  Hope he moved off after we left because he might end up in the very good Alligator Stuffed Mushrooms, yum.  Just kidding.

Check them out.  It is worth the trip.

The location is horrible if you eat outside. Too much foot traffic and many solicitors as you try to eat. Food was good but very overpriced. Took my dad there for his birthday and it was average, although they try to be the best on the block. Good one time but won't be back.

Dude is this a fantastic spot for someone in the need for a Korean fix. Since I left my home town my favorite Korean spot was closed down (damn you Covid) and it had this hip fusion vibe with K-pop music videos, some delicious fusion fries and the best bibimpop.

This gem in Reno it's all the right spots and more, give or take a few items I have yet to really find a replacement for (cheesy buldok for example). But the fries are incredible with kimchi and bulgogi. The bibimpop is so effing delicious with a nice heaping of gojujang (I practically finish the bottle on my rice bowl, and the flavors are so reminiscent to the Bay Area Korean spots. 

The service is always fantastic and I can tell the staff love their job ( or do a great job posing as so). Whenever I make it to Reno I make it a point to hit this spot. My Korean food craving never stops and this place definitely eases that need that comes back shortly after I leave. I would eat here every day if I could.

100% my favorite Korean spot, I've tried a lot more dishes than the few I listed but those are my go-to options, with many more being added as I try new things. 

Thank you for giving me an incredible experience with exceptional food. This is a date night spot for sure.

Metazoa is a very cool spot -- especially if you are a dog owner or an animal lover! I'm always on the hunt for pet friendly restaurants or bars and this one takes the cake. Many people bring their dogs here and they have free treats available at the bar. They also have things like bandanas and other gear available to buy for your furry friends. There is a variety of indoor and outdoor seating. Picnic tables, couches, bars, tables. 

As for the beer- it honestly is not my favorite beer. My boyfriend and I split a flight and sampled most of the choices. Their flights are very cool and available in multiple sizes. In my opinion, a lot of their beers are just okay. I do really like nap in the hammock though, which is a lighter style beer. However, my roommate LOVES their beer, so it truly is just a matter of opinion. Regardless of how much I like their beer, I will continue to be a customer simply because I love the atmosphere and the ability to bring my dog here. A percentage of their proceeds are donated to animals (can't remember specifically to what) and I love that. They also regularly have live music and different events going on.

Business hours aren't correct, it said they were open until 12 on maps, the sign there said 4 am, and when I arrived at 11:30 pm they said they closed at 10. Multiple employees saw us walking around and none bothered to mention they weren't open, just stared at us and waited for us to ask.

So disappointing!  We are Choice Members and usually have great experiences at Comfort Inn & Suites!  I cannot recommend this hotel in Antioch!  

Location is bad.  Hard to enter and the outside noise is too loud even  with the windows closed!  I thought my window was OPEN.  Abandoned building next-door had seedy characters lurking in the shadows.

The smell of Marijuana and cigarettes are overwhelming!  And the counter staff was unfriendly. 

Bed was comfortable and clean sheets.  Won't be back...

We had a wonderful time on the brewery tour and hanging out at the bar. Buck aka Matt aka Will was an excellent guide and will most likely go by a different name each time. The tour is well worth the $10; Buck has a ton of knowledge of the brewing process and the servings of beer for the tasting are hefty! The staff is friendly and engaging, especially Colt! Overall the food and beer are great but the pickle sampler was a little shocking (with pickled plums!) and not that awesome.

This was our first time at this restaurant. We had tabbouleh, felafels, lamb kifta, hummus, various pita breads, and dolma. Everything was very tasty. There are a lot of options for vegetarians. The service was pleasant and caring. We will definitely eat here on our next visit to Tucson. Because it is right on Speedway, the restaurant is not romantic, but it is clean and pleasant, great for lunch. The music is not obtrusive.

Recently had our family reunion for lunch in the Victorian Room and had reserved the entire space. Have been coming here for years as customers for lunch, dinner, events, etc.  The staff did not disappoint! Shout out to the kitchen for doing an exceptional job with our three meal choices. Not an easy task making sure all the meals were at the proper temperature. The crab cakes and steak were a hit. We were very impressed/pleased with our servers Bonnie and Paula. They were both spot on with their attention to detail from start to finish. Another shout out to Marie for all her help assisting a handicapped family member when we needed assistance. Thanks Lambertville Station for making our 44th reunion very special!

Yummy food, lots of options, many of which are healthy. Smallish portions, but very reasonable prices for the quality. Friendly service and nice, casual ambiance. We will definitely return if it's on our path.

Definitely a good spot. After a short wait, we were seated near the kitchen, but it didn't feel like an insult, as it was brightly lit, just as bustling as any other corner or the restaurant and frequently checked for water/cutlery needs. 

While many things appealed to me, in the end I went with the filet mignon, which I ordered medium rare and came just how I liked it: pink but not quite bloooody. The twice baked potato was fantastic. I mean. Oh my. Seriously. The house salad was also quite tasty and a bit nicer than average.

So good. Every. Damn. Time.
I am obsessed with the Flamenkuchen. The pate is divine. I recommend the crawfish bisque to everyone.
With all the great reviews I'm not going to spend a lot of time on this one. Just know this place is awesome!

No Snake Bites!   The bartender made a poor attempt to make a Snake Bite and failed.   So here's link to help them out:   http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Snakebite_(beer_cocktail)
They have their own version of Guinness but it didn't match up.    There version maybe a local favorite, but unfortunately not mine.    It didn't have that certain kick and pleasing after taste.   It was dry and lacked that coarse bitter taste. 

Three stars for the live performance from the Brew Brothers Band!    Rockin' out to a live band playing music from the 70's, 80's, 90's and today's music is awesome!    FYI - They only perform on Friday and Saturday nights starting at 10:30PM til 1:00AM. 


Perfect for Girls Night Out:  Yes!  Especially if it's a bachelorette party!  The place had several parties for the ladies.    My buddies Noah and Jay did pretty good partying with the local ladies!    HUSH!   No details!

Mixed Crowd:  Yes.  The way I like it although the place will get too crowded.

Recommended for visitors:   Yes!   I'd skip the clubs because it's casual dress here, $5.00 admission after 10:00PM (get there early to have dinner), and it's indoors inside the El Dorado area.     There are a lot of threads about "Any Clubs in Reno?"    So this is my big recommend to check it out. 

Serves Dinner:  Yes.   We came here for the drinks and entertainment, so I can't Yelp about the menu.    Will I go back and try the menu?  Maybe.
came in here once when i got my blood drawn, and another time with family just not impressed and very expensive.

Unfortunately, the furniture did not fit appropriately in the room and this was not obvious when it was delivered. I was tossed around for 3 days when calling. The representatives (front desk, salesperson representative and even a manager that did not introduce himself as so) kept on asking me to call back at another time as they will evaluate, having to make phone calls several times a day. After 3 days, a different manager told me that it could not be returned since they have a strict policy about returns and once the delivery team leaves your home it cannot be returned. And that everyone knows about it......That would have been nice to know and for the other people from the store to tell me before having made 6 phone calls over 3 days. Customer service was definitively not straight forward with me and I got the sense depending on the day and the manager, something different could have happened..... I will never purchase anything else from this store.
Very nice folks, fast, and great service. I left actually feeling good rather than suspecting I had been taken advantage of. Would definitely go back as soon as I need another service.

Absolute worst ever!! Don't walk...Run from this company. I Contracted their freight service for shipping a crate of raw materials for my main client. This was critical material needed on a reasonable timeline. 
Freight Center uploaded tracking with a bol that had nothing to do with my crate. After tracking showed delivered and it wasn't here I found this out. It only went downhill from there. Turns out my crate was never actually picked up. After tons of calls, having to explain the entire story every time, they blamed the carrier, then the shipper. No responsibility taken whatsoever! One rep repeatedly said "we have no control over the carriers" Why are they in business then? 
Finally, after charging me an additional $85 they "rescheduled" a pickup. 2 day transit then delivery now stands at 14 days. It made it to the terminal but sits in a trailer until they can get it unloaded. Meanwhile, client is upset, I'm in a major bind all thanks to freightcenter incompetence!
I will never use them again or recommend them to anyone I like!

Scrumptious, delightful, southern, did I mention Scrumptious Lunch!

Went here last minute (thanks for making it easy to make a reservation yelp!) for an early lunch last week.  It was delightful!

First of all a lemonade cocktail that was like a mint julep but with lemon and I believe strawberry instead...knocked my tastebuds and socks off!

Started the fried green tomato salad-two perfectly breaded and fried green tomato salad topped with a perfectly dressed green salad...did I mention the cornbread and biscuits they bring with it???

Shrimp with grits...I had the same "dish" and commanders palace a day earlier and they were both equally rich, delightful, and unique.  It was shrimp backstroking in grits-a sight you must experience.

Move on to desert....I had the baked Alaska...it has a delightful sorbet center...we had another dessert which was delicious too but I think my cocktail had kicked in a bit and I forget which one it was!

Servers were fantastic.  Thank you NOLA for a truly decadent southern summer ladies lunch!

Their online order tracking is painful, meaning you must call in to the store to track a ship to store order. If you order online for ship to store, you get zero useful feedback of your order tracking except "shipped", then if you use their "track order function", you have no way to click on the order and track? Sierra is part of the TJmax portfolio of companies and I hope they can upgrade their ship to store process to be more like REI. 
I have to say the associates at the store were very helpful in tracking down and holding my ship to store order. 
I do feel  the layout of the Meridian store is a bit random.
Finally, I have gotten good deals here so I'm going with 4 stars.

It's a shame there wasn't a way to select NO stars. Repair nightmare. They shouldn't tell people they can work on your computer and get it back to you in two to three days. On the third day they said, sorry, we just figured out you need a new hard drive. It'll take a few days to get here. They kept my computer 2.5 weeks! They hadn't even begun work on it. At the end of the 2.5 weeks I went in and picked up my broken computer and took it to a repair place in Nashville. They fixed it in one day and charged me way less than ubreakifix quoted. Ubreakifix? Run, don't walk, from this sorry excuse for a cell phone/computer repair shop. A day after I'd picked up my computer, they called and said they would fix it for free if I'd bring it back in. They said they felt bad and wanted to "make it right." No thanks. Do it right the first time. I ran my own business for 24 years and I've never seen such a lack of customer service.

I have never gotten a spray tan in my life (I've always been a sun worshipper! ;)) and I can honestly say I'm totally converted!!!  I absolutely LOVE this glow!!! It looks gorgeous and I love how quick and easy it was! Plus Jen completely put me at ease (I was a little nervous actually). Great atmosphere and professionalism!!!  I'm already looking forward to going back!!! :) Mindy Winkler-Jarosinski, Fishers

Love these guys. I got kicked out of Philadelphia archery and gun range trying to purchase a weapon and membership. I was feeling pretty sad and my friend found this place on line. I walked in bought my venessa and a years membership. They gave me two free boxes and let my friend shot free that day. The guys were so laid back it scared me at first, but I have grown to love that about them. The range itself gives off a cod black ops feel. I love it. Given the unfortunate opportunity that you have to use your firearm, the conditions are not going to be perfect. 
P.s. LADIES SHOOT FREE ON TUESDAYS!!!!!!
Delicious steak, amazing salmon!  Get the sweet potato w/butter & brown sugar~yum!!  Outdated decor but with the great service & excellent food, who cares!
I'm a regular here, I don't think there's a food item on the menu that I haven't had and I've never been disappointed. They own up to their mistakes and always do their best to serve you.
Dive bar type place but with truly outstanding wood fire pizza. Do NOT judge this book by it's cover. Fast service and my #1 wood fire pizza place.
Food is great but can be very noisy on football days. Remodeling going on with the porch area really enjoyed the roasted Brussel sprouts in Vinaigrette help is very attentive!

A mix of old meets new, Sugarcube is a dream for fashionistas and frugal shoppers alike, male or female. Every item is hand selected by the dedicated staff, and the owners are passionate about their customers just as they are about their business. Anyone searching for a unique piece that no one else will have should consider this store. 

In the fall, I coveted an 80s-inspired silky black and white blouse with billowy sleeves and slender, buttoned wrists; the back was cut in a sexy but flattering v-shape. Much to my chagrin, the piece was one of the new items and therefore, out of my price range. I'm still a little tormented by the memory of feeling like a stone cold fox in that top. Next time I have a little extra green to shell out on something special, I'm going back.
What a yummy spot for ramen! Very casual! Fresh ingredients! Will def be back! It's also clean, the staff is friendly and easy to find.

I had the burger royal with fries and it was good. The seasoned fries were golden brown & cooked to perfection, the fried egg on the burger was juicy & had great flavor. My wife had the 4 pieces of honey chicken & she gave me some i can say it was amazing. The seasonung on the chicken was out of this world.

Not for the Feint of heart. I get than Anthony Bourdain crowned this the kind of the tri-state cheesesteak Mecca but many will walk away just not getting what make Donkeys an institution. Donkeys is a corner bar in the corner of Camden off a corner of Haddon Ave. It's a hideaway a place that Harley's back to the days of old, a place that could have been featured in American Hustle and not changed because the bar hasn't. I remember trips with my father as a small child and the bartender bringing over pitchers of Budweiser and serving them in paper cups. The clientele is what you want for Camden, working class men of all races creeds and colors, coming together to practice the holy communion of lunch of the working class. This is why donkeys is the Sistine chapel of the cheesesteak, it's hat it represents that all the other places has gotten away from; this is a working class sandwich for a working class people going to a working class bar. They have but one sandwich, one bread and one option, (onions or not) to share with the masses, and so the masses come because they know that breaking bread and cheesesteaks at donkeys is communion for Camden county...

Some nights you get great service, other nights you won't see a server or your food will take 1-2 hours.

Good food/beer specials. 
Food is decent bar food.

Inconsistency in service/food times is a big issue. We have walked out multiple times due to wait times.

If you go for lunch you will have a good experience. Dinner, is awful.

My dad came into town to visit. He wanted to go and try this place... we stood at front door for 13 min before even being approached by an employee. The employee was a food prep to go get someone to at least seat us to a table.  After finally being seated waited another 30 min after a waitress comes to offer us to order a drink. After our drinks came we waited another 20 min before we finally decided we had spent almost an hour already there for what ? To order a water? 
We got up and left.... will not be back! Sad thing is the place wasn't busy at all none!
Not nearly as much of a dive as we pictured. happy hour deals going til 8 pm were a plus.

If I could rate them higher, I would. John, David and Anna are the nicest, warmest people that one can meet. That they are so personable and make you feel extremely comfortable is fantastic!

I got a pocket clock tattoo from John which is an amazing piece of art! Highlights of my experience:-

1. Extremely welcoming atmosphere in the shop
2. Clean and extremely hygienic!
3. Fun conversations with the artists 
4. John has a feather like touch, the session was a breeze! 
5. Good explanation of the aftercare process and I got a few bar recommendations too!! :)

When I have the next idea of what I want to get, I know I am going back here only!

I really wanted to like my food but the Korean Noodles had NO MEAT. I even asked the cashier and she said no no it's in there mixed in with the noodles... but there was none. So I had noodles, then rice and salad..... variety not so great. $9 for a meal that lacks protein not happy about. 

I've had Korean food all over the state and Korean meat is sooo good. Really disappointed. I gave an extra star for their salmon... my mom let me try it as I had no protein..... but also $10 a bit pricey for a lunch room meal..

Fortunate enough to be seated without having reservations. Located in the heart of downtown Reno in a small fine Asian cuisine restaurant. I ordered the house chow mien and the chef special shiitake mushrooms. I received exceptional service with menu recommendations. The food pleasing to my taste buds. I would recommend trying out the restaurant with the exception of having reservations.
Greatest pizza ever. Stacy our server was amazing super attentive and very pleasant. Great place to eat!

I eat here every time I'm in the quarter...it's a ton of food for not too much cash!  I've never been able to finish despite how tasty all the food is.  The hickory burger and loaded potato combo is my favorite.  Can be a bit loud at times but it's a small price to pay:)

This place serves real food with real ingredients!! Very flavorful!! Hard to find quality and taste that matches the square meal. I had the McFadden. Was awesome. Every ingredient compliments each other. They had good music playing and it was a really great vibe from the second i walked in the door.

The workers here probably saw the lost look on my face when I walked in because they were very helpful with my copying needs! I did have to wait a while but that was just because there were a lot of individuals that needed help too, but they were prompt when it was my turn to get help. They offer a student discount, so be sure to show them a cat card if you have one. All in all, very pleased with how helpful they were.

Don't always have the best specials, but the food is decent and so is the atmosphere. Their chicken strips appetizer is HUGE for an appetizer - I always have it as a meal and usually even have some leftover! Their spicy potatoes are amazing, and their hot wings are delicious, too! Service is sometimes spotty, so I tend to sit at the bar and it's great!
This casino is really fun, but some of the bartender did not came back even tho I tipped them good amount of money. Also they have a non smoking area which is perfect for me because I am not a smoker

Hadn't been here in years, so was curious to see if it was still good and it is! Great NY/Philly style pizza at a good price. I ordered takeout and it was ready earlier than expected. Yes, it's a neighborhood spot but worth the detour if you're in the area.

IMHO, this is the best sandwich place in Reno.  My favorite sandwich is the smoked tri-tip with havarti cheese.

Check out their catering too.  I had them cater my party and the food received great reviews.

Our conversation at brunch went something like this: "This is the best biscuit I've ever had" to "this is the best breakfast I've ever eaten" to "this is the best food on earth." The shrimp Toast was divine, the chicken and biscuits has the perfect blend of heat and sweetness. But the biscuit with butter and jam is simply the best you will ever eat.  It's light, it's flaky, it's buttery, it's slightly crunchy on the outside, and the inside is pure heaven.  You may need to wait for a table, but you won't regret it.

i went here with a group of friends yesterday evening for some drinks. first off, the place is really, really dark. if you're walking in out of the sunshine, be prepared for temporary blindness until your eyes adjust. also, expect to need to read your menu with the candle on the table. we took over a lounge area with couches and a couple small tables. i didn't order any mixed drinks, but friends of mine got a few mojitos. they came with a piece of sugar cane in them. i tried the classic mojito and it was very tasty. not too sweet, but just right. we also ordered the guacamole with black truffles. it was awesome. instead of tortillas, the guacamole was served with plantain chips. delicious.  i highly recommend it. the only annoying thing is that it's a bit of a pain to get to the bathroom from the bar. it's tucked back past the kitchen on the second floor. stumbling up and down stairs isn't fun in heels during a day-long bachelorette party. i would love to go back here for an actual meal in the upstairs dining room.

Rude service. The lady up front didn't even look at me or greet me when I came up, she literally just was like "what you want?" And I tried to just brush that off and order anyways but when she gave me my pizza she just handed it to me and walked away, no words or nothing. Was just really rude and later to find out that lady was the manager. Why is someone like that a manager?

Wow, the food was delicious!! They have lots of different options to choose from. I think the staff may seem short with people but they can go through a line very quickly because they're working so fast. I thought it was a great place for lunch!! The food is great! Fresh chicharrones! OMG yummy!!!!!!
Really funky saloon vibe. Tony, our server, was great. We had the ribeye and a mud pie for desert. Plain food with a perfectly cooked steak. Go for the food And friendly service.

I am sorry this place isn't closer to us because we have had consistently good experiences.  The menu changes fairly often so I cannot recommend some of our favorite things (scallops with black squid mousse for instance), but we have never had anything we did not enjoy.
Unlike some of the reviewers, we have found the service to be very good both in the lounge and the restaurant. The charcuterie plate and the cheese plate in the Lounge are tasty with some less usual offerings (tongue pastrami, smoked trout--although the selection changes!), but the new drink and food pairing plates are really fabulous. Both the drink selection and service have gotten over their newbie bumps and now suit the gorgeous space.
I appreciate the creativity in the restaurant although it means some things remembered as delicious no longer are available. Perhaps they will return--we certainly will.

I LOVE this little cafe. I stop by almost every morning and see the staff freshly prepping everything. Everyone here is so friendly and their coffee and bagels are awesome. If you're looking for a place to work on your laptop or catch up with a friend/coworker, this is the perfect spot... and I haven't even tried lunch yet! Love this spot in the am before work.

Arrived around 7:45. After being told they were out of oyster, we ordered boiled shrimp, we also orders soups. Soups came after our food, even though ordered as starters.  Our boiled shrimp was served without potatoes and corn even though we were told it came with it because they were out. When asked about a discount due to lack of dish inclusions, the waitress said no, she'd give us extra potatoes next time. There will be no next time! She was rude, food was cold not to mention missing half its items. She even got huffy when we asked for some biscuits to replace the potatoes, she never brought any.  We will never be back!

I heard of this place from one of my coworkers and was excited to try it out since I recently just moved to the area. WE ended up ordering pick up since they were booked for reservations that night. When arriving to pick up our food we could tell they were a popular place by how busy they seemed to be. 

We started with the fried chicken buns. They were ok, very dry, and needed a lot more sauce. Next, we got the spicy chicken momo. Not impressed. Super peanuty and I could hardly taste any other flavor. After, we ordered the brisket ramen. It was good but nothing incredible. The matzo ball was delicious as well as the Kimchi but it was not spicy whatsoever which was very disappointing since on the menu it stated it was spicy. Lastly, we ordered the coconut curry ramen which was by far the best dish. It was super flavorful and the noodles were cooked perfectly.

CHG restaurants are not my favorite spots to eat as the food is normally bland or inedible and the service left to be desired.

On the couple of occasions I have attended LUX, the experience has been much better.

They now have a host who comes around to ask if you need anything, grab your coat, etc and supplements the service provided by your server. It is a nice touch and I suppose adds to the lux nature.

The prices are a little bit higher than are warranted and having to find parking can be an annoyance, including having to pay so validation would be nice, but generally our experience is good here.

The calamari appetizer is nice, I would get it again.
I had Chef Matt's special sriracha fried chicken with corn and fries that was off menu and it was wonderful. The corn needs to be added to the everyday menu.

The side of mushrooms is always a treat as well and the desserts, especially the carrot cake are both well worth it.

All in all Lux is a good experience on the higher end of price and service is typically fine. Check it out.

Food was delicious and the service was great.  I got the bison burger and would recommend it for sure!  Looks like they had a nice drink selection as well, but was with the boss so I couldn't indulge.

Everyone loves the food here but I haven't been able to find anything to confirm that. Its not a bad place at all just not what I expect. It's ok. The atmosphere is great and the beer list is usually pretty good. The burger is probably the best thing I've had here but nothing to write home about. I will say that brunch is their better option. 

I sat at the bar and the service was not very good. The bartenders dropped us a menu and never came back. Had to flag them down for a drink and they never asked if we wanted food so we had to flag them down again. The bar isn't that big and there were 3 of them. I bartended for a long time so let's go guys, get it together. Busy or not it's quite simple to give decent service.

I honestly did not really enjoy my experience at this salon. When I went, it was my first time. The stylist barely talked to me or paid attention to me. She did not offer any suggestions nor tried to hold a conversation of make me feel comfortable. After I went home after my service, I had dark hair die all at my roots, which clearly meant she did not put enough stuff by my roots to prevent that or she did not wash my hair out fully. I just felt such a disconnect at this studio. I prefer a much more interactive experience when getting my hair done.

4 stars for a heavy, delicious brunch! i really enjoyed their little sweet sticky buns. the huervos rancheros was so delectable! i really recommend it. somehow, every bite included a mix of southern deliciousness that i really hadnt had in a long time on a brunch plate. i highly recommend those. and the BMW pancakes are really really good in the first 5 bites before it becomes to heavy. So maybe you can take a few bites of your friends dish and order something savory (like i did haha)

the dinner was good, but i prefer the brunch here! this place does southern food pretty well.

Mai Lee is definitely a 4/5 star place.  I particularly enjoy their noodle soups.  The noodle soups come in a giant bowl with a plate overflowing with vegetables.  Basically, you get an enormous quantity of high-quality food for around 8 dollars.  I can barely finish it, and I am a big eater.

My dog has come home twice limping with no explanation. Always drinks two bowls of water when he comes home so I'm assuming they don't get enough water. I will be finding a new place. Plus the staff is really young and don't care what goes on. No one communicates either. Management is useless too and doesn't take responsibility for their employees actions...or lack there of them.

Graat tour Tommy is funny and entertaining! Using his phrase"it was more than Adequate"!

I highly recommend Tommy. About a 4 hour tour!  Lots of information and tons of laughter!    

Best $45 bargain!!

I sometimes help out with feeding the homeless in Reno at 4th and Record.  We usually cook the food ourselves.  But once I had a friend tell me she couldn't make it, but she wanted to give me $30 for 30 McDonald's burgers anyway.  Ooookay.  The people at the drive-through didn't even blink.  They said they just needed 10 minutes and they were ready.  And let's be honest, when I showed up at the feed with 30 cheeseburgers, the first 30 people in line nearly jumped for joy.

This is pretty much the nearest McDonald's from Incline Village - 30 minutes, door to door.  In some places of America, this would be considered amazing, considering the plethora of fast food places in most of suburbia.  To be honest, I sometimes stop here on my way to Reno for a bathroom break.  I don't really use the Wifi here, but the few times I've used it, it's been actually pretty good.

We just love  going to the drive-in! Such a blast from the past ! Places like this are a real
Boon to the community. A way to have some inexpensive family bonding or a great date. This place has clean restrooms &snack bar. Vintage but tidy.We love that we can bring our chihuahua and some snacks with us . Smoke, have a drink ,,,know what I mean?     
   The snack bar is pretty reasonably priced & offers refills on a large  popcorn,So that's cool. They have diner items like pizza burgers, burritos.Bring small bills$Cash for your tickets, please?You can sit in your car or bring some chairs and blankets. But TURN OFF your running LIGHTS and dome lights so everyone can see better?Maybe arrive on time
so you don't disturb the show while you park?They often offer a double feature making "drive-in night"a real bargain !

I was a little skeptical going here because it was fairly new, but I LOVED it!! Great salon, awesome customer service & complimentary wine  I will for sure be back and I would recommend it to everyone! They have a ton of colors to choose from and different manicures and pedicures instead of just the basics, which I really liked!

There are a few reasons why I love this place and it all started when I stumbled across their huge OPEN sign one winter Saturday night, (eventually leading to my affectionately calling them Maki Maki Open) because they were the only place I could find in the vicinity open late on weekends...until 2AM actually.

But wait, it gets better.

They have a full service lounge that is available to be booked and is a perfect venue for a private party, especially if your peeps like to dance! I threw a party there and was able to bring in my own DJ - we had about 30-40 people and they decorated the lounge for us before we got there as a special touch. Service was awesome, and they even provided us with a dedicated bartender.

Let's talk about the food.

I love to get the assorted sashimi boat. They serve the sashimi nice and cold and I highly recommend asking for the special spicy sauce that really enhances the flavor of each fish. The octopus is fantastic!

My favorite roll has to be the Deja Vu Roll which I ended up remembering (they have a ridiculously HUGE selection of rolls) by how it kept me coming back again, and again and again = sushi deja vu. :)  On one of my latest visits I gave the Erotic Roll a try which was definitely different, with a vinegar-y sauce and topped off with scallop sashimi....very artfully assembled, I must add.

Did I mention they have TWO patios?? Check them out in the summer...great place off the Ave to just chill on a warm summer night.

Lastly, ample parking...always a bonus.

I ordered for delivery and it was my first time trying this place. I got wonton soup, edamame, and sushi. My 4th bite into my wonton soup, I pulled up my spoon and found a BEETLE. MY FOURTH BITE! So disappointing, I went out on a limb to try a new place and it's infested. I won't be back.
If you get anything get the BURGERS the G.O.E Burger is SOOO good.. The quality is consistent nice and clean , And Sunday brunch is 10-2pm 15.99 for adults 7.99 for kids

Would love to give 0. No updates, no information for weeks. We finally got a hold of them only to be told that they do not have the appliance and they would try to find something that matched. DISHONEST 
DO NOT. ORDER FROM THEM!
Now attempting to get a refund.  UGH

It's only a week or so old at this point, I think, so in a month or so the stars may go up if the kitchen has worked out the kinks...

...starting with the salt.  Seriously.  Olives are salty.  Capers are salty.  There is really no need to add MORE salt to some of these dishes that include copious amounts of said olives or capers.

We started with the steak tartare and cherry tomato salad.  The tomato salad was the clear winner, due at least in part to the awesome grilled croutons that came alongside.  The steak tartare, alas, fell victim to the oversalting sickness going on in the kitchen.  Again, capers, y'all.  Salty.

Onward to the "larger" plates: the catch of the day, swordfish, and the skate.  With tapenade.  Salty salty salty tapenade.  The skate itself was delightful -- crispy at the edges, tender but not mushy inside, perfectly seasoned.  The tapenade was (obviously) way too salty.  The swordfish was good and really beautifully presented with crushed green picholine olives and lovely browned crisp fingerling potatoes.  This was the one dish that included olives or capers that did not taste like it had emerged from a salt mine.

Last dish of the night was an espresso pot de creme topped with a citrus confit.  I really really wish I had an iphone (for so many reasons, but in this case...) so I could have taken pictures.  The pot in which the pot de creme arrived was seriously the most adorable pot I have ever seen.  Ok, the dessert itself was good as well, smooth, rich, potently flavored, and the citrus was a nice match to the espresso.  But the pot.  So cute.  Add in the tiny spoons and the glossy citrus zest on top of espresso goodness and you basically have a perfect picture.

Non-food related commentary...

This place is in the old Melograno space (*sniff*).  Not a big space.  So when we walked in, we certainly didn't expect to be greeted by the Screaming Trees "I nearly lost you" playing at full blast.  Smooth yellow walls with simple framed photos on the wall, soft lighting coming from the silverware-chandeliers, lush wood tables, and loud ass rock music.  Right.  The playlist was equally disjointed and confused, ranging from the aforementioned Singles soundtrack to something that may or may not have been some kind of pop/easy listening situation like.. Josh Groban or something.  Even so, I could have handled the insane playlist had I not also been concerned for rupturing an ear drum or ending up with tinnitus.

On the service side, things are also still a little confused.  Midway through our wait for our "larger" dishes my fiance was like, "A lot of waiting in this place."  True story.  I don't know if it's a lack of defined sections or a lack of communication between kitchen and floor, but the waits between app and entree and entree and dessert were both far too long, especially for two fish entrees that probably required at most ten minutes or so of cooking time and a dessert that obviously must be pre-made and just pulled from the fridge.  That said, everyone was friendly and helpful and our server was very knowledgeable about the menu.

Salt festival aside, we'll probably be back to check out the scene in a few weeks or so.  My understanding is that they'll still be BYO then, which only helps them in my book, so hey... New restaurant that is temporarily a BYO = basically guaranteed a repeat visit from me.

Fantastic store!! Their service is superior, prices are right in line with online, and selection is massive. I have been shopping online for weeks, looked at every lighting website, and with their help, found perfect lighting for my renovation! Definitely recommend!

It's not bad but it's not mind blowing either.  The appetizer I had "Flash Fried Oysters" were good but not great.  I guess when you fry oysters they all taste the same... The fillet mignon I had was cooked to perfection but there was something missing... I guess his "BAM!" I don't know what it is and I can't put my finger on it.  Overall the dish was decent  just not as good as Bobby Flay's steak at the Mesa Grill.  

The dessert to me was VERY DISAPPOINTING.  I asked the waiter what he recommended and everyone around me was ordering the Banana Creme Pie.  It's not the traditional banana cream pie we know and love.  It doesn't have the banana custard or the whip toppings.  It's a mix between a cheese cake and a pie....just not as flavorful.  I say get the creme brulee.  

Bon appetit!

My son, daughter in law & granddaughter ate there Friday night.   I had pollo en pipian verde & the chicken was done beautifully.   It's hard to good chicken at a restaurant.   The sauce was best sauce I've ever eaten.   Rice was cooked al dente, very good.  We had flan which had an excellent texture and was made by the owner. Our server did a great job explaining the 6 or so specials.  She was also very accommodating to my granddaughter.   I live in Skippack and will go there again with my boyfriend.

Pretty good donuts but the lady wasn't very nice :/ and of you get a mixed dozen they restrict what kind you can get between 'fancy' 'raised' & 'cake'. -_- so you dont even get what you really want
 Not going back. Better to just go somewere else and get to pick what I want.

My experience with FF was two years ago. It still haunts me and makes me angry. They left my baby's body at the vet's office, never picking her up, after arrangements had been made. At two weeks, I had called to see if she was ready to be picked up, and was told they had to check but should be. No word. At three weeks, I called again, just to have the owner berate me on the phone, accuse me of never calling and lying about it (I would have no reason to do that). It wasn't until a bad review on Facebook that the owner tried to half-handedly apologize, but still wouldn't take responsibility for what had happened. My experience was unfortunately not a one-off. Many have had similar bad experiences. I still have nightmares about my baby being in the freezer compartment at the vet's office and never being picked up. I still cannot comprehend someone dropping the ball so severely, then trying to blame the customer for it. I would never recommend this company to anyone.

You never know what you'll find at this store, the selection for kids clothing isn't that great, but if you are shopping for adults it is abundant and the selection change daily! Its not just clothes here either, I came looking for a new pair of yoga pants and ended up with a new blue kayak they had for sale, so you never know here. The location is close to Tyrone mall and their parking lot is huge, so its never a hassle to park and get inside like some stores. The main reason so many come to this store are the prices, compared to stores in the mall it is definitely cheaper shopping at Marshall's.

I have been a long time customer of Eastwood, and very happy for the most part. However, on a recent purchase I noticed that one day after ordering a dual speed  buffer they reduced their price for the item by $14.00. I initially went through Amazon, and then through Eastwood for a price adjustment. I was told that they wouldn't be able to help me but that I could return the item if I paid return shipping and a 15% restock fee. Then it was suggested that I could re-purchase the item for $14.00 less! So the restock fee comes to $32.10 and then shipping on a 60 pound item must be around $50 bucks...Not sure if their customer service rep thinks she is funny, but I did not. I understand that no company is perfect but Eastwood made zero effort to keep me as a customer. Guess business is pretty good for you guys. At least I am "gaurenteed" 100% satisfaction! I know it's true cause I read it on their web site!

North 3rd is always a win. The atmosphere is cool, the food and drinks amazing. Parking is usually pretty easy; I've never had to drive more than a block away. The staff has always been courteous and friendly. In the four years or so that I've gone there I've yet to have any sort of a bad experience.

For pizza and price you can't beat this place.  I'm telling you, after my spot 11th street pizza I think closed it was hard to find good cheap eats.  I've ordered from this place about 3x times and always get the 2 pie special and add chicken.  The pizza crust has flavor, the sauce doesn't taste like it's out of a jar or can, and the chicken is seasoned.  I don't know what their other food is like, but even if it's garbage I'd still go back just for the pizza and will continue too.

The Franklin Flea may call itself a flea market, but as other reviewers have mentioned, the items are more vintage and at a much higher price range than what you would usually find at a flea market. It's very reminiscent of the short-lived Brooklyn Flea in the Piazza, though with less of an emphasis on the furniture.

With that being said, the Franklin Flea is a really cool use of the old Strawbridge's building. The location is stellar-- near both the PATCO station and the Market East station, plus there's parking lots right there as well.

There were some really cool vendors there-- old jewelry and select furniture pieces are what this bazaar specializes in. There is a wide range of clothes, but as I mentioned before, you're paying retail prices (or higher) for clothes that have already been worn. Not really my jam.

Ya'll it's time to BREAKOUT of your routine!  To heck with Netflix & Chill or hanging at the bar (although Netflix & Chill is life), mix it up with your friends and head to the south side for challenging,  exciting, and fun night of crime fighting - brain teasers - and o really I missed that moments! 

Yelp Elite took over BREAKOUT south local for a challenging night of fun, because homeostasis is overrated. Breakout is an escape room type of challenge with, I believe over 8 different mysteries to solve.  I can't give you the answers because we've been sworn to secrecy, but the Museum Heist was my favorite challenge! 

I'm pretty sure this is was my grade school reading Nany Drew has trained me for.   It's also an excellent team building experience and it's amazing the traits you get to see come out in people when they're locked in a room with only 45 minutes to solve the case!

The facility was clean and fun.  The staff was incredibly helpful and polite. You can definately tell they really LOVE working there. 

I recommend going in a larger group because you get a better price deal - we definately can't wait to go back!

I like this place but it is less sports bar and more karaoke/music bar. The food is fantastic. It's typical bar food but done very well. French fries are from fresh cut, whole russet potatoes, you never get that at other restaurants.

Beer prices are good and happy hour is all day but it really is all about the food for me. That boy is a genius on the hot plate.

From Topeka, Kansas to Los Angeles, California, I've been to many Thai restaurants around our great country.

This one is good.  Especially good for St. Louis County.  

The green curry is on point.  I ordered mine at a 3 (1-5 in spiciness) and it came out perfect.  I've tried the pad thai and pad see ew, and both were excellent.  The spring rolls and other appetizers were good as well.

Basically, a solid place that is most welcome in STL county.  And surprisingly better than some Thai places in south city, though I won't say their names here.

HONEST, not upselling, fast, convenient, fantastic auto shop! I'm not kidding, I don't think I've ever had such a great experience with a mechanic--it makes me feel so comfortable knowing my car is in great hands and not at the expense of my wallet. Jim is so unbelievably genuine, you want to have him over for dinner! He was very professional and knows HIS stuff! 
I will be sure to bring any and all of our car needs back here...and a plus: support small local businesses! Thanks again Jim :)

This place is absolutely out of this world. It's hard to find on the street because of the vestibule, but I enjoyed that it was secluded and that you had to talk to a host through a peep hole in the door. The decor is phenomenal but the food is unbelievably delicious. Christina was our server and she was extremely efficient, kind, and friendly. My boyfriend and I were so full when we were done but did not regret a single bite. I will never forget my experience at Alpen Rose.

Great FroYo, and the owner is very friendly every time we come in. 

Good pricing, plenty of options and toppings.

The place was less than half full and the hostile hostess would not seat three of us at a table for six because our entire party was not there. Tried to reason with her, and she got worse.  I hope their food is better than their customer service.

I was initially introduced to MDG Salon several months ago when they hosted a Yelp event. I loved the ambiance and all of the staff were friendly. I also liked that it was just 2 blocks away from my apartment downtown. There's no designated salon parking, but I went during the day on a Friday and was able to find metered street parking right across the street. 

One of my good friends referred me to go see Belinda. Belinda is knowledgeable about different hair types, textures, and cuts. I needed something that would work when I wear my hair naturally wavy, when I straighten it, and when I curl it - that's exactly what I got. She also styled it beautifully and just how I wanted. Not to mention, the girl is super entertaining and hilarious. 

The stylists all have varying rates for their services, but Belinda's cuts are $65.

Great prices. I usually get a gel manicure, which lasts 2-3 weeks. Not the friendliest service. Also, not the most organized when they are busy. If you go at a busier time, be prepared to wait. They will do fun designs if you ask or show them pictures. 
They'll try to get you to get an eyebrow wax, but it's only $10 and they do a good job.
Nice quiet place right along 4th street in downtown.  We only had drinks, but the double rye old fashioned was very good.  The service was a little slow for the number of people in the place.

Mei World Pizza has pizza and something that you not imagine they have it - The Taiwanese cuisine. I was able to take picture of the whole Chinese menu for the patrons who look forward what they are cooking. They are very flexible and they can cook to your order - meaning not in the menu. 

Mei World Pizza has another name in Chinese. The beautiful food World. Which mean the great food of the world. The specialty include noodle that is home made by hand from the kitchen. These noodles are not buying from grocery store. As a result, it creates the specialty of the restaurant with the fresh made noodle. Every Saturday weekend has fresh made dumpling. They are not frozen. They will made and cook at the spot. In winter, they cure their own meat and sell it on the February, March and April.  During that time you find the cure meat food that is not in the menu. 

The secret is out. Go enjoy the beautiful bowl of soup noodle or have them cook a special cuisine for you. I will be back to try their different food.
My favorite place in pinellas to get sushi! The staff is so nice and remembers me every time I come in. The sushi is out of this world and there hot dishes are delish!

After driving by this place a couple times per week for the last few months, I finally decided to check it out for lunch today and I'm so happy I did! The lunch special of 3 tacos was very good and if I was able to eat at the restaurant, I'm sure I would have ordered more!

My order (as pictured): 2 Tinga de Pollo (chicken) tacos and 1 Chorizo taco. Just the right level of spice and the addition of the multiple variations of salsa/hot sauce were perfect. Can't wait to try more of their options in the future!

Stopped by for a visit for potential day home for my 12 year old, well-behaved dog. We were told that this facility does not accept any dog over 9 years old.  Went to Knine2Five.They do a in-house temperment test on each individual dog-- we now have day care & boarding home!

Nicck Townsend is an amazing esthetician who is VERY professional but produces amazing results . His work speaks for itself . He will evaluate and accommodate whatever need or concern you may have . I have known Nicck for many years and he produces nothing but exemplary work!!! Please visit his salon in East Falls you will not be disappointed !!!
good pizza good customers service the only thing didnt likis u have to ordera day ahead to get byob wich good for friend getting together but goos spot

The first time I went I was left waiting in the exam room for over 30 minutes. Someone did come in and let me know an emergency had walked in right before me, so I stayed. Then I took my son and we waited almost 30 minutes. I just took my son for his next scheduled cleaning and they made us wait AN HOUR (it would have been longer, but I walked out). The ONE doctor was working on the same patient since before I got there. There is no hygienist at this facility, the dentist does everything and causes a huge backup in patients. Nobody came in to let us know it would take awhile. Nobody called me ahead of time to say the other dentist wouldn't be there & ask me to reschedule. There was zero communication. I asked the assistant who did the x-rays how much longer and she said, "he's almost done. He'll be right in." I asked if that meant he was cleaning up or what and she said, "yes". She lied. I waited 5 more minutes and walked my son out. I saw the assistant hiding in a back room as I loudly announced we were leaving. The dentist was literally in the room next to me with no doors, so he knew we had been waiting. I heard him chit-chatting in between whatever he was doing to that patient. We will never go back. Who makes a little kid wait over an hour for a cleaning? Horrible horrible service. On top of that, you have to call months ahead for an appointment so now my son is behind on his scheduled check-up and cleaning because I need to find a new dentist. Don't go here. I hope they close.

Before they expanded their hours, I had a few failed attempts on dining here for dinner. On one of my favorite small blocks of the city, Urban Element -- since re-opening under new ownership -- has crafted a menu that's been missing from Indy. 

First up, that block it's on. The block is small, and maybe that's why I love it. On one side of the street you have Datsa Pizza & Urban Element. On the other it's The Ambassador with the first floor bar -- all in the shadow of the Central Library. Maybe it's how narrow Penn is... maybe I'm delusions of grandeur and like staring up at tall buildings while eating. 

The menu that's been missing. Since living in Los Angeles for a long while, I love mid-priced lunch menus that have a healthy slant: entree salads for under $10. Now don't go huffing and puffing because you want your deep-fried fix -- they have that too. And they serve beer. Yes, beer at lunch is quite all right. Really, it is. Handle yourself much unlike you didn't handle yourself at your Big Ten school. It's okay. A cream ale with a salmon salad is just fine. 

I opted for a curry chicken salad sandwich. Is curry chicken salad it's own genre? Lunch's own oeuvre? Is "Curry Chicken Salad" nom de guerre for a suave Ceylonian spy hunter in the War For Awesome? Because this curry chicken salad is silky and woo-ing me to order it everywhere I go. 

Urban Element's version... terrific. The whole chicken makes a difference. I didn't ask what chicken they used but I liked it. Annnnnd... it's green curry paste! Now you see... the traditional batch is yellow curry. Here, green. It's easy being green if you're the curry in me. 

It's listed as on grilled or deep fried pita. I'm not interested in the deep fried. The pita as it is was solid. 

The chips were damn good chips. I do believe these are house cut, house fried potato chips. 

I'll be back for the entree salads, the porch sitting under the library. If there's ever place to pay to drink a cream ale or just sit outside of your home, it's this place.

We were slightly disappointed at our recent visit to the restaurant this past weekend.  I have read such rave reviews and decided along with our traveling companions to make this our "special" dinner as it was our anniversaries. I called over a month ago to request the Chef's table, and was informed it is booked months in advance.  That being the case, I requested a nice table in a quiet and unique area of the restaurant.  Upon arrival we were shown to the Garden Room.  Our table unfortunately was tucked in a corner, right across from the wait staff preparation area.  Our waiter Eric, although very nice, did not give adequate attention to our table.  Kate, our second waitress, was not only friendly, but the more attentive of the two.  

With regard to food - My husband and I shared the escargot for appetizer, which was okay. I had the pecan encrusted fish which was very good, and he had the seafood bouillabaisse which he liked very much.  The whiskey bread pudding was just average. Our bill was steep, which isn't a problem, as we often dine in NYC, but for what we paid and after requesting a nice table for a special occasion, I do not feel the cost was well deserved.

My initial thoughts?

Not bad, a bit outdated but not terrible. Security was a breeze and everyone was friendly. 

My only compliant? The rental car building felt like a trek getting there and the southern humidity doesn't help. Shuttle, anyone? I believe there are plans to get one...but, until then, you'll sweat your hair out getting there.

My bf and I came here on a very good reccomendation from a friend so we were excited. On first impression, after we seated ourselves since no one approached us ( I understand it's a dive bar, but still not even a hello from the three workers) was it was kinda dirty, even for a dive bar. We sat at a booth against the wall. The booth had not been wiped down from the previous eater and the air conditioner mounted on the wall above us was dripping onto the table and our arms, kinda gross. Tried not to look at the dirty floors, seats etc.. cause I was really hoping the good reviews of the food would make it worth it. We ordered 10 lemon pepper parm wings, 10 medium buffalo wings and a basket of the house cut fries. And the French onion soup. The food was good, not amazing like I was hoping. After reading review and off of my friends opinion I thought the wings would compare to Currans or Jughandle, but they were pretty bland. The slow service and lack of refills on beer and soda also just make this place a below average wing dive bar.

Went October 22 to see LPO. The place is beautiful and the sound was great but the view was horrible.  Maybe it was just our seats (entire row) because we had a bar that split our view of the orchestra.  We had to lean forward to be able to see entire orchestra and soloist. We were on the third floor.  There was only one elevator and going up those stairs was nearly impossible.

Aweful experience. Pain in the butt. Way over priced to cook your own food. Our waitress gave us the wrong cheese fondue and then never checked in with us. Service was slow food was awful. You had to cook it yourself with no timer to see how long you cooked it for. If you don't have a watch your screwed with way over cooked food or under cooked. I will never go back.

Awesome place! Great food, service and a fun place to watch the game! I almost walked past because it was noisy downstairs and I really wanted to watch the football game. They have a great room upstairs with a fun atmosphere to enjoy the game. John was a fantastic server. The bathroom was clean and had my favorite soap! I highly recommended this place!

This place is terrible. First of all, boneless chicken is just chicken nuggets. I guess I thought the boneless chicken here is like every other wing restaurant where it's a boneless drummie. I was told it would be a 15 to 20 minute wait for my order. I sat in front of the register where I ordered and after 30+ minutes of waiting I asked someone to check on my order. It was sitting there for who knows for how long. No one ever told me my order was ready even though I was sitting right there. When I got home I did not have the correct amount of chicken that I ordered. I was short several pieces of chicken and no sauces.   This is my third visit here and every time there's an issue with extremely slow service. No wonder the restaurant is always empty. Never going back!

Chilly dining room so bring a jacket.  I think it may be because they have the wood fired oven in the dining room so they are having to bump up the ac to negate that.
Ordered the sangria which was good.  Calamari appetizer was good.  Pizza was good.  Nothing really reached great yet nothing was really wrong.  We'd like to go back and try other menu items.

I would give the food 3.5-4 stars but the space was a little concerning. The wings were tasty and flavorful. My favorite sauce was sesame teriyaki! The rice was fine (special sauce adds good flavor). The bathroom wasn't very clean. Restaurant is mostly handicap accessible but it's tight. I'd return for takeout. The prices are reasonable.

Early one Saturday morning in August. we decided to take an impromptu trip to New Orleans. We went to Bourbon Street Saturday night, and early Sunday morning we were looking for something to do. We remembered a coworker had mentioned Tree and his wonderful tours a few months ago. We called Tree up at 9:30 am, and despite it being last minute, he agreed to take us on both the Garden District and Voodoo Tour that day. We got really lucky that he was available at the last minute. We met him in the Garden District, where in spite of the light spattering of rain, he loaned us little stools and started right in with his enthusiastic spiel. The tour showcased beautiful homes, some of them inhabited by celebrities, and an amazing cemetery. We then went on to the Voodoo Tour, rife with fascinating history and great photo ops. Tree was so gracious and inspiring and informative. He is such an animated person who truly loves his job. We feel honored to have met him and so much more knowledgeable about this enchanting city.

Love this spot. The crepes are good for eating and (especially relative to other coffee shots in the neighborhood) the wifi is actually good enough to stream video and such even when there's a lot of people in the building.

There are experiences that deserve a YELP and this is one!!!!
Western dental was excellent. 
1. I messed up my appointment time. They worked me in same day. And on time never had to wait more than a few minutes!
2. I didn't like the first dentist that met with me. I explained to Cindy I have a lot of anxiety over going to the dentist. I asked for a nice dentist. They introduced me to Dr. Kim. He was truly wonderful!!! 
3. I had my teeth cleaned with Anna. Again, nicest hygienist I have ever had.
From start to finish wonderful experience. 
Thank you Western Dental!!

I've been here twice once I ate in, and was craving it for a week then got it to go. It's been delicious both times and the workers are such sweethearts. Best Asian cuisine I've had in Kenner/Metairie.

Galliano was really good!! When I found out this was the new, casual sister restaurant of Rebirth, which I love, I knew I had to try it out. I was looking for a restaurant that specialized in Cajun/Creole food in particular because my boyfriend and I wanted to take a friend there who lives out of town and doesn't get to eat Southern food often. I made a reservation the day before through Open Table and I'm glad I did because it was crowded for a Wednesday night, especially for a place so new. I would describe the ambiance as trendy but dress code is casual and I saw plenty of people in jeans and t shirts.

Galliano is actually next to Rebirth and where the restaurant Root used to be. When you walk in, the host stand is right in front with a full and really nice bar to your left. I really appreciate a beautifully set up bar because I love craft and specialty cocktails. There's probably a dozen or so tables as well as a couple of large booths in the corner. I really like the large windows that let you enjoy the view outside as you're eating. The Rougaroux cocktail I ordered was really good! I like my drinks sweet and fruity but also with a kick and the Rougaroux definitely delivered. It was a mixture of dark rum and coconut rum with juices and garnished with cherries and an orange.  

For an appetizer, we were given complimentary hush puppies with buttermilk sauce which were good. We also ordered a dozen of the Galliano chargrilled oysters. My other dining companions felt this was a tiny bit salty but I thought they were perfect. I loved the breadcrumbs sprinkled on top and the presentation. For my entree, I got the Southern fried chicken which was excellent. I'm usually hesitant to order fried chicken at restaurants because I have really high expectations and was worried that it'll come out dry. However, theirs was DELICIOUS! I liked my meal the most out of everyone's. I had a very generous portion of two pieces of perfectly crispy and VERY flavorful fried chicken. I think one piece was a thigh and the other was a breast, so it was nice that I didn't have to deal with bones either. The red beans that came with it were very well done. Needless to say, I completely stuffed myself and finished every bite. 

My boyfriend got the Porkchop Laplace which was Andouille sausage stuffed inside a porkchop. Talk about massive lol. Our friend ordered the Sunday pot roast which I also really liked if you're looking for something not too heavy or rich. The pot roast was really tender. I thought every dish we tried had tons of flavor. My only qualm was my boyfriend's porkchop looked pink and slightly undercooked, but the manager came by and said that might be due to the sausage inside the porkchop making it appear undercooked. He assured him it was fine to eat and offered to throw it back on the grill for a little bit longer, so no big deal there. When the bill came out, I was surprised to see that it was a lot less than I thought it would be, considering we had a round of cocktails, appetizers and specialty entrees. I would definitely return here the next time I'm craving really good Southern cuisine!!

SUMMARY: I get the sense that the chef is trying things out and having fun with it. Other than R Bistro or Zest, I haven't tasted anything like it outside of NYC or Chicago. Bravo!

Popped in here a few months back to check it out. I used to live across the street and this was my video store back then... go figure.

The place has a lot of buzz and it seems to live up to the hype. I had the duck, pickle of the day opener... and enough yummy drinks that I am a little fuzzy about the rest.

The bartender, whose name escapes me, was good and enthusiastic. She did a great job explaining the drinks and the food. The atmosphere is cozy and dark, with long communal tables in the middle section, 2 and 4 top private tables, and of course, the bar. I don't think you could get more precise with the seating arrangement and still not feel crammed in. Brilliant job whoever  designed the layout!

There is also ample outdoor seating, but it was packed that night. Looks fun, though!

The food was good, priced a little over where I think it should have been (but fair), and most of all very interesting. This restaurant has a "flavor" and it is pickled! (not that everything is pickled... it's a theme). I get the sense that the chef is trying things out and having fun with it. Other than R Bistro or Zest, I haven't tasted anything like it outside of NYC or Chicago. Bravo!

Had pizza from here very recently and was so happy and pleased with the entire process.
Do not eat much pizza.  It is rare pleasure for us.  We try to avoid the calories.  Even the delivery went well and was on time.   They were nice on the phone also, since we are not that familiar with their choices.  Just a really good experience.  Good Pizza!
Nothing amazing about the food to brag about, but you get your money's worth. More of Italian/Cuban food. Margaritas were phenomenal!

This is definitely one of the better shops in the area. The layout is different than most which almost gives an element of privacy while you're in there (if that matters to you).  
Partly Cloudy has a bit of everything you'll need and the prices are very reasonable. They even have a rewards loyalty program! 
I've experienced a couple of the different staff members and they all seem very knowledgeable and were a great help in picking out some stuff.

We love nifty fifty's, but this was our first time at this location. If you haven't been to nifty fifty's before, it's a 50's style diner, but the food is much better than typical diner food. I've enjoyed everything I've tried from here. Their burgers are great, they're the thinner type like a steak burger, I had the bacon cheeseburger. The fiancé and I shared an order of cheese fries which are always good. Their milkshakes are awesome and there are tons of different flavors. Our waitress was good and our food came out in reasonable time frame despite being busy. This particular nifty fifty's has an arcade and mini golf course, so it would be a great place to take the kids.

As other reviews note, yes, it is next to the highway and across from a budget motel and gas station.

But I found the customer service to be excellent and the rooms were clean and modern. That's what I was looking for and that's what I got, so I was a happy customer!

Impressive!!  Not as fun when it's just wood (looks real enough to blend with the REAL wood walls around it) but when it's playing...great stuff!!

I missed this past holidays 3D show :( but i saw the one they had the first holiday season and it was great!!  Plus when the Phillies were in the series, they played the games!!!

Scrolling through the reviews I see plenty of people commenting on the insane owner/manager, and we had our own experience with him. He yelled at us -- yes, honestly yelled -- for daring to want to move our table over by less than two feet: that was to avoid having a member of our party bang his head into the beer taps right behind his chair. We were told moving ANYTHING was not allowed...even though other tables got moved regularly as diners came in. Go figure.

Pizza is ok, a little bland and certainly overpriced, as are the salads, but its the rude, nutty owner that guarantees we will not return.

I must have hired this company at least six times in the last several years.   And, I think they've become my favorite service provider in Tucson.    They've always done excellent work and charged incredibly fair prices.    I can't say enough about this great local company.   
Repairman arrive on time, and the office is responsive all along the way...and that is so good!    
Thanks, Signal Doors!
(I still recall Precision Doors trying to sell me new rollers many years ago.   Those "old" rollers are still working just fine today.   And they wanted money just for the estimate whether doing the job or not!)

We just moved to the area and have tried a few breakfast places. You were great, fresh fruit, huge menu and great service. You will now be our regular  breakfast place for our weekends. Thanks , Jeff and Jodi

FINALLY!! The Westbank has a Fleurty Girl!

I have been saying for years that the Westbank needed it's own little branch of this fun local shop, and owner Lauren finally made my wish come true. The newest Fleurty Girl shop is in Old Gretna and I couldn't be more excited!

After the madness of Gretna Fest died down, I was able to stop in and see FG's newest home. It's perfect- an old house that has been converted into a quaint little shop where you can find New Orleans themed t shirts and gifts. I have been a Fleurty fan for years and it's been so exciting watching this little company expand from a t shirt shop to a full blown "must" for any New Orleans gift giver.

On the day I was here, I was greeted with a friendly "Hello!" from the woman working and I was eager to look around and see exactly what this shop had to offer. FG-OG is a bit smaller than the other shops I've been in, but they pack a lot into a smaller space. They sell much more than just shirts- they also have a variety of jewelry, accessories, house decor and a lot of other fun things that you are sure to like.
