On this day, I found a pair of earrings that will be perfect to wear when watching a Saints game. I also saw a few t shirts that will definitely be going on my Christmas list. Oh yeah...if you want to buy me something, a Fleurty Girl gift card will do nicely.

I'm so happy that Fleurty Girl has found a home on the Westbank and I can't wait to make this place one of my regular shopping stops.

My first visit to Kabuki Sushi & Thai was with a Meetup group of about twenty people. For this reason, I would normally not review a restaurant; large, unannounced groups can often throw a team off their game. 

But that was definitely not the case here. The service and food were both awesome. We were all seated, waited on and served in a very timely manner. They were also very understanding about us needing individual checks and provided fast service to those who were on a tight deadline. 

I had a spicy tuna roll and the pumpkin curry with chicken. Most of the people in my group opted for the $20-all-you-can-eat sushi, but that curry was calling my name. It was delicious, as was the roll. 

I will definitely be back here, whether with my group or by myself.
A Philly tradition and must eat whenever you find yourself near South Street! The largest pizza slices I've ever had for $3 and they're NY style thin crust which is my favorite!

Contrary to what some reviewers have written I found our tour guide Preston to be an awful representative for this business. He was difficult to understand because of his speech patterns and chronic mumbling, and he didn't seem to care that most of us could neither understand or even hear him (we were a group of 15). 
Preston rambles on a lot - including his personal stories - but came up short on the historic information we came to learn. 

Our tour ended 30 minutes early - at 5, not 5:30 - and apparently we were supposed to go somewhere for bread pudding according to other reviewers but Preston eliminated that. When asked why were were done early he simply said go enjoy your Friday night, no mention of cutting out one of our taste samples. 

I wish we had the other tour guide (Bob), he seemed much more concerned with giving a great tour.

Memo and Katie opened their new venture on 8/11 to a packed crowd.  While some old standards are on the menu, there are lots of new things that should be tried.  They have a variety of street tacos, and I am anxious to try the Al Pastor whjich is chopped pork shoulder slow cooked in a pineapple guajillo chili marinade, yum!  They have their own take on Nachos with several varieties.  Of course you can get buritos and enchiladas and fajitas.  But try the Isabel's Carnitas, Malcajete Ranchero and Torta Ahogada.  We were thrilled to see they kept the Mojarra Frita (Deep Fried whole Talapia).  Do yourself a favor, make sure you get their guacamole authentico and Memo's Especial Frijoles.  Yes, I am one of their biggest cheerleaders, I appreciate hard work, good food and am an ardent supporter of local business.

This is a small classic place in downtown Indianapolis. It is kind of mediocre, but still pretty good! It is pretty expensive, but comes family style (huge proportions). The veal Parmesan was our favorite, and super good. The fettuccine Alfredo was what you would expect. The baked ziti was really good also. The dessert platter was good but the cheesecake was not the best ever for how expensive it was (there was no crust). As far as the location, it's a quaint small eclectic place with decorations covering floor to ceiling. Our waiter was super friendly and helpful.

Well this time we went and unfortunately it took them 30 mins for a waitress to approach our table after I had complained 3 times that nobody has came to our table to greet us and take our drink order. That's a long time (30 mins) I've never been so upset. I've been to a lot of busy restaurants in St Pete and ALWAYS got a drink order in within 5-10 mins of getting seated. They were not even busy. Then we FINALLY got to put our order in and 15 -20 mins later they came back to tell us they had no chicken wings!!!! Now we've been there for 45 mins! And not getting wings! Why wouldn't they tell us that when we ordered or a few mins after we ordered that they had no wings?! They had no clue what they were doing. We like that place but the St Pete one on Park Ave in Pinellas Park FL was a disaster that never ended. And sadly it wasn't even busy or we may have understood. The manager was super nice but we were there for an hour and 15 mins before we got any food and he offered nothing at all. We went for wings and we had to ultimately get burgers. Sad evening.... we won't be back. There's plenty of restaurants in St Pete...... we do not recommend them at all.
The food was nice for the price you pay. The staff were friendly with a constant smile. In the back the patio is tucked away which gives it a cozy feel.
We went for lunch and our service was amazing.  The fish and chips were fresh and tasty.  The cheese cake was delicious as well.  Pretty spendy, but worth ever bite.

Good but nothing fabulous.  For farm to table, expected more healthy interesting choices vs the many fried options available.  Was there for dinner on a Sunday night. Busy and noisy. Our server was not particularly attentive and clearly was ready for us to leave when he provided dessert menus while 1 member of our party was still eating his meal! Rude. Cant say I would rush to go back.

You need a quick breakfast 'cause you're doin' a beach day! You're going to Honeymoon Island, maybe take the boat to Caladesi Island, or just laying on the Dunedin Causeway Beach. Brenda's is waiting for you. Old school greasy spoon that makes great fast breakfasts. Biscuits and Gravy goood! One flapjack will fill you and you can get it as a side for under $2. Bacon made crisp like I love it. The servers are mature ladies that will take care of you. Did I mention the prices are the cheapest on Alt 19? BUT they only take cash! Quick! Simple! Cheap! Hit the beach! End of story. :)
Delicious chicken burrito for lunch!!! Fresh ingredients and very fulfilling, too.

This was my first visit today. The food was excellent. I had the Grilled Chicken Feast, Grilled Chicken Breast with the Roasted Red Potatoes & Greek Salad. Very fresh and I look forward to my next visit!

I am thrilled that I discovered this Amazing Pizzeria restaurant. The best Italian Food around! Their burgers are Absolutely delicious! Their pizza is the very best! All of their bread is homemade!! I can't say enough about this place!!! I would give them 10 stars if I could!!!

Another great place for local, live New Orleans music every night of the week.  There's a $5 cover on the weekends, but free the rest of the week.  

It's got a prime location right in the heart of Frenchman Street so there are many other music venues close by to hop around to.  There's a huge beer selection, but it's a little pricier then everywhere else around.

I think this location is related to the d.b.a. in NYC so it has a sleeker more swanky look to it.  The bar split nicely with one side dedicated to music and dancing, the other side has tables, and there's a small back room with couches.   It's much larger than all the other venues on Frenchman.

d.b.a. is definitely worth checking out. The music is always great.

Stopped here for breakfast as our Airbnb suggested it. This place does NOT disappoint! Got the farm breakfast and my husband got the bob. Food was amazing, large portions and the bacon.... Out of this world! We both got mimosas which were not light on the champagne which is great, especially after an 18hr drive from MA! I also got the monkey mocha and golden monkey coffee, both were delicious. The staff was upfront about the long wait on food (for a place this great, I can see why it was so long). They were very attentive to us while we waited, and extremely friendly! Would highly recommend this place!

I am absolutely addicted. I have spent somewhere in the ballpark of $3,000 I think in the last 2 months on what are now my staple wardrobe essentials. The chaturanga leggings, asana muscle tanks, aspire ankle pants, sonar capris, tulip dresses and more are my spirit clothing. Haha! Seriously. I am phasing out my entire closet at this point and replacing it with Athleta. 

High quality clothes, great fit, awesome color options---plus it's free and easy to ship returns (I've ordered almost everything online). Customer service is great too. 

My only quibble would be that with as much as I have spent, I'm bummed I don't get any special coupons or promotion codes! I feel like I've earned it. Haha

I'm a sucker for local coffeeshops, especially when they're as charming and inviting as PROVIDER. I mean, come on, who doesn't love working in a space filled with plants!? I'm obsessed! 

Baristas: They're the bees knees. Top notch. They know their coffee and give great recommendations!

Coffee: The ginger latte - sweet with a little bite - one of my faves. The Pistachio latte - not as sweet but creamy and the perfect thing to wake up with. Don't worry, these lattes are not only delicious but also incredibly photogenic. 

The space: The vibes are exactly what I'm looking for when I walk into a coffee shop. It's warm and inviting with a touch of hipster. It makes me feel cool.

Snaps to you PROVIDER. I'll be back in the PM next time for a touch of alc in my bev.

Delicious dinner! Last minute reservation and we were seated immediately...on a Saturday night. HIGHLY recommend reservations unless you're ok with hanging at the bar (which isn't the worst thing). Joe was our waiter, friendly and knowledgeable and very accommodating with drink suggestions and samples. Appetizers came quickly however when the gumbo wasn't up to par, joe immediately took care of it. The alligator was delicious! Our entrees were fish, filet mignon, scallops and seafood pasta...all were fabulous. The crawfish risotto...yum!! Off the beaten path, not the Bourbon St crowd and well worth it!

Great food, friendly service and awesome beer selection in a terrific family-owned restaurant, tavern and craft beer shop.  This restaurant is located in an historic building and has been operated by the same family for over 40 years!  I will definitely be back to try more items on the menu and some of the excellent beers.

Nice renovation of an old favorite. Personal but professional staff.  Coffee is excellent as are the pastries.  Free refills and "to go"cups as you leave.
Miss the old school tables but still a warm feeling.

After a long, hot early morning/ afternoon of walking the streets of Nashville, we were looking for some good BBQ in a comfortable environment that wasn't overly crowded. That's exactly what we found at Mission BBQ! Friendly service, great food, comfortable atmosphere. I had the chopped brisket sandwich with mac n cheese and my husband had the brisket sandwich and fries. We both agreed we would come back if we ended up in Nashville again!

LOVE, LOVE, LOVE the ACME Screening Room in Lambertville NJ.
We are 2-year dual members thus far.

In the three years since living in Bucks County and first finding the ACME, they have fundraised to upgrade the chairs, the screen, and digital projection equipment.  They have also like overnight somehow been able to acquire viewing of the most current indie and foreign films.  Top films at that.  We just saw Stan and Ollie, Shoplifters, Cold War, and many other excellent films.  

Just last night, 3/2/19, we saw a South Beach Miami documentary of two photographers that captured the life and evolution of South Beach.  Well done and informative.

Just in the past 4 months, we've seen more films at the ACME then at the Montgomery Theater in Skillman and we no longer drive out to the Ambler, Hiway or Colony theaters.  

I've also participated as a presenter at two 20x20 Pecha Kutcha events and recently volunteered to photograph presenters of the Feb 8th event.

Feels good to be apart of the community.

Support the ACME so that they can continue to bring us such great film and other experiences.

After a busy night, we were looking for a hotel to stop at on our way back to Michigan. The staff was extremely helpful and kind! Our room was fantastic. I don't think I've slept that well in a hotel, EVER! We also had a delicious breakfast. Overall a great place to stay! We will most definitely be staying at Hampton Inns from now on!
White barbecue sauce! Dry rub! Great selection! Roomy tables and seating area, with a well maintained outdoor patio! We ate here twice during a long weekend visit and will return again.
Fresh salads variety of toppings and dressings. They have a kids menu with sandwiches and hot dogs.

I remember when this place opened. My sister in law worked here. 
At first I was skeptical because it's in a strip mall but to my surprise the food isn't bad at all. I've actually been back many times over the years and usually have a pretty good experience.

We just returned from New Orleans. We visited for the 1st time 4 years ago and just returned for our 2nd visit. The Mona Lisa is in a great location tucked away from all the madness. Quiet, great for a date not necessarily good for kids. Pizza and pasta is good, prices are average. We had a great bottle of wine. We were very happy with the service. Suggest splitting a bowl of pasta, salad and a bottle of wine. Definitely worth checking out, the neighborhood is beautiful!

White Chili, Seasoned Beef Sandwich, Large Coke, To Go. That's my order. Do I really need to write any more? Just read Jon L's review about the sandwich... I can't improve on that description. The white chili is really good, just a little spicy ( I could stand a little more, but its good as it is)

I stopped in and placed an order to go. It was not busy, no line and maybe 6 people in the whole place eating. I waited for for at least 15 min for my food. When I got home and opened my bag I found the grossest quesadilla I've ever had. And the chips were soooo salty (and I like salt! But these chips were bad). I will never go back, there are much better options for Mexican food in the area.

Great service! Very fast getting beers and food! Beer was good and food was too, nothing terrible but wasn't amazing. None of the beers really stood out. Was nice to have a brewery with food as many in Florida don't and it was definitely above average food! Forgot to get a photo of the food, sorry. Presentation was definitely nice of the fish tacos and chicken sandwich.

BBQ has good flavor with mild smoke (had combo: chicken, brisket, and ribs).  The brisket and ribs were bit dry, but entirely rehabilitated with application of the various sauces.  Good judgement would have you stop there.  The sides I tried (corn, beans) are filler; not bad, but quite forgettable.  The cornbread, sadly, does not quite even reach the level of filler-forgettable.  Overall, good BBQ, if a tad expensive in light of the sides and relatively raw atmosphere.
The customer service was poor, the owner was rude, and the employees don't wash their hands after using the bathroom.

Had another great breakfast here with the family over the weekend. We all over ordered but there's just so many yummy things to choose from on the menu!

I ordered Crumb Cake, Cinnamon Bun and lemon scone for the table to pick on before breakfast came. It was a bummer that they brought these items out literally two minutes before all of our breakfast items came out. I do wish we had more time to just chill and eat pastries first.

Three of us ordered the Biscuits and Sausage Gravy. It was so good, huge portion, and adequately spicy on its own. It's a brown sausage gravy, not white like I've previously seen around here. The husband ordered the Brisket Benedict with corned beef in his side of potatoes. Again, a huge portion and so yummy! My daughter had a blueberry pancake and enjoyed it that day and the next!

I can't wait for my next meal at Two Birds!

If you're going to get your home cleaned, Martha's is the place to call. She provides quality service at a fantastic value, and will go out of her way to make sure that you're 100% satisfied. For years I've searched for a cleaning company that I could trust in my home, and I've finally found the one.

If you like authentic tacos, this is not your place. It's not Mas Tacos. Vibe on Murphy Road is much better. They suburbanized it. Chicken Lime Tacos were yummy and they had a couple of good vegetarian options. Good lunch crowd and kudos on the valet parking. So smart. Try it for a quick lunch. Well worth it.

Stay away, tourists! Not only is the food truly awful, but they are super shady. If they think you're a tourist who might be out of town by the time you notice, these guys may try to charge your card twice! I live in New Orleans and stopped in last night to hear a friend play music. I bought a round of beers for the table and a bowl of (absolutely disgusting) fried crawfish. (Seriously, how do you make fried crawfish taste bad? Yeah, I dont know either! But these guys fucking did it!) After I paid, added a tip and signed the receipt, the waiter came back and said the machine kicked out my charge. He asked for my card to check the machine. He didn't say he was going to run it again. And then... That's right guys, he ran it again! But for a different amount. I looked up the charges in my account and, as expected, I had 2 charges. In short, I paid $50 for 3 beers and a bowl of (shitty) crawfish. I complained and made clear that I wasn't going away until this was taken care of. When they realized I wasn't a tourist and I wasn't letting this go, they brought out all receipts and assured me the money would be back in my account at midnight. It's not. I'm heading back there tonight. In short, STAY AWAY! THE FOOD IS SHIT AND THEY ARE RUNNING SCAMS!

My family loves brunch, and so we HAD to try Ruby Sunshine because they only serve breakfast food! We came by on a Sunday and they had 1/2 off mimosas, such a great deal and they were huge!! Other tasty brunch cocktails included peach belliini, Bloody Mary, etc. For brunch I got the fried chicken biscuit sliders with gravy. The Tasso ham in the gravy is delicious, I got it on the side and ended up eating it all anyway! My dad got the French toast and he was a bit disappointed because they were out of real maple syrup, it's kinda his thing, but otherwise was a happy guy!

This hotel is a landmark... a beautiful haven nestled on the beach in Montecito.  You can't beat this location, it is breathtaking.  The service is solid, from the valet to housekeeping.  You know you are staying at one of the nicest hotels in Southern California.  Many friends have recommended the Biltmore and I understand why.  My experience was truly memorable.  The price tag is very high end, but you only live once... right?

I don't know what I've been doing going to Maria's Prime Time Bakery instead of Traub's. Traub's is so much better! The selection is HUGE! 

I love all the personal-sized cakes/tartes/cupcakes and just the sheer variety of options. Now I don't have to select one giant cake, I can get a mix of little treats and everyone can sample everything!

I used to go to Maria's and struggle to find something that would appeal to everyone, but Traub's has so many different indulgences that it's easy as pie.

Pun intended.
Cool, come as you are, stiff drink pouring locals dive bar. And by Dive Bar, I mean the kind of place that prides itself on being a dive bar. Juke box, TV, low lights, attentive service. Cheers!

I love dining in New Orleans, such a great great food city! Had the best meal ever at Cafe Sbisa with our friends. The Turtle soup and the Veal were beyond fantastic! This place is so fantastic that we are flying down from Chicago for the weekend and my wife asked me to please make a reservation for Saturday night. This never happens, returning to the same spot twice in under 3 months, very high praise for this great restaurant!

I spotted Bittersweet on our way to the National WWII museum and knew I had to stop on my way back.  It is a very attractive shop on a street with nothing going on.

As I said, we stopped on our walk back and found the selection of goodies to be extensive and hard to decide on what to choose; they all looked yummy.  In the end we ordered to go the Turtle Brownie and the Aztec confection.  Three of us shared them for dessert a couple of hours later.  We found the Turtle Brownie just ordinary, but the Aztec confection was very good.  The contrast of the sweet and spicy flavors was well done indeed.

This place is so awesome! Good draft, wine, and sake selection and pretty awesome coffee and tea selection too in case drinking isn't your thing. Just a place to be social with people other than the folks you come with (not that I don't love my person). It was just nice to meet another couple and just play a game no awkward conversation between sports game breaks. Just a really good time playing games where we didn't lose money like the rest of Reno. Lol. So if you just need time to recover from your latest "fun night" go here! Also Jay our bartender was awesome!

We had a wonderful oreMother's day brunch with my mother.  We all ended up ordering from the Skinnylicious menu and it was fantastic !!  We have the chicken soft tacos with avacado and the pickled side salad--wow!! So healthy and delicious !  We also had the  Angel hair pasta and shrimp for less than 500 calories !  And finally, Mom had the chicken salad sandwhich and loaded baked potato soup.  It was so nice that hey were open for brunch.  They open at 9 on Mother's Day!! Highly recommend for food quality and excellent service and comfortable atmosphere!

Went in with a party of 5 at 9:45. Was told waitress was stressed had a bad night not sure she would serve 5 people party by the hostess.  Then hostess came back and said kitchen was jammed would be at least 20 minutes wait to be seated.  There was 1 Other table In dinning area.  Asked for manager and waited5 minutes.  Surprise. No show.  Sitting at Chills happily getting waited on

Update:

If you do just order a sandwich this place is consistently good. The multigrain bread is my favorite! Plus love the location next to Bookman's its great to walk off lunch and eruse the books.

This is a decent Sephora location. SAs are helpful and attentive, but the selection is just okay. They don't stock everything the bigger stores stock and I've been pointed to the website or the International Mall location many times. It can get frustrating when they randomly stop carrying a product they used to carry which seems to happen with some frequency. There are always about a million people inside this store.

The location inside JCPenney at the same mall is nice too, I actually like it a little better. Maybe it's just the more "cozy" atmosphere and that it's always way less crowded than this one.

Overall, it's a better option than Ulta across the street and easy to get in and out if you know what you're looking for and if they stock it. Just be sure to check the site or call ahead if you really need to pick something up the same day, or you might be disappointed.
Hands down the best bbq around!!! Needs more seating but worth the wait...Quaint  place..

I went here on a Thursday night and was kinda of surprised when my boyfriend and I walked into a virtually empty restaurant.  I mean even bad restaurants are mostly filled on a Thursday night, but we were one of only 3 couples.  

Regardless of the lack of customers, the menu selection was extensive.  They had a variety of hand and specialty rolls.  The 3 I ordered were absolutely amazing.  The spicy salmon roll was probably the best I have ever had.  Big and filled with an abundance of the spicy salmon mixture.  Their gyoza was also delicious.  They have a pretty good happy hour too with $1.50 Nigiri and $5 specialty roll.

Definitely better quality and selection sushi then Sagami which for some reason gets all the hype of great sushi in South Jersey.  Not only do they have excellent sushi but their menu also includes a wide variety of Asian dishes such as noodle and rice dishes.  

So if your thinking sushi in South Jersey try here, you wont be disappointed!

Bagel cafe is the best thing that's ever happened to me. Honestly I'm there all the time. They have so many different bagel options as well as cream cheese flavors! My personal favorite is the galaxy bagel with chive! Yum! also, they have great sandwich options, like the Super Deluxe and the Sicilian bagel! Bagel Cafe also has a bunch of email offers that they send out to those that give them their email, like a $6 any sandwich and drink or the $3.50 any bagel and coffee deal. Bagel Cafe is the bomb!

I LOVE this sushi restaurant and am happy I decided to give it a try despite the location. The inside is very nice, the sushi is fresh, delicious and what you should expect - not at all the dumbed down American version of crap rolls! The waitress (wish I could remember names) always remembers us, is friendly and even renamed the Edison roll to the Kelly roll for my friends name (unknowingly it reminds her of her mom who recently passed and meant the world when they named it)

Very hit or miss here. I love the girls that work there! Such a friendly atmosphere. Salads are decent and consistent. However, the first time I had a burger there, it was the best i ever had! The next time it was a little red inside, though i had asked for "well done". Last night it had no flavor at all. i couldnt even finish it. 
They have different types of menu selections for this area,  so you can always try something new.  I think I'll have to do that next time. They offer paninis, smoothies, banana whips...all that I have yet to try.
This is a hidden gem in sparks! The fish is fresh the staff is friendly and they answer all questions you may have! Surely will be back soon!

Sometimes my wife and I will go here when we are in the neighborhood seeing a movie or shopping. The cheese biscuits are amazing and addictive. The service is pretty good at times, but like any place you have your hit or miss moments. 

While my expectations are a little lower because of being a nationwide chain rather than something that has a local delicacy I just wish the menu would have a better fish selection. The shrimp and lobster is good which is something I would expect, but the fish selection is somewhat limited. Call me crazy, but sometimes while someone enjoys the fried death on the menu sometimes I just enjoy a piece of fish and I just seem not to be able to find what I am looking for at times at these restaurants.

Today I went to corporate hill as I knew the food truck Truck Norris was going to be there. I had been wanting to try their STL steak burrito and I messaged them on social media yesterday to make sure this item would be on the menu. I wanted to make sure since this last Friday at food truck Friday it was not on the menu. I arrived at the food truck around 11:30 and placed my order. My food was ready really quick probably less than 5 minutes. Once I received my burrito it was piping hot and the best burrito I have had to date! I was worried about the beer cheese but it must have been good. I need another one of these in my near future!
Came here for Valentine's Day. Drinks were amazing!! Food is absolutely terrible!! Come for drinks but do not eat here!!
Best pizza in town hands down. Customer service is amazing. 10 out 10. If you're in the city try this place.

We went there for Valentine's Day. Their fixed menu was perfect. We both got the 8 oz. Filet Mignon and they were prepared just right. The quality of the meat was top notch. We got mushrooms and creamed spinach as our sides and they were delicious. The service was excellent as well. We will be back soon!

We love the Newks in Greenwood, however this location just isn't as good.  We've been here 4 times and each time something just seems to be a little off with either the service or the food. Today we waited in line with at least 3 other groups waiting to order, while the one person taking orders was trying, by herself, to take a huge ($400+) order. After awhile of just waiting, we left. 

We do enjoy their variety of menu offerings and will probably give this location another shot, hopefully they can turn it around.

I really wanted to like these guys since they are so close by.  Good price on an oil change too.  They just opened shop out here on Pendleton Pike and we were very excited to learn that they did oil changes!  My fiance and my dad took my Subaru to get an oil change here.  We went on our road trip honeymoon the following Monday and halfway to Florida, we smell oil burning.  It's raining, it sucks.  We pull over and my new husband checks the oil level.  It low on oil.  What the hell????  So we purchase the correct oil, a bit miffed because that's $13 extra.  

It turned out that they did not tighten the drain bolt when they did the oil change.  Over the next 2200 miles, we used the entire quart of oil and by the time we got back, it was low again.

We explained what the issue was and Kate asked us to bring the car back into the same location.  So we took it back there.  I have not had issues with my oil before.

My husband is the one that went. I am glad I did not because I would have lost my mind.  They cleaned the splattered oil under the car and topped off the oil in the car.  Then they handed us an estimate for a supposed oil leak that we magically got to the tune of $376.  Funny how I didn't have any leaks before you changed the oil in my vehicle.  

All I have to say is DO NOT go here.  I see what I see.  Before I went there my car was fine.  After an oil change, I suddenly had an oil leak.  Is this the type of place that will sabotage your car and then give you an estimate for work?   I don't know but I got an estimate for work in my hand.

Belle Tires, You just lost a customer with 3 vehicles and a review that will alert others to your shady dealings.  It is a pity, we really hoped we found a gem, but it ended up being a dud.
We enjoy the atmosphere almost as much as the great food. The young crowd helps us stay vibrant. Good food and a fun enviroment.

Lovely place with nice decorations. The wait staffs were polite and friendly. I ordered the Hazelnut with mayonnaise shrimp, crabmeat and the spicy soup dumplings. The hazelnut mayonnaise shrimp was only a few shrimps about 7 shrimps in a typical honey glaze. It was very normal which cost me 18ish dollars. Very pricey for a normal tasting shrimp dish. 

The soup dumplings flavor was good especially the spicy ones. However the dumpling skin was not very good. It was doughy, not smooth, and easily to break. A few dumplings broke in tray that they came out of. 

If I ever have to come back here by forced, I will order the Spicy soup dumpling or some other dish to have my second thought. Other than that, I'm not coming back here.

Property was listed on Friday morning and I called for a showing and was informed that Debbie was out of town. They took my information and promised Debbie would call to schedule an appointment when she got back on Monday. Debbie finally sent me a text on Wednesday to tell me the unit was rented out but I should look at their other units. Very unprofessional behavior.
Just left an incredible workout led by Jen who is incredibly knowledgeable. Super excited about this new find in Carmel!!

Upgraded cause of brunch! $13.49 for bottomless champagne?! I'm there. 

Roast beef: A bit chewy but flavor was pretty good.
Asian food: Typical but decent.
Mexican food: The rice is good!
Desserts: They got better than before. Pretty yummy and lots of variety. They have tons of cakes, muffins, breakfast pastries, jello and soft serve.
Breakfast food: French toast was really good. Nice slightly crisp crust with soft sweet doughy goodness. Bacon was crispy. Omelette station had good variety. Country fried steak is ok. A bit too greasy. Biscuits and gravy hit the spot but was a bit dry.
Salad bar is small and limited. They only have romaine lettuce. No spring greens or spinach. They have a bacon spinach salad that's pretty good though. You can add extra bacon and mushrooms in it too. 
Fruits were surprisingly good. Watermelon was super fresh and crisp. 

Side note: They have styrofoam cups by the cashier when you leave so you can take one for the road. Hell yes. Filler up.

Amy's Donuts is a five start Tucson staple, let me tell you why. 

First of all, Amy's is open 24/7. If you happen to go late at night there is a security guard to keep things safe and chances are he will hold the door open for an added touch of service. 

The donuts are amazing and come in sooo many different styles and toppings. I personally love the mounds and would go back for it. The dough is soft and fluffy, and stayed fresh even the next day. 

If it's a donut you are craving, Amy's will take care of you.
Good food and nice environment. Always seems to have room available with a full bar that helps when you busy times

From start to finish, this was one of the greatest meals in a restaurant I have ever had.

My wife and I were celebrating a new job, so we decided to splurge. We got cocktails, entrees, and desserts for the both of us and our total bill ended up sliding in just over $100 after tip.

My wife had the Coq au Vin, I had the crab cakes. Every single element of both dishes were absolutely delicious. As a general rule I don't like cabbage, but the bacon braised cabbage that came with the crab cakes was delicious. We both had the Creme Brulee for dessert: it was the perfect model of a great Creme Brulee.

The atmosphere was unique and inviting, simultaneously laid back and upscale. I would feel equally comfortable dressed up or casually dressed at Sips. The staff were courteous, knowledgeable, and efficient.

Sips is not a place to go if you aren't ready to lighten your wallet, but if you want to celebrate something or treat yourself, I would recommend Sips over any other restaurant I've tried in the area.

My one and only complaint: The "Whipped Pear" cocktail is WAY too sweet. My wife and I both couldn't handle any more after just a few sips. Their signature margarita, however, is just as delicious as everything else.

Delicious dogs! 

The bread is soft, but not soggy, the sausages are filled with flavor and the toppings are really fresh and unique.

Last time I was here I tried the Field Roast Italian Dog (eggplant vegan sausage, fennel
& garlic spiced), which was surprisingly tasty. Topped it with sauerkraut, grilled onions and sriracha mayo. Heck yeah!

Brought my 14 year old daughter in for a nose piercing. Everyone was great at explaining to her what to expect. Jay was gentle and talked her through the entire process and aftercare. It was really busy when we went on a Saturday but the wait was worth it!
Found this Resturant by using Yelp and I'm so glad I did. The food and service was excellent. Prices were worth it. Not one complaint from my kids or hubby. We will be back

Since I was out for an early medical test, I figured I'd surprise the Queen Bee with something for breakfast. So I rode down Belcher and made the quick right to get here...I really wasn't into waiting at some diner for an omelet or whatever to carry out.

First thing I got was their koulouria...basically a Greek style bagel. They sell these things on street carts in Athens, etc. Back in the day they were just 80 drachmas each: pennies! These puppies were still warm out of the oven when I got back home. So I gobbled down two with my coffee and OJ.

The other goodies I picked up were a few different pastry/pie items. The first was a sweet: bougatsa. It's basically custard in a phyllo wrapper; best I've had since moving to FL. Also got three savories: meat, spinach and cheese pies. All fantastic as always by Mr Kranias and his little elves.

Their shop is still immaculate and clean as it always has been. Mr K is a very hospitable and friendly gentleman. We spoke Greek and English to each other and traded a few jokes as I was waiting. The place has a pretty nice lunch menu as well as a few breakfast  sandwiches too, along with the usual Greek and American sweet stuff. 

A true mom and pop shop in the best sense of the phrase. I heartily recommend these folks hands down if you're looking for basic homemade pastries, bread stuffs  and sandwiches, both Greek and American. Beats the prices and tacky atmospheric phoniness of Tarpon Springs any day!

I've walked by this place a million times but never once thought to stop in here. From the outside, it looks more like a fancy steak dinner spot but I was definitely surprised when I saw the menu. It's definitely a comfort food and diner-ish place. We got reservations for 7pm on a Sunday pretty easy even though there was a good crowd when we got there probably from the nearby touristy spots. The decor was retro and definitely had a Stephen Starr feel to it if you're familiar with his other restaurants. 

It was a hot day so I started with the black and white milk shake which in my opinion was the best thing I tasted on the menu. Worthy of five stars. 

For my entree, I ordered the fried chicken and waffles (definitely not on a health watch here). The waitress brought over some syrup which was a bonus. The gravy that came with it was extremely tasty, it was a rich flavorful gravy with chicken bits, carrots and celery in it. However, the chicken was salted so heavily that I had to eat around the breading. 

My bf ordered the thanksgiving dinner which consisted of turkey, gravy, stuffing and mashed potatoes. At some point during dinner, he made a comment about the mashed potatoes tasting store bought and heated up. 

There were some hits and misses but next time we'll probably try something different or check out the brunch that's supposed to be good here.

So we came here on a whim around 7pm on a Thursday evening and because we didn't have a reservation we wound up sitting at the bar.  This place is hopping - make reservations!

The bar was totally fine and service was super fast and friendly.  The food is great value for what you pay for and their sashimi was fantastic!  Their rolls are your basic sushi rolls, no attempts at recreating new/modernized rolls. The veggies were all super fresh too.  Our teapot was always full so that was really nice too - despite how busy they were they were def taking care of their customers.

Totally worth checking out!

Know full well that if you do not go in there with a large group of people that you will be seated at a big table with strangers. 

If having to bust into some strangers conversation on the opposite end of a long table to get someone to pass a pitcher of water down to your end, forcing all the people between you to stop eating and continue passing the pitcher sounds like fun, than this is the place for you. 

The food was fine, but I would never go here again unless I had enough people to fill a table. Most awkward restaurant I have ever been in.

The consistency of their food is what I have the most issues with.  The last order was the best so far.  We shared with a few neighbors who have lived locally for years and they were impressed.  The lady who took the order by phone was really sweet and didn't rush us. No problems with delivery. 

Previous orders have come out bland and/or under cooked.  I hope this last time is not the best time, but the expectation from here on out.  We don't order anything crazy, just pizza and wings every time.
3.5 stars is too low for this place. In an desert of overpriced hotel restaurants, this was an oasis. Solid Bloody Marys and grits.

I had surgery here two months ago and spent a week. Both me and my family were treated more like family then me as a patient. I absolutely have zero complaints. I'd recommend this hospital to anyone based on my experience.

I'm a repeat customer and here is another beautiful bouquet!! I ordered at around 10 am and it was out for delivery by 1 pm. The flowers are always amazing and last a long time. 

Thank you Posh Petals!!

My family chose this place for breakfast because it was open early. What we got exceeded our expectations. We started with Johnathan's bread of the day which we inhaled in a minute. My kids loved the waffles. I had the smoked salmon eggs Benedict which was outstanding. Friendly service to boot. What a great breakfast place.

Today was our first time here although we live around the corner and have been seeing how crowded this unique eatery is for many months.
The place is clean and has about 8 tables inside and about 4 outside. One of the walls in side is a chalkboard so you can draw while you wait. There is a tv mounted on the other wall. They had the Olympic basketball game on today.
The cashier was friendly and helpful. I had read the reviews prior to coming so knew I wanted to try both the carbonara pizza and a burger. 
The cashier suggested the OMG burger and the Texas burger, so I ordered both.
The burger had a wonderful chargrilled flavor which I love. I demolished it within minutes, adding one of their three homemade sauces (one of the pink ones supplied at the table). Delish! The bread is fantastic and unique.  
The carbonara pizza was a bit of a disappointment. While the flatbread was perfect, the toppings that made up the pizza had no flavor. Egg, bacon, cheese and sauce. The tomato sauce was overpowering. This pizza would be better with a white sauce, IMO. One the eggs was barely cooked, clear and runny, while the other egg was cooked hard and dry. The pizza oven obviously cooks unevenly. Anyway, once I added one of the pink sauces to the pizza, it was better. Took my leftovers home and added salt and it def helped.
Def will be back with my kids for burgers!
Good food and service  we enjoyed everything we got sat out side and watched the football game. Great atmosphere
Delicious enchilada. Friendly bartender. Super quick service. And $4 margarita. I'll be back.

Visited early on a busy Sat night.  Couldn't get seated at a regular table, but did have plenty of space at the full service bar.  We had the Beef Bourguignon and Seared Sea Scallops with Lobster Mac & Cheese.  Both were served piping hot and were outstanding!  Awesome tasting and large portions!  Service was impeccable.  Can't go wrong with the Midtown Cafe!

We've been to Tarpon Springs many times over the years and have eaten at many of the Greek restaurants, but this one is by far superior.  From the food to the service! We ordered the octopus which came with a plethora sides, children's Greek spaghetti and a Greek salad.  Even the house wine was very smooth.  Hellas is excellent and will be our go to place from now on!  Wish we would've visited sooner!

I saw an ad for Sugarbowl in Edmonton's weekly alt-mag Vue last week.

It claimed the hip, local fixture bakes up the city's best cinnamon buns - so I had to see and taste for myself.

I wandered in there Sunday, mid-morning, and the brunch crowd had the place packed and humming with coffee-fuelled conversation, clanking cutlery and lots of greasy, hungover smiles with mouthfuls of smoked salmon and avocado omelettes, home fries and eggs benny.

I stood at the bar, where several patrons sat on high stools sipping cappuccinos from tall glass mugs, and ordered my cinnamon bun.

As I waited, I caught a glimpse of one of the sugary treats on someone else's side plate (it needs its own plate!!)  and it looked sugar-rush worthy.

When my own bun came, still warm, and wrapped in cellophane, I cradled it in two hands (it was bigger than my one hand!) and immediately started salivating at smells emitting from whirlpools of rolled and layered cinnamon and doughy goodness, destined for my mouth.

Grandmas who are permanently dusted in flour, and have clocked a lifetime of kitchen hours and have pudgy, little grandchildren, bake cinnamon buns like these. Sugarbowl's buns are big and yeasty, with the right amount of cinnamon and sugar, crusty crunch and soft melt-in-your-mouth gooey morsels.

Huh ... advertising that's actually dead honest - I like it. These ARE the best cinnamon buns in E-town!

Someone's grandma's spirit must live in Sugarbowl's kitchen.

Stella's slick overhaul of the Cosi space belies its underwhelming pizza. 

We stacked up a marghertia, spinach and meat pie for sampling. Each one was the same: satisfying crust, soggy center and unremarkable flavor. For as much fuss as they give the oven, I couldn't taste the benefit.

A note on price: I'm not one to equate quantity with quality. But when the inversely as small and flavorless as the price is bloated (without the offset of BYOB), I can't see the draw.

Skip Stella and wait for Starr's next pizza joint opening near Parc soon.
First time visiting this coffee shop and I will definitely be coming back! It is super cute and cozy. The staff was nice and friendly, the coffee was great!
What dump! Can't believe this hotel for santa Barbara! Need i say more! Photos speak for themselves!

Very good pizza, some of the best pizza around (I had the buffalo chicken pizza, but prefer the one at Two Cousins - just a matter of taste) having options in front of you is great, and they even asked me if it was made the way I wanted, and stood by ready to make any possible changes - talk about personal customization! It was delicious and I recommend you try it out!

Great service and great food! I came with My boyfriend and his daughters and Alexis took amazing care of us. We didn't have to ask for anything because she was always on top of things. We both got steak fajitas and the horchata was delicious! Make sure to stop by. Thanks again Alexis!
Food was great but the service we received from Rody sucked! Was rude! Trey was a great server!

I stop in here to buy bread.  They make great sandwiches too.  I got the tip about their ciabatta from Wildflower.  They served some really good grilled ciabatta on an appetizer plate.  I asked if they made it in-house, and they said they got it from Beyond Bread.  It's the place I go now.

All of their loaves are good.

First time for their Sunday Brunch!

Awesome ambiance, cool tile, yummy food and good service! The Bloody Mary with whiskey was a unique twist, the breading on the fried chicken for the Chicken and Waffles was yummy and somehow light. It was fabulous.

The biscuits and gravy were super good too. 3 half biscuits, home made for sure, and nice flavor.

I'd have brunch here again for sure and would love to come back for dinner or happy hour, based on the reviews,  sometime!

Leigh - We both know the parts were not new.   I have pictures of the vehicle in your delivery area that clearly show used parts being sold as new.   I will share those pictures with anyone that would like to see them.   You were extremely apologetic for my experience, however that doesn't erase the deception and unprofessionalism that I experienced from your service manager.

At the time of this post there 33 ratings and over half of the reviews are a 1 star rating  - This doesn't appear to be to be an isolated incident with the dealership
Overall amazing experience. Doctor was very nice and Monika my hygienist couldn't have been any better! I highly recommend this dentistry! 5 stars!!!!

I was visiting the area from out of town and found this place. It was an hour before closing and we walked in and were told they were closed because they were out of most dishes. I was very disappointed. The place was full and we were turned away.  Bad business practices.

This is such a fun experience! 

You must be adventurous to come here and enjoy it for your money's worth though. If you are just getting regular cuts of meat like beef and chicken, I don't think this place is worth the price for you.

So the basic concept is a buffet where you serve yourself sides and put up a little marker to show you're ready for the meats. Everything is all you can eat.

Our server was very nice and even though she's gone through the explanation spiel a million times I'm sure, she was very warm and took time to explain everything. They did a good job of incorporating Brazilian things into the menu--each table gets a starter of 3 appetizers that are all Brazilian themed: fried polenta, fried banana, and a cheese popover. 

I also ordered a Caipirinha, because it's the only Brazilian drink I know! I got mine with strawberry and coconut, and it has big chunks of fruit in it. It was very tasty!

They have an amazing bar of sides. You serve yourself the sides, and then the meat is brought to you by servers. There were so many delightful salads to choose from. My favorite was the roasted coconut salad, it was like a coconut cole slaw! They had couscous salad, quinoa salad, kale salad, and tons of other sides to choose from. They had macaroni and cheese, mashed potatoes, baked ziti, and a few other non-salad sides. This sides bar is well stocked and has tons of choices--probably 20 different items I woulds say. I could have filled up on this alone.

Service was rapid! When we turned our marker over for more meat, they would arrive one after the other! We had to quickly flip the marker to stop them, because they would just rapid-fire offer us a new meat before we could even take a knife to what was on our plate already. It was great! And all the gentlemen carrying the meat skewers were very nice and chit-chatted with us.

Meats we tried: Japanese pork, lamb, some kind of white fish (forgot what is was!), sweet and sour chicken, some other kind of chicken, a few different cuts of beef, Rocky Mountain Oysters (Google it...), Yak meatballs, Rattlesnake sausage, Elk sausage... I think that's it?

I love the yak, the "oysters," rattlesnake, elk, and the rare beef. The fish was good, but I prefer a whole fish to just a slice :P As for me, yes there were a few cuts and types of meat I didn't like, such as the lamb (it was awful, but I've never had lamb before either). But that didn't detract form the experience at all, since I came prepared for an adventure. Overall, I really enjoyed the food. I do feel it is a tad overpriced at $35 a plate, but I can see how having all those exotic meats can raise the price up. 

I was originally worried that there wouldn't be enough rare meat, since that's how I like my steak. They had a good mix of rare and more done though, so I was happy to see one steak cut into that was very bloody. And it was delicious!

I realize that food can be a subjective thing, especially when you're dealing with regional cuisine. For one person the best cheese steak is where the meat isn't chopped up much at all or is still a whole slab, for another, the finer it is chopped up the better. One cheese steak purist will insist that it can only have cheese wiz on it, while another aficionado is disgusted by the florescent orange goop and must have American cheese. For the record, I fall into the latter on both categories.

I've had Jim's steaks and others from within the city and I'm convinced that more often than not it's the mom and pop joints in the strip malls out in the suburbs that tend to make the meanest cheese steak. There are a few places in Philly and just outside the city limits that know how to make a great cheese steak IMO, but Jim's isn't one of them.

Is a Jim's cheese steak good? Yeah it's good. Is it great? Not by a long shot - though it's arguably the best of the cheese steak tourist traps. I think what pains me most about the high profile establishments like Jim's, Pat's and Geno's is that when people visit from out of town they are invariably going to be drawn to one of the big name places for their "official" cheese steak experience. With the cheese steak being to the Philly region what Po Boys are to Louisiana, that to me is a culinary tragedy.  So it doesn't surprise me that places like Jim's Steaks are peppered with reviews from out of towners making statements like, "what the heck are you people in Pennsylvania eating!?!"

Came here for lunch during our vacay in NOLA.  We ordered the crispy calamari, chicken & waffles, and swordfish sandwich. All were outstanding and the portions were ridiculously huge! Great bang for your buck. The atmosphere is awesome.  We sat so that we could watch the kitchen at work during our meal. FANTASTIC! And, as crazy as it may sound, the complimentary breads they served at the beginning of the meal were equally as great as the remainder of the meal.  I would expect nothing less from the great Emeril Lagasse!

Stopped in here randomly on a Monday night and have to say I'm really happy I did. 50 cent boneless wings Monday & Tuesday's. Really nice thick Boneless Wings, super friendly staff and the wings are so crispy and fresh. Their Louisiana Rub is so good, their Garlic Parmesan is kinda weird as its not really a sauce like other places. This place is a definite if you're craving wings and in Greenwood.

I've been to three shows at Jubilations in West Edmonton Mall, and I'm definitely a fan! 

The whole staff participates in this dinner theatre experience, which has servers bringing all of your dishes right to your table for you, including your soup & salad, main and dessert, in between acts of whatever musical is in rotation. 

All three of the performances I have so far seen have been awesome, and I would definitely recommend my friends to check it out for themselves. Lots of dancing, singing, and good times, and pretty good food to boot. 

My only problem is with the space itself. It is crowded and a bit outdated, despite the fact that they paint the walls each time a new production takes to the stage. I love the servers being in character, although some can be a but too much at times. But it's all worth it. 

This place would be one the top choices to check out of someone new to Edmonton was coming down for the weekend, or for anyone who likes a fun and memorable night out! #yeglove
Terrible service and process. Order online, but make you stand in the cold in a line. Sketchy neighborhood. They do not answer the phone so you are just wondering if your pizza will be ready or not.

Above average Philly bar. This will probably be the 1,000th post that says you should get tater tots. You should. They're very very good. Although, it's hard to screw up tater tots.

My big "Don't Knock It 'Til You Try It" from Urban is the Peanut Butter Burger. Maybe go by yourself one day, try it (enjoy it immensely), then bring some friends out and order it and tell them they're crazy when they say it's gross. That's what I do, at least.

I'm at Marchwood Tavern and their kitchen is being remodeled. Saloon 151 truck is doing the cooking. Ordered the pulled Chicken Taco salad and it is awesome. Much more than I can eat, but the flavor is forcing me to stuff! Thank you Saloon 151, for a great meal!
If you are out at 100 Oaks this is a great place to eat, large portions, friendly service and cheap, sure it's americanized but this is America.  Try the bangkok eggs - worth the wait.
Oh my! This place was delicious! I had the Ramen and two sushi hand rolls (did I say delicious)!! I will definitely go back soon!

The first time I ordered from this location, my order included a 2-liter of diet coke, but I received two 16-oz diet cokes instead. The second time I ordered from this location, my pizza came pushed to one side of the box as if it had slipped, or been dropped. I have NEVER experienced this much poor service from a Domino's before. I love Domino's, but no longer trust this location to deliver me a quality product.
The chicken and waffles was amazing!!! I had a delicious sangria. We all loved our meals and the atmosphere is so fun!
This place has never disappointed me.  The staff is friendly, ingredients are fresh and the location is awesome.  Keep up the good work:)

Authentic deli meets NOLA and a whole lot of Jazz! WOW. 

I live in Pittsburgh but travel to St. Louis for work often, as my company is based down the road. Today was my first time visiting this establishment, and let me tell you, I've now found my new lunch spot for ALL of my STL stays. The moment you lay eyes on the establishment, you'll notice the line of hungry patrons wrapped along the red brick of this corner building( Imagine Seinfeld's soup Nazi scene). Do not be intimidated! This line moves super quick and you'll be at the front counter, greeted by friendly staff momentarily. I ordered the 1/2 mufalatta and my god is this thing massive! The bread was fresh and delious with what I think are toasted sesame seeds, the olive salad was crisp, briney and zesty, the meats and cheese-- a perfect symphony of salty and creamy goodness. Not to mention, the 1/2 is enough for 2 people and then some and the price is an absolute steal ($7.50 or something).

Will they hold accountability for my ever expanding waistline after my visits here? I am without a doubt sippin' the Blues City Deli Kool-Aide. This 'ish is AWESOME.

I have never posted a review of an establishment online, but my experience at this hotel warranted a first for me. 

The location of this hotel was great if you want to be in City Center, however you do have to park in the under ground garage across the street, under Liberty Square. Which is typical for a major city. 

The check-in process was very easy, and the staff was extremely polite. It seems as though this hotel was puts on a great facade with an impressive lobby with sparkling water dispensers and cereal. But it seems as though the actual hotel rooms are a completely different story. When I got to my room I saw that there was no refrigerator and the room was very small and had a stale odor. The room was no bigger than my dorm room in college, and there was barely enough room to turn around in the bathroom. 

The "queen/king size bed" was merely two twin mattresses on the same bed frame, which made for an extremely uncomfortable night's sleep due to the space in the middle where both of the mattresses meet. The television was also mounted across the wall from the bed, but on the left side of the bed, and was not centered at all. The bottom sheet on the bed was merely laid on the bed, and was not a fitted sheet or even tucked in under the mattress, which meant the sheet kept sliding off of the bed while trying to sleep. Because the sheet slid off, this revealed the mattress pad underneath the sheet, which was covered in stains.

The drinking glasses in the room still appeared to be dirty from the last occupant of the room, and were stored in the bathroom above the toilet. 

Upon leaving, when we checked under the bed, we saw that there was a 2nd comforter that was just stuffed under the bed, and was not in a bag. There was also trash from previous occupants found under the bed.I find this absolutely disgusting.

I have stayed in few hotels in the Philadelphia area, and would definitely not recommend this place. The hotels located in Penn's Landing were much cleaner, more functional, and parking was much easier.

Great chicken and tri-tip.  The grilled chicken is so moist and juicy and the tri-tip is tender.  Simple menu of chix & tri-tip plates, sandwiches and burritos.  Side dishes of rice, beans and tortillas with fresh salsas and condiments.  Everything tastes and looks fresh.  I had the tri-tip sandwich tonight and it was great.  A small place with a cool, casual atmosphere.  Friendly employees too!

I had the design your own vegetarian platter- okra, eggplant, cabbage, and tofu.  It tasted fresh and could use a little extra seasoning, but overall good.  The place is quiet and gives off a cool coffee shop vibe.  I'm happy I found a decent Ethiopian food restaurant in the city!

Must be under new management. Ate here a whole bunch a few years back. 
       The portions were drastically smaller ( toasted raviolis)
       The wings we ordered with buffalo sauce, they arrived at our table cold and lacking sauce. Everything was extremely SALTY! 
        It seams to me the place is staying a float because of the alcohol. 
        Sad! I recommend this place to tourist and friends that never been. Now I may have to keep my mouth shut. I will be going back this spring to check on things. I hope it goes back to normal.

I had been meaning to come to this place for awhile. I really enjoyed it. About 10-12 little tables with chairs and some outside seating for a nice day. They have a small menu which includes the Eggel which is a fried egg with pesto and cheese on a bagel that was pretty good. We also tried the toast with yogurt olives and olive oil and that was also pretty satisfying. We got there around like 12:30 and there was only one Eggel left. I mean we were definitely there past the normal breakfast time but FYI they only make a certain number of Eggels every morning and when they sell out they don't make more.

Going to this place made me wish I were still in school so I had a good excuse to go hangout there with my laptop for a couple hours. Really good atmosphere with exposed brick and great music selection (not too loud, just enough to add a little to the background noise). I will definitely be coming here on a rainy day with book to just read for a while with big mug of coffee.

HORRIBLE SERVICE! We left our Toyota Tundra here for service while we were away on a trip. When we returned, we found that they had neglected to turn off the SERVICE Engine light on the dash. We Called and were told that someone would call us back,  but no one ever did.  Two months later, we again left the same Tundra for service, and this time got a call from Chapman's service dept. saying that the oil pan had a stripped screw and it would be $400 to replace the pan and screw. We told them that they were the last ones to work on it, and a stripped screw is not a result of normal wear and tear.  They refused to make good on their own shoddy workmanship and told us to come and get the truck. Disgraceful customer service!

This library has a variety of events and classes for children, teens, adults, and senior citizens. I've been attending the tai chi classes for balance every Monday & Wednesday since 2011, when I retired from teaching. I started volunteering 4 years ago, and love the experiences I've had interacting with staff and patrons. My favorite activity is pizza & movie night, the last Wednesday of the month. The monthly concerts from Nov. to March are also wonderful. At PHL, the children have their own wing, with movies and books, and the teens have their own room, with computers, games and books. There is something for everyone here, and all you need is a library card.

Honestly i heard bad things about the people here and the selection, but I don't listen and tried it for myself... Bunch of red necks with attitude problems if you got a little pigmentation under your skin spend that dollar elsewhere they don't want your money ‍
Love the staff! We had the whiskey and "red wine" of the night. Great after dinner spot. Music and outdoor options. Casual and relaxed without being stuffy

Things continue to evolve here. Went in today looking for a Greek Tortoise but only had a very healthly Russian Tortoise. The price was par with others in area. Their salt water fish looked very well but some fresh water tanks needed attention. However we did find a Blue Oranga goldfish that was very healthy. I watched it for over 10 minutes to make sure no odd behaviors and it was fine so we bought it(rare goldfish). Most of the other goldfish looked sicky except the large pond and Koi fish which looked good. The store's inventory had been reduced but there was still a wide selection non the less. Just be aware that you will spend more here.

I ordered a gold ram cichlid and a curviceps cichlid along with some Cory's, after waiting weeks with no response whatsoever, I unexpectedly receive my fish only to open the box to find one fish and a piece of paper noting that the other fish were backordered, and the fish that I received WAS NOT what I ordered. I received a sickly blue ram that had ich and would not eat and died within 2 days. My other fish finally came, still with NOT ONE WORD back from these people, and I'm not sure if my "curviceps cichlid" is really the right fish or if its a female apistogramma due to how young it is but it seems to be holding up for now. WILL NEVER order from here again and sad I made the mistake of not checking reviews.

I REALLY wanted to like this place since I'm looking for a new salon.  As soon as I entered the door, immediately saw several arrangements of what were once fresh flowers that are now disgustingly overdue being thrown away.  It really grossed me out.  That, plus the place was NOT clean.  At all.  So much so that I almost turned around and walked out the door.  But, I was in a hurry and I needed my nails done.  So, on I went, and was seated in one of the pedicure chairs for my pedi.  The chair was broken, so I had no "massage" on my back and no side table to put my phone & water on.  The girl who did my pedi & full set was very very nice.  I later found out she was "in training", which wasn't a big deal until I got home and now realize that there is a huge space between my natural nail & the acrylic one.  This means water, dirt, etc will now be between them & can cause nail fungus.  Not a happy camper.  Go elsewhere would be my advice.
*****UPDATE******
My BRAND NEW SET did not even last one week!!!  Every single acrylic nail wasn't matched with my  natural nail, so they began to lift immediately.  I also have nail fungus!!!!  WORSE nail salon EVER!!!!!

At first I was really impressed with the haircut but after noticing my dog was scooting a lot and got concerned. I check her tummy and near her butt and saw she had a cut near her private parts. 
I am very upset, my dog is very uncomfortable, and I won't be going back!!!

Absolutely awful. Waiting for my order an hour and a half. 10 minutes on hold when I call in and my order was quoted at 35 minutes. I don't usually get upset about much but this was terrible service. I'll be taking my business elsewhere.

Great place, service was wonderful, the food was delicious, but the view at sunset was the cherry on top!  I ordered the shrimp and bacon tacos with no cheese and they were delicious (disclaimer: I didn't notice my tacos didn't have bacon on them until I was 2 tacos in, but they were still a 10/10). However, overall my plate was a good size and be try filling. They also have an open bar!! Definitely would recommend this place to eat (especially at sunset!)

As another reviewer said don't let the fact that it's located in a hotel fool you.  Service was fantastic even with a larger party who had four kids under 3.  Food was amazing and the gluten free options were divine and tasted real. We will be back

It doesn't get fresher than this.

The Indian Candy Smoked Salmon will change your life. The flavor, the texture, every part of it is delicious!

my FAV biscuits!! worth the drive. 

PROTIP: order biscuits to go and eat them in a park or at home! they will still be warm 20 min later (Which is what i usually do) 

the breakfast food is aites to me (but i dont like heavy breakfasts to start my day). 

tourists: watch out for the drive. this isnt technically located in "nashville" but 20 minutes west of nashville.

Popular tourist spot. So many things to try, we shared a combo plate and experienced local comfort food. Don't focus on cleanliness or atmosphere, just enjoy the home cooking. Did notice most of the staff seemed unhappy, no smiles. Could be because of the no tip signage..!!  Tip them anyway, they deserve it! Would not visit again, yet glad we experienced it one time.

Just got a balayage done at this salon by Lianne. My hair looks fantastic!  I would highly recommend this salon. However, the lady who cashed me out was incredibly rude. She is heavyset with a short tapered red hairstyle. She didn't say two words to me, not even a thank you! She did not inform me that it was cash tips only. Also, she kept answering phone calls during the transaction. It literally took me twelve minutes to pay for my service. Not they type of customer service that what I would expect from a high-end salon.
Phuong did my pedi +  mani & Minh did my french shellac gel. Great service + excellent work. Will be back!

This place is by far the quickest oil change place I've ever been to. I've been going here over 2 years now for both my Audi and My Kia. Very fair priced and I love that you can get your oil changed in a matter of 15 minutes or less without even leaving your car. I wouldn't trust my cars with just anyone, but this guy knows what he's doing.

Lawn Love Lawn Care. They robbed senior citizens. So my parents are unable to shovel their snow. They charged 80.00 and never provided any services. I called several times and no one as of yet has resolved this matter. No worries! We will be dealing with this matter in small claims court.

I shop at Pottery Barn at La Cumbre Plaza all the time.  Sometimes I make some purchases there, but often, I order online.  I love the merchandise, pricey but still affordable.  I feel fortunate to be able to buy some things from there.  I like to love that store location, but just difficult to.  The staff personnel at La Cumbre Plaza are unfriendly and intimidating.  There are usually more staff than customers, and yet no one approaches and/or ask me for any assistance. It seems they are more selective on who to approach, mostly I noticed "wealthy looking" people of certain racial group get the attention.  I think today will be the last time I will shop there. I'm so glad that there are so many cute privately own shops in town that carries furniture and home décor/stuff.

Technicians were on time, fast, clean, and friendly. Didn't try to charge us for any unneeded work and communicated w/ us and our home warranty company throughout the process. Installed a new water heater and removed the old one within a few hours.

It gets the job done.

Came here for breakfast recently...  There was no line, and the three of us went right up to the counter.  

The guy who took down and prepared our orders was dreadfully slow, but I have a strong feeling that it was his first day or something, so I cut him slack on that.  

They have their regular menu on the wall above the register, but keep an eye out for the specials on the wall to the right of the register.

We got a sausage egg sandwich, one of the specials that is just pork-roll and cheese, and a salsa-egg wrap concoction.

Overall the food was okay, and is great in a pinch...  

I think the simpler you stick on the food, the happier you will be.

I wasn't super impressed by Emmy Squared. Our service was slow, incredibly slow from the time we were seated to the time a server came by. The food was good, nothing to write home about. I feel like if it had been hotter it would have been better but it was warm at best. The salad we ordered came out with the pizza. I would be willing to go back and try another pizza if someone I was eating with really wanted, but i don't imagine it will be a place I will visit again soon.

Been here twice.  The food was really good both times, however, the wait was outrageous.  There was no line the first time but the food still took 20 minutes (3 sandwiches).  On the second trip, we stood in line for over 10 minutes, then 30+ minutes to get the food (again just 3 sandwiches).  If you don't mind waiting a long time, the food is good.  Otherwise, hopefully they are able to speed up their order fulfillment or we won't be back.
Such a cool experience. Everything from the service to the food to the drinks....A+. Such a special treat while I was visiting New Orleans.

I am so happy to have found Moko (though I am a little late writing my review).  I was in Moko just over a month ago for a cut and color with Rachel.  She was really helpful in deciding on a color, showing me swatches and explaining some different options.  I wanted to keep some of the natural highlights I had and she was able to do this for me.  I never ask for anything crazy as far as cut, so I was happy with my cut.  I also really liked the way she blow dried my hair - I don't know if she always does it that way or if she did it because I had explained that's how I do it myself - but it was nice to leave the salon knowing that this was really how my hair will look each time I style it, rather than worrying that it will never look that good again.  It's been a month and my hair color still looks great - I just got a compliment on it last week, actually!

As far as the rest of the experience, I was obsessed with the herbal tea and Jaclyn was kind enough to refill my cup more times than I would like to admit.  Jaclyn also did a great job with the shampoo.  My hair tangle very easily, but she was careful when washing and combing.  The little head massage was lovely, too.

Everyone was also very helpful and informative about their hair care, skin care and cosmetic products.  I can't wait to visit again!

Best boiled seafood in town. It's always fresh and seasoned to perfection, not overly salty like some places. Every time I go in it is busy, but the line moves quickly and the workers are always nice! Make sure you get some boiled potatoes and a bottle of remoulade sauce!

This place was packed with Penn kids and we had difficulty finding seats for a big group.  Tried the burger that had hot sauce/blue cheese, the sweet potato fries and the vanilla caramel bourbon milkshake.  The burger itself had an ample amount of delicious blue cheese on it.  But I'd have to agree with my buger connoisseur friend that for a place dedicated to burgers the burger here was not very big, juicy or flavorful.  I found myself being hungry an hour later.  The option for sweet potato fries is great.  The sauce they gave with the fries tasted nice but was way too runny to dip in.  The sauces they put on the table are good options with regular ketchup, mustard, as well as "chipotle ketchup," "jalapeno sauce," "burger sauce," etc.  The BEST part of the experience was the vanilla caramel bourbon milkshake.  It was delicious and you could taste the subtle hints of all the flavors.  The chocolate/Kahlua shake was also great.  It was phenomenal and nearly even worth the $7.50 I paid for it.  Also - and yes, I know this is a burger place - but there was not any good vegetarian options for those not inclined to eat meat.  My girlfriend is a vegetarian and would have loved to try one of the burger options with a good veggie or black bean burger.  Why not?  Instead, she got a pretty sub-par salad.  Overall the inside looks cool, and it's a nice idea for an upscale burger place, but I don't think the burger was worth the price.  I probably would not return.

Okay so I haven't set foot in this place probably since prom in 2007, so I had no idea there was a gluten-friendly menu! I had the Belgian waffle combo and it was actually sublime, which is unexpected for a place that is so....pedestr? But honestly it was a better night breakfast than other restaurants I've been to. 

I am still here, drinking a milkshake, but I wanted to remember to write this review because our server Ashley deserves it. She was cool af and genuinely friendly, not the forced, performative friendliness required of those of us in service jobs. It's 1am on a Saturday-Sunday night and she's one of only two(?) servers and yet she is completely on top of all of her sh*t and hasn't dropped the ball on a single thing. Even if my waffle had been trash, I probably would come back just to have her as a server, and I'd just order a drink and watch other people eat. 

Another thing I super duper appreciated was Ashley's humility when she brought our food and admitted she doesn't know a lot about what gluten is, and she didn't want to bring toppings until she was sure they wouldn't make me sick. I can't tell you how often people just say a lot of nonsense, like "oh, this has yogurt so you can't have it," which is not related to gluten at all and that makes the entire plate suspect. I'm not mad if you don't know what gluten is, but I am livid when you pretend you do and then make me sick. 

One con was that my eggs were waaay too dry. But that's about it. 

In conclusion, give Ashley a raise.

Not many places I've been to where I've eaten the food and was still thinking about it hours after. The seafood burger is the real deal. It's fresh and you taste every ingredient from the salmon, shrimp, and crabmeat that's rolled into one form topped with cheese. The bun is very soft and light. The seafood fries (although a small amount) was also very good. Seasoned and was flavorful. The chicken wings were just ok. However, the turkey cheesesteak...AMAAAAZING. It's topped with peppers, onions, and some house made sauce that I couldn't identify. Huge portion so you definitely get your money's worth. No dining in as there's no seating. This place gets busy so call your order ahead. Clean place and appeared to be somewhat organized. Definitely worth every penny.
Their burgers are soo good!  I got their cob salad with chicken, just make sure you really Like blue cheese or get it on the side.   Support a local business!

Vlad was great. He ordered the part we needed for our subzero, got it early so came early. Was super respectful and polite. Fixed the broken ice maker and left everything tidy. Will definitely use him again!

Great Catholic church to take a gander regardless of your religious affiliation. It is a very welcoming church. We lit a candle ($2) and got a chance to pray while we were there. We missed mass however (there is a sign that notifies you when mass is being held just so you are aware). Very beautiful architecture, elegant statues, gorgeous relics and replicas, stunning windows. It is an oasis of quiet in a very loud city. I highly encourage you to poke your head in feel the peace and awe it has to offer. Splendid church.

Day by Day is simply delicious. They have an awesome variety of options for lunch and brunch foods, and everything I've had there left me oozing with satisfaction. My favorite Day by Day indulgences are the desserts- scrumptious cookies, pies, cupcakes, and the like. The service is terrific- everyone is really friendly and the food comes quickly. This is definitely my favorite lunchtime spot in Philly!

Pretty average.  Good for watching sports, and drinks, but skip the food.

Overpriced for what it is. I'm from Nyc and would be surprised to see this price in Manhattan. Turkey club at brunch was 14.50.... And tiny and bland. Didn't even have the avocado as promised. Weak cocktail for 10.50. Guess you pay for the atmosphere. Get one of the greasy things with melted cheese if you come. White trash hash was the highlight... Bummer when the potato side is highlight.

The rest of my party got omelettes. Omelette was crappy. Wasn't really an omelette...just an egg patty folded over ham and cheese.  Surprised given how awesome other food was in Nashville.

Service was slow. Our waitress never checked up on us and we used cash to pay and left shortly after getting our food. The place wasn't busy and we only ordered a side of fries... it was a disappointment.

Went here after dinner one night. The layout of this store is weird, because you have to pay and order your ice cream before you know what is available. It doesn't make sense and you don't know what the options are before you pay. The servers were not very friendly. The main problem was they were out of almost every flavor.
