Ingredients were super fresh and the duck was perfect.  I also got my niece Chicken and Broccoli with no sauce that the happily accommodated and that was also very fresh and delicious.  Highly recommend over other local Chinese restaurants in the area.  Also wanted to add when I got my first delivery the delivery person donated his tip to my niece's lemonade stand for charity, which I thought was super sweet and makes this restaurant a good community business.
Beautiful setting on the water with quality food and nice staff . Would definitely recommend and look forward to dining here again

This is our absolute favorite BBQ joint in St. Louis! We have tried every local BBQ place that we know of, and each one falls short in some way. Their meat will be good but sides mediocre, or vice versa.  Absolutely  EVERYTHING at Salt + Smoke is amazing. The meat is perfect -- tender, flavorful, and unique. It needs no sauce. We have tried almost everything on the menu at this point. The sides are perfect too! The mac n cheese is delicious, the fries are sensibly fried in beef fat, the chili is so hearty...  Their portions are generous, prices fair, and wait staff super friendly and efficient. Their service is also incredibly fast! I literally cannot say enough positive things about this restaurant.
I would not take my dog here. They never return calls, faxes , or have any sense of customer service.

Chipotle is awesome, the food is great no matter what location you're at and the service is always quick since they serve it up cafeteria style.

I love this Chipotle location because you get to eat in a cool laid back college atmosphere.  I've been going to this Chipotle for four years and not once have I ever had a problem.

Whether it's a burrito or a burrito bowl they do a great job of preparing you're food.

FYI:  If you get a burrito bowl you can also get a tortilla with it for FREE!!

This place has the worst service ever. Went in for lunch with my daughter to sit on the patio. Some guy in a ninja turtle hat who works there tells me I have to let the bartender know were on the patio. No problem, I go inside to tell the bartender and no ones at the bar. I go back outside and ninja hat guy. He is busy smoking and looks annoyed. He tells me to go back in. I go back in and finally found someone. She tells me that the patio is closed and they are not serving out there. It is 12:45 pm, 75 degrees, and sunny. I decide at that point to leave. I tell the ninja hat guy were going somwhere else and that I think it is pretty lame how they run their buisness. I told him Im in the restaurant buisness as well and would never treat customers as if they didnt matter. He then says "Oh yeah, hows that working for you" in a condescending tone. I hope the management there can do something with some of the staff there. I like eating there and think the food is great. I cant believe that the management would want tier employees treating guests that way.

Newly renovated.  On the plus side they opened up the walls and renovated the bathrooms and put in tv screens and modernized the place.  Better visibility of the stage.  On the bad side it looks just any other modern bar and they SHRUNK the size of the pints .  No more Big Rock Traditional.  The place could use some blues or biker character.  Music is still great!  7 nights a week!  Waitresses still dress bluesy biker-ish, yeah!    Lost a star for the smaller pints.  Not sure if they offer any food.

Kumas has the best food and super cool "rock" vibes. they have a great vegan burger and if you're not vegan, the mac and cheese is to die for.  i also recommend the bloody mary- i got tipsy off of one LOL! it is also a great place to be in the summer. they have a patio and open up their front windows so you get fresh air from the inside as well.

Myself and 7 others dined here on a Tuesday night. The restaurant interior is clean and modern with a masculine finish but maintains a warmth and lighting that created perfect ambiance for an evening meal. We had a reservation so we were seated quickly, and the waitress was prompt to take drink orders and bring out carafes of water, both when the first half of the group arrived, and the second.

To start I had a Three Coins in the Fountain to drink and shared the Bufula Montata and the Bruschetta Caprese. The drink was pleasant; nice to look at, easy to drink, tasty. Both of the appetizers were flavourful and fresh. The bufula was a bit small to share with more than one person, but the caprese had more than enough to go around. Only thing to note is that the Bruschetta Caprese was really just a bunch of rather large pieces of tomato and a hard mozzarella. It tasted great, but half the people at my table were like "Hmm... weird! Not what I was expecting but okay!" 

For dinner I had Casarecce con Pollo e Funghi and loved it! White sauces are always indulgent and comforting and this dish was just that. The chicken was moist and a surprisingly enjoyable part of the pasta. The truffle oil was a very subtle flavour. And lastly, the serving (while by no means meagre) was a lot more filling than it looked! 3 other people dining with me ordered the same and all of us were tapping out after eating less than half. 

Worth noting that all the food came out in a timely fashion and all at once, however the second round of drinks we ordered came a little late, near to when we were finished eating although they were ordered just before the food came out. 

Everyone agreed the food was good and it was an enjoyable dining experience, but nothing spectacular. Not everything has to be, though! I'd say if you want to eat some pasta in a beautiful setting, give Bianco a try! I'm sure I will be back! Can't wait to try the patio in the summer!

I recently moved to Reno and really needed a good stylist. 
I'm happy and extremely satisfied I found Kim. She's great! 
Also got a quick trim from the expert Dean who is amazing!

Not really impressed.  Had a mediocre (at best) bread bowl of clam chowder.  Service was S-L-O-W!  Monday night about 7:45-ish....no good excuse for sub-par service.   My 3 pieces of bread that came out before the meal were all eaten (slowly) before my water finally arrived.  I appreciate the server's attempt to be witty by saying "extra lemon" after I requested none, but it took far too long to be acknowledged, once seated, so I was already a bit irritable.  I just couldn't get the check fast enough.

I got 200 gift card for xmas 2019. So I totally understand we're all doing the best we can. My mother in law who got me the gift cards for me had a 200 gift card for herself as well originally we planned on doing a spa day with massages facials mani pedi the works. So covid happened and their aesthetician is no longer there. They have 1 masseuse and 1 person who does nails. There is no way you can do any kind of girls day. My mother in law wanted her money back for her card, since the whole reason she got the card wasn't going to happen and she really wanted facials the most but it  was promptly denied.I went ahead and got massages with
 mine. My mother in law finally gave in and just bought 200 worth of products the products are absurd. NOTHING has a price. You have to ask the desk to price check everything. The girl behind the counter was watching me like a hawk like I was going to steal I guess. I won't be back. The masseuse is the nicest girl but they didn't offer the special shower or any of the usual perks you get with a massage. They didn't give me a discount. The only reason I give 2 stars is cause like I said the masseuse is very professional and very nice. But 1 star would be fair

We always make the Redfish our first stop when we get to New Orleans and always get the same thing. I do not profess to say all their food is 5 stars, but what we get is consistently great. Order the hickory grilled redfish with lemon butter and topped with crab and you can't go wrong. We order it over white rice and it absorbs all that delicious sauce, making it so tasty! Also, the buffalo oysters are great too. Melt in your mouth and not too hot. For dessert, get the pecan pie. So good! I only wish we could have stopped there one more time while we were in New Orleans but it wasn't meant to be. Next time for sure, as always! Service is wonderful too. The manager usually pops over to make sure everything is okay and I think that is a nice touch. 

Bad: They took their Bloody Mary off the menu, I think it was called the eye opener or something. It was very spicy and dirty but I guess you can't get it anymore which is a shame. It was the best in New Orleans. The one on the menu isn't nearly as good.

So I just ordered potato salad for ten to go and I went to pick it up. On the menu, it says it includes Greek dressing and bread. But then the cashier said no. False advertising. Won't ever come here again.

Place is truely overrated. Waited 50 mins and it was atleast 5 parties ahead of me (saw atleast 3 tables available when i checked in and came back to see how it looked upon being called to seat), there weren't any benches infront of the establishment for those waiting to go into the restaurant, my sweet tea was watered down when came to the table (ice melted in it, I'm sure it was sitting for awhile before brought to my table), and my beverage came out 40mins after ordered (after I recieved my food). Wished I had went back to Neyows.

The food is decent. I like the shrimp pho in particular, and I have gotten it several times. I would rate the restaurant 3 stars overall however given the somewhat questionable service. One time, I ordered the Taro tapioca smoothie and they brought me a boba-less smoothie, informing me that they ran out of boba. I told them I didn't really want the smoothie on its own, and they got annoyed. Another time, my friend and I were left standing for about 10 minutes even though it wasn't busy and there were few customers in the restaurant. Hmm. The restaurant was conveniently located which is why I've eaten here a lot over the years, but it's not somewhere I'd recommend to a friend.

It's what you expect from a beach restaurant, fried fish items and a fantastically old clientele partying around the bar. I walked in to see the most senior group of happy hour goers I have ever seen and I loved it. Live music featuring old Johnny Cash songs made for an enjoyable listening experience. My dinner companion was visiting and wanted beach food and that is what he got...fried platter of nearly unidentifiable fish/seafood, but I was told that it was delicious. We ordered the rum runners because they were on special, menu listed them for $3.50/each (incredible deal) but here is where their otherwise 4 star rating went to a 3 star quickly.... the bill came and the rum runners were not $3.50, but rather $4.50. Only a dollar, but after a few of these, that adds up to a value equal to a whole other rum runner. I pointed this out to our super helpful and surprisingly professional server and he promptly had the manager come speak to us. The manager asked us to note for next visit that they are in fact $4.50 and to disregard the menu price. Why not just change the menu price?! It's a beach restaurant and the food is certainly not fantastic, but it's a fun experience, just be careful of the menu prices vs the real price.

Wow. I happened into this place as it was just two steps from my hotel.  What luck! A quiet table outside, a long beer list, and the cioppino is truly out of this world.  Tempted to stay another night just to try something else on the menu!

I was a groupon customer. 
When I first walked in the door I was not greeted. I stood there for several minutes while the employees were having a conversation. 
When I sat down to the manicure table I had to ask the technicians name, again, no greeting or introduction. 
As for the actual mani/pedi:
I'd never had a mani before but I assumed that the dead skin/hang nails would be removed and the massage would've been longer than a couple minutes. Basically cuticles pushed back and polish applied. The polish was lumpy in places and also not covering my nails in places. I could've done better myself. 
I've had plenty of pedis, same goes for the leg massage, a couple minutes. No hot towels were offered. 
When to get to the car and look at my nails I was sorely disappointed. Nail polish was extending past the toe nails and onto the toes. I honestly am not trying to be rude but it was a very sloppy paint job. 
If I'm correct groupons serve to bring business to you. I felt like I was treated differently because I was a groupon user. 
I also left a 20% tip (20% of the original price, not the groupon price). stuoid on my part. I wish I'd seen these Yelp reviews before I bought my groupon

I love pho and vietnamese food in general, and could definitely eat it all the time, but I've been on a particular bender lately going multiple times a week.  Perhaps it's the cold weather, perhaps it's knowing that your belly is going to be full on very little money.  Whatever the reason, Pho Ha is always a great bet for tasty and hearty vietnamese at extremely affordable prices.  It's one of my faves out of all the pho spots in Philly.  The portions are large, the pho is great, and their broken rice plate with grilled chicken is pretty much one of the best things you'll ever eat in your life.  It's hands down the best dish they serve.  The place is no frills, although they do have some crazy paintings on the walls.  Prices are low, the food comes out super fast, and you will leave happy.  Cash only though, so beware!
Thank you for repairing my tire today! I even made it to work on time.  I have done business at 3 of your locations and have been very pleased with each experience.

I have been to Bavarian World three times. The service was always below average, one time it was really horrible. There is a bad vibe coming from the owner Klaus. The food was just okay on two occasions, but the last time I liked the Jaegerschnitzel. The place is way to big for the little business they have.

Great little hole in the wall I just discovered.  Got the cheeseburger . Excellent! One of the best I've ever had!   Fries were nothing special. However Cheeseburger Fries and a canned soft drink for $7 bucks was quite a deal!   Put in your order and there is a line of seats to wait until your number is called. Great Service! Will definitely be back

We already had dinner reservations but wanted a place to grab happy hour oysters beforehand. Unfortunately, all of the happy hour spots we knew of were completely booked. So crazy, but we stumbled upon this little hole in the wall through a quick Yelp search. They didn't offer happy hour but their dozen was only $14.95 which was still a steal. Of course, we ended up ordering more than just oysters. This happens to me at almost every restaurant out in NOLA. Can't say I regret it. 

Crawfish Rockefeller Oysters - So freaking good. This was chargrilled with crawfish, bacon, and spinach. Every bite was bursting in flavor. ($19.98 per dozen)

Iced Raw Oysters - Super pump and also really good. It was a decent size. ($14.95 per dozen)

Crawfish Spinach Dip - OMG. I would definitely come back here just for this. It came with homemade thin tortilla chips. So freaking creamy and loaded. 

Turtle Soup - This was our first time trying turtle soup and to my surprise it was really flavorful and rich. 

Po Boys (Shrimp) - The shrimps on this Po Boy were huge. Fried just perfectly, crispy but still soft on the inside. Laid on a simple French baguette and dressed. Only thing is it didn't come with fries so we had to order that on the side. 

Drinks - We all got the Hurricane. When in NOLA right? The server hooked it up. So good that's it's dangerous. Careful because there's definitely Everclear in this one.
Ok Indian cuisine . Go there if you this is the only Indian restaurant open in a 20 mile radius . Looks like that is what the restaurant is banking on instead of focusing on making better food.
Food is tasty and nice portions. It can get crazy busy but it always good to order ahead.

My co-workers wanted to order from Rocco's because they love it. I went to the on- line menu and chose the Penne with Vodka Sauce. When my co-worker phoned the store, she was told my dish was no longer on the menu. I then chose something else to complete the order. We were told it would be ready in 20 minutes. 40 minutes later, my co-worker is still standing in the store and was just told " we have a lot going on here". Unless you're delivering a baby or something, what's going on should be FOOD! Unacceptable. Oh the food was OK.

Barry was very helpful and completed the job the same day I dropped off the repair. He knew I lived out of town so he even arranged for his wife to drive the glass home with her so I could pick it up closer to my home without having to drive into town during rush hour traffic! The glass repair looks great and the service was wonderful. Thanks again!

Zero stars.  It was truly a waste of time and a waste of money.   Much of the "art" was high school level, at best.  Nothing was labelled.  Displays hung by pins through the corners of the photographs/drawings.  We were so looking forward to a Sunday afternoon of being inspired by contemporary art.  After a painful 40 minutes, we left -  a little miffed and very bewildered.  It was "half price" for summer admission.  I wish I had spent our $12 on a novel.  Very, very disappointing.

First night in Nola and Desire did not disappoint! Had the oysters in half shell and they were HUGE! 
Gumbo was delish, jambalaya was super-flavorful but not too spicy and the warm French loaves brought to the table melted in your mouth!
Bread pudding was good but not epic...or I would have made this a 5 star review!
Service was good, atmosphere lively to say the least. Wouldn't bring small children in evening as it's pretty crowded and tables are close together. And it's Bourbon Street so you can't predict what will go on at the next table:)

Once again my husband and I were in a hurry for a quick breakfast. The staff was mindful of our  time crunch and expedited the order which we really appreciated. I did not sample the entire menu but had some delicious gluten-free bread for my avocado toast. I added two perfectly fried eggs to boost the nutrition as I was super hungry. I enjoyed all of it and recommend it to you.
We went back and tried the green curry.  Not a single drop was left.  Ordered the Pad Thai again and enjoyed it.  Our consensus:  Better than the Thai Pepper restaurant chain.

We went here for what we thought was going to be lunch, but after our appetizer we got up and left.  the wait staff seemed to be a little slow.  it took 5 minutes just for the girl at the front to put our names on the list, like she was overwhelmed be the task of writing down names.  

for a dining experience, it was OK, all we ate were the Fried Green Tomato's, which is the first time I've ever had them but I wasn't impressed, they tasted like onion rings which is to say, all you could taste on them was batter, and they came with a generic ranch sauce, fresh from the bottle.

I would say this restaurant earned it's 3 star, meh, reputation

Didn't think The Laughing Cat closing would ever be a good thing, but I have to blame the Cat because I never noticed this place across the street.  Excellent Greek food.  The garlic feta fries were as amazing as everyone says in these reviews.  The chicken shawarma was excellent with the various homemade sauces.  $10 for the entire meal with a drink?  A cheaper and tastier alternative to Acropolis (plus you can hear yourself talk!).
A little hard to find but totally worth the effort! Classy, clean & great sense of humor! Comb the Desert!

Stopped in for the lunch special on a Saturday afternoon. $9 got each of us a soup, appetizer, and entree (in reasonable lunch-sized portions). Everything tasted very fresh and carefully put together. 

In case anyone is wondering, I got the red curry (two spicy stars) and I didn't find it very spicy at all (but it was extremely tasty!) 

Service was nice and attentive.

My girlfriend and I frequented the Ale House on a rainy Saturday night and were thoroughly pleased with the experience.  We started with a couple of beer samplers.  The Ale House is somewhat unique in its approach to the sampler - they gave us a list of about twenty beers on tap, and allowed us to choose four.  The selection was good, and I was especially happy to see several Dogfish Head selections.

We started with the soft pretzel appetizer, which was very good.  We both had the Kobe burger for dinner, which was excellent, and our waiter went to great lengths to see that burgers ordered medium came out medium - not overcooked, as is common in a lot of restaurants.  The only down-side was that our burgers came with regular fries instead of the sweet potato fries that were advertised on the menu - but no big deal.  The decor of the place was nice, not huge, but comfortable.  We'll definitely be back.

I had never had Oysters Rockefeller before I ate here. Now, I want them for every meal. I had never had crawfish étouffée, gumbo, or jambalaya before I ate here. Now, I find myself trying to create meals that remind me of the great New Orleans cooking that I had at this restaurant. It's a solid restaurant that will take care of you while you are in New Orleans.

While the facilities are beautiful, we experienced multiple issues during our stay and the customer service response was hugely disappointing given the supposed quality of the hotel. The hotel allows smoking on the patio/balcony of their "non-smoking" rooms. When I booked a non-smoking room I assumed that meant the entirety of the room was non-smoking.  However, the guests upstairs smoked nonstop on their balcony and threw all of their cigarette butts down onto our patio. We were unable to use our patio due to this. When I contacted guest services about this issue, they told me that even though the rooms were non-smoking the guests were allowed to smoke outside. I was not made aware of this when I booked the room and they had no other response to my inquiry except to have the housekeeper pick up one of the butts off our patio. In addition to the obvious health risks with second hand smoke and the fire danger associated with throwing non-extinguished cigarette butts into dry brush (and me! One hit me in the head), it seems the hotel should be more transparent about their allowances of smoking in the room areas. We were never offered to move to a room surrounded by non-smokers. JI feel that It is not unreasonable to expect no smoking in/near a room designated as "non-smoking".  The second issue came up when the same upstairs guests decided to have a party in their room and invite the guests to stay all night. At 11pm I notified guest services that the upstairs room was very loud and had extra guests. Again, there was no corrective response except to tell me they (guest services) were sorry. They room was partying until 1:30 and then the extra guests got up at 5:45am to leave (making lots of noise again). I stated this all to the front desk upon checkout and received $29 credit on my bill.  When I asked if guests were allowed to have extra people stay in the room, he mumbled something about occupancy rules and I then said that there had been six people in the room and he just looked at me. I felt that the responses to our concerns were very disappointing and I would definitely NOT recommend staying at this hotel if you would like a quiet, relaxing vacation.
Go see Caroline at the bar! She's oyster shucker and she won't street you wrong! Tip well, she's awesome!
One star. I'm pretty sure I saw a guy in the back giving himself a solo facial. Kinda impressed with the facial...not so much the restaurant.

So I'm fighting a cold with a some Saline nose spray last week when a rouge squirt sprays my glasses.  I go to wipe the lens and SNAP.

Oh Snap....Right on the bridge of the nose my four year old spectacles bite the dust.  

I dig out my 9 year old Army issue horned rims and rock those for a few days while I wait out the inevitable expense of either repair or new glasses altogether.  

Sadly the snapped frames were beyond repair so my wife (the household negotiator) calls up Lenscrafters to explorer my options.  She was able to talk with a very helpful Lab Tech, Kelley.  As it turns out since I had bought my glasses there 4 years earlier and they still had the frames in stock I would be able to switch out the lenses and pay for the new frames.  This of course, was the best case scenario, though I was dubious.

We arrive, speak with Kelley and sure enough, she was true to her word.  Now, once the sales staff caught wind of this I had miraculously qualified for a brand new "free pair" (free, meaning only the frames,  I would have to shell of for the lenses and and the eye exam as my prescription is over two years old.) I politely declined this offer and don't begrudge them for trying, otherwise they would be crappy sales people. 

So I walk out having only to pay $32 after insurance for the same frames I had and was able to shelve the the brown-Army issue-wannabe-hipster frames for the next emergency.  Great service Lenscrafters crew you, though you have already had it thanks to you're one stop service at an affordable price, have earned all future business from my family.

I have always enjoyed the SB zoo, but have not been there for a while.  It is a small zoo, so you can see the animals in a few hours to half a day, and still have plenty of time for everything else SB has to offer.  Now, if you have small kids, there are plenty of activities to extend the day, but for me, I check out the animal exhibits and then head on with my day.

The zoo seems to have spent a fair bit updating the animal enclosures, which seem more realistic.  For us, the highlights were the African exhibits, including the gorillas and the giraffes.  Now, with the natural enclosures, it does give the animals plenty of areas to hide, so in the heat of the day, you may not be able to see some of them tucked away in the grass napping, like the two foxes, but hey, they get to rest too, don't they?

Excellent. We had beer, wine, bourbon, wahoo, chicken dishes. Very clean and quiet - tables well spaced. I disagree with the review that said the place was not romantic. Probably the best place for an upscale beach dinner on Indian Ricks Beach. Much whiter than Salt Rock. Cleanest bathrooms on the beach by far. Also a very nice bar out back. We had a very sharp waitress who served our table well. Lots of parking in back.

Yes!!!!!!! This place, oh my word, this place is so good! The burgers are perfectly cooked and tester so insanely delicious! Every burger and tot is so unique that you really have to go multiple times and try a new one each time! The dekes burger, Mac and cheese burger are by far my favorites so far, but you really can't go wrong with a pb&j burger either

It was a crazy busy Friday and there wasn't much room to park, but once you find a spot they come to the window quick and you food is ready before you are. Inexpensive, super friendly. Great tacos. We will be back

I always leave stuffed. The burgers are sooo good, I really appreciate that they are so committed to not freezing any of their ingredients or food that they do not even have a freezer in the whole restaurant. You can really taste that difference in the food. A small thing, but one we really like, is that they have caffeine free diet coke in their soda fountain, that's all my husband can drink and most places do not have that option. The only reason I don't give five stars is that they are little misleading with all that "Best five dollar burger you can buy" stuff. Two soda's, an order of fries to split between two people, and two burgers usually runs almost $20.00. Worth it, but not exactly what I expect when thinking about a 5 dollar burger.

Update: we gave them another shot and they proved that our last experience was indeed an anomaly. This pizza was hot, fresh, loaded with sauce and toppings and one of the most delicious pies we have ever had! Keep up the great work, we're going to stay regulars for sure.

I rarely write negative reviews, but after waiting nearly half an hour in a relatively empty cafe this morning for an iced matcha that was basically a $5 cup of milk, I cannot justify going to Cafe Ma'kai' anymore.

I wanted to love this place SO much. It's so cute and they use fresh ingredients, but every time I have been here, the customer service has really been awful. The man at the front today was particularly rude. He gave me a number for a table and when I said "oh this is to-go", he replied "yeah. I know. We still have to find you???", as if I was an idiot. And again, in a pretty empty cafe where everyone already had their food/drinks.

I debated walking out after waiting for so long if I didn't already pay. Just extremely disappointed even when the drink finally got to me and I almost feel scammed lol
The food was home made and the coffee and hot chocolate were so delicious. The family and I were so impressed. It was so good!

You won't spend all day here. It's a small, quiet shop.

You will, on the other hand, likely walk out with at least a couple rare or high-quality finds after a good conversation with the friendly owner or one of the equally as nice paid-beer-experts. And that is why I love having this place close by. I just can't believe how long it took me to initially stop in a couple months ago!

But seriously, don't let the size of this place steer you away. They pack so much greatness in here. Just yesterday, I walked in with no agenda and left with three singles that I would like to try...right now.

BOB accommodated a large, impromptu  birthday party on a Saturday night-because we asked nicely. Love this place. Try everything-this is the place to be adventurous. The alligator "cheesecake" is more like a cheese dip-my husband loved it. I love, love, love the Gumbo Ya Ya. 
Service was steady, not fancy or fake-flattery. Servers weaved in and out quietly and efficiently. I don't think anyone's drink ran out. That's a big deal-especially with Cajun food!
Speaking of Cajun, I'm very much a fan of flavorful food that isn't painfully spicy, and the gumbo and jambalaya both hit just the right note.
Now that Mardi Gras is over, this is a great place for seafood on Friday-but be prepared to wait (as adults are generally able to do). It's totally worth it.

Bad Ass. This place is about a quarter mile from my work and this is the second time I have had it this week. Rough on the waist line, easy on the taste buds. 

The burritos have corn and potatoes and random goodness inside that I have never had (You may argue that this is not authentic..I argue that burritos are not a mexican, but an american thing anyway). They do it with style. It is also a breakfast joint with things like Chorizo enchiladas topped with perfectly made eggs. OMG. Sauces are amazeballs. Tiny little gem in sparks. Go there. Yum.

Very knowledgeable and enthusiastic staff, who can answer any question extensively.  Lots of alternative options for food and other goodies.  I especially like the bulk options as you can carry the treats away in your own bag or container and reduce a little bit of waste.  (I would love to see a company come up with bulk dog food options some day.)   I like to support independently owned businesses over chains whenever possible and this store gives me plenty of reasons to do so.
Pretty good food. I love their spinach salad. The staff isn't the best. The wings are good. The pizza is ok. Cheesesteaks are good. They have a nice variety of choices available.

This is the one I've been looking for! Best boba in town, and super close to the campus, everything I had is so good and also very good service. There is no any other place I can go to take a break from school in IV. You really should go and check this out!

Lucky 97 is the landmark supermarket in Chinatown.  Even if you've never been there, you've probably heard of it.

I went to Lucky 97 for the first time in a few years and I was a little disappointed.  

Don't get me wrong, it's still a great place to buy Asian imported foods, but it's not quite what it used to be.

I find that everything is a little run down now - even the overall feeling of the place.

I got some star fruit which was yum yum yummy! And I picked up a few other things (fish, noodles, a few spices).

Fair warning, you can very off track while shopping here.  There are so many foreign items that you can easily get distracted and start exploring.  It's fun though!

More tourist trap than fine dining establishment. Dress code not at all enforced. I felt overdressed. I also felt rushed through my meal. (Emphasis on turning tables and not quality of food or service.) For the price, and based on the history of the restaurant, I expected more. My pompano still contained bones and was dry around the edges and the mushroom sauce on my husband's steak was gelatinous. I can now say I've been; but, I can also say I won't return. There are at least 150 better options in this town!

Update: After receiving a reply from the restaurant (the reply being as impressive as the meal), I read other reviews. I wish I would have read them first and saved myself $200! This really was one of the worst dining experiences I've ever had.

I use to live here and I loved it.  The building is concrete so you can't hear your neighbors.  The management in my opinion was great and friendly and always assisted me when needed.  Nicole is super helpful. The west views are nice but the area can be a little shady although it's not too bad.  Just the usual characters roaming around.  I always felt safe there and would return to rent in the future if I come back to St Pete.

What a disgusting place in regards to the food the prices and the lack of service. Great concept but without the entire staff. A bunch of young kids that lack any idea of what service is and they cop an attitude when I ask for a rag to clean the table. I am a experienced traveler and know when you can't polish a turd

The best spot on Frenchman Street. Fantastic food, creative cocktails, fun and friendly staff, and top musical acts. We hit Frenchman Street each of our three nights in the city and each time it was the highlight of the evening. We usually arrived a bit later (after 10) and were able to snag a seat at the bar but if you want a table, book in advance. Try the lamb sliders, and the Major Minor Margarita. Can't wait to go back!

The service was excellent and the drinks were great, but the food left a lot to be desired. The clams were gritty, so, while the sauce was good in my opinion (too salty in my boyfriend's opinion), it was like getting a little mouthful of sand with each bite. The cheeseburger birra pizza was pretty flavorless, barely had any meat on it, and I make better crust at home.

We held my son's 21st birthday dinner there (15 people)and we were so happy with everything they did for us. For starters it was cold outside and we originally were going to take the patio but their manager made room for us inside. The food was great as always. Our server, Kurt was awesome! He kept up with our orders and he was always ready when others showed up late. The price was extraordinarily reasonable too!! Worth every penny. You've got a class act there Harold!!Kudos!
Crappy place dirty 4 out  5 times got old food or cooked wrong, Their  menu keeps going down hill, U think  they would know that they need to have a good product and make it the same every time

I was in Indianapolis on vacation and had an unexpected break on my bike. Needed a very quick fix since i was leaving for St Louis the next day. The staff at Matthews was very accommodating and said they could fix my bent piece on my frame by the end of the day. I was impressed with their customer service and they didn't charge me an arm and a leg to fix it either. Next time I am in town, I will be paying them a visit. I bought a water bottle with their name and logo on it to proudly display on my bike as I ride through the midwest.

Friendly staff, clean establishment, and yummy food!

Soups were excellent

1st visit here and must say, I really enjoyed it. Wednesday eve at 7p and not a huge crowd, but moderate. Food came out quickly! I settled on 2lbs of Snow Crab, Garlic Seasoning and No spice. Loved the flavor!!! I was pleased with the cook on the legs, very easy to pull out whole portions of crab for a great bite. I must admit, 2lbs ended up being about 5 claws and I was definitely full off that. I also ordered fries and garlic bread because I thought the crab wouldn't be enough and I was wrong. Fries were good, the basket is huge, enough to share with 3 or 4 folks. The garlic bread was meh, don't need that again.
Yes, it's market price on all of it. Prepare accordingly and ask questions.

This is the best place in the world I always have a great experience when I come here they have everything in the world you can ask for and the Amish section hands-down my favorite place. I come all the way from Minnesota just to come here and I love it.

We bought a great room sofa, love seat, and chair.  After we had it for a week we noticed it had an odor we couldn't get rid of, so my wife called the store and they returned it without any issue at all.  They went above and beyond making sure we were satisfied.  We will shop here first for all of our furniture needs going forward.

This place was freaking amazing. Great food, great service and great prices. Everything we ordered was delicious. We started planning our next trip before we were finished with dessert. Everything is made from scratch and you can definitely tell. Best cheesecake I have ever had. Highly recommended! We will be back as soon as possible!

honestly, my experience there was by far...one the worst I ever had in my life! the worst cheap suhi/preparation/presentation ...!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! cheapness was take it to another level by this cheap restaurant...everything is bad, complicated, untasty, poor refrigeration chain care, rotten avocados, and NOT ENOUGH ENGLISH to explain their crazy menu/system....dirty tables...2 employees sleeping in the kitchen...gosh! looks like theyre living there!!!!!! food was terrible! even the cheap rice was overcooked and sticky....for sure I will call health department!!! peoples life..... are in disease risk there!!!!!!

I enjoyed this place. 
They have a large selection of beers to choose from, especially locally. As well as a wine selection. Then they had 30 beers on tap to choose from. Inside and outside seating.

The only thing I didn't quite like was how crowded it was. There wasn't enough seating and it was so loud. Definitely could benefit from a more open design for the inside.
But it's good that it's busy!!

Food was pretty good, but thats not the reason I'm here to write this.  I stopped in there a little later Monday night, the young kid wearing an orange hat working in there, was quite possibly one of the nicest people I've ever met. I was with a friend who lives in the area, and while I live about 30 minutes away, I would return simply because of this kids kindness. Incredible, seriously, don't think I've ever met a kid that young (probably 15ish) who was so nice. Awesome, way to go Pizza Land, nice job hiring that young man.

Is it possible to give negative stars?  This company has taken over supplying CPAP supplies from an excellent company and ever since, I have had nothing but headaches.  They constantly send me bills for supplies that were fully covered by TWO health insurance plans.  My previous supplier sent out equipment four times a year and would only bill me if I had to fill the deductible.  They were always correct in their bookkeeping.  Verus always tells me I have a deductible or a co-pay so I put a hold on the order until they can straighten out their books.  So now I get one or maybe two shipments a year.  Big Corporate mentality...they would be making 2-3 times more money if they were competent. Currently being billed for $190.34.  Next step Better Business Bureau...

Great food and great atmosphere!!  The staff is super friendly and attentive.  The entire place is sports oriented with any game you are looking for on the big screens, there is a patio with a TV and plenty of inside seating for the big game.  The menu is delicious and the homemade poppers will are a must.   Get there early on Football Sunday for a great seat and a cold one.

They need to learn a lesson about customer service & providing accurate wait times. I was told 15 minutes, 40 minutes later my bagel was still not ready. But, while I stood in the store waiting, they kept yelling out post mates pick ups were ready so clearly they don't know how to organize phone orders/in store customers/online orders in a way to provide accurate wait time info. Also, while I was waiting I asked the person behind the counter at 25 minutes to please check on how much longer it would be but she just never came back to tell me, which is how I ended up still waiting 40 minutes in. So I asked a different person who came back & told me 10 more minutes. At that point I said I can't wait 50 minutes for a bagel sandwich when I was told 15 minutes. The entire time I was waiting, everyone around me looked frustrated too & another guy requested his money back so I then did the same. Also, that entire time about 90% of their orders being picked up were post mates only while the rest of us stood around in person waiting. Bad customer service is not acceptable in this industry & can quickly ruin reputation. I work in the F&B industry and we would never expect people to wait 3 times the estimated wait time for their to go order & the minute their wait time gets beyond the quoted time we would be communicating with the waiting guest then refunding them without them asking & giving them their food on the house. I requested a refund, which took another 4 minutes of my life & I walked out starving & late to work. Also, the manager tried to tell me they don't prioritize online orders over in person orders & phone in orders but it was obvious that isn't true when everyone is waiting 50 minutes & only post mate orders are ready. Sad, I used to love this place.

We came for breakfast to this little bakery, but it's probably better for deserts or in the afternoon. We still liked it a lot. We had a brown and a delicious green apple tart. I also had a cappuccino, which was not very good.

My friend and I are repeat breakfast customers here.  The food's consistently good and the staff is friendly.  It's diner food, but it's made well and the prices are good -- plus, they'll pretty much make you whatever you want if they can.  it's an innocuous looking place and easy to miss, but don't...nice  folks -- go in and give them a try.
Awesome food.  Great service   I love that the spice can be 0-5.  Depending on what you want.   Small but great decor and staff.

Wow sooo bland!! I wouldn't recommend this place for good sushi. Everything tasted like nothing!! I taste more lemon because I wasn't happy and kept asking for more so I could put with my soy sauce to dip my sushi!!! if you want REAL sushi go to miyagi's or naked chopstix in north side.

This place is a fun, casual and cute place to go! It's located somewhat in between central west end and SLU and attracts a younger crowd (mainly SLU university students). I love going here and often come for a quick fix of either ramen or sushi. I find it is a little more authentic than other sushi places nearby and the service is pretty quick! The menu is diverse and the ramen is great! There's a lot of variety in their sushi too!
I love these guys!  Gentle Dentistry at its best.  All of the staff are wonderful!

First timer for this place and for any waxing adventure. This big girl was greeted promptly, treated with respect, spared a pressure sales pitch and will be a repeat customer. You don't have to look like a freakin supermodel to be pampered here. You deserve it, and so does your partner. Ask for Leia!

One of the most beautiful and peaceful spaces I've been to in New Orleans. The staff was so nice and the pastries are works of art. Everything from the old bathhouse tile outside the entrance to the serene patio area, overflowing with foliage and sun beams, creates the perfect setting to enjoy breakfast.

This is my absolute favorite crawfish spot. The prices are good. The staff is friendly and efficient.  I love their viet-cajun seasoning. The viet-cajun seasoning is one of a few flavors they offer customers to submerge their seafood in.  Once I tried that seasoning I have never gone back to traditional new orleans style crawfish. It's spicy and extremely flavorful. I can't get enough. I like to peel my crawfish and then dip the tail in the access liquid seasoning.  Yum!

Based off of the last few months I'd like to give it 1 star but I've been a member since it opened in 2011 and it wasn't always that bad. Like most gyms I'm sure when it first opened it was great...the equipment was brand new and always available, there were crowds but nothing extreme...actually really up until the past few months it was fine. Now whenever I go I'm either getting hounded by salesmen...er, I mean "trainers" to sign up for the training program or I'm sitting on a bench waiting to utilize the cardio equipment.  It's constantly packed....and I mean PACKED...the parking lot is huge however anymore we find ourselves driving around for about 10 minutes trying to find a spot. We usually go sometime after work and I'm aware of peak hours but we've even tried to go later and it's still more of the same. It's gotten to the point where I feel like we either have to go at 9:00 at night or 5:30 in the morning to get in a decent workout and neither of those times are convenient. Honestly for 45.00 a month (it should be noted that my membership is not a universal one that can be used at any LA Fitness...it's local to only this one) I don't feel that I should have to jump through hoops just to make sure I can utilize equipment. I know LA Fitness just bought out Bally's so I guess they absorbed a lot of their members but what about the members you already had? I mean it's not like they're going to expand the gym and God forbid they put a cap on memberships for the time being. I mean the place is a joke at this point...it's constantly dirty, over crowded, the other day I saw someone running barefoot in jean shorts on the treadmill and a few treadmills away there was a guy walking on an incline in flip flops. It's ridiculous. Not to mention the trainers...if I get approached one more time I'm gonna flip out...they literally harass you during your work out. Needless to say we're in the process of finding another gym to join which is ashame because again it wasn't always like this and they do have a huge variety equipment but it's just not worth the money or time anymore.
This is nice hidden gem. We have never been disappointed. The staff is very friendly and willing to please. The food is very tasty and something a little outside the box from you normal restaurant.

Shouldn't be open during COVID, even with a large staff they're not able to handle dine in and takeout together. Orders state they'll be ready in 20 minutes but I waited more than 2 hours for my order and it was still wrong. I ended up getting a refund for part of the order - which the manager wasn't to pleased about.

Great atmosphere. Live music on Saturday night and the friendliest service.  From the host to our waiter, they were all smiles and very attentive.  Great service and the food was good.  Had the steak tacos and they were good but not a very large portion. I would definitely come here again.

I don't even know where to begin. This is the most unprofessional bunch I have witnessed. To the lack of care to the attitudes with many excuses main one being we are short staffed. They didn't do mouth care till I asked if it was done? She was there over a week. I provided everything so I was aware it never had been used. Then I asked about her shower noone knew. I knew then it was time to document everything they did wrong. 5 out of 7 days we would visit and her Oxygen was empty she was always left alone at the nurses station when socials were going on. Music, ice cream etc. I would ask why ? Noone knew. Noone knows nothing but to say were short staffed. 7 weeks with them and she lost every skill and her life she went in Feb 21 2018 and passed away April 12 2018. With them she struggled to breath, was left alone with breathing treatments that she would put on the floor that she NEEDED she had ammonia. Lost her ability to walk when she walked the building the 2 Nd day there with therapy. And walked all the way up to being there a for a week. She couldn't feed herself due to the heavy dose of antidepressants she was put on. She was left in her room with no TV on curtain pulled alone. Or at nurses station while everyone was enjoying social time this place was a true orphanage for elderly people. It's do or die there !!! And my little lady died. U have to be there the full 24 hrs a day to make sure your family member is cared for properly. Mine definitely wasn't. And as much as I place blame on the CNA it was the whole team all the way to the administrator who got involved when dcf was involved. Shit hole at its finest. Shame on them.  Stay away. A bunch of evil ass women with fake smiles. Noone even knew about this ???? Someone knew
Love this place so much!  They have everything you need and go above and beyond to help you find exactly what you're looking for!

This place is amazing! Dr. Dinh is very thorough and explains in detail exactly what is going on with your eyes. The clinic is very clean, professional and they have a great selection of frames.

The staff is awesome! I had Wendy, Audra (sp?) and Tommy all helping out and they were so genuine. 

The best part - I picked two awesome frames and while I went in for the second check after my eyes were dilated, Tommy was able to get my lenses cut. I walked out with my new pair of eye glasses ready to wear the SAME DAY!

Definitely will be recommending this place to anyone who is looking for an eye doctor!

My boyfriend and I had a late evening craving for something sweet after dinner. We looked up some quick sweets in the area and I'm SO glad we chose TeeJay's. We each had a donut Sunday. And it was beyond amazing! They had an assortment of ice cream and topping that you could choose for your donut Sunday. The icing on the donut (cake) was when they heated it all together! Oohy gooey ice cream on a hot donut?! What could be better! One of the owners was in and she was beyond sweet! We will definitely be back.

MIT Computers is by far the most competent computer company in the Tampa area. All of the technicians are highly trained and respectful. Better prices and quality than Geek squad and Staples. More reputable than the Mom and Pops pop up computer shop.  I have been a customer for 5 years, they have fixed my Mac, IPhone, Desktop, and I even have a custom build I will be picking up later this week.

Reunion is my favorite restaurant in Laguna Beach, and my whole family was very excited to see them opening a location in my hometown of Santa Barbara! What a great use of this space. The food is incredible as are the creative cocktails. And you can't get a better location than on the beach at Cabrillo!

Hoping they are successful and stay here for a long time. Looking forward to breakfast service and online to-go orders once they get established.

Rebecca is a true artist! She captures what ever she's photographing just perfectly... from a child's special facial expressions to the beauty of the setting. She is always willing to help, wether it's with props, location, outfits, you name it! She's so easy and fun to work with, that you're sort of sad when your sessions is over. Rebecca has a way of making you (& your children) feel comfortable from the get go. I feel it really shows in her work. We've worked with her many times and each time my kids say how much fun they have! You will not be disappointed and you will have amazing photographs to treasure forever!

I'm in love with Reading Terminal! I had seen in numerous times on various TV shows and I was finally able to go! Amazing food! Anything you want they have it and more! 

Tip: Make sure to take a lap before settling into a certain vendor when it comes to getting food so you see all the amazing options.

This place is absolutely amazing and every non-vegan I have taken along with me agrees! Not one dish, drink, or dessert is "just okay". The menu changes from time to time as they work seasonal vegetables into their offerings. Everything tastes so fresh and unique. It's pricey, but totally worth doing at least once (or once in a while).
Hilarious dinner conversations over how bad the food was. The raw chicken really topped the night off. I wouldn't recommend going here.

Hooray for St. Louis Cupcake!  I went on opening day to support the local business.  They had about 6 different flavors of cupcakes available at the end of the day.  I bought a few chocolate ones with vanilla icing and sprinkles.  The cupcakes are smaller - these are not the super large cakes you'll get at some other shops, but good things can come in small boxes!  The cake was moist and flavorful and the icing was so good! The cakes are about $3/each.  They have some seating but not much - the shop itself is pretty small but clean and bright.  Everyone was very nice and helpful.  I am so happy to have them in the neighborhood!

My third visit to Burger IM
Where they are making my Donelson 
even more loveable!
With their fresh and tasty food!  
The options here are plentiful. 
There's a vegan falafel patty and homemade veggie patty for vegetarians. 
Today I had the side House salad with balsamic dressing and grilled chicken on top. 
(side salad is a meal salad in my eyes) 
Absolutely delicious!
Normally there would be cucumbers. 
But lucky me, they were out of cucumbers today  and offered me my choice of substitution. 
I choose avocado. 
So very nice of them :)
Ordered Caesar  salad and wasn't expecting iceberg lettuce, I don't like iceberg at all and all czar salads are made with ROMAINE!

As sleazy as it gets with sales. They'll keep you waiting on purpose while they're having "staff meetings" when the customers should always be first. Won't give you quality customer service until you get upset & demand basic, courteous service. 

Didn't even bring my car in for a free oil change bc the service department never answered. 

Got a manufacturer recall for a part to be replaced on my car. Came in for 5 mins when they could've told me over the phone that the part needed to be ordered, then when the actual appt was made & I came back, they said they couldn't do it the day we scheduled. When I got upset about having to drive 30 mins on my day off, they agreed to have my car ready for me that day. A huge inconvenience. Save yourself the trouble & go elsewhere for sales & service.

Low prices and full of beach essentials & souvenirs. We purchased 2 straw beach mats for $3.99/each. They have a wide variety of swimwear/cover ups at reasonable prices. We found my 10 year old daughter a boogie board for $10. They have a nice selection of t-shirts, suntan lotion, selfie sticks, candy, picture frames, sun glasses, beach hats and other random 'tourist items.'

For nearly a year, I've avoided sweets but knew that one day I will have a craving that will need to be satisfied. I'm glad when that time came, I've already done my research and read so much great things about Mr. Wizard's that the choice was obvious.

My first of a few visits (~4 this year so far since I really don't want to overdo it), I tried their Hawaiian concrete with yogurt. I did get brave and tried their custard but quickly regretted the sinful decision. I do have to say that their custard was really creamy, thick, and delicious. But nowadays, I am happy and satisfied with my occasional visit to pick up some yogurt concrete with coconut flakes, pecans, bananas and pineapple chunks.

Service has always been quick and the staff have always been friendly. I have noticed though when I've passed by several times that the place does get extremely busy and there is barely enough parking for everyone! It's that good.

i've been coming here for years while i wait for my oil change and never had problems but this time the staff completely ignored me while i was the only one in there and standing at the register for 5 minutes while they walk back and forth in the back and can see me. then she took my order finally and when she gave me my boba she didn't put the lid on and it obviously spilled it over the top and she started shaking her head and talking in her language to the lady in the back. very rude. never coming back here again. i rather drive to dunkin donuts

Made popular by tv, Hash House A Go Go's are popping up everywhere.

We were pleasantly surprised to see it in Reno on our weekend trip up.  Located conveniently in Harrah's.

The boys ordered burgers and meatloaf while I shared the chicken pot pie and a salad with my sister.  

when the food arrived BOY was it a sight.  all the meals were decorated with these edible stick things.. well at least we think it's edible we ate them, not much flavor but they made the dish look pretty.  The chicken pot pie was huge and looks different then what you would imagine a "pot pie" to look like.  The crust was a giant cookie ish thing..  It was seasoned very hard and dry.. not too bad if you dipped it in the chicken pot pie sauce.  The inside however was DELICIOUS.  a mixture of broccoli, chicken chunks, carrots, corn, and I'm sure more.  and to our surprise underneath the pie, a heaping stack of potatoes.  Shared between the two of us we still couldn't finish it.

The fries that came with the burgers were the best fries we had all weekend.  The boys were definitely stuffed with plenty of left overs as well and you could tell they enjoyed their meal.

I got a tomato something salad.  I wasn't too fond of the dressing, it was rather on tart side and the salad was plain.  one tomato sliced into 4 big chunks, lettuce, and some cheese sprinkled on top.  I'll know for next time to pass on the salad, but the pot pie was really good.

The food did take awhile to come out.. and it didn't all come out at once which was a little weird.  Maybe it was just this one location.
Rachel  the Manager was amazing she made me feel very comfortable, I needed a place to stay because my house is being remodeled.  Thank u Rachel for your kindness and hospitality I will be back.

My knowledge of Indian cuisine is new and limited so I always go here with my daughter who knows what to order. We do not do the buffet ($8.99 for lunch) as we really want to taste the true spices and venture into new taste treats. We so far have stuck with our favorite which is the Vegetarian feast and comes with multiple dishes that just keep coming. When you walk in and smell all the spices, that is basically what I want to taste and am never disappointed. They do ask the level of heat you want and I am at 'medium'. The staff are amusing and quite dedicated to your experience being a positive one. I photographed many of the dishes but many were gobbled up before I remembered to take a photo and that is a good sign. I recommend dining here, I always leave feeling it was a delicious and spicy dining experience.

You may want to run away from this company not walk!!! They don't show up on the day of the move, days later they show up with no apologies.  If your things turn up at all they will be damaged or broken.  There insurance does not pay the claims and your things mysteriously go missing.  Oh by the way apparently they will only deliver to your garage and not your home due to covid...one of my favorites they do not honor their quotes it will probably be 25- 40% more and will hold your things hostage and charge you for storage if you don't pay up...just my experience with them.

What a rip off!!!! The sushi "chef" took forever to acknowledge, smile and never welcomed me. The hand roll was SO SMALL that I could hardly find the fish among the copious amounts of rice. 
If you want rice...go here, if you want a good roll, friendly and prompt service definitely go somewhere else!!!

We stopped in to watch the USWNT game yesterday - the place is definitely not a sports bar but the atmosphere, food, and service definitely made it a great experience! The wings were great (and do choose the house dipping sauce), the polenta fries were ok, the peanut butter ice cream brownie was exactly as good as it sounds. The real highlight was the bartender (cbadger) - she was friendly, knowledgeable, and made a good experience great. We were only in town for the weekend but would definitely return if we were locals!

The trainers and workouts are great. Everyone is super personable and inclusive. Not only the staff, but the other trainers are lovely as well. It feels like a community, without the weird cult-like vibes at a crossfit. The trainers also remember your modifications to make sure you get a workout that is intense, but also right for your body. They're good people and help you see results. I started with the 21 Day Challenge to introduce you to the gym - a great deal to get you acquainted with everyone before jumping totally in.

Unfortunately due to the circumstances of listening and understanding the depth of what I believed an easy order, I paid full price and never received my whole order. This also led to me not feeling there was any flavor to the food what so ever on the order I asked for and did not get. It's unfortunate to the simple order I had. It sure would be nice if I got refunded for the true order I requested or the company to at least send me a new order again to renew my confidence in their abilities. This creates less than one star in my opinion.

Went here for a simple shrimp poboy, and got it, and the special (shrimp stew).  Both were pretty awful.  Worst tasting poboy I ever had.  Overly breaded shrimp, that were not deveined, and not fresh tasting.  The entire poboy was half the size of what a poboy should be.  The special was shrimp stew, and the shrimp were so tiny, they were the size of dried shrimp.  Very little seasoning, and the short grain, cracked rice, was something you feed to hogs.  The service was good.  People who like this place just don't know what good seafood tastes like.  I would never serve someone the crappy food I purchased here.
Great hole in the wall. Don't pass it up!! Burgers, jambalaya, portions for cost were great.

I will preface my review by saying the food here is actually quite good, despite my giving it a lackluster two stars. I will follow that up with mentioning that I have only eaten here once, because the other two times I attempted to give the place my business, I was turned away at the door.  Once I was told they weren't accepting any more guests, and the second time I was informed that the kitchen was closed. Apparently, you don't have to seat anyone at 9 PM even if the sign on the door says your restaurant is open until 9:30 PM in Saigon. This could easily be a 3-31/2-star place if they would actually allow people to eat their food.
Best cheese steak EVER, and lived around Philly for ten years. Really good beer selection also.
Highly recommend!! They demoed our chimney and rebuild it. The final product looks great! Overall Matt and his crew were awesome to work with.

Was this the best Philly cheesesteak in the world? Maybe not, which is too bad because a) that's what you'd hope for when in Philadelphia and b) this place is highly renowned. It was still very good though. I got mine "Provolone wit" and thought it was definitely pretty tasty. I think one risk you run with Philly cheesesteaks is dryness, but this was overall a pretty good amount of moist. It was kind of greasy, which was okay for the time being, but I do think that detracted a little bit from the sandwich. The bread was fine. Could have been a little firmer. By nature they have very efficient service (necessary when there's a ton of people lining up into the street) and the sandwiches are really big, with a ton of meat packed in them. It was a little expensive but fair enough considering the status Pat's holds in the area. I'm not sure that I would go back, but it was worth the experience as a tourist.

Wonderful experience from the moment we walked in and were greeted warmly.  Waitstaff were friendly and professional.  Drinks were interesting but a bit pricey.  Food was perfectly prepared.  Good place for special occasion - not loud you can sit and talk and enjoy your dining experience.

I purchased a gift certificate about a year ago and gave it to my wife to go see Patricia. She said that I better buy more because it was the best wax job that she had ever had! We highly recommend her.
Leo, a personable gentleman, came to my home within 20 minutes. Got me into my place and changed a lock.  Reasonable pricing and it was all done within 20 minutes. I could not be more pleased.

Food is a little above average, but the service is awful. Of the 4 times I ate here, one time did not get what I ordered on first try, next time my salad had no dressing and no cherries as promised. Would not be too much of an issue but it takes a long time to correct the mistakes and no one seems to care that the service is lousy.

The Cinnamon Swirl Crepes is a MUST HAVE!!  Walk here, run here, drive here, fly here, it doesn't matter how just make it here for a breakfast.  The cinnamon swirl crepes were crazy good!  The crepes were light and fluffy and filled with a cinnamon sugar mixture like would be in a cinnamon roll.  I was so delighted to see that the fruit on my plate was a complete Vitamin C party - whoot whoot!  It was pineapple, grapefruit segments, mandarin orange segments, and pieces of blood orange.  So yummy!!  I had a decaf coffee and I was so happy when they brought me the French press.  I love a good French press coffee.  I am fairly certain that I will dream about this breakfast and I will be going back for it again.  YUM!!!!

Best steak for the money available. Much less expensive than the upscale steakhouses in Tampa. Decor is tacky, seems to be targeting the "early bird" crowd, but the steak is awesome. I do wish they'd offer something other than the pate for the pre-meal freebie.

I brought a 2015 Ford Explorer Sport in for service. I was hearing a knocking and a little hesitation with steering. The service team was Great they found several things wrong, most under warranty. They also did my inspection and gave me a loaner vehicle. John Paul stayed in touch with me and gave me all the updates. My Explorer runs great now.Thanks

I moved to the area in May and I found this place and the food was scrumptious and they have ice cream so it's a win win right. 

Wrong. This place is inconsistent. The quality of food I've had from here has been poor to say the least. Salty is another word that comes to mind. Sloppy and not appealing when opened. Oh yeah the cookies. Don't try them unless you like hard biscuits. Literally. I tried to get my money back and when I returned my name wasn't left so I looked foolish. 

The last two visits haven't been stellar at all. There's a guy named Brian and I swear when he's there my food taste old and salty. When the girls are there no problemo go figures. Dudes careless maybe. Idk all I know is my food has been consistently poor quality and taste. 

They have nice toppings for the sandwiches like purple cabbage, coleslaw, etc so if it's not there it's not the same and asking me to return is a non negotiable since I'm home and it's nearly 8pm

I'm disappointed and at this point I just want my money back.

A newly opened brewery in north Wales. Everything is all shiny and new. Retro bar stools. Extensive hot dog menu.  Purse hooks on the bar always earn an extra star from.me.   
Beers rated on a 0-5 pint scale based on the ammount of pints I could drink in a night. 
Arnold palmer: partea pale ale combined with lemonaide. Very light and refreshing. Great summer beer. 4 pints. I wonder how it would he with a touch of raspberry syrup. 
Partea: typical ipa. 0 pints. 
Bitto honey: ipa blended with local honey. Smooth and less bitter than a traditional ipa. 1 pint. 
Love is evol: Subtle hints of strawberries and jalapenos. Delayed jalapeno flavor. 2 pints. Evol is love backwards
Flying magic zebras: black and tan type beer. Blend of death match hopless and partea. Nice smooth. Not too bitter. 3 pints. 
Red zone: an Irish amber beer blended with cinnamon and cloves. Similar to an Octoberfest type beer, but not as sweet. 2 pints. 
Insana stout: a chocolate Bacon stout. Subtle toasted chocolate finish. Limited Bacon taste, but a nice enlisted flavor.  3 pints.
Death march: hopless stout blended with star anise. 0 pints. I don't like star anise.  A potential 4 pinter if they took out the star anise.

Love love love! Always a great time! Great, unique way to see parts of the city. Dedicated to keeping you safe and making sure you have a good time. I also love the events they put on for the community.

This company ROCKS!  They are the oldest boat moving company in the nation... have the equipment and experience to move ANYTHING!!! They have over 200 trailers, 50+ drivers and yards in several states too!  

They moved my oversized yacht across the country... without a hiccup. ALL Permits and pilot cars taken care of!!!

Serious, if you want the BEST, use Joule.  They have been successfully moving boats since 1954!!!

I should hve gone with the reviews. The Thai food here is horrible. I got take out at 2:30 pm and they were serving stale rice! The curry was sub-par at best. Worst part, it wasn't a cheap mistake! Not returning to this restaurant in the future.

Avalon Lake is an excellent apartment community if you are looking for something centrally located, reasonably priced, and spacious living. The maintenance and office staff are extremely friendly and helpful and always respond to requests within 24 hours.

Heard back from the owners. Very quickly I might add after I emailed them. They were courteous and  agreed that things should be handled differently going forward. The cake itself was very good and their candor and responsiveness equally so thus my updated review.

We were greeted promptly, staff listened to what we wanted, offered additional side items, served us with a smile. Overall, a pleasant experience. Also, one of the cleanest stores we've been to as I watched an employee preform HAACP checks of food and equipment. Nice to know that the employees care.

French-Lebanese cafe with an elegant vibe. A perfectly suitable brunch alternative to Honey's, which is just a couple doors down, and with a much shorter wait (if any). 

We came here for brunch in the early afternoon and ordered the Foul Moudamas, a plate of two scrambled eggs, tomatoes, and hummus topped with fava beans. It comes with very light, fresh-baked pita. It was very tasty-- I'd say the hummus was the star of the plate. 

I've heard the pastries are baked off-site by a former Le Bec Fin pastry chef.  We tried a brioche bun, which was quite delicious, although it wasn't as fresh-tasting as we would have hoped... perhaps if we had come in the morning it would have been better.  

The ambiance is exquisite, from the arabesque-designed cups to the embroidered seats. And all the servers were very friendly and helpful, and the owners came around to chat with customers and make sure everything was going well.

Great eating experience-- perhaps (for now) one of the best kept secrets of NoLibs 4th Street.
Great prices wonderful food. Only negative is that the lights are so low it is hard to read the menu.

For a very busy buffet I think this place does a great job. Their food is fresh and I love their dessert selections.  The pho bar is my favorite. Kind of expensive for what it is but that is expected of the casino buffets.  I wouldn't recommend going for the crab it is filled with tons of water.

Poorly prepared food ,  poor service, high prices.  
The decor is better than the cuisine.

Overall, this is a nice place to visit.  There are a few issues that need to be improved upon, though.  I made reservations far in advance for a party of 4 for afternoon tea for the Saturday before Mother's Day.  We've been to this establishment many times over the years and have always enjoyed the afternoon tea service.  This time, unfortunately, I was less than impressed.  We were seated near the rear door, and there was very little room between our table and the doorway.  I kept getting bumped by staff and customers wandering in and out of that door throughout the duration of my visit.  At first, it was just a mild nuisance, but after a while I became annoyed with it.  It was not a good seating arrangement.  Further, the servers seemed somewhat overwhelmed by the level of customers.  One of our companions had asked for a glass of water; another one asked for a refill on the pot of tea.  Neither item arrived until we made a second request, this time to a different server.  Meanwhile, the line of customers waiting for macaron orders started to stretch around the interior of the building, making things a bit awkward for those of us who were seated at tables.  Perhaps my experience would have been better if I had come on a less busy day.  I cannot fault the bakery for being busy, but I do fault them for the cramped seating and for what I felt was less than stellar service, despite the $26 per person charge for the afternoon tea option we had selected.

Hothouse is a relaxing coffee house with a good variety of beverages, pastries, and light meals (read, sandwiches). I rarely take a seat, as I usually stop in for a latte in a "just passing through" manner. The people are really friendly and seem to enjoy working there. I appreciate that they offer seasonal beverages.

One suggestion: I wish they had a punch card for drinks. Buy 10 get 1 free type of thing. They offer gift cards, but we all love frequent caffeine-flyer miles, right?

I have traveled through several different airports however,  I have never been through such an organized airport as Tampa International! Unlike other airports, once you arrive and check in your luggage,  you have to wait (with all the other passengers regardless of the terminal location) awhile to get through TSA. Well, this is where Tampa International stands out from the rest. Instead of every passenger trying to get through the same TSA check point,  you actually take the tram to your terminal and then go thru TSA. To me this process is much easier, as well as, quicker! 

There are a few bars located in each terminal as well as, several different food concepts. The lines move quickly and the food is piping hot! There is plenty of tables to sit and eat at an actual table versus using your lap as a table. In addition,  there is plenty of desk like areas, near the gates, for those who have work to do or who need to charge their electronic devices can without being interrupted or in the way. I suppose you can state there is personal space unlike st other airports where people are on top of people. 

Very nice and organized airport! I highly recommend flying out of this airport if it's an option.
Lately this sonic has been pretty good. They've been getting our order right, the food has been fresh and the servers have been friendly;) I hope it stays this way
Definitely better than Tea Do. Don't care if this is controversial. Tea Do is too watered down and Kung Fu tea tastes much better and has a better menu. My favorite is the taro slush :)
I grew up going to Yats in Indianapolis and the new location in Franklin does not disappoint. By far the best meal you can get for under $10 anywhere in the Nashville area.

We sat in the covered outdoor area and had a lovely meal. Great service by the chef's wife! Highly recommend the Moroccan red wines. Entrees were fish and lamb with cilantro pesto and were delicious. It's on the pricier side, but a real gem.

I was here less than 24 hours and didn't have much interaction with staff. Rooms seem a bit small but overall i would stay  there again if I was in the area. Location is close to the airport and about 25 minutes from Bourbon Street.

I had the pleasure of visiting Points of Health during our trip to Santa Barbara. It is a welcoming office--a tranquil house that is converted into an office with multiple treatment rooms--the perfect atmosphere for healing and well-being.  

Erik, both business owner and acupuncturist, is one of the warmest, most caring people you'll ever meet. He addressed my concerns with utmost attention and his approach to acupuncture is gentle and thorough. 

Johanna, also an acupuncturist, is delightful. She spoiled me with a head and foot massage at the end of a session and I left feeling like a noodle (sooo relaxed).

Amazing. The best fish I have ever had in my life, hands down: yellow snapper amandine. The almonds & butter make it caramelized on top, giving it a delicious crunch that fish never has. Just perfection! The green beans it was served with were fabulous as well, really fresh.  We had a few appetizers, I'd recommend the cauliflower, they season it really well and it's cooked just right. 

We had a gluten-free member with us and they were very accommodating and provided a celiac-friendly meal. Clayton, our server, was the most polite and thorough waiter I've ever had, too! He kept running back to the kitchen to ask how they made everything so good :-D Plus the other waiter moved over a heater for us to stay warm outside after sunset. It was a lovely evening made so much better by our visit to Oak and Ola!

I was extremely happy with how easy Calcote's was to work with. I needed my outside unit replaced and it was so difficult to get someone out to give me a quote, but Calcote's came out the next day and replaced my unit in the same week. Super easy and helpful. I enjoyed working with Johnny and his sons.

One of the best bowls you'll ever get in your life. I have traveled to a lot of places and these bowls are on the same level as bowls from super exotic places. It is also very helpful that they let you exchange certain items. If you want toppings at the bottom the middle and at the top they will go out of their way to do that for you. All around some of the best customer service in Nashville Tennessee. They remember faces, orders, they are always smiling. Must eat in Nashville Tennessee. 

YouTube @Whats Up Rosko

My first impression as I walked into India Palace was that my boys and I were way under-dressed. My stereotype about what an Indian restaurant should look like was shot down immediately. The tables appeared to be covered in white tablecloth (it turned out to be paper), there were candles and nice silver on each table and all of the servers were dressed in formal wear. 

I was prepared to turn around and choose another destination, but then I noticed that several other tables sported young children and none of the patrons appeared to be dressed in anything other than jeans and other comfy wear. So we took our seats and started to peruse the menu.
