We were greeted at the table almost immediately with glasses of water and a cracker-like bread. The bread was great. I perused the menu and waited for another server to come by and take our order. And waited. And waited. And waited. 

I brought a magazine to read and got through two articles before one of the gentlemen came by and asked if we had been waited on yet. I had even been giving him and others the faint smile and raised eyelids which is the universal signal for "hey, how about some attention here!"

We were not offered any drinks. We were not offered anything else besides the appetizer and two entrees I had been eyeing for several, long long minutes. I was planning on ordering wine for myself and two fruit drinks for my boys, as well as a dessert. Check average is not important to India Palace, I guess.

To be fair, the food was good. Not amazing, but good. But my experience was already ruined by the time we received it.

I first visited Casa Mexico when I moved to Boise in the summer and it's location is a great place to sit outside and have a few margaritas. The staff were friendly and very helpful! I wasn't super impressed with the food (being from around San Antonio, Texas I'm a harsh critic) but it's definitely a place I like to still order from in Boise to satisfy that craving. Their food is fresh and just seems to lack in the flavoring of the meat. Because of COVID I've only ordered delivery since which limits my review of food presentation. Typically I order the Chile con queso which is a white cheddar base with tomatoes and peppers. This is actually pretty good compared to other restaurants! I also order the beef enchilada and two taco entree. I've had the chicken version before which wasn't as good so I recommend to go with beef! Like I said above, the food is fresh but seems to slightly miss the mark for that robust flavor in the meats. On the other hand, the food isn't greasy not give you that oily feeling afterwards! 

I'd say if you're looking for something closeby in the Boise area with reasonae prices (even better if the weather is nice) to definitely check it out! I also recommend this place for delivery. Isn't 100% there but can satisfy that craving for Mexican food. My overall rating 3.5/5!

I love this place! Boyfriend and I use this as our late night food craving. It gets delivered most of the time before the estimated time. I usually get the chicken wings, which are awesome with Chinese vinegar  and chilli flakes, and he gets the beef chow fun. Always good and open til 2am!!!

Long line that moves fast, and just our luck - we came on national ice cream day. Lots of diff flavors, and the staff here are all friendly. Do note that they use fresh dairy (from cows) for their ice cream, so if you are lactose intolerant like I am, you will be uncomfortable. Worth the discomfort imo because the ice creams were so decadent and creamy. I love how you can choose two flavors for their "one scoop" cones.. or try a flight of 3 flavors for slightly more ice cream. Scoops are VERY generous and large, and their waffle cones are delicious and fresh. I think I tried something caramel-y and something toffee-ish, both very good. Already on my itinerary for my next trip to SB. :)
Great dog park! Lots of people/dogs.  We stopped here traveling from CA to Boise, ID to let the dog and kids run around. Highly recommend.

I love this place. I had a Groupon and tried 3 sandwiches: the goat, the craw gator and the mac n cheezy. The goat was the best! It had a sweetness to it that I loved and the mac n cheesy was my second favorite. The staff were all friendly and the place was very clean. I would say it's in the same category if a Chipotle or a Company Burger. It's a huge step up from fast food. I will be back, this is one of my new favorite places. Please build in metairie!

This place is a gorgeous bit of mid century architecture. I love libraries, plain and simple but I go out of my way to spend time here. 

As far as space usability, this place is on par with other universities. The book stacks are less. The technology is more present and the space is more welcoming of an evolving culture. 

There are spaces for gathering. Plenty of study rooms. The first floor is for conversations, traffic, groups and snacks at the coffee bar. 

It's a home away from home for graduate students. So yeah, we like it pretty well.
It went to simply buy a fish for my tank got a 3rd degree from some attendant named Chrissy Very bad attitude won't be back

Ann did a fabulous job with a major in grown nail I've had for years. Typically within a day or two of having a pedicure my toe starts hurting again. It was painful while removed, but so worth the savings over going to the podiatrist. She has a great selection of natural remedies. Highly recommend. Won't go anywhere else to have my pedicures.

Great place for a quick drink on the water. We didn't eat here but sat outside and enjoyed the beautiful view. Happy hour prices were great. Perfect spot to stop for a few drinks on the way to dinner.

The atmosphere was great--The space is really interesting, and for a large room with tall ceilings, it was surprisingly easy to have a conversation without shouting or having trouble hearing one another. The service overall was friendly and attentive, and I was especially impressed when I was three blocks into my walk home when one of the staff came running up, holding my purse, which I'd left at the table. The fact that he chased us down during a busy Saturday night service was really above and beyond, in my book.  

Food was good, though I wouldn't say it was amazing. There were a few inconsistencies between what the menu stated and what we were actually served; for example, while the menu described the cheese board as coming with truffle honey, the food runner who delivered the board said it would be jalapeno honey, and it turned out to be regular honey. That said, the cheese was good, and my dining mates loved the bacon jam. 

I'll definitely be back, and look forward to checking out the beer garden.

As a "local", i find myself avoiding a majority of the sponge docks due to the tourist crowds...now that seasons ending I finally decided to check this place out and i sure am glad that i did.


Started off with the bacon wrapped shrimp & feta appetizer: nice crisp bacon around extra large shrimp with a nice char taste. Only complaint is the small amount of Feta. If youre gonna use it in the name of the appetizer, i think increasing the amount of Feta would be a good idea. If that was the case id order again. 

For my entree i had the Shrimp Po Boy (Blackened). The bun was toasted nicely and the blackened shrimp was seasoned perfectly and packed this sandwich with flavor. Definitely get the fries instead of the kettle chips for a $1 upcharge.

In addition to the great food, the servers were pleasant and extremely attentive to drink levels and all our needs. The ambiance is great, right on the water and they even have the option to dock your boat to come in and eat.

I look forward to being a regular at this establishment.

Delicious pizza made the way you want.  The process seems a little slow but then again you don't feel rushed picking your toppings for your pizza or a salad if you prefer.   The one on Congress is better though.

Very disappointed. My partner tried the sushi a few weeks ago and loved it so we decided to try the Thai food tonight. The chicken was dry, flavorless and tasted a few days old. It honestly tasted like they batch cooked a bunch of the chicken at the beginning of the week and then topped the meal with that protein instead of making the chicken fresh with the meal.

DIRTY AND SMELLY!
Unimpressed...
Now, I like a nice place but don't need the Taj Mahal. Just a clean place to lay my head will do...
Firstly, there were trash cans and garbage piles in the landing of the stairway which was odd but didn't smell bad 
We were on the fly to check in ( on our way to an event) and no one was at the desk - to prevent us having to check in at 11:30 at night we had to make an inconvenient trip to get gas and zip back to the hotel to try to check in again

The toilet had a SPLOTCH on it!! Ummmmm, no thank you!!
We got a room with a kitchenette which was fairly decent sized but the fridge stunk like dead fish so we could not use it ! It stunk up the room simply from opening the door.
The " breakfast " was packaged snacks and coffee
We went to the desk in the morning about getting our room cleaned a bit better... no one there again
UPDATE :
At 9 am we asked if they could please come and check out the smell and at the very least clean the toilet... 
3pm we returned to our room-NOPE
We asked again , left for the day ( we opened the windows with our own tools so we could air it out and it was COLD when we returned -- but, fortunately we had purchased some new Boise State sweatshirts we could sleep in!)
We returned at  11pm ready for bed and a fresher smelling room and ...NOOOOOPE! 
We left the front desk guy know and his response was" oh, she told me she cleaned it"- nope! 
We asked the front desk guy ( who was polite but not particularly concerned or motivated) to come and clean it. He came to the room , opened the fridge and ..... DEAD FISH!!

The guy opened the fridge and fishy whiffs wafted out to the other end of the room. We all went "whoa!!" Even our football players who can handle a lot of stink could smell it ... and the guy said " I don't smell it". He continued to claim that he could not smell this disgusting smell  ( we are now wondering if he had COVID or a broken olfactory system because that is literally the only way!!) 
He simply shrugged and said well, I cleaned the vents and I don't smell anything soooo." And left 

Fortunately we bought a candle while we were out just in case the smell was still there. 

So here we lay with our cinnamon candle burning, the windows wide open wondering if the smell is actually coming from a carcass under the bed- no one will look so we will just go with dead fish in the fridge 
We should probably go sleep in the stairway with the garbage piles - it might be warmer and fresher smelling 

Not staying here again. This is our least favorite hotel in Boise,  fo sho! Give the Comfort Suites Just down the road on Vista

Overall we've been satisfied with the quality of the food.  I"m still not 100% convinced that it's saving me money because I do have big eaters in my house but I do like the quality.  The steaks are really good.

Overall 4.25 and excellent value, especially during RW. Their usual prix fixe also great value. Of the Solomonov group's offerings, Zahav is still our favorite, but Abe Fisher delivers tasty twists on Jewish classics

Pickled mackerel (4.75 stars): large chunks of tender mackerel in a dairy based and slightly sweet dip. Was our favorite of the night. Also on the HH menu!

Breads and spreads (4.5 stars): challah and rye were quality, and all the dips were fantastic. In order of favorites: chicken liver mousse (creamy, no grit, not too iron-y), onion butter, garlic cream cheese spread, and borscht tartare

Corquettes (4 stars): crispy, creamy white fish innards

Tartare (4.2 stars): tender beef, good balance of sweet from apple and spicy horseradish

Dumplings (4 stars): very interesting, a tad on the sweet side with brown butter and Seckel pears. Loved the texture though, very fluffy and tender

Brisket yapchik (4 stars): very savory, meat wasn't dry

Banana bread pudding (3.75 stars): the bread pudding was actually quite light and not dense. Very strong on the banana flavor. A few pieces of the flambeed banana were a bit unripe

Quark panna cotta (4 stars): a thicker version from the quark, giving more of a full mouth feel

Both cocktails from the HH menu (5-7 daily but only at the bar) were unfortunately too sweet for me. Decent wine selection. No problem getting seats for 2 on Sunday 5pm although we sat at the bar to take advantage of HH. Service was nice but not pushy. Free sparkling water!
Gelato was good, but they had no macarons or crepes at 1:30 in the afternoon. Staff is not unfriendly, but obviously not happy to be there.... Somewhat apathetic.

Decided to revisit Montecito Inn with my family. Wanted to stay local with my kids, so our concierge recommended this restaurant. The ambience was very nice, but the food was mediocre/terrible. I ordered paella...and it was so disappointing. Even kids meals were bad. It would have been better to order appetizers for my kids. That would have been cheaper for sure. One mediocre dinner, one disappointing dinner, and 2 over priced kids meals for $92 ( including tip). Ugh!  It wasn't a great way to start off our little weekend get away.

This place does not disappoint! The service & quality of food is great. I recommend the Smith and Hook Cabernet Sauvignon & flatbread trio. Overall everything I've ever had at Lucky Fins was really good.

I can't believe corporate hasn't stepped in to fix this place. It is the single worst establishment I have ever been to in my life. I've never seen something so horrible in my life. Never go here... Ever.

If your in the market for a appliance repair person look no further than this man!!  He is courteous, knowledgeable, prompt and definitely reasonable on his prices!!  Had a dryer issue and he came out and had it up and running in no time.  Arrived at the time frame as promised.  It is hard to trust a repairman these days and I was lucky to find this one!  Give him a chance and you won't be sorry!  Will definitely use David for all my appliance repairs in the future!!
This is for the car wash only.  I've had multiple terrible experiences here, including with the management regarding the car wash.  It just doesn't work well.

As a regular customer of New India's Kitchen, I would like to say that this is a very nice establishment and has a very comfortable and peaceful atmosphere. As one reviewer noted, they recently had an unfortunate situation and had a leak in the roof. They have cleaned the water up and are only awaiting everything to get settled with insurance before putting in new flooring and making this lovely place even more appealing! I especially love the beautiful chandeliers and the way they keep the tables set with pretty water glasses and clean white linens. 

Don't let anything keep you away! You don't want to miss out on the delicious foods that Neeraj provides on the daily lunch buffets as well as all of the wonderful options available on the menu. He is a great chef and, as I have said before, I am fully convinced that he can make every food taste fabulous. I especially enjoy his soups and curries, but I really love it when he creates something new! He frequently will do this and put the new dish on the buffet. These original creations are always terrific.

If you have not yet been here, you need to come out and taste authentic Indian food made with quality ingredients but more importantly served with integrity and care. The staff at New India's Kitchen genuinely desire that you enjoy your food and not just give them your money. From the first minute I entered the place, I have felt most welcome and known that they truly want my business because I am a person they care about and not just to meet their bottom line. That, my friends, is a unique blessing to find in America today. 

I encourage you to come check out this wonderful place that offers so much more than just a plate of ethnic food. See you there!
Waited for more then an hour for a Togo order of 2 teriyaki chicken when they only had 2 tables!!!!!never will come back

I have been coming here for over 20 years.  Never a bad meal EVER!  I bring so many out-of-towners here and walking up to the door they always look like I am nuts for bringing them but once they take a sip of coffee and bite into a croissant, (or anything else on the menu), they want to come back again!   I am devoted to my Ham and Cheese Croissant but have tried many items over the years and they never disappoint me!

On a side, I met a man on a flight back to Philadelphia in Georgia.  He used to live in the area but not for many years.  He mentioned this little restaurant in a town outside of Philadelphia in Chestnut Hill that was his favorite restaurant ever.....well, I had the best flight back with this gentleman recollecting his favorite scones and jealous I lived 10 minutes away from his favorite restaurant!

This is not a great place to stay, and we will not be back. We booked way in advance of the date we would arrive and we got a room on top of the railroad tracks. We were told the rooms had microwave and refrigerators  we didn't have one in our room. We ask for a King bed, no we got two double beds.  The sheets were stained and not something I would use camping. The room seemed clean other than that but never got freshened up or bed made, we were told they were short handed. We had 6 couples who did not have rooms cleaned and one couple did not have a working toilet on the morning we checked out. We all had to go get fresh towels. In fact my husband had to go to the laundry himself to get towels for our room. We ask to speak to the manager twice and never had one on site. I do not feel we should have been charged full price if the rooms was misrepresented and not cleaned.

I came here by myself because I wanted my opinion to be the only one. After all it's my wedding day. I showed up about 20 minutes early to a 3 o'clock appointment so I wasn't expecting to be helped right away however, just moments after being greeted and signing in, a very friendly stylist came up and got me started. Scarlet was her name and let me tell you I would highly recommend asking for her directly. She pulled dresses that I have saved as favorites on my online profile but also some that she suggested based on my likes and wants. She was amazing. Not only did she help me put on everything on she let my son help her pick veils. He was so happy to be included. I did not leave with a purchase just because I have a couple to decide from but I did make my second appointment on the spot for my bridesmaid dresses. Scarlet was awesome, so awesome that I cancelled my appointment at a competitors store to try on more dresses. I can't wait to order my dress and to go back to pick out my bridesmaids dresses!!
Showed up right at closing time but they helped me get my ice cream fix anyway. They loaded my blizzard with extra stuff and it was fantastic!

OH MY SWEET LORD! I love sushi and am very particular about it. This was up there with the best I've ever had. The prices are incredibly reasonable. We got the Monster Roll, Crunch Roll and the Spicy Salmon roll. The Spicy Salmon was good. The Monster Roll? AMAZING! And the Crunch Roll wasn't too far from amazing. The wait staff was very friendly.  Our waitress talked us into getting desert and we chose the fried cheesecake. It was ok. I didn't love it. The restaurant itself was lovely,  adorned with hand drawn murals. I'm new to this area and am excited to have found my new favorite restaurant.

I love district donuts! They have one of the best cinnamon rolls I have tried. It is a bruleed cinnamon roll with cream cheese icing. The perfect cinnamon roll for me is crispy on the outside but soft and warm in the inside. 

Plus a variety of fresh and creative donuts that change from day to day! Pictured is the maple bacon donut because who doesn't love bacon and a carrot cake!

They also have kolaches, biscuits, breakfast tacos/bowls, croquenuts, and of course coffee! My favorite is a basic cappuccino.

Grabbed lunch here the day after Thanksgiving and was underwhelmed. Ordered two steak tacos and a fish taco, along with a drink (fruit tea) and chips. The steak tacos were good, but too salty and also sloppily made. The fish taco was almost inedible. It was basically a frozen fish stick wrapped in a tortilla - totally unacceptable. Chips weren't fresh or tasty. The meal cost over $14, which I'll be disputing with my credit card.

The classic red tomato pie is the best thing ever. It's absolutely delicious! Bruschetta pie not so much. I was not a fan of the flavor, but classic pie is a solid 10/10! Great app for a party, tailgate, etc

This is such a cute and relaxing place to have a pastry or a coffee.  I have a friend from Europe who ate here and said it was one of her favorite places due to the quality of the desserts, so I had to check it out. I hope they have a their fall outing again this year where all the shops open up and for an evening of fun. Great location in an old building right off the Monon

A-maz-ing. Ok yes, service can be shaky. I can't lie. They are sometimes understaffed for sure. But the food. The pork schnitzel and pierogi is my favorite dish. Every person I take there loves it. And try the Ukrainian Borscht. YUM. While you are at it, try the polish bison vodka with Apple juice. You'll thank me.

One of the bankers (not a teller) came out to greet us and even though we were just there for a deposit she helped us with everything and went above and beyond. She gave my girlfriend some checks to use, explained how to manage credit card spending and explained the best way to get a credit card through Chase. She also got me some hot chocolate mix. Now that's service and it was with all done with a friendly smile. Thanks!

I was disappointed at how they "nickle and dimed" me on the bill.  As a vegan I'm used to not finding much on menus, so I was not surprised when they really didn't have much.  I ordered a chicken salad without the chicken and cheese, and again wasn't surprised when they didn't deduct anything from the price of the salad given I didn't have the most expensive items on the salad.  But I was surprised when they charged me extra when I asked for some more vegetables on my hummus appetizer AND charged me .75 for an extra small side of salad dressing - really? If you're going to charge for the little extras, shouldn't you deduct for the big item I DIDN'T have??  And the waitress never mentioned that she was charging me for the extras.

The workers are good. The smell is WAY too much. Too much enough to make my mother and I both literally sick to our stomachs. I got sick in the parking lot as soon as I walked out. Took a while for them to see us. Dirty. Nobody wiped anything.

The theme is military and police. A lot of military and police. Wall-to-wall military and police. The BBQ is good and that's more important than the decor. They have a number of sauces to choose from and I enjoyed trying them. The bun on my sandwich looked so good with a butter top but was very dry. Otherwise, I enjoyed my meal.

This is a good gym - convenient to my location. This past year they lowered the prices which is nice; however, the gym has become overcrowded, particularly during peak hours. The exercise classes also appear crowded. They have a good assortment of weights and equipment. With the exception, they don't have enough squat racks. Overall, a decent choice if you live in the neighborhood.
By far my favorite breakfast spot. The staff is friendly and the menu is creative and delicious! Don't leave without trying a signature pancake!

I used to work in Doylestown and had been going to this place consistently for about 3 years. Amazing food, generous portions, great specials, and the staff is incredible. When I moved away and got a job elsewhere this was one of the places I kept on my radar to come back to. My mechanic is still in Doylestown so I decided to come back and see if everything has held up since the year or so since I last went to them. I'm happy to say that Hickory Kitchen is still doing well and still churning out some of the best comfort food you can find anywhere. And this might be a little thing to some people but the fact that the owner recognized me and remembered may name just kinda hammered home why I love this place. Take your friends, take your family, go on a date here, doesn't matter what it is I guarantee you that you'll love it.

I order from johnny rock's fairly often. Their food is great and I would recommend anything on the menu. I gave 3 stars solely for the poor delivery service I recently received. I owned a pizzeria for 5 years and know how important time is to a customer, especially a frequent customer. Waited 1hr and 20 minutes for two sandwiches. Usually, they're pretty quick. The burger bun was drenched in oil from sitting over an hour and was terrible. The fries were like cooked spaghetti. Ended up throwing away the fries and bun. Just awful. Also, if you use Styrofoam containers, cut the corners off so the condensation does not wilt the food! Again, their food is awesome and I highly recommend it, but the delivery service could be much better.

Very nice history of Ybor City, including an informative video, and many nice exhibits of clever little artifacts that really put the information into context.  The tour wasn't as informative as hoped, with the restored home lacking period decor or most information regarding the daily lives of the workers.  It was, however, an excellent spot for some real Tampa history.

My favorite food on this planet: donuts. My favorite place to get them: Long's Bakery. These are the definition of perfect donuts. The yeast ones are great and the blueberry cake donuts... well they take the cake. Be prepared for a wait, but it moves quickly and you get to make some friends in line. Cash only!

We've been loyal customers of this restaurant for many years and over the past 5 visits, take out only, we have been very unhappy. Our orders have been wrong, missing items and when I call I'm promised better next time. I'm fed up, tonight I called and was very upset that they forgot the rice that went with our entrees. I was told I could come back to pick it up or get credit for next time, after telling them there won't be a next time after all these mistakes, and the owner hung up on me.

I come here once or twice a month, and I like it. I usually get a sandwich, breakfast, or something from the bakery when I'm here, and I'm always satisfied with the food (as much as you can be by diner food, anyway. Come on, we all know what we're getting into when we go to a diner). 

I've found that service is very hit or miss. They seem to have a lot of staff...I don't think I've ever had the same waitress twice. Sometimes the staff is prompt and really good, other times...not. My best friend I went for an early dinner once, the place was not crowded at ALL, and we sat with empty plates for about 25 minutes (with our waitress walking directly past our table several times and my friend literally waving for her attention) before we were noticed. It took another 10 minutes for our check to be brought over. That particular incident was about a year ago. There were other times it's been pretty slow as well, but none as bad as that time.

I love rating Starbucks against smaller, more local, more interesting coffee shops.  Once again, this particular Starbucks isn't as good.  Stopped in at 11am, ordered medium roast.  It tasted not so fresh.  Service was reasonable but not very friendly.  Some Starbucks employees are cheerful, not here.  

This particular Starbucks is long and narrow with nice decor and a decent selection of baked goods.  It is fairy new and looks that way.

If you, like me, are new to the city, and spending your nights whipping around Philly abducted by some fine folks in constant search of the new adventures - then you will undoubtedly need an appropriate vehicle. And if your vehicle of choice is a bicycle - then you're my kind of a dancer.  For the handy ones-the bike church on 39th and Locust is a holly place of bicycle worship, filled with used (and some new-ish) bikes, bike parts and accessories, with tools and skilled advice at hand.  For the rest of us, the not-so-handy ones, well, be prepared to get stuck in.  I went on a Weds eve- the 'woman's night', which means your facilitators are girls.  This makes a perfect setting for the beginners who may be reluctant to ask stupid questions. Well, fear no more, as these skilled lasses have heard them all, and won't blink an eye at such work-shop blasphemies as '..Erm..and what exactly is WD-40?'. I promise.

But it all comes at a price, and not of a monetary kind - as I certainly exchanged my work-shop virginity for the work-shop enthusiasm, and what is now an entirely free free-wheel. Not a bad deal if you ask me.  But bring some cash and make a donation, they deserve it.

So so so delicious. Make plans a week in advance, make a reservation, pick up a nice bottle of wine and enjoy! This place is fantastic. It's next to impossible to get a reservation a few days in advance so plan ahead. The food is out of this world and the vibe is so fun. Can't wait to go back again.

The lady who waited on us at the counter was extremely helpful and very nice. She helped my friend and I decide what pastries we wanted to try. The almond croissant and the plain croissant are delicious! My friend ordered the Macchiato which was also enjoyable. The house brew over ice was also very delicious. The aesthetic of the coffee shop is very appealing - very urban rustic vibes -which is quite charming. Definitely recommend this cafe to avoid rain in the city!!

Used to be my favorite place to go and have a stroll, eat, sightsee. Now it's more of a place I go to when I can't find a specialty item. Whole Foods would then be my last resort. I'm a Costco fan now especially since it seems as though Whole Foods, has dumb down their product in a sense. And the customer service has plunged into the deep end.

PROS: Delicious, fancy asian food, soothing ambiance, good for dates
CONS: Pricey for small portions

As far as "fine" Asian dining goes, I think Buddakan is as good as it gets. Everything is more or less perfectly executed --- the meats are succulent and well-flavored, the sides perfectly complement the dishes, and the desserts are to-die-for. My only gripe is that I'll order an appetizer, entree, and dessert and leave only feeling 60% full. On days where my mouth craves exquisite flavors, Buddakan would fit the bill. On days where I just want something hearty and filling, I'll probably look elsewhere.

I was looking for colorful, American-made dishes that were lead free and beautiful. Well, HF Coors provides all of the above and more. I am so pleased with my purchase. The dishes are outstanding quality and the colors are vibrant. I have been shopping on line these days and I just want to say thank you, thank you for delivering an outstanding product. I'll be ordering from you again!
everything was hot & fresh!!! the wait was pretty long but it was graduation season when we went.

Snowshoeing in the winter, mountain biking in the summer. The meadows are versatile year round. I love coming here especially for snowshoeing. You can pretty much go any where in the trail, many people even bring their backcountry skis. It looks really fun!

I recently spoke with Walter at this dealership. He told me about a car he knew I was looking for. I went in and he was off. I was referred to landen. Both sales representatives were awesome! Knowledgeable . Helpful. Courteous. And above all HONEST! BJ was the finance manager working that day. My interaction with him was equally impressive. He told me he could have the deal ready to sign in 45 minutes. 20 minutes after, I had signed and was getting in my new Audi. Amazing dealership! I returned to have the car detailed and spoke with chris Lowe! He was just as the others were. My car looked amazing! It was completed very quickly with full professional attention. Absolutely going to be a repeat customer! Look here Reno buyers. For new and used. You won't be let down.
They did a great job inside and out! After driving 2300 miles, with a fog that sheds, the car was filthy. I would definitely go back!
The best chicken fingers ever. This location is always very friendly and fast. We get Raising Canes way more often than we should.
Very clean establishment good food  fast and friendly I would recommend trying their food and cheap delivery fee also large menu

This cleaning service is simply terrible. The first clean they did was great but each one after has become worse and worse each time. The owners are so incredibly desperate to run your credit card for the charge they neglect whether or not the actual service they provide is any good. I have tipped the ladies really well in the past but each time the clean is worse. A lot of places charge $100 or close to that for a clean. I chose Royal Maid knowing they were a lot more money because I assumed if they charge more the service would be much better. It was not. I spent the first 15 minutes at home going behind them and cleaning what I paid them to do. I told the owners of my disappointment and they didn't even care enough to respond back. I sent them pictures showing them the poor clean. They could care less. Maybe because they were too busy running the $255 (before tip) charge onto my card to be bothered with the quality. I recommend you not waste your money like I did. They will disappoint you guaranteed.

2016 , better late than never because I'm reminded every time I see the portrait. I want to start by praising the actual photography process and the results. Great work but I want to get to the customer service aspect of the visit. I don't want to site race as a factor but maybe class was the issue. Maybe we weren't the star studded athletes they were use to seeing or a rich family but nonetheless Kingsley's mother wanted pictures taken here. So the day we arrive to pick/pay for the package the manager was not very warm or welcoming. Obviously we were first time parents , I was pretty indifferent about baby pictures but Kingsley's mother was elated to be at this well renowned business. Her face lit up with excitement going through the pics & while trying to decide what she wanted the manager became impatient and started to rush her. She made her very uncomfortable and her elation turned to anxiety, despair & fear. I wanted to just say F it and leave because why spend this much money to be treated so rudely. She picked the package but she was so unsure & uncomfortable that it bothers me until this very day. If the manager was behind I felt as if she should have scheduled us for another day , this should have been a moment of joy but she ruined that for us. Product turned out great but the customer service was terrible & I wouldn't recommend anyone to go there if there is a single chance they would be made to feel like we did.
The restaurant is at the end of all the partying on bourbon street.   Very good food. My only problem is the space very small. But my grilled shrimp basket was good enough for two ppl.

I absolutely cannot understand how this place has so many positive reviews. Honestly, I didn't think it was possible to mess up Mexican food this bad. The salsa we got might as well have been a can of diced tomatoes poured in a bowl. Zero flavor and the tortilla chips were nothing to write home about. I ordered cheese dip which came thick and chunky. My daughter said it tasted like mac n cheese. She wasn't complaining because she likes Mac n cheese but when I order queso, that's what I'm looking for. For our meals, she got the kids taco with rice and beans and I got the fajita nachos with sour cream. My daughter's plate had liquid all in the bottom of it which then made the taco soggy and crack in half at the bottom. We never actually decided if we thought the liquid was water or grease. Next she brought out my nachos which were burnt with tough steak and what appeared to be hardened mozzarella cheese on top. Instead of putting a drop of sour cream on my plate I was brought an entire bowl and charged $1.50 for it. Who comes to a restaurant and orders a container of sour cream? I sent the burn nachos back and when the check came I asked her to remove the sour cream charge because I ordered it on my nachos which I didn't get to eat. She didn't question taking either off my bill. I sat with an empty cup for more than half my meal before I just decided she was never going to refill it and just started helping drink my daughter's. Old Hickory absolutely needed a Mexican restaurant but this one isn't it.

As always, the chef was very entertaining and was the star of the night. I've had hibachi dinners numerous times and I enjoy it experience every time! 

Ikura is asking people to make reservations at this time. You will be seated with other parties, but if possible, they will leave chairs vacant in between parties. However, if the parties sizes do not allow that, you MAY be sitting next to strangers. My party and the party I sat next to were both small, so the sat us at opposite ends of the table. The chef wears a mask the entire time. Masks are required and hand sanitizer is available. 

The food was good. The salmon was OK, but the noodles, rice and veggies were all good. 

The waiter wasn't very attentive but nothing to complain about.
Love happy hour at Trident. Great service. Our favorite is the chicken skewers with peanut sauce!

I really appreciate the quick response that I received from work law on some work related legal questions. They had a great understanding of issues I should consider for employee practices in both California and Nevada. The quick answers I received were very helpful. They didn't try to make it sound complicated or make me feel like I needed more legal help to figure it out. They just quickly addressed my questions and gave me easy advice to follow. thanks Work Law!

Perfect sports hangout place... No complains about food. I was greeted well, Joshua works there and he addressed me to the table.. Courtney is our waiter both of them received us well... All the staff are super cool .. Everyone have good attitude... Good food+ nice staff= FIVE stars...we had thai curry wings and they were delicious...

Cocktails are very good and the appetizers are a perfect combination. Service is very good and knowledge about drinks.  
Menu is limited but if you're just here for drinks and appetizers it's a great place to start.

Love this place! It has become a part of my regular grocery trips. There's three locations in Edmonton; I've been to two, and think it's a great little place. The store is relatively small, as it specializes in produce. The best part? So cheap!! I get all my fruits and veggies here, lots of selection, really good quality (besides bananas not being ripe enough and the bread being a little stale, but could've just been that one time). They have a few other things like some dry pasta, and salad dressings and honey. I got a cardboard box FULL of produce for $30!! And the box was a foot deep, a foot wide and two feet long. They have different deals for different days of the week too. One time I got a free container of strawberries for spending a certain amount. Highly recommend!

Decided to try five guys after I heard about five guys getting in a fight at five guys in Florida. 

$15 for cheeseburger, small fries and a drink

Not great

The fries had potential but were very soggy. Had 3 and decided I was done with them

Not sure how the burger tasted as it was overpowered by a velveeta tasting pile of cheese

Free peanuts were the highlight - 1 star

Ginger Ale - 1 star
I've been here a few times, easy to navigate , Baggage claim is simple. Easy Curbside pick up when my Maroon Limo shows up

I must start by saying that I am extremely upset that my favorite restaurant that me and my family dined in for years has truly ruin its reputation by making terrible decisions in hiring new cooks that do not know how to cook a steak I ordered a porterhouse steak medium well with a lot of pink in it and they cook my steak well-done so I send my steak back and several minutes later the manager walked over and apologized and she ordered me a new steak medium well with a lot of pink and after waiting another 20 minutes it still came back well done .......... I was on a schedule and couldn't wait any longer so I had to leave at least the manager was nice enough to offer me another steak but enough was enough .I really don't know what happened to my favorite restaurant.......

I just ate the best hoagie of my life.  Well, half of it anyways, and even though I'm stuffed I keep eyeing that other half.  I've lived within blocks of this place for years and somehow never tried their food until now.

We ordered a Godfather hoagie (my incredibly delicious choice), a Sicilian, and a Caprese.  The Godfather is hoagie perfection- proscuitto, sopressata with lovely chunks of peppercorns, roasted peppers, sun-dried tomatoes, basil, green olives.  I opted to go sans cheese as per usual and I didn't miss it at all.  Get it on the seeded roll for sure, a hoagie roll just wouldn't stand up to the hefty portions of meat and moist fillings and vinegar.  This beauty was $8.95 on a seeded roll and easily enough for two meals.  The other hoagies were in the $6-7 range and were just as large and all around got rave reviews.

The moral of the story is, why wait forever for Sarcone's and pay more when there's Cosmi's? Plus, they deliver.  It's a win-win.

I feel so lucky to live within walking distance of this small restaurant slash wine and beer shop slash european deli. It's such a fun environment and the Friday/Saturday night prix fixe dinners are amazing. This weekend was German night, and it was stunning. Add to that a beer and wine list that's something like thirty pages long, an atmosphere where you talk to both the proprietors and the guests at neighboring tables, and a relaxed  pace, and there's nowhere I'd rather be on date night. Yay! p.s. they also have Thursday evening wine and beer tastings, which I haven't attended yet, but you can bet I will be doing so in the future.

As always beautiful. The only thing we didn't care for were the creepy faces on the trees right when you enter the park. My daughter missed seeing the jumping fish that were absent from the display this year. 10$ was a good price per a car. Go before The 18th!

If you havent made your way over to the Northside yet, I'd highly reccomend it, the Northside Social in particular has delicious food with a touch of southern charm!  The service is excellent and the atmosphere is dark and cozy.  Their cuisine is a twist on a some classic southern dishes.

We stated with some a fresh summer salad.  Roasted juicy baby beets, sweet strawberries,  tangy balsamic, candied pecans, creamy whipped goat cheese, and fresh frisee come together to create a fresh delicious summer salad.  As well as their buffalo cauliflower wings.  You don't have to be a vegetarian to fall head over heels for this spicy, crispy, tender, creamy concoction!  And my personal favorite was the Mousse Trio.  Think the creamiest most delicious tea sammies you've ever had.  Smoke salmon, deviled egg, and pimento cheese served up with warm toasted bread and tangy picked veg!  TWAIN TIP:  Get extra bread!  They also had what seemed like a decadent sinful breakfast in one small bite!  A fluffy hoecake topped with seared slab bacon, savory bacon jam, tangy pickled green tomatoes, and a sweet honey glaze.

Don't forget to get a delicious cocktail or two to go with your startersd!  Like a crisp fresh mule.  Beware though their drinks are strong and tasty, quite a dangerous combination!

Their sides are a indulgent series straight out of grandmas cookbook!  All the cheese please!  Northside Social is definately added to my top 5 mac places in Indy!  They have a few choices.  The crispy pork mac n' cheese and the veggie friendly pimento mac n' cheese.  Cheese on cheese on cheese!  Their bacon braised greens were also quite delicious!  Because balance.  But also these greens were delicious, talk about a taste of the south!  They also have some crisp tender asparagus drizzled with a silky, creamy ramp bearnaise.

Now for the main event!  The entrees at Northside Social are pretty amazing.  Scrumptious, beautiful, and expertly prepared.  P.S. my fellow foodies are pretty amazing too!  Check out Circle City Supper Club for more foodie coverage!  They have a variety of seafood, chicken, pork, and beef options, as well as a variety of fresh made pastas and veggie eats!
We started with the plump smokey shrimp, creamy grits, scrumptious salty greens, and a sprinkle of nuts.  Talk about southern charm!  Next was Pan-Seared Scallops green garlic risotto, glazed carrots, english, snap, snow pea salad, and carrot purée.  This might just be the most gorgeous place you've ever seen?  If Andy Warhol was in the kitchen I'm sure this would be the product!  They also have something similar to a piaya.  Don't let the name fool you, the lowcountry boil is nothing but a high quality dish full of flavor.  

One of my personal favorites was a sinfully delicious fried chicken paired with a creamy hardy pimento mac & cheese could cause a southern affair!  If you'd prefer your chicken in cream sauce I'd recommend the 
Parmesan & Herb Crusted Chicken.  This dish feels like home.  Creamy pasta and chicken were a staple growing up for my home, but Northside Social's green chili cream and lemon butter broth takes this to a whole new level!

Jerk Braised Lamb.  Please don't pass this one by!  A tender juicy lamb shank, hardy baked beans, and a fresh summer slaw.  This was by far my favorite dish, and I can't wait to go back!  This is southern so we can't forget the ribs!  These smokey sweet peach butter ribs with homemade potato salad will have you salivating for more!

And the summer specials are just as charming !

For something on the sweeter side they have a great in house made dessert menu, with a real deal pastry chef!  And the creme de la creme!  Chocolate cake with fresh strawberries and whipped cream served up in the sweetest little mason jar.  My favorite was a scrumptious moist peach upside down cake with crunchy sweet candied pecans and bourbon caramel sauce was the perfect end to a perfect meal.

@twainindy

Ordered to-go for a small group function (7 adults).  The food was delicious.  My one critique was that the person I spoke to regarding my order (a day in advance of when I needed it) was not at all helpful regarding quantity and had I taken her advice, I would have ended up having spent waaay too much money and with waaay too much food.  As it was, we ended up with leftovers (which in reasonable quantities is a delight). I would like to try their outdoor eating space- it's lovely.

Build Your Own Bagel :)  How can it not be awesome!? It didn't disappoint.  I built a lox/onion/capers bagel and the lox were tasty & fresh.  My boyfriend ordered a jalepeno cc/bacon/egg bagel and loved it.  
Only two complaints, 1) they cook their eggs in the microwave.. I didn't order anything with eggs, but still it kinda was weird, and 2) they have some 'interesting' customers, as in they kinda let anyone in.  That may not bother some people, but it kinda was a little un-appetizing to me.

Great service, and good pizza. Dough is semi frozen/slightly pre-baked, and the sauce is a good mix of tangy and tomato-y. There are set made up pizza combinations you can order, or you can custom order your toppings, but my friend and I stuck to the pre designed topping orders, subbing out some of the ingredients to ones that we like better. 

The meat lovers (sub out some of the meats for mushrooms and veggies) with their regular crust was awesome, and the crust came out perfectly with the bake directions included.

The gluten-free crust that we got came out pretty differently to what we are used to, as it was our first time trying gluten-free bread and pizza. It was not as light and crunchy as a white crust but still a good alternative for a day you are trying to be healthy or if your diet is gluten free. I think it is great that there is an alternative for these people to enjoy pizza as well.

On my way out, I received a $1 token for my next purchase, so I'll be back! CASH/CHECK ONLY

I have been to Ramsey's several times few times for tire issues and once to have my brakes and rotors fixed.. the price was tad bit high I thought for a 2017 Ford,  but I trusted Ramsey and the also have 2year warranty.
Customer service is impeccable and the owner is also hands on. 
As a female who doesn't really trust mechanics, your in good hands when taking your car here.
Phenomenal. Got the chicken and was everything to be expected. Others with me got the fried oyster plates and sampler

Minus half a star....

So tried this place for the first time today. 

I heard good things about the food and the service so on a lazy Sunday I decided to give it a shot. 

The whole claim to fame is their prompt service and speed...  I got neither. 

Took about 50min from the order to deliver. 

I was told that it would be quick and a person on a bike (Schwinn to be exact) would be delivering. Meanwhile a guy in a car dropped it off. I don't know why the confusion but it is what it is. 

The food:

I ordered a margarita pizza which was terrible. Partially because it was cold. And the other part because it was just a bad pizza. Normally on a margarita pizza there's a hint of basel and thinly sliced tomatoes. But I had these thick cut sad versions of tomatoes with a strand or two of Basel that wasn't even enough to alert the sense of taste or smell.  Certainly not the best dish on the menu. 

Also had an Italian sub. This was okay but it was about 8" long... For $11....  I could have walked to subway and the same quality and half the price. Certainly another dish that can't be the best on the menu. 

I really don't understand all the amazing reviews but maybe they just got better service or better food. Or maybe both. 

Ultimately, this place was lackluster at best and certainly does NOT make me want to try again. 

The reason for 1.5 star and not one star is because food was edible. Just nothing amazing. Nothing special. Just ehhh. And now I learned my lesson. 

So I had a bad experience with ClusterTruck and they game me a code for a single complimentary meal (even though I ordered 2 bad meals) and the code doesn't work. Beyond terrible.

Minus half a star

So after wait to talk to whoever deals with customer service things got worked out. Although have two bad experiences will not make the star rating go up dramatically. 

I ordered some food from Bru Burger which of course is decent. 

The food came by bike messenger. 

Certainly better than my first order (which is NOT a difficult accomplishment). 

Food was like warm at best but still tastier than the initial order. 

Is the place great??  Not really. 

But they did do everything they could to please a dissatisfied customer. 

All in all the customer service came around to fill the need of the customer. 

Will I be ordering anytime soon. Doubtful but we'll see.

Quaint little place. I sat at the bar to take advantage when we are it is always happy hour at the bar, discount on drinks and appetizers. I had the linguini bolognaise with three meats and red wine sauce. It was amazing. 

Another reason to sit at the bar is being able to watch the kitchen staff turn out the amazing food in this little space.

I will suggest this to my co-workers and friends.

Excellent food! Took my girlfriend here last night for Valentines day and we were blown away! They had a four course meal and they were not messing around with the portion sizes! 

Everything was great! The service, the food, the atmosphere. My only complaint is that the bartender should learn how to make a better dirty martini. 

Shrimp and Crawfish Croquettes and Artichoke, Sun-Dried Tomato and Roasted Garlic Cheesecake are out of this world. We decided that we could just eat a plate of the Croquettes for dinner and be completely happy. The fried oyster salad was alright, but it was not the star of the show. 

For our entrées we had the Spicy Tempura Fried Gulf Shrimp and the Grilled Filet. Both were amazing! The shrimp were huge and cooked to perfection. They were served with a sweet and spicy Thai influenced sauce served over sticky rice. The flavors took me back to the days I spent living on the beach in Thailand! The steak was cooked exactly how I ordered it. It was paired with some potato wedges that were great too. 

And the two desserts ended the night perfectly! We had the Dulce de Leche Cheesecake and the Chocolate Truffle Cake. The piece of cheesecake was huge and delicious! It was topped with almonds and caramel. What else could you ask for? Perfection! To all Chocolate lovers out there, order the Truffle Cake. It should be called fudge, because its extremely dense! I am not a huge Chocolate fan, but this was good. 

Overall a great experience for dinner here! I will return.

Just got off the phone with Charter. I had called to cancel our TV and home phone service. Spoke with Tamara and then Orrin in the Retention Department. Tamara was fairly ok, but she lied telling me that I could only cancel the TV part. She switched me over to Retention where I spoke with Orrin. Horrible experience. This guy tried over and over again to get me to change my mind. I told him repeatedly I did NOT want to keep the TV and phone service, but he kept asking and asking me. He talked over me, too, not letting me finish what I was saying. In the end the TV and phone have been cancelled, he said, but he told me there was no survey at the end of the call as the recording at the beginning of the call said there would be. Do yourself a favor - save the money (it costs too much anyway) and save yourself the trouble. Don't use Charter.

I spent the last week in Nashville for a meeting. The very first night I took a taxi to Prince's which cost $40 round-trip.  I'll do anything for some good chicken!!  I ordered:
-a half chicken mild
-extra bread
-an order of fries
-side of coleslaw
-a slice of Irene's homemade lemon cake

My order was taken to-go. The wait was about 30 minutes and the place was packed.  When I got back to the hotel, I sat down with 2 bottles of water and dug in.  The chicken was extremely flavorful, skin was very crispy, french fries was amazing and coleslaw was average.  My breast was a little dry but the rest was very good a moist.  I would definitely go back if I'm ever in Nashville.  I like spicy food and the mild was enough to have a good array of spices and flavor.

P.S. Don't forget to buy a piece of cake from Irene's homemade Cakes on your way out!
Banh mi sandwich is crave-worthy and a bonus is it's under $6.00. Next time you're heading out Nolensville Rd toward downtown hit them up.

I get that the holiday season is upon us and it gets pretty busy in all businesses. After we were seated, we ordered our drinks, we are a party of six, two of us are deaf. After that Allyson, our waiter is rushing to take our order and kept interrupting every word we say. 30 mins later she came to say one of our orders is out of stock. So we changed it 15 mins later she came and said another one of our orders is out of stock. So we changed that too.  1 hour has past the rush crowd has slowed down and we barely got our appetizers. After that it took another hour till we got our main course. 2 hours?!? Yeah that's why I'm writing this review.  And not only that but our table neighbor was getting some harsh lash comments "if we are not going fast enough for you, there's the door!" Said another waitress. I thought that's harsh since you're in a customer service business. If the BBB gets a hold of most of these comments, I bet the casino will have some things change. The food tho, ehh it's not that great I personally got the fettuccine Alfredo, it was more like over oiled noodles with dry over cooked chicken. I barely ate it.

One of the many Honky Tonks you'll find on Broadway!  If you are in Nashville, Honky Tonks is a MUST visit and Tootsie's does not disappoint.

There is multiple floors...we mostly stayed on the 1st floor.

The music was great and the bartenders were very fast with service, despite the crowd!  

If you are up for it, try the Apple Pie Shine!  It is surprisingly DELICIOUS!!!

Most of the food was great. The Jefe margarita was awesome. The flour tortillas are amazing.  

And then there was the service. Timing was way off. My meal came out 2 minutes after the tableside guacamole. Everyone else got there meals about 10 minutes later. The request for chips or drinks or tortillas were met with "it will be a right out" but took forever. 

As we were paying the bill, we found out the server was on her first day. That made sense.

A regrettable $19 spent. I agree with more recent reviewers on this place not deserving its 4 star mark. The service was pretty much non-existent. In fact, it would have been better as a 'serve-yourself' type of place. You order inside, then someone brings your order to your table. In my case, the food came before the water and my drink - whilst being stormed by flies sitting outside. I had to ask the waitress for hot sauce. Then when she came back napkins. I didn't realize there was no silverware so attempted to eat my corn with my hands (didn't want to get back up to go inside to get a fork, leaving the flies to my food). The waitress never came back to check on me. The food was barely mediocre-the tacos being completely dry and the lettuce of questionable freshness. Overall a regrettable sum of money for what I got. Won't be back.

I am highly disappointed at the service that I experienced at Gary Barbara for the service of my vehicle I had an appointment set up for 11:30 am because my car wouldn't start I had my car towed to the dealership and dropped off on Saturday at 11am We waited  until Tuesday to give them time to look at my car the appointment was set to have a diagnostic check and stickers done We waited until Tuesday to give them time to complete everything however when We called on Tuesday each service member acted like they couldn't find my vehicle my husband called multiple times and left voicemails I was transferred to a agent named Brian he asked my husband for all of his info explained that the car would need to be diagnose he told my husband to call back with the info for our extended warranty when my husband called in Brian couldn't be reached he left the info on the voicemail and the call was never returned and my husband called again the next day and Brian stated that this wasn't his service vehicle! With an attitude my husband asked can he transferred to who could help him because the way I am being treated its unacceptable brain replied "ok cool "like that was no issue and customer issues aren't that Important ! He was very condescending not only on the phone but also in person and combative since this is the kind of customer service that Gary Barbara provides and allow . I will never patronize this establishment ever again the service team needs to realize that they are the face of Gary Barbara when a customer comes in they expect service and not fingers being pointed if someone drops  the ball my car literally sat for 5 days without them knowing what is was there for nor who's car it was despite receiving calls from both my husband and I calls and the appointment being scheduled prior to the drop off as well as a call the Day of the appointment .All in all the most helpful people was Ms. Claira during the phone calls and Shawn when we arrived to pick up our Jeep today .

Amazing service! We had a reservation for my mom's birthday and they made it so special! David was our server and he was great! He was friendly, knowledgable about the menu and made our visit memorable. Thank you Adele's!!!

I came into Firehouse two days in a row with a group of people with special needs and I was beyond impressed with Lolita's service! She went out of her way to get tables put together for us, remembered everyone's names and orders, and ensured we had a great experience. We were not the easiest group to accommodate​, but she did it with a smile and was so great to us! Thanks Lolita!

If you have items that you can't fit in your place & can put away in storage for extended periods of time, that Might mean you don't actually need those items.  If you still think that you do, SSS would be glad to take your money while you store things that... you don't actually use.

Sadly, I am a victim of the system & have paid SSS to do exactly that, but the tyranny is over (for now).  SSS has tons and Tons of storage units underground in a nice part of town.  The rates are not exactly cheap, but they are competitive.  We've never had a problem with parking; you can park in their dark, dank loading dock.  It gets the job done.  It's never crowded in the office or underground, and the service is mediocre but friendly enough.

Pet peeve:  the lights in the storage area run on a 30 min timer.  That's fine if your unit is within 500 feet of the timer.  Mine wasn't.  Having the lights shut off while you're alone in an underground labrynth is less than fun, & having to run through the labrynth to hit the lights is worse.  But it's better than a normal light system where they run 24/7, right?  The things we do for you, mother earth.

You can also send mail from this location AND have your mail delivered here.  You know, for when you can't have your roommate intercepting "special" packages.
DO NOT STAT HERE! Loud guest shouting all night and the staff is rude and does not care

First, I believe the owners of the establishment are Korean-Americans (I know that Asians may look alike, but it is ridiculous to believe the account of some of these reviews if you are going into an Asian-style restaurant and ignorantly conglomerate them all as Japanese).

I went on a nice breezy Friday night and found the waitresses to be very helpful. They were quick to seat my party and gave us our time to look through the menu until we were comfortable to order.

I loved the volcano roll and found the miso soup to be one of the best I've had in Philadelphia (and as an Asian, miso soup tells a lot about the quality of what's to come). The waitresses did not hesitate to clear out trays when they were empty, and they always did so politely.

We lingered for a bit after finishing our food and the waitresses did not rush us although it was a a weekend night. I left a nice tip for good food and good service with good friends.
Prices are kind of high. the food is really good though. especially the bbq chicken pizza, mozzarella sticks and buffalo wings

We visited with a large party and children. Part of our party was stuck in traffic so we had to wait for them. Graciously, they seated us and got us drinks and we ordered an app. However, we didn't see our waiter again until well after our fellow party members arrived and we had to ask them to get our waiter. It would've been nice to order our girls' dinner while we waited. I had a Caesar salad and a burger. Both were good. My husband loved his turducken burger. Girls had pizza and chicken nuggets with mac n cheese, which was eh at best. Rest of family liked their food. Their credit machine was down so we were given our sodas for free for the inconvenience. This morning, my daughter is sick, and I have to attribute it to her dinner. Overall food was okay, service could've been better. I won't say I'll never return but there's much better food in the city.

The layout of this hotel is genius. The wide U-shape with the pool and restaurant and sitting areas inside the "U" allow for people with rooms on the inside to be able to see everything going on. Great people watching just from the room. Be sure to request a room with the pool view, well worth it (the view also includes the mountains and part of a city view if you are on one of the upper levels). We went for the 4th of July and the fireworks were right on the golf course, so close we felt bits of debris falling into our room so we had to shut the patio door, lol--but not dangerous, just some tiny lightly floating things. Additionally, this architecture makes for easier meandering and finding things; so many hotels you get lost in and the layout is all over the place. 

The thing I liked the best about this hotel was that you can tell management is doing something right with their workers. Every single person we came in contact with smiled, asked us how we were, told us to have a great day, and provided top-notch service. This includes the service people vacuuming the hallways even--they would shut off the vacuum when you walk by, make eye contact, smile, and tell you to have a nice day. When we arrived to check in, the guy upgraded our room on his own without us asking, because he saw that a nicer one was available for us! One night at dinner in the restaurant there, the hostess was able to get us into a special table with a view even though we didn't have reservations. Then, the waiter went out of his way to make me a special guacamole dip that didn't have tomatoes, since I can't eat those. At the pool, every member of the staff was smiling and pleasant even though it was 90 degrees outside and they were probably sweating their tushes off. The valet boys were quick and smiley, even when a jerk would yell at him. 

The signs in the parking lot say parking is $10 but they never actually charge you. Valet is $20 though. We had to do it one night only because the holiday weekend meant you had to park down the street and take the free shuttle to the hotel and we just didn't feel like doing that. The regular parking is a bit of a walk to some of the rooms and there doesn't seem to be much parking in general, but that wasn't much of a problem for us--if that is something that would bother you I'd recommend asking for a room in the wing that adjoins the lot. 

The rooms themselves are great, no complaints there. Not sure what other reviewers meant by outdated, I thought they looked nice. Maybe those people just didn't like the style? 

Anytime I come back to Tucson, this is the only place I will stay!

Fitler Dining Room, the new venture by the folks behind Pub & Kitchen that took over the old Meme space, is money well spent and a fantastic meal to boot.  On a recent Saturday night here with the BF, we enjoyed an amazing dinner in an intimate space with good service and great food.  I really enjoyed everything and I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a change in the Rittenhouse restaurant scene.

After being seated, we started with the Oyster Chowder and the gnocchi.  The oyster chowder was terrific; a great combination of light salty oysters and hearty minced potatoes, served in a light and creamy broth with toast points and oyster foam.  His gnocchi was incredibly velvety; the kind that melts in your mouth and makes you beg for more.  As for dinner, he ordered the scallops over mushy peas with mint and grapefruit.  The scallops were seared perfectly, the peas a wonderful textural complement to the more solid scallop, and the flavors all melded perfectly.  My duck breast over potato puree with mushrooms was one of the best duck dishes I've ever had.  With so much duck on my plate, there was plenty of the savory yummy protein to soak up the vegetables and starches that added to the dish's terrific flavor balance.

As for dessert, we split a hazelnut torte and two types of cheese (picked from a selection of about 12).  The cheese, a creamy yet salty brie-style from Jasper Hill Farms, was hands down incredible; a great and unexpected finish to the meal.  The torte was good too, but the cheese was so much better.

Add on top of that terrific service with attentive servers and hosts, you can clearly tell that the chefs and staff have great passion for their food and clients.  I would highly recommend all my friends to have at least one meal here and I would certainly come back again to try more of the menu.

Beau Monde was my first love in Philly. I've been going there since I was a sophomore in high school. Ten years later, they still have the best crepes I've had outside of France. Unfortunately they still also have the most inattentive service I've ever experienced...

Beau Monde has a great selection of both sweet and savory crepes. I can never pick between the two, so I usually split one of each with a friend. Their buckwheat batter is unlike any other crepe place. They crisp it up really nicely and it has a nutty flavor that goes well with both sweet and savory fillings. There's a good amount of House Recommendations, but if you don't like any of those combinations, you can make your own, which is what I typically do. I'm a fan of their ratatouille filling, although it was a bit heavy on rosemary last time. 

The prices at Beau Monde ($10-$25 per crepe, depending on the types of ingredients) may seem high compared to other crepe trucks or small creperies, but the price is worth the quantity of food they serve. I can never finish my entire crepe because of how filling it is. 

I recently took two of my friends, who were visiting Philly, to brunch at Beau Monde. I was expecting a good hour wait given that it was prime brunch time on a Sunday, but to my surprise the restaurant was practically empty! My friends were very pleased with the food. The service, not so much. But what matters is, now, whenever they go to another creperie, they long for Beau Monde. 

During this last visit, I noticed that the interior at Beau Monde looks like a has-been. The once glamorous wallpaper, accented with gold hand-painted flowers, is fading; the velvet curtains are starting to look patchy. It feels like the owners have really let go.

The crepes at Beau Monde definitely deserve 5 stars, but the service and the decor need a revamp desperately. I would recommend going here if you have a large group because the space is huge compared to many others in Philly, and apparently it's not popular as it once was.

The staff is very nice and welcoming. I'm always nervous when going to the dentist and they are excellent at calming you down and making you feel at home.

Dr. Gold is a very nice man who I felt completely comfortable with. He and his staff were straight forward with me and gave me every option and their opinion. Making an appointment is easy and you can usually get in the next day.

Overall just an excellent staff and dentist. I highly recommend!

We're locals and long time experienced, sushi affectionados. We've bounced around to many sushi restaurants over the years as chefs or owners change. We'd been thinking of heading to Truckee for a change but thought we'd head back to The Atlantis for a great dinner, as we hadn't been there in a few years. There are a staggering number of sushi restaurants in the area to choose from so finding the best is a personal choice but, knowing what's not up to par isn't tough. Unfortunately, that's what we found here last night.
We went in around 4:30 to beat the crowd, stuff ourselves silly, and have time to digest our meal before sushi coma set in. The place was almost empty. Perfect for some personal service from the chefs. We were seated right away and our server Olena greeted us immediately. Olena was the only "great" part of the meal. She was attentive, pleasant, and served us very well. She knew the sake menu as we picked out a large filtered wine. The weird thing was that she had to serve us with stemmed wine glasses as required by the sommelier. I guess I'm just accustomed to drinking sake from a cup.
 Our chefs were not busy at all but it was one of those "I've got to get their attention" to order ordeals. They weren't engaging with us or asking how we were doing, you know, one of those "you should be happy to be served by us if we can fit you in" feelings or, "you don't know how good you have it being served by my excellent skills" attitude. We've all experienced that. Funny thing was, there were three of them within a 15' space, serving one other customer, and not making hardly any table orders.
Also, the sushi was just ok. The menu was plain, simple, and not exciting. The fish was fresh, I'll give them that. 
Dinner is $30, on the high end for Reno, so you should get a little more. I get it, it's a casino with tourist prices. 
I just wanted to post an opinion from a local perspective. There are many, many, choices here for sushi. That's one of the reasons we like living here. Go out and experience some that try to please you, don't get stuck having to "bow and beg" for a service you are paying for.

Some of the best BBQ I've had. We even had them catered for a party the weekend of my wedding. We go there all the time and bring out of town guests there. 

We got my dad a gift card there and when he went to use it last week they said it had a zero balance and they had a problem with their gift card system and some didn't activate properly. So--they didn't do anything about it. They didn't honor the gift card or even give my dad a free lunch. After being such loyal customers and supporters, spending hundreds of dollars there for my wedding party alone, they won't even honor a $25 gift card. It makes me think twice before recommending them and going there again. 

Don't buy gift cards there. Ever. 

Very disappointed in the management there.

Tried the seasonal flight at the recommendation of Kate the Narwhal trainer. Her previous experience with porpoise, dolphin and aquatic mammals made for good instruction. The wet bar decor was nautical kitsch without going overboard. Sail the whole crew in and anchor in this port for any storm.  If the social weather is stormy the Adirondack chairs provide the high back comfort for a view. For those with less restraint heavy ropes can be found to lash ones self to the mast and prevent the golden siren song that serenades from the cherry blow bar. Those interested in Ishmael cosplay might chose this perch to scout Bar Louie and it's prime harpoon whaling. As you might have guessed I'm pretty proud of this review.

This spot is really the only thing I ever head out to South Street for.  The dudes are real nice, tons of options.  When I order a "South Philly Cheesesteak" - provolone, spinach, roasted peppers - I can ask them to also fry up some onions and cherry peppers in with it, free of charge.  Italian hoagie's on point.  Fries deserve the hype, as does the Gremlin.  I only wish they'd warm the bread a little, give the outside of it a little crunch, chewy bread is whateva.  I'm new here so yeah I'm gonna eat at other places, but on the day-in day-out this place has become my go-to sanwich spot.
This is really the only great restaurant in our area. Fresh food, quality ingredients and very consistently prepared. I hope they survive this second shutdown.

My favorite apartment complex I have ever lived at. The office staff is so kind and willing to help. I never had a problem with maintenance or parking. If you are aware of the parking rules, you should have ZERO problems. Residents, tell your guests the parking rules!! Guests, your friends suck if they dont tell you the parking rules lol. I have never had any problems with sound or hearing any other residents.

Just rude! an order wasn't done correctly. they said they'd remake it, then decide to stick the same order back in my bag and give it back. when they were called on it, they said that they'd give our money back and then the owner said "i'm the owner, you can have your money back and never come here again" BET. this location has always been dirty anyway.

I feel like such a young working singe professional whenever I go to The Keg as that's who are usually there, in the lounge that is. But I still like the atmosphere and food.

The keg has fabulous steaks and they should because that's what they're known for. I find it interesting though that when you order your steak you have to order your sides too, like potato, mushrooms, veggies, etc. And of course you can't have a good hunk of meat without a nice glass of red wine. 

Needless to say it costs for a nice meal and it's not often we go to The Keg but when we do we go all out - appetizers, drinks, meal and dessert. I joke that I need a cigarette and after a meal because I feel totally satisfied (read between the lines people - I'm discrete here!). All joking aside you'll have a fabulous steak dinner here. Now, if you're not into steak they have good selection of other entrees like chicken dishes, pastas and fish and seafood. The Keg was the first place I had lobster. So the next time I go I'll steak and lobster and think I'm all that.

The service has always been good, for the price you pay it should be. I recommend making a reservation though as it does fill up quickly on the weekends.

My family used to stay at this hotel whenever they would come to visit us. This past visit changed all that, however. On September 20th a tree in The Hollander parking lot fell on my car. At the time, their assistant manager Tim came outside and assured me that they would take care of this and not to worry. The auto body shop quoted the damage at $3300 and informed me that my roof may crack if not repaired. The hotel has made no attempts at "taking care" of this and has been avoiding all contact with my husband and I. They clearly do not care about their guests or the safety of vehicles parked in their parking lot. With the numerous hotels and bed and breakfasts in downtown St. Pete, you're better off staying somewhere run by honest people.

We were so utterly disappointed by the dim sums, they just didn't taste " right ", dough had the consistence and taste of having been steamed too many hours earlier. One star for the duck. Staff was aloof. The Chinese mustard was so liquid, suspect of having had water added to it.

This place was SO loud that it became uncomfortable and unpleasant as we could not maintain normal conversation. The food was just ok; we were bummed to "waste" one of our dinners in NOLA eating here. Do not bother with the cauliflower - it is absolutely so smothered in oil and cheese that you can't taste anything but that. The best part of dinner was dessert; if you decide to eat here, skip the food and go straight to the end!

Before you go to this place, ask yourself:

1. Am I in a band?
2. Does my life revolve around making myself look cool?
3. Do I sell drugs to the employees that work here? 
4. Do I sleep with any of the employees here?

If not, then stay away, because the employees most likely hate you. You're not cool enough to merit any type of customer service, or even a hint of respect.

Stopped in for the first time based on the other reviews and was underwhelmed. The garlic knots just used a garlic butter and didn't have any real garlic smell or flavor. The manager did make good and refunded me the knots.

Was disappointed by my pizza when I got it home. Top was watery, almost like the canned mushrooms weren't drained properly. Due to the topping distribution the center of the pie was undercooked. The hunt for pizza continues.

This is the only place I visited twice while I was in NOLA. I made friends with the bartenders who took care of me like we've known each other for years! Cocktails were amazing. The music was amazing. Felt comfortable and safe and def a wonderful change from the craziness I saw on Bourbon street.

I've had a lot of teas, desserts, & sandwiches here. Nothing I wouldn't want again.

One of the best places to get vegan dessert in the city (ever-changing selections). They always have the best Vegan Treats choices, and I think they charge less than Govinda's. 

Staff is cool. Music is good (a lot of punk-influenced hardcore). Local art is a plus.
