And they have an interesting library in the back - lots of unique books to pick through while melting into the couch with coconut-cream-spiked coffee and vegan peanut butter cheesecake.

Got my eyebrows done here and they were great! I only wanted a cleanup and they listened perfectly and didn't go overboard. 
Clean and quick too.

Pretty big place with piano room, a bar and a garden with fountain. Drinks were strong but NOT tasty. Yikes. Had the hurricane, the mint julep and a green drink and all of them were terrible.
But a nice place to hang out and apparently it's a place you have to go when you're in NOLA.

I dont rate many places a 5 due to the fact the food may be so so and service great or vice versa or the atmosphere was good but food bland or the price you pay doesn't warrant what you got on your plate . . . Anyway this place surpasses all expectations for Food portion, Taste , price , and service. You are greeted in a very friendly and sincere manner. So we ordered the Hummus ( this is  a must ) to start off with and then proceeded to order more . Our meal consisted of Shish Tawouk , Sujuk (Spicy Sausage)  and the mixed platter . Well after the first bite your taste buds start doing the "tango" - wanting more. You get so many flavours bite after bite . The garlic dip is to die for . . .  I highly recommend trying this place and you will not be disapointed in the quality / taste of the food , price and the exceptional service. Worth a trip .

It's like being a kid in a candy store for people who love the outdoors. I had gotten a gift certificate for my birthday and decided to check it out. Their website doesn't do it justice as I was expecting a much smaller place than it actually was.  Large selection of everything from kayaking to fishing to camping.

I'm trying to get into saltwater fishing and don't know much about the difference between types of rods, lines , etc... The staff was very friendly and answered any questions that I had. I've felt intimidated asking "rookie" type questions at other outdoor stores but that was not the case here. I got set up with the perfect rod for my skill set and unlike some of the employees I've dealt with at Wal Mart or Dicks, I felt confident that the employee helping me understood what I wanted and steered me in the right direction.

Prices were definitely higher here as opposed to Walmart so it might not be the best place to start for a beginner although the knowledge of the staff may justify the prices do you don't end up buying a shotty product and have to buy another one a few months later. 

Having said that, I love this place and will definitely be back. Parking is a bit confusing and if its crowded, it's almost like you have to make your own spot. Small price to pay for the quality inside.

I am a cheese and fondue lover. Went here for my pre-birthday lunch. Worst idea ever, thanks (actually no thanks) to the overrated reviews in a meetup group. The cheese is terrible, Swiss fondue is absolutely unauthentic, portions are worse than stingy; more like unbelievable. The biggest ripoff ever considering the price for those scraps, since whatever little cheese goes in the pot sticks to the pot, so you literally scrape food off the dishes. Call it The Melting Wallet.

I can get a foodgasm from eating Swiss Knight fondue cheese from Safeway melted in a microwave oven, and that too a hearty portion for under $3 for the cheese and another $1 for french bread. It is that good and authentic like I'm in Switzerland, complete with the taste of Kirschwasser without which fondue tastes cheap as opposed to the distinct taste that sets fondue apart from regular melted cheeses.

The cheese here tasted like it was from a bag labelled 'Assorted Shredded Cheese' with the fine print 'simulated flavour, contains no dairy' or from factory sweepings.

The chocolate (fondue) was acceptable, but that isn't the point of going here.

Anyone who says they like the fondue here instantly loses credibility with me as a foodie.

I came to La Famiglia for the first time this past  restaurant week I was seated right away even though the other half of my party was very late.  I really appreciated this, because I have been at many an empty restaurant where they wouldn't seat me until my whole party was there.  

My table ordered the eggplant melenzane (AMAZING), Gnocchi in gorgonzola (okay), NY strip (outstanding), veal (I didn't try it, but they all liked it), and the salmon (moist, with the perfect amount of lemon).  

The service was excellent, but the desserts and mixed drinks needed improvement.

They have an awesome wine cellar in the basement, which was really cool to see as well.  I would definitely return to this restaurant.

Had an enjoyable lunch here.  Of course you can't go wrong with Ph.  Just make sure you say it right.  Its not your enemy to your stomach so it's not a foe.

The food here is good and the service is also good.  Its a nice place to stop by if you are in the area and needs some delicious food to warm your soul and fill your stomach.

We decided to stop by again before driving home today and ate enough food for lunch and dinner. We ate around 2 pm and it's now 6:30 and I don't think we will be eating any more. We are stuffed.  And I bought home food because the Fritanga was way too much for me even with the help of my husband eating some of my food. He had the Pollo al carbón cabrón and was amazed. He exchanged rice for the yucca with slaw and couldn't stop raving about the taste. Mine was so good, I thought I'd start speaking Spanish. Stop here for fresh and delicious food.
Bought 2 units on this company 7 years ago and it's the worst experience we ever had. We spent more than $4k of repairs and labors under their maintenance watch.. also had the worst soldering tech.

Quick and simple, no frills kind of coffee shop. Lacked liveliness that other cafés have and when I visited. As the barista made my macchiato, he seemed the least bit intent of even offering a "how was your day". The drink itself was well presented, but it was a bit too milky for my taste.

On a Wednesday afternoon it was filled with yuppie, business-type folk, two of whom were talking loudly on their cell phones. I sat the the bar long the wall, and although it's convient seating, I didn't like having my back to everything and being situated so close to a rather blank wall.
 
I'm willing to stop by again, but now I know to be more specific of how I want my drink so I can walk away happy.

Just off Veterans BLVD, on the north east corner of Veterans and Homestead, right behind a two story building, this small building has two parking spots in front. The dry cleaners next door has a sign that says parking for them in their parking lot only. So, if the spots are full, I guess the only other option is the CVS across the street, though I am sure that is not legal.

The interior of the restaurant could use a good deep cleaning, but it is clean enough. It is small. Very small. You walk in, the counter to order is on the right. They have a basic menu, some burgers, some po-boys, fries, grease. To the left is a unisex restroom and 3 tables, each with 4 chairs. The restaurant could also do with some better lighting. The whole place gives the feeling that it has been here forever, and about half that time, it has been forgotten. It is a hole in the wall that just strives to be itself and nothing else, which on one hand is a relief that it isn't trying to overcompensate or underestimating its abilities. It is what it is.

My main goal in coming was for the po-boy as someone recommended it. My first visit, I got the roast beef po-boy to go. I was in and out in about 5 minutes. The po-boy was pretty darn awesome. I am impressed.

The second visit, I got the burger and fries. The burger was good enough. The fries were hot and good. I will agree that they are king of the po-boy.

I will be back, though only on occasion. This will not be a regular stomping ground for me. I am sure a group of 10 or so customers will seem large for this small space, so I am not sure it is good for large groups. Or even those for large personalities. I will probably be back sooner than later to get a po-boy to go!

Came here for dinner once and this MUST be a breakfast place because I was thoroughly unimpressed. I had a thanksgiving themed sandwich served on an over buttered croissant. The service was fine although the waiter was inattentive, I definitely wouldn't return.
This place is a local gem. It's set up like an old diner. The food is a little pricey but delicious and the kids love it!

I was referred by a friend to Dr. Cercek and I was not disappointed. They did my daughter's cleaning and Meadow the hygienist was awesome to her! I had mine done too and after seeing Dr. Cercek I realized that my previous dentist was ripping me off with high fees and stuff. My previous dentist wants to do extraction & bone graft, and dental implant which is very very expensive. But Dr. Cercek did not require me to have bone graft if I don't plan to have a dental implant. Check your dentists if they're ripping you off. Go to a reliable dentist like  Dr. Cercek that will not rip you off!

This place never disappoints. I go here weekly and the food is always on point and the service is great. I recently used them to cater a large special event and worked with Mattie. She was great, from helping me plan what to order and how much, she followed up and helped me make changes up until the day before my event. She also personally came by my event to help set up and make sure we had everything we needed. Nothing is better than seeing a room full of Mercado's tacos and empanadas! Would definitely use them again for catering.

Make sure you keep track of your receipts/bank account!!  They double charged both my friend and me one night while we were there for dinner.  The dinner was fine and I enjoyed the time on the deck with my group of friends, but the poor response I got when I went to inquire about my refund is unacceptable.  The waitress assured me that the manager would review the charges from that not and get back to me. Nothing. It's been over a week. My bill was not overly expensive ($18.76 turned into $37.52) but that's not the point. They double charged two at a table of six... How many more had this happened to?

I recently visited Philadelphia and one of my most memorable dining experiences was at Green Eggs Cafe. We were craving a great breakfast spot so I looked on Yelp and this came up. After scanning the menu and seeing some photos, I was sold.  Once we arrived the hostess told us it would be a 20-25 minute wait, which we didn't mind because we were in a cute neighborhood on a gorgeous day and there was an interesting mural directly in front of the restaurant. The wait actually turned out to be only 15 minutes. I love when that happens. The inside was very bright and welcoming and the menu had a ton of options. My boyfriend ordered a Bloody Mary made with pepper vodka (complete game changer in my opinion) and I ordered an Irish coffee. Both were delicious! For my meal I ordered the guacamole and pepper Benedict. It was great. I could've used a little less of the peppers but overall I'd recommend. My boyfriend had the breakfast burrito which had the nicest plate presentation I've ever seen for a breakfast item. We both were very full and completely satisfied with our meals. The service was great and everything we ordered came within a reasonable amount of time. The overall experience was really enjoyable. I loved the atmosphere and it was the perfect way to start our day of exploring the city. If you have a chance, definitely stop in for some breakfast.

Such delicious food!  Came with some friends and got to try a pretty good variety of stuff.  For burgers we had the Walk of Fame, the Prime Degree and the Semester at Sea.  Walk of fame has an egg on top, Semester at Sea is a seared tuna burger. Prime degree is prime aged beef burger with bacon.  You really couldn't go wrong with any of them.  We started with the Shishito peppers for an app.  Wasn't a huge fan of them, but it was more that I just got tired of eating a plate of fried (blistered) peppers.  

We also had the beer cheese tots, cucumber-tomato salad and the pork belly mac and cheese.  Tots were good, but lets face it: they're tater tots.  The salad was amazing.  Its an asian flavored salad so it has the sweet vinegar taste.  I loved it!  The mac n cheese was delicious, but it was inconsistent.  We had 3 bowls of it and all 3 were very different. Like goldilocks and the 3 bears, one had WAY too much cheese, one had none and the 3rd was perfect.  If they all came out like the 3rd option, I'd say its a no brainer, but it just wasn't consistent.  I suppose its nice in the sense that it seemed like each bowl was made to order, rather than having a huge vat of it that they scoop it out of repeatedly.  

The service was phenomenal also.  

Overall, it was awesome!  The burgers alone are worth the price of admission.  Give it a try

Grabbed lunch at Opa during a family-visiting stop in Indiana. I appreciated the bright atmosphere and the large portions of yummy food. I like that they have a "lighter" section of the menu, which is basically the same main entree's but with salad as a side instead of potatoes. Actually, it still comes with a good amount of pita bread so is it really "lighter side"? That's for you to decide.

I'm not a big appetizer person normally but I highly recommend everyone get the Flaming Saganaki because it's $8 for tiny explosion and cheese. Worth it!

Since I have always gone to private optometrists, I was a little nervous about going to this chain but went based on the recommendation of a couple of Yelpers.  I was not disappointed!  I made my appointment online and was greeted immediately once I arrived.  The exam was quick, performed by a technician and the eye doctor.  I was very impressed by the efficiency of the process and by how knowledgeable Dr. Roth is.  We talked about some of my prior difficulties with contacts and he provided a couple of options to try.  He even ordered two sets of samples for me so that I can try both kinds of contacts before purchasing the  year supply!  I opted for the $99 membership which gives you three years of eye exams and some discounts on their products.  I really enjoyed going here and will be returning to order my contacts.
I'm so upset I went in today to go get my nails done for Easter and they look horrible I was so mad  I didn't want to turn back around to say something to the manager never going there again

The food here is usually pretty good but the customer service is TERRIBLE ALL AROUND. When you go in, it is usually so loud that you can barely hear your thoughts. I visited this location on Saturday 10/26/2019. I needed time to calm down before I formulated this review. When I first arrived I waited in line as usual. When Lee Lee ( tall, dark-skinned black woman with glasses) first approached me the first thing she said was " Slim or Husky?". No hello, no welcome, no smile, NOTHING. She literally threw so much sauce and toppings and my pizza and with an attitude. I asked her to please lighten up on the large number of toppings because it was too much on the crust. While waiting on my food to come out of the oven, I went ahead and attempted to gather my garlic sauces as I placed a TO-GO order. No one told me that this location no longer provided to-go lids and that I need to purchase an 8 dollar bottle of sauce for one pizza. At this point, I wanted to speak to a manager. The staff was looking for Nick or Nate who was the active manager on duty on this day. He was not in the restaurant and I was told that he was across the street. I got in my car to go across the street and right before pulling out, I noticed another couple who came out of the restaurant with to-go ramekins of sauce with LIDS. At this point I am furious because I know they have lids. When I got across to the roll-out, Nick/Nate was still nowhere to be found. I ended up speaking to Shaquita ( pointless and made me even more irritated by proving my point) who told me that I needed to calm down and that they only have lids for Uber/ Postmate delivery drivers. SO TO MY POINT, THEY HAVE LIDS. It was such a terrible experience and it makes me regret supporting black business. There was a lack of customer service, attitudes all around, no management on duty and no apology after the runaround. You can look at this pizza and tell it was not appetizing. My crust was impossible to find and it was soggy and wet due to the number of toppings and sauce placed on this pizza.  I wasn't sure what I could do, but this was a waste of my money and my time and I am totally overwhelmed by the lack of care and customer service at this location. I could not find a OWNER anywhere on the website so I email Clint Gray two weeks ago and he has not responded AT ALL. It is to be expected with the customer service provided at this location. They say it starts at the top. Do not go to this place. You will most like be disappointed after the SLOW LINES and RUDEEEEEE employees. Please get this staff together and keep management in the stores. Terrible experience, but the one is Antioch is perfect! The staff is friendly and it is not super loud. It's also more spacious!
Excellent. Go here if you want Greek gyros. Their lamb gyro is huge for $8.99... I can eat a large pizza by myself, I could barely finish the gyro. And it was EXCELLENT.

I've been to a few different locations, but as they say, "there's no place like home". The Chili's in Goleta has some of the kindest staff - and human beings! - I've ever met. I think there are a couple people who aren't very pleasant, and I try to avoid sitting in their areas, but Kathy and Jen in the bar are like wonderful friends! They remember our preferences and never fail to make us smile. Angela is wonderful, too! So, when you're looking for something easy and not too expensive (seriously, just order the 3 for $10), THIS Chili's is the place to go!

Pretty upset. Not only is there a pandemic , but I found a long hair in my first bite of food. Make me feel pretty uneasy that I found this with everything going on. Makes me think they aren't taking proper precautions.

This is one of my favorite restaurants in St. Louis. They always have great quality food. I recommend the wraps with a side of smiley fries - which are actually better than their regular fries. And if it's your birthday you get a free root beer float! The toasted rav appetizers are to die for and I love the pretzel sticks too. I highly recommend this place!

We popped in here to watch a soccer game (which they did have on so points there), but the beer was just ok and the cocktail I ordered was overly sweet. We didn't stay very long since the drinks weren't the greatest and left probably 20 minutes after arriving so I cannot comment on the food.

We were staying at the Homewood Suites and Gyros Kitchen is right next door; super convenient! 
The smells match the taste of the food...yummerz! 
Very flavorful and authentic. 
Highly recommend if your are in the mood for some good Mediterranean food.

Everyone I know goes here for them to cater the best baking possible.
Small store located in strip mall area, with parking lot. Definitely worth the trip. Small store, with many desserts lined up to tease you as you walk through the front door. Other condiments and goods are served all around. Service is great and owner is extremely friendly. Very accommodating. 
I cant tell you what's great there specifically but its all good.
My fiance makes weekly trips for his parents for the toast and then pastries, reasonably priced.

This was probably my favorite breakfast spot at one time, but it is really a breakfast place to me. It's a sandwich spot, and the breakfast is an after thought. The food is great, service is good. So I can't complain in that department! Just not really a breakfast place to me.

I have been to Teresa's Next Door many times and have been very satisfied every time I have eaten here.  I am a big fan of the game burger and have had the chance to try their boar, camel, goat, and venison burgers which were all very good.  I enjoy trying new types of animal meat so the game burger is a great way to do so.  

During my most recent experience, I had a late lunch with my girlfriend and a friend around 3 P.M. on a snowy day.  We decided to split three appetizers and went with the escargot, crispy artichokes, and bunny bites buffalo style.  All of these appetizers were very good and the escargot was probably the best I have had at any restaurant.  The bunny bites were tasty with a spicy buffalo sauce that was somewhat calmed by the bleu cheese.  As for our entrees, I went with the game burger which was goat.  I have had a goat bacon game burger here before but this time decided to add goat cheese, bacon, and a fried egg.  The burger was delicious and cooked perfectly to medium-rare.  My girlfriend had the gyro which she enjoyed but I definitely preferred my goat cheeseburger over it.  The beer list is extensive with a lot of great choices and each time I get to try something new which is a fun experience.  

I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for good food in a comfortable atmosphere with some good quality beer served in its own labeled glass.

What a great way to end and begin what just so happened to be an extremely long night. Let me begin by explaining how I found Knead. 

I was working an overnight shift and had a craving for a bacon, egg, and cheese bagel. I was thinking simple like Einstein's (since it was readily available in Miami), but I decided to hop on yelp first. After going through the mediocre reviews of the many franchises I came across knead. The pictures were beautiful, the food looked stunning, and I needed decadence so I hopped on over as soon as I got off. 

I found the location easily and parking was not a problem. I went inside and was instantly greeted by the many people that work there, but what instantly grabbed my attention was the baked goods on the counter. Fresh baked breads, baked goods, cookies, and my new favorite their koolache choices. I chose to get the bacon and three cheese koolache with a glazed cinnamon sugar morning bun for later, both to go with a cup of fresh squeezed orange juice.

When I got home I took a bite of the koolache and was immediately impressed. It was full of flavor, it was fresh, the bacon was not your normal bacon, and I could not have been happier. I enjoyed the fresh bread, the fresh herbs, the delicious bacon, and most of all the cheese. I could rave about that forever, BUT the reason for my review was the cinnamon bun. This cinnamon bun was the end to my day and the best part of it!! Despite the fact that I waited until 9 pm to enjoy it still was the best baked good I've ever had. It was soft, it was sweet but due to the flavor of the dough it was slightly tart. It had flavor bursting in every bite. I will dream about this decadence for weeks! I can't say enough it is the best thing I've ever tasted!

A straight-up Nashville institution. 
First off, it is really not Greek food.  While there are Greek-influenced dishes, the food is definitely Americana:  pastas, sandwiches, eggs and omelets, burgers and seafood, the list goes on and on and on for some 120 different meals, including breakfast served all day.  The variety is impressive, and honestly a little daunting.   Athens is more like a greasy spoon diner and it is reflected in the ambiance: plain blue and white cafeteria decor, pictures of Greece are inter-spliced with community postings and some navy memorabilia.

That's not to say it's a bad thing.

The service is excellent; the waiters/waitresses are nice, friendly, and a quite chatty bunch, and can help you work through the daunting four-page menu. The food is minorly expensive and not haute cuisine by any means, but it is quite sizable, pretty good, and filling.  I especially like the Kotopita, a mix between a shepherd's pie and a chicken pot pie, with chicken breast meat added to feta cheese and vegetables in a filo crust. It has a bit of a stronger taste than normal meat pies and the filo makes the pie almost dissolve in your mouth.  The cost is about $12.

In sum, this is a nice and friendly, if somewhat expensive diner with a wide menu selection.  The late closing times of Athens make this place especially appreciated for someone working with odd schedules, and while not especially worth going out of the way for, Athens is definitely a familiar and favored neighborhood meal spot. 
Final note: The water always tastes strange-seriously, order a drink.

OK.....how about you stick to the basics 1st before you start putting eggplant,  pineapple and mayo on pizza. Walked in for a slice they didn't even have plain or pepperoni slices ready. But sure did have curry chicken with saffron goat dick ready to go, right next to the hummus eagle eggshell asparagus pizza. DON'T WASTE YOUR TIME WITH THIS HIPSTER WANNABE COOL BULLSHIT

Came here with my girlfriend for the Jazz Brunch after a long night of partying on Bourbon Street. This 'luxury Creole buffet' definitely hit the spot. Everything we sampled was very good and the overall experience was great. Sitting outside in the picturesque, wisteria covered courtyard right next to the fountain listening to the band playing in the distance was awesome. Court of two Sisters also earned extremely high remarks in my book for the most courteous, forthcoming and genuinely nice staff I have ever experienced at any establishment (and I made sure to let the management know that!).

My old HVAC stopped cooling our house during one of the hottest 
pre-summer weeks. Unfortunately the old system used R66 gas, which is no longer available; so the condenser and coil needed to be replaced and charged with a newer R-407C gas.  

Rodrigo and Christopher came out, delivered and installed the new units on a day when the outside temperature hovered around 100 degrees. We got some cooling, however it needed further attention the next day, a Saturday. Rodrigo pretty much gave up his day to get the system fine tuned and it has been working well ever since. Thank You Rodrigo.

A perfectly filled Krispy Kreme doughnut has the filling in the very center, not off to one side. Just wanted to get that message to the workers here. I came in to get my favorite, custard filled with chocolate on top. I got half way through the doughnut before finding any custard. The chocolate glaze on top was also only found on one side, the edge really. This is the description of failure. 

Never know I was such a doughnut critic! I just like em to look like they do online... If I'm going to pay $1+ each...

If you love Hungry Howie's "back home" but have been disappointed by the other locations throughout Pinellas county, you need to come over to this side of the bay and give this one a shot. 

The crew here clearly takes pride in the job they do, and they aim to ensure that you're getting a quality product. The fact that there doing so while still providing it at an economic value that Hungry Howie's is known for is fantastic. 

Trust me, I had nothing but great experiences here at this location, and I'll find myself going out of the way to get my pizza and sides specifically from here.

I am so embarassed to say that I've lived in Indy for 10 years and haven't been here until last night. Our waitress was nice and we could tell she was dedicated to the place. We shared an order of mozz sticks, I had the vegas burger which was really good; a burger topped with pulled pork, cheese, onion, and mushrooms. I'm on keto so this was plenty for me ordered without the bun. I also had their french onion soup without croutons, which is house made and honestly the best damn french onion soup I've ever had in my life. A cup comes with a fresh baked baguette that smelled so good. I gave it to my hubby since I can't have carbs. They had long islands on special for $4. I didn't drink since I was the DD. I really love the fact that they have a game room where you can play darts, foosball, and pinball. I like that the place has many different rooms so if you want a slightly quieter space where you aren't drowned out by the band, you can find it. They have outdoor seating too. I love the blues so I had a great time. We will be back! The only negative is that they were out of blue moon. Luckily they had shock top as well. If they're not busy, the lot behind the noodle is for noodle customers only and it's free. If you plan to drink I suggest just ubering it as many lots around there are $20 if there is anything at all going on in the city such as a big convention or concert. The history of the place is incredible and it is frequented by many celebrities. It's Indiana's oldest bar. Unlike the 30 other places I've loved so much that have closed in the past ten years, this place will always be here. I'm sure of it. Live blues pretty much every night! And the bands are really good.
First time ordering from Tasties, the food took a very long time, and it was very burnt.

I had incredible service here and the only reason I am not giving this place five stars is that the dishes were a touch oily for my taste. I liked their selection and their breakfast food was exquisite. Best waitress!

I have lived in Q.V. Mews for almost 14 years and Cobrin has been our management company the entire time. I have been on the condo board for a number of years and the president for the past several years. Our account is managed by Kevin McGrath and Suzanne Kennedy. Kevin and Suzanne have been invaluable partners in a number of major improvement and maintenance projects for the association. They are always responsive and understand in particular the needs of the smaller condo association. I can recommend them without hesitation to other condo associations!

I've been here quite a few times and I think they have adapted really well given COVID restrictions. The wait for food was high as usual because of the weekend rush, but when we picked up our order it was fresh and hot! I got the Pinang curry and drunken noodles which were both delicious! I am looking forward to dining in again once this is all over with! Thanks for the yummy meal Thai chili!

Just moved to New Orleans (Metairie area) and was looking for a cute breakfast place. I got just that, and more! I ordered the traditional breakfast with scrambled eggs. I was expecting your ordinary eggs, bacon, and potatoes but was pleasantly surprised! The bacon was nice and crisp, not floppy like other places. The eggs were fluffy and the potatoes were nice and done like I like them! I got an iced mocha that my amazing female server suggested and it hit the spot. I would suggest this place to everyone!

This hotel is absolutely disgusting, the room smelt like urine, toilet doesn't flush, the furniture is gross along with the beds. Absolutely not worth the price of over $200 a night. We felt so dirty inside. There was mold in shower, they charged you to eat breakfast for the price it was disgusting. I do not recommend

My husband and I ordered a few meals to go for ourselves and toddler while we're in town on vacation. Food was really good BUT there was no napkins or plastic silverware in the bag and they also got my husband's order wrong. We got it delivered by Uber eats so it's not really worth it to get our car out of valet and drive there to get it corrected. Oh well!
AMAZING burgers & fries!!! Love love love the truffle mayo! Wish I had one closer but well worth the hour drive! Shakes are also delish!

I went here for the first time and I fell in  love this place.  I ordered the ole mole burrito and it was delicious! Their horchata is also homemade and very creamy and good.  The price is very reasonable, about $7-8 for a big burrito.  Definitely will go back soon!

Not the casino type I guess. At all. Here with my kids for a lacrosse tournament. I feel like I've smoked 3 packs and we arrived around 2pm. Arrived to long airport type lines at check in. Eventually ushered into a smaller check area by a nice man dressed as a silver miner I think. Then I was charged $23 extra a night for a "resort fee" per night for a resort that I'm not getting. I'm getting a huge amount of perfumed pumped in "air."  My nose is dry and irritated. Our eyes are watering and are itchy. My kids legs are itching. The $23 extra gets us a pool that's not opened yet.  Or a hot tub which faces a work out room with dudes looking over my
Kids as they sit in said hot tub. "4" stars according to Hotwire. Ummmmm no. Not at all. If you have to come to Reno go to an area not near the smoke pit. While you're here eat at a killer gastropub called The Depot or something. So far, pre games, that was the best part of our Reno visit. Time to close my eyes to hopefully give me some relief from the nonsmoking room's smokey air and my irritated kids.

When my plane finally arrived in NOLA after several delays, I was starving so I stopped in here for a quick brinner (breakfast for dinner). The menu is limited but covers the basics. 

Nothing was great but it was solid and cheap. The space was clean but slow. This isn't someplace I'd go out of my way to find but it's a solid choice for the basics.

I am very satisfied with the service at this Enterprise location. They picked me up and dropped me off on a prompt, timely manner. The car I got was nice, clean, and comfortable. I will use this branch again.

Great vibe ! It's located inside the le meridian lobby . Reminds me of a speak easy with great cocktails and selection of wine . I ordered the malbec which was superb ! Bartenders here really friendly .

If you're looking for a quick, cheap, and good-tasting food... you'll probably have to look harder because you won't find it on the surface of Chinatown.  Actually, you'll have to look below it since it's located in a dingy underground next to a so-called "supermarket."

This place does live up to its name... and it is quite "tasty." My usual order is Beef Chow Fun. For $5, they offer generous portions. The only downside is that it can be a bit too oily.  

It's probably one of very few places in Chinatown where the service is friendly... and that's RARE!

Good food. But shit service and had repeatedly for my food and didn't even come out. And they tried to make me pay for food I never got. Horrible. Sketchy workers and they were cussing me out in Spanish

From the moment we walked in the door to the minute we left we received excellent service. The food was so tasty it was hard for me to stop!  The fact that I spent less than $10 for two meals worth of food is wonderful!  

I will definitely be back!

My sister (the bride), myself, and 3 other bridesmaids went to David's in hopes of finding the perfect dress and having a fun time out with the ladies. My sister took the time to set up an appointment and an online profile so they knew what she was interested in. After meeting our consultant who was not friendly from the get-go we sat down to wait as my sister tried on dresses. The consultant was rude, impatient, unfriendly, and not interested in conversation or anything we suggested. She made it a point to let us know she was going on her break after our appointment. My sister only tried on 3 dresses and the consultant eagerly urged her to not try any more on as we had found one we kind of liked. She did not seem to enjoy her job whatsoever. It was such a bummer to be expecting to have fun with our girlfriends celebrating an exciting event coming up and having this person be such a downer!! (Luckily we are a fun bunch of girls and we enjoyed ourselves regardless of her bad attitude) Suddenly about 10 minutes before we left she perked up and was finally friendly. But in my opinion it was too late. First impressions were very negative of this particular David's Bridal. We won't be buying any dresses there, I don't want a rude consultant getting any commission off of my purchase!!
Okay in a pinch. Get a room away from the traffic. It's noisy on the street side. Seemed clean. No serious complaints but nothing special.

The Subway of Noodles. It may seem like a healthy alternative, but is it actually that?

Service was slow and not very friendly. Food was kind of bland. We just popped in for a quick bite at the mall, I had soup and my kid had Mac-n-cheese. The tables were almost all taken by customers, or they were waiting to be bussed. We cleaned off a table and waited twenty minutes for someone to bring our meal. They don't offer any bread, but said the soup came with crackers, which was a lie. A LIE, I TELL YOU.

Also, it's about as Asian-fusion as a Speed Racer cartoon. Let's put it this way: if you consider Olive Garden Italian food, then this is your kind of Asian-fusion.

Need last minute reservations on a Saturday night? PF Chang's pulled through! Service was excellent! Food was excellent! Bummed that they were out of sushi but made up for it with some killer crab wontons.  The lettuce wraps are mandatory - but that Great Wall of chocolate satisfied a craving we didn't know we had.

This place just opened in the last couple of days. They have a sushi happy hour with $1 sushi, $3 rolls and $2 sashimi. The selection for the happy hour is not bad. It is better than other places I have been too that offer the same prices for sushi happy hour. 

The menu overall is a combination of Japanese and Thai with a Korean dish or 2 as well. 

We were seated right away and given menu's. If took almost 10 minutes for the waiter to come by and take our drink orders. The place was not that busy but it appears they do not have much staff. 

Service was very slow. Waiter never came back to see if we wanted to order more or if we needed additional drinks. 

I would like to think that they are still working out the kinks in the system, but I really just think the wait staff is just not professional servers. 

We will try it again and hopefully the service will be better.

This is an awful business.  Ordered once online got half the shipment, they even wrote on the packing slip "refund 2" and have been fighting for 6 months to get a credit.  They never did it, my discover card refunded me but this place never did.  Will never buy from again and wholly suggest you dont either

Absolute top notch service. ASK FOR DON FERGUSON. He is honestly the best. Just got a new 2016 Corolla S Premium and I got a great deal on it. Everyone at the dealer is so professional and friendly. So clean and I was in and out so quick. Love my car so much and they even scheduled my first service appointment for me. Awesome awesome awesome!!

Very overpriced. Mostly sandwiches and bar food - the burger is just OK, and the fries were soggy. Went back and tried the chicken sliders, which had good flavor, but were greasy despite the chicken being grilled. Good service saves them from getting only 2 stars.  On the plus side, the bar appears to have a nice selection of draft beers and there's small seating areas with tvs - probably a great place to catch a game (also probably an expensive place to catch a game).

i have to preface this by saying that i used to work there, so I'm obviously biased, but then again, being biased is what this is all about.  

I've loved the pneumatic diner for years; through different owners, through being an omnivore to being a strict vegetarian, to dabbling into moderate veganism, all of it.  and i know that being on customer side of things it can seem a little daunting and unaccommodating.  it's a tiny place that's hard to find with only seven little tables to sit at.  and sometimes, you even have to wait to sit at one of those seven little tables.  but it is worth every inconvenience that we have grown accustomed to expecting from other larger restaurants.  

first things first, and this should not be overlooked because it's strikingly rare in a city like Reno.  
everything is made in house.
the hummus, the rojo sauce, the tahini sauce, the falafel, the ratatouille, the soups, the lasagna, the pesto, the buckwheat waffle batter, everything is made with loving care and dedication by the exemplary staff at pneumatic diner who put in far more work than they get paid for because the place is worth the effort. 
i've moved on to bigger and better things; studying and now practicing architecture in San Diego, and still to this day, the Pneumatic Diner is the first place i go when i get off the plane coming home.  

my favorite dishes are the theban wrap with added falafel, the vegan bayard, the falafel plate and of course the slab tacos.  but for the uninducted, i have to recommend the infamous cookie bomb and the beanie dip.  you haven't had good eating until you have had the beanie dip.  

so yeah, the odd location and all vegetarian / vegan / sometimes raw menu will turn some people off, and i say:  that's great, because there are only seven tables, but otherwise, in my opinion, you don't really know *R*E*N*O* until you know pneumtaic diner.

Disclaimer: this is a late post so the flavors might have changed

There's nothing better than getting ice cream on a nice day. It makes it better when it's really good in-house made ice cream with unique flavors as well. McConnell's has all of that and it was even worth the short wait. I got a flight (3 scoop taster) of the boysenberry rose milk jam, eureka lemon and marionberries, and pineapple rum and guava jam. I'm not usually a fruity ice cream type of person, but it seemed fitting for the sunny weather. All three of the scoops were so creamy and had a soft consistency. The flavors were all unique and delicious as well. You can't go wrong with any of them.

Overall, come for delicious ice cream and great quality.
Wonderful coffee and baked goodies, and the staff always makes it a very welcoming shop to visit. Can't wait to check out the new location on The Hill!

Had el ultimo steak sandwich- loved the garlic aioli and the steak was cooked well. The fried potato strings gave it the perfect crunch. Got rice and beans for a side for my toddler and he wolfed them down- very flavorful and a generous portion for a side. I thought the portion overall was generous and I took home half the sandwich and enjoyed it later. My sister who is not usually a big fan of Cuban food got the pork bowl and said it was the best shredded pork she has had. Bowl was also delicious. Sister-in-law tried the burger which looked awesome too. This has probably been my favorite restaurant I've tried at Armature works and I'll definitely go back

Why do I love target? Listen I have made myself really comfortable in my life. I do pretty well, which is amazing considering my Insatiable need to poison my evil liver. It deserves it... anyway still I must have been a vagrant in another life because I just can't wait to get to target for the free samples. Free samples you say, oh do tell. I sample the deodorant and put it back. I sample the face lotion and then I use the sock helper. I weigh myself here constantly. They have tons of scales. I help myself to the free toilet paper cashes. Always awesome at target. I do buy stuff too. My only complaint is what is up with the pop corn? Come on now, it's pop corn....

Recently have become a fan of this spot! It's now our go-to game watching bar.  It's big, has many TVs, and hasn't been overly crowded as of recent. Don't get me wrong, there is a decent crowd, but you are still able to get a drink without a wait.

Best idea is their "Draft Pass" where you buy a 16oz mug for $10 and get 25% off all beers and mixed drinks during any NFL or College game. The draft selection is legit and you can get some complimentary popcorn to munch while you sip (or chug...your choice). If hungry you can order anything from the nearby restaurants and get it delivered or pick it up and bring back. For the Saints/Falcons game Publiq House had two guys cooking up some tasty brats on the patio, delicious! 

Great music venue as well, I've seen a few shows here. The décor is made up of salvaged doors and lighting fixtures, which I dig. Overall a great place on Freret to watch a game, catch a band, and grab a drink.

We had burgers, salads, shakes, and ice cream, all delicious. I had the ahi tuna salad and loved it. The vibe in the restaurant is so beautiful and unique; there is children's artwork on the wall along with the monthly amounts that the restaurant donates to special needs causes. Kyle, the special needs boy whom the restaurant was inspired by, came around and said hello to us. The family-centered atmosphere with the special focus on special needs awareness while still serving great food is what makes this restaurant worth going to!

Wife loves the Baja salad and she's a salad snob. 
Maybe these people can learn a little customer service. I would have been happy with a smile.

My parents and I had been visiting the Constitution Center. When we discovered that the Red Owl Tavern does not serve classic American/"tavern" fare, our waitress recommended Jones. 

What a keen suggestion, and thank goodness we heeded it! Although it was after 8pm, Jones seated us right away and brought our food out very quickly. My dad and I each enjoyed what was objectively the best burger either of us had ever had, and my mom loved her club sandwich (she bright half of it home and enjoyed it for lunch the next day, but dad and I left satisfied and empty handed). Very reasonably priced as well. 

The lighting was a little dark and the other patrons a little younger than my parents--it was clear that this Stephen Starr establishment is frequented by young professionals more often than retirees, but we didn't feel at all out of place. 

I would highly recommend to ANYONE looking for some American fare to complement the historic American context in which Jones is located.
After trying their apple and goat cheese king cake I will definitely be back to try more things. I usually do not like filled king cakes, but this was awesome!

Well I was in need of nipple piercings and I was in a rush. These people act extremely racist and rude! The 2 times I've been it took everything In me to not curse somebody out. The first time they need me and my bf, he's white im black, and they didn't want to give us service for a face tatt.. and the 2nd time I stood there while this lady helped someone out FOR A EAR PIERCING FOR 30-45 mins. They were just choosing one.. then after she was done she turned around and acted like I wasn't there!! I'm never coming back to the shop again. They should be shut down for their service. NEGATIVE 1000 points from me.

Ive own the owners of this hotdog truck for over 5 years, Esteban and his wife are incredibly kind and attentive. They make amazing hotdogs, its a bacon wrapped sausage topped with avocado sauce, mayo, ketchup, fried onions, parmesan cheese & a fried jalapeño. they also have ignacios ( nachos with meat and cheese ) and fries. the food is always fresh and made right in front of you. 
I saw a few reviews saying their company name was " the race " but La Raza in spanish is another word for family, which is the same way they treat you. 
theres always people to laugh with and enjoy your dinner. 
its located infront of the 7-11 on Vassar with pretty good parking on both sides of the street. definitely worth giving it a try!

The vegetable dishes here are so food! I love the garlicky veggies and the eggplant with potatoes. Each dish is enough to share. They are doing take out right now and the dishes are just as tasty as if you were dining in.

I think I might have had too high expectations for this place given all the hype and fame. We had a cheesesteak (wiz wit),  a roast pork sandwich with broccoli rabe, and some salt and vinegar fries. The pork and fries were great, the cheesesteak was honestly a bit disappointing. 

Staff was friendly and the place is efficiently run, but expect to wait in line for a while given its popularity. Fortunately it's pretty easy to get to and there's a lot of parking nearby and seating inside and out so overall the experience was pleasant.

Good evening Yelpers.   Why am I giving  a three. 
Let's start with the customer service.   As soon as you walk in you are greeted by the staff.   Nice the you are recognized when you walk in.  

This is a very small place so if you have a large party be prepared to be cramped.   It's small but clean. 

Now the food.   The ribs were well seasoned but tuff .  There was a lot of fat on the ribs as well.  The baked beans were really good.   They had chunks of meat on them.  Very tasty. The macaroni and cheese was very bland and mushy.   The sweet tea was not sweet at all and it was hot even when you put ice in it.  The food portions were very large. 

Now for the sanitation.   People would lick their fingers and then touch the paper towels and the barbecue sauce bottle.  No bueno. :-(.  They should probably consider putting napkin dispensers on the table so that people are not putting barbecue sauce on the paper towels. 

Overall I was not very impressed.   I  don't think I will be back.

The hotel is ok. Very affordable, but affordability comes with its own price. First, it is a dog friendly hotel. However, there is not a designated floor for dogs and there seems to be no size limit. Also, the hallway always smells like cigarette smoke. The service from the employees is decent. Three stars because the rooms are actually above average and the beds are super comfortable. All in all, worth the price but nothing more.

We don't have pizza like this in Texas, and I didn't expect it in Nashville.  Wonderful family story of a couple from NY coming to Nashville and opening a pizza haven.  It's just a "hole in the wall" joint, but the pizza is the best I've ever eaten.

Just had horrible service.. asked for a mani/pedi, then women was rude. No hello or how are you. During my mani she rushed everything still dead skin around my nails and no hot towel or Hans massage. I had a 10 minute pedicure! Also, no massage which I was looking forward to the most. No hot towel, did not scrub the dead skin... horrible
Very good Cuban sandwich and I got a delicious gingerbread cookie. Good Cuban coffee too.

I usually go to the dealer to get my oil changed. But saw this was closer and decided to give them a try. What a great place! Professional, courteous, and knowledgeable. Went over the choices, didn't try to up sell me for additional services I didn't need. Quick,quick, go early in & out in 15 minutes! Will definitely be back! Great job!

This place is amazing. We're from NYC and stopped by on our road trip and it blew us away. The combinations have awesome names and the FLAVORS!!! The prices are perfect as well. Olivia, our waitress was super awesome as well. Can't wait to eat here again when on another road trip!!

We came here for breakfast on a recent trip to New Orleans. There was no wait on a weekend morning and the service was friendly. The table shared a plate of aebleskivers with lemon curd- soooo good! Sweet and delicate. I had the prosciutto toast with egg and I can't remember what my dining companions had but everything was delicious. Would definitely recommend.

I didn't think you could really make a bad hot dog, but after stopping by here one afternoon I finally realized what it takes to make a good one. The menu is set up to have a variety of different specialty dogs, all affordably starting at $3-4, but with the option to upgrade to a footlong(basically a bit over twice as much food) for only $2 more! That's right, for $6, you can get a foot long, perfectly charred split all-beef dog with a plethora of toppings, on a toasted hoagie roll(or flat-top bun, I'm not exactly sure how he chooses the bread to go with each dog but it always turns out alright). The Pleasant Pig, Nightwalk, and Jersey are all great. Can't skimp on that perfectly crispy bacon. And you also can't leave without trying their grilled donut sandwich. You'd think it would fall apart after one bite, but the donut is bisected and toasted to firmness, and the ice cream is kept cold enough that it won't disintegrate when placed between the donut halves.

So take it for what it is, a place that does simple, satisfying, topped-off hot dogs, but does so without skipping a single beat.

Wish I could give a 2.5 star rating. 

The location is convenient, the front office ladies are nice and the nurses are too. I really like dr Norton and Dr Pimentel. Dr Llewelyn barely looked up from her computer during the one time I met with her, making NO effort to make a connection. Dr Patel was ok but more rushed than dr norton and Pimentel. 

Wait time is horrendous!! I often wait an hour past my appointment time before I see the dr. I have started threatening to come late. I stopped showing up early. They have called a couple times to let me know the dr is running late or early and to change my appointment time, which I appreciate but then to still wait almost an hour is frustrating. 

I'm a little frustrated that it took them 3 months to decide to refer me to a PCP for a cough I could not get ride of. Each dr tried something new which wouldn't work, then I had to wait till the following months appointment to try something else. Finally the PCP came to conclusion of Pregnancy Induced Asthma. I'm 3.5 weeks out from my c section date and I can finally lay down and my cough is gradually decreasing and being more controlled. No thanks to the drs attempts though. Only dr norton offered one suggestion AND a backup plan. 

I hate that you have to see ALL the drs even for a schedule led c section. Why? See the section on dr Marks below. 

I don't know if I would recommend them... probably not due to wait time and dr marks. A shame Bc Dr Norton and Pimentel are very nice. I would have searched for another office but I was already close to my second trimester when I transferred to this office and finally saw the last of the 5 drs a month and a half before my due date. 

If you can AVOID DR MARKS. He is an asshole with NO manners bedside or otherwise. He is every reason I have ever had and every fear for not wanting to see a male dr. I saw him my first visit and he came bursting into the room as if I had kept him waiting... reality I had been waiting an hour to see him. His tone was accusatory and interrogating. He barely introduced himself and didn't shake my hand.  Did not acknowledge the person I brought with me to my appointment. He had NOT read my file as a transferring patient, he admitted this. Then when I would mention something he would jump on my case about it. He used inappropriate language saying a reason I wanted to stay on my antidepressant was bullshit and told me to get off of all my meds and supplements cold turkey. This did not end well at home. Meds that my previous put of state Ob said were ok. I was told I had no choice but to have another c section. A shocker and disappointment Bc the out of state OB had supported the idea of trying for VBAC. I left that appointment calling him out in the hallway, telling him he barged in like a rhinoceros giving me no opportunity to tell my story and have a conversation. I was crying to the receptionist while I scheduled my next appointment with ANYONE ELSE but him.  I filed a form of complaint but never heard back. And when I scheduled my csection last visit I was told one of the other drs assists my chosen dr... I told them anyone BUT dr marks. I want him nowhere near me. The nurses don't like him either. 

To end on a positive note. I am very comfortable and confident with my choice to use DR Pimentel to deliver my daughter via c section in 3.5 weeks.

Man I've been there twice and their food is so good! Don't be intimidated by the line because it goes by so fast. I hope they open up again soon! I know their closed right now due to the state of the world.

Sonny's has to be the first place to try a cheesesteak. I have to say they were good but the portion size was a little small and did not have enough cheesewiz on top. The staff was professional on giving your food. And the restaurant itself was classy. The meat was chopped too which was a plus. I recommend this place to people that want a quick in and out dining experience without having to go to south philly.

Very untrained staff called for parts for my 99 Honda crv coil spacers to be exact guy working there told me that car is not a off road vehicle and he has been doing this for 20 years and never heard of anyone lifting a crv I told him to go on YouTube and look he laughed at me very unprofessional I would not recommend this place to anyone
Mama's has great food for any occasion. This authentic Italian restaurant will fulfill any crave for traditionally prepared pasta, meat and seafood. Try their cooking classes they are a great time!

Stopped in expecting mediocre Italian food. Were pleasantly surprised to find that TJ's offers much more than just mediocre! The food was beyond delicious, the staff was very friendly and attentive, and the service was extremely fast. Definitely coming back soon!

Every time we dine here, we have a superb experience.  The wait staff is excellent.  They are efficient and knowledgeable.  It is nice to see Chef walking through the dining area checking on his clients.  

The bar is fun, the fireplace room is wonderful for a private event.  We have had lunches, special event dinners, drinks, and a wedding shower here.   The vibe is  lovely - the ambiance is romantic yet I have brought customers here for dinners.    The food is always exceptional with delightful seafood and pasta dishes.  

You won't go wrong with Villa Barolo as your dining choice.

Horrible!! Had him come out to do about 100K worth of work on a remodel.. New windows, framing, electrical, roofing, plumbing.. the works.. He had Mike Renzulli from Philly's Best Contractors with him.. sounded like he know what he was talking about.. They didn't.. from the start, what should have been a 1-2 week framing job turned into 6 weeks.. the plumbing was shoddly done.. the framing of the ceiling was uneven.. I wouldn't use them if they paid me.
The catfish Po' Boy was excellent and more than I could eat. The wife had the shrimp po'Boy and she loved it. We will definitely recommend this place to our friends and we will be back!
Affordable just like the name says. Good service, prompt, reliable and trustworthy. It's what you'd expect and want from a business. Cant go wrong with choosing AA Affordable Overhead Doors.

Amazing room! This tub for two was the perfect way to end our vacation in NOLA. 

The only negative (which turned positive)... we needed a bottle of wine opened and there wasn't a corkscrew in the room. When we asked concierge they said room service could send one up but jay we'd be charged. We figured we'd just buy our own from the casino gift shop - It broke when we tried to get the cork out. We brought the bottle back to the concierge to see if he had access to pliers or something to assist ~ and the most important part: help us get into the $60 bottle of celebratory moscato! 

We're thankful for the concierge who, after several failed attempts with our wine (our corkscrew & their broke), made sure that our bottle got opened!

AVOID AVOID AVOID ! 

They don't cover shit. everything is considered pre-existing even if it happens during the time of the insurance. Infectious disease coverage doesn't include any testing. So you gonna get a surprise bill from the laboratory! so far i've been charged $1400 by lab and a family physician... it's ridiculous. I could have spent the money they charged me for this insurance on these actual claims instead.

Excellent work
Fast service
Owner does the work

I needed a carpet repair in my finished basement.  I had pulled the carpet up myself and left several areas of the end frayed.  Rob came out himself, installed the padding, and put everything back together as good as new.
Omg...excellent food and service...people this is the spot...check it out you guys will love it..
Stopped on our way thru Nashville tonight and was not disappointed.  My wife had the shrimp and I tried the pork..... amazing!!  The staff was friendly and efficient.  We will definitely stop again.

Unfortunately, I can't give my experience at CVS a five star rating. Usually you walk in and you're greeted with a "welcome to cvs" but that was not the case. Alright, no big deal. I wander to the cosmetics aisle and a nice employee offers her assistance. Then at check out, the same lady that couldn't be bothered to greet me when I entered is once again rude to me. I asked if she could by any chance give me $40 back (1 twenty and 2 tens). Instead of nicely saying they didn't have any tens, she just shook her head. Her tone of voice indicated she didn't care nor did she want to be there. I'm a firm believer in "customer care". If you treat your customer with respect, he or she will be more inclined to return to your store and buy your products. Common sense. CVS may be just a convenience store, but each customer should be told to have a good day at the minimum.

Went to the Clover tonight for a quick bite.  The place wasn't busy around 10 pm, so we had our choice of empty seats at the counter.  There was only one server, so we waited patiently for him to deliver some food, do drinks, ring up a takeout order, input a new order, ring up a bill, etc, etc.  Finally after sitting at a dirty counter for 10 minutes without menus or so much as an acknowledgement of our presence, we got up and left.  Don't get me wrong, we've been there many times - even took father on law once and recommend the place to friends coming to town, but crappy service is crappy service.  I'm a patient, low-maintenance diner, but my opinion of the place is spoiled.

Came here after grocery shopping next door and this was a much needed refresher on a hot day. 

I got the raspberry mango smoothie.The smoothie got the sweetness just right with the flavors blending really well together. Service was fast and and friendly and the place itself is clean and well kept! 

This definitely a great alternative to a lot of the other juice/smoothie places!

Was referred to Bommarito from a friend who has bought several vehicles from them previously. Everybody hates to buy cars but Bommarito Honda Superstore is like the Ritz Carlton of buying cars. In 3/2011 I walked in at 12:00 p.m. and walked out at 1:30 p.m. with a new car. The free maintenance for 2 years is awesome. They have a very nice waiting room with FREE WI-FI also. Very pleasant experience. Oh, they wash my car for FREE also. 

Thanks Bommarito for a very pleasant and professional experience!

I purchased a Groupon for Indiana Air Duct Cleaning.  This was by far the worst experience I have had with Groupon.  Indiana Air Duct Cleaning, also known as Duct Cleaning Central, used very high pressure sales.  I said no three times and they kept offering discounts, turning it into payments.  I still said no.  I asked them to leave me an estimate.  They stayed and kept asking.  It was very uncomfortable.  

The number they gave me turned up another business on Yelp.  Read the reviews, people had similar experiences with this company.
http://www.yelp.com/biz/duct-cleaning-central-west-chicago

If you have a Groupon for this service, I would suggest you cancel it immediately.  Any positive reviews I read on Yelp do not look like they were left by well established Yelpers.  I hope my review finds you before doing business with this company.

No wonder the Han Dynasty is considered  a golden age in Chinese history because this place was a gold mine of good food. We ordered family style and would definitely recommend doing it that way as you are able to try a lot of different things. Was only able to get a picture of the bok choi because we devoted everything else. Overall great experience, would recommend.

I was in desperate need of a car detailing and I found this place on Yelp. Located in the most convenient location right in Center City, by Rittenhouse Square, I figured I would give it a try.

It was the best decision right from the beginning. I messaged the shop the day before and they were able to accommodate me and my schedule! They took me the next day! I told them I needed to be done at a certain time because of a workout class and they were done an hour early...talk about customer service! 

My car looked better than when I picked it up from the dealership! I had lots of crumbs and dirt on the floors and stains on my tan cloth seats and everything was spotless upon completion! Inside and out, I was amazed, especially because I hadn't cleaned it once since I got it over a year ago (oops!!!) There are also so many trees on my street where I live and my car is white, so I wasn't extremely hopeful the outside would look great, but I was wrong! The car was shiny and so clean.

The whole process was seamless and while the car was getting done, I walked around, got breakfast and coffee, and did some shopping. The whole process was seamless and easy, which I love and Harrison was so nice - not to mention the quality of work, which was outstanding!

Highly recommend! I will definitely be back!

This is THE neighborhood pizza place, hands down. Every time I come here, it is very family friendly and everyone seems to know someone. Theo's is a very laid-back restaurant where you come in, order, and then take a seat. The pizza is brought out to you and someone will come and check on you every now and then. Once when I came here during an LSU game, I asked them to put on the Longhorn college football game and they happily did so. It was very nice of them to change one TV. It didn't bother any of the other customers because they had plenty of other TVs to watch LSU on. 

Besides serving great pizza all around, Theo's also serves great gluten free pizza, which to me is a big deal. You can order any pizza on the 10 inch gluten free crust. I like The Expert pizza the best, so far, but I have so many more to try! 

I once ordered a salad here and it was very good. I got the sweet olive oil and vinegar. I wasn't a fan of that dressing, but I was able to order a different dressing. I got the Romano cheese dressing and it was very good. I would order it again if I came to Theo's in the mood for salad, but to be honest, I'll probably always come here in the mood for pizza!

Came here for my birthday diner with my boyfriend.  The service was very professional and warm. ( I thought my waiter smiling like Will Smith ;) ) We both had NY strip, which was just fine.  The flavor was not bad, but the beef they used was not good at that price. If the meal was only for steak,  I might just give them 3 stars. But we also tried the oyster. We had 3 west and 3 east species, and both liked the east a lot. So we had another 6 east oyster. The oysters were very fresh, which you might not need any sauce, not even lemon juice to add on. We tried the stone crab claw too. Although this was my first time to try, I though it was over cooked and no flavor. As it's my birthday, we got a free crime brulee as the desert. To be honest, I didn't like it, but my boyfriend did. The top hard caramel was too thick and uneven, and as it was cold, it was too hard to eat. Anyway, my boyfriend said he would be back, just for their oyster;)
Incredible pancakes and scrambled eggs.. however.. the bathrooms in this place are atrocious.  Like something out of a horror film.

Nice pit-stop, clean, personnel are friendly and helpful.

Normally I wouldn't review a Sky Club because frankly they are all great. The reason for this review however is the size of the club, wanted to give other frequent travelers a heads up. When it becomes busy at all this area gets small and crowded very quickly - you may want to think about just staying out in the terminal as it is frankly more comfortable than this Sky Club when it fills up a bit.

I can tell they use high quality items and the price reflects this.
I had the Larry's Breakfast and it consist of 2 eggs, 2 small strips of bacon and about eight finger potatoes the size of nickels for $10.00.
Side of toast for $2.00 more.
The potato was delicious and the toast was good too. Didn't like their bacon as it was really crunchy and had no flavor at all.
I didn't think my breakfast was worth $12.00.
The service was great.... it's kind of loud inside cause of the wood floors and such.
I'll try dinner one of these days but based off the breakfast I'll take my time coming back.

Went there a couple of weeks ago after I decided (yet again) to save my front flower bed from looking awful. I dug it all up and needed a lot of help... when I stopped by the nursery, Kathy greeted me and listened to my sappy story about how "things either die or completely take over". She had ideas right away of how to help me. Not only did she recommended the plants which would match my house and were perfect for my situation, but she also drew a diagram of how to plant them, so they looked better as finished product. I'm lost no more! My flower bed finally looks great!!! I'm very happy with how it turned out. With Kathy's helpful tips, I'm confident that it will stay that way for a long time.

Used to love this place.. went for the first time since quarantine and it was awful. The "rules" were not clear and the manager/ owner/ waiter???? I don't even know who he was because he never identified himself or even had on eddy attire for that matter was a total dick. He seemed annoyed people were there, you cannot even get up from your table.. it was a terrible experience. We want to support businesses! We understand that places are doing the best the can but man the way he talked to customers was totally unacceptable. Will not be returning until they get things sorted out.

Just not sold on this place. Food is not bad. Typical bar food/wing joint. Sports Bar sit up inside. Service is typically just ok. It's just so expensive. Hard to pay those prices for carry out bar food.

Coming from Seattle and eating Chinese food, viet, Thai, Indian, Cambodian, Malay and everything inbetween, this was by far the worst Asian food I've ever had. While Chinese food is maybe not as flavorful as other Asian cooking, this wasn't about flavor/spice, it was not edible. Gross. We had the shrimp and vegetable and chicken and vegetable dishes and we had to throw it away after only a few bites. While the veggies were over cooked, that may be a midwestern thing and that's fine but the sauce was so gross...it wasn't even a sauce is was some gooey indescribable nastiness. I'd stay away from here til they get people who can cook! Ps no one seems to eat there as it was all takeaway despite there being tables to eat at. But it was cold inside so be forewarned. That's said the kitchen area looked clean and they did have a separate cashier from the folks preparing the food and on that alone I'll bump from one star to two

Amazing.

My wife and I made reservations, and after a rough year for her, did the staff ever deliver.

Complimentary champagne and dessert, absolutely delicious food, a personal tour of the kitchen and wine cellar and topped off with a reserved table at Irvin Mayfields in the front row.

I cannot thank our waiter (whose name escapes me, but whose Van Dyke'd face won't be forgotten) and the staff enough for probably the best dining experience of my life. 

Cheers.

What an absolute gem of a restaurant! While in Tucson for a meeting we found the Polish cottage. The interior of the restaurant is warm and welcoming, like sitting down and in your own dining room.  I ordered the perogie dinner with a combination of potato and cheese and sweet formers cheese perogies.  My husband ordered the half portion stuffed cabbage and it was delicious and a huge portion. It reminded him of the stuff cabbage that his German mother made, except better!  Highly recommend this wonderful restaurant anytime you're in Tucson and looking for a good home cooked meal.
One of the top Thai restaurants in north Pinellas county. The pineapple curry is fantastic.
Excellent Thai food! Everything prepared after your order so it is fresh and very tasty!

Everything was fantastic. Although the parking lot looked packed, I was surprised to see how much space they have inside. The decor is beautiful, the tables are spread out far apart enough for everyone to be comfortable, and the food is delicious.  Top-notch professional and friendly service, too! It's a bit pricey, but worth it.
Tacos were delicious and ready quick. Cashier and cooks were friendly and talked to us the entire time, suggesting different sauces, toppings, etc to try out. Love this place.

If by killer you mean not very good.... Then great name. How does this place have four stars?? Pork belly was terrible. Sloppy and undercooked. There are plenty other places to enjoy a tasty po boy on bourbon street. Come on nawlins yelpers!

I live a block from this FedEx and have used their services for shipping and copies. The self service copy machines are easy to use. I don't love the quality of the prints but for fliers to hand out, it's fine. I wouldn't use it to make a copy of anything you'd want to frame. 

Service is hit or miss. I've had employees reluctant to end their personal conversations to address my questions and I've had employees who have been competent and don't waste my time. It's a gamble and keeps life interesting right? (Not really, since we all just want good help but what are ya gonna do?)

Molecajete with steak was really tender, and lots of sauce, so be sure to order rice on the side.

Shrimp and halibut tacos were really fresh and flavorful, not greasy at all. 

Steak burrito was huge, good enought for two people. 

Friendly staff and even though very busy, they will do all they can to get you a table when your order is ready. 

One of the best mexican food restaurants in California.

What a perfect little birthday celebration for my partners birthday! We were so excited to start our vacation off with Henrietta Red. When we walked in we got seated at a nice little two seater, nicely spaced out between other tables. They even customized the menu to say Happy Birthday! The atmosphere in the restaurant was amazing, we really enjoyed the open kitchen to watch the chefs at work. 

They were having 2 for 1 happy hour, but we opted out and just got wines we preferred. I ordered the vegetarian gnocchi dish, and my partner got the shrimp linguine. The gnocchi was decedent and pillowy. I completely finished it and even said I wished I had a spoon because the sauce was THAT good. For the linguine I personally did not try it, but my partner was raving about it, mentioning his never been anywhere that was so generous with their shrimp. 

For dessert we got their vegan option, which was a chocolate brownie, mint ice cream, and cashew fluff. It was so moist, literally if you didn't tell us it was vegan we would of had no idea. One of the best meals we had in Nashville, if not the best meal I've had in awhile. 

The service was also exception!

Gimmicky burgers...."What's the weirdest combo of stuff we could put into a burger?" seems to be the theme behind the menu.  Straightforward, old-fashioned burger?  Won't find it here.  The noise-level is deafening, so not the place to go if you actually want to talk with people at your table.  Service is pleasant, though a bit slow.  If I want a good burger, can think of other places much higher on the list.

Nothing wanting here!  Gerson, Jonathan, Rodrigo and team provide great service.  New, imaginative rolls relieve the boredom of the same old AYCE you find all over town.  Try the chef's roll - several types of fish wrapped in paper thin cucumber instead of seaweed.   They'll also make you any custom item you ask for.  Don't miss the ceviche roll!  This is a family run business that I'm happy to support.  Open everyday you don't feel like cooking!  Can't wait to go back!

I've gone twice for a gel manicure and spa pedicure. Each time the gel manicure (using OPI gel) have lasted at least two weeks. The pedicures have always been incredibly relaxing and rejuvenating. They offer a complimentary shoulder/neck massage while your nails are drying. It's reasonably priced, clean, and convenient.
Waiting staffs r great but raw oysters r dirty n torn. We order the seafood stuff mushrooms n it is dry n salty. The 2 lbs lobster was actually 1 1/4 pound.

Cantina Laredo has been on my list of Yelp bookmarks for a while now. First thing you must know is that this is not street Mexican food. I am sure you (like me) were thinking "Oh great, this is another over-priced upscale Mexican place." Let me be the first to tell you that Cantina Laredo is upscale Mexican, but it is not overpriced. I have been to Cantina Laredo for happy hour several times and never been disappointed with the food and drink. Happy hour lasts until 7:00pm--which is awesome! Most places around downtown Clayton end happy hour at 6:00pm. Drinks are well crafted and strong. My favorites are the Strawberry Mint Margaritta and the Ginger Mint Mango Rita. There is a lot of food choices that are good, flavorful, and cheap. You must get the tableside guacamole. The queso great as well. My go-to is the Chicken Quesodilla. The only reason I am not giving Cantina Laredo 5/5 starts is the service. The waiters are not stellar and it usually takes all too long to get your food.

I'm not a fan of the warehouse thing but my wife liked it very much and it was very clean and modern. The service could not have been better even though we didn't need much assistance. The roof top pool is very small considering the number of rooms in the hotel but it does give a great view of downtown and has a nice hot tub if you catch it late when traffic is slow. I loved the health club with it's steam room. I could do the steam every day. All in all a good experience.

Called for a pick up in the Metro Center area. Waited 30 minutes. No show. Called back. Was told that it hadn't been "dispatched." Wow. OK, 2nd chance. Called back another 30 minutes later. Has been dispatched, car 14. Driver called me and said he was on the way. No show 30 minutes later. Called dispatch again. They said he's on he way. I gave up and found a cab on the street.

I go to Han Dynasty so often that it might as well be an addiction. I have tried every single item on that menu at least once. If you don't like Han Dynasty, it is because some ridiculous childhood trauma has rendered you soulless and dead inside.

You can be assured that every dish I mention in this review is a favorite. Here's how to do Han Dynasty right, based on countless experiences with varying numbers of people at this restaurant-

"The Lonely Man"(for one lonely, sad person)
Dan Dan Noodles, dumplings in chili oil. You will have leftovers.

"The Basic"(for two people, probably a date early in the relationship)
Dan Dan Noodles, Spicy Cucumber, Three Cup Chicken - You will have leftovers.

"Company"(for three people, because your significant other has someone visiting from out of town and you want them to like you)
Dan Dan Noodles, Spicy Cucumber, Double cooked pork belly, Fried Taiwanese sausage.

"The Party"(for four people, because three folks from your work are tired of hearing about you rave about the restaurant and have demanded that you take them.)
Dan Dan Noodles, Spicy Cucumber, Dry Pepper Shrimp, Fish hot pot

Any party greater than 4 usually means that someone with Han Dynasty experience will be in the party and should know what the hell they are doing.
