The U.City location is larger and serves the food more quickly than any other location. Seriously, they are really fast here. I've eaten here and received my Dan Dan noodles and cucumbers before the drinks arrive. It is ridiculous.

I've given so many stars to Han's restaurants on Yelp that this chain might as well be its own group of constellations. Google "han dynasty rap" for more of my shameless plugging of this restaurant.

After the noise and hustle and bustle of Pat O'Briens, we 2 tourist wanted a little local flavor. Lafitte's had been pointed out to us on a tour earlier that day so we had to check it out.

The true portrait of everything 'Naw'Leans' from the dim candlelight, exposed brick, and underlying eeriness Lafitte's was a memorable spot, or so I think? By that time I was well on my way to a Hurricane induced coma, so perhaps my view is a bit skewed. 

I do remember the bar tender being very friendly, not cold or annoyed seeing that we were obviously tourists. He was chatty and sincere. There was a lovely piano equipped with a piano man whom I acquainted myself with quite quickly. He didn't even mind when I proceeded to take over his piano and begin to sing, mind you I can do neither. 

The charm of Lafitte's has followed me back to California, ever reminding me of the uniqueness and individuality we lack. Oh how I miss New Orleans....

Nook is a food stand that's located inside Lama Dog in Santa Barbara. My family wanted to go for some beer and I was happy that they had food available at Nook since I don't drink beer.

They have a huge German Pretzel that's bigger than the size of my face! It's $6 and comes with Beer Cheese and Beer Mustard Dip! It was pretty bomb and I'd recommend it! I want to learn how to make pretzels from scratch now!

Horrible Customer Service!  STILL WAITING  AFTER SIX WEEKS for the remainder of uniform order.  They said it would be mailed to our home directly since they were out of stock in June.  Have attempted to contact Parker Uniform Brentwood , TN. three different days via phone.  Having held OVER thirty minutes each time to NEVER speak with anyone regarding WHERE our order is.   Stopped by the store today in person.  I was told it would be a 50 minute wait to speak with someone about our order that was purchased SIX weeks ago and has never arrived.   No one has time for this.  We purchased our uniforms in JUNE.  Pitiful Customer service.  No resolve nor due date.
Went to get my windshield replaced a while back, they were super quick and the best quote. Would definitely recommend!

I had a bad customer service experience today, and it will be my last visit to Walgreens.
I had my items and was going to get in line in the cosmetics department, but she was helping someone, and so I went to the front of the store, where an older woman was at work checking out people. There were two women behind her, and so I looked for other options. I noticed a man standing by the register in the photo department. I approached and asked him if I could check out there (I would have been fine had he said no), but he said "Sure. I'll open up over there (near the main front register." As I walked over and he followed he said, "I'll take the next person in line". *Wait a minute. I went and asked you to check me out and you tell me you will take someone other than the customer that got you? Okay. Stay with me.*
I didn't say a word, but waited in the line where the older woman was checking out customers, waiting on him to say he would then take me. What does he do after he checked out the woman? Wait for it...wait for it... HE WALKED AWAY. Yes, he walked back to the photo department and didn't look in my direction. Who does that?!
Normally I would have said something, but it didn't seem worth it. If he didn't have the customer service skills to say "Ma'am I will take you now", then he probably wouldn't have had the skills to handle my complaint like a professional. 
The sad part is that this was one of my favorite stores, but CVS and Target are directly across the street. When there are other options, learn how to treat customers.

This is not the worst restaurant I have ever been to, but close.  Save your money from this really lousy and mostly empty- all -the -time (for a reason) restaurant. 

The food is (for the most part) poor quality, spongy, cold by the time it gets to you, and just bad-- but hey, the wait staff is sweet.
You'll be right if you think that's not enough of a reason to waste your money.  And the staff would do well not to stay there to get abused by the owner.  There's such a thing as "learned helplessness", guys.  Believe me--you're cool-- you can find a better job!

Because even worse than the food is the surly belligerent owner who pushes everyone around and responded to a polite request for a non-peppery dish with denial and hostility.

If you don't want your mouth and stomach to burn worse than hotter than hottest Indian restaurant you can imagine -- and having to put up with an aggressive bullying rude response from the owner if you ask for anything else, be warned from a nasty night out, and stay away!

First of all, their customer service was great. I went with a friend during lunchtime so we didn't really have to wait long to be seated. They were very attentive and kind. It's understandable that they are busy but our waitress was awesome, she explained everything thoroughly even though she was super busy. The food was pretty good. I had the Mongolian beef bowl and my friend had the chicken bowl, those were really good. However the Mongolian beef bowl did have a little too much onions. We also got some nonalcoholic drinks - Chang's coconut cooler and strawberry cucumber limeade. The coconut cooler was good but tasted like straight coconut and the strawberry cucumber limeade was delicious but a bit too sour for my taste. Overall, it was a great experience.

I ate at Acme 15 years ago, and it became my standard for the best fried oysters anywhere, period. In the past, there were heaps of delicious big fresh oysters.

Now, for $23, there were maybe 3-4 good sized oysters then the rest were little breaded fry basket trash. All atop a piece of french bread hidden underneath to make it seem bigger. The oyster shucker who was shucking big oysters told me those weren't the ones they use for fried oysters. 

Never Again.

We just had our new roof installed by Trenton Roofing and Siding, Inc. and we really couldn't be happier!  The entire experience was a true pleasure and there is not one thing we can complain about.  

Our neighbors used Trenton Roofing and Siding Inc. and recommended that we give them a call and ask
for Mike.  Mike Burgaretta came out to our home to provide us with an estimate.  Mike was thorough and extremely professional as he let us know exactly what we could expect if we chose to use Trenton Roofing and Siding, Inc. to install our new roof.  Mike's great personality and the fact that he explained every aspect of the project in detail, made us feel comfortable and secure in making our decision to choose Trenton Roofing and Siding, Inc.. If you are looking for an estimate for your next roofing or siding project and just want to deal with someone honest and knowledgeable, I encourage you to call and ask for Mike as well - you WILL NOT be disappointed!!

Even the office staff at Trenton Roofing and Siding, Inc. was so pleasant and very easy to deal with.  All of the ladies I dealt with over the phone and email were polite and super responsive.  They kept us informed and updated throughout the whole process and asked if we were satisfied or had any concerns once our new roof installation was completed - Talk about exceptional customer service!!!! Thank you very much Nicole and Chelsea!

I would also like to thank the entire crew that came out on a Saturday(on time and ready to go!) which also happened to be one of the hottest days we've had this summer.  The team worked fast and effectively and left us with one beautiful roof that has been getting many compliments lately - I never imagined we'd be so ecstatic & proud of our new roof.  Thank you so much Trenton Roofing and Siding, Inc.. We will always recommend you to our friends and family!

These guys are professionals.  They take customer service, and satisfaction seriously.  Their communication throughout the process was excellent; sending emails to inform me of the process, and help me setup my mail forwarding, utilities etc.  They called to inform me of the time the container would be dropped, and to update the time when it was unavoidably delayed.  The also called the morning that I ordered the pickup to give me an eta.  The cube was transported without any damage to its contents, and claiming my goods was easy and uneventful.    Overall, they made my move easy, taking the stress out of a very stressful process.  Thank you U-Pack.

You know the song from the show "Annie" where Annie first enters Daddy Warbucks' mansion and along with Grace and staff, sings "I think I'm Gonna Like It Here?"

That's how I felt as I pulled up and walked into this luxurious resort hotel last week... I was only there for 24 hours, but I wished I could have stayed longer!

So, unfortunately, there was no Cecile to pick out all of my clothes and no bath to be drawn by Mrs. Greer... but if I'd stayed more than just one night, I know there would be someone to make my bed!  

In addition to friendly and accommodating staff, gorgeous views and top notch amenities, this JW offers the following:
*27 holes of championship golf (the view from my room overlooked a portion of this and it was beautiful!)
*a wonderful fitness center and a couple of exercise classes each day
*a daily 6:30am guided hike
*biking / jogging / hiking / nature trails
*Hashani Spa (which I didn't check out unfortunately either)
*several pools including one with a waterslide, and one with a lazy river
*a handful of restaurants and a Starbucks
*a 5:30pm tequila tasting
*clean, comfortable rooms 

I'm definitely a fan and cannot wait to return on my next trip to Tucson to take advantage of more of the above... Clearly, my gut was right; I did like it here!

I've been here twice and have tried the baked goods, a salad, and the Santa Fe sandwich; all were great.  I hate bread that is over-toasted but here my sandwich was toasted to a perfect thin layer of crispiness. I got a brownie that was in a muffin cup and it had that great crinkly layer on top as well as chocolate chunks.  

The shop is small and cute with outdoor seating.  I wish there was more indoor seating since it's getting colder.

Chronically undercooked pizza at this location.  This has been true for the last few years.  Have previously reported this directly to the location and they blamed undertrained staff, improper covering, etc.  When it's a chronic problem, it points to other issues.

Note, thin crust pizza should be crispy.  Deep dish pizza should not have stringy dough when you pull it apart - ditto your stuffed cheesy bread.

The only reason why we even keep trying Dominos and hoping that they fixed their problems is that all the other pizza places in town that we have tried are so bad.

Okay, I might be a little picky, but if the service is good, the ambiance is nice and the food is good, I won't complain. 

BUT...

I arrived 10 minutes before our scheduled dinner reservation. I was told that our table wasn't ready and that I would need to sit at the bar. After sitting at the bar for at least 5 minutes I was finally asked if I wanted a drink. In the five minutes I waited I observed a couple of things. 

First, they weren't so busy that it should have taken me that long to get some service. Second, the bar was covered with the servers backpacks, half eaten food, drinks and other stuff. It gave a bad impression. It took at least five more minutes to get my drink and the bartender was rude to me when picking up my signed credit card receipt. 

I visited the restroom; it was gross. There was a cinnamon plug in and it made the trip to the bathroom almost unbearable. There was a dirty rag on top of the baby changing station and a galvanized steel bucket underneath that said "NO TRASH." Weird. 

Coming out of the bathroom there was a random sneaker on a bar stool next to the back bar. WHAT? Who's shoe is that and why is it on the bar stool? Again, GROSS.

The food was okay but the service for the rest of the meal was terrible. The waitress was sweet but it took FOREVER to get our drinks from the bar. More than 20 minutes! 

I'd say the food and service are better at Bangkok Thai. Don't waste your time here eating in... At the very least, get takeout!

The Cochon De Lait po boy was THE tastiest bite I had during our week in New Orleans. 

Just a great local bar.

I don't generally get too excited about the Doylestown food scene, but Honey is one exception.  Subtly enticing from the outside, the honey inspired atmosphere could easily hang with the center city crowd inside.  Lots of privacy for such a tiny restaurant, many of the tables are booths.

Drink list is large enough, though I didn't feel inspired to order anything.

Here the tapas, as we ordered it, is essentially a deconstructed tasting menu, and the price is in line with that.  It's nice in that you have more control, but it comes at the cost of pacing and size.  I always find it a little intimidating to figure out the right amount to order, and we overshot it a little bit this time.

Bowl of spiced popcorn was a nice starter from the kitchen.

Following was the Chinese 5 spice sweet potato fries, which comes with Red Miso Maple and Sweet Chile Sauces.  Fairly standard fries, but the Miso sauce is excellent.

Hot on its tail was the "Fire & Ice", which is chilled king crab with oranges, daikon, white miso-chile mayonnaise, and spicy carrot sorbet.  A little heavy with the mayo, but the flavor was good.  Carrot sorbet works really well.

At this point all of the previously mentioned items were on our table in some partially eaten state.  It makes you feel kind of rushed and cluttered when it's only two people.  Just relax and let us savor it.

After clearing out our backlog, the lamb, cremini mushroom, and escargot skewers wrapped in bacon appeared.  It comes with a roasted garlic aioli dipping sauce that is quite good.  Nothing overly complicated, it's hard to go wrong grilling lamb.

Pan seared arctic char with shredded brussels sprouts, smoked pork belly, and
truffled artichoke emulsion was pretty good.  Pork belly interior was very soft with good flavor to match with the crispy char.  Not bad, but the best was for last.

Beef tenderloin with butternut squash and barley risotto, veal sausage, and barley wine reduction.  Wonderful.  Rich and layered flavor, it has an almost smokey undertone.  One of the better risottos I've had, with the veal sausage in there more to add flavor than to be a primary ingredient.   Tenderloin is perfectly cooked, a five star dish for sure. 

Intermezzo of pineapple sorbet and candied ginger.  Good, but the ginger is so strong and sticky that I started eating around it.

Desserts were pretty exceptional.  Lemon cheese cake with minted pineapple relish, toasted pine nuts, and spiced cranberry coulis.  Butternut squash cake with maple syrup, white miso caramel, toasted sesame, and persimmon ice cream.  Great ending to an excellent meal.

A few of the sauces were a little heavy, but the creativity and flavors make Honey a must try.  One of the best restaurants north of the city.

I have been to T'Asia plenty of times and i've tried alot of the different sushi they have and I have never been disappointed. I usually get the Tempura roll and it is fantastic every time, along with the crab avocado salad which is the best i've had. Athough it's not the nicest looking place to eat at the food makes up for it completely. I highly reccomend this place.
100 craft beers on tap.  Need I say more?  The food is great too!  My new go-to spot in Hendersonville.

First, the woman who answered the phone had the most wonderful phone voice.   It was like customer service in 1975.   I explained my furnace issue and was given a 1.5 hr window for 2 days hence.  I emailed to them info I had from the owners manual and a failed repair attempt. Brian showed up on time, seemed to have actually read the email, assessed the furnace, indicated that it might be thermostat wiring shorting in the attic and suggested a low cost solution - relocating the thermostat to the living room wall behind the furnace.  This as done quickly and efficiently and I was impressed with how careful and tidy he was.  Furnace is still working and the week of bundling up indoors while my nose runs from the cold appears to be over!

Fantastico!  Que Sabroso! What can I say? Masitas de puerco, arroz con frijoles negros, yucca con mojo, platanos maduros!  Some of the best Latino food I've had while still in the US. Probably the best pork I've eaten since my wedding reception. WOW.

I've been here a couple time personally, but my family orders here often. The staff is always extremely nice!!! The food has always been delicious and I can't anticipate that changing anytime soon.  The wings and the white pizza are hands down my favorite. They won me over the night I ordered 100 wings and 3 pizzas for the Mayweather McGregor fight, an hour before the fight, and it was done within a half hour and they could not have been more cool about it. Super nice people with awesome food!

Fantastic new, small and hip place to eat.  Sandwiches are made with crunchy but not too hard bread flown in from Louisiana.  Toppings are generous and cooked well.  I had the veggie po boy which was great!  Sweet potato fries great compliment not found in Indy often.  Very good sandwich shop in Indy.

Wow wow & dbl wow. I wish I lived next door. Killer atmosphere, friendly & inviting. Dark in all the good ways. Killer beers & drinks, bar staff, all that. AMAZOING FOOD ever time!!! Astounding. Go. NOW.

My best friend got married here and I was super impressed with everyone and the excellent service. And the food- it was incredible. I couldn't stop eating. It was ridiculously good. The chicken wraps were excellent, unique and flavorful.

This place was way too expensive - no bang for your buck. The fish was good, but the servings for the sushi were minuscule. My shrimp tempura roll was tiny. My friend got an order of tempura chicken and broccoli that was huge. I paid $10 more than her for my plate of sushi and stared at her while she finished eating. 

Service was really good and friendly, unlike some people's experiences. This is a good place, but there was a disparity between quality and price.

My first impression of this place was not great.  The hostess was not exceptionally pleasant and the seating was a bit uncomfortable.  It was like 2897 degrees out (the first place we went didn't have A/C- what!?!?) and I was admittedly not in the best mood when the waiter arrived. I have to say though- he was great!  He made suggestions and waited patiently for me to decided on a drink.  From there, everything looked up.

Three of the four of us got the flatbead burger.  I was hesitant but I really liked it.  We all did.  My other friend got a chicken parm flatbread and also liked it.  I do wish I had gotten the tots instead of friends; although the fires were good, the tots were AWESOME!!!

I look forward to a cooler day when we can eat on the upstairs roof deck.  I am glad I gave the place a chance and I will definitely be back!
I am really fascinated in Latao Hot Pot. It's really excellent quality and reasonable price. We've got a decent serve. There won't be crowded at weekday lunch. You will never regret it.

It's Easter Sunday and me and my group of 4 girl friends decided to go get some margaritas on Sunday evening. Our waitress took my DMV temporary ID and rudely interrupted us multiple times as we requested her to look at the temporary ID & Identification photo on my phone. She proceeded to say she would go ask her manager if it was okay, then returned less than 30 seconds later and then THREW THE ID AT OUR TABLE and abruptly turned and stormed off. She then dropped our table and sent a different waitress over to re-take our order. As a experienced restaurant server, it was very uncomfortable and I believe the way she acted was very unprofessional. It should not be acceptable to throw an ID, let alone any object, at a customer, no matter the circumstances. Keep your composure and talk smack in the back like every other restaurant worker. We are LOYAL customers to chili's and this really disappointed me and my friends as WE ARE YOUR NUMBER ONE CUSTOMERS ... if u want proof DM me

I'm not a person to complain or leave a bad review by any means, but I am very frustrated and upset with Psomi's owners/management that I want to share my experiences. 
Occasion 1 (January 2020)- Me and friends went to grab brunch, we were greeted by our server with some water and told us he would come back for our drink orders. 20 minutes later he shows up to take drink orders and by that time, we were ready to order food after the long wait. One of my friends asked if she was able to do a substitution on her food and he wanted to ask the kitchen before giving us an answer. Around 30 minutes passed, and our server is nowhere to be seen. We still hadn't gotten our drinks or put in our food orders and had been sitting there for 45 minutes. I went to the hostess area and explained the situation and asked if she could get our servers attention or send us a new server. We ended up getting a new server that mentioned our drink ticket was lost hence why we never got anything. After an hour of sitting there we finally got our drinks and then 15 minutes later our food. During our wait one of the owners came up to us to apologize for the experience and proceeded to ask us "Can I get you a free dessert?" We all said no because we were starving and just wanted our food. She said "I'll get you guys something before you leave." But quite honestly I think our food or drinks should have been on the house for over an hour wait. We got our checks and absolutely NOTHING was taken off, which obviously annoyed me because by the time we even got our food/drinks we didn't enjoy it. The owner also never came back with whatever she was wanting to bring us. So $60 dollars later I left irritated and slightly angry and absolutely nothing was done for the ridiculous experience we endered at psomi except for a "sorry." 
Occasion 2 (6-4-20): I really wanted to try a dine-in experience again because there bakery is delicious and the establishment is beautiful so today me and my friends tried it out again. Our server was great and took our drink and food orders quick. I got a latte and the chicken souvlaki. When I started eating I noticed the texture of the chicken was off but disregarded it until I got to the middle of the sandwich and bit into a larger piece of chicken, realizing it was raw. I have a very weak immune system and stomach so naturally I started getting very anxious that I was going to get sick. I told my waitress and she took one glance and knew what they served was not acceptable. Another one of the owners (different one from last) comes out and apologizes and says that they'll remake it and if we'd like some cookies for the inconvenience? We said no. Then my friend noticed that her chicken as well was not cooked. It wasn't until then that the owner said they will take both our chicken souvlaki's off our bill and remake it for us. Even though we both said we didn't want new plates, they insisted. After taking forever to make the new plate we asked them to pack it to go (even though I had no plans of eating it). I would have rather them just comp the whole meal or surprise us with a dessert instead of asking. I ended up paying $20 for my drink, and a take home dessert that they didn't even offer to take care of, not to mention they charged me for a side of tzatziki that I didn't even get to eat.  Again I left feeling irritated and angry. In BOTH situations they didn't even offer to take care of ANYTHING. Also after looking at all the reviews on YELP and google the owners only reply to the 5 star reviews. There are several reviews that sounded very similar to my situations but the owners chose not to comment or instead reply back angrily. I would really appreciate I response and the situation to be resolved appropriately.

Took my daughter's 2010 Jeep Wrangler to Banghart's for a much needed  updated stereo with wireless Carplay and bluetooth before she headed back to college.  Even though they were super busy, they found a way to squeeze us in. They went above and beyond in providing us with a great product and phenomenal service.....but more importantly a great local business in West Chester, PA with a great group of guys!!  

Thank you Frank for going above and beyond!!  

My daughter loves her new Kenwood system and enjoyed it thoroughly on her 7 hour ride back to North Carolina! 

Highly recommend!!

I can't say enough nice stuff about this place! Stacy was AMAZING... she even tried on a dress for me once (voluntarily) when I was unsure about it being right for my bridesmaids! She will call you "hon" and "girlfriend" and make you super comfortable... I loved her.
The place looks funny from the outside (kind of a big trailer) but inside it is spacious and well-maintained. Everyone there was wonderful. Prices are pretty moderate, and the selection is big. These girls know what they're doing!

Poor management! 
This place is not worth the money. 
There is a high turnover rate with teachers.
Worst place ever. They changed my appointment time in me last minute, then when I showed up they couldn't service me because they double booked... DO NOT USE THIS BUSINESS!!!

Brunch here was hands down one of my most memorable experiences during my first visit to New Orleans. I will never forget it! 
The place is just perfect all around: comfort food and comfort PEOPLE! The ladies on the wait staff are a fantastic riot! 

My first impression of New Orleans is that is somehow a magical place and that magic has a lot to do with the food, history, music and people. My impression of Coffee Pot is that it somehow encapsulates NOLA.

PS. The seafood gumbo was the best we had on our trip.

Yeah they spread the Asian out.  Pan Asian I believe?  But I've been coming here for years and have hardly ever been disappointed.  Their Crab Rangoons are the best Ive ever had.  I love the Coconut Curry soup. Ask for extra spicy if you like it that way,  as I do.  Seared Ahi Tuna salad,  bomb. Combo platters, can't go wrong. As far as the sushi,  they have a decent 3 roll special for their basic rolls.  They're specialty rolls are a little exspensive for my taste but they sound good.  Nice atmosphere. Great happy hour,  and clean bathrooms! (Which is always a good sign). And they're open till 2 am.... Awesome!

Man, I want to love you, Flying Fish. You're a welcome addition to the neighborhood. But MAN is your service bad. Hilariously, absurdly bad. No one answers the phone or returns calls (we left a message a week ago about throwing a party there), food and drinks can literally take hours. I hope these are just growing pains because I'd really like this to be our place!

Bottom line:  "At least the food is cheap."

Someone once told me in life things can be cheap, good, or fast.  You can often have two out of the three, but rarely all three at the same time. 

My wife and I has been to Sushi Alive many times before in the past, specifically during their happy hour because the food and beverages are cheap.  The speed can be fast or slow depending on how busy it is, and it does get busy, which is something they can't control so they get a pass on speed. 

What is remaining is the question of how good Sushi Alive is.  The quality of the food is not the only metric by which to judge how "good" a place is as service is also important.  Let's address the food first.  The food itself is pretty standard and nothing special, in other words- average.  Average is not a bad thing.  Being at least average, but consistent, is what brings people back to a restaurant.

The problem with Sushi Alive is the service.  The service can be terrible.  The last time we went we sat outside on the patio.  We sat on a table behind the bar and waited.  I made eye contact several times with the server and waited and then waited more.  Okay, I get it, you might be busy, but at least say hello or something.  Ten minutes later we just left.  It was not too busy when we were there (roughly six pm).  On the way out I advised the host that no one came to us and he mentioned something about having to order or sit at the bar.  It is quite possible it is our fault, but at least say something.  If this was the only time we experienced bad service, I would have given them another chance, but alas, this was not the only time service was terrible to us here. 

If the service was decent, then Sushi Alive would be a solid 3 out of 5 stars.  But the food is only decent and the service is terrible so they get 1 star.  But hey, at least the food is cheap (during happy hour).

A friend recommended this veterinary clinic to us, and while we have only gone a few times, we have been nothing but pleased with each visit. The vets (we've seen three of them) have been taking excellent care of our two dogs (a pit bull mix and an Aussie shepherd mix), and the whole staff are compassionate, thorough, and implementing precautions for COVID very well.

Recently i went to get a tattoo of a saying "love yourself first". i just walked right in and the vibe of the place was comforting, didn't feel awkward and i was welcomed right away! the work was amazing and i am happy i got all the info on how to take care of it, Michael was very helpful and he did an amazing job! i am definitely going back to him for future tattoos for sure! i recommend carmel ink tattoo because they do great work, charge appropriately, and just know how to take care of their guests! thanks Carmel Ink Crew :-)

Not that no I have super high expectations for a fast food chain in a service area but with the exception of the guy who rung us up the service and food here was lousy. The person who took our order told my partner 5-10 minutes for vegetables when it took almost 20. Of course it took them like 5-10 minutes just to start them so what can you expect?

Had dinner here last night. Tried a few things. Here's my take on each...
Got two free soups as the appetizer took about 30 minutes.
Apps
Gumbo - rich and decent flavor but no seafood or  meats (chicken or sausage). As I didn't actually order it, I don't know if there are variations. 
Corn and crab bisque - bland bland bland
BBQ shrimp - great! Flavorful, seasoned and not overly oily like most.  Worth the wait. 
Dinner
Seafood platter - meh - 
catfish -over cooked
Oysters -pretty good... We all know why. 
Shrimp -over cooked
Soft shell crab -great
Crab 'ball' -Whatever the hell it was, there was just stuffing. 
Fries -underneath the fray -were greasy and sorta tasty... Color me  non pretentious.
Dessert
Bananas Foster bread pudding- light, rich... Good but missing something. 
Coffee cake- this was pretty bad. Dense and bland. 

Atmosphere
Bright and loud.  :/

Service
Nice waitress. Didn't know how to handle the long wait on the appetizer. A bit nervous but again, nice. 

Zero wait. Got there around 8:30 and sat down immediately. 

This review might make it sound sort of bad, but it wasn't. Overall it was decent. I'm glad there's another restaurant at the lakefront. The food was pretty good though nothing to write home about.
I'll probably go back to try the crab dip. 
Oddly, there was not a lot of crab on the menu.

I came here with intentions of wanting a good ok' Southern breakfast. It was more of a lunch and dinner joint. They were more than accommodating and offered to make me some eggs, bacon and Texas toast with my coffee. Long story short, I went for the wet Tennessee ribs with garlic mashed potatoes and some amazing beans! The food was delicious, in happy I stayed and the service was good ok' Southern love! Hope you enjoy your meal and the pecan pie!

Best Burger I've had in a LONG time! Great quality food, great taste, and great service. This is the kind of experience you want to have when you check out a new place. I had the "Mission" burger and added bacon to it and it was like heaven in my mouth. Will definitely come back next time we are in SB.
The Chicago Style stuffed pizza is great! I like the meat lovers. Its a cant miss pie, but also good fries and you cant go wrong with a chicago style beef dip sandwich

Went to Irish Mile tonight as my dad has been frequenting the establishment since he moved here. The three male bartenders know him by name and all three were very pleasant. Tonight we had the Mexican menu. We started with the fresh guacamole. A little on the spicy side but I like it that way. It was very good and had small chunks of avocado. Seemed like fresh homemade chips too. I then had three soft tacos-two chicken and one beef. I wish all three had been beef as that one was quite tasty. The chicken was kinda bland, even with lime. My fiance had tostados which he said were just okay. 
P.S. My dad has quesadilla last week and was dismayed that it came with lettuce and tomato piled on top. Not sure if that was a mistake on their part but menu does not stay this.

I've eaten at BJ's a few times, and each time I go I inexplicably find myself liking this place, even though the food is very average. I've tried the pizza, salads, fish tacos, the loaded baked potato, and several of the appetizers, and they aren't bad, but the food doesn't wow me either. I give it 3 stars because the food really drives my ratings, with everything else adding a little bit to the experience.

The only exception is the avocado egg rolls appetizer. These things are ridiculously good, with a tamarind dipping sauce. It's worth going here just for this! I could order this and have a couple beers and be very happy.

Their beer selection is excellent with many imports, craft beers, and the regular domestics. Their own beer is very good and I have tried the Stout, the Red Ale, the Pale Ale, and the Porter, and I've liked all of them.

It's a chain with a warehouse feel to it, and it's generally very crowded in the evenings and you have to wait. It's nicely decorated, clean and slightly upscale, and I have enjoyed my visits. I just wish the food was a little better.

Food: 3 stars
Atmosphere: 4 stars
Beer: 5 stars
Service: 4 stars

We made the right choice going with Four Seasons. Our son has been there for over a year now and he loves it. The staff is excellent, they have great curriculum of developmental programs. He brings home something new he did every day.

The Sicilian Pizza is amazing!  This is my go to pizza place in the area.  Quality food, great service, reasonable prices.  They have a dining room if you would like a more upscale eating environment. Or choose the standard pizzeria area.  The Pizza is as close to North Jersey as I can get in Salem County, and that is a complement!!!  I will definitely keep coming back.

One of our favs in the city was so disappointing.  Pork belly had the strangest flavor, chicken gumbo roux was burned, no signature shrimp and grits on menu and a 12-year old ate a $36 steak and declared that he was starving.  I hope this was just an off night, but I can't take the chance when paying this kind of money.  There are too many sure choices in Nola.

Thanks, Kandy! Heather was my stylist of choice. When I called I was informed Heather  had moved to Oracle Rd, but didn't know the name of the salon, nor did anyone else there know. Did some investigating and checked out many websites and found that there is Heather at Encore.Thanks to Kandy, for confirming that she's the one! If I hadn't felt lied to, I may have given this shop another try.

Consistently good food at a fair price. Good selection of meals, all very tasty. Service is quick and accurate, never a wrong order. Plenty of chips and salsa. Nice family atmosphere. Plenty of soccer on the TVs!!

Visiting the area and stopped in at 3:30 on a hot Monday afternoon. Thirsty and hungry we were happy just to find somewhere to get a cold beer and some basic bar food. Turns out food was AMAZING!!! We are real foodies and this was a very unexpected surprise. Bartender couldn't have been nicer and even gave me a different draft when I didn't like the one that I had. Would definitely go back.
The staff scanned my lost cat for a chip, called and returned our errant cat. Very professional.

I've been getting pizza from Sal's for over a decade and didn't realize just how awesome it was until I moved to Boston and couldn't find a decent slice ANYWHERE. Seems like your standard neighborhood joint, but they really make some top notch pizzas. Plenty of sauce and cheese, but never greasy like the chain places (Pizza Hut, Domino's, etc.). I looooooooove their steak pizza, which features a heaping portion of crispy shaved steak.

Sal's is definitely my go-to over other local places like Fiesta, Roman Delight, Roslyn Pizza, etc.. Only reason I didn't give them five stars is because I haven't had anything else off of their menu, but the pizza is certainly worthy of a perfect rating.

I know, it's a St. Louis institution, but honestly, there are so much better places here.  I would recommend Naughty and Nice (get the naughty!) or Ices Plain and Fancy over Ted Drewes.  They are much more original, and in my opinion, better.  But then again, I did not grow up here, so.....
This place is amazing and their mama's falafel sandwiches are delicious! The prices are reasonable and you definitely get a deal for what you pay for. The place also only takes cash.

This cute little place was perfect.  The staff was extremely kind and helpful. This place was also storey affordable.  We had a killer lunch with pizza and a steak sandwich with four cocktails and it was less than 20 $ a person.  The body marrys blew my mind.  The food quality is above average but below amazing and that's ok!  It couldn't have been better.  Go go go.

I had a business lunch of sorts here last week.  My employer rented a meeting room to do a product presentation to our clients.  The room sat around fifty and we filled it.

The wait-staff was excellent.  I hold places like this to a pretty high standard, so it's no insult to say that they met my expectations.

We started with a jumbo shrimp appetizer.  I didn't realize that shrimp grew that big!  Along with cocktail sauce, there was another that I didn't recognize but loved none-the-less.

For the main course, everyone had a choice of steak, chicken or fish (I think it was salmon), but I only saw the steak being delivered to the tables.  Mine was medium-rare, with whipped potatoes and something that I think was creamed spinach.  "Creamed Spinach", you say?  Well, this wasn't what you may remember from grade school.  We were sitting five to a table and were served "family style" with two serving dishes of each; I went back for seconds.  By the way, I was sitting next to someone who was apparently on the South Beach or Atkins diet; they got asparagus instead or the carbs.  I really wanted to steal a couple of spears, but I've learned that never impresses the client.  :)

I had to skip the dessert (a gelato), but it, too, looked great.

In conclusion, I would gladly return for a special anniversary.

Our server Will was amazing! So sweet and checked up on us a lot. It was like a dose of good southern hospitality from back home in Atlanta. Love you baby!

First timers definitely try the Taste of New Orleans platter. The Shrimp Etoufee in the platter was SO good. If you get the Gumbo, make sure to put the lemon in. It reminded us of a Progresso soup before we added the kick of lemon to break up the herb taste.

It's 95 out with super high humidity,We are in Ardmore and we wanted a light dinner. Fellow Yelpie Regina M suggested The Tasting Room. We are ecstatic she did because we have found a new favorite place to dine lightly( if you chose to, because they offer both "tasting" and "entree" sized portions). 
The beauty of Tastings and it's "tastings" sized small plates is being able to try multiple items on their innovative, beautifully presented, delicious menu. Being reasonably priced is an added bonus!
  Tonight we tried:
  - Tomato and Cucumber gazpacho which also had pieces of watermelon. We were blown away by the consistency, taste and absolute beauty of this cold soup.
 - Dad's Sliders with smoked Gouda, tomato and Brie butter. Yes! Brie Butter

Coconut Shrimp with such a light batter you could really taste the fresh coconut. It came with a side of sweet n spicy mango sauce for dipping which was delectable. 

 Beverages were iced green tea which were tasty and refreshing. 
I had forgotten my phone so I didn't do a check in so what came next was completely surprising. The owner sent us home with two free samples of a strawberry dessert that was beyond delicious.   That's good business! 

We loved our meal so much we are returning next week for restaurant week and I am sure even more thereafter.

Tried this place out for lunch yesterday and it was a great experience.  only reason didn't give it 5 stars was that its a little on the expensive side.  BUT the food was excellent and service was quick and friendly.  Will certainly be back!

I have one word for you, Ginger! This place has the lowest price fresh ginger anywhere  this side of the Mississippi. Now to be fair, the place smells like a fish market, but don't let that bother you.  The place was very busy, the aisles are a little small; I am a big guy and I had to turn sideways to let other people get by me. The prices are pretty good and the service at checkout was fast. 

Directly across from the Costco gas station for point of reference.
Absolutely amazing. The salad was sooo good! We ordered the stuffed pepper tapas as well as the a few other tapas. All fantastic!
Cute, quaint, relaxing environment. The service was very friendly and attentive. Food was delicious. Will definitely be coming back!!
Really small bar but the ambiance was dark and piratey in a good way. It's nice and cozy and a cool little place to meet up with friends.

The merger of UMC with Banner has been nothing but a disaster for patients. Doctors are leaving in droves and the conversion to the new electronic medical records system is causing hour-plus long wait times on hold just to get an appointment and is a step backward from the system installed just a few years ago. I can't wait till all my doctors have moved to TMC or elsewhere so that I can get appointments, have my records available, get referrals handled in a timely basis, etc. None of that is possible at Banner UMC despite the millions being spent. What a waste of resources for our community and a shame for our teaching hospital.

Nothing blows your socks off in terms of the food, although they really are trying hard to project it into a special spot. The place is nice. The drinks are good. The clientele is strong, and they love that. There are some stand out dishes over others. The octopus wasn't cooked properly, resulting in that gummy texture. The Italian American style stuff was definitely better.

I tried this place awhile back for take out and was seriously disappointed. I got the steamers that time and had to throw them away because they were soo chewy that I was unable to chew them up (I didn't want to choke to death on a clam). My neighbor order the Sicilian pie 2 weeks ago and shared with all of us and my oh my it was yummy! So tonight I figured I would try it again and ordered the Sicilian and large fries with a side of whiz.  Soo disappointed. I can't even believe this Sicilian came from the same place the one 2 weeks ago came from. It was dry like cardboard, the cheese was burnt entirely around the outer pieces ( which is the best part of the pie) and the fries would have been perfect except they came in a tin covered with plastic so all the heat from the fries creates steam and the lid gets wet and the fries were soggy! The whiz was amazing but that is made by someone else. It is impossible to find a place in Warminster that has good food across the menu and that is consistently good each time. I am not expecting great or exceptional food, just all around good. This place is just like the rest. It should never be acceptable to serve people burnt food. Pizza should not be dried out. It's not that hard.

So good. I took my husband here for his birthday and we will definitely be back. We split a few appetizers (bruschetta and mussels) and split a first and second course (gnocchi special and chicken rollotini). Overall I think the food is good, especially for the price. The atmosphere is fun and romantic too. I don't think this place would be good for a large group as it seems the chef makes all the food to order and it seems like it would take a long time. Plus, the restaurant is on the smaller side. 

In regards to the food, the bruschetta and gnocchi special were excellent. Super delicious. The mussels and rollotini were good, not great. 

Wine by the glass was affordable too....I think around $5-6/glass for good wine. 

I would 100% recommend eating here and we will be back.
This was a solid choice in Delmar for a girls lunch. Authentic food, I was not disappointed.

After a few days of hitting the towns sites and eateries we decided to burn off those cheesesteaks and bowl a few games.  I'll start with the good...

GOOD:
Happy Hour from 4 - 7 with $3 beers, $4 wines and $5 cocktails (ADD 1 STAR)

Nice interior with neon lighting and big, comfy seats to go back to after throwing that strike! (ADD 1 STAR)

Staff was actually nice and our waitress was attentive and always checked on us (ADD 1 STAR)

Now for the the bad...

BAD:

Food during HH was a rip off.  How are chips and guacamole $11 during HH??? The cheese curd things were quite tasty but for a dozen pieces I think $10 is pricey.  And this is during Happy Hour, I'm afraid to see what prices are AFTER HH! (MINUS 1 STAR)

And again got ripped off for bowling.  Not sure if the guy who rang us up thought we were paying for dates that weren't there but we were charged double.  He didn't even correct the problem when only 2 of us were asking for shoes. (MINUS 1 STAR
)

It was a good time for the few hours were there so I'll just chalk the overcharging to "tourist taxes!" Haha)

This is the best kept secret in Nashville! Creative menu options with unique flavor (hello secret sauce on steak tacos) but NOT pretentious and over-hyped like most nice restaurants in town. Even the basics are good, like the creamy tomato basil soup (that I crave weekly). Hubby likes the Flatiron steak ($10 steak night? Yasss) or the Wagu beef sliders. If you're expecting something uppity like beef tartare cooked on a Peruvian forest leaf on a miniature plate, this is NOT the place for you. But if you want a nice atmosphere to relax with your friends, that has crave-worthy high quality food, this is your jam.

Ps: shout out to Ryan and Taylor, who always go above and beyond and treat us like VIPs.

Disappointing hibachi show ! Terrible service ! Burnt Mongolian bowls ! Need I say more ! The place was packed on Friday night , so we assumed it was probably very popular and good- we were so wrong ! The hostess couldn't keep up with how many people were in our party and squeezed us on a hibachi table with 3 other folks - the table was too small for 10 people! Our waitress was either extremely tired or didn't care for the service she was providing . Overall a bad experience ! Not going back - or at least not when they are very busy , Because they are definitely not equipped to handle that !
Excellent!! Great, hot fresh food with TONS of flavor. Great little hole-in-the-wall restaurant with quick service. Overall a really great spot with fabulous food. Would highly recommend.

Excellent twist on Mexican food. Favorite restaurant in this town
Crispy shrimp tacos or excellent.

Went to the El Charro on Broadway for happy hour, boy that was a mistake. The place was empty, overstaffed and service was inattentive. I ordered a beer and was asked bottle or draft...apparently draft is the happy choice and I didn't know that until a regular came in and told me after I had already had two. The bartender was pleasant but more concerned with the regulars than my wife and I. I ordered the pork carnitas burro and the meat was so overcooked, it literally tasted like charcoal. The meager brown lettuce and dry rice were a disappointment. My wife had the grilled white fish tacos because apparently they put cheese in their masa for the tamales...new to me. She said they were generic at best. The final remark made cane from who I assumed was a manager, we overheard him say...well if she is gluten free why come here? Some people are just not too smart. I was shocked. It took all my control not to come unhinged. I can absolutely state that I will no longer go to El Charro again. Tucson tradition has completely lost its touch with the guest.

We arrived in town earlier than we could check into our condo.  This sweet little coffee shop was perfect.  We killed some time in a beautifully decorated, comfy shop with a super friendly barista.  The thin mint iced coffee was the perfect pick me up! She went over and above to make sure our visit was perfect, and we left with a pound of banana nut bread coffee which I've enjoyed on our balcony all week.
Thank you for making Christen's bachelorette such a fun and festive day. The girls and I had such a blast with your team. Thanks again for all of your help... xoxo
Cheesesteak was okay, 6/10. Caprese panini was a 4/10 and was not really a panini as it wasn't warm. Pizza fries were good.
The ramen is incredible! Very friendly owner, as well. There is much seating, but they package everything really nicely for to-go orders.

I have only been to New Orleans twice. Both times, Tropical Isle was a must for me. 

I was introduced to this bar by some friends who are locals and it did not disappoint. You will find some of the best drinks for the lowest price at this bar!

They are known for their Hand Grenade, which will get you good and buzzed after one go! They are cheap, like $8 for a looooong-necked delicious signature beverage.

Those staffing the bar have smiles on their faces and are very helpful. They'll even take that "I-don't-know-what's-good-here?" question like a champ!

Also, if you go here, buy the "Shark Attack" drink. You'll be grateful you did. ;)

It has a wonderful tropical party atmosphere that only accentuates when you hit the second floor, which comes complete with more TVs and a pool and air hockey table, not to mention another bar and a jukebox.

On that second floor, you can get some outdoor seating on a beautiful balcony that overlooks Bourbon St.

Bottom line is, this HAS TO BE one of your stops on Bourbon!

The service is always good! The first time I went service was good better then the most recent time (my 2nd). I decided to take my boyfriend out to get champagne and dessert. We did not have reservations. So I told the hostess we would not be in the restaurant for a long time. So she was nice enough to pencil us in on the spot!!!! We had the champbongs which were pretty cool a great way to celebrate special locations. The Smore's dessert was pretty good. The brownie was chilled, I will preferred had it been warmed. That's how Jack Rose serves it.

I wish I had read the reviews BEFORE signing the lease. They touted their free Wifi (which I have trouble connecting to at least once a week), their free Sunday paper delivery (which I probably never would have received, had I not asked about it), free business center with copy machines and fax machines (not in my building), management staff that take forever to get back to you, and "at your door" package delivery (3 days after the package arrives at Green Street's suite 2 miles away. 

Management is quick to respond to neighboring business' complaints about trash in front of their business, but NEVER responds when patrons of said businesses puke in our vestibule.

Place is cool, service is LOUSY.  I went in at a time that was not busy - later in the evening after the big rush and nobody ever waited on me.  After the first five minutes I decided to see how long it would take.  I sat in a very cool lounge chair with a TV right in front of me, atmosphere is very cool but I couldn't get a drink or something to eat for 15 minutes so I left.  It wasn't just me, they seated a couple of guys to my left 5 minutes after I got there and when I left they hadn't had anyone come over either - and it was only 1/2 full.  So - on only one visit - I say - bring someone with you that you really like that is a professional server and it looks like it would be fun.  BYOS bring your own server.

Trenton, New Jersey, is the last of the state capitals to have a Starbucks.  After 400+ years of history, it has finally arrived.  And, from the look of the place, the Green Mermaid spared little expense in designing this java joint. It is large, bright and original.  Cut in a triangular shape at the corner of Front Street and South Warren Street, on the first floor of a State office building, the two outer walls are all glass, and both are lined with comfortable sitting areas for work and conversation.  The back walls are painted with colorful murals of famous cityscapes - including the famous Trenton Makes Bridge across the Mighty Delaware River to Pennsylvania. 

The coffee is standard Starbucks (not my favorite), but there is something to be said for consistency.  Their reliable snacks are present, and the service is friendly, knowledgeable and efficient. Everyone gets "TO GO" cups, even those hanging out, to save on losses. 

I enjoyed the fact that this beautiful facility was actually in this Sad Sack city, as much as I enjoyed my latte and slice of lemon pound cake.  I watched as people filtered in and out.  No one seemed to be taking the space for granted.  The gold balloons didn't let that happen. 

I allowed myself a moment of pride and gratification for this city that has been down so long that Starbucks is a very big win. Let's hope it is the beginning of a renaissance that has been awaited since Washington surprised the Hessians on a cold Christmas morn.

This place is fantastic! They are a good spot to go for one of a kind gifts, useful knick knacks, and beautiful jewelry.  I go in, and I end up finding at least three things I want. I recently bought a very affordable pair of gorgeous earnings, that were totally handmade!  I think almost all of the artists are local, which is something I really appreciate!

Great place for Chinese or Japanese food! They have many great choices for both! Like the Honey Walnut chicken and the Red Dragon Shrimp. On the sushi side, I like the Beach Roll. The Honada Roll is great too!

Checked them out at the Sea Isle City food truck fest. The workers were up beat, friendly, and very helpful. I had the pork dumplings, crab Rangoon, and the pad Thai egg roll. Everything was delicious and I'll definitely be back for more!

Do NOT get alterations done here.

You should probably skip Brides & Grooms for wedding dresses as well.  Let's be honest, I went here for the price and I got a good price on a wedding dress from a 4 year old collection.  I bet if I looked around I could have gotten that price elsewhere, but not much better.  So if you've got the dress in mind and you want a price check this place is fine.  that's as good as this store gets

Customer service is terrible.  There is one person in the shop that does 90% of the work from what I can tell, she's the store manager (potential relative of owner).  The rest are pretty much worthless.  You can call ahead but appointments are not written down.  I don't need to be pampered so I like that you pull your own dresses, for some that could be a problem.  Best part - while trying on dresses you can hear the store manager taking calls from upset customers... and the calls never stop.  Wrong sizes ordered, dresses late, bridesmaids dresses shipped to the wrong location... oh the stories are endless and all end with the customer saying to the store manager "I refuse to talk to anyone but you in this store again."

but the heart of the matter is that the person in charge of alterations (might be the owner) is terrible.  she will lie to you and argue with you.  After charging me near $300 for alterations she will fight to only do one round of alterations.  I got my altered dress and thought it was a bit long and still lose at the waist.  She said - "that's what wedding dresses look like."  I trust her and I take my dress cross country for my wedding and the lady who pressed my dress took one look at me in it and started hemming it... 3 inches off and you still couldn't see my shoes (yes same shoes I wore for the original alterations).  And without my commenting on the waist she said "you ok with me taking this in a bit?"  

So the second lady did all the real work for less than HALF the price of Brides & Grooms.  I could not be more displeased with this place.
Was not impressed. The food came out freaky fast and my food was really soggy as if the made it an hour ahead. The only thing good was there sangria and poker machines.

Lunch hot spot!!! Almost a once a week lunch spot for me. I've never had a bad chicken pad Thai experience here. The servers are very kind and bring you as many refills as you can stand. Lunch comes with edamame, a spring roll and a mound of whatever you choose. You will not leave hungry. Don't skip the appetizers because they are delicious. Affordable, quick lunch spot for anyone working in the Metairie area.

Overpriced clothing store with interesting and cool knick-knacks for parents who don't know what else to get their kids. Bean-bag chairs, folding chairs, lava lamps, assorted jewelry... you name it.

Clothing is overpriced, but seems popular on campus. Some gear for hiking are displayed on the walls, but I have no idea who actually buys those. 

Good for picking up random crap/gifts for a college dorm room.

Careful, doctors are nice but they are definitely out for the $$. Got my tooth fixed and cannot chew on it. Now they want to charge me for taking a look at it and tell me it needs another type of procedure ( after first procedure was well over 1000.00). Same story with my mother...she cannot chew after spending 10k.
I do NOT recommend this dentist for anything other than cleanings.
Good luck.

The new Bench location is quickly becoming our new go-to spot. Food is delicious, especially the chicken, and it comes out fast.  The only thing I would suggest they work on is service. The woman working the register isn't the most friendly person I've ever met.

I've been a snob about going to Olive Garden most of my life. Recently, I decided to give them a real chance. It's not the greatest, but my experience was not bad. 

Food-wise, I tried several dishes. The mussels as the appetizer were a bit too salty. The minestrone soup and pasta fagoli were both decent. The breadsticks were very good, but didn't need salt on them which they had. The mixed grill was better than I thought it might be although the steak was a little tough. I tried a sampling of the dessert shots, as well as one of the zeppolis. They were good chain restaurant desserts but not overly special. Other people at the table got the unlimited pasta special which they seemed happy about. Service for us was decent. 

There are better places locally for Italian. But I have softened my stance on this place. Just don't go in with overly high expectations.
The worst McDonald's in the world cold food slow service no service and a very dirty dining area

I curse my stars whenever I have to go to this shithole. I hate this place from the bottom of my heart. I'm not gonna write a generic negative rant. I'm gonna make my case point by point. 

1) I have been to this restaurant about 4 or 5 times in the last year and every time they have gotten my order wrong; twice on one occasion. The recent one, that happened a few minutes ago was so bad that I downloaded yelp just so I can leave a review.
1 a) I ordered a sandwich to go. When I walked back to my office and opened the box, there was a huge slab of cheese in the sandwich. I especially asked for no cheese because I'm lactose intolerant.

1 b) I removed the cheese somehow and started eating. I had taken just two bites that I realized that there was no sauce in the sandwich. The menu clearly states tomato sauce an one of the ingredients.

1 c) When I went to return the sandwich and ask for a refund, instead of apologizing for screwing up my order, the lady gave me attitude about how I had eaten half the sandwich!! The long roll was cut into two halves and I had eaten two bites off of one half. the other half was still untouched. 

1 d) I was told that no cheese had been put in the sandwich. I politely invited the lady to come to desk and look in the garbage bin where two slabs of cheese could still be found from this sandwich.

1 e) Instead of admitting their mistake, the workers ignored me, treated me like shit and acted as if I had made a mistake.

2) The quality of the food sucks. The meat is old and smelly. The place smells like a dump.

3) I took my coworker here once and he threatened to stop talking to me if I took him here again.

I will eat a can full of nuclear waste before I put anything from this God forsaken hell hole into my mouth.
they FINALLY have a rewards program -- thank goodness! I still come here a ton and it's nice to get some $ off every once in awhile.

I stopped to the drive thru on my way to work and I order the pick 2 which is the sald and sandwich.  Well I wasn't very satisfied with my food. The sandwich was more bread than the chicken avocado. I had this sandwich before and it wasn't the great today.  The salad was good the passion fruit smoothie was good.  But the sandwich was a huge disappointment for 1$8.09 for that was not great.

My boyfriend and I went to this place in search for a good frozen yogurt... We wish we found this place earlier!!! So so so so DELICIOUS. The owner is so sweet. Here are some points:

-Great Price, very affordable. There are more than three sizes. Medium is quite large. I would say larger than a Ben and Jerry's pint cup. 
-Ask for free samples! Flavors are delicious. I personally love the vanilla custard.  Tastes just like vanilla!
-Can get more than one flavor in your cup with no additional cost
-Can get as many toppings as you want, and they make sure to put toppings at the bottom, in between layers, and the top!
- Locally owned business :)

All in all. This place is amazing! I highly recommend this place to everyone. They're right next to Toys R Us. It's such an affordable price, I have never seen such excellent customer service.

Friendly staff, nice atmosphere, great hours, and delicious ice creaaaam! I think my favorite thing of the night was the ice cream. So smooth snd creamy and they have a nice variety that changes weekly. I liked their philly as well. Fries weren't my favorite but next time I want to try the fried lobster!

The rolls are amazing. I've never had pesto or basil in my rolls and they were incredible. Service was awesome. John C is the man! I will definitely go there any time I am visiting Reno! Highly highly recommend. And the location is perfect right on the river.
This is one of my fave fast, cheap Chinese food in Reno. Always a go to! The apps are delicious, food always hot and prepared perfect. If you are looking for good Chinese look no further.

The barbecue bacon cheeseburger is amazing. The meat is fresh and the burger is huge. It comes with Cole slaw or fries. We order the onion rings they are hugh. I could only eat soup so I had the chicken noodle soup which did not disappoint.

In a world where most people think BBQ means grilling a hamburger, Black Label is a welcome addition to the ever growing Nola BBQ scene. For years the city was a virtual wasteland when it came to legitimate BBQ and now we have a bunch of places to choose from. 

Black Label bills itself as Texas style BBQ and that is an accurate description. As far as technique, they fire up actual smokers as opposed to some electric smoking rigs used by other area restaurants. Their food is good to very good, but I think other aspects fall a little short.

Food

Brisket - Very Good. The brisket plate was mostly lean, but it had a great thick smokey taste. If you are unaccustomed to real BBQ, you may find this flavor off putting, but for me, I loved it.

Pork - Good. The pork was moist, but not as smokey as the brisket.

Jalapenos - Holy Mackerel. The stuffed jalapenos were creamy bites of smokey goodness. I could make a meal solely on these incredible poppers. Whatever you do, make sure you get some of these.

Location

Black Label is a pop up based in Barrel Proof. Maybe I am getting old or something, but it was pretty dark inside and I was confused about where to order. Once I noticed the host stand at the back left of the bar I figured it out. Because it isn't a dedicated restaurant, the vibe of the place was a little odd. People were friendly, but it felt like the combination of fancy whisky bar and BBQ joint was a bit forced.

Prices

I realize that the price of beef has skyrocketed, but I felt like the prices are a little steep. I am no expert in food cost, but brisket at Black Label is around $9-10 more per pound than other local stand alone bbq joints. Their brisket is very good, but I don't think it is above and beyond the other places with lower prices.

Summary

Black Label puts out a good product, but the location and prices detract from the otherwise good product. If I find myself inside of Barrel Proof for some reason I feel sure I will be ordering more BBQ from Black Label. I just don't know if I will go out of my way to visit.

The service here is the worst. Some of the cashiers won't even look at you or grunt up one word the whole time they are ringing you up and checking you out even when you say hello.  Their choices are nothing like shoprite.  I go there for convenience as it is near my house. Store seems clean enough and their prices aren't terrible which is why I gave a 2.

Very happy with Steakworks!! The roll was delicious. Definitely from Philly. They had a dozen different cheesesteaks to choose from. I just got a cheesesteak with onions. Flavor and texture of the meat was wonderful. This will be my cheesesteak place from now on. 

The pizza looked really food also so I think there is a good chance that I will try that sometime soon. The seating area is pretty dated but large. A lot bigger than it looks from outside. If you called ahead you they could probably accommodate a pretty large group (post-Covid).

I had the pleasure of working with both Asa (at TMC) and TJ (Mama's Latte home visit). Breastfeeding did not come naturally to me and my newborn had a narrow latch. My only regret is that I didn't call sooner! TJ came a week after birth and I already had nipple damage and was struggling with pain. TJ was a life-saver. She had a ton of great information and her support really boosted my skills and confidence. She was very patient with all of my questions and sent lots of follow-up resources and videos to my email. To say this was worth the money is an understatement. Mama's Latte was an essential part of my transition to motherhood. Thank you!

hands down among the best mediterranean food i've ever had anywhere, including amsterdam. the falafel is above average but the items that really shine are the greek salad (that lemon dressing is sublime), labna (silky smooth cream cheese-like dip) and homemade pita bread ... which there's never enough of. the tabouleh just screams fresh as well. not sure why such good mediterranean food exists in new orleans but it does. and the value is stupendous. i'm not a grape leaves fan but people swear by babylon's as well.

We're new to STL and having come from the west coast love good Mexican food. So when we found the local Hispanic neighborhood and this place, we had to try it. This place does not disappoint and serves up great portions. It's also a good sign when you have Hispanic families dining in. Anyways, I'm adding pictures of their menu so that folks can take advantage of just calling in their orders for pickup.

This restaurant has exceptional food, excellent service and outdoor seating so that we could sit and dine with our dog. The inside dining area is beautiful. As an Italian American, I felt that the food was authentic. They served warm bread with olive oil and cheese with the meal. The pastas were homemade and the veal was delicious. My father taught me that if you can cut the veal with a fork (and you don't need the knife) then you know it's good. This passed the test and it was the first place in a long time for me that did.

Great taste of New Orleans. A little locally owned bar and restaurant with great home cooking. The stewed chicken and homemade potato salad were great. We finished up with a bread pudding with praline sauce.

Great place to see what the local restaurant scene is all about. Experience the real NOLA .
The view is worth the trip.  Definitely a spring break kinda place.  Go for sunset and quick drink. Didn't try the bar fare.

We are from out of town and used yelp to find a nail salon.  The first salon we tried we walked out after not being acknowledged.   Here we were quickly acknowledge and sat down for pedicures.  It was my husbands first time and he was made to feel very comfortable and even given tips on what he could do for his toe nails and heels.  A lot of men will not go for pedicures and I've been trying for years to get my husband to go.  Great first time experience for him!  Thank you!

OMG! I LOOOOOVE this restaurant! I went there for the first time today and was super impressed with everything! The ambience, the friendliness of the staff and the food...oh my the food was to die for. I dont think you can go wrong with anything. Even the bread rolls they give you at first is yummy. Hubby and I had chicken tenders and the alligator sausage flat bread for apps. To die for!! Did I mention the portions are huge. By the time entree came we were so full and had to take to-go...we noticed everyone had a to-go bag too. For entree, i had the blackened cat fish...oh gosh, the taste, AMAZING!!!!

I'm sad. I love Cracker Barrel and always have great experiences. This one just missed the mark. My food did not taste good - in fact, I didn't even finish it. The mashed potatoes reminded me of plastic. 

I won't be going back here. Go to another location!!

My fiancé and I came here for a work trip, we order room service , and not only they were rude, the orders where never correct. I called up for more towels and I was told I can't have more then two because there are other people staying in the hotel.. and then the sanitation of our room, I do not think it is very satanized to have a sheet the blanket they never change, and another sheet, no duvet cover ! There where stains all over out blanket

This was my first visit, on a Thursday night, and I can honestly say that it was awesome. 2 bands played, we grabbed a couple of beers by the bar. We also were hungry and decided to go for a few dishes starting with the fish tacos (which were so good we ordered a second round) followed by a Poutine. Now having lived in Canada, I wasn't expecting anything as good as they have there but this one was fantastic. A great place, with great beer, good food, a good experience !

.....dont order the baked beans...mild bbq sauce wasn't anything special and the smoked turkey & brisket wasn't tender, potato salad is decent just a little heavy on the onions. first time at this place as an out of towner, would not recommend. the side of toast was good though.
They were prompt, professional and did a great job. Cleaned up well after too. I would definitely use them again.
This places is great! I love all the choices of Eggs Benedicts. The food has average prices. I'd come back.

My husband and I happened on Cueni walking the bike trail, so glad we stopped in. The owners were super friendly and knowledgeable about their beers. Gave us great advise and loved the selection we had. Definitely a regular stop for us!
The food was amazing and very reasonably priced. The service was also excellent. Our server Tina was kind, respectful, and hilarious. I would honestly want to be her friend. #outofthered
Decent pint and a good irish whisky selection. Good place to have a pint before taking the train home to the 'burbs.
Great brunch spot. Wonderful egg white omelettes. Brioche French toast got rave reviews as well. Service was at a good pace for a leisurely brunch.

Jalisco offers a very inexpensive way to get some delicious tasting Mexican food. Their chile rellenos are tasty and their enchiladas have a wonderful rojo sauce along with being filled with Mexican cheese, not cheddar.
 You get a side of corn tortillas and all the chips you can eat. That's a good deal. The beans and salsa were somewhat average in taste but it's not a deal breaker by any means.
The restaurant itself is pretty utilitarian in design with nothing flashy or colorful adorning the walls. Just a TV tuned in to some great Mexican soap operas that you can understand no matter what language you speak.
Jalisco is also a little store and offers a nice variety of sauces and tortillas.
Service was great.

This was a very nice time for my first visit. 

Kristen did a good job of serving up samples of their classic and premium beers.  Ray did an excellent job of being accessible and explaining how they all came to be.  

All beers had a very nice balance of flavors.  I ended up having 2 pints of the Yacht Rock.

Very nice to have great camaraderie between local Indy breweries.

What a find! A co-worker recommended this place to me, and I went in July 2013.  It was a really hot night, I was the only one that sat outside.  I got their salad w/grilled salmon, and some sweet potato fries, all were good and the portions were huge.

Went back with my boyfriend June 2014, on a Saturday night, we had a reservation for 6:30 but were able to get a high top table outside immediately. I prefer the hightop to the regular table.  The bread was actually better than the last time I was there - it was nice and grainy.  butter was good too.  we ordered their famous eggplant fries - but really there is nothing special about them, the sauce tastes loaded with mayo too.  when I bit into one of the fries there was very little eggplant and mostly just friedness - I do not recommend them, but the BF liked it.  

For dinner, I got their special swordfish with spinach, orzo salad with red onion and parsley. it was divine - the fish was cooked perfectly and everything tasted out of this world.  I wish the fish piece was bigger.  My BF got their lamb chops - they gave him 5 nice sized ones and it ame with green beans and they subbed the mashed potatoes for redskin since he has an allergy.  he loved it.  we got sides of veggies - they were steamed and pretty flavorless.  

The price was good for the size $24 for mine and $27 for his. The only downside was that the service was REALLY slow.  and not just to get our food, but to even get the check! we got in at 630 and didn't leave until almost 830.

We will be back!
This is the best place to get king cakes for Mardi Gras or weddings cakes in the New Orleans area. Never been Dissapointed . Can't go wrong with the petit-fores either , they are top notch !

I stayed at The French Market Inn for a bachelorette party when we decided that Bourbon Orleans was too expensive and we were NOT disappointed with our decision on switching. The hotel is so cute and huge. You wouldn't think how big it is from the exterior. 

Myself and 2 other girls arrived a day earlier than the rest of our group. I was nervous about them getting a room far from where our room was but the hotel kindly put them right next to ours. We had a part of the 3rd floor where it's like a secret staircase to get to and only 4 rooms are. Like the courtyard our room had a brick wall (which I'm a sucker for) and cathedral ceilings. It is the nicest hotel I have ever stayed in. Maybe because it isn't a chain hotel. 

The staff is very friendly as well. We didnt have turndown service because we refused it but they gave us new towels and toilet tissue when requested. HIGHLY recommend staying here.

Stayed here for a few nights. After I got back home from my vacation I noticed that someone stole my credit card information. They ended up spending a couple thousand. Not 100% sure it was from this hotel but this was the only place where I provided my personal info ( address&name) the charges happened right after I checked in. Airline tickets, concert tickets, online purchases were made. Just becareful if you decide to stay here and make sure you check your credit card charges every day.

This place is overated!  Gyro meat is small chunky strips instead of being shaved.   I have no problem with that it its meaty.  But it had a mushy texture.  The kebob combo had 2  chicken and 2 beef pieces and a ground lamb "sausage".  The meat lacks flavor and the beef was burnt.  Even the rice tasted "instant".

Very delicious food, friendly staff, and cute inside! My only complaint very cold inside. The tables are arranged a little strange but the food and atmosphere so awesome it didn't matter! Would like to eat next time in front of pizza making guys yum!!

Horrible online experience. I ordered a repair and waited days for email instructions on how to send them in. I contacted them, and they told me I "messed up" and simply missed the "obvious" instructions on sending them in at the end of the online carting process, which didn't matter because they don't do Boston repairs any longer. I asked for a refund, and it has been going on for two weeks with no luck. I would highly suggest you take your business elsewhere.

The owner is very nice. The food is very good. Make sure to try the guacamole.
Delivery is a bit suspicious. It is rumored to happen, but it has never worked out for me.  
Reservations on weekends a must as it gets a lot of Penn Students.

I have always enjoyed Larry's Steaks. Driving from Delco just to get me a taste of one. However, I can only give this location a 2 star due to the lack of customer service their employees have. I called in my order the young lady didn't even say Hello and the entire time I'm placing my order she's humming. What??? Then I say Thank you after I'm done and she acknowledges me by a simple hum. Totally unprofessional from the phone to the pickup. Complete attitude and then couldn't "locate my order". (You're given a order number over the phone for "simplicity". RIGHT? ) 

Larry's Steaks should seriously consider the people they hire to represent their establishment. Sadly this is my last time patronizing. And the steak was a 6 at best  

I'll travel to Maxx's

Went during restaurant week, 3 courses for 35$
Restaurant week is supposed to make you try restaurant, give you an overview and cutting prices as compare to usual menu without cutting anything from the menu...
That's not the case here... and clearly, after dinner, you still have room for an entree!!
