Other thing that prove it... we were a party of 5 (including my parents and my gd mother 85 years old), she was so happy at the end and said 'that the first time ever I ve finished all my plates, you should be still all hungry' lol... yes gdma!! We are....

Nothing more frustrating than leaving a restaurant and wanting so bad an other meal...

Other proof... the menu in Sunday for 50... 5 courses.... if you cut 2 courses and 15 dollars... you have the restaurant week menu 3 courses at 35$
So dont forget to eat a cheesesteak or a cheesecake before or after your passage at Pumpkin within Restaurant week^^

Except this true fact, menu was really good, scallop for 1st course (good but gdma choice with the celeri root soup was way far better)
Then we all had the salmon, really good but again you look for something more consistent with the good piece of salmon (you have 10 crispy rice lol and 6 cherry tomatoes, one large spoon of celeri leaves and 1 spoon of sauce
...),
Dessert was ok too, bourbon pot de creme, looks like a panna cotta (good even if you can find better...)

Also, space is little... and if you have some neighbor that speak on the typical american way (that is yielling instead of speaking...) it's a little bit annoying to eat in here... and you have to speak soooo loud to make other people at your table hear you...

You go out of Pumpkin with release and hunger^^

So I will recommend not to go within restaurant week, to take the 5 courses menu and to avoid crowded time.... so maybe dont go^^
Interesting place but don't let that stop you! Great service and fast!!! Thanks for getting me in on such short notice!! I was very impressed by this RV service.

Place is real nice. Stayed there for one night and customer service was excellent. They have a nice bar to enjoy a drink and bourbon street is right across the street. There's security at night when you try and enter your room you need to show a room key which is good and the elevators have little or no wait at all. I def recommend here.

My husband and I regularly order from Bossie's and are never disappointed! The Korean Fried Chicken Sandwich is amazing, and the Rotisserie Chicken is so delicious as well. I recently tried the biscuit and gravy and WOW- that combo is to die for! We haven't been to the restaurant itself in awhile due to covid, but it is a cute little spot with a great ambiance. Highly recommend this restaurant for some great, comfort food-like cooking!

I stopped at a lot of these Goodwill stores because I do arts and crafts and I can find items in the store that I can use. I went in this one yesterday and one of the things I look for are the grab bag and their grab bags were so lightly packed that you could see everything in them so there was no element of surprise when you got them home and the value it's not good when they do that. Also it seemed that this Goodwill was fairly low on inventory I don't know if it was because we just went through the holidays and they were just depleted or if it is due to covid. I will likely stop here again whenever I'm in the neighborhood and see if it's a little better outside of the holiday season.

STL Bubble Tea seems to be one of the few bubble tea place serving WashU's Danforth and Medical campus. When my friend and I arrived, the cashier wasn't overly friendly and bristled at my friend's request to sample a few flavors (she worked at a bubble tea shop back home). When she asked how they cooked their "bubbles", he merely shrugged and said "She makes them in the kitchen" while motioning to the cook. 

When asked whether STL Bubble Tea uses powder, again he shrugged and replied "I don't know how she makes them back there" and made no attempt to ask the cook.

I understand that customer service isn't the main attraction of a fast food Chinese place, but honestly? You could at least put some effort in, you know?

The Taro bubble tea was sub par. It had ice, but overall, it was lukewarm (yikes). The tapioca seemed to be alright, however, but my friend disapproved with my opinion. 

I don't recommend.

4-stars for the 15.32! that's 2 cocktails plus 2 appetizers for only $15 bucks during the month of August. I chose the boudin egg rolls and sausage wrapped around sugar cane (not "to die for" but lovely presentation). The 2 cocktails were great and excellent service from our waiter. Highly recommend the Prohibition beer on draft (if you like IPA). 

Restaurant is an easy on/off from the St. Charles Streetcar @ Melpomene St.

This was the second Subaru we have bought from this dealership. Buying my 2016 CrossTrek at John Kennedy Subaru was a very satisfying experience. Marie Carson was extremely knowledgeable about the entire Subaru line going back several years. She was not the only helpful and friendly person we encountered during the car-buying experience. Everyone, every step of the way, was friendly and enthusiastic, and were very patient with my 11 year-old son, answering his questions and letting him attach the license plate to the new car. I would highly recommend anyone looking for a quality vehicle and good service to John Kennedy Subaru.

If you are looking to get away from the rat race of Nashville and you like cold beer, live music, and excellent burgers this place is for you. The patio is the place to be. The music is excellent. All you have to do is rode up sit back and relax. It is more than worth the drive out plus its an awesome little town.

This was hands down the best meal I had in New Orleans! It's not a typical cajun/creole place its more diner food.  I have honestly been to a lot of diners but this one was just perfect.. the tables were ushapes that go all around the resturant.  The workers are so nice and welcoming.  I had steak & eggs and my boyfriend the roast beef po boy.  BEST steak and eggs of my life! Juicy & flavorful and boy can they cook the perfect eggs.  My boyfriends roast beef po boy had this amazing gravy..
New Orleans must try

Do I have to give them any stars? I arranged for rental online for a rate of $48/day on arrival and check in I was charged nearly double that because of "taxes and fees". I travel frequently and rent from various agencies and I have never been charged nearly $200 more than the fee given to me online. Never, again will I rent from dollar, btw National is owned by the same company.

Service was great. Food was disappointing. We choose this as a double date night. We've all been craving Italian so we made reservations and headed to the hill. Should have stayed in the county. Tried two apps Goat cheese ravioli and rice balls. The ravioli wasn't cooked. We love aldente pasta. However you needed a knife for the ravioli. The flavor was okay but the underdone pasta turned us all off. Riceball was good but needed seasoning and happened to be the exact same rice in my chicken risotto. 

Entrees: Chicken Ossobuco veggies (the special) chicken risotto, chicken Alfredo and spaghetti with meat sauce. 

The special - two dehydrated chicken breasts pounded thin. It was okay. $26. Not good. 

Chicken risotto- dehydrated chicken and dry rice paste type risotto. Not creamy and savory. Didn't eat a 1/8 $18

Chicken Alfredo - dehydrated chicken. The rest was fine.

Spaghetti and meat sauce - no meatballs. But was the best looking part of our dinner. 

Bread was AMAZING. Thank goodness. So our 1/2 of the check was $90 with tip. Food is barely okay I've had better Italian from Olive Garden. But it was surprisingly busy.

If you want the best prime rib or steak Harold Seltzers is the place to go. Is it your birthday, let them know you get free bottle of wine and free dessert. Waiters/waitresses are pleasant and helpful  check for happy hour specials best steakhouse in St. Petersburg.

I loved this office. The doctors were really awesome but I stopped going there for 1 reason.. Their email system was spamming me every month and when I brought it to their attention, the lady at the front desk said "she couldn't do anything about it". I said "Well, I like the doctor but I dont want to be emailed something "random" from your office every single month and she said "the system is set up that way".  So my thoughts to this office is this.....women see their gyn once a year or once every two years and we dont need to be reminded of our visit every single month. The receptionist had the nerve to send me a letter that said "the patient is not returning to our office because she doesn't want to be bothered". Really?? I don't want to be bothered??  She would not remove my email!!! They let a patient go elsewhere because they could not fix an admin problem. It ticks me off every time I think about it.

A beautiful, world class airport with every amenity you could ever need. I am blessed to have such an outstanding facility as my home airport. I can't wait for the expansion and upgrades to be completed.

Just moved into town and was hankering for pad thai. I feel like if a Thai place can't make decent pad thai then it's not somewhere to try anything else at. Thai Basil delivered on that front... pad thai was delicious, even gave us extra peanuts in our take away. Also ordered the yellow curry and subbed in tofu, it was delicious and I'll definitely be ordering again. Tasted very fresh, my husband liked the little eggplants in the curry. The last thing we ordered were eggrolls, which I don't think they make there (possibly from frozen), weren't nearly as good as the paper-thin ones we used to get at home, I'd rate them as OK but wouldn't order them again. Didn't spend much time in the restaurant, but the girls at the register were very nice and friendly.
food always good here. my biggest complaint is the size of the place. better get there early on weekends or no seats.  but food is really good.

I have to admit, we read Yelp before we dined here and were very nervous.  We picked this as our anniversary dinner based on the Philly Mag write up and our love for anything Indian.  However, after reading Yelp and noting the head chef abruptly left and the menu was under construction we weren't looking forward to it. 

We were pleasantly surprised!  Food was great, the staff was very knowledgeable and very attentive to our needs.  Our waiter had a little fun fact about every thing we tried which made the meal more interesting for us.  He was very forward with the information that the menu was under review and they were trying things out.  We were even given a survey at the end of our meal asking what we loved/hated/would change.  I think they were aware of the latest Yelp reviews and are doing everything they can to reestablish themselves.  I give them credit for that.  Highly recommend the Sloppy Patel, Gol Gappa and the Crème Brulee for dessert.  Everything we had was delicious and we will be back!

Unfortunately, my experience at Brick & Spoon was not good. I do not like leaving negative reviews of a restaurant because I feel everyone has their weak moments, but I feel this one is necessary. We were excited to learn of B&S (on Yelp) as a possible new go to for brunch in uptown New Orleans. When we arrived at the hostess stand, no one was there to greet us. Red Flag # 1. Again, it happens, so let's give them the benefit of the doubt. When someone finally noticed us and came over, we told them we would like to sit out front. At which time, we proceeded to be seated at a table that had not been bussed and was full of other people's dirty dishes. Red Flag # 2. The hostess said she would send a busser over. We then see a busser come out and clean the table next to us. After finally realizing we were sitting at a table that had not been bussed, we got a half hearted buss job while we sat there awkwardly with our hands in our laps. The table was no cleaner than before, just less plates. Actually, the bread plates were left for us to reuse. Red Flag # 3. After sitting there for about 10 minutes with no server coming to our table, we overheard another server explaining to the table next to us that their waiter walked out on the job. Red Flag # 4. We immediately got up and walked out, instead going to the Sushi place next door.

Look, I get it. We all have bad days. But this experience made the lack of good management quite evident. The menu looks great. I would like to try some of the dishes at some point, but I think I will give this place some time to get its stuff together.

Good things about this coffee shop:

1) Right by the marina. You'd be surprised how big the marina is--enough to have boats and waves. If you're here in the wintertime, you can get a good view of the water and snow-capped mountains.
2) They serve some decent coffee drinks (read more below).
3) They serve beer!
4) It's clean with different types of seating (bar stools, long tables, patio furniture, etc.).
5) The lighting is great (lots of natural light comes in) and they play good music.
6) Awesome, fast, free wi-fi!

Bad things about this coffee shop:

1) Did not have the siphon coffee maker available at the time I visited (please put up a sign or something or just don't have it on display to tease me).
2) The worker at the cash register didn't know anything about the coffee. I am pretty coffee snobbish and I want to know the origin and flavors of what I am about to drink. I mean, what's the mission statement of this place? Just serve random coffee or are they actually passionate about the product?

I would give 4 stars, but not knowing a single thing about about the coffee makes this place an A-OK coffee shop. The only reason to go here would be for coffee of unknown origin, beer, and wi-fi!

I dined here during restaurant week with a friend. First I will talk about the taste of the food and then I will get to the offensive service. The food was good, but I have had better. The mashed potatoes were like soup. When I want to go to a Brazilian Steakhouse I usually dine at Fogo de Chao (which I highly recommend, been there about 7 times and have no compliants). Okay, the service. I don't think I have ever experienced more offesnsive service in my life. We were seated at a table and not more than 4 minutes later the table to my left was seated. Our waiters (each table has 2) went to their table and took their drink order first although they arrived after us. The servers were short with us, almost like we had done something to them in a previous life. Anyway after eating at the disappointing salad bar, the waiters did not come back to get us new plates. I had to take matters into my own hands and get them myself. I mean no big deal as I am not a lazy person however that is their job. I noticed the table to my left and right was attended to more than us. Like I said, it was almost as if we did something to them. Our table was small and I put the 2 used plates off to the side and they walked passed them and stared at them instead of removing them. The service ruined my night and we were totally offended!

Big TinRoof2 guy. Ive been here quite a bit and so far all of their food we've tried has been delicious. 

The absolute best quesadillas south of the Mason-Dixon.

5 stars, but the prices  went up 3 years ago as more tourists started coming. But the locals remain loyal. After all its open 24x7 all the food is great, and they still have great local foods. Boudan, gater, crawfish etoufe, shrimp Creole, and more.

Great burger! However, lets focus our attention on the onion rings those things will have me driving from the River Parish to Nola every day of the week. Now back to the burger (not the best I ever had, nonetheless it was tasty) I am not a fan of pickles on my burger but the house made pickles I ll take them in a jar to go..

Seating is not that spacious and I was not prepared to sit outside; thanks to my good karma seating was available at the bar.

Great fare! Great service! At The Company Burger.

Wonderfully private graduation dunner for 12. Service was extraordinary- patient, kind, thoughtful and timely. The atmosphere is peaceful and beautiful- it is like dining in Europe. The food was wonderful.

This is my new favorite Italian place! The service was attentive, my cannelloni was stellar and the sangria was super tasty!

I met up with a couple of friends at Guido's at the suggestion of a person in our party and she was spot on about this place. The server was quick with suggestions on the tapas but we weren't there for the tapas, we had all been drooling over provel-laden Hill-y goodness for about week waiting for our meet up. I had the cannelloni in white sauce and it was fantastic. It had a buttery flavor to the sauce I had not tasted in a white sauce before. The pitcher of sangria was supposed to provide 5 glasses but it easily served us 7 or 8 glasses. My friends all enjoyed their food and we sat there for quite a while catching up. The server still checked on us and did not seem to have any issue with us taking up a table.

I will definitely return! Great Job Guido's!
This place is terrific for an inexpensive breakfast / lunch / brunch.  The service is exceptional considering the place is always packed and the food is very good, sans frills.

Room is good size. All workers from the front desk, cooks, cleaning ladies are very friendly. The best part is the COOK TO ORDER breakfast. (Hint - the breakfast buffet is worth at least $20 pp, market value). 

We had room of 100-110 section. These have pool and garden view. (Hint- ask for this section). 

Great value. Very convenient next to the freeway. Only 10 mins to the beach or downtown.
Great place to go !You see them cook the food, so you know what's going into the food. Fresh ingredients- so the not so guilty feeling afterwards.

This place was fantastic. Make sure you put the "ocean sauce" on whatever you get. We loved the stuffed flounder and the escargot was amazing. Best meal we've had in NOLA.
Come early as the it's small and fills up quickly.

Stopped by and like the recent updates and menu additions.   Met some cool people and tried a couple of the new menu items.  Their grilled cheese was not your normal sandwich.  It was crisp, gooey and had some delicious pickled vegetable.  If I hadn't been sampling so many of the different beer choices might remember what it was.  I also ordered a salad.  It turned out to be a perfect blend of crisp, sharp and sweet.  I think that there was some mango in there.  Can hardly wait to go back and try some more of their new items.

Helpful Hint: The ladies locker room is VERY WARM! The spa robe makes you even warmer! Bring a beach wrap or sarong...you will be much more comfortable. Also, don't bring too much "stuff"...lockers are small and the locker room is "cozy". There is one private changing area. Other than that, don't be shy. 

Should you go?   Yes!
How to get the best value?  Get a spa pedicure for $70+...least expensive item on the spa 
                                             menu AND you get to use the facilities all day!  Get in a great work 
                                             out, eat lunch poolside...enjoy it ALL DAY!

I've visited Kraftwork twice in the past few weeks and walked away impressed each time. 

First time was during the most recent incarnation of the Craft Beer Express. The place was crowded when my friend and I got off the bus, but we managed to snag a table and settled into a few of the featured beers and an order of the pretzel bites. The service was prompt, efficient and the place was friendly - I walked away feeling that if I lived closer, this place might become my default. 

Second time was over lunch, on a Tuesday. Three of us arrived around 12:30pm and we were a little concerned at being only party there, not that should have been concerning at mid-day on a Tuesday, but after a half an hour the place got decently busy. 

Our meal, now known as "the best lunch ever", consisted of practically every appetizer on the menu as none of us could make a decision on what to eat (or rather what not to eat), which turned out to be the best decision. We ordered the pretzel bites, perogies, bratwurst, Korean BBQ tacos and fries and vigorously tucked into each plate all as soon as it arrived, only pausing to here and there to declare with mouths full of food that this was "the best lunch ever". The bratwurst and perogies were overall winners and and my only wish would be a bit more salt on the pretzel bites. Yes, we were starved, and yes, there was a certain thrill in taking a lunch away from one's desk (which we don't normally do), but combination of good food, beer selection, atmosphere and service = awesomeness.

I absolutely love their cakes.  I brought a layer cake into work for someone's birthday and everyone loved it.  They are very nicely decorated, they are absolutely delish and the price is great.  Their donuts are homemade and one of a kind.  The staff is very friendly. This place is a gem.
Went there Christmas nite man was the food bad had breakfast eggs and bacon etc. the eggs where a shade of yellow I've never seen the bacon was paper thin and not cooked

Saturday, my adult children were in town, so I searched for a place to take them to dinner in Meridian that was practicing social distancing. We all love sushi, so I looked at Kona Grill. It said right on their website that they were practicing social distancing and people were required to wear masks. Neither was true. We made reservations and the place was absolutely packed. Every table was taken. I thought distancing meant limiting people. People were walking in without masks, and our waiter had his nose uncovered until I asked him do so. You have got to be kidding me. I'm sitting here in fear of coming down with this virus.

we go to this location all the time because we love their fish deal which is 10 wings and fries for $10. I don't think you can beat a deal like that especially for the amount of food you receive, it does not include a drink though.

since we go to this location all the time we were a bit disappointed with our last visit because the guy that normally cooks was not there and when we got home to eat our food the chicken and fries weren't seasoned as much as they normally are. i'm not sure the name of the gentleman who is normally there to cook but we definitely noticed a difference in taste in the food with him being gone i'm not sure the name of the gentleman who is normally there to cook but we definitely noticed a difference in taste in the food with him being gone. we need to figure out his name and next time we call in we will ask if he is working and if he is it we probably won't order or will ask to make sure there is enough of the seasoning on the food.

I love this place! Fresh breakfast and lunches done w the best ingredients. Yes you can pay less elsewhere but not w the same quality!!!! My favorite is the lox w capers and cream cheese or how they call it.... The Ed Novellas.......on an everything bagel or have it w/o the bagel. Fresh orange juice!!!!! They are always full especially on weekends!!!!! But overall one of my favorite places to go that's fresh, real food real ingredients and great service!

I received a takeout box of grease. Order the salt  chicken wings and sweet and sour chicken.  Absolutely disgusting and I discarded $23 worth of food after 2 bites. My search for great Chinese food continues.

Disappointed in myself for not getting to Amelia's sooner! Just to think about all of the wonderful bread I've been missing out on is a sad thing! This place is dangerously close to all of my guilty pleasures in Fountain Square and I'm excited I've found yet another place to indulge my love of carbs. I got several treats including two of their oat cookies and a Kouigns Amann roll (like a yeast roll and croissant had a baby) and it only set me back $15. They also have a Tinker Coffee self serve station with sugar cubes. I will definitely be a regular here!

Great place for a quick bite. Awesome chocolate egg cream.

I usually get the Caesar salad with a grilled crab cake. Eat and on my way! 

Good service, usually pretty quick.

The first time I went there they gave my bowl to someone else because it looked similar. I was given a new bowl and a punched out card for a free meal next time, which was good customer service. I decided to go back and try it again, and this time they screwed up my and my coworkers order by mixing the orders together. The girl at the front had repeated our orders back to us and they were correct so the kitchen area is where it went wrong. When the guy brought it out we told him they'd been mixed up and he acted like there was nothing wrong with it. Then he finally offered to bring us side dishes of what was missing and he didn't bring it out until we were almost finished with our meals. The food itself is good, but the service needs a lot of work.

Hilton is my go to brand.  Good quality without costing a fortune.  The HGI is medium price and has became my first choice of hotels.  
The HGI at this location definitely met our needs.  The entire staff was very welcoming and helpful for our long weekend visit.  Rooms were kept clean and I really enjoyed chatting with the upstairs staff.  Lobby was a great place to meet or wait for friends.  Very comfy but attractive.  
The layout of my room was functional excepting for lighting.  I've yet to have what I call good lighting in a hotel though.  My mattress may have been on it's last leg but not too much of an issue since you're only there for a few nights. Temp controls were easy to use.  The free internet was easy to connect to and was fairly reliable.
Banquet staff was very accommodating.  I would highly recommend having a small event at their facility.  
Location to all things touristy was great, you couldn't ask for better.
Hoping to eat there the past few days but it appears to be closed.
Great neighborhood bar! Such a friendly place with great prices and plenty of live shows. We saw Kermit there on a random Monday night!

This is my new favorite restaurant in Reno. Everything is organic and vegan except for the yogurt sauce which they have a vegan option for. I have had Indian food from so many different places and this was by far the best I've ever had. Everything is fresh and you can taste all of the herbs and spices. Sometimes Indian food can be overly greasy but that is not the case here at all. Also, everyone who works here is extremely friendly and awesome. Will definitely be coming back soon!

This place has so much potential, but it misses the mark almost every single time. Today was the final straw for me. Ordered a vanilla 16 oz. latte and was charged $7.67. REALLY? The listed prices  here are steep and I'm fine paying it, but that's not what's listed on the menu. Also, you should probably list the menu next to the register for reference. Price inconsistency is a constant issue with this place. You will be charged a different price every visit even though you order the same thing. When I brought it up with to cashier she started going back and forth with me about the price.  I left saying it doesn't even matter, but I certainly will not be returning (no matter how convenient). A 16oz vanilla latte from Goat House is not worth over $2 more than a 20 oz from any other establishment. Disappointing.

I came here for brunch after Broadstreet run... so I was ready to devour 1000 calories and get tipsy off a beer. 

I ordered the appetizer baked mac n cheese which was delicious and definitely entree worthy of a size. Despite being hungry, I couldn't finish the whole thing. And it was $7! My friends got the burgers which they said were food. Brunch cocktails are only $4 and options include an array of bloody marys, mimosas, beer-itas, and more! 

The vibe was pretty whatever. Service was good. Casual (you can just wear yoga pants) and other groups of close friends. 

I've come here on a Thursday night also and it was fun! Music, drinks, plenty of space for a big group.
Meh. Yeah it's a diner, but they could put a bit more effort in across the board.

Do not stay here. Poorly ran. 
Stains on the bedding. Roaches in the towels (not kidding). Dirty. Smelled horrible (desk clerk offered to spray orange scent in our room). Previous room guest belongings were left in room.
The Mexican potatoes? Yes, please! My husband and I get the burrito azteca for carryout quite frequently. The habanero chicken is not as hot as you would think.

No menu listed. Staff no help when asked about what they sell "sandwiches and stuff" is an abysmal answer for a first time customer. How can you run a restaurant with no menu? I don't care how long the place has been on business if you don't change with the times you get left in the dust. 0/10 would not do again.

Really exceptional Mediterranean cuisine. This is a favorite late lunch stop for me. My staple is the Gyro sandwich and a cup of lentil soup, but everything on the menu is delicious. 

There are two locations, State St. being the first. The restaurant is owned by a lovely local family, all of whom are clearly proud of the food they serve. 

Enjoy it folks. this is small business USA at its finest.

worst delivery service possible i live maybe 10 minutes away max and it takes over an hour for delivery any night  of the week pizza is always cold im done with papa johns when i lived near the one on marsh road service/food was always as advertised very disappointed with this place

Loved it!  Recommend the brisket it was to die for.  They came out first with this cheese spread on saltines that was so tasty.  The brisket fries were also good.  French fries covered in cheese and brisket, you can't get much better than that.  We also had the beef tongue with some sort of jelly.  I usually am not a big tongue eater but man it was good.  I also got the jalapeño cheddar cornbread which was also tasty.

Burnt ends and coleslaw!!!!!! We had chicken too which was smoky and juicy. Beans pretty good, pass on potato salad as it had only potatoes
 and mayo. Fast delivery thru Uber eats made this weary traveller happy! Best burnt ends i had in years!! Sweet tangy homemade slaw:)

I have never waited so long for take out in my life!  We walked in a placed our order, an hour and a half later it was finished!  They weren't very busy either, only 4 or 5 more people walked in when we were there.

The food is average chinese take out, nothing spectacular and DEFINATELY not worth the wait.

Makes haddonfield downtown square a destination. Great water ice. They also have good soft serve and Bassett ice cream. Indoor seating (never have walked inside) and window service. Sit down in the square and enjoy.

ABSOLUTELY worth the wait! 

We moved to St Pete nearly 18 months ago and were told this was THE place for Mexican. Unfortunately, each time we stopped by there was almost an hour wait.

Last night we headed​ over just before​ 5 PM​, midweek​, after spring break and go in after only a few minutes. 

Not only do they have excellent Mexican food and really strong drinks, but there are about five tables on the patio, four tables (4+ seats) inside and about six hightops across from the bar.

If you come in the front door be prepared to be sent through the kitchen to the hostess on the back patio for seating.

My husband arrived first and was offered a hightop table for two, and we jumped at the offer. You are taken through the kitchen, into the bar area. 

He ordered us two Margaritas with salt ($5.00) we got two big coupe style glasses with a delicious, VERY STRONG margaritas. 

We told the server we needed a few minutes and she offered to answer any questions. We started with ​basic Chips and Salsa ($2.95) and received​ a good portion of thick, chunky, fresh salsa and a basket of corn tortilla chips. The salsa was delicious, fresh and flavorful with a little bite.

We both went with the Wet Burrito ($8.95) with chicken they are known for and added the rice and beans to make it a platter ($2.00).

Shortly, they brought out to large, hot platters with a nice size burrito smothered in red sauce and melted cheese, a side of refried beans and rice with a small mound of shredded lettuce, diced tomato, black olive and a cup of sour cream.

Everything was well seasoned, and the burrito was moist and delicious. The biggest surprise was the incredible amount of shredded white meat chicken in the burrito. WOW!

We tried their jalapeno and cilantro sauce with these, and our server mentioned they have something​ hotter if we'd like. We both love spicy food and are no wimps, but this tiny cup of spicy hot sauce was SMOKIN.

The server was friendly and attentive, the place is loud and hectic, the wait can be long, ​but the food and the drinks are worth the wait.

If they offer you a seat at the bar TAKE IT!

Pedicure was REALLY good. Nails, not as much. I got a refill and it was so lumpy and bad. I was so shocked because the reviews and pictures on Yelp were so nice! Maybe because the pictures were uploaded by the same one person. Debating if I should go back and try a different person or just completely avoid.

I purchased a Spending Spree certificate and was excited to try this new place.  I checked out the menu and was thrilled to find out that a Franklin pizza joint was open til 1 am!  They have happy hour and specials every day, in addition to the late night happy hour, which is 2 4 1 pizza after 10!  Additionally, they offer vegan cheese at no extra charge, which was great news for my vegan sister.  We went there on a Friday night and had an overall good experience.  The atmosphere is incredible with live music, an expansive bar, and great lighting.  We ordered the Brixx stixx for an appetizer.  They were rather bland, so we won't be ordering those again.  For dinner, we ordered the greek pizza and the barbecue  chicken pizza.  Both pizzas were delicious, not the best wood fired I've had, but good nonetheless.  Plus the prices were just right, all pizzas under $11.  I think that next time we will hit up the late night happy hour to sample some of their other creations.

The bop was ok but I'm not running back. I had pork Bibimbop. The pork was a little stringy and not much flavor. My wife had the chicken Bibimbop and hers did not have much flavor either. Wait staff and hostess are inexperienced. Hostess sat us near the door because she said they were booked. During our whole meal there were plenty of other tables open. She made no effort to accommodate us.
I'm from philly and this is an absolute MUST do. My husband and I went one year, late on Christmas Eve and it was magical. we always feel like kids when we go.

I came here for New Years and the place was busy but lucky we made a reservation and got seated pretty quick. There didn't offer the all you can eat since it was a holiday so I got the meat lover combo which comes with some appetizers, five or six meat dishes and s'mores for dessert. The amount of food shared between two people was pretty decent. I love the fried chicken, the meat platter and the miso soup. We also order additional meat and appetizer. Everything was decent and I would love to come back to get the all you can eat options.

The service was pretty good and the food came out at a reasonable pace. I would recommend this place to people to try if they love meat and Japanese food.
Amazing amazing amazing!!! Service and food were killer. Feels mom and pops with chef run precision.

We bout a Groupon for a pass here, I brought my son for their open bounce time and was disappointed that we were on ONLY ones there. The bounce equipment seems more for the older kids. I wouldn't suggest taking a toddler here. Even though it states of their website that this is toddler friendly place. My no fear having 2 year old was scared to slide down the very large slide. That could also be due to fact that no one else was there at the time. 

They have tons of play space and I can't wait to come back with friends. The staff were all super nice, and opened up additional play space even though we were the only ones around.
Wonderful experience all around! Atmosphere, food, service...all excellent. Can't wait to go back and celebrate special occasions there. And eat more mile high pie :)

Nancy r took care of my two cavaliers and it was such a positive experience. They didn't spend all day in cages with other dogs and all stressed out!  When finished, they were happy CLEAN dogs!  Nancy R is fantastic with them!  Be sure to ask for her!

We were at this on Sunday late afternoon. From the start, the service was very bad. After ordering, we waited for 15 minutes to get food. Wings were overcooked and dry. Will NEVER return to this horribly managed place.

Ok. Let me start by saying I'm not a usual fan of chain BBQ, I own a hardcore smoker and do it as a hobby. Out of all the places in Tampa, I think Jazzy's is second best to First Choice in Brandon (and it's a very close call). 
WHAT YOU WILL GET: Awesome BBQ. Try the sides too (greens are awesome). One thing that nobody mentioned is the beef. They don't have brisket, but whatever chopped beef they are using is the style I like and tastes AMAZING (I tend to think brisket is overrated anyway and most of the times dry in every place I had it)
WHAT YOU WILL NOT GET: Atmosphere. You are there for the BBQ and good food. Don't expect nice plates, lots of light or an ocean view.

Other than that, this is one of the best kept secrets in Tampa. If you are there for the food, you can't go wrong with Jazzy's. Try it.

And no, I'm not associated with them by any means (look at my profile pic...)

It's good to have a Walmart in the east but it sucks that it closes At 10 we can't even get midnight! It's a typical Walmart, not as ghetto as tchop location but it has its moments. I sometimes just drive to the chalmette location...
Very professional providing Excellent service, will go the extra mile for their client. My only trusted and very dependable account!
Awesome place. Great facility with a ton of different bats and well working machines. The owner is a sweetheart small business owner, will def be returning!

#ThankYouThursday2021 Once again Kelly was bright and friendly taking my order, and my two friends' orders, and ringing us up. She starts the positivity here. Then the marvelous kitchen staff expedites our orders - always delicious. 

We usually sit and talk for awhile after we eat. Chase came by today and took our dirty dishes for us - always with a smile. Thank you, Chase! 

We don't use the internet, but when we do, we're happy it's free. We check facts or look up books and movies for future reference. This is our favorite Panera - always clean, with efficient, friendly staff!

This coffee place is super duper cool. Like, maybe Greenwood is cooler than you ever imagined it could be type cool. 

They did an amazing job with the remodel of the old  Jonathan Byrd's cafeteria, and as a big bonus, some of their dishes still have meat cooked by Jonathan Byrd's. If you are like me, (and the rest of the senior community), then you frequented Jonathan Byrd's often enough to know they have some absolutely delicious food. 

I just got the coffee, and it was very good solid coffee. I would say the coffee itself was so bold that it did not pair well with the Carmel syrup shots I got in it. 

Let's all move past the immense amounts of judgment all of you coffee purists out there are leveling at me right now. I'm agreeing with you for the moment. This coffee would have been amazing dark. 

I want to come back and sample the food, and potentially upgrade one more star. They lost one because my two companions both did not enjoy their drinks. One ordered a hot chocolate and said it tasted nothing like a hot chocolate and was terrible (the server who gave it to us announced it as a mocha con leche....and he wasn't Latino..... and my other friend who ordered a latte also was unimpressed. 

Cannot wait to go back, try them again, and upgrade this review!

I love everything I eat here! It's always so fresh and delicious!  They were so busy slicing those fresh ingredients that they forgot to add the avocado!  At first I was bummed but after eating my whole BLT and a yummy crunchy pickle and then licking my fingers, I realized I didn't much care! I already look forward to my next meal from McAlister's Deli!

Headed to this little quaint place just because i was in the neighborhood but ended up being pleasantly surprised. Didnt know much about it and when i walked in, it was small and cozy. Made me feel i was in a busy downtown, including seating by the windows to people watch. The menu is printed and up on a blackboard. They offer everything from breakfast to booze :) Local offerings and in house specialties. You must try the home made Maple Scones!! Absolutely wonderful! 
The service was very pleasant, but when it gets busy, its so busy that sometimes the wait is unbearable. Make sure to check it out the first time during down hours. The only reason it only got 3 stars was because of the poor service when it got busy. The staff was so overwhelmed that some people got ignored. The prices are reasonable for locally made awesomeness but wont break the bank for the portion sizes you get. 
Ive also been told to try the fish tacos, although I went with the quesadilla (yum!)

All in all, head up a little farther north on 4th ave than you are used to and check this little place out!

Faves: maple scones
Their everything bagels have sea salt on them, a bit on the saltier side but still tastes great. Bagels are so fresh that we take them home and don't even need to toast them!

This place is fantastic.  I just love the Row.  What a awesome experiences. The People at La Strada are top notch. Great people and feel really at home every time we dine here.  Their food is second to none.  Incredible mushroom ravioli! The management is incredible.  My choice to always go to when we go out.  The Ownership and Administration of the Row is the BEST!! I travel all over the world and this is in my Top places to BE and Dine

The staff present for my first game were amazing and we had a blast.  My complaint is with the woman who answers the phone to book an experience.  Twice now, she has been so rude that we chose not to go.  The first was for a business retreat for 11 and the second involved a groupon.  On the second, I didn't read the fine print that it wasn't available on Saturdays.  She informed me that was the case and when I asked for an exception, she muttered something under her breath.  She wouldn't repeat it.  I am very sorry to have put her out, but her response was awful customer service.  She easily could have said, I am so sorry, but I can't.  Anyway, if you can book online, you can avoid her, but I wouldn't give her a call.

I've had a lot of bad luck with phones, and anytime I've had to come in to get one fixed the staff here is beyond helpful. They're always friendly, and they all seem to love working here. And they check my plan to see if they can offer a better deal to save me money. I've had tmobile since 1997 - when they were called Omnipoint I think, and I've never wanted to switch carriers. Big shout out to all the staff at this location- it's rare these days to find such excellent customer service!

This is my last review before I vow to never post without having a few pics to share as well. I've been to this place a few times. I enjoy the street side, but also the back bar area. The wait staff is super friendly and accommodating! We stopped in on a Sunday morning and they didn't have the typical bar food menu, but rather a brunch-esque menu. They had a breakfast burrito and were more than happy to omit the meat for me. It was bustling, but not crowded and there were a few groups that you could tell went there for the mimosas and bloody mary bar. 

Younger, millenial crowd at times, but they didn't care that this mid-life crisis lady wanted a seat at the bar for a bite and a beer.

I really don't understand why there are so many bad reviews. I guess they are from people that don't now the taste of the puerto rican food. I'm literally leaving the restaurant right now and our food was great!!!! I definitely will be coming back. Don't let these bad reviews keep you from giving it a try. The only thing that I noticed is that the servers were a little inexperienced but the lady that attended us what doing her best to keep us happy and she did well.

I have had nothing but bizarre experiences at Amy's.   I got lured in to going by the complementary happy hour cocktail special they have and the reasonable (for this area) pedicure price, but the experience is always so awkward.  The employees don't seem too thrilled about working there.  I've had several conversations with the techs during manicures about how the hours "are too long" or how they don't like working on Sundays.  I divulged that I have an internship in a hospital during small talk once, and my tech asked me if I could help her get insurance because she was diabetic and her husband was old. I felt really uncomfortable, especially when she told me over and over "don't forget me, don't forget to come back!"  Additionally, in my experience, it *hurts* when they do acrylics (full set and refills).  I have had several techs do this for me, and each time I told them it was burning, they laughed and told me I had weak nails.

I wanted so badly for Amy's to be my go-to nail place, but it just isn't for me!

This is one of the worst experiences with online ordering that Ive ever had. I will NEVER do business with them again. After ordering a glass tube that cost a little under $200 they held my money for over a month giving me multiple excuses as to why my order wasnt arriving;shipment delayed, items arrived broken, etc. Finally after a month and a half they just gave me my money back. I still dont have the item that I ordered, so I now have to start from scratch ordering something that Ive desperately needed for over a month. Not having this item cost me money and in the end I have nothing to show for the hassle. Do not do business with them!

I enjoyed their pastries but the customer service was horrible! They took forever to ask if I needed help when there were 3 people just on their phones. There were clearly customers waiting and when it came my turn, the girl acted as though I did not exist. When I finally got my order she did not even hand me my bag but just left it to the side and walked away. I would never go back, the food was not that great to overlook how rude the workers are.
This hotel has just been remodeled and is beautiful. Last week I stayed at another hotel close by and it was dirty but not here. Everyone is so nice and the room is very clean.

I had the chicken potstickers and egg roll appetizers. I've never had potstickers as delicious as these. Our service was amazing! We were celebrating with friends who are members of the Wine Club. Our sweet waitress brought us complimentary chocolates for the celebration. The atmosphere was relaxing and a great place to have dinner with friends or alone.

In love. Obsessed. Cannot wait to go back! The entire experience was just so damn lovely. The setting in the greenhouse. All of the rustic details. The garden. The shopping! Oh my! 

First let's start with the food. Fresh bread in a little terra-cotta pot. So cute! My girls split the Kennet Square Mushroom soup, grilled cheese and fruit salad. I ordered the portobello burger which I took of the bun because it was so huge and it was Passover. It came with a massive amount of fries. We all had leftovers. I did get a nice almond milk latte for dessert though in one of their neat flavors. They serve everything on either slates of wood or wood chargers and they are beautifully presented. 

The store! Omg. So many amazing things to look at. Not cheap but what in Urban or Athro is. Worry it though. I loved and wanted everything. Carefully planning a shopping list for next visit. 

Every detail of the entire place was amazing. Farmhouse-ish. Very cool. Very neat. A must visit. We made a whole day of it and did Linvilla Orchards too. You could combine Longwood Gardens and Terrain also.

We come every season to see what's new. A visual treat for sure. A little pricey but some true gems. The last time we ate in the cafe it was fall and I had the stuffed acorn squash. It was amazing! This place is not to be missed. Definitely worth the drive!!

Stephanie sure didn't care about her job this morning taking orders at the register. Had she repeated my order back, she would of been able to confirm that i ordered a chicken egg n cheese biscuit not bacon. Thanks for that face. Definitely not a face of chickfila to be standing at the front.

I came in for the $10 bag deal and I was able to find Nike shoes, two crop top sweaters and a printed blazer. 
I always like to stop through here when I have the chance. I'm not always lucky in finding things but it's a cute and fun place to shop!

**Be aware: This Ted Drewes location is only open during the summer months (not sure which ones these are) from 11 am onward!**
I made the mistake on my St. Louis visit by driving by and seeing the mini building all boarded up.  They also don't accept credit cards at this location...

Ted Drewes is definitely a St. Louisian cultural landmark that you can't admit you have never been to when in St. Louis.  Picture it as a "When in St. Louis" kinda thing.  This is the reason I had no choice but to check it out...   Darn it!  I began with the location closest to me and not the other Chippewa one.  ((Again, if it's winter, just go straight to the other one in St. Louis Hills.))

Now for the truth...I personally prefer my basic Culvers or Kopps custard.  It must be because I'm originally from the Illinois-Wisconsin border.

My big confusion is, "Why are there so many famous ice cream or the "fancier, smoother" sister custard joints across the Midwest??"  After all, it's only warm for 7 months of the 12...at most!

Well even though it's edging onto the end of winter, I was finally able to visit the Route 66 St. Louis landmark Ted Drewes on Chippewa.  Once you make up your mind on which ice cream concoction you want, you'll get asked whether you want it as a sundae or "concrete."  The latter is basically a blizzard that goes by another name.  I had the Terramizzou concrete (pronounced like the Italian delicacy tiramisu)  that is a secret blend of chocolate and pistachio nuts.  Too many nuts for me, but it was definitely delicious and didn't give me an upset stomach after chowing down.  Also the portions are definitely larger than they look, so you have been forewarned!

We decided to finally order from Big Sky during the stay at home order. I wish we had done so a month ago.! The food was amazing and the pick up at curbside worked flawlessly. 

We started with crab cakes and they were light, fluffy with just the amount of a spicy cream sauce. We each ordered spinach salads with nice portions of pine nits, goat cheese and dried cherries or cranberries. They were fresh and generous proportions. Next we ordered roasted Cauliflower and roasted Brussel Sprouts with little pieces of smoked bacon mixed in them. Both dishes were very tasty and were crispy on the outer layer but still moist. We also ordered the macaroni and cheese and the cioppino.  The macaroni was great and seemed to have smoked pieces of bacon mixed throughout and lightly toasted panko on top. The cioppino had a generous assortment of shrimp, white fish, mussels and a tomato broth. It is one of my favorite dishes. 

We finished with a family order of the smoked NOLA shrimp and gouda polenta and they were fabulous. They  compete with New Orleans finest. Last we each had a carrot cake bite that was given by the restaurant to us. They were a nice surprise. 

The dinner was the best that we have had in the pandemic and I highly recommend Big Sky! Great job Big Sky!
Amazing! Moved here from NYC and was craving authentic Italian. This is the best pizza and pasta I've found in Nashville thus far. I would say it's even better than most nyc spots!
I love this place. I come here almost every day after class to study. Phenomenal coffee, mimosas, food, and atmosphere. Service is great!
Love having lunch at Sushi Maki. The sushi is so good love the atmosphere. My new favorite place

I just had my first appointment here a week ago (I got the Brazilian), and I am in love. The location, the atmosphere, and my sugaring babe! She was so fast but also very attentive to detail and a beautiful soul too. I used to go to another sugaring place, but they seemed to be having difficulty retaining employees. I'm glad I decided to try here, which is closer to where I live anyways. They have my business for as long as they want! :D

Had to take my car in and get repair. and the shop had to keep it few days. And had to get rentel car. Thanks to holly at Enterprise for hooking me up on a good deal. for vehicle, had many to choose from. As I'm a toyota guy.. Went with the camry.. When I returned the vehicle. I needed a drive to the shop. And got a drive there. Overall. Was a great experience. And would definitely come back again.

My favorite Indy location. B-Dubs has amazing wings. This location is big and open, with projection screens everywhere. The service is always friendly, which cannot be said about some of the other locations. It is a great place to watch a game, and hang out with your family too.

I think this place was alright. They do have a variety of different crepes but the crepe lack a certain flavor. We had the fruit one and it lack something. If only the hazelnut chocolate is in there, it would complete the taste. My breakfast crepe had ham, eggs, basil, and pepper. If there is a sauce, it would be delicious. Instead, I mixed ketchup and Tabasco to  give it some flavor. :D

One thing for sure this place has down is its crepes skin. The skin is perfect, not chewy like some other place. Nice and crispy.

Awesome lunch spot and great food. Some of the best sandwiches and box lunches you can get in Nashville. The quality of food at Provence makes Panera Bread look like nasty left-overs. The turkey sandwich is spectacular and honestly, the best turkey sandwich I've ever had in my life. Everything is just superb and full of flavor.

I met a few friends here for a bite to eat and a drink last night. The concept is a bit strange- you order your food at the counter and they bring it to your table. Then you hop over to the bar, order a drink, and take it with you. When you have a large group,this is actually a good idea; no splitting of tabs (though you can run one if you wish), no tips. The bartender was very friendly. The food and drink are a maybe a hair pricey, my wine was $9 and my very small flatbread about $10. The flatbread was excellent, however. It has a rustic, homey feel with country artwork and wooden tables. On a weeknight, the place was full but not packed. It was a bit awkward when "last call" came at about 9, and by 9:20 they were pretty much kicking us out with the bright lights and good-nights. Not a place to linger. I'd go back.

Excellent Greek food! A busy place in the evening with great food, wines from Greece and great service. We arrived around 8pm and there were still people coming in around 10pm. A lively crowd.

We tried some dishes I've never eaten before: fiddleheads as well as fava beans cooked in their pods. We also had tzatziki, meletzanosalata, spanokopita, a village salad and a grilled whole fish.

We'll stop by again the next time we're in town.

This restaurant is clean, great food, clean restroom, and great service. Ask for Grayson; he is the best and very knowledgeable. The fried green tomatoes come with a sauce that you can ask for more of (because it's so delicious) and the salmon fell apart so easily with the slightest pressure of a fork. The vegetables served as a side are delicious. The jambalaya is life changing, and the specialty drinks are different in a good way. There is a ginger-bourbon drink that's tastes 100%, and an extremely Spicy-hot martini that's great to try if you have the tongue for it. We will definitely make reservations when we come back to this place. It's expensive, but worth it.

I will never forget when I put 3 birthday cards (containing gift cards) in the Haddonfield drop box WITHOUT POSTAGE.  I didn't realize it until 3a.  I woke up and my heart started pounding.  Then I called the post office and they didn't answer of course.  But at 8:30a, a kind postal worker man answered and listened patiently to what I had done.  He retrieved the letters and said he would put them aside until I arrived with stamps.  Who does that?  I love this post office.  Also, I mailed a letter to Cinnaminson on a Sunday night and my mom got it the very next day.  Plus I got my passport photo ID picture taken here and the postal man said we would keep taking it until it looked good.  For real?  It took 3 tries and it was the best damn photo ever.

First off let me say used car sales you go in expecting to have an awful experience. I can't tell you how pleasantly surprised to be wrong about that at Gordon Chevrolet.I came in looking for two vehicles with a knowledgeable staff and I only ended up purchasing one vehicle not based on Gordon Chevrolet but based on that's all I needed at the time. My sales rep Hal was "no pressure"!!! And I mean that he' never pushed the issue in a bad way ever and it made me come back and buy a vehicle from him because of it. The finance department was amazing they help me find the best loan at the best rate, the people there are fantastic I will definitely buy another vehicle when I'm in the market from Gordon Chevrolet!!!

Went here to look for a vehicle, drove around to check out different ones, got out and looked at the specifics on a few. When no one came to talk to us, we went inside to see if there was anyone available. Waited in the front lobby for 10 minutes and no one bothered even noticing us. Two guys were too busy looking at videos to even realize we were there. I knew they were looking at videos because I could hear their excited commentary. Obviously, not excited to make a deal, and they don't appear to be hurting for business, so they don't need ours.

If I could give 0 stars, I would! This dominos has messed up my order FOUR TIMES IN A ROW. They never give sauces unless you ask for them EVEN WHEN YOUVE ALREADY PAID FOR THEM (four times in a row now) today I had to make 3 trips to the store... I have spoken up every time about this and they give me attitude and completely disregard. I typically tip 30% because I work in the food industry and understand the struggle but I'm tired of giving so many chances and spending  so much $ on a messed up order. I spend $50-$70 every time I come  before tip and NEVER get everything. I get delivery about 50% of the time and don't even have the choice of having a different dominos store deliver! I would seriously consider moving so I could have a different dominos store, hahah this is so ridiculous that this is such a constant issue.. Contacting corporate I suppose because my already spent $ is not completely accounted for.. but honestly I don't even care for the $20+ in missing things at this point, I just want to see an improvement in work ethic and store quality.

I requested a tune up and checking the suspension online. Came in and explained motor sounds like it's running harder, and the sounds the wheels make over bumps. They told me my oil was "very dirty" and recommended an oil change. I changed it a month ago. They were adamant that not having a sticker in my window meant something. I took off the sticker after my last oil change a few weeks prior. They charged me $150 for throttle body cleaning and rear brake cleaning and adjusting. My car still made the sounds over speed bumps. I went back and took a ride with the mechanic. He was a more aggressive driver than I. He assured me there were no issues and the squeaks were probably the rubber the suspension spring sits in becoming more brittle due to the changing season. He informed me to remind him during the next oil change so he would spray everything down to try to mitigate anything before winter. My car seat cushion (just a walmart thing I bought) was cut so the cushion's internal sticky gel got over my seat cover. My car runs no different.

--
About a week later, I had time to check my oil. It's nice and clear yellow. Now I know why they were pushing hard for that oil up-sell, if I didn't take it then I would know they were lying. Unfortunately for them, I didn't take it and can confirm they were lying. I looked up what a throttle body cleaning was, and read online how it is just an upcharge. Youtube shows how simple it is. I now question the integrity of the business, and do not trust them for future work.

A $150 mistake from me, but now I know not to go back.
--

Google Reviews says Dom Balducci is no longer owner of the shop. Maybe that could explain the disparity in experience.

Best experience I've ever had in any kind of class I've ever taken before! I came here for a bachelorette party and the instructor was so fun and definitely patient and supportive with us. Everyone at the party had the time of their lives! I would definitely come back in a heartbeat!

This hotel way exceeded my expectation. For $135 per night during memorial weekend, I got a two-bedroom, two-bathroom, with a full kitchen! The most spacious hotel room I've ever had, great for family trip. Their hot breakfast is also good. 

Few complaints:
(1) Their parking space is a problem. For my pool view room, I had to park a bit far to walk to my room.
(2) They don't have elevators.

Other than that, I definitely recommend this place to anyone, especially for family trips.

Great breakfast menu, generous portions, friendly service. I ordered the egg white frittata with hash browns and wheat toast and it was excellent. 
I had tea with my my breakfast but the bloody Mary's & bottomless mimosas looked amazing !

Very rarely do I give a 5 star - it has to knock your socks off and Stella Mares always does!  Have eaten there about a dozen times over the last 9 years and it is our first place choice for a special dinner out - even though it is an hour and a half drive from home.  The food is always seasoned and served with special care.  The flavors are a party for your mouth.  I had a signature cocktail - a lavender limonade - which was excellent.  My husband and I both chose a filet mignon but each was prepared differently, but both were excellent!  We will always go back!  I will say - I have not been wowed the two times I went for lunch.  I think they are at their best for dinner.

I needed to get my groomed quickly and was becoming less impressed with our usual groomer. I walked past this salon at La Cumbre and decided to give it a try. Shiva was so sweet and easy to work with. I have a small, white papillon/Maltese mix dog. She did an amazing job washing and grooming him! He looked amazing and came out happy (usually he's more timid after the groomer). I'm so happy I found this place and will continue coming back. He even had a little bandana on!

Wow! This meal was still steaming when we got it delivered. The flavors of each dish are incredible and you'll want to get yourself a side of chili oil to put on...like everything.  The fried rice was perfect, not too heavy or greasy. Honestly my only complaint is that I didn't order more food because it was that good.

I have been coming to this location and seeing Kayleigh for about 5 years. I thought I was going to die when she went on maternity leave. But she kindly reconvened whom to see in her absence. Seriously she does my Brazilian in about 10 minutes. She is fast, efficient and super fun. Go see her.

We were on vacation visiting grandparents in Indiana when we heard of SkyPark. It is a great facility to take your kid here to wear them OUT. Every second my daughter spent here was pure joy and all the staff were very kind and helpful in suggesting what we do for my daughter for her age group. We would love to come back next time we're in town! Overall, a really great place for kids and families to spend an afternoon.

The food was cold and not worth the money. I was told the cost was $20.32. Checked my credit card online and they rounded up to the next dollar amount. $21.00. Then a couple of days later they added an additional $3.00 for a total of $24.00. I called to complain but the manager never called me back. DON'T EVER EAT HERE!!!! THEY ARE CROOKS!!!!!!!!!
The food was good but my order was wrong. The tots was a super small order and the burger was small. For the price I expected a little better service.

Absolutely the BEST Dentist EVER.  I can even say, FUN! 

Dr. Milne is patient. She answered all of my many questions very thoroughly. She really cares about her patients. After my exam, Dr. Milne was incredibly reassuring while she explained everything she was thinking, and in simple terms! She gave me all of my options, the pros and cons of each.  I never felt like she was pushing any unnecessary treatments (which has definitely happened to me at other dentists). 

For someone like me with complicated & serious health issues, she and her staff have made it super easy and less painful. More than anything else, they made me feel like family, which made it comfortable for me to return as often as necessary for maintenance.

They did an AWESOME job with my crown. Before Dr. Milne permanently cemented it in, she asked me if I liked the color; I thought it looked good. However, she wasn't happy with how it matched my other teeth and asked me if I was okay with having the temporary crown on for another week in order to have the lab fix the color.  She ended up fixing the color for me and I LOVE IT.
  
All of the team is great and friendly. They are super conscientious, respectful and professional. I can say that I actually look forward to going to the dentist because of them. I feel very fortunate to have found this practice.  I am planning on being with this practice for a very long time.  :D

One other note: Very fair price. They were very transparent about pricing and insurance. I was given a detailed treatment plan with prices before having any work done. I had several issues that needed to be addressed and we tackled them together, one at time, the most urgent first.

I would highly recommend Inspiration Dental!

We had a great time! My boyfriend and I had the garlic chicken and angel hair pomodoro. Both were very good. The service was great. When our waiter got busy the manager and the bartender came out to the patio to make sure we were good. Food came out quickly, hot, and delicious. Overall a great experience.

OK.  Somebody explain this to me.  Why are all those people lined up across the street in 45 degree weather when over here on this side is Felix's? The cocktails here were perfectly prepared, the raw oysters were superb. The grilled oysters were perfectly prepare and absolutely delicious. The fried shrimp and oysters were as good as fried seafood gets.  And they substituted onion rings, which are done as onion rings ought to be done (thin and crispy) for French fries at no extra cost. We will be back every trip.  This has become our go to place for grilled oysters and fried seafood in NOLA.

A friend and I visited Tree House while visiting St. Louis and loved it so much that we came back the next day.  As a Chicago native, I'm fairly spoiled when it comes to vegetarian dining options but Tree House ranks up there with anywhere that Chicago has to offer.  We didn't have to worry about waiting to be seated, but the dining area was pretty full, so if you are on a tight timeline, be sure to make a reservation.

The menu offers a wide variety of selections and I ended up ordering the Korean Bibimbop bowl which was incredible and comes highly recommended.  The wait staff was very friendly and the interior was inviting and clean.  Check this place out whether you're vegetarian/vegan or not!

I was visiting Tampa for business and was in desperate need of a spa treatment. Per the reviews on Yelp, I decided to go here. I have no regrets.  I love the way the spa is decorated. Moreover, the services were awesome.  I was snoring so loud during my massage, I woke myself up!  If/when I return to Tampa, I will add Spa Sundara to my itinerary.

First time here for pizza. Awesome napolitana style pizza! Super fresh, natural, great tasting! Service (by Amy) was superb! Nutella desert pizza was the perfect finish. Absolutely worth going downtown for dinner. Very cool small restaurant with great ambiance, neat, clean, comfortable & cozy. We'll be back!!
Love it when I come here to do my hair.  Great job.  My  needs work and Arelis always does a great job and Ana does too.  La flaca
I went to the farmers market today. I wanted to like it. I wanted to love it. But with only four vendors, I felt sad. The vendors who were there were very nice. Hopefully, it was just an off day.

My husband and I went there on a date night. 
We tried the burrata cheese as a starter but this came with tortilla chips . 
I then had the catfish tacos and it had a moldy taste...really bad, so I could not finish it. My husband had the beef tacos ...this one was wayyyy too spicy. 
Drinks were ok. Really good beer selection! 
Good place for drinks, not for food.

It tastes like they completely ran out of salt. Breadsticks? BLAND, marinara? BLAND, the pizza? BLAND. I think the idea is very cool but the execution was not well thought out. Read a bunch of reviews on here beforehand and decided to give this place a try, was very disappointed. Staff was very nice and welcoming but the food here is just... not good.

We called to ask if we needed reservations and we were told yes, so we made them online. We arrive to a near empty restaurant.

Despite being an adult couple, we are seated between whining elementary school kids and a screaming baby. Can't control your guests but you can control where they sit. We saw the other three adults only tables get seated far away from the child circus. We clearly looked distraught and the waitress could only gurgle about how cute the kids were to us. Really? Do you not read facial expressions at all?

The mozzarella-tomato salad and the chicken parm were the highlights of the night. I ordered the duck and it was cold after two bites. Unfortunately the server checked in after the first bite and nver came back despite attempts to flag her down in the near empty establishment. Sucked for me because that duck only had two decently cooked slices. The fat hadn't been rendered and the duck was so chewy I couldn't swallow it. I finally got the server's attention and in that sickly sweet fake facade she told me that this is the way the duck was supposed to be prepared. Even after gesturing to the covered mound of chewed and discarded duck pieces (I tried all of them, to no avail) I got nary an apology. I didn't make a bigger scene because the boyfriend had picked the spot and already felt bad... no need to make it worse.

Next time... if there is one... we will do take out and won't pay for the duck.

I love 1864 Tavern! Gabe always is juicing me some awesome Carson (a juice blend with carrot, apple, ginger, and some other goodness).  They have some great specialty drinks as well.  The trivia night on Wednesdays are my favorite, although we always seem to loose.

This place never disappoints. Hands down the best egg rolls I have ever had. The general tso is incredible. The only reason I gave them 4/5 stars is because they don't deliver. Absolutely worth the drive though. 100% recommend!

Had the Crab & Bacon Dip, this dish is outstanding! I can't say enough this was our second time at the Red Dog and we came back just for the dip. Our waitress was a little off her game that Day. It was a Sunday Morning so I think it was a little too much Bourbon Street for her. 

Cool atmosphere! If you find yourself in NOLA go to Magazine St. and check this place out. You will enjoy it.
The appetizers were great. Buffalo chicken bites. The salad left a bit to be desired. Service was excellent even if the food was sub par for the price

I love Wawa. But not this one. It's dirty, it's dirty it's dirty! The staff are silly and immature. The place is also too small. The only reason I go in here is for the ATM. YUCK Going to the one in glenside

Ok.  Been here a couple of times as I live in Biloxi, ms area.  I always stop by the Louisiana visitors center, as I did a few weeks ago.  this restaurant has had for years now a card for Buy one entree get one free.   I got  a few cards there like I mentioned and have talked this place up.

So looked again at other cards at the visitor center, like you see in hotel in the French quarter, and there were no more cards.  Guy there said they stopped the promotion.

NEVER HAD AN EXPIRATION DATE .

So I called tonight and lady said they no longer accept them even though I received mine recently.  

Never go back here.
Best daiquiris I have ever had! Ask for Nicole when you go! Super sweet and an excellent waitress.

The Good: 

Based on recommendations on Yelp, I tried the chicken Nigella. It came with a soup or salad and they let me nix the rice for some hummus at a small upcharge. I got the lentil soup, which was really tasty! Very flavorful and came with garlic bread and a lemon slice to add some acidity. 

The chicken was extremely good. Juicy, not spicy, but full of really tasty spices, and the yogurt sauce was similarly amazing. 

The hummus was also good! It was looser and had more spices in it than other hummus I've had and it didn't have too much tahini in it, which to be honest I appreciated. They threw a side salad on there for good measure, with was solid too.

Service was good too! The host/waiter was super nice and he was attentive as well. He was also darn cute, so that didn't hurt! 

The Bad:

Menu is very large and tries to cater to too many different tastes, but it is to be expected given the proximity to USF. But they need a way to separate those items out and highlight the traditional items and their specialties.

The shop itself is really small. They are closing for renovations later this month, but the tables are too large for the space and the booths too low for the tables. It was a bit of a squeeze for me, since I'm chubby. The seating outside looked nice, but it was two degrees past Hades and I was not going to go for that.

Celtic management refuses to provide documents to support accusations of money owing. Refusal to respond to lawyer letters or the owners letters for basic account requests. Celtic Management charges an extreme amount of money, however they do not maintain the property such as main fire doors coming off of hinges, electric box fixed with a piece of tape, damed flooring and the list goes on. Celtic Management is apart of the better business group however if you are not a board member they will not look at or post your complaint !!! Be very very wary of this terrible group!! REMEMBER AT THIS TIME IF THEY CHOOSE TO IGNORE EVEN A LAWYERS REQUEST FOR INFORMATION YOU NEED TO GO TO THE COURT OF QUEENS BENCH TO HAVE RESOLUTION. THIS PATHETIC BUISNESS RELYS ON THIS!!

So I'm really new to the Tampa area, and I have been in search of a place to watch my hometown teams. The Press Box is the best sports bar I've found yet. Everything about this place is great!

The food is reasonably priced and tastes fantastic. I went with the giant appetizer sampler, and everything I had was delicious. The menu is huge, and they have a ton of drinks and drink specials. Bartenders are friendly and helpful. There are a TON of TV's everywhere, so this is the place to go if you're like me and have multiple games to watch. 

There's lots of other stuff to do as well, such as pool, darts, jukebox, video poker arcade games, etc. Surely is never a dull moment at this place. I can't wait to go back. 

Synopsis: Go here- you won't regret it. One of the best Sports bars in Tampa.

I went back 2 nights ago for a sushi fix. I got some of my usual hand pressed Nigiri. I noticed on the chalkboard that they had Salmon belly Nigiri. $5.50 for 2 pieces. I was very happy that I tried it! Soft and tender, it melted in my mouth like butter. DELICIOUS! This is one of my favorite places in Tucson for fresh and tasty Sushi. I also tried the spicy Octopus roll and it was excellent. Bass is something most other places do not offer. I always get some here.

Ate here in June. 

Entered waffle house with a hangover. This is the first time I have ever actually eaten in the Waffle house, I have before only got drinks there. 

The table was dirty, with all sorts of trash left on there when we entered. It was very busy though. So I had eggs mushrooms and home fries and a OJ and a coffee. The coffee was really good, loved it! The home fries were greasy, soggy and generally rank. The mushrooms were oily.The eggs were good. They ran out of OJ so I could only get half a glass. 

Atmosphere was great, buzzy and divey. The service was over busy and stressed. Every table was full and the waiting staff seemed run off their feet. I felt sorry for them. 
 
I didn't expect them to run out of OJ and the food was super greasy. that said I could see myself eating there again, only to berate myself afterwards with the "why did I bother" feeling that I often get when trying to look on the bright side of businesses with that budget and divey feel.- which waffle house has in spades.

I had to ask for it because i had already gone 6 times and never got it. So i got it finally 2 weeks ago. I dont know what they check with there 23 point courtesy check.
