I just went and smelled it and felt it.  I wish i could do no starts. Meineke you have ripped me off for the last time. Get some real mechanics.

Food and service was excellent.  I had the filet and it was cooked to perfection.  Husband had the ribeye, seasoned well and very moist.  Server was very attentive and the manager came by to check on us.

I love Gental Dental, the minute you walk in the door you feel welcomed. The staff is very professional and also down to earth. Dr.Fee is the best dentist that I been to. She explained the treatment plan that she put together for me. I had a deep cleaning and scaling which was done by the hygienist Natalie Angelini.She explained the process step by step to me while also encouraging me to follow up with continuing care.

This is the best carry out Chinese restaurant that I have been to.  The food is excellent, and the staff are very friendly.  I appreciate all the options that they offer including Chinese, Japanese, and Thai dishes.  You can get lo mein instead of white rice with many dishes for a slight charge.  They also offer a bucket of fried rice which my kids love.  I have ordered from them many times in the previous few months and have never been disappointed.

This was my first time here and with a groupon now.  The service was great and my son and I loved our sandwhich.  We tried the pb w/ bacon, bananas and honey on wheat toast...awesome!  They give you a bag of sun chips, also.  I decided to take a jar of pb home too.  I chose homestyle, but next time I'll be a little riskier, lol.

So Sunday my friend and I decided to stop by for a quick bite/drink since she was getting car wash down the street.  I got there few minutes before she did and sat at the bar, girl eventually came to ask if I needed anything and she then handed me her menu.  I told her I was waiting for friend, to give me few more minutes.  So she seemed like a bit bothered by the fact that I wasn't ordering right away.  Then my friend came we looked at the menu and ordered our drink, we wanted something from the small bites menu and she completely said that was only for dinner and we couldn't order that, we were limited to 5 things on the other menu.  We Decided on no food, so we just had our drink, but somehow the girls seemed bothered that we weren't ordered anything else.  And honestly not that they were busy it was only probably 4 other customers in the whole restaurant and bar.  Usually I do like this place and never had such bad service, it'll probably be while to return here.

I love a good cupcake.  I love to shop local.  I have stopped by here on a few occasions to surprise my daughter with red velvet cupcakes.  The cupcakes aren't bad.  Ive had better cupcakes.  She loves them.  There selection changes daily and some of the cupcakes give a percentage of the cost to charitable causes which I love. Will I be back.  Most definitely.  As I said my daughter loves this place.

I liked all the photos I saw posted on Yelp about this place,so stopped by this Monday evening for some quick takeout dinner.
Ordered a House Special fried rice,one Pho Tai soup,and two orders of fried eggrolls.
It was a slow Monday evening,when we arrived there weren't too many customers.Sometimes this doesn't bode well,as during lulls some restaurants' food tends to not be the freshest.But I'm happy to report that when we got home and opened everything we were greeted by some hot great smelling,eye appealing food.
I've been to around 4 or 5 of the Pho spots around Pinellas Park,and this Pho was the best I've had.The meat was fresh(on the side and not in the broth,as should be),the usual side veggies were fresh and abundant,and the broth had more flavor than the more bland other ones' I've had in the past from the other Pho joints.
The eggrolls(seemed more like springrolls but that's what they are called on the menu)
were crispy with a decent tasting filling(I think I actually detected the taste of crab meat)
that was better than the more common ones' I've gotten from other places where they are heavy on the cabbage and light on premium ingredients.You get 5,yes 5,for 3 bucks,and they came with a nice sweet fish sauce fusion dipping sauce.
The House Special fried rice was tasty with a combo of Chinese sausage,beef,chicken and shrimp.One thing I really liked was that the beef had a nice "grilled" taste.
All in all,I was impressed.Spent 24 bucks,had a nice quick dinner for two,and had leftover fried rice for tomorrows lunch.The food was fresh,nicely cooked,and had all the extras that are normally supplied with these dishes.Not bad for a slow Monday evening.
We'll be back,and next time plan on dining inside to try some of the other offerings from this restaurant.

Ok, I usually don't write a negative review, but I feel compelled to share my experience at the "Famous" Loveless Cafe. First on a Positive, everyone was really nice and upbeat. Second the place was clean and the decor was very nice. Third The ice tea was pretty good if you could get some and that's where it all starts downhill.
The server took our order, brought my tea and my wife's warm water and the Really So so Biscuits( they are not really that good). We asked for some crayons to do the search word game and she did. After she handed us the Crayons and while I was litterly opening the box she brought out our breakfast plates of food! Folks come on! Waffle House has a better breakfast, at least it's hot and not sitting in buckets waiting for you to order!! No thanks. I mean in 3-5 minutes our food was on the table. 
Not my idea of a good old fashion Hot Breakfast. I'll pass. She never offered or asked to fill our drinks again! I had to flag her down to get a second glass of ice tea.. only reason I give it two stars is because of the atmosphere and cleanliness of the restaurant. Go there if you want but I'll go to Denny's for a better breakfast.

Was unimpressed. Was super hyped to go and get decorations. They hardly had anything and it was over priced. I was going to buy a big bow. It was 12$. Nothing had prices on it. Didn't even have lights except for pa is with 100 on them

$3 drafts on Tuesday with the best wings (ordered them blackened, crispy) anywhere! Great outdoor pool area for dining. Don't know that I'd want to hang out there on the weekend but perfect on a weeknight.

Since the new owners take over it's much cleaner the staff is very friendly the cook in the kitchen Joaquin is very polite and always nice the whole staff has Uniforms now which is very good Great prices For happy hour and everything is fresh

Sometimes when a celebrity chef has a restaurant people go because of the name. I saw the reviews and decided to check it out. I will have to say that you could ignore that perspective because regardless of name this place had some absolutely delicious food!

We ended up sitting in the bar area because it was booked solid until 10PM. WE got here before 6PM, when they serve food, we had an ample time to grab a drink and settle in first. And I will add that I really liked the feel of this place, too, which again surprised me (it wasn't generic or stuffy!).

I ordered the BBQ Shrimp for an appetizer and it was spot on with similar dishes I had around NoLA, which means it was very good!! For the entree, I had the duck, which was a special. It was served in a long, narrow plate where the duck was sliced in about 1 inch thick piece all the way across it. I can't remember the other specifics of the dish but I can tell you that I polished it off rather quickly. I absolutely loved the dish. And I did get the flan for dessert, which was a spin off the traditional flan, and I appreciated the variation and I thought it was very good too.

Just as other have said- I would recommend this place.

If you are looking for a trendy and classy place for a happy hour, the oyster house is a good choice. It is extremely popular and I would recommend getting there early (it was an hour wait for us when we got there at 8:45pm on a Saturday night) however you might get lucky if you stay close to the cocktail bar and pay attention to patrons who may be close to finishing their meal/drinks (bar counter is first come first serve seating) 
I definitely recommend the $1 oysters and also their oyster stout beer! Fried calamari is also delicious. The Londoner shooter is for the brave hearted as it comes with oyster flesh at the bottom of the glass.

Don't come hungry and make sure you have a big wallet and don't hope for food that has some soul.
Empanadas blahh, filet is about 3oz and they only give you 6 pieces of spinach, no dinner rolls but tiny sliced bread but the mushroom and oil is good.  My sis had the scallops and linguine (she said it was just ok) and it was about a cup full and no flavor.  2 filets, 1 scallop dinner, 2 orders of empanadas, 2 lemonade, 3 water, and french fries was $133.

Eh. The nachos with pulled pork and BBQ sauce were good, the bread sticks were more like cheesy-gooey sticks... not super healthy, but if you like melted cheese, you will love them. 

This place is LOUD, televisions all over the place with what must be very important sport contests taking place, just based on the amount of screaming and clapping taking place.

This is the second Subaru we've purchased from Glanzmann. Can't recommend them highly enough. Personal and straight forward in every step. 
they started by sending me a price on email to get the ball rolling. Met with Jake - he's greeat - and within 2 meetings, we drove our car home.
they were a lot cheaper than the other Subaru dealers too.
LOVE our CrossTrek. Recommend both Glanzmann AND the Crosstrek. Great value.

This review is for the INN ONLY as we did not eat on premises at all. 

I am a huge Bruce Springsteen fan. Love his music and always will. Not so much Bon Jovi. I think that if Springsteen wasn't from my native NJ, I would like Bon Jovi a lot more. While Springsteen penned such classics as Thunder Road & Jungleland, Bon Jovi came up with much more benign classics like, You Give Love A Bad Name and Have A Nice Day. Now, what does Springsteen/Bon Jovi have to do with The Logan Inn you might ask? If New Hope didn't have my absolute favorite B&B anywhere, Porches, I would probably like the Logan a hell of a lot more.

There is nothing wrong with it, per se. The rooms are nice enough, but on the small side. The location can't be beat and the place is quite nice. The staff, on the other hand, is exceptional and quite friendly. Helpful too. But at well over $250/ weekend night there are much, much better choices in the surrounding area. Choices that offer more eclectic rooms and include gourmet breakfasts. 

For me, the Logan Inn is the place to go when everything else in the downtown New Hope/Lambertville is booked. I think a room there is worth about $150 and if it was, I would add another star, perhaps even 2 but for what they charge, it's simply not worth it.

Called on a Thursday and was able to get a Friday appt for a squirrel problem in our home.  The guys showed up early for the appt and were professional, thorough and cleaned up everything from their work.  I can't recommended these guys enough and will definitely give them a call for any future needs.
The Margaritas as top notch, totally natural, no sugar or mixes added!! Also love their salsa bar!! And HH rocks!

Everything about the coffee is the best. Baristas can be a little snooty, and I wish there were more seating, but it's impossible to rate La Colombe anything less than 5 stars.

If this is your first time here you should know: there is only 1 size for everything, so do not mention small/medium/large, in order to avoid looking foolish around the already snooty baristas. It's worth it to sit down if you can, you get a beautiful mug instead of a paper cup.

Lunch is fantastic here. The service is amazing, and it seems like a family run business. They are good at getting you in and out for the lunch break.    I haven't eaten anything that I don't like though I do like some meals better than others. It's also fun to play around with different combinations, and they're very amenable to creating your own meal

This place is booming with bedazzled retirees!! The food was above average. Portions were a good size, but not large. Service was excellent- fast and attentive. Go in the bathroom (even if you don't need to "go") just to see the hilarious signs!!

I love  how Mr. Bob Candicci's family owned  business is consistent with excellent service and food without breaking the bank for his customers.

Bob when present  will come out and speak to all of his customers.
The manager and staff are very friendly  and helpful toward me. 
I do remember when Bob first open this location in the 80's .
It's like having your authentic Italy food on the Hill, but right here in Ballwin without the drive.
I love the live entertainment that is provided at this location.
The happy hour are great too.  They offer a great discount  on bottles of wine for happy hours. 
The  food is excellent for lunch and dinner too.
The outside patio is very nice while the inside decor is very nice too!
This is a great place to meet for business or personal  experience.
Thank you Mr.Bob for providing Excellent service and food! You know I will be back!
This is for Ms.Emily St.Clair  who was our amazing happy accommodating server on  Tuesday May  2017, this was here first on the job. OM ... her personality was like sunshine on a cool beach. 

Gloria~

I lived here last year and was extremely disappointed with this company. Especially Erin. She is entitled, immature, and unreliable. It is obvious that she is not qualified to be the voice of this company. 

She is also trying to bring people into IV during COVID, which is a testament to the failures of her character, and her absolute disregard for the safety of this community.

Five stars for the taste and consistency of the smoothies we ordered.
Five stars for the friendly staff. 
Four stars for the prices. 
I'm not usually one to complain about prices in a review because I figure if you know the price beforehand and go ahead and order, it is basically conscious acceptance of the prices. However, this place does not list the prices and I just thought 'well, how much can it possibly be for two smoothies?' 
Just under $20 for two smoothies is how much it can be and is. 
They are doing a great job here and I understand the rent probably accounts in part for the high prices...but this place is kinda big for a smoothie bar and there was only one other customer there. Perhaps a smaller space could accommodate lower prices??
Floor lady was super nice, very friendly. Food was good and comfortable price. It was cozy dining experience. Highly recommend!!

I absolutely loveeeeeeee church's chicken !  Butttttt a huge unfortunately this location is seriously the worst location there is ! From the time you enter you are not greeted which is whatever . I get it your busy . Butttttt when you get up to the register to order the people at the register are absolutely rude as hell. Very lazy don't want to work . Obviously hate there lives. They don't ask can I help you or anything they just dead stare you. After I order they forget my drink . I sit down wait 20 mins and get my food and leave . Come home open it up and I ordered three spicy chicken sandwiches and mash potatoes and gravy . The chicken sandwiches were rock solid and there was no spicy sauce . The mash potatoes must have been siting for hours . I was so disgusted I called to let them know. No one answered I called home office left a message no response it's been months . Come back to order food again hoping it's better and told them what happened the manager told me the people there are terrible and that I need to check each sand which every time before I leave . That is so uncalled for. She wouldn't replace my order or anything . Every time I go I hope it will be good because I absolutely love churches but they prove me retarded every time for trusting them. The guy who makes the food stares at me the entire time I sit and wait every time he is there and licks his lips at me and says things like ayyy girl. It's kind of scary . I hope they get it together .

I simply love this place. I eat meat, yet I enjoy their General Tso's mock chicken dish more than any other real meat General Tso's i have every tried. Definitely a must whenever I find my self in chinatown

If you attend, just stick to the sandwich menu. I ordered "The Ferdie, my brother order the shrimp poboy, and his girlfriend order Alfredo. Her Alfredo came out saucy, noodles undercooked and no Parmesan in it. My brothers poboy had shrimp that weren't deveined at all. This place truly devotes their time just to the muffalatta. I won't go back to this place again.
Best Pizza in the city, I go out of my way to get pizza from here, just amazing
Just stop in my chance. We had traditional Reuben sand and chicken salad for a quick lunch.  Both were delicious.
Renovated, clean and "Friendly".  We haven't been here for a while but enjoyed our visit.  Good selection, very tasty.  We'll be back!!

This is a cute little place to grab a fancy donut and a cup of coffee. The donuts are delicious and unique, with clever names. The donuts are priced reasonably from ~$1.50-$4.00. The baker is super friendly and helpful when you're trying to decide on a donut. They're owned by the Flying Cupcake, so it is similar decor/atmosphere.

Wow is all I can say! Super impressed with how good the food was here. This area has some good Mexican restaurants but Sancho Pistolas is not the typical Mexican. 

I happened to attend during an Eagles game and also happy hour(double whammy). One of the few places that honor happy hour on the weekends(except sat).

First i had the steamed buns on special. Got to try 3 of the 4(spicy pork, carnitas and cheeseburger) and they were all excellent. 

Ordered the nachos for half off happy hour. Very fresh and tasty. For my entree, I had ordered the pork belly tacos and wow was i impressed!! The flavor was amazing!! Also during football season they offer buffalo chicken tacos at 3.00 ea. I had one and it was delicious!

Couldn't be happier, especially living within a few blocks away, I can see myself coming here almost once a week. Also the wait staff(Gerald) was very attentive, pleasant, and all around a great guy!

We didn't try a lot of variety. Pastrami on the Big Apple and the Reuben, cole slaw and tater tots. The big Apple was pretty good but the pastrami on the Reuben was really dry and tough. The tots were fantastic but the cole slaw had too much mayonnaise and we didn't care for the spice used. The atmosphere reminds me of a carry out deli. The staff was really friendly. I know they've only been open a few weeks and we don't live close by. If we're in the neighborhood we may give them another try.

Hubby & I headed over here on the coldest night in Feb. We were THAT hungry & wanted a warm satisfying meal. First, the atmosphere is not very inviting @ all. It's cold & no frills & reminded us of a hall one would rent for a graduation party, only without the decor. That said, our server (the only one that night), was very friendly & prompt. We ordered the bread basket which was some of the best Naan I've had. For appetizer we had the fried veggie dish which consisted of samosas & other veggie/potato goodies. I was very impressed with how crunchy & oil-free everything was. For dinner we ordered the lamb shank, which was a bit tough but the sauce was amazing. The chicken tikka masala was delicious as well. They really know what they're doing with their sauces. The chai was hot but too milky. We had the Payasam for dessert, which is a creamy rice & vermicelli pudding, with milk steeped cashews, so yum. We'll definitely be back to try more of the menu, as its huge. Prices are reasonable as well.
Everyone loves donuts! Nice display of options, staff is friendly, clean environment, good location, delicious donuts, I'm a happy customer.

i just went to this studio for the first time today. its thanksgiving. start of the holiday season. that stresses me out. on my drive, i saw 2 walk of shames from last night being the biggest party night of the year. i was already thankful i went to bed early and didn't partake in the nonsense. im easing my way into the merriment. i took felicia's yintensive class. i had no idea what that meant. it sounded like i was gonna get my ass kicked, but i was just the opposite. it was lovely. gentle practice, almost like a restorative class. props and blankets and we never stood up. i didnt know going in, but i think i needed this more. i opened everything, stretched myself calm, and left feeling like i had a spa day. felicia was so welcoming and her practice was warm and caring. the class had about 10 people in it, and i felt a great sense of community. felicia gave me a tour when i came in. the space is cute. very clean and simple. great retail area. there are actually 2 rooms to practice. both have the same cozy feel. im surprised ive never been here before. its the closest studio to my house. i still like to bounce around the city to yoga classes that fit my schedule and budget, but ill be paying closer attention to the goings on at wake up yoga south.

This place needs to make sure they advertise for kids because that's what its for. Only 1 or two rides where an adult would have a good time.

The good: Variety of rides, fast ones, slow ones. A good size park where you can ride very single ride in one day and repeat your favorites. The 3 pools are probably the best thing in there, parents can just sit back sun tan or sit in the water and let the kiddos run around. Rides are safe (except the wooden coaster, simply put: stay away), staff is extremely friendly. They pretty much let the kids have as much fun as they can but if someone gets out of line then they escort him out. I saw this happen in one ride, the kid was jumping during the slide. Also season pass prices are cheap as long as you take advantage of them and go at least 3-4 times. They even have some dry rides for little ones. My 1 year old had a blast! Bathrooms were clean. Season passes comes with coupon book with a few free things like tickets to ballparks. Also comes with a .99 cent refill bottle. 

The bad: Maintenance could be better. I work in maintenance so my eye goes straight for it. I really hope management sees this part of the review. Season pass registration room is a very small room with like 40 people inside. Doors always opening and closing and the room has a window air conditioner unit which was doing nothing. I took it upon myself to pop the filter out and behold there was like 2 pounds of dirt on the filter. NEVER BEEN CLEANED BEFORE. I mean come on maintenance!!!!!!!! I cleaned it with my own hands and banged it on the floor under a table. The a/c was much colder after that and the air was safe for my kids to breath. The black tube water ride looks like its never been cleaned on the outside. Some features of certain rides were not working correctly. A few other minor things I can't remember right now.

We were unable to take in food for my 1 yr old. He can eat a variety of foods but on a day of running around and burning energy I want him to eat something healthy not a pizza.

Overall: We have a great time every time we go, I recommend it to everyone and bring my family along when we go.

The food specials were good for happy hour. Unfortunately the waitress was rude and seemed like we were bothering her for simple things. She never said her name and we didn't bother to ask. She had a long low ponytail. Probably won't return because of her demeanor.
Best donuts I've ever had! They are soft and moist the glazed isn't too sweet!!! Just perfect!!! Line is long but they work very quickly!!! Must try!

If you are a regular reader of my reviews, you know that I do not venture outside my 3 mile comfort zone very often; however, today my sister needed me in Greenwood, so I headed south ....with the assumption we would have some GOOD food for lunch.  

I am a Thai rookie....after asking about where I should go in the Talk! section, I learned of many wonderful Thai delights around Indy and I honestly never thought I would have a chance to get to Thai Spice, but my sister is a huge Thai fan and she said it was the best....

...and comparing it to Thai Orchid, I have to say....I cannot disagree; however, I think they are BOTH delicious.  She had the Padd Thai which was VERY good but not very spicy even at "medium" ...they offered to spice it up but I thought it was GOOD!! :) I had the Padd Seuw and it was also delicious.  I loved the larger noodles and the larger chunks of chicken along with the broccoli....yummmmy!

For lunch, it was reasonably priced and I would definitely go back.  I am so sad it is in Florida (aka Greenwood) b/c it will probably be a long time before I get to indulge again!

If I haven't already mentioned it, thank you, Yelpers....I am addicted to Thai because of you!

Christine gave me a wonderful facial ! I have had plenty of facials but you can tell she has experience and is great at what she does. The facial massage was probably my favorite part of the service. So relaxing and took the extra steps to make me feel relaxed. Will be returning!

Every once in a while I like to try something different than my usual favorite places. So, when my friend suggested this place I was game.

I had the vermicelli noodles with egg  roll and crispy pork. It was ok but nothing outstanding or memorable about it. I tasted mostly mint, and the few pieces of pork were like jerkey and pretty tasteless. The egg roll seemed like a sad afterthought to the dish.

Service? Forget about that as they not once came by to check on us. I had to get up for more water but when she saw me coming, she was quick to apologize and filled up my empty glass...no ice. Nothing like flat water to wash your food down with. I could of asked for ice but why bother at this point.

After finishing our food the wait was on for the check. Yep...had to ask for that too.

I left a nice tip as I know how tough it is to live on a meager wage in this town. So, this review balances things out and hopefully will serve as a reminder for them to step it up a bit.

I always thought this placed was shut down cause it was never open when I drove by. Turns out, they're only open during the warm seasons. Finally got to try them, got a small chocolate shake and a banana split. There are so many sundaes to choose from! I thought it'd be in a medium-ish size cup... nope it's a full on banana split in a boat. Cut up bananas in the bottom, 3 scoops of vanilla, sliced strawberries, chopped pineapple, chocolate syrup, whip cream, and chopped nuts! I wasn't expecting a full size sundae but I finished it! Yum! I want to go back and try some other sundaes and the food too. Wish they served french fries though.
Food took hours, and the burger was still alive. We left before we played games. Do not go here!

If you're not from the Sherwood Park area like me this store is still worth checking out. For starters they have a large selection and good stock. A year ago I called every store in Edmonton to finally and luckily call Sports Closet to find out they had what I needed in stock. 
But what I really want to do is shoutout to experience I had this week at Sport Closet. The store staff helped me have one of the best experience I've had in a long time! The staff are so helpful and friendly. And now I've got myself a nice new oilers jersey :)

I was really pumped about going to the IMA today. I was even really interested in becoming a member as me and my girlfriend were talking about it. Unfortunately due to rude staff I think we'll pass on the membership. 
When we entered the Lily House the usher kept bothering us about time even though we had 30 minutes left and was even clapping as if to rush us along. Seriously, be a professional. If you don't like your job look for a new one. When we asked for directions to the garden we were responded with a what and sigh. I get it's free night but, how are you going to get membership when you treat your customers so poorly?
To be honest I'll only return on free nights just because I like art. I just don't wanna pay to be treated with such a crap attitude.

Awesome soup dumplings and variety
BYO
Cheap
Only accepts cash so beware of that

Starting off, the person did not know what type of Oil my car took.  That is a big part of an Oil Change. When asked the difference between the oils he said this one has more additives going all the way up to the more expensive.  My car's manual states no additives to oil.  I told him that.  He then said there is no additives.  Contradicted himself.  They charge you 5 dollars to remove a skid plate, which is 6 bolts and on every modern car.  I told him I had a coupon, which he then said is great because it would cover the 5$.  At the time of checkout he hands me the bill and I said I had a coupon.  He said that I needed to tell him.  I told him and he acknowledged it.  This is the worst oil change experience I have had in 22 years.  It is a new car and I hope they did not mess it up.  They never even bothered with a sticker for the windshield.  No drink offered as the website explains. (I looked to see what they were supposed to do, not that I wanted a drink!)

I have been here twice for lunch and love it so far. I had the Steak sandwich and El Cubano which were both very good. The sides (grilled vegetables, broccoli salad etc.) were great too. The service was great as well!

My husband and I have been wanting to try this establishment since their remodel this last year as we often frequent the Peppermill as one of our favorite locals spots. We made reservations for Wednesday night for my birthday and were seated immediately upon arrival. We were immediately given a basket of sourdough bread with butter and ice water. I didn't care for the bread so much and decided to order a glass of wine and an appetizer. My husband's soda was brought to the table immediately and I waited several minutes for my wine. 

For our appetizers, my husband ordered the fried calimari and I ordered the lobster bisque. The calamari was over fried to a crisp and the lobster bisque just didnt taste right and lacked the rich flavor of lobster bisque in several of the other quality seafood restaurants throughout the area. 

I asked about ordering a lobster tail and was told I could get just the tail but would have to pay the price of the entire Maine lobster which I did not feel was worth the cost. I elected to get 8 oz filet mignon and my husband selected the Chilean sea bass. The fish was bland and tasteless and the risotto was bland mush. My steak while actually seasoned well was extremely fatty and therefore mostly inedible and the potatoes were bland and a bit overcooked. I asked for some bernaise or hollandaise for the steak and asparagus and was told they don't carry it. I was pretty surprised and disappointed, but it pretty much matched the totality of the overall experience.  The waitress didn't really come back to check on us after that as she seemed to pick up on the fact that we were less than pleased.

The one saving grace was the manager on duty Cesar who noticed our disdain when we asked for the check and was kind enough to ask about what our complaints were so they could work with the kitchen to get it right. I went over all the issues we had with him and since we had literally only taken a few bites and hadn't eaten almost anything, he did not charge us. I did insist on paying for our drinks and I was impressed at his level of concern for the customer experience so I might consider giving them another chance one day in the future.
This review is for the Shrimp Ceviche Tostada. On special during Happy hour M-TH for $3. Loaded up and so good. I had two and it ended up being my dinner. I will be back for this one!

A little disappointed: too much cream, oil, not enough flavor, not enough meat.
It took a two halves but hardly felt the difference between the 2.

Masami was a hit with our family!  Some semi-strong Yelp reviews led us here as we were looking for Hibachi.  We find Hibachi style restaurants to be a dual threat, great food and entertainment all rolled into one.  The kids love the Hibachi experience.

I was a little concerned upon arrival, as the hostess/waitress that seated us did not come across as overly welcoming.  That attitude unfortunately continued throughout the evening with the drink ordering and refill process as well.  Fortunately, the Hibachii chefs killed it!  They were as friendly as could be and seemed genuinely happy that we were there as their guests.  They played it up for big time for the kids!

The food was very good.  You start off with a fresh salad with ginger dressing and a crock of miso soup.  Once the chef fires things up you are on your way to getting some excellent fried rice, veggies and your meat of choice.  I found the steak and shrimp to be excellent!  The scallops seemed slightly over-seasoned.

As far as beverages go, you can try a Japanese soda.  It comes in a unique glass bottle, that has a marble inside.  But more importantly, for those looking for an adult beverage, Masami is a BYOB.

Masami gets an endorsement from this Yelper.  Just wish they could correct some of the service issues that are so frequently mentioned in their reviews.

Stay AWAY!! THIS coming from an emergency room physician!! Way too $$$$ and far better options in town! Always CHECK multiple reviews if available prior to entering any facility. You are your own consumer advocate when it comes to pet health care, not regulated by insurance like human medical care. Don't get duped!!

Every step of our business with Havertown Carpet went smoothly! They are quick to respond, know their product and are very helpful and friendly. The actual installation took less than a full day and they happily worked around the weird closet maid things that are in our closets from the previous owners. They also moved all the furniture carefully and would ask me to double check placement. The carpet is so lovely and pricing is reasonable. I would highly recommend Havertown Carpet!

Love this place, little seahorses! And the Hto cocoa is soo good and they always put this adorable little leaf cream thingy on top. And, I LOVE shopping for such unique things while waiting for my coffee

Go here if you love beverages!
I wish I was more hungry during my visit. Had the brisket and it was delicious. Definitely worth a 30-minute wait!

Charming, clean and quaint, Greek City Cafe came through when I was looking for some substantial, comfort type food on a dismal weather day. 

Conveniently located in a shopping center type area adjacent to the Countryside Mall, Greek City Cafe delivers fresh, fast and tasty options for people looking for quick eats. It is my understanding that the owners of this is the Pappas family that has roots in Tarpon and I could certainly see how the family recipes and quality have translated into the cafe realm. 

Ordering at the counter is easy and you are given a number to take with you to your chosen seat. There are tables and booths available as well as outdoor seating. I chose the falafel wrap and per a Yelp check-in I was generously given an order of the Greek fries.  

The service was fast and I received my wrap in no time. I like that the wrap was a wheat one and it was pressed. The substance of the falafel sandwich was stellar and I really enjoyed the yogurt sauce that accompanied it. I highly recommend getting if you are a falafel fan, the spices and veggies blended together nicely. The Greek fries were indulgent and fit the bill for the kind of day I was having-hot and crispy with the right amount of sauce and cheese (even more than I can eat). I also enjoyed that there were healthier menu items as well, I just decided to indulge in that particular day. 

I didn't have much time to try any desserts or coffee but I will be back! Thanks Greek City, for an awesome and fast dining experience!
Definitely the best Chinese food in Tucson. My favorite is Mongolian tofu gluten free . Take home at least once a week. Lovely ambience and service.

This is one of the nicer bar/restaurants in Manayunk, with an upscale atmosphere and prices to match.

Both times I've been here, I've had the salads and pizza rather than the entrees which are bit pricey at 25 and up. The pizzas are fairly good size, so if you have a moderate appetite two people could order salads (12-15) and share one pizza (about 15), and your meal would be in the range of $45-50 before drinks. 

My one knock on this place would be the wine by the glass selection- for a place that bills itself as a wine bar, I would think they could come up with a better tasting selection.  The wines by the glass are in the range of 11-12, and taste like they are from $12 bottles of wine.  They do have an extensive list if you are willing to buy a bottle, and I think that would be the better way to go here. 

On the other hand, there is a nice selection of beer on tap as well as about two dozen craft beers in bottles.  So I give Jake & Coopers two thumbs up for the beer, pizza and salads.  As a wine bar, though, it doesn't hold  candle to the wine bars in Philly like Tria and Zavino.

Edit:  Apparently the restaurant won a Wine Spectator award, as the manager informed me when he read my review here on Yelp. So, if you are impressed by that, you may want to discount my comments about the disappointing glass pour list. I'll just say that I  wasn't impressed with what I drank and leave it at that.
The Turkey & Provolone is amazing! I always get it "Mike's Way" and add mayo and pickles. They put a legit amount of meat on the sub too! Love this place!

I stop by this mini Walmart grocery store on occasion because it is so close to my home.  Looking over the Walmart branded cut fruit, I will almost always pass the section by.  It is often not well stocked, and what is on the shelves is far from appealing looking.
 
Near the fruit is the "fresh" unpackaged fruit and vegetables.  Same deal here.  Much of the fruit is unappealing to the eye.  To be fair, I personally won't buy Walmart brand packaged fruit or vegetables or unpackaged at our Super Walmart either.  No Walmart packaged meat or chicken either.  Those of you that have read the Consumer Reports review of grocery chains will understand why.   The only exception is that I have not encountered any problems with their baked goods.
 
So basically what the Walmart Neighborhood Market is of use for to me is  fresh and frozen name brand foods.  Many of the prices of these are cheaper than Publix, though a few are higher.  It can be crowded at times, and the shelves are not always restocked as quickly as they should be.
 
There are also drugstore, paper products, household sections in this Walmart Neighborhood Market.  Prices are typically good, and these sections are well stocked.  This is where I usually go to buy vitamins, soap, shampoo, paper plates, etc.  Prices are often the same as the Walmart Super Center.
 
Checkout is typically quick and the cashiers are friendly, though some clearly are not happy about being there.  For those that are mobility limited, the parking lot usually has spaces open close to the store, and unlike a Super Walmart, it's not a marathon to make a circuit walk through the store.
 
It has it's place in our weekly shopping routine, which consists or going to the Neighborhood Walmart Market to buy the products we trust from there, and then on to Publix/Whole Foods/Sprouts for fruit, vegetables, meat, and fish.
Updated with pictures. Many years later, I still come here to get all my vehicles serviced. All the awards on the wall speak for themselves!

My husband and I were introduced to Kimu, by our Burmese neighbors. It is become one of our favorite restaurants and eat there approximately once a week. I really enjoy the savory Special Fried Rice, with its squid, shrimp, scallops and crab bits. I love the hot sauce and sprinkle it generously all over the dish.  Their homemade lemonade is my beverage of choice and if you decide have one of the delectable soups I urged that you bring your appetite.  Their addition of dessert is yummy as well as very attractive, Shwe yin aye a rice, tapioca and coconut dessert from heaven.
Ordered the hot chicken sandwich, my friend did as well. Both sandwiches on the inside were completely raw meat, barely even cooked. Absolutely disgusting.

I was lucky enough to be invited to Mercato for lunch by their lovely PR lady, Kate. As you can see from my previous reviews, Mercato has long been a favorite of mine and I'm happy to report that my feelings remain the same after my lunch visit. The boyfriend and I enjoyed a leisurely pre-Memorial Day weekend meal with a bottle of white and our experience could not have been better. 

We started with a lentil salad, which was perfect for the season. Next up was the grilled artichoke, a personal favorite, with sea salt and the most delicious aioli for dipping. A salmon tartare was delicious, and though I usually prefer tuna to salmon, this version was a nice change. 

By the time our main course arrived (orecchiette with sausage and plum tomato sauce), I was pretty stuffed. I thought I'd only take a few bites but it was so delicious that I ate the entire thing. Fortunately, I would not be spending time on the beach that weekend. 

It had been too long since my last visit to this restaurant but I'm so pleased that the food is just as good as ever. Mercato is consistently awesome.

My clients wanted to go out for a quick bite. It was late and we had no reservations. So we ended up at Rusty's. This would be a great place if you've been drinking all night and needed some grease for your stomach. Unfortunately, this was not the case. 

There is nothing close to healthy on the menu. In fact, I was dining with a registered dietician, and I asked her, "what's the best thing on this menu?" Her response was - "the burger is probably your best bet." 

But, if you're into that, the burgers, beers and other deep fried foods are great here. 

Service is SLOW. It took us a half hour to get our drinks and another hour to get our food. They're burgers... not filets!!

Alright, this is likely going to be a long review so bare with me. 

I work for the 17th largest corporation in the world, whose sole business and area of expertise is hospitality. So I did come here with a critical eye, and the things I found are astounding. 

First off, the parking is horrendous. If you are in any way disabled, you are going to have a horrible time getting around because the grounds are way too large for the single area of parking they provide. Very odd and very frustrating. 

Second, the customer service desk was really disappointing. For the bulk of our two day stay, we dealt with Giovann, who seemed to not give a crap about what he was doing or who he was serving. When we provided him with some of our concerns, he literally rolled his eyes. (If one of my employees ever did that, they would not only get the critique, but be required to apologize). 

Third thing, according to 'Brand Standards', they do not put fitted sheets on the beds. If you are taller than 5'10" this is going to be a problem on the double bed they put you in because your feet hit the sides and start to scrape. Not really the way you want to spend your night, and seriously, that is a ridiculous brand standard. ( I work in brands all the time. When a customer does not like something, I SAY SOMETHING ABOUT IT). 

Fourth, the hot water on one of the sinks was not working... need I go on. 

YES

Fifth, internet is friggen ridiculous! You get basic, which is not all that much. And then have to pay more depending on what you want. Yeah, Mc Donalds will give you free wifi, but not the Westin! 

Sixth, the beds were not comfortable. Super lumpy and pillows were horrible. 

Seventh, the sign on our building to get to our room was mislabeled. It made it seem like our room was on the other side, but no. It was a misprint, on the sign, for the rooms. Seriously! These are things you expect at a Motel, not a $$$$ Westin resort. 

When these things were finally brought to management (Since Giovann seemed to give two s***s), the one thing she did was remove the resort fee of $25 from our second night. Oh gee, thanks! $25 after spending over $600 for two nights. Give me a break! 

I know this is long, but I feel it needs to be said. This is place IS NOT WORTH IT. Go somewhere else. Overpriced, overhyped! 

P.S. The General Manager has all these great credentials, but seems to do diddlysquat here. Things need to change. Apparently they are merging with Marriot so there is a chance!

Best wings in town. Worth the wait. It's busy for a reason because it is very good. I can't wait to see some great live music there as well. This is going to be a great place to go watch Colts games. Tv's everywhere!

So, I stopped in here yesterday to check out another restaurant in The Grove.  I really wanted to taste something on their menu since there were a lot of really mouth watering pics of their food. On top of that they have 1/2 off margaritas for happy hour!!  YaHOo!  I was very impressed with their overall drink selection besides the standard boozy treats they also have: homemade infused vodkas, tons of microbrews and a lot of wine.  I saw they have Dragon's Milk (which is one of my favorite beers) and a number of other hard to find microbrews. I ended up ordering the Fly'n Mayan, which came with salsa, mexican rice and fresh sauteed vegetables.  The shredded pork in the burrito was prepared with delicious spices and the enchilada sauce was tasty!  I really enjoyed the relaxed atmosphere and the playful cattiness of the bartenders.  Definitely will stop back in :D

Absolutely the WORST/NASTIEST marina that I've ever docked at! And I've been too 100's..
Bathrooms out of order.
Showers out of order. 
Shabby outdated antiquated slips!
Embarrased to stay there...
Go elsewhere!!

Top quality ingredients, mediocre cooking skills.
I had very high expectations for Vernick but I got somewhat disappointed. The portion is relatively big so we had one small plate one big plate each.
Sea urchin with eggs has a nice presentation. Sea urchin is very fresh but the transition between cold foam and warm eggs is very strange. 
Grilled sea bass is very salty and the fried broccoli is greasy. 
My guests' wagyu beef is very tasty but the roast chicken is salty too. 
Also the server talked a lot with other customers but barely said anything with us...

Nice little find in Old City. We came here based on Yelp reviews looking for a cocktail lounge for drinks before our late dinner reservation elsewhere. Yelp did not steer us wrong. It's a small cozy joint. Good ambience, has an old school international vibe to it. Check out the coffered ceiling. We were able to score a 2 place high top across from the bar at 6 on a Saturday. There are some booths in the back. The place filled up as we were there.

The drink menu is interesting and different. Wifey was very happy with the French Snap. I had a Classic Margarita and a Dark and Stormy. Both were tasty and easy drinking, but I feel like they were a little light on the liquor. Maybe it's just me. Drinks were about $10 each. It's not cheep, but pretty much expected prices for a downtown bar.

Another nice thing is it wasn't loud. I don't remember if there was background music at all. There was lots of bar noise from the other patrons but it was pleasant and not overwhelming like other places where you have to shout to hear the people you are with. Wifey and I were able to have a nice conversation.

One thing we were confused about is if you were supposed to go up to the bar if sitting at the table. We entered, sat down, waited a bit. We were discussing if I should just go up to the bar when the bartender came over to get our order. Then the place got busy and we didn't get any attention until a second bartender came on and checked on us. When we were ready to leave we has to flag down the bartender for the check. Maybe I'm getting too used to table service. I dunno.

This is one of the best restaurants in Kirkwood. The staff is very attentive  and friendly. Also the decor is modern and welcoming. The food is priced fairly well . In addition; well presented and served. I played it safe and tried the burger. Everything came out great, overall this a great casual restaurant.

The exterior and interior is really nice.  The manager is nice.  The food is average-- I had a burger it was average and the fries were average and not a huge amount.  The sparkling sangria was excellent.  The waitress was bad.  Left dishes everywhere. Mixed up the order, took forever to get water refills.

I've been to this building when there used to be two previous yoga studios (which unfortunately closed). Now, on the first floor, there is a new yoga studio. It is a small and intimate space. Usually, a class consists of 4 or 5 people. The class types and times are varied and can work for most everyone's schedule. They have Vinyasa, Hatha, Kundalini and Restorative classes. Most of them are all levels, with some beginner's classes mixed in. They also offer Reiki meditation classes and courses. They have a "pay what you can" payment system - pay what you feel the class is worth, deal. Extra mats and accessories are also available at no extra charge. The instructors are great and really know their stuff! I would HIGHLY recommend coming to practice at this space!!!

hawthorneyoga@gmail.com
1241 Carpenter St.

May 15th and we just left the Garden Shop at the Home Depot in Downingtown, my husband and I both adhered to all of the COVID 19 rules...mask, 6 feet apart from customers and the store employees, we wiped down our cart....yet both Home Depot Cashiers in the Garden Shop has their mask down around their chins while waiting on customers.  FOLLOW THE RULES HOME DEPOT!!!!

I usually run in here if I'd like something to snack on while running my errands on the weekends.  I usually also pick up some extras and drop off to a few local friends or for my next door neighbor.  I mean really, who doesn't love a fresh, warm soft pretzel!?  I know I do!

The store is always clean, they have a strict rule about how many customers in the store at one time and the staff is always friendly!

Worst service I have ever received. I went here with my mom and we weren't even greeted when walking into the restaurant. I was confused on whether the person approaching was a customer or a worker because he did not give me any sort of greeting gesture. 

I ordered the chicken parm and my mother got the green heart omelette (I forget if that's the actual name) either way we waited about  40 min for the food. The chicken parm was ok the omelette was so plain and the fruit given to us looked very old as they were soggy. 

Our waitress barely catered to us and there were only two other tables besides us. Eventually it was just my mom and I at the restaurant and our waitress too 10 min to get us a bottle of ketchup. What other jobs do you have to forget your only table that your serving. 

Will never go back

Sitting outside for breakfast on Shoreline Drive across from the harbor gives breakfast a nice atmosphere with plenty of views! 
A pretty extensive menu with lots of choices. 
I chose the 1957 Breakfast Sandwich on a Bagel
with Scrambled Eggs, Bacon, Red Onion and American Cheese on an English Muffin. Served with Home Potatoes.
The Best Half choose:
HUEVOS RANCHEROS SPECIAL
Two Eggs, Fried Corn Tortilla, Black Beans, Cheddar Cheese, Chorizo, Jalapeno, Sour Cream, Salsa and Guacamole. Served with Home Potatoes she ordered a Cappuccino and she said it was delicious! The coffee was good too 
Really large portions so bring your appetite.
Only take away is it's a little noisy on the Highway but traffic is intermittent!
Clifford our server and his team were excellent in attending our needs!

There a few times where I am just completely satisfied with my meal and I have to say this Vietnamese place is a gem amongst restaurants. The chicken wings were amazing fried rice was awesome and the banh mi sandwich was just too good to be true. I could have used a little bit more meat on the sandwich but for $3.50 who's complaining. I have a feeling I will be frequenting this place often.

Food: Plate looked beautiful. Portions were great. However the food was very bland, had barely any taste, and I had to put on salt to taste anything. 
Service: maybe it was our particular server, however our table felt very neglected. She would not make even eye contact with us after she had taken our order. 
Price: food was way over priced for what it was. If it was a unique delicacy, the price would make sense however this restaurant was at a higher price point than formal restaurants. Majority of plays were average at $17 which is higher than average in the area.

Smokin' Betty's delivers some of the best food in the neighborhood.  We stumbled across Betty's on a lazy Sunday afternoon and were blown away by the food.  The Betty burger was amazing, 1/2 pound burger stacked on a confit pork belly, topped with avocado, cheddar, lettuce, tomato, a roasted garlic aoli and an egg sunny side up (don't knock it until you've tried it- it's life changing).  Not to be outdone, the Tur-Duck-En Burger was also outstanding.  If you took thanksgiving dinner and put it into a tasty burger bun and topped it with sweet potato ribbons, you would not be far off. Simply Delicious.    

Definitely give Smokin Betty's a try. You will not be disappointed.

I've had breakfast at Southwest Diner several times over several years and will continue to return because it's my favorite breakfast in all of St. Louis. The New Mexico breakfast burrito topped with red chili sauce is usually what I go for but on my last visit decided to try the Southwest slinger and yum! It comes with 2 burger patties, cheese, home fries, two eggs of your choice with that fantastic red chili sauce is like combining St. Louis and New Mexico traditions especially with a sopapilla and the diner lives up to its name. I grew up in Texas and having visited New Mexico on ski trips I love sopapillas so it's nice to have a place to be able to have this comfort food here in St. Louis.

I stopped by Noshville for dinner one night and wasn't blown away, but wasn't disappointed either. Food is typical diner fare, but maybe a tad overpriced for what you get. I had the Reuben which lacked really any notable compliments aside from the fact that a trough of Russian dressing was served next to it. The latkes are decent and I guess thrown in to compliment  the NY deli ambience a bit more. 

The service was quite fantastic though, certainly improved the experience more than the food so I compliment them. I don't remember any specifics, but I left the restaurant thinking the service was excellent, so that's the best part right?

Service was pretty bad, food was subpar and cold! And not to mention my silverware was dirty! I was super disappointed because I wanted to love this place after I heard so many good things about it! I will not be returning...however the hush puppies would have been good if they were hot!

Decided to try last minute before catching a movie downtown, and SO glad we found this place. 

We ordered two pizzas; the Crudo, and a one of the specials. We also got a Caesar salad which was large enough to split between two people. 

A con for some, may be the seating arrangement.  It was "family" style seating ... we grabbed seats at a packed table that had an end and side seat open.  Not sure it's the type of set up I'd like to go for a first date to have initial conversations but worked well for us.  

Also, a nice craft beer selection but other than that it's limited. 

The pizza really is amazing, would recommend to anyone I know.

This was my first visit to this location (I've been to the one on the East side). Decided to get the lamb gyro and fries combo, which is a really great deal. It was under $6 for a good-sized gyro with all the toppings, minus feta (which you can add on for a small price). The gyro meat was basically your typical spit-roasted meat mixture you find at most gyro joints. It was cooked perfectly and wasn't too dry. The tzatziki sauce was thick and delicious. Full of garlic and other robust flavors like it should be. They put a lot of meat on the sandwich, too. 
Even the fries were cooked well. They're definitely frozen, but at least they were cooked to a golden perfection. Service was quick and friendly; nice greeting and asked if I needed any condiments before I left. This place is very similar to Chicago-inspired joints, such as King Gyros, where they offer a lot of different fast-food options (but with much higher quality food). If you're looking for a quick-fix of delicious and cheap fast food, this is your place. Skip the McDonalds and the BKs.

Simply love Sierra Belle boutique!  They have darling tops, the best jeans, and friendly service.  Their clothing selection appeals to women of any age who desire current, stylish, casual clothing at a good price point.  Love popping in every month or so and there are always cute new things to purchase.
Food was delicious. Had the Young Chow Fried Rice and I couldn't finish it. Service & ambiance was also primo. I hope to come to Philly and eat at this establishment again.

The food quality is amazing and the employees seem to do things very fast. The place is just right and there are plenty tables. The place gets really busy during the weekends and usual every day dinner and lunch rushes.

I like this little place - the owner couldn't be more friendly and obviously cares that everyone enjoys themselves.  Also extra credit for having a great Main Street location.  The place is nice and clean.

Prices a bit high, but you kind of expect that given the location.  I had the lunch special, which was a brisket "Philly" with chips and a drink for $9.50.  He explained the lengthy process for transforming brisket into this delicious and verey tender meat.  He obviously knows his stuff.  The only complaint I have is too many green peppers and not enough meat on my sandwich.  The bread was good, but nothing special.  

I'll likely go back for lunch sometime.  It's the kind of place you can trust for quality.
Shittiest pizza ever. Tasted like fuckin Chuck E. Cheese pizza. Y'all definitely paid for those reviews. No wonder portnoy gave u guys a 2.4. Busted ass pizza.

This was a pleasant experience. The waitress was very good at changing my order for me.  My dinner can with flour tortillas, she gladly exchanged them for corn. The food was yummy and plentiful. Would definitely be visiting again. I was impressed.

Got a carne asada quesadilla and taquito de frijol with Jamaica. Everything was DELICIOUS and 100% reminded me of living in Sonora. I will be back!! Sooo good. Quick service, clean, and Covid-friendly service.

Enjoyed a solid meal tonight with server Adriana and chef Vanilla Rice. Table was ready on time. They used clear plastic partitions to divide parties at the table so anyone with Covid concerns should feel safe. Food was excellent and the chef was entertaining. I'm sure we'll be back.

How they don't have a solid 5 starts is just mind boggling. 

If you're looking for the best pastries in St. Charles look no further. They literally have almost anything you could ask for. Saturday's are most definitely the best day's to go as they extend their menu out a bit with additional breakfast pastry offerings and a specialty what seems like every weekend. Their cinnamon rolls and sticky buns are weighty and delicious while their croissants and danishes are so light and airy. They just do things right and consistently pump out killer product. 

If shopping out of the case their macrons are definitely worth the price of admission; get a dozen, you won't regret it (London fog is shockingly good). Their cookies are also divine. 

While their pies are pricey they totally aren't out of line with any other pastry shop and they're so food you'll forget what you paid for it after the first bite.

Was very excited to get my first facial at this location.   Unfortunately I felt like they spent the entire session trying to sell me on the Murad products that they use.   I really just wanted to relax and have a good facial experience.   I don't have anything to compare it to but if it is just cleaning my face, applying a mask then moisturizer then I can do that at home without the cost and the sales pitch.

OMG THE FOOD WAS NASTY!!!!  I went there for a birthday party, and people were saying how gross and how stupid this place was, and to some extent I agree.  The decor was ugly, but the service was not bad, the food was absolutely gross!!!!!

This is a pretty good nail shop. Best one in the area where there isn't much to choose from. I enjoyed the services and the prices are reasonable. I gave 3 stars because I went in on a Saturday and it was extremely busy and they don't have a sign in or an organized way to keep track of who should be serviced next. This caused some confusion. Also my nail tech was kinda rough and I ended up with a stinging cut in my finger from filing too rough. I know it was an accident so I will likely return. If you go here tell them to be gentle and avoid busy Saturdays.
Most everyone there is pleasant and professional, However, the service manager appears uninterested or unconcerned about customer issues and their satisfaction.

I just wanted to say thanks to Olivia who took care of my sons windshield within a matter of days. She was super responsive the price was competitive and I didn't even have to take my car into a shop. I hope I don't have to see you for a new windshield anytime soon but when I ever do or anyone I know needs a windshield you're my gal.
I'm not going to waste a lot of time writing........all I will say is this chicken is the BEST!!! No trip to Nashville is complete without a chicken run. Enjoy.

I have been here twice in the last month, and both times have had great food, been treated well, and enjoyed my experience.  First time I had a turkey sandwich and fries (I was playing it safe). It was very good.  Fries were awesome!  Second time, I got a little adventurous and tried the chicken-fried steak breakfast. OMG.  The best I have ever had! I could tell it was homemade... super flavorful, awesome gravy, crispy hash browns (soft in the center), and even the scrambled eggs tasted wonderful!  My husband had a two-egg breakfast both times and he loved his food. This is now our go-to place for great breakfast food (and lunch!).  Can't wait to come back and try something new.

Sadly we had to wait an extra 30 min for our pick up order and when they did finish, they forgot one of our burrito bowls. When we sat down to eat it at home mine was very wrong and so spicy (which I didn't order) I couldn't eat it. My husbands was also missing two items. Bummer! We've never had problems with Chipotle before. Wish I would have seen the other reviews first before choosing this location, cause it's not the one we normally go to. Will know for next time.

If everyone I've met in South Tampa was as nice as these guys, well....

Took a boxed bike in for assembly (a gift purchased online, not even from their store) and they couldn't have been friendlier. Helped me get it out of the car, said they'd call when it's ready. 

I've always found the people who work here to be really knowledgeable, helpful and kind. It's a busy shop with a wide range of customers, beginners to hardcore riders. But everyone feels welcome.

My husband and I ate here this morning. My husbands Cobb salad had a large living bug in the bowl of course after he almost finished the entire salad. He brought his plate to employee to show them and was never offered money back. Instead she asked him what he wanted her to do about it and asked him if he wanted anything else. Seriously would never eat here again. Extremely disappointed that she at least didn't comp our meals or at least the salad. Just hoping he didn't eat any bugs before he saw the one.

Roommate and I ordered chicken and broccoli, wonton soup, and chili wonton app. Chicken and broccoli regular size was easily enough for us to split and still have leftovers. Chili wonton appetizer is really good but definitely spicy. Quick delivery, and great quality of food. Will be ordering from again!

I was pretty disappointed with this place. I ordered the shrimp tempura bento box and what I received was not satisfactory at all. It came with 3 very small shrimp tempura that were not crispy at all (they were actually a bit soggy). The salad that came with it was not fresh at all and soggy as well. The California rolls in the bento box were not fresh either. I definitely will not be returning to this place as the quality of the food was not good at all and the portion size of the bento box was very small.

Best Indian food I have had outside of Bangalore. Really traditional South Indian food. People in the other comments were not kidding about the lines but they move quickly and its is well worth the wait. I came for the buffet on a Sunday and couldn't stop eating. Food has a nice heat to it and there is a large selection. So very happy I found this place!

Tara's food is ok at best. It's good for ppl who aren't accustomed to good Trini food. Visit Caribbean Connection instead. Make sure that you calculate the total price for your food yourself because she is known for ripping ppl off...and I'm not just talking from my experience. One of my friends warned me about her and I was nonchalant about it until it happened to me. I've never visited her spot since then. I wish that there were more Trini spots to avail myself of, because this restaurant is definitely the last resort.
Nostalgic family restaurant. Good cheap food. Ribs were a surprise! Tender and tasty! The Delmonico steak was described as tender with a good grilled taste.

South Philly, PA
Pretty good for cheesy greasy plain pizza. My family ordered from there last night. They saved me some since I wasn't home for din din. I looked at the name of the pizza and wondered where is this? Lol. Took a slice. Not bad. Reading Yelp reviews. I guess I will have to try more things to get a better feel of all the ooo la la about this place. O they sing here...Niceee. 3.5 stars.
I've done this place twice now. Both times I've come away extremely impressed. Quality food at great prices.

Excellent meal and service. Seabass was exceptional and ribeye steak was perfect. Manager Seth checked on us several times to make sure all was ok. Lots of people here for special occasion dinners. We will definitely come back!

It may sound strange, but the first word that comes to mind when I think of the Florida Acquarium is "adorable".  I have been to several  larger aquariums in other cities and in comparison, this acquarium is small and compact, but still very fun and dare I say..."educational" for children (and adults!).   This Tampa acquarium can be completeted in just a couple of hours or longer, depending on the amount of shows one attends or the extra 'adventures" one adds on (each at an extra cost).

The acquarium is indoors, except for the "Explore A Shore Overlook", which has a pirate ship/splash zone.  The building has two floors which are jam packed with wild life. Some highlights include a "Wetlands Trail" with gators, otters, birds, etc.  We loved the colorful "Journey to Madagascar" with lemurs, gecko's, and hissing cockaroaches!  "Bays & Beaches" had more of the traditional fish, including sharks and Stingray Beach. "Coral Reefs" included many types of exotic saltwater fish & eels.  I never knew there were so many different types of sea horses until I saw the "Dragons Down Under" exhibit.  Finally, "Octomotion" highlighted jellies, crabs, and schools of thousands of fish.

There are many interactive shows and feedings.  In order to catch them, you have to check your guide and plan your time really well.  We added two "adventures" to our day.  I do not remember the cost of each but the Stingray Adventure was very reasonable and well worth it.  An acquarium educator first took our small group to the area where all the food is prepared for the animals.  Seeing where and how all of that food is prepared is totally fascinating.  The educator then told us all about stingrays and how to effectively feed them.  The rest of the time was spent feeding the stingrays.  I have fed stingrays at other venues, but the education part was well worth the price. I only wish they had given us a little more fish for the stingrays but I guess they have a limited amouint they can eat at a time.

Our second adventure was the "Penguins Backsage Pass".  This was a lot pricier but a great experience as well.. A penguin biologist took our family and just another couple to where the penguins who were not on display were kept.  There were a lot of them!  Of course we learned all about the penguins.  We were given a chance to touch and even hug the penguins.  Needless to say, the kids loved the experience!

Overall, the Florida Acquarium is a fun, educational, and yes, "adorable" venue.  I do wish we had something similar here in the Fort Lauderdale area as my kids love to look at fish and wildlife.  If something like that was here, I wiuld surely become a member as the admission was somewhat pricey, above $20 for adullts.  There are discounts in every tourist magazine you see and I hear there are occasional groupons.

I didn't even bother reviewing some of the bars on tonight's pub crawl but this place demands a review.

Right on main street in Manayunk.  The beer selection and the specials are tasty and cheap.  I am going to have to come back here and try more things off the menu.  I am only rating this place as a bar but as a bar it is top notch and clean.

I was there on a dead night so I don't know how they manage a crowd but the old man behind the bar was friendly and welcoming.

Perfect spot for lunch with incredible deli sandwiches! We're from out of town and a friend recommended we give this place a try. We came here right before venturing across the street to taste some wine and had a hard time choosing what to order as they had a good size menu with a ton of really tasty sandwich and salad options. They also had a large selection of vegetarian sandwiches. We ended up ordering the #12 Roast Chicken w/ Pesto, Pine Nuts, Feta Cheese & Sun-Dried Tomatos and the #14 Roast Chicken w/ Prosciutto. Both sandwiches were absolutely phenomenal and had incredible flavor! This location also had a bunch of tables set up outside so it was enjoyable to dine outside and enjoy the nice weather. Wish we had one of these back home!!

I usually have someone pickup a to-go order. 99% of the time I order the same thing. Spring rolls and a #30.

The last 2 times ive done that ive gotten summer rolls and they charged $6.50 for them. Summer rolls are $4.50 according to there menu. I cant eat seafood so i prettymuch have to toss them because summer rolls are just weird. Nobody will eat them. 

Its too far to drive to bring the things back so I figured I would just leave a review on here. Maybe they will start to check things before just throwing them in a box. I guess they do this alot and try to push off mess-ups in the kitchen on something already made to the to-go orders.

The first U.S. Post Office! We stopped here after visiting the Ben Franklin Museum and had to mail a letter. Since this is the first post office in U.S. history, it provides only basic services, but the help was friendly and the experience was memorable!

The food is consistently good here. Nothing super-great or fancy or overly amazing or even that original, but consistently GOOD, all the time. 

All day breakfast, yummy eggs and pancakes, giant giant giant salads that you can, like at all the mg locations, mix and match with whatever you like. And consistently interesting enough specials. 

Also, soup. MMM. Matzo ball soup. MMM. 

And the manager, Renee is the sweetest person in history.

Very good place! Clean, nicely decorated and the service was wonderful and punctual. My friend and I both had the steak salad, it was filling and tasted great. Finished our meal off with crime brûlée = yummy! They have both indoor and outdoor seating. Can't want to have the filet next time with the cauliflower rice!

This place is nestled into the confluence of two south Philly streets. This makes for a unique space.

I really wanted to be blown away by this spot seeing as it made the Yelp Top 100 of 2020.

We started with pupusas. These were excellent. The pastry was fresh. The dough was super flavorful and perfectly executed. The pork and cheese filling was well executed and flavors distinct and balanced.

For my main, I made the mistake of ordering the Salvadorian enchiladas. This is a miss. Its a few crunchy tortillas topped with chopped chicken, cabbage, tomato, and queso fresco.

The flavor was overtly bitter and the dish lacked a redeeming savory element.

Granted, the server did kindly warn me this was an "adventurous" dish. Adventurous? No. Just mediocre. Next time I'll get something else and probably enjoy it more. Until then, I'm ambivalent on El Bocado.

In my opinion, Mino is the best sushi establishment in the Malvern area; perhaps in Chester County. The food is well prepared. The menu has a large selection. The prices are reasonable. The service is top notch. Well done, Mino!

LOVE Kelli with her magic foils and fingers! I always drive home looking at my beautiful hair in the rear view mirror. Been going for over 3 years, love the family feel and wouldn't go elsewhere if you paid me.

Very nice selection of products.  Unfortunately, you have to expect to be the ignored when you arrive in their showroom.  After standing around in their showroom for over ten minutes and having the ladies working their ignore me, I simply walked out.  I guess if you don't come in with an interior designer you are going invisible to them....

I got there and they couldn't tell me when my dog would be done bc there were many other dogs even though I scheduled ahead of time. My dog gets done in 3-4 hours and he looks hideous. Almost all his fur was shaved off when I specifically asked them not to shave a lot, and it looked like his ears were in pigtails. He came back looking pink and his underside had clipper burns everywhere. The poor guy has been licking down there like crazy. Not to mention that my dog's breed (maltipoo) is notoriously known for having sensitive skin and allergies, yet they put the most heavy type of perfume or powder on him. He's been itching his entire body for days. I could've shaved my dog better for zero bucks if I wanted to. Not ever coming back here. It seemed so unorganized and careless.

The first thing I do in a new city is look for a local cafe serious about coffee. This little place hit the spot. It's pretty small, but I went at 8am on a Sunday morning and there were plenty of seats available for me to relax. The menu is also small but perfectly adequate. 

I ordered the Orange Cold Brew and was REALLY pleasantly surprised. It was full of whole orange segments (I was expecting something more subtle like some invisible orange essence). 

I will DEFINITELY be back to order this over the next few days while I'm in Tampa.
Catfish is amazing! Service was timely and friendly. Good margarita and perfect location...

The Alpine Shop did a great job mounting my rossi bindings on my atomic automatic's. I was skeptical at first about having a shop in the midwest do the mount, but the mount is clean, flush, centered, and fit to my boots perfectly. The DIN was set right where I expected it to be given the information I provided. When my ego grew larger than my talents on a recent trip to Vail, the skis ejected at the appropriate time. Thanks for the great job, guys!

I love black lab for their great service and wonderful dinner, This time I went for brunch, eggs and bacon don't seem to be their strong point.

Crab eggs benedict: I decided to get this because of how great their crab cakes are, the crab was tasty however the poached eggs were way overcooked and the hollandaise sauce was nothing special and had no taste

French toast: a lot of toast, I enjoyed the whipped cream cheese topping. Could have used more berries. The french toast was bordering on soggy
The coffee and service were fantastic however. Probably not coming back for brunch, dinner is definitely their strong suite.

I go to Flix about 10-12 times per year with my wife.  We love movies, brewery's and food.  Flix has figured out how to deliver a solid product and great service that incorporate all 3.  I recently had an issue where a movie voucher I had been trying to redeem would not work after multiple attempts, over about a 7 month period.  The voucher was about to expire, so I called in because my wife and I wanted to see Fantastic Beasts on that night.  The voucher didn't include this movie because it had just come out.  I left a message for management about my frustrations with the voucher and received an immediate called back.  Flix employees Rob, Scott and Kimberly put their heads together to make this right.  They offered us 2 complimentary tickets and the best seats in the house.  I'm not a big fan of asking for handouts and they made it very easy on me, which I very much appreciate.  They went above and beyond for me and I'm grateful.  See you in about 3 weeks, Flix.  Thanks again.


-Eric Scott

Wow--maybe the most disappointing dining experience in long, long time. Service was extremely slow, there were out of so many things (several beers on the menu, queso, mayonnaise,etc.). The food was salty and cold. This was just all around bad.

I new to this vegan journey and the nacho tot did not disappoint! They were amazing! I will return and try other options on the menu. Currently they are only doing takeout but service was quick and easy. They suggest you place the order online but for some reason I wasn't able to get to the website so they took my order over the phone. A must try even for non-vegan folks

I have use this FedEx location quite a number of times over the last several years and I am always satisfied with the service provided. I think everybody is familiar with FedEx- generally good reliable shipping and generally reasonable rates. So my comments here are related specifically to this FedEx outlet at 20th and Market. 

I find the people who work here always to be pleasant and helpful and knowledgeable. The store is clean and well organized, large enough that it doesn't feel crowded, and they always have available the materials and services that I need. If I'm not sure what is the proper way to ship something, the people will take their time and help figure it out for me. On my visits things are usually efficient, although I don't generally come during the business day so I can't speak to that, but evenings and weekends are good.

I always come away satisfied with the service that I receive.

leather chair ambiance 
quiet and dark
if you are looking for a gift art book
or buy books for their fine binding
you may like this book store

section is very very limited

no trade size paperback books

if you like to root around in the stacks
if you like books piled in the corners 
and stacked on the floor this is not 
your book store 

pity Phoenix books is closed
