Not sure how I've never stumbled across this place in the past but I'm glad a buddy brought me in here for a beer today. The owner, Paul, was bartending when we came in. Super nice guy. Engaging with his customers. Awesome draft list. Tons of tequila options. Squeezing fresh juice for cocktails. This is definitely a spot I will venture to more often. Great vibe. Sounds like they will be doing some events with live bands and food trucks in July as well. No masks either! Great to see people's faces again. All said, great beer, great customer service, great vibe. You won't be disappointed with this spot.

Not sure how the bar manager made it to adulthood. Paying cash was a foreign concept, almost as foreign as making change. They have three local beers on tap so there's that. Happy hour could be happier but so could your mom.

Fantastic service and atmosphere! I wanted to do something special for my 30th birthday and this was PERFECT. My friends and I booked a booth ( The Epernay package for 6, it was the best deal ) through their website for 8pm. 

We had no idea what to expect but we were quickly captivated by the whole experience. The atmosphere definitely has that speak-easy feeling as you're walking into the building (I wasn't sure we were even in the right place, which kinda added to the fun!) but then I saw the line out the door and realized we must be. I wasn't sure what to expect but I must say I was genuinely surprised to see the place was BUMPING! They were so busy!

It was everything I was hoping for! The acoustic music was just short of magical! From the service (Thanks, Molly!) to the candle-lit marble tables, to the perfectly placed succulents, even the lighting fixtures were perfect (wine barrels, how clever!). 

My birthday was made even more spectacular by the complimentary glass of birthday champagne the Somm, Patrick brought me. I spent the first evening of my thirties laughing until it hurt with close friends in a warm and intimate atmosphere. This is my favorite birthday to-date and I'm going to be telling ALL my friends to check this place out!

PS- BUY TICKETS IN ADVANCE! They are totally worth it!! They had a line out the door when we arrived at 8pm and these tickets saved our seats & included a free glass of bubbly!!
Great place for dum sun. Find Chinese friends go with five people have a blast to the unusual
I would have given no stars if that was an option. Hamburger was cold over cooked and the bun tasteless. Plus, at $6.50+ it was a rip off.

If you are looking for a nice place to live don't choose this place! If you choose to live here know that you will hear souped up vehicles roaring their engines up and down McKinley as well as in the complex all hours of the day and night. There are a lot of younger students that live here ( USF is down the street) who are not respectful at all noisy cars aside. When you walk around the lake to walk your dog you will see dog poop everywhere (even though there are designated dog bag areas). This place used to be nice but has went downhill with the people who they let move in. Stay away! You can find better for what you spend here. 
The one good thing about this place is the maintence people and the lawn care.

At this point I've nothing else to believe about Buckbean and their beer beyond the obvious fact that it's a joke and a gimmick.  They can their beer.  OK.  They could pour their beer into filet mignon, wrap it in apple smoked bacon and deep fry it, and the whole thing would still leave me searching for my Boston Terriers ass to lick only to get the taste of their schwill off my tongue.  I could take a dump into an aluminum can, and it would still just be a can full of shit.

Their two staples, which I've had off and on throughout the past few years since they opened doors in Reno in 2007, were relatively flat, unbalanced and pedestrian in flavor.  Orange Blossom and some red ale named after a duck.  I couldn't tell the difference, the experience was too close to drinking a glass of tap water.

So I was reluctant when my girl told me she had a growler coupon to cash in there.  It was a good deal and I was short on cash for my weekend buzz so I quiesced.  My past experience interacting w/ Dan Kahn and a few other folks there has been an attitude of aloof condensation and so I didn't have high hopes for personality, but I did want my growlers filled for cheap so I was willing to tolerate it.

The bartender this Friday apparently made a point of not dispelling my preconceived prejudice against Buckbean.  He was vapid and distracted, and knew nothing about the beer he was serving.  The further events were uneventful... had a pint, taste just OK, gathered our booty and went home.

It was when I got home and really poured into the two beers we had filled our growlers with; an IPA and the Duck Piss Red or some such name which was supposed to be an amber.  To qualify, prior to leaving the house, I washed both growlers with dish soap and rinsed and then a drop of iodine and rinsed thoroughly.  They were both sterile and clean.  Both beers were entirely overwhelmed by Diacetyl.  It's a bacterial byproduct of fermentation and skilled brewers can control it, and actually use it to enhance their beers flavor given certain malt combos, but we're talking about Dan Kahn here.  The buttery, creamy, carmel sickness... even on the IPA was just disgusting.  Waste of $10.  Both growlers were down the drain as that's the only place for Buckbean's schwill.  I've lived in Reno a long time and there are some really quality brewers and beers coming out of this town.  Buckbean is just a disgrace.

A review based off of one flavor? That's right. Out of the few places I get my fro-yo in this awesome city of ours, Berry Sweet is the only place I've been able to get the sea salt caramel pretzel (or whatever it's called) and it's absolutely heavenly. The only thing I don't like about this place is the way they give you samples. They actually fill the little cup for you, so does that mean if they're super busy I get no samples? I'm all about customer service and I'm iffy about a place that can't trust me to fill a tiny paper cup on my own. I mean really, how much yogurt can a person fit in that thing for them to worry about customer sampling too much? Any who, the yogurt is still good, so I'll be back.

I totally recommend True Blue Salon. This was my first visit and I saw Tyler. He is very knowledgeable, kind and takes the time to listen. If you are looking for a colorist to correct your color, get a touch up or a complete change, you need to see Tyler.

I needed my wisdom teeth pulled and they got me in the following week when I made my initial call. They followed up with an estimate on the cost and they gave an overestimate just in case, which was nice because my final bill was $70 less than what I was expecting. The staff was very friendly and comforting, which was important for me as that was my first time getting anesthesia. The anesthesia made the surgery feel like a blink, and the only pain I felt was the pinch of the IV needle. I highly recommend them based on the service, efficiency and how well the procedure went.

My first time having sushi I was a little nervous. But it was so good! Also the menu is very creative and has a lot of variety. Everything was very fresh. Great service. A little cozy, but even going in with 5-6 people is easily accommodated. Great spot for sushi!

Been there a few times with my girlfriend and has always been a good time. The ambience is what really sells it. The serving size is on the small side but everything is tasty. The bartenders are very talented & Make sure to try the cocktail "Ruby slipper". The only real complaint I have is the lack of mask wearing, even when someone has it on it's always below their nose if not just below their mouth. 

Also make sure to get a reservation several hours earlier to make sure you have a spot. The place gets packed quick.

When we visit Philadelphia we always make it a point to stop at New Harmony. Even if it's just to get an insane amount of food to take home. If time allows we will sit in and dine and still take home tons of food. The service is always fast and friendly. The seating is a little tight and parking can be difficult. We always park at a near by parking garage to make it easier. We've never had anything that we didn't like here. Everything is amazing. Even non vegan and non vegetarian family and friends love this place. It's so nice to enjoy things like pork buns, beef buns, sticky rice with beans and pork in the middle and know that it's all vegan!

First time eating here and my last. Warning to all, just visit the restrooms and you will be grossed out. They smell like a sewer, They were dirty , both toilets had been used and not flushed! The sink to wash your hands has never been cleaned. Now I should have figured this out and walked out but decided to give it a try. The buffet had no food left, picked through and all dried up. Kind of like dog food! Furniture old, carpet dirty. 
When the restrooms are dirty you could only imagine what the kitchen looks like. Staff worked like robots with no personality. 
Food is cheap but tastes cheap! 
DO NOT EAT HERE!

Stopped in for a late night bite since this was close to my hotel and had to order from the bar. I kind of was disappointed that the menu selection was so limited. However, I ordered the fresh plump burger and garlic fries which had me licking my fingers. I have never had garlic fries before and found the smell and taste to be intoxicating. I will definitely order again. Great job GB for getting me to try something different and completely fall in love with it.

I came here with my boyfriend for the purpose of eaten by oysters and maybe drink a couple beers. Upon entering we noticed the crowd was all older men and women, which seems to be pretty common in the area I suppose, this did not bother us since we weren't looking for a party atmosphere. The bartender, a young girl, took our orders and served us two beers, after sitting for only about 3 min I noticed her attitude was slightly offensive considering the patrons were an older crowd. Instead of simply saying thank you to her 60+ aged customers, she replied "spank you very hard". Me and my bf sat quietly while she continued to make sexual comments to her older guests. She then commented to my bf about a hickey on his neck, he is Russian so he didn't under what she was saying, so naturally he looked puzzled, she made him feel uncomfortable by engaging in conversation about his hickey with the old woman sitting next to us. During her conversation with the woman, she told her about a hickey she had on her boob,...I think her conversation was super inappropriate! And maybe the older regulars didn't mind her, but the way I was raised, you don't talk like that to or around older people, I felt like I was talking to to a bartender in a strip club rather than a beach bar! Luckily they had a shift change and we don't have to listen to her anymore! Other than that, we ordered oysters and peel n eat shrimp, bother were ok tasting. Oysters were better than the shrimp,...

Ok, total disclaimer.  I've been going to this Camellia Grill since I was in high school (I was in the last class when Franklin was in the old building before we moved to the UNO campus) so it's been like 20 years!  These guys know me so well that we're like family!

With that being said, my regular is the dressed cheeseburger, chili cheese fries (which now gets rough because I'm getting older and the gas is killing me! hehe) and the chocolate freeze.  

It makes me laugh when I see tourists coming off the streetcar to line up in Camellia Grill but hey, I guess it is a New Orleans institution.  I just remember my first memory being there packed during lunch (in high school), eating across from my best friend on the counter, and then having to get my food to go because we only had a limited time for lunch so I had to eat my food in my Spanish class in the trailer! hehe...

This is my go to place after going out (which I don't do very often).  I've also explored different foods and really enjoyed the grilled cheese with bacon.  One of my friends really enjoys the Doc special (?) with the double burger on bread.  Plus friends have had omelets, waffles, etc.  I also enjoy the pecan pie...yummy! *sigh* Oh, and my bestie swears by the orange freeze, but he loves orange drinks so what are you going to do! hehe

Came here in search of puppy snacks. Monster Pet's looks like it closed down some sections of their store. The variety of products here are great. Pricey. Seems like they specialize in the fishes more so then other pets. Tons of puppy and cat stuff.

They also have rodents, spiders and lizards sold here. Creepy and scary for some of us but a cool place for kids to explore.

I ordered pizza here when I visited my parents. It's baller. 

Seriously. 

Honey Mustard Chicken Pizza? 
Baller.

Bacon Cheeseburger Pizza?
Baller.

Taco Pizza?
Baller.

Also, did I mention that it is all diet food? 
Because, if I did, I was lying.

We waited outside for approximately 30-45 mins on a Sunday. The food was well worth the wait! I went to this place because a coworker recommended it and I definitely approve! Good sweet tea as well! The jam was a hit too! I ordered the chicken with biscuit and sausage gravy and it was pretty good! The food came within a reasonable time

This was perhaps the worst experience I have ever had at a restaurant. The employees were not very helpful and got my order wrong twice. The bun on my hamburger was soggy from all of the grease! And to top it all off I had to wait 30 minutes before I got my food, which was wrong. People who came after me were getting their orders and I wasn't. Worst experience ever, DO NOT GO HERE!

Great coffee shop with superb coffee, good prices, ample seating, tons of outlets, good music, and a nice selection of food choices. They also have an app where you can order and pay ahead of time and pick up your order with no wait. 

I don't know how I didn't see this coffee shop sooner since I've walked past it numerous times, but I discovered it through Yelp when looking for coffee shops near me. There is free WiFi and there are plenty of tables and outlets and people on laptops, so it's the perfect place to sit down for a couple hours and get some work done. 

The interior is very spacious with different seating options and the vibe is chill. I don't get a hipster or pretentious vibe from this place, which is something I try to avoid in coffee shops. 

They don't have a huge selection of flavored lattes or a giant menu, but their coffee and lattes are delicious so I don't think they need a novel-sized menu, and the prices are reasonable. They also have self-serve still or sparkling water on tap, which is really nice.

While this Home Depot is quite the mecca, it doesn't help me when I can't find anything. Yes I can find the plants and yes I can locate the wood, but everything in between is a mystery to me...

I get a little intimidated in hardware stores so I tend to start speed jogging around the aisles so that no dudes think I look helpless and try to schmooze me with their hardware store know-how or ask me "whatcha makin'?" The worst. This tends to happen 1 out of 3 times if I'm not moving at break neck speeds. Too bad the dudes offering assistance aren't wearing the orange aprons of the staff or else this would be helpful. 

I've gone to this location a few times, and maybe the times I'm there is "let's block off the aisles and look too busy to answer questions" time. I feel like I'm being a bother when asking where to find contact paper for shelving. I get waved in a general direction, where I find a meh selection of contact paper in this ginormous Depot. I've also been here before to try and find cedar for a garden box, was directed in the area of wood, where, alas, after 10 minutes of power walking around the wood section was finally told, "oh yeah, we don't have cedar." 

I just don't understand how it's bigger with just as little stuff in the area of my needs as other home improvement stores that are smaller. SO yeah, I've experienced better.

I miss the days of " time to make the donuts". They no longer taste fresh like when they were made in store.

I know a lot of people like their breakfast but I have never enjoyed it.

Donuts and coffee are pretty decent.

Always have issues ordering online. No big deal. So I call in my order. A salad and sandwich combo. Open my salad only one cucumber which is slimey and gross. Then notice the lettuce is just as wet and slimey. Super bummed about this visit. And it's honestly not the first time it's happened

One word to describe this place.... Humble. It has great music. The bartender lady and the bouncers were awesome(I forget their names/Thursday night). It's nothing fancy but worth going to. I would definitely go there more often if they had a karaoke patio and board games, etc.  Definitely give it a try ;)  
Or as Shia Labeouf would say, "Just do it!"

We dined at Bern's on July 3rd and was definitely a unique experience.  My 3 star review might be slightly harsh as I was comparing it to the steak restaurants in NYC.  We started in the dining room with cocktails (which were not that impressive).  The highlight of the meal were the two appetizers we ordered (the hamachi sushi and taratare and the truffle steak taratare).  Would highly recommend both.  We ordered the 21 ounce porterhouse (which was enough steak for the both of us).  The filet of the porterhouse was very good but the strip was tough (even at medium rare) to eat.  We enjoyed all the items that came with it (the French onion soup, salad and onion rings).  Definitely more than enough food for 2.  Afterwards we went to the dessert room and had the brown sugar (underwhelming) and the banana bread pudding (which was pretty good).  The highlight was the Hungarian (and all different types) of dessert wine.  Amazing wine selection but we weren't in the mood for it last night.  Definitely an opulent experience and even with my three star review would recommend people try it.
Wonderful service! Fast and Easy. The repairmen were incredibly knowledgeable and polite! Very happy with the outcome.
Filthy and ghetto as hell. If you make it out of this place and don't need a tetanus shot you are immune to Coronavirus

My wife and i stopped here for some drinks and an App. We had the Top Shelf combo appetizer, which consisted of Spicy jack cheese wedges, loaded potato skins, , and the famous chicken tenders. It was very good. Ot came out within 10 minutes. Our server Ashkey was amazing. She was  the epitome of Southern Hospitality. She was nice , engaging , and helpful. I know she had a wonderful smile under the face covering too. The spicy jack cheese wedges were amazing. So yelpers give them a try and ask for Ashley.

The menu was very interesting and prices not bad, but the portions were small. The inside is dark and decorated like an old diner. But we still thoroughly enjoyed, good service and yummy mexican food which is hard to get in the city. Very similar to distrito and el vez in the menu items. Loved the corn quesidella.  We may go back.

This was the first bar on Broadway we ended up hopping into, solely because the music coming out of it was stellar. While this bar doesn't have as much room to dance as others, I felt that each night I visited the music was miles better than anything around - and isn't that the whole point of Nashville? 

Great bar, great music, great atmosphere. One of the top spots on Broadway.

I've been coming to the Tucson gem show for twenty years.  I ALWAYS went to el Charro's for authentic Mexican food.... Well, I found a local true Mexican restaurant.  

It was such great food and service I thought it was a chain!!!!!!!

Not..... In town you must come here from great food and even a better time

Just tried Salt + Smoke for the first time & will definitely be back! I ordered the brisket sandwich and mac & cheese- It was amazing! Although the restaurant was very busy our waitress was attentive and food came out quick. The manager also stopped by several tables to check in and thank customers for dining with them. I would recommend this place to anyone looking for a great meal with friendly service.

I love Kim's work-I wish I could give her more stars! I've been going to her for over a year now and her work is meticulous. She tailors my lashes to my style, length, and eye shape. I normally get a set of volume lashes and Kim makes them look so natural and I can go 3-4 weeks between fills. Definitely go to Kim for your lashes!

After reading the other reviews I feel kind of bad saying so, but our group was underwhelmed. We found the service friendly but a bit slow (we got our appetizers before our drinks). Maybe the grill is the better option, but we all ordered off the a la carte menu and found the food kind of bland. We asked each other what we thought and said everything was okay, but we probably wouldn't order it again. My friend has trouble with chopsticks and asked for cutlery and was told no - they don't have any. We asked if she'd look anyway and she returned with some after all. For dessert I was excited to try the cheesecake, but was served the tiniest thumbelina-sized piece of cake I've ever received. It as well was just okay. I may come again to try out the grill but wasn't wowed this time around.
Great fresh rolls, and Carmen's Hoagies located on premises. Good combo. Fresh doughnuts too......

I did not have a good experience at all. I went in for the price of groupon deal. $89 for full highlights and cut. I was Upsold to add in lowlights and glaze and root touch up. Sure why not. I told my stylist please do not put lots if layers in my hair because it just looks choppy and poofs out. She said she would do long layer and take 1/2 inch off. What I ended up with is spending twice as much for highlights that look streaky and my hair is now darker then I started with. 
Now to the cut. My hair that was down to my bra strap is now barely to my shoulders . Seems my long layer is pretty much all of my hair with a few pieces a little longer . The layers itself are uneven one side to my shoulder the other to my neck. 
At this point I am just trying to not look at myself in the mirror. I  not going to mention any names but beware of stylists offering "deals" on Facebook

First time here and I really enjoyed it. I ordered 1 pound of the shrimp (head on) and added potatoes and sausage. For the seasoning, I chose Mr & Mrs Crab Special (All above). IT was too good! Perfect mix of all the other seasonings. The shrimp was really good and tasted fresh. I had more than enough food and could not finish the entire boil in one sitting. Pretty good place to try.
Great customer relations. The work on our RV was done on time and as promised. They answered our questions and did not push unnecessary repairs.

One of the worst hotel experiences I have ever had. I have had better service at a $60 motel. We arrived late and they provided no help with our bags and we were traveling with my elderly grandmother. We asked to use a cart and they did not let us and it is a 5-10 minute walk from the self parking lot to our room. On one of our trips to and from the car at 11pm, we passed a hotel staff member who did not offer his assistance with our bags. At check-in they didn't inform us that the valet parking was only $5 more or we would have done that and had help with our luggage. We called to get more coffee the next morning (they only provided 2 pods and we had 4 people staying in the room) and they never came. When we came back to the room we found that housekeeping did not come, and when we asked about it, they said you needed to request it 24 hours in advance. We were also not told this at check-in. The cold water knob on the faucet was broken in our room. Nothing special about the rooms either. We expected much more from a $300+ a night hotel. Save your money!!!!

Came here a few times with friends during happy hour and really enjoyed it. I even decided to bring my visiting parents here and they enjoyed it as well.

Today I decided to come in after a workout to try the tuna salad. I was told that there would be a 50 minute wait even though many tables were open and socially distanced. Whatever, we decided to wait. Ten minutes in our table was ready, I knew that had tables open lol. After they told us the table was open we walked over and had to wait about 10 more minutes for them to clean it.

We ordered appetizers, one of the special chicken and waffle beignets and the crab beignets. We got them after about 45 minutes. Then waited another 10 minutes for silverware. After eating them no one came to check on us and here I am another 45 MINUTES LATER, WAITING ON MY SALAD. A SALAD. Haven't been checked on.

I also watched multiple other people have to get up and ask for the check 

Probably won't come back here. Jeez, this is sad.

I ordered a meatball sandwich to eat in and a Ham & Cheese for my wife to go ( she works next door at Harley Davidson)  My Meatball sandwich would have been the best I have ever had if it were hot. It was luke warm in the middle. Her Ham & Cheese was the same way. I will go back only because the meatball sandwich had great flavor and I would like to have one prepared properly. ( It was 11:30 am and they were not busy?) I have heard great things about the pizza so another trip back is the plan but it will have to be better or it will be the last
Love love love this place. The teriyaki mushroom burger is fantastic!

OK so this morning before work I wanted to get a slice of pie,so I stopped in,great.Since I work only a few doors down and am swamped with repairs I decided to hit up ole Jacks for a quick sandwich of pork shoulder.
  Now mind you this doesn't happen often,in fact I can't believe I'm doing this BUT,the meat was or rather(I'm still struggling with the sandwich)so tough and dried out I'm thinking of ditching it and heading up the hill (4th ave.) to the Arcade for something better...... dammit!

We did take out from Jazmine last Friday night. Ever since we have been in Reno, we have been looking for good hot and sour soup. I think we found it!! The yin and yang of the hot and sour was just right and the taste was phenomenal. The soup also contained a lot of meat in it and could have been a meal in itself. We also ordered chicken chow mien and vegetable fried rice. Both were wonderful. We will definitely be back!!
Good atmosphere, clean environment and friendly staff. Great place to relax and have your nails done.

I would LOVE to try something else on the menu, but why would you do that when the Pizza is all you need?

I ordered a cheese for my wife, and I believe I had a meat specialty pizza.

It's perfectly crispy, packed full of great toppings, AND the cheese pizza had a layer of cheese baked into the bottom of the pie.

I've never had anything like this before, and it's basically the best pizza I've ever had.

My four star review is really just because I need to try something else from here before I inevitably give it five.
Verchio's has great prices and quality products, but their cashier Nancy is rude and nasty, I will be sure to avoid her line next time I go!

No one likes blood work but this spot is quick and makes the bloodletting relatively painless.

I showed up. Handed them the orders from my doctor's office. Waited, maybe 2 minutes and that was it. 

The person drawing blood was friendly and did a good job of distraction while she found a vein with her sharp. Then a couple of vials later, done.

Only thing else I could really ask for was a lollipop because I didn't cry.

Loved everything about it! Wine was very good (6-7 out of 10...not bad for Delco/Chesco winery ;-) BUT the location/ambiance is AMAZINGLY beautiful. We will most certainly return. LIGHT years better than some of the other local wineries. Just fantastic...really!
Love Love Love! Great staff all the time and food is fresh!! Worth your buck!

Needed an item and asked a female employee for instructions on where to find it. She didn't even stop to talk to me when I asked her a question, she kept walking and simply yelled back stating flex seal in the paint section." Didn't even make eye contact, very rude all around. Spent ten minutes looking for the spray and turns out they moved it. The only reason I'm giving four stars is because Bret helped me find what I was looking for.
Food always comes out quickly and hot, hot, hot!  During COVID, they've made to go ordering very easy - as well as the pick up.  Food is always cooked correctly and tastes so good!
Closed down. We made reservations for today, Friday, May 11 at 7 pm. They are not open for business on a Friday night.

Great nail spa! Friendly vibe, attentive staff, and excellent mani pedi services! Nice to get consistent high quality service from people who genuinely appreciate Their customers. For these reasons and more, I highly recommend!

My wife and I finally tried Woodfire last night. To be honest, we were hesitant to eat here based on the reviews here on yelp, but decided to give it a shot. We were not disappointed. We both had filet and started with the meat and cheese appetizer. The food was great and well priced compared to the equivalent in the Nashville scene. The only reason I didn't give it 5 stars is that I feel that the wait staff are not as attentive as you would expect at this price point. Glad to see a non chain restaurant her in MJ.
Just awesome! A wonderful local joint but still fancy. Fantastic sandwiches and wonderful salads! Looking for a great local meal on the lighter side.

Tony- I came back TWICE on the SAME day and Tom still could not fix them because they were too thick and uneven!!! The color did not match BEFORE HE FILED THEM DOWN -which was ANOTHER HOUR OF MY TIME! I've been getting my nails done longer than some of your staff have been born, so please don't insult my knowledge and the fact I've been a customer of yours for YEARS!!! I left after the second time-angry and frustrated so I returned the third time, different day and different tech because I didn't want Tom again! That's where Sally came in. It took her a long time to get the SNS off... she even commented on how uneven and thick they were. I was charged $20 additional to fix your techs mistakes and lazy work!!! I don't want a dumb gift card I wanted my money back (only the $20 nothing more) because I already paid $60!!!!!! I never should have been charged anything additional for your staff errors!!!!!! Just as you state your time is important well so is mine!! I waisted a total of 4 hours of my time and missed a cookout due to it! So as far as other solons "kicking me out", I doubt that would happen-- I pay and tip well and never have complained except for this time and the more important thing would be OTHER SALONS ARE PROFESSIONAL NOT UNPROFESSIONAL AS YOU HAVE SHOWN- they would assure customer satisfaction!! So good luck and don't expect any nice reviews from me on social media or by word of mouth. I will never enter your place or business again! And for the record I am not trying to teach your techs anything-  but PERHAPS YOU SHOULD SO YOU WONT HAVE DISSATISFIED CUSTOMERS.

On our first night of adventures in New Orleans, we were eager to try many cool places, but at the top of our list was "The Spotted Cat". We'd heard of the cute jazz bar from yelp and wanted to be sure it was our first experience of jazz bars in NOLA. But boy, was that a bad idea. 

If you creep on my yelp page, you'll find that I don't even have a check in at this bar, that's how fast we left. 

After walking all around Frenchman street in heels (not my brightest idea), I immediately wanted to find a place to sit for a second and rest my feet. We found a seat in the back of the bar and were getting ready to get settled in and get some drinks when a lady (I'm assuming a bar employee) comes up, shoves a tip bucket in our face and says "tips for the band?!". Now we've just sat down and the band just started playing a song. I explain to the lady that we will tip on our way out (like most people do) after enjoying a few songs. The lady then gets very rude and huffy and says "if you aren't gonna buy a drink or tip the band then you're just taking up space and you should leave"...and that is exactly what we did. 

I get it. Bands play for tips. This is NOLA, everyone here understands that. But to be badgered for tips as soon as you get in the door, before you've even had a chance to make your way through the crowded bar to buy a drink?? Not a great first impression. 

Lucky for us, there are many other great places to listen to jazz music (like the street performers right outside of the bar), so I'm thinking we didn't miss much.

We were staying next door at the courtyard and had a craving for some food. Walked over her mostly because we wanted to sit outside. My were we surprised. We ordered the chicken and waffles and the scoop of chicken salad. Prices were reasonable and the portions were good. The chicken was hot and soft. The waffle was fresh and hot. Yes it was slightly soggy from the little bit of syrup on there but isn't a waffle meant to get soggy with syrup anyway? Some of these complainers are just extra. Anyway, when we are back in this area we will definitely be back... whether for a small meal like tonight or a larger more filling meal. And I didn't know this was a sister company of Demos and just went there today for lunch! So I guess we are all in the family today!!

I wanted to love this place.  It has a cool idea.  The food is fresh and produced mainly locally.

Everything in there is pretty interesting, down to the bread bowl,  There were long pretzel-like things in there that I had never seen before.  The decor was pretty good, but I kept joking about how the windows had chain-mail curtains, that didn't quite fit.

The food was delicious, but the portions were tiny.  I heard the waiter say that the portions were 'realistically' sized  I ordered butternut squash tortellini (for $23) and received 6 or 7 pieces of moderately sized pasta, with some mystery foam on the top.  I'll say it again, it was delicious, but 6 or 7 pieces for $23???

Sovana Bistro advertises casual dining but, I'm not so sure about that.  My trifted sweater seemed quite out of place.  Perhaps it was my 'cutting edge hairstyle' that delivered us the corner table within elbow-bumping room of the next table (did I mention that It wasn't even busy and there was plenty of room.)   And apparently, the hostess who appeared to be 16 at best decided that I didn't deserve a beverage menu.  I was planning on having one...until  I decided that their profit margin on the butternut squash tortellini would be large enough.

I felt pretty uncomfortable there, but the food was really good and I liked the way it looked.
The tots are the best, the brew is always fabulous & the staff is fabulous! My favorite good time.

I woke up Sunday ready to workout only to discover my car battery was dead. I want to say thank you to Dominic for his wonderful customer service and his great sense of humor. You made a frustrating event bearable and I walked away with a smile! You now have a repeat customer.

Idk how this place has poor reviews! Ignore the bad ones! This place was incredible. I don't even know where to start. 

Upon arrival, we were greeted by Valet and the bell service and they were so friendly. They loaded up all of our luggage and we're so nice. We immediately felt the good vibes. 

Check in: They hired the most friendly and helpful staff. I was greeted by name (contactless check in app helps you upload a pic (optional) so they know who you are when you arrive). They provided my keys and itinerary (we had a Sense Spa yoga session booked) and provided a map. They even upgraded us to the Garden Bungalows. 

The room-holy cow. Beautiful. Modern. Fresh. Big! They have a lovely seating area outside the room and we kept smelling a fresh Rosemary smell that was invigorating! The room was stocked w plenty of beverages (for a fee) and if you didn't want to leave your room, you had plenty of drinks and snacks! The beds were so dreamy and comfortable! We slept so well! The rooms were just so perfect. If you are looking at the price night, the rooms are 100% worth it alone. Not joking. No I'm not rich lol we saved up for this

The property was sooooo big!!! Like huge. We didn't get to fully see everything and yet everything we saw was breath taking. The property just has awesome energy. Every single employee we met was so friendly and if they met us once, they remembered our names during our stay! 

They have a crossing section to get the the beach bar, Caruso's, and the beach and they have a full time staff member making sure there isn't a train coming so you can cross safely. This is when I met CT. He was so awesome and friendly. We chatted for a while and just had this awesome positive energy. He brightened our day when we saw him! 

The pool-We could have just spent all day here. It was amazing. The pool is heated to 82° and felt amazing! The bar had amazing drinks that were fresh and delicious! The bathrooms were super clean and nice and they provide you with a fresh towel and towel blanket to cover ur seat as soon as you arrive. We found ourselves at the pool a ton!

Fire pits! There were so many areas you could bring a drink out to to relax and enjoy the warm fire! The hotel also has a billion lanterns lit in the property which was beautiful and helped keep it perfectly bright at night. Just a sight to be seen. 

Sense Spa yoga on the beach. Well. This was epic. Private session with just our instructor, we did this for an hour and were so zen afterwards that we went back to the room to nap haha it was incredible. 

Revere Dinning-fast. Amazing food. Great service. We had $60 complimentary breakfast passes but spent well over that bc all of the food was incredible!

Food in general-I've never been to a resort or hotel where everything we ate was to die for. The flavors. The portions. The seasoning. All. Amazing!! Hands down the best food around. 

Services-we checked out and were still able to use our key cards for the pool and what not. We stayed forever and did not want to leave!! 

All in all. This is 100% a 5 star hotel. Do not let anyone else tell you any different. This was truly a magical get away. If you have the money for it, and need to get away from stress. From life. Go here. If you need a marriage retreat. Go here and get the couples yoga. Go here and go to Caruso's. Expect to pay for this hotel. Expect to pay for the food. But I'm telling you. It's worth it and we are already trying to plan the next trip here.

This is a great, rather small, spot.  I almost hesitate to bring it attention because it may make it even more difficult for me to get a seat.  It has a very ambitious menu which has always delivered for me.  I am very impressed with the "down home" catfish & shrimp.  They serve a giant yam or sweet potato with butter and maple / brown sugar that makes a great appetizer / meal / dessert.  They permit BYOB, although they do not serve pork, their smoked turkey collard greens are still excellent.  The wait staff is very friendly and I will go again at my next opportunity.  Leave your diet at home.

Deplorable wait time when plenty of tables were readily available but waiting to be cleaned.  For some reason the hostess, that would rather be crashed-out on a couch somewhere else, is responsible for cleaning tables so just don't be in a hurry at this place.  Great food & drink but poorly managed on gameday.

My dad purchased a Groupon for Chappy's and when I came to Nashville to visit, we went there.  It was our first time at the restaurant.  We had not eatten lunch, so we arrived around 5:30pm.  I know that is kind of  "senior supper" early, but it's not that early is it?  The place was empty.  Litterally.  We were the only customers and it was a little sad.  While we were there, more people started to show up though.

I'm surprised other Yelpers have commented negatively on the customer service.  We were welcomed by the hostess the minute we walked through the door and our server was fantastic.  Unfortunately I do no remember his name, but he was tall and cute!

Our server was great.  (Did I mention he was cute?)
Our food was really good.  I had one of the daily specials.  My mom loved her fried shrimp.  My dad ordered a seafood sampler of sorts.  He ordered the one that has catfish.  He liked it but he was unable to get any meat out of the crab.  All three of us loved the fresh baked bread served with four types of butter.  The pimento butter and garlic butter were my favorites.

Our entrees came with small house salads.  I've never met anyone who thinks iceberg lettuce is amazing, so the salad was pretty boring.  The three of us love blue cheese dressing, so that's what we ordered.  The dressing was spicey.  I've never had blue cheese dressing spicey like that, usually it's creamy and you taste the cheese.  I found the spices to overpower the natural flavor of the cheese.

My entree (one of the many daily specials) was served with "voodoo sauce" on the side.  Basically, if you want to kick your meal into spicey hot territory, add the voodoo.  For my taste, I found a little dab would be enough.  I thought the food had a nice pleasent flavor without the voodoo sauce as well.  In other words, they do not rely on the sauce to provide all of the flavor.  

The serving portions were absolutely huge.  I asked for leftovers in a doggie bag and was so delighted when our waiter came back with my food wrapped up like a swan!  I've only seen that done in the movies!  Really fun.  

I agree with the other reviewers who commented on the decor; it is a little strange.

The nurses are superior. Very caring and compassionate. They are kind and take their time with each patient. The admitting and attending physicians are good. Some of them are very difficult to deal with and some do not take time to listen to your complaints and concerns. The other Drs are wonderful and have great bedside manor. The hospital is clean and the wait time in the ER is minimal. The specialists that work out of this hospital are top notch and are excellent in their field. The food leaves a lot to be desired. At times it is ok. Most of the time its hot but also mostly not tasty and very bland.

I've only been to this store twice while visiting Philly but I love it and have to remember to return!
They have a great supply of shampoos and conditioners, nail polish and makeup. I bought 3 different shades of roll on shimmer by NYX which I will use on my eyelids as I channel the '70s &'80s :)  

Rose and Aundrea were friendly and professional. Special thank you to both of them for throwing some complimentary shampoo & conditioner into my bag - perfect for my travels!

Can't wait to return!

So we received info about a Prime Rib Dinner for 2 @ $40 and wanted to call to make sure it was available and make a reservation.  ALL DAY trying to get through - there is no direct phone number for the restaurant an NO ONE answers at Sugarhouse Casino.  They tell you to leave a message - which I did - no call back.  I finally went onto the Fishtown Hops Facebook and messaged them there.  Got a response a few hours later- yes we could come to dinner and yes they are offering the Prime Rib Special. 

After a harrowing 2 hour ride into the city during rush hour we arrive.  Sugarhouse Casino sent me info about comps but when I got there they gave me a different available total. Booo.

We walk into Fishtown Hops - only 2 people drinking at the bar.  Sign says seat yourselves - which we did - at a table for two  - 4 feet from the bar.  Server walks up and says you can't sit here.  No service here only at the bar.  I tell him I messaged them a few hours prior and was told we could do dinner.  He concedes - so we stay at the table.

We order our dinner - in 25 minutes it comes out - prime rib on silver round pizza trays - no kidding.  I ask for horseradish sauce- told quite specifically that he KNOWS they don't have that stuff.  I say ok what about just horseradish- he says probably not but I'll go check - gee thanks!  He reappears 5 minutes later with LO and BEHOLD - horseradish -- but NO SAUCE.  I wanted to tell him - let me go into the kitchen and pull the MAYO- that's how simple it is but at this point it was ridiculous.

At about 7:40 we ask about the dessert that comes with the dinner.  The server  brings it out to us in a To Go container with disposable flatware.  WHAT???  We were going to get another drink and coffee and have dessert overlooking the Delaware.  Guess not!  We had to carry the dessert around with us on the casino floor.  Yikes.

Unbelievable - it would have been better to be told don't come in tonight.  

Freaking silver pizza plates for prime rib! LOL.

Terrible terrible terrible.  It's a shame because we loved the view and the prime rib itself was pretty good.

Poke-chan is my new favorite poke place! This place has extremely fresh ingredients and a lot of variety. I had the regular bowl with yellow tail and spicy salmon. It really tastes so fresh and they give out a good portion. One thing that made me really like this place is that you can get a scoop of snow crab salad without getting charged! It's included. Other poke places charge an extra $1 on top of the $12. They also offer milk teas and sweet handkraft macaron ice cream sandwiches. So no need to drive somewhere else to get dessert! 

I'm not sure if i love or hate the way they do their orders. You get a laminated menu and you get to mark off what you would like included and add notes at the bottom. I don't like how this is set up because that means the order is not made right in front of you compared to other places (other places are like subways styles). Also, some items on the menu I did not know at all. When you go up to where the food is made, the food is not labeled for you to know. I do like it in way because that way you're never behind someone who is indecisive and backs up the line. But then, the line can get backed up bc so many orders are in. I'm just not sure if this way is efficient. 

The only con I would have to say is that you have to street park.

We found the Frog Pond on Yelp and other travel sites. Our experience didn't disappoint!  We stopped for brunch on a Thursday. The place was packed however we were seated quickly. 
The greeter (I assume the owner) was beyond friendly and truly took the time to check with each customer. 

And the food? Omg!  Amazing!  From the French toast to the HUGE omelettes. Attention to freshness and detail was apparent!  Our wait for food was minimal yet everything was cooked to perfection!  

This is most definitely a place we will return should we vacation in the area again!

Best tailor I have ever been too in terms of quality and service. He fit a suit and four pairs of slacks of $200.  My suit, which was a store bought couple hundred dollar suit, now looks like a thousand dollar suit. The pants look and fit great. I also wanted to get shirts done but he told me up front it would be a waste of my money and it would be cheaper just to buy new ones. You have to respect and honest business man.

Go in advance, he takes two weeks since he is quite popular in the area.

I love the history of Lafitte's, and the fact that they chose not to install lights in most of the bar, so it preserves some of the original feel of the place as you drink and talk by candlelight.

BUT, that "from another era" vibe is ruined by the television above the bar, another screen at the bar, and a photo booth. Not to mention the piano music creeping out over the place. I've never been to a piano bar that had good musicians, and after coming here I still haven't.

Apparently the drinks are strong if you're into that sort of thing, so there's that. But for me, this bar makes me think of how much more interesting and wonderful it would be without all of the modern distractions that they have allowed into the place.

This place is ruined for me, and crowded to boot. There is absolutely no reason to come here now.

Staff was very friendly. Service was prompt and dishes were presented well. That is what was good.

I am originally a Colorado native. Colorado is known for their unique version of Green Chile. Therefore, I was very excited to see "Colorado Green Chile" on the menu and ordered a bowl. They need to change the name. While it was an acceptable Chile Verde, it was missing two ingredients always in Colorado Green Chile and the consistency was too thin and watery. More of a stew.

We also ordered the Street Corn Queso. Very thin, runny and bland. I ordered the Jamaican Jerk Chicken tacos. The chicken was shredded with no seasoning. The only thing redeeming it as Jamaican Jerk was a very small amount of spicy jelly drizzled on top. This Jerk jelly was quite good and made the tacos better once I asked for more. The tortilla was a store bought corn tortilla. Fresh made tortillas would be welcomed when offering craft taco's on a menu. My wife had the Shrimp Pappardelle Bowl. We had to laugh about the size of the shrimp. The pappardelle pasta noodles were wider than the shrimp! The calabrese peppers were cut up whole with the core and seeds left intact. It created an off taste to the dish. Finally, my Mexican Street Corn side was cold and bland.

Overall, the food all tasted very bland and unseasoned. I so wanted to like this place and have a place to go for good Colorado Green Chile. Unfortunately, if rating just the food I would have rated two stars. However, the atmosphere was good and the staff was good, resulting in a three star rating.

I can only vouch for the exceptional tomato pie. I have never tried else. I used to go to Corropolese or Conshohocken Bakery for tomato pie but Tony Roni's is my forever favorite. The crust is thin and crispy. The gravy is perfect not too sweet. They have a version called the pavaroti which has provolone under the gravy. It is terrific.

40 minute wait,  not a big deal,  it is what we were quoted.  So they call us up that our table is ready.  We are then stuck standing at the hostess stand for 15 minutes because the staff is slower than dripping Heinz ketchup.  Finally get seated.  20 minutes just to actually get a waitress and drink order.  We order the nachos with chicken as well as beverages.  I think it's sad when we get our nachos before our drinks (note no alcohol was purchased).  Our nachos came out without chicken on them.  We then waited another 35 minutes for our food.  This is without question the worst service I've had.  I will not be returning to this location again.

We love this place.  They are open for dine in and take out.  We dined in recently.  They are following the COVID rules as far as we could see.  Service was excellent and food is always good.  Good selection of local craft beers on tap.

Well not the best looking establishment but the food was pretty great. I ordered the chicken and waffles for a mid day breakfast and I ordered the shrimp and grits for my mom. Like I said the food was tasty but they need to work on either finding a better facility or fixing the one they have.

Breakfast is terrible the sausages are hockey pucks, they have a waffle maker but no waffles! Coffee pot in the room is not there & when you ask for one 2 days in a row they say we'll get one now but never show with one or say sorry we can't find one. They just blow you off. Do yourself a favor and don't stay here!!

Lots happening here from marathons to live music, festivals and celebrations.
The parkway is really enjoyable to walk rather than use by vehicle.

In Europe, markets (farmer's markets as we call them here) are a staple of everyday life. Here they are kind of a novelty but I think we are slowly creeping toward staple. In our house we like to see the market as a necessity.

We try to buy only at the market and not from the grocery store: eggs, bread, jams, sausage/bacon and fresh flowers for home decoration. We easily find these things at this market year-round (ok, maybe not the flowers).

We enjoy purchasing seasonal fruit and vegetables that we don't grow at home or don't grow enough of. Berries are a favorite in the summer in which  multiple vendors provide.

Sweet corn is reallllly popular at this market. You will wait in a line. 

We enjoy purchasing and eating breakfast the market but we find it is expensive for the portion you get - no matter the vendor. Jason Michael Thomas has delicious breakfast sandwiches.

In 2021 the market was not in Broad Ripple 'proper' and that ruffled some feathers. I was personally very pleased to see it at its temporary home at 2nd Presbyterian as I live only a few blocks away.

Everyone that works at the market (market staff, vendors, volunteers...) I have found very friendly and inclusive of everyone in the community.

The market's instagram pack is very usual as a way to see a market 'preview'. I plan ahead what I want to buy based on the preview. 

Our young daughter loves to join us for shopping and a bit to eat... and in the Summer the real attraction are the dogs. So many cute dogs! The live music is a great addition. We buy breakfast and head over to the tables near the music and make a great morning out of it. Music is continued at the Winter market as well (which is currently located in the vacant Macy's).

I hope to see this market continue to expand. We enjoy it very much. My only ask is that the folks running the trash/recycling be a little less condescending when it comes to sorting rubbish.

Aramingo recently did my 3 bedrooms, my hallway, and my stairs. The owner was very helpful with his advice. The price was fair and we decided to move forward with the company. My issue is the only person who really knows anything, is the owner. This means, when you call you have to wait until Ken gets back to you. My husband and I were told we would get 4 of our phone calls returned and they never were. Finally the 5th time I call, I get a prompt phone call back with good news. This is extremely frustrating and I hope they train their employees soon because I fear they're going to put a poor taste in the wrong customers mouth one day. However, The final product was very good quality and great work! The installers were friendly and they had it done all in one day. Ken did a great job at moving this along quickly for us and I appreciated that. I just wish I didn't have to call so many times.

My wife and I received a gift certificate for the Santa Ynez Wine Tour. We booked it in December and turns out we had the bus to ourselves! Dave was our guide and he was the best. He could hear in our voices how beautiful we thought the scenery was so he took us through some back roads so that we could get a better view. He educated us as well as kept us entertained.

We highly recommend this wine tour, it was beautiful, delish and fun. Ask for Dave to be your driver, you won't regret it!

I just finished having heaven on a plate! I had a plate of grilled salmon on a bed of cheese fried grits with poached eggs a skew of shrimp and hollandaise sauce. It had some spinach and sliced grape tomatoes as well. This was absolute perfection.

Fondas shop came recommended to me through a friend and I have not been dissapointed, so much so that Ill have my 3rd appointment in the next few days.    She takes her time creating perfectly shaped, dazzling nails.   Im hooked on the SNS powder dips she uses - they are strong and last like accrylic, can be made long or short AND dont require having to scrape them off like gel.   She also does a bomb pedi & offers complimentary beverages (wine too) while you unwind in her relaxing, welcoming salon.   Highly recommend!
Great food, beautiful beach view.

I ordered some authentic Chinese food from the Chinese menu! I think the English menu has more Americanized food. It's not easy to find outstanding Chinese restaurant like Peking  in this area! Unfortunately, I don't live in Media. Otherwise, I will go there very often!

I like Dr. Hernandez but unfortunately he has a front office manager now that is not customer focused. I have waited for three weeks for some office machine repair so that the glasses I was prescribed over a month ago would be ready. When I called back today I was given an excuse and told I would need to go to a different office so that the order for my lenses could be submitted to the lab. Well, three weeks ago I would probably have been willing to drive a half hour out of my way but since I am already disappointed with the lack of communication and seeming disinterest in resolving  the issue with the broken equipment, or getting me the glasses which I have already paid for in full, I am going to be getting a refund and taking my business elsewhere.

Incredibly priced dinners and beers. Friendly staff and an overall great experience. Sit at the bar if you can, great service with filling up your beers. This place is always packed so have patience with sitting down.

Well, my other post got deleted, so here is my revised version

I had bought some kind of online voucher for this place before I read any reviews. Oh how I wish I had read them first. The owner was extremely unprofessional, he talked the whole time about how great he was and was telling blatant lies about his experience. To be honest, I don't think the machine he was using was even turned on. Maybe because it was " insanely expensive". Well, he over paid because I had NO RESULTS.

PLEASE, google the owner, Suhkdave Seehra or Ultra Medic

Bottom Line:  Long live the old-school barber shop!!  This place is exactly what you need it to be - no nonsense

I started working close to this place so I had to give it a shot.  Its exactly what it looks like; an old school barber shop.
    The guys that work there are professionals and will get you looking sharp, quick.  I have been here a few times and have been to Alex and Pete - both super professional.  Just a couple quick questions and they are off.
    Love the straight razor, tight fade.

thanks, guys

Keep finding my way here when I want great Mexican food and value.  Menu is relatively limited, but what they do, they do very well.  Seems very mom-and-pop-ish in a good way.  People there always seem to be happy to take your order, instead of punching a clock.  I suggest you get 3 tacos, steak, chicken and carnitas to try them all!
The worst pizza I've ever had. Small, low quality, just overall awful pizza. I have never wanted a refund for a pizza before but there's a first time for everything. The wings were ok.

If you are looking for a wax, Kelly is the one. I've lived in New York and LA before moving to Philly for school. Never in either of these places have I received a wax so amazing. My eyebrows are thick and hard to wax and often times people will ruin my shape. Kelly actually saved my brows after years of unprofessional waxes. She's a truly artist.

I was Order a men wallet from store at King of Prussia in Philadelphia Pennsylvania. But did not receive any confirmation or item over 1 week. I keep contact the store and the men who was order the wallet for me. they said call me back after they find out. But never get a phone call from them. Really bad service.

First time in Philly in a long time, staying over near airport and searched for cheesesteaks came across this place. Got a cheesesteak all the way, peppers, onions, ketchup, cheese. It was pretty awesome! Definitely recommend to anyone coming thru Philly to stop there and get your fill.

I've been here twice, once for birthday, and once for my bridal shower. i really like it! the biggest nuisance I would say is the parking, since its so close to south street, but this was at a time when I thought $12 was too much for lot parking - hah and then I moved to new york....but that's another story. back to beau monde, i really like the atmosphere here, the lighting is dim, and the waiters are all really friendly and quirky. I actually find this to be a great place if you're looking to have a coversation. the first time i went, i thought this place is so romantic, which is enhanced by the lovely food. i have tried the smoked salmon crepe, almonds and honey crepe, ham and cheese crepe, and nutella and bananas i wanna say. probably even more since i like to eat off other people's plates. ha...so the salmon one i wasn't so crazy about, its good for like the first 4 bites, but then i think it just becomes too much of that same flavor. the almond and honey is obviously delicious. the ham and cheese is good. and nutella is too, but still will never compare to the streets of the Champs Elysees in Paris. Above Beau Monde is this club, which I went to for my post shower Partayy. The club is fun! the crowd was kind of young, like college-aged, but very entertaining. I remember people pretend double dutching, that was funny. the music was really good too, they would play all different types, so you never knew what to expect, but not enough reggaeton for my taste. anyways, if you're in philly you should go to this place, i really think its a hidden gem.

I'm going to do a musical tribute to POC. Or at least, try. Picture it:New Orleans, 2016. It's been raining. April Rain. As a matter of fact, it's been raining for days. Jazz Fest has been turned into Lake Gentilly. Natives are restless. What are they calling for? Burgers. Served with baked potatoes. FULLY LOADED. Because there's no calories on Sunday. 

The crowd was OUT THE DOOR. They gave our party of 3 a 1 hour wait time. So we went to Court of Two Sisters for rum punches while we waited. Because SERIOUSLY when that place is full you couldn't squeeze a fart out between the chairs. 

Atmosphere-Dark. Loud. It might be smelly but no one knows and no one cares. Wooden chairs, wooden tables...come to think of it, it resembles the mess* of a pirate ship. *mess as in dining hall, not disarray. Well played, POC. Well played. 

There was music playing, and I actually got the server to jam along! 

Bar-as soon as you walk in the door (if your cup size is larger than DD you might have to turn sideways-lol) it's there. It's big, and I have never seen an empty seat. Some member of the staff ALWAYS acknowledges your arrival, and adds you to the waiting list as needed. 

Drinks-I've only ever ordered the Monsoon, but my gfs opted for some of the other fruity/boozy concoctions. We all sampled each other's. They are all good. And BOY DO THEY PACK A PUNCH. And I'm not a lightweight. If you go to POC, order a specialty drink. You can get beer anywhere. Also, I order the smaller size and it's PLENTY. 

Food-do they even have anything other than burgers? I don't know. And I don't care. Because the burgers are the only thing I need from them. Pick your toppings. And your potato fixins. Mushroom, lettuce, tomato, mayo, etc etc. however you like it. Cuz the burger is gonna be big, juicy, perfectly cooked, delivered hot with the tater. Dive in. I have never finished an entire burger, either. 

When your done, sit back, loosen your buckle, and pat yourself on the back. 

Another successful trip on the high seas of Port O Call

Stopped in for some drinks while we were out and about. They had some good options for beer and typical New Orleans cocktails. Kingfisher had pretty decent atmosphere and it seemed people were really having fun....people like us. Service overall was excellent from the bartenders. They were pretty attentive even though at times they were quite busy. Only thing holding me back from 5 stars is Alec. The Jonas Brother look alike was less than enthused to be working in the service industry and was actually a little pompous. Not even a thank you or acknowledgement for our patronage.

Good place to have a quiet lunch on a weekday. Very good hummus, baba ghanouj, chicken sandwich. The Tabouleh was average. Parking was easy to get, though I think very limited for weekends and evenings. Good service.

Let me start off by saying I am addicted to Dunkin Donuts coffee and I have been to DD's from Boston to Florida. This store is the absolute worst. I got a cup of coffee and a sandwich for lunch and was checking my emails for work. I was sitting by myself tucked away from the larger sitting area by the pickup counter and the restaurant was empty. A worker sweeping the floor came over to where I was eating and kept ramming the broom under my table and feet. He must have hit my feet and legs with the broom six times. Finally I said excuse would you mind not doing that. He just kept doing it. When I confronted the manager he told me he (worker) doesn't speak English and in broken English himself said "you can leave  now." Stay away from this store. Deserves less than 1 star.

This is my favorite brunch spot in the city. We go back time and time again. I'm vegetarian but don't let that put you off if you're a meat eater... the meat options look even better!

I've never had whiskey there, but a bloody mary on a Sunday goes down a treat, and they have a great selection of local beers, including some of my favorites, and often they have them on tap.

For food we always start with some of their amazing pickles - usually beets, which come paired with grilled bread, olive tapenade and whipped butter. The olive tapenade could do with being finer chopped and better spiced, but hey.

The veggie burgers come in many variants, and it's pretty much build your own burger. I go for the truffled mushrooms and blue cheese, and it comes with guacamole anyhow. The burgers are slightly curried and very tasty indeed. My only criticism is that the burgers can be a bit crumbly and difficult to hold together. They usually need eating with a knife and fork!

The regular fries are fried in duck fat, but you can order veggie fries which are string fries and pretty good. Make sure you ask for burger and fries at the same time or they can come separately.

They probably have other stuff on the menu but who cares when the burgers are this good!

It has been a pleasure dealing with all the kind and knowledgeable folks at Credo. We have been using their expertise for a few years now... always do a great job as well as a wonderful experience. Highly recommended!
One of the best restaurants I've eaten at in a while. Absolutely fantastic sushi and I HIGHLY recommend the Bulgogi Torta.

Sleeping wise the beds are uncomfortable and the rooms don't really get cold. The floors squeak so much that you can't sleep. When neighbors are moving around. The valet is convenient however a bit expensive they do have a save and park package but I'm not too sure if it's worth it. The main issue I had with this hotel was that we never got extra towels or even got our rooms cleaned even though we stayed 3 nights. It is conveniently placed walking distance from the ruby slipper mothers and the river walk so I enjoyed my self.

Was good when previous owner had it. Not any more. Food sits out on the counter all day while the flies Hoover all around it.  Has several fish tanks in the place that look like they can use a good cleaning. Too many other good pizza places around like Tower, Cornerstone, and Emilios.

I went here with a group of five for dinner. First of all, the wine list was outdated & the wine we asked for wasn't available. Not a big deal, but I don't know why they haven't taken the time to update the menu.

Anyway, we all agreed our food was delicious, but the staff was rude-- sighing and complaining about our questions & our payment (we were using a coupon & a credit card...it's not that difficult). Our group works in food service so we weren't being picky or rude. We're in our mid-twenties and the other parties were all much older, so maybe that was it, I don't know.

If you make me feel unwelcome, fine, but I won't be going back or recommending the place.

These pinball machines are in beautiful condition,  well- spaced so there is plenty of room to move while you play (I may be the only one? ), and very family- friendly! 
If you go,  introduce yourself to Candace,  she's  the owner and very enthusiastic about her business! She has done children's parties (of course), but how about a company team building? Yep, she can arrange that... and you can bring your own food! How about a private bachelor or bachelorette party? Yep,  those too! Your imagination is almost the limit! 
There are couches to relax on while you are waiting your turn,  change machines,  and a soda machine. Yes,  you can bring in drinks... but do not put them on the machines! 
Plenty of parking nearby and of course,  you are right of 4th Avenue... so,  plenty of things to see and do! 
You gotta come check this place out and let me know what you think!

Love this place. It's perfect for sandwiches at lunch, charcuterie and wine before dinner, or dessert after dinner. We've also bought some of their premade pastas. Everything has been absolutely delicious. Highly recommend this place. It is a gem that fits perfectly into the St Pete foodie environment. It's topped off by the owner always on hand to make a recommendation and clearly takes pride in his business. Don't pass this up at least for a snack.
The food here was very good. I had the pear salad which was excellent and the stuffed meatballs - also very good. It's a bit loud - but, a nice place for a good meal with friends.

Absolutely awful experience with this company!  They were dispatched by my home warranty company, I will be sure to NEVER allow them to dispatch them to my house again!   The "tech" was very rude, inconsiderate, and talked to me with disrespect in the way he presented himself.   ALL he was concerned about was Freon... my compliant wasn't warm air... it was the noise my outside unit was making.  He spoke another language on his phone the whole time and never diagnosed the problem. Never left me a copy of his "service call" as I refused to sign it.
Bruschetta and penne con pollo were really tasty. Portions were good, and wine was good!

I love El Sitio so much - pretty sure they are my favorite Mexican restaurant in Goleta and Santa Barbara. The Adobada Mixto is the BOMB, seriously the best plate of deliciousness I have experienced (hot mix of mushrooms, poblano peppers, cheese, and adobada with fresh hot tortillas for making your own tacos - add their medium spicy pico de gallo salsa and you are in for a treat. I haven't been able to order anything else from El Sito because this one plate is so good, I get it every time. Thank you El Sitio you guys are amazing!

This place was great. Not a big menu, but honestly that makes it easier sometimes. Feel pretty good on the food for value as well. Definitely a hidden gem amongst Indy. If you're looking for that authentic Korean feel for food, this is your place.

took my sister and her family out for dinner and honestly this was the best part of their trip coming down to nj from california. the food was so delicious and fresh. would recommend this spot to everyone. great food and good hospitality on the staff for accommodating all of us. we will definitely be coming back.

Not going to lie I am sad the Zoe's closed - that's shocking to me. Great spot. But, I do love CAVA and am happy to have a location in Plymouth Meeting by my boyfriends house for when I'm craving it. 

It is super good and the staff was super friendly. The only issue was the slowness, but I understand - new spot and they're learning the dishes, menu, etc. But, I'd recommend ordering ahead rather than waiting in line because it could back up/take a bit.

Overall recommend and this will be a regular spot I'll frequent!

For all you wannabe rock stars out there (again, I mean this in the best way possible), follow the lights to Smack. I always wondered where all the country rocker types walking around Nashville got their clothes, and then I walked into Smack. With rhinestoned crosses and skulls galore, this place must call out to someone, not me, but I have seen you walking around with leather bracelets, tight jeans, snakeskin dress shoes, and Ed Hardy like button downs. Clearly, this place is not my bag of chips, but I will say that if you head upstairs you will find some good deals on going out dresses and even some great shoes on sale. The guy who was working upstairs was really nice and helpful, the woman downstairs not so much. Again I say, RHINESTONES!

Mostly consistent service, one server is ALWAYS on top of things. She even remembers my orders, even if I haven't been for a while. Food is 9/10 times perfect and that 1/10 is usually fixed without hesitation. Love coming here especially before 11 am on weekdays to get the early bird discount. Love it here!

This location seems to be very popular. Every time I try to run through the drive-thru it's always very full. Glad I have the Starbuck's app and generally order ahead so my drink is waiting for me. I'm usually on my way home to Phoenix, need caffeine for the 2 1/2 hour drive and want to get in and out quickly. 

My orders have always been correct and when I've ordered ahead it's always been ready and waiting form. It's a spacious newer location with indoor and outdoor seating although as of this writing the indoor seating is closed due to COVID.

Can't ask for much more than that.

I agree with the first reviewer... this hilton is a bit older and it shows in the room.

The location can't be beat.. and the restaurant on the ground floor ( luke) is freaking awesome!! and you don't hear me often raving about hotel food.

We were upgraded to the executive lounge... ( I'm a diamond member thanks to years of biz travel with IBM ).. bigger room.. floor has key card access to keep out the rifraff...and free breakfast, happy hour , and drinks and snacks available all day. ( no happy hour on the weekends though :(

Only issue I had with this hotel was the airconditioning... whenever we would return to our room after being gone, it felt like walking into a humidifier... but, after about 15 mins it was nice and cool again.. so a minor inconvenience and probably attributable to the age of the hotel.
Nice service, great music, yummy food and huge selection of whiskeys. Great onion soup and salad with point Reyes blue cheese, and delicious steak sandwich!

Overall staff and faculty are in inadequate and don't have a proper processing system for walk ins and basically tell you have to wait all day and don't wanna accept anyone after 3:30pm. People were there for work injuries had longer wait periods when clearly injured.

Standard Mexican cuisine and if in the area, a solid choice if you're craving Mexican.  Their chicken enchiladas were really good, but the margaritas left me wanting more.  Expect a long wait, and a full parking lot.

First time here. Had the chicken fried rice  and sesame chicken and pork wontons.  Was really delicious. Can't wait to try more of there dishes. 
Yum Yum.
Love this place. Great location and super friendly. Small is plenty and the cookie sundae is not to be missed!

Today my daughter & I went to check out this little gem in Boise. New little shop. You can get smoothies to fruit bowls. My daughter loved her High Tide bowl - sweet & tart. My peach cobbler was super yummy!!
Did exactly what I needed and charged exactly what they told me. How all Tucson businesses should run. Thanks Ernest.
Great work and very reasonable! He's busy and was a bit delayed due to COVID 19. But worth the wait.
Get the wings! Great service and all the food is good. The beef is amazing and your water glass is never empty.

Great spot. North of Tampa, which I will use as a vague term to define all areas north of USF, all the way up through Wesley Chapel, has seemingly countless option for Italian, Chinese, and burgers. So when you're in the mood for something different, and very authentic to its cultural tradition - head to Mr. Dunderbak's. Great German food, tons of beers, authentic German décor, including longtable seating, are some of what make any evening there very distinct from any other night out. A very friendly staff will do everything from helping newbies decipher the menu, to keeping the veterans steins full. Mix things up and put Mr. Dunderbak's into your rotation!

A cool Philly landmark where you can watch a LARGE tv screen courtesy of the Comcast Center folks! There are also restaurants downstairs if you are hungry & a pretty outdoor seating summer restaurant!

Cheesus crust........ Scordato's is underwhelming.

All parts of this trip was just A-OK as 3 stars boast. We ordered 2 pizzas (Mortadella/Pepperoni/Soppressara & Robiola/Fontina/Mozzerella) and 2 beers. The crust is divine, but the mushroom was overwhelming. TBH will definitely eat here again, due to it's proximity to my house but it's nothing too crazy special. I definitely would say go with a basic pepp and cheese combo here, as the fancier it got, the less I liked it.

Side note, if you order a draft beer - it comes in a HUUUGEEE glass. Scoooore! (Blue moon with orange on point!)

Last but not least, can they please shorten the names of these pizzas? It's a mouthful and unfortunately most of us do not speak Italian either!!
