We ate here the other day and the food was mediocre and just weird. I did not care for some of the ingredients, like mushrooms in the Kung Pao. If the menu listed them I would have left them out. 

Certainly not the best Chinese food, actually far form it. I love trying different restaurants, But places like this make me want to stick with chain restaurants, at least then I know what to expect.

I have been a client of Vixens for over 5 years! Master stylist Kemi continues to blow my mind and my hair loves her.  No matter where I travel inside or outside of the US people comment on my color! The signature red is stunning!

Believe me the best color mix-ologist this side of the GWB is at Vixens!! 

Her shop is professional and staff are pleasant and accommodating!

 Do your hair a favor check out Vixens!!

Basic Chinese take-out restaurant but seriously the best one in the Largo area.I've tried pretty much all of them and this is the only one I go back to! They are super pleasant and always have the order ready quickly and on time. The dinner and lunch specials are so cheap its unbelievable! I recently tried the pan fried dumplings and their sauce is AMAZING! I have been craving them all week! In my opinion they are a must try here!

Was my meal good...yes, was my meal great, no it wasn't. 

I sat at the bar and the service was phenomenal, I had the Pork Shoulder Sandwich, meat had almost no flavor, however the slaw had fennel in it....wayyyyyy to much fennel

Wife had Cauliflower Soup...it was average at best 

Pork Belly Appetizer was great 

Ricotta Dumplings appetizer was really good

Good chicken and greens. Way too pricey, and the cabbage was really bland. Would not go here again and the man who answered my phone was very rude. He didn't take my name and just hung up on me and when I called back and was going to give him my name he told me to just come. He then hung up on me again. They were not busy when I got there so there was no excuse for his behavior. Oh well.

This is a consignment store aimed at a relatively young Santa Barbara demographic. The clothing is about 75 percent women's and 25 men. I was hoping to find some high end mens clothing of a classical style. There was none to be had. However the prices were reasonable and I think a young crowd interested in buying relatively generic but not disposable clothing and shoes could find some bargains here.

Authentic Somalian pastries and coffee. Subtle spice is not overpowering. Family owned. Met Zakariya who is very personable. Tried the Nafago. Would recommend it if you have never tried Somalian food before. Also tried the beef Sambusa which is also really good.

In response to Lynda M.'s 10/16 comment on my review, the first "main concern" is false. That material was not from a close out. I got it at SIRs Fabrics where it sells for $20 per yard compared to $40 per yard at Fabric House, at least according to Lynn, your 30 year custom drapery vet who seems to have a really difficult time reading a tape measure. 

At Lynn's direction, I ordered an additional 15.5 yards of that material so the design she created could be achieved, and I told her (more than once) if more fabric was needed I could oder it promptly. All of which is documented in e-mails. Somebody at Excuses House is telling fibs.

As far the second concern you raised, it just proves my point- you're making excuses. The finished version didn't have to look like that. With troubleshooting it could've looked presentable, but you guys took so long (14 weeks!) sent the installation guy out here without the right paperwork and without the right materials, avoided calls, wouldn't return emails, and just made excuses that I just lost confidence in you, and I stand by my assertion that competence is lacking. 

And furthermore, the rod being over the window has nothing to do with why there's a 15" gap between the cascades and drapes, or that the drapes don't go to the ceiling as specifically stipulated in our agreement. 

If this is an example of you doing your best, please let me know when your close out sale is. You've got some pretty things there.
A true gem! Cozy, friendly, great coffee and pastries, as well as Pinocchio ice cream. The best place to hang in the hood!

What a pleasant 20 minute experience of tastings.  What made it a great experience was the sweet, and knowledgeable women working (can't recall her name, she worked Friday. evening 7/6/18. "Christina" maybe) Whatever her name, its HER that makes the place a great place to shop. I cant wait to try her suggestions.
Lots of good food in the city. When good food comes with courteous service, then the experience becomes rare. Thank you, Metropolitan Cafe for your good food and good service.
Good Mexican food. I had the fajitas and my friend had the taco salad. The fajitas were delicious and the tortillas served with them were fresh and hot. It was a good lunch for a reasonable price.

This is absolutely the best place to go for Dim Sum brunch. So many options to choose from and whatever you order comes out piping hot and very quickly. I've tried all the dumplings, all the buns and most of the sweeter selections. I wish I had taken photos but we were all so hungry as soon as the little metal dishes hit the table someone's chopsticks dove right in snatching up a tasty bite. Of the sweeter dim sum options I must say the sesame balls and the coconut milk jello cubes are my favorite. I have no words for how much I enjoy this place and their delightful dim sum. Go there now.

The location is great it so close to a shopping district. But the food and service not so much. I had a server basically throw the food down on the table and then ran off never to be seen again. The food was cold, old and greasy. Nothing like chicken cold and greasy. This location needs help.

I found this little cafe tucked away in Old Town Mall, across from Round Table Pizza.  They have a of espresso drinks as well as wide variety black and green teas.  Their wraps are so good.  I had a Pepita.  It is offered in whole and halves and even the half size was split in two.  The best thing is the homemade baklava.  I have to come back to try their homemade soups.  It is a local business so don't expect the fast food atmosphere.  Take some time to enjoy the ambiance and the food.
Delicious and really fresh food. The owners are from Italy and it shows! Big porch for outside dining. Friendly, family owned business. We'll definitely be back!

Fox Wine Co; Yes!!  The pinot is a delight and the Happy Canyon Cab is gorgeous.  The space is relaxed and a lovely retreat in a rad neighborhood.  David did a wonderful job suggesting wines and making our stay very cozy and delicious.  I can't wait to bring my family and friends here when they visit from the midwest.  Unpretentious atmosphere with elevated flavors.  

I was able to sit next to a Sommelier from Napa who said that Fox is the first place she and her Som husband hit up when they come down to the SB area.  So take it from the experts (them) and the wannabe (me)- Fox is a must.

Such a unique restaurant hidden upstairs of Nordstrom's at International Mall! The food was delicious; the fries sprinkled with cilantro and dipping sauce were divine! Salad fresh, soup unique and tasty, and bread warm! Service was VERY attentive :)

A couple of locals steered us there (and away from a pricey seafood joint).  That was a good thing.  Good prices, good seafood and outdoor seating are the highlights.   The atmosphere is totally casual - jeans and t-shirts.  Adding a few of the more interesting beers to their menu would be good, and a full bar would be great.

Ordered a pizza and appetizers. Corn nuggets taste great! Not spicy at all though... cheese sticks were 6/10 fried zucchini was 7/10 fried mushrooms were 10/10. Now the pizza: Overpriced for the quality. About the quality of a Digiorno pizza.

One of the best meals I've ever had. The corn bread is amazing! We do a lot of traveling and love to eat at all kinds of great restaurants around the world. I can't wait to come back here!

Amazing food. I'm Indian and I definitely miss all the Indian options I had in New York but this place is amazing. They offer a variety of vegetarian and meat dishes, fluffy naan in different flavors and even Mediterranean wraps too so my husband can get his gyro. I was impressed with the authenticity of the sauces and unlike most places, they're not stingy on the paneer. I will definitely be ordering again soon.

Sean & Ari are incredibly talented patient amazing groomersFreddy is a sweet Tibetan Terrier with an Attitude, he loves coming to get groomed and he's not the easiest. Ari & Sean make it a positive experience for him. I highly recommend !!!'

Let's get one thing straight: I hate all big chain pizza delivery.  Domino's is no exception.  But on a cold day, when the kids were miserable because they had to walk in the cold, I caved and struck a bargain.  If they cooperated, we could get Domino's for dinner (their request).  They did, and we did.

This location is clean and not scary like others I've seen.  It wasn't very expensive, though I realize few people ever pay full price. They offer coupons everywhere, in papers and mailers, but since I never eat there I don't ever save them.  We waited for our pizza, and it was quick.

The pizza: blecch.  But the kids liked it.  I chalk it up to the sugar/corn syrup in the sauce (and probably in the crust).

The Cinna stix: crust with cinnamon sugar and a side of sweet icing.  Ick.  Again, kids loved them. But they tried the sweet icing and told me to throw it out immediately because it was too sugary!  Now you KNOW it's bad if kids say it's too sweet. They said they had enough sugar from the stix themselves and warned me not to even taste it.  But I had to know; they were right.

As a chain, Domino's gets one star.  But this location, for being clean, well-lit, efficient, and friendly, gets three.

After waiting one hour and 4 minutes on hold to talk to a representative, who's voice was so digitized I could barely hear her, I thought an update was in order. After the insane wait time several days ago, when told that my order had not shipped because they no longer carried it (but were never going to tell me that without asking) they told me they would cancel the order and put the money back in my account if it had been deducted,  but that it usually did not unless shipped...ok..then I received an email last night saying that it shipped.  So I call customer service,  wait over an hour, to suffer through a horrible digital feed that allowed only small fragments of her sentence to be audible...finally to be told that yes, it had been shipped...dont walk..run from this place. . Ineptitude would be a compliment to this distributor

Quest has a very easy and convenient process which I truly appreciate! I made an appointment  online  and filled out  all of my information. I had to cancel my appointment so, the following day I decided to show up as a walk-in. There are 3 tablets for signing in, but when I visited there was no one at the front desk to assist those who aren't tech savvy. Check in process took 15 seconds and my wait time was less than 10 minutes. There were maybe 7 people ahead of me for various things, and there's a monitor in the wait room so you can see how long your wait is. Patients with appointments have priority, but this did not make the wait time any longer. 
I came in with my notes from my doctor and the nurse was able to take the blood draw. In total, I was out in ~30 minutes as a walk in. Easy peasy lemon squeezy!

You can create a profile on Quest to receive your results and have them shared with your healthcare provider. I went in on Monday, and received my results online on Wednesday. The results shared were pretty comprehensive and easy to understand-- coming from someone who has NO medical literacy.

Not only can you be referred here by your medical professional you can also choose your own tests and screenings such as glucose, drug screening, etc. I definitely look forward to coming here again.

This is a joke tourist attraction. You arrive and are like "Wow!  A big old warehouse!" But the goods are not uncommon and extraordinarily overpriced. Expect to pay 2x-3x the market price at comparable antique malls.

They have no COVID precautions - the place can get crowded.

And there is no air conditioning, so fans blow the hot, humid air all over you. In fact they direct you to the water fountains so you can cool your body from the inside out.

Must miss.

I tried their mac and cheese at the Taste of Pinellas last year and had to go back to the restaurant to have some more.  Not only the mac and cheese but the appetizer calamari and pork tenderloin were absolutely delicious!!  

The service....though we were seated quickly and the food came out at a right time, the server seemed irritated when we asked nicely for another round of water and bread.  I understand he might have been busy but we did not rush him or were rude to him so maybe he could have been a little nicer about it.  That was the only downer...everything else was fantastic!!

This is my go-to place when I need to get the car washed. The prices are decent and they do a good job. Plus, you save more with the wash books.  They used to do themed discount days but I guess they scrapped that so everyone gets the lowest price.  I usually go for the $6 Classic Wash (tax is included in the price), but I think you can get the Economy Wash for as low as $4.

Just note that sometimes it gets really busy, particularly during lunch hour, and the drying job isn't as good as normal at that time because they have to push the cars through quickly.

Our go to place.  We love it.  Their Fig Jam Flatbread is a must - I get it every time.  We also love their cheese options.  Have tried multiple seasonal dishes that have all been a huge hit.  Oh, the wine - top notch!  I typically get a full-bodied flight of some sort.  We have also gotten several bottles of wine from them, as their staff is very knowledgeable and helpful.  Go check it out yourself for a chilled out experience.  I find myself stealing their Pandora stations every time I leave...

I'm not a lover nor a madman, but maybe if I come here often enough I will be. Best Iced Chai Tea Latte I have ever had. And I try them pretty much everywhere. It's a good way to judge how well a tea/coffee shop knows their recipes. Too often places just dump the sugary mix in without trying it. And this place clearly knows what tastes good. They play nice hip coffee shop music, they have free internet, and they provide a decent place to sit. I wish they were open more often and later at night. This is the perfect place to catch up on some reading or work after working on your fitness at the Pottruck Center. I'm not a college student, and I don't have flex points or whatever so I can't afford that smoothie stand that's 20 feet away from the treadmills. But I can afford a nice refreshing drink 3 blocks away. Two thumbs up Lovers and Madmen.
Incredible food and maybe the best level of service I have experienced.     It is pricey - but very worth it.

What the heck are you going in Acme for anyway?  Get the same delicious fresh shucked oysters here instead.  Sure there's no ambiance and no room when it's crowded, but that's what the bar's for.  The bar is also where i suggest you belly up for a cold beer and few dozen fresh shucked.  You will be a happy patron.
This was such a cool museum. It was only $5 and had A LOT of fascinating things. They had historic medicine and well as other things. Their collection of things was massive and interesting.

One of the best breakfasts I've ever had!!! Got great service also. The ingredients were of good quality and the portion was nice. So tasty and the options were unique! The topped cornbread and chakchouka was amazing! The owner brought us cornbread for our road trip home. It was such a nice gesture! I want to go back to St. Louis to eat here soon!!!

My husband and I were in town visiting family last week and tried this place.  Not sure if it was the seafood app or the under cooked meal but we both felt horrible afterward. I'm not sure of her name, but the bartender seemed distracted and was missing from behind bar constantly,  needless to say it was hard to get a drink. She was very abrupt with us as well and had to correct our bill twice. The place is very nicely decorated , but service is sub par.  Hopefully they can get it together to have the service match the atmosphere.

We ordered three pizzas last night for three people. We will be eating pizza for days! Such a good value for the money. I am gluten intolerant but the fact that they ferment the dough for four days makes it light, chewy and yummy and I can eat it! It's been a long time since I've been able to walk into a pizza place and just order and not worry about it. Or get a flat, gummy gluten-free crust. Lots of great toppings,  lots of good choices, fresh, and lots of garlic! Very highly recommend! Quick wonderful service and the pizzas came up super fast. I hope that Santa Barbara supports them!

I was given a tour of one of their apartments and there was the biggest stench of weed I've ever smelled. The apartment next door had their door wide open with multiple speakers blaring. Alcohol bottles were stacked in front of many of the windows. Tour guide was friendly which is the only reason this is even getting 1 star. If you're looking to party, this is the residential area for you. If you're looking to get some sleep at night you're better off looking somewhere else.

It's clear the company has asked people to submit reviews to balance against the more negative (real) reviews that are now somewhat buried. I recommend that Ablitt's simply accept the fact that not everyone will be pleased with their service. They provided cleaning services for me for a number of years and did an okay job.

You pay late twice in a 12 month period and they force you over to cash payments only, stupidest thing I've ever heard. If I got paid in cash I'd be using cash, but I have a card like most people these days. Worst power company ever.

As a vegetarian I have avoided Shake Shack since I assumed they would not have anything to offer to me except fries. I WAS WRONG! The portobello mushroom is one of the best vegetarian burgers I have ever had. It's simply a large portobello mushroom enclosed in a crunchy flavorful layer of crispy goodness. Then this burger is dressed like a traditional shake shack burger. The burger was very fresh, my assumption is that it was made upon order to maintain its crunch. Also tried the cheese fries which were a great side.
Best gluten free pizza I have had yet. Pricey but definitely worth it. We had to have it two nights in a row. A must try!

I come here all the time for Happy Hoursssss or dinner and a good time. Food is delicious, drinks are great and plentiful, and service is stellar.

Tommy and Nick at the patio bar will NEVER DISAPPOINT. Once you try it, you'll be a regular. 

Cheers!!!

Decent but overpriced dim sum. But it is the only place in this area for dim sum. I have gone to this place for years for the food and have tolerated the bad, bad service. However, this last time I went in for dim sum, two of the dishes were undercooked (the shrimp was partially raw) - when I showed the server, she argued with me that it was properly cooked. At first, the manager told me I had to pay for the raw dishes, but she quickly removed the items from my check when she saw that I took pictures of the raw food being served. Forgiving if the staff had been nicer about it, but I definitely suggest that you be very careful, especially if you bring small children to this place.

Purcell installed 8 new Michelin tires on my Class A diesel motorcoach. They had decently competitive prices for line haul tires, had them in stock, and I was out the door for a reasonable price. They don't take appointments, but I showed up early in the morning and the whole process took about three hours (as expected). Easy peasy.

The only reason they get dinged one star is that one of the valve stem extensions was installed loose. Three days later, that one tire was severely under inflated. I caught it because I have tire pressure sensors installed. Called up Purcell, they were very responsive, they fixed the stem quickly and I was on my way. Glad I caught that, but it could have cost me a brand new tire. Honest mistake and it happens. I would still recommend Purcell for your commercial tire needs.

Not a fan. I'm sure you run into this anywhere but the lack off communication between staff,doctors and patients is insane. I was sent to the wrong waiting room twice. Sat in an out patient room for 2 hours when my wife had been out of surgery and moved to a room but no one knew what was going on. I wish the staff in the hospital has some avenue of communication as everyone seems to not know what the other is doing. Was told my wife would be released very soon and that was 4 hours ago.

Hard place to find unless you are looking for it. I tried it based on the reviews here and wasn't disappointed. My wife and I had the 39 piece sushi platter for $32 and it was a great deal! The only drawback to the place is its size and the # of tables in it. Its tiny - definitely not the place to go if your claustraphobic. I highly recommend it!

Allie is an awesome stylist! When I started going to her I hadn't had my hair trimmed in years and was so nervous! She was patient with me and made changes only as I was comfortable with them. Now I have the long, full and healthy hair I have always wanted! So happy to have found Allie and Murraki Salon!

Very pretty park.

Came here for the bourbon, beer, bbq fest so view was limited but you could tell without the mob of people it would be a nice place to hang on a Sunday afternoon, 

The restrooms were clean and air conditioned as well. 

Nice view

we did breakfast here.  It was good.  I will never spend that much money on breakfast again, but I can say that i tried it -- once.

Two of us did the Prix Fix menu for breakfast, and we got different things so we could try more stuff.

1st Course
The turtle soup was really good.  But not as good as Remoulades down the street by any means (and Remoulades is cheaper)
The southern baked apple with double cream was wonderful.

2nd Course
The Oysters Benedict was good (although the canadian bacon seemed to compete too much in flavor) 
The Eggs Nouvelle Orleans was tasty with the crabmeat.

3rd Course
The bananas foster - just maybe the reason to come here.  outstanding.
The chocolate Pecan Pie was good - but really really rich.

I had a absinthe suissesse and also an absinthe frappe - both very tasty (I am an absinthe affectionado) - nice wine list as well.  

It was good.  was it worth it? meh.  maybe.

Great food awesome service.  I am already a regular customer. Love it. Can't wait to go again.  Highly recommend this place.   The first Chic Gil A ive ever been to and they have not let me
Down

Great dim sum! Affordable price, good service. I hopped off a plane and came straight here. So happy we have a good dim sum.place in Delco! The dumplings, meat bun, sauteed string bean and shrimp shu mai were my favorites. Highly recommend
Great beer and cocktail options. The food is also pretty good! Definitely try something from their smoker!

I'm not quite sure why this place has such awful reviews because I was in last Sunday and I thought it was 5 star service with a smile. The food prep area was neat and clean, everything in its proper place. My sandwich was made to my exact specifications and tasted nice and fresh. The sandwich artist was nice, quick, and friendly. I would definitely come back for another sandwich.

Standard smash food but terrible service at the Malvern location.  They always seem overwhelmed and food delivery is always slow even before they get busy at lunch time.  Orders never come up together and you end up not eating with other at your table.

I have been coming here for years - both for my eye check up and to purchase glasses. They are always amazing at helping fit us in and recommending just the right pair of glasses.

Staff is very kind but honest- which I like when making a glasses selection. After all these are going to be on my face for a while!  Plus they have a wide selection- from wild to everyday. And a wide range of price points. Also important. 

The other great positive is there is lots of free parking. And now with the a LRT station coming close it will be even easier to get there.

This place has the best pizza and wings around..
Their staff is amazing from the waitress to the cooks.
EVERY TIME  we come in we never have an issue..
They are very accommodating since a member of our family has a food allergy and we always make them aware and they accommodate us

Great place. The ghost tour was amazing and some of the old furniture was over 300 years old. Our tour guide was very funny and good. The history was amazing and my favorite room was lena's. I initially wasn't very excited to go on a tour and learn more facts while on a vacation, but I don't regret it. I highly recommend this place and would visit again. I enjoyed seeing my first mummified cat as well.

I've been a customer of European Style Salon for well over a decade. Silvia has always taken EXCELLENT care of me and uses the best products on my hair that last longer than any other salon I'd ever used. Plus, they are actually GOOD for my hair! I receive compliments on my hair daily and I haven't been in for a touch up in almost 3 months! I love the atmosphere of the salon as well as the convenience of the new location. You always feel welcome and comfortable by everyone. Thank you Silvia for taking such awesome care of me and for always getting me in with my busy schedule. You truly are THE BEST!

Really good food. Waffles are really tasty. The only problem is that if you look at the underside of the waffle, it always has black flaky pieces of  burnt waffle embedded in it. Always. The whole underside of the waffle is covered in it. That can only be from not cleaning the grill/waffle maker. All it takes is caring, and a wire brush, or some kind of rough metallic cleaning pad. Just once a day. I can't imagine the employees haven't noticed this themselves. I'm sure they have seen the underside of their own waffles. I'm always shocked that it's always like that and no one has done anything about it. I have been a customer for a few years and I'm always in a hurry so I've never had time to write this cause I usually eat my order on foot as I rush to work. . Lol. And the burnt pieces are cooked into the waffle, so its hard to take them off without throwing away a good amount of the underside of the waffle, so i dont always pick all the burnt pieces off. I figured, what the hell, there is a small amount of burntness on many things we eat that are on the well done side... toast, pizza crust, etc.. Plus, im on foot. Except,  the last time I got a waffle, I could taste the burnt pieces. Tasted like charred carbon.. ugh.. luckily, it was only just a hint of the overall flavor cause the waffle is really tasty, and, i guess everyone eats it like that and they're still in business, so I figure no one complains, plus, I'm always starving!...but ugh... I could taste the burnt flakes regardless. Care, and a daily cleaning... that's all.  Simple. That's what even slightly caring restaurant owners/employees do. It's a quality part of town. Make your product live up to it.

I went with a group of friends for happy hour and we sat at the bar, aside from our food and drinks being phenomenal our waiter was on top of EVERYTHING from the moment we arrived. He was super pleasant, knew what to suggest based off of our drink preferences and even surprised us mixed drink he concocted himself. I definitely recommend happy hour at Harp & Crown, well worth the money! A true Happy Hour experience for sure.

Tri tip sandwiches on a Sunday is a wonderful way to kick back on a lazy afternoon.  Have a drink, grab your sandwich when you are ready and visit with your neighbors at the communal tables.  

A couple of tips:
1.  Go early if you can, parking is limited on this narrow road.
2.  Ask them to cut your sandwich in half....even if you intend to eat the whole thing.  Just easier to manage.
3.  Don't miss the au jus at the sandwich counter - you need to dish it out yourself.
4.  ALL of the condiments they offer at the self serve stand are good.  Grab a couple extra of the au jus containers and pour them on your sandwich as you eat.  The bun doesn't disintegrate and you get to mix and match toppings as you eat. 
5.  If you have a motorcycle now is the time to break it out.  You will be in good company.

Great mix of people, good food and beautiful views make for a memorable afternoon!

I love Tijuana Flats. I lived next to the first location when Brian opened. Today I had a very sub par burrito here. The wrapper was wrong and so were fillings. Not busy so I don't know what the problem was. Unfortunately I was out of time. Server did offer to have it remade but I have limited time on lunch. I won't return here, but I will try other locations.

Good golly- the best biscuits and gravy I've had anywhere! The rest of the food was amazing- all very fresh and delicious. Service was great and the atmosphere is very chill. Don't know what else to say because everything was perfect. I can't wait to go back!

I love this place! Whenever we have the hankering to go downtown to some hip spot, we always find ourselves here being greeted by their friendly and helpful staff. The interior of this place looks like one of those cool industrial chophouses like you would see in Portland or Seattle. There is seating both inside and out. But the food here is why we come. Everything is sources locally, including meats, cheeses, produce, many of the beers and wines, etc. We have explored the menu ordering different things each time. All have been outstanding and very reasonable priced. Makes my mouth water just thinking about it. I feel Bittercreek could easily win an award for best restaurant in the Treasure Valley.

A great place to do research!  Kudos to the Support staff!   esp the PC support team!  These guys are spot on with regard to their helpful advise and with keeping these machines and network running and up to date!   The Reference staff are always helpful and are happy to assist!  The library is going through a long overdue renovation and will soon be rid of the horrible orange interior features!  But face it, this place has much to offer anyone who makes the effort to walk through the front door.

Two of us had dinner here before the Hozier concert at GSR last night. Neither of us felt like sushi, so if that is a review you are looking for - move on. My husband and I shared 3 things and we liked them all, we were just not crazy about them, hence only 3 stars. We had Hot and Sour soup and it was good, but I have had better. We shared a plate of supposedly "spicy" salt & pepper calimari, lightly fried, (NOT SPICY) and it was pretty good, too. I generally don't order fried foods, but this was not greasy at all. We also shared a plate of supposedly spicy orange chicken (AGAIN NOT SPICY) and it was ok. Nice atmosphere, but SO LOUD that my husband and I could hardly talk across the way too large 2-person table. The 2 young women next to us were complaining about the same thing, btw. Great service, however, from everyone we encountered. Also, for the price, each thing we ordered was a decent sized portion. This is a nice option if you are a captive audience at GSR.

There's a lot of great eating to be done in Indianapolis, more than our fair city gets credit for, but there isn't an abundance of great restaurants. 

From chops and pizza to Thai and Indian and street-style tacos, people are doing great things with food here. But the Hoosier state's general lack of pretense works against the restaurant scene. The thinking of too many restauranteurs seems to be that if the food is good it doesn't really matter if the rest of the experience (design, service, etc) is underwhelming. 

That's why St. Elmo continues to loom large in the hearts and minds of locals and visitors alike. It's more myth than restaurant, a powerful story that is passed down from one generation to the next. St. Elmo's stewards are smart enough not to monkey with that story, ensuring that Indy's young turks will enjoy more or less the same St. Elmo experience that our parents and grandparents did.

If you aren't familiar with the St. Elmo story, here's the condensed version; Founded by Joe Stahr in 1902 and named for the patron saint of sailors, St. Elmo has be in operation ever since. The restaurant has been under the control of just three owners: Stahr, Harry Roth and Isadore Rosen (see: Harry & Izzy's), and the Huse family. The servers wear black jackets and bowties - many of them have worked there for decades. The menu is early 20th century American; huge steaks, chicken, lobster tail, potatoes, asparagus, etc. When Indy was a provincial outpost with a pharmaceutical company and a racetrack, visiting big wigs posted up at St. Elmo. They still do. Sports casters mention it when broadcasting nationally-televised Pacers and Colts games. The shrimp cocktail is famous. It's also awesome. If you take a large bite of the horseradish-filled sauce you'll get a sensation approximating that of having an icepick rammed into your brain through your nostril. Some see it as forever beyond their means. To others, dining at St. Elmo is an aspirational benchmark. 

The reality is that while St. Elmo is an expensive place to eat by any measure, the sticker shock that young professionals or middle-income types might feel when at a $26 chicken entree or $50 steak can be assuaged by the simple fact that one dish will feed two people comfortably. The sides can stretch even further. The Wife and I spilt the Amish chicken, a side of green beans and the King Crab mac'n'cheese and left with enough chicken and mac'n'cheese to feed her lunch the next day. Our server told us with regret that there was no more pie or cobbler so we opted for white chocolate & blueberry bread pudding. Half of THAT ended up going home with us as well. The only dishes that got completely crushed were the shrimp cocktail and complimentary bread.

If you can't swing splitting an item from the regular menu, St. Elmo offers a bar menu of sliders and small plate options that run $5 to $12 and begs the question, "if you're going to drop $25 on beer and a snack at a cheesy chain bar and grill, wouldn't you rather spend the same amount of money at St. Elmo?" The answer is obvious to me. The bar servers are more casually dressed than those who patrol the dining room but they are no less skilled or attentive, and there's just enough hustle and bustle to make the restaurant feel like a living organism. The bar's walls are covered with autographed photos and newspaper stories featuring several eras-worth of national and local celebrities that offer silent testimonial to St. Elmo's decades-long A-list status. 

It may seem obvious, and some locals might be tired of hearing it, but the story is true; St. Elmo is a great restaurant. In Sept. 2011 work will be completed on the new second-floor 1933 Bar that in my estimation will feel brand new like its always been there. An extension of the St. Elmo story, framed photos will evoke jubilation on the day that prohibition ended and drinks will be served across an antique bar made by the same manufacturer that made the original bar downstairs. I'm looking forward to taking my firstborn there in 2031.

Ok I've been very honest in my previews reviews saying this is the best sushi place ever, BUT that was until I ordered the lunch special which is obviously a very busy time for the restaurant so busy that i just sat there until someone approached me to try to explain me how it worked she ( the hostess) was in the middle of doing so and then she left, then again about 5 minutes later I thought understood the system when the waitress I was talking to left again so I couldn't complete my order, when she finally came back I order they lunch special "all you can eat" which is only 2 rolls from 4 kinds they give as options, one appetizer also pre- picked by them and 2 sushi's at least the selection here  is bigger. What really surprised me was how tiny the rolls were I was back in town happy  to have the saint Louis roll again and it was the size of a quarter but I guess for 12.99 I couldn't expect more it wasn't disappointing per se, and the waitress were helpful and nice just obviously too busy and in need of help hiring one more person would be the logical thing to do.
The food was excellent, and the service was quick. It was a bit pricy, but we anticipated that. The desserts were worth the splurge!

Visited with a couple friends for the weekend, and it was the first food place on the agenda! The atmosphere was terrific, highly recommend outdoor seating! The brisket, Mac and cheese, and fried chicken sandwiches were all very delicious. The service was also very quick and efficient. They also accommodate gluten restrictions nicely

Recommend
A large 4 item breakfast for $3.99? Hell yes! Service was great, food was super quick. Popular with locals, may be busy! If you want fast good food and plenty of it, check it out!!

Came here with an out-of-town friend to watch some football and grab some drinks before meeting up with other friends for dinner. My brain was not functioning super well that day (long story short - don't break up with your gf of 1.5 years with a text message), however with the expert guidance of our server Panda (hard name to forget), we were steered into getting a pitcher of beer and some wings. Talk about a deal you cannot beat! The pitcher was 5.99.. you couldn't get two pints for that. So even though we didn't drink it all, it was well worth it.

As for the wings, we ordered your standard traditional buffalo wings, however the kitchen had run out so we ended up with the boneless instead. They were good but a bit spicy for my palate. I'm a bit of a wimp, I admit. Plus I wasn't feeling super hungry and I'm sure that contributed. I had not realized that it was a chain until I got there and figured out I had been to the one in Seattle. Sports bar atmosphere, pub food. I try to eat generally healthy so I'm not sure I'd make a major effort to go back - unless it was game day. Then bring on the pitcher.
(Rating the hotel, not the eatery.) Absolutely disgusting. Smells dank and sour and looks like it hasn't been updated in about 40 years.

Dr. Wipf is an incredible dentist. I was having an issue with a tooth that was misdiagnosed and treated by another dentist. Dr. Wipf gave me the possible scenarios and treatment options, and let me know that some aspects of the treatment were irreversible. This gave me a clear picture of the situation so I could make an informed decision about treatment. I have since felt much better and am hopeful that will continue. I have since seen Dr. Wipf several other times for other reasons and every time he gives me his time and attention to ensure we get the problem corrected. He is an expert and I highly recommend him if you have any dental concerns. Plus, his staff is awesome. A+!

It's a very pretty area to walk around and parking wasn't that difficult.  However, I was pretty disappointed in the types of shops and merchandise.  Some stores were rather tacky; I was expecting more locally made items not mass-produced trinkets.  In many of the stores, the employees were downright unfriendly.  Why would I spend money in places that weren't welcoming or helpful?

Been here a few times and the food is usually good. The service is pretty slow though. Went tonight with my family and me being 9 months pregnant. We sat down in the back of the restaurant in the couch area. We sat there for 15 minutes with 3 waitresses and 1 waiter helping the tables next us and not 1 of them said hello or even looked at us. The restaurant was maybe half full and it was around 5pm on a Sunday. Not sure if we will be back again.
Small craft beer place with a super friendly and knowledgeable owner who knows his stuff. Helped me pick out a 6 pack of local brews. Definitely worth supporting this place over the big retails!

My French is a little rusty, but I think "Mis en Chic" means "insanely overpriced crap and rude shopkeeper" or something like that.  

Now I'm a thrifty gal, but I also have a pretty good understanding of why things are priced the way they are. And 86 bucks for a spray-painted papier-mâché picture frame is just stupid. $350 for a pasta server is flat-out ridiculous. I didn't even bother to look at what the furniture was going for. Putting giant price tags on stuff doesn't increase the value or the quality. Bob Barker taught me that.  

I suppose I could have overlooked the grossly overinflated cost and just enjoyed the surroundings (because yes, the shop is lovely and smells heavenly) if the woman behind the counter hadn't been such a, um, mis en biche.

My sister and I walked in on a rainy Monday afternoon to an empty shop, save Miss Gulch and her wine glass of water at the counter (I know, right??!). She greeted my sister, not warmly, but at least she acknowledged her presence. I got a cold once-over and a sigh. Yeah, I had the nerve to step foot in this joint with tattoos. Half-sleeves, kids. On my arms. In this store. Mon dieu!

At any rate, even if I had found something worth purchasing at this place, I wouldn't have due to the complete lack of customer service from the hag at the cash register.  

Our comeuppance was that my sister accidentally broke Hagatha's wine/water glass right before we left. Whoopsies!

DO NOT HIRE THEM!!! This was as bad of a moving experience as you could imagine.  We were excited to move into our brand new home and that excitement was ruined by careless movers who damaged our brand new wood floors, backed into our house and caused external home damage and caused thousands of dollars in furniture damage.  I tried working with them to get this resolved and it never was.  Truly awful experience 0/10.

I've now been to this salon 3 times, and I love the staff. I've done gel nails and a pedicure, and they do a great job. They are also cheaper than other salons in Tucson. They give you a really nice massage anytime you get a manicure or pedicure. My nails look fabulous, and they always come out perfect. They offer a wide selection of colors. I recommend OPI gel.

Walked in on a wed afternoon, no wait and quick service. The food was good we got the St Charles Chicken And it was very flavorful. The salad was amazing, wasn't really fond of the Costa Rican dish but everything else was great.

If you have the money, the stores here have what you're looking for. From Bebe to Godiva, to Saks, to Nordstroms, to Gymboree, to Pottery Barn, to Restoration Hardware, to Tiffany, everything here is upscale and super trendy. My favorites are Banana Republic, Restoration Hardware, and Crate and Barrel (sp?). 

They also had a seasonal See's Candies (Mmmm.... Chocolate!), a cookie place who's name escapes me, several healthy (and unhealthy) choices in their small food court above Keystone Crossing (the road that is) and a fabulous movie theater, Keystone Art Cinema, which offers more than just your average movie snacks while watching films that usually win academy awards (ie, Atonement was shown there before it was nominated.) 

Check it out, but be prepared to shop, not buy, if you're on any type of budget.

Great atmosphere. Great service. Great bbq.
Smoked turkey platter with jambalaya rice and a creamy broccoli salad was excellent. Turkey was moist (sorry, I hate that word too) and smokey, presauced with white and bbq sauces. Not over dressed. Just right. .

I love that they have special sides daily.

Everything was delicious. I'll be back for sure. Definitely a must try if you're in Franklin, TN.
Go to for Thai in south tampa, but be prepared to wait. Definitely best to call ahead and add 10 mins to however long they say. Love everything on menu! Beware- closed Monday's and now also Tuesdays?

This is an incredible, unique family business which you should check out even if you don't need glass or ceramic repairs or great, custom gifts. Their work is known internationally, though they are quite humble and sweet people. I have gone to them for years and am so glad to know they're moving, not closing!

I've been here twice! Once in the day when it was slower and the lady that worked their was able to show me around and recommend some porters for me and once on a Friday night when it was packed with people. Even when it was packed I got smiles and good vibes from the employees and I loved the Maui coconut porter they had on tap! From a inspired beer geek trying out new things I loved this place. Best place to buy your buddy or someone a gift card. I will be back in the near future.

Been here a couple of times... once for lunch and once for AYCE dinner. I've been on a hot pot kick for the past couple of months trying out new places and figuring which is the best for variety, taste, freshness, and price. This place is great! The staff are also very friendly and attentive. I suggest coming early, as this place gets pretty packed during peak lunch/dinner hours. Also, I know this place looks a bit sketch as it's right next to a run down looking motel, but don't let that deter you from a great hot pot experience!

The lunch is 5 items for $15-ish. They give you quite a bit, so keep that in mind when ordering your veggies. There are lots of sauces to choose from. I really like the peanut sauce. They even give you a complimentary ice cream after your meal, which I think is great if you like the spicy soup (definitely need a milk product to help calm the spice).

The AYCE dinner is $30.95, but they charge $2 for broth (if you choose from the many different flavours) or $2.50 for half & half. You can get the Ginger and Green Onion broth for free, which is just as good. I got this and added extras from the sauce station. There is lots to choose from on the dinner menu, so you will definitely leave satisfied.

Think I've found my go to hot pot lunch spot! Looking forward to trying more of the broths!

The motel itself is in fairly good condition, the AC worked ok, the place was clean and well maintained. My problem was their WiFi. It totally sucks! They charge you $2.99 a day for WiFi that is as slow as my dial up modem was in 1985! This is a joke, I need WiFi to access the intermet for lots of reasons. This put a huge damper on my trip to Reno. I complained to the desk and all I got was a shrug! Also Jeremy H's review is accurate also, lots of vagrants hanging around. I will never stay at another Motel 6.

Usually I love coming here for lunch and have a great experience so it was probably an off day. We went for a weekday lunch and wasn't very full. It took awhile for the server to take our order. When the bread came the pieces were pretty charred from being warmed in the oven. It is normally quick for the orders to come but it took a lot longer. The food was good but the capellini had a lot more oil in it than usual.

Took the Scandalous Cocktail Tour on 12/17.  It was great because it was a very small group and we didn't have any trouble hearing the guide.  Really liked being able to get into different places we wouldn't have even known about.  I understood that drinks were NOT included, as it was clear when I booked the tour.  The drinks cost $8-$15 each, but there was never any pressure.  My husband and I shared one at each stop - good way to try something new and not a big deal if you didn't like it.  Interesting information learned from tour guide.

Stepped inside. There was a kiosk to grab a ticket. Come on people, you already know what to expect! I went during lunchtime, so there were many people in the waiting room. I only had to renew my drivers license. My wait was only 5 minutes. After talking with the woman at the info counter, she pointed me to the Self-service. My situation is different than others, so your results may vary. A few minutes later I received a receipt and a temporary license. The new hard copy license will arrive in two plus weeks. Hey I came and did what I had to do. I had spare time to get back to work.

Oh my god. The tacos. THE TACOS!

Who would have thought you'd find the best tacos in the city under a little tent in front of a parking garage selling beer... they were incredible. With home made sauces and perfectly charred tortillas, you could tell the chef was inspired and cooking was his passion. I had the lengua taco and I swear I'm salivating at the thought of having some more. I really hope this chef gets the press he deserves.  I also wish I had more photos of :(

Great new coffee shop with wonderful owners! The coffee itself is delicious and the fact that they have soy milk with the self serve milks is a plus! I can't comment on the surplus of pastries they had out other than the fact that they looked wonderful. Try it out and see for yourself!

Terrible experience. My car started losing power the ability to get up to speed on the roads. I took the car in to Pep Boys for a diagnosis. First of all, they completely misdiagnosed the problem (after charging me $100 for a diagnostic fee). They said it was the catalytic converters and sensors. But I took it to another mechanic for a second opinion, and it turns out the problem was a bad timing chain, which can be replaced for $900.

They quoted me $3000 for a misdiagnosis. Very shady. Stay away. Buyer beware.

I've been to this place before but only got one of their slushies. This time around, I stopped for lunch with my family before heading back to Phoenix. I think this place is more about their slushies than their food. The sandwiches were just okay at best and were so LOADED with mayo that I had to constantly wipe it off with my napkin. They're pretty bland sandwiches all around and it was a bit of a disappointment. The employees were very nice, so there's that.

So..... we went here as part of a walking pub crawl and although it felt like we stepped in to a bit of a time machine we had a great experience!  The staff was really friendly and attentive, the prices were great, and the food was perfectly tasty pub fair. We will definitely be back!

I'm undone by the sea bass and the sashimi (yellowtail). OMG so good. They got those two things so right.

In contrast much of the rest of the menu seemed to consist of highly overpriced generic Chinese food - or perhaps my table just preferred those types of appetizers. I was unimpressed. There did seem to be other choices on the menu but sadly we did not buy them. The overpriced Chinese food however, was enough to annoy me.

Also, I thought the kobe beef satay would be kobe quality, but sadly it was satay quality. So be aware you'll get a lower quality cut of meat.

My recommended solution: simply ignore the Chinese half of the menu and you're good. Unfortunately the menu was not divided into halves so you just have to avoid anything that looks Chinese.

I have stayed at this hotel multiple times. There have been a few issues but overall I think it's the best value in the area for a balcony and they are great with early check in or giving an extra hour for Check out. Parking is an additional $30 but it's competitive for overnight parking in the area, covered, and easily assessable with cameras. Make sure when making reservation that you say you DO NOT want breakfast or it's an additional amount as well and there are much better places to eat in the area like Ruby Slipper. Anytime this hotel has messed up corporate has always been there to make it right and I think being an IHG member is extremely helpful.

Had a great experience at Fond. The servers were kind and knowledgeable, never too pushy. The dishes were well spaced and we never felt rushed. The tuna crudo and seared scallops were incredible. I highly recommend them.

I love this place! Great casual place to have a steak dinner on a patio. The pork chop is amazing and a must with the bread pudding of course. The only thing is it is very tight quarters inside the building and not easy to get through. That is why we prefer the summer and patio dining!

Food was great as usual, I had the Baja tacos, two of them and of course a so-papilla as  well when I finished the tacos. Wife had the tea-enchiladas, a few to many onions for our taste buds. Had a great time overall. If your in the area check them out.

Yes, yes, a thousand times yes! I've been following Chapati on insta for a while, and drooling over the content. I have a hard time convincing myself to head west, despite the call of so much excellent world food. Sunday changed that, when we had another reason to venture that way, I knew it was my moment. We ordered two combo meals with the goat karhai, an eggplant dish, malai kofta, and chicken masala. The flavors were so amazing. I was nervous to try the goat because I haven't before, but my fears were unfounded. So tender and delicious. The malai kofta was a show stopper, I only wish there had been more. The rice was also great with some soft shredded carrots. Even my 2 year old was loving this food, which was awesome to see. I wish they were closer because I could easily eat here weekly. It's really that good.

I visited Jimmy Hula's a few weeks ago for a brunch time event. The service was very nice and helpful and the drinks that I got were huge and tasty as well! 

Sadly I don't think the food matched where I wanted it to be. My bowl was lacking in good flavor and the steak that I ordered seemed to look more like ground beef and was rather dry. We also ordered nachos for our table that sadly arrived after our entrees were served  so not much was eaten but it did look cheesy. The appetizers that did arrive were the poke and the avocado. We thought they would be enough for a group but that was not the case they were an avocado split in two with cheese on top with a few chips and another avocado with some poke in the middle of  the avaocado where the pit would be. I think maybe larger portions or a replacement with guacamole could help make an improvement and some higher quality steak. It would be awesome if the jerk bowl had some balance for flavor like plantains instead of all the cheese on top.

I love these guys! Used them twice for the company Christmas party and just had them deliver to my home during the Safer at Home period. Their brisket is my favorite. soooooo Tasty!  Love all their sides. And both the dry and candies ribs are awesome. Totally recommend them!

Enjoyed having twice dined at Gian-Tony's in the last 2 weeks.  Will do so again.  Nice ambiance but two suggestions come to mind. One: some house wines (ie, Rose) are pricey - $10 per glass.  Two: Consider having servers prepare dishes of olive oil when diners are seated.  I consider this a refinement that's standard among nicer Italian restaurants.

Fun atmosphere and fantastic service. The band was amazing but we were extremely disappointed that the restaurant only allowed you 90 minutes at a table. Nashville also doesn't allow any dancing in any of the bars right now. We drove 6 1/2 hours to stay for 3 days. There was still plenty to do though considering all the Covid rules

Just had my birthday party at this location. All I could say it's very edgy upscale ambience /vibe . The food was really good especially the gravy fries and chicken wings. Will definitely come back again. Customer service is excellent!

Service department is a disaster. I bought my Maxima from this dealership and have used them for service in the past. Initially the service was good / satisfactory. My last two visits have been worse than terrible. If I could find a way to give no stars I would prefer to do that for the service center. 

I brought my car into the shop at 8:00 as per the appointment I had scheduled. The car required a belt and a tension devise which had to be ordered "from the Orlando warehouse". They have now had my car for a day and a half and are telling me they will need it another day!!! To replace a belt, I thought this was a Nissan Service Center and you don't have a belt in stock? Again this is the second time I have experienced this service center not delivering my car in a reasonable amount of time. I think they have mechanic issues and use  "ordering from the warehouse" as an excuse to cover poor management. Both times I have needed to escalate to a manager to get any response. When I called on the second day to get a status on my car I was told the service manager I was working with was out and they would leave him a voice mail to call me. When I asked if I could get a status on my car there was a long hold and I was told it be tomorrow. This is absolutely unacceptable, they can say what they want, but it appears they had forgotten to work on my car.

Too many Nissan dealerships and mechanics in the Tampa area to ever bring your car to these guys. I will not bring my car here again for service and I will never buy another car from this dealership.

Been here several times and no complaints. However, if you are expecting to sit outside on Fitz's nice patio on a beautiful sunny Sunday afternoon don't! After asking several times to sit outside we were told the patio was "closed" because "no one wanted to sit out there." Hello! You have customers wanting to sit outside right in front of you! Poor customer management...
Amazing food. Great vibe and friendly staff. Very nice place for some amazing food a great beer list.

Would have loved to give 5 stars and would have based on food and service but prices were just a little high for a byob. Had the smoked scallops and short rib fra diavolo which was excellant. My wife had chicken and biscuits with chorizo gravy which was awesome as well. Our server was great and we will return
one of the juiciest burgers ive had. They give big portions for sides, i expected the onion rings to be a small plate but it was a huge tray piled high...its real gud man
Dope ass bulk wings for the price.  Order 1st go there in the daylight. Run in and run out and do go alone. 30 whole wings for $25 with tax

This place is worth it! I ordered the pasta Athena with a side Cesar salad and wow. As a restaurant worker myself, I appreciated the friendly caring service as well as the perfectly made pasta. I will absolutely be coming back to try more items on the menu.

Now a days if you order out your most likely paying for over priced food that you could cook better yourself. But there are only a few places I choose to give my money to and conestoga pizza is one of them! Throughout all the years, they've always had good take-out and not pricey at all. I am very picky who I order from now and Conestoga pizza and Yang-ming are definitely my go to places when I don't cook:)

Awesome shoes.  Awesome service.

It had been quite a while since I bought tennis / exercise shoes... but when the previous pair finally fell apart, shopping we went.

My wife recommended Big River because they had done so well with our son's shoes.

Alyssa welcomed us and shared all they offer... and started me with a Currex foot step test, which analyzes how you step.
She quickly then identified an insole that gives my high arches support.

Alyssa also recommended trying three pairs, and I'm glad she did.
While I could have selected any of the three, comparing each helped me confirm the pair I purchased.

Alyssa also recommended some socks, which have proven to be quite comfortable.

I'm glad we bought my shoes at Big River and look forward to getting future pairs there, too!

Thanks, Alyssa!

Okay, went back again.  This time service was good, food was great, little to no wait.  Glad the management took notes.  So loving the black cherry spinach salad, hoping it sticks around or can yoiu bottle the salad dressing please!

Stop here to get some breakfast food after working a double.  I was tired , my waitress Zoraida was wonderful.  She checked on me numerous times.  Always with a smile on her face. We talked for a moment or two. Turned me around.  Restaurant was clean and food came out quickly.  Will be back because of Zoraida and her sister.

Multiple issues. Biggest one being that the appetizer said grilled shrimp skewers but was actually fried. Nowhere did it say fried. Brought it to waitress attention and she was gonna have me pay for something else that actually had grilled shrimp. My family was already going to be spending $60 and I was very unhappy that I was brought $77 check w out the shrimp appetizer taken off. Service was very slow after appetizer. Few other little things. Food was good I guess but really wasn't hungry after I felt like situation wasn't resolved properly.

Sometimes when I come here it is great, other times, however, it is horrible. I made an appointment for 10 am this morning because I have many errands to run and am on a time schedule. I showed up 7 minutes before my appointment to find every worker starting on someone. This is very frustrating. Don't take appointments if you don't know how to.

This was fun!  Had a chance to sample a nice selection of beers, and even bring home a growler.  The excursion is fairly well planned -- about 30 mins at each stop, with some flexibility.  I wish they had a better way to handle the fact that the tours are over the dinner hour, though.  There really isn't much opportunity for eating, especially if you have special dietary needs.  If you're lucky, there will be a food truck at one or two stops.  And hopefully they have something you want to eat!  So plan for this.  Maybe eat a light supper beforehand, and then plan to go out for a bite afterward.  It's too bad this isn't made clear on their website.  I'm accustomed to breweries that are also restaurants, so this caught me off guard.

Our driver was friendly but his commentary was often offensive and quite crude.  We learned quickly to avoid interaction, but when he stood at the front of the bus and gave information, we were stuck with it.

All in all, a fun experience (minus our driver.)

RWWC is a very attentive business for your regular annual checkups. When you arrive for your appointment you are usually not waiting for longer than 10 minutes. Dr. Rowbowtham and O'Brien are both very friendly. I come here once a year to get an annual check up and a complete blood test and the medical assistants/phlebotomists are very welcoming as well. Overall I got the impression that they aren't very good at giving advice for out of the ordinary situations so I would ask for a referral to a specialist if you are having a specific problem.

Have been a couple of times now and thoroughly enjoy the juice and the smoothies. There is a wide variety of both and there are also blended juices, acai bowls, etc. Everything is made fresh and tastes great. Added bonus: they leave out sample sizes of whatever the people before you have ordered. It's a pretty small space so probably better to grab and go. Also not a bad idea to have an order in mind beforehand. The only real knock I can give is the price, but it's not outrageous considering everything is hand made fresh in front of you.

Lovely folks who were kind enough to meet me very last minute in order to get a family friend their favorite dessert, cheesecake, on the day of their retirement. The cheesecake is a great size and so tasty. The texture was also beautiful. Overall a really good value and I look forward to seeing them around town and trying another one of their cheesecakes!
I love this place. Grace is awesome. She is talented at brows. I love my brows and I'm thankful I found someone who is attentive and caring. I will definitely go here for my brow waxing.

Visited Silk City a variety of times.  Fridays and Saturdays are typically over crowded, hot and sweaty and a typically wasted and annoying crowd, but the music is decent.  The food is great - I've been eating at the diner since the first time I visited Philly and recommend the food to anyone.

Solid breakfast. I had an omelet and my boyfriend had the eggs Benedict. Both were cooked well. My boyfriend specifically noted the good hollandaise sauce on this eggs. The waitress was very nice and very quick with our orders. Would recommend for breakfast if you are staying in the moonrise hotel. We also stopped here for drinks after checking in to the hotel, super late at night because our flight was delayed. Good beer selection and the bartender was also very nice. Would recommend.

We are always here when we are in New Orleans. The steak night cant be beat, breakfast are always good, and the crowd is always interesting.
Drinks are good and prices are too

I really enjoyed staying here during our vacation, we had no idea the French Quarter Jazz Festival was happening the Friday we arrived. The rooms are very small, we had to beds and it was hard for a family of four to navigate in the room. I love that they had ear plugs in the room just in case the noise outside got too loud. Our key card kept getting deactivated several times but no big deal,  I just had to go to the check-in counter to get it activated. Theres a gym but I actually forgot there was one !!! There's a very nice seating area by the bar where you can look out into Bourbon Street and see drunk people pass by. The bathrooms in the lobby are very nice and clean !! I believe we will be staying here next year

The mac and chesse was some of the best my husband and I have had in a long time. The oxtail was nice and tender and well flavored. 

I wish I could give trappixx more stars cause the food was great but when we went to pick up our order, there was no employees in the front and we had to wait ~15 minutes until we saw a person.

Seriously, this is the MOST international food fair I been to. And they are legit international food. As in the people running the food stands are from that country.

When is the last time you saw that happening? I think it's because a lot of those food stands are run by U of A clubs. LOL.

I don't know how many food stands there were, but there were a lot. Jamaican food, Chinese food, Vietnamese food, Turkish food, Danish food (which was only serving danish pastries), Swedish food, Thai food, American food, Costa Rican, Mexican, Japanese food, and oh the list goes on and on.

Be aware, you might spend a lot of money here but your options are almost endless. You'll probably get full before you even eat at half the food stands. And that's a good thing because it will save you some money.

I didn't really care for the entertainment but the crowd and atmosphere was great. Perfect to grab some friends and hang out for the night and munch away at whatever you fancy.

Notable things were the Japanese hotdogs and the $1 Thai iced teas!!! And the all little old Asian ladies behind the Thai food stand chopping vegetables.

I've been here so many times but never written a review. I came here last weekend on Saturday morning around 8 am. Typically Lenny's is PACKED. So the earlier the better. I was definitely right as there was plenty of seats at that time and no wait. You start out with a basket of danishes for each person. Then of course whatever you order off their extensive menu. Nothing I have had here was bad. I like the firehouse omelette or firehouse fries. Super yummy!!

The things we do for our kids, right?  Well, we decided to take the family to Coco Key after a fun filled day downtown Philly.  When making the reservation I really wanted to stay at the connected hotel, but after reviewing the hotel I decided that the Doubletree down the street looked a lot nicer and spacious.  I'm really glad we made that decision, but it would have been nice to walk to the room instead of drive.

The waterpark is actually very large.  They have three large water rides that the kids absolutely loved.  The line was extremely short as the kids would be up and down the slide within 5 minutes or so.  The young lady running the bar (yeah, it's a must at a place like this) was fantastic.  She was very helpful and quick to make a drink or pop a beer.  The food was absolutely horrible....but that's not a surprise.

The water was kind of nasty.  When going through the lazy river I got a bit in my mouth on accident and the taste was indescribable.  I've tasted chlorine water before, but this had an extra special funk to it.

Again, this place was nirvana for the kids, but I think I'll wait a while to come back.

The food was awesome some of the best I've had in a long time the server Josh was the best. Recomend the borchetta, calamari, octopus, lasagna, scallops with risotto. The reason for the low stars is the hostess trying to enforce the wearing a mask rule while not seated. Can any human be so dumb as to think this actualy helps in any way? This stupid rule goes against all science and biology.  the excuses that something can happen to the business if they dont enforces is a lie, the governor ended all enforcement. This girl thought she was the police trying to get me to were one. You can order me to wear a mask but you can not make me wear one. This covid lie has gone to far for to long. And no I'm not a trump follower. This society has turned into children playing a game of shut off you brain and  follow the rules.

Couldn't have had a better experience. Jeff is informative, understanding, an artist, and knows his craft. He took the time to understand us, what we wanted, and crafted a breathtaking and unique ring. 

Most importantly, Jeff worked WITH us. He found a variety of stones we were interested in and listened to our feed back. He didn't push us into picking this over that. They made sure we were not simply satisfied, but thrilled with our selection. My wonderful fiance was also happy about how much he saved by going through Beje. Truthfully, this is the best place for jewlery.

Thank you for being a part of our journey!

Service was really good but there was nobody in the restaurant at the time (around 5pm on a Saturday). My pita bread for the gyro was dry and already broken in half, our silverware was dirty and our soup seemed old.

I drove by another day and they were packed. Maybe I had a random bad experience but I do not plan to go back.

Best Italian specialty food establishment ever! A hidden gem with great ambiance and excellent customer service. The food is prepared with love and quality products. You feel as having a perfect
Moment  while being there.

This ice cream shop has great service!! The employees were very friendly and helped my friend and I out. The vibe of the shop overall is very comfortable and cozy. They have checkers and other games to play with while you eat your ice cream.

OK, I guess it's me because I haven't been in this place for years, but I used to love it there. I love their flavored margaritas, and normally I'm a beer drinker, so that should say something.  

Food wise. . .yeah, I dunno.  I'm a vegetarian so I'm limited in any place like that.  Probably why I haven't been back in so long. Well that and I would rather drink beer, (because tequila and liquor somehow makes me naked! I learned past 25 this is NOT a good thing.).  BUT, they used to have really awesome  Ahi tuna sandwich's.  I used to go there just for one ordered  Atlantic City style. . . yummy.  

I guess things have gone to hell since I was last there.  It's been what, eight years. . .maybe seven.  That sorta makes me sad.  But if I ever feel the need to get a little shitty on tequila all fruited up with salty tassels, I'm still heading over there. They can't fuck that up!

I like this hotel because it is nice, but not too expensive, far enough away from the French Quarter to get some peace and quiet, but close enough for you to walk, nice decore and amenities, right near a streetcar route.  Only bad thing about it was that the water in the sink never got cold.  It stayed lukewarm. Not a make it or break it thing for me.

I first wrote a review on Sea-Guini back in March 2016, a couple weeks after it opened.  My wife and I have returned each year since then and every meal and experience has exceeded our expectations.  The food is beyond compare on the island or anywhere in the St. Pete area.  The service has always been outstanding.  They never rush you, giving you plenty of time to relax, enjoy your wine and take in the beautiful dining room and view.  The menu offers a wide range of delicious well-presented specialties, each complemented with wonderful side dishes.  On this visit, March 2020, we had a small hiccup that was resolved in a way that is typical of Sea-Guini's attention to the guest experience.  I had made a reservation month's in advance to ensure a spot, but when we were seated on a very busy Saturday night, it was in the louder bar section.  Expecting a quieter evening I mentioned to the hostess I would have preferred the dining room based on my month's prior reservation.  She apologized and we were seated.  A few moments later she came back and said if we wanted to wait a few minutes more she could seat us in the dining room.  Keep in mind this was an extremely busy night with many walk-ups & a full reservation list.  After a short wait, we were seated and enjoyed a wonderful meal.  The staff could have left us in the bar and moved on, but they went the extra mile to ensure we had a pleasurable experience.  They even kept apologizing for the extra time it took to seat us at a different table!  I spoke to the manager to extent my thanks for his fantastic staff and the night we had. When the bill came, the server presented it and then wanted it back as she forgot to adjust the bill downward due to the table mishap.  I told her no, that I was more than happy to pay the full amount.  To me, they went above and beyond, as they always do to make sure my wife and I had an enjoyable evening.  Sea-Guini is a restaurant you must try if you are in the area and want a wonderful dining experience.

Best Indian in Nashville. Live music was nice too. Authentic atmosphere. 



Yum. 



Yum.

Very Bust Italian Marketi
Eat in or take out
Great  Italian Food
Homemade pizzas to take out are wonderful

i work down the street. we order take out A LOT.
The food is always rad but the bartender is just as amazing
Love love love this place. There's usually a wait but it's so worth it. The queso and chips are next to mom other I've had. One of my favs!

Returned to the Shack for breakfast. Service was fast and the servers were friendly. Ordered the 
"me now, hate me later " breakfast burrito. It had great flavor. The cheese sauce was oddly orange colored but flavored well. The chili was better than the last time I had it on a Slinger. The coffee has a bitterness to it as it was the last time. Must be the brand they use. Will b

It pains me to write this review. I want to start off by saying thank you for all your hard work and that your customer service is fantastic, as are your employees who answer the phone and work the cash register. 

I must say, however, the flavors of the cake were a huge disappointment. The banana chocolate chip was super dense and tasted like banana bread but way too sweet, while the vanilla cake was not soft or flavorful and had a thin sliver of strawberry jam in the middle. JAM. I was shocked, we expected strawberries, not jam, and much more than one sliver. The design was elementary looking and childish which I explained I want to avoid. I was told Id get an ombre look and the crushed candy did not look good at all with the colors. Im just disappointed at the look and taste compared to the cost of about $260.The cookies were a little dry but the brownies were spectacular. 

I felt a strong need to reach out and say something. I think Im still shocked and confused. The whole not having a mailbox wasted hours of my time searching for items to put on the cake and $150 in mailing fees and for the items themselves but because you didn't have a mailbox, I lost out on that time and money. I believe not having a mailbox is very unprofessional and costly for a business and your clients. I have a lot of family in your area, thats why I did the party in Tucson. They were also disappointed. Such a bummer.

Great pizza that's worth dealing with the tiny parking lot.  I'm not Italian but this is what I'm guessing is legit Italian pizza.  Very fresh ingredients.  I got the veggie and it had huge chunks of green bell peppers, onions, broccoli,  etc.. that were perfectly cooked.   They tasted as if they were covered in olive oil before they were put on the pizza.   The sauce is plentiful, chunky and very flavorful...and on top of the cheese ala Chicago style.  The cheese itself tasted like cheese and not grease.  It was stretchy and aromatic when hot.  It also didn't break apart in chunks when cold like the cheap cheese does.  The crust is hearty but not too thin with a chewy crust.  It's not thin crust by any means but it's also not too thick either.  
I've also had the plain cheese which is as cheesy and delicious as it gets.  Plenty of sauce, on top, which really gives the savory sauce a chance to shine.  
There aren't a ton of options to choose from but the ones they do have are great.  I don't think they need to change at all.
I vote this the best pizza in Delaware County.   It's not the best pizza I've ever had but certainly the best I've had out this way.
There is another location on Baltimore Pike but it's only open on weekends.  I suggest you go to this location in Primos which is also right off of Baltimore Pike in the Clifton Heights area.   
Take Out Only, no place to eat in.
Emily does such a great job.  I love my eyelashes and I get a lot of compliments.  Her studio is so relaxing and inviting.

If I could give zero stars I would. They are constantly "updating" which means they are marking off people's patios, parking spots and common areas because they w gone into disrepair and they take almost a year to complete. The people they hire use the tenant's electricity for tools and radios. Lampposts have corroded and fallen all over the property and no one has been out to repair. Rent has gone up over $500 this year alone. There are not enough parking spots and kboi is getting ready to do a report on them for city permits not being enforced.
Super knowledgeable and helpful. No big crowd. Unique strains. This will be my Reni dispensary from now on.
Ate here the other night and got the worst cramps and diarrhea ever - I would discourage visiting.

A standard Shoppers Drug Mart location. The lineups weren't clear to me when I visited which seemed disorganized. The cashier wasn't the most polite that I've encountered but I imagine the job is stressful. I like the fact that they sell bus passes.

I had shopped over 30 Nissan dealers in the Tampa, Orlando, Lakeland, Sarasota Florida
area. Auto Nation of Brandon was the best experience we have ever had buying
a new Nissan. Price and all the paper work was done almost all online. Just show up
sign papers and drive away. In and out within 1 hour....SWEET!

I've purchase many many new cars and AutoNation of Brandon was 
a FANTASTIC experience! Keep up the great job!

Laura  Igarza was the best sales lady ever!! FIVE STARS!
