My usual place was closed and I needed my brows done quickly! Paid a little more than what I'm used to but Dimple is so very pleasant and she has my brows looking the best they have in a while. She actually fixed the one that most threaders don't take the time (or have the technique) to shape properly, and ends up looking weird. Will return to keep my brows fleeky.

Responsiveness, communication, and price were all good until it mattered.

I had an 8 AM appointment.  I emphasized to them I had a flight to catch and on time service was important.  It's a 20-30 minute job.

I show up early.  8 AM comes and goes.  I'm in a storage unit, which requires a code to get in.  So i called them, left a message, left a message on Yelp to let me know if they were coming or there or whatever.  I run an errand at 815.  I get a call at 830 with an apology.  No problem.  Let's go.  Then came the excuses, which are too many to name here.  

They asked to come at 10. My flight is at 11 so no can do.  Response was oh well, that is all we can do.

Ok
Greasy grouper sandwich, fries cooked in old grease .  Tastes rose than Macdonald fish sandwich  service was great

true fan.  i usually go to lemon grass in wp, and swear by lemon grass.  I just moved to manayunk, and did not feel like driving out there.  i google thai delivery, and boom.. here it is.  i ordered the usual basil chicken, and shrimp in the shell.. [very similar to lemon grass shrimp in a  blanket].  i was pretty impressed.  basil chicken was super spicy.. but , who cares when the food is a definite head banger.. AND  they deliver, AND take credit cards..no runnin to the atm.. aaaaaa-mazing!
yum!

Delicious food. This is The Gem of the French quarter. I came here over 6yrs ago and came back because I remembered how excellent the food, the cocktails, and the service were.
Yesterday, I had the watermelon gaspacho and shrimp escabeche. Both delicious. The shrimp escabeche had the perfect combination of flavors and texture. I will be going back today for lunch.
And the people who work there are super welcoming and friendly, and will brighten your day in a minute. Perfect awesome little gem :)

We didn't know what to expect on this tour but it was great!  Our tour guide Angela was a great guide and story teller. I highly recommend this tour. There is so much to New Orleans that you can't learn on your own. Who new there was so many haunted spots in New Orleans.
good food!!! the fusions are cool and taste great, but the basic menu will always be where it's really at in my opinion.

I'm sure on most given days George's is an acceptable option, meaning if they can make additional money off of you they'll respond. 

Not only did I pay 80$ for an inspection, I never got an inspection report or a response in the three days following payment.  When I filed a dispute with the credit card company George decided to call my Realestate agent and harass them instead of? Reaching out to their client? Who, by the way, is another business, with deadlines to meet.  

So I will send yet another email to try and clear this up, but honestly, I could have gone without the forgotten appointment scheduled, the extra two hours wasted waiting for these people, and a harassing phone call the next day demanding payment and not letting me get off the phone while waist deep in payroll... so yeah. I'll reach out for the 4th time.
Food was really awful too salty and not even close Indian cuisine anywhere else in Indians.I am of Indian origin so could see the horrible quality.

Food was great! Service was great! Absolutely loved sitting out by the pool. 
Only complaint is the french fries that came with the burger tasted not so good, kinda like old oil? Other then that 10/10 on the food.

A must go for brunch.  The wait can get a bit long but the turnover is pretty quick and it's not as long as the estimate.

The food is incredibly fresh, innovative, and delicious.  The eggs benedict options are plentiful.  I, too, had the chicken and waffles benedict and it was just to die for.  My boyfriend had the short rib benedict -- also delicious.  The prices are more than fair as the food is of good quality and so fresh.  I'll be back.
Good cheesesteaks, just wish they were bigger. Their $9 large is less than a footlong, but very tasty.

I came here with my boyfriend and a couple friends for the first time after seeing a movie down the street. My first impression was that the place is really cute... tiny but cozy with a lot of personality. 
There is a large bar and an elevated area if you want to sit and eat. 
The food is a bit better than average pub food. We got a plate of nachos and thank god we shared 'cause it's huge. I ordered the pieorgies and kielbasa for myself. Very good.
Decent beer selection. 
If I lived closer to here I'd probably frequent this place. Very Cheers-y.

I can always find the foreign food I want that I can't get at the Asian markets. I always get my UK foods here.

Great service and great variety of food as well as coffee. I love getting the Naan bread. So delicious!
Found this place on Yelp on a recent visit to Nashville. My Avocado Toast, on a cheddar biscuit, was delicious. My homemade cheddar tator tots were the BEST I HAVE EVER HAD!

My wife was here with her mother shopping for fruits and vegetables the gentleman at the counter try to overcharge her 11 bucks for her fruits when my wife said how does this equal $22 when it's supposed to be 11 she asked for the manager and they looked at each other she didn't say anything to him these people are ripping people off left and right please be careful they're overcharging and putting the money in their pockets.
AWESOME FOOD, EXCELLENT PRICES!!! I couldn't be happier to have found this little spot. The employees/ owners are very nice and the food is LEGIT! The guacamole is some of the best I have ever had.

My family and I really enjoyed watching football all day the first Sunday of the 2012 NFL season. We were in town to attend our Grandmother's funeral and needed a devertion.  We got what we needed at McQuinn's and plan to come here again when we're in town.

OUTSTANDING service! It was my 25th birthday last weekend and decided to stay here with my girlfriends. From the moment we got here we received nothing but GREAT service. Valet guys opened the car door for us and helped us with our luggage. Door guys got the doors for us every time we'd come into the hotel. They offer wine when you check in and have delicious hot chocolate with marshmallows and chocolate chips at the lobby, have as many refills as you'd like. The receptionist was VERY nice and friendly. Room was spacious and cute, not to mention the bathroom and the rubber frog on top of the bath towels. Beds were supper comfy, and the balcony with an incredible view of Downtown SB. I asked for an earlier check in and room was ready when we arrived, also asked for a later check in and we got it. They really made us feel welcomed and the service was EXCELLENT. Great job! I will be returning to SB and will be staying at the Canary. I'd rate this place a 10/10 if I could. Had a awesome birthday. THANK YOU!
Wow it was so crowded in here, you have to push your way up to the front just to order and cash only this place is killing it.

So me and best friends went in too get our nails done and they were polite and we all loved our nails but 2 days later 2 of my nails break outta no where. Walmart nails have lasted me longer than that I'm very disappointed and angry that I couldn't enjoy my nails longer than it lasted.
Office favorite...friendly service, and honest pricing! The salad, meat, and produce is always fresh. The perfect place to grab a healthy quick lunch.

My dog has Kennel Cough I called the vets office to get basic round about pricing for a diagnosis. The First Lady I spoke to was rude and said the office visit is $65 I don't know how much everything else might cost. I asked her if she could go ask someone. She huffed her breath put me on hold for 15min then hung up on me. 
I called back spoke to someone else and she said the same thing but this time she put me on hold and a "Lisa" came on the line and refused to give me pricing I just wanted to know what all it included in the testing and general pricing so I know what to expect. She told me to find another VETERINARIAN she has an emergency to tend to and hung up on me. She also refused to give me pricing. 
I feel this establishment is racist and clearly unprofessional. 
I did call another Vet and they told me simply we listen to your pets lungs and if need be will do a blood test and prescribe medication, in all I'm looking at around $150-$200 IF it's in fact kennel cough. 

That's all I wanted this awful establishment to provide me with. DONT GO TO THEM! THEY ARE THE TYPE OF PLACE TO MAKE YOU COME IN AND THEN POTENTIALLY OVERCHARGE WITH A LINGERING RACIST UNDERTONE.

Pretty decent bar fare with a twist each night of the week. Tonight (Thursday) happens to be bacon night with even a bacon bread pudding offered on the menu. They have good burgers, winga, we've had their breaded pickle spears more than once and they have Stella on tap which makes me happy. It is a good place to bring the kids or hang out with friends to catch a game. Tuesday is trivia night, tried that recently as well.  All in all we stop in frequently because it is close to home.

The food was delicious! Everything tasted very fresh. The bao buns were perfectly steamed. I definitely recommend the Brussels sprouts. They have crunch rice in it which makes it 1000% better. It feels like you eating pop rocks without the popping. Also the dessert was very good and fresh as well. Definitely recommend!

Excellent food, service and atmosphere. Everything was perfect. Delicious food and quick service even though they were very busy on a Sat. eve.  It has been a while since we were here, but will definitely be back soon! Thank you!
Wow...that lunch special...I had avocado bowl...has penil..yellow rice..n like plantains (arañitas)..Young men work there Pedro..very nice..n listen good..taking our order..
Great cut and Chris is a super friendly guy to get to know. Some cool decor and warm atmosphere. Definitely recommend

This was by far the best food I have had in St. Louis.  We had the Ozark Tasting menu and with the new fall line-up, we experienced just how delicious autumn can taste.  Much of the history of the Ozarks includes influences from German settlers. As my family's heritage, tonight's meals were very reminiscent of my childhood.  We had 7 courses and and intermezzo, and were treated to a good-bye cookie to take home. Best of all, Chef Rob was personable and spent time with his patrons, talking about the food. Couldn't have asked for a better dining experience.

Not sure what happened here. Last night I stopped in to get a crystal shrimp roll to go. The guy that took my order in the front was good. They seemed pretty busy and with in 5 minutes I got my roll. Drove home a mile away, took a bite and threw it away. Wtf? Horrible. 1st time experience total fail.

In the end they paid for us to go to another hotel one night, and then this am they gave my wife and I an amazing suite. Even providing free champagne and fruit. How could I not give 5 stars. Ohhh and the morning manager even admitted they shouldn't have given our room away ;-)

Came here for a civil engineering event. I really like the venue in terms of looks. It's nice, clean and service was good. Food was just okay. Not bad but could be better. Like most venues, catering food is usually just okay. Overall a good experience.
Best Italian place in Pike Creek.  My fiancé and I found this place a few months ago and decided to try it. We are extremely glad we did.

Abundant portions of well-seasoned food in a lovely dining room. My husband and I have shared an appetizer sampler for dinner. We also have ordered separate meals and had enough leftovers for two more meals! The rose water and pistachio ice cream should not be missed. A welcome addition to the north side of town!

Best lunch truck on campus hands down.

I've made a concentrated effort to sample every establishment on campus over the past year and the food at Yumtown just can't be challenged.

They throw some interesting ingredients together that you wouldn't find anywhere else on campus and they do it well too. Even the cookies are spectacular. 

The prices are slightly higher than food truck fare goes, but the quality you will get is worth it. Some of the sandwiches look small but they are so densely filled that you get too full halfway into the enjoyment. 

Only down side is I'm too lazy to go all the way to Norris most days O:). 

Yumtown needs to open a store...it would be tough competition for Sabrina's-like establishments.

I went to see a foot doc about my heel pain two times. I waited 45 min each time. When I mentioned this to the doctor. He didn't reply. Perhaps if they scheduled less patients per half hour we wouldn't have to wait so long. My time is as valuable as his. I filled out 13 pages of paperwork.

The place is dirty! Kids are always getting sick here and it's too crowded ... Caregivers never know how the kids got hurt and always try to blow parents off when they want an explanation. .. Would never take my kids here,,

This little establishment is doing a great job during these challenging times. They've got a bunch of tables out in the sidewalk and manage to serve quickly and with a friendly approach. We went for breakfast and waited for about 10 minutes. The only table available at the time was in full sun but we took it because we were  hungry. Good food. Good iced tea. Downside is the public walks through the dining area--many without masks. Loved the vibe and menu.

I went in a week or so earlier and was not impressed with the sushi. I'm from Hawaii so I guess I'm spoiled. I came back to give it another shot and was shocked at how I was treated... I swim at a gym a lot so I guess my eyes were red? I was happy to be there and the bartender kid said he wouldn't serve me a drink, only food? I calmly ask the kid why and said that they stood to lose a good customer permanently... With that being said the bartender kid acted like he was playing a violin and danced around in front of me? I was so shocked I said so this is how you're going to treat me? He said yup? ... I understand taking caution on the restaurants behalf, but to mock and make fun of a guest is completely unacceptable. I just walked out. I'll never go back after that... Time for some customer service classes and a little respect for the paying customer? If I could give zero stars I would. Ridiculous...

Wowza... I had never been to Tinto before, but it was an excellent dining experience. Tinto is a small plate tapas style restaurant. I can't remember everything we ordered, but some of my favorites were the Foie Gras, kobe beef, scallops, and prawns. It happened to be my friend's borthday, so they also brought a beautifully decorated dessert treat. Check out the pics.

First of all, the ambiance of this place makes you feel like you should be surrounded by gangsters and crooners like Sinatra. It's a great way to get a taste of old Philly days.

Second of all, I easily had the best Old Fashioned of my life here. The aroma of this drink was enough to make me keep smelling it for minutes before I even took my first taste, and when I finally did, the mixture of flavors combined with the orange-cherry-whisky aroma put me in another world.

My only complaint....I live in Syracuse and this bar is a 4-hour drive away.

We stumbled upon Sylvain and fell in love with the decor. Hip, modern and sexy vibe with dark walls, oversized art and aluminum ceiling. To start we had the fried eggplant with lemon aoili and parmesan, then I had the braised beef cheeks which melted in my mouth. Skip the po boy and try the beef cheeks. Garden in back for cocktails. Will definitely go back!

I couldn't eat a lot of things here (gluten, dairy, oh wow) but I have to mention it for the mocktails! Few places bother to list non alcoholic drinks on the menu, but Bud & Marilyns did. 
The atmosphere is nice. There are tables for meals, or a wrap around bar with seating where you can see the kitchen and all the cooking that goes on. Really nice spot for a first date or after work nightcap.

I just had the WORST experience at your Flourtown, PA location. I normally go to another Movie Tavern but selected this location as it was closer for our guest to go to. First we arrived about 30 minutes before the start of the movie and collected our tickets from the front desk because all the kiosks were out of order. No one to take our ticket or to greet us and show us to our theater. So we showed ourselves to our theater and seats. 
We waited 45 minutes, the last of the previews were running, before we were even greeted by anyone. We placed our order and had appetizers, entrees and drinks. We waited about another 30 minutes before our drinks arrived. 15 minutes later ALL our food came out at once, they even tried to bring the ice cream out that my friend ordered for dessert.
The food was not very good and I couldn't even eat my pork sandwich as it tasted so bad. I finished my drink so I pressed the button to call my waiter, it took him 20 minutes to respond and I ordered another drink from the bar. After 45 minutes of the drink not showing up I went looking for my waiter but was unable to locate him. I checked the bar and no one was there so I went back to my seat. Along the way I saw another server and asked him who I need to talk to about my drink order, he said he would get the waiter and have him visit me. After about 10 minutes the waiter showed up and said they couldn't make the drink because they didn't have the ingredients (Margarita). So I waited almost an hour for a drink that was never going to come and no one ever came back to tell me.
We finished the movie and still had not received our bill to sign the credit card receipt, it wasnt till almost the end of the credits that bill finally showed up. We noticed the Ice cream was still on the bill even though we sent it back because we didnt want it with our dinner, so we had to flag down the waiter again to let him know he needed to remove the ice cream.
This was our friend's first Movie Tavern experience and they were sad to see the level of service and quality from the Movie Tavern, they do not plan to return to that location, and neither do I. The staff at that location gives Movie Tavern a VERY bad name.
Fit the bill for a quick dinner... Small pizza and chicken francais all good - good service

I have been to almost every sushi restaurant in Reno and I find myself coming back to this one. This is the second one. The original is located in Spanish springs. They are both jail themed which is quite an interesting concept. It makes the ambience quite unique and dare I say a little spooky due to the black decor and walls but it is different in a good way.

Now if you're not a sushi fan, don't worry because they have an a la carte menu with various Asian dishes to choose from which include main courses, appetizers, and desserts!

The reason why this is one of my favorite sushi joints is because of their food. The sushi is consistently delicious. Their nigiri is always fresh and the rice to fish portion is perfectly balanced. Same goes for their long/hand rolls. My favorites are the epic high, hitman, and tha joint. The menu has a lot of variety including raw, cooked, half cooked half raw, and even vegetarian rolls! But wait, there's more. The appetizers are also amazing. If you go to sushi and don't get yakiton, you're missing out. I also love the calamari rings. And of course who doesn't love to end their meal with dessert? They have a variety of desserts from both mochi and ice cream. My go to is green tea or tempura banana ice cream.

The service is okay but it could be better. The servers are always friendly but not the most attentive. They tend to disappear until it's time to give the bill. The lunch and dinner menu are exactly the same so if you're expecting more options for dinner you won't find any even though the dinner price is more.

Unlike other sushi restaurants in Reno, lunch ends at 4pm whiles others end at 3pm. Lunch is $18.95 and dinner is $24.95. They also have a 10% off for students and military Monday-Thursday. Yay for AYCE sushi!

I ordered Buca through Uber Eats and I am so disappointed. I have been to Buca many times and have enjoyed the food. Tonight I am sitting here thinking, how does an Italian restaurant meets up spaghetti? The pasta tastes old and the sauce is straight from the can. I could have ordered Fazoli and got the same cheap tasting food for half the pricess. This is disgusting!

This was our first visit to The Lucky Dill, and it definitely won't be the last. Michael was a fantastic server, his suggestions were spot on and his service was perfect. Husband had the Friday all you can eat fish and chips, I had the Waldorf chicken salad sandwich. SO MUCH FOOD and very fresh and delicious. Prices are very reasonable. Loved the live music in the bar! Can't wait to go back!
Leonardo was great and the roof is transformed! Great price and everyone was very personable. You couldn't ask for more!

Me and my boyfriend go here all the time. Love love love the sushi. I also always get two orders of the steak & chicken hibachi w/ fried rice. YUM! Sometimes the waitresses are always surprised with how much food we order and are kinda of opinionated. What can u say? We're always wanting more and more. All you can eat, right? I'm down! I also don't mind their rules with having a 2 hour limit for the lunch or dinner special. It only takes me and him about an hour to complete our food. I have worked in food service so I have bit of a pet peeve with cleanliness, and it's a very clean environment to eat! I'll be going back later today and any other day after that!

I dare say this is my absolute favorite place to dine in Tucson; this is the place I like to go on my birthday.  I can no longer eat burgers from other establishments as the burgers at Ermano's are far superior.  They have wonderful selections for craft beer and wine, and awesome daily specials.

I have been here three times now for the weekly trivia pub night.  Without a doubt, I have always had a good time.  Just as a note, trivia nights used to be on Tuesday during the summer, but they now occur on Thursday for the Fall hours.

I wanted to highlight a few things that I really like about this place.  First, the decor and atmosphere are top notch.  It is clean, well-lit, warm, and lively--great place for trivia.  I will admit that it can get a bit loud, but I think it adds to the excitement (people quiet down when the questions are called).  

Second, the food is surprisingly good.  Apparently it is a "gastropub," which is something I didn't realize--or even knew existed--before I checked their website to find why they are now closed on Tuesdays.  They have a few veggie options, which I enjoyed.  My friends thought the hamburgers where pretty amazing.  As an added bonus, they buy local and try to use what is in season.  

The last thing I want to mention is the service.  I have always been impressed how friendly and attentive the wait staff is.  Even when the place is full with people playing trivia, they were always checking up on us.  They also went out of there way to be accommodating for special request.  Some friends wanted to try multiple different beers on tap without ordering a pint of each.  The pub was more than willing to do "flights" of beer and charge by the ounce.  So my friends had three small glasses of the beer they wanted.

Overall, it is a good place to grab a bite or spend the evening with some friends playing trivia.

I went to Spain because I bought a Groupon for $30 to the place. We made reservations at about 4pm for 6:30 on New Year's Eve. The place was nearly empty when we arrived despite the hostess claiming they were booked from 7-8 PM. Upon arriving, I was surprised to find a very minimalist interior. Having lived in Spain, I can attest that the interior was nothing like any place I'd ever been in Spain. The "ambience" was definitely intended to convey a young, hip and modern feel, but It seemed a bit overdone. The prices were acceptable considering the quality of the food (with tax and tip, it was $108 for six tapas, churros, and a pitcher of sangria), but there was a distinct disconnect from the ambience. We ordered six tapas, including tortilla Espanola, croquetas, champinones extravaganza, filete de res, pimientos, calamares fritos and churros. Everything was very good with the exception of the croquetas, which were a bit pasty and the churros came two to a plate. The service was very good and the sangria was top-notch. If it weren't for the ambience, I would have given this place five stars. I'll definitely go back!

Whenever I am in Indianapolis, I make it a point to stop at Yats (any location) The food is consistently great, every single dish I've ever had. Just point at the board, whatever you get will be delicious.

First time visit with the bright sign drawing me in. Food is 5/5 but because of service speed i had to drop it. Maybe once they figure out a better workflow, we can bump it up but the long 15+ minute wait was unexpected for something that appeared to be a fast food set up. I think if they had a ticket order system and assigned clear roles for the employees to minimize their movement and optimize the line setup, the confusion and delay would resolve.

When i walked in, i thought oh it's like Chipotle but with Indian cuisine. I got the chicken korma and was super impressed. Then i threw on the spices from their orange packet and ate it with the freshly baked naan and mint chutney and oh, my, goodness! i was so happy. The serving was enough to feed me twice and i woke up the next day having to exert self control because i wanted to go back. 

There's a little bite to the curry but nothing painful to me. If you want naan, I'd recommend telling them first before your entree order because it can take up to 5 minutes to make it. I saw the reason why. There's someone in the back rolling out each naan piece and then it gets put in the oven for 4 minutes. I only saw one oven so if the people in front of you all order naan, you can see how the time adds up.

Maybe i have it all wrong and it's not meant to be fast food but i think if they can deliver on speed, more people would be happy to visit more often.
The reading was vague. Then I had to make more appointments and she always had something I had to buy to "help" me. I felt like an idiot for falling for.  Not for long, tho'.
Best Dentist in Bucks County! Hands down the best dentist and staff. Highly recommended.

Amazing quality of fresh foods and lots of variety. They have some of the best prices for the quality of produce they offer. It is a great atmosphere and the employees are always friendly and seem like they enjoy what they are doing! Plus, I love that they have an organic honey stand where you can buy honey. Local products are a major plus for me!

May be the dish I have order didn't impress me. I have book mark this place for some time. I was having a high hope for it. Tuk Tuk is rickshaw in Thailand. So this is mobile food.  

The menu show interesting selection. One thing catch my eyes is their crab fried rice. I got one of that. I also got their Thai ice tea. The Thai ice tea has strong enough tea in it. I like it the milk and tea mixed. 

I have the crab fried in Thai hot. It does bring on the heat. But the dish did not impress me for several reasons. The rice is too watery. The tomato put in there actually damp the wetness of the dish. It is not a good combo. The crab meat it spread in thin pieces. It can be chunky. It has crab taste but not really crab meat taste. May be they use the blue crab instead of dungeons. 

Services is average. The initial contact is a bit slow but the close up and paid is quick.

Where else can you get amazing seafood but here. Service is up to par as normal. It has great local beers that if you are from out of town you must try.
Be warned there normally a wait as everyone once to eat there

We came here at 7:30 on a Tuesday night. We had been recommended this place by friends, and had high hopes for the food! When we arrived, we were told it would be an hour wait, which was fair because there were 7of us. The host was working bartender and the host station which started the frantic atmosphere. She was rude to us when we asked how long the wait would be, and if we could wait at the bar. We waited outside for about 30 min before going inside. At the bar, we waited 20 minutes to be served. We ordered the happy hour oysters with 15 minutes left of the deal. We also ordered 5 drinks which she said would be right out. We waited another 30 minutes for the drinks and they came out right before we were seated around 8:45. They forgot one of the beers, and we sat at the table for another 20 minutes before the oysters came out. The only reason I am giving this a generous 2 stars is because the oysters were delicious. They were served in a delicious oil with bread, though there was some sand still in them. We did not mind this, and were hopeful for the food. We all ordered, and waited again for our food. We ordered 5 burgers, chicken, and a fried shrimp Po boy. One of the burgers was ordered as medium rare, and came out burned past well done. We returned this burger and the waitress said she would bring another. The fried shrimp in the Po boy was NOT deveined. This was quite gross and unexpected for a recommended seafood restaurant. My friend did not eat this but did not return it because it was not worth the long wait. By the time we were all finished eating, the replacement burger came out. We decided to order the check immediately because of how slow and inhospitable the service had been. When the check came, we were charged for the beer that never came to the table. Additionally, we were charged a 20% tip to each bill. This service was absolutely not worth 20% and we were appalled at this. This restaurant may be nice for oysters and drinks if you don't mind waiting 2.5 hours, but for anything else STAY AWAY. We will never return.

Came here for breakfast. The food took close to 30 mins to come out and there was no more than 5 tables and 4 people at the bar.

The service was so bad. I don't know what was wrong with that guy but he was either high as a kite or hungover. 

I won't be back here

Great food and a great concept.  I can't give it 5 stars though, because the service wasn't the best.  They're friendly, but still working out some service issues.  We had to wait quite a while for our food order to be taken.  I'm sure they'll be able to work through this though.

This review is for those who don't know Five Guys, those who have never tried it before and if you're reading this and curious, try them if you want a good American cheeseburger. They do it classic but they do it classically well. I ate there today for lunch. Do not skip out on the fries. Get the Cajun seasoning. Use the paper bag and toss some seasoning in the bag and shake. Their fries are amazing. If you like em crispy, let them know. Great location too. Always friendly, always clean and open till 10:00PM everyday.

I really enjoyed the lamb shank and loved the falafel!!! One of the BEST I've tasted in nashville! The stuffed grape leaves weren't as tangy as I prefer but good... the pita was deliciously fresh! I wish the tzatziki sauce was a little more seasoned... the atmosphere was ok but would really add to that good cook they already have!! I'm not a fan of country music in a middle eastern restaurant.. Celebrate the whole experience! I'll definitely be back!

This is a great fast food Greek spot. We routinely get chicken gyro platters to go here. They come with a Greek salad that's decent, and lemon roasted potatoes and green Beans. The one thing I would say is you should ask for extra tzatziki sauce cuz they don't seem to give enough.
This place is great. I am a vegetarian so I love that they have more than one veggie roll, service is great and my friend I was with likes all their seafood rolls. Also, I love their mochi balls.

I'm a fan of iron hill for sure!  It's a great place to grab a quick brew and little something to eat. The menu has a really good variety for vegetarians and meat eaters alike. The staff knows the menu well and can always pair a meal with the perfect beer.

Outstanding service and selection!! Every section is packed with gems, known or not! Very diverse selection of music and the staff is exceedingly knowledgeable and easy to talk with. Their emphasis is on vinyl records, but they also offer great CD and cassette selection! Best place to buy music in the entire county, and perhaps the greater area!
Dr Cole has changed my life. I would recommend him to anyone. He actually listens to his patients and works with you to make the right plan for your health.

Hard to believe that I tried living through this nightmare again - But I did - took a business associate out for dinner - Salmon was undercooked - asked if they could put on the grill for a couple minutes more - my food disappeared and here I am an hour later eating for my salmon - was told my order went to another customer - was told I'm getting free desert - was told by the manager my food would be here shortly but here I sit waiting for my food at a table by myself - I encouraged my work associate to go home - I might get home at someday

Do you like tacos?? you'll love these!!
I have only had the tacos, quac and salsa here but have been told the rest of the menu is delicious. This is the baby sister to Delicia so some of the menu items and drink list are shared between the two places.

Recommendations!
Tacos: Fish, Pork, Carne Esada and Shrimp. the tortillas and the toppings are fresh and pop with flavor. (all the tacose are great, these are just my favs)

Guacamole: probably one of the best in the city and made fresh. besides the normal guac they add in fresh jalapenos and pistachios. its amazing!

Salsa: nothing fancy just darn good salsa!

Drinks: their margaritas are made with no store bough mix, they create it in house. not too sweet not too sour. there are a couple of other drinks that are from the Delicia menu like the fire and ice that are pretty great.

The bar is small but they have a nice beer selection with some locals on tap.

The place is small but quant and fun to dine at. 

I have been many of times and only once did we have an issue. It was slammed busy and the waitress that was working our section was horrible (not purposely just couldn't keep up). A few tables left without ever getting anything ordered and our order got screwed up. All the other times i have had exceptional service and great food.
Food and service were welcoming and plentiful. This place is best to visit on a Tuesday or Wednesday in order to avoid the crowd.

Excellent breakfast. Little bit of a wait in line, and was lucky to get a table. Food was great though, everybody I was with loved what they got. Staff is very friendly and welcoming. Nothing really negative to say, will likely be going back again next time I'm in town.

Self care seems to be the order of the day. 

Y'know-I think one of the biggest bunches of b.s. about sheltering in place is the message that we should be using this time like we are in some safe, cozy cocoon, metamorphosizing into A Better Self. We should be reorganizing our homes, sussing out the most flattering paint color for the guest bath, purging our closets and drawers, building or acquiring firm glutes, six pack abs and toned arms, learning how to play Beethoven on the alto clarinet, planting the perfect victory garden (even if we are apartment dwellers), perfecting our French and whipping up incredible gastronomical delights, including every variation on sourdough bread imaginable. The content writers who promote this crap are greedy and hungry for bait clicks and clearly do not live in a real world where there is no toilet paper to be found, going to the grocery store is more hazardous than swimming in a rip tide ocean or the polluted Schuylkill, people are frightened, lonely, angry and despondent and no one knows when or IF anything will ever be 'normal' again. Some of us don't have jobs anymore. Some of us have become sick. Some of us died. This is not holiday break or Adult Self Improvement Vacation Boot Camp. This is real life. This is a pandemic.

Since as of today's date, Pennsylvania is still in lock down/SIP, I did not visit this place. My review is for online ordering. 

One of my vices (next to eating and drinking) is skin care. My maternal grandparents were immigrants thus growing up using egg white masks, chamomile tea hair rinses, lavender essential oil on burns and so on was completely ordinary and normal. Until just the past few years, 'clean' face and body products were things that you usually only got a very high end spas. 

Enter Sabbatical Beauty-a local company (Bok Building-South Philly), woman owned (Dr. Adeline Koh), stressing maximum results with minimum filler and a K-Beauty sensibility. I had a few days of fun, online window shopping, filling my cart, editing my cart, taking the quizzes, exploring the website and reading customer reviews before I pulled the trigger and actually placed my first order. One thing I found appealing was the ability to buy travel sizes of most SB products. In one order, I purchased Caphe Roasters Vietnamese Coffee Scrub. Local coffee roasters who are doing good things for their Kensington neighborhood and using Southeast Asian beans provide the grounds for this. It's a serious dose of caffeine, sugar, coconut milk and botanicals in a pudding-light, very gentle but effective exfoliant. Upon first time use, my skin felt velvetized all week. Yes, from one use. A little goes a long way.

Another order was one of Adeline's Botanical Hand Purifiers. Taken from the site-"These are a combination of two types of ideas: one, an effective antibacterial hand cleanser, and two, a throwback to herbalism and herbal medicine." Hand sanitizing is a way of life now so why not do it as pleasantly as possible without turning your hands into withered claws? This comes in 3 sizes and 3 scent combinations and no, it is not just a pretty smell. When I used it for the first time (Lavender & Chamomile Flower was my first order), for at least an hour after, I was catching whiffs of something very uplifting and delightful. Not heavy, more of a soft, ambient scent that came and went, like blossoms on a breeze. I finally realized it was from this product. I have since ordered the other 2 scents as well and use the hell out of them. No withered claws on Warren.  

Because this is a time when supporting small business and performing  kindness goes a long way, I've placed gift orders for local friends, too. Nothing but raves and positive feedback from every recipient. With every order (ultra fast UPS shipping), I get a personal thank you e-mail from Adeline. The packaging is Earth friendly, it feels good buying from a woman owned, local, ethical business, you can design a minimal or full skin care routine for yourself (or buy just one travel size thing and incorporate it into your existing toilette) and these small batch products are not just bottles and jars of empty promise. They do what they claim.

Sure. Maybe you can't go and sit, see and be seen at your favorite (fill in the blank) Philly bar/restaurant but while you're still sheltering in place, you can certainly pamper and prepare your visage for when that time finally does come. 

P.S.-There's no *SHOULD* here as I wrote about in my preamble. Once you have a Sabbatical Beauty item in hand, you will absolutely WANT to take care of yourself.
Such a gem to the typical Roxborough fare and would love to see more places like this on Ridge. With the new brewery coming, hopefully locals continue to support new businesses.

We are so lucky to have found Kincannon Photography from the very first meeting withJeremiah, he made us feel comfortable. Jeremiah shot our engagement photos and initially my fiancé and I were super nervous but Jeremiah was amazing ! It's honestly a day I'll never forget. I can't for them to capture the moments at our wedding ! I highly recommend Kincannon.

This is the WORST location by far.  I've ordered here several times via Door Dash and they managed to screw up my order 3 weeks in a row.  That's not Door Dash's fault because Chipotle's incompetent employees make and pack the orders.  Reading comprehension and caring about their jobs is apparently not part of the hiring criteria at the Plymouth Meeting location. Today my coworker ordered (I won't anymore) and after her order was supposedly picked up, they canceled it.  She called the restaurant and they said they were too busy.  As horrible as they are with quality checks and customer service, I have to wonder about food safety.  
Beware of this place!!!
I come all the way from Las Vegas for the beef chorizo. It is amazing!! Inexpensive and delicious.

Food was tasty and staff was attentive to refill drinks or help out. A group of 14 came in behind me and their good came out super fast. The place is located in a small shopping center if you are looking for it. Go on Thursdays for the great special: medium burrito, chips and drink for 5.99.  Plus self serve salsa bar. They serve other items besides burrito's too.
It hit the spot on a very, hot muggy day. We both ordered sushi extra deluxe platters. The hand-rolled California roll was very good.

Such an incredible find!! We've never had a warmer welcome than from Ben here at the Harbor House Inn. The place is small and quaint - and that makes it peaceful and quiet! Our room was like a condo and had everything we needed and then some. 

What struck me was how upscale and tasteful the furnishings and decor are. Everything is much nicer than your standard hotel. 

We also enjoyed the proximity to the harbor and beach - easy walking distance. We didn't take a ride on their beach cruiser bikes this time but we plan to next time.

Classy place, upscale beachy vibe, and we'll definitely be back soon!

My family of 9 had dinner here on Christmas Eve 2016. 
Due to our party size we booked a reservation and when we arrived our table was ready. 
The service was great! She was super friendly and very patient with us as we decided what we wanted and provided some great recommendations. 
We ordered 9 dishes which was the perfect amount for 9 people. 
The food was hot, delicious and very flavorful. The best was the walnut shrimp and the Peking duck. The orange chicken was a bit sweet for my taste but still very good. 
The prices are also very reasonable for the amount and quality of food you get. 
The restaurant was very clean which I alway appreciate. 
My only complaint is that the food is served on square plates which do not fit well on the lazy Suzan but thankfully the food was a bit staggered so we were able to get rid of some of the empty plates before more food arrived. 
Highly recommend this restaurant if you want good service and food at an affordable price!

I do not recommend this place to anyone who actually cares about food.  I came here with high expectations. I don't care that this restaurant is in a casino, if they are charging the prices they do, they should provide the service and food quality fitting those prices! 

We sat fifteen minutes before they took our order, half an hour before they brought our drinks, then another twenty five minutes before they brought our food! The service was seriously slow.  Our water glasses got empty, and no one filled it even once, until my boy friend asked one of the servers to fill our glasses again.  They don't clean the tables regularly either, no waiter checked on us even once, and unfortunately, the fact that the table next to ours got better service, made our Brazilian and Persian guests to think that perhaps because they thought this table belonged to foreigners, that's why we got a worse service. 

Now on to the food:  We were served two types of bread upon sitting, and the bacon/cheese bread was actually really good.  the onion roll, was only ok.  For appetizer, we had foie gras, and... it didn't taste like foie.  It was either overdone to the point of losing its yummy fattiness, or it was simply fatty duck liver rather than real foie.  So that was immensely disappointing for me.  We also got a clam chowder, which was ok, didn't taste much like clams, and the few clams that were present in the soup had a plastic-like texture... simply horrendous. 

Then it was the steak time, I tried the rib-eye and the fillet, and I also tried a prawn.   The rib-eye was tough, and tasteless, my jaw got tired way too soon and couldn't finish more than couple of bites.  I got tired soon, and had to stop eating before I was full.  The vegetables that came with the steak were also overcooked, so I couldn't fill up on those either.  I then moved to the french fries that my dad got, and oh my god, there was no doubt in my mind that the oil they cooked the fries in were rancid.  The fries lacked seasoning, and they did not taste good at all.  When we complained to our server (who didn't show up until it was time for the check), he simply replied: "yeah that's weird; the fries aren't my favorite item either!".  I mean seriously?? that's what you answer? no apologies, no nothing? anyways, back to the food: the shrimp was also overcooked, and did not taste great.  I've had cheaper better tasting shrimps MANY times before, and this place is only memorable for its bad quality. 

the fillet was tender, and while it was just as tasteless, at least it was easy to chew.  We will not go here again, and I honestly would have given them zero stars if it was possible... so at the end, all I can say is: "Eek! methinks not."

Very quiet place to stay within park. No way to avoid train or plane noise wherever you go. Staff are very helpful, friendly and accommodating. Beautiful country, a garden and walking trails. Will stay there again next time I go through.

This place is awesome! I needed new work boots last minute for a job interview that was on Monday and I found out about this place Friday night. I had been scouring all over the philly and south jersey area in these work boot retailers(Work n gear, dicks, etc.) and couldnt find anything decent. A lot of the inventory at these places just have the corniest styles and always from the same three brands.

These guys had a waaaaay better selection and I'm talking about "designer" and made in America brands like Chippewa, Carolina, Thorogood. I dont remember the last time I visited a retailer where I could try on several styles of Thorogood's. The staff was super friendly, knowledgable and the price was  way cheaper than ordering online. 

I'm telling you, if you want real work boots, and you actually want to try them on before you buy it, come here.

Pachuigo is one of the fewest or perhaps the only gelato shop in the Tampa Bay Area that has 6 flavors that are dairy free that I know of. 

3 out of the dairy free are sherbet so 3 are "flavored like" dairy.  I.e. Chocolate and Vanilla made with sugar and flavors the worker said. 
 
Located on beach drive so this particular gelato shop is surely a happening spot. 

Seatings inside are limited but there are numerous outdoor seatings available with a beautiful view of beach drive. 

The prices of the gelato are affordable so its budget friendly.

Went there to get a "sampler" selection of hand rolled cigars for a cigar smoking friend's bday. Wife and I know nothing about cigars. The person who helped us was incredibly friendly and made the choices for us at our request. Once presented, our friend said their cigars are great there. And his brother-in-law has paid to have them shipped to him in MN. So I'll leave a positive review on his and his BOL's behalf.
My husband and I really enjoy the food and the service!!! We have dine there several times and the food and service is always awesome!!!

Second time. Again, no wait. Again, excellent food. Get the pretzel bites.  And the beet salad. For entrees, the chicken is superb. I live here in old city and this is truly a hidden gem. Skip all the other crappy restaurants on Market and go here.

My wife and I decided to visit here after walking by it a bunch of times and seeing it was always pretty busy, no matter what time of the day it was.

I also wanted to catch the end of World Cup game ;)

We stopped in for a drink and it was a great experience. I had a Mojito and the house Margarita. The Margarita was pretty good but the Mojito was killer! I could have had about 10 more.

The complimentary bottomless chips and salsa were a nice touch. Their salsa was good and the chips were seasoned with seasoned salt and were addictive!

We sat outside and the seats were a little dirty, but it was shady and the ambience was cool so it was OK. Mostly I just think the tree near by was shedding.

The service was right up my street too. I'm from the UK so can get a bit annoyed by the over-attentiveness I sometimes encounter over here in the states. The waitress was friendly and helpful and came by whenever our drinks or chips were empty but other than that she left us to enjoy our time together.

I would definitely recommend this place, it seems like a good time whatever time you go!

This is quickly becoming a favorite bar of mine for craft cocktails and I've yet to steer from their Templeton drink or beer.  I LOVE when cities convert mortuaries into bars or breweries with one of my favorites being the Pine Box in Seattle.  The Penca people have done a fantastic job with this old Brings building.  It is very dark and quiet on some nights and dark and noisy on others but the great part is that so far the bartenders continuously keep moving and the wait has never been long yet.  Speaking of the bartenders, they are friendly and knowledgeable aside from being quick and attentive.  There is a large room to the right of the entrance for extra seating but the cozy bar is usually where I like to go.  There are old pews as well that will help seat a few more if a little uncomfortably.  They have a nicely varied beer list with bottles like Dixie and Carta Blanca that are pretty uncommon.  Of course the whiskey list is pretty extensive and they have bottles of wine as well, something for everyone.  This Club is a great addition to downtown.

Huge fan of Distrito always, they finally have re-opened for outdoor dining and everything was nearly perfect. The margaritas (we ordered a pitcher) were STRONG...like, really strong. The chicken tacos were prepared differently if my memory serves me correct, they are no longer shredded but still absolutely to die for. Nothing Distrito can really do here, but the lantern fly's were seriously everywhere around/on the table and it was pretty gross. I wish they still accepted the rewards card for Garces as I had $25 to spend on mine, but I understand so much has changed this year with dining! I will always come back!

Aa a 50 year old California vegetarian, I can honestly say this was one of my most memorable dining experiences..

Incredible service and the pizza platter taco presentation just nailed it.

Indiana is exceeding all expectations..

Megan rocked our world!

Thank you!

Another winner! Thanks Yelpers!! Fantastic ice cream in a wonderful space. Get the homemade waffle cone!  The creators have thought out tasty combinations of flavors and textures. It's worth the drive when visiting Nashville and you have a craving for ice cream!

We are true fans of mexican food, in general.  I don't expect it to always be a "cheap" meal but if it's going to be pricey it better be damn good!
its in a swanky location downtown where all the action is. great. but parking sucks.

Now, the place inside is super fancy and swanky for sure. did not feel like ANY mexican place I've ever been in before.

EVERYTHING  was overpriced as far as Im concerned. from appetizers to drinks....dinner for my husband and myself which consisted of 2 drinks (total), and the following for dinner:
Pork Belly - pickled pepper + guajillo diablo salsa
Baja Fish-beer-battered mahi + cabbage + chipotle crema
Grilled Street Corn-chili mayo + cotija + lime + cilantro
Queso Loaded-smoked gouda + pico de gallo + black bean puree + rajas + habanero "kreeper" salsa
Churros: made-to-order doughnuts + cinnamon + sugar

the food was good. not outstanding to merit the prices. 

our bill was almost $90!!  without the tip!
the service was mediocre nothing to write home about, we had to flag down waiters to get water and to take our order.

would I go back...nada....nope. but you should go and try it for yourself.
my pockets just arent that deep to pay a lot for small portions and lack luster service.

First off, lemme just say, I'm very picky about my hair. Got a Low Fade today from Dustin. I was so impressed with the level of detail and precision of my cut. It was my first time here but definitely not my last! Place is a great environment, friendly and great prices, what more can I ask for!?
I absolutely love this place! It is our go to for poke. The ingredients are always fresh and the staff are very friendly.

My husband and I made it out of the house tonight for a rare date. We have four little ones, three of whom currently have fevers, and my mom agreed to babysit so that we could take a break. We had heard good things about Ella's and wanted to give it a try. The Sunday brunch food was delicious, our waitress was helpful and pleasant, the service was quick, but the live music was loud. Overall a good experience until we stood up to leave and a lady in a ski mask and a shirt that said "Feminist as F***" flew up in front of us, shoved a donation bucket in front of us, and said, "Give to Planned Parenthood."
Really?!  Even after a nice meal, this completely inappropriate fundraiser left a bad taste in our mouth and we will not be returning to this establishment. Disappointing.

As an Ambassador Elite with Marriott/SPG stays all over the world I was truly impressed with this Residence Inn. What an excellent hotel stay. When I arrived with other coworkers we were welcomed by the friendly reception staff of Pauline, Reign, Brittany, Natalie and Assistant General Manager Benny. Was checked in by Pauline and she was amazing. She was very attentive, professional and friendly. Needed assistance the next day and was welcomed by another friendly face Grachelle. What great customer service. She was amazing as well. Would definetely recommend this hotel to everybody! It's a true example of excellent hospitality. Thank you again  for going above and beyond. We'll definitely be coming back.

Great food... Cool ambiance ... Long lines.  But three stars because the lady said the whole grain blueberry pancakes would be better than the buttermilk.... Super wrong!  One bite and down.  Would not recommend whole grain unless you love it.  Spud potatoes really was the best thing ordered!

The food was as good as it was when it was Tijuana flats. The order system needs to be changed. If I am eating in I should be able to sit down and order at my table and not have to stand in line. The salsa verde was great and it was a nice touch that the owner came over checked on us a couple of times.

I have thick, wavy hair with some frizz and curls and Nicole is a magician with her haircutting techniques. When need be her cuts have lasted me 3 months, they grow out so well. She also styled me for my daughters wedding and i loved the wavy look she gave me and it lasted the entire day. The salon is elegant, warm, and well managed in a cute historical shopping center mid town.

Since Devlin's closed, there are few bars on Whyte that seem to cater to the "in between" crowd - too young for the really upper crust but too old for the incredibly loud music of an O'Byrnes.

Food is respectable, and the beer is fantastic. Can have a conversation here without having to yell, which is rare enough to call out. Would go back n a heartbeat.

I'm torn between three and four stars. I stuck with three because I'm fairly certain my four star thoughts have something to do with the fact that I live 30 seconds away. There's nothing more awesome than being able to satisfy a thai craving in 30 seconds. 

That being said, Baan Thai is good. I can't say it's great but it absolutely satisfies my cravings and the price is very right. 

Some highlights: I never eat here or order out here without getting the duck curry. Wow. it's great. It's duck breast with red curry, coconut milk, pineapple and basil. It's everything you want. Sweet, creamy, spicy and salty. Delicious. Their pad thai and drunken noodles are good. I'd have to say my favorite noodle dish is their Pad See Ew...the sauce has a bit of a sweetness that I love. Most of the noodle dishes are loaded with lots of veggies which i like. The spring rolls are standard as the firecracker shrimp and dumplings.

Overall, solid thai place. I'm happy it's around the corner for my thai needs.
The ambiance of this place was good but food is not worth the money. Food tastes SOO bland.

Place looks good. They have tons of selection. I ordered the daily special of the donut cone with soft serve ice cream. It was Fruity Pebbles. The ice cream was pretty good, but the donut cone was very stale and dry (I ended up throwing it away before I was done). Not impressed with prices either. Paid $10 for the cone and an Americano.

It was sooo bad.  food --0   ahi was cooked like eel.  burger was freezer to table with too much coking.  the drinks were a no go and sent back.  the server tried but really was more like olive garden.  went to stony river the next night.  was 20% less and tasted great.  
one and done for us.

Brother and I went in to get him a car. Had to be 4wd and we saw one on CL that brought us there. We looked at several options but returned to our first choice. They are here to sell cars and after a minimum of back and forth we got the car at the price we wanted to pay. Got it home and realized there was an issue. Called next day, brought it in and Jay said "we will take care of that.". They totally did. Outstanding customer service and willing to stand behind their business. I recommend them!

Love this place for this vegan pizza! Their vegan pepperoni is so good and nostalgic for me as it's what we ate every TGIF. Only thing about pizza head is they are on the pricey side and pizza is all one size, but the size is huge!!! Box so big it barely fits into my car each time!

Do you love tacos, cause I do they are delicious.  I just got back from this place and it was good.  1 dollar make you hollar tacos on Tuesday, and 4 dollar margaritas.  I guess it gets better then this, I could have one the lottery but I didn't I ate cheap tacos.
I've been going to New Tampa Dental since I moved here 13 years ago.  Great dental office, I am very pleased with the care I receive from the dentists and hygienists there!
Chicken fried steak and eggs, extra gravy please! Who doesn't love this place. The pancakes are a childhood favorite and the rest of the menu never disappoints!
Formerly known as "Level 2"

My goodness, we have been here many times since November, 2018 and we love this place!!

I am so grateful for the chance to meet one of the owners soon to discuss business and business ventures. 

This place is awesome and, obviously, friendly and helpful!!

Went in, was politely greeted by a red headed fellow.  Unfortunately was ignored by the rest of the staff who then helped everyone else who came in after me.  Was not able to sample anything nor was able to purchase anything highly disappointed sad but they're only on their 2nd day.  And the fact that I was part of the only 2 minorities in there, it felt kind of discriminatory based on those they actually helped.

I normally don't veer away from Tiffin Indian cuisine. I am ashamed by my infidelity. I was enticed by the high reviews, 5$ dollar off coupon on Grubhub and intense Indian food cravings. 

I ordered delivery. Garlic naan, medium spice chicken tikka masala, and gulab jamun. 

Pros: timely delivery, food was hot, large generous serving of yummy naan, hot yummy gulab jamun. 

Cons: the tikka masala was rather flavorless and the medium spice had no spice at all. Surprisingly bland for any dish let alone Indian! The portion was smaller than expected. Hardly any rice and not much of the curry. Confusing since I was given so much naan. 

The naan and gulab jamun couldn't save the experience. The reason for only two stars is because I crave Indian for the flavorful spicy curry and this curry was beyond disappointing. I won't be trying it again.

My friend took me to lunch after the museum and this was her choice. She's familiar with the owner and wanted to show off what he does. It was an AWESOME choice. 

The ambiance is white table without being stiff and stuffy. Deep hues of Blue and rich browns make it relaxing as you look out over Tampa bay and Bayshore drive.  

I expected notes of paint, and maybe if it were evening time, that's what you'd here, I don't know, but that's the vibe: chill and elegant.

The drinks were. Delicious, we had mimosas. And the food was decadent. I had their special picnic lunch and now know why people come JUST for the salad. The beef was amazing too. 

My friend had herself the stuffed crab and could not stop raving about it! 

We enjoyed ourselves with our waitress too! She was so much fun! I want to say her name was Ashlee, but I'm probably wrong. She had a great sense of humor and really loved her job. 

This place is one of my new favorites in St. Pete!

We are from out of town and husband wanted to find a place that we could establish a relationship with for our furbabies for when we come down to visit our daughter.   We went in the building and came out not realizing that the place only trained on the weekends.   Lady training outside was not friendly and we felt that she was annoyed we were there.  No warm and fuzzy feeling to feel welcomed back in the future.

I do not recommend this place at all.  Not once, but twice, the manager did not keep our appointment time.  They made no attempt to rectify and simply said " the manager wrote down the wrong time".  We had text communication showing we had the correct time.  Do not plan on this place keeping there appointment.  They will take walk in people and give up your appointment  time for more money.
Try the General Tsu non-chicken!!!  LOVED it!  Every time I am in Tucson I make a specific trip to pick it up on my way home to Phoenix :)

I had a really great experience visiting Zahav with a large group. We ordered the tasting menu and were able to add a few items that we really wanted to try.

My favorite dish, which surprised me, were the duck hearts - they are amazing, give them a shot!

The wine pairing was great and the ambiance was very nice, laid back, and cozy. I also recommend the cauliflower! We were sitting at a larger table even though we were a group of 6 and had a hard time hearing each other.

This was place was great. I luckily tucked in here after a big rush on game night. Was able to indulge in a few menu items. BBQ was outstanding. The mac and cheese and philly steak tots off the hook! I rolled myself out of here. If I'm back in St. Louis I would definitely hit this place up again.

We're told that it's smart to get a second opinion.  In this case, I was getting service at a dealership and they informed me that the radiator was leaking transmission fluid internally and that the radiator had to be replaced.  More importantly, the coolant could be getting into the transmission and ruin it.  I decided to wait on this $900 estimate and get someone else's opinion.  That is why I came to NE Auto Service.

They were prepared to change out the radiator for much less but advised me that there wasn't an issue with the radiator.  Just a leak near the clamp.  Saved me a big bill, and won a new long term customer.

Horrible Cambodian/Khmer restaurant that cooks Southern American soul food, now I love me some southern soul food from Monell's (or Paula Deen in Savannah) and the various cafe and diners in Nashville (my favorite place is Prince's Nashville Hot chicken at their old location), with the pick of proteins and veggies BUT this restaurant is a Cambodian restaurant taking on the name of the Khmer Empire greatest architecture feat Angkor Wat. There's nothing authentically Cambodian or remotely Asian on the menu but the fried rice and egg rolls, which I was advise to order if I am looking for Cambodian or Asian flavors but once I tried it, it reminded me of cheap Americanize Chinese take out which I would regularly order late night back in college cramming for my exams. I was sad (wasted money) and extremely disappointed they didn't introduce new authentic Cambodian flavors to the Nashville's food scene. The lady further advise me to call ahead during the weekend so her sister can prepare a more authentic Cambodian dish, but having tasted their Americanize Chinese version of fried rice and egg rolls take out, I won't be coming back because it was sweet and too salty for me. I am a very adventurous eater (willing and searching for something new) and like my food spicy, so I was greatly disappointed that they played it safe and catered to what the locals in the area are familiar with. I hope the local in the area support their business because I cannot. I grew in California in a very diverse community, lived in DC, visited a few more cosmopolitan areas with diverse communities adding authentic flavors and wonderful international food festivals so Nashville needs to upgrade their food culture.

So I come from a town in the Poconos where wings are a staple. Since moving to the Philadelphia area several years ago, I have yet to find anything comparable. While I can't say the wings here were on par with home (there is nothing like ordering a dozen on a wing night from a hole in the wall bar), I will say that I was pleasantly surprised. They were cooked well and appreciated the special on a Tuesday night. Not to mention the amount of sauce was just right (enough for dipping celery).

Now for the cons: I would have liked more options of sauces to choose from, the place got SUPER crowded, and my boyfriend ordered a burger with no onions....and alas onions. He didn't make a big deal about it and just took them (and most of the cheese) off, I didn't think it was a difficult order for then to mess up. 

I would come again specifically for wing night, but probably not anything else.

Really wanted to try this place out after hearing great recommendations from friends. We lasted 5 minutes, if that. Imagine being approached by a waiter do desperate to up sell that he asks if we wanted bottled water or Schuylkill Punch. Bite me. Good bye.


It was a youngish waiter with curly hair. Watch what you say.

Went in for the first time for lunch the other day. Found it was very nice. The food was excellent. They have vegan options for those who want it. The hummus was very good. The service was very good, and the prices reasonable. Will go back again gladly.

This could easily be a 5 star review.  The food is great here.  I did the chef tasting menu with 7 courses.  FYI... This is a lot of food!!!  

Here is the lineup:
Pork Bao Bun - This was good.  I would probably try another dish next time.
Hamachi Ceviche - This is amazing.  Served like an amuse bouche.  The citrus flavors are amazing.
Korean BBQ Beef - Very good.
Crispy Rock Shrimp - Very good.  Probably swap out next time.
Crispy Szechuan Chicken - Nothing Special
Lemongrass Scallops - A little salty.
Kobe Beef Fried Rice - Very Rich flavors.
Soft serve.  The honeynut cheerio cone was my favorite.

There is nothing bad here.  It was all good.  There is a lot of food in the chef tasting so be prepared to take some home.

The service was very attentive.  Another trip here will be in order.

I just got my dog groomed at this establishment. He was dropped off with Abby--she was told "do not cut the ear hair, trim the face/tail and trim his hair down to a summer cut(about a half inch). He comes home from the groomer, and i notice right away his beard looks uneven and his hair is frizzy. Then i pick up the hair on his back/-it was about 3-4 different lengths. Nails cut incorrectly(left long and jagged. To top it off, he had a cut that she covered up with Talc and never told me about.

So I call and speak to the groomer Tressa. She debated with me about how i asked for the "shaggy dog look" when did i ever ask for that? I said a summer cut with trim only on face,tail, and ears. So then she blames the unevenness on Abby for giving her the wrong combs.I asked her if she had access to the blade combs...she ignored me. I asked her about the cuts, she ignored me. I told her i didn't want to speak with her any longer...i wanted a manager. 

Tressa kept trying to get me to bring him back but I didn't feel comfortable bringing him back to a place that cuts him, puts powder in the cut then makes no further mention of it.

30 mins later, Loreta called, apologized and refunded my money.

I would not bring either of my babies back here. Ceasar looks terrible and his hair cut looks like I did it. This is just pure laziness on Tressas fault. I now have to take him elsewhere to get groomed because he looks Homeless

Smh. Reconsider bringing your animal here

I have done business with Tucson Federal Credit Union on Oracle for the past few years.  Their staff is knowledgeable and friendly.  I have seen no difference in the quality of service when I compare it to a bank.  I definitely get better rates here.
Best THAI in Indy hands down!! Doesn't matter if you carry out or dine in, food is consistently yummy!!! I live close to 2 other Thai restaurants and Manee blows them away.

Bought an open box sound bar on BestBuy.com described as "Excellent" with "no missing parts, accessories, or manuals". The item I picked up was entirely wrapped in bubble wrap, which should have been a red flag. When I got home, there was no remote, no cables, and no manual. There were also clear signs of wear and a sticker that said store demo. Basically, the listing was an outright lie. Unfortunately, I was leaving on business the next morning and could not return the items within the 15 day return policy. The store manager refused to do anything, and was a jerk about it. I will never be shopping here again. Completely misleading and then terrible customer service to back it up!

BAM!
Pig ears were crispy and tasty.  The ears are cut into really thin strips and then fried.  In fact, I liked these a whole lot better than the fries bravas.  The pig ears have more flavor, and a better texture than the fries here.  

The rotisserie lamb was cooked well, and had a good flavor.  The rosemary, garlic, and lemon tasted great with the meat.  

Interesting beer list and not bad on the pricing. 

I didn't particularly like sitting in the booth, because everyone is sitting facing the same direction, like at a bar, rather than facing one another.  It made it difficult to talk to the people you are eating with.  

I like the look of this place.  Sort of trendy and clean.

The service was friendly and efficient.

I hadn't been to the Kopper Kettle Tavern for at least twenty years, perhaps indicating that I didn't feel an urge to visit this fish oriented restaurant on Bridgetown Pike in Trevose, PA. It was as remembered - cozy, slightly past its prime, with small bar and side dining room. Lots of old Formica tables and rolled stainless steel chairs. I took a stool at the bar and ordered a domestic light draft and the flounder dinner with pepper hash and baked potato. 

Everything was pretty much average. No surprises in the brew. The fish was probably frozen, nicely breaded and fried in oil clean enough to have no secondary taste. The potato was not of a baking variety and remained dry no matter how much butter was melted into it. I liked the pepper hash, which was basically a spicy slaw. I mixed the tartar and shrimp cocktail sauces together on the plate from the two table rockets given me by the friendly bartender. They made for decent dipping of the fillets. 

Maybe the sandwiches are the way to go at the Kettle, because the platter was twice the price, yet far less than double the value.

Upper restaurant was wonderful. A bit of a wait, but we'll worth it. We were seated right at the window overlooking Broadway and enjoyed the people watching while dining. Server was very attentive and kind. Food was fantastic. The mozzarella, tomato arugula croute was light and refreshing. The squash soup was savory and delicious. For entrees we both got prime rib, medium rare, delicious and cooked to perfection. Grilled Brussel sprouts and squash casserole were very good as well.

I've purchased supplies and gotten great advice over the years from this local shop in Tucson. Every time I go in there it's like being "home". Eric, the owner is a great person and his main man Whitey very knowledgable. I was the Trout Unlimited State Chairman in Arizona for a number of years, fished waters and been to fly shops all over the country, Dry Creek is at the top of the list. If you're in Tucson I highly suggest a visit to this wonderful Fly Shop and avoid big box junk.

To be honest I really don't like Plato's Closet. They gouge their prices on items that you would normally pay $2 for at a Goodwill or any other thrift store. In fact, you might as well just go to a TJ Maxx or Marshalls to get the same items NEW for the same price or even sometimes for a lower price! For example, I've see worn-out, no-name dresses at Plato's for $12. You could get a much nicer, brand new, no-name dress for $10 at TJ Maxx.

In my opinion, the only plus side to Plato's is that you have the option of selling your old clothes there- as long as they are very, very, very lightly used. I've sold quite a few items there over the years, and I never ever get an amount close to what the item is worth. for example, I sold a sun dress that I paid over $20 for and only wore twice for $2.10. You will never make a ton of money, but I guess it is nice to make some money instead of just giving it all away for free.
I love this dentist office! Courtney was very helpful for everything that I needed. She was very understanding that I am very nervous of the dentist and was very caring :)

Went in alone on a Fri afternoon. The service was excellent. The food was better than I expected. Cannot wait to take my husband. Everything was delicious and well prepared plus generous proportions
Victoria Normand

Love this place! The owners are lovely & very friendly. Small quaint restaurant. We have enjoyed every dish we have had here. Also, the Garlic Naan is light & airy with a nice char. It is now on our list for go to places when we eat out. You won't be disappointed.

I have to say we have stayed at the Nugget a lot over the last twenty years and it has always been good. This stay we got our room and when we walked in the headboard that had some kind of synthetic fabric cover was peeling on both beds. OK, I thought this may be due to cleaning? Looks bad but not unacceptable to me. The next morning I go in to take a shower and there was mildew around the tub, ceiling and on the little mat. Yikes I thought. The tub didn't drain well. The mirror over the sink was not cleaned well. Then I really started looking at the cleanliness of the bathroom. There is textured wall paper (bad idea for a BR). I was looking around the toilet area and saw what looked like dried secretions on the wall near the toilet paper and a brown spot that looked like feces on the wall.  The baseboards were dirty and the tile floor looked like it was moped with dirty equipment. Dirt in the corners etc.. It was so gross. We told the desk clerk and asked to stay in the other tower in six months when we have to come back. All she had to say was it will be remodeled.
Update: My husband booked us a room here again for a conference. The room was very clean, but the service was terrible. Trouble with the night check in manager, then to top it off we ate at Rosies buffet, at the end of our dinner a cockroach crawled up the back of the booth. The Manager did nothing, not even an apology. He gave us the card to his supervisor. GROSS I can't make this stuff up-

First of all get the pork belly quesadilla the best we also had the duck de cafe and the lamb both were great but for me the quesadilla was the best, the duck is prepared is coffee and that was the only thing i did not like but still was a great dish, the lamb was was great with the sauce the alcohol that we received was a bkueberry margarita which was excellent not to sweet and not strong

Waffle House all across America is open 24 hours. I stopped by this place on my way to the airport and the waitress informed me, after I walked through an unlocked door, that they are not taking orders right now. What a great all American joke.
I have eaten at both locations on state. Both were yummy and left full and satisfied. Definate recommend for pho.

I liked this place. The food was delicious, prices were great in comparison to the size and quality. I must say typically when I go to a southern comfort food kind of place I look to be blown away by the Mac and cheese. Sadly, the Mac'n cheese didn't blow me away, it was slightly dry and not the most flavorful. Other than that, this is a great place, great atmosphere, great staff!

Jeni's is my go to ice cream place and it's dangerous having one so close to my house. The Brambleberry Crisp is my favorite but I always try a scope of a new flavor too. I have never been disappointed. I always appreciate how willing the staff are to get me samples and explain flavors. Recently I stopped into Jeni's on Ice Cream for Breakfast day. The line was long but coffee was provided while we waited and it moved quickly. The special flavor of the day was Banana French Toast. The base was the same as the Banana Brulee flavor but it had little pieces of french toast throughout. It tasted more like cinnamon banana bread chunks but I'm not complaining. I loved it regardless. The Frose is also a winner. Its a nice fruit flavor with a hint of alcohol at the end. The price is a little high but its worth it for the quality and unique flavors.

On Wednesdays, Miles does a 1/2 off burger deal. Seemed like the right incentive  to get me over there.  Order at the counter and your meal is brought to you. Outdoor seating is available and it is BYOB.
 
 
The traditional ground chuck Miles Burger comes on a brioche with applewood bacon, remoulade, cheddar, lettuce, and tomato with fries on the side for $12.50. The real disappointing catch with the half off deal is that all of the super fun adds on are NOT included. Add ins like bacon, mushrooms, avocado, fried egg and another $1.50 and mushroom, caramelized onion, and roasted pepper are $1 each.  So once you add things to make it more than just a plain burger, the savings greatly decrease. But the burger patty was big and cooked almost to the medium rare requested. Fries were good; thin and crispy, with standard ketchup to dip them in.
