I had the falafel burger, which comes with tahini, lettuce, tomato, and feta, regularly $9.50. Again the feta was not included in the half off, but I felt it was necessary to have it on top.  I liked the crispy outside, mushy inside  texture and chickpea flavor. As far as non-meat burgers go, I think I prefer a more carrot plus greens taste, but this has a certain appeal
 
It does appear to be Wednesday, the deal is all day, and while it might not be the super bargain I was hoping for, you can save a few dollars. So, if you are in the mood for a "neighborhood" burger today, this could be the place.

So happy to have found this place.. it's definitely hidden. We were looking at houses in the area and stumbled upon it, seeing people sitting outside on the patio made us want to stop and grab a bite to eat. 

We came for brunch, their prices are super reasonable. They have an unlimited mimosa deal (we didn't get it) but looked really tempting. Many groups were in here hanging out and enjoying this though!!

The food here was good - I had the crab cake benedict. It was good, nothing to complain about though I did wish it came with a side of breakfast potatoes or something, but it didn't!

I'm still not even sure where Fox Chase is at - though I was there all day. This place is an endearing hybrid of your Grandfather's basement bar in suburban Ohio, and a potentially-hipster-driven dive bar. The food selection is pretty small and not for vegetarians or people who care about their cholesterol score - but it's great tasting and cheap. Brats-a-plenty. 

My one complaint was being teased at the bottom of the beer menu with a list of beers on tap... next month. It just made me disappointed I couldn't have them. Alas.
My favorite place to get tacos in Nashville!! Food is always 10/10 and the service is awesome! Don't let the wait scare you - so worth it!!

If this place was in NYC you'd never ever be able to get a seat. Kicks the butt out of all the veggie/vegan restaurants in all 5 boroughs. Reminds me of the superior vegan/veggie food in California. Definitely not to be missed. If your a Pennsylvania consider yourself lucky to have this gem. Us PA folks have way more going on the people give us credit for.
This is a pretty cute cafe. I ordered the Sumac and Za'atar Roasted Carrot Croissant and it was amazing! I'd order again.

Since we were up in the area we decided to come by. We went through the drive thru as we had our dogs with us. The first thing that I wasn't a fan of was that they had people out way before you go to the menu ready to take your order. My wife was a little flustered, and we did not really get a good look at the menu. This would've been useful as it was our first time coming to eat.

We each had a Portillos hot dog, I also had an italian beef sandwich with sweet peppers, and we split a chocolate cake shake. The chocolate cake milkshake is amazing; probably the main reason for me wanting to go back. Everything about it is perfect, minus the calorie count.

The hot dogs were very good, however a little hard to eat. You can't really complain about that, that's just how a Chicago dog is. I think the most disappointing thing for me was the italian beef. I got it with some extra gravy scooped on, which was needed. The beef was a little dry and did not have much flavor it seemed. I paid extra for sweet pepper but there was nothing sweet about it. Maybe next time I'll go with the hot and see if it's noticeable. 

Overall the prices were good and portions were large. The shake and dogs were great and are the main reason I'll come back. I would not drive out of my way to come here, but if in the area may swing through.

Going during Covid. BREAKFAST is NOT included!!! We went on Father's Day weekend I guess if we were going to pay something pricey it would include breakfast. Thanks covid for ruining waffles! Total bummer. 

Attention business-Please change to state not included or continental only.

My friend and I stumbled on this place while walking around. It was super cute inside. I really liked the layout of the store and the decorations. I got the Jack and Jill pressed juice and the Dorothy and oz smoothie. Both were really good! My friend got frozen yogurt and he really enjoyed the key lime flavored one. I was super hung over and the juice helped. Will definitely come back if I'm ever in town again!

I live close to here, and wish it could be a "go-to" place for me. On paper it sounds great, but in the real world it is lacking.

Service is always slow, and for no reason. 

I have ordered several different options, but have felt sick every time I've eaten there.

Would not recommend.

Updated 9/23/27 - came here because some friends wanted to. It is literally the worst service ever. This place is terrible.

Simply, the ultimate destination to satisfy your taste buds. Get the Spicy Crispy Cucumber($6.95) and the Beef Dry Pot($17.95). You're welcome!

Four solid Yelps.
Love this place! Locker rooms are stocked with items to freshen up, the showers and restrooms are clean, the instructors are fantastic and the energy is super calming!

They have 4 scheduled trash pick-ups at my residence in the past 5 weeks.  I submitted a complaint but they couldn't be bothered to respond.  I guess it's time to start looking for a new provider.

I wouldn't recommend getting trash removal services through Republic.

I love Mugshots!  As a result, I'm probably one of their best customers.  I go there just about every morning.  

If you're a coffee lover like me, you can enjoy a cup for $1 if you bring your own mug.  Otherwise, you may have to pay more.  For example, a large iced coffee would be $3.05!  You save over $2 just by bringing in your own coffee mug!  From what I understand, they just want you to recycle - and not just use cup after cup that you're just going to toss after you've finished your drink.  Very cool.  

I've never had a bad meal there, either.  Their food is delicious!  I love them.

Solid 3 star Chinese food shack. Family run. Cheap good eats. Better than Chin but it has no atmosphere. If you are with your buddies and you want chinese, this would be a good spot. If you are with your girl, you shouldn't be getting chinese food.

Wow and double wow!!!

Fairly new restaurant in a familar location on Dale Mabry north of Waters.

Barbeque is excellent with a great variety of smoked meats, fried shrimp and fried catfish. Homemade sides are fabulous - cheese grits, fried okra, collard greens, baked beans, and so on.

Food is spot on, served very quickly for extremely fair prices.

Restaurant has counter-order / table-delivery service, and also a drive-through window.

Well worth the visit!

Well well well, maybe people like it since it's fresh, but I am totally not sold on its freshness and the quality of the fish and other ingredients used in its sushi rolls. Not to mention quality/price ratio is extremely low. But maybe this is what Greenwood has to offer.

As someone who doesn't like sushi, going to a sushi bar was probably an unusual choice. However, I greatly enjoy other kinds of Japanese meals, and I have to say I was not disappointed with mine. The restaurant was almost completely empty when we went, which was likely because we went at an odd time. The staff were all very friendly, not just our waitress, and the overall atmosphere was extremely welcoming. The focus on this restaurant was definitely more on the food than the atmosphere, which is fortunate because it was absolutely delicious! I ordered a negimaki beef entree while my brother had a variety of sushi rolls. My entree came with miso soup and ginger salad, which came out promptly and tasted excellent. The actual entree had beef rolled with asparagus as well as fried rice and vegetables. Unfortunately, the asparagus on the inside was slightly mushy and I, being a very sensitive person, had to pull it out and put it aside. However, everything was very flavorful and came out hot.

There are multiple parts of this experience that made it stand out from other restaurants I have visited. For one, Ichiban is very close to the University of South Florida campus, making it easily accessible for students, even for those like myself who don't have cars. Another pro at this restaurant was the prices, which were more than fair; I paid about $16 for a salad, soup, and entree with meat, rice and vegetables, while my brother paid about $5 for each pair of sushi rolls. For the value, the ambiance and the overall experience--the food coming out fresh and quickly, the friendliness of the staff--I really enjoyed my experience here and definitely look forward to coming back and trying other items on the menu.

John L. Hunter had the touch of a surgeon. Wonderful experience and great value. Relax and enjoy a haircut as it should be. Found it by pure luck as we were in town on vacation from Michigan. I'm typing this as my husband dictated it to me.
Kinda dirty inside. I didn't eat there...I walked inside and didn't like it...so we left. Maybe I didn't give it a fair chance, but cleanliness is a must for me!

This Pizza Plus location really is bad. It is such a shame because we use to frequent pizza plus, and we do still come here occasionally. They really cannot seem to get an order right to save their lives. During a PPV fight a few weeks ago, we placed a large order. We were told what time to come and get it. I showed up at that time and waited....and waited....and waited.... I waited an additional half an our. I was irritated but did semi-expect it due to the fact that it was a fight night and we expected them to be busy. I got all the way home only to realize that the order was wrong! I was LIVID. I called and they told me that they could bring out new wings (which would take an hour and a half) or they could credit free wings to my account. I took the credit. Went to Pizza Plus last night, only to have them get the order wrong again. Only half of our order came out. They told us they would hurry up and fix it and bring it right out. 20 mins later, no one was hungry anymore. What a waste! So unfortunate because when the food is good it is very good, however the service at this location is just bad.

Excellent service and food was delicious! We went on a Sunday during the holidays and brought our own wine. We even bought a Limoncello wine glass to add to our collection. 
We plan to go back very soon. Definitely worth a visit if you are in the area.
One of the better Chinese restaurants I've been too. The veggies always come out fresh and crispy not over cooked and soggy like most places.

First off, this is not the best brewpub in America.  They advertise themselves as such, but they are not.

They don't even have pitchers!  WTF!

Secondly, I found service extremely difficult to render.  I was waiting for my girlfriend's uncle that had kindly offered to take me here to meet me.

I went the bar to get a beer.  I waited, and waited, and waited.  Finally the bartender deigned to serve me at least 10 minutes later.  Was he slammed?  No!  Did he serve drinks in the meantime?  Yes, probably four at most and it was beer for chrissakes.  Did he introduce himself or say "Hi, be with you in a few?"  No, he did not.

The best brewpub in America ought to have better than the snottiest or least friendly service in America.

We met up and got ourselves a table.  That happened pretty quickly and our server handled our needs well.  She apologized for their asinine no pitchers policy despite, I'm sure, having had to do so scores of times before.  Her service was rock solid, friendly, helpful, and prompt without being fawning and annoying.

I got a grilled chicken sandwich that was pretty tasty, but it didn't exactly blow me away.  It wasn't Scobie's in Alameda, CA.  Perfectly serviceable and totally fine for a brewpub.  The uncle got a steak that I helped finish.  It was marbled with fat and a little gristle by the time he was done with it, but still prepared well with good flavor.

Beer was very good, very fresh tasting and with decent flavor.  I think I got a pale ale and a porter and the uncle got red.

A perfectly fine experience save for the jerkwad bartender (a male during a Friday night) and for my outrage at the "best brewpub in America" not having pitchers.

This place is located on the upper level walking area that links the Silver Legacy and Eldorado, I think just on the Eldorado side of the edge (so just south of center).  There's a lot of foot traffic so it's nice for people watching.

Great flavor, great service. Horrible portions, the sizzling steak was 3.5 tiny slices of steak. Of the 6 people with us, 4 of the orders were incorrect. From the kitchen, the server did a great job putting it all in. Not certain I'll be back. It was not a great experience. The staff is incredibly young and insincere. Not the best.

The two girls who came out (Katie & Sara) put my place that even a Marine Drill Sgt. would find exceptional!!  They were able to lift stains I wasn't able to do!! AND this company has the best price of all the cleaning companies I researched.  They were on time, their curtesy and professional manner never left them. They went high and above any cleaning service I've ever used. They cover all the counties in the Philadelphia region.
First time at Bangkok Kitchen. Great atmosphere, good food and great service. I would definitely recommend this place.
Amazing food. We were there on a very busy night. Server was alone and slammed with take out orders but was very composed and took good care of us. Would definitely recommend to anyone.
His work is VERY detailed and the cars he services are IMMACULATE when he is done.  On top of that, he donated to a youth/children's event in Martinez.  Great owner, great business!
24/7 great location and staff plus funky beats. Went there to do a quick print on a file on my phone. Took a total of 12 minutes to be in and out. Not too bad.

A Great Catch

Sometimes Yelp just really comes through, and this was one of those times. Everything about this place was great. As first timers here, we were so happy with everything that we'd go out of our way to go back as we live about 45 mins away.

The service was top notch. I wish I could recall his name, but he was awesome. He was very laid back but in a good way. He gave his honest opinions which all turned out to be true in terms of dishes we would not be disappointed with, he went out of his way to get a different dressing on a salad they don't typically substitute dressing for, and he was attentive anytime we needed something or had a question.

The food was just SNAPtacular! (sorry) My red snapper was absolutely delicious as I cleared the plate. One of the most unique yet equally tasty dishes I've had in a long time. The shrimp appetizer was perfectly prepared, and my whole group was thrilled with their plates. The stuffed grouper was awesome, and on top of that, they again went out of their way to prepare a piece of grouper simply grilled and blackened even though it wasn't on the menu.

It was all just top notch. I couldn't have left happier.
Great lattes! Appreciate the big space to grab a table and get some work done.

I must say my expectations were high reviewing other reviews...

By far, the star of the night was the lamb chops... seasoned to perfection... melts in your mouth... best lamb I have ever had.

When I say by far, this is because the other dishes fell short. The crispy potatoes were a salt lick... but the ketchup and aloe masked this. Unfortunately, the spinach and ricotta gnudi was also too salty. But I could definitely see why the chef selected the remaining ingredients - should taste like harmonious bliss! 

As for the atmosphere on a Friday night... a little chaotic... I don't recommend sitting at the bar unless you are with a group of friends and have a lot to talk about. I glanced around the room and it appeared that so many parties were just staring into space waiting for their meals. It's a small space... and the staff can't help but run a little behind with so many customers. They seem so rushed it can be a little difficult to get their attention. The wait can be long on a busy Friday night, it was for my friend and I. 

All in all, I would definitely come back for more lamb chops!

I had recently relocated to the East coast and had not yet established a veterinarian; my cat suddenly became ill and was in serious distress. I made an appointment with Banfield Hospital; prior to my arriving, I was convinced that my little guy would not be returning home with me (he was extremely sick); Alicia (Client Services Coordinator), immediately provided an exam room, where Anne (VeterinaryTechnician), gave "Frankie" a preliminary exam (i.e. weight, vitals, details of symptoms etc...) she acknowledged that he appeared to be a sick young man (his fever was 105, and he was extremely lethargic, and appeared dehydrated). It was within a matter of minutes that Dr. Wolbramsky entered the exam room and established a quick rapport (having already read Anne's notes), she exemplified much compassion and was very thorough while examining my little guy. Dr. Wolbramsky was very kind and thoughtful...no hit-or-miss exam here; it was established that "Frankie" was dehydrated with fever , as a result of a severe upper respiratory infection. Dr. Wolbramsky administered fluids, antibiotics, and gave "Frankie" an injection; she and Anne remained by his side until his fever reduced. "Frankie" DID return home with me (with a course of antibiotics), and thorough instructions on how to keep his fever down, and with specific guidelines regarding what side effects to monitor. I am forever grateful to Banfield; the establishment is clean, courteous, personable, and professional. The next day, the staff followed up (via telephone) to chek up on "Frank's progress. UPDATE: Five days later, I had to take my other guy in (similiar issues); Dr. Rinehimer (equally as professional), examined him and administered an injection, he was not quiet as ill as "Frankie". I believe that my two little guys became ill during my relocation (the traveling along with the change in climate/environment).  I will forever be "thankful" to Banfield; the entire staff are both kind and thoughtful. I highly recommend this establishment for your pets needs. I know WHO and WHERE, my guys will go whenever the need arises!! (Visited the Banfield in Warminster due to travels).

I am typically not a fan of asian fusion restaurants. I find that rather than sticking to one type of cuisine and doing it well they try and cover so many different styles and everything is okay at best (but often subpar) and I often leave disappointed. I went into KO with this expectation, but their menu looked interesting and they had decent reviews so I decided to try them out. I have been here multiple times this summer and come to the conclusion that I really like this place. They have a decent happy hour that they even offer on Friday / Saturday which is plus. I have tried a lot of things on the menu and have really liked it all, but my top two favorites are: the beef bulgogi bao buns and the spicy pork bulgogi. I could eat these every day. As far as negatives I will say the service has not been consistent and have had a few bad experiences, but not enough to change my rating. Overall, definitely recommend it.

Don't understand the hype. It's just some trendy place that is cool because people say it is. It's overpriced and the bartender we had was extremely unfriendly. When my husband and I travel, we're always looking for hidden gems, we were not impressed with this place at all.

My husband and I went through the drive thru for a couple of Frostys. How can you screw that up, right? I don't usually complain, but this was horrible. No gloves, no masks, rude employees and... the best part? The cashier took my money, then went with his bare hands and started rolling potatoes. Touching the potato with his bare hands! During this Covid-19 pandemic, that is unacceptable! I will never return there, and I highly suggest anyone who reads this, think twice.

It is right in the heart of Philly very delicious Mexican style food! Pretty authentic compared to the many 'Mexican' chains out there! I loved my carnitas tacos, my Mexican corn and my Original Margarita! It's a little pricey but it's worth it! Great for a group gathering, a night on the town and not so romantic for a romantic dinner! Very loud!

Came here for dinner Wednesday ( around 4.30/5pm ) the food was banging. We had the filet sanwhich with Guinness cheese and Korean bbq wings, fish tacos and tenders and fries ( toddler ) our server was awesome too! I'm sorry I don't remember his name! We live around here and will defo be back! Great outdoor seating!

The staff use to be great and fun and inviting however they have changed a few things and the prices have jump really high. So instead of getting five stars that they once earned, I have to knock them down to three stars.

The food was mediocre at best. Even the kids mac and cheese tasted like paste. For three adults and two kids, with tip, it was $92. That was after they removed the mac and cheese from the bill. We had three waters, two soft drinks, no appetizers. Definitely not worth the price. I have always loved Pasta House but we will not be back. They have gone too far down hill.

Good resturant in downtown....high end food quality...very good for small events...i have attended three or four events of upto 50 people...each time was good...appetizers were excellent....they have their own ample parking....so very convenient...recommended especially if u are organizing a high end dinner event...

Grapevine Cuisine is incredible! Went there for the first time last night with my fiance. We live in Downingtown and have wanted to try it for some time. He never had Greek for before and was thoroughly impressed. The service was excellent as well. We ordered the spanikopita to start. I had the moussaka for dinner which came with my soup of choice for only $11. He got the lamb gyro and also got a soup on the side. The pricing for the quality of food is great. We will be going back and telling everyone we know to try this place.

Nirvana is a decent Indian restaurant within the city. I have been there 4 times, it has been a hit or miss. Twice the curries were tasty. The rest of the times they were ok. Consistently rice is not well cooked and Naan is very bulky and completely uncooked at the edges. 

I would go there again only if I crave for Indian food. If I have other options, would prefer that.

My words can't do this place justice.  If you're in Philly for the night check this place out.  You can't go wrong with the dips and tacos.

Food Guy Out!

I rented a home 2 blocks from this bar and found myself here often. You can't find $2.50 beer anywhere else in NOLA that I know of. Fun staff and colorful natives come here too. I meet a lot of musicians here during the afternoons. I recommend there bloody Mary.

If I could give 0 stars I would. I had an appointment today as a new patient. I left the doctor's office after waiting almost 2 hours past my appointed time with no direction on how much longer the doctor would be. Then, I asked for a refund on my copay, and it took the receptionists another 10+ minutes to figure out how to work the machine to return my money.

There is absolutely no excuse for a GENERAL doctor to make a patient wait almost 2 hours before seeing them. Who knows how much longer I would have had to wait if I hadn't left. 

Never going back and would suggest others not to as well.

This was the worst Asian food experience I've ever had. I ordered the asparagus delight consisting of shrimp, calamari & scallops. The calamari was rubber, the scallops tasted past it's prime, the shrimp had shell on which doesn't work for this sauce dish. The crab Rangoon was also fishy. It's obvious the seafood isn't fresh. I advised the restaurant of the past prime seafood and they did nothing. Very disappointing. I will mention the veggies were delicious as were the spring rolls. That's it.

We were looking for a new spot we haven't tried and this seemed promising. When we arrived, the waitress brought our menus and I went with breakfast and my husband went with lunch. We were pleasantly surprised with the portions, and the quality of the food. The waitress was fast and made sure we had everything we had and then only checked on us another time. Which I like. We didn't need anything so I was happy that she wasn't coming around every 5 minutes and let us enjoy our food. I had 2 eggs, hash browns and sausage links, which I could not finish! And my husband went with the cheeseburger and fries which was big and filling. He was definitely pleased and he tends to be picky with his burgers. Overall super satisfied and the staff was super friendly and welcoming. Will definitely be coming back!!

The restaurant is at a prime location with thousands of reviews, we wanted to give it a shot but regret it. The wait was horrible. My husband went there first around 5:25 the kids and I stayed at our hotel room next door. He was told that it's about an hour wait. We came down at 6:15, and we didn't get seated until 7:20. We kept seeing people who came and put name down after us getting seated. 
We didn't get our food until 7:50, we tried to be graceful knowing restaurants in all places are short staffed. 
2-storied restaurant with 9-10 tables were empty on the first floor and upstairs were empty 
We ordered a French onion soup, a Chicken Cajun Alfredo, seafood platter, and a Jambalaya pasta. They looked good but tasted too salty, The chicken, fried seafood are dry and even the garlic breads that came with the dishes were stale and tasteless. 
We finished what we could because we were starving, and quickly paid the bill and were just waiting for my daughter's dessert which took another 20 minutes to get. 
One positive thing was the manager came and talked to us. I guessed he spotted unhappy faces across the room. We gave him some feedbacks about the service and food, and he was very accepting and apologized for the experience and took care of the bill. We understood his hands are tight when it comes to short staffed and undertrained staff. 
We thank him for talking to us but I'd not recommend it. I'd give it one start, but the manager got another start.

My girlfriend and I were at the airport parking garage getting ready to fly out for 4th of July when my driver's side window decided to fall into the door. Not wanting to leave the truck with an open window for a week, we called JSL Auto Glass as soon as we arrived in Denver while we waited for our connection. Lisa was amazing! She arranged their mobile repair team to go to the airport and fix the window. Amazing level of service. I called a few other bigger companies before I called JSL. None of them wanted anything to do with a mobile repair in an airport parking garage with the owner on the other side of the country. Thanks to JSL, the window was fixed within hours and didn't sit open all week.

Awesome pizza! A little pricey but delicious and not great at all! Service is a little slow and usually are put on hold when trying to order. I think they have a hard time keeping staff. Super friendly people and great local pizza!

They helped me out with my broken mirror and made an effort on my behalf to get the job done well and as quickly as possible.  They also provide good transportation for anywhere you need to go.  Their prices are reasonable and their work is of good quality.

Firepits, liters of beer, ping pong, bratwurst. What more do you need? 

There is a line on weekends, just keep that in mind.  The line moves pretty quickly.

I will never go here again. The bartender completely ignored my friend and I while we waited with empty glasses. He walked around the bar to "take a selfie" with other patrons, then left the bar unattended for a long time. We were trying to pay our tab and could not get anybody to help. This was so incredibly unprofessional and unlike any experience I have had in this restaurant. Awful customer service. I do not recommend this place.

I have been there twice, 1st time was great but second time service kinda slow. My husband order hibachi steak, it took forever to get his food. My food came out first and I already finished mine so my husband had to ask them to put in the box. Also my husband asking for 2rd beer, it never come :(
A really cool building, but a lot of the food is pretty ho hum. Pretzel rolls are very good though. Worth a visit.
Worst location. Food and service isn't good and the workers in the back are loud and unprofessional

I will of course follow this up with the corporate office but I wanted to just comment on my experience here at 10 at night at the veterans location. It took 26 minutes to go through the drive-thru and I must say Dante the professional at the front window, working all of the handouts, was impressive. He was calm cool and collected the entire time. The woman on the cash register- working cash and orders - was less than professional: she was at most early twenties with a Rastafarian headband on and long hair out of uniform standard, and she was more concerned with her cell phone than she was with her customers. The manager Tamika was very stressed out, understandably, she was very shorthanded and was vocal about this when she apologized to me. It's unfortunate when any staff is short-handed and normally second shift always feel the brunt of that so I felt for her and her staff. She made sure that my order was placed correctly into my hands after I'd ask her for a receipt, and I appreciated that. She didn't even have time to comment on Dante's work because they were so short-handed that I feel like she was so overwhelmed. It is at these times the very few managers could show leadership but merely have to manage in the moment, and I would never comment or speculate on the amount of stress that this staff had to be in before I pulled up to the window. I think it's unfortunate that they were understaffed, though that is the nature of the beast unfortunately in customer service. The biggest downfall of my night was that the cash and orders taker laughed at and seemingly encouraged the GMC SUV in front of me to point the middle finger at me for allegedly honking my horn repeatedly which was actually the Subaru behind me. Though we can get stressed as workers, albeit  for us to encourage customers to be nasty and rude and engage in that type of behavior.

This is the best place I've ever received hair cuts and bang trims. 
I drove 72 miles for Abbi K. And she did a fantastic job on my bangs! 
Very clean salon, great atmosphere and accommodating staff.

Dried out hamburger, under cooked! Fries were also undercooked. Other people got their food before us! Felt like a long wait to get just about everything. Calamari was delicious though and the chilli was excellent!

Redding Terminal has everything! Its usually very crowded but worth the trip! They also have lots of homemade items that are great for gifts! The fudge booth is amazing! And they have lots of fresh fruit and veggies!

These were the best fish tacos I ever had. Everything was made fresh from the house salsa to the shaved cabbage.  The other menu items look promising as well. Prices are reasonable for such quality. If you're in Sta Barbara treat yourself to East Beach Tacos!

I used Vital Express Limousine for the first time two weeks ago.  I was delayed 6 hours on my trip home and they were there to pick me up.  The driver texted me shortly after I landed with instructions on where to meet him.

They were on time, the cars were clean and the drivers were polite and drove safely.  And they met me at 1:00 in the morning when I was delayed through no fault of my own.  What more can you ask?  Oh, yes, the owner was extremely polite and patient with me whenever I called.

Highly recommend!

This place is INCREDIBLE.  They do it right here - from everything to using a real copper kettle, to tempering the chocolate, the way it should be done.  Five stars worthy, for sure.

Their pralines and caramels are divine.

Speaking from an East-Coast perspective ... their coffee was bland and way too weak for me.  But their chocolate creations - exquisite.  The staff were pleasant and polite.  Borderline lukewarm - but I was here for the chocolate.

I have visited New Orleans LA and been to several places that boasted about being the best.  I can say honestly that Leon's Candy is way up there in terms of authenticity --- and standards.  Quality.  Second to none.  Got my vote for sure.  Mmmmmm ...

The food, the staff, the atmosphere... it is all on point. I love the cuban sandwich. My kids love the guava and cream cheese. The owner is wonderful and always interacts with my little boys. We play dominos while we wait for our food and you can't beat a place that has something interactive while you wait. Don't leave with getting a coffee. 

Parent Tip: There is not a changing table in the restaurant though. There just isn't room in the tiny restroom.

Came down and our cousin-in-law took us to this restaurant. We wanted to go for happy hour but just missed it! He ordered us the buttery shrimp, alligator, crab claws, charboiled oysters, raw oysters, and the oyster and shrimp poboy. Everything was delicious! Alligator tastes just like chicken. So glad we were introduced to this restaurant!

We enjoyed our visit here today.  The admission prices are reasonable, with people 12+ at $9.50 and our 11 year old at $6.  The store is pretty small with not a lot of items, but that's okay.

We took the 1 hr tour, which was quite interesting.  Lee, Hap, and Norm were our tour guides at different parts of the 1 hr tour.  Most of it was inside.  It started with a 17 minute movie, which was very informative.

Both our kids got volunteered by Hap to help out, which was wonderful and made it even more fun for us.  These guys have been around for awhile and I bet they have some stories.

If you have only a short amount of time and want something interesting to do, you can visit this museum, which is the last remaining Titan II Missile site in the world.  Pretty fascinating.

Let me start by saying I used to love this place and would drive from SB on the regular. Today, however, not so much. 

The service has always been terrible but the sushi was always worth that pain but today it all turned from bad to disgusting.

FIRST a sushi chef at the counter bent down and sneezed towards the floor. I appreciated his efforts to avoid directly bombing the food but I never saw him wash his hands afterwards and when he caught my eye a few minutes later knew he was caught. Still no hand wash instead he just rubbed his nose with his bare hand and continued preparing someone's food.

SECOND of the three waiters who tend to linger around more than perform work one standing behind the bar used his t-shirt to cover his nose during a sneeze and carried on a conversation with the other "waiter". Still no hand wash.

THIRD as I was preparing to leave, I see a cook from the broiler area emerge who was vigorously rubbing his nose if not more. When we got eye contact he proceeded to turn and walk away from me and the original direction he was going.

Lastly, my order was prepared with sashimi which was AT BEST the size and width of a folded matchbook, not the nigiri I had ordered. Rice and tempura were both cold. Miso was decent.

My gut reaction is that "take n'bake" is a somewhat silly concept. Either order pizza or make your own! Why do we need this hybrid method unless we are trying to fool guests into thinking we've gone through the trouble to make pizza from scratch when we've actually just paid Papa Murphy's $12 to do it for us? 

Concept concerns aside, however, the Papa Murphy's veggie 'za wasn't bad. Definitely better than your average frozen pie from the grocery store. We got the veggie special with regular tomato sauce instead of the creamy garlic sauce they offer. It had so many veggies, it was kind of like a garden in my mouth. The sauce could have used a bit of basil or some more interesting spices to bump up the taste of the pizza overall, though. I would probably rather have this than Donato's or Hot Box and definitely more than a Tombstone from the freezer aisle. Would I rather have it than 'Za or Bazbeaux? No.
So glad I followed the reviews and ate here. So delicious, great place! Will def eat here again when in Philly. Had the tostadas carnitas. Fresh ingredients, great experience

First timer and my Wife and I really enjoyed it, food was very tasty and served in large portions. It has outdoor seating which is great but we sat inside. Best of all the prices are very good for this day and age. Our server was a little dry but she was attentive. We will definitely eat here again, this is a hidden gem.

Korean fusion yumminess!!! I stumbled upon this korean restaurant on yelp and decided to drag my girlfriend along haha. My girlfriend ordered the spicy fried rice w chicken and I got the cheese skillet. I really really liked my dish!! It was just the perfect level of spice and the mozzarella cheese was awesome! My girlfriend didn't like her fried rice though. She thought it tasted sorta bland and that it wasn't spicy enough. We both thought it was weird how a korean restaurant didn't have any kimchi but that's okay. On the other hand, the service was quick and awesome. The owner seemed very involved and seemed to be friendly w some regulars.
Super good food, good prices, the wait was not bad at all probably waited  3 minutes for my table and 5 minutes after I ordered my food. Alex is super good!!! Good server and very nice.

Very disappointed in my pedicure. I spent 3 times what I normally spend on a pedicure and it is the worst polish job I have gotten...including from my 8 year old granddaughter. The lotion, massage & clipping was fine well. My toes were not dry when they sent me away. Had lunch across the street and every nail got smudged! Went back for them to fix and she painted right over the old and it looks so sloppy. Told me they never dry nails, "you just have to be careful' I get a better, professional pedicure at Wal-Mart

Solid no-frills Filipino grocery located just east of the King of Prussia Mall.

The location is great since it is right off the turnpike.

They have all the Filipino grocery essentials. Also offer hot food to go (pay per weight) -- Adobo, Sinigang, Mechado, etc. The fish-based food is always a bit sketchy at buffets, so I stick to chicken/pork/beef.

The worst moving experience ever! Supposed to be there at 8 am called 10 minutes before and told us a whole crew didn't show up (really?). Came 6 hours later. Couldn't fit everything in the truck and came with 3 men instead of 4. Destroyed a leather couch and the stairway the jammed it up, then said they didn't do it. They were at the new house until 10 pm and didn't finish. They left furniture at the prior house until the next day. Dropped the couch off the ramp, out the headboard on backwards, lost screws to the mirror and only put two in so the mirror leaned forward. Left other furniture unassembled. By the way they give you a penny per pound for damage so hopefully the furniture they damage weighs as much as an elephant. Hopefully their reputation will put them out of business.

This was my first time coming here, and I've only had my nails done once so I didn't really know what I was doing.. I came in with a picture of nails that I wanted and they were so nice and did such a good job! I will definitely be coming back and recommend this place to anyone looking to get their nails done
This place is amazing. The sandwiches are unique and great. I've ordered delivery several times now and each time, the food has been awesome. Highly recommend.

My girlfriend and I went to this place one Saturday to watch football and drink. After walking in, sat at a bar table and were promptly greeted by a friendly bartender. She explained the menu and took our drink orders. We got the Blastoff Shrimp, the Corn and Shrimp soup, and the BBQ Pizza. All three were excellent and far exceeded any expectations we had for a franchised pizza restaurant. 

Anyone thinking of trying this place should disregard negative reviews based on opening week service glitches. The food is great and we will be back.

I had a blast at this museum. I thought it would be small but there were 3 stories and the restaurant inside was just as nice and good! The building was just beautiful.

The exhibits are so clean and intriguing, I gladly spent hours absorbing everything!!

What a wonderful addition to North Broad and another reason why going to The Met has become one of our favorite activities. We sat at the bar on a Friday night because we hadn't made a reservation and were instantly wowed by the gorgeous lighting, woodwork and chandeliers. We made instant conversation with others at the bar as everyone was eager to share their menu finds. Our bartender was wonderful and helped us to choose the eggplant ant baratta appetizers and 2 incredible pastas for our second course. The gelato was the perfect way to end our meal. Will definitely be back.

Pure Barre is an awesome workout for any level. The instructors are very well trained and know how to help you get the most out of your burn! They offer up two types of class both being 50 minutes in length. This class is a challenge no matter how good your technique is! The owner, Barretenders, and instructors are very professional while also being friendly as well as knowledgeable about all things barre and fitness related! I look forward to working out and seeing the other women in my classes as well. The studio is always kept very clean and Jessica (the owner) always has cute decorative details that give it a warm, inviting feeling.

2nd time I've been there in the last two weeks and is very consistent. Today I got the flank steak noodle bowl and chicken and broccoli lunch and split them with my girlfriend and 18 month old. We couldn't finish and were totally stuffed! The service was good and we were out the door for 25 dollars even with an egg roll appetizer. We'll be back!
Had the most amazing time on my 21st which just happened to fall on a Monday. Daniel the bar tender was absolutely amazing! Made the best drinks ever!

Started with a couple very good Bloody Mary's. Then ordered the tacos. The cook doesn't normally allow mix and match but since it was slow he had no problem cooking a fish and beef taco. Both were excellent! My wife showed up after her spa treatment and ordered the quesadilla which was also excellent!
The bartender/server Rebecca was awesome! She was very friendly and took very good care of us!
Whether you're golfing or just want a great place to day drink, this is the spot!

The atmosphere is awesome and the views are incredible!  It's a blast to be able to pull right up to the dock to a restaurant.  The dock hand was fast and competent,  but inpatient with us as newbies. The service was fast and fairly friendly. The crab cakes were great, but the salad and fried shrimp very run of the mill. Not bad, but you certainly won't ever be craving them.  Even at an off time they were pretty busy. The servers were airing  some differences between themselves. They were quiet about it, but I still caught on. Something that should have been handled after hours or behind the scenes for sure.  We would come again with the thought in mind of what we would really be getting.

Yesterday, my daughter, husband, and I all went to build a Bear to stuff bears and the steamboat Willy that I got for my husband for his birthday in January, which we had purchased on their web site before Christmas, but didn't have a chance to take in before COVID happened. It was as fun as ever, there were a few changes to keep people safe. First, when you go in, they have a gate keeper. This is so that there aren't too many people in the store at the same time to keep everybody safe. There's one stuffer, and instead of handing your bear directly to them, you put it in the box, they take it out and stuff it, then they put it back in the box, and you do the hug test, choose a heart, perform the heart ceremony, you can't build a bear without the heart ceremony, and put it in your bear and put the bear back in the box. Then, they take it out of the box, put more stuffing in if need be, or just so it up. This way, you don't come in direct contact with them, or they with you. They don't cut corners when it comes to the fun. I didn't get pictures because I wanted to make sure, since it is a popular store, that more people had a chance to come in. I'm happy to say, most of the employees that were there before are still there. I asked, because we practically used to live there. No worries, if you don't want to do the heart ceremony, you can opt out, but it's definitely part of the experience. All of the employees wear masks, but for obvious reasons, did not where gloves. It's a little hard to sew with gloves, and all that fluff will end up sticking to them anyway. All in all, I felt safe and had fun at the same time. I highly recommend Build-a-Bear workshop!

I have been to a lot of zoos throughout California, and the SB zoo is by far my favorite. Everything is close together, so you don't have to walk too far from one exhibit to the next. You are able to get rather close to the animals and get a really good look at all of them which I appreciate. The zoo is clean, the animal homes are always well kept, and the staff is kind. A really fantastic place to take your family! Oh! And there is a cute play area for the kids where they can slide down a hill on cardboard sleds, my son and niece loved it. They had a blast!

I have been a client of Gianna at Salon Vanity for two years after I moved to Philly from NYC, and I recommend this place to everyone I know. I have received the following services: full balayage, partial balayage, haircut, low lights and blowout.

POSITIVES ABOUT SALON VANITY
Both as a new client and now as a repeat client, the reception desk is highly effective--they respond to every inquiry and appointment request quickly and are able to accommodate me on relatively short notice if needed.

In these times of COVID-19, it is clear Salon Vanity takes the health and safety of its clients and employees very seriously. As of my appointment in July 2020, the salon was operating at 50% capacity (seating clients at stations least 6 feet apart). Every staff member and client was wearing a mask, and they installed plexiglass at the reception desk and hair washing stations. Their website offered clear instructions to call the reception desk upon my arrival to the building, and that they would call me up to the salon when they were ready.

My experience in Salon Vanity before COVID-19 was very comfortable as well. As my sister, who I also introduced to Salon Vanity, likes to say, "It's so luxurious!". I make appointments at Salon Vanity not just when I'm due for a haircut or color, but sometimes when I just want to treat myself to a gloss and blowout! 

POSITIVES ABOUT GIANNA AT SALON VANITY
In the other cities I've lived in, I never found a stylist or salon I was loyal to because my haircuts never turned out the way I wanted. My experience with Gianna at Salon Vanity is just the opposite: Gianna consistently goes above and beyond to make sure I get the cut and color I'm looking for. She actively listens to what I want, thoroughly explains the process and options in terms I can understand (translating the beauty/stylist lingo) and always makes sure I'm comfortable with the approach and that we're on the same page. She doesn't impose her preference or style on me; she politely offers her expert advice and then goes with whatever I decide.

I never had balayage before becoming a client of Gianna at Salon Vanity. My once natural, dimensional dirty blonde hair grew out as I got older into a medium brown with curly gray hairs sticking out, and I had been looking for a stylist who was great at balayage to bring me back to my younger natural color. I actually discovered Gianna on Instagram by searching for #balayage and noticing she was in Philly! I was so impressed by her work that I knew I would be in good hands for my first balayage session. Again, she took the time to understand that I was looking for a natural-looking, sun-kissed balayage, and she delivered just that. I have recommended Gianna to now two of my friends looking to convert to balayage, and they are extremely happy as well.

For my first meal here, I ordered the Croque Monsieur... because any sandwich that has a 100% chance of being fried in butter is always going to be my first choice! The dish came with lightly-dressed greens, and, though I turned them down initially after finding out the sandwich came with greens, ended up ordering an order of the duck fat frites.

I only ate about half my sandwich (the Croque Monsieur was a generous size) in order to save room for dessert. I was leaning towards crepes but decided on the pavlova, a dessert of meringue, lemon curd, fresh berries and whipped cream.

Lovely decor, comfortable atmosphere and fantastic food make Petite Chou Bistro a winner in my book! I look forward to coming back and trying other items on the menu when I'm back in the area.
Wonderful yarn and a friendly, helpful and patient staff. I was not a knitter ,but they turned me into one and helped me make a cardigan sweater.  :-)))

I have been a client at both locations.  Lynda does my nails (gel) & wax.  She is by far one of the most professional, creative & meticulous person ever.  She's incredibly warm spirited & I trust her implicitly.

Everyone is so friendly & has fun.  It truly is a warm & welcoming environment.  It is extremely clean & I feel so pampered during my visits.

Definitely, by far, the #1 place to get your services done.  You are the client & you are catered to.

I've been to very expensive salons & the talent & treatment, far surpasses here!  Don't think twice, just go, it will be the best decision ever made.

Photo of my latest, custom free hand design by Lynda

Pretty good stuff.  I'll be back for sure.  First time food ranking (1-5):
- St. Louis roll: 4
- Red Dragon Roll: 5
- Tiger Roll: 3

Hands down my favorite Chinese seafood restaurant in China Town
Their fried rice is always so good. Their ginger scallion lobster is a MUST TRY! So good and very worth the money. The lobster pieces are hefty pieces and tastes really good with the sauce. The duck there is also very good and is a must 
We also got the crispy fish rolls? That was good and perfectly crisp 
The service there is also excellent! The waiters there are friendly and helpful

If you are in NOLA and spending long days at the convention center like I was recently, check this place out for dinner. It is bright and open with a great bar super bartenders and an extensive collection of brown Liquors.  I tried something I have never eaten before, pork cheeks. Amazing! This place gets crowded so either make a reservation or be prepared to wait a little bit. Well worth it.
Hand made tortilla's and all, some of the best tacos I've had, hands down! Gotta try the shrimp taco!

I visited the Intergalactic Fireworks store and I was blown away by their amazing selection and fantastic prices. I felt like I was a 10 year old and walking into toys r us for the first time. You name it, they got it. Since it was my first time, the staff is extremely nice and is great at explaining how each item works. If you need fireworks, this is the ONLY place to go. I will be back!

I have been shipping items back to Philly from this location for the last few years. Elizabeth and the staff are just fabulous. Some of the items are baseball memorabilia in glass or plastic. All of these items were wrapped perfectly and were received with no damage. My home has a nautical decor and we have purchased wooden turtles that were hand crafted. Again Elizabeth & her staff wrapped up some large and some small turtles and they all were very well wrapped and were delivered to their new homes without any damage. i have been shipping items back to Philly from the Gulf Coast of Florida for over 20 yrs and This UPS Store is by far the best choice and now the only choice that I have made.  This location is the GREATEST

This is a great place for breakfast, lunch, and of course that weird melange of meals, brunch. The food is solid, the omlettes are excellent, and the service is fast. Coffee is ok, not as strong or rich as I'd like it, but I roast my own beans at home, so I am spoiled by that luxury. 

I highly recommend their namesake omlettes as they are excellent. I've only had the "Omlette You Can't Refuse" (bacon, potatoes, sour cream), and the "Piggy Piggy Piggy" (ham, sausage, bacon, and cheese), but my friends attest to the Hippie with a Benz and others on the menu. You get a side of fruit or a side of mixed greens, and a choice of toast. Go for the cinnamon toast, as it's buttery, delicious, and not too sweet. I've also had assorted soup and salad combos, as well as some of their sandwiches. Portions are big and hearty, but healthy in that protein loading way. 

It can get packed quickly on the weekends, so go early. I thought that 10:15 on a Saturday would be early enough, but there was already a big line and a 35 minute wait. No matter though, since the meal was worth it. Prices are reasonable too--my meal with tax and tip (didn't have a drink) was $14.

Re owners remarks. I was promised a price, but it was put on the floor at 1/2 the promised price. I was told "it was priced right because it sold the first day". I asked why I wasn't called before the price was lowered - no answer. I actually called several times and was basically told "too bad", so yes, I had no choice but to cash the check.  Should I lose the furniture and tear up the check too. No one ever called me back to try to make things right.  Do not do business with them. You will be sorry.

Love it here! Flowers are so beautiful and fresh! Followed a Yelper's advice and asked to spend around $12-15 for a bouquet. Ended up spending $15 for a bouquet + 3 roses (couldn't help myself). What a great deal! And the whipped it up in minutes. Will be back.

Based on 3 or 4 visits, although one I remember not so much; there were orange martinis and oysters and candles ... and frivolity. Outstanding oysters. Always. And so cutely labeled. Fabulous attentive bar. Personalized Theo cocktails. Only once did it get to the entrees - but the skate is tremendous. Intriguing lighting/art. Happy hour beers are moderate to mediocre - but there are plenty of real choices. Recently, had to wait outside in the cold because enthusiasm led to a slightly early arrival (not that friendly from lady at door :-( , hence only 4 stars, but rescued by Theo at bar who opened the door and was welcoming - thanks!). Go early. Go often.

I don't have anything bad to say about Kristen's work and it would be unfair to rate her so poorly which is why I'm going into detail with this review instead. I've only been twice and it the results have been good. No complaints there. 
However..... when you go to a MedSpa you want to feel welcome and relaxed and enjoy the experience. But I felt like shit every time I had to make an appointment at Elitist Medical. The only redeeming quality was that when I would go I would also see Avery and she was nice. Every time I'm in the office Kirsten would talk down to me (sprinkled with the  "oh your so pretty" thing which seemed disingenuous when you pair it with how your talked to proceeding that). I'm not an aesthetician or an injector but I do, do a lot of research and painstakingly review procedures beforehand to not only have realistic expectations but to know the risks of each procedure. (Collectively I can say I've probably done well over 100 hours of collecting research. And while that does not make me an injector I know several techniques for several different zones and am interested in them for my face a good injector can talk me through these things and we can both agree what's best for my face and what makes me the happiest client (and I am not a fan of filler so no I do not want to be injecting my face full of it)) and I take injecting anything into my face very seriously and I don't need to be talked down upon if I'm trying voice what I think could be useful to my face or which technique I'm interested in. I feel like I can't even mention what I research as she will roll her eyes at me. Our faces are a big deal we only have one face and that should be treated with the utmost respect. I would have been more than happy to hear why these techniques would or would not work but I was talked at like I was an idiot telling me things I already knew. I felt mansplained to by a woman, it was unsettling. 
She had trouble with transitioning between Secretaries and they were not on top of their scheduling yet if you miss an appointment because your sick (during a pandemic may I add) they need to take time to see if you can even be considered to get an appointment now? Why do I need to feel bad about getting sick, I gave 24 hours notice and I don't want to infect other people. I understand she has a new policy and that's her right but me being sick was before the policy was put in place so your patients get no chances and are affected retroactively? That doesn't seem like good customer service. In fact that is unequivocally bad customer service. Penalizing or punishing clients from before a policy is put in place? Ok. What a lovely place to go to...
I message them as polite as I can I have texted them in depth several times (once just asking what the next step was as we had been over everything I wanted to do and you would think they have a plan for me and knew what I should schedule next if not allow me to schedule a consultation so we could decide at the spa). I've been messaging them since March and they don't even know whose texting them when I write.... I've actually never had a worse experience and I don't usually write reviews but I kid you not the experience every time with scheduling to being in the office was the worst in my 28 years. 
Contrast to seeing a very prestigious injector dr. rivkin in Los Angeles (who invented the non-surgical nose job has been on numerous tv shows and done work on celebrities and who has more of a right to this "god-complex" was a much more pleasant experience than her.) 
I only stuck around because my friend had referred me and I thought maybe she was having a bad day and having the problems with secretaries and that can be frustrating so I was understanding, it happens.  I always want to give people the benefit of the doubt but making appointments  seemed very unprofessional how do they not even know my name yet after 6 months? The face after was not worth the experience of being mansplained to. It's just not the place if you want mutual respect and to be able to talk about your needs (which will in turn give you the results you want) with your injector.

I was in the area for a few days visiting, and we decided to see Wonder Woman. I love the entire concept! Theater was very clean, and the staff were polite. Food was brought out in a timely manner, which was not my experience at another restaurant similar to this. I wish we had one of these!

A Moroccan Chitpole-like serving style makes it easy to learn about ingredients. Plus, the servers are great about suggesting things to try. I love the schwarma on a pita with lots of toppings, and the kids like trying a variety of things with a plate. The name, Poccadia, means fast food fresh, which is really accurate.
Great Dane or large dog gathering on Sundays at 1:00!!!

I had their Spicy Tofu sandwich last night a Flicks & Food Trucks. I thought it was really tasty and a reasonable price ($7-8 - can't remember exactly). The girl working the register was really sweet, too. 

I appreciate when food trucks consider options for us annoying vegetarians!

Some times, you don't want a gastropub.  Now, I do enjoy having great food choices, but sometimes you just want a place that is very, very basic, and more about the drink, more about the hangout.  I think the POPE does this quite well.  It's a place I feel very comfortable in.  The beer selection is always interesting, and more importantly to me, there's always a beer I can settle down with- it's not all 'extreme' beers.  I am a bit of a beer geek and like my extreme styles, but not for a session.  One or two, okay, but then let me settle into that pint of Sawtooth!

The juke box is a bit too obscure for me, but I don't mind, saves me putting the dollars in.

The staff is very knowledgeable about the beers, and can point you to one you will most likely enjoy.  

And they've got Prince Albert in a can.  How can you go wrong?????
Both good and beer are good but they MUST fix the parking situation! Literally driven away multiple times simply due to lack of parking.

I was welcomed like a King. The waitresses really took good care of me. Multiple waitresses were coming and asking me how things are going. The manager also came and asked me if the waitresses are treating me good. The food was also delicious. It's a good big restaurant. I have heard their aap will be launched soon, so there will be less wait to pay for the meal. People will be able to pay early during their meals. You can also get paged on the app when the table is ready. It will be cool to use it.

I'm probably the last person who'd spend $60 on a haircut. Before I saw Danielle, I went to the same stylist for years and, starting in college, decided to be super punk rock and DIY my hair. (It, uh, didn't go too well, though I could eventually manage a barely-passable bang trim.) But I had a little extra money burning a hole in my pocket after starting a new job, I was in the area, and they had a free appointment for that day, so why not? More money for a cut means it's better, right?

I'll preface my reaction by saying that my hair sucks. It's thin, it's wavy, occasionally it manages to be both flat and frizzy. I usually wear it tied back, but my big resolution for this year was to ditch the ponytail and get a nice cut. Danielle actually took the time to hear me bitch and moan about my hair, then steer me towards a more flattering and practical cut for my hair type and face shape. Instead of giving me a style that wouldn't work or look bad (like the terrible Amelie-inspired 'do I rocked through most of high school), Danielle opted for a more subtle, layered approach. I came out of the salon feeling like my hair was looking and behaving the way it was meant to. It wasn't drastically different but it felt right. I think my hair actually bounced as I walked through Rittenhouse. Best of all, it still looks awesome after a couple of weeks.

Other than the extremely cramped seating (this place is hoppin' at lunch time), our party of 4 enjoyed our food very much.  I had the Burmese Crunch salad with tofu and it was delicious. 2 of my friends had it with grilled chicken.  A 4th colleague had the curry with large grilled shrimp which looked amazing.

We'll be back for sure.  I would like to try the wings. 

Much improved over the Chinese place that used to occupy this spot.

Five Guys is a solid place for burgers. You get your burger exactly the way you want it. I always order the little bacon cheese burger (6.99$) dressed with mayo, ketchup, mustard, lettuce, extra pickles, and grilled jalapeno. I like a side of A1 or BBQ sauce as well.

Everything is cooked to order and made fairly fast. Friendly service!

The woman is so nice, I've had her hem women's double layered silky dressy pants, repair some tears, she did a fabulous job, the pants were perfect, the mending was perfect, she does it quickly at a very reasonable price. She's my go to for alterations and mending.
The best biscuits and moon shine Mary's ever. Love this place even though they are always packed and the wait is long, but that's okay, the wait is worth it and all the shops are super cute.

Came in at 5:00 pm on a Sunday night (2015/01/25). There were piles of people at the door. We were told 30 minute wait - despite our hesitation we decided to wait.

It was a painful 40 minutes watching the hostesses (or anyone for that matter) do little to fix the wait while there was dirty empty tables everywhere. I watched the bus boy saunter over from table to table slowly cleaning. The most frustrating part was the table we ended up being seated at was empty and dirty from the moment we arrived. 40 minutes passed and finally we watched as they cleaned it eventually seating us there. (5:47 pm)

Alice was our server and she was a breath of fresh air after waiting for our table. She was polite, personable and helpful with our kids. 

Luckily, the food service was timely and the food was delicious. 

Two hours later (7:00 pm) and we were finally done. If it wasn't for the service provided by Alice this review would have been a 1 star.

This was a great experience. From the atmosphere to the drink and the amazing food. We stumbled upon this restaurant while visiting the area for a hockey tournament. We were a party of 8 and everyone of us had a great meal. The carafe if white peach sangria was a crowd pleaser at the table. Appetizers were great. Pictures include the crab cheesecake, fried calamari, cheese platter and a seafood sampler. Dinners were delicious. I tried the Champagne Pear Sacchetti, definitely a must try. Unfortunately we were to full for desert but I would imagine it would be just as good. Service was really good. Our waiter was very attentive to us and it was a busy night so kudos to him for being so attentive to our group.

Seafood was fresh (we order snow crab legs and crawfish), sauce was on the saltier side but pretty flavorful, open space with great ventilation, server was nice and attentive (a little too attentive) but overall pretty neat spot for the northeast to get seafood!
I love this place. Food is excellent (I especially love the garlic knots and meatballs). Service is great. All around, it is a very pleasant experience every time we are there.

I finally had a chance to order the jumbo lump crab cake entree here... and it is to die for! It is definitely 100% crab meat, no fillers or other funny stuff. It is cooked just right - not over done, fresh, succulent and filled with moisture.The accompanying glaze compliments the crab cakes very well, I must say.

Apparently, this entree is a special and is not located on the menu. If you love crab cakes, I suggest you go for it. It will not disappoint.

Last Sunday, while out and about with the husband, we were looking for a BBQ joint to eat at. Sadly, when we stumbled in on the Pig, they had already closed, by the scent of the air alone, we vowed to come back. Today was our lucky day!

Since we both had today off, the husbeast and I made our way back to picturesque Ozona and knocked on the door of this rustic eatery. There were a couple of noisy gents at the bar, and a few other diners at tables, so we sat ourselves in a booth and were promptly served by a friendly waitress.  Since we'd never been there before, we took a few minutes to place our order, but what we were presented with was MOUNDS of food.

We both ordered the BBQ plate, I chose the pulled pork (of course) and he got the brisket. Normally these are served with beans and slaw, but they let you sub out for most of their sides, He chose fries and I chose potato salad.  When they were delivered to the table, each was garnished with a deviled egg (YUM!) and a trio of heated sauces. 

The pork was so tender and the beef was yummy, and while I like the vinegar based sauces, the husbeast wasn't so fond of them, he found them too runny to be of much good. What he DID like was the shaker of rub that was on the table - he liked it so much he asked if we could buy some. (We did). We ate our fill, my husband is a member of the clean plate club, but I'm afraid I am not, there will be some shame on my face for that, but while the food was delicious, I really did want to save some room for the Homemade banana pudding - or Southern creme bruele as the menu put it. 

I'm glad I did, that stuff was fan-freaking-tastic.   We will be back, the service alone was amazing. The locals at the bar, well they were "colorful" and made a few.. mm off color jokes that everyone could hear, but I really can't hold that against the establishment.

Perfect for New Year's Day. The coffee was hot and delicious, the atmosphere was quaint and quiet. They had a different music selection playing, which was a phenomenal change from the same stuff playing on every business' radio. Very casual and intimate. When the server sits at your table to take your order, it's my favorite thing ever. To me it shows that they're giving full attention to your order and willing to take the time to answer any questions you may have, although I know that not everyone may feel the same. Over easy eggs, are a classic but so easy to mess up and these were perfect. The oatmeal was delicious, a nice addition to a breakfast joint. 
Four out of five because there's always room for improvement, none of us are perfect and a slightly larger selection and variation would be nice too.

I had a wonderful experience at Roz's.  It was my first time there and she was prompt, courteous, professional and GENTLE.  Barely felt her hands in my hair!  And I was so impressed with the style she gave me. It was beautiful and is wearing very well because I have been able to maintain it with little to no effort (which I love).  I will definitely be going back and would recommend her very highly.  I should mention that I am very particular about my hair (currently wearing a very short cut) and have salon horror stories for days...finding Roz's is a dream come true.

We went there recently because the reviews are good. We went on a Friday night and were sorely disappointed. Not to sound like a snob but... The sushi seemed on the level of Giant's pre-packaged sushi, not even on Wegman's level. It was mushy and crumbly. To put it in perspective, we frequent Sushi Planet, in Queen Village, and Fat Salmon, in Society Hill; and they are awesome. 

Originally, I was going to give a second star but I remembered that the waitress dropped off the check before we were done dinner and had no interest in our desire to try the desert. 

Overall, it was a less than thrilling experience. No wonder city people scoff at the suburban restaurants. Ooka sucka.

56 Methi Malai Mutter Panner
67 Chicken Pepper Masala
54 Palak Paneer

That's what I had one of the times I have gone to Bawarchi.  They were pretty good!  I loved the Chicken Pepper Masala.  And the different Paneers are really good.  Is it super authentic?  I have no clue.  Is it better than the other places in town for putting a different flavor in your face?  Yep!

The service here is basic and utilitarian, very similar to most East Asian restaurants that I have been to.  They don't take the time to chat you up, they just get your order and get your food out to you when it's ready.  This isn't a negative per se, but it can be a little off-putting if you are accustomed to the basic 'merican restaurant experience.

The space has been changed very little since the last business left.  They did lighten it up though.

I will eventually get through all of the menu items.  But for now...all of the ones I have had are worth going back for.
Local hangout with awesome doughnuts and breakfast.  Spectacular customer service!  A must stop for outtatowners.

Customer Service, yikes!

I've call this property management a couple of times to ask questions about some properties. I was very turned off by the receptionist! She wasn't friendly at all and also had a very defensive tone. First impression are everything and having someone like that answering the phones, yikes. No wonder why they have a low rating. 

Thankful I read all these reviews before a submitted an application!

Someone please bring this idea to every city because these smoothies are amazing. We got a flight of smoothies- strawberry basil lemonade, prickly pear margarita and cherry blossom mojito. Of those three, I definitely like the strawberry basil lemonade the best. The only one where I could actually taste the alcohol was prickly pear margarita, but even then, that taste quickly went away after a few sips. My friend ordered the key lime pie, which basically tasted like a milkshake. 

I will say though, these are super dangerous! They're so delicious and hardly taste alcoholic but I definitely felt the alcohol kick in after a bit. 

Seating was definitely a bit limited but it was a Saturday night so totally understandable. There is a back patio but it looked super crowded so we didn't end up checking it out.

This place makes me wish St Louis were just a bit closer so I can go there more often. I can't wait to try the other flavors!

My family and I went to Landry's on the Lake during a mini-vacation in New Orleans this past weekend. We enjoyed quite a few meals in the Big Easy, but this one was definitely one of our favorites as the view of Lake Ponchartrain could not be beat!

We dined on the back patio overlooking the lake. The breeze was cool and my mango mojito was the perfect refreshment!

We were just there for drinks and some apps and Landry's did not disappoint.

Our order consisted of:
Crab, Spinach and Artichoke Dip
-served with tortilla chips
Oysters Rockefeller
-topped with spinach, bacon and cheese
Firecracker Shrimp
-battered and fried with a sweet chili sauce
Fried Green Tomatoes
-topped with crawfish and sauce
BBQ Shrimp
-served in a french bread boat thing?

Our favorite was by far the BBQ shrimp for the sauce alone... not quite sure what it was, I think the menu called it a BBQ butter? But it was great. Tangy and spicy. I think I could drink it if given the option. The bread was served crispy and was perfect for sopping up that delicious sauce! 

The service was friendly and efficient. Next time we're in NOLA, we will definitely stop by again!

We got an estimate back in the beginning of April.  They said they would be available the following week, and never called.   After numerous phone calls and promises they still never showed.  Go figure now they are closed!  I'm not surprised.  The service was disappointing (phone service that is . . .we never got the work done)!

I have been taking my dogs to Canine Connection for years and they have always done an amazing job. When I have to board my dog I know they will take the best care of him and will keep me updated on how he is doing, plus I love being able to see him on the webcam. The staff even went out of their way to make sure that he had what he needed while I was out of town the last time that he stayed with them. This is by far the best day care in the city, and I'm so glad I found them!

I love this place!! Happy hour is my go-to but at any time of the day is a great place to be. Fun & friendly staff, wonderful food ... happy hour is WONDERFUL! Sushi is innovative, fresh & yummy. 
I can't believe I haven't done a review with as many times as I've been here but I've been enough to be able to tell you it's great food & consistent.

Quik Trip does it right. Of course - you can go anywhere to get processed food and beer - but there is something about Quik Trip which sets them apart in the competitive field of quick, high calorie, clog your arteries, crap for your gullet. 

Stores are clean, brightly lit and have open aisles. Counter spaces are not cramped and you can get in and out quickly. The Quik Trip brand is solid and they do offer relatively priced healthy options. 

All in all - a great place to drop in for snacks and gas!

Now that Mesa Burger has been around for a while, I'm glad we gave them another shot. 

Tonight we tried the Funk Zone burger and the Southwestern Arugula salad. We hadn't tried the salads before but we were so glad we did!!  Mesa Burger has strong salad game. All of the salads looked delicious and we loved the Southwestern!! We'll definitely be back to try more of the salads. 

The Funk Zone Burger was also pretty stellar. The bacon was a little difficult to bite into but still delicious. These were thick cuts of bacon though! I wasn't sure I'd like the roasted tomatoes but paired with the mushrooms it was so good. This burger was PACKED!! 

Top that off with some parmesan & truffle fries and a couple of beers perched on the Mesa Burger patio and it's a perfect night out. 

I also really liked how the look of Mesa Burger is a little more down to earth. Sweet colorful flower designs decorated the kitchen wall! Less industrial and sterile feeling. I felt like I was in a good friends kitchen.

My rating would have been five stars had we not had to wait for our reservation.  The food is incredible--inventive, delicious and beautiful. The service was impeccable--everyone was attentive.  

We had the following:
Salamati and Turkish hummus - The salted beets were my favorite salad of the six.  The Turkish hummus is a must.
Cauliflower - So flavorful. Our server said this was the one item that would always be on the menu.
Lamb's tongue - Had we not been told what the dish was, we wouldn't have guessed it!  
Kibbe Naya - It was good, with crunch bits on top of small raw lamb scoops/patty-shapes. I loved the mushrooms. 
Sweetbreads - Cooked to perfection. Soft, not chewy or mushy. 
Duck hearts - So tender....
Duck kebab - We were full by the time this came to the table, but it was still tasty.
Merguez - The grilled lamb was seasoned well, and the ramps paired well with the lamb.
Grilled eggplant - Nice but my least favorite of all the dishes.
Malabi - Super interesting combination.  I really liked the melon sorbet and the phyllo pastry.

I was stuffed half way through.  I would go back without hesitation, but allow time for waiting for a table.

Literally been standing in line for 25 minutes just to pick up an online order. There is only one cashier named Lupe and she keeps taking care of phone calls and appointments instead of me. I thought the whole point of ordering online first is to pick up quickly. The other two attendants who I'm presuming are mechanics just sit there twiddling with their watch and thumbs and have absolutely no answers for any questions I have. I just want to leave and cancel my order altogether because this isn't worth the hassle. Finally seen after 30 minutes.

Came once.  Disappointed.  Thought maybe they had a bad day.  Came a second time.  Worse.  Armorall on 3 doors but not the driver door?  Armor all very inconsistent inside and out.  Horrible odor in my truck now!  Maybe the cleaner or dirty sponges they used?  Not sure.  Definitely not worth $27.
they are absolutely nasty!! i don't know happen in the last year or two but they not good for NOTHING besides margaritas
Loved the fast service and healthy options here! Had the egg white omelet and it was amazing!

Nothing really stood out to myself or the people with whom I attended. 

Of course, the experience was immediately tainted by a somewhat snarky host. I went with 4 other women, a small child, and a baby (7 total). When the head of my group called to make reservations, initially she said we would need 8 chairs.
