She later called back to say one person could not make it, so our final count would be five adults, a 7 year old, and that we would still need a seat for a baby carrier, because the establishment did not offer a high chair. When we arrived at Tilly Mint's, two tables were pushed together. 

We were awkwardly seated and spaced out, as we did not even need two tables. We were asked multiple times, when the other people were coming. Other people? We were all there... When my MIL explained that she had called to cancel one person and explained the numbers, the woman was giving us an attitude, making her displeasure known that we needed a seat for a baby. Okay...well, maybe you should have high chairs then? She rudely retorted that she "could have sold the other table for business if we had been up front with her." Um...lady, we were? Sorry you didn't understand. Whatever happened to the customer is always right, anyway? It was somewhat of a scene, and I was embarrassed for her that she would not let it go and continued to make comments, and proceeded to talk about our table to the other woman in the establishment WITHIN EARSHOT...very uncouth at a wannabe British tea place when manners are supposed to be of paramount importance. As said earlier, just left a bad taste in our mouth at the beginning of the experience. 

Anyway, I honestly did not give 2 stars for this sole reason. The teas were, by no mean, bad. I got the peaches and creme, my other tablemates got the chocolate raspberry truffle and enjoyed it. We all got the Wavertree Tea, so an app, sandwiches and desserts. My niece got the children's entree and the presentation was adorable. My SIL and I commented when all was said and done, we'd have been happier with the child's entree.

The quiche and soup weren't anything to write home about and I was not fond of any of the sandwiches. The salad was practically dripping with dressing, but that's just my personal taste--don't like my lettuce soggy and soupy. The desserts were okay, but a lot of it reminded me of baked goods that you could purchase at Acme in a plastic container. I know better tea food exists, because I've had it at multiple  tea places. Not bad...but not worth the hour drive it took us to get there coupled with the unpleasant woman.

All in all, we won't be back, nor can we recommend to others...as we weren't impressed with the food and certainly not the service.
this is a fun event that everybody turns out for...next year I am gonna dress up.

This review will be short, because it's been so long, I don't remember exactly what I ordered.  What I do remember is the fries being so tasty and with an interesting mix of flavors on them.  Staff is very friendly and service is fast.  When I remarked that I was curious about the pulled pork, owner overheard me and came out with a pork laden spoon for me to sample. Yum, yum, get you some!!

I've been here a few times and it's always been ok. The service has always been a little odd. Last night we went with a large group of 9. The amount of time in between the water, drink order, menu order, food delivery was timed out way too long. Two in our group never got their meal. When the food was delivered, the waiter never asked - "are we all good, do you need anything else?" - nope, walked away and never came back until we were nearly done and bill ready. When we asked him about it, he referred to the guy that had delivered the food with him and said "did he say he would be back", nope-- "oh well that food comes out of a different window and it's probably still sitting up there." Well unfortunately, by that time, it did not do us any good and the food was most likely wasted. It's frustrating because even if he would have checked in 5-10 minutes after the food was delivered, he would have been able to catch it, but he didn't.

The worst part was that 18% gratuity was already included because we were a group.  Frustrating.  

I will say the salsa is delicious here, no to hot and with just enough flavor. Drinks are also delicious. Unfortunately, the service and food has never been spectacular. There are a lot of better Mexican places in Dunedin/Clearwater that won't disappoint. 
If your looking for drinks and apps... come here otherwise go somewhere else.

Went in a Saturday night and it was pretty busy. We had reservations so were seated right away. We say for 20 minutes before we flagged down a random server to try to get some help. Our actual server didn't approach our table until 10 minutes after that.

The food was decent. We split some apps which were good. Ordered the cheese and polenta bites and they tasted like pure butter.

On the up side we ordered dessert and it was amazing. I had the homemade choco taco and it was a 10 out of 10. My girlfriend had a fruit smoothie and that was also excellent.

Not sure if I would go back to give it another try.

They have always been good. I have been here dozens of times in the last 2.5 years and the food quality has been consistent.  The employees are about the nicest and most polite people in the area. The diet lemonade was not that good, but that's a personal taste and I won't take a star off for that. It was VERY bland but, who even attempts "diet" lemonade. I'll stick to tea.

As part of my job I have dealt with management on a few occasions through good and bad times.  They have always been professional towards me as a costumer and in my work capacity.

This location is very hit or miss. Sometimes the bowl is thick and delicious w/ ripe fruit, other times the bowl is way too liquidy, and has pappy apples, underripe pineapples, etc. Also a little pricy, but I'm sure it's not their fault. I usually will take the drive to Bethlehem to go to Playa Bowls if I have the time!

We saw the Celtic Angels on their opening night in Clearwater.

Loved the show, thought the acoustics were good and the seats reasonably comfortable.

Bar drinks on the expensive side, restrooms clean and large enough to handle intermission crowds and plenty of ushers to get people to their seats.

Fun to meet some of the cast post show.

Great evening.
Amazing and fresh food. The staff is very friendly and considerate. I ordered the 2 bowls and 1 wrap. Everything was delicious. Will sure be back again.

I totally recommend this place! Ate here for dinner while on vacation. We came around dinner time and was quoted a 35 min wait. Worked out perfectly since all we have to leave is a phone number which sends a link to the open table app allowing you to check on your table status. With that, we were able to walk around and shop. Seating wise you can sit outside or inside. Or sit open bar. Service was amazing! Our waiter gave great food recommendations and gave us great advice on what to do in Boise and provided a little bit of history for us as well. Food was also amazing! The fondue was very good, prime rib dip was to die for, burgers were tasty, and the voodoo chicken and the short rib was good as well. And, the butter cake was absolutely a great way to end our dinner!

My new favorite hoagie! The guys working are all attentive and nice. The roll is great, crusty enough to add texture soft enough dive right in. The real win is the ratio of the meat to cheese to veg. Its the perfect size for eating. Way to go guys!

Stopped in for a quick smoothie and some frozen yogurt. The smoothie was good said the lil one and my chocolate frozen yogurt was delicious. 

Their prices are not bad and their service is great. The young lady was very nice and she was very helpful to my son, who had just had a dental appointment. I just wanted ice cream and it scratched an itch I didn't know was even there. 

The yogurt was so creamy and if I could stir up the energy I would go right back now. The toppings were fresh and covered. Which is a good thing cuz don't nobody want sneezed on M&Ms, nuts or cherries. 

The place is clean and you can tell they pride themselves on taking care of it. 

I give them 4 stars based on their food quality and quality service but their prices are a bit expensive. I spent $9 on a Light sized smoothie and a yogurt with only 2 toppings.

This is a nice place in Palm Harbor and I must say they have the best hamburgers I have ever had. Went there a while ago and the food was great but wait staff wasn't all that top notch. Waited for someone to come over and finally someone arrived. Wait staff was more concerned with taking selfies of each other at the bar than coming over and asking how we were doing. We tried to motion them over a few times but selfies were winning.

Again, the food is really good but wait staff need to understand how they influence overall experience.

This is the best bar in the  Warminster/Southampton  area.  Great specialty drinks.  Fun happy hour.   And the food is always good. I really  Like the change-up of weekly food specials and craft beers.

I live in Philadelphia, so I've had my fair share of delicious sushi. BUT, Toyosu Sushi, is the best I've ever had. Every roll is fresh, thick, and delicious. I will gladly leave the city for this sushi. It's that good! Thank you

Overall I had a wonderful new car purchase experience with Cherry Hill Audi and with my sales representative, Steve DiMuzio.  Last Saturday I purchased a new Audi A6.  The car has absolutely exceeded my expectations and  the sales representative, Steve DiMuzio was terrific.  I had already visited the dealerships of several other competitive car manufacturers as well as another Audi dealer.  Steve was clearly the best at helping me finalize the decision of what to purchase and explaining the various car features to help me pick the right car for me.  Once I knew what I wanted I asked if I could actually buy the car the same day and drive it away.  He made calls to the insurance company and quickly got others at the dealership involved to make it all happen quickly and at a great price.  Others at the dealership were also extremely helpful.  A few days after the purchase I called Steve back asking for some technical help to integrate some unusual features on my cell phone  with the car speaker system.  Steve went above and beyond by contacting the technicians himself and quickly getting back to me with a technical solution that worked great.  I highly recommend Cherry Hill Audi and Steve DiMuzio.

Good decor on a budget although I would like to see the unicorn cult die out. I think every hipster in their 20s should be forced to watch THE LAST UNICORN and then they will feel my pain.

Fries were on point, but not as crispy, tasty or generous as at Delachaise. Allioli was the best thing I consumed. They definitely have their condiments down. Korean dumplings were okay. Wrapper was solid. Pork was not seasoned enough. Prison camp serving size.

I liked the Yuca shell with the mofongo, but again- meat was underseasoned except for strong presence of paprika. I did enjoy the pickled peppers though.

Drinks were intriguing and well priced- perhaps not layered or nuanced but interesting. Beer selection is mostly from country's who make awful beer, so I passed on the Turkish lager but that is probably my own prejudice. 

Drinks were inventive, but not subtle. I think it takes a lot of thought and a deft hand to make intriguing, nuanced artisinal drinks and everyone wants to get down with the program but you have to put your time in. These are three ingredient drinks- some of them work, some of them don't but for 7 bucks I wasn't complaining.

Overall- there just needs to be a better correlation between pricing and quality. Seven bucks for an okay/intriguing drinks is def a good look
Worst customer service that we've experienced in a long time.  Rude hostess that ignored us entirely.  We left before sitting down.

Thought I'd try it while driving to another restaurant for 1hr lunch break Friday 1/15/21 about 5 after noon. Drive through empty.... cool? Or a sign?
Very nice girl let me know that tenders were gonna take 10+ minutes and I chose to wait. 
Ordered the Pimento Sammy at highest heat level and was warned I'd have to sign a waver. 
Decided to bump it down 1 notch to hot level. 
Waited in my car by one other person for about 15 min and was delivered plane chicken sandwich with pickles (no pimento cheese). Person who packaged it had likely never used a styrofoam container before as it was upside down with food in the lid. Not even remotely spicy. Parm garlic fries squirted grease with every bite like the oil wasn't hot enough. Probably won't try this again. Looked good and good concept though.
The best sushi north of town. So fresh and delicious! Great Korean fare as well.  This family run spot is a true gem.  All homemade and authentic.  Try the short ribs, you won't be sorry!

A new and exciting addition to the New Hope dining scene with some traditional as well as fusion food.

Interior well done with new booths and decor.  The tropical fish tanks as a room divider is a neat idea.

Menu items are many and priced right.  Service was excellent too!
Small, clean, no frills, no fuss. Order, get ur food, take out. Back on ur way licking split.
Think Korean Barbeque meets PF Changs, meets Chipotle...yeah, think that...pretty decent...ambiance isn't fussy like PF Changs...food is ok.

This salon is gorgeous. I went at the recommendation of a friend whose hair is always on point  And tells it like it is. Everyone was so kind and Ieft feeling like a Kween.

Took the Cote blow drying class. Super cool, BC I have thick, naturally wavy, keratin-treated hair. So the less toxic the product -- the better. Will def go back!

Bought a one liter, double insulated stainless bottle/growler of stout after a taste. Great beer! The bottle was dented so the bar took the cost of the vessel and I only paid for the beer since I was in too much of a hurry for another pour.  One caveat. The method of sealing employed on this fancy schmancy stainless bottle does not provide a tight seal, and beer that normally stays carbonated for up to a week will not stay fresh in this container. The best method of sealing is a simple glass growler with a metal cap, under coated with thermoplastic, tightly screwed, and finished by the bartender with a couple inches of electrical tape around the circumference. Sounds crude, but the best microbreweries I visit eschew the fancy stainless (which brings a hefty price, and no doubt a handsome profit to the seller) for a good old fashioned bottle. I've kept beer fresh for a week, even checked it for flights around the country. This is why customers buy growlers, so they can share the freshness with friends days later. Vault should stick to what works and forget the glitzy appeal or upgrade the seal.
I liked this place. They had a large variety of food, and it was fairly tasty considering it buffet food. I would return!
Went with a friend and got the chicken satay tacos. The staff was really friendly and the tacos were banging. Check it out if you're looking for good food at a great price near Drexel.
Friendly medium sized store easy to find your way around. Prices are good.

Their Nashville wings give me life. After our first time here we came back the net two nights in a row.
Love the atmosphere. It's our new go to dinner/ hang out and have a beer spot. Love to play the games and/ or watch a game. 
I really should try something else on the menu, but their wings are so freaking good. My friend did get the grilled cheese and said it was amazing.

@yelp can I give 6/5 stars?

If I could give this place zero stars, I would. My husband mailed a large package to the East Coast and used this store because it's closest to our house, and the package recipient wanted to return it UPS. 

He was hesitant, because we've always had super bad service at this store. Once, while he was waiting to be served, the owner was on the phone with someone, yelling and screaming at them, while customers waited to be served, it was a joke, at best.

But, I digress. One to this experience. The clerk measured the box, and told him it would be over $80 to ship it. He wasn't prepared for that much, but paid it, as he needed to get the box shipped. When our friend returned it after repairing it, his shipping total was a little over $40, also from a UPS store! My husband felt he'd been overcharged, and saw that the measurements on the return trip were smaller than the measurements this UPS Store gave him.

He stated by calling UPS, only to be told that the UPS Stores are franchises, and UPS actually has nothing to do with them! After much digging, he found the corporate site, and where to complain, which he did. The operator understood the problem, and promised to get back to him the next day, after contacting the store. She never did.

We found out after many more phone calls, that the local store (Lemmon Valley) wasn't returning the calls to the operator, or any others we had contacted. My husband perservered, and finally found out the store had overmeasured the box, and indeed overcharged us. They said we'd have a check within a week for the excess charges. 

Well, a week went by, and then another, and another. To make a frustrating story short, we waited from July until September to finally see a check. We will never use this store again, and will drive the additional miles to use the Fed Ex store in midtown. They are somewhat better most of the time, and a whole lot cheaper, and they guarantee delivery. This UPS Store is the worst ever, as others have noted. Avoid at all the costs, and stay away from the owners, they are absolute jerks.

I really like this place! We tend to be more health conscious eaters, and they have lots of delicious options. Their Moo Shu is awesome, we have tried both chicken and pork versions. We love Mongolian beef, broccoli and beef, snow peas and prawns, and a few others. We also like their hot and sour soup. They know how to make perfect steamed veggies, or with a very light sauce. I never feel like their food is overly salted, etc....and the best part is they deliver!!!
My friends, family and myself enjoy the restaurant. We all vary with what we eat so across the board it is very good in our opinion
Poles and bait provided for you. Just show up and enjoy fishing. Was a lot of fun. Crew was so nice and helpful.  Great for families!!!

oh man. this place is the spot.

eat tacos. lot's of them. and get every single taco on the board. get it all. it's all so good. i am drooling on my keyboard thinking about it.

eat tacos.

The service was quick and friendly...the quality of sushi was what you would expect from an all you can eat, with one exception...they make everything to order. They offered mackerel as sashimi, that was a pleasant surprise. I'll go again.

We took our car into service for the first time here, We were afraid! You never know what a dealer is going to do to you. Not the case!!  Frank Casey in the service department was very nice and helped us. Very honest and fair, did great job!!! Nice to see for a change!

Crawfish is flavorful but too salty. It gets very hard to eat after a while. We came after a huge last-minute party and waited at least 45 min for our quite simple order of 5 pounds of crawfish. 

I am not usually one to quibble over service, but it was truly awful - our waiter was bussing tables inside and probably only had a few outside, so never came outside. Someone at a neighboring table actually went in to flag them down to help us order drinks. They were very apologetic and tried to comp said drinks, only for us to realize that they had also charged us for an extra one none of us ordered. I'm sure there was no ill intent, just the mess of too many customers, but again - truly awful.

BEST BRAZILIAN WAX I'VE EVER HAD. Asma is her name and waxing is her GAME. Fast is what describes her. I walked in at 11:40 walked out ten minutes later. Sugar wax is what they use and they cook their own wax..she made me feel comfortable and was very sociable. Can't wait till four weeks from now ask for ASMA!!! Other than that is was a clean place and not hard to find at all.

Been coming here for around 30 years. Penny's had the most unique flavorful crust of any place around. Tonight on a sunday  we got the most bland ordinary crap. We couldn't more disappointed. I called and asked for the manager to see what had changed and he just blew me off telling me that everything is the same. He offered nothing not even an apology. After hundreds of pizzas from this place I would have done better with a grocery store frozen. That's what it was like.  They have either gone with cheap ingredients or their present employees and management don't care. Another great business goes down I guess.
I came here on Friday night.  I got the regular cheesecake ice cream with cookie dough mixed in.  My bill for 1 scoop 1 topping $7.65.  Not sure what the hype is, but I will not be returning.

First night in Nashville. My son & I were famished. Pastaria was a short walk from our AirBnB. Busy restaurant. Mixed green salad was fresh and delicious- perfect amount of dressing. 

We split a pizza ("The Holmes") and shared a pasta dish ("Garganelli")--both were flavorful and well-executed.

Absolutely absurd with the service here! Ordered drinks from a waiter and 25 minutes went by and still didn't receive drinks. We had to ask the waiter again for drinks and he apologize for not putting the order in and said he'd have it right up. Another 20 min went by and NO DRINKS. UNACCEPTABLE!!!!

Not my best experience tonight. Usually the service is on point and fairly quick, but tonight was not the case.  They did not appear to be short-staffed, however it took a while for us to receive drinks, appetizers,  and food.

Love this place! It's not fancy, but the regulars are loyal. It is clean, but more importantly, they focus on the fundamentals. Booty burn is a great way to get in shape. Typical yoga classes range from  intro all the way to level 3!

Was so looking forward to trying this place as there was so much hype on social media! Maybe my hopes were too high but I was disappointed in my biscuits and gravy.. Wouldn't say it's worth the long lines

$1.00 tacos. Delicious tortilla soup. The waitress was nice and friendly. The prices for everything was reasonable. 
I love this place

Fast, fresh, delicious Vietnamese/Japanese fusion food is what you get here at this cute  spot in Downtown. I came on the recommendation of fellow Yelper Kylie K and she's was right on.

I ordered the tofu Bahn mi and the avocado summer rolls (these are a must!). There's a variety of Bahn mi for both the meat eaters and vegetarians - I really appreciate the variety which makes this one of the best lunch spots in downtown for office lunches. 

I loved this sandwich, plenty of vibrant fresh cilantro, thin carrots and some cucumber (could have used some more of that). The tofu was really razzed up with spices and i think it was sautéed, but I forgot to ask before I devoured it.

They have a variety of summer rolls but I went with the avocado. Huge chucks of avocado! Yay! And the dipping sauce, oh man, I wanted to order a pint to go.

The place is casual, bright and clean. Plenty of spots to eat solo at the window table bar or at a table with a group. 

The service was prompt and friendly. 

I will definitely be back.
Nice casual atmosphere. Good tap selection and very good food. Came in to watch MNF. I got the Half chicken dinner served with 2 sides(sweet potato fries and red beans). Very delicious!

Just a standard Margaritaville you can find scattered anywhere in any city. The food is okay, service is pretty good, the menu items are on the expensive side, and the live band is pretty good. There's probably other places you can go to in the area that would be better, but if you really don't like deciding, then I guess this place is okay.
Take out half the time. Eat-in half the time. Food is always great. Service is amazing. Takeout is normally ready for pickup in less than 15 minutes.

I don't know why this place doesn't have more stars! I've been going to this place ever since I was little. Love their sushi! The Green Dragon is my favorite. Everything is made fresh and tastes amazing. The only downside to this place is that I get full soooooooooooo quickly because everything is awesome!

They also have beer imported from Japan. Two thumbs up!!
Had a great dinner with friends. Food was delicious and the drinks were good too. If you check - in on yelp, you get a free dessert!

Just heard they were closing Chifa.  We dined here a few weeks ago, it was our 4th or 5th visit.  It was not as good as past visits, and unfortunately this review isn't really going to help anyone unless you make it before they close!

The ceviche we had was in a bowl.   It was so drowned in a gazpachio-like sauce that you might as well have called it soup.  The fish's wonderful natural flavor was drowned.  The specialty drinks were nice.  I will miss them.   The red curry was good, but not distinctive enough I guess to put Garces' name on it.

The service was excellent, but the restaurant was 1/3 full at best on a Thursday.  

Not surprising that they are closing.

I've been a number of times, most recently on a Saturday with my pops and grandmother, and as always, the food here is solid. 

I love curries and they do them well here. My grandmother order the korma and I got a quick sample and really enjoyed it. 


My father and I got the lunch buffet (which costs around $9) and though we both found the selection to be limited, were both please with what was available. 

The chicken tandoori was delicious. Butter chicken ditto. Mango meatballs were spicy and rich. Oh, and there was plenty of naan to go around.

Overall, a reliable place to eat in the Foothills, Oro Valley area.

I see another review posted by Steve W. in January that echos much of what I have to say.

We love the gondola house and go a couple times a year it's a great place to meet friends and get a good meal

What a great find! Tarra was super sweet and very thorough/attentive/professional... I had a very relaxing deluxe pedicure and acrylics taken off and switched to gel acrylics (the dip). Usually can't stand having that much work done at one time (it hurts!), but she had a light touch making it pain-free. They look amazing and so natural! Additionally, the place was very clean. I'll for sure be back!
Great selection of seafood. Oysters were great and not super expensive! Got our food fast. Very nice experience

Terrible customer service! I'm a president's circle member that travels to Wilmington weekly for business and have been told on multiple occasions after making a reservation that there are no cars  available. I was told to wait hours into the afternoon for them to have a car ready for me. They suggested I take a cab to work and come back in the afternoon. What's the point? 

Both Avis and Enterprise next door have friendlier service, better availability and cleaner cars.

I was sadden to see the menu of Silvergreens after the restaurant remodel. The options for my favorite meat, steak, were limited to sandwiches. Upon ordering a chicken teriyaki bowl with a friend, my order arrived much later, even though I ordered first. The bowl given to me had  overcooked and fatty chicken that was barley chewable. They only offer healthy drinks too, which all tasted too sweet. My friend had horchata and said it was watered down. I give the place three stars for the ambiance, but the food and service was poor. This is my personal experience. If you are a health nut, then this is the place for you. However, if you are looking for a place in between with healthy and non-healthy options, then this is not the place for you.
Very good food and great service. There is a Wine and Spirit shoppe across the street and they are BYOB.
The best Mexican restaurant I've ever had! We came twice while on vacation & will be back in the near future!!

Heavenly nails is my favorite nail salon! They continue to improve and expand. Saly P by far is the most talented nail technician I've ever been to, she always does an amazing job, especially with SNS powder. Laura T is also excellent and did a great job on my boyfriend's first manicure and pedicure. I have continued to visit Saly and Heavenly Nails despite moving to Clearwater, when you find a place so good you have to stay loyal!

The food here was absolutely delicious! I went in on a snowy day and got the wings and grilled cheese. Everything came out fast and was absolutely delicious. The wings were the perfect kind of savory for a winter day! Everyone was very friendly too!

Updated Yelp review to say get the Chef Antipasto Board! It's one of the BEST charcuterie boards I have had in a minute. This time I actually got to enjoy dinner at Forbici to celebrate a friends birthday. As usual, make a reservation if you can. I ordered the red house wine and it was a delicious Pinot Noir. We decided to split a couple of appetizers like the shrimp which were juicy, meatballs which were *chefs kiss*, and the antipasto board which was heaven. It had everything you needed including cheeses, pickles, bread, mustard, meats. The stuffed tomato's were delicious. For dinner I got the chicken Milanese and it was crispy and fresh! Forbici is on my list of Tamils staples that are sure to please!

If you want excellent and tasty Chinese food, this is the right place to go or call for takeout.  The portions are generous at very reasonable prices.   We recommend this restaurant to everyone.  Their delivery service is also prompt and courteous.  The owners are super nice; they always have a smile for every customer regardless how busy and stressed they are.

We showed up around 10:40 am last Sunday. The waitress cheerfully greeted us, told us to select a table. She asked if we had been there before, when we said "no", she said she would be back to talk to us.
There was definitely a weird vibe and I felt uncomfortable. There were no people of color as customers, only workers in the back.
When we got up to leave 20 minutes later, no one attempted to stop us. 
I will blame our experience on poor customer service, but it felt like wrong place, wrong time, we weren't going to get served any time soon.

The items we had were more along the lines of higher end bar food.  It was good and next year this will be one of the places to suggest for a group.  Honestly, it's been over six months since I ate here and have forgotten the exact food we got.
I usually order the chicken flautas.  I like their chips and queso, but their guacamole isn't very good.  It's kid friendly and usually fast.

We had high hopes based on the reviews. Unfortunately, this place did not live up to our expectations. They were out of many things, and it was very slow. My enchiladas were okay - I wouldn't get them again. My husband got carne asada tacos -  not that flavorful.  The sopes were the saving grace (and what deserved the 3 stars). I hate leaving this review because I want the place to succeed. Hopefully, it's just some growing pains.

The smoked turkey is, as previously noted, quite good.  The brisket was disappointing, as were the ribs -- there was no discernible taste of smoke in either.  There was also no nice bark on the ribs.  This isn't the southern barbecue with which I am familiar.

The amount of moisture in all three of the meats that I tried makes me wonder if the cooks are using more water in preparing them than might be advisable.  Try the potato salad; it's very good.

The space is tidy and the owner is very friendly.  It's nice to see another barbecue option in the Edmonton area.

We were looking forward to trying this place as we live nearby and saw on Yelp the good reviews.
I'm sorry to say we did not have the experience we expected. We were told to sit down, a few waitresses walked by and never acknowledged us. We flagged down 2 waitresses and they didn't return to take care of us.  We walked out after 25 min of waiting after seeing other parties being helped.  We will not return. Bad customer service. Very unfortunate.

The burgers and chicken strips from here were pretty good. It's bar food so you shouldn't expect too much. The drinks are made well and the beers are always ice cold. All in all it's good bar and Thursday is dollar beer day.

I love the Mexican rolls and teriyaki chicken bowl from here! Yum! Nice little restaurant with some rooms with Japanese style seating, as well as normal tables and booths. I love how you can see the chefs making sushi right behind the counter as you walk in. They offer take-out if you come pick it up, which is nice if you don't feel like coming in to sit down. And, my favourite part: during dinner hours (after 4pm?) you get a free miso soup and bean sprout salad before your meal (except not with take-out orders). I'm not brave enough to try too many things on the menu, but it's still good enough that I return every so often for a craving quick-fix. They only lose a star because it's not my number 1 favourite sushi place, and it can get pretty busy at lunch and dinner.

Just finished lunch at Sake Don.  Vyet, the waiter was very helpful and friendly in recommending rolls to try.  Sushi chef was also friendly.  Food was served quickly and was fresh and very tasty!
I started with the chef salad which was plentiful and fresh.  I ordered the Monster Roll and the spicy crawfish roll.  Both rolls were delicious but word to the wise, the Monster Roll is huge and I brought a good portion of it home with the crawfish roll.
Very happy to have this sushi restaurant available to the neighborhood.  We did not have one before.  Not great on atmosphere but food and service was escellent!  I will definitely return.

I went there for a fabulous lunch! It was quick and the staff was friendly. I had the Chicken Tikka Marsala. The chicken was tender and flavorful!There was plenty of rice, a beautiful garnish and lots leftover to take home for dinner! The Naan bread was hot right out of the oven! The decor was beautiful. It was busy but the food was brought out promptly. I will be back!

Really disappointed. Shrimp scampi was tiny shrimp. Pasta zucchini was watery/soupy with processed/chewy chicken and the grilled tilapia was a huge serving but the bread crumbs were hard to find. On the plus side the service was good, man size drinks from the bar and the prices are very reasonable. It's painful to say something negative about Rigazzi's but last night they dropped the ball.

I've visited several times and it's consistent on food quality and service. Place is decent size for a homey kitchen style food. Authentic Peruvian flavors so far. I recommend this place to everybody looking for Peruvian food in tampa.
This place is absolutely  amazing if you want ramen. Coupled with great service! You have to try the bun bun with pork and the spicy ramen. They can add extras like egg, spices and extra noodles.

Stopped in for lunch with my daughter while we were out running errands. On the outside,  the restaurant looks a little rough but inside it's clean and airy. The outdoor tables were not available to sit at so we sat inside. I was pleasantly surprised to find they have a vegetable options section. My burrito was stuffed full of mushroom, peppers, onions and broccoli. It was a bit dry but the cheese sauce on the outside helped. The rice was ok but I would have like a bit more or some beans. The waiter brought me a second cup of water and it had crusty stuff on the outside so I guess it wasn't washed properly.  I didn't drink the water. My daughter's hot and spicy burrito was not spicy according to her and underwhelming.

Drive thru order.  We were told to wait out in front because our order would take longer.  We pulled around front and waited.  15 or more minutes later our food was brought to us.  We asked if all 4 whoppers were in the bag...we were told, rudely, "all of its' in there".  We got home and only 3 of the 4 whoppers were in the bag.  We attempted to call that night over five times and no one answered the phone.

We called back the next day and the person we spoke with was only willing to refund us the cost of the whopper, they were not willing to do anything else to help us for all of the trouble that they caused.  I asked to speak with his manager and he kept repeating that there was no one else there.  He then hung up on me without doing anything to help.

I will never visit this booger queen again, and I advise all to do the same.

Reading these reviews makes wonder if these people have ever been to a good steakhouse before.  Or hell, even the Texas Roadhouse across town if you want cheaper fare.  I'd rather have a burger from Midtown Eats

1)  This place is a straight sh!t show.  You've got people running every which way in a frantic rush to get all this sub par food to the wrong tables.  And I know that the menu states the onion is an appetizer.  But what it really means is we are going to drop the App off at the same time as your salads.  Oh wait you haven't got your glasses of wine yet?  Well luckily your entrees just showed up with your wine.  We literally got all our food within 3 minutes.  I've seen monkeys fling feces at the zoo with better coordination than this place.

2)  When the menu says they season the whole piece of meat they mean it!!  It was hands down the saltiest food I've ever eaten.  I was worried I might puff up and not be able to get my shoes off when I got home.  Chicken, Pork, Beef, it all tastes the same here.  I'll save food like that for when I'm a little older and the taste buds are completely shot.

3)  The one thing I will say that our waiter Deven did hustle.  All the things above are attributed to his management so that is not his fault.  They are mostly high school and college kids that are doing their best in a poorly managed restaurant.

Do yourself a favor.  Park, and then walk right past Ruby River to Naan & Kabab where Chef Maurice knows how to run a restaurant.

Pretty cool place with decent food, guess I expected something more in the lines of flavor. The advertise doing it for so long I was hoping for food bursting with something that made me say mmmmm OMG. But unfortunately that moment never came. For the price I also would of expected a more wow factor.  

It's a good breakfast, the staff super nice and friendly. However I left a bit disappointed. But I probably got my hopes up too high.
Great spot for fast food Italian. Quick, yummy and excellent service. It is always very clean, too.

I'm usually wary of men with beards--not sure why. (Maybe it's the cult-like vibe I get from the Amish.) But if they make candy this good, and are able to maintain such well-groomed facial hair, then they're fine with me.

For the most part. 

What's even more impressive is that everything is made on site with machines that probably run on this "elbow grease" my Nana keeps going on about.  Check out the handcrafted candy toys, larger-than-your-face lollipops, and jawbreakers the size of a fist inside of another fist. And of course, there's chocolate: straight-up by itself or drenched over something equally delicious (yes, I'm talking about bacon).  If I weren't concerned about obesity or the elasticity of my sweatpants, Shane Candies would be my grocery store.

Peace.

My girlfriend and I tried reef on a wednesday night. We walked in around 7:30 and the place was not even half full. There were 6 sushi chefs working plus a fry cook. 

We sat down and put in a small simple order of about 6 popular nigiri and 2 rolls. 

After 15 minutes, our waitress came over to apologize that our food had not arrived, but said it would be out quickly. 

After 30 minutes, our waitress came by again and apologized again that our food was not ready. She offered us appetizers, but I declined. I saw her go behind the bar and speak with the sushi chefs everyone looked confused.

Around this time, tables on either side of us that came in 5-10 minutes after us, and ordered after us, started to get their sushi. 

After 45 minutes, as one of the tables next to us who ordered after us were getting their third round of sushi delivered, we got up, found our waitress, canceled our order and began to walk out. 

We had been in the restaurant for around an hour and never got any food. 

I talked with the manager on the way out and he said "our food is almost ready" and pointed to a sushi chef who was just beginning to prepare our order. One piece of nigiri had been plated. 

I don't know if they lost our order or gave it to someone else, but there is no excuse for such a long wait at a sushi place. It is especially disappointing watching people who ordered after us get their second and third orders before we got our first.
Try the gooey butter cake. You don't be disappointed. Friendly service. Sometimes the line is long but it moves fast. I love the French dip.
BECCA WAS AMAZING! Thank you for such a great time!!! The tractor was huge, staff was nice, and the music was great. During the day was just as fun as the night!
Possibly some of the best BBQ I've ever had. I was with a group of 8, we tried it all!! No regrets can't wait to come back again sometime soon. Thanks for an awesome meal.

Good service even during peak periods. The food is excellent no matter what is ordered. My wife always orders the big bowl soups with vermicelli noodles and I order fried egg noodle dishes with seafood or chicken or beef. They have a cooler full of beer as well. This place never disappoints!!
The Reading Terminal is my food mecca. Fresh and local produce, poultry and meats, not to mention all of the vendors selling delicious sandwiches and snacks. And local honey?!?!?! Yes, please.

Stopped for lunch fantastic, fresh and delicious. Owners are very knowledgable and friendly. Can tell you how to cook everything if you want to take something home. The sausages are made fresh and look great. Fresh organic veggies for sale too.

Love this place. I kept driving by wondering if it was any good but never went in. Finally a coworker invited me out and it was awesome! Great food and great one if a kind brews. The staff are great as well. Please check this place out, I don't want it to go anywhere!

I don't know about best sandwich in the nation, but it's a damn good sandwich!

Got the Beef Brisket with Broccoli rabe. Great combination. The rabe adds a little kick to the densely stuffed sandwich. There must have been like a pound of tender juicy beef in there. Worth the long lines.

MALIKA IS THE BEST!! I pray to god that you get Malika as a your guide. She is by far the funniest, wittiest tour guide I have ever personally had, and I travel a lot. Lots of info I had no idea about, and I have visited and loved NOLA for many years. I was definitely creeped out, AND my husband took a series of photos that ended up having lots of orbs in them (if you believe in orbs). Either way, skeptic or not, go on this tour, it's well worth the money and super informative, easy to do and leaves you with so much more appreciation for one of the oldest cities in the US.

I have yet to eat-in at Cesar's, but their catered food is awesome! I had their fresh ceviche and hand-made tamales at a friend's house party the other night and was really impressed. I liked it so much in fact that we placed an order from them for a holiday party we are hosting. I plan to head into their Milpas location at some point to try some of the other seafood items on their menu.

Great food, friendly staff, relaxed atmosphere, highly recommend. Been there for lunch and dinner and will continue as we completely enjoy this restaurant. The guacamole, chips and salsa are each the best we've had here in Tucson. We've been able to order enchiladas the way we like them and the chorizo dishes are to die for and my favorite as I turn the left overs from this meal into breakfast the next day. So far I've only had a few of the house margaritas but they have been excellent.

Walked in at 8:30pm to find the serving stations looking a mess! Food spilling out everywhere across the counters. The store manager looked nonchalant and unbothered by the messiness of his store. It's obviously a busy store and the workers were pleasant and work hard to fill the orders but more care should be taken to keep prep and serving areas which are in full view of customers tidier and cleaner!!!

We just recently joined and made a couple visits but still have not seen all that the Hagley has to offer. The DuPont company was and still is a great example of American entrepreneurship and this museum offers a glimpse of how French immigrants came across the Atlantic and helped make America great.

Ok, enough platitudes. The Hagley is a great place to take the kids with plenty of outdoor activities and demonstrations (the gunpowder demonstration is my fave!). You can't do it all in one day.

Again, we haven't explored all there is but by being members, we are eligible to attend the classic car show and the Independence Day fireworks, both of which are considered the best in the region. I'm also looking forward to seeing it decorated at Christmas time.

Holy Mother of Pearl! I spent a night in Nashville for the first time. Upon checking into my hotel I asked the front desk "where can I get the real deal Southern comfort food in this area?" He replies "hands down Hattie B's and its around the corner from here."  The moment the front desk associate told me "There's always a line so you may want to call I'm ahead." I knew I was in for a mega treat! I had no problem waiting in line as many people in line were first timers also coming from BONNAROO so we had lots to chat about. Once I walked in I saw people's plates and wanted to take a nibble of everything. The sandwiches looked hunky and I could see from a mile away that fried chicken was crispy to perfection. I ordered fried chicken with collard greens, Mac n cheese, and potato salad. There's levels to the heat on your chicken. I usually order the highest level of heat at restaurants because let's face it when most places label something as hot it's usually mild. I went with damn hot thinking it may just be hot. The damn hot was exactly that DAMN HOT! So beware they mean business! The chicken had s dry rub with the heat on the outside so as my eyebrows and every other pore on my face began to sweat which ended up smearing heat all over my face. Nose running lips on fire. It was so tasty I couldn't stop despite my suffering. The potato salad and pitcher of beer cooled me down a little. A serious nap was definitely in order as soon as I was done eating. I don't normally post reviews but I felt compelled to for the sole reason that I've been craving Hattie B's ever since. I live in Fort Lauderdale, FL so it's hard to crave something so tasty from such a distance. So for those of you who live close by or are passing through please do not skip this stop, I promise you won't regret it, unless you tried to show off getting a level of heat higher than you can stand but of course that would all be on you. I will def. be back hopefully sooner than later.
Very rude employees . I picked up 25 pretzels for baseball. Guy asked me to call because he says not sure why people fell "entitled" to order that many pretzels. Really?  It's $10 worth of pretzels.

I dig this place!   Haven't had a proper cut since I moved to Reno, a year ago.  I really enjoyed the environment and staff.   My first appt was with Jessee Buck...all I can say is; this dude freakin rocks!    He took the time to help with my thinning/balding areas.  I felt like a million bucks when I left Maxwells.

Thanks again fellas.  Keep doing an awesome job

Just meh. I was meeting a friend here, and so I got a half booth near the bar and ordered a cocktail. I had a question about one of the cocktails, but the server couldn't answer it. Kinda bummed so I picked a different one, and it was fine - a whiskey sour with Bushmills Black Bush. 

After my friend arrived, she placed an order for their adult hot cider cocktail, and we looked over the menu. The drink finally came out probably 5+ minutes later. The drinks were slow all evening while we were there. The server explained at one point that they were doing a shift change, but that doesn't explain why it was slow all evening even though the restaurant wasn't busy at all when we arrived. (My whiskey sours are super simple to make so I don't understand the delay.) So, after my friend tried her drink, she knew immediately something was off. I tasted it as well, and instead of brown sugar and cinnamon on the rim as advertised, it tasted like blood mary spices had been added instead. Not a good combo! We waited for our server, Parker, to return. When she described what had happened and that the taste was off, he mentioned he saw the bartender do the correct rim. Once would have been enough, but he kept saying it like that would suddenly change her mind. He did take the drink back and remove it from the bill, but at that point, we're both thinking the bartender had switched the lids to the rimming sugars/spices and that it wasn't a good idea to order a replacement. Fortunately, the blue drink she ordered (that was, again, super slow to come out) was a hit. 

The fish and chips here are tasty as I've had them before, and that's what my friend ordered with plenty left to take home. We split the fried pickles which were slices lengthwise of a pickle so that was a little bit of a different way to do it than a lot of places. They were okay but not notable. 

I ordered the chili mac and cheese since I had been in the mood for chili and the mac and cheese section sounded very good indeed! It was a hearty chili under large shells and a thick cheesy sauce! Super filling so I didn't quite eat it all, but it would be great for cold days or hangovers, to be honest. That was a nice bright spot in a very lackluster visit. I would return to try again and hope to update my review with more stars next time!
Top notch store with a great selection.  The staff, especially Brit, are friendly and extremely helpful.
Great spot to hang out with friends! Views are great too. They also have a giant TV screen outside which is nice as well.

6 or at least 8 brown woman standing around talking . One girl was kind of working, reluctantly took our orders ( two mini blizzards )
It took 8 minutes of them standing around till another girl finally got around to making it. 
She didn't bother turning the sloppy goo upside down. 
My blonde coworker said thank you and the woman literally sneered and turned around and started back into her conversation . 
We grabbed our own napkins and spoons. 
Worst customer service ever!!! And sub par
Food.

What a wonderful experience, this is now my favorite restaurant!
My husband and I just moved to Fallon in February we get a little tired of the local restaurants.. We went on Yelp and read all about a manager named Marco at a casino steakhouse called Sun Valley Steakhouse inside of Hobey's Casino.
We made reservations and had one of the best nights we've had since we moved. The service was outstanding, the atmosphere was so cool, (tons of wonderful Halloween decor).
I ordered the filet mignon with lobster tail oh, what a deal! My dinner was so tasty and we were smiling the entire time we were there.  Totally happy with everything. 
Our server's  name was Kevin ..he was kind and friendly, and Marco came by a few times to check on us. We basically had the best time and then walked into the casino and won a hundred bucks. I kept telling my husband how happy I was since we sat down in the restaurant and then all the way home...we thank you Marco and Kevin!

Awesome pizza and sides.  Great slices.  Absolutely delicious.  My grandkids love it here.  They have a blast.  The owner is really nice and the staff is great.  Prompt service and very clean.  Nice environment.  Great salads too.  Bathrooms are spotless!

I absolutely love the World Cafe.  I've been there three times to date--twice in 2006 for two consecutive shows; Ben Jelen (with the Alternate Routes as his opener) and Will Hoge (with The Trews as his opener), and once in 2008 to see Ben Jelen (with Standard of Living as his opener).  The two times I saw Ben Jelen, he performed upstairs and that is my favorite part of the venue as it is the most intimate performance setting.  When I saw Will Hoge, he performed downstairs and my friends and I rocked the front row for that performance.  

 I have never made it to a Free at Noon show, but my dad has gone (to see Hanson...oh how jealous I was even though I had a meet and greet pass to their show at the Troc later that evening...I had no choice but to go to school that day and not see Hanson's free at noon show.  However, Taylor was happy to hear during the meet and greet that my dad had attended the noon performance).   

World Cafe also has great food, drinks, and desserts, so if you're attending a show upstairs, make sure to get there early enough to get a table close enough to the stage!  There are also tables downstairs but I am not sure if they always have seating for downstairs shows.  Regardless, I will definitely be returning to World Cafe Live and hope to perform at one of their weekly open mics sometime in the near future.

Food was awesome!

We stopped in for breakfast around 10AM on a Sunday morning. The streets were already filling up, so we were worried about wait time. We checked in and were told it would be 15-20 minutes, however, we were seated within five. 

Milk and Honey is very near the famous "wings" mural you see all over Instagram, so get there early and you'll have time for your wings picture before the line gets long. 

The server was great. The menu was great and there were a lot of tough choices. 
I got the chicken and biscuit sandwich with fruit and I'm glad I did! Loved everything about it. 

The decor was typical of the neighborhood. A lot of "reclaimed" wood and metal and no frills. 

I really have no complaints about this place at all. For the three of us, breakfast came out to $56 +tip. That is relatively expensive these days, but just about average for the Gulch area. I would definitely recommend.

Great people, good beer and food.  I sat at the bar for a couple of meals as I was in the same area for a couple days. . Great staff that makes you feel welcome.  And the regulars are just as nice, I definitely felt like I was part of the group pretty quickly.  

Food is good, I had the challenge on the first night.  It's two half pound burgers that were well cooked.  Cheese selection is nice, I mean what kind of bar has asiago or gouda?  The fries are to die for though.  Super crispy. 

Next night I had the salmon, which was a proportioned cut.  Well cooked also, with a but too much of the sweet glaze on it.  Also, could have used a little more rice pilaf on the side, but in general pretty good. 

The beer selection was decent, and they were concerned enough about the Wisconsin fans coming in (it was the week before the final four) that they were trying to finish a tap to make room for the leiny summer shandy.  Good attention to customer wants.

I have been bringing my mixed breed Eddie here for 3+ years. We have never had a bad experience. Eddie is a rescue dog, so we don't really know what his previous life was like, and he can be high strung at times. The staff handles Eddie perfectly! He always looks great, and they are happy to cut him different ways and lengths depending on my request. They can be very busy, so I make sure to schedule my next appointment when I pick him up.

One my favorites on Magazine! Nice place to enjoy lunch. I love the poboys here. Sit on the porch and enjoy the food, an ice cold beer, and talking with friends. The poboys are huge.  The Abita amber on tap is great too! The staff works their tails off here too making sure you have what you need. Definitely recommend strolling down magazine and ending up here for a meal and nice cold drink.
Awesome detailing job. My car was DIRTY. Hadn't washed it in months. Got the executive detailing option now look at me.

So I've been wanting to go here for awhile now, especially after reading the Craig LeBan article rating it so highly. I dragged a friend out here tonight who owed me a dinner and it was well worth it. We ordered the special--meatballs and split a salad and ordered a truffle pizza to share. Unfortunately the truffle pizza was a little too mushroom-y for me (which I should have figured) but the waiter, Tom was probably the best waiter I've ever had, and just wanted me to eat something and picked out a pesto and goat cheese pizza on the house for me to have. It was excellent as was the service. Tom was great, a breath of fresh air. Great place in a great neighborhood with great food and amazing service. Nomad's got it figured out.

I am so disappointed by this place! I bought Justin's Honey peanut butter (along with lots of other stuff) a few days ago and I was shocked to find it expired July 18, 2016!! I am so disgusted by the fact that they are selling products that expired over a month ago. I would not recommend this place to ANYONE!!

This place has great food and amazing treats for all times of the day and year. Not only is the atmosphere conducive to hanging out after your meal but it's a cool place to bring people from out of town. I think it's a shame that some people are reviewing not the food and service but silly newspaper articles and innuendo that's based on nothing

It's a good thing there isn't a Whole Foods in the near downtown vicinity or I would never buy groceries and would just eat here for every meal! Wouldn't be very wallet friendly, but it's all just so tempting! 

That's why I love this particular Whole Foods, not because of its grocery selection (although its great, just slightly out of my price range), but because of the plethora of ready to eat food options at my fingertips. On the more frequent than I would like to admit occasion, I find myself too tired to wrestle up something good for dinner, Whole Foods is where I turn. 

My favorites:
The salad bar (seriously, could you put a few more options on there? I joke.) 
Pre made sushi
Hot bar - that mac n cheese
Pizza
Smoothies - creating your own is my favorite, you can even add green super food! 
The bakery - did you know they have gelato? 

So, for most grocery items Whole Foods is a splurge, and although my dinner choices here may not be as cheap as fast food, prices for most grab and go items are reasonable and relatively health conscious. 

Highly recommend stopping in Whole Foods, if for no other reason than to browse their massive cheese, alcohol and frozen foods sections. I could get lost on those aisles! And find myself splurging occasionally on unique items.

I had bar service. Great staff. Saturday night. Order took a long time and I had to leave to catch a show. The food that they removed from my bill arrived as I was settling the bill. They encouraged me to taste it. It was incredible. I will come back on a slower night!! Thank you for being so accommodating!!
This business added a supply chain surplus charge to my paint after they mixed my paint. I won't ever purchase from this store again. This is bad business

I bought a dozen donut, the guy serving me was wearing a disposable glove. You would think it's good - NO ! He was using the same glove on everything , he handled my donuts ( no tongs or anything) just with the glove and my payment using the same hand with the same glove. 
And helped the next customer with the same glove. 
I also asked to boston cream on display, he gave me some from a different tray on the side. 
I get home, some donuts were already hard, you can tell that they were old.

I stopped here on my visit to New Orleans and left so disappointed. I have never dealt with such rude and incompetent servers before. I asked about what's on tap and he said that's what the menu is for. Honestly, the whole vibe of the place felt this way. Condescending arrogance in the air like I was bothering them for being there. Never again.

We went here per recommendation and were not impressed. The chef was not very professional and the food was very mediocre. The yum yum sauce had a weird texture and did not taste right. Also the chef kept scooping jarred minced garlic into everything which instead of adding flavor, it was just garlic overkill. The waitress was good but just not a great experience overall. Won't be going back here.

Everyone go psycho! Sike. The line here is freaking crazy even though there's hella tables available. The food here is below par, meaning that the food has hella msg and salt. Lemon chicken was hard, prime rib was raw but salty as FREAK. Idk..you be the judge..The only good thing was the blueberry yogurt with granola, prunes, and green grapes. But yogurt at a buffet? C'mon. -.-

A Family Favorite! Authentic Italian. Doesn't get much better than this! Competes with Charlie Gitto's for our Favorite spot on the hill! But this is where we went the night we got engaged so it will always be special! We are pretty strict critics of Italian Food and this place delivers!!! Classy and Romantic as well!

Upgrading my review to 3 stars because they did finally acknowledge that there was a problem with my daughter's air conditioner and they fixed it (we did have to pay a deductible which was pretty much bullshit since we had bought the car in the spring and it had ac problems as soon as the weather warmed up, so it was obviously an existing problem) but at least it's fixed now.  They also finally paid us back for the battery we had to buy the week after we bought the car.   Our problems have been taken care of, for now, but I'm still not quite sure I would recommend the place.
Love this place! They have gluten free corn tortillas and several gluten free options. I liked how the tortillas were rolled like burritos for the tacos. They didn't fall apart either!
Chorizo burger and smoked old  fashion were both pretty bomb...and they have Shculpin on tap!

I love chipotle. However the staff is rude. They get you through the line quickly but they aren't personable. Also this location is constantly out of something, bowls or rice or  plasticware, it's always something. I only come to this specific location because I its convenient for me. But if I can ever go to a different location I do.

Luke was our waiter and he was awesome! The decor is tasteful and creative. The food was excellent especially for the price. The Manager even stopped by the table a couple of times to check on us. They currently have 4 locations with another opening soon. But they do not have that "chain" feel. We will definitely be back on our next trip through!!

Perfect place for lunch. We'd been on the road for 5 hours and decided to take a break for lunch. What a good choice. First we were greeted by Tyler who was so cheerful it was infectious. Then or waiter Jacob was excellent  This restaurant has one of the best salad bars I've seen. Everything was fresh. I could havre eater just that,but after reading the menu a Reuben sandwich was calling my name. The corn beef was lean and tender the toast was not hard and crusty- in short delicious. My husband had the chicken mozzarella chiabatta. He said that was excellent. This restaurant is closer to I-95 and will be one of our regular stops in the future. Our side was sweet potatoe fries which were so good we got a box for the ones we couldn't eat

We have tried this place twice and the food is fantastic!! We love fresh seafood and travel to the ne
beach regularly. This place rivals some of our favorites when at the beach. Fresh seafood in Nashville has been non-existent and this is a joy. We have done only takeout, but they have been prompt

Yep! I love
W me some real margaritas here, the guacamole is fresh as all hell... Love my Tex Mex!  They do it right here.... Virtually every dish I a winner, great happy hour plates too!

I love that there's a Filipino restaurant in Nashville. The price is very affordable. The combo allows me to try three dishes for $9.99 which is great since I can never just pick one! Their menu changes everyday so follow them on Facebook because they'll post it online. Great family atmosphere and traditional Filipino cooking.

I must say I am not a big fan of the dentist but this practice is by far the most comfortable and pleasant experience I have ever had.  Dr Kessler and her entire staff goes the extra mile to make it that way. My hygienist Diane made a scary situation for me very pleasant and comfortable..so if you had fears like mine make this your dentist, you will NOT be sorry.. thank you all for all you do.
So damn good. The varied breakfast options are winners and the service was terrific. Nice people, good food. Definitely a full recommendation.

There are several other options in Philly-GO THERE!!
This place has to be the worst in the area. I ordered a Philly cheesesteak and fries. 
Sandwich: No condiments on sandwich or in bag. Very little cheese stuck to bread with dried meat on the super thick bread.
Fries: Old and burnt. No salt, no flavor.
Service: I called restaurant to speak with someone and was immediately placed on hold. Called back placed on hold again.
Definitely not eating here ever again.

We own a home here in reno and had called them out for our refrigerator and they came out and said that the motor had stopped working we were going to loose a lot of food they called parts place and found motor went and picked it up and with in 3 hours had our unit up and running we lost nothing thank you so much
One of my favorite brunch place in Philly, amazing good food and very friendly place!

This is our second event with the couch tomato, first one was at their site and this was at our home. If you're in need of an at home caterer to wow your guests, this place is it. Above and beyond quality of the food, friendliness of the staff and attention to detail. Can't wait for our next party to have them back!!!!!

I had a Royale sandwich and a latte. Loved everything that was on the delicious multi-grain bread. However, I wasn't a fan of the salsa and chips that came with the sandwich meal. My boyfriend had the Nathan sandwich (has natural peanut butter, honey, and bananas), and he said it was the best peanut butter and banana sandwich he's ever had! I wouldn't say the latte was the best latte I've ever had in Nashville, but it was still delicious. Great customer service and beautiful location!

I'm surprised this giant has so many positive reviews. I hate going here. In fact, I was scolded by a checker a couple of months back for putting a case of water on the belt to be scanned. She wouldn't scan it until I put it back in the cart!!?? After that, I refuse to go back. I should have just walked out.
My chef complaint is that it's always sooo crowded.  By the time I've gotten to the ice cream isle, I'm beside myself with frustration weaving through all the carts sitting in the middle of the isle while people browse, and kids running around. I've tried going in the morning but it's no better because every isle is filled with stockers. And then I have to wait for deep in line.
When I go to the store, I like to get in and get out. Maybe giant is good if you want to spend half your day browsing and chatting. Besides all of that, the selection is pretty good, but not with the time and frustration.

I don't think they are open anymore. First I tried doing their online reservation from the link on their website, which I didn't work. So then I tried calling the number multiple times but each time it would ring and no one was on the other end or had a pre voice recording that they were closed, busy, etc.
This is one of nashvilles best fast foods, the food and service was splended. I'd recommend coming here it is a delight!

Decent Mexican food for Indianapolis! Honestly, this place gets 3.5 stars, but Yelp doesn't do halfsies, so I am rounding up. 

I got a Burrito Mexicano with chicken instead of steak. It was tasty and huge. It made me happy that it was a burrito-burrito, in that it wasn't covered with sauce like an enchilada, like most Mexican restaurants in Indiana do. When I order a burrito, I want to be able to hold it in my hands, and for the most part I could do that with this burrito. 

The chips and salsa come complimentary with every entree. The chips were good and addictive. The salsa was thin and tomatoey like I like it. Together, they made a good pair.

I got my food to go, and they were super quick with taking and fulfilling my order.

This is a very hidden place but it is definitely worth going to. It has a very special ambience and atmosphere. Service was great. We were sitting outside and had a great time. We had the crab omelette and the crab sandwich and my favorite the fried potatoe salad as a snack. Loved it and would def recommend it.

So you are planning a trip into Boise in your RV and need a place to stay?  Want to be central to Boise, Eagle, and Meridian?  Want a safe, clean place that isn't a fortune?  Need to stay for awhile?  Call Hi-Valley.  We booked a week here a little over a month ago.  They are filling up fast and now are booked up through summer.   I am sad/happy to continue on our trip but we really liked our one week stay.  

Here is the deal with this place.  They have many residents here, most of the spots are filled with month to month renters.  There are a little under 40 spots for short timers, or weekly renters.  The full timers here are a mixed bunch of really nice and inviting people.  I feel like this is a mix between retired folks, families, and working individuals.  The place is run by some of the residents.  I like the vibe here, it feels safe and friendly.

The facilities are good with a big community club house (that resembles a living room, kitchen, and office), bathrooms with showers, a laundry room, small workout room, mail services, a dog park, playground, pool and spa.  The park is all gravel and pavement with a few trees scattered about.  The spaces are very close together but if you are in an RV, who cares?  People are nice and it is a place to stay in a residential/ farm/ urban area so who is complaining about how much space you get here?

The park backs up to a canal and you can take a walk along a path that runs parallel to it.  If you need to get anywhere in the area, you are not far from it.  The place is clean, safe, and a great place to call home for a day, a week or longer.

I bought a 2005 BMW X3 from these guys, I tested out several other cars but wanted an SUV, I told them the a/c wasn't working and so they fixed it right? Wrong after a couple of days the a/c went out and called them they thought they fixed the problem, so I went to a family friend to shoot ink into the a/c to see if there was a leak and the air compressor was cracked badly so I called the back and the owner said they will replace it. The put a new one in and never had a problem since I had for over a year, when buying a car you have to find out car fax and what not before you buy. Now I won't say I won't buy another car from them, but 3 stars is due to decent ownership

Absolutely amazing experience; food was beyond my expectations. 

Came here with a large group (made a resi on OpenTable) and were seated immediately. We had a round table which was perfect for everyone to talk with each other. 

Highly recommend the Kale / Quinoa salad. The sauce was subtle. Salmon with eggplant / spinach was the highlight!! We also ordered the ice cream to finish up (they have a cart to show you each dessert; hard to say no) Overall fantastic experience. Will definitely come back again.

Better than any of the other chains and has definitely become a PC landmark!  Great fried chicken and sides (esp cole slaw & mashed taters).  I mean, not my favorite style of fried chicken (I like a light dredging), but still better than any other you can find and for a better price than most.

I just ate at the new Location for the first time last night.  What a treat!  A more intimate dining space and no more Sangria, but the same great food!  Service was quick and the food was even BETTER than I remember.  I had the Thai Mex Curry with shrimp  . Undoubtedly I'll be back before the weekend is over.

Where to start....Well, to begin with, let's just say that a 5'2" 95 pound woman and her 6' 155 pound husband walking into an all you can eat steakhouse is just funny.  We walked in and the bartender said I think you guys are going to make us money.  He said it in a funny way so I was not offended! He obviously didn't count on us being human hollow legs!  Our waiter Chris was marvelous.  I loved him.  He was attentive and he was very very helpful.
The food they put on the table went mostly untouched as we wanted to save room.  The salad bar was actually good.  Ceaser salad, parmo wheel (I want one at home) fresh veggies and cured meats from DiBruno Bros.  Yum.
Now for the meat....I do not like cooked salmon.  I LOVED this cooked salmon.  I ate 10 different meats... parmo pork, flank steak and lamb as well as my salmon were by far the best.  Bacon wrapped filet I didn't care for too much nor the ribs, but I am very particular with those. 
I'd go in a heartbeat!  Make sure you ask for Chris.

I've been coming here for a few months now and Eve knows exactly how to cut my hair. I'm in the military and am forced to have my hair within certain standards that make it hard for it to look decent. I've tried out numerous places near the base (JBMDL NJ) that have left my hair looking goofy and hard to manage. Eve managed to undo the damage and I've been happy ever since.
Great variety of food. Everything fresh and hot. The staff was friendly. Capacity was limited. Everything was clean. L

When I have to make a trek out to the wilds of the Autobahn, er, Eagle Road, Pueblo Lindo is one of my first choices when looking for sustenance. Plenty of chain restaurants and fast food joints flank the road, but Pueblo Lindo has the charm and service only found at smaller, local eateries. 

The decor is rustic Mexican and charming. Staff are attentive without being disruptive. I love that they leave a carafe of water at the table. 

I've only been here during lunch. Their chips are fresh and perfectly salted. The salsa is piquant and stands out from the typical Mexican restaurant salsa schtick. I'd like to see some beans along with the chips, but that could be due to my American palate. 

I've had the Pueblo Lindo enchilada and the burrito. They are similar, but the enchilada sauce has a mole-ish base; the taste of peanut is distinct. The meat is always tender and the food is steaming hot. 

Next time you're in the Meridian area, give this place a shot. It's tucked away from the fray, and very worth a visit.
Nice big bar and grill restaurant with dozens of TVs with all different sports channels. Service was quick and friendly. Food was good.

This was one of the most disappointing meals I've had in the Santa Barbara area. We went on Memorial Day and they did not have their usual lunch menu. The service was inattentive, didn't understand us well and was non existent most of the time. Took forever to even get a menu after we safe down and the place had only a few tables full. No one checked to see if we needed anything like more tea or water. 

FOOD: Soup--hot and sour soup had a strange texture as if they mixed it with egg drop soup. The egg drop soup was watery and lacked the correct consistency and flavor (it had no flavor). 

The moo shu shrimp came already wrapped which was odd. No plum sauce was put on the pancakes first and the filling was flavorless and dry. There was no sauce whatsoever. Even the pancakes were too thick. They're supposed to be light and airy not thick like a burrito. The only good part was the plump sauce but there wasn't enough of it. 

The shrimp with lobster sauce was a joke. Tasted nor looked anything like the real dish and they put water chestnuts in it to make it more bland. 

The mushrooms with bok choy were also not great. No knives were given yet they serves whole pieces of bok choy. Impossible to eat and it tasted like watery garlic. 

They gave my mom the wrong dish. She ordered sweet and sour pork but they gave her Schezuan pork. They did make her a new one to go once she said something but no one ever came over during our meal to ask if everything was okay so it was late by the time that got sorted. 

There was no soy sauce, salt, pepper not hot sauce on the table but boy were they needed. Overall it was a disappointment. Wouldn't recommend and won't return.

The best sushi I have had outside of Beaver Creek, CO.  
Manager/hostess is unbelievably friendly and offers wine to first time visiters.  
Remember this place is a BYO.

First stop while in NOLA.  One of the girls at a nearby store recommended this place. At first I was kinda not in the mood for American food as I was anxious to have some seafood but this diner did not let me down. Our waiter was super friendly and recommended the burger - he said they make them fresh - no patties so that got me! I had the fried egg burger; they didn't even ask me how I wanted my burger but the cook cooked it to perfection.  It was so most and juicy. The egg yolk poured out, I was in heaven! The only downside was the fries, they may need to work on that. Loved the old school stool seating. The server was in the center interacting with everyone.  Very lively.  Prices were reasonable.
Reef has amazing fresh sushi and a great team. Ask for Reggie, he's the man! They also made me a beautiful strawberry flower... Made my night. Love reef. Best sushi in Reno.

Located directly across the street from 'Tommy's' and 'Tommy's Wine Bar' on Tchoupitoulas in the Warehouse District, the location is terrific for a Latin-fusion joint like Tomasito's.  I say this because I can't really think of any other Latin restaurants in proximity, aside from Liborio's on Magazine St. in the CBD.

Now, I write this review based on my experiences extending over the last month or so.  I have been privy to mixed feelings from friends and co-workers concerning the restaurant in its early youth so I'm not going to try to expound too much on that.  What I will say is that when the restaurant initially opened, it featured a different chef and struggled with consistency, as most new restaurants tend to do.  There has since been a change in chef and direction toward culinary delinshusness!

Lately, I have been dining at the bar counter, near the back of the restaurant beside the open courtyard door.  Yes, there is a courtyard behind the restaurant for those diners looking to eat under the stars.  The courtyard is quite nice but I find that it's much better to eat out there after the sun has gone down.  New Orleans heat is unforgiving!  

There appears to be adequate tables for all diners and is also a good spot for friend/family gatherings.  The staff is all too eager to oblige by putting tables together, as I have witnessed on several occasions.  One thing I like about the dining tables is that they are sufficiently spaced apart from one another so that you aren't sitting in the lap of the patrons beside you.  I hate going to nicer restaurants in a party of two and they seat you so close to the next table that you can't go to cut a steak without knocking elbows with others around you!  It's nice to see that problem doesn't exist here!

The menu has recently changed and upon speaking with the bartender (who is quite regular there), Tommy and the chef are still working out which items will remain on the menu and what will be leaving.
