Don't drive too fast, you might just miss this place. I was told these were the best clams in Idaho and when i looked for reviews (3 posts) i was very interested. The last post was about a year ago. Anyways, i took my boss' advice and tried it out. I don't know what an amazing clam is supposed to taste like, but I'm sure they got it right here.   The clams are cooked perfectly and the butter and cocktail sauce they provide, just makes it taste so much bettThe steak fingers

More like Supersick. Look, I'm no germaphobe but the place is gross! Guys, hire a couple part time people to come in and sweep a few times. And the smell! It's like dog**** and BO had a devil child. I don't care how cheap it is. I'll pay extra to clean that dump up. Get it together Superfit.

I'm a transplant from Northern New Jersey, and locating decent Italian has been challenging. 

I like this place. Hopefully the neighborhood leaves the establishment alone. 

The cold sandwich is something that does not require repeating. The mission of finding a good sub, hoagie, whatever u call it - that mission is still in progress. Despite a fail on the Italian sub, their meatball salad is fantastic! Been back twice for it... Who would ever imagine that the two could compliment so nicely. I give all the credit to that meatball though.

Laisa - I would like to thank you for taking the time to give me the best haircut I have ever had.  I was at Lakshmi Hair Studio almost a month ago and am still enjoying my haircut.  I will be honest I left the salon feeling exhausted and underwhelmed.  I was there for three hours for a cut and color.  I have been at a salon that long before but this was my first time having a baby at home and having come from work - so I missed the baby and also was really needing to nurse him.

Everyday I have enjoyed my haircut more and have been even wearing my hair down - which I have honestly probably never done unless it was professionally blown out.

So I just wanted to say thank you Laisa for the best haircut ever -  I will definitely be back and it can take however long is necessary.

(I am not sure about my color though - but that is fixable - I have had great experience with Wella color but with the rate that my hair is growing currently my roots are almost salt/pepper and my hair is medium-dark brown.)

I sent this to the salon as a thank you.  Laisa was fantastic and really took the time to give me a great haircut!

Also they have online booking but there are issues with it - so I would recommend calling for appointments if you are booking more than one service.
We Haven't had anything bad here! They have Great sushi! Trustworthy place to eat! My cousin and I go here all the time.

Jaclyn at the front was AMAZING, so sweet such a people person and gives great recommendations! Ryan, our server was just as amazing, he came back 2 times to take our order since we wanted to take pictures and was so patient with us. AND THE FOOD!!! Oh my gosh, how ever long the wait is, ITS WORTH IT!!! The chicken Alfredo was the best I have ever had in my life. The margs were so strong and good (get the double) . I would love to come back here and see these amazing smiling servers and hostess again. Such a good place to eat.

Sushi was excellent and fresh, my wife doesn't even like anything fishy, but we powered through 6 long rolls, and she loves it. We will come back here for sure. Also Costco sells two $50 gift cards for $79.99 which makes the deal even sweeter.

I needed to find  a place to get my iPhone screen fixed. I went on yelp and found this company 2 minutes from my house . He had my phone fixed in 15 minutes. It looks and works as good as new. Corey is the owner and the one who fixed my phone . If you need your iPhones fixed please come to this business . Great service !
This place was great. Although the service wasn't top notch, everything else made up for it. The buffalo mozzarella is a MUST.
Last week I bought two replacement SUPS...this time I made sure the dealer would stand behind the products regardless of environmental " events"
other reviewers are dead on.  If you like being talked to like your an idiot go waste your money here.  This is why so many chains close.  They keep morons like this in charge

New Greeks Pizzeria location in the Tinker Street corridor (16th Street near the Monon Trail). The owner Ryan and the staff (including several students from nearby Herron High School) go out of their way to make sure you have a great experience. Good decor, cold local craft beer selections and hot pizza within a short walk from home is a great addition to the neighborhood. They also deliver and have plenty of parking on side streets on out front on 16th.

This is, by far, the worst Mexican food that I have ever had. The service is slow, they did not check on us whatsoever. I got food poisoning from the dinner that I ate( chile relleno and burrito ) that I had eaten. I would rather dine at Taco Bell than this crap that they served. I will NEVER go back !!!!

We love trying new restaurants in Nashville and Americano ranks at the top of our list! Our server was knowledgeable, personable and attentive. Cocktails were wonderful, especially the swirled margarita. We had the tuna guacamole, crispy brussels sprouts and americano paella. Each dish was unique, fresh and flavorful. From the outside on busy West End, you would never guess that this place is a hidden gem!
Excellent service, our waiter went over the menu and we ended up building our our own burgers. Definitely One of the best burger joints I've been to

As you wait in line outside the restaurant smelling the aroma of a nearby gutter you wonder if the restaurant smells better. 

It does. The restaurant is crowded and tables are far too close but that all goes with the general atmosphere. Service is decent and food quality and quantity was average too. 

You will not return from this place thinking that you have had the best oysters of your life but you wont feel cheated either.
I'm pretty picky and usually get a plain turkey sandwich but for some reason I went for what they are know for and man that was one tasty sandwich

Omg I do not understand the level of passive aggressiveness in this place. I stopped in to get three bagels. The woman cut me off after the second one then had someone else get my last bagel. I just said I wanted two toasted and one not toasted. Because she just cut me off and told someone else to help me, she missed that part then just openly talked about me in the most passive aggressive way. Like first off, I'm right here. Second off, just ask if you aren't sure and don't cut me off. There's a ton of bagel places around here and I don't need that kind of attitude.

I've had Roma's before and it has always been a wonderfully experience but today, has made me NEVER want to order from Roma's EVER again.  I placed an order that came to $44+, the quality of the food was less than what you would serve to a dog.  First, the delivery guy that brought the food was yelling at the security to the company that I work for to the point that I almost did not get my food. Second, I called the location that I called to place the order and the first call went unanswered, called a second time and was answered with a, "yeah?"  I thought that I had the wrong number at first but I didn't. The person on the other end of the line tried telling me that I had hung on him, had to let him know that must have been another customer that he was rude to and that I had gotten my food and that it was horrible.  There was little to no meat on either of the 2 subs that I ordered, no meat in chef salad and the Chicken Alfredo was so dry that it could not even be eaten.  He tells me to call back in 30 minutes.  I call back to then be told that he wasn't there and that he wouldn't be in until 10am on Monday. Third, what little I did eat of my sub, 4 bites, rest is in the trash, my stomach feels like it is full of acid from all of the vinegar that I was poured on the 5 pieces of lettuce on the thing. 

Absolutely the WORST that I have ever had.  I am NEVER going to order from there again!

The tidy boxes of buttons on the wall drew me into the Fabric Outlet on an otherwise frustrating day trying to find the right apparel fabric on fabric row. I bought some appropriate fabric there for an great price (honestly it cost half of what I'd seen elsewhere), and got some very unusual buttons.

I'm just learning how to make garments and choose the right fabric, and I must have gone into ten other stores on fabric row but they just didn't have the right selection of apparel fabrics (either very costumey with lots of sequins or completely lacking in non-upholstery non-quilting fabrics). Many of the other stores also smelled strange (musty urine scent), and were very hard to navigate with unrolling bolts stacked to the ceilings. By the time I got to Fabric Outlet, I was really overwhelmed and discouraged, but the gentleman at Fabric Outlet was very patient and I found all of the items I needed for my skirt class at Spool (even thread and invisible zipper). It was well-organized and had both a great variety of machine-washable apparel fabrics and some really beautiful quilting fabrics (I bought a Virginia Quilting Museum quilting cotton that I'm so excited to use later!). The selection is not huge, and I get the impression that it rotates frequently (it IS an outlet), but it was such a calm and easy to use change from the other jam-packed stores on Fabric row that I would definitely recommend it.
The Colorado burritos solidified my faith in all things Mexican Food Factory. Nice little outdoor spot to take in some northbounders in Midtown. Salsa esta muy bueno!

This place is as authentic as it gets. I love coming in and chatting with the owners. Really super people , very down to earth, and they really know their stuff. Also they ship, so if you live out of state you can still get your goodies. If I lived closer, I would be in there all the time. If anything , just to pick the owners brains for info. They do a lot of candles and oils, my two favorite ways to get my voodoo on.

The renovated restaurant is simple and nice. The location is super convenient (on Lindbergh a bit south of Watson). Service is prompt and courteous. However, their rolls are just average to me. I still prefer other sushi restaurants over this one.

Good and Bad experience this morning: 

Good:
I go this Wawa frequently due to the convenience of location. Usually I go in for a quick cup of coffee because it is the best, and always fresh! (guess it is hard to mess that up). Customer service at the counter is ALWAYS great! 
Bad: Today I ordered a scrambled egg/sausage burrito with avocado, (which i have ordered from other locations with no issue) and I am extremely disappointed with how it was prepared. The wrap was simply a mess. Initially I thought "ok they were in a rush...ill eat it with a fork and knife when I get to work" , but after opening it and noticing that it was a WET sloppy mess, with more salsa then eggs and NO AVOCADO, i couldn't even eat it.

I am a huge fan of Wawa, specifically this Wawa, because of the customer service, but I will not be ordering from their deli anytime soon. 

I hope this review is read, and the message gets out to the employees that are prepping food to SLOW DOWN, and make the food like they would be the one that has to eat it, like the other Wawa locations do.

Thanks,
Christina

Every once in a while I look to try something new so in my travels I noticed that there was a long line at this restaurant and that usually means there is good food so I went inside.  The 1st thing I noticed was how vast the menu is and it not only included traditional Jamaican dishes like Curry goat but they also had non traditional dishes such as cow foot and cow skin... I ended up ordering the curry goat and it was delicious even if you have never had it before the flavor made it something that everyone can like.

You wouldn't expect such a fresh, well made grouper sandwich from the looks of the place.  It has a very fast food feeling but serves very fresh fish and fries. (The kind where they actually cut up potatoes, not frozen bagged kind)
The three of us had the grouper three different ways: fried, grilled and Cajun.  All terrific,
Nice guys too.

Hidden gem.  We inquired about the exquisitely photographed fried chicken and were told it was just a special, then were prepared a Cornish hen fried the same way and served with beignets covered with condensed milk and powdered sugar - "Chinese chicken and waffles" - insane.  Insane.  Throw this on the menu (the beignets already are, protip) and I will come once a week.  Hopefully the chef can bust out creatively and make this place truly special.
Wingstop is good.. But the employees need good management .. They have a bunch of teenagers working there and they are always acting immature and playing around , they need better management

Best Burger in St Pete and probably the entire Tampa Bay Area. The Srirracha Wings had just the right amount of heat to go with that perfect tangy taste. Wings were cooked perfectly, great crust and moist chicken within. The Blue Cheese dressing is very light and not overpowering. The Seaweed added another nice touch. 

I went for the Demi God served on a bed of lettuce.  Burger was a perfect medium rare (very moist, slightly red, not bleeding on plate). The toppings were very well done, making it one awesome burger. 

Wife went for Corn Dog and Tater Tots, both were huge. Not your typical little pup on a tiny stick combined with a plateful of hot, crispy tater tots. Dog served with several sauces for dipping - did not matter, the dog was fantastic all by itself. 

My one complaint - that we have not found this place sooner. Sure won't be long before we're back though. Too many great items on the menu we must try.

It started out by me calling them to find out what sauces they had for the wings because my girlfriend was ordering some for us on Uber Eats. I asked the gentleman how the sauces range on the hotness scale from mild-hot. He was very knowledgeable about the menu and answered all of my questions. His customer service skills were unimaginably good. He offered a sample of sauces to be put in my order and he definitely delivered. I had the smokin' wings (second to last on the hotness scale of their wings) and dipped them in the included sample of the double dog and the double dog dare sauces. I am not lying when I say that I got emotional by tasting these wings. I have never EVER cried because of good food;(I've gotten close before) UNTIL I HAD THESE WINGS. I will definitely be back WITH FRIENDS and by myself. The co-general manager (I cant remember his name), is an amazing human being and I thank him for allowing me to experience the borderline orgasmic euphoria that is those sauces with those wings.

Some of the best soft serve I've ever had!  The small is a big portion! And they have unique flavors.  They had a graham cracker & cereal milk flavor that was or of this world! If I lived in close proximity of this place, I'd be here three times a week!
Reno Tahoe Audi is an excellent dealership great customer service from sales and service dept. I highly recommend this dealership.

My last pizza was burned. It had brown spots all over then when I called because it was gross they guy said it has to be like that with triple cheese. The time before that they came without my sauces. These people are lazy rude and are not detail oriented.

Came here for dinner while on a girls trip to Nashville. The wait was over an hour which we didn't mind too much because there are a few cute little boutiques there that we enjoyed checking out. When we were seated, the waitress told us that the drink special was a watermelon margarita. I ordered that and was pleasantly surprised. It had a great flavor and they did not skimp on the tequila! I didn't like that they don't serve complimentary salsa and chips so we had to order some for the table. It was just okay in my opinion. For dinner they have a long list of different tacos to choose from as well as other entrees. I was super excited to try out some of the tacos. I ordered the Korean taco and the taco royale. I enjoyed the Korean taco the most. Great flavors. The taco royale lacked flavor. They need some sort of extra sauce or something to go along with it. I got the sweet potato fries as my side and they were salted too heavily for my taste. We didn't like the fact that our waitress never came back to fill up our waters or ask if we would like another margarita which I would have definitely orders another. All and all I would say it's worth a try. I wouldn't mind returning one day to try more of their many taco selections.

Olive Garden has always been our to go spot for birthdays, celebration and special occasions. It was our favorite spot because of the fast service, and food while waiting for our entree. We are very disappointed with the Brandon,FL location which is the closest one to our home. This is the third time we give a try and once again here for my bday and the service is so bad waiting for more than 30 just for the bread stick is unacceptable. The manager toon the time talking to us the last time that why we are and leaving again disappointed. Not coming back here

Service was prompt, the vet and nurse were attentive and courteous I can't remember the spelling of the vet's name but I'm almost positive she assisted last October when we put our Onyx to sleep after 18 years. And she sent a lovely sympathy card a few days after. I haven't noticed any change with Smokey yet to remark on the meds.

Uhh, other than the fact that he yelled at me for wanting to take a picture of his quaint shop from the inside, went outside and stuck a GOOEY sticker on my son's most cool Acura windshield without really asking ( gooey crap everywhere)  baked in the Florida sun, left a big chunk of my widows peak stickin out in front , it was fabulous !!! Worth every penny of the $4.95 and 100% tip.Oh the reason he did not want pictures taken? who knows because here is what HE posted  https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=G_mNhKfgEWk

I would say this is the best breakfast in the area(right up there with Frog Pond.) it's always busy in the mornings but they never have you wait for too long. Food is delicious and always a step up from other places. The outdoor seating is very relaxing and quaint. Service here is always great too.

The marinated beef tip melt is my favorite in town. The combination of pesto sourdough and pepper jack is fantastic. The highland grog is my go to coffee. I'm looking forward to trying the late night cafe menu.

Trevor 
We took a tour today with Trevor as out guide, he was awesome ! 
Half way through the rain began , Trevor kept us all dry and gave us a verbal final half .
Great job Trevor !
Would definitely recommend. ..

I called Edward Powell Pump and Well because my water softener had stopped working. The problem was a tiny plastic nut that had broken. This part probably cost them ten cents, literally, but the breakdown of charges was this: $30 (!!!!!) for the tiny plastic nut, plus $120 labor, plus $9 tax. Total: $159.00. Are you kidding me???? That a ridiculous overcharge, in my opinion. Oh, and they tried to sell me more ph solution, which I won't need for over a year. I should have called the plumber; he would have charged under $100. I feel ripped off, but that's just my opinion; what do you think? I think I won't call them again.

I tried to order on the app and it wasn't working so we went inside and someone tried to get it to work but couldn't. I tried to order inside but was told I can't order what I wanted from the app only through the app. But he knew the app wasn't working so we ordered something different. We waited at least 20 minutes for our food. Not happy at all

Had an issue with a leaking toilet, found this company on Yelp over the weekend and requested an estimate. They were quick with replies and we were able to schedule a time Monday morning for them to come and complete the repair! Hyram arrived and it took him less than one hour to complete. He was kind and friendly and I would definitely recommend them to my friends and family!

Very poor service in the bar area on a Saturday lunch.  Two very young servers, probably just age 20 or below, maybe some college if that just home for the summer. You seat yourself, wait forever for a menu and a glass of water.  No bartender at lunch, so these two make the drinks and are back and forth from bar to the outdoor patio with tons of drinks for middle aged to elderly golfers who love alcohol in 90 degree heat out in the sun.  Great combo, huh?  My turkey club was finally delivered with no place setting, silverware, napkin.  I walked up to their stock area and got it myself.  After requesting a second iced tea, the young whipper snapper refilled it and just left it on the bar as he went and did something else. I ended up grabbing it myself as it sat on the bar for 10 minutes.  When they run your credit card, they make you sign their cell phone electronically.  No paper, no pen.  Weird is the understatement on that note. When I left, no thank you, other than " Have a good one "

I'd say management is as half-ass as the staff, at least in the food & bev dept. *Service sucks

Loveless was such a fun experience! We went on a Friday, so it was not busy at all. There was a small wait, but the shops and grounds made the wait go fast. Walking around was quite enjoyable. There were plenty of vegetarian options. The pimento green tomato biscuit was the best. I ordered the cheese omelet as well, which was not great. I rectified that by making my own biscuit sandwiches with the endless biscuits we kept getting. The biscuits and jams alone I would give it a 5 star! My fiancée loved the bbq - he said to pass on the ham. My only regret is not going back while we were in town.

Wow! Surprisingly good. The extra large is as close as you'll get to New York style pizza around here. Great sauce and good balance of ingredients. At &17.50 for an X-Large...maybe not the biggest bargain in town,...but likely the best pizza joint in the area!

I've ordered from here twice and both times I was dissapointed.The delivery was slow, waited over an hour for my food, and the food was not great. Tasted like I was eating leftovers. Don't order the chicken wings they looked weird like they came from a pre-mature chicken. I won't order from here again.

I normally go to the Sierra Rose location even though its always been across town for me, but the location is much cleaner than other Lap Corp locations (ie: Mill location). 

I figured I'd try this one out, since its a lot closer to work, I know I have been here before, back probably between 2010 and 2011, at that time it was down a hallway next to the rock climbing place, and I remember having to wait out in the hall. When I asked the front desk lady this visit, how long they'd been in this office she said 12 years... so maybe it was all a dream? 

Regardless, this visit looked promising initially compared to my last (maybe not) visit a few years ago. Big wall of windows, so it is bright at least and a big open space with the chairs. The walls and half wall are just plain dirty, it feels dirty when you walk in. The front desk lady never smiled, and wasn't friendly. I'm spoiled because there is normally one person at the Sierra Rose location who remembers me, plus the techs are generally super nice and good at their job (not that I'm a hard stick). 

I noticed before I went into the back the tech kept remarking to the patients "Did you drink water today?"... and I just wonder if she was having a hard time with them. When I went in, she said "Oh you have nice veins, thanks, makes my job easier." I don't know, I'm sure I'm biased from the atmosphere of the place, but I just wasn't too confident in this office staff's abilities. 

I'm not ruling it out, because of the proximity to my work, and how often I need labwork... and I'm only here for 20-40 minutes, but I will probably stick to Sierra Rose in the future if I can.

We walked up to the hostess stand, no one there.
After about 5 minutes a waiter came to the stand and got a couple of menus .
Asked if we had been helped,we said no and he said she should only be a minute. We waited another few minutes..at that point we decided if a restaurant can't handle having a hostess to greet you, then they dot deserve our business.  By the way there were only two of us and we could see two tables for two clean and ready for customers.

Gave this two stars only because we did not eat there and if the food is good we didn't want to rate it too low.

Too many other options...we went to The Gumbo Shop! Check out our review there.

Great little gem hidden away. Food was  good. Tried the Italian sausage sandwich, Stromboli, and the roast pork sandwich. Italian sausage was really good...until I ate the roast pork...Oh man!!  Now that is a sandwich!  The Stromboli was very flavorful as you would expect, but exceptionally salty. Glad I only tried a few bites, no way I could have eaten a whole sandwich. Service was great, atmosphere was great. Would definitely recommend it to a friend.

Lamb shank with Greek salad is my fav! 
The lamb melts off the bone, the red sauce is cooked in is very light and flavorful. 
The baklava is not the greatest. Is A little "too moist" with watered down honey.

The food was so good in this little restaurant. Don was our waiter and had us laughing so much. The price was very fair for the amount of food, atmosphere and laughs that came with it. I can't wait to go again!

We came here on a Saturday night the kitchen was near to closing. We were quickly seated at a table...but the table was dirty, I cleaned it off before sitting down.

The reason we wanted to come here was because we had read that there are many vegan options. When I looked at the menu I found several vegan sections, this is definitely a to go spot if you are vegan!

I ended up ordering a bowl of vegan veggie soup, I found the bowl to be on the smaller side. I also ordered Thai iced tea, but I had no idea there would be dairy in my tea, our server didnt explain that and neither did the menu. Ive ordered Thai iced tea at my to go spot in IL and Ive never been served a tea like this one. I didnt feel like complain so I drank it.

The rest of my party enjoyed their food, there was so much variety from fish, to rice, nooodles, curry. The servings were generous we had some leftovers. If I ever visited NOLA again Id try something else off the vegan menu.

Honestly, I almost didn't come here after reading the reviews.... However, I love magic, I really wanted to spend my anniversary here, and I was truly pleasantly surprised. Wonderful ambiance, delicious food, and great entertainment. I'm so glad that I came to try it for myself. We were celebrating our anniversary and everyone made us feel really special, our server even brought us a complimentary glass of champagne. I wish I could post pictures, but they were not allowed. It's a great night out. Be prepared to spend about $100 a person, but it's worth every cent. 

Certain things about the dress code project a business that's racist, sexist, and anti lgbt. However, we didn't have any issues and found the staff from the hosts to the servers to be quite wonderful, accommodating, and welcoming.

2018 - DO NOT STAY HERE 

Never again will I be okay with my husband using Hotwire to book a 2.5 star room in Franklin/Cool Springs.

I mean where to begin?
We have just arrived and the room smells like cigarettes and dogs and feels like a wet mildewy humid box.

As I mentioned in my tip DO NOT STAY HERE and I'm praying we don't leave with bed bugs or lice.

It's literally terrifying. 

Filthy:

- bed duvet 
- desk
- night stands

- wall plugs

... actually what isn't filthy? 

It's very obvious they do not clean these rooms, I pray they do clean the sheets.

There are a few guys sitting outside being incredibly loud drinking and smoking right outside our window with the smoke blowing into our running AC vent. Never again.

Best dental experience ever! I was really nervous for my first root canal and have had bad experience with dentists in the past. But they reassumed me by letting me know what to expect. Even the numbing process was painless and so was the rest of the process. I was very impressed!
So much fun! All the food and beer were great. For dessert we had the apple strudel and it was amazing. Loved the atmosphere.
