We got takeout from here in September while staying nearby at The Gables Bed and Breakfast, which the restauranteur also runs. The food was fast and delicious, the owner is warm and accommodating, and the prices were a great deal given how ample and good the food was. Safe indoor dining is available too if you want to dodge the heat.

The nearby Gables Bed and Breakfast is a great place to stay to boot. If you stay there, you're just a 10-minute walk from this restaurant.

Just finished a wonderful Thanksgiving dinner of six at Rapscallion. Thank you to the staff and all for a lovely time and great food. Quick and attentive service, everyone was friendly and just a relaxing dinner. Thanks for working so our group could enjoy a nice time.  

I recommend Rapscallion anytime of the year.

Second time at Tom's and the dishes I've been choosing continue to miss the mark. The Chong Qing Chicken had perfectly crispy fried pieces of chicken but I've never seen it done with sauteed onions and an awful lot of them. This is in addition to the spring onions which are supposed to be there so I fished all the others out. The real crime here was the lack of heat and garlic and that was sorely missed.

I also had the Pan Fried Pork Dumplings and there was just way too much dough and not enough filling. Very disappointing.

I can't imagine how anyone could ever give this store anything other than a 5 star rating! This chain of stores is the best thing since sliced bread. Although they generally have their own brands of comparable brand names, their items are just as good, if not better than brand names and far more reasonable. The shelves are always fully stocked and clean. The parking lot and outside of the store is always clean and well lit. By using the quarter system, you're ensured to not get any dings in your car from carts left all over the place. The bag system, meaning bring and bag your own, is yet another way we as a people can go green and help our environment and world. The cashiers are exceptionally fast as they're allowed to be comfortable by sitting down while scanning items rather than the constant pick item up, find bar code, scan, turn, bag and back to the front belt again. It's a very unique and thorough system. Honestly the only con is that they don't take coupons but who cares because the items are so cheap already! So, do the earth a favor, take a quarter and some bags and happy shopping!!

Despite living across the street from this restaurant for well over 4 years - I had never been there.  Much less even really acknowledged its existence.  

ILast night a friend and neighbor was having a welcome home party for his dog - since he had been missing for 9 days.  Well, a 2 hour party turned into a 5 hour party - finished off by a short drive across the street to La Terraza for some food and more drinking.  Even though I was aware of it being there - I still had never been.  Instead opting to go to El Sombrero just down the street at Lenox Village.

Seating at 7pm on a Sunday night was very easy and they happily accommodated our group of 6 people.  We weren't seated very long before the server came over and got our drink orders and delivered them very quickly to our table along with copious amounts of chips and salsa which, by the way, was very nice and flavorful.  I can see where some people may not like the salsa because it isn't super chunky - its a pretty smooth salsa.  But I like that personally.  I pitcher of margaritas we were served was very, very good.  

A friend of mine talked to another table of people who were drinking something out of these huge glasses and he asked them what they were drinking.  They said it was beer with clamato juice - they described it as a beer based bloody mary.  Several of the members of my table tried and described it as being very good...but I don't like bloody mary's OR beer - so I doubt I'd enjoy it.  But it was interesting to look at none-the-less.

For dinner - I had the Chimichanga with re-fried beans and rice.  It was VERY good.  The crust for the chimi was light but held together well.  The melted queso blanco they pour over top was very good as well.  The re-fried beans were a little runny - but the rice was very good.  More than anything - everything tasted fresh - which was great.  You could really taste all the ingredients.

All in all - it was a good place for a good meal.  The restaurant was clean.  The service was friendly and efficient.  It was a fun atmosphere for sure.  Its a new restaurant (for me) close to my house that I won't hesitate to visit again in the future - if not for the food - for the margaritas for sure!

Very impressed with the service and food. I've never eaten here before and was being a bit curious. My family comes from Austrian, Polish and East Euro heritage, so I thought I would fall in line and try it. I ordered the smoked Kilbasa and Cabbage Roll. Both were tasty, unique and filling. The portions were not over the top and the floors were suttle not American-style over the top rich. The food did not seem of cheap quality and truly unique in taste. As a matter of fact I would say this place is superior if you like high quality, decent priced and unique international food!

Keith's is a very casual atmosphere with polite staff and service on most occasions has been good.  There have been some visits where we have not had the most attentive waitress but nothing that would turn me off not to visit again.  There is plenty of parking and the price is average.  I only wish they had a better designated spot to wait and a seperate smoking area outside,  luckily we have never had a very long wait time to be seated.  Keith's offers a variety of foods for each course.  They have cheese fries to calamari, burgers to steaks and seafood platters and deserts.  There are drink specials (mostly on beer) throughout the week as well.  For me personally, Keiths is a place I look to go to when i don't feel like getting dressed up - don't feel like putting make up on - burger and fries kind of night.  I wouldn't recommend any of the seafood unless you're dying for some fried mediocre mystery fish.  Our last visit one of our party ordered the grouper sandwich and it was questionable if it was really grouper.  It didnt taste bad but more along the line of what you'd get from a fast food joint.  The burgers and chicken sandwiches have always been very good, cooked to order and filling.  I ordered the patty melt with fries this visit which was very delicious and generous size.  If you are looking for a VERY casual night out and want something a step up than a fast food joint this is the place you're looking for.

I love Ciccios. My family and I come here all the time. The food is always great and served quickly. Tonight, I went with my family again and had Gabi as our server. Gabi was the best server I've ever had and I'm going to make sure I ask for her during my next visits and so should you!We LOVED her.
Love it...although it seems the prices have continued to rise....its still a cool place to pick up some awesome tamale's and taco's!

Extremely rude staff and the owner herself is not much better.

I went in with my husband as we are interested in re-flooring our kitchen and was treated horrible.

The owner, Kris, must have been having a bad day but she really needs to learn to not treat her customers so poorly or she'll no longer have any.

They will never get a penny from any of my family or friends.

This place is on point conceptually. It's a light hearted burger joint that serves classics, new twists, and milkshakes with liquor in them. I heard that the service was shaky, but the bartender was awesome to us. 

I will definitely be back, even though I don't head out to NoLibs often. It's worth it for the onion rings alone.

Don't understand the hype for this place. I almost wonder if people feel like they /have/ to say they like this pizza because of the hype and scarcity? I've tried both the Detroit and NYC style pies and both were just "meh" to me. Certainly not worth having to reserve it a week in advance. 

The sauce on the Detroit tastes way sweeter than it should, and the price is...out of hand. I've had Detroit-style pizza in actual Detroit and you get twice as much pizza for the price. In Philadelphia, Circles + Squares blows this Detroit out of the water (and the taste is actually worth the advance order system). 

The NYC pizza was so, so dense. If you like an absolutely massive amount of cheese on your slice, you'd probably be ok, but it's not for me. The closest local comparison I can think to make is Roma's. It also had a really chewy crust (the flavor was actually pretty good) that wasn't sturdy enough to support all the cheese. It's like...if we weren't in the middle of a large city with a million other options, the NYC style would be fine. But good enough to make it worth reserving in advance and choosing it over all of the other great options around? Nah.
Today, I walked into Fellini's around 4:00 pm for dinner was ignored by chef who was visible.  I saw many dirty unkept tables and said goodbye walking out the door.

Went to Toscana 52 last night with our family (4 people) and was very pleasantly impressed with everything- the building, the food, the service.  I think that some of the previous posted reviewers had visited before the official opening and it was unfair to judge a new place at that point.  We did not have any service issues at all, and in fact, had an extremely pleasant, knowledgeable, and attentive waitress.  The place is very nicely designed inside and out, with the only downside being it is on a busy street with the turnpike in view.  (Put it in a beautiful setting in Tuscany and it would be better!)
As for the food, we did try the crab cheese appetizer (split it for two) and liked it- but half was enough for us as a starter.  This week was Pisa week- and two of us had specials from that selection: a risotto with lobster and saffron, and an asagio gnocchi.  Both were excellent.  The "regular" menu seemed extensive enough for just about anyone to be satisfied.  One of us had skewered grilled shrimp with one of the choices of sauces- tomato pesto- and loved it.  It came with a risotto cake, which was Delicious.  The wine selection by the glass was vast, and they even offer various champagnes by the glass.  One day late for Cinco di Mayo, but we still tried a frozen Margarita which was just right.  
The deserts were homemade, different than usual, and delicious. Two of us had a creme brulee pie-  and really enjoyed this. The chocolate mousse with raspberries was a hit.  Cappuccino was well made the way I like it- hot, frothy, strong.
All in all, we will be going back soon.

The ambience is great! The restaurant is super cute & great for photos! The hibiscus margarita was really good! I was with a group of 5 & we waited all of 2 minutes until we were seated...pretty good! One of my friends & I both ordered the shrimp & crab enchiladas & after trying them was disappointed! I am use to my enchiladas being messy & there was no sauce or much flavor to these. My friend actually found crab shells in hers as she was eating which made me stop eating mine. They also bought out our rice & roasted veggies family style (on a big plate for everyone to share from). We had a party next to us with the same amount of people & everyone received their sides individually so we thought this was weird. It was a very weird selection of veggies & the rice had no seasoning. The waiter messed up the checks & the bartender was rude when I asked for change to tip valet! All in all, I will give them another try because I loved the hibiscus margarita! Lol

Daniel is the absolute best! He's an amazing and meticulous stylist, but more importantly he's a truly wonderful human being! My eleven year old son loves him and wouldn't dream of trusting anyone else with his hair.

Tried this place out for the first time tonight with a friend that had been there once. Mondo was our server and he was awesome (even if he does like star wars).  He was very funny and friendly, and gave us the run down of how the menu works. 
We tried the chicken wings in lemon pepper and cajun style. they were very flavorful. My husband had the shrimp in the Stupid sauce, and he liked it a lot. we also tried the shrimp in the mild cajun flavor. we got both louisianna style with the corn, potatoes and sausage. everything was bomb! 
we are definitely looking forward to going back and trying other things on the menu! The manager came by our table and asked how everything was which was nice, our drinks were refilled plenty of times without having to ask. Really great customer service, best we've had in a while! 
PS don't wear anything you don't mind possibly getting dirty! :) Hope this place stays around for a long time to come!

Very unimpressed with my recent service. Paid $600 for a recommended tune up. Problem not resolved.  Without my permission they did more repairs to actually fix the original problem. Will not to return here.
Best Indian food I've had in Santa Barbara and their lunch special is great. 13 bucks for all you can eat heaven

Generous portions, affordable prices, genuine tastes. It's not a fast-food joint, yet you order at the cashier, which deters the hassle of asking for itemized checks if you're in a group and one person only has plastic. The sundry menu lists all sorts of items without compromising authenticity with originality.

I've eaten here a handful of times, and it's nice if you're craving cheap Japanese food. The portions are quite large, and the lunch specials are a particularly good value. The bento lunch is $8-$10, and comes with a salad and miso/clear soup. I've gotten the grilled salmon bento (pictured) and chicken teriyaki, and both were fine. I've also gotten the Hana special lunch ($14), which is a LOT of food (shrimp tempura, chicken katsu, shumai, and sushi/sashimi). Unfortunately, I found the sushi to be subpar (fish isn't fresh and quite bland in taste), but the chicken katsu is pretty good, particularly if you get it fresh in the restaurant. The tempura is ok too, but all you can taste is the batter because it's so thick.

TLDR; it's cheap Japanese food that can be split over several meals but don't expect high quality.

I really want to like this place, especially since I live right around the corner and love steak.  I think it needs more time, because it has potential.   I spent $100, which I'm willing to do for a great meal - but my overall feedback is everything served to me was very plain.   Filet and fries came out and there was nothing special to it, just plain.  I think I was expecting flavorful food because this is an argentine steakhouse.   Maybe my expectations were high and that altered my thoughts overall.   There wasn't really anyone there, so the two people working were all over us trying to take our plates away :-)  I will go back and have wine at the bar, but will not spend that kind of money on a meal there until some improvements are made.

I've been going here for years & my nails always look amazing. All the technicians are talented but I consider Tweet a friend too. I've gone in multiple times with pictures of what I want & she does it. Check out my Lisa Frank inspired Halloween nails!

I love this restaurant! I am always coming here at least once or twice in the month! They have such great variety of food. The service is really great! Compared to other indian restaurants, the pricing is also very reasonable. They actually genuinely care for their customers and want each individual to have a great experience. Ashu, the owner, always goes the extra mile! I highly recommend this place as there is no other indian restaurant in my opinion that has great indian food at reasonable prices and executes customer service the way they do!!! I also recommend the butter chicken (chicken makhani) , Chilli chicken, Chilli paneer, Matar paneer, regular tandoori naan, chicken tikka masala, garlic naan, the goat curry, papdi chaat as these are my favorites!

Stopped for dinner on my way home from work. Two male servers, too busy flirting with the young bus-girls to take my order. The cook was obnoxiously loud and you could hear him clearly as the kitchen is open to the diner. I had an unremarkable straight from the freezer burger. With the cool hipster vibe, I would have expected the beef to be fresh. Fries were inedible - soggy, lukewarm, and dripping with grease. When I paid the bill and told the kid at the register, he didn't even apologize. Doubt I'll be back.

I was visiting customers in  Brandon, Florida when I saw a banner for a BBQ restaurant I've never heard of. So I made a quick turn and went in. First impression ... Clean floors nice kitchen and a heavenly smell of hot BBQ. 
I ordered at the counter: Burnt ends, fried Okra and Mac n Cheese. 

The meat was excellent, the fried okra was just as good as my grandma made when I was a kid.
The sauces are on the table, and all 3 that I tried were great. I mixed the sweet n hot with a little mustard based...yum!
The people that work there really take pride in keeping a nice clean place. I'll be back!

We were staying at the hotel and had dinner here. The kids buffet was great for them and they enjoyed the selection of items. The New York Strip and corn entrée that both my wife and I had was very good. The steaks were cooked to a perfect mid-rare and the sauce was a perfect compliment to the steak. Though we are used to eating spicy food the corn's aioli had a good lick to it. The only down side to our visit was the only adequate service, it took a little too long for refills on our drinks. Overall, a pleasant experience.
Yummy rolls, creamy lobster. Pair that with Dizengoff and the beds at the Sofitel- bam, heaven.
The worst ever! Unprofessional, very unorganized. I suggest not using this location! Definitely go to another pharmacy..

Very good authentic Mexican food... Service could have been alittle better but the place was very busy on a late dat afternoon and the quality of the food made that a non factor..Very comfortable room with a roaring fireplace...Guacamole was a definite top 10 for the area...

They took over the golds gym that has been here for a while, and made pretty good use of it too. At first I was devastated they took away all the golds equipment but the newer equipment they replaced it with isn't so bad. 

The top floor is filled with cardio machines. Two stair masters!! That's enough to get me pumped, obviously. I wish there were more bikes, but the few will do for now. The lower floor is filled with machines on one side, free weights in front of the mirrors, and a room for classes. The cybex pulley systems are a major upgrade from other youfit locations. I wish there was more room to move around the benches but I'm always able to find space somewhere without people running into me. There are 2 free squat racks! I usually have to fight people at nearby locations for a rack, but it's less hostile here. 

The locker/bathroom is clean, plenty of showers, and plenty of stalls. I've never had a problem with a free locker, or it stinking. This location is easily my favorite of all youfits.
Delicious food, and great fresh juice! My son loves their pancakes, and the plates are generally rather filling. There are options for just about any taste.
Really some of the best fried calamari, fries...and gazpacho I've had in a long time. And GF on the batter (tho not the fryer.) friendly. Fast. Good job!

I had a ball! Better then I expected, Robyn & Joe were wonderful. Sangria was awesome! We made Mozzarella (pizza) and Ricotta (fritters). Our surprise desert was berry cobbler and was it delicious.  Great date night.. can't wait to do it again.

4.5 stars is probably more accurate.

Great games. Solid drink selection. Nice atmosphere. Great location. I'm not entirely sure what is lacking, but it's not quite magical enough for 5 stars... close.
First stop for us every year we come down! Fabulous, local, friendly feels at this place. Love their seafood bisque, shrimp and grouper. Also very awesome smoked fish spread.

Classic Philly brunch. Expect a wait, but you can call ahead to put your name on the list and you just have to show up to check in 5-10 minutes early. It's great because we live down the street and just call when we're almost ready to head over. 

All of their brunch food is great. They serve huge portions - I always take half my meal home. The specials menu is fun. I love their egg white omelettes.

In this time when restaurants are all closed we are trying to take out from our favorite local restaurants every few days. Called Opa with an order for curbside pickup. It was easy as when we got close we called and someone was out on the street with our order, she even crossed the street when we waved and gave it to us through the window. It was great, we had the horiatiki salad, a great combination of vegetables and fresh feta, then the spanakopita, four nice pieces of flaky crust with flavorful spinach, an order of the beef and lamb gyro and the moussaka. The gyro had a lot of meat and a large pita, coleslaw, fries, and tomatoes. The moussaka was a huge portion of their traditional dish, very good. Bottom line, support the restaurants you love at this time when they need our help, this one comes through every time whether eating in or taking out.

Walked around all day and needed a massage to finish off the day.  I was able to book a massage with Sharon with only two hours notice.  Sharon asked what my massage preferences were and made sure to regularly check on whether the technique and pressure were good.  I haven't had a great massage in a long time, and this one broke the bad streak!  If I lived in this city I would definitely visit Sharon on a regular basis.  Thanks Sharon!
Great locally owned coffee shop. Jeremy is great to talk to, so is the food and ambiance. Excellent place if you want to meet someone, read a book, or just get some work done.

Very dissatisfied. Bad customer service. I hate to leave a bad review during covid but I want other people to know what happened. The first time I got a powder manicure and pedicure for a wedding shower was 80 dollars. The second time was $125 dollars because the pedicure and actually powder service is separate...ridiculous. The man in charge didn't believe me when I said it was only 80 dollars when I first came for the same service. Another customer ironically complained in the bathroom about her service being $130 dollars too. I've been to super high end salons in downtown but this place is downright overpriced and not upfront about how much they are charging you.


Also I forgot to mention, my toes nails are completely destroyed because when I went in for a fill, the girl practically ripped off my toe nails because she didn't know what she was doing. My toes nails are chiclets now and will need time to regrow to look normal again...very bad service
My husband and I eat breakfast here at least once a month. We love the food, price, and staff. Friendly people all around, and good old fashioned breakfast food.

So me and my wife went to Bubba's for a lunch date. It was our first time there and decided to give it a try. Soon as we walkeed in we knew it would be a good place, hostess was very friendly, the atmosphere was just what we were looking for. More Tv's than seats and all sorts of sports, music, and Chive tv. They have a great selection of beers on tap, and quite a few combinations of cocktails. My wife and I decided to try appetizers so we could sample a little bit of everything without breaking the bank since they don't offer an appetizer sampler. We got 12 smoked wings, the shotgun shrimp, fried pickles, and Bubba's fiesta dip. I will review in order. 
1. The smoked wings were not smoked at all, absolutely no flavor of smoke anywhere. The raspberry sauce they put on was ok but not good. 
2. The shotgun shrimp was good with a little sweet and spicy, and cooked just right. 
3. The fried pickles were excellent, good crisp on the outside and juicy inside. 
4. The Fiesta dip was horrible! It says it was bacon ground beef and was worse than what I could make at home. The grease wasn't drained off at all, no seasoning, no bacon and was bland as hell. 
The wait staff and manager were great with customer service and even invited us back with a free app coupon. I have to say we won't be back due to my wife getting sick there at the restaurant and me getting sick later that evening. I don't know if it was just a bad lunch crew in the kitchen or what?

Don't forget to bring your ID!

Came on a crowded night for dinner. Seated by a somewhat nice waitress. She got some waters and asked for IDs. I took out the only ID I brought with me, a GOVERNMENT-issued passport card....and nope, she said it had to be a "real" passport or another ID like a driver's license. 

Her attitude really left a bad impression.... can't say anything about the food.

Last Friday evening, at 6:30pm Wife and I returned to this little French Restaurant after about a years absence.  We found the place about 3/4 empty and was about 7:00pm. Seemed a little strange as this restaurant seeming had great thing to claim.  But let me tell you, the service was marginal even with a partial crowd.  We sat inside which should have given us just a tad bit more of awareness by the staff.  Ordered our usual vodka tonic.  Funny we were never offered to have a second cocktail.  We did order our food but the waiter seems very unsure of what was being offered.  Mind you we have eaten here several times before so this was quite surprising.  Even to the point when we arrived (remember this place was near empty) asked if we had reservation.  After a long pause, this guy looked over the area and found us one of the smaller tables.  By the way, when we finished our dinner by 8:00pm, the place was about 1/2 occupied.  Ok, we got our bread and butter.  The bread was warm and the butter tasty.  Our order was delivered by what appeared to be the kitchen help.  What happened to our waiter?  Who knows!  We finished our dinner and suddenly the waiter reappeared and asked if we would like boxes since we did not finish the food.  We said yes and the he grabbed our plates and departed.  He came back withy the check but never offered desert!  What????  When he delivered the check he did it give us our boxed food.  When we questioned about the whereabouts of the food, he said he would bring it once we paid the bill!  What is this?  Kind of made me wonder if I didn't tip enough the food might be "compromised".  This was very uncomfortable!
Bottom line the food was good and the service was marginal this trip.  Yes, we will return but the management needs a wake up call and properly train the wait staff.

What a nice surprise! A friend bought me a gift certificate for this place and I chose to use it on a massage. I'm so glad I did! Victoria gave me the best massage I've ever had! She was so intuitive! I left feeling a million times better than when I went in. My husband gifts me with massage certificates fairly often and I told him that from now on please buy them at Shine. I can't wait to go back. Also they have a nice selection of products/gifts as well. I bought a couple of xmas gifts while I was there.
One of the best rooftops in downtown! Has a great view of the river, and has reasonably priced beer. Didn't have any of the food, but it looked amazing.

You know, I've been going to Diamond Eyecare for several years, and every time I go I think ... "Oh right, this is why I need to find someone else!" The front desk staff and the optical staff are amazing humans but Dr. Diamos is seriously terrible at making patients feel comfortable. I mean ... your job is to stick stuff in people's eyes, shouldn't you make them feel a little at ease? She numbed my eyes without really explaining why, and then got frustrated when I jumped at a pointy thing coming at my eye. (Doesn't everyone?) She literally held my head against the forehead brace to keep me from jumping. No more Clockwork Orange for me.

It said aquarium so I was thinking fish, tons and tons of exotic fish. As it turns out this is a rehab facility for injured marine life (dolphins, turtles, rays etc) and not an actual aquarium. Once the disappointment wore off I did enjoy walking around and learning about the different animals. Since it is a non profit I was more than happy to have visited. Hope the dolphin from Dolphin Tale lives here with a few others and if you have kids I would definitely recommend bringing them here.

You know you're in New Orleans when your gym has a bar. Not a punch line, just fact.  Moving beyond the outside poolside bar and cafe, this place rocks! Spinning room. 3-4 fitness classroom and 7 days of various fitness classes at various times, a cafe complete with food, smoothies and PJ's coffee, multiple indoor pools and outdoor pools, hot tubs, a cold dip, cardio floor, walk/run track, weight rooms, racquetball courts and a variety of services as well as  pro shop! Literally everything you could want in a gym! We love coming here and the people here are here to better themselves and not to strut around and grunt. Giving it a 4 star only because it's super pricey!

I've been going to this restaurant for a few years now and have even recommended it to friends of mine.  On 2/7/09 I made a reservation for a party of 3 for 8:00pm.  Our party arrived about 5 minutes before our reservation and were greeted by an overcrowded waiting area.  We tried to get somebody's attention to let them know we were here (a waiter, hostess anybody) but nobody even acknowledged our presence or anybody else waiting for that matter.  After about 15 minutes a table for 4 opened up which we thought would be ours, but a waiter arbitrarily gave that table to a party of 2 (who didn't even have reservations) without even asking us about our reservation.  I had to fight my way through the crowd to grab the attention of a waitress and told her we had 8:00 reservations, to which she replied she "didn't do the seating", and just went to the back.  We weren't seated until after 8:30.  
The food was decent, but I am hesitant to come back or recommend Punjab anymore based on their total lack of guest service and their lackadaisical attitude toward reservations.  They know how to take reservations, they don't know how to HOOOOLD reservations.  If they're going to ignore reservations they should not take them in the first place.

One of the best shops in town. We buy a lot of gifts here, there is a wide variety. Funny, eclectic, snarky, you name it. 

Great baby gift section, especially for Philly related gear. 

If you are in the area visit, buy gifts you don't need now, but have them ready when you do.  It is that good.

Going with 3.5 stars on this one. 

Pros:
-super fresh
-friendly service
-not overly greasy, and well seasoned burgers for a thin patty
-easily customizable, and the aioli on the Louie was delicious, and I enjoyed the cheese
-the fries were delicious (both kinds, though I preferred the regular ones)

Cons:
-odd bun to meat ratio. I was playing Goldilocks and thinking "are 2 patties too few? Would getting 3 be too much?" (I'd recommend going for 3, 2 was too bunny)
-seemed a little pricey to me. I understand that the ingredients are all fresh, but ouch. 

I'm glad I came and tried this place. Was it good? Absolutely. Do I feel like it lived up to the hype? Not really. If I'm in the area, I might stop in again, but likely for the fries and a beer.

Upscale steakhouse with a modern twist on classic foods, A solid good choice for any occasion. Steak was excellent, sides were above average, and the prices were high but justifiably so. 

Both our steaks were done just to our asking, great presentation, excellent taste. Side are not included and must be ordered seperately but the Mac and Cheese was a hit for me, miss for my date cause it was dressed up with bread crumbs and a stronger than average cheese. The cocktails and desserts were a strong finish to a great dinner.

This was definitely and high 4 stars, almost a 5 but not quite.

I've tried five guys a few times now and can't say anything bad about them. The endless choice of toppings makes for some very creative burgers and there isn't an additional fee to add them. The burgers can be a bit on the greasy side, but if your looking for a fast food burger I doubt grease is a primary concern.

It is beyond ludicrous that this theater shuts everything down 15 minutes after the last movie begins. Hope you don't want a soda, snack or food because the staff will be extremely rude to you should you ask. They seriously cannot afford to pay one employee to keep their concessions open? Doesn't somebody have to stay anyway and turn out the lights?!?

I work for a collision business and a customer's insurance suggested she use Hertz. I called to see about getting her a rental and they will not answer the phone. It continuously rings and eventually just stops ringing. I have tried a minimum of 5 times and no one continues to answer the phone. I can only hope that their phones are not working properly or their urgency to assist their customers is extremely poor.
The jerk wings, cabbage, rice and peas with plantains is the best I've had in St. Louis. Hole in the wall, but very good service every time I go.

My husband and I bought a Groupon for this place, then my mom ended up getting us 2 more as gifts.  I called one day to ask how we could go about using them, and the man who answered the phone acted extremely irritated that I was asking about it.  Then suddenly, in mid-sentence, he handed the phone over to the manager.  I couldn't get over how incredibly rude she was to me from the moment she got on the phone.  When I asked if we could make reservations for the following weekend to use our Groupons, she sounded very annoyed and said, "We're too busy to use Groupons, if you want to use a Groupon you can come in the middle of the week."  I asked her if that was a policy, because it isn't listed on the Groupon, and she said "I don't care, we're too busy to deal with that."  I called Groupon, who was VERY helpful and courteous, and had apparently received other calls from people trying to use their Shiraz Groupons.  I was able to get a full refund on our Groupon, and my mom was able to get refunds for the ones she got us as well.  I will NEVER give Shiraz my business, and I wouldn't recommend it to anyone.  I've talked to neighbors of ours who have also been treated poorly at Shiraz... I just don't see how they can stay in business with how they treat their customers.

Diner beware!!!!! The most horrible experience I have ever had in Nashville. We ordered dinner for 7 people. It took over 20 minutes just to get a glass of water. One of our group saw the owner playing on his phone downstairs and asked where are water was--then he brought it. Then as we waited for dinner for nearly an hour we decided that it just wasn't worth it. As we were about to leave the owner showed up with our food and told us to -quote- "take a chill pill." It was just plain disrespectful to patrons who were there to pay you for your service.  We told him we were going to leave and he threatened to call the police and have us arrested. We paid for dinner for 7 but didn't eat any of it. Two of our group ordered bottled beer at the bar and the bartender said she didn't have a bottle opener. So they had to pop the tops off on the brick. Get an air tire gauge for that bartender! Weird! Weird! Weird! Don't go even if it's the last restaurant in Nashville.

UPDATE (as promised):

Went to dinner on Saturday night (1/14) -- this time indoors. Right off the bat, it seemed we might have some problems. The hostess walked us into the dining room, then left us standing there while she went back to her reservation book to check where we were to be seated. Awkward.

Appetizers were great. I particularly enjoyed the Tzatziki dip that they serve with warm pita bread. My wife had the Tyropita, which is one of her favorite Petros appetizers.

Unfortunately, when ordering dinner, I was told that they had run out of my favorite dish, Kefthetes (a Greek meatball dish). I eventually settled on the Lamb Souvlaki, and my wife ordered the Feta Crusted Colorado Rack of Lamb. Dinner looked wonderful when it arrived. My wife's lamb was nearly perfect (she ordered it cooked medium, it arrived medium rare), and mine looked fantastic as well. However, my lamb was served nearly at room temperature. I ate a few pieces, but ended up sending it back to be reheated. They actually remade the whole new dish, which turned out exactly as I had hoped, and was quite delicious.

Dessert was hit and miss. They had a special homemade Tiramisu, that I frankly didn't care for. It was too heavy and sweet. The 5 Layer Chocolate Cake my wife ordered was very tasty though. We tried to order the Greek coffee, but it wasn't available that evening either. I ordered a shot of Ouzo, and my wife ordered a cappucino. These were supposed to arrive with our dessert, but we had to ask for them again when we were nearly done eating the cake. When the drinks did arrive, the shot glass with the Ouzo in it must have been slightly sticky, because when our server set it down, she ended up spilling it as she pulled her hand away.

Overall, the food we ate was a solid 4 or maybe even a 4.5. Service was a 3.5 this time around, which was a major improvement over our previous experience. Our desserts and my Ouzo were both comped...thanks!. Still a few kinks to work out, but certainly worth coming back for more.

* * * * * * * * * *

Original review, posted on 1/9 (rated 1 star):

WOW...this is the first review I've done on Yelp. In fact, it's the ONLY one I've ever felt was deserving of a review. Why? Since joining, I make a point of avoiding restaurants that are not rated 4 or 5 stars. If you're going to spend your hard-earned money dining out, you should get the best you can afford. In fact, If it weren't for Yelp, I would have never dined at the Petros location in Los Olivos.

I made reservations for Saturday evening (1/7) at the new Petros here in Santa Barbara, and requested a table on the patio. Being locals, my wife and I know that patio dining in Santa Barbara is perfectly pleasant during the winter -- provided there are heaters. We've dined at Petros in Los Olivos several times (thanks, Yelp!), and we just knew that the guests we had coming from San Francisco and New York would absolutely LOVE Petros. When I made our reservations, I requested a table next to a heater, since both my wife and daughter get chilled fairly easily. I WAS ASSURED THIS WOULD NOT BE A PROBLEM.

When we arrived at 6pm, it was already quite chilly, and there was a mild breeze. I knew however, that the breeze wouldn't be much of an issue on the patio, since it's enclosed. We checked in with the hostess, who immediately explained that they were having problems with their heaters. When I voiced my disappointment at the lack of heat, she politely offered one of the few remaining heaters just as soon as one of the other tables were finished with their dinner (BTW, none of those tables were even close to being done with their meals). In the meantime however, we'd have to freeze our asses off.

Needless to say, I felt humiliated in front of our guests, and disappointed that nothing was done to take better care of our party. All afternoon I had been talking about how great Petros was, and how much fun we would have. The staff at Petros knew that they had issues with the heaters, but made no effort to call people who had patio reservations (we could have booked a table someplace else). They refused to do anything else to resolve the situation, and even though several tables were still unoccupied indoors, we were told that they were fully booked. Oh, and that little incident cost us $5 for parking. However, luck was on our side -- we found an available table at a nearby Italian restaurant.

As regulars at several restaurants in Santa Barbara, I am obligated to say that this was NOT A GOOD FIRST IMPRESSION. I was really looking forward to having another great restaurant so close to our home, but in the end, I was utterly disappointed.

It should be noted that this experience, while extremely frustrating, isn't likely to prevent us from returning. Truly good Greek restaurants are just too far and few between. I'll be sure to update this review to reflect a more typical experience once I've had another opportunity to dine at Petros.

This is the first fast food I e been to during my stay here because it was recommended I try one out coming from Florida and lord this was not it. Not a few onions rings but a whole slab of onion. The bun was mushy, fries where soft and unsalted. Don't even get me started on the hot dog. Overcooked and I asked for mustard on it, I opened the box to see what looks like a dab of mustard spread into a super thin layer. Just overall bad taste. Really disappointed.

I didn't feel that this place lived up to the hype.  The food was good but not amazing.  We shared the pork belly buns (um, like ribs chopped and stuffed into plain bao) and peruvian ceviche (this was the highlight of the meal - perfectly fresh, creamy, and accented with sweet potato) for the appetizer course.  I got the parihuela, which I suppose is the Latin version of bouilliabaise (w/saffron,, of course).  It was decent but a tad on the bland side.  I sampled the smoked sirloin, which was better, with a delicious miso butter.  It was also generously sized.  The lychee sangria added a nice touch to the meal.  Overall, a decent experience but nothing spectacular.

Great place for authentic and delicious Japanese food! They have sushi, donburi, ramen and bento boxes.We ordered takoyaki, gyoza, a UA bear down roll, a shrimp tempura roll and a Las Vegas roll. The takoyaki had plenty of toppings but did not have bonito flakes, which wasn't bad for me since I'm indifferent towards the flavor. The rolls were of average price and size but they had a good balance between fish and rice and tasted AMAZING. While these are classic rolls that you can order at other sushi restaurants, there is something about the taste that sets them one level higher than the rest. Their tempura batter is so delicious and different from other tempura I've tried--there must be a magical secret ingredient! It did take a little longer than normal to get our food but in the end, it was worth the wait.

The wait staff was pleasant and our main waitress was particularly a delight. She made on-point recommendations for both the food and drinks (that mango soda drink was so good!!) and kept us smiling throughout the meal. She must have sensed we were first timers in the restaurant so she stopped by a few times to answer our questions and check on how we were doing. At the end, as we were walking out, she waved and said, "see you next time!" Yep, there definitely will be a next time!

Overall, Reno-Tahoe airport is very easy to use. Dropping off and picking up passengers is very easy and quick. No traffic jams - security keeps things moving, but it's not as intense as other larger airports.  Parking is easy and just across the walkway from the terminal.  The food concessions close early - I landed last night at 9pm on a Saturday night and all the food options were closed except for the restaurant on the main level. Restrooms are clean and baggage claim is usually fairly quick with getting the bags out.
I went here for a date but got stood up. The staff made a crappy night actually tolerable. I ended up only getting the crispy fried green beans, but they were amazing.

Seats need upholstery fixes
Food is great, hard working staff
Location perfect
Parking great

Coming from SoCal, this place I guess does justice for Reno residents. I've traveled across country for good tacos and even TJ. 

Ordered 4 tacos: 
Intestine - over cooked so it gives a bitter Crisp when over tried. 

Tongue - decent but not the best tongue I had. It's better then the rest. 

Tripes - typical nothing special. 

El pastor- dry. They had it precut in a steel container. So it's not fresh cut off from their grill. Perhaps I will get lucky next time they have them fresh. 

Overall the flavor is not all there. Though I do have to commend them on their corn tortillas. It pretty decent and fresh. Presentation is nice as well.

When I heard that HAAS was offering $169 for full highlights, gloss and cut for new clients, I couldn't resist. My hair is shoulder length and was still light from previously being blonde. I called and made the appointment and the receptionist confirmed the discounted price for select stylist. When I arrived, my stylist told me that the price was going to be roughly $250, not the $169 as advertised. I was already there and only stayed because I felt bad to cancel last second. I went from light brown to very dirty blonde and a trim for $250 and my hair is short... the last time I paid that much for my hair was when I went from light brown to platinum blonde. My roommates couldn't believe what I paid because it was not a traumatic difference. I would've gone to my other hair stylist had I known I'd get charged nearly $100 more at HAAS. 

Update: the owner reached out to me and informed me that the reason the price was $220 instead of $169 is because they used Olaplex... No one asked me if I wanted to add Olaplex and  I certainly wouldn't have agreed to that $50 add on had they asked... Thats's a horrible excuse for not sticking with your advertised promotion..

Updated my review based on poor customer service. Won't be going back.

Yikes. My experience today wasn't nearly as bad as the other posts. I walked in after already chugging coffee at home and still failing at successfully waking to acceptable daytime levels. DD is my last resort place these days. Stuff makes me jittery.

It was pretty empty despite the morning hour, and I ordered my large coffee and muffin. Staff member was friendly enough/efficient. Muffin was good. Coffee succeeded in waking me up for a little bit pre-caffeine crash/causing extreme jitters.

Pretty standard DD experience overall. It's in the strip mall between Westmoreland and Allegheny on Broad. Lots of other convenient chains surround it.

So many tantalizing menu items - tough to pick what to eat. I passed on the poutine (would love to try ) and got a loaded burger with an egg. It was fantastic. The sweet potato fries were awesome too. Staff all introduced themselves and are quite attentive. This place is a hit!
The process of ordering through yelp was easy and pickup. They got the order wrong even though the receipt read the right order. The food didn't taste great.
Great food, great service, great atmosphere. I have hosted larger parties, intimate date nights, and taken the family, everyone we received the same great service.

Rittenhound is the best! Thanks so much to Lea and Evan for taking such amazing care of our babies while we were away! Not only did they leave us a detailed and adorable report card, but sent us picture text messages everyday so we could see how happy the boys were at the dog park and at home! They've never been left home alone for that long before, and I was nervous at first. But the messages and updates were greatly appreciated and comforting. We came home to two very tired and content dogs. Reliable, affordable, and extremely friendly. We will definitely be referring Rittenhound to all of our doggie friends! Thanks again.

I am a professor at UCSB and I tried to order cupcakes on 7/18/19 and on 7/20/19 for an event on campus on 7/23/19 in my department. Both times I was told that you were too busy to take my order (and on Thursday I was hung up on). Perhaps you should provide information about your pricing of cupcakes on-line to reduce the time an employee needs to be on the phone with a customer. I have ordered pastries for events in the past from Anna's but am happy to take my business elsewhere and will do so in the future.

Came here on a friday night. Awesome beer. Delish corn bread and mac an cheese! And they do flights. Servers are super nice and attentive, and they broadcast phillies games. Wish i could give them more stars!
I went back recently and they had a whole bunch of new things like little cakes and bubble tea. I had a passfruit bubble tea and it was sooooo good. Good price. I want more.

On vacay here with the fam and found this place to get some pho fix. It was surprisingly delicious.

I highly recommend the spring rolls. It's hands down the best spring rolls I've had. The pork is flavored, which brings the taste up by several notches.

The beef pho, chicken pho, and soda & eggs were all fantastic. My only complaint is about the MSG as I had a huge MSG headache afterwards (common when eating pho). For most folks, that's not an issue, but for suckers like me who love to eat but are allergic to MSG, it's the price we pay for trying out new places.

I recommend this place for sure!

Went on a Thursday night after work with 4 Co-workers. The place is quaint and cozy. Perfect date spot. Parking was tough but did find a lot behind the Mediterranean place across the street. I admired the stone oven. Wish I had that in my backyard!  Each person ordered their own pizza and everyone said theirs were good. I got the Tres Carne. The Italian sausage was the bomb. Best of the three meats. Service was perfect and I would highly recommend this place if you're downtown.
Hands down the best Chinese food I've had in SB. The spicy crispy chicken is perfectly seasoned and crispy. The tea is excellent especially for cooling the spice. And the chicken hearts are amazing!
Have ordered delivery 3 times and everytime the order was correct and not melted. The ice cream is really good.

Little Village has been in our neighbourhood of Grovenor for some time but we never tried it despite a love of Greek Food.  We finally were motivated by two things.  First, the bizarre plan to destroy the Stoney Plain Road/149 St. area with an LRT overpass would also force Little Village to close or relocate, so we had to give it a try.  Secondly, my wife wanted moussaka for her birthday but her birthday fell the day before a religious holiday involving a lot of food.  Takeout moussaka would be a perfect fit.

We scouted the Little Village a few days before the birthday to make sure that moussaka would be available and to see what the restaurant was all about.  The owner helped us plan the entire menu with suggestions for the size of salad and when to order the moussaka to be sure of getting what we wanted (order early).  The Little Village has a few places to eat in but they look grossly uncomfortable, especially for two elderly people with bad backs.

On my wife's birthday, we called early, the owner remembered us and sounded happy to have our business - not an everyday experience for me when ordering takeout.  We picked up our order at 5:30 pm as we prefer to eat late.  Be warned that Little Village is in the same strip mall as some kind of fitness spa and the parking lot is full of badly parked urban luxury vehicles.  Why is it that patrons of fitness places seem to lack parking skills?

When we finally sat down to eat in the comfort of our own home, we were delighted by our dinner.  The moussaka was 80% meat/eggplant/zucchini filling and 20% bechamel topping.  Our previous moussaka was in an very expensive restaurant and the proportions here reversed.  The lemon potatoes were made from small, tasty spuds with the skin left on, not a peeled boiled tasteless lump that often graces the table of Greek restaurants.  The Greek Salad was superb, perhaps needing a few more kalamata olives. but that's a matter of taste.  The baklava is like dying and going to Thessalonika, full of walnuts and sweet enough to rot your teeth with two mouthfuls.

Be warned that portions are generous, also a rarity when the good is this good.  OK, there's no belly dancer, even if you eat in.  But in the grand scheme of things, that saves money as there's no need to put folding money in the dancer's belt.  We will go back again as, since our meal, it seems as if the city has given up on destroying our part of the city.

Outstanding!!!! Great food, great service perfect combination. The Fish and grits dish was perfect, with the blackened salmon. The French toast with butter cream sauce was also excellent and we can't forget about fruit tea. 
Great atmosphere, If you are in Nashville (over a weekend) it's worth the wait. It's only open on the weekend.

The best market I have ever been to. They have amazing sandwiches. Really good selection of food. Always clean, employees are so friendly and welcoming. They always have fresh bagels and breads that are so freaking good. I go here every saturday  morning for coffee and a breakfast sandwich. They have so many good juices to choose from, which when hungover are all a god-send.
As a Muncie native, this is the real deal just like home. Diced sausage and pepperoni with a crispy crust. Have ordered in and pickup a couple dozen times with no major issues.

Wow was this place a rip off. Walked in on a Friday night at 8:30 and the place was empty but it took the staff nearly 20 min to set the table.  Then the menu came out. Now I'm from New York and used to high prices but this was outrageous. $45 for branzino!  $40 for local grouper. And came with nothing but two asparagus sticks.  The grouper came out well but the appetizer poke was terrible.  Waitress was nice but not good. Forgetting things we asked for multiple times. Hostess stand folks were flat our rude. 

For $10 less per meal I'd give this place a 3 but for this price it's a solid 2. Skip.

My first stop on my first ever morning in Philadelphia, donuts christened the day. I highly recommend the strawberry lavender -- a refreshing taste, something you've never experienced before. Also, some of the best fried chicken -- not overly fried, just a nice layer over some quality, well-cooked white meat chicken! 

Next time, I'd love to grab a cup of coffee and enjoy a donut with friends; also a great date spot with the tall tables. Quaint atmosphere. 

You can also order donuts and fried chicken online to-go -- perfect to take to a meeting or a party!

(I'm not qualified or able to tell anyone what is or is not a good art museum so I'm not even going to try.  All I can bring to the table is what I thought about Michener.)

Going back to front on this one.  In retrospect my impression of Michener is that it's less an art museum as opposed to a building that offers a lot of classes and performances which incidentally also happens to have art as well.

We came on a Sunday not long after they opened and things initially seemed very busy (note I say seemed).  We got the counter to pay and the poor women at the register got confused really quick.  I told her that we had two child admissions, one college student with ID and we wanted to use our Bank of America CC to make the last one free since Michener participates with BOA's first weekend of the month free museum program.   She couldn't figure this out and after asking a colleague what to do she just gave us a map with the little plastic clip-ons to show that we "paid" and said to have a good time.  Free is never a bad thing.

Once the guided tour and jazz concert started things cleared out in a hurry.  After that we had the place mostly to ourselves.

The three things I remember were the giant sculpted heads from the Janis Project (Weird). A lot of decorative chairs and their permanent gallery of PA inspired paintings which seemed Bucks County-centric.

www.michenerartmuseum.org/mam_exhibitions/frank-hyder-the-janis-project/
www.michenerartmuseum.org/mam_exhibitions/the-art-of-seating/

Overall the museum was enjoyable and after about 90 minutes we were done as honestly there is not that much to see.  Had we paid the full admission price I probably would not be very favorable in my opinion of Michener but free is a strong persuader to not be so hard on something especially when you're not exactly sure that anything you saw was actually all that interesting.

Can't say enough about Rocco's. Prices are a little high, but the quality of the product is evident, as well as the customer service. Very good food. Their crab cakes are outstanding.

Excellent fish tacos!  I'm not a beer drinker but my husband and step son are. They enjoyed everything Chuck suggested. Chuck even brought me 2 samples since I don't really care for beer, I did like one of the two. Saison was light and pretty tasty. We all enjoyed our lunch and appetizers too! We'll definitely return. Kudos to Chuck who was friendly and knowledgeable!

We loved this place. It has this eclectic collection of lamps without being messy. The music was uplifting but jazz :-) . But forget the nice / clean cool  atmosphere. Restaurants are about the food - I had the crab cake entree, my husband had the jambalaya risotto. Nice tooth, spice right. A not too sweet bread pudding (big enough to share) Add to that good service from Gail and we are SO GLAD we went here. Difficult because all NOLA reviews say 4.5 stars but aren't as starry as this place.

Of course Bob Johnson of Legion Transformation Center decided to charge my card again after i not only told him I no longer wanted to use their service, but that I wanted a refund. Now I'm convinced that this guy Bob Johnson is a money hungry creep because he's charging me for services I'm not using. Filing a dispute with my bank today and sadly I'm going to have cancel my credit card to stop this financial bullying from happening any longer.

Bob Johnson still hasn't refunded me and I've filed several disputes to get my money back. At this point he stopped returning my emails, but he got what he wanted out of me. There are so many better places to get in shape use them instead of Legion Transformation Center.

I used to come here often when I was younger (with my family), so for old times sakes I went with a few friends. Maybe it was just a bad day, but the quality of food was very poor. Being from South Korea, perhaps I'm being too harsh but there's not one thing I enjoyed about my meal here. The reason it gets two stars instead of one is because the staff there was nice. There aren't many good Korean restaurants in the Philadelphia area, but I didn't expect the food to be of such poor quality. Not recommended.
Travis was great. Fast service and very helpful. Gave great tips to help keep my garage door running well

I dropped off some hard drives and printers for recycling.  I was assured that they'd destroy them.  I left the store, and had a nagging feeling that I should watch them do this, and not assume. 

When I returned, I thought I'd be greeted with quite a few 'eye rolls'; however, I was pleasantly surprised that Varun treated me with utmost respect.  He retrieved my drives from the back room and put them in a bucket of water before using the hammer.

I made a small purchase to assuage my guilt for not trusting G2.  

Because of the stellar treatment I received for a free service, i will highly recommend them to anyone in need of Apple products.

One word.  Fresh. This bakery is the real deal. Bread is baked daily. It's beautiful sitting in the display racks. The aromas are intoxicating. The owner, Lou made a customer from out of town feel like a long time customer from south Philly. 

What a place!

Had lunch there today. I am a local. Disappointing. Had the bean soup, flavorless, and was a pinto bean soup. Tasted like a mediocre bean soup at a Mexican restaurant. Where is the salt and pepper let alone the garlic. How about a Cannelini Bean.
The Meatball Panini. Same deal. The bread was good. Flavorless meatballs, and tasteless red sauce. These are things that are easy to fix, so why in the world would I go back and order a complex dish.

I brought my disabled friend in for a girls day with gel manicures. A man sat in front of her and began taking off her polish. He asked if she was able to put her hands in the light machine that they use to set the gel polish. I told him yes, but he should guide her hand in to prevent her bumping a nail on the side. He stated he wasn't sure he would be able to do her nails. She is not physically disabled and has full range of motion so I was confused. I replied that if he did not feel he could serve her needs to please not go any farther and allow someone else to do it. He sat for a few moments in silence then began removing her polish again. A moment, seriously one tiny moment later he informed me he was not able to work with her. She was doing as asked and holding her hands out for him perfectly. I am still unclear why he was unable to work on her nails. This is a task this lady has been doing 2 times a month for the 20 years I've known her, so she knows what to do. I asked who else could work on her nails. He responded that she would have to wait until I was done and my tech could do it. Needless to say we immediately left this establishment and went elsewhere. This was clearly discrimination based on her being a developmentally disabled person! We will never return...

These folks do an outstanding job!
Outstanding customer service and follow up to make sure the problem is resolved and the customer is 100% satisfied!

Small and quiet.  Out of the way in Franklin.  The only reason I didn't give it 5 stars was because the atmosphere was boring and generic, but the food was very, very good. We have eaten there, as a family, several times.  We get a variety of dishes and have never been disappointed.  Will definitely be back.

The sad thing is that it's a great concept and many of the frontline customer service people are polite and competent, the drivers are polite and helpful.  But using this company is like playing Russian roulette especially when your situation gets elevated to "customer service specialist " level. You are told someone will get back to you in 24-48 hours.  The first time I was told that was 7/26/2021 today is 8/30/2021 and no one has called. Back on July 2020 we packed up a pod in SC it was brought to the storage facility in Savanah.  We got a cryptic call in October claiming a computer  glitch had sent our pod to Asheville seemed like quite the story but it happened. I had to deal with a rather unpleasant person. After much back and forth they agreed to leave the pod in Asheville until we decided where we wanted it delivered. They also confirmed we would be billed based on the Savanah location. On July 26 2021I contacted pods to arrange delivery to our new condo. I  was told many stories over the next 3 days spending 8 hours each day trying to clear up the situation. I was told more than 5 times it had been escalated and I would hear back in 24 to 48 hours as noted above I have still not received a call. At the end of the day Wednesday I was told I could only deal with the person who had already given me such a hard time. This person wouldn't be back until 8/2/21 . On Monday 8/2 I sent several emails to this person but I got no response. When I called the next day I was told that person was no longer going to help me and the person who was would not be back for several days.  Never heard from that person either. I was forced to pay double the price but with a promise that once  reviewed I would get the price would be correct and a credit would be issued to my card. This never happened. I  was forced to deal with all of this because of the incompetence of this company.  But it was the only way to get my (now damaged) belongings released. Because of the multiple moves many things were damaged. I have contacted my insurance company they can deal with pods. This was a terrible experience and as everyone knows moving is already enough of a  hassle without being jerked around like this . Please know that everything  you read online about pods is true. Use them at your own risk Peace

Don't sit upstairs when it is hot outside because it's so much hotter up there! 

The restaurant looks much smaller when you first walk inside but it has the upstairs area and another room for bigger parties. The kitchen is open and you can see them cooking. The staff is very attentive, the guy we had was funny when I tried pronouncing my meal. I like that they have a vegetarian part on the menu (duh!); I ordered the Rajas Poblana. I'm a little surprised it comes with white rice and not a Mexican rice, my only complaint. The food was delicious! Seitan is a hard thing to make delicious especially getting the texture correct and it was GOOD. Our entire party loved the food, some of the guys realized getting the fish tacos is a small portion (only 2) so if you're hungry order the corn on the cob!

BYOB.
You can order margarita mix for $7 or check-in on Yelp and get one free!! I heard it tastes really good but it is sweet so add some water to dilute it. Really good food and nice people, I would definitely try this place! Not too expensive either. You can also call to make reservations, we had a party of 7 so it was a good idea for us!

I was over my friends house for a Phillies game and they had ordered pizza and wings. I have never had a buffalo chicken pizza before and was really surprised it was quite addicting. The wings were also very good and  restaurant like quality. I asked them where they got the food and they said the Pizza Place. I have ordered a few times since than and have been very happy with each delivey. I heard they had re-vamped their staff and menu over the past few months. It appears to be working. Ask for the secret garlic sauce on a pizza. It is amazing!!!

Sweet little dive bar off Bourbon, not far off the beaten path. It's got the original bookshelf doors for the restrooms which were previously found in The Dungeon. The jukebox offers a variety from the dark side. There's usually not much of a crowd here.

Had my first appointment here today - loved everyone from the woman at the front desk to the examining doctor. 

I arrived 10 minutes before my scheduled appointment, and was seen exactly on time. Kristin Roddy, CRNP is who I had my appointment with; she made me very comfortable and has such an upbeat personality. I appreciated that she took the time to carefully go over my medical history before she began my exam. Kristen addressed any concerns I had and felt confident with her answers.

After having so many bad experiences with my last gyn, I'm so grateful to have found this place. It's clean, spacious, and everyone is so nice - definitely recommended!
Although the price range is not cheap, the portion is pretty generous (i had Pad-thai to go).  The taste is pretty good.

Picked this place based on the great reviews and I'm very satisfied! Sadie was wonderful! Friendly, talented and willing to listed to give me a haircut I would love. I will be going back. I have already recommended her to my friends.

I've been searching for a good bagel in Philly.  This place is not it.  I stopped in this morning to grab a breakfast sandwich on a bagel.  When they directly me to the baskets holding about 5 different varieties, I was dismayed to see that they were all burnt.  I was assured that they could give me a "lighter one", so I ordered the sandwich.  The eggs were nicely cooked...fluffy and flavorful, and the bacon was nice and crispy.  However, the "light" bagel was still burnt.  When I bit into it, it even had that dark brown ring inside the black outside that you get when you keep something too long next to the flame.  I can imagine that with a little finesse, this cooking method could make some really interesting bagels, but whoever is doing the cooking does not know how to do it, resulting in a sandwich that tastes like charcoal.  Also, there were a couple of bites reminiscent of fish, which makes me think that the salmon must come into contact with the grill and that the grill doesn't get cleaned very well between orders.

Plus, they DO NOT recycle!!!!  I finished my orange juice before my order was done and asked where the recycle bin was.  I was told there wasn't one and to just throw it in the trash can.  Isn't recycling the law in Philly these days??

I got my curly cut with Matt. Although I left happy with the some of the result, parts of the cut and styling process were disappointing. As someone with fine but extremely curly hair (3b/c), I was excited to have someone experienced in dry cutting take on a slight trim and reshaping. I haven't yet found a salon in this area that reliably cuts curls well. Unfortunately, after washing my hair Matt immediately went in to dry and brush it out before cutting it. As someone with fine hair, this can be extremely damaging to the curl and break my hair, but he assured me it would look better as an end result. The trim ended up being the length I asked for, and I liked the product he used to style it. However, the dry brushing before cutting put me off of coming back here. Stylists of curly hair should know to detangle wet hair with a wide toothed comb rather than brush dry curls, which left my hair frizzy and damaged.

Senor tacos is an awesome place to go with your family! Great service great staff and great management we are there all the time and they know it's by faces!! I have had nothing but good food good quality food nothing was bad service was great...

With another couple we enjoyed a very pleasant evening at The Inn of the Hawke. The menu was diverse, with emphasis on seasonal items. The food was nicely prepared and plated and the prices are reasonable. 

The bar is lively, and provide generous pours. 

Our waiter was Matt, who was attentive and helpful.

We have not eaten at The Inn for several years and now wonder why not? Based on last night we will most certainly return very soon.

So good we had to do breakfast here two days in a row.
From a pastry apsect, everything we had was delicious but the cheesy, carmelly quesito was phenomenal.
The breakfast egg sandwiches with meat and cheese on Cuban break were among the best I've ever had.
Everyone in the joint was welcoming and friendly.  GO HERE!

My husband and I met with Eric to discuss our roof concerns. Eric was professional and very informative about what Shingle Masters has to offer and how they can address our needs. Eric was very responsive throughout the process and kept his agreed appointments with us. Eric responded to calls/texts timely and addressed any concerns we had throughout the process. Shingle Masters had a month or so from the time we signed the estimate to the start of our roof. Shingle Masters did a great job with the removal and replacement of our roof and gutters. Their team had the old roof removed in the first portion of the first day and our new roof was completed by the end of day two. Their speedy service allowed us to have piece of mind that our wood was protected, especially from the upcoming rainy season. My husband received great feedback from the inspector about the quality of Shingle Master's craftsmanship. We i all of our documents to submit for our updated wind mitigation and proof of new roofing at the time of payment. Shingle Masters offers options for financing and also gives options for cash/check discounts. Shingle Masters offers a workmanship warranty in addition to the manufacturer warranty on the shingles. I would recommend Shingle Masters for their professionalism, craftsmanship and overall great customer service.

The girls here are great! And the man, who I believe is the owner, is the best! There was never a dull moment in conversation during my manicure.

There are a lot of regulars that come here and I completely understand why after trying it myself. I will definitly be there every 2 weeks to get my nails redone.

WeI have lived in many apts over the  years and have lived at this apt for 3 years. The office was super nice when I moved in, but after that, they never answer the phone, there are a couple new girls in the last year that are flat out rude. And, rarely do we ever get return calls when we leave messages. 

Today, its 10 minutes before they closed and doors are locked. This happens quite often. A staff members behind office at pool, 2 other people inside who work there and they lock door early. excellent first time experience. my friend referred me here and I will continue to do the same after this afternoon. I came in with a hemming alteration at 5:20pm. Poor service (took 10 minutes to get waters). Chicken Park over cooked and pasta seriously undercooked (it was barely cooked). Going downhill.

Great Experience. It's a pleasure to finally find a reliable contractor that does great work for a reasonable price. After going through many sub-par contractors, I finally found one that I would definitely recommend. They do great work and are very clean. At ECI Comfort, we do work for a wide range of customers and get nothing but positive feedback after the work is done. They are Aces in my book.
Darius made the experience!  He is a keeper for Mattress Firm.

Apparently Circus Circus is un-American and doesn't appreciate their employees who are also service members. My son was recently employed here, but then subsequently terminated after returning from his first drill weekend. Way to be patriotic Circus Circus!!

Very much so enjoyed my visit there food was excellent service buzz buzz okay that wasn't bad it wasn't it wasn't the best but it was it was as if I could layout of the place really cool it's definitely on my top enjoyable places to go

I've only been here a handful of times.

This is a low cost clinic. So i guess the saying "you get what you pay for" is true. 
They do not take appointments so plan to be here for about an hour and a half to two hours. I guess you have to think about how much your time is worth.
Each time Ive been here the vet has been in with me for about 3 minutes.  So I don't feel like I'm really heard. 
The office staff and vet techs are all very friendly and helpful!

I will def return, but will make sure I have phone charger and/or a book to read!

Came here for a work lunch the other day and was super excited!
I mean, John Besh - New Orleans legend - and Aaron Sanchez - one of my favorite Food Network people - combined forces and came out with this!  I couldn't wait!

We did not have a reservation, but they were still able to seat us immediately (group of 5), even though it was starting to fill up (it got packed a short time later).  We passed on appetizers because they have complimentary salsa (red and green) and chips (tortilla and !plantain!).  And we stuffed our faces with those.

I ordered the wood fired shrimp salad, which came with mixed greens, SPICY grilled shrimp, avocado, and roasted pumpkin chunks on top of a savory pumpkin yogurt sauce type thing.  It was FANTASTIC!!  I also had a side of the street corn, which had a kick of spice and citrus.  It was interesting, but good.  Our waitress was very friendly and helpful.  She gave us a fair warning that they are still working out the kinks in the kitchen (that explains the slow food service).  So hopefully that picks up and I can give them that extra star!

I hope to try this place again in a few weeks and see how they've improved!

Good:
Ambience, reasonable variety for meat eaters, tastes good, nice place to take your girl out

Bad: 
-Unfortunately NOT much variety for vegetarians. -My Veggie friends were clearly disappointed. 
-Expensive, small portions

If you are a non-vegetarian and looking to try something new - go for it. May not be a good choice for vegetarians
