Great pizza, definitely unique, but somehow missing something.  I can't quite point out what it is, but other than this is good and it's not too expensive.  This definitely breaks the monotony of chain pizzas.  I ordered the chicken alfredo pizza, which had pesto in it and it was great.

Really bad/rude service at this location. If you're not happy doing what you do or working for Starbucks, then you shouldn't be there misrepresenting a good company. There's a Dunkin down the street that I'm gonna have to start going to or just drive to the Starbucks on 10th st... I'm not the only person that this has happened too at this location.

I absolutely freaking adore this place. It is tucked down on the water next to the Wagon Wheel flea market on Park Blvd and can be easy to miss if you don't know where it is. To get there, you have to find a small drive way and drive down into a bumpy parking lot that can be a pain when other cars are trying to navigate the space. It is well worth the effort. 

Cajun Cafe is very Kitschy. From the half New Orleans half swampland decor to the signs that are hung everywhere that threaten you to put your cell phones away. If you are caught using it, you may be ejected. There is also a humorous section on the menu that warns parents to control their children. Make sure you read it. :) 

Anyways, Cajun Cafe has a plethora of beer (both on tap and in bottles). My beer snob Husband is always happy to find some of his favorites here. The food however is the real star. I have been here twice now and tried a variety of things. I absolutely love the Alligator Piquant and have ordered it both times. It is a spicier dish that is packed full of flavor. It is also a huge helping that I normally end up happily eating half of for lunch the next day. I have also tried the gumbo, fried crawfish, sausage, fried green tomatoes, boudin balls and the whiskey bread pudding. They have all been delicious. The whiskey bread pudding is something that you MUST try when you visit. It is some of the best bread pudding I have ever had and it is perfect to share with a group (one or two people probably can not finish it. Our last visit four people verily tackled it). 

If you are looking for traditional cajun fare, Cajun Cafe on the Bayou is the place to go...just remember to be on your best behavior. :)

I have eaten (and drank) here almost every Thursday for the past 10 mos.  Good food, good drinks.  Not too pricey compared to comparable airport venues (yes, Subway is cheaper).  Service is usually very good (try to snag a table in the blond spikey haired guy's section) and the food used to be authentic.  Recent changes are upsetting - the protein (shrimp, chicken, etc) is cooked separately from the rice on the Jambalaya.  No more to go drinks - their hurricanes were excellent, now they are a little too rich and sweet, but doesn't matter much because no to go means I have to sacrifice the drink.  The red beans and rice are still good.  I also like the shrimp remoulde salad and the poboys, but I don't know if the new GM changed those items too.
Fun decor. Great local family. Good food. Fun atmosphere. Great place to meet for lunch, dinner or a drink.

Very nice Vietnamese place that is open really early and around for lunch too. The early opening helps since they have Vietnamese iced coffee to wake you the heck up. Granted, sometimes they don't open when their hours say they do since I went here at 8:45 once to find it still closed. The chicken teriyaki is to die for though they are often out of it by late lunch time. It's got a good atmosphere and definitely a good choice if you're in downtown area.

If you come expecting the best Mexican food don't bother, but if you come looking for decent Mexican food then you found it. The service is always good and the value of their adult Mexican beverages is great. For the most part the place is clean, the chips and salsa are good especially the salsa. Their San Jose guac is awesome. We've been a half dozen times or more and enjoy it even for just chips, salsa and beverages on the open patio. Don't be so boujee and support local vendors.

Been going here since I was six years old (i'm twenty now), I have very happy memories with my friends and family eating here. Always left this place under $15. Good food, good atmosphere, great memories.
love the food and pizza here. The slices are huge and delicious. Wow, this is it and they deliver.

Visiting the Tampa area and finding local cuisine and brewery options! This place sits outside the 7th sun brewery and it is fresh, flavorful and tasty! Food trucks can be iffy but this is the bomb!!! Had the chicken shredded tacos and chicken studded burrito and it was amazing! Did not disappoint!
I was feeling under the weather and decided to get my favorite thing for that, grilled cheese and tomato soup.  There is a place named after that so stopped in.  Tasty, but laughably overpriced.

Good bar food, big projector screen for sports watching.  They have an extensive menu.  Place is a bit dark, there's a pool table, and the location and space is big enough to accomodate larger groups.  There's karaoke, and stuff like that.

Maintenance are always smiling and friendly and willing to help and or fix any problem you need. Unfortunately I don't believe the management is as on top of the financial side of upkeep as the maintenance is willing to provide it. My wife and I went without AC for two weeks a while back whilst "parts are being ordered". I've never had any actual problems with the complex aside from the PARKING! There is none. They tried implementing parking tags to residents two tags per household to eliminate visitors from taking the parking. They never enforced the rules of the tags and instead came up with "reserved parking" which on top of their over priced monthly rent can be purchased at a monthly fee so that you can have a space. All but 5 spaces in the entire parking lot have been turned reserved. My now pregnant wife and myself usually have to park illegally or down the road a ways to come home. This is very inconvenient in weather and also toting groceries. They seem money hungry. All I can say is, WE ARE ECSTATIC TO BE MOVING!
Great handmade, unique and fresh burgers. Everytime I visit from Chicago I must stop by to get a hellfire burger and tots! Local brews tops it all off!

Lip smacking traditional indian-pakistani food, excellent service and welcoming hospitality. Owned by a couple from Karachi. They serve you amazing phulkas with really tasty curries. They tasted like homemade curries. Phulkas were very soft. We loved the food so much we even took a takeout. The kheer was the perfect dessert to end the meal. Finished the kheer clean even though we were full with the main course 

Ps - they are opening a new fine dine called masala in the loop. Attached address in the picture

I never give 5 stars, but this place deserves it! After eating delicious pierogis in NYC I came home looking for them. Pierogi Grill blew it out of the water! I got the veggie combo pierogis and O.M.G. SO GOOD! My favorite were the sauerkraut and mushroom followed closely by the spinach. Also had the sour soup, to die for, and tried the borscht and it was delish (and I don't like beets!). I can't wait to go back, in fact I may have convinced myself to get take out for lunch! I LOVE YOU PIEROGI GRILL!

Do people not know how to watch a movie? I literally listened to a couples life story while watching the hunger games with my girlfriend. I'm not even exaggerating when I say they talked the whole time. And it wasn't like a whisper, it was like a outside voice. I'm not racist but it was 2 black girls. 

Then in the middle of the movie a guy and a girl left, and the guy screamed "Get money n***a" at the bottom of the stairs. I found this hilarious because he forgot his phone and had to come back. Lol, what a peasant.

Oh and people farting, chewing loud and obnoxiously. Jesus.

This place was also extremely dirty. Grease everywhere from the movie before. Food in my seat. I saw the seats in front of me had something spilled all over them and it wasn't even cleaned. It looked sticky. I told the manager and he had some guy with a wet rag come try and talk to me during the movie. That was a little rude. The place should of been clean in the first place.

Anyways the seats are very comfortable and recline further then any movie theatre. That's why they get 2 stars :).

I told the manager this and he was very apologetic and gave me a refund. Thanks.

I know they can't control the people talking but I hope they get more strict on cleaning the theatre after every movie.
It was our first time and we will definitely be back! Excellent food, excellent service. Owners are on-site and personable. Taylor was our waitress and was terrific!

Hurricanes and fried oysters! Excellent. Po boys are huge and great specials. Thank you to Brandon in the kitchen for telling us about the restaurant while on the St Charles trolley. Get off at the Louisiana stop and walk about 4-5 blocks to Magazine. You won't be sorry!!

As others have said, this is the best Chinese buffet in Tucson.  Tucson really isn't known for Chinese food like a city like San Francisco is, so I'll cut this place some slack.  Being that Chinese is my wife's favorite food, we stop by here often.  The food is pretty good and none of the things I've tried are old.  My favorite thing to eat here is the orange chicken and the won ton soup.  The servers are always quick to clean up plates and getting refills, which I like.  If you're looking for the best Chinese buffet in Tucson, this is it.

Sat outside & had lunch on Saturday & thoroughly enjoyed Praveen Khanna's hospitality & personal attention to every detail. The food was authentic & presentation was great. Amritsari fish, tricolor Paneer Tikka & Malai Chicken Tikka were awesome. 
Garlic Naan , Lachha Parontha & Bullet Naan were done to perfection. 
Khanna's Desi vibes brought back wonderful memories of delicious food back home in India.

Should have paid attention to the other reviews. This place has gone downhill and the food is terrible. The place was basically empty. The appetizers were just cheaply fried, tasteless, and on shredded lettuce which was weird. For the curries, the noodles werent cooked right and the chicken had clearly been boiled separately in water, it tasted like nothing. Afterwards we both felt sick and robbed. Save yourself while you still can and go somewhere else!

Way overpriced and spotty service....my 2nd time here, my spouse's 3rd.

Went there last night with three plus myself....dinner started off okay with the cauliflower hummus and "over-peppered" toast points with brie and inconsistent sliced apples.  

The beer selection, while good, is way overpriced....$10 and $8 for beers you can get 30%-40% cheaper even in the city.

We asked our waiter what's in the Impossible Burger specifically....he told us "plants"!!!! (We just looked at each other in amazement.) When he brought our drink order back...we asked what kind of plants....he noted the "kitchen doesn't tell them".

I had the Farmers Platter....it was delivered by a runner... I asked for some ketchup and never saw that runner again....by the time our waiter came to check on us...it was already far to long into the meal.  My chicken was significantly overcooked...the ribs (two bone) was easily 80% fat.....in the long run, I spent $20 for a hot dog.

Another member in our party ordered the roasted turkey platter....the meat was fibrous, stuffing tasted like "stove top"....and the mash potatoes tasted like instant, cut with yogurt.

The other two ordered the white pizza and the beer can chicken....both were satisfied by flavor and enjoyed their meal.

In a previous visit, (just to touch on service....I was going to write a review back then but decided not to)....my spouse just ordered the beet salad, which she noted was very good.....when the waiter came back to pick up her plate, he stated (in what was interpreted in a very condescending manner) was "wow, somebody really enjoyed their meal".

The $173 tab for 4 was off-putting to all of us.....thank goodness they have a built in audience with all of the condo's/apartments around them. It'll be some time before I even decide to think about coming back.

Sawatdee is confirmation that you should explore outside of your comfort zone. We already had our regular Thai place, but after last night we may have to change allegiances.

Between the grilled squid salad, flat noodles with pork and Chinese broccoli, and the mixed seafood dish, we were just knocked out. The squid/seafood was perfectly cooked and tender. The seasoning was fantastic (thankfully they ignored my request for everything  to be very spicy - it just wouldn't have tasted right with some of the flavor combinations.)

My only complaints would be not enough broccoli in the noodle dish and the fact that they don't deliver. How can you expect to be admitted into my regular rotation if you force me to get off the couch and retrieve my food?
Who can complain about McDonald's their best breakfast meal is the big breakfast the hotcakes and sausage are the best its hands down best fast food place period

I don't go out for breakfast often, but this is my go to spot. This is a small neighborhood restaurant with good diner basics at reasonable prices. The server are friendly and
the food is served quickly and hot!

Clearly, much thought, effort and care is taken on menu creation.  Ingredients are sourced locally and kitchen is doing really sophisticated work.  It is an impressive array of delicious offerings. Vegetables are the primary concern, but the kitchen also prepares fresh bread every day.

Highlights - wood grilled mushrooms, vegi platter with a dazzling selection of dips (pesto, lardo, hummus and goat cheese). Very tasty cocktails. AMAZING goose eggs with spring peas served in the shell.  Mushroom tacos served in a turnip shell.

Lowlights - the bar is very slow to get drinks out. The grilled peach dessert had overtones of the meat that had been grilled on the fire before it.  The amount of vegis on the platter to go with are dip seemed a little skimpy.

But my biggest gripe about this otherwise sophisticated and care-crafted dining experience is the sound in the room.  The room, while beautiful and full of STL's beautiful people, is as loud as bombs and our 4 top could barely hear one another.  Curtains, or ceiling baffles - something!- are really needed.

I felt like everywhere I went, bar, restaurant, park, it kept getting better, and this place did not disappoint. A very dark and old bar, it has a piano in the back where you sit around and sing songs along with the piano player while drinking beer, liqour or whatever you fancy. The bar is so cool, so old, and a must visit if you're in New Orleans.
The only place I'll go to for my nails when I'm at school! Super friendly staff, beautiful salon, a little pricey but definitely worth it.

WHO'S WORKING ... ???????
Who's bartending and working depends upon the service you will receive. There's quite a difference in the service for sure. 
And very disappointing.
I been here a number of times, 
all at Happy Hour.
Loved my first few visits.
thanks to the bartender and service, made the experience worthy of coming back again.
The last two, very dissatisfied 
And not 
the same experience at all!

.... WASN'T served chips and salsa.
..WASN'T told about the specials
..WASN'T asked if I woukd like another cocktail.


Just waiting and waiting.

**Not sure what happened with their WINGS...they were huge first two times... now smaller then small.

SORRY!

Not as fancy as some pet stores, but the prices are super fair!

We stopped by Pet Supermarket after shopping for dog toys at another store and we found the prices were much better here.  Most of the toys were at least $1 cheaper and the store informed us they match prices (if you bring in the ad) and they also take their competitors coupons.

The selection is HUGE and the staff is really nice.  Will return to Pet Supermarket next time I am in need of doggy toys or treats!

I loooove my pizza and am very picky but this pizza just made the grade! They actually have a cauliflower crust for those of us who are watching our carbs and it's DELISH! I highly recommend The Great White pizza:) It's the best white pizza ever! This pizza is crazy awesome all the way down to the crust. They have cinna-knots too and have been blowing the minds of my associates at work!! We get them delivered at least once a week! Way to go, Slice of the Burg!!!!
The food is great, especially the all day breakfast menu.  The staff is also great, but one counter crew member apparently does not like customers, especially repeat customers.
Never eat here. I found a literal chicken foot in my meal and almost ate it. Disgusting
Senor Taco is awesome. I usually get one of the burritos, but everything I've tried has been very good. Great service as well.
So excited they have opened!  Most romantic restaurant, and the menu is fantastic with a French flair. Love the cous cous, new item. Great crowd, upscale, and warm inviting atmosphere.

Very good Szechuan food, a big menu with less heard of dishes, fresh ingredients, rarely do places pan fry their scallion pancakes nowadays, pork feet noodle soup is definitely worth trying.  Not as spicy as Szechuan food should be, but I like it very much

My mind is completely blown away. Been on this planet for a long time and this is the most delicious Mediterranean food I've ever had. Fresh. Flavorful. Spicy. It was an experience I wish I could take back on the plane with me.

I've seen this come up on my list to review several times, and I've skipped it over because I didn't really know what to say. I mean, it's a Starbucks.

Here's what I can say for this particular location. I generally go through the drive through and there's always a line. It goes faster than other ones that I've been too. The service is always professional and friendly, and I've never had something not right here. In my book, that's a pretty good experience.

Not so freaky fast or freaky friendly.  I wish there was a little more explanation on their new menu of what was on a sandwich.  I asked if tomato was on a particular sandwich, got an eye roll.  Tomato does come on the sandwich so I had to pick them off. 

I didn't realize that the person taking my order needed to do something special to get my rewards added, but they weren't happy when they had to go back a step.  

Perhaps kiosks would be helpful so I wouldn't interrupt whatever this person was otherwise thinking about.

Food here was fantastic - only topped by the service!

We got the eggplant dish, chicken curry, naan and samosas for an appetizer. The portion sizes on all of these were quite substantial so a great place to go if you are hungry too!

This was our first Audi experience, and it was great!  The dealership sits back in Tom Wood's mecca of car businesses.  We were greeted by Todd, who helped us through our car-buying journey.  The dealership itself is gorgeous and open.  It screamed luxury.  We were offered something to drink at every turn and they made us feel comfortable.  I would recommend checking this location out.... it is the only Audi dealership in Indy!
I told them I did not want a contract and they lied to me. They said the sent all the details in the email and I should have read them. Do not do business with these crooks! Shady company!

We were there over 4th of July weekend and it was crazy busy! Not sure if this is typical or not. There was no reserved seating so you have to walk around and hope for the best. We managed to find a small high top table and then located two bar stools in a different area. There were two live bands playing. We really enjoyed the band in our area. I am not even much of a country fan but both the male and female lead singers did a great job.  The BBQ was decent. I had the pulled pork and my husband had ribs. I think both would have been better with some different sauce options. The sides were quite good. I had potato salad and beans and my husband had fries and cole slaw.  We shared an order of the corn cakes and they were very good!  Overall, solid bbq but not anywhere near the best we've ever had.
The food was good, but not the best I've ever had. I love the environment. Super nice place for a night out. There were TVs so around for a nice source of entertainment!

I had the pleasure of attending PokeZone's soft opening. It is a new concept for Tucson, so I think the downtown setting suits it perfectly. 
Pokezone has a Chipotle-style kind of ordering process.

 When it comes to building your bowl, instead of choosing between carnitas and chicken, you have fresh salmon, yellowtail, octopus, spicy tuna and ahi tuna. 
They have many sauces to accompany your bowl such as house dressing, sweet chili, spicy mayo, eel sauce etc. 
They also offer toppings such as crab, edamame, cucumber, green and friend onion, avocado etc. to top it off!

I ordered my bowl with half brown rice and half salad. I really think the salad kept it from being too "heavy" and more on the healthy side. The yellowtail and spicy tuna were amazing. And I loved all of the fresh ingredients that they had to offer. It was a great feeling to be able to finish an entire bowl and not feel guilty about it. 

The owners were attentive and walked around to make sure that all of their customer's needs have been met. We sat in the bar area (still waiting on their liquor license, hoping to have it in a month or so) and they even changed the channel to whatever we wanted to watch. Awesome service!

I must say it's about time Tucson was introduced to the poke game. There is no doubt I'll be back. Can't wait until they are officially open! Word is, it'll be May 6th.

Chill was great in the beginning when it first opened. Now, I sit in a booth that looks great and trendy but is uncomfortable and uneven. Food use to be delicious every time, not anymore. Still pretty good most of the time and sometimes still delicious but prices are too high for it not to be great every time. Listening to clanging plates as they are cooking in the middle of the restaurant is getting old. You can't see the cook/chef's hands or the food to see what they are cooking - if the kitchen is going to be in the middle of restaurant we need to see their 'art' of cooking - or put a wall up to keep down the noise and smell. Hostess/waitress stations line middle of restaurant next to tables, makes no sense. Today at 9:30 in morning there was a lounge act as if it was Saturday night. Too loud - watched people ask to be moved to the coffee side, due to noise. The singer was actually trying to converse with audience like it was a night-show act. In my opinion music at brunch is lovely but best when understated and just in the background. I am a local and live in the area - I wanted to see Chill make it. After my food today was over-cooked (again) I have decided I am done. Chill is just too pricey for so many inconsistencies. I hope they get it together as I would love to see a local business make it...but I am done making excuses for what I have been experiencing my last several times in.

Ahh Ted Drewes.  My friend and I used to skip school and end up here instead.  I have a million favorites.  Great Pumpkin and Big Apple each with a whole slice of pie ground in, Polynesian, and more recently blueberry.  However, nothing can hold a candle to the Bunny Crete.  My friend and I called every single day for weeks to ask if it was in yet.  They grew to know and loathe us by the time the beautiful treasure finally came in.  The Bunny Crete is vanilla custard, cream cheese, raisins, carrot, and nuts.  It's only around for Easter.  I'd try to make it at home, but what would be the point?

Great beer
Great Staff
No food, but they help you get something delivered.
Little spendy, but then again, you get what you pay for.

I don't think they are working on too high of margins, rather, the beers just cost them that much...
I have eaten here once a month ago. The service was horrible. Waited forever to order, everyone's dishes came out at different times, rude service. I left zero tip, and I have the right to do so.

This place is amazing Italian food!  

My dad has had the chicken franchise here.  He said it was very good!   My mother has had the veal piccata here and she loved it! 

I'm on a certain meal plan so I ordered salmon plain with the some herbs and roasted vegetables. It was perfectly cooked and delicious. 

I am told the bread is also delicious here. 

I am also told the Caesar salad is great! 

My mother had penne with anchovies, capers with Diablo sauce and enjoyed it.  

My dad had Veal portofino.    Veal sautéed in white wine with spinach crabmeat and mozzarella.    Roasted potatoes .    I tried this and it was amazing! 

The only negative is that it took about 50 minutes to get the food. 

The owner and the cook was great. They came over to the table and gave my mother long hots to take home. 

My dad finished off the meal with cappuccino.  He said he enjoyed it. 

I highly recommend this restaurant!

Food was delicious, great staff, and a wonderful atmosphere. The portion sizes are perfect. I would recommend the tasting menus.

Came to Tuscon from LA for a wedding. Woke up wanting nothing but some mangu con tres golpes. To my surprise, we found this place! 

The food was delicious. We both ordered the mangu con tres golpes and a morir soñando. We also had a couple of Colombian empanadas de pollo.

Service was quick and friendly. The place is clean and nice, with good music playing (bachata and salsa, mainly). 

The cook even came out to see how we liked the mangu! 

Next time I am in Tuscon, I will absolutely be back!

This is my second time coming here and I must say I love this place. The server was really nice and changed the grill many times at no worries. We ordered many meats and a couple times and everything was great. The beef short ribs, fatty beef, and the bulgogi were amazing. There is a wide variety of sauces at the sauce bar and we just selected a few and mixed a bunch of them for a great taste. The price is very reasonable for amount of food you get.

They deserve zero stars.

In the summer of 2020 (right after we put a brand new roof on our home), we had The Solar Store install solar coils for our swimming pool. We explained that our new roof was silicone and asked to make sure that their product wouldn't damage our new roof. We were assured they would not. January 2021, our roofer was inspecting our roof and found significant damage from their solar coil install. I contacted the company and they were originally responsive. They sent an installer out right away to check it out. He told me that the person/group that finished the install (wasn't him) did it wrong and that they were no longer with the company. He wanted to fix the roof but I asked him to please provide HOW they would fit it as they are NOT a roofing company and I wanted to make sure my warranty with MY roofing company was still valid if they fixed it. Weeks went by with no response. I received the estimate from my roofing company in early February and sent it to The Solar Store. I was told it was forwarded to management. We have tried to call numerous times and keep being told we will get a return call. No calls or emails have been returned. At this point, we are over a month out from the initial contact with them to tell them about the issue. And with rains coming, I can't wait for the repair to happen - I need to schedule it and do it now. We also have an issue where they drilled through the outer (fence) wall and that entire section is cracked from their hole to the top of the wall.

A friend and I went to Flix for the first time last night and had a great experience. Everyone was very friendly and helpful. We sampled a beer and a cider, then decided on wine (a decent wine selection in spite of this being a beer place-no hard liquor available, though). 

We ordered our meals right after sitting down and received them quickly. She had a meatloaf sandwich she really liked and I had a margherita pizza that was yummy. They have pull out desk-like tables for each seat, which worked well. 

We found the whole experience to be very positive and will definitely return!

Seated very quickly. Waitress was very sweet.  The ambiance was casual and inviting.  Ordered a pizza and trio appetizer. It took 45 minutes to get our food. Everything was extremely salty. The $24 pizza was also soggy. I blame myself for even ordering a pizza for $24. I do plan on returning just in case my next visit will be better.

So my father-in-law brings me a pizza from this location every weekend for his granddaughter and it's always a cheese pizza so the box even says cheese pizza open it up and my daughter says it doesn't taste right finds out there's bacon on it I called the store to complain about it and they said well bring it back I tell them the problem is I'm 40 minutes away from you and they said well you have to bring it back so we can investigate why there's bacon on it that's a no-brainer but the simple fact is for a $1za

Why do they put these things in phlly? its jam packed on any given day of the week. it's as clean as it can be for place with 3 million people at any given time of the day. and parking.....yeah right. 
Pros: it's only a few month out of the year, the atmosphere screams WINTER WONDERLAND
Cons: everything else.
it's not my thing but you might like it. go. park, spend $20 to park in a seedy place, enjoy yourself.

These idiots want $15 an hour and they can't even be nice or get an order right??? Guy taking the orders got upset when we said we had more on the order then tried to apologize about it. Then we got the completely wrong order. You get paid less because you can't get things right. This McDonald's is garbage.

I bought 2 banh mi... I got banh mi thit nuong and thit nguoi... it was verrrry good.. I just wished the baguette was not as crusty... I hate having the baguette toasted..  I hate the crumbs.. 

Overall the banh mi were good... alittle bit more meat wouldnt hurt though...

Bubble teas are good as well.. my fav is taro bubble tea

this place is AMAZING! we ordered takeout and everything was delicious, packaged well, and seasoned perfectly! we got the buffalo wings, pulled pork sandwich, fried fish, baked mac and cheese, and ribs - definitely a hidden gem

I tried to have my first ever Eggs Benedict and BOY was I disappointed when I touched my fork to the soft head of the egg and experienced no ooze but instead a hard, crumbly yolk. BUMMER. Also, I was given only one half of a hard muffin but would have enjoyed the other half. Sue me and my carb loving heart!

My impression was that they didn't know how to accommodate the 6 of us and our different brunch orders while keeping my poached egg poachy (runny?). This wasn't an isolated experience, my friend ordered the same meal and same disappointingly hard yolk. Another friend had her spongy omelette arrive after we were done eating.

So I am still technically an Eggs Benedict virgin. Look out Bennys, here I come!

What a great addition to our area! The food is excellent, fresh and I haven't found anything like it since we were stationed in Hawaii. The Poke is authentic and high quality with amazing flavors. The restaurant is very cute and spotless - with a lot of drink options. The staff is friendly and provide great service. We will definitely be back!
The Wake-n-Bake was SOOOOOOOO good!!    The waffle had bacon and sausage baked into it and the bacon was still crispy.   One of the best breakfasts I have ever had.

This is a place worth seeing even you aren't planning on sitting through any sort of cinematic feature. This place was build during the golden age of cinema and has that old theater look to it, with much of the original Art Deco décor still inside.

This place is great! I just moved into the apartments next door so I come in quite a bit and the whole staff is very friendly and enjoyable to be around when I come in. The food is great and never had anything bad to say about anything here.

As airports go, our is pretty nice.  What we lack in restaurant and shop choice, we gain in convenience.

I fly two or three times a month and a rarely see security lines with over a 10 minute wait.  The shuttle service to long and short term parking runs continuously.  The rental cars are all on site and quickly accessible.  The flow of the airport makes a lot of sense.  

The walk to C-26 is pretty long, so I hope one day they'll consider a people mover.  The traffic flow getting in and back to the terminal is pretty confusing during the construction, but you just need to watch the signs.  The cell phone waiting zone is perfectly placed with great sign flight alerts.  

Finally, it's close the city.  It seems you can be at our airport in a matter of minutes from anywhere.  When I land in Denver, Kansas City or Atlanta, I know I have another trip after I get on the ground. Nashville...nah...it's simple!

The other reviewers are on the money: with all the other LA Fitnesses (LA Fitnessi?) in the surrounding areas, this location is clearly not a top (or any) priority at Corporate. 

When I went in yesterday, there were no fewer than FIVE treadmills with "OUT OF ORDER" signs on them. In fairness, I usually have no problem getting on the equipment I need, but that's largely because I tend to go when it's not crowded. 

The interior of this place is in rough shape--the rugs are old and bare, the roof does indeed leak (I've also seen the buckets during and after rain storms), and every once in awhile it apparently becomes necessary to set out rat traps in the mens' locker room (I've never seen any rats in them--I'm not sure whether that's a good or bad thing). Several years ago, the plumbing in the mens' bathroom backed up and flooded the entire bathroom/shower/changing area with standing water--and by "water" I mean "sewage"--that was in place for at least a couple of days. Management's response was to DRY and CLEAN--not replace--the carpeting (!) that was at that time in place in the locker room. Several months later, the powers that be saw fit to replace the carpeting with tile. For me, this anecdote pretty much summarizes the attitude LA Fitness has toward its Havertown facility.

Also, this place has a tendency to cycle through staff--at least at the front desk. The crew that's there now seems to be decent enough, but there have been some real...interesting...folks there at different times. When my child was younger, I did take advantage of the Kidz Klub services a couple of times, but I was never comfortable with the attentiveness, competence, or friendliness of the child care staff (or of the cleanliness of the kids' area), so I stopped doing that (which my child shed no tears over).

All that said, the hours and location are convenient (for me) and I've been an active member here for the last 8 years (I've also invested a small fortune in shower shoes, for obvious reasons). But when the new Y opens up on Eagle Road, I expect to be moving my fitness center dollars. I strongly suspect I won't be the only one.

I am so glad we decided to check this place out! We have been trying to get in to OwowCow in Chalfont but their lines are always too long which tells me their service isn't that great so we came here. They have do many choices and the ice cream is amazing, we were served in 5 minutes and we really enjoyed it! We will definitely be back often!!!

It is unfortunate that I have to give such a low review of this place, due to its fame. I am a bit biased since I don't like cheesesteaks in the first place. This place is overpriced and way too touristy for me. There are only a few tables and there are people constantly standing by you, so you have no privacy. Plus, it is quite loud. We went when it was cold and windy, so it added to the experience. They had a nice menu, quite large. The sandwiches are a bit small and are overpriced. I could get a Subway steak sandwich which will probably be of similar quality, which is cheaper and bigger. The steak itself was so bland and fatty. The cheese wasn't that good, I personally don't enjoy it. I feel that this place is overrated and the sandwiches are just average at best. Plus, service isn't friendly, just quick.

One bite everybody knows the rules.... Had to go back just to make sure this is how all their pizzas come and sure enough it is. Picked up a slice and everything slid right off. 3.8/10 Gave them that extra point for being straight up. Common frankie spend a couple more bucks on the cheese and pepperonis...

We tried out The Swamp Room on a Friday after work for happy hour for a change of scenery from our normal spot. It was awesome! Cheap drinks, lots of beers on tap, quick service, what more can you ask for? It's a perfect divey spot to unwind with a cold draft after a long week. Can't wait until I can go back after this COVID-19 mess and try more of their menu.

Stopped in with my kids and wife. Greeted by a beautiful smile, sat down, and were introduced to a character of a waiter. Looked like a pirate(Chris M.)! The corn and calm chowder was amazing. Fish tacos and jumbalaya was perfect. I would come back anytime. Margaritaville rocks!

Went there last night as they were closing - the welcomed us in - a group of 6 of us - and the cheesecake was excellent.  Service was great and the folks were very accomodating.  The band that they have on Friday nights was already breaking down, so we missed that - we'll have to get there early next time.  I recommend it highly.

This is hands down the best museum I've ever been to and I've been to most of the Smithsonian museums. They have several interactive exhibits that make you feel like you are right there fighting in World War II.
If you are ever in New Orleans you cannot miss this place. It took us 3 days to go through and see everything.

After Getting in contact with several companies and totally fail due to high sky prices or nasty attitude(which I totally don't get) Somehow I got to Washington Kitchen online
I called them and asked them a bunch of questions, which for my surprise were answered very politely and even though they didn't knew I was going to spend money they still treated me amazing. Long Story Short  Steve Was amazing in the explanation of prices and materials and helping to match granite with counter cabinets 
WOow! What an experience!!! I love my new basement Kitchen prices are super affordable, Gorgeous Granites, deliveries on time by experienced and friendly people.
The whole experience totally exceeds my expectations. Will definitely getting back to Steve to remodel my main kitchen.

We were in the Maryland Heights area of St. Louis for a convention, and a friend recommended we go to Sugarfire.  We were prefaced with a few bits of sage advice, which I will pass on here: there will be a line; there could be difficulty finding a place to sit; it will all be worth it. 

I'm from the Kansas City area, and Kansas City and St. Louis aren't quite eye-to-eye on what constitutes barbecue, but whether you are wet or dry, pork or beef, spicy or sweet, you can still recognize quality slow-cooked and smoked meats.  Sugarfire has them.  They also feature Double Cola beverages, a smaller regional beverage-maker out of Tennessee, so this could be a place to get your unique regional soda fix.

Sugarfire operates cafeteria-style, and patrons wait in a line to get to the counter / kitchen to order.  Food is dished up and put on your tray or is marked down on the paper underlayment of your tray for later delivery.  We were met with the line and the small size of the dining room, it didn't look as though the number of people in line would fit in the seats in the dining room, much less that enough of the dining room would turn over to make seats available by the time we made it to the front of the line and got our food.  But, as the restaurant deities often smile down on you just when you need it most, a table opened up just as we all were receiving our food. 

I ordered the Big Muddy.  Big is an understatement for this brisket-and-smoked-sausage sandwich.  I believe I attacked it with knife and fork for 5-10 minutes (because it would have been ridiculous to attempt to hoist it to my mouth).  All the while I was trying to eat bits of the Big Muddy, I was also plowing through the sizable bowl of beans I had ordered as a side.  The beans were rather good on their own, though I enjoyed enhancing them with the espresso barbecues.

Another big key of the dining experience at Sugarfire is selection of sauces.  I'm not sure we ended up getting them all, but we had 6-7 bottles of different sauces on the table, from the bold coffee barbecue sauce, to a horseradish sauce, to a tangy mustard, to several other spicy and sweet barbecue sauces.

We also ordered some of the pork belly hushpuppies.  These were good, though not quite what I expected.  As best as I can judge, they are merely cooked in pork fat (which is rather tasty), but I was thinking they would have blocks of belly in them.  They also come with a rather good, sweet, neon green jalapeno jelly. 

Our final element was a smoked chocolate chip cookie, which is apparently a regular chocolate chip cookie that is cooked in the smoker along with the meats.  While it was a good cookie, I didn't really get any smoke flavor on it.

One further element that Sugarfire has going for it is some booze shakes - friends got the chocolate peanut butter bourbon shake, and it was delicious.

On a side note, my wife and I had a mishap in the kitchen a couple of weeks ago where sugar caught on fire.  A real sugar fire can be serious business.  YMMV.

All around delicious specialty dining. All of the foodis prepared meticulously. The seafood recipes crafted to a very special level of uniqueness. Top notch service. Must try everything!

With all of that, my favorite cool little thing is the way they serve the Caesar Salad. Trust me...order it...it's fun food :)

So, I had this craving for pies - been missing the pie shop in Occoquan VA, that I often visited. From the moment I walked into Pie Lady Café, I knew this was going to be one of my regular places. The place is cute, very warm ambience and nice outdoor seating. I just bought a few slices to go--mixed berry pie, coconut custard pie, coconut scone and feta/spinach quiche. I warmed the mixed berry pie and it was simply wonderful - plenty of fruit and the crumble was just perfect. Just waiting now to share the coconut pie with Ben...mmmmmmm ;-)
Can't wait to go back this weekend! Oh I had their coffee - awesome La Colombe coffee (I was a regular in DC)!

On vacation in St Pete. Ran across a Groupn for this place and decided to try it out.. I am not a big seafood lover, however the other members of my party absolutely love seafood and were craving scallops. this is a quaint little place on the river next to a big marina. All the seating is outside. The service was good, but the flies were horrible, they were all over everything. we got the grilled Grouper with Scallops, the grouper was just ok, it had a more fishy taste than use to. The scallops were very good. I being the land lubber got the fajitas, never get fajitas at a seafood restaurant, totally hit the mark on that one, the tortillas were all stuck together and the chicken was tasteless. The salsa tasted like it cam straight out of a jar and there was no guacamole with it. The kids got the hamburger and pizza stcks were they really enjoyed.

Gave this place a try for dinner, sad to say I didn't love it. It was okay/ decent but the menu descriptions did not live up to the taste I was expecting. The crab cake almost had a pumpkin, cinnamon taste, 2 out of three of us did not like it. The goat cheese croquette was a huge let down as well. The braised short rib was very good I will say. The service was very good and the two deserts we shared, the apple crisp and the peanut butter mouse were incredible.

They specialize in tab building with dopey specials
Overpriced
Go to a byob. Lacks an individual feel

Four of us had dinner at Brasserie. For appetizers we ordered the cheese platter (fromage) and steak tartare. We also had several rounds of cocktails, 2 cod entrees, the braised beef entree, and the cassoulet entree. We had a bottle of ranard wine with our meal, then finished with the floating island and profiteroles desserts with Kaldi's coffee. We spent 2.25 hours there. 

Food Quality: A
Food Quantity: B+
Cleanliness: A
Design & Decor: B- 
Noise Level: A
Staff Friendliness: B+
Server Food & Beverage Knowledge: A

OVERALL GRADE: A-  (Although pricey, I will eat at Brasserie again)

PROS: French food quality was excellent -- the entree sauces made the meals. The cocktails were really good and the steak tartare made our tastebuds break dance. I could eat the cod entree every day of the week. They also have $3 valet parking. 

CONS: Our server was knowledgeable and professional but could have been friendlier. The booth that is against the west wall is not comfortable and is a much lower height than the chairs. The tables for the booth seating are too close to one another - it makes it difficult to get up without bumping into the next table.

I used to hate this place, but was craving sushi so the husband and I gave it a shot. We ordered the AYCE thinking we would get small rolls like the normal AYCE places. NOPE!! The rolls were huge probably 10-12 pieces each so we ordered WAY too much food. We felt bad so we sat there forever trying to finish the dinner lol. It was good and fresh. I would order the suchi again but probably not eh AYCE. And you get a free drink with Yelp check in.

first, poi dog the shop is actually located between chestnut and sansom.  the map on yelp got me all confused saying it's on ludlow!

i tried the shoyu ahi tuna bowl (reg size) and boy! did it fill me up!  the serving bowl is quite small or maybe i just wasn't used to small serving dishes.   most restaurants now a days use mainly oversized bowls and plates i feel~  anyway, DO NOT underestimate the amount of food in the small bowl! the portion was decent for $12.75 (pretax) but yes i always prefer it to be cheaper.. lol the bowl holds plenty of fish and opulent amount of rice for one.  honestly i had trouble finishing it and didn't leave room for anything else~
flavor wise, it was solid! i love the classic hawaiian poke with the shoyu, sesame oil and seeds with some scallion and onion.  they also mixed a little bit of ginger with it which i didn't mind! overall a pretty good balance between all the sauces.  i was pretty content with it since i feel like it's sooo hard to find the classic classic poke. 

i did order a musubi for fun thinking the poke bowl would not be enough for me lol and it was alright~ typical musubi... i wanted to dunk the chunk of rice into furikake but that's just me lol i probably wouldn't get it again since it's just spam and rice.

i'm looking forward to returning to try some other poke dishes! the local hawaiian dishes-- maaaaybe.. that side of the menu had too much fried stuff for me though
This place is amazing! Great food,affordable and absolutely beautiful. If your in the philly area, this is a place you don't want to miss.

So happy I found this gem!! Saw them on the corner driving to Safeway and it's just what I've been looking for!  I always crave Hawaiian shaved ice and this not only satisfies my craving but the soft ice is so much better. Would definitely recommend and cannot wait to go back!

We travel all over the country for business, and Walgreens is an easy, consistent place to get necessary items.  We had the misfortune stopping by this Walgreens to grab drinks.  We travel in a large group and made up about a third of the line waiting to check out.  We had about 6 people in front of us and 6 people behind us.  They graciously opened another line at the cosmetics counter to help alleviate the back up.  All of the people behind us went to cosmetics.  Since we were together, we decided to just patiently wait our turn.  The cashier, who identified herself as Cheryl Cook, stopped checking out customers and yelled "why aren't you moving?  I said cosmetics was open!  MOVE!"  I was appalled, but we all went to the other line without saying a word.  She then decided that that wasn't rude enough, and followed up with "What?  You don't speak english?"  There are no less than 8 other Walgreens in the city of New Orleans.  If you happen to be passing through, I would suggest finding another one unless verbal abuse while shopping is your thing.

Unfortunately this review comes after personal sadness. But a few of my family members have utilized them for their end of life care. Most recently the last 2 weeks. 
The folks here are angels from heaven. They could not be more helpful, compassionate, and caring. This includes the front office staff, nurses, aides, doctors, etc. They truly understand end of life care, and ensuring dignity and pain free for the patient is top of mind. They offer many services including grief counseling. 
I can't recommend them enough or thank them enough for what they've done for my family.

This review is strictly based on the upstairs private rooms since I attended a baby shower here. If I lived in Tampa, this would be my top choice for a place to throw my baby shower. Actually, my friend who's shower it was wanted this place after attending one here herself!

The room was nice and most importantly, the staff was just perfection!!!!! They went above and beyond for every guest's desire! They were beyond accommodating! The food was great too. The tomato, mozzerella, and basil salad was a nice touch for an appetizer, as was the calamari which was great! I had the lasagna for my meal which I would give 3.5/4 out of 5 stars to, and it was served with a nice chopped salad beforehand (no cheese for me which they graciously accommodated!) They brought everyone to-go boxes, and then helped with the trash during the gift opening. 

The best part..the staff brought ALL the gifts out to the car parked in the garage and loaded it themselves! Nice touch and great shower!!!!
Awesome selection of brewed coffees.. love this place!  Pleasant servers and good atmosphere and dog friendly outside!

We (APAPA Tri-Valley Chapter) just hosted a Lunar New Year Celebration sponsored in part by the city of Dublin.  What a pleasure to work with Alvin.  He is professional, talented, and thoroughly entertaining.  I got many calls and notes expressing their appreciation of such a wonderful show yesterday.  Nothing but raving reviews about his act.  Hours later, everyone is still talking about the magical moment, and how it could be done.  Thanks for being so awesome, Alvin!

We were here for a work dinner and we had an Uber ride home.  SO, the meal was expensed and we didn't have to drive.  Great combination!

The beer and cocktail list are stunning; and the wait-staff are well versed in the various beers and libations.  Kudos to them!  

The appetizer portions could have been more generous, but that left room for me to open up some serious noshing on the main course. 
 Because I'm on a Nashville Chicken kick right now, that's what I ordered and it showed up with a side of sweet potato pancakes.  That's heaven on a plate!  

I'd highly recommend swinging into the Yard House the next time your travels bring you to Indy.  It was definitely better than most of the other places we typically eat when we're in the downtown Indy area.

Totally disappointing....drove all the way out there to watch football in their new sports area they have been advertising. If you are not lucky enough to get on their high rollers reservation list don't even go.  Because you don't really have a chance of getting to enjoy the game. Manager that sat us rude!, and when we asked to move to a table where we could enjoy the game because they had at least 15 booths or tables with better views open but reserved so can't move.  No thanks!!

This is a Chinatown staple for Philly. They hold weird hours, I think they're open for dinner most nights and Friday lunches (but I could be wrong). Anywho, Joe and I ordered to go from here since we didn't feel like the hassle of looking for parking in Chinatown. We split two dishes. And staying true to the spirit of take out, we didn't use any of our own dishes or utensils to save the trouble of doing dishes later on.

This dish was amazing but tiny! for the price, I would've thought the box would've been more than 1/3 full. come on! the pieces of white meat were dredged in a flour batter and deep fried and then cooked in a black bean based sauce. I liked that the black bean flavor didn't overwhelm the other elements going on here (dried red peppers? garlic?)

the salt baked shrimp and scallop is my favorite in all of Chinatown (that's right, I'm putting my 2 cents down). I'm not a fan of squid but luckily Joe eats everything so this worked out for us both. Usually when you eat it at a restaurant, the batter is crispy but since we had gotten it to go, the batter had a chance to become a bit soggy. whoops! fortunately, this is a testament to this dish, when I ate it, it was still delicious!

This place never disappoints!! The food is so good and awesome for the prices! I think the best part are the wings, the sweet and sour are the best in my opinion. The habanero ones are not for the faint of heart, they're extremely spicy (and I can usually tolerate spice!) not to say they aren't tasty though! They're also very filling so you can easily get full off one order of them and probably enough for a snack the next day! 
I've also had their pizza but I thought it was a bit too oily for my taste but that might've been due to the vegan cheese, it was still tasty though. The vegan cheesesteak was a little odd, maybe because I've never had a cheesesteak I can't compare it to the actual taste, but the fake cheez whiz didn't sit right with me. 
Overall, this is a great place to try some amazing vegan food!
I'm picky about my cuts and this place is legit. Easily the best shop in Santa Barbara. Quit procrastinating and get in there! You'll be glad you did.
Yummy boba tea! I'm so happy there's a place near me! Lots of choices and a nice location.

Love this place!  Very relaxing, modern, and top of the line products and facility. Everyone was so welcoming and friendly. We brought in wine, and they provided glasses and re-poured when we got low. Prices were very reasonable for what you get. I had the pedi with the paraffin treatment and it was amazing. Had a very great experience. I will go back and bring friends!

Disappointed. Ordered the French toast waffle and it is literally just one waffle. Luckily ordered 2 eggs on the side for an extra $$ so wasn't completely starving. I'm not at all a big person, but I can't justify paying $9 for one waffle? Husband got the BLT with fried green tomato which was okay not great. We live in the CWE and haven't had a chance to go here yet but there are too many other good restaurants to spend our time at. Can't complain about service at all (we were here at like 2pm on Columbus Day though and no one was there) and sat outside which was great- just have to give it 2 stars bc of the food for the $.

Went to Clementine's based on Yelp reviews.  

The food was great!  The four of us sampled each others food and it was all terrific!  

The waitress was fantastic!  She took the time to talk to us and answer all our questions and then some friendly chit-chat.  We felt right at home!

The pies were awesome!  Again we sampled each others pies and they were all winners.

As we were leaving the waitress introduced us to the owner, now in her eighties, who actually makes all the pies herself.

It's not cheap but we would go back in a heartbeat.

The pizza is great reminds of NY. I will go back and try other stuff on menu. As long as they keep service friendly quality up. All I can say to a place like this is we are in a time where people can voice their opinions online. What that means is we have an outlet to recognize places like this. And I hope they stay just remember that the customer is number one and brandon pizza will be here to stay.

I've been coming here since I was a kid and nothing has changed. Great food, great service, excellent atmosphere. Everything on the menu is phenomenal. The pizza, chicken parm, calzones and breadsticks are mouth-watering. I had family staying on the beach a few weeks ago, and as soon as they said "Pizza", I sent them straight to Pizza Shack. Definitely the best pizza spot in town!

My first time - won't be last!!!  Smoky aromas hit you when you enter.  Everything is home made  my guest had the daily sausage sandwich. Excellent texture and flavour  my sandwich was filled with tender beef cheese and their homemade candied beets  large portions rustic decor. Open kitchen.   Vegans stay home although their roasted veg side dish was great!!!!
I need to go back and try brunch! real meat. Real cooking. Oh and dark rye.  Yum
Delish! The crust is crave-worthy... crispy edges with a soft fluffy inside. Loads of cheese and toppings. Will definitely order again!

Q Cleaners is the best cleaners in Cherry Hill.  Not only is the service great but the owner (Donna) does a wonderful job at making you feel like her personal customer and friend.  There are a variety of services offered with each being done professionally and with the utmost care as if your clothes were their clothes.  The cleaning technique is organic which is another indication of the professionalism Q Cleaners gives your clothes.

Stop by and drop off your clothes and you will not be disappointed by the work or the great customer services Q Cleaners gives to their customers.  I promise you you won't want to go anyplace else!!

The best gelato I've had this side of the Atlantic besides maybe capo giro in center city. They are true crafters. Great coffee as well. And I love the interior.  Get the mascarpone or sea salt caramel that is made with pink Himalayan sea salt.

The place was alright,i was there last night  I had the papaya salad which was ok, and the green curry, which was a little too runny for my blood. But I really liked the eggplants in my soup/ curry.I think their closed on sundays.  They use a lot of fresh ingrediants and thats the only reason I'd go back that and the service was pretty bad ass. My waiter was bursting with information and he was real cheerful and happy which made for a really good experience. I also wish I had brought some pinot grigio too..

We were in the mood for light and easy... this is the place.  The draft beer menu could use more choices, however the food was good.  Nothing fancy, basic southern cajun.  I expected the jumbalaya to be soupy (it was not) but still tasty.  Food arrived quick and they had good service.

We dined at Margot for our 29th anniversary weekend. We love the ambience and the cozy feel of the place. The waitstaff is friendly, knowledgeable, patient, and attentive. We very much enjoyed the new middle-eastern infusion of the dishes, from the meatball with tahini starters, to the chocolate tahini tart with cardamom ice cream for dessert. Our main courses, the grilled mackerel and the pork tenderloin, were cooked perfectly and tender. The environment of the restaurant is energized with the sound of laughter and conversation, while the music stays very much in the background, as it should be. It's exciting to see that Margot Café remains one of the Best in a town with a large selection of new trendy competitive eateries available.

I love their pizza, but hate the south philly attitude you get from the ladies that work there. The place is literally a 4 x 4 room and it kinda reminds me of the soup nazi they get really snippy there, but it won't stop me from getting amazing pizza in this city where good pizza is hardly found.

The Hilton Garden s certainly conveniently located in Center City just blocks from City Hall. It is adjacent to the Pennsylvania Convention Center which was my destination. There is convenient parking, premiumly priced as is the hotel. I had to request a coffeemaker and blowdrier. Overall a good stay

Car shopping can be overwhelming. I had been shopping around for about two months with no luck and faced terrible experiences at car dealerships. A friend of mine highly recommended New Century Motors of Santa Barbara and I decided to check it out.

As soon as I walked in I was greeted by Santiago. He was so kind, polite and patient. I was pretty clueless on what I wanted. He was attentive to my needs and took the time to get to know me better to help me figure out what I might like.

I ended up going home with a brand new Jeep, and I couldn't be happier. Thanks to Santiago for going above and beyond the customer satisfaction expectations. I highly recommend going here for your next vehicle purchase !!

Great little cafe in the Wiregrass Ranch shoppes. Really good crepes and sandwiches but the main thing is the gelato. Really rich and really good. 

Very friendly staff and nice atmosphere. A must go if you are in the area.

Went to The Yachtsman on a Sunday afternoon to meet some friends. The tiki bar decor is unlike anything that currently exists in Philadelphia. Had the Missionary's Downfall, which was a fantastic cocktail with rum, peach puree, lime, honey, and mint. Please be aware that there is a $15.00 minimum charge for credit cards.

I visited this location during Mardi Gras. It came with raving reviews. However, the reviews were far from unfounded. I sat at the bar and waited about 20 minutes before being able to order drinks. I ordered food and had to send each item back twice. I spoke with the manager who was dismissive at best. He offered no means to give his staff the opportunity to make things right. It was only until I asked for the GM that anything changed. While this location is cute and the concept is nice, it's not somewhere I have to try again, nor will I recommend this establishment to anyone else. For those who want to try this spot, best of luck!

These people are nothing but crooks!! I had walked in here because they towed my car for no apparent reason and they expect me to pay $200+. They claim that they have to pay their tow truck drivers to go pick up a car that is 2 minutes up the road!! I then see my car in the back with a bunch of other smashed cars. (John,Anthony) said that in order to have my car that I would have to pay that much money. Therefore obviously I disagree and try to get them to release my car to me. Anyway, to make a long story short after cops have to come I had to pay $175 for them to get my car to the towing place 2 minutes up the road and a $75 (no key) entry fee. That was an easy $175 bucks for them in less than 5 minutes!!

Well the Bartender made me two very good mason jar margaritas but I thought for the price the king crab legs would have been better, kind of soft and over steamed, more amounts of sides would have been great.  My mistake for not complaining because I believe they would have brought me more.  Good service and friendly staff.
Great food here.  Do you like coconut and curry? They do too, and it shows.  Great recipes and preparation. Come hungry.

HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!!! Best Pizza Joint Ever! My family was traveling back from spring break and we were looking for exactly this! We ordered 3 small pizzas (due to dietary requirements) and the four of us finished it all with full tummies! This place had it all: great pizza, great prices, great service, & who doesn't love supporting a local business! It was a little out off the interstate, but well worth the extra 2-3 min to get there!!

Lunch on a weekday. Reminded me of my favorite place in chi-town in the South Loop, the one Barack Obama used to frequent, with all the politicoes, cops, lawyers, homeless people, and various nutjobs all squashed together. 

Sweetie Pie's in fact has fewer rough edges, but also fewer surprises on its menus. 

It was just solid, decent food. I had the baked chicken with gravy - cooked just right. Okra was perfect. Excellent mashed potatotes. Didn't have room for the pie but it looked good. These guys could be on the Wikepedia entry for "comfort food."

I went here awhile back (like Q1 2015) when it was Santa Barbara Wine Spa, I am not sure what business name they go by now (Soma Get Fit, Santa Barbara Sparkling Spa) but I am sure my comments are relevant there as well. Needless to say it is very shady that the location has moved and changed names so many times. 

I've never had a professional massage prior to my experience at Santa Barbara Wine Spa but maybe my expectations are too high...I didn't enjoy it and honestly I was so bored I fell asleep. It was an expensive nap...whatever, I didn't feel compelled to go out of my way and review based on this. The customer service was awkward so to speak, heavy up-selling and strong arming about tipping. Again, I didn't feel comfortable reviewing because I have no experiences to compare Santa Barbara Wine Spa to.

After seeing what harassment another Yelper had undergone I decided to leave a review for anyone looking to do business with whatever Scott Crawford wants to call his business. Obviously a name and location cannot stick for whatever reason, perhaps he doesn't like the feedback that follows. I understand his business has trouble with the volume of people booking through Groupon and has difficulty honoring their deal purchases...perhaps he should stop selling more Groupons then. 

Snarky "compliments" and harassing messages are just one of the many flavors of love one should expect from Scott. Even a year later, he cannot accept some negative feedback - despite a generous Yelp rating bolstered by fake reviews. He will call you too, my friend described the tone as one of a scorned ex-lover. 

Again, I didn't want to leave this feedback I was perfectly happy with my life and had moved on. But when you poke the bear, the bear will poke back. I would strongly discourage people from dealing with this business, whatever the name will be in the future because it won't be static at any point.

This is a small place with a very intimate atmosphere. They have a great bourbon selection and the server and owner really knew about all the Bourbons and were generous with their knowledge. We had the burgers which were cooked perfectly with some really wonderful baking to accompany them.

The best car dealer and service I ever had
I am in good hands.
The car is great so is the people and the service.
I will stay with forever

I'd be too embarassed to tell you how much HELL I put this shop through with saddle exchanges, warranty replacements, and doing everything possible to make me happy, so I'll just tell you, that I put this shop through HELL trying to find the right road saddle.
Honestly, I think it's all in a day's work for these guys. Everything they did was "no problem," or "no worries." Easily, the coolest bunch of cats in cycling retail I've ever done business with, and I've been riding and shopping bikes for many years.
When I first discovered the shop, I thought, o.k., they are a Specialized and Pinarello dealer, these guys are going to be total snobs. 
Boy, was I wrong. They are all totally down to earth, real cyclists, and understand what a pain in the ass it can be, to find a saddle that isn't a pain in the ass. If you've been through it, you know what I'm talking about.
Everyone there is very knowledgeable and they all get out and ride some real miles.
I just have to say that Stan, the owner, Kevin, the GM, and Ron, the sales guy, really are incredibly patient and down to earth. 
The shop is huge and comfortable to shop in, with PLENTY of elbow room.
They even have employees that clean up the drool from gawking at all the carbon bikes. Just kidding, but maybe not. LOL
I was there one Sunday, and they had 2 huge boxes of cupcakes for the customers. I had rolled the dice that day and brought my 6 year old son, hoping he wasn't going to pester me while I was doing some shopping or play around on a $4000 bike and break something, but I gave him a cupcake and parked him in the mini-lounge in the middle of the store and he was totally happy. All he needed was some SpongeBob on the TV, but I didn't want to be TOO ridiculous that day, but they WOULD probably do it, "no problem!"
So, if you're shopping for a bike, or just need accessories or repair, I would totally recommend this shop.

Rob P

What's not to like about this place?

The sweet aroma lured me into this narrow and crowded candy store. The ladies working there were just as sweet as their praline!

The regular praline was not too bad, but I liked their sweet potato praline much better. (Disclaimer: I love anything with sweet potatoes!!!) Caramel tortues were soft, sweet, chewy, crunchy, and absolutely delicious. I can't believe how buttery the pecan bits tasted.

We also got a chocolate-covered Oreo and chocolate-covered peanut butter sandwich (which had an obscene amount of peanut butter sandwiched between Ritz crackers and completely coated in chocolate). They were not too bad, but they were not as memorable as the caramel tortues!!
I've been here a couple times while visiting Nashville for work and it's easily THE most classy and upscale version of deja vu

Here is all you need to know - 

Lansdale has a new pizza god. Bow down.

The food is authentic and the portions are huge! Table-side salsa made to your heat preference is a great touch - and the guacamole table-side is worth the spend! Our server - Luis - did a great job explaining everything and ensuring the experience was excellent! We will return when we are in town again!

This Taco Bell is not like the others.  The person who took my order was cheerful while being thorough.  Both people working at the windows were extremely polite and again cheerful.  I got my food quick and it was not only accurate but hot and fresh.  I was thrown off at first by the experience so I went back a second time today.  To my surprise I had an equally cheerful experience.  I don't eat Taco Bell a lot, but the service you get at this one makes me want to eat it more.  The manager and the associates of this establishment should be commended.

Went in for a oil change and asked to check the breaks since the break light was on. Received a phone call later explaining that I had to replace ALL rotors and breaks immediately along with finding a leak in my break hose. I was then quoted $927.00. I asked to just perform an oil change. When I went to pay $27.00 for the oil change the gentleman then included I needed a new battery all of a sudden (battery was 1 year old). 

I went and got another opinion at another shop in Castleton which had been rated 5 stars on Yelp. Come to find out I was in no danger with my breaks and rotors, also while finding no break hose leak and my battery was in perfect condition. I was suggested that I would begin thinking about replacing rotors and breaks while I still had time. I told them since they were honest to go ahead and replace them on a different date later that week. I was quoted $600 for EVERYTHING including break fluid that was low (which was why my break light was on). I do not recommend Firestone because I believe they give auto shops a bad name trying to make an extra buck. Hope this helps someone.
Love the products, the atmosphere and most of all the staff. Angela gives the best haircuts, actually listens to what you want and takes great care of her clients.

Not the best. I have to say honestly the worst made old fashioned I've found at such a nice welcoming steak house. The desert, while pretty, wasnt made well either. Their interpretation of cremè brulee was more like pudding with a browned sugar topping. The service and staff were wonderful though. So if I ever have the misfortune of going again, im hopeful for better food and drink. Because no improvements necessary on atmosphere and staff.

This is more about a specific donut than an overall restaurant experience. 

I haven't had a Krispy Kreme donut in probably 3 years. But the other night my bestie shared a special treat with me: KRISPY KREME KING CAKE DONUT. It was on my mind for weeks. So, I went. The only KK in an hour+ radius is located on Clearview parkway. And it's actually pretty accessible (or maybe my sugar-depraved mind thought it was) because if you're headed south on Clearview it's an easy turn-around, and if you're on Metairie Rd you'll make an easy turn. I went through the drive thru. They were fast and courteous. I ordered 8 king cake and 4 others (just so they didn't think I was some kind of monster. Or maybe I was just trying to convince myself) and bit into the donut before even putting my car back in gear. **drooool** if you're jonesing for king cake it's the perfect single serving portion.

I was in the food court not sure what to get and I got a sample of teriyaki chicken from here as I was walking by. It was really good so I wanted some! I got the chicken teriyaki with white rice. I ordered double meat which was only $1.99. Not too bad of a price. The price was pretty good overall for the whole meal! It was really filling! Definitely would eat here again and recommend it.

Worth a second, third visit for sure. Gotta check out that drink list. The octopus was tender and tasty, short ribs tasted like stew meat...my coworker had the lamb and I will have to try that for sure. The service is slow and could be a little friendlier.

The food was delicious. But what stood out the most to me was the great, warm and welcoming customer service. 
I had a chicken platter.

Ever heard the song "Hideaway" from the Pajama Game?
THIS IS IT!!!

We had to give a password through the door peep-hole and then we were in.
Very Dark... 
suggestion:  have a flashlight ready on your camera.

We started off with some traditional prohibition era drinks....
And then went to our standard beers.

The Chef came out and had a lengthy conversation with my b/f which made it a very personable experience.

Since we were only doing appetizers, 
We started off with ESCARGOT.
Yum!  Cooked perfectly.

Then we ordered :

CHARCUTERIE-
International meats and cheeses served with fruit, olives, figs and nuts, in a truffle drizzle - $14
Outstanding!!!
Please refer to my pic.

We didn't know complimentary bread with drizzled oil and spices would be also served.

Needless to say, between all 3 dishes, that was our dinner!

I took my camera since we were having a date day out. 
GLAD I DID.  

I hope you enjoy my pictures... 
We were there at the opening, so I was lucky not to have a lot of people around.
The crowd starting coming in around 6:30.

I LOVE the Sister's Tea house. We hosted a bridal shower for my friend here and it was a huge success. The venue is very Beautiful! We did not have to decorate at all since the house is already decorated, The tables had beautiful white lace and hot pink table clothe with flower centerpieces. The staff were really helpful, nice, and available to help with setting up/cleaning. We brought our own food, utensils,  and drinks. Also, the venue is extremely affordable. I would highly recommend this venue for bridal or baby showers.

Domino's Pizza. 

There's alot to say as a pizza Domino's is my go to delivery. After a few brewski's or in a midnight cram session Dominos is a hero of many Villanova students. This Domino's is quick, courteous, and the food is delicious. I ordered chicken wings and they were dynamite. There online ordering is amazing it's super easy and allows you to pay with a credit card! Domino's gets it.

This place is great! Stopped in for a quick manicure and Mindy got me right in, and gave me the best man-icure I've ever had. Definitely must try this place! I'll be coming back the next time I'm in town for sure.

I have been taking my car to Don's (found him on Yelp btw) and I highly recommend his services. He is amazingly quick and he is extremely fairly priced. The best thing is that you can truly trust him. Today I brought my car in for inspection. I knew I needed work on my brakes. I dropped the car off at 9am. He did the inspection, replaced my rear brake pads and a headlight that was out and called me at 10:19 am to tell me the car was done. I'm so pleased with Don's and all my friends who have used him feel the same way

Very impressed with this restaurant! Me and my family were tourists from New York City and we were very impressed! We loved their Philly cheese steak and their Chicken sandwich was very good! I definitely recommend going to John's Roast Pork!

Absolutely love this place. Now how often do you hear that about a dealership. I have been taking my car there for about a year now and they have always been good to me. You can make appointments even on the weekends which is so awesome. I have never had any issues and they are always on time. When I decide to buy my next car I will be buying from them. The service department is always very nice about telling you of any problems or issues with the vehicle and will not pressure you into anything. I've dealt with a lot of different dealerships and I have never been as impressed as I've been with this one.

Service is on point. Food is on point. Prices are on point. I have only been to Coriander once, but I loved it. Samosas were excellent and not too greasy, while the one portion of chicken tikka masala was enough to feed two people. My date and I finished our meal with mango lassi. It was so fresh and so filling! 

It is a bit more casual than its competitors, such as Indeblue, but I think the service is better!

Drs lie right to your Face. Very different than what's being put in writing. 
The girls at the front are nice...the only positive.
Absolutely love the food and service and this gem of a restaurant! Delicious flavors, beautifully presented food, and fantastic service. This is a must visit in the Midtown area.

Food was awesome, drinks were cold (great prices and selection too!). Loved the outdoor area. I got the pork plate...it was a little spicy for me but the flavors were incredible. Pork was so tender and juicy. The rice was amazing and the cabbage was the best I've ever had. Plantains were a little mushy for me but still very good. Would definitely recommend!

I asked to get an alignment and they told me "I didn't need one". After my latest tire rotation, my tire was improperly balanced and when I tried to discuss this with the front desk, the individual changed the subject and asked me some questions about something unrelated. Good prices, questionable ethics.

The best food in any sports bar/ restaurant in all of  St. Louis, there is something for everyone from burgers and fries to grouper and salmon, there are vegan and vegetarian options as well, different food specials everyday the menu is very diverse which is hard to find in a sports bar they all tend to be the same burgers and wings but not here, everything surpasses expectations.
Amazing atmosphere, the amount of work put into the once Dorsett Inn does not go unnoticed it looks brand new, The waitresses are always attentive and friendly along with the food, there are also drink specials everyday, great prices overall, its truly the best place in St. Louis to watch games, a tv everywhere you turn there are over 40!
