To sum it all up, Amazing food with a variety of everything at more than fair prices, great service, cold drinks and the ability to watch any and every game all in one place. What more could you ask for!

Always good! 
Big portions, fresh salads and great pizza!
You can buy by the slice and it's huge. Great prices for good food.

I love 4 Rivers... and I don't like Bar B Que so that says A LOT! I've been waiting on this location to open up since moving to St. Pete in March and I was there front and center on opening day. Location is nice a big, clean, modern and has ample seating inside and outside. Outside seating includes misters for the warmer days.

Their menu is extensive with almost every part of the cow you can choose from, but also includes smoked turkey, pork and chicken. 

Their sweet shop is in a league of it's own.  They have their own bakery that provides all of the sweets you see here. If you haven't had it, try it! I promise you'll love it. And if you've tried other locations, this one is just as good. 

Welcome to Tampa 4 Rivers!

We went there a couple weeks ago and I was really looking forward to it since I have lived in Boise for 12 years and had not eaten there yet so I was excited to finally go. So when we got there we had to wait 40 minutes, we were told about 15-20 minutes, but I get it, it's a busy Saturday morning. We finally get seated and we order coffee and OJ to start, when we get the OJ it was served it an extremely warm glass like it just had gotten out from being dried. When I took a sip of it, the juice it self was warm, not exactly how I like to drink OJ..... then we order and I was excited to finally eat and then the food came and my dish was actually really cool to the touch and not even hot, within minutes the whole dish was just cool. I was very disappointed and I let our waitress know about it. She did not offer to make me another plate with hot food, she only offered to take the dish off of the check. Working in the industry for years myself, I realize that when people come to a restaurant, they usually want to eat and when someone is not eating their food because it's cold, then I would ALWAYS suggest to get another plate that is hot, I would never send a customer home with an empty belly if they came to eat. I understand that this could be their policy to take it off the check, but if the customer is not eating the food, then get them something else to eat......I was highly disappointed with my very first visit there, I probably won't ever go back, I would rather eat at a restaurant where feeding their customers is more important than getting the food taken off their bill. I would have been happy to wait for a hot plate of food rather than staring at the cold plate of food as my husband ate his breakfast.

A nice spot off the beaten path. Unassuming cafe inside. My guy and I started off with the Boudin Balls with spicy Mayo. Can you say yum?! We both had the 1/2 poboy with gumbo. I had the barbecue shrimp poboy with the Mumbo Gumbo and my guy had the fried shrimp poboy with the same. Large fluffy rolls were served with the Poboy's and lots of shrimp. The gumbo bowl was mostly rice I have to say. The soup was supposed to include crawfish and crab. But none were detected. The rue was really tasty though.

We had our wedding at the Duling Kurtz over Labor Day weekend, and I cannot even begin to explain how incredible the staff, atmosphere, and food is at DK!  Michael, the owner's son, and Sam the manager were so helpful throughout the entire event planning process, and made sure every detail was perfect for our big day.  They went far above and beyond when the little bridge over the creek was washed away by hurricane Irene days before the wedding, and had a crew come in to build a brand new bridge just for our wedding!  The food was out of this world, and the staff was so sweet and friendly, my guests are still talking about how great the waiters were and how incredible the food was.  We also stayed at the Inn for our wedding night, and for getting ready before the wedding. It is so darling and cute!  The quaint vintage colonial room made amazing "getting ready pictures" in our wedding album.  The entire experience, the inn and the restaurant, was A+.

My first and last visit to this inexpensive fast-food sushi place. It's busy and popular, but that doesn't make it good.  The emphasis is more on cheap than on quality. My kids would like this, and I would probably visit again if it were in my hood.  It is clean, quick and unassuming.  But there are just so many better places to eat. Meh.

Seemed like a great place until we got the bill! $64 for four shots of Patron tequila! I wonder what a margarita cost. Freaken highway robbery! Why didn't the bartender mention the cost? Nashville is not the N.Y. city.

This past Friday, October 7, 2016 I had my daughter's rehearsal here. It was an amazing! It turned out exactly as I wanted it. Everyone loved the food. Diminica was so accommodating with setting up the event. Our servers Lisa & Denise were wonderful. I need to go back soon for gnocchi in the vodka blush sauce. I recommend dinner at Filomena's. It is a great place for all your celebrations! Thank you to Diminica, Lisa, Denise, and the staff for making the evening so memorable.

Holy-Moly!!! I went with the "chef's 6-course tasting menu" with wine pairings and was absolutely blown away! Incredible food. Amazing service. Awesome wine. An overall wonderful dining experience...and might I mention that I came in less than 30 minutes until closing and was still served and treated like royalty by all staff members and not rushed at all. I wish I could give this place above and beyond 5 stars!!! Thanks to all the staff and management for a true 5-star experience!

We went to our first tour today; Saint Louis cemetery 1. Aubrey was our guide and she killed it!! She was on point with her history and made the tour awesome!! We go back tonight for Ghosts and Vampires tour so we hope thats awesome too:)

While dining last week the food was very good. HOWEVER, the service was terrible. Our server was rude, and sloppy in her approach. she dropped cutlery into the table while serving dessert and was not responsive at all. Her attitude would stop us from visiting this location again.

I have been shopping at Le Jouet for decades. I am a last minute Xmas shopper. Stopped in today, Saturday 12/23 expecting the worst. I got the same service as always. Everyone is friendly, attentive, and fast. As a hater of all types of shopping, I actually look forward going to Le Jouet. It is one of my personal Xmas traditions.

I have gotten takeout and dined in once at Koreana so far. Great experience with takeout through the Ritual app! My food was ready on time and the pick up process was very smooth. I also got $5 off for my first order! The tofu lunch box was PLENTY of food. The sauces were pretty sweet and the kimchi was VERY fermented (great, just not for opening back at the office). Will order again and try something new next time.

I asked for medium rare. I get a well done steak. They take it back, but they give me a crappier piece of meat from what I originally ordered.

Happens every time I go, maybe it's my fault for trying to give them another chance every time. Never going back now. They should have refunded me for their shitty food.

We walked past this place a few times whilst walking around exploring the French quarter and thought oh what a lovely place. My boyfriend checked the Yelp reviews and said it only had 2 and a 1/2 stars, we now understand why. He ordered the surf and turf poboy with fries, the poboy was good the chips were just like plain oven chips no flavour at all. I ordered the the mushrooms and a garden salad and it tasted like dish water it was such a weird taste.

Such a let down considering it looks so pretty from the outside.

Awesome little market! Love their selections...a mixture of organic, healthy, and fresh!

They serve some really good tacos! I get the fish or shrimp tacos, and they're always delicious. The medley they put on top has a little kick to it but it's not overbearing. 

I also go here to load up on my snacks. I particularly love to grab my Yerba Mate, as they have a moderate variety. 

Super cool atmosphere. I think it is great that they sell locally and regionally grown products. Some of the fresh produce even have labeled which farm the produce came from. 

The employees are pleasant. I could not ask for a better neighborhood store.
Very good. I had the cod sandwich, I really liked it. My wife had the filet medallions, very good as well.

I decided to pop in here while waiting to check in to my hotel on a weekend trip down from Indiana. I was very impressed not only by the large selection of comics and memorabilia, but by the very friendly and  knowledgeable staff. A very comfortable atmosphere, great for anyone looking for comics, action figures, statues, print glasses (!), or any other comic/sci-fi merchandise.

This is by far one of the best restaurants I have ever been to! I wish I could eat here everyday. The gluten free menu is amazing and the selection is out of this world. For anyone that has the food allergy they would understand how hard it is to find great food. The service is priceless! The atmosphere is fabulous, I feel like I am sitting at my grand Father's dinner table. I could not ask for or expect a better experience. If you have not been to this restaurant and you have not met Pasquale or Skip please put down your fork and knife because what you have on your dinner table could not even begin to compare to the great food and fabulous atmosphere you will experience at Pasta Pomodoro!
I had the shrimp tacos, the shrimp were extremely tiny ( being from Los Angeles this is not what I'm use to) other than that they were just okay. Great  ice cream selection.

Everything you want in a good Mexican joint. The LJ special quesadilla with grilled chicken is ! Great specials for lunch and strong drinks. The service is quick and staff are friendly.

Always a stop on my list when I'm in Indy.

This was my first time getting a cut and shave from Hiend Tight. My barber was Haythm who was very polite and courteous. I was very impressed by the detail and precision of the haircut I received, but the reason I had to lower my rating is because of the shave. I don't know if the razor was dull or the technique he used was different than I was used to but I ended up with cuts and razor burn all over my neck. I had to use a paper towel to clean up the cuts and bleeding pores on my neck for about a half hour after I had left the shop. I hate to give a bad review but I expected more than what I received with the shave. Haircut alone was a definite 5 stars... the shave made me drop the rating down to a 3. I plan on returning for another cut but I am debating on getting a shave again.

We had a great time here! The staff was awesome and made my experience that much better. They all had such great customer service skills and the best attitudes. This location is pretty far from me, but from my amazing experience last night I will be sure to make the trip back up to this specific location.

First timer here and it was okay.  There was 10 of us and I have to say that I was a little disappointed.  I was expecting it to be better than I expected.  First of all the size portions of the items or combo plates on the menu cost more than out would expect to pay for pasta and the portions do not equal the cost of the meal. (they are small) The service was so so, because we thought a few times that our server forgot we were there until she brought our bill.   Overall it's seems a little overpriced to me.

Power-flow is very  energizing.  My sister took me as her guest the other night.  Good teacher, intermediate-adv. class on thursday evenings.  I hear they have a good number of teachers & courses, so there is probably something for everyone.

Today I had the fried flounder platter with greens and whipped yams and bread pudding. The fish, yams and greens were delicious. The bread pudding had good sugar vanilla and cinnamon flavors but it was waaaay too wet for me like it wasn't all the way done or something. I enjoy bread pudding but this really missed the mark and I couldn't eat much of it and won't be getting it again.

Tonight's take out. I ordered the salmon  and substituted the grits for Elysian Peels( potatoes steak fries) with a side of asparagus ( which was more like garnish, only three pieces.) Unable to place phone or online order, had to drive over. It was worth it! Waited 15 minutes for two entrees,not bad. After my 10 min drive home the food was still warm. I'm definitely adding to the rotation. Next time I'll dine in. I was given ample amount of napkins and disposable utensils.

Pete's has a phenomenal slice.  It's a fantastic sauce and the lines are worth waiting in if you want a quality slice.  Service can be hit or miss but I usually attribute that to how long the line is at the moment and how the customers are acting.  The only reason Pete's gets a 4 stars instead of 5, is that it is the 2nd best pizza in the Farmer's Market.  Best is clearly Kate & Al's, but Pete's is a close 2nd and probably the 2nd best in the state behind K&A.

I went to this location on 8/4 around 1.30 because they were able to fix my flat tire faster than all the others. I had a (no joke ) 1.5 inch bolt in my tire. They guys at the Patriot location got me in and out in 20 minute And didn't even charge me. That really made my day. thank you guy I appreciate you!! have a great day I'll definitely come back!
We are really enjoying our stay at Sonesta. It is centrally located and the rooms are impeccably kept. A fridge and kettle are provided. All the staff we encountered has been very friendly as well.
Was completely ripoff!!! Nothing but bread for a primo hoagie yes times are tough but seriously put meat worth while on sandwich portion

I'm keeping this short and sweet. The store is clean and organized. I noticed this store has far more options than other locations, which I love. I went in to pick up dessert, a Marie Callender Coconut Cream Pie. And hot-dog was I presented with a plethora of options. I also noticed during my trip the freshness of the fruits and veggies. Yeah, this is a well put together location.

My wife and I have bought 5 used cars from Autonation Toyota and we have used the same salesman, Juan Carlos.  Juan doesn't pressure us and has always been great.  Juan is more of a friend now than a salesman.  Even when there were problems, he would get answers and let us know it would be taken care of.  With the exception of one minor detail left, they have kept their word.  After speaking with managers etc they have always been receptive and willing to help.

We will continue to buy from Autonation because of Juan. 

I recommend Autonation to anyone who wants great customer service, even after the sale has been made.

Please use my name (John P.) with Juan for an additional year of service.

Btw, I am sure you might be wondering why 5 cars!  It is because we upgraded each time.

Dinos After Dark. What a fantastic idea this is. It's a pay-what-you-wish system, with the suggested price being $10. They accept cards too btw! 

They basically open up the whole museum for guests for $10...they also have bars and food. The evening I went, they had Mexican food...tacos, nachos, etc. While they were very tempting, we decided to skip food since we had plans to attend a restaurant afterwards...and head straight to the bar. First round, my friend had the sangria and I had their Crocodile Lemonade. We were a bit disappointed with the high cost, low quantity and almost non-existent alcohol content on them...so we decided on beers on the second round. 

They set up high tops and game tables throughout the dino area. This is where you'll also find the bars and food. After exploring the dino area, we decided to venture out into the other areas. Such a great museum. They had museum staff come out with samples and engage guests. Awesome! They even offer a presentation of live animals in their little auditorium. The Croc Room was probably one of my favorites...with live alligators and/or crocodiles with several educators engaging with guests. Love it. 

The crowd was a good mix of young and old, parents and non-parents, hipsters and representation of various races, ethnicities, and generations. I want to reiterate...this is a really fantastic idea. They have one monthly until the end of Spring I believe. If you get a chance, I recommend you check it out.

I stopped by this place for the first time. I'd have to give the food, service, and value a bad grade .
The soup came after the main course and I was forced to eat it with a teaspoon since the waiter never returned to the table. The soup seemed overprice a 5.99 for a tiny cup they call a crock.
To me crock sounds like a bowl of soup, not a cup side order. The fish tacos were good and the sweet potatoes fries were good as well. But the after waiting a long time for the check from the vanishing waiter, made me want out ASAP and never to return

Dinner at the Kitchen...Filet Mignon was cooked perfectly! Bread and butter heavenly....Short rib really tender and flavorful. Service was spot on! Only bummer was the flies we encountered at the bar waiting for our table. Bartender apologized and explained that it was just that time of the year. Will certainly come back however. Valet parking is also a nice feature of this restaurant. Attendant was very friendly!
If you are  looking for a Veterinarian Dr.Tamas is the best. She is so caring and loves our pets . Her staff is wonderful and the office is spotless.

Terminal side at the airport is not typically where you'd expect to find a decent restaurant...but this is an exception. The food was decent (especially for airport standards). The prices were what you'd expect, high. And the drink selection was a nice upgrade. I had the Cuban sandwich and it was a decent tasting imitation. Not out of this world, but alright. You're kind of spoiled for choice here, but it's worth it if you're hungry.

Great pizza and the cheese steak is amazing and the chicken cheese steak is my wife's favorite. I'm a big fan of their Margarita pie. I recommend you give it a try before ordering from some prefab frozen pizza delivery joint.
I have enjoyed everything I have ordered, Jerk wings, coconut shrimp, fish tacos, spinach dip, firecracker shrimp...and a few more things I cannot remember the names to post.
The orange and vanilla combo is my favorite. Staff are always really friendly and helpful. They also have a nice line set up (for Covid social distancing) which is appreciated!

This review is for the Taco Bell on commercial way near the rural king. We went drive through at 630 pm. We ordered two chicken power bowls. Cashier informed us they were out of guacamole and sour cream. Really. That's just poor management. We also ordered one five dollar box. They must have also been out of lettuce. I had one teaspoon of lettuce in the bowl. Overall weak presentation. I ate the taco crunch wrap. Tasted old. Hard shell taco wilted and soft shell stuck to the paper. Perhaps waiting a while not fresh made. But I found lots of lettuce on there. Hmm. It's fast food not rocket science. 
Cashier was pleasant and food came out instantly. The thing I like the most. The Baja blast drink. 
Do yourself a favor. Go to the TB at four corners.

I really was hoping this place would be better, but it's just your average deli.  I love a plain bagel with cream cheese and I ordered that while everyone else got a full breakfast.  Service was not that great and when my bagel arrived, it included a package of Philadelphia cream cheese.  When I'm eating at a deli, I prefer a slab of cream cheese.  I was really bothered by the single serve cream cheese.  Someone else at my table had the cream cheese the way I like it, so I stole a bit of theirs.

I tried to be very cool & polite from the beginning. I will apologize for getting out of character but I will not accept the responsibility for something that I did not do. And remember tI told the manager and this waitress that I did not have a problem with her, liked her...she WAS a good waitress Exedra before things got ugly. 

I walked into the restaurant where I am a regular when I come to town for business every couple months. I got greeted with a hey, a bill and an accusation saying that I walked out on a bill on a date I WASN'T EVEN IN TOWN 2 months ago...& I have proof. No drink or menu was offered. A bill for food that I do not eat and for soda that I do not drink due to my diet.  I told her I would pay it because it was only $12.  She kept trying to push her manager on me, told me I was on camera. The waitress instead of getting upset because I was taking it personally could have taken the $20 I offered her, cashed the ticket out and served me without even getting him involved. I don't even think the manager realizes I was trying to pay for it just so I could eat because I was that hungry before he even got out there. It was how I was approached, it was very disrespectful especially how often I frequented this restaurant (almost two to three times a day when I'm in town, spend good money and tip very well) she even said because of this she vouched for me and that the cook told her to let it go....well letting it go does not mean you approach me in the way that she did....they all know me by name and to be treated like I'm some thief is ridiculous. She laughed in my face and when I started yelling. I told her she was disrespectful for laughing at me she said quote "I will be that b****" and her manager said nothing! Apparently they have video of me so when he rudely asked are you going to pay?... I changed my mind & said no, not unless I see the video which they wouldn't show me.  I make too much money to be going to such a rundown restaurant to be treated like that. I never complained about the food because it was cheap and easy. I'm probably no longer allowed in this establishment. The manager followed me out screaming (no joke) at me. I understand that I was being dramatic but he is the one in the position that needs to keep calm and learn how to deal with customers especially if they're going to have waitresses accusing people. Even tho I am most likely eighty-sixed I would NEVER go back EVER. Ruined my entire day. Restaurants that I worked at in the past, NEVER trained us to handle things like this. I'm still in shock. I have been coming to St Louis & going to that restaurant for years...:(

Ken was fantastic! He showed up with ample time to set up, brought all kind of fun equipment and made our party a blast. He catered to the music tastes of our guests, which was a challenge due to range in ages. Ken took the time to understand what we wanted to achieve. He helped execute a few speeches and a heck of a closing at the end. All in all a great night with an awesome DJ! Thanks Ken!

Burgers are great, Gyros are actual gyros, and the steaks are exceptional. The best thing about this place is the price and portions. The gyros are loaded with meat and the tzatzki sauce is glorious. It also come with fries on the side and for a great price ($6.99 before tax)

They have a wide assortment of books, magazines, and DVDs.  The store is well designed and pleasant. The staff is competent and courteous.  The only fly in the ointment is that their prices are not always the lowest available.

I have to say I was pretty disappointed in this place.  The food just didn't quite work and the atmosphere maybe just a little to "cool" for what I look for.
We started by walking up to a gorgeous house and the restaurant design and vibe is really something special.  We didn't have reservations so they sent us downstairs to the bar which was fine.  We like sitting and getting recommendations from the staff.  
The patio behind the bar was really nice but it had been raining recently and they didn't have it open.
For drinks I had a rum based cocktail that I would recommend.  Definitely spirit forward but with a little sweetness to take to edge off.  
We ended up trying three appetizers to make our meal as we had already been out for a round of drinks and snacks... I really really wanted to like these.  I could see what they were going for but came out over flavored with ingredients that seemed to be chosen to be creative but took away from the natural good flavor of the ingredients.
I'll start with the ribs.  The sauce and quality of meat were good but it every square inch was covered with green onions and a chopped nut.  Flavor was too strong per bite.
The shrimp and grits we didn't really like because of the seasoning and temp.  Was Luke warm and a certain spice overwhelmed all other flavors.
Lastly the aged beef tartare.  I usually get beef tartare as I love the flavor of steak...they added lots of corn nuts!  It's not that I don't like corn nuts but it's not the flavor I want when I have steak tartare.  It becomes most of what you taste.

The only good thing about this aparment is the closeness to forest park. The desk staff is rude, the street is noisey, the ceiling and walls were literally falling off/down in my apartment and they tried to patch job it many times and it still would be awful. Our plumbing clogged all the time and the parking is horrible, sorry can't afford $100 a month for a parking spot (insane!). The cafe downstairs is closed 50% of the time and the pool in miniature and in the middle of a parking lot (just pathetic). Don't waste your money here they rob you blind! Find a place down the street that's cheaper and nicer. The amenities they "offer" are so not worth it. The elevators are ALWAYS broken, and when you live on the 9th floor, its so fun to walk up with groceries. Water was literally raining in the elevator one time. It took MONTHS to get out deposit back, and my roommate had to go there to get anywhere with that. DO NOT LIVE HERE, you won't enjoy it.

OMG OMG OMG!! So we were in Bartique one afternoon (couple stores to the left of here) and in walks this guy with some tuna nachos to sample and we all said sure we would try. BEST DECISION ever, those were soooooo phenomenal. We had already eaten dinner so we didn't go in, but we made a mental note how great they were so we went to st. Pete again and this time made sure to make room for some nachos and we went back!! First of all, the staff were so nice and helpful and walked us thru the whole menu and we explained we were there for the nachos bc they were so good and we just wanted to get a bunch for us to nibble on. They made them right up, and once again to die for! My husband doesn't even like raw fish and he said they were good so you can only imagine. That was all we got to eat but everyone's food around us did look delicious. Next time we will go again with an even bigger appetite to try more. Definitely go try!!

The fried chicken sandwich now uses vastly different, lower quality ingredients. The coleslaw looks like it's purchased at a super market and not freshly made like it used to be.

The hot sauce is now franks, or similar low quality. It used to be a unique, tasty hot sauce.

Theyve never really given a large piece of chicken on their sandwiches but the rest of the flavors used to compensate. Now it's glaringly low quality especially given the price.

They also never honor requests in any of the apps instructions. Very disappointed as I used to be a reliable customer.

There's no way you will be getting a sandwich like the photos used to be.

Just go to wendy's for a similar sandwich

I came in with high hopes. Nice setting. The only reason it got one star was the layout of the restaurant. Open. And clean. Also nice. 

First started with me waiting five minutes to place my order. No one in the place and actually upon asking the cashier they said it was prepping time. They were too worried about getting prepped to take new customers. Bad sign. 

The food came out quick enough but I was immediately annoyed at how little seven dollars got me in food. Small messy six inch food. The meat was like ground beef and was soggy and wet. The layout of the sandwhich was bad also. It only had cheese and peppers on one side of the bun. 

But the bun was cut all the way through so that stuff fell out continually. I ate in two minutes and the entire time was disgusted. My uncle with me as well had the same feeling. 

Gross food. Too little for the money. Don't go here unless to get drunk and if so take a PB and J with you. You will be more satisfied with that.

This place is nice inside and our waitress was friendly. My wife and I both ordered fish and shrimp along with crab dip and gator bites for appetizers. The food is ok, I would argue the food is not worth the price. It is a generally nice location and place but I would visit another location in this area if you wanted tasty food at this price.

Delicious authentic Mexican food.  I've only gotten take out so I can't comment on the wait staff, but my food has always been ready to pick up at the promised time as well as being correct to what I ordered.  I knew I was going to like this place when I saw they had my favorite El Yuchateco hot sauce on the tables!  A+

Where do I begin? First of all, I made the mistake of coming here because my go-to place (which I adore) is closed on Sunday's and I knew it was the only day that week I could make the time to get my nails done. I'll never make that mistake again! Nothing about my experience here was good. Their website (and their door) said they were open until 4pm. I arrived at 2:55pm and they already had a closed sign in the window and the door was locked. However, I noticed many people inside so I knocked. A woman opened the door with a dirty look and I asked "are you still open?" Her response was a very rude "well, what do you want?" I asked for a gel manicure and was let in. To say the manicure was rushed is an understatement. I had to ask her to refile my nails, as she left them uneven. The water I soaked my fingers in was ice cold. She barely trimmed my cuticles and then proceeded to paint all over them - we all know that painting gel on the cuticles causes it to not seal correctly. She just didn't care. When she was finished, she asked if it was OK, and I said absolutely not - there's polish all over my fingers. I was told it's that way because my nails are short...um, you just trimmed them! So she sat there and started clipping the skin with the polish off with the cuticle removers. It was beyond asinine. The worst part of all of this is that I can't even trust them to be sanitary! I walked back from washing my hands in the sink and she was TRIMMING HER OWN CUTICLES with the tool she had just used on me. Absolutely gross. To end on an even lower note, they charge more than most other places in town and my manicure didn't even last one week. Do yourself a favor and steer clear of this place.

Service was very pleasant and food was ready for pick up pretty quickly. The staff were wearing masks and food was in a separate table for pick up. Serving of chicken pad Thai was huge, the right spice level,  and tasty. (This is one of those places where it makes sense to share a dish or plan on leftovers.) The spring rolls were not bad but not good enough to order again,

Food is decent, but stay for the karaoke rooms! They're honestly not that expensive (you can order food and drinks to cover the price of the karaoke rooms!), and by far some of the nicest I've seen. They have pretty decent music choices, and your room comes with plenty of seating and even a private bathroom! Definitely necessary if you have some pukers amongst your group...

The alcohol was watered down, and my mojito only had mint -- no lime?! People were fighting over the chicken wings (I think we were just hungry though), and the rest of the bar food was all right as well. But it's okay; you won't mind that your food isn't top-notch because you'll be too drunk and having a great time karaoke-ing!

Pretty disappointing experience. The atmosphere is great, but the good vibes wear off as soon as you sit down. There was no host to seat us, and a waitress came around eventually to take our drink orders. Coffee and a couple of bloody marys took way too long because the bartender was new and alone handling the whole load by herself on a holiday.  Refills on coffee and water were few and far between as well.

I ordered a dish that was described as rib tips with Hawaiian flair, but they just came out as a small plate of plain rib tips and no side, which was a let down as they looked to be a special insert on the menu and a bit more expensive than other items. 

I was hangry by the time the food arrived. There was no craftsmanship to any of the dishes at our table. Could have gotten the same thing at a dive bar.

The waitress had an excuse for everything, and service overall was very slow. They obviously weren't prepared for the holiday crowd. To them it just seemed as if it was going to be a slow Tuesday lunch hour.

Despite the slow service and long wait time for food, the waitress was quickest with *surprise* the check. That came out almost immediately. I still tipped her because she was obviously trying her best, but I will not return to or recommend this place.

I have been going to Guys and Dolls for many years now and I am very satisfied with the quality, the service and the friendliness of the employees.  Selvana usually cuts my hair and I have found her to be absolutely perfect.  She is very personable to all her customers.  A few months ago I accidentally left a pair of reading glasses at the shop.  Selvana put them aside and kept them for several months until my recent return and made sure I got them back.  I will continue to follow up with Guys and Dolls and Selvana.  I have remained very satisfied.

This is our first time to Yolk (and to Indianapolis). Awesome place for breakfast!  The food was good - real eggs and portions large, prices very reasonable. 

The pancake special is French Toast Crunch. Very rich and sweet kinda like a cinnamon roll. The kind of pancake where you only eat about a quarter of it. 

We are trying to figure out how to get a Yolk in Southern California!

Haven't been to a Taco Bell in a while, and have never been to this location. Walked up to look at the menu with my boyfriend, and immediately the girl behind the counter started ranting about her kids blowing up her phone and her baby daddy or something. We were trying to decide our order and not listen to her, so we ignored it and continued to look. 15 seconds later, she's asking me if he's my boyfriend and if "sometimes I want to punch him in the face, but I can't because I love him." And we immediately walked out. I came here for food, not some cashiers life story. Very unprofessional, and will never be back to this location.

Had the lamb platter. It was very bland. No flavor whatsoever. Couldn't finish the food. I've had similar dishes from the same cuisine which had much more flavor. Plus you have to pay cash. To use a card, your total mush be $30 or more.
Best boards in Santa Barbara. J7 private label clothing and accessories, and a super knowledgeable staff makes this shop one of the best. JJ isn't bad either , the shop chihuahua

This place is amazing for a quick bite or a night out! Half price wings on Wednesday is awesome. Plus they have Angry Orchard on draft which is always my fall go-to! Food is good, mainly the burgers and wings. As far as staff goes, everyone is great and the atmosphere is always nice. I've had some great experiences with James in particular, but everyone is great! World of Beer is my new go-to!

I live in CT however when I am in town (6x a year), I always go here for a pedicure.  Best pedicure I have ever had.  Its worth the money spent.  You are offered water, wine, coffee etc.  I always look forward to going to Luxecares.

After moving from the city out to the suburbs, making an hour trip to do a run at First Oriental was getting to be a pain, so we were very excited to find out there was an H mart nearby. 

The selection here was great! My wife is Taiwanese (not Korean) yet all of the items she typically heads downtown for were available at H mart; leeks, dumpling paper, meats for hot pot, our favorite brand of rice, etc.  Was also impressive how much of our typical American food items we found here as well. It could likely take the place even of our standard grocery store run as well. 

Inside was exceptionally clean, and the store was very well staffed. Giving four stars only because it is a bit smaller than other H mart locations around the city and thus doesn't have some entire sections (e.g. beauty and cosmetics) that we were hoping for.

Came in to order a new wine refrigerator. Painless customer service with Allen helping us. Should be a quick turn around for shipping. And, we know if there are any problems with it we can always return it to the store.

I got to say, this is the best I came acroos for pizza in this area. I can only say this is because I haven't  found any other place yet. I haven't recieved any greesy pizza yet but I find this pizza tasty. The sauce is just right but the crust could use a little bit more time in the oven. I need that crunch and it needs to have a thinner crust. 

I like the fact that it is a good family place and has a good sports bar. You can come here with friends or family to watch all the games. They also have gelato and subs, both are good too.

I'll keep coming here for my pizza until I find something better.

2 stars is appropriate for this  because well... 'Meh. I've experienced better.' I was very disappointed with this new restaurant and now I really missed Growlers! (previous restaurant in this spot)

I love Mexican food and was looking forward to it opening  but this place missed the mark on so many simple things. Ironically, the only thing I really enjoyed was not even a traditional Mexican dish, it was an appetizer.  Hopefully they improve since they just opened.... 

Tacos - Pork Carnita tacos came three to an order. Instead of using two corn tortillas for each taco, there was only one which made it difficult to eat and it fell apart. Many traditional Mexican tacos are served with two so that it doesn't get so sloppy and the tortilla absorbed a lot of the marinade. Well, the pork was dry so maybe that's why they used only one. The pork was very dry! 

Nachos - We got it topped with Chorizo and that was good but I feel that there should have been more and there were a lot of extra naked chips meaning that there was not enough toppings. 

Cocktails - I should have just ordered the Negro Modelo(great Mexican beer)!  Instead, I had two signature cocktails and they were both off-balanced.

Mulherin's used to be one of our favorite restaurants, but brunch yesterday was a disaster. Toast was burned, entrees came out over a 40-minute interval, and my mother found a piece of glass in her pancakes. I also noticed that the brunch menu does not have a single green vegetable - no salads, no veggies, nothing. Management comped drinks (non-alcoholic) and the pancakes but not the whole meal. Disappointing.

This review is long overdue, but my wife and I love kingfisher. We went there for the first time a few months ago. The menu is full of delicious looking entrees, but realize that you are paying for fresh seafood in the desert. The shrimp cakes were very good. Our favorite dish was the seafood pot pie (I think that's what it was called). It was like a seafood soup with bread on top. The wine selection was wonderful as well. Recommended.

My son was late on a payment, so when he had the money he went online to pay like always. Instead of taking what he requested they took two payments and his other bills were overdrawn. Pissed customer. Since a star is required I ga e one.

Dentists are not my favorite visit but I try to be responsible. They are wonderful here, doing appointments, cleaning, X-rays, inspection and fillings with a minimum of fuss and discomfort. All service is provided with a friendly personal smile which is also appreciated. 

Thank you Bay Arbor!
Great small owned business. A lot of improvements to come but so far have had Agua Fresca, Raspasdo and Pepicuates

I initially started going to Star Nails for Pedicures only after being referred by a friend.  I stopped going because they are not consistent with their procedures.  Often times the technicians cuts corners (files one foot and not the other, etc...).  I don't expect all techs to be equally trained, but because they are a team servicing the community for pay; they should support one another in their weaknesses, aside from using their native tongue to talk about their patrons.  Thank god for the foreign language classes at Tulane, I understood everything they were saying. 
And as for Nancy, the manager.... she lacks people skills.  I understand the clientel is diverse but this shop has the nicest patrons, so why treat one any different from another because of the color of their skin.  If NANCY, as the manager would focus on accepting constructive criticism;  when patrons point out oversights or complain of a particular product, she immediately assumes something is wrong with the patron or how they handled their nails.  Nancy, sometimes two pair of eyes are better than one.  I mean afterall, would you want to walk out of a salon with a bad nail job.  Charlie has the most pleasing personality, I sometimes wonder edif it is because he is a man and women loved to be pampered by a man.  But the one one thing I admire of his personality is his straightforward communication, honest opinion, and knowledge of the product and ability to listen to the patrons concerns.
I hesitate to recommend this place to anyone.  Especially if I think they will be shafted by the managment.
PS:  What's up with the two different pedicure rooms, Is there a "whites only" room.  This is what I have noticed.  I have appeared on several occasions, a chair was available, purposely asked for the same pedicure as someone in the newly remodeled room and was redirected to the general population.
What!? Do you pay more for the newly remodeled room.
Thirdly, I only notice one tech sanitizing the pedicure area before running more water.  I find my skin on my legs and feet itch more once I leave this facility.
Sandi

I had the pleasure of stumbling upon this gem while in Indy for a business trip. I walked from the Sheraton, and was struck by the fact that there were no sidewalks to get there. It didn't help that it was raining, and luckily I had boots on. And despite having two major intersections between the two locations, there were no crosswalks. Needless to say, it was both a perilous and daring walk from the hotel to Ruth's.

That being said, the service was great, and my server, Michelle, gave me a terrific suggestion. The beef brisket hash, topped with two over-medium fried eggs and a side of sausage gravy presented me with a near-perfect facsimile of the classic SOS. I can't find that in Los Angeles, and it was delicious!

If you're looking for something that isn't a chain and has a great hometown feel, you can't go wrong with Ruth's!

This place has some of the nicest Native American jewelry (both old pawn and new construction) and art you'll find for sale at any price in Tucson Arizona, they also support, back up, and help out a lot of working Native American artists who's work they sell. I've found a lot of really great and unique pieces of jewelry here over the years. They also do really quality and fairly priced repair and modifications to existing work. They've also got a big internet presence on Etsy. Check 'em out next time you are in Tucson or online.

Leesa immediately greeted us warmly and gave us a tour of the house. She is friendly and inviting. We wanted an alternative to the chain hotels while we visited Indy for the 500 and Nestle Inn was perfect! Beautiful accommodations and one block from Mass Ave. No driving required to have a wonderful evening out in Indy. Nestlé is only 6 miles from the speedway too. See you next May for the next race!!

We went there for lunch and everything that we ate was superb!  I guess because it was for lunch, there was no line up.
- raw oysters were big, plump, and so so fresh
- seafood gumbo had a little kick to it and tasted very flavourful
- softshell crab was delicious, and the coleslaw that came with it had a sweetness to it which I really liked a lot (but my friend didn't)
- BBQ'ed shrimp was fantastic!  It came in a cast iron pan with lots of oil, but if you take your fork and dig down there is nothing but goodness to be scooped up and SOOOOO delicious on bread

I am not the type of person to go to a restaurant more than once on a trip because I like to try a little of everything, but if I had the time to go back, I would have.

When I think of 1904, I think of a simpler time. A time when you could pay the town doctor in sacks of potatoes. A time when the living wage was 22 cents an hour. A time when most everyone died of tuberculosis. And they were grateful for it.

But at the 1904 Steak House, the leading cause of death is stroke. Because you're gonna have one when you see these prices.

Now in 1904, a girl like me would have been sold for parts. I am not a member of upper society, so while I am aware that there are restaurants that sell steaks for $50 a piece, I've never been allowed in one.

Upon entering this establishment, it was clear that the high entree prices are in place to subsidize the 40 chandeliers strewn throughout the 1904 Steak House. I did appreciate being seated in one of those crescent shaped half-booths where I can see anyone approaching, Scarface style. This restaurant is in a casino, and if someone's coming for a pinky or a baby toe, they're going to have to work for it. Clear view of my enemies aside, I just wasn't impressed by this place.

In one serious paragraph, here's why this place isn't worth it: $50 steaks aren't served with anything. This would be OK if the meat itself or the sides were of a quality that deserved the price tag, but nothing was outstanding. Wines by the glass are very limited and more marked up than usual. Raw oysters were served with the mignonette already on them, which is the biggest first world problem I've ever verbalized.

This place is expensive just to be expensive. If you have comps or the corporate card, go nuts I guess. Otherwise you're just a sucker.

Also, don't even ask. There's no World's Fair replica ferris wheel. Ridiculous.

The guys at Peruzzi Toyota are awesome.  I've bought two cars from Peruzzi over the last 4 years and each time my experience has been awesome.  From the sales guys to the finance team, bar none, these guys are professionals and personable.  I've sent several friends to Peruzzi who have also bought cars.  

Why go anywhere else???

s_petsch@yahoo.com

okay, i'll admit it. this place is expensive. but DELICIOUS! i love their sesame bagel with garlic veggie spread, you can tell the spread is made with fresh veggies, and is sooo good. the service is also top-notch, really nice. beware: the line might go out of the window in the morning, but as said before, it's totally worth it :D  you should definitely stop by when you're in the area.

It's great to have a *very* good quality Indian restaurant in a top of the Hill location! I have not dined in yet - I have ordered food for takeout several times. They ask what spice level you want on a 1-10 scale and I usually aim for a 5 which is good but not crazy spicy. I have tried the samosa, lamb dishes, chicken dishes, and several vegetarian dishes. All have been excellent and obviously freshly prepared to order. I definitely recommend the restaurant and look forward to continuing to enjoy their excellent food for many years to come! Give them a try!

By the way, if you dine in, it's BYOB and conveniently located next to the PA Wine & Sprits store! ;-)
As far as them forgetting to put the oil cap back on and ruining a $5000 engine, these guys are truly the best. Terribly corrupt!
Great authentic Hawaiian Food. Loved it! Order the Combo Plate if you want to sample a little bit of everything.

Quite the diamond in the rough. There are very few restaurants around the Sam Jones corridor, so that makes The Library even more special. The decor is oddly classy, but the atmosphere is very laid back. I have never had a bad experience there.

The Salad/Soup/Pasta bar is all I have ever had and I don't think that I will deviate from that in the future. The salad bar is always the same, but it is a solid selection of greens and toppings with no problems. The soups and pasta always change and I have never had the same thing twice. I always try a little bit of everything, because their so good and so filling. BONUS DESSERT! Oreo mouse and apple butter with fried hushpuppies are worth the price of admission.

It's a great lunch spot if you work/visit the southwest side. You won't find anything like it.

Online to go order. Found a piece of torn plastic in my food. Some of our food was also missing. Called the manager and was placed on a 10 minute hold to "collect our information". Hung up and called again and spoke to a different manager who offered an e-gift card to cover our order. Gift card has the wrong first name on it so I doubt it will be usable. Not going back to this location in any case.

I have been going to this shop for years.  Rich is an excellent business man who does great work.  I have been taking my car to this shop for years and they have always been fair, honest and have good pricing

WOW. My last review was for another favorite pizza place in the city. Theirs was a solid triple, but Dock Street has just knocked one out of the park.

The food was unbelievable! We started with the Trio fries -- white and sweet potatoes with leeks. I love me some sweet potato fries, and the leeks just sealed the deal on this one. Then the pizza...so many delicious pies to choose from. We ordered two of their 10" individuals ($8-$9 ea.) to split: the Flammenkuche (caramelized onion, apple smoked bacon, gruyere, creme fraiche, fresh thyme) and the Florentine (creme fraiche, spinach, sliced tomato, leeks, fresh herbs, mozzarella). The crust is thin, slight char, but not TOO crunchy. Perfection. My mouth is watering just thinking about the leftover slices in my fridge. The caramelized onions were unbelievable. Vegetable candy, how can you go wrong?

As for the beer: the Saison was soft, not overly hoppy. It was nice, though I prefer Victory's Saison Du Buff (a little more body). Dock Street's Hop Garden Double IPA packs a serious wallop! I'm anxious to try their Rye IPA.

Our server was friendly and attentive when we arrived, and then let us linger without hovering, very nice. The place was pretty empty when we got there and took a table by the window, but a few hours later it was packed. Definitely louder at that point (big open room with high ceilings) but we didn't have any trouble carrying on a conversation.

GREAT food, great price. Dock Street, I will be back!

Went there last Saturday 05/09/20 around 1pm ordered the large seafood platter and onion rings soft drinks and beers well over $100.00.
Wait time and seating was good and clean. 
Got our food, not plates  went inside only to encounter the rudest person in the restaurant industry that informed me "plates are extra and cost $1.00 each and ranch in cups are .75 each" I was blown away  from her salty AF personality bought the ranch and got back to my food. Plates should come with your meal !
Bottom line during economic hard times when you see the owner on Fox 8 making an effort to respond a local business and I bring my family to eat lunch at your establishment have the person that takes your order and that is answering the phone be at least bit decent!

Bottom line the food is pretty good. 
The service is horrible and by far the rudest in bucktown. 
Would I go back!?! 
Nope, Never because of one employee 

#Parkway

We ordered takeout and although the service was decent, the food was some of the worst I have had, anywhere. My heart was pounding from what I would bet was MSG. There are much better options for great Chinese food on the west side of Edmonton.

Just had an overall bad experience here. Service was awful, our waitress, Samantha, was not very personable. The nachos had like 10 chips? Waitress added 20% gratuity on a table of 2? Is that even allowed? Without saying anything? I work at a restaurant in center city and we are definitely not allowed to do that. She barely checked on the table and when she did she was there for one second, not giving us a chance to speak to her. Food was good but service could be improved.

I love hanas sushi with a passion. They seriously have the best sushi in new orleans hands down but the customer service is horrible.  You start your meal off with a delicious noodle salad float to some amazing sushi and in between have to deal with a waitress who acts like your in her way. Fix please for 5 stars.

Pretty good place for a quick bite, we usually don't like chain restaurants but we were late for a city tour so we stopped in for a quick breakfast sandwich. People were friendly, service fast, and good for fast food. Ate on the way to the tour and its on Bourbon St so it's convenient.

I've been frequenting Hub for quite some time now, and I've never had a sub-par experience. The espresso is top notch, and the coffee is the same. If I'm not stopping by for an espresso, I'm using their beans at the house.

I loved this restaurant, yall! I lived in Hong Kong for two years and this restaurant is a welcomed throwback to those glory years in Hong Kong. The vegetables and produce are all fresh and the cooking is authentic. I look forward to becoming a regular and getting to know the owners a bit better. Had MaPo Tofu which is an extremely Chinese dish and thought it was delicious. Sichuan chicken was great and so was the Moo Goo Gai Pan.
Smaller on the inside but great, friendly service and delicious rolls. The Alaskan roll is especially awesome.

When I saw an Instagram ad pop up for this place I felt like it was destiny. My wife went paleo several years ago and unless she is in the mood for a tummy ache her birthday treats are quite limited. 

I called an inquired about a 4 pack of cupcakes they offer (basically 4 for the price of 3) which includes cinnamon, chocolate, vanilla and chocolate chip. 

After work one night I headed over (they are in NW Reno) to grab a 4 pack. When I arrived, they had sold the last 4 pack... BUT the owner was nice enough to give me 4 at the price of 3. I opted for 1 chocolate, 2 cinnamon and 1 vanilla. I was hoping I could steal the extra cinnamon one for myself! She also provided a sample of their pumpkin bread for me to snack on during my ride home!

When I brought them home my wife was ecstatic! A birthday treat she could actually enjoy! She decided to save them for the following day since we were spending the whole day celebrating her birthday. 

The packaging was great as it kept each of them upright, secure and fresh and flavorful. 

Chocolate was the first one she bit into - she melted. She said it chocolate was rich and decadent and the chocolate frosting was the perfect compliment! 

A bit later she tried the cinnamon one. She didn't read the package first and said she was expecting cinnamon frosting not vanilla frosting. She said the flavor as great and the cake was super moist. She was disappointed in the vanilla frosting. She said the shortening as the frosting stabilizer idea the flavor very heavy instead of a light vanilla flavor. She did say that the frosting didn't overpower the delicious cinnamon cupcake though. She didn't wind up eating the vanilla ones because we forgot them in the car. Whoops!

The most incredible part was she said that she never would have know they were paleo because they tasted like any other cupcake from a cupcakery. 

Having this in town makes birthdays and special occasions a little less stressful. Now I will always have a place to stop and get a sweet celebration treat! Thank you so much for bringing paleo yumminess to Reno!
Best restaurant ever! The breakfast buffet is always piping hot and filled. You can get the blue plate special and only take One trip for a cheaper price. Servers are super friendly and attentive.

Pretty good.
Standard fare as the "new world" burger joints go. Doesn't really stand out anymore as this market has exploded.

No nonsense menu.
Can get pricey fast.
Burgers get messy fast!
Decor less than amazing.
I enjoy taking the kids here from time to time.

Discover this place for Breakfast or Lunch while visiting the Children's Museum or if you live close, always tasty, fresh, usually local or organic 
Truly a hidden gem, if you love their food truck, come here

Professional and very quick. I contacted multiple companies to get quotes, and Clean Streak was at my place the next day with the job completed before others could even come by to quote it. Good use of technology combined with good old fashioned customer service, highly recommended!

Came here on a Sat night because they have karaoke on Sat nights. Mistake! First of all, the website they use for their songbook would not load on any of our 4 phones. 2 of us had beer spilled on us from sloppy patrons. It was super loud with bad acoustics.

I have to say that I was shocked at how well the Roy's people do their thing at this restaurant. I usually avoid chains but I am a big fan of Hawaii and for years I always wanted to try this place, so we went over the weekend. It' not cheap (we had a party of five, bill was $300+), but you have a very good experience for the money. Nice restaurant, great ambiance, loved the variety of the menu, and the service really is outstanding. I have not been to Bern's but this was the best service I've had in a Tampa Bay eatery. I agree with Brett N; the food ranges from good to amazing. Now, this is not food that tastes "home made" or "from scratch" (like Osteria Natalina), this is food that still tastes like restaurant food, and I am sure there is a certain amount of processing that goes into it. But everything is delicious, quality/freshness is good and the portions are surprisingly adequate for a restaurant in this price point. I loved the sushi. Believe it or not the pork chop was excellent. The pad thai was OK, although the shrimp served with it was very good. The trout was excellent. The salmon also. Where else can you get very good sushi, collard greens, kim chee, onion rings, and tuna poke on the same night? The pineapple upside down cake was TO DIE FOR. This is truly one of the best restaurants in Tampa, maybe even a hidden gem since I never hear anyone talk about this place. I would rather go here than MANY other highly rated independent Tampa restaurants, like Pane Rustica, Oystercatchers, etc. 

I can't wait to go back!

We were looking forward to having a nice dinner with our friend who we had traveled with in India. The evening started out horriblely. I had specifically made a reservation to sit outside because we had been forwarned that the restaurant its terriblely noisy. We were not only not given a table outside but I was accused of lieing that I had not made the reservation for outside. I made the reservation on June 12th for outside!!! The owner tried to accuse me of not even calling until today, June 21st. The owner treated us very rudely. He was absolutely obnoxious. They finally moved us outside and what a relief to our ears. We were finally able to carry on a conversation. The food was fine and the service was okay too but it could not make up for the rude behavior and treatment we received by the owner. He never did come to talk with us to see how our food was or to apologize for his behavior. It is no wonder that he could not stay in business in any of his other locations. There are way too many wonderful restaurants to choose from where we are welcome!!!

How is possible that this place got 5 stars is beyond me. I ordered veggie plate with a side of the beef on the rotisserie. Wow was that beef chewy and pretty bland. The end of the day bread tasted like thick paper! If I had dentures they would have broken or fallen out. Oh its my fault I got there a 815pm they close at 9pm. The falafel was good, tomatoes good, hummus nothing special, grape leaves okay I've had way better. Service was nothing notable. The place was empty and I told them first time customer. No interaction until I paid. She asked how was everything I lied and said good! I should have said good luck! No pic since it did look good but tasted  bad. I will not return since to go from 5 to 2 stars IMHO is enough.

It is in incredible that the owner responded by insults. This is the first time I have ever experienced rather then try to make things right or say sorry,  you throw insults and accusations. You are not an attorney you own a crappy food joint. You also criticize Yelp without proof, I dont work for yelp.  I ask for a receipt everywhere since Im here on business. Admitingly I lied about your dry old horrible food only to be nice to the very old lady. It was a white lie something you would not understand. I said good because some of it was good thanks to God not you. Consider getting out of the food business and joining Trump in politics your a counter puncher not a true restauranteur. Everyone should learn from this bitter old man who criticizes yelpers and accuses, insults honest hard working born in America citizen excercising his free speech to criticize terrible food! God bless America! Yelp will probably agree that for insulting and derogatory comments I took away 1 star leaving you with only 1 star!
I've probably been in this store 12 times half of the staff is great but my order has been messed up at least 4 times now and I am hesitant to go in depending on who is working.

Highly recommend El Gallo Giro downtown Boise! Delicious tacos and many more! Never seems to disappoint! Always recommending this restaurant to those who enjoy authentic Mexican food! Their costumer service is amazing! Will most certainly return!

It was recommended to our family as a "must do." The fish special, the fish Florentine, the crawfish gumbo, shrimp gumbo...food was lovely. Service needed some help. Our server was kind and as attentive as she could be, but it should not have taken us three hours to eat. The lines are long,  yet we got in in 20 minutes. To sit and wait for food as long as we did changed all of our plans for the rest of the evening. I would still recommend Gumbo Shop, just be prepared to spend your time there.

Anika, Kellie, the ladies at the front desk, and the young  lady Nina made my experience here even more spectacular. The services we received were bragadocious if I spelled that right. I gave up on nail salons in New Orleans, for the lack of experience, services that you pay for and never get, and actual technique. I'm glad I found this place because it will be my return spot every two weeks. Thank goodness for a real spa experience.

OMG! OMG! OMG! 
This is not a five-star place, it is a DOUBLE FIVE-STAR! 

Superb in everything: food, service, decor, atmosphere, matching hand-painted clay little candle holders, tiny vases with a fresh flower and a bread bucket. No paper on a table cloth either with linen purest white napkins!

Service is super-good: a friendly, attentive, dressed-up servant who know her job. Great!

Food. 
I cannot name you an item that disappointed me or my partner during our dinner. Even bread, pickled peppers and whole grain mustard on the side of an appetizer were delicious there! 
We started with Charcuterie Plate. Superb! Three different kinds of meat prepared in different ways. My fav one was "housemade boudin" which is a sausage and I'm not a big fan of ground meat  stuffed in gizzards. :)

Entrees. 
Roasted Pheasant Breast & Confit Leg. That was my first half a pheasant in my life and it was delicious, cooked with perfection: the breast part was juicy and melted in my mouth. And the leg part was flavorful, tender and  came off the bone with a slight touch. The "sunchoke puree" that accompanied this dish was the best sauce for a cooked bird I've ever had! Even baby carrots and little onion were cooked perfect. 
And one more important part - both entrees had the minimum amount of sodium which is very rare nowadays in restaurants. I appreciated that very much. 
Grilled Hanger Steak was the best example of great beef served with the best choice of sauce - red wine & marrow reduction. It was the tenderest piece of juicy med-rare meat in a rich red wine juice with berries.

And with all those goodies I could not resist but finish our fine dinner with a dessert. 
I had the richest Chocolate-Hazelnut Dessert ever. And it was served in a funny way: a tiny praline cookie topped with mild vanilla ice-cream, a deep dark moist tender chocolate cupcake full of nuts and ... a little glass jar in a form of tiny tube with a cover that was filled with hazelnut milk chocolate paste. I called it "much more chocolate nutella". :) They even served a dessert spoon that fitted perfect in that jar! :)

The chefs did their best! 
Thank you very much, Patios, for a great time we had and delicious food we enjoyed!

Brilliant!  Busy on a Wednesday night between the holidays!  But holy yummmm!  

Greg and I shared ancheese plate appetizer and a pasta carbonara dinner.  More than enough for both of us. So good!  We sat at the bar and enjoyed the talented bar staff and the delicious bar concoctions they brought. Highly recommend and we will be back for the next time we are in Downingtown!

This restaurant has the WORST CUSTOMER SERVICE And the so-called "owners" DK and another women shouldn't own a business if they can't handle customers and know how to act friendly when something is wrong. I've worked in a restaurant for 7 years and I know the ends and outs and how to treat customers NO MATTER WHAT IT SAYS ON THE MENU. If you want to run a successful business maybe start with a smile and friendly services first. Never go here. EVER.

My daughters love learning Tae Kwon Do from the knowledgeable staff at Ellixson's. It keeps them active, it teaches them patients and focus. The owner has always been very nice and has treated me and my family with respect. Also the birthday party's they host there are a lot of fun! I highly recommend this place.
Delicious, thin-crust pizza. Greek salad is great too. Try a pizza with honey and you won't be disappointed.

I can't believe it's taken all this time for me to try the infamous, La Segunda! I tried the Cuban and continental special, both pressed. The Cuban was average tasting for me. I much preferred the continental special because the roast beef stood out. I also ordered a cappuccino for a cold day. It came extremely hot! It took forever for it to cool down enough for it to be drinkable, so be careful!

I've been to Cancun Mexican Restaurant several times because it is convenient.  Their food is good and predictable and their prices are moderate.  The best part about Cancun is that you can almost always find a coupon or discount somewhere.  My favorite dish is their carne asada tacos.

Seen these in Harold and Kumar.  They are not something one would be craving.  
They were greasy and not as good as I thought they would be like.  .Compare to the frozen ones they are worst because of the grease. 
Gotta try them once.

I was glad that I found this place, because the owner treated my hair well. What I asked for was make my hair thinner and more layers, she didn't cut my hair too short and met my requirements. BTW, she is a great artist in painting. I love her work.

Tried two frozen tamales to go. Both reheated well per the instructions on the wrapper, and both were delicious.  Frozen makes them extremely convenient when you're in a pinch playing your favorite video game.

More hipster, than Mexican.  More Chipotle, than the South Tucson Taqueria.

The cut was pretty good.  Like how she cut the back.  However, the colour was not great. Asked for low lights and highlights.  Ended up with my mousy grey and brown hair mixed in with highlights that were too dark and very dull.  Would go back because I did like the cut but will make  sure next time that I get what I ask for (LOWLIGHTS and HIGHLIGHTS)!!
Salami pizza was very good.  We shared a pizza and a lasagna, very very good lasagna but very different.  The calabrese pepper oil they serve with bread is soooo good.  Very trendy, very good.

Best coffee I had for a long time. Beautiful bouquet, aroma with a chocolaty rich taste. 
The scones were soooo good that I am already thinking of tomorrow's coffe and scones. 
Beautiful service as well.
...very friendly.  Kelly gave an excellent shampoo and excellent haircut.  Another person did my color and left marks on my face.

Update: I haven't been a patient there since 11/17, but just got a bill for supposedly unpaid services from LAST year to the tune of $100's plus! It also said this was my final notice. I never got a first one! 
I knew that it was a mistake, so I tried to call the billing dept 6 TIMES over several hours and could not get a person to talk to. Wound up calling my insurance company, who were able to point out to them that yes, that bill had been paid in full. Finally got a call from billing a week later telling me to ignore the bill. When I asked about the mistake the woman hemmed and hawed and refused to discuss it further. Run for your life before they destroy your credit rating.

Great location and excellent bar. Nice view of the water. Appetizers were very good but the main courses is not so much. Highly recommend the mussels and calamari apps but the 'hand carved' steak is very average (and i doubt... 'hand carved'). It seems Seafood is the Specialty here, as our group all loved seafood based dishes but the beef ones fell short. The food deserves three stars for this particular visit but they get an extra one for great service.

Very accommodating for gluten free. They could do almost anything on the menu for me. I cannot rave enough about the short ribs appetizer. We substituted the spaetzle with risotto and it was so good. I'll be back just for that. But the pasta and cheesecake (almond flour crust) were delicious as well!

Dined in Sunday night 2/10/19
Seated around 7 PM and didn't leave until 8:52 PM
Server: Geraldine 
Manager: Bryan or Ryan (didn't hear what he said clearly)

*Skip to the last paragraph for the best part of this all*

I want to start out by saying that I LOVE The Cheesecake Factory. This wasn't our first time, so we know the drill here. I have also been a server for three different restaurants, so again, I know the drill. 

We waited about 35 mins to be seated, but that's expected here. Once we were seated, our server, Geraldine, came to say she'll be right back. 20 minutes later she finally came back, didn't introduce herself and then took our order. We got 3 apps, the first came after 20 minutes. 15 minutes later we were still waiting for our two other apps. They finally came and we're good. We finished our apps around 8 (at this point I was paying close attention to the time. 

8:30 our food finally comes. My cheese was crusty on the burger, the onions were shriveled and there were two random sauces on the burger. There should have only been one sauce. I ordered sweet potato fries and got regular, AND they were cold. We sat for about 10 minutes waiting for Geraldine to come check on us. Meanwhile my boyfriends burger was getting cold. By the way, his was missing sauce and he didn't get a sauce on the side he asked for. She finally came and I asked for the manager. He came, and handled the situation really well. Although I wish I could say he saved the night, after 2 hours there, our night was disappointing. His name was Bryan or Ryan (not 100% sure what he said). So he brings us the check and we wait for Geraldine to come grab it. Once again we were waiting for 10 minutes and finally just got up to YET AGAIN find the manager to complete our payment. We could have just not paid and left. It didn't seem like Geraldine would have even known.

I want to add that both tables surrounding us had a problem with their service as well. Table to our left hadn't gotten drinks for a good 30 minutes and the table to the right didn't get their cheesecakes for at least 35 minutes. I don't know if Geraldine was having a bad night or what, but I wasn't paying $100.00+ for this kind of service. I really got the impression that she was newer and was getting flustered and overwhelmed. Although it was 7:30 on a Sunday.. 

All in all, service was terrible and it seemed the kitchen was off too with all the odd sauces or lack thereof I should say. I would definitely prefer to go to the KOP location next time.

After we finished our first appetizer, we wanted to make room on the table for the next two apps. When Geraldine came to drop off the two plates I asked her if she could take the empty plate (which was sitting there. Ever heard of pre-bussing?) from the first appetizer to make room. She took the tray and started walking away, then turned around and I kid you not she said to my boyfriend "Wait actually can you hold this while I get something for them?". I promise you she handed the plate BACK to my boyfriend and she walked to another table to give them "something". The kicker? SHE NEVER CAME BACK FOR THAT PLATE! My boyfriend sat there holding the plate and just looked at me in shock. I was also speechless. I still am!

We came here to watch the Colts beat the Raiders:) Grant was a really good server and the boneless wings were perfect. My hubby loved the chicken nachos too.  It was our first time here and we will be back.

Filthy, disorganized, stuff all over the place, never have enough inventory, shelves are never restocked, there's usually only 2 registers open at a time with lines of people. One of the worst walmarts I've ever been to. I don't even go here anymore because I know they never have what I want in stock, so I go straight to the Target or Kmart.

Corazon Cocina is so delicious and I wish I could eat it every day! I love Mexican food, and this place was just so good that I can't get enough. 
I just found out they have axxess card deals for the 2018 axxess and the 2019 axxess so make sure to use yours!

I tried the shrimp quesadilla, chicken taco, and the al pastor taco. Everything was amazing! There were large chunks of shrimp  with flavorful cheese in a perfectly crunchy tortilla for the shrimp quesadilla. The chicken taco was tender and perfect! The al pastor taco was my favorite! :) They also have an amazing salsa bar here which was awesome! They have spicy pineapple that you are able to put onto any of tacos which was my favorite addition!  

The flavors of this place were just so incredible and I loved everything! I can't wait to come back here to try all of the rest of their stuff! :)

I am so happy I finally tried this place and we will definitely be back ASAP. If you are ever in the SB public market try this place! They also have amazing Taco Tuesday deals too! :)

Went to Wild River Grille yesterday for happy hour and had a great experience! There were about 7-8 of us and we received amazing service as well as lots of tasty treats. The majority of us drank wine which was $4 on the happy hour menu, which was a great price. We also ordered a bunch of appetizers including the bruschetta (sooo good!), poutine, Cesar salad, crab cakes, and the French onion soup. Great spot for happy hour. I will definitely be back ASAP.

After having a torta from the Valencia location I was hoping this location would be close quality-wise but it wasn't. The chimi I got was bland, I asked for enchilada style but didn't get that. My friends super papas was not popping with flavor either. Really was hopeful

The flavor and portions here are always inconsistent. Last time we ordered to go during Covid for some reason the pad Thai and the drunken noodle tasted more Chinese than Thai. The one time I ordered Thai bbq chicken, it was really good but on the salty side. I've had thai bbq chicken at other Thai places and this one was way more superior in flavor compared to ones I've had in the past. But I would have to try it again to make sure it's consistent in flavor.

Amazing food, worth the wait on a sunny day.  I brought my two friends here in June for one of my last meals in Philly before moving, and I still cannot stop thinking about it.  Everything is fresh and light, and each day is a surprise!

Nicely curated beer list, good food, great conversation while overlooking the river on a early Saturday evening. Very relaxing.

Ambiance - Plenty of space, (2) fairly large dining rooms plus a smaller bar area with high-top tables. Casual'ish dress environment. 

Food - This restaurant is new, the inaugural menu seemed to have a little something for everyone. 
 :Tuna Poke - Excellent (I hope to see more variety of poke offerings in the future)
 :Seafood Tostada - Very good
 :Housemade Soup - Good, hit the spot on this rainy evening.
 :Chipotle Bacon Burger - Excellent, had a nice 'flame broiled' taste to it, good meat-to-bun ratio, the condiments worked well together & the meat was cooked as requested.
 :Crispy Chicken Sandwich - D i s a p p o i n t e d! The chicken did not have that golden brown crispness that I expected. It was mushy and oily. The sandwich was piled too high vertically and just fell apart in my hands as my teeth tried to break apart the tough chicken. The accompaniment of french fries were very good.

Libations - Nice selection of beers. My wife felt that the per-glass wine pour was a little on the chintzy side. Do/will they have any special cocktail offerings, we were never given a cocktail menu?  

Service - Excellent, she gave us the perfect mix of attention and alone time. We didn't feel rushed. Our carafe of water was refreshed and the dishes were cleared in a timely manner.

Pricing - For the most part, it seemed reasonable to me. 

Observations/Suggestions/Complaints: I know that sandwich offerings allow the restaurant to serve "approachable" items but I would like to see some more entrées. Also, Is that small bar going to be able to handle higher volume in the future? (our drinks took a while to come to the table)

We like this restaurant, can't wait to return and check-out the outdoor patio!
Came here twice for lunch while on vacation.  Great pizzas and pasta.
Great steak amidst a pleasurable atmosphere,  higher end on the water,  great date place.  Small, intimate, and delicious.  Highly recommend.

The usual. Coffee. Snacks. Tables. 

Expect to wait in line at almost any time of the day.

I don't normally give 5 ratings a lot for obvious reasons, but the mix of awesome customer service, a great final product, and overall fantastic experience Rudy's gets a fizive! 

I recently had the clasp on my Burberry Watch go bad and couldn't find a decent jeweler in the city. I went in on a Wednesday and my watch was ready to pick-up on Saturday, nice clasp and shinier than ever! 

The work was impeccable and they guarantee all their work so if anything ever goes wrong with my clasp again I can take it in here! Every person I dealt with was 100% customer service oriented and it was so refreshing to feel like a patron instead of a number.
