Rudy's is legit and I would recommend it as a Class A jeweler that knows how to handle fine jewelry or just switch out a watch battery!

This is the best nail salon in the Nashville area. I drive 50 minutes from Hendersonville to get my nails done here. The owners are super nice and accommodating. They genuinely care about their reputation and make sure that you are completely happy. The pedicure scents are amazing! We usually go as a group of 4 once a month and it is the best Sunday of the month for us!
I was excited to eat here on Friday and the place was closed.  This was so disappointing!  Hopefully they are still in business and will try to give them another opportunity.

I have ordered from the skippack el limon location twice now through door dash. The first time the order took 2 hours to reach my house, less than 3 miles away. I decided to give them another chance 2 months later. This time I ordered early too, at 5, to make sure it doesn't take too long. But I had 2 incorrect items in my order. I will not order from here again.

Wonderful experience. Unfortunately I could have these test I was scheduled for due to reasons out of their control (my body was the issue)  I have to return Friday. Though it was not their fault they apologized profusely and even gave me a voucher for the cafeteria for my troubles. This facility is nearly and hour from my home but I chose to go here because of the wonderful service every time. A bonus is that the place is gorgeous and the coffee is delicious.

Had the calamari and mushroom apps, seasonal salad, and combo Fiduea.  Everything right down to the bread and butter was ridiculously good.  Fiduea takes a little time but is sooooo worth it.  I've never had anything like it, and can't wait to go back.  And oh yeah, get the sangria.

Altough I have been here a few times for splurgy cocktials, I have only eaten here once over four years ago.  Despite the long-time last since my last visit, the divine taste of the gnocchi is still on my mind.  I also remember enjoying my lamb dish thoroughly.  The ambiance is first rate and reminds me of many high-end bars in London.  The only downside is that it's opresseviely expensive.  Be sure to go here when someone else is paying!
Pizza is vary good pasta good.  They have a buffet  at  11:00am. All you can eat  . Service  beer. A fun  place to eat.

Estia's food exceeded my expectations. My friend and I did the restaurant week menu and both got the lamb and it was so good and flavorful! The only thing that wasn't good was the service though. We had a waiter the first time before switching tables and he was unfriendly, curt, and seemed like he did not want to wait on us, and when we asked about their other menu he just said it's about the same (they have a $35 menu that's basically the same as restaurant weeks)... like thanks for the explanation. We switched tables after because my friend spilled her water lol and our new waitress came by once to take our orders and then to give us our checks and the bus boys took care of us more than she did. Made me sad knowing that the majority of the tip was going to her and not the people who seems to be working a lot harder.
"Terrific hole in the wall!!! Best guacamole that I have ever had!!! Super friendly staff!!!"

After reading some of the previous reviews, I admit that I was nervous to dine at La Viola. 

The experience I had last night, though, was phenomenal. I arrived with a group of about 12 people and we were quickly seated outside. Not long after, a few servers delivered warm bread to our table and popped a few of our champagne bottles. 

Since we were such a large group, we were given prix fixe menus. For the appetizer, I ordered a plate of mozzarella and tomatoes, which was a light and tasty dish. I ordered the salmon as my entree. I personally found it to be very "fishy." For some people, this may be off putting. The filet itself was huge, so if anything, you will definitely get your money's worth. Overall, the dish was fine, but nothing extraordinary. To conclude the meal, I ordered tiramisu and immediately fell in love. The dessert was perfectly fluffy and creamy. Absolutely incredible! 

Overall, the food at La Viola is nothing to write home about. The tiramisu, however, was a knock out. This place will have a special place in my heart, because of the convivial atmosphere and exceptional attention we received all night!

This place now accepts credit cards but, alas, no alcohol. The food, however, was quite good. Place is relatively small with only two tables designed for more than four diners. Service was fast and friendly. Owner/chef came out to see if we were satisfied.

Our server was Alicia. She was great. We were visiting family and this restaurant was recommended for breakfast. Great choice. We normally go to another restaurant  but decided to break the monotony.  Glad we did, we both had  the make your own omelette.  Both were great. The grits were cheesy and delicious. Had a side of biscuits and gravy, which was delicious. I am not a fan of biscuits  and gravy but I would order this again. The only downside is parking. The are about 10 slots behind the restaurant and street parking down the street. Definitely will go back when we are in town.

You can't beat the view from The Canopy! It makes it one of the best spots in DTSP. My friend and I stopped by for a Fri night happy hour. The crowd was eclectic which was nice. The servers were friendly and all wearing masks. The only downside was an older patron enamored by the view who stood directly over my friend (behind her chair) taking pictures. So rude!!

If you are looking for a GIANT MILKSHAKE this is the place to go!! My boyfriend loves the chocolate shakes here and has been coming here for years. I was craving a strawberry milkshake last night and he suggested going here. We went through the drive thru and ordered a large chocolate and a large strawberry shake, the cashier asked if I wanted real strawberries and i said yes. I assumed that it would have chunks of strawberries, which I wanted, and I was correct. What my boyfriend forgot to mention was size of the shakes...they are huge (also makes up the fact that the total of the two shakes was a bit more than $11). At the window they have a sign to be patient as the food is made to order, but we got our shakes right away, I think it was because it was late. I would go back again and try more of their flavors because they have MANY. I was also surprised by the size of their food menu!!

Cheap, simple, delicious. This restaurant is a textbook lesson in how to succeed by sticking to what you're good at. The Jamaican patties are tender, savory comfort food and the menu is limited to a few things.

Buy one or two for a snack, 3 or more for a meal. I have yet to try the curry but I will certainly be back. 

CASH ONLY. I've been thwarted once when I showed up and forgot to bring cash money. Frowny sad face was me. (Not frowny enough to dock it down from 5 stars)

Food was really good and fresh , remind me of wicked spoon in Vegas . Only reason they received 2 Stars its because of Edward Leung the chef who was handling the Pho station. This guy has no idea of what he is doing , didn't speak a word of English and the looked on his face is horrible when we ask him to do his job . Management , if your reading this , discipline him before he makes more mistakes .

Went to the Washington twp location for first time today. Parking is crazy. But nice selection of produce.  Flowers all seemed very healthy. Will definitely go back again. Next time I will check out the deli side

I enjoyed my visit here to Frida's and the food is very tasty! The restaurant has vibrant art work and is very festive. One thing I liked was that it was also quiet and I could enjoy conversation at the table. The service is very friendly too.

I ordered the nachos which were enjoyable but I would have liked more toppings on them. I also tend to favor the thicker chips that El Limon offers.  I tried the Chile rellenos and they were really delicious. These are such a tough item to find. Frida's version  was delicious and the egg batter was light and fluffy and the peppers had some chorizo too.

The star of the show for me was the dessert. Churros crispy cinnamon and sugar served warm and crisp with a lovely scoop of vanilla ice cream. I would run not walk back here for the churros alone. The best I've ever had.  I would definitely go back to Frida's. They even offer breakfast. Check for availability.

Have to to many Legal Seafood in various locations over the years. It has been several years since I have been due to no nearby location. The receptionist was rude. I was giving her my name when the phone rang. She immediately answered the phone without a word or a gesture for me to hold on. She talked on the phone for several minutes so I walked away. Spoke to the manager and she was very laissez faire attitude. Once seated, yikes, the menu is limited and very pricey
As your sides were fries and coleslaw. Needless to say I got up and left. I was so disappointed, its not the same. So much changed for the worse.
Giving me a bun with only pastrami in it isn't fucking funny.
You can order outside due to COVID-19, which is cool with me. The Chai Latte was delicious and I also ordered a the pesto sandwich on a croissant. Yummy!

I had a wonderful experience here for a friend's wedding last night.

Now, I'm a fan of all of Paul and Wendy's ventures (including, but not limited to, 1111 Mississippi, Pw's Pizza, and Vin de Set) so I knew when the day came that I was finally invited to a special event at Moulin (you can't just go there, because it's an event venue) I would have a great time.  And I did.

Staff were there to greet me when I came up the stairs and showed me where gifts were placed, where to sign the guest book, and where the food and alcohol was.  Our bartenders were friendly and fast, the food (especially the bacon-wrapped shrimp) was fresh and delicious, and dinner service was stellar.  Even when there was a hiccup or two (inexperienced servers losing half a tray of champagne glasses onto the floor), the cleanup was fast and efficient, with little drama.

Service was very good, our waiter was excellent, and frankly the highlight of our evening.  Food was okay, not bad at all, but just now "wow".  The place is dirty and old, hasn't been updated (and possibly cleaned) in decades.  The location and the hotel next door, downright scary.  There were some very questionable people hanging out at the hotel when we came out after dinner, made me uneasy.  I realize a place doesn't have control over it's surroundings, but the scary hotel really brings this place down!
Solid deli style subs and sandwiches. Hot and cold options. I had the Omar which was delicious and their Macaroni salad was well done. I will be back.
Yay gluten free pizza! Yummy. Prices are resonable and the food is awesome. Very friendly service. I will definitely be back. They have the best gluten free pizza crust i have tasted so far.
Absolutely my favorite Mexican restaurant! Can't say enough good things about the food, drinks or the staff! Marco is awesome. Never have I left disappointed! This is a must go-to.

Mollies food is outstanding!!! My husband and I love coming to Mollies! I love how she goes to every table and greets every customer and gives them recommendations. Her and her staff are definitely great people!
It just keeps getting better and better.  $2 Tuesday night pints make my day.  Great service.

One of the best meals I've had in quite some time!

Amazing food, great beer and wine selection, and very friendly staff. 

Don't be put off by the mostly residential neighborhood. It's definitely worth going a little out of the way for.

This place is beautiful. It's a hidden treasure in the rough. From the outside you would not believe how beautifully it is on the inside. It's a great venue for parties, wedding reception and like the event I attended there a Royal Princess Ball. This place is set up for a princess.  You would feel like you walked into a palace. The ambience was spectacular.  It's an inexpensive venue for any function.  The staff there was very accommodating especially Kim the event Manager.
Love this spot!!! Kurt is an awesome bartender, and Pete (owner) is one of the nicest guys you could ever meet!!!

My dish was too salty
:( 
Aftertaste was sour from our shrimp creole 
But the plantains taste amazing !!
Hella heavy seasoning. 


Price was decent 


Vibe was chill, not a lot of people inside when we were there.

We were nearby and had to try it based on a friend's recommendation. 
Server was great, food was exactly as described.

I've got to admit, my favorite part was the red hot Riplet seasoning for the fries.

All the parts of our burgers tasted good, but mine could've used some type of sauce; the bun was pretty dry.

Neat place, I'd recommend giving it a try.

The food was good. Had a dosa and a vada. The flavors were there. The place was sort of in the middle of nowhere. The cleanliness of the place looked suspect. 

I may not venture there again. 

Good luck to them.

Came here because the reviews looked good, and the food looked tasty in pictures. But in reality, it only looks good, tasted below average. Overpriced for what you get, and the chicken wings were not seasoned at all- no flavor! Greasy chips, spinach and artichoke dip was terrible. It had hard chunks of inedible artichoke and was cold. Fish and chips were over-breaded, and lacked flavor. All around disappointing, and service was extremely slow. Waiters were not helpful, either. 
Would not recommend coming here.

I am a Tampa Native and I've always thought this place was stellar but what moved me to write this review today was a chocolate chip cookie I grabbed for my daughter. This choc chip cookie was a religious experience- I mean perfect crunch on the outside and chewy and chocolatey and spectacular- I wish I could think of more adjectives but I was so blown away all I could think of was,"WOWWWWWWW". 
 
This is a fantastic place for lunch- the soups always do me so right- ohhhh and the pastries in the morning- or Tortas (little omelette like things in a pan) sell out quickly. My fav in there dinner menu has always been the salmon in dill sauce. The menu is pretty seasonal and the chef always comes up with new things! This is a muy popular place- and now with their added bar- the parking lot in this strip mall is entirely always packed!  Oh and grab some bread from Pane Rustica, walk next door to redneck wine then continue in to Cheese Please and have an instant intimate party at home! Tampa is moving on up!

Yumm, Benchmark Eatery is where it's at! Super friendly cashier and waitstaff and everything on the menu looked delicious! This was was first time snd the person I was with recommended the tacos. They ordered a beef taco and carne asada taco and I ordered a chicken taco. We also shared the coconut shrimp app. We both ordered water, which comes in a glass container you bring to the table and pour yourself. We sat on the outside patio and it was lovely. Thank you!
Lunch today at Estia was fabulous. I eat out often on the Main Line and Estia is consistently delicious...the service is always excellent... 'they get it'.
Food and service were great!  Don't order the large frozen margarita unless you have a way home!

Just really the worst place. Visiting family. Salty Dog was 2 hour wait; Noah's as well. Popped into Cobblestone...dead! Maybe couple tables and some people at the bar. Like two people. This was foreboding but decided to try as we were starving. Got Wedge Salad with dressing on the side; let you get a good look at the lettuce which was wilted beyond eating. Some strange peeled tomato garnish. The several slices of cucumber were good. My husband got the salmon appetizer and the toast was soaked through. We ordered three $38 steaks; two were rare when supposed to be medium and one was not tasty. The garnish which I think was a fresh sprig of thyme at one point was burned beyond knowing and was the first impression when the waitress shoved the plate in my hands. I asked for no brown butter as my meal needed to be dairy free. There was no brown butter on my meat but our asparagus (which only the tips were barely edible; the woody brown stalks occupied the remainder) was drenched in it while my daughters' was dry. When we pointed out to waitstaff after I had eaten it, she came back saying the chef said he had put olive oil on it which was a lie as we compared the "on the side" butter with that on my plate. Exactly the same and the usual lactose intolerant symptoms all evening and night. Mashed potatoes on other two plates had hard crust as if had been under heat lights. Absolutely no presentation. Really kinda dead feeling everywhere. Won't be back, period.
4 for the food and service but a big zero for the political bullshit. It's a restaurant not Fox News. Such a shame. The food was fantastic but i won't give a penny more to science  deniers.!!!
omg!!! off the hook delicious fresh food!!! fantastic service!!! And great atmosphere !!!!
The rooster!! So much yum fun! Yum drinks! Yum food! Our server SCREAMED when he talked. Taken back, but still had fun!! We appreciate it! Xoxo

This restaurant is walking distance to my boyfriend's house, so we had to check it out. It was totally worth it, and before we were even half way through our meals, we both said "Oh, we are definitely coming back!"
He purchased a Chicken Shawarma pita and I ordered Greek Salad. Both portions were large and extremely tasty. The ambiance is a little homemade, but there was a small stage and we want to go back when there is live music. There is a great, but small outdoor space so you can totally enjoy the weather. Overall, very satisfied and definitely a staple in our new neighborhood. Great job Malelani.
I had the vegetarian Philly cheesesteak. It was really good. The fries were awful. The service was fast. My waiter Michael was so nice and sweet.

Was waiting in line for about three minutes with a curly haired girl behind the cash register on the phone , the next cashier said next in line please , the cashier that was on the phone watched us wait in line never said this line is closed . It was crowded with kids running around with no supervision. The pizza was disgusting when we got home with it witch we live two minutes away, it was under cooked and the cheese and all the toppings all fell off of every slice, so we ate pizza dough with pizza sauce and had to eat the cheese and toppings separately never go back again and lived here all my life will never recommend this place to anyone . Get good pizza at Giovanni's way better

We came here to watch the Philadelphia Union game tonight and the staff and manager were so great and accommodating. We were able to get a seat right in front of the screen. They have great COVID protocols with online ordering, drinks always came fast when we put in a new order. We'll definitely be back for Philly sports!

I thought the service was amazing! We never had to wait around for anything and our main meals came out as soon as we finished our appetizers. This is my first 5 star review and I don't mess around when it comes to Stars people. Bravo urban grub. Bravo

My reviews are reserved for meals that are particularly special to me.  Isabel's should be named when listing the best Mexican restaurants in Philly.  The plates are well executed and even if they miss your particular standard, they don't cut corners.  My fiancé and I had a groupon and decided to use it.  My fiancé had tilapia ceviche, carne asada, and we shared a tres leches.   I had the queso fundido, cochinita pibil, same dessert.  

Firstly: in-house tortilla chips that were NOT greasy--well done.  Salsa is loaded with cumin, interesting and fresh.

Tilapia ceviche: tasted like anything but tilapia.  Huge portion, loaded with the right ingredients (SIMPLE: cilantro, tomato, onion, lime) and they were crisp and fresh.  Fiancé added their in-house habenro hot sauce for a kick.

Carne Asada: we were disappointed in the asada because you can't choose the temp and they inevitably over cooked it. Guac, beans, and rice were phenomenal--would have traded the meat for a double side of rice and beans.

Queso fundido- a universally welcomed comfort food.  Chorizo is the high-light with a smokey, cinnamon finish.  Mushrooms compliment the chorizo with a necessary earthy note.  Cheese is a good quality Oaxaca, fresco blend.

Cochinita pibil- 5 out of 5, amazing, and totally unexpected.  Usually cochinita pibil is crispy and in danger of becoming dry, but not this version.  The pork is cubed and probably cooked longer on a lower temp; the reason why I think it's cooked longer than usual is because the achiote sauce is incredibly dense with flavor--only time produces such results.  Rice, beans, and an unnecessary well executed caramelized, baked banana.  Without pickled onions, the dish looses a star--such a nice balance.

Tres leches- sweet, sweet, sweet. Nothing new, but nothing lost. I'm still shaking a bit, hours after the fact.  The "fluff" top borders on ridiculous, but I didn't mind it.

Three stars because I'm marrying a Colombian and have been to multiple Mexican weddings: we simply don't have the ingredients and time/patience to eat Oaxaca/Yucatan meals.  The service was well intended and the atmosphere was warm an friendly.

 If you want "complex" go to Starr.  If you want "good" support your independent restaurateurs.

Recently moved from the dmv to philly and was very hesitant to get a new dentist, especially during COVID. This place was awesome! The staff was extremely friendly, professional, and I was in and out within an hour. The dentist was super informative and walked me through everything she was doing. 10/10 would recommend.
Really good place to eat, quick service, lots of fun art and antiques to look at while you eat!
I will start this review by saying that this is one of my place to eat. The food here is amazing and the people here are exceptionally friendly, I would definitely recommend this to a friend.
The best of the best!! Won't go anywhere else. Same day service at its finest. Highly recommend them. Great prices and friendly staff.

We just had a drink and dessert here. My husband had the fried pie. It was apple. He said it was too much like Mickey D's....and that it needed  some cinnamon. I had the ice cream sandwich which was a sugar cookie with vanilla ice cream and marshmallows. It was good.

Had some work to do in town and found this gem. Amazing food!!! Probably one of the best veal I ever had. Staff were friendly and helpful with the menu. Ask about "The Secret" for dessert. Ooofah! Delicious

I've never been a fan of counter culture, their brewed coffee tastes fruity, watery, and lacks body. However the espresso pulled by that tattooed fella with the beard was one of the finest I've had in years. Excellent music filled the air, with various genres. Him and I exchanged stories of parenthood, he even offered us some baby clothes! Like wowsers we just met. It's those kind of interactions that people crave to start their day. Not to mention he had some sweet karate tips to share with me!
Heard they just opened and stopped in for a quick bite to eat and pleasantly surprised. Excellent food with great outdoor vibe.

While I only got to stay here for one night I have to say that everything about my experience was perfect. Checking in took 2 minutes, staff were amazingly friendly, stunningly impressive lobby (I'll nerd out over the design later), and to top it off, the front desk gave us a complimentary 2 hour late check out! I visit the city often and always seem to stay at the wrong hotel but I know this will be my new home in Philly! The building must be a historic structure - looks like it was built c.1920, with your typical neo-classical high-rise details and columns. As you enter you're swept away by the beautiful marble floors, trendy furniture, eclectic colors and a gorgeous mixture of different feels and textures. The mixture of wooden and brass accents against the bold colors that play on modern and historic really push this place to be unforgettable. There's nothing basic or typical about it. I'm personally sick of basic old hotel lobbies and standard rooms, and this place checked off all the boxes from design, to service to hygiene! The rooms were pretty clean and despite the COVID frenzy I felt pretty comfortable staying here.
Worth the walk! Even their basic cheese fries, death by chee... eeese is well executed. The fries are huge and the pies ate just the right size!

First off...I miss the A&P. But Mr. B still works there and probably still throws shop-lifters through the door window on occasion. I think the prepared foods were better before but they seem to be trying to make way for a few more items there (No clue where they will put them as small as it is). I still drop in occasionally to say hi and get a quick drink. 
DOn't expect to go there and pay regular Rouse's prices on most things.  It's not that kind of store. If I needed real groceries and still lived/.worked in the area, I'd probably go to Matassa's. 
True story, I once met Sabastian Bach in line. He was buying tons of booze. This was when we was "sober".
Smoked Salmon Eggs Benedict was great, meal portion was just right. Staff was attentive .  Will return
Overpriced, bunch of idiots. I have gotten sick after eating here and so has a co worker of mine at the same location.

I'd give the store itself a 4, the service a 1. Yeah, I know it's fast fashion, made in China, but check yer clothing tags, so is everything else (not that that's an excuse). As a girl saving money for more important things right now, I loathe to spend $$$ on trends, so this is a good store for non-classic buys; looks that I'm not sure I'll be loving 1 or 2 years from now.

I hesitate on the shoes;  I do have one pair from here that I love. I've returned a few. I'm fairly picky about shoes.  Not being 17, my dogs were barking over the cheap shoe thing. Lesson learned.

This store is great for tees, cute little dresses, blouses- stay away from anything silver or gold-tone in the jewelry, it'll look icky cheap in a week. 

The service on the FLOOR here is So. Comically. Bad. It's a lot o clerks who seem to have been magically transplanted to the South from, like, Encino? And really, like, don't know where anything is, okay? And they've really have to go right now, like, Destiny, can you help herrrr? No? Well Trevor can YOU do it? Look, lady, why don't you look at our website, I gotta go hang up these tanks. Like, seriously. 

The service at the counter is great, no problem. Odd. 

You just have to have a sense of humor about the floor show, and order what you really need... SIGH.... off the web, if you can't find it, and return it to the store to avoid shipping costs if you didn't like it. :/

Very cool, informative, and exciting experience! I went on the day tour on a weekday so it wasn't as crowded as I'm sure a weekend might be. The tour guide was quite knowledgeable about each "big cat" we saw. I was sad to learn that so many of the big cats that they've rescued had been abused. However, it's nice to know that Big Cat Rescue does everything in their power to give these cats the best life that they can.

Pink & White is my go to nail salon. This visit, I got an SNS manicure from Wanda and am so happy with the results! She shaped and cut my nails exactly how I wanted and was very helpful when I asked her opinions on what color to choose.
Ordered a buffalo chicken wrap on Uber eats from here, it tasted amazing, and they even followed my special instructions! Will definitely be ordering again from this restaurant again.
Came here a couple days ago with friends. I like their rabbit meat! Very tasty. And the salmon sashimi was very fresh!

Great location and finally found a restaurant with easy parking in SB! Cafe has a nice, casual atmosphere right next to the beach. You can order your food at the counter and grab a seat. Coffee is great (Peets coffee) and the pancakes are BOMB.com! 

We orders the Santa Barbara omelette (tasted like pico de gallo & lots of cheese scrambled in) and the wheat germ blueberry pancakes. No complaints here; just a nice full belly! One thing that was a little annoying was there wasn't any food descriptions... Most of the menu items are pretty simple and self-explanatory but nonetheless delicious! 

Ps. Take a stroll down the beach to walk off the pancake belly :)

Terrible service!  Tried to up-sell me on things they could not even explain and when I asked how the more expensive upgrades do what they do, she developed an unpleasant attitude to say the least.  In the future I'll be going elsewhere

My husband and I eat here quite a bit and it was once of our favorites.... We stopped ordering entrees quite a few visits ago,  typically both of us are not overly hungry.  Campo is great with salads, appetizers, pizza, desserts, (even though very small) lunch menu is over all good. Ambience is cool, relaxing yet busy and trendy. 

   This evening we tried an entree again.... Fail! Steak was tough, so tough it took more than a two minutes to chew. And sauce was fairly bitter. $26 was too much for flank steak. Halibut, Dungeness crab for $28 was fishy and drowned in lemon. Way too much! 

  We rarely complain but the last meal was bad enough, we couldn't stomach $70 for gross food. Although not expecting any discount from the check, it's typically the thing to do. The manager seemed upset to do so, we DIDNT ask for it, he did it on his own accordance. 

  Pretty bummed. :(

Favorite pizza place in the area!! Fantastic garlic knots and you get a ton in each order! The pizza is incredible and the service is even better. Crust is good, sauce is good, and not too greasy! Highly recommend!

Nice little place but it packs a huge food punch.    The food is excellent and the food presentation is what you would find in a five star restaurant. 
The service is fantastic and they have my favorite desert banana foster

My mother stayed here last night. She valet parked her car.  

This morning the police were there when she came downstairs.  Her car was one of several to get broken into last night.

The concierge woman was very rude.  The manager would not speak to my mother at any point during the day.  They wouldn't compensate her room, or give back to her in any way even though many things were stolen from her car.  

The least I would expect was that the people who run the hotel would be sympathetic and kind when a crime happened under their watch.

The people at this hotel do not care about the people who stay here.  AND don't bring a car, or there is a good chance your car will get broken into and the hotel won't care.   

Stay elsewhere.

If you are looking for a realtor, Steve Appel is the guy to go to. We knew within minutes of meeting Steve we were going to ask him to sell our home.  He was very honest up front and suggested to us what improvements we needed to do in order for a faster sale.  Steve did his homework on our house and showed us how our home compared against other homes in the Hillsborough/Pasco County area. Steve put our home on the market in February and it was under contract within 12 days. Steve is very personable, positive attitude, reassuring, very knowledgeable, honest, but most of all we could tell without a doubt he loves his job. These are just a few of his wonderful attributes This is the first house my husband and I sold and Steve made us feel comfortable, and provided us with his knowledge and also guided us during the process of selling our home.  He always kept us updated; he would phone, text or email us.  He sent us updates on the how many views, hits, and saves we had on line. How many people came to our open house etc., we never once had to call him and ask him what was going on with the selling of our home.  We were contacted 2 weeks after we closed by our HOA President and I called Steve to see if he could assist us,  he immediately took care of everything.   He did not have to do this but he took the time to take care of us.  We just want to Thank Steve Appel for being a the best Realtor anyone could have!  You are the best Mr. Appel!!

I don't know why I keep ordering from here. It's really good if you get enough dressing but it doesn't have enough flavor if you don't. I have ordered from here at least 6 times for extra dressing and they have never once sent it with the delivery. I pay an extra .60 for it. I have complained to the restaurant every single time and nothing has changed. I have also wrote in the comments "please don't forget extra dressing thank you" and still nothing. They also don't put in any of the extras that I pay for. I always order extra edamame and mushrooms and still barely get any. This is one of the few places I can order from because of food allergies. So if you don't mind paying for things and not receiving them, order take out or delivery from here.

I expected authenticity, but overall this is great addition to American Chinese Cuisine when one is craving Chinese food. It had American dishes with a little authenticity. Perfect for those not use to the traditional Chinese cuisine but wanting a relaxing atmosphere and decent food.  While the menu is huge, you can find dishes for most everyone. 

We tried the Beef with Chinese Broccoli, which was O.K., but didn't match up to other restaurants or what I make at home.  The other dish we had were the Pork Meatballs.  They were moist, flavorful, but still lacked a WOW! factor.  As an appetizer, we choose one of the best options: Shrimp and Pork Wontons in a spicy chili sauce.  Those were good with just a little hint of spice.  

At the end of the evening, the waiter recommended the spicy hot pot (on the secret menu).  Maybe next time?
Best breakfast in Indianapolis.  The cinnamon roll French toast is my favorite.  My husband loves the breakfast chimichanga.
if your looking for a down and out good home cooked breakfast look somewhere else this is breakfast with a twist...overall it was okay but thats my taste buds

The environment in nail tek is your typical, factory line of nail services. The prices are right, the employees work at a quick pace and their work is quite good. Don't go expecting a quality spa experience,  go expecting a safe and sanitary environment with high quality professional products being used. I've done sets, refills and pedicures here with great results.  Barely would one of my nails get broken or have I received shoddy workmanship. If you are dissatisfied,  the staff will rectify the situation and do what they can to ensure you leave with a smile on your face and beautiful nails. They don't try to strong arm you into spending more than is necessary and are quite fair.  As someone from the beauty industry I give much respect to the staff and the services they provide. Even at their busiest of times, their service is prompt and you will be attended to in a timely manner. If you want a high quality "spa" experience then I suggest seeking out a day spa , however for amazing nails with an amazing price,  this is the spot !!

AMBIENCE: 7.3/10
SERVICE: 7.7/10
FOOD: 7.4/10

It's crowded.
Food prices are affordable.
This is NOT a place to take kids or a date.

EXCELLENT!  Freshest tacos I've had in a while.  Delicious salsa collection.  Personable & professional employees.  Definitely recommend.

I had to convince my husband to go here at first. He didn't trust my pregnancy taste but it served us well. The building appears to be an old factory (go figure) and\or church. Maybe a factory church, or church factory (where they make churches). We were seated immediately by Rachel Dratch (a Debbie Downer of a hostess) after waiting our turn to sit in a fancy chair (some kid was abandoned by his mother in a velvet, Prince-esque chair). My husband ordered a sausage spaghetti and I ordered a lobster\pesto ravioli. They were both delicious as was the garlic bread. The giant man server taking care of two neighboring tables was quite entertaining ("Hey, ya'll! I got bread!"). People watching was pretty great, too. Everything was topped off with a meal-included Spumoni ice-cream. Weird, but good. Thanks, ye Old Spaghetti Factory! Cheer up, Rachel Dratch.

Absolute scam. My car got towed (totally my fault). I went to the impound lot and paid all outstanding tickets / fees. Then I got a notice I still needed to pay for the two tickets which initiated the tow in the first place. I had already paid for these tickets at the lot in order to get my car back the same day it was towed. 

I was forced to dispute the tickets online which I did immediately, in April when it happened. They are supposed to rule on the dispute within 30 days. After not hearing a word, I called them in July (90 days after) and they said "disputes are backed up you won't hear on the ruling until December". Which is absolutely insane but it gets worse. I received a ticket for parking in the same spot i park every day in an eligible zone for my residential pass that is clearly visible in my rear window. Went online to dispute that one too and what do you know, my two tickets that I had disputed from April where apparently ruled on in November, and each incurred $65 in late fees because of their own "back up in disputes". 

Called customer service and was told I could request an in-person hearing or get on a payment plan. What a joke and scam this organization is. They were 8 months late on my dispute then without any notification at all (no mail no email nothing) they rule against my dispute AND charge me the late fees that they were responsible for. 

What course of action do I have? Nothing because you are dealing with an organization run by criminals with no oversight into their malicious shady practices.
Jakera just opened a drive thru.  Super fast and convenient.  Food is from an abreviared menu and was delicious
Kind of new for Tucson. Went in on a whim. I can honestly say it's the best authentic Indian food in town and I've been  here 30 years! Try it!
Awesome service and attention to detail. Alfonso always delivers on his word. Plus they have the most competive prices around:-))

I am a local of the Radnor Township area.  I love to eat locally and try new places, so today before heading to the US Open my girlfriend and I decided to grab a quick bite to eat.

Having to head out to Wayne to grab the tickets from a friend, my girlfriend suggested "the grilled cheese" place in Wayne.  Having never been there before, and looking for something quick and a little on the lighter side, we decided to check it out.  

Now she had been there once before and said it was good from what she had remembered as it was a while ago.  Plus, she had been talking about it for a couple of days and who doesn't love a grilled cheese.  After looking up the menu online, we both decided it'd be perfect to get a half grilled cheese sandwich with salad and soup.  The Melt Down is reasonably priced, it'd be the right amount of food, and my girl had liked it in the past... well boy did we not have a good experience at all.

A little background of myself.  I am in the restaurant business, a server as a matter of fact, on the Main Line.  I have been serving on the Main Line for 5 years, and let me tell you I cannot wait until I'm done.  Serving customers in this area is very tough as the people are demanding, picky, and unforgiving.  So, I know the deal and have been around.

We walk in and are looking up at the menu trying to decide.  A couple of people come in behind us and are trying to decide as well.  Knowing I wanted to get to the Open, I looked at my girl and said I'll order and you just decide on the fly.  I go up to the girl taking orders (who will remain nameless unless pressed for a name as I still have my receipt) and said "Let me get two of the two-fer combos.  I would like the Maryland crab grilled cheese with the chopped salad." She then asks chips or apple and I say chips.

I turn to my girlfriend to order.  She goes, "I'll have the ham and cheese with the corn chowder soup."

The girl asks cup or bowl.

At this point we were confused because we knew only a cup is offered with the combo, but didn't think twice as she heard me ask for the two two-fer combos.  My girlfriend says bowl, and then the employee proceeds to ask "apple or chips", and my girlfriend orders an apple.  

The employee then asks me if I would like a fountain drink or milkshake.

Great! I love milkshakes so I said, "Awesome, let me get a vanilla milkshake".

She then proceeds to hand me a fountain drink cup, we pay, and take a seat.  Now not ever having been here before I was unaware of how the milkshake thing worked.  

So we sit down and are looking around trying to figure out how I'm getting my shake.  As we are doing that my girlfriend is looking over the receipt and notices we were only rung up for one two-fer combo and the other was rung up as a full sandwich (with a note of 'fruit' as the side), one bowl of soup, and a fountain drink.

I see a couple of milkshakes go by, but nothing for me.  Our food finally comes up and the girl who took our order drops it off.  My girlfriend shows her the receipt and says "we ordered two two-fers and you only rang up one but that's fine, but where is his milkshake?" (the vanilla one I ordered)

She proceeds to say, "He didn't say he wanted a milkshake."  My girl says, "Yes he did, you asked fountain drink or milkshake and he said vanilla milkshake."

She looks at us says, "No he didn't, I'm sorry" and walked away.  

Now working in the service industry, whether I did or didn't, you could offer a milkshake AT LEAST.  She told me what I said.  On top of that both sandwiches came with chips, no apple!

One of my old restaurant bosses once told me, if you provide OUTSTANDING service, the food can be just good and people will come back.  If the service is AWFUL then people wont come back.

I can truly say I will not be back to Melt Down Grilled Cheese.  All I needed was some sort of solution to the problem and I would have probably gone back as the grilled cheeses were pretty good.

Disappointing.  Upset with my fellow service industry people.

I got a full body massage and it left me bruised.  I  Iike medium pressure, but that was not what I received.  I had a hard time breathing because of the tremendous amount of pressure.  I should have stopped it.

I cannot emphasize how underwhelmed we were. First- when scheduling, you're asked to put together a portfolio of interest. This includes sizes, price ranges, preferred shapes, etc. This feels like a great way to make sure you have time to see a lot in your 45 min appointment slot- except they do not prepare nor gather any of the items you select. When prompted, our representative said that we could instead "build" the preferred ring on their computer and they would mail it. Anyone who knows anything about ring shopping knows NOT to build a ring online. You will certainly be ripped off. 

We found our representative under informed on: trade in/trade up policies, differences in natural vs lab made diamonds, and company mission. What exactly is an "ethically" made diamond if 90% of in house rings are lab made? We still don't know. We couldn't figure out why a 2 carat ring was $35k compared to the same 2 carat ring being $9k if lab made. For those in the market- those are STEEP differences compared to what you can find on jewelers row. 

I would recommend that ring shoppers skip this place. The showcase is probably 30 rings big and all customization happens on the computer. They really mainly show "ready to buy" rings and our representative confirmed that 70% of their customers are there for un-customized lab made diamonds. They cannot compete in the natural diamond market which means 816291916 other chicks probably have the same ring as you.

Definitely slept on this place! I got the brisket with the bbq beans and mac & cheese, and I have to say that I was impressed. Definitely was enough food for $12. Only thing I didn't like was the hot bbq sauce... it was too "vinegary". Like the after taste from the sauce didn't taste right for me. I'll try the other bbq sauce next time. Still 4 stars for the food !
The pizza was absolutely great.  Beef tortellini was great too. Service was really good. I will be back

Pretty hard to imagine anyone giving this hotel more than one star. You get far less than you pay for. I have no bias and no hidden agenda. I knew it was cheap when I booked it, but seriously?  Where do I begin:

1) Toilet rocks severely (not anchored to the ground)every time you sit down you worry it will be its last.  
2) The furniture is so old and broken down that goodwill won't sell it. The mattress has been removed from the (formerly) pull out couch making the cushions sink so low that it is uncomfortable to sit down on it. 
3) The air works but it shoots right up the curtains and most of it remains there. The curtain hangs over it so the thermostat thinks it is cold enough and turns off. 
4) in general the place feels dirty and disease ridden.
5) Expect to walk to your room from the car. There are very few parking spaces in front of the rooms
6) Even after a long night of drinking it's hard to fall into these beds for a good nights sleep. They sleep rough. The worst part is the stretched out bottom sheet (it hasn't been a fitted sheet for some time). It slides off the mattress and takes the mattress pad with it so you find yourself on the bare mattress. Several times last night I woke up wondering how much DNA I was laying on. The haven't cleaned the carpets ever so I am sure they don't clean the mattresses. 
7). I will give them props on the shower. The water is hot. The water pressure is solid and shower head is newer. 

The most surprising thing about this hotel? They ask you to review it on tripadvisor!!  Amazing they would want anyone to review this poor, sad excuse for a hotel.
Always fresh crawfish weather you buy live or boiled always excellent & great prices too

We held my son's wedding dinner here this past Monday.  We had a party of 20 in the back room with a limited banquet menu.  Nothing could have been better.  We only booked it the week before and dealt with Christin, who could not have been nicer as I kept calling to change (increase) the number of attendees.  The beach wedding was delayed for several reasons from 4 to 6:45 and our original reservation was for 6:30, as I called a few times to give arrival time updates the staff was amazing.  We finally all arrived about 7:45, members of our party that were already seated were able to enjoy wine and some appetizers we had pre ordered.  Our waitstaff team was perfect, with the limited menu everyone was able to be served rather quickly and efficiently.  Every single person RAVED about the meal, filets, salmon and chicken were all equally enjoyed.  We were supposed to be charged an 18% service fee, it was not on the bill, I tipped closer to 25% that is how good the service was.  I cannot thank Christin and every staff member I came in contact with enough, and I need to mention I tried to arrange this all from Mobile, Al.  Thank you Parkshore Grill, we will return on our next trip to St. Pete.

I toured the Center City campus with Ms. ShaNyka and I was very impressed, and also very relieved.  I had been looking for a daycare for my 4 year old daughter and I have to say that 5 out of the 6 schools I visited completely horrified me. 

Firstly, I was late for the tour - we got lost thanks to the GPS and showed up almost an hour late.  Ms. ShaNyka was kind enough to run back over from the infant center to tour with us anyway.  She immediately took my daughter's hand and looked her straight in the eyes and greeted her warmly.  I remember that so vividly because my daughter is usually shy and for the Assistant Director to give her that much attention the first time they met gave my daughter a little more confidence.  

The facility is immaculately clean, well-lit, well-ventilated, and very spacious.  The Pre-K class was on the 2nd floor and I loved how the Pre-K class was called "Bumblebees".  The "Bumblebees" teacher was SUPER nice.  She greeted us when we were standing at the front door and we saw her do a headcount with all the kids she was bringing in from a walk outside.  Ms. ShaNyka even let my daughter sit down in her class as she read a book to the children, who seemed genuinely happy to be there.

There are cameras in almost all the classrooms, the kids' lunches are prepared on site fresh everyday (they have their own on-site chef) and the Pre-K class has its very own "Graduation" ceremony in the Summer.  

The timings are a bit later than most daycares (8 to 6) but there is an option to drop off your child earlier or pick them up later at an additional cost.  The only downside would be the cost, but honestly, I would pay every nickel for care this great!  It's worth it!

Delicious and creative sushi! Variety of beers and drink menu to suit any preference. We had the crab rangoons and gyoza for an app and 4 rolls to share. SO SO GOOD! Very full and extremely satisfied when we left. Definitely a must try if you love sushi. Also, they have a variety of entrees we want to go back and try.

I wouldn't waste my time coming here again honestly. The food isn't horrible, but it's definitely not great either. The Mac n cheese is disappointing (mushy with no flavor) and they didn't have any rolls or cornbread available to go with the platters (major let down).

Good tequila and setting and the "blue dream" taco is delicious. The whole reat of the taco menu is... regrettable. Been here four times.
Stick to the tequilla and like one blue dream taco
These guys are awesome! Thanks Todd and Kathy I will be back for sure customer for life!!!!!

Here's all you need to know:  They've expanded their store!  

If you miss playing shopping cart derby, there's always the parking lot.

First time here for brunch. Delicious! Breakfast bar. Barbecue bar (salmon and pineapple were wonderful). Seafood bar (lovely shrimp). Dessert bar (Creme brûlée was very tasty.) Live music. Attentive  and endearing staff. Beautiful food. Nice resort shops. They even carry Arizona Sun products which have become difficult to find. Great way to spend a lovely Sunday afternoon.

I got already 5 frames plus 6 lenses from Angelo and I never had a single complain about Absolutely Optical.
I have seen the Dr just once and he just confirmed my prescription from Bascom Palmer.
I think Angelo is not just a nice guy but also very experienced in his job. I definitely recommend Absolutely Optical.

Not the friendliest people in business. I bought $170.00 worth of merchandise and when I ordered, was told there wasn't a restocking fee if I changed my mind. Well, I found something I liked better, online. When going back to pick up- and return- I was charged about $55.00 in restocking fees, anyway. Not a good experience, never going back.

Came in for a flu test. Have been here for 2 hours, locked in a room, zero communication until I finally opened the door. Certainly not the place to go if you have anything to do. Secretary acted like it was an inconvenience to tell me how much longer the dr. Would be.
Room was very clean and the bed was very comfortable and I had a very nice stay thanks to "Nikki", she was very courteous and helpful and made our stay complete. Will return

I have done a tour of gyms around Nashville and this one is my favorite by far.  I started at the YMCA Downtown, which had a pretty facility, but it was too busy, too big, and I paid for a "key" to keep track of my workouts, but the system never worked.  I moved to Go Fitness in Cummins and loved the 24-hours, but it always smelled a bit wet sock/basement-y, and was geared more for serious athletes unless you're doing personal training or group sessions.  After that year ended (I barely went after a personal training session left me so sore I took two days off work), I went to the Coleman Community Center which is very small, but $30 a month.  I was limited by the hours and they weren't open on Sundays.

So after another four months of gaining weight, I moved to GetFit Anytime.  I used the Yelp! deal without a hitch and have been every night since signing up.  The busiest time was around 8p, but there was still plenty of equipment and three open treadmills.  Everyone is very clean and I haven't encountered anyone "sketch" yet.  All the machines are in good working order and the treadmills have built in TVs (HBO and Showtime I discovered last night) and fans with adjustable cool air flow.  The weight machines are very easy to use and have clear instructions written on them so I don't look like a doofus trying to do a chest press.  

They have multiple membership options, so I suggest checking out their website.  The door locks solidly when anyone leaves and the keychain scanner works every time.  Plenty of parking, and though it may look a little dim around midnight, there is significant lighting in the parking lot once you get up there in it.

Linden Terrace has been the most pleasant place to live since I have been in college! Bill (the owner) cares about his tenants so much and is quick to answer any maintenance issues. The neighborhood is quiet, safe, and close to the University without the outrageous price. The apartments are clean modern and the landscape is well kept. I would 100% recommend this place to anyone!

I am surprised at the amount of 5 star ratings. My experience was definitely not 5 star. Her touch is good, but it is not very deep and more of a spa, rub style massage. I specifically asked if she could do more work on my neck and back after a car accident but she said she couldn't do it because it was too "hard" on her. 

I would recommend Sharon for someone who wants a light, relaxing massage. But not for anything outside her comfort zone.

I've been a member of their unlimited car wash deal for 6 months now and I can't speak more highly of it. For about $30 a month you get unlimited washes which for me is necessary having a white car in Florida. I go to the Dale Mabry location and it's always a less than 10 minute affair to drive through the car wash to get my exterior cleaned. They make it so easy (a team member just scans the barcode on your dash and away you go) and there are so many staff on hand at all times. Highly recommend!
Simply amazing.  From the staff to the doctors you can tell this vet cares about the people and their pets.  I won't go anywhere else from this point forward.

We have been Carol House customers for over twenty years. We recently had their design team come to our New house to help us redesign our living room. It turn out amazing!!! We had one slight oversight on our part and the Manager Kevin stepped in and solved the issue for us immediately.  This is why when we shop for furniture we always choose Carol House. Thank you again to the entire staff for their professionalism and truly 5 star service. We will be back soon for our den redesign. By the way we love nice things!
Andy was great! Love the overall environment of this nail salon. Very reasonable price

Jaynes Chicken Jack Wrap was another thumbs up from me. I came in so hungry today and just wanted something light, this was a decent choice. It had Pepper Jack cheese, fresh spinach , and tomato inside and I love the way they press their wraps here. Hot and a little crispy on the ends. I did add hot sauce for a little more flavor to kick it up a notch .It also came with a white bean salad that had little pieces of dill and green onion. I love dill so I was pleasantly surprised. The only complaint I have is that their food needs salt to bring out the flavors of all ingredients a bit more, but they do keep Pink Himalayan Salt handy at the counter if needed, but why do I need to salt every bite myself? It would make the food here so much better. Other than that, I do enjoy eating here because they use fresh healthy ingredients in everything, and I always feel good afterwards when I leave, like I did something good for my body. Guilt free

First off.. Our waiter was great! He was knowledgeable about the menu and made good recommendations for drinks and entrees.  We started with the chargrilled oysters .. Delicious!  For our main meals we had shrimp and grits and crawfish étouffée.. The shrimp and grits were very tasty and were enjoyed immensely . The crawfish étouffée was a little bland and I would not order it again.  Desert was bananas foster .. Not a spectacular presentation but very tasty nonetheless.  For beverages we had a hurricane which was not good; tasted like unsweetened pineapple juice  on ice.  The pink fairy cocktail, however, was perfect; I'd order that again in a heartbeat .  Overall a very good experience.. Planning to return again soon!

This place is amazing! Walking in, the atmosphere felt great and had that local market appeal. The food was amazing. I got one of their kale bowls and it was huge!! The people who work there were so nice and were working hard considering it was pretty busy when I got there. Will definitely be back!!

I had a tasty egg and cheese sandwich for breakfast here. I would order it again if needed but I'm not a regular. The service was friendly and professional and the espresso was tasty! Thanks Panera! 

Life is good with early morning breakfast!

I've been using "Dr. Bob" for over five years now and he's the best! When my Weimaraner, Max, knows he's going for a visit he practically wags his tail off in excitement. Dr. Bob and Max are the best of buds and Max gets exceptional care. Dr. Bob is also an avian vet and I have nine parrots. He's had to treat two of them and they're both as good as new thanks to his knowledge and care. Although there are numerous vets a lot closer to me I'd never consider going anywhere else.

Great value for the design choices. You can get a high-end look without spending a lot of money. My experience there has been wonderful. I have purchased several items from this location. If you prefer a more modern look, go here. I could easily tell the quality of furniture is much better than the national chains out there. My only complaint is that they allow Internet access to their store's website, a magazine for customers, and that their prices were posted online.
The salads were super fresh and tasted great! We got a cookie and it was not as great. Tasted like it had been sitting for days. Would definitely come back again for lunch!

Excellent little spot.  The appetizers are excellent...I had an order of the best calamari and spicy mussels in red sauce on the beach...they were delicious.  Not to be outdone, the chicken marsala was incredible.  Also, the service from Tia was first rate!!!  Do yourself a favor and try this spot out or call for delivery or take out...I'll definitely come back...
I called first before coming out the person was so rude and when i areived she straight up said no table. Do not go there because of the service. Ive eaten here before and it's not worth it.

Normally I really like this place and am a regular customer.  Maybe I hit this place on an off day, but I'm sitting here right now waiting for a pedicure, it's been an hour, and they STILL haven't gotten to me even though they've started working on other people who came in after I did!  Not only that, the staff were rude about everything, half the massage chairs were broken, and now they charge credit card customers extra!  I won't be back again.

While a little off the beaten path, Comet Coffee is well worth the detour.  The richness of flavour in all their drinks is simply astounding.  Add in a friendly wait staff and delectable house-baked treats (try the chocolate chip cookies!) and you have a real winner-- stop reading and pay them a visit!

2020 has been hard on small businesses, so I majorly dislike having to leave a negative review, but this experience merits such.

Let's start with something positive. The pulled pork sandwich was really smokey and the bbq sauce was awesome. Portions are huge for being not all that expensive. So, those reasons are why this is a two star and not one star review.

Unfortunately, that's where positivity stops. My friend and I came after having gone to Ott's nearby to pick up Christmas gifts. We thought we'd grab a quick lunch nearby before heading back to Philly. Quick, it was not. We walked in and had to look for a hostess (who put on a mask after seeing us...). We were told where we could sit inside (shouldn't indoor dining be closed?). When we got to the table I wished I had my sanitizer wipes with me. Didn't look like cleaning the tables was a huge priority. We got our menus and then waited... and waited... and waited for someone to come take our order. They finally came, we ordered and waited. 20 minutes later, the hostess came back and said they were out of our orders (WHY did it take so long to tell us...?) so we had to order again and then wait longer for our food. When we were finished I had to go look for someone so I could pay our bill. Just wow...

All in all, what could've been an hour lunch was 2.5 hours. Definitely will not ever be back here again.
Get my meds there for years wonderful staff in Pharmacy. Decided to shop here now and was amazed how clean and wide aisles not to mention so many choices I will certainly be shopping there now! BJ

We went here to get some carry-out for 4 of us.  The owner was incredibly helpful in recommendations.  He was on target with two of the donor gyros and a gyro salad being plenty to feed 4 of us.  The bread was so fresh and delicious!  We will definitely be back again!

You better have your hotel numbe right or the guy at the front desk won't give you a towell.... I am so upset. I stayed here and  they made me feel uncomfortable by not dispensing my towell because I didn't know my room # and my hotel key (card) did not have it printed. I was so mad I left to stay in another hotel. 1 star hotel and smoke smell everywhere. Go to the Hilton and expect good service!

I was intrigued to try Zizzo's so I went for it. I ordered an iced coffee with cream and sugar in the drive thru. I think they could've put more coffee though because my coffee tasted like sugary milk. I would've been happier with McDonald's coffee.

OMG! This food is amazing.  The portions are HUGE! My son and I both love to cook, I expressed an interest in the recipe for my meal and the Head chef Nathan invited me to come and learn how to cook, our server Brandon was on point with everything we needed.  You all need to come here!  I am already thinking when I'm coming back.
We love Soy - it can be hard to decide what to get because I have truly enjoyed everything I have ever ordered. Fridays are special though when they have the Bulgogi - SO GOOD.

IPS Parcel delivered my package on time. My packages arrive safely without any type of damage. They are careful when placing packages in front of my door, yet not out for all to see. They have awesome tracking all along the way. the staff also are nice, polite and helpful. Awesome service!!!

I had the rib combo where you get eight "bones" as they say.  Because it was a combo there were baby backs and sticky ribs.  The baby backs were by far the best of the two styles.  I had the sweet sauce with pepper in it, which was good.  For sides I got the corn bread and potato salad, the corn bread was great but the potato salad was good.  I enjoyed the meal but the price seemed high for amount of food that I got.  Parking is tricky and maybe even a little dangerous.

Wanted a place that was somewhat casual for our first night in town after a day of mostly travel and this didn't disappoint.    We came as a part of five and all left completely full and content :-)   

We started with stuffed wings, alligator pies, and cheese fries for our appetizers.   I didn't personally try the fries but the other guys seemed to enjoy them.   The alligator pies were like mini empanadas, the meat didn't taste gamey at all.   The wings were excellent, they had a nice sweet glaze but the ends were stuffed with this yummy Andouille sausage mixture.   Those went fast.    

For entrees, one us of had meatloaf that they found to be excellent, another had the chicken & dumplings which is best described as a one pot stewy concoction with a nice seasoned broth, a sweet cinnamon or something background to it.   Plenty of chicken and small little dumplings with roasted vegetables on to.  The other three of us opted for this pork chop, that is served on top of a bed or jalapeno grits with a swirl of the most yummy sweet greens.   All with a dash of red eye gravy around the edges, it was soooooooo good (echoed by all three guests).    The grits were yummy, and the glaze on the chop was great, but it was the greens that stole the plate, they were just so good.  

One of us was brave enough to try the bananas foster milkshake for dessert and several of us had to stick a straw in for a taste because it was so yummy.  

Service was great, attentive to our water glasses and drinks from the bar.   Overall a great place to start our culinary adventure at on this trip.

Beautiful park, lovely scenery, great trails. What more could I ask for? I am sincerely hoping no development takes place in the area right near Creve Coeur Park. It would be a shame to mess with the natural tranquility of the area.

My daughter and her friend shopped at Savers in Crestwood on Sunday and were treated so poorly by the sales associates. My daughter put her purchases on the counter asked if they took Apple pay, the girl said NO! took the purchases and threw them in the return to rack bin without saying another word
Then my daughters friend had a pair if pants that came to $10.91 and she declined them being over her budget. The salesperson literally yelled at her "They are ONLY $10.91!" The manager came over to void the sale and asked why, the salesperson yelled out again "She doesn't have enough money, they're ONLY $10.91!" SMH. We will never go back!

We were greeted by a very inviting and friendly atmosphere. The server asked if we had ever been before and handed us menus as well as pointed us in the direction of the line and billboard menu. The cooks were very friendly and outgoing, holding brief yet inviting conversation. The food was portioned right in front of you at a cafeteria style set-up. Great side options. Once seated with food, drink server came right over and offered drinks from the bar. Overall great experience, food was outstanding and service was on par! Will be attending again soon!

Very satisfied with my first visit for state inspection and minor repairs on work my previous shop had heffed up.  Easy to communicate off hours via the web and arrange an appointment. Efficient and professional at the service desk.  Work done on time at reasonable price, with no bogus fluff added in (the last straw with the former guys was a half hour shop rate labor charge for tightening what they said was a loose nut on the battery tie down bracket.). So far, so good here, will be back with our other vehicles.

I was so excited about going to Barney's CO-OP - there's one in Bethesda, MD, near where I am from and I LOVE it.

However... like another poster said, I think underwhelming is the best word to describe it.  I came in on a relatively empty Sunday and I received zero greeting in the women's department.  I couldn't find anything I liked there - the selection is not vast by any means.  

However, I walked up the stairs to the men's section where everyone is super nice and the prices much better.  All of the sales associates were incredibly helpful and very generous with their time.  The selection also looks MUCH better upstairs!

I would never return to this CO-OP for their women's section, but they do have an awesome men's section!

I used to frequent this place. However, with the budget cuts in the food quality and the price increases, I've been reduced to lunching. Their server, Lori is the redeeming quality. She always makes it a great experience. Her service is beyond outstanding, she's efficient and always gracious. She's the best thing about this place!

Went here with my bf and we ordered three dishes. None of us left feeling full. The beef pot came out looking like left over. I had to devour a bowl of rice with red chili pepper on the bottom of a fish dish because I wasn't full AT ALL. You won't get the mind F**k unless you actually go there, which I highly recommend you not to.

This is our First time coming here.
I did some research on yelp before choosing which bar we should come to since we're not locals. We wanted a sports bar feel while watching the game. The moment we walked in the TV volume was off. I asked the bartender if she can turn on the volume, but she said her coworker took the remote home...20 minutes later they found it! The service here is really slow, sorry to say. A customer in front of us found hair in her food! They offered to comp her meal and offered her a drink. (Which was nice) the other customer was complaining that her foods not out and she was here before us. All I ordered was 6 chicken wings. We waited over 30 minutes for the wings and after 40 minutes the wings came out cold and they were super dry! Our server/bartender never once checked in with us to tell us what's going on with the wait. I know it's not her fault, but I'm not sure why there kitchen is so backed up on a Sunday when there's a football game on and you know people are going to be out. She did comp our bill because I returned the wings! I'm sorry, but I just waited 40 minutes for 6 Wings and they were cold! She also took care of the beer we ordered. 

On a positive note: They do have really good beer selections. We tried the Mango Stash from Hop Valley Brewery. It was very refreshing! 
I personally wouldn't come back here or recommend it to my friends and family.

Food was great! Lots of flavor but not overly spicy. We ordered vegetarian and it came with several options. I have to say that the location and facility were terrible. It's located in what seems like a rough neighborhood. As for the facility, the toilet was backed up, tables were a little sticky and used dishes were sitting at the bar. If you're willing to overlook this, the food and experience of eating Ethiopian food in a communal style is worth it.

This is my favorite Italian restaurant. Anything I ever order is delicious, cooked to perfection, and a generous portion. My husband and son love it too, as well as anyone else that comes with us. There have never been a time when my family or friends were ever disappointed. My favorite is the chopped salad and the sausage flat bread. The bruschetta is great too, and all the seafood appetizers and pasta dishes are awesome. The Berry Tiramisu (usually served during the summer) is to die for. Great wine selection, service always good and friendly, atmosphere and decor great, and prices so reasonable. I absolutely love this place and can't wait to come back again.

Let's start by admitting that I should have checked online and read some reviews before signing a contract with Power.
So far it seems like as any other big company, their sales force is the good part of their work force. The young fella in the Home and Garden Show was very nice and friendly then, the remodeling consultant coming to my house did an impecable job to the point that he sold me an overpriced product and I was "happy" to paid for it; even the guy from the financing department was diligent and efficient but, once the contract was signed and the money was "secured" things started to go the other way.
The pre-inspection got cancelled and I didn't know about it, I had to re-arrange my work schedule for nothing. They said that they called and left a message first thing in the morning but is not true, I had no miscalls or voicemails. Even if they had called, I think that I deserve the courtesy of a follow up call to confirm if I had received the message and if I wanted to re-schedule my appointment.
 If this is the way they work, I need to re-think things because I can't imagine how hard it will be to get their attention and services if something is not done right or I have to call for the warranty.
Hopefully things will change, now I'm hesitant about continuing with the project.

Coast to Coast not only offers the best pricing, but also the fastest delivery (2 days!!!).  My driver was Kurt and he was amazing!  Very courteous and stayed in constant communication with me from pick-up to delivery.  I will definitely use Coast to Coast in the future!

Great beer selections. Especially hosting more than 4 San Diego breweries. I took the green line street car from Canal St. It's a mellow location, their staff is friendly and they offer weekly food trucks. I recommend to craft beerers for sure.

Wow. I would give 0 stars of an option. We booked our rooms through hotels.com for the Polmoro house, the sister hotel of Mar Monte. We had THREE communications with the Mar Monte  hotel to make sure that these rooms were conjoined rooms as we are a FAMILY of 6 with 4 young children. We get here and are told the room are never conjoined but they can offer us rooms across from each other. We are told we can check in, one room is not ready and they are TOTALLY down the hall. This is ridiculous. I called to complain with the "manager" of the mar monte and she was super rude and kept saying sorry for what we were promised but offered no resolution. I demanded a trundle bed and to cancel one room/ she gave me grief but agreed. This place sucks! Super rude. Will never come here again! Ruined our trip.

So after being invite by the owner to comeback for a visit the Mrs and I did just that. This time however we dined in the main bar area. The seating is limited but it makes for a niche feeling that matches the decor. The bourbon, whiskey and rye selection is existence and there were a few I had never tried before so that's a plus. 

Our waitress was awesome and we enjoyed watching the bartenders shaking the drinks with the style of and old fashion speak easy. 

 I enjoyed trying to name the brand of Bourbon bottle they repurposed to server water in. This is a great use for empty bottles. 

 We order the cheese plate for an appetizer and we not disappointed with the selections the chef put together. The Mrs order the deconstructed Cobb salad hold the blue cheese and I order the Hendry burger. 

The Mrs enjoyed her salad and I enjoyed the burger. The BBQ sauce in it was really good and had just the right amount of sauce on it. The only thing I can knock this place for is serving ketchup in small black plastic containers. The metal ones would fit more with the higher end appeal this place has vs some of the cheesier places in town. 

We will go back for sure and next time I will try the disco fries.

BEWARE! I came in for a replacement tire. I thought the price was fair as I did shop around before hand. I even purchased the roadside hazard warranty ( I would have done that no matter what) once they began working on the car they suggested an alignment "because of whatever I hit or because I drove on the rim." I said okay go ahead. Then I had some corrosion and would be 8$ to get if my off and was needed in order to get a good seal (seal on what?) idk but whatever okay. This is what prompted me to look on yelp for reviews. Then it hit me. This place is a joke! I usually look on yelp before I go anywhere but I was sort of desperate so I skipped that and I regret it. They got me good! Never again!

I have parked at this garage for over two years.  With the exception of about three employees over this two year period, I have NEVER been treated pleasantly.  I realize that being a parking garage attendant is very often a thankless and even unpleasant job due to the weather or rude customers, but there is honestly no excuse for the way they treat not only me, but most everyone. 
     And NEVER park there if you are in a hurry!  I have waited as long as 15 minutes to both drop off as well as pick up my car (it is valet, not self-park).  Should you inquire-not complain, mind you, but gently inquire-if your car is on its way because you are, you know, LATE for work because this has been an eternity, you are punished by having them take much, much longer to get your car (which you would never even believed could be possible. trust me-it most definitely is.)
     There is one gentleman in particular, a younger man with dark hair and a moustache, who is just so blatantly mean and surly that I have almost cried.  At first I thought he was just behaving this way with me, but I have witnessed him talking to other customers just as disrespectfully, once even taunting another customer with her ticket, holding it away from her while she tried to get it, all the while explaining that she was late for work! Once when I was treated especially badly, I tried to complain, asking for a phone number to speak with someone in charge and the person dialed a number and put it up to my ear! I then attempted to explain the problem in front of the people who were causing the problem-and the gentleman on the phone was also very curt-unbelievable!
     This place is the parking equivalent of a very dysfunctional family. I will now be spending my parking budget at two other lots, where I have been treated much more pleasantly.  I realize that the customer is not always right. However, there is no excuse for the extremely rude, sometimes bullying behavior of the Park Safe staff.  Spend your money elsewhere-don't park here!!!! And not to mention I tried to help one man there to get his kid into the school I work at, and he was incredibly rude to me. Never park here- ever.
Just like the other reviewers stated, Brian and Zach were very professional and did the work as promised.   Easy and affordable. Highly recommend.

We stayed here for the 4th of July weekend 2015. Loved every bit of it. The breakfast & dinner buffet was great. The kids had a blast swimming in the big pool. We brought our own chairs that the hotel allowed us to set up on the front lawn of Cabrillo and we were able to see the fireworks from there. The service was great, the rooms are very large, the ambiance very nice. Going on a holiday weekend is super pricey. About $600 for 2 queens per night. So a holiday weekend is going to run you under $3,000. It's not that far a walk from the pier which is on State Street. Maybe about 1.5 miles to the pier. Over the weekend, vendors set up along Cabrillo. We walked Cabrillo and looked at all the vendors, then down the pier and had ice cream. Then went down State Street for more shopping. GREAT HOTEL!

Stopped in for a quick bite and ordered a sausage and mushroom pizza. What they served us was far and beyond our happy taste bud's expectations. I'm talking the cheesiest of FRESH  toppings (owner/cook extraordinaire Shawn makes the hand tossed dough daily), and a generous piling on of assorted toppings masterfully paired with a full bodied red sauce on a delicately wood oven baked crust. The sauce is the best I've ever tasted which is saying a lot as I'm a pretty tough customer when it comes to pizza. It's not sweet or wine flavored but with just the right balance of full bodied tomato and a slightly zesty kiss of fresh Sicilian ingredients.
