Michael, the attendant was very professional, courteous and user friendly.  We appreciate all he did.   Thanks guys for making our night even more memorable.  We will definitely call you guys back for our future events.

Flavorful soul food that is done with heart and soul. I ate here for breakfast and lunch on two different days and had great meals and service both times. While the food is delicious, I believe the people make this place. You can feel their kindness and soul and it attracted me back. Excellent food and service!

I started coming here long after the unfavorable reviews but I love this place. The food is delicious and the staff is super friendly. It's quickly become my go-to delivery food and I've never been disappointed.
Milkfish rules. Their specials are awesome, and I don't know anywhere else in New Orleans that serves dishes even remotely similar to theirs.

I will not go back to Three Flags Tavern.  Very, very disappointed in tonight's experience. I brought three out-of-town co-workers to Three Flags, thinking it would be a great example of a local gem. Unfortunately, that was not the case at all...it was an embarrassment.

First of all, when we walked through the front door, we were hit with a very strong odor, reminiscent of an old folks' home. Despite our better judgement, we forgave that issue and decided to stay.

We ordered tacos as an appetizer and never received them. The waitress just forgot to order them...And it wasn't even that busy.

My boss (you know...the guy that's in charge of my annual reviews and pay raises) got a bad oyster...so bad that he walked across the street to Walgreen's in search of something to make him purge the oyster to avoid food poisoning. Trust me...you're way better off going to Peacemaker for oysters. 

And then our entrees were very slow to arrive...which is why it was so hard to imagine why my pork chop came out raw. Of course, I sent it back, and as quickly as the waitress returned, there is no other answer than...they tossed it in the microwave. At least it was no longer raw, I guess. 

The lobster rolls were good, according to those in our party that had them, but for $24, I'd expect it to be bigger than the size of a hot dog bun. Again...you're way better off going to Peacemaker for lobster rolls, too.

I had been to Three Flags before for brunch and had a great experience. But after tonight and after reading other recent negative reviews, I'm afraid Three Flags had turned a bad corner. Unfortunately, I will never go there again and would caution anyone else to think twice...there are too many other good options in St. Louis. Go try Peacemaker instead...I wish we had.
Amazing food and great lunch prices. The cheese is to die for. Highly recommend this restaurant.

Been here multiple times and treatment is always the same.  Evening counter and drive though staff is very UNFRIENDLY and immature.  I get that the employees are high school girls but at least act like you give a "?!@ about your job or the paying customers. You may want to also be a little less obvious when your making fun of your dining room customers!!  What a shame!!

It seems like in the Lansdale/Colmar area Wawa has pretty much killed off most of the other competing gas stations so it was interesting to see a non-Wawa station that was not boarded up and that was open early on a Sunday morning.

Their price was right in line with Wawa and it was easy off-easy on and we were back on our way towards the Lansdale SEPTA station.

Came here yesterday for lunch. The staff are genuinely nice. The food was quick and efficient. We got the short rib burrito, side of kimchi, and mango boba! Everything was delicious. I will have to be back to try more things!

Had lunch here last week and it was delicious and quick. The caprese sandwich was awesome and I loved the local chips. Once the lunch crowd picks up, it definitely gets loud, but the food makes it worth it.

Fast service, affordable, great food. Recommend queso dip, clchicken chimichanga fajita and their beef hard shell tacos. Plenty of room to dine comfortably though some booth seats are in need of replacement. Not the cleanest of establishments.

Highly recommended

Seriously, the best meal of my life. Go with a large group and do their tasting menu. The whole group has to do it but it is the most bang for your buck. The steak was like butter and the sides were delicious. Service was pretty good although the bartender was a little rude. The only downside was we had a reservation (we arrived 10 mins early) and they didn't sit us down for an hour and a half.
Amazing and soooo delicious. The food at this 'famous' bowling alley is not at all what you might expect. A very diverse menu with all the regular favorites plus a lot more.

Not as enamored of this place as everyone else seems to be. It was just alright. 

We ordered a lighter dinner of dan dan noodles and wonton soup with a side of dumplings in chili oil. The best of the 3 was definitively the dumplings. The wonton broth had good flavor but the dumplings could only be described as weak. Weak on flavor with a super soft dough. The boyfriend liked the dan dan noodles but I didn't. We wish they were spicier. I didn't really care for the texture but he enjoyed it.  

Delivery was pretty quick so that's a big plus. I'd give it another shot perhaps. I need to get a better ideal of other delivery in the area before I will make a repeat stop.

Cool hangout spot in fountain square. They are open late (until 3am on Friday) and serve food which drew us here. We came on a Friday night and it was busy so service wasn't the best. Grab someone's attention to be served or you'll get overlooked during busy nights. The bar selection is also limited, many of what I like to drink was unavailable. I settled for a beam and coke and my hubs got a corona and long Island. They offer a full food menu which I appreciate, drinking is always better with food. We purchased wings and fries, the classic. They have many flavors for the wings to choose from, we tried lemon pepper, very flavored and a little salty but texture and the smokiness was satisfying. Nothing special about the fries, but still good. To my surprise, it was quite delicious for bar food. I'll definitely bookmark this place when craving smoked wings, I'll just try another flavor. 
Something that wasn't very pleasant was that they only had 1 restroom with 1 toilet for the size of this bar. I was told by other customers that they had more restrooms but due to vandalizing issues they were closed. Having to wait in line for 10 minutes to use the restroom was not cool. 
The first floor consists of the bar, tables and comfy chairs/couches. You'll find stairs that lead to an upper level game room that's decent in size. It contains tables, couches, pinball machines, oversized connect four, 2 dart boards, and several pool tables. Darts and pool are 10$ an hour. I didn't play on the pinball machines, so not sure how much they cost. We spent  a vast amount of time in the game room area playing darts and pool, we love games and get pretty competitive. We had a lot of fun. They didn't have any service to order drinks or food upstairs, so we did have to go back downstairs to the bar area. I ordered a whiskey sour which was tasty. I did notice if you bought food and went upstairs, workers would bring the food up to you. Drink and food prices are fair. This bar does not provide a parking lot, so street parking (I didn't see any meters though, so free?) or parking in lots nearby are available. We parked for free in a lot nearby.

I was very happy with this group for years. But recently their quality has taken a big dip. I got my 911 back and was driving in the area when I was stopped by a pedestrian who noted that my car was dragging something.  PA had not secured the underside of my car and I was dragging it on the road.  That is a big red flag for me. Time to find another Porsche mechanic.

The best radio station in St. Louis for news, sports, and weather.  20 years ago I'd have given them 5 stars, but the quality of coverage has gone down and syndicated programming has taken the place of local fare. The home of the St. Louis Cardinals on the radio; can be picked up in about 40 states at night with its strong 50,000 watt non directional signal.

This is a cute shoppe in a great location! They have a variety of anything baked and it's all gorgeous to look at,,, THAT BEING SAID HOWEVER,,,, they are the rudest most uninspired group you will ever meet! They must not really need our business because they barely speak and if they do you can barely hear them ,,, no eye contact, no have a nice day ,,, nothing. I was going there for coffee and a muffin or something like that in the mornings to avoid the rush at other similar places in the area... $13 for two small coffee and 2 muffins,,, ok, I will fork that out no problem but the customer service is so bad that I actually tried an experiment to see if I was over reacting. I tried to have a conversation with the girl behind the counter and I just got stared at.. that made us both uncomfortable.. sooo,,, do yourself a favor and spend your Money where the staff is ACTUALLY GLAD YOURE THERE,,, you have options!! ,,, and McDonald's for less than $5 for the same order are 10x more appreciative.

I get that it's fusion food, and that it's not trying to serve authentic pho, but throughout my entire meal I kept enjoying the flavors, but kept thinking, "this would be so much better with more pho spices."

I came with a group of five people for lunch and we had no issues getting seated right away. We were all craving pho and wanted to give this place a try. Some of our table got the alcoholic bubble teas, which were really good and priced okay. I split a duck po'boy, their version of a banh mi with someone and was a little shocked at what I got for $11. Since I split the sandwich I was barely able to take three bites and it was gone. The sandwich was good, but nothing special, surely not worth $11. Killer Po'boys makes a far better "fusion po'boy."

I also ordered a bowl of pho and started with the pork broth and added grilled tofu, grilled mustard greens, and flank steak. You get to add three "proteins" or add-ins to your pho and then can add additional components for an extra price. I literally got three thin pieces of flank steak, only about four pieces of tofu, and a few pieces of mustard greens in a giant bowl of broth. I must say though, whatever they did to the mustard greens, they were amazing; a little charred and smokey with all their vibrant green glory showing, but if only I was able to try more of it. On top of that, everyone at our table had to ask for more fresh herbs and bean sprouts since each of us were presented with less than a handful of greens to add to our pho. We were all disappointed by the lack of "proteins" in our pho. 

My whole meal I felt a little cheated by flavor and quantity of food for the price. I brought home a tall Tupperware canister of mediocre broth and one lone tofu chunk for leftovers. It kind of annoys me that they even use the title "pho" in their name and call their soups pho, since it's clearly lacking the full flavor and quality of a real pho. 

I've debated back and forth about whether to give this place three or two stars, since some aspects do really stand out, but since I don't see myself coming back and really wouldn't recommend this place to anyone I have to settle for two stars.

I was going to put more stars here, but then I read the other reviews, and I am wondering...  I bought my car here in 2000, and have had the majority of my services performed here, with no complaint. I will, however, execute some vigilance when I go back, which I probably will. I haven't personally had any complaint with them, and I hope it stays that way.  They do wash my car, always mention the shuttle, and have never charged me for anything they didn't do. As for the poster who was being cited for negligence regarding a car he had surrendered to them, did he or she not keep copies of paperwork that could be shown to the collection agency and police that the car was no longer in his or her posession?

Some very nice classic and simple french fare, you know, to get your bourguignon on!  Sleeper lunch item is a fantastic burger that could rank top 3 for Santa Barbara.  Serving sizes are generous, prices fair, and the atmosphere is rather nice.  The greenhouse is fun and festive, and the many rooms of the house have, like the word implies, a homey feel.

So why not a higher rating? Service can be slow and inattentive, its happened to me three times.  For instance, i asked for ketchup for my 'frites' (yes, I know the french are not big fans of the Catsup!) and it appeared, after asking three people, about the time dessert was served.  
If it happened just once i might not mention it, but three times and I have to assume poor training, not the best recruiting or a rough work environment might be at fault.

But, be alert and clear with communications, and give it a try by all means, the food and atmosphere are a winner.

A group of New York City girls flew to Nashville to celebrate a friends 30th. We started the weekend off at Taco Mamacita. It was nice enough to sit outside, although it was under heating lamps. Our waiter was helpful with all of our questions, food allergies and menu recommendations.

Exceptionally slow for no reason at all. Staff seem to be watching tv mainly and took 15 minutes to type in basic info on my insurance, address, etc. Nurse was okay, but we had a very basic need. I definitely will not be back for this slow, could-care-less place. It took us over an hour and we were the only ones there.

Went back again part of a party of 6. We were seated immediately. Our server was hurt, she said that she had fallen a few days prior, but her service was great. Food was good as usual and the blueberry margarita was to die for. The queso remains without compare, and the quesadillas are big enough for 2 meals. A very nice dinner.

Wow! I can't believe this place even sells one car. Had an appointment to test drive vehicle, but did not see it listed the night before my appointment. Called to make sure it was still there and the sales associate said yes it was on their inventory. Changed my work schedule and drove 45 minutes to get there on time. Once I got there the "manager" , wasn't there and neither was the car I was scheduled to drive. They sold it the day before. I understand that's the way it works, but they do not have the common courtesy to let their customer know. On top of that, 10 minutes from my house. I get a phone call that they were sorry and if they could help me get into another vehicle. Ha!! They just lost $10,000 cash and could have financed another $50,000. Good thing Tesla is taking over! 
NEVER DO BUSINESS WITH LITHA ( wish Yelp had negative stars)

I started seeing Dr. Young for a dislocated tailbone and I'm truly impressed with the results I have experienced. I was so uncomfortable when sitting that my quality of life was starting to suffer. After three appointments the relief I have is just amazing! Definite recommend!

Walked in and walked right back out. Sign on the door requiring mask for entry, I assumed being a small business they'd want to set a good example and be better than the chains, but nope. Girl taking orders and serving food wasn't wearing a mask, gloves, nothing. I'm pregnant and have an extremely high risk daughter so I felt extremely unsafe there. Disappointed, do not recommend and will not be coming back. The owner's response to reviews are also extremely unprofessional! If I had seen them before I wouldn't have even thought to attempt to order here.
About your average Waffle House with one exception, the service. Deb, our waiter was very friendly and fun! She was singing and dancing and enjoying her time. 10/10 will come back.
Great food. Staff very friendly. We ordered take away tacos and a salad. Everything was perfect. Will come back !
Best doctor if you need to get health certificate for driving test. Your work is done in 10 minutes flat.

This is a quality burger joint!

Gourmet burgers, cold beer, no complaints.

A friend and I made a recent visit to CCD after years away. I've been coming here since I was a kid (at least 35 years), and during high school my friends and I had many meals here. As it's been at least five years since my last visit, I was pleasantly surprised at the remodeling that's taken place. No more three separate rooms. The first room you enter from outside (and where the bakery is located) looks the same, including the it-wouldn't-be-a-diner-without-the counter and the mouth-watering bakery display, but they've combined the second window-deprived "mirrored room", as I used to call it, with the third and largest dining room, added booths on the left side and totaly reconfigured both rooms. I was impressed.
The service was also very good. Our waitress was a real sweetheart, kept stopping back to see how we were doing, and the menu has expanded to include some more restaurant-quality dishes rather than just diner food. We experimented with both and both were better than expected. But, then, the desert! CCD has always been famous for its cheesecake, and justifiably so, because it's ridiculously good. I'm somewhat of a cheesecake connoisseur (albeit a limited one, so my waistline doesn't pay the price), and their cheesecake has not changed since I can remember. It's retained its totally smooth and creamy texture, and tastes SO good, I'm at a rare loss for words. Just trust me on this one. If you like cheesecake, you're going to *love* theirs. I'd drive out to the Northeast just to pick one up every once in a while, and, in fact, I think I'm going to do just that. Recommended, recommended, recommended!

Wow!  We stopped here before visiting our friend, who has celiac. We all had dessert from this bakery.  Absolutely delicious. The donuts, the cookies, yummy. 
Next time we will try the bread as well. 
Great job.

Love love love some Ground! Shout out to Daniel and the crew! Love how we are made to feel at home! Great quality food and great service! Attention to detail is great, even new plastic cups and colors for each holiday! If you haven't tried it yet, give it a go you won't be sorry! Much more than just Burgers!
This outfit is the BEST ever !!!! there staff is very professional and excellent knowledge  Josh is amamzing  thank you so much you guys, the roofing guys were also excellent

Perfect Sport Bar to Watch the Eagles! First of all this place is attached to the Hyatt at Bellevue Hotel which is Beautiful. So we didn't have to even walk outside in the freezing cold. We were able to walk inside to inside! We are watching he Eagles Playoff game here and the vibe is electrifying, the people are awesome, the staff are on point and very professional. I highly recommend this place!

I love IKEA's inclusivity and support for Pride month. As a gay woman it fills me with Pride to see this celebrated at IKEA so openly with their flag raised and their rainbow crosswalks. Also the amazing Pride bag for $1.99 which I purchased that is going towards Edmonton Pride Center. It feels great to have a business like IKEA outwardly showing their allyship and support for the 2SLGBTQ+ community!

I went the other day because livingsocial was offering a deal and every year I go to Eastern State pen and I wanted to try something new this year. It was actually really good. This is a haunted walk through in a factory hence the name fright factory lol. The costumes were really good! The decorations were really good as well, you can tell they took their time in creating this attraction. The actors did a really good job, they kept walking with people who were scared. There is parking right next to the fright factory and street parking all around that is easy to find.

This is a cool venue - older building with a divey feel to it.  I think I'm a bit spoiled because we have great cajun food in Houston, but I wasn't a fan of the Crawfish Etouffee here.  I went here for lunch and it seems like it would be more fun at night.  I also tried the Shrimp & Grits and was a bit disappointed.  I should have read the menu more carefully because their take on grits is to make a grits cake and deep fry it.  Not really what I expected or wanted...
Beautiful rooftop seating area. Delicious garlic fries. Cute location. A nice place for a first date.

I've had a Living Social deal for this place for about a year now, so my husband and my 1 year old daughter and I decided to stop by for some afternoon lunch now that we live down the street from here. We got there after 3pm, when all the drinks and sushi are included in the happy hour. My husband got the chicken terriyaki, I got the Mexico sushi, which came with soup and a salad with this oh so DELICIOUS Ginger Vinaigrette. I had 2 sets of 6 rolls for $13.99. I wanted a drink, but the bartender wasn't there yet, so we opted for a bottle of their sweetest Sake, it was delicious! All in all we spent about $42, minus the $20 Living Social deal, we walked out paying $31 (we added an $8 tip. Great place, decent atmosphere (there was another couple with a baby 2 tables down from us), and ok staff - our waiter was a little too chill for my liking, but he was nice so that helped. Cool place to eat.

Right along the Katy Trail across from Frontier Park, you will find Bike Stop Cafe. A great place to break and catch a bite to eat after a long bike ride or to start your adventure along Katy of exploring Saint Charles Main Street. 

They offer a variety of bikes for rent and a diverse menu of foods and snacks. 

Always so kind and knowledgeable when renting bikes. Prices are good and they will educate and orient you to the bike(s). Great for families and kids as they have smaller bikes for the kiddos too! 

Hungry, try the green goddess. It's so good for breakfast or lunch. They have extensive coffee/espresso menu and offer craft beers and other drinks for dining on site or on the go. 

Coming off Katy and want to walk around main? Bike racks to secure your bike are available along with Free Parking. Give this place a try. Gather friends or the family and kick off your adventure here.
Great local bar.  Excellent sports bar, bar food and pizza.  Owners are awesome.  Highly recommended.

Super delicious baked goods and good coffee. I stop in on my way to work 1-2 times a week. The Quiche is the best I have ever had. I haven't used the pre-order option, but it looks super easy and i have heard it is a must to get the good stuff on the weekends and avoid the line.

This company is the best! I needed to move our stuff from Philly to Austin, ABF took care of the city permit and delivered the box on time. Packed it up and they took it to Austin without any problem, I tied everything down and nothing was damaged as a result. They delivered it to my apt complex in Austin, and pick-up was simple to arrange. If you don't drive, or don't have much to move, I highly recommend using ABF/UPack!

First of all these guys are extremely friendly and accommodate to your liking. I got the mix and match tacos including 2 pork carnitas and 1 tinga (chicken with tomato chipotle sauce). They double the corn tortillas so that the base is strong enough to hold all of the deliciousness on the inside. The spicy sauce is an amazing addition to dip on the side to add a little kick. UGH I'm obsessed.

Really liked this place! Would definitely come back! We got brunch on a Sunday morning with 8 people and they were very accommodating - they don't take reservations which is annoying, but they served us about 20/30 minutes after we got there. 

Really fun cocktails with hilariously clever names - including "My Drinking is Only a Problem For You" which my friend got. The staff was all super friendly and the decor is really cool. They have indoor and outdoor seating as well as bar seating with TVs playing sports. 

We all got eggs and breakfast food and everyone loved it. I got The Joe Blow which came with two eggs, bacon or sausage, hash or grits, and biscuit or toast. The eggs were cooked well and the potatoes were amazing. Also, they split our check (with 8 people) with no problem and were very easy going. Overall pretty fairly priced and I would definitely come back.

I came in here to return a DVR to spectrum.
The couple that run the store are semi-retired from NY. I could tell almost right away they are married. I loved listening to the banter between them. They asked how I knew they were married. I told them I was married almost 25 years. I worked with my wife too lol. We bickered a little but it was fun. I could tell theirs was light hearted bantering. The got my package all shipped. They were nice enough to ship it UPS even though the sticker said FedEx. Nice store. Clean and sell stocked. Even sold toys for the kids. I'll be back!!!!

Gsr is a great place to to have a drink! I used to get tickets for concerts there i spend a couple thousand dollars... and i put in request for concert and always get denied.  I put in a request in today for 2 pitbull tickets and the lady said theres a good chance i wont get approved... so why spend so much money there!! I  should stop gambling there and just but ticket when i want to see something.

It took a little while to get to this park, but it was well worth the 30min drive. My family and I spent about two hours here, walking on the various paths and enjoying seeing the various animals scattered around this park. The paths are flat and easy to walk on. 

There were lots of ducks other water fowl as well as other birds. We saw turtles, blue gill, some bluegills, large koi/ carp and a few large bass (too bad you can't fish here). The highlight was probably seeing a small gopher snake climb up a palm tree. There's something special about seeing a larger body of water in the desert that makes this place special. 

There was a large grass field and multiple picnic tables with benches throughout the park. We didn't go to the nature store or visitor center, but I think it's great that they have one. Loved that the bathrooms were clean and well stocked. 

I believe the city is in the process of draining and sealing the pond, while making some other improvements. I hope they're able keep all the fish alive in the process and I look forward to coming back to this park again in the future.

Wow!! So not your traditional Italian restaurant but so amazing!!! Our family celebrated my husbands 50th birthday at Toma! The home baked bread and complimentary olives are Delightful! You'll be asking for more olives! The grilled Romain was full of flavor and the salad wedge was "absolutely delicious" my husband says. Gnocchi, short rib and scallops were exquisite! Perfect portions. You must save room for dessert- the Phyllo Crisp was so unusual and totally complimented our meal!!
Great place. Clean and offers many options. Jessica was wonderful. Would definitely return.

We booked this tour through a tour guide that stated it was the best tour in town. While the tour was informative and showed us all around town (all very awesome) we felt like we were in school being reprimanded by the tour guide. She got very upset when our party was 3 min. Late. The tour guide told us it was a 1/2 window. There needs to be better communication. This is a great tour as far as the information goes but it's not great if you're looking for the essence and fun that New Orleans offers!

I ordered my Sister's birthday cake on short notice (3 days before). The staff was very accommodating. We ordered white cake with strawberry mousse. My sister pick up the cake and brought it to the party. As soon as we placed it on the table we all noticed the name was wrong! This turned her smile upside down. I called the manager and informed her of the mistake. The manager apologized and confirmed the name was right on the ticket, and they had made a mistake. I was offered $10 off my next cake order. The cake by the way was very delicious and moist. It would have been 5 stars if they didn't mess up the name.

Must try ... Very delicious Mediterranean food, and excellent service.
Their shish Tawook is wondeful. The soup is very tasty. 
The dining area is spacious and clean.

We came here for breakfast one Sunday morning. We had the vegan biscuits and gravy and the vegan sweet potato tacos.  Both meals were good.  If you're wanting traditional biscuits and gravy, this isn't it! These are made with a mushroom gravy that would also be amazing as a mushroom stroganoff.  

The gals working there were super friendly and explained the ingredients to us as we are vegan.

Came straight here after we land. The pho noodle was not fully cook my 3 year old son has a hard time eating it. My fiancee pho it all cool not even warm. May be will try it again but not recommended!

I do not like this chain at all!
This one is marginally better than the hellish one in Doylestown.

The Gyro is a joke.
The tortilla I had was cold.

Not good.
Chipotle and Qdoba are better for "fast food Mex".

Uck!

Cool things:  Cheap prices, wall of hot sauces and "mix your own" soda flavors.

Otherwise - I'll pass.

We went to the new Olga's for brunch. After walking through the wind tunnel front doors, we were immediately seated.  I recognized the waitress who worked for many years at the Medport Diner in Medford. Her service was excellent keeping the coffee and tea cups always filled and the dirty dishes immediately removed.
We both had different types of omelettes which were very good.
My only complaint about the new Olga's is the pricing of the menus.  It was very over priced.$33.89 plus tip is a lot of money for two omelettes a coffee and a tea. Think about it. They charge $2.75 for a tea bag and hot water. At those prices, I think people will go there once to see it but not rush back. They will continue to eat at there local favorite spots!

I LOVE mexican brunch...My roommates have been raving about this place for a while and I finally had a chance to try it a few weeks ago. We were a large group of people (maybe 8)? I ordered an iced mexican hot chocolate (their signature drink is the hot version) and a breakfast burrito with chorizo. I liked the drink but definitely should have stuck to the hot version which is AMAZING (had a few sips from my friend). My burrito was delicious and huge, I only wished it had more chorizo! A lot of our group ordered the chilaquiles which you can get with or w/out eggs (someone might have gotten chicken too but I can't remember). I wouldn't necessarily have ordered that because it is mostly tortilla chips but everyone really enjoyed their dishes. Another member of our group, loved his tacos. The churros y chocolate were also delicious. The waitresses were very sweet and accommodating and not flustered at all by our large group. People were coming in and out of the place, you could tell they are popular. I want to go back to try more dishes (tacos and other brunch items) and a cafe con leche! I wish it wasn't cash only as I never carry cash with me... =( The prices were reasonable though! They also own la mula terca across the street which I also want to try (more expensive though). Also, the mural outside (flower) is beautiful! =)

Nice romantic little place with great Italian food at a reasonable price. Had the lasagna     and it was wonderful, the wait staff was very friendly and provided good service. A place to go back to here in the quarter

Food is always fantastic. Beg for Brian as a server. He's always amazing. 

Downside: Front desk is still terrible. Made a reservation for the patio. Hostess took us to one of three or four tables in the sun when there were four or five in the shade. We asked to sit at a table for next an umbrella in the shade. We sat down only to be told that the table had not been sanitized and we had to move to another table. 
Less than five minutes later the other hostess seated a party of three without anybody coming to the table to sanitize it. I get that Bardenay needs to be careful and mindful of COVID procedures, but they need someone responsible to manage the process. What's being done currently is inept and just upsets customers.
Delicious food, good wine. Everything we ordered was fantastic. Service was a little slow. But we didn't mind.

Dine-in, takeout, curbside pickup, or delivery. This place has excellent falafel. We opted for dine-in. We were the only people eating inside. But they were busy preparing takeout and delivery orders. Close to WashU, convenient, clean, quick, and courteous. We will definitely be back.

Had heard this place was good. 

Get there, the napkin from the last guest is still on the chair. Waiter takes 10 minutes to get to us, another 10 to get a beer, which he presents in a can, with no glass offered. 

Prime rib was cold, no seasoning. I should have taken the warning when the server asked how I wanted my prime rib cooked. Proper prime rib comes one way. Tasted as if I had attempted to make prime rib for my first time and forgot salt. Mashed potatoes were also cold, dry and tasted earthy, not something you'd want out of mashed potatoes. 

Waited to get a steak knife after my steak had arrived. 

No refill on water, no offer of another beer, no offer of a to go box even though I clearly had taken one bite of my potatoes. 

I've been a server for three years so normally I have sympathy, but honestly this place sucks.

I was looking for a florist that has the  most beautiful arrangements and this florist is the best in Philly for a reason!!Kathy the owner helped  me over the phone ,long distance  and could not have been more helpful. I was thrilled to see this gorgeous floral arrangement !!! It was well received and our family loved it!! Thank you for taking such good care of delivering this in such style and flair ! it was delivered with a carefully placed cover to shelter the blooms from rain!!!!!!! so much attention to detail and filling the vase with such high quality blooms i was thrilled. This is my go to place and they will not disapointcannot  wait to place my next order

Ok, Patrick is someone we have been looking for for miles. We are traveling in an RV and you can't find quality beer just anywhere! We google searched beer stores nearby and found 504! SO FUN!! We sat and enjoyed any beer we wanted, choices from the whole store. Had some good conversations, our pup could go in and was loved all around! I truly hope this business explodes. Lots of beer love behind those 504 doors

We had the weisswurst and it is seriously the best Bratwurst I've ever eaten in this country. The bread was crispy and light and the sauerkraut and grilled onions with real german mustard was fantastic! The weisswurst which is made from veal avid pork is soo tender and juicy. We sat outside and really enjoyed our lunch!

Great food. Family run. Fresh made.
The food really tastes fresh. From the never frozen local patties to the hand pulled (not shredded) lettuce. Great, unique recipes and interesting flavors. Pricey but well worth it. This family run burger joint needs to be on Fieri's radar.
Great garlic fries, perfectly cooked burger and REALLY good shakes. I can't wait to try the next interesting menu item.
Oh yeah! Check out the beer float. Really good. Try the "Mickey", chocolate cherry shake.

I want to preface this review saying that I'm basing this off of my first time and impressions at this coffee shop. I went with one of my friends who is a regular here and LOVES it. She has a great relationship with the staff here and goes every weekend with her dad. Unfortunately today I was not blown away like she was. It could have just been partially an off day, so I wanted to make sure I noted that I know people do truly love this place, as clearly shown by the many people in the shop. 

From what I heard about Hubbard & Cravens, I assumed it was just a coffee shop. When I walked in  I saw the area to order coffee to my left and tables to my right. I assumed that people just got coffee and sat down to socialize or work. I then learned from my friend that the right half is actually a restaurant and you sit down to order food. I honestly would have never known that since I didn't see anyone at a hostess sign or clear signage. 

I approached the cashier looking at the menu. As I just did a workout I was looking for some protein and carbs for recovery so I focused on the smoothie section. I was a little disappointed to see that there was mostly just juices and few smoothie options. When I was asking the difference between the smoothies as there was no differentiation on the menu itself the cashier didn't really know the different. Another staff member stepped in to the rescue to explain what each smoothie had, and I'm glad she was around because she really helped with my order. I'm wondering if the cashier was new, so I did take that into consideration. The one I ordered, the green smoothie, isnt actually a smoothie, it was juice, and I would have been confused if i didn't know prior. It had kale, spinach, apple juice, and banana. It's originally sold at room temp, so the barista suggested I have it over ice. The 2 other smoothie options were strawberry and I think blueberry, and those were just typical fruit and yogurt smoothies. This location is in a complex with 2 workout places, and as we know post workout protein is key, so I think it would be an awesome touch if they generated some smoothies with more protein and less sugar. 

As for my juice, it was just fine, not super special. Because it was made with apple juice it was very sweet, and I could not really taste the spinach or kale, so it would be a good way to get your greens in. I know too that coffee is a priority here, but for the crazy people like me who do not enjoy coffee it's an added bonus to have options for us when we get dragged to coffee shops. 

Overall, the staff was nice and the inside of this shop was very cool. I have heard that it can get a little crowded and sometimes work space is limited so if you plan on coming to do some work, you may need to go around times when it's not as busy.

Everyone was so pleasant and wonderful.. They ensured I got the proper spa, had everything I needed and explained the process to me... The guys that delivered my spa were so helpful and pleasant.. Funny too.. 
This was one of the best experiences I have had in long time..
It was painless. I am enjoying my Hot Tub... Thank you to the whole team at The Spa and Sauna.

Very nice staff.  Made me feel comfortable.  Would recommend to other people.  They offered suggestions about after care and what direction to go in.  Wish they were closer to Santa Barbara but hey we all can't have everything

I have a rescue greyhound (Pond) that is a little shy and still getting used to being around people and other animals and a cat(Meeko). And the staff at Westchase are friendly and really good with both. They are always available to answer the many questions I have about making sure our Pond is in good health and that we are doing the right thing. And even though my cat thinks car rides are the devil they take excellent care of her. I highly recommend this wonderful very clinic.

I have hundreds of pictures from this place, but the ones I most admire of Juara... I miss that fella so much!!!  :(

Hands-down, the Saint Louis Zoo is the best in the nation... great exhibits (none of them make me sad), food is nicely located, admission is FREE, parking isn't too terrible, and you can drink there!  High kick! 

I'll post a picture of Juara!!  May he rest in peace!!

Don't go here. The tools looked dirty, the place looked dirty, I should have walked out. My nails were rushed and came out messy. The cuticle trimming was painful and not done carefully. It was dead silent in there even though there were a few other customers. By the time I noticed my nails were the wrong color, they had already done the first layer on my hand. At that point I was already so uncomfortable I just wanted to get it over with so I didn't bother to say anything. When they brought out the uv light box to set my gel nails, they propped it up so it was leaning up on the arm rest and the light was shining right up in my eyes. 

Somehow I ended up with a dark brownish color instead of black. As far as the quality goes, just see for yourself.. 

oh and the woman next to me asked if she could get her eyebrows done and the nail technicians response was "and not your lip? Just your eyebrows?" What an insulting attempt at an up-sell! The comment was totally unprompted and honestly one of the only things I heard her say to the woman. Needless to say I won't be coming back.

This is one of my go-to places from out of town. Great food, great prices, the best service. Can't wait to go back the chips and guacamole are outstanding. So happy to have Livery here!  And, there is valet parking. Very nice to have that option.
I had my first session with Jessi and she is amazing! Great work, fun to talk to and she knows her stuff. Everyone was so kind and welcoming. All was super clean and professional.
Always great pizzas and salads, quick service. Best for take out and going to nearby wine tasting rooms since their space is small and crowded
Food is fresh and delicious- the tastiest Tex mex food I've ever had! Yum!

We order from here multiple times a month on Grubhub and we have never had issues with delivery and their food is always so fresh and has really great flavor. The one time we ordered a pizza and it was delivered all messed up we called and LaScala's offered to make a new one and deliver it right away. This is rare though because we normally never have issues with delivery. Overall it's great service and AMAZING food. Their vodka sauce and gnocchi is the best.
Pizza had good flavor, but the crust was a little flimsy & soggy, especially in the middle of the pizza, so if we came back I would ask for it to be cooked a little longer.

Great sushi place on Mass Ave! We all know I'm obsessed with sushi so I had to give 45 degrees a try. I honestly don't know how I haven't been here before !? I was so pleasantly surprised by how good and fresh the fish tasted! 

I went on my lunch break and got their killer lunch special ($8 for sushi roll and soup or salad)! The shrimp tempura was absolutely amazing and the mid soup was to die for! I loved how much tofu they gave me! 

All around a very tasty sushi restaurant in the perfect location! The inside was very spacious and well done as well. Yum!

Visited twice. Love the casual, cozy atmosphere and variety of places to sit indoors and outdoors. The beer is great although I can barely tell the difference between the IPAs, and I've tried several of them. They are all yummy. The food is great... rabbit...my first time having it, was exceptionally delicious. The pretzel was awesome. Everything we have tried was excellent.

I had the BEST massage this past weekend.  Jules was very personable, professional, and thorough with her assessment of what was going to help me feel better.  I will definitely be back!   Thank you Jules!

Overall, rather disappointing...

The spring rolls were good but the kung pao chicken had so much thin sauce it was more like eating soup (which barely had any chicken or flavor).  The Lo Mein also had the thickest noodles I've ever seen in a Lo Mein dish (think soba noodles) and was covered in sauce.
We ordered delivery which was 30 minutes late during which the food had turned lukewarm.
Great location - surrounded by restaurants and close to the airport. The rooms are clean but the walls are very thin. The staff is friendly and made us feel welcome.

I have been going to YangMing since I was a freshman in HS at VFMA. I got in A LOT of trouble for being a foodie even at the young age of 13 I had a passion in trying new restaurants esp if they looked TOP NOTCH. One day I went AWOL from a medical appt next door to YangMing, being hungry my friend and I decided to try YangMing.

We happened to be eating their while the Dean of Students wife was eating there LOL and sure enough we ended up getting in A LOT of trouble.

Was it worth it???? F ck YEA it was!!!! I enjoyed it so much it became the place of choice to eat every time my family came to visit me.

After graduating HS I barely am ever in the Lancaster Ave/ Philly Suburb area. But when I am I make it a point to come here to eat.

Yes the food is designed more for the american palate, with that said. They make some very delicious food and they have an extensive wine menu to match.

They have a knack in producing great and exquisite flavors with their beef, seafood and chicken dish's. I tend to almost always order a shrimp dish which you can order in a variety of ways. Even some ways that are not listed on the menu such as with ginger and scallions. Simply Delish.

I am a big fan of their spring rolls. Really tasty and crisp.

The Young Chow Fried Rice which is called something else on the menu is also another excellent choice.

The food is top notch and the bill can be just as top notch and can add up rather quickly.

If coming for dinner on the weekend one should def make a reservation, because this is a very popular hot spot and gets packed on the weekends.

Def worth checking out if you enjoy good quality Americanized Chinese that is def much better then PF Changs

This is the place to go for whole roasted Peking duck. They will cut it up for you if you ask. Just like Chinatown in Manhattan! Lots of variety of chinese; spices,vegetables,produce,fish, and everything else Chinese. All to go.

best i've found in Boise.

very inclusive selection of bagel sandwiches, breakfast bagels too. 

excellent customer service, excellent prices. 

always a winner for a bagel craving.

We were headed to another restaurant when this place caught our eye. All of the food is raw and they only have a dehydrated. No microwaves, ovens, stoves, toasters/toaster ovens, etc... The creations the owner comes up with are all her own and they are so good. We bought her book and she was there and she signed it for us. Very generous owners and staff. The waitress at the counter was helpful and gave us samples of their pates, and desserts. I mean the ingredients are incredibly good for you. Everything is homemade and organic. I am excited to try out new recipes and enjoy an even newer way of eating; raw. #nextlevel. Their cayenne cacao chocolate was so good. Their avocado cacao pudding was so good. Their basil wrap was awesome. Their chili platter was great. Everything was fantastic. All of their pates were great. Their mango and hibiscus tea was great, too. Eat here!

My friend and I met here for a quick bite. I was scoping out the menu in advance and was debating between the Korean beef tacos and the angry hamachi roll. I went with the roll, which has tuna on the inside and grilled hamachi on top as well as raw jalapeno. I love spicy food and sushi so I was looking forward to this one. It was tasty, but not real spicy.

It was not really busy the night we went so we were able to get a table right away. It is pretty dimly lit and modern looking. White tables, chairs and benches. I am not a big fan of the look as it just makes me think of a cafeteria.  There are a few outdoor tables. I think I would prefer to sit outside next time.

Service was good.

I rarely go to International Plaza and it has been a while since I ate at any of the restaurants there, but this is a good option for future trips.

Best tea in Reno, in my opinion. However, they get busy and the wait is long. I took my kids there after school around 3pm and we literally waited 30 minutes for our order of 3 boba teas. The wait was interesting though, there was a lot going on in the area today. There's no indoor seating, you order at the counter outside. They offer one size only FYI. The coconut and banana mix is awesome! I also like the passion fruit tea with popping boba. So, if you don't mind a long wait it's a good spot to get a boba tea.

lot's of potential. 
The breakfast chimi is great on the inside, but the outside leaves something to be desired. Why use bad thick store bought flour tortillas when you are in a location with the best tortillas in the world? Could use a little more sauce as well. 
The bacon donut is awesome though. The bloody mary's are a bit weak but they do have fun varieties.

As of now, my husband and I have vowed never to go back to this cinema unless some MAJOR changes happen!  The walls are disgusting!  The fabric on the walls are pulled off and look like someone spills LOADS of stuff all over them.  The whole building actually looks bad.  The bathrooms, lets not even talk about them.

The movie playing ability isn't bad, just the place itself.  There are also LOTS of kids at almost any given movie time.  Its really hard to escape them.  so if your looking for a relaxing time at the movie...don't go here.

I was in Philadelphia with a couple of friends to watch the Philadelphia Eagles play in Super Bowl LII! Since my friend's apartment was right on Rittenhouse Square, I decided to go out and celebrate in the streets with the rest of Philly! 

While out celebrating on the streets, I came across this Modell's Sporting Goods, which was selling a variety of Philadelphia Eagles Super Bowl LII celebration gear. Even though the game just ended they already had a section set up with a variety of gear including hats, sweatshirts and more! The staff also had a nice, organized line that allowed for everyone to checkout as quickly as possible especially because there was a large crowd.

In the past, I have been to this Modell's Sporting Goods and gotten a variety of athletic gear from here and it is generally pretty good.

Altogether, this is a great Modell's to pick up a variety of sports and athletic gear. Best of all, the Philadelphia Eagles ended up winning the Super Bowl!!! #FlyEaglesFly

Ferg owes me $325 for a Fender amp of mine he sold on consignment for 1/4 of what we agreed on. The kids you take advantage of today will grow up tomorrow, Ferg. That amp is worth $1000 today, and you sold it for $100 (or so you claim) and gave me $75 and said I could take it or leave with nothing. Screwed me out of my amp and my money. Don't trust Ferg with your amp or your money.

I stopped in for lunch around 1pm the other week and this place was empty.  Ordered a sushi lunch special and the spicy tuna roll was filled with crunchy stuff and very dry.  New from Southern California, I trying just about every sushi place in town.  Doubt if I would return here.

This Thai spot is hidden in the heart of Northdale. Was in the mood for Thai and this place had great reviews so I figured why not. I ordered the calamari as an app and the chicken pad thai for dinner. The pad thai was AMAZING! Great authentic taste! The portions are super generous too! The calamari was also great but smaller then the usual calamari appetizer. Although,  It was fresh and not too chewy. The prices were also not bad. I paid 17 for my app and dinner and well worth it. I will definitely be back to try the different types of curries they have! .

Best place to eat on St Pete beach. Everything from the food to the service is incredible. Don't bother spending a ton of money on some of the other places in the area.  You can leave here full for under 10 dollars.

I went here again within the past 7 days and noticed they had sales on just about everything we purchased.  My fiance was pleasantly surprised as well.  My complaint lies in the cashier who upon checking us out moving like a hurricane to roll the next person's groceries down as I was scooping up my groceries and putting into the final 2 bags.  I saw this as rude and discourteous, especially after we spent over $200, bagged our own groceries, and the fact it was after 9:30 pm.  I should have said something to her like, "Would you please wait 60 seconds until I finished gathering my items and putting them into my bags and cart?"  But again, nothing surprises me about the attitude and lack of professionalism of people in the Philadelphia Metro Area.  The last thing is that they seem to improve their cleaning SOMEWHAT of the men's bathroom however the log revealed they only check/clean once per day, usually around 10 am.  I suggest they clean and check the bathroom in the afternoon and evenings with some elbow grease and bleach mixed up in there...why the laziness, Acme?  Put your employees to work and hold them accountable!

I called Milne for a quote to tow my car, in town. I explained to the phone operator that I needed this done before 4pm, it was 2pm when I called. The operator said it wouldn't be a problem and would call me when the driver was on his way. I asked for a quote and he said it would be $60 with 5 free miles and $5/mile beyond that.  I finally received the call that the driver was on his way, just in time for me to get this completed before 4pm. Well... the driver showed up 40 minutes later, no way was he on his way when I was told. Not a huge deal, they were late, whatever. 
What came next was the worst customer service I have EVER experienced. EVER! The driver showed up, didn't even say hello, he saw my car loaded it up. The driver then went into his truck and sat down, I walked up and asked if he was ready to go, he asked for the delivery address. I gave it to him and mentioned that it was 5.7 miles away, he loaded the address into his GPS and it showed that it would be 8 miles. I explained that if we went the shortest route it would be 5.7 miles. I asked if he would follow me in my truck, he agreed. Before we left I reset my odometer to make sure that the trip was in facet, 5.7 miles. We were off. As we were in route I received a call from the driver stating that he forgot his credit card reader, I explained that I'd have to stop by a bank, so I did and withdrew cash. We were off again and finally made it to the destination, my odometer read 5.3 miles. I showed the driver where I wanted the car placed, the said "I need $75 first." I asked if he would explain the charges as I was quoted $65, he said $65 for the hook up and $5 per extra mile. I politely explained that i tracked the trip and showed 5.3 miles, he looked at me and SCREAMED, "Are you calling me a liar!" I was taken back and said, no, I did track the trip on my truck and it is different that what you're telling me. He then threatened to impound my car if I didn't pay. I agreed to pay the extra $10 and call it good, all the while he was breathing hard and acting as if we were going to get into a fight. This is only $10, I'd rather just give it to him rather than have any more drama. I pulled out $80 and asked for my change and a receipt, he SCREAMED again and said, "I'm a truck driver, I don't carry change!" (Remember, I stopped at an ATM as he forgot his card reader). I then told him I would go get change, which I did from a neighbor. When I walked up to the truck with the cash the driver told me to wait, he continued to talk on his cell phone for 15 minutes, he knew I was in a hurry. He finally unloaded my car, I gave him the $75 and he said, bye. I asked for the receipt again, he turned around went into his truck without acknowledging my request. I followed him, went up to his window and stared in, he looked back and finally wrote out my receipt. 
From the moment the driver showed up at my house, I had a feeling something could go wrong here so I took a photo of his truck as well as my odometer, before and after the drop off.
It's difficult to say what the driver's intention was with all of this, all I can really say is beware of using this company. Shady business practices and aggressive driver(s) will make you wish you called someone else.

Quite possibly the worst "indian" food I have ever experienced. Not a hater. This is based on takeout  so I have no experience with the service.

Bland, bland, bland, burnt, and awful. Love Indian food. I wish this approximated it.

Our order consisted of fairly pedantic fare, as far as Indian goes:

-pappadam...not on menu they went to the Nepalese place across the street to buy it...chutney. ...noooope
- chicken tikka (date ordered it , don't judge) tasted like tomato soup with tandoori chix
- chicken jalfreizi, ordered Indian spicy, had canned veggies in it, in a broth - like substance, unedible
- Naan- was ABC and dry, oh and burnt-to-beat-the-band.
- garlic kulcha- only edible item. Tho it was neither garlic or kulcha

All for the low, low price of 70 cold stones. 

If you like a bizzaro world of Sysco "Indian food" this your place. If u want anything close to Indian.....wide berth from your local India garden.

This has been one of my favorite bars in Indy for several years now! Great place to watch Colts games, one of the best draft selections in the city, and by far the best wings in the city! Today they lost a star from me by apparently [this is what my boyfriend and I agreed was likely responsible for the decline in flavor; either way something was up with the garlic!] changing from fresh to canned garlic for their garlic teriyaki wing sauce. Super gross! This was my favorite wing sauce, but I'm not likely to order it again unless I find out they switched back to the previous recipe. I hate it when restaurants cut corners by compromising the integrity of their ingredients, and I really hope they switch back!

My favorite sushi place! I forget to check -in on yelp because I'm so excited to eat here! 

Try starting your meal with SHRIMP Shumai...my friends and I agree that this is better than any other SHRIMP Shumai out there!

Okay so I am vascillating between 2.5 and 3...went ahead and rounded up. I was supposed to be here for a week. I am leaving after three days. I wanted to like Tucson but I don't, and I think Roadrunner has something to do with it. 

I came in with a reservation for a private room. when I got here i was informed that the private rooms were in a casita half a block away on the back side of a building on the other side of 12th street, down a dark alley where a dog was barking at me through a tin gate. The casita was impeccable but the room was tiny, didn't even have a nightstand with lamp, just a ceiling fan light with only 2 of 4 bulbs working.  The kitchen, laundry, tv room and free wifi were all back at the main building. In a word, this room, this arrangement is not worth the $40 per night fee. 

I asked to be moved back to the main house because i felt uncomfortable being so far away. the woman on duty was resistant because i'd already paid her in full, telling me the casita is safe and the dog is friendly. right. i insisted, and she said she didn't have any private rooms in the main house. (but she did, and she gave it to a couple who checked in after me) I said "Fine, a $20 dorm room will do" and she was still resistant. But I moved over. (this same lady has since told me i was in her way, talked passive-agressively about me, and generally not been nice or helpful because "she's not working tonight". Well why are you in here then?!)

Not 15 minutes after first handing her the full amount for the private room, I asked to be refunded the difference for the $20 room. She said she "couldn't". Only management can do refunds. I get policy, I do. But this was 15 minutes, it's not like I spent a night in the private room! It was just an extra hassle and it made me worry that they were not going to give me my money back. But they DID, the next day, and the manager was totally fine with it.  

The rest of the staff is chill, and when there were actually other people my age at the hostel, we had a great time together.  That was one night/day. The rest of the time, inhabitants are WAAAY older dudes who have no homes or are otherwise here for really long stays and are pretty creepy and considering the female dorm doesn't have a lock on the door, and I am alone here with them, I don't feel particularly safe. I mean I don't think they are going to murder me but I don't like being the only woman here. 

The hostel does offer free waffle breakfast, $1 to wash 75 cents to dry laundry, two free computers and free WiFi, as well as a video library, phone usage, free parking and plenty of tourism info. The female dorms do not have the underbed lockers that are advertised on the site. The beds are really uncomfortable and the bunks are wicked creaky. 

The neighborhood is not that close to downtown as advertised and is not in a great area (a nearby blood bank has wierdos chilling outside).  So while the public rooms of the main house are decent, the majority of the staff is really friendly and great, and most of the amenities are valid, I feel like the place deserves 3 stars. But strange policies, "meh" location and uncomfortable sleeping areas earn, well 1.5 stars.

I received a message from the business letting me know that the person who was so rude to us and to at least 2 other parties was in fact the owner.  All of us left and went to other local eateries.  You can read the full review for additional details on our treatment.  They thanked me for my feedback but encouraged me to spend my dime elsewhere where I am more comfortable.  Will do!
These guys got national delivery down its not New York or Chicago style its national style that sorta fits in between all of them it's quick & easy
Food sucks. Management sucks. Service sucks. Overpriced. Save your money, go somewhere else.

My boo bear and I came in tonight, and ordered for some organic nuggs and the crew members gave me and my sweetie pie the dirtiest look, I was shook! That is so disrespectful. Then it took a like 5 minutes for our food. And you won't believe what happened! our nuggs weren't vegan! How dare you do that to sweet little baby chickens! They are harmless and innocent. I hope all the animals you brutally murder and eat will haunt you.
Ate here while waiting for my granddaughter to be born, not only is it convenient but they have a great menu alot of choices and the food is very good.  I will definitely come back.

Friendly staff, food very good. Had crabcake sandwich which was great. Did the hoppy flight option. Beer is just ok. All 4 were drinkable but if u compare them to New England microbrew they suck. But I drank them. HOT in this place, asked to turn on AC and they never did. Has a bit of a TGIFridays vibe but not full cheese.

Impeccable service. Not quite there for the portion, for the price, for the region, and its missing Michelin star(s). You are left feeling hungry without having gone through an experience worthy of the hunger.

Cold Spring Tavern is everything you never knew you wanted. 

Came here on a warm Sunday, led by a friend who lives In SB locally. She said it was delicious Tri Tip hidden in the mountains. I was confused and intrigued! Parked a little bit up the hill and hiked down to the Tavern. When you turn the corner there are dozens of people hanging outside, Sons of Anarchy, but much nicer! There was a shack that served as a bar where you order your meal ticket, and around the building was the grill. The holy grail. the tri tip sandwiches! 

It may be difficult to find seating, but we got incredibly lucky with some picnic benches in the back. Beer in hand, onion rings on deck, I was ready to dive in. They offer a few sauces: bbq, a horseradishy deli mustard, and an au jus. The bread was basic, but soft enough to soak with au jus. The tri tip was simply seasoned, and perfectly tender. The onion rings were great too! The onions bit off with every bite (no awkward just-batter moments). 

CST was everything you never knew you wanted. Rustic, "hidden," simple. peaceful.

been going to cawleys since i was little for the food then i started drinking in there. good neighborhood bar. GET THE WINGS!!!!!!!!! also get the buffalo chicken fries!! the only thing - if you pay with a card - they will put a 30$ charge hold on your account. i just was there and realized this. its also a smoking bar.

Good food, horrible service. My friends and I were unable to pay for our orders separately, all with cash, because it costs these people "too much money and it is against their policy." Usually a 20-30 minute minimum wait time. Prices seem to keep on going up every time. Due to poor service, I do not recommend.

This hotel is in the perfect location!  Close to Royal, Bourbon,  Decatur and Frenchman Streets. 

Staff waa accommodating and for the most part friendly.   I had originally planned on a 4 night stay, however,  due to weather that was reduced to 3.  Sara, the reservations manager, didn't charge us for the first night when per the cancellation policy she could have.

My first shower was lukewarm but upon notifying the staff the problem was immediately rectified. 

I'll stay in a different room next time as we were in 1 of 2 rooms that opened directly onto St. Phillip...there were no windows and we didn't feel safe unless the shutters were in deadbolt position.  (Room 243)

My only complaint was the filthy rug between the 2 double beds.  I dig that the building is over 300 years old but wash the rug at least every century or throw it away.

This is my go-to Walgreens but tonight I went to the front check out counter and the woman was clearly ill and admitted it when asked. How in the world can a health focused retailer let a potentially contagious and clearly sick personal handle merchandise, give out change and be in close proximity to customers? Maybe it's good for getting customers back into the store to buy more stuff when they catch what she's got.  It grossed me out.

Took a weekend trip to Nashville and got this recommended to me by several different people. It was spectacular and certainly a must for any future returns to Nashville. It is a casual dining setting, you order at the counter, get a number and seat yourself. This place is extremely popular. We got here 30 minutes after it opened and had to wait about 10 minutes (not too bad) but by the time we left the line was half way down the street. So be prepared to wait, or get there early!

We got the bonuts (heavenly) and I ordered the East Nasty (fried chicken thigh on a delicious homemade biscuit with aged cheddar cheese and sausage gravy on top) which was superb. I had a hard time choosing between that and the Princess (someone at the table next to us ordered this and it looked incredible as well). I doubt you can go wrong with this place. Definitely a must if you're in Nashville!

Held a private party on a Saturday night. The staff was incredibly accommodating and attentive. Food was delicious, as always.  Each cut of meat done to perfection. This place is where you learn what the term "meat sweats" really means. Our party was early -4:30 which I would recommend because this place gets busy fast!  By the time we left, people were lined up everywhere to get in there!  It's a bit $$$ but you won't be disappointed unless your vegan
Really good breakfast food. Fast and friendly service. Specialty pancakes are very yummy.

An incredibly mediocre experience for the price I paid. A bowl of flavorless "curry" soup and a bland cocktail ran me $20 plus tip. I wouldn't go back, and I can't praise anything about my experience except the decor.

Jeremy in the service department was very helpful from the start to finish. As soon as I pulled up, he helped me with my vehicle and gave me an estimate quote that my car will take 2 hours max. He also informed me about how the company has shuttles to take you to where you need while you're waiting for your vehicle. No one has told me the past times I've been there. Joyce, my shuttle service lady was very sweet and took me to my house while my car was in the shop and also picked me back up when it was done.

Cafe Degas is actually my favorite restaurant. I love this restaurant not only for the food, but the atmosphere. It's small and just so quaint. It has charm like you are on a little French Patio. On great weather days, this place makes me smile; it's just so cozy. It's a great spot for very small gatherings, especially dates. It's not a location that can accommodate big parties at all.

Food... Let me start with the dessert, my favorite has to be the floating island. It's like custard of sorts surrounding a pool of delicious cream. It makes me want to sing a song completely in French. The French Onion Soup is amazing and overflowing with amazing flavor, cheese and moor. It will definitely soothe your soul especially on a chilly day. Another favorite soup of mine is the Crab Mirlton Soup, which is definitely not lacking crab and surrounded by such a rich sauce. The meal I probably get the most here has to be the hangar steak and pommes frites.  The pommes frites are addictive and I'm not sure how to live life without their fries. They are literally perfect and I can't stop eating them once I stop. The steak is actually always cooked as asked in a nice simple sauce and cut.

Parking. It's next door to Nonna Mia and other businesses but you shouldn't have too much trouble parking in the vicinity, most likely directly across the street by a tiny cute park.

I give this place 5 stars just because the sushi is fresh, cheap and close to CC campus! They have combos that come with Udon, Tempura and a sushi roll for around $10 which can not be beat with the great view of the harbor. Their bento boxes, rolls & special poke bowls have never disappointed me.

This review is only for Dan Dan noodles. It's dry and no too much flavor. The portion is enough for one person.

The restaurant itself is very elegant and clean. I like the painting of a lady on the wall upon entering.

Wonderful lunch with friends.  Food, service and atmosphere great.  Owner makes a point to stop at tables and deliver plates periodically - seemed very attentive and concerned with details.  Would love to try for dinner.

Who doesn't love Target? You can get ANYTHING here. This Target is no different. They have a good kids section, food, household goods, etc. I bought some maternity clothes here and registered. It's easy for me to drop by on my way home from work. Loses one major star for an awful parking lot set up. This area is on my AVOID list for the weekend. It's a "parking lot derby," as Steven B would say. I always feel like I'm going to hit someone or be hit. I'll stick to the 5 star Kirkwood location whenever I can!

Meh.

The pizza toppings were decent, but the crust itself was pre-made, like a Boboli, except in a restaurant that you're supposed to take seriously.

The building is yet another empty echoey warehouse-style space, which means that the music and the crowd noise reverberates and gets overwhelming.

We were there like the week after they opened, and the waitress was still in the starry-eyed over-perky stage at which she was smiling in a scary, over-exaggerated way.

Honestly, for better pizza from a chain go to Papa John's.

First time and probably the last. Food was mediocre. Husband had the redfish,a little on the dry side. I had the shrimp and grits. Sauce tasted like watered down ketchup with a hint of hot sauce. Grits very watery. The chargrilled oysters were just ok. Nothing to brag about. Server was very attentive.

They do a great job. My gel manicure lasts 3 weeks, which has never happened to me before at other nail salons. They have a wide range of gel nail colors. They are reasonably priced. $40 for gel manicure. I usually pay 35-45 at other salons. It's definitely worth it since the manicure lasts 3 weeks. They are quick, too, which is definitely a plus if you are in a hurry.
Dr. Linaker and his staff are great.  I appreciate the personal attention. They have taken care of my daughter and now she has a beautiful smile.  Thank you !

Woohoo finally a fantastic local coffee shop (this review is some time over due)! I love the llama, and most of all their outdoor space. Sitting underneath the giant Torrey Pine, sipping a macchiato (on a Macchiato Monday of course), enjoying a good conversation is what Carpinteria (and the Llama) is all about. And while you are enjoying your favorite coffee drink (do include some oat milk!) dive into one of their  Açaí Bowls. All of them are good, and in good Local tradition, the one with Avocado is the best!!

Just not happy at all.
For $35 I got a pedicure that was worth $15 
My mom asked to get her toe nail fixed with acrylic and it was absolutely terrible. 
Last time I came here (January) I loved the place and was so pleased with the service. However, I will not come again after paying for an overpriced "deluxe" pedicure and they still charged my mom for a terrible job. 
Other places will give you more for your buck including quality service!

Quick Summary: It's definitely a hole in the wall, but the food is good and the value is great!

One of my favorite parts of going to my barber shop (see my reviews) is that they always talk food at some point and this place came up a couple of times through my visits. Curious I made my way here for lunch after getting a fresh cut.

The joint is not the most clearly marked and when you do see it, it kinda makes you raise your eye brow... walking into you definitely realize that Market takes precedence on Restaurant.  The menu isn't the most elaborate, a few sandwiches some soups, sides... a good place to grab a quick lunch.

Grouper sandwhich was awesome! So big it wouldn't fit in your typical to sandwich sized to-go box. They had to put a rubber band over it to keep it together.  There's multiple filets in the sandwich, all thinly breaded but a good crispy exterior, so you taste the fish and get the crunch of the fry.  Served with tartar sauce, lettuce and tomato... it's simply awesome. cause it is so big though I can be a bit challenging to eat... but that's just part of the fun.

Loved the hush puppies, don't find these that often since most people prefer fries... but they are excellently prepared here.

Not so good was the clam chowder not so good... it was pretty bland and more goopey than soupy.

All in all though, that sandwich and hush puppies... I'll definitely be back for a lunch bite! Probably wouldn't hang out inside much... since it is a fish market... but there are tables outside to kick back and bite into that sandwich creation of deliciousness.

The food was good. The service was good. The entertainment was great. We sat upstairs and enjoy drinks and pizza and salad and live music by Aubryn. The atmosphere and general feel was very friendly and open.

The only thing I really like about this place is the decor. It's a nice decorated space, and there is plenty of room for big groups. Other than that, though, I wouldn't recommend going here. I've been here maybe four times now, and I keep hoping the service and drinks will get better. But the cocktails are weak, they've messed up my beer order more than once (even though you order it at the counter, right next to the tap), and the bar snacks are greasy. I'm glad the workers are being paid decently, but they always seem rather inattentive and aloof, it's weird. Overall, this place is an OK option if you have a group of 10+ people and you keep your expectations low.
Great service by a great waiter.  Excellently prepared food.  Delicious. Sat outside which was fun to watch people go by.  FUN place.  All this and dog friendly patio too.  Loved it!
had dinner here twice.  Excellent food and service.  calamari was nice and soft--not chewy at all.  Pistachio gelato was an awesome dessert

First time here & I'm a fan!! Delicious, high quality bagels with unique spreads. They don't skimp on the cream cheese- very generous portions. The staff are super friendly & helpful. Haven't left yet & already can't wait to return.

I really like this place BUT it seems like they cook the chicken shawarma different every time I come here. Sometimes the chicken is a nice golden color with a nice sear and really flavorful. Other days (my last 3 times here), it's lighter in color, no grill sear at all and less flavorful. The rice also changes in consistency, sometimes it's fluffier than other days, more flavorful and plentiful, then some days they are very modest with the rice. The spicy potatoes have NOT been consistent in size or spice. These are regular potatoes being served at this point.

I would just like some consistency. Or I might just need to ask the name of the chef on the days it's cooked properly. Clearly there are different people cooking. Or maybe they're not cooking the chicken fresh to order as of late.

Love myself some Five Guys!  Great place for a big Saturday lunch.  Cannot go wrong with a bacon cheeseburger and some of the best fries known to man.  I'll do lettuce, tomato, grilled onion, pickles, bbq, and hot sauce, with cajun fries please.  Massive helpings.  Fresh as can be.  Awesome prices.  And if that wasn't enough, they have the coolest soda dispenser on the market, the touch screen Coke machine!  It took me years to try Five Guys, but that was a mistake on my end.  Don't you make that mistake.  You've been informed!

Literally a hole in the wall restaurant tucked away in a residential neighborhood. Parking is available on street and they have a cute bike rack (shaped Lonas) on the side of building. We arrived at 5pm so wasn't busy but there's a line by the time we're leaving. As other reviewers said, there're 2 seating indoor areas & an outdoor patio; self-serving soft drinks, chopsticks & other utensils. The interior is modern-hip design, clean, small groups tables & has a small bar. Very friendly service & staff. 

Ok, here's the food reviews: 
- Five-star platter: includes all proteins except beef brisket ($2 extra if you want it, we didn't this time) & 2 fillers (we picked cold glass noodle & fried rice) & a side (we did spicy eggplant). All the proteins are flavored yet able to complement any sauce provided. Our favorites are beef, pulled pork & shrimp. Chicken breast pieces were dry & a little rubbery and spicy tofu was ok. It's a good dish to try everything or share!
- Beef Dumplings: mostly mixed veggies and some beef bits. Not the usual frozen types, so we enjoyed it with the spicy red sauce.
Great soup. Fast service (we told them we were in a hurry). Good fish. Good margaritas according to my companion.

So the food was 3.5 stars but the price is 1 star. On her friend's recommendation, a colleague and I stopped into Mulate's for lunch. I should have kept my reservation for Emeril's - the food was so much better abs I actually paid less for lunch.

I ordered the Mardi Gras shrimp poboy platter for $21.99. Since I was already spending a ridiculous amount of money, I decided to go for the extra $3.99 for jambalaya.

The pros - service was quite good. They were attentive and friendly. It was easy to get seated at lunchtime because it's a big restaurant. And there was one standout in the food: my shrimp itself.

The Mardi Gras shrimp was fried and coated in what they called a spicy Cajun honey mustard sauce, but I probably would have called a remoulade. Anyway, the shrimp itself was great.

The bread was only ok, the tomatoes on the sandwich were mealy, and the coleslaw was in some kind of a green goddess type dressing. Now, that would probably have been good if it hadn't have been served room temperature, almost warm. I don't know about you, but I'm not getting sick from warm coleslaw. Nuh uh.

And then there was my tiny little side dish of jambalaya, which was basically bland rice with some brownish red coloring. I have rarely been so disappointed in my food.
