To top it all off, my iced tea was almost $4. So my meal came to over $40 with tax and tip. What a ripoff. Avoid, and instead spend your $40 on all the amazing and delicious other restaurants in the area.
Great service, Jared did a great job got out the few stains that I had. The living room looked new again. I would recommend to anyone looking to get their carpets cleaned. Awesome work guys
The Matzoh Ball soup is amazing, food is always great, never had a bad dish, the staff is equally great, meatloaf is awesome and the blackened chicken quesadillas are great.

This little pretzel shop at 42nd & College is a quiet little gem of a place, though those who need their retailers to be all polished and shiny will likely be disappointed and might as well head someplace else.

This is the kind of place that you're likely not going to notice unless you already know it's there. Located directly across from the library in an older building, A Taste of Philly, or Pat's Philly Pretzels, lost a star almost immediately simply because I can't ignore their lack of wheelchair access. There's a step going into their establishment - you can see it for yourself clearly in the photos here and my guess is it would be an obstacle for most folks in wheelchairs. 

However, I'm willing to keep the rating above average because the product was high quality, a pretzel of course, and the employees were friendly. They even allowed us to take a chair or two outside so that my companions could join me as we ate our pretzels. 

I visited on the last day of my Tenderness Tour and, quite literally, while I was on my route as this is only about 3 blocks off of the Monon Trail. While that seems like an easy detour, the path itself has a lot of broken sidewalk concrete and if you are in a wheelchair or utilizing a bike or have a stroller with you then you should be careful.

I kept it really simple during my visit - after all, I was wheeling all day and needed my energy. That said, the pretzel hit the spot as I wound own my day. Will I go back? Probably not - primarily because it's not accessible and that's more difficult to manage when I'm alone. That said, for those without mobility issues this is a divey little gem in Indy and definitely worth a visit. They do group orders/trays and have a variety of dipping sauce options available. They do also have some drink options - mostly of the bottled variety.

Flavorful, friendly, and charming!  
We lucked into Embermill and met Harold, the creative director and owner. The place was quiet for our early dinner. There were a few other customers curious for a taste of the Caribbean. By evening the place was filled and lively. It's casual and there's paid parking conveniently around the corner. 
What a cute historic location right in the interesting part of State Street!  We relaxed in the shade of the patio, but they've opened up the place so there's a cool breeze when you need it. 
We had jerk chicken and pulled pork which came with plantains, red beans and rice, and sweet potato. There are vegan and vegetarian choices as well. Everything tasted fresh, hand made, and just the right amount of island spices to make you want to return for more. 
Our waitress, Ixel, checked in frequently, made good suggestions, and was personable. There was excitement and pride in their new venture and they should find lots of success in the locals and visitors of Santa Barbara who enjoy a tasty food adventure.

Lucky Lane is a St. Louis gem! My daughter has been attending for about a year now, but the school has been a part of my family for much longer. Both myself and my father attended Lucky Lane, so the decision to send my daughter there was a no-brainer. 

The staff at Lucky Lane is great. The teachers are all so kind and the director, Carly, is easy to work with. One of the most unique things about Lucky Lane is their flexible scheduling. It really makes a huge difference to my family, and I have not encountered another school that offers anything like it.

My daughter has learned so much there. She always comes home singing new songs from music class, with new books form the library, or with stories about playing with her friends outside or in the wheel-toy room. She is always excited to go to school in the morning, which makes dropping her off each morning a breeze. I simply can't say enough great things about Lucky Lane!
Excellent food, angry owner... But whatever, the food is worth it. Very good food and extremely low price... Well worth it.

First dermatologist visit ever. I didn't know what to expect. As a healthcare professional,  I've seen the good, bad, and down right ugly! How refreshing to meet the team at M.D. Claiborne Dermatology office! I was warmly welcomed by the front desk(given the most needed ink pen to take home)! Carrie the medical assistant was very thorough in getting my medical history and reason for my visit. Jennifer, Esthetician, very knowledgeable when explaining the services offered and how to keep my skin healthy. Dr. Claiborne actually listened to what my issues were and gave me a regimen, I could  follow. Also Annie and Bonnie were both very knowledgeable regarding Daavlin booth and  scheduling of my future visits. I give the entire team a huge thumbs up ! Looking forward to my next visit. It's so comforting when you have a great team both clinically and customer service oriented.

I'm writing this to thank the owner of this establishment for his hospitality to our group this past weekend.  We held our Fantasy Football draft party here, and the staff really made us feel at home.  They provided us with an excellent amount of service throughout the night.

It's just a neighborhood place to grab a beer, but I found it to be clean with a good beer selection.  And since I am a fan of Shock top, seeing it prominently offered on several taps with different flavors won me over.  

And you can play Donkey Kong there.  It's like they know me.

Nearly a garden atrium. Great coffee, cozy shop. 

I came here on a Yelp CMYE and was quite pleased. I ordered a caramel latte which came out perfect temp, perfect sweet. The nuclear colored paint unfortunately did not bestow me with any super powers so that's a bummer. I did like the rampant garden through the windows and the snug study feel of the seating area. 

Due to the garden, this joint would have a much different feel season to season, which is a cool affect even if it weren't intended. Overall, looking forward to heading back!

Bought a 2017 Tacoma from this dealership, worked with Bryan and got a very good deal  with zero hassle. Just had the first 5,000 mile service with Bonnie and was in and out fast on a Saturday! Good job Toyota of S.B.!!

Delicious breakfast spot with friendly service. The coffee and breakfast sandwich were great and came out in a reasonable amount of time. There are several tables and chairs in the business for studying or meeting a friend to chat!

There aren't enough words to express my thanks and gratitude to Sherwood Florist.  My Mom's very untimely passing from breast cancer on September 30th put our whole family into a tailspin - with all of us doing our best to hold ourselves together while also trying to make sure my mother got the type of memorial service she deserved.

All of the staff at Sherwood were so compassionate, understanding, accommodating, professional, respectful, and patient with us from Day One!  They truly made us feel like family - at a time that we needed it the most.  The service was beautiful - and the attention to detail regarding the set up of everything we selected was second to none.

I no longer live in Spring Hill, but knowing from the start I was dealing with a top notch florist put my mind at ease.  Their recommendations and creativity were spot on.  If anyone is on the fence about renting the "doors to heaven," all I can say is DO IT!  People are still contacting me about how beautiful they were.  

From the bottom of our hearts - the Valuri family appreciates you all.  We will always recommend Sherwood Florist to anyone who needs their services.   

Saying good-bye to my Mom was a bit easier because of you.  You are the best.

Usually a grocery store is low on my list of things to review, but I enjoy the Schnucks at Hampton Village.  It is well organized, clean, brightly lit, has the cheesy music turned low, and the employees are usually friendly.  I like their beer selection and they seem to have a large wine/liqueor selection for a grocery store.  The crowd here is pretty good too.  You won't see many shoppers wearing pajamas, screaming kids, or having domestic disputes in the frozen foods section.  At least not compared to other Schnucks locations I have frequented.

I highly recommend this location.

Super cute. I was in town for the wknd and booked this for my friend and I. If you enjoy paint & sips and want to try something different I recommend wax & wine. 

We both enjoyed it. My friend kept saying this was a good idea. Idk how i came across this but I just knew it was something we had to do once we get to PA 


It is BYOB and staff is great
I had the Creole stuffed fish. It was so delicious! Great customer service with such friendly waiter's & waitresses. Loved the music being played as well. Highly recommend & will definitely be back!

It's okay if you're looking for older vinyl records. They have a good variety, but they are very overpriced. I went to Grady's in Ventura and bought an Eric Clapton record, a Fleetwood Mac record, and a Rolling Stones double LP all in mint condition for $11 total. At JPM, the total would been about $50. They charge about $10 more than any other record store for the same records in (usually) worse condition. Not my favorite store but it's all we got here in SB

If you want to visit an upscale martini bar, this place isn't for you. However, if you want a fun and funky place that totally defines Bourbon Street, this is the place.  And it may be the most tourist-friendly bar in New Orleans.
The food here is just amazing, plain and simple. Lively atmosphere, outdoor seating option, friendly staff. I'd definitely go back.

I've been here twice since it opened. One time, the service was excellent. The other time, our waitress was inattentive and the pacing was horrible (entrees arrived minutes after our soups hit the table). Both times, several of my party's steaks were under-done. This is unacceptable in a supposedly 5 star steakhouse. Ruth's Chris nails the steaks every time and I'll just keep going there instead.

I soooooo whole heartily agree with Johnny T on EVERY point. 
So disappointed at choices and the lack of care by employees, I can only guess it's a manager issue bc if all act this way then the manager must be the one leading the attitude.  
Also seriously PLEASE stop shutting everything down so early !!! 
We lost power the other day and came to get food that would already be cooked and it was an HOUR before closing and half of everything was pulled and butcher was pulling all the meats and not ONE rotisserie chicken??? 
Again so much room to be the best in this hood and you are failing at it... Why so different then the one in the gulch???? 
So much better and more options then here why??????? 
I can not get to Whole Foods and you are right by my house.  It's frustrating.  You need a better person doing the self serve food choices and you need more options in the butcher area and you need to do more of what your doing in the gulch and pls stop closing a hour before the time ! So so frustrating to walk over with and hour to go and find everything pulled!

I usually find really good restaurants on Yelp, and to be honest I was iffy about this one, but I was tired, hungry, and definitely wanted to visit Fauburgh Marigny, so we gave it a try. 

I do think a two and a half rating is most appropriate, so i will round up because rounding down I feel would be mean, and there are a few things I like about the Praline Connection. They are:

+Location on Frenchmen St. in the Fauburgh Marigny. 
+Old charming upbeat atmosphere. 
+Nice waiters and waitress. 
+Service was decent, unlike most yelpers mentioned, they were not slow at all. 
+Crawfish ettoufee appetizer was small, yet delicious.
+Bread pudding was good

Here is what I didn't love:
-Fried chicken- way overrated. 
-Catfish- bland and barely a taste. 
-Cornbread- hard and tasteless

I would never return.

Tried this place after reading the reviews. Drive by this daily, they are pretty darn good fried rice is awesome! Pot stickers, and egg drop also well and the service was fast and polite. We will go back again think we found a good new Chinese place! They are a little "hole in the wall" place but those are pretty darn good!

What can you really say about a dollar store? I feel obligated to dictate some amazing ode about it. Oh Dollar Tree, you've capture me! From the dollar finds that blow my mind to the useless crap I know I shouldn't bring back. I'm enchanted by your many rows, every item keeps me on my toes. Dollar Tree, oh Dollar Tree! You fill me with so much glee. In all seriousness, it's a clean, no funky smells or overflowing isles to the point you can't find anything. It's my go to spot for things I'll only need once or twice like holiday items. This Ollar Tree (it was missing the D for awhile so I call it the Ollar Tree) has everything a CVS has but cheaper but generally you get what you pay for.

Fantastic Cigar shop. Matt the owner very helpful, knows his cigars. great selection. I visit Santa Barbara once a week. I always stop in. Has wireless - I do some work while smoking a good cigar. I have never been disappointed.

Good sushi and good service. 
 We got the Pan Fried Port Potstickers, Panang curry with beef, Lama Roll, Tornado Roll and Crunchy Salmon Roll
We got the 3 signature rolls for $30 and were very pleased by the selection and quality.  
The Tornado Roll was the best tasting, second best was the Crunchy Salmon, a distant third place was the Lama Roll (simply because it seems to have too much cream cheese that took away from taste of the  tuna and salmon) 
We also tried a thai dish, the Panany curry.  This was my least favorite this everning.  I thought the sauce seemed too thick, too much peanut butter taste, not enough sweet tasting.  I have a sweet tooth so my opinion here might not be shared by anyone else. 
Restaurant overall has a very nice quiet atmosphere, everything is new, seats are comfortable. The service is nice and prompt.

This isn't even our normal vet, but they have a fantastic app (Medici) that allowed us to have a consultation through the app (on a weekend even!) and get medication called in for our dog instead of having to decide between waiting till normal business hours or go to an emergency vet. Dr. Smiley is great and we are so appreciative of him and the ability to be able to get advice pretty much any time!

Probably the best (and only) cold shawarma I've ever had. The meat surprisingly was really good despite it being lukewarm. It was surprising because they have a vertical rotisserie that looked great but instead chose to reheat already cooked and refrigerated shawarma instead. Real Nice. Feels like a bait and switch. At least they smile at you while they do it.

They put things in the pita that were unexpected, like lettuce that while foreign, was a nice addition. They had a very interesting green colored tzatziki like condiment served on the side that was tasty and would have preferred it to be drizzled inside the sandwich and would have requested so if given the option.

I could have asked them to reheat the meat (again), or tell them to put their sauce on top of the food, but I shouldn't have to, and I don't. A lot of people, like myself, just deal with it and go along with our days. And don't make the same mistake twice.

The staff was friendly and quick, and they had a nice selection of specialty soft drinks.

Great store. Carries all pro lines. Staff is very helpful. Recently talked with Mike about a club purchase. Answered all my questions and looked up specs on the internet. Then suggested a lower cost ball that I find as good as the ball all the pros play.

PLEASE READ!!!! 3rd paragraph after this one is most important if you want to skip reading my entire review. If I help one person I will be content.

I want to start off by saying I understand this is a business. I understand they want to stay competitive. So when they increased my rent, I understand why they think they had to do it. With that being said, I wasn't going to leave a review but they're spamming my inbox for one so now I'm going to give it my honest review.

The gentleman that helped me seems like a nice guy. His service was great, and his communication was great. This review isn't on his customer service. This review is on Extra Space Storage.

Extra Space Storage really, and I mean REAAAALLY pissed me off. I got a notice in the mail that they were increasing my storage rent by $80!!! Their reasoning was to stay competitive with the market, and yes it's in the contract that they can increase your rent as long as they give you a 30 day notice, which they did. BUT I WAS ONLY THERE FOR 2, yes TWOO months. They reeled me in with their great rates, and once I was moved in to their 10x15 storage unit, a unit that fit my two bedroom apartment, they jacked up the price by $80!!! Read my first sentence of this review.... But $80 price increase after 2 months. That is shady. They want you moved in, they know the demographic, they know peoples situation, and they're taking advantage. It almost seems like they do it on purpose, like if I wouldn't want to move my stuff to another storage unit, but I'm not lazy. I was out of there in two weeks after giving my notice and paying my rent. Theres a lot of people who are exhausted of having to move into such a big unit that Extra Space Storage knows they won't move and just pay the price increase which is such a scam. 

I called a competing storage company, they asked why I was leaving, and I told them the truth. Extra Space Storage increased my rent after being there two months. And they assured me that they don't increase storage fees until at LEASST a year. 

I am now paying for an indoor storage unit that happily matched the same rate Extra Space Storage was charging me, but I am MORE than happy to have paid even $50 MORE than extra space storage to be with an honest company, and NOT have the feeling I'm getting ripped off or being taken advantage of. At the rate they were increasing my rent who's to say they wouldn't have done it again. 

Extra Space Storage is a TERRIBLE choice for a storage unit. If you don't care getting reeled in by a great rate only to have your rent increased after just two months by $80! That's a 40% increase!, then this place is for you. You've been warned.

I finally found a place in Tampa that tastes like my Mom's Cuban kitchen! Beef empanadas are delicious and the Coladas/Coffee are great too. I feel like I'm home for a meal, I can't wait to come back while I'm here on a work trip.

This is a great idea if you have visitors from out of town! It's a cool way to show everyone what Downtown Tampa is all about. They have quite a few stops along their routes and they even have an app you can download so you can live track the taxis. We waited for a taxi to arrive for over 30 minutes so we called and they were very helpful and even called us back to let us know when a taxi was on the way over to us. On board you can purchase water, wine, and beer. They'll also allow drinks in any Riverwalk approved cup. All the employees were very welcoming and funny, we really enjoyed our experience.

Only downside is that it's expensive. An all day pass is $20 per person which is very pricey. If you're planning on using the Pirate Water Taxi a lot, get the yearly pass. For $100 you get 1 pass and 1 guest pass which is good for an entire year.

Extremely delicious! Pad Thai was cooked great and the chicken and shrimp had tons of flavor. The server was great and checked on us just enough. My girlfriend had the beef and shrimp fried rice was that was another great choice. Both my noodles and her rice were cooked perfect and not overly greasy or soft. I also had a Singha beer which for Thai, beer it's good!

What an AMAZING dental office!  My son face planted on the tile floor at 8 o'clock last night and chipped his front tooth. I called their office at 8am this morning as a new patient and he was in the chair by 9:30am. Everyone was very friendly and Dr. Dan was amazing!  We have definitely found our new dental office!!  Thank you so much!!!

Very excited to try the newest spot created by one of the former owner's of Brandon mainstay, O'Brien's.
We had the margarita pizza to start and throughly enjoyed it. Nice thick, fresh mozzarella, but they don't put sliced tomatoes on it. I hate tomatoes, so it's all good for me.
The crab cakes are so good! So good! They are made fresh and you can tell. The texture is like a pancake. Must be pan fried them as opposed to deep fried. The ratio of crab meat to breading is perfect too; you can really taste the crab. Comes with a tart and tasty fried green tomato all over remoulade. Definitely recommend.
My friends both had the fish n chips. It was a big delicious piece of fish instead of little frozen sticks you get most places. I tried a bit and it was great. The guys both devoured it. Served with a side of coleslaw, fries, and smashed peas. 
The ambiance is a simple bar & grill with a fisherman's flare. There are mounted fish on the walls and dockside whatnots. It works for the proximity of the location to the bay. 
Samantha was our server and she was very friendly, helpful, and attentive.

I just moved to South Philly and am used to getting hair cuts in center city. Stopped in here a few weeks ago and needed a serious hair cut. Well, I got exactly that! They played Batman while I was waiting for my barber to finish another customer. 

It was an all around great experience, nice people, great waiting area and finally a great hair cut!
Hand crafted burgers, fish sandwiches, patty melts, sliders. Decent assortment of beer. Best sweet potato fries anywhere-- be sure to get the Chipotle sauce.
The deli is ridiculous six people in line and only one meat cutter and she is busy talking

I'm not sure if our night was an off night for the crew here, but nothing was very good. First, the live music just did not set the right mood. I get that they are trying to establish a pub atmosphere, but that's hard to square with an average entree price of $20. That said, the music could have been ignored if the food lived up to its reputation. 

Unfortunately it did not. The fish and chips missed on both texture and flavor. Both the breading and the fish were mushy, and the fish was severely under-seasoned. Again, either we went on a bad night for the kitchen or thee reviewers stating the fish and chips are "the best in town" simply don't know what they are talking about. The shepherd's pie was better (not saying much) but again, under-seasoned and just not what you'd expect from an Irish pub. 

To top it off, our waitress, while competent, was not exactly interested in our displeasure, which we were definitely not hiding. During my days of waiting tables, had I seen a guest obviously not enjoying him/herself, I would have made sure at least to inquire regarding the experience.
Great portion sizes, varying menu offerings. They were packed and couldn't seat us without a reservation, but we were lucky to find 2 spots at the bar. The churros were crazy good!

I have lived in Tucson for 5 years, and I have heard a lot of wonderful things about the Cafe Poca Cosa. I have been to the Little Cafe Poca Cosa several times, and had a great experience there. I understood that the Cafe Poca Cosa was the place to go for Mexican food in Tucson. Tonight, with my parents in town visiting, I went to check it out...and I must say, I was not impressed. The service was great, but the food was bland and uninteresting. It tasted like the sort of food that one would expect to find at an 'ethnic food night' in a retirement home. 

To begin with, the salsa was totally bland. It tasted like some sort of unspiced tomato puree. And then my entree (the Mole Negro) was a disappointment. It was boring and sweet, without a hint of spiciness, and the chicken was dry. I was kind of shocked. Really? Do you think that I am 90 years old? I mean, let me be clear. I am not the sort of person who thinks that all good Mexican food needs to be spicy, or who imagines that good Mexican food needs to correspond to some American construction of 'the authentic'; but if the food is boring and tastes like a dietary meal for the elderly, then it isn't something that I want eat, let alone pay anything for. 

Also, while the interior ambiance is excellent, I need to say that the paper napkins were pretty tacky and kind of ruined the vibe. A formal restaurant that charges $22 a plate really should offer cloth napkins. Am I having a picnic in a park? No, I am in a fancy restaurant that is too cheap to rent cloth napkins from a linen supply company. 

But that said, my parents had the carne asada, their dish was delicious. The spicing was sort of bland, but it had smooth creaminess that was very nice. They enjoyed it. Maybe I just ordered poorly.

I'm extremely disappointed with my experience here. I asked for them to repolish my nails after the initial job was done horribly. They informed me it would be a 25 minute wait to get my nails redone. The customer service is non existent and I won't be returning.

I couldn't have had a better experience. We always love it here, but tonight was different. I was mourning the passing of my best friend, and had not eaten in a couple days. My sweetie took me here cause I'm vegan and I love the options. I had a hard time trying to eat, but omg, the most amazing server William whose inner light shined so brightly got me calmed enough to finish my always delicious plate. He is a jewel and I hope his bosses realize that. I have worked in this bz 30 years, and I would hire him in a second and double his pay. He made a very sad night for me great by just being such a beautiful person. We will come back cause the food is awesome, but William is my boy! Even gave me a hug cause he knew I was hurting. Love you William and love Sukho Thai!

It's not worth the wait for a po-boy that takes over 30 mins . The sandwiches were ok !! I would just got straight to " butcher " .
It took us almost 45 mins to sit and then another 30 mins to get our food

My room was spotless!!! I loved the location and we had a nice view of the Arch from our room. There's a Panera Bread and a hot dog stand about a block away (not a hot dog fan-but his were the BEST)-this hotel was close to sightseeing AND public transit. The housekeeping staff did a wonderful job-it's a lovely hotel...I'm giving 4 stars because the front desk clerk had a bit of an attitude problem.

Had a great time!  You can't complain about the cover because the free beer makes up for it.  The music transitions from country to more dance at some point in the night.  My only real complaint is with the bartender.  She had an attitude all night, couldn't remember that I gave her two dollars for quarters to pay pool and was only going to give me one, and begged for tips that she didn't deserve all night long.  Complaining about not getting a tip is not going to get one from me any faster.  For the record, I did tip the waitress with the shots quite well.  She was very pleasant and the shots were reasonably priced.  Overall, good place to enjoy the night.

I'm new to sushi but have been to many spots as it's a family fav. Lately my wife and I have been trying on our own and finding things that we like. So with that said it was a joy to see Sake Don's opened in our neighborhood. After a great recommendation from friends in the 'hood we gave it a try. 

The staff was friendly and wanted to get to know me. They gave some great recommendations, we tried the Monster Roll, Rock n Roll, & Spicy Tuna Rolls. All were fresh and tasty. Even making them all with soy paper. (We don't like the seaweed wrap) The chili sauce was a bit much for me on the Monster Roll but I chalk that up to personal preference. I'd get it again sans chili sauce next time.   

The only thing we didn't care for was the gyoza. We thought it was too much won ton and not enough filler. The spring rolls were yummy. 

All in all it's a great addition to the family run joints on Jeff Hwy & Central. We look forward to more great meals at Sake Don Sushi Bar. Yeah you right!!!!

This is the type of business that I love to support.  Good food, good prices, and friendly service.  It doesn't get any better than that.

Tried the chicken curry (medium spice) and the lamb nihiri.  Both were full of explosive flavor, with just the perfect amount of heat.  The chicken and lamb were cooked perfectly; hot and juicy.

Served with a side of rice, and paired with an order of fresh garlic naan bread, this becomes a memorable meal that you are eager to have again in the future.

Very convenient to the loop.  Dine in or carry out... both options are highly recommended.

Delicious!! My sister and I came here for breakfast on a Sunday morning around 9am. This cafe is pretty small so I can imagine there might be a decent wait later in the morning. At 9, we were seated right away. The coffee was sooooo good!! Super smooth and just tasty. I got the croque madame and my sister got the grits bowl. Both were very tasty. Our server was funny and very helpful!

Food is ok there's lots of options to choose from but basically it's an over glorified Mongolian grill. My biggest complaint is service is always lacking their waitstaff seems bored and disinterested and good luck getting a refill, to go box, or anything once they've dropped off the check

Well this is first time I been out to Lunch for a long time, I when out with some guys from work and we when to a Pho restaurant Pho Barclay.  I was very pleased with the place.  Most everyone played it safe and ordered grilled something Pho.  Like one of the guys got Grill Beef pho number 62 and the others got Grilled Brisket Pho, and Pork Pho.  They all seemed to enjoy their dishes.  I on the other hand wanted to really experience the Pho experience so I ordered the house special which has our server described it, "it was once around the kitchen" or in other words, a little bit of everything: Brisket, Beef, Pork, Tendon, Tripe.  I was so glad I did.  It was a great combination.  The broth had the perfect in balance good salt with a nice bouquet Asian spice.
So when I received my Pho I added their homemade sauce, Thai basal, bean sprouts and a bit of the Sriracha sauce.  The combination gave the Pho some umami and a bit of backend heat.  The result brought the whole dish together.  Surprisingly, the Tripe was more taster than I was expected and the tendon was extremely tender.  This was another pleasant surprise.  The service was also good.  The Pho came out in no time and the portion was quite large.  I will definitely be trying this place again and will want to try some of their other version of Pho.  I would definitely recommend you try this restaurant; it is a great place for lunch, quick and easy.

Small menu but items are crafted and flavors will explode in your mouth (above all appetizers. Tried the roasted avocado, "especial" (lamb flatbread), eggamuffins....It's a small establishment , reservations a must. Outside patio where we sat was nice, service excellent (waitress "K" was knowledgeable and professional). Entrees are good. , the wagu beef  and the pork were our choices. no desert. For cocktail fans, this place only serves wine and beer.

Great idea but waaay overpriced. Just spent over $40 for 2 smoothies & 2 Salads & 1 cup of soup. Simple food ingredients that could be prepared better at home. The healthy "fast" food option is great but the "fast" is not accurate. It took over 20 min to get our food and I was finished my smoothie before my salad showed up. This place used to be great years ago but nowadays I walk away disappointed. I don't think I will return for a meal anytime soon.

I stumbled across this place. The barbecue was good the chicken wings cooked to order. The restaurant is a nice size easy to social distance. I did take out. The customer service is very friendly. Restaurant is off the beaten path so I do hope they get more business I had ribs and chicken wings potato salad and collard greens I enjoyed it all. If you're in the clear water Largo area please go support black businesses. I will be going back and will post more pictures.

If you are looking for corrective lenses, think twice before selecting this Lens Crafters.  The lack of customer service is not to be believed!!! Their approach is to not fully understand what has taken place prior to them getting on the call or to understand what the customer has been told previously but rather to basically blame the customer for the issue as a posed to work to correct and provide confidence that the product is of appropriate quality.  One would think that speaking to the Lab Manager, that there might be a little more training and level of professionalism that they would bring to the situation to help in resolving the matter, instead continued to further blame the customer and to imply the customer is the issue.  His inability to comprehend the concern and the lack of training of his part time staff to communicate accurately to customers is appalling, when, if it weren't for the customer and many other customers neither one would have the job they currently hold.  As a manger when dealing with a situation, the customer should NEVER feel they are an interruption to their work but should feel as if they are the purpose of it.  This 20+ years customer wont be back.

This is your typical extended stay type place with a full size refrigerator/freezer, a stovetop, and a sink. along with a "dining area" and "office area" in the same room as the bed.  The room was incredibly nice and spacious.  We stayed here for a week and found our stay for the most part to be pleasant.  In fact, we had to check into the Clearwater Beach Hilton later on for a company function, and I found myself wishing we were staying at this hotel instead.

This hotel features the Marriott bed, a foam mattress akin to a Tempurpedic bed.  I liked it so much that I'm thinking about buying The Marriott Bed off of their website.  It was by far the most comfortable bed I've ever slept in.  They even put a sheet on TOP of the comforter on this bed, which is nice, since most of us are probably wondering how many "stains" are on it before we lay on it.  

I've only got two complaints.  ALL of the dishes in the kitchen area had coffee grinds or food stuck on them.  I ended up having to wash all of the dishes by hand because there was no dishwasher detergent for the dishwasher.  Apparently they think you're going to steal Cascade should it be stocked in the room, and only the housekeeping folks carry it.  

This hotel has a free hot breakfast buffet and an event on the weekdays where they have a free dinner.  The free breakfast buffet was pretty decent, although there were days when the "hot" food was sorta cold and gross, and on the last day I found dried up food stuck to the plates for the dinner buffet.

Other than the housekeeping complaints with the dishes, this place was very nice and I enjoyed my week long stay here.

This Walmart wins the sucky Walmart award. It sucks in every way possible. Dirty, crowded, everything is damaged or out-of-stock, most of the checkout lines are shut. The shoppers here are not the problem. Nor are "EBT users" the problem. The people who work here are also not the problem. The problem is that STL is full of chain stores which treat certain demographics like dirt, while catering to more "preferred" demographics in other locations. It may be profitable. But how is it legal?

Furthermore, the parking lot is too busy and crowded to ride your shopping cart out to your car. And I think it slopes uphill.
Great place when Heather is working. I believe she is only there for breakfast/ lunch weekdays. Diner food with a Greek flare.
Decent Philly cheesesteaks here.  They pack 'em pretty good and it's a suitable option if you're hopping around South Street.

I did this tour with 3 other friends and all of us were EXTREMELY disappointed. We purchased a Groupon for the 3-in-1 tour and were really excited for this tour during our trip. 

Our tour guide, took us around different house and told us storys we took pictures and when we ask all of this happen in this house? He said no it happen 5 blocks from here but its out of our way. OMG we where taking picture of nothing!!!! Our group started with 28 and ended with 10!!!! My husband fell asleep cause the stories where boring Never again!!!!

Delicious Turkish coffee, super wonderful gyros, fast and thoughtful service from everyone's friend, Belal, and the foule muddamas and zatar bread are some of my favorites. I cannot understand why people go to the Wildflower over the Mediterranean Oasis. The food is so much better here.

I had the pleasure of dining at this restaurant last night before the Bruno Mars concert. It's a beautiful, elegant restaurant with a lovely ambiance. 
We had a very nice server, who took good care of us and we really liked her. She was extremely busy but didn't miss a beat.
Now the food. The food...was..amazing. First, we had the mussels and clams. I wasn't expecting to enjoy them, as I'm typically not a fan of red sauce. I was wrong. The sauce has a smoky rich flavor that inspired us to soak up every last drop with our soft, fresh bread. 
The lobster bisque was just as good, which I understand is made with the same tomato base. It was served with a scallop and caviar as garish. I will go back to this restaurant for the bisque alone!! Perfection.
Our steak was done perfectly. It was flavorful and tender. 
Over all, I highly recommend you try this steakhouse. Be prepared to pay a pretty penny, but it's worth it!

Good as usual. Got the cheese steak and it's very beefy just how I like them. You know your eating steak. Wife got the cheese burger and enjoyed it(even though she orders them well done). Kids got chicken fingers and the macncheese. We both enjoyed her Mac n  cheese. Chicken fingers were good pieces of chicken breast.
Tried today for the first time. Good service (Molly's the best!) Indoor and outdoor seating. Wide variety of salads, appetizers and mains. Must go back and try more. Especially for the ribs.

Although this did not take place at the pantano location, it took place at their new location on thornydale, the woman at the drive thru did say the shredded beef and carne asada had been brought over from the pantano location. My girlfriend and i went to go get super nachos from 3 betos tacos to find the restaurant under the new management of Jason's Mexican Food, we were told by a female employee that the meat in our meals was Jason's carne asada  and jason's shredded beef, and went on to rave about how sure she was that we would taste the difference. My girlfriend sure did. After a couple bites of carne asada my gf felt queasy, so she tried the rolled tacos with shredded beef from jason's and promptly vomitted. After helping her, i went to inspect the carne asada and found not of it to be undercooked but most of it being 65/35 gristle-to-meat ratio, enough to turn anyones stomach. I hope this whole incident is simply the growing pains of opening a new location or else northwest tucson just lost a great fast food mexican place in 3 betos and gained a fast food joint that makes people sick.

Ross Stores is along the lines of TJ Maxx and Burlington Coat Factory, except that it's more haphazard and disorganized, at least for this location. This store is the first in Central Indiana, and it just opened recently (October 2016). Perhaps they are still working on its operations and getting the inventory in order.

Just like similar retailers, Ross carries brand-name goods at discount prices. Expect to find apparel, accessories, footwear, and household items. The selections were just okay and I didn't find any compelling buys, although prices were competitive compared to other discount stores.

If you are doing some shopping in the Castleton area, you might as well stop by Ross. Perhaps you will find some unexpected deals there. Other competitors are nearby so you can always bundle your trips together.

So, I was in Nashville for a conference and before I went a co-worker advised me that there was one place I had to try: Las Paletas. Mind you, he had not been here, but had heard about it and seen it on a show. I am always up for trying highly recommended places and once I saw the Yelp reviews, I knew I had to go.

Two city buses later (which are actually quite easy to ride)- my friend and I were walking through Sevier Park to our destination. First impression from outside was "what a cute little block"- nestled in a newer building with some other small local shops. Second impression was the lovely and warm lady inside (one of the two sisters). Third impression was the amazing flavor choices and how delicious they all looked. 

I could not decide on one, so I got a canteloupe and a Mexican caramel- I wanted one fruity and one more creamy flavor. My friend got a watermelon and a raspberry chocolate chip. We wandered back outside into the sunshine to eat our popsicles and wait for our returning bus.

I had the Mexican caramel first and it was AMAZING! It was creamy and did not have a fake caramel flavor- very smooth. I quickly devoured that and moved onto the canteloupe, which tasted exactly like a perfectly right canteloupe! It was perfect on this sunny spring afternoon! My friend was also pleased with her flavors, which I tasted and enjoyed (but preferred mine!). 

I lived in Arizona for four years and never had a popsicle close to as good as these ones were. Definitely stop by if you are in Nashville, you won't be disappointed!

I had my front bumper replaced here. A few weeks later, the side of the bumper started coming off, so I took it back and they fixed it. A few weeks later it came loose again! They put a clip on it and hopefully it is fixed now. I was disappointed that I had to go back twice for them to fix the bumper when it should have been right the first time. I will not take my car back here again.

Skidders is absolutely amazing! They have great early bird specials at a great price! I ordered the broiled grouper which exceeded my expectations. It came with potatoes and broccoli which were super tasty. The whole plate itself was superb! I loved every bite of it! Didn't leave a trace behind. They have plenty of options to chose from on their menu so there's definitely something for everyone. Can't wait to come back. :)
The piercing artist was super friendly and we giggled during the whole thing. It was not painful at all. Yes, go there for your piercings.

I had heard so many locals tell me this place was good so my date and I decided to try it.
We had the shirache shrimp for appetizer and it was ok, my date said sauce was too gooey which was probably reduced too far. I agree.
like the heat but honey was too much.
my date had the seafood trio, sea bass was good but he hardly touched his tuna.
I had asked for shrimp scampi but received a blend of tomatoes capers peppers and onions over shrimp that reminds me of a sicilian appetizer Caponatina. it was good, but define try NOT shrimp.scampi. 
we both agreed we would try sushi happy hour on Tuesday but not dinner again.

Stopped by during a working lunch and was glad I did. I wasn't aware it's not a place you go to when you're pressed for time, but that staff was so accommodating with getting us our food out fast, yet still tasty and fresh. We both opted for the blue corn crusted cauliflower with a salad. The salad tasted fresh and the vinaigrette was light and tasty. The main dish also had sweet potatoes and other veggies. The atmosphere is an ideal date night or gals night out spot. They even have a $7 cork service so you can bring your own wine and beer. Best of all they have GF and vegan options!

My computer stopped working and I had no idea what to do. I dropped it off in the afternoon and picked it up the same day and it's fixed and working properly. 

Very professional and reasonably priced services. 

Would definitely recommend.

I usually go to a local place with good ratings and get horrible service. I think I am jinxed. However, service and food at Sugar Creek were excellent. Staff was very friendly and food was excellent. Waitress paid attention and kept drinks filled. We will go back.

OPA!! This place is as close to Greece as you're going to get inside the land-locked boundaries of the Hoosier state!

I've been going to The Greek Islands for the last couple years and it is consistently awesome. Recently I even had the pleasure of meeting one of the owners, Angela, whose passion for cooking and entertaining guests is evident. All of her recipes are passed down from her family and are always authentic and delicious. I try to branch out and try new things but the moussaka always calls my name from the menu....It's so good!!

It's hard to talk about this place without mentioning the atmosphere! On weekends, there is belly dancing and sometimes live music! It's so nice to just sit back and enjoy the show while you wait for your flaming Saganaki to arrive and the room to erupt is a joyous round of "OPA"!!

Kali Orexi!

All that makes Jacks great, and a better atmosphere!  I have not once had bad service here, most usually it has been exceptional.   Now if we could just get them to put a cappuccino on the menu...hehehehe

It's not that there is anything wrong with this place, it's just that when we went, I saw the beach, the flags and banners. I saw the sun shining down on the patio and a wraparound porch of the victorian house that is the Summerland Beach Cafe. I was ready to fall into some sort of wonderland. 

But the thing is, I found this place mostly mediocre. The food was bland, and the coffee tasted weird. The portions are big and the price is not exorbitant, but the service was kind of compulsory/scripted/over-anxious-feeling. 

You pay for water, which they advertise on the table helps save water, which is a good thing, but it's a symptom of privatization of water and made me feel weird. Delicious water, though. And it's only a dollar. How to decide?!

Stopped in after being turned away from a more popular restaurant in the area.  I'm actually glad we stopped in!!!  We were seated outside on the deck with a lovely view of the water.  The waiter was a hard working fellow Veteran, so we chatted about where we were stationed.  

I had a delicious sangria & ravioli stuffed with crab & lobster.  My husband had gnocchi, which I don't like, but their sauce had my fork in his plate several times!!!!  So glad he is a good sport when it comes to sharing.

This place was a pleasant surprise with a beautiful view at the end of a wonderful day.

Me and the wife went for dinner. She loves sushi I am not a fan. She loved her sushi. I got chicken and rice and tasted microwaved. Some of the chicken was crunchy and some was good. It was thinly cut strips of chicken. The pot stickers where amazing. I wouldn't go back but my wife would for sushi. That's why it got a 4.

With all the great choices on State Street,  we decided on Patxi Pizza spot. It had a real cool vibe. I had my 3 little ones with me along with my mother. 
Wait staff were super friendly and helpful. We came during lunch on a Saturday, so there was no wait.
So let me start by saying, I should not have expected more from a pizza joint. But, I'm on State Street,  so of course I was expecting a little more and again... I shouldn't have. 

For the kids I ordered..
Mac n Cheese
Build your own pizza
And a flatbread cheese sandwich 

Problem 1: there are no sides. Not chips, bread or fries. Just your order and a drink.
Problem 2: they advertised milk, but they were out of milk. So I  got apple juice.
Problem 3: paying $2 for a "side" of carrots and celery since there was nothing that came with these kids meal
The kids pizza and flatbread cheese sandwich was good. As it could have.
The mac n cheese was a very soupy mess. It was literally cheese soup with noodles. 

For the adults
I played it save: slice and side salad. I went with the butter lettuce salad with blue cheese, bacon and subs the butter lettuce with their field creams and ranch dressing.  It was good.

No Beverage, just water

My mom got the minestrone soup and half chicken pesto panini.
The soup was average. The panini was a little too toasted but not terrible. 
Beverage: "fresh lemonade"... NOT at first taste... you know the taste the moment it hits your tongue. That lemon concentrate juice from the green glass bottle. And unsweetened. They offered some Sprite to add sweetness. 

All and all the experience was okay. The food was okay as well. More misses than hits.
But it looked like a pretty good selection on alcohol so if your coming.to watch a game, have a drink and a slice, I think you will be satisfied. 

I would not recommend for a family looking for other options for their kids other than pizza. 

And remember no sides at all. No chips, bread, french fries... nothing
You can buy celery & carrots or broccoli for $2

May and team do a fantastic job! They are skilled professionals with years of experience. Language is not an issue as some of the stylists do speak English. Just come ready to explain what you want and they'll listen and execute. Women's haircuts can range from $25-30 (depending on length). If you want to skip the wait, come on a weekday or call ahead to make an appointment.

This company is fantastic! Use them!!! My dishwasher had broken, so I called at 8am (ish) and left a message. Within the hour they returned my call and set up an appointment for THE SAME DAY!!! They said they'd be here between 3 and 5; they arrived at 3:15. The tech, Jason, was courteous, incredibly knowledgeable, and fixed my washer so quickly I was amazed. He gave me the invoice and it was at least $100 less than I was expecting. I will most definitely be a return customer.

You walk through the dingy and smelly streets of Chinatown and find a gated door with a very demure bright blue neon light. A door with no name. You ring the door bell and out comes the bouncer and Mr. Lee, the Owner. He asks, "can I help you?" Your answer and the way you look will determine if you are in or not.

The minute you walk in, you enter through this waiting room. It is lined with books from floor to ceiling against a rich velvety red wall. I felt like I was  about to participate in an Alfred Hitchcock mystery game. Then, Mr. Lee ushers you to this grand and impressive candlelit room with a magnificent oak bar. I LOVE that the bartenders/mixologists were in their white jackets. I would have preferred to sit at the bar but it was full. So, Lee sat us at a table. I would have loved to have known a person who lived through the prohibition days and know what this place was like.

Our drinks were phenomenal. I ordered a drink outside of the menu - a Vieux Carre. Outstanding and perfect. I used to be a regular at the Ranstead Room till the 2 Daves left. So sad. I've been to Franklin Mortgage when it first opened. I loved it then, now its...ehh. I'm glad Hop Sing Laundromat opened. Mr. Lee was a riot! My sister and I loved his 3-piece outfit and all the accessories that came with it. So original, so classy.

We will be back. From one New Yorker to another...cheers! you did a great job Lee!

p.s. I would have loved to hear roaring 20s music as you walk in. Then, as the night progresses, move into more of a lounge music  (hip hop/house) from 12am-closing time rather that hard rock/honky tonk mix you had. It was fine but it was rather inconsistent and just didn't go with the theme of speak easy you were going for. Just a suggestion.

Oh man, it's really difficult writing this review because the hospitality of this mom-and-pop place was amazing.  I ordered a pizza and salad for pick-up and she talked to me with genuine concern about my husband's health (whom I'd mentioned was sick).   

So I preface this with saying that this review is entirely based on the standard "pizza and salad" order that I am always looking to perfect.

Unfortunately, the order - for my husband and I - left much to be desired. 

Pros:  The atmosphere and hospitality were amazing.  The sauce was delicious and tasted fresh.  The sausage on our pizza was sliced Italian sausage and it was amazing, I wish every place did this. 

Cons: The mushrooms on the pizza were canned.  There are few ways to ruin a perfectly good pizza quicker than canned mushrooms.  Since these don't bother everyone, I decided to overlook them and focused on the pizza as a whole.  Overall, the pizza was salty and the crust was so tough that it was difficult for myself (a 31 year old woman life-long pizza eater) to chew.   Also, the Greek salad had black olives rather than kalamata. 

Perhaps it's simply because I am of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtle generation that I have such a high standard for Pizza, but just the same: If I'm going to spend $22 on a pie, it better be better than I can make at home.  This wasn't.
These guys are great! Fast, clean, on time, and priced right. Heater went out and He offered to bring us space heaters until he could get the parts to fix it. You can't find any better!

I have enough money to order whatever I want, but I do not overpay unless my hand is forced. Let's put it this way: I almost walked out based on the prices alone. This is not a full-service restaurant. It is a counter service, industrial vibe place. There is no reason and no warrant for such a place to overcharge. 

Let's compare. I ordered a biscuit with sausage gravy. The gravy might have been walked past the sausage bin or made with sausage grease, but I couldn't detect any sausage meat in it. The flavor was fine, the texture was nice, and the quantity was sufficient. The biscuit, split in half, was a regular sized biscuit. Nothing spectacular, but then again, it was under gravy so hard to tell. $6 bucks. You read that right. I had water to drink. I considered the Five -- a $9 chicken biscuit with some extras described in other reviews. I decided these were Disney prices, and I wasn't in a theme park. Serve yourself sodas or tea are $2.75. 

Leaving Maple Street, I drove a couple of blocks to Chic Fil A, ordered a chicken biscuit with bacon and a large iced tea in the drive-thru. $6.30 with tax. No appreciable difference in the cleanliness of the restaurants and Chic Fil A has tables that are more comfortable. 

The employees of Maple Street were very enthusiastic, describing the options on the menu and asking if I had any questions, etc. I feel sorry for them. I really do. I don't know how this place is going to stay in business. I read that it started in Jacksonville, and so it must be a chain. Who am I to criticize anyone who wants to pay a lot of money?

I probably will go again at some point if it manages to stay in business, just for the variety. But I know it won't be someplace I go regularly because I don't like to have to gulp when I read menu prices.

Listen ya'll, I'm not a vegtarian but JUST TRY and tear me away from a Kung Fu Hoagies and you might want to check yourself. 

These guys drove all in on my turf for a weekend food festival and had my food nose radar standing at attention right away. I ordered a beef seitan Bahn Mi with a little extra sriracha sauce for good measure and was not let down. I tore into that bad boy like a 5 year tearing into a Christmas morning present. It was amazing. The seitan was tender, flavorfully sweet and in abundance. The roll was soft on the inside and had a crisp crust on the outside. The pickled veggies were tart and sweet at the same time and gave that extra snap that pulled the sandwich together deliciously.

A+ my friends. This is some good eats!

I had tried sauce on the side a few years ago and wasn't a fan so I had avoided it until recently. My siblings were in town and wanted to try it so we went for dinner. I tried the Which Came First and thought it was quite good. I wish the egg was a bit more runny and the salsa verde sauce doesn't pair that well with this calzone. My siblings enjoyed their calzones. Excited to try some of the other ones on the menu next time!

St. Louis dog is one of the best I've had. Chili is also excellent. Only thing keeping this from a 5 star review is the price point. 6.00-7.00 for an average size hot dog is a little steep, but you get what you pay for. Odd location but great lunch pick up option. They are quick and efficient in processing our orders and take out times. Give it a shot. You won't be disappointed!

If u could give 0 stars I would! Came here to wash my car, when I left and arrived at home I realized that my whole front driver side rim was scratched, clearly from the car wash machine based on pattern of scratches. Came back having to drive all the way from Costco area only to have been told it' wasn't there fault, insinuating that it was previously damaged! Why would I waste my time doing that pointless!!! Asked to speak to owner....and the manager told me to write a letter and Mail it to their address, and once a month when he comes to pick up mail he would get back to me! I asked for a number said they didn't have one for him! Makes no sense! Terrible! Now i have to pay 200! To get it fixed!!!

I've been looking for a good nail salon since moving to Boise and I'm so happy I came here. Tracy is amazing! I showed her what I wanted and she exceeded my expectations. I'm so happy I have a go to nail tech that does such amazing work. Highly recommend!
Our orders were wrong, waitress disappeared a lot, food was beyond bland. Not what I expected for an NOLA restaurant, totally disappointed. Don't waste your money

Seasons Pizza is usually pretty good. Up until this order, I ordered a grilled chicken salad along with my co-workers lunches at 11:30 am hoping for a 12:30 pm delivery. Their lunches arrived on time but mine was missing. I called and asked about it and they said they would send my order out now. About an hour later it arrived, the salad container had opened and spilled into the bag and the co tents where a mess. Also you can tell by the amount of condensation that the food had been sitting for a while. 

In the end I waited over 3 hours to throw a salad in the trash.

We had been having a manufacturing issue with a trailer that we had only owned for 3 years.  We finally decided that it was time to cut our losses and see what we could do to trade it in.  DDRV came to the rescue.  Shawn and Jim had shown us an Outdoors RV Timber Ridge trailer that is built in the NW for the NW, and a very solid trailer. We took our proposal to Shain in the Sales Office who worked his magic and made us a great deal on our trade in, and a deal for the Timber Ridge.   We have been camping in our trailer on two trips for 10 days, and we're glad we made the move to trade!  Thanks Shawn, Jim, and Shain!

I hired Clark's to aerate my lawn. Their prices are what drew me in at first. After I left a message they got back to me within a few hours and the appointment was set for the next day. They showed up on time and made quick work of my lawn. That's where the review should end right? I didn't have a lot of work done. Aeration is to the point. What really impressed me was the owners honesty. I over paid him by a lot  and wasn't even aware until he called me an hour later to inform me of the error. We met up and he gave me back the money that I would have never faulted him for keeping as I made a bone headed mistake. I will continue to hire them in the future for landscaping services not only based on services provided but the integrity of Clark's custom lawn as well.

I have been coming here ever since I was 16 and I am now 26. I have never had one single complaint on the service or food I have received here. Mariah has been a STAPLE at urban and makes me feel like family every time I walk in the door, the service this woman give is absolutely impecable, utilize this woman and give her a bigger position !! Beyond loyal and genuinely kind, know the employee you have because she is the best. Also being back here after a while and seeing the re model, I love it. Thank you for caring about your guests and eye view. Also meeting and having Vegas give us the utmost impeccable service has been lovely, thank you so much for the delicious forzen margs and phenomenal service, you are such a easy going sweet man. DONT SLEEP ON THIS PLACE EVERYONE. Go away Karen's, have some damn respect for those who are making this money for a living.

This is a true hidden gem of a diner. I had the Monte Christo and it was very yummy and I could only eat half of it!  My husband had a great breakfast plate. Very good and attentive service. Will definitely return.

Good place, good service but it's time they change up the menu. Holding the same items for over two years becomes bland and stale after awhile. If it's your first time wanting to visit, it's worth it to try out. If you are a foodie and like to frequent places, there are plenty of other options available with seasonal menu's.

Very cool atmosphere in a part of town that needs some commercial and retail updating. Unfortunately, that's where it ends. I don't recommend eating their food if you do go there. 

I jest, but I honestly, the food is missing the mark. There's too much good food in Nashville to pay a premium for this BBQ. My pork was so burnt it hurt to bite into. Most of those in my group experienced similar quality. The girl next to me had pancakes literally charred on one side!

I hate to say it, but if I see Smokies in 2016, I'll be very surprised.
Staff are rude and ultra hovery. In the end I ordered what I needed from Amazon since they won't let you touch anything anyhow.

Very good pizza , the place is small but the slices are large and tasty. I stop here when i pass through the area. the people are friendly and you can't beat the lunch special 2 slices and a soda for $3.99.On  street parking can be a problem at times.

I had an appointment scheduled for 7:45 am at the Horsham location. To my surprise when I arrived they were closed. A sign on the door told me to go to the nearest location. When I arrived at Abington location I had to sign in as a walk in because my appointment was not for this location.. my wait was 25 minutes as appointments are taken first. I explained to the tech was unable to explain to me why the location was closed no apology nothing .. all she was able to tell me was that alot of people are sick . What help was that to me I wondered . She was rude and very unprofessional,

This is really one of the nicest Starbucks I've been in. The decor is very comfortable, the Google WiFi service is lightning fast, service is quick & friendly, and the drive-thru option outside is a great option for people on the go. I'm not crazy about the location right next to the KoP mall, but hey, you can't have everything. Now all they need is a Tiki bar and a dog play area, and I might move in.

I highly recommend Silva's Small Engine repair. Bob took a look at our mower, which has been out of commission since last fall. The repair took him no time at all. Bob then gave the mower a good once-over and noticed it was running a little rough. Thanks to his attention to detail, the mower now purrs like a kitten and is ready for a busy spring and summer. It's refreshing to find someone who does business very honestly and who has such attention to detail.Very reasonable rates, too.

Great hotel for the price. Nice location and actual rooms. The only downside I found was the wait for the elevator after I checked-in since there were a lot of people getting to their rooms. They only had two elevators for the hotel. Since I was lucky to get a room on the third floor, I always left the hotel via the stairs since it was easier.

Had a Invitation to Come tonight 11/29/13  6-8:00pm for a special event of the Christmas decorations- Drinks & Snacks.   Sounded  like a fun event. What they had was a Cash Bar & checks Mix. After you bought a drink you had NO MONEY to buy an Christmas decoration....Very poor advertising......Seriously- a couple free bottles of Wine & some Cheese would have opened up more wallets for purchases....

Diane was wonderful, professional, knowledgeable and creative!
We could not have asked for a better florist for our Daughters wedding!
She understood our budget and look for the flowers.
We LOVED everything she did for this event.
I highly and confidently recommend Diane talents to anyone  who 
wants beautiful flowers!

We first tasted sugaree pies at Quincy Street Bistro, the apple caramel ala mode.  A crunchy brown sweet crumb crust on a slightly tart sugary apple filling.  Tho is the pie u eat if u have a true sweet tooth.  Perfect blend of sweet with slightly tart apples.  flaky crunchy crust, this pie is a non brainer.  Warning:  its hard to eat one slice

This is the closest Kroger to where I live and is convenient to stop by here after working out at the gym to stock up on "healthy foods", heehee. There is also the giant recycle bins in the parking lot which is helpful for me since there is no curbside pick up where I live. I agree with previous reviews that the produce department could use an expansion and face lift.  But overall a clean store with happy employees and visible managers.

Such a great taproom experience! I've been to my fair share across many states and I was so happy to find such a high quality example less than a mile from my home. Super friendly staff and multiple areas to accommodate singles, couples, and even families. Excellent artisan paninis to satisfy your hunger and they even have a home brewer supply section. They even have their plans for future expansion posted for the patrons to see as it happens. I could not be happier to have such a fantastic brewery added to my neighborhood.

We walked into this restaurant on a whim the day after new years and were disappointed to find that  they were out of almost their entire menu. However, the bartender had fantastic customer service. My boyfriend and me really enjoyed sitting at the bar having a couple of beers just BS'ing with her. We halved the hot sausage po-boy which was pretty good! We would deff come back to try out their menu bc everything did look and sound pretty tasty but also bc of the great customer service we received.

I don't know why I went to Hartford Coffee for the first time just a couple of weeks ago, but I'm really glad I did.

Hartford is nestled in the Tower Grove/Shaw neighborhood on an unassuming corner. I love the brightness as you walk inside - everything's yellow and just feels airy and happy. There was no live music during either of the days I visited, but I loved that Hartford has it and promotes the hell out of it.

Ordering at the counter is easy; I hate when you're confused about which end of the counter to order at or which menus you should look at in which order. The staff members are super friendly, chatting with you about the food or whatever crazy thing is on your shirt. The menu is pretty extensive for "just a coffee shop," and I found a ton of vegetarian options that sounded scrumptious. During two visits, I've had the cheesy potato (two cheeses and butter - fattening but so yummy!), the cheese quesapita (like grilled cheese, but on pita. Has onions and hot sauce - and my heart! So good!), a side garden salad (very fresh, and quite large for just a side), a chocolate chip cookie (basic, but tasty), and hot cocoa (again basic, but I liked it just fine, and it was quite hot). MAJOR shout-out to Hartford for featuring a vegetarian menu section on its website AND not having annoying PDF menus!

Prices were reasonable for food that was a level up from typical cafe fare. I think my cheese quesapita and side salad were only like $7. Hartford accepts credit cards and is smokefree.

I had my laptop with me for both visits, and the free wifi was adequate. There were quite a few outlets at that large table in the middle of the space, while there were only a few outlets around the wall seats. I got some stuff done, but I found it a little distracting because I was people watching and sound carried a bit. Plus I was chilly - a draft came in each time someone opened the door, and there was really nowhere to hide from it. 

Street parking can be cramped, as you're surrounded by residences. Walking a block won't kill you, though, and Hartford is worth it.

Hartford Coffee is in the neighborhood for several of my friends, so chances are I'll be back for more yumminess soon. I have my eye on that gooey buttercake, darn it.
Love, love, love the breakfast. The huevos rancheros and huevos con salsa verde are perfect!! We would eat it more often if it were open earlier!

I love diners. I love the food, I love the atmosphere, everything.

I'd say Peter's is really solid. The menu and the portions are huge. They have all day breakfast and lots of tantalizing desserts. Even the salads looked amazing. Generally I don't ever find myself wanting a salad, but theirs looked really fresh and surprisingly appetizing!

I thought I wasn't that hungry so I just ordered the Parisian crepes, which were two crepes with ice cream (I opted for vanilla) and whipped cream. I am a big breakfast and sweets person but I wasn't too impressed with my order. As I was eating it, I kept longingly glancing over at my grandma's Manhattan chowder, Caesar salad, and Alfredo pasta. If I ever come back here, I'd probably just order soup, salad, and an entree. 

Aside from my crepes, I did get to sample some of my family's orders - the most notable of which was my mom's eggplant Parmesan. It was the best I've ever had as it was very crispy and not soggy at all. 

I also really liked the New York style strawberry cheesecake. The strawberry glaze they used was good and the berries were good as well. I happily ate it and almost finished it until I realized how full I was.

All in all, I'm sad I don't have anything like this close to where I live!

I like/appreciate that they have vegan options, but they haven't "mastered" the recipes. We got a tofu bowl, which had a lot of stuff in it (radish, pickled cucumber, ginger, etc. on top of rice,) which was nice, but the tofu was extremely salty. It was a large serving size but there was too much sauce, and that made the rest of the ingredients taste less fresh.
You can make the kamikaze fries vegan (just ask for no cheese) but it's way too salty between the salt on the potatoes, the gravy and the ketchup. Maybe just ask for the sauces on the side? It was good but way, way over salted.  
I probably wouldn't go there again or just stick to the juice it up.

Also this was during adjusted finals week and there was one girl at the front and one cook so it took forever, felt bad she had to run around like that! Maybe management can reconfigure scheduling so that doesn't happen?

This one is as good as it gets!!  BEST DAMN MAC N CHEESE I HAVE EVER HAD!!  But really onto the BBQ... it is as good as pappys, it is as good as Bogarts, and those are both great!  

I had the brisket plate, perfectly cooked.. tender, juicy and just the right amount of seasoning.  the Mac n cheese, as previously mentioned, is to die for!  the apple sauce stands on its own two feet as well.  I cannot argue with this as a legitimate contender for #1 BBQ in the Lou... Well technically not in the Lou..  

And that is the only thing that I can knock on the place... the location is nowhere near anything I frequent... so I just will not be going very much... Other than that, it is great food!

It was a good day to be me- red beans,rice,sausage & Dixie beer !! The portion was big, but needed salt & hot sauce. I wish this restaurant hadn't been remodeled - the old Pearl was fun,really good groceries & was filled with Nawlins charm. I'm holding out hope that the "new " Pearl stays in business.

Went there for lunch.  One of us ordered coffee, one ordered hot tea. Went to get it and all the coffees and water were cold.  You could tell they weren't fresh at all. Asked them if they could make fresh and they said they would. Waited till after lunch to ask again. Told the lady at check-in that no one has gotten anything new since before I had my lunch. Pretty much was called out by a very rude woman. Said I was wrong that their coffee wasn't cold. A manage came out and said he was sorry but the was a microwave there if I needed one but that he had added some fresh coffee to the cold stuff and the was no reason it wouldn't be hot. It was. Lunch was good except the steak panini had one tiny rolled up piece of steak. Just too bad there's no pride in product or respect for customers here.

Love that this coffee shop is located in my neighborhood. Such a great atmosphere and the food and coffee are delicious. Service is often slow, things are typically not kept well stocked, today they ran out of clean forks and knives even though they weren't very busy. Most days I avoid going to the restaurant because when you leave you smell like greasy food. Also not sure why they often keep the terrible overhead lights turned on when they already have enough sufficient soft lighting.
Great quality and extremely nice people. They are supposed to get their credit card machine tomorrow (Oct 18).

The service was friendly but not irritating out creepy and the food was outstanding. The Muffler's had lots of meat, olive salad, the best ciabatta bread. The bread seemed homemade. The only negative was that the pizza only came in sizes for multiple people. No slices or individual sizes. They looked good but I was eating alone and they didn't have an option.

Oh my Gosh! Dined here on our honeymoon last week and it was worth every penny! The steak was cooked to perfection, the lobster Mac n cheese was great! The Chef's complimentary cuscus was amazing! The staff was kind and attentive. Definitely recommend.

Wait time in office is unbelievable! Still sitting here more than an hour past appt time with Kevin Shelby! Every time we come in, we wait at least half an hour but this ridiculous. And never an apology.

I can't say enough great things about this school!  I am an educator, and I looked around at many schools before I decided to send my daughter to Goddard.  My daughter LOVES going here.  The teachers are loving and supportive.  The environment is clean and safe.  My daughter is very well prepared for Kindergarten this fall and this is because of the strong PreK curriculum offered at Goddard.    I have always felt that I could communicate any concerns I have about my child.  I love that I receive daily communication about my child's day electronically as well as pictures of different activities that take place in the classroom.  I will truly miss our Goddard family!

My husband and I were looking for a reasonable priced meal.  Bitter Bob's menu pleased us both. We couldn't decide so we split a pulled pork dinner and a brisket dinner. Both with BBQ sauces. Lots of meat and good flavor. 
By the sides were very disappointing. Bland Mac and cheese,  baked bean melange that had an odd flavor, cilantro cole slaw that was very vinegary.  Delicious corn bread but it would have been even better with butter.   The service was great.  But I don't think we would go again.

Had a wonderful dinner with my girlfriend - service was very good despite having the power turned off because of some work being done outside.

We got the marinara with clams pizza and the mushroom pizza - both were fantastic.  The dough was soft and tasty and perfectly cooked.  They didn't skimp on the toppings for either pizza and unlike many places it was not too salty.  For an appetizer we got the clams in a ragout sauce - spicy but not too overwhelming.

To top it off they are a BYOB so we took advantage of that and had some wine and a couple of beers.
One of the absolute best restaurants I have been to. An absolute gem. Great service awesome ambiance terrific food. Coming back here every time I come through Boise.

This was my first visit to this McAlister's.  We arrived a little after 11, and there wasn't anyone ahead of us in line. We ordered at the counter, were given our table number and had a seat at a booth.

Our food was delivered a short time later.  I had a 1/2 French Dip, a 1/2 baked potato, and a huge iced tea. 

The food was ok.  Kind of fair to cloudy in weather-girl terms. The meat tasted like sliced grocery deli roast. Not a plus. The bread was decent and the au jus was as well, although it was on the salty side.  The potato was a run of the mill potato with melted cheese and sour cream on the side. The iced tea was stellar. I do love a good, fresh, cold tea.

I may return again with my mom. She steered me here today, as she really loves the place. Not awful, but not a New Orleans type place.

Got to check this place out for a Junior Yelp Elite Event which was a really great opportunity to introduce my Little Sister to the joys and perks of the Yelp Elite Squad! I was really impressed with how friendly the staff was and how clean the bounce houses were. My Little is 9 and has a lot of energy so she loved jumping and running around checking out all the games. They had plenty of seating for adults to relax (the brown chairs were sooo comfy!) and I could keep an eye on her no matter where in the room she was. They have great deals for moms groups and the coffee bar would make it a perfect place to relax while your little ones run around and socialize. They also have a separate area specifically for 3+.

Glad we got to check it out, we had a great time!

I did the online training and my wife had the in-class training. Hers took about 45 minutes including taking the test and she was done. Mine took a lot longer(a week) studying while working etc. The price for in-class is just a tad more but had I known the time difference, would gladly have done that. The couple running it are sweet and very helpful.

Excellent tacos and Aguas Frescas. I am very picky about mexican food because I cook it at home and I grew up with family that owned mexican restaurants, shall I say Tex-mex. This place has the best tacos in town and made my belly very happy. So glad I live close by. I plan on using their catering service sometime in the future too. Looking forward to trying their Tortas.

I went in the store today to drop off some packages, I already had labels on them and I was asking one of the employees if I can just drop them off on the counter as usual. He ignored me the 1st 3 times I asked him this question.  He did not even acknowlege my presence until the 4th time I asked him. If I were the owner of this store, I would have a chat with my employees about customer service.

Oh yeah....coming in at #1 for some damn good shrimp and grits in Philly area!  Now I've had many, East coast, west coast, up north and down south; right here is ranking right up there with some good old New Orleans cooking. A small little restaurant with wonderfully friendly staff and chef/owner. Today's brunch consisted of salmon and grits, shrimp and grits, and some pineapple upside down pancakes between the 2 of us (I know lil piggies right!).
