Oh yeah, how could I  forget about the free funnel cake fries! Everything was very good, lots of flavor! Will be having this one again, mos def!

Awesome food. Great people. Reasonable prices. You won't leave hungry. You need to check them out for lunch and dinner. They make you feel special. Family like atmosphere.

GIVE THEM A TRY!

One of my regular neighborhood lunch places.  I usually get 3 tacos, one al pastor, one charbroiled chicken and the other I rotate.  I've tried all the meats and they are all damn fine, but I agree with the majority, the al pastor is the tastiest.
The queso is pretty good, but the chips are hit or miss.  Today they were stale.  Yuck!  That's why you get 4 stars, Felipes.

It's cafeteria style, so know what ya want before you get in line!  

They carry Abita rootbeer and Mexican Coke!

They have their own parking lot, (or share one with a liquor store) but it's very narrow so watch out for pedestrians and cars pulling out.

My girlfriend and I had dinner at Commander's Palace.  We ordered the Shrimp and Tasso Henican, Turtle Soup, Pecan Gulf Fish, and an Alligator dish.  Given the reviews and the name of the restaurant, we came with very high expectations.  

The food was good, and we enjoyed it.  However, at the end of my meal I couldn't help but feel that I would have been more satisfied with another pork belly sandwich from Cochon Butcher (which I had for lunch).  And with the significantly higher price tag for a meal at Commander's Palace, I feel that a three star is where I would put the place at.  

On a side note, the service at Commander's Palace is definitely a 5 star experience.  The wait staff were very attentive, nice, and funny.
Love, love, love it!!! Saw this on Man v. Food and was not disappointed. Worth the wait in the rain!

I'll keep this quick ...
- Great customer service, always friendly on the phone
- Speedy delivery even during an Eagles game
- Food is great
- Prices are comparable to any other pizza place
This has become our new go-to place to order food from! Love them!!
Absolutely the best restaurant we visited. Food was awesome, cocktails were awesome, and if you have never tried gator Oceana is the place for a first try. Loved it

Don't even deserve 1 star. Severely disorganized. Trains constantly displaced for unknown reasons and must switch. 45 minutes added to the trip. You have one job. 

Express from thorndale to 30th in the am only has 3 cars and it's like a can of sardines I swear. Most septa employees don't bother checking passes because it's so crammed. 


Update: maybe try 5 cars instead of 4. Do better.

We had my husband's retirement party there a few weeks ago. The management (especially Reggie!!!) and staff were amazing. Reggie helped with all of the details, both big and small. Our waiters (Brayton and Mark) were on top of things and took great care of us. Our party was large and we were never neglected. The food...tasty as always. I would highly recommend this restaurant for a party of any size. Thank you, Southport Scotty's Brewhouse for helping us celebrate this milestone and giving us memories to last a lifetime! You rock!!!!!

Best chicken tortilla soup ever.  The chicken in it is better than the entree chicken at most restaurants.  The only reason I had to take a star off is their packaging.  I always get several orders to go.  They stack them on top of each other.  Every order I have gotten has had at least one of the lids broken by the bottom of the container on top of it and the result is soup all over the rest of my food and dripping from the bag.  Not to mention one less bowl of soup to eat.  Still the best.

Not what we had imagined. Long wait and food was average at best. During the wait we went to the bar and the bartender clearly had issues. He started an order and would move on, then back. Exactly what you don't want at a place with a long wait! The bar could have made it acceptable. Food still just average at best. Servers also made us feel like we were inconveniencing them.  What? Ok moving on

So so food and harried service. Two friends and I had lunch at the a Tap today. We shared some dill pickle fries which were tasty, but my Haystack burger was just all sorts of wrong. Premade burger patty with no to little seasoning. I ordered it medium must it was medium rare at best with absolutely no sear on the outside. So it was just an undercooked flavorless patty. Bacon was tasteless. It was just bad. Fries were good though. Service was equally off. Harried at best. Unfriendly at worst. It took ten minutes just to get ketchup for my tasteless burger. I won't be going back.
The worst whataburger imaginable. I went to the drive through and ordered 5 items and 2 of the items were missing, and they charged me for them.

After cutting my own hair for YEARS I finally decided to spend the money and get a real haircut. I cannot recommend this place highly enough. Right when you walk in you're offered tea or their (delicious) cucumber water by the friendly staff. I've been about 5 or 6 times and have had a different hairdresser every time. Every time I get my haircut I say it's the best haircut of my life. I always go in saying "do whatever you want, I trust you" and I leave looking great every time. It is pricey but in my opinion totally worth the money. They also do free (!!) bang trims and if you recommend a friend they'll give you $10 off your next appointment. This place is great!

Wow amazing chips so light and salsa was really good as well, our food was pretty good . We did catch the at the end of the night and were the last ones they were sitting for the night.  we were not able to have desert. I will be back because I heard it was amazing food, just think we caught them when they were all ready  to get out of dodge... we have that red chili pork enchiladas with green chili on the top and the Soli unfortunately it was a bit on the cold side but had good flavor, it was served with lettuce I have never had that I've always had it soup with cabbage was a little weird to me but.

This place is up a long flight of stairs. It's very possible to miss the entrance doors! It's decorated like a southern bar...very rustic. Washrooms are pretty unique too with 4 unisex stalls each individually decorated. It is dim in here, but that adds to the bar feel. 
I came with a large party (15+ ppl) in the evening for dinner here. It sounded like there was a mix up with the reservation, but they were able to accommodate our group without much of a fuss. They serve pretzels with mustard dip for munching/ while you wait for your order.
Menu was pretty southern and seems authentic. I ordered the group pie w/ pulled pork & collards w/greens and country ham. Dishes are served low key in metalware. For an appy & a side, it was pretty filling. Food does have s bit of a spice kick. Collard greens actually reminded me of spicy cabbage rolls in flavour. However, other people in my party ordered the fried chicken & donut which they raved about the chicken, but commented a waffle would have been better than a donut. Those who ordered the rib platter ended up sharing their food too which is a good sign to me that you get your money's worth here. 
Service was pleasant and attentive, server was mindful of little things like drink refills and providing cutlery without prompting. Bills were also able to be split up per person/ couple which was convenient too. I would come back here to try some of their other menu items too.
Good food and solid beer. I love the bbq sauce.
During a visit to the city my dog was not well.  This vet was concerned enough to see him and spent a great deal of time with us.  She has a great bedside manner and was very thorough

This place's appeal is entirely the aesthetic and patio. Came on a Sunday and it wasn't too busy, there were plenty of open seats and ordering was quick and easy. All the food, entrees and sides, came out cold (not not-warm, cold), stale, and bland. The signature cocktails are creative but the mixes don't quite work, and they're super sweet. This is a cute spot to come with a group of people or show off to tourists how trendy St. Pete is, but definitely not worth it if you're looking for quality food.

Was in town for the weekend with my cousin & had only enjoyed my making of the famous St. Louis Gooey butter cake. So I was looking around for places that both sold it & was open on Sundays. I came across this place, & it helped that the reviews were great as well. I purchased 4 slices to go as I was heading out of town. These were phenomenal, Gooey & buttery. Definitely will be back here when I return to St Louis.
I really like this place! I don't know why they have bad reviews. I have been a patient for some time and they have always taken care of my needs. I would recommend this place.

This is where God gets his burgers.  ...and his black & white milkshakes.  Some people don't "get" this place.  I feel so sorry for them.

This is my shortest Yelp review ever, because there is nothing more to say.

If you see God while you're there, tell him I said "Hi"...

Counter Culture was extremely underwhelming. The menu and prices are high-end while the atmosphere and ambiance and that of an Ikea cafeteria (cheap plastic chairs, bare walls, and flooring that is "interesting." They were understaffed, which meant our server was slammed, which resulted in cold food and the longest dinner of all time. The food was ok, but nothing fantastic. Portions were definitely on the small side and didn't really seem to match the menu descriptions. With tip, the bill came to about $470 for a dinner for 4. I can easily say it was the worst dining experience I've had at that price point.

lovely little hole in the wall spot in south Philly! 
the service could be better, but they were busy when we came here on a Friday night at 7:30. 
As many others have said, the burrata dish is to die for! I love that it is served with prosciutto and arugula. The perfect trifecta.
The grilled calamari is a nice change of pace from the usual overplayed and overly-fried dish, but I wish they served it with marinara sauce on the side rather than olive oil. 
 
The pasta dishes are huge! I had the bolognese and was pleased. The sauce is good but the dish is quite heavy. I wasn't able to finish it. The pasta was perfectly al dente, so A+ there. 
I love that this place is BYOB as well! Would love to try again, perhaps at their new Havertown location!

Ryan Christofferson is the best! Going into it, you have to know that they are students and have a process they have to go through (it might take longer than going into a professional salon). With that being said, the staff is awesome and attentive and I left just as happy if not happier with my hair than if I went to my normal salon (and paid $150 less).

Just like everyone else I came for the Hand Grenades.

No crowd on a Thursday afternoon. Got 4 of these babies to go (one for each of us, $9 a pop). They DO NOT skimp on the alcohol, but add enough sweetness to offset the liquor. Service is incredibly fast and efficient, though it gets pretty packed at nighttime (opted to try other spots).

Totally a place to stop by for a good "walking around" drink. Probably should limit yourself to one of these.

HIGHLY overrated.  I have been waiting to have the famous brunch here for four months and unfortunately it didn't live up to the hype. I pretty much tried everything from the jambalaya to the Bananas Foster.  At the end of the day, it was just a buffet.

This is one of those casual Old Florida places that specializes in seafood. They had several different types of fresh fish the night we were there. The fresh fish can be part of a platter or a sandwich or a Reuben sandwich. 

The ciabatta bread with the mango butter was delicious. I had the half pound of shrimp and the smoked fish dip and my husband had the fresh catch Reuben sandwich and both were good. A friend had the fish and chips which he said was good. Prices were reasonable. 

We went at prime dinner time during spring break so they were very busy and, not surprisingly, service was slow. Our waitress was friendly and hard working and she apologized for the slowness but we did have to wait a long time at every step. I think they wanted our table because she didn't even ask us if we wanted any of the key lime pie.

Absolutely delicious homemade ice cream. The store offers a million different flavors, including flavors from decades ago. They are also super accommodating​ with food allergies! Ambiance: the cutest little old-timey store in an adorable location of Philly, Instagramability: 5 stars!, Yummyness: every single flavor is exceptional!

This has become one of my favorite places in Nashville. My boyfriend and I live in the 12 South neighborhood, so we love walking or riding our bikes to Edley's. Blocks before we get there we are drawn in by the aroma of BBQ brisket calling our names. Get there early if you want the brisket though. They seem to run out everyday before dinner because word got out that it is so good. The food is reasonably priced and they don't skimp on the portions either. 

We have become regulars on Thursday nights since they started doing 2-4-1 beers.  They also have a great patio for people watching. The staff are friendly and the food and drinks are good, which will keep us coming back again and again.

Came back to update this review because Stacy is worth the time to do so for! 

Booking Stacy as our engagement/wedding photographer several years ago was one of the best decisions I made with regards to our wedding. Not only was she professional, skilled, and friendly, but she helped this bridal dunce navigate wedding planning and "day of" flow. She was amazing with helping us pose and also kept us laughing the entire time, making it way less awkward!

We received our photos back while on our honeymoon, so fast, and they are BEAUTIFUL. I have booked Stacy several times since our wedding for various photos including headshots, family porch photos, and dog photos. I could not recommend her enough (and I do, frequently, and friends say the same thing I did: she's amazing!) Recently she came to my neighborhood and did COVID Porch pictures of families to document this time in our lives. She only charged us b/c I made her do so- (and even with my pushing, she was very inexpensive for the short sessions she did)- she does photography for her love of people and her love of the art.

I had such high hopes after reading the reviews, but none of their donuts have any flavor except "sweet". I bought a cherry fritter for a friend and, after eating it, she thanked me for buying her an Apple fritter. I had a long John with brown frosting. I have no idea what flavor the frosting was supposed to be. It could have been chocolate, or maybe it was maple. I'm not one to give up on a donut shop after 1 bad donut, so I've gone back and tried others and I keep having the same experience. The blueberry cake donut was blue, but didn't taste, or even smell, of blueberries. The jelly filled had red filling, but you could have convinced me it was cherry or strawberry. Grant it the donuts are fresh. They have a good texture. It's just the taste that is lacking. Really, with so many donut shops in the area, this one isn't worth the stop.

C+

I was in here for a quick lunch bite and I was not fan of their pizza. The service was pretty quick, but was pretty much it.

I had the pepperoni and pineapple pizza and barbecue chicken pizza.

Pepperoni and pineapple pizza was really good, so I was very excited for my next pizza. The barbecue chicken pizza was very dry. The chicken was so dry that I did not even finish the slice. If I had to go back I would get the pepperoni and pineapple pizza.

Also they give refill for $1.

I use to go here often and enjoyed the food enough. However, they recently added a 10% surcharge to all items. This combines with cost increases a month or two back to now where item I commonly get is up 25%. I understand things are getting more expensive now but the costs on menu should reflect what they charge and not have additional surcharge.

It dubs itself a "Premium Burger Joint." I got a steakhouse burger ($6.95), herbed garlic fries ($1.95) and a beer ($2.75). I probably should have built my own burger, but it was entirely too confusing to make all the selections on my first visit.

The burger was maybe 1/3 pound. I got it cooked medium-well, which is what they suggested, and it's still got pink in the middle. Iceberg lettuce, gorgonzola, tomato, "special" sauce (some mayo/ketchup mix) and onion straws. The bun was Dave's special bun, a caraway seed bun, almost tasting like pumpernickle.

You order at the counter, they give you a number. You take a seat, and they bring your food when it's ready. I was there early, and there was just one other person in the place besides the employees.

In the dining area, there are booths, tables and high-tops. I sat at a high-top. Probably too close to the door, because I was freezing the whole time. There was music in the background, and a television on mute.

The fries were a huge order with mozzarella sprinkled on top. It was just starting to melt, so only the fries on the top got the cheese. They were tasty.

I cut the burger in half and still had to squash it to fit into my mouth. It was a kinda sloppy bite.

I ate half the burger and half the fries, so had another meal for the next day.

There's also a punch card. Buy seven entrees, and the eighth is free.

The restaurant is in the Bellerive Shopping Center just a little west of Olive and Mason, right next to Schnuck's.

We eat here a couple times a week. Don't let the fact that it is inside a gas station fool you, this place it top notch. The food is fresh and hot! It is consistently good and reasonably priced. I typically get the ham and swiss, my husband usually gets The Original. Both are excellent choices. Go ahead and add that brownie, too, you won't be disappointed.

This joint is like most other Chinese affairs in Boise.  Unimpressive  and predictable.

Service was actually good as was the hot tea. The salad was better suited for the trash can... It was served with something resembling French dressing.  It was iceberg with carrots and had clearly spent too much time in the fridge as pieces were frozen.

The Mandarin chicken was a bit over cooked but tasted ok as did the fried rice. 

On the upside the waitress was quite pleasant and had a nice pooper.

So far so good. These guys came in to spackle and sand new drywall that I installed. They also patched old plaster from the original build. I recently primed and painted the walls and everything looks great. About a month in and no cracks. I'll add pictures asap. Price was in the middle of the quotes received..very fair. I will use them again

Definitely not my favorite Mexican restaurant, which was sad because these restaurants in Muncie,IN are amazing. Idk may be different owners for this location, but the prices were a bit high for the quality here and the wait time was a bit much for such a mediocre meal. Probably wouldn't recommend this location and won't go back most likely, bc I luv Mexican food and have favorites elsewhere just gave this one a try once.
Stopped in here on an evening to try out a local place. Burgers were good, fries were very good! Service was quick and the prices are decent. Would definitely recommend.

Okay, I know what you all are thinking..ANOTHER BCD review...
I get it, I KNOW you all know, YES Aspin we know you love BCD.....
Listen up-- today is Wednesday...so you know what that means?!! its.......wait for it...
APORKALYPSE day!! Of all the times I've been and on Wednesdays I have forgotten to order this delectable sammich, so today-- i did! 
and after i was woke up outta my food coma, i decided to write this raving review on this sandwich...
It was soooo delicious-- picture this: garlic roasted pulled pork, topped with bacon, provolone cheese, pickles and boom boom sauce...(i know, right!?) 
have that with a side of Cape Cod waffle cut potato chips, a chocolate chip cookie, and an iced tea, and THAT ladies and gents, is the most perfect lunch in the world!

First off, if you want to eat soup in an oven or a sauna, this is your place! I came here because of the ratings. They completely disappointed.

Ordered the Vietnamese crepe which I've had other places and is usually life changing. This was completely off and tasteless! Also ordered a wonton egg noodle shrimp and pork soup. I figured it's the best of both worlds to have seafood and meat. I also wanted the wontons too. Total of two wontons, three small shrimp and three small slices of pork. This is mostly the noodles and soup which are the filler items. My pet peeve is of food like this is having mostly the filler foods.

My hubby had fried rice and pepper steak. I kept talking up Vietnamese fried rice to him and yes it disappointed. Everything was flat out BLAND!

Our service was ehhh. And again eating this food where it was terribly uncomfortable and hot here didn't help anything.

We have eaten at Taormina's a number of times.  The restaurant is always clean.  The service has always been good and friendly.  Now for the food, Always fresh and hot.  We have never been disappointed!

A regular haunt for me, this place has evolved into something Westchase can be proud of. Offering free pool, darts, and a card table, the drinks here pack a punch. For the Winter months there are strategically placed heaters inside and out. Next to the warm fireplace an array of games and a variety of seating options ideal for one person hanging out, or the whole gang. There's a fire pit outside where the smoking of a fine cigar is encouraged. While the Prohibition feel is firm throughout, I'm quite certain that Liz is making these drinks as well if not better than her illegal old school counterparts, and it's fun to watch her go. (Try my drink, The Gigi) Dave and the others make this place an absolute party every time but what's different about this spot, is that it's more class and less fist pumping than Westchase is used to. Feels like our cozy little secretive cave of libations!

What an incredible experience! Everyone down to the owner, Dominic, was so attentive. We had two different men taking care of us, Gino and Ty, and they were both so knowledgable and kind. For dinner, we had their specials - crab stuffed swordfish and pesto risotto with scallops, lobster, and one other type of shellfish I can't remember. As an appetizer, we had snails (not escargot, as they will tell you). All of it was just amazing. Ty suggested we soak our bread in the olive oil mixture that came with the snails and let me tell you what; that just may have changed my heckin' life. It's a nice place without being pretentious and a great atmosphere for any occasion. Thank you to everyone at Dominic's for making our visit something to remember.

I absolutely LOVE that u can wait in your car now. I always felt like I was in the way of shoppers when I waited inside. Time seems to pass by quickly when u are able to chill in ur car and listen to your own music. The store is a really nice clean store. Employees are nice.

I am new to Yelp - so not sure how this works? But, suffice it to say I am a huge fan of World Market. The international flare and flavor of everything from décor to food is amazing - all in one spot. They  have truly unique items, decent prices, and stellar sales. 

Having both grown up in Europe, my husband and I appreciate the culinary goodies and brands (such as RitterSport, Milka, Kinder, Bhalsa) that we grew up with. They have high quality cooking oils, coffees, and specialty goods. 

I love the linens, bath items, candles and knick knacks too. We shop here about 3x per month. 

One thing I will say is that their customer service (at least at this location) is superb. High marks from us.
Food is always good! Vegan friendly, used to come here all the time. Staff was always nice, always clean, and food is always delicious!!!
Passing by through HAD TO STOP! Not disappointed once again. Friendly as last time and service was quick and the foods was fresh !

If you asked me to truthfully answer whether I did or did not drool on my plate on my first bite, I would be forced to say yes. And if you get the chance to stop by, you'll understand why. We started with the burnt ends appetizer and were immediately taken back. I loved having a plate of my very favorite part of barbecued pork and it was done unbelievably well. For dinner, I got the pulled pork flatbread which also had green apples, bacon, carmelized onions, and white cheddar on it. So so so good - truly drool worthy. My boyfriend got the two meat plate with pulled pork (and he added a bun to make a sandwich of it) and meatloaf. He is a foodie/cook and still said it was probably the best meatloaf he had ever had. I'm not a meatloaf person normally, but I had to agree after tasting it. We also split a side of ribs - quite wonderful too. The extra sauces on the side were all unique and delicious and the beer list was extensive. I want to eat at The Shaved Duck for every meal of the rest of my life.

Tin Angel: YUMM, YUMMM AND YUMMM!!

Can't say enough about this place!  Just go, especially for brunch!!

Must haves are:  fried green tomato appetizer, stuffed French toast with a side of sausage

Service:  B+
Food:  A+++
Ambiance / clientele: A
Location: A
Price (you get what you pay for):  A
Overall: A 

Mom's bday brunch 4-14-13
Service and atmosphere, AmAzing! The food was pretty tasty, and the price was hard to beat! Check this place out!

So I get to sample items prior to purchasing?  Did I mention it is free?  Sign me up!!

I stumbled into this little jewel of a shop on my lunch break one day.  I spent close to an hour sampling and asking questions.  I wound up with a nice little selection of oils and vinegars.  I chose some for cooking and others for either salads or flavoring a finished product.  For those of you who think that oil is oil, you really need to drop by and do a little comparison.  You'll be amazed at the nuances and flavors.  Some are nutty, some are fruity, some strong, some mild - a plethora of choices depending upon what personally makes your taste buds dance and sing!

Another great perk is that you can sign up for their emails.  I've received a lot of great recipes from that.

I have been going to Therapeutic Massage & Bodywork on and off for a few years, but recently I have become a regular.  The owner is a really great guy and very tuned into his customers.  The massages are geared to exactly what you need and I could not feel any better every time I come away from a massage with Don.  

I would recommend this business for anyone that wants a massage for fun or for more serious reasons.

Great dinner.  My son and I went to try after driving by many times.  Everything was wonderful.  The Red Curry chicken was fabulous.  The fantasy duck was so flavorful.  The service was friendly.  Just a great time.

I am going on my third time in two months I have ordered from here. Reminds me of Brooklyn. Thankfully they ARE from Brooklyn. I have had the oxtail, jerk pork, patties, etc. No complaints. None. Keeping this restaurant in my rotation.

These guys are awesome.  On my first visit, I had an oil change and because of the great service I came back two days later when my engine light would  not turn off.  A test was administered to see if the alternator or the battery was the culprit.  It was discovered, however, that the alternator needed replacement along with an accompanying part and the serpentine belt.  In the end, the manager did not charge me for the alternator because of a prior test that was inaccurate.  I can't tell you how much I appreciate that gesture.  It goes to show how honest and customer-oriented A&A Auto Repair is.  As a result, I plan on bringing my car here in the future for any mechanical needs.
Welcome to the hood! Anxiously awaited a neighborhood bar/restaurant in this side of town. Beautiful water views.... super friendly staff! We are quickly becoming regulars.
My favorite restaurant in Boise! I love it here! The fish is always so good and fresh.
A phenomenal shop with a bright and classy team to help you decide which Hermes scarf to buy (pink!). Well organized and very nice selection.

Wanted to get a good pizza via Uber Eats, and decided to order from here since its close to where I live and hadn't tried it yet. Ordered the Spinaci pizza, which had spinach, onion, garlic, mozz, ricotta, and more! It was DELICIOUS. Seriously one of the best pizzas I've had, and I've had a lot of pizza! 

Atmosphere: haven't personally dined in ever, but its mostly a pick-up kinda place with some seating for 1-2 and larger parties as well. Casual environment

Food: My pizza was warm, crispy crust, beyond cheesy, and I'm talking gourmet-level cheesy, like someone went to Whole Foods and bought the entire cheese section of GMO, gluten-free, etc. kinda cheeses! Absolutely delicious. Creamy ricotta, fresh mozz, tasty spinach. 

Service: VERY accommodating. I called and asked for a side of olive oil, parmesan cheese, and crushed red pepper. The guy that answered filled up side-cups to the brim and included them in the box! 

Pro tip - pick up pizza for date night and enjoy in the comfort of your home with some wine or beers!
I love this place soo much the owner is wonderful I love her. I appreciate her soo much... AEWSOME!!!!!

I am doing this review both on the bar, and the tour. Tour first: my friend and I walked in one afternoon. We were greeted and given a sample. We waited at the bar and had a beer. The bartender was friendly. Our tour was given by a guy whos name i forget. Excuse me if I'm rude but all I can say is he was a very large man. Anyway, he made the tour awesome! I've been on a couple brew tours where they're kind of boring, but this guy was great. I like that yards tour lets you try more beer as u go thru as well. I like how small it is and I often order yards just to show some Philly love when I'm out because it was a good experience. 

As for the bar: I didn't eat but from what I saw it's typical bar food and yards beer. Simple stuff. I even bought a yards sign to put in my place. 

My friend comes in from chicago and I'll be taking her here.

From the moment we arrived here it was a very unpleasant experience. First time to New Orleans and in the heat of Mardi Gras, I understand that places can get busy but the attitude of the staff and service was ridiculous! I worked at Marriott for years and know good customer service and this wasn't the place for it . I'm not a picky person and not one to complain at all but I will probably NEVER stay at a Westin again! When we arrived, the bellman was arguing with the valet being so unprofessional I was just irritated they were actually having this conversation right in front of me. In regards to the front desk & reservations - We paid for the rooms upfront, called to say we were arriving late and they said "it will not be a problem." But because we arrived at the hotel at 1:00 AM (because of a late shuttle), it was "considered the next day" so they gave our room away which WE PAID FOR and said we were considered a "no show" because it was the next day. No apology, no concern. They said that we would be charged a NO SHOW FEE on top of it!!!  They didn't even offer to contact any other hotels to see if any rooms were available.  I had to ask them and they acted like I was bothering them do do so!  They called ONE hotel!  I understand it was Mardi Gras and rooms can overbook, but we were already charged for the room. They said if we stayed in the lobby, we would be asked to leave!! Unbelievable!!!!!  So we tried to make the best of it and hit Bourbon Street, but by 6am, I was beat! We waited in the lobby until they finally gave us a room at 11:30am.... again, very rude and no concern at all that were on the streets all night and completely ruined our plans the next day since we didn't sleep. We tried calling to talk to the front desk manager and even left a message for the General Manager. No call was returned!!!!!! NICE CUSTOMER SERVICE!!!!! DON"T STAY AT THIS HOTEL!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

Local customer, two visits (Friday and Saturday evenings).  New place, friendly staff and a good experience overall.  Good prices for Happy Hour and daily drink specials (their Irish 31 Red Ale is always $3.10 and It's a good red ale).  The interior space is a modern twist on the Irish bar theme and does not feel like a traditional Irish bar - then again, are there any traditional Irish bars left?  :-) 
Lots of large TVs on every wall and their exterior windows open to create a long indoor/outdoor counter space (for up to 20 people).  Live music a few nights a week - the two fellas I heard were good and kudos to the musician last night for asking the crowd if his volume was too much (it was a bit too loud and he turned it down).
Haven't sampled the food yet but have heard other customers expressing satisfaction with their meals.
It's a block off the main drag which likely hurts them on customer counts but also means they won't be jam-packed like some of the other places on Mandalay.  Definitely worth a walk through the parking structure to check out.

So I've been in love with Philly Fair Trade coffee since I started buying it at Pumpkin Market on South Street something like four or five years ago. After Pumpkin Market closed I hoped someday I'd be able to go straight to the source to get my favorite coffee, and now I finally can.

Worth the wait! We've been eating his food for the last few times we've been at Moto Sonora and it's always been beyond our expectations. The best fried pickles we've ever had and a vegan burger worth recommending to a friend!! Would highly recommend ordering from him, and I highly suggest ordering ahead online. He's only a one man show so give him a heads up on your order! I look forward to watching his business expand, and I know it will!!! Amazing!!

Quite good. Creative menu and OK ambience. I may have to say the dreaded term' for the area' there still is not a really fine Cajun place that I have found in West Chester/Phoenixvile. If only Cajun Kate at Booth's Corner was a real sit down...

Got takeout for the first time and I said to my partner, 'how did we not know about this place before?!' It was SO good! Fried tofu starter was like dreamy tofu chicken nuggets - impressively crispy, and not greasy. Drunken noodles tasted like fresh rice noodles, the veggies were fresh, it was awesome. I'll be eating here all the time!
Great coffee and desert shop.  Plenty of nice seating and free wifi. Very nice atmosphere.

This is the worst Domino's. DO NOT ORDER FROM HERE! All of the other reviews are totally accurate. Delivery takes at least an hour. At least. Staff is rude. Pizza isn't even as good as other Domino's.

My wife and I had a deep dish cheese pizza.  We had heard a lot of good things about Pi's pizzas, but we did not like the one we got,  We lived in Chicago and have had lots of deep dish pizza in our day.  The Pi pizza was lacking in cheese.  We have had thin curst pizzas with more cheese.  The sauce was good, the crust was good, buy you gotta have a fair amount of CHEESE on a deep dish cheese pizza.  Maybe the kids making the pizza that day were having a bad day.  Unfortunately, for what they charge for a deep dish pizza, I don't think we will go back to find out.  I really hope we just had a non-typical deep dish pizza.

Best gelato in Ventura County, haven't found anything better yet. Someone prove me wrong. A must have every time I go to SB.

Truth be told, the Gelato Chef is from Italy, you can taste it in their chocolate.

Continuing my beer tourism I saw this place right next to where I had dinner and figured, a brewery in downtown-ish Philadelphia, that's a must try for a West Coaster like me.

My main goal and review here is for their beer selection, which I have to say is good and unique. Ordering the flight was perfect cause it gave me a taste of everything on their menu.

Grog - This full flavored brown ale was really nice with some coffee overtones. It had a bit of nut to it and went down really well.

Ich Bin Ein Berliner Weisse - This drink was tart but crisp and smooth, not dry. As I found out later it is a unique style of beer that's not often found, I was quite impressed with it. The tartness was smoothed out by adding woodruff syrup as tradition calls. Oddly the syrup on its own is a bit tart, but mixed in with the beer, gave it light sweetness. I was a big fan of this one.

Picnic - A cherry ale, it had a great aroma to it and a gorgeous ruby color. The flavor was a sharp tart, which was nice, I think a sweet cherry flavor would have ruined it.

Brotherly Suds Volume 3 - This dark amber colored beer didn't have much of an aroma that I could discern. It had a good malty flavor and a bit of a bitter after taste, but not so much that it 'bit' you like an IPA.

Oakeller Pilsner - I'm not a fan of pilsners usually and this one didn't deviate, it had a bit of a bite in the after taste, as I find most pilsners do. To me it had the flavorings that a pilsner should, so if you're a fan you'd probably like this one.

Bullseye Bitter - This hoppy beer had a unique earthy/dirt-like flavor just as they described. Its unique but not bad. I'd have this one with a full meal, like steak, medium rare.

Bill Payer Ale - This one I couldn't find on their website, but it had a great hoppy aroma to it and great hoppy flavor. I would definitely drink this one again.

Rascal - This brown ale, I expected to be a bit on the sweeter side, but was greeted with a familiar hoppy flavor. It had a solid flavor to it and rounded out my experience.

*** Edit 2012 06 12

We did order the Jerk Mussels, a very goodchoice. They were plump and juicy and the sauce/stew was very good. Definitely had me nodding in agreement.

Overall, I like the beer selection they offered. I didn't find any that I would say are must have, though I highly recommend the Berliner Weisse... very unique. A good experience but didn't find that beer that would make me come back next time I'm around; but a good stop to make for sure.

Billy the bartender was outstanding! We came there for lunch and sat at the bar and from his first greeting to the rest of our dining experience he was friendly, professional, personable and exemplary. He was quick with our orders and serving us and then had great follow up. The food was good and came out exactly like the menu described. This is a pace that exemplifies what NO is all about. I highly recommend it.

Literally the absolute worst eegees in Tucson. I can't even handle the level of incompetence that happens here - right down from management to the person who cleans the floor. It's closest to my house and yet I regret going here each and every single time I do. Love the food, hate the bozos that work here.

For the price, it is pretty good.  The salad bar is good,  the "Chinese"
 dishes are good.  The Hibatchi Grill items are fresher than the items on the steam tables.  The desserts are good.  The service is good.  Nothing great, but nothing fair or poor, either.  It is big and clean.  And you can eat until someone needs to carry you out.  However, the four stars are for what it is.  It is a big chain Chinese Buffet.  If you are looking for pressed duck, you will be dissapointed.  You will leave with a lot more money in your pocket, but you won't find true Chises cuisine here.

I'm really happy to have Benna's West in my neighborhood. The interior is beautiful. The menu has all of the Benna's classics including sandwiches, coffee drinks, baked goods, fresh juices and smoothies. Oh yeah, and vegan soft serve! What's best is that this location has the ability to serve dishes beyond sandwiches and smoothies. Very nice!
What I don't understand: why have a nice iPad point of sale system and not accept credit card payment? I know this used to be the norm but you can pay with credit card almost everywhere these days, even at neighborhood coffee shops. Impose a minimum spend. CineMug is a block away and accepts credit card, so I'll be visiting them for my morning coffee and bagel.
Excellent food, great service and half-priced shakes after 8pm. :)

We just returned from dinner at the pub. We were a party of 5 and we're seated almost immediately. The food was quite slow but the place was pretty crowded. The food was pretty good, my cousin had a flatbread that arrived cold, but other than that it was good. The fish and chips were awesome, but I was told the burgers were not quite as good. I would say it was mediocre at best. I will try it again, but until then...I cannot recommend it.

Severely disappointed with all the high reviews here that led me astray since I was bringing two first timers for some NOLA food near our hotel.

The service was EXTREMELY SLOW. I get we're in the big easy but this went beyond southern slow to the point where it took 30 minutes for an appetizer and 30 minutes for a drink to arrive

The shrimp platter had zero seasoning. The shrimp were literally just boiled in plain water.

Shrimp po-boy came completely dry. Just a huge loaf of bread covered in crispy shrimp. No remolaude or sauce and very little pickled veggies to cut through the dense carbs. Sorely disappointed.

Only giving an extra star for the grilled oyster appetizer which was good. But you can't really go wrong with cheese and butter.

The bottomless margaritas and mariachi guitar player/singer were the two best features of the restaurant. Other than that, the service was lacking, the food is overpriced for the quality and quantity and the food really lacks flavor. My family and I came here around 8 pm on a Saturday evening. The bottomless margaritas are well done, very refreshing with the perfect combination of tartness and sweetness. The mariachi singer/guitar player was wonderful! Our appetizers took about 20 minutes and our main dishes took over an hour! It was really insane! And the waiter didn't offer any apology or explanation. He did come to pour more water and margaritas but didn't check in on us much in that hour of waiting. The food was not very good at all. My entire family agreed that their meals were all lacking flavor (including the soups). Most people around us were drunk from the bottomless margaritas so there was a lot of yelling and laughing around the restaurant. There are plenty of other Mexican restaurants I'll be going to around the Philadelphia area in the future.

If any of my coworkers found out that I was writing a 5-star review for Apron, they'd all roll their eyes and go "yup, we know." I have worked in Haddonfield for two and a half years, and after trying pretty much every place in town, Apron is now my go-to. 

The food is very much "my mom just made turkey meatloaf, do you want some?" Lots of home-cooked goodness, with a healthful twist. There's tons of kale and quinoa for the "food snob" in you, but they also have a good peanut butter & jelly sandwich (with apples!). The menu varies pretty regularly, with new quiches and roasted veggies every few days. 

I primarily come here for the soup, about which I am generally quite picky. It's always homemade and you can get an advance preview of the week's soups on their website. They even take customer suggestions sometimes. The split pea is always a big winner, it has fresh baked ham in it rather than those creepy cube things. 

The staff here is great; they are generally very friendly. They can sometimes get a little harried around the lunch rush, and you might have to wait a little. If you're impatient, I suggest you call ahead. They're a family business and love to chat it up if they know you. 

The only negative part about the Apron experience is possibly the prices-I've known multiple people to complain about how much stuff here costs. I tend to think paying for high-quality tastes-like-homemade food is worth it, so YMMV.

Real talk: I would not be going to this place 3 times a week if I didn't think they were freaking amazing. This is so much better than getting a slice of pizza at some crappy chain restaurant.

A dive bar that surprisingly served food. I had a beer while I was waiting for my order and decided to take my alligator po boy & cheese fries to go, but that seemed to upset her. Everyone else was busy drinking and I didn't want to be the only one eating. On a Saturday night they were way understaffed with one bartender/server servicing more than 20 people. Didn't notice me for the first 10 mins but I understand. But overall the bartender/server didn't seem very friendly at all, maybe she thought I wasn't going to leave a tip. The look she gave me felt like she would spit on my food. I wouldn't come back here again because I don't like to eat other people's spit.

I'm sorry...I think it's me, not you.

I have been here several times. It's conveniently located in the heart of Center City and being a big Korean food fan I was very excited when this opened.

To be fair, Bop advertised itself to be a "Korean inspired American restaurant" so I should not be expecting traditional flavors. However when there's an entire "Bibimpop" (bibimpap= rice w/ assortment of vegetables/meats traditionally served in stone bowls) section on the menu my wishful thinking led me to be anticipating flavors I've had at mom and pop Korean restaurants. I've tried both the bulgogi and the mushroom bibimpap, and preferred the mushroom one. The bulgogi bibimpap needed more...oomph. It felt like the flavors were technically there but just too timid on all fronts.

Not a fan of the Korean Nachos. It was fine, but I think the problem is when a few of the ingredients are clearly Mexican--which is ok logistically because it is a nachos dish--I inevitably compare this to good nachos I've had before and this just fell short. The wonton chips felt too flimsy to stand up to the other ingredients on the skillet.

The mandoo, on the other hand, I thought was delicious and visually appealing. Chicken wings--I've tried both the Korean fried and the chargrilled styles--are delectable. One thing I would say about the chicken wings here, they're always juicy and tender. As you can see, Bop still does many things right.

Service has been great every time I've been here and the happy hour food deals are excellent since many items from the dinner menu are served at a significant discount. The space/vibe is conducive to both intimate and group dining.

I think this place has a lot of potential therefore my rating is on the more harsh side despite actually enjoying my times spent here. Looking forward to giving an updated input in the future :)
Overpriced Burgers were over cooked and the flavor was not good. I've had better fast food burgers. I wanted a really good burger for Mother's Day and was really disappointed.

just finished my Postmates order from Favors, and i am impressed! ordered two orders of buffalo wings and one order of cheese fries; the wings were so throughly sauced and they added more wings than what was supposed to be in the platter (which i'm not mad at)! cheese fries were good, as well. could've been a little hotter in temperature, but i think that's due to the Postmates having them in the car. prices are reasonable, 10 wings for less than $10 is amazing & you won't find that price any where else. will definitely order from Favors again!
very large selection of frames, service can be slow. I use this place or goleta valley optical.... if you really want lots and lots of frames to look through before you decide, go here.

the beef and carrot soup is the best soup in nashville. the gyoza is fresh and delicious. Spring rolls are fresh and flavorful.

the 5 stars are pretty much just for that soup. I haven't really eaten anything besides these dishes.

make sure you bring cash.

Mike came out promptly and gave us a quote to install a new neo angle shower enclosure for our shower. Price was acceptable and we moved forward with the installation, the two workmen who came to install could not communicate with us because of a language barrier. When he  brought the large pieces of glass in on his shoulder he knocked into our chandelier and then our walls upstairs which took a chunk out of our door woodwork. I did not complain at that time.
My problem with Mike is the door moves, rattles and shakes when you open it, mike said I'll order you a bracket to go across the top to secure it in place. Ok great, that was acceptable to us.  However when we have texted or called to find out when he is coming to finish the job he is non responsive. Mike has not returned my texts, phone calls or emails and I now realize he has blocked both my number and my husbands. He has completely disappeared ! Unprofessional and rude beyond. Do not use Norristown Glass for any projects you have. I wish I had read the reviews on here b/c I am not the first to complain about non responsiveness from Mike.

If you're looking for quality freshly hand made sandwiches and hoagies, this is the place.  They have an assortment of Italian style hoagies choices with some other hot sandwich varieties.  

Ended up going with the Damaggio.  It came on a Freshly baked long roll which I see delivered daily every morning.  Had quality prosciutto and dry cured cap with sharp prov.  Not an overly filling jam packed sandwich but when you are dealing with such expensive cured meats it's more quality over quantity.  Also came dress with Romain (as opposed to the usual iceberg places have) thick tomato slices and thinly sliced red onion. A good balance but could have used a little more meat filling.  Also, went with the Cajun fries.  Spicer than our normal place for Cajun fries and the Cajun mayo was real good.  They seem to have it spread on different sandwiches which I highly recommend.  Wish the fries could have been a little crispier.  In the future I might check out a sandwhich called the crack as they had t shirts there for it.  You have to go old school and call the place because they aren't on grub hub.

Love this store: always helpful staff and unique gift ideas.  If you are looking for a specific Hallmark item that they don't have in stock, they will call around and get it sent to their store for you to pickup.  I appreciate that and their convenient location, and always friendly smiles!

If I were living in Santa Barbara, this would definitely be my go to burger place over In & Out. Great burgers, great fries, and great milkshakes. The holy trinity of any good burger place. I'll definitely be coming here again on my next trip down. Also, the fast service (even with a line almost to the door) was impressive.
Aaaaammmmazing!!! Staff is kind and welcoming!!!! Clean environment and the food was Awesome!!!

Finding a good wine shop is like finding a good hair stylist. Sure there might be someone closer or cheaper, but why risk a disaster?

I am not a wine expert. BUT, I know what I like. STILL, I need help. And the guys at The Wine Shoppe at Green Hills is ready and at your service. Tell them your price - and I promise they don't care - and tell them what you like - red, white, full body, fruity - and they'll give you several selections to choose from. 

PLUS, they print out a receipt so you can keep it handy and jot down which wine you preferred. 

And just because it's in Green Hills, doesn't mean you're going to pay more. In fact, you'll probably save money because the guys who buy are smart little shoppers.

A hidden gem in a sea of Northern Liberties bars. The Bardot staff is nothing short of personable, approachable, and knowledgeable! I've taken friends and family here and each time is better than the next. I've never seen it extremely crowded and the service is just always impeccable. The drink menu is awesome as they have crafted cocktails and a decent beer list! Let's not forget the half of drafts during happy hour! I haven't dug deep in the menu yet but the honey sriracha wings are well worth checking out!
Awesome slices at great prices....freshly made and NY style....huge slices....2 slices and soda for $5.....how can you beat that?
The salon is so clean, modern, and pretty. Hailey did my nails, and did a wonderful job as always! I will definitely continue to come here!

I have had a numerous amount of problems with the guy who we receive services from. He is always rude. Always leaving a note about the smallest things. Today's note entails that the bag wasn't tied. Not true, I tie the bag everyday. It also says leaking or loose trash. When I put the bag out the day prior There was no rips, he missed a day and of course the bag had been tampered with by animals. Now I have to go do the job that I'm forced to pay my apartment complex monthly. This is not the 1st time and there are other people who have similar issues with this little angry old man! Moving forward I'll make sure to not deal with any company that has a contract with your company.
As I've saw, my go to for C PaP supplies right down rt 73 for me. But shipping is just as good no need to go to store. The ppl although are great. Thanks

We took a trip to Lambertville for Halloween and truly enjoyed ourselves and course found ourselves hungry ...we attempted to put our names on a waiting list for a restaurant I won't name down by the bridge to New Hope, told we had a 40 minute wait so we went off to explore...40 minutes no text, 50 minutes no text,   we go back and get the runaround about being backed up so we canceled there and decided to try More Than Q....WOW...what a diamond in the rough !! We ordered pulled pork sandwiches (sorry no pics) baked beans and corn bread and there are no words to describe how good this was!!! Pork was cooked to perfection, smooth smokie flavor, juicy and delicious!! No sauce needed at all. We will be back here for sure and you should stop in and give it a try...you won't be disappointed!!

This is a "regional chain" but a chain nonetheless. The place seems sterile, like it should be hosting a giant boardroom meeting, not getting a brunch with a hangover. I needed coffee and a large amount of water. I ordered but my friends Bloody Marys came ahead of the coffee. But when it came it was the most watered down coffee ever and came with those weird cream container deals.

I got the "banana jackets" which was bananas in egg rolls for $10 but there was some sort of green substance on my plate when I lifted up one of the egg rolls. Delicious they were however, that gets you an extra star. Somebody at my table got these absurd "breakfast tacos" for $12 which had lettuce and a wacky fried shell in some sort of accordion shape.

Slow service. Couldn't get my hideous water coffee refilled. Bloody Marys were fine.

3 1/2+ stars... always good variety of nursery products & pet supplies... but the Chinden location is best for outdoor plants. Indoor plants do always seem to shine at this location. Staff are usually very very friendly.., but they can also be very very unfriendly... like pulling teeth to get help sometimes... other times they r full of ideas & advice.....  I wouldn't rate this as very accessible as the staff never seems to help with awkward bags nor do they ever set their cashiers up w/adequate counter space... The bathroom is also small & the store layout is always slightly changing. It is nice that the aisles are fairly wide... but the displays are often in odd locations (& this was pre-covid-19 too.) So I do proudly support this local Treasure Valley icon... just wish their service (including more & better shopping cart options) would become more consistent.

The atmosphere of this place -- chalkboard with the menu specials, sunflowers, green apples, light, open, and airy reminds one of the feel-good, save-the-earth vibe of Ikea.
Inside it gets very crowded and noisy. Very hard to have a conversation without shouting and trying not to listen to your neighbors'.
The best bet is to sit outside, and look at the lovely Spruce St. brownstones, while dining on flat breads and the like. 
The food is pretty good, interesting (have had ostrich as a daily special) and the waiters attentive.

The food was alright... I've definitely have had better Thai food (but then again, I come from Southern California). Atmosphere was classy and felt very intimate. It's on the more expensive side for Thai food, but I guess the "fusionness" of the place warrants the price.

We had heard such good things about this place and were really hoping to love it. Sadly though, it was a below average experience mainly based on food. Service was decent.

The beers were not very good - too sour or hoppy for the most part. I know they change their beers regularly so maybe we caught a bad day.

The food was underwhelming - no free bread for the table?! Each plate of bread is $3.5 which seems high for a few slices of cold bread which was not very good and butter. The cheese plate was underwhelming - the cheese was really good but there was no range and the cuts were tiny. And a tiny amount of extremely crusty bread with it. You are forced to order more bread. All In all an underwhelming experience.

My new favorite burger spot in New Tampa!! Burger was cooked exactly the way I asked, bun was toasted perfectly... Not my top choice of french fries but they were still delicious. We will be visiting this place very often as they have a lot of items on the menu that we are looking forward to trying

I love this place and food, but my last experience was dishearten, the waitress was not trained will at all. I asked for the stripes reward chips and dip, I opened my tab on my phone.She messed up my mixed drink in which she did quickly replace with the correct one.  After waiting about 10 minutes for so I asked for the chips and dip in which she forgot about. I ordered the steak well done and my friend order the soup and salad. My steak was undercook, in which I had it sent back to be corrected, and once brought back to me she stated her you go and walked away. I cut into it and it still wasn't correct, but instead of waiting several minutes to find her again, I began to eat, plus my friend was almost done with there meal. We order dessert, in which my friend order a refill on her diet coke, instead she received a Dr. pepper. She said ok and brought a diet coke without a straw. By this point we were not happy, I always tip 20% or more, but I could not bring myself to do that based on the poor service. BTW this was on a Friday in which I always on a Friday's or the Weekend!

Had been using another local plumbing group and had even gotten an estimate on the job, just couldn't get them on the phone to schedule and do the work!

That was by no means a problem with Mark.  I got a call back shortly, he visited to view the job and provide an estimate the same day, and was scheduled the next morning to do it.

He took care to make sure things stayed clean in our house, and put down drop cloths from the door to the basement so they wouldn't scuff up the floors.

The job was smooth, the results were professional and he and his help was gone within a couple of hours.

Next time I need a job done I'd call Mark, and would definitely recommend him to a friend.

Well I thought i was too old for places like this but... apparently I am not. It's like a 3 floor bar with music on each floor plus big crowds and a lot of sloppy stuff going on. But that's sort of what the broadway area seems like on the weekends in general and you could do worse than Tootsie's where the bartenders seem to be able to hear over the din at near superhuman levels. Truly baffling.

They've got a lot of awesome cheese options. They have great deli meats. They have fast moving lines. They have helpful staff. What? Are we still in Philly? Why cant every grocery store have employees that act like they aren't trying to get fired. 3 cheers for Di Bruno and their awesome staff. Its a pricey place to go shopping, but you pay a premium in this city for the service they offer.

This place is hands down better than those more expensive sushi restaurants. Coming from Hawaii this is the kind of place close to home and kind of affordable. What is up with putting so much in their poke bowl? In Hawaii it was so simple and affordable. When we bought this everyone kept looking at our food and I do hope they give this place more business. I plan on coming here more often

So I read my txt msg wrong on Wednesday nights they have buy one get one wings. I drove all the way from clayton Mo to get wings. I was greeted by a pretty woman. Told me to sit where I wanted. I wasn't even seated yet as a man approached me with a cold glass of water and a menu. The same woman that greeted me asked me if I was ready to order. She then announced that it was some guy Birthday there where about 15 of us in total n the bar. We all said n unison Happy Birthday! He then said, Thanks Kim! So with all that being said I was greeted by kim which was very friendly n made me feel welcomed. I watched how she interact with the customer thumbs up Kim!!! I don't get out much but if I do this is my new spot. Same time of course 5pm. She rocks so I know her staff rocks as well. Update had to take away a few stars for the food the cook doesn't have the same energy in the kitchen as the ladies do on the floor. We spent 60 on food n drinks. My fries were cooked so hard that they where stuck together. My catfish nuggets weren't done and my son chicken was cooked way tooooo hard. So it's a HARD PASS with the food and the cook that prepared it Friday 7/26/2019.

Not Philly style Chinese food - which is a positive.  No gloop!!  Go for the lunch specials.  For $9 you get either an egg roll or salad which are good size portions - particularly the salad, and, you get a cup of their hot and sour soup (really good here - probably the best part of the meal) and of course one of the lunch menu entrees.  It's a much better value and the food is good (not great, but good).  And, at lunch, there's no extra charge for brown rice.

Also, for lunch, ask for the chocolate dipped fortune cookies (they're free) if they forget to get them for you when they bring your check.

Overall, I think the food here is definitely one of the better Asian restaurants on the Main Line (although, that's not saying much for the Main Line area).  Maybe that's just because we lived in Vancouver, Canada for a while (awesome city for Chinese food from multiple regions), and we became too picky.

A better place is R & Z Ping Pong in Wayne (in the Gateway Shopping Center).  Get the dan dan noodles...they're good.      

Since my last review, that particular waitress who was always there at lunch and who always tried to charge us extra for everything is no longer there.  Service is a lot better now.

Purchased tickets ahead of time and arrived to find out that the concert has been postponed as of a week ago .  Not happy that they didn't communicate this to those  who purchased tickets beforehand.  Won't attend another event here again.

We own an apartment community and contacted Andy because we had a coin operated commercial washer that needed repair. Paid him $550 for the initial repair.  Turned out the repair did not correct the problem. Called Andy several times.  Same story as the rest of these reviews.  Promised to come back out but never showed up.  Stopped answering our calls until I called him from a phone number he didn't recognize.  He also said the machine was under warranty but we never got a credit or refund for the initial part replacement that he mis-diagnosed. Definitely will NOT use his services again. He is definitely not an honest guy.

I went to Verizon two days ago because of a problem with my G5.  Keenan worked with me to explore the options I had to repair or replace my G5.  Fortunately, LG had a promotion where LG brought out the remaining months of my 2 year contract.  Keenan was patient and helpful discussing different cell phone specifications.  I had a great experience.  Thanks to the Verizon staff at the BBD/CLR location.

This is the worst Wendy's I've EVER been to. Customer service was HORRIBLE, my order was wrong and  it took them forever to make my order. Every time I go the drive thru line is always at least 9 or 10 cars deep...they should consider closing this location are at least firing everyone in the store form the manager on down and start over...I will never go to this Wendy's again!!!! If I could give them a half of one star I would!!!

Often go here as it's become our local, and for the most part it's a great little spot.  The service can be hit or miss, but there's always a special on and the crowd tends to be the same easygoing crowd that it was when the pub used to be down on Jasper and 114.  The food is good for pub fare - wings and the Firehouse burger are personal favourites.

Fast, free, local delivery is a LIVE SAVER. Not to mention the selection here is amazing. They have the best dog foods and the frozen bones are my dogs favorite. So many quality brands to choose from and the people who work here really know their stuff.

My visit to this dealership was not a good experience. I went to look at a couple of used Toyota Prius's, which were ok cars. They were horrendously overpriced for having 80,000+ miles. They also claimed that they couldn't give me the value of my trade in because they 'don't see a lot of these cars'. I took my business elsewhere.
Local honey latte and a vegan brownie...heavenly! Quaint little joint in West Nashville.  Go get some goodness!

Today we visited here first time. We recommend better customer service for a Sunday morning after Thanksgiving. Only one person working and they put us on hold for 2-4 minutes with no return to the phone in meantime while I was waiting. And I did not prefer the attitude of the lady working behind the counter. Broad customer service was lacking.
AMAZING service by Zac and Stella!!! GREAT SERVICE! and the food is excellent!! My lasagna was amazing as well as the Chicken Stephanie ! Will come again every time we come to visit Sesame Place !!

I haven't been to this location- living in NYC but I did order my new Biologique Recherche regiment from here. After a couple days of my skin purging from the Lotion P50 and googling what to do (zero help) I called and spoke to Michael Wible who gave me advice I had not yet seen online AND it 100% worked- my skin is looking incredible just days later. Thank you for your advice, Michael! Feels great knowing that I have a skin care expert a phone call away.

Wow what an experience! Came in with my friend before open - not knowing they weren't open yet- and the manager STILL let us come in and tended to us! Among the great service and food. I WILL be coming back :) thank you shrimp wrecked to an amazing start to my Saturday! You're the best!

I am giving this deli three stars but it really is a hit or miss. The hoagies and wraps are really good and big. A few months ago we would get hoagies from here and they would be filled with meat and delicious.  Lately, they have been very thin on the meat. I had to order from there twice this week for two separate family trips. The first time great no issues. Today I ordered two turkey and american cheese hoagies and one Italian, I come home and open the hoagies they are all American hoagies no lettuce on them and they mixed the oil and vinegar together. Mind you this is after I told the lady on the phone multiple times turkey with American cheese. I swear sometimes they just do whatever they feel like.
Amazing customer service. Had the fish tacos....hated them , but no worries . They happily replaced them with steak tacos ! No questions asked ! Awesome place
Great Menudo.   The best I've had in Indiana!  Cool little salsa bar has good variety of salsas.  Try this plave gor the real deal in Mexican food.

Wonderful dinner! Six people for birthday celebration. Everything from drinks (bartender's bourbon special) to charcuterie and páte  and salad to mains (beef bourginon and striped bass were a hit) were delicious! Busy but not too busy so we could linger after dinner. Great place! L

I had the smokehouse double and a Oreo cookie shake with peanut butter mixed in and it was fantastic..Lynden was out waitress with lots of energy and a bit spunk..we had such a great time here and you would too.

I started a new job in Speedway so I'm trying out different places to find what I like. Stopped at Canton today. Paid $8 for a lunch sweet and sour chicken. The chicken was way undercooked and I had to throw it all away. The egg drop soup tasted burnt and I had to pay $1.64 for the crackers for soup. I will not be going back. Ever.
Great first time experience with Niven . My eyelashes look great and I got plenty of compliments and it is only the first day . I will definitely come back here
I stop in there at least once a week. It is always clean, and the staff is friendly.  I love the salads, and everything is always fresh. I would give them the 5th star if they were open for dinner!

Nothing to say about the flowers, they look beautiful, but the drivers are rude and aggressive.  Maybe you've got some crazy flower delivery deadline, but it's super unprofessional to see someone in a Grow With Us van slowing down traffic to curse people out.

I'll start with the positive: the food was very good. 
Ok now, let's go straight to the negative... service wasn't that great. However, our waitress wasn't to bad, up until the moment I forgot to tip her. You ask, "How does that happen?" Well... I finished paying my check with my credit card and the moment I reached into my pocket to leave a cash tip my finance says, "OMG, look!!!" What I see was a rat  (not a mouse, but yes a rat!) run by us. I watched it crawl up the wall onto the bar and in between the liquor bottles. At this point, we just grabbed our stuff and went outside. Not realizing I got distracted with the rat, I forgot to tip the waitress. We were outside stunned with what we saw, when the waitress came outside, upset and asked, why I didn't tip her. (First all, I don't have to tip anyone if I don't want too. However, if you deserve it I will tip you. It's the right thing to do.) Anyways my intentions were to tip and I did tip the waitress, but I had to point out that I got distracted with the huge rodent that ran passed me.

The girls are very friendly but the beds are always dirty.  I've personally worked at a tanning salon and know that it takes longer than 5 seconds to spray a bed and wipe it clean.  There should NEVER be crusted lotion on either the tops or the bottoms of the beds.  Either they need to train their employees better on how to clean beds or they need to get new ones.

I  was excited about tasting the local brew and hearing some jazz, as it advertises it's all day jazz. We went about 4pm and thwre wasn't any jazz playing. Also the flight comes in 4, 5 or 6. And you have to get the preselected beer, only 5 plus seasonal. You can't decide which 4 you want. Not a lot of choices for vefan/vegetarian. My husband had the shrimp poboy had flavorful shrimp and hard and chewy bread. The shrimp gumbo was bland and they didn't give crackers with it. I had the oyster club no bacon with chips and the club was tasty, I didn't like the chips but the hubby did and I ate his fries that needed salt and ketchup badly. I would give it 3.5 stars.

Been here twice for lunch and both times the food was BELOW average. In a nutshell - imagine the DMV or the federal government running a restaurant.....well, that encapsulates our experience. 

Yesterday, we first had the seared tuna appetizer.  It was evident, after one bite and a spine-chilling swallow, that the tuna had "turned". When we told the waitress she really couldn't have reacted more indifferent. Yes, she took it away and I assumed that we wouldn't be charged - but we "accidentally" were. 

The Bourbon (or was it whiskey?) Salmon was comparable to something you get from O'Charley's but more expensive. 

The beer (Chimay) was something they couldn't mess up if they tried (actually you could put it in a plastic cup and screw it up - which they didn't) and it was served in a proper tulip glass and it was chilled perfectly. The waitress even poured it with care.  

The food was bland to bad and it wad expensive for the "Sysco-like" food.  Food certainly not up to the standards of a restaurant group who owns Virago.  So, my review is 90% food quality and 10% service.  Service deserves a 1 star and food a 2 star.  Two strikes...

We were walking from the PMA to 30th st station and were looking for a place to get a drink along the way. We quickly yelped for anything with decent stars along the way and decided on Cherry St. 

Based on the reviews, I walked in expecting a sportsbar or a standard kind of dive bar and left feeling like i'd found something a bit more special. There's something incredibly charming and old-school about this place. Aside from the good beer list and excellent pub-style sandwiches and food, this place had a certain, uncommon kind of flair to it that I can't quite put my finger on.

I'll definitely try to come back if i'm ever in the neighborhood again.
This is great seafood very fresh and tasty... you get good bang for your buck here and will definitely leave satisfied

Like most people, I really don't like culvers food. I find the burgers are way too greasy and the other food a little dry.   

However, I generally like their custard. I think they have some creative "flavor of the day.  I especially love the raspberry cheesecake.  I will go 10 miles out of my way if there is a culvers that has this flavor on that day.

I stopped in today at this culvers for that exact reason.  First, I will say that the restrooms were not very clean. That always concerns me. However, the restaurant itself appeared to be well kept.

When I got my two scoops in a cone, I noticed that it was running all down the cone. The ice cream was melted   I asked the server and she said that is the way it is served. They mix the raspberry juice on the top and it runs down the cone. HUH???

I went ahead and took it because I love that flavor. So, I thought, who cares.  When I ate through the top of the melted cone, I noticed that they had not mixed any of the flavor in the bottom 2/3 of the cone.   It was only vanilla.  Obviously, besides serving melted custard, they have not trained their employees.  I don't think I'll be back.

We had a good time at Skull's!

We wound up here after wandering through Printer's Alley during a thunderstorm. They were closing soon but we were able to watch the awesome band for a few songs and enjoy a drink. The cocktail list here is serious. The service is extremely friendly. It's a classy vibe but you can stroll in in a pair of jeans and a t-shirt and still feel welcomed. 

Very very classy place to catch some live music.

I love visiting small, local bookstores and Back In The Day was such a hidden gem in the Clearwater area. They had a nice selection of books, puzzles, adult coloring books, tee shirts, and more. I was surprised at the selections because they had quite a few new releases that I've had my eye on, but didn't want to buy online. Local bookstores don't get the volume discount that chain stores and A**z*n gets, so I knew the prices would be full retail value but that's fine since I'd prefer to support local businesses when possible. I bought two books that I have on my TBR but I could've bought several more. Also, I appreciate that masks are required for staff and customers - I'd much rather shop at places that protect everyone. :) This is such a lovely shop and I would absolutely return if in the area again.
I have tried the Prime Rib now 3 different times and always the same outcome cannot cut it nor chew it. I had to go to the backup chicken when my heart wanted Prime rib

I've been coming to St Clair Square for well over 25 years now; primarily out of necessity because there isn't a decent mall within 40 miles or anywhere else in the metro-east!

SCS used to be a pretty formidable shopping venue. Over the years, though, it's gone down hill.  Far down hill!  Many of the corridor stores you typically expect to see in a top-notch shopping mall, have come and gone from SCS, leaving behind vacant spaces or second-rate trinket stores.  Some of the bigger department stores are still operating (Macy's, Dillards, J.C. Penney's, etc), but I can't help but wonder how much longer they'll hold out here.

My husband is black and I'm white. They served 3-4 other tables before us that span from 45 minutes. We only ordered 4 street tacos. While at the bar to fix my horrible drink I overheard the cook saying " now we'll cook the food for that table with the black people"! It was so discussing to us that we're now moving out of this beautiful state because of you and your racists employees!! We didn't call the news station but should have to show that this is happening and isn't acceptable!! Just like at Starbucks but so much worse cause I actually heard your employee disrespect my family!! Our server heard it and tried to make us feel better by telling us about how he grew up with a " black " friend across the street from him and isn't racist. We payed our bill and still tipped our server cause we understand it's not his fault but yours as a company that shouldn't accept this!! You need to fix this issue ASAP!!

Oh glory, glory! I have found a salon that is a perfect fit for me. The management was very hands on and made sure to make me feel at home. I was promptly sat and offered a drink by the manager himself. They have an large range of polishes, gel and dips. I was in and out in 30 minutes & was very happy with my nails. I will 100% be back. By far my new favorite spot to get manis.
Amazing. Our favorite shaved ice!!!! Loved the flavors, loved the condensed milk topping. Place super clean!

Our favorite sandwich shop, hands down. Super fast service and consistently delicious. Menu is great! Super fast service in-store or for delivery. I ordered a sandwich and a pickle for delivery at 6:04 PM, and it was at my door at 6:17 PM. Can't beat that! The sandwiches are consistently delicious. This is my favorite sub place. 5 stars every time!

I had a very nice experience here. The setting was nice and peaceful. The massage was great. It was head to toe including hot towels and hot stones. Everything about it was great. But I'm giving it 4 stars because as i was leaving the man at the front suggested a tip and that's fine, but i told him since it was already paid for through Groupon i didn't bring any money with me. Then he continued to ask me for a tip because the employees work very hard. So i said they chose that occupation so that has nothing to do with me and i didn't have much money to give anyway. So i gave him the only cash i had on me which was $4 and he told me it was a minimum of $10. How is there a minimum for a tip and i didn't have to even give you the $4 but he surely kept it. He had a nerve to be mad, then i left.

Cash only despite the fact that the printed menus say they take credit cards. But the service was good, and the BLT was delicious! I love me a really good BLT. Atmosphere is what you would expect from a small neighborhood lunch counter.

My parents retired in this area but we are from New York and I live in Manhattan.

I think the customer service here is even better than what I receive at the Saks in New York.
