I have visited twice and find that - if you are willing to dig a bit - you can come up with great finds.  I bought 6 items last night (2 dresses, pants, shoes...) and it all totaled to $158.00.  My last visit was also under $200.00 for about 5 items.

Debbie is my absolute favorite associate!!  I plan to write Saks headquarters and send my praise for her.
Way too expensive. Unfriendly service. They are not interested in doing anything that is not easy.

We come here all the way from New York just to have their cheese steaks and let me tell you it's worth the drive!! We always go for the cheese steak with onions, peppers, mushrooms and whiz, the whiz is a must!! I tried it with provolone and it wasn't as good. But I think you would like that better if you want something light and less fattening... The steak is nicely cooked and chopped and personally I love how they dice the meat very small since it's easier to eat and has a nice texture. 

The line can get very long and it can get very crowded but just make sure to raise your hand when they ask who's ready to order and don't be afraid to ask people if they are ordering since there may be people just waiting in the store to pick up their food. 

I would make sure you know what you want before since the workers do tend to rush you, as they gotta serve others as well. Also It's CASH ONLY.

Disappointing experience, not high on my return list for Thai food. Used to be a good, well priced place but it's quality is currently really suffering. 

Ordered pad siew, sweet/sour/spicy fish, papaya salad and some Thai sausages to pick up. I was told 25 minutes, and I waited at least a half hour past that time inside the restaurant. Peanuts were added to the papaya salad despite a request for them to be on the side, so I waited again as the salad was remade. At least she checked with me at the last minute? Turns out the peanuts are whole, not crushed, and are easy to remove.

As I waited I observed that the restaurant is probably not one I would choose to dine in. The staff are working hard to maintain the kitchen orders for pickup/delivery, and the dine-in guests are a bit neglected, as is the dining room itself. When I was there, a couple of well-behaved children were hanging out in the dining room, but they were unmasked. This simply isn't OK in the age of COVID.

The food was disappointing. The papaya salad was limp and soggy, but it was spicy as requested. The pad siew was really plain, lacking in sauce and just boring despite being requested to be spicy. The fish dish was OK, kinda soggy by the time we got it, but served with a generous amount of mango and chopped veg, not bad but not great. The Thai sausages were the best dish, which is maybe sad but they are a good treat at $1.25 each for a cocktail-size weenie.

Not worth a repeat visit: slow service, dodgy area, cleanliness questionable, food below average.

Awesome place we stopped for happy hour and it was happening here. While we looked at menus stuff noticed and offered us to try daisies before ordering. It was very helpful. Food got ready fast and everything was tasty. Def one of our new fav spots in Tucson.
The best!! I have been here multiple times and every time it's amazing! Quesadillas are really good and so is the salsa! can't go wrong here! Friendly staff as well.

Decent seating, poor lighting, drinks are OK. The manager here is a real piece of work. Rude to his customers and cocky (there's not much he's got going on to be cocky for!). They serve breakfast burritos which they microwave and charge an arm and a leg for, and sometimes it's still frozen while they serve you. I do not recommend this place. Boise deserves much better. Compared to flyingM, java, Goldie's, this place is a joke.

The "Chicago Style" pizza I ordered had an obviously previously pre-baked and frozen crust, collapsed and dry. Hardly edible and barely filled--NOT a Chicago pizza.

Every order I've placed with them (only one for a Chicago pie) has taken over 2 hours. 

This is a picture of a piece from a "Chicago Style" pizza. I asked for the works, including the stewed tomatoes on top. Notice the fall of the crust, lack of filling, and a "part" of a tomato on the top.

They used to be quality that I was willing to wait for. Not anymore.

Hash House a NO NO!  Thanks goodness we had a Living Social deal when we tried this place or I would have cried when I paid the bill.  This prices are high and the food is definitely about quantity over quality.  Even though this is supposed to be a hip place with fresh food and fancy plating, it seemed like the same service and massed produced casino food you'd get in the coffee shop.  The service we received was so poor, I felt like we were on Candid Camera.

Trying to find a consistently great sushi place is hard.  I remember years ago someone told me about Sachiko -- or at least this location 'the sushi place by Trader Joe's' -- and said it was great.  When I did a search this week on "best sushi" this came up on my side of Tucson so we tried it.

Going in, we were always going to do sushi... but I gotta tell you, their menu is so much more.  We ordered five rolls - Vegas, Mexican, Alaskan, Octopus and Spicy Tuna.  ALL of them were fantastic.  They started us off with miso soup and some edamame while we were waiting.  Nice touch since some sushi restaurants don't do that.  We polished off every bite.  Prices were totally reasonable, considering quality.

Service was outstanding.  They made sure we were taken care of, filled up our water and checked in often.  Looked to be family running the place?  At any rate -- I will be a repeat customer and might just try the ramen next time.

I absolutely love this place. Staff is always friendly and helpful. This is absolutely the best burger available in town. I am not a big fan of food chains, but you can tell that the ingredients are fresh and very flavorful. I just wish there weren't as many calories in the food. For all my out of the country visitors, this is where we take our people for the real American burger experience.

Decent beer list,  b+ mojito(fresh but small pour on the rum) .

The hanger steak is awesome, super tender for that cut.  Chicken tacos were hefty and delicious. Guacamole was fresh, but over-processed, i like mine simple and chunky.  The chips were cut from half a large tortilla fried,  which was nice for  pig like me because i'll eat a whole basket.  Brussels sprouts and bacon never does me wrong, great special side item.

the Bread pudding with bourbon, (which i took home and am devouring now) is fantastic.

The server/bartender dod a great job, especially considering she was running the whole show.  I'll be back for the steak.

Great food and service. A roast beef for lunch was the best roast beef sandwich I've ever had. On another visit the fish and chips were very good also. Service is usually good. Prices are fair. Lots of TV's for sport watchers.

Wow, how could anyone ever give a bad review of this place.  The waitress was excellent and the food was even better.  The manager even stopped over to make sure our meal was  great. Joscelyn the waitress was there every time before we needed anything.  I wish we had one in the Bay Area.

Persis is my favorite Indian restaurant in the Nashville area.  I'm especially grateful that's it's in my town of Mt. Juliet. The dishes available are diverse and tasty.  The biryani and naan are the best I've ever had.  There are lots of vegetarian dishes, too and the chana masala is especially superb. We get a lot of takeout from here and since Covid delivery is now available through Door Dash.
Dwayne has a gift that sets him apart from people around the world. I just wish he lived in my city or I made more trips to New Orleans. Thanks for a great massage and teaching.

On Oscars Sunday, I left the Moorestown Theater after seeing The King's Speech with a mission to pick up dinner. Pei Wei was convenient and required no further strategy as I simply had to make my way across the parking lot. 

Once inside, I placed my order; moments later, everyone else in Burlington County decided to come in and place theirs, too. I was feeling claustrophobic and annoyed, with the phone constantly ringing and a very frenzied atmosphere overall. When I received my food, I got out of there as quickly as possible and thought that maybe I had made a mistake.

Turned out, the food was all nicely packaged and generously portioned. Our lettuce wraps were crisp and the filling was tasty, with extra sauce served on the side. My spicy chicken salad was huge, with tons of chicken (also served on the side, so no sogginess!), and my boyfriend enjoyed his Thai Dynamite chicken with brown rice. 

I will definitely stick with take out in the future, and next time I'll place my order over the phone to avoid waiting with the masses.

Products used are absolutely amazing, but very pricey. Haircut was average. I unfortunately felt pushed to buy product, even though multiple times I said I don't need anything to add to the products I already have. The hair stylist also pushed extra services such as coloring. I will not return. I think they're best at fun coloring and curly hair - neither of which are for me.

I am going to give it a 4 and not a 3 because food was nice but with the expectation planted on me before my first visit this was a high quality place and my server could care less about that statement. We arrived and stood there in front of the server while she spoke with another employee, till I said out loud "Is this where we order" okay. Any place should have their guests feel welcomed and given attention to, no matter how quality branded they are. The food was tasty and fresh, we ordered the Cali Sandwich which contains my most loved ingredients like bacon, grilled chicken and avocado. PDQ will have my business from now on is definitely a better place than other fast foods visited.

Visiting Reno and decided to have some Asian food.  101 doesn't disappoint.  The decor was classy and pleasant and our waitress is very friendly.  We ordered Shedded chicken salad Taiwan style, stir fried rice noodle, pineapple fried rice, and ginger fish soup.  We didnt quite enjoy the fish soup, but everything else is delicious. The portion is huge and the quality is great yet the price is very inexpensive.  We also enjoy the leftover and still amazed by the quality ingredients they use.  The waitress told me the restaurant has been open for 9 years.  we will definitely come back next time when we visit Reno.
The food sucked and the place is rude. Not the staff. The rules of the place. Then I found out they steal tips from their employees. Never going again.

I have purchased 5 bikes from this shop for me and my family and a few friends. I would not think of going any where else.  I have personally dealt with everyone in the shop and being in the customer service business I can recognize exceptional service when I see it. My grandchildren will be the next ones up for bikes from Scott and crew. Support local business they certainly support us!!!

These ladies sewing shop is right next to my pet grooming salon.  They are always so friendly and with a steady flow of clientele they seem to know what they are doing! I wont be going to anyone else for my sewing needs!

Came in for the first time. Found hourly parking right in front which was convenient. Greeted and got the option to choose our seating. That was nice! Servers were attentive and food was excellent. The creme brûlée French toast was delicious. Highly recommend.

We absolutely loved it and can't wait to go again :) Everyone was so nice and helpful. The place was beautiful it's a very nice place to go and have fun with your loved ones. I have been there with my boyfriend and my mother they have both loved it and now we don't know where to put our paintings!

FIRST VISIT...

The ribs, though not cheap, were wonderful.

The baked beans were a great value and awesome.

My sole complaint was the portion of beef on the BEEF BRISKET REUBEN - perhaps it was 1/4 lb. for an $8 sandwich - and that the bread was barely toasted, AND THAT ONE OF THE SLICES OF BREAD WAS AN END of the loaf. Not happy about that.

Very few great new restaurants open in this area, really glad I checked Yelp tonight before hitting up a one of the safe bet's. The Brisket Sweet Potato Tots where killer along with the French Onion Soup Onion rings and my flat bread. Friend got the Steak Mac'n'Cheese and we where both surprised it was a decent cut of steak in there far exceeding our expectations. Drinks where great as well, the Old Fashioned was perfect and Tried a few others that turned out to be quite good as well.

Will be back and bringing more friends.

This place was great! I am not vegan, but travel with someone who is. My food was delicious, had the Rueben and curry vegetable soup. Good sized portions too. Grabbed a cookie for the road which I enjoyed later. Will definitely eat here the next time I am in Nashville.

Friendly staff but we didn't really like any of the cider options they had. Can't really knock them completely on that. The atmosphere was nice and clean, heaters were a plus on a really cold day. Definitely feel like I would've appreciated this place more in a pre-pandemic time.

It was one of my worst experiences ever I came through drive-through and they got my chicken wrong of course it was supposed to go to my son. Who is seven and they gave him hot chicken I quickly went inside the store and told him that they got my order wrong I told him I had no time to wait in the line and I gave her my order and receipt and told her I will come back when I came back they told me that there was no woman that took my receiptAnd gave me a sample of chicken to replace my inconvenience I am so upset that I did not get my meal. back
Chillout is a great place to go for ice cream! it will be a different experience for you!

Love Kayaking at Canoe Music City. We just went for our 2nd time and it never disappoints. The staff is always super nice and helpful. You can make a reservation without providing a credit card number which is nice for big groups and the pricing isn't bad at all. The only negative would be the wait at the drop off site to get into the river and the vans they transport you in need a little more loving. 

We always have a blast and the scenery is so beautiful. They have a 5 mile and 7 mile float, we've always done the 7 mile and it's perfect. Plenty of stops along the way to eat or relax in the water. I can't wait for our next trip.

Two words:  Bacon Jam
That was what lured me to The Shack at the recommendation of a friend.  Went with a few friends.  Shared an order of the fried pickles, which were done perfectly.  Really tasty breading and sauce.  My friends gave me a taste of the blueberry mojito and the strawberry lemonade (with bourbon).  Both were really good.
I had the JH Jam Burger (which had the bacon jam and a peppercorn aioli).  Oh..My..God that was tasty, messy but so tasty.  Had homemade chips on the side that were done perfect too.  Friends burgers and sandwich looked tasty too.
Our friend ordered up the donuts to share for dessert.  They're donut holes with sugar and cinammon on them served with a side of whipped maple butter and bacon bits.  Didn't really need the bacon bits and we all took turns dipping our fingers in the maple butter when the donuts were gone (screw cleanliness that stuff was good).
For what we got I felt the price was really good.  Will definitely go back!

If you're looking for something fancy...this ain't it. But if you want some good southern food or a hangover cure stop in this place. My only issue was there wasn't any menu prices. I kinda get the feeling depending on whose ordering (local or tourist) or what day of the week it is they'll charge you whatever they want because there are no prices on the menu. The good news is that it's worth it. I had a shrimp platter and the shrimp was falling off the plate because there were so many. My boyfriend had a fried pork chop with rustic potatoes on the side. He loved both especially the potatoes. All in all a great hole in the wall spot. Especially if it's close to where you are staying. Check it out you won't be disappointed.

Best po' boy spot Uptown.  Everything is good and consistency is the true sign of a good sandwich shop anywhere.  Also, the meat pies might be the best thing I have ever eaten.  I am notorious for complicated schemes to have them mailed, shipped, and smuggled back to California.
My favorite coffee chain is finally close by!  Love their coffee - it's not bitter at all!  Price is right and coffee sizes are perfect!

Happy happy joyyyu joy! 
I passed by this location the other day. I started to stop by that day but was too exhausted. So, today I stopped in for lunch. I placed my order online and noticed there was about a 20 min wait for the order. Unfortunately, I finished placing my order once I arrived in the parking lot. 

After about a 10min wait, I called the restaurant to let them know they could call my phone when the order was ready, as I was out in the parking lot. When my order was ready, I received a call to come inside and pick it up. 

That bag had the inside of my car smelling edible; with that or I was really hungry :)

I ordered the lunch Drunken Noodles with tofu, tempura vegetables, and tempura shrimp.

Now I would have been full from the appetizers, but I didn't know that when I placed my order. Everything was fresh! And delightful! Another customer mentioned all the veggies and main ingredients are listed on the menu. I was happy that everything listed with my order, was what I received.

I feel bad, I don't believe I have ever had drunken noodles, but I anticipate having more. I feel like a drunken noodle, as I enjoyed my meal with a glass of sangria (not from the establishment)

Great atmosphere, reasonable prices, delicious food, and nice staff. Definitely recommend the Ultimate Piña Colada, with coconut shrimp. The rice bowls and delicious, and the shrimp tacos were good. Definitely recommend!

We had a problem with our water pump in the back, and as a business that needs water, it was a great concern.  Mark took a look the next day, gave us an estimate that was fair and honest, and fit us in before his vacation!  The work was done quickly, with great care.  I don't think any recommendation would be overstating the job that Mark did.  Won't even look for other quotes in the future.  We know who we will go with.

Tonight I ordered two large pizzas.  One deep dish with extra pepperoni and one traditional the works pizza.  This was a spend $15.00, get a large one topping free so I was charged almost $4.00 for extra pepperoni.  I was disappointed that "extra" consists of 3 pepperoni slices on each of the 8 pieces.  This seems very stingy especially since one topping was free and the additional $4.00 essentially got me 16 pieces of pepperoni.  

As for the large pizza with all the toppings, it was sparsely topped and kinda greasy.  I don't think this pizza is worthy of the $23.00 price tag since topping wise, I would say it is comparable to Little Ceasars.  Overall, not horrible but not something that makes me smile either.  To be fair, in the past, I have had pizza that tasted better at this location so maybe they were having an off day (again) but the $23.00 sort of stings when you are faced with two greasy pizzas nobody wants to eat.

Hungry Howie's will have to work hard to earn my business back.

It was rockin on a Friday morning at 11:35.  I ordered a chicken breast dinner with potato salad and mac & cheese.  It was very good.  Home made mac & cheese, yay.  Only disappointment was they don't have bbq beef.  Took about 20 minutes from a line of 6 in front of me.  Ill be back.

I hadn't had a pedicure in over a year. In August I had back surgery and had been dealing with bilateral footdrop with accompanying parasthesia in both feet. 

I was curious to see if my feet would tolerate a deluxe pedicure and I'm happy to report that Susan did a wonderful job! The paragon wax was a nice touch! And the glass of Chardonnay! Sitting next to my wife and having  tandem pedicures is a luxury we've enjoyed indulging.

BTW, Angela also expertly took care of Melody's feet and legs. We'll be back. Just find the Grove and drive to the building nearer I-75. Then after your pedicure or manicure take in the Cinebistro or Outback Steakhouse or just shop!

Ah... Bourbon Street. You know it's gonna be fun when the street you're walking on bears the same name as alcohol, right? Been here too many times to count and with the exception of the "post Katrina" era, there's always hilarity and it's assured to be rowdy, lively and festive.

Always a cast of characters, guaranteed to amuse nearly everyone, with massive amounts of raging, drunken debauchery sure to be on the menu!!!

Plenty of establishments to grab a cold one, (Big Ass Beers, Hurricanes, Hand Grenades, the list goes on and on), listen to good "live" music, dance / twerk your ass off and / or eat some butt kickin' grub!!! Souvenirs abound via all the "gift shops" along the way...

But beware!!! As the legendary Jim Morrison sang, (and even though the metaphor may not fit per se'), "people are strange" and the "streets are uneven"!!!

The food was amazing! Everything tasted great. The service was not up to par. We arrived approximately 9pm. They started cleaning up before we were finished eating. I had to ask for a refill on my sweet tea and the waiter said they "ran out" and brought me unsweet instead. My fiancé had to ask for a refill on his water and they brought it back with no ice in it. It's way over priced as well.

Avoid CBH Homes at all costs! We bought one a year ago and are having major flooding and water damage issues to the point that our foundation is crumbling and CBH refuses to address the issue. CBH developments are notorious for water drainage issues. We wish we had never bought this house. We should have bought a Hubble Home instead.

You'll find a relatively large selection of used records and knick knacks. Clothing is so-so; they have a large selection of "nicer" thrift store clothing (i.e. no XXXL t-shirts, children's clothing, or ratty sneakers) and some vintage. The front of the store sells art, clothing, purses, and jewelry from Philadelphia artists. My recommendation is to check out the large selection of handmade cards.

Not my first visit here. But it is definitely what I come to expect from a Second Cup. I'm always unhappy to put up a three star, but let's be real. Three is average and there is nothing wrong with average. 

This most recent visit was an early morning Sunday, so there was very few people there. Lots of available tables and everyone was extra quiet. The cafe itself was very clean too, but I've never seen it disgustingly dirty. This place is good for that. The service was fine. No overly friendly. It was good and the reason I'd come back.  

The cinnamon buns are $3.10 a piece and worth it. They are quite big. They are topped with generous amounts of icing. If you want extra icing, stop. You don't need it. You're likely getting a sugar filled beverage too. I coupled mine with a caramel corretto. Though I'm filled with happiness, is basically the foreshadowing for an amazing afternoon sugar crash.  

I like this place because it is easy to access from 75th.

First off I love Mike the sushi maker there! Him and his wife are awesome! The service however is deplorable! My fiancé and I had been going there since it open(years),but after they got the place all pretty we started noticing the service failing! Now I'm a server and former line cook at some pretty nice restaurants here in Florida and New Orleans so I know when things are not right! The service got so bad we started sitting at the sushi bar with Mike and everything was good again! Well my lady and I met another couple there to celebrate my friend Sam birthday (he was on my bill) and right away things went from bad to worse! It took 20 mins to get a beer(and the place was not packed)then they screwed my app and entree up along with the bday boy dinner! We tried to make the best of it because we know things happen! It was only at the end did we realize we were not important to these people including the owner! They put an 18% gratuity on my party of three check and another 18% on my friend Rolondos party of two check (I can'tmake this up) saying that we were a big party! Rolondo and I both ask to speak to a manager and the lady owner came out acting as if she didn't understand what the complaints were and as if she didn't speak much English (you know how they do) which upset my lady very much(and she's the most easy going people I've ever met) well after we finally had the automatic tip removed,we didn't receive any apologizes nor did they take off a percentage for their mistakes on numerous mistakes this server made! Idk if it was because I'm black and Rolondo is Cuban but we are great tipper even when the service is bad I tip 15%. And Rolondo owns Rolondos Cigar bar in Dade City! I vowed never to go there again which is pretty sad because we miss Mike the sushi chef! Hey did I mention Rolondo and his wife Titi(rip titi) bill was $260 plus dollars!  In closing I think there food isn't that great for the cost and my party and I felt singled out when they added a tip to both checks know they gave us horrible service, and were not made to feel welcome there!  I mean we went there to have a great time and left very upset! One more thing they did! So I got the red snapper,the big red snapper but they brought out the small snapper and tried to charge me the price of the big snapper! I had no problem paying for the big snapper because I ordered it but to bring me out the small snapper (as if I don't know what ounces looks like) as if I'm stupid was very insulting! And that's why I'll never go there again even if I have to go to Fancy Sushi in Lakeland or Bonsai in Wesley Chapel! I'm done with this place...

I think its too trendy and the food isnt that great. Its overvalued. . Service is not that great. Ive had 2 meals there and me snd my friends could have made better meals. Kind ot too BS trendy! Way so!

I love this wine shop.  It has a nice selection with all different price ranges and if you love beer.  The selection is great.  Service is very personable and there are not long annoying lines.  Usually there is a wine sample to try as you are looking around.  The owner also has some really great fun events which makes this store even more unique and worth the visit!

BEST TATTOO EVER!!!!

# 5 TATTOO... BEST TATTOO!!!!

Although Pat is an ašśhóle... he is the best ašśhóle I've ever encountered!!! HANDS DOWN!!!

Seriously though... Pat was a true professional!!!! 

The entire process was, without question, the best customer experience EVER!!!

HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!!!!

I booked online and participated in the Beermaster Tour for $35 with my friend from 10:00 am on Saturday in February. I am not good at English, so I asked a document that shows a summary of the tour when I booked, and I got one. A guide talked fast, so it was difficult for me to understand, but the document helped me. However, disappointingly, I had to give it back after the tour.

In the beginning, at the first room, we put a headset, protective glasses, and a blue Bud Light cap, so I could hear the guide's explanation even in loud areas. We walked around the brewery, for example, a house of Clydesdale, an old brewery building, a packaging area, and a new brewery area. At the new brewery area, there are a lot of tanks, and we could get beer sample before filtering and sample from a finishing tank.

After that, we went back to the first room, and we drank beer. We could choose bottles of beer by ourselves from a fridge where they have a lot of kinds of beer at the room. That was like a colorful showcase in the fridge. At last, I got the blue Bud Light cap and a glass that I used for drinking sample from the finishing tank as gifts.

In case that you will go there in winter, you will feel freezing because the finishing area is very cold. I recommend you to wear warm clothing.

Very clean restaurant with very pleasant atmosphere. Staff greets you upon your first step inside the door. Fast friendly service continues throughout your meal. The owner, Ms. Liz, is super friendly and makes sure you have everything you need and you are happy with your food.  Went for the pho twice, but ended up getting vermicelli and grilled shrimp with rice. Both delicious!

This is a complete hole in the wall with awesome, cheap food that will fill you up. The menu is smallish, featuring various tacos (al pastor, carne asada, pollo asado, carnitas, etc.), tostadas, tortas, and a delicious grilled chicken dinner that comes with rice, beans, lettuce, fresh salsa and a few things I"m forgetting. I am a big fan of the ceviche tostada, which is topped with a generous serving of sliced avocado. The flavors truly remind me of the home-made cooking of my sister in law who is from Mexico. I brought her there once, and she actually liked it, which is rare for Mexican restaurants in Tennessee. This is a great place to go on a budget if you want something tasty and filling.
Great happy hour spot and beer selection. Hamburgers were cooked to order. Love the nachos. Bartenders can make some tasty cocktails as well. Will definitely be back.

We saw it on the Food Network and decided to go. We went, not once, but twice. I'm 74 years old and have had a LOT of fried chicken. The mild (& medium) fried chicken as Hattie-B's is the best fried chicken that I've ever had.
The mild & medium is hot enough for me. My wife gets the #3 hot or #4 hot and it's great for her.
We're going back the next chance we get.

My favorite Mexican restaurant in south jersey.

A family owned and operated establishment.  Food is a good mix between authentic and Americanized.  The spices in the food are excellent and flavorful although perhaps not as bold as they were a few years ago.

We have been coming here for several years and I've tried most things in the menu.  The bistec a la Mexicana is my favorite although I would go salavadoreno if you want less spicy.  The fat Alex burrito is I think a superior burrito and the enchalidas are good.  Combo number five is probably the best combo.  In general, I think the steak dishes are better than the chicken dishes.  The bar is great - best of local Mexican restaurants.  

Staff is wonderful.  Great atmosphere.  Their cinco de mayo party is the best in the area.

I just have to say this salon is great. Billie fixed a really bad haircut for me and now I feel human again. He took time to talk to me before he even started and checked out my hair before the shampoo to see how it would fall naturally. Use the stylist match they have on their website and go with who they recommend. The staff is friendly and welcoming. They care in this salon. I highly recommend them.

Um. YUM. If you are driving through SB like we were, I would highly recommend this place. The food was incredibly fresh and delicious (and that is coming from a food snob Aussie!) and the customer service is great. The place is also very cute. Definitely get the yogurt parfait side - yummo!

I've been a fan of Pierre's for some time - most recently, Jessica spent time to help me find just the right jacket to wear as MC of an event I was hosting at The Trocadero ... Although  you can get things somewhat cheaper elsewhere - the key word is 'cheaper'. At Pierre's you get what you pay for - and that includes as much guidance as you require to find just that right outfit or look.  Love 'em!

Tried this restaurant for the first time tonight. It's close to home which is nice. The atmosphere is very nice and very clean. The food was also very good. My husband ordered the carne asada and I had the grilled chicken with onions. We liked it and would definitely return. The only downside was the length of time to get our food. The place was only half full so I was surprised it took so long to get out food. And even when we were done eating, it took long before they picked up our plates and brought our check. Other than the slow service, I really liked this place.

Ok I forgot to leave this yesterday, however, since we went back today I figure I'll leave one comment for both days.. lol 

So being that I've lived in Tampa, well Brandon for over a year now, I thought I was pretty familiar with the restaurants in the area... NOPE NOT AT ALL. All this time I thought this place was a bank but scrolling through Yelp as I do on a daily basis, I saw that a friend of mine had checked in and I saw food!!! OMG was I pleasantly surprised.  I immediately told my better half lets go. 

When we got there it was 24 people ahead of us, but it was still early so the wait wasn't that bad and it went pretty quick.  We also used the app "NOWAIT" which was AWESOME as well.

Once seated, we had THEEEEEE BEST waitress (Sara), we told her that it was our first time there and she was so helpful and very personable. We loved her! Every question we had, she answered and gave us her "SARA's FAVS" as well which we appreciated.   Note* Sara will make sure you get great choices!! 

She explained every damn thing so good we ordered:
Butternut Squash Soup
Pumpkin pancake
Smoked Salmon Frittata
Veggie Burger 
Orange Cranberry Muffin
& coffee with pumpkin spice creamer  

....only to turn right around and pretty much order the same thing today. To bad Sara wasn't there lol 

Well since this place is right around the corner from the house, I guess we will be seeing Sara a lot more.... lol
My favorite late night spot!! Fast service, friendly staff and a ton of variety on the menu!
Always a nice place to get Chinese food. Have tried couple of dishes it never disappoints.

Yelp, you've done it again. I was on vacation in March, searching for food and this spot popped up with amazing reviews.

Y'all. Were. Not. Lying.

My tacos were so delicious and quite affordable. My friend went back for a 2nd order, he loved them so much. We're planning our trip next March and already have Pearly's on the agenda.
This is not what I expected for what I was told. Maybe because I'm not Cuban or something. Quality of the food is horrible, customer service is mediocre

Great food and bartender. Helped me choose the right brew to go with my meal. The environment is really entertaining with a variety of people. I just missed the Halloween costumes as I walked out. Wish I had started a bit longer to see this place in action on the weekend.

Southern Candymakers pralines are a must for anyone who wants a sweet taste of New Orleans!

Upon walking in, you're greeted by fresh made pralines in the making which come in several different flavors - original creamy, chocolate, rum, peanut butter and sweet potato.  You can order by piece or by box though the price is a bit steep at $27.95/pound (10-11 pralines).  We ordered two half pound boxes of original creamy and chocolate to bring home.  They're both a must!  The original creamy is light on the sweetness and the bf was in love with the chocolate pralines.  Both had giants chunks of praline.  The staff is friendly so if you're in doubt, ask for a sample!  

If pralines isn't your thing, they do have plenty of other options such as brittle, tortues, and toffee.  

Their candies are available for shipping.

Ordered the shrimp roll...thought about ordering the BLT..I should never second guess my food intuition..The shrimp roll was flavorless..but the roll was crispy and buttery..The BLT my friend ordered was soooo good!! The bacon was different in some way ..I didn't know bacon could be more bacony!!

Nice relaxing location in downtown Tampa for my morning coffee.   They have outdoor seating which is in a incredible cozy setting.  

They specialize in Cuban food. I ordered a Cuban coffee.  Would have liked if their carried spends as all they offer is sugar and sweet and low.  

I arrived at 810am and they were open so the posted hours were correct.

Staff was friendly and courteous and prices seem fair.

This food truck is near my job every Friday. I tried it for the first time last week and I was blown away at how TENDER the pulled pork was! My sandwich was delicious! Customer service was great, they were clean and provided fast service! Thanks guys!

I give it a five star rating because it was really good food.  And the staff was really polite.  However, itd be nice if they had a combo deal.  I dont care if it costs more than the per item ordering, some people, like me, just want a combo deal.  And how about a big fill me up burger option. The patties are three ounces they said. Id like to see a half pound option or a whole pound burger. Anyway, this place is really good.  Just need a combo and a fat boy burger option.

Joy and Dwright are fantastic! I'm lucky to have this locally owned and operated store literally across the street from my apartment building.  They are incredibly friendly and professional, and can handle both UPS and USPS shipments.  They always greet me with a smile and are super helpful, whether it's accepting (and boxing up) a package or having a document notarized.

This is NOT one of my favorite TJ Maxx Stores.  

It's nice, don't get me wrong, but they're no where nearly as neat, as organized or as up to date as others in the region.  Their make up, hair care and sundry items is no where near the stock that others have. 

The store does have a nice jewelry counter, and i've bought a few costume pieces from them, those make me happy. Finding that one sparkly item that really makes you shine, THAT's a good thing. 

I'll come back to see what new things come one, but only every so often.

As much as I love Fiats, I could not be impressed with this dealership. I am looking into a new car once I pay off my Civic and after I test drove a Fiat, I figured it was a done deal -- now I'm not so sure. The employee I was working with was both awkward and not at all accommodating to my needs. He was very insistent on pressuring me to go through with the purchase process at that time, despite the several instances I had told him I was not interested at that specific moment in time. I realize car salesmen are normally this way, but that does not make it okay. I left the dealership feeling frustrated and annoyed. Perhaps I should just stick with Honda.

I wanted to update, because since I last reviewed I have gotten both mashed potatoes and red beans and rice here.

The mashed potatoes are good and they come with gravy.  I'm sure they are "instant", but who cares?  Other fast food places serve instant potatoes.  It's a convenience store and it's just as good as Popeyes, especially if you take them home and add some Crystal to them.

And yes, Brother's has red beans and rice!  Who knew?  I was really surprised at how good it was!  I'm actually going to "go there" and say that I prefer them over Popeyes!  They are more like actual homemade red beans and not the canned stuff that Popeyes is serving up these days.  Like I said before, pick some up and spice to flavor with some Crystal sauce and you are good to go.

When I get food here, I get the two piece white with a small mashed potato and it costs about $4.75, which is cheap and on top of that, they are open late.

Just sayin...  ;)

Uncle Bill's is a place that really *is* everything it appears to be. It's a family eating establishment that specializes in pancakes. That's about it.

As you can probably imagine, it's not a culinary juggernaut, and it's not very expensive. I've tried lots of things on their menu, but nothing really grabs me... except for their breakfast foods. Even as I think about it, I'm not exactly sure if there's anything remarkable about this place, but I somehow keep going back, almost every week.

Every week, I order the Supreme 4-D. I eat 2 pancakes, 2 eggs, 2 sausages, 2 pieces of bacon, and some hash browns. I always feel *immensely* satisfied. It tastes wonderful. The Burgers? Not good. The chicken fried steak? Not good. BUT... the breakfast? *That's* good. You should definitely eat at Uncle Bill's.

Just make sure to get the breakfast.
The most bland Mexican food I've ever had. Not very authentic. No sizzling fajitas here.
The best cooked to order Chinese downtown.  Not a lot of room to eat there but damn is it delicious. Cheers!
I ordered breakfast for delivery, the service was exquisite and the food was delicious. My entire staff was raving about the sandwiches and the muffins. I highly recommend Ripple.

I love the concept of this place! Scheduling a blowout with your regular hairdresser at a salon is always difficult, but I got an appointment here with ease. The staff made me feel very comfortable and the stylist did a great job with my hair in just an hour. Really great price value too. I would recommend this place to anyone looking to get their hair done for an event or just for a quick pick me up. I usually only get my hair done for events but I plan to return here for a weekend blowout.

Most disappointing Dunkin experience ever. Coffee order was wrong, donuts were wrong and they didn't even toast the bread on my sourdough breakfast sandwich. But the good news is that the staff could care less.

Called for a simple oil change and to do this you have to call a main number and be routed to what you need... Lame, why can't I simply call the particular line directly. After I got through to the service center at this location I was put on hold, for 15 minutes. I hung up and went through the crazy process to reach the same person. This time when whoever answered, I forget his name, asked if he could put me on hold. I said no, and that I had already been put on hold for 15 minutes. He then became super rude and seemed to have little to no knowledge about customer service. I was shocked and appalled that someone would be rude to a customer that they had kept waiting... I told him that I wasn't interested in going there and hung up. Waste of my time! I only deal with Jim Click services because I have their maintenance for life. Horrid experience. Do not recommend!

Great little place that has some good food selection.  They have a homemade pimento cheese that is served with their pretzel bites.  THere is also a burger that has it on it, and it's delicious!   They have all their beers on tap plus some seasonal.  I didn't see any guest taps advertised.  Inside decor is cozy and there is a side patio.   Sundays they have $2 pints on their house beers.   Check to make sure this special is still ongoing, but it's nice to have a couple of pints and a burger on Sunday!

This is my hubby and I favorite pizza place in Lutz/odesa area. They have so many great deals for pizza and wings. Hand made pizza, ohh and garlic knots with sause AMAIZING!!
I definitely recommend this place if you're looking for NY style real pizza

Wow,. hard to describe the perfectly prepared farm to table experience of this establishment and I have a feeling they are just warming up!...The gardens are in place and the food is exquisitely prepared and presented.   Great dinner with my folks and my husband again.  White chocolate covered berries for desert.  Thanks for another stellar experience!
Why offer appointments to only be booked when u get there? Waste of time lost my business. Ill be loyal somewhere more honest.

Hands down the best Mexican food in the area !!! Their Tres Leches cake is amazing. They have a small dining area, so I am assuming a good amount of their business is take out. They do offer BYOB and they have a nice selection of Mexican sodas. I have had their shrimp bowls and burritos and they are both delicious! The tacos, Mexican soup are also very good The portions are huge and their prices are very reasonable..
I got the Bibimbap, which was OK. I wasn't too impressed, nothing stood out--their beef wasn't seasoned very well. My friend got their Kimbap which was a little bit better with sesame seasoned rice.

Rude. My chips were soggy. I asked for fresh chips and was informed that they are all cooked in the morning and they are all the same. The place was dirty. The staff acted as though they were doing me a favor by waiting on me. I won't be back

Found this place on our most recent Tahoe/Reno trip. We wanted some coffee but were also hungry. So we decided to come here since they had food, baked goodies/desserts and coffee. 

Our group ordered some sandwiches, salads, and chicken pot pie. My turkey melt was really tasty. It was so good in fact, my bf begged for my other half. And he traded me what was left of his pot pie. I felt the pot pie was not as salty and I'm not a big fan of celery, and the celery taste was very apparent. 

The cakes were decent. We got some strawberry one, tiramisu, and opera torte. There were also a few cookies that came with the meal, as well as a peanut butter sammie one that bf got. 

Their pies looked really good, too bad they don't sell in slices. We only had 4 people and would in no way, have finished 1 whole pie...

Will come back for their melts. Hope to be able to try their pies someday, maybe sell by slices?? Overall, 3.5 STARS!

If you're craving pho, it's ok. What was disappointing was the bubble tea. Their Thai iced tea was super bland and watery. The pho itself was ok. One of the severs who helped me seemed to be very confused as I asked for beef broth but didn't want meat. He kept asking what meat I wanted and I said none which confused him and well, I thought the vegetarian pho was cheaper, but was still rung up for a beef pho. So, meh? If you crave pho, this works in a pinch for a quick lunch, but for the real thing? Pass.

Came from New York and used to get Stromboli from the Italian market on Arthur Avenue Bronx Came down four years ago was unable to find any ones that knew how to make Stromboli the right way until Murphys Market.  Stromboli makes there's just like the ones I used to get on Arthur Ave. Along with all the rest of their GOOD, HELPFUL & FRIENDLY staff. MURPHYS MARKET is the place to go for Meats, Cheese & Cold Cuts & Fresh vegetables. Thank You. George Coon

So far so good room is clean, no smells, clean towels, clean bedding, great service. Fast WIFI, nice size TV. View from our room is blah we see the pool which is closed and the front of the Elderado. The rates were great!

For $100/night in SB, this wasn't a bad choice at all. The staff was friendly and helpful, rooms were clean and quiet. Stay here for a (Santa Barbara) budget priced night.. Without budget style problems.

Dont judge a book by its cover because this place serves up good quality, tasty wings!   

They are cooked to order and seasoned perfectly.  

The menu is a little basic and doesnt list the sauces but they have several different types.  

The restaurant has limited seating so it's mostly a takeout joint, but they also deliver through Uber Eats.  It doesn't look like much from the outside so dont let that deter you.

All in all, it's one of the best options in South Tampa for no frills wings...especially for the price.

Definitely check them out if you're in the mood for wings.

Such an amazing bakery! I would have never known about this place if it wasn't for a friend raving about the cupcakes and brownies. I stopped by and picked up the glazed brioche which were off the hook! Chocolate Guinness cupcakes are rich and delicious, as well as, the salted chèvre brownie which is insanely yummy! I took home some macarons which were pretty yummy, but still not like the ones I get at Maison du Macaron in NYC. But I give them a ton of credit for making French macarons because they are not easy!

I ordered my fiance's birthday cake from here and had one small cake of carrot with cream cheese filling which was so moist and delicious! Tons of carrot and coconut and lots of flavor. The cake and icing was not sickening sweet like some bakeries make it to be. I also had a bigger cake of red velvet with Oreo cream cheese buttercream and it was divine! Aside from the cake being soooooo delicious, they were able to make the 3-D character cake I requested. It was so life like I squealed in excitement when I saw it!

It is probably a good thing I don't live near this bakery, and that their hours are hard for me to visit because I would be here wayyyyyy too often!

This is my favorite Cosi.  I know they all serve the same food and beverages,  but this location does it much,  much better.
The staff here is so young and enthusiastic,  they get you in & out quickly with a smile and a decently prepared meal.
I noticed they have a lot of negative reviews,  and maybe it's because I get Big Guy preferable treatment (even though I'm a little smaller) and even though I really don't care for their coffee, the food and the fast,  friendly service gets me everytime.

Wow. Just blown away with the service this morning at the S Carrollton restaurant. Ms. Debra stopped by multiple times at our table to make sure our visit was exceptional. She even offered to refill my coffee. Keep it up guys, service like this will earn you repeat business!

We ate at Sloppy Joe's while vacationing at Treasure Island.  I got fish tacos which were pretty average.  My wife got the firecracker shrimp tacos which in my opinion were better than the fish tacos.  Overall average service, average food equals about a 3 star review.

This is such a cute, tiny, mom-and poppish sushi place.  For a small place. they have a wide selection to choose from.  My bf and I had one of their specialty rolls - I forget what it's called but apparently it has an 'explosive flavor' and it certainly was a symphony of flavor.  It wasn't as hot as I thought it was going  to be, but it did have a perfect kick to it from the sliver of jalapeno.  The spicy tuna was really awesome too.   There were other rolls we got that I paid no attention to the name because I was too busy eating that were amazing, so I'm just going to assume everything here is amazing.  The sashimi melts in your mouth, by the way.

Service was great and friendly.  Bathroom was super clean.  It's  a great place for a peaceful candle lit dinner and is BYOB.

I previously left a 4 star review and had enjoyed our experience here but today my husband went to breakfast with his family and got my lunch to go and my spinach salad had no dressing. On the menu it said it came with a warm bacon vinaigrette so I assumed that meant the salad was dressed already and didn't ask my husband to specify. He brought me my salad and it was spinach, hard boiled eggs, mushrooms and onions. The spinach was pretty wilted and the onions were huge, thick slices. It probably wouldn't have been that much better with the dressing but at least I could have eaten it. My husband also said during breakfast they waited almost an hour for their meal and my sister in law had to end up getting hers to go since she had an appointment. What a bummer. Down the road maybe we'll try again but I'm pretty turned off now.

Modern twist to indian cuisine. Chilli lamb chops one of the highlights on the menu !
 
Mango panacotta  for the dessert

We stumbled across this place because it was one of the bars participating in the Philly Bar Crawl. I was very impressed and this had to be one of my favorite bars on the bar crawl. The staff was very friendly and knowledgable about the food. They were also doing a good job of handling the huge St Patricks day crowd. We enjoyed our Cajun wings. They were some of the best Cajun wings that I've ever tasted in my life. The restaurant is very narrow, which made it a little hard to walk through but that wasn't a problem. The ladies' room was kept very neat and clean. This was shocking to me because bathrooms are usually disgusting when there's a lot of drunk people.

Come hungry! Enjoy the view!

Anything with Paneer. Naan is perfect.... chutneys are decent.
This is where native-born and speaking Indian-Ameicans in the area eat. Which tells you a lot. 

Weekdays buffet is hugely popular. Service is prompt and efficient. 

I've eaten were dozes of times and only had one less-than-four star experience.

I have been here about 5 times and everytime I go it is always a amazing! 

Staff quality: 5 out of 5

I love this place and go here every time I'm on the east side. The staff is very nice and they are very quick when coming to your table to check on you.

Food quality: 5 out of 5

The food here is absolutely always amazing. However I have a couple times gotten dry corn bread but there custom soda fountain quickly filly my dry mouth with the unique flavor of their custom sodas. 

Decor quality: 5 out of 5 

This place always looks amazing on the inside with its unique writing all over the walls. It is a definite place I love to go.

Would I go back?
Yes!

Would I recommend it to others?
Yes!

Flatwater has improved lately and has a fun relaxed atmosphere.  The food is above average and they have a beer list large enough to please most.  Great outdoor patio that most nights has a band.  Overlooks the Canal. Other patrons tend to be in their high 30s to low 50s, good mix of single and married.  When you walk into the front door, you first go through a small dining room, recall this used to be a house, then Bazbeaux before they moved to their current location down the street.  After the dining room you come into the main bar area. With maybe 10 to 12 stools on three sides of the bar and high top tables opposite the bar, It can get very crowded.  Wooden bar with the rail and comfy stools. The bar back contains liquor shelves taps and a couple TVs.  There's also another small bar out side that serves the patio and has a decent number of stools.  Good place to have several drinks and relax when the weather is warm.

The atmosphere here is cool, and it feels like a bustling neighborhood coffee shop - which is good. However, the barista was far from attentive and was fine with loud, distracting music but then turned off actual acoustic stereotypical coffee shop music, looking right past me as I mouthed the words along to complain to another customer about the song I was getting into! Plus, when I went to get a hot tea water refill, I had to wait for 4 espresso drinks to me made before my 10 second refill as she didn't even make eye contact or say "just a moment" or anything. Finally, when I tried to get the Wifi password from her she basically ignored me and a nearby customer had to give it to me. Overall, I just sensed no urgency or even sense of obligation to help.

I was pretty impressed with the space and "feel" of the place outside of the distracting music, and will go back hoping that most of the baristas actually give a damn or that she was just having a bad day. While the crowd there seemed cool, the barista just gave the impression that if you aren't one of her beloved regulars you aren't worth her time... not a way to earn new regulars!

Best coffee place I've found in town. Plus, it's within walking distance from my house. I never wonder if they're going to get my drink right, whereas with other coffee places, I leave worried. The consistency from this location is awesome. I also love the points system and the deals they have all the time!

(Ring...Ring...)
KOJA - Hello, Koja
BRAD - Hi, I'd like to know if you guys would deliver up to Broad and Allegheny.
KOJA - Yes.
BRAD - What? Really?
KOJA - We can deliver up there...what will you have?
--

Alright, the above conversation seems pretty simple, right?  Nothing out of the ordinary?
WRONG.

Every time I try to get any Temple main campus food establishment to deliver to the health science campus, I'm treated to a heap of excuses and bullshit.  It usually goes something like this:

(ring...ring...)
RESTAURANT - Hello.
BRAD - I'd like to see if you deliver to Broad and Allegheny.
RESTAURANT - Groooooannnn.  Where is that?
BRAD - It's about 1.5 miles north of where you are.  And did you say the word groan instead of just make the noise?
RESTAURANT - Oh wow....well...I just...I just don't know.  Let me talk to my manager.(2 mintues pass).  Hello?
BRAD - Yes?
RESTAURANT - Oh, I thought you would've hung up by now.
BRAD - I hate what my life has come to.
RESTAURANT - I hate you.
--
Koja gave me nothing but amazing and efficient service and delivery that arrived EARLIER than they had estimated.  The food is very reasonably priced, the portions are generous, and it is tasty.

I had the spicy beef over soba noodles.  Now, curb your expectations here.  These aren't amazing wheat noodles akin to what you'd get in Japan.  They are decent.  The meat quality is high but it is kinda skimpy.  The spicy seasoning is very good.  As a bonus, all the meals we got came with marinated green beans and are a nice touch.  One of my colleagues got the spicy shrimp wit flat noodles and they seemed to pile on the shrimp for him.  I will probably get that dish next time.

I had a great experience dealing with them.  This is a great place.  Everybody on Temple health sciences campus area should utilize this establishment frequently.

Everything I have tried on the menu has been very tasty.  Chopped brisket and hot wings are 2 favorites.  A little pricey, but you get large portions of food.  Only complaint would be that sometimes, they "run out" of some items.  I once ordered a brisket sandwich - none left.  I then ordered a roast beef sandwich, none left.  I guess Monday and Tuesday are much slower days and that is the reason they are no longer open those days.

The outside appearance is very rustic and city cool. The inside has an industrial rustic look. We immediately got seated to our table with a view of the beautiful downtown street. Our waitress greeted us and explained the beer band deal. Basically you get to fill a cup of beer after you give your ID and credit card for on file and you are charged by ounce and the price is based on which beer. Lots of variety. We ordered the Guzzler pizza with GF crust. The GF crust was delicious and the pizza itself had lots of flavors that blended beautifully together. The goat cheese wasn't overpowering and the drizzle of balsamic dressing was outstanding. We decided last minute to order the appetizer called the No.10 Can Nachos. It's basically chili nachos that come in a big can, they lift the big can when served, and all the delicious insides fall to a flavorful blob. The nachos were good at first but within a few minutes you could tell the blob was basically that... a gooey, soggy, gross, fattening mountain of yuck. I told the waitress that we loved the pizza but the nachos were gross (obvious because we barely ate them at all). She didn't say anything except "well I'm glad you liked the pizza!" And then handed us our $30 check. If you have money to try all the beer then come here and get drunk, watch sports, and eat good pizza. But overall, the servers need to brush up on things a bit more. I asked her for paper napkins and she said they didn't have any because they're a "trendy eco friendly place" so she handed me paper towels. Mean while they had paper towel dispenser in their bathroom? That's not very eco friendly. They don't use straws unless you ask and their paper straws, so that's good! Overall, meh. I'd come back so I can eat GF pizza since it's hard to find but that's it.

Yo this place is awesome. Everything was good. And service was great as well. Fried green tomatoes in Indianapolis, wasn't expecting that but they were perfect.  Burgers excellent and cooked as requested all around. Editing to add that Patrick was our server and he was excellent!

Great park.  It is a lot larger than it looks and there are so many things to do here. I know it is called a creek, but the creek empties into a large lake.  They have canoe, kayaking and boat rentals.  Or you can bring your own. I think it cannot have a motor, but I would double check before you get there.  If you have a Pennsylvania license you can fish, but it has to be in certain areas, which they have well marked by signs.  

The back part of the park has a paid swimming pool. There is also a camp ground that is available for picnics and grilling.  

For the most part Marsh Creek State Park is a great place to get away and get some peace and quiet.   The only problem is that this is the place I go to get away from noise and some people that come are so obnoxiously loud. This has been a more recent thing, but it can be really annoying.  Sometimes when I fish, I think they scare the fish away.   If I go during the colder days, it is usually more quiet.

My first time trying Columbian food and I am obsessed now! Our server was so helpful and showing us the best options the atmosphere was great and there's a club next door for later at night. Unfortunately we couldn't go as our flight was leaving later. The food was amazing and enough to take home. I can't wait to go back to Clearwater to get some more!
This is a great place to chill and get bubble tea! The service is always nice and fast. The drinks themselves always taste great and consistent.

Visited here with my family in 2016 and back in 2013 with friends. Always funny and good humor. I was hoping the food had gotten better in the 3 years but it hadn't. The prices are very high too. I kinda wish the waiters and waitresses lived up to there name better. Outside of the writing on the hats the wit wasn't very creative for there line of work.
Is a fast food (McDonald) Vietnamese restaurant.  If you are looking for something fast, simple and easy, price about $8-$9.

I love McDonald's but this is the worst one in the state of Tennessee! The service is so slow! I go at times when there's no line and yet it still takes forever. And for some reason the workers are mad at me! They always say rude remarks. Normally there is one worker who runs everything and the rest just sit around and do nothing. THEY NEED NEW WORKERS. I'm  over it. Goodbye eat safe :)
I have only been to West German to get parts.  They have been in the area for a long time and seem to have a good following.
Great Beer! Good Bar food. It's a true bar with all the crowded college crew that comes with that. I'll go back on a slow night!

Just came here for dinner. Nam phuong never fails in my book. Service is like the speed of lightning, food comes quickly, the prices are reasonable and parking is always available.
My favorite is the country style beef cubes that come with watercress. It comes with a salt and pepper vinegar that you can dip it in. Add a bit of Sriracha and rice and you're great. We also got the sautéed chicken with coconut curry & peanut topping surrounded by bright green broccoli.
These waiters are on point!

Taylor was awesome! Very knowledgeable about curly hair. I had shoulder length curls going on before. I was thinking of doing a pixie cut and we had both decided it wouldnt work too well with my poofy hair. I love the asymetrical cut I came out with. I have had pretty terrible luck in the past with stylists that had no idea what to do with my hair, and she totally nailed it.

I was delighted with the chef's Puttanesca Pasta. It made my mouth dance!! .  This was my first time and definitely not my last. My dish was so tasty I had to refrain from ordering the same meal the next night.  Yummy menu, I must try their decadent desserts.
Sooooooo good! My favorite sandwhich place in the world! Excelent bread, fresh vegies, tasty meats, amazing condements!

This place is an absolute hidden gem!  I was excited to hear about a place that offered Scottish goodies as I really enjoy celebrating and learning about my heritage.  As I stopped by the shop, I was greeted by one of the owners who helped me find the item I was looking for, Irn Bru soda.  There were also a lot of other imported treats such as chips, haggis in a can, teas, and two types of Scottish soda, as well as cookies.  The shop was sparse, and could benefit by moving to a smaller location.  All of the goods there are imported, so anything you might get there will seem pricey.  They can order your tartan for a custom made kilt, and have lots of kilt and other traditional dress items.  I was happy to purchase a Scottish flag pin, a sticker for my truck, a bag of Aberdeen steak flavored chips, two bottles of Irn Bru, and a can of Barr's sparkling lemonade.  The owner also enthusiastically gave the the last publication of the NV Scottish Clans newsletter and informed me of upcoming events.  This will certainly be a place that I frequent, to try the other food stuffs and also get some of the other items as gifts.

Came from Soith Florida for work and didn't have time to get my nails done prior. I came across this place and it was very busy so I had high hopes. That is when I met Sally, she was detailed, fast and thorough. I got a dip manicure and the volcano pedicure and it was well worth it. I am looking forward to seeing her again very soon!
Great night at Blanco for National margarita day! Service was incredible and food great! Always love the Bar staff Ashley, and Red.

Last night's visit was only a three star but because I've enjoyed it so much in the past, I'll go with four stars.  As usual, we ordered the boudin and the mac and cheese.  This is some of the best boudin I've ever had and I love those sweet-sour pickles it's served with.  The mac and cheese is so rich and wonderful with the green-flecked breadcrumbs and smoky pancetta flavor.  
However, the cubano, about which I've heard such great things, was just okay.  The ham was fine but the pork tasted...old.  There was also some unadvertised parsley pesto or something of that ilk all over it.  I'm not a huge parsley fan and even if I was, it made the bread soggy.  I'm all for new spins on classics but you have to do it BETTER than the original to get away with it.  This didn't compare to a real cubano.
But the boyfriend's backboard bacon melt with collard greens was (as always) delicious.  Next time I'll try the Gambino.
Place still sucks.  They did take my advice on "free" chips though.  Nothing else has changed since my last review from 2 years ago.

What a great winery! I could take a glass of everything we sampled. You can get 5, 1oz pours for $6 to get an idea of the offerings. With fun names like the Terminator Malbec or Vulcan's Anvil Cab I wanted to drink them all... and we got through a fair amount.

They have a great outdoor space with a fire pit and fountain. It's a good space for groups. They also have a back room that you can rent. 

I also appreciated that they have glasses/pitchers of water that you can grab because hey someone has to drive... plus you can order in food and hang awhile.   we will definitely be back!
Awesome tri tip! I requested rare and they delivered. Great value and very friendly staff. 10/10 recommend when looking for a quick bite.

Extremely friendly staff, great selection on the menu, clean delicious tastes from the Korean Peninsula. 
I highly recommend, & will be back soon for more!!
Everything about my sandwich was messed up starting from the type of bread, what was on it, I wanted it toasted, there was no cheese. Disappointed
Dr. Foore is the best!  My family and I have been seeing him for years and have always been very happy there.  They recently remodeled their office and it is great!
My goodness! Our breakfast burrito was greasy and SO filling! It was big enough to share too!

The entire experience here at chili's in North Wales was terrible.  Upon arrival and being seated in a booth in the back that the table was sticky and the seats were sticky should have been an indicator for us to leave.  We waited quite a while for the worlds slowest (although she was nice) waitress.  We both ordered the 3/10 deal they had.  My crispy chicken just tasted like oil and the chicken was so over cooked I couldn't bite it.  Fries were okay.  The corn on the cob was disgusting and looked like it had been sitting for a few days.  Even the salad wasn't good.  The croutons were super stale.  My son had the quesadilla with chicken and cheese.  This kid will usually eat anything.  He couldn't eat this.  The cheese was disgusting.   I pad the check at the table with the little device they leave there and we left with pretty much of our entire meal still on the plate.  Definitely never going back to chili's

We hired Daryl for our wedding and he was absolutely amazing! Wedding can be a stressful event but he made it easy and fun and made us feel relaxed. I'm from the Czech Republic and wanted to have some specific Czech songs played, nothing was a problem for Daryl. Everyone loved his personality at the wedding! He delivered exactly what we asked for and more!
Thanks again!

So we had been to the Dunedin location but wanted to check out the Tampa location for the release of the Klaw. This place has ample parking and is pretty dang easy to find! Their outdoor seating is going to be key in the winter, cannot wait for the cool down! We sat the bar while I worked (they have great WiFi) and had a flight (you make your own, as many as you want). We tried the PoweSlave, Beneath the Remains, Equatorial Farmhouse, the Kiwi Coconut Berliner, Making Love at Midnight, Partners in Crime, and Slaughter of the Soul. Any brewery that has a mix of sours, stouts, saisons, and IPAs is the place for me. The taproom is quite large (larger than the Dunedin location) and has more taps, they also have a few guest taps. A food truck pulled up around dinner time but there are plenty of other spots to order in from. The decor inside is simple, the music is subtle but fun, and the location is great. I highly recommend this spot to anyone who loves craft beer whether you're new to craft or are an old pro. They really have something for everyone!

Bland bland bland! The $9 margarita was bland and undrinkable by the girlfriend or myself. The fish sandwich was bland and came with two condiment cups of bland coleslaw. It should have arrived with some tartar sauce in one of those cups. Her fish tacos were just "okay". The Pub Chips (fries) were very good and the reason I didn't leave still hungry.

One star for the cool building and atmosphere it provides. Another star for the fries that saved the day.

"When I dip you dip we dip!"

"You put yours and I put mine 
And we can get down low 
And roll it round!"

I may be referencing the lyrics from Da Dip by Freak Nasty but my friends I am talking about the deliciousness of The Turning Point.

I endulged on the Flight of Pancakes this joyous New Year and what a presentation of Bourbon Walnut Banana, Cinnamon Roll, and Berry Chocolatey panckes it is indeed. You get two pancakes of each selection and my favorite was hands down the Bourbon Walnut Banana which has alot going on but do not be afraid to redip that bourbon flavored pancake in the maple syrup. The Cinnamon pancake has a cheese frosting on it detailed in the picture and I can say I never had such a unique pancake. The Berry Chocolatey pancake was my least favorite as it had a bittersweet dark chocolate flavor to it and I feel most pancake fanatics will criticize. You can however choose one of there other options like the lemon blueberry pancake option.

This breakfast joint has spectucular coffee options including French Press coffee for an upcharge of $7.25 per pot if you want to splurge. I have gotten the OMG french toast here before again you are getting a meal full of sugar but they have a whole list of healthy options as well.

I will be back to this establishment and highly recommend you venture into The Turning Point if you are a virgin to the experience. And as always people SYOY!!!

Worst Popeyes ever created. Ordered 4 piece meal with a side of pie. Not only did they only put three pieces in the box, but also forgot the pie and messed up my side. People that work here are lazy and could care less
The food was pretty good. The people didn't seem like they wanted to be at work, especially the bartenders. Too bad, especially for people who are working for tips.

I'm relatively new to Florida and Land O Lakes in particular and I've been searching for a good place to get my haircut. I've tried a handful of places and they've al been so so. Saw the reviews for Cheers and have it a shot. Kenny cut my hair and did a fantastic job. It's been a little over two weeks and the haircut still looks good. I think I've found my new place.

We had dinner with friends at Domani Star. I felt it was a bit pricey. The food was good. I must admit, I have not returned - I don't believe I will either. It is always busy, so I know it is a favorite of so many people, just not this reviewer.

Leave the south/west corner alone. That's for the homeless. I never hang in the park but cut through whenever I get the chance. It's cool and very Philly specific. I love the view of the Art Museum from there. Flawless. The "Love at Lunch" concert series in the summer is cute. I also love when the fountain's color changes. See my pics for pink in honor of October's Breast Cancer Awareness month. I wish the kids could skateboard. The park looks like that is what is is meant for. But oh well. My suggestion to enjoy Love Park to it's fullest? Wear headphones to block out the nonsense and just appreciate it for what it is. Visually impressive.
I've been going for the past couple of years and it's always consistently great... we always sit at the bar and  service  is always awesome!

This place opened this past Monday 12/5/16 and I know what you're gonna ask me...

"Are they related to THE Dinic's, the one in Reading Terminal Market (RTM)?" 

Well, yes. According to the owners they are cousins of the current owner of the original Tommy Dinic's in RTM.

"Are they just as good as the original?" 

That's a bit of a loaded question... I don't think the original can be beat, but Dinic's Pork and Beef does  more than an admirable job. 

Their pork is flavorful with au jus in abundance. The sandwiches come in at ten inches, not as massive as those at RTM and that's okay; one sandwich filled me up without making me uncomfortably full. My wife didn't really notice a difference compared to RTM and we agreed it's the best we've had in the suburbs!

Bottom line: It is really hard to find a good roast pork sandwich in the Montgomeryville area and Dinic's Pork and Beef accomplishes that. Their sandwich isn't a carbon copy of the one in Reading Terminal but it doesn't have to be; it's a darn good sandwich and definitely worth a try.

I had the asian shrimp salad, which was a pile of greasy fried salad shrimp on nothing but  a pile of spinach leaves with long stems and some hard-as-rock indistinguishable crunchy... noodles?  The dressing was okay.  That, with a huge appetite, made the salad edible.  I wouldn't order it again.  It was side-salad sized, definitely not dinner-salad sized.  Twelve dollars for that?  Ambiance was spare, but the fire in the middle of the place was nice.
The food was good, but I thought it was extremely pricey!  If it did shut down I think that's the reason why.

Can't say enough about the place - Food is as fresh as it gets , terrific and personalized service , beautiful inside , ... and a swell owner !  Happy to say Selene is here to stay - thanks again to all.
This. Place. Was. AWESOME. Fried bologna was unbelievable. The fried green tomatoes were perfect. I won't waste words. Just go.

Went to VooDoo last night after a day of Mardi Gras-ing. The food was soooo yummy...the Honey Pepper Angel Wings are delicious..not enough celery (3 teeny stalks)...but OMG, the wings are so good.  I had the Graveyard Platter with pulled pork, turkey, mac & cheese and steamed vegetables...all delicious.

Now, for the not so great comments...

The service was good, but slow....I don't think it was the waitress' fault though....I think it was the kitchen.  The waitress was nice and accomodating enough.

The hostess was a little strange....when we let her know that we didn't want a table by the door, she put us in a very awkward table that was jammed between others directly in front of the waitress/service station...you know, where waitstaff is always getting beverages, scraping plates, and making noise with ice, etc.  We asked for another table, since there were SO many available and she told us we could sit where we wanted.  Weird.

The portions have REALLY gotten smaller over the years (see the picture on the blue plate...everything was half that size...except the bread).  I know this is happening everywhere, but most places don't make their portions smaller AND raise the prices.  VooDoo has done both.  BOOOOOOOO!  I did specifically tell the waitress about my dissatisfaction with the portion sizes and she said absolutely nothing.   BOOOOOOOO again.

Its been 5 months since i've been to yo mama's for the first time and I am STILL talking about it to everyone. I have never had or seen on a menu in the NJ area "peanut butter bacon burger". It was so different and delicious. It was one of my favorite meals in New Orleans. The ginormous baked potato dressed with everything was also amazingly delicious. Two thumbs up in my book and if I ever get back to NOLA that will be my first stop!

Went here for happy hour drinks and snacks. The mojitos and frozen margarita were sooo delicious and were $5. We got the guacamole which came with plantain chips which were absolutely delicious. The guac was authentic so it was more the chopped up avocado rather than the creamy kind. The bar gets really crowded early on in happy hour so try to get there earlier.

Haven't been here in a while, but food is still great and place is always clean...
The service is great and always respectable...
I am impressed with the professionalism, enthusiasm and affordability of this law firm. They are top notch!

RUDE!!!
So rude! I asked for prices and the lady on the first picture...I guess the owner...was so bothered she gave me the worst attitude. I walked right out!!!

Beware of this place! This place is the worst ever. Dr. Hal not keeping his promise to his patients, the manager is full of lies to lure you for your business. Once they took your money, they will not finish the work they suppose to do.

We love SIPS. Its like a classy yet neighborhood bistro. I can't remember the name of the gentleman who takes care of you in the dining room but he is very professional in a European way and takes good care of you. I had the oysters and then the scallops. The scallops were excellent. A well played dish accompanied by the appropriate ingredients without the need to throw the starch and veggies of the day. My husband had the special which was wild boar bolognese. It was excellent and enough to share the left overs for lunch!

We got sat around 6:30 and didn't get our drinks until 8 and didn't end up getting our food at all. We left around 10ish after waiting hours for our food. The manger came out to talk to my family and started yelling at us and was very rude to us. The people next to us saw the manger being extremely rude and told him to stop and he started yelling at them also. Don't ever go to this restaurant, it has the worst service ever!!!!

NJ Transit is a great convenience to travel down to AC or NYC. This particular location has safe parking but I'm not sure I would leave my vehicle overnight. You can book your tickets online now and travel with them on your phone, which is a big time saver.
