One of our favorite restaurants. Food consistently good, great staff and fun atmosphere, without being too noisy. Quality food at fair prices. You can scale down (price-wise) with pasta or scale up with more traditional meat or fish dishes. Have had delicious risotto here too.

Everyone knows when you visit New Orleans you have to try the beignets! Of course, everyone raves about Cafe du Monde, but I was not impressed. Though the line to order was out the door and around the corner, the staff was efficient, the prices were reasonable, and the beignets were fluffy and delicious!

This is a great find...the smell is alluring so I stopped by and had the fried prawns and garlic fries...the seat by the window was the perfect spot to gaze and graze....ummmmm so good. Had leftovers...go here!....itsme itsme

Finally made it to spring mill Café. 

Been wanting to get here for a couple years. Glad we finally did! 

What a lovely little place. Great atmosphere. Quiet, understated but elegant. Felt like eating at my French grandmothers house if i had one and she were an excellent cook. 

Everything was excellent, from the escargot de Bourgogne to the Benedict, from the gazpacho to the Lapin d'alsace a la moutarde, from the omelette to the trout amandine. 

Not one dish was anything but very good. 

Service was excellent. Accommodating, but unobtrusive. Responsive and caring. The young gentleman that headed up our service was well versed in food and passionate about the place he worked. 

We felt at home and at ease and really enjoyed the meal. I'm happy we chose your establishment to celebrate our occasion! 

Thanks for helping to make my folks 50th anniversary brunch special. 

We'll definitely have to join you for dinner sometime!

I recently moved to the tampa area and was nervous about finding a new groomer after having the same one for so many years. The minute I walked into woof gang I knew it was the perfect place. The store itself is very cute and pink but the grooming is what makes me the happiest. All dogs are hand dried, there is no cage drying...actually there arnt really cages at all! Woof gang believes in grooming one dog at a time so they don't have to be stuck in a cage. I had asked what I could do in the area with my other dog and the groomer Josh volunteered to let him stay there to hangout too! (I didn't take him up on that but what a nice gesture). Oliver ended up looking great and happy as ever when he came back out. I would recommend this place to anyone who needs their dog groomed and will continue to use their services.
AWFUL! BEWARE! Very quick to make empty promises. Very slow to give any kind of refund. Good luck getting through on the phone it's a minimum of 20 minutes and they blame covid.

Have been here on several occasions and it has never disappointed. Special blueberry French toast is very good along with the bacon and fresh eggs. Also nice cup of coffee and you are set. Will definitely keep coming back. To add, staff is always attentive and very nice. Top notch service.
Took over hour and half to get pizza delivered.  Should be renamed Turtle Pizza.  Manager on duty was completely rude when called out about it. Terrible service.

Wanted to start close to the airB&B I was staying at so I wondered down to this gem. My favorite here was the live music with pianist. The cocktail I had I believe was "The Muse" and it was delicious. Love the environment friendly paper straws too! I did try the Bleu cheese stuff dates and honestly was not a fan. Didn't taste like there was cheese in there at all and the bacon that wrapped the dates tasted too burned for my liking.

We have seen many Trader Joes at different locations but never have a chance to go into one. The first Trader Joe's we have seen is at Atlanta near the Ah Ma Kitchen a year ago. We were curious what kind of the grocery store is that.

After the nearby UYE event, we have a chance to actually have the first hand experience in this grocery store. The people who has shop there are 70% skinner than me. That tell me the food there is organic, gluten free, or healthy food. My friend warns me about the parking space. It is better to go there at off hours to get a parking. At the entrance they already have some food taste. When you walk into the store, the herb plants are on the side of the entrance. I like mix herb plant because they are the fresh ingredient for cooking. You just need to plug a few of them when you need it for cooking.

The grocery store is not as big as Publix or whole food. But they do carry enough material for cooking. We have bought the Seasoned Rack of Lamb (all natural), Rice drink, Seasoned Kale Chips and the Bacon end tip. The price is reasonable here compare to many place. The end tip bacon is 3.65. After remove the fat, we still have a lot left for the lean meat. The dessert tasting is provided at some time. Some good some tasteless due to too organic ingredients. 

I would recommend this place due to the quality, pricing, and healthy living.
Great staff. Great facility. David King is very welcoming and personable. The technology is cutting edge. Very knowledgeable and friendly staff.
Such a chill spot to relax alone or with a friend. The teas are delicious!! Love the atmosphere too!

The fact that I just got free birthday pancakes here might have biased me some, but they were delicious and my server, Lydia, was excellent. Very kind, and I never went without water.

I tried the rooty fruity full stack with raspberry topping, with some tasty scrambled eggs on the side. Feeling stuffed and happy. The low rating is something of a mystery.

Been using Northside Glass for over 6 years for myself and clients. Tons of options for custom work, and very quick with quotes. I've never waited longer than 36 hours for a custom quote. Usually same day or the next morning. Matt is very prompt and responsive when coming to measure your project. He's great about explaining all your options on site and getting you multiple quotes if needed.

This place is amazing!!! It's very cute and clean. The staff is beyond friendly and helpful. I probably tried more samples than I should have. I will be coming back tomorrow for some more gelato, especially the pistachio and confetti flavored. Just don't try the vanilla cupcake. The "buttercream" frosting tasted like straight butter, and it's not sweet at all.

Make sure you shop around and check reviews!  I won't use this company again.

We called Approved Painting this August 2013 to get an estimate to paint our house.  The owner Bill, came over to give us an estimate.  He was very nice and even came over on Sunday to accommodate our schedule. He gave us an estimate which was pretty much average. We agreed on starting the job at the end of August. We knew the shade that we wanted but we weren't sure exactly which color.  

He came by the house one day while we were at work at put two samples on the wall at the rear of the house.  We weren't to crazy about either and asked him to show us two more shades. He told us that he wanted to start painting the next week which was two weeks before we had agreed on. The day he came to put the last two samples his crew started prepping the house for painting.  We still had not chosen a shade and felt rushed to do so.  We have children and both work. We have very busy schedules.  

We wanted the trim of the house to be a little darker than the color of the house. He said he could do that by making the actual color used on the house a little darker. Once the house was finished, you couldn't even tell that the trim was darker. It all looked the same color! And that wasn't just our opinion it was also the opinion of several neighbors and friends.  He was already paid in full! I called him and expressed my concern to him but he didn't seem convinced and said that it would be an extra $400.00 or more to change the color of the trim. 

He came over  and we both looked at the house and he still disagreed with me when it was so obvious that the house looked as if it was all just one color.  I also pointed out some areas of the house that they missed and the front and rear door where they used a brush on the edges after using a sprayer on the rest of it. . . very sloppy! He agreed with that and even looked around and said that they would come back, fix those areas and clean the cement walkway where they had spilled paint.

Again, we felt rushed to find a shade that we wanted for them to use on the trim/pop-out of the house because he was sending his crew at the end of that week! I took the time out to make several trips to H.D. trying to find the right color and buying multiple samples of paint! Finally found one that we liked and selected that one. 

He sent his crew and changed the color of ONLY  the pop-out for a much smaller fee. They also fixed SOME of those ares that they missed while painting. They NEVER cleaned our cement and the owner never came back or called to see if we were happy with his work and never gave us a receipt even after I asked him for one. 

So now we will have to find time out of our hectic schedules to paint the areas that they missed and clean the cement ourselves! 

 Next time I will use another company!

My favorite spot on State Street. The food and drinks are yummy and affordable--I recommend the passionfruit juice, the salmon, and of course the pão de queijo. Santa Barbara food is a little homogenous (read: boring) so this place offers some much-needed uniqueness and flair. I've never eaten Brazilian cuisine before, but eating here made me want to try more.

The atmosphere is somehow both lively and relaxed. I came on a rainy day, so there weren't many people, but the restaurant was playing some upbeat music, and the place definitely felt alive. The decor and lighting almost takes you out of SB and makes you feel like you're in, well, a cafe in Brazil. I sat down for a while and read a magazine, and I noticed a few other people doing work at their tables. Others were chatting and hanging out. It's a great atmosphere for both.

This place is a gem in Santa Barbara, and I'm really glad it's here! Give this place a shot, especially if you're a bit tired of Santa Barbara's repetitive food scene.

On my way leaving Nashville I wanted to take home some bbq. Being from St. Louis my standards of good BBQ are set pretty high. I measured this place like any other with my 2 initial criteria. The first being is it in an Urban area. We all know BBQ in Urban areas seem to have that FLAVA! My second criteria is can I smell the BBQ outside of the restaurant?
At first sight and scent JCB had 2 of 2 check marks.
When I went inside I was happy to see the meat was already ready and I didn't have to wait long for my order. It was sort of buffett style where you tell the server what you want as you go down the line. 
I noticed that the portions were a bit skimpy so that was a turn off especially for the price of a plate with 2 sides. I got a brisket kids plate with mac and cheese and baked beans and a rib plate with beans and potato salad and a chicken plate with beans and greens. 
I took the vinegar and the kc bbq sauce home to try.
Upon eating my brisket and the sauce it all seemed like it had an over hickory flavor to the point where it was a bit bitter tasting. The brisket was tender enough and the mac and cheese was between kraft and stoffer's so that was about a 2 out of 4 for me. Four being homemade. The beans once again had that rich over smokey taste that made them a little bitter. The ribs and chicken I took to family members and they raved about the ribs. They said they were EXCELLENT and they loved the flavor of them. I will have to take them at their word because they are rib enthusiasts and have tested many. They said the chicken was average.
I personally am used to a half chicken being much bigger than what we got. The vinegar based sauce tasted more like salsa and the kc was ok but once again that bitter taste got me. I didn't taste the greens but they smelled really good.
I would not go back here if I came to Nashville again but I guess it was worth the try. My experience at Central BBQ in Downtown Memphis was much better.
This place is one of the most consistent in Doylestown. Spicy salmon skin salad is amazing. One of the only places my entire family likes to eat.

we ordered the 20pc wings and you can have them served on different sauces with different dips. we also ordered the onion rings and coleslaw. all tasted good. the wings are wonderful and cooked perfectly. not too crispy and not the soft skinned ones, just right crispiness in them. topped with onion rings and coleslaw and a glass of yuengling, sam adams boston lager and the chocolate beer was pefect! will try sandwiches next time :) definetly try it!

The bank that gets the most flack. I have been with Bank of America for a long time and I have not had any real grievances with them but I've heard other people's stories. Close to my job and convenient when needed.

When you approach the restaurant you are likely going to see a line. Don't be discouraged. It moves pretty quickly and is well worth the wait. 

Try the chargrilled oysters and Oyster Rockefeller soup.  So good.

Have eaten here many times. Lovely, comfy  atmosphere with great friendly service. Love the pad Thai  but today I tried the Hunan shrimp. it had just enough spice. The lunch specials are great. I think the hibachi chicken is still my favorite here, and the fried rice is so delicately flavored it taste like pad thai.

I must say I was pretty disappointed.... I was thinking with all of the 'boom' in downtown Nashville that surely, the Doubletree is keeping up, but I was mistaken. The rooms are soooo dated! I've been to a Holiday Inn that was more modern. The best thing, was the bed! It sleeps well, but the lighting was dull, no refrigerator, dull carpet. They need to duplicate the liveliness of the lobby, in the rooms.... I won't be going back. There's too many other options.

One of the best places in Philadelphia.  Food is incredible, everything on the menu is delicious.  Even better than the delicious food is the wonderful staff and super friendly owners who treat you like family every time your there.  Highly recommend!!
Pasta Viex Carre is fabulous. Great service. We were all happy with our food. Piano live entertainment.

This review is only for their eyebrow waxing service and not their manicures. I hate to give a bad review, but the waxing and customer service were bad on a level I've never experienced before. I came in to get my eyebrows waxed with the shape of my eyebrows pretty defined and tweezed already. I needed a simple clean up around the browbone. When I asked to get a wax, the salon owner was not very attentive and didn't seem to have someone qualified to wax. She had a short conversation with a girl who apparently was recently trained to wax. I'm ok with a little error given she wasn't that experienced but the whole wax was excruciatingly uncomfortable and painful. First, they used cheap pink wax that kept breaking apart. The girl kept mentioning that I had fine hair on my browbone and how she couldn't wax it (even though at other salons I've had no problem or anyone unprofessionally commenting about it). She then proceeded to use brow scissors to try to cut the hair and actually left me with a small scab/scar when she pierced my browbone skin. I discovered this when I came home because she failed today mention her mistake. When I went to check out, the salon owner was completely inattentive and kept scrolling on her phone. I paid in cash and she went back to looking at her phone without giving me change. I literally had to initiate everything about the transaction, telling her what I got done to asking for a receipt. I tipped because you should always tip, but I will never come back because it was downright impolite and uncourteous to ignore your customer trying to pay (with no line either!).

This place is my obsession. Since I've moved to Nashville, I've tried (and hated) so many nail salons, and none of them come close to Poppy. 

While I will say that the prices are higher than most nail salons, with that comes exceptional service, unbeatable nail art, beautiful design, inspired product assortment, the list goes on. It's also worth noting that it's not one of those places you can just pop in for a manicure. It's becoming increasingly popular, so you have to book your appointments in advance, especially if you have a specific artist that you prefer. If the prices were lower, I imagine it would be even busier and therefore harder to secure an appointment. 

I love the diverse employees, all women of different shapes, sizes, and colors, and they do a great job of making everyone feel welcome, pampered and taken care of. Since Ive been coming to this salon over a year, I love to talk and catch up with the artists, but if you're more of a silent, enjoy-your-spa-experience type of person, they'll give you that too. 

There are so many positive aspects of this place, and you can really tell that everyone involved loves their job. Its also so important to support a business of hard working, incredibly skilled women. 

Also- how have I not mentioned the nails? I get so many compliments on my manicures, and the best part is that you can indulge guilt free, since this is a non-toxic, clean beauty haven. 

I attached a few photos of some of my own mani's that i've gotten here. You can't go wrong with any of the nail artists, but some of my favorites are Claire and Yasheka! 

Five stars, 100 emoji, praise hands emoji, A+, big hugs to everyone involved.

This place is the cutest! Duckies wandering around, bunnies & piggies to pet. ALL of the cutest plants! And the service is on point. Staff is friendly, chatty, & knowledgeable. They were kind & helpful in repotting my cacti family for me! 10/10 & 100% recommended!

Amazing food for a basic diner. Deb had a perfect pork tenderloin with fresh green beans made with bacon and onion. I had the famous beef and noodles.  It does melt in your mouth. Paired with mashed taters and gravy and a very fresh side salad.

I really enjoy the atmosphere in Millennium Nails it is quiet, clean, and comfortable. They are always very friendly when I call to make an appointment and I also feel that its not too hard to get a walk in appointment. Their $35 dollar manicure and pedicure can't be beat especially with other places that are pricier on Germantown Ave. My nails last pretty long and I always feel like they do a good job. I have found with other places they tend to skimp on the hand massage or with cleaning up your nails. However at Millennium Nails they automatically do a good job! its great ! I definitely recommend.
Wonderful! We went for breakfast. Great service...so friendly. Enjoyed the pancakes. Chicken sausage was very yummy!

I stayed at this Hilton for the first of many business trips to St. Louis. I usually opt for another larger brand but stayed at this location because another co worker already had made his reservations here. The check in was easy and they looked up my Hilton Honors account that I hadn't used in a long time. The big disappointment came when I got to my first room. I have several allergies, one of which is dust. When I walked into my room it was everywhere. The door trims, above the light switch plates, the fire sprinklers, light fixtures, both air vents were caked with dust. 

I called the front desk and they were nice enough to run me up keys to another room. It was less dusty but far from what I would consider reasonable, with or without allergies. 

Some other comments that make me concerned about the level of cleanliness that can't be seen by the naked eye:

No fitted sheets
Visible residue on the bathroom vanity, it looks like it was wiped with a dirty towel. 
Stains on furniture
"Note pad" was 1 3"X3" sheet of paper with dirty stains on the back. 
Hilton information card is dirty and stained. 
A random non Hilton pen was left on the counter, with a Hilton pen. 
Floor and wall trims are falling off
Smoke stained ceiling above the smoke detector. 
The shower drained very slow 3-4 minutes of shower resulted in 4"+ deep water. (It's gross because you have no idea if the tub is even clean)

I stayed in the West tower and it's pretty rough. The east tower is newer, but my coworker is texting me now at 10:40 at night because maintenance is replacing his dust caked air conditioner because it's leaking water all over the floor. 

I considered 2 stars, but the fact that this room is costing me $200/night after taxes and fees it's not going to happen.

UPDATE: I was moved to the nicer East tower and given some Hilton Honors Points. The new room is much better than the last. +1 star.
They serve very high quality meat and sides, though the showmanship of all the fires was a little much for a nice dinner.  I had the bone in rib-eye and it was cooked to perfection.

First time using Junk Shot and had to say I was so impressed!!!  Julius and Jose were very professional yet friendly.  They showed up on time, gave me a very reasonable quote and started working as soon as I accepted the quote.  All the junk was out the door in minutes!  Will definitely use them again in the future.

If you're wondering if Blackbird pizza still has "it", they do. I highly recommend the BBQ wings, which only got tastier and more addictive as I went on. 

Overall, there's not a ton of seating area so I would probably recommend takeout, pickup, or stopping only for quick eats. Service is average speed, so don't expect fast-food level quickness.
At least half a dozen trips and they always manage to screw something up. Staff looks as if they hate life.

This place is most definitely a hidden gem. Originally we were aiming for Wing Stop. They were closed for whatever reason (very unprofessional establishment anyway might I add), but I was determined to get my wings one way or another. So I went online and found this place that wasn't too far. Best decision ever. The inside is decorated nicely. It's Baseball themed which I think is very unique. They have a bar you can sit at, as well as plenty of regular seating. They have big screen tvs all around so it really gives you that "Bar atmosphere." The workers are friendly, and the service is surprisingly quick for it to be a smaller business. If you're like me and you enjoy smaller wings over those gigantic ones you'll most definitely love this place. They have a variety of sauces, but I went for my usual lemon pepper and it was SO GOOD. They even let you get the wing sauces/seasonings on your fries. We got to meet the owner, and he's so friendly. It's always a plus when the business is black owned! I have no complaints at all with this place, and I can't wait to go back and try more.

Been here a couple times. Food is extremely good for a Mexican restaurant in America. Servers and staff have always been extremely polite and friendly and restaurant is always clean. 
They have a great kid's menu for the little ones. I do find the food a little on the pricier side for Mexican restaurant, but overall wonderful. We will continue to dine here.

Oh my gosh. We stopped here for dinner before Brantley Gilbert concert. Our friends are from the area and love this place. They kept talking it up so I was excited to try it out. 

They did not disappoint. 

The food was amazing, we all ordered something different and each plate was delicious. We all tried a bite from each plate. Plate presentation was on point and the portions are good. 

I ordered the chicken nunzio. If I'm ever in the area, it will definitely be ordered again.  The chicken is moist and packed w flavor. Of course the crab meat and provel add to the flavor. Garlic mashed potatoes and green beans were just as good. 

The others at the table ordered chicken spidieni, ny strip, and filet nunzio....  yum. 

Highly recommend people stop in. Ambiance is great. Prefect for date night or just a casual night. It is in the higher price scale, but totally worth it.

This place was just okay for me. I had really high expectations but the food fell flat. Everything seemed under seasoned. The food was just okay. It is more affordable than other steakhouses but the food was bland. The best thing in the menu was the Caesar salad. That was probably one of the best salads I've had.

Malgo, was great! I came in with a dress that was way too big on me (even though I ordered what was recommended according to my measurements). She eased my stress away with each appointment by working her magic. Her attention to detail and care for the dress was just incredible. At the end, my dress fitted like a glove. Malgo was just so kind and sweet to me throughout the whole process. I cannot rave enough about her! Would recommend her in a heart beat!

My husband and I went there for the first time and LOVED this place. Will definitely go back to try something different although we loved our first meal. My husband actually said that it was really good which is high praise from him. He had the tri-tip sandwich. I ordered the sliders with grilled onions and sweet potato fries from the appetizers menu. Great portions for the price. The sliders were fully loaded and then with the grilled onions?? Soooo good as were the fries. Can't wait to go back! And, the staff was super!

Very casual and located in a little shopping strip behind the 7-11. Not fancy but well worth the trip.

This is the best Chinese fast food in the Northwest Reno area.  The owners are very friendly and the restaurant is well maintained and clean.  The fried rice is excellent as well as the other dishes.  This locally owned restaurant definitely beats other national chain restaurants.  Great prices and generous portions.
Red beans and rice.  All you can eat on Tuesday.   Great food.  Great service.  Authentic Cajun.

I ordered a phone online and picked it up at this store. The person that gave me the phone did not ask if I needed help with anything;  activating or accessories. When I got to my car it was the wrong phone. I took it back into the store the individual was very defensive.
 When I returned home and opened the box I realized I didn't want to try and figure it out myself or go back to this store so I decided to return it. I called customer service and customer service told me to take it back to the store and there would be no charge since it wasn't even turned on. 
When I went back to the store I was told there would be a restocking fee even though the phone had not been touched. I said Customer Service told me differently. He argued with me and told me it was policy period. I said I had been a customer since 2002 and that I would be changing carriers if you could not do this little thing for me. He said "sorry" as he smiled and I walked out the door. It was obvious he didn't care.
I called Verizon Customer Service and they are sending me a return box, crediting my credit card fully and not charging a restocking fee. So much for in person customer service.

Tried Geno's and Pats. I hate that they only take cash... So be prepared or you'll have to withdrawal $20 which is actually $23 after the ATM fee for a mediocre sandwich that cost $9.50. Everything about a cheesesteak counts and the only way genos is better than pats is they have better bread.

So I was really craving a gyro and I had to be in BRipp tonight anyways, so I figured tonight was the night I would try Sam's!

I love hipster Mediterranean vibe that the restaurant gives, its super chill and uniquely decorated, and my waitress fit right in.  She was really great, and she always made sure I was taken care of!

My gyro was ok. Just ok.  I ordered the lunch special with the half sandwich half salad and the greek salad was...again, just ok.  Nothing special.  I don't know if it was just because I had high expectations for this place having super authentic food, or maybe my pallet is just not fine tuned to the Mediterranean ways quite yet, but I just was under impressed.  

I have to say that for the price I paid ($9.80) I was DEFINITELY not happy about my lunch choice.  The portions were large, but thats not saying too much when you aren't crazy about the dish in the first place. 

I'll definitely give this place another go, I'm not one to give up that easily, but next time I will surely be trying something different and not having my expectations as high as my first go at things.

This place is awesome!  I went in for a slice after driving by one day and was impressed with the pizza & the people. 

We now get whole pies, pasta, desserts, you name it!  And the prices are really good. I think we pay about $11 for a large cheese pizza. Not bad!

If there was anything I would suggest that they could do, it would be to clean the front door; leaving the shop always makes me cringe.
Great gym! Our kids love coming every week. Staff and coaches are great and very helpful.

We always eat here when we visit Reno, regardless of what hotel we stay in.  The filet mignon is always cooked perfectly (finally a chef that knows what "medium" should look like!).  They also bring out a very small bowl of something called the "chef's amusement" prior to your meal.  Now, if they had told me before what was going to be in the bowl, I would have told them not to bother as I am not what you would call an adventurous eater (smoked salmon, apple slices, dill, some type of coleslaw for the fall menu this year).  But after my husband rave about it I scooped it up and my only complaint is - I wanted more!  I'm not a fan of those items in general sans salmon, but the combination was amazing.  The customer service also can't be beat - the manager always makes sure to come over and ensure we are satisfied and the waitress was great.   Now, it's a little pricy I will admit - but you get what you pay for.

Best food truck in the city, without question. I've been enjoying Scratch since they opened, and my order hasn't changed: scratch burger with fries. You can't go wrong with a classic. The bacon marmalade is UNREAL, the arugula on the burger is a great surprising flavor combination with the sweet bacon flavors, and the buns are excellent. The fries... oh the fries, they're wonderful too. Perfectly seasoned, and great dipped in some ketchup. Don't put ketchup on the burger though, it doesn't belong!

We heard about this place on a "Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives" episode I watched recently. Since we're temporarily staying in Tampa for medical appointments, we just had to go try it out.

First thing to notice is the huge outdoor bar area that is separate from the inside seating. Both have their own appeal and this time we chose to sit inside because the weather was chilly that night.  It's a neat area to have a beer and watch people strolling through Ybor City.

We waited the estimated 45 minutes before being seated - not bad because of the above-referenced drinking and people-watching opportunity.

Our server was excellent from start to finish. I have some special requests due to my medical condition and she was very thoughtful about fulfilling them and even anticipating some. 

Our group chose the wings and housemade blue cheese dipping sauce. I had the ranch dipping sauce which was also very good. (My diet restricts me from having blue cheese or feta cheese, darn it!)  

The beer cheese soup was simply delicious and as good as Guy Fieri said it is.

My husband chose "The Bomb" burger - encased in pizza dough. He ate every bit of it and it is huge!

Another in our group ordered the 15th Street burger and declared it yummy.

I had the cheeseburger, again because of my diet, had to forego the onions and other fresh toppings and it had to be well done. In spite of that, the cook managed to keep some moisture and taste in the burger and I was satisfied with that.

The fries are very good - hand cut and cooked to perfection.

Now for the dessert of the day - a trifle made with all sorts of chocolate, caramel sauce infused with one of their beers, whipped cream. I've forgotten all of the ingredients in this wonderful creation. Our group shared one and agreed unanimously that it was simply the best dessert we've ever had!

We would definitely go again. There's a fun but comfortable atmosphere along with another very long bar and t.v.'s which don't detract from the enjoyable feeling we got. Thanks again, Guy, for recommending it!

Stopped here for dinner based on reviews and it was in walking distance to the hotel we were staying in.  The weather was beautiful that Saturday evening so we dined outside.  Our server was Sam and she was delightful and attentive.  Unfortunately, our meals were not as impressive.
Appetizer:
Gamberi E Proscuitto Croccante - Good
Main Dishes:
Pappardelle Boscaiola - little meat for the amount of pasta, good flavor, reminded me of a fettuccine alfredo with bits of meat.
Cioppino: 
Usually this dish is seafood in a savory broth or stew.  This version was more of a sauce with seafood. Flavor was ok, just lacked the savory version we were expecting.
I wouldn't say the meals justify the cost.
Such a fun and authentically New Orleans culinary experience! Lives up to the hipe. And the staff are wonderful. Truly enjoyed this dinner.

jambalaya is nasty...tastes like they putt bbq sauce in it and the food is very expensive for the quality. Service was slow, took 90 minutes to get in and out and thank god we had cash for the bill because the food server kept disappearing.

High class place, which means high prices. I went there for the first time I was impressed by the atmosphere. Food was delicious, especially their bang bang shrimp. The only two things I didn't like was the slow service, even though they weren't very packed since it was a Tuesday. And the second thing was the paper covering the table tops. Very  ghetto. Too ghetto for such a nice restaurant

Their food has always been good but their service sucks. I never know whether or not to seat ourselves. You stand at the door and they tell you to sit anywhere then when u come in the next time you seat yourself while they have an extended conversation amongst themselves then someone finally comes over to give you menus. We were the only customers so it's not like they were busy and I made eye contact with the staff when we walked in.  Then once we were finished eating the waitress finally brought our bill and box and said "your pizza and bill are over here" as she placed it on another table.  Odd.  So my daughter picked up the bill which wasn't even totaled up?  Needless to say, that was the first time I have ever tipped less than 20%.
Food is very good.  Grandma's pizza is the best. The website they use for delivery is the worst to the point we stopped ordering from there

A different kind of bookstore, more like a curated collection of unique and fascinating books. 
 I'm surprised by the comments about customer service; when I asked for help I got it right away, with good suggestions, otherwise I was left alone which I like. 
 Yes, it's small but the way it's organized encourages rewarding exploration. I always come across something I didn't know I needed, and leave with a few gems. 
 Just come in ready to browse and leave that wet umbrella at the door. If you love books, you're in the right place!

Giving this review in hopes things change. Management will higher or pay more.

I traveled the day before and after thanksgiving.

TSA was fine, the airport maintenance was bad. Bathrooms were gross, not kept up. Low inventories of bathroom goods, like TP. Dirty bathroom. I went to 3-4 bathrooms. To hunt a decent one.

Outside of the bathrooms, the airport (floors, walls, tables,Vending stock) itself also looked low maintained.

Same for the restaurants in the airport, low maintenance and dirty.

Right off the bat they were nearly impossible to reach on the phone. Each time I tried to call to make an appointment, I'd get immediately put on hold and then left there to wait and wonder for minutes... Sadly, that's not all that unusual for businesses in New Orleans, so I went ahead and made an appointment anyway (in person), based mostly on a good recommendation from a friend. I just wanted a brake check because the front pads had started intermittently squealing. I was shocked and overwhelmed when they called me a few hours after I dropped it off to learn that I needed "a complete overhaul" on my brakes, both front and rear. They quoted me a range between $1,400 - $1,600, depending on labor, but "generously" offered to give me a ~$150 discount in the event I decided to finance the huge bill by opening a Firestone credit card. Gee, thanks. Anyway, long story short, after having my Dad call and receive an assurance that it was in fact safe for me to take a road trip (home to St. Louis) before having any of the work done, I was very pleasantly surprised to learn from my trusted family mechanic in the St. Louis, Mo area that no brake work was necessary. NONE. After a brief celebration at the "savings" I'd realized, we decided to report the issue to Firestone Corporate. They assured us they'd look into it and apologized for the "confusion," but we still haven't heard anything back. Needless to say, I wouldn't trust this place.

I have passed by this place on my way to the breakfast station for three  years; however , today to avoid the nonsense menu of  the station
whereby no item under $8.00, and poor seniors be dammed , my wife suggested a pit stop at the Boulevard fr.  this was an honest mistake.
The Boulevard is the place you tell tourists to NEVER GO THERE1   The day  we arrived  the kitchen was out of coleslaw,.  and substituted 
a fruit cup of skined grapes to save money.; also they don't toast burger buns, serve leftover french fries pieces and stems, and mustard in
penny packs.  The help wanted sign in the doorway says it all.  Send kitchen and wait help! In the meantime I will be a regular customer some where else.

We have had an issue with our dryer not a fully drying. I called Hemi's and they scheduled an appointment within 24 hours. JD called on his way over, quickly diagnosed the problem and gave us a reasonable quote before doing the work. Very courteous and professional, receipts via email so helps with digital side,  and offered to let us pay using Venmo or PayPal if we wanted.   Will keep in mind for the future.

Really disappointed. 40 minute line for over-salted, mediocre food. $78 for four biscuit dishes and coffees and an order of Bonuts. Yikes. Biscuits were nothing what I had hoped for. Ever had Loveless biscuits? I guess I thought I would have had  something similar. Not really even biscuits. More like greasy little dry cakes. Cheese grits? Bland. The sausage is in a word: weird. The Bonuts were nothing close to special. Bacon: undercooked. Two stars only because of an incredibly attentive and friendly staff. Off the list. Bummer.
Hipster haven. The food is delicious & fresh. They have so many options for fresh pressed juice as well. Pancakes are great. Totally worth a visit.

Bayou Beer Garden is a super cool spot to frequent to enjoy a wide variety of beers. There are plenty of TVs to watch sports and I really enjoyed the outdoor patio in the back. Don't let the front part of the bar fool you into thinking it's a tiny place. There is a huge area in back!
This pizza is fresh! I just finished the eggplant, and it is good. The dough is freshly made, and the ricotta is top quality. Highly recommended for a delicious lunch. Pefect size.

This is the spot in Plainfield you want to take your family or friends for a celebration or just a Friday night dinner out. They have the best ketchup in Indiana .... yes.... I said ketchup! Their fresh cut fries are great too. I'm not really a salad person typically, but the gorgenberry pecan is my go-to. Nice draft beer selection too and the management and staff are consistently on top of things. We've gone here probably 40 times since it opened.

Strange place.  I think they should take some of the money they spend on the gazillion TVs and put some of it into maintaining their furniture and tableware. Most of the chairs seem to be broken and the silverware was so scuffed. ew. BUT, the drinks are large for the price, they seem to have good happy hour specials, and the food was decent.  My Cajun Chicken Philly was flavorful and I love that you can have a salad as a side for free. I hate the standard skanky outfits of the waitresses too. Clearly my husband dragged me here.

I'm a local cyclist who works downtown and needed some help.

They had a sign that they don't look at anything/work for free.

I told them the issue I was having, and they helped immediately, took a couple minutes, no charge.

I think the fact that I was somewhat bike savvy and had a bike that I take care of may have affected their treatment.  The person riding a 4 year old bike that has never seen a cleaning and barely knows which side is the front (handlebar side) may get different treatment.

Great spot! I went here on a Saturday afternoon. I ordered inside and it was so nice! I only got a hot chai tea latte, but the pastries they had on display looked really good, which I will definitely be getting next time! The prices are also very reasonable here too. I love local coffee shops and I'm glad this spot is now open!

It has been a sheer enjoyment to have my arteries close a little
bit more this evening. My visit to the Lobster was a delight!
Our server was top notch, checked up on us frequently....
promptly served chilled Caesar salads, drinks quickly presented.
And my meal was a belly stretchin' hub cap platter known by
many as the "Admiral's Feast" Oh Boy!!! And slap a butter and
sour cream oozing fluffy baked potato on that bad boy plate.

You just can't go wrong with fried seafood.....Yeah okay, you're
saying " It's Red Lobster....Olive Garden's little brother" They ain't
got no good stuff. Well you would be wrong tonight. They have
improved over the years. So I say proudly "I LIKE RED LOBSTER"

If you ever find yourself having a Cookie Monster-like craving then this is a good place to get your cookies from. My only disappointment is that on my last 2 visits they haven't had my favorite chocolate-chocolate chip with walnuts cookies. No biggie as I quickly found some other substitutions to satisfy the sweet tooth.

This is one of STL's hidden gems! They do an amazing fish and chips as well as a lot of traditional Scottish food. They took off their brideies which were amazing but did replace them with a lamb filled puff pastry which is pretty good. They also have a great cheese board which is a must get! Their seasonal/daily offerings are constantly changing but are always spot on.

This was my first time giving JA Ramen a try, let me start by saying that this place is way over priced for Ramen.  I don't mind paying good $ but the Ramen better be amazing. Well, this ramen was anything but that.   The broth in the ramen when it arrived was like warm at best.  The noodles in the broth were not ramen noodles they were I kid you not angel hair pasta disguised as ramen noodles.  This ranks at almost the bottom of my list of places to eat ramen in Tucson. I was hoping it would be great but was disappointed on so many levels.  I would not recommend this to anyone for ramen.  Although the smell and look of the curry was amazing.

This place is adorable!  You totally feel like your somewhere in Europe when you arrive...well, that is until the emo wait staff come to your table. Lol!  They are all sweet, but it's a definite contrast to the pretty and delicate interior design. The only other odd thing was that they had Elton John's best of hits on repeat. Lol. Luckily I like Sir Elton.  But all of that is totally offset by the incredible food and decor. Ahhhhhh...  If Yelp would let us do half stars, I'd give it 4.5....but I didn't feel right downing to the 4, because the quirks didn't warrant that. I had the crepe with sunny side egg, creamed spinach, bacon and Gruyere. Yummmmm....  My hubby had the croissant sammy, which he loved. And we both loved our lattes. Great place!

Gorgeous and stylish. Comfortable and clean. The service is super friendly and clearly everyone has been directed to be as kind and as professional as possible. 
This is absolutely the best location in terms of historical old city Philadelphia. Everything is close by. I think this will be my new place to stay when I come back to Philadelphia.

We love going for the Saturday and Sunday Brunch!  food always hot and the service is awesome. You have a choice of inside or outside dinning. I would suggest to reserve your spot through Yelp to save time
This is some delicious pizza and amazing breadstick! The ambience is relaxing, the food is delicious, and the service is great. Will definitely be back!

The best thing about the coming around of summer is the theater season at The Muny. Oh how I love going to see whatever plays there. Sitting outdoors at night among the other theatergoers, watching and enjoying everything around me.

Each time that I have been I never have once paid for a single ticket. Yes! The man has not gotten a single dollar from me when it comes to theatrical performances in St. Louis. Really I would not mind paying for a ticket, but since there is a free section and if you get there early enough, front couple of rows are just as good as the tickets you pay for. If you are lucky enough, as I have been a couple of times, you can get the front row of free tickets right behind the row of people who paid for a seat, knowing that their view and just about the same as yours, only you didn't have to pay.

While I don't go see every single play that is put on, the ones that I do go and see I enjoy. Because of that reason, I always like to go along with friends and family where we can all have a nice night together.

If no one told you, you need a guide to visit the cemetery in the French Quarter.  There is no better walking guide than the Voodoo Bone Lady.  I had the opportunity to having her direct the tour herself.  She's very skilled at sharing her story while also giving you insight and knowledge about the French Quarter.  I recommend that you make sure you take one of her tours as soon as you get into New Orleans because she also provides you with helpful hints about the area.  My only regret is that I wasn't able to book more tours or visit her new shop.
i really had a great experience here this morning.  i went in totally frazzled needing to have five copies of a 500+ page manuscript printed by noon, and the staff was really, really great.

I like the El Dorado but a huge complaint is the disgusting perfuming smell that they have pumping through the vents. Other than that, it's a great casino. I love the chicken, apple, walnut salad at Brew Brothers. I have been eating that salad there for ~ 20 years. It's the only thing I eat when I go there. Everyone is always very pleasant and they have the best parking garage of all the casinos.

This was my first visit. As I was walking in I saw lots of people and almost every table full. That gave me the feeling I was going to have some good food. The Corner Bakery Cafe did not disappoint. Tasty food, fast service gave me a great experience. I will be returning soon and often.

Twinz used to be my favorite place in Tampa. Amazing burgers and hotdogs. The Twinz Tampa bay dog and garlic parm fries were priceless! It looks like they've closed, I'm hoping they can open up again, it was truly a great place and the owners did a good job of making customers feel welcome.

Parking here can be a little tight if you're coming at prime-coffee-time...but that'll probably be the only issue you encounter. The store is pretty big inside and the employees seem to be adhering to COVID precautions pretty darn well. My drink came just as I expected it to, so overall I left happy and would definitely return.

Just okay...the ambiance is better than their ale and a thousand times better than the bartender.  The guy with more muscle than brain was SUCH a jerk.  Just slammed glasses down in front of you and didn't bother to listen to questions. I could see if it was crowded but it was late on a Sunday evening and there were probably 6 seats open at the bar.  When a group of sorority girls came in he complained out loud to "Holly" and begrudgingly served them.  He needs to learn people skills and eye contact if they plan on keeping him. Holly prompted the 3 stars. Otherwise between the 3 I sampled and his attitude I would have given it a 1

I must say this was kind of disappointing.  I expected better with such great reviews.  Maybe I caught them on an off night.  I walked in solo around 8:30 on a Tuesday night.  Was greeted and Sat promptly, there were only three other tables taken up.  With a $$ rating I was surprised to find the place kind of pricey actually.  I pursued the menu, and was disappointed to see that their specialty cocktails were all made with Vodka, for a place that lists spirits on their exterior sign I expected a wider variety, oh well, went with a glass of Pinot Noir (Kris was the brand) and I did not much care for it.  Too flowery for my liking but that is no ones fault.  

Ordered the Tortellini with prosciutto and peas, was informed it comes with a choice of soup or salad, I got the cauliflower soup.  It was very meh, oily and nothing special at all.  Tortellini was ok, the sauce was a little too rich for me tho, after a few bites I felt like I had eaten a stick of butter.  Bread that was served to start with was nice and warm but the butter was too hard to spread.  

The servers were very nice but the bus boy got on my nerves.  He kept trying to remove things from my table before I was done with them.  I felt rushed, so I figured they were trying to close and asked what time do they shut down only to be told that the kitchen stops at 9:30 and it wasn't even 9 yet, so why rush me? 

The restaurant is very pretty and had a nice ambiance, but next time I want Italian in the area I will go to Michael's.

This place is very small! We're so glad we stopped in though. They serve wood fired, Neapolitan style pizza. Only the best ingredients are used here! I like that you can order a  generous slice, or other different sizes of pizza. The prices seemed reasonable too. All of the workers were friendly and helpful. We will definitely bring the rest of the family back!

My review will be based on my experiences on Football Sundays rather than their night time operations. My friends and I use to go to Maloney's every Sunday for Football but have stopped this season. I feel that the overall service from the staff has come down drastically and that whomever is in charge of the TVs lacks knowledge for their position. I cant count how many times I was in the middle of watching a particular game, just to have the TV changed to another game. This is very frustrating. With all the TV they have, I don't understand how they cant get this done correctly.

Food wise, they have a OK deal w/ the $5 menu, but the quality of food isn't worth $5. Three sliders for $5? Two hot dogs for $5. I would say the best value would be the Bottomless French Fries, but they are so salty you can only really do two rounds.

The drink special is usually 2 for 1, which is good if you stick with beer. Besides that everything is so expensive that your probably paying what would be fair price for two drinks.

Basically, its poor execution that kills this place (haha, you see what I did there). I think once they get the right management and staff on Sundays, this place can be fun to catch a game at again.

I would give more stars if I could!!! This place has got it going on!

The food...is...BOMB. Their chicken is so crisp juicy and flavorful, and the bulgogi beef is popping with spice but not TOO much spice for those who are sensitive (like me). The crab rangoons have big flakey pieces of crab. All of the ingredients mix together so well, every bite is DIVINE! 

The staff are so nice too! Everything is super clean and organized. 

I tried this place for the first time and was back for another meal within 24 hours. 

I live a solid 30 minutes from this place, but the drive is absolutely worth it.
Tried the dimsum menu for lunch.  Shiu-mai, pork buns and steamed dumplings and rice cake were all good.  Appetizer of fired calamari was good.  Overall, very good food but slow service.

So one of my girl friends has suggested to come see HK at this salon. And I'm so grateful she did because I will forever be seeing HK to get my nails done! :) I called and at first they said she had appointments booked all day so I said I'll call again tomorrow. Then they called me back and said she had made some time for me to come in; it was so nice of them as they clearly want to make their customers happy and they work around your availability. HK was so welcoming and sweet and told me she was gonna give me "Pinterest nails", I'm like girllllll hook it up! Haha, and she did! I'm so pleased with my experience. Best mani-pedi I've had in a while! Thanks so much HK! You've got yourself another loyal client.

Debbie at Debbie's Pet Sitting provides excellent care for my animals! It is so nice to have peace of mind, knowing that our pets are being taken care of by someone who loves them almost as much as I do! Highly recommended!

Classic A-OK. 
Fine experience. Nice atmosphere. Good food. Service is a bit canned...as in you can hear the servers saying the same thing to every table. 
We went for a special occasion and left kind of feeling ... OK
It feels a bit like a chain restaurant

I was almost involved in a very serious accident at 44 and Southwest this morning with a representative of this company. He obviously doesn't know what the term "yield" means. He decided to show me how big of a man he is by pulling in front of me on the highway and locking his breaks up. I came very close to slamming into the back of his work truck. I got the license plates and contacted the Police over this. If you are looking for a landscaping company, do NOT contact this one. The employees are trash who have no regard for safety. The one that nearly killed this morning is a total POS. I will make sure everyone, including strangers, avoid this business. 
Ps-i would like to also add this is the THIRD negative review this company has had about their rude, careless drivers.

My second fave donut shop in STL. Great old fashioned donuts. Fluffy and delicious. I prefer the marble or chocolate glazed but they have goof variety here. Watch out though, there's often a line, especially in the morning on weekends.
What a great find! Seating is all outside but plenty of umbrellas to provide shade. The buffalo shrimp and drunken shrimp were amazing. Service was great! Will be back!

Watch out they have nothing . Lol most of the stuff is not available. Like ice cream , most bread , chicken . Last time was here they didn't had straws . If you for pancakes, you are probably fine , anyways breakfast I think most of the stuff available but lunch and dinner- forget it .
We had a broken spring on our garage door. Called at about 4:30 pm, and scheduled service for the following day. Serviceman was on time and completed the job quickly. Price was just as expected.

A colleague from out of town and I went there for lunch and drinks (day drinking on the clock) and had a great time.  It was really warm for November so the bartender told us we could sit outside if we wanted and we did.  Cute beer garden!  Their lunch menu is pretty limited but we just wanted sandwiches so it met our needs.  They said they were getting ready to expand the menu though.  We had a couple ciders and beers that were really good too.  The crowd was really light on a Monday at lunch time but that just meant we had even better service speaking with the bartender and one of the brewers.  Nice place and more quaint than the location in the Grove.
Great juice options, affordable for the amount and you get to reuse a bottle and get $2 off!!!  Anytime I'm in SB, I will go here.  They are great and their staff is helpful.

Let me start with my favorite word: Bacon. 

Ok, I'll come back to that. 

So as you may have seen from my previous review, my fiancée and I had a night stay at the Delta hotel and Sunday brunch here. It was a warm and cozy atmosphere to walk into. The server was friendly and got us coffee and juice right away and invited us to brunch buffet right away. 

What we found was the grand treasure of food! A pirate would have seen the treasure and screamed out "yaaaar, mateys!! We found the gold!" 

Fruit, various salads, eggs Benny, sausages scrambled eggs, French toast, and bacon was the breakfast side. Then were hot food items of BBQ chicken, salmon, dessert table, a carving station with a roast, and of course the omelette station! Wow!

I swear I may have heard angels sing...

As promised, let me tell you about this bacon. It was SMOKED bacon! When I looked at it, it didn't have the usual straight and greasy delicious look to it. It was a bit dryer and all curled up. It smelled heavenly and reminded me of cooking bacon over a camp fire. Amazing. Crunchy to the mouth and flavourful to taste as the juices and savior had been locked within. 

If anything I would go back for just the bacon. I left a happy camper.

We had the tomato pie.  It was amazing! One slice will fill you up!! It was the best I have EVER had. It was thick and doughy with a crispy bottom. They were on the list for tripadvisor and I can see why!
A Nashville institution.  Don't let the line scare you.  The wait is never very long.
Nini makes you feel like home here. Super clean salon with well experienced nail techs! I will forever and always go to and recommend William!!!

Awesome tacos! Freshly made corn tortillas. Enchiladas in green sauce great flavor. The empanadas are fresh but we got chicken and were a but dry. Torta cubana nit too much flavor even though its packed with ham, egg, cheese, beans. NOT a big place to eat, literally 3 booths.

What a wonderful place for Pakistani cuisine! Not busy on a Sunday night, so we got extra special treatment from the cook's son who explained the menu carefully to us. 

My friend and I decided we'd get one of the four yogurt chaats as an appetizer. We opted for the aloo chaat with potato cakes and chickpeas. A great choice...the mixture of hot and cold and crunchy and soft was great! 

For the entree, we got beef behari (spiced halal beef kabobs) which was so tender it literally (and I'm a wordsmith, so I'm NOT exaggerating) melts in your mouth. Per my request, it was made pretty spicy, and went well with the green sauces served with it. This was my favorite of all the items. I highly recommend it. 

The other entree was a "combo" where we selected two of the "gourmet dishes"--buttered chicken (which actually contained no butter--excellently done) and goat beets. The beets were a gamble item that I ordered and I was pleasantly surprised with the outcome! Also rather spicy, but I like that. 

Finally, the chapati (bread without yeast) was incredible. 

The owner brought us a sample of the Arabian smoothie with acai berries and strawberries and if we weren't stuffed, we definitely would have gotten one as it was one of the best smoothies I've ever tasted! 

Quality ingredients, great service and staff, huge portions. A+

Kendall (hopefully the spelling is correct!) is an amazing server who goes above and beyond to make her tables happy. A friend and I came in for a lunch and my friend is on a strict diet. This requires a lot of substitutions and removals, which Kendall paid attention to and took seriously. She even made sure the coke machine was full of the right syrup (they'd mixed up the coke zero and diet). Wow! 

Chili's is not my favorite. Most of their food is just okay, got or miss, nothing fancy... But I'd come back regularly because of how great Kendall was as a server!
Total scam do not get taken by these people signed up and completed 16 week still getting charged they refused to refund very poor businessWould give zero stars if able
This is the best Chinese restaurant in Tucson. I love dry braised shrimp! Staff are super nice, young and speak English very well.

Took a friend here for his birthday, overall we enjoyed it.  The environment was nice, the staff was nice, but somewhat, slow.  We had the following:

- Chef Duke's Oven Baked Cheesy Garlic Bread with Marinara - how can you go wrong with cheesy garlic bread?  It was delicious and cheesy!!

- Oysters Giovanni - Lightly Fried & Served on a Stained Glass of Five Sauces - supposedly this is an award winning dish.. the oysters were very small! (hence the pictures) All I tasted was breading and sauce.. no oysters!

- Spicy Caprese Seafood Plate - Louisiana Crawfish & Shrimp in a Spicy Aioli Sauce Over a Sliced Tomato & Mozzarella  - very light and refreshing, a well balanced appetizer 

- Sautéed Louisiana Shrimp in a Sweet & Spicy Sauce, Portabella Mushroom, Fried Green Tomato & Creamy Corn Grits - delicious, but I just wish they had a little more grits, it would of balanced out the saltiness of the sauce

- Quattro Formaggio al Forno - Sautéed Breaded Veal Baked to a Golden Brown With Marinara & Four Cheeses, Served with Penne Tossed in a Rosé Sauce - delicious, and cheesy!  A very hearty dish!

Overall, we had a good time here.  The ambience was nice, and the food was not bad.
The food is excellent and authentic, and we were very pleased by the number of vegetarian options. Excellent service and reasonable prices. Highly recommended!

Stopped in early on a Tuesday evening, so it wasn't too crowded.
Food and drink were just what we wanted.
Excellent mezze plates. We shared two of them for four.

This place was so delicious and totally 'Gram worthy. I had the sourdough French toast (which i was skeptical about) but it did not disappoint! They are pretty busy on weekends so get there early. Our wait for a group of 6 ended up being about 30 minutes which isn't bad and there's a little bakery/cafe where you can get coffee and a snack inside to hold you over while you wait! Definitely a Nashville must try.

It's a shame that Landmark gets the wrap of a crummy college bar because their food is very good. We used to come here all the time when we were younger for the bar, it is a younger crowd because of the college, though it dies down a bit when Rowan's not in session. As a bar, it's ok. Nothing fancy, cater to college kids with drink specials etc.

The restaurant is nice and all the food I've gotten here has been good. Good wings, good apps, good sandwhiches. Just got their cheesesteak eggrolls and I have to say they were some of the beat I've had!

My one complaint, the bar always stinks! Please get new mops and/or floor mats. Very off-putting.  :/

If you haven't been here yet?! Shame on you Indy! Owned and operated by husband/wife heart and soul. AMAZING food and Indy Art vibe.  

Food to go? Sit and chill? Summers outside! 

I recommend the Smash Burger. Only Thursday's & Fridays ... among other amazing options. 

Do it. Mmm

I found the best finds here and for a lot cheaper than other thrift stores! I left with a red vintage cocoa cola jacket, a heavy duty suede bomber jacket, and a few cute tops. All for $25! Affordable costs for trendy pieces. Our Thrift Store is a must visit if in the area. Very nice employees too!!

Quite possibly the worst tacos I've ever had. The tortillas claim to be house-made; if that's the case, fire your tortilla maker. Tortillas should be warm and dry, not slimy and cold. And they were definitely from a package. Old El Paso hard shells would have been more welcome than these atrocious things. And the fillings were tasteless. I ordered the duck and the fish taco- just wrong. Mushy, bland, and completely unappetizing. Glad I only ordered two and got the heck outta there.

This is such a fun place! We love board games and this cafe has so many high quality games to choose fromz plus their donuts are so creative and delicious and they have great coffee and beer selection too. Great for families or date nights

Maybe it was a bad day. But when I walked in with a prescription the "pharmacy" was closed. I asked an employee who, without responding, walked to the pharmacy area, opened the door, spoke to someone and then walked back past me, again without speaking. I went down the street to Walgreens and got much better service.
I thought the course looked and played great. I played on a Friday afternoon - quick pace and the staff was friendly. I would definitely recommend this course - great value.

Best FLAN ever!  But let me back it up.  Started date night with a killer mojito from the bar.  Fresh and tasty!
Salsa salad was huge and split between the 2 of us.  Mango dressing - Yes,Yes!
Sweet plantains, yucca,  etc.  Fresh ingredients,  attentive server. Authentic food. Clean and inviting.
Next time, weather permitting, we will enjoy the deck too.

My contact at the company was Dan. He was very courteous and helpful. His inspection report was very thorough with several pictures and explanations of all of the issues that he found in the home that I am about to purchase. The report pointed out fire hazards and other issues that I would have easily overlooked.

He was very responsive whenever I had questions and quick to follow up with test results that were submitted. I am very happy that I decided to use All American Home Inspections for my new home inspection.

Probably my favorite meal we had while in New Orleans!  We came in for lunch and it was amazing.  They brought us through the kitchen when taking us to our table which was fun and along the way, every single employee said hello and welcomed us, it was awesome!  The $6 wine offering was delicious and pared well with my pork tenderloin, which was cooked perfectly.  It had an orzo mac n' cheese and some other delicious items accompanying it-so good!!  I started with the shrimp bisque and that was tasty too.  I'm kicking myself for not trying a dessert because watching those bread pudding souflees and strawberry shortcakes go by me was quite a sight.  Southern hospitality at it's best, an amazing dining experience!!

Have been here so many times - every time the food is amazing and the staff is friendly. Some turnover recently, but still nice staff.

Let's get to the food. Their guac is amazing. White quest, can't go wrong. Chorizo queso, you really really can't go wrong. 

The steak chimichanga is amazing. Their meat is what makes this place stand out. Chicken and steak are both great. We love the mixed chicken/ steak fajitas. Their burritos are huge. 

Must go!!!

Maybe this rating isn't a fair one since I hadn't been there in awhile. But I'll give it anyway...  One review labeled it a bit ghetto... While this term might be a bit extreme, it's also extremely accurate... I had been to this mall quite often when it had some extremely nice stores there.... Now, it's just a waste of time to drive there and walk through.. I don't think that I've ever been in a mall with more closed stores.. It's mainly a hangout for unsupervised kids.. and the stores that are open are there to cater to the couple of bucks that the kids will spend there.. If you're into the usual low budget food courts, air brushed art, baggy clothes, and cheap jewelry, this place is for you.... 
Personally, Moorestown, Cherry Hill, and King of Prussia malls are more my speed... I'm not necessarily trying to go to a kid free environment. I just like a better shopping experience with better stores..

My friend who is a meat smoker guru suggested we go here. 
Wow! The brisket is tender, great smoke ring! 
The potato salad with dill and the baked beans are delicious!! 
The decor is "used" but who cares!! 
Great price great food!!

The food was excellent! We had sushi combos. I especially liked that the rice was firmly put together  so the sushi didn't fall apart when dipped.  Nice variety of menus selections. At about 6 on a Thursday it was not busy. We would definitely go back if we are in Philly at dinner time. Only a few blocks from the Forrest Theatre, nice stop before a show.

If you want the best burger in Philadelphia.. PYT will meet your expectations. I am a huge fan, but I feel like I can only go once in awhile to preserve how great it is every time I do go! Great food, great beer selection (Golden Monkey on draft.. too nice) and best of all great food. Can't go wrong with this place. I'll definitely have to check their night life out sometime, but it can't be that bad. Very cool and hipster-ish spot, definitely recommend this place!

****please read to the very end****

     With that said, they have no bedside manner. The woman who built up the tooth said, "you will never be able to bite into a sandwich ever again" no asterisk at the end of that. I had snapped my front tooth in half the evening before, this "professional" should know better then to say something that blunt to a 17 year old in a lot of pain. Truth is I just have to be careful with it and I'm fine, no apples essentially. Also the color they picked was 3 shades too dark for my teeth so I now have a visible line where the filling stops and my tooth begins. 
     That day they did a full inspection of my teeth and the dentist proceeded to jam an instrument down a fairly large cavity I had.
ON TO THE WORST PART!!!
     I also needed a tooth canal on one of my teeth and just today I went in to have a reconstruction of their "handy work" because they didn't fill my entire tooth. Food is really good, but the service today was terrible. We waited in line for 15minutes because the cashier was on the phone. Then in the middle of ordering she picks up the phone and takes the person on the phones order. Tells us it's going to be 2 minutes. 30 minutes later we still don't have our food. Terrible service for to-go orders

The Butterfinger milkshake was so good. I had the BBQ bacon blurry bleu burger, my boyfriend has the pickleback and my friend had the cheeseburger with avocado. Everyone loved the food. We also had pickle back shots and my friend had the Jeffrey, which was surprisingly good.

First time having dinner here. I've had lunch a couple of times. I was very impressed. The sushi was fresh and delicious. The atmosphere was nice. Wait staff was particularly attentive and very nice. I'm a big fan of sushi and it's not easy to find a great sushi restaurant. Kisso is great. I highly recommend.

I guess I'm on a roll lately with unsatisfactory experiences; I feel like I've had to give an awful lot of 1- and 2- star reviews recently. Maybe that's just this sh*t town for ya.... and it gets worse and worse every year. Sorry for those of you who "Love Reno" or think this place is a great place to live... it's depressing how more derelict the cities of Reno and Sparks both become month by month (except, of course, for the newly-flourishing "Midtown" and "Riverwalk" districts, which, surprise surprise, happen to be Mayor Schieve's pet projects (because she and her friends own businesses there). The rest of the city goes to hell. But that's a whole 'nother can of worms we won't get into now.

Anyway... I paid for the most expensive carwash ($15) and even got suckered on the "hey just pay $5 more and get two washes for $20!" deal. My receipt, however, said it was a "BOGO" deal -- not exactly; do they really understand what "BOGO" means? I didn't buy one at regular price and receive another free -- I paid extra to get a slightly discounted deal on two.

Anyway... this supposed "best wash" description on the sign said it included a "dash wipe and air freshener" as well as tire cleaning & shine treatment. It was hot out, I was tired, and I wanted to have to do the minimal amount of work to clean up the car, so yeah, I paid a little extra for what I thought would be extra services done by hand.

It turned out to be just a run-of-the-mill drive-thru wash; the employees didn't even look at my receipt; they didn't even scrub or jet-spray or hand-wash or shine my wheels or tires, they just sprayed some sort of oily "cleaner" on them. That did clean SOME of the gunk off but when the wash was finished and I pulled over into the vacuuming area to check out the results, I noticed that much of the oily residue was still left on my wheels and the remaining dirt was now dripping downward in greasy, ugly streaks - obviously it didn't look good, professional, or thoroughly cleaned. I had to re-clean that all by hand with my own paper towels. 

Whatever shine treatment they put on my tires, they didn't even bother to apply it fully to the entire outside-facing wall of the tire - I stood back and could clearly see spots that were shiny and looked clean, and sections that had not received the "treatment" and still looked like... well... dirty, faded rubber tires. 

Furthermore, whatever jet spray they used, or something they did prior to running my car thru the mechanical wash to clean the plastic trim on my car, ended up leaving ugly streaks that looked terrible; again, I had to get my own cleaner & paper towels and re-do it all by hand. 

I then remembered I had paid for this "dash wipe and air freshener" service -- which is totally misleading -- I had to walk all the way back to the entrance of the carwash to speak to the manager, showed him my receipt, and I said "should I bring my car back around for someone to wipe down the dash?" -- he looked at me kind of confused and then said, "oh no, I'll just go get it for you." He walked away leaving me befuddled -- and then returned with -- no joke -- a tiny packet of air freshener and what looked like a wet-wipe in a plastic pouch: apparently THIS was the "dash wipe and air freshener" "treatment" I thought I had paid for. I literally could do a better job of cleaning my own dash with my hand... and had to in the end. So much for saving energy by paying extra. It was almost laughable, had I not already been so tired and irritated.

I do like the fact that they have free vacuums for customers who have bought a wash there, but I didn't even get the full benefit of those -- it wasn't even close to dark yet, and yeah I didn't pay attention to their business hours -- but they could have been courteous enough to mention that they were closing very soon (and that the vacuums would be shut off at that time). I was about halfway through my vacuuming when the machines simply shut down, and without a word an employee wheeled away the trash bin and hoses, shut the roll-down door, and they closed up for the night.

Thanks a lot, for a lotta' nothing. And gee, I still have that 2nd carwash (aka "BOGO" deal) I bought to look forward to. Can't wait. (Sarcasm.)

Very nice salon.   I am new to the area and tried several different salons closer to home that left me unsatisfied with service and product.  I am so pleased to have found My Nails & Spa.  Pedicure and acrylic nails on spot.  Service was professional, on time with application and technique A+.  Highly recommend.
The chicken and waffle was a big portion. The cornbread waffle was great! The outside seating was nice as the weather was good.
Awesome food big portions. Staff was very friendly. For a small place, they have a tremendously large menu.

This was probably the best experience at Bru Burger Bar that I have had so far.  If I would have reviewed it prior to today, it would have been a solid 3 star place to get a burger.  Today, it earned another star.

Even though it was Devour Indy week (and ordering off of the set menu would have been a great deal) I choose to get a single burger and fries.  I got what I normally order (garlic three cheese burger and a side of fries).  Past experiences (3-4 times) have yielded a very greasy burger that often falls apart-- even at the other locations (Lexington).  Today (thankfully) was different.  The burger was cooked to a beautiful medium (per my request- it amazes me when they ask how you want it cooked and then still char the thing!) topped with the perfect amount of cheese and garlic.  Fries were crispy and as always, the house-made ketchup was SO GOOD.  I love that stuff and I wish I knew the recipe.

Service was friendly, the food was delicious and came quickly.  All I could ask for when I come to a restaurant!
The calamari and an apple martini (well, 2 cuz it was happy hr) I enjoyed iT all and had to walk home ; drinks worth the $
Don't have one bad thing to say about this place. Excellent service, amazing food and awesome atmosphere. Took my wife here for our anniversary and it was awesome. Will be back a lot!

I am a frequent customer here! I went several times prior to the pandemic, many times during the height of the shutdown when it was takeout only, and have continued to go now.

The Ways has nice seating indoors and outdoors and also does takeout. The menu includes a good variety of options including vegetarian and vegan options. They are also pretty accommodating with dietary requests.

I love their sweet potato tacos, veggie burger sliders and Buffalo cauli. Among my boyfriend's favorites are the corn flake crusted chicken tenders.

Service is great and quick.

Definitely recommend if you're in the area!

EXCELLENT St Louis traditional gooey butter cake in a variety of flavors. I especially enjoyed the amaretto flavor. To bad they no longer take mail orders. I'll have to experiment with a recipe and try to recreate my own. If you haven't tried this sweet treat that originated by accident in St Louis you're missing something special.

Movie night is fun and cheap. Only $3 and it comes with a PBR or other cheap beer. Come early. It gets crowded and tricky to get a seat. The draft selection was good but the prices were a bit steep. It was also hard to get a drink. The bar could have been staffed better, especially during the rush to get drinks before the movie. I would have bought more drinks but it was just too hard to get them and I was missing the movie trying to get service. Also, this place needs to modify the door between the balcony and bar. It is heavy and closes loudly if you're not careful. One of the male bartenders seemed driven crazy by it and confronted and yelled across the bar at the people who didn't negotiate it well. Luckily I got through quietly but it was awkward watching him essentially accuse person after person of intentionally slamming the door in front of the whole bar. If 25% of your customers bang the door, change the door. Don't loudly scold 25% of your customers. I don't like patronizing places where staff is rude or hostile to people.

White Chocolate Habanero Wings....oh god. I'm a sucker for anything, sweet, salty and spicy at the same time and these wings were all of that and more. Oh, did I mention crispy too? That were crispy...even with the creamy white chocolate sauce. My mouth is watering just thinking about them.  I actually might put them in my " best wings in Philly" category. I can't say they were THE best but they certainly were up there for me. 

Wings aside, I loved the fried chicken tacos. Yum. They were tangy, crispy and delicious. They were really easy to eat which isn't always the case with a soft taco so I greatly appreciated that. 

The restaurant was super casual, comfortable and spacious. The drink menu was extensive. If you love whiskey, this is your place though the drinks were a bit pricey. My friends and I overall had a great time and all agreed we would go back. 

Matt Levin, I'm glad you're back!

Too long to be notice.

For good customer service I think being acknowledged of your existence within 8 minutes is a good thing.
