I walk into the store, I'm the only one near the front, I see two workers talking amongst themselves neither lifted their heads. I walked over and stood patiently by the photo lab. I taught retail customer service so I was curious how long it would take for me to be noticed. After four minutes other customers came in, another two minutes when a customer yelled for their attention, and finally two minutes after that when I was spoken, 8 minutes in all.

That's not good.
NO ONE should wait that long.

Fitz's is great for kids, particularly if they're running the bottling plant when you pop in.  For adults, the upstairs bar is pretty fun for drinking and playing pool with friends.  

I'm not a huge fan of the burgers, and would much rather go across the street to Blueberry Hill to grab my burger of choice, but I know people who swear by Fitz's burgers.  As for the other food selections, I didn't think anything was very memorable, but it's all decent American bar & grill food.

The real selling point is Fitz's selection of their house sodas.  The root beer and cream soda are favorites, but they are just 2 of many selections offered.

Fitz's is in the heart of the Loop, so parking nearby is likely scarce.  There's a small private lot right next door (which is mainly handicapped spots), some street parking in front, and 2 lots behind the building, on either side of Leland.

As a U. City native, whenever I go to Fitz's, it brings me back to the days of my childhood, when we used to go to family dinners with my grandparents at the Lantern House Chinese restaurant, which was then located in the same warehouse-style building that Fitz's currently occupies.  Now that was some yummy Chinese food.

Great food! Can't go wrong with their delicious pizzas, super rolls, sandwiches, and breakfasts. They also have amazing fresh juices and baked goods and they recently started doing happy hour specials which we are looking forward to trying.

One of my favorite spots to brunch in the city. The inside decor is very British in theme with the menu. For starters I've tried the house made ricotta which is fresh and delicious and the Chicken & Duck Liver Pate which is very rich and fresh. You can't go wrong with the fish + chips or steak + chips here. Some other nice times to come are mid afternoon for tea time and on Sundays for the roast. The ambiance and British style make this a unique place to visit with excellent food. Not a slam dunk for vegetarians, but there are some smaller items to order.

This is a great place for Chicago style deep dish pizza. The servers are always very nice. Be prepared to wait about 35-40 minutes for your deep dish pizza; but know it's WELL worth it!! You'll be totally stuffed full after 1-2 slices. My husband and I usually take home at least half the pizza and eat it the next day. This location puts out coupons pretty regularly in the Clipper magazine and lately has been offering 1/2 off any pizza (including the deep dish) on Wednesdays. You just have to ask/mention it. The appetizers are very good. We got a sampler last time and it was HUGE. Wayy too big for us, so we ended up taking some of that home too.

The ambiance is good, perfect for a group meeting which is what we did this afternoon. The ice cream flavor just fell a little flat for me. It tastes like almond milk/nut milk which can be a little bland. Not the usual rich taste of milk. It is a good choice for lactose allergy families and such. I think it's awesome they have this option for those who cannot have milk or do not want/like milk.

The Four Seasons is always nice but the Santa Barbara property was so peaceful. Just BEAUTIFUL, totally peaceful. The Spanish style so Santa Barbara and the rooms and property are so well kept. A wonderful week.

I have had some bad Mani Pedi's but this one takes the cake. This was the fastest Mani Pedi in record time. I got to soak for a whole 3 minutes in ice water to only endure the most painful pushing back of my cuticles. All I got was my cuticles pushed back, rubbed a little scrub - rinsed off then some lotion and polished all under 10 minutes for the pedi. As far the Mani my hands are worse then when I walked in - I really hate when they thin out polish to only have it bubble up with particles.... 

Will not recommend nor return.
Why is 172 degrees inside this theater??? Also, the seats make airplane seats seem spacious & luxurious!

We are now in October we still have not received our dining room set nor our sofa sectional we get no updates sales service and management are horrible  customer service there is none.. I have never done business with any company in my entire life that conducts business the way this establishment does they do not care about their customers they do not stand behind their guarantees they do not stand behind anything they promise you once they make the sale that's it they don't know you anymore. I will never recommend or refer anyone to go to any of this  stores.
The service is fast and friendly.  Seriously, everyone there just seems to be in a perpetual good mood.

I LOVE going in here on my lunch break. Always a friendly, funny, and helpful staff to chat with, cozy environment to try on clothes, and really fun styles and designers. My go to place for a unique dress when it comes to weddings and formal events.

I am obsessed with this place and the beautiful curtains upstairs. Its such a fun combo of bar + restaurant!

I really like the brightly lit room upstairs. It's the perfect place to get a great look at your dining partner.

I guess if you want DINNER, go to Dahlak. If you want only a bar, go to Queen of Sheeba. If you want BOTH, go to Gojjo!

I usually get the shared crazy platter for two people and share with some friends! the cabbage is AMAZING!

We LOVED living here. We'd still be here if our children hadn't insisted we move into a house with no stairs. Our spacious apt was on the 3rdfloor so we felt we were living in a treehouse. It was so beautiful. The nesting owl family often perched right outside our windows. What a treat. The staff was always helpful and friendly and very professional. Maintenance staff was always prompt with any problems we might have. 
The landscaping was always beautifully done. We can't say enough positive things about this place. We miss the friends we made there.

Absolutely the Best restaurant! We went for our third time and it was our family's first time at this restaurant. They were raving about this meal experience. 
Mary was our server and she was amazing! The whole staff was terrific to include Paul Miller their Manager who flew in from Detroit. The steak was so tender and the sides were absolutely delectable.
A must go to restaurant in Brandon, FL. Great experience!

Not exactly happy with my order from the online store. Purchased the "Brie Mine" gift set. I understand substitutions may sometimes occur, but out of the 6 items described as being included in this gift set, I only received two as described; Brie and crackers.

What I ordered:
8oz Brie cheese
4oz Goat cheese
8oz Comte Fleur cheese
Crackers
Venchi Suprema Fondant
Wildwood Berry Berry chocolate bar

What I received:
8oz Brie
No goat cheese (no third cheese)
9oz Hardison cheese
Crackers
Marco Colzani Hazelnut spread
Orange and Cherries chocolate bar

I also want to note, it took longer for them to process and prepare my order than it took UPS Ground shipping to actually deliver it. (3 days before being shipped) 

I guess when it comes to giving someone a gift, it's the thought that counts, but Di Bruno Bros certainly failed on the execution. Nearly a $100 mistake I won't be making again. Nice looking boxes though!

I LOVED living here! My husband and I lived here and year and I cried when we moved for his company! The staff is amazing, the amenities are incredible and it is always clean! The units are built so wonderful, quiet and spacious. The walking path is my favorite! The entire complex was so well thought out with two exits and entry. I truly can not recommend enough! Such a deal! Plus walk to WaWa!!!

Such a weirdly awesome place. Food is so yummy and cheaper than most Indian restaurants. Awesome weekly specials, especially Thursday. I'm hooked I this place for life.

This place is now closed

Upon arrival the front desk crew were not very friendly nor did they appear to even want to be at work.  We got to our room and realized at a very inopportune time that they did not refill the toilet paper and left no extra rolls in the room for us to refill on our own.  Fast forward to later in the evening, went to take a shower and the shower was barely a trickle, not enough to even rinse the shampoo out of your hair.  Also, extremely hot water that took approximately 15-20 mins to get cool.  I just thought I couldnt figure out the shower.  Then we went to lay down on the bed & realized the sheets had not be changed from the last guest, gross! So very unsanitary.  We stayed 7 nights, not sure why other than the pains of moving hotels is such a burden.  Each day was something, 3 days we had to call & ask them to clean our room because at 6 pm it still wasnt done.  We got literally no towels one day.  No coffee or coffee cups another day.  No clean glasses or a bag in the ice bucket another day.  Trash no picked up another day.  And if you have to call the front desk or guest services be prepared to have the phone ring & ring approx 30 times before anyone will pick up.  The room itself was nice if you can get past all of the mishaps along the way.  Definitely not worth the price we paid for a week stay.  Very disappointed.

We have been great Verizon customers for years.  We have used this store, including post Covid in January buying a new watch.   I checked the website to see updated Covid policies and there was nothing that indicated an appointment was needed.   Upon arrival there was a guy in the parking lot screaming about masks and how they wouldn't let him in because he didn't have a mask.   Upon trying to go in the sales representative came out and told us we couldn't go in.   I don't know if he was rude because the guy was yelling, but he was very unkind.   The situation then escalated quickly.   He became very aggressive and rude.  He told us he had no appointments available.  I tried to explain we have traveled two hours.    He then raised his voice and told me they had no employees.   I asked for the store number to make a complaint.  He then yelled at me.  "Make a complaint about what, that you can't schedule an appointment right."   His customer service was awful!!!!!  I will not use this store again.

Um um um.  I came here today for the first time because of the good reviews and because the food looked good.  I arrived around 4 on a Sunday.  Unfortunately it was a bad experience.  I wanted the stuffed Bell pepper but they were out of that so I said cool let me get the red beans and rice. After waiting 15, 18 minutes for my meal the waitress lets me know that they're out of red beans too.   The waitress ( who was very nice) gave me the menu to pick something else..for the third time!  When she came back I decided to leave and go to NO hamburger and seafood.  I hate when some restaurants start off good and then they start to get comfortable and fall off.  Maybe this was just an isolated incident but it was a bad first impression.  It'll probably be a while before I come back or recommend this place.  And I was bucked up to try the food here too...smh

I wanted to take my 5 year old daughter there for some indoor play because it was a rainy day. Drove 45 mins, I had my 12 month old sleeping in the stroller but they still wanted me to pay $17 for her to be pushed around in a stroller. They told me they have a strict policy and had to charge me for my sleeping baby. $51 for us was way to steep. I could barely afford to pay for 2 but, I couldn't swing all 3. The woman told me I was SOL and couldn't get a manager because she was at lunch. I decided to pay, but after she swiped my card I didn't want to pay. She rolled her eyes, laughed and had someone else get me a refund.  My 5 year old and myself left in tears.
I have been in customer service my entire life and never, would I ever think, to treat anyone the way she treAted me. I deal with people less fortunate than myself and I would never roll my eyes or laugh at anyone that is facing hard times. I'm not even facing hard times, it was the point if it. I went there purposely at nap time, so I could let my 5 year old play while my baby slept. $17 for a sleeping baby? They should lighten up on the admission fee for small children.
These employees need training in customer service and managers should make a decision on 12 month olds having to pay such a steep admission fee.
To add insult to injury, when I checked my bank account the next day, no refund. When I called I told the woman what happened, she looked into her records to find out I was not issued a refund. It got lost somehow. Really?!?!!!!????
She ended up refunding my card on the spot. I took the opportunity to tell her the story and to tell her their customer service skills suck. She was very unapologetic and couldn't have cared less.
I'll never go there again and recommend you don't go either. The Smith playground is down the street and is free. They have an awesome playground, wooden slide and a huge mansion filled with different themed rooms filled w toys. Go there instead and save yourself a ton of cash!
Hot tub is drained but pool is open. VERY friendly staff. Hand sanitizer stations are empty. Rooms seem to have been recently remodeled.

Not your average Mexican. Everything was super delicious. We had the chips and salsa/guacamole/queso combo...and filled up on that. When ou food came, it was SO much. I had the Steak burrito and it was incredibly delicious. Great flavor balance. Would definitely return!

Jourdan is the most beautiful caring person I have ever met. A natural born healer.   She is beyond talented.  She has an incredible voice. I did a session in a class she presented in New York and I went so deep into Hypnosis and walked away feeling so awakened I could walk on air.

This store is located right across cafe Monde. They sell all the souvenir items & gift baskets of Cafe du Monde.
We were there on Tuesday, the store is closed due to covid.
There is another store that is open on same side as Cafe du Monde but on the other end, 848 Decature, that's where we picked up our supplies to take home on Wednesday

HORRIBLE wait staff.  We just went there this evening - seated in a booth by the bar, 3 wait staff sitting and chatting with friends while the Preds game was on.  They looked right at us and yet NONE of them bothered to get off their lazy butts to help us.  We left.  Try Sopapilla's or Uncle Julio's instead - both have great food and friendly staff.  Here are some photos from tonight's meal at Sopapilla's...MUCH better!!

Free for students with valid USF ID. Free parking. Actually, I visited the museum as a requirement for the extra credit in my American Government class. I was kind of excited and surprised about what I saw and learned from this educative visit. The museum was pretty small but quite informative about the Holocaust. There were variations of arts, pictures, and artifacts. I just do not feel this is a right or fun place for children.

Probably my favorite pizza from anywhere! So thick even I can only eat 2 or 3 slices of a large deluxe pizza. So So yummy and filling! We also had the hot wings which were good, but not as hot as I prefer them, so wings are average, but pizza is awesome. They even ship their pizza's in a frozen box out of state. This is a small hole in the wall older style building and location in small south east Indy area of Wanamaker. Once you have this super thick, multi layer pizza, you will not be happy with any other pizza, ha. Service was nice and friendly, on time, and prices are average as expected. Overall great place, and they offer a full bar area too.

This is the second Mexican restaurant tonight that promises 2 for 1 Margarita specials and the second place that lied.  This seems to be a trend.  However they are nicer here than the first place tonight.  Out of 9 Mexican restaurants in a 6 mile radius I'm wondering if this is what they all do.

I love this place.

I eat here every Sunday morning after a night of wine tasting in Santa Ynez. Every time, I've loved my breakfast. Now, I just order the same thing each time because I can't get it anywhere else that I know of: Jasper's eggs benedict. It is eggs benny but with corned beef. 

My latest trip was on St. Patty's Day and they had green-mosas. The ambience was fun with the waiters all wearing green.

You just can't go wrong with this place--the service, food quality, variety, and price!
Their donuts are terrible their coffee is terrible they are really expensive and the service is slow. Other than that, I love this place!

I stayed for a weekend with my husband (Friday-Monday). The house keeper only came once to clean our room (Saturday). Whoever cleaned our room took out all the towels and did not replace any of them. When we called the front desk they were not in a rush to bring us more. My husband walked the halls to find someone to replace our towels. 

The AC in our room was broken, (which is unacceptable considering how humid it is in NOLA) therefore we could not control the temperature on our own. It was either REALLY cold in the room or REALLY hot.

It looks as if they have given the hotel a "facelift" but they have not made basic repairs on a regular basis.

My wife and I still talk about the fabulous Segway tour of Santa Barbara almost a year ago. I felt a little guilty not walking, but this really is a fantastic way to experience intimacy with the city in a short time frame. Very easy to learn how to control the machine.

First, the good: The place was very clean.  Too many neighborhood businesses don't seem to think that's important.  The interior was clearly completely renovated.  Most importantly, the food was excellent!!  I had the chicken kebab sandwich and as soon as I took the first bite, the flavors exploded in my mouth.  Fantastic!  It was gone within minutes.

The could-be-better: The young ladies in the kitchen seemed to be having trouble keeping up with the orders.  I was told 15 minutes, but it took about 30 minutes for my food to be done.  But I'll know to add on time for next time.  Which might be today.

My insurance towed my car to this body shop after I was in a collision.  They fixed the body to my satisfaction.  But after I drove it a while, I noticed that there were still issues.  I ended up taking to another mechanic to double check the repair and found out that they had cut corners.  Instead of replacing a part that had been damaged in the accident, they taped it (fuel line).

Thanks to Ally - she made our lush experience amazing! The fact that she knew the product so well help me pick out what I did and ( didn't need )! So excited to get home to try! We got 2 bath bombs, face mask and a face cleanser, and my boyfriend saw the mouth wash tabs and tooth paste so she was so sweet to let us take a sample home to try :) can't wait to come back and show at he SB location!
Great food for a great price. Really enjoyed the staff they were so friendly. The space was great for our group with the long communal tables

After the recent tropical storm that went through I noticed some water seeping into my house. My neighbors have had this issue before and have tried several things to fix it. I went over to ask them for advice and they mentioned that their wall had leaked again and there was a home inspector coming to look at it in the morning. Thankfully, no one minded me tagging along. I figured I could pick up some knowledge of how I might fix my leak. 
I can't tell you how much I learned from Todd. Not just about the issue at hand but other home building issues to be aware of (door rot, kick flashing problems, mold growth, grading...). He was very thorough, not only with the leaking and cracks, but with anything else that he noticed as we walked along. He explained everything and made it easy to understand. When he was finishing up with the neighbors house he asked if I would like him to just take a quick look at mine. I jumped at the chance! He was so professional and went above and beyond to include a quick look at my house. I highly recommend him, very knowledgable!

The worst! Plain and simple. It is true they don't speak English well. This is a problem when it's over  the drive thru intercom. 
I definitely ordered the only flavor milkshake I ever drink.  JAMOCA ALMOND FUDGE.  and since you can't understand communications with the person at the window.  I ended up with just a jamoca milkshake.  Well, mistakes happen.
Until, he started arguing with me saying he repeated the order back and I said okay. Doesn't he know that the average person can't understand and word he says. But never offered to replace  or remake it???
It doesn't take a MBA to know that THE CUSTOMER IS ALWAYS RIGHT.

I'm reposting my review for Eddie and Sams. It's just ok. The sauce is bland and the pizza is huge but quantity doesn't mean quality. It's not to thick, but it's doughy and not cooked enough. They do get large lines, why I don't know. Sorry Eddie and Sams

Food and service was excellent. I am excited to return here for more! We were seated promptly upon arrival and were brought our drinks right away. Our server was always making sure us and his other tables were well taken care of. The appetizer and food came out quickly and we really enjoyed ourselves. Thank you! Looking forward to our next visit!

I've been shopping at this TJ Maxx location for years. The two-star rating is only for the product selection.. Lately, it has been pretty sparse. I used to spend hundreds of dollars here but now my typical purchase is only around fifty.

As far as customer service, I give it a zero. I can't remember the last time I saw a sales associate smile or have any attitude other than "I hate my job, what do you want...." And that is IF they can even muster that much personality. 

I will say, the last few times I've been in, I haven't seen the creepy guy that always used to hit on me (I lost count of how many times he gave me his number, made inappropriate comments, etc). I actually started shopping at other TJ Maxx locations simply to avoid his presence. Kudos to this location for (I assume) finally terminating him.

Wonderful selection of handcrafted brews. We tried two flights and all 8 beers were really good. The mango IPA was one of our favorites and I am not usually a fan of IPAs.

Nice seating area with lots of games to play.

Its a cute, romantic place with dim lighting and friendly service. The Tom Yum soup wasn't very flavorful but the golden bag appetizer was unbelievable.

As reviews mentioned before, the pad thai is a little off. Not necessarily bad, but not the usual, peanut-y sauce that I'm used to. 
The massaman curry was the best I've had in a while but if you are looking for a good drunken noodle, head to tamarind on south street.

The food was delicious and the restaurant looks nice inside and I love their outdoor section. The only hang up we had was slow mediocre service. It was nice that they didn't play their music too loud to where we couldn't enjoy conversation. Would definitely give this location another try!
What a gem! Great staff and chef and amazing food. Love this place! Love the special dinners!

Finally made the time to stop at this famed McConnell's shop! It's a bummer that you can't eat inside this cool ice cream shop during this Covid-19 era, but the ice cream is still top notch. Got a flavor that I've never seen sold in stores before: Berry pie flavor (single) that was outstanding! Not cheap at just over $5 for a small portion, but it is extremely well made ice cream. 

Locally, I always hunt for the pint of "Eureka Lemon and Marionberry" ice cream flavor. Although the little raspberry sized seeds from the marionberries always get stuck in my teeth, that balance of sour lemon and sweet cream with berries is just a killer mixup.

Cashless note during Covid-19: i find it hilarious that they are Cashless for food, but have a Cash Tip Jar like nearly all other food retail joints! Huh?!?

Jim is the best! I took my mangled ring there after it had been "resized" at another jeweler. He walked me through the whole process, and I was able to sit next to him and watch every step as he fixed my ring. It looks beautiful now and the craftsmanship is excellent. I would go to him for any repair in the future.

Last summer was our first trip here and we have decided that we will do it every summer, as most of the guests we met do.  The slogan "Your best vacation since becoming parents" is completely true.  Our 2-year-old daughter had a great time with her camp counselors and since we felt she was in good hands we were free to do whatever we wanted.  You can do as much or as little as you want.  There are plenty of organized activities to choose from, an amazing fitness center, beaches nearby, and the lovely town of Santa Barbara.  The twin beds weren't the best for snuggling but I loved that my daughter had her own room and this made us all sleep better.  I liked that there was also a little living room.  The food was so much better than what I had had  in my college dorms and there were a lot of options to fit any dietary needs.  I loved the date night where they dropped us off in Santa Barbara for the evening while our daughter got to enjoy a pizza/movie pajama party.  We also stuffed a tiger and made ceramics in the craft hut.  This vacation is a great value and I also like that you can be billed in installments if you like ahead of time.  I highly recommend it and can't wait for next summer's trip.

I absolutely love Sweetsboro. When we want something sweet, i know we can always count on them. Between all the fancy little pies, pastries and other sweet treats, they do it all. Their cakes are beautiful and always delicious. Their staff is always so friendly. I always love seeing their posts on Facebook, and love how engaged they are with their customers.

The only place I trust with my eyebrows. I have very thick eyebrows and I usually just ask to clean them up. However, people tend to get excited and experiment on my eyebrows that I then have thin or mismatched eyebrows. Thread bar takes the time to ask what you want, along the way ask if your ok (pain wise although I've been threading since I was 12 so it's a breeze) they show you the process and if your ok with it. Upon completing one eyebrow they ask if it's ok thus far so they know they can move on to the next. It's always pleasant going there. They also give you a loyalty card which the only unfortunate thing is they don't combine them I'm always forgetting since I live in jersey and usually take the train there (another plus right next to the station) and I forget so I have multiple with just one signature.

FYI: I am reviewing Courtesy's coin laundry, not the other cleaning services.

I clean and dry my laundry here often in the coin-operated machines. The staff members are very friendly and helpful. They keep the facility nicely clean. It's cool that they offer free dryer sheets. My only minor complaint is that the hot water in the washers is usually only lukewarm. I plan to continue going here for as long as I live in this part of Indy.

We've been wanting to try this dessert place for so long but don't live in this area. So finally we made it a point to have pizza around the area then dessert here! The shop is small and couple of tables available for dining. The menu looks appetizing in the eyes, but we had to ask what some of the items are since there were no description. It would have been super helpful if we know what we were ordering instead of going off the photos just because they looked delicious. We ordered mangoniada, peanut M&M milkshake, and gansito milkshake. The shakes were all delicious and so is the mangoniada. However, for the price of mangoniada, I actually prefer another from a different store which is even priced lower. Essentially, the mangoniada is a cup of fresh mangoes with couple of scoops of mango sherbets and tamarindo candies. For what I paid for the mangoniada, I could had sliced my own mangoes at home LOL! I guess I'm used to more mango sherbet than fruits from another store!! We'll return but I will order something else... perhaps the java shake or pingüino :)

Been living here for 8 months now and couldn't be happier with the decision. LOTS of pros:

1. Everyone who works here is so kind and good at what they do. The maintenance guys know my dog by name and always say hi when we're walking around. We've had various problems and they've always come right over to fix it.

2. For such close quarters, we don't really hear noise from other homes. We share a wall with a family who has a baby and have never heard him cry, even on nights when they say he was up all night. They've also never heard our dog bark (despite our copious Amazon packages.)

3. We park directly in front of our home. It's amazing.

4. Fantastic dog park! Our pupper loves it so much. All we have to do is say "bark park" and she loses her mind.

5. They're so quick about weather stuff - it snowed last week for the first time this season and when I woke up the sidewalk and patio to my place was shoveled! This weekend they spent hours removing fallen leaves and branches.

6. It's so much roomier than other places in WC. We're paying about the same as we did at another community but we have 2 BR, 2 BA, 2 floors whereas before we had 1 of each.

CON:

Fixtures are kinda old and outdated.

Not that much storage space.

Overall, we're happy!

Don't get me wrong, the food was great- everyone enjoyed their dishes. We had the ravioli, bolognese, clam linguine, and lamb ragu. All of it was cooked to perfection and my friend who really enjoys Italian loved it.

My issue with Ca'Dario was the service- I can't tell if the hostess/servers were just really busy or just kind of rude... but there were no smiling faces and everyone seemed to be stressed. We were not greeted with a smile and our hostess barely checked on us. It definitely put a damper on a fun night.

Best place to go. We stayed in town a few years ago and found this gem. It is one place you will never get old of. My husband has a go to of - peanut butter smoothie with dragon fruit. However, I always order a different smoothie each time. When ever we pass this town we always stop by. So sad that this olace has closed down. Hope they open another one soon.

This was our first time here. The atmosphere was relaxing. Perfect location with plenty of safe parking. We enjoyed the piano music playing softly in the background. They have a great wine list. We ordered the lasagna and was told by our waiter that it was more than enough for two people. When we got it, there was very little meat and very little pasta in our lasagna. It was mostly all cheese. Also when we got our bill it included a split charge that we were not told about. It was very pricey. It was $39 for lasagna and $10 split charge. We will not be back. Charlie Gitto's On the hill is better priced and food is just as good.

Nice, dark dancefloor.  I am picky about DJs (being one myself), and sometimes the DJing leaves a little to be desired, but if you just wanna cut loose, have a good time, and not be gawked at by people parking on the dancefloor, it's a good place for that.  

Drinks can be a bit on the pricey side (this ain't Chicago, peeps), but my last Red Bull and vodka there was vodka with a splash of Red Bull, so... eh... who's complaining, really?  

I know it's a bar full of mostly dudes, but damn... one bathroom stall for the ladies?  A bit frustrating when you really have to go, but waiting always becomes an adventure in meeting new people, so thus far the waits have meant entertaining company.  

I like that there's a little smoking area out back, which gives you a moment to cool off, and people are mostly pretty friendly, so you can chat and be silly while you engage in your terrible smoking habits (I smoke.  Not judging.)

I've had a lot of fun every time I've been there.  I would only encourage the DJs to pick a vibe and run with it, and not toss in hip hop in the middle of some crazy, high energy set.  Take it up, bring it down, and keep the dancefloor flow moving.  :)
Best brewery in NOLA. We love to come here to just grab a beer hang out outside. The barbecue was excellent probably one of the best NOLA.

Ordered my food on Grubhub at 3:40pm, it is now 5:35pm and my order just showed up. After calling twice to see where my food was, I was told that they forgot to put the order in when I first placed it. No apology, no refund, just excuses. 

Never will order from here again, no matter how good the food actually is when I get around to eating it. 

Edit: Ate my luke warm sausage parmesan sandwich...it wasn't worth the wait.

I ordered the deluxe PHO. And I added a little more of the tendon because I like that texture and flavor as well. The wait staff was very attentive. And  the Decor was very delightful and soothing to the eye.

this place is fantastic and consistent. I've been frequenting Pura vida for a few years and it always delivers. The shrimp burrrito is delicious and a great deal. Its comfortable and friendly but they dont have high chairs for little ones. That could be a plus or minus depending on your situation. BYOB (bring your own booster)

The menu option here is huge and mimics an Italian pizza by the slice/ burger joint. However, do yourself a favor and order off the spicy menu. It's well worth it. If your looking for a kick or a little bit of Indian flavor, this is your place. Masala fries, spicy chicken cheesesteak, and egg bhurji with no toast in the picture. I ordered a medium for every thing and even though I love spicy food, I wouldn't have gone more than that. It was spicy !

Clean place and large beer selection. I'll definitely be back !
Best AYCE BBQ & Hot Pot around for under $35! Great for small groups of friends and the waiters will even cook the BBQ for you if you want. Krisy is fantastic!

This is a unique place because their menu is so dynamic.  When you want to bring in a bottle of red and enjoy a great Italian meal, you can have that experience.  If you want to go for a cheesesteak and fries and watch the Eagles, there you go.

Regardless of your final destination for entree - please get the Antipasto - an amazing array of flavors and textures such as mushrooms oreganata, roasted red peppers, red onion, italian sausage to name a few, all served with a homemade rustic Italian dressing, chunky and bursting with garlic, oregano and olive oil.

My go-to is their White Spinach pie with fresh tomatoes.  The crunch of the crust pairs  up the creaminess of the fresh mozzarella and perfectly sautéed spinach and finishes with a burst from the tomatoes in every bite.  

Their chicken sandwiches (try the #4!!!!)  are totally unique and are perfect with one the best side dishes ever - broccoli bites - batter dipped and served with real deal Philly cheese whiz.

I have tried it all and always have a warm, family friendly experience every time I go back.

This is the first time I've ever been here and I liked it a lot. We bought tickets online and had to set a time because of covid. There is a $10 parking fee. You can arrive up to half hour early or late. I found it to be well maintained and clean. Nice variety of different fish and animals. Gift shop very well organized. My favorite part was the penguins. There is also a shark tunnel and a shark bridge rope. Outside there is a beautiful view of the river and Philadelphia. If you walk up a little bit you can get to the battleship and the area is very clean and maintained beautifully!! This was an enjoyable experience for us!!

Wanted to love . . . only kind of liked.  The food is all fine - not excellent, but pleasant enough . . . .just not pleasant enough for the price tag.  Go with light eaters; if you don't, there won't be much for you to eat!

Went to Santucci's for lunch and was able to take a table outside on a beautiful day with great weather this past week.  We had two personal pizzas, one plain, and one with all of the hot peppers.  They were both very good.  
I am not typically a fan of Sicilian, square, or thicker crust pizza, but this was very good.  The sauce was a little heavy in quantity, but it wasn't too sweet.  The cheese was fine and the crust was crispy on the outside and doughy enough without being to bread-like.
I think the only real issue is the service.  The service is slow.  There was one table packing up, one table with a couple people, and one table with one person, and service was still excruciatingly slow.
I may return, but hopefully they can get a spring in their step next time.

My two daughters have been enrolled at Goldfish for three months.  I have been so impressed with the quality of their program and their customer service.  My children's swimming ability has improved tremendously and they can't wait to go to their lessons every week.  I have tried lessons at many other programs over the year but nothing really stuck.  The management goes above and beyond to provide outstanding customer service and flexibility in scheduling.

I go there only because I have a great nail tech. She is very good at her work and does not try and upsell any of their services. I always get an appointment with her and she does both my pedicure and dip polish. My nail tech is friendly and makes some good recommendations. Some girls at the front desk are really nice. Overall a good place,  but they could offer some seasonal specials and discounts.

This is a rustic family owned restaurant located in the wharf at Santa Barbara. The food is expensive but worth it for gee fresh sea food. The lobster roll is something that I highly recommend here! The crab cakes were ok and the sea urchin was a new experience for me! This place is also open a little later than several sea food places in Santa Barbara which is a win win!
My friend and I stopped by for brunch after a morning of strolling up and down mass ave and really enjoyed ourselves! Food was good and fresh and the drinks were great too. Will be back for sure.

Cute place, but the tacos are incredibly bland. Seriously. Even the shrimp and chorizo taco was bland, which was a wonder in itself because how does one make bland chorizo? We had to ask the waitress for the salt and pepper. The carnitas taco had way too much liquid that wasn't properly drained before being placed on the tortilla. The fish taco I suggest definitely skipping. I also don't recommend the queso unless you're ok with it being soupy. Waitress was very nice, but the food alone is why I won't be returning. Margaritas were ok, I've had better.
Excellent Staff!! Vincent and Mike are both amazing people. Thank you both for great service.

The owner is a complete Ahole. Ignorant, unprofessional, odd, and rude. The place is unkept and outdated. The staff is nice but they seem like theu arent happy working there. I heard this place used to be great until it was sold. Well the previous owner should have been more selective with who to sell to. The food.......2 words.....never again.

I saw Wapango on my way to the Cheesecake Factory while in St Louis on business.  The place caught my eye because it was unique looking and I never heard of the place (I am always looking for new places to eat) I decided to go the following night.  

When me and my coworker arrived we were quickly seated and waited on.  Upon reviewing the menu I ordered the Arepas as an appetizer and of course a glass of wine.  The appetizer was a corn cake, fried, with black bean and shredded pork added on top.  It had a decent but not strong flavor.  For the main dish we both went with the Carne Asada Steak that came with all the normal fajita fixings.  The steak was tender but lacked flavor, even with the additions of the rice and other toppings.  For desert we both had the Cuatro Leches cake (normally I see this dish as Trece Leches cake, somehow they found room for more milk..ha).  Anyway, it was a dense cake with strawberries and was nicely presented.  

Likes - 
* The waitstaff was extremely friendly and accommodating.
* 1/2 price wine special (I think every Wednesday)
* Cool/ Modern decor
* Unique menu (based on what you may expect). 

Dislikes -
* Pricing was a little high
* Food light on flavor had me looking for salt... 
* Cake was a little on the dry side for Cuatro Leche 

Overall an OK experience and not a fantastic experience.  I would give this place another try when I venture back in the area, but unfortunately it was nothing to write home about.
Pretty unhappy with the device I received earlier this week. Management did nothing after a complaint I left!

Was craving Chinese and on the recommendation of a co-worker we went to the Yummy House...wow! This place is amazing and the service was excellent!! Will I go back?? YES!!
We have been back about a dozen times. ...never disappointed and food is consistently amazing!

I signed up for Denny's reward program. I got a lot more online coupons than I did before joining. I used the $1 coupon for 10 pancake puppies (reg. price $2.99, 6 ct. $1.99). I did not know what to expect but thought they sounded like hushpuppies. They were much to my delight as they contained Ghirardelli cocoa and melted chocolate chips in a fried batter and covered with powdered sugar with a side of cream cheese icing. They were amazing!

Went here on Valentine's Day around 8:30 -9 (I think) so you know love was in the air  They have complimentary valet which is great when you come to busy restaurant on highly celebrated holidays such as Valentine's. Valet was fast and quick!!! Soon as we pulled up they were ready to park the car. Which was a plus because it was freezing out.... We had reservations, however they said they were 30 mins behind. Which was expected but still pretty annoying. However, for the wait they have is a complimentary card for any flat beard of our choice. So we chose the braised rob flat bread. And it was soooo good!!! Our server was a young guy who was very nice as well as knowledgeable. He knew the menu and had answers if we had questions. Which I can ALWAYS appreciate a server who knows his stuff!!! And he didn't seem like he was being bothered and we didn't feel rushed even though the place was packed!!! Both of our meals tasted soooo good. The truffle Mac and cheese was pretty bad... the taste of it was just all off so we didn't even eat more than a half spoon full each. But we didn't complain... but the server assured us if we don't like something next time don't hesitate to let them know. He could have taken it off the bill. So that was noted for out next visit. Because the food was delicious, the atmosphere was great and the price was right. Those three things plus the valet parking says "we will be back". We didn't have dessert because normally we are always too stuffed for dessert. But maybe next time

The atmosphere is 100% dive. Definitely not the spot to break out the coat and tails. The music was enjoyable without being too loud.

The cocktails? Good and strong, with an amazingly large beer selection if that's your thing. Also, there are great happy hour deals.

The food? Based on my sampling, excellent. The appetizer wings were moist and wonderfully flavored. The Castro (their take on a Cuban sandwich featured moist pork medallions and the entire sandwich was uniquely (and deliciously) spiced. "The Disgrace," the infamous bacon & chocolate dessert, was phenomenal.

The service? Second to none. Our server was always at the ready to refill our glasses when necessary, and our table was bussed efficiently. Everything about my experience there made me feel as if they wanted me as a customer!

Tonight was the first of what I'm sure will be many visits to the Bleeding Deacon. I can hardly wait to go back!
Cool Mo's has a decent Cuban sandwich. And by decent I mean it's good for those of us that want something quick. I just don't believe a lot of time or effort is put into making them.

This place is great! I traveled to STL for a while for work and I was so glad I found this place on Yelp! After reading the reviews I decided to check it out. Although it is pretty hipster, I would think most anyone would come here and really enjoy the service, food & drinks! Everything is top quality and you dont have to pay a ton for it. The staff is extremely friendly and very knowledgeable about the beer on their menu, everything they serve and are very open with their opinion (to me this is a must). When you go for sure do not pass up getting the side of mac and cheese! All of the meat is amazing and the atmosphere is really relaxed. Overall great gem and one you must go to when in STL!

Loved the place!
I went there while I was waiting in line for the Vietnamese place nearby. 
Owners were so nice to talk to. The place had a nice comfy ambience. And the ice cream I had (coffee) was just amazing 

And since we didn't like the veitnames food that much, we went there again after the food. 
Also I loved their spoons :)
food is pretty good if you stick with basics such as  pulled pork, black eye peas, greens, grits and cornbread. Not too salty or greasy.

Best Brisket chili nachos. Satisfied hungry man who had to share! 
Great servers. Very attentive and helpful with menu selections. 
Polite and fun place. Even the owner or manager comes around to check on you! 
Music is a bonus! Usually a guitar player singer. Not over powering and loud pleasant listening!

Took my iPhone 5 in to get a battery replacement! It only took 5 minutes to replace it, $35 buck. Great deal!! Awesome knowledge on products!! Good customer service. I will be telling my friends and family about his business.

Definitely a Venue

I love the fact that Underground Arts is, unapologetically, a venue. It reminds of the Old Grape Street Pub (before it moved the first time), only it's much bigger. 

They have a few good beers...which is enough to be honest. The food list is equally concise, but everything they offer is very satisfying. 

Seemingly, they are trying to do some great things for the Artistic community also.  I've been there twice to see world music performances; I'm happy to see they offer a stage for less mainstream Artists. There's so much good Art in the city that never gets a platform, so kudos to Underground Arts for trying not to pander. One of the shows was preceded by 'comedy'...this was not so good. A gent with no shirt, calling himself 'Necro-boy' or something, accosted the audience for the longest ten minutes I can remember.  Avoid the comedy the same way you avoid the plague. I can give a tip of the hat to everything else they offer though.
Solid food, great service, fun little off the beaten path location. Low key, good menu selection.

I love the decor! The food was delicious and not greasy like other Indian restaurants I've tried in Reno. The vegetarian samosa had a light and flaky crust and just the right amount of filling. The garlic naan was so good. I also ordered the shrimp tandoori which was made with huge shrimp. My favorite was the channa masala. The chickpeas were so tender and tasty.
I really hope they will last. They obviously spent a lot of attention to the ambience and the place is very clean.

I think taj is my favorite Indian place in Nashville hands down. The buffet had an amazing variety of food items and was kept full and there were plenty of people of there. 

I went for thirds and really stuffed myself. Everhthign was just so delicious. 

However, the only thing that made this a 4 star rating instead of a 5 star was their naan. There naan was a bit disappointing and I think it's because I've had amazing naan and it just didn't live up to expectations.  

But otherwise the food is DELISH and highly recommended.
Reese was fantastic! Always smiling and attentive to our needs. We had a lovely experience!

This is a review for Instructor Carolyn Poerio's  Big Yoga series.
I am a fan of Carolyn's classes because she approaches each student and class with a  body positive perspective, no matter what the class is called. If you have ever felt of or place or afraid to practice amongst the lithe Carolyn's classes are THE place to work around your limitations, build strength and pump up the confidence to do your practice anywhere and around any BODY.  Supportive, introspective and affirmative mind sets are cultivated while you move with intention to the edge of your limitations. ( both perceived and physical limitations)Prop use and experimentation  is highly encouraged along with several variations on poses to find the right for for your body. 
My 45th birthday was on the horizon and I wanted to do good for my self,This was a 5 week class and I joined so I could opt back in to my life, feel more at ease in my body, gain a bit of strength and find refuge after a really rough couple of years. 
My expectations where exceeded all around. The studio is lovely and clean, easy to reach, elevators are present for those who can't climb steps. The class seemed to flow around where we where as a group each week rather than a fully choreographed list of postures. We laughed, we discussed difficult things and supported each other on the mat. 

I can't wait to take another class. See you there

Delicious, but I wouldn't wait an hour for it again.

I love fried chicken and was super excited to come to Nashville for the hot chicken. I got here about 15 minutes before they opened and waited for about an hour before eating. Definitely a hot spot for both locals and tourists. Just a little better than the hot chicken I've had in LA and the mild isn't spicy at all.

I got a side of the black eyed pea salad because people here seem to love it, but it was gross. It was really sour, so not really my thing.

Loved the concept! Excellent piece of Italy in USA. 
It carries a  little bit of every good Italian dish.  I loved it..... It is a must.

Tried this new pest service after getting a knock on my door late one Sunday evening. I signed up for 6 treatments. So far I have received 2. The first treatment was great. 2nd treatment was missed and had to call and get rescheduled. Third treatment was scheduled for September 8th and they were a no-show nor did they call. I've been on hold this morning and they are not answering. Terrible customer service and not a reliable company. I will be canceling our contract ASAP. Going back to Premier Pest control. They were excellent and reliable. I don't skimp on my pest control. 
Aptive, you better step up your game. You have too many competitors who will pick up your slack.

We have eaten at Bimini's many times and have always enjoyed our meals and the professional and friendly staff. We recently went there and ordered a Caesar salad, steaks and baked potatoes.  The Caesar salad was prepared at our table and was delicious. The steaks were not hot , burnt on the outside and dry. We did send them back; they were a little better, but for the price, they were meditating best. The baked potatoes were not hot and the skin was so overlooked that we couldn't cut it with our knife. We were very disappointed with the quality of the food. I hope they can improve whatever was wrong in the kitchen.  The staff was very apologetic and tried extra hard to please us.

First problem I had with this property was calling in making reservations for a wedding. I was told the bride had so many blocked rooms. Some of which were two bedroom suites. So being that I had five adults in my party I figured we'd better get the 2 bedroom suite. Well on February 13 I called made the reservations for the suite. Then called other family members and told them they should go ahead and get their suite before they're all reserved. They took my advice and did just treat. Fast forward a week prior to our arrival I'm checking my email for confirmation and discover the young lady gave me a studio. 
I immediately call the property only to be told there are NO MORE ROOMS! I'm furious! What am I going to do. The rude young lady answering the phone suggests that I call everyday to see if there are any cancellations. I do just that to the point of where I know I'm getting on their nerves. Needless to say they Never had two night two bedroom suites to become available. Luckily at the last minute my husband decided not to come. So the kids and I had to make the studio work. 
Checked in on Friday March 23. The check in process was great and revived a room close to my family as requested later. Because I worked for Marriott years ago I'm still a loyal customer. So whenever away from home I look for a clean safe Marriott location. Because this was the first on the Brides list of choices I chose this place, not to mention it's a Marriott property. So I feel at this point I'm winning! NOT! Again we checked into our small cramped up room on Friday afternoon. After driving almost seven hours from Atlanta. Immediately upon opening the door I see this is not what I'm used to from Marriott. The bathroom door does not shut properly nor does it lock. So while in the bathroom my three year old grandson was able to constantly open the door. Ok so it's time to shower n get comfortable.  Only to find out now the tub doesn't drain. The bathroom wasn't cleaned properly which made us afraid to even sleep in the bed. The closet is located in the no vent bathroom. Making it extremely hard to get to the iron and ironing board. Ok we get through the night next morning it's time to get some good coffee and a decent breakfast. not here, that's for sure. Coffee was awful and breakfast was even worse. Mind you they only serve breakfast from 7 to 9 on the weekends. So you better get down there quick. I woke my kids up to be certain they'd get a good breakfast, my three year old grandson didn't even like the cereal. I couldn't believe the lack of quality for such a well known establishment. The next morning we didn't even bother to get up and go down. 
Needless to say this was not a good experience, not what I expected from a Marriott property. I will not stay at another TownPlace Suite by Marriott. The two stars are for the friendly staff.
This place makes me wish that I lived in a Philadelphia so that I can try all the amazing food stands inside.
Such a beautiful view from the restaurant the pollo asado plate was delicious(keto friendly options) highly recommend if you are in the area.

Overpriced, undersized plates, overinflated price. The attempt is notable and i really wanted to like the place. But i really can't explain the 700% mark up in pricing for 3oz of potato chips with 2oz of seasoned ground beef, tomatoes, and some seasoned sour cream sauce. If you want to open a Gastro Pub in Plant City you need to offer better food and better drinks for the prices you charge. This isnt Cali or Washington.

I just had a squash carbonara. It was good, could've used a pinch of a salty herb. But that might've been what the bacon was for. Customer service on the other hand was sub par and food ultimately may have tasted better had that been on point. I was one of 3 customers there this afternoon at the bar but bar manager or owner, didn't speak besides taking my order and did not check to see if my food was satisfactory while I was eating. I actually tried to engage with him and another person working the bar since at one point I was the only customer. Granted they were preparing for the evening but acknowledge a customer sitting there. Then the bar manager or owner (couldn't tell) received a cold call from a media salesperson while I was at the bar and told the greeter with a bad attitude, "no time for salespeople, tell them I'm unavailable and to leave a message and throw it in the trash haha". Rude to say in front of a fellow media salesperson sitting at the bar. You never know who your customers are. Anyway finished eating, moved my plate in front of me and literally had to put my credit card on the table for them to come back. After I paid with 20% tip and leaving, didn't even get a "thank you, come back soon" or goodbye. It was an awkward exit. So 4 stars for food, 2 star for customer service. 3 seems like best overall answer.

Don't worry!  You can still go to 'oasis juice bar' in Devon for the juices and desserts while the Frazer location is under construction.  Just downed a green juice and had a nibble of the AMAZING Pralines & Creme Pie.  I'm trying to save the rest for later, it was unbelievably goooood.

One of my favorites in Philly! The decor, ambiance, service, and food are all top notch. I wandered in around 5pm on a weekday and, understandably, it wasn't packed. We were able to snatch seats on the lounge sofa right in front of the fireplace- incredibly romantic and warm! I wasn't expecting much of the roast beef sandwich but I was so pleasantly surprised and ended up loving it! It was delicious, juicy, and the sourdough bread was so good along with the side salad. I will definitely be back!

I had asked for a stylist who is experienced with pixie cuts and got an appointment with someone whom I was assured was good at them.  Unfortunately she got sick and went home on the day of my appointment, causing them to reschedule my haircut an hour beforehand with a far less experienced stylist.  I needed a haircut before the holiday and this was my only day available so decided to take a chance.  My stylist obviously had no idea how to achieve the shape or texture that I described to her.  I walked out with the most uneven, choppy, badly butchered haircut I've gotten in years.

On the other hand, the salon was nice and everyone was very friendly.  But I will continue my search for a good salon and a competent stylist.

We arrived around 3pm on a Saturday it was busy and the wait wasn't bad, it was around 10 minutes. I was pleased with my lunch. Service was fast and the food was delicious. I selected 2 items from the "snacks" menu. The price was reasonable and the portions were good. I would return again.

In a weekend where I made a decision to jam down as many fishes and chips into my gullet as possible, it was IMpossible to avoid a place so named. 

Talk about a quaint little Hot Dog On A Stick vibe for a food like this! Very awesome. The menu was set up in an easy-to-read manner, and I'm sure I ended up overlooking some great items simply because I focused in too narrowly. I didn't even have a beer. Stupid me!

That said, the fish was moist and tasty, and definitely as advertised on the menu. The chips were CHIPS, rather than fries -- which I appreciated -- but were otherwise not noteworthy. I ordered a side of gravy, and that was also nothing to write home about. It was good, but a little bit thinner than I'd prefer with my chips. I wasn't toppled over by my meal, but it met my expectations and I was satisfied.

Side note: this is the first place I've been that didn't throw a lemon on to the plate with the fish. Very odd.

All in all, if you want fish and chips and great beer, you should hunt down Brewhouse and rejoice; but if you're on State and want a quality plate, I have no qualms about recommending Mac's. Just... please... don't keep your focus too narrow!  ;o)
Nasty bathrooms and some serious pricing discrepancies with questionable business ethics. The food itself was okay, but won't be back unless the place gets a serious cleaning!

Whoa Nelly! Yelp baby! Keeping this long haul trucker well fed! Dominos is fast becoming one of my late night faves!! #pizzadelivery #right2mytruck!!
#greatcustomerservice #oohLahLah!! :-D
A grill similar to Benihana with performing chefs, etc.. Visiting such a place is an interesting life experience, but not an everyday lunch.

I had the pleasure of getting to visit this historic location during the 2012 Tale's of the Cocktail gathering.  To give a brief history- The restaurant was opened by Count Arnaud Cazenave in an 1833 mansion.  The bar was originally a 'gentlemen only' club and a safe haven for political figures.  The bar and back bar are truly vintage, dating to the late 1800s.  How the name came to be though, well, is kind of ironic if you are one of the countless people that make fun of the French army.  To be fair, it was strong back then, but anyway, the bar and their namesake is derived from the French 75 Field Rifle.

We came here to pay homage to the cocktail, learn its roots, and experience its birthplace for what it is today.  Connected to the restaurant, but separated by look through doors, the bar was very tight and seating was invariably limited during the prime time of drinking hours.  Bartenders and bar backs manned the bar, churning out and endless variety of drinks.  A bar manager moved around rapidly in his black, penguin tail tuxedo, complete with bowtie and slicked back hair.

On the wall was a large cabinet of cigars to choose for the perfect compliment to your cocktail.  Many, many people had taken advantage of this is the small, cramped space, and three-quarters of the way through our cocktail, I found myself a bit sickly from the profuse clouds of smoke beginning to fill the room.  Thankfully we were quickly on our way out, but nonetheless, the experience and to get to see such a gorgeous bar was very worth it.

This was our first time here. We weren't sure what to order. Our server was very helpful in suggesting us to order apps. My sister and I ended up ordering way too much. Love the tapas menu. Their fusion of flavors in their ramen is to die for. I left so stuffed with a bag of leftovers!! Overly joyed I found this place. To our server, didn't catch his name bc all the servers worked together but I think his name was Joe or something like that! Can't wait to bring my bf here

Staff does NOT care. Management needs to be replaced. This place could be a goldmine. Drive through service were more concerned about talking to each other than helping their customers. The line was wrapped around the building. A fight was about to start in the parking lot because cars couldn't move. The signs all over the windows : we taking cash only(how about we're or we are) I'm embarrassed for you.

Stopped by today for a late Bfast with a group. Service was slow. They are very stingy with the coffee refills. The waitress passed me up two time in a row after she filled all the other cups. The guy finally  did get me refilled. 
I guess she does not like the color of my money, no tip from me.
I only order toast, they put way too much butter on it. Gave me a sour stomach. 


 Want Mex food go else where. Don't plan on coming back.

The one thing good about this place is the price - relatively cheap.

However, the food is just so-so - meh! I guess I'm really spoiled by the amount of good Filipino food in the SF Bay Area - even the cheap ones are better.  

If you really have a hankering for Filipino food and have no other places to go (in Reno), then maybe you can go here.  Otherwise I'd skip this...
Went for lunch tried the steak salad and the French dip sandwich ! Both very good- waitress was super nice- cool atmosphere and lots of tv's! Will go again !
Best Mexican of Santa Barbara- especially their horchata and free chips with the best salsas
This is my favorite burrito in Plant City. It's perfectly grilled and packed with fresh ingredients.
Thunderbird pizza has the best buffalo chicken pizza on the planet. Also the staff is always very friendly despite how busy they are!

Been here a fews  times  for breakfast, and  lunch and dinner. Best place to eat very friendly staff. The food is beauuuuutiful ...!!! very good. The best drinks of had like Sangria, Mojitos n all the drinks. I truly recommend this place to eat at at any time.

We tried this place out with extended family in town. They mentioned that the visit with family was great and that they will certainly be back for the pizza. We really like the concept of building your own pizza. Everybody can get what they want. I am sure that we will be back several times between family visits. Thank you for the great meal and outstanding service.
The rating is really for their soups, esp the carrot ginger.

I have eaten here a couple times now and both times I was disappointed.  I went here because they went organic so I was super excited.  The first time they just put too much in our burritos and they broke open.  You had to eat the burrito with a fork.   This happened again the second time I ate there.  I watched the server make a burrito and ask the guy if its okay that it broke open.  The customer said remake it.  I got my drink cup filled it with tea and there was a body hair (not mine)on the cup.  Then when I was eating my chicken burrito, there was a piece of steak and a piece of pork in it.  I was totally grossed out and couldn't eat any more.  There food bar has been questionable each time I have been in here.  They need to work on the cleanliness on their store as well as grooming habits of employees.

I have eaten at the  Milwaukee location and they made the perfect burritio!!! and their food bar was super clean.  Totally different atmospheres.
This is my favorite chinese place! WAY better than Fortune up the block. Great price and quality food. Their egg rolls are fantastic!

2.5 stars. Stopped here last one night around 11 PM. There was only a single customer drinking a beer at the time. 

I got a roast beef sandwich with provolone and a side of long hots to go. 

The total was nearly $11 and the side order of long hots should be called a 'long hot' because it contained a single pepper. 

I got home and the sandwich was just subpar. The roll didn't taste fresh, the beef was cold and dried out, horseradish was watery and bland, and the long hot was mediocre. 

It wasn't a good sandwich and not worth $11. Hoagiefest at Wawa is charging only $5 for a large sandwich this month and arguably has better hot sandwiches than this particular one. 

I might go back another time to try the roast pork but I won't be stopping here again for the roast beef especially later in the evening. Just might wait to go to the original Nick's in South Philly instead.

Love the sandwiches here, but they need more employees- we called in lunch on a Saturday and they left me on hold forever, then when we got there we saw that there was only one cashier/server and one cook working. So it took forever to get our food, even though we had called ahead AND given them twice as long as they'd estimated to make our order.

On a recent trip to St Pete Beach - this was my favorite meal. Not fancy at all but really great food and nice service. 

We were planning on dining at Dockside Dave's for lunch but didnt want to walk that far (having stayed at the Sirata and not wanting to move the vehicle). We settled for Crabby Bill's and were glad we did. Those staying in this area will be well served by this place. The top bar has a nice view of the beach but we opted for the conditioned interior. It seemed like most tourists were ushered down to some long wood tables on the right side of the restaurant while locals stuck to the interior bar and surrounding tables. 

They were offering a nice Yelp deal for a free order of Onion Rings with an order of $25 which we were bound to spend. That being said, why do I always feel like I'm in trouble when using one of these check-in offers?  Upon informing our waitress (who was extremely nice), we were visited by the manager who approached asking to see the coupon. I wish it wasn't so intense.

That being said, the onion rings were awesome! And a huge order - something built for 4 rather than 2, imo. Seriously, i could have loaded up on those onion rings and been good for the day. 

Instead, we enjoyed a couple well-made (albeit pricey) rum and diets while waiting for our lunch meals of fried clams and grilled mahi mahi. The fried clams were plentiful (way more than needed) and accompanied by serviceable sweet potato fries. The highlight of the meal though was a delicious, fresh, lightly grilled Mahi Mahi. Seriously, that fish was delicately basted in butter and served promptly. Beautiful. For a day on the beach - it was perfect. 

The sides unfortunately were not on the same par. Garlic Mashed Potatoes were fine but they arrived in a paper boat leading me to believe they had just been microwaved and the sauteed green beans had no place being on that menu. Canned green beans mixed with limp, undercooked bacon. Yuck. 

As long as you know what to avoid, you should be fine though. If I'm back in the area, I would have no problem with a revisit.

Still giving this dump 1 star, wish I could give 0, I went in today for something quick to eat with my acquiantence Joa and upon starting the last portion of our meal (which wasn't delightful in any way possible) we both began to get horrible stomach pains and feel nauseous. Wendy's should seriously push for healthier food and better quality, until then, I will repeatedly give 1 star to every Wendy's establishment I step foot into.

My husband and I are staying on the North Shore of O'ahu and we're looking for a place for some good coconut shrimp. Did we score!! We stopped at Kahuna Grill, and boy did we pick right!! First of all, our order was taken by a lovely young lady named Alyssa! She explained our choices such as rice or home fries, additions we can add to our salads, the dressing and sauces. I had the Coconut Shrimp and hubby had a combo of Coconut Shrimp and Garlic Shrimp!! YUM!!! Alyssa came out to make sure all was tasting good and if we needed anything. If you want great food made and served by genuinely nice people, you need to visit Kahuna Grill, BUT MAKE SURE YOU LEAVE ROOM FOR THEIR DELICIOUS HOMEMADE CHOCOLATE CHIP BANANA BREAD that's also TO DIE FOR!!! You won't be sorry!!

This place is great!  It's one of the biggest breweries for seating I've seen.  The decor is sleek with an urban factory vibe.The bar staff was great, especially Coleen.  She was very informative about the brewery and the beers.  We ordered a Reuben Sandwich and it was yummy!! We, also, shared an order of Deviled Eggs.  It's a nice set up when you are ready for food.  They have a very friendly staff that mans the ordering window area.  You are given a number and your food is brought to your seating area. I can guarantee this...if you go once, you will go back again.  Kudos to the owners!!

My new favorite spot to get a sandwich in the 'hood.  I personally love the Diablo with fresh peppers and avocado.  Get it pannini-pressed and you'll be in heaven.  Their sandwiches are pretty reasonable too - they have some quality cuts and lots of choices.  The Foodery is part deli, part bar, part convenience shop. 

This area needed something a bit chic to spruce up this part of Roxborough.  It's a particular block where there's a lot of old-school commerce, divey pubs and metered parking.  If I know Roxborough locals, some would be opposed to the hipster implosion but I find it refreshing.  The family-style seating layout is nice and you can chill and have some suds with friends in front of some big picture windows instead of a dark old pub (some more seating would be great, though).  Word is out and it can get crowded - a lot of the area is dedicated to imported snacks but would likely serve better for people to congregate.  A lot of it is over-priced, Euro frill that no one could care about but there's nothing else like it in the area, which I guess is the appeal.   People leave their business cards around so I get the feeling it is replacing Starbucks as a meet spot and it feels like a neighborhood community gathering spot.  They support the local dog park and it's dog-friendly, too.  Bonus.

Of course you must mention the beer selection, which is quite good AND extensive - import and domestic, single or 6er.  Alas, minus one star for trying to rip people off.  I get it - novelty and convenience but c'mon.  We are not in New York City and you are not fooling anyone.
I have a problem with them because i was trying to make a purchase when i seen their cart or food truck around my school i was told that i couldn't use my money to buy from them.

Gluten free find!!  Breakfast: GF pancakes & French Toast.  Lunch:  GF bread for sandwiches and GF soy sauce glaze on their roast chicken.  Treats: GF cupcakes, cookies, banana bread....   Oh and they have non-GF foods too.  Terrific salad and soup bar!  Yum!!!!

Came here for the valentines haunted house. 
Pros:
Very interactive and entertaining
Actors were great

Cons:
Was raining and posted there was covered waiting areas but there wasn't
Haunted houses were about 5 minutes a piece, there was two
Was told there wasn't a line and to not buy fast pass but we waited about 45 minutes in total. When we definitely would have paid the extra for it

Finally went for Restaurant Week lunch and it was amaahhhhzing.

THE SALTED CARAMEL BUDINO. So good. AND. If you can't finish it because you just ate sooo much and it's really rich, you can ask for the lid and take home the adorable little jar it comes in and enjoy your budino for days.

The roasted beet salad was really good, as was the sheep's milk ricotta. 

The pizza was good and really huge for a restaurant week portion.

The soup was actually really good too.

Good service, great food, cute atmosphere.

We were looking for a nice brunch spot on our last day in NOLA. This place was perfect, quaint, pleasant, nice atmosphere, great food, great service (thank you, Darcy for your suggestions, prompt service and yet not hovering).
it is right on Frenchmen Street which is a local treat!

Amazing customer service every time I've been in. Everyone is always so helpful and knowledgeable. It's nice that they remember me whenever I come in and make me feel welcome! The manager is so nice and provides an amazing customer service experience so it's no wonder that she has amazing staff too. I will definitely be shopping here for years to come.

Whoooa !!   one word.. dirty. For real I'm not the type who's looking around for that but this was really blatant. The floors caught my eye first.. look like they haven't been swept/mopped in days !! I stopped in around 2:30 and the counter with napkins and was trashed. Sticky residue from soda, ketchup just stuck to the counter, napkins all over the place. Looks like no one is occasionally walking around wiping things down.

After working down the street for many years without a single visit to Lucky's, I finally made a reservation and went with four of my girlfriends--and we had a blast!  Our server Ringo was very attentive and knowledgeable, he made sure we were well taken care of the entire night (thanks Ringo!).  We ordered a few appetizers to share, but the meatballs definitely stood out for me. And the bread basket with raisin bread was a little something extra.  I ordered the petit filet medium-rare and it was cooked PERFECTLY, with a sliver of red, and paired with the mashed potatoes and cauliflower gratin- I was nearly in heaven.  Topped off dinner with coffee and homemade blueberry apple pie which was also divine.  I cant wait to go back and try more! The burger sounded amazing and I had a bite of the ever-so-flavorful ribeye.  Lucky's was exceptional and it's easy to see why everyone loves this place.  Ill be back.

I had a slice. It was perfection. The kind of thing you taste in the city then long for, try to recapture and are terribly disappointed over and over until you almost give up, but you try once more and there it is! The thin crispy crust, sauce not too sweet and well seasoned, cheese gooey but not too stringy, fold in half and hold just right so it doesn'tdrip on your arm. And with a cold beer and very nice staff, PERFECT! 

This is the best pizza in Newtown Square IMO. I can't wait to go back!

I came here today for my first time it was absolutely amazing the meat was the best and the salad festival they have is very nice I like how they make you use gloves to go through the salad bar to avoid germs also the workers were the nicest ever and they didn't charge for my 3 and 8 year old sister so that was really cool I definitely recommend this place especially if you wanna take your girl on a date it's very nice. My favorite was the mozzarella garlic beef I think it's called oh my gosh I don't even like beef that much but it was so freaking good! Definitely one of my favorite restaurants will be going back for sure!
The house salad had gorgonzola and pear. Wow! The grouper and spaghetti was fantastic! Great atmosphere and overall experience! Highly recommend.
The new stuffed crust pizzas are pretty good for fast food pizzas. The garlic dipping sauce and banana pepper helps add flavors to the stuffed crust pizza.

Very clean, cheap, and big store. I like the fact that they added grocery to the right of the store. I think they have too much women's clothing. The home department is very organized. The dressing rooms are in a bad place, though. The electronics are in the back. They carry CDs, DVDs, TVs, Computers, DVD players, and cameras. The grills are reasonably priced. The back-to-school savings are great! From backpacks to lunchboxes to crayons, they have it all. I commend the pharmacy and potrait studio. I enjoy seeing the lady's footwear department!!! I'll be back!

We went here for dinner on a Saturday around 5. It was an hour wait if we wanted to sit at the hibachi grill, but there were tables open in the regular dining room. Since the menu is exactly the same, we opted to sit in the dining room. The service was not very good and there was a very rowdy group in the dining room which did not make our experience very pleasant. The food was just OK. In my opinion, there are much better options around Indy for sushi. We may go back for lunch sometime, but I doubt we would ever go there for dinner again.

Caitie is the best hairstylist in town! After my previous stylist left Nashville, I was tasked with finding a new spot that I could trust to get my hair right every time. Traveling for work often makes it hard to get in on a regular basis but Scout's always seems to have openings that work with my schedule, especially now that they are open late.

The food truly is authentic and the tacos are definitely a staple of Mexican cuisine. Simple but delicious, and there is a salsa bar so you can add your own toppings to your tacos. The horchata is delicious as well and tastes fresh. The vegetables are fresh and the meat is lean and cooked well. There are simpler options like carne asada, chicken, and then more complex options like tripa, lengua, and more. The atmosphere is very warm and inviting. Prices are also cheap and they carry specialties like menudo and pozole.

Wonderful old inn next to the river with an attractive dining room and bar. Cosy, comfy dining room that is bustling - even later in the evening.  Crab bisque was excellent - loaded with crab.  The Margarita salad (a house specialty) was interesting and tasty - mixed greens and melon with walnuts and blue cheese.  Grilled trout (also a house specialty) with green beans and fava beans was wonderful.  Also, good seasonal beer on tap and wine by the glass.  All in all a great meal.

Brunch.  It can be so simple.  Small menu done right and it's the best meal you had all week.  Done wrong.....well you know.   These guys do it right.
