They take the love of Proscuitto and make it an art form.   Cream Chipped Proscuitto was so good I almost licked the  bowl.   Ouvo Inferno was amazing.  The cheese board, the desserts and the salads.  Wow.  Way to Big Dan, this is my new fave for brunch.

King Dough has some uniquely tasty pizza options including the Pork & Pine which I tried.  They also have salads, appetizers, and sandwiches along with a full bar.

The first expansion of this Bloomington restaurant is tucked away at the corner of Michigan St (one way west bound) and Highland.  They have some street parking along Michigan Place (side street) and a small lot on site if you are lucky enough to grab one.  The restaurant has a large pergola covered patio that leads into the dining area (but could use some signage letting you know where to enter.)  The dining area is bright and has glass garage doors that will open up to the patio during warmer months.  There is also a separate bar on the east side of the building next to the kitchen.

The staff were friendly and even though I was getting an order to go, offered me a beverage while I waited.  The pizza was ready in a surprisingly short time too!

The flavor of the pizza was really good.  The pork & pine comes with Turchetti's Canadian ham, pickled pineapple, pickled jalapenos, red sauce, and cheese.  The pickling was a great addition to the flavor depth as the acidity balanced the sharp flavors of the peppers and fruit so that when paired with the savory flavors, made for a full flavored bite.

My only real negative was that the pizza was charred on the crust (it bubbles quite a bit) and soggy in the middle which made most of the ingredients fall off or stick to the box in the center.  It didn't detract from the taste, but is a bit of a nuisance when the cardboard box gets soggy.  Maybe they could adjust the amount of baking powder so that it didn't bubble as much which would allow the center to cook just a bit longer.  I would have thought a pizza place could figure that out, but maybe they like soggy centers.  Me, not so much.

Review #2227

I had read about this restaurant in a local online magazine, so I wanted to give it a try. We made a reservation and as mentioned in other reviews, I would just call the restaurant to make the reservation. We met another family there, so there were 6 of us. While we waited for the other family to arrive we cracked open one of our wines (it's BYOB), sat outside and enjoyed the beautiful December evening and wine. All of the wait staff and host were very friendly. 

Once everyone arrived and we were seated, they brought us a basket of wonderful homemade crusty bread. Our table ordered the Caprese salad, Caesar salad & Cicchetti. The salads were large enough for 2 people to share and we passed the Cicchetti around the table. Our table ordered Guitar Strings, Straw & Hay and Al' Arrabbiata Shrimp. The servings were just the right size for one person and everyone loved what they ordered! My husband was a little disappointed, because he saw on the December menu on their website that they had Sunday Gravy - fresh meatballs, but they actually weren't serving it the night we were there. Their website does say "menu changes daily". 

We wanted to order the Italian Gelato, which was Pistachio on the evening menu, but they were out of it, so again we were a little bummed. The only options for dessert that evening where Budino and Tira Misu. One couple did order the Tira Misu and said it was fabulous. 

Overall, the restaurant is very charming, the staff is friendly and the food is delicious! We will be back!
Great place and great food! The cheese steak was fabulous! They were super friendly and gave us extra bread for our picky 4 year-old.

Got the egg salad sandwich on a croissant and it was pretty good - better than I thought it would be! Sunday was good as well and you cant beat the price. Atmosphere also makes it a fun place to bring kids too.

Personally, I have had nothing but amazing experiences at Clark and Company. I have very curly hair and I called the salon for a recommendation on who to use and the receptionist suggested Frank. I was very hesitant because again my hair is curly and unruly, however, Frank eased my fears and cut my curls perfectly. Not only is he awesome with cuts, he also corrected my horrible hair color which was done by someone else. I came in with an idea in mind and I left 100% satisfied with the color. Frank is personable and will go above and beyond to make sure you are satisfied! I would recommend him to anyone.

This is the second time I used Art's services.  Both times the movers were on time, respectful of my property, took precautions with the fragile items, disassembled and rebuilt certain items correctly.  They were really nice guys and at a better price then the competitors.  I've recommended and will continue to recommend them to anyone needing movers.
Sadie does a great job. Give her a shot and she will not disappoint.

Dissatisfied,
waited over a half hour for our food. Had to ask for the lettuce and tomato. The French fries looked nothing like the photos,  over cooked and grease.

I'm not sure how many different ways I can ask to be removed from a mailing list...

The last time I was a Sweat Fitness member was four years ago. I have done everything short of sending a Vine video of me crying[1] to get them to leave me alone. Yet the steady stream of spammy e-mails from Sweat Fitness continues.

Seriously. Stahp.

P. S. Fellow OKC Yelper, Ashley D. made an excellent suggestion about contacting the FCC in dealing with Sweat's obnoxious spammery, so now I'm hoping they will keep sending me more emails.

[1]See (not me): https://vine.co/v/MPeFFUHlBiw

Burgers are spot on, my favorite in St. Pete, although my fiance prefers The Burg Bar (quite the in house rivalry we've got going on). We both agree that Engine No. 9's apps and desserts are delicious. They also have a substantial selection of beer. I only wish they had more tables, especially more room for parties greater than four.

My Dad and I got the brisket nachos which were very good. I recommend asking for barbecue sauce it makes them better! My Mom got a pulled pork sandwich and waffle fries which were very good! She let me try one and they were very good. Overall it's a little pricey but everything was really tasty and our server originally got our ticket wrong but corrected it. Have never been and will be back ! I'll take my dog-o next time one of the waitresses said there outside seating is dog friendly

This place is a hidden gem.  Located in a discreet industrial area of South Tucson.  It is a Italian deli with wonderful sandwiches and pasta dishes. The prices are reasonable the food is awesome & the employees are friendly.
Be sure to give this place a try, it's worth it.

3 words- saint chuck duck.  Best sammich in the city.  All the food is amazing! The bar is nice and open, with big cushy bar stools and the bar tender was very friendly too.   

The menu is basically the same as it was at Avenue Pub.  If you ate ate J'anitas at Avenue you are probably experiencing withdraws by now... I know I was.  So make the journey to Rendon Inn, it is worth the trip!

The first time we came here was great. Our visit yesterday showed that things had declined a bit. We sat at the bar and the service was awful. We ordered a snack from the happy hour menu, after 25 minutes, I asked about them, she told us they were on their way. About 10 min. later she said she never put them in.  After clarifying our order, it was still wrong.  She then tells us she's new and "struggling". There were 4 people behind the bar at one point, but they didn't help each other much and one bartender who came in in the middle of all of this was complaining about the condition of the bar where everyone could hear it. Just unprofessional.

I mean the title says it all and the donuts are, in fact, quite yummy. There are always plenty of flavors and it's easy to get something everyone likes if you're picking up for a group. You can't ask for much more from a donut shop.
Been getting my glasses here for the last 4 years.  Had alittle issue with my lens but they fixed it for me without an issue.  Ask for Bob!  He's what great customer service is all about!

I have been here several times. They have never let me down. Super clean. Excellent food and service. Every time I go in, I see something else I want to try. 

The gelato.....mmmm.

Love giving a 5 star review to this wonderful, locally owned bistro. We come here often on the weekend.  Always feel welcome and well-tended to. Food is always fresh. Love the homemade granola and the sweet potato/kale salad.
Yummy new flavor with southern flare of delicious drinks, chicken and pancakes! Will be great this spring/ summer with outdoor dining.

I had the best blended mocha and double espresso at State Street before heading to the beach.  I also had a cinnamon roll that was the perfect amount of sticky.  The coffee was super strong and much needed!
Great beers and food. Service isn't too bad with the exception of one waitress that came over and threw the menus and coasters on the table. Maybe just a bad day.

My routine eye and vision exam took two hours. The actual contact time I had with staff was only about 15 minutes. The place seems be to be in complete chaos. They overcharged me for the exams and tried to charge me double for contact lenses. I ended up ordering from my previous optometrist in California and having them ship them to me. I'm now trying to get someone on the phone to refund me for the overcharge. Don't go here.

Plus, after the exam, the doctor said "the girls" at the front desk would take care of me. Wtf? Is this 1950?

I absolutely love zwicks pretzels. We've gotten take out from here a good few times. The bunzel toasted is a fabulous little snack and let's you get a good taste of there pretzel buns. I know my family has gotten the mczwick a few times and absolutely love it. We also typically get the butter and salt nubs and the sugar coated nubs with a few different dips. The garlic aioli is fabulous and is my typical go to dip for something savoury. The cream cheese and caramel dips are also great for a dessert style add on to your nubs. I think the only downside is probably trying to leave the parking lot as it's on a very busy street but that isn't too big of an issue, I also wish they were open a bit later but this is a delicious spot for a lunch date, early dinner or picking up a couple different packages to take with you for a picnic or party. I would recommend zwicks to anyone looking for a delicious soft pretzel place that has a bunch of varieties, all of which are delicious.

I concur with the other one star reviews on this business. First and last time in this location. Three guys working and all act completely annoyed at a consumer coming in, asking a question or any other manner of service. They even went so far as to gossip about each customer openly after the walked out the door, rolling their eyes. Really disappointing to see a small, privately owned company perform like this, hope the owner sees this and starts to put some effort into providing better service.

We drove down from Doylestown after hearing a review and following on Instagram. It was so worth the drive. I don't even know where to start, the food was excellent. I have never tasted fries like this and the taste was just perfect. Hummus and falafel were both amazing. My husband grew up right around the corner and said the cheesesteak was a+. Chicken rice bowl and the chicken topped fries were also so flavorful. What a gift to the community to have a place like this. I wish we lived closer but we will absolutely be back to try more.

I remember going to the mall for panda Express all the time with my friends and enjoying their food. The last time I went I decided to splurge and get a bowl the price wasnt too unreasonable but it really tasted like it didnt have the flavor it used to and the portion felt smaller than before. I'll try it again maybe because it was a bad day there but I just wasnt very impressed this time!

This is like the Toy's R Us of booze. I enjoy craft cocktails and when I learn of a fun drink from my local bartender at Scott n Co, this is were we can find exactly what we need. This is a warehouse of wine and spirits. The isles are open and wide and usually people are shopping with shopping baskets. Every visit to Total Wine there is usually an employee asking if I have found everything i'm looking for, and usually I find so much more. I must admit I get a thrill when I go inside since it's pretty massive inside.

The staff was friendly but I was less than impressed with my cut. Brought in photos of what I wanted and my bangs were still butchered. I feel bad leaving this review but its what yelp is for. My search for the right stylist still continues.

Breakfast, Lunch or Dinner this place does not disappoint. Food portions are great and the food is always delicious. Service is great and if you do have to wait- the wait is not very long. Very polite and friendly servers.

Stopped in for lunch.  Pasta con Brocoli, garlic bread and 20 oz soda. $6.99.

The pasta was  served casserole style with cheese baked on the top.  
Can't wait to try the wings.  Several different sauces as well as "trashed".

Service is very good: timely, professional and knowledgeable. My problem is NOT with this location but, the home office billing dept. Be warned, you will receive a phone call 2 months before your bill is due asking for payment. In addition, your FIRST bill will also arrive 2 MONTHS BEFORE THE DUE DATE with a "WARNING" that your bill is "DANGEROUSLY CLOSE TO EXPIRATION" 2 months before the due date.  Banana Land.

Beautiful and historic house. Very nice and clean rooms. Great location in New Hope. But, the breakfast was not so good. If good home cooking is high on your list when looking for a B&B, maybe not the place for you.

Maria's is our go-to Mexican restaurant in town not only because the food is delicious, but also because the atmosphere. My son and I always get the #5, the three enchilada plate with rice and beans. I get cheese and he gets chicken; he ends up eating two of mine! I love that they know what we want before we even ask. For people who went there when it was Abel's, try again! It is SO much better now. They are also making cosmetic improvements to the inside and outside. We love Maria's.

What a fun place! The food was great. The atmosphere was great. They had a guy playing music and singing. We had the best time. We enjoyed an amazing mimosa and Sunday breakfast. The pretzels were amazing. The staff was so fast and helpful. I'm really pleased with this place and excited to go back. I'll definitely make the drive from Sahuarita often! Definitely recommend checking this place out. We loved it!

If there was a way to give zero I would. I guess that if your in a t-shirt they won't give you the time of day. I have a large full beard and was looking at grooming supplies.  And neither clerk thought to give me the time of day. Their loss as I would have spent substantial money in their store.
Love having Luca's in the neighborhood. Food is delicious and everyone is friendly. Try the Boardwalk Pizza.

Never again! I've been a huge fan of Red Robin for years and this past weekend was the nail in the coffin for this location. From the moment we requested to be seated it was bad. Hostess told us 25 min in a tone with a face that should've told me then. 5 min later the text message arrives. Promptly seated and 45 minutes later had our NON ALCHOL drinks. I thought we were being smart and ordering food at the same time...wrong. Our food was brought about 20 min after the drinks we still had no silverware and no ketchup. After seeing our waitress only to take our order and bring our drinks I asked the manager for these items to which I received there's ketchup on the table..well jacka** I'm not blind it's empty. We then end up with 9 settings of silverware...my boyfriend having to work that night wanted 1. More fries..bottomless right? WRONG 2. And order food to go. No kidding the waitress showed up and her response to the fries it will take a while and to the food an odd look and then "Why?" Does it matter WHY? One would think as a waitress after your deplorable service would be thinking about me being a decent human being and tipping you on the amount! 

I was going to talk to the manager but after watching him take a server outside and return her in tears in the middle of dinner service not to mention his overall attitude with us decided against it. NEVER EVER EVER AGAIN! Oh and last time our receipt was in French and when we brought it up they stated someone has been hacking their systems and placing notes on checks and changing the language. Red Robin booooooo

Came here once for brunch and I've got to say that it was my favorite brunch in Philly.  I will def. be back to try the place out for dinner.  The atmosphere is excellent and reminds me so much of my vacation in Greece (they really got it down perfectly and it almost feels like you could walk outside and be overlooking the mediterranean sea.

Their eggs are fantastic and cooked in a unique blend of greek spices and surrounded by veggies.  I got a more traditional Greek platter so that I could try several Greek dishes from their menu and it was excellent.  They serve coffee in a french press and the place is BYO as well if you want to have mimosas with brunch!

I think our expectations were set pretty high knowing it's the same chef from Baru uptown, but it just slightly missed the mark. We had the  8oz wagyu picanha where the emphasis was on the meat so it lacked a bit of seasoning (could be a good thing or bad depending what your into). The pork chop portion was huge and the carrots albeit small were delicious. The mash potatoes were nothing special so we should have gone with the waiters Recommendation of the bravas. Overall the service was excellent and it was a cute date spot outside of our normal stomping grounds. Since it was Christmas Eve we drove around and looked at lights in the neighborhood nearby. I would say try for yourself and see if you like it!

Let's say one day you wake up and after looking around for a few minutes determine that you're still wearing all of your clothes, you don't appear to be currently engaged in any form of sexual activity and you don't seem to be in any immediate danger. Groggily you realize you're sleeping on a floor in a poorly air conditioned apartment somewhere the upper ninth ward of New Orleans. Sure you're hungover and still a little bit stoned from the uncountable joints that goddamn trust fund hippie named tarragon or okra or some other plant based food insisted on rolling last night, but what you really need is some fucking coffee. You're a bit grungy so you consider going to Satsuma but you are worried some really clean hipster on a new mac book talking loudly into an iphone about some vaguely tech or movie related project might be there silently judging you and you're too hungover to deal with that pseudo-yuppie bullshit today. You know moving closer to the quarter will only make matters worse so you step outside and head towards the industrial canal. You also have a strong craving to buy a mid-priced drip coffee after you walk past at least one bodega where you will definitely have to pay through bullet proof glass, see at least four stray roosters, definitely see one person you know but who's name you can't remember and have a 50/50 chance that some hipster who is more stoned than you is selling homemade vegan pastries. "Fuck me" you curse yourself almost silently "I know just the place, Solo Espresso."

If you didn't know this is St Elmo's "sister" restaurant. 

If you like shrimp cocktail don't be shy and order 1 or 2 for yourself. I caution you to try just a small amount of cocktail sauce. It has a big helping of horseradish. It will quickly clear your sinuses. 

I went off course with this trip and got the bone in filet and not the ribeye and I went with a rare not a medium rare. It was delicious. I was very happy with my choices. 

For desert we got a Bread pudding to split among the table. It was the perfect desert to end the dinner. 

Service is 10 stars. Sometime it seemed too good if that's even possible. 

Make a reservation to help with any wait times.

Jazz is a great place, I really like their oysters on the half shell, very fresh and on Thursdays 75 cents each. I really like the Chicken Pierre and the Coonass Chicken. My daughter had the Catfish Nuggets and the ones I sampled were great. The service is fast and courteous. Great restaurant.

I lived in Louisiana for about 3 years and I was hoping to get the fresh Crawfish like one can only find in Louisiana and Eastern Texas. My hopes in the Crawfish department were dashed however. I don't think there is a way to transport the crawfish live and the only way I like them is fresh, alive into the boiling pot full of the crawfish boil seasoning.

Everything else I have tried besides the crawfish has been delicious. I will definitely go back again for everything except the crawfish. Don't even try the crawfish outside of Louisiana, Eastern Texas and maybe Mississippi because what you are tasting is a poor substitute to the real thing.

Nordstrom is a real, old-school store where service is more important to them than sales. I've bought a couple suits from Nordstrom and they will always find the right suit for you. They listen to what you like and want, and give their educated opinion about what will work or not.  It's the most pressure free sales environment and it's inspired me to be a faithful customer.  Sure it's more expensive than Men's Wearhouse, but when you're buying a top quality suit and get top quality service, It's worth every penny!

I'm not a coffee aficionado, I can only tell you if coffee is really bad, not the difference between various types of great coffee. When I went to Crema the other morning, I ordered a 16oz cup of coffee and a rosemary pear scone to go. It cost $5 and some change,the staff was friendly and they didn't mess up my order. I didn't think the coffee was great, but that may have been because I just brushed my teeth. The scone surprised me, I ordered it thinking "scones are never that good, I won't eat the whole thing". I was wrong, this scone was exceptionally good. So next time, I'll probably try an Americano and be careful around the baked goods.

Lucked up and there was no wait. Was disappointed they had ran out of the crusted ham they're famous for. Once seated I had to clean the table of crumbs left from the previous patrons. Food presentation is quite undesirable. Nothing special about the taste of regular soul food.

disappointed.
sushi was very subpar. the tuna wasnt fresh the special rolls was small. i have had better "50% off" sushi. definatly better places in area

What a great shop! Awesome experience every single time and the owner, Will, is more than willing to help. Being new to vaping it was very intimidating but the team at blue dream has been nothing but great and helpful!

I would give this place zero stars. It took an hour and 45 minutes for a delivery. Food arrived ice cold. I refused the order and called to speak to the manager for a refund and they said he was too busy. Very bad customer service. I have always ordered from the Ybor location  and they are fantastic. Would never order from this location again. Buyer beware if you want your order fast and hot don't order from here.

Worst meal of my life. Spent an absurd amount of money with such a low return. Would never go here ever again. Would not recommend to anyone. Wish I could go back in time and tell myself to not waste my money.

Honestly, one of the best DMV experiences I've had. The best? Maybe. 

I came with a camera card, and got a number within a minute of arriving. That line was kept rather short. I sat for under 10 minutes, hearing each of the desks announce their next number served, one after another. I was impressed at their efficiency. I thought - they must rush you while you're up there. 

But then, my number was called and to my surprise - the gentleman was polite, unhurried, professional and kind. When it came time to sit for my new license picture, he even took 3 to get one that I liked. For something that will live in my wallet for the next 4 years, I was really grateful for that kind of attention. Even though it didn't take more than a minute to do, it meant a lot to me. 

I sat back in the waiting area for a matter of moments, and before I knew it, I had my printed license in my hand and was out of there. I feel like they have perfected their processes to a science, and the attendants are pretty darn skilled at it. 

Not sure where I'll live in 2020, but I hope my experience is half this good wherever I end up for my next renewal!
The best shrimp po boy I've ever had!  Very casual and the perfect stop after a walking tour of the garden district!
My favorite new brew pub in Delaware.  Inventive menu and great beer.  Nice to be down town and don't forget to stop at UD Creamery for an ice cream to top off the visit.

Nasty puke everywhere you couldnt touch anything. So crowded you couldn't dance. Staff very rude disrespectful, overbearing and extremely aggressive. Out with my sister a security staff was trying to get by he says let me pass we were trying to get out his way but there was nowhere for us to step over he yells it again and we tell him we are trying to but no one is moving. He pushes my sister in the middle of her back to make a space for him to get by pushing her into someone else i confront him about it and he grabs me and tells me you gotta go you dont put your hands on me puts me in a arm lock and proceeded to drag me down the stairs i have heels on so he spranged my ankle im telling him let me walk and just escort me out he is using profanity and proceeds to drag me down the stairs and then pushes me out onto the curb hurting my elbow when i fell. All this beacuse he was rude and disrespectful from the beginning...DO NOT GO HERE unless you find enjoyment in brutality!!!!

We sat down at our table. It took 30 minutes to get someone to bring us water or take our order. After two or three more visits they finally took our order and then we waited another 40 minutes to get our food. The restaurant was half full when we placed the order. Our drinks were empty several times with no service checking on us. And no apology for the slow service. 

The food was good. :)

LOVE LOVE LOVE! "straight fire" - says my boyfriend. We love the food and the service. 

Owner/ Manager (?) with salt and pepper hair and accent is so amazing! He really cares.

I have been here for lunch and dinner both dine-in and delivery, that's how much I like this place!

They have an awesome lunch roll special, which is fantastic dining in or for delivery. We frequently will stop in on a whim for dinner since it's on our way home. We have been happy with the quality of the fish and will keep returning for more.

This place is a gas station. Yep, a gas station that has a food spot in the back.  I've had some great meals at Gas Stations. This would be my first Po-Boy from a gas station. It was pretty tasty. Overflowing with Shrimp and the fish po-boy was hot and flavorful from my friend. They close up shop at 5pm so please realize that and get your snack on long before then. There is a tip jar in the back, be sure to add at tip. It may get you a little extra?! Maybe not!

The Verdict
If its the middle of the morning and you are stuck hungry I'd say stop. The portions are healthy enough to share and pretty ok.

This panera has the ABSOLUTE Worst service of any Panera I have ever been to. My office is less than 2 miles away, I typically order rapid pick up or delivery. Every SINGLE time I get rapid pick up I get back to the office and something is wrong in my order. Example; I requested basil mayo instead of regular, they give me no mayo. Or They give me no croutons with my tomato soup, or not give me a spoon...it goes on and on...Every Single Time. Nothing I'm going to call and complain about, but seriously people, it's ridiculous. Also the delivery is ungodly slow. I get it it's lunch time there are lots of orders and that's fine. But don't tell me my order will be ready at 12:20pm then send a notification that it's out for delivery at 12:05pm if it's not going to actually get here until 12:45pm. I am ordering delivery because I am at work and I have a schedule and now I have about 5 minutes to eat my lunch before my meeting. So Frustrating. I am about to the point that I will no longer be patronizing this location. It's just terrible.

I had never been to a speakeasy before, so I was excited to check out all the hype on my birthday. It was definitely worth it. Pricey yes, but you pay for the ambience and the exquisite cocktails. Dressing up and sneaking to a shadowed entrance and giving a password through a little window in the door... so much fun! The cuisine was outstanding as well. I had the steak and it was everything you'd expect in a high-quality cut. It arrived on a bed of cornbread grits that were absolutely superb. The portions were perfectly sized- not all huge like many places do these days. The seating is exciting too; dark, sexy veiled booths. Very romantic! I tried several cocktails- mainly with gin. Each was a a perfect mix of flavor.

First-time homebuyer here and I had no idea what I was getting into when buying my first house. Amy was such an incredible asset throughout the whole process, and enthusiastically walked me through every step along the way. She never made me feel like any of my questions were "dumb," and as a first-time homebuyer, I had many. She educated me on the process, helped outline my priorities, and kept me up-to-date and well-informed the entire way through. While I was busy being pulled in 50 different directions with time-consuming work "emergencies" at the onset of a global pandemic, Amy stayed on top of all of the homebuying logistics -- as well as on top of me -- and all of the matters I needed to see through. It felt like I was her only client! She was super responsive, getting back to my messages promptly and keeping things rolling smoothly. Even after closing, Amy has gone above-and-beyond to help get me situated and linked up to the right contacts to get everything dialed in. She even offered to throw a post-pandemic housewarming for me! I recommend Amy without hesitation!

The the tub wouldn't drain and toilet overflowed in our room the 2nd day of being here, to the point it went all over the bathroom floor. Absolute nightmare. The store inside the resort has astronomical prices, probably 200-300% markup ($3 for a tiny bag of cookies, over $7 for a small bag of popcorn to name a few), and there are no vending machines. We can hear people using the restroom in the room above us, which is gross. They also don't do any form of housekeeping while you're here unless you call and ask them to change trash or bring clean towels. Regardless of COVID, I don't find this unacceptable. 

While the hotel did the right thing by offering to switch us rooms, we chose just to have them fix the bathroom plumbing issues to avoid having to repack, move rooms, and unpack again.  The people here are nice, as is the resort, but I wouldn't stay here again.

They have forgotten key ingredients in our salads the last 3 times I've been there. Salads have also been extremely oily and salty, to the point that they are not edible. Staff is friendly, so we gave this location a few chances but will not be back.

Popeyes and KFC has nothing on this place!!! Game changer right here chicken sandwich packed with flavor and for desert southern apple bread pudding OMG it was delicious!!!! I got there right before lunch so I able to sneak right in and out before the lunch crowd and I was impressed GREAT JOB

This place is the worst. Order an arrangement for a friends birthday to be delivered on her birthday. Unfortunately, their system seems to have incorrectly placed her old address. The manager was unwilling to redeliver today unless I paid an extra delivery fee. Worst business ever! Will definitely not recommend to anyone.

"Oh My God...  We have to go to MONSTERS?!"  Really that's what I like to call this place - MONSTERS - not because the staff or people there are beasty or anything.  It's because the place is so dingy, grimy, and gross that I seriously believe monsters are going to come flying out of the bathroom at any moment and swoop down on all the dudes and chop our heads off.  

Seriously, though, the vibe here is not good.  The staff act like they don't want you there - or maybe it's my penis they don't want there.  No matter how much you tip or compliment the bartenders, you cannot get them to crack a smile.  You may, however, see their crack as their dickies sag or when they bend over to grab a beer.

And really, the buffet...  Come on, pigs have better digs from a trough.  It freaks me out a little bit because it's so dirty on the first floor.  And don't use the mens restroom - hold it or go outside - I don't think they've been cleaned since 1999.  Oh it's nasty!

If you do decide to go, I'd recommend going on a Thursday night.  They have a great drink special.  And the drinks they serve are seriously straight booze with a hint of ice!  That's the only saving grace, the strength of the drinks.  After 2 or 3, you'll be able to tolerate everything else.
Enjoyed the wings, fries and IPA draft beer.  Noisy, nutty and packed.  The wings were sensational.

I love the cleanliness of this shop when arriving. The wall in the back you can doodle on is a super nice touch! 
I had a chocolate chip waffle cone and the ice cream was superb! 
The service was also exceptional and they let us try all the flavors we wanted!
I think it was a little on the pricey side but overall well worth it. I guess the price is to be expected for a beach location. 

Thanks! Will be back!

That restaurant is middle of no where in Tucson, but the steaks is so juicy and so delicious.  I highly recommended is you go to Tucson, Arizona. 
Well know for the 2 pounds T bone steak.

Anitca has some promising dishes on the menu, and some were good. But the service was odd and, after a $60+ tab even with happy hour specials, we were still hungry enough to hit up a nearby pizza joint later and order another meal.

First, when you walk in it's hard to tell where to "check in" with the hostess. We had a reservation and the restaurant was relatively empty. We entered the front door - the one by the street should qualify. No one was within 50 feet of the door so we walked around and there was only a bartender on the floor, busy mixing drinks. Finally someone came out of the kitchen to seat us... well the host stand is in the middle of the restaurant if you can't find it.

The wait staff was a little slow to start, then was attentive for a while. Then we wanted more food - as others mention, the plates are tiny - it took a while to get someone's attention. The food we ordered came out quickly. Then it took a long time to close the tab. The restaurant was filling up but it didn't seem to have a lot of wait staff.

We enjoyed the gnocchi with scallops and the stuffed mushrooms. The wasabi edamame dip was disappointing, the catfish cakes OK. The pepita butter tomato preservers were good. Of all the good items, most were much smaller (yes, I get that tapas are supposed to be small) than their price would lead you to believe.

Parking is easy - street or garage.

I love the staff at the store. We agreed that humor and are extremely helpful in helping me locate different sizes. Compared to consignment stores like Plato's closet Greenstreet is a little more expensive, but the quality of clothing is much nicer. Make sure you check in regularly if there's a particular item you were looking for. They're always adding new things to the shelves. They are snagged a Mark Jacobs leather Crossbody bag for only $40. It was placed on the shelves last night. Lucky me!

Having made an appointment for today Oct 19 and thought it would be a positive experience.  Not so!  I have been home for a couple hours and my gel is peeling o. 4 nails!  I paid $89 plus tip.  So very unhappy. I will never go back and am out almost $100.  And I don't consider their prices to be $$ I would say $$$$ is their price scale.

Ordered online for delivery. After the delivery time went by called and was informed that they were not doing delivery that night. Asked about my order (would have picked up), was informed that it was not started. The person on the phone was nice and apologetic.

A key part of dining is the art of ordering, and myabe I failed at this as my impressions greatly differ from the others.

We walked in 6:45ish on a Sat night, prime dining time with no reservations, and we got a table. We had our pick as we were the only customers, it was a bit eerie, I mean very uncomfrotable. 

The menu is full of the usual suspects, americanized chineese dishes, vietmeese and a few more traditionaol dishes.

I went with the Balck mushrrooms with soft Tofu in a rich sauce. Between the softness of the mushrooms, tofu and thick sauce it was mostly a chunky stey on my plate.  The sauce was thick however it needed more flavor, even with some chillie oil it needed more. Over all I was less than impressed.

I did not find the value that high either, if I were to spend 7.95 on chineese goods from harbor freight nextdoor I think I would have been much more satisified.

I've been vacationing in Clearwater for 15 years, and I've been coming here multiple times per trip for at least 10 years. Today I came in for an early dinner with my family and my sisters family. My sister is local, and frequents crabbys as well. First, we were seated at too small of a table that did not accommodate our party. I asked to be moved to a larger table, and pushed tables together myself to accommodate everyone in the party. Our server came to our table a handful of times. My family alone spent $200 on our meal and drinks... we got no refills, and there was an enormous hair in my coleslaw. They did not attempt to discount the meal or even offer a dessert for that disgusting discovery. My sister sent her entire meal back for the first time ever. We have always loved crabbys, but I don't know if we will ever be back after the terrible service and terrible food we received today.

Love the atmosphere inside. A big plus to the salsa bar stocked with all kinds of salsa from mild to spicy. We really loved the chips that came initially before we got our meal. Large portions, esp. for lunch and I got the chicken mole tacos which were really good. The rice was delicious! Normally I don't finish all the rice, but this time I finished it up. It was fragrant and had a seafood flavor in it. Hubby got the Agave burrito. It was filled with shrimp, rice and had a delicious sauce on it. The salad that came with it looked amazing as well.

this will be my last trip here.  the previous time I came I was told they were out of broth for the udon soup.  I had it before and was quite good.  this trip, the staff didn't bother to tell me they didn't have it for over 10 min AFTER I placed my order.  this is unacceptable and I will not be back.  the other menu items are okay, nothing special.  overpriced sushi and okay hibachi items.  if they had told me they didn't have any broth,  by the way, how can a restaurant not have broth when they have a whole section of soups on their menu, I would have left and gone elsewhere if I hadn't been there with a coworker who already had his food.

I am a pretty big fan of Bonefish. My family doesn't really eat red meat so when I take my parents out it is typically to a seafood place. 

I don't know if this is a franchise but at each location that I have ever been to the servers are great! 

I'm giving this place 5 stars because one of the servers was so nice! I came here with two of my friends. Apparently, he was extremely charming and pulled out their chairs. When I arrived late, he shook my hand and introduced himself. I honestly should have remembered his name but I don't. I have never had a server shake my hand. Props man. 

You make Bonefish more awesome!

I found this place on a search for sushi. Other reviewers on yelp said things like "great sushi". I was disappointed to heard they do not have sushi and I was given no other explanation. I tried to substitute jasmine rice for fried rice and was told no at first and then asked if I could order it as a side, in addition to my meal? I was told they only have white rice as a side, if I wanted to order fried rice it is ordered as a 13$ meal. I thought for she she didn't understand me and I tried to explain myself and it turns out she did understand but just wasn't willing to substitute or allow any side orders of rice :/ I said nevermind I wasn't going to be placing an order but thank you anyways. She offered no additional help, suggestions or ANYTHING. Waste of time!!!!

Every single time we go here they get the order wrong. Ordered a cheeseburger , Cheese fries and onion rings. Also ordered a kids meal. My burger had some weird white mushy stuff in it almost looked like potatoes. No cheese instead they gave me honey mustard. Gave me two fries when there was supposed to be one fries and one onion rings. Seems to me they were probably out of onion rings and cheese sauce so instead of dropping a new basket of onion rings and getting more cheese they threw fries in and honey mustard since it could be mistaken for cheese. Lazy crew. Has been this way for years. Sucks. Place is always dirty although I cannot speak for tonight as we went thru the drive thru

Stopped by to pick up some coconut milk curry paste and rice noodles they had everthing I needed WAS GLAD TO SEE THIS NEW AND MUCH CLEANER LOCATION the girl working was very friendly and she also told me about their new sandwich shop 
One thing I did get was a tin of Coffee with Chicory for $5.99 from Cafe DU Monde in New Orleans which I needed for my french press was surprised to see they even carried it! 
Store was clean freezer section full,shelves a little barren.owner was bopping in and out of the office and they had a table set up front with new years items
After shopping downtown san fran nothing here even compares and prices here are higher?

I'm a fan of ice cream in general but this place is amazing! Super small and cute space. I went on a snow-warning day so there wasn't anyone else in there, but they had some awesome flavors like coffee oreo, lavender, and cookie monster as well as some normal flavors like vanilla strawberry and butter pecan. The server is super friendly, gave the kid I was with free sprinkles. There is also a decent amount of seating considering people normally just ice cream and walk around. 
Will come back soon!

Delicious food. The Shanghai Shao Mai was very tasty. The orange chicken was crispy and had great orange flavor.  The pork and chive dumplings were good.  The mapo tofu though was too spicy for me though.  Finally the pork pan fried noodles had a smoky flavor and was good.  The food is very authentic. No need to go down to chinatown when you have this so close by.

Pretty underwhelming visit. The Layout of this place was a bit similar to nature's patch but not sure if there's a reason why I'll visit here instead of any of it's competitors, who have better range of products and more competitive pricing

I have been meaning to update this review. I have been coming back for the past couple months to get gel manicures. Don is amazing. He pays attention to details, and my nails look great every time. I definitely recommend this place for gel nails.

On the positive side, I know Full Steam just opened so I have hope they will work out their kinks. I don't want to give it a 1 star, because I like it but my family and I had a frustrating experience.

It went like this - 5 of us ordered food. The first order was a salad, it came out wrong so she took it back to make it correct, my uncle (he ordered the same thing) received her salad. We were fine with that. Then the cashier came to our table to let us know they were out of the salad she ordered so would she like anything else? She said yes, maybe a sandwich and the cashier said maybe we can put some prosciutto on that, does that sounds good. My aunt agreed. Less than 10 seconds passed and she delivered the prosciutto panini and admitted that it was made for some else but they didn't want it. It was cold. My aunt went with the flow. Then my great aunt got her keish, it was cold and she asked them to heat it up. Then I received my veggie sandwich and it was stone cold. All were suppose to be panini sandwiches and warm. 

In the end we should have said something every time there was an issue but after two errors, and 30 minutes later (on a lunch break), we just wanted to eat.  

I will try this place again. It was just disappointing since I only see my family once every 5 - 10 years and I wanted to show them some place fun to eat.

One of my favorite spots in Broad Ripple! It has a great outdoor patio that overlooks the canal but the food here is tremendous! 

Anything gyro is delicious, the wrap, the salad, the original gyro, etc. The salad is a HUGE portion but the tzatziki sauce is amazing. The texture of the tortilla wrap with the gyro sandwich is delightful, its not as filling as a regular gyro pita. 

When you sit down, you are greeted with some warm pita and olive oil/spice dip. Aside from the gyro, I think the garlic feta fries are the star of the show! It's going to take a lot of mints and gum to get the garlic breath out but I would gladly eat these everyday if I could!

i got a delivery from this place last week. To begin with, they got my order wrong. i ordered for chicken with hummus with meat and I got lamb. But i must point out, the lamb was very well cooked and a little delicious!

their shawarma wasn't good at all. The lamb and beef kebabs were overcooked. only the chicken kebab was correctly cooked and was eatable. the rice also felt undercooked. The baba ghanouj tasted so sour i was afraid its gone bad. the best item of the order was the simplest of them all - plain old hummus with pita. i should have ordered 2 of those instead of ordering everything else.

This theater is old, and I understand that but it is dirty and there are stains on the seats. And so stuffy, it actually smells musty. 

I'd certainly rather spend $4 more dollars a ticket and have a clean theater.

I happened to stumble upon Fred's with my in-laws and fiancé.  We arrived in New Hope pretty early and needed a place to grab a reasonable breakfast without the muss and fuss of an overpriced brunch like many of the other spots on Main Street.  

Cue Yelp to the rescue.  What I didn't realize is that Fred's is supposedly a members only breakfast club?  Ok?  We were able to walk in, since someone opened the door for us (we clearly didn't have a key fob that you need to open the door being non-member peons).  The sea of people waiting to be seated obviously was a good sign.  So, we took our chances, put our name on the waiting list and grabbed a cup of coffee.  My darling, Anthony, clearly blew up our non-member status when he asked where we pay for the coffee.  Turns out it's free.  Oopsies.  Anyway, no harm done, the employees were all super friendly about it.  We had a bit of a wait but I have to say it was worth it.  I had the garden omelette (with egg whites) and got the side of grilled tomato rather than the home fries.  (Trying to be healthy after a night of wine and Mexican food ..eek!)  Everyone else also had some variety of eggs/potatoes which looked great.  Stole some of the hubby's home fries and can confirm they were very good.  I would also highly recommend the fresh squeezed orange juice.  SO good.

The counter only seating is a cool, no frills, concept.  I also loved hearing their pooch howl as they sung happy birthday to a fellow member.  Definitely a place I would recommend trying if you're looking for a low key breakfast experience with good food and reasonable prices.  If you're looking for a stuffy brunch where you're going to pay 17 bucks for eggs benedict, this is not the place.  But don't worry there are plenty on the main strip that will gladly take you're money.  ;)

I've had the pleasure of having both breakfast and dinner at The Farm House. The wait staff were pleasant, professional and attentive. The menu is rather pricey, but my husband and I shared the Hot Chicken (dinner) between the two of us and it was perfect portion for sharing. The potato salad that accompanied the chicken was also tasty. We had for breakfast the eggs and bacon. They were not greasy and the eggs were scrambled perfectly. My husband loved the deviled eggs and they were delicious with a beautiful presentation and excellent balance of flavors. Five stars. Will return.

The Bagel Spot is the best spot to get bagels in Cherry Hill. Located right off Kings Highway, The Bagel Spot is tucked away into a never crowded strip mall. Although The Bagel Spot itself can get pretty crowded, especially Sunday mornings after church lets out, so if you want to get a specific flavor- get there early.

The Bagel Spot offers all kinds of bagels, of course they have the typical flavors; chocolate chip, egg, blue berry, poppy seed, everything, etc. But they also offer some awesome special ones. My personal favorite is the french toast, delicious (to make it even better, I suggest heating it up). They also make green bagels for certain occasions such as Eagles play off games and St. Patrick's Day. 

There are a few different breakfast options other than bagels- but if you're not getting a bagel, why would you come to somewhere called the BAGEL spot? They are Kosher certified, so no meats. 

The store isn't huge, and there really isn't anywhere to sit. All of the bagels are behind a glass with labels of their flavor. You can easily tell who the newbies are, as they aren't accustomed to the ordering process. When you enter the cramped space, quickly decide what you want while you're in line, place and pay for your order at the register, then move aside to wait for your order to come out. Do not linger at the register.

I've been coming to The Bagel Spot since I can remember, and have never experienced bad service. The staff here is always busy, so they might not so as much attention to customer as a Starbucks might, but I've never found them to be rude.

A bit aged, could definitely use some upgrading.   I kept looking for the guys from "American Pickers" to show up.  

The pool area is the highlight of this property, well kept, clean, plenty of lounge chairs, towel service, and a great tiki bar.   Beautiful view on the channel, leading out to the gulf from Clearwater.   

There is NO beach on this property, however, you can walk down a small "boardwalk" to a nice beach area.   

The coffee shop attached, very good!  

The restaurant at the Hotel, old, but the food was very good.   

Would stay again.

We ordered to have the food delivered to our hotel room.  We both had pad Thai.  I specifically requested chili sauce or chili flakes with the order. It came with none. In the pot I really lacks flavor there's no lemon or lime e to squeeze on it and it's just kind of bland.   Also, there were no bean sprouts.

Also, it took almost an hour and a half to get it to us .  I guess that's another Thai restaurant in Reno to cross off our list.

I had to look up information about this doctor.  As a patient, I want to know the qualifications of someone I am trusting with my life.
Abdollah Assad got his MD from Spartan Health Sciences University in the West Indies.
Presently, the MD program was placed on probation by CAAM-HP, the accrediting body for schools in the Carribean.
The University is listed in the World Directory of Medical Schools.  A school that is not accredited may be listed in the directory!
In the United States, the medical boards of the following states listed Spartan as an institution whose graduates were ineligible for licensure:
California, Indiana, North Dakota, and Kansas
Abdollah Assad is no longer with West Hills Hospital in Reno, Nevada.
Viva Taco Bar catered our son's graduation party yesterday. Everyone loved the food!!! I would highly recommend them for any occasion. Great job!
To be honest I wasn't impressed. The food was meh and took a while. They weren't that busy.
Gross doesnt explain this place!  Besides the stained carpet, broken doors, broken lamp, broken shower handles ....it doesn't feel safe here.
wednesday 8.30pm,first of all,yes food was good,second,ambience was busy,and third,i am traveling sometimes by myself and it really pisses me off to get always seated at the bar for dinner!!

I absolutely ADORE this place.  They have the best shrimp po' boy that I've ever had in my life.  It's unbelievable and goes well with Crystal hot sauce.  Not only that, they have the coldest beer in the frostiest mugs that I've ever tried.  I came here after work in the 9th ward for dinner and it was exactly what I needed after a tiring day of construction.  I had several frosty beers and a delicious po' boy.  The atmosphere is so relaxed and old school.  I also tried some of the roast beef and gravy po' boy and it too was excellent.  I like to get them "dressed" meaning with toppings, but that's just a matter of preference.  I definitely have to say that if someone was going to New Orleans and asked me where they should get a po' boy, I would without hesitation send them to Domilise's. I learned while I was there that Anthony Bourdain was there in his New Orleans episode.  I can see why, it's one of those places that I would go to at least once a week if I lived in New Orleans.
Chicken waffle bites are rediculous! Great bar food and service. Live music! Definitely worth a stop.

Such a fun place to visit! I took my mom for her birthday and she absolutely loved it. So many scents to choose from and the staff is always so helpful. They serve wine and beer as well which makes for such a fun experience. Definitely recommend! Make sure to get reservations.

Great vibe, great food, great service.  Wings were tangy!  Corn salad with salmon was delicious.  Service was quick and attentive.  We were offered to go cups for our drinks without asking.  Wish we had one closer to home!

I went on a rainy Saturday afternoon. Friends had told me it was a great place. They failed to mention the waiting area was one tiny bench in a very cramped space directly next to the drafty doorway. Employees were sitting in the pedi chairs talking on their phones while people were waiting to be seen. The menu was out of date. They had me sign in with what I wanted then didn't tell me how long the wait would be. People who came in after me were seen before me and that's when I left. The employees were all dressed like slobs; sweats and sneakers. For a "spa" no one seemed to take any pride in their appearance or customer service. I will never try to go here again nor would I recommend it to my worst enemy.

Browsing Yelp and found this place. 

Understand that every one has their own palate and that what one person loves you may not. We read the reviews and became quite excited. Jumped up and made it there immediately lol. 

Lobster Fried Rice ( I MEANNNNNNN )
The rice was in fact delicious but not what we expected. It was oily and the lobster you see in the photo was all the protein in the container and for $ we expected a little more lobster to be throughout the rice. Would I order it again? No based on the price for the quality of the product. 

Beef BLT
Beef Bacon which I can't seem to find at home in Alabama but was told it was everything so I had no choice but to try it. Unfortunately this sandwich didn't blow me away. I definitely needed some sauce or heavy Mayo or something. I would have also preferred the moisture that a fresh red tomato would've given. 

I was struggling with picking my side dish bcus of the choices available but the cashier gave me a sample of the Brussels and they were tasty but after a few they get off putting. They are hella sweet and spicy af at the same time and they were cooked to consistency of well done cabbage. 

Fried Green Tomatoes 
The best part of the order. They were still hot and the dipping sauce was delicious. 

First visit here for us both and we would not return based on this experience even though there were other things we wanted to try later.
Great brunch. Tons of options. Jazz band is great. Completely recommend, just make reservations if you can.

This place just sucked from service to food.  I feel i been giving a lot of negitive reviews but i just was compelled to post this one. I use to love 5 points but these new owners need to be on top of stuff. Save your money go to Dennys

This place was great when we dropped off our car, but when it came to pickup, they were terrible. Our flight path got changed and we arrived instead via rental car to the Philadelphia airport. I spoke with the customer service woman 4 separate times to explain our situation and request pickup at the rental car return (directly across the street from departures). She refused to listen to my request and simply told me to call when we had our luggage in the arrival terminal. No matter how many times I explained that we were no longer flying in, she kept repeating useless information. We then made our way to the nearby departure gate (where they had dropped us off before our initial flight) and called again. She then told me we HAD to find our way to arrivals because they weren't allowed to pick us up at departures. Although this is an airport rule, she never mentioned it to me in any of our previous phone calls. We had to drag luggage across the airport to arrivals and then stand in the freezing cold waiting for our car, which was late. I know it's a good price, but I would have much rather paid more for actual good service.

One of my top 5 favorite restaurants. I had never had orean food before and, when I was young, my dad used to make his own kimichi. I hated it. One day, passing by there on our way to the hibachi place next door (that place is terrible by the way) my co-worker suggested we stop in. Since I never tried it, I was game. We were the only caucasian people in the joint so, I assumed it had to be good. The staff was extremely friendly and the owner, Sam, was there to talk me through the menu. I ordered the bulgogi at the recommendation of my friend. The small dishes or food, I later learned it is called 'banchan' was almost enough to fill me up. The center piece of the banchan is the kimchi. I was a bit hesitant but, this stuff was amazing. I had a whole new outlook on kimchi. But, the one item that I absolutely look forward to having every single time is the 'Kirby Pickles', marinated cucumbers. It's the best!! When the main dish came out, I was almost stuffed. The bulgogi was AMAZING!!! I had never had anything quite like it. Also, the noodles that came with the Bulgogi Box were delicious. Since then, I make it a point to go there at LEAST once a week for lunch. I highly recommend this place for anyone that has never had Korean food and even more so for anyone that has tried it and didnt like it. I really want to try the Kimchi Jigae but, I can't seem to pass up on the bulgogi dolsot!!

I may be retired, but I'm not a fan of sitting around, watching the clock tick. I also like to find a place I like and then use them each time.
Today, I used the Call Ahead service. At 2:27, someone answered the phone and I said, "I'd like to make a call-ahead appointment." She asked my name and confirmed who I was by telling me my phone number in the system. 
She asked, "When would you like to come in?" I replied, " When would you like? I can be there in 10 minutes." She replied, "Good, come on in then!"
I arrived eight minutes later, checked in (the reservation said "next available stylist"), and sat down. 
Thirty minutes later, I was still waiting. During the last ten minutes of which, two stylists stood and chatted with one another. Then a third finished her client and decided to sweep the store. 
Three stylists working on hair color clients, three with no clients, me waiting.
NOT happy! So much for trying to make one shop my "regular place".
Time to find another shop! If you have a life, you may want to as well.
One of my favorite places to go in Reno for dinner. A hidden gem with a series of really good options. She makes each dish with heart and care for us to enjoy.

I had a couple of drinks and the bartender called
The police on me   I talked to the 3 policeman for 45 minutes before i drove away. I have never had the police called  on me ever in my life. This is the absolute worst place i have ever been

First time visit yesterday.  I got the hot pork on a Kaiser with provolone and the Flamin Rooster for the wife. 

I was really impressed with the pork sandwich. I was pretty tired and rushing to get home so I didn't ask for my typical fixings like a broccoli rabe or onions or extra gravy. So when I got home with the sandwich, I anticipated it would be dry.  That was not the case.  Very juicy, flavorful with a soft roll perfect amount of cheese. Very impressed. 

My wife liked her chicken sandwich too. 

I'll be back.  Try the cheese steak next time, but the pork will be my go to.

Still being harassed by this man. He will use fear tactics while have you followed. He never has the correct facts, I believe he hears one thing and makes up the rest to create a better story for his clients. A man of no integrity or has the best interest of a your child. He is only after emptying your bank account.

Now, let me admit that I rarely drive to the north side of Indianapolis, but when I do, there is food involved.

I ordered the salmon salad during a business lunch and I felt myself quite embarrassed at how quickly I devoured my meal. The presentation (originally in a jar) and flavor were delightful. 

If a salad is on your mind, you won't be disappointed.

My friends and I arrived here as a very happy accident after running the Philly half marathon, when looking for a post-race celebration at another place with a similar name. Apparently this happens now and then, and I would say it's a stroke of good luck for anyone who ends up here! It's unassuming - so much so that we walked right past the awning before noticing the door. It's small, with a real neighborhood dive sort of look to it, until you get a peek at the menu and beer list. 

The bartender was friendly and gave great advice on beer selections - as well as offering tastings before we committed to our choices. We ordered a mix of appetizers and other food - all of it sounded great, and delivered on that promise. Think bar food, taken up several notches! My burger was fantastic, and my friends enjoyed their steak nachos and mac & cheese with pulled pork, as well as the meatball sliders. Nothing came out of a food service bag or freezer - it seemed as if everything was freshly made, and the chef even shared some of his secrets to great mac & cheese, as well as offering some tasty homemade dill & garlic pickle chips after the meal. It's obvious he loves food, and care and extra touches to each item the menu make this real hidden gem. 

Everything was great, and we will definitely come back - on purpose next time! If you're looking to go off the beaten path a little, this place is worth the trip. Great value for the price, awesome beer selection, and a menu worthy of any foodie's appreciation. Thumbs way up!

It was ok until I noticed one of the nastiest things they grab the host grabs the pancake syrup and puts it under the front counter next to the table cleaner and chemicals , the syrup was there next to the cleaner , everyone took the cleaner and no one put the syrup away or even noticed it was there . I won't be back . Not safe conditions!!!

First things first, please keep in mind that Daily Eats (or just Soho in general) has a dress code. Guys must be fully decked out in Under Armour gear with BLACK crew socks with neon green Nike running shoes. Gals must be in yoga pants. No other outfit is acceptable in Soho.

----- Positives -----

(1) I'd rate their food 3.5 stars. I had the Gigante which was two eggs, two stripes of bacon, two pancakes, two pieces of multigrain toast, and home fries. It was solid but nothing to write home about. Eggs were cooked just the way I wanted; home fries and multigrain were pretty good. On the other hand, pancakes and bacon were not too impressive. 

(2) Daily Eats has great ambiance/vibe. This is in part because of the demographics that Daily Eats attracts. The successful 20/30 year-olds who frequent this type of restaurants are usually well-educated, motivated, friendly, and fit. When you eat at Daily Eats, just have a look around. At 9am on a Saturday, the girls there look like they already finished a yoga session and the dudes can barely walk because it was a leg day. It's quite impressive that these people already went to the gym and had breakfast while lazy people like me are just getting out of bed. 

Sometimes, I go eat at Daily Eats just to get in the habit of waking up early, planning my day ahead, to surround myself with diligent folks, and get stuff done... You'd be amazed how beneficial a good breakfast is. Seriously, do you want to be someone who wakes up early, eats at Daily Eats, and gets shit done... or do you want to be someone who wastes time on Reddit and eats at Taco Bell at 4am? The choice is yours -- Daily Eats or Taco Bell. (frankly, Taco Bell sounds f'ing good right now)

We ordered dinner last night. I ordered a meatball parm and was very disappointed!  The sandwich was tasty but the long roll had 3 meatballs cut in half.  The sandwich was all bread so in reality I had a half of a sandwich. Definitely not worth the price!

5...only because we can't give it a 6! Had dinner here with my wife and brother on a whim,had Fried Shrooms, Italian Oysters and a 14' Chicago Deep Dish pie....AMAZING!!! 
 The owner and his wife were all over ensuring everybody was happy, WE WILL BE BACK

I used to go here quite frequently but no longer do. The wait staff is superb (very thoughtful, quick, and remember their customers) as is the noodle salad, but their current sushi chefs are not what I'm used to be. On my second to last visit the chef was audibly disturbed by my ordering brown rice then intentionally let my fried softshell crab roll sit until other items in the order were ready; when my waitperson tried to bring it to me I overheard the chef say something to the effect, " well, that's what happens with brown rice." Needless to say  my softshell was a soggy, sauce-soaked lump of hell which was sent back. Instead of offering to make an edible softshell roll they just scratched it off the ticket. I had been ordering them there since 2003 and never had this problem before the new chef came. A few weeks later we went back only to be served bubbly fermented tobiko. I haven't been back since as there are too many dining choices in NOLA for this sort of foolishness. I do miss going here and will probably give it another chance, just not anytime too soon.

Went there around 5:00 on Saturday night. It was packed with a line to get in. Had a 45 minute wait. Seats opened up right away at the bar. Nice menu. Got the Jumbo king crab dinner. It was very good. I should of asked the price because it was 85.00. That was crazy! All are food was great. Great service.
Great prices on meats, fried chicken and hoagies.  Good selection on groceries and refrigerated meats.
Great culture and fantastic food. I really enjoy the menu selection and trend towards the skirt steak. Spirits and margs are great too
Best Thai I have ever had. The taste is amazing the portions are huge, the price is great and this place is always spotless. I love it! Try all of it and get a thai tea too!

I went there on a recommendation of the Hotel. Being very cold and having no car I decided to give it a try... I am a self-proclaimed BBQ snob so off I went...  

I was with a large party and we called ahead so they had no issue accommodating us ( 22 or so)... We were seated quickly and the servers did a good job of handling the group.

I really liked the fact that I could mix and match meats without having to but a large combo platter.

I had to order the Brunswick Stew... Unfortunately, it was a major disappointment. It was basically a vegetable soup with chicken on top.. not worth the 4.95.. they charge... oh well...

I also had the beef and the sausage..... Both were good.  I read were other yelpers did not care for their sides. I had BBQ beans and slaw.. plus the garlic bread that came with the meal... I enjoyed all three.... especially the garlic bread... Other members of my party had all the other sides... They liked everything...

I give them 3 stars because of the stew and the beef.. while it was good it just did not have much of a taste. The sausage was the better of the meats I had.

With that said I would go back...  It was good but not as good as I have had.

Overly popular spot with extraordinary vibe and stylistic layout. Remember to spare a check before going here on the grounds that costs are really high for what you get. The sustenance is brilliant (but we just had two starters - the mahi tacos are strong) and the beverages are outwardly shocking too. These folks even had their name in the ice 3D shapes - alongside a gold leaf pear! Who does that!? Cool spot, however I would prefer to set aside my cash.

I could not love WXPN more if I tried. Upon moving to Philly, I turned my radio on and started unpacking boxes. There was no other station playing actual music, so I landed on 88.5. I don't think I turned the radio off for days. I wake up to XPN, I get dressed to XPN, I listen to XPN while I work, and I blast XPN and dance around my room. It's exactly what a radio station should be. Other radio stations don't come close. 

The best part is that I'm always learning from them. Whether it's engaging interviews with intelligent people, or introductions to new music and new artists, I get so much out of the station. And I'm proud to be a member. All members get treated equally no matter how small your donation, and I know that any amount helps them stay excellent. 

The XPoNential Music Festival in Wiggins Park, Camden this year was outstanding. Who would've known Camden was nice? And the artists appreciated being there and all thanked XPN for playing their songs when no one else did. 

There is one small downside that I am able to overlook, but which annoy my boyfriend incessantly. Those the fund drives. I understand the need for them, and they are what spurred me to become a member, but they do get old quick. Problem is that XPN is smart and plays their best music during the drives. I keep it on, tune out the talk (I'm used to that from listening to crappy stations my whole life), and rock out. Nothing but love for you, XPN.

This is a great place to enjoy chef quality food without endangering your child's college education fund.
Small plates are, as described, small but not tiny and arevery tasty. They define the delineation between quality and quantity.

I had to visit sugarfire multiple times before I decided how to feel. For first time visitors, completely disregard the term 'sandwich' before you step foot in this restaurant, as it has no mercy for convenience or cleanliness. 

With that said, this place is best for their specialty sandwiches. Their sandwich of the day never disappoints. To be honest, I will only come here for their specialty sandwiches, as I 'smell that smoke' and save some money getting old school BBQ one exit down the highway. 

I would also rate sugarfire five stars for their burger. Being a meat and cheese guy, their prime ingredients go a long way in making a great burger.

It's an exciting time for BBQ in St. Louis. Sugarfire's new school vibe and unconventional eats are a great place to experience what's next in this American past time.

With so many tattoo shops in Ybor city, I selected Bay City at random. Savannah was very sweet and very friendly. Jack (the artist) was very thorough with his experiences with finger tattoos (they fade). I was impressed enough with the staff to proceed. I am very pleased with the result:  a small Purple Heart on my ring finger.
Very disappointed ride lines were very long and food was not that good and cold. And the prices were outrageous example a bottle of water was $3.00

I'm hesitant to leave this review because the restaurant is quite small and I am eager to get back in. Simply put I just had perhaps the best Italian meal ever in St Louis. It rivaled the best I've had in Tuscany. My date had the pasta special and it was like something she had never tasted before. Exquisite. I had the absolute best veal Saltimbocca ever. Thanks Pepe

The guy who runs this joint is a character. Go there on a quiet afternoon and just hang out with him.

Oh, and the hot chocolate is delicious. I don't even like chocolate and it's good.

"Train wreck" pretty much sums up our complete visit. 

Service - 
Waitress was horrible as she had no idea what was actually on the menu or what was on tap. 

Food - 
I wouldn't have fed this to my dog. (I don't even have a dog) However, we tolerated the cold, tasteless meals as we were tired from traveling all day. 

Tip: Find someplace, anyplace, other than "Trainwreck".

The old Freddy's Tavern is now the mile  ..nice job on cleaning up the property  our waitresses very friendly.. multiple beer selections the chicken pot pie special was delicious on this cold night nice bar Fair. good wings there's a dining room for the family $$
OMG Burger blew my mind. As fries were mesmerising. Im on vacation and coming back on Tuesday!!

Yummy sandwiches delicious coffee a bit pricey but really tasty - the only thing I wish is the the service was Bette a d the servers friendly was welcoming - it's a pain ti find parking so this is better after dinner or before lunchtime
Cool spot in the back of a very crowded bar.   Not much seating but a diverse, hip crowd.  Staff was friendly and helpful.  The pork belly poboy was tasty and unique.  Will return.
Great food, great patio!! Our daughter loves their quest! 4 stars only b/c I wish they had a traditional taco!

I got the best massage of my life at this place.  My husband & I went on a whim after my orthopedist suggested some deep tissue work. It was 6:30 on a Thursday with no appointment, so it had to be a spot in Chinatown. I've been strolling by this place for years with some curiosity, so we figured we may as well check it out. There are a million and one aches and pains that make me not want to get out of bed in the morning. This morning they're gone. It's amazing. I do hot yoga on the reg, smoke some dank Indicas & take the occasional muscle relaxer & I'm still stiff as f*ck. It's unpleasant. My psoas & hips are tight, I have a knot in my left shoulder that's been messing up my game for over 10 years. I feel amaze after an hour in this place. It might be the best $50 I've ever spent. Yeah, that's no typo- $50 for an hour of bliss- WTF are you waiting for?  

I suppose I should mention some necessary details. Don't go here if your pampered & precious & made of glass. This place is straight Asia style. It's not some "serenity now" environment. The walls are paper... literally. So you can hear dude next to you. But whatevs, it Thailand they lay you out on the floor like a row of corpses. Deal with it. There are no whale sounds or waves crashing or bells & incense. It's clean  & convenient with 3 people who are there to kick some stress ass. Anyway, I'm never going anywhere else for massage in Philadelphia ever again.

I had never been here until I needed some watch bands adjusted. Super nice store and the staff was really nice! They adjusted the two watches and refused to charge me. I was surprised since I didn't buy the watches from them ( they we're company awarded gifts ). I will be back to buy something nice for my wife in the near future. Thank you !

I stopped in here today after an outing with a friend and her daughter. We were a ungry crowd and were lured in by the recommendation of someone who raved about the complimentary donuts that were offered at this establishment. We ordered parmigiana chicken, a veggie medley sandwich, a cheesesteak and a slice of pizza. Everyone was beyond content. 

This is a standard pizza shop, but they offered lots of pizza topping options that easily meet anyone's needs + a bunch of sandwich options. The staff was very welcoming. When they saw that e had a hold with us, a high chair was immediately offered and the slice of pizza was cut into 10 easily small-hand managed pieces. Thanks! This totally bumped my rating up by 1 star.

If in the area again, I'd stop back in. Don't forget to pick up a few donuts after finishing your meal!

The longest wait ever on a Saturday evening and the food was cold blah.  
We waited in line for an hour and a half.  It shouldn't have been that long of a wait, and host staff needs to get it together.  They don't know how to accommodate a party larger than four.  It really upsets me when you've been standing in line for that long, and they hosts take parties of 2 or 3.  Most all of the tables in that place can be moved together.   
When we finally got seated,  the food was cold and without a lot of flavor.  I won't be going back.  Definitely NOT worth the money or the time.

Absolutely the best dining experience! We LOVED this place and our server Bailey was wonderful! While visiting Tennessee we decided to stop in Nashville and have dinner, luckily we found this place and boy was it a gem! The decor is tasteful and eclectic, definitely gives off a great fun vibe; the restroom is adorable! The menu had so many great options from the appetizers to the drinks! We started with the Rice,Rice,Baby which were recommended by Bailey. GET THEM! EAT THEM! LOVE THEM! I ordered the delicious Ooooh Barbacoa which had a beautiful presentation and had an amazing flavor profile with the potatoes and green beans. My friends ordered the The Bird Is The Word (not pictured) that is perfectly fried chicken thighs that weren't greasy.  The mash potatoes were a perfect compliment to the chicken. We shared a side of Mac & Cheese which was also very delicious. If all this delectable food and great service doesn't make you want to write a review, get dessert....the Let's Get Kooky was to die for! Two warm Supreme chocolate chip cookies with Vanilla ice cream will definitely seal the deal!

I took my old Lexus to Firestone three times. Three times they failed to fix it. I honestly don't think they even looked at it the last time. I took it to AZ Auto Refrigeration, and they fixed it right the first time. It's been working perfect ever since. They were polite and charged a fair price. I was actually surprised how cheap it was. I own four cars, from now on they get my business
Gave us free pizza!!! And the pizza is delicious! Customer service is amazing and it came a little bit late but they were so nice to give us the pizzas for free because of that.
