Very cool dive joint down on Morgan Ford. Not complicated, straightforward grab a beer, cheese burger & shrimp it'll be a great afternoon. Great beer selection with a cool bartender to chat it up. Clean restrooms and a sum what spacious patio for a sunny afternoon.

DELICIOUS desserts!! 

I had the summer grilled cheese and it was fantastic. My daughter had the kid's Mac and cheese and it was tasty and homemade but needed a touch of salt. 

We ordered a cinnamon roll to go, a delicious slice of mocha cake and a buttercream-y cookie for my daughter. All were delightful and glorious.

As good as it gets by the airport.  The bar is good with quality offerings.  Service and food are inconsistent.  Drinks can be mixed well one minute and have the same melted ice woth no straw stick the next.  Dont ask for anything special with your food, its too difficult for them.  There you have it.
Great oldies station in Philly! Mostly 60's and 70's music. I love me some Motown soul :P
I had the Beef Satay soup and oh man was it good. Will definetly be coming back. Must try more items on their menu.

Don't understand the negative reviews?  Was in town visiting and took my elderly parents there Saturday night.  Quick service and did not have to wait for the food.  Was impressed with the large food portions and actually got 4 takeout boxes since it was too much food to eat.  They provided cardboard boxes instead of the typical Styrofoam which is good for the environment!  They were playing a mix of classic rock music and heard Radio Rich.( an old KSHE St. Louis Icon ).  Discovered he is now streaming online at TheRoots.FM.   Took the music to go as well with the TuneIn App on my phone!

THE PLACE AND THE LOCATION: 
The location is not that bad. Its in the shopping center where Ross and Big Lots reside.

THE FOOD: 
Let me start out by saying that my grandfather was of Chinese decent and was founder of a great Chinese restaurant in the Philippines. I don't expect Chinese restaurants here to measure up to that but I do expect some decency.  The food at this place was well below par. I felt that I would have been better off heating up some food from the Freezer section of WalMart and it would have been MUCH better than this. I figured I would get something simple for my first visit to see how the chef does...I ordered Chicken and Broccoli. When it came out, the sauce was still congealed from not being heated up enough. The saucy was overly salty and had no other flavors other than salt. 

THE SERVICE: 
The service was well below what you expect at least a mid-level restaurant to be. It took them way too long to take our order and then refills were extremely slow. I usually base a service on whether they let you get thirsty or not....this place didn't disappoint....they kept you thirsty. 

THE PRICE: 
The price was average. $8.95 for a dinner plate. 

OVERALL: 
Never, Ever, EVER again will I go back.

I was lucky to attend two school related events here two days in a row and was so pleased that the kind manager accommodated my requests for vegan meals both days.  The freshly made meals were very delicious and beautiful to look at.  Additionally, the wait staff was very efficient and pleasant. Thank you, Palma Ceia, for satisfying my plant based needs.

I've walked past this place several times and finally stopped in to check it out because they always have interesting things outside on display.

And what a gem!  The name of the store makes it seem like it's for "older" women, but really this place has unique gift items for women of all ages.  

There were interesting coloring books, pretty planners, clothes, lovely jewelry, wind chimes, bead curtains, and just all kinds of fun things to look at and that would make interesting gifts.  On top of that customer service was good!

The prices were a bit on the higher side, but nothing crazy.  This is definitely a good place to go, especially if you're looking for a special, unique gift.

First off I'm not a beer drinker, but my bf loves the beer there. I have fallen or the AMAZING sangria.  The best I've have any place in the area! The food is limited but I also find it wonderful each time I go. The only down side is the slow service. Just don't be in a hurry if you go.    FYI they are pet friendly on the deck.

When service and expertise is what you are looking for. . . look no further.  Audi of Cherry Hill impressive in look but a wealth of information when deciding on a vehicle for our family.  Salesman, Joel Mazie made our experience in discovering what the Audi brand is about, safety features for our young children and all of the specializes features that we needed for our lifestyle.  My husband and I leased a beautiful new Audi Q7.

We couldn't be happier with our purchase.  We have been enjoying the SUV with our friends and family and being new Audi owners we are falling in love with the brand, car, features, and style each and everyday.
With having 2 children (3.5 years and 2.5 years old) Joel made the process smooth and quick.  My son wants Joel to come over for dinner!  

We are honored to be part of the Audi family.  Thank you to Joel and the Cherry Hill Audi team for making our decision an easy one.  If you are looking for technical knowledge, great people, service and answers. . . Cherry Hill Audi is your answer.

This place has gone downhill over the last 10 years.  We used to only get our pizza from here, but the quality of food has gone down.  For instance, in the past you could order delivery for fries and onion rings on the side and they were packaged in vented Styrofoam.  Now they are packed in a sealed hard plastic shell.  So when they arrive, they are soggy.  The result was that their real onion rings (solid onion rings) would have the bread coating fall off.  Instead of updating the packaging and keeping a quality product, they dumped using whole onion rings for pre-packaged frozen ones that are minced onion shaped into a ring.  They taste frozen, and not like the fresh onion rings they used to sell.  The pizzas are now 'wet'.  You need to order it well-done or you can expect it to be all floppy and runny.  However, if you order it well done, it no longer keeps as well in the fridge overnight, so that joy of eating cold pizza is gone.  

I continue to order from here once every 6 months to see if it gets any better.  Each time I'm slightly more disappointed.

The nicest people in a beautiful space! Come for some fruits, pie, or cider tasting. Everyone was so friendly and accommodating. Would recommend for a short visit! Only porta potties though so be prepared.
Always a good experience. These guys know what they are doing and the service is much faster than at the Apple store.
We tried the Al Pastor burrito and loved the caramelization of the pork, the touch of sweetness from the pineapple salsa, and great service to boot!

As a Bay Area California native, a trip to the South is somewhat of a bucket list item. I attended a Saints game, saw the Whitney plantation (also highly recommend), explored difference pockets of the city, and had a meal in the Garden District before finally exploring the French Quarter for the first time w/Mr. Waters. I am very happy I didn't spend time in the Quarter until the Hidden History walking tour. Without spoiler alerts, the 2+ hours we spent opened my eyes, mind, and soul in a way I did not anticipate. You think you have an idea about history - I had no idea. I've been on many tours while traveling. This experience is like having a personal teacher/historian/activist/community member with a depth and understanding of the world, and there to passionately share it with you. It was a rich, harsh, history and present-day lesson that I now have with me wondering what I can do with what I know - with also the desire to know even more. Hands down, the highlight of my NOLA trip. This won't be my last visit to New Orleans, and I look forward to more time with Hidden History.

I ordered their chargrilled oyster, raw oyster, poboy and onion ring. My fave dish? Onion ring. Their chargrilled oyster is a lil salty and not too fragrant, oyster is fresh but okay. Poboy nothing special

DELICIOUS. The hummus is creamy and delicious, the tabbouleh is crisp and fresh. Pitas are hot and fluffy and the falafel is steamy and crispy and perfect - not greasy at all. But the babaganoush. Oh, the babaganoush is the best in the world. Smoky and tangy and eggplant-y....I wonder if they sell it by the gallon. 

If you're not a fan of Mediterranean, don't fret - there's so much here to please your palate. We got the fried shrimp platter and the shrimp were big and sweet and cooked to perfection. 

We skipped dessert but only because we were stuffed. We even brought home some leftovers. The nicest couple in the world are running this place and working their tails off (the husband was making to-go deliveries and cleaning the windows while we were there and his wife was cooking and waiting on us). 

Don't be intimidated by the location on the busy corner either! Just take a right at Esplanade when you're heading south on the Causeway - they're right behind Chris' Cafe and they've got a big parking lot and a beautiful building.

I've been here several times and it's okay if you like really rich, cheesy foods. Everything has cheese on or in it I think. Beer is decent and service is generally slow but acceptable. Worth a visit to see for yourself.
Always a fun place to get dinner with friends! Their burgers and fries are amazing and the drink selection is so fun and tasty! I got a spike hot cider which was great!

Classes are great - teachers & music are good and bikes are new. Online booking is easy and there typically is a bike available. 

The room is a little tight - making it rather warm if you take the 2nd class of the day. This also sometimes makes the floor wet and a little slippery.

This is a tough call, when this place was Georgia Reese I think it had the best fried chicken north of the Mason Dixie line - 4-1/2 easy.  Under the new name I have been there 2x.  First, I was able to get the chicken the old way, still excellent, tonight I forgot and it was slathered with sauce - not as good.  Also, the greens with it are good, but they cut the portion this time.  Either way $26 is way too much for chicken, even if it is the best around.  Saving grace is the bar tender Tye - get the "seasoned" ice, without her, 2 stars max. The lobster pops were good, but if it isn't clear by now I only come for the fried chic.
Man, their burritos are huge!!! I am definitely a fan of this place. Good food and the food was served quickly. Try it out.

OMG Philly Phlava is the next best thing to home. Not lacking in "Phlava"!! We all get varied menu items, my daughters chicken fingers were more like the size of your palm! She said they were awesome. We will be going back enough, they'll think we're stalkers!!! Check it out!!!

All the negative reviews are true
I have sent 2 replies and comments to fly away. I wish I had read the reviews before I booked the spot. Departure was great, arrival horrible. Waited over 40 minutes for pickup after walking Quite a long way due to the construction. This is for everything not just this. They were only running one shuttle, used the app, called 3 times and had to leave messages. Competitors came and went numerous times. Finally got picked up. I was leaving to go out of town the next day so ordered and paid for a car wash. It wasn't done as they said my reservation was for pm not am. They knew it wasn't as she had already credited my account. Heck for the time I waited it could have been done. Just blaming and justifying the poor service. No explanation no apology. I WILL NEVER USE AGAIN. All the negative reviews are true. I have also sent this to both the corporate emails last week when I arrived home. No response at all.

So my friend ordered Shawarma on the Run for our game night last night through Door Dash, only the driver never showed up to pick up the order! The owner of SotR called her and explained the situation, apologized, saying this particular Door Dash driver has done this before and the owner then offered to drive it across the CCC from Gretna to us Uptown. When he arrived, we were going to give him a big tip to say thanks for taking ownership of this issue, and he refused to accept it! That is some amazing care for your customers. 

And the food was freakin' delicious to boot!! Smooth creamy amazing hummus, amazing warm (!) pita, and awesome shawarma plates. Such a pleasant surprise for what could have been a disaster in hangry company! Kudos!
My family eats here very frequently and every thing We have ever tried was delicious!! I usually get a cappuccino or a sandwich to go. The staff is always super friendly!!! Will not disappoint !

Went there with our neighbors , a group of 8 on a Saturday night. We had reservations so getting table was no issue. Very crowded and loud scene, and for good reAson. The food was delicious - I had the pork ragout w side of fried green tomatoes and pepper jelly. Wife had shrimp and grits. Bourbon selection was limited but good enough. Service was a little slow but given how crowded it was, understandable. Would definitely go again

Completely amazing chocolate and strawberry ice cream.  Some of the best if not the best I ever had.  Yummy!   The person who took my order was so very delightful.  She used to work at another Urban location and moved over here.  I wish I knew her name as she was tops in customer service and should manage the place. I look forward to a return visit.  Please fix the door to auto close as most people don't close the door on their way out.

Don't come here....it was terrible... The chicken was dry with no seasoning...the mac n cheese tasted and looked like Kraft... Plus I was a bit sick afterwards...I am sure it was the mac n cheese, cause it was not fresh...
Awesome breakfast and lunch! Only had take out so far, but can't say enough about the food. Great omelets, cream chip beef and lunch specials.

I want to give 5 stars, based on the taste and quality it is definitely 5! The ingredients use soy milk which my girlfriend is allergic to.  I had to eat my brioche while she cried, and then I had to go back after she left town... that loses them a star because when I eat while upset my food doesn't sit great.. although my second trip alone was fantastic.. hope to see less soy in the future, it is a crop that is not particularly healthy for people or the environment...

My first NO Jazz & Heritage Festival was in 2008.  It was one of the most memorable times of my life!

I had just got into town just after some heavy rains had ended.  It was beautiful the rest of the time I was there.

The admission was only $40 for the whole day.  I opted for a shuttle from the Sheraton Hotel on Canal Street to the event.  I believe it was $15 round-trip.

The event is inside a park where they run horses.  Since it was raining a lot the past few days, the grass and dirt areas was very wet and muddy.  At first this was a bit of a problem...but after hopping over pools of water and mud, you just had to give up and just go with the flow.  You got dirty and so what, as time passed and as the drinks kept going down, it really did not matter.

I saw some great acts on the stage that year.  Many local artists and some of the big high lights that year were Santana and Jimmy Buffet!  It was awesome!!!

For the price of admission, cheap beer and yummy food along with great music, it was a great weekend in the Big Easy!

Outstanding ceviche! The medium size was plenty for 4 people.  It had magnificent flavor, plenty of shrimp.   Great service!  Waiter on top of things wiithout being intrusive.  Cameroon  rancheros was good choice for a non spicy selection, add one of the 8 sauces on the table to give it a kick.

Exceptionally delightful! Look past the long lines and enjoy the delicious oysters. 

Unlike any other fried oysters that I've ever had; the chargrilled oysters taste heavenly. The taste took me by surprise: a true gem.

I always get the veggie dog here. Its good. A change from some of the other thicker fuller dogs in town. I normally get the Chicago or the Nashville. I love the bean coleslaw mix!  I wish they had veggie chili but they dont. I love their fries as well. I have become a regular since I started eating here a few months ago.

Phone Repair Plus is awesome! I have a Samsung Galaxy S6 active that has a shattered screen, the first thing I would say is they are the only company with in PA that carries a new screen without having to order one, second they are extremely reasonable with the price I did not need the screen because I'm sending my phone back to the manufacture but they were kind enough to temporarily put the new screen on my phone just so I can access the information I needed. The staff and the owner are extremely professional and really kind and willing to help you out in any way possible. I'm not going to get into how much I paid but I can assure you it was way less than what other companies were wanting to charge.  If there was an option to rate this company more than 5 stars I would  without a doubt would do it. I recommend anyone and everyone who has a problem with any electronic device to give this place a shot.

This place is amazing! I wandered in without realizing that their menu is all vegan (which I love). I had the cider/prosseco drink and it was delicious. Not too sweet like most drinks at other places. Plus it came garnished with a delicious slice of red apple. 
The chicken empanadas were SO good and the sauces they come with make them even better. One is a salsa and one is an aioli I think. 
I had the brussel sprout/fried avocado tacos (a special not usually on the menu) and they had this great smokey taste. But I do wish they had been spicier (thankfully, the waiter brought the always reliable Cholula hot sauce). Next time, I will likely try a spicier dish only because of my personal taste. Otherwise, wonderful and flavorful dish. I always love a unique vegetable in a taco. 
I wish I'd had room for dessert but I will definitely be back to try more things here!

Wow, another unbelievable high quality meal.  The time taken in each meal preparation is amazing.  The smoked pork appetizer was amazing, as well as the Chilean sea bass for the entree.  Everything was done with love and care.  Looking forward to our return!

If I could give this place zero stars I would. TERRIBLE customer service. Unless you have an hour to kill, don't go here. I went there this morning right when the store opens, at 8:30am, to get 3 mylar balloons filled for my son's 2nd birthday party. The party was at 10, so I was in a hurry, but not a super rush. There was 1 customer in front of me with a balloon order and four employees. FOUR. One employee was helping that customer & none of the other employees acknowledged me. One was even filling balloon orders for LATER IN THE DAY. I finally said something to the woman who looked like the manager who wrote down my order & told me I'll have to wait. While I watched the other woman continue to fill balloon orders for LATER IN THE DAY. And NOT help the customer IN FRONT OF HER with THREE BALLOONS to fill! THREE! Unbelievable. Long story short, I waited FORTY FIVE MINUTES to fill THREE BALLOONS. 45. I can't make this up. Not to mention the store is poorly stocked with damaged merchandise. I found ONE #2 candle that wasn't cracked. The staff is unfriendly & lazy. AVOID.

Sub World Restaurant has been serving delicious breakfasts and lunches to the Carrollwood community for 25 years. This family-run restaurant is located in the Publix shopping center at the corner of Linebaugh Avenue and Dale Mabry. Sub World faces Dale Mabry, and you'll find it around the corner next to the dry cleaners and pizza place.

As you walk in the door the main counter is to your right with a number of padded bar stools, and then to your left are tables which can be pushed together for groups. The restaurant is small -- I would call it intimate -- but they are always filled with locals who are on a first-name basis with the staff.

This place is open Mon - Fri, 7am - 3pm, and Sat, Sun, 8am - 2pm, and they are all about serving you a delicious and filling breakfast or lunch for an extremely wallet-friendly price. Plenty of three-egg omelets, fried eggs, and breakfast sandwiches to get your day started. Lunch is all about submarine sandwiches with classic Italian cold cuts or a Cuban sub, and everything in between. They also offer salads, burgers, hot dogs and much more. Everything is prepared fresh and in-house.

WORST SERVICE EVER! I've worked in service for many years so I try to be patient when it comes to dealing with people in that industry, but for the first time in my life I had to say something and not even an apology. There was one boy who was doing all the work and the girl at the cash register decided instead of helping with the line of customers that she needed to restock the cups, when there were plenty already there. It took about 20 minutes for me to get my one meal, when there was only two people ahead of me in line. Even the manager walked by seeing the line waiting for for their orders to be complete and did not say a word. I've been to this location in the past, for lunch they seem to be faster maybe they have capable workers and managers at that time, the dinner crew has always been extremely slow, this has been my worst experience and I don't believe I will ever go back.

 The food is okay, a step up from Taco Bell, but Chipotle is down the street and has much better service and better flavor.
EXCELLENT! Never been disappointed with the floral arrangements I've gotten from here. As long as they're in business, I'll be a repeat customer!
Amazing atmosphere, really chic interior, every dish is unbelievably delicious and better than the last, great service.....absolutely amazing experience! Def. worth going back over and over again!

I have used Mobile Maintance & Towing, LLC  twice.  The service has been great!  Both times the driver, Mark C was both on time and friendly.  He was very efficient in getting my car ready to be towed.  Will definitely use them again if I need a tow.  Would recommend them to anyone looking for a professional towing service.

CHICKEN AND DONUT SANDWICH. Yeah, I know - sounds . . . not good, right? You've got to wrap your head around this one. The chicken itself is amazing on its own, with great skin and piles-of-napkins-on-the-side juiciness. The chili-garlic sauce or the buffalo are the ones to get, IMHO. The chicken order comes with a honey-glazed donut as the side bread. However, if you get a chicken sandwich it can (almost) make you forget GADCO is a donut shop. They normally serve it on a brioche-like bun, but if you ask nicely you can get the bun replaced with that honey donut. The result will be at once sweet (depending on the thickness of the glaze that day) and a bit salty. Dipping it in one of the sauces adds to the complexity of tastes; if you choose to add the coleslaw the extra crunch will cut the sweetness a little more. [I don't care for the slaw on its own, as I personally find it a bit flavorless, but others seem to really enjoy it] Even at room temperature, the combination will take your breath away (case in point - I ordered two of these for carryout and drove them over an hour to Muncie, so you know they weren't hot when I got home. My friends dived in and went silent for five minutes. The happy glazed look in their eyes said it all. Now that sandwich is ALL they talk about). 

Word to the wise - getting an order of chicken is not a fast process there; I've always had to wait at least 25 minutes. A sandwich might be a little faster, but I'm usually ordering a quarter or half chicken so I'm not sure about the sandwich time alone. Also, they don't start serving chicken until 11, which means they may be low on most other donuts by the time you arrive. Do you go early to get your favorite donuts, and miss the chicken, or do you go for lunch and risk not getting a Reese's Donut, too? Solution: call in early and have them hold your donuts until you get there later in the day!

Been in philly for three days with my wife and best friend for made in America and have been raging super hard so we came to this place to recharge. After long but well worth the wait dilemma of which foods to eat it was decided I was getting a #9 with onions and mushrooms bc you know shoot your shot. Anyways this place is great they should be looking for investors to expand and remodel don't be scared of growth. Great service very polite

First visit today and I will definitely be back.  It's extremely rare to find a restaurant serving so many house made fermented/probiotic foods.  I'm excited to try more!  Today, I had the lion's mane (mushroom) "crab" cakes, a flight of 4 unique kombuchas (my favorite 2 were one with chickory & spruce tips and one with lambic hops & mace), and a delicious house made cacao nut butter cup.  This is really well-done foodie stuff folks, not your standard vegan fare.  They put a lot of work into he ferments and a lot of thought into the herbs and accompaniments for the health benefits.  Love love love.  Other reviewers are right that this place is not cheap, but from someone who cooks this kind of stuff at home, I know it's a TON of work, days to prepare, and the ingredients are expensive.  So these prices I think are quite reasonable!  The awning over the door is the same as Urban Chestnut so look for the door with the painted sign.

CLOSED - NEW NAME - New Ownership?

Was looking for Laceno, found La Locanda in its place.  Still a decent plate of Italian food regardless of what is written across the front door.

Terrible service does not even begin to describe this location.  Most recent visit: It took over ten minutes just to place my order. My bills,  change, and receipt, were crumpled into a ball and shoved in my general direction.  After waiting about 15 minutes I was given 1/3 of my order. 3 people who ordered after me for their stuff and left. When I inquired about the rest of my order the cashier says "Are you sure you didn't get your order? " I went off and asked for my money back. It took another 5 minutes for the guy in charge to open the cash register and he shorted me 14 cents.  They need to loose their franchise.

This is our go to before basketball games.  It is unfortunate that this is far from us on the east side.  Love the pizza and the beers are so good.  They give you samples if you would like.  So many beers to pick from and they rotate every week.  The slices are so huge that I typically cut it in half and eat the rest another time.

This place is great if you want to relax in a cool environment with great wine. Its basically a house converted into a store/restaurant so The entrance is a wine store where you can purchase wine, cheese and whatever then you exit  out onto the patio, grab a couple glasses of wine and can listen to live music. They also have a restaurant where you can order food.
I just got my tire repaired by Lee and his staff. Service was outstanding and quick. I will be coming back for all of my automotive maintenance needs. Highly recommended!

Not a vegan nor a vegetarian but still rank this as one of my top favorite lunch places in Nashville. If you like buffalo chicken, definitely give the buffalo tempeh wrap a try! I add dairy cheddar cheese to mine just cause I love some cheese on just about everything. Also if they have the vegan cookie dough dessert when you go, DO NOT pass it up! It's delicious!

They were attempting to repair a LG Studio series gas range. Top of the line according to manufacturer. They replaced a circuit board which cost over $300.

After replacing the board the issue still was prevalent. They contacted the manufacturer and it was then deemed that TWO more circuit boards need to be replaced. Another $700 and we still don't know if the issue will be solved. 

This being the case we went out and bought a competitor brand gas range. As we will have invested over $1000 and who knows what's will fail next.

Why didn't they just deem the range a "dog" and have the manufacturer supply a reconditioned range. But who knows the reconditioned range may be worse off. Or maybe a mouse may have been inside.

Maybe the manufacturer wants all items fixed no matter what the costs. But when you are spending almost as much as the items cost in the beginning there has to be a cut off point!

Where to even begin... 
It's Monday night 9 PM and I'm freaking out. It'a 12 hours before my first Brazilian wax and my heart is pounding. I'm thinking, "maybe it's not too late to cancel, but than again I already committed". I toss and turn through the night anticipating my alarm to to buzz at 6:30am. I get up do some more research to make sure i feel as little pain as possible. I go through a series of breathing exercises to calm my nerves. Nothing is settling the anxious heart. I hop in the shower for a warm rinse off because that's what research said. I jug a whole water bottle and prepare for the drive the drive across town. Im new to Tucson so I  figured leaving my home at 8 Am sounds reasonable for a 9:15 Am appointment. But than again, I'm trying not to think about the excruciating pain I'll soon feel. As I weave in and out of traffic, I'm trying to chug my third water bottle and not choke on a Tylenol(please don't do this) because why not live life on the edge, I already booked myself for an experience of a lifetime, right? I get there, park my car, and check in for my appointment...

I am so glad I did this. I am so happy that I found this little hidden gem! I felt so comfortable and the ladies were so kind and welcoming. Jackie was absolutely amazing !!! She was also being shadowed by a young lady, whose name I forgot in the midst of the anxiety. They were talkative and made the experience feel like a nail/ hair appointment. I even booked my next wax. I have also looked through the other services offered and i am ready to book a facial as well!!! Thank you soooo much ladies ! I'll make sure to tell all my friends about this place

These guys were great overall, except for one issue-- they were helpful and polite over the phone and were able to get me in almost right away.

They have a good Central, mid-town location although parking isn't that great.

The only problem?  They put the tire I bought on backwards...  (I didn't even know this could happen...)

This is a tire shop-- this is what they do all day everyday.  So why did they put my brand new tire on backwards?  How come no one noticed they were making a mistake or another tech not catch this issue? The tire even had arrows pointing to the direction it was supposed to go on!!

I trusted these guys to do a good job and didn't even know there was something wrong until my husband pointed it out to me several weeks later and said, "Did you know your brand new tire is on backwards?"

No.  No I did not.

I'd been driving around for several weeks with it on backwards.

So we had it fixed at another store.

Oh well...

Decent indian restaurant in Newark area. And this is coming from a north Indian who knows how a good Mughlai and Punjabi food tastes. Don't listen to pseudo-Indians, those who can be found in Starbucks and Subways, they know nothing about Indian food. 

Just one suggestion - give cook ample time to prepare your dish, either call them beforehand and place your order or tell them to take their time.

I can't give this Wendy any stars. Service was non-existent and at times rude.  After waiting 5 minutes to be waited on, I asked one of their workers if anyone was working the front. He said he would take my order and then walked away and never returned to take my order. When the order was finally taken by a very sweet young lady, I waited and waited for the food. Eventually I was told they were "making fresh meat" because the last was burned. How do you burn fast food? Never heard that one before. When I got the food, finally, it was awful. I also used the rest room while there and discovered they had no hot water to wash hands. I asked a worker who was coming in to use the restroom about the no hot water issue and looked at me like I was crazy and walked away. I saw 4-5 workers behind the counter, all doing nothing but standing around. Will never return to that particular Wendy's. Especially since they have a hygiene issue.

This place is wonderful with super helpful and friendly employees!  I have had many experiences here, and they have all been a pleasure!  I make it a point to buy my bike-related things here to keep supporting them! 

I first came here for help with my bike seat when I had knee pain after replacing a bike seat that had been put on at the wrong height (at another bike shop I won't name). They adjusted it right away and even gave me a tool to adjust it on my own. 

I bought a bike lock here. I started having trouble with the lock after a couple weeks, so I came back and asked about it. They replaced it on sight (apparently there was an issue with a new product) with what seemed to be an even nicer lock right without any hassle. 

When my bike was stolen, they helped me try to get it back and helped me pick out a new bike I'm totally in love with.  This place is the best!

Recently rented from TPA, pleasantly surprised to get an upgrade. I asked the woman if I was being charged more and she said it was a difference of like $2. When I got to my destination I looked at the original confirmation and there was more than a $2 difference.  They did charge me for that full size car.  I called up the office and she handled it right away for me.

Food was great.  Service once we were seated was great.  However, we were told that it was an 1 hour and 45 minute wait for the dessert table when we arrived.  We left had a drink across the street at our hotel and came back less than 30 minutes later to be told our names were called 20 minutes prior and we would have to rebook our reservation.  That 2nd reservation was suppose to be no more than 30 minutes but we waited an hour.  Not sure who to blame on this one,  but it left a sour taste in our mouths to the extent we will never come here again.

Carbs are the best part of any meal, am I right? And at Sam's Morning Glory Diner, you get double. Every frittata and scramble comes with breakfast potatoes and a delicious buttery biscuit. The portion sizes are HUGE, but certainly well priced. The establishment itself is pretty small, but the service was great! Come hungry, for sure!

Been to Tokyo Sushi a few times now. Love the sunrise roll. Good service. Good food. Love the selection of app's, rolls and desserts. There is a great deal on beer and sake during the week. The only problem is the don't stay open very late so make sure you check the times.

Food was amazing
Service was just as great 
Will definitely go back when I'm in town again

Not much for me to review.  I called and asked if they delivered to my address and was told yes. I got my order together and called back to order and was told they don't deliver to my address, then got put on hold, then they hung up on me.  I won't be calling back.  Poor customer service is not a good first impression.

I've been going to Rescue Spa since May and I can honestly say every visit has been amazing. I wish I took a before photo because I started to see improvement after the first visit and since my last appointment on Sunday my skin has never looked or felt better. I used to wear full coverage concealer and foundation and now just put on a bit of concealer where needed. 

In terms of skin type and products, Ive always had sensitive and reactive skin, so I have to be careful with what products I use. My entire skin care routine at this point is primarily products I've received as recommendations from Rescue and I could not be happier with them. It's taken a few visits and improving my overall skin care routine but I'm very happy with the results. 

I'm writing this now based on my last appointment, which was with Gigi. Not sure what happened, but the day of my appointment I had pretty awful skin.  Gigi spent a lot of time talking to me about my skin, my routine, and the products I've been using before starting the facial. We had great conversion and overall it was a very positive and relaxing session but it was clear the amazing results were based on how she catered the overall session to my skin type and issues. I also really appreciated her professionalism and referring me to seeing a dermatologist to diagnose what was going on with my skin on Sunday. Again, wish I had taken a before and after because by Monday afternoon my skin was glowing and totally cleared up. She also recommended several products which I started using and am 100% in love with! I appreciated how knowledgeable she was and how much time she took in explaining how each works and how it should be incorporated into my routine. 

If you are unsure about getting a facial here I HIGHLY recommend booking with Gigi. Her level of care and ability to connect and create an incredible overall spa experience is why moving forward, I'll be booking exclusively with her.
What a great place for lunch. If you enjoy fresh and healthy food, you really need to try this place.  Tempura fries are great !!!

I have been coming here for at least 6 years, tonight we sat in the bar area at a table.  The music was HORRIBLE ... you could not even  talk over the mosh pit junk ... my teeth rattled!  We will not go back until things change ... sad!

The staff and beer selection here is above average for the area, however on my last visit there was a horrible band, the bar was filled with burley biker men and my group of girls felt very uncomfortable.  Needless to say it was a one and done visit.  I recommend checking the entertainment before choosing this as your night spot!
best breakfast place! the pancakes were so fluffy and chocolaty and also the bacon was spectacular and the service was a little backed up but it was worth the wait!
Great lunch specials and fast service. Wasabi has the best sushi in St. Louis in my opinion!

One of my co-workers introduced me to "Yellowhouse" about 3 years ago.  I never actually bothered to look at the real name b/c everyone at work called it that.  This is a great spot when you don't know what you want for lunch (or dinner).  I've eatten upstairs, but usually take it to go.  The cashiers are quick and friendly. 

There's a good mix of hot and cold items. You pay by the pound, so generally I never buy the heavier items like the pastas or potatoes.  I love their couscous salad.  You can also build your own salad and get whatever hot meats are out to put on top (grilled chicken, salmon, or marinated chicken). It seems to kept clean and tidy.  Once I saw a woman use a spoon for another dish and a worker immediately picked it up and replaced it with a clean one.  

While this place won't blow your mind, it's great in a pinch whether you want the buffet or the deli line.
I thoroughly enjoyed my gelati, which was a mix of salted caramel and chocolate soft serve. The employee at the counter was extremely polite.

So excited to see they had the build your own Arepa option on the menu and so many Gluten Free options on top of that. I had the shredded beef Arepa with black beans, cheese and some spicy sauce, along with some empanadas that were also GF and some awesome chimichurri dipping sauce. The Arepa was crispy and held together all the delicious flavors inside perfectly. Shredded beef was fresh and really well seasoned; black beans tasted great and were definitely prepared fresh along with the sauces. The owners are really nice people that are planning to do additional projects to expand their business and philanthropic aspirations. Great to see this kind of business succeed!! Will definitely be back to try more!

my experience at the dealership was great, the sales staff was very professional and helpful. This was the most pleasant car buying experience I have ever have; however the 2012 elantra I got has been nothing but trouble and a big disappointment, I've had it for 90 days now and I've been having trouble with the breaking system. I'm so disappointed with this car, but I've already signed on the dotted line and I'm stuck with it. You buy a new car you don't expect to have to take it back to the dealer 3 times in 3 months. I really regret getting this car, I should have gotten a Nissan Altima. So to anyone that's thinking about buying this model be warned.

The chef guy was OK, but there were problems.  My wife ordered the 'vegetable delight' and the vegetables were totally burned.  The Hibachi steak I had was so-so.  I had water to drink and I wasn't refilled once, until the very end when she brought my check.  Also, the chef was trying to entertain - he did the onion volcano and stuff - but he wasn't 100% nice.  Overall, I probably will not return.

We took the dog to get a shot here. They have full COVID protocols here so when you get there, you call them and they take your dog and you wait outside. They will give you a call when they are done. I found that their prices were a bit more reasonable compared to my last vet out of state so that was nice.

Back in FL from CT and we HAD to make a stop here. Best tacos we've had, and we'd consider ourselves foodies. Staff are always super patient when we're deciding and helpful with suggestions Tried 4 tacos today that were all delish but "The Ranger" pulled pork taco was magical. The pork was so flavorful but not overly salted. The "Big Kahuna" taco was fresh and light with sweet chopped mango and lightly fried white fish. Perfect sunny day spot. Chips and queso come with a blob of guacamole in the middle and are so fresh! Free refills on chip buckets, which we took advantage of to scoop the fallen fillings of our tacos with. Love the homemade sodas and mango tea. Not too sweet. Can't wait to come back!

I have many happy memories from when I was young of riding the swings while my mom watched and took pictures as well as riding the train through the park with my dad. 

These memories are part of the reason I feel sad sometimes when I see how little time and money has been put into maintaining and updating the park.There are way too many faded signs,peeling paint,and burnt out bulbs for my liking. Also if you go during the week I have noticed that some of the rides and games will be vacant with nobody manning them and no signs to indicate when or if somebody will be returning.

Don't get me wrong there is still lots of fun to be had here for the kiddos like the train,swings,dragon coaster,balloon Ferris wheel and the haunted house. There is definitely a lack of rides that I would consider to be stimulating for adults though. The mind bender roller coaster,the upside down ship,and the smaller yellow coaster are the first and only things that really stick out for me which means as an adult you might be looking at a long day with lots of walking,standing,and watching.

Another point I want to bring up is that the majority of the staff here are underpaid teenagers so the service can sometimes be a little questionable. The mother of one of the developmentally delayed children I do respite for brought her son into the galaxy kids play park portion of Galaxyland today and he was able to get the staff to open the door for him so he could sneak out and go running after a little boy he had been playing with that he didn't want to leave without them questioning who he belonged to. 

I say if your a tourist in Edmonton or maybe a local whose kids have just reached theme park age it's worth it to go once just to allow them to burn off some energy,have fun,and make some memories. Outside of that though considering the price and condition of the park it's my opinion that after one trip any repeat visits to the mall could be better spent at the waterpark.

I swing thru here about twice a week, and have rarely left without a purchase. I am a picker of vintage, kitchy goods and this was my best kept secret til now! :) amazing, unbeatable prices and the staff is always cheerful. LOVE this place!
I felt that i got a high rice to fish ratio in all my sushi...especially when compared to other places in town...
Good BBQ with great service.  Kind of a small place and not so clean inside.  Food was great for BBQ even though its my first time tasting Jamacian.

You know what writers neglect to mention 99% of the time they review exercise businesses like this? RESULTS! Sure, i want to go to a clean class and of course I hope the instructors are good at what they do but honestly, none of it matters if you dont get results. If i dont see before and after results on IG or on Yelp then i am skeptical. However, i found a groupon deal which is why i gave barre a try. it didnt do a thing for me. 

Before anyone runs me over with hate messages, I eat clean, plant based and I watch my macros so a good workout should be all i need to really improve my body. Barre didnt so it for me. Maybe it will for you but Im telling you it did not slim me down further or tone me. That is why im giving 4 and not 5 stars (should be 3.5).

I have about 5lbs that I want to get rid of and I want to tone my legs so i try barre for a month. If you can get that muscle shake consistently, then youll get a good workout. The issue is the classes are so full the instructors cant watch everyone all of the time and if you can't get the form right and get that muscle shake then the work out is basically worthless. sure it is better than sitting on the couch but you arent going to get the results you want. 

Sure, this place is worth a try for sure. The facility is clean and there is ample parking. The prices are fair compared to pilates classes. 

You really have to have a certain temperament for these classes. Are you a high energy cardio junkie or low energy low impact exerciser? If the former, then these classes may leave you unsatisfied. If you enjoy yoga and hate all of the HIIT exercising where you run around overturning oversized tires and crap like that then this is more likely to be your speed.

Cajun Poutine fries. Add Sriracha wing sauce. Pepper Bacon Burger. Never look back. 

I really feel that is the only thing you need to know. 

Do they have an awesome outdoor seating area? Yes. Can you eat inside if its raining? yes, but where is the fun in that??? Is it fun the kitchen is an old air stream? Duh. Is the menu diverse enough for those who don't want a burger? Absolutely. Is the staff good? Very! Do they have craft beer to enjoy at the bar? Yessssssss. Do you get my drift? This place is seriously one of my favs. 

It is just far enough outside of "main Downtown St Pete" but still close enough to stop by on your way to/from there.

Wow, I can't believe this place is still here. My dad used to bring me all the way out here when I was a kid. I had no idea where the place was. Today, I just happened to be browsing Ardmore and I thought the name sounded familiar. It was so long ago (88-89?) that I don't even remember the brands or anything (Pony maybe?), but I do remember it being located on a corner across from an aisle. He would just say do you want black sneakers or white sneakers, pick something out, and try them on first.

I can't image they cost that much especially for a kid. I guess my dad was (is) QUITE the deal hunter. I guess John's is a testament to small town small business.

Yay! Finally a place nearby to get authentic café con leche just like in Miami. We first stopped in to try the breakfast mainly so we can critique the Cuban coffee. Since our go to Cuban food truck operator in the area retired we've been searching for a viable replacement. We were so impressed that most of the breakfast choices come with pan de mantequilla and café con leche. I'm not going to lie, I can come in for just the pan con mantequilla, café con leche and a cortadito to go and that would fuel me through a late lunch! I don't eat pork so they have turkey choices which I appreciate!

We were so excited that we came back the same day for a late lunch and ordered bowls. I got the chicken bowl with salad on the side. It was so flavorful! 

The bread basket they give you before your entree is out of this world! It's a mini fry basket with toasted bread and tomatoes for dipping/topping "bruschetta cubana." 

The side salad is scrumptious as they serve it with a house made dressing. The maduros are perfectly cooked (you know when the plantain is caramelized a bit on the edges!). 

So, the chef convinced me that I would like the flan...I ordered and I didn't like it...I love it! It was more like a high end flan. Much more rich and almost almost creme brûlée-like as the caramel on top isn't torched, but has a slight glass candy to break through before the custard. It's plated so pretty with mango sauce and a balsamic reduction.

My only criticism is that the Cuban toast isn't on the menu by itself, so when I came in and ordered the coffee and toast it was way overpriced. It would have been a better value to order a whole breakfast with eggs and hash brown that comes with the coffee and toast. Hopefully this gets worked out.

We've been back several times now for coffee, breakfast and dinner. Everything has been authentic and flavorful!

What a great restaurant!  Fantastic gluten free pizza!  The salads are pretty amazing too!  We got our food so fast!  The place is so clean, the waitress so nice.  Just all around really pleasant experience!
What a great little place in the middle of old historic area. Very friendly staff and great service. The food was perfect. My burger was perfection. I'm glad I decided to stop.

Only took us four years to finally dine here, and now we can't wait to return!  Everything was amazing!  Our server, Bre, was very informative and sweet. We ordered the nachos to start, and they are the most delicious nachos ever!  We will definitely be ordering this every time we return. We shared the portobello tacos on flour shells with a side of yummy lentil stew, as well as the chickpea salad. We've already decided to each get the lentil stew next time. Sooo much flavor. Wish I could duplicate the recipes!Believe me, you need to try it!

Four stars for the shakes! 

They are fresh-made,  not that artificial syrup crap McDonald's and Rally's have.

If you go at happy hour they are half off. I believe happy hour is from 2-4, maybe after 8 pm as well? 

I also like the hot dogs here.  The chicken strips are burgers are good, not great.  The tater tots are delicious! Fries,  not so much. 

This particular location has a drive thru window as well as the drive in. Sometimes the drive thru is faster.

Went to Rebellion for the first time today and it was amazing!! Had to try the burger after it getting Best New Burger last year. We also had the ramen fries and the black rice pudding dessert. My friend had the nori roll and the watermelon and crabmeat soup. It was all so amazing! I love how my burger was Asian fusion. Rebellion is really something that New Orleans was missing. The servers were incredibly attentive and the chef even came out to greet us and make sure everything tasted great. Highly recommend.

The place is great, friendly staff, good drinks and..........even better food. The cheesesteak egg rolls are to DIE for. The skirt steak is only $23 a/o 6/18/2019  but they're worth at least $40. Amazing deals amazing vibe and staff highly recommend. Recommend Dillon as a bartender. Dude takes care of the entire restaurant as well as YOU at the same time.

Exquisite nails is truly exquisite! They actually care about how your nails look and your nails overall health. I've gotten beautiful acrylics a few times now I am getting dip powder! Absolutely wonderful and looks great.

Had a two night stay for a family wedding.  The room price of the special "Wedding Block" was higher than just going on-line and booking ourselves.  We arrived before the 3 PM check-in, but had to wait 1/2 hour for the room to be ready....not. The room was OK, but found the toilet seat bolts very loose, making the seat extremely "wonky" and less than an inch of TP on the only roll (no extra roll anywhere) with three women, one of which was pregnant.  The room issues were corrected in a timely manner.  When I went to fill the ice bucket at the only dispenser on the floor, it was not working and did not work for the 2 days we were there. 
Somehow the room keys got deactivated.  There was no Snack Shop or vending machine other than for soda.  Not being familiar with Cox Cable, there was no printed guide.   Checking out was interesting.  I was told I was all paid up...but I I hadn't and wasn't.  So I had to convince the desk help to review the bill again.  Although both clerks were friendly, polite and patient, they showed no genuine confidence or hotel operation knowledge.  Because the in-house Sunset restaurant food was very good, it probably is independently owned and operated.  You just had to be hungry at the specific hours they were open...so no late lunch, or early breakfast.  I won't be going there again, even though the bed was comfortable and the room very clean.  Looking to relax in the pool or spa?  The spa, a 4 seater and the pool was puny and not even close to each other.  Also, I had to listen to the deck clerks tell a groom, checking in for a night before his wedding, that his second night, his WEDDING NIGHT, that he had 2 email confirmations for, had been canceled!  They tried to say that HE'D called and canceled.  By the look on his face of shock and dismay, you know he hadn't.  INCOMPETENCE!

I came back again for brunch like I said I would, and it's still just as delicious the second time around. They were even nice enough to hold our luggage for some of our girls who had to catch a flight right after we finished eating! I wish my stomach could hold more food though. I was full after the appetizer came out, and so after a few bites of each dessert, we took most of them to-go, wrapped up in individual aluminum foil animals!
I honestly don't know why the star rating average isn't higher. It's a sports bar. And for a sports bar, the food is delicious -- especially the burgers!!
RIchie's is what everyone wants, a nice clean atmosphere, great young Barber's/stylist, all around great place.

HORRIBLE EXPERIENCE!!!! DO NOT ORDER WITH BOB'S! 

Ordered a bedroom set in November of 2019 and it came damaged multiple times. Then a mirror was back ordered until March. Spoke with customer service multiple times and they assured once everything was delivered they would compensate me money back to my original form of payment. Today they claim they never said that and offered me a $50 gift card. Despicable customer service.

Patriot's Service Department is ridiculous. I bought my 3rd vehicle in 4years from Patriot and in less than a year the Air Conditioning blew only HOT AIR. I brought it in for repair 4 TIMES (and close to $1000.00) and Still HOT AIR! They to,d me I need to bring it back a 5th time, plus ANOTHER $1000.00 to REPAIR IT CORRECTLY. Long Story Short, I have a truck that I purchased off Patriot that has NO AIR CONDITIONING, NO TOUCH SCREEN or RADIO THAT WORKS (touch screen stopped working because the truck is 100+degrees w/ No Air Conditioning) And I am about $1000.00 Poorer.. Patriot does not care about Customers, I bought a new 2020 Equinox from Patriot and was about to trade in for another car but will definitely Not be back there.
Lets just say I'm not a fan of overpriced, salty sushi. People sweat this place but I suggest leave it for them. If you do go just enjoy your $20 martini and then hop over to somewhere else.

this place was so nice. looked very new and modernized. area was clean and the workers were hanging to business very well. although there were about 6 people in front of me when i got there, i did not wait more than 30 minutes which isn't bad when you're talking nails. i got a full set with gel polish and my nails came out beautiful. also they did it in a good amount of time, about an hour, where usually full sets can take a while. my total was $40 due to length coffin shape and gel which is also a very reasonable price. definitely check this place out!
Very pricey, location is great........the accommodation needs some serious updating. Parking in first came first serve in the streets.

I come in and the man says no there not accepting walk ins and asked who I spoke to. I said I spoke to a man and he told me I couldn't have spoken to a man cause he's the only man working here. I  made sure I called the right location and told him I did. I had my call log ready to show him I spoke to someone from this exact location he said " okay we're still not doing COVID shots right now" I asked when is a good time for me to come he kept repeating "we're not doing COVID shots right now" I said okay, if I come tomorrow what time is best for me to come he responds "we're not taking walk ins  right now" I said so "your not taking walk ins AT ALL" he said  "yes CVS doesn't do walk ins"
