Ants on our table. We were given dirty appetizer plates. The booth bench we were sitting on broke, exposing nails. No one refilled our water or cleared our table. I expected more.

This place is pretty solid.  Their burritos are always full of flavor and will def. fill you up!  The one draw back for me is the price.  With a drink it usually comes to around $10 for lunch and for that I could eat at a mexican restaraunt.  Overall though this place is pretty good.

This is our go to for Chinese food.  The food is always tasty, fresh and hot when delivered. My personal favorite is sesame chicken and boneless spare ribs. The food tastes consistent every time you order, so you know what the taste will be each time.


I highly recommend, can't be best (IMHO)

A group fo us (8 girls) went to Zahav last night for my friends birthday.  The experience was SO WORTH IT!

We were seated at the long table by the door.  I was not initially too excited about this location, but it ended up being out of the way just fine.  No traffic control issues at all.  Had it been particularly hot or cold outside, the vestibule would have made it a not-so-drafty location too.

I ordered my first drink- the Eastbound, which was sort of like a cucumber/vodka mojito.  It was DELICIOUS!  I could have drank myself under the table on these, but I controlled myself.

All 8 of us went for the "Tayim" which is 4-course price fixe for $39/head.  It included a little bit of everything I wanted, so I was excited by the direction this night was taking.

First Course was 6 different salads, with 2 choices of hummus.  We went for the hummus-tahina and turkish hummus at the recomendation of our dreamy waiter- Chris.  This dream boat knew what he was talking about.  The salads of were delish.  My favorite was the beet salad, and the taboulli.  Of the hummus, I really preferred the hummus-tahina.  I felt like the turkish hummus was ok... but please keep in mind this is Solomonov-ok which means it was 500x better than most hummus I've ever had. Just compared to things to come... it wasn't a bright spot in my mind.

We got to digest a bit between course 1 and course 2 which i think was key to our making it through the cullinary night.

For course 2, we had 2 small plates each, so we pooled them and ordered a total of 16 items.  As the token vegetarian, I could only eat 4 of the options... but i really didn't feel like I missed out on a thing!  The cauliflower came out first, and it was probably my favorite dish of the night.  It was fried perfectly, and set atop this creamy labeneh with dill.  If I had gone home at this point, I would have left happy.  Next came the brussels sprouts which happen to me one of my favorite vegetables.  They were grilled and came with little dollops of creamy feta cheese and allegedly some sort of baba ganouch, though i'm not quite sure that enhanced the dish.  These were delicious too.  A little dollop of feta on a brussel sprout- a combo i never would have thought of, but the feta cut the bitterness of the sprout.  Top notch.  My friends were awesome enough to get the sunchoke without the anchovies so i could take a taste, and they too were delicious.  Like the turkish hummus, it wasn't a highlight, but like the turkish hummus, not a highlight Solomonov style was still INCREDIBLE.  Finally, I sampled the haloumi cheese plate.  It was grilled so it was a bit burnt around the edges in the best possible way.  It was absolutly memorable.  It came with a date puree on the plate.  If you got the cheese from the top of the pile, it didn't have the dates, and was delicious.  If you got the cheese from the bottom fo the plate, did have the dates and was equally delicious.

Then came dinner.  I got the eggplant entree which was the only vegetarian option.  I was pleased to see that it wasn't a daunting quantity of food, because at this point i was a tad bit on the stuffed side, but still eating because everything was so delicious.  Similar to the sunchokes and the turkish hummus, the eggplant entree was not a high point.  I was glad I didn't save a tremendous amount of room for this.  Had I gone out to a restaurant and ordered this, I would have been elated.  It was a really good plate... but compared to everything else I ate... it just didn't stack up.  The eggplant was cooked well, and the sauce on top was great.  The lentils that it sat on, however, had a liccorice taste to it that I didn't particularly care for.

Desert was our final course.  I got the Konafi which looked like shreaded wheat with ice cream on top.  It tasted like baklava meets apple pie with the most amazing tart frozen yogurt on top.  This was absolutly memorable, and one of the highlights of the meal.

All in all, the bill was a bit steep, but we knew what we were getting ourselves into.  It was a great night of eating, drinking, laughing, and celebrating.  I'm not sure I could handle this serious of a meal on a Tuesday night normally, but I will defintily be back to Zahav for future celebrations.

Other noteworth hilights include:

  -Michael Solomonov running the kitchen.  He's really impressive and entertaining to watch.  
  -Service- Philly Mag called these guys Ninja's and I know why.  My drink never got empty without the opportunity to refresh, nor did my water.  The courses were timed perfectly.
  -Chris- our waiter.  In addition to being quite handsome, he was incredibly attentive, patient etc.  Our birthday girl was devistated when they said they were out of the Striped Bass.  She was dreaming of it.  I'm not sure if Chris went fishing during course 1 and course 2, or what happened, but they brought her out the bass even though they said they were out of it.

I love adventure and risk-taking. This is why I went on this cruise at a time when everything around the country was being shutdown due to coronavirus. But there is a twist.

Everyone on that ship had CV on their mind when they boarded, but none of them had it on their mind a few hours after boarding and for the next 48 hours. That's because there were more immediate concerns due to 25-foot swells and 60 mph winds. The staff said this wasn't normal (I inquired).

I hit the Dramamine like I had a box of Tic-Tacs at the poker table. I knew I had motion sickness, but I also knew it was being masked by something I didn't understand. All I knew was that I liked it. 

On the second rough night, I slept on the pool deck because it was mid-ship and I had fresh air. While sleeping, a couple stopped, woke me up at 3 a.m., and the girl asked if she could take a picture with me. I said, "Sure," took a picture, and went back to sleep. I assume she kept collages of homeless-looking people during her travels.  

Aside from the rough seas early in the trip, I really enjoyed my first cruise. A lot to explore. I could go to Centrum for live music and a chocolate chip cookie, the Schooner Bar for a a glass of red wine, Vintages wine bar for a beer, Windjammer for buffet food (good), Minstrel if I wanted to get dressed up on vacation, Solarium for late night pizza, the outdoor pool to see the spring breakers laughing and partying (not too much because these were kids from rich schools and were well behaved), the gym for increased motion sickness, and the balcony of my stateroom for peace and quiet. 

I didn't like Grand Cayman. It was blah. Friends and family did an excursion to 7-Mile Beach. They said the water was gorgeous but it wasn't worth the trip because the beach was crowded and it was a 30-minute ride to get there from boat. 

Cozumel was enjoyable. Therefore, I would recommend staying on the boat during the Grand Cayman stop so you can fully enjoy the ship when nobody is around, and then go to Cozumel for the experience. I will write about Cozumel in a different review. 

Other than one really braindead waiter, the service on the ship was amazing. Everyone was very friendly, and they were constantly cleaning the ship. 

Adventure, excellent views, great food, superb service. I also can't forget the little Asian guy at the entrance of the Windjammer wearing the upside-down Mario Brothers mushroom hat. With a wide smile and while squirting Purell into to your hands, he would say: "Happy! Happy! Washy! Washy!" 

Overall, battling high seas, Coronavirus, drunk spring breakers, constant raffles so they could take money from you, and more, it was a hell of an adventure! I know this sounds like a negative review, but I truly did enjoy it very much. 

Definitely recommended!

I was absolutely blown away by this restaurant. We ordered the Arctic char, pirogies, lamb, beet salad, cheese board, gnocchi basket, and gelato dessert. Everything was to die for. We eat all over the city, and this is one of the best restaurants in the city by far. The atmosphere was quiet and quaint, and the staff was very welcoming and attentive. Darryl was our waiter who was overly helpful and friendly. This is our new favorite spot!

They kept us waiting and waiting with our three kids without telling us anything. 
Beside that, the food wasn't bad but really nothing exceptional especially for the price!

Visiting from out if town. Heard them playing music I like so wanted to check it out even though there was like 5 people there at 11pm. Went up to bar and asked the nice bartender how much for a kamikaze ..she said $7 .. .I ordered two ,one for my cousin and me, she serviced them in two tiny shot glasses instead of a short glass...for some crazy reason...then charged me $16 instead of $14. Paid and tipped her $2 because it was dead there and she was nice and i dont know if shes just not trained well. I THEN went to the back bar and told the guy there about it....he basically agreed with her tactic and didn't at least offer to make them right which i would have paid for. Never in my bar hoping life of 8 years....since Im 29 ...have I ever been ripped off so badly. I blame the manager....everyone seemed nice and happy to be there but clueless. Never going back!

I've shopped at this mall since I was a kid.  It's amazing how much it has changed especially recently. 

Restaurants galore line the mall's exterior -- you can choose from Maggiano's, Capital Grille, California Pizza Kitchen and Bobby Flay's Burger Palace to name a few.  There is also a small food court inside the mall near JC Penny's.  And it is a small food court compared to the food court the mall had BEFORE renovations.  

The Cherry Hill Bistro is also an excellent spot for lunch or dinner (it sits in the middle of the mall between Nordstrom's and Macy's where Woolworth's lunch counter was a gazillion years ago).  

Nordstrom demolished and rebuilt in the section that once housed Strawbridge's.  Nordy's is an excellent department store for that mall to have.  

There is a huge variety of stores including Pottery Barn, which recently moved into the mall.
Great tour! Only in NOLA for a few days and this helped us decide which places we wanted to go back and explore further. Our tour guide, Paige, was amazing!
good food, exotic experience.
Amazing ! Very fast and Reasonable priced ! Definitely recommended to get your tint done . They explained everything to me , very nice people felt welcomed
This place is awesome! Great food and great service.....Staisha and Hannah do a great job of taking care of their customers!!!
Vile people who don't care about you at all. Incredibly rude and terrible, all of the staff. They charge more than any other clinic and treat you like garbage. goodluck going there.

The burger was very juicy even when I asked for  it well done ! Very accommodating staff and great service by waitress Sarina ( I think)!   It's so nice to go out and pay for restaurant prices and get real service! So thank you!! Delicious clam chowder too!! Your outdoor patio-Nice ambiance!! Coming back!

After I had my appendix out ... the only thing I wanted was the tomato basil soup. I hadn't eaten in 4 days and I was ready... It was perfect ;)

My love affair with La Madeline has been consistent for like 15 years. The French Onion soup is also a favorite. Order with extra cheese and extra croutons. 

I also really enjoy the quiche. 

I know its a chain but its affordable, there is free wifi and its quite delicious.

Ok ... this place was unreal. I don't give pizza places 5 stars unless they are in Staten Island or Brooklyn so I apologize but in New Jersey LET ALONE SOUTH JERSEY, this pizza is unreal. I mean I came here randomly for lunch one day and have been back everyday. If you put this in a line up with NYC pizza I'm telling you it would hold its weight. The crust is beautiful, perfectly charred and balance. Thin and crispy and they aren't shy with their cheese. Their Sicilian slices are so flaky and flavorful I was taken aback. Their broccoli and tomato pizza is my favorite. Wire slice LOADED with cheese and tomatoes and broccoli. I will be back Monday at 12 for lunch. Seriously great job.

Been coming downtown for job training and this is one of my favorite spots to grab lunch. 

When it comes to what I order, my go to is the turkey blt wraps grilled, which are so tasty and fresh. 

I have yet to try any desserts from here but heard they are really good. The wraps are where its at. 

The service is great and speedy and can have you in and out really fast.

Love this place.  Great little neighborhood bar. Unique theme and logo.  Great selections of drinks. Happy hour is off the hook.   Limited menu but very good food especially the thin crust pizza.

Not sure what Domenick L 1 star review is talking about.   Been here about 6 times. Always great service

Great food, coffee and service. 

We had burrito and another egg dish, which were good, but I saw someone else order the avocado toast, and I think I might have to go back just to try it. 

We're just visiting Nashville, and the baristas/servers gave us lots of info about different neighborhoods and other restaurants to check out. So nice.

Fun Bartender!  Made me a con"cock"ion we dubbed Tootsie Roll - made w/the star attraction Jameson.

Drink cost - $12

Other drinks featured on menu - roughly $10

And there is also a section for food

You're not going to believe how good the food is in this bizarre, little bodega.  I almost turned around walked out.  I'm really glad I stayed.  By far the best fried catfish sandwich in the entire world.
Honestly one of my favorite places to eat Mediterranean food. Very affordable and straight up, every appetizer and entree are delicious! My go to is the mousaka. I love coming here

Horrible experience!  Owner said they would only glue my daughter's nails as a repair.  We had her nails filled three days ago at Lucky Nails and you can see how horrible they look!  Went to Party Nails where they were kind enough to fix this monstrosity.  Her nails look magnificent and we will never be back.  Their 2 1/2 star rating says it all.  Do not go here... Party Nails is across the street and superior.  If you like being talked down to and talked about in a foreign language then go here.
Great food!! Amazing breakfast and the price is amazing!! The owners are so kind, always has a smile and is always super friendly, me and my boyfriend come here all the time

Great location and atmosphere!  So many choices for good seafood in NOLA and although I can think of others with better prices and great food, it's hard to beat the combination of the location and the food.  We always enjoy Blue Crab when we want to enjoy a meal in the lakefront area.  The rest of my family prefers the fried seafood at Blue Crab, especially the jumbo shrimp they serve, but I always enjoy their grilled fish dishes or grilled fish salads, which either aren't available or aren't very good at many of our local staples for excellent fried seafood.  Like some others, I Iike to substitute the catfish for either the mahi mahi or fish of the day in the salad.  The grilled fish I've had at Blue Crab has always been very tasty and was better than many other excellent seafood restaurants in the city that have great fried seafood.  

When it was still pretty new, when departing after a meal, I had been very genuinely asked by a manager (I presume) for candid feedback about the food and service.  I remember the first time I went and the onion rings weren't up to standards compared to many of the more established restaurants in the city, but they have been vastly improved the last couple of visits and have been really good.  It seems like they are working to continuously improve.  

It's great to see the beginnings of a vibrant southshore lake shore drive again.
I love this place!!! I come in here to study all the time. The staff is great ! Everyone is so friendly and welcoming !! Miss Tracey herself is an inspiration and a great business woman !!!!

My husband and I visited one evening during our weekend trip and overall we were pleased with the steaks.  We ordered the coconut shrimp appetizer, which was not very good at all. The shrimp was overcooked and the entire dish was pretty bland.  My husband ordered a top sirloin with rosemary bleu cheese sauce and garlic mashed potatoes. I had the 9 oz. filet (should have ordered the 6 oz.) with the rosemary blue cheese sauce, which was divine. Our steaks were both cooked medium well and were delicious.  If you're up for a nice strong drink, order the Santa Cruz - a grapefruit/vodka concoction that was perfect for the night and the weather!  Half-way through our meal, we realized it was our 6th wedding anniversary so we ordered a cookie sandwich....this is where things took a really strange turn :( Since they were closing up shop, we ordered the dessert to go and decided to eat it when we returned to the hotel.  Now, I'm not sure what happened between the restaurant and the hotel but when we opened the container to enjoy our dessert we found the cookies to be inedible.  The cookies smelled like they were deep fried in fish grease. Not certain, if the smell was coming from the cookies, we tasted them and they were not palatable. I've never tasted anything so bad!  Anyway, we called the restaurant the next morning and they apologized/offered a desert in the future.  Hopefully they will modify their recipe because a $9.00 cookie sandwich should be edible.  Need a recipe for cookies: 2 1/4 cup flour, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp baking soda, 2 eggs, 1 tsp of vanilla, 3/4 cup brown sugar, 3/4 cup white sugar, and 1 cup softened butter....My goodness Google a recipe, cookies are not supposed to be rock hard. IF we go back, it will be for the steaks and drinks ONLY.

The place itself was pretty cool, and the view is awesome. The service at this place was terrible. We came at a time that wasn't crowded and there were a ton of open tables. We were told to seat ourselves, but no one came to us for upwards of 10 minutes, but still managed to attend to the tables next to us. Basically it took 20 min to get one cocktail and one beer. Normally I'm empathetic to servers and I'm pretty patient, but it was slow. I wouldn't waste your time, which will end up being more than you want.

So it was my first time ever eating at a longhorn. I can say that i was not very impressed.i figured with it being a steak house it would be amazing.. I got the 8 oz filet.. Cook medium..the steak had no flavor really. The house salad was good..broccoli was good.. But all in all i wasn't wow'd.. But their menu looks really good. Maybe something else may be tasty.. I would say i would give it one more try..i do understand with restaurants.. Sometimes it depends on the cook they have on duty
If you like being treated like a cog in a factory, this is your place! Otherwise look harder.

I didn't know what to expect when i dined here for a weekday lunch but i enjoyed the food. For starters, i tried the Guacamole, they make by your table when you order, and the Queso Fundido- which was good, not great.  I also tried their Enchilada Mixtas- It was delicious and they didn't skimp on the meat and the sauce. They give free Churros after the meal which gave it a nice touch.

My husband and I got a last minute reservation here last week and it definitely lived up to the hype we had heard! First of all, we loved how it was decorated and the ambience, with the wood burning fireplace and a rustic feel. It's a great date night spot! The cocktails are pricy but definitely worth trying. They were really unique and when I ordered a second cocktail tht was very different than my first order, the waiter explained what the second cocktail was like and made sure it was what I wanted before recommending something more similar to the fruity, light one I had first ordered. 

The waitstaff is very knowledgeable and is happy to share recommendations, especially if you're torn between two options. We ordered the octopus, the egg and speck pizza, the messinesi, and I forget what the dessert was called but it had hazelnut in it. Everything was so delicious and this was the perfect amount of food for two people. The pizza was the standout and definitely one of my favorite pizzas I have tried in Philadelphia. It was so unique! 

We definitely will be back, both for food (there was so much more I wanted to try!) and to grab cocktails at the bar. I've also heard good things about the brunch! This is worth checking out. Make sure you make a reservation via Resy!

Possibly the best patio in St. Charles, and maybe even St. Louis. During those rare but beautiful days that the Midwest gives us, I crave a good meal on a unique patio.  This patio is shaded by beautiful trees and is placed next to a running creek, hence the name.  It is an all brick patio with beautifully done string lighting. 

Though my roast beef sandwich wasn't too much to write home about, the large beer selection and patio will bring me back.

Went in the day after Thanksgiving when my regular doctor's office was closed so I had limited options. I did make an appointment online. That process was simple and quick through the website. Got in a room right away coughing and gasping and within 30 minutes was diagnosed and being treated. Was able to get my medicine right there. The staff was quick and courteous and I felt so awful when I threw up on the nurse who took it rather well. I would go back in a heartbeat, my new go to Urgent Care.
Wallie salad is my number one go to, filled with fruits, vegetables, nuts, topped with balsamic vinegar, I can not seem to order any other food choice.

We were here a few months ago. Great ambience ... better food. If you've never had fresh frog legs, this is the place to give them a taste ... Florida Everglades legs, perfectly batter fried with garlic and lemon butter. Mmmmm. Between the two of us and our guests, we dined on halibut, scallops, crab legs and a tutto mare special. The presentation was upscale ... the quality of presentation even better. This was a busy night, but the wait staff (elegantly attired) politely kept up with the frenetic pace. Probably not a good place for dinner with young children, but if you are going out with good friends and looking for a great dinner, Beachcomber is a perfect pick in Clearwater Beach.

Let me first start off by saying the staff was extremely nice so that's why I gave them two stars. I was quoted at 600 for a control arm replacement however I know for a fact the part only costs 120 at the most. That however wasn't my issue. I had it checked by two other mechanics who completely disagreed that I even needed it replaced and brought me into the shop to prove that I didn't. So to be quoted at 600 after you check my car and find something wrong that's not actually wrong is very dishonest. I will not be returning to McGee tire at all, ever.

Okay, when I first moved to Nashville, I kept hearing about something called a "meat & three, but I never knew what the hell all these weird Nashville folk were talking about.  Of course over the years I have had my fair share of "meat & three" here in Nashville.

I think there are several stand out "meat & three" joints in Nashville, Sylvan Park, being one of the.  However, I think that At The Table is almost, if not better than Sylvan Park.  It is a mall place with a huge sign that reads, "At The Table, Great Homestyle Cooking" and it is just that, great homestyle cooking.  I was lucky enough to get there on the night they had fried chicken.  Very tasty and juicy, the breading was really good.  Right up there with Sylvan Park, for sure.
Like most "meat & three" places, the people who work there are almost as important as the food.  As for At The Table, the people are super nice.  I even spoke with the owner named Robert Hudson, who told me a bit about his family history in Nashville and the restaurants history.  But when I asked him about what the components of the awesome batter he makes for his fried chicken, he would not tell me!  

Definitely try this place out if you are a "meat & three" aficionado.

Easy drive from New Orleans to the swamp tour. Our group of 8 had an amazing time and Jacob was an entertaining and knowledgeable tour guide. I highly recommend! 
For parents considering bringing their toddlers, it is just taking a boat ride and sightseeing and the 3 year old on our boat had an amazing time. I'd bring my 2 year old and 4 year old in the future.
Best Mac and cheese ever! Prices went up a little bit recently so I don't go as often but it's out of this world!! Must try!

I get work done here pretty much exclusively. As a woman I've experienced getting screwed over at a lot of other shops and this is the only place I don't get that vibe at all. They're reasonably priced and always very patient with me. I'm not sure how they don't have a five star rating.

Love it...love it!  My kids are easy, they love superman, or vanilla with sprinkles, or cotton candy.  I love this $@&% just got real.  It's so delicious.  I prob need to head over now for a scoop but prob two.

TBC is 3 minutes drive from The Parthenon and is connected to Cumberland Transit. Delicious coffee with Hipster/modern vibe and awesome decor. Well lit place, free WiFi, plenty of seatings and tables have outlets which is very convenient if you're studying or working. Prices are very reasonable (ranges from $5-10). Ordered Iced Caramel latte and a bagel, both were good and coffee has a perfect balance of sweetness and slightly bitter. Great service. Not much parking space so you have to park in the small center next to the coffee shop. 
And the star of the show?? Their black and white mural next to the coffee shop and perfect for your instagram worthy photos.
Why not shop for hiking boots next door while you wait for your coffee. :D
Overpriced, grossly under filled tortilla.  The only flavor  that was detectable was that of old Fryolator grease. Would never, ever consider stepping into Ft Ripoff again!

Rip off! My friend paid $150 for a great bottle of wine. Next week it was lowered to $110. She had her receipt and they refused to refund the difference. Now we find the same bottle online for $50. I know they need a little mark up but 100-150% is restaurant prices. Lost our business...

Good food at a reasonable price.  The decor is kind of plain, but the place is clean and the staff is friendly and courteous.  Had the Generals Chicken and pot stickers.  The food was served promptly and everything was tasty.  I'm on a quest for the best Chinese in Boise, and to date, this is my favorite.  Well worth a try!

A neighbors patio umbrella flew over his house in a terrible storm and played all over my Acura.  Scratches were everywhere.  Kenny at renewit was soooo nice and gave me a very reasonable price to buff out all the scratches.  To my surprise they washed my car, dressed the tires and cleaned the inside.  I couldn't be happier.

Wow. We live an hour outside of STL, but came here after an appointment. Did not disappoint. We ordered the ribs and brisket as our main dishes, and both were tender and flavorful. Sweet Carolina sauce was our fav. For sides, the beans weren't anything special, but I really enjoyed the sweet potato fries and slaw. The latter was flavorful without being heavy or creamy. Glad I took Food Network's recommendation and chose Pappy's over countless other options. The price wasn't bad, either -- around $40 for two meals, after tax and tip.

We have been coming here for years and the food is usually great, but I had my rehearsal dinner here, which we called ahead of time and even ordered the dishes we wanted ahead of time. When my party arrived, nothing was prepared and they acted like they didn't know anything about our large party. When the food finally came out, one of my bridal party found a HUGE, intact WASP in his food. Not only were we embarrassed, but the owner did not seem very apologetic or concerned with our disgusting experience. He did agree to take only 10% off our bill, not to mention they wanted a $100 deposit ahead of time that I think they kept on top of the bill. My in laws ended up paying the bill and it was so chaotic after the wasp that everyone forgot to check about the $100 deposit. Good luck, hopefully you don't find a wasp in your food.

If you want someone to get incredibly excited about your strange piercing requests, give you a bangerang, little tattoo on a walk-in whim and follow up by sending you to the coolest art museum on the Gulf coast; then look no further. 

Cannot say enough good things about this place!

My wife and I are regulars here and the food is top notch. The server is always polite to us keeping our glasses full of drinks. I've brought family from out of town here and they've been impressed. I would recommend this spot if you want good food and friendly service.
Great food, friendly bartender, good ambiance. Parking was a nightmare but there are a couple of cheap parking garages within a few minutes walk from the restaurant.

I met Marla over ten years ago and followed her all over town. I love her hair advice and go to her for my regular cuts and also for special occasion up-dos. I appreciate her advice on products and the latest hair trends, especially regarding environmental and health safety. She also did my wedding hair! She let me have two consultations with her and she did my hair and make-up day of. She made me look like a princess!! Very excited about the new space and will try the massage services at my next visit.

Wow I definitely loved this place
Never in my life have I had a burger 
That good . I literally looked at one burger online and was determined to come and try it out because of the Mac & cheese bun I was instantly sold . 
Would recommend this place to EVERYONE 


But the only thing I would point out is the parking
Sucks & the outside really needs some change .. 
As me and my fiancé drove by finding parking we thought "oh it doesn't look that nice from the outside ". But when we got inside it really took us by surprise . Very nice inside and clean . 
But other then that DEFINITELY will be coming back ! Great experience , great food & drinks & the service was great .

I usually just stop in here on my way to work and get a almond croissant. THEY ARE AMAZINGGGGGG!!!! But today I was really hungry at lunch and Uber eats was looking too expensive so I decided to walk from my job to gracious cafe (about 7mins) and I'd honestly do it again. I got the roasted tomato caprese sandwich and it was so delicious. Everything tasted fresh but flavorful. The only thing I would do different is ask to have it warmed. I did not realize it would be served cold. I'm also a lavender lover and they had a blueberry lavender cupcake. It was ok. Kinda dry and the flavoring was decent. But overall I will be back for lunch!
The service was also very nice and welcoming. The inside of the place is clean and plain. It's typically not loud so it's a great place to study or meet up with friends etc

Worth going to, if in the neighborhood. I only go when others want to and it happens to be a pretty central location for friends. Slightly above average bar. I drink beer, but tried a very good mint julep once. Having single stall bathrooms seems a little unreasonable for a bar of this size.

Went on a Sunday night for dinner with my parents and boyfriend.

When you first walk up to the dock, they offer to take a professional picture of you and your group ($20 if you like it).
Then you get seated at your table with the option to either converse or roam the outside deck area until dinner is served.

The menu included 3-course meals: You choose between soup or salad, an entree, and dessert.
Firecracker shrimp- not at all spicy as the description intends, and very very small portion (5 shrimps). Also way too pricey...this thing was $12!
Ceasar salad- huge leaves of lettuce with some croutons and cheese- not the best.  
Meatloaf- delicious. Comes with mashed potatoes...and (garden veggies which I didn't like- looked cold and not fresh).
Braised porkchop- okay. I didn't have too many bites of this to judge better.
White chocolate bread pudding- delicious
Cheesecake- even better.

After dinner, theres a DJ and dancing up on the top deck- perfect to work off the huge meal you just ate and to let loose with your party while taking in the gorgeous sites of Tampa Bay.

Would I do it again? Probably not because its too expensive. 
Would I recommend it to others? Definitely! Such a fun experience!

This place is terrible. It's unfortunate because the location and atmosphere are great. From the service to the dirty utensils to the over-salted food, one star is too high. Our waiter had an attitude until the check came, then he was all smiles and "it was my pleasure."  Utensils had dirt and terrible water spots on them. Regarding the food, potatoes were salty, eggs were bland, hamburger was greasy. Tea is served in a small metal container which only fills up the cup 3/4 of the way. The only redeeming quality item is the Bloody Mary. My husband said it was very good and you can fill it up with various things like shrimp, celery, etc. Needless to say, we will not be returning. Spent a good amount of money for bad food and service.
The food is amazing but the place is unprofessional as all get-out. They will give your reservation away without any notice.

The Righteous Tap House has potential to be a local hit. It maintains a "hole in the wall" atmosphere as it is hidden off the side of the road but has a modern feel to it. Still in the early stages it has a little bit more to go until this tap house is the number one choice for the locals but they are well on their way. With a long list of beers on tap at a reasonable price and a spacious bar top, it's a great spot to unwind and jam to some tasteful music. In regards to the food, the selection was very limited (which hopefully is just a starter menu) but all of the food is deliciously different. Will definitely be back to try again.

I was so looking forward to a great country breakfast at Bob Evans! What a disappointment!! Went there on a Sunday morning. Expected a crowd and somewhat slow service. But not a 35 minute wait for the server to appear at our table. Finally flagged down a bus boy who got us coffee and sent waiter (James) our way. After ordering we waited another 20-30 minutes for food. My order came out wrong. When I got blueberry hot cakes, the top cake was fine, bottom cake was a half cake and soggy in the middle!
I'll never return-at least not to this one in Indy!!

This place was recommended by a friend I consider an expert in BBQ,after all he owns 3 BBQ restaurants in Chicago. The ribs are the most tender and delicious dry rubbed west of the Mississippi, corn on the cob was unbelievable, excellent selection of bottled soda and the staff were so incredibly friendly. Looking forward to my next visit to St.Louis just so I can have Pappy's again.
Delicious, homemade food and excellent staff!! Yummy chocolate mousse and tiramisu! The atmosphere is cozy and fun!!

This was a good self guided tour with their audio headsets. You could spend 1 hour here or as much as several hours depending on your level of interest. This is one of those places that you just have to go see if you are in Philly. We would not go again but, are happy that we saw the place once.

While they may not be the place most folks will think of when it comes to pralines in NOLA but it should be. Their pralines are bigger than any other places has, their prices are better and they flat out taste better. They are the only play we will buy pralines from period.
Only two  stars yes. Took three times to get the order correct and the food was cold. I will keep going to the other location from now on.

This place has consistently gone downhill over the years. Every dish tastes the same, they must use the same sauce for everything. The ignorant woman at the front desk rushes you off the phone without worrying about the accuracy of your order. God forbid you want extra (more than one) sauce, she hands you a cup with about a quarter ounce of sauce in it.

NEVER again at this dump.
The food was good and not to pricey, the problem was the cleanliness. I felt like my table and the overall environment have not been kept up. Other than that, great food!

I ordered Lokum online. Delivery and communication were very good. The Turkish delights are amazing, you would have to try them to understand how delicious they are. It's the same if not better than what I have had in Turkey.

Zayna's was such a treat!

The falafel to start was a wise choice and was just slamming. As I've noted in other reviews, falafel can be a bummer if made wrong, but here they hook it up. It was crispy, zesty, spicy, but still had that moist, interior so you don't feel like you've eaten cotton balls. 

And the main plates, mannn. So much food comes and every ounce of it is good. I struggle with the names now, but I had a rice pilaf and chicken dish and I destroyed it. There was not a morsel on my plate when I was done. My wife also had a chicken plate and handled hers as well. I'd say that rice pilaf is a star though, as is the hummus here. OH, and of course, the chicken was well seasoned and memorable. 

To top it all off, I got to try some a Lebanese dark beer, which is not something I can say too often. 

I'll certainly make a beeline for this place next time I'm in Tucson. Great food and great bang for your buck. Plus the service was friendly and quick.

Panera in the Wynnewood shopping center is a good choice for lunch if you are in the area. Their soups, salads and sandwiches are always tasty and fresh.  The food comes fast and is a good value. 

This is also just a good place to hangout, do work on a laptop, or meet a friend for coffee.
Excellent beer and an excellent "Pig Mac" sandwich.  The place was packed on a week night, and deservedly so.  I'll be back on my next trip to the area.

What a horrible experience. When I arrived they told me there were no cars available. Then they pulled up what they call a midsize car, maybe for gerbil. The car was dirty inside and out and pulled to the right so badly that if you let the steering wheel go it would've made a right-hand turn. When I returned the car I thought the right thing to do was to inform the Hertz personnel that the car pulled severely right and the front end shook at 60 miles an hour or above. He could care less. Good thing I'm a gold member hate to think how a treat others. Let me rephrase that X gold member X hertz customer.
They should take lessons from enterprise and learn what it means to take care of a customer!

I have gotten about 90% of my tattoos here.  Everyone who works there are the best of the best.  Hands down, this is as good as it gets. Haters,  Stop complaining about the pricing, a tattoo is not something you want to skimp on and if you are going back for multiple session they will totally work with you on price.  You really do get what you pay for here, its amazing work, some of the best you will ever see or have.
go.
Very very very good ribs. Love the sauce. Mac n Cheese and fried green beans too are awesome too. Will be back again!

Was really excited to try this bakery since there isn't many cupcake bakeries around. Found the place on a busy road had to pay for parking. Went in the store the lady was talking to two people about a cake order and completely ignored me for ever 5 mins, the phone even rang she told someone to ask it. I will waiting more people came into the store finally someone came out to help. None of the cupcakes have flavor descriptions on them so I just had to guess what it will taste like. I got a red velvet and banana flavored one. I've had great cupcakes so I know flavor this cupcake was the worst cupcake of my life I could have gone to a grocery store and gotten one with more flavor. Never going back again found a cute farm store in chalfont that sells real cupcakes with flavor

Professional, courteous and on-point! HIGHLY recommend. I had a large crack in my natural stone fireplace which they repaired. It looks brand new! Great experience and would give them more stars if I could. Thank you Rodinei and team for a job well done and great, friendly service.

I'm so thrilled with my experience. The rubber sole came off of my boot heel and so I took them in.  The woman working quickly came out and brought me 3 options for replacements.  We picked the color that looked best with the boots.  After 1 minute, I had paid and had my pickup ticket in hand. 

I went back two days later and my boots looked brand new.  Not only did they fix the soles, but they definitely gave them a little polish.  For $25, you can't beat it.

Wow! Came for happy hour and it was amazing! I had the vodka mule with lychee and I thought it was prepared phenomenally. I also tried some happy hour bites, the edamame dumplings and the bbq beef skewer with kimchi. Both were amazing! I would normally not go for edamame dumplings but they were next level in a delicious light (sake) broth. Challenging to find seats and pricey but soo worth it!

Stopped in here for a quick drink on Tuesday, March 12. We ended up having 2 each before we left (there we 4 of us). The bartender and bouncer were awesome. 
While we were wandering the Quarter on Wednesday, my buddy, who listens primarily to country music, says he wouldn't mind going back. So, after dinner, we went back. Katy, the bartender recognized us straight away. Had a different bouncer, Nobody. We ended up camping out for about 4 hours. We had the best time. Any time we stepped away from the wives, Nobody looked after them. We will DEFINITELY be back the next time we are in New Orleans!!!
Great coffee/espresso, minimal wait time, proactive customer service. Overall: convenient, fast, quality coffee, and friendly staff.

We went in today just looking around. Tomorrow is our two year anniversary and I just wanted to give Jeff an idea of what I want if/when the time comes for him to go shopping. Madison was our sales person and I really liked her. She was not pushy and explained some details about the rings we weren't aware of. 

She explained their warranty and even about insuring the ring against theft or lost diamonds. She put the ring I chose on file and spoke with Jeff in private about financing and such. 

We had already been to three other stores shopping around and while I found a ring at each store that I liked none of the other stores had the style of this particular ring that I had picked here. 

Highly recommend for your jewelry needs. They even cleaned my diamond earrings that weren't purchased there for free.

I am an LA native, living in philly for five years now and it's taken me that long to find great tacos!! This little place is a slice of heaven. Not only are the tacos delicious, the owner Vanessa is a peach, and the picnic bench seating is a beautiful way to spend a summer night. It's well worth the hike out west.

Been one of my favorite places to buy my favorite TV shows, movies and video games. They always have a huge selection, not always organized haha but they try.

I've started buying funky pop characters from here (I'm addicted) and they always have special deals. If you can't find it they probably have it. Also the staff is always helpful and patient with me!  Thanks for everything guys!!!

So with complete transparency: yes, i'm rating 5 stars. Yes, i've only ever ordered the Massaman curry. That dish is SO good. It's hard for me to branch out here when I know something like that is readily available. 

So, obviously, I recommend the Massaman curry. Get it with chicken and make it Thai hot. :)

Service here has always been very professional, but warm. I've never had the lunch buffet, but after reading reviews here, I think I need too. 

The environment is romantic and unique - light jazz music will play in the background, or you'll be treated to a live musician on weekends.

I've been to another Thai restaurant near Bangkok and it just lacked the level of professional service. Whenever i'm craving takeout or want to enjoy something different for a night out, Bangkok is one of my favorites.
Chicken and waffles! Chicken and waffles! The 5 piece, oh my the 5 piece wings and waffle will give you life. It's usually pretty crowded. It's usually pretty good. Check it out.

I had been wanting to try this place after learning they used locally grown food and fresh products. I went for brunch on a Sunday and honestly I really was not very impressed. I got the fresh farm egg bagel sandwich and it was mediocre and the potatoes that came with it were super dry. The only good thing about my meal was the unsweet iced tea. Even though I admire their mission, I will not be returning.
The food was original though slow to arrive, my one complaint was that hair was not properly tied back on servers and line cooks. It's great that the food is cooked right in front of you.

I love this area of Philly and this brasserie, where I've spent many sunny days lunching with a cocktail in hand. The cocktails here are good - try the "Romarin" which combines elderflower, rosemary, and grapefruit!

My husband swears the chicken sandwich is the best he's ever had. The warm shrimp salad comes with a perfectly balanced lemon-butter dressing. The desserts are also excellent, especially the seasonal fruit tart. My only complaint would be that there are not a lot of vegetarian options, but one expects that at a French brasserie I guess. 

This is not a cheap place to eat, but I think worth it. We've generally had very good service and at times excellent.  The food is consistently very good and the ambience lovely whether inside or out.

According to Wikipedia, "Clarissa Harlowe "Clara" Barton (December 25, 1821 - April 12, 1912) was a pioneer American teacher, patent clerk, nurse, and humanitarian. At a time when relatively few women worked outside the home, Barton built a career helping others. One of her greatest accomplishments was founding the American Red Cross. This organization helps victims of war and disasters." 

 So they named a rest stop after her.

Food...pretty pretty pretty good. 

Service? Piss Poor. Horrid Host who tried to make us share a table with two other people we didn't even know. When all parties refused, he huffed off. We were about to leave, then the manager got us a table. We should have just left.

The waiter was decent but like the "Magic Man" (now you see him, now you don't) but this place is just trying too damn hard.  Not everyone wants a NYC-Wannabe lounge to eat sushi in. Too bad, cause the food is fab.

Unfortunately, the rudness of the people working there was so off-putting, I doubt I will ever go back. Too bad for me I guess.

I think this place is excellent. The staff has outstanding customer service. The guy at the register is hilarious. He was very educated about the food and being a first time customer he made it extremely easy to make up my mind. They have fresh baked cakes. The prices are great. Everything is seperate no combo meals but it's basically the same as ordering a meal from McDonalds. The FOOD IS AUTHENTIC CHICAGO FOOD. VIENNA BEEF HOT DOGS. Wow I will be back again. I also recommend this place to everyone.

They had a deal for (any kind of 16 oz. on) two Monsters for $3.50. I grabbed 2 of those. Also purchased a Starbucks frap for $2.99. Got 1 of those. Total was supposed to be around $6.50+tax. The guy charged me $8.50 at which time I told him about the 2 Monsters deal. Then he redid the transaction and it came out to $6.93. I gave him $7 and waited for my change and he never gave it to me. It's not about the money but the principle of honest business.

Five stars because I have eaten their crawfish macaroni on multiple occasions and it's the best macaroni I have ever had.  My only warning to people is that unless you are out in the later parts of the evening you are likely to only encounter them at a festival or large event.  I don't think they do a bad job at these larger events, but I think the taste and novelty of their food is depreciated when you have to wait 30+ minutes in a line, and you order something that you know was produced for very large quantities of people.  Still the best macaroni around.
Got take out on a Friday night and had enough left over for dinner the next day!!! Food was very authentic, super good, and fresh! Would definitely order again and highly recommend!!!

Very nice and fun! Great custard with plenty of toppings! Be sure and let them know about food allergies! They will help! We go there with peanut and tree nuts food allergies and have never had a problem!

I had been to Manos before the pandemic and recently revisited the restaurant.  Now the tables are social distanced and servers are wearing masks.  

The food has remained good.  We normally come here because my family likes the grilled shrimp salad, which has tons of grilled shrimp and nice flavors.  This time we also got the chicken wings - which were not good as they were bland - and the eggplant parmesan which was really good, had lots of flavor, and a huge portion size. 

Overall a good place for a decent lunch

I don't think their sushi is excellent but their teriyaki entrees and lunch specials are. I've been eating at this place for over six  years and I'm never disappointed by the chicken teriyaki entree. It comes with a side of sticky white rice, a finely grated cabbage salad with a dollop of the creamy thousand island dressing, a generous portion of chicken covered in teriyaki sauce and a California roll for under $15! That and an Arnold Palmer and I'm set! They do close in between lunch and dinner time, though. So, don't be surprised if you're there on the  later side of lunch time and they want get you out the door!

A decent selection of new and used CDs as well as a well organized vinyl collection in the back.  Some very inexpensive music posters plus a few expensive signed posters.  For some reason there were about 10 signed Beatles posters/ $100 each - if that's your thing this is the place for you!

This is what this vet did to my dog on routine neuter. This is the WORST vet I have ever encountered in my life Dr.Neal does not give a shit about any animal under her care and she is the owner. I had to pay $2,000 to save my dogs life due to her negligence. If you care about your pets at all go literally anywhere else.

Great place, good food. Yummy pancakes. 
Cris , she's outstanding server. 
Love the call ahead reservation they have.

Wonderful. Great texture, great portion size, great flavor. Not too heavy - not too light. I had a medium serving which was definitely enough - maybe even a bit too much. Half dark chocolate, half peanut butter crunch. Yum! I'll be going back. This location is super clean and friendly staff. Plenty of outdoor seating with misters. No complaints!

I love this store for the simple fact that the staff are always friendly and eager to help. That makes shopping here so much more pleasant. Plus, the store is always clean, neat and orderly. Their stock constantly changes and don't always have what you want, which kind of sucks. But they are really nice about it. Highly recommend shopping here.

MY WIFE BROUGHT HER CAR BACK WITH LOOSE LUG NUTS!!! I would give zero stars if I could. She came in for a wobble in her front tires and was given a quote for $1800 for the car to be inspected. Mind you the inspection isn't due until April. She called me after this quote and I told her to just have them put two new tires on and mount and balance them (because I can't do that myself). Their response was "that's the least of your worries."  When she drove her car home she said the wobbling was exponentially worse when she drove the car home.
